dag: Di chɛ ka munaafichinim be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. Chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu di bɛn yuri duŋ taabu pam!.
en: Dont let those cruel liars enjoy success here. Let disaster hunt them down.

dag: Amaa ka o daa zaɣisi ninkura maa yɛligu maa wumbu, ka dolila o bipalitab bɛn min o laɣim zooi ka bɛ be o san la yɛligu.
en: But he ignored the advice of the older men and went instead to the young men who had grown up with him and who were now his advisers.

dag: ka yɛli, Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka n dan naa ti kani man ŋun nyɛ o dabili ŋɔ sanna? Ka Dauda yɛl o, N yɛn dala a kabɔɣili ŋɔ m-me sara maligu bimbini ti Yawɛ, ka di chɛ ka o vuug alɔbo ŋɔ ka chɛ niriba maa.
en: He said, Why has my lord and king come to me? David answered, I came to buy the threshing floor from you. Then I can build an altar to the Lord . Then the disease will stop.

dag: N ni yiɣisi n suhu bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka zaŋ ba leei shihirili mini bɛ ni maani shɛba ansarisi, ka yihi ba n niriba sunsuuni, ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will oppose you. I will make an example of you. I will remove you from the community of my people, so that all of you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Yɛtɔɣ suma n-kul pali n suhu ni saha shɛli n ni ŋma yilli ŋɔ ni n-yili jɛm naa. N zilinli ŋmanila gbansabir so ŋun mi yila sabbu daalikalimi.
en: Beautiful words fill my mind, as I compose this song for the king. Like the pen of a good writer my tongue is ready with a poem.

dag: Ka bɛnkam zaa daa yi n-chaŋ tiŋ maa dunol ni maa daa saɣi Hamɔr min o bia Shɛkɛm ni yɛli shɛm maa; ka dɔbba bɛn zaa daa yi n-chaŋ bɛ tiŋ maa dunol ni maa daa guni.
en: Every grown man followed this advice and got circumcised.

dag: Ka tuma zuɣulaannim maa daa kul muɣisiri ba ka yɛra, Tummiya yi tuma naari dabisili kam kaman bɛ ni yi tiri ya mɔri ka yi tumdi li shɛm maa.
en: But the slave bosses were hard on them and kept saying, Each day you have to make as many bricks as you did when you were given straw.

dag: N na bi birigi zaligu shɛli din daa yi o noli ni na, n zaŋ o noli ni yɛligu niŋ n suhu ni.
en: and I have always treasured his teachings.

dag: A ba daa ʒil ti ʒi tibisili pam, dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, filimm a ba ni daa chɛ ka ti tumdi tuun kpeen shɛŋa la, ka lan filim o ni daa ʒil ti ʒitibisi shɛl la; ka ti jɛm a.
en: Your father Solomon forced us to work very hard. But if you make our work easier, we will serve you and do whatever you ask.

dag: Aduna bidibisi yuya m-bɔŋɔ: O bituuli Nadab mini Abihu ni Ɛliɛza ni Itama.
en: These are the names of Aarons sons: Nadab the oldest, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

dag: M biyurisi, chɛliya ka ti yuri taba, dama yurilim yirila Naawuni sanna; ka ŋunkam yur o mabia nyɛla Naawuni bia, ka mi Naawuni.
en: Dear friends, lets love each other, because love is from God, and everyone who loves is born from God and knows God.

dag: Ti ni nya piɛri mini niɣi n-ku n-ti ba ka di saɣi ba? Bee ti yi gbahi teeku zahim zaa ti ba, di ni saɣi ba.
en: Could enough cattle and sheep be killed to satisfy them? Are all the fish in the sea enough for them.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ ma alahiziba n ni daa bi nya ninvuɣ so ŋun ni sɔŋ ma maa; amaa ka n suhuyiɣisili maa daa ti ma kpiɔŋ ka n di nasara n toli.
en: I looked and found no helper; I was astonished to find no supporter. But my arm brought victory for me; my wrath helped me.

dag: ka a naanyi kɔrig o Yawɛ tooni Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni.
en: Then kill the bull there in the Lord s presence at the entrance to the Meeting Tent.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn suhuri yuri Yawɛ zaligu, ka bɔhindi li ka tɛhiri di yɛla wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ.
en: Instead, they love the Lord s teachings and think about them day and night.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Yɛlim Aduna ni o kpuɣim o jaaŋgbee zuɣusaa fiɛbi taŋkpaɣu, ka taŋkpaɣu maa leei pɔri n-yɛrigi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa.
en: Then the LORD said to Moses, Tell Aaron, Stretch out your shepherds rod and hit the lands dirt so that lice appear in the whole land of Egypt.

dag: Ka o tumtumdib kpɛm maa garigi yɛl o, Tinzun paɣisar so ŋun daa doli Naomi yi Mɔab tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la m-bala.
en: The servant answered, She is the Moabite woman who came with Naomi from the country of Moab.

dag: ni Hivinim ni Arikinim ni Sinnim.
en: Hivites, Arkites, the Sinites.

dag: Di daa niŋla lala ni di chɛ ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim nya Ibrahimma ni daa nya alibarika shɛl la Yisa Masia zuɣu, ka ti zaa tooi deei Naawuni Shia Kasi so o ni daa lo ti alikauli la yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: Christ did this in order that the blessing which God promised to Abraham might be given to the Gentiles by means of Christ Jesus, so that through faith we might receive the Spirit promised by God.

dag: Ka bɛ daa du n-kpe tiŋ maa ni. Bɛ ni daa kpɛri tiŋ maa ni, ka bɛ nya Samuɛl ka o yiri ni o chaŋ sara maligu daboli maa zuɣu.
en: They went to the town, and just as they were going through the gate, Samuel was coming out on his way to the place of worship.

dag: Dinzuɣu malaikanim lee nyɛla bɔ? Bɛ nyɛla shihi bɛn jɛmdi Naawuni, ka lan nyɛ o ni timdi shɛb ka bɛ ti sɔŋdi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛn nyari tiliginsim.
en: Angels are merely spirits sent to serve people who are going to be saved.

dag: Ka Jona daa deei Yawɛ noli, ka yiɣisi chaŋ Ninive. Ninive daa nyɛla tin titali. Daba ata ka nir daa naan zaŋ chaŋ kpe di ni gari.
en: So Jonah obeyed the Lord and went to Nineveh, a city so large that it took three days to walk through it.

dag: Ka o daa kpuɣi salima mini anzinfa ni la shɛŋa zaa bɛ ni daa nya Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini nayili, ka gbahi bɛ ninvuɣ shɛba n-zaŋ ba kuli Samaria ti leei daba.
en: He took the gold and silver, as well as everything of value from the Lord 's temple and the king's treasury. He took hostages, then returned to Samaria.

dag: Cheechi shɛŋa din be Ɛsha tiŋgbɔŋ ni nim puhiri ya. Akuila mini Prisila ni cheechi din laɣindi bɛ yiŋ puuni la puhiri ya pam ti Duuma ni.
en: The churches in the province of Asia greet you. Aquila and Prisca greet you warmly in the Lord, together with the church that meets in their house.

dag: Ka Jɛrusalɛmnim daa zaŋ Ahazia ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛhɔram kaluɣi la n-leei naa zal o ba zaani; dama ŋmɛnditoya bɛn daa doli Laribunim maa ka sansani maa ni na daa ku Jɛhɔram bikpamba zaa. Dinzuɣu ka Jɛhɔram bia Ahazia daa leei Juda naa maa.
en: Earlier, when the Arabs led a raid against Judah, they killed all of Jehoram's sons, except Ahaziah, the youngest one. So the people of Jerusalem crowned him their king.

dag: Di saha ka Yɛhudianim maa daa bɔhi taba, Ya polo ka o lee yɛn chaŋ ka ti ku lan nya o? O yɛn chaŋla Yɛhudianim ni wurim chaŋ nti be Giriikinim tin shɛŋa la ni ti wuhiri Giriikinim maa yɔɣɔ.
en: These Jews said to each other, Where will this man go that we cannot find him? Will he go to the Greek cities where our people live? Will he teach the Greek people there?.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa, Naa Ahasivɛrɔs suhuyiɣisili la ni daa ti maai, di saha ka o daa teei Vashiti yɛla min o ni daa niŋ shɛm ni bɛ ni daa zali zaligu shɛli ka di di o la gba yɛla.
en: Later, even after the king's anger had cooled down, he kept thinking about what Vashti had done and about his proclamation against her.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Sulemaana daa chaŋ Ɛziɔngɛba mini Ɛlat tin shɛŋa din daa be teeku noli Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: Then Solomon went to Ezion-geber and Eloth on the coast in the land of Edom.

dag: N yɛri ya mi ni zaadali Sɔdomnim azaaba nyabu ni ti so tiŋ maa nim dini.
en: I tell you, on the judgment day it will be worse for the people of that town than for the people of Sodom.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka niriba mini bɛ paɣiba daa ti piligi kumdi pampam niŋdi bɛ dɔɣiriba bɛn nyɛ Yɛhudianim la.
en: Then there was a great protest of the people and their wives against their fellow Jews.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa mali salima bans ayi n-zaŋ li gɔhi nyolɔrigu maa puuni naŋgbanbiya, ka di miri binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa maa.
en: Two other gold rings were attached to the lower inside corners next to the vest.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli m ba Dauda, A ni lo a suhu ni ni a me jɛmbu duu ti ma maa, a niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga a ni lo lala a suhu ni maa zuɣu.
en: But the Lord said to my father, I know that you want very much to build a temple to honor me, and it is good that you want to build it.

dag: O ni ti zaŋ yi bipuɣinsi leeg o tulaalɛmaaniba min o bindir duɣiriba ni o bɔrɔbɔro shɛriba.
en: Your daughters will have to make perfume or do his cooking and baking.

dag: n-tuhi Juda Naa Ahazia dɔɣiriba soli m-bɔhi ba, Banima n-lee nyɛn ya? Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Ti nyɛla Naa Ahazia dɔɣiriba, ka kana ni ti ti kaai nabihi mini napaɣ Jɛzibɛl bidibisi.
en: he met some relatives of the late King Ahaziah of Judah and asked them, Who are you? Ahaziah's relatives, they answered. We are going to Jezreel to pay our respects to the children of Queen Jezebel and to the rest of the royal family.

dag: Nyin Yawɛ yɛligu ka m paɣira, nyin Naawuni yɛligu ka m paɣira.
en: the Lord , whose promises I praise.

dag: Di saha ka Ibrahimma daa zaŋ waagasi mini bihim ni naɣilabil kpabili so bɛ ni daa kɔrigi duɣi maa nimdi na nti zali bɛ tooni, ka ʒe bɛ sani tia maa gbini ka bɛ dira.
en: He took some cream, some milk, and the meat, and set the food before the men. There under the tree he served them himself, and they ate.

dag: Ka bɛ daa puhi suɣa tibu chuɣu kaman di ni daa sabi shɛm; ka daa maani sara shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la. Maligunim maa kalinli daa dolila zaligu ni wuhi ni bɛ maani li dabisili kam shɛm.
en: Then they celebrated the Festival of Shelters just as the Law of Moses said. They offered the right number of burnt offerings for each day of the festival.

dag: Dama n yidana ka yiŋa. O go n-chaŋla katiŋa.
en: My husband isn't at home. He's on a long trip.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Zaŋmiya yi laŋ maa bahi yi ŋariŋ maa nudirigu polo; yi yi niŋ lala yi ni nya shɛli. Ka bɛ daa niŋ lala n-gbahi zahim pam hal nti tarigi laŋ maa vɔbu zahim maa galisim zuɣu.
en: He said to them, Throw your net out on the right side of the boat, and you will catch some. So they threw the net out and could not pull it back in, because they had caught so many fish.

dag: Zuliya kam nanim kpiya dola bɛmaŋmaŋ gbala ni ni jilima;.
en: The kings of other nations lie buried with honor, each king with his own grave.

dag: Ka n yi ti lan ka yi sanna yaha, yi ni mali daliri din ni chɛ ka yi maan paɣi Yisa Masia n ni lab yi sanna maa zuɣu.
en: and to increase your pride in Christ Jesus through my presence when I visit you again.

dag: Miriya ka yi zɔri ba, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ka be yi sani ŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni ŋun galisi ka o yɛla mali dabiɛm.
en: Dont be afraid of them, because the Lord your God is with you. He is a great and awesome God.

dag: Saimɔn Isikariɔt bia Judas la yɛla ka o daa yɛri maa, dama ŋuna n-daa nyɛ ŋun ti yɛn yi o nyaaŋa ka mi nyɛ bɛ pinaayi maa ni yino la.
en: He was speaking of Judas, Simon Iscariots son, for he, one of the Twelve, was going to betray him.

dag: Ka o daa boli bibil so na nti zaŋ o zali bɛ sunsuuni.
en: Then he called a little child over to sit among the disciples.

dag: Amaa Yuria daa bi kul o yiŋa, ka daa yi nti dɔnila nayili samban dunol ni tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa guli nayili maa sani.
en: But Uriah did not go home. He slept outside the door of the kings palace, as the rest of the kings servants did.

dag: Di saha ka bia maa tizɔpaɣ maa daa bɔhi Firawuna bipuɣiŋga maa, N cham ti boli Hiburu paɣ so ŋun mali bihim na ka o ti mɔɣis a bia maa bihim ti a.
en: Then his sister asked her, Shall I go and call a Hebrew woman to nurse the baby for you.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛl o bapir maa, O kahigimi wuhi ti ni yi nya bunsi maa. Amaa Samuɛl ni daa yɛl o nam yɛtɔɣa la dina, o daa bi saɣi yɛl o di shɛli yɛla.
en: He reassured us that the donkeys had been found, Saul answered. But Saul didnt tell his uncle what Samuel had said about the kingship.

dag: Shimilan bɔri ni o nyala buni yomyom, ka bi mi ni ashaara nyɛla din yɛn kana ka biɛhiŋ kani.
en: Selfish people are in such a hurry to get rich that they do not know when poverty is about to strike.

dag: Ka bɛ niriba pirigibu balibu buyi bɛn daa paɣiri Naawuni maa zaa daa mali hal ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni. Ka zuɣulaannim pirigili daa be n sani.
en: Then the two singing groups went to their places in Gods Temple. And I stood in my place. And half the officials stood in their places in the Temple.

dag: Teem a ni daa zal a dabili Musa zaligu shɛl la yɛla. A daa yɛl o, Yi yi bi ʒe ma yim, n ni wurim ya kpɛhi zuliya shɛb ni.
en: Remember now what you told Moses: If you people of Israel are unfaithful to me, I will scatter you among the other nations.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ bɛ na kul tumdila alahichi pahira. Bɛ zaŋ kuriti mali binnana, ka baŋsimnim dooi anzinfa mali buɣa, ka di zaa nyɛ machɛl ni mali shɛli, ka bɛ yɛri niriba, Malimiya buɣa ŋɔ. Ka ninsalinim jɛmdi naɣibihi.
en: Now you continue to sin by designing and making idols of silver in the shape of calves. You are told to sacrifice to these idols — yes, even to kiss them.

dag: Dama di sabiya: Ti Duuma n-su dunia ŋɔ mini binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni.
en: The Scriptures say, The earth and everything in it belong to the Lord.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa ha daa di li tiɣi.
en: Everyone ate and had enough.

dag: A mi saha shɛli bɛ ni dooni dɔɣiri bɛ bihi? Ka a mi saha shɛli bɛ bihi maa ni yirina?.
en: They crouch, split open for their young, send forth their offspring.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛɣu deeri birapu ashilɔni ni di chɛ ka o taɣi zaligu soya.
en: Crooks accept secret bribes to keep justice from being done.

dag: Ka Gabirɛl daa kana ti zani baɣili ma. Ka dabiɛm daa gbaai ma pam, ka n lu n-dɔni tiŋa. Ka o yɛli ma, Daadam bia, n ni chɛ ka a baŋ di gbinni. Ʒii maa wuhirila dunia ŋɔ bahigu yɛla.
en: Gabriel came over, and I fell to the ground in fear. Then he said, You are merely a human, but you need to understand that this vision is about the end of time.

dag: Amaa ka Jɛhɔshafat daa bɔhi, Yawɛ daanab so lan ka tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni ka ti ni bɔh o nya.
en: But Jehoshaphat said, Doesnt the Lord have another prophet here? Lets ask him the same question.

dag: Amaa ka Rut daa yɛli Naomi, Di yɛri ma ni n labimi ka chɛ a, dama a ni kuni shɛli, nimaani ka n kuna, ka a ni kpɛri shɛli, nimaani ka n gba yɛn kpe. A niriba ni leei n niriba, ka a Naawuni leei n Naawuni.
en: Ruth answered, Please don't tell me to leave you and return home! I will go where you go, I will live where you live; your people will be my people, your God will be my God.

dag: O yuri ni o yɛli noli din bie ti niriba. Chɛ ka noli di o. O je alibarika, dinzuɣu di chɛ ka alibarika mir o.
en: Since he loved to curse, let it come back on him! Since he didnt care much for blessing, let it be far away from him!.

dag: Yawɛ jilima maa daa ŋmanila buɣim diri zoli maa zuɣu Izraɛlnim sani.
en: To the Israelites, the LORDs glorious presence looked like a blazing fire on top of the mountain.

dag: Binnamda zaa, paɣimiya Yawɛ! Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: Praise the Lord , all living creatures! Praise the Lord !.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pii fɔntinsi pinaata Isaka mini Asha ni Naftali ni Manaasa zuliya niriba pirigili bɛn be Bashan la tiŋgbana ni ti Gɛrishɔn daŋ niriba.
en: The descendants of Gershon acquired thirteen cities by lot from the clans of the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and the half of Manasseh located in Bashan.

dag: ni yi niɣi mini biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, binshɛɣukam din ti yɛn bili yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni na ni ti nyɛla bindirigu.
en: your domestic animals, and the wild animals in your fields. Everything that it produces may be eaten.

dag: Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka ti bi tumdi tuumbiɛri ni di tahi zaɣ viɛlli na? Lala ka ninvuɣ shɛb zuri nyaaŋa yɛri ni lala ka n shiri wuhiri niriba. Bɛn yɛl lala maa simdi tibidarigibo.
en: It would be the same to say, We should do evil so that good will come. Many people criticize us, saying thats what we teach. They are wrong, and they should be condemned for saying that.

dag: Yi tuumbiɛri n-chɛ ka m-mɔŋ ya dimbɔŋɔnima, ka yi daalahichi mɔŋ ya din viɛla.
en: Instead, your sins have kept these good things from you.

dag: Ka o daa shiri zaŋ bɛ zaa niŋ sarika ni daba ata.
en: Then Joseph put them all in prison for three days.

dag: Tumtumdiba yi di n-tiɣi bee bɛ yi bi di n-tiɣi, bɛ yi dɔni, bɛ gbihirimi pali bɛ nina, amaa bundana ŋun buni zuɣu chɛmi ka o gaani gom.
en: If you have to work hard for a living, you can rest well at night, even if you don't have much to eat. But if you are rich, you can't even sleep.

dag: Ka bɛ kɔŋ o garigibu.
en: But they were not able to answer him about this.

dag: Ŋunkam ku ninsala, bɛn kum o.
en: Any who commit murder shall be put to death.

dag: Suhupiɛlli nyɛla tila suŋ, amaa suhugarigu din nyɛla din kuuri kɔba.
en: Happiness is good medicine, but sorrow is a disease.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa boli Musa Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la ni n-yɛl o:.
en: So the Lord called out to Moses from inside the Meeting Tent and said.

dag: ka lan laɣim nyu binnyur yini; dama Naawuni ni daa ti ba kuɣ shɛli ka di doli ba la kom ka bɛ daa nyura. Masia mi n-daa nyɛ kuɣili maa.
en: and drank the same spiritual drink, which flowed from the spiritual rock that followed them. That rock was Christ.

dag: Ka shɛb yi tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni, chɛliya ka bɛ niriba ata bee ayi kɔŋko n-tɔɣisiri ka tiri taba; ka chɛ ka so wuhi di gbinni.
en: When you meet together, if anyone speaks to the group in a different language, it should be only two or no more than three people who do this. And they should speak one after the other. And someone else should interpret what they say.

dag: Hal yi zuɣu ka Yawɛ je suli niŋ ma yɛli, A gba ku kpe tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Because of you the Lord also became angry with me and said, Not even you, Moses, will enter the land.

dag: M mabihi, m bi tɛhi ni m pun nya li, amaa n ni niŋdi bin yini shɛli nyɛla n tamdila binshɛɣukam din be n nyaaŋa yɛla, ka kul kpaŋdi mmaŋa ni m paala din be n tooni.
en: My friends, I don't feel I have already arrived. But I forget what is behind, and I struggle for what is ahead.

dag: Sool bia Ishibɔshɛt yuma daa nyɛla yuun pihinahi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam n-su Izraɛlnim maa, o daa dila nam maa yuma ayi. Amaa Judanim bɛn daa dolila Dauda.
en: Ish Bosheth son of Saul was years old when he began to rule over Israel. He ruled Israel two years, but the tribe of Judah followed David.

dag: Ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa lan lo tab alikauli Yawɛ tooni, ka Jɔnatan daa kuli, ka Dauda mi kpalim be Hɔrɛshi.
en: Then the two of them made a covenant before the LORD. David stayed at Horesh, but Jonathan went back home.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni lan me Ziɔn, o ni kana ni o jilima.
en: because the LORD will rebuild Zion; he will be seen there in his glory.

dag: Bɛ zaŋdila jɛrilim n-dihi bɛn tɛha bi zilima nachiinsi, amaa baŋsim n-nyɛ yɛnnim zuɣupila.
en: Stupidity is the lot of the naive, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ yi gba: Yi yi tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛtɔɣ shɛli so ni bi mi, wula ka so ni tooi baŋ di gbinni? Di yi nyɛ lala, dindina yi tɔɣisiri bahirila pɔhim ni yoli.
en: In the same way, how will anyone understand what you are talking about if your message given in strange tongues is not clear? Your words will vanish in the air!.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Jɛdiayɛl daŋ ni niriba, ka daa nyɛ zuɣulaannima bɛ daŋ maa ni. Bɛn daa nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi ka ni tooi chaŋ tɔbu kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pinaayopɔin ni kɔbisiyi.
en: All these were Jediaels family, heads of their households, and mighty warriors. There were , ready for battle.

dag: O yi kana, Kɛilanim ni gbaai ma ti o? O shiri nyɛla ŋun ni kana kaman mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni wum shɛm maa? Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, n suhir a, yɛlim mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ. Ka Yawɛ garigi yɛl o, O ni kana.
en: Will Saul come to Keilah? Will the people of Keilah give me to Saul? Lord , God of Israel, I am your servant. Please tell me! The Lord answered, Saul will come.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛli garigi yɛl o, Cham ni suhudoo. Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ ni deeg a suhigu maa, ka ti a a ni suh o shɛli maa.
en: Go in peace, Eli said, and may the God of Israel give you what you have asked him for.

dag: Ka a nuu bee a napɔŋ yi chɛ ka a yɛn birigi tum alahichi, nyin ŋmaam li bahi, dama a yi kɔŋ a nu yini bee a napɔn yini ka ti be, di so ni a mali nuh ayi bee napɔna ayi ka bɛ ti zaŋ a kpɛhi buɣim din bi kpiri ni.
en: If your hand or your foot causes you to fall into sin, chop it off and throw it away. Its better to enter into life crippled or lame than to be thrown into the eternal fire with two hands or two feet.

dag: N di kul gbilisirila tibili, amaa yɛlimaŋli, yi ni so bi wuhi ni Ayuba mali taali bee n-garig o yɛtɔɣa maa shɛli.
en: I was attentive to you, but you offered no rebuke to Job, no answer from you for his words.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa yɛl o ni o bom naa ti ba maa Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaa.
en: Samuel told the people who were asking for a king what the Lord had said:.

dag: Ka o kpamba daa yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛri din gari lala n-jɛndi ti Duuma NAAWUNI min o dabili Hɛzɛkia.
en: The Assyrian officials said even worse things about the Lord God and Hezekiah, the Lord 's servant.

dag: ka bɛ gahi bɛ kulipal tab nuu ni bɛ kana ti sɔŋ ba. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti sɔŋ ba, ka bɛ yihi zahim maa pali ŋarima ayi maa zaa hal ka di ti yɛn shim.
en: Then they signaled for their partners in the other boat to come and help them. The men came, and together they filled the two boats so full that they both began to sink.

dag: Ka n chɛ ka Izraɛlnim zaa daadambiɛligu nabi, ka niriba ʒini yi fɔntinsi ni, ka yi lab me luɣ shɛŋa din daa bahi yol la.
en: There will be many people living on you. The whole family of Israel—all of them—will live there. The cities will have people living in them. The destroyed places will be rebuilt.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa yɛli naa, N ni daa be n ya ka wum a yɛla ni a yɛm yɛla shɛm shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: She said to King Solomon, What I heard in my own country about you and your wisdom is true!.

dag: Ka Dauda suhu daa ti lu yiŋ ni ka o yɛli, N di bi zaɣisi ka so chaŋ Bɛtilihɛm ti tooi kɔbil shɛli din do di dunol shee la ni kom na ti ti ma ka n nyu.
en: David grew homesick and said, How I wish someone would bring me a drink of water from the well by the gate at Bethlehem.

dag: Dama di simdi ni yɛm yɛtɔɣa yiri maligumaana nol ni na, ka niriba ni bɔr o wuhibu, dama o nyɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ tumo.
en: The lips of the priest should guard knowledge; everyone should seek Instruction from his mouth, for he is the messenger from the LORD of heavenly forces.

dag: Amaa o ni yɛli shɛm maa yi nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, ka shɛhira shɛli kani din wuhiri ni paɣisarili maa daa nyɛla ŋun pali.
en: But if the man was right and there is no proof that his bride was a virgin.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun be yi tooni ŋɔ maŋmaŋ ni tuhi tɔbu maa tin ya kaman o ni daa kul niŋ shɛm Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni yi ninni la.
en: The Lord our God will lead the way. He will fight on our side, just as he did when we saw him do all those things to the Egyptians.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa daa yihi saliŋ shɛŋa din be bɛ tiba ni n-zaŋ na ti ti Aduna.
en: So all the people took out the gold rings from their ears and brought them to Aaron.

dag: Dama di niŋ kamaata ni o diri nam hal ti nyaŋ o dimnim zaa n-du n-tam bɛ zuɣu.
en: Christ will rule until he puts all his enemies under his power.

dag: Maligumaana yi yɛn kpe dundɔŋ maa ni, di bi simdi ka o nyu wain.
en: None of the priests should drink wine when they come into the inner courtyard.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna ka bɛ ni ti kana ti kpuɣi binshɛɣukam zaa din be a yili ŋɔ min a yaannim ni daa bo binshɛɣukam zali zaŋ kana pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ n-kuli Babilɔn; ka di shɛli ku guui, Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: One day everything you and your ancestors have stored up will be taken to Babylonia. The Lord has promised that nothing will be left.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ Yawɛ ninvuɣ gahinda ŋɔ, lumiy o sizuura; dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lur o sizuura binshɛli bi poori ba.
en: You who are the LORDs holy ones, honor him, because those who honor him dont lack a thing.

dag: Ka Kalɛb daa ŋme n-kari Anaki bidibis ata bɛn daa nyɛ: Shɛshai mini Ahiman ni Talimai bɛn daa nyɛ ŋun Anaki zuliya la bahi.
en: Caleb attacked Hebron and forced the three Anakim clans of Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai to leave.

dag: N sabi n zaligunim paai ʒiibutuhili ti ba, amaa ka bɛ zaɣisi li, ka tɛhi ni di nyɛla zaɣ pala.
en: My instructions for sacrifices were written in detail, but you ignored them.

dag: Tarim ŋɔ daa kuhiya, ka Yawɛ wum, ka yih o o muɣisigu kam zaa ni.
en: As a poor, helpless man I prayed to the Lord , and he heard me. He saved me from all my troubles.

dag: Babilɔnnim gbahibu maa vuri ni ti chɛ ka tiŋgbani dam, ka zuliya kam ti wum bɛ kuhigu.
en: The sounds of your destruction will be heard among the nations, and the earth will shake.

dag: Zaligunim ŋɔ ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Musa zali Izraɛlnima Mɔab bɔpiɛligu ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli zaŋ labi Jɛriko polo la.
en: These are the rules and regulations that the Lord gave the Israelites through Moses in the plains of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli ma shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Deemi suhuyiɣisili wain pipia ŋɔ n nuu ni n-chɛ ka n ni yɛn tim a zuliya shɛb sani ŋɔ zaa nyu li.
en: The Lord , the God of Israel, said this to me: Jeremiah, take this cup of wine from my hand. It is the wine of my anger. I am sending you to different nations. Make all the nations drink from this cup.

dag: Mɔabnim yudua la naaya. Bɛ lo ba zaɣ biɛɣu Hɛshibɔn. Kamiyana ka ti wurim li, ka di ku lan beni. Ka nyini yinyahi tiŋ ŋɔ gba, bɛ ni ti chɛ ka a fo. Takɔb ni ti dol a.
en: No one honors you, Moab. In Heshbon, enemies make plans to end your life. My sword will leave only silence in your town named Quiet.

dag: a yi shiri bo yɛm, ka moog a nini bahi tɛhi zilima zuɣu.
en: Yes, beg for knowledge; plead for insight.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ ba alahiziba pam ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Bɔtaa nira n-lee bɔŋɔ hal ka sanʒiɛɣu mini kɔgbana ti wumd o noli.
en: Overcome with awe, they said to each other, Who then is this? Even the wind and the sea obey him.

dag: Sabimi n-ti Laodisia Cheechi malaika n-yɛl o ni ŋun nyɛ Ami, ka be tibi, ka nyɛ yɛlimaŋli shɛhiralana ni ŋun daa tab Naawuni binshɛɣukam nambu ni la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Write this to the angel of the church in Laodicea: Here is a message from the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the ruler of all that God has made.

dag: N ni kpuɣi n tiliginsim pipia zuɣusaa, ka kuhi boli Yawɛ yuli.
en: I will bring a wine offering to the Lord , to thank him for saving me.

dag: Bɛ kɔŋko ka bɛ daa zaŋ tiŋgbani maa ti, ka sana daa bi gari bɛ ni.
en: Their land was free from foreigners; there was no one to lead them away from God.

dag: Ka Pita yɛl o, N Duuma, di yi nyɛla nyini m-bala, nyin chɛ ka n tam kom ŋɔ zuɣu ka a sanna.
en: Peter replied, Lord, if its you, order me to come to you on the water.

dag: Amaa man kul ni lihirila Yawɛ. N ni guhirila Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n tiligir ŋɔ. N Naawuni ni wum n suhigu.
en: But I trust the Lord God to save me, and I will wait for him to answer my prayer.

dag: M mini ya n-yi be Naawuni jɛmbu duu dabisili kam ka n wuhiri ya, ka yi bi gbaai ma. Amaa dimbɔŋɔ niŋmi ni Naawuni Kundi yɛligu la niŋ pali.
en: Day after day I was with you teaching in the Temple, and you did not arrest me. But the Scriptures must come true.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daba ayi ka Gomna Filiksi min o paɣ Drusila ŋun daa nyɛ Yɛhudia paɣ la daa ti kana n-tim ti boli Pool na ni bɛ ti wum Yisa Masia yɛla o sani.
en: After some days Felix came with his wife Drusilla, who was Jewish. He sent for Paul and listened to him as he talked about faith in Christ Jesus.

dag: Yawɛ zɔbu nyɛla din tir nir nyɛvili ni yɛlimaŋli, ka di yi be nir kɔbili ni, o ni mali alaafee, ka barina shɛli ku paag o.
en: Showing respect to the Lord brings true life— if you do it, you can relax without fear of danger.

dag: Malimiya zoligo! Dama ninvuɣ kubo kul palila tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka damli dambu pali tiŋ puuni.
en: Everything is in confusion —the land is full of murders and the cities are full of violence.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛli, Chimham ni doli ma kuli ka n ti niŋ o a ni nya ka shɛli viɛl a sani, ka a suhu ni kul yu ni n niŋ shɛlikam zaa, n ni niŋ li ti a.
en: The king answered, I will take him with me and do for him whatever you want. And I will do for you anything you ask.

dag: Puri dola zaɣ nɛya; ka tiŋgbani fabinda, dama bindira saɣimya zaa, ka wain naai, ka kpam gba lan kani.
en: The fields are devastated, the ground mourns; for the grain is destroyed, the new wine dries up, the olive oil fails.

dag: Ka Yawɛ bɔh o, Bɔ n-lee be a nuu ni ŋɔ? Ka o yɛli, Jaaŋgbee.
en: The Lord answered, What's that in your hand? A walking stick, Moses replied.

dag: N yɛli Yawɛ, Nyini n-nyɛ n Duuma; n ka bin sun shɛli pahila nyini.
en: and I have said, Only you are my Lord! Every good thing I have is a gift from you.

dag: Ka Pita daa gbaai yɛla maa yiniyini n-kahigiri wuhiri ba yɛra:.
en: So Peter gave them a complete account of what had happened from the very beginning:.

dag: a ni ti bɔhim bɛ biɛhigu maa, ka di chɛ ka a kpɛh amaŋ zana ni.
en: You might turn out like them and get caught in a trap.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun su binshɛɣukam, ka nyɛ bɛ ni zo so dabiɛm, ŋuna n-chɛ ka suhudoo be o daalizanda din be zuɣusaa ŋɔ ni.
en: Supreme power and awe belong to God; he establishes peace on his heights.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna ka bɛ ni ti kana ti kpuɣi binshɛɣukam zaa din be a yili ŋɔ min a yaannim ni daa bo binshɛɣukam zali zaŋ kana pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ n-kuli Babilɔn; ka di shɛli ku guui, Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: a time is coming when everything in your palace, everything that your ancestors have stored up to this day, will be carried off to Babylonia. Nothing will be left.

dag: Nir ni tooi dɔɣi bihi kɔbiga, ka beni n-yuui pam, hal o yi yuui ti yaɣi gba, amaa ka bi di dunia ŋɔ binyara nyaɣisim, ka ti bi nya sɔɣiri viɛlli, dindina man ni yɛli shɛm nyɛla, Zaŋbahi so o.
en: Some people may have one hundred children and live a long life. But no matter how long they live, if they arent content with lifes good things, I say that even a stillborn child with no grave is better off than they are.

dag: ka Gidiɔni bia Abidan daa nyɛ Bɛnjamin zuliya zuɣulana.
en: and Abidan son of Gideoni was in command of the tribe of Benjamin.

dag: Ka Ɛlikana min o yiŋnim zaa daa ti chaŋ Naawuni sani ni bɛ yaa ti mali yuuniyuuni sara la Yawɛ sani, ka pal o ni daa lo alikauli shɛl la.
en: When Elkanah and all his household went up to make the annual sacrifice and keep his solemn promise.

dag: N suhir a mi, chɛli mani ŋun nyɛ a dabipaɣ ŋɔ taali. Dama biɛhiŋ kani, Yawɛ ni me a yili a ni tuhiri ŋun Yawɛ tɔb shɛli ŋɔ zuɣu; ka a ku tum zaɣ biɛɣu hal ni a nyɛvili tariga.
en: Please forgive me, sir, for any wrong I have done. The Lord will make you king, and your descendants also, because you are fighting his battles; and you will not do anything evil as long as you live.

dag: Amaa yimaŋmaŋ tumdi tab taali ka diri tab zalinsi, hal yimaŋmaŋ mabihi ka yi niŋdi lala maa.
en: But instead you are doing wrong and cheating—and youre doing it to your own brothers and sisters.

dag: Iso ni daa wum o ba ni yɛl o shɛm maa, ka o kum suhusaɣiŋgu kumsi pam ka yɛl o ba, M ba, niŋm alibarika niŋ n gba ni.
en: When Esau heard his fathers words, he became very angry and bitter. He cried out and said to his father, Then bless me also, father.

dag: Yawɛ, kokpɛɣu kpuɣi zani, kokpɛɣu duhi di yee, kokpɛɣu gbaai vubu.
en: Lord , the ocean roars. The mighty ocean sounds like thunder as the waves crash on the shore.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan yɛli, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, ŋun Yawɛ ni ku o bee o kum dali yi paai, o ni kpi bee ŋun chaŋ tɔb ni ka bɛ ti ku o.
en: As surely as the Lord lives, the Lord himself will punish Saul. Maybe Saul will die naturally or maybe he will be killed in battle.

dag: Mbusim be yi zuɣu, yi zali yiya tuɣi taba, ka gbahi paliti tuɣi taba hal ka so ti ku lan nya palo nimaani pahi yi zuɣu, ka yi kɔŋko n-kul be tiŋgbani maa ni.
en: You are in for trouble! You take over house after house and field after field, until there is no room left for anyone else in all the land.

dag: N daa na ʒi n-zaŋ n noli tum alahichi din nyɛ n yɛli noli ni bɛ kpi.
en: I didnt let my mouth sin by asking for their life with a curse.

dag: O ni daa di bindirigu maa ka nyu kom naai nyaaŋa ka o daa pa buŋ nyaampara ti o ni daa bol a anab so labisina maa.
en: After he ate food and drank, the old prophet saddled the donkey for the prophet he had brought back.

dag: N ni chɛ ka dabiɛm gbahi Ɛlamnim bɛ dimnim bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ba sani. N ni yiɣisi n suhu pam bahi bɛ zuɣu n-chɛ ka yɛlibiɛɣu lu bɛ zuɣu. N ni chɛ ka tɔbu lu bɛ zuɣu hal ka n ti kpihim bɛ birili. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will terrify Elam before their enemies, before those who seek to kill them. I will bring disaster upon them, my fierce anger, declares the LORD. I will send the sword to attack them until I have destroyed them all.

dag: Naawuni dan ya la shaara, dinzuɣu di leeya ninsalinim daba.
en: You were bought and paid for. Dont become slaves of people.

dag: Amaa zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛlnim polo, Naawuni yɛliya: Biɛɣ asiba zaŋ hal ni yuŋ ka n kul teegi n nuhi n-gahiri booni tipawumlinim bɛn nyɛ duntaariba ŋɔ.
en: But he says about Israel, All day long I stretched out my hands to a disobedient and contrary people. .

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ yɛnnim ŋɔ, yi diri jɛra suɣilo ni suhupiɛlli!.
en: And since you are so smart, you will gladly put up with a fool.

dag: Ka Pita gbaag o nuu ni n-yiɣis o zali; ka boli Yisa nyaandoliba maa mini pakoya maa na nti zaŋ Dɔɔkas ŋun lan niŋ nyɛvililan maa ti ba.
en: He gave her his hand and raised her up. Then he called Gods holy people, including the widows, and presented her alive to them.

dag: Di zaa yoli Yawɛ daa bi bɔr ni o bahi Dauda daŋ maa yoli, o ni daa lo Dauda alikauli shɛl la zuɣu. O daa lo Dauda alikauli ni o ni zaŋ nam ti o min o zuliya ka bɛ be kaman firila la sahakam.
en: but the Lord was not willing to destroy the dynasty of David, because he had made a covenant with David and promised that his descendants would always continue to rule.

dag: Piɛri ni ti a situra, ka a buhi mi yo a palo samli.
en: Cut the wool from your lambs, and make your clothes. Sell some of your goats, and buy some land.

dag: daa tim ka bɛ chaŋ yiliguliba dundɔŋ ni ti zaŋ Jɛrimia na; ka bɛ daa zaŋ o niŋ Ahikam bia Gɛdalia ŋun daa nyɛ Shafan yaaŋa la nuu ni ni o zaŋ o kuli. Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu daa chɛ ka o be omaŋmaŋ niriba sani.
en: sent orders to release Jeremiah from the prison quarters. They entrusted him to Gedaliah, Ahikams son and Shaphans grandson, so that Jeremiah could move about freely among the people.

dag: Ka doo maa daa wuhi ba so shɛli din kuni tiŋ maa ni, ka Yisifu zuliya niriba maa daa kpe tiŋ maa ni ti zaŋ takɔbi ku tiŋ maa nima. Amaa ka daa chɛ do so ŋun wuhi ba tiŋ maa soli maa min o malibu ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: The man showed the spies the secret way into the city. The men of Joseph used their swords to kill the people of Bethel. But they did not hurt the man who helped them or anyone in his family. The man and his family were allowed to go free.

dag: O kalinsi nyaaŋa ka o bia Amazia daa di nam zan o zaani. Bɛ sabi o bidibisi yɛla mini bɛ ni daa tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa pam jɛnd o la ni o ni daa mali Naawuni jɛmbu duu me shɛm la, niŋ Nanim yɛlikura litaafi ni.
en: The story about Joashs sons, the great prophecies against him, and how he rebuilt Gods Temple are written in the book, Commentary on the Kings . Joashs son Amaziah became the new king after him.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa daa bɔhi ba, Tuun dini n-lee simdi tumbu Vuhim Dabisili dali: Tuun viɛlli bee tuun biɛɣu; din ni tiligi ninsal nyɛvili bee din ni di li? Ka bɛ daa fo.
en: Then he asked the people, What does our Law allow us to do on the Sabbath? To help or to harm? To save someone's life or to destroy it? But they did not say a thing.

dag: O duhir o yee zama pam ni, ka tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa fɔntinsi dunɔdaya gbini.
en: Above the noisy crowd, she calls out. At the entrances of the city gates, she has her say.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Ashaara niŋbu din doli taba, nyama, dina n-kanna ŋɔ.
en: The LORD God proclaims: Disaster! A singular disaster! Look, it comes!.

dag: Sulemaana ni daa tum Yawɛ jɛmbu duu tuma maa zaa naai, ka o daa zaŋ o ba Naa Dauda ni daa pun zaŋ neen shɛŋa din daa nyɛ anzinfa mini salima ni la shɛŋa zaa ti Naawuni la nti zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa nɛma zaashee.
en: After the Lord 's temple was finished, Solomon put in its storage rooms everything that his father David had dedicated to the Lord , including the gold and silver, and the objects used in worship.

dag: Bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ yɔhindiba pam be dunia ŋɔ ni pumpɔŋɔ. Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi saɣi ni Yisa Masia daa leei ninsala n-ka dunia ŋɔ ni na. Ninvuɣ so ŋun yɛl lala nyɛla ninvuɣ yɔhinda ni Masiachihira.
en: Many deceivers have gone out over the world, people who do not acknowledge that Jesus Christ came as a human being. Such a person is a deceiver and the Enemy of Christ.

dag: ka nya so ka o ʒe di sunsuuni ŋ-ŋmani daadam. O daa yɛla binyɛr wɔɣinli din chaŋ ti lim o napɔnvari, ka salima nyolɔrigu lo o nyɔɣu.
en: There with the lampstands was someone who seemed to be the Son of Man. He was wearing a robe that reached down to his feet, and a gold cloth was wrapped around his chest.

dag: mini Pateesa shɛŋa din yili dundɔŋ ni zaŋ tabili pateesa shɛli din daa yili dundɔŋ ni dunol ni n-liri Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili mini sara maligu bimbin la ni di mihi zaŋ tabili di tuuni kam fukumsi.
en: the curtains for the court which is around the Tent and the altar, and the curtain for the entrance of the court. They were responsible for all the service connected with these items.

dag: ni firila kpam ni tulaale din ni mali kpa shɛli bɛ ni boori bahiri niriba zuɣu ni la ni tulaale zim din nyom viɛla.
en: the oil for the light; spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet-smelling incense.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Musa mini Aduna ni salo maa kpamba daa kali Kɔhatinima kaman bɛ daŋ niriba mini bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: So Moses, Aaron, and the chiefs of the community enrolled the Kohathites by their clans and their households.

dag: Sintani ni daa zahim Yisa zahimbu balibu kam ŋɔ zaa naai ka o daa na chɛ o, ka lan bɔri so shɛli yaha.
en: The devil finished tempting Jesus in every way and went away to wait until a better time.

dag: Gbibiya yimaŋa ka di ti tamya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yɛla, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi kɔŋ n ni zaŋ o fukumsi zalikpana mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi tiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ gbibbu.
en: Be careful. Dont forget the Lord your God! Be careful to obey the commands, laws, and rules that I give you today.

dag: ni Kain ni Gibia ni Timna: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔntiŋ kara pia m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah. In total: ten cities and their surrounding areas.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, A ni tam n yɛla, ka zaŋ ma niŋ a baɣaka zuɣu, dim a pagɔrisigu min a kɔre tuma maa nyɔri.
en: Now this is what the Sovereign Lord is saying: Because you forgot me and turned your back on me, you will suffer for your lust and your prostitution.

dag: kaman o ni daa lo ti yaannim bɛn nyɛ Ibrahimma min o zuliya alikauli shɛli hal ni saha din ka bahigu la.
en: He has done what he promised to our ancestors, to Abraham and his children forever.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu ka o lo ti alikauli kara din mali buchi ni di chɛ ka ti yi dunia ŋɔ niŋgbuŋ kɔr biɛri din saɣindi ninsalinim la ni, ka ti min o laɣim mali Naawunitali biɛhigu.
en: God made great and marvelous promises, so his nature would become part of us. Then we could escape our evil desires and the corrupt influences of this world.

dag: di saha yi ni ti boli ma, amaa ka n ku garigi ya. Yi ni ti bo ma ni nimmoo, amaa ka ku nya ma.
en: You will ask for my help, but I won't listen; you will search, but you won't find me.

dag: N nya yɛl biɛ shɛli dunia ŋɔ ni, ka di nyɛ din ʒi daadamnim zuɣu.
en: I saw a tragedy under the sun, and it weighs heavily upon humanity.

dag: Ti yipa baŋya ni a mi binshɛɣukam zaa, ka di bi lan simdi ni so vih a; dimbɔŋɔ chɛ ka ti baŋ ni a shiri yila Naawuni sanna.
en: We know now that you know everything; you do not need to have someone ask you questions. This makes us believe that you came from God.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ʒi ba lab Shɛkɛm tiŋgbɔŋ ni ti sɔɣi ba ti yab Ibrahimma ni daa zaŋ anzinfa laɣipiɛligu da sil shɛli Hamɔr bihi san la ni.
en: Later, their bodies were moved to Shechem, where they were put in a tomb. It was the same tomb that Abraham had bought in Shechem from the sons of Hamor. He paid them with silver.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti kpe o yilikpɛrili ka o nyaandoliba bɔh o ashilɔni, Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka tinim di bi tooi kari alizin birigu maa bahi.
en: Then Jesus went into the house. His followers were alone with him there. They said, Why werent we able to force that evil spirit out.

dag: Di saha ka Yisahaku daa boli Yaakubu na ti niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni ka yɛl o, Miri ka a kpuɣi Keenan paɣa.
en: So Isaac summoned Jacob, blessed him, and gave him these orders: Dont marry a Canaanite woman.

dag: Ka Jɛshua bia Ɛzɛr ŋun daa nyɛ Mizipa naa la daa mali me gooni din be bɛ ni duri luɣ shɛli chani tɔb nɛma ni be luɣ shɛli gooni maa gɔŋbu shee tooni la m-pan o zuɣu.
en: Ezer son of Jeshua, who ruled Mizpah, rebuilt the section of the wall that was in front of the armory and reached to the corner of the wall;.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa nya ka tuumbiɛri n-kul be dunia ŋɔ ni, dama sokam zaa daa kul dolila tuumbiɛri soli.
en: God saw that the earth was corrupt, because all creatures behaved corruptly on the earth.

dag: Ka Sintani yi ŋmaligi tuhir omaŋa o ku tooi be, amaa o bahigu n-yɛn bala.
en: So if Satan's kingdom divides into groups, it cannot last, but will fall apart and come to an end.

dag: Ka yi beni duhiri yimaŋa! Di di bi simdi ni yi fabindimi? Yihimiya ninvuɣ so ŋun tum lala maa yi ni.
en: You are proud, when you ought to feel bad enough to chase away anyone who acts like this.

dag: Ka Jɛhiɛl bia Obadia daa nyɛ Jɔab daŋ zuɣulana, ka dɔbba kɔbisiyi ni pisaayika daa pah o zuɣu.
en: of Joab, Obadiah, Jehiels son and with him men.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti ʒini n-diri bindirigu maa ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, m mini yinim bɛn laɣim diri ŋɔ ni yino ni yi n nyaaŋa.
en: During the meal, Jesus said, I assure you that one of you will betray me—someone eating with me.

dag: Bɛ ni voo li to ba ka di pili yi bɛ niŋgbuna ni. Ka di naŋgban dirili maa pili yi bɛ binsom ni; ka dabiɛm gbahi ba.
en: They pull it out, but it sticks out from their backs; its shaft in their liver brings terror.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ma, A bi mi di ni nyɛ shɛli? Ka n garigi yɛli, N dana, m bi mi.
en: He said to me, Dont you know what these are? I said, No, sir.

dag: Bɛ ni ti daag a niŋ gballi ni, ka a kpi gadama niŋbu kum teeku bulli maa ni.
en: They will hurl you to destruction, and you will die, murdered, on the high seas.

dag: Ka o yɛli, N Duuma, bɛ ni so bi lan yɛl lala. Ka Yisa yɛl o, Man gba bi yɛli ni a simdi kubu. Cham a chandi, amaa ka di lan tum alahichi yaha. .
en: She answered, No one, sir. Then Jesus said, I dont judge you either. You can go now, but dont sin again.

dag: Reechɛl ni daa dɔɣi Yisifu nyaaŋa ka Yaakubu daa yɛli Leeban, Bahim ma ka n kuli n ya ni n yiŋa.
en: After the birth of Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, Now let me go back to my own homeland.

dag: din ni chɛ ka n gbibi n ni daa po pɔ shɛli yi yaannim sani ni n ni zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam ti ba kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ ŋɔ. Di saha ka n daa garigi yɛli, Yawɛ, lala n-nyɛ li.
en: I did this to keep the promise that I had made to your ancestors. I promised to give them a very fertile land—a land flowing with milk and honey. And you are living in that country today. I answered, Amen, Lord .

dag: N ni chɛ ka a kul nyɛ dabari sahakam, ka so ku lan ʒini a fɔntinsi ni yaha. Di saha ka a baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will make you empty forever. No one will live in your cities. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Nyama, buɣim pun yi zuɣusaa na ti di n-ku sapashinnima ayi la mini bɛ tɔbbihi pihinunu, amaa tiligim man nyɛvili.
en: Look, fire came from the sky and burned up the two earlier commanders and their troops of fifty soldiers. Please have regard for my life.

dag: Yisa ni daa neei kum ni bakɔi piligu dali asibaasi maa o daa tuui yila Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la zuɣu. Ŋuna n-nyɛ Yisa ni daa kari alizin biɛri ayopɔin so zuɣu la.
en: Very early on the first day of the week, after Jesus had risen to life, he appeared to Mary Magdalene. Earlier he had forced seven demons out of her.

dag: Ka sagbani daa sirigina ti pili Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa, ka Yawɛ jilima daa pal o biɛhigu shee maa.
en: Suddenly the sacred tent was covered by a thick cloud and filled with the glory of the Lord .

dag: dama n sani, m bia ŋɔ daa kpimi ka lan neei na, o daa bɔrigimi ka n lan nya o yaha. Ka bɛ daa dii gbaai diɛma diɛmbu ni suhupiɛlli.
en: My son was dead, but now he is alive again! He was lost, but now he is found! So they began to have a party.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yi sara maligu gbaliŋ la pa shɛli n sani. Yi ni zaŋdi piɛla bihi shɛb mini biŋkɔb suma kpa shɛli yi ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maani sara la, n nyee nyɔni li. N kɔre ka naɣilahi mini piɛla bihi ni buhi ʒim ni.
en: The Lord says, Why do you continue giving me all these sacrifices? I have had enough of your sacrifices of rams and the fat from well-fed animals. I dont want the blood of those bulls, sheep, and goats.

dag: Amaa ka Firawuna bipuɣiŋga la daa yiɣisi Dauda tiŋ la ni n-kul omaŋmaŋ yil shɛli Sulemaana ni daa me n-ti o la ni. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa me ŋ-ŋari luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Millo la.
en: Solomon's wife, the daughter of the king of Egypt, moved from the older part of Jerusalem to her new palace. Then Solomon had the land on the east side of Jerusalem filled in.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni wuh a so shɛli a ni yɛn doli; n shiri ni wuh a a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm ka gul a.
en: You said to me, I will point out the road that you should follow. I will be your teacher and watch over you.

dag: Ka din daa lu gɔhi ni la mi ŋmanila bɛn wum Naawuni yɛligu, ka ŋmaligi chaŋ ha ka dunia ŋɔ yɛliniŋda mini azichi yubo ni kɔre balibu kam chɛ ka di bi dɔɣi niŋ biɛlim.
en: What about the seed that fell among the thorny weeds? That is like the people who hear Gods teaching, but they let the worries, riches, and pleasures of this life stop them from growing. So they never produce a crop.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ o dabili Izraɛl zuliya, ka lan nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ o ninvuɣ gahinda ŋɔ!.
en: you who are the offspring of Israel, his servant, and the children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

dag: Di daa ʒiɛla Ijipti tɔbbihi mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi sunsuuni. Sagbani maa daa nyɛla zibisim Ijiptinim polo, ka nyɛ neesim Izraɛlnim polo yuŋ zaa ka bɛ so daa bi tooi mir o kpee yuŋ maa zaa.
en: In this way the cloud stood between the Egyptians and the Israelites. There was light for the Israelites. But there was darkness for the Egyptians. So the Egyptians did not come any closer to the Israelites that night.

dag: ka nyɛ bɛn daa kpalim be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ka Izraɛlnim daa bi ku ba la zuliya ka Sulemaana daa zaŋ leeg o daba ka bɛ tumdi tuun kpɛma hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: that is, the descendants of such people who were still in the land because the Israelites werent able to destroy them—Solomon forced into the labor gangs that are still in existence today.

dag: N-daa lan yi biɛɣu dabisi shɛli din pahir ayi goli palli dabisili maa nyaaŋa, ka Dauda ʒiishee maa na kul nyɛla zaɣ kuŋ. Di saha ka Sool daa bɔh o dapala Jɔnatan, Bɔ n-niŋ ka Jɛsi dapala ŋɔ bi kana bindirigu dibu shee ŋɔ sɔhila bee zuŋɔ.
en: On the next day, the second day of the month, Davids place was empty again. Then Saul said to his son Jonathan, Why didnt Jesses son come to the New Moon celebration yesterday or today.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba maa ni daa ʒiya diri bindirigu maa ka o zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka ŋmahiŋmahi li zaŋ ti ba ka yɛli, N niŋgbuŋ m-bala; zaŋmiya li ŋubi.
en: While they were eating, Jesus took a piece of bread, gave a prayer of thanks, broke it, and gave it to his disciples. Take it, he said, this is my body.

dag: Ka nachimbihi maa ni yino garigi yɛli, Nyama, n daa nya Jɛsi ŋun nyɛ Bɛtilihɛm nir la dapala, ka o mi mɔɣilo ŋmɛbu pam, ka nyɛ do so ŋun mali suhukpeeni, ka ni tooi tuhi tɔbu; o tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa viɛnyɛliŋga, ka lan nyɛ ŋun viɛla, ka Yawɛ be o sani.
en: One of the servants said, There is a man named Jesse living in Bethlehem. I saw Jesses son. He knows how to play the harp. He is also a brave man and fights well. He is smart and handsome, and the Lord is with him.

dag: ka bɛ ti yɛrigi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni zaa hal ka so ti ku lan nya tiŋgbani gba. Ka bɛ ti bahi ŋubi sakuɣa la ni daa chɛ bindir shɛŋa zali ya la mini yi tihi din be mɔɣu ni.
en: There will be so many that they will completely cover the ground. They will eat everything that the hail did not destroy, even the trees that are left.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin dahin yini dali, di simdi ka yi zaŋ li leei vuhim dabisili, ka piɛbi kikahi n-laɣim jɛm Naawuni.
en: Tell the Israelites: On the first day of the seventh month, you must have a special day of rest. Blow the trumpet to remind the people that this is a holy meeting.

dag: Ka o ba maa yɛl o, M bia, nyin kul bela n sani sahakam; ka n ni mali binshɛɣukam zaa nyɛla a dini.
en: Then his father said, Son, you are always with me, and everything I have is yours.

dag: Adɔnikam daŋ bɛn daa ti doli nyaaŋa na, bɛ yuya n-nyɛ: Ɛlifɛlɛt mini Jɛwɛl ni Shɛmaya, bɛna n-daa nyɛ bɛ daŋ zuɣulaannima, ka dɔbba pihiyɔbu daa pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: from the last of the descendants of Adonikam: Eliphelet, Jeuel, Shemaiah, and other men;.

dag: dama kaman zabigu ni zaani lɔŋni shɛm la, lala n-nyɛ ba. Bɛ ni yɛl a, Dim ka nyu. amaa di bi paai bɛ puu ni.
en: They might tell you to eat and drink all you want, but they dont really mean it. They are the kind of people who are only thinking about the cost.

dag: N yura ŋmanila tipum din yirigi Ɛngɛdi wain tihi puu ni.
en: My lover is like the wild flowers that bloom in the vineyards at Engedi.

dag: Zaŋm a gbaɣino min a nyɔtaɣirigu yiɣisi zani sɔŋ ma.
en: Pick up your shields, large and small. Get up and help me!.

dag: Yi ni so yi zaŋ o mabia tahi ʒiishee, yi dihila yimaŋ vi maa. Bɔ n-chɛ ka yi ku dihi yɛla sɔŋ yi suhuri ni? Bɔ n-chɛ ka yi ni so yi din ya zalinsi ka yi ku chɛ di yɛla bahi?.
en: The very fact that you have legal disputes among yourselves shows that you have failed completely. Would it not be better for you to be wronged? Would it not be better for you to be robbed?.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ pagɔr liɣiri bee bɛ tuma liɣiri ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu na ti yo yi ni po pɔri shɛli samli, dama bina ayi ŋɔ zaa nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: Dont bring a female prostitutes fee or a male prostitutes payment to the LORD your Gods temple to pay a solemn promise because both of these things are detestable to the LORD your God.

dag: Ka o daa kari doli Abinɛr, o ni daa kariti dol o maa, o daa kul sula o gbini ka bi ŋmaligi kpa o nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo.
en: Asahel ran straight toward Abner and began chasing him.

dag: Ka daa yi Janɔa maa m-mali hal ti paai Atarɔt mini Naara n-zaŋ hal ni Jɛriko n-kul mali lala hal ti paai di tariga Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni.
en: Then it went from Janoah down to Ataroth and to Naarah. The border continued until it touched Jericho and ended at the Jordan River.

dag: M mabiyurisi, hal ti ni kul yɛri ŋ-ŋɔ maa zaa yoli, ti niŋ ya naani. Ti mi ni yi mali bin suma din yi yi tiliginsim ni na ka nyɛ din so binshɛɣukam.
en: My friends, we are talking this way. But we are sure that you are doing those really good things people do when they are being saved.

dag: O daa yɛli Yisifu zuliya: Yawɛ daalibarika ni be o tiŋgban ni m-pahi zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani puuni pin gahinda.
en: Descendants of Joseph, the Lord will bless you with precious water from deep wells and with dew from the sky.

dag: dama ti Duuma ni niŋ kaman o ni zali ni o ni niŋ shɛm o sariakaribo puuni dunianim zaa sani ŋ-ŋmaai li jia.
en: The Lord will be quick and sure to do on earth what he has warned he will do.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa nyaŋ ba lala hal ni Kadɛshibarinia zaŋ ti paai Gaza zaŋ tabili Goshɛn tiŋgbɔŋ zaa m-mali lala hal ti paai Gibiɔn.
en: Joshua wiped out towns from Kadesh-Barnea to Gaza, everywhere in the region of Goshen, and as far north as Gibeon.

dag: Amaa a nyɛla ŋun tum tuun suma, dama a daa wurim Ashɛra ŋmahima zaa tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka zaŋ a suhu zaa niŋla Naawuni jɛmbu ni.
en: But not everything about you is bad. You destroyed the sacred poles used in worshiping the goddess Asherah—that shows you have tried to obey the Lord .

dag: Yurilim zuɣu ka bɛmbɔŋɔnim bɛn niŋdi lala maa, dama bɛ mi ni Naawuni zaŋ lahibal suŋ ŋɔ zuɣu zabbu tuma ti ma.
en: They love Christ and know I am here to defend the good news about him.

dag: Ka n zaŋ buɣu leei n situra ye, ka bɛ maani ma ansarisi.
en: I dress myself in clothes of mourning, and they laugh at me.

dag: Chɛ ka Naawuni yiɣisi, chɛ ka o dimnim wurim; chɛ ka bɛnkam je o ŋmalig o tooni guui.
en: God, get up and scatter your enemies! May all your enemies run from you.

dag: N tɛhiya ni di tuhiya ni n neei yi tɛha ka yi teeri yɛla ŋɔ, n ni na kul be n nyɛvili ni ŋɔ.
en: I think it only right for me to stir up your memory of these matters as long as I am still alive.

dag: Nyin daadam, a ni kari saria, a ni kari tin shɛli nim bɛn kuri niriba ŋɔ saria? Di nyaaŋa ka a yɛli ba bɛ ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa zaa.
en: You, human one, will you judge? Will you judge the bloody city? Then explain all her detestable practices to her.

dag: Ka buɣim yi ti di so mi tuma zaa, o ni kɔŋ di laara, ka ŋun maŋmaŋ lee ni tiligi, amaa ka di naɣ ni bemi kaman ŋun zo n-yi buɣim ni tiligi.
en: But if their building is burned up, they will suffer loss. They will be saved, but it will be like someone escaping from a fire.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni bimmɔrima mini yuma ni nyinvɔɣu ni saŋkpana la lu yi zuɣu, ka yi ku kpaŋ.
en: The Lord will make you suffer with diseases that will cause oozing sores or crusty itchy patches on your skin or boils like the ones that are common in Egypt. And there will be no cure for you!.

dag: Dabisili din pah anu dali, zaŋmiya naɣilah awɛi mini piɛlah ayi ni yuun yini piɛlabihi pinaanahi bɛn ka dansi mali sara;.
en: On the fifth day of this festival, you must offer bulls, rams, and lambs that are one year old. There must be nothing wrong with them.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti wurim ya kpɛhi zuliya kam ni dunia ŋɔ ni luɣilikam, ka yi ti jɛmdi buɣa din nyɛ dari mini kuɣa nimaani, yi mini yi yaannim ni daa pun bi mi buɣ shɛŋa.
en: Those of you that survive will be scattered to every nation on earth, and you will have to worship stone and wood idols that never helped you or your ancestors.

dag: Siɣimsiɣim bunu ka Yɛhudianim fiɛb ma barazim pihinahiyinikaka.
en: Five times my own people gave me lashes with a whip.

dag: bɛ yi zaŋ bɛ ni deei binshɛŋa talima labisi ti bindana, ka labisi bɛ ni zaŋ kpiɔŋ fa binshɛŋa ti dilana, ka doli zaligu shɛŋa din tiri nyɛvili, ka bi lan tumdi alahichi, biɛhiŋ kani bɛ ni be, bɛ ku kpi.
en: for example, if he returns the security he took for a loan or gives back what he stole—if he stops sinning and follows the laws that give life, he will not die, but live.

dag: Yawɛ bela n sani ni o sɔŋ ma. N ni di nasara bɛn je ma sani.
en: It is the Lord who helps me, and I will see my enemies defeated.

dag: Du shɛli din dunoya daa kpa Naawuni jɛmbu duu sambani wulinluhili polo la yɛliŋ daa nyɛ mita pihitanaanu, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛla mita pihinahinaanu, ka di dikili barilim nyɛ mita ayi ni pirigili gili di zaa.
en: The structure facing the yard on the west was one hundred five feet wide. The structures wall was seven and a half feet wide all the way around, and its length was one hundred thirty-five feet.

dag: Asirianim ku tooi tiligi ti, ti ku lan ba yuri yaha, ti mi ku lan boli ti ni zaŋ ti nuhi mali binshɛŋa la ti Naawuni. Yɛlimaŋli, kpibiga nya nambɔzɔbo.
en: Assyria will not save us. We will not ride on war horses. We will never again say, Our God to something we made with our hands. This is because you are the one who shows mercy to orphans.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n yɛli, Zomiya ka chɛ ma ka n kum pam m pubiɛ niriba kum zuɣu. Di bɔriya ni yi maai n suhu.
en: Now leave me alone to weep bitterly over all those of my people who have died. Don't try to comfort me.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛl o ni daa chɛ ka bɛ gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb zaa Jɛrusalɛm kuli Babilɔn la shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: The LORD of heavenly forces, the God of Israel, proclaims to all the exiles I have carried off from Jerusalem to Babylon.

dag: Di zuɣu ka n timd o yi sanna ni o ti yɛli ya ti zaa ni be shɛm, ka di kpaŋsi yi suhuri.
en: Thats why I am sending him—to let you know how we are and to encourage you.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Dinzuɣu Naawuni zaligubaŋda kam ŋun bɔhim alizanda nam yɛla m-baŋ li viɛnyɛliŋga ŋmanila yil yidan so ŋun bi kɔŋdi bin pala mini bin kura o nɛma ni.
en: So he told them, Every student of the Scriptures who becomes a disciple in the kingdom of heaven is like someone who brings out new and old treasures from the storeroom.

dag: Di saha maa ka Farisiinim shɛb daa ka Yisa sanna ti yɛl o, Yim ya ŋɔ, dama Naa Hɛrɔd lɔri nia ni o ku a.
en: Just then some Pharisees came to Jesus and said, Go away from here and hide. Herod wants to kill you.

dag: Bɛzai daŋ — kɔbisita ni pisinaata.
en: of Bezai.

dag: Ka Nikɔdimus bɔh o, Ninsal yi kurigi, wula ka o lan yɛn niŋ ka bɛ dɔɣ o yaha? O ni lan tooi kpe o ma puuni ka o dɔɣ o yaha.
en: How can a grown man be born again? Nicodemus asked. He certainly cannot enter his mother's womb and be born a second time.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli Farisiinim mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdib maa, M bɔhiri ya mi, tuun dini n-lee simdi tumbu Vuhim Dabisili dali? Tuun viɛlli bee tuun biɛɣu? Din ni tiligi ninsal nyɛvili bee din ni di li.
en: Then Jesus said to them, I ask you, which is the right thing to do on the Sabbath day: to do good or to do evil? Is it right to save a life or to destroy one.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa kuli yiŋa nti nya ka alizin biɛɣu maa shiri zo ka chɛ o bia maa, ka o dola o bindoo zuɣu.
en: She went home and found her child lying on the bed; the demon had indeed gone out of her.

dag: Ka Judanim ni ti ŋmaligi yɛli bɛmaŋa, Jɛrusalɛmnim malila kpiɔŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ sani. .
en: Then every clan in Judah will realize that I, the Lord All-Powerful, am their God, and that I am the source of their strength.

dag: Ka wulimpuhili polo pɔhim kpuɣi ba zuɣusaa bɛ yinsi n-ʒe ba chaŋ.
en: Then a scorching wind will sweep them away.

dag: Babilɔn tɔbutuhiriba chɛ tɔbu tuhibu. Bɛ kpalim bela bɛ kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛli. Bɛ lan ka yaa. Bɛ kpalimla paɣiba. Bɛ niŋ buɣim dabi bɛ yiya, ka kabisi bɛ dunɔdaya dakparita.
en: Babylons warriors quit fighting; they hide in their fortifications. Their strength is worn out; their courage is gone! Babylons houses are burned down, and its gates are smashed.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses.

dag: Ka niriba daa paɣi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gba daa saɣi zaŋ bɛ nyɛviya pa talima ni bɛ ni chaŋ ti be Jɛrusalɛm maa.
en: The people who stayed asked God to bless those who were willing to move to Jerusalem.

dag: N yɛligu bi bemi kaman buɣim bee zali din nyɛ bɛ ni mali shɛli ŋmɛri wurindi kuɣa la? Man Yawɛ m-bɔhi lala maa.
en: My words are a powerful fire; they are a hammer that shatters rocks.

dag: hal o yi kul sɔɣ o jɛlinsi maa o bilikɔnsi yɛtɔɣa ni, dim maa ninvuɣ biɛtali ni bahi yi palo niriba ni.
en: They hide their evil plans with nice words, but in the end, everyone will see the evil they do.

dag: N ni ti zani a tooni Sinai Zoli tampiŋ zuɣu, ka a ti zaŋ a jaaŋgbee maa fiɛbi tampiŋ maa, ka kom yi di ni na ka niriba maa nyu. Ka Musa daa niŋ lala Izraɛl kpamba maa ninni.
en: I will stand before you on a rock at Mount Sinai. Strike the rock, and water will come out of it for the people to drink. Moses did so in the presence of the leaders of Israel.

dag: Ŋunkam tu o ba bee o ma, bɛn kum o.
en: Whoever curses their father or mother must be killed.

dag: Di zuɣu ka m boli ya na ni n ti nyan ya ka m mini ya tɔɣisi, dama Izraɛlnim zaa ni mali tahima shɛl la zuɣu ka bɛ lo ma zoligo ŋɔ.
en: That is why I wanted to see you and talk with you. I am bound with this chain because I believe in the hope of Israel.

dag: ka zuliya kam ti laɣim zan o tooni, ka o woligi ba kaman piɛgul ni woligiri piɛri mini buhi shɛm la.
en: All the nations will be gathered in front of him. He will separate them from each other, just as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.

dag: Ka n ni ti chɛ ka n shɛhiranima ayi pil buri, ka n niŋ ba yiko ka bɛ tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa biɛɣ tuhili ni kɔbisiyi ni pihiyɔbu.
en: My two witnesses will wear sackcloth, while I let them preach for , days.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda mi daa yɛli Filistia doo maa, Nyin kanila n sanna ni takɔbi mini kpan titali ni kpam bila, amaa man zaŋla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛl tɔbbihi Naawuni so a ni ta daɣiri ŋɔ yuli kan a sanna.
en: David answered, You are coming against me with sword, spear, and javelin, but I come against you in the name of the Lord Almighty, the God of the Israelite armies, which you have defied.

dag: O paɣ so ŋun yuli daa booni Hushim la gba daa dɔɣi bidibisi, bɛna n-daa nyɛ: Abitub mini Ɛlipaal.
en: Shaharaim and Hushim had two sons named Abitub and Elpaal.

dag: Zanimi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ku tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa zaani n-tɔɣisi bɛ yɛtɔɣa ti ba. Zabimi bɛn ka yaa yɛlimaŋli zuɣu.
en: Speak up for people who cannot speak for themselves. Protect the rights of all who are helpless.

dag: amaa ka daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o bɔrɔbɔro shɛriba kpɛm maa ti yil tia kaman Yisifu ni daa yɛli ba shɛm maa.
en: But the chief baker he hanged, just as Joseph had said would happen when he interpreted their dreams for them.

dag: Dinzuɣu ninvuɣ biɛri ku nya nasara saria karibu ni, ka alahichinim mi ku be wuntizɔriba ni.
en: When the time for judgment comes, the wicked will be found guilty. Sinners have no place among those who do what is right.

dag: Ka Jɛrɔbɔam daŋ ni ŋunkam kpi yiŋa, bahi ni ŋub o; ka ŋunkam mi kpi mɔɣu ni, juri ni di o. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Anyone from your family who dies in the city will be eaten by dogs. And anyone from your family who dies in the fields will be eaten by birds. The Lord has spoken.

dag: Dinzuɣu lala n-nyɛ li. Yi gba yi niŋ bɛ ni wuhi ya ni yi niŋ shɛm zaa yin yɛlimiya, Ti bi simdi paɣibu, dama ti tuma ni nyɛ shɛli ka ti tum maa. .
en: And that's how it should be with you. When you've done all you should, then say, We are merely servants, and we have simply done our duty.

dag: Saha shɛli ha yi gba daa bela katiŋ ni Naawuni, ka nyɛ o dimnima yi biɛhigu puuni yi ni daa tɛhiri bin biɛ shɛŋa yɛla ka tumdi li la zuɣu.
en: You used to be far from God. Your thoughts made you his enemies, and you did evil things.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni la sani. O daa bi siɣis omaŋ anab Jɛrimia ŋun daa zaŋ Yawɛ yɛtɔɣa tɔɣis o la sani.
en: He sinned against the Lord and did not listen humbly to the prophet Jeremiah, who spoke the word of the Lord .

dag: Wuntizɔra noli nyɛla nyɛvili kɔbilinini. Amaa duŋtaabo yɛtɔɣa m-be ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋun noli ni.
en: The words of good people are like a spring of fresh water, but the words of the wicked only hide their violent plans.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa gili Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa niŋ sunsuuni n-kari doli ba kuri ba n-zaŋ Nɔha hal ti paai Gibia wulimpuhili polo.
en: The Israelites had the enemy trapped, and without stopping they pursued them as far as a point east of Gibeah, killing them as they went.

dag: ka yɛl o tumo, Cham ti lihi teeku polo. Ka o daa chaŋ ti lihi ka yɛli, M bi nya shɛli. Ka Ilaija yɛl o, Labimi yaha n-niŋ lala hal ti paai siɣimsiɣim buyopɔin.
en: and said to his servant, Look toward the sea. The servant left. And when he came back, he said, I looked, but I didn't see anything. Elijah told him to look seven more times.

dag: Ka Ainim daa kari ba bɛ tiŋ maa dunol ni hal ti paai Shɛbarim n-daa ku bɛ ninvuɣ pihitanaayɔbu laasabu sɔŋ zolɔŋni. Ka Izraɛlnim baɣiri ni daa cheei kom, ka dabiɛm gbahi ba.
en: The men of Ai chased them from the city gate as far as some quarries and killed about thirty-six of them on the way down the hill. Then the Israelites lost their courage and were afraid.

dag: O daa zaŋ bɛ tiŋgbana ti o niriba ni bɛ su li. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He gave their lands to his people; his love is eternal;.

dag: Naawuni noli ni di binshɛɣukam ti ku be tiŋ maa ni. Kulla Naawuni mini Piɛbil maa nam ʒiishee la n-yɛn beni, ka o daba ni jɛmd o.
en: There will no longer be any curse. The throne of God and the Lamb will be in it, and his servants will worship him.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa yɛl o, Di gbinni m-bɔŋɔ: Tiwula ata maa nyɛla daba ata.
en: Then Joseph said, I will explain the dream to you. The three branches mean three days.

dag: Ti mi ni binnamda zaa kul ŋuhirimi ka wolisiri biɛrim zuɣu hal ni pɔŋɔ;.
en: For we know that up to the present time all of creation groans with pain, like the pain of childbirth.

dag: Nimaani ka tuumbiɛtumdiba la lu n-doya. Bɛ daai ba mi luhi ka bɛ kɔŋ yiɣisibu.
en: See where evil people have fallen. There they lie, unable to rise.

dag: Mbaye, Yawɛ takɔbi, saha yuusim wula ka a lee kul yɛn ŋmara? Labimi kpe a tɔɣu ni ti dɔni baalim vuhi.
en: You ask how long will I continue to attack you with my sword, then you tell me to put it away and leave you alone.

dag: Yisa daa ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli, Alizanda nam ŋmanila azichi shɛli din sɔɣi tiŋgban ni so puu ni, ka do so kana nti nya li ka daai tam pi li, ka chaŋ ni suhupiɛlli nti zaŋ o ni mali shɛlikam kɔhi n-lab ti da puu maa.
en: The kingdom of heaven is like what happens when someone finds a treasure hidden in a field and buries it again. Such a person is happy and goes and sells everything in order to buy that field.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa kana ti liri Izraɛlnima; tɔb maa ni daa ti mii, ka Filistianim daa tuhi nyaŋ Izraɛlnima, ka ku bɛ tɔbbihi tusa anahi tɔb maa ni.
en: The Philistines made a fierce attack. They defeated the Israelites and killed about , of them.

dag: Ka malaika maa lan yɛli Zakaria, Mani n-nyɛ malaika Gabirɛl ŋun ʒe Naawuni tooni la, ka o tim ma na ni n ti ti a lahibal suŋ ŋɔ.
en: The angel answered him, I am Gabriel, the one who always stands ready before God. He sent me to talk to you and to tell you this good news.

dag: A daa zaŋ a shia suŋ ti ba ka o wuhi ba baŋsim, a daa bi mɔŋ ba manna, ka daa ti ba kom ka bɛ nyu.
en: In your goodness you told them what they should do; you fed them manna and gave them water to drink.

dag: Ka Sool suhu daa yiɣisi pam, dama yɛtɔɣa maa daa bi niŋ o nyaɣisim ka o yɛli, Bɛ zaŋ tuhi piapia ti Dauda, ka zaŋla tuhilituhili ti m mi, ka bɔ n-lee lan kpalim ka pa ni n nam ŋɔ ka o yɛn deei.
en: Saul burned with anger. This song annoyed him. Theyve credited David with tens of thousands, he said, but only credit me with thousands. Whats next for him—the kingdom itself.

dag: Juda Naa Amazia Jɔash bia la ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pinaanu saha ka Izraɛl Naa Jɛhɔash bia Naa Jɛrɔbɔam daa di Izraɛl nam Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuun pihinahi ni yini.
en: In the fifteenth year of the reign of Amaziah son of Joash as king of Judah, Jeroboam son of Jehoash became king of Israel, and he ruled in Samaria for forty-one years.

dag: dindina Yawɛ ni chɛ ka dɔr biɛri ni alahiziba dɔriti din ku naai lu yi mini yi bihi zuɣu.
en: the Lord will punish you and your descendants with terrible diseases. He will cause you to suffer illnesses that have no cure. And you will find no relief for your misery!.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ni zaɣisi n yɛligu maa zuɣu.
en: So then, because you would not listen to him, the Lord Almighty says.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, pako faralan ŋɔ tɔhiya gari bɛ zaa.
en: He said, I tell you that this poor widow put in more than all the others.

dag: Ka Sintani daa zaŋ o chaŋ Tiŋ Kasi la ni nti du n-tam Naawuni jɛmbu duu zuɣusaa kpaakpaanyom ni ha.
en: Then the devil led Jesus to the holy city of Jerusalem and put him on a high place at the edge of the Temple area.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Zadok mini Abiata daa zaŋ Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa labisi Jɛrusalɛm, ka daa kpalim be nimaani.
en: So Zadok and Abiathar took Gods chest back to Jerusalem and stayed there.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli Pɛnuɛluɛlnim maa, N yi ti labina ni alaafee, n ni daai yi pii ŋɔ luhi.
en: I'll come back safe and sound, Gideon said, but when I do, I'm going to tear down your tower.

dag: Sulemaana daa chɛ ka bɛ mali nɛma maa zaa ka di galisi pam, di zuɣu n-daa chɛ ka bɛ bi tooi zahim baŋ bɛ ni zaŋ daanya shɛm tariga mal li.
en: There were so many bronze furnishings that no one ever knew how much bronze it took to make them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pii bɛ buɣili Baalibɛriti duu anzinfa laɣibaligu pisopɔin ti o. Ka Abimilɛk daa zaŋ liɣiri maa ti da ninvuɣ galima mini ninkuunsinima n-zaŋ ba pa omaŋ zuɣu.
en: Then they gave Abimelech pieces of silver from the temple of their god Baal Berith. Abimelech used the silver to hire a gang of rough soldiers who would do anything for money.

dag: O daa lan dɔɣi bidibis ayopɔin mini bipuɣins ata.
en: He was the father of seven sons and three daughters.

dag: Kom ni daa di dunia maa nyaaŋa, Nuhu daa niŋla yuun kɔbisita ni pihinu pahi.
en: After the flood Noah lived years.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa mali ti du Gɛnɛsarɛt tiŋgbɔŋ ni teeku duli.
en: Jesus and his disciples crossed the lake and came to shore near the town of Gennesaret.

dag: Bee a lomi ni a ku ma kaman a ni sa ku Ijipti doo la shɛm la.
en: Are you planning to kill me like you killed that Egyptian yesterday? .

dag: Ka kpambal so ŋun daa chaŋ ni o ti boli Mikaya na maa daa yɛl o, Nyama, anabinim maa zaa ni naai noli yɛli shɛm nyɛla din doli naa suhu ni yu shɛm. A gba kul yɛlimi la din tiɣi naa nini kaman bɛ zaa ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Meanwhile, the official who had gone to get Micaiah said to him, All the other prophets have prophesied success for the king, and you had better do the same.

dag: dama o daa yɛli o suhu ni, Hal n yi kul shihi o binyɛrigu gba, n ni nya alaafee.
en: She thought, If I can just touch his clothes, that will be enough to heal me.

dag: Ka Naawuni daalibarika min o yiko daa pali Stiivin ka o tumd alahiziba tumtumsa ka wuhiri shihira pam niriba maa ni.
en: Stephen, a man richly blessed by God and full of power, performed great miracles and wonders among the people.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa daa zaŋ doo maa yi tiŋ maa tariga nti pihi kuɣa lab ku o kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm.
en: So he was killed, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.

dag: Naa, a yi saɣi, nyin zalimi zaligu n-chɛ ka bɛ ku ba. A yi ni niŋ lala, n lo alikauli ni n ni tooi zaŋ anzinfa din sania zuɣu tibisim paai kilɔgiram tuhi kɔbisita ni pihinahi n-niŋ a liɣiri kpanjɔɣu ni.
en: If it pleases the king, I have a suggestion: Give a command to destroy these people. And I will put , pounds of silver into the kings treasury. This money could be used to pay the men who do these things.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ lan yɛli, Yinim bɛn wumdi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa anabinim ni daa yɛli bɛ ni daa zali n jɛmbu duu ŋɔ tanzaa saha shɛl la wuhiya ni n jɛmbu duu maa ni me, kpaŋsimiya yimaŋa.
en: The LORD of heavenly forces proclaims: Be strong, you who are now hearing these words from the mouths of the prophets spoken on the day when the foundations for the house of the LORD of heavenly forces were laid.

dag: Dindina wula ka ti lee ni yɛli zaŋ chaŋ dimbɔŋɔ polo? Naawuni yi ʒe ti nyaaŋa, ŋuni n-lee nyɛ ŋun ni tooi zaŋ o nyɔɣu yo ti?.
en: In view of all this, what can we say? If God is for us, who can be against us?.

dag: Tizɔra kam gbibila omaŋ binshɛɣukam puuni. Bɛ niŋdi lala maa ni bɛ ti deela zuɣupil shɛli din saɣinda, amaa tinim niŋdi lala ni ti ti deela zuɣupil shɛli din bi saɣinda.
en: Everyone who competes practices self-discipline in everything. The runners do this to get a crown of leaves that shrivel up and die, but we do it to receive a crown that never dies.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim maa daa mali bɛmaŋ kasi, ka mali niriba maa ka bɛ niŋ kasi; ka lan mali dunɔdaya mini gooni maa ka di gba niŋ kasi.
en: So the priests and Levites made themselves pure in a ceremony. Then they also made the people, the gates, and the wall of Jerusalem pure in a ceremony.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ daa na bi mi o, amaa lala zuɣu ka n daŋna nti baptaiziri niriba kom ni ni o ti yi palo ka Izraɛlnim baŋ o.
en: I did not know who he was. But I came baptizing people with water so that Israel could know that he is the Messiah. .

dag: Gol so ŋun pahi pinaayi, ka bɛ boon o Ada la biɛɣ pinaata dali ka bɛ daa yɛn zaŋ zaligu maa tum tuma Naa Ahasivɛrɔs tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni. Dindali maa ka bɛ daa zali ni bɛ kum Yɛhudianim maa.
en: The day set for the Jews to do this was the th day of the twelfth month, the month of Adar. They were permitted to do this in all King Xerxes provinces.

dag: Ka Yisa daa bɔhi ba, N ni daa tim ya ka yi bi ʒi liɣiri kolibihi bee adiikunima bee namdanim la, shɛli daa ti pooi ya? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Aai, shɛli daa bi pooi ti.
en: Jesus asked his disciples, When I sent you out without a moneybag or a traveling bag or sandals, did you need anything? No! they answered.

dag: Di chɛliya ka yimaŋ malibu bela palɔni kaman zabiri pambu mini salima yɛri yɛbu bee situr viɛla yɛbu.
en: Dont try to make yourselves beautiful on the outside, with stylish hair or by wearing gold jewelry or fine clothes.

dag: Amaa ka o daa bɔhi ŋun yɛl o lala maa, Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ m ma, ka banim mi nyɛ a tizɔbihi.
en: Jesus answered, Who is my mother and who are my brothers.

dag: Ka bimbir shɛŋa din daa lu vuhim shee la, din ŋmanila ŋun wum Naawuni yɛligu ka baŋ di gbinni, ka di ti dɔɣi n-niŋ biɛlim kɔbigakɔbiga, shɛŋa pihiyɔbuyɔbu, shɛŋa mi pihitata.
en: The seeds that fell on good ground are the people who hear and understand the message. They produce as much as or or times what was planted.

dag: M bi simd a yurilim maŋli min a ʒiɛyimtali shɛl a ni ʒe man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ biɛlifu gba, dama n jaaŋgbee kɔŋko ka n daa zaŋ na ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ du; amaa pumpɔŋɔ m malila buni balibu buyi.
en: I am not worth all the kindness and faithfulness that you have shown me, your servant. I crossed the Jordan with nothing but a walking stick, and now I have come back with these two groups.

dag: Dama dimbɔŋɔnim zaa zuɣu ka zuliya kam kul jiɣindi biɛɣukam, amaa yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ mi ni dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha simdi ya.
en: Only people who don't know God are always worrying about such things. Your Father in heaven knows you need all of these.

dag: A daa kari zuliya shɛba ka zaŋ ba ʒili bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni. A daa darigi lala zuliyanim maa tibili, amaa ka chɛ bɛna.
en: With your great power you took this land from other people, and you gave it to us. You crushed those foreigners and forced them to leave this land.

dag: Amaa ka Musa daa yɛli Yawɛ, Di saha Ijiptinim ni wum li, dama bɛ sani ka a daa zaŋ a kpiɔŋ yihi ba na.
en: But Moses said to the Lord , You brought these people out of Egypt by your power. When the Egyptians hear what you have done to your people.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yi tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣ yoya. Amaa ka yi bɔhira, Wula ka ti lee tɔɣisi a yɛtɔɣ yoya.
en: You have said horrible things about me, and yet you ask, What have we said.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ, pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Sokam yɛlima, Ami! Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: Lord God of Israel, you deserve to be praised forever and ever. Let everyone say, Amen! Shout praises to the Lord .

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa zo n-chaŋ ti zaŋ o na, ka o ni daa kana nti zani niriba maa sani, o daa wɔɣ gari sokam.
en: The people ran and took Saul out from behind the supplies. Saul stood up among the people. He was a head taller than anyone else.

dag: n-yɛli ba ni bɛ zaŋm bɛ ni booni gol so Ada la biɛɣ pinaanahi mini biɛɣ pinaanu dabisa n-leei vuhim dabisa yuuni kam.
en: He did this to tell the Jews to celebrate Purim every year on the th and th days of the month of Adar.

dag: Dama Izraɛlnim zaka din nyɛ bini pia kam puuni zaɣ yini shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi tiri man Yawɛ la, n zaŋ li ti Lɛvinim ni di nyɛ bɛ tarili. Dinzuɣu ka m pun yɛli ni bɛ ku mali tiŋgbani Izraɛlnim sani.
en: because I have given to them as their possession the tithe which the Israelites present to me as a special contribution. That is why I told them that they would have no permanent property in Israel.

dag: Yim ka tiŋgbani daa ti dam pam, dama ti Duuma malaika n-daa yi alizanda ni siɣina nti biligi siliga maa nol ni kuɣili la n-du n-ʒi di zuɣu.
en: Suddenly an angel of the Lord came from the sky, and there was a huge earthquake. The angel went to the tomb and rolled the stone away from the entrance. Then he sat on top of the stone.

dag: Yawɛ, wummi n suhigu, chɛ ka n sɔŋsim bɔbu kuhigu ŋɔ paag a.
en: Listen to my prayer, O Lord , and hear my cry for help!.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni niŋdi Musa mini Aduna. Niriba maa zaa daa yɛlimi, Ti yi di daa kpi Ijipti, di di so! Bee ti yi di kpi mɔɣu ŋɔ ni, di di so!.
en: They complained against Moses and Aaron, and said, It would have been better to die in Egypt or even here in the wilderness!.

dag: Ka o yɛli, Saamba sani. O ni daa yɛli ni saamba sani maa, ka Yisa yɛli, Ka dindina tiŋbihi bɛn nuu kani.
en: The foreigners, answered Peter. Well, then, replied Jesus, that means that the citizens don't have to pay.

dag: Ka bɛ daa dee lala, ka ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni niŋdi yil yidan maa.
en: they began complaining to the owner of the vineyard.

dag: Bɛ zaŋla galimi n-yo ma yurilim samli, amaa ka man suhiri Naawuni tiri ba.
en: I loved them, but they were against me. So I said a prayer.

dag: Nir yi ŋme o dabipaɣ bee o dabidoo nimbila ka di saɣim, ŋun chɛ ka dabili maa chaŋ yoli, o nimbil maa zuɣu.
en: When a slave owner hits and blinds the eye of a male or female slave, he should let the slave go free on account of the eye.

dag: Di zɔri ba dabiɛm, dama n ni be a sani din ni fa a bahi. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Do not be afraid of them, for I will be with you to protect you. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka nandahima daa gbaai Izraɛlnim zaŋ chaŋ Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa polo, Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim noya woligi la zuɣu.
en: Since the people had a change of heart concerning the Benjaminites because the LORD had caused a rupture in the tribes of Israel.

dag: Dinzuɣu niŋmiya siɣa, ka teeya ni yuun muna ata ka n zaŋ saɣisi yi zaa ha ni nintam yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni.
en: Stay alert! Remember that for three years I constantly and tearfully warned each one of you. I never stopped warning you!.

dag: Dina n-nyɛ gbuɣinli ŋun nyɛ ŋun mali kpiɔŋ pam mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ni ka bi zɔri so dabiɛm ŋɔ.
en: a lion—he is the warrior of the animals and runs from nothing.

dag: Dama o daa zali zaligu n-chɛ ka sanʒiɛɣu yiɣisi n-kpuɣi teeku kɔgbana zuɣusaa.
en: At his command a storm arose, and waves covered the sea.

dag: Juda Naa Hɛzɛkia ni daa biɛ ŋ-kpaŋ, di nyaaŋa ka o daa sabi sabbu ŋɔ yɛli:.
en: This is what Hezekiah wrote after he got well:.

dag: Shallum mini Akub ni Talimɔn ni Ahiman ni bɛ dɔɣiriba n-daa nyɛ dunɔguliba .
en: The following Temple guards lived in Jerusalem: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, and Ahiman. Shallum was their leader.

dag: N-yi biɛɣu ka Pool daa zaŋ niriba anahi maa n-chɛ ka o mini ba mali bɛmaŋa n-kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu ni bɛ ti wuhi bɛmaŋ malibu maa ni yɛn naai dahin shɛli ka maligumaana mali sara bɛ zaa yinoyino zuɣu.
