en: The next day Paul took the four men with him and got himself ready at the same time they did. Then he went into the temple and told when the final ceremony would take place and when an offering would be made for each of them.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa gbaag o ka o kpaag o nina kpa malaika maa ka bɔh o, N dana, wula? Ka malaika maa yɛl o, Naawuni deeg a suhigu, ka nya a ni tiri nandaamba pina la, di zaa leei ŋun Naawuni ni ku tam shɛli yɛla.
en: Staring at the angel and feeling afraid, Cornelius said, What do you want, sir? The angel said to him, God has heard your prayers and has seen your gifts to the poor. He remembers you and all you have done.

dag: Di saha ka a yɛli ba, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn chɛmi ka tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ nim zaa mini na shɛb bɛn ʒi Dauda ʒiishee la ni maligumaaniba ni anabinima ni Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa nyu dam kuli.
en: Then tell them that I, the Lord , am going to fill the people in this land with wine until they are drunk: the kings, who are David's descendants, the priests, the prophets, and all the people of Jerusalem.

dag: Bɛ daa dɔɣi ma ka teeku na kani, ka kɔbilinina din bilisiri kom pampam gba daa na kani.
en: When I was born, there were no oceans or springs of water.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun tumd alahiziba tumtumsa; ka nyɛ ŋun kahig a yiko tuma wuhi zuliya shɛba.
en: You alone work miracles, and you have let nations see your mighty power.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ Urim mini Tumim niŋ sariakaribo nyolɔrigu maa ni, ka di ti pa Aduna nyɔɣu zuɣu saha shɛl o yi ti ka Yawɛ tooni na. Dina n-ni chɛ ka lzraɛlnim saria karibu yɛla kul be Aduna suhu ni Yawɛ tooni.
en: Put the Urim and Thummim inside the judgment pouch. They will be over Aarons heart when he goes before the Lord . So Aaron will always carry with him a way of judging for the Israelites when he is before the Lord .

dag: Shiibanima mini Dɛdannima ni Speen kɔhigɔriba ni di tɔbbi pola zaa ni ti yɛl a, A kamina ni a ti di nɛma? A laɣimla a tɔbbihi na ni yi ti ŋme n-di nɛma, ka va anzinfa mini salima, ka zaŋ niɣi mini nɛma pam chaŋ.
en: Sheba and Dedan and the merchants and officials of Tarshish will say to you, Have you come to take plunder and seize loot? Have you assembled your army to take silver and gold, to take goods and cattle, to engage in great looting.

dag: Ka o kpee maa gba damd o tooni m-balind o yɛra, Na dim ma suɣilo, n ni yo a di zaa.
en: The other servant fell on his knees and begged him, Be patient with me. I will pay you everything I owe.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka sanʒiɛɣu maa na kul ʒiɛri pampam, ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ pii neen shɛŋa din daa be ŋariŋ maa ni bahi kom ni.
en: We were so battered by the violent storm that the next day the men began throwing cargo overboard.

dag: Ka doo maa daa chaŋ ti yɛli Yɛhudianima ni Yisa n-nyɛ ŋun daa chɛ ka o kpaŋ la.
en: Then the man left and told the Jewish authorities that it was Jesus who had healed him.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka niriba maa daa yi Hazɛrɔt n-chaŋ ti dɔni Paran mɔɣu ni.
en: After that the people left Hazeroth and traveled to the desert of Paran where they set up camp.

dag: Ŋunkam miri Yawɛ o biɛhigu shee ŋɔ yi ni kpi, dindina ti zaa kul kpimi maa.
en: Anyone who approaches the LORDs dwelling will die. Are we doomed to perish.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb be a ni ŋ-ŋmari ʒiri ka kuri niriba, ka shɛb be a ni n-diri bindira zoya zuɣu ka be biɛriyoli.
en: Some of your people tell lies about others in order to have them put to death. Some of them eat sacrifices offered to idols. Some are always satisfying their lusts.

dag: Ka Zakius daa ti yiɣisi zani n-yɛli ti Duuma Yisa, N Duuma, n ni zaŋ n nɛma pirigili ti nandaamba, ka n yi daa dila so bini zalinsi, n ni lan labisi dilan bini lala siɣimsiɣim bunahi zuɣu ti o.
en: Zacchaeus said to the Lord, I want to do good. I will give half of my money to the poor. If I have cheated anyone, I will pay them back four times more.

dag: O daa me o jɛmbu duu ka di be kaman alizanda la, ka be kaman o ni daa nam dunia ŋɔ ka di kul beni sahakam shɛm la.
en: God built his sanctuary like the highest heaven and like the earth, which he established forever.

dag: Yidana n-su o paɣ fukumsi kaman Masia ni su cheechi fukumsi shɛm la; Masia maŋmaŋ mi n-lan nyɛ cheechi din nyɛ o niŋgbuŋ la tiligira.
en: A husband is the head of his wife, as Christ is the head and the Savior of the church, which is his own body.

dag: Ka naa daa bɔhi, Ka bɔ ka ti lee niŋ ti Mɔdɛkai din ni ti o jilima? Ka o naazɔnim bɛn be o sani yɛl o, Ti bi niŋ shɛl ti o.
en: the king asked, What has been done to reward Mordecai for this? Nothing, Your Majesty! the king's servants replied.

dag: Tii maa vari daa viɛli pam ka di kul wali gbilim; ka dunia ŋɔ ni daadamnim mini binnɛma zaa ni tooi paai li di n-tiɣi. Ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri kanna ti dooni di mahim vuhira, ka noonsi tɛri bɛ tɛri di wula zuɣu, ka vuhirigu kam diri di wala.
en: It was covered with leaves and heavy with fruit— enough for all nations. Wild animals enjoyed its shade, birds nested in its branches, and all creatures on earth lived on its fruit.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee yɛn yiɣisi zani n-tuhi ninvuɣ biɛri ti ma? Ŋuni n-lee yɛn yiɣisi zani tuhi tuumbiɛtumdiba ti ma?.
en: Who stood up for me against the wicked? Who took my side against the evildoers?.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Niŋmiya din tuhi ka doli wuntia soli. Famiya bɛ ni ŋari ninvuɣ so n fa o ŋun nahind o maa nuu ni bahi. Miriya ka yi zaŋ gala bee kpeengarigu niŋ sana bee kpibiga bee pakoli bee n-ku ŋun ka taali kpe ŋɔ.
en: This is what the Lord says: Do what is right and fair. Protect those who have been robbed from the ones who robbed them. Dont hurt or do anything wrong to orphans or widows. Dont kill innocent people.

dag: Wuhimiya ma yi paɣ bɔbo puhigu liɣiri ni nyɛ shɛm, ka yi yi ni saɣi ka n kpuɣ o, n ni tin ya yi ni kul yɛli ni n tin ya shɛm zaa.
en: Ask anything, no matter how expensive. I'll do anything, just let me marry Dinah.

dag: Ka Yaakubu yɛli, Nyama, wuntaŋ ni n-na bɔŋɔ, biŋkɔbiri maa taɣ kuli yiŋ saha na bi paai, dinzuɣu ŋɔŋmiya kom ti piɛri maa ka bɛ nyu, ka yi zaŋ ba chaŋ ka bɛ ti ŋub mɔri.
en: Jacob told them, Look, the sun is still high up in the sky, and it's too early to bring in the rest of the flocks. Water your sheep and take them back to the pasture.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ daba ayi ka Pool yɛli Baanabas, Chɛ ka ti lab tin shɛŋa ni ti ni daa moli ti Duuma yɛligu molo la nti kaai ti mabihi bɛn be nimaani maa n-nya bɛ ni be shɛm.
en: Sometime later Paul said to Barnabas, Let's go back and visit the Lord's followers in the cities where we preached his message. Then we will know how they are doing.

dag: Aduna bidib shɛb bɛ ni daa pii ka booi kpam bahi bɛ zuɣu ni ni bɛ leei maligumaaniba n-tumdi tuma maligumaana tuma duu yuya m-bala.
en: were the ones to be ordained as priests.

dag: Amaa chɛ ka bɛnkam zaa ka a sanna suhuri paligi ka bɛ mali suhupiɛlli. Chɛ ka bɛnkam zaa yur a tiliginsim la kul yɛra, Yawɛ galisiya.
en: But let all who seek you celebrate and rejoice in you. Let those who love your salvation always say, The LORD is great.

dag: Tɛra ni daa ti paai yuun pisopɔin saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Ibram mini Nahɔr so ni Haran.
en: When Terah was years old, he became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.

dag: Izraɛl Naa Jɛrɔbɔam ŋun pah ayi ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisinaayopɔin saha ka Amazia bia Uzia daa di Juda nam.
en: Azariah, Amaziahs son, became king of Judah in the twenty-seventh year of Israels King Jeroboam.

dag: Ka Amasa daa yi n-chaŋ ni o ti boli Judanim maa na, amaa ka o daa yuui hal ka bɛ ni daa zal o dabisi shɛli maa ti gari.
en: So Amasa called the people of Judah together, but he took longer than the king had told him.

dag: Stɛfanas mini Fɔtunatus ni Akaikus ni daa ka n sanna la niŋ ma suhupiɛlli pam, dama bɛ daa zani yi zaani n-niŋ ma yi ni naan niŋ ma shɛm.
en: I am happy that Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus have come. You are not here, but they have filled your place.

dag: Ka bol o dan maa sandiriba zaa yinoyino na ti bɔhi ŋun daŋ tooni, N dana samli ala n-lee dol a.
en: One by one, the manager sent for each person who owed his master money. He said to the first, How much do you owe my master.

dag: Ka naa daa ti chaŋ Gibiɔn ni o ti mali sara shɛli nimaani, dama nimaani n-daa nyɛ sara maligu shee din galisi pam. Sulemaana daa yi zaŋdila bɛ ni mali sara maligu shɛli nyɔri buɣim la bin tuhili m-maani sara bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: King Solomon went to Gibeon to offer a sacrifice because that was the most important high place. He offered a thousand burnt offerings on that altar.

dag: Paɣimiya Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma Yisa Masia Naawuni min o Ba ŋɔ. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ti Ba ŋun nyɛ nambɔzɔra mini suhumaabo zaa Naawuni.
en: Let us give thanks to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the merciful Father, the God from whom all help comes!.

dag: Dama Ɛzra daa zaŋ o suhu n-niŋla Yawɛ zaligu bɔhimbu ni, ka daa dol li, ka mali zaligu shɛŋa mini biɛhigu soya zaligunim wuhiri Izraɛlnima.
en: Ezra had devoted his life to studying the Law of the Lord , to practicing it, and to teaching all its laws and regulations to the people of Israel.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ni daa chɛ ka anabinim zaa yɛli ni o Masia ni ti di wahala pam la n-niŋ pali maa.
en: But this is how God fulfilled what he foretold through all the prophets: that his Christ would suffer.

dag: N-daa lan yi biɛɣu dabisi shɛli din pahir ayi goli palli dabisili maa nyaaŋa, ka Dauda ʒiishee maa na kul nyɛla zaɣ kuŋ. Di saha ka Sool daa bɔh o dapala Jɔnatan, Bɔ n-niŋ ka Jɛsi dapala ŋɔ bi kana bindirigu dibu shee ŋɔ sɔhila bee zuŋɔ.
en: But on the next day, the second of the new moon, Davids seat was still empty. Saul said to his son Jonathan, Why hasnt Jesses son come to the table, either yesterday or today.

dag: Yɛm tuma nyɛla din chɛ ka biɛhigu niŋdi nyaɣisim, ka di soya zaa nyɛ din tahiri suhudoo na.
en: Her ways are pleasant; all her paths are peaceful.

dag: Chɛliya ba! Bɛ nyɛla zoomba bɛn vɔri bɛ taba, Ka zom yi vɔri zoma, bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa ni ti lula bɔɣili ni.
en: Don't worry about them! They are blind leaders of the blind; and when one blind man leads another, both fall into a ditch.

dag: Yawɛ, a suhuyubu puuni ka a tum tuun kara ŋɔ zaa, mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ zuɣu, ka kahigi yɛl kara ŋɔ zaa wuhi ma.
en: Lord , you have done this wonderful thing for me and because you wanted to.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ zahin shɛrili ti o;.
en: They gave him a piece of cooked fish.

dag: amaa ka Maikil min o malaikanim maa daa nyaŋ waɣ biɛ titali maa min o malaikanima, ka bɛ lan ka biɛhigu shee alizanda ni.
en: but the dragon was defeated, and he and his angels were not allowed to stay in heaven any longer.

dag: Ka o bapir maa daa yɛl o, N suhir a mi, yɛlim ma Samuɛl ni yɛl a shɛm.
en: And what did he tell you? Saul's uncle asked.

dag: Pɛriʒia Naa daa zalila zaligu zaŋ chaŋ yiliyiiniba polo, ka sabi wuhi bɛ ni yɛn yiini yila maa shɛm dabisili kam.
en: though the daily choice of music and musicians was decided by royal decree of the Persian king.

dag: Bɛ ni gbib a bɛ nuhi ni ka a napɔŋ ku tuui kuɣili.
en: They will carry you in their arms, and you won't hurt your feet on the stones.

dag: Di ni lan sɔŋ zaŋ chaŋ yɛm wuhibu mini wuntitali ni zaligu dolibu ni nimmaŋtali polo.
en: They provide insightful instruction, which is righteous, just, and full of integrity.

dag: Dinzuɣu yinima n-nyɛ bɛ ni yɛn daŋ gbahi shɛb kuli tinduya ni, ka yi churi puhibu mini yi suhuyubu maa zani tariga.
en: Therefore, they will now be the first to be taken away, and the feast of those who lounged at the table will pass away.

dag: Kɔbulli yɛliya, Di ka n ni, ka teeku yɛli, Di ka n sani.
en: The depths of the oceans and seas Say that wisdom is not found there.

dag: Bi so ŋun buɣisi ni o yɛli noli ti o ba bee o ma o firila ni kpi bumbɔn ni.
en: Those who would curse their father or mother are like a lamp that goes out on the darkest night.

dag: Ka di chɛ ka n tɛhi kurimbuni ha yɛla, ka teei yuun shɛŋa din gari la yɛla.
en: I think about days long past; I remember years that seem an eternity in the past.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa nanima ayi maa ni ti laɣim ʒini n-di, amaa ka zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu tɛha din be bɛ suhuri ni zuɣu ni ti chɛ ka bɛ yɔhim taba. Ka bɛ ni bɔri shɛm mi ti ku niŋ, dama di saha na bi paai.
en: Those two kings will want to make trouble. They will sit around the table planning their lies, but it will not do either one of them any good because God has set a time for their end to come.

dag: Dinzuɣu di bi simdi ni ti gbihiri kaman shɛb ni niŋdi shɛm la, amaa chɛliya ka ti ne n-ʒiya ka gbibi ti maŋa.
en: So then, we should not be sleeping like the others; we should be awake and sober.

dag: Yɛm mɛrila o yili, amaa jɛrilim ŋun wurindila o yili.
en: Homes are made by the wisdom of women, but are destroyed by foolishness.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba ni daa ʒiya diri bindirigu maa ka o zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro n-niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka ŋmahiŋmahi li n-zaŋ ti ba ka yɛli, N niŋgbuŋ m-bala; zaŋmiya li ŋubi.
en: While they were eating, Jesus took bread, blessed it, broke it, and gave it to the disciples and said, Take and eat. This is my body.

dag: Ka o daa gbaai Sukɔt nachimbil so m-bɔh o bɔhigu. Ka nachimbil maa daa kali Sukɔt kpamba pisopɔinnaayopɔin wuhi Gidiɔn.
en: He captured a young man from the people of Succoth and interrogated him. He listed for Gideon the seventy-seven officials and elders of Succoth.

dag: Ka kukoli maa lan yɛli ma pahi buyi, Naawuni ni lihi binshɛŋa bin suma, nyin miri ka a bol li bin yoya.
en: The voice from heaven spoke to me again, When God says that something can be used for food, don't say it isn't fit to eat.

dag: ka yi zani Vuhim Dabisili dali neei biɛɣu maa n-kali hal ni biɛɣ pihinu, di nyaaŋa ka yi naanyi zaŋ chi mini kawaan pala na ti mali chi mini kawana sara ti Yawɛ.
en: You will count off fifty days until the day after the seventh Sabbath. Then you must present a new grain offering to the LORD.

dag: Ka yi ʒiɛmannim ti baŋ ni n ni daa yihi Izraɛlnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la, n daa chɛ ka bɛ bela suɣa ni. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: so that your future generations will know that I made the Israelites live in huts when I brought them out of the land of Egypt; I am the LORD your God.

dag: Ka zuliya bɔbili ti kana ti yɛli, Kamiyana ka ti du Yawɛ zoli zuɣu n-chaŋ Yaakubu Naawuni jɛmbu duu, ka o ti wuhi ti o soya, ka ti dol o soya maa. Dama wuhibu ni ti yi Ziɔn na, ka Yawɛ yɛligu yi Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: People of many nations will come and say, Let's go up to the mountain of the Lord God of Jacob and worship in his temple. The Lord will teach us his Law from Jerusalem, and we will obey him.

dag: Ka Yisa ni daa yuri nyaandol so la yɛli Pita, Ti Duuma m-bala! Pita daa pirigila o binyɛrigu sɔŋ ka tumdi tuma, ka o ni daa ti wum ni di nyɛla bɛ Duuma maa, ka o zaŋ o binyɛrigu maa ye n-kpilim lu teeku kom maa ni ha.
en: The follower Jesus loved very much said to Peter, That man is the Lord! When Peter heard him say it was the Lord, he wrapped his coat around himself. Then he jumped into the water.

dag: Imɛr daŋ ni: Hanani mini Zɛbadia.
en: Of the family of Immer: Hanani and Zebadiah.

dag: Ka naa daa lan yɛl o, A mi amaŋmaŋ suhu ni a ni daa tum m ba Dauda tuumbiɛ shɛŋa la zaa, dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni labis a tuumbiɛri maa zaa ʒil a.
en: I know you remember all the cruel things you did to my father David. Now the Lord is going to punish you for what you did.

dag: Dindina n naan lu bɛ dimnim zuɣu pumpɔŋɔ; n naan filim bɛ dimnim maa zaa ti ba.
en: I would quickly defeat their enemies and conquer all their foes.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka jɛra gbibi liɣiri ni bɛ da yɛm, ka lee nyɛ bɛn ka yɛm din ni tooi bɔhim?.
en: It does a fool no good to spend money on an education, because he has no common sense.

dag: yɛtɔɣa yɛli ba, Izraɛlnima wummiya, yi vu m-miri ni yi ti tuhi yi dimnim zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira bee n-zɔriya dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka yi ni sɔhira bee n-zɔri ba dabiɛm.
en: He will say to them: Listen, Israel: Right now you are advancing to wage war against your enemies. Dont be discouraged! Dont be afraid! Dont panic! Dont shake in fear on account of them.

dag: Chɛ ka n wumd a yurilim maŋli la yɛla asiba kam; dama nyini ka n niŋ naani. N suhir a, wuhim ma n ni yɛn doli so shɛli, dama nyini ka n kuhiri niŋda.
en: Show me your faithful love this morning. I trust in you. Show me what I should do. I put my life in your hands!.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ n kpiɔŋ ŋuna n-lan nyɛ n yaa. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun ti ma tiliginsim. Ŋuna n-nyɛ n Naawuni, ka n ni paɣir o. O nyɛla n yab Naawuni, ka n ni duh o pam.
en: The Lord is my strength. He saves me, and I sing songs of praise to him. He is my God, and I praise him. He is the God of my ancestors, and I honor him.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim yi ni doli n zaligu shɛŋa zaa n ni zali ba la mini n dabili Musa ni daa zali ba la zaa, n ku chɛ ka bɛ lan yi n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli n-ti bɛ yaannim maa ni n-chani dari ginda.
en: I will not cause the Israelites to leave the land that I gave to their ancestors. I will let the people stay in their land if they obey everything I commanded them and all the teachings that my servant Moses gave them.

dag: O ni yɛn doli so shɛli kana, dina ka o ti lan yɛn ŋmaligi dol labi ka ku kpe tiŋ ŋɔ ni na. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: He will go back by the same way he came. He wont enter this city, declares the LORD.

dag: Bɛn daa pahi bɛ zuɣu n-nyɛ Hɛman mini Jɛdutun ni bɛ ni daa lan pii ninvuɣ shɛb zali ni bɛ paɣiri Yawɛ o yurilim din bi naara ŋɔ zuɣu la.
en: Heman, Jeduthun, and all the other Levites were chosen by name to praise the Lord , singing, His faithful love will last forever.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba ata maa yi zoli maa zuɣu siɣina nti paala salo pam.
en: The next day, Jesus, Peter, John, and James came down from the mountain. A large group of people met Jesus.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Sintani daa zaŋ o chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ti du tam Naawuni jɛmbu duu zuɣusaa kpaakpaanyom ni ha ka yɛl o, A yi shiri nyɛla Naawuni Bia, nyin bahim amaŋ lu tiŋ sa;.
en: The devil brought him into Jerusalem and stood him at the highest point of the temple. He said to him, Since you are Gods Son, throw yourself down from here.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Miriya ka yi chɛ ka anabi shɛb mini laasabuniŋdib shɛb bɛn be yi san la yɔhim ya. Di gbilisiya tibili wumdi bɛ ni zahindi zahin shɛŋa la.
en: The LORD of heavenly forces, the God of Israel, proclaims: Dont let the prophets and diviners in your midst mislead you. Dont pay attention to your dreams.

dag: Bɛn su bipuɣiŋga maa ni daa nya ka bɛ ku lan di o baɣibuɣibo maa nyɔri maa ka bɛ daa gbaai Pool mini Silas n-vo ba tahi tiŋ maa kpamba sani daa puuni.
en: When the girl's owners realized they had lost all chances for making more money, they grabbed Paul and Silas and dragged them into court.

dag: Daadam, zaŋm a nini kpa Ammɔnnim polo tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi ba.
en: Human one, face the Ammonites and prophesy against them.

dag: Amaa yi yi zaɣisi, ka niŋ tipawumli, Yawɛ yɛliya, Bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi kun ya. .
en: But if you turn against me, your enemies will kill you. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Amaa goli biɛɣ pinaanu dali ka Yɛhudianim bɛn daa be Susa puuni maa bɛn daa zaŋ leei bɛ Vuhim Dabisili. Bɛ ni daa na kul be bɛ dimnim maa kubu ni biɛɣ pinaata mini biɛɣ pinaanahi dali, ka daa ti chɛ ba kubu la biɛɣ pinaanu dal la zuɣu.
en: The Jews in Susa joined together for self-defense on the thirteenth and fourteenth days of the month. But they rested on the fifteenth day of the month and made it a day of feasts and joyous events.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa chaŋ ti zani wain tihi puri sunsuuni luɣ shɛli din bi yɛlim shee ka goma be di yaɣa ayi zaa.
en: Then the angel stood between two vineyards, in a narrow path with a stone wall on each side.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Yi yi gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ du m-paai Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: to give the people of Israel this message: When you cross the Jordan River and enter Canaan.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa yɛli Sukɔtinima, N suhiri ya, niŋmiya bɔrɔbɔro ti n niriba bɛn doli ma ŋɔ; dama di wum ba pam, ka m mi na kariti dolila Midian nanim Zɛba mini Zalimuna.
en: Gideon said to the men of the city of Succoth, Give my soldiers something to eat. They are very tired. We are still chasing Zebah and Zalmunna, kings of Midian.

dag: Yiŋbia maa yiŋlan maa yi ti kuna nya o ni lala, o ni nya suhupiɛlli.
en: Happy are those servants whom the master finds fulfilling their responsibilities when he comes.

dag: Naawuni ŋun daa bi zaɣisi ni omaŋmaŋ Bia kpi, amaa ka daa zaŋ o ti ti zaa ŋɔ, o ku zaŋ binshɛɣukam din kpalim zaa gba pah o zuɣu ti ti?.
en: God did not keep back his own Son, but he gave him for us. If God did this, won't he freely give us everything else?.

dag: Mbusim be yinim bɛn bɔri ni yi nya Yawɛ dabisili la zuɣu. Zaɣ viɛl bɔ ka Yawɛ dabisili maa yɛn tum ya? Di yɛn nyɛla zibisim dabisili, ka pa ni neesim dabisili.
en: How terrible it will be for you who long for the day of the Lord ! What good will that day do you? For you it will be a day of darkness and not of light.

dag: Ŋunkam gol o ba paɣa, noli din dim o, o ni ta o ba bindoo daɣiri zuɣu. Ka sokam yɛli, Ami.
en: The Levites will say, Cursed is the one who shames his father by having sexual relations with his fathers wife. Then all the people will say, Amen.

dag: Sana bee tinzun nir yi be yi sani ka ti leei bundana, ka yi mabia mi leei faralana, ka zaŋ omaŋa pa talima san maa bee tinzun nir maa bee san maa yiŋ ninvuɣ so sani.
en: Maybe a foreigner or visitor among you becomes rich. Or maybe someone from your own country becomes so poor that they sell themselves as slaves to a foreigner living among you or to a member of a foreigners family.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Anatɔtnim bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku a la polo m-bɔŋɔ. Bɛ yɛra, Miri ka a lan zaŋ Yawɛ yuli tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa yaha, di yi pa lala ti ni ku a.
en: This is what the LORD says concerning the men from Anathoth who seek your life and say, Dont prophesy in the LORDs name or else you will die at our hands.

dag: Amaa ka Lɔt daa yɛli ba, Aai, n duumanima, n suhiri ya.
en: Lot answered, You have done us a great favor, sir. You have saved our lives, but please don't make us go to the hills. That's too far away. The city will be destroyed before we can get there, and we will be killed when it happens.

dag: Ka Liya bɔh o, A ni fa n yidan maa nyɛla yɛli bila? Ka a lan bɔri ni a fa n ŋmaankpihiga gba pahi? Ka Reechɛl yɛl o, Kpɛm o sani zuŋɔ yuŋ ŋɔ a bia ŋmaankpihiga maa zuɣu.
en: Leah replied, Isnt it enough that youve taken my husband? Now you want to take my sons erotic herbs too? Rachel said, For your sons erotic herbs, Jacob may sleep with you tonight.

dag: A daa nyɛla ŋun ka galimi a biɛhigu ni a nambu dali hal ka bɛ ti nya alahichi a ni.
en: Your conduct was perfect from the day you were created until you began to do evil.

dag: Ka Izraɛl kpamba zaa daa kana, ka maligumaaniba daa kpuɣi Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka Kasi maa buɣi.
en: When all the elders of Israel arrived, the priests and Levites carried the Holy Box of the Lord up to the Temple. They also carried the Meeting Tent and all the holy things that were in it up to the Temple.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du n-chaŋ ti piligi Aroa mini fɔn tin shɛli din daa be vinvamli sunsuuni zaŋ kpa Gaad din be Jaza polo la.
en: After they crossed over the Jordan River, they made their camp in Aroer on the right side of the city.

dag: Ka maligumaana Pashihur ŋun daa nyɛ Imɛr bia, ka nyɛ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu kpɛm la daa wum Jɛrimia anabitali yɛtɔɣa zaŋ chaŋ binyara ŋɔ polo.
en: When the priest Pashhur son of Immer, who was the chief officer of the Temple, heard me proclaim these things.

dag: Aduna bihi n-daa nyɛ Nadab mini Abihu ni Ɛliɛza ni Itama.
en: Aaron was the father of Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

dag: N sabila yɛla ŋɔ ti yinim bɛn niŋ Naawuni Bia maa yuli yɛda la ni di chɛ ka yi baŋ ni yi mali nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: All of you have faith in the Son of God, and I have written to let you know you have eternal life.

dag: Ka binnɛma maa daa kul chani tooni ka labiri nyaaŋa yomyom kaman saa nyaɣisibu la.
en: The creatures themselves darted back and forth with the speed of lightning.

dag: Ka yi yi ti yɛn kpe tɔb maa tuhibu ni, yin chɛliya ka maligumaaniba kana ti zani tooni n-tɔɣisi tɔbbihi maa.
en: As you advance toward the war, the priest will come forward and will address the troops.

dag: Chɛ ka ti yɛli ni so yi ti ye binyɛr suma, ka piri salima nintuhi kpe yi laɣiŋgu ni na, ka nandana ŋun ye binchɛra gba kpɛna.
en: Imagine two people coming into your meeting. One has a gold ring and fine clothes, while the other is poor, dressed in filthy rags.

dag: Ka Judanim zaa daa zaŋ Uzia ŋun daa nyɛ yuun pinaayɔbu bia la leei naa zal o ba Amazia zaani.
en: Then the people of Judah chose Uzziah to be the new king in place of Amaziah. Amaziah was Uzziahs father. Uzziah was years old when he became king.

dag: Chɛ ka di yuŋ maa leei bumbɔn titali. Di chɛ ka di leei suhupiɛlli dabisili pahi yuuni puuni dabisa zuɣu. Di kal li pahi goya dabisa ni.
en: May gloom seize that night; may it not be counted in the days of a year; may it not appear in the months.

dag: Ka binneen shɛb bɛn be tiŋgban ni ka nyɛ bɛn nyɛ daɣiri n-nyɛ: nantariga mini jɛŋgbariga ni wua min o balibu zaa.
en: Moles, rats, mice, and lizards must be considered unclean.

dag: ka Rafu bia Paliti daa yi Bɛnjamin zuliya ni na;.
en: from the tribe of Benjamin, Palti, Raphus son.

dag: Shɛmia bidibisi maa n-daa nyɛ: Otini mini Rɛfaɛl ni Obɛd ni Ɛlizabad ŋun mabihi daa nyɛ bɛn mali yiko la ni Ɛlihu ni Sɛmakia.
en: Shemaiahs sons were Othni, Rephael, Obed, Elzabad, Elihu, and Semakiah. Elzabads relatives were skilled workers.

dag: Do so ŋun daa kpaŋ maa daa bi mi ŋun chɛ ka o kpaŋ maa ni nyɛ so, dama salo daa galisiya nimaani, ka Yisa mi pun yi ni chaŋ o chandi.
en: But he did not know who Jesus was, and Jesus had left because of the crowd.

dag: Nyini n-chɛ ka goli wuhiri saha, ka chɛ ka wuntaŋ mi o lubu saha.
en: Lord, you made the moon to show us when the festivals begin. And the sun always knows when to set.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Naa Zɛdɛkia daa po pɔri ashilɔni Jɛrimia sani yɛli, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ka nyɛ ŋun tiri ti nyɛvili ŋɔ zuɣu, n ku ku a, m mi ku zaŋ a niŋ bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku a maa nuu ni.
en: So King Zedekiah swore to Jeremiah behind closed doors, As the LORD lives, who has given us this life, I wont put you to death and I wont hand you over to those who seek to kill you.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ n ti yɛn kana, kpaŋm amaŋ karimmi Naawuni Kundi niriba ni, ka yihimi waazu, ka wuhimi niriba.
en: Until I come, give your time and effort to the public reading of the Scriptures and to preaching and teaching.

dag: Yawɛ zɔbu nti yɛn nyɛ o suhu ni yuri shɛli. O ti ku kari nimmira saria bee n-kari, Bɛ yɛliya, saria.
en: His greatest joy will be to obey the Lord . This king won't judge by appearances or listen to rumors.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun be samban ni yi shihi bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku so bee n-shihi ninvuɣ so ŋun kpi o dahalali kum bee n-shihi ninsal kɔbili bee gballi, dilana ni leei ŋun bi be nyam daba ayopɔin.
en: Anyone in the open field who touches a person slain by the sword, or who died naturally, or a human bone or a grave, will be unclean for seven days.

dag: Bɛ niŋgbuna zaa sheei lu, ka nir ku lan tooi nya li, ka bɛ kɔba din daa bi tooi nyarila yina.
en: the flesh wastes away, no longer visible; the bones, once hidden, protrude.

dag: Naa Uzia ni daa tum tuun shɛli zaa pahi min o ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: The rest of Azariahs deeds and all he accomplished, arent they written in the official records of Judahs kings?.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah ata daa piɛb o kikaa, ka saŋmar titali ŋun ne kaman buɣim mokpalli la yi zuɣusaa n-lu mɔɣa ata kam zaɣ yin ni mini kɔbilisi ni.
en: When the third angel blew his trumpet, a great star fell from heaven. It was burning like a torch, and it fell on a third of the rivers and on a third of the springs of water.

dag: Ka di bi simdi ni man chɛ ka paɣ so ŋun nyɛ ti yab Ibrahimma zuliya ka Sintani daa lo m-pɔri gɔɣ o yuun pisaayika ŋɔ kpaŋ Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: This woman belongs to the family of Abraham, but Satan has kept her bound for years. Isn't it right to set her free on the Sabbath.

dag: Ka tuumba ayi maa yɛli Reehab, Biɛhiŋ kani, ti ni niŋ a ni chɛ ka ti po ni ti niŋ shɛli maa.
en: The men said to her, We will keep the promise that you have made us give.

dag: Di zaŋya bindira dibu yɛla saɣim Naawuni tuma. Binshɛli kani n-chihiri dibu, amaa di nyɛla taali ni so chɛ ka o ni diri binshɛli zuɣu chɛ ka o tab lu.
en: Dont let the eating of food destroy the work of God. All food is right to eat, but it is wrong for anyone to eat something that hurts the faith of another person.

dag: Maika daa malila binnana jɛmbu duu; ka daa she mukuru laasabu din nyɛ bɛ ni daa lihiri shɛli ni buɣiri baɣa niŋ di ni, ka daa zaŋ o bidib yino leeg o maligumaana.
en: This man Micah had his own place of worship. He made some idols and an ephod, and appointed one of his sons as his priest.

dag: Dolimi naa nyɛvili; ka chɛ ka o kul be ʒiɛmani kam ni!.
en: Let the king have a long and healthy life.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Aai, ti ku ku a, ti kul yɛn zaŋ a mi ti ti ba. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ mi pala ayi lo o n-zaŋ o tampiŋ lɔŋ maa ni na ti ti ba.
en: We wont, they said to him. Well only take you prisoner so we can turn you over to them. We wont kill you. Then they tied him up with two new ropes, and brought him up from the rock.

dag: Ka ŋunkam tibigir omaŋa ni nya filiŋ, ka ŋunkam mi siɣisiri omaŋa ni nya tibiginsim.
en: People who think they are better than others will be made humble. But people who humble themselves will be made great.

dag: N ni ti be Izraɛlnim sani n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: I will live among the people of Israel, and I will be their God.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ŋun kul maari bɛn suhuri saɣindi suhuri ŋɔ daa maai ti suhuri Taitus kandina la zuɣu.
en: However, God comforts people who are discouraged, and he comforted us by Titus arrival.

dag: Di saha ka tumtumdi kpɛm maa daa yɛli o suhu ni, N dana yi yihi ma o tuma ŋɔ ni, wula ka n yɛn niŋ? N lan ka yaa din ni tooi tum tuun kpɛma, ka mi zɔri vi ni m mali bara.
en: So, the manager thought to himself, What will I do? My master is taking my job away from me. I am not strong enough to dig ditches. I am too proud to beg.

dag: M bi sabila yɛtɔɣa pihita ti a ni di ti a saɣisigu mini baŋsim.
en: I have written sayings for you. These are words of advice and wisdom.

dag: Ka o daa tirisi tooni ha nti nya Alifius bia Lɛvi, ka o ʒi farigu deebu shee. Ka Yisa yɛl o, Yiɣisim doli ma! Ka o yiɣisi dol o.
en: As he walked along, he saw a tax collector, Levi son of Alphaeus, sitting in his office. Jesus said to him, Follow me. Levi got up and followed him.

dag: Ka Samsin min o ba ni o ma daa yiɣisi chani Timna, ka Samsin daa ti kpe bɛ wain tihi puu ni; ka gbuɣim polli nya o ŋumda.
en: Then Samson traveled down to Timnah with his father and mother. When he came to the vineyards in Timnah, suddenly a lone young lion came roaring to meet him.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋdi dimbɔŋɔ ka gbib li viɛnyɛliŋga ni nya alibarika. Ŋunkam gbibi Vuhim Dabisili viɛnyɛliŋga ka bi saɣim li, ka mi bi tumdi din bie ni nya alibarika.
en: I will bless everyone who respects the Sabbath and refuses to do wrong.

dag: Di lihi ʒiɛm ma, n ni sabigi maa zuɣu. Wuntaŋa n-kpe ma ka n sabigi maa. N tizɔdɔbba jɛla suli niŋ ma; bɛ chɛ ka n gulila wain tihi puu, ka kɔŋ dahima maani mmaŋa.
en: Don't look down on me because of my color, because the sun has tanned me. My brothers were angry with me and made me work in the vineyard. I had no time to care for myself.

dag: n yɛn zaŋ ya mi ti wulimpuhili polo nima ka bɛ sun ya. Ka bɛ ti ti bɛ suɣa yi sani n-ʒini yi sunsuuni. Bɛ ni ti di yi tiwala, ka nyu yi bihim.
en: Now I am going to let you be conquered by tribes from the eastern desert. They will set up their camps in your land and eat your fruit and drink your milk.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti kuhi boli ti Duuma yuli ni tiligi. .
en: And then, whoever calls out to the Lord for help will be saved.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Dauda daa ti bɔhi, Sool daŋ ni ninvuɣ so na beni ka n ni niŋ o nirilim Jɔnatan zuɣu.
en: David asked, Is there anyone still left in Sauls family? I want to show kindness to this person. I want to do it for Jonathan.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm paɣiba, n sabigimi, amaa ka viɛli pam. N sabigimi kaman tiŋgban nɛl ni Kɛdar tanti suɣa la, amaa ka viɛli pam kaman Naa Sulemaana pateesanima.
en: My skin is dark and beautiful, like a tent in the desert or like Solomon's curtains.

dag: Paɣipiɛl so ni ti niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga, ka bɛ ti bol o yuli Imanuɛl. Di gbinni nyɛla, Naawuni be ti sani.
en: A virgin will have a baby boy, and he will be called Immanuel, which means God is with us.

dag: Ka doo maa yɛl o, Bɛ zaŋ kpa luɣ shɛli polo, dama n wumya ka bɛ yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ Dɔtan. Di saha ka Yisifu daa biɛh o biɛyanim maa naba nti nya ba Dɔtan maa.
en: They're not here anymore, the man replied. I overheard them say they were going to Dothan. Joseph left and found his brothers in Dothan.

dag: Naa Sulemaana daa zaŋla yuun pisi m-me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini ŋun Sulemaana nam yili.
en: It took years for the Lord 's temple and Solomon's palace to be built.

dag: Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zani dabari ka yi suhuri paligi shɛm, lala ka n yɛn niŋ yi gba; nyini Siɛr Zoli mini Ɛdom zaa ni zani dabari. Di saha ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Just as you rejoiced over the house of Israels inheritance because it became desolate, so I will deal with you. Mount Seir, you will become a desolation, with all of Edom, all of it. Then they will know that I am the LORD.

dag: Yawɛ suhu ni ti yiɣisi bahi yi zuɣu, ka o chɛ ka saa ku lan min ya, ka yi bindira ku niŋ, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi kpi yomyom Yawɛ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ viɛl shɛli tiri ya maa ni.
en: the Lord will become angry and keep the rain from falling. Nothing will grow in your fields, and you will die and disappear from the good land that the Lord is giving you.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Pumpɔŋɔ n ni labisi Yaakubu zuliya daazichi ti ba, ka zo Izraɛlnim zaa nambɔɣu. Ka n ni ti zabi nyuli n yuli din be kasi ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: So the LORD God proclaims: Now I will bring back the captives of Jacob. I will have compassion on the whole house of Israel and defend my holy name.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa nya ka Musa birigi kanna ni o ti nya li maa, ka Naawuni daa bol o tutuɣu maa ni, Musa! Musa! Ka o garigi yɛli, N-nyɛ ma.
en: The Lord saw Moses was coming to look at the bush. So he called to him from the bush. He said, Moses, Moses! Moses said, Yes, Lord.

dag: Ka kɔŋlan so daa ka Yisa sanna nti damd o tooni m-balind o yɛra, A yi di saɣi, a naan chɛ ka n kɔŋ ŋɔ naai ka n kpe n tab ni.
en: A man who had leprosy came to Jesus. The man bowed on his knees and begged him, You have the power to heal me if you want.

dag: Naawuni zaligunim min anabinim yɛligu daa pun benimi hal ka Jɔn Baptaizira ti kana; di saha maa zaŋ kana zuŋɔ, bɛ kul mooni Naawuni nam lahibal suŋ, ka ŋunkam suhu ye di zuɣu kul zaŋdila kpiɔŋ ni o ti kpe di ni.
en: The Law of Moses and the writings of the prophets were in effect up to the time of John the Baptist; since then the Good News about the Kingdom of God is being told, and everyone forces their way in.

dag: Naawuni yino ŋun nyɛ ti zaa Ba, ka nyɛ ti zaa Duuma ŋun be ti zaa ni ka tumdi ti zaa ni la m-beni.
en: There is one God who is the Father of all people. Not only is God above all others, but he works by using all of us, and he lives in all of us.

dag: Puhimiya yi zuɣulaannim mini Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda la zaa ti ma. Ti mabihi bɛn nyɛ Italinim la puhiri ya.
en: Greet your leaders and all of Gods holy people. The group from Italy greets you.

dag: Amaa nyin suhu min a nini kul mirigila a nyamma din bi doli so shɛli din tuhi ŋɔ zuɣu, ka a kuri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali, ka doli kiŋkansi soli nahindi niriba.
en: But all you think about is how to cheat or abuse or murder some innocent victim.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa daa yɛl o kpambaliba, Yi mi ni Ramɔtigiliad nyɛla ti ni su luɣ shɛli, ka ti kul shini ka bi deei li Siria Naa sani maa.
en: Ahab asked his officials, Why haven't we tried to get Ramoth in Gilead back from the Syrians? It belongs to us.

dag: Ka Amasa daa kpi n-do o ʒim ni solɔɣu maa zuɣu. Ka ŋunkam daa yi kana ti nya o, dilan kpalindimi zani. Ka doo maa ni daa nya ka niriba kanna ti kpalindi zaani maa, ka o daa vuui Amasa solɔɣu maa zuɣu nti sɔŋ mɔri ni, ka zaŋ binyɛrigu pa o zuɣu.
en: Amasa was there in the middle of road, lying in his own blood. The young soldier noticed that all the people kept stopping to look at the body, so he rolled the body off the road and into the field and covered it with a cloth.

dag: amaa zaŋ tabili ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka ti sani kpe zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ gba.
en: He is making it with all of us who stand here in his presence today and also with our descendants who are not yet born.

dag: Ka Ɛbɛd bia Gaal maa daa ti yina ti zani tiŋ maa gooni dunol ni, ka Abimilɛk min o niriba maa yiɣisi bɛ sɔɣibu shee maa yina.
en: Gaal son of Ebed went out and was standing at the entrance to the gate of the city of Shechem. While Gaal was standing there, Abimelech and his soldiers came out of their hiding places.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Yilimiya yili palli paɣi Yawɛ! Paɣimiy o, o niriba bɛn ʒe o yim laɣiŋgu ni.
en: Praise the LORD! Sing to the LORD a new song; sing Gods praise in the assembly of the faithful!.

dag: N ni kul wuhi ba ka ti ba yaa maa zaa yoli, bɛ bo soya n-tum tuumbiɛri jɛndi ma.
en: I taught them what they know, and I made them strong. Now they plot against me.

dag: Yi zaŋ kpamli yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi ninvuɣ so ŋun ka yɛm, ka tɔɣisi yɛm yɛtɔɣa pam.
en: advised one lacking wisdom, informed many with insight!.

dag: Ka o bihi maa daa niŋ kaman bɛ ba ni daa zali ba shɛm.
en: So Jacobs sons did what their father told them.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ daantalisi maa sa Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dunɔdali luɣa zuɣu; yini daa sala nudirigu polo, ka din la mi sa nuzaa polo. Ka bɛ daa boli din sa nudirigu polo maa Jachin, ka boli din sa nuzaa polo maa mi Bɔaz.
en: Then he set up the pillars in front of the sanctuary, one on the south, the other on the north. The one on the south he named Jachin, and the one on the north he named Boaz.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira baptaizibu la, Naawuni n-daa lee zal li bee ninsalinima.
en: When John baptized people, did his authority come from God or was it only from other people.

dag: Wummiya satahiŋga din yi o kukoli ni na mini vu shɛli din yir o nol ni na.
en: Listen to Gods thundering voice! Listen to the sound coming from his mouth.

dag: Amaa m mini n niriba ŋɔ mi lee nyɛ banima, ka ni tooi zaŋ pina ŋɔ ti a ti suhu yubu puuni? Dama binshɛɣukam zaa yila a sanna, a ni su shɛli ka ti lan zaŋ ti a maa.
en: Who am I, and who are my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly? Since everything comes from you, we have given you that which comes from your own hand.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛhiɛl bia Shɛkania ŋun daa yi Ɛlam daŋ ni na la daa yɛli Ɛzra, Tinima n-zaɣisi ti Naawuni noli ka kpuɣ tinzun paɣiba tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ niriba sani, amaa di zaa yoli, Izraɛlnim na kul mali tahima.
en: Shecaniah son of Jehiel from the family of Elam said: Ezra, we have disobeyed God by marrying these foreign women. But there is still hope for the people of Israel.

dag: Ka padiriba maa daa gbahi o yiŋbihi maa n-fiɛb bɛ yino, ka ku yino, ka lab yino mi kuɣa.
en: But the tenant farmers grabbed his servants. They beat some of them, and some of them they killed. Some of them they stoned to death.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapuhi, ka niŋ salima pa di zuɣu ni bɛ mal li kpuɣiri teebuli maa.
en: He made the poles used to carry the table out of acacia wood, and he covered them with gold.

dag: Naawuni lo alikauli o luɣ kasi shee yɛli, N kpiɔŋ zuɣu, n ni pirigi Shɛkɛm; ka zaŋ Sukɔt Vinvamli tari.
en: Our God, from your holy place you made this promise: I will gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri yɛtɔɣa nyɛla din tahiri kum na, amaa ninvuɣ suma yɛtɔɣa nyɛla din tiligiri ba.
en: Bad advice is a deadly trap, but good advice is like a shield.

dag: Ifriimnima, wula ka n ni tooi zaɣisi ya? Izraɛlnima, wula ka n ni tooi chɛn ya bahi? Wula ka n ni niŋ ya kaman n ni daa niŋ Adimanim shɛm la? Ka wula ka n ni tooi niŋ ya kaman n ni daa niŋ Zɛbɔiimnim shɛm la? N suhu taɣiya, ka n nambɔzɔbo galisi.
en: Ephraim, I dont want to give you up. Israel, I want to protect you. I dont want to make you like Admah. I dont want to make you like Zeboiim. I am changing my mind. My love for you is too strong.

dag: Ka Sool daa bɔh o, Nachimbila, ŋun dapala n-lee nyɛ a? Ka Dauda daa garigi yɛl o, A dabili Jɛsi ŋun nyɛ Bɛtilihɛm nir la dapala n-nyɛ ma.
en: Saul said to him, Whose son are you, my boy? Im the son of your servant Jesse from Bethlehem, David answered.

dag: Di kɔŋkɔba bebu din pahi nyɛla, di daa simdi ni bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba nyɛla ninvuɣ bɔbili bɛ ni daa kpiri ka bɛ tuma zaani tariga la zuɣu;.
en: Also, when one of those other priests died, he could not continue being a priest. So there were many of those priests.

dag: Bɛ nyarila ʒiinim din nyɛ ʒiri tir a, bɛ buɣirila ʒiri baɣiri tir a. Bɛ zaŋ a mi pa ninvuɣ yoya mini ninvuɣ biɛri nyiŋgoya zuɣu. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn dabisili pali, ka nyɛ tibidarigibo din bahindi nyaaŋa saha.
en: False visions and lying divinations set you against the necks of vile, wicked men whose day had come, the time of final punishment.

dag: Amaŋmaŋ cham miri ha ti wum Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn yɛli shɛm. Di nyaaŋa ka a yɛli ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛl a shɛm zaa, ka ti wum ka niŋ li.
en: Moses, go up close and listen to the Lord . Then come back and tell us, and we will do everything he says.

dag: dama n nyɛla tarim dɔɣirili, amaa o bi chɛ ma piibu di zuɣu. Ka zuŋɔ zaŋ chana, ʒiɛmani kam nim ni boli ma alibarika paɣa;.
en: I am not important, but he has shown his care for me, his lowly servant. From now until the end of time, people will remember how much God blessed me.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Aduna, Zaŋmi duɣu n-zahim manna maa lita ayi n-kpaai niŋ di ni n-zaŋ li ti zali Yawɛ tooni, ka di be nimaani yi ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: Moses said to Aaron, Take a jar, put two quarts of manna in it, and place it in the Lord 's presence to be kept for our descendants.

dag: Ka di ni yiri ninvuɣ so tooni na maa yi ba binshɛlikam n-ʒini di gali zuɣu, gali maa ni leei din be daɣiri ni.
en: If that man sits on a saddle, it will become unclean.

dag: Wummiya, di simdi ni n wuhi ya shihir shɛŋa min alahiziba tumtumsa shɛŋa Zallakudura Naa ni kahigi wuhi ma.
en: I am very happy to tell you about the miracles and wonderful things that the Most High God did for me.

dag: Dindali maa dɔbba ayi ni ti be puu ni; ka Naawuni ti kpuɣ yino ka chɛ ŋun la.
en: Two men will be working together in the field. One will be taken and the other will be left.

dag: Di saha maa ka anabinim ayi maa daa wum ka kukol shɛli yi zuɣusaa na n-yɛri ba, Dumiya kpe na! Ka bɛ daa kpe sagban ni n-du alizanda ni bɛ dimnim maa ninni.
en: Then they heard a loud voice from heaven say to them, Come up here. And they went up to heaven in a cloud, while their enemies watched them.

dag: Bɛ ni ti di yi buni, ka ʒe yi daguya. Bɛ ni ti daai yi goma luhi, ka wurim yi yil viɛla la. Bɛ ni ti va yi kuɣa mini yi taabɔdari ni yi taŋkpazim ti bahi kom ni.
en: They will destroy your wealth, plunder your goods, tear down your walls, and raze your fine houses. Your stone, lumber, and rubble they will dump into the sea.

dag: O daa malila biŋkɔbbaligu tusaayopɔin mini laakumnim tusaata ni naɣilakɔra tuhili ni bunnyama kɔbisinu, ka mali tumtumdiba pam; ka lala zuɣu daa chɛ ka o nyɛ ninvuɣ titali gari wulimpuhili polɔnim zaa.
en: He owned sheep, camels, oxen, and female donkeys. He had many servants. He was the richest man in the east.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔ puuni, a ka yɛlimaŋli, n ni garig a: Naawuni galisiya gari daadam kam.
en: Now youre wrong about this; Ill answer you, for God is greater than anybody.

dag: Nir yi ŋma ʒiri nya bindirigu di nyaɣisa, amaa di nyaaŋa taŋkuɣa n-yɛn pal o noli.
en: Stolen bread is sweet, but afterward the mouth is full of gravel.

dag: Ka n daai yi ni zaŋ bimpiɛlli paligi goon shɛli maa luhi tiŋa n-wurim li ka chɛ di tanzahi zali. Di ni ti lu n-kun ya, ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: You put plaster on the wall, but I will destroy the whole wall. I will pull it to the ground. The wall will fall on you, and then you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Mɛlikizɛdɛk daa bi yi Lɛvi zuliya ni na, amaa o daa deei zaka ti yab Ibrahimma sani, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ ŋuna ŋun daa deei Naawuni daalikaulinim la ni.
en: Although Melchizedek wasn't a descendant of Levi, Abraham gave him a tenth of what he had. Then Melchizedek blessed Abraham, who had been given God's promise.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni bɔri ni niriba niŋdi ya shɛm, yi gba niŋmiya ba lala, dama Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim min anabinim yɛligu ni wuhiri shɛm m-bala.
en: Therefore, you should treat people in the same way that you want people to treat you; this is the Law and the Prophets.

dag: Bɛ ni daa sabi gbaŋ maa n-yɛl o shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Naa Darius ka ti sabi gbaŋ ŋɔ tira. Naawuni ti ma suhudoo zaa!.
en: In the message they sent him, the following was written: To King Darius, all peace!.

dag: Hal binshɛŋa din ka nyɛvili kaman yua bee mɔɣilo, ka pa ni bɛ piɛb li mi bee ŋ-ŋme li ka di doli soli, wula ka nir ni tooi baŋ di ni kum yɛli shɛm?.
en: Take such lifeless musical instruments as the flute or the harp—how will anyone know the tune that is being played unless the notes are sounded distinctly?.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ti ni daa wum Naawuni Bia maa sani ka yɛri ya di yɛla. Dina n-nyɛ: Naawuni nyɛla neesim, ka zibisim ka o ni hal baabiɛla.
en: We heard the true teaching from God. Now we tell it to you: God is light, and in him there is no darkness.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ kabiɛlim maa ʒi n-kuli ti wuh o yidan ma o ni nya shɛm tariga. Ka daa lan zaŋ o ni ŋub ka guui bɔrɔbɔro shɛl la gba ti o.
en: She took the grain to town and showed Naomi how much she had picked up. Ruth also gave her the food left over from her lunch.

dag: Bɛ dɔbba bɛn daa nyɛ gol yini zaŋ chani zaa kalinli daa yiɣisila tusaayopɔin ni kɔbisinu.
en: Their enrollment, according to the number of males over one month old, was .

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, nahiŋgu nyɛla din chɛri ka yɛndan niŋdi jɛrigu, ka birapu dibu mi saɣindi nira.
en: You may be wise, but if you cheat someone, you are acting like a fool. If you take a bribe, you ruin your character.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ taŋkpaɣu ka Naawuni daa zaŋ nam tuuli Adam; ka Adam ŋun pah ayi maa mi nyɛ ŋun yi alizanda ni na.
en: The first Adam, made of earth, came from the earth; the second Adam came from heaven.

dag: Hal ka wuhiri li buri ni mini duu kpɛhibu ni ni muɣisigu nyabu duŋtaariba nuu ni ni tuun kpɛma tumbu ni ni gɔgaliga ni ni kumkpibo puuni.
en: We went through beatings, imprisonments, and riots. We experienced hard work, sleepless nights, and hunger.

dag: Ka yi beni duhiri yimaŋa! Di di bi simdi ni yi fabindimi? Yihimiya ninvuɣ so ŋun tum lala maa yi ni.
en: And youre proud of yourselves instead of being so upset that the one who did this thing is expelled from your community.

dag: O chɛ ka binshɛɣukam mali di saha; ka din pahi nyɛla, o chɛ ka ti mi din pun niŋ, din saha gari mini din na yɛn niŋ dahin shɛli ha yɛla. Amaa ka ti lee ku tooi baŋ ŋun Naawuni ni pun niŋ shɛm kurimbuni ha ni o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm di bahigu ni.
en: God makes everything happen at the right time. Yet none of us can ever fully understand all he has done, and he puts questions in our minds about the past and the future.

dag: ka yɛli, Yaa n Naawuni, vi mali ma pam ni n kpuɣi n zuɣu zuɣusaa a tooni. Dama n Naawuni, ti daalahichi dumi hal ti yaɣi ti zuɣuri zuɣu; ka ti taali du hal ti tɔri sagbana.
en: Then I prayed this prayer: My God, I am too ashamed and embarrassed to look at you. I am ashamed because our sins are higher than our heads. Our guilt has reached all the way up to the heavens.

dag: Ka Leeban daa kana ti paai Yaakubu. Yaakubu daa tila o suɣa zali zoya ni, ka Leeban mi min o dɔɣiriba maa daa ti bɛ suɣa zali zoya ni tin shɛli din yuli booni Giliad la.
en: Jacob had set up camp in the hill country of Gilead, when Laban and his relatives came and set up camp in another part of the hill country. Laban went to Jacob.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Yɛhudianim daa maan mooi bɛ nini bɔri ni bɛ ku o, dama bɛ daa zaŋ zali ni o bi saɣim la Vuhim Dabisili dali zaligu kɔŋko, amaa ni o yɛliya ni Naawuni n-nyɛ o Ba, ka di wuhi ni o zaŋ omaŋ maɣisi Naawuni.
en: This made them even more determined to kill him. They thought it was bad enough that he was breaking the law about the Sabbath day. And now he was saying that God is his Father, making himself equal with God!.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔshafat daa ti kani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o o yab Dauda tiŋ la ni; ka o bia Jɛhɔram daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Jehoshaphat died and was buried in the royal tombs in David's City, and his son Jehoram succeeded him as king.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ ni shɛb daa yɛli, Alizin biɛri naa ŋun yuli booni Biilzibul la n-niŋ o yiko ka o kariti alizin biɛri bahiri maa.
en: But some of them said, He throws out demons with the authority of Beelzebul, the ruler of demons.

dag: M pun nyaŋ Kalino mini Karikɛmish, ka nyaŋ Hamat mini Aripad, ka nyaŋ Samaria mini Damaskus.
en: I conquered the cities of Calno and Carchemish, the cities of Hamath and Arpad. I conquered Samaria and Damascus.

dag: Ka salo maa ni yino daa kuhi yɛl o, Karimba, n suhir a mi ni a lihi m bia ŋɔ ti ma, dama o kɔŋko n-kul nyɛ m bia.
en: A man shouted from the crowd, Teacher! I beg you, look at my son—my only son!.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Do so ŋun tib ma maa n-yɛli ma ni n kpuɣimi m bindoo maa chaŋ.
en: He answered, The man who made me well told me to pick up my mat and walk.

dag: Ŋuna ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa Juda naa Amɔn bia Jɔsia nam dibu yuun pinaata saha la.
en: The LORDs word came to Jeremiah in the thirteenth year of Judahs King Josiah, Amons son.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa ti niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga, ka paɣ maa daa nya ka o bia maa viɛli pam, ka o daa zaŋ o sɔɣiri hal ni chira ata.
en: The woman became pregnant and gave birth to a son. She saw that the baby was healthy and beautiful, so she hid him for three months.

dag: O mɔŋ ma suhudoo; man tamla suhupiɛlli yɛla.
en: I have forgotten what health and peace and happiness are.

dag: N yiɣisirila yuntisuɣu m-paɣir a, a wuntia zaligunim maa zuɣu.
en: I get up in the middle of the night to give thanks to you because of your righteous rules.

dag: Amaa nyin pun kpahim baŋ n wuhibu mini m biɛhigu ni n ni lo shɛm m bebu ni ni n yɛda niŋbu yɛla zaŋ tabili n daania niŋbu ni n yurilim ni n ʒiɛyimtali.
en: But you know all about me. You know what I teach and the way I live. You know my goal in life. You know my faith, my patience, and my love. You know that I never stop trying.

dag: ni Ofiri ni Havila ni Jɔbab; bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Jokitan bidibisi.
en: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yi kumdi bɔri sɔŋsim, Yawɛ wumda, ka yihiri ba bɛ muɣisigu kam zaa ni.
en: The righteous call to the Lord , and he listens; he rescues them from all their troubles.

dag: A lee tɛhiya ni ŋuni ka a turi ka maani ansarisi maa? Mani ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ ka a niŋ karimbaani lihi ʒiɛm maa.
en: Whom did you insult and ridicule? Against whom did you raise your voice and look on with disdain? It was against the holy one of Israel!.

dag: Hal ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kahiri tandi nɛma n-tiri daa zaŋla bɛ nu yiniyini tumdi tuma, ka zaŋ nu yiniyini mi gbib bidibbina.
en: who were rebuilding the wall. Everyone who hauled building materials kept one hand free to carry a weapon.

dag: Naa Hɛzɛkia ni daa wum yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, o daa darigi toola o binyɛrigu, ka zaŋ buɣu ye n-chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu.
en: As soon as Hezekiah heard the news, he tore off his clothes in sorrow and put on sackcloth. Then he went into the temple of the Lord .

dag: Bɛ yihiri waazu yɛra ma, Di yihiri waazu. Di yihiri waazu yɛri binyara ŋɔ yɛla; vi ku di ti.
en: The people say, Dont prophesy to us. Dont say those bad things about us. Nothing bad will happen to us.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl daa yɛli Yisifu, Di ku lan yuui ka n kpi, amaa Naawuni ni be yi sani, ka ti zaŋ ya labisi yi yaannim tiŋgbɔŋ la ni yaha.
en: Then Israel said to Joseph, Look, my time to die is almost here, but God will still be with you. He will lead you back to the land of your ancestors.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛli ma mi, Malim buɣili ŋun yɛn be ti tooni ti ti, dama Musa ŋun daa yihi ti Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na maa ŋuna, ti bi mi din niŋ o. .
en: They even told me, That man Moses led us out of Egypt, but now we don't know what has happened to him. Make us a god to lead us.

dag: Diri ka nyuri nyɛla din tahiri lari na; ka wain nyɛ din tiri nir suhupiɛlli; amaa liɣiri n-chɛ ka nir nyar o suhuyubu.
en: Feasting makes you happy and wine cheers you up, but you can't have either without money.

dag: Ka o daa ti miriti Jɛrusalɛm n-siɣiri Olivi Tihi zolɔŋni ha, ka salo bɛn nyɛ o nyaandoliba suhuri paligi pam, ka bɛ kuhiri yɛri pampam m-paɣiri Naawuni bɛ ni daa nya alahiziba tuun kar shɛŋa la zuɣu.
en: Jesus was coming close to Jerusalem. He was already near the bottom of the Mount of Olives. The whole group of followers was happy. They were very excited and praised God. They thanked God for all the powerful things they had seen.

dag: Ka naa daa fabili Abinɛr zuɣu yɛli, Bɔ n-niŋ ka Abinɛr ti kpi kaman jɛrigu la?.
en: King David sang this sad song at Abners funeral: Did Abner die like some foolish criminal?.

dag: N ni yɛl a wuntia tuma min a tiliginsim yɛla dabisili puuni zaa hal n ni ku tooi baŋ di kalinli maa zaa yoli.
en: I will tell people how good you are. I will tell about all the times you saved me— too many times to count.

dag: Ŋuni ka a lee maani ansarisi ka tura? Ŋun zuɣu ka a lee tahira, ka niŋ karimbaani m-mirigir a nina niŋda? Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ ka a mɔri maa.
en: Sennacherib, you cursed, shouted, and sneered at me, the holy God of Israel.

dag: ka yɛli, A ni yɛn kana ti paai shɛli tariga n-yɛn bɔŋɔ; di tirisi tooni. Kpe ka a kɔgbana din mali karimbaani maa yɛn zani.
en: I told it, So far and no farther! Here your powerful waves must stop.

dag: Ka bɔzuɣu ka yi daa chaŋ? Nira ŋun bɔbi ka yi daa chaŋ ni yi ti nya? Nyamiya, bɛn bɔbiri bela nanim yinsi.
en: What kind of man did you go out to see? Was he someone dressed in fine clothes? People who dress like that live in the king's palace.

dag: Ka o yi ti lan kana zaawuni ni o ti nyo firilanim maa, di simdi ka o lan tuɣili tulaale zim maa, ka di nyɛ tulaale zim shɛli bɛ ni yɛn tuɣindi sahakam Yawɛ tooni yi ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: He must burn incense again when he checks the lamps in the evening so that incense will be burned before the Lord every day forever.

dag: Yisahaku ni daa niŋ alibarika niŋ Yaakubu ni naai, ka Yaakubu ŋmalig o ba Yisahaku sani yi, di daa bi yuui ka o biɛli Iso yi o mɔɣu gɔbu maa paa na.
en: After Isaac had finished blessing Jacob, and just as Jacob left his father Isaac, his brother Esau came back from his hunt.

dag: Amaa n yi ti yɛli bia maa, Nyama, piɛma maa be a tooni ha; dindina nyin zoma, dama Yawɛ n-wuh a ni a zom maa.
en: But if it isn't safe, I'll say to the boy, The arrows are farther away! This will mean that the Lord wants you to leave, and you must go.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa wum ni Leeban bidibisi yɛrimi, Yaakubu n-fa ti ba binshɛɣukam zaa, ka binshɛlikam din nyɛ ti ba dini, dina ka o zaŋ nya buni.
en: Jacob heard that Laban's sons were saying, Jacob has taken everything that belonged to our father. He got all his wealth from what our father owned.

dag: Mɛlikizɛdɛk daa bi yi Lɛvi zuliya ni na, amaa o daa deei zaka ti yab Ibrahimma sani, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ ŋuna ŋun daa deei Naawuni daalikaulinim la ni.
en: But Melchizedek, who isnt related to them, received a tenth of everything from Abraham and blessed the one who had received the promises.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda maŋmaŋ yi daa bol o o Duuma, di chaŋ wula ka o ni lan nyɛ ŋun Naa Dauda yaaŋa? Ka Yisa yɛligu maa daa paligi salo maa suhuri pam.
en: David himself calls the Messiah Lord. So how can the Messiah be Davids son? Many people listened to Jesus and were very pleased.

dag: Nyama, n ni lihi a nyɛvili ka di nyɛ binsuŋ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, lala ka Naawuni gba ni lihi n nyɛvili ka di nyɛ binsuŋ, ka o ni tiligi ma nahiŋgu kam zaa ni.
en: I spared your life today, and I pray that the Lord will spare my life and keep me safe.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa gbaŋŋmara daa gooi salo maa ka yɛli, Ɛfɛsusnima, ŋuni n-lee beni n-ʒi ni Ɛfɛsusnim nyɛla bɛn guli buɣili Aritɛmis ŋun galisi ŋɔ duu mini kuɣ shɛli din daa yi zuɣusaa luna la?.
en: Then the city clerk persuaded the people to be quiet. He said, Men of Ephesus, everyone knows that Ephesus is the city that keeps the temple of the great goddess Artemis. Everyone knows that we also keep her holy rock.

dag: Pɛlɛg ni daa dɔɣi Riu maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiyinaawɛi. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: Peleg had more children and died at the age of .

dag: O yi di deeg o shia, ka deeg o vuhim.
en: If God decided to take away his spirit and the breath of life he gave us.

dag: Dinzuɣu doo maa ni daa yɛli Bɔaz ni o dam li maa, o daa pirigila o namdili ti Bɔaz.
en: So when the man said to Boaz, You buy it, he took off his sandal and gave it to Boaz.

dag: Yi ni shɛb kpɛla yimaŋ duhibu ni, dama yi tɛhimi ni n ku lan ka yi sanna.
en: Some of you have become proud because you have thought that I would not be coming to visit you.

dag: Niriba maa zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahinaayi ni kɔbisita ni pihiyɔbu.
en: Total number of exiles who returned - . Their male and female servants - , Male and female musicians - Horses - Mules - Camels - Donkeys - .

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ bɛ ni kpe binnan shɛŋa zali yɛda, ka yɛli ni binnana maa n-nyɛ bɛ wuna, bɛ ni di vi ka ŋmaligi lab bɛ nyaaŋa.
en: Everyone who worships idols as though they were gods will be terribly ashamed.

dag: O daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani, ka dol o yab Dauda soli, ka bi ŋmaligi kpa o nudirigu polo bee o nuzaa polo.
en: He did what was right in the LORDs eyes and walked in the ways of his ancestor David, not deviating from it even a bit to the right or left.

dag: O ni daa kpe yili maa ni ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi kumdi ka fabindi lala? Bipuɣiŋga maa bi kpi, amaa o gbihirimi.
en: Then Jesus went inside and said to them, Why are you crying and carrying on like this? The child isn't dead. She is just asleep.

dag: Amaa ka Nɛtania bia Ishimail daa zaŋ niriba anii n-zo n-tiligi Jɔhanan nuu ni kuli Ammɔnnim tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: But Ishmael, Nethaniahs son, and eight of his men eluded Johanan and went to the Ammonites.

dag: Yiɣisim sɔŋ ti! Tiligim ti a yurilim maŋli la zuɣu!.
en: Come to our aid! Because of your constant love save us!.

dag: Bɛ kari ba niriba ni bahi; niriba yɔhiri ba mi kaman tayiɣ la.
en: and they are run out of towns, as though they were thieves.

dag: Amaa ti tuumbiɛri mini ti daalahichi zuɣu ka o daa nya dansi ni nahiŋgu maa. O ni daa nya tibidarigibo shɛli zuɣu n-chɛ ka nyaɣisim kpe ti mini Naawuni sunsuuni. O fiɛbbu dansi zuɣu n-chɛ ka ti nyari tibbu.
en: But because of our sins he was wounded, beaten because of the evil we did. We are healed by the punishment he suffered, made whole by the blows he received.

dag: Man ŋun nyɛ kpɛm la n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri n ni yuri paɣ gahindi so min o bihi ni yɛlimaŋli la. Ka di pala n kɔŋko n-yuri ya, amaa bɛnkam zaa mi yɛlimaŋli la gba yuri ya.
en: From the church leader. To a very special woman and her children. I truly love all of you, and so does everyone else who knows the truth.

dag: Ti Duuma, deem ti suhigu ka chɛ m-paŋ ti. Ti Duuma, wummi ti suhigu maa ka niŋ ti ni bɔri shɛm maa. Ka di zuɣu chɛ ka sokam baŋ ni nyini n-shiri nyɛ Naawuni. Di chɛ ka di lan yuui! Tiŋ maa mini niriba maa nyɛla a dini.
en: Forgive us! Hurry and do something, not only for your city and your chosen people, but to bring honor to yourself.

dag: Di zuɣu ka bɛ daa zaŋ takɔbi ku ti banima, ka gbahi ti paɣiba mini ti bidibisi ni ti bipuɣinsi chaŋ ti leei daba.
en: Thats why our ancestors died violent deaths, while our sons, daughters, and wives were taken captive.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Di ku lan yuui ka a dɔni pah a yaannim zuɣu, di nyaaŋa niriba ŋɔ ni ti saɣim bɛmaŋa n-jɛmdi tinzun buɣa din be bɛ sani, ka nyɛ bɛ ni chani tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa ni buɣa. Bɛ ni ti zaɣisi ma ka saɣim n ni daa lo ba alikauli shɛl la.
en: The LORD then said to Moses: Soon you will rest with your ancestors, and the people will rise up and act unfaithfully, going after strange gods of the land they are entering. They will abandon me, breaking my covenant that I made with them.

dag: N sabila yɛla ŋɔ ti yinim bɛn niŋ Naawuni Bia maa yuli yɛda la ni di chɛ ka yi baŋ ni yi mali nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: I write this letter to you who believe in the Son of God. I write so that you will know that you have eternal life now.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi ti zaŋ ba niŋ yi nuu ni, ka yi nyaŋ ba, di saha yin kumiya bɛ zaa. Di ti lɔnya ba alikauli, yi mi di ti zo ba nambɔɣu.
en: When the Lord your God places these people in your power and you defeat them, you must put them all to death. Do not make an alliance with them or show them any mercy.

dag: Lubu din mali dabiɛm pam mini chirachira be Ʒii Nyabu Vinvamli ni, ka bɛ daai ti tiŋ goma luhi, ka ŋme sɔŋsim bɔbu kuŋ bahi zoya ni nima. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-niŋ lala maa.
en: This is a time of panic, defeat, and confusion in the Valley of Vision, and the Sovereign Lord Almighty has sent it on us. The walls of our city have been battered down, and cries for help have echoed among the hills.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun wumdi n yɛligu, ka ʒe n dunɔdali gbini dabisili kam, ka ʒe n dunoli ni guhiri mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Come to my home each day and listen to me. You will find happiness.

dag: ka o ni nyɛhi bɛ nintam zaa bahi, ka kum ku lan beni bee fabila bee kumsi, ka biɛrim gba ku lan beni yaha, dama bin kura la zaa vuuya.
en: He will wipe away all tears from their eyes. There will be no more death, no more grief or crying or pain. The old things have disappeared.

dag: Ka yuun shɛli din pahir o ni daa di nam maa yuun piniyini ni, Bul goli ŋun nyɛ gol so ŋun pahir anii la ni ka bɛ daa me Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa, ka mali di binshɛɣukam kaman bɛ ni daa wuhi shɛm naai. Yuma ayopɔin ka o daa zaŋ me li naai.
en: He finished the temple in all its details and measurements in the eleventh year during the eighth month, the month of Bul. He built it in seven years.

dag: Ninvuɣ so yi ku o kpee, yin chɛ ka ŋun ku o kpee maa kul dari ginda hal ti kpi; ka di chɛliya ka so sɔŋ o.
en: Don't give help to murderers! Make them stay on the run for as long as they live.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee yɛn yiɣisi zani n-tuhi ninvuɣ biɛri ti ma? Ŋuni n-lee yɛn yiɣisi zani tuhi tuumbiɛtumdiba ti ma?.
en: No one helped me fight against the wicked. No one stood with me against those who do evil.

dag: dama n nyɛla tarim dɔɣirili, amaa o bi chɛ ma piibu di zuɣu. Ka zuŋɔ zaŋ chana, ʒiɛmani kam nim ni boli ma alibarika paɣa;.
en: for he has remembered me, his lowly servant! From now on all people will call me happy.

dag: N-yi biɛɣ asibaasi, ka Yisa daa yiɣisi chaŋ mɔɣu ni. Ka niriba maa daa kar o naba nti bo n-nya o, ka bi saɣi ni o lan woligi ba;.
en: At daybreak Jesus left the town and went off to a lonely place. The people started looking for him, and when they found him, they tried to keep him from leaving.

dag: N dabisa gariya, n ni daa lo nia shɛŋa ka di nyɛ n suhu ni yu shɛŋa la saɣimya.
en: My days have passed; my goals are destroyed, my hearts desires.

dag: Amaa ka Yisahaku bɔh o bia maa, M bia, ka wula ka a lee niŋ nya li yomyom lala? Ka o garigi yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ n-ti ma di nasara maa.
en: Isaac said to his son, How could you find this so quickly, my son? He said, The LORD your God led me right to it.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba maa bidibisi mi daa su tulaalɛnim maa zaŋ gari tab tuma fukumsi.
en: Some of the priests blended the ointment for the spices.

dag: Lɛvi bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Gɛrishom mini Kɔhat ni Mɛrari.
en: Levi was the father of Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

dag: Wain tihi kuuya, ka wain dii bi lan nyara, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali suhupiɛlli liɣi ʒini.
en: The grapevines are dying. The new wine is bad. People who were happy are now sad.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ ni ti ko Ziɔn kaman puu la yi zuɣu. Jɛrusalɛm ni ti leei tanduya, ka jɛmbu duu zol la ti leei tihi nyɔŋ.
en: And so, because of you, Zion will be plowed like a field, Jerusalem will become a pile of ruins, and the Temple hill will become a forest.

dag: M bi zaɣisi ka m biɛhigu di be kaman di ni daa pun be shɛm la, kaman saha shɛli Naawuni ni daa yuuni ma la;.
en: If only my life could once again be as it was when God watched over me.

dag: Naa, dinzuɣu wummi n saɣisigu ŋɔ. Chɛl alahichi tumbu ka tumdila din tuhi, ka zɔri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari nahiŋgu nambɔɣu. Ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka a nya suhudoo ka di yuui.
en: Your Majesty, please be willing to do what I say. Turn from your sins and start living right; have mercy on those who are mistreated. Then all will go well with you for a long time.

dag: Tol bɔbili kana nti lu ti tiŋgbɔŋ zuɣu. Bɛ mali yiko pam, ka lan galisi hal nti ka kalinli. Bɛ nyina dirimi kaman gbuɣinli nyina la, ka bɛ nyindari be kaman gbuɣinnyaŋ nyindari la.
en: A powerful nation came to attack my land. Its soldiers were too many to count. Its weapons were as sharp as a lions teeth and as powerful as a lions jaw.

dag: Yinim Shafirinima, zaŋmiya yi zaɣim mini yi vi gari chaŋ. Zaanannima, di yin ya na. Bɛtɛzɛlnim kuhirimi, ka ku lan sɔŋ ya.
en: Depart naked and ashamed, you people of Shaphir. The town of Bethezel mourns because no one from Zaanan went out to help.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa lan bɔhi ma pahi buyi, Bɔ ka a lee nya? Ka n garigi yɛli, N nyala duɣu ni bini ni kpeera, ka gbiligi yi nuzaa polo na.
en: Then the Lord showed me something else and asked, What do you see now? I answered, I see a pot of boiling water in the north, and it's about to spill out toward us.

dag: nti yɛl o ni o tim o gbana ka o zaŋ chaŋ Damaskus Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o yi ti nya sokam ŋun doli soli ŋɔ, bɛ yi nyɛla dɔb bee paɣiba, ka o gbahi ba n-lo ba mihi tahi Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: seeking letters to the synagogues in Damascus. If he found persons who belonged to the Way, whether men or women, these letters would authorize him to take them as prisoners to Jerusalem.

dag: Ka ʒiɛman shɛli din dolina puuni, yi bihi yi ti yiɣisina yi kalinsi nyaaŋa bee saan so yi ti yi tinshee katiŋ na n-nya Yawɛ ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛ shɛli mini nahiŋgu shɛli paai tiŋgbani maa.
en: The Lord will strike your country with diseases and disasters. Your descendants and foreigners from distant countries will see that your land.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ jilima n-taɣi naɣibil ŋun ŋubiri mɔri kɔtomsi.
en: of a bull, instead of you, their glorious God.

dag: Teemiy o daalikauli yɛla sahakam. O ni daa zaŋ yɛligu shɛli zali ʒiɛmana tuhili nim la;.
en: Remember his agreement forever, the promise he gave that will never end.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa yɛli Yisifu, Naawuni ni wuh a dimbɔŋɔ zaa maa zuɣu, so kani m-mali tɛhi wɔɣila ni yɛm kaman nyini.
en: The king told Joseph, God is the one who has shown you these things. No one else is as wise as you are or knows as much as you do.

dag: Dama kaman niŋgbuŋ ni nyɛ zaɣ yini ka mali yaɣ bɔbili, ka di yaɣ bɔbili maa zaa nyɛ niŋgbun yin la, lala mi n-nyɛ Masia gba.
en: Christ is just like the human body—a body is a unit and has many parts; and all the parts of the body are one body, even though there are many.

dag: Di yuuni maa siɣili saha ka Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa timna ti gbaag o kuli Babilɔn ka daa zaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu neen viɛla pahi kuli, ka zaŋ Jɛhoyakin mabia Zɛdɛkia leei Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm naa zal o zaani.
en: In the spring of the year, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia had Jehoiachin arrested and taken to Babylon, along with more of the valuable items in the temple. Then Nebuchadnezzar appointed Zedekiah king of Judah.

dag: N daa kuhi pam niŋ o, ka yili yila ni suhupiɛlli paɣ o.
en: I prayed to the Lord, and I praised him.

dag: Ka dɔbba mini paɣiba bɛn zaa suhuri daa yu lala zaŋ nachiinsi nɛma din nyɛ tibikpara mini nintuhi ni bansi ni salima nɛma zaa na. Sokam daa zaŋla salima na nti mali sara ti Yawɛ.
en: Men and women came willingly and gave all kinds of gold jewelry such as pins, earrings, rings, and necklaces.

dag: Yi tumdila yi ba tuma. Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti pala dagɔribihi; ti malila ba yino, ŋuna n-nyɛ Naawuni.
en: So you are doing what your own father did. But they said, We are not like children who never knew who their father was. God is our Father. He is the only Father we have.

dag: Amaa man yɛri ya mi: Hal ŋunkam jɛri suli niŋd o kpee gba ni ti be yɛla ni saria karibu shee; ka ŋunkam tu o kpee, Ninvuɣ fini ni ti be yɛla ni saria karibu shee; ka ŋunkam mi bol o kpee, Jɛr yoli ni ti be buɣim ni kpɛbu barina ni.
en: But I tell you, dont be angry with anyone. If you are angry with others, you will be judged. And if you insult someone, you will be judged by the high court. And if you call someone a fool, you will be in danger of the fire of hell.

dag: Miri ka a vili tumtumdiba bɛn nyɛ nandaamba mini faranim yɔri gbibi. Bɛ yi nyɛla a Izraɛl taba bee bɛ yi nyɛla saamba bɛn be yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni yi tinsi maa tin shɛl ni.
en: Dont take advantage of poor or needy workers, whether they are fellow Israelites or immigrants who live in your land or your cities.

dag: Tol la ni daa ŋubi binshɛŋa zaa la, n ni labisi li tin ya kaman di yuma kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm; dama mani n daa tim toli bɛn daa yiɣira mini bɛn daa saɣinda ni bɛn daa ŋmahiri la na. Bɛ daa nyɛla n tɔbbihi bɛn mali yaa, ka n tim ba yi sanna.
en: I, the Lord, sent my army against you. The swarming locusts and the hopping locusts and the destroying locusts and the cutting locusts ate everything you had. But I will pay you back for those years of trouble.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya nyɛ tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛma. Ka Zadok mini Abiata nyɛ maligumaaniba.
en: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was the commander of the army; Zadok and Abiathar were priests;.

dag: Ka n daa lihi nya kalima anahi ni ʒe m-baɣi chɛrubinim maa. Kalinli yini daa ʒe m-baɣi la chɛrubi yino kam. Kalima maa daa ŋmanila diɣi n-nyaɣisira.
en: Suddenly, I saw four wheels next to the winged creatures. There was a wheel next to each winged creature, and the appearance of the wheels was like sparkling topaz.

dag: Pa Jɔn maŋmaŋa n-daa nyɛ neesim maa, amaa o daa kamina ni o ti niŋ neesim maa shɛhiralana.
en: He himself wasnt the light, but his mission was to testify concerning the light.

dag: Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba n-daa nyɛ: Mɛshulam bia Sallu ŋun daa nyɛ Joɛd yaaŋa la. O yaannim shɛba n-daa lan nyɛ Pɛdaya mini Kolaya ni Maasɛya so mi ni Itiɛl ni Jɛshaya.
en: These are the descendants of Benjamin who moved into Jerusalem: Sallu son of Meshullam .

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa zaŋ niriba maa chaŋ kuliga ni, ka Yawɛ ti yɛli Gidiɔn, Ŋunkam mal o zilinli nyuri kom kaman baa la, nyin woligim o zal o ko; ka ŋunkam mi ti gban tiŋ nyura, nyin woligim o gba zal o ko.
en: So he took the people down to the water. And the LORD said to Gideon, Set aside those who lap the water with their tongues, as a dog laps, from those who bend down on their knees to drink.

dag: Amaa ka Firawuna bipuɣiŋga la daa yiɣisi Dauda tiŋ la ni n-kul omaŋmaŋ yil shɛli Sulemaana ni daa me n-ti o la ni. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa me ŋ-ŋari luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Millo la.
en: Pharaohs daughter moved from the City of David to the palace that Solomon had built for her. Then he built the Millo.

dag: ka kuhiri yɛri zoya maa mini tampima maa, Lumiya ti zuɣu na n-lim ti ka ti sɔɣi yi ni, ka ŋun ʒi nam ʒiishee ŋɔ ni nini ku lan nya ti, ka Piɛbil ŋɔ mi suhuyiɣisili yɛlli ŋɔ ku paai ti.
en: They said to the mountains and the rocks, Fall on us. Hide us from the face of the one who sits on the throne. Hide us from the anger of the Lamb!.

dag: Piɛbimiya kikahi paɣ o. Ŋmɛmiya biɛɣu mini mɔɣilo paɣ o.
en: Praise God with the blast of the rams horn! Praise God with lute and lyre!.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa nyaŋ Itiɔpianim maa ti Asa mini Judanima ka Itiɔpianim maa daa ŋmaligi guui.
en: The Lord defeated the Ethiopian army when Asa and the Judean army attacked them. They fled.

dag: Di saha ka n ni chaŋ nyin Naawuni sara maligu bimbin la gbini, luɣ shɛli din nyɛ nyin Naawuni ŋun tiri ma suhupiɛlli pam ŋɔ sani la; ka ŋme m mɔɣilo paɣi nyin Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Then I will go to your altar, O God; you are the source of my happiness. I will play my harp and sing praise to you, O God, my God.

dag: Amaa m mabiyurisi, di tamya bin yini din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli ŋɔ yɛla. Dina n-nyɛ: Ti Duuma sani, dahin yini nyɛla kaman yuun tuhili, ka yuun tuhili mi nyɛ kaman dahin yini.
en: But dont forget this one thing, dear friends: To the Lord a day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years is like a day.

dag: Lihimiya li viɛnyɛliŋga, ka gbibi li hal ti zahim li maligumaaniba zuɣulaannim mini Lɛvinim ni Izraɛl dɔɣirikpamba tooni Jɛrusalɛm Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la puuni duri ni.
en: Guard them carefully until you weigh them out in Jerusalem before the officials of the priests, the Levites, and the heads of the families of Israel, within the rooms of the LORDs house.

dag: N nyee nyɔni n ni niŋ wahala nya shɛlikam zaa dunia ŋɔ ni, dama m mi ni n yɛn chɛ li zalila na shɛb bɛn yɛn doli n nyaaŋa.
en: I hated the things I worked so hard for here under the sun, because I will have to leave them to someone who comes after me.

dag: Pa dunia ŋɔ shia ka ti deei, amaa Shi so ŋun yi Naawuni sanna ka ti deei ni ti tooi baŋ pin shɛŋa Naawuni ni zaŋ ti ti.
en: We havent received the worlds spirit but Gods Spirit so that we can know the things given to us by God.

dag: Chɛ ka karimbaannim di vi bɛ ni ŋmari ʒiri pari ma la zuɣu, amaa n kul ni tɛhir a zaligunim maa yɛla.
en: Bring shame on those proud people who lied about me. All I want to do is study your instructions.

dag: amaa ŋun mali shili ni o kari nyɛvilinim mini bɛn kpi saria la ni ti bɔhi ba di zuɣu.
en: But they will have to answer to God, who judges the living and the dead.

dag: Ka bɛ daa laɣisi bɛ mabihi m-mali bɛmaŋ be kasi n-kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni nti mal li ka di be kasi kaman Yawɛ ni daa wuhi naa ka o zali ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm.
en: Then these Levites gathered their brothers together and made themselves ready for holy service in the Temple. They obeyed the kings command that came from the Lord . They went into the Lord s Temple to clean it.

dag: Yisa daa ti lihi nya bundaannim ni tɔhiri liɣiri shɛm Naawuni jɛmbu duu;.
en: Jesus looked up and saw some rich people tossing their gifts into the offering box.

dag: Nyama, pa bɛ buni ka bɛ gbibi bɛ nuhi ni maa? Man kul ku deei ninvuɣ biɛri yɛtɔɣa.
en: We succeeded all on our own. And so, I keep away from them and their evil schemes.

dag: Ka Salimɔn daa nyɛ o paɣ Reehab bia Bɔaz ba, ka Bɔaz nyɛ o paɣ Rut bia Obɛd ba, ka Obɛd nyɛ Jɛsi ba.
en: Salmon was the father of Boaz, whose mother was Rahab. Boaz was the father of Obed, whose mother was Ruth. Obed was the father of Jesse.

dag: Di simdi ka yi mal li ka di be kaman n ni daa wuh a shɛm zoli zuɣu la.
en: Take care to make them according to the plan that I showed you on the mountain.

dag: Yawɛ, a nyɛla ŋun wumdi nandaamba suhigu; ka lan nyɛ ŋun kpaŋsiri bɛ suhuri, ka ni gbilis a tibili wum.
en: Lord , you have heard what the poor want. Listen to their prayers, and do what they ask.

dag: N Ba ŋun zaŋ ba ti ma maa gari sokam, ka so mi ku tooi fa ba m Ba maa nuu ni.
en: My Father, who has given them to me, is greater than all, and no one is able to snatch them from my Fathers hand.

en: Find out how many grown men there are in Israel and require each of them to pay me to keep him safe from danger while you are counting them.

en: He said: I will hide my face from them— I will see what becomes of them— because they are a confused generation; they are children lacking loyalty.

en: I will initially pay them back double for their evil and sin, because they have corrupted my land with their disgusting, lifeless idols and have filled my inheritance with their detestable practices.

en: Give up all the evil you have been doing, and get yourselves new minds and hearts. Why do you Israelites want to die?.

en: I will bless her, and I will give you a son by her. I will bless her, and she will become the mother of nations, and there will be kings among her descendants.

en: If the offering is an entirely burned offering from the herd, you must present a flawless male, bringing it to the meeting tents entrance for its acceptance before the LORD.

en: and come out of their graves: those who have done good will rise and live, and those who have done evil will rise and be condemned.

dag: Amaa ka Jɔshua daa lan yɛli niriba maa, Miriya ka yi tahi bee n-chɛ ka so wum yi kukoya vuri bee n-chɛ ka yɛtɔɣ shɛli yi yi nol ni na; naɣila dahin shɛli n yi ti bahi ya noli ni yi tahima.

en: a sound of terror pierces their ears; when safe, raiders overtake them.

en: We risk our lives to get food. There are men in the desert with swords.

en: I sweated every day, and I couldn't sleep at night because of the cold.

en: So Jesus traveled everywhere in Galilee. He spoke in the synagogues, and he forced demons out of people.

dag: Amaa Naawuni chɛ ka o Shia Kasi kahigi li wuhi tinima; dama Naawuni Shia Kasi n-nyɛ ŋun vihiri binshɛɣukam hal zaŋ tabili Naawuni yɛla din gbinni zilima.
en: God's Spirit has shown you everything. His Spirit finds out everything, even what is deep in the mind of God.

en: She said to him, Why have you done such a wrong to God's people? You have not allowed your own son to return from exile, and so you have condemned yourself by what you have just said.

en: The LORD said more to me: I have seen this people. Look! What a stubborn people they are!.

en: They would be happy to find their grave. They would rejoice to find their tomb.

dag: Di dabisa maa ni, bɛ ti ku lan yɛra, Bihi laamba di wain tiwala din miha, ka bihi nyina ni nyɛmda.
en: No longer will anyone go around saying, Sour grapes eaten by parents leave a sour taste in the mouths of their children.

en: The priests, the prophets, and all the people heard Jeremiah declare these words in the LORDs temple.

en: Here is what I discovered: A bad woman is worse than death. She is a trap, reaching out with body and soul to catch you. But if you obey God, you can escape. If you don't obey, you are done for.

en: From the north comes golden light, the awesome splendor of God.

en: The princess is in the palace—how beautiful she is! Her gown is made of gold thread.

dag: Nir yi zɔri o taba dabiɛm, di nyɛla zana, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋ Yawɛ naani ni yi yɛla ni.

en: And Joshua said, Sovereign Lord ! Why did you bring us across the Jordan at all? To turn us over to the Amorites? To destroy us? Why didn't we just stay on the other side of the Jordan?.

en: Therefore, I want men to pray everywhere by lifting up hands that are holy, without anger or argument.

en: God blesses those people who are treated badly for doing right. They belong to the kingdom of heaven.

dag: Ka Daniɛl daa garigi yɛl o, Naa, Naawuni dolim a nyɛvili!.
en: Daniel answered, May Your Majesty live forever!.

dag: Ka Sool daa tim tuumba ni bɛ ti zaŋ Dauda na, ka paɣ maa yɛli ba, O biɛrimi.
en: Saul sent messengers to take David prisoner. But Michal said, David is sick.

dag: Bi so ŋun mali yɛm tir o ba suhupiɛlli, amaa jɛra ʒiɛmdila bɛ manima.
