en: A wise child brings joy to a father, but fools despise their mothers.

dag: Dama n yi suhuri Naawuni tinzun yɛtɔɣ shɛl ni, n shia n-suhiri maa, amaa di ka buchi zaŋ chaŋ m milinsi polo.
en: For if I pray in this way, my spirit prays indeed, but my mind has no part in it.

dag: Teem niriba maa ni bɛ doli zuɣulaannim mini bɛn su fukumsi yɛligu ka deeri bɛ noli, ka mali shili n-tum tuun suŋ kam zaa.
en: Remind your people that they should always be under the authority of rulers and government leaders. They should obey these leaders and be ready to do good.

dag: Ka Hatak daa chaŋ ti yɛli Ɛsta Mɔdɛkai ni yɛl o shɛm maa.
en: Hathach went back to Esther and told her what Mordecai had said.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ oniɣisi kuɣ ayi n-sabi Izraɛl bidibisi la yuya pa di zuɣu.
en: Take two carnelian stones and engrave on them the names of the twelve sons of Jacob.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Sandihir so n-daa be m-mal o sandaannima ayi; yino daa di o samli ka di paai tumtumda yuma ayi tuma yɔri, ka ŋun la mi di o samli ka di paai tumtumda chira ayi tuma yɔri.
en: Jesus told him, Two people were in debt to a moneylender. One of them owed him silver coins, and the other owed him .

dag: Ka bɛn daa dol o liɣi ʒiɛya n-wumdi kukoli maa, amaa ka lee bi nya so.
en: The men who were traveling with Saul had stopped, not saying a word; they heard the voice but could not see anyone.

dag: Yi mini tinzunnim bɛn be yi sani zaligu yɛn nyɛla zaɣ yini, di nyɛla zaligu shɛli din kul yɛn be yi ʒiɛmana zaa ni. Yi mini tinzunnim zaa yɛn nyɛla yim Yawɛ sani.
en: The assembly will have the same regulation for you and for the immigrant. The regulation will be permanent for all time. You and the immigrant will be the same in the LORDs presence.

dag: dindina o ni tooi zaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ŋɔ yuli tum tuma kaman o Lɛvi tab zaa ni zaani Yawɛ tooni tumdi tuma nimaani shɛm.
en: and ministers in the LORD his Gods name, just like his relatives—the other Levites serving there in the LORDs presence.

dag: Zaligu ŋɔ ni daa kul moli gili, Izraɛlnim daa zaŋla bɛ puri atam din daŋ niŋbu ka nyɛ kawana mini wain palli ni kpam ni shiri pam ni bɛ puri ni bindira zaa na. Bɛ daa lan zaŋ binshɛɣukam pirigibu bupia kam puuni yim zuɣu pam na.
en: As soon as the order was given, the people of Israel brought gifts of their finest grain, wine, olive oil, honey, and other farm produce, and they also brought the tithes of everything they had.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛl o, Tim ma pini. A ni zaŋ Nɛgɛb tiŋgbani n-ti ma la zuɣu, tim ma kulibɔna din kom zɔri gba pahi. Ka Kalɛb daa zaŋ zuɣusaa polo mini naɣiliŋga ni kulibɔna ti o pahi.
en: She answered, I want some water holes. The land you have given me is in the dry country. So Caleb gave her the upper and lower springs.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi Naawuni zaligubaŋdib mini Farisiinim maa, Di luhiya ni nir chɛ ka bara kpaŋ Vuhim Dabisili dali bee di bi luhi.
en: and Jesus spoke up and asked the teachers of the Law and the Pharisees, Does our Law allow healing on the Sabbath or not.

dag: Malimiya pipih anahi din ŋmani alimɔnd pum ka mali bintira kɔtomsi mini tipum kɔtomsi tam firilatamdigu maa maŋmaŋ zuɣu.
en: The shaft of the lampstand is to have four decorative flowers shaped like almond blossoms with buds and petals.

dag: N Duuma, chɛ ka mani a dabili ŋɔ mali suhupiɛlli; dama nyini ka n kul suhira.
en: Make my heart glad! I serve you, and my prayer is sincere.

dag: Ti yi chɛ ka o niŋdi lala, sokam zaa ni niŋ o yɛda, ka Romnim kana ti saɣim ti Naawuni jɛmbu shee, ka bahi ti zuliya ŋɔ zaa yoli.
en: If we let him go on in this way, everyone will believe in him, and the Roman authorities will take action and destroy our Temple and our nation.

dag: Ŋunkam fiɣisir o ʒiʒiinikpee ashilɔni, n ni ku dilana. Ŋunkam nyuri bara ka mali karimbaani; m mini dilana ku kpe.
en: I will get rid of anyone who whispers evil things about someone else; I will not tolerate anyone who is proud and arrogant.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Leeban zuɣu ka o bɔhi Leeban, Taal bɔ ka n lee tum a? Ka alahichi dini ka n lee tum ka a kariti n naba na?.
en: Then Jacob lost his temper. What crime have I committed? he asked angrily. What law have I broken that gives you the right to hunt me down?.

dag: Naawuni, tiligim ma! Dama kom paala n nyiŋgoli tariga.
en: Save me, God! I am about to drown.

dag: N di yɛlimi, Chɛ ka ninkura tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, ka chɛ ka bɛn yuma galisi pam mi wuhi yɛm.
en: I thought, Let days speak; let multiple years make wisdom known.

dag: Ka o daa booi kpam maa bahi Aduna zuɣu ni m-mal o ka o niŋ kasi.
en: He poured some of the anointing oil on Aarons head to make him holy.

dag: A daa zaŋ wain tia Ijipti na nti kari zuliya shɛba ka zaŋ li sa.
en: You brought a vine out of Egypt. You drove out the nations and planted it.

dag: Miri ka a chɛ ka a suhu ye naa bindir nyaɣisa zuɣu, dama di nyɛla yɔhiŋ bindira.
en: Dont eat too much of his fine food. It might be a trick.

dag: ni muli ni wolisi ni kparibuhi ni bambuhi.
en: deer, gazelles, roe deer, wild sheep, wild goats, antelopes, and mountain sheep.

dag: Gooni maa ni daa me n-naai, ka m mali pununima n-kpɛhi di dunoya la zaa saha shɛli, ka bɛ daa pii dunɔguliba mini yiliyiiniba ni Lɛvinim n-ti ba bɛ tuma ni.
en: When the wall had been built and I had hung the doors, the gatekeepers, singers, and Levites were appointed.

dag: Wuntaŋ yi ti lura, nyin zaŋmi li labisi ti ti o, ka o zaŋ o chinchini maa pili gbihi ka paɣ a, ka di ti a laara Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: return it to him each evening, so that he can have it to sleep in. Then he will be grateful, and the Lord your God will be pleased with you.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Aduna naanyi kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni nti yeeg o ni ye neempiɛl shɛŋa kpe luɣ kasi shee maa sɔŋ nimaani.
en: After this, Aaron will enter the meeting tent, take off the linen clothes he was wearing when he entered the inner holy area, and will leave them there.

dag: Yisifu mini Mariama ni daa niŋ ti Duuma zaligu ni daa wuhi shɛlikam zaa naai maa, ka bɛ lab kuli bɛ ya Nazarɛt Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: When Mary and Joseph had completed everything required by the Law of the Lord, they returned to their hometown, Nazareth in Galilee.

dag: N ni chɛ ka a be kaman daanya gooni la niriba maa sani. Bɛ ni tuh a, amaa bɛ ku tooi nyaŋ a; dama n ni be a sani n-tilig a ka fa a bahi. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will make you like a solid bronze wall as far as they are concerned. They will fight against you, but they will not defeat you. I will be with you to protect you and keep you safe.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ piibupiibu m-piila Mataias, ka bɛ daa sab o yuli pahi tuumba piniyini maa yuya ni.
en: Then they used lots to choose one of the two men. The lots showed that Matthias was the one the Lord wanted. So he became an apostle with the other eleven.

dag: Ka Ifriim zuliya daa zaŋ bɛ tuuta yiɣisi doli tab gbilligbilli paya. Ammihud bia Ɛlishama n-daa nyɛ bɛ zaa zuɣulana;.
en: The banner of Ephraims camp marched with its military units. Elishama, Ammihuds son, commanded its military.

dag: Ka o ni daa tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣa maa, ka shia daa kpe n ni n-yiɣisi ma zali n naba zuɣu, ka n daa wum ka o yɛri ma;.
en: Then the Spirit came into me and lifted me up on my feet, and I listened to the one who spoke to me.

dag: Ka yi lan wuhiri ni nir yi po sara maligu bimbini di pa taali, amaa ni nir yi po sara shɛli din pa bimbini maa zuɣu, shee ka o niŋ o ni po n-dalim yɛl shɛli maa.
en: You also teach, If someone swears by the altar, he isn't bound by his vow; but if he swears by the gift on the altar, he is bound.

dag: Amaa ka o ma daa bi saɣi ka yɛli ba, Bolimiy o la Jɔn.
en: But Elizabeth said, No! His name is John.

dag: Yawɛ miri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri saɣim, ka tiligiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yihi tahima.
en: The Lord is there to rescue all who are discouraged and have given up hope.

dag: Nyin ŋun chɛ ka n nya wahala pam mini naŋgbantom ŋɔ ni lan yiɣisi ma zali yaha; a ni yihi ma tiŋgbani puuni na.
en: You have let me see troubles and hard times, but you will give me new life; you will lift me up from this pit of death!.

dag: N ni puh a salo laɣiŋgu ni; n shiri ni paɣ a salo ni.
en: And when your people meet, I will praise you and thank you, Lord, in front of them all.

dag: Abinɛr mini ninvuɣ pisi bɛn daa dol o la ni daa ti paai Naa Dauda sani Hiburɔn, Dauda daa chɛ ka bɛ duɣila bindira ti Abinɛr mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be o sani maa ka bɛ laɣim tab di ka nyu.
en: Abner took soldiers with him, and when they got to Hebron, David gave a big feast for them.

dag: Amaa ka Babilɔn tɔbbihi daa kari doli ba nti gbaai Zɛdɛkia Jɛriko bɔpiɛligu ni n-zaŋ o tahi ti ti Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza Ribila din daa be Hamat tiŋgbɔŋ ni la. Ka o daa kar o saria nimaani.
en: But the Babylonian army pursued them and captured Zedekiah in the plains near Jericho. Then they took him to King Nebuchadnezzar, who was in the city of Riblah in the territory of Hamath, and there Nebuchadnezzar passed sentence on him.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali gadama ni bɛ ba, ka kariti bɛ ma bahira nyɛla bi shɛb bɛn tahiri vi mini turi na.
en: Disgraceful children rob their father and chase their mother away.

dag: N kul paɣiri Naawuni sahakam yi zuɣu, o ni niŋ alibarika shɛli niŋ yi ni Yisa Masia zuɣu la zuɣu.
en: I thank my God always for you, because of Gods grace that was given to you in Christ Jesus.

dag: Hɛzɛkia ni daa ti faai siɣ o yaannim sani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Dauda daŋ silisi la zuɣusaa polo. Ka Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa daa sɔɣ o jilima sɔɣibu. Ka o bia Manaasa daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Hezekiah died and was buried in the upper section of the royal tombs. All the people of Judah and Jerusalem paid him great honor at his death. His son Manasseh succeeded him as king.

dag: Ka bia maa daa ti zooi m-mali yaa ni baŋsim pam; ka Naawuni daalibarika be o ni.
en: The little boy Jesus was developing into a mature young man, full of wisdom. God was blessing him.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa tim Izraɛlnim maa sani ka bɛ chaŋ ti nya ka bɛn biŋkɔbigu zaɣ yino gba bi kpi. Amaa ka Firawuna daa lan niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni o ku chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: Pharaoh sent people to see if any of the animals of Israel died. Not one of them died. But Pharaoh remained stubborn and did not let the people go.

dag: Yim kpe n-zaŋ kpa wulimpuhili polo n-chaŋ ti sɔɣi dɔni miri Chɛrit kulibɔŋ din be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili wulimpuhili polo la.
en: Leave and go across the Jordan River so you can hide near Cherith Creek.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ lumiya Yawɛ sizuura, ka jɛm o ni yɛlimaŋli, ka ʒe o yim. Zaŋmiya wun shɛŋa yi yaannim ni daa jɛmdi Mɔɣili duli mini Ijipti la bahi ka jɛm Yawɛ.
en: Then Joshua told the people: Worship the Lord , obey him, and always be faithful. Get rid of the idols your ancestors worshiped when they lived on the other side of the Euphrates River and in Egypt.

dag: Bɛ kul malila kpiɔŋ chana; bɛ ni nya Naawuni ŋun gari wuna zaa Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu la zuɣu.
en: They grow stronger as they go; they will see the God of gods on Zion.

dag: ni Nibishan ni Yalim Tiŋ la ni Ɛngɛdi: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔntiŋ kara ayɔbu m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Nibshan, Salt City, and En Gedi. In all, there were six towns and all the fields around them.

dag: Ka doo maa min o paɣa Awa daa laɣim ka o niŋ pua n-dɔɣi Keen ka yɛli, N nya ninsala Yawɛ sɔŋsim zuɣu.
en: The man Adam knew his wife Eve intimately. She became pregnant and gave birth to Cain, and said, I have given life to a man with the LORDs help.

dag: Amaa n yɛri ya mi ni zaadali Taainim mini Sidɔnnim azaaba nyabu ni ti so yi dini.
en: But I tell you, on the day of judgment it will be worse for you than for Tyre and Sidon.

dag: Amaa ka o ni daa boli ninvuɣ shɛb maa zaŋ li niŋ asahi, ka bɛ ni yino zaŋ kpa o puu polo, ka yino chaŋ o tuma shee.
en: But they paid no attention and went away—some to their fields, others to their businesses.

dag: Ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa gbaai chandi hal ti paai Bɛtilihɛm. Bɛ ni daa paai maa, di daa garila tiŋ maa nim zaa ka bɛ damna, ka paɣiba ti bɔhira, Naomi m-bala.
en: They went on until they came to Bethlehem. When they arrived, the whole town became excited, and the women there exclaimed, Is this really Naomi.

dag: Ŋun pa Yisa yɛdaniŋda yi boli ya ni yi ka o yiŋ na nti di bindirigu ka yi yu ni yi chaŋ, bɛ yi ti kul zaŋ shɛlikam zaa zali yi tooni, yin dimiya li ka di bɔhiya, ka di chɛ ka yi suhuri ni tɛha muɣisi ya di zuɣu.
en: If an unbeliever invites you to dinner, and you want to go, then go. Eat whatever you are served. Don't cause a problem for someone's conscience by asking where the food came from.

dag: Lala ka di lan simdi ni yi zaŋ yi naɣilabil tuuli bee yi biŋkɔbbaligu bi tuuli kam ti ma. O ni be o ma sani daba ayopɔin, ka dabisi shɛli din pahir anii dali, di simdi ka yi zaŋ o ti ma.
en: Do the same with your oxen and with your sheep. They should stay with their mother for seven days. On the eighth day, you should give them to me.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim maa daa doli ba na ti siɣi teeku maa sunsuuni, Firawuna yuri zaa min o chɛchɛbunsi ni o chɛchɛbunduhiriba la zaa.
en: The Egyptians chased them and went into the sea after them, all of Pharaohs horses, chariots, and cavalry.

dag: N daa yɛlimi, N ni gbaai mmaŋ zaŋ chaŋ n ni niŋdi shɛm polo din ni chɛ ka n zilinli ku tum alahichi. N ni gbib n noli saha shɛlikam ninvuɣ biɛri yi ti be n sani.
en: I said, I will be careful about what I do and will not let my tongue make me sin; I will not say anything while evil people are near.

dag: Di zɔnya yi dimnim dabiɛm! Kul maliya suhukpeeni ka di kahigi wuhi ba ni bɛ ni ti bahi yoli, amaa ka yinim ti tiligi, dama Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun tiri ti nasara.
en: That way, you wont be afraid of anything your enemies do. Your faithfulness and courage are a sign of their coming destruction and your salvation, which is from God.

dag: Wummiya, di simdi ni n wuhi ya shihir shɛŋa min alahiziba tumtumsa shɛŋa Zallakudura Naa ni kahigi wuhi ma.
en: I am glad to tell about the wonderful miracles God Most High has done for me.

dag: Chɛ ka n di wain tiwala n-nya kpiɔŋ, ka di apil ka n nini neei, dama doo bɔbu chɛmi ka n ni chɔɣisi zaa.
en: Sustain me with raisin cakes, strengthen me with apples, for Im weak with love!.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Ɛhud bidibisi.
en: Ehud was the father of Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera. They were clan leaders in the town of Geba, but were later forced to move to the town of Manahath, and Gera led the way. He had two sons: Uzza and Ahihud.

dag: Ka paɣital dɔro ni daa mali paɣ so yuun pinaayi daa be bɛ ni.
en: A woman was there who had been bleeding for twelve years.

dag: Wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa, ti kul suhir o ni o chɛ ka ti mini ya lan nya taba, ka ti tooi zaŋ din pooi ya yi yɛda niŋbu ni la sɔŋ ya.
en: Day and night we sincerely pray that we will see you again and help you to have an even stronger faith.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ paɣ shɛb bɛn daa tumdi tuma Yawɛ min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili dunol ni la daanya diɣisi mali tahili mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛli zuɣu.
en: He made the bowl and its base with bronze. He used the bronze mirrors that the women gave. These were the women who served at the entrance to the Meeting Tent.

dag: Ka ti ni paɣ shɛb yɛl ti shɛli ka di gari ti pam: Asibaasi ŋɔ ka bɛ daŋ yibu chaŋ siliga maa gbini.
en: But theres more: Some women from our group have left us stunned. They went to the tomb early this morning.

dag: Siɣimsiɣim bunu ka Yɛhudianim fiɛb ma barazim pihinahiyinikaka.
en: Five times I was given the thirty-nine lashes by the Jews;.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ n ni yihi ba yi ni daa zaŋ ba kɔhi luɣ shɛŋa maa ni na. N ni chɛ ka yi tuma maa lab lu yi zuɣu.
en: But now I am calling them from the places where you have sold them, and I will repay you for your deeds.

dag: Ka bɛ daa be Ijipti n-tumdi pagɔrisigu tuma. Bɛ bilim ni ka bɛ daa kul tumdi pagɔrisigu tuma maa. Nimaani ka bɛ daa tabisi bɛ biha, ka zaŋ ba saɣim.
en: When they were girls in Egypt, they began to prostitute themselves by allowing their young and nubile breasts to be touched and fondled.

dag: Zabimi n zuɣu n-tiligi ma. Dolimi n nyɛvili kaman a ni lo ma alikauli shɛm.
en: Argue my case, and set me free. Let me live, as you promised.

dag: Di daliri zuɣu chɛ ka nayili tɔbbihi zaa mini bɛn zaa kpalim be kpe ŋɔ baŋ ni m be sarika ŋɔ ni la Masia zuɣu.
en: All the Roman guards and all the others here know that I am in prison for serving Christ.

dag: Dabiɛm ni ti kpe Tɛman tɔbbi biinsi, ka bɛ dimnim ti kpimsi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Iso Zoli maa zuɣu zaa.
en: Warriors from the city of Teman will be terrified, and you descendants of Esau will be wiped out.

dag: Di saha ka n di zaŋ n zuɣu silim tiŋa n-jɛm Yawɛ, ka paɣi ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n dan Ibrahimma Naawuni ŋun wuhi yɛlimaŋli so shɛli n ni yɛn doli kpuɣi ŋuna n dan maa dɔɣim bipuɣiŋga nti ti o bia maa.
en: I bowed my head and worshiped the Lord . I praised the Lord , the God of my master Abraham. I thanked him for leading me straight to the granddaughter of my masters brother.

dag: Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o Aramaik yɛtɔɣa ni, Naa, Naawuni dolim a nyɛvili! Yɛlim ti a zahindi maa ka ti wuh a di gbinni.
en: Then the Chaldeans answered the king. They spoke Aramaic and said, King, live forever! Please tell your dream to us, your servants, and then we will tell you what it means.

dag: Zuliya kam ni zo Yawɛ yuli, ka dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa lu o sizuura o jilima zuɣu.
en: The nations will fear the Lord ; all the kings of the earth will fear his power.

dag: Yi ni nyɛ n ninvuɣ gahinda, ka n tiri ya jilima, ka yuri ya la zuɣu, n ni zaɣisi zuliya pam niriba, ka tiligi ya.
en: I will give up whole nations to save your life, because you are precious to me and because I love you and give you honor.

dag: Yuun tuhili maa tariga yi ti paai, Naawuni ni chɛ ka bɛ yooi Sintani o sarika maa ni bahi.
en: After the thousand years are over, Satan will be set loose from his prison.

dag: Naawuni yubu zaŋ chaŋ yi sani nyɛla ni yi mali m-be kasi, ka di niŋdiya zina.
en: Gods will is that your lives are dedicated to him. This means that you stay away from sexual immorality.

dag: O ni daa ti nya o, ka o zaŋ o lab Antiɔk. Ka bɛ daa be nimaani Yisa nyaandoliba sani yuun muni zaa n-wuhiri niriba pam Naawuni yɛligu. Antiɔk maa ka bɛ daa tuui boli Yisa nyaandoliba Kristiɛnnima.
en: When he found him, he brought him to Antioch. They were there for a whole year, meeting with the church and teaching large numbers of people. It was in Antioch where the disciples were first labeled Christians.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naawuni ni lo ti vuhim nyabu alikauli shɛl la ni na kul ʒiɛya zuɣu, chɛliya ka ti zo dabiɛm ka yi ni so ti ku kɔŋ vuhim maa shee paabu.
en: Now, God has offered us the promise that we may receive that rest he spoke about. Let us take care, then, that none of you will be found to have failed to receive that promised rest.

dag: Kom koligu maa ni kom ni daa ti naai, ka o zaŋ bia maa ti sɔŋ tutuɣu gbini.
en: After some time, when all their drinking water was gone, Hagar put her son under a bush.

dag: Ŋuna ka anabinim zaa di shɛhira ni ŋunkam niŋ o yɛda ni nya alahichi chɛ m-paŋ o yuli zuɣu la.
en: Everyone who believes in Jesus will have their sins forgiven through his name. All the prophets agree that this is true.

dag: Di ʒin ya liɣiri kolibihi bee adiikunima bee namdanima; yi mi di puhiya daadam kam sol ni.
en: Don't take a purse or a beggar's bag or shoes; don't stop to greet anyone on the road.

dag: N yi ti yɛn darig a tibili dahin shɛli, a ni tooi mali suhukpeeni bee a nuhi ni tooi mali yaa? Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa, ka mi ni niŋ li.
en: Will you be brave then? Will you be strong at the time I come to punish you? I am the Lord . I have spoken, and I will do what I said!.

dag: Ka ŋunkam daa malila anzinfa bee daanya daa zaŋ li na ti ti Yawɛ. Ka doo kam ŋun daa mali gɔpiɛliga dari din ni tooi tum tuma daa zaŋ li na.
en: Anyone who had silver or bronze or acacia wood brought it as a gift to the Lord .

dag: Bɛ Naawuni zaligu bela bɛ suhuri ni, ka bɛ bi sarigiri bɛ napɔna yaabu ni.
en: They have learned Gods teachings, and they will never stop living right.

dag: Dama n leela ŋun ka buchi kaman wain koligu din yili nyɔhi ni; amaa m bi tam a zaligunim yɛla.
en: Even when I am like a dried wineskin on the trash pile, I will not forget your laws.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn yɛri noya tiri niriba, amaa nyin niŋdila alibarika niŋdi niriba ni. Naawuni, chɛ ka bɛn nahindi ma maa di vi, amaa ka chɛ ka a dabili mali suhupiɛlli.
en: They may curse me, but you will bless me. May my persecutors be defeated, and may I, your servant, be glad.

dag: M mini ya n-yi be Naawuni jɛmbu duu dabisili kam ka yi bi gbaai ma. Amaa yi saha mini zibisim yiko saha m-paai.
en: I was with you every day in the temple, and you didn't arrest me. But this is your time, and darkness is in control.

dag: dindina yi kpamba mini sariakaritiba bɛn cham ti buɣisi o ni do luɣ shɛli maa zaŋ chaŋ fɔntin shɛŋa din miri nimaani wɔɣilim.
en: The judges and other leaders from the towns around there must find out what town is the closest to where the body was found.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa bi kari zuliya shɛb bɛn kpalim maa yomyom, ka mi daa bi chɛ ka Jɔshua kari ba.
en: the LORD left these nations instead of driving them out immediately or handing them over to Joshua.

dag: Yawɛ niŋdi ninvuɣ suma nirilim, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali nia biɛri, o wuhiya ni bɛ mali taali.
en: The LORD favors good people, but he condemns schemers.

dag: Di saha Yawɛ jilima ni yi zahira ka sokam zaa nya li. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala.
en: The LORDs glory will appear, and all humanity will see it together; the LORDs mouth has commanded it.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ nini kul mooi ka bɛ mɔhiri vuri yɛra, O piligila o wuhibu maa Galili n-wuhi li Judia tinsi zaa ni zaŋna hal ti paai kpe, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka niriba taari duŋ.
en: But they insisted even more strongly, With his teaching he is starting a riot among the people all through Judea. He began in Galilee and now has come here.

dag: Nandahima ni daa mali ma dahin shɛli, ka bɛ daa kana ti liri ma; amaa ka Yawɛ daa nyɛ ŋun guli ma.
en: They attacked me in my time of trouble, but the Lord was there to support me.

dag: Di saha paɣipuhinim mini biliɛrinim yɛla ni ti mali nambɔɣu pam!.
en: How terrible it will be in those days for women who are pregnant and for mothers with little babies!.

dag: Saha shɛli Mɔdɛkai ni daa ʒe n-guli nayili dunoli, ka Bigitan mini Tɛrɛsh bɛn daa nyɛ namɔɣilis ayi n-ʒe n-guli naa zɔntua dunoli daa ti je suli niŋ Naa Ahasivɛrɔs ka lo ni bɛ sɔɣi ku o.
en: During the time that Mordecai held office in the palace, Bigthana and Teresh, two of the palace eunuchs who guarded the entrance to the king's rooms, became hostile to King Xerxes and plotted to assassinate him.

dag: Bɛ biɛhi daa kul tuhimi, ka bɛ naba puuni be kaman naɣibila napɔŋ puuni la, ka nyaɣisira kaman daanya shɛli bɛ ni nyahi ka di nyaɣisir la.
en: Their legs were straight, but their feet looked like the hoofs of calves and sparkled like bronze.

dag: Mɛrari bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Mahili mini Libini ni Shimɛi ni Yuza.
en: Merari's descendants included Mahli, Libni, Shimei, Uzzah, Shimea, Haggiah, and Asaiah.

dag: N yɛri ya mi ni yɛl shɛli din gari Naawuni jɛmbu duu be kpe.
en: I tell you there is something here greater than the temple.

dag: Di saha ka Bɛtɛl maligumaana Amazia daa tim ti yɛli Izraɛl Naa Jɛrɔbɔam, Amɔs yila a nyaaŋa Izraɛlnim sani. O yɛtɔɣa muɣila tiŋgbani maa.
en: Amaziah the priest at Bethel sent this message to King Jeroboam of Israel, Amos is plotting against you in the very heart of Israel. Our nation cannot put up with his message for very long.

dag: Zuɣusaa daantalisi sɔhigimi, ka di gari ba o ni kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni maa zuɣu.
en: And columns supporting the sky tremble at his command.

dag: ka yi ŋme n-nyaŋ bɛ ni me birininim gili bɛ tin shɛŋa la nim mini tiŋ gahinda la, ka ŋma bɛ ti suŋ kam zaa luhi; ka ŋari bɛ kɔbil nina zaa, ka kahi kuɣa sɔŋ luɣ shɛŋa din tam vuhiri shee zaa n-saɣim li.
en: You will capture all their walled cities and important towns. You will chop down every good tree and stop up every spring of water, then ruin their fertile fields by covering them with rocks.

dag: Ana daa nyɛla Dishɔn ba. Dishɔn bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Hamiran mini Ɛshiban ni Itiran ni Kɛran.
en: Anah was the father of Dishon and the grandfather of Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.

dag: Timiya ba tuun kpɛma pam ka bɛ tumda din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku lan gbilisi tibili wum yɔhiŋgu yɛtɔɣa.
en: So make these people work harder. Keep them busy. Then they will not have enough time to listen to the lies of Moses.

dag: O chɛ ka a dunokparitisi mali kpiɔŋ, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a niriba ni.
en: Because God secures the bars on your gates, God blesses the children you have there.

dag: Dama saa ni yi nyaɣisi wulimpuhili polo m-mali ti ba wulinluhili polo shɛm la, lala ka Daadam Bia kandina maa ti yɛn be.
en: For the Son of Man will come like the lightning which flashes across the whole sky from the east to the west.

dag: Naawuni lo alikauli o biɛhigu shee. O yɛliya, N kpiɔŋ zuɣu, n ni pirigi Shɛkɛm, ka pirigi Sukɔt Vinvamli tari.
en: God has spoken in his Temple : I will win the war and rejoice in victory! I will divide this land among my people. I will give them Shechem. I will give them Succoth Valley.

dag: N Duuma, a mi n suhu ni ye shɛli zuɣu zaa, a mi n siɣimbu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Everything I long for is laid out before you, my Lord; my sighs arent hidden from you.

dag: Yɛlim niriba, Bɛna m-bɔŋɔ! Molimi molo jɛndi Jɛrusalɛmnim yɛli, Bɛn yɛn teei gili ya yi tiŋgban shɛli ni katiŋ kanna. Bɛ tahirila Juda tinsinim zuɣu.
en: Report it to this nation. Spread the news to the people in Jerusalem. Enemies are coming from a faraway country. They are shouting words of war against the cities of Judah.

dag: Saha yuusim wula ka anabi shɛb bɛn tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa din nyɛ ʒiri, ka tɔɣisiri bɛ suhuyubu anabitali yɛtɔɣa din nyɛ yɔhiŋ ŋɔ lee yɛn chɛ lala niŋbu?.
en: How long will this continue? They think up lies and then they teach them to the people.

dag: N Duuma NAAWUNI daa lan chɛ ka n nya binshɛli ʒii. Nyama ŋuna n Duuma NAAWUNI daa zaŋla buɣim ni o darig o niriba tibili. Buɣim maa daa dila teeku, ka lan diri tiŋgbani gba.
en: The Lord showed me that he is going to send a ball of fire to burn up everything on earth, including the ocean.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali adaka ka kpe kuɣ parilana ayi kaman tuuli dina la n-zaŋ kuɣ parilana ayi maa gbibi n nuu ni du zoli maa zuɣu.
en: So I made a box from acacia wood. I cut two stone tablets like the first two stones. Then I went up on the mountain. I had the two stone tablets in my hand.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kpe di ni deei li su. Amaa bɛ daa bi deeg a noli bee n-dol a zaligunima. Bɛ daa bi niŋ a ni yɛli ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛl la. Dinzuɣu ka a chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu ŋɔ zaa paai ba maa.
en: They came into this land and took it for their own. But they didnt obey you. They didnt follow your teachings or do what you commanded. So you made all these terrible things happen to them.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋun daa siɣina maa n-nyɛ ŋun daa lan lab du zuɣusaa n-gari chaŋ ha ni o ti pali luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: So the one who came down is the same one who went up, above and beyond the heavens, to fill the whole universe with his presence.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni chɛ ka di yi n-chaŋ ti kpe tayiɣ mini ŋun ŋmari ʒiri m-pɔri n yuli yinsi n-saɣim bɛ binshɛɣukam zaŋ tabili dari mini kuɣa. .
en: The Lord All-Powerful says, I will send that scroll to the houses of thieves and people who lie when they use my name to make promises. That scroll will settle there and destroy even the stones and wooden posts of their houses.

dag: Ka salo bɛn dol o maa yɛli, Yisa ŋun nyɛ anabi n-yi Nazarɛt Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni la na m-bala.
en: The crowds answered, Its the prophet Jesus from Nazareth in Galilee.

dag: Kulla dindali maa yuŋ ka bɛ daa ku Bɛlishaaza ŋun daa nyɛ Babilɔnnim naa maa.
en: That very same night, Belshazzar the Chaldean king was killed.

dag: Ka bɛ kuhi pam yɛl o, Kpahim o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: The people shouted, Kill him on a cross.

dag: Shɔbal bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Alivan mini Manahat ni Ɛbal ni Shɛfi ni Onam. Zibiɔn bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Aiya mini Ana.
en: Shobal was the father of Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. Zibeon was the father of Aiah and Anah.

dag: Yawɛ, bɔ saha ka di yɛn niŋ? Dim suɣilo. Zom a daba nambɔɣu.
en: Come back to us, LORD! Please, quick! Have some compassion for your servants!.

dag: ni salima sara maligu bimbin ni bɛ ni yɛn boori kpa shɛli bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni ni tulaale zim din nyom viɛla ni pateesa shɛli din yɛn yiini suɣili maa dunoli.
en: They showed Moses the golden altar, the anointing oil, the sweet-smelling incense, and the curtain that covered the entrance to the Tent.

dag: Nyama, Sulemaana daamaŋka m-bala ka tɔbbihi pihiyɔbu bɛn mali yaa Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni gil li.
en: Solomon is coming, carried on his throne; sixty soldiers form the bodyguard, the finest soldiers in Israel.

dag: Zuliya kam zaa ni ti jɛm o min o bia ni o yaaŋa hal ka omaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ lubu saha ti paai, ka zuliya pam mini na kara ti zaŋ o leei bɛ dabili.
en: All nations will serve Nebuchadnezzar and his son and his grandson. Then the time will come for Babylon to be defeated. Many nations and great kings will make Babylon their servant.

dag: M bi lan je suli niŋ wain tihi puu maa. Di yi mali gɔhi mini suligunyinyari, dindina n ni mali shili lu di zuɣu, ka nyo li buɣim.
en: I am no longer angry with the vineyard. If there were thorns and briers to fight against, I would burn them up completely.

dag: Yi pun mali din simdi ya zaa! Yi pun niŋ bundaannima! Yi di nam ka chɛ ti! N di bi zaɣisi ka yi shiri nyɛla nanima, ka ti di pahi yi zuɣu n-di yi nam maa!.
en: Do you already have everything you need? Are you already rich? Have you become kings, even though we are not? Well, I wish you really were kings, so that we could be kings together with you.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa wurim ba nimaani n-kpɛhi dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam zaa, ka bɛ daa chɛ tiŋ maa mɛbu.
en: So people stopped building the city, and the Lord scattered them all over the earth.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa lan tum alahichi zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ sani yaha. Ka Yawɛ daa ti Mɔab Naa Ɛgilɔn kpiɔŋ ka o lu Izraɛlnim zuɣu, bɛ ni daa tum alahichi shɛli zaŋ chaŋ ŋun Yawɛ sani maa zuɣu.
en: The people of Israel sinned against the Lord again. Because of this the Lord made King Eglon of Moab stronger than Israel.

dag: Wain kalinsi zuɣu chɛ ka niriba doli soya kumda, ka suhupiɛlli kam naai, ka dunia ŋɔ suhupiɛlli zo;.
en: People shout in the streets because there is no more wine. Happiness is gone forever; it has been banished from the land.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ, dama o viɛla, ka o yurilim maŋli bi naara.
en: Give thanks to the Lord , because he is good; his love is eternal.

dag: Naa daa yi ti chani Naawuni jɛmbu duu saha shɛlikam, bɛ zaŋdila nyɔtaɣirisi maa dol o chaŋ, di nyaaŋa ka bɛ lan zaŋ li labisi ti niŋ di duu.
en: Whenever the king entered the LORDs temple, the guards would carry the shields and then return them to the guardroom.

dag: Ka bɛn daa guli kuruchunim maa zo n-chaŋ ti yɛli fɔnnim mini tiŋkpannim dinkam daa niŋ maa zaa. Ka bɛ daa kana ni bɛ ti nya din niŋ maa.
en: Those who tended the pigs ran away and told the story in the city and in the countryside. People came to see what had happened.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu gba daa mali shili ni o yi Nazarɛt Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni kuli Bɛtilihɛm Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni Naa Dauda ya la, dama o daa yila Naa Dauda zuliya ni na.
en: Joseph went from the town of Nazareth in Galilee to the town of Bethlehem in Judea, the birthplace of King David. Joseph went there because he was a descendant of David.

dag: Sool daa bi yɛli shɛli dindali maa, dama o daa tɛhimi, Binshɛli n-niŋ o ka o bi be kasi, biɛhiŋ kani, o shiri bi bela kasi.
en: Saul didnt say anything that day because he thought, Perhaps David became unclean somehow. That must be it.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa kpuɣ o zuɣu nya o tizo Bɛnjamin ŋun nyɛ o ma puuni bia la, ka bɔhi ba, Yi ni daa yɛli ma yi tizɔbil so yɛla la m-bɔŋɔ? Di saha ka o daa yɛli, M bia, Naawuni niŋm alibarika niŋ a ni! .
en: Joseph looked up and saw his brother Benjamin, his own mothers son, and he said, Is this your youngest brother whom you told me about? God be gracious to you, my son.

dag: Daadamnim mini yɔnaɣila kara ni naɣila pola zaa ni ti lu n-doya. Bɛ ʒim ni ti zo n-tiɛli bɛ tiŋgbani, ka tiŋgbani maa nyu bɛ kpam tiɣi.
en: So the rams, the cattle, and the strong bulls will be killed. The land will be filled with their blood. The dirt will be covered with their fat.

dag: A chɛ ka n fabila leei waa. A piligi buɣu n zuɣu ni, ka zaŋ suhupiɛlli zuɣupiligu pili ma.
en: You changed my mourning into dancing. You took off my funeral clothes and dressed me up in joy.

dag: Amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn suhuri ni paligi ka bɛ mali suhupiɛlli Naawuni sani. Bɛ suhuri shiri ni paligi ka bɛ wa waa ni suhupiɛlli.
en: But the righteous are glad and rejoice in his presence; they are happy and shout for joy.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ku Ainim bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba zaa dindali maa, ka bɛ kalinli daa yiɣisi tuhi pinaayi.
en: Joshua kept his sword pointed at the town of Ai until every last one of Ai's , people was dead.

dag: Di yuriya dunia ŋɔ bee binshɛŋa din be dunia ŋɔ ni. So yi yuri dunia ŋɔ, ti Ba Naawuni yurilim ka o ni.
en: Don't love the world or anything that belongs to the world. If you love the world, you cannot love the Father.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim Izraɛlnim maa ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, ka n ni yihi ya Ijiptinim dabitim maa ni. N ni teei n nuu tum tuun kara n-darigi bɛ tibili ka tiligi ya.
en: So tell the Israelites that I say to them, I am the Lord ; I will rescue you and set you free from your slavery to the Egyptians. I will raise my mighty arm to bring terrible punishment upon them, and I will save you.

dag: Ka ti daa ti yiɣisi ni n-yi biɛɣu paai Kiɔs n-naanyi yi biɛɣu paai Samɔs n-kaai biɛɣu paai Milɛtus.
en: The next day, we sailed away from there and came to a place near the island of Chios. Then the next day, we sailed to the island of Samos. A day later, we came to the city of Miletus.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kpalim zani ka boli ba na ti bɔhi ba, Bɔ ka yi lee bɔri ni n niŋ tin ya.
en: Jesus stopped and called them. What do you want me to do for you? he asked them.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa du zo shɛli zuɣu ka boli ninvuɣ shɛb o ni bɔra, ka bɛ daa ka o sanna.
en: Then Jesus went up on a hill and invited those he wanted to go with him. So they joined him there.

dag: Bɛ daa malila dapaɣa pisi niŋ Naawuni biɛhigu shee suɣili maa nudirigu polo.
en: They made frames for the south side of the Holy Tent.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nya din niŋ maa yɛli ba di ni niŋ shɛm ka alizin biɛri ni daa ʒi do so zuɣu maa ti lan leei ninvuɣ maŋli maa yaha.
en: Those people who had actually seen what had happened told them how the demon-possessed man had been delivered.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa wum lala maa, ka bɛ gbaai yibu yinoyino. Ninkura n-daa daŋ yibu; ka di ti kpalimla Yisa kɔŋko, ka paɣ maa ʒe o tooni.
en: When they heard this, they all left, one by one, the older ones first. Jesus was left alone, with the woman still standing there.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia daa ti kani, ka o bia Manaasa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Hezekiah died and was buried with his ancestors. And his son Manasseh became the new king after him.

dag: Jɔn daa lan wuhi niriba maa yɛla pam pah o lahibal suŋ waazu maa puuni.
en: In many different ways John preached the good news to the people.

dag: Nir yi sɔɣi Yawɛ sani, di so ni a niŋ ninsalinim naani.
en: It is better to trust the Lord for protection than to trust anyone else.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ binyɛribil din yɛri gbinni yɛl o, ka zaŋ shɛlɔrigu lo o, ka zaŋ zabba yɛl o, ka zaŋ binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa yɛl o, ka zaŋ balati lo o.
en: He put the priestly shirt and robe on Aaron and wrapped the sash around his waist. Then he put the sacred vest on Aaron and fastened it with the finely woven belt.

dag: Ka yi yi suhiri Naawuni ka taali be yi mini yi tab sunsuuni, yin chɛliya paŋ taba din ni chɛ ka yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ gba chɛ yi taali paŋ ya. .
en: And whenever you stand up to pray, if you have something against anyone, forgive so that your Father in heaven may forgive you your wrongdoings.

dag: Bɛn daa tumdi di tuma maa mini bɛ bidibisi yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Kɔhat daŋ ni niriba n-daa nyɛ: Hɛman ŋun daa nyɛ yiliyiina, ka nyɛ Joɛl bia la, Joɛl daa nyɛla Samuɛl bia.
en: Those who served and their families were: Kohaths family: Heman the singer, son of Joel son of Samuel.

dag: Lahibal suŋ ŋɔ ka ti zaŋ na ni ti ti tin ya: Naawuni ni daa lo ti yaannim alikauli shɛl la.
en: God made a promise to our ancestors. And we are here to tell you the good news.

dag: Paɣimiya Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma Yisa Masia Naawuni min o Ba ŋɔ. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ti Ba ŋun nyɛ nambɔzɔra mini suhumaabo zaa Naawuni.
en: May the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ be blessed! He is the compassionate Father and God of all comfort.

dag: Di yi ti wali yuuni na di viɛla; ka di mi yi ti bi wali, man naanyi ŋmaa li luhi. .
en: Maybe it will have figs on it next year. If it doesn't, you can have it cut down.

dag: Ka yi ti sab li pa yi yinsi dunɔpaɣirisi zuɣu mini yi dunɔdaya zuɣu.
en: Write them on your houses doorframes and on your citys gates.

dag: ka tin yin nim ni ti yɛli tin shɛlinima, Ti chanimi ni ti ti jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, ka suh o ka o niŋ alibarika niŋ ti ni. Kamiyana ka ti mini ya chaŋ.
en: People from different cities will greet each other and say, We are going to worship the Lord All-Powerful. And the other person will say, I would like to go with you.

dag: M bɔri ni a baŋ ni n ni be a sani, ka gbib a luɣ shɛlikam a ni yɛn chaŋ, ka ni ti zaŋ a labisi tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni na. Dama n kul ku chɛ a hal ti niŋ n ni lo a alikauli ni n ni niŋ a shɛm maa.
en: I am with you now, I will protect you everywhere you go, and I will bring you back to this land. I will not leave you until I have done everything that I have promised you.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yɛl o, Doli ma, ka chɛ ka kpiimba sɔɣimi bɛ kpiin taba.
en: But Jesus said to him, Follow me, and let the dead bury their own dead.

dag: Karia bia Jɔhanan mini tɔbbihi sapashin kpamba bɛn daa be mɔɣu ni la zaa daa ka Gɛdalia sanna Mizipa.
en: One day, Johanan got together with some of the other men who had been army officers, and they came to Mizpah and met with Gedaliah.

dag: piɛri mini niɣi zaa ni mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri gba.
en: sheep and cattle, and the wild animals too;.

dag: Dama n ni kpi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni; n ku du Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili, amaa yinim ni du li chaŋ ti deei tiŋgbɔn viɛlli maa su.
en: So I must stay here and die on this side of the Jordan, but you will cross the river and take the land.

dag: Nir yi zaŋ o nyɛvili taɣ o zɔnim dini, yurilim shɛl lan kani gari li.
en: No one has greater love than to give up ones life for ones friends.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin mini Hashub daa mali me bɛ yiŋ tooni m-pani bɛ zuɣu. Ka Maasɛya bia Azaria ŋun daa nyɛ Anania yaaŋa la daa mali me o yiŋ luɣili ni m-pani bɛ zuɣu.
en: After them, Benjamin and Hasshub made repairs opposite their house. After them, Azariah, Maaseiahs son and Ananiahs grandson, repaired beside his house.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kul doya gil tiŋ maa m-mali hal ti paai Naa Zɛdɛkia ni daa di nam maa yuun piniyini saha.
en: The city was under attack until King Zedekiahs eleventh year.

dag: Izar bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Kɔra mini Nɛfɛg ni Zikiri.
en: The Izharites: Korah, Nepheg, and Zichri.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daa bi tam Nuhu mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ni yiŋ biŋkɔbiri bɛn zaa daa be o sani ŋariŋ maa ni la yɛla. Ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka pɔhim ʒiɛna, ka kom maa daa gbaai nyuubu.
en: God had not forgotten Noah and all the animals with him in the boat; he caused a wind to blow, and the water started going down.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma lan yɛli, N na kul bɔri ni n yɛli n Duuma shɛli pahi. Ka a yi ti nyala wuntizɔriba pisi nimaani? Ka o garigi yɛli, Wuntizɔriba pisi maa zuɣu, n ku saɣim tiŋ maa.
en: Then Abraham said, Lord, may I bother you again and ask, what if there are twenty good people? The Lord answered, If I find twenty good people, I will not destroy the city.

dag: N lɔri nia ni n chaŋ Masidɔnia tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka n yi ti chaŋ nimaani, di nyaaŋa n ni gari ka yi sanna.
en: Ill come to you after I go through Macedonia, and because Im going through Macedonia.

dag: O tim buɣim ka di yi zuɣusaa na, ka di nyooi ma hal ti kpe n kɔba ni. O bari zana, ka di gbaai n naba. O kari ma labisi. O chɛ ka bɛ zaɣisi ma, ka n tarigi doya dabisili kam zaa puuni.
en: He sent fire from above, a fire that burned inside me. He set a trap for me and brought me to the ground. Then he abandoned me and left me in constant pain.

dag: O ni daa ti yiɣisi o Naawuni suhibu maa shee o daa labila o nyaandoliba maa sani nti nya ka bɛ gbihirimi, suhugarigu ni daa mali ba zuɣu.
en: Jesus got up from praying and went over to his disciples. They were asleep and worn out from being so sad.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa yɛl o, Yuun pihinahinaayɔbu ka bɛ daa zaŋ me duu ŋɔ, ka nyin ti yɛli ni a ni labi me li zali daba ata sunsuuni.
en: The Jewish leaders replied, It took forty-six years to build this temple, and you will raise it up in three days.

dag: Naawuni ŋun chɛ ka ti mali yɛm gari biŋkɔbiri bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni mini noonsi bɛn yiɣiri zuɣusaa ŋɔ lee be ya.
en: They don't turn to God, who makes us wise, wiser than any animal or bird.

dag: Yi kul tɛhirimi ni ti zabirila timaŋ zuɣu yi sani? M mabiyurisi, Naawuni sani, Masia zuɣu ka ti kul tɔɣisira, ka di zaa nyɛla yi kpaŋsibu zuɣu.
en: Perhaps you think that all along we have been trying to defend ourselves before you. No! We speak as Christ would have us speak in the presence of God, and everything we do, dear friends, is done to help you.

dag: Saamba bɛn be yi sani biɛhigu ni ti du pam gari ya, amaa ka yinim biɛhigu ti labi nyaaŋa pam.
en: The immigrants who live among you will be promoted over you, higher and higher! But you will be demoted, lower and lower!.

dag: Ka Abishai ŋun daa nyɛ Zɛruya bia la daa ku Ɛdomnim ninvuɣ tusaanii Yalim Vinvamli ni.
en: Abishai the son of Zeruiah defeated the Edomite army in Salt Valley and killed , of their troops.

dag: n-zaŋ o nudirigu nubil tim kpa shɛli din be o nuzaa ni maa n-zaŋ o nubil ni kpam maa mihi Yawɛ tooni ʒiibuyopɔin.
en: dip a finger of his right hand into the oil, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred tent.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi yuli bɛ zaa ti tuui taba ka yɛli doo maa, Teem a nuu maa. Ka o teei li, ka di dii kpaŋ zaa.
en: Jesus looked around at all of them and then said to the man, Hold out your hand. The man held out his hand, and it was healed.

dag: Naa min o niriba maa ni daa yiri maa, tiŋ maa nim zaa daa duhila kuŋa n-kum pam. Ka Naa daa chaŋ ti gbaai Kidirɔn kulibɔŋ du, ka o min o niriba maa zaa daa zaŋ kpa mɔɣu polo.
en: All the people were crying loudly. Then King David crossed over Kidron Brook, and all the people went out to the desert.

dag: Kulla di saha maa ka niriba tusa gari shɛm daa laɣimna hal ti nɔri tab naba bɛ galisim zuɣu, ka Yisa daa daŋ piligi saɣisir o nyaandoliba yɛra, Miriya Farisiinim dabindi din nyɛ bɛ bilikɔnsi la;.
en: When a crowd of thousands upon thousands had gathered so that they were crushing each other, Jesus began to speak first to his disciples: Watch out for the yeast of the Pharisees—I mean, the mismatch between their hearts and lives.

dag: Ka yi lan zaŋ di vulo maa yi Hɔr Zoli maa gbini hal ni Lɛbohamat samban ni, ka di tintariga naabu shee yɛn nyɛla Zɛdad.
en: From Mount Hor you will mark out your boundary to Lebo-hamath. The limit of the border will be Zedad.

dag: Di saha ka o tɔɣis o daanabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Bɛɔr bia Balaam daanabitali yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ, Ninvuɣ so ŋun nyari viɛnyɛliŋga daanabitali yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Then he uttered this prophecy: The message of Balaam son of Beor, The words of the man who can see clearly.

dag: Ka ŋun daa daŋ tooni ka o sanna ti yɛl o, N dana, a pɔŋli la dɔɣila pɔŋ pia.
en: The first servant came forward and said, Your money has earned a return of one thousand percent.

dag: Niriba yi daŋ yiɣisibu asiba n-tum tuun kpɛma bindirigu zuɣu hal ni yuŋ, ka bi daŋ gbihibu, di ka buchi, dama Yawɛ n-tir o ni yuri ninvuɣ shɛb gom.
en: It is a waste of time to get up early and stay up late, trying to make a living. The Lord provides for those he loves, even while they are sleeping.

dag: Dinzuɣu, daadam, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli Gɔg, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Dindali maa n niriba Izraɛlnim yi ti be ni alaafee, amaŋmaŋ ni ti yiɣisi.
en: I, the Lord God, know that when you see my people Israel living in peace.

dag: A ni daa mali karimbaani saha shɛli la a daa bi maanila a mabia Sɔdom ansarisi.
en: Didn't you joke about Sodom in those days when you were proud.

dag: Bɛ yi di nyɛla n saawaranima, dindina bɛ naan moli n yɛligu maa n niriba sani; bɛ naan yihi ba bɛ biɛriyoli ni, ka yihi ba bɛ ni tumdi tuumbiɛ shɛŋa ni.
en: If they had stood in my heavenly council, then they would have told my messages to the people of Judah. They would have stopped the people from doing bad things. They would have stopped them from doing evil.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ, A yɛn je suli niŋ a niriba wunsuhigu hal ni bɔ saha?.
en: How much longer, Lord God Almighty, will you be angry with your people's prayers?.

dag: Di saha maa ka dɔro daa gbaai Hɛzɛkia ka di ti chɛ biɛla ni o kpi, ka o daa suhu Yawɛ, ka o deeg o suhigu maa, ka wuh o shihirili.
en: About this same time, Hezekiah got sick and was almost dead. He prayed, and the Lord gave him a sign that he would recover.

dag: Zuɣulaannim bɛn nyɛ karimbaannim ni bɛn nyu wain buɣi la, bɛ ni ti no n-taai ba.
en: Every drunkard in Ephraim takes pride in Samaria, but it will be crushed.

dag: Siria naa daa ti lo tɔbu ni o tuhi Izraɛlnima, ka daa niŋ o sapashinnim saawara, yɛli, Luɣili yaakaza ka n yɛn chaŋ ti dɔni.
en: The king of Aram was making war against Israel. He had a council meeting with his army officers. He said, Go to such and such a place and prepare to attack the Israelites when they come by.

dag: ka Yawɛ daa tim anab so Izraɛlnim sanna ka o ti yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mani n-daa yihi ya Ijipti na, ka yihi ya dabitim ni.
en: The Lord sent a prophet to them. He said, This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: You were slaves in the land of Egypt. I made you free and brought you out of that land.

dag: N ni daa zaŋ dabu gbaŋ maa ti Nɛria bia Baruk maa nyaaŋa, ka n daa suhi Yawɛ yɛra.
en: After I had given the deed of purchase to Baruch, I prayed.

dag: Bɛ zoorimi kaman momaha la asibaasi; zaawuni ka bɛ ti zaɣi kpi.
en: that grow and burst into bloom, then dry up and die in the evening.

dag: Ka bɛn yi dɔɣim kam zaa ni mini zuliya balibu kam ni ni niriba balibu kam ni ni tinzun yɛligu kam nim ni na ni ti lihiri ba ka zaɣisi ba sɔɣibu, ka bɛ ni do nimaani dabisi muna ata ni pirigili.
en: And for three and a half days, members of the peoples, tribes, languages, and nations will look at their dead bodies, but they wont let their dead bodies be put in a tomb.

dag: Bɛ ni daa chaŋ ni bɛ ti da kpam maa ka amiliya aŋgo maa dii paana, ka o mini bɛn daa pun mali shili gu o maa kpe amiliya lɔbu yili maa ni, ka bɛ kpari di dunoli.
en: But while they were gone to buy oil, the groom came. Those who were ready went with him into the wedding. Then the door was shut.

dag: Chɛ ka a nina kpa duu ŋɔ yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni; luɣ shɛli a ni daa yɛli, N yuli ni be nimaani la. Ka mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ yi ti zaŋ n nina kpa duu ŋɔ polo na ka suh a, nyin deemi n suhigu.
en: Watch over this Temple day and night, this place where you have chosen to be worshiped. Hear me when I face this Temple and pray.

dag: Uziɛl bidibisi ni, Maika n-daa nyɛ kpɛma n-zaŋ Ishia pa.
en: Kohath's youngest son, Uzziel, was the father of Micah and Isshiah.

dag: Ka Nan bia Jɔshua ŋun daa nyɛ Musa sɔŋda ni o ninvuɣ gahinda ni yino la daa yɛli, N dan Musa, karim ba.
en: Then Joshua son of Nun, who had been Moses' helper since he was a young man, spoke up and said to Moses, Stop them, sir.

dag: ka nya ka pako faralan so daa tɔhi pihinu diba ayi.
en: Then he saw a poor widow put two small copper coins into the box.

dag: ka yɛli ba ni bɛ di ŋubi mɔri bee bimbilli kam bee tihi vari, amaa ni bɛ nahimmila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka Naawuni bintabinda la bɛ gbiɛri zuɣu la.
en: They were told not to harm the grass or the trees or any other plant; they could harm only the people who did not have the mark of God's seal on their foreheads.

dag: Ka sagbana mini sakuɣa ni sala buɣim daa puhi yi neesim din be o tooni maa ni na.
en: Hailstones and fiery coals lit up the sky in front of you.

dag: Pukpar so n-daa chaŋ ti kɔr o puu ka yaɣind o bimbira; ka di shɛŋa daa lu sol zuɣu ka niriba nɔri li garita, ka noonsi ti kana nti gahim li di.
en: Once there was a man who went out to sow grain. As he scattered the seed in the field, some of it fell along the path, where it was stepped on, and the birds ate it up.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛhab bia Ahazia daa yɛli Jɛhɔshafat, Chɛ ka n niriba pah a niriba zuɣu ka bɛ zaŋ ŋarima maa chaŋ; amaa ka Jɛhɔshafat daa bi saɣi.
en: Then Ahaziah, Ahabs son, said to Jehoshaphat, Let my sailors go with your sailors on the ships. But Jehoshaphat didnt agree to this.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti be dufahirili zuɣu, ŋun di lan siɣina ni o ti kpe o duu kah o nɛma.
en: Those on the roof shouldnt come down or enter their houses to grab anything.

dag: Ka o mali Naawuni Kundi yɛligu kahigiri wuhiri ba yɛra, Di daa kpala talahi ni Masia di wahala ka lan neei kum ni, dinzuɣu n ni yihiri Yisa so waazu maa n-nyɛ Masia.
en: Through his interpretation of the scriptures, he demonstrated that the Christ had to suffer and rise from the dead. He declared, This Jesus whom I proclaim to you is the Christ.

dag: Bɛ daa malila yuri kɔbisiyopɔin ni pihitanaayɔbu, ni buntaansi kɔbisiyi ni pihinahinaanu.
en: horses, mules.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, A yi di mi Naawuni pini, ka mi ŋun suhir a ni a niŋ kom ti o ka o nyu ŋɔ, a gba naan suh o ka o ti a nyɛvili kom.
en: Jesus answered, You dont know what God can give you. And you dont know who I am, the one who asked you for a drink. If you knew, you would have asked me, and I would have given you living water.

dag: Dama m baŋ n tuumbiɛri ni nyɛ shɛli, ka n daalahichi kul ʒe n tooni.
en: I know about my sins, and I cannot forget the burden of my guilt.

dag: Kulla di saha maa ka o daa paɣi bɛ fiɛbbu dansi la, ka Pool mini Silas daa baptaizi dansarika gula maa min o yiŋnim zaa.
en: While it was still night, the jailer took them to a place where he could wash their cuts and bruises. Then he and everyone in his home were baptized.

dag: Ka ti kul ŋuhirimi ti dunia ŋɔ ni niŋgbuŋ ŋɔ puuni, dama ti suhuri kul yɛmi ni ti zaŋ alizanda ni yili maa ye kaman binyɛrigu la m-pa ti dunia ŋɔ ni Tanti yili maa zuɣu;.
en: And now we sigh, so great is our desire that our home which comes from heaven should be put on over us;.

dag: So bi yɛn teeri yɛndana bee jɛrigu yɛla sahakam; dama saha shɛli kanna ka bɛ ni ti tam bɛ zaa yɛla, dama bɔzuɣu ka yɛnnim mini jɛra zaa yɛn kpi kpiri yini?.
en: There is no eternal memory of the wise any more than the foolish, because everyone is forgotten before long. How can the wise die just like the fool?.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino daa bɔhi malaika so ŋun daa be kozɔrim maa zuɣusaa polo la, Saha yuusim wula puuni ka alahiziba yɛla ŋɔ tariga yɛn paai.
en: One of them asked the angel who was standing further upstream, How long will it be until these amazing events come to an end.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa daa bi baŋ o ni yɛli shɛm maa gbinni, amaa ka mi daa lee zɔr o suhu ni bɛ bɔh o baŋ.
en: But the followers did not understand what he meant, and they were afraid to ask him.

dag: Ka gbaai naɣila kpabili na ti kɔrigi ka ti ŋubi, ka diɛm suhupiɛlli diɛma;.
en: Fetch the fattened calf and slaughter it. We must celebrate with feasting.

dag: ka yɛra, Ami! Ti Duuma Naawuni ŋun su alibarika mini yɛm ni yiko ni kpiɔŋ simdi jilima tibu mini paɣibu ni tibigibu hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami.
en: saying, Amen! Blessing and glory and wisdom and thanksgiving and honor and power and might be to our God forever and always. Amen.

dag: Ka so ti ku lan wum suhupiɛlli diɛma vuri. Bɛ ti ku wum amiliya mini aŋgo kukoya Juda fɔntinsi ni mini Jɛrusalɛm solɔri zuɣu. Dama tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ti zani dabari.
en: I will bring an end to the sounds of joy and happiness in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem. There will be no more sounds of the bride and bridegroom in Judah or Jerusalem. The land will become an empty desert.

dag: Bɛ daa mali salima naɣibila n-zali Sinai Zoli gbini; ka daa jɛm salima binnani.
en: They made a gold bull-calf at Sinai and worshiped that idol;.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli bɛ ni daa gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb chaŋ maa Yawɛ ni daa wuhi ma binshɛŋa zaa.
en: I spoke to the exiles about everything the LORD had shown to me.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti nyɛla Ibrahimma zuliya, ka na ʒi n-leei so daba; ka di chaŋ wula ka a ti yɛli ni ti ni yi dabitim ni.
en: They responded, We are Abrahams children; weve never been anyones slaves. How can you say that we will be set free.

dag: dama n niŋ li mi ni yi nya ka mi niŋdi taba kaman n ni niŋ ya shɛm maa.
en: I did this as an example for you. So you should serve each other just as I served you.

dag: Dinzuɣu nyama, n ni niŋ o marisa n-zaŋ o ka tiŋgban nɛli ni na nti tɔɣis o yurilim yɛtɔɣa.
en: Therefore, I will charm her, and bring her into the desert, and speak tenderly to her heart.

dag: Ka binshɛb bɛn mali kpiŋkpama ka be nyam, yin ŋubimiya ba.
en: But you may eat any clean bird.

dag: Dama n dabisa kul chanimi gariti kaman nyɔhi la, ka n kɔba ni mi diri buɣim kaman daaŋa ni buɣim la.
en: My life is disappearing like smoke; my body is burning like fire.

dag: Amiramnim mini Izarinim ni Hiburɔnnim ni Uziɛlinim ni:.
en: Other guards at the treasury were from the Kohathite clans of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ku Izraɛl do so mini Midian paɣ maa yuli n-daa booni Zimiri. O daa nyɛla Salu bia, ka lan nyɛ Simiɔn zuliya niriba dɔɣirikpɛma.
en: The Israelite man who was killed with the Midianite woman was named Zimri son of Salu. He was the leader of a family in the tribe of Simeon.

dag: Ka salo bɛn daa ʒe nimaani maa wum lala ka yɛli ni saa n-tahira. Ka shɛb mi yɛli ni malaika n-tɔɣisir o yɛtɔɣa shɛm maa.
en: The crowd standing there heard the voice, and some of them said it was thunder, while others said, An angel spoke to him.

dag: Yɛhudianim bɛn daa be Bɛria daa nyaŋ niriba gari bɛn daa be Tɛsalɔnaika la, dama bɛ daa taɣi deei yɛligu maa ni suhupiɛlli, ka vihiri Naawuni litaafinim ni biɛɣukam ni bɛ nya yɛla maa shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: The people in Berea were much nicer than those in Thessalonica, and they gladly accepted the message. Day after day they studied the Scriptures to see if these things were true.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa chaŋ ti yihiri waazu yɛri niriba ni bɛ niŋmi tuuba.
en: So they went out and preached that people should turn away from their sins.

dag: Ka Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa zali yuma ata shɛŋa la saha daa ti paai, ka Ashpɛnaz zaŋ nachimbihi maa zaa tahi ŋun Nɛbukadnɛza sani.
en: At the end of the three years of training, Ashpenaz brought all the young men to King Nebuchadnezzar.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ piɛla yino m-pahi kpam lita pirigibu ʒiibuta yim la zuɣu m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara, ka zaŋ li gahigahi, ka di leei bɛ ni zaŋ sara shɛli gahigahi Yawɛ tooni.
en: Then the priest shall take one of the male lambs and together with the half pint of oil he shall offer it as a repayment offering. He shall present them as a special gift to the Lord for the priest.

dag: Taɣimiya Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa ŋɔ yuli m bol o, Vuyɔra ŋun zaŋ o daalɔbo bahi.
en: In their homelands, those soldiers will say, Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, is only a lot of noise. His time of glory is over.

dag: Ka tuun shɛŋa Baasha ni daa tum pahi min o ni daa pun tum tuun shɛŋa ni o kpiɔŋ yɛla, bɛ sab li niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi ni.
en: Now the rest of Baashas deeds, what he did, and his powerful acts, arent they written in the official records of Israels kings?.

dag: O ni daa yɛli ŋ-ŋɔ maa ka shiri na kpalim be Galili tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: He said this and then stayed on in Galilee.

dag: n ni ti laɣim zuliya kam zaa n-zaŋ ba ti zali Jɛhɔshafat Vinvamli ni. N ni ti kari ba saria nimaani bɛ ni daa niŋ n niriba Izraɛlnim shɛm la zuɣu. Dama bɛ nyɛla n ni su shɛba. Bɛ daa kari ba kpɛhi tinzun tinsi ni, ka pirigi n tiŋgbani ti taba.
en: I will gather all the nations, and I will bring them to the Jehoshaphat Valley. There I will enter into judgment with them in support of my people and my possession, Israel, which they have scattered among the nations. They have divided my land.

dag: Nyin ninsala, ka a ni kariti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi tuumbiɛri ŋɔ tatabo saria ka amaŋmaŋ gba tumdi li maa, a tɛhiya ni a ni nya soli din ni doli yi Naawuni sariakaribo ni?.
en: And since you do the same things as those people you judge, surely you understand that God will punish you too. How could you think you would be able to escape his judgment?.

dag: Ka lan lihi nya tiŋgbani maa vuhiri bee di nyɛla tiŋgban kpiŋ, ka nya tihi be di ni bee di kani. Niŋmiya suhukpeeni n-ʒi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni tiwal shɛŋa na. Wain tihi wal daŋda moobu saha n-daa bala.
en: And learn other things about the land. Is the soil good for growing things, or is it poor soil? Are there trees on the land? Try to bring back some of the fruit from that land.

dag: Ti lan yɛl a ni di bi tu ni maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim ni yiliyiiniba ni dunɔguliba ni Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa tumtumdiba bɛn pahi yo farigu.
en: You are forbidden to collect any taxes from the priests, Levites, musicians, guards, workers, or anyone else connected with this Temple.

dag: ni n ni ti yɛn darigi Izraɛlnim tibili bɛ tuumbiɛri zuɣu dahin shɛli, n ni ti saɣim Bɛtɛl sara maligu bimbina, ka ŋme n-kabisi di lɔrisi ni tandaɣa din sansaya la bahi tiŋa.
en: When I, the Lord , punish Israel for their sins, I will destroy the altars at Bethel. Even the corners of the altar will be left in the dirt.

dag: Bɛ zaa yinoyino ŋmanila luɣ shɛli nira ni ni zo nti sɔɣi tiligi pɔhim bee sanʒiɛɣu. Bɛ ŋmanila kɔzɔrim din zo n-tiɛli tiŋgban nɛli, ka ŋmani mahim din be tiŋgban nɛl ni tampin titali lɔŋni.
en: They will be a place of safety from stormy winds, a stream in the desert, and a rock that gives shade from the heat of the sun.

dag: Zoya nyɛligirimi kaman kpam la, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ dunia zaa Duuma ŋɔ tooni.
en: The hills melt like wax before the Lord , before the Lord of all the earth.

dag: Ka o ni ti tim malaikanima ka bɛ chaŋ ti laɣim o ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛlikam zaa na.
en: Then he will send the angels and gather together his chosen people from the four corners of the earth, from the end of the earth to the end of heaven.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa ti tim omaŋmaŋ bia ka yɛli, Bɛ ni ti ti m bia ŋɔ ŋun jilima.
en: Last of all he sent his son to them. Surely they will respect my son, he said.

dag: Dabiɛm gbaai ma mi ka n ni sɔhira, ka dabiɛm din galisi nyaŋ ma;.
en: Fear and trembling have come upon me; Im shaking all over.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ piɛlaa na ni bɛ ti mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la, ka Aduna min o bidibisi maa daa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa piɛlaa maa zuɣu ni.
en: Then Moses presented the ram for the entirely burned offering, and Aaron and his sons pressed their hands on its head.

dag: Bɛ zuliya maa nyɛla bɛn baɣa ka niriba ni ka lan nyɛ tipawumlinima, ka n timd a bɛ sani ni a ti yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Im sending you to their hardheaded and hard-hearted descendants, and you will say to them: The LORD God proclaims.

dag: ni Alikauli Adaka la mini di dapuhi ni di yɔrigu ni di pateesa la.
en: the chest with its poles and its cover, the veil for a screen.

dag: Ka Dan zuliya niriba maa daa ŋmaligi chaŋ. Maika ni daa nya ka bɛ mali kpiɔŋ gar o maa, ka o ŋmaligi lab kuli.
en: Then the men of Dan turned around and went on their way. Micah knew that these men were too strong for him, so he went back home.

dag: O daa di wahala pam timanim sani n-saɣim o ni daa mali shɛlikam zaa ha, ka di bi niŋd o soochi ka kul maan pahirimi.
en: She had suffered very much. Many doctors had tried to help her, and all the money she had was spent, but she was not improving. In fact, her sickness was getting worse.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa ni paɣiba daa boli bia maa yuli Obɛd ka yɛli, Bɛ dɔɣi bidibiga ti Naomi! Ka Obɛd daa ti dɔɣi Jɛsi, ka Jɛsi mi dɔɣi Naa Dauda.
en: The neighborhood women gave him a name, saying, A son has been born to Naomi. They called his name Obed. He became Jesses father and Davids grandfather.

dag: Yuŋ ti ku lan beni; bɛ mi ti ku bɔri firila bee wuntaŋ neesim, dama ti Duuma Naawuni maŋmaŋa nti yɛn nyɛ bɛ neesim, ka bɛ ni ti di nam hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: There shall be no more night, and they will not need lamps or sunlight, because the Lord God will be their light, and they will rule as kings forever and ever.

dag: Yiɣisim a suhu zaa pam n-lihi bɛnkam mali karimbaani, ka a filim ba.
en: If you are as powerful as God, then show your anger! Punish those who are proud and humble them.

dag: Asha zuliya ni, tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa mali shili ka ni tooi tuhi tɔbu saha shɛlikam daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahi.
en: from Asher, , experienced troops armed for battle.

dag: Nyɛvili wɔɣinli bela yɛm nudirigu ni, ka buni mini jilima be di nuzaa ni.
en: In her right hand is a long life; in her left are wealth and honor.

dag: N Duuma, a pal a ni daa lo alikauli shɛl la, dinzuɣu chɛ ka man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ yi dunia ni ni suhudoo;.
en: Now, master, let your servant go in peace according to your word.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, ti Duuma NAAWUNI na ʒi n-niŋ shɛli ka bi kahigi li wuh o daba bɛn nyɛ o daanabinima.
en: The Sovereign Lord never does anything without revealing his plan to his servants, the prophets.

dag: Di saha Bɛtishɛmɛshinim daa bela vinvamli ni n-chɛri alikama, bɛ ni daa ti kpuɣi bɛ zuɣuri lihi nya Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa ka di niŋ ba suhupiɛlli.
en: Now the people of Beth-shemesh were harvesting wheat in the valley. When they looked up and saw the chest, they were overjoyed at the sight.

dag: N Naawuni, n kuhi bol a wuntaŋ ni, amaa ka a bi garigi ma; ka n kuhi bol a yuŋ, ka bi nya gom gbihi.
en: During the day I call to you, my God, but you do not answer; I call at night, but get no rest.

dag: Ka di nyaaŋa kɔr biɛri yi tiɣi pua, di dɔɣirila alahichi; ka alahichi mi yi ti bi zaa, di tiɣirila pua n-dɔɣi kum.
en: Your desire grows inside you until it results in sin. Then the sin grows bigger and bigger and finally ends in death.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa niŋ a daalikaulinim yɛda, ka yili yila paɣ a.
en: Then your people trusted you and sang your praises.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn mini ninvuɣ kɔbiga bɛn daa be o sani maa daa mali ti paai sansani maa shee yuntisuɣu saha tiŋguliba ni deeri tab tuma saha shɛli n-dii piɛb bɛ kikahi ka ŋme ŋ-ŋma bɛ ni gbib duɣubihi shɛŋa maa.
en: Gideon and his one hundred men came to the edge of the camp a while before midnight, just after the guard had been changed. Then they blew the trumpets and broke the jars they were holding.

dag: Amaa bɛ dɔɣila ninsalinim niŋ yɛlimuɣisira ni, kaman buɣim ni yi tahi yiɣi zuɣusaa shɛm la.
en: No indeed! We bring trouble on ourselves, as surely as sparks fly up from a fire.

dag: Ka yi daa garigi yɛli ma, Ti tum alahichi Yawɛ sani. Ti ni chaŋ ti tuhi tɔbu maa kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ti shɛm maa. Ka yi ni doo kam daa zaŋ o tɔbutuhiri nɛma niŋ omaŋa, ka daa tɛhi ni zoya ni tiŋ maa ni chandi yɛn nyɛla asama.
en: You replied to me: Weve sinned against the LORD! We will go up! We will fight, just as the LORD our God commanded. Each one of you grabbed your weapons. You thought it would be easy to go up into the hills.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ bɔh o, Ŋuni n-lee chɛ ka ninsalinim tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa? Ŋuni n-lee chɛ ka bɛ nyɛ biriti bee tikpiranima bee n-nyara bee n-nyɛ zoomba? Pa man Yawɛ?.
en: But the Lord answered, Who makes people able to speak or makes them deaf or unable to speak? Who gives them sight or makes them blind? Don't you know that I am the one who does these things?.

dag: Paɣimi n tuumbiɛri zaa bahi, ka nyahi n daalahichi.
en: Wash me completely clean of my guilt; purify me from my sin!.

dag: Yawɛ suhu piɛl o niriba zuɣu pam. O tiri bɛn siɣisiri bɛmaŋ nasara.
en: The Lord is pleased with his people, and he gives victory to those who are humble.

dag: Ti ni lan zaŋdi ti bidib kpamba mini ti niɣi ni ti biŋkɔbbaligu ni tuui dɔɣi zaɣ lo shɛba n-tahiri ti Naawuni jɛmbu duu na nti tiri maligumaaniba bɛn tumdi tuma ti Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni kaman di ni sabi shɛm zaligu ni.
en: We will also bring the oldest offspring of our children and our cattle, as it is written in the Instruction, and the oldest males of our herds and flocks to our Gods house, to the priests who serve in our Gods house.

dag: din nyɛ sagbana ni kpaari shɛli bahira, ka di luri ninsalinim zuɣu na pampam.
en: and supplies us with rain.

dag: Kaman piɛguliba ni vihiri bɔri bɛ piɛri shee shɛm saha shɛli bɛ yi ti wurim kpe yɔɣu la, lala ka n yɛn bo m piɛri maa shee. Sagbani mini zibisim titali dali, n ni lihi bo ba bɛ ni daa wurim kpe yɔɣu m-be luɣ shɛlikam zaa n-tiligi ba.
en: If a shepherd is with his sheep when they begin to wander away, he will go searching for them. In the same way I will search for my sheep. I will save them and bring them back from all the places where they were scattered on that dark and cloudy day.

dag: ka be yi tanti suɣa ni ŋumdi yi kparima ni yɛra, Yawɛ ni je ti maa zuɣu ka o daa yihi ti Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni o ti zaŋ ti niŋ Amɔrinim ŋɔ nuu ni ka bɛ ku ti.
en: You complained in your tents, saying things like, The LORD hates us! Thats why he brought us out of Egypt—to hand us over to the Amorites, to destroy us!.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka ti daa kpalim be vinvamli maa ni Bɛtipɛɔr tooni polo la.
en: After that, we stayed in the valley across from Beth-peor.

dag: Juda Naa Amazia Jɔash bia la daa niŋla yuun pinaanu Izraɛl Naa Jɛhɔahaz bia Naa Jɛhɔash kum nyaaŋa.
en: Fifteen years after Jehoash died.

dag: Na so ŋun pahi n-nyɛ Bashan Naa Ogi ŋun daa nyɛ Rɛfaimnim ni yino ŋun kpalim ka be Ashitarɔt mini Ɛdirɛi;.
en: the territory next to it. Then there was Bashans King Og. He was one of the last of the Rephaim. He lived in Ashtaroth and Edrei.

dag: Zɛbulɔn zuliya ni tuhi pinaayi, Yisifu zuliya ni tuhi pinaayi, Bɛnjamin zuliya ni mi tuhi pinaayi.
en: , from Zebulun, , from Joseph, and , from Benjamin.

dag: Naawuni n-daa neei ti Duuma kum ni, ka ni ti neei ti gba kum ni o yiko ni.
en: God has raised the Lord and will raise us through his power.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni chɛ ka di yi n-chaŋ ti kpe tayiɣ mini ŋun ŋmari ʒiri m-pɔri n yuli yinsi n-saɣim bɛ binshɛɣukam zaŋ tabili dari mini kuɣa. .
en: The Lord All-Powerful has said, I am sending this scroll into the house of everyone who is a robber or tells lies in my name, and it will remain there until every piece of wood and stone in that house crumbles.

dag: Bɛ jɛmdi ma la yoli, dama bɛ malila salinim zaligunima wuhiri niriba kaman Naawuni zaligunima n-nyɛ li la.
en: Their worship of me is empty since they teach instructions that are human words.

dag: Biɣivai daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tusaayi ni pihiyɔbunaayopɔin.
en: the descendants of Bigvai:.

dag: Ti ŋmanila zoomba bɛn chani baɣisiri dukpini ka tuuri wuntaŋ zuɣusaa kaman di nyɛla yuŋ la. Bɛn mali yaa sunsuuni, ti ŋmanila kpiimba.
en: and we grope about like blind people. We stumble at noon, as if it were night, as if we were in the dark world of the dead.

dag: O dari tɔhi n yaɣa zaa, ka n yɛla naai, ka darigi vuɣi n tahima kaman tia la.
en: He hits me on every side until I am worn out. He takes away my hope. It is like a tree pulled up by the roots.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ Izraɛlnima, wummiya n ni wuhiri ya zalikpan shɛŋa mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ŋɔ zaa, ka dol li din ni chɛ ka yi be, ka chaŋ ti ʒini tiŋgbɔn shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiri ya maa ni.
en: Israel, listen to these laws and teachings! If you obey them, you will live, and you will go in and take the land that the Lord is giving you. He is the God your ancestors worshiped.

dag: ka dihi bɛn kpiri kum bindir suma, ka kari bundaannim ni nuzaŋa bahi.
en: He filled the hungry with good things, but he sent the rich away with nothing.

dag: ka o yi ti zal o ni yɛn pirig o ni su shɛli ti ba dahin shɛli, o ka soli ni o niŋ o ni yuri paɣ so maa bidibiga kaman o bikpɛm sani, ka chɛ o ni bi yuri o paɣ so maa bia ŋun nyɛ kpɛm maa.
en: When the man divides his property among his children, he cannot give the rights of the firstborn to the son of his favorite wife.

dag: Ɛlipaal bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ɛba mini Misham ni Shɛmɛd ŋun daa me Ono mini Lɔd ni di tiŋkpansi la.
en: Elpaals family: Eber, Misham, Shemed, who built Ono and Lod with its towns.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Naawuni daa yɛli Nuhu min o bidibisi maa.
en: God said to Noah and his sons.

dag: ka hal malaikanim bɛn mali yaa mini kpiɔŋ gari karimba ʒirinim ŋɔ bi doli ʒiɛmbu soli fiɣisiri bɛn mali jilima maa ti Duuma sani.
en: The angels are much stronger and more powerful than these beings. But even the angels dont accuse them and say bad things about them to the Lord.

dag: Ŋunkam zaa ka n sanna ti wum n yɛligu ka dol li, n ni wuhi ya o ni ŋmani so.
en: Ill show what its like when someone comes to me, hears my words, and puts them into practice.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yɛli, Kpe ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu ti yɛn be, ka Izraɛlnim ni ti yɛn zaŋdi sara nyɔri buɣim bimbin shɛli zuɣu be kpe.
en: David said, The temple of the Lord God must be built right here at this threshing place. And the altar for offering sacrifices will also be here.

dag: Ka Jɛfita nin ni daa kul nya o bia maa, o dii darigimi cheeg omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu ka kuhi yɛli, Mbaye, m bia! A chɛ ka n suhu saɣim. A leei ŋun ti ma nandahima; dama m pun yaai n noli lo Yawɛ alikauli, ka ku tooi lan yi di nyaaŋa.
en: When he saw her, he tore his clothes in sorrow and said, Oh, my daughter! You are breaking my heart! Why must it be you that causes me pain? I have made a solemn promise to the Lord , and I cannot take it back.

dag: Ka neesim maa kul neeri zibisim ni, ka zibisim maa bi tooi nyaŋ li.
en: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not defeated it.

dag: Ka Abishai daa yɛli Dauda, Naawuni zaŋ a dim maa niŋ a nuu ni zuŋɔ; dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ chɛ ka n kul zaŋ kpani ŋɔ kuh o yim tabili tiŋa, m bi yɛn kuh o buyi.
en: Abishai whispered, This time God has let you get your hands on your enemy! I'll pin him to the ground with one thrust of his own spear.

dag: Bɛ daa kuhi bol a, ka a fa ba bahi; bɛ daa niŋ a naani ka bi di vi.
en: they cried out to you and they were saved; they trusted you and they werent ashamed.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa ni daa tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai nyaaŋa ka o labi alizanda ni nti ʒini Naawuni nudirigu polo.
en: After the Lord Jesus spoke to them, he was lifted up into heaven and sat down on the right side of God.

dag: Yi ni mali binshɛŋa kpariti yi dunoya nyɛla kuriti mini daanya. Yi dabisa ni yɛn be shɛm, lala ka yi yaa yɛn be.
en: Your gates will have locks made from iron and bronze. You will be strong all your life.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Paɣimiya Yawɛ yuli. Yinim bɛn nyɛ Yawɛ daba.
en: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORDs name! All you who serve the LORD, praise God!.

dag: Ka Naara daa dɔɣi Ahuzam mini Hɛfa ni Tɛmɛni ni Haahashitari; bɛna n-daa nyɛ Naara bidibisi.
en: Ashhur and Naarah were the parents of Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari.

dag: Ka kɔhigɔriba maa yɛl o, A suhu ni yi yuri binshɛŋa la zaa zoya ka chɛ a, ka a buni min a bin suma zaa zo ka chɛ a, ka a ku lan nya li yaha.
en: Babylon, the things your heart desired have all escaped from you. Every luxury and all your glory will be lost forever. You will never get them back.

dag: Ti Duuma, bɔ saha ka dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ti yɛn niŋ, ka shihir bɔ nti yɛn wuhi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa niŋbu saha? Ti bɔri ni a yɛl ti.
en: Tell us when this will be, they said, and tell us what will happen to show that the time has come for all these things to take place.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba zaa mini salo zaa daa bi lan ʒe yim hal ti yaɣi. Bɛ daa kul tumdila din chihiri kam kaman zuliya shɛb ni tumdi shɛm, ka ta Yawɛ ni pun mal o jɛmbu du kasi shɛli zali Jɛrusalɛm la daɣiri.
en: The people of Judah and even the priests who were their leaders became more unfaithful. They followed the disgusting example of the nations around them and made the Lord 's holy temple unfit for worship.

dag: M bɔhim din be a zaligunim puuni ka di wɔɣa, ni a zal li mi ni di kul be sahakam.
en: Long ago I learned from your laws that you had established them forever.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa kahigi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa wuhi anabi Habakuk m-bɔŋɔ.
en: The oracle that Habakkuk the prophet saw.

dag: Ka Zakius daa ti yiɣisi zani n-yɛli ti Duuma Yisa, N Duuma, n ni zaŋ n nɛma pirigili ti nandaamba, ka n yi daa dila so bini zalinsi, n ni lan labisi dilan bini lala siɣimsiɣim bunahi zuɣu ti o.
en: Zacchaeus stopped and said to the Lord, Look, Lord, I give half of my possessions to the poor. And if I have cheated anyone, I repay them four times as much.

dag: N ni yɛn yɛli shɛm ŋɔ pala din yi n Duuma sanna, amaa m barinyubo ŋɔ puuni n tɔɣisirimi kaman jɛrigu la.
en: Im not saying what Im saying because the Lord tells me to. Im saying it like Im a fool. Im putting my confidence in this business of bragging.

dag: Di pa shɛli bɛ ŋme n-dila nɛma, ka bɔri ni bɛ pir li tari taba; ka tɔbbia kam nya paɣisar yino bee bɛba ayi, ka Sisɛra nya chinchin suŋ, ka man gba nya nɛma maa ni yɛri zaɣ suma ayi ye.
en: They are only finding things to capture and divide, a woman or two for every soldier, rich cloth for Sisera, embroidered pieces for the neck of the queen.

dag: Dɛhi nɔri li mi sɔŋdi tiŋa, ka binnɛɔŋ kam ŋun gɔri mɔɣu ni diri li.
en: Now the vine is gobbled up by pigs from the forest and other wild animals.

dag: Farisiinim ni daa wum ni Yisa tɔɣisi luhi Sadusiinim maa, ka bɛ daa laɣim tab ka o sanna.
en: After Jesus had made the Sadducees look foolish, the Pharisees heard about it and got together.

dag: O daa ku na kara. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Our God defeated mighty kings. God's love never fails.

dag: Ka mɔɣ shɛli din pah ayi yuli booni Gihɔn. Dina n-nyɛ din zɔri gindi Itiɔpia tiŋgbɔŋ.
en: The second is the Gihon River that winds through Ethiopia.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi yurilim nyɛ yurilim maŋli. Di niŋ kamaata ni yi je din bie, ka gbibiya din viɛli kirikiri.
en: Love should be shown without pretending. Hate evil, and hold on to what is good.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ dunoli, ka so yi doli ma kpe, o ni tiligi. O ni doli ma kpɛri ka yira, ka nyari dihili.
en: I am the gate. All who come in through me will be saved. Through me they will come and go and find pasture.

dag: Babilɔn Naa Bɛlishaaza nam dibu yuun tuuli puuni ka man Daniɛl daa zahim zahindi n dooshee n-nya ʒii yuŋ, ka sabi zahindi maa ni nyɛ shɛm sɔŋ.
en: Daniel wrote: In the first year of King Belshazzar of Babylonia, I had some dreams and visions while I was asleep one night, and I wrote them down. The four winds were stirring up the mighty sea.

dag: Mbusim be bɛ zuɣu, dama bɛ birigi n sani. Bahiyoli n-doli ba, dama bɛ zaɣisi ma. N naan tiligi ba, amaa ka bɛ beni ŋmarila ʒiri pari ma.
en: Doom to them, for they have strayed from me; destruction will be their lot because they have rebelled against me. I would redeem them, but they speak lies against me.

dag: Amaa Musa daa yi chaŋ Yawɛ sani ni o min o ti tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, o piligirila sariga maa o ninni, naɣila o ti yina. Ka o daa yi yina ti yɛli Izraɛlnim Naawuni ni yɛl o shɛm.
en: Any time Moses went before the Lord to speak with him, Moses took off the covering. Then Moses would come out and tell the Israelites what the Lord commanded.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda daa tim ti yɛli Zadok mini Abiata bɛn daa nyɛ maligumaaniba la, Bɔhimiya Juda kpamba, Bɔzuɣu ka yinim nyɛ bɛn ti yɛn bahindi nyaaŋa naa zaŋ kulis o yiŋa, hal ka Izraɛlnim zaa yɛtɔɣa ti paai man naa?.
en: When the things that all the Israelites were saying reached the king, David sent a message to the priests Zadok and Abiathar: Say the following to the elders of Judah: Why should you be the last to bring the king back to his palace?.

dag: O ni ti labisi Izraɛlnim pam bɛ Duuma Naawuni sani yaha.
en: He will bring many Israelites back to the Lord their God.

dag: Dama Aram tinzuɣu nyɛla Damaskus, ka Rɛzin gba nyɛ Damaskus zuɣulana.
en: The chief of Aram is Damascus; the chief of Damascus is Rezin.

dag: Ka yi ninvuɣ yino kam karitimi doli ninvuɣ tuhili ka bɛ ŋmaligiri guura, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni tuhiri ba tiri ya kaman o ni daa pun lɔn ya alikauli shɛm la zuɣu.
en: Any one of you can make a thousand men run away, because the Lord your God is fighting for you, just as he promised.

dag: Nir yi zaɣisi zaligu dolibu, hal dilan wunsuhigu nyɛla din chihira.
en: Those who turn their ears from hearing Instruction— even their prayers will be detested.

dag: Hɛzɛkia ŋɔ n-daa nyɛ ŋun taɣi Gihɔn zuɣusaa polo kulibɔŋ la kom zali ka ŋmaligi li ka di zɔri chani Dauda tiŋ la wulinluhili polo. Hɛzɛkia daa di nasara o tuuni kam puuni.
en: Hezekiah was the one who blocked the upper outlet of the waters of the Gihon Spring, channeling them down to the west side of Davids City. Hezekiah succeeded in all that he did.

dag: Bɛnhadad min o natab bɛn daa ʒe o nyaaŋa la daa bela bɛ suɣa ni nyuri dam, ka bɛ zaŋ o ni daa yɛli shɛm maa na ti yɛli Bɛnhadad. Ka o daa yɛl o tɔbbihi ni bɛ malim shili n-chaŋ ti liri Samarianim maa, ka bɛ daa teei zani.
en: When Ben-hadad heard this message, he and the other kings were drinking in their tents. Ben-hadad said to his officers, Take your positions! So they took up their positions against the city.

dag: Ka Yisa daa wum lala maa ka yɛli, Bɛn mal alaafee bi bɔri dɔɣite naɣila bɛn biɛra.
en: When Jesus heard it, he said, Healthy people dont need a doctor, but sick people do.

dag: Ka nam ʒiishɛhi pisinaanahi gili nam ʒiishee maa, ka kpamba pisinaanahi ye binyɛr piɛla, ka pil salima zuɣupila n-ʒi nam ʒiishɛhi maa ni.
en: Twenty-four thrones, with twenty-four elders seated upon them, surrounded the throne. The elders were dressed in white clothing and had gold crowns on their heads.

dag: Nyamiya, n ni daa kari ba bahi tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni zaa ni sujee mini suhuyiɣisili pam la, n ni yihi ba nimaani n-zaŋ ba labisi kpe na nti chɛ ka bɛ ʒiya ni alaafee.
en: I will gather them from all the countries where I have scattered them in my fierce anger and rage. I will bring them back to this place to live securely.

dag: Bɛ ni daa lɔrigiri buŋ maa ka bɛn su o bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu ka yi lɔrigir o.
en: While they were untying the donkey, its owners asked, Why are you doing that.

dag: Ka Aduna yi ti kani, yin zaŋmiy o binyɛr shɛŋa din be kasi maa ti o bidibisi maa ka bɛ ye, ka yi booi kpam bahi bɛ zuɣuri ni, ka bɛ leei maligumaaniba.
en: After Aaron's death, his priestly clothes are to be handed down to each descendant who succeeds him as high priest, and these clothes must be worn during the seven-day ceremony of ordination.

dag: Binnɛma maa daa yi chana, kalima maa baɣi ba mi chana. Ka binnɛma maa daa yi wuɣi du zuɣusaa, kalima maa gba wuɣirimi du zuɣusaa.
en: The wheels always moved with the living beings. If the living beings went up into the air, the wheels went with them.

dag: ka zaŋ noombil nɛɔŋ la mini sida dari la ni mi ʒee la ni taaŋkɔro la ni noombil nɛɔŋ maa zaa tim bɛ ni kɔrigi noombil so kɔzɔrim kom ni la ʒim ni.
en: He must take the other bird that is still alive and the piece of cedar wood, the piece of red cloth, and the hyssop plant and dip them in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water.
