dag: Ka Nan bia Jɔshua ŋun daa nyɛ Musa sɔŋda ni o ninvuɣ gahinda ni yino la daa yɛli, N dan Musa, karim ba.
en: Joshua son of Nun said to Moses, Moses, sir, you must stop them.

dag: Ŋuna n-yihiri teeku bulli puuni zibisim, ka chɛ ka neesim neeri zibisim titali ni.
en: discloses deep secrets of darkness, makes utter darkness enter the light.

dag: Zaŋmiya yimaŋ ti taba yi ni luri Masia sizuura la zuɣu.
en: and submit to each other out of respect for Christ.

dag: M bia Timoti, n zaŋ niriba zuɣu ni kpahibu yɛla ŋɔ niŋ a nuu ni. Di nyɛla anabitali yɛtɔɣa ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ a polo. Chɛ ka di yɛtɔɣa maa leeg a bidibbina ka a zaŋ li tuhi tuhiri suŋ.
en: Timothy, my child, Im giving you these instructions based on the prophecies that were once made about you. So if you follow them, you can wage a good war.

dag: Maligumaana ni ti zaŋ alahichi sanyoo sara maligu maa binʒim shɛli n-vie Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dunɔpaɣira mini sara maligu bimbini naŋgbaŋkuɣila bunahi zuɣu ni dundombila dunɔdali dunɔpaɣira la.
en: The priest will take some of the blood from the sin offering and put it on the doorposts of the Temple and on the four corners of the ledge of the altar and on the posts of the gate to the inner courtyard.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yi kul chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam o dirila nasara; dama Yawɛ daa be o sani.
en: The Lord helped David, and he and his soldiers always won their battles.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa kpe m-pali Pita ka o yɛli ba, Yinim bɛn nyɛ zuɣulaannim mini kpamba ŋɔ.
en: Peter, full of the Holy Spirit, answered them, Leaders of the people and elders:.

dag: Dinzuɣu, Yaa Izraɛl Naawuni, chɛ ka a ni daa yɛl a dabili m ba Dauda yɛtɔɣ shɛli maa niŋ yɛlimaŋli.
en: Please keep this promise you made to your servant David.

dag: Dinzuɣu vuhim nyabu ni na kul ʒiɛya gul shɛb ni bɛ vuhi, hal ka bɛn daa tuui wum lahibal suŋ la daa bi paai vuhim shee Naawuni sani bɛ ni daa bi niŋ yɛda la zuɣu.
en: Therefore, its left open for some to enter it, and the ones who had the good news preached to them before didnt enter because of disobedience.

dag: O yi kana ti gbaag a kpɛhi duu, ka kar a saria, ŋuni n-leei ni tooi ŋme o naŋgbankpeeni?.
en: If God passes by, imprisons someone, and calls a trial, who can stop him?.

dag: ka di nyɛ o min o zuliya maligumaanitali alikauli ʒiɛmani kam ni, dama o zab nyuli ti o Naawuni ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim nya alahichi chɛ m-paŋ. .
en: This is the agreement: He and all of his family who live after him will always be priests, because he had strong feelings for his God. And he did what was needed to make the Israelites pure.

dag: Di nyɛla vi ni nir tɔɣisi niriba ni niŋdi binshɛŋa ashilɔni yɛla.
en: It is really too shameful even to talk about the things they do in secret.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yɛli Reechɛl ni o nyɛla o ba dɔɣim, ka nyɛ Ribɛka bia. Ka Reechɛl daa guui kuli ti yɛl o ba.
en: He told her that he was the son of her aunt Rebekah, and she ran and told her father about him.

dag: Ka ti ni shɛb mi yi Kriit mini Areebia na, amaa ka ti ti wumdi ka bɛ tɔɣisiri Naawuni daalahiziba tumtumsa yɛla timaŋmaŋ ya yɛligu ni.
en: Crete, and Arabia. Some of us were born Jews, and others of us have chosen to be Jews. Yet we all hear them using our own languages to tell the wonderful things God has done.

dag: Yɛlim Aduna min o bidibisi la, alahichi sanyoo sara maligu zaligu m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ ni kɔriti biŋkɔb shɛba bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maani sara Yawɛ tooni luɣ shɛl la, nimaani ka bɛ yɛn kɔriti alahichi sanyoo sara maligu biŋkɔbiri. Di nyɛla din be kasi zaa.
en: to give Aaron and his sons the following regulations for sin offerings. The animal for a sin offering shall be killed on the north side of the altar, where the animals for the burnt offerings are killed. This is a very holy offering.

dag: ka yihiri wain na ka di tiri ninsalinim suhupiɛlli, ka yihiri olivi tihi kpam na ka di chɛ ka ninsalinim ninni nyɛlisira, ka chɛ ka ninsalinim nyari bindirigu diri ka di tiri ba kpiɔŋ.
en: wine to cheer us up, olive oil for our skin, and grain for our health.

dag: N wuh a yɛm, ka wuh a so shɛŋa din tuhi.
en: I teach you the path of wisdom. I lead you in straight courses.

dag: Kaman man ni nya shɛm, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kɔri zaɣ biɛɣu puu, ka biriti yɛlimuɣisira, dina ka bɛ ti yɛn chɛra.
en: In my experience, only those who plant seeds of evil harvest trouble.

dag: Yi ni daa bi kpuɣi li tuuli la zuɣu n-daa chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ daa yiɣisi o suhu bahi ti zuɣu n-darigi ti tibili la, dama ti daa bi niŋ li kaman di ni simdi ni ti niŋ li shɛm.
en: Because you were not there to carry it the first time, the Lord our God punished us for not worshiping him as we should have done.

dag: Sidɔnnim mini Arivadnim n-daa nyɛ a kpatoonsi. Ka Zɛmɛr yɛnnim nyɛ a ŋariŋ duhiriba.
en: The princes of Sidon and Arvad were your oarsmen. Your own wise men were in you as your helmsmen.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yaakubu daa tum tuma yuma ayopɔin Reechɛl zuɣu, amaa ka di daa ŋmanila dabisa biɛla o sani, o ni daa yuri Reechɛl maa zuɣu.
en: Jacob worked seven years for Laban, but the time seemed like only a few days, because he loved Rachel so much.

dag: Yi yi ti kpe yil shɛli, yin puhimiya ba puhiri suŋ.
en: When you enter that home, say, Peace be with you.

dag: Ka Bɔaz daa ti neei kaman yuntisuɣu saha n-lɛbig omaŋ tuug o ka di gar o, o ni nya ka paɣ do o naba tiŋli maa zuɣu.
en: During the middle of the night, the man shuddered and turned over—and there was a woman lying at his feet.

dag: Ka ŋun daa ʒi sagbani zuɣu maa zaŋ o gɔrigu maa n-tim dunia ni chɛ li.
en: The one on the cloud swung his sickle and harvested the crops.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛli, Bɔ ka ti lee lan bɔri shɛhiranim ni ti niŋ yaha? Timaŋmaŋ wum li o nol ni.
en: They replied, Why do we need more witnesses? He said it himself.

dag: Ka Ɛzra ŋun daa lan nyɛ maligumaana la daa zaŋ li ka niriba maa sanna kaman bɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm maa. Bɛ daa nyɛla dɔbba mini paɣiba ni bɛnkam ni tooi wum ka baŋ di gbinni. Di daa nyɛla gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin dahin yini dali.
en: So Ezra brought it to the place where the people had gathered—men, women, and the children who were old enough to understand.

dag: Dama Yawɛ daa pun yɛli ni bɛ ni kpi mɔɣu maa ni. Bɛ ni so daa bi kpalim, naɣila Jɛfune bia Kalɛb mini Nan bia Jɔshua kɔŋko.
en: The LORD had said to them, They will die in the desert. Not one of them remained, except Caleb, Jephunnehs son, and Joshua, Nuns son.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yawɛ malaika maa yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, a suhu ni yiɣisi bahi Jɛrusalɛm mini Juda tinsi zuɣu yuun pisopɔin m-bɔŋɔ pumpɔŋɔ. Ka bɔ saha ka a lee yɛn zo ba nambɔɣu.
en: At this, the angel said, Lord All-Powerful, for years you have been angry with Jerusalem and the towns of Judah. When are you ever going to have mercy on them.

dag: Jɛrimia daa yɛliya, Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: The Lord told me.

dag: Ka din gari di zaa nyɛla, zaŋmiya yɛda niŋbu leei bintaɣirisi din ni chɛ ka yi tooi tiligi Sintani piɛma din noya ni mali buɣim la nyɔɣibu.
en: And also use the shield of faith with which you can stop all the burning arrows that come from the Evil One.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli naa Ninvuɣ so ŋun daa ku ti ka lo ni o kpihim ti birili Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa maa.
en: They answered, Saul wanted to destroy us and leave none of us alive anywhere in Israel.

dag: Amaa ya polo ka nir lee yɛn bɔ n-nya yɛm? Ka luɣ dini ka baŋsim be?.
en: But wisdom, where can it be found; where is the place of understanding?.

dag: ka a dihi nam n-zaŋ ba leei maligumaaniba ni bɛ jɛmdi ti Duuma Naawuni, ka ni ti diri nam dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: You have made them a kingdom of priests to serve our God, and they shall rule on earth.

dag: Nir yi zɔri o taba dabiɛm, di nyɛla zana, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋ Yawɛ naani ni yi yɛla ni.
en: Fear can be a trap, but if you trust in the Lord , you will be safe.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm niŋ pali ti bebu puuni; dama ti nyɛla bɛn bi lan doli ti ninsalitali biɛhigu yubu, amaa ka naɣ dolila Naawuni Shia Kasi ni wuhiri ti shɛm.
en: He did this so that the righteous requirement of the Law might be fulfilled in us. Now the way we live is based on the Spirit, not based on selfishness.

dag: Amaa o yidana yi wum pɔri maa yɛla ka bi yɛl o shɛli dabisili din paya dali, dindina di wuhiya ni o saɣ o ni po pɔ shɛŋa min o ni lo alikauli shɛŋa zaa ni o niŋ shɛli maa, o ni daa wum di yɛla saha shɛli ka bi yɛl o shɛli maa zuɣu.
en: If her husband hears about a promise and says nothing about it for a whole day, she must do what she said—since he did not object, the promise must be kept.

dag: A ni ti yɛn diri bindir shɛli tibisim ti yɛn nyɛla giram kɔbisiyi ni pihita dahin yini kam. A ni ti diri li la bɛ ni zal a ni a di li saha shɛli.
en: You will be allowed eight ounces of bread a day, and it will have to last until the next day.

dag: Di nyɛla kaman n ni pun yɛli nyin Firawuna shɛm la, Naawuni n-kahig o ni yɛn niŋ shɛli wuh a.
en: God has shown you what will happen soon. He will make these things happen just as I told you.

dag: Anabinim yɛtɔɣa kul nyɛla pɔhim, dama yɛligu maa ka bɛ ni. Lala ka di ti yɛn niŋ ba.
en: The prophets are only empty wind. The word of God is not in them. Bad things will happen to them.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ bɛ ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb la pali zoya zuɣu, ka chɛ ka bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbiri ku ninvuɣ shɛb la ti lu a daboya zuɣu min a vinvama ni ni a kɔsoya ni.
en: I will cover the mountains with corpses, and the bodies of those who are killed in battle will cover the hills and valleys.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk bɔhi Ibrahimma, A ni woligi piɛsah ayopɔin shɛb zali bɛ ko maa mi gbinni lee nyɛla wula.
en: So Abimelech said to Abraham, What are these seven lambs youve set apart.

dag: N ni zaŋ o leei m bituuli, ka o gari dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa.
en: And I will make him my firstborn son. He will be the great king on earth.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni yuri so, dilan zuɣu ni ka o kpahira kaman doo ni kpahir o ni yur o bidib so zuɣu ni shɛm la.
en: The Lord corrects those he loves, as parents correct a child of whom they are proud.

dag: Yawɛ, a nudirigu mali yiko ni jilima. Yawɛ, a nudirigu ka a zaŋ dari tɔh a dim bahi.
en: Lord , your right hand is amazingly strong. With your right hand, Lord , you broke the enemy to pieces.

dag: Mushi bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Mahili mini Ɛda ni Jɛrimɔt. Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-daa nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya maa n-doli bɛ yaannim dunoya ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: Mushis sons were Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These are the leaders of the Levite families. They are listed by their families.

dag: Ka Yisa daa teeg o nuu tir o nyaandoliba maa ka yɛli, M ma mini n tizɔbihi m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Then he pointed to his disciples and said, Look! Here are my mother and my brothers!.

dag: Yi ni tooi ŋub ba yi tinsi ni, bɛn be nyam mini bɛn bi be nyam zaa yi ni tooi ŋub ba kaman yi ni kul ŋubiri kparibuhi mini wolisi shɛm la.
en: You can butcher it where you live, and eat it just like the meat of a deer or gazelle that you kill while hunting. Even those people who are unclean and unfit for worship can have some.

dag: Dama n zaŋ n nuu tiri zuɣusaa, ka po pɔri ni mani ŋun be sahakam ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: I raise my hand toward heaven and make this promise. As surely as I live forever, these things will happen!.

dag: Mbaye n niriba, pumpɔŋɔ teemiya Mɔab Naa Balak ni daa lo shɛm la yɛla, ka teei Bɛɔr bia Balaam ni daa garigi yɛl o shɛm la yɛla. Lan teemiya yi ni daa yi Shitim chani Giligal ka binshɛŋa niŋ ni di chɛ ka yi baŋ Yawɛ tiliginsim tuma yɛla la.
en: My people, remember what Moabs King Balak had planned, and how Balaam, Beors son, answered him! Remember everything from Shittim to Gilgal, that you might learn to recognize the righteous acts of the LORD.

dag: Yiliyiiniba m-be tooni, ka biŋkumdiŋmɛriba doli nyaaŋa, ka paɣisara be bɛ sunsuuni n-chaɣisiri sayɛya.
en: Singers come first, and then the musicians, surrounded by young women playing tambourines.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ dali ka bɛ mali shili, dama dali man Yawɛ ni yi Sinai Zoli maa zuɣu siɣina niriba maa zaa ninni.
en: and be ready the day after tomorrow. On that day I will come down on Mount Sinai, where all the people can see me.

dag: Ka bɛn kpalim daa zo nti kpe Afɛk, ka tiŋ maa gooni daa lu bɛ zuɣu n-ku bɛ ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaayopɔin bɛn kpalim. Ka Bɛnhadad gba daa zo nti kpe tiŋ maa ni sɔɣi.
en: Those who were left fled to Aphek, into the city where a wall fell on twenty-seven thousand more of them. But Ben-hadad escaped and hid in an inner room within the city.

dag: So yi zaŋ o yili ti Yawɛ ka di leei zaɣ kasi, maligumaana n-ni zali di daa ni nyɛ shɛm, maligumaana maa ni zali di daa ka di doli di ni viɛl shɛm bee di ni bi viɛl shɛm, ka maligumaana maa ni zali di daa shɛm, lala n-yɛn nyɛ li.
en: If you promise a house to me, a priest will set the price, whatever the condition of the house.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun mali yɛm kul bɔhindila baŋsim pahira, ka yɛnnim tiba kul bɔri ni di wumdi baŋsim yɛtɔɣa.
en: Intelligent people are always eager and ready to learn.

dag: Bɛ ʒii nyabu nyɛla ʒiri, ka bɛ daanabitali yɛtɔɣa nyɛ ʒiri. Bɛ yɛra, Yawɛ yɛliya. Ka di mi pala Yawɛ n-tim ba. Amaa ka bɛ bɔri ni bɛ yɛligu maa niŋ pali.
en: Their visions are false, and their predictions are lies. They claim that they are speaking my message, but I have not sent them. Yet they expect their words to come true!.

dag: Bɛla bidibisi daa nyɛla: Adda mini Gɛra ni Abihud.
en: The descendants of Bela were Addar, Gera, Abihud.

dag: N naan zaŋ n yɛtɔɣa maa sɔŋ o tooni ka ti tɔɣisi di yɛla.
en: I would state my case before him and present all the arguments in my favor.

dag: Di saha hal ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali suhukpeeni kaman gbuɣinli la suhuri ni fuŋ dabiɛm zuɣu, dama Izraɛlnim zaa mi ni a ba mali kpiɔŋ. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa be o sani maa nyɛla bɛn mali suhukpeeni.
en: Then even the bravest men, as fearless as lions, will be afraid because everyone in Israel knows that your father is a great soldier and that his men are hard fighters.

dag: Ka o daa gbahi buɣa maa maligumaaniba bɛn daa be nimaani zaa n-ku ba pa bimbina zuɣu, ka daa nyo ninsalinim kɔba buɣim bimbina maa zuɣu. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa ŋmaligi lab Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Josiah killed all the priests of the high places that were in Samaria. He killed the priests on those altars and burned mens bones on the altars so that they could never be used again. Then he went back to Jerusalem.

dag: Ka di sabi yɛli, Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka doo ŋmaligir o ba min o ma sani n-zaŋd omaŋ tabind o paɣa, ka bɛ niriba ayi maa be kaman ninvuɣ yino la.
en: And God said, Because of this a man should leave his father and mother and be joined together with his wife, and the two will be one flesh .

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrusalɛmnim shɛb daa bɔhi, Pa doo ŋɔ ka bɛ bɔri ni bɛ ku la?.
en: Some of the people from Jerusalem were saying, Isn't this the man they want to kill?.

dag: Izraɛlnim chandi maa zaa puuni, sagbani maa daa yi ti vuui ka chɛ Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa, bɛ yiɣisirimi chaŋ.
en: When the cloud rose from the Holy Tent, the Israelites would begin to travel.

dag: Gbibi bɛ ni wuh a shɛli viɛnyɛliŋga, ka miri ka a chɛ ka di faai. Guli yɛm, dama ŋuna n-nyɛ a nyɛvili.
en: Always remember this teaching. Dont forget it. It is the key to life, so guard it well.

dag: Ka o binyɛrigu mi paligi paratɛte kaman gol la; ka chib shɛli ka dunia ŋɔ ni din ni tooi paɣ li ka di piɛl lala.
en: His clothes became shining white—whiter than anyone on earth could make them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan niŋ wain maa ti bɛ ba ka o nyu dindali maa yuŋ; ka biasani maa gba daa kpe ka o min o ba ti dɔni, ka o ba bi mi o ni dɔni o sani saha shɛli ni o ni yiɣisi saha shɛli.
en: So that night the two girls got their father drunk with wine. Then the younger daughter went and had sexual relations with him. Again, Lot did not know when she came to bed or when she got up.

dag: ni tanvoya binyɛra ni tan piɛl viɛlli binyɛra ni bantabisi ni sarisi.
en: the mirrors, linen dresses, turbans, and long shawls.

dag: Ka Asha zuliya niriba daa bi kari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Ako bee bɛn be Sidɔn bee bɛn be Ahilab bee bɛn be Akizib bee bɛn be Hɛliba bee bɛn be Afik bee bɛn be Rɛhɔb.
en: The tribe of Asher didnt drive out the people living in Acco, Sidon, Ahlab, Achzib, Helbah, Aphik, or Rehob.

dag: Amaa n ku vuui n yurilim maŋli la ka chɛ o bee n-yi n ʒiɛyimtali nyaaŋa.
en: But even then I wont withdraw my loyal love from him. I wont betray my faithfulness.

dag: Ka di ti pa Aduna gbɛɣu zuɣu, ka di chɛ ka Aduna ti deei taali shɛli din ni be Izraɛlnim ni zaŋ bɛ pin kasi shɛŋa zaa na ni bɛ ti mali sara kasi maa ni ʒi. Di simdi ka di kul pa o gbɛɣu zuɣu sahakam din ni chɛ ka Yawɛ niŋ ba nirilim.
en: Aaron will wear this on his head. In this way he will remove the guilt if anything is wrong with the gifts that the Israelites give to God. Aaron will always wear this on his head so that the Lord will accept the gifts of the people.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiri ni Naawuni daa be Masia ni n-zaŋdi dunianim naari ŋun Naawuni maŋmaŋa, ka bi lan niŋdi bɛ daalahichi laasabu, ka zaŋ niriba naai ŋun Naawuni yɛla niŋ ti nuu ni.
en: What we mean is that God was in Christ, offering peace and forgiveness to the people of this world. And he has given us the work of sharing his message about peace.

dag: N ni ti a alizanda nam saafɛbihi, ka a yi ti lo yɛl shɛlikam dunia ŋɔ ni, dina n-ni zani alizanda ni; ka a yi ti lɔrigi yɛl shɛlikam dunia ŋɔ ni, di mi ni ti lɔrigi alizanda ni gba.
en: Ill give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven. Anything you fasten on earth will be fastened in heaven. Anything you loosen on earth will be loosened in heaven.

dag: Yaakubu bidibisi, Laɣimmiya na ti wum. Wummiya yi ba Izraɛl ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm.
en: Assemble yourselves and listen, sons of Jacob; listen to Israel your father.

dag: M bia, gbibi n yɛligu, ka chɛ ka n ni zal a shɛm be a suhu ni.
en: My son, pay close attention and don't forget what I tell you to do.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: Then the Lord told me.

dag: Leeban daa malila bipuɣins ayi; ŋun daa nyɛ kpɛm yuli n-daa booni Liya, ka biasani mi yuli daa booni Reechɛl.
en: Now Laban had two daughters. The older was Leah and the younger was Rachel.

dag: Anabi Musa n-daa nyɛ ŋun daa lan yɛli Izraɛlnima, Naawuni ni ti pii so yi mabihi ni n-chɛ ka o niŋ anabi kaman o ni daa pii ma shɛm la.
en: This is the Moses who told the Israelites, God will raise up for you a prophet like me from your own people. .

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Dindali maa n ni kabi naɣikɔra dapua o nyiŋgoli zuɣu bahi, ka kabisi o bandi maa, ka tinzunnim ku lan zaŋ o leei bɛ dabili.
en: At that time, says the Lord All-Powerful, I will break the yoke from the necks of the people of Israel and Judah, and I will break the ropes holding you. People from foreign countries will never again force my people to be slaves.

dag: Yurilim zuɣu ka bɛmbɔŋɔnim bɛn niŋdi lala maa, dama bɛ mi ni Naawuni zaŋ lahibal suŋ ŋɔ zuɣu zabbu tuma ti ma.
en: They are motivated by love, because they know that Im put here to give a defense of the gospel.

dag: Amaa man yɛri ya mi, di kul pɔnya gba. Di pɔ alizanda, dama di nyɛla Naawuni nam ʒiishee.
en: But I say to you that you must not pledge at all. You must not pledge by heaven, because its Gods throne.

dag: Ka o daa boli bia maa yuli Ikabɔd ka yɛli, Naawuni jilima yi Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni! Bɛ ni daa fa Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka la min o yidan ba ni o yidan ni daa kpi zuɣu.
en: She named the boy Ichabod, saying, The glory has left Israel, referring to the capture of Gods chest and the death of her father-in-law and her husband.

dag: Ka Musa daa saɣi m-be bɛ sani, ka o daa zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga Zipɔra ti Musa.
en: Moses was happy to stay with that man. Reuel let Moses marry his daughter, Zipporah.

dag: Bɛ daa ku Hamɔr min o bia Shɛkɛm gba, ka zaŋ Daina Shɛkɛm yiŋa n-chaŋ bɛ chandi.
en: Dinahs brothers, Simeon and Levi, killed Hamor and his son Shechem. Then they took Dinah out of Shechems house and left.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, n na ʒi n-zaɣisi nandaamba sɔŋbu, bɛ yi ti be muɣisigu ni n-kuhiri bɔri sɔŋsim.
en: Why do you attack a ruined man, one who can do nothing but beg for pity?.

dag: Ka Zikiri ŋun daa nyɛ Ifriim zuliya ni tɔbutuhiri biiŋa la daa ku nabia Maasɛya mini Azirikam ŋun daa nyɛ nayili sapashin kpɛm la ni Ɛlikana ŋun daa nyɛ kpambal kpɛma m-pa naa zuɣu la.
en: During that battle, an Israelite soldier named Zichri killed three men from Judah: Maaseiah the king's son; Azrikam, the official in charge of the palace; and Elkanah, the king's second in command.

dag: Yi yi bi nya saɣisigu kaman o bihi zaa, dindina di wuhiri ni yi pala o bihi alali, amaa yi nyɛla kaman dagɔr bihi.
en: So, if you never receive the discipline that every child must have, you are not true children and dont really belong to God.

dag: Di zaɣisi zaɣ viɛlli niŋ ti di ni simdi ni a niŋ li ti ninvuɣ shɛba, a yi mali yiko din ni niŋ li.
en: Dont withhold good from someone who deserves it, when it is in your power to do so.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yiɣisi nimaani kul o ya, ka o nyaandoliba daa dol o.
en: Jesus left and went back to his hometown. His followers went with him.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla o daalibarika zuɣu ka o pii ba, dindina di pala bɛ ni tum shɛli zuɣu. Ka di yi nyɛla bɛ ni tum shɛli zuɣu, dindina alibarika maa naan ku lan nyɛla alibarika yaha.
en: His choice is based on his grace, not on what they have done. For if God's choice were based on what people do, then his grace would not be real grace.

dag: ni gali sabilifaa ni gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛl viɛlli ni buhi kɔbiri.
en: blue, purple, and red wool; fine linen; goat hair;.

dag: Man Daniɛl kɔŋko n-daa nya ʒii maa. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be n sani bɛn daa bi nya li, amaa ka dabiɛm lee gbahi ba pam ka bɛ zo nti sɔɣi.
en: I, Daniel, was the only one who saw the vision. The men with me didnt see the vision, but they were still afraid. They were so afraid that they ran away and hid.

dag: bɛ yi ti baŋ bɛ ni tum alahichi shɛli maa saha shɛli, bɛ laɣiŋgu maa bɛn zaŋmi naɣila polli mali alahichi sanyoo sara maligu. Di simdi ka bɛ zaŋ o ka Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa gbini na.
en: Once you realize what has happened, you must sacrifice a young bull to ask my forgiveness. Lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent.

dag: Ka Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa daa wum di yɛla, ka boli tiŋgbani maa yuli Akɛlidama.
en: And all the people of Jerusalem learned about this. That is why they named that field Akeldama, which in their language means field of blood.

dag: Ka doo maa bɔh o, A yuli? Ka o yɛl o, N yuli Yaakubu.
en: What is your name? the man asked. Jacob, he answered.

dag: lala nti yɛn nyɛ Daadam Bia gba yi ti labina yi palo.
en: That is how it will be on the day the Son of Man is revealed.

dag: Hal n ni kul wurim ba kpɛhi tinzun tinsi ni la zaa yoli, bɛ ni be katinsi maa ha ka teeri n yɛla. Bɛ mini bɛ bihi ni tiligi, ka ni ti laɣim tab labina.
en: Though I have scattered them among the nations, yet in far-off places they will remember me. They and their children will survive and return home together.

dag: Mɔdɛkai daa yi kul chanimi nti be luɣ shɛli din miri napaɣiba yili maa dundɔŋ dabisili kam. O daa chanimi gindi ni o baŋ Ɛsta nimaani benibu yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm ni din yɛn niŋ o.
en: He was anxious to see how Esther was getting along and to learn what had happened to her. So each day he would walk back and forth in front of the court where the women lived.

dag: Ribɛka daa mali tizɔdoo ka o yuli booni Leeban. Ka Leeban daa guui yi n-chaŋ nachin kpɛm maa sani kɔbiliga maa gbini.
en: Rebekah had a brother named Laban, and Laban ran to the man outside by the spring.

dag: Bɛ ni ti dirila bɛ ni zaŋ chi mini kawaan shɛŋa na ti mali sara shɛli ni alahichi sanyoo sara binyara ni taali sanyoo sara binyara. Ka bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛli zaa ti Yawɛ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni nyɛla bɛ dini.
en: The grain offerings, the sin offerings, and the repayment offerings will be the priests' food, and they are to receive everything in Israel that is set apart for me.

dag: Ka Juda daa yɛl o ba Izraɛl, Chɛ ka bia maa doli ma ka ti yiɣisi chaŋ, ka di chɛ ka ti mini ya ni ti bihi ŋɔ ku kpi.
en: Then Judah said to his father Israel, Let Benjamin go with me. I will take care of him. We have to go to Egypt to get food. If we dont go, we will all die—including our children.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa yɛl o yiŋnim mini bɛnkam zaa daa be o sani, Yihimiya tinzun tiŋ wuna din be yi sani bahi, ka mali yimaŋa, ka taɣi binyɛra ye.
en: Jacob said to his household and to everyone who was with him, Get rid of the foreign gods you have with you. Clean yourselves and change your clothes.

dag: Bɛ ni daa di bindirigu ka nyu n-naai Shilo maa nyaaŋa, ka Hanna suhu daa saɣim pam ka o yiɣisi chaŋ Yawɛ tooni ti suh o, ka kum pam. Di saha Ɛli ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana la daa ʒila kuɣ zuɣu Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni tab dunoli.
en: One time, after eating and drinking in Shiloh, Hannah got up and presented herself before the LORD.

dag: Ka banim ka o daa po n-yɛli ni bɛ ku nya vuhim o san la? Pa bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn daa niŋ tipawumlinim la?.
en: And who did God say would never enter his place of rest? Weren't they the ones that disobeyed him?.

dag: Ka Zua bia Nɛtanɛl nyɛ Isaka zuliya zuɣulana;.
en: Nethanel son of Zuar was in command of the tribe of Issachar.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka maligumaana maa zaŋ paɣ maa mirina ti zali Yawɛ tooni;.
en: The priest will take the woman before the Lord and make her stand there.

dag: Ŋunkam niŋ ma yɛda kaman Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli shɛm la, nyɛvili kom ni ti zɔri yir o suhu ni na kaman mɔɣa kom ni zɔri shɛm la.
en: If anyone believes in me, rivers of living water will flow out from their heart. That is what the Scriptures say.

dag: Ka taŋkpaɣu labi di ni daa yi shɛl na, ka shia mi labi Naawuni ŋun daa zaŋ li ti sani.
en: Your body came from the earth. And when you die, it will return to the earth. But your spirit came from God, and when you die, it will return to him.

dag: O daa lan bo naɣilabil yino mini piɛla yino ni yuun yini piɛlabil yino mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la.
en: one bull from the herd, one ram, and one year-old male lamb for an entirely burned offering.

dag: Dama shɛlini so mi n-zaŋ yɛm mini baŋsim ni tuumbaŋsim yɛm tum nya shɛli, ka ti chɛ li tila ŋun bi di di wahala ni o di di nyaɣisim. Dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din ka buchi ni zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: You work for something with all your wisdom, knowledge, and skill, and then you have to leave it all to someone who hasn't had to work for it. It is useless, and it isn't right!.

dag: Di saha ka Iso daa zaŋ o paɣiba min o bidibisi ni o bipuɣinsi ni o yiŋ niriba zaa ni o niɣi min o biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn pahi zaa ni o ni daa bo n-nya binshɛɣukam zaa Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni n-yiɣisi chaŋ ti ʒini tiŋgban shɛl ni ha ka chɛ o tizo Yaakubu.
en: Esau took his children and wives, his relatives and servants, his animals and possessions he had acquired while in Canaan, and moved far from Jacob.

dag: M mabiyurisi, zaŋmiya yi daadiini wuhibu din be kasi la kpaŋsiri yimaŋa, ka kul suhimiya Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni.
en: But you, my friends, keep on building yourselves up on your most sacred faith. Pray in the power of the Holy Spirit.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka naa daa zali ni bɛ malim adaka zali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu samban ni dunɔdali gbini.
en: Joash gave orders for a wooden box to be made and had it placed outside, near the gate of the temple.

dag: Ka o daa lan kpuɣi bɔrɔbɔro n-niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka ŋmahiŋmahi li n-zaŋ ti ba ka yɛli, N niŋgbuŋ m-bala; n niŋgbun shɛli n ni zaŋ pa talima yi zuɣu. Niŋmiya dimbɔŋɔ n-teemi n yɛla.
en: After taking the bread and giving thanks, he broke it and gave it to them, saying, This is my body, which is given for you. Do this in remembrance of me.

dag: Ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ tɛha maa ka bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi tɛhiri tɛhi biɛri yi suhuri ni?.
en: But Jesus knew what was in their minds, and he said, Why are you thinking such evil things?.

dag: Bɛnjamin ŋun nyɛ biasan la zuliya m-be tooni, ka Juda zuliya kpamba paya, ka Zɛbulɔn mini Naftali zuliya kpamba doli nyaaŋa.
en: There is the smallest tribe, Benjamin, leading them. And there comes a large group of leaders from Judah. Following them are the leaders of Zebulun and Naphtali.

dag: Naawuni ni ti lu tiŋ maa zuɣu m-me bindura tabili di gooni gili.
en: God will attack the city, surround it, and besiege it.

dag: di saha ka Judanim maa zaa daa yi bɛ ni woliwoli tab be luɣ shɛŋa ni n-labi Juda tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni Gɛdalia sani Mizipa nti tɔɣiri wain, ka pɔhiri tiwala pam.
en: So they left the places where they had been scattered and returned to the land, to Gedaliah at Mizpah. There they gathered large amounts of grapes and summer fruits.

dag: N vuhim shee m-bɔŋɔ sahakam; kpe ka n yɛn be, dama n yuri li.
en: This is my residence forever. I will live here because I wanted it for myself.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa ŋmaligi Dauda sani yi nti tim ni bɛ cham ti gɔŋ Abinɛr labisina. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti paag o Sira kɔbiliga gbini n-gɔŋ o labisina, amaa Dauda daa bi mi di yɛla.
en: After leaving David, Joab sent messengers to get Abner, and they brought him back from Sirah Well; but David knew nothing about it.

dag: Ahazia ma Atalia ni daa nya ka o bia lan kani maa, ka o bahi noli ni bɛ kum Juda nabihi zaa.
en: As soon as King Ahaziah's mother Athaliah learned of her son's murder, she gave orders for all the members of the royal family of Judah to be killed.

dag: Di saha ka Shɛkɛm gba daa yɛli Daina ba min o tizɔdɔbba maa, Yi yi saɣi ti ma, n ni tin ya yi ni kul yɛli ni yi bɔri shɛlikam.
en: Shechem added, Do this favor for me, and I'll give whatever you want.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yihimi Izraɛlnim bɛn kpalim la zaɣ yiha kaman bɛ ni yihiri wain tia wala yiha shɛm la, ka lan zaŋ a nuhi doli di wula kaman wain tiwalipɔhira la.
en: I will tell your enemies to leave your nation bare like a vine stripped of grapes. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken.

dag: N yuri Yawɛ, dama o wumdi n ni yɛri shɛm; ka deeri n suhigu shɛli n ni suhir o ni o zo ma nambɔɣu ŋɔ.
en: I love the Lord , because he hears me; he listens to my prayers.

dag: Ti nyari wahala binshɛɣukam zaa ni, amaa ti bi ŋma n-chɛrisichɛrisi; ti birinda, amaa ti suhuri bi saɣinda;.
en: We often suffer, but we are never crushed. Even when we don't know what to do, we never give up.

dag: Naa Hɛzɛkia ni daa wum yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, o daa darigi toola o binyɛrigu, ka zaŋ buɣu ye n-chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu.
en: As soon as King Hezekiah heard their report, he tore his clothes in grief, put on sackcloth, and went to the Temple of the Lord .

dag: Lɛvinim bɛn daa be tin kasi maa ni zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiyi ni pihiniinaanahi.
en: So there were Levites who moved into Jerusalem, the holy city.

dag: Yawɛ ni tiligi ma, ka ti zaŋ goonjɛnim ŋme m-paɣ o. Ti kul ni paɣir o o jɛmbu duu hal ni ti nyɛviya tariga.
en: You, Lord , will save me, and every day that we live we will sing in your temple to the music of stringed instruments.

dag: Manaasa zuliya niriba m-bala: Bɛ ni daa sab bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb yuya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihinunaayi ni kɔbisiyopɔin.
en: These are all the family groups from the tribe of Manasseh. The total number of men was .

dag: N yi teei dahin shɛli ha yɛla, n suhu saɣindimi. Dina n-nyɛ: m mini salo ni daa yi doli chani Naawuni jɛmbu duu, ka mani n-nyɛ bɛ toondan la. Bɛ mi daa yi nyɛla salo bɛn mali suhupiɛlli yiini yila, ka duhiri bɛ yɛhi m-paɣiri Naawuni.
en: My heart breaks when I remember the past, when I went with the crowds to the house of God and led them as they walked along, a happy crowd, singing and shouting praise to God.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa ti nya doo maa Naawuni jɛmbu duu yɛl o, Nyama, a kpaŋya zaa! Di lan tum alahichi din ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu din gari din la ti paag a yaha.
en: Later, Jesus found the man at the Temple and said to him, See, you are well now. But stop sinning or something worse may happen to you.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, Mani n-nyɛ soli maa, mani n-nyɛ yɛlimaŋli, mani n-lan nyɛ nyɛvili; ka so ku tooi chaŋ m Ba sani, ka pa ni o paala mani.
en: Jesus answered him, I am the way, the truth, and the life; no one goes to the Father except by me.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisahaku biŋkɔbiguliba maa daa lan gbi kɔbil shɛli, ka bɛ daa lan niŋ ba naŋgbankpeeni di zuɣu; dinzuɣu ka Yisahaku daa boli kɔbiliga maa yuli dimdi kɔbiliga.
en: They dug another well and argued about it too, so he named it Sitnah.

dag: Amaa chɛliya ka binshɛɣukam zaa lee niŋdi dɛde ka doli soli.
en: But do everything properly and in order.

dag: Dama Sulemaana daa ŋmaligi dolila Sidɔnnim buɣili Asitati din nyɛ paɣ la mini Ammɔnnim buɣili Milikom din nyɛ daɣiri la.
en: Solomon followed Astarte the goddess of the Sidonians, and Milcom the detestable god of the Ammonites.

dag: ni Ahio ni Shashak ni Jɛrɛmɔt.
en: Beriahs sons were Shashak and Jeremoth.

dag: Ŋuna n-kahigiri yɛl shɛŋa din baŋbu to min ashili yɛla wuhiri niriba; o mi din sɔɣi bumbɔn ni, neesim mi n-gil omaŋmaŋa.
en: He reveals things that are deep and secret; he knows what is hidden in darkness, and he himself is surrounded by light.

dag: Nyama, a du m-bala Ijiptinima bɛ mi nyɛla kaɣili jaaŋgbe kabili din ni kuhi ŋun dihiri li nuu. Lala ka Ijipti naa Firawuna be zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn du m-ba o polo. .
en: Is he depending on Egypt and its king? That's the same as leaning on a broken stick, and it will go right through his hand.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Di bi simdi ni nir zaŋ bihi bindirigu ti bahi.
en: Jesus replied, It isn't right to take food away from children and feed it to dogs.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali nandahima mal alibarika, dama Naawuni ni ti maai bɛ suhuri.
en: Great blessings belong to those who are sad now. God will comfort them.

dag: Di simdi ka a ti mal li ka di be kasi zaa, ka binshɛlikam din ti shihi li ni niŋ kasi.
en: You will make all these things holy. They will be very special to the Lord. Anything that touches these things will also become holy.

dag: Malaika yi di be bɛ sani, ŋun nyɛ sandaantimda, ka nyɛ malaikanim tuhili ni yino, n-wuhi ni daadam nyɛla ŋun bebu tuhi.
en: But maybe one of Gods thousands of angels is watching over them, to speak for them and tell about the good things they have done.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa mini Aduna ni bɛ chɛ ka bɛ niŋ shɛm maa.
en: All the Israelites obeyed and did what the Lord had commanded Moses and Aaron.

dag: Lala ka di daa kul be, sagbani maa daa kul pil li mi wuntaŋ ni, ka be kaman buɣim la yuŋ.
en: It was always there. The cloud covered it by day, appearing with lightning at night.

dag: Ka Zilipa daa lan dɔɣi bidibiga ti Yaakubu pahi.
en: Leahs servant Zilpah gave birth to a second son for Jacob.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, m bɔri ni a mali duu zali ma, dama m mali tahima ni Naawuni ni deeg a suhigu, ka labisi ma ti a.
en: Please get a room ready for me. I hope your prayers will be answered, and I can visit you.

dag: Jɛhɔram daa mali tizɔbihi bɛn nyɛ Jɛhɔshafat bidibisi, bɛna n-daa nyɛ: Azaria mini Jɛhiɛl ni Zakaria ni Azaria ni Maikil ni Shɛfatia. Bɛmbɔŋɔ zaa daa nyɛla Jɛhɔshafat ŋun daa nyɛ Juda naa maa bidibisi.
en: Jehorams brothers were Azariah, Jehiel, Zechariah, Azariah, Michael, and Shephatiah. They were the sons of King Jehoshaphat of Judah.

dag: N yi ti wurim ba kpɛhi zuliya shɛb ni mini tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni, bɛ ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Then they will know that I am the Lord . They will know that I scattered them among the nations. They will know that I forced them to go to other countries.

dag: Ka suhusaɣiŋgu zuɣu daa chɛ ka Naa Bɛlishaaza ninni biɛhigu maan taɣi pahi, ka o kpambaliba bi lan mi bɛ ni yɛn gbaai shɛm.
en: At that point King Belshazzar was really frightened. All the color drained from his face, and his princes were also very worried.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Naawuni zuɣu ka ti be kum barina ni asiba hal nti paai yuŋ; bɛ lihi ti mi kaman piɛ shɛb bɛ ni kɔrita.
en: As the Scriptures say, For you we are in danger of death all the time. People think we are worth no more than sheep to be killed. Psalm :.

dag: Ka Yawɛ chɛ ka o kukoli be o tɔbbihi tooni tahira. Dama o tɔbbihi galisiya pam, ka bɛn deer o noli ka kalinli. Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ dabisili nyɛla dabisili titali ka mali dabiɛm pam. Ka ŋuni n-lee ni ti tooi zaŋ o nyɔɣu yo li?.
en: The Lord God leads this army of countless troops, and they obey his commands. The day of his judgment is so terrible that no one can stand it.

dag: O ni ti yihi biŋkɔb yino yi biŋkɔbiri pia kam puuni ka yi ti leeg o daba.
en: He will also take a tenth of your sheep and goats. You will become the king's slaves.

dag: amaa ka bɛn daa mali yɛm la bɛn daa ʒi kpam pahi bɛ firilanim zuɣu.
en: while the wise ones took containers full of oil for their lamps.

dag: Yawɛ, wuhim ti a yurilim maŋli la, ka ti ti a tiliginsim.
en: Show us your love and save us!.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa chaŋ Sool sani, ka Sool ti yɛl o, Yawɛ niŋmi alibarika niŋ a ni, n niŋ Yawɛ ni zali ma ni n niŋ shɛlikam zaa la.
en: Samuel finally caught up with Saul, and Saul told him, I hope the Lord will bless you! I have done what the Lord told me.

dag: Ka lan bɔh o, Filip, a bi niŋ yɛda ni m be m Ba maa ni ka m Ba maa gba be n ni? Yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa n ni tɔɣisiri ya maa, m bi tɔɣisiri li la mmaŋmaŋ yiko ni; amaa m Ba ŋun be n ni maa n tumdi o tuma maa.
en: Do you not believe, Philip, that I am in the Father and the Father is in me? The words that I have spoken to you, Jesus said to his disciples, do not come from me. The Father, who remains in me, does his own work.

dag: Yawɛ dunoli m-bɔŋɔ; wuntizɔriba kɔŋko n-ni tooi dol li kpe.
en: Here is the gate of the Lord ! Everyone who does right may enter this gate.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ni yɛn zaŋ binshɛŋa lo daantalisi din gili dundɔŋ maa zaa ti nyɛla anzinfa ka di bansi ti nyɛ anzinfa, ka di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu ti nyɛ daanya.
en: All the posts around the courtyard must be joined with silver curtain rods. The hooks on the posts must be made from silver, and the bases for the posts must be bronze.

dag: Chɛ ka wuntizɔra kpahi n zuɣu ni, ka chɛ ka ŋun ʒe yim saɣisi ma. Di chɛ ka m bo jilima ninvuɣ biɛɣu sani, dama n kul galindila bɛ tuumbiɛri maa n wunsuhigu puuni.
en: If good people correct me, I will consider it a good thing. If they criticize me, I will accept it like a warm welcome. But my prayer will always be against the wicked and the evil they do.

dag: A ni daa bi doli wuntia soli n-niŋ daabiligu, ka tum alahichi pam zuɣu daa chɛ ka a saɣim a jɛmbu duri. Dinzuɣu ka buɣim yi a ni na n-di a zaa; ka n daa chɛ ka a leei tampiligim do tiŋa bɛn zaa daa nya a ninni.
en: You have cheated so many other merchants that your places of worship are corrupt. So I set your city on fire and burned it down. Now everyone sees only ashes where your city once stood.

dag: Zuliya kam buɣa nyɛla anzinfa mini salima, ninsalinim ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali binshɛŋa.
en: Idols of silver and gold are made and worshiped in other nations.

dag: Yisa ni daa deei baptaizibu naai ka puhiri yiri kom maa ni na, di saha ka zuɣusaa daa bɔɣi, ka o nya ka Naawuni Shia Kasi yi zuɣusaa na kaman ŋmani la nti tam o zuɣu.
en: So Jesus was baptized. As soon as he came up out of the water, the sky opened, and he saw Gods Spirit coming down on him like a dove.

dag: Dindali maa ka Ibrahimma min o bia Ishimail daa guni.
en: Abraham and his son were circumcised on the same day.

dag: Salima pipihi din diba ayi kam daa bi ŋman taba ka bɛ daa mali nyuri binnyura. Ka naa maa daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ omaŋmaŋ ni nyuri wain shɛli pam ti niriba maa.
en: The guests drank from gold cups, and each cup had a different design. The king was generous.

dag: Dinzuɣu man yuya ni pakoya bɛn nyɛ paɣisara la kuli dɔbba dɔɣi bihi n-ʒi bɛ yinsi gbib ba, ka di chɛ ka ti dimnim ku nya soli n-yɛli ti din bie;.
en: I would prefer that young widows get married, have children, and look after their families. Then the enemy won't have any reason to say insulting things about us.

dag: O ni daa ti yina, o daa kɔŋla yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu, ka bɛ baŋ ni o nya ʒii Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, dama o daa kul malila o nuhi buɣisira, ka ku lan tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa yaha.
en: When he did come out, he could not speak, and they knew he had seen a vision. He motioned to them with his hands, but did not say a thing.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa wuhi ba zahindi ni ni bɛ di lan lab Naa Hɛrɔd sani; ka bɛ daa taɣi so shɛli kuli bɛ ya.
en: Then they returned to their country by another road, since God had warned them in a dream not to go back to Herod.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Bɛtilihɛm din be Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la; dama anab so daa sab yɛli:.
en: They said, In Bethlehem of Judea, for this is what the prophet wrote.

dag: Amaa ka Mikaya daa yɛl o, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, man Naawuni maa ni kul yɛli ni n yɛli shɛli, dina ka n yɛn yɛli.
en: But Micaiah answered, As surely as the Lord lives, I can say only what my God says.

dag: Amaa o yi yɛli ma, N nini bi lan tiɣ a. Nyama, mani m-bɔŋɔ, O niŋmi ma kaman o ni nya ka shɛli viɛl o sani.
en: But if he says he is not pleased with me, let him do whatever he wants to me.

dag: Yisifu daa bol o bidib kpɛm yul la Manaasa dama o daa yɛlimi, Naawuni chɛ ka n tam n wahala la zaa mini n dɔɣiriba yɛla.
en: Joseph named the first son Manasseh. He was given this name because Joseph said, God made me forget all my hard work and everything back home in my fathers house.

dag: Nyama, n Duuma NAAWUNI daa wuhi ma, ka n nya ka o namla toli ka bɛ galisi pam, bɛ ni daa chɛ nayili wɔrimɔri, ka mɔri maa lan piligi puhirina saha shɛli.
en: This is what the LORD God showed me: The LORD God was forming locusts at the time the late grass began to sprout.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n shiri ni ti zaŋ Shia Kasi niŋ n dab bidibisi mini n dab bipuɣinsi ni, ka bɛ ti tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: Yes, even on my servants, both men and women, I will pour out my Spirit in those days, and they will proclaim my message.

dag: Dama bɛ nyɛla n tumtumdiba, n ni daa yihi shɛb Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na; di bi simdi ka yi kɔhi ba kaman daba la.
en: You must do this because these people are my servants—I brought them out of Egypts land. They must not be sold as slaves.

dag: Ti wum dinkam beni. Yɛlli maa naabu m-bɔŋɔ: Zom Naawuni, ka dol o zaligunima; di ni simdi ni sokam niŋ shɛm m-bala.
en: After all this, there is only one thing to say: Have reverence for God, and obey his commands, because this is all that we were created for.

dag: Jɔram ni daa ti nya Jɛhu, o daa bɔh o mi, Jɛhu, alaafee? Ka Jɛhu garigi bɔh o, Wula ka alaafee lee yɛn niŋ beni, ka a ma Jɛzibɛl sotali min o buɣijɛmbo tuma la na kul beni pam.
en: When Joram saw Jehu, he said, Do you come in peace, Jehu? He said, How can there be peace as long as the immoralities of your mother Jezebel and her many acts of sorcery continue.

dag: Jɛrigu yɛtɔɣa tahirila zabili na, ka jɛrigu noli ni yɛtɔɣa lan bɔri buri tir o.
en: Fools say things to start arguments. They are just asking for a beating.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛl o, N yi yu ni o kul kpalim beni hal ka n ti labina, di lee nya a ya? Nyin dee doli ma.
en: Jesus answered, What is it to you, if I want him to live until I return? You must follow me.

dag: Dama alahichi nya soli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa ni n-yɔhim ma ku ma di zuɣu.
en: Sin used this command to trick me, and because of it I died.

dag: Ka Ribɛka min o dab bipuɣinsi daa yiɣisi m-ba laakumnima n-doli nachin kpɛm maa ka o zaŋ o lu yiŋ soli.
en: Afterwards, Rebekah and the young women who were to travel with her prepared to leave. Then they got on camels and left with Abraham's servant and his men.

dag: Nyini n-su teeku din kul damdi pampam ŋɔ yiko; di kɔgbana yi ti yiɣisi, nyini n-chɛri ka di maari dooni baalim.
en: You rule over the powerful sea; you calm its angry waves.

dag: Yaakubu daa zo n-kuli Mɛsopoteemia, nimaani ka o daa tum tuma paɣ zuɣu; o daa gulila biŋkɔbiri ni di yo o paɣ kpuɣibu samli.
en: Jacob fled to the land of Aram; there Israel served for a wife, and for a wife he kept watch over livestock.

dag: Ka malaika maa yɛli ma, Sabimi dimbɔŋɔ sɔŋ: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛ ni boli ni bɛ ka Piɛbil maa amiliya lɔbu chuɣu bindirigu dibu ni na mal alibarika! Ka lan yɛli ma, Dimbɔŋɔnim shiri nyɛla Naawuni yɛligu maŋli.
en: Then the angel told me, Put this in writing. God will bless everyone who is invited to the wedding feast of the Lamb. The angel also said, These things God has said are true.

dag: Ka chɛrubinim maa daa teei bɛ kpiŋkpama pɔbi Alikauli Adaka maa zaashee maa, ka di daa chɛ ka bɛ kpiŋkpama pɔbi Alikauli Adaka mini di dapuhi.
en: Their outstretched wings covered the Box and the poles it was carried by.

dag: Bɛ daa kpuɣi bɛ bipuɣinsi niŋ bɛ paɣiba, ka zaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ bipuɣinsi ti bɛ bidibisi; ka jɛmdi bɛ wuna.
en: They intermarried with them and worshiped their gods.

dag: Bɛ ni gbib a bɛ nuhi ni ka a napɔŋ ku tuui kuɣili.
en: They will carry you with their own hands so you dont bruise your foot on a stone.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa zaŋ gabisi maa vo Jɛrimia kɔbiliga maa ni yihina. Ka Jɛrimia daa kpalim be yiliguliba dundɔŋ maa ni.
en: and they pulled me up out of the well. After that I was kept in the courtyard.

dag: ni o ti kari sokam zaa saria, ka nya bɛnkam zaa bi luri Naawuni sizuura la taali, ka di nyɛla bɛ ni tumdi tuun biɛ shɛŋa mini bɛna bɛn nyɛ alahichinim maa ni tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ biɛ shɛŋa dalim ŋun Naawuni la zuɣu.
en: to execute judgment on everyone and to convict everyone about every ungodly deed they have committed in their ungodliness as well as all the harsh things that sinful ungodly people have said against him.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yisa chaŋ. Ka Yisa daa ʒi omaŋmaŋ dapulli maa hal ti paai luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Goligɔta Hiburuli ni la. Di gbinni nyɛla Zuɣuŋmaŋ Shee.
en: He carried his own cross to a place called The Place of the Skull.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yiɣisi chaŋ ti ʒini Ijipti maa hal ka o mini ti yaannim maa zaa daa ti kpi nimaani.
en: So Jacob went down to Egypt, where he and our ancestors died.

dag: Pita noli daa na bi lu tiŋa ka sagban piɛlli dii sirigina ti lim ba, ka bɛ wum ka kukol shɛli yɛri sagbani maa ni, M Biyurigu m-bɔŋɔ; n nin ni tiɣi so pam m-bala; wummiy o noli.
en: While Peter was still speaking, the shadow of a bright cloud passed over them. From the cloud a voice said, This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him. Listen to what he says.

dag: Di saha ka Stiivin daa yɛli, Nyamiya, n nya ka zuɣusaa bɔɣi, ka Daadam Bia la ʒe Naawuni nudirigu polo.
en: Then Stephen said, I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right side of God.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, sokam ŋmanila shilinshia. Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ ni niŋdi shɛlikam nyɛla yoli. Bɛ laɣindila bɛ nyamma sɔŋda, ka bi mi ŋun ti yɛn di li.
en: no more than a shadow. All we do is for nothing; we gather wealth, but don't know who will get it.

dag: Kalim bɛn zaa nyɛ yuun pihita zaŋ ti paai yuun pihinu ka bɛ zaa nyɛ bɛn ni tooi tum tuma Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili la puuni.
en: Count all the men who are from to years old who come to serve. These men will have the job of caring for the Meeting Tent.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa zuɣu, chɛliya ka ti kul zaŋdi wumpaɣibo kaman sara la paɣiri Naawuni, dina n-nyɛ ti yaai ti noya kahigi wuhi ni ti tibigir o yuli.
en: So lets continually offer up a sacrifice of praise through him, which is the fruit from our lips that confess his name.

dag: ka yuri ʒiishe viɛla ni ʒinibu bɛ jɛmbu duri ni, ka yuri jilima ʒiishɛhi ʒinibu bɛ churi puhibu ni.
en: They like the front seats in the synagogues and the best seats at banquets.

dag: Ka a ti baɣisi di shɛli ka di niŋ zim balli, ka a zaŋ di shɛli ti zali Alikauli Adaka shɛli din be Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili puuni luɣ shɛli n ni yɛn kahigiri mmaŋ wuhir a la gbini. Di simdi ka di ti nyɛla din be kasi zaa a sani.
en: Beat part of it into a fine powder, take it into the Tent of my presence, and sprinkle it in front of the Covenant Box. Treat this incense as completely holy.

dag: ka Dauda yiɣisi zaŋ o tɔbbihi pa omaŋ zuɣu chaŋ ti ku Filistianim kɔbisiyi, ka ŋmahi bɛ yokol gbana n-zaŋ di zaa ti ti naa din ni chɛ ka o leei naa deemba. Ka Sool daa zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga Mikal ti o ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: David and his men left and killed Philistines. David brought back the proof that Saul had demanded and showed it to him, so he could marry Michal. Saul agreed to let David marry Michal.

dag: Dama n daa bi dee li la ninsal sani; pa so mi n-daa zaŋ li wuhi ma, amaa di yila Yisa Masia ŋun daa kahigi li wuhi ma la sanna.
en: I didnt receive it or learn it from a human. It came through a revelation from Jesus Christ.

dag: ka a dihi nam n-zaŋ ba leei maligumaaniba ni bɛ jɛmdi ti Duuma Naawuni, ka ni ti diri nam dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: You made them a kingdom and priests to our God, and they will rule on earth.

dag: N dan Tiɔfilus, litaafi shɛli n ni daa tuui sab la wuhirila Yisa ni daa piligi wuhiri niriba ka tumdi shɛm.
en: Dear Theophilus: In my first book I wrote about all the things that Jesus did and taught from the time he began his work.

dag: Nyini n-shiri nyɛ n tampiŋ mini m birini; a yuli zuɣu, be n tooni, ka wuhiri ma.
en: You are definitely my rock and my fortress. Guide me and lead me for the sake of your good name!.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛl o, Di bi simdi ni nir zaŋ bihi bindirigu ti bahi, shee bihi dimi tiɣi pɔi.
en: But Jesus said, The children must first be fed! It isn't right to take away their food and feed it to dogs.

dag: N wum ka a ba yɛr a biɛli Iso.
en: she said to Jacob, I have just heard your father say to Esau.

dag: Ka Midiannim maa daa zaŋ Yisifu chaŋ Ijipti nti kɔhi Pɔtifa ŋun daa nyɛ tɔbbi shɛb bɛn guli Firawuna la sapashin kpɛm zuɣu.
en: The Midianite traders later sold Joseph in Egypt. They sold him to Potiphar, an officer of the king of Egypt and the captain of his palace guards.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu Naawuni ni daa ti buɣisi ti yab Ibrahimma saha shɛl la, o daa zaŋ Yisahaku mali sara ŋun Naawuni sani. Ti yab Ibrahimma ni daa nyɛ Naawuni ni lo so alikaulinim la zaa yoli, o daa saɣiya n-zaŋ o bi gaŋ Yisahaku mali sara Naawuni sani.
en: Abraham had been promised that Isaac, his only son, would continue his family. But when Abraham was tested, he had faith and was willing to sacrifice Isaac.

dag: Ka Hanna daa yɛli Chɛ ka mani ŋun nyɛ a dabipaɣ ŋɔ nya zuɣusuŋ a sani. Di saha ka Hanna daa kuli ti di ka nyu, ka daa bi lan mali suhugarigu.
en: Sir, thank you for being so kind to me, Hannah said. Then she left, and after eating something, she felt much better.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa tim a ka yɛl a, Cham ti ku Amalɛknim bɛn nyɛ alahichinim ŋɔ, ka tuhi kpihim bɛ birili zaa.
en: When the Lord sent you on this mission, he told you to wipe out those worthless Amalekites.

dag: ka tiŋgbani maa zaa leei chilibi mini yalim, ka binshɛli ku biri nimaani ka binshɛli mi ku bili nimaani, luɣ shɛli mɔri ni ku bili. Di ni ti saɣim kaman Sɔdom mini Gomɔra ni Adima mini Zɛbɔiim, Yawɛ ni daa saɣim shɛli o suhuyiɣisili puuni la.
en: Look at all its land burned by sulfur and salt, unsuitable for planting, unable to grow or produce any vegetation, as devastated as Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboiim, which the LORD devastated in anger and wrath!.

dag: Nir yi zɔri Yawɛ, o nyɛla ŋun je zaɣ biɛɣu. N je karimbaani mini maŋduhibu ni zaɣ biɛɣu ni ʒiŋmabo yɛtɔɣa.
en: To fear the LORD is to hate evil. I hate pride and arrogance, the path of evil and corrupt speech.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa yi lo tɔbu ni bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi bɛ dimnim saha shɛlikam, Yawɛ paarila o nuu bɛ zuɣu bɛ daalahichi tumbu zuɣu kaman o ni daa pun kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni ka po n-yɛli ba shɛm la. Ka nandahima daa mali ba pam.
en: Every time they would go into battle, the Lord was against them, just as he had said he would be. They were in great distress.

dag: Di maan kahigi yɛla ŋɔ wuhi ni maligumaani so ni ti yiɣisi ŋmani Mɛlikizɛdɛk.
en: And its even clearer if another priest appears who is like Melchizedek.

dag: Amaa m mini n niriba ŋɔ mi lee nyɛ banima, ka ni tooi zaŋ pina ŋɔ ti a ti suhu yubu puuni? Dama binshɛɣukam zaa yila a sanna, a ni su shɛli ka ti lan zaŋ ti a maa.
en: All these things didnt come from me and my people. All these things come from you. We are only giving back to you things that came from you.

dag: Ka Jɛrimia yɛli, Di ku niŋ lala. Nyin dee kul deemila Yawɛ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa n ni zaŋ yɛr a ŋɔ, ka di niŋ viɛnyɛla a sani, ka bɛ ku ku a.
en: I said, If you will just obey the Lord , the Babylonians won't hand you over to those Jews. You will be allowed to live, and all will go well for you.

dag: Ka saamba di yi buni, ka yi tuma nyɔri kuli tinzun nir yiŋa;.
en: Otherwise, strangers will sap your strength, and your hard work will end up in a foreigners house.

dag: Gomna Fɛstus min o kpamba ni daa niŋ tab saawara naai ka o yɛli Pool, A yɛliya ni a ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣa maa chaŋla Naa Siiza sani. Dindina Naa Siiza sani ka a shiri ni bahi chaŋ.
en: Festus talked about this with his advisors. Then he said, You have asked to see Caesar, so you will go to Caesar.

dag: Dinzuɣu di bemi kaman Naawuni Shia Kasi ni yɛli shɛm la: Yi yi wum Naawuni kukoli zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: So then, as the Holy Spirit says, If you hear God's voice today.

dag: M paɣiri Naawuni o ni bi zaɣisi n suhigu maa zuɣu, bee o ni bi vuui o yurilim maŋli ka chɛ ma la zuɣu.
en: Praise God! He did not turn away from me—he listened to my prayer. He continues to show his love to me!.

dag: Yinim sowuhiriba bɛn nyɛ zoomba ŋɔ, yi nyɛla bɛn lɔŋdi nanviɣu, amaa ka lee vaani laakum.
en: You guide the people, but you are blind! Think about a man picking a little fly out of his drink and then swallowing a camel! You are like that.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba maa daa fiɣis o pam;.
en: The chief priests were accusing him of many things.

dag: M mini ya n-yi be Naawuni jɛmbu duu dabisili kam ka n wuhiri ya, ka yi bi gbaai ma. Amaa dimbɔŋɔ niŋmi ni Naawuni Kundi yɛligu la niŋ pali.
en: Every day I was with you teaching in the Temple area. You did not arrest me there. But all these things have happened to show the full meaning of what the Scriptures said.

dag: Amaa niŋmi Barizillai ŋun nyɛ Giliad nir la bihi nirilim, ka zaŋ ba pah a mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn laɣindi diri zuɣu. Dama bɛ daa niŋ ma nirilim saha shɛli a biɛli Absalom ni daa kariti doli ma ka n zɔri la.
en: As for Barzillais sons from Gilead, show them kindness. Let them eat with you. When I was running away from your brother Absalom, they came to me.

dag: kaman yuun kɔbisinahi ni pihinu. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa ti ba zuɣulaannima m-mali hal ti paai Anabi Samuɛl saha.
en: All this happened in about years. Then God gave our people judges until the time of the prophet Samuel.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka sapashinnim maa mini bɛ tɔbbihi ni niriba bɛn zaa nyɛ tarimba ni wɔɣira daa yiɣisi kuli Ijipti, dama bɛ daa zɔrila Babilɔnnima.
en: Then all the Israelites, rich and poor alike, together with the army officers, left and went to Egypt, because they were afraid of the Babylonians.

dag: Saha shɛli Yaakubu ni daa nya o ŋahiba Leeban bipuɣiŋga Reechɛl mini ŋun Leeban piɛri maa, o daa chaŋmi ti paai kuɣili maa kɔbiliga maa noli ka ŋɔŋ kom ti o ŋahiba Leeban piɛri maa ka bɛ nyu.
en: When Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his uncle, and the flock of Laban, Jacob came up, rolled the stone from the wells opening, and watered the flock of his uncle Laban.

dag: Ka di daa ti lu Naa Hɛrɔd dɔɣim dabisili dali, ka o laɣis o kpamba min o sapashinnima ni Galili ninvuɣ zuɣuri zaa na ni bɛ ti puhi di chuɣu. Ka di daa niŋ Hɛrɔdias katari.
en: Then the right time came for Herodias to cause Johns death. It happened on Herods birthday. Herod gave a dinner party for the most important government leaders, the commanders of his army, and the most important people in Galilee.

dag: N ni tooi niŋ shɛlikam zaa Masia ni tiri ma yaa la zuɣu.
en: I can endure all these things through the power of the one who gives me strength.

dag: Ti ni daa mali ti yaɣi Kilikia mini Pamfilia teeku noya zuɣu, ti daa paala Maira din be Lisia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: Then we sailed south of Cilicia and Pamphylia until we came to the port of Myra in Lycia.

dag: Ka n ni yɛn ku wuntizɔriba mini ninvuɣ biɛri zaa bɛn be a ni maa zuɣu, n takɔbi ni yi di tɔɣu ni n-ku sokam bɛn be nudirigu polo mini nuzaa polo zaa.
en: I will cut off both good people and evil people from you. I will pull my sword from its sheath and use it against all people from south to north.

dag: ka Bɛnaaya mini Jahaziɛl bɛn daa nyɛ maligumaaniba la mi nyɛ bɛn yɛn piɛbiri kikahi m-be Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa tooni.
en: Benaiah and Jahaziel were the priests who always blew the trumpets before the Box of Gods Agreement.

dag: O yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaanu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pihitayinika. O ma daa nyɛla Jɛrusalɛm paɣa, ka o yuli booni Jɛhɔadin.
en: Amaziah was years old when he became king, and he ruled years from Jerusalem, which was also the hometown of his mother Jehoaddin.

dag: Vinnyaɣili chɛ ka fara gbaari nira, amaa ka tuma tumbu viɛnyɛliŋga mi chɛ ka nir leeri bundana.
en: Laziness leads to poverty; hard work makes you rich.

dag: Aduna yuma daa nyɛla yuun kɔbiga ni pisinaata saha shɛl o ni daa kpi Hɔr Zoli zuɣu maa.
en: Aaron was years old when he died on Mount Hor.

dag: dama di kɔŋko n-nyɛ o ni mali shɛli pinda, ka bɔ ka o ti yɛn zaŋ pili gbihi? O yi fabili niŋ ma, n ni wum o fabila maa, dama n nyɛla nambɔzɔra.
en: His clothing may well be his only blanket to cover himself. What else will that person have to sleep in? And if he cries out to me, Ill listen, because Im compassionate.

dag: Ka salo pam bɛn daa yi Galili mini Tinsi Pia tiŋgbana ni na mini bɛn yi Jɛrusalɛm ni Judia zaŋ tabili Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili dulinim zaa daa kabiri dol o.
en: Large crowds followed him from Galilee and the Ten Towns, from Jerusalem, Judea, and the land on the other side of the Jordan.

dag: ti yɛra, Doo ŋɔ wuhirila niriba ni bɛ doli Naawuni zaligu ni bi wuhi shɛm n-jɛmdi Naawuni.
en: This man, they said, is trying to persuade people to worship God in a way that is against the law.

dag: A bɔhiya, N wuntitali maa nyɔri lee nyɛ dini? Ka n ni bi tum alahichi maa, di nyɔri lee nyɛ ma dini.
en: because you also ask him, Whats the use of trying to please you? What good will it do me if I dont sin.

dag: Ka Siria Naa Hazaɛl daa ti kani, ka o bia Bɛnhadad di nam zan o zaani.
en: Arams King Hazael died. His son Ben-hadad succeeded him as king.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni bɛn tɛhi lala baŋ ni ti ni yɛri shɛm ti gbana puuni maa, lala ka ti ni niŋ ti yi ti be yi sani gba.
en: Those people had better understand that when I am with you, I will do exactly what I say in my letters.

dag: Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka o binyɛrigu ti mɔhi kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun nɔri wain tiwala binyɛrigu la?.
en: What are those red spots? Your clothes look stained from trampling on grapes.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, o shiri nyɛla n tizɔpaɣa. O nyɛla m ba bipuɣiŋga, amaa ka lee pa m ma puuni bia, ka n zaŋ o leei m paɣa.
en: She is my wife, but she is also my sister. She is the daughter of my father but not the daughter of my mother.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ be kaman giŋgalanyɔri ni yi chaŋ gari ka bɛ jolijoli doya shɛm la; ka chɛ ka bɛ be kaman bɛ ni zaŋ bi so bahi ka o nini bi nya wuntaŋ la.
en: May they be like snails that dissolve into slime; may they be like a baby born dead that never sees the light.

dag: Izraɛl zuliya nam be barina ni. Di tipum zuɣupiligu din mali jilima, ka pili bɛ zuɣulaannim bɛn yu nam pam zuɣuri ni la nyɛla din kpaara. Bɛ zuɣuri zaa nyola tulaale, amaa ka bɛ lee nyu wain buɣi do nimaani.
en: Oh, the majestic garland of Ephraims drunks and the fading flower of its splendid beauty on the head that flows with perfume of those hammered with wine.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl naa mini Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat daa chaŋ Ramɔtigiliad.
en: Ahab and Jehoshaphat led their armies to Ramoth in Gilead.

dag: Ka Jɔash bia Gidiɔn maa daa mali hal ti kurigi ka naanyi kpi, ka bɛ daa zaŋ o sɔɣ o ba Jɔash siliga ni Abiɛza daŋ niriba ya Ofira.
en: Gideon lived to be an old man. And when he died, he was buried in the family tomb in his hometown of Ophrah, which belonged to the Abiezer clan.

dag: Jɔsia yuma daa nyɛla yuma anii saha shɛl o ni daa di nam. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pihitaniyini.
en: Josiah was eight years old when he became king. He was king for years in Jerusalem.

dag: ka di chɛ ka yi ku mali taali, ka naɣ ni bela kasi, ka nyɛ Naawuni bihi bɛn be tibi m-be ʒiɛmaan biɛɣunim mini ʒiɛman golimanim sunsuuni ŋɔ. Di simdi ni yi be bɛ sunsuuni dunia ŋɔ ni n-ne kaman saŋmarisi ni ne shɛm la.
en: so that you will be blameless and pure, children of God without any fault. But you are living with evil people all around you, who have lost their sense of what is right. Among those people you shine like lights in a dark world.

dag: Bɛ daai nandaamba baɣili palli kpaŋa, ka nandaamba zaa zo n-sɔɣi.
en: thrust the poor out of the way, make the lands needy hide together.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ka Musa mini Aduna ni Izraɛlnim zaa sanna Kadɛshi Paran mɔɣu ni. Bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ chandi yɛtɔɣa n-yɛli bɛ mini niriba maa zaa, ka zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni tiwala wuhi ba.
en: The Israelites were camped near Kadesh, in the desert of Paran. The men went to Moses and Aaron and all the Israelites. They told Moses, Aaron, and all the people what they saw and showed them the fruit from the land.

dag: Yi ni yɛn niŋ shɛm ka Kɔhat daŋ niriba la ti miri binshɛŋa din nyɛ kasi la, ka ku kpi m-bɔŋɔ: Aduna min o bidibisi la kpɛm ti wuhi bɛ zaa yinoyino o tuma bee o ʒili ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: This is what you must do for them so that they stay alive and dont die when they approach the most holy things. Aaron and his sons will enter and assign each of them his work and his load.

dag: N yuya ni yi baŋ ni timaŋ buɣisibu pala din nyaŋ ti.
en: I hope you will discover we have not failed.

dag: Ka ŋun yɛli ni o be Naawuni ni, di niŋ kamaata ni o be kaman Masia ni daa be shɛm la.
en: If we say we are his, we must follow the example of Christ.

dag: Ka o daa vihi li. O daa daŋla bɛ kpɛm dini vihibu m-mali lala hal ti paai bɛ biasani dini; ka daa nya pipia maa Bɛnjamin kpalaŋa ni.
en: The servant started looking in the sacks. He started with the oldest brother and ended with the youngest. He found the cup in Benjamins sack.

dag: Bɛ daa tum bɛ Naawuni tuma mini binyɛra mali ka di be kasi tuma viɛnyɛliŋga. Ka yiliyiiniba mini dunɔguliba gba daa tum bɛ tuma kaman Dauda min o bia Sulemaana ni daa zali shɛm la.
en: when they performed the ceremonies to make people acceptable to worship God. And the singers and the temple guards did their jobs according to the instructions given by David and his son Solomon.

dag: Dinzuɣu nir yi nya biɛla diri ka mali suhudoo, di so ni o niŋ wahala nya pam. Di ŋmanila nir ŋun zɔri doli pɔhim.
en: Maybe so, but it is better to have only a little, with peace of mind, than be busy all the time with both hands, trying to catch the wind.

dag: Di saha ka nolɔɣu dii kum pahi buyi, ka Pita teei Yisa ni daa yɛl o ni nolɔɣu ti yɛn kum buyi o ni chihi siɣimsiɣim buta ni o bi mi ŋun Yisa la yɛla. Ka di daa niŋ Pita suhugarigu ka o kum pam.
en: At once the rooster crowed a second time. Then Peter remembered that Jesus had told him, Before a rooster crows twice, you will say three times that you don't know me. So Peter started crying.

dag: Ka Ibram mini Haga daa dɔni, ka o niŋ pua. Haga ni daa nya ka o mali puu maa, ka o lihi ʒiɛm Zarai ŋun daa su o maa.
en: Later, when Hagar knew she was going to have a baby, she became proud and treated Sarai hatefully.

dag: N ni tumdi Naawuni so tuma ni n suhu zaa o Bia lahibal suŋ tuma ni la di ma shɛhira ni n suhiri Naawuni tiri ya sahakam.
en: Every time I pray, I always remember you. God knows this is true. He is the one I serve with all my heart by telling people the Good News about his Son. I pray that I will be allowed to come to you. It will happen if God wants it.

dag: dama bɛ suhuyiɣisili dabisili paaya, ka ŋuni n-ni tooi zaŋ o nyɔɣu yo li.
en: That terrible day has come! God and the Lamb will show their anger, and who can face it.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, N Duuma, n niŋ yɛda! Ka dii gbaag o jɛmbu.
en: The man said, Lord, I believe. And he worshipped Jesus.

dag: Di saha ka Abishai ŋun daa nyɛ Zɛruya bia la daa yɛli naa Bɔ n-niŋ ka ba kpiŋ ŋɔ doli yɛri n dan naa zilima lala? Chɛ ka n chaŋ ti ŋma o zuɣu.
en: Abishai, whose mother was Zeruiah, said to the king, Your Majesty, why do you let this dog curse you? Let me go over there and cut off his head.

dag: Maligumaana bipuɣiŋga yi kuli do so ŋun pa maligumaana, ŋun miri ka o lan di sara maligu kasinim maa.
en: A priests daughter might marry a man who is not a priest. If she does that, she cannot eat any of the holy offerings.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa wum naa ni kari saria maa ŋ-ŋmaai li shɛm maa, ka bɛ daa lu naa maa sizuura, dama bɛ daa baŋya ni Naawuni yɛm be o ni, ka o ni kariti saria ka di doli zaligu soli.
en: The people of Israel respected the king when they heard about this decision. They saw he had the wisdom of God to make the right decisions.

dag: O ni daa baŋ ni tahima lan kani, o kɔŋla o bia maa, ka o daa lan piig o bi so wums o ka o niŋ yaa.
en: When she realized that she waited in vain, her hope faded. So she took another of her cubs and set him up as a strong young lion.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni zaŋ ya ti bahi tiŋgban shɛli din be Damaskus tooni ha. Man Yawɛ ŋun yuli nyɛ Binnamda zaa Naawuni la n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will force you to march as captives beyond Damascus. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, have spoken!.

dag: Gbuɣinli yi ŋum, ŋuni ka dabiɛm lee ku gbaai? Ti Duuma NAAWUNI yi zaŋ o yɛligu yɛli, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi zaɣisi ni o ku zaŋ li tɔɣisi niriba.
en: A lion has roared; who will not fear? The LORD God has spoken; who can but prophesy?.

dag: Siɣimsiɣim bushɛm ka o daa fa ba bahi, amaa ka bɛ daa yi o nyaaŋa, ka bɛ daalahichi daa chɛ ka bɛ nya filiŋ.
en: but you saved them time after time. They were determined to rebel, and their sins caused their downfall.

dag: Yawɛ chɛ ka zuliya balibu kam nianim kpalindi yoli; ka lan chɛ ka bɛ ni lo nia ni bɛ niŋ shɛm zaani soli.
en: The Lord frustrates the purposes of the nations; he keeps them from carrying out their plans.

dag: Ka zaŋ piɛlaa la mini bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi piɛɣu pal la m-mali biɛrisuŋ sara Yawɛ sani; ka maligumaana maa lan mali chi sara mini binnyura sara din pahi la.
en: Then he will sacrifice the ram and offer the wine, grain, and bread.

dag: Yaa ti Naawuni, pa nyini n-daa kari tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni niriba ka chɛ a niriba Izraɛlnima, ka zaŋ li ti a zo Ibrahimma zuliya sahakam la?.
en: Our God, you forced out the nations who lived in this land before your people Israel came here, and you gave it to the descendants of your friend Abraham forever.

dag: N nyɛla bɛn mali suhudoo ka ʒe yim Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni yino. Ka yi ti bɔri ni yi wurim tin shɛli din nyɛ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni tinsi ma? Bɔzuɣu ka a bɔri ni a saɣim Yawɛ ni su binshɛli.
en: I am one of many peaceful, loyal people in this town. You are trying to destroy an important city of Israel. Why do you want to destroy something that belongs to the Lord .

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa bol o nyaandoliba maa na ti yɛli, Chɛliya ka bihi kam n sanna, ka di karitiya ba, dama Naawuni nam nyɛla bɛ tatabo dini.
en: but Jesus called the children to him and said, Let the children come to me and do not stop them, because the Kingdom of God belongs to such as these.

dag: Duuma yino m-beni, amaa ka o tuma soya lee nyɛ balibubalibu.
en: There are different ways of serving, but the same Lord is served.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda tɔbbihi mini Jɔab daa yi ŋmɛnditoli yɔɣu paana ni nɛma pam. Amaa di saha maa Abinɛr daa lan ka Dauda sani Hiburɔn. Dauda daa pun chɛbis o mi ka o chaŋ ni suhudoo.
en: Later on Joab and David's other officials returned from a raid, bringing a large amount of loot with them. Abner, however, was no longer there at Hebron with David, because David had sent him away with a guarantee of safety.

dag: Di nyaaŋa di tintariga maa ni lan zaŋ hal ti paai Zifurɔn, ka di tariga ni nyɛla Hazarɛnan; yi nuzaa polo tintariga n-yɛn bala.
en: The border will go out to Ziphron. Its limit will be Hazar-enan. This will be your northern border.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, dabisili kanna ka n ni ti darigi Babilɔn binnana tibili. N ni ti dihi di tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa vi. Bɛ ni ti yɛn ku di ninvuɣ shɛb zaa ni ti lula di puuni.
en: And so the time is coming when I will deal with Babylonia's idols. The whole country will be put to shame, and all its people will be killed.

dag: Bɛ ŋmarila tab ʒiri; naŋgbammalisim mini tɛha ayiyi yɛtɔɣa ka bɛ tɔɣisira.
en: Everyone tells lies, and no one is sincere.

dag: Dinzuɣu so yi yɛn me n-tam di zuɣu, o yi zaŋla salima bee anzinfa bee kuɣ viɛla bee dari bee mɔri bee kaɣa me.
en: Whatever we build on this foundation will be tested by fire on the day of judgment. Then everyone will find out if we have used gold, silver, and precious stones, or wood, hay, and straw.

dag: Teemiya o ni tum tuun kar shɛŋa yɛla, ka teei o ni tum alahiziba tuun shɛŋa min o ni daa kari saria shɛm yɛla.
en: Remember his miracles and all his wonders and his fair decisions.

dag: Daadam Bia ni chaŋ kaman di ni ʒe o shɛm, amaa mbusim be ŋun yɛn yi o nyaaŋa maa zuɣu.
en: The Human Onegoes just as it has been determined. But how terrible it is for that person who betrays him.

dag: Ka Filistianim nanim maa daa bo tɔbimi pala zaɣ maha diba ayopɔin ti Dilaila na, ka o zaŋ li lo Samsin.
en: Then the rulers of the Philistines brought seven fresh, new bowstrings to Delilah, and she tied Samson with the bowstrings.

dag: Ka ti ni paɣ shɛb yɛl ti shɛli ka di gari ti pam: Asibaasi ŋɔ ka bɛ daŋ yibu chaŋ siliga maa gbini.
en: Some women in our group surprised us. They had gone to the tomb early in the morning.

dag: Yidaampaɣiba, zaŋmiya yimaŋ ti yi yidaannima kaman di ni simdi shɛm ti Duuma sani.
en: A wife must put her husband first. This is her duty as a follower of the Lord.

dag: ka zaŋ o bidibisi maa na nti zaŋ zabbanim yɛli ba;.
en: Bring his sons and put shirts on them;.

dag: Ka ti daa ti laɣim bakɔi piligu dali ni ti ŋmahi bɔrɔbɔro n-laɣim di Ti Duuma Bindirigu, ka Pool ni daa lɔri ni biɛɣu neei ka o chɛbisi ba ka chaŋ la zuɣu chɛ ka o daa tɔɣisi ba Naawuni soli yɛla hal ni yuntisuɣu.
en: On Saturday evening we gathered together for the fellowship meal. Paul spoke to the people and kept on speaking until midnight, since he was going to leave the next day.

dag: Niŋmiya bin zusanim niŋ yi ni yɛri situr shɛŋa naŋgbambiya anahi.
en: And when you make a coat, sew a tassel on each of the four corners.

dag: ka Abishua nyɛ Buki ba, ka Buki nyɛ Uzi ba.
en: Abishua was Bukkis father. Bukki was Uzzis father.

dag: Tuumba bɛn ʒe yim ŋmanila atam kpuɣibu saha sakuɣili din maai bɛ kpamba sani; bɛ chɛ ka bɛn tim ba suhuri maara.
en: Like the coolness of snow on a harvest day are reliable messengers to those who send them; they restore the life of their master.

dag: Amaa ka ŋariŋ maa zuɣu polo daa chaŋ ti firi bihigu ni ka di tarigi chandi, ka kɔgbana daa ŋmɛri di nyaaŋa polo hal ka di ti ŋma n-chɛrisichɛrisi.
en: But they struck a sandbar and the ship ran aground. The bow was stuck and wouldnt move, and the stern was broken into pieces by the force of the waves.

dag: Ŋuna n-fuɣiri maligumaaniba situra ka mali ba chana, ka luhiri wɔɣira.
en: leads priests away barefoot; overthrows the well-established.

dag: Yawɛ zɔbu puuni ka nir niŋdi naani din mali kpiɔŋ, ka o bihi nyari sɔɣisili shee.
en: Reverence for the Lord gives confidence and security to a man and his family.

dag: N ni wuhi ya Naawuni yiko ni nyɛ shɛm; n ku sɔɣi ya din be Kpiɔŋlan Naa sani.
en: I will teach you Gods power, not hide what pertains to the Almighty.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan yɛli Ibrahimma, Di simdi ni a min a zuliya maa gbibi n daalikauli maa bɛ ʒiɛmana zaa ni.
en: God said to Abraham, As for you, you must keep my covenant, you and your descendants in every generation.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ zaawuni, di nyaaŋa ka biɛɣu neei; ka di niŋ dabisili din pah anu.
en: Evening passed and morning came—that was the fifth day.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab daa kpe nayili maa nti yɛli naa, Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, a dihi a tɔbbihi bɛn zaa tilig a nyɛvili ka tilig a bidibisi min a bipuɣinsi ni a paɣiba ni a mamanim zaa nyɛviya ŋɔ vi.
en: Joab came to the king inside and said, Today you have humiliated all your servants who have saved your life today, not to mention the lives of your sons, your daughters, your wives, and your secondary wives.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ shɛhira maa zaa daa kul bi bahi doli taba.
en: Not even they, however, could make their stories agree.

dag: dama bɛ zaa daa nya o ka dabiɛm gbahi ba pam. Ka o dii yɛli ba, Di zɔriya dabiɛm! Chɛliya ka yi suhuri kpɛma! Mani m-bala.
en: All of them saw him and were terrified. But at this same time he said, Don't worry! I am Jesus. Don't be afraid.

dag: Amaa n ni tiligi yi shɛba, ka yi ni shɛba zo n-tiligi takɔbi kum ni zuliya shɛb sani, ka wurim kpe tiŋgbɔŋ shɛŋa ni.
en: I will let some escape the slaughter and be scattered among the nations.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika daa chaŋ Asirianim sansan ni dindali maa yuŋ nti ku bɛ tɔbbihi tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihinii ni tusaanu. Ka niriba daa yiɣisi asibaasi n-nya ka kpiimba n-kul do luɣilikam zaa.
en: That same night the Lord sent an angel to the camp of the Assyrians, and he killed , of them. And so the next morning, the camp was full of dead bodies.

dag: Dauda ʒiɛman maa ni kum daa ti lu yuma ata doli taba. Ka Dauda daa bɔhi Yawɛ ni o baŋ din tahi li. Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Ninsalinim ʒim yihibu taali n-ʒi Naa Sool min o daŋ zuɣu, dama o daa ku Gibiɔnnima.
en: During David's reign there was a severe famine which lasted for three full years. So David consulted the Lord about it, and the Lord said, Saul and his family are guilty of murder; he put the people of Gibeon to death. .

dag: Dama zuɣulaannim bɛn daa su Izraɛlnim la mini Izraɛl nanim ni Juda nanim saha la zaa zaŋ kana pumpɔŋɔ, yi na ʒi n-lan puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu.
en: No Passover like this one had ever been celebrated by any of the kings of Israel or of Judah, since the time when judges ruled the nation.

dag: Ulam bidibisi daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biinsi, ka lan nyɛ peentɔriba ni yɛlimaŋli. O daa mali bidibisi mini yaansi pam. Bɛ kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbiga ni pihinu. Bɛ zaa daa nyɛla Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba.
en: Ulam's sons were brave soldiers who were experts at using a bow and arrows. They had a total of children and grandchildren. All of these belonged to the tribe of Benjamin.

dag: ka o yidana maa wum li, ka bi yɛl o shɛli o ni wum li saha shɛli maa, dindina o pɔri maa min o ni lo alikauli ni o niŋ shɛli maa zaa ni zani.
en: and her husband hears it and on the day he hears it keeps silent—her solemn promises will stand as well as her binding obligations for herself.

dag: Ka niriba maa garigi yɛli, Din kariya ka ti chɛ Yawɛ jɛmbu ka ŋmaligi jɛm wuna.
en: Then the people answered, We will never stop following the Lord . We will never serve other gods!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa baŋ li ka yiɣisi ni n-zo n-chaŋ Listra mini Dɛɛbi din be Laikɔnia tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaŋ tabili tiŋkpansi din daa gil li zaa.
en: When the apostles learned about it, they fled to the cities of Lystra and Derbe in Lycaonia and to the surrounding territory.

dag: Ka bɛ ni zaɣ yino yi lu yaɣiri duɣu ni, binshɛɣukam din be di puuni leela daɣiri, ka di simdi ka yi ŋma li.
en: If any of these animals is found dead in a clay pot, the pot must be broken to pieces, and everything in it becomes unclean.

dag: Ka Samuɛl yɛli, A takɔbi ni daa kul chɛ ka paɣiba kɔŋ bihi shɛm la, lala ka a ma gba yɛn kɔŋ bia paɣiba ni. Di saha ka Samuɛl daa chɛ ŋ-ŋmahiŋmahi Agag sɔŋ Yawɛ tooni Giligal.
en: But Samuel said, Agag, you have snatched children from their mothers' arms and killed them. Now your mother will be without children. Then Samuel chopped Agag to pieces at the place of worship in Gilgal.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn muɣisiri bɛ yinsinim ti ku lan mali binshɛli yaha, ka jɛra ni ti tumdi tuma tiri yɛnnima.
en: Those who bring trouble on their families will have nothing at the end. Foolish people will always be servants to the wise.

dag: N ni zaŋ alibarika shɛli mini noli yɛlibu shɛli zali yi tooni ŋɔ yi ti niŋdi ya, ka yi teeri di yɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn kari ya tahi zuliya shɛba zaa ni ŋɔ sani.
en: I have told you everything the Lord your God will do for you, and I've also told you the curses he will put on you if you reject him. He will scatter you in faraway countries, but when you realize that he is punishing you.

dag: O ni daa zaŋ li na ka o piligi li n-nya bia maa, ka bia maa dii gbaai kuhigu. Ka di daa niŋ o yoli, ka o yɛli, Hiburunim bihi la ni yino m-bala.
en: When the king's daughter opened the basket, she saw the baby crying and felt sorry for him. She said, This must be one of the Hebrew babies.

dag: Wuhim ma a nirilim shihirili, ka lala chɛ ka bɛnkam je ma la nya li ka di vi; dama nyini Yawɛ pun sɔŋ ma ka maai n suhu.
en: Show that you approve of me! Then my hateful enemies will feel like fools, because you have helped and comforted me.

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa la min o ni daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi ni o ni daa niŋ shɛm n-chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ suhu yiɣisi la zuɣu ka lala daa niŋ maa.
en: This happened because of Jeroboams sins that he committed and that he caused Israel to commit, and because he angered the LORD, Israels God.

dag: Yi daa bi zaŋ piɛri na nti mali sara nyo buɣim ti ma jilima. M bi muɣisi ya ni yi zaŋ sara maligunim na ti ti ma. M mi bi muɣisi ya ni yi zaŋ tulaale zim na ti tuɣili ti ma.
en: You have not honored me by sacrificing sheep or other animals. And I have not burdened you with demands for sacrifices or sweet-smelling incense.

dag: Ka so yi ti bi deei ya bee n-zaɣisi yi yɛligu wumbu, yi yi ti yɛn yi yili maa ni bee di tiŋ maa ni, yin pihimiya yi napɔna taŋkpaɣu bahi di zuɣu.
en: If someone won't welcome you or listen to your message, leave their home or town. And shake the dust from your feet at them.

dag: Ka Yisa daa deei komihigu maa ka yɛli, Di naaya! Ka silim o zuɣu tiŋa n-dii bahi.
en: After Jesus drank the wine, he said, Everything is done! He bowed his head and died.

dag: Amaa ti Duuma sani, paɣ ku tooi be omaŋmaŋ zuɣu ka chɛ doo, ka doo gba ku tooi be omaŋmaŋ zuɣu ka chɛ paɣa;.
en: As far as the Lord is concerned, men and women need each other.

dag: Nyini n-daa fa ma m mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zabiri nuu ni bahi. Nyini n-zaŋ ma leei zuliya bɔbili zuɣulana; ka n ni daa bi mi ninvuɣ shɛb zaa jɛmdi ma mi.
en: You saved me from my rebellious people and maintained my rule over the nations; people I did not know have now become my subjects.

dag: Jɛra n-zaŋdi bɛ nuhi taɣindi tab ʒiya, ka chɛ ka kum kuri ba.
en: They say that we would be fools to fold our hands and let ourselves starve to death.

dag: So ni ti yɛli, n nyɛla Yawɛ nira, ka so zaŋ Yaakubu yuli bol omaŋa, ka so mi sab pa o nuu zuɣu yɛli, Yawɛ nira, ka zaŋ Izraɛl leeg o yuli.
en: They will worship me and become my people. They will write my name on the back of their hands.

dag: N ni daa tuui tɔɣisi n-zabi mmaŋ zuɣu saha shɛl la, so daa bi zani n nyaaŋa; sokam zaa daa zomi ka chɛ ma. Naawuni di zaŋ di taali ʒili ba!.
en: When I was first put on trial, no one helped me. In fact, everyone deserted me. I hope it won't be held against them.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu pam. Bɛ ni daa kana shɛm, lala ka bɛ ti lan yɛn yi n-chaŋ. Ka nyɔ bɔ ka bɛ lee di bɛ ni tum tuun shɛŋa ti pɔhim maa ni?.
en: It is very sad that people leave the world just as they came. So what does a person gain from trying to catch the wind?.

dag: Amaa bɛ daalikama mini bɛ ni daa yi booni alikama shɛli sipɛlit la, din daa bi saɣim, dama di daa bi daŋdi niŋbu.
en: But wheat and spelt ripen later than the other grains, so these plants were not destroyed.

dag: Dama ti ka tin shɛli din ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu dunia ŋɔ ni, dinzuɣu ti lihiri bɔrila tin shɛli din ti yɛn kana la.
en: Here on earth we dont have a city that lasts forever. But we are waiting for the city that we will have in the future.
