dag: Jɛsi bia Dauda daa di nam n-sula Izraɛlnim zaa.
en: David son of Jesse was king over all Israel for years. He was king in the city of Hebron for seven years. Then he was king in the city of Jerusalem for years.

dag: Amaa n yɛri ya mi, n ku lan nyu tiwala kom ŋɔ naɣila dahin shɛli ka m mini ya ni ti lan laɣim nyu di zaɣ palli m Ba Naawuni nam ni.
en: I want you to know, I will not drink this wine again until that day when we are together in my Fathers kingdom and the wine is new. Then I will drink it again with you.

dag: Yi yi yɛli Ti ni nahim o pam, dama yɛlli maa mi yila o kɔbili ni na.
en: How can we torment him? You looked for some excuse to attack me.

dag: A ni pahi ma jilima; ka maai n suhu yaha.
en: You will help me do even greater things. You will comfort me again!.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa garigi yɛli paɣ maa, N yi bɔh a bɔhigu nyin di sɔɣi ma shɛli. Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, N dan naa, bɔhim ma.
en: The king answered, I'm going to ask you a question, and you must tell me the whole truth. Ask me anything, Your Majesty, she answered.

dag: Ka kpambaliba maa zaa daa ka Jɛrimia sanna nti bɔh o; ka o garigi yɛli ba kaman naa ni daa wuh o shɛm maa. Ka bɛ daa chɛ ka bi lan bɔh o shɛli, dama bɛ daa bi wum bɛ daalizama maa.
en: The officials did come and question me about my meeting with the king, and I told them exactly what he had ordered me to say. They never spoke to me about the meeting again, since no one had heard us talking.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n dan Ibrahimma Naawuni ŋɔ, n suhir a, tim ma nasara zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka niŋ n dan Ibrahimma nirilim maŋli.
en: The servant said, Lord , you are the God of my master Abraham. Please show your kindness to my master by helping me find a wife for his son Isaac.

dag: Dama m mini n saawaranim ayopɔin n-timd a ni a chaŋ ti vihi nya Jɛrusalɛm mini Juda yɛla kaman a Naawuni zaligu din be a nuu ni ŋɔ ni wuhi shɛm.
en: You are sent by the king and his seven counselors to investigate Judah and Jerusalem according to the Instruction from your God, which is in your hand.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ Aduna bidibisi la na nti zaŋ zabbanim yɛli ba, ka zaŋ shɛlɔriti lo bɛ shɛhi ni, ka zaŋ zuɣupila pil ba kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ŋun Musa shɛm.
en: Then Moses brought Aarons sons forward, dressed them in tunics, tied sashes around them, and wrapped headbands on them, just as the LORD had commanded him.

dag: Biɛrim yɛn ti ma la daŋa, n dimnim ni tam a yɛligu yɛla zuɣu.
en: Something that really upsets me is the thought that my enemies ignore your commands.

dag: Ka o daa gindi Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili polo tinsi zaa n-yihiri waazu yɛri niriba, Niŋmiya tuuba, ka m baptaizi ya kom ni, ka Naawuni kpihim yi daalahichi.
en: So John went throughout the whole territory of the Jordan River, preaching, Turn away from your sins and be baptized, and God will forgive your sins.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka buɣim di Gaza goma n-saɣim bɛ ni me goma gili luɣ shɛŋa zaa.
en: I will send down a fire on the wall of Gaza; it will devour Gazas palaces.

dag: Jɛhɔram daa mali tizɔbihi bɛn nyɛ Jɛhɔshafat bidibisi, bɛna n-daa nyɛ: Azaria mini Jɛhiɛl ni Zakaria ni Azaria ni Maikil ni Shɛfatia. Bɛmbɔŋɔ zaa daa nyɛla Jɛhɔshafat ŋun daa nyɛ Juda naa maa bidibisi.
en: Jehorams brothers, the other sons of Jehoshaphat, were Azariah, Jehiel, Zechariah, Azariah, Michael, and Shephatiah. All of these were the sons of Israels King Jehoshaphat.

dag: Ka Dauda daa fabili fabila ŋɔ Sool min o bia Jɔnatan zuɣu.
en: Then David sang this funeral song for Saul and his son Jonathan.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi ti chɛ ka yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa yɛligi kaman o ni lɔn ya alikauli shɛm la, ka yi ti bɔri ni yi ŋubi nimdi, dama nimdi kɔre ni ti mali ya, yi ni tooi ŋubi yi ni bɔri li saha shɛli.
en: When the Lord your God enlarges your territory, as he has promised, you may eat meat whenever you want to.

dag: Judanim kuhirimi, ka bɛ fɔntinsinim tarigi; bɛ dola tiŋgban ni ni suhugarigu, ka Jɛrusalɛmnim kuhigu chaŋ haliya.
en: Judah mourns; her gates wither away. The people fall to the ground in sorrow, as sobs of Jerusalem ascend.

dag: Daadam, yɛlim di tiŋgbani maa ni di nyɛla tiŋgban shɛli din bi yi daɣiri ni bee saa ni bi mi n-niŋ tiŋgban shɛli ni suhuyiɣisili dabisili dali.
en: Son of man, speak to Israel. Tell her that she is not pure. I am angry at that country, so that country has not received its rain.

dag: ni shinshingooro ni wɔɣivaana balibu kam ni napakoli ni zɔŋ.
en: the stork, any kind of heron, the hoopoe, and the bat.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani. Bɛ daa kpɛla Baalnim jɛmbu ni.
en: Then the people of Israel sinned against the Lord and began to serve the Baals.

dag: Yalim nyɛla bin suŋ; amaa ka yalim yi ti niŋ piti, wula ka yi lee yɛn niŋ chɛ ka di lan nyaɣisi yaha? Chɛliya ka yalim be yi ni, ka yi mali suhu yini ni taba.
en: Salt is good. But if it no longer tastes like salt, how can it be made salty again? Have salt among you and live at peace with each other.

dag: Di saha maa ka yi ni baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun be Ziɔn din nyɛ n zoli din be kasi la zuɣu. Jɛrusalɛm ni nyɛla tin shɛli din be kasi, ka tinzunnim ku lan tooi tuhi fa li yaha.
en: Then, Israel, you will know that I am the Lord your God. I live on Zion, my sacred hill. Jerusalem will be a sacred city; foreigners will never conquer it again.

dag: Ka o yidan maa bɔh o, Bɔzuɣu ka a bɔri ni a chaŋ o sani zuŋɔ? Zuŋɔ pala gol palli dabisili bee Vuhim Dabisili. Ka paɣ maa yɛli, Di bi galim.
en: Why do you have to go today? her husband asked. It's neither a Sabbath nor a New Moon Festival. Never mind, she answered.

dag: Yawɛ, sɔŋm ti! Dama wundaba lan kani; ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim lan ka daadamnim ni.
en: Help, LORD, because the godly are all gone; the faithful have completely disappeared from the human race!.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka yi nahindi n niriba ka diri tarimba zuɣu nyɔri? Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ni Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n yɛli lala maa.
en: What gives you the right to hurt my people? What gives you the right to push the faces of the poor into the dirt? The Lord GOD All-Powerful said this.

dag: Farisiinim ni daa laɣim Yisa sani maa ka o bɔhi ba.
en: When some Pharisees gathered together, Jesus asked them.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Izraɛl toondaannima n-daa gari tooni chaŋ ti tuhi tɔb maa, ka niriba maa daa zaŋ bɛ nyɛviya pa talima ni bɛ suhu yubu.
en: When hair is long in Israel, when people willingly offer themselves—bless the LORD!.

dag: Ka o daa ŋmaligi yɛli bɛn ʒe nimaani maa, Deemiya pɔŋli maa o sani n-zaŋ pahi ŋun mali pɔŋ pia la.
en: Then the king said to the men who were watching, Take the bag of money away from this servant and give it to the servant who earned ten bags of money.

dag: A bi kpahim nya niriba maa ni yɛra, Yawɛ zaɣisila o ni daa pii zuliya ayi shɛb la? Lala zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ lihi ʒiɛmla n niriba maa, ka bi lan lihi ba ka bɛ ŋmani zuliya yaha. .
en: Jeremiah, have you heard what the people are saying? They are saying, The Lord turned away from the two families of Israel and Judah. He chose those people, but now he does not even accept them as a nation.

dag: Piɛri ni ti a situra, ka a buhi mi yo a palo samli.
en: you can sell lambs and goats to buy clothes and land.

dag: Kamiyana ti nya Naawuni ni tum tuun shɛŋa, o tuma mali dabiɛm pam ninsalinim sani.
en: Look at what God has done! These things amaze us.

dag: Ziɔn Zoli ni kpalim dabari, ka kunduna be di zuɣu gɔra.
en: Mount Zion, now deserted— only jackals walk on it now!.

dag: Yi Duuma NAAWUNI yɛliya, Izraɛl tin yini ninvuɣ tuhili yi chaŋ tɔbu ni, bɛ puuni ninvuɣ kɔbiga n-ni ti labina. Ka tin shɛli nim mi ninvuɣ kɔbiga yi chaŋ tɔbu ni, ninvuɣ pia n-ni ti labina.
en: The LORD God proclaims: The city that marched out one thousand people will have one hundred left, and the city that marched out one hundred will have ten left in the house of Israel.

dag: Yaa tiŋgbani, miri ka a pi n ʒim; di chɛ ka n kuhigu zani soli.
en: Earth, dont cover my blood; let my outcry never cease.

dag: Mabi so bɛ ni tum taali mali yaa gari fɔntiŋ din nyɛ zaɣ titali, ka lala zabili ŋmanila dapua din kpari birini dunoli.
en: Making up with a friend you have offended is harder than breaking through a city wall.

dag: Gallimnima, tahimiya! Laishanima, Wummiya! Anatɔtnima, garigimiya!.
en: Cry out, Bath Gallim ! Laishah, listen! Anathoth, answer me!.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim mini bɛ mabihi bɛn daa bɔhim Yawɛ jɛmbu yila, ka mi li yilibu viɛnyɛliŋga kalinli daa nyɛla niriba kɔbisiyi ni pihiwɛiayika.
en: All these twenty-four men were experts; and their fellow Levites were trained musicians. There were men in all.

dag: N nyala putɔɣu yɛl shɛŋa din niŋdi ʒii. Di nyɛla nyaanyira ni ŋun tumdi saɣiŋgu tuma ʒii. Ɛlam tɔbbihi, lirimiya ba. Miidia tɔbbihi, dɔnimiya gili tinsi gu. Naawuni ni chɛ ka Babilɔnnim ni tahi wahala shɛli na maa zan tariga.
en: A harsh vision was proclaimed to me: The betrayer betrays, and the destroyer destroys. Go up, Elam! Lay siege, Media! Put an end to all her groaning.

dag: Bee bɔ ka yi daa lee chaŋ ni yi ti nya? Nira ŋun bɔbi? Ka o lan yɛli, Nyamiya, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔbiri ka niŋdi bɛ suhu yubu bela nanim yinsi.
en: What did you go out to see? A man dressed up in refined clothes? Look, those who dress in fashionable clothes and live in luxury are in royal palaces.

dag: Amaa ka Yaakubu yɛl o ma Ribɛka, Nyama, m biɛli Iso niŋgbuna mali kɔbiri pam, ka m mi niŋgbuna be polipoli.
en: Jacob said to his mother Rebekah, My brother Esau is a hairy man, but I have smooth skin.

dag: Ka Abijam daa ti leei ŋun kani, ka bɛ zaŋ o sɔɣi Dauda tiŋ la ni; ka o bia Asa daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Abijah died and was buried in David's City, and his son Asa succeeded him as king.

dag: Yawɛ, gbilisim tibili wum n suhigu; wummi n suhigu shɛli n ni suhir a ni a zo ma nambɔɣu ŋɔ.
en: Listen closely to my prayer, LORD; pay close attention to the sound of my requests for mercy.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Chɛ ka ti boli paɣisarili maa na nti bɔh o nya.
en: They said, Summon the young woman, and lets ask her opinion.

dag: Izraɛlnim chandi maa zaa puuni, sagbani maa daa yi ti vuui ka chɛ Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa, bɛ yiɣisirimi chaŋ.
en: Whenever the cloud moved from the tent, the people would break camp and follow;.

dag: Di saha ka Liya daa yɛli, Naawuni ti ma pin suŋ, pumpɔŋɔ n yidan ni ti ma jilima, dama n dɔɣi bidibis ayɔbu ti o; ka daa boli bia maa yuli Zɛbulɔn.
en: she exclaimed, God has given me a wonderful gift, and my husband will praise me for giving him six sons. So she named the boy Zebulun.

dag: Amaa ka o daa fɔh o nuu maa kpɛhi, ka o mabia maa daŋ o yibuna; ka paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣinda maa yɛli, A niŋla kpaɣikpaɣi nya soli yina maa! Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa bol o yuli Pɛrɛz.
en: At once his hand went back in, and the other child was born first. The woman then said, What an opening you've made for yourself! So they named the baby Perez.

dag: Ka taŋkpaɣu labi di ni daa yi shɛl na, ka shia mi labi Naawuni ŋun daa zaŋ li ti sani.
en: So our bodies return to the earth, and the life-giving breath returns to God.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa daa yɛli Jɛhɔshafat, N di pun bi yɛl a ni o ku yɛli din nyɛ zaɣ viɛlli zaŋ chaŋ m polo naɣila zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Then Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, See, I told you! This prophet never says anything good about me. He always says something bad.

dag: Di pɔ dunia ŋɔ, dama di nyɛla Naawuni napɔntamdigu; ka di pɔ Jɛrusalɛm gba, dama di nyɛla Natitamlan tiŋa;.
en: nor by earth, for it is the resting place for his feet; nor by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka gbariti maa leei ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim; ka bɛ ni daa kari ninvuɣ shɛb bahi la ti leei zuliya shɛli din mali yaa, ka Yawɛ ti su ba Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu sahakam.
en: I will make the lame into survivors, those driven away into a mighty nation. The LORD will rule over them on Mount Zion from now on and forever.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ salima alali niŋ di zuɣusaa mini di luɣa ni ni di luɣilikam zaa ni di binyila la, ka niŋ salima kɔɣili li gili.
en: He covered it with pure gold and put a gold edging around it.

dag: ka zaŋ chi sara mini binnyura sara pahi naɣilahi maa mini piɛlahi maa ni piɛlabihi maa zuɣu kaman bɛ kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The grain offering and their drink offering for the bulls, rams, and lambs will be as prescribed for their number.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ ʒiishee leei dabari, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ ku lan be bɛ yinsi.
en: Make their homes empty. Dont let anyone live there.

dag: Benya ni suhu yini ni taba; di lihiya ʒiɛm so, amaa zaŋmiya yimaŋ tabili tarimba; di kuuniya yi baŋsim.
en: Consider everyone as equal, and dont think that youre better than anyone else. Instead, associate with people who have no status. Dont think that youre so smart.

dag: Amaa pu shɛŋa din be bɛ fɔntinsi maa tiŋgban ni, di bi simdi ka bɛ kɔhi dina, dama di nyɛla bɛ ni su shɛli saha shɛlikam.
en: Also, the fields and pastures around the Levite cities cannot be sold. They belong to the Levites forever.

dag: Amaa paɣ ni tiligi bihi dɔɣibu puuni, ka di mi ni yila o yi kul mali yɛda niŋbu mini yurilim ni biɛr kasi zaŋ tabil omaŋgbibbu ni na.
en: But women will be saved by having children, if they stay faithful, loving, holy, and modest.

dag: Mbusim be yinim bɛn doli zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu soli bo buni niŋ yi yinsi, ka te yi tɛri luɣ shɛŋa din du pam shee ni barina di paai ya ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Doom to the one making evil gain for his own house, for putting his own nest up high, for delivering himself from the grasp of calamity.

dag: Areebia yɛla yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ: Yinim Dɛdannim sochandiba bɛn dooni Areebia mɔɣu ni ŋɔ.
en: This is a message about Arabia. People of Dedan, you whose caravans camp in the barren country of Arabia.

dag: Yisifu ni daa sɔɣ o ba maa nyaaŋa, ka o min o biɛyanim ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa dol o chaŋ sɔɣibu maa shee maa daa lan lab Ijipti.
en: After Joseph had buried his father, he returned to Egypt with his brothers and all who had gone with him for the funeral.

dag: Kɔhat daŋ niriba maa ni daa deei fɔntin shɛŋa zaa kalinli daa yiɣisila tinsi pia ni di zaa ha biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: These families of the clan of Kohath received ten cities in all, with their pasture lands.

dag: Ka Pita chihi bɛ zaa nini maa ni yɛli, Man bi baŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa gbinni.
en: But in front of everyone Peter said, That isn't so! I don't know what you are talking about.

dag: Ka Jɛrimia yɛl o, Di nyɛla ʒiri. M bi yɛn zo n-doli Babilɔnnim maa chaŋ. Amaa ka Irija daa zaɣisi ni o ku wum o yɛligu maa, ka gbaai Jɛrimia n-zaŋ o ti ti kpambaliba.
en: Jeremiah said to Irijah, That is not true! I am not leaving to join the Babylonians. But Irijah refused to listen to Jeremiah. And Irijah arrested Jeremiah and took him to the royal officials of Jerusalem.

dag: di yiŋbia maa yiŋlan maa ni ti kuna o ni bi yuun o soli dahin shɛli bee saha shɛli.
en: Then the master will come when the servant is not ready, at a time when the servant is not expecting him.

dag: Hɛzɛkia ni yɛri ya, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ni fan ya Asiria naa nuu ni bahi la, yi bi mi ni o yɔhindi ya mi ni kum ni kɔnyuri kun ya maa.
en: Obviously, Hezekiah has fooled you into surrendering yourselves to death by hunger and thirst when he says, The LORD our God will rescue us from Assyrias king.

dag: Kpɛmiya tampima voya ni mini tiŋgbani voya ni n-tiligi Yawɛ dabiɛm zɔbu min o nam dariza ni saha shɛl o yi ti kana ni o ti dam dunia ŋɔ.
en: People will go into the holes in the ground and the cracks in the rocks because they fear the Lord and his great power as he stands to shake the earth.

dag: Yinima n-nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu, ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu bela kasi. Ka so yi saɣim Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa, Naawuni ni saɣim dilan gba.
en: Together you are God's holy temple, and God will destroy anyone who destroys his temple.

dag: O mɛla gooni gili ma ni di chɛ ka n ku tooi zo. O zaŋla zoligo titaŋa lo ma.
en: He shut me in, so I could not get out. He put heavy chains on me.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ soya maa ni ti nyɛla sariginli soya din be zibisim ni, bɛ ni ti yɛn kari ba bahi so shɛli zuɣu ka bɛ ti lu. Dama n yi ti yɛn darigi bɛ tibili yuun shɛli n ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai ba. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will stop giving my messages to them. They will walk in darkness. The road will be slippery for those prophets and priests, and they will fall in that darkness. I will bring disaster on them; I will punish them. This message is from the Lord .

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni sa gɔhi ŋar o soli, ka me gooni gu o soli, ka o ku lan tooi nya soli.
en: I, the Lord , will build a fence of thorns to block her path.

dag: Amaa m mi a ni ʒiini shɛm min a ni yiri shɛm ni a ni labiri kpɛri shɛm ni a suhu ni yiɣisi bahi n zuɣu shɛm yɛla.
en: I know all about you, even how fiercely angry you are with me.

dag: ka di chɛ ka yi ku mali taali, ka naɣ ni bela kasi, ka nyɛ Naawuni bihi bɛn be tibi m-be ʒiɛmaan biɛɣunim mini ʒiɛman golimanim sunsuuni ŋɔ. Di simdi ni yi be bɛ sunsuuni dunia ŋɔ ni n-ne kaman saŋmarisi ni ne shɛm la.
en: Then you will be the pure and innocent children of God. You live among people who are crooked and evil, but you must not do anything they can say is wrong. Try to shine as lights among the people of this world.

dag: Bɛ ni ti wuhiri n niriba maa binshɛŋa din be kasi mini binshɛŋa din nyɛ daɣiri.
en: Also, the priests must teach my people the difference between things that are holy and things that are not holy. They must help my people know what is clean and what is unclean.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Nail Mɔɣili kom nyuui, ka n zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa niŋ ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni. N ni ti chɛ ka tinzunnim saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ maa n-tabili binshɛɣukam din be di ni. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will dry up the Nile River, then sell the land to evil buyers. I will send foreigners to turn your entire nation into a barren desert. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛl o nachimba ka bɛ ku ba, ka ŋmahi bɛ bɔɣiri mini bɛ naba n-zaŋ li ti lo n-yili baɣili Hiburɔn biaŋ. Amaa ka bɛ daa zaŋ Ishibɔshɛt zuɣu maa ti sɔɣi Abinɛr siliga din be Hiburɔn la ni.
en: So David gave the order to his servants, and they killed Rechab and Baanah, cutting off their hands and feet and hanging them up by the pool at Hebron. But they took Ishbosheths head and buried it in the grave of Abner at Hebron.

dag: dindina yi kpamba mini sariakaritiba bɛn cham ti buɣisi o ni do luɣ shɛli maa zaŋ chaŋ fɔntin shɛŋa din miri nimaani wɔɣilim.
en: Your leaders and judges are to go out and measure the distance from the place where the body was found to each of the nearby towns.

dag: ka a bahi noli ka bɛ vihi litaafi shɛŋa a yaannim ni daa chɛ ka bɛ sabi zal la ni. A yi chɛ ka bɛ vihi li, a ni nya ka lala tiŋ maa bi zani tuhi nanim mini tiŋgbɔna yaɣa, ka duŋtaabo pun be nimaani ka di wɔɣa. Dina n-chɛ ka bɛ daa wurim li maa.
en: so that you may search the records of your ancestors. You will discover in the records that this is a rebellious city, harmful to kings and provinces, and that it has been in revolt over a long period of time. As a result, this city was laid waste.

dag: dama o daalahichi dumi hal ti paai sagbana, ka Naawuni teeg o tuumbiɛri yɛla.
en: For her sins are piled up as high as heaven, and God remembers her wicked ways.

dag: Chamiya Mirataim tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Chamiya ti liri ba, ka liri Pɛkɔdnima n-ku bɛ zaa. Niŋmiya n ni zali ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam zaa. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The Lord says, Attack the people of Merathaim and of Pekod. Kill and destroy them. Do everything I command you. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Dama n ni ti yihi Baalnim yuya o nol ni, ka o ku lan boli bɛ yuya yaha.
en: I will take away the names of the Baals from her mouth, and they will not be mentioned by name anymore.

dag: Shɛfatia daŋ — kɔbisita ni pisopɔinnaayi.
en: of Shephatiah.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Nyama, n ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu yi a yiŋ dundɔŋ ni na n-lu a zuɣu; ka n ti zaŋ a paɣiba ti a ʒiʒiinikpee ka o zaŋ ba dɔni palo ni wuntaŋ ni a ninni.
en: Someone from your own family will cause you a lot of trouble, and I will take your wives and give them to another man before your very eyes. He will go to bed with them while everyone looks on.

dag: Yisa daa lan ŋahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lihi bɛmaŋ wuntizɔriba ka lihi ʒiɛm bɛ tab la ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli ni.
en: There were some people who thought they were very good and looked down on everyone else. Jesus used this story to teach them:.

dag: Wuntaŋ ni daa ti lura, ka sokam zaŋ bɛ bar shɛb dɔro balibu kam ni mali tahi Yisa sanna; ka o daa zaŋ o nuhi pa bɛ zaa zuɣu ka bɛ kpaŋ.
en: After sunset all who had friends who were sick with various diseases brought them to Jesus; he placed his hands on every one of them and healed them all.

dag: n-nyo di zaa buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu, dama di nyɛla sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim tiri Yawɛ ka di nyom nyɛ din tiɣir o nini.
en: Then make sure that the whole animal goes up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa di manna maa yuun pihinahi hal ti paai bɛ ni daa yɛn ʒini tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni maa. Bɛ daa kul dirila manna maa hal ti paai Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: The people ate the manna for years, until they came to the land of rest, that is, until they came to the edge of the land of Canaan.

dag: N daa gbihimi, amaa ka n suhu lee ne. Wumma, n yura n-kpahiri n dunoli maa. N yura ni n tizɔpaɣa, yoomi ka n kpɛna. N ŋmani ŋun luɣ shɛli ka galimi. Maligim lumi mahigi n zuɣu, ka yuŋ paɣili kpe m-mahigi n zabiri.
en: I am asleep, but my heart is awake. I hear my lover knocking, saying, Open to me, my darling, my love, my dove, my perfect one! My head is soaked with dew. My hair is wet with the mist of the night.

dag: Juda naa Amɔn bia Naa Jɔsia ni daa di nam ka di ti paai yuun pinaata saha shɛli ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisiri ma yɛtɔɣa, ka n gba kul mal li tɔɣisiri ya di zuŋɔ yuun pisinaata, amaa ka yi zaɣisi wumbu.
en: For years now, ever since the thirteenth year that Josiah was king, I have been telling you what the Lord has told me. But you have not listened.

dag: Ka Ahitub bia Zadok mini Abiata bia Ahimɛlɛk nyɛ maligumaaniba, ka Sɛraya nyɛ gbansabira.
en: Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abiathar the son of Ahimelech, were the priests. Seraiah was the secretary.

dag: Yawɛ be o jɛmbu duu din be kasi ni; ka o nam ʒiishee be alizanda ni. O nini nyari daadamnima, ka kpahindi ba.
en: But the LORD is in his holy temple. The LORD! His throne is in heaven. His eyes see— his vision examines all of humanity.

dag: Ʒiŋmabo nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ sani, amaa bɛn ʒe yim nyɛla o suhu ni piɛli shɛb zuɣu.
en: The Lord hates liars, but is pleased with those who keep their word.

dag: Sagbani maa ni daa kul vuui suɣili maa zuɣusaa saha shɛli, nyama, ka niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu dii gbaai Miriam, ka o niŋgbuŋ paligi zaa kaman gumbɔrigu la. Ka Aduna daa ŋmaligi lihi Miriam polo n-nya ka niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu n-gbaag o.
en: and the cloud disappeared from over the sacred tent, Miriam's skin turned white with leprosy. When Aaron saw what had happened to her.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbahi ba nti kpari duu ni biɛɣ neei, dama di daa nyɛla zaawun yuŋ.
en: It was already late in the afternoon, and they arrested Peter and John and put them in jail for the night.

dag: Paɣa, ka pumpɔŋɔ n suhir a mi, chɛliya ka ti yuri taba. Ka di pa ni n sabirila zaligu palli tir a, amaa di nyɛla ti ni daa pun deei shɛli piligu ni la.
en: And so I ask you, dear Lady: let us all love one another. This is no new command I am writing you; it is the command which we have had from the beginning.

dag: Di saha ka Bilidad ŋun daa nyɛ Shua nir la daa garigi bɔhi.
en: Bildad from Shuah answered.

dag: Ka o daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ daanya mali gaɣa kɔtomsi m-pie taba ʒiibuyi zuɣu n-zaŋ li zali kɔniŋdi bini maa lɔŋni, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pinaata ni pirigili, ka di daa tuɣituɣi taba.
en: Its outer edge was decorated with two rows of carvings of bulls, ten bulls to about every centimeters, all made from the same piece of metal as the bowl.

dag: N kahigi n ni tum shɛlikam wuh a, ka a deei n suhigu; wuhim ma a zaligunima.
en: I told you about my life, and you answered me. Now, teach me your laws.

dag: Bɛ yi ti tum alahichi a sani ka a chɛ ka saa bi lan mira, di nyaaŋa bɛ yi ti niŋ tuuba bɛ daalahichi maa zuɣu ka ŋmaligi kpa kpe na m-bol a yuli ka suh a zaŋ chaŋ bɛ tibidarigibo maa polo.
en: When the sky holds back its rain because Israel has sinned against you, but they then pray concerning this place, give thanks to your name, and turn away from their sin because you have punished them for it.

dag: Ka Saimɔn kuhi yɛli, Suhim ti Duuma ti ma, ka yɛla ŋɔ zaa miligi n zuɣu.
en: Simon said, Please pray to the Lord, so that what you said won't happen to me.

dag: ka chɛliya ka barinim bɛn be nimaani kpaŋ, ka yɛliya ba ni Naawuni nam miri ba.
en: Heal the sick who are there, and say to them, Gods kingdom has come upon you.

dag: Bɛ ni ti kari ya bɛ jɛmbu duri ni. Yɛlimaŋli, saha kanna ka ŋunkam ti kun ya ni tɛhi ni o tumla Naawuni yubu.
en: You will be expelled from the synagogues, and the time will come when those who kill you will think that by doing this they are serving God.

dag: Ti piligima n-lan tibigiri timaŋ yaha? Bee di nyɛla talahi ni ti tin ya shɛhira gbana bee n-deei shɛhira gbana yi sani kaman shɛb ni niŋdi shɛm la?.
en: Does this sound as if we were again boasting about ourselves? Could it be that, like some other people, we need letters of recommendation to you or from you?.

dag: Nyama, yi ni ti boli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒin ya, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒin ya ti zo n-ka yi sanna. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ ni tibigi ya shɛm la zuɣu.
en: Now you will summon foreign nations; at one time they did not know you, but now they will come running to join you! I, the Lord your God, the holy God of Israel, will make all this happen; I will give you honor and glory.

dag: Ŋunkam ku ninsala, bɛn kum o.
en: Death is also the penalty for murder.

dag: Lala ka di daa niŋ ŋun pah ayi mini ŋun pah ata m-mali hal ti paai ŋun pah ayopɔin maa.
en: The same thing happened with the second brother and the third, and in fact with all seven brothers.

dag: Dinzuɣu deemiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ noli, ka dol o fukumsi zaligunim min o zaligu shɛŋa zaa n ni zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: So you must do everything that the Lord your God tells you. You must obey his commands and his laws that I am giving you today.

dag: Ka sana daa ti paai bundana maa, ka o je ni o piig o piɛri maa ni bee o niɣi maa yino n-niŋ o saani, amaa ka daa chaŋ ti gbaala faralan maa piɛsaa la na nti niŋ o san maa saani.
en: One day someone came to visit the rich man, but the rich man didn't want to kill any of his own sheep or cattle and serve it to the visitor. So he stole the poor man's lamb and served it instead.

dag: Ka Ɛsta yɛl o, N ni bɔri shɛli mini n ni yɛn suh a shɛli nyɛla:.
en: Esther replied, Your Majesty, if you really care for me and are willing to do what I want, please come again tomorrow with Haman to the dinner I will prepare for you. At that time I will answer Your Majesty's question.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla yi bibihi shɛb yi ni yɛli ni bɛ ni ŋme ŋ-gbahi ba la, yi bi shɛb bɛn bi mi din viɛla ni din bie zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n-ni ti kpe di ni, bɛna ka n ni ti zaŋ li ti ka bɛ deei li su.
en: You thought your little children would be taken by your enemies. But those children, who are still too young to know right from wrong, will go into the land. I will give it to them. Your children will take the land for their own.

dag: Laɣimmiya tab na. Yinim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim zaa, vumiya mirina. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn buɣiri bɛ wuna din nyɛ dari ginda, ka jɛmdi wuna din ku tooi tiligi ba la nyɛla bɛn be ʒilinsi ni.
en: You people who escaped from other nations, gather together before me. These people carry statues of false gods. They pray to useless gods, but they dont know what they are doing.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi zɔri Naawuni ku dɔɣi bihi, ka buɣim ni di ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn deei birapu yiya.
en: The ruthless gang is barren, and fire consumes the tents of bribers.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pɔri Samaria buɣili Ashima yɛra, Dan, a buɣili din be ŋɔ zuɣu, bee n-yɛra, Bɛrishiiba buɣili din be ŋɔ zuɣu; bɛ ni lu ka ku lan yiɣisi yaha.
en: They made promises by the sin of Samaria, They said, Dan, as surely as your god lives, we promise .... And they said, As surely as the god of Beersheba lives, we promise .... But they will fall and never get up again.

dag: Miri ka a zaŋ a liɣiri paŋ o ka bɔri ni a niŋ nyɔri bee n-kɔhi bindirigu ti o ka niŋ nyɔri.
en: Dont charge them interest on any money you lend them. And dont try to make a profit from the food you sell them.

dag: Pɔhim ʒiɛri kparila di yubu polo, ka a wumdi di damli, amaa ka bi mi di ni yiri shɛli polo na bee di ni kpari shɛli polo; lala mi ka Naawuni Shia ni dɔɣ sokam be.
en: Gods Spirit blows wherever it wishes. You hear its sound, but you dont know where it comes from or where it is going. Its the same with everyone who is born of the Spirit.

dag: Miri ka a zaŋ a yaa ti paɣiba, a mi di zaŋ a soya ti bɛn kuri nanima.
en: Dont waste your strength on women. Women destroy kings, so dont waste yourself on them.

dag: N ni daa nyɛ bidibbila ka na pɔra m-be m ba sani, ka nyɛ m ma ni daa yuri so pam.
en: When I was my fathers little boy and my mothers dear son.

dag: N kul guhima, bɛ ni ka yɛtɔɣ shɛli din ni yɛli maa zuɣu? Bee bɛ ni ʒiɛya ka bi lan garigi n-yɛli shɛli zuɣu?.
en: Shall I go on waiting when they are silent? They stand there with nothing more to say.

dag: Masia gba daa bi pii maligumaaniba zuɣulaantali mini di jilima. Naawuni n-daa lee piig o ka yɛl o: A nyɛla m Bia; zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka n leeg a Ba.
en: This is how it was with Christ. He became a high priest, but not just because he wanted the honor of being one. It was God who told him, You are my Son, because today I have become your Father.

dag: Binnɛma ayi kɔtomsi din wuhiri ni Naawuni jilima be bɛ sani n-daa tam adaka maa zuɣusaa n-kul lihiri di zuɣusaa luɣ shɛli din booni Naawuni nambɔzɔbo shee la. Amaa ti ku tooi wuhi yɛla ŋɔ zaa gbinni pumpɔŋɔ.
en: On top of the chest were the glorious creatures with wings opened out above the place of mercy. Now isn't the time to go into detail about these things.

dag: Bɛ dari ba yihi bɛ ni niŋ yili shɛli yɛda ni, ka zaŋ ba tahi na so ŋun yɛla mali dabiɛm sani.
en: They will be taken away from the safety of their tents and be led away to meet death, the king of terrors.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, M pun mi ni yi ni ŋahi ma ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli, Timlana, tibim amaŋa! Ka ni lan yɛli ma, Niŋmi ti ni daa wum ni a niŋ shɛm Kapɛrinium la amaŋmaŋ ya ŋɔ! .
en: Then Jesus said to them, Undoubtedly, you will quote this saying to me: Doctor, heal yourself. Do here in your hometown what weve heard you did in Capernaum.

dag: Absalom daa niŋ yuma ayi Jɛrusalɛm ka o nini bi nya naa.
en: Absalom lived in Jerusalem two years without ever seeing the kings face.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Ŋunkam tum alahichi n sani, dilan yuli ka n ni kpihim litaafi maa ni.
en: But the LORD said to Moses, The ones Ill wipe out of my scroll are those who sinned against me.

dag: A bɔri ni yɛlimaŋli be nir suhu ni; dinzuɣu wuhim ma yɛm n suhu ni.
en: And yes, you want truth in the most hidden places; you teach me wisdom in the most secret space.

dag: Ka n ni ti chɛ ka alahiziba tumtumsa tum zuɣusaa ha, ka wuhi shihira din nyɛ ʒim mini buɣim ni nyɔhi dunia tiŋgbani puuni;.
en: I will perform miracles in the sky above and wonders on the earth below. There will be blood, fire, and thick smoke;.

dag: Kurugu ŋmanila muriga o sani, ka daanya mi ŋmani da kpima.
en: and weapons of bronze or iron are as useless as straw or rotten wood.

dag: O daa bela tiŋ maa gomna ŋun yuli daa booni Sɛrigius Poolus ŋun mali yɛm pam la yiŋa. Ka gomna maa daa boli Baanabas mini Sool ni bɛ ti tɔɣis o Naawuni yɛligu.
en: He always stayed close to Sergius Paulus, who was the governor and a very smart man. He invited Barnabas and Saul to come visit him, because he wanted to hear the message of God.

dag: O ni zaŋ a niŋ o kpiŋkpama lɔŋni, ka a nya sɔɣibu shee o kpiŋkpama maa ni. O ʒiɛyimtali nyɛla gbaɣino mini din taɣiri nira.
en: You can go to him for protection. He will cover you like a bird spreading its wings over its babies. You can trust him to surround and protect you like a shield.

dag: A zuɣu ka bɛ kul turi ma, ka n kul diri vi.
en: My face is covered with shame. I carry this shame for you.

dag: M bi galim ya yi sara maligu mini yi ni kul mali biŋkɔb shɛb maani sara n-zaŋdi ba nyɔri buɣim tiri ma la zuɣu.
en: Although you offer sacrifices and always bring gifts.

dag: Ka o daa me goondahi gili Juda fɔntinsi, vuhim ni daa be tiŋgbani maa ni saha shɛli, dama o mini so daa bi zabira. O daa bi tuhi tɔbu di yuma maa ni, dama Yawɛ daa ti o vuhim.
en: When the land was at peace, he built fortified cities in Judah; there was no war in those years because the LORD had given him rest.

dag: yin doliya n ni zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa zaa zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: you must carefully follow the regulations and the case laws that I am laying out before you right now.

dag: A nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tɛhi ni bɛ mali yɛm la? Jɛra mali tahima pam gari ba.
en: Do you see people who consider themselves wise? There is more hope for a fool than for them.

dag: Biɛɣ ti yɛn neei ka zibisim vuui. N ni zo yomyom du mɛɛr ni nyo zo shɛli zuɣu, ka zo n-du firanki tulaale zim ni nyo dabo shɛli zuɣu.
en: I will hasten to those hills sprinkled with sweet perfume and stay there till sunrise.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Ba yuri o ni tim o Bi so na maa, ka zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa niŋ o nuu ni.
en: The Father loves the Son and gives everything into his hands.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri mini tiliginsim shee waɣ pam, dama bɛ bi bɔri a zaligunima.
en: Salvation is far from the wicked because they havent pursued your statutes.

dag: N dabisa zɔri yomyom gari tizɔra; di kul zɔrimi gariti ka zaɣ viɛlli ka di ni.
en: My days are swifter than a runner; they flee and dont experience good.

dag: Di lan doliya yimaŋmaŋ suhu yubu n-niŋdi kaman bɛn pa Yɛhudianim ni niŋdi shɛm la. Dina n-nyɛ: Kɔr biɛri tuma mini niŋgbuŋ kɔre ni danyubo ni vuyɔbo yiriŋ ni tab laɣim nyuri dam ni buɣijɛmbo din chihiri zaligu ni wuhi shɛm la.
en: You have already lived long enough like people who don't know God. You were immoral and followed your evil desires. You went around drinking and partying and carrying on. In fact, you even worshiped disgusting idols.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lih o ka yɛli, Di to ni bundaannim kpe Naawuni nam ni!.
en: Jesus saw how sad the man was. So he said, It's terribly hard for rich people to get into God's kingdom!.

dag: Amaa o yi zaɣisi wumbu, nyin bom ninvuɣ yino bee niriba ayi pah amaŋ zuɣu lab o sani, ka niriba ata bee ayi shɛhira dibu zuɣu ti chɛ ka yɛtɔɣili kam mali nyaanzaana.
en: But if they wont listen, take with you one or two others so that every word may be established by the mouth of two or three witnesses .

dag: Ŋunkam ti mali dalinli ŋun di mirina, do so ŋun nyɛ zoma bee wɔbiga bee ŋun ninni mali dansi bee ŋun bɔɣu yini gari zaɣ yini.
en: No man with any physical defects may make the offering: no one who is blind, lame, disfigured, or deformed;.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan zaŋ sipirɛs tihi dari m-mali dunoyɔriti ayi, ka duno yini dini nyɛ dunoyɔriti ayi din kpabira; ka duno din la gba dini nyɛ dunoyɔriti ayi din kpabira.
en: There were two doors made from pine. Each door had two parts that folded together.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa tim o sapashin so ŋun su tɔbbihi pihinu fukumsi min o tɔbbihi pihinu maa o sani. Ka sapashini maa daa chaŋ Ilaija sani ka o ti ʒila zoli zuɣu, ka o yɛl o, Naawuni nira, naa yɛliya, Siɣim na. .
en: Then he sent an officer with fifty men to get Elijah. The officer found him sitting on a hill and said to him, Man of God, the king orders you to come down.

dag: Ka Hiram ŋun daa nyɛ Taai naa la daa tim tuumba ka bɛ ʒi sida tihi dari na ti ti Dauda, ka daa lan tim kapintanim mini tammɛriba na ni bɛ ti me Naa Dauda yili ti o.
en: King Hiram of Tyre sent a trade mission to David; he provided him with cedar logs and with carpenters and stone masons to build a palace.

dag: Ya ka zabili mini naŋgbankpeeni ŋmɛbu zaa lee yina nti be yi sunsuuni? Pa yi niŋgbuŋ kɔre nyaɣisim bɔbu din be yi niŋgbuna yaɣa ni n-zabiri la ni ka di yina?.
en: Where do all the fights and quarrels among you come from? They come from your desires for pleasure, which are constantly fighting within you.

dag: N chɛli ninvuɣ so ŋun zaŋ ninvuɣ biɛtali sania mini ʒiri kpalaŋa n-zahind o nɛma?.
en: Some people carry special weights that they use to cheat people when they weigh their goods. Should I pardon them?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan zaŋ gali sabilifaa wuɣi alichɛbba shɛli maligumaana ni yɛn yɛri pahi binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa maa zuɣu. Alichɛbba maa daa nyɛla zaɣ sabilifaa zaa.
en: The robe that goes under the ephod was made entirely of blue wool.

dag: O ni daa yi Jɛrusalɛm kana ni o ti tuhi Naa Dauda soli maa, ka naa bɔh o, Mɛfibɔshɛt, bɔzuɣu ka a daa bi doli ma chaŋ.
en: When he met the king at Jerusalem, the king said, Mephibosheth, why didnt you go with me when I ran away from Jerusalem.

dag: Naawuni, a yurilim nyɛla yurilim maŋli! Ninsalinim zaa ni tooi sɔɣ a kpiŋkpama mahim.
en: Your faithful love is priceless, God! Humanity finds refuge in the shadow of your wings.

dag: Ka anab maa yɛl o, Yawɛ yɛliya, A ni zaŋ n ni yɛl a ni a ku do so la bahila zuɣu, a ni zaŋ a nyɛvili yo o nyɛvili samli; ka zaŋ a tɔbbihi gba nyɛviya yo o tɔbbihi nyɛviya samli. .
en: Then the prophet said to the king, This is what the LORD says: Because you freed a man I condemned to die, it will be your life for his life, and your people for his people.

dag: Yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ puuni ka alahichi yirina, amaa yɛndana nyɛla ŋun gbaar omaŋa ni yɛtɔɣa pam tɔɣisibu.
en: With lots of words comes wrongdoing, but the wise restrain their lips.

dag: Yimiya Babilɔn; zomiya ka chɛ ba. Tahimiya suhupiɛlli tahigu n-yɛli di yɛla. Ka mol li ka dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam zaa nim wum li. Yɛlimiya, Yawɛ tilig o dabili Yaakubu zuliya.
en: Go out from Babylon; flee from the Chaldeans! Report this with a loud shout, proclaim it; broadcast it out to the end of the earth. Say, The LORD has redeemed his servant Jacob.

dag: Ka Azaria ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa min o maligumaanitab maa daa lihi nya ka kɔŋ wulig o gbɛɣu zuɣu. Ka bɛ daa daag o yihi yomyom, ka o gba maŋmaŋ daa niŋ yomyom yi, dama Yawɛ n-daa chɛ ka kɔŋ maa wulig o maa.
en: Azariah and the other priests stared at the king's forehead in horror and then forced him to leave the Temple. He hurried to get out, because the Lord had punished him.

dag: Bɛ ku leei bundaannima, ka bɛ nyamma pala din ni zani yuui; ka bɛ daazichi mi ku yɛligi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: They will not remain rich for long; nothing they own will last. Even their shadows will vanish.

dag: A chɛ ka ti ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ ti dimnima, ka ti dimnim maa di ti nɛma.
en: You make us retreat from the enemy; our adversaries plunder us.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa nya ka neesim maa viɛla, ka o woligi neesim maa ka chɛ zibisim.
en: God saw how good the light was. God separated the light from the darkness.

dag: A puli ni fahiri ka a puuni biɛri waawaayili la zuɣu, di lan nyuri kom kɔŋko, amaa nyum wain biɛlabiɛla pahira.
en: Timothy, stop drinking only water, and drink a little wine. This will help your stomach, and you will not be sick so often.

dag: So yi kabi o kpee kɔbili, bɛn kabim o dini labisi, ka ŋun fɔɣ o kpee nini bɛn fɔɣimi o dini labisi, ka ŋun ŋme n-kabi o kpee nyini bɛn ŋmɛm kab o dini labisi. O ni ti o kpee maa dalinli shɛm, di simdi ka bɛ niŋ o gba lala.
en: a broken bone for a broken bone, an eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth. The same kind of injury a person gives another person must be given that person.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-bo li ti ba. Ŋuna n-niŋ lala ni o vuui bɛ barinyubo shɛli bɛ ni nyuri zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni tum shɛli polo la, ka dihi bɛ ni tibigi ninvuɣ shɛb zaa dunia ŋɔ ni vi.
en: It was the Lord All-Powerful. He decided to destroy the great things they were so proud of. He wanted to disgrace those who were so highly respected.

dag: Dabisili maa ni ti bie pam! Dama Yawɛ dabisili la dali miriya. Di ni ti kana kaman zaɣ biɛɣu din yi Kpiɔŋlan Naa sanna.
en: We are in for trouble! Soon the Lord All-Powerful will bring disaster.

dag: Doo yi po pɔri Yawɛ sani bee m-po pɔri lo alikauli ni o niŋ shɛli, ŋun miri ka o yi o yɛligu maa nyaaŋa; amaa o niŋm o ni yaag o noli yɛli shɛlikam maa zaa.
en: When one of you men makes a promise to the Lord , you must keep your word.

dag: Amaa kaman n ni pun yɛli ya shɛm la, yi nya ma ni yi nini, amaa ka bi niŋ ma yɛda.
en: Now, I told you that you have seen me but will not believe.

dag: Ka Hamɔr daa yɛl o, M bia Shɛkɛm bɔr a bipuɣiŋga, n suhir a, zaŋm o ti o ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: But Hamor talked to Dinahs brothers and said, My son Shechem wants Dinah very much. Please let him marry her.

dag: Di saha ka Pita mini Jɔn daa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa bɛ zuɣu ka bɛ deei Naawuni Shia Kasi.
en: So Peter and John laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.

dag: Dunɔguliba — kɔbiga ni pihinahiyinika.
en: of Shallum, Ater, Talmon, Akkub, Hatita, and Shobai in all.

dag: Ka ti daa kul be gooni maa mɛbu ni, ka gooni maa zaa daa me n-tuɣi taba hal ti paai di dubu pirigili, dama niriba maa suhuri daa be tuma maa ni.
en: So we went on rebuilding the wall, and soon it was half its full height, because the people were eager to work.

dag: N-yi biɛɣu ka bɛ chaŋ ti miri Jɔpa, di saha ka Pita mi daa du jirambisa zuɣusaa ni o ti suhi Naawuni. Di daa nyɛla agbaa saha.
en: The next day they were coming near Joppa about noon, when Peter was going up to the roof to pray.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ zaa ha daa gbaai bɛ daliri ni nyɛ shɛm wuhibu. Ŋun daŋ tooni daa yɛlila tumo maa, N dala puu, ka yɛn chaŋ ti nya li, dinzuɣu n suhir o gaafara.
en: But all the guests said they could not come. Each one made an excuse. The first one said, I have just bought a field, so I must go look at it. Please excuse me.

dag: Suhubɔhibo yi mali nira, di chɛrimi ka o zahindi zahima. Ka jɛrigu mi mali yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ.
en: If you keep thinking about something, you will dream about it. If you talk too much, you will say the wrong thing.

dag: Yawɛ, nyin ŋun nyɛ n tampiŋ ŋɔ ka n kuhiri niŋda. Di zaɣisi n kuhigu maa wumbu! Dama a yi shini ma, n ni ŋmanila kpiimba bɛn do gbala ni la.
en: O Lord , my defender, I call to you. Listen to my cry! If you do not answer me, I will be among those who go down to the world of the dead.

dag: Biɛkaali neesim chɛ ka daboya mini vinvama yi palo ni, kaman binyɛrigu kpabbu bɔba la, ka ne n-doya kaman bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛli dihi yaɣiri zuɣu ka yihi li ka di bɔbili doya shɛm la.
en: Early dawn outlines the hills like stitches on clothing or sketches on clay.

dag: ka yihiri wain na ka di tiri ninsalinim suhupiɛlli, ka yihiri olivi tihi kpam na ka di chɛ ka ninsalinim ninni nyɛlisira, ka chɛ ka ninsalinim nyari bindirigu diri ka di tiri ba kpiɔŋ.
en: and wine, which cheers peoples hearts, along with oil, which makes the face shine, and bread, which sustains the human heart.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Pɔtifa daa zaŋ o ni mali shɛlikam zaa niŋ Yisifu nuu ni. Yisifu ni daa be o sani maa zuɣu, o baɣa daa lan ka shɛl ni n-naɣ pahila bindir shɛl o ni daa diri ni. Yisifu daa yi nachimbil viɛlli pam, ka o lihibu viɛla.
en: Potiphar left everything up to Joseph, and with Joseph there, the only decision he had to make was what he wanted to eat. Joseph was well-built and handsome.

dag: Ka o kuhi yɛl o, Samsin, Filistianim kana ni bɛ ti lir a! Ka o yirigi neei ka yɛli, N yaai ni yi n-chaŋ kaman n ni yi pun chani shɛm la, ka dam mmaŋa ka shɛli ku gu ma soli. O daa bi baŋ ni Yawɛ lan ka o sani.
en: and shouted, Samson, the Philistines are attacking! Samson woke up and thought, I'll break loose and escape, just as I always do. He did not realize that the Lord had stopped helping him.

dag: N kpuɣila n nuhi wuh a n-suhir a, n suhu zaa kul yɛla a zuɣu kaman tiŋgban kuŋ ni bɔri kom shɛm la.
en: I lift my hands in prayer to you. I am waiting for your help, like a dry land waiting for rain. Selah.

dag: Amaa lee maliyala suhupiɛlli yi mini Masia ni laɣim di wahala ni di chɛ ka yi suhuri ti paligi, ka yi tooi mali suhupiɛlli pam saha shɛl o jilima yi ti yi palo la.
en: Be glad for the chance to suffer as Christ suffered. It will prepare you for even greater happiness when he makes his glorious return.

dag: Ŋun tumdi putuma deerila shɛli o tuma zuɣu, ka laɣindi atam maa sɔŋdi guli nyɛvili din ka bahigu saha ni di chɛ ka ŋun biriti mini ŋun chɛri zaa ti laɣim mali suhupiɛlli.
en: The one who reaps the harvest is being paid and gathers the crops for eternal life; so the one who plants and the one who reaps will be glad together.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yinim Izraɛlnim bɛn pɔri ka ka yaa ŋɔ, di zɔriya dabiɛm, n ni sɔŋ ya. Mani Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ n-nyɛ yi Tiligira.
en: The Lord says, Small and weak as you are, Israel, don't be afraid; I will help you. I, the holy God of Israel, am the one who saves you.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Yɛhudianim maa daa tooi niŋ bɛ dimnim maa bɛ ni bɔri shɛm. Bɛ daa zaŋla takɔbiri ku bɛ dimnim maa.
en: The Jews put down all their enemies with sword blows, killing, and destruction. They did whatever they wanted with those who hated them.

dag: Di dubihi mini di pilanim ni di zɔntua mini dina la daa nyɛla yim, ka takɔriti be di ni zaa gili ni di zɔntua maa ni. Di wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita pisinaanu, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pinaayi ni pirigili.
en: Its rooms, arches, and porch, as well as its windows and porch all the way around, measured the same as the others. It was seventy-five feet long and thirty-seven and a half feet wide.

dag: Ka Absalom daa chaŋ naa sani ti yɛl o, Naa nyama, a dabili yɛn chɛla o piɛri kɔbiri, ka bɔri ni naa min o kpamba zaa kana.
en: He went to King David and said, Your Majesty, I am having my sheep sheared. Will you and your officials come and take part in the festivities.

dag: N ni nyaŋ o dimnim ti o, ka ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je o.
en: I will strike down and crush his troublesome enemies.

dag: Yi ni ŋma n-wurisiwurisi kaman yaɣiri duɣu la, hal ka salichee din ni mooi buɣim bee n-tooi kom kɔduɣu ni ku lan beni.
en: You will be like a large clay jar that breaks into many small, useless pieces. You cannot use them to get a hot coal from the fire or to get water from a pool in the ground.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa darigi Ashidɔdnim tibili pam n-chɛ ka alɔbo lu bɛ tiŋ maa ni zaŋ tabili di tiŋkpansi din gil li zaa.
en: The Lord punished the people of Ashdod severely and terrified them. He punished them and the people in the surrounding territory by causing them to have tumors.

dag: Alizin biɛri daa kuhirimi ka zɔri ka chɛri bɛ ni ʒi ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu, ka bɛn bɔɣiri mini bɛ gbaya daa kpi ni gbariti pam daa nya alaafee.
en: With loud shrieks, unclean spirits came out of many people, and many who were paralyzed or crippled were healed.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛl o paɣ tizɔdoo Hɔbab ŋun daa nyɛ o deemba Riuɛl Midian nir bia la, Ti yiɣisiri kunila luɣ shɛli Yawɛ ni daa yɛl ti, N ni zaŋ li tin ya la ni. Dol ti, ka ti ti niŋ a zaɣ viɛlli; dama Yawɛ pun lo Izraɛlnim zaɣ viɛlli niŋbu alikauli.
en: Hobab was the son of Reuel, the Midianite. Moses said to Hobab, We are traveling to the land that the Lord promised to give to us. Come with us and we will be good to you. The Lord has promised good things to the Israelites.

dag: Ka n ti darig o min o bihi ni o kpambaliba tibili bɛ daalahichi zuɣu. N ni ti chɛ ka n ni daa yɛli ba alɔbo shɛŋa zaa yɛla la lu bɛ mini Jɛrusalɛmnim ni Judanim zuɣu, dama bɛ kul zaɣisiya ni bɛ ku wum.
en: You, your children, and your servants are evil, and I will punish everyone of you. I warned you and the people of Judah and Jerusalem that I would bring disaster, but none of you have listened. So now you are doomed!.

dag: ka kul fo n-ʒiya saha shɛli ti Duuma ni chɛ ka di paag o maa.
en: He should sit alone and be quiet when the Lord puts his yoke on him.

dag: N ni chɛ ka bɛ teer a yɛla ʒiɛmani kam ni. Dinzuɣu niriba ni ti paɣir a sahakam.
en: I will make your name famous from now on, and you will be praised forever and ever.

dag: Di zaa ni ti saɣim, amaa nyin kul ni beni sahakam. Di ni ti kpi kaman siturili la. A taɣiri li mi kaman situra la, ka di kul kpira.
en: They will disappear, but you will remain; they will all wear out like clothes. You will discard them like clothes, and they will vanish.

dag: Naawuni mini Yisa Masia ŋun ni ti kari bɛn ne mini bɛn kpi saria la sani n zal a, Yisa Masia labbuna min o nam dibu la zuɣu, niŋmi dimbɔŋɔnima:.
en: When Christ Jesus comes as king, he will be the judge of everyone, whether they are living or dead. So with God and Christ as witnesses, I command you.

dag: Ka Sool daa bɔh o, Nachimbila, ŋun dapala n-lee nyɛ a? Ka Dauda daa garigi yɛl o, A dabili Jɛsi ŋun nyɛ Bɛtilihɛm nir la dapala n-nyɛ ma.
en: Saul asked him, Young man, whose son are you? I am the son of your servant Jesse from Bethlehem, David answered.

dag: Abija ʒiɛmani maa ni Jɛrɔbɔam daa bi lan nya yaa, ka Yawɛ daa ti ŋme o luhi ka o kpi.
en: Jeroboam never regained his power during Abijah's reign. Finally the Lord struck him down, and he died.

dag: ka di zuɣu chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛɣu ku tooi su niriba, bee m-bariti niriba zana.
en: He keeps the wicked from ruling so that they will not bring harm to the people.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim ku lan lihiri Ijiptinim ninni bɔri sɔŋsim. Bɛ yi ti teei din daa niŋ Ijiptinim maa yɛla, di saha bɛ ni baŋ bɛ ni daa bɔri sɔŋsim bɛ sani maa galimi ni nyɛ shɛli. Di saha ka bɛ ni baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ Duuma.
en: And the family of Israel will never again depend on Egypt. The Israelites will remember their sin—they will remember that they turned to Egypt for help and not to God, and they will know that I am the Lord GOD.

dag: Yawɛ ni niŋ ba kaman o ni daa ku Ogi mini Sihɔn bɛn daa nyɛ Amɔrinim nanima ka niŋ bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ shɛm la.
en: The Lord destroyed Sihon and Og. He destroyed those Amorite kings and he will do the same thing for you again!.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ma yaha, A na ni nya bɛ ni tumdi din chihiri shɛŋa pam gari lala.
en: But I will show you something even worse than this.

dag: Hal tɔbbihi yi teei gili ma, n ku zo dabiɛm; ka hal bɛ ni kul lo tɔbu na ti liri ma maa zaa yoli, n kul ni niŋ naani.
en: Even if an army surrounds me, I will not be afraid. Even if people attack me in war, I will trust in the Lord.

dag: Di ni ti nyɛla shihirili ni alahiziba yɛlli yi mini yi zuliya sani sahakam.
en: These curses will show people that God judged you and your descendants forever. People will be amazed at the terrible things that happen to you.

dag: Amaa yinim bɛn nyɛ baɣisi mini zinaniŋdiba ni pagɔra bihi ŋɔ, kamiya kpe na.
en: You people are unfaithful! You go to fortunetellers, and you worship idols. Now pay close attention!.

dag: Liya ni daa dɔɣi bidib shɛb min o bipuɣiŋga Daina ti Yaakubu Mɛsopoteemia la m-bala. O mini Liya zuliya bɛn nyɛ bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pihitanaata.
en: These are the sons Leah bore to Jacob in Paddan-aram. Her daughter was Dinah. All of these persons, including his sons and daughters, totaled .

dag: Bɛ yila dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam zaa na. Yawɛ zaŋ o suhuyiɣisili bidibbina na ni o ti saɣim dunia ŋɔ zaa.
en: They are coming from far-off countries at the ends of the earth. In his anger the Lord is coming to devastate the whole country.

dag: Jɔab mabia Asahɛl n-daa nyɛ ŋun pah anahi n-su gol so ŋun pah anahi ni. O kalinsi nyaaŋa, o bia Zɛbadia n-daa zan o zaani, ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi ka o daa su.
en: The fourth for the fourth month was Asahel, Joabs brother, and after him his son Zebadiah. His division numbered .

dag: Dama ŋun mali ni ti lan nya m-pahi; ka ŋun mi ka ni ti bahi kɔŋ o ni mali biɛla shɛl la.
en: Those who have something will be given more, and those who have nothing will have taken away from them even the little they have.

dag: Bɛ mi daa bi niŋ tuuba bɛ ninvuɣ kubo bee bɛ baɣibuɣibo bee bɛ zina niŋbu bee bɛ tayiɣisigu zuɣu.
en: Nor did they repent of their murders, their magic, their sexual immorality, or their stealing.

dag: Amaa n ni chɛ ninvuɣ tusa ayopɔin bɛn zaa na bi gbani jɛm Baal bee n-zaŋ bɛ noya mɔɣis o kuɣa la Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: But , Israelites have refused to worship Baal, and they will live.

dag: ni di chɛ ka yi yɛda ku me n-tamla ninsalinim yɛm zuɣu, amaa ka ni me n-tamla Naawuni yiko zuɣu.
en: Your faith, then, does not rest on human wisdom but on God's power.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, A pun nya o, hal ŋuna n-dir a alizama ŋɔ.
en: Jesus said to him, You have already seen him. The Son of Man is the one talking with you now.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Ŋɔri malila voya, ka noonsi mi mali tɛri, amaa Daadam Bia ka luɣ shɛli din ni zaŋ o zuɣu sɔŋ gba.
en: Jesus answered him, Foxes have holes, and birds have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lie down and rest.

dag: Ti mabihi bɛn be Kɔrinti, ti neei shɛlikam wuhi ya; ti yooi ti suhuri tin ya.
en: Corinthians, we have spoken openly to you, and our hearts are wide open.

dag: Di simdi ka chi mini kawana sara din yɛn pahi piɛlaa maa zuɣu nyɛla lita pinaayopɔin ni pirigili. Ka chi mini kawana sara din yɛn pahi piɛbihi la zuɣu dina, o kul bom o ni bɔri ni o ti shɛm tariga, ka bo kpam lita ata tahili kam zuɣu.
en: With each ram he is to bring an offering of half a bushel of grain, and with each lamb he is to bring whatever he wants to give. For each half-bushel of grain offering he is to bring three quarts of olive oil.

dag: O ni ti wuhi ya jirambisa du kar shɛli bɛ ni pun malimali binshɛɣukam zali, ka yi mali chuɣu maa shili nimaani gul ti.
en: He will show you a large upstairs room, already furnished. Make preparations there.

dag: Yɛhudianim bɛn mini ba daa be m-miri taba ni daa kana, bɛ daa yɛli ti siɣimsiɣim bupia, Ti dimnim maa ni yi bɛ ni be luɣ shɛlikam zaa kana ti liri ti.
en: Then the Jews living among our enemies came and said this to us ten times, Our enemies are all around us. They are everywhere we turn.

dag: Saimɔn ni daa nya ka tuumba maa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa bɛ zuɣu ka bɛ deei Naawuni Shia Kasi maa zuɣu ka o daa bɔ liɣiri ni o ti ba.
en: Simon saw that the Spirit was given to people when the apostles laid their hands on them. So he offered the apostles money.

dag: din ni chɛ ka n gbibi n ni daa po pɔ shɛli yi yaannim sani ni n ni zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam ti ba kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ ŋɔ. Di saha ka n daa garigi yɛli, Yawɛ, lala n-nyɛ li.
en: I will fulfill my solemn pledge that I made to your ancestors to give them a land full of milk and honey, as is the case today. And I replied, As you say, LORD.

dag: N ni yɛl a wuntia yɛla dabisi muni puuni dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lo ni bɛ niŋ ma zaɣ biɛɣu la di vi ka nya filiŋ.
en: All day long I will announce your power to save. I will tell how you disgraced and disappointed those who wanted to hurt me.

dag: Jɔnatan bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Pɛlɛt mini Zaza. Bɛmbɔŋɔ zaa daa nyɛla Jɛramiil daŋ niriba.
en: but Jonathan had two sons: Peleth and Zaza.

dag: Ʒiɛmana din gari la puuni, Naawuni daa bi kahigi ashili ŋɔ wuhi ninsalinima, amaa pumpɔŋɔ Naawuni yipa kahigi li o Shia Kasi zuɣu n-wuh o tuumba min o daanabinim bɛn be kasi la.
en: No one knew about this mystery until God's Spirit told it to his holy apostles and prophets.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa ti bɛ zaa yinoyino binyɛr piɛla, ka yɛli ba ni bɛ na guhim hal ka bɛ tumtumdi tab mini bɛ mabi shɛb bɛ ni na yɛn ku kaman bɛ ni daa ku ba shɛm la gba yɛla ti naai zaa.
en: Each of them was given a white robe, and they were told to rest a little while longer, until the complete number of other servants and believers were killed, as they had been.

dag: mɔɣu ni mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni, maliya suhupiɛlli! Tihi din be nyɔŋ puuni zaa, yi gba yilimiya suhupiɛlli yila.
en: Let the fields and everything in them be happy! Let the trees in the forest sing for joy.

dag: N ŋmanila tiŋgban nɛli ni juɣu, ka ŋmani dabari ni viɣu.
en: I am lonely, like an owl living in the desert, like an owl living among old ruined buildings.

dag: N vuhim shee m-bɔŋɔ sahakam; kpe ka n yɛn be, dama n yuri li.
en: He said, This will always be my place of rest. This is where I want to sit on my throne.

dag: . Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ zaligu shɛli n ni zali ya, Yumiya taba! .
en: . So I command you to love each other.

dag: Ka naa mini Jɛhɔiada daa zaŋ li ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa su Yawɛ jɛmbu duu tuma fukumsi la ka bɛ bo tammɛriba mini kapintanima ni bɛ mali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa, ka lan bo bɛn mi kuriti mini daanya tuma ni bɛ mali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa.
en: The king and Jehoiada would give the money to those who were in charge of repairing the Temple, and they hired stonemasons, carpenters, and metalworkers to make the repairs.

dag: Naawuni zaŋ ma tila ninvuɣ biɛri, ka zaŋ ma niŋ putɔɣunim nuu ni.
en: God has handed me over to evil people.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa lab kpe saria karibu shee maa ka boli Yisa na ti bɔh o, A nyɛla Yɛhudianim Naa.
en: Pilate then went back inside. He called Jesus over and asked, Are you the king of the Jews.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Amaa wahala dabisa ŋɔ nyaaŋa saha, di ku yuui ka wuntaŋ dii zibigi, ka goli ti ku lan piɛla, ka yiko din gbib zuɣusaa ni ti dam ka saŋmarisi yi zuɣusaa luna.
en: Soon after the trouble of those days, the sun will grow dark, the moon will no longer shine, the stars will fall from heaven, and the powers in space will be driven from their courses.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa chɛ ka o mini ba naai noli, ka o lo ba alikauli ni bɛ ku ku ba. Ka Izraɛl kpamba gba daa lo ba alikauli ni bɛ ni ʒe alikauli maa nyaaŋa.
en: Joshua made peace with them. He made a treaty with them to protect their lives. The leaders of the community made a solemn pledge to them.

dag: Ka Yisifu min o ba yiŋnim daa kul be Ijipti. Yisifu daa niŋla yuun kɔbiga ni pia dunia yili ŋɔ.
en: Thus Joseph lived in Egypt, he and his fathers household. Joseph lived years.

dag: Ka Isaka bidibisi daa nyɛ: Tola mini Puva ni Jashub ni Shimrɔn.
en: Issachars sons were Tola, Puvah, Iob, and Shimron.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ ni nyɛ daba ninvuɣ shɛb nuu ni zaa daa zo ba nambɔɣu.
en: He made all their oppressors feel sorry for them.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabihi, ti pala dab paɣ maa bihi, amaa ti nyɛla bilichin paɣ la bihi.
en: My friends, we are children of the free woman and not of the slave.

dag: Ijipti naa ni daa wum ni Izraɛlnim maa zoya maa, ka o min o kpamba zaa suhuri daa lan taɣi zaŋ chaŋ bɛ polo ka bɛ yɛli, Bɔzuɣu ka ti daa niŋ lala? Bɔzuɣu ka ti chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa chaŋ ka chɛ ti tuma.
en: When Egypts king was told that the people had run away, Pharaoh and his officials changed their minds about the people. They said, What have we done, letting Israel go free from their slavery to us.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti paai Misia tintariga shee m-bɔri ni bɛ chaŋ Bitinia, amaa ka Yisa Shia daa bi saɣi;.
en: After they arrived in Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit of Jesus would not let them.

dag: Di saha ka Ayuba daa garigi yɛli Yawɛ.
en: Job responded to the LORD.

dag: Yilimiya yil palli paɣi Yawɛ, dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam nim zaa. Paɣimiy o! Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn duhiri ŋarima teeku ni mini teeku puuni binnɛma zaa ni teeku dulinim zaa, paɣimiy o!.
en: Sing to the LORD a new song! Sing his praise from the ends of the earth! You who sail the sea and all that fills it, the coastlands and their residents.

dag: Biɛɣuni ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha n sa ni chɛ ka sakuɣ kara luna, ka sakuɣa lala na ʒi n-lu Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni di piligu ni hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: So at this time tomorrow, I will cause a very bad hailstorm. There has never been a hailstorm like this in Egypt, not since Egypt became a nation.

dag: Ka nimaani leei jɛŋgbina mini kunduna gɔbu shee, ka alizinnim be nimaani booni taba; ka Lilit ni kani nimaani na ti vuhira.
en: Wildcats and hyenas will hunt together, demons will scream to demons, and creatures of the night will live among the ruins.

dag: N naan wuh o n napɔna yaabu zaa, ka chaŋ o sani kaman naa la.
en: Then I could explain everything I have done. I could come to God with my head held high like a prince.

dag: ni chuɣu dali binyɛra ni binyɛr shɛŋa din yɛri pari zuɣusaa ni binyɛr kara ni nuhi ni kolibihi.
en: all their fine robes, gowns, cloaks, and purses;.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Kiburɔtihataava, bɛ ni daa sɔɣi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpiri kɔre pam nimaani la zuɣu.
en: The name of that place was called Kibroth-hattaavah, because there they buried the people who had the craving.

dag: N ni zaŋ n yuli boli jɛmbu du shɛli ŋɔ, yi pa leela ŋmɛnditoya duu yi sani? Yawɛ yɛliya, N kul pala nina lihiri ya.
en: You are thieves, and you have made my temple your hideout. But I've seen everything you have done.

dag: Yɔhiŋ sania zaŋ zahim binyɛra nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ sani, amaa binyɛra zahimbu sania zuɣu din tuhi nyɛla din paligir o suhu.
en: The Lord hates false scales, but he loves accurate weights.

dag: Ka o ti ŋmahiŋmahi biŋkɔbigu maa n-tabil o zuɣu min o biŋkpam, ka maligumaana zaŋ li pa da shɛŋa din be buɣim maa ni la zuɣu sariasaria sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: You must cut the animal into pieces and remove the head and the fat. The priest will then lay them on the wood that is on the fire of the altar.

dag: Bɛ ni ti yɛli, Kamiyana ka ti labi Yawɛ sani ka o ti tibi ti, dama ŋuna n-daa darigi tooi ti. Ŋuna n-daa ti daŋa, o ni niŋ tim niŋ ti daŋ maa.
en: Come, lets go back to the Lord . He hurt us, but he will heal us. He wounded us, but he will put bandages on us.

dag: Ka Shɛshan daa zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga ti o dabili Jariha maa, ka o daa zaŋ o dɔɣi Atai.
en: Sheshan let his daughter marry Jarha. They had a son. His name was Attai.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ma, Daniɛl, cham a chandi shee pumpɔŋɔ, dama yɛla ŋɔ nyɛla din yɛn be ashilɔni n-sɔɣiya hal ti paai saha tariga.
en: He answered, Go on about your life Daniel. The message is hidden. It will be a secret until the time of the end.

dag: A ni tooi zaŋ zoligɔnim ga saŋmar shɛb bɛn laɣim taba ka bɛ booni ba Gbiŋgbiŋ min o bihi la? Bee a ni tooi yihi binshɛli din gbibi saŋmar so bɛ ni booni Goli wulan la.
en: Can you tie the Pleiades together or loosen the bonds that hold Orion?.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai bɛ ba Yaakubu sani Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni, bɛ daa yɛl o la dinkam zaa niŋ ba, ka lan yɛl o.
en: When they came to their father Jacob in Canaan, they told him all that had happened to them:.

dag: Yawɛ yiko puuni, o daa kpahi n zuɣu ni ni n di doli niriba maa naba. O daa yɛli ma.
en: The LORD spoke to me, taking hold of me and warning me not to walk in the way of this people.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei ka Yɛhudianim shɛb lo nia ni bɛ ku Pool, ka daa laɣim po pɔri ni shee bɛ ku Pool ni di yi pa lala bɛ ku di bee n-nyu.
en: The next morning some of the Jews made a plan to kill Paul. They made a promise to themselves that they would not eat or drink anything until they had killed him.

dag: Di saha ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Izraɛl fɔntinsi ni ni ti yina m-mali buɣim nyo bidibbina. Bɛ ni ti va nyɔtaɣiri bihi mini zaɣ kara ni tɔbiri ni piɛma ni kpana n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim yuma ayopɔin.
en: Those who live in Israels cities will go out and kindle a fire with the weapons—shield and buckler, bow and arrow, spear and lance. They will burn them with fire for seven years.

dag: Jɔtam ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o ni daa pun niŋ shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: All the great things that Jotham did are written in the book, The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: Ka o mayilinim maa daa zan o zaani n-zaŋ o yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi Shɛkɛmnim zaa ti o, ka Shɛkɛmnim maa daa wuhi ni bɛ ni doli Abimilɛk, dama ni o nyɛla bɛ mabia.
en: Abimelechs uncles spoke to the leaders of Shechem and asked them that question. The leaders of Shechem decided to follow Abimelech. They said, After all, he is our brother.

dag: ka nahindi nandaamba mini bɛn ka, ka fari niriba, ka bi labisiri bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛli pa talima o sani n-tiri bindaannima, ka jɛmdi buɣa, ka tumdi din chihira.
en: He mistreats poor, helpless people. He takes advantage of them. When a debt is paid, he does not give back what he took from them. He prays to filthy idols and does other terrible things.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Sool, Miri ka a chɛ ka so suhu saɣim doo ŋɔ zuɣu, mani a dabili ŋɔ ni chaŋ ti tuhi Filistia doo maa.
en: David said to Saul, Your Majesty, no one should be afraid of this Philistine! I will go and fight him.

dag: Bɛ ni ti yi Ijipti kana ka bɛ ni sɔhiri kaman noombihi la. Ka shɛb ti yi Asiria kana kaman ŋmana la, ka n ti zaŋ ba labisi bɛ yinsi. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: They will come back, fluttering like birds from Egypt or like doves from Assyria. Then I will bring them back to their homes. I, the Lord , have spoken!.

dag: Dindali maa, n ni boli Hilikia bia Ɛliakim ŋun nyɛ n dabili la na.
en: He will give your official robes and your authority to his servant Eliakim son of Hilkiah. Eliakim will be like a father to the people of Jerusalem and to the royal family of Judah.

dag: Dinzuɣu yinim bɛn pa Yɛhudianim lan pala tinzunnim ni saamba yaha; yi mini Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda zaa yipa laɣim nyɛla tiŋbi yinsi ka nyɛ Naawuni yiŋnima.
en: So then, you Gentiles are not foreigners or strangers any longer; you are now citizens together with God's people and members of the family of God.

dag: Nir yi guni bee o yi bi guni di zaa pa shɛli, amaa Naawuni zaligu dolibu n-nyɛ din mali buchi.
en: Being circumcised or uncircumcised isn't really what matters. The important thing is to obey God's commands.

dag: Ka di daa gari Yɛhudianim maa ka bɛ bɔhira, Wula ka doo ŋɔ lee niŋ mi yɛla ŋɔ, ka pa ŋun nya bɔhimbu.
en: The leaders were surprised and said, How does this man know so much? He has never been taught.

dag: ni ʒiri shɛhira lana ŋun di ʒiri shɛhira ni ninvuɣ so ŋun tuɣindi nir min o yiŋnima.
en: a false witness who breathes lies, and one who causes conflicts among relatives.

dag: Ka o dii yiɣisi zaŋ o daamaŋka maa yi bɛ zaa ninni. Ka di daa niŋ bɛ zaa alahiziba pam, ka bɛ paɣiri Naawuni yɛra, Ti na ʒi n-nya alahiziba tuuni ŋɔ tatabo.
en: Jesus raised him up, and right away he picked up his mat and walked out in front of everybody. They were all amazed and praised God, saying, Weve never seen anything like this.

dag: dama bɛ ŋmaligiya ka chɛ o dolibu, ka bɛ baɣa lan ka o soya ni.
en: Because they turned from following him and didnt value all his ways.

dag: Bɛ yi ti tahi ya Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni mini nanim ni zuɣulaannim sani, yin di ti bɔhiri yi suhuri yi ni yɛn garigi shɛm bee yi ni yɛn yɛli shɛm zuɣu.
en: When you are brought to trial in the synagogues or before rulers or officials, don't worry about how you will defend yourselves or what you will say.

dag: Ka ti yaannim maa daa zaɣis o noli, ka woligi bɛmaŋa ka chɛ o, ka daa paɣila Ijipti labbu bɛ suhuri ni.
en: But our ancestors did not want to obey Moses. They rejected him. They wanted to go back to Egypt again.

dag: Jɛsi bidib kpamba ata daa dolila Sool chaŋ tɔb maa ni; o bidibis ata bɛn daa doli chaŋ tɔb maa ni yuya n-daa booni Ɛliab, ŋun daa nyɛ o bidib kpɛm la, ka ŋun daa pa o zuɣu yuli booni Abinadab, ka ŋun pah ata mi yuli booni Shamma.
en: His three oldest sons had gone with Saul to war. The oldest was Eliab, the next was Abinadab, and the third was Shammah.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa tim ka bɛ chaŋ ti boli Yisifu n-zaŋ o sarika maa ni na yomyom; ka o daa pini o ninni ka taɣi binyɛra ye n-kpe Firawuna sani.
en: The king sent for Joseph, who was quickly brought out of jail. He shaved, changed his clothes, and went to the king.

dag: O daa chɛ ka sakuɣa luna ku bɛ wain tihi, ka chɛ ka maligim din leeri sakuɣa luna saɣim bɛ fiig tihi wala zaa.
en: God killed their vines with hail, their sycamore trees with frost.

dag: N daa chɛ n yaaŋa ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn buri ma, ka chɛ n jira ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn dariti sibiri n teeŋkɔbiri. M mi daa bi ŋmaligi n nini bahi kpaŋ ka chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn maani ma ansarisi bee bɛn tuhiri nintɔri viɛri ma.
en: I let them beat my back and pull out my beard. I didn't turn aside when they insulted me and spit in my face.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun tum zina, o ka yɛm. Ŋun tum lala o saɣim omaŋa.
en: But if you go to bed with another man's wife, you will destroy yourself by your own stupidity.

dag: Amaa so yi bɔri ni o ŋme dimbɔŋɔ naŋgbankpeeni, ti ka kal shɛŋa pahi di zuɣu, ka Naawuni cheechinim gba lan ka kal shɛŋa pahi di zuɣu.
en: But if anyone wants to argue about it, all I have to say is that neither we nor the churches of God have any other custom in worship.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛl o, N ni be a sani, ka chɛ ka a ŋme n-ku Midiannim kaman ninvuɣ yino n-nyɛ ba la.
en: The Lord answered Gideon and said, I will be with you, so you can defeat the Midianites as easily as if they were only one man.

dag: Kum mihi daa vili ma, ka kokpɛɣu din ni di nir varisi ma.
en: Deaths cords were wrapped around me; rivers of wickedness terrified me.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri tuumbiɛri n-luhiri ba, amaa wuntizɔriba nyari kpɛhili shee bɛ biɛrisuntali zuɣu.
en: In times of trouble the wicked are destroyed, but even at death the innocent have faith.

dag: Zaŋm bindira balibu kam gba n-niŋ ŋariŋ maa ni, ka di ti nyɛ a mini ba bindirigu.
en: Also bring every kind of food into the boat, for you and for the animals.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yi di nasara, niriba malila suhupiɛlli pam, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri yi di nasara, niriba sɔɣirimi.
en: When an honest person wins, it's time to celebrate; when crooks are in control, it's best to hide.

dag: Gbilisim a tibili wum sarikanim ŋuhibu, ka tiligi bɛ ni zali ni bɛ kum shɛb la a yiko din galisi pam la zuɣu.
en: Listen to the prisoners groan! Let your mighty power save all who are sentenced to die.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mbusim be tin shɛli nim bɛn kuri niriba zuɣu. Hal mmaŋmaŋ ni laɣisi dari pam duhi.
en: So now the LORD God proclaims: Horror! You bloody city! I myself will add fuel to the fire!.

dag: Dindali maa bɛ ni ti piɛbi kika titali, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa yirigi be Asiria tiŋgbɔŋ ni mini bɛ ni daa kari shɛb kulisi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la kana ti jɛm Yawɛ Jɛrusalɛm zoli din be kasi la zuɣu.
en: On that day, a great trumpet will be played. Those who were lost in the land of Assyria and those who were scattered in the land of Egypt will come. They will bow to the LORD at his holy mountain in Jerusalem.

dag: Kum chɛ ka bɛ lan ka yaa, ka barina do n-gu ba ni di chɛ ka bɛ tuui.
en: They used to be rich, but now they go hungry; disaster stands and waits at their side.

dag: Biŋkɔb so ŋun mali takarifiɛma, ka o takarifiɛma maa wɔrigi, ka o gbuɣiri ŋubira, yin ŋubimiya lala biŋkɔbigu maa.
en: any animal that has divided hoofs and chews the cud.

dag: Bɛ daalahichi mini bɛ diribarilim zuɣu ka n daa chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka n darigi bɛ tibili ka chɛ ba bahi; amaa ka bɛ niŋ tipawumli n-kul dolila bɛmaŋmaŋ suhuyubu soli.
en: Your greed made me furious. That's why I punished you and refused to be found, while you kept returning to your old sinful ways.

dag: Yawɛ, amaa a miri ma, ka a zaligunim zaa nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: But you are near to me, Lord , and all your commands are permanent.

dag: ka Hɔshaya bia Azaria mini Karia bia Jɔhanan ni ninvuɣ yoya la zaa daa yɛli Jɛrimia, A ŋmala ʒiri, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ bi tim a na ni a ti yɛli ti, Di chaŋya Ijipti ti ʒini nimaani.
en: But Azariah, Johanan and some other arrogant men said to me, You're lying! The Lord didn't tell you to say that we shouldn't go to Egypt.

dag: N ni daa pun yɛli ya shɛlikam zaa la niŋya, ka yi ni saɣi yɛli ni n ni daa yɛli shɛm maa nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. Pumpɔŋɔ n yɛn yɛli ya la yɛl pala, di nyɛla ashili yɛl shɛŋa yi ni na ʒi.
en: Youve heard and seen all this— wont you admit it? From now on Ill tell you new things, guarded secrets that you dont know.

dag: Ka naa daa zaŋ alimug dari maa sa n-tuɣi tab gili Yawɛ jɛmbu duu min o yil la, ka zaŋ shɛli m-mali mɔɣilɔnim mini goonjɛnima n-ti baansi; ka so m-bi lan nya alimug dari maa tatabo hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: Solomon used the wood to build railings in the Temple and the palace, and also to make harps and lyres for the musicians. It was the finest juniper wood ever imported into Israel; none like it has ever been seen again.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ yuli ni ka ti sɔŋsim yirina.
en: Our help comes from the Lord , who made heaven and earth.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ tin shɛli yi ni yɛra, Tɔbu mini kum ni alɔbo ŋɔ zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ li niŋ Babilɔn naa nuu ni la polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Jeremiah, what you said is true. The people of Jerusalem are suffering from hunger and disease, and so the king of Babylonia will be able to capture Jerusalem.

dag: Bɛ ni daa dɔɣi bi shɛb Jɛrusalɛm ti o maa yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Shammua mini Shɔbab ni Neetan ni Sulemaana ni.
en: The names of his children in Jerusalem were as follows: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon.

dag: Dama di nyɛla Naawuni yubu ni yi tum din tuhi, ka di chɛ ka yi mum jɛra bɛn tɔɣisiri ʒilinsi yɛtɔɣa la noya.
en: Submit to them because its Gods will that by doing good you will silence the ignorant talk of foolish people.

dag: ka chɛ ka o kpe n-ʒin o chɛchɛbuŋ din pah ayi puuni, ka chɛ ka bɛn be o tooni kuhiri yɛra, Damdimiy o tiŋa! Lala ka o daa niŋ zaŋ Yisifu leei Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa zuɣulana.
en: He gave him the second royal chariot to ride in, and his guard of honor went ahead of him and cried out, Make way! Make way! And so Joseph was appointed governor over all Egypt.

dag: Ka o daa sab gbaŋ zaŋ chaŋ yɛlli maa polo pahi ba. O ni daa sab yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: The commander wrote a letter that said:.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi vihi baŋ ti tuumbiɛri maa? Ti lo yɛmbimbiɛri nia biɛɣu ŋɔ. Dama ninsal suhu ni tɛha zilim pam.
en: They make evil plans and say, We have planned a perfect crime. The human heart and mind are a mystery.

dag: Dama wula ka n yɛn tooi niŋ ʒiya lihiri n niriba ka mbusim ŋɔ tatabo paai ba? Bee wula ka n yɛn tooi niŋ ʒiya lihiri n dɔɣiriba ka bɛ kuri ba.
en: and I can't bear to see my people and my own relatives destroyed.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla a daa chɛ ka sagbani wuhiri ba soli wuntaŋ ni, ka chɛ ka buɣim ne yuŋ n-wuhiri ba bɛ ni yɛn doli shɛli polo.
en: Each day you led your people with a thick cloud, and at night you showed the way with a flaming fire.

dag: Amaa n ni be, ka chɛ ka man Yawɛ jilima pali dunia ŋɔ zaa la zuɣu.
en: But I promise that as surely as I live and as surely as my presence fills the earth.

dag: Ka o suhu daa gbaai Daina Yaakubu bipuɣiŋga maa pam, ka o daa tɔɣis o yurilim mini suhumahili yɛtɔɣa.
en: But Shechem was attracted to Dinah, so he told her how much he loved her.

dag: O pun baai du mɔɣili n-chaŋ ti gbe Gɛba; ka dabiɛm gbaai Ramanima; ka Sool ya Gibianim yi n-zo.
en: before crossing the valley and spending the night at Geba. The people of Ramah are terrified; everyone in Gibeah, the hometown of Saul, has run away.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa boli Musa mini Aduna nti yɛli ba, Suhimiya Yawɛ ka o yihi poloya maa ka chɛ m mini n niriba ŋɔ, ka n chɛ ka yi niriba maa chaŋ ti mali sara ti Yawɛ.
en: The king called for Moses and Aaron and said, Pray to the Lord to take away these frogs, and I will let your people go, so that they can offer sacrifices to the Lord .

dag: O kɔŋko n-nyɛ ŋun tumd alahiziba tuun kara. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Give thanks to the only one who makes great wonders— Gods faithful love lasts forever.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ jilima baŋsim ni ti pali dunia ŋɔ kaman kom ni pali teeku shɛm la.
en: Then people everywhere will know about the Glory of the Lord . This news will spread just as water spreads out into the sea.

dag: Di tiwul kpana kuumi kab lu, ka paɣiba va li ti mali buɣim. Dama niriba maa nyɛla bɛn bi baŋdi shɛli, dinzuɣu ŋun nam ba maa ku zo ba nambɔɣu bee n-niŋ ba nirilim.
en: When its branches are dry, they are broken. Women come and set fire to it. These people have no understanding; therefore, their maker wont have compassion; the one who formed them wont be gracious.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa kpahi tuumbiɛtumdiba ayi shɛb tabili dapula m-pahi Yisa zuɣu maa ni yino daa yiɣisi o suhu bahi Yisa zuɣu m-bɔhir o, A pala Masia? Tiligim amaŋa, ka tiligi ti pahi.
en: One of the criminals hanging there also insulted Jesus by saying, Aren't you the Messiah? Save yourself and save us.

dag: Amaa bɛ ku mali fali bɛ mabihi sani, Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ fali kaman o ni daa lo ba alikauli shɛm la.
en: The tribe of Levi will not get any share of land like the other tribes. Their share is the Lord himself, as he said to them.

dag: Ka shihir shɛli daa lan puhi zani alizanda ni yaha. Waɣ ʒiɛ biɛ titali ŋun mali zuɣur ayopɔin mini yila pia, ka nam zuɣupilis ayopɔin pil o zuɣuri maa daa yina ʒiɛya.
en: Then another wonder appeared in heaven: There was a giant red dragon there. The dragon had seven heads with a crown on each head. It also had ten horns.

dag: ni Aijalɔn ni Gatirimɔn ni di zaa biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: Aijalon and its pastures, Gath-rimmon and its pastures; in total: four cities.

dag: Dɛbɔra, yiɣisima, yiɣisima. Yiɣisima, yiɣisima, Yilimi yilli! Barak Abinɔam bia, yiɣisim zaŋ a ni gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb daba la kuli!.
en: Lead on, Deborah, lead on! Lead on! Sing a song! Lead on! Forward, Barak son of Abinoam, lead your captives away!.

dag: Lɛvinim zuliya bɛn daa yi Babilɔn n-lab kuli maa kalinli m-bɔŋɔ: Jɛshua mini Kadimiɛl — pisopɔinnaanahi.
en: Clans of Levites who returned from exile: Jeshua and Kadmiel - Temple musicians - Temple guards -.

dag: Gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin ŋɔ biɛɣu pia dali ni nyɛla sanyoo dali, ka di ni ti nyɛla yi laɣiŋgu kasi saha, ka di simdi ni yi ti lo noli, ka mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ.
en: Note that the tenth day of this seventh month is the Day of Reconciliation. It will be a holy occasion for you. You must deny yourselves and offer a food gift to the LORD.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yuli ba ka bɔhi ba, Wula ka di lee sabi Naawuni Kundi ni yɛl la? Di sabiya: Kuɣ shɛli tammɛriba ni zaɣisi la n-yipa leei kuɣ gahindili. .
en: Jesus looked at them and asked, What, then, does this scripture mean? The stone which the builders rejected as worthless turned out to be the most important of all.

dag: Niŋmiya bin zusanim niŋ yi ni yɛri situr shɛŋa naŋgbambiya anahi.
en: Sew tassels on the four corners of your clothes.

dag: dindina n ni teei n ni daa lo Yaakubu mini Yisahaku ni Ibrahimma alikauli shɛŋa la yɛla, ka lan teei tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ yɛla.
en: then I will remember my covenant with Jacob. I will also remember my covenant with Isaac. And my covenant with Abraham. And I will remember the land.

dag: Di chɛliya ka Kɔhat daŋ niriba la ti kpi Lɛvinim ni.
en: You must not let the tribe of the Kohathite clans be eliminated from the Levites.

dag: Neesim neeri wuntizɔriba sani, ka bɛn biɛhigu be tibi bɛ suhuri ni mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Light shines on the righteous, and gladness on the good.

dag: Dinzuɣu Mɔabnima, kummiya! Sokam kummi Mɔabnim zuɣu. Bɛ ni ti kum Kiriharɛsɛt bindira zuɣu.
en: Because of their pride, everyone in Moab will mourn. They will wish for the way things used to be. They will wish for the raisin cakes from Kir Hareseth.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu zuɣusaa polo dunɔdal la, ka daa lan me Ofɛl goondaa la pahi.
en: Jotham rebuilt the Upper Gate of the Lord s Temple. He did much building on the wall at the place named Ophel.

dag: Saha shɛli Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni daa kpe hal ti pibigi gol so ŋun daŋ tooni puuni la, bɛna n-daa baai du li chaŋ ti kari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be vinvamli ni wulimpuhili polo mini wulinluhili polo zaa la.
en: They were the soldiers who crossed the Jordan River in the first month of the year, when it was flooded over its banks. They chased away the people in the valley who were on both sides of the river.

dag: Yawɛ, wuhim ma a soya, ka chɛ ka m baŋ li.
en: Teach me your ways, O Lord ; make them known to me.
