dag: Nyɔhi ni tuɣiri chani shɛm la, karim ba ka bɛ chaŋ lala. Shigbaŋ ni miriti buɣim ka nyɛligiri shɛm la, chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri nyɛligi lala Naawuni tooni.
en: As smoke is blown away, so he drives them off; as wax melts in front of the fire, so do the wicked perish in God's presence.

dag: Ka o shi sara maligu biŋkɔbigu maa ŋ-ŋmahiŋmah o.
en: You must remove the skin from that animal and then cut the animal into pieces.

dag: Ka Babilɔn tɔbbihi bɛn zaa daa be sapashin kpɛm maa sani daa daai goon shɛŋa din daa gili Jɛrusalɛm la zaa luhi.
en: The whole Chaldean army under the commander of the guard tore down the walls surrounding Jerusalem.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa ha daa di li tiɣi, ka bɛ daa laɣisi bɔrɔbɔro chɛhi mini zimburisa din guui pali piɛr ayopɔin.
en: They all ate and had enough. Then the disciples took up seven baskets full of pieces left over.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yɛli, N nini nya Naawuni ka bi kpi. Dinzuɣu ka o daa boli nimaani yuli Pɛniɛl.
en: Jacob said, I have seen God face to face, and I am still alive. So he named the place Peniel.

dag: Yawɛ, so lan kani ŋ-ŋman a, ka Naawuni so mi lan kani pah a zuɣu kaman ti tiba ni wum shɛm.
en: No other god is like you, Lord —you alone are God. Everything we have heard about you is true.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ chɛ ka bɛ yihi buɣijɛmbo maa bɛ kɔbili ni, ka zaŋ bɛ na kpima chaŋ katiŋa ka chɛ ma, ka n kul be bɛ sani sahakam.
en: Now let them take their sexual sins and the dead bodies of their kings far away from me. Then I will live among them forever.

dag: ka maligumaana maa ti lih o, bimmɔriŋ piɛlli yi be o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ zuɣu din chɛ ka nimaani kɔbiri leei zaɣ piɛla ka mari na be bimmɔriŋ maa ni.
en: If he discovers that the sore spot is white with pus and that the hair around it has also turned white.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba mini bɛ jintɔriba zaa daa bɔri daliri shɛli din ni chɛ ka bɛ tɔɣisi luhi Yisa ka ku o, amaa ka daa lee bi nya di daliri.
en: The chief priests and the whole council tried to find someone to accuse Jesus of a crime, so they could put him to death. But they could not find anyone to accuse him.

dag: Dama nyini n-daa ti ma kpiɔŋ ni n tuhi tɔbu. Nyini n-daa chɛ ka n no n dimnim firi tiŋa.
en: You helped me win victories and forced my attackers to fall victim to me.

dag: Ka n daa bɔhi n dan maa, Ka paɣ yi ti bi saɣi n-doli ma na.
en: I asked my master, What if the young woman refuses to come with me.

dag: Naawuni ni lo nia shɛli ni di saha ti paai ka o pal li la nyɛla ni o ti laɣim binnamda zaa luɣ yini: Binnamda bɛn be alizanda ni mini bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni, ka Masia ti nyɛ bɛ zuɣulana.
en: Gods goal was to finish his plan when the right time came. He planned that all things in heaven and on earth be joined together with Christ as the head.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ yuli pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chani hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: May the Lord s name be praised now and forever.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni ti chɛ ka yi nya alahiziba binyara kaman yi ni daa yi Ijipti na, ka n chɛ ka yi nya li shɛm la.
en: Work miracles for us, Lord , as you did in the days when you brought us out of Egypt.

dag: Amaa o daa lee bi wurimla luɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni daa jɛmdi buɣa la; ka niriba daa na kul chani nimaani nti maani maligu, ka tuɣindi tulaale zim. Jɔtam n-nyɛ ŋun daa me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu zuɣusaa polo dunol la.
en: However, he didnt remove the shrines. The people continued to sacrifice and burn incense at them. Jotham rebuilt the Upper Gate of the LORDs temple.

dag: Ka Jɔsia daa nyɛ Jɛkɔnia min o tizɔbihi ba, bɛ ni daa gbahi ba chaŋ Babilɔn saha shɛl la.
en: Josiah was the father of Jechoniah and his brothers. This was at the time of the exile to Babylon.

dag: Yinim Aduna zuliya, niŋmiya Yawɛ naani! Ŋuna n-nyɛ yi sɔŋda ni ŋun guli ya.
en: Trust in the Lord , you priests of God. He helps you and protects you.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni maa. Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ n-nyɛ yi tiligira. N ni zaɣisi Ijipti mini Itiɔpia ni Siiba, ka tiligi ya.
en: I am the Lord , your God, the Holy One of Israel, the God who saves you. I gave up Egypt, Ethiopia, and the region of Seba in exchange for you.

dag: N jɛmbu duu yi ti be bɛ sani saha shɛlikam, di saha zuliya kam ni ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ m-mali Izraɛlnim ka bɛ be kasi. .
en: When I place my Temple there to be among them forever, then the nations will know that I, the Lord , have chosen Israel to be my own people.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Dauda daa kpe nti ʒini Yawɛ tooni ka yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, m mi lee nyɛ ŋuni bee n daŋ lee nyɛ banima, ka a ti zaŋ ma zali n ni ʒe zaashe shɛl ni ŋɔ?.
en: Then King David went into the Tent of the Lord 's presence, sat down, and prayed, I am not worthy of what you have already done for me, Lord God, nor is my family.

dag: Ka Ribɛka daa suug o koyuli maa na yomyom gbibi ka yɛl o, N dana, nyuma.
en: She said, Drink, sir. Then she quickly lowered the water jar with her hands and gave him some water to drink.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Izraɛlnim daa chaŋ gili Jɛriko goma hal ti paai daba ayopɔin dali, ka goma maa lu.
en: God's people had faith, and when they had walked around the city of Jericho for seven days, its walls fell down.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nya din niŋ maa yɛli ba di ni niŋ shɛm ka alizin biɛri ni daa ʒi do so zuɣu maa ti lan leei ninvuɣ maŋli maa yaha.
en: Those who had seen it told the people how the man had been cured.

dag: ni n ni ti yɛn darigi Izraɛlnim tibili bɛ tuumbiɛri zuɣu dahin shɛli, n ni ti saɣim Bɛtɛl sara maligu bimbina, ka ŋme n-kabisi di lɔrisi ni tandaɣa din sansaya la bahi tiŋa.
en: Israel sinned, and I will punish them for their sins. And when I do, I will also destroy the altars at Bethel. The horns of the altar will be cut off and fall to the ground.

dag: Ka tiŋgula ŋun daa tam Jɛziriil pii zuɣu daa ti lihi nya Jɛhu min o niriba ni kanna ka yɛli, N nya niriba ka bɛ kanna. Ka Jɔram yɛl o, Timmi wɔribara ka o chaŋ ti tuhi ba soli m-bɔhi ba, Alaafee? .
en: A guard on duty in the watchtower at Jezreel saw Jehu and his men approaching. I see some men riding up! he called out. Joram replied, Send a rider to find out if they are friends or enemies.

dag: Amaa ka Pita yɛl o, Zɔri, m bi baŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa gbinni. Pita ni daa kul yɛri maa, o noli daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka nolɔɣu dii kum.
en: But Peter answered, Man, I don't know what you are talking about! At once, while he was still speaking, a rooster crowed.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino daa shiri chɛ n-shɛligi maligumaaniba zuɣulan dabili nudirigu tibili bahi.
en: And one of them did use his sword. He cut off the right ear of the servant of the high priest.

dag: ka Hilikia nyɛ Amizi bia, ka Amizi nyɛ Bani bia, ka Bani nyɛ Shɛmɛr bia.
en: Hilkiah was Amzis son. Amzi was Banis son. Bani was Shemers son.

dag: Amaa ka yi bɔhira, Bɔzuɣu ka bidibiga ku di wahala o ba tuumbiɛri zuɣu? Bidibiga maa yi nyɛla ŋun niŋdi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm ni din tuhi, ka nyɛ ŋun doli n zaligunim zaa viɛnyɛliŋga, biɛhiŋ kani, o ni be.
en: You may wonder why a son isn't punished for the sins of his father. It is because the son does what is right and obeys my laws.

dag: Zuɣu ni kpahibu ka a mali darigiri ninsalinim tibili bɛ daalahichi zuɣu, ka saɣindi bɛ ni yuri binshɛŋa zaa kaman binneembihi n-nyɛ li la. Yɛlimaŋli, ninsal biɛhigu shiri ŋmanila vuhim.
en: You punish people for doing wrong to teach them the right way to live. As a moth destroys cloth, you destroy what people love. Yes, our lives are like a small cloud that quickly disappears. Selah.

dag: Ka Mɔabnim daa zɔri Izraɛlnim pam, dama Izraɛlnim maa daa galisiya pam. Dabiɛm daa kpe Mɔabnim pam Izraɛlnim maa zuɣu.
en: The Moabites greatly feared the people, for they were so numerous. The Moabites were terrified of the Israelites.

dag: ka bɛ mi ni zaŋ li yɛli tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ nima. Yawɛ, bɛ pun wum ni a be niriba ŋɔ sani. Yawɛ, bɛ nini nya a, ka a sagbani ʒe bɛ zuɣusaa, ka a be sagban ni m-be bɛ tooni wuntaŋ ni, ka be sagbani maa ni n-nyɛ neesim yuŋ.
en: Theyll tell the inhabitants of this land. Theyve heard that you, LORD, are with this people. You, LORD, appear to them face-to-face. Your cloud stands over them. You go before them in a column of cloud by day and in a column of lightning by night.

dag: Ka bɛnkam zaa dol o zaligunim maa be o ni, ka o mi be bɛ ni. O ni zaŋ o Shi so ti ti la n-chɛ ka ti baŋ ni o be ti ni.
en: All who obey Gods commands live in God. And God lives in them. How do we know that God lives in us? We know because of the Spirit he gave us.

dag: a kul lɔrila saɣiŋgu nia. A zilinli ŋmanila piliŋ. A kul dolila ʒiŋmabo soli sahakam.
en: You make plans to ruin others; your tongue is like a sharp razor. You are always inventing lies.

dag: Ka nachin kpɛm maa daa kul maag o ni n-lihir o ni o nya Yawɛ chɛ ka o dila nasara o chandi maa ni maa bee.
en: The man kept watching her in silence, to see if the Lord had given him success.

dag: Ka Bɛtishɛmɛshi ninvuɣ shɛba daa lihi Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa puuni, ka o daa ku bɛ ninvuɣ pisopɔin zaa. Ka niriba daa kum bɛ zuɣu, Yawɛ ni daa ku ba pam shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: But no priests were there to lead the celebration when the men of Beth Shemesh saw the Lord s Holy Box. So the Lord killed men from Beth Shemesh. The people of Beth Shemesh cried loudly because of this hard punishment.

dag: Ka Naawuni yi ti ba pin shɛli noo ti gba ni daa niŋ ti Duuma Yisa Masia yɛda ka o ti ti la, ŋuni n-lee nyɛ ma ka n ŋmɛri Naawuni naŋgbankpeeni.
en: God gave these people the same gift he gave us who believed in the Lord Jesus Christ. So how could I object to what God wanted to do.

dag: Soli din kuni neesim biɛhigu shee lee be ya, bee zibisim ni be luɣ shɛli lee be ya.
en: Wheres the road to the place where light dwells; darkness, wheres it located?.

dag: Amaa ka Baanabas daa zaŋ o tahi Yisa tuumba la sani nti kahigi Sool ni daa nya ti Duuma sol ni ka o yɛl o shɛm wuhi ba, ka lan yɛli ba Sool ni daa zaŋ Yisa yuli yihi waazu ni suhukpeeni shɛm Damaskus.
en: Then Barnabas brought Saul to the apostles and told them the story about how Saul saw the Lord on the way and that the Lord had spoken to Saul. He also told them about the confidence with which Saul had preached in the name of Jesus in Damascus.

dag: ka yɛl o, A yi shiri nyɛla Naawuni Bia, nyin bahim amaŋa n-lu tiŋ sa, dama di sabiya, Naawuni ni bah o malaikanim noli, ka bɛ gbib a. Bɛ ni gbib a bɛ nuhi ni, ka a napɔŋ ku tuui kuɣili kam. .
en: Since you are Gods Son, throw yourself down; for it is written, I will command my angels concerning you, and they will take you up in their hands so that you wont hit your foot on a stone. .

dag: Ka Saimɔn Pita daa bɔhi Yisa, N Duuma, ya ka a chana? Ka o garigi n-yɛl o, N ni chani luɣ shɛli maa, a ku tooi doli ma pumpɔŋɔ; amaa a ni ti doli ma saha shɛli.
en: Simon Peter said to Jesus, Lord, where are you going? Jesus answered, Where I am going, you cant follow me now, but you will follow later.

dag: A ni sabi jaaŋgbe shɛŋa zuɣu maa yi ti be a nuu ni ka bɛ nya li.
en: Hold in your hand the two sticks and let the people see them.

dag: Naawuni, di shini; Naawuni, di fo, a mi di kpalim ʒiya!.
en: God, dont keep quiet! Dont close your ears! Please say something, God.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana mini Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn daa laɣim o sani na maa pah o zuɣu n-laɣim zani Alikauli Adaka maa tooni n-kɔri piɛri mini naɣilahi pam bɛn ka kalinli m-mali sara.
en: King Solomon and all the people of Israel assembled in front of the Covenant Box and sacrificed a large number of sheep and cattle—too many to count.

dag: Ka Mikaya garigi yɛl o, N nya ka Izraɛlnim zaa kul yɛrigila zoya zuɣu m-be kaman piɛ shɛb bɛn ka gula. Ka Yawɛ yɛli, Niriba ŋɔ ka zuɣulana; chɛ ka bɛ zaa yinoyino lab kuli ni suhudoo. .
en: So Micaiah answered, I can see the army of Israel scattered all over the hills, like sheep with no one to lead them. This is what the Lord says: These men have no leaders. Let them go home in peace.

dag: ni Lɔd ni Ono din daa nyɛ Nuhi Tuumbaŋdiba Vinvamli la ni.
en: Lod, and Ono, and in Craftsmen's Valley.

dag: N wuh a yɛm, ka wuh a so shɛŋa din tuhi.
en: I have shown you the way that makes sense; I have guided you along the right path.

dag: Ka Dauda tɔbbihi maa daa chirigi Absalom ka o ba o buntaaŋa zɔra, ka buntaaŋa maa daa ti yɛn zaŋ o gari oki ti titali gbini, ka o zuɣu kpe n-shɛbisi oki tia maa wula ni ka o yili zuɣusaa, ka buntaaŋa maa zo ka chɛ o ka o kpalim yiliya.
en: Suddenly Absalom met some of David's men. Absalom was riding a mule, and as it went under a large oak tree, Absalom's head got caught in the branches. The mule ran on and Absalom was left hanging in midair.

dag: Juda Naa Amazia Jɔash bia la ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pinaanu saha ka Izraɛl Naa Jɛhɔash bia Naa Jɛrɔbɔam daa di Izraɛl nam Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuun pihinahi ni yini.
en: Jeroboam, the son of Israels King Joash, became king in Samaria in the fifteenth year of Judahs King Amaziah, Jehoashs son. He ruled for forty-one years.

dag: Filip daa mali bipuɣins anahi bɛn na bi kuli dɔbba, ka nyɛ bɛn tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: He had four unmarried daughters who had the gift of prophesying.

dag: Ka n ni chɛ ka dab paɣ bia maa gba nam zuliya, dama o gba nyɛla a zuliya.
en: But I will make of your servants son a great nation too, because he is also your descendant.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ yino nɔzaɣisibo zuɣu yi chɛ ka niriba pam leeg alahichinima, lala zuɣu n-chɛ ka ninvuɣ yino mi nɔdeebo zuɣu gba ni chɛ ka niriba pam yi taali ni Naawuni sani.
en: Many people were made righteous through the obedience of one person, just as many people were made sinners through the disobedience of one person.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ paɣi Yawɛ o yurilim maŋli min o ni tumdi alahiziba tuun shɛŋa tiri daadamnim la zuɣu.
en: Let them thank the LORD for his faithful love and his wondrous works for all people.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Nyamiya, n lɔrila nia ni n chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu lu yi daŋ ŋɔ niriba zuɣu, ka yi ku tooi yi di ni, ka yi mi ku lan tooi chaŋ karimbaan chandi, dama di ti yɛn nyɛla zaɣ biɛɣu saha.
en: Therefore, the LORD proclaims: I myself am devising an evil against this family from which you will not be able to remove your necks! You will no longer be able to go about arrogantly, for it will be an evil time.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun daa be Izraɛlnim sani mɔɣu maa ni saha shɛli malaika so ŋun daa be bɛ san la ni daa tɔɣis o mini ti yaannim yɛtɔɣa Sinai Zoli gbin la. Nimaani ka ŋun Anabi Musa daa deei Naawuni yɛtɔɣa din nyɛ nyɛvili yɛtɔɣa la ti ti.
en: Moses brought our people together in the desert, and the angel spoke to him on Mount Sinai. There he was given these life-giving words to pass on to us.

dag: N Naawuni maa yɛliya, Alahichinim ka suhudoo.
en: There is no peace, says my God, for the wicked.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ daa na bi mi o, amaa lala zuɣu ka n daŋna nti baptaiziri niriba kom ni ni o ti yi palo ka Izraɛlnim baŋ o.
en: I didn't know who he was. But I came to baptize you with water, so that everyone in Israel would see him.

dag: Gbaŋ ŋɔ yila man Pool ŋun nyɛ Naawuni dabili mini Yisa Masia tuun so o ni tim ni n ti kpaŋsi Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda yɛda mini bɛ yɛlimaŋli baŋbu din nyɛ din luri Naawuni sizuura la sanna.
en: From Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ. I encourage God's own people to have more faith and to understand the truth about religion.

dag: N ni yi be bɛ sani maa, n yi gbib ba la a yuli din nyɛ yu shɛli a ni daa wuhi ma la zuɣu. N kul gbib ba viɛnyɛliŋga hal ka bɛ ni yino bi bɔrigi naɣila bahi yoli bia la ni di chɛ ka nyin Naawuni yɛligu niŋ pali.
en: When I was with them, I watched over them in your name, the name you gave to me, and I kept them safe. None of them were lost, except the one who was destined for destruction, so that scripture would be fulfilled.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Ibrahimma daa teeg o nuu kpuɣi sua ni o kɔrig o bia maa.
en: Then he picked up the knife to kill him.

dag: Saha shɛli ha yi ni daa na ʒi Naawuni la, yi daa bela dunia ŋɔ binshɛŋa din pa bin jɛmda dabitim ni.
en: At the time, when you didnt know God, you were enslaved by things that arent gods by nature.

dag: Nyin Firawuna suhu ni daa ti yiɣisi bah a tumtumdiba zuɣu, ka a zaŋ m min a bɔrɔbɔro shɛriba kpɛm ti kpɛhi duu a tɔbbihi bɛn gul a sapashin kpɛm yiŋ la.
en: You were angry with the chief baker and me, and you put us in prison in the house of the captain of the guard.

dag: Dauda daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi yaha, bɛna n-daa nyɛ: Ibihar mini Ɛlishama ni Ɛlifɛlɛt.
en: He had nine other sons: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naawuni ni laɣim shɛba, sal ŋun miri ka o woligi ba.
en: Therefore, humans must not pull apart what God has put together.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Pool tahi bɛ jintɔriba laɣiŋgu shee din yuli daa booni Ariɔpagus la ti yɛl o, Ti bɔri ni a wuhi ti wuhiri pal shɛli a ni wuhiri ŋɔ ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: They took Paul to a meeting of the Areopagus council. They said, Please explain to us this new idea that you have been teaching.

dag: Daadam, zaŋm a nini kpa Gɔg ŋun be Magɔg tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka nyɛ Mɛshɛk mini Tubal nazuɣu ŋɔ polo tɔɣis anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛnd o.
en: Son of man, look toward Gog in the land of Magog. He is the most important leader of the nations of Meshech and Tubal. Speak for me against Gog.

dag: N niriba maa ŋmanila piɛ shɛb bɛn bɔrigi, bɛn guli ba taɣi ba kpɛhi yɔɣu ŋ-ŋmaligiri ba gindi zoya zuɣu mini daboya zuɣu, ka bɛ tam bɛ biɛhigu shee yɛla.
en: My people, you are lost sheep abandoned in the mountains by their shepherds. You don't even remember your resting place.

dag: Ka di simdi ka o ti zaŋ suhudoo maligu biŋkɔbigu maa biŋkpam din pili namanama zuɣu la mini kpam din be namanama maa ni zaa.
en: Then you can offer a food gift to the LORD from the communal sacrifice of well-being: the fat that covers and surrounds the insides.

dag: Hal ŋun pun beni maa yi yuui m-paai yuun tusaayi gba, amaa ka bi di binshɛli nyaɣisim, pa luɣ yini ka bɛ zaa kuna?.
en: He might live years. But if he does not enjoy life, then the baby who was born dead has found the easiest way to the same end.

dag: A zaŋla neesim ye kaman binyɛrigu la. A teela sagbana sɔŋ kaman tanti la.
en: You wear light like a robe. You spread out the skies like a curtain.

dag: Ka Ananias daa wum yɛligu ŋɔ ka dii lu n-kpi, ka dabiɛm daa kpe bɛnkam zaa daa wum li.
en: When Ananias heard these words, he dropped dead. Everyone who heard this conversation was terrified.

dag: N daa kuhi boli Yawɛ ŋun simdi paɣibu ŋɔ, ka tiligi n dimnim nuu ni.
en: I called to the Lord for help, and he saved me from my enemies. He is worthy of my praise!.

dag: A mi n yibu saha ni n dɔnibu saha, ka mi n soya zaa.
en: You know where I go and where I lie down. You know everything I do.

dag: Ka Nɛgɛbinim ti deei Iso Zoli su; ka bɛn be zolɔna ni wulinluhili polo la ti deei Filistia tiŋgbɔŋ su. Ka Izraɛlnim ni ti deei Ifriim mini Samaria tiŋgbɔŋ su. Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya mi ti deei Giliad su.
en: The people of Israel who live in the Southern Desert will take the land of Edom. Those who live in the hills will capture Philistia, Ephraim, and Samaria. And the tribe of Benjamin will conquer Gilead.

dag: N ni daa kul suhiri Naawuni maa, ka Gabirɛl ŋun nyɛ n ni daa pun nya do so tuuli ʒii la ni la daa yiɣi ka n ni daa be luɣ shɛli maa na. Zaawuni sara maligu saha n-daa nyɛ li.
en: while I was still speaking this prayer, the man Gabriel approached me at the time of the evening offering. This was the same Gabriel I had seen in my earlier vision. He was weary with exhaustion.

dag: Izraɛl ni daa nya Yisifu bihi maa, o daa bɔhimi, Ka banima n-lee bɔŋɔ.
en: When Jacob saw Joseph's sons, he asked, Who are these boys.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ bɛ yiinila yila maani ma ansarisi, ka n leei bɛ ni maani so ansarisi.
en: Now their sons sing songs to make fun of me. My name has become a bad word to them.

dag: Yaa n Naawuni, ka dimbɔŋɔ na nyɛla din pɔra a sani, ka a lan yɛli n yili ni ti yɛn be shɛm saha shɛli din na kanna. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, a lan wuhi ma n zuliya ni ti yɛn be shɛm yuma din kanna.
en: But even this was too small in your eyes, God. You have spoken about the future of your servants dynasty and have chosen me as an important person, LORD God.

dag: Chɛ ka di biɛŋmarisi leei zibisim, ka chɛ ka di niŋ neesim tahima, amaa ka bi nya li. Di chɛ ka asiba neesim lan neei di ni.
en: Keep the morning star from shining; give that night no hope of dawn.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni sakom leei taŋkpa zim ka duɣiduɣi kɔŋko yiri sagbana ni luri yi zuɣu na hal ti kun ya.
en: The Lord will not send rain—only sand and dust will fall from the sky. It will come down on you until you are destroyed.

dag: n-chaŋ ti ʒe Yisa sani kumda, ka o nintam tɔɣiri luri Yisa naba zuɣu, ka o mal li paɣiri Yisa naba maa, ka mal o zabiri nyɛhiri li, ka bɔbindi li ka zaŋ tulaale maa ʒiɛri li.
en: and stood behind Jesus, by his feet, crying and wetting his feet with her tears. Then she dried his feet with her hair, kissed them, and poured the perfume on them.

dag: Dama laɣiyubo nyɛla bin biɛɣukam nyaɣili; ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri daa kul ye liɣiri nyabu zuɣu la birigi ka chɛ yɛda niŋbu soli dolibu, ka suhugarigu balibu kam din be kaman piɛma la kuhi bɛ suhuri.
en: The love of money causes all kinds of trouble. Some people want money so much they have given up their faith and caused themselves a lot of pain.

dag: Yi yi gbibi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ fukumsi zaligunima, ka dol o soli, ŋun Yawɛ ni zaŋ ya leeg o niriba bɛn be kasi kaman o ni daa po pɔri yɛli ya shɛm la.
en: If you follow and obey the Lord , he will make you his own special people, just as he promised.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ daa yɛli ma, Cham Shɛbina ŋun nyɛ nayili tumtumdiba zuɣulan la sani nti bɔh o.
en: The Lord All-Powerful is sending me with this message for Shebna, the prime minister:.

dag: Ka maligumaana ni zaŋ o nubil suɣi ʒim maa n-zaŋ vie binyila din be bɛ ni nyɔri sara maligu buɣim bimbin shɛli zuɣu la, ka kpaai ʒi shɛli din kpalim bahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara maligu nyɔri buɣim sara maligu bimbin shɛli zuɣu la gbini.
en: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood of the animal, put it on the projections at the corners of the altar, and pour out the rest of it at the base of the altar.

dag: Yi ni dɔɣi bi shɛb zaa puuni, so kani n-nyɛ ŋun ni tooi wuhi ya soli. So mi ka yi ni wumsi bi shɛb maa zaa puuni n-nyɛ ŋun ni tooi vɔn ya.
en: Theres no one to guide her among all the children she bore; theres no one to take her by the hand among all the children she raised.

dag: N ni bɔhim a zaligunim maa, ka zaŋ n zaɣa niŋ a soya ni.
en: I study your instructions; I examine your teachings.

dag: Saha shɛli n ni daa yihi Izraɛlnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la hal ni zuŋɔ n na ʒi m be duu, amaa suɣili ni ka n kul be ka yi mali ma ginda.
en: In fact, I havent lived in a temple from the day I brought Israel out of Egypt until now. Instead, I have been traveling around in a tent and in a dwelling.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka ti doli din ni chɛ ka naŋgban yini be ti sunsuuni mini din ni kpaŋsi tab suhuri.
en: So lets try as hard as we can to do what will bring peace. Lets do whatever will help each other grow stronger in faith.

dag: Ka o daa ŋmaligi yɛli sapashin maa, Kulima! A ni niŋ yɛda shɛm maa zuɣu, di ni niŋ lala. Ka o yiŋbia maa daa shiri kpaŋ di saha maa.
en: Then Jesus said to the officer, Go home, and what you believe will be done for you. And the officer's servant was healed that very moment.

dag: Kɛnan ni daa dɔɣi Mahalalɛl maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinii ni pihinahi. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: After Mahalalel was born, Kenan lived years and had other sons and daughters.

dag: Di saha ka Zɛdɛkia Chɛnaana bia la daa chaŋ ti lab Mikaya tapaɣa, ka bɔh o, Wula ka Yawɛ shia niŋ yi n ni kana ti tɔɣis a yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ.
en: Zedekiah walked up to Micaiah and slapped him on the face. Then he asked, Do you really think the Lord would speak to you and not to me.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa laɣim Musa sanna ka o ti zaŋ Yawɛ ni daa yɛl o zaligu shɛŋa yɛla Sinai Zoli zuɣu maa ti ba.
en: After that, all the Israelites came near as well, and Moses commanded them everything that the LORD had spoken with him on Mount Sinai.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni ti ti Mɔrɛshɛtigatinim chɛbisibu pina, ka Akizibnim ni ti nyɛla bɛn yɔhindi Izraɛl nanima.
en: Now you will have to give a going-away gift to Moresheth. Israel's kings will discover that they cannot trust the town of Achzib.

dag: Duuma yino mini ti ni niŋ yɛda yin shɛl la ni baptaizibu yini m-beni.
en: We have only one Lord, one faith, and one baptism.

dag: Nandan gbansɔɣu ni tooi niŋ bindirigu pam, amaa ka bɛn doli soli din bi tuhi fa li.
en: Unused fields could yield plenty of food for the poor, but unjust people keep them from being farmed.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa ŋmaligi lu Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba bɛn kpalim zuɣu n-zaŋ takɔbi ku ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri ni bɛ ni daa nya binneen shɛb zaa; ka daa niŋ buɣim nyo fɔntin shɛŋa din daa kpalim zaa.
en: The Israelites turned back and went to every town in Benjamin's territory, killing all the people and animals, and setting the towns on fire.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli, Di karitiy o; dama so kani ŋun ni tooi zaŋ n yuli tum alahiziba tuma ka dii lan ŋmaligi galim ma.
en: Jesus said to his disciples: Don't stop him! No one who works miracles in my name will soon turn and say something bad about me.

dag: Dindali maa ka Yawɛ daa lo Ibram alikauli yɛli, N ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ti a zuliya. Zaŋ Ijipti mɔɣili noli hal ti paai Yufretiiz Mɔɣ tital la noli.
en: So on that day the Lord made a promise and an agreement with Abram. He said, I will give this land to your descendants. I will give them the land between the River of Egypt and the great river Euphrates.

dag: N ni ti lo a alikauli ka a baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I myself will establish my covenant with you, and you will know that I am the LORD.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli ba, Yi yi yɛn zaŋ Izraɛlnim Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa labisi, yin di zaŋya di kɔŋko labisi, amaa yin zaŋmiya alahichi sanyoo pini m-pahi di zuɣu din ni chɛ ka yi nya faako ka baŋ o ni darigiri yi tibili daliri shɛli zuɣu maa.
en: The priests and magicians answered, If you send back the Holy Box of the God of Israel, dont send it away empty. You must offer gifts to the God of Israel. Then you will be healed. You must do this so that God will stop punishing you.

dag: ka daa zaŋ fɔŋ maa puri mini di tiŋkpansi zaa ti Kalɛb ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛfune bia la.
en: The fields and villages, however, that belonged to the city were assigned to Caleb son of Jephunneh.

dag: Dindali maa, bɛ ni ti yili yila mali ya ansarisi, ka kum ni fabila pam yɛli, Ti bahi yoli zaa, Yawɛ taɣi n niriba fali ti shɛba. O deei li n sani. O piripiri ti puri tari bɛn gbahi ti maa. .
en: On that day, a taunt will be raised against you; someone will wail bitterly: We are utterly destroyed! He exchanges the portion of my people; he removes what belongs to me; he gives away our fields to a rebel.

dag: N kuhimi ka n nina mɔhi, ka zibisim titali limsi n niŋkari.
en: My face is red from crying. There are dark rings around my eyes.

dag: Yi yi bi birigi Vuhim Dabisili dali zaligu, ka bi tumdi yi suhuyubu dindali maa, ka tiri li jilima, ka bi chani soya, ka bi tumdi tuma bee n-tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ yoya dindali maa.
en: If you stop trampling the Sabbath, stop doing whatever you want on my holy day, and consider the Sabbath a delight, sacred to the LORD, honored, and honor it instead of doing things your way, seeking what you want and doing business as usual.

dag: Di saha o ni tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa ni suhuyiɣisili, ka kpɛhi ba dabiɛm o suhuyiɣisili puuni yɛli.
en: Then he warns them in anger and terrifies them with his fury.

dag: Ti ni daa chɛbisi ba bahi ka ti ŋariŋ yiɣisi n-zaŋ sochibiga nti paai Koos n-naanyi neei biɛɣu m-paai Rodis n-daa ti yi nimaani chaŋ Patara.
en: After we tore ourselves away from them, we set sail on a straight course to Cos, reaching Rhodes the next day, and then Patara.

dag: Masia Naawunitali yiko chɛ ka ti nya binshɛɣukam zaa din simdi ni ti zaŋ mali nyɛvili mini biɛhigu din luri Naawuni sizuura, ŋuna ŋun bol ti o jilima min o zaɣisuntali baŋbu puuni la zuɣu.
en: God's divine power has given us everything we need to live a truly religious life through our knowledge of the one who called us to share in his own glory and goodness.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan yɛli, So na ʒi n-nyo firila zaŋ lɔɣu pil li bee n-zaŋ li zali garo lɔŋni, amaa o ni zaŋ li mi tam binshɛli zuɣu ni bɛnkam kpɛri yili maa ni na nyari li.
en: No one lights a lamp and then covers it with a bowl or hides it under a bed. Instead, they put the lamp on a lampstand so that the people who come in will have enough light to see.

dag: Yi ni ti sa wain tihi ka mali di ni, amaa yi ti ku pɔhi di wala bee n-nyu di wain, dama zunzuya ni ti ŋubi di zaa.
en: You will plant vineyards and work hard in them. But you will not gather the grapes or drink the wine from them, because the worms will eat them.

dag: Di saha maa Izraɛlnim daa ka naa, dinzuɣu sokam daa kul tumdila o suhu ni yu shɛm.
en: This was before kings ruled Israel, so all the Israelites did whatever they thought was right.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma kpe du titali puuni nti buɣisi di pilanima. Yaɣa maa zaa pilanim maa zaɣ yini kam yɛliŋ daa nyɛla mita ata.
en: He brought me to the main hall, and he measured the arches. They were nine feet deep on both sides, so that was also the depth of the tent.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa je suli niŋ bɛ ʒiɛmani maa nima ka yɛli, Bɛ kul birigirila bɛ suhuri ni waawaayili, ka zaɣisiri n soya dolibu.
en: Then God got tired of them and said, You people never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.

dag: Ka n daai yi ni zaŋ bimpiɛlli paligi goon shɛli maa luhi tiŋa n-wurim li ka chɛ di tanzahi zali. Di ni ti lu n-kun ya, ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: The lying prophets have tried to cover up the evil in Jerusalem, but I will tear down the city, all the way to its foundations. And when it collapses, those prophets will be killed, and everyone will know that I have done these things.

dag: N ni tum alahichi Yawɛ sani zuɣu, n ni deeg o suhuyiɣisili hal ka o ti lan zani n nyaaŋa n-kari ma saria, ka ti ma yɛlimaŋli. O ni zaŋ ma yihi neesim ni ka n ti nya o wuntitali ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: We have sinned against the Lord , so now we must endure his anger for a while. But in the end he will defend us and right the wrongs that have been done to us. He will bring us out to the light; we will live to see him save us.

dag: Amaa ka Ɛsta daa chaŋ naa sani, ka naa ti zali zaligu, ka chɛ ka bɛ sab li sɔŋ ni Haman ni lo nia biɛ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Yɛhudianim polo maa simdi ni di ŋmaligi dila ŋuna. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Haman maa min o bidibisi yili gar dari.
en: Esther went to King Xerxes and asked him to save her people. Then the king gave written orders for Haman and his sons to be punished in the same terrible way that Haman had in mind for the Jews. So they were hanged.

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam daa di nam n-niŋ nam maa ni la yuun pisinaayi, ka naanyi yi dunia yili; ka o bia Nadab daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Jeroboam ruled as king for twenty-two years. He died and was buried, and his son Nadab succeeded him as king.

dag: Yawɛ, n ni zaŋ n suhuyubu pini mali sara ti a. Yawɛ, n ni paɣ a yuli, dama a nyɛla ŋun viɛla.
en: I will gladly offer you a sacrifice, O Lord ; I will give you thanks because you are good.

dag: Shaul bia n-daa nyɛ Shallum, o yaaŋa n-daa nyɛ Mibisam, ka o yaantibichee nyɛ Mishima.
en: The descendants of Shaul included his son Shallum, his grandson Mibsam, and his great-grandson Mishma.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn muɣisiri bɛ yinsinim ti ku lan mali binshɛli yaha, ka jɛra ni ti tumdi tuma tiri yɛnnima.
en: Those who cause trouble for their families will inherit nothing but the wind. A foolish person will end up as a servant to one who is wise.

dag: Chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi bahila zuliya shɛb bɛn bi mi a la mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi jɛmd a la zuɣu. Dama bɛna n-vali Yaakubu zuliya. Bɛ vali Yaakubu zuliya n-naai ba; ka chɛ ka bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ zani dabari.
en: Pour out your wrath on the nations that ignore you and on the people who dont call on you, since they have devoured Jacob; they have devoured him completely and ruined his country.

dag: Nyin daadam, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa n-jɛndi Gɔg yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyini Gɔg ŋun nyɛ Mɛshɛk mini Tubal nazuɣu ŋɔ, m bi ʒe a nyaaŋa.
en: Son of man, speak against Gog for me. Tell him that this is what the Lord GOD says: Gog, you are the most important leader of the countries Meshech and Tubal, but I am against you.

dag: Nanim daa laɣimya n-kana ni bɛ ti tuhi tɔbu.
en: The kings gathered together and came to attack Mount Zion.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋdi binshɛŋa nyɔri buɣim maani sara mini kawana ni chi sara maligu ni alahichi sanyoo sara maligu ni taali sanyoo sara maligu ni maligumaana leebu sara maligu ni suhudoo sara maligu zaligu m-bɔŋɔ.
en: This concludes the Instructions for the entirely burned offering, the grain offering, the purification offering, the compensation offering, the ordination offering, and the communal sacrifice of well-being.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa niŋ naɣitɔroko palli ni n-yi Abinadab yiŋ chana, ka Yuza mini Ahio daa vɔri li chana.
en: The people moved Gods Holy Box from Abinadabs house and put it on a new wagon. Uzzah and Ahio were driving the wagon.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa be sagban ni n-siɣina ti zan o sani nimaani ka yɛli, N yuli m-booni Yawɛ.
en: Then the Lord came down to him in a cloud, stood there with Moses, and spoke his own name.

dag: Chɛ ka n di wain tiwala n-nya kpiɔŋ, ka di apil ka n nini neei, dama doo bɔbu chɛmi ka n ni chɔɣisi zaa.
en: Restore my strength with raisins and refresh me with apples! I am weak from passion.

dag: Bɛ Naawuni bitali maa mi bi yila ninsalinim ni dɔɣi ba la ni na bee n-yi ninsalinim yubu ni na, amaa Naawuni yubu ni ka di yina.
en: born not from blood nor from human desire or passion, but born from God.

dag: Ti yi doli Naawuni zaligunima dina n-nyɛ din wuhiri ni ti yuri ŋun Naawuni. Ka o zaligunim maa mi pala yɛlimuɣisira.
en: Loving God means obeying his commands. And Gods commands are not too hard for us.

dag: nti sɔŋ Yisa tuumba maa tooni, ka bɛ pirigiri li n-tiri bɛ ni sokam kaman di ni simdi ni bɛ zaa deei shɛm tariga.
en: and turn it over to the apostles; and the money was distributed according to the needs of the people.

dag: Anabi Musa daa yɛliya, Ti Duuma Naawuni ni ti pii so yi mabihi ni n-chɛ ka o niŋ anabi kaman o ni daa pii ma shɛm la. O yi ti yɛli ya shɛlikam, yin doliya li.
en: Moses said, The Lord your God will give you a prophet. That prophet will come from among your own people. He will be like me. You must obey everything he tells you.

dag: Mɔɣili maa kom yi zo n-chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam, binnɛɔŋ kam ŋun gbamda ni niŋ nyɛvili, kom maa yi paai nimaani zahim pam ni beni. Di ni niŋ nyaɣisim. Ka mɔɣili maa kom yi paai luɣ shɛlikam binshɛɣukam ni niŋ nyɛvili.
en: Wherever the stream flows, there will be all kinds of animals and fish. The stream will make the water of the Dead Sea fresh, and wherever it flows, it will bring life.

dag: Ka ti bɔri ni yi zaa yinoyino kul moor o nini lala hal ti paai di tariga, ka di chɛ ka yi ni mali tahima binshɛl zuɣu la niŋ pali.
en: Our great desire is that each of you keep up your eagerness to the end, so that the things you hope for will come true.

dag: Zikiri bia Joɛl la n-daa nyɛ bɛ zuɣulana, ka Hasɛnua bia Juda mi nyɛ zuɣulaan so ŋun pah ayi n-su tiŋ maa fukumsi.
en: Joel son of Zichri was their supervisor, and Judah son of Hassenuah was second in charge of the city.

dag: Ifriim zuliya mini bɛ daŋ niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Shutɛla daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Shutɛlanima; ka Bɛcha daŋ niriba nyɛ Bɛchanima; ka Tahan mi daŋ niriba nyɛ Tahannima.
en: These are Ephraims descendants according to their clans: from Shuthelah, the Shuthelahite clan; from Becher, the Becherite clan; from Tahan, the Tahanite clan.

dag: O daa be ka binshɛɣukam na kani, ka binshɛɣukam tuɣ taba la o ni.
en: God's Son was before all else, and by him everything is held together.

dag: Amaa ka o ba maa yɛl o yiŋ bihi, Zaŋmiya kpar suŋ na yomyom ti yɛl o, ka zaŋ nintua na ti pir o, ka zaŋ namda na ti pir o pahi.
en: But the father said to his servants, Hurry! Bring the best clothes and put them on him. Also, put a ring on his finger and good sandals on his feet.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisifu min o mabihi maa ni bɛ ʒiɛman ni niriba zaa daa ti kpi.
en: Eventually, Joseph, his brothers, and everyone in his generation died.

dag: Ka ti daa labi ti nyaaŋa n-kpe tiŋgban nɛli maa ni zaŋ labi Teeku Ʒiɛɣu polo kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛli ma shɛm, ka ti daa baɣisi Ɛdom Zoli chana n-niŋ dabisi gbaliŋ.
en: We spent many years wandering around outside the hill country of Seir.

dag: Man Pool maŋmaŋa n-sabi ŋɔ: N ni yo a li. Hal n ni tooi yɛli ni n samli dol a zaŋ chaŋ amaŋmaŋ nyɛvili polo.
en: I, Paul, will pay it back to you . Of course, I wont mention that you owe me your life.

dag: N di bi zaɣisi ka m mali sochandiba kpɛhili shee tiŋgban nɛli ni, n di naan chɛ n niriba ŋɔ ka zo, dama bɛ zaa nyɛla zinaniŋdiba ni nyaanyiriba.
en: If only I could flee for shelter in the desert, to leave my people and forget them— for they are all adulterers, a bunch of crooks.

dag: Ŋuna n-dihiri nabihi vi, ka lɔrigiri bɛn mali kpiɔŋ shɛlɔriti.
en: He disgraces those in power and puts an end to the strength of rulers.

dag: Nir yi nya o suhu ni bɔri shɛli, di nyaɣisila o sani, amaa nir yi chɛ zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu, di nyɛla din chihira jɛra sani.
en: It's a good feeling to get what you want, but only a stupid fool hates to turn from evil.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Di bi sabi yimaŋmaŋ zaligu ni ni Naawuni yɛliya ni yi nyɛla Naawuni ŋmahinli?.
en: Jesus replied: In your Scriptures doesn't God say, You are gods?.

dag: A tɛhiya ni zuŋɔ ka m piligi bɔhiri Naawuni n-nyar o yɛla tir o? Naa, di zaŋ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ mini n daŋ zaa so taali, dama mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ bi mi dimbɔŋɔ zaa yɛla hal baabiɛla gba.
en: That was not the first time I prayed to God for David. Not at all! Dont blame me or any of my relatives. We are your servants. I know nothing about what is happening.

dag: Dama Daadam Bia gba bi kamina ni o ti ʒiya ka niriba tumdi tir o; amaa ni ŋun lee ti tumdi tiri ba, ka zaŋ o nyɛvili pa talima niriba pam nyɛviya zuɣu.
en: for the Human One didnt come to be served but rather to serve and to give his life to liberate many people.

dag: Naawuni, nyini m-pun wuhi ma m bilim ni ha, ka n na kul mooni a daalahiziba tuma molo.
en: You have taught me ever since I was young, and I still tell of your wonderful acts.

dag: Ŋunkam mali yɛm, ŋun wummi dimbɔŋɔnim viɛnyɛliŋga, ka tɛhi Yawɛ yurilim maŋli ŋɔ yɛla.
en: Be wise! Remember this and think about the kindness of the Lord .

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa laɣim Naa Sulemaana sanna Ɛtanim gol ni ŋun nyɛ goli so ŋun pahir ayopɔin la puuni chuɣu dali.
en: So during the special festival in the month of Ethanim, the seventh month of the year, all the men of Israel came to the meeting with King Solomon.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa zaɣisi Samuɛl yɛligu maa wumbu ka yɛli, Aai! Ti bɔri ni ti mali naa ka o su ti.
en: The people paid no attention to Samuel, but said, No! We want a king.

dag: Ka Hagai lan bɔh o, Ka nir yi shihi kpima, ka kana ti shihi bindira maa, di ni chɛ ka bindira maa leei din pa kasi? Ka Maligumaana maa garigi yɛli, Iin.
en: Then Haggai said, Suppose someone has touched a dead body and is considered unacceptable to worship God. If that person touches these foods, would they become unclean? Of course they would, the priests answered.

dag: Ka o yidan Ɛlikana daa yɛl o, Niŋm a ni tɛhi ni shɛli viɛl a sani, kul guhim hal ka bia maa ti ŋmaai bihili. Yawɛ chɛ ka o yɛligu niŋ pali. Ka Hanna daa kpalim yiŋa m-mal o bia maa hal ka o ti ŋmaai bihili.
en: Hannahs husband Elkanah said to her, Do what you think is best. You may stay home until the boy is old enough to eat solid food. May the Lord do what you have said. So Hannah stayed at home to nurse her son until he was old enough to eat solid food.

dag: Bɔ n-daa chɛ ka bɛ bi nya li? Bɛ daa bi bo li la yɛda niŋbu puuni, amaa ka daa bo li la bɛmaŋmaŋ tuma puuni. Bɛ daa tuui kuɣ tuurili shɛli.
en: They failed because they tried to make themselves right by the things they did. They did not trust in God to make them right. They fell over the stone that makes people fall.

dag: Ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdib mini Farisiinim daa ti zaŋ paɣ so ŋun tum zina ka bɛ gbaag o n-tahina ti zaŋ o zali sunsuuni.
en: The Pharisees and the teachers of the Law of Moses brought in a woman who had been caught in bed with a man who wasn't her husband. They made her stand in the middle of the crowd.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Lɛvinim ka tarili bee fali bɛ mabihi maa sani. Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ fali kaman ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa lo o alikauli shɛm maa.
en: The Lord promised that he would always provide for the tribe of Levi, and that's why he won't give them any land, when he divides it among the other tribes.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni be kaman zunzuya Ifriimnim sani ka be kaman bin pɔŋ Judanim sani.
en: Therefore, I am like a moth to Ephraim, and like decay to the house of Judah.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, yi pun wum ni Naawuni daanfaani zuɣu ka o zaŋ tuuni ŋɔ ti ma ni n tum yi sɔŋbu zuɣu.
en: Surely you have heard that God in his grace has given me this work to do for your good.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ yi ni nya binshɛŋa ŋɔ polo, dahin shɛli kanna ka di zaa ni ti wurim hal ka di kuɣ yini gba ti ku lan pa di kpee zuɣu.
en: As for the things you are admiring, the time is coming when not even one stone will be left upon another. All will be demolished.

dag: ka chɛ ka o kpe n-ʒin o chɛchɛbuŋ din pah ayi puuni, ka chɛ ka bɛn be o tooni kuhiri yɛra, Damdimiy o tiŋa! Lala ka o daa niŋ zaŋ Yisifu leei Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa zuɣulana.
en: He also let him ride in the chariot next to his own, and people shouted, Make way for Joseph! So Joseph was governor of Egypt.

dag: Jɔshua kum nyaaŋa, ka Izraɛlnim daa bɔhi Naawuni, Ka ŋun daŋ niriba n-lee yɛn daŋ tooni chaŋ ti tuhi Keenannim ŋɔ ti ti.
en: After Joshuas death, the Israelites asked the LORD, Who should go up first to fight for us against the Canaanites.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti baɣa kul be ti ni yɛn niŋ shɛm kpaŋsi tab suhuri ni, ka di chɛ ka ti wuhiri ti yurilim ni nyɛ shɛm ka tumdi tuun suma.
en: We should think about each other to see how we can encourage each other to show love and do good works.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa garigi yɛl o, Di gbinni m-bɔŋɔ: Piɛr ata maa nyɛla daba ata.
en: Joseph answered, This is what it means: the three baskets are three days.

dag: Ka o garigi bɔhi ba, Yi na bi karim ni Naawuni ŋun daa nam ninsalinim piligu ni la daa nam ba la doo mini paɣa?.
en: Jesus answered, Don't you know in the beginning the Creator made a man and a woman?.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa teei dɔni n-zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋa ka la ka yɛl o suhu ni, Wula ka ninvuɣ so ŋun paai yuun kɔbiga ni tooi lan dɔɣi bia? Ka Zara ŋun paai yuun pihiwɛi ŋɔ ni tooi lan dɔɣi bia.
en: Abraham bowed with his face to the ground and thought, I am almost years old. How can I become a father? And Sarah is . How can she have a child? So he started laughing.

dag: Ka Ishibɔshɛt daa kɔŋ o ni yɛn yɛli Abinɛr shɛm, dama o daa zɔr o mi.
en: Ishbosheth was so afraid of Abner that he could not say a word.

dag: N ni daa wum o kukoli, n daa lu n-dɔn la tiŋa n-liɣi ka n nina kpa tiŋa.
en: and at the sound of his voice, I fell facedown in a deep sleep.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi baŋ din ni sɔŋ daadamnim bɛ dunia ŋɔ yili biɛhigu din bi yuura, ka ka buchi ŋɔ puuni? Bɛ nyɛviya chanimi gariti kaman shilinshia la. Dama ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yɛli ba din yɛn niŋ dunia ŋɔ ni bɛ kalinsi nyaaŋa?.
en: Who knows what is best for people during their short life on earth? Their life passes like a shadow. No one can tell them what will happen later.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ n ni kpɛm ninvuɣ shɛba m-maani ma ansarisi la; n ni daa yuli ʒiɛm shɛb banima, ka ku saɣi zaŋ ba pahi m bahi zuɣu ka bɛ doli m piɛri la.
en: But now those younger than I mock me, whose fathers I refused to put beside my sheepdogs.

dag: Ka Izraɛl kpamba zaa daa ka naa sanna Hiburɔn, ka Naa Dauda ti lo ba alikauli Yawɛ tooni Hiburɔn maa, ka bɛ daa booi kpam bahi Dauda zuɣu ni ka o leei Izraɛl naa.
en: So all the Israelite elders came to the king at Hebron. King David made a covenant with them at Hebron before the LORD, and they anointed David king over Israel.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Di bi simdi ni nir zaŋ bihi bindirigu ti bahi.
en: He replied, It is not good to take the childrens bread and toss it to dogs.

dag: Amaa bɛ yi ti deei puu maa chuɣu puhibu la saha, di ni nyɛla din be kasi Yawɛ sani, ka nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋ pu shɛli ti Yawɛ. Maligumaana n-ni ti su li.
en: At the next Year of Restoration the field will become the Lord 's permanent property; it shall belong to the priests.

dag: Ŋunkam yɛli ninvuɣ biɛɣu ni o ka taali, dilan nyɛla niriba ni yɛn turi so, ka zuliya kam zaɣis o;.
en: The people will turn against a judge who lets the guilty go free. Even the people of other nations will curse him.

dag: Naftali tiŋgban ni bɛ daa yihila Kɛdɛshi din be Galili la mini Hamɔn ni Kiriataim ni di momaha tiŋgbana zaa ti ba.
en: Finally, the Gershonites received three towns from the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee, Hammon, and Kiriathaim, including the pastureland around them.

dag: Sabimi n-ti Laodisia Cheechi malaika n-yɛl o ni ŋun nyɛ Ami, ka be tibi, ka nyɛ yɛlimaŋli shɛhiralana ni ŋun daa tab Naawuni binshɛɣukam nambu ni la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Laodicea: I am the one called Amen! I am the faithful and true witness and the source of God's creation. Listen to what I say.

dag: N je ʒiri, ka zaɣisi li, amaa n yur a zaligu.
en: I can't stand liars, but I love your Law.

dag: Di saha ka malaikanima ayopɔin bɛn daa mali lah ayopɔin maa ni yino kana nti yɛli ma, Kamina ka n ti wuh a pagɔr biɛɣu ŋun du n-ʒi kulisi koma zuɣu ŋɔ saria karibu ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm.
en: One of the seven angels who had emptied the bowls came over and said to me, Come on! I will show you how God will punish that shameless prostitute who sits on many oceans.

dag: Bɛ ni ti nya o ninni, ka o yuli ni ti sab pa bɛ gbiɛri zuɣu.
en: They will see his face, and his name will be written on their foreheads.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa chaŋ ti dɔni miri Chɛrit kulibɔŋ din be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili wulimpuhili polo maa kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa.
en: So Elijah did what the Lord told him to do. He went to live near Kerith Ravine, east of the Jordan River.

dag: Dama a sabi yɛl shɛŋa din to pam jɛndi ma, ka chɛ ka n di wahala n ni daa tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa m bilim ni la zuɣu.
en: You have a list of terrible charges against me. Are you making me suffer for the sins I did when I was young?.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa kahigi ashili maa gbinni wuhi Daniɛl ʒii nyabu puuni yuŋ. Ka Daniɛl daa paɣi Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ yɛli:.
en: In a vision one night, Daniel was shown the dream and its meaning. Then he praised the God who rules from heaven:.

dag: Bɛ daa chaŋ Nɛgɛb n-zaŋ ti paai Hiburɔn, ka Ahiman mini Shɛshai ni Talimai bɛn daa nyɛ Anaki zuliya niriba la daa be nimaani. .
en: They entered the country through the Negev and went to Hebron. Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai lived there. These men were descendants of Anak.

dag: Ka Hanania daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa niriba maa zaa sani yɛli, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ŋ-ŋɔ ka n yɛn kabi Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza naɣikɔra dapua la zuliya kam nyiŋgoya ni yuma ayi puuni. Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka anabi Jɛrimia daa ŋmaligi chaŋ o chandi.
en: and said in the presence of all the people, The Lord has said that this is how he will break the yoke that King Nebuchadnezzar has put on the neck of all the nations; and he will do this within two years. Then I left.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ kpa viɛl shɛli mini wain viɛla zaa ni chi ni bindiri daŋda shɛŋa zaa ti man Yawɛ, n zaŋ li tin ya.
en: I am giving you all the best of the first produce which the Israelites give me each year: olive oil, wine, and grain.

dag: Yilimiya yil palli paɣi Yawɛ; dunianim zaa, yilimiya yila paɣi Yawɛ.
en: Sing a new song to the Lord ! Let the whole world sing to the Lord !.

dag: Lɛvinim tuma kpɛm ŋun daa be Jɛrusalɛm n-daa nyɛ Bani bia Uzi, ŋun daa nyɛ Hashabia yaaŋa la. O yaannim ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pahi n-daa nyɛ Matania mini Maika. O daa yila Asaf daŋ ni na. Bɛ daa nyɛla yiliyiiniba bɛn su Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuma fukumsi.
en: The supervisor of the Levites in Jerusalem was Uzzi son of Bani son of Hashabiah son of Mattaniah son of Mica, from the family of Asaph, who were the singers in charge of the work of Gods house.

dag: Bɛ vuhim yi ti naai, bɛ labirila tiŋgban ni; di saha ka bɛ ni lo nia shɛŋa zaa kpalim yoli.
en: Once they die and are buried, that will be the end of all their plans.

dag: Yawɛ yɛla daa gbahi tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa din daa gili Juda tiŋgbɔŋ maa nanim zaa dabiɛm, ka bɛ daa bi buɣisi ni bɛ lo tɔbu n-tuhi Jɛhɔshafat.
en: The nations near Judah were afraid of the Lord , so they did not start a war against Jehoshaphat.

dag: Yi ni ti yi n-chaŋ ni suhupiɛlli, ka ti lab kuli ni suhudoo. Zoya mini kunkuna ni ti yili yila ni suhupiɛlli, ka mɔɣu ni tihi mi ti kpahi di nuhi.
en: You will leave Babylon with joy; you will be led out of the city in peace. The mountains and hills will burst into singing, and the trees will shout for joy.

dag: ka bi nahindi saamba mini kpibisi ni pakoya bee n-kuri bɛn ka taali kpe, ka bi jɛmdi buɣa din nyɛ barina zaŋ chaŋ yi sani ŋɔ.
en: Stop taking advantage of foreigners, orphans, and widows. Don't kill innocent people. And stop worshiping other gods.

dag: O yiɣisiri faranim taŋkpaɣu ni, ka yiɣisiri nandaamba tampiligim ni.
en: God lifts the poor and needy from dust and ashes.

dag: Di ni lan chɛ ka tarimba nya fahim, ka wuhi bipola baŋsim mini yɛm.
en: These proverbs will make even those without education smart. They will teach young people what they need to know and how to use what they have learned.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti wum ni be gbaai Jɔn Baptaizira, ka o yiɣisi chaŋ Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Now when Jesus heard that John was arrested, he went to Galilee.

dag: Yawɛ n-nam tibili din wumda mini nini din nyari ŋɔ zaa.
en: Ears to hear and eyes to see— the LORD made them both.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a kuhiri niŋdi ma? Yɛlim Izraɛlnim maa ni bɛ cham tooni.
en: Then the LORD said to Moses, Why do you cry out to me? Tell the Israelites to get moving.

dag: bɔɣili maa lan ni yo samli. Di simdi ka o yo biŋkɔbigu maa lana, ka zaŋ biŋkɔb kpiŋ maa.
en: The man who owns the hole must pay for the animal. But after he pays for the animal, he will be allowed to keep the body of that animal.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti ʒi Olivi Tihi Zoli zuɣu tuhi Naawuni jɛmbu duu, ka Pita mini Jeemsi ni Jɔn ni Anduru bɔh o ashilɔni.
en: Later, as Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives across from the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew came to him in private.

dag: O niriba kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi pihinunaanahi ni kɔbisinahi.
en: There are , men in his division.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, Di zɔri ba, dama biɛɣuni ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha, n sa ni ku bɛ zaa ti Izraɛlnima; ka yi sa chɛ n-chihi bɛ yuri napɔn jila, ka nyo bɛ chɛchɛbunsi buɣim.
en: The Lord told Joshua: Don't let them frighten you! I'll help you defeat them, and by this time tomorrow they will be dead. When you attack, the first thing you have to do is to cripple their horses. Then after the battle is over, burn their chariots.

dag: Dama bidibiga lihi ʒiɛm o ba, ka bipuɣiŋga yiɣisi lu o ma zuɣu. Ka paɣa yiɣisi lu o yidan ma zuɣu. Ka nir dimnim ni nyɛla omaŋmaŋ yiŋnima.
en: Sons refuse to respect their own fathers, daughters rebel against their own mothers, and daughters-in-law despise their mothers-in-law. Your family is now your enemy.

dag: Ka o bɔh o, O biɛhigu lee nyɛla wula? Ka o yɛl o, Do kurili n-zaŋ kparibu pɔb omaŋa n-yirina. Di saha ka Sool daa baŋ ni Samuɛl m-bala, ka damdi zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋa n-lu o sizuura.
en: What does he look like? Saul asked her. An old man is coming up, she said. Hes wrapped in a robe. Then Saul knew that it was Samuel, and he bowed low out of respect, nose to the ground.

dag: So miri ka o zaŋ o tizɔpaɣa dɔni, o yi nyɛla o ba bipuɣiŋga bee o ma bipuɣiŋga, bɛ yi dɔɣ o la yiŋa bee luɣ shɛli polo.
en: Do not have intercourse with your sister or your stepsister, whether or not she was brought up in the same house with you.

dag: Ka Dan zuliya niriba maa ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu daa lo tɔbu yi Zɔra mini Ɛshitaol.
en: Six hundred men from the tribe of Dan strapped on their weapons and left Zorah and Eshtaol with their families.

dag: din nyɛ zaligu shɛŋa zaa Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Musa zali ya dahin shɛli Yawɛ ni daa zali zaligunim maa zaŋ chaŋ yi ʒiɛmani kam ni polo la.
en: or everything that the LORD commanded you through Moses from the day of the LORDs command onward for all time.

dag: Pirigimiya bɛ ni di neen shɛŋa na maa ʒiibuyi n-zaŋ yim ti tɔbbihi bɛn chaŋ tɔbu ni maa, ka zaŋ yim la mi ti Izraɛlnim zaa.
en: Divide what was taken into two equal parts, one part for the soldiers and the other part for the rest of the community.

dag: O daa tuhi nyaŋ Filistianim hal ti paai Gaza mini di tintariga tinsi; ni di tiŋkpansi zaŋ tabili di fɔntinsi.
en: Hezekiah defeated the Philistines all the way to Gaza and the area around it. He defeated all the Philistine cities—from the smallest town to the largest city.

dag: Di daa lan wuhi ni bɛ yi yɛn me duu maa dikili, bɛn zaŋm kuɣa me kulis ata, ka zaŋ dari mi n-niŋ kuliga zaɣ yini n-tam di zuɣu. Ka yihi nam fukumsi kpanjɔɣu ni liɣiri n-yo duu maa mɛbu tuma samli.
en: Its wall will be in layers that have three rows of large stones and one row of wooden timbers. The cost of building the Temple must be paid for from the kings treasury.

dag: n-yɛra, N ni zaŋ Keenan tiŋgbani ti a, ka di nyɛ a tarili ka a su li.
en: I will give you the land of Canaan, he said. It will be your own possession.

dag: Amaa ka Sool daa zaŋ kpani to o ni o ku o; di saha ka Jɔnatan daa baŋ ni o ba shiri loya ni o ku Dauda.
en: Saul threw his spear at Jonathan and tried to kill him. Then Jonathan was sure that his father really did want to kill David.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa daŋ yiɣisibu asiba n-zaŋ Izraɛlnim daŋ kam niriba na ti zaani tooni, ka Yawɛ daa yaala Juda zuliya.
en: Early the next morning, Joshua led out all the Israelites. Each tribe came forward to stand before the Lord , and he chose the tribe of Judah.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ ti bela yi nuu ni; niŋmiya ti yi ni nya ka di simdi ni yi niŋ ti shɛm.
en: Now, here we are in your power. Do to us whatever seems good and proper to you.

dag: Amaa o min o kpambaliba ni tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba daa bi wum Yawɛ yɛligu shɛli o ni daa chɛ ka anabi Jɛrimia zaŋ yɛli ba maa.
en: Neither Zedekiah, his attendants, nor the people of the land listened to the LORDs words spoken by the prophet Jeremiah.

dag: Jɔshua ni daa ti wum niriba ni yɔri vuri, ka o yɛli Musa, Niriba yɔrila tɔb tuhibu vuri sansani maa ni.
en: Joshua heard the people shouting and said to Moses, I hear the sound of battle in the camp.

dag: Yawɛ, ti zaa nyɛla a niriba, dinzuɣu, di chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi hal ti yaɣi. A mi di gbibi ti taali sahakam.
en: so do not be too angry with us or hold our sins against us forever. We are your people; be merciful to us.

dag: Tihi nyɔŋ mini tiŋgbani din mal atam, Yawɛ ni ti saɣim li, o ni ti saɣim niŋgbuŋ min o shia, ka di ni be kaman dɔr biɛɣu ni saɣindi ninsal niŋgbuŋ shɛm la.
en: The rich forests and farmlands will be totally destroyed, in the same way that a fatal sickness destroys someone.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Naa Jɛhoyakim ŋun nyɛ Juda naa Jɔsia bia la polo m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ ti ku fabili o zuɣu yɛli, Mbaye, m mabia! Mbaye, m mabia! Bɛ mi ti ku fabili o zuɣu n-yɛli, Mbaye, n dana! Mbaye, n naa.
en: So then, the Lord says about Josiah's son Jehoiakim, king of Judah, No one will mourn his death or say, How terrible, my friend, how terrible! No one will weep for him or cry, My lord! My king.

dag: Ka yi lan zaŋ di vulo maa yi Hɔr Zoli maa gbini hal ni Lɛbohamat samban ni, ka di tintariga naabu shee yɛn nyɛla Zɛdad.
en: From Mount Hor it will go to Lebo Hamath, and then to Zedad.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun daa bɔhi biɛri ti ma, ka zaŋ niriba ti ma ni n su ba.
en: He is the God who punishes my enemies for me, the one who puts people under my rule.

dag: Amaa wuhim Jɔshua ka kpaŋs o suhu, dama ŋuna n-yɛn leei niriba ŋɔ zuɣulana n-zaŋ ba du nti deei a ni yɛn nya tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa ti ba.
en: Joshua will lead Israel across the Jordan to take the land, so help him be strong and brave and tell him what he must do.

dag: Yi biɛhigu ni ti nyɛla biɛhiŋ wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa, ka dabiɛm mali ya ka yi nyɛviya be barina ni.
en: You will live in constant fear of death.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli ba, Yi yi yɛn zaŋ Izraɛlnim Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa labisi, yin di zaŋya di kɔŋko labisi, amaa yin zaŋmiya alahichi sanyoo pini m-pahi di zuɣu din ni chɛ ka yi nya faako ka baŋ o ni darigiri yi tibili daliri shɛli zuɣu maa.
en: They replied, If you are returning the chest of Israels God, dont send it back empty, but be sure to return a guilt offering to him. Then you will be healed, and it will become clear to you why Gods hand hasnt left you alone.

dag: yi yi bi birigi kpa nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo n-doli jɛmdi wuna ka chɛ n ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa tiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: You must not turn away from any of the teachings that I give you today. You must not turn away to the right or to the left. You must not follow other gods to serve them.

dag: Yuria paɣa Batishiiba ni daa wum ni o yidan kpiya, o daa kum o zuɣu.
en: When Bathsheba heard that her husband had been killed, she mourned for him.

dag: Juda zuliya n-daa zaŋ bɛ tuuta daŋ yiɣisi doli tab gbilligbilli gbaai chandi. Aminadab bia Nashɔn n-daa nyɛ bɛ zaa zuɣulana.
en: Judah and the tribes that camped alongside it marched out first, carrying their banner. Nahshon son of Amminadab was the leader of the Judah tribe.

dag: ni m mini ya ti laɣim ʒini n nam ʒiishee n-diri ka nyura, ka yi ti ʒini nam kuɣisi zuɣu n-kari Izraɛl zuliya pinaayi la saria.
en: You will eat and drink with me in my kingdom, and you will each sit on a throne to judge the twelve tribes of Israel.

dag: Ka Sool daa bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a mini Jɛsi bia ŋɔ gbiri ma zamba bɔɣa? Bɔzuɣu ka a daa ti o bindirigu ka ti o takɔbi ka lan bɔhi Naawuni n-nya o yɛla ti o ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o yiɣisi lu n zuɣu n-sɔɣi do n-gu ma kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Saul said to him, Why did you and Jesses son make secret plans against me? You gave David bread and a sword. You prayed to God for him. And right now, David is waiting to attack me.

dag: Dama yi nyɛla ninvuɣ kuriba bɛn nuhi tum taali; ka yi lan ŋmari ʒiri ka zaŋ yi zilima tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri.
en: Your talk is filled with lies and plans for violence; every finger on your hands is covered with blood.

dag: Ka malaika maa daa yɛli paɣiba maa, Di zɔriya dabiɛm; m mi ni yi bɔrila Yisa so bɛ ni daa kpahi tabili dapulli zuɣu la.
en: But the angel said to the women, Dont be afraid. I know that you are looking for Jesus who was crucified.

dag: Di saha n yi ti laɣim ya, n ni zaŋ ya kuli yiŋa, dama n ni chɛ ka yi yuli du, ka yi nya jilima dunianim zaa sani saha shɛli n yi ti lan labisi yi daazichi la na ka yi nina nya li. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: At that time, I will bring all of you back, at the time when I gather you. I will give you fame and praise among all the neighboring peoples when I restore your possessions and you can see them—says the LORD.

dag: Jɛsi daa nyɛla Ɛliab ba. Ɛliab n-daa nyɛ o bituuli, ka ŋun daa pa o zuɣu nyɛ Abinadab, ka ŋun pahi ata daa nyɛ Shimia.
en: Jesse had seven sons. In order of age they were: Eliab, Abinadab, Shammah.

dag: dama binshɛɣu kani din sɔɣiya ka ti ku yi palo, binshɛɣ mi kani m-be ashilɔni ka bɛ ti ku baŋ li.
en: Everything that is hidden will be found out, and every secret will be known.

dag: Ka o daa saɣi ka shiri niŋ ba lala biɛɣu pia.
en: So the guard agreed to test Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah for ten days.

dag: Ŋunkam yuri zabili nyɛla ŋun yuri alahichi. Ŋun me dunɔbia din du pam nyɛla ŋun bɔri kɔb kaba.
en: A troublemaker loves to start arguments. Anyone who likes to brag is asking for trouble.

dag: Cham ti kpe bɛ wain tihi puri ni n-saɣim li, amaa di saɣim di zaa. Ŋmahimi di wula zaa bahi, dama di pala man Yawɛ ni su shɛli.
en: I will send enemies to cut down my people's vineyards, but not to destroy them completely. I will tell them to strip away the branches, because those branches are not mine.

dag: Yirigimiya yimaŋ zuɣu, ka suhimiya Naawuni ni yi di ti lu zahimbu puuni, yi suhuri din bɔra, amaa ka yi niŋgbuna lee ka yaa.
en: And he said to them, Keep watch, and pray that you will not fall into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak.

dag: ni yi niɣi mini biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, binshɛɣukam din ti yɛn bili yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni na ni ti nyɛla bindirigu.
en: And there will be enough food for your cattle and other animals to eat.

dag: Ka Lɛvinim maa daa mali bɛmaŋ yi alahichi ni, ka paɣi bɛ binyɛra, ka Aduna daa zaŋ ba kaman sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi gahiri zuɣusaa la zali Yawɛ tooni, ka mali sara ti ba bɛ daalahichi zuɣu m-mali ba kasi.
en: The Levites sprinkled themselves with the water of forgiveness and washed their clothes. Then Aaron brought them to the altar and offered sacrifices to forgive their sins and make them acceptable to the Lord .

dag: O daa lan yɛli di yɛla yaha: Bɛ kul ku nya vuhim shee n sani.
en: But in the Scripture above God said, They will never enter my place of rest.

dag: Di ka buchi, di nyɛla yɔhiŋ tuma. Di tibidarigibo saha, di ni bahi yoli.
en: Idols are merely a joke, and when the time is right, they will be destroyed.

dag: hal nti paai dahin shɛli o ni daa ti o tuun shɛb o ni pii la zaligu Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni ka lab alizanda ni la.
en: right up to the day when he was taken up into heaven. Before he was taken up, working in the power of the Holy Spirit, Jesus instructed the apostles he had chosen.

dag: Yawɛ lab me Jɛrusalɛm, ka laɣindi bɛ ni daa kari Izraɛl ninvuɣ shɛb kpɛhi yɔɣu la na.
en: The Lord rebuilds Jerusalem and brings the people of Israel back home again.

dag: Ka Dauda daa kul nyari yaa pahira, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ daa be o sani.
en: David grew increasingly powerful, and the LORD of heavenly forces was with him.

dag: O ni daa be suhusaɣiŋgu ni pam zuɣu ka o daa suhuri Naawuni ni nimmoo hal ka o niŋgbuŋ ni woligu ti tɔɣiri luri tiŋa kaman ʒim la.
en: Jesus was full of pain; he struggled hard in prayer. Sweat dripped from his face like drops of blood falling to the ground.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna Hɔr Zoli din daa be Ɛdom tintariga maa gbini.
en: on the border of Edom. There the Lord said to Moses and Aaron.

dag: n kul paɣirila Naawuni yi zuɣu sahakam, ka kul teeri yi yɛla n wunsuhigu puuni.
en: I dont stop giving thanks to God for you when I remember you in my prayers.

dag: Ka alikauli maa daa shiri lɔrigi dindali maa. Ka bɛn daa dari piɛri maa ŋ-ŋmaligiri kɔhiri la daa lihiri ma nti baŋ ni Yawɛ n-wuhiri ba shɛli n ni niŋ shɛm maa puuni.
en: The sheep dealers who saw me knew at once that this was a message from the Lord .

dag: Ba maa ni mali nyɛvili omaŋmaŋ ni shɛm, lala ka o ti o Bia maa yiko ni o gba mali nyɛvili omaŋmaŋ ni.
en: Life comes from the Father himself. So the Father has also allowed the Son to give life.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wuhi ma di gbinni shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Biŋkɔb so ŋun pah anahi la wuhirila nam din pah anahi nti yɛn yiɣisi zani. Di ni ti be di ko ni nama zaa. Di ni ti dari chahi dunia ŋɔ zaa chɛrachɛra, ka no li sɔŋ tiŋa.
en: This is the explanation I was given: The fourth beast is a fourth empire that will be on the earth and will be different from all other empires. It will crush the whole earth and trample it down.

dag: Dama yi yi diri wahala din tuhi tumbu zuɣu ka di nyɛla Naawuni yubu m-bala, di so ni yi di wahala din bi tuhi tumbu zuɣu.
en: It is better to suffer for doing good than for doing wrong. Yes, it is better if that is what God wants.

dag: M mini ŋun doli gbaai mani ŋun nyɛ o zo ŋɔ, ka yiɣisi o ni daa lo ma alikauli shɛli.
en: My former companion attacked his friends; he broke his promises.

dag: A ni ti wum bɛ ni yɛn yɛli shɛm. Ka di nyaaŋa a ni nya kpiɔŋ chaŋ ti liri ba. Ka o min o tumtumda Pura daa chaŋ ti zani miri bɛ dimnim maa tɔbbi shɛb bɛn lo kpara do sansan maa tariga.
en: and youll hear what they are saying. May you then get the courage to attack the camp. So he went down with his servant Purah to the outpost of the armies that were in the camp.

dag: Ka a zaŋ li yili gɔpiɛliga daantalis anahi shɛŋa zuɣu yi ni niŋ salima pa, ka di mali salima bansi ka tam anzinfa bintamdisi zuɣu la.
en: Hang it on four acacia-wood posts covered in gold. They should have gold hooks and stand on four silver bases.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa yiɣisi nimaani chaŋ teeku nol ni, ka salo pam yi Galili dol o; ka shɛb mi daa yi Judia.
en: Jesus left with his disciples and went to the lake. A large crowd followed him because they had heard what he was doing. They were from Galilee.

dag: Naa Hɛzɛkia daa mali buni pam ka niriba daa tir o jilima. O daa mɛla omaŋmaŋ nɛma zalibu shee duri, n-zaŋdi o da anzinfa min o salima ni o kuɣ viɛla ni o tulaale ni o nyɔtaɣirisi ni o binshɛɣukam din mali shaara pam.
en: King Hezekiah became very wealthy, and everyone held him in honor. He had storerooms built for his gold, silver, precious stones, spices, shields, and other valuable objects.

dag: Jɛhu ni daa kuri Ɛhab daŋ niriba maa saha shɛli maa, ka o daa tuhi Juda kpambaliba mini Ahazia mabihi bidibisi bɛn daa doli Ahazia maa soli n-daa ku ba.
en: and while Jehu was doing that, he saw some of Judah's leaders and Ahaziah's nephews who had come with Ahaziah. Jehu killed them on the spot.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli, M Ba Naawuni, chɛli paŋ ba, dama bɛ bi mi bɛ ni niŋdi shɛli maa gbinni. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yisa binyɛra pumpu n-sɔŋ n-tɔri tɛte ni bɛ nya bɛ zaa yinoyino ni yɛn di shɛli.
en: Jesus said, Forgive them, Father! They don't know what they are doing. They divided his clothes among themselves by throwing dice.

dag: Maligumaana ni ti zaŋ alahichi sanyoo sara maligu maa binʒim shɛli n-vie Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dunɔpaɣira mini sara maligu bimbini naŋgbaŋkuɣila bunahi zuɣu ni dundombila dunɔdali dunɔpaɣira la.
en: The priest will take some of the blood of this sin offering and put it on the doorposts of the Temple, on the four corners of the altar, and on the posts of the gateways to the inner courtyard.

dag: Ka Yaakubu paɣ Reechɛl bidibisi daa nyɛ: Yisifu mini Bɛnjamin.
en: Benjamin was also with Jacob. Benjamin was Jacob and Rachels son.

dag: Amaa di nyaaŋa, ka bɛ daa ti lan zaŋ bɛ ni daa bahi dab shɛba, ka bɛ nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba la leei daba yaha.
en: But after that, the people who had slaves changed their minds. So they took the people they had set free and made them slaves again.

dag: Lihimiy o ka mali suhupiɛlli; ka vi ku be yi ninni.
en: Those who look to God will shine; their faces are never ashamed.

dag: So mi n-nyɛ bundana, ka mali suhudoo ka binshɛli yɛla bi muɣis o, ka o ti kpi.
en: Some of us die prosperous.

dag: Ka Naomi daa ti wum ni Naawuni niŋ alibarika niŋ ŋun Naawuni niriba ni, ka chɛ ka bɛ puri atam niŋ pam, ka o daa mali shili ni o min o bihi paɣiba la yiɣisi Mɔab tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni kul o ya.
en: When Naomi heard that the Lord had given his people a good harvest, she and her two daughters-in-law got ready to leave Moab and go to Judah. As they were on their way there.

dag: Mbusim be yinim bɛn yɛri dari, Neemiya gom ni! Bee n-yɛri kuɣili din fo n-doya, Yiɣisim zan a tolitoli! ŋɔ zuɣu. Di ni tooi wuhi so binshɛli? Nyama, salima mini anzinfa ka bɛ zaŋ mal li, ka di bi vuhiri hal baabiɛla.
en: You are doomed! You say to a piece of wood, Wake up! or to a block of stone, Get up! Can an idol reveal anything to you? It may be covered with silver and gold, but there is no life in it.

dag: Ibrahimma mam ŋun yuli daa booni Kɛtuura la ni daa dɔɣi bidib shɛba n-daa nyɛ: Zimiran mini Jokishan ni Mɛdan ni Midian ni Ishibak ni Shua. Jokishan bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Shiiba mini Dɛdan.
en: Abrahams secondary wife Keturahs family: she gave birth to Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. Jokshans family: Sheba and Dedan.

dag: Yɛlim ba ni a nyɛla n tizɔpaɣa, ka bɛ niŋ ma nirilim a zuɣu, ka tiligi n nyɛvili a zuɣu.
en: So tell them that you are my sister. Then they will be good to me because of you. In this way you will save my life.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ ninvuɣ tuhi piapia chani Lɛbanɔn nti niŋdi goli yiniyini ka tiri taba. Bɛ daa niŋdila goli yiniyini Lɛbanɔn, ka niŋdi chira ayiyi yiŋ mi. Adɔniram n-daa nyɛ niriba maa zuɣulana.
en: He sent ten thousand to work in Lebanon each month. Then they would spend two months at home. Adoniram was in charge of the work gang.

dag: Apolɔs ni daa be Kɔrinti saha shɛli maa ka Pool daa gari chaŋ tin shɛŋa din be nuzaa polo n-daa mali hal ti paai Ɛfɛsus. Nimaani ka o daa nya Yisa nyaandol shɛba.
en: While Apollos was in Corinth, Paul took a route through the interior and came to Ephesus, where he found some disciples.

dag: Ka a yɛli Izraɛlnima, Ŋunkam tu Naawuni, dilan daalahichi ni ʒin o zuɣu.
en: Tell the Israelites: Anyone who curses God will be liable to punishment.

dag: ni di chɛ ka niŋgbuŋ yaɣa maa zaa ku gaŋdi taba, amaa ka di baɣa lee ni bela tab ni.
en: He did this to make all parts of the body work together smoothly, with each part caring about the others.

dag: Dama o ni lo ni o niŋ ma shɛli maa, o ni niŋ li naai; ka lala binyara pam kul be o suhu ni.
en: He will fulfill what he has planned for me; that plan is just one of the many he has;.

dag: Ka ŋun paya la gba daa niŋ lala nya nyɔri ka di min o gba laɣidaya saɣi taba.
en: In the same way, the one who had two valuable coins gained two more.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yisa tahi luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Goligɔta la. Di gbinni nyɛla Zuɣuŋmaŋ Shee.
en: They led Jesus to the place called Golgotha.

dag: Mɔɣu ni buŋ yi ti ŋubiri mɔri, o lan kumda? Bee nahu yi ti ŋubiri taɣitaɣi, o lan ŋumda?.
en: Do oxen and wild donkeys cry out in distress unless they are hungry?.

dag: Yisa ni daa yi zoli maa zuɣu siɣina ka salo pam kul kabiri dol o;.
en: As Jesus came down the mountain, he was followed by large crowds.

dag: N lan yɛri ya mi, yi ni niriba ayi yi naai noli dunia ŋɔ ni bɛ ni suhi Naawuni yɛl shɛli zuɣu, m Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ ni chɛ ka di niŋ.
en: And I tell you more: whenever two of you on earth agree about anything you pray for, it will be done for you by my Father in heaven.

dag: Nimdi mini gbaŋ dina, o daa zaŋ li yila bɛ biɛhigu maa shee kpaŋa ti nyo li buɣim.
en: Then Aaron burned the meat and skin on a fire outside the camp.

dag: Man ŋun nyɛ kpɛm la n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri n zo Gaiɔs ŋun nyɛ n ni yuri so ni yɛlimaŋli la.
en: From the church leader. To my dear friend Gaius. I love you because we follow the truth.

dag: N dimnim zaa ni di vi, ka dabiɛm gbahi ba pam; di ku yuui ka bɛ di vi maa, ka ŋmaligi zo.
en: My enemies will know the bitter shame of defeat; in sudden confusion they will be driven away.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla halibiɛrinima, amaa man yur a zaligunim pam.
en: Those people are so stupid that they care for nothing, but I enjoy studying your teachings.

dag: Dama n ni daa yihi yi yaannim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na dahin shɛl la, n daa bi yɛli ba shɛli bee n-zali ba zaligu zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini sara maligunim polo.
en: On the day I brought your ancestors out of the land of Egypt, I didnt say a thing—I gave no instructions—about entirely burned offerings or sacrifices.

dag: Amaa ka yɛl shɛŋa n-yi beni pahi, di ni tooi mali jintɔriba laɣiŋgu ni.
en: But if you want to do more than that, the matter will have to be brought before the city council.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna:.
en: The Lord gave Moses and Aaron the following instructions.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Dauda daa bi lan zaŋ Alikauli Adaka maa kuli ŋun Dauda ya la, amaa ka ŋmaligi zaŋ li tahila Obɛdɛdom ŋun daa nyɛ Giiti nir la yiŋa.
en: So instead of taking it to Jerusalem, David decided to take it to the home of Obed-Edom, who lived in the town of Gath.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa pali bɛ zaa, ka bɛ piligi tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa Naawuni Shia Kasi maa yiko ni.
en: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to talk in other languages, as the Spirit enabled them to speak.

dag: Maligumaana Ɛliashib ŋun daa su Naawuni jɛmbu duu nɛma duri fukumsi la mini Tɔbaya daa nyɛla dɔɣim.
en: The priest Eliashib was a relative of Tobiah and had earlier been put in charge of the temple storerooms.

dag: M mabihi, ti bɔri ni yi baŋ ti ni daa nya wahala shɛli Ɛsha tiŋgbɔŋ ni la yɛla; di daa nyɛla wahala din ka buɣisibu, hal ka ti daa yihi bebu tahima gba.
en: We want to remind you, friends, of the trouble we had in the province of Asia. The burdens laid upon us were so great and so heavy that we gave up all hope of staying alive.

dag: Ka Yisa nimmiriba zaa mini paɣ shɛb bɛn daa dol o yi Galili na daa ʒe kpaŋ ha n-nya dimbɔŋɔnim zaa.
en: All those who knew Jesus personally, including the women who had followed him from Galilee, stood at a distance to watch.

dag: Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ n ni boli shɛb la, wummiya! Mani n-nyɛ Naawuni; Mani n-nyɛ piligu. Mani n-nyɛ naabu.
en: The Lord says, Listen to me, Israel, the people I have called! I am God, the first, the last, the only God!.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ gba nyɛla nɔzaɣisiriba pumpɔŋɔ ni di chɛ ka bɛ nya nambɔzɔbo kaman yi ni nya nambɔzɔbo shɛm.
en: In the same way, they have also been disobedient because of the mercy that you received, so now they can receive mercy too.

dag: Amaa lahaba shɛli din ti yɛn yi wulimpuhili mini nuzaa polo na ni ti kpɛh o dabiɛm, ka o yiɣis o suhu n-tuhi ku niriba pam.
en: Then news that comes from the east and the north will frighten him, and he will fight furiously, killing many people.

dag: ka n suhu kpe bɛ ni ashilɔni ka n jɛm ba.
en: worshiped the sun or moon.

dag: Tɔɣisim yɛtɔɣ maŋa din nyɛ so ni ku tooi galim shɛli, ka di chɛ ka bɛn chihir a di vi ka ku tooi mali zaɣ biɛ shɛli ni bɛ yɛli dalim ti.
en: and a sound message that is above criticism when you teach, so that any opponent will be ashamed because they wont find anything bad to say about us.

dag: Mɔɣu ni biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn mali karimbaani na ʒi n-dol li, ka gbuɣinli gba na ʒi n-dol li.
en: Wild animals have never been there. Lions have not traveled that way.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kpe yili maa ni, o daa dola o bindoo zuɣu o dugbɛrili ni gbihira, ka bɛ zaŋ sua n-kuhi ku o, ka ŋmaag o zuɣu. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o zuɣu maa doli Araba polo yuŋ.
en: They had entered the house while Ishbosheth was lying on the bed in his bedroom. After they stabbed him and killed him, they cut off his head, took it, and traveled all night through the wilderness.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ ni niŋ yɛlimaŋli ninvuɣ shɛb sani mali alibarika. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn Naawuni nyɛ Yawɛ mali alibarika.
en: Happy is the nation of whom this is true; happy are the people whose God is the Lord !.

dag: Dama bɛ ni daa mali binshɛŋa daa galisiya pam, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ ku tooi laɣim be luɣ yini. Bɛ niɣi zuɣu n-daa chɛ ka bɛ ni be luɣ shɛli maa bi saɣi ba.
en: He did this because the land was too crowded and could not support him and his brother with their flocks and herds.

dag: Naawuni, m paɣir a. Di shini ma!.
en: I praise you, God; don't remain silent!.

dag: So ku lan zaŋ jɛrigu boli ninvuɣ titali bee n-zaŋ yɛmbimbiɛrilana boli ninvuɣ suŋ.
en: Fools will no longer be highly respected, and crooks won't be given positions of honor.

dag: Ka m bɔh o, N Duuma, di yɛn be lala yuui hal ni bɔ saha? Ka o yɛli ma, Di ni be lala hal ka tinsi ti lu n-dahim, ka so ku lan be di yiya ni, ka tiŋgbani maa kpalim tiŋgban nɛli doya.
en: I asked, How long will it be like this, Lord? He answered, Until the cities are ruined and empty—until the houses are uninhabited—until the land itself is a desolate wasteland.

dag: Ka Hilikia daa yɛli Shafan ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la, N nyala zaligu kundi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni; ka o daa zaŋ kundi maa ti Shafan.
en: Hilkiah said to Shaphan the secretary, I found the Book of the Law in the Lord s house. Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan.

dag: zaɣ biɛɣu ku tooi paag a, ka alɔbo shɛli mi ku tooi mir a yiŋ na.
en: So nothing bad will happen to you. No diseases will come near your home.

dag: So miri ka o laɣim paɣ min o bipuɣiŋga dɔni, ka miri ka o bo o bidibiga bipuɣiŋga bee o bipuɣiŋga mi bipuɣiŋga, bɛ nyɛla paɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ o dɔɣiriba ni yɛlimaŋli. Lala nyɛla zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: And don't have sex with the daughter or granddaughter of any woman that you have earlier had sex with. You will be having sex with her closest relatives, and that would make you unclean.

dag: Gbaŋ ŋɔ yila man Pool ŋun nyɛ Naawuni dabili mini Yisa Masia tuun so o ni tim ni n ti kpaŋsi Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda yɛda mini bɛ yɛlimaŋli baŋbu din nyɛ din luri Naawuni sizuura la sanna.
en: From Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ. I was chosen and sent to help the faith of God's chosen people and to lead them to the truth taught by our religion.

dag: Ka Siria Naa Hazaɛl daa ti kani, ka o bia Bɛnhadad di nam zan o zaani.
en: At the death of King Hazael of Syria his son Benhadad became king.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ko n-dolisi kulibɔŋ bindira ni niŋ pam, ka bɛ suhiri paligi, ka niɣi mini bunsi gba nya mɔ suma ŋubi.
en: Some of you live away from the cities. You plant seeds by every stream and let your cattle and donkeys roam free. You will be very blessed.

dag: Ʒimiya liɣiri pahi bɛ ni daa zaŋ laɣ shɛli labisi niŋ yi kpalansi noya ni la zuɣu mali chaŋ, di pa shɛli bɛ daa chirimmi maa.
en: Take twice as much silver with you, and take back the silver returned in the top of your sacks. It might have been a mistake.

dag: Niriba maa ni da n-gili tiŋgbɔŋ maa puuni ni tahima kalinsi, ka kum wum ba. Kum din yɛn wum ba maa mini bɛ suhuyiɣisili maa puuni, bɛ ni tu bɛ naa mini bɛ wuni. Bɛ ni ti kpuɣi bɛ zuɣuri lihi zuɣusaa.
en: They will pass through the land, dejected and hungry, and when they are hungry, they will be enraged and will curse their king and God. They will turn toward heaven.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Di nyɛla yi yɛda pɔrilim zuɣu. Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi yi mali yɛda ka di be kaman zabiliga tibiɛlim la, yi ni tooi yɛli zoli ŋɔ, Yiɣisim a dooshee ŋɔ nti dɔni kpe ha, ka di shiri yiɣisi; ka shɛli ku kɔŋ nanibu yi sani. .
en: It was because you do not have enough faith, answered Jesus. I assure you that if you have faith as big as a mustard seed, you can say to this hill, Go from here to there! and it will go. You could do anything.

dag: N ni daa kul lihiri yila maa, ka n ti nya yilibila ka di daai yil ata shɛŋa din daa pun saya la n-vuɣ li bahi, ka puhi yina. Yilibil maa daa malila nina ka di be kaman ninsal nina la, ka mali noli ka di tɔɣisiri karimbaan yɛtɔɣa.
en: While I was looking at the horns and thinking about them, another horn grew up among them. This was a little horn with eyes like a human. It also had a mouth that was bragging. Then the little horn pulled out three of the other horns.

dag: Di tahigu maa nyɛla din yɛr o yɛla, ka niɣi gba mi ni saa kanna.
en: His thunder announces it; even cattle proclaim its rising.

dag: Di dabisa maa saha yi ti paai, n ni chɛ ka wuntizɔr so yi Dauda zuliya ni na, ŋuna n-ni ti doli zaligu mini wuntia soli n-su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: In those days and at that time, I will raise up a righteous branch from Davids line, who will do what is just and right in the land.

dag: O ni ti taɣi ti niŋgbuna din poori ŋɔ n-chɛ ka di be kaman omaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ din bi poori la. O yiko din chɛ ka o tooi su binshɛɣukam zaa la puuni ka o yɛn niŋ dimbɔŋɔ.
