en: He will change our humble bodies and make them like his own glorious body. Christ can do this by his power, with which he is able to rule everything.

dag: Nyin Musa kɔŋko n-ni miri man Yawɛ; bɛ ni so di ti mirina; niriba maa di pah a zuɣu du na.
en: but you are to come near. Don't let anyone else come up.

dag: Yawɛ, a nyari paɣibu a kpiɔŋ zuɣu! Ti ni yili yila paɣ a yiko maa.
en: Be exalted, LORD, in your strength! We will sing and praise your power!.

dag: Miriya ka yi dihi yɔhiŋgu yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ tabili. Dina n-nyɛ: Yawɛ jɛmbu duu m-bɔŋɔ, Yawɛ jɛmbu duu m-bɔŋɔ, Yawɛ jɛmbu duu m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Dont trust in lies: This is the LORDs temple! The LORDs temple! The LORDs temple.

dag: Ka Yisa daa wum lala ka yɛli, O dɔro maa pala kum dɔro, amaa di nyɛla din ni chɛ ka Naawuni nya jilima, ka Naawuni Bia gba nya jilima di zuɣu.
en: When Jesus heard this, he said, His sickness won't end in death. It will bring glory to God and his Son.

dag: Dinzuɣu baŋmiya ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ yɛda n-nyɛ Ibrahimma yaansi.
en: You should realize, then, that the real descendants of Abraham are the people who have faith.

dag: Lɛvi zuliya bɛn daa tumdi maligumaaniba tuma la, Naawuni fukumsi zaligu daa zali ba ni bɛ deem zaka Izraɛlnim sani. Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiri ni bɛ deem li la bɛmaŋmaŋ mabihi sani, hal bɛ mabihi maa gba ni daa kul nyɛ ti yab Ibrahimma zuliya la zaa yoli.
en: The descendants of Levi who receive the office of priest have a commandment under the Law to collect a tenth of everything from the people who are their brothers and sisters, though they also are descended from Abraham.

dag: Jilima mini dariza m-be o tuma ni, ka o wuntitali kul beni sahakam.
en: All he does is full of honor and majesty; his righteousness is eternal.

dag: Amaa yinim miriya ka yi niŋdi lala, dama yi Ba Naawuni pun mi din simdi ya hal ka yi na bi suh o li gba.
en: Dont be like them. Your Father knows what you need before you ask him.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kuri niriba chihiri bɛn ka taali, bɛ nyɛla bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn biɛhigu tuhi.
en: Murderous people hate the innocent, and they seek the lives of the virtuous.

dag: Di ni nyɛla sara shɛli bɛ ni yɛn zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim Yawɛ tooni Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili dunol ŋɔ ni sahakam yi ʒiɛmana zaa ni. Di nyɛla luɣ shɛli m mini ya ni yɛn laɣim ka n tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa nimaani.
en: You must burn these things as an offering to the Lord every day. Do this at the entrance of the Meeting Tent before the Lord . Continue to do this for all time. When you make the offering, I will meet you there and speak to you.

dag: Yi lee zahimla wula? Ka bɛ garigi yɛli, O simdila kubu.
en: What do you think? And they answered, He deserves to die.

dag: Bɛ ni daa na kul tɔɣisiri lala maa ka Yisa maŋmaŋ dii zani bɛ sunsuuni yɛli ba, Naawuni tim ya suhudoo.
en: While the two men were saying these things to the other followers, Jesus himself came and stood among them. He said to them, Peace be with you.

dag: Ka di saha dɛde daa ti paai ka o kahigi li wuhi palɔni o lahibal sun shɛli o ni zaŋ niŋ n nuu ni, ka m mol li kaman ŋun Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira ŋɔ ni zal li shɛm la.
en: At the right time, God let the world know about that life. He did this through the telling of the Good News message, and he trusted me with that work. I told people that message because God our Savior commanded me to.

dag: ka duh o yee suhi Naawuni bɔh o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ka n ni kana ti be pako so sani ŋɔ bidibiga ŋɔ kpi n-ti o suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: Then he prayed aloud, O Lord my God, why have you done such a terrible thing to this widow? She has been kind enough to take care of me, and now you kill her son.

dag: Ŋahili ŋɔ ka Yisa daa ŋahi ba, amaa ka bɛ bi baŋ o ni yɛli ba shɛm maa gbinni.
en: Jesus told them this parable, but they did not understand what he meant.

dag: Zakaria min o maligumaanitab daa yi tumdila maligumaanitali tuma deeri taba.
en: One day Zechariah's group of priests were on duty, and he was serving God as a priest.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti ʒini Naawuni jɛmbu duu miri bɛ liɣiri tɔhibu shee n-yuuni niriba ni tɔhiri liɣiri shɛm; ka bundaannim tɔhiri pampam.
en: Jesus was sitting in the temple near the offering box and watching people put in their gifts. He noticed that many rich people were giving a lot of money.

dag: Dinzuɣu bahi naaya yi yaannim tuma maa!.
en: And you will finish the sin that your ancestors started!.

dag: Saha shɛli o ni daa zali pɔhim di tibisim ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm, ka buɣisi kom tariga ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm la.
en: God gave the wind its power. He decided how big to make the oceans.

dag: So yi be yi ni n-nyɛ ŋun ka, ka nyɛ yi ʒilɛl ni nira m-be yi tin shɛl ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya maa ni, yin di kuuya yi nini niŋ o bee n-kpibi yi nuu zaŋ chaŋ yi ʒiʒiinikpee ŋun ka maa polo.
en: Now if there are some poor persons among you, say one of your fellow Israelites in one of your cities in the land that the LORD your God is giving you, dont be hard-hearted or tightfisted toward your poor fellow Israelites.

dag: ka bɛ daa lan mali gbuɣima pinaayi n-tamtam dura maa yaɣ ayi maa zaa naŋgbaŋgbirima zuɣu. O nam ʒiishee maa ŋmali daa ka na so sani.
en: Twelve figures of lions were on the steps, one at either end of each step. No throne like this had ever existed in any other kingdom.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n wum Ifriim daŋ ni fabindi yɛra, A darigi ti tibili, ka ti saɣi ti tibidarigibo maa. Ti daa ŋmanila naɣisa so bɛ ni bi baligi. Zaŋmi ti labisina, ka chɛ ka ti ka a sanna, dama nyini Yawɛ n-nyɛ ti Naawuni.
en: I have heard Ephraim crying: Lord, you punished me, and I learned my lesson. I was like a calf that was never trained. Please stop punishing me, and I will come back to you. You really are the Lord my God.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka buɣim di Taai goma n-saɣim bɛ ni me goma gili luɣ shɛŋa la zaa.
en: So I will send a fire on the wall of Tyre; it will devour their palaces.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu lomiya ania n-chɛ ka zaɣisuntali pahi yi yɛda niŋbu zuɣu, ka chɛ ka baŋsim pahi yi zaɣisuntali zuɣu.
en: For this very reason do your best to add goodness to your faith; to your goodness add knowledge;.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔshafat bia Jɛhu ŋun daa nyɛ Nimshi yaaŋa la daa lo nia ni o liri Jɔram. Di saha maa Jɔram mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa pun dola Ramɔtigiliad n-gu Siria Naa Hazaɛl;.
en: Then Jehu, Jehoshaphats son and Nimshis grandson, plotted against Joram. Now Joram along with all of Israel had been guarding Ramoth-gilead against Arams King Hazael.

dag: Yɛm mini baŋsim din chɛ ka o tooi kahigiri zahima mini yɛliŋaha ni yɛlimuɣisira wuhiri niriba shia be o ni. Dinzuɣu timmi ti boli Daniɛl ŋun nyɛ naa ni daa boli so Bɛlitishaaza la na, ka o ti wuh a yɛla ŋɔ zaa gbinni.
en: He also changed the man's name from Daniel to Belteshazzar. Not only is he wise and intelligent, but he can explain dreams and riddles and solve difficult problems. Send for Daniel, and he will tell you what the writing means.

dag: Amaa bɛ daalikama mini bɛ ni daa yi booni alikama shɛli sipɛlit la, din daa bi saɣim, dama di daa bi daŋdi niŋbu.
en: But both durum and spelt wheat werent ruined, because they hadnt come up.

dag: So yi yɛn zaŋ chi bee kawana na ti mali sara, ŋun zaŋm li niɛm zim, ka bo kpam mini firanki tulaale zim pahi di zuɣu.
en: When any of you present an offering of grain to the Lord , you must first grind it into flour. You must put olive oil and incense on it.

dag: Di saha maa ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba zaa daa laɣim maligumaaniba kpamba zuɣulan so ŋun yuli daa booni Kaiafas la yiŋa.
en: At that time the chief priests and the nation's leaders were meeting at the home of Caiaphas the high priest.

dag: Di simdi ka yi chɛ ka buɣim kul be sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu dira sahakam, di bi simdi ni di kpi.
en: The altar fire must always be kept burning—it must never go out.

dag: Bɛ daa yi yila daa na bɛ bi diri bindirigu faashee bɛ paɣila bɛ ni pɔi. Ka bɛ daa lan paai bɛ yaannim kal shɛŋa dol li pahi. Dina n-nyɛ: Pipihi mini duɣiri ni taha ni teebuya paɣibu.
en: None of them will eat anything they buy in the market until it is washed. They also follow a lot of other teachings, such as washing cups, pitchers, and bowls.

dag: Di daa lan yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm yɛl shɛŋa din sab gbaŋ maa ni n-wuhi ni di nyɛla zaligu, ka chɛ ka sokam ŋun be bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣili kam ni baŋ di yɛla lala. Ka di daa chɛ ka Yɛhudianim mali shili gu ni bɛ ti bɔhi bɛ dimnim biɛri di dabisili maa dali.
en: It was to be proclaimed as law and made known to everyone in every province, so that the Jews would be ready to take revenge on their enemies when that day came.

dag: Ti Naawuni maa nyɛla tiliginsim Naawuni. Ti Duuma Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun tiligiri niriba kum ni.
en: You always protect us and save us from death.

dag: Ka Ammɔn kpamba daa bɔhi Hanun, A tɛhiya ni Dauda ni tim na ka bɛ ti sɔɣi kuli maa wuhiri ni jilima ka o ti a ba maa? O tuumba maa kamina ni bɛ ti vihi baŋ ya ŋɔ daashili zaa, ka o kana ti tuhi nyaŋ ti.
en: the Ammonite leaders said to Hanun, Do you really believe King David is honoring your father by sending these men to comfort you? He probably sent them to spy on our country, so he can come and destroy it.

dag: Yɛm tuma nyɛla din chɛ ka biɛhigu niŋdi nyaɣisim, ka di soya zaa nyɛ din tahiri suhudoo na.
en: Wisdom can make your life pleasant and lead you safely through it.

dag: Dinzuɣu pa ŋun biriti bee ŋun mihiri kom maa n-nyɛ shɛli, amaa Naawuni ŋun chɛ ka di zoori maa n-nyɛ shɛli.
en: What matters isn't those who planted or watered, but God who made the plants grow.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee mali yɛm viɛnyɛliŋga din ni baŋ dimbɔŋɔ gbinni? Banim ka Yawɛ lee tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, ka bɛ ni tooi zaŋ li moli? Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka tiŋgbani maa bahi yoli doya kaman tiŋgban nɛli, ka so bi lan gariti nimaani?.
en: Who is wise enough to understand this? Who has been taught by the LORD and can therefore explain it? Why has the land been reduced to rubble and laid waste like a desert, with no one passing through?.

dag: Dama naa min o kpamba ni bɛn zaa daa laɣim Jɛrusalɛm maa daa to jina n-saɣi ni bɛ puhimi Yaɣigari chuɣu maa gol so ŋun pahir ayi puuni.
en: King Hezekiah agreed with all his officials and all the assembly in Jerusalem to have the Passover in the second month.

dag: Naawuni tim a sakom din mal alibarika, ka chɛ ka a tiŋgbani vuhira. Naawuni tim a kawana mini wain pam.
en: May God give you dew from heaven and make your fields fertile! May he give you plenty of grain and wine!.

dag: Ka o zuɣuri la ni yini daa mali dan titali din ŋmani din yɛn ku o; amaa ka daa lee lan naai, ka di daa niŋ dunianim zaa alahiziba ka bɛ kab dol o.
en: One of its heads appeared to have been slain and killed, but its deadly wound was healed. So the whole earth was amazed and followed the beast.

dag: Naawuni yi be ti sani, ti ni di nasara. Ŋuna n-yɛn du n-tam ti dimnim zuɣu.
en: Only you give us victory and crush our enemies.

dag: ni di chɛ ka Abimilɛk mini Shɛkɛmnim bɛn daa kpaŋs o suhu ka o ku Gidiɔn bidibisi pisopɔin bɛn daa nyɛ o ba bihi la laɣim deei bɛ ʒim yihibu maa tibidarigibo.
en: This occurred because of the violence done to Jerubbaals seventy sons. Their blood came back on their brother Abimelech, who killed them, and on the leaders of Shechem, who supported him when he killed his brothers.

dag: M mali baŋsim gari ninkura, dama n kul gbibila a zaligunim maa.
en: I have more understanding than the elders because I guard your precepts.

dag: N suhu yiɣisiya pam bahi zuliya shɛb bɛn be afua ni la zuɣu. N suhu daa yiɣisila biɛla bahi n niriba maa zuɣu, amaa ka bɛ kpe di ni n-dihi ba wahala biɛri pahi.
en: And I am exceedingly angry with those carefree nations. Though I was somewhat angry, they added to the violence.

dag: ni binyɛr viɛl shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn yɛri tumdi tuma luɣ kasi shee mini Aduna ŋun nyɛ maligumaana binyɛra din be kasi ni o bidibisi ni yɛn yɛri binyɛr shɛŋa tumdi maligumaaniba tuma.
en: and the finely woven priestly clothes for Aaron and his sons.

dag: N naan zaŋ n yɛtɔɣa maa sɔŋ o tooni ka ti tɔɣisi di yɛla.
en: and argue my case.

dag: Bɛ ni daa gbahi zahim maa shɛm maa zuɣu ka di daa niŋ Saimɔn mini bɛnkam zaa be o sani maa alahiziba pam.
en: Peter and everyone with him were completely surprised at all the fish they had caught.

dag: ka ashili yuli sab pa o gbɛɣu zuɣu. Di ni daa sab shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Babilɔn titali, pagɔra mini dunia chihi biɛri ma.
en: On her forehead was written a name that has a secret meaning: Great Babylon, the mother of all prostitutes and perverts in the world.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Miriya ka yi tumdi yi wuntia tuma ni niriba nyari ya m-paɣiri ya di zuɣu; yi yi niŋdi lala, yi ku nya laara yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ sani.
en: Make certain you do not perform your religious duties in public so that people will see what you do. If you do these things publicly, you will not have any reward from your Father in heaven.

dag: N ni gbilisi tibili labila yɛtɔɣ ŋaha polo, ka ŋme mɔɣilo n-kahigi di gbinni wuhi.
en: I listened to these sayings. And now, with my harp, I will sing and make the hidden meaning clear.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni nira niŋ siɣa ni yɛm dimbɔŋɔ puuni. Zuɣur ayopɔin maa nyɛla zoya ayopɔin shɛŋa zuɣu paɣ maa ni du n-ʒiya;.
en: This calls for wisdom and understanding. The seven heads are seven hills, on which the woman sits. They are also seven kings:.

dag: N yi lih a ni nam sagban shɛŋa ŋɔ, ka lihi goli mini saŋmar shɛb a ni nam ŋɔ.
en: I often think of the heavens your hands have made, and of the moon and stars you put in place.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli biriginsim soli, Yawɛ ni zaŋ ba pahi tuumbiɛrinim zuɣu n-darigi bɛ tibili. Naawuni tim Izraɛlnim suhudoo!.
en: But when you punish the wicked, punish also those who abandon your ways. Peace be with Israel!.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa pihi kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya, ka zaŋ fɔntinsi ŋɔ mini di tiŋkpansi m-pahi di biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee ti Lɛvinim kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli Musa shɛm la.
en: So the Israelites gave these cities and their pasturelands to the Levites by lot, exactly as the LORD had commanded through Moses.

dag: Yi nyari suhukpaŋsibo yi ni be Masia ni la zuɣu? Yi nyari suhumaabo o yurilim zuɣu? Yi mini Naawuni Shia Kasi mali simdi ni taba? Yi niŋdi tab nirilim ka zɔri tab nambɔɣu?.
en: Think about what we have in Christ: the encouragement he has brought us, the comfort of his love, our sharing in his Spirit, and the mercy and kindness he has shown us. If you enjoy these blessings.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Ahasivɛrɔs daa bɔhi Napaɣ Ɛsta, Ninvuɣ ŋuni n-lee buɣisi lala niŋbu maa? Ya ka lala nir maa lee be.
en: Who would dare to do such a thing? the king asked.

dag: Chɛ ka so ku niŋ o nirilim. So di zo o kpibisi maa nambɔɣu.
en: Don't let anyone be kind to him or have pity on the children he leaves behind.

dag: Bɛ zuɣu ka m mali mmaŋa m-be kasi ni di chɛ ka bɛ gba mali bɛmaŋa m-be kasi a yɛlimaŋli maa puuni.
en: I have given myself completely for their sake, so they may belong completely to the truth.

dag: Amaa hal o yi bi yihi ti, Naa, nyin baŋmi ni ti ku jɛm a wuna ŋɔ min a ni mali salima binnan shɛli zali maa.
en: But even if he doesn't, Your Majesty may be sure that we will not worship your god, and we will not bow down to the gold statue that you have set up.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa ti yiɣis o kpim maa sani n-chaŋ ti yɛli Hitinima.
en: He left the place where his wife's body was lying, went to the Hittites, and said.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛlila Jɛfita, Kamina ti leei ti zuɣulana n-zaŋ ti chaŋ ka ti ti tuhi Ammɔnnima.
en: The elders said to Jephthah, Come and be our leader so that we can fight the Ammonites.

dag: Ka o daa wuhi ya o daalikauli shɛli o ni zali ya ni yi doli, dina n-nyɛ o fukumsi zaligunim pia la. Ka o daa sabi li pa kuɣiparilana ayi zuɣu.
en: The Lord told you about his agreement, which he commanded you to obey. He told you about the Ten Commandments, which he wrote on two stone tablets.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yi ʒi yi ni suhiri shɛli maa. Yi ni ti tooi nyu binnyur shɛli din be m pipia la ni ka n yɛn nyu la? Ka tooi deei baptaizibu shɛli bɛ ni ti yɛn baptaizi ma la.
en: Jesus said, You dont understand what you are asking. Can you drink from the cup that I must drink from? Can you be baptized with the same baptism that I must go through.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, Pa ŋunkam dii booni ma, N Duuma, n Duuma, n-ni ti kpe alizanda nam ni, naɣila ŋun tumdi m Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ yubu.
en: Not everyone who calls me their Lord will get into the kingdom of heaven. Only the ones who obey my Father in heaven will get in.

dag: Di saha ka Yɛhudianim maa daa bɔhi taba, Ya polo ka o lee yɛn chaŋ ka ti ku lan nya o? O yɛn chaŋla Yɛhudianim ni wurim chaŋ nti be Giriikinim tin shɛŋa la ni ti wuhiri Giriikinim maa yɔɣɔ.
en: The people asked each other, Where can he go to keep us from finding him? Is he going to some foreign country where our people live? Is he going there to teach the Greeks?.

dag: Zuɣusaa, chɛ ka wuntia luna kaman saa la. Chɛ ka tiŋgbani bɔɣi, ka tiliginsim yina; ka chɛ ka wuntia gba yina; Man Yawɛ n-nam li.
en: Pour down, you heavens above, and let the clouds flow with righteousness. Let the earth open for salvation to bear fruit; let righteousness sprout as well. I, the LORD, have created these things.

dag: ni Iddo ni Ginnɛtɔi ni Abija.
en: Iddo, Ginnethoi, Abijah.

dag: N ni chɛ n niriba bɛn kpalim la bahi, ka zaŋ ba niŋ bɛ dimnim nuu ni, ka bɛ nyaŋ ba ka di bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ nɛma zaa.
en: I will abandon the people who survive, and will hand them over to their enemies, who will conquer them and plunder their land.

dag: O niŋla Naawuni naani; lala zuɣu Naawuni yi bɔr o, ŋun fam o bahi pumpɔŋɔ, dama o yɛliya, N nyɛla Naawuni Bia. .
en: He trusts in God and claims to be God's Son. Well, then, let us see if God wants to save him now.

dag: ka o yina nti yɔhim zuliya kam bɛn be dunia luɣ anahi ŋɔ ni. Bɛna n-nyɛ bɛ ni booni shɛb Gɔg mini Magɔg. O ni ti laɣim ba lo tɔbu; ka bɛ kalinli ni ŋmanila mɔɣ bihigu.
en: He will fool the countries of Gog and Magog, which are at the far ends of the earth, and their people will follow him into battle. They will have as many followers as there are grains of sand along the beach.

dag: Yi ni zaŋdi yi pin shɛŋa na maa ka buchi. Chɛliya li zaŋbuna. Yi tulaale zim nyɛla zaɣ biɛɣu n sani. Yi goli palli churi puhibu mini vuhim dabisa ni yi ni booni laɣiŋgu shɛŋa puuni, n je alahichi ni be yi jɛmbu laɣiŋgu shɛŋa ni.
en: Your sacrifices are worthless, and your incense disgusting. I can't stand the evil you do on your New Moon Festivals or on your Sabbaths and other times of worship.

dag: Biŋkɔbiri kul yɛrigila mɔɣu ni; ka bindira kul zibigi vinvama ni, ka bɛ tahira, ka laɣim duhiri bɛ yɛhi yiini yila suhupiɛlli zuɣu.
en: The pastures are covered with sheep. The valleys are filled with grain. Everything is singing and shouting for joy.

dag: Yawɛ ku chɛ ka zaɣ biɛ shɛli niŋ a. O ni gul a nyɛvili.
en: The LORD will protect you from all evil; God will protect your very life.

dag: Amaa ka Ammɔn naa maa daa zaɣisi ni o ku wum Jɛfita ni tim na ti yɛl o shɛm maa.
en: But the king of Ammon paid no attention to Jephthah's message.

dag: din ni chɛ ka yi woligi bɛn nyɛ daɣiri ni bɛn viɛla, ka lan baŋ yin ni di binnamdi so ŋun mali nyɛvili ni yin ku di binnamdi so ŋun mali nyɛvili.
en: in order to distinguish between the unclean and the clean and between creatures that can be eaten and those that cannot.

dag: Yawɛ, zaŋm ti labis a sani, ka chɛ ka ti lan lab a sanna. Chɛ ka ti lan labi ti biɛr kurili la ni.
en: Bring us back to you, Lord ! Bring us back! Restore our ancient glory.

dag: Ʒiɛmana kanimina ka vuura, amaa dunia ŋɔ din kul ni beni sahakam.
en: People come, and people go, but still the world never changes.

dag: Bɛ bihi ʒiɛla bɛ tooni, ka bɛ nina nya bɛ yaansi.
en: They watch their children grow up and live to see their grandchildren.

dag: Alibarika ni ti be yi bihi ni. Alibarika ni ti be yi puri atam ni, alibarika ni ti be yi biŋkɔbiri bihi ni. Yi niɣi mini yi biŋkɔbbaligu bihi ni ti nabi.
en: He will bless you and give you many children. He will bless your land and give you good crops. He will bless your animals and let them have many babies. He will bless you with calves and lambs.

dag: Ka Ayuba daa lan gbaag o yɛtɔɣa yɛli.
en: I swear by the living Almighty God, who refuses me justice and makes my life bitter—.

dag: Anabitali yɛtɔɣa nyɛla din be naa noli ni, ka o ka alahichi saria karibu ni.
en: A kings speech is like an oracle; in a judgment, one cant go against his words.

dag: N kpahimya nya ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri yɛm pam nyɛla bɛn mali suhuyiɣisili. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mi bɔri baŋsim pam nyɛla bɛn mali suhugarigu.
en: Remember: In much wisdom is much aggravation; the more knowledge, the more pain.

dag: Wain yi ti mɔha, ka be pipia ni kpeera, ka yiɣiri lɛbira, nyin di lihi li.
en: Don't even look at that colorful stuff bubbling up in the glass! It goes down so easily.

dag: Hɛzirɔn ni daa ti kani tin shɛli din yuli booni Kalɛb Ɛfirata la ni nyaaŋa ka o pakoli Abija daa dɔɣi Ashihur ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛkɔa ba la.
en: After Hezron died, his son Caleb married Ephrath, his father's widow. They had a son named Ashhur, who founded the town of Tekoa.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa ʒe nimaani bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu ka yi lɔrigiri buŋ maa.
en: some of the people standing there asked, Why are you untying the donkey.

dag: N daa ko ʒiɛri puri mini tihi puri, ka tiwala balibu kam tihi be di ni.
en: I made gardens and parks for myself, planting every kind of fruit tree in them.

dag: Amaa yi yi mali nyuli zabbu din yiri putɔɣu ni na mini diribarilim tɛha yi suhuri ni, yin miriya ka yi nyuri bara, ka leei bɛn chihiri din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli.
en: If you are selfish and have bitter jealousy in your hearts, you have no reason to boast. Your boasting is a lie that hides the truth.

dag: Yi yi ni deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ noli, ka dol o fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa zaa n ni zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: But this will happen only if you obey the Lord your God. You must be careful to obey every command that I have told you today.

dag: Di saha ka omaŋmaŋ daa yiɣisi chaŋ Rama nti chaŋ kɔbil titali din be Sɛku la gbini ti bɔhi, Ya ka Samuɛl mini Dauda lee be la? Ka so yɛl o, Nyama bɛ be Naiɔt Rama tiŋgban ni.
en: Finally, Saul left for Ramah himself. He went as far as the deep pit at the town of Secu, and he asked, Where are Samuel and David? At Prophets Village in Ramah, the people answered.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛli Samuɛl, Wummi bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka bo naa ti ba. Di saha ka Samuɛl daa yɛli Izraɛlnim maa, Sokam labimi kul o ya.
en: Then the LORD said to Samuel, Comply with their request. Give them a king. Samuel then told the Israelite people, Go back, each of you, to your own hometown.

dag: Ka so daa kana ti yɛli Dauda, Izraɛlnim suhuri lɛbigila Absalom polo.
en: A man came in to tell the news to David. The man said, The people of Israel are beginning to follow Absalom.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa paai Dauda tiŋ maa ni, ka Mikal ŋun daa nyɛ Sool bipuɣiŋga la daa lihi takɔro ni na n-nya Naa Dauda ni wari waa ka yiɣiri jɛmda, ka o ʒiɛm o o suhu ni.
en: When the Box of the Lord s Agreement arrived at the City of David, Sauls daughter Michal looked through a window. When she saw King David dancing and playing, she lost her respect for him.

dag: ka a zuliya ni ti bemi kaman bihigu la, ka yi ni yɛligi kpa wulinluhili polo mini wulimpuhili polo ni nuzaa polo ni nudirigu polo, ka dunia ŋɔ zuliya zaa ni ti nya alibarika la a min a zuliya maa zuɣu.
en: Your descendants will spread over the earth in all directions and will become as numerous as the specks of dust. Your family will be a blessing to all people.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba ni dinzuɣu bɛ chɛ ka bɛ ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ zuɣuri dol o chaŋ ti wuhi doo maa taali ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: If he has done anything wrong, let your leaders go with me and bring charges against him there.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi, a wuhiri ba ni a gba bela kasi, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mi nyɛ ninvuɣ biɛri, a wuhiri ba a ninkuunsi ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: You never do wrong to those who have done no wrong. But you outsmart the wicked, no matter how clever they are.

dag: Di saha ka o naanyi kahigi yɛli ba, Lazarɔs kpimi;.
en: So Jesus told them plainly, Lazarus is dead.

dag: Ka Naawuni nyɛla ŋun ni tooi niŋ alibarika din galisi pam niŋ yi ni, ka di chɛ ka yi kul mali binshɛɣukam ka di saɣiri ya, ka chɛ ka yi tooi mali pam din ni zaŋ tum tuun suŋ kam.
en: God can bless you with everything you need, and you will always have more than enough to do all kinds of good things for others.

dag: ka di bi ba jila bɛ suhuri ni viɛnyɛliŋga. Lala niriba niŋdila yɛda daba ayi, ka wahala bee muɣisigu yi ti paai ba Naawuni yɛligu maa zuɣu, bɛ dii zaŋdi li mi bahi.
en: Because they have no roots, they last for only a little while. When they experience distress or abuse because of the word, they immediately fall away.

dag: Gumiya yimaŋ viɛnyɛliŋga ka chɛ niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu, ka di ku lu yi zuɣu. Doliya Lɛvi maligumaaniba la ni wuhiri ya shɛlikam la viɛnyɛliŋga kaman n ni zali ba shɛm.
en: I have told the priests what to do if any of you have leprosy, so do exactly what they say.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ Yawɛ naani ŋmanila Ziɔn Zoli din ku tooi dam, ka kul ni beni sahakam la.
en: Those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion. They will never be shaken. They will continue forever.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu Anabi Musa ni daa ti bi doo, o daa zaɣisiya ni o pala Firawuna bipuɣiŋga bia.
en: Then after Moses grew up, his faith made him refuse to be called the king's grandson.

dag: Dinzuɣu nyini pagɔrili ŋɔ, wummi Yawɛ yɛligu.
en: Prostitute, listen to the message from the Lord .

dag: Ka Dauda daa lo noli, ka kpe duu nti teei dɔni tiŋgban ni suhiri Naawuni bia maa zuɣu din dali maa yuŋ zaa.
en: David prayed to God for the baby. David refused to eat or drink. He went into his house and stayed there and lay on the ground all night.

dag: Ti mi ni Naawuni fukumsi zaligu nyɛla Naawuni yɛla, amaa man kul nyɛla ŋun mali ninsalitali biɛhigu ka nyɛ alahichi dabili.
en: We know that the Law is spiritual; but I am a mortal, sold as a slave to sin.

dag: Ka n daa lan zaŋ Araba gba mini Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili mini di duli zaŋ Kinɛrɛt ni Araba Teeku din nyɛ Teeku Kpiŋ la ni Pisiga zo lɔŋ din be wulimpuhili polo la ti ba.
en: Also the desert plain, with the Jordan River as the boundary, from the Galilee Sea down to the desert sea below the slopes of Mount Pisgah on the east.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa, saha shɛli Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib min o tɔbbihi zaa ni daa do Lakishi la ka o daa tim o tuumba Jɛrusalɛm Juda Naa Hɛzɛkia mini Judanim zaa bɛn daa be Jɛrusalɛm la sani nti yɛli ba.
en: After this Assyrias King Sennacherib, who was attacking Lachish with all his forces, sent his servants to Jerusalem with the following message for Judahs King Hezekiah and all the people of Judah who were in Jerusalem.

dag: N ni ti ti ba tiŋgban shɛli din mali atam viɛnyɛliŋga, ka bɛ ku lan kpi kum tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni yaha. Ka zuliya shɛb ku lan tu ba yaha.
en: I will give them some land that will make a good garden. Then they will not suffer from hunger in that land or suffer the insults from the nations anymore.

dag: Ka malaika maa garigi yɛl o, Naawuni Shia Kasi ni ti siɣ a zuɣu na, ka Zallakudura Naa yiko mahim ti gil a; dinzuɣu a ni ti yɛn dɔɣi bi so maa, bɛ ni ti boon o la bi suŋ ni Naawuni Bia.
en: The angel answered, The Holy Spirit will come down to you, and God's power will come over you. So your child will be called the holy Son of God.

dag: Ka so ti ku lan wum mɔɣilo ŋmɛriba mini bana ni alijeeta piɛbiriba ni kika piɛbiriba damli a ni; ka tuuni kam tuumbaŋda ti ku lan be a ni, ka so ti ku lan wum nɛli vubu a ni!.
en: The music of harps and of human voices, of players of the flute and the trumpet, will never be heard in you again! No workman in any trade will ever be found in you again; and the sound of the millstone will be heard no more!.

dag: Ka Musa suhu daa yiɣisi bahi sapashin kpamba bɛn daa yi tɔb maa ni na ka nyɛ bɛn su tɔbbihi tuhilituhili mini bɛn su tɔbbihi kɔbigakɔbiga fukumsi la zuɣu.
en: Moses became angry with the commanders of the army, the officers of thousands and the officers of hundreds, who came back from the battle.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋunkam zaɣisi wuhibu ŋɔ, pa ninsal wuhibu ka o zaɣisi, amaa Naawuni ŋun ti ti o Shia Kasi la wuhibu ka o zaɣisi maa.
en: So then, whoever rejects this teaching is not rejecting a human being, but God, who gives you his Holy Spirit.

dag: A mini Vɛdannim ni Javannim bɛn yi Uzal na daa niŋdila a nɛma daabiligu. Bɛ daa lan zaŋdila kuriti mini kasia ni tulaale na ti taɣiri a daguya.
en: Damascus traded wine from Uzal for the things you sold. They paid with wrought iron, cassia, and sugar cane.

dag: Ka Ɛsa daa nyɛ Jɛhɔshafat ba, ka Jɛhɔshafat nyɛ Jɔram ba, ka Jɔram mi nyɛ Yuzaia ba.
en: Asa was the father of Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat was the father of Jehoram. Jehoram was the father of Uzziah.

dag: Bɛ ni teei gili yinim ninvuɣ shɛb ŋɔ, kpuɣimiya yi daadiikunim tiŋgban ni.
en: People of Jerusalem, you are under siege! Gather up your belongings.

dag: Ka n yi daa nyu bara yi zuɣu o sani, dindina vi bi mali ma di zuɣu, amaa kaman ti ni daa pun yɛli ya binshɛɣukam ni daa nyɛ yɛlimaŋli shɛm la, lala ka ti barinyubo yi zuɣu Taitus sani gba wuhi palɔni ni di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: I did boast of you to him, and you have not disappointed me. We have always spoken the truth to you, and in the same way the boast we made to Titus has proved true.

dag: ni Rakalnima ni Jɛramiilnim tinsi ni Kɛnnim tinsi.
en: and Racal; to the clan of Jerahmeel, to the Kenites.

dag: Di saha maa ka Farisiinim shɛb daa ka Yisa sanna ti yɛl o, Yim ya ŋɔ, dama Naa Hɛrɔd lɔri nia ni o ku a.
en: At that same time some Pharisees came to Jesus and said to him, You must get out of here and go somewhere else, because Herod wants to kill you.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ ŋun daa zali ya ŋɔ yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ yi polo Izraɛlnim mini Judanim ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛli la zuɣu. Bɛ maanila maligu tiri Baal n-yiɣisiri n suhu.
en: The LORD of heavenly forces who planted you has announced disaster for you, because the people of Israel and Judah have done evil and made me angry by worshipping Baal.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa chɛ ka niriba bɛn ʒe dunol ni n-nyɛ ninkura mini bipola maa zaa zom, ka chani bɔbindi bɔri dunoli shee.
en: Then the messengers blinded the men near the entrance of the house, from the youngest to the oldest, so that they groped around trying to find the entrance.

dag: Gbibi n nyɛvili, dama n zaŋla mmaŋ zaa ti a; tiligim a dabili ŋun niŋ a naani ŋɔ. Nyini n-nyɛ n Naawuni.
en: Guard my life because I am faithful. Save your servant who trusts in you—you! My God!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbaai tab bɔhibu ni bɛ baŋ bɛ ni yino ŋun yɛn niŋ lala maa.
en: They began to argue among themselves about which of them it could possibly be who would do this.

dag: Ka kom zo n-tiɛli n zuɣu, ka n yɛli, N ku be.
en: Water covered my head— I thought I was gone.

dag: Ka do so daa ti nya o ka o be mɔɣu ni chani ginda, ka o bɔh o, Bɔ ka a lee bɔra.
en: and wandering through the fields, when a man asked, What are you looking for.

dag: Ʒii maa nyabu puuni, n daa nya ka m bela Susa nayili tin shɛli din be vinvamli ni Ɛlam tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, ka daa lan nya ka n ʒɛla Ulai Mɔɣili noli.
en: In the vision I suddenly found myself in the walled city of Susa in the province of Elam. I was standing by the Ulai River.

dag: Ti ni daa kul wum li; ti suhuri zaa daa dii fuŋmi, ka suhukpeeni lan ka ti ni so suhu ni yi zuɣu; dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni maa n-nyɛ zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani Naawuni.
en: We were afraid as soon as we heard about it; we have all lost our courage because of you. The Lord your God is God in heaven above and here on earth.

dag: Bɛn daa pahi bɛ zuɣu n-nyɛ Hɛman mini Jɛdutun ni bɛ ni daa lan pii ninvuɣ shɛb zali ni bɛ paɣiri Yawɛ o yurilim din bi naara ŋɔ zuɣu la.
en: With them were Heman and Jeduthun and the rest of those chosen by name to give thanks to the LORD, because his faithful love lasts forever.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Kpuɣim a jaaŋgbɛ shɛli a ni daa zaŋ fiɛbi Nail la n-niŋ a nuu ni, ka zaŋ Izraɛl kpamba pah amaŋ zuɣu, ka yi gari niriba maa tooni chaŋ.
en: The Lord answered, Take some of the leaders with you and go ahead of the rest of the people. Also take along the walking stick with which you struck the Nile River.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli niriba maa, Di simdi ka yi teeri dabisili ŋɔ yɛla, di nyɛla yi ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni dahin shɛli ka yi dabitim bandi ni la, dama Yawɛ yiko nuu n-daa yihi ya nimaani maa. Di bi simdi ka yi ŋubi bɔrɔbɔro din mali dabindi.
en: Moses said to the people, Remember this day—the day on which you left Egypt, the place where you were slaves. This is the day the Lord brought you out by his great power. No leavened bread is to be eaten.

dag: Ifriimnima, buɣa bukaata lee nyɛ bɔ yi sani? Mani n-nyɛ ŋun wumdi yi suhigu, ka lihiri ya. N ŋmanila sipirɛs tia din vari kul mahi ʒiɛya sahakam la. Yi bidɔɣiligu yirila n kɔbili ni na.
en: Ephraim, I will have nothing more to do with idols. I am the one who answers your prayers and watches over you. I am like a fir tree that is always green. Your fruit comes from me.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri suhuri kul bɔrila zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu, bɛ bi zɔri bɛ ʒiʒiinitab nambɔɣu.
en: Evil people want to do wrong, even to their friends.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa nyaandoliba daa ka o sanna ti bɔh o, Ŋuni n-lee gari sokam zaa alizanda nam ni.
en: At that time the disciples came to Jesus and asked, Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.

dag: Pa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-chɛ ka niriba tumdi tuma ka buɣim diri li, ka niriba diri wahala yol la?.
en: But the Lord All-Powerful has decided that a fire will destroy everything that those people worked to build. All their work will be for nothing.

dag: Ka bɛ yi saɣi suhumahili yɛtɔɣa maa, ka zaŋ bɛmaŋ tin ya, dindina ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be nimaani zaa ni tum dabitim tuma tin ya.
en: If the city responds with peaceful terms and surrenders to you, then all the people in the city will serve you as forced laborers.

dag: Ka ŋunkam shihi dilan bindoo maa, ŋun paɣim o situra ka su kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: Anyone who touches his bed.

dag: Ka bɛ daa tim ti yɛli Jɛzibɛl, Ti lab Nabɔt kuɣa ku o.
en: The leaders of Jezreel sent a message back to Jezebel that said, Naboth is dead.

dag: Bɛ nyo li buɣim; bɛ ŋma li luhi. Lihim ba suhuyiɣisili lihigu ka bɛ kpi.
en: It is burned with fire. It is chopped down. They die at the rebuke coming from you.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Lala ka Izraɛlnim ti yɛn ŋubiri bɛ bɔrɔbɔro daɣiri n ni ti yɛn kari ba tahi zuliya shɛb ni maa sani.
en: Then the Lord said, This will show that the family of Israel will eat unclean bread in foreign countries and that I am the one who forced them to leave Israel and go to those countries.

dag: Dinzuɣu nyama, pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ zaŋla ʒiri shia niŋ a daanabinim ŋɔ zaa noya ni. Yawɛ yɛlila din nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ a polo.
en: So now, since the LORD has placed a lying spirit in the mouths of every one of these prophets of yours, it is the LORD who has pronounced disaster against you.

dag: Amaa n ni daa yuuni bɔri zaɣ viɛlli saha shɛli, zaɣ biɛɣu n-daa paai ma; ka n ni daa guhiri neesim saha shɛli, zibisim n-daa ti kana.
en: for I awaited good, but evil came; I expected light, but gloom arrived.

dag: O daa lan me bimbina zali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu puuni, Yawɛ ni daa yɛli, Jɛrusalɛm n-nyɛ luɣ shɛli n yuli ni yɛn be sahakam la.
en: He even built altars in the LORDs temple, the very place the LORD was speaking about when he said, My name will remain in Jerusalem forever.

dag: So yi chɛ bɔɣili yali bee so yi gbi bɔɣili ka bi ŋari li, ka nahu bee buŋ lu di puuni kpi.
en: If someone takes the cover off a pit or if he digs one and does not cover it, and a bull or a donkey falls into it.

dag: dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ ninʒeensinim liriti ma mi. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ ninkuunsinim lo nia ni bɛ ku ma. Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn baɣa ka Naawuni ni.
en: Cruel strangers have attacked and want me dead. Not one of them cares about you.

dag: ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: Then the Lord told me.

dag: Daadam, zaŋm a nini kpa Izraɛl zoya polo n-tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi li.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, face the hills of Israel and tell them:.

dag: Ka yi daa garigi yɛli ma, Ti tum alahichi Yawɛ sani. Ti ni chaŋ ti tuhi tɔbu maa kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ti shɛm maa. Ka yi ni doo kam daa zaŋ o tɔbutuhiri nɛma niŋ omaŋa, ka daa tɛhi ni zoya ni tiŋ maa ni chandi yɛn nyɛla asama.
en: You replied, Moses, we have sinned against the Lord . But now we will attack, just as the Lord our God commanded us. Then each one of you got ready to fight, thinking it would be easy to invade the hill country.

dag: Kaman sagbana ni yi wurim naai shɛm la, lala ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpi ku lan labina.
en: Just as clouds that come and go, people are put in the grave, never to rise again.

dag: Ka sanʒiɛ titali daa ti yiɣisi teeku maa ni, ka kɔgbana yiɣiri luri ŋariŋ maa ni hal ka kom ti yɛn kpe m-pal li; amaa ka Yisa do di ni gbihira.
en: Suddenly a fierce storm hit the lake, and the boat was in danger of sinking. But Jesus was asleep.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum lala maa ka bɛ deei kom baptaizibu ti Duuma Yisa yuli zuɣu.
en: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Ŋahili maa gbinni m-bɔŋɔ: Bimbira maa nyɛla Naawuni yɛligu.
en: This is what the story means: The seed is God's message.

dag: ka chɛ ka o su binshɛɣukam zaa fukumsi. Di yɛliya ni Naawuni daa zaŋ ninsala n-leei ŋun su binshɛɣukam fukumsi. Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiya ni shɛli kani ka Naawuni bi wuhi ni ninsal su li, amaa ti bi nya ka ninsal su binshɛɣukam zaa pumpɔŋɔ.
en: and made them rulers over all things. It says that God made them rulers over all things; this clearly includes everything. We do not, however, see human beings ruling over all things now.

dag: Ka Absalom daa bɔhi Hushai, A ʒiɛyimtali zaŋ chaŋ a zo maa sani ni bahindi shɛm m-bala? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a bi dol a zo maa chaŋ.
en: But Absalom asked Hushai, Is this how you show loyalty to your friend David? Why didn't you go with him.

dag: Hal bɛ kalinli ni daa bi galisi, ka bɛ lan nyɛ saamba nimaani.
en: At the time there were only a few of us, and we were homeless.

dag: Harif ni Anatɔt ni Nɛbai ni.
en: Hariph, Anathoth, Nebai.

dag: Di saha ka buɣili Zius ŋun duu daa be tiŋ maa tooni la tindana daa bo naɣilahi mini vari n-ka tiŋ maa gooni dunol ni na ni o mini niriba maa ti kɔrigi mali ba.
en: The temple of Zeus was near the city. The priest of this temple brought some bulls and flowers to the city gates. The priest and the people wanted to offer a sacrifice to Paul and Barnabas.

dag: O suhu kul yɛla yi zaa nyabu zuɣu, ka o suhu bi doya, dama yi daa wum ni o biɛra.
en: He misses you all, and he was upset because you heard he was sick.

dag: Ka Omri mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa daa yi Gibɛtɔn n-chaŋ ti teei gili Tiriza.
en: Then Omri and all the soldiers of Israel left Gibbethon and went to Tirzah. They surrounded the city and attacked it.

dag: amaa ka di bi ba jila o suhu ni viɛnyɛliŋga. Lala nira niŋdila yɛda daba ayi, ka wahala bee muɣisigu yi ti paag o Naawuni yɛligu maa zuɣu, o dii zaŋdi li mi bahi.
en: Because they have no roots, they last for only a little while. When they experience distress or abuse because of the word, they immediately fall away.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa yɛli Yawɛ malaika so ŋun daa ʒe tuturi ni maa, Ti chaŋ gili dunia zaa n-nya ka dunianim zaa malila suhudoo.
en: Then they responded to the LORDs messenger, who was standing among the myrtles, We have patrolled the earth. The whole earth is peaceful and quiet.

dag: Amaa chɛliya ka yɛlimaŋli naɣ beni kaman kulibɔŋ kom din zɔri la, ka chɛ ka wuntia mi be kaman mɔɣili kom din zɔri la.
en: But let justice and fairness flow like a river that never runs dry.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni wuhiri ba bɛ galimi ni nyɛ shɛm bɛ ninni? Ka ŋuni n-lee yɔri ba bɛ tuma samli?.
en: There is no one to accuse the wicked or pay them back for all they have done.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni tiwal shɛŋa na nti ti ti. Bɛ daa lan ʒi lahibali na ti yɛli, Tiŋgbɔn viɛlli ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ zaŋ ti ti maa.
en: They took some of the lands fruit and then came back down to us. They reported to us: The land that the LORD our God is giving to us is wonderful.

dag: Ti wum Mɔabnim karimbaani yɛla. Bɛ mali karimbaani pam. Ti lan wum bɛ duhimaŋtali mini bɛ karimbaani ni bɛ barinyubo ni bɛ nyarimaŋtali yɛla.
en: I know about your pride, and how you strut and boast.

dag: Ka Yawɛ Shia daa piligi tir o kpiɔŋ saha shɛl o ni daa be Mahanɛdan din be Zɔra mini Ɛshitaol sunsuuni la.
en: And the Lord 's power began to strengthen him while he was between Zorah and Eshtaol in the Camp of Dan.

dag: dama Yawɛ yɛli ma, Miri ka a di bindirigu bee n-nyu kom nimaani bee n doli so shɛli a ni di doli kana labi. .
en: This is what God commanded me by the LORDs word: Dont eat food! Dont drink water! Dont return by the way you came.

dag: Amaa o ni daa ti kul kpɛri ha m-be dunol ni, ka Ahija wum o naba vubu ka yɛli, Jɛrɔbɔam paɣa, kpɛmina; bɔ n-niŋ ka a taɣ a biɛhigu ni a be kaman paɣ so la. M mali yɛtɔɣ kpɛma ni n yɛl a.
en: But when Ahijah heard her coming in the door, he said, Come in. I know you are Jeroboam's wife. Why are you pretending to be someone else? I have bad news for you.

dag: Ka Yawɛ bɔh o, Tuun bɔ ka a lee tum maa? A tizo maa ʒim kukoli kuhigu n-yi tiŋgban ni ka n sanna.
en: Then the Lord said, Why have you done this terrible thing? Your brother's blood is crying out to me from the ground, like a voice calling for revenge.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ kawana ʒili bɛ bunsi lu soli.
en: The brothers loaded their donkeys with the grain they had bought, and then they left.

dag: Di saha ka Kɔhat daŋ niriba daa kpuɣi neen shɛŋa din be kasi la ʒi n-gbaai chandi. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu shee suɣili maa ti sa pɔi ka bɛ naanyi paai ni.
en: Next were the Kohathites, carrying the objects for the sacred tent, which was to be set up before they arrived at the new camp.

dag: O daa lan zaŋ nyolɔrigu lo o pahi, ka zaŋ Urim mini Tumim niŋ di ni;.
en: Then Moses placed the chest piece on Aaron and set the Urim and Thummim into the chest piece.

dag: Ka malaika so ŋun daa daŋ tooni na maa yɛli malaika so ŋun doli nyaaŋa na maa, Guui chaŋ ti yɛli nachimbil so ŋun mali bimbuɣisirigu maa ni niriba pam mini niɣi pam n-yɛn be Jɛrusalɛm; ka di be kaman tiŋkpansi din ka goma la.
en: and said, Hurry! Tell that man with the measuring line that Jerusalem won't have any boundaries. It will be too full of people and animals even to have a wall.

dag: Zɛdɛkia nam dibu yuun piniyini, gol so ŋun pahir anahi daba awɛi dali ka bɛ daa kabi Jɛrusalɛm goondaa luhi.
en: And on the ninth day of the fourth month in Zedekiahs eleventh year, the wall of Jerusalem was broken through.

dag: Ka yɛli ba, Zaŋmiya yi liɣiri chaŋ. N suhu n-yu ni n yo yi mini bɛn yoli kana maa zaa yim.
en: So take your pay and go. I want to give the man who was hired last the same pay I gave you.

dag: N Duuma, zom m bidibiga ŋɔ nambɔɣu! O nyɛla kpilinkpihilana, ka di nahind o pam; di kul luhir o la waawaayili, ka o luri buɣim ni, shɛlini mi kom ni.
en: and said, Lord, have pity on my son! He has a bad case of epilepsy and often falls into a fire or into water.

dag: O tiri paɣiŋoo bihi, ka zaŋd o leeri bihi ma ŋun mali suhupiɛlli. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: He gives children to the woman whose home is empty. He makes her a happy mother. Praise the Lord !.

dag: N di bi zaɣisi ka n zuɣu nyɛ kɔbiliga, ka n nina nyɛ nintam kɔbilinini ka n di tooi kuhiri bɛ ni ku n niriba bɛn yɛla mali nambɔɣu maa zuɣu yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni.
en: If only my head were a spring of water, and my eyes a fountain of tears, I would weep day and night for the wounds of my people.

dag: ka o ninni biɛhigu daa taɣi, ka di muɣis o pam hal ka o kɔba ni ti dii chɔɣisichɔɣisi, ka o duna ŋmɛri taba.
en: He was so frightened that his face turned pale, his knees started shaking, and his legs became weak.

dag: Manaasa yuma daa nyɛla yuun pinaayi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-niŋla o nam maa ni yuun pihinunaanu Jɛrusalɛm. O ma yuli n-daa booni Hɛfiziba.
en: Manasseh was years old when he became king, and he ruled for fifty-five years in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Hephzibah.

dag: Bɛ tuumbiɛri maa tirila naa suhupiɛlli, ka bɛ biɛriyoli maa tiri bɛ kpamba suhupiɛlli.
en: The king and his officials take great pleasure in their sin and deceit.

dag: Di saha nir ni ti yi o mabia nyaaŋa n-chɛ ka bɛ ku o; ka doo ni ti yi o bia nyaaŋa n-chɛ ka bɛ ku o, ka bihi gba ti zaɣisi bɛ banim mini bɛ manima, ka zaŋ ba puhi kubu.
en: Brothers and sisters will betray each other and have each other put to death. Parents will betray their own children, and children will turn against their parents and have them killed.

dag: Wummiya satahiŋga din yi o kukoli ni na mini vu shɛli din yir o nol ni na.
en: when I hear the roaring voice of God in the thunder.

dag: Ka n ni zali yi tiŋgbɔŋ tariga la Teeku Ʒiɛɣu noli zaŋ hal ni Filistianim Teeku noli, ka lan zaŋ tiŋgban nɛli ni hal ni Yufretiiz Mɔɣili noli tariga. Dama n ni ti zaŋ di niriba maa niŋ yi nuu ni, ka yi kari ba.
en: I will see that your borders reach from the Red Sea to the Euphrates River and from the Mediterranean Sea to the desert. I will let you defeat the people who live there, and you will force them out of the land.

dag: Amaa di yi nyɛla bɛ zula biŋkɔbigu maa dilan sani, dindina di simdi ni o yo o zuɣu.
en: But if the neighbor stole the animal, then he must pay the owner for the animal.

dag: N daa yooi dunoli maa ti n yura maa, amaa ka o bi kpɛna ka ŋmaligi chaŋ. N ni daa kul wum o kukoli, ka n suhu kpe o ni. Ka n daa yina lihi bo o, amaa ka bi nya o. Ka n daa bol o, amaa ka o bi garigi.
en: And I yearned for him while he spoke to me, but when I opened the door, my darling had disappeared. I searched and shouted, but I could not find him— there was no answer.

dag: Bɛraya bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Hɛbɛr mini Malikiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Birizait ba la.
en: Beriahs sons were Heber and Malkiel. Malkiel was Birzaiths father.

dag: Naa maa daa yɛli ba, Man Naa Ahasivɛrɔs n-tim nayili bihi Napaɣ Vashiti sani nti yɛl o yɛligu ka o zaɣisi n noli! Ka wula ka zaligu lee wuhi ni ti niŋm o.
en: The king asked them, What does the law say must be done to Queen Vashti? She has not obeyed the command of King Xerxes that the eunuchs had taken to her.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Ŋahili maa gbinni m-bɔŋɔ: Bimbira maa nyɛla Naawuni yɛligu.
en: This is what the parable means: the seed is the word of God.

dag: Toondaannim ni daa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa a zuɣu ka Naawuni ti a pin shɛli anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu puuni la, miri ka a zaŋ li niŋ a baɣaka.
en: Remember to use the gift you have, which was given to you through a prophecy when the group of elders laid their hands on you.

dag: Yawɛ ni zali zaligu shɛŋa m-bɔŋɔ. Yɛlim Izraɛlnima ni bɛ bom naɣisa ʒee ŋun ka dalinli ni galimi, ka nyɛ bɛ ni na bi zaŋ naɣikɔra dapua n-niŋ so na.
en: This is the regulation in the Instruction that the LORD commanded. Tell the Israelites that they must bring you a red cow without defect, which is flawless and on which no yoke has been laid.

dag: Tiŋgban shɛli din nyuri sakom din luri di zuɣu waawaayili ka bindira zoori di ni n-leeri din mali buchi bɛ ni biri li shɛb zuɣu la sani, Naawuni niŋdi alibarika niŋdi tiŋgbani maa ni.
en: A field is useful to farmers, if there is enough rain to make good crops grow. In fact, God will bless such a field.

dag: Amaa ka naa yɛligu maa daa zani, ka chɛ Jɔab dini maa. Di saha ka Jɔab daa yiɣisi chaŋ gili Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa n-kali niriba maa, ka labi Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: But King David was stubborn. Joab had to do what the king said. So Joab left and went through all the country of Israel counting the people. Then he came back to Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti paai zuɣulan maa yiŋa n-nya ka yupiɛbiriba mini salo pam beni n-yarindi ka mɔhiri vuri.
en: Jesus continued going with the Jewish leader and went into the leaders house. He saw people there who make music for funerals. And he saw a crowd of people crying loudly.

dag: ka o kuhi yɛli Mariama, A mal alibarika paɣiba ni, ka bi so ŋun be a pul ni ŋɔ gba mal alibarika.
en: In a loud voice she said to Mary, God has blessed you more than any other woman. And God has blessed the baby you will have.

dag: O yi di nyɛla dikili, ti naan me anzinfa pia tam o zuɣu; ka o yi di nyɛla dunoli, ti naan zaŋ sida dapaɣa yo o.
en: If she is a city wall, then we will build a turret of silver on her. And if she is a door, then we will barricade her with a panel of cedar.

dag: N yura maa viɛlimi pam ka mali yaa. Ninvuɣ tuhili puuni so bi ŋman o.
en: He is handsome and healthy, the most outstanding among ten thousand.

dag: Asha zuliya ni, Okiran bia Pagiɛl n-yɛn sɔŋ ya;.
en: from Asher, Pagiel, Ochrans son.

dag: N daa sabi gbaŋ tin ya n-yɛli ya ni yi di chɛ ka yi mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi daɣiri tuma laɣim be.
en: I wrote to you in my letter that you should not associate with people who sin sexually.

dag: Ka anabinim maa daa kul kuhiri pampam, ka mali suhi mini kpana ŋ-ŋmari bɛmaŋa ka chɔhiri bɛmaŋa kaman bɛ taara ni daa nyɛ shɛm hal ka ʒim ti puhiri yiri bɛ niŋgbuna ni na.
en: So the prophets of Baal cried with a louder voice and cut themselves with swords and knives as was their custom. Their blood flowed all over them.

dag: Yi ni tooi zani Naawuni zaani n-tɔɣisi ʒiri yɛtɔɣa, bee n-zan o zaani tɔɣisi yɔhiŋ yɛtɔɣa?.
en: Will you speak injustice for God, speak deceit on his behalf?.

dag: ka o yɛli ba, N sa zahimla zahindi ka di yɛla muɣisi ma pam ka m bɔri ni m baŋ di ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: he said to them, I'm worried about a dream I've had. I want to know what it means.

dag: bee n-ni suh o zahim ka o gbaai wahu ti o?.
en: Or would you give him a snake when he asks for a fish?.

dag: Amaa ka o yidan maa daa dol o kuhiri hal ni Bahurim. Ka Abinɛr daa ti yɛl o, Ŋmaligi lab kuli, ka o daa lab kuli.
en: Paltiel followed her all the way to the town of Bahurim, crying as he went. But when Abner said, Go back home, he did.

dag: O daa wuhi Musa o soya, ka wuhi Izraɛlnim o tuma.
en: He taught his Law to Moses and showed all Israel what he could do.

dag: Ka Babilɔn naa daa ku ba Ribila din be Hamat tiŋgbɔŋ ni la. Di saha ka bɛ daa gbahi Judanim daba n-yi bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni chaŋ.
en: The king of Babylon struck them and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. And Judah went away from its land into exile.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋma n-chihi kur tibisa din bari ŋariŋ maa zaani bahi kom maa ni, ka daa lan ŋma n-chihi mi shɛŋa din daa lo da shɛŋa din ŋmaligiri ŋariŋ maa, ka zaŋ ŋariŋ maa tanti lo n-tuhi pɔhim, ka pɔhim maa daa ʒe ba duhi duli.
en: They cut the anchors loose and left them in the sea. At the same time, they untied the ropes that ran back to the rudders. They raised the foresail to catch the wind and made for the beach.

dag: Yawɛ, a daa nya bɛ ni tum ma taali shɛm, karimi n yɛla maa saria.
en: Judge in my favor; you know the wrongs done against me.

dag: Dama nyin Yawɛ tiligi n shia kum ni, ka nyɛhi n nintam, ka tiligi n naba tuubu ni.
en: You, Lord , have saved my life from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.

dag: Di saha ka n daa suhi Yawɛ yɛli, Yawɛ, n suhir a, tiligim ma!.
en: Then I called to the Lord , I beg you, Lord , save me.

dag: A mini Vɛdannim ni Javannim bɛn yi Uzal na daa niŋdila a nɛma daabiligu. Bɛ daa lan zaŋdila kuriti mini kasia ni tulaale na ti taɣiri a daguya.
en: Vedan and Javan near Uzal traded you iron and spices.

dag: ka nya ka do so ŋun yuli booni Ananias kpe o sanna nti zaŋ o nuu pa o zuɣu ni o nina neei.
en: He has seen a vision in which a man named Ananias came and laid his hands on him so that he could see again.

dag: Amaa zom a Naawuni, ka di zaŋ ninkuunsi gbib o.
en: You must not be a cruel master to them. You must respect your God.

dag: Amaa zuliya shɛb bee nam shɛli din niriba zaɣisi ya jɛmbu, bɛ ni bahi yoli zaa.
en: The nation and the dynasty that wont serve you will perish; such nations will be devastated.

dag: Vuri maa ni daa ti maai, ka Pool laɣim Yisa nyaandoliba maa na nti kpaŋsi bɛ suhuri ka chɛbisi ba, ka zaŋ kpa Masidɔnia polo.
en: When the riot was over, Paul sent for the disciples, encouraged them, said good-bye, and left for the province of Macedonia.

dag: zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ yi yi vihiri ti mi ni yi baŋ tuun sun shɛli din sa tum ti gbarigu ŋɔ ka o kpaŋ maa.
en: if we are being questioned today about the good deed done to the lame man and how he was healed.

dag: N ni yɛl a jilima din galisi ŋɔ min a tibiginsim yɛla, ka tɛh a daalahiziba tuma yɛla.
en: They will speak of your glory and majesty, and I will meditate on your wonderful deeds.

dag: Dinzuɣu Mɔabnima, kummiya! Sokam kummi Mɔabnim zuɣu. Bɛ ni ti kum Kiriharɛsɛt bindira zuɣu.
en: Therefore, let Moab wail; let everyone wail for Moab. Let them moan, utterly stricken, for the raisin cakes of Kir-hareseth.

dag: N suhir a mi, chɛli mani ŋun nyɛ a dabipaɣ ŋɔ taali. Dama biɛhiŋ kani, Yawɛ ni me a yili a ni tuhiri ŋun Yawɛ tɔb shɛli ŋɔ zuɣu; ka a ku tum zaɣ biɛɣu hal ni a nyɛvili tariga.
en: Please forgive me for doing wrong. I know the Lord will make your family strong because you fight his battles. People will never find anything bad about you as long as you live.

dag: Ka yi yi ti paai Ammɔnnim tintariga, yin di muɣisiya ba bee n-tuhi ba tɔbu, dama n ku zaŋ Ammɔnnim tiŋgbɔŋ maa tin ya ni yi su li, dama n daa pun zaŋ li tila Lɔt zuliya ni bɛ su li. .
en: You will be just across from the Ammonites. Dont bother them or fight with them, because I will not give you their land. They are descendants of Lot, and I have given that land to them.

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ Jɔɔdɛn tooni tin shɛli din yuli booni Jɛriko, ka di be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo ka be Rubin zuliya tiŋgban ni la tinsi din yuya daa booni Bɛza ka di be tiŋgban pasi ni la mini Jaaza ni di momaha tiŋgbana zaa ti ba.
en: In the territory of Reuben, east of the Jordan River beyond Jericho: Bezer on the plateau, Jahzah.

dag: Inok daa jɛmdi Naawuni viɛnyɛliŋga, ka so daa ti bi lan nya o, dama Naawuni n-daa kpuɣ o.
en: Enoch walked with God and disappeared because God took him.

dag: Kunyanambɔzɔbo ni daa ŋmaai bihili, ka o lan niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga yaha.
en: When Gomer finished nursing No Compassion, she became pregnant and gave birth to a son.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa bo bimpiɛlli chaŋ ti siɣisi Yisa dapulli maa zuɣu na n-zaŋ bimpiɛlli maa niŋ o n-zaŋ o ti sɔɣi sil shɛli bɛ ni daa chib tampiŋ ni ka na ʒi n-sɔɣ so di ni la.
en: Then he took the body down, wrapped it in a linen sheet, and placed it in a tomb which had been dug out of solid rock and which had never been used.

dag: Yi ni shɛb kpɛla yimaŋ duhibu ni, dama yi tɛhimi ni n ku lan ka yi sanna.
en: Some of you are acting so proud, it seems as though you think I wont be coming there again.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ paɣi Yawɛ yuli, dama o kɔŋko yuli tibisi gari yuli kam. O jilima galisiya dunia ni mini zuɣusaa.
en: All creation, come praise the name of the Lord . Praise his name alone. The glory of God is greater than heaven and earth.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chɛ bɛ kpalansi mini bɛ binyɛr ŋmahi ni binyɛr waɣila yɛli ba hal zaŋ tabili bɛ zuɣupila, ka lo ba mihi n-zaŋ ba ti bahi buɣim duu din buɣim diri pam maa ni.
en: So Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego were tied up and thrown into the hot furnace. They were wearing their robes, pants, cloth caps, and other clothes.

dag: Kpuɣimiya paɣiba n-dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi. Bomiya paɣiba ti yi bidibisi, ka zaŋya yi bipuɣinsi ti dɔbba; nabimiya pahi nimaani, ka di filimya.
en: Get married and have sons and daughters. Find wives for your sons, and let your daughters be married. Do this so that they also may have sons and daughters. Have many children and grow in number in Babylon. Dont become fewer in number.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa ti chɛ ka bɛ kɔrigi noombil yino niŋ yaɣiri duɣu ni kɔzɔrim kom ni.
en: Then the priest shall order that one of the birds be killed over a clay bowl containing fresh spring water.

dag: Di yuma ayi nyaaŋa ka Pɔɔshius Fɛstus daa kana ni o ti deei Gomna Filiksi, ka Gomna Filiksi ni daa bɔri ni o niŋ Yɛhudianim ni yu shɛm zuɣu daa chɛ ka o chɛ Pool niŋ sarika ni.
en: When two years had passed, Felix was succeeded by Porcius Festus. Since Felix wanted to grant a favor to the Jews, he left Paul in prison.

dag: Shɛb daa ʒila zibisim mini bumbɔn ni, ka nyɛ sarikanima, ka bɛ ba ba bandi ʒili ka bɛ diri wahala.
en: Some of the redeemed had been sitting in darkness and deep gloom; they were prisoners suffering in chains.

dag: Binneembihi zaa bɛn mali kpiŋkpama nyɛla bɛn nyɛ daɣiri bini yi sani, ka di bi simdi ni yi ŋub ba.
en: All winged insects are unclean; do not eat them.

dag: Ka Sintani yi ŋmaligi tuhir omaŋa, wula ka o nam lee ni tooi zani? Dama yi yɛri ni Biilzibul yiko ni ka n kariti alizin biɛri bahira.
en: So if Satan's kingdom has groups fighting each other, how can it last? You say that I drive out demons because Beelzebul gives me the power to do so.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti mabihi, ʒiɛnya viɛnyɛliŋga, ka gbibiya wuhibu shɛŋa ti ni pun wuhi ya ti waazu yihibu ni mini ti ni sab gban shɛŋa tin ya la puuni la.
en: My friends, this is why you must remain faithful and follow closely what we taught you in person and by our letters.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli ba, Bɛn mal alaafee bi bɔri dɔɣite naɣila bɛn biɛra.
en: Jesus answered, Healthy people dont need a doctor, but sick people do.

dag: Yi ni ti dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi, amaa yi ti ku su ba, dama bɛ ni ti gbahi ba leei daba chaŋ.
en: You will have sons and daughters, but you will lose them, because they will be taken away as prisoners of war.

dag: Mikimas — kɔbiga ni pisinaayi.
en: from the town of Micmash:.

dag: Ti daa nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be a biɛhigu shee din be kasi la, amaa ka ti dimnim daa kari ti nimaani, ka wurim a jɛmbu shee din be kasi maa.
en: We, your holy people, were driven out by our enemies for a little while; they trampled down your sanctuary.

dag: ka Jɛrimia daa yi Jɛrusalɛm ni o kuli Bɛnjamin zuliya tiŋgban ni nti deeg o tarili nimaani niriba maa sani.
en: Jeremiah set out for the land of Benjamin to secure his share of the family property.

dag: zaŋ tabili Araba din daa be Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo la zaa hal ti taɣi Araba Teeku Pisiga zolɔŋ la ni.
en: and all the desert regions across the Jordan River, on the east, down to the Dead Sea, beneath the slopes of Mount Pisgah.

dag: Mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ pun ku gbuɣima mini kunduna, ka Filistia do so ŋun bi guni ŋɔ gba ni lee bɛ ni yino, dama o ta Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ tɔbbihi daɣiri.
en: Sir, I have killed lions and bears that way, and I can kill this worthless Philistine. He shouldn't have made fun of the army of the living God!.

dag: Gomna Pailɛt ni daa bɔri ni o niŋ niriba maa suhu yubu zuɣu ka o daa yihi Barabas bahi, ka chɛ ka bɛ fiɛb Yisa, ka o naanyi zaŋ o ti ba ni bɛ ti kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: Pilate wanted to please the crowd, so he set Barabbas free. Then he ordered his soldiers to beat Jesus with a whip and nail him to a cross.

dag: Amaa Nadab mini Abihu bɛn daa kpila Yawɛ tooni, bɛ ni daa zaŋ buɣim shɛli din bi simdi n-nyo sara maligu Sinai Zoli gbini mɔɣu ni la zuɣu. Bɛ daa ka bihi, dinzuɣu Ɛliɛza mini Itama n-daa tumdi maligumaana tuma n-sɔŋdi bɛ ba Aduna o ʒiɛman ni.
en: Nadab and Abihu died before the LORD when they made an unauthorized offering to the LORD in the Sinai desert. They didnt have any sons. Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests during the lifetime of their father Aaron.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Naa Zɛdɛkia daa po pɔri ashilɔni Jɛrimia sani yɛli, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ka nyɛ ŋun tiri ti nyɛvili ŋɔ zuɣu, n ku ku a, m mi ku zaŋ a niŋ bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku a maa nuu ni.
en: But King Zedekiah secretly swore an oath to Jeremiah. Zedekiah said, As surely as the Lord lives, who gives us breath and life, I will not kill you, Jeremiah. And I promise not to give you to the officials who want to kill you.

dag: Baŋmiya ni Yawɛ n-nyɛ Naawuni. Ŋuna n-nam ti, ka ti nyɛ o ni su shɛba. Ti nyɛla o niriba, ka nyɛ o ni gul shɛba kaman piɛri la.
en: You know the Lord is God! He created us, and we belong to him; we are his people, the sheep in his pasture.

dag: O ni daa ti wuhi ba naai ka o yɛli Saimɔn, Chamiya teeku ŋɔ bulli ni ha ti lab yi lansi maa gbahi zahim.
en: When Jesus had finished speaking, he told Simon, Row the boat out into the deep water and let your nets down to catch some fish.

dag: Yi ni ŋubiri mo viɛla ŋɔ di bi saɣi? Ka wula ka yi lan nɔri mo shɛŋa din kpalim ŋɔ sɔŋdi tiŋa? Yi yi nyu ko viɛlli, di lan kpami ni yi zaŋ yi naba saɣim ko shɛli din kpalim?.
en: Is feeding in good pasture or drinking clear water such a trivial thing that you should trample and muddy what is left with your feet?.

dag: nti kpuɣi Baal jɛmbu binnan shɛli din be di ni na nti nyo li buɣim.
en: They brought the sacred pillar out of Baals temple and burned it.

dag: A yi tim a ʒiʒiinikpee wain tihi puu ni chana, a ni tooi pɔhi di wala maa a suhu ni bɔri shɛm tariga di, amaa miri ka a pɔhi shɛli niŋ a nɛma ni.
en: When you go through another persons vineyard, you may eat as many grapes as you want. But you cannot put any of the grapes in your basket.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa tim ti boli Shimɛi na nti yɛl o, Mɛm a yili Jɛrusalɛm ŋɔ n-ʒi kpe, ka miri ka a yi kpe n-chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam.
en: Next, the king sent for Shimei and said to him, Build yourself a house here in Jerusalem to live in and dont leave the city.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa lan yɛl o, N tiŋgbani n-kul do a tooni maa, ʒinimi a ni bɔri ni a ʒini di ni luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: And Abimelech said, Look all around you. This is my land. You may live any place you want.

dag: dindina bɛ niriba ayi bɛn mali yɛtɔɣa maa bɛn cham Yawɛ tooni maligumaaniba mini sariakaritiba bɛn be tuma ni di saha maa sani.
en: both of you are to go to the one place of worship and be judged by the priests and judges who are then in office.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba pahi, Yi yi ti kpe yil shɛli, yin di lan taɣiya yilikpɛrili hal nti yi tiŋ maa ni.
en: He also told them, Wherever you are welcomed, stay in the same house until you leave that place.

dag: Amaa nir nyari zahimbu din ni chɛ ka o tum zaɣ biɛɣu la omaŋmaŋ kɔr biɛri yi ti voog o kpɛhi di ni n-gbaag o kaman tɔŋ la.
en: Everyone is tempted by their own cravings; they are lured away and enticed by them.

dag: Bɛ bili paɣiba Ziɔn tiŋ puuni, ka bili paɣisara bɛn na ʒi dɔbba Juda fɔntinsi ni.
en: The enemy raped the women of Zion. They raped the women in the cities of Judah.

dag: M bia, zaŋm a suhu ti ma, ka kpahim m biɛhigu;.
en: My son, listen closely to what I am saying. Let my life be your example.

dag: Amaa Yisa nyɛla ŋun simdi ni o mali jilima pam gari Anabi Musa kaman ŋun me yili ni mali jilima gari o ni me yil shɛli maa shɛm la.
en: A man who builds a house receives more honor than the house itself. In the same way Jesus is worthy of much greater honor than Moses.

dag: Saamba bɛn be n yiŋa tamla n yɛla. Ka paɣ sara bɛn nyɛ n tumtumdiba zaŋ ma leei sana. N leela tinzun nira bɛ sani.
en: My guests and female servants think me a stranger; Im a foreigner in their sight.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba, Dahin shɛli kanna ka yi ni ti bɔri ni yi nya Daadam Bia saha ŋɔ dabisili zaɣ yini gba, ka ku nya li.
en: Jesus said to his disciples: The time will come when you will long to see one of the days of the Son of Man, but you will not.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Ɛdomnima, Nyamiya, n ni filim ya zuliya kam sani; ka chɛ ka sokam ʒiɛm ya.
en: The Lord said to Edom: I will make you the weakest and most despised nation.

dag: Ka bɔzuɣu ka a daa yihi ti Ijipti n-zaŋ ti na ti niŋ luɣ shɛli din bi viɛli ŋɔ? Luɣ shɛŋa nir ni yɛn biri chi bee n-sa fiig tihi bee n-sa wain tihi bee n-sa pumpɔrinchihi tihi kani, ka kom gba kani ka ti ni nyu.
en: Why did you bring us from Egypt? Why did you bring us to this bad place? There is no grain. There are no figs, grapes, or pomegranates, and there is no water to drink.

dag: O ni daa leei ŋun be tibi maa zuɣu, ka o leei bɛnkam zaa deer o noli tiliginsim din ka bahigu ni yiri so sanna.
en: Suffering made Jesus perfect, and now he can save forever all who obey him.

dag: Yi ŋmanila abie tihi din vuɣisi waɣa. Yi ŋmanila pu shɛŋa din do m-baɣ mɔɣili. Yi ŋmanila aloosi ti shɛŋa Yawɛ ni sa. Yi ŋmanila sida ti shɛŋa din ʒe m-baɣi kom.
en: Like palm groves that stretch out, like gardens next to a river, like eaglewood trees that the LORD has planted, like cedar trees next to water.

dag: So yi kɔhi yili bɛ ni me goondaa gili tin shɛli ni, o ni tooi yo di zuɣu ka deei li yuun muni nyaaŋa, dama di yi paai yuun muni o mali soli ni o yo di zuɣu ka deei li.
en: When a person sells a home in a walled city, it may be bought back until a year after its sale. The period for buying it back will be one year.

dag: Bɛbai daŋ — kɔbisiyɔbu ni pisinaata.
en: the descendants of Bebai:.

dag: Hal pumpɔŋɔ, a dimnim taala duŋ; ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je a gba mal a gadama.
en: Your enemies are getting ready to do something. Those who hate you will soon attack.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, niriba ŋɔ nyɛla bɛn namdi tuumbiɛri tumbu, ka wuhiri niriba yikombiɛlim tuma tiŋ maa ni.
en: Then God spoke to me and said, Son of man, these are the men who make evil plans for this city. They always tell the people to do evil things.

dag: Ŋun zo n-tiligi maa kandina dazɔhigu dali zaawuni, Yawɛ nuu daa pala n zuɣu. Amaa ŋun zo n-tiligi maa ni daa paai n sanna asiba saha shɛli maa, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka n zilinli lɛbigi, ka n noli yaai, ka n-tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa.
en: The evening before this man arrived at my house, the Lord had taken control of me. So when the man came to me the next morning, I could once again speak.

dag: Jɔsia ni daa tum Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuma ŋɔ zaa naai nyaaŋa, ka Ijipti Naa Nɛko daa chaŋ Karikɛmish din daa be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili dul la ni o ti tuhi tɔbu; ka Jɔsia gba daa lo tɔbu chaŋ ni o ti tuhi Naa Nɛko.
en: After all of these things, when Josiah had finished restoring the temple, Egypts King Neco marched against Carchemish by the Euphrates, and Josiah marched out against him.

dag: Bɛ mini bɛ mabihi bɛn daa tumdi Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni tuma zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisinii ni pisinaayi. Jɛrɔham bia Adaya daa nyɛla Pɛlalia yaaŋa. O yaannim shɛba n-daa nyɛ Amizi mini Zakaria so mi ni Pashihur ni Malikija.
en: and men of their brothers that did the work for the Temple, and Adaiah son of Jeroham .

dag: Ka di daa gari Ɛdom nanima; ka Mɔab zuɣulaannim niŋgbuna sɔhira ka Keenannim zaa kɔba ni chɔɣisi.
en: The commanders of Edom will tremble. The leaders of Moab will be afraid. The people of Canaan will lose courage.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi zaawuni maa n-zo ni bɛ tiligi, ka chɛ bɛ tanti suɣa mini bɛ yuri ni bɛ bunsi. Bɛ daa kul zomi ka chɛ bɛ sansani maa kaman di ni daa kul be shɛm.
en: So they had got up and fled in the evening, leaving their tents, horses, and donkeys. They left the camp exactly as it was and ran for their lives.

dag: Ka Saimɔn deempaɣa niŋgbuŋ daa bii ka o doya, ka bɛ daa dii yɛli Yisa o niŋgbun biisim maa yɛla.
en: When they got there, Jesus was told that Simon's mother-in-law was sick in bed with fever.

dag: Dinzuɣu daadam, tɔɣisim Izraɛlnim yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Dimbɔŋɔ puuni yi yaannim daa lan mo ma bɛ ni daa bi ʒe ma yim la puuni.
en: Ezekiel, tell the people of Israel that their ancestors also rejected and insulted me.

dag: Amaa zaligu palli ka n zaani ya ŋɔ; dina n-nyɛ, Yumiya taba! N ni yuri ya shɛm, yi gba yumiya tab lala.
en: And now I give you a new commandment: love one another. As I have loved you, so you must love one another.

dag: Ka yi biɛhigu bemi kaman ti biɛhigu zaŋ tabili ti Duuma gba biɛhigu, dama hal yi ni daa di wahala pam la zaa yoli, yi daa deei ti yɛligu maa ni suhupiɛl shɛli din yiri Naawuni Shia Kasi sanna la.
en: You became imitators of us and of the Lord when you accepted the message that came from the Holy Spirit with joy in spite of great suffering.

dag: Ka Pita daa dii yiɣisi doli ba. O ni daa mali ti paai, ka bɛ zaŋ o du jirambisa zuɣusaa duu maa ni, ka tiŋ maa ni pakoya zaa daa ʒe n-gili Pita kumda, ka wuhir o binyɛr shɛŋa Dɔɔkas ni daa na be o nyɛvili ni ka she n-ti ba.
en: At once, Peter went with them. The men took Peter upstairs into the room. Many widows were there crying. They showed him the coats and clothes that Dorcas had made while she was still alive.

dag: N ni kari ya n sani bahi kaman n ni daa kari yi mabihi bɛn nyɛ Ifriim zuliya la zaa bahi shɛm la.
en: And as for you, people of Judah, I'm going to send you away from my land, just as I sent away the people of Ephraim and the other northern tribes.

dag: Anabinim tɔɣisirila anabitali yɛtɔɣa din nyɛ ʒiri, ka maligumaaniba doli anabinim maa ni wuhiri ba shɛm n-tumdi bɛ tuma. N niriba maa n-yu lala. Amaa di yi ti paai di tariga, wula ka yi yɛn niŋ.
en: The prophets tell lies. The priests will not do what they were chosen to do, and my people love it this way! But what will you people do when your punishment comes?.

dag: Nam yini puuni niriba yi ŋmaligi tuhiri taba, bɛ nam maa ni wurim.
en: A nation whose people fight each other won't last very long.

dag: O tahiri teeku zuɣu, ka di kom nyuura. Ŋuna n-chɛ ka mɔɣa kom nyuura; ka Bashan mini Kamɛl tihi vari suura, ka Lɛbanɔn tipuma suura.
en: At the Lord 's command, oceans and rivers dry up. Bashan, Mount Carmel, and Lebanon wither, and their flowers fade.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri sara maligu nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ sani, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi din tuhi suhigu nyɛla din tiɣir o nini.
en: The Lord is pleased when good people pray, but hates the sacrifices that the wicked bring him.

dag: Ka bɛ ni zaɣ yino yi lu yaɣiri duɣu ni, binshɛɣukam din be di puuni leela daɣiri, ka di simdi ka yi ŋma li.
en: If any of these creatures fall into a pottery jar, everything inside it will be unclean; you must smash the pot.

dag: Ka o daa lan chɛ ka bɛ mali daanya kɔniŋdi bini ka di nyɛ zaɣ kpilli, ka di naŋgbanyɛra zaŋ ti tuui tab nyɛ mita pinaata ni biɛla, ka di dubu nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla, ka di yɛliŋ mi nyɛ mita anahi ni biɛla.
en: He also made a round tank of bronze, 1⁄2 feet deep, feet in diameter, and feet in circumference.

dag: Ʒiɛmana din kanna niriba ni ti jɛm o; bɛ ni ti yɛli ʒiɛman shɛŋa din kanna niriba ti Duuma yɛla.
en: Future descendants will serve him; generations to come will be told about my Lord.

dag: Izraɛlnim gula, wummi ti suhigu; nyin ŋun mali Yisifu zuliya chani kaman piɛri la, wummi ti suhigu. Nyin ŋun ʒi a nam ʒiishee din be chɛrubinim zuɣu la, chɛ ka a neesim neei.
en: Listen to us, O Shepherd of Israel; hear us, leader of your flock. Seated on your throne above the winged creatures.

dag: Pita ni daa ti lab Jɛrusalɛm ka bɛn doli Yɛhudianim gunibu kali soli daa galim o.
en: So when Peter came to Jerusalem, some of the Jewish followers started arguing with him. They wanted Gentile followers to be circumcised, and.

dag: Ti mabihi, zaŋ chaŋ ti Duuma Yisa Masia labbuna mini ti ni ti yɛn laɣim tuh o sol la yɛla polo, ti suhiri ya.
en: Brothers and sisters, we have something to say about the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ. We want to talk to you about that time when we will meet together with him.

dag: Sabimi ti Filadɛlfia Cheechi malaika n-yɛl o ni ŋun be kasi ka nyɛ yɛlimaŋlilana, ka mali Naa Dauda saafɛbia, ka nyɛ ŋun ni yooi ka so ku tooi daai yo, ka ni yo ka so ku tooi yoo la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Write this to the angel of the church in Philadelphia: Here is a message from the one who is holy and true, the one who holds the key of David. When he opens something, it cannot be closed. And when he closes something, it cannot be opened.

dag: Di nyɛla shihirili shɛli din kul ni be m mini Izraɛlnim sunsuuni. Man Yawɛ daa zaŋla daba ayɔbu n-nam zuɣusaa mini dunia, ka vuhi daba ayopɔin dali, ka n ni maai. .
en: The Sabbath will be a sign between me and the Israelites forever.

dag: Nyin Bɛlitishaaza ŋun nyɛ timanim kpɛm ŋɔ, dama m mi ni wun shɛŋa din be kasi la shia be a ni, ka a tooi baŋdi ashiya gbinni. N ni daa zahim zahin shɛli maa m-bɔŋɔ: Wuhim ma di gbinni.
en: I said, Belteshazzar, not only are you the wisest of all advisors and counselors, but the holy gods have given you special powers to solve the most difficult mysteries. So listen to what I dreamed and tell me what it means:.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa yɛli Ilaisha, N suhir a, kpalimmi kpe; Yawɛ n-tim ma Bɛtɛl. Amaa ka Ilaisha yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ mini nyini ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, n kul ku chɛ a dolibu. Ka bɛ daa laɣim doli chaŋ Bɛtɛl.
en: Elijah said to Elisha, The Lord wants me to go to Bethel, but you must stay here. Elisha replied, I swear by the living Lord and by your own life that I will stay with you no matter what! And he went with Elijah to Bethel.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛliya: Biɛhiŋ kani, n ni sa nya Nabɔt min o bihi ʒim sɔhila shɛm la, n ni bɔh a di biɛri puu ŋɔ ni labisi. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ zaŋm o bahi puu maa ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli shɛm maa.
en: The Lord said, Yesterday I saw the blood of Naboth and his sons. And I, the Lord , am telling you that I will punish Ahab in this field. So take Jorams body and throw it into the field, just as the Lord said.

dag: m mali tahima ni n yi ti gariti chani Speen n ni nyan ya. Ka n yi ti kaai ya n-niŋ daba ayi yi sani, yi ni sɔŋ ma ka n gari chaŋ.
en: I hope to do so now. I would like to see you on my way to Spain, and be helped by you to go there, after I have enjoyed visiting you for a while.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Anatɔtnim bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku a la polo m-bɔŋɔ. Bɛ yɛra, Miri ka a lan zaŋ Yawɛ yuli tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa yaha, di yi pa lala ti ni ku a.
en: The Lord said to me, Those people from Anathoth are planning to take your life. They are telling you not to prophesy in the name of the Lord or they will kill you. This is what I have to say about them:.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa chaŋ ti ʒe teeku duli.
en: The dragon stood on the seashore.

dag: Ka Abinɛr yɛl o, Ŋmaligim a nudirigu bee a nuzaa polo n-gbaai nachimba ŋɔ ni yino n-fa o ni mali shɛli. Amaa ka Asahɛl bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ o dolibu.
en: Abner didnt want to hurt Asahel, so he said to Asahel, Stop chasing me—go after one of the young soldiers. You could easily take his armor for yourself. But Asahel refused to stop chasing Abner.

dag: ka di chɛ ka yi baŋ yi ni yɛn doli so shɛli, dama yi na ʒi n-doli soli maa. Amaa lee miriya ka yi miri Alikauli Adaka maa. Doliya di nyaaŋa m-be li larigim kaman kilomita yini laasabu.
en: You have never been here before, so they will show you the way to go. But do not get near the Covenant Box; stay about half a mile behind it.

dag: Apil tia ni be nyɔŋ tihi sunsuuni shɛm la, lala ka n yura be nachimba sunsuuni. N yur o mahim ʒinibu ka o wala nyaɣisi pam n sani.
en: And you, my love, are an apple tree among trees of the forest. Your shade brought me pleasure; your fruit was sweet.

dag: Doo yi yih o paɣa, ka paɣ maa yi o yiŋa n-chaŋ ti kuli do so, o ni tooi lan biɛhi o paɣ maa naba? Di tiŋgbani maa ku saɣim pam? Yi tum zina yi mamanim pam sani, ka lan yɛn labi n sanna? Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The Lord says, If a man divorces his wife, and she leaves him and becomes another man's wife, he cannot take her back again. This would completely defile the land. But, Israel, you have had many lovers, and now you want to return to me!.

dag: A ni ti bahi yɛmbahiga, dama tahima beni; Naawuni ni ti gul a, ka a vuhiri ka barina kani.
en: You will live secure and full of hope; God will protect you and give you rest.

dag: ka n dimnim yɛli, Ti nyaŋ o. Ka n dimnim suhuri ni paligi n lubu zuɣu.
en: Don't let my enemies say, We have defeated him. Don't let them gloat over my downfall.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yawɛ zaligu kundi la n-gili Juda fɔntinsi ni zaa wuhi niriba.
en: They carried with them a copy of the Lord 's Law wherever they went and taught the people from it.

dag: Amaa hal ni zuŋɔ Yawɛ na bi tin ya tɛha din ni baŋ bee nina din ni nya bee tiba din ni wum.
en: But even today, you still dont understand what happened. The Lord has not let you really understand what you saw and heard.

dag: Yuma ata nyaaŋa ka n daa ti chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ni n ti kaai Pita. Biɛɣ pinaanu ka n daa niŋ o sani.
en: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Cephas and stayed with him fifteen days.

dag: Laɣimmiya niriba maa na Chɛliya ka laɣiŋgu maa be kasi. Laɣimmiya ninkura na, ka laɣimmiya bihi mini bimɔɣirisi gba na. Hal di nyɛla talahi ni aŋgɔnim yi bɛ duri na, ka amiliyanim yi amiliya lɔbu duri na.
en: Make sure that everyone is fit to worship me. Bring adults, children, babies, and even bring newlyweds from their festivities.

dag: Dama Ayuba yɛliya, N ka taali, ka Naawuni mɔŋ ma yɛlimaŋli.
en: for Job has said, Im innocent; God has denied my just cause.

dag: Ŋmahimiya gɔpiɛliga daantalis anu n-niŋ salima pa di zuɣu, ka mali salima bansi n-gɔhigɔhi pateesa maa n-zaŋ li yili daantalisi maa, ka zaŋ daanya mali daantalisi maa ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu diba anu.
en: For this curtain make five posts of acacia wood covered with gold and fitted with gold hooks; make five bronze bases for these posts.

dag: Ka Dauda min o niriba maa daa daŋ yibu asiba n-labi Filistianim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka Filistianim maa daa chaŋ Jɛziriil.
en: So David and his men started out early the following morning to go back to Philistia, and the Philistines went on to Jezreel.

dag: Juda Naa Asa ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihita ni yini saha, ka Omri daa leei Izraɛl naa maa. O daa niŋla o nam maa ni yuun pinaayi. O daa diya ʒinila Tiriza yuma ayɔbu.
en: Omri became king of Israel during Asas st year as the king of Judah. Omri ruled over Israel for years. Six of those years he ruled from Tirzah.

dag: Yawɛ zɔbu n-nyɛ baŋsim piligu, jɛra bɛn lihi ʒiɛmla yɛm mini wuhibu.
en: Respect and obey the Lord ! This is the beginning of knowledge. Only a fool rejects wisdom and good advice.

dag: Ka Jɔn daa niŋ Naawuni yɛligu maa mini Yisa Masia shɛhira ni omaŋmaŋ nini ni daa nya shɛlikam zaa shɛhiralana.
en: who bore witness to the word of God and to the witness of Jesus Christ, including all that John saw.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika maa yɛl o, Labim a lan maa sani nti zaŋ amaŋ ti o.
en: The angel said, Go back to Sarai and be her slave.

dag: Ka Yisa daa dii chirigi ba soli maa ni puhi ba; ka bɛ chaŋ ti gban o tooni m-bɔbil o naba, ka jɛm o.
en: Suddenly Jesus met them and greeted them. They went near him, held on to his feet, and worshiped him.

dag: n-yɛli, Yi ma daa ŋmanila gbuɣinnyaŋ gahindili gbuɣima sunsuuni. O daa dola gbuɣim pola sunsuuni n-wumisir o bihi.
en: Your mother was a brave lioness who raised her cubs among lions.

dag: Ka a yi lan ko puu tiŋgbani maa ni, di bindira ku lan niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga. A ni leei ŋun ka kpɛhili shee, ka leei ŋun dari gindi dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: When you farm the fertile land, it will no longer grow anything for you, and you will become a roving nomad on the earth.

dag: Pita daa lan yɛli yaha, M mabihi, n ni maan yɛli ya ti yab Naa Dauda yɛla. O daa kpiya ka bɛ sɔɣ o, ka o gballi na be kpe hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: My friends, I must speak to you plainly about our famous ancestor King David. He died and was buried, and his grave is here with us to this very day.

dag: A ba daalibarika mali kpiɔŋ gari zoya din doya sahakam ŋɔ mini kuŋkuna din kul beni sahakam ŋɔ daalibarika. Naawuni chɛ ka o daalibarika ŋɔ zaa be Yisifu ŋun min o mabihi daa woligi ŋɔ zuɣu ni, ka be o gbɛɣu zuɣu.
en: My parents had many good things happen to them. And I, your father, was blessed even more. Your brothers left you with nothing. But now I pile all my blessings on you, as high as a mountain.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka o yɛligu paai Hanani bia Jɛhu zaŋ chaŋ Baasha polo yɛli.
