en: The Lord spoke to the prophet Jehu son of Hanani and gave him this message for Baasha:.

dag: Naa Hɛzɛkia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pinaanahi saha ka Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib daa kana ti liri Judanim ni daa me birininim gili fɔntin shɛŋa zaa n-tuhi deei li.
en: During Hezekiahs th year as king, King Sennacherib of Assyria went to fight against all the strong cities of Judah. Sennacherib defeated them all.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ, nyini ka n niŋ naani; n yɛliya, Nyini n-nyɛ n Naawuni.
en: But me? I trust you, LORD! I affirm, You are my God.

dag: A ni tooi tahi sagbani zuɣu n-chɛ ka kom kpe n-lim a?.
en: Can you order the clouds to send a downpour.

dag: Yi birila ninvuɣ biɛtali, ka kpuɣi atam din bi doli yɛlimaŋli. Yi dila ʒiri tiwala. Yi ni niŋ yi chɛchɛbunsi mini yi tɔbbihi bɛn galisi ŋɔ naani la zuɣu.
en: You have plowed wickedness, you have reaped depravity, you have eaten the fruit of lies, because you have trusted in your way and in your many warriors.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan yiɣisi nimaani chaŋ ti paai kɔbili shɛŋa bɛ ni booni Bɛr la. Nimaani ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Laɣimmi niriba maa na ka n ti ti ba kom.
en: The Israelites left that place and traveled to Beer. There is a well in Beer, where the Lord said to Moses, Bring the people together here, and I will give them water.

dag: Bɛ chanimi gindi bɔri bindirigu. Ka bɛ yi bi nya n-di n-tiɣi, bɛ ŋumdimi.
en: like dogs roaming about for food and growling if they do not find enough.

dag: Yɛlim ba, Zuliya ŋɔ nyɛla bɛn bi deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ noli, ka zaɣisi saɣisigu; yɛlimaŋli vuuya, di lan ka bɛ noya ni.
en: You will tell them that their nation does not obey me, the Lord their God, or learn from their punishment. Faithfulness is dead. No longer is it even talked about.

dag: Ka niriba pam bɛn pun kpi la ni ti neei kum ni, ka bɛ ni shɛb ti nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu, ka shɛb mi ti di vi din ka bahigu.
en: There are many who are dead and buried. Some of them will wake up and live forever, but others will wake up to shame and disgrace forever.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri yiɣisi bah a zuɣu ni di vi; ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tuhir a mi ni kpalim yoli ka kpi.
en: Look, some people are angry with you, but they will be ashamed and disgraced. Your enemies will be lost and disappear.

dag: Niriba anahi bɛn daa nyɛ kɔnsi daa do Samaria sambani polo dunol shee. Ka bɛ daa ti bɔhi taba, Bɔzuɣu ka ti lee yɛn ʒi kpe hal ti kpi?.
en: There were four men sick with leprosy near the city gate. They said to each other, Why are we sitting here waiting to die?.

dag: Amaa lee baŋmiya dimbɔŋɔ: Yili yidana yi di mi tayiɣ ni yɛn ka o yiŋ na yuŋ saha shɛli, o naan ne n-ʒiya gu o, ka ku chɛ o yili maa bahi ka tayiɣ maa kab li kpe.
en: What would a homeowner do if he knew when a thief was coming? You know he would be ready and not let the thief break in.

dag: n-ti bahi ku Amalɛknim bɛn daa zo n-tiligi la, ka ʒini nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: They struck down those who were left of the Amalekites and have lived there ever since.

dag: Ka Jaɛl daa yina tuhi Sisɛra soli yɛl o, N dana, ŋmaligim kpe kpe na, ka di chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira. Ka o daa ŋmaligi kpe o sani tanti maa ni; ka paɣ maa ti zaŋ chinchini pil o.
en: Jael went out to meet Sisera and said to him, Come in, sir; come into my tent. Don't be afraid. So he went in, and she hid him behind a curtain.

dag: Ŋuna n-su teeku, dama ŋuna n-daa nam li; ŋuna n-su tiŋgbani din nyɛ o nuhi tuma la.
en: He rules over the sea, which he made; the land also, which he himself formed.

dag: Di kɔŋkɔba bebu din pahi nyɛla, di daa simdi ni bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba nyɛla ninvuɣ bɔbili bɛ ni daa kpiri ka bɛ tuma zaani tariga la zuɣu;.
en: There have been a lot of other priests, and all of them have died.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Bɔhimi ba. Niriba yi lu, bɛ bi lan yiɣisir yaha? Ka bee bɛ yi birigi kpe yɔɣu, bɛ bi lan labirina?.
en: Say to them, The LORD proclaims: When people fall down, dont they get up? When they turn aside, dont they turn back?.

dag: O daa mali piɛri mini niɣi pam ni tumtumdiba gba pam, ka Filistianim daa ti zabir o nyuli di zuɣu.
en: In fact, the Philistines were jealous of the large number of sheep, goats, and slaves that Isaac owned.

dag: Ka paɣ maa dɔɣibu saha daa ti paai ka jahi m-be o puli ni.
en: When she gave birth, she discovered she had twins in her womb.

dag: Saha shɛli yi yi ti zaŋ naɣilaa ni yi mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la bee alikauli palibu sara bee suhudoo biɛrisuŋ sara ti Yawɛ.
en: When a bull is offered to the Lord as a burnt offering or as a sacrifice in fulfillment of a vow or as a fellowship offering.

dag: N yɛri ya mi o ni kari saria yomyom ti ba nasara. Ka ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Daadam Bia yi lab dunia ŋɔ ni na, o ni nya bɛn mali yɛda.
en: I tell you, he will judge in their favor and do it quickly. But will the Son of Man find faith on earth when he comes.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa na kul bi baŋ Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli ni o ni ti neei kum ni la gbinni.
en: They still did not understand the scripture which said that he must rise from death.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ daadamnim zaa, kamiya n sanna ka n tiligi ya! N kɔŋko n-nyɛ Naawuni ka so kani pahi n zuɣu.
en: I invite the whole world to turn to me and be saved. I alone am God! No others are real.

dag: Wuntizɔriba alibarika duhirila tiŋa, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri noli ni yɛtɔɣa wurindila tiŋa.
en: A city becomes great when the righteous give it their blessing; but a city is brought to ruin by the words of the wicked.

dag: ka suhi Yawɛ n-yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun ʒi o nam ʒiishee chɛrubinim zuɣu ŋɔ, a kɔŋko n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun su dunia ŋɔ nama zaa, ka nyɛ ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ.
en: and prayed, O Lord , the God of Israel, seated on your throne above the winged creatures, you alone are God, ruling all the kingdoms of the world. You created the earth and the sky.

dag: ni Anduru ni Filip ni Baatolomiu ni Matiu ni Tomas ni Alifius bia Jeemsi ni Taddius ni Saimɔn ŋun daa nyɛ bɛn bɔri ni bɛn Izraɛlnim su bɛmaŋ la ni yino.
en: Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus were also apostles. The others were Simon, known as the Eager One.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka ti paɣi Naawuni ti ni deei nam shɛli din ku tooi dam ŋɔ zuɣu. Ka chɛliya ka ti lan paɣi Naawuni ka zo o n-lu o sizuura ka jɛm o la jɛmbu shɛli din ni tiɣ o nini;.
en: Therefore, since we are receiving a kingdom that cant be shaken, lets continue to express our gratitude. With this gratitude, lets serve in a way that is pleasing to God with respect and awe.

dag: Ka so yi ti nya zahimbu, ŋun miri ka o yɛli ni Naawuni n-zahim o, dama zahimbu din ni chɛ ka nir tum zaɣ biɛɣu ku tooi zahim Naawuni, ka ŋun Naawuni mi ku zahim so lala.
en: If we are tempted by such trials, we must not say, This temptation comes from God. For God cannot be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no one.

dag: Ka o daa bol o na ti bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ka n go n-wumd a yɛla shɛm ŋɔ? Malimi m binshɛɣukam din be a sani laasabu n-zaŋ ti ma, dama a ku lan niŋ n tumtumdi kpɛma.
en: He called the manager in and said to him, What is this I hear about you? Give me a report of your administration because you can no longer serve as my manager.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi yila vuri la zo n sani. M mi ku wum yi biŋkumda kumsi.
en: No more of your noisy songs! I won't listen when you play your harps.

dag: Ka so yi ti yɛn nahim ba, buɣim ni yi bɛ ni na n-di bɛn nyɛ bɛ dimnim maa, ka ŋunkam ti yɛn nahim ba lala n-yɛn niŋ o ka o kpi.
en: If anyone wants to hurt them, fire comes out of their mouth and burns up their enemies. So if anyone wants to hurt them, they have to be killed in this way.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Izraɛlnim mini Judanim taali maa galisiya pam. Bɛ kul kurila niriba tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka bi lan doli yɛlimaŋli soli tiŋ maa ni. Dama bɛ yɛra, Yawɛ chɛla tiŋgbani maa bahi. Yawɛ bi nyara.
en: God answered, The people of Israel and Judah are guilty of terrible sins. They have committed murder all over the land and have filled Jerusalem with crime. They say that I, the Lord , have abandoned their country and that I don't see them.

dag: Ka tɔbu daa yiɣisi alizanda ni. Malaikanim zuɣulana Maikil min o malaikanima n-daa tuhiri waɣ biɛ titali maa min o gba malaikanima.
en: Then war broke out in heaven. Michael and his angels fought against the dragon, who fought back with his angels;.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu, hal n ni mali suhukpeeni Masia zuɣu ni n tooi wuh a di ni niŋ kamaata ni a niŋ shɛm la zaa yoli.
en: For this reason I could be bold enough, as your brother in Christ, to order you to do what should be done.

dag: Ti wumya ni ti ni shɛb daa ka yi sanna nti mali yɛl shɛŋa doli ya ni yi niŋ, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi suhuri bi doya, amaa pa tinima n-wuhi ba lala maa.
en: We have heard that some people from here have terribly upset you by what they said. But we did not send them!.

dag: ka gbi bɔɣ zilinli sɔŋ Akasia fɔŋ ni. Amaa n ni fiɛb bɛ zaa.
en: At the place of worship you were a treacherous pit, and I will punish you.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ di simdi ka a gba niŋ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabipaɣ ŋɔ ni yɛn yɛl a ni a niŋ shɛm ŋɔ. Chɛ ka n niŋ bindirigu ti a ka a di ka nya yaa lab yiŋa.
en: Now please listen to me. Let me get you a little something to eat. It will give you strength for your walk back to camp.

dag: Miriya ka yi booni man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yuli yoliyoli, dama ŋunkam booni man Yawɛ yuli yoliyoli mali taali man Yawɛ sani.
en: Do not use the LORD your Gods name as if it were of no significance; the LORD wont forgive anyone who uses his name that way.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ziŋ maa ni o gbuɣimi Jona bahi, ka o daa zaŋ o ti gbuɣi bahi duli.
en: Then the LORD spoke to the fish, and it vomited Jonah onto the dry land.

dag: Ka ŋun daa deei pɔŋ tusaanu la zaŋ pɔŋ tusaanu pahi di zuɣu na ti yɛl o yiŋlan maa, N dana, pɔŋ tusaanu ka a daa zaŋ ti ma, ka n nya pɔŋ tusaanu nyɔri pahi di zuɣu.
en: The servant who had been given , coins brought them in with the , that he had earned. He said, Sir, you gave me , coins, and I have earned , more.

dag: Bɛ mabihi bɛn daa nyɛ Lɛvinim la n-daa su Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni tuun shɛŋa din pahi fukumsi.
en: The other Levites were assigned all the other duties at the place of worship.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli ba, Di zɔriya dabiɛm, zanimiya baalim nya Yawɛ ni yɛn tum tiliginsim tuun shɛli tin ya zuŋɔ; dama yi ni nya Ijipti ninvuɣ shɛb zuŋɔ ŋɔ, yi nini ku lan nya ba yaha.
en: But Moses answered, Don't be afraid! Be brave, and you will see the Lord save you today. These Egyptians will never bother you again.

dag: Lɛvinim ni gbibi bɛ bidibbina bɛ nuhi ni n-zani gili naa, ka ŋunkam kpe nayili maa na, bɛn kum o. Kul benya naa sani, o yi ti yɛn yina, yin benya o sani, ka o yi ti labiri kpɛra yin benya o sani.
en: You Levites must protect King Joash. Don't let him out of your sight! And keep your swords ready to kill anyone who comes into the temple.

dag: Ka Yisa daa teeg o nuu shih o ka yɛli, N saɣiya, di naama! Ka o kɔŋ maa dii naai.
en: Jesus reached out his hand, touched him, and said, I do want to. Be clean. Instantly, the skin disease left him.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu? Tuumbiɛ bɔ ka o lee tum? Ka bɛ maan mɔhi vuri pam yɛli, Kpahim o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: Pilate asked, Why do you want me to kill him? What wrong has he done? But they shouted louder, Kill him on a cross.

dag: O zaŋla noli yɛlibu ye kaman binyɛrigu la. Chɛ ka di tabil o niŋgbuna kaman kom la, ka chɛ ka di be kaman kpam la n-nyɛligi kpe o kɔba ni.
en: Since he wore curses like a coat, let them seep inside him like water, seep into his bones like oil!.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Chama, ka daa chɛ ka o chaŋ ni o ti niŋ chira ayi. Ka o daa ŋmaligi ka o min o dol tab chaŋ ti du zoya zuɣu n-fabil o ni yɛn kpi ni o paɣipiɛlital maa zuɣu.
en: Yes, you may have two months, Jephthah said. She and some other girls left, and for two months they wandered in the hill country, crying because she could never get married and have children.

dag: Dinzuɣu gbibiya n ni zali ya zaligu shɛŋa, ka tummiya di tuma din ni chɛ ka yi ti be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ka barina shɛli kani.
en: Remember my laws and rules. Obey them and you will live safely in your country.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa bɔh o, Ka daɣila Yawɛ suhu yula bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa nyo buɣim mali sara ti ŋun Yawɛ mini sara pina n-gar o noli deebu? Nyama, noli deebu gari sara maligu, ka o yɛligu wumbu mi gari piɛla kara.
en: But Samuel answered, Which pleases the Lord more: burnt offerings and sacrifices or obeying his commands? It is better to obey the Lord than to offer sacrifices to him. It is better to listen to him than to offer the fat from rams.

dag: O daa wuh o ni bɛ zaŋmi salima din nyɛ alali m-mali dirijaba mini taha ni pipihi, o daa lan wuhi salima laa kam tibisim ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm, ka lan wuhi anzinfa laa kam tibisim ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm.
en: for the forks, bowls, and cups of pure gold; for the weight of each gold dish and the weight of each silver dish.

dag: Ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa bahi Nɛbuzaradan ŋun daa nyɛ yiliguliba sapashin kpɛm maa noli zaŋ chaŋ Jɛrimia polo yɛli.
en: But King Nebuchadnezzar commanded Nebuzaradan, the commanding officer, to give the following order:.

dag: O ni daa kul nyɛ Naawuni Bia maa zaa yoli, o daa bɔhim nɔdeebo wahala dibu puuni.
en: But even though he was God's Son, he learned through his sufferings to be obedient.

dag: Ka n daa wum yɛtɔɣa kukolibil ni, ka n tibili daa wum di ni sɔɣiri yɛra.
en: But a word sneaked up on me; my ears caught a hint of it.

dag: Kpiimba biɛhigu shee nim malila shili ni bɛ deei Babilɔn naa. Bɛnkam zaa daa nyɛ nanim dunia ŋɔ ni yiɣisiya ni bɛ puh a. Bɛn zaa daa nyɛ zuliya shɛb nanim ni yiɣisi bɛ nam ʒiishɛhi puh a.
en: The place of death is excited that you are coming. Sheol is waking the spirits of all the leaders of the earth for you. Sheol is making the kings stand up from their thrones to meet you.

dag: ka Ira ŋun daa nyɛ Jair nir la mi daa nyɛ Dauda maligumaana.
en: and Ira from Jair was also a priest for David.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa boli palo maa yuli, Ʒim Palo hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: That is why that field is still called the Field of Blood.

dag: Bɛ sɔɣimi do bɛ sɔɣibu shee kaman gbuɣinli la guhira. Bɛ domi gu tarimba ni bɛ zaŋ bɛ zana bari gbahi ba n-vo n-chaŋ.
en: They are hungry lions hiding in the bushes, hoping to catch some helpless passerby. They trap the poor in nets and drag them away.

dag: ka n suhu paligi pam Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n tiligira ŋɔ ni.
en: In the depths of who I am I rejoice in God my savior.

dag: Chɛ ka ti chaŋ wain tihi puri ni nti nya di daai pum. Ti cham ti nya di puma maa yirigiya, ka nya pumpɔrinchihi tihi gba daai pum. Nimaani ka n ni wuh a n ni yur a shɛm.
en: Lets get up early and go to the vineyards. Lets see if the vines are in bloom. Lets see if the blossoms have opened and if the pomegranates are in bloom. There I will give you my love.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, A zuɣu n-lɛbigi! Amaa ka o nini kul mooi ka o yɛri ni di shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. Ka bɛ yɛl o, O malaika m-bala.
en: You are crazy! everyone told her. But she kept saying it was Peter. Then they said, It must be his angel.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nya ba, ku lan nya ba, bɛ yanim ku lan nya ba.
en: and vanish from the sight of family and friends.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka a daa yihi ma pul ni na? M paɣiya ka n daa kpi ka so nini na bi nya ma.
en: Why did you let me be born? I would rather have died before birth.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Aŋgo zɔnim ni tooi lo noli aŋgo ni be bɛ sani saha shɛli? Aŋgo ni na be bɛ sani maa, bɛ ku tooi lo noli.
en: Jesus answered, At a wedding the friends of the bridegroom are not sad while he is with them. They cannot fast while the bridegroom is still there.

dag: ka tiligi shɛba kaman buɣim ni ka yi tim yihi ba la. Ka chɛliya ka shɛb mi yɛla niŋ ya nambɔɣu ni dabiɛm; ka leeya bɛn je bɛ binyɛr taɣilima din be tiŋli ka bɛ niŋgbuŋ kɔre gabisi li la.
en: Save some by snatching them from the fire. Fearing God, have mercy on some, hating even the clothing contaminated by their sinful urges.

dag: Chɛ ka wuntizɔra kpahi n zuɣu ni, ka chɛ ka ŋun ʒe yim saɣisi ma. Di chɛ ka m bo jilima ninvuɣ biɛɣu sani, dama n kul galindila bɛ tuumbiɛri maa n wunsuhigu puuni.
en: Good people may punish me and rebuke me in kindness, but I will never accept honor from evil people, because I am always praying against their evil deeds.

dag: Ka Saimɔn min o tab la daa chani bɔr o shee.
en: Simon and the others started looking for him.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ m binnamda zaa kpɛma, ŋun nam o kɔŋko n-ni tooi zaŋ takɔbi mir o.
en: I made it more powerful than any other creature, yet I am stronger still.

dag: Wuntaŋ mini goli, paɣimiy o! Saŋmarisi bɛn nyaɣisiri zaa, paɣimiy o!.
en: Sun and moon, praise him! Stars and lights in the sky, praise him!.

dag: Yisahaku daa yurila Iso, dama o daa yuri mɔɣu ni nimdi pam, ka Ribɛka mi daa yuri Yaakubu.
en: Isaac loved Esau because he enjoyed eating game, but Rebekah loved Jacob.

dag: Ka Pool garigi yɛl o, N nyɛla Yɛhudia nira, ka nyɛ Taasus din be Kilikia tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka bi pɔri la tiŋbia. Ka lan yɛl o, N suhir a noli ni a chɛ ka n tɔɣisi niriba ŋɔ yɛtɔɣa. .
en: No! Paul replied. I am a Jew from Tarsus, an important city in Cilicia. Please let me speak to the crowd.

dag: Bani daŋ ni: Mɛshulam mini Maluk ni Adaya ni Jashub ni Shial ni Jɛrɛmɔt so yaha.
en: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth from the family of Bani;.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Cham ti bɔhi Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima, Yinim ku tooi bɔhim yɛm ka gba deei n noli? Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, says to go to the people of Judah and Jerusalem and tell them this message: You should learn a lesson and obey my message. This message is from the Lord .

dag: Ka Musa daa yeei Aduna kpariti maa n-zaŋ li yɛli o bia Ɛliɛza; ka Aduna daa shiri kpi zoli maa zuɣu. Ka Musa mini Ɛliɛza daa yi zoli maa zuɣu siɣina.
en: and Moses removed Aaron's priestly robes and put them on Eleazar. There on the top of the mountain Aaron died, and Moses and Eleazar came back down.

dag: Di ni daa niŋ shɛm ka Ɛfurɔn ti zaŋ o tiŋgbani din daa be Makipɛla din be Mamri wulimpuhili polo la ti Ibrahimma m-bala. O daa zaŋ siliga mini tihi din zaa daa be tiŋgbani maa ni ti.
en: So the field of Ephron changed owners. This field was in Machpelah, near Mamre. Abraham became the owner of the field, the cave in it, and all the trees in the field. Everyone in the city saw the agreement between Ephron and Abraham.

dag: Jɔshua mini Izraɛlnim zaa ni daa nya ka bɛ tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa sɔɣ doya la deei tiŋ maa, ka di nyɔhi kpuɣi du zuɣusaa maa, ka bɛ daa ŋmaligina n-lu Ainim maa zuɣu n-dii ŋmɛri kuri ba.
en: When Joshua and his men saw that his army had taken control of the city and that smoke was rising from it, they stopped running away and turned to fight the men of Ai.

dag: Ka n daa kul lihiri nti nya ka yilli maa lo tɔbu n-tuhi wuntizɔriba nyaŋ ba.
en: As I was watching, this little horn began attacking and making war against Gods holy people and killing them.

dag: Zimiri ni daa kul di n-ʒin o nam ʒiishee, di daa bi yuui ka o ku Baasha daŋ niriba zaa. O daa ku dɔbba bɛn nyɛ o daŋ ni niriba min o zɔnim zaa.
en: As soon as Zimri became king he killed off all the members of Baasha's family. Every male relative and friend was put to death.

dag: Lan gbilisim tibili wum a dabili min a niriba Izraɛlnim fabila; saha shɛli bɛ yi ti ŋmaligi kpa kpe na ka suhir a nyin gbilisim tibili a biɛhigu shee alizanda ni n-wum ti suhigu ka chɛ ti taali.
en: Hear my prayers and the prayers of your people Israel when they face this place and pray. In your home in heaven hear us and forgive us.

dag: Hal o daa mɛla buɣa jɛmbu shee Juda zoya tinsi ni, ka daa chɛ ka Jɛrusalɛmnim bi lan ʒe yim, ka lan chɛ ka Judanim birigi.
en: Jehoram also built high places on the hills in Judah. He caused the people of Jerusalem to start worshiping other gods. He led the people of Judah away from their God.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni be ti sani kaman o ni daa be ti yaannim maa sani shɛm la. O di chɛ ti bee n-zaŋ ti bahi.
en: May the LORD our God be with us, just as he was with our ancestors. May he never leave us or abandon us.

dag: Chɛ ka zaligu litaafi ŋɔ yɛtɔɣa kul be a nol ni sahakam, kul bɔhimmi li wuntaŋ ni ni yuŋ din ni chɛ ka a tooi doli din sab di ni maa viɛnyɛliŋga; ka di chɛ ka a tɔŋ a sol ni, ka lan chɛ ka a di nasara viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Be sure that the book of the Law is always read in your worship. Study it day and night, and make sure that you obey everything written in it. Then you will be prosperous and successful.

dag: Tizɔra kam gbibila omaŋ binshɛɣukam puuni. Bɛ niŋdi lala maa ni bɛ ti deela zuɣupil shɛli din saɣinda, amaa tinim niŋdi lala ni ti ti deela zuɣupil shɛli din bi saɣinda.
en: Athletes work hard to win a crown that cannot last, but we do it for a crown that will last forever.

dag: Dama kum daa mali ma, ka yi mɔŋ ma bindirigu; ka kɔnyuri daa mali ma, ka yi bi ti ma kom;.
en: I was hungry but you would not feed me, thirsty but you would not give me a drink;.

dag: N ni yɛli Yawɛ yurilim maŋli la yɛla. O ni tum tuun kar shɛŋa ti ti la zuɣu, n ni paɣ o. O nambɔzɔbo min o yurilim maŋli la zuɣu, o niŋ alibarika pam niŋ Izraɛlnim ni.
en: I will tell about the kind deeds the Lord has done. They deserve praise! The Lord has shown mercy to the people of Israel; he has been kind and good.

dag: Nimaani ka yi ni ti jɛmdi wuna din nyɛ kuɣa mini dari, ka nyɛ ninsalinim ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali binshɛŋa, ka di ku tooi nya bee n-wum bee n-di bee n-wum nyom ŋɔ.
en: There you will worship other gods, made of wood and stone by human hands—gods that cannot see, listen, eat, or smell.

dag: Ka Ibram daa pirigipirig o tɔbbihi maa n-chaŋ ti liri ba yuŋ ŋ-ŋme n-kari ba hal ti paai Hɔba din be Damaskus nuzaa polo la.
en: That night he and his men made a surprise attack against the enemy. They defeated them and chased them to Hobah, north of Damascus.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kul laɣindi Naawuni jɛmbu duu ni suhu yini biɛɣukam, ka laɣindi taba yinsi n-laɣindi diri ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Day after day they met together in the temple. They broke bread together in different homes and shared their food happily and freely.

dag: Gaal ni daa nya niriba maa, ka o ŋmaligi yɛli Zɛbul, Nyama, niriba n-yiri zoya ŋɔ zuɣu sigirina! Ka Zɛbul garigi yɛl o, Pa niriba m-bala. Zoya maa shilinshihi ka a nya ka di ŋmani ninsalinim maa.
en: Gaal saw them and said to Zebul, Look! There are men coming down from the mountaintops! Those are not men, Zebul answered. They are just shadows on the mountains.

dag: Wula ka ti lee ni yɛli ti yab Ibrahimma so zuliya ni ti ni yila na yɛla?.
en: So what can we say about Abraham, the father of our people? What did he learn about faith?.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Musa daa chaŋ ti zaŋ Yawɛ yɛtɔɣa maa yɛli niriba maa; ka daa laɣim Izraɛlnim kpamba ninvuɣ pisopɔin na nti chɛ ka bɛ zani gili suɣili maa.
en: So Moses went out and told the people the LORDs words. He assembled seventy men from the peoples elders and placed them around the tent.

dag: Hal Ijiptinim yi wum ni Taai wurimya, di ni niŋ ba nandahima pam.
en: Even the Egyptians will be shocked and dismayed when they learn that Tyre has been destroyed.

dag: Zaŋm nɛkaŋa n-niɛm zim. Paam a sariga sɔŋ, ka kahi a mukuru ka chɛ a biɛhi n-siɣi mɔɣa kom ni du.
en: Take the millstones and grind flour! Remove your veil, strip off your robe, expose your thighs, wade through the rivers!.

dag: Ka Pool daa siɣi nti kurim o sani m-bɔbind o ka yɛli, Di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira, dama o na nyɛla nyɛvililana.
en: But Paul went down and threw himself on him and hugged him. Don't worry, he said, he is still alive.

dag: Ka o bidibiga Jɛhɔshafat daa di nam n-zan o zaani, ka daa mali shili gu Izraɛlnima.
en: Asas son Jehoshaphat succeeded him as king. Jehoshaphat strengthened his position against Israel.

dag: Dama ti daa wum yi ni niŋ Yisa Masia yɛda mini yi ni yuri Yisa nyaandoliba zaa shɛm la yɛla;.
en: Weve done this since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and your love for all Gods people.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt yɛli ba, Ka dindina zaŋmiy o chaŋ ti doli yimaŋmaŋ zaligu soli kar o saria. Ka Yɛhudianim maa yɛl o, Ti ka soli ni ti ku nira.
en: Pilate told them, Take him and judge him by your own laws. The crowd replied, We are not allowed to put anyone to death.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim ni zɔri Juda tiŋgbɔŋnima, ka bɛ yi ti boli Juda yuli bɛ ni so sani, dabiɛm ni gbaag o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni lɔri nia shɛli zaŋ chaŋ bɛ polo zuɣu.
en: The people of Egypt will be terrified of Judah every time they are reminded of the fate that the Lord Almighty has prepared for them.

dag: Cham ti yɛli Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa maa ni o chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa yi o tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: to demand that the king of Egypt let the Israelites leave.

dag: O kɔŋko n-nyɛ nyɛvili din bi naari ni be so ni; ka nyɛ ŋun be neesim shɛl ni so ni ku tooi miri. So na ʒi n-nya o, ka so mi ku tooi nya o. Ŋuna n-simdi jilima tibu mini yiko subu hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Ami!.
en: Only God lives forever! And he lives in light that no one can come near. No human has ever seen God or ever can see him. God will be honored, and his power will last forever. Amen.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Agiripa yɛli Pool, Di ni bɔŋɔ a tɛhiya ni a ni lɛbigi ma Kristiɛn saha biɛla ŋɔ puuni.
en: Agrippa said to Paul, In this short time do you think you will make me a Christian.

dag: Lɛvinim bɛn daa be tin kasi maa ni zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiyi ni pihiniinaanahi.
en: In all, Levites lived in the holy city of Jerusalem.

dag: Kurimbuni ha zaŋ na ni pumpɔŋɔ, so nini na ʒi n-nya bee n-wum ni Naawuni so beni pah a zuɣu, ka nyɛ ŋun tumdi tuun kara tiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn guhir o.
en: You are the only God ever seen or heard of who works miracles for his followers.

dag: Yi yɛm bi yaɣi lala? Yinim bɛn daa piligi Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni ŋɔ, yi yɛn zaŋla yimaŋmaŋ yiko naai?.
en: You began your life in Christ with the Spirit. Now do you try to complete it by your own power? That is foolish.

dag: Jɛhu ni daa kuri Ɛhab daŋ niriba maa saha shɛli maa, ka o daa tuhi Juda kpambaliba mini Ahazia mabihi bidibisi bɛn daa doli Ahazia maa soli n-daa ku ba.
en: Jehu was punishing Ahabs family. He found the leaders of Judah and Ahaziahs relatives who served Ahaziah. He killed the leaders of Judah and Ahaziahs relatives.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa lan bɔhi ba yaha, Ka wula ka yi lee bɔri ni n niŋ yi ni booni so Yɛhudianim Naa ŋɔ.
en: Pilate spoke again to the crowd, What, then, do you want me to do with the one you call the king of the Jews.

dag: Naftali zuliya n-daa pah ayɔbu n-nyɛ bɛ ni ti shɛb tiŋgbani kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: For the people of Naphtali, the lot went out sixth. For the clans of Naphtali.

dag: Yi chɛ ka yi kɔhigɔriba galisi gari saŋmarisi bɛn be zuɣusaa ŋɔ. Toliga fuɣisiya ka yiɣi chaŋ.
en: More merchants are in your city than there are stars in the sky— but they are like locusts that eat everything, then fly away.

dag: Ka Hɔsa ŋun daa nyɛ Mɛrari bidibisi ni yino la gba daa mali bidibisi; Shimri n-daa nyɛ bɛ zuɣulana.
en: Hosah, from the Merari clan, was the father of Shimri, Hilkiah, Tebaliah, and Zechariah. Hosah had made Shimri the family leader, even though he was not the oldest son. Thirteen men from Hosah's family were chosen to be temple guards.

dag: Yawɛ, tim naa maa nasara; ka garigi ti saha shɛli ti yi ti kuhi bol a.
en: Give the king victory, Lord , and answer our prayers.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ saguya ŋɔ, baŋmiya, jɛra ŋɔ, bɔ saha ka yi lee yɛn niŋ yɛm?.
en: You ignorant people better learn quickly. You fools—when will you get some sense?.

dag: M-pahi Hɛshibɔn mini di tin kara din daa be tintan ni la zaa ni Dibɔn ni Bamɔtibaal ni Bɛtibaalimiɔn.
en: It included Heshbon and all its cities that are on the plateau: Dibon, Bamoth-baal, Beth-baal-meon.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia min o kpambaliba niŋ bɛ dimnim bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ba la nuu ni. N ni zaŋ ba niŋ Babilɔn naa tɔbbihi bɛn zo ka chɛn ya la nuu ni.
en: I will hand over Judahs King Zedekiah and his officials to their enemies who seek to kill them: namely, the army of Babylons king, which has just withdrawn from you.

dag: Ka o mini niriba maa gbaai saawara naai, ka o daa pii baansi shɛba ni bɛ zaŋ bɛ neen kasinim yɛna ti yili yila paɣi Yawɛ. Ka baansi maa daa gari tɔbbihi maa tooni ka ŋme kuŋ yɛli, Paɣimiya Yawɛ, dama o yurilim bi naara.
en: After consulting with the people, the king ordered some musicians to put on the robes they wore on sacred occasions and to march ahead of the army, singing: Praise the Lord ! His love is eternal.

dag: N ni zaŋ a min a ma ŋun dɔɣ a labi bɛ ni daa bi dɔɣi ya tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni, ka yi ti kpi nimaani.
en: You and your mother were born in Judah, but I will throw both of you into a foreign country, where you will die.

dag: Yaa be o nyiŋgoli ni, ka dabiɛmnim ʒe o tooni ka bɛ ni sɔhira.
en: His neck is very powerful. People are afraid and run away from him.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ nti ʒini tin shɛli din yuli booni Nazarɛt la ni di chɛ ka anabinim ni daa yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. Bɛ daa yɛliya ni bɛ ni ti bol o Nazarɛt nira.
en: He settled in a city called Nazareth so that what was spoken through the prophets might be fulfilled: He will be called a Nazarene.

dag: Ka Balak daa bɔhi Balaam, Bɔ n-niŋ ka n daa tim na ti bol a ka a bi kana? A bi tɛhi ni n ni tooi ti a pin titali.
en: When Balak saw Balaam, he said to him, I asked you before to come. I told you it was very important. Why didnt you come to me? Did you think I might not be able to pay you.

dag: Ka o daa lan leei nyɛvililana n-dii yiɣisi zani; ka Yisa daa yɛli ni bɛ tim bipuɣiŋga maa bindirigu ka o di.
en: Her life returned and she got up at once. He directed them to give her something to eat.

dag: Ka Ibram mini Nahɔr daa kpuɣi paɣiba. Ibram paɣ yuli n-daa booni Zarai, ka Nahɔr mi paɣ yuli booni Milika. Milika mini Isika ba n-daa nyɛ Haran.
en: Abram and Nahor both married; Abrams wife was Sarai, and Nahors wife was Milcah the daughter of Haran, father of both Milcah and Iscah.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka a wurim duɣu maa, a mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn chaŋ maa ninni.
en: Then the Lord told me to break the jar in front of those who had gone with me.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka bɛ mini Filistianim maa daa ti lan tuhiri tɔbu Gɔb, ka Sibɛkai ŋun daa nyɛ Husha nir la daa ku Saf ŋun daa nyɛ tiyaawumyanim zuliya ni nir la.
en: There was another battle with the Philistines at Gob, where Sibbecai from Hushah killed a descendant of the Rephaim named Saph.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti Yisahaku mini Ribɛka suhusaɣiŋgu pam.
en: They made life miserable for Isaac and Rebecca.

dag: Di simdi ni yi kul ʒe Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yim.
en: You must be faithful to the Lord your God, never doing anything he considers wrong.

dag: N suhu kul yɛla a zaligunim dolibu zuɣu sahakam.
en: My heart aches with longing; I want to know your judgments at all times.

dag: Amaa ka Ahimɛlɛk ŋun daa nyɛ Ahitub bia maa bidib so ŋun yuli booni Abiata la ŋun daa zo n-tiligi chaŋ Dauda sani.
en: But Abiathar son of Ahimelech escaped. He ran away and joined David.

dag: ka di zuɣu chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛɣu ku tooi su niriba, bee m-bariti niriba zana.
en: He prevents a lawless person from ruling, from capturing people.

dag: Ka n daa nya do so ʒii puuni yuŋ ka o bari wɔr ʒiɛɣu. O daa ʒiɛla vinvamli ni mitil tihi sunsuuni, ka wɔr ʒiɛ so mini wɔr ʒiɛ taŋkpaɣu ni wɔr piɛlli dol o nyaaŋa.
en: At night I saw a man riding a red horse. He was standing among some myrtle bushes in the valley. Behind him, there were red, brown, and white horses.

dag: Yɛhudianim pam ni daa wum ni Yisa be nimaani maa ka bɛ daa kana. Pa Yisa kɔŋko zuɣu ka bɛ daa kana, amaa bɛ daa kamina ni bɛ ti nya Lazarɔs so Yisa ni daa neei kum ni la.
en: Many Jews learned that he was there. They came not only because of Jesus but also to see Lazarus, whom he had raised from the dead.

dag: Ka tiŋgbani daa sɔŋ paɣ maa bɔɣi, ka waɣ titali maa ni daa tuhi ko shɛli o nol ni na ka di be kaman mɔɣili kom maa zɔna ti kpe di ni, ka di nyu di zaa.
en: But the earth helped the woman. The earth opened its mouth and swallowed the river that the dragon poured out of his mouth.

dag: ni o zaŋ omaŋ pa talima n-tiligi bɛn be fukumsi zaligu maa sulinsi ni, ka zaŋ ti leei ŋun Naawuni bihi.
en: This was so he could redeem those under the Law so that we could be adopted.

dag: Asiria naa Sarigɔn ni daa chɛ ka o tɔbbihi zuɣulana chaŋ ti liri Ashidɔdnima n-tuhi nyaŋ ba yuun shɛl la.
en: In the year that Assyrias King Sargon sent his general to Ashdod, he fought against Ashdod and captured it.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Di saha maa, bɛ ni ti kurigi Juda nanima mini kpambaliba ni maligumaaniba ni anabinim ni Jɛrusalɛmnim kɔba bɛ gbala ni;.
en: Then the bones of the dead kings of Judah and their officials will be dug up, along with the bones of the priests, the prophets, and everyone else in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa ko bɛ tiŋgbani maa ni biri n-daa ti kpuɣi di daatam ka di gari o ni daa zaŋ shɛm biri maa ʒii bukɔbiga zuɣu. Ka Yawɛ daa niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni.
en: Isaac planted grain in that land and reaped one hundred shearim that year because the LORD had blessed him.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni gali piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli mali pumpɔrinchihi kɔtomsi niŋ alichɛbba maa tiŋli ti tuui.
en: On the robes lower hem, they added pomegranates made of blue, purple, and deep red yarns and of fine twisted linen.

dag: Amaa ka Pool daa kuhi pam yɛl o, Di niŋ amaŋ shɛli, dama ti zaa be kpe.
en: But Paul shouted, Dont hurt yourself! We are all here.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Laɣimmi Izraɛl kpamba ninvuɣ pisopɔin shɛb a ni mi ka bɛ nyɛ niriba maa kpamba ni zuɣulaannim bɛn su ba n-zaŋ ba ka Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa gbinna, ka bɛ ti zani nimaani pah a zuɣu.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Bring to me of the elders of Israel. These men are the leaders among the people. Bring them to the Meeting Tent. Let them stand there with you.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa yɛliya, Nyama, di ku yuui ka n kana! Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli anabitali yɛligu din be litaafi ŋɔ ni mal alibarika.
en: Remember, I am coming soon! God will bless everyone who pays attention to the message of this book.

dag: nyin be alizanda ni ka wum, ka niŋ din tuhi, ka kar a daba saria n-wuhi ŋun tum taali, ka chɛ ka o tuuni maa ʒin o zuɣu. Ka a zani wuntizɔra maa nyaaŋa, ka ti o laara o wuntitali maa zuɣu.
en: Please listen from heaven and judge them. If they are guilty, please show us that they are guilty. And if they are innocent, please show us that they are not guilty.

dag: Kulla sɔhila ka yi paai kpe na; ka n chɛ ka yi doli ma chani gindi ka m bi mi n ni kuni luɣ shɛli polo gba? Zaŋm a mabihi maa ka yi labi. Yawɛ ni wuhi ya o yurilim din bi naari min o ʒiɛyimtali.
en: You haven't been with me very long, so why should you have to follow me, when I don't even know where I'm going? Take your soldiers and go back. I pray that the Lord will be kind and faithful to you.

dag: Amaa ni a ni chaŋla n ya n dɔɣiriba sani ti bo paɣ na ti ti m bia Yisahaku ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: Go to my land and my family and find a wife for my son Isaac there.

dag: ka daa lan zaŋ bantabiga vil o, ka zaŋ salima bimparilan din be kasi niŋ di tooni kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ŋun Musa shɛm.
en: He placed the turban on Aaron's head, and on the front of the turban was the narrow strip of thin gold as a sign of his dedication to the Lord .

dag: amaa a nina yi bi ne, a niŋgbuŋ zaa ni bela zibisim ni. Dama din di naan nyɛ a neesim yi niŋ liti, dindina nyin baŋmi ni di zibisim maa ku mali kpee.
en: But when your eyes are bad, everything is dark. If the light inside you is dark, you surely are in the dark.

dag: Varanda shɛli din daa be wulinluhili polo la, niriba anahi n-daa ʒe di palli zuɣu, ka niriba ayi mi ʒe di samban ni gul li.
en: At the courtyard on the West, there were four at the road and two at the courtyard.

dag: A yi lo ni a niŋ shɛli, di ni niŋ; ka neesim lan neei a soya zuɣu.
en: He will do whatever you ask, and life will be bright.

dag: Ka n daa nya biŋkɔb so ka o yiri teeku ni na; o daa malila yila pia, ka mali zuɣur ayopɔin, ka nam zuɣupila pia pili o yila maa, ka Naawuni mɔbu yuya sab pa o zuɣuri maa zuɣu.
en: and I saw a beast coming up out of the sea. It had ten horns and seven heads. Each of its horns was decorated with a royal crown, and on its heads were blasphemous names.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa bahi noli ni bɛ niŋm kawana pali bɛ kpalansi ka labisi bɛ zaa yinoyino liɣiri niŋ bɛ kpalansi maa ni, ka bo bɛ sol ni bindirigu ti ba. Ka bɛ daa shiri niŋ lala ti ba.
en: Joseph gave orders for his brothers' grain sacks to be filled with grain and for their money to be put in their sacks. He also gave orders for them to be given food for their journey home. After this was done.

dag: Yi yi ti biri yi bimbira, o ni chɛ ka saa mi n-niŋ li ka di zooi niŋ, ka yi kpuɣi atam pam, ka yi biŋkɔbiri nya mɔri pam ŋubira.
en: Whenever you plant your crops, the Lord will send rain to make them grow and will give you a rich harvest, and your livestock will have plenty of pasture.

dag: Ka o daa ti paai luɣ shɛli ka wuntaŋ lu ka o kpalim gbe nimaani dindali maa yuŋ. O daa piila kuɣ yini nimaani sɔŋ n-dɔni zaŋ o zuɣu kuɣ li gbihi.
en: At sunset he came to a holy place and camped there. He lay down to sleep, resting his head on a stone.

dag: Dama bɛ tɛhi bɛ ni niŋ shɛm yɛla, ka zo n-yi bɛ ni tumdi tuumbiɛ shɛŋa zaa maa ni, biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ ni be, bɛ ku kpi.
en: They will think about what they've done and stop sinning, and so they won't be put to death.

dag: Di chɛ ka karimbaannim zaŋ bɛ naba du n-tam n zuɣu nɔra bee n-chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri zaŋ bɛ nuhi kari ma.
en: Do not let proud people attack me or the wicked make me run away.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa chɛ ka o nyaandoliba kpe ŋariŋ daŋ o tooni baari duri Bɛtisaida polo, ka ŋun kpalim ni o chɛbisi salo maa.
en: At once Jesus made his disciples get into the boat and go ahead of him to Bethsaida, on the other side of the lake, while he sent the crowd away.

dag: amaa yi ni mali pam pumpɔŋɔ zuɣu, di niŋ kamaata ni yi sɔŋ bɛn ka. Ka yi gba yi ti ka ka bɛ mi mali pam, bɛ ni sɔŋ ya, ka lala niŋbu ni chɛ ka yi tab sɔŋbu saɣ taba.
en: At this time you have plenty and can provide what they need. Then later, when they have plenty, they can provide what you need. Then everyone will have an equal share.

dag: dindina bɛ ni tooi yo o zuɣu ka deeg o o ni zaŋ omaŋ pa talima maa nyaaŋa, o mabihi ni yino ni tooi yo o zuɣu ka deeg o.
en: the Israelite will have the right to be bought back after they sold themselves. One of their relatives can buy them back.

dag: Ka Bɔaz daa bɔh o tumtumdib kpɛma, Ka paɣisar ŋuni n-lee bɔŋɔ.
en: Boaz said to his young man, the one who was overseeing the harvesters, To whom does this young woman belong.

dag: O daa lan yɛli, Yi ni yɛn niŋ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: yi pirigibu buta puuni yim bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim bɛn yɛn be tuma ni Vuhim Dabisili dali yɛn nyɛla dunɔguliba.
en: This is what we will do. When the priests and Levites come on duty on the Sabbath, one third of them will guard the Temple gates.

dag: Amaa ka jintɔriba maa ni yino ŋun yuli daa booni Kaiafas, ka o nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulana di yuuni maa la yɛli ba, Yi ʒi shɛli!.
en: One of them, Caiaphas, who was high priest that year, told them, You dont know anything!.

dag: Dama piɛguliba maa nyɛla jɛra, ka bi bɔhiri Yawɛ ni bɛ baŋ shɛli. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ bi tɔŋda, ka bɛ piɛri zaa wurim kpe yɔɣu.
en: The shepherd kings have lost their senses and dont seek answers from the LORD. That is why they have failed and their flock is scattered.

dag: Nyin Firawuna suhu ni daa ti yiɣisi bah a tumtumdiba zuɣu, ka a zaŋ m min a bɔrɔbɔro shɛriba kpɛm ti kpɛhi duu a tɔbbihi bɛn gul a sapashin kpɛm yiŋ la.
en: When you were angry with me and your chief cook, you threw us both in jail in the house of the captain of the guard.

dag: Dindali maa ka Firawuna daa zali bɛ tuma zuɣulaannim mini bɛn daa yuuni ba ka bɛ tumdi tuma maa zaligu yɛli.
en: That same day the king commanded the Egyptian slave drivers and the Israelite foremen:.

dag: Amaa zuɣulan maa daa yi ti kpi, bɛ lan ŋmaligirimi tumdi tuumbiɛ shɛŋa din bie n-gari bɛ yaannim dini. Bɛ daa kul jɛmdila wuna ka damdir li tiŋa. Bɛ daa bi saɣi chɛ bɛ tuumbiɛri maa shɛli bee n-chɛ bɛ tipawumli soya la dolibu.
en: But when the leader died, the people would return to the old ways and behave worse than the previous generation. They would serve and worship other gods, and stubbornly continue their own evil ways.

dag: Chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi bahila zuliya shɛb bɛn bi mi a la mini nam shɛŋa din niriba bi jɛmd a la zuɣu.
en: Turn your anger on the nations that do not worship you, on the people who do not pray to you.

dag: Alikizanda ŋun nyɛ daanya doora la daa tum ma zaɣ biɛɣu pam; ti Duuma ni bɔh o biɛri labisi o ni tum shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: Alexander, the craftsman who works with metal, has really hurt me. The Lord will pay him back for what he has done.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa woligi piɛbihi bɛ ko, ka ŋmaligi biŋkɔbiri maa nina kpa Leeban biŋkɔbiri bɛn mali bomaboma mini zaɣ sabila zaa la polo; ka wolig o biŋkɔbiri zali bɛ kɔŋko ka bi chɛ ka bɛ laɣim Leeban biŋkɔbiri maa ni.
en: Jacob separated the spotted and the black animals from the other animals in the flock. He kept his animals separate from Labans.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka doli Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la naba, ka daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ li.
en: He did what was evil in the LORDs eyes. He walked in the sins that Jeroboam, Nebats son, had caused Israel to commit. He didnt deviate from them.

dag: Bɛ kala a sanna kaman niriba ni kanna shɛm, ka ʒini a tooni kaman n niriba n-nyɛ ba la, ka wum a yɛligu, amaa bɛ ku deei li. Bɛ nyɛla naŋgbammalisimnima, amaa ka bɛ suhuri lee bela bɛ bomma ni.
en: So they come to you as people do, and they sit before you as my people. They listen to your words, but they refuse to do them. Though they speak of their longing for me, they act out of their own interests and opinions.

dag: Ka di bi simdi ni man chɛ ka paɣ so ŋun nyɛ ti yab Ibrahimma zuliya ka Sintani daa lo m-pɔri gɔɣ o yuun pisaayika ŋɔ kpaŋ Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: This woman that I healed is a true descendant of Abraham. But Satan has held her for years. Surely it is not wrong for her to be made free from her sickness on a Sabbath day.

dag: Sanzali lu bɛ kulisi zuɣu ni di chɛ ka di koma nyuui. Dama di nyɛla binnana ni pali tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni. Ka bɛ suhuri zaa kul ye buɣa jɛmbu zuɣu.
en: A sword against the water supplies so that they dry up. It is truly the land of idols, idols about which they have gone utterly mad!.

dag: M mabihi n suhiri ya, niŋmiya suɣilo n-deei n saɣisigu yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, dama yɛtɔɣa biɛla ka n zaŋ n-sabi gbaŋ ŋɔ tin ya.
en: My friends, I have written only a short letter to encourage you, and I beg you to pay close attention to what I have said.

dag: Naawuni tim a suhudoo! A zɔnim la zaa puhir a. Puhimi ti zɔnim la zaa ti ma.
en: Peace to you. The friends here with me send their love. Please give our love to each one of the friends there.

dag: Samsin daa niŋ Izraɛlnim zuɣulana la yuun pisi shɛŋa puuni Filistianim ni daa su bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa la.
en: Samson led Israel for twenty years while the Philistines ruled the land.

dag: M paɣiri Yawɛ; o ni deei n suhigu shɛli n ni suhir o ni o zom ma nambɔɣu la zuɣu.
en: I praise you, Lord , for answering my prayers.

dag: Yawɛ, n nyɛla a dabili. N nyɛla a dab bipuɣiŋga bia. A kabisi m bandi.
en: I am your servant, Lord ; I serve you just as my mother did. You have saved me from death.

dag: Di daba anahi dali ka bɛ daa daŋ yibu asibaasi m-mali shili ni bɛ kuli, amaa ka paɣ maa ba maa yɛl o deemba maa, Ʒinimi suug a noli n-nya kpiɔŋ ka naanyi chaŋ.
en: On the fourth day, they got up early in the morning, and he got ready to set out. But the young womans father said to his son-in-law, Eat a little food to give you strength, and then you can go.

dag: Di saha ka Bɛtɛl maligumaana Amazia daa tim ti yɛli Izraɛl Naa Jɛrɔbɔam, Amɔs yila a nyaaŋa Izraɛlnim sani. O yɛtɔɣa muɣila tiŋgbani maa.
en: Amaziah, a priest at Bethel, sent this message to Jeroboam, the king of Israel: Amos is making plans against you. He is trying to make the people of Israel fight against you. He has been speaking so much that this country cannot hold all his words.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini tɔbbihi maa zaa daa yiɣisi ni bɛ chaŋ Ai, ka Jɔshua daa pii tɔbutuhiri biinsi tuhi pihita n-chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ Ai yuŋ.
en: So Joshua led his whole army toward Ai. Then Joshua chose , of his best fighting men and sent them out at night.

dag: Di bi simdi ka bɛ pini bɛ zuɣuri bee n-chɛ ka bɛ zabiri zibigi. Di simdi ka bɛ wahiri bɛ zabiri.
en: Priests must never shave their heads when they are mourning. But they must keep their hair properly trimmed and not let it grow too long.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, o daa shiri biɛra, hal ti yɛn kpimi gba; amaa ka Naawuni daa zo o nambɔɣu, ka di pala o kɔŋko ka o daa zo nambɔɣu maa, amaa zaŋ tabili man gba ni di chɛ ka n ku mali nandahima n-lan pahi.
en: In fact, he was so sick that he nearly died. But God had mercy on him—and not just on him but also on me, because his death would have caused me great sorrow.

dag: Yɛndaan yino chaŋ ti liri tɔbutuhiriba tiŋa n-wurim bɛ kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛli ka bɛ niŋ li naani la.
en: One wise person can defeat a city full of soldiers and capture their fortress.

dag: O daa yɛli Bɛnjamin zuliya, Yawɛ ni yuri so, barina ku tooi paag o. Naawuni ŋun galisi ŋɔ nyɛla ŋun be o luɣilikam dabisi muni puuni zaa. O ni yuri so ʒila o bɔɣusapima sunsuuni.
en: Moses said this about Benjamin: Benjamin is loved by the Lord and lives close to him in safety. The Lord protects him all the time like a child at rest on its mothers back.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka ti kpaŋ timaŋ paai vuhim shee Naawuni sani, ka ti ni so ti ku lu nɔzaɣisibo ŋɔ tatabo zuɣu.
en: We should do our best to enter the place of rest, so none of us will disobey and miss going there, as they did.

dag: Ka Miriam ŋun daa nyɛ anabi ka nyɛ Aduna tizɔpaɣ la daa zaŋ guŋgombil din mali chaɣisa, ka paɣiba zaa daa zaŋ guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisa n-yi nti pah o zuɣu wari waa.
en: Then the prophet Miriam, Aarons sister, took a tambourine in her hand. All the women followed her playing tambourines and dancing.

dag: Dama di nyɛla talahi ni sokam ʒi omaŋmaŋ ʒili.
en: We each must carry our own load.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, chɛ ka a ni daa lo a dabili Dauda alikauli shɛli maa niŋ pali.
en: Please keep this promise you made to your servant David.

dag: Di saha ka dɔbba bɛn zaa daa mi ni bɛ paɣiba maanila buɣa mini paɣiba bɛn zaa daa ʒe nimaani, ka nyɛ bɛn galisi pam zaŋ tabili ninvuɣ shɛb zaa bɛn daa be Patrɔs Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa daa garigi yɛli Jɛrimia.
en: A large number of Jews from both northern and southern Egypt listened to me as I told them what the Lord had said. Most of the men in the crowd knew that their wives often burned incense to other gods. So they and their wives shouted:.

dag: Aai, lala ku niŋ. Yi dɔbba kɔŋko cham ti jɛm Yawɛ, dama yi ni bɔri shɛm m-bala. Ka bɛ daa kari ba Firawuna tooni yihi.
en: No way! Only your men can go and worship the LORD, because thats what you asked for. Then Pharaoh had them chased out of his presence.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ malaika daa chaŋ Asirianim maa sansan ni nti ku ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihinii ni tusaanu, ka biɛɣu daa neei ka kpiimba kul yɛrigi luɣilikam.
en: That night the angel of the Lord went out and killed , men in the Assyrian camp. When the people got up in the morning, they saw all the dead bodies.

dag: Ka Gomna Filiksi daa ti Pool noli ni o tɔɣisi. Ka Pool daa yaag o noli yɛli, N ni mi ni yuma shɛm ka a nyɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ nim sariakarita zuɣu, di niŋ ma nyaɣisim ni n tɔɣisi zabi mmaŋ zuɣu a sani.
en: The governor nodded at Paul, giving him permission to speak. He responded, I know that you have been judge over this nation for many years, so I gladly offer my own defense.

dag: Dama Adam ka Naawuni daa daŋ nam ka naanyi ti nam Awa.
en: After all, Adam was created before Eve.

dag: Ka Pita mini nyaandol ŋun maa daa yina n-zaŋ kpa siliga maa polo.
en: Peter and the other disciple left to go to the tomb.

dag: Yuri, chamiya tooni, chɛchɛbunsi, bilimmiya yomyom! Chɛ ka tɔbbihi cham tooni. Itiɔpianim mini Libianim n-gbibi nyɔtaɣirisi ka Lidianim mi nyɛ peentɔriba.
en: Command the horses to go and the chariots to roll! Send out the soldiers: men from Ethiopia and Libya, carrying shields, and skilled archers from Lydia.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛli Naawuni nir maa, Ti kulimi n yiŋa ka n ti niŋ bindirigu ti a ka a di, ka n ti a yɔri.
en: The king spoke to the man of God: Come with me to the palace and refresh yourself. Let me give you a gift.

dag: Amaa wuntizɔriba ni ti kari ba saria ka yɛli ni bɛ nyɛla sariakaritiba bɛn nyɛ bɛn niŋ zina ka ku niriba. Dama bɛ nyɛla zinaniŋdiba ni ninvuɣ kuriba.
en: But good men will judge them guilty of adultery and murder, because Oholah and Oholibah committed adultery and their hands are covered with blood.

dag: Nyama, n dabili ni tɔŋ. Bɛ ni duh o, ka ti o jilima pam.
en: The Lord says: My servant will succeed! He will be given great praise and the highest honors.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Sabimi n ni yɛl a yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa zaa niŋ litaafi ni.
en: The LORD, the God of Israel, proclaims: Write down in a scroll all the words I have spoken to you.

dag: Ka di tintariga bɔbili maa daa lan zaŋ nimaani n-kpa shɛli polo yaha nti ŋmaligi wulinluhili polo zoli gbini n-zaŋ kpa nudirigu polo hal ti paai Kiriatibaal .
en: The border turned and came around southward on the west side, running from the mountain that is opposite Beth-horon on the south. It ended at Kiriath-baal , a city of the people of Judah. This was its west side.

dag: Suhugarigu chɛmi ka n gbarigi zaa; n kul malila nandahima m biɛhigu puuni. Ka n ni be nandahima shɛŋa ni maa zuɣu chɛ ka n gbarigi zaa ka n kɔba ni zaa kul chɔɣisichɔɣisi.
en: I am exhausted by sorrow, and weeping has shortened my life. I am weak from all my troubles; even my bones are wasting away.

dag: Kum kɔgbana daa gili ma niŋ sunsuuni, ka bahi yoli kɔgbana liri ma.
en: Waves of death were crashing around me. A deadly flood was carrying me away.

dag: ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti ʒini Gɛdɔr tooni Vinvamli wulimpuhili polo ni bɛ biŋkɔbiri ti ŋubiri mɔri.
en: They went to the area outside the town of Gedor to the east side of the valley. They went to that place to look for fields for their sheep and cattle.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa garigi yɛli ma, Bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa tuhiya.
en: The Lord said to me, What they ask for is good.

dag: Ti mabihi, din bahindi nyaaŋa nyɛla, suhimiya Naawuni tiri ti ka o chɛ ka ti Duuma yɛligu yɛligi yomyom ka di nasara kaman di ni daa di nasara yi sani shɛm la.
en: Finally, our friends, pray for us that the Lord's message may continue to spread rapidly and be received with honor, just as it was among you.

dag: Sokam birigiya, bɛ zaa laɣim dolila biriginsim soli; so kani n-nyɛ ŋun tumdi din tuhi, hal ninvuɣ yino gba kani.
en: All have turned away from God; they have all gone wrong; no one does what is right, not even one.

dag: Yi ni chɛ so taali paŋ o, n gba chɛ m-paŋ dilana. N yi pun chɛ taal shɛli paŋ so, ka di yi shiri nyɛ yɛlimaŋli ni n chɛ taal shɛli paŋ so, yi zuɣu ka n chɛ li paŋ o zaŋ chaŋ Masia sani.
en: I will forgive anyone you forgive. Yes, for your sake and with Christ as my witness, I have forgiven whatever needed to be forgiven.

dag: M bi tɛhi ni n nyɛla ŋun pɔri tuun shɛba yi ni tibigiri la ni.
en: I dont consider myself as second-rate in any way compared to the super-apostles.

dag: N yura maa viɛlimi pam ka mali yaa. Ninvuɣ tuhili puuni so bi ŋman o.
en: My lover is radiant and ruddy; he stands out among ten thousand!.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ n nyaandoliba ŋɔ, gbibiya ka guliya n wuhibu viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Bind up the testimony; seal up the teaching among my disciples.

dag: Ka zuɣulan maa yɛl o, N Duuma, kamina paai m bia maa ka o na bi kpi.
en: Sir, replied the official, come with me before my child dies.

dag: Miriya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ŋmani bahi ka nyɛ tuumbiɛtumdiba la, ka miriya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpaŋsiri niŋgbuŋ ŋmaabu yɛla la.
en: Watch out for those people who behave like dogs! They are evil and want to do more than just circumcise you.

dag: Nyini n-ti ma a tiliginsim nyɔtaɣirigu; ka a sɔŋsim chɛ ka n lee wɔɣirili.
en: Youve given me the shield of your salvation; your help has made me great.

dag: Tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa ni wurim n-leei dabari, ka zuliya shɛb bɛn gili ya maa ti jɛm Babilɔn naa yuun pisopɔin.
en: That whole area will be an empty desert. All these people will be slaves of the king of Babylon for years.

dag: Ka o daa di nam ʒini Jɛrusalɛm yuma ata. O ma yuli n-daa booni Mikaya, o daa nyɛla Uriɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Gibia nir la bipuɣiŋga. Ka tɔb daa ti lu Abija mini Jɛrɔbɔam sunsuuni.
en: and he ruled three years in Jerusalem. His mother was Micaiah daughter of Uriel, from the city of Gibeah. War broke out between Abijah and Jeroboam.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, Naawuni ŋun nam dunia mini binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni ŋɔ n-nyɛ zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani Duuma. O bi be bimbin shɛŋa daadam ni zaŋ o nuhi me zuɣu.
en: This God made the world and everything in it. He is Lord of heaven and earth, and he doesn't live in temples built by human hands.

dag: Dama ŋunkam tibigir omaŋ ni nya filiŋ, ka ŋunkam mi siɣisir omaŋ ni nya tibiginsim.
en: All who lift themselves up will be brought low, and those who make themselves low will be lifted up.

dag: Nir yi ŋubiri ka kuma ka mali suhudoo, di so yil shɛli nim bɛn diri bindir nyaɣisa ka zabili be di yili maa ni.
en: Better a dry crust with quiet than a house full of feasting with quarrels.

dag: Sool mini Izraɛlnim zaa ni daa wum Filistia doo maa yɛtɔɣa maa, di daa gari ba mi ka dabiɛm gbaai ba pam.
en: When Saul and his men heard this, they were terrified.

dag: Jɛsi bia Dauda wunsuhigunim tariga m-bala.
en: This is the end of the prayers of David son of Jesse.

dag: Ka bɛ yi di daa bi pun baŋ wuntia soli yɛla, di naan so n-gari bɛ baŋ li ka lan ŋmaligi ka chɛ Naawuni zaligu kasi shɛl o ni daa zaŋ ti ba la.
en: They would have been better off if they had never known about the right way. Even after they knew what was right, they turned their backs on the holy commandments they were given.

dag: Ŋun pa Yisa yɛdaniŋda yi boli ya ni yi ka o yiŋ na nti di bindirigu ka yi yu ni yi chaŋ, bɛ yi ti kul zaŋ shɛlikam zaa zali yi tooni, yin dimiya li ka di bɔhiya, ka di chɛ ka yi suhuri ni tɛha muɣisi ya di zuɣu.
en: If an unbeliever invites you to a meal and you decide to go, eat what is set before you, without asking any questions because of your conscience.

dag: Dundɔŋ maa ni lɔris anahi ni daa malila dundombihi, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pisi, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pinaanu. Diba anahi maa zaa daa saɣila taba.
en: There was a small, enclosed area in each of the four corners of the courtyard. Each small courtyard was cubits long and cubits wide. The four areas measured the same.

dag: Wuntia puuni ka yi ni niŋ yaa. So ku lan nahim ya, ka dabiɛm ku lan mali ya. So ku lan kpɛhi ya dabiɛm, di ni ti niŋ ya katiŋa.
en: You will be firmly founded in righteousness. You will stay far from oppression because you wont fear, far from terror because it wont come near you.

dag: Ka niriba maa yɛl o, Alizin biɛɣu n-naɣ ʒi a zuɣu! Ŋuni n-lee bɔri ni o ku a.
en: The people answered, A demon is making you crazy! We are not trying to kill you.

dag: Ka ti Duuma Yisa daa ti baŋ lala ka yi Judia labiri Galili.
en: So he left Judea and went back to Galilee.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa zaŋ o paɣiba min o bihi balisi laakumnima.
en: So Jacob got up, put his sons and wives on the camels.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa yɛli Musa, Yim n sani, Miri ka a lan chɛ ka n nya a yaha. N nini yi ti lan nya a, n ni ku a.
en: that he said to Moses, Get out and stay out! If you ever come back, you're dead.

dag: Amaa yi mali kali din ti ma soli ni n yihi dansarika yino so yi ni bɔri bahi Yaɣigari Chuɣu puhibu saha; dinzuɣu yi bɔri ni n yihi Yɛhudianim Naa maa bahi.
en: And since I usually set a prisoner free for you at Passover, would you like for me to set free the king of the Jews.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa wum ni Leeban bidibisi yɛrimi, Yaakubu n-fa ti ba binshɛɣukam zaa, ka binshɛlikam din nyɛ ti ba dini, dina ka o zaŋ nya buni.
en: Jacob heard that Laban's sons were complaining, Jacob is now a rich man, and he got everything he owns from our father.

dag: O daa lan wuhi ma shɛli. Nyama, n daa nyami ka n Duuma ʒe bɛ ni zaŋ bimbuɣisirigu buɣisi m-me goon shɛli gbini; ka bimbuɣisirigu maa be o nuu ni.
en: This is what the Lord showed me: He stood by a wall with a plumb line in his hand.

dag: Ka di ni nyɛ bɔrɔbɔro kpil yini zuɣu, tinim bɛn galisi ŋɔ gba nyɛla niŋgbun yini, dama ti zaa laɣindi ŋubirila bɔrɔbɔro kpil yini maa.
en: By sharing in the same loaf of bread, we become one body, even though there are many of us.

dag: Niriba maa yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Juda zuliya ni toondana n-nyɛ Jɛfune bia Kalɛb.
en: These are the names of the leaders: from the tribe of Judah—Caleb son of Jephunneh;.

dag: Kul suhimiya Naawuni ni o yihim ti tɛhibiɛrinim mini ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni, dama pa sokam zaa n-nyɛ bɛn niŋ yɛda.
en: And pray that we will be protected from crooked and evil people. Not everyone believes in the Lord, you know.

dag: O ʒiɛla luɣ shɛŋa din du zuɣu mini so naŋgban kpansi ni sochira zuɣu.
en: Atop the heights along the path, at the crossroads she takes her stand.

dag: M mabihi n suhiri ya, niŋmiya suɣilo n-deei n saɣisigu yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, dama yɛtɔɣa biɛla ka n zaŋ n-sabi gbaŋ ŋɔ tin ya.
en: My brothers and sisters, I beg you to listen patiently to what I have said. I wrote this letter to strengthen you. And it is not very long.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa tim tuumba Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa zaa sani nti bɔhi ba, Tuumbiɛ bɔ ka yi lee tum la?.
en: The Israelite tribes sent messengers all through the territory of the tribe of Benjamin to say, What is this crime that you have committed?.

dag: Ka Shafan daa lab Naa Jɔsia sanna nti yɛl o, A tumtumdiba yihi laɣ shɛli zaa din be Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni n-zaŋ li ti tuma zuɣulaannim bɛn lihiri ka bɛ tumdi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu tuma maa.
en: He went to King Josiah and told him what happened. Shaphan said, Your servants have gathered all the money that was in the Temple. They gave it to the men who supervise the work on the Lord s Temple.

dag: Amaa ka Yisifu daa ti kpe yili maa ni dahin shɛli ni o ti tum o tuma, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be yili maa ni kani.
en: One day when Joseph arrived at the house to do his work, none of the households men were there.

dag: Miri ka a doli ninvuɣ biɛri soli. Miri ka a doli tuumbiɛtumdiba soli.
en: Do not go where evil people go. Do not follow the example of the wicked.

dag: nyuli yi kpe o yidan maa suhu ni ka o zab nyuli o paɣ maa ni tum daɣiri tuuni maa zuɣu bee o yi zab nyuli n-zilisi ni o paɣ maa tum daɣiri tuuni maa ka o mi bi tum li;.
en: If jealousy overcomes him and he is jealous of his wife who has defiled herself, or if jealousy overcomes him and he is jealous of his wife who hasnt defiled herself.

dag: N lee yɛli dimbɔŋɔ maa la ninsal suhu yubu puuni bee lala ka Naawuni zaligu puuni gba yɛli?.
en: I don't have to limit myself to these everyday examples, because the Law says the same thing.

dag: Ka Gaad bidibisi daa nyɛ: Zifiɔn mini Hagi ni Shuni ni Ɛzibɔn ni Ɛr ni Arɔd ni Arɛli.
en: Gads sons were Zephon, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.

dag: Di saha ka Absalom daa bɔhi Ahitɔfɛl, Wuhim ti ti ni yɛn niŋ shɛm.
en: Absalom said to Ahithophel, Please tell us what we should do.

dag: Yawɛ, yɛlimaŋli, Asiria naa shiri bahi niriba pam mini bɛ tiŋgbɔna yoli.
en: Its true, LORD, that the Assyrian kings have destroyed all the nations and their lands.

dag: ka o ni yihi bɛ ni zaŋdi binshɛli nyɔri buɣim maani sara tiri Yawɛ la n-gbib li omaŋmaŋ nuu ni na. O ti zaŋm biŋkpam mini bimbihili na, ka bɛ ti zaŋ bimbihili maa gahigahi ka di leei gahibu sara maligu Yawɛ tooni.
en: You must bring the fat and the breast of the animal to the priest. Then he will lift up the breast in front of the Lord to show it was presented to God.

dag: Di dunoya zaa mini di takɔriti zaa firimnim daa nyɛla zaɣ mɔɣiri. Takɔriti maa daa tuhila taba, ka tam tab ʒii buta zuɣu.
en: There were three doors at each end. All the door openings and frames were square.

dag: Di simdi ni dapaɣ yini kam wɔɣilim nyɛla mita anahi, ka di yɛliŋ mi nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: Make each frame meters high and centimeters wide.

dag: ni Kɛdɛshi naa ni Jokiniam naa.
en: the king of Kedesh one.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli ni bɛ laɣimmi Babilɔn baŋdiba zaa na ka bɛ ti wuhi ma zahindi maa gbinni.
en: I ordered all Babylons sages to come before me, so they might tell me the dreams meaning.

dag: Ka do so yi ti zahim zahindi yuŋ mahig omaŋa, dindina ŋun yim sansani maa ni, ka di lan kpe sansani maa ni na.
en: If a man becomes unclean because he has had a wet dream during the night, he is to go outside the camp and stay there.

dag: ni Bɛnaaya so ni Bɛdɛya ni Kɛluhi.
en: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Keluhi.

dag: Amaa bɛn so bɛ zaa nyɛla bɛ ni bi dɔɣi shɛb ka bɛ nini nya ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma din tumdi dunia ŋɔ ni la.
en: But those who have never been born are better off than anyone else, because they have never seen the terrible things that happen on this earth.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa dihili ni ti nyɛla dɛde hal bɛ ni mali tarili bɛ dɔɣiriba ni kɔhiri bɛ daŋ ni neen shɛŋa ni la zaa yoli.
en: And that Levite will get an equal share with the other Levites, in addition to the share his family normally gets.

dag: ni bɛ niŋ o kaman a ni daa pun lo shɛm a yiko ni min a milinsi ni la, dama di daa ʒe o la lala.
en: They did what you in your power and wisdom had already decided would happen.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli paɣ maa, Pumpɔŋɔ ti niŋ yɛda, ka pa ni a yɛligu la zuɣu yaha, dama timaŋmaŋ wum o yɛligu ka baŋ ni o shiri nyɛla dunia ŋɔ tiligira.
en: They told the woman, We no longer have faith in Jesus just because of what you told us. We have heard him ourselves, and we are certain that he is the Savior of the world.

dag: Ka a daa kul lihir o hal ka kuɣili din pa ninsal nuu ni ŋme ŋ-ŋmaai shɛli bahi na daa ti kana ti lu binnani maa napɔnvari din daa nyɛ kuriti mini yaɣiri la zuɣu n-wurisiwurisi li buɣibuɣi.
en: While you were looking at it, a great stone broke loose from a cliff without anyone touching it, struck the iron and clay feet of the statue, and shattered them.

dag: nyin be a alizanda ni; ka deei bɛ suhigu ka niŋ bɛ ni bɔri shɛli maa ti ba.
en: Answer their prayers from heaven and give them victory.

dag: Saha shɛli n ni daa yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na hal ni zuŋɔ, bɛ tuma zaa kul wuhirila lala, bɛ zaɣisi ma ka jɛmdila buɣa, lala ka bɛ niŋd a gba maa.
en: Ever since the day I rescued my people from Egypt, they have turned from me to worship idols. Now they are turning away from you.

dag: Ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ ni bɔri ni bɛ bɔh o shɛm ka bɔhi ba, N ni yɛli ni di kpari biɛla ka yi ku lan nya ma, ka di ti tooi biɛla ka yi lan nya ma maa gbinni ka yi bɔhiri taba ni yi baŋ maa?.
en: Jesus saw that the followers wanted to ask him about this. So he said to them, Are you asking each other what I meant when I said, After a short time you wont see me. Then after another short time you will see me again?.

dag: Di simdi ka o ti zaŋ naɣilaa maa ka Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la dunol ni na Yawɛ tooni nti zaŋ o nuu pa naɣilaa maa zuɣu ni, ka kɔrigi naɣilaa maa Yawɛ tooni.
en: The priest will lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent, lay his hand on its head, and kill it there.

dag: yin miriya ka yi niŋ tipawumlinima kaman Naawuni niriba ni daa niŋ shɛm taai duŋ yɔɣu ni n-zahim o ka di chɛ ka o yɛli.
en: do not be stubborn, as your ancestors were when they rebelled against God, as they were that day in the desert when they put him to the test.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan yɛli, Ka daɣila Kɛilanim ŋɔ ni zaŋ m mini n niriba ŋɔ niŋ ŋun Sool nuu ni? Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli, Bɛ shiri ni zaŋ ya niŋ o nuu ni.
en: David asked, Would the leaders of Keilah hand me and my soldiers over to Saul? Yes, they would, the Lord answered.

dag: N ni daa nam dunia ŋɔ saha shɛli, a daa beni? A yi mi, nyin yɛlim ma.
en: Where were you when I made the earth? If you are so smart, answer me.

dag: N suhu kul yɛla a tiliginsim zuɣu hal ti tarigi; amaa m mali tahima a yɛligu ni.
en: I feel weaker and weaker as I wait for you to save me. But I put my trust in your word.

dag: Amaa bɛmbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ di ni bi simdi ni yi ŋubi shɛba: tɔrili mini juɣu ni zinyaarigu.
en: But dont eat any of these birds: eagles, vultures, buzzards.

dag: Lala ka Reehab ŋun daa nyɛ pagɔrili la gba daa niŋ yi taali ni Naawuni sani, o ni daa deei tuumba la n-chɛ ka bɛ taɣi doli so shɛli n-zo n-tiligi la puuni.
en: In the same way, wasnt Rahab the prostitute shown to be righteous when she received the messengers as her guests and then sent them on by another road?.

dag: Nir yi lo wahu kabire o dimbu nyaaŋa, di ku ku ŋun lo o kabire maa buchi.
en: If a snake bites before its charmed, then theres no profit for the snake charmer.

dag: N zaŋ a yɛligu ti ba, ka dunianim zaɣisi ba, bɛ ni lan pa dunia ŋɔ nima kaman n ni pa dunia ŋɔ nir shɛm la zuɣu.
en: I gave them your message, and the world hated them, because they do not belong to the world, just as I do not belong to the world.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa, Sa daŋmi yiɣisibu biɛɣ asiba n-chaŋ ti zani Firawuna tooni yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Hiburunim Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Chɛ ka n niriba maa chaŋ ti jɛm ma.
en: Then the LORD said to Moses, Get up early in the morning and confront Pharaoh. Say to him, This is what the LORD, the God of the Hebrews, says: Let my people go so that they can worship me.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka ti doli din ni chɛ ka naŋgban yini be ti sunsuuni mini din ni kpaŋsi tab suhuri.
en: We should try to live at peace and help each other have a strong faith.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabiyurisi bɛn nyɛ n suhu ni kul ye shɛb nyabu zuɣu la, yinima n-nyɛ bɛn chɛ ka m mali suhupiɛlli, ka nyuri bara yi zuɣu. M mabiyurisi, bamiya zani viɛnyɛliŋga ti Duuma ni!.
en: Dear friends, I love you and long to see you. Please keep on being faithful to the Lord. You are my pride and joy.

dag: Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa yɛl o, Ka doo mini paɣ yɛla yi nyɛla lala, dindina di bi simdi ni nir kpuɣi paɣa.
en: The disciples said, If that's how it is between a man and a woman, it's better not to get married.

dag: Ka Ɛzra daa yɛli, M paɣiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti yaannim Naawuni ŋun zaŋ yɛlli ŋɔ niŋ naa suhu ni, ka o ti Yawɛ jɛmbu duu din be Jɛrusalɛm la jilima ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Blessed is the Lord , the God of our ancestors. He put the idea into the kings heart to honor the Lord s Temple in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Dimbɔŋɔ gari ma pam! Yi bi mi doo maa ni yi shɛl na, amaa o neegi n nina.
en: The man answered, What a strange thing that is! You do not know where he comes from, but he cured me of my blindness!.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ ni chɛ ka Izraɛlnim zaŋ bɛ ni kɔriti binneen shɛb maani sara mɔɣu ni la ka Yawɛ sanna Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ŋɔ ni nti ti maligumaana, ka o zaŋ ba mali suhudoo sara maligu.
en: The meaning of this command is that the people of Israel shall now bring to the Lord the animals which they used to kill in the open country. They shall now bring them to the priest at the entrance of the Tent and kill them as fellowship offerings.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-ni chɛ ka yi tooi baŋ shi so ŋun yi Naawuni sanna: Ŋunkam yɛli ni Yisa Masia daa leei ninsala n-ka dunia ŋɔ ni na n-nyɛ ŋum mali Shi so ŋun yi Naawuni sanna;.
en: This is how you can recognize Gods Spirit. One spirit says, I believe that Jesus is the Messiah who came to earth and became a man. That Spirit is from God.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ m biɛhigu shee maa zali kaman n ni daa pun wuh a shɛm zoli zuɣu la.
en: Then set up the tent in the way I showed you on the mountain.

dag: Musa ni daa tɔɣisi Izraɛlnim zaa yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli tiŋgban nɛli ni bɔpiɛligu din daa be Suf tooni, ka be Paran mini Tɔfɛl ni Leeban ni Hazɛrɔt ni Dizahab sunsuuni la m-bɔŋɔ.
en: These are the commands that Moses gave the Israelites while they were in the Jordan Valley, in the desert east of the Jordan River. This was across from Suph, between the desert of Paran and the cities Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth, and Dizahab.

dag: ka a zaŋ li ti ti a ba ka o di, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni pɔi ka naanyi kpi.
en: Then you can take it to him, so he can eat it and give you his blessing before he dies.

dag: Kamiyana ka ti yili yila paɣi Yawɛ. Chɛliya ka ti yo suhupiɛlli vuri m-paɣi ŋun nyɛ ti tiliginsim tampiŋ ŋɔ!.
en: Come, let us praise the Lord ! Let us sing for joy to God, who protects us!.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, Bin kpiŋ ni be luɣ shɛli, nimaani ka juri laana.
en: Its like looking for a dead body: You will find it where the vultures are gathering above.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔh o, Pa doo n-nya a? A kpee be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni? Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a bi ʒiɛya gul a dan naa? Dama ninvuɣ so kana ni o ti ku a dan naa maa.
en: David answered Abner, You are a man, arent you? And you have no equal in Israel, right? Then why havent you kept watch over your master the king? One of the soldiers came to kill your master the king.

dag: M bihi, di chɛliya ka so yɔhim ya. Ŋunkam tumdi din tuhi n-nyɛ wuntizɔra kaman Masia ni nyɛ wuntizɔra shɛm.
en: Little children, make sure no one deceives you. The person who practices righteousness is righteous, in the same way that Jesus is righteous.

dag: Yi tihi mini yi puri atam zaa ni ti leei toli bindirigu.
en: Locusts will destroy all your trees and the crops in your fields.

dag: Ka teeku maa kom pirigibu ʒii buta puuni yim leei ʒim, ka teeku maa ni binnɛma zaa pirigibu ʒii buta puuni yim kpi, ka ŋarima din daa pa teeku maa kom zuɣu diba ata kam puuni zaɣ yini saɣim.
en: a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.

dag: Ka n yi bi mi tinzun yɛtɔɣ shɛli gbinni, dindina n nyɛla tinzun nira ŋun tɔɣisiri li maa sani, ka o gba nyɛ tinzun nira n sani.
en: But if I dont understand the meaning of what someone is saying, it will just be strange sounds to me, and I will sound just as strange to them.

dag: Bɛ nahindila paɣ so ŋun bi dɔɣi bihi, ka bi niŋdi pakoli zaɣi viɛlli.
en: These evil people hurt women who have no children to protect them, and they refuse to help widows.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti yɛli ba, N kul yɛn be yi san la daba ayi kɔŋko ka lan labi ŋun tim ma na maa sani.
en: But Jesus told them, I will be with you a little while longer, and then I will return to the one who sent me.

dag: Jɛhɔram yuma daa nyɛla yuun pihitanaayi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa, o daa di nam maa la yuma anii Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Jehoram was years old when he became king, and he ruled for eight years in Jerusalem.

dag: Giriikinim shɛb daa be ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kana ni bɛ ti jɛm Naawuni chuɣu maa puhibu ni la kalinli ni.
en: Some Greeks had gone to Jerusalem to worship during Passover.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Izraɛlnima, di pala yi zuɣu ka n yɛn tum tuuni ŋɔ; amaa n yuli din be kasi ka nyɛ yi ni daa saɣim shɛli zuliya shɛb sani yi ni daa be la zuɣu.
en: So tell the family of Israel that this is what the Lord GOD says: Family of Israel, you ruined my holy name in the places where you went. I am going to do something to stop this. I will not do it for your sake, Israel. I will do it for my holy name.

dag: Ka duu ŋɔ ni lu n-dahim, ka bɛnkam ti gariti nimaani yi nya li, di ni niŋ ba alahiziba, ka bɛ yɛli, wɛi, ka bɔhira, Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka Yawɛ niŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ mini duu ŋɔ lala.
en: This Temple will be destroyed. Everyone who sees it will be amazed. They will ask, Why did the Lord do this terrible thing to this land and to this temple.

dag: Bɛ chi sara yɛn nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ kpam ŋmiri chi zim viɛl shɛli; ka yi zaŋ di kilɔgiram ata pahi naɣila yino kam zuɣu, ka zaŋ di kilɔgiram ayi m-pahi piɛla yino zuɣu.
en: You must also give a grain offering of cups of fine flour mixed with olive oil with each bull, and cups of fine flour mixed with oil with the ram, and cups of fine flour mixed with oil for each lamb.

dag: Bumiya yi nyɔri ni suhusaɣiŋgu yi tiŋgbani din vuhiri mini yi tiwala tihi din saɣim la zuɣu.
en: Slap your breasts in sorrow because of what happened to the fruitful fields and vineyards.

dag: Di chɛ ka di yi a sani, gbibi li a suhu ni.
en: Dont let them slip from your sight. Guard them in your mind.

dag: Yawɛ n-chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb nyɛ nandaamba, ka chɛ ka shɛb mi nyɛ bundaannima. Ŋuna n-filindi nira, ŋuna n-lan duhiri nira.
en: The LORD! He makes poor, gives wealth, brings low, but also lifts up high!.

dag: Amaa nyini Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, nyini n-nyɛ ŋun kariti saria ni wuntia; nyini n-nyɛ ŋun mi din be ninsal suhu ni min o tɛha ni; chɛ ka n nya a ni yɛn darigi bɛ tibili shɛm, dama n zaŋla di binshɛɣukam niŋ a nuu ni.
en: Then I prayed, Almighty Lord , you are a just judge; you test people's thoughts and feelings. I have placed my cause in your hands; so let me watch you take revenge on these people.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa bi garig o. Ka o nyaandoliba balim o yɛli, Karim paɣ maa, dama o kuhiri doli ti.
en: Jesus did not say a word. But the woman kept following along and shouting, so his disciples came up and asked him to send her away.

dag: Dama ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ n-daa yihi ti mini ti yaannima Ijipti luɣ shɛli din nyɛ dabitim ni la na, ka daa tum alahiziba tuun kara ti ninni, ka tiligi ti ti ni daa doli so shɛŋa zaa ni mini ti ni daa kpe zuliya shɛb ni garina nuu ni.
en: The Lord our God brought our fathers and us out of slavery in Egypt, and we saw the miracles that he performed. He kept us safe wherever we went among all the nations through which we passed.

dag: Bimbɔ ka tumtumdiba lee nyari bɛ tuma puuni?.
en: Do people really gain anything from their hard work?.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab daa yiɣisi chaŋ Gɛshur nti zaŋ Absalom kuli Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: So Joab got up, went to Geshur, and brought Absalom back to Jerusalem.

dag: O daa kari dɔbba dagɔr tuma tiŋgbani maa ni, ka wurim buɣ shɛŋa zaa o yaannim ni daa me n-zal la.
en: He removed the consecrated workers from the land, and he did away with all the worthless idols that his predecessors had made.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Sulemaana, Nyama, Adɔnija zɔrila nyin Naa Sulemaana, dama nyama, o gbaala sara maligu bimbini bin yila la gbibi ka yɛra, Faashee Naa Sulemaana daŋ po pɔri yɛli ma ni o ku ku man ŋun nyɛ o dabili ŋɔ. .
en: King Solomon was told that Adonijah was afraid of him and that he was holding on to the corners of the altar and had said, First, I want King Solomon to swear to me that he will not have me put to death.

dag: Lala ka Absalom daa yi niŋdi Izraɛlnim bɛn zaa kani naa sanna ni o ti kari bɛ yɛtɔɣa saria ti ba, ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim suhuri lɛbigi ŋun Absalom polo.
en: Absalom did this with every Israelite who came to the king for judgment, and so he won their loyalty.

dag: Gunimiya, ka di nyɛ m mini ya daalikauli maa shihirili.
en: You must circumcise the flesh of your foreskins, and it will be a symbol of the covenant between us.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda garigi yɛli, Bolimiya Batishiiba ti ma. Ka o daa kpe naa sanna nti zan o tooni.
en: David said, Tell Bathsheba to come here. She came and stood in front of him.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ a ni mɛri du shɛli ŋɔ polo, a yi ni doli n fukumsi zaligunim mini zaligu shɛŋa n ni zali pahi la zaa, n ni niŋ a kaman n ni daa lo a ba Dauda alikauli ni n ni niŋ a shɛm la.
en: If you obey my commands and do what I say, I will keep the promise I made to your father David. I will live among my people Israel in this temple you are building, and I will not desert them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Tabɛra, Yawɛ buɣim ni daa di bɛ sani maa zuɣu.
en: The name of that place was called Taberah, because the LORDs fire burned against them.

dag: Yawɛ, pumpɔŋɔ chɛ ka a ni yɛli mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ n zuliya polo ŋɔ niŋ pali sahakam. Niŋmi kaman a ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Now, LORD, confirm forever the promise you have made about your servant and his dynasty. Do as you have promised.

dag: ka me bimbini n-chɛ ka di kuɣa do m-pa tab zuɣu viɛnyɛliŋga tam zoli ŋɔ zuɣu n-ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ; ka zaŋ naɣila so ŋun pah ayi la mali sara zaŋ o pa Ashɛra ŋmahinli binwɔɣinli shɛli a ni daai luhi la dari zuɣu n-nyo li buɣim.
en: Build an altar to the LORD your God in the proper way on top of this high ground. Then take the second bull and offer it as an entirely burned offering with the wood of the Asherah that you cut down.

dag: Naawuni chɛ ka Rubin zuliya kul beni, ka ku kpihim, hal o zuliya kalinli ni kul pɔri maa zaa yoli.
en: Moses said about the tribe of Reuben: May Reuben never die out, Although their people are few.

dag: Amaa n yi ti tɔɣis a yɛtɔɣa, n ni chɛ ka a noli yaai ka a yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya. Chɛ ka bɛn ni wum, wum. Ka chɛ ka bɛn zaɣisi wumbu, zaɣisi. Dama bɛ nyɛla duŋtaariba.
en: But whenever I speak to you, Ill open your mouth, and you will say to them: The LORD God proclaims. Those who hear will understand, but those who refuse will not. They are just a household of rebels.

dag: Ka Filistia doo maa daa bɔhi Dauda, Baa n-nyɛ ma ka a zaŋ kpahi kani n sanna? Ka o daa kar o buɣa bahiri Dauda zuɣu.
en: Goliath said to David, What is that stick for? Did you come to chase me away like a dog? Then Goliath used the names of his gods to say curses against David.

dag: Malaika maa daa lan yɛli ma: Siria na so ŋun ti yɛn dol o nyaaŋa ni ti nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋun ka soli ni o di nam maa, amaa o ni ti zaŋ yɔhiŋgu fa nam maa di n-libigi ba.
en: That ruler will be followed by a very cruel and hated man, who will not have the honor of being from a kings family. He will become a ruler by being tricky. He will attack the kingdom when the people feel safe.

dag: Naawuni Shia Kasi daa palila Yisa ka o yi Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili polo na, ka Naawuni Shia Kasi maa daa zaŋ o chaŋ mɔɣu ni.
en: Jesus returned from the Jordan full of the Holy Spirit and was led by the Spirit into the desert.

dag: Ka Judanim ni ti ŋmaligi yɛli bɛmaŋa, Jɛrusalɛmnim malila kpiɔŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ sani. .
en: Then the clans of Judah will say to themselves, The Lord God Almighty gives strength to his people who live in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Samsin bɔhi ba, Yi ni niŋ shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu, M poya ni n ku chɛn ya, faashee ka m bɔhi ya biɛri labisi ka naanyi chɛ.
en: Samson then responded to them, If this is how you act, then I wont stop until I get revenge on you.

dag: Dinzuɣu deemiy o ni suhupiɛlli ti Duuma zuɣu. Timiya niriba lala tatabo jilima.
en: So welcome him in the Lord with great joy and show great respect for people like him.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛhu, A ni tum din tuhi n sani, ka niŋ Ɛhab daŋ niriba kaman n suhu ni daa yu shɛm zaa la zuɣu, a daŋ ni bidibisi kul ni diri Izraɛl nam hal ti paai ʒiɛmani din pahir anahi ni.
en: Later the Lord said, Jehu, you have done right by destroying Ahab's entire family, just as I had planned. So I will make sure that the next four kings of Israel will come from your own family.

dag: Nyama, ti Duuma mali ninvuɣ so ŋun mali kpiɔŋ ni yiko din ni tooi lu bɛ zuɣu. O ni kana kaman sakuɣa saa bee sa kurili ni kopaliga nti di tiŋgbani maa.
en: Only the Lord is strong and powerful! His mighty hand will strike them down with the force of a hailstorm or a mighty whirlwind or an overwhelming flood.

dag: Nyama, n dabili ni tɔŋ. Bɛ ni duh o, ka ti o jilima pam.
en: The Lord says, My servant will succeed in his task; he will be highly honored.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti ʒiya nyuri wain, ka naa lan yɛli Ɛsta, Bɔ ka a lee kul bɔra? N ni zaŋ li ti a, hal di yi nyɛla n nam ŋɔ pirigili gba, n ni zaŋ li ti a.
