en: While they were drinking wine, the king asked her again, Now Esther, what do you want to ask for? Ask for anything, I will give it to you. So what is it you want? I will give you anything you want, up to half my kingdom.

dag: O miri ka o ti yi luɣ kasi shee la n-saɣim o Naawuni luɣ kasi shee maa, dama o Naawuni kpa shɛli din be kasi ka bɛ boori li bahiri niriba zuɣu ni la nyɛla din be o zuɣu ni. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: He must not exit the sanctuary, making his Gods sanctuary impure by doing so, because his Gods anointing oil, which separates, is upon him; I am the LORD.

dag: Ninvuɣ suma nimmaŋtali n-wuhiri ba soli, amaa bilikɔɣinim bilikɔnsi bahiri ba la yoli.
en: If you do the right thing, honesty will be your guide. But if you are crooked, you will be trapped by your own dishonesty.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛl o bidibisi, Pamiya buŋ nyaampara ti ma. Ka bɛ daa niŋ lala.
en: The old prophet told his sons, Saddle the donkey. They did so.

dag: Dama man Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni n ti nyɛ yi Naawuni, dinzuɣu di simdi ni yi be kasi, dama n nyɛla ŋun be kasi.
en: I brought you out of Egypt so that I could be your God. Now you must become holy, because I am holy!.

dag: So yi bɔr ni o ŋme o naŋgbankpeeni, o ni bɔh o bɔhigunim tuhili, ka o ku tooi garigi bɔhigu yini gba.
en: If one wants to contend with him, he wont answer one in a thousand.

dag: N Naawuni maa yurilim maŋli la zuɣu, o ni ka n sanna; n Naawuni maa ni chɛ ka n nyaŋ n dimnima.
en: God loves me, and he will help me win. He will help me defeat my enemies.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yɛli ma, Chɛ ka ti chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu; di saha n suhu daa paligiya pam!.
en: I rejoiced with those who said to me, Lets go to the LORDs house.

dag: M biyurisi, Naawuni yi yuri ti ŋ-ŋɔ, dindina di simdi ni ti gba yuri taba.
en: Dear friends, if this is how God loved us, then we should love one another.

dag: Malaika maa kɔtomsi daa ŋmanila saa ni yi nyaɣisi la, ka o binyɛrigu piɛli kaman gol la.
en: The angel was shining as bright as lightning. His clothes were as white as snow.

dag: Di saha ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa zaŋ Gɛdalia Ahikam bia ŋun daa nyɛ Shafan yaaŋa la n-leei gomna ka o su o ni daa chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb niŋ Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni la fukumsi.
en: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia made Gedaliah, the son of Ahikam and grandson of Shaphan, governor of Judah, and placed him in charge of all those who had not been taken away to Babylonia.

dag: Niriba zuliya ni zuɣulaannim bɛn daa yi Babilɔn doli ma n-lab kuli Jɛrusalɛm Naa Atazɛrikisɛs nam dibu ʒiɛman ni la yuya m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: These are the heads of the families, and this is the genealogy of those who went up with me during the rule of King Artaxerxes.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ di simdi ka a gba niŋ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabipaɣ ŋɔ ni yɛn yɛl a ni a niŋ shɛm ŋɔ. Chɛ ka n niŋ bindirigu ti a ka a di ka nya yaa lab yiŋa.
en: Now its your turn to listen to me, your servant. Let me give you a bit of food. Eat it, then youll have the strength to go on your way.

dag: Yawɛ mali yiko pam, amaa o suhu bi yiɣisiri yomyom. Biɛhiŋ kani, Yawɛ ku chɛ alahichilana tibili darigibu. O soli nyɛla pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga mini sanʒiɛɣu, ka sagbana nyɛ o napɔna taŋkpagbiligu.
en: The Lord does not easily become angry, but he is powerful and never lets the guilty go unpunished. Where the Lord walks, storms arise; the clouds are the dust raised by his feet!.

dag: Ka Naawuni nini ni tiɣi ŋun jɛmdi Masia lala, ka ninsalinim gba ni di o shɛhira suŋ.
en: Whoever serves Christ this way pleases God and gets human approval.

dag: Ka Naa Ɛla ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa pun tum tuun shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi ni.
en: Everything else that Elah did is recorded in The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Ti ni tɔɣisiri zuɣu ni kpahibu yɛl shɛŋa yɛla ŋɔ daliri nyɛla ni di kpaŋsi yurilim din yiri suhu din ka daɣiri mini suhu ni tɛha din ka galimi ni yɛda niŋbu maŋli ni na.
en: My purpose in telling you to do this is to promote love—the kind of love shown by those whose thoughts are pure, who do what they know is right, and whose faith in God is real.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ kuɣ viɛl shɛŋa pie taba kulis anahi. Bɛ daa zaŋla bɛ ni booni kuɣ shɛŋa kanɛlian mini kirisolait ni ɛmɛrald m-pie taba kul shɛli din daŋ tooni;.
en: They mounted four rows of precious stones on it: in the first row they mounted a ruby, a topaz, and a garnet;.

dag: Ka bɛ daa mali ti paai Ɛshikol vinvamli ni ŋ-ŋmaai nimaani wain tia wala yilli, ka niriba ayi zaŋ li pa dapua zuɣu buɣira; ka bɛ daa lan ʒi pumpɔrinchihi mini fiig tia wala gba na.
en: When they got to Bunch Valley, they cut off a branch with such a huge bunch of grapes, that it took two men to carry it on a pole. That's why the place was called Bunch Valley. Along with the grapes, they also took back pomegranates and figs.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, kɔba ŋɔ ŋmanila Izraɛlnim zaa. Bɛ yɛra, Ti kɔba kuuya zaa, ka ti lan ka tahima; ti yɛla naaya zaa.
en: He said to me, Human one, these bones are the entire house of Israel. They say, Our bones are dried up, and our hope has perished. We are completely finished.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ ba suhugarigu, ka bɛ gbaag o bɔhibu yinoyino, Mani? Mani.
en: Deeply saddened, they asked him, one by one, Its not me, is it.

dag: Ka Jɔn daa bi bɔri ni o saɣi ka yɛl o, Mani n-naan ka a sanna ka a ti baptaizi ma, amaa ka nyini nti lee kani n sanna.
en: But John kept objecting and said, I ought to be baptized by you. Why have you come to me.

dag: Ka paɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa mi gumdi mibu daa mi gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni gali piɛl viɛlli.
en: All the skilled women brought fine linen thread and thread of blue, purple, and red wool, which they had made.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan bɔhi Yawɛ yaha. Ka Yawɛ daa garigi yɛl o, Yiɣisima, cham Kɛila, dama n zaŋ Filistianim maa niŋ a nuu ni.
en: David again asked the Lord . And the Lord answered David, Go down to Keilah. I will help you defeat the Philistines.

dag: Dama man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ kul gbibila a nudirigu ni. Mani n-nyɛ ŋun yɛl a, Di zɔri dabiɛm; n ni sɔŋ a la.
en: I am the Lord your God, who holds your right hand. And I tell you, Dont be afraid! I will help you.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima: Paɣ yi niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga, o ni be daɣiri ni hal ni daba ayopɔin kaman o ni yi nya sɔrilim ka be daɣiri ni shɛm la.
en: Tell the Israelites: When a woman gives birth, she will be unclean, just as she is during her monthly time of bleeding. If the baby is a boy, the mother will be unclean for seven days.

dag: Nɛbukadnɛza daa lan va Yawɛ jɛmbu duu neen shɛŋa kuli Babilɔn ti zal o nam yili ni Babilɔn maa.
en: Nebuchadnezzar took some of the things from the Lord s Temple. He carried them to Babylon and put them in his own house.

dag: O ni yɛli ma, Nyini n-nyɛ m ba ni n Naawuni ni n tiliginsim tampiŋ.
en: He will say to me, You are my Father and my God, as well as the mighty rock where I am safe.

dag: Ka bɛ zaŋ alahichi sanyoo sara naɣilaa la mini alahichi sanyoo sara bua la, bɛ ni zaŋ shɛb ʒim kpe luɣ kasi shee la n-yi bɛ sansani maa ni kpaŋa nti nyo bɛ gbana mini bɛ nimdi ni bɛ bina buɣim.
en: The bull and the goat used for the sin offering, whose blood was brought into the Most Holy Place to take away sin, shall be carried outside the camp and burned. Skin, meat, and intestines shall all be burned.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianim ka nyɛ bɛn daa be Ɛfɛsus daa wum yɛlli ŋɔ, ka dabiɛm kpe bɛ zaa, ka ti Duuma Yisa yuli daa du n-chaŋ haliya.
en: All the people in Ephesus, Jews and Greeks, learned about this. They were all filled with fear and gave great honor to the Lord Jesus.

dag: A ni ti ma suhupiɛl shɛli n suhu ni gari bɛ ni yi ŋahi kawana pam, ka tɔɣi wain pam, ka mali suhupiɛl shɛl la.
en: You brought me more happiness than a rich harvest of grain and grapes.

dag: N nyari suhupiɛlli a zaligunim maa dolibu ni, dama n yuri li pam.
en: I find pleasure in obeying your commands, because I love them.

dag: Di saha ka Abimilɛk min o niriba daa yiɣisi yuŋ chaŋ ti piri tab ʒii bunahi zuɣu n-dɔni gili Shɛkɛm.
en: So Abimelech and all his men made their move at night and hid outside Shechem in four groups.

dag: Bɛ daa ŋmɛla binnɛma maa mini abie tihi pa sunsuuni duu maa dunoya zuɣu kaman bɛ ni daa ŋme li pa dukpina maa zuɣu shɛm la. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ dari mali varanda zɔntua maa tooni sambani polo.
en: Also Cherub angels and palm trees were carved on the doors of the Holy Place. They were like those carved on the walls. There was a wood roof over the front of the porch.

dag: Di ti yɛn nyɛla dabisi gahindili. Di ti ku mali wuntaŋ ni, di mi ti ku mali yuŋ, dama yuŋ gba ti yɛn malila neesim. Yawɛ kɔŋkɔ m-mi lala ni ti yɛn niŋ saha shɛli.
en: And the Lord has decided when it will happen—this time of unending day.

dag: So di kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni naɣila maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim bɛn tumdi tuma la kɔŋko; bɛna n-ni tooi kpe di puuni, dama bɛna m-be kasi, amaa di simdi ka bɛnkam kpalim zaa saɣi Yawɛ ni zali ba shɛm maa.
en: Only the priests and Levites who serve in the Lord s Temple are permitted to enter it. They are the only ones who have been made holy. Dont let anyone else enter. All the others must do only the work the Lord has given them.

dag: Yawɛ kɔŋko ka m mali, ka a tiri ma n ni bɔri shɛlikam, ka n dahin shɛli ha biɛhigu yɛla zaa bela a nuu ni.
en: You, LORD, are my portion, my cup; you control my destiny.

dag: Saha shɛli niriba maa ni daa yi bɛ tantinim ni na chani ni bɛ ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du, ka maligumaaniba bɛn daa ʒiri Alikauli Adaka maa daa gari bɛ tooni chana.
en: The priests carried the Box of the Agreement, and the people left the place they had camped. The people started going across the Jordan River.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, N nya ka Sintani yi zuɣusaa luna kaman saa n-nyaɣisi la.
en: Jesus said to them, I saw Satan falling like lightning from the sky.

dag: Ka o daa yɛl o tɔbbihi bɛn mali kpiɔŋ ni bɛ lom bɛ niriba ata maa mihi n-zaŋ ba ti bahi buɣim duu din buɣim diri pam maa ni.
en: He told some of the strongest men in his army to bind Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego and throw them into the furnace of flaming fire.

dag: Man Pool ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia tumo Naawuni ŋun daa lo ti nyɛvili shɛli din be Yisa Masia ni alikauli la yubu puuni la n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ.
en: From Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by Gods will, to promote the promise of life that is in Christ Jesus.

dag: Ka di ni yiri ninvuɣ so tooni na maa yi ba binshɛlikam n-ʒini di gali zuɣu, gali maa ni leei din be daɣiri ni.
en: Any saddle or seat on which the man with the discharge sits is unclean.

dag: Yuun piniyini puuni gol so ŋun pahir ata dahin yini dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: In the eleventh year, on the first day of the third month, the LORDs word came to me.

dag: Di yi pa lala, o yi pil li mɛbu ka bi tooi me n-naai, ŋunkam nya li lala ni mal o ansarisi.
en: Otherwise, when you have laid the foundation but couldnt finish the tower, all who see it will begin to belittle you.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa nam mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri balibu kam zaa, ka nam niɣi balibu kam zaa, ka nam binnɛma bɛn gbamdi tiŋa balibu kam zaa. Ka Naawuni daa nya ba ka bɛ viɛla.
en: God made every kind of wildlife, every kind of livestock, and every kind of creature that crawls on the ground. God saw how good it was.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ piɛgul suŋ. M Ba ni mi ma ka n gba mi m Ba shɛm, lala ka m mi m piɛri ka m piɛri maa gba mi ma; ka n zaŋdi n nyɛvili taɣiri m piɛri maa dini.
en: I am the good shepherd. I know my own sheep and they know me.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka niriba ni ti bɔhi, Ya ka bɛ Naawuni maa lee be? Darigim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yih a daba ʒim maa tibili ka timaŋmaŋ nini nya.
en: Why should the nations ask us, Where is your God? Let us see you punish the nations for shedding the blood of your servants.

dag: Jɔn nyaandoliba maa ni daa kuli naai, ka Yisa piligi tɔɣisiri salo maa Jɔn yɛla ka bɔhiri ba, Bɔ ka yi daa lee chaŋ tiŋgban nɛli ni ni yi ti nya la? Gbiŋgban shɛli pɔhim ni ʒɛra?.
en: When Johns disciples had gone, Jesus spoke to the crowds about John: What did you go out to the wilderness to see? A stalk blowing in the wind?.

dag: Ka lala bindira maa ni nyɛ a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni bindira n-ʒiɛya gu yuma ayopɔin shɛŋa ni kum ni ti yɛn lu Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni maa, ka di chɛ ka kum ti ku ku tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ nima.
en: The food will be a reserve supply for the country during the seven years of famine which are going to come on Egypt. In this way the people will not starve.

dag: di yi pa lala, so yi wum li, o ni dih a vi, ka a yu saɣiŋgu ku mali tariga.
en: Others will find out, and your reputation will then be ruined.

dag: A kpahiri karimbaannim bɛn mali taali ka bi dol a zaligunim la zuɣu ni.
en: You punish those boastful, worthless nobodies who turn from your commands.

dag: Yawɛ, yiɣisim chaŋ a vuhim shee, a min a kpiɔŋ alikauli adaka maa.
en: Come to the Temple, Lord , with the Covenant Box, the symbol of your power, and stay here forever.

dag: Maligim daa yi ti luri bɛ biɛhigu maa shee yuŋ saha shɛli, ka manna maa gba dol li luri na.
en: The manna fell on the ground each night when the ground became wet with dew.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa yɛli Samuɛl, Kul suhimi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ tim ti, ka o fa ti Filistianim ŋɔ nuu ni bahi.
en: Don't stop praying! they told Samuel. Ask the Lord our God to rescue us.

dag: Ka shɛŋa lu tɛriŋ zuɣu luɣ shɛli tam ni bi zilim pam n-dii bilina yomyom, nimaani tam ni bi zilim zuɣu.
en: Other seed fell on rocky ground, where there was not enough dirt. It grew quickly there because the soil was not deep.

dag: Ka zaŋ di shɛli mihi sara maligu bimbini zuɣu ʒiibuyopɔin, ka booi kpam maa bahi sara maligu bimbini maa mini di zuɣu lahi ni di kɔniŋdi bini ni di naba zaashee zuɣu m-mali di zaa kasi.
en: He sprinkled the bronze altar seven times, and he sprinkled its equipment, as well as the large bronze bowl and its base.

dag: ninvuɣ biɛri suhupiɛlli daa bi yaɣi lala? A bi mi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi zɔri Naawuni kul dirila nyaɣisim saha biɛla kɔŋko?.
en: that sinful people are happy for only a while.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ku lan nya ʒii shɛŋa din nyɛ ʒiri ŋɔ bee n-tum buɣijɛmbo tuma. N ni tiligi n niriba yi nuu ni. Di saha ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will no longer let these women give false messages and use magic, and I will free my people from their control. Then they will know that I, the Lord , have done these things.

dag: ka daa tim ni bɛ cham sarika ni nti ŋma Jɔn zuɣu na.
en: He sent men to the prison, where they cut off Johns head.

dag: Dansarika so daa beni ka o yuli booni Barabas, ka o nyɛ bɛ ni mi so yɛla pam.
en: At that time there was a man in prison who was known to be very bad. His name was Barabbas.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Yisa daa ti be Naawuni jɛmbu duu wuhiri niriba, ka yihiri Naawuni lahibal suŋ waazu, ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba ni tiŋ maa ni kpamba ka o sanna.
en: On one of the days when Jesus was teaching the people in the temple and proclaiming the good news, the chief priests, legal experts, and elders approached him.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ bindirigu din mali nyɛvili n-yi alizanda ni na maa. Ka ŋunkam di bindirigu ŋɔ ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu; bindiri shɛli mi n ni yɛn zaŋ ti dunianima ka bɛ nya nyɛvili di zuɣu maa nyɛla n niŋgbuŋ.
en: I am that bread from heaven! Everyone who eats it will live forever. My flesh is the life-giving bread I give to the people of this world.

dag: Ka di daa gar o pam bɛ biɛhiŋ maa zuɣu. Di nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa yi nimaani chani gindi tiŋkpansi wuhiri niriba.
en: He was surprised that the people did not have any faith. Jesus taught in all the neighboring villages.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, a ni bi lihi nya Yawɛ ka tum tuun shɛli ŋɔ zuɣu, paɣ maa ni yɛn dɔɣi bi so ti a maa ni kpi.
en: But because you have shown such contempt for the Lord in doing this, your child will die.

dag: Ka n daa wum ka bɛ boli kalima maa yuli, Kalima din wari ginda.
en: I heard a voice calling out, Whirling wheels.

dag: Amaa a yi zaɣisi ni a ku zaŋ amaŋ ti ba, Yawɛ ni kahigi shɛli wuhi ma ʒii puuni m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: But the Lord has shown me that if you refuse to obey.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: M bi ʒe Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa ŋɔ nyaaŋa, n ni kabis o bɔɣiri din mali yaa mini din pun kabi la, ka chɛ ka takɔbi yi o nuu ni lu.
en: So now the LORD God proclaims: Im against Pharaoh, and I will break his arms, both the sound one and the broken one, and Ill make the sword fall out of his hand.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa yɛl o, Pumpɔŋɔ ti baŋya ni alizin biɛɣu n-shiri ʒi a zuɣu, dama ti yab Ibrahimma min anabinim zaa kpiya, ka nyin ti yɛli ni nir yi dol a yɛligu o ku kpi hal abada.
en: The Jewish opposition said to Jesus, Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham and the prophets died, yet you say, Whoever keeps my word will never die.

dag: O nyaandoliba maa ni daa nya o ka o tam kom zuɣu chani maa, ka dabiɛm gbahi ba pam, ka bɛ yɛri ni alizini m-bala, ka kuhi dabiɛm kuhigu.
en: When the disciples saw him walking on the lake, they were terrified and said, Its a ghost! They were so frightened they screamed.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl anabinim yino ni o yɛlim o kpee, Ŋmɛm ma. Amaa ka o kpee maa daa zaɣisi ni o ku ŋme o.
en: One of the prophets told another prophet, Hit me! He said that because the Lord had commanded it. But the other prophet refused to hit him.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔiada daa zali dunɔguliba Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa dunoya ni ni bɛ kariti bɛn bi be kasi.
en: Jehoiada also put guards on duty at the Temple gates to keep out anyone who was ritually unclean.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam chani yuŋ tuurimi, ka di nyɛla neesim ni kani zuɣu.
en: But if they walk during the night they stumble, because they have no light.

dag: Ka Baalihanan Akibɔr bia maa daa ti kpi, ka Hada daa di nam zan o zaani. O ya yuli n-daa booni Pau, ka o paɣ yuli daa booni Mɛhɛtabɛl. O daa nyɛla Mɛtirɛd bipuɣiŋga, ka nyɛ Mɛzahab yaaŋa.
en: After Baal-hanan, Achbors son, died, Hadar became king; his citys name was Pau and his wifes name was Mehetabel the daughter of Matred and granddaughter of Me-zahab.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛla ba, Di bi simdi ni bɛ chaŋ. Timiya ba bindirigu ka bɛ di.
en: Jesus replied, They don't have to leave. Why don't you give them something to eat.

dag: A chɛ ka mɔri zoori ka biŋkɔbiri ŋubira, ka chɛ bindira bimbilima ti ninsalinim ni bɛ kɔri li ka di yihiri bindirigu tiŋgban ni na.
en: You make grass grow for the cattle and plants for us to use, so that we can grow our crops.

dag: Dinzuɣu yihimiya dabin kura la yi sunsuuni din ni chɛ ka yi leei bɔrɔbɔro ziŋŋɔriti palli din ka dabindi kaman di ni simdi ni yi be shɛm. Dama Masia ŋun nyɛ ti Yaɣigari Chuɣu Piɛbil la pun zaŋ omaŋ mali sara.
en: Clean out the old yeast so you can be a new batch of dough, given that youre supposed to be unleavened bread. Christ our Passover lamb has been sacrificed.

dag: Ka malaika so gba daa yi alizanda ni Naawuni jɛmbu duu na n-gbibi gɔr dirili.
en: Then another angel came out of the temple in heaven, and he also had a sharp sickle.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum lala maa ka bɛ fo ka bembe nti gbaai Naawuni paɣibu yɛra, Dindina Naawuni n-chɛ ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim gba niŋ tuuba ni bɛ nya nyɛvili.
en: When they heard this, they stopped their criticism and praised God, saying, Then God has given to the Gentiles also the opportunity to repent and live.

dag: Ka Amnɔn daa zaŋ di yɛla muɣis omaŋ hal ti gbaai dɔro o tizɔpaɣ Tama maa zuɣu. Dama Tama daa na ʒi doo, ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka Amnɔn kɔŋ o ni yɛn niŋ o shɛm.
en: He was so much in love with her that he became sick, because it seemed impossible for him to have her; as a virgin, she was kept from meeting men.

dag: amaa n nya zaligu shɛli n niŋgbuŋ yaɣa puuni ka di mini n tɛha ni zaligu tuhiri taba n-zaŋ ma leeg alahichi din be n niŋgbuŋ yaɣa puuni maa dabili.
en: But in every part of me I discover something fighting against my mind, and it makes me a prisoner of sin that controls everything I do.

dag: Amaa nyin Yawɛ n-su nam sahakam. A nam kul ʒiɛla ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: But you rule forever, Lord . Your kingly chair lasts forever and ever.

dag: Yuun shɛli din pahiri yuma awɛi ni gol so ŋun pahiri pia la biɛɣu pia dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: Nine years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the Lord spoke to me on the tenth day of the tenth month. He said:.

dag: Daba ayopɔin maa dali, di simdi ni o pin o zuɣu min o teeŋkɔbiri ni o ninkari ni o niŋgbuŋ ni kɔbiri zaa. Di nyaaŋa ka o paɣ o situra ka su kom n-leei ŋun yi daɣiri ni.
en: On the seventh day, the person must shave off all their hair again: head, beard, and eyebrows—everything. They must wash their clothes and bathe in water; then they will be clean again.

dag: Ka saa nyaɣisibu mini saa tahibu ni kukoya vuri pam yiri nam ʒiishee maa gbin na; ka buɣim mokpala ayopɔin din nyɛ Naawuni shih ayopɔin la sa nam ʒiishee maa tooni dira.
en: From the throne came flashes of lightning, rumblings, and peals of thunder. In front of the throne seven lighted torches were burning, which are the seven spirits of God.

dag: Akasia dari ka o daa zaŋ mali dapuhi maa, ka niŋ daanya niŋ li.
en: He made the poles out of acacia wood, and he covered them with copper.

dag: Dinzuɣu m bia, pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ ni be a sani ka ni chɛ ka a nya nasara Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu maa mɛbu ni kaman o ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ a polo.
en: David continued, Now, son, may the Lord your God be with you, and may he keep his promise to make you successful in building a temple for him.

dag: O daa chɛ ka sagbana bɔɣi ka o siɣina; ka zibisim titali be o naba tiŋli.
en: You opened the heavens like curtains, and you came down with storm clouds under your feet.

dag: N ni ti filim yi bɔrɔbɔro zaɣa, ka paɣiba pia ni ti mali yi bɔrɔbɔro dubil yini puuni, ka ti filim yi bɔrɔbɔro maa tibisim, ka yi ti ŋub li ka bi tiɣi.
en: You will have such a shortage of bread, that ten women will be able to bake their bread in the same oven. Each of you will get only a few crumbs, and you will go hungry.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni ti zaŋ o daŋ niriba mini bɛ bihi ni bɛ yaansi zaa ʒili nyaɣil o m-pahi lahi balibu kam, din nyɛ pipihi zaŋ tabili lahi ni duɣ bihi zaa.
en: But all his relatives and dependents will become a burden to him. They will hang on him like pots and bowls hanging from a peg!.

dag: Biŋkpila maa daa tamla daantalis ayi la zuɣu, ka be duu maa gɔŋbu shee zuɣusaa lansi luɣili ni, ka pumpɔrinchihi kɔbisiyi kulis ayi gili biŋkpil yini, ka lan gili biŋkpil din la gba lala.
en: Above the round-shaped part and next to the network were two hundred pomegranates. These were placed in rows around both of the capitals on top of the columns.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa nim daa yina ka bɛ mini Jɔab ti zaŋ nya taba, ka Dauda tɔbbihi maa shɛb daa lu nimaani, ka bɛ daa ku Yuria ŋun nyɛ Hiti nir la gba nimaani.
en: The men of the city came out to fight against Joab. Some of Davids men were killed. Uriah the Hittite was one of them.

dag: Ka daa lan zaŋ nimaani hal ti paai Jafilɛtinim tiŋgban ni n-zaŋ lala hal ti paai Bɛtihɔrɔnnim tiŋgbani din daa be zolɔŋni la m-mali lala hal ni Gɛza n-yi nimaani chaŋ ti naai Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku ni.
en: Then the border went west to the border of the Japhletites. The border continued to Lower Beth Horon. Then the border went to Gezer and continued to the Mediterranean Sea.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti lan lab bɛ sanna pahi buta m-bɔhi ba, Yinima na kul gbihirimi ka vuhiri jɛlinsi? Di saɣ lala, saha maa paaya; so pun yi Daadam Bia nyaaŋa ka zaŋ o niŋ alahichinim nuu ni.
en: When Jesus returned to the disciples the third time, he said, Are you still sleeping and resting? Enough of this! The time has come for the Son of Man to be handed over to sinners.

dag: Yi yaannim ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni dahin shɛl la hal ni zuŋɔ n kul timdila n daba zaa bɛn nyɛ anabinim la yi sanna dabisili kam.
en: Ever since your ancestors left Egypt, I have been sending my servants the prophets to speak for me.

dag: Dama buɣim daa yi Hɛshibɔn na, ka buɣim niɛm daa yi Sihɔn fɔŋ ni na. Di daa di Ar din be Mɔab la, ka di Arinɔn zoya zuɣu.
en: A fire began in Heshbon. That fire began in Sihons city. The fire destroyed Ar in Moab. It burned the hills above Arnon River.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka n daa chaŋ yaɣimɛra maa yiŋa ka o ti bela yaɣiri mɛbu ni.
en: I went there and saw the potter making clay pots on his pottery wheel.

dag: Dinzuɣu lala n-nyɛ li. Yi gba yi niŋ bɛ ni wuhi ya ni yi niŋ shɛm zaa yin yɛlimiya, Ti bi simdi paɣibu, dama ti tuma ni nyɛ shɛli ka ti tum maa. .
en: It is the same with you. When you finish doing all that you are told to do, you should say, We are not worthy of any special thanks. We have only done the work we should do.

dag: Bom sipirɛs dari din mali kpiɔŋ mali ŋariŋ, ka niŋ duri niŋ di ni, ka bo diɣiri n-tabilitabili di puuni mini di nyaaŋa.
en: Build a boat for yourself out of good timber; make rooms in it and cover it with tar inside and out.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ jɛlinsi lu a zuɣu n-fa a ni tum tuma nya binshɛŋa la zaa, ka chɛ a zaɣ nɛli. Ka a pagɔrisigu tuma la yi palo. A kɔre min a pagɔrisigu tuma maa.
en: And they will show how much they hate you! They will take everything you worked for, and they will leave you bare and naked! People will clearly see your sins. They will see that you acted like a prostitute and dreamed wicked dreams.

dag: Amaa di liɣisibu maa yi kul kpalim be luɣ yini, ka bi yɛligi gil o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ zuɣu, amaa ka sabigi, di nyɛla bimmɔriŋ din yi buɣim yum maa ni na, ka di simdi ni maligumaana maa yɛli ni o nyɛla ŋun ka daɣiri ni, dama di nyɛla buɣim wuliɛɣu.
en: But if the bright spot has not spread on the skin but has faded, it is only a scar from the burn. The priest must announce that the person is clean.

dag: Ka di daa gari bɛ zaa, ka bɛ paɣir o yɛtɔɣ suma din yi o nol ni na maa zuɣu, ka bɔhiri taba, Pa Yisifu dapal la m-bala.
en: Everyone was raving about Jesus, so impressed were they by the gracious words flowing from his lips. They said, This is Josephs son, isnt it.

dag: Bɛ ni ti yɛli, Kulla Yawɛ kɔŋko sani ka wuntia ni kpiɔŋ be. Amaa ŋunkam zaa je ma ni di vi.
en: They will say that only through me are victory and strength to be found; but all who hate me will suffer disgrace.

dag: N zaŋla n nina kpa a jɛmbu duu la, ka gbani paɣ a yuli a yurilim maŋli la min a ʒiɛyimtali la zuɣu, dama a duh a yuli min a yɛligu gari shɛlikam.
en: I worship at your holy temple and praise you for your love and your faithfulness. You were true to your word and made yourself more famous than ever before.

dag: Di saha ka Gomna Pailɛt daa chɛ ka bɛ fiɛb Yisa.
en: Then Pilate ordered that Jesus be taken away and whipped.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Naa Dauda daa yɛli Yila litaafi puuni yil shɛl ni: A ku chɛ ka a ninvuɣ gahindili niŋgbuŋ pooi.
en: In another place it is said, You will not let your holy one experience deaths decay. .

dag: Di saha ka Asiria naa maa daa yɛl o niriba, Zaŋmiya maligumaaniba shɛb yi ni daa ʒi nimaani na la yino n-labisi ni, ka o ti be nimaani wuhiri ba tiŋgbɔŋ maa tiŋgbani zaligu.
en: So the emperor commanded: Send back one of the priests we brought as prisoners; have him go back and live there, in order to teach the people the law of the god of that land.

dag: Gomna Fɛstus min o kpamba ni daa niŋ tab saawara naai ka o yɛli Pool, A yɛliya ni a ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣa maa chaŋla Naa Siiza sani. Dindina Naa Siiza sani ka a shiri ni bahi chaŋ.
en: After Festus had talked this over with members of his council, he told Paul, You have asked to be tried by the Emperor, and to the Emperor you will go.

dag: Di saha ka anabi ninkurili maa yɛl o, Man gba nyɛla anabi kaman a ni nyɛ anabi shɛm maa; ka Yawɛ chɛ ka malaika yɛli ma, Cham ti zaŋ anab maa n-lab a yiŋa ka o ti di bindirigu ka nyu kom. .
en: The old prophet lied to him and said, But I am a prophet like you. And an angel from the Lord came to me and told me to bring you home and give you something to eat and drink.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔhi nachimbil so ŋun daa yɛl o li maa, Tiŋ kani ka a lee yina? Ka o garigi yɛl o, N nyɛla Amalɛk saan so ŋun be a tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni bia.
en: Then David talked with the young soldier who had told him about Sauls death. David asked, Where are you from? The young soldier answered, I am the son of a foreigner. I am an Amalekite.

dag: ni Bɛtimaakabɔt ni Hazarisusim ni Bɛtibiri ni Shaaraim. Bɛ fɔntinsi ni daa nyɛ tiŋ shɛŋa m-bala hal ka Dauda ti naanyi di nam.
en: Beth Marcaboth, Hazarsusim, Bethbiri, and Shaaraim.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Jɛrusalɛm be kaman wain pipia la, ka zuliya kam bɛn gil li nyu li n-jeeni kaman danyuriba bɛn nyu m-buɣ la. Ka bɛ yi ti teei gili Jɛrusalɛm, bɛ ni teei gili Juda tinsi la gba.
en: I will make Jerusalem like a cup of wine; the nations around her will drink and stagger like drunks. And when they besiege Jerusalem, the cities of the rest of Judah will also be besieged.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni amaŋmaŋ gba tumdi tuun suma, ka di wuhi bɛn kpalim la din simdi niŋbu ni nyɛ shɛli binshɛɣukam puuni. Mali biɛri suŋ mini maŋgbibbu a wuhibu puuni.
en: You should be an example for them in every way by the good things you do. When you teach, be honest and serious.

dag: Abigeel n-daa dɔɣi Amasa, Amasa ba n-daa nyɛ Jɛta ŋun daa nyɛ Ishimail zuliya ni nir la.
en: His other daughter Abigail married Jether, a descendant of Ishmael, and they had a son named Amasa.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla dunia ŋɔ niriba, dinzuɣu ka bɛ tɔɣisiri dunia ŋɔ yɛla, ka dunia ŋɔ nim wumdi tiri ba.
en: Those false prophets speak about matters of the world, and the world listens to them because they belong to the world.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Bɔhimi ba. Niriba yi lu, bɛ bi lan yiɣisir yaha? Ka bee bɛ yi birigi kpe yɔɣu, bɛ bi lan labirina?.
en: The Lord said: People of Jerusalem, when you stumble and fall, you get back up, and if you take a wrong road, you turn around and go back.

dag: Ka o daa zani, ka dunia dam. Ka o daa lihi, ka niriba ni sɔhira. Ka kurimbuni ha zoya la wurim, ka o kurimbuni ha daboya din nyɛ o so kurisi la firi.
en: He stood and judged the earth. He looked at the people of all the nations, and they shook with fear. For many years the mountains stood strong, but those mountains fell to pieces. Those old, old hills fell down. God has always been able to do that.

dag: A tɛhiya ni n ku tooi suhi m Ba Naawuni ka o tim malaikanim tusatusa shɛm n sanna pumpɔŋɔ?.
en: Surely you know I could ask my Father and he would give me more than twelve armies of angels.

dag: n-nyo di zaa buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu, dama di nyɛla sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim tiri Yawɛ ka di nyom nyɛ din tiɣir o nini.
en: Burn the whole ram on the altar as a food offering. The odor of this offering pleases me.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli naa N ni daa be n ya ka wum a tuma min a yɛm yɛla shɛm maa shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: The report I heard about your deeds and wisdom when I was still at home is true, she said to the king.

dag: Firawuna daa lan niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni o ku chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa chaŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun chɛ ka Musa yɛli shɛm la.
en: that he refused to let the Israelites go. This was exactly what the Lord had said would happen.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Bɛ yi kanimina ni bɛ ti tuhi ti bee bɛ yi kanimina ni bɛ ti niŋ sandaani niŋ ti yin gbahimiya ba zaɣ nɛma.
en: So Ben-Hadad said, They might be coming to fight or they might be coming to ask for peace. Capture them alive.

dag: Yi kul tɛhirimi ni ti zabirila timaŋ zuɣu yi sani? M mabiyurisi, Naawuni sani, Masia zuɣu ka ti kul tɔɣisira, ka di zaa nyɛla yi kpaŋsibu zuɣu.
en: Have you been thinking up to now that we are defending ourselves to you? Actually, we are speaking in the sight of God and in Christ. Dear friends, everything is meant to build you up.

dag: Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba, Dinzuɣu n yɛri ya mi, miriya ka yi jiɣindi yi nyɛviya bee yi niŋgbuna zuɣu zaŋ chaŋ yi ni yɛn di shɛli bee yi ni yɛn ye shɛli polo;.
en: Then Jesus said to his disciples, Therefore, I say to you, dont worry about your life, what you will eat, or about your body, what you will wear.

dag: Ka malaika maa bɔhi ma, Bɔ ka a lee nya maa? Ka n garigi yɛli, N nyala gbaŋ ka di be pɔhim ni yiɣira, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita awɛi, ka di yɛliŋ mi nyɛ mita anahi ni pirigili.
en: and the angel asked, What do you see? A flying scroll, I answered. About nine meters long and four and a half meters wide.

dag: Jɛmmiya Yawɛ ni suhupiɛlli! Yilimiya yila ka o sanna!.
en: Be happy as you serve the Lord ! Come before him with happy songs!.

dag: Ka Sintani garigi yɛli Yawɛ, Nyɛvili bi ʒir ka dimsira! Ninsal ni zaŋ o ni mali binshɛɣukam zaa taɣi o nyɛvili.
en: Satan replied, A person will give up everything in order to stay alive.

dag: Dama pumpɔŋɔ n ni chɛ ka n daalɔbɔnim lu amaŋmaŋ min a kpamba ni a niriba zaa zuɣu din ni chɛ ka a baŋ ni n kpee ka dunia yili zaa.
en: This time I will punish not only your officials and your people, but I will punish you as well, so that you may know that there is no one like me in all the world.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, N yɛri ya la dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ni yi di ti birigi.
en: I have told you this, so that you will not give up your faith.

dag: Ibrahimma n-daa da palo maa Hitinim sani. Nimaani ka bɛ daa sɔɣi Ibrahimma min o paɣ Zara.
en: This is the same cave that Abraham bought from the Hittites. He was buried there with his wife Sarah.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyamiya n ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu lu tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ mini di niriba zuɣu din nyɛ yɛl biɛ shɛŋa zaa din sabi kundi shɛli bɛ ni karim wuhi Juda naa maa ni la.
en: the following message from the Lord : I am going to punish Jerusalem and all its people with the curses written in the book that was read to the king.

dag: Siɣisimiya yimaŋ be baalim, ka mali suɣilo sahakam. Dimiya suɣilo zaŋ chaŋ yi tab polo yurilim puuni.
en: Always be humble and gentle. Be patient and accept each other with love.

dag: Tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ti sɔɣi ba din ni chɛ ka bɛ nya jilima dahin shɛli n ni ti yɛn wuhi ba n jilima ni nyɛ shɛm maa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Everyone in the land will help bury them, and they will be honored for this on the day of my victory. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka Hatak daa chaŋ ti yɛli Ɛsta Mɔdɛkai ni yɛl o shɛm maa.
en: Hathach came back and told Esther what Mordecai had said.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ n Naa ni n Naawuni ŋun chɛ ka Yaakubu zuliya di nasara gbaliŋ ŋɔ.
en: God, you are my king. Give the command and lead Jacobs people to victory.

dag: Bɛ ni teei gili yinim ninvuɣ shɛb ŋɔ, kpuɣimiya yi daadiikunim tiŋgban ni.
en: Pack your bags and get ready to leave, you who live under siege.

dag: Ka dilan yi ku tooi nyaŋ ŋmanʒiɛh ayi bee yiŋ ŋmambihi ayi maa, ŋun bom zim viɛlli kilɔgiram yini na ti mali sara o ni tum alahichi shɛli maa zuɣu. O di ti niŋ kpam bee firanki tulaale zim pa di zuɣu, dama di nyɛla alahichi sanyoo sara maligu.
en: If you are so poor that you cannot afford doves or pigeons, you may bring one kilogram of your finest flour. This is a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness, so don't sprinkle olive oil or sweet-smelling incense on it.

dag: Ti Duuma Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Tinzunnim bɛn zaa be Izraɛlnim sani, ka nyɛ bɛn bi guni bɛ suhuri ni mini bɛ niŋgbuna ni la bi simdi ni bɛ kpe n jɛmbu duu puuni.
en: And so I, the Lord God, say that no godless foreigner who disobeys me will be allowed in my temple. This includes any foreigner living in Israel.

dag: Amaa ka ŋariŋ maa zuɣu polo daa chaŋ ti firi bihigu ni ka di tarigi chandi, ka kɔgbana daa ŋmɛri di nyaaŋa polo hal ka di ti ŋma n-chɛrisichɛrisi.
en: But the ship hit a sandbank. The front of the ship stuck there and could not move. Then the big waves began to break the back of the ship to pieces.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ, dama o viɛla. Yilimiya yila paɣ o yuli, dama o nyɛla ŋun niŋdi nirilim.
en: come and shout praises. Praise the name of the Lord ! He is kind and good.

dag: ni ashaara dali ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn tiligirimi, ka nyari faako suhuyiɣisili dali?.
en: On the day of disaster the wicked are spared; on the day of fury they are rescued.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri ni nya li ka bɛ suhuri yiɣisi; bɛ ni ti dim bɛ nyina ka bahi yoli; ninvuɣ biɛri suhuri ni ye shɛli zuɣu ni kpalim yoli.
en: The wicked see all this and fume; they grind their teeth, but disappear to nothing. What the wicked want to see happen comes to nothing!.

dag: Bɛ daa sɔɣila Abinɛr Hiburɔn, ka naa daa yaag o noli kum pam Abinɛr gballi maa gbini, ka niriba maa zaa gba daa kum pam.
en: They buried Abner in Hebron. The king wept loudly at Abners grave. All the troops cried too.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, A nini ni nya ma zuɣu ka a niŋ yɛda? Amaa bɛn nini bi nya ma ka niŋ yɛda mal alibarika.
en: Jesus said to him, You believe because you see me. Great blessings belong to the people who believe without seeing me.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti gari dunoya ayi shɛŋa dunɔguliba ni daa ʒiɛya guli maa zuɣu, bɛ daa mali ti paala kurigu dunoli din yiri kpɛri tiŋ maa puuni. Ka di daa yooi di toli, ka bɛ yi n-doli solɔɣu chaŋ ha ka malaika maa ti dii chɛ o ka chaŋ.
en: They passed by the first guard station and then the second, and came at last to the iron gate that opens into the city. The gate opened for them by itself, and they went out. They walked down a street, and suddenly the angel left Peter.

dag: Di saha paɣipuhinim mini biliɛrinim yɛla ni ti mali nambɔɣu pam.
en: During that time it will be hard for women who are pregnant or have small babies!.

dag: Ka doo maa daa ti lan yiɣisi ni o kuli, ka o deemba maa lan balim o hal ka o ti lan gbe yaha.
en: The Levite tried to leave, but his father-in-law insisted, and he spent one more night there.

dag: Miri ka a di jɛrigu alizama, o ni lihi ʒiɛm a yɛm yɛtɔɣa maa.
en: Don't try to talk sense to a fool; he can't appreciate it.

dag: Ka nyuli zabbu mini diribarilim tɛha ni be shɛli, nimaani ka chirachira mini tuumbiɛri balibu kam tumbu be.
en: Where there is jealousy and selfishness, there is also disorder and every kind of evil.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti diri bindirigu saha shɛli, bɛ nini nyabu yim ka tiŋ maa ni ninvuɣ galima shɛb daa ti kana ti teei gili yili maa kpahiri di dunoli ka yɛri ninkurigu ŋun nyɛ yil maa lan maa, Zaŋm do so ŋun kpe a yili ŋɔ na la ti ti ka ti gol o.
en: They were enjoying themselves when all of a sudden some sexual perverts from the town surrounded the house and started beating on the door. They said to the old man, Bring out that man that came home with you! We want to have sex with him.

dag: Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi baŋ din be daadam suhu ni ka pa ni daadam maŋmaŋ shia din be o ni maa zuɣu? Lala ka so gba ku tooi baŋ din be Naawuni suhu ni ka pa ni Naawuni Shia Kasi zuɣu.
en: It is only our own spirit within us that knows all about us; in the same way, only God's Spirit knows all about God.

dag: Ka Nikɔdimus bɔh o, Wula ka dimbɔŋɔ ni tooi nani.
en: How can this be? Nicodemus asked.

dag: ka zooi kaman tia ni zoori shɛm. A daa zooya niŋ wɔɣilim m-bi paɣa. A daa yi biha, ka a tooni bili kɔbiri, amaa a daa na bela a zaɣim.
en: I took care of you, like someone caring for a tender, young plant. You grew up to be a beautiful young woman with mature breasts and hair, but you were still naked.

dag: Zuɣusaa nyɛla din wuhiri Naawuni jilima! Ka sagbana wuhir o nuhi tuma!.
en: The heavens keep telling the wonders of God, and the skies declare what he has done.

dag: Dama o chɛ ka sanʒiɛɣu ʒe n-kabisi ma, ka kul chɛ ka n dansi pahira, ka di ka daliri.
en: He sends storms to batter and bruise me without any reason at all.

dag: Ka paɣ so yi yila o yidana yiŋa, ŋun kpalimmi ʒiya; ka di yi pa lala, ŋun niŋmi sandaani niŋ o yidan kuro maa, ka lan lab o yiŋa. Ka doo mi miri ka o yih o paɣa.
en: But if a wife does leave, she should remain single or get back together with her husband. And a husband should not divorce his wife.

dag: Miriya ka yi jɛm ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gili ya ŋɔ zaa wuna.
en: Don't have anything to do with gods that are worshiped by the nations around you.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka neesim shɛŋa din be zuɣusaa zaa niŋ liɣa a zuɣusaa, ka chɛ ka tiŋgbɔŋ zibigi. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will darken the lights in the sky over you. I will make your whole country dark. This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: ka Zakaria daa nyɛ Iddo daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma; ka Mɛshulam so mi daa nyɛ Ginnɛtɔn daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma;.
en: of Iddo, Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka ti paai Sidɔn, ka sapashini Julius daa niŋ Pool nirilim wɔɣis o ka o chaŋ o zɔnim sani ka bɛ ti niŋ o saani.
en: The next day we came to the city of Sidon. Julius was very good to Paul and gave him freedom to go visit his friends there, who gave him whatever he needed.

dag: ka yɛra, Nyin ŋun wurindi Naawuni jɛmbu duu ka lan mɛri li daba ata sunsuuni ŋɔ, tiligim amaŋa! A yi shiri nyɛla Naawuni Bia, nyin siɣim dapulli maa zuɣu na.
en: You were going to tear down the Temple and build it back up in three days! Save yourself if you are God's Son! Come on down from the cross.

dag: N tiligim ba kpiimba biɛhigu shee chandi? N tiligim ba kum ni? Nyin kum, a daalɔbɔnim la lee be ya? Nyin kpiimba biɛhigu shee, a bahiyol la lee be ya? N nini bi lan zɔri nambɔɣu.
en: I will not save this people from the world of the dead or rescue them from the power of death. Bring on your plagues, death! Bring on your destruction, world of the dead! I will no longer have pity for this people.

dag: Amaa a na kul duhirila amaŋa n niriba sani, ka zaɣisi ni a ku chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: Yet you are still arrogant and refuse to let my people go.

dag: N daa lan nya nahiŋgu shɛŋa din be dunia ŋɔ ni. N daa nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari nahiŋgu maa ni kumdi shɛm, ka ka ŋun goori ba. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nahindi ba maa daa mali yiko pam, dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa ka ŋun ni gooi ba maa.
en: Then I looked again at all the injustice that goes on in this world. The oppressed were crying, and no one would help them. No one would help them, because their oppressors had power on their side.

dag: Saɣimmiya yi ni yɛn kari ninvuɣ shɛb ka deei bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa buɣa jɛmbu shee zaa, din be zoya zuɣu mini daboya zuɣu ni ti maha gbina ni zaa.
en: But the nations that live there worship other gods. So after you capture the land, you must completely destroy their places of worship—on mountains and hills or in the shade of large trees.

dag: Ka Musa daa chɛ ka bɛ moli molo gili bɛ sansani maa ni zaa yɛli, Doo bee paɣa miri ka o lan niŋ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ bɛ suhuyubu pin shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋdi na ni bɛ ti zaŋ tum luɣ kasi shee tuma la polo. Ka bɛ daa gooi niriba maa ka bɛ bi lan zaŋdi pina maa na.
en: Then Moses sent this message throughout the camp: No man or woman should make anything else as a gift for the holy place. So the people were forced to stop giving more.

dag: M bi sabiri dimbɔŋɔ ni n dihi ya la vi, amaa n sab li mi ni n saɣisi ya yi ni nyɛ m biyurisi la zuɣu.
en: I write this to you, not because I want to make you feel ashamed, but to instruct you as my own dear children.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa na ti ti Musa, ka daa lan zaŋ suɣili maa mini di nɛma zaa ni di bansi ni di dapaɣa ni di dapuhi ni di daantalisi mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu.
en: Then they brought to Moses the dwelling, the tent, and all its equipment: its clasps, its boards, its bars, its posts, and its bases.

dag: Ka yi gba daa tumdila lala yi ni daa siɣi ʒe di puuni saha shɛl la.
en: And this is exactly what you did, when you lived among people who behaved in this way.

dag: Yaɣigari Chuɣu kam puhibu saha daa yi ti paai, Gomna Pailɛt yihirila dansarika so niriba ni bɔri bahi.
en: Every year at the Passover time the governor would free one prisoner—whichever one the people wanted.

dag: Bɛrɔtnim maa daa zo n-chaŋla Giteem nti ʒini nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Its original inhabitants had fled to Gittaim, where they have lived ever since.

dag: ni Zabad ni Shutɛla ni Ɛzɛr mini Ɛliad bɛn daa chaŋ ni bɛ ti taɣi Gaatinim niɣi chaŋ ka bɛ ku ba.
en: Zabad, Shuthelah. Ephraim had two other sons besides Shuthelah: Ezer and Elead, who were killed when they tried to steal the livestock belonging to the native inhabitants of Gath.

dag: Di saha ka Dan zuliya bɛn daa be nyaaŋa ka nyɛ niriba maa zaa guliba la daa yiɣisi paya. Ammishadai bia Ahiɛza n-daa nyɛ bɛ zaa zuɣulana;.
en: Dan and the tribes that camped alongside it were to protect the Israelites against an attack from behind, and so they marched last, carrying their banner. Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai was the leader of the tribe of Dan.

dag: Ka na palo daa ti di Ijipti, ŋun daa bi mi Yisifu.
en: Then, a new king, who knew nothing about Joseph, came to power in Egypt.

dag: Sool gbaɣinɔʒiri maa ni daa nya ka Sool kpi maa, ka o gba lu o takɔbi zuɣu kpi m-pah o zuɣu.
en: When the soldier knew that Saul was dead, he killed himself in the same way.

dag: Di nyaaŋa, ka o kɔrigi niriba maa daalahichi sanyoo sara bulaa la, ka zaŋ o ʒim maa kpe pateesa maa puuni na nti niŋ kaman o ni niŋ naɣilaa maa ʒim shɛm maa, ka zaŋ li mihi adaka pindigu la zuɣusaa mini adaka maa tooni.
en: After that, he shall kill the goat for the sin offering for the people, bring its blood into the Most Holy Place, and sprinkle it on the lid and then in front of the Covenant Box, as he did with the bull's blood.

dag: Yawɛ, teem a nambɔzɔbo min a yurilim maŋli la yɛla; dama di nyɛla din daa pun beni kurimbuni ha.
en: LORD, remember your compassion and faithful love— they are forever!.

dag: A kɔŋko ka n tum alahichi maa, ka tum din nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu a sani. Dinzuɣu a niŋ din tuhi, a ni wuhi ni m mali taali la puuni; a ka galimi a ni kari ma saria shɛm maa gba puuni.
en: I did what you said is wrong. You are the one I have sinned against. I say this so that people will know that I am wrong and you are right. What you decided is fair.

dag: N ni ti ba nyɛvil wɔɣinli; ka wuhi ba n tiliginsim.
en: You will live a long life and see my saving power.

dag: Di saha naa maa daa tɔɣisirila Gɛhaazi ŋun daa nyɛ Naawuni nir maa sɔŋda la yɛtɔɣa n-yɛr o, Yɛlim ma Ilaisha ni daa tum tuun kar shɛŋa zaa yɛla.
en: Meanwhile, the king was asking Gehazi the servant of Elisha about the amazing things Elisha had been doing.

dag: Yɛndan yɛtɔɣa ŋmanila wɔhu chɛmi; ka piɛgul yɛtɔɣ ŋaha mi ŋmani kuriti kpa shɛŋa bɛ ni kpahi ka di kpaŋ zani.
en: Words from the wise are like sharp goads. When these sayings are written down and saved, they can be used to guide people, just as a shepherd uses a sharp stick to make his sheep go the right way.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Di shihi ma; dama n na bi chaŋ m Ba sani. Amaa cham m mabihi la sani nti yɛli ba ni n chanila m Ba ŋun nyɛ yi gba Ba la ni n Naawuni ŋun nyɛ yi gba Naawuni la sani.
en: Jesus said to her, Dont hold on to me, for I havent yet gone up to my Father. Go to my brothers and sisters and tell them, Im going up to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa tim Taai nti zaŋ Huram na.
en: Then King Solomon sent a message and brought Hiram from Tyre.

dag: Yaakubu daa yɔhim Leeban ŋun daa nyɛ Aram nir maa, o ni daa bi yɛl o ŋun Yaakubu ni daa lo ni o yiɣisi nimaani la zuɣu.
en: Jacob tricked Laban the Aramean by not saying that he intended to leave.

dag: N daa yɛlimi, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋun su alizanda ŋɔ, a nyɛla Naawuni ŋun galisi, ka a yɛla mali dabiɛm pam. A nyɛla ŋun ʒe yim ni a ni lo alikauli shɛli zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yur a ka dol a zaligunim polo.
en: Lord God of heaven, you are great and fearsome. And you faithfully keep your promises to everyone who loves you and obeys your commands.

dag: Amaa m mali piɛ shɛba ka bɛ ka buzɔŋ ŋɔ ni, faashee m bahi zaŋ ba na ka bɛ gba ti baŋ n kukoli, ka di chɛ ka piɛgul yino mini buzɔn yini kɔŋko beni.
en: There are other sheep which belong to me that are not in this sheep pen. I must bring them, too; they will listen to my voice, and they will become one flock with one shepherd.

dag: Shilo zuliya ni mi, Asaaya n-daa nyɛ kpɛma nti pahi o bidibisi zuɣu.
en: From the Shilonites: Asaiah the oldest son and his family.

dag: Ŋunkam niŋ Bia maa yɛda mali nyɛvili din ka bahigu; ka ŋunkam mi bi deei Bia maa noli ku nya nyɛvili, amaa ka Naawuni suhu kul ni yiɣisiri bahir o zuɣu.
en: Whoever believes in the Son has eternal life. Whoever doesnt believe in the Son wont see life, but the angry judgment of God remains on them.

dag: Ka o yi zaŋ o puu ti Yawɛ yi nɛma labisi ti yuuni puuni yi ni zal li da shɛli, di daa n-kul yɛn bala.
en: If this promise is made in the Year of Celebration, the land will be valued at the full price.

dag: Ti kul suhiri Naawuni tiri yi zaa, ka kul paɣiri Naawuni yi zuɣu sahakam;.
en: We always thank God for all of you when we mention you constantly in our prayers.

dag: A ni daa na bi kɔhi li la, pa nyini n-daa su li? Ka a ni kɔhi li maa, pa nyini n-na kul su di liɣiri maa? Ka bɔzuɣu ka a zaŋ tɛha ŋɔ tatabo kpɛh a suhu ni? Ka yɛl o, Pa ninsalinim ka a ŋma ʒiri maa, amaa Naawuni maŋmaŋa.
en: Wasnt that property yours to keep? After you sold it, wasnt the money yours to do with whatever you wanted? What made you think of such a thing? You havent lied to other people but to God.

dag: Piɛguliba ni ti zaŋ bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu kana ti lu o zuɣu. Bɛ ni ti ti bɛ suɣa gil o. Bɛ ni ti ŋubi bɛ ni be luɣ shɛlikam mɔri.
en: kings will camp there with their armies. They will pitch their tents around the city, and each of them will camp wherever they want.

dag: Tiŋ maa ni paɣ tuumbiɛrilan so ni daa wum ni Yisa be Farisii maa yiŋa n-diri bindirigu maa ka o zaŋ luɣilu viɛlli din pali tulaale.
en: There was a sinful woman in that town. She knew that Jesus was eating at the Pharisees house. So the woman brought some expensive perfume in an alabaster jar.

dag: Yawɛ kukoli vuri chɛ ka mɔɣu ni damda. Yawɛ chɛ ka Kadɛshi mɔɣu ni dam.
en: and the desert tremble. And because of the Lord , the desert near Kadesh shivers and shakes.

dag: Yawɛ chɛ ka o ni yɛn ti a bi shɛba, ka paɣisarili ŋɔ dɔɣi ba ti a ni nyɛla bɛn ni ti chɛ ka a zuliya bemi kaman Pɛrɛz, Tama ni dɔɣ so ti Juda la.
en: May the Lord bless you with many children through Ruth. May your family become great like the family of Perez, the son Tamar bore for Judah.

dag: Hiram daa lan yɛli, Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun nam zuɣusaa ni dunia, ka nyɛ ŋun ti Naa Dauda bi so ŋun mali baŋsim mini yɛm, ka lan mi tuma viɛnyɛliŋga, din ni me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ka lan me omaŋmaŋ nam yili ŋɔ.
en: Praise the Lord God of Israel, Creator of heaven and earth! He has given King David a wise son, full of understanding and skill, who now plans to build a temple for the Lord and a palace for himself.

dag: Niriba maa daa jɛmdi Yawɛ, ka daa lan pii bɛ ni ninvuɣ shɛba n-leei maligumaaniba ka bɛ maani maligu bɛ ni jɛmdi buɣa luɣ shɛŋa la tiri ba.
en: They also worshipped the LORD, but they appointed priests for the shrines from their whole population. These priests worked in the houses at the shrines.

dag: Di bi simdi ka a nya a ʒiʒiinikpee buŋa bee o nahu ni lu n-do sol ni ka a baɣa kani, di simdi ni a sɔŋ yiɣis o zali.
en: If an Israelite's donkey or cow has fallen down, don't ignore it; help him get the animal to its feet again.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Asiria naa polo m-bɔŋɔ: O ku kpe tiŋ ŋɔ ni na bee n-to piɛm di ni bee ka o tɔbbihi ti gbib nyɔtaɣirisi kpe di ni bee ka bɛ ti me bimbin dura gil li.
en: I promise that the king of Assyria won't get into Jerusalem, or shoot an arrow into the city, or even surround it and prepare to attack.

dag: Ka bɛ sɔŋdi taba, ka yɛra, M mali suhukpeeni.
en: Worshipers of idols comfort each other, saying, Don't worry.

dag: O chɛ ka n dooni momaha ni. O zaŋdi ma tahiri kom din do baalim shee.
en: He lets me rest in fields of green grass and leads me to quiet pools of fresh water.

dag: Paɣiba maa ni daa ŋmaligi chani maa, di saha ka siliga maa guliba maa ni shɛb daa chaŋ tiŋ puuni ti yɛli maligumaaniba kpamba dinkam zaa daa niŋ maa yɛla.
en: Now as the women were on their way, some of the guards came into the city and told the chief priests everything that had happened.

dag: Miri ka a bɔri ni yuŋ zibi din nyɛ din ʒiri niriba chani la.
en: nor can you find safety in the dark world below.

dag: Naa Hɛzɛkia ni daa wum yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, o daa dari tɔhila o binyɛra, ka zaŋ buɣu ye n-chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu.
en: As soon as King Hezekiah heard their report, he tore his clothes in grief, put on sackcloth, and went to the Temple of the Lord .

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, A ni yɛli shɛm maa n-nyɛ li. Amaa n yɛri ya mi ni dahin shɛli yi ni ti nya Daadam Bia ka o ʒila Yiko Zaa Naa nudirigu polo m-be sagbana ni kanna.
en: Jesus answered, Yes, thats right. But I tell you, in the future you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right side of God. And you will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven.

dag: M pun yɛl a, Chɛ ka m bia maa chaŋ ti jɛm ma, ka a zaɣisi ni a ku chɛ ka o chaŋ, dinzuɣu n ni ku a bidib kpɛma.
en: and I commanded you to release him, so he could worship me. But you refused, and now I will kill your first-born son.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, Jɔn Baptaizira gari paɣ ni dɔɣi sokam, amaa ŋun pɔri alizanda nam ni galisi gar o.
en: The truth is that John the Baptizer is greater than anyone who has ever come into this world. But even the least important person in Gods kingdom is greater than John.

dag: N ni ti saɣim yi binnana la mini yi binwɔɣila din be yi san la, ka yi ku lan jɛm yi ni zaŋ yi nuhi mali binshɛŋa.
en: I will destroy your idols and sacred stone pillars; no longer will you worship the things that you yourselves have made.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa zaŋ o jaaŋgbee tiri zuɣusaa, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka satahiŋga mini sakuɣa ni buɣim lu tiŋgban ni na. Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka sakuɣa lu Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: So Moses raised his stick toward the sky, and the Lord sent thunder and hail, and lightning struck the ground. The Lord sent.

dag: Ka Shɛkɛmnim mini Bɛtimilɔnim zaa daa laɣim chaŋ Shɛkɛm oki tia din nyɛ bɛ tiŋgban la gbini nti leei Abimilɛk nam.
en: Then all the leaders of Shechem and all Beth-millo assembled and proceeded to make Abimelech king by the oak at the stone pillar in Shechem.

dag: Amaa ka ninvuɣ yo shɛb daa yɛra, Wula ka doo ŋɔ yɛn tooi niŋ tiligi ti? Ka bɛ daa ʒiɛm o, ka zaɣis o pina tibu. Amaa ka o daa kul shini.
en: But some worthless people said, How can this fellow do us any good? They despised Saul and did not bring him any gifts.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka bɛ chɛ tin shɛli din yuli daa du pam ŋɔ bahi? Di nyɛla n suhu ni piɛli tiŋ shɛli zuɣu.
en: Damascus is a happy city. The people have not left that fun city yet.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yimiya! Bipuɣiŋga maa bi kpi, amaa o gbihirimi. Ka bɛ lar o.
en: He said, Go away, because the little girl isnt dead but is asleep; but they laughed at him.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni deei n kawana, kawana ŋahibu saha, ka deei n wain, wain tɔɣibu saha, ka deei n daago mini atampa shɛli n ni daa zaŋ ti o ni o lir o gbin la.
en: So at harvest time I will take back my gifts of grain and wine, and will take away the wool and the linen I gave her for clothing.

dag: Lɛvinim daŋ ni: Jɔzabad mini Shimɛi ni Kɛlaya, bɛ ni daa lan booni la ni Pɛtahia ni Juda ni Ɛliɛza.
en: Of the Levites: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah , Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yi zaɣisi ma, yi lɛbila yi nyaansi biri ma, dinzuɣu ka n teegi n nuu m-bahi ya yoli. N niŋla suɣilo hal ka n nyee ti nyɔni.
en: You people have rejected me; you have turned your backs on me. So I reached out and crushed you because I was tired of controlling my anger.

dag: Bɛ lan zaŋm chinchin sabilitim pili firilatamdigu la mini di firilanim ni di firiladuhirisi ni firilakpihindisi ni di tahipɔna ni di kpam ni be kpaŋman shɛŋa ni;.
en: Then they must cover the lampstand and its lamps with a blue cloth. They must also cover all the things used to keep the lamps burning and all the jars of oil that are used in the lamps.

dag: Ti ni daa ti miriti Saipurus ka ti chɛ li bahi ti nuzaa polo ka chaŋ Taai din be Siria tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, dama nimaani ka bɛ daa yɛn yihi nɛma ŋariŋ maa ni.
en: We sailed near the island of Cyprus. We could see it on the north side, but we did not stop. We sailed to the country of Syria. We stopped at Tyre because the ship needed to unload its cargo there.

dag: Daadam, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa n-jɛndi Izraɛl anabinim bɛn tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa la, yɛlim bɛn zaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ suhuyubu tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa la, Wummiya Yawɛ yɛligu! .
en: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the prophets of Israel who say they speak in my name, but who preach messages that come from their own imagination. Tell them it's time to hear my message.

dag: Nyin ŋun mali Naawuni fukumsi zaligu nyuri bara, a nyɛla ŋun saɣindi Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa n-dihiri ŋun Naawuni vi?.
en: You boast about having God's law—but do you bring shame on God by breaking his law?.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti di biŋgbamda bɛn gbamdi tiŋgban ni ŋɔ n-filim yimaŋa, ka miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka bɛ saɣim ya, di yi pa lala yi ni leei bɛn be daɣiri ni.
en: Do not make yourselves unclean by eating any of these.

dag: O bia Yisahaku maa daba anii dali ka ŋun Ibrahimma daa gun o kaman Naawuni ni daa zal o shɛm.
en: Abraham did what God commanded and circumcised Isaac when he was eight days old.

dag: O yi yɛn malila wumpaɣibo sara maligu, ŋun zaŋm bɛ ni zaŋ kpam gari zim ni mali mah shɛŋa, ka dabindi ka di ni mini karikaasi shɛli bɛ ni niŋ kpam niŋ ni bɛ ni zaŋ kpam gari zim viɛl shɛl ni mali mah shɛŋa m-mali wumpaɣibo sara maligu maa.
en: If you offer it to give thanks, you must offer some bread together with it. Use the finest flour to make three kinds of bread without yeast—two in the form of loaves mixed with olive oil and one in the form of thin wafers brushed with oil.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim mini paɣ shɛba ni Yisa ma Mariama ni Yisa tizɔbihi zaa daa malila tɛhi yini n-laɣim suhiri Naawuni.
en: The apostles were all together. They were constantly praying with the same purpose. Some women, Mary the mother of Jesus, and his brothers were there with the apostles.

dag: Ka o daa tim tuumba tiŋ maa puuni Izraɛl Naa Ɛhab sani nti yɛl o, Bɛnhadad.
en: Benhadad sent a messenger to tell King Ahab of Israel.

dag: O daa yɛli Gaad zuliya: Ninvuɣ so ŋun yɛligi Gaad tiŋgbani ŋɔ mali alibarika. Gaad zuliya niriba ŋmanila gbuɣinli. O darigiri tɔhigiri bɔɣu, ka darigiri fuɣiri zuɣugbana.
en: About the tribe of Gad he said: Praise God, who made their territory large. Gad waits like a lion To tear off an arm or a scalp.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka m po pɔri ka o yɛli ma, Miri ka a kpuɣi n ni kana ti be Keenannim shɛb tiŋgbɔŋ ni ŋɔ bipuɣiŋga ti m bia maa ka o niŋ o paɣa;.
en: My master forced me to make a promise to him. He said to me, You must not allow my son to marry a girl from Canaan. We live among these people, but I dont want him to marry one of the Canaanite girls.

dag: dama m bi yɛri shɛli mmaŋmaŋ yiko ni, amaa m Ba ŋun tim ma na maa n-zali ma n ni yɛn yɛli shɛm ka tɔɣisi shɛm.
en: This is true, because I have not spoken on my own authority, but the Father who sent me has commanded me what I must say and speak.

dag: Ka bɛn daa ʒe Yisa sani maa ni yino ŋoog o takɔbi chɛ n-shɛligi maligumaaniba zuɣulan dabili tibili bahi.
en: When that happened, one of the followers with Jesus grabbed his sword and pulled it out. He swung it at the servant of the high priest and cut off his ear.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa yi chani Yawɛ jɛmbu duu bɛ jɛma saha nti tumdi bɛ tuma kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa chɛ ka bɛ yab Aduna zali ba shɛm la.
en: These were to enter the LORDs temple according to their appointed duty and by the procedure established for them by their ancestor Aaron, just as the LORD God of Israel had instructed him.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa daŋ yiɣisibu asibaasi n-kpuɣi kuɣ shɛli o ni daa zaŋ kuɣ o zuɣu la sa nimaani, ka booi kpam bahi di zuɣu.
en: After Jacob got up early in the morning, he took the stone that he had put near his head, set it up as a sacred pillar, and poured oil on the top of it.

dag: Hal yi yi yiɣi kpe zuɣusaa kaman tɔrili la, ka yi tɛri be saŋmarisi biɛhigu shee, n ni siɣisi ya tiŋ na. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: This is what the Lord says: Even though you fly high like the eagle and put your nest among the stars, I will bring you down from there.

dag: Amaa ka Zɛbulɔn mini Naftali zuliya niriba bɛn daa zaŋ bɛ nyɛviya pa talima tɔb ni zoya zuɣu.
en: But the men of Zebulun and Naphtali risked their lives fighting on those hills.

dag: Yuma ayi ka kum ŋɔ na niŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni maa, ka di na kpalim yuma anu, ka so ku ko bee n-kpuɣi puu atam.
en: This terrible famine has continued for two years now, and there will be five more years without planting or harvest.

dag: Bɛ ni ti mol o tiliginsim yɛla molo bɛ ni na bi dɔɣi ninvuɣ shɛb sani yɛra, o pun niŋ li.
en: They will proclaim Gods righteousness to those not yet born, telling them what God has done.

dag: N zɔri dolila a zaligunim soli, dama a yɛligi m baŋsim.
en: I do my best to follow your commands, because you are the one who gives me the desire.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛr a, faashee bɛ maan labi dɔɣi ninsala, di yi pa lala o ku tooi nya Naawuni nam.
en: Jesus answered, I am telling you the truth: no one can see the Kingdom of God without being born again.

dag: Ka Dauda mini Abishai daa chaŋ tɔbbihi maa sani yuŋ, ka Sool ti dola sansani maa sunsuuni gbihiri ka o kpani sa o zuɣusaa, ka Abinɛr mini tɔbbihi maa do n-gil o.
en: When night came, David and Abishai went into Sauls camp. Saul was asleep in the middle of the circle of men. His spear was stuck in the ground near his head. Abner and the other soldiers were asleep around Saul.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka pɔhim kpiɔŋ yi wulinluhili polo na nti ʒe toli maa ti niŋ Teeku Ʒiɛɣu ni, ka zaɣ yino gba daa bi lan kpalim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: The LORD turned the wind into a very strong west wind that lifted the locusts and drove them into the Reed Sea. Not a single locust was left in the whole country of Egypt.

dag: ka a dihi nam n-zaŋ ba leei maligumaaniba ni bɛ jɛmdi ti Duuma Naawuni, ka ni ti diri nam dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: You made them to be a kingdom and to be priests for our God. And they will rule on the earth.

dag: Jɛhɔahaz ni daa tum shɛlikam pahi min o ni daa tum shɛlikam ni o kpiɔŋ tuma zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: Everything else that Jehoahaz did and all his brave deeds are recorded in The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Masia zuɣu ka tinim bɛn nyɛ Yɛhudianim mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianim zaa ni tooi chaŋ ti Ba Naawuni sani o Shi yino la zuɣu.
en: Yes, through Christ we all have the right to come to the Father in one Spirit.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Ahija, Nyama, Naa Jɛrɔbɔam paɣ kanna ni o ti bɔh a nya din yɛn niŋ o bia ŋun ka alaafee. A ni ti yɛn yɛl o shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: O ni daa ti paai, o daa taɣila o biɛhigu ni o be kaman paɣ so la.
en: The LORD said to Ahijah, Look! Jeroboams wife has come seeking a word from you about her son. He is sick. Say this and that to her. When she comes, she will be disguised.

dag: Dama n nyari ba zoya zuɣu, ka nyari ba daboya zuɣu. Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be bɛ ko; ka bi tɛhi ni bɛ mini zuliya shɛli nyɛla yim. Bɛ wuhiya ni bɛ be bɛ ko ka chɛ zuliya kam.
en: From the high rocks I can see them; I can watch them from the hills. They are a nation that lives alone; They know they are blessed more than other nations.

dag: Amaa nyini daadam, wummi n ni yɛl a shɛm maa, ka miri ka a niŋ duŋtaara kaman duŋtaariba maa. Yaam a noli n-di n ni zaŋ binshɛli tir a ŋɔ.
en: As for you, human one, listen to what I say to you. Dont become rebellious like that household of rebels. Open your mouth and eat what I give you.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa zaŋ bia maa yi jirambisa maa zuɣu n-siɣina kpɛhi yili maa ni nti ti o ma maa ka yɛli, Nyama, a bia maa lan leei nyɛvililana yaha.
en: Elijah brought the boy down from the upper room of the house and gave him to his mother. Elijah said, Look, your son is alive.

dag: Amaa ka Ilaisha daa yɛl o, Wummi Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm. O yɛliya ni biɛɣuni ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha, bɛ sa ni kɔhi zim balli din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ata anzinfa laɣibaligu zaɣ yini, ka kɔhi chi kilɔgiram ayɔbu mi anzinfa laɣibaligu zaɣ yini Samaria ŋɔ dunɔdal ni.
en: Elisha answered, I have a message for you. The Lord promises that tomorrow here in Samaria, you will be able to buy a large sack of flour or two large sacks of barley for almost nothing.

dag: O daa lan wurim dagɔra du shɛŋa din be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu puuni luɣ shɛli paɣiba ni daa wuɣiri Ashɛra jɛmbu binyɛra la.
en: He destroyed the living quarters in the Temple occupied by the temple prostitutes.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa naai Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa min omaŋmaŋ yili maa tuma zaa. Naa Sulemaana ni daa lo nia ni o tum tuun shɛlikam zaa Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni min omaŋmaŋ yili maa ni maa daa tum naai zaa.
en: In this way, Solomon finished the LORDs temple and the royal palace. He successfully accomplished everything he intended for the LORDs temple and his own palace.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa yɛri Naawuni mini Musa finafina, Bɔzuɣu ka yi yihi ti Ijipti na ni ti ti kpi mɔɣu ŋɔ ni? Dama bindirigu mini kom ka kpe, ka ti nyee nyɔni bindir chɔɣima ŋɔ.
en: They began complaining against God and Moses. The people said, Why did you bring us out of Egypt? We will die here in the desert! There is no bread and no water! And we hate this terrible food.

dag: ka di yɛra, Mani n-nyɛ a yaannim Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu Naawuni. Ka dabiɛm daa gbaag Anabi Musa ka o ni sɔhira, ka o bi lan saɣi ni o lihi li.
en: The Lord said, I am the same God your ancestors had—the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. Moses began to shake with fear. He was afraid to look at the bush.

dag: Yi daa wum di yɛla la ti tumtumdikpee Ɛpafiras so ti ni yura, ka o nyɛ Masia tumtumda ŋun ʒe yim ka ʒe ti zaani la sani.
en: from our good friend Epaphras. He works together with us for Christ and is a faithful worker for you.

dag: ka kana ni nti chɛ ka a baŋ din ti yɛn niŋ a niriba dahin shɛli ha. Dahin shɛli ha yɛla ʒii m-bala.
en: Now I have come to you, Daniel, to explain to you what will happen to your people in the future. The vision is about a time in the future.

dag: Di zuɣu ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Farisiinim daa laɣim jintɔriba na ti bɔhi ba, Wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ? Dama doo ŋɔ wuhiri shihira pam.
en: So the Pharisees and the chief priests met with the Council and said, What shall we do? Look at all the miracles this man is performing!.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa kul shini, hal o daa bi garigi bɛ ni fiɣis o yɛl shɛŋa zuɣu maa zaɣ yini gba. Ka di daa gari Gomna Pailɛt pam.
en: But he didnt answer, not even a single word. So the governor was greatly amazed.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni chɛ ka bɛ duɣi chuɣu bindir suma, ka bo wain kura mini bindir suma din mali kpam ni wain shɛli bɛ ni te viɛnyɛliŋga n-ti zuliya kam zaa zoli ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Here on Mount Zion the Lord Almighty will prepare a banquet for all the nations of the world—a banquet of the richest food and the finest wine.

dag: Hɔdia paɣ ŋun daa nyɛ Naham tizɔpaɣ la bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Gamnim bɛn daa be Kɛila la yaannim mini Maakatinim bɛn daa be Ɛshitɛmɔa la yaannima.
en: A man named Hodiah was married to the sister of Naham. Hodiah's descendants included Keilah of the Garmite clan and Eshtemoa of the Maacathite clan.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya ni zim maa ku naai di duɣu ni, ka kpam la gba ku naai di ŋman ni hal ti paai dahin shɛli ŋun Yawɛ ni yɛn chɛ ka saa mi.
en: The Lord God of Israel has promised that your jar of flour won't run out and your bottle of oil won't dry up before he sends rain for the crops.

dag: Kpahimmiya kahiŋkɔri: Bɛ bi birita bee n-chɛra; bɛ mi ka kambɔna bee kunchuna; amaa Naawuni n-dihiri ba. Yi mali bukaata pam gari noonsi.
en: Consider the ravens: they neither plant nor harvest, they have no silo or barn, yet God feeds them. You are worth so much more than birds!.

dag: Ka yi ninvuɣ yino kam karitimi doli ninvuɣ tuhili ka bɛ ŋmaligiri guura, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni tuhiri ba tiri ya kaman o ni daa pun lɔn ya alikauli shɛm la zuɣu.
en: Any one of you can defeat a thousand enemy soldiers, because the Lord God fights for you, just as he promised.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ a daba bihi ni be ni alaafee. Bɛ zuliya ni ti nya zaa zani a sani.
en: Let your servants children live safe; let your servants descendants live secure in your presence.

dag: Nuhu gba ni daa ti paai yuun kɔbisinu saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Shɛm mini Ham ni Jafɛt.
en: After Noah was years old, he had three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

dag: Dahin shɛli a yi ti yɛn tuhi a dimnima, a tɔbbihi ni ti saɣi ti a. A nachimba ni ti ŋmanila asiba maligim n-laɣimna ti gil a sheeni zoli din be kasi la zuɣu.
en: Your people stand ready on your day of battle. In holy grandeur, from the dawns womb, fight! Your youthful strength is like the dew itself.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan zaŋ o yɛligu yɛli Jona pahi buyi.
en: Then the Lord spoke to Jonah again and said.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Bɛn be Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni bi sab gbaŋ yɛl ti a yɛla, ka ti mabi shɛb bɛn mi ka ya ŋɔ na bi tɔɣisi a zaɣ biɛ shɛli yɛla ti sani.
en: The Jews answered Paul, We have received no letters from Judea about you. None of our Jewish brothers who have traveled from there brought news about you or told us anything bad about you.

dag: O maani ansarisimaaniba ansarisi, amaa ka niŋdi tarimba nirilim.
en: He mocks mockers, but he shows favor to the humble.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Kalɛb zuliya: Hur ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛfirat bituuli la bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Shɔbal ŋun daa nyɛ Kiriatijiarim ba la.
en: These were Calebs descendants. The family of Hur, Ephrathahs oldest son: Shobal, Kiriath-jearims father.

dag: Dama ŋuna n-yuuni dunia tarisi, ka nyari binshɛɣukam din be sagbana tiŋli.
en: for he looks to the ends of the earth and surveys everything beneath the heavens.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi nirilim zaŋdi bɛ binyara paŋdi niriba mali alibarika. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli yɛlimaŋli soli tumdi bɛ tuma mali alibarika.
en: Happy is the person who is generous with his loans, who runs his business honestly.

dag: Naawuni yila Tɛman na. Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ yila Paran Zoli zuɣu na. Ka o jilima pili zuɣusaa. Ka o paɣibu pali dunia zaa.
en: God is coming again from Edom; the holy God is coming from the hills of Paran. His splendor covers the heavens, and the earth is full of his praise.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Pumpɔŋɔ n ni mali ba, ka bɛ neei kaman machɛli ni maani kurugu shɛm la, ka buɣisi ba nya. Dama wula ka n lee lan yɛn niŋ n niriba bɛn nyɛ alahichinim ŋɔ?.
en: Because of this the Lord Almighty says, I will refine my people like metal and put them to the test. My people have done evil— what else can I do with them?.

dag: Kpuɣimiya yi gɔriti dama atam kpuɣibu saha paaya. Kamiyana ti siɣi no, dama wain bɔɣili paliya. Wain ni tɔɣiri niŋdi binshɛŋa ni maa palimi hal ti puuri bahira; dama bɛ tuumbiɛri galisiya pam.
en: Bring the sickle, because the harvest is ripe. Come, walk on the grapes, because the winepress is full. The barrels will be full and spilling over, because their evil is great.

dag: Ka daa kari ba yihi.
en: And he drove them out of the court.

dag: nti zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ti ba, a ni daa lo bɛ yaannim alikauli ni a ni zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli din mali atam mini anfaani ti ba la.
en: Then you gave Israel this land rich with milk and honey, just as you had promised our ancestors.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a zaŋ a nini sɔɣi, ka zaŋ ma leeg a dima?.
en: Why have you turned your back and count me your enemy?.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa chaŋ ti liri Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa dabisili din pah ayi dali.
en: The Israelites moved in against the Benjaminites the second day.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi pam bahi bɛ zuɣu; ka o chɛ ka bɛ ŋme ba tɔbu, ka di be kaman buɣim la gili bɛ luɣilikam zaa, amaa ka bɛ bi baŋ di daliri, ka di di ba kaman buɣim la, amaa ka bɛ bi lihi li ka di nyɛ shɛli.
en: He was furious with us and punished our nation with the fires of war. Still we paid no attention. We didn't even care when we were surrounded and scorched by flames.

dag: Bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn daa yi ti dɔɣirikpamba bɛn nyɛ ti yaannim la zuliya ni na. Ka Masia gba yila bɛ zuliya maa ni na o daadamtali puuni. Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ŋun gari sokam zaa ŋɔ simdi paɣibu hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Ami!.
en: The Jewish ancestors are theirs, and the Christ descended from those ancestors. He is the one who rules over all things, who is God, and who is blessed forever. Amen.

dag: nti sɔŋ Yisa tuumba maa tooni, ka bɛ pirigiri li n-tiri bɛ ni sokam kaman di ni simdi ni bɛ zaa deei shɛm tariga.
en: to the apostles. Then they would give the money to anyone in need.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Naawuni n-lee ka Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni bee di chaŋ wula ka a ti timdi ni bɛ cham ti bɔhi Baalizibub ŋun nyɛ Ɛkurɔn buɣili la nya a ni kpaŋ bee a ku kpaŋ? Dinzuɣu a ku yiɣis a bariŋ bindo shɛli zuɣu a ni doya ŋɔ, amaa biɛhiŋ kani a ni kpi.
en: and said to him, This is what the Lord says: Because you sent messengers to consult Baalzebub, the god of Ekron—as if there were no god in Israel to consult—you will not get well; you will die.

dag: n-daa kpalim ni niŋ chira ata. Ka daa ti yɛn yiɣisi kpe ŋariŋ chaŋ Siria ka wum ni Yɛhudianim gu o soli, ka o daa lo nia ni o ni zaŋ doli Masidɔnia polo chaŋ.
en: and stayed there for three months. Paul was about to sail to Syria. But some of the Jewish leaders plotted against him, so he decided to return by way of Macedonia.

dag: Di saha ka Hamɔr min o bia Shɛkɛm daa chaŋ tiŋ maa dunol ni nti yɛli tiŋ maa ni dɔbba.
en: The two men met with the other leaders of their city and told them:.

dag: Amaa nyini ka n naɣ ni lo alikauli. Zaŋm a paɣ min a bidibisi ni bɛ paɣiba n-kpe ŋariŋ maa ni.
en: I will make a special agreement with you. You, your wife, your sons, and their wives will all go into the boat.

dag: Juda Naa Ahaz ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pinaayi saha ka Ɛla bia Hɔshia daa di Izraɛl nam Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuma awɛi.
en: Hoshea son of Elah became king of Israel in the twelfth year of Ahaz's rule in Judah, and he ruled nine years from Samaria.

dag: Naawuni ni ti ti pin kɔŋkɔb shɛŋa la zuɣu, chɛliya ka ti zaŋ li tum tuma ŋun Naawuni ni niŋ alibarika shɛli niŋ ti ni la zuɣu: Naawuni ni ti ti pin shɛli yi nyɛla anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu, chɛliya ka ti tɔɣisi li kaman ti yɛda ni nyɛ shɛm;.
en: God has also given each of us different gifts to use. If we can prophesy, we should do it according to the amount of faith we have.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ, nyini ka n zaŋ n nina lihira. A sani ka n sɔɣi. Di chɛ ma ka m bahi yoli!.
en: You are my Lord and God, and I look to you for safety. Don't let me be harmed.

dag: Amaa tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba bɛn lo kpara ŋɔ zaa ni du n-chaŋ ti tuhi tɔbu maa ti Yawɛ kaman nyin ti dan ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: But your servants, everyone equipped for war before the LORD, will go over to do battle as my master said.

dag: Yisa daa lan bɔhi ba, Bɔ ka n lee kul yɛn zaŋ ŋmahindi Naawuni nam?.
en: Then Jesus said, What can I compare God's kingdom with?.

dag: Ka zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, a kahigi wuhi ma a ni niŋ ma zaɣ viɛlli shɛm, ka bi ku ma saha shɛli Yawɛ ni di zaŋ ma niŋ a nuu ni la.
en: Today youve told me the good you have done for me—how the LORD handed me over to you, but how you didnt kill me.

dag: Rɛhɔbɔam daa tum din bie, dama o daa bi zaŋ o suhu zaa niŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu ni.
en: He did what was evil, because he did not try to find the Lord 's will.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Yaakubu daa ti saɣi kum ka niŋ alibarika niŋ Yisifu bidibisi zaa yinoyino ni, o ni daa zaŋ omaŋ dalim o jaaŋgbee n-jɛmdi Naawuni saha shɛl la.
en: And Jacob, also because he had faith, blessed each one of Josephs sons. He did this while he was dying, leaning on his rod and worshiping God.

dag: O lan yɛli ni a lɔri nia ni a chɛ ka anabinim moli gili Jɛrusalɛm puuni zaŋ chaŋ a polo n-yɛri ni a nyɛla Juda naa. Ka pumpɔŋɔ bɛ ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ yɛli Pɛriʒia naa. Di zuɣu n-chɛ ka n yɛli ni a chirigim ma ka ti tɔɣisi di yɛla maa.
en: And the rumor is that you have chosen prophets to announce this about you in Jerusalem: There is a king in Judah! Now I warn you, Nehemiah, King Artaxerxes will hear about this. So come, lets meet and talk about this together.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa yɛli naa, N ni daa be n ya ka wum a yɛla ni a yɛm yɛla shɛm shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: The report I heard about your deeds and wisdom when I was still at home is true, she said to the king.

dag: Ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim zaa daa lu o zuɣu, ka bɛ daa yirigi zana pil o n-gbaag o bɛ ni daa gbi bɔɣ shɛli sɔŋ ni.
en: Then the people who lived around him set a trap for him, and they caught him in their trap.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, A mi ni su tins anu fukumsi.
en: To this one, the king said, You will have authority over five cities.

dag: Ti leela ti ʒiʒiinitab ni maani shɛb ansarisi, ka leei bɛn gili ti ni maani shɛb ansarisi ka lari ti.
en: Weve become a joke to our neighbors, nothing but objects of ridicule and disapproval to those around us.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be bɛ nyɛviya ni n-nyɛ bɛn paɣir a kaman n ni paɣir a shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Bihi banim yɛri bɛ bihi a ʒiɛyimtali yɛla.
en: People who are alive, people like me, are the ones who will praise you. Fathers should tell their children about how faithful you are.

dag: ka bɛ dɔbba bɛn zaa mali suhukpeeni daa yi n-chaŋ yuŋ ti yihi Sool min o bidibisi maa Bɛtishan gooni maa zuɣu n-zaŋ ba chaŋ Jabɛshi ti nyo ba buɣim nimaani.
en: So one night, some brave men from Jabesh went to Beth-Shan. They took down the bodies of Saul and his sons, then brought them back to Jabesh and burned them.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daa zo ma nambɔɣu ni di chɛ ka Yisa Masia wuh o suɣilɔdibo zaa ni nyɛ shɛm man ŋun nyɛ alahichilana n-gari sokam zaa ŋɔ sani; ka di leei ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn na yɛn niŋ o yɛda n-nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu la ni ni doli so shɛli.
en: But this is why I was shown mercy, so that Christ Jesus could show his endless patience to me first of all. So Im an example for those who are going to believe in him for eternal life.

dag: Bɛ daa tila Pɛriʒia gomnanti tuma zuɣulaannim birapu ni bɛ gbarigi bɛ ni daa lo nia ni bɛ niŋ shɛm maa Pɛriʒia Naa Sairus ʒiɛman ni zaŋ hal ti paai Pɛriʒia Naa Darius ʒiɛman ni.
en: and bribed officials to frustrate their plan. They did this throughout the rule of Persias King Cyrus until the rule of Persias King Darius.

dag: Ka Azaria mini Ɛzra ni Mɛshulam.
en: along with Azariah, Ezra, Meshullam.

dag: ni bɛ taba Shɛbania ni Hɔdia ni Kɛlita ni Pɛlaya ni Hanan ni.
en: and their brothers: Shebaniah, Hodiah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan.

dag: Ŋunkam ŋme n-ku nira, bɛn kum o gba.
en: Death is the punishment for murder.

dag: Naawuni yubu zaŋ chaŋ yi sani nyɛla ni yi mali m-be kasi, ka di niŋdiya zina.
en: God wants you to be holy and completely free from sexual immorality.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n yɛn bahila yoli zama laɣiŋgu ni.
en: So now I have suffered through just about every kind of trouble anyone can have, and everyone knows it.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Kpɛm kuɣ parilana ayi kaman tuuli dina la, ka zaŋ dari mali adaka n-zaŋ li du zoli ŋɔ zuɣu ka n sanna.
en: At that time the LORD told me: Carve two stone tablets, just like the first ones, and hike up the mountain to me. Construct a wooden chest as well.

dag: Ka Ifriim zuliya niriba daa bi kari Keenannim bɛn be Gɛza, ka Keenannim maa daa kpalim be nimaani pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: The tribe of Ephraim didnt drive out the Canaanites living in Gezer, so the Canaanites kept on living there with them.

dag: O zaŋ saa nyaɣisibu gbib o nuu ni n-chɛ ka di nyaɣisir o ni zal li luɣ shɛli polo.
en: He grabs the lightning with his hands, and commands it to strike where he wants.

dag: Bɛ lan zaŋm chinchin sabilitim pili firilatamdigu la mini di firilanim ni di firiladuhirisi ni firilakpihindisi ni di tahipɔna ni di kpam ni be kpaŋman shɛŋa ni;.
en: With another blue cloth they will cover the lampstand, along with the lamps, the lamp snuffers, the fire pans, and the jars of oil for the lamps.
