dag: Di saha ka Jɛhɔshafat daa silim o zuɣu n-zaŋ o nini kpa tiŋa, ka Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa daa lu tiŋa Yawɛ tooni jɛm o.
en: Then King Jehoshaphat bowed low, with his face touching the ground, and all the people bowed with him and worshiped the Lord .

dag: Gomna Pailɛt ni daa wum ni Yisa pun kpi maa ka di gar o pam, ka o daa boli sapashin la na nti bɔh o ni Yisa shiri kpiya?.
en: Pilate wondered if Jesus was already dead. He called the centurion and asked him whether Jesus had already died.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa ti yɛli Yisifu, N zahimla zahindi ka bi nya so ŋun ni wuhi ma di gbinni; ka n wum ka bɛ yɛli ma ni bɛ yi yɛl a zahindi ni nyɛ shɛm, a ni tooi wuhi di gbinni.
en: Pharaoh said to Joseph, I had a dream, but no one could interpret it. Then I heard that when you hear a dream, you can interpret it.

dag: ka ŋun mi bɔri ni o gari yi zaa, ŋun zaŋm omaŋ lee yi zaa ha dabili.
en: and if one of you wants to be first, you must be the slave of all.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa ti lan labina nti yɛl o, Bɛnhadad ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, N daa timna ti yɛl a ni a zaŋ a daanzinfa min a salima ni a paɣiba ni a bihi ti ma na.
en: Later the messengers came back to Ahab with another demand from Benhadad: I sent you word that you were to hand over to me your silver and gold, your women and your children.

dag: N ni chɛ ka m min a lo tab alikauli, ka n chɛ ka a zuliya nab pam.
en: If you do this, I will prepare an agreement between us. I will promise to make your people a great nation.

dag: Ka Jokishan daa nyɛ Shiiba mini Dɛdan ba. Ka Dɛdan bihi daa nyɛ Ashurim mini Lɛtushim ni Liummim.
en: Jokshan was the father of Sheba and Dedan. The people of Asshur, Leum, and Letush were descendants of Dedan.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi niŋ yimaŋ barina titali ŋɔ ni yi ku dɔbba mini paɣiba ni bibihi ni biliɛri Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni din ni chɛ ka so ku lan kpalim?.
en: And so I, the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, now ask why you are doing such an evil thing to yourselves. Do you want to bring destruction on men and women, children and babies, so that none of your people will be left?.

dag: Bee wula ka a ni tooi yɛl a mabia ni o chɛ ka a yihi bimburigin shɛli din be o ninni ka daantaliga lee sa amaŋmaŋ ninni?.
en: Why do you say to your friend, Let me take that piece of dust out of your eye? Look at yourself first! You still have that big piece of wood in your own eye.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa naai Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa min omaŋmaŋ yili maa tuma zaa. Naa Sulemaana ni daa lo nia ni o tum tuun shɛlikam zaa Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni min omaŋmaŋ yili maa ni maa daa tum naai zaa.
en: After King Solomon had finished the Temple and the palace, successfully completing all his plans for them.

dag: Ka o daa saɣi, ka piligi bɔri so shɛli o ni yɛn doli yi Yisa nyaaŋa n-chɛ ka bɛ sɔɣi gbaag o salo ni ka o sani saha shɛli.
en: Judas agreed to it and started looking for a good chance to hand Jesus over to them without the people knowing about it.

dag: Ka nam ʒiishɛhi pisinaanahi gili nam ʒiishee maa, ka kpamba pisinaanahi ye binyɛr piɛla, ka pil salima zuɣupila n-ʒi nam ʒiishɛhi maa ni.
en: In a circle around the throne were other thrones with elders sitting on them. The elders were dressed in white, and they had golden crowns on their heads.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ lan yɛli yaha, N ni yihi n niriba bɛn be tiŋgban shɛŋa din be wulimpuhili mini wulinluhili polo la.
en: The Lord All-Powerful says, Look, I am rescuing my people from countries in the east and west.

dag: n-daa puhi zani o sani ni jilima, ka bɛ min o tɔɣisiri ŋun Yisa ni ti yɛn niŋ shɛlikam Jɛrusalɛm ka naanyi kpi la yɛla.
en: They were clothed with heavenly splendor and spoke about Jesus departure, which he would achieve in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ pini maa daŋ o tooni, ka ŋun maŋmaŋ daa kpalim gbe suɣa maa shee dindali maa yuŋ.
en: So Jacob sent the gift ahead of him, but he spent that night in the camp.

dag: Bɛ ni daa baptaizi yinim shɛb Yisa Masia ni la zaŋla Masia biɛhigu kaman binyɛrigu la ye.
en: All of you who were baptized into Christ have clothed yourselves with Christ.

dag: Ka ŋunkam tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri dalindi Daadam Bia ni tooi nya di chɛ m-paŋ; amaa ŋunkam mo Naawuni Shia Kasi, dilana ŋun kul ku nya di chɛ m-paŋ Naawuni sani.
en: If you speak against the Son of Man, you can be forgiven, but if you speak against the Holy Spirit, you cannot be forgiven.

dag: ka yi gba deei nyɛvili maŋli o sani, yi mini Masia ni laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yin la zuɣu. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun gari alizinnim bɛn nyɛ zuɣulaannim mini bɛn su fukumsi zaa.
en: And you have been filled by him, who is the head of every ruler and authority.

dag: Amaa saha shɛli bɛ ni daa ti yɛn zaŋ Mɛrab ti Dauda, bɛ daa ŋmalig o mi ti do so ŋun yuli booni Adiriɛl ka o nyɛ Mɛholat nir la, ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: But when the time came for David to marry Saul's daughter Merab, Saul told her to marry Adriel from the town of Meholah.

dag: Nyamiya, n ni gbaai kulibɔŋ ŋɔ du nti guhiri mɔɣu ni hal ka yi ti tim na ti yɛli ma lahibali din beni.
en: I'll wait at the river crossing in the desert until I hear from you.

dag: ni Holɔn ni Dɛbir.
en: Holon and its pastures; Debir and its pastures.

dag: ka yi yɛli, Ti ka taali. O suhu bi lan yiɣisi bahi ti zuɣu. Pumpɔŋɔ n yɛn kari ya la saria, dama yi yɛliya, Ti bi tum alahichi.
en: But still, you say, I am innocent. God is not angry with me. So I will also judge you guilty of lying, because you say, I have done nothing wrong.

dag: Ka malaikanima ayopɔin bɛn mal alɔbo balibu ayopɔin la daa yi jɛmbu duu maa ni na. Bɛ daa yɛla binyɛra din paligi paratɛte kaman gol la, ka zaŋ salima nyolɔra lo bɛ nyɔri.
en: The seven angels, who have the seven plagues, came out of the temple. They were clothed in pure bright linen and had gold sashes around their waists.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Hanun daa chɛ ka bɛ gbahi Dauda tuumba maa m-pini bɛ zaa teensi pirigilipirigili bahi ka chɛ pirigilipirigili, ka daa lan ŋmahi bɛ binyɛra bɛ sakpuɣa zuɣu bahi ka chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: So Hanun took Davids officers and shaved off one half of their beards. He cut off their clothes at the hips. Then he sent them away.

dag: Ka bɛnkam zaa zaɣisi a Naawuni zaligunim maa dolibu bee n-zaɣisi naa zaligunim dolibu, bɛn darigim bɛ tibili pam. Di yi simdi ni bɛ ku ba bee n-kari ba yihi yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni bee n-fa bɛ nɛma zaa bee n-kpɛhi ba duu yin niŋmiya lala.
en: If any disobey the laws of your God or the laws of the empire, they are to be punished promptly: by death or by exile or by confiscation of their property or by imprisonment.

dag: Ka tɔbutuhiri biinsi ninvuɣ pihita la puuni niriba ata daa ti chaŋ Dauda sani Adulam vo kabili ni saha shɛli Filistia tɔbbihi ni daa lo tɔbu n-do Rɛfaim Vinvamli ni la.
en: Three of the thirty commanders went down from the rock to David at the fortress of Adullam, while the army of the Philistines camped in the Rephaim Valley.

dag: Amaa ka yi niŋ tipawumli, ka zaɣisi bɛ yɛligu wumbu, ka zaŋ li niŋ yi baɣaka. Yi tum tuumbiɛri pam n-gari yi yaannim ni daa tum shɛm.
en: But you have ignored me and become even more stubborn and sinful than your ancestors ever were!.

dag: dindina ŋun ku nir maa ya kpamba bɛn timmi tiŋ maa ni ti zaŋ o na ti ti ŋun yɛn bɔh o biɛri, ka bɛ ku o.
en: the elders in his hometown must send someone to get him and take him away from the city of safety. These leaders must hand him over to the close relative. He is a murderer and he must die.

dag: Sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu daaŋa ni ti nyɛla mita ayi, ka daaŋa maa zuɣu zaŋ du zuɣusaa polo ti nyɛ mita ayi, ka mali binyila anahi.
en: This top section, on which the sacrifices were burned, was also feet high. The projections on the four corners were higher than the rest of the top.

dag: Ti zali timaŋ zaligu ni ti ni zaŋdi ti tiŋgban ni bindir daŋda mini ti tia kam wala din daŋdi moobu zaa n-tahiri Yawɛ jɛmbu duu na yuuni kam.
en: We also accept the responsibility of bringing the first part of our harvest, whether from the grain in our fields or the fruit from our trees. We will bring them to the Lord s Temple each year.

dag: Di saha ka o kpamba maa daa bɔh o, Wula ka a lee niŋ shɛm maa? Bia maa ni daa na ne, a daa lola noli ka kum o zuɣu pam, amaa ka o ti lee kpi ka a yiɣisi di bindirigu.
en: Why are you acting this way? his servants asked. When the child was alive, you fasted and cried and kept watch, but now that the child is dead, you get up and eat food.

dag: Di saha ka Pita daa siɣi ninvuɣ shɛb Kɔniilius ni daa timna maa sani ti yɛli ba, Mani n-nyɛ yi ni bɔri so maa. Ka bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-lee tahi ya na.
en: So Peter went downstairs and said to them, I think Im the man you are looking for. Why did you come here.

dag: Ka o daa lan kpuɣi bɔrɔbɔro n-niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka ŋmahiŋmahi li n-zaŋ ti ba ka yɛli, N niŋgbuŋ m-bala; n niŋgbun shɛli n ni zaŋ pa talima yi zuɣu. Niŋmiya dimbɔŋɔ n-teemi n yɛla.
en: Jesus took some bread in his hands and gave thanks for it. He broke the bread and handed it to his apostles. Then he said, This is my body, which is given for you. Eat this as a way of remembering me.

dag: Ka timanim mini saŋmaribaŋdiba ni Kalidianim ni laasabuniŋdiba daa laɣim na ka n ti yɛli ba n zahindi maa, amaa ka bɛ bi tooi wuhi ma di gbinni.
en: After they arrived, I told them my dream, but they were not able to say what it meant.

dag: Saha shɛli din gari la ha puuni, yi daa nyɛla kpiimba yi nɔzaɣisibo mini yi daalahichi tumbu zuɣu.
en: At one time you were like a dead person because of the things you did wrong and your offenses against God.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, N dima n-niŋ ma lala maa. Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ka daɣila a bɔri ni ti chaŋ ti sib li bahi.
en: The man answered, An enemy planted weeds. The servants asked, Do you want us to go and pull up the weeds.

dag: Ŋun pal alikauli ni bin din pɔra ni lan pal alikauli ni bin din galisi. Ŋun mi bi pal alikauli ni bin din pɔra ku pal alikauli ni bin din galisi.
en: Whoever can be trusted with small things can also be trusted with big things. Whoever is dishonest in little things will be dishonest in big things too.

dag: Binshɛli beni ka di daa simdi ni n niŋ di ni ka m bi niŋ li? N daa mali tahima ni di ni wali wain tia wala, ka bɔ n-chɛ ka di ti zaŋ walila wal biɛri?.
en: What more could I do for my vineyard? I did everything I could. I hoped for good grapes to grow, but there were only rotten ones. Why did that happen?.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ mali takɔriti niŋ li, ka di sambani polo yɛlima, ka di puuni polo nyɛ zaɣ muɣilinga.
en: There were narrow windows in the Temple. These windows were smaller on the inside of the wall than on the outside.

dag: Yawɛ, zahimmi ma, ka buɣisi ma nya; buɣisim n suhu mini n tɛha.
en: Examine me, LORD; put me to the test! Purify my mind and my heart.

dag: ka maligumaana maa zaŋ ba mali sara; yino ni nyɛla alahichi sanyoo sara, ka ŋun la mi nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la. Ka maligumaana maa yo din yi o tooni na maa samli Yawɛ sani.
en: The priest will offer the birds, one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering. In this way the priest will make that man pure before the Lord .

dag: Ka o daa chani gindi Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa yihiri waazu Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni.
en: So he continued preaching in the Judean synagogues.

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o kpiɔŋ yɛla ni o ni daa tuhi tɔb shɛm min o ni daa deei Damaskus mini Hamat din nyɛ Judanim ni su shɛl la shɛm, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: Everything else Jeroboam did while he was king, including his brave deeds and how he recaptured the towns of Damascus and Hamath, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Dan ni ti ŋmanila sokpaŋ tinvurigu. O nyɛla sokpaŋ gariŋga ŋun dimdi wɔhu napɔŋkpaa, ka ŋun bar o lɛbiri lur o kpali zuɣu.
en: Dan will be a snake on the road, a serpent on the path, biting a horses heels, so its rider falls backward.

dag: hal ti paai palo din be dunoli zuɣusaa hal ni puuni duu la ni ni di samban ni. Ka bɛ ŋme binyara pa puuni duu maa dukpina zaa zuɣu mini di sunsuuni zaa ti gili.
en: over the doorway. On all the walls in the inner room and the outer room of the Temple were carvings.

dag: Ka Yaakubu yɛli Firawuna, N ni gɔri gindi ŋɔ, n yuma nyɛla yuun kɔbiga ni pihita. N yuma maa mini di dabisa bi galisi, amaa ka yɛl biɛri lee be di puuni. Di bi be kaman yuma mini dabisa shɛŋa n yaannim ni daa zaŋ gɔri gindi la.
en: Jacob said to Pharaoh, I have had a short life with many troubles. I am only years old. My father and his ancestors lived to be much older than I am.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: Then the Lord said.

dag: Yinim bɛn zaa mali tahima zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ sani ŋɔ, maliya kpiɔŋ mini suhukpeeni.
en: All you who wait for the LORD, be strong and let your heart take courage.

dag: m-pahi bɛ daba bɛn daa nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba bɛn kalinli daa nyɛ ninvuɣ tusaayopɔin ni kɔbisita ni pihitanaayopɔin; ka bɛ daa mali dɔbba mini paɣiba bɛn daa nyɛ yiliyiiniba, ka bɛ kalinli nyɛ ninvuɣ kɔbisiyi ni pihinahinaanu.
en: This number doesnt include their , male and female servants; they also had male and female singers.

dag: Yawɛ yurilim din galisi ŋɔ zuɣu ka ti bi kpi; o nambɔzɔbo ka tariga.
en: Certainly the faithful love of the LORD hasnt ended; certainly Gods compassion isnt through!.

dag: Ka Yisa daa teeg o nuu tir o nyaandoliba maa ka yɛli, M ma mini n tizɔbihi m-bɔŋɔ.
en: He stretched out his hand toward his disciples and said, Look, here are my mother and my brothers.

dag: Amaa sapashin kpɛm maa daa naɣ chɛla tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni nandaamba shɛba ni bɛ maani tihi puri ka kɔra.
en: He let only the poorest of the common people stay there. He let them stay so that they could take care of the grapes and other crops.

dag: Bɛ daa lan mali di daantalis anu mini di bansi, ka niŋ salima pa daantalisi maa zuɣuri ni mini di mihi zuɣu, amaa di ni yɛn tamdi bina anu shɛŋa zuɣu la dina, daanya ka bɛ daa zaŋ mal li.
en: Then they made the five posts and the hooks for this curtain over the entrance. They covered the tops of the posts and the curtain rods with gold. And they made the five bronze bases for the posts.

dag: Ninsalinim ni yi bɛ manim puya ni na ni nuzaŋa shɛm, lala ka bɛ ti lan yɛn yi dunia ŋɔ ni ni nuzaŋa. Bɛ ti ku ʒi bɛ tuma binshɛli bɛ nuu ni yi.
en: They came into this world naked, and when they die, they will be just as naked. They can't take anything with them, and they won't have anything to show for all their work.

dag: Ka ŋun Musa daa zaŋ o nuhi pa Jɔshua zuɣu n-zaŋ o leei toondana kaman Yawɛ ni daa zal o ni o niŋ shɛm.
en: As the Lord had commanded, Moses put his hands on Joshua's head and proclaimed him as his successor.

dag: dindina a ni lan nya suhupiɛlli Kpiɔŋlan Naa sani, ka kpuɣ a zuɣu lihi ŋun Naawuni.
en: Then you will always trust in God and find that he is the source of your joy.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli anabi Shɛmaya.
en: Meanwhile, the Lord had told Shemaiah the prophet.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔhi Yawɛ, M biɛhimi ŋmɛnditoya ŋɔ naba? N ni paai ba? Ka o garigi yɛl o, Biɛhimi bɛ naba, a ni paa ba n-fa a niriba maa.
en: Then David prayed to the Lord . Should I chase the people who took our families? Will I catch them? The Lord answered, Chase them. You will catch them, and you will save your families.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛl o binshɛɣukam, ka bi sɔɣ o shɛli. Ka Ɛli garigi yɛli, Ŋuna n-nyɛ Yawɛ, o niŋm o ni nya ka shɛli viɛl o sani.
en: So Samuel told Eli everything. He did not hide anything from him. Eli said, He is the Lord . Let him do whatever he thinks is right.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Daniɛl, n kamina ni n ti ti a yɛm mini baŋsim.
en: He explained, Daniel, I have come here to help you understand the prophecy.

dag: Miriya ka yi mali kuruwa balibu buyi din nyɛ zaɣ karili mini zaɣ bila yi yinsi puuni.
en: Dont keep measures in your house that are too large or too small.

dag: Yi daa tam tampiŋ din dɔɣi ya yɛla, ka daa tam Naawuni ŋun dɔɣi ya yɛla.
en: You deserted the rock that sired you; you forgot the God who gave birth to you!.

dag: Ziza daa nyɛla Shifi bia, ka Shifi daa nyɛ Allɔn bia, ka Allɔn daa nyɛ Jɛdaya bia, ka Jɛdaya daa nyɛ Shimri bia, ka Shimri mi daa nyɛ Shɛmaya bia.
en: and Ziza son of Shiphi son of Allon son of Jedaiah son of Shimri son of Shemaiah.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord commanded Moses.

dag: N tumdi tuun kpɛma ka nyari wahala, ka gaani gom waawaayili, ka kpiri kum ni kɔnyuri, ka kɔŋdi bindirigu waawaayili, ka chani gbinfini ka wari mali ma.
en: I faced these dangers with hard work and heavy labor, many sleepless nights, hunger and thirst, often without food, and in the cold without enough clothes.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna, ka yi ni ti yɛli, Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Kuhimiya bol o yuli ka o sɔŋ ya! Yɛlimiya zuliya kam zaa o ni tum tuun shɛŋa! Yɛlimiya ba ni o galisiya pam!.
en: And you will say on that day: Thank the LORD; call on Gods name; proclaim Gods deeds among the peoples; declare that Gods name is exalted.

dag: N Duuma Naawuni ni tin ya din simdi ya zaa o bundaantali din be Yisa Masia ni la zaa puuni.
en: My God will meet your every need out of his riches in the glory that is found in Christ Jesus.

dag: Naɣilabil tuuli jilima nyɛla o dini. O yila nyɛla yɔnahu yila. Dina ka o ti yɛn zaŋ ʒe niriba n-kari ba ti bahi dunia tarisi. Bɛna n-nyɛ Ifriim zuliya niriba tuhi pia; bɛna n-nyɛ Manaasa zuliya niriba tusa shɛm la.
en: Joseph has the strength of a bull, The horns of a wild ox. His horns are Manasseh's thousands And Ephraim's ten thousands. With them he gores the nations And pushes them to the ends of the earth.

dag: Naomi ni daa nya ka Rut shiri bɔri ni o dol o kuli ni o suhu zaa maa zuɣu, ka o daa shini ka bi lan yɛli shɛli.
en: When Naomi saw that Ruth had made up her mind to go with her, she stopped urging her to go back.

dag: Din pahi dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu, yi mi ni pumpɔŋɔ nyɛla nimmoo saha ka di simdi ni yi neei gom ni, dama pumpɔŋɔ ka tiliginsim miri ti n-gari ti ni daa tuui niŋ yɛda saha shɛl la.
en: I say this because you know that we live in an important time. Yes, it is now time for you to wake up from your sleep. Our salvation is nearer now than when we first believed.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Mani ŋun tɔɣisir a yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ m-bala.
en: Jesus answered, I am he, I who am talking with you.

dag: Di ni ti lu n-doya ka noonsi ti tamdi di mundili maa zuɣu, ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri zaa ti be di wulikpana maa ni.
en: On its trunk roost all the birds in the sky, and on its boughs lie all the beasts of the field.

dag: Dindina nir yi mɔɣi tampiligim di so. O suhu ni tɛha m-birig o maa, ka o ku tooi tilig omaŋa bee n-yɛli, N ni gbib binshɛli n nudirigu ni ŋɔ pala Naawuni.
en: Hes feeding on ashes; his deluded mind has led him astray. He cant save himself and say, Isnt this thing in my hand a lie.

dag: Ka goli maa biɛɣ pinaanu dali mi nyɛla Bɔrɔbɔro din ka Dabindi Chuɣu Yawɛ sani. Ka yi ni ti ŋubi bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi daba ayopɔin.
en: The LORDs Festival of Unleavened Bread is on the fifteenth day of the same month. You must eat unleavened bread for seven days.

dag: Zaŋm ma tabil a suhu kaman a nyɛla dalinli la, ka zaŋ ma pa a baɣiri zuɣu kaman n nyɛla dalinli la. Dama yurilim malila yaa kaman kum la, ka kɔre mali yaa kaman gballi. Di dirimi kaman buɣim la, ka di buɣim zilinli mali kpiɔŋ pam.
en: Always keep me in your heart and wear this bracelet to remember me by. The passion of love bursting into flame is more powerful than death, stronger than the grave.

dag: Hal yi zabiri zaa mali kalinli.
en: God even knows how many hairs are on your head.

dag: Ka Saimɔn Pita mabia Anduru ŋun daa nyɛ Yisa nyaandoliba maa ni yino la yɛli Yisa.
en: Another one of his disciples, Andrew, who was Simon Peter's brother, said.

dag: Dama saha shɛli Dauda ni daa be Ɛdom la, ka Jɔab ŋun daa nyɛ o sapashin kpɛm la daa chaŋ nimaani ni o ti sɔɣi bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛba.
en: Some time earlier, when David conquered the nation of Edom, Joab his army commander went there to bury those who had died in battle. Joab and his soldiers stayed in Edom six months, and during that time they killed every man and boy who lived there.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti zɔri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ka jɛmd o, ka zaŋm o yuli kɔŋko pom pɔri.
en: Respect the Lord your God and serve only him. You must use only his name to make promises.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ko n-dolisi kulibɔŋ bindira ni niŋ pam, ka bɛ suhiri paligi, ka niɣi mini bunsi gba nya mɔ suma ŋubi.
en: those who sow beside any stream will be happy, sending out ox and donkey to graze.

dag: Yinim Gilibɔa zoya, maligim bee saa ku lan lu yi zuɣu na bee bimbilima ti lan bili yi zolɔna ni. Dama nimaani ka kpiɔŋlaannim bidibbina nya filiŋ. Ka Sool nyɔtaɣirigu bi lan nya kpam ʒe.
en: You hills of Gilboa! Let there be no dew or rain on you, and no fields yielding grain offerings. Because it was there that the mighty warriors shield was defiled— the shield of Saul!—never again anointed with oil.

dag: Kɔbil shɛli nabihi ni daa gbi. Kolibil shɛli niriba toondaannim ni daa gbi. Nam jaaŋgbɛhi ka bɛ daa zaŋ gbi li. Bɛ jaaŋgbɛhi ka bɛ daa zaŋ gbi li. Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi yɔɣu maa ni chaŋ Matana.
en: The well dug by princes And by leaders of the people, Dug with a royal scepter And with their walking sticks. They moved from the wilderness to Mattanah.

dag: Di saha maa ka bɛ ni ti nya Daadam Bia ka o be sagban ni kanna ni yiko mini jilima pam.
en: Then the Son of Man will appear, coming in a cloud with great power and glory.

dag: Yɛhudianim mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianim ni daba mini bilichinnima ni dɔbba mini paɣiba zaa bi be kɔŋkɔba; yi zaa nyɛla zaɣ yini Yisa Masia ni.
en: So there is no difference between Jews and Gentiles, between slaves and free people, between men and women; you are all one in union with Christ Jesus.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira baptaizibu la, Naawuni n-daa lee zal li bee ninsalinima? Yɛlimiya ma.
en: Tell me, where did John's right to baptize come from: was it from God or from human beings.

dag: Ka Jɛhu daa tim tuumba ka bɛ gili Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa, ka Baal jɛmdiba zaa daa laɣimna, ka so daa bi kpalim ka bi kana. Ka bɛ daa kpe Baal duu maa ni hal ti pal li, ka di luɣilikam zaa ti nyɛla niriba.
en: Jehu then sent word throughout Israel. All Baals worshippers came. No one stayed away. They entered Baals temple until it was packed from one end to the other.

dag: O kpee ka dunia ni, o nyɛla binnɛɔŋ ŋun bi zɔri dabiɛm.
en: There is nothing on earth to compare with him; he is a creature that has no fear.

dag: Din daa chɛ ka Yisa yɛl lala maa nyɛla, bɛ ni daa yɛli ni alizin biɛɣu n-ʒi o zuɣu la.
en: Jesus said this because the teachers of the law had accused him of having an evil spirit inside him.

dag: Ka Musa daa kpe sagbani maa ni n-du zoli maa zuɣu. Musa daa be zoli maa zuɣu la wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ biɛɣu pihinahi.
en: Then Moses went higher up the mountain into the cloud. He was on the mountain for days and nights.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee zaŋ nasaridira ŋɔ yi wulimpuhili polo na, ka chɛ ka o diri nasara luɣ shɛlikam ŋɔ? O chɛ ka o nyaŋ nanim mini zuliya kam. O zaŋ o takɔbi tim bɛ ni n-niŋ ba kaman taŋkpaɣu la. Ka zaŋ o piɛma to n-wurim ba kaman wurigu la.
en: Who was it that brought the conqueror from the east and makes him triumphant wherever he goes? Who gives him victory over kings and nations? His sword strikes them down as if they were dust. His arrows scatter them like straw before the wind.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Bɛn be zuɣusaa, paɣimiya Yawɛ! Bɛn be zuɣusaa katiŋ ha, paɣimiy o!.
en: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD from heaven! Praise God on the heights!.

dag: Ka daa lan bɔhi ba, Ka bɔ lee niŋ ka yimaŋmaŋ bi baŋdi din tuhi?.
en: Why do you not judge for yourselves the right thing to do?.

dag: O ti bom yuun yini piɛbila ŋun ka daŋa m-maani bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la tiri Yawɛ dabisili kam, o niŋmi li asiba kam.
en: Each morning a year-old lamb that has nothing wrong with it must be offered as a sacrifice to please me.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa nya bɛ ni niŋ shɛm maa, ka lan nya bɛ ni ŋmaligi ka chɛ bɛ tuumbiɛri soya maa, ka o taɣ o tɛha zaŋ chaŋ o ni daa lo ni o ni niŋ shɛm maa polo, ka daa shiri bi niŋ li.
en: When God saw that the people had stopped doing evil things, he had pity and did not destroy them as he had planned.

dag: Ka o daa pahi bɛ zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ. Ka bɛ daa paai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni nti gbaai dari maa ŋmabu.
en: and he left with them. They went to the Jordan River and began chopping down trees.

dag: Ka bɛ duhi bɛ yee yɛli, Kum o! Kum o! Kpahim o tabili dapulli zuɣu! Ka Gomna Pailɛt bɔhi ba, N kpahimi yi Naa maa tabili dapulli zuɣu? Ka maligumaaniba kpamba daa garigi yɛl o, Ti ka naa pahila Naa Siiza.
en: The Jewish leaders cried out, Take him away! Take him away! Crucify him! Pilate responded, What? Do you want me to crucify your king? We have no king except the emperor, the chief priests answered.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o dɔɣi bidibiga ka yɛli, Sana n-nyɛ ma tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni. Dinzuɣu ka o daa boli bia maa yuli Gɛrishom.
en: And when she had a son, Moses said, I will name him Gershom, since I am a foreigner in this country.

dag: Naawuni nyɛla ŋun be tibi; ŋuna m-boli ya ni yi min o Bia Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma la ti laɣim be.
en: God is to be trusted, the God who called you to have fellowship with his Son Jesus Christ, our Lord.

dag: Bɛ sani, a ŋmanila yiliyiina ŋun yiini yurilim yila, ŋun kukoli viɛla, ka o mi biŋkumda ŋmɛbu viɛnyɛliŋga. Bɛ wumd a ni yɛri shɛm, amaa bɛ ku niŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: They treat you as though you were merely singing love songs or playing music. They listen, but don't do anything you say.

dag: Ka Musa daa ti bɔhi alahichi sanyoo sara maligu bua la yɛla, ka nya ka bɛ pun zaŋ o nyo buɣim, ka o suhu yiɣisi bahi Ɛliɛza mini Itama bɛn nyɛ Aduna bidibisi bɛn daa kpalim maa zuɣu ka o bɔhi ba.
en: Moses asked about the goat for the sin offering and learned that it had already been burned. This made him angry at Eleazar and Ithamar, and he demanded.

dag: Ka n daa lan nya ka ninsalinim tuma mini bɛ baŋsim puuni, bɛ zabirila tab nyuli. Dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din ka buchi, di ŋmanila nir ŋun zɔri doli pɔhim.
en: Then I realized that we work and do wonderful things just because we are jealous of others. This makes no more sense than chasing the wind.

dag: O tiri bɛnkam zaa zɔr o bɛ ni bɔri shɛli. O lan deeri bɛn suhir o suhigu ka tiligiri ba.
en: God shows favor to those who honor him, listening to their cries for help and saving them.

dag: O daa yɛli Hagai ni o bɔhim Shialtiɛl bia Zɛrubabɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Juda gomna la mini Jɛhɔzadak bia Jɔshua ŋun daa nyɛ Maligumaaniba zuɣulana ni niriba bɛn kpalim la.
en: Say to Judahs governor Zerubbabel, Shealtiels son, and to the chief priest Joshua, Jehozadaks son, and to the rest of the people.

dag: Luɣ shɛlikam zaa daa zibigimi agbaa dɛde zaŋ ti paai kurig ata saha, ka wuntaŋ daa bi lan ne. Ka chinchin shɛli din daa yili Naawuni jɛmbu duu la cheei di sunsuuni m-pirigi buyi.
en: It was about noon, but it turned dark throughout the land until three oclock in the afternoon.

dag: Yisa ni daa be dunia ŋɔ ni saha shɛli, o daa suhiri Naawuni yɛr o o ni bɔri shɛli, ka duhir o yee kuhiri ni nintam niŋdi Naawuni ŋun ni tooi tilig o kum ni la. Ka Naawuni daa wum o suhigu maa o ni daa zɔri ŋun Naawuni la zuɣu.
en: In his life on earth Jesus made his prayers and requests with loud cries and tears to God, who could save him from death. Because he was humble and devoted, God heard him.

dag: ka di yi ti lan puhi situra maa ni bee bɛ ni bahi mi shɛŋa maa ni bee bɛ ni wuɣi tan shɛŋa maa ni bee bɛ ni zaŋ gbaŋ mali binshɛli maa ni yaha, di yɛligirimi maa, yin zaŋmiya dɔro maa ni be binshɛli ni maa nyo buɣim.
en: Later, if the spot reappears elsewhere on the clothing or the leather, you must burn it.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa ti bol o bia Sulemaana na ti yɛl o ni o mɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu maa.
en: He sent for his son Solomon and commanded him to build a temple for the Lord , the God of Israel.

dag: N daa fabindi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be muɣisigu ni zuɣu, ka m puu biɛri nandaamba zuɣu.
en: God, you know that I cried for those who were in trouble. You know that I mourned for the poor.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, A yi bɔri ni a niŋ shɛlikam dɛde, nyin cham ti kɔhi a ni mali shɛlikam zaa n-zaŋ ti nandaamba n-zali buni alizanda ni, di nyaaŋa ka kana ti doli ma.
en: Jesus replied, If you want to be perfect, go sell everything you own! Give the money to the poor, and you will have riches in heaven. Then come and be my follower.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Chama, ka daa chɛ ka o chaŋ ni o ti niŋ chira ayi. Ka o daa ŋmaligi ka o min o dol tab chaŋ ti du zoya zuɣu n-fabil o ni yɛn kpi ni o paɣipiɛlital maa zuɣu.
en: Go, he responded, and he sent her away for two months. She and her friends walked on the hills and cried because she would never have children.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ, n suhir a, deemi n nyɛvili, dama n kum so m bebu.
en: At this point, LORD, you may as well take my life from me, because it would be better for me to die than to live.

dag: O mi o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm zaŋ salima mini anzinfa ni daanya mali binyɛra.
en: He is a very good designer. And he can make things from gold, silver, and bronze.

dag: Ŋmaligim m polo na n-zo ma nambɔɣu; zaŋm a kpiɔŋ ti a dabili ŋɔ, tiligim a dab bipuɣiŋga bia ŋɔ.
en: Turn to me and have mercy on me; strengthen me and save me, because I serve you just as my mother did.

dag: N nandahima puuni, n daa kuhi boli Yawɛ, ka o garigi ma. N daa bela kpiimba biɛhigu shee din zilim pam la ka kuhi bol a, ka a wum n kuhigu maa.
en: I was in very bad trouble. I called to the Lord for help, and he answered me. I was deep in the grave. I cried to you, and you heard my voice.

dag: Ka Dauda suhu daa saɣim pam, dama o niriba maa suhuri daa yiɣisimi, ka bɛ yɛli ni bɛ ni lab o kuɣa. Dama sokam daa kul fabindila o bidibisi min o bipuɣinsi zuɣu. Amaa ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Dauda Naawuni ŋɔ daa kpaŋs o suhu.
en: David was desperate. His soldiers were so upset over what had happened to their sons and daughters that they were thinking about stoning David to death. But he felt the Lord God giving him strength.

dag: Tiŋ maa ni paɣ tuumbiɛrilan so ni daa wum ni Yisa be Farisii maa yiŋa n-diri bindirigu maa ka o zaŋ luɣilu viɛlli din pali tulaale.
en: In that town was a woman who lived a sinful life. She heard that Jesus was eating in the Pharisee's house, so she brought an alabaster jar full of perfume.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka biɛrim yiɣisi n niŋgbuna ni m-be kaman paɣa ni yi wolisiri ni o dɔɣi ka biɛrim shɛli mal o la, ka n ni daa wum ka nya ʒii shɛli maa puuni maa chɛ ka dabiɛm gbaai ma.
en: I'm in terrible pain like a woman giving birth. I'm shocked and hurt so much that I can't hear or see.

dag: Juda Naa Asa ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihita ni yini saha, ka Omri daa leei Izraɛl naa maa. O daa niŋla o nam maa ni yuun pinaayi. O daa diya ʒinila Tiriza yuma ayɔbu.
en: So in the thirty-first year of the reign of King Asa of Judah, Omri became king of Israel, and he ruled for twelve years. The first six years he ruled in Tirzah.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah ayi daa piɛb o kikaa, ka binshɛɣu din be kaman zo titali ka buɣim diri di zuɣu la yiɣ ti lu teeku ni.
en: When the second angel blew his trumpet, something like a great fiery mountain was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned to blood.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni yɛli shɛm Naawuni Kundi ni la: O ni daa du zuɣusaa ha la, o daa zaŋ bɛn nyɛ daba la pam mali chaŋ, ka daa zaŋ pina ti ninsalinima.
en: As the scripture says, When he went up to the very heights, he took many captives with him; he gave gifts to people.

dag: Zo kpima chɛ ka tulaale nyom niŋdila biɛribiɛri; lala ka jɛrilim biɛla saɣindi yɛm mini jilima.
en: As dead flies spoil the perfumers oil, so a little folly outweighs wisdom and honor.

dag: Tihi nyɔŋ mini tiŋgbani din mal atam, Yawɛ ni ti saɣim li, o ni ti saɣim niŋgbuŋ min o shia, ka di ni be kaman dɔr biɛɣu ni saɣindi ninsal niŋgbuŋ shɛm la.
en: Its abundant forest and farmland will be finished completely, as when a sick person wastes away.

dag: Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam niŋ ma yɛda, o gba ni ti tum tuun shɛŋa n ni tumdi ŋɔ, hal ka ni ti tum tuun shɛŋa din gari dimbɔŋɔnima, dama n chanila m Ba maa sani.
en: I tell you for certain that if you have faith in me, you will do the same things I am doing. You will do even greater things, now that I am going back to the Father.

dag: O daa ŋahila ŋaha tusaata, ka o ni daa yili yil shɛŋa mi daa nyɛ tuhilinaanu.
en: Solomon wrote , wise sayings and composed more than , songs.

dag: Yoomi wuntitali dunoya ti ma, ka n dol li kpe nti puhi Yawɛ.
en: Gates of goodness, open for me, and I will come in and worship the Lord .

dag: Bihim ka n daa mali dihiri ya, pa saɣim; dama yi daa naan na kul ku tooi di li; hal ka na kul tooi di li pumpɔŋɔ gba.
en: So I had to treat you like babies and feed you milk. You could not take solid food, and you still cannot.

dag: Ka yɛm shia daa pali Nan bia Jɔshua, dama Musa daa zaŋla o nuhi pa Jɔshua zuɣu, dinzuɣu ka Izraɛlnim maa daa deeg o noli, ka niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm.
en: Before Moses died, he had placed his hands on Joshua, and the Lord had given Joshua wisdom. The Israelites paid attention to what Joshua said and obeyed the commands that the Lord had given Moses.

dag: Yɛla maa ni nyɛ shɛm tariga m-bala. Dabiɛm daa kpe man Daniɛl pam, ka n ninni biɛhigu taɣi, amaa ka n daa lee zaŋ yɛla maa niŋ n suhu ni.
en: The account ends here. Now as for how I, Daniel, felt about this: My thoughts disturbed me greatly. My mood darkened considerably, and I kept thinking about this matter.

dag: Yi nahindi nandaamba ka fari bɛ chi. Dinzuɣu yi ku be yi ni zaŋ kuɣa me yi yiya shɛŋa la ni, yi mi ku nyu yi ni sa yi wain ti viɛl shɛŋa la wain.
en: You take unfair taxes from the poor. You take loads of wheat from them. You build fancy houses with cut stone, but you will not live in them. You plant beautiful vineyards, but you will not drink the wine from them.

dag: Pool ni daa tɔɣisiri ni o zab omaŋ zuɣu maa, ka Gomna Fɛstus ti duh o yee yɛl o, Pool, di ni bɔŋɔ a kpɛla yinyari! A baŋsim pam zuɣu n-chɛ ka a kpe yinyari maa.
en: While Paul was still defending himself, Festus shouted, Paul, you are out of your mind! Too much study has made you crazy.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli, Bɛ mal li kunila Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni ni bɛ ti me di duu zali nimaani. Bɛ yi ti me di duu maa naai, bɛ ni zaŋ piɛɣu maa zali di ni.
en: He answered, To Babylonia, where they will build a temple for it. When the temple is finished, the basket will be placed there to be worshiped.

dag: Ka naa maa suhu daa paligi ti yaɣi, ka o bahi noli ni bɛ yihim Daniɛl bɔɣili maa ni na. Ka bɛ daa voog o yihi na n-nya ka o bi nya daŋa hal baabiɛla gba, o ni daa niŋ Naawuni yɛda zuɣu.
en: King Darius was very happy. He told his servants to lift Daniel out of the lions den. And when Daniel was lifted out of the den, they did not find any injury on his body. The lions did not hurt Daniel because he trusted in his God.

dag: Di chɛ ka a baɣa be kurimbuni lahibaya din bi luri Naawuni sizuura ka nyɛ din pa yɛlimaŋli la ni. Kul zaŋm amaŋ niŋla wuntia soli yɛla bɔhimbu ni.
en: Don't have anything to do with worthless, senseless stories. Work hard to be truly religious.

dag: Bɛ puuni ka kuɣ tuuli ti yɛn yina. Bɛ puuni ka suɣili kpaa ti yɛn yina. Bɛ puuni ka tɔbutuhiri tɔbu ti yɛn yina. Bɛ puuni ka zuɣulan kam ti yɛn yina.
en: From this flock will come leaders who will be strong like cornerstones and tent pegs and weapons of war.

dag: nti lihi Sɔdom mini Gomɔra ni vinvamli la zaa polo n-nya ka nyɔhi din ŋmani mɔɣu din galisi pam buɣim nyɔhi la kpuɣi du zuɣusaa.
en: Abraham looked down into the valley toward the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah. He saw clouds of smoke rising from the land, like smoke from a furnace.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan nam neesim kara ayi n-chɛ ka din galisi pam la ne wuntaŋ ni, ka chɛ ka din pa di zuɣu mi ne yuŋ; ka daa nam saŋmarisi gba.
en: So God made the two larger lights, the sun to rule over the day and the moon to rule over the night; he also made the stars.

dag: Ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ suhuri ni tɛha maa ka bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bɔhiri yi suhuri dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu?.
en: But Jesus knew what they were thinking and said, Why do you have these questions in your minds?.

dag: Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba, Bundaan so n-daa mali tumtumdi kpɛma, ka bɛ ti nyih o ni o tumtumdi kpɛm maa bahir o buni maa yoli.
en: Jesus also said to the disciples, A certain rich man heard that his household manager was wasting his estate.

dag: Ka Ɛliab mi zuliya daa nyɛ Nɛmuɛl mini Datan ni Abiram. Datan mini Abiram daa nyɛla niriba ni daa pii shɛba. Bɛna n-daa pahi Kɔra min o nyaaŋa zuɣu n-taai duŋ niŋ Yawɛ, ka yɛli Musa mini Aduna finafina.
en: and the grandfather of Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These are the same Dathan and Abiram who had been chosen by the people, but who followed Korah and rebelled against Moses, Aaron, and the Lord .

dag: Amaa di nyɛ ma la talahi ni n gbaai soli zuŋɔ ni biɛɣuni zaŋ chaŋ dali; dama anabi bi kɔŋd o nyɛvili luɣ shɛli ka pa ni Jɛrusalɛm.
en: But I am going on my way today and tomorrow and the next day. After all, Jerusalem is the place where prophets are killed.

dag: Miri ka a yɛli, N ni niŋ n taba kaman bɛ ni niŋ ma shɛm. N ni niŋ ba yo bɛ ni niŋ shɛm samli.
en: or say to someone, I'll get even with you.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa daa duhi bɛ yee yɛli, Yihimila Barabas bahi, ka ku doo ŋɔ.
en: But with one voice they shouted, Away with this man! Release Barabbas to us. .

dag: Teemi ni a ni daa doli Bɔaz so paɣisara yihiri kayiha la nyɛla ti dɔɣira. Wumma, yuŋ ŋɔ o ni be kabɔɣili ni m-buri chi.
en: Boaz is our close relative. You worked with his women servants. Tonight he will be working at the threshing floor.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ, ti nyɛla daba m-be tiŋgbɔn shɛli a ni daa zaŋ ti ti yaannim maa ni hal ni zuŋɔ. A daa zaŋ li ti ba ni bɛ diri di tiwala, ka nyari di pin suma daanfaani.
en: So now today we are slaves, slaves in the land that you gave to our ancestors to enjoy its fruit and its good gifts.

dag: Ka Yisa tuumba pinaayi la daa boli Yisa nyaandol bɔbili maa na ti yɛli ba, Di bi simdi ni tinim chɛ Naawuni yɛligu tɔɣisibu ka kpalim bindira taribu ni.
en: The Twelve called a meeting of all the disciples and said, It isnt right for us to set aside proclamation of Gods word in order to serve tables.

dag: Paɣimiya Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma Yisa Masia Naawuni min o Ba ŋɔ. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ti Ba ŋun nyɛ nambɔzɔra mini suhumaabo zaa Naawuni.
en: Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. He is the Father who is full of mercy, the God of all comfort.

dag: Sa malimi shili biɛɣuni asiba n-du Sinai Zoli zuɣu na nti zaŋ amaŋ ti ma zoli maa zuɣu.
en: Be ready tomorrow morning and come up on Mount Sinai. Stand before me there on the top of the mountain.

dag: Sulemaana daa lan mali ʒiʒiriba tuhi pisopɔin mini kuɣikpɛriba tuhi pihinii zoya ni tiŋ la ni.
en: Solomon also forced , men to work in the hill country cutting stone. There were also , men to carry the stones.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika maa yɛli Manɔa, A yi gooi ma ʒili, n ku di yi bindirigu maa; amaa yi yi niŋ shili ni yi zaŋ li mali sara nyo buɣim, yin zaŋmiya li na ti ti Yawɛ.
en: The angel of the Lord said to Manoah, Even if you keep me from leaving, I will not eat your food. But if you want to prepare something, offer a burnt offering to the Lord .

dag: N nyaya ka ninvuɣ biɛri kul nahindila niriba ka duri zuɣusaa kaman Lɛbanɔn sida tihi la.
en: I myself have seen wicked powerful people, exalting themselves like a stately cedar.

dag: O ni daa di nam ka di ti paai yuma ata saha shɛli, ka o daa tim o kpambaliba, Bɛnheel mini Obadia ni Zakaria ni Nɛtanɛl ni Mikaya ni bɛ chaŋ Juda fɔntinsi ni ti wuhi niriba.
en: During the third year of Jehoshaphats rule, he sent his leaders to teach in the towns of Judah. These leaders were Ben Hail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel, and Micaiah.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Sintani, Ya polo ka a lee yina? Ka Sintani garigi yɛli Yawɛ, N yila dunia ni na, n chaŋmi ti gɔŋgo di ni ka chaŋchaŋ gili di ni.
en: The Lord asked him, Where have you been? Satan answered, I have been walking here and there, roaming around the earth.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be n yiŋa daa yɛra, Bɛnkam kpe yili ŋɔ na dirimi tiɣira.
en: Surely those in my tent never said: Who has been filled by Jobs food.

dag: Amaa yinim gbibi n ni zali zaligu shɛŋa, ka miriya ka yi ni tiŋbia bee saan so ŋun be yi sani tum din chihiri maa.
en: Now don't do these sickening things that make the land filthy. Instead, obey my laws and teachings.

dag: Yawɛ n-chɛ ka ti naba bari zaana, o nini yi tiɣi ti soli;.
en: The Lord guides us in the way we should go and protects those who please him.

dag: ni putɔɣu ni ninvuɣ kubo ni danyubo ni vuyɔbo yiriŋ ni din ŋmani dimbɔŋɔnima. N kpahiri yi zuɣu ni kaman n ni daa pun kpahi yi zuɣu ni shɛm la: Bɛn niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnima ti ku kpe Naawuni nam ni.
en: they are envious, get drunk, have orgies, and do other things like these. I warn you now as I have before: those who do these things will not possess the Kingdom of God.

dag: Ka Absalom daa zo nti be Gɛshur maa yuma ata.
en: After Absalom had run away to Geshur, he stayed there for three years.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Mani ka yi nyaɣi takɔbiri ka gbib kpahi kana ni yi ti gbaai kaman ŋmɛnditoli n-nyɛ ma maa?.
en: Jesus responded, Have you come with swords and clubs to arrest me, like an outlaw?.

dag: Bɛnjamin zuliya mini bɛ daŋ niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛla daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Bɛlanima; ka Ashibɛl daŋ niriba nyɛ Ashibɛlnima; ka Ahiram daŋ niriba nyɛ Ahiramnima;.
en: The tribe of Benjamin: the clans of Bela, Ashbel, Ahiram.

dag: Ka mɔɣ shɛli din pah ata yuli booni Tigiris. Dina n-zɔri kpari Asiria wulimpuhili polo. Ka mɔɣ shɛli din pah anahi mi yuli booni Yufretiiz.
en: The Tigris River that flows east of Assyria is the third, and the fourth is the Euphrates River.

dag: dindina a ni lan nya suhupiɛlli Kpiɔŋlan Naa sani, ka kpuɣ a zuɣu lihi ŋun Naawuni.
en: Then you will enjoy God All-Powerful, and you will look up to him.

dag: N vu n tiliginsim mirina, ka di shee bi wɔɣa. N tiliginsim maa kandina ku yuui. N ni tiligi Jɛrusalɛm, ka di ti Izraɛlnim jilima.
en: I will soon come to save you. I am not far away and will waste no time; I take pride in Israel and will save Jerusalem.

dag: Dama piɛguliba maa nyɛla jɛra, ka bi bɔhiri Yawɛ ni bɛ baŋ shɛli. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ bi tɔŋda, ka bɛ piɛri zaa wurim kpe yɔɣu.
en: I answered, Our leaders are stupid; they do not ask the Lord for guidance. This is why they have failed, and our people have been scattered.

dag: ka yɛli ba, Yi yi ni saɣi ka n sɔɣi n kpim maa kpe, yin wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ. Balimmiya Zɔhar bia Ɛfurɔn.
en: and said, If you are willing to let me bury my wife here, please ask Ephron son of Zohar.

dag: Hal Babilɔn naa kpambaliba tuumba ni daa kana ni bɛ ti bɔhi baŋ shihirili shɛli din niŋ o tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, Naawuni daa chɛ o mi ni o niŋ o ni bɔri shɛm, ka di chɛ ka o zahim o baŋ dinkam zaa be o suhu ni.
en: even in the matter of the ambassadors sent from Babylonian officials to find out about the miraculous sign that occurred in the land, when God had abandoned him in order to test him and to discover what was in his heart.

dag: O zaŋ kuɣikpɛra me ŋ-ŋari n soli. O chɛ ka n soya niŋla so gɔna.
en: He has blocked up my path with stones. He has made my path crooked.

dag: Di saha Dauda zuliya ni so ni ti leei naa, ka zaŋ ʒiɛyimtali mini yurilim su niriba. O ni ti niŋ din tuhi yomyom. Ka chɛ ka niriba doli din tuhi soli.
en: Then one of David's descendants will be king, and he will rule the people with faithfulness and love. He will be quick to do what is right, and he will see that justice is done.

dag: Ka o ni daa yɛli shɛm maa zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ bi tooi gbaag o o yɛtɔɣa ni niriba maa ninni, amaa ka o ni garigi ba shɛm maa daa gari ba pam, ka bɛ fo.
en: The men were amazed at his wise answer. They could say nothing. They were not able to trick Jesus there in front of the people. He said nothing they could use against him.

dag: Di saha ka Hushai daa yɛli Zadok mini Abiata bɛn daa nyɛ maligumaaniba la, Ahitɔfɛl ni yɛli Absalom mini Izraɛl kpamba shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, ka m mi yɛli ba shɛm m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Hushai told the priests, Zadok and Abiathar, what was said. He told them what Ahithophel suggested to Absalom and the leaders of Israel. Hushai also told them what he himself had suggested. He said.

dag: Yinim bɛn bi ʒe yim ŋɔ, labimiyana. N ni yihi ya yi bi ʒiɛyimtali maa ni. Ti ka a sanna, dama nyini n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni.
en: I will tell them, Come back, and I will cure you of your unfaithfulness. They will answer, We will come back, because you are the Lord our God.

dag: Yawɛ, di chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri suhuyubu niŋ; di chɛ ka bɛ di nasara bɛ ni lo nia biɛ shɛŋa ni.
en: Lord , don't give the wicked what they want; don't let their plots succeed.

dag: Dama yi nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ m-pii ya dunia ŋɔ niriba zaa sunsuuni n-zaŋ ya leeg o niriba bɛn nyɛ o ninvuɣ gahinda.
en: Do this because you belong to the Lord your God. From all the peoples on earth he chose you to be his own special people.

dag: Dama niriba lala tatabo bi doli ti Duuma Yisa Masia, amaa bɛmaŋmaŋ kɔre ka bɛ doli, ka mali yɛtɔɣ suma mini naŋgbammalisim yɔhindi bɛn tɛha bi zilima.
en: People like that are not serving our Lord Christ. They are only pleasing themselves. They use fancy talk and say nice things to fool those who dont know about evil.

dag: Daadam, yɛlim Ijipti naa Firawuna min o niriba zaa: A galisim lee ŋmanila ŋuni?.
en: Human one, say to Pharaoh, Egypts king, and his troops: With whom do you compare in your greatness?.

dag: Dinzuɣu suhimiya Naawuni ka o chɛ ka yɛla ŋɔ ti ku niŋ tu kikaa saha;.
en: Pray that these things will not happen in winter.

dag: Bɛ bili paɣiba Ziɔn tiŋ puuni, ka bili paɣisara bɛn na ʒi dɔbba Juda fɔntinsi ni.
en: On Zion and everywhere in Judah our wives and daughters are being raped.

dag: Di saha ka Hilikia bia Ɛliakim ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la ni Jɔa bia Asaf ŋun daa su bɛ ni sab gban shɛŋa sɔŋ tuma la daa dari tɔhi bɛ binyɛra, ka ŋmaligi lab Hɛzɛkia sani nti yɛl o Rabishake ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Then the palace manager , the royal secretary , and the record keeper went to Hezekiah. Their clothes were torn to show they were upset. They told Hezekiah everything the Assyrian commander had said.

dag: Di bi simdi ka bɛ ti be yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni, di yi pa lala, bɛ ni chɛ ka yi tum alahichi zaŋ chaŋ n sani, dama yi yi ti jɛm bɛ buɣa maa, di ni leei tɔna gbahi ya.
en: Do not let those people live in your country; if you do, they will make you sin against me. If you worship their gods, it will be a fatal trap for you.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni malaika daa yɛli ma zahindi maa ni, Yaakubu, ka n saɣi yɛli, N-nyɛ ma.
en: In the dream, Gods messenger said to me, Jacob! and I said, Im here.

dag: Chɛ ka m min a laɣi tab zɔri kaman a ba mini m ba ni daa be shɛm la. Nyama, Anzinfa mini salima ŋɔ, n zaŋ li mi ti a pini. Larigim a mini Izraɛl Naa Baasha zɔsimdi alikauli la din ni chɛ ka o zaŋ o tɔbbihi yiɣisi ka chɛ ma.
en: Lets make a covenant similar to the one between our fathers. Since I have already sent you silver and gold, break your covenant with Israels King Baasha so that he will leave me alone.

dag: Ka o yi bi tooi deeg omaŋ soya ŋɔ zaa puuni, dindina bɛn bahim o min o bihi nɛma labisi ti yuuni maa ni.
en: If they are not set free in any of these ways, they and their children must be set free in the next Year of Restoration.

dag: Ka n lu tiŋa ka wum kukol shɛli damli ka di booni ma yɛra, Sool, Sool, bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋdi ma alaka.
en: I fell to the ground and heard a voice asking me, Saul, Saul, why are you harassing me.

dag: Di simdi ka o zaŋ kawana lita pinaayopɔin ni pirigili pahi naɣilaa kam zuɣu, ka lan zaŋ kawana lita pinaayopɔin ni pirigili pahi piɛlaa kam zuɣu m-mali sara din nyɛ o chi min o kawana sara, ka bo kpam lita ata pahi kawaan tahili kam zuɣu.
en: For each bull and each ram that is sacrificed, there is to be an offering of half a bushel of grain and three quarts of olive oil.

dag: Ka n yi kariti alizin biɛri Biilzibul yiko ni, ka ŋun mi yiko ni ka yi niriba lee kariti ba bahira? Dinzuɣu yimaŋmaŋ niriba maa ni zaŋ yi nol ni yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi luhi ya.
en: You say that I drive out demons because Beelzebul gives me the power to do so. Well, then, who gives your followers the power to drive them out? What your own followers do proves that you are wrong!.

dag: Ti ku lab ti yinsi faashee ka Izraɛlnim zaa ti nya bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbana.
en: And we wont return to our homes until each one of the Israelites takes possession of his property.

dag: O daa yɛliya, N Duuma Naawuni, bɛ ku a daanabinima, ka wurim a sara malibu bimbina, ka n kɔŋko n-kpalim ka bɛ bɔri ni bɛ yihi man gba nyɛvili.
en: Lord, they have killed your prophets and torn down your altars; I am the only one left, and they are trying to kill me.

dag: zaɣ yino ku paai n ni daa po ni n ni chɛ ka yi be tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni la naɣila Jɛfune bia Kalɛb mini Nan bia Jɔshua kɔŋko.
en: I promised to let you live there, but not one of you will, except Caleb and Joshua.

dag: Nyamya, n ni tim anabi Ilaija yi sanna pɔi ka Yawɛ dabisi titali din mali dabiɛm maa dali naanyi paai.
en: I, the Lord , promise to send the prophet Elijah before that great and terrible day comes.

dag: N ni zaŋ a min a ma ŋun dɔɣ a labi bɛ ni daa bi dɔɣi ya tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni, ka yi ti kpi nimaani.
en: I will throw you and your mother into another country where neither of you was born. You and your mother will die in that country.

dag: Paɣimiya Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma Yisa Masia Ba ŋun niŋ alibarika kam din nyɛ alizanda ni alibarika niŋ ti ni Masia zuɣu ŋɔ!.
en: Praise the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ for the spiritual blessings that Christ has brought us from heaven!.

dag: Amaa ka Iso yɛl o, M mabia, mal a bini; n gba bi kɔŋ.
en: But Esau said, I have enough, my brother; keep what you have.

dag: Binshɛɣukam din beni nyɛla bɛ ni pun zali shɛli, ka ninsalinim biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm bi sɔɣi. Ka bɛ mi ku tooi ŋme ŋun gari ba kpiɔŋ naŋgbankpeeni.
en: Everything that happens was decided long ago. We humans know what we are like, and we can't argue with God, because he is too strong for us.

dag: M pun yɛl o ni n ni darig o yiŋnim tibili hal ni saha din ka bahigu, tuumbiɛ shɛli yɛla o ni pun mila zuɣu, dama o bihi mɔri man Naawuni ka o bi yihi ba di ni.
en: I told him that I would punish his family forever because of the wrongdoing he knew about—how his sons were cursing God, but he wouldnt stop them.

dag: Gol so ŋun pah ayopɔin maa biɛɣ pinaanu dali, yin laɣimmiya jɛm Naawuni, ka di tumiya tuun shɛli, ka zaŋya daba ayopɔin puhi Yawɛ chuɣu.
en: There will be a special meeting on the th day of the seventh month. You must not do any work on that day. You must celebrate a special festival for the Lord for seven days.

dag: Ka gbaŋŋmara maa daa yɛl lala n-naai ka yɛli salo maa ni bɛ wurimma.
en: After he said this, he dismissed the assembly.

dag: N dana, daŋmi man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ tooni, ka m mali biŋkɔbiri maa mini bihi maa chani biɛlabiɛla na hal ti paag a Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: My master, go on ahead of your servant, but Ive got to take it easy, going only as fast as the animals in front of me and the children are able to go, until I meet you in Seir.

dag: Naawuni mini Yisa Masia ŋun ni ti kari bɛn ne mini bɛn kpi saria la sani n zal a, Yisa Masia labbuna min o nam dibu la zuɣu, niŋmi dimbɔŋɔnima:.
en: Before God and Jesus Christ, I give you a command. Christ Jesus is the one who will judge all people—those who are living and those who have died. He is coming again to rule in his kingdom. So I give you this command:.

dag: Ɛvilmɛrɔdak daa tɔɣisi Naa Jɛhoyachin nirilim yɛtɔɣa, ka ti o jilima ʒiishee n-gari na shɛb bɛn daa be o sani Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Evil-merodach treated him kindly and gave him a position of greater honor than he gave the other kings who were exiles with him in Babylonia.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋdi bɔrɔbɔro din be kasi tamdi teebuli maa zuɣu n-zaani n tooni sahakam.
en: Set the bread of the presence on the table so it is always in front of me.

dag: Yawɛ moli molo gili dunia ŋɔ zaa yɛli: Yɛlimiya Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga, nyama, a tiligira kana, ka laara mini yɔri be o sani.
en: Here is what the Lord has said for all the earth to hear: Soon I will come to save the city of Zion and to reward you.

dag: Zara daa lan yɛli, Ŋuni n-daa naan yɛli Ibrahimma ni bihi ni ti mɔɣi man Zara biha. Amaa m bahi dɔɣi bia ti o, o ninkurilim ŋɔ ni.
en: Then she added, Who would have said to Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? Yet I have borne him a son in his old age.

dag: Yi yi shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋyɛriba, yin chɛliya ka yi mabi yino kpalim be sarika ŋɔ ni, ka chɛ ka yi bɛn kpalim ʒi bindira kuli ti ti kum ni mali yi yiŋnim shɛb maa.
en: If you are honest men, one of your brothers can stay here in prison, and the others can go and carry grain back to your people.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun mali yɛm, sɔɣirila o milinsi, amaa jɛra bɛn kul moonila bɛ jɛrilim.
en: Be sensible and don't tell everything you know— only fools spread foolishness everywhere.

dag: ni Ɛlishama ni Ɛliada ni Ɛlifɛlɛt bɛ daa nyɛla niriba awɛi.
en: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet—nine in all.

dag: mini yɛdaniŋdiba bɛn laɣind o yiŋ la ni ti tizɔpaɣa Afia ni Aakipus ŋun nyɛ ti tɔbbikpee la.
en: Apphia our sister, Archippus our fellow soldier, and the church that meets in your house.

dag: Dinzuɣu zuliya kam wummiya, ka baŋ binshɛli din yɛn niŋ ba.
en: So I tell all nations on earth, Watch what I will do!.

dag: O ni daa kpe yili maa ni ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi kumdi ka fabindi lala? Bipuɣiŋga maa bi kpi, amaa o gbihirimi.
en: He went in and said to them, Why all this confusion? Why are you crying? The child is not dead—she is only sleeping.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisifu daa yɛl o tumtumdiba bɛn nyɛ tima baŋdiba ni bɛ niŋm tim ʒe o ba niŋgbuŋ ka di ku pooi. Ka tima baŋdiba maa daa niŋ tim ʒe Izraɛl niŋgbuŋ.
en: Joseph then ordered the physicians in his service to embalm his father, and the physicians embalmed Israel.

dag: Bɛ ni nyu li hal ti ʒiɛhira, ka bɛ yɛma fa, n ni yɛn zaŋ takɔb shɛli liri ba maa zuɣu.
en: They will vomit and act crazy, because of the war this cup of anger will bring to them.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ dimnim yiɣisi lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: The Lord found people to go up and fight against Rezin. He stirred up Rezins enemies.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: Then I received another message from the Lord . He said.

dag: dama ninvuɣ so ŋun kpi yi alahichi dabitim ni.
en: Anyone who has died is made free from sins control.

dag: Ka o yi bi yo di zuɣu ka deei li yuuni maa puuni, dindina yili din be bɛ ni me goondaa gili tin shɛli ni maa ni leela ŋun da li maa dini sahakam o ʒiɛman ni, ka di bi simdi ka bɛ ti deei li nɛma labisi ti yuuni la ni.
en: If it is not bought back before a full year has passed, the house in the walled city will belong to the buyer permanently and their descendants forever. It will not be released at the Jubilee.

dag: N ni ŋmalig a gili n-zaŋ ziŋgɔhi ga a yɛno n-vo a min a tɔbbihi zaa ni a yuri ni a wɔribariba bɛn zaa ye gbaɣinɔnima, ka nyɛ bɛn galisi pam ka gbibi nyɔtaɣiri kara mini nyɔtaɣiri bihi ni takɔbiri ŋɔ zaa yina.
en: and I will make you powerless! I will put a hook in your jaw and drag away both you and your large army. You command cavalry troops that wear heavy armor and carry shields and swords.

dag: Ka bɛ zaɣ yino kam daa ku o mini ŋun nyɔɣu yo taba. Ka Sirianim maa daa ŋmaligi guui, ka Izraɛlnim kari doli ba, amaa ka Siria Naa Bɛnhadad daa ba wɔhu pahi wɔribariba ni n-zo n-tiligi.
en: Each of the men of Israel killed the man who had come against him. So the men from Aram began to run away and the army of Israel chased them. King Ben-Hadad escaped on a horse with the chariots.

dag: Do so niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ yi mali bimmɔriŋ bee yum bee dalinli, ka di ti leei niŋgbuŋ dɔro o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ zuɣu, dindina bɛn zaŋm o tahi Aduna ŋun nyɛ maligumaana la sani bee o bidibisi bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la ni yino sani.
en: If any of you have a sore on your skin or a boil or an inflammation which could develop into a dreaded skin disease, you shall be brought to the Aaronite priest.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ pala binshɛli din ka buchi yi sani, amaa di nyɛla yimaŋmaŋ nyɛvili. Di puuni ka yi ni ti mali nyɛvili wɔɣinli m-be yi ni yɛn du Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili chaŋ ti deei tiŋgbɔn shɛli su maa ni.
en: This is no trivial matter for you—this is your very life! It is by this means alone that you will prolong your life on the fertile land you are crossing the Jordan River to possess.

dag: Ka naa maa daa bɔhi ma, Yuma ala ka a yɛn niŋ nimaani, ka bɔ saha ka a yɛn labina? Di saha o paani daa ʒimi baɣ o. Ka di daa niŋ naa nyaɣisim ni o tim ma, ka n daa yɛl o n ni yɛn labina saha shɛli.
en: With the queen sitting beside him, the king asked me, How long will you be away and when will you return? So it pleased the king to send me, and I told him how long I would be gone.

dag: kaman yuun kɔbisinahi ni pihinu. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa ti ba zuɣulaannima m-mali hal ti paai Anabi Samuɛl saha.
en: This happened over a period of about four hundred fifty years. After this, he gave them judges until the time of the prophet Samuel.

dag: Naawuni di saɣi ka n nyɛ sana m-be Mɛshɛk. O mi di saɣi ka m be Kɛdar suɣa ni.
en: How I hate living here among these people! Its like living in Meshech or in the tents of Kedar.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Naawuni daa yɛli Nuhu min o bidibisi maa.
en: God said to Noah and to his sons with him.

dag: Nyini n-zaŋ ba sɔɣi sɔɣibu shee a sani, ka ninsalinim ku tooi niŋ ba zaɣ biɛɣu. A gbib ba a ni zaŋ ba niŋ a sani luɣ shɛli maa viɛnyɛliŋga; ka so ku tooi paa ba tu ba.
en: You hide them in the safety of your presence from the plots of others; in a safe shelter you hide them from the insults of their enemies.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi yi ti baai du Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili maa, yin zaŋmiya n ni zaani ya zaligu shɛŋa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni be kuɣu shɛŋa ni ŋɔ ti sa Ɛbal zoli zuɣu, ka niŋ tari ta li.
en: Once you have crossed over the Jordan River, set up these stones that Im telling you about right now on Mount Ebal. Cover them with plaster.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa ni nim suhuri daa paligi pam.
en: What a happy day this was for that city!.

dag: amaa ka je Iso. N daa chɛ ka o tiŋ din be zoya ni la leei dabari, ka o tiŋgbani leei tiŋgban nɛli din nyɛ yɔbahi biɛhigu shee.
en: instead of Esau. And I turned Esau's hill country into a barren desert where jackals roam.

dag: A ni daa bi doli wuntia soli n-niŋ daabiligu, ka tum alahichi pam zuɣu daa chɛ ka a saɣim a jɛmbu duri. Dinzuɣu ka buɣim yi a ni na n-di a zaa; ka n daa chɛ ka a leei tampiligim do tiŋa bɛn zaa daa nya a ninni.
en: Because of your corrupt trade, which surpassed your many other sins, you made your sanctuaries impure. Therefore, I will bring fire from your midst. When it has consumed you, I will turn you into dust on the earth in the sight of all who see you.

dag: Ka Hiram daa chɛ ka o kpambaliba zaŋ ŋarima mini tumtumdiba bɛn mili teeku nti ti o, ka bɛ mini Sulemaana tumtumdiba daa chaŋ Ofiri nti ʒi salima din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram tuhi pinaanu na ti ti Naa Sulemaana.
en: King Hiram sent him ships under the command of his own officers and with experienced sailors. They sailed with Solomon's officers to the land of Ophir and brought back to Solomon about sixteen tons of gold.

dag: Mɛmiya tinsi ti yi bihi ka me piɛri buzɔna ti yi piɛri mini yi buhi, ka niŋ kaman yi ni lo alikauli ni yi ni niŋ shɛm maa.
en: So build towns for your children and walled enclosures for your flocks, but do what you have promised.

dag: Di bi simdi ni yi nyɛ suhutunanima, amaa chɛliya ka yi biɛhigu bemi kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa niŋ yɛda ka mali suɣilo la biɛhigu, ka di chɛ ka yi nya Naawuni ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛŋa la palibu.
en: Then you would never be lazy. You would be following the example of those who had faith and were patient until God kept his promise to them.

dag: Niŋmiya tuuba, dama alizanda nam mirina.
en: Turn away from your sins, he said, because the Kingdom of heaven is near.

dag: Ti ku zaŋ li sɔɣi ti bihi, ti ni zaŋ Yawɛ jilima tuma min o tuun kara ni o daalahiziba tuun shɛŋa o ni tum la yɛla yɛli ʒiɛmana din kanna niriba.
en: And we will not forget it. Our people will be telling this story to the last generation. We will all praise the Lord and tell about the amazing things he did.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, N dana, pɔŋ pia la pun be o sani.
en: But Master, they said, he already has ten times as much.

dag: Ka zom maa kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi ka yɛli, N nya niriba ka bɛ chana; amaa bɛ ŋmanila tihi.
en: The man looked up and said, I see people, but they look like trees walking around.

dag: n-chaŋ Taai birini la mini Hivinim ni Keenannim tinsi zaa ni. Ka bɛ daa lan yi nimaani chaŋ Nɛgɛb din be Juda tiŋgban ni Bɛrishiiba polo la.
en: They came to the fortress of Tyre, then went through every town of the Hivites and the Canaanites. Finally, they went to Beersheba in the Southern Desert of Judah.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ nyɛla Yaakubu mini Reechɛl zuliya. Bɛ zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaanahi.
en: These were the sons of Jacob from his wife Rachel. There were people in this family.

dag: Bɛ puri ni tihi ni ti wali wala, ka tiŋgbani ni bindira niŋ. Bɛ ni ti be bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ni alaafee. N yi kabisi dapuhi din pa bɛ nyiŋgoya zuɣu la, ka fa ba ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋ ba leei daba nuu ni bahi, bɛ ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: The trees in the field will bear fruit, and the earth will yield its harvest. They will be safe on their fertile land, and they will know that I am the LORD when I break the bars of their yoke and deliver them from those who enslaved them.

dag: Di saha maa ka bɛ ni ti nya Daadam Bia ka o be sagban ni kanna ni yiko mini jilima pam.
en: Then the Son of Man will be seen, coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Abiata, N ni daa kul nya Doɛg Ɛdom nir la dindali maa, n daa pun baŋ ni o ni yɛli Sool di yɛla. Mani n-nyɛ ŋun bo kum ti a ba daŋ ŋɔ zaa maa.
en: David told Abiathar, That day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, I knew that he would tell Saul everything. I am to blame for the deaths in your fathers family.

dag: Bɛ ni ti boli ba, Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi, ka nyɛ Yawɛ ni tiligi shɛba. Jɛrusalɛm, bɛ ni ti bol a la, Tiŋ gahindili, ka lan bol a, Tin shɛli din be kasi, ka Naawuni bi zaɣis a.
en: Then you will be called, The Lord 's Own People, The Ones He Rescued! Your city will be known as a good place to live and a city full of people.

dag: Bɛ ni teei wula, ka bɛ viɛlim ti ŋman olivi tihi viɛlim. Ka bɛ nyom ti viɛl kaman Lɛbanɔn nyom la.
en: Your branches will spread with the beauty of an olive tree and with the aroma of Lebanon Forest.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔhi, Ka Izraɛl daŋ niriba ni banima n-lee bi ka Mizipa na Naawuni san la? Ka bɛ yɛli, Jabɛshi din be Giliad la nima m-bi ka laɣiŋgu maa ni na maa.
en: When they asked if there was some group out of the tribes of Israel that had not gone to the gathering at Mizpah, they found out that no one from Jabesh in Gilead had been there;.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ alikauli la niŋ adaka maa puuni, ka zaŋ dapuhi la niŋ adaka maa, ka zaŋ adaka maa yɔrigu yo li.
en: Moses took the Agreement and put it in the Holy Box. He put the poles on the Box and put the mercy-cover on it.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee zali dimbɔŋɔ ka niŋ li, ka wuhi ʒiɛmana yɛla piligu ni zaŋ kana? Man Yawɛ n-daa beni piligu ni, ka ni lan beni naabu ni.
en: Who was it that made this happen? Who has determined the course of history? I, the Lord , was there at the beginning, and I, the Lord , will be there at the end.

dag: Ŋmaligim a nini ka chɛ ma, dama di gbaari ma! A zabiri yirigirimi kaman buhi ni zɔri sirigiri Giliad Zoli zuɣu shɛm la.
en: Dont look at me! Your eyes excite me too much! And your hair is long and flowing, like little goats dancing down the slopes of Mount Gilead.

dag: Ka binshɛɣu kani din sɔɣiri ka ti ku yi zahira, ka binshɛɣu mi kani m-be ashilɔni ka bɛ ku baŋ di yɛla ka di yi palo.
en: Whatever is hidden away will be brought out into the open, and whatever is covered up will be found and brought to light.

dag: N yura, a viɛli pam. Yɛlimaŋli, a shiri viɛli pam. Ti bindoo nyɛla momaha.
en: My love, you are handsome, truly handsome— the fresh green grass will be our wedding bed.

dag: Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bi baŋdi n yɛligu gbinni? Yi ni bi deeri n yɛligu maa zuɣu n-chɛ ka yi bi baŋdi di gbinni maa.
en: Why do you not understand what I say? It is because you cannot bear to listen to my message.

dag: Sabbu maa ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: MENE, MENE, TƐKƐL UFARISIN.
en: These are the words that were written on the wall: mene, mene, tekel, uparsin .

dag: Amaa o di ti miri sariga la gbinna bee n-ka sara maligu bimbini la gbinna, dama o nyɛla ŋun mali dalinli, ka lala chɛ ka o ku dihi n luɣ kasi shee ŋɔ vi; dama mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun mali ba ka bɛ be kasi.
en: But he cannot go through the curtain into the Most Holy Place and he cannot go near the altar. This is because he has something wrong with him. He must not make my holy places unholy. I am the Lord , and I make these places holy.

dag: ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka ʒiɛmana din kanna niriba ti mi li, ka bɛ ni na bi dɔɣi bi shɛb gba ti yiɣisina n-zaŋ li wuhi bɛ bihi.
en: so that the next generation might learn them and in turn should tell their children.

dag: Naawuni, n niŋ a naani zaa; n shiri niŋ a naani zaa! N ni yili yila ni kukoli nyaɣisili niŋ a.
en: I am faithful to you, and you can trust me. I will sing and play music for you, my God.

dag: Yi bindir daŋda dina, yi ni tooi zaŋ li na ti ti Yawɛ, amaa di bi simdi ka yi nyo li buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu ni di leei din nyom viɛla.
en: An offering of the first grain that you harvest each year shall be brought to the Lord , but it is not to be burned on the altar.

dag: Buɣim yirila o sani n-chani ti diri o dimnim bɛn gil o luɣilikam zaa.
en: Fire leaps from his throne, destroying his enemies.

dag: Ka o ʒiʒiinitab min o dɔɣiriba daa wum ti Duuma ni zo o nambɔ shɛli maa yɛla, ka di niŋ bɛ min o zaa suhupiɛlli pam.
en: Her neighbors and relatives heard how wonderfully good the Lord had been to her, and they all rejoiced with her.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ biliɛri fiɛbi bina chɛrisichɛrisi bɛ ninni, ka ʒe bɛ yinsi nɛma, ka bili bɛ paɣiba.
en: They will see their children beaten against rocks, their homes robbed, and their wives abused.

dag: Yɛtɔɣili la nyɛla yɛlimaŋli: Ti min o yi daa laɣim kpi, ti min o ni ti lan laɣim be.
en: This saying is reliable: If we have died together, we will also live together.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa tim Neetan Dauda sani, ka o daa chaŋ ti yɛl o, Niriba ayi n-daa be tin shɛli, yino daa nyɛla bundana, ka ŋun la mi nyɛ faralana.
en: The Lord sent Nathan to David. Nathan went to him and said, There were two men in a city. One man was rich, but the other man was poor.

dag: Di ni ti nyɛla bɛ ni mali maligumaaniba shɛba ka bɛ be kasi, ka nyɛ Zadok zuliya bɛn doli n zaligu la dini. Bɛna n-daa bi birigi kaman Lɛvinim ni daa niŋ shɛm saha shɛli Izraɛlnim ni daa birigi la.
en: Only priests who are descendants of Zadok will receive a share of this sacred land, because they remained faithful to me when the Levites and the rest of the Israelites started sinning.

dag: Yisa ni daa kpe ŋariŋ maa ni lan baai du duli ha nti ʒe teeku noli ka salo pam daa lan laɣim o sanna.
en: Once again Jesus got into the boat and crossed Lake Galilee. Then as he stood on the shore, a large crowd gathered around him.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, Miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka so birigi ya;.
en: Jesus answered, Watch out, and do not let anyone fool you.

dag: Ka o daa yihi ti nimaani na nti zaŋ o ni daa po pɔri ni o ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ti yaannim la ti ti.
en: But the Lord brought us out from there so that he could bring us in, giving us the land that he swore to our ancestors.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli soli din tuhi nyɛla bɛn zɔri Yawɛ, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali biɛriyoli ʒiɛmd o mi.
en: Be honest and you show that you have reverence for the Lord ; be dishonest and you show that you do not.

dag: Bimbɔ zuɣu ka di daantalisi daa lee tamiya? Bee ŋuni n-daa lee sɔŋ di tuuli tampuɣili?.
en: What supports the foundation? Who placed the cornerstone.

dag: Ka Musa daa chani nti paai luɣ shɛli gbe nimaani, ka Yawɛ daa kana ti bɔri ni o ku o.
en: On the way to Egypt, Moses stopped at a place to spend the night. The Lord met Moses at that place and tried to kill him.

dag: Alizin biɛri daa yi nya o saha shɛlikam, bɛ lurila o tooni ka kuhiri yɛra, A nyɛla Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ Bia.
en: Some people had evil spirits inside them. When the evil spirits saw Jesus, they bowed before him and shouted, You are the Son of God.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Nail Mɔɣili kom nyuui, ka n zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa niŋ ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni. N ni ti chɛ ka tinzunnim saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ maa n-tabili binshɛɣukam din be di ni. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will dry up the Nile and put Egypt under the power of evil people. Foreigners will devastate the whole country. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, bɛ ni daa na bi dɔɣi Ibrahimma saha shɛl la, man daa pun beni.
en: Jesus answered, The fact is, before Abraham was born, I AM.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Ilaisha daa ti ka Damaskus na. Di saha maa ka Siria Naa Bɛnhadad daa biɛra. Ka bɛ daa yɛl o, Naawuni nir la be yaŋɔ.
en: Elisha went to Damascus at a time when King Benhadad of Syria was sick. When the king was told that Elisha was there.

dag: Chɛ ka o dabisa filim, ka so deeg o zaani zani.
en: May his life soon be ended; may someone else take his job!.

dag: Ka Ɛhab ni daa chaŋ ni o ti di ka nyu saha shɛli maa, ka Ilaija daa du Kamɛl Zoli zuɣu nti kurim n-zaŋ o nini kpa o duna;.
en: While Ahab went to eat, Elijah climbed to the top of Mount Carmel, where he bowed down to the ground, with his head between his knees.

dag: Bɛ dɔɣ ti la Yɛhudianima, ka ti pala bɛn pa Yɛhudianim bɛn nyɛ alahichinim ŋɔ.
en: We are born Jews—were not Gentile sinners.

dag: Ka Amazia daa niŋ suhukpeeni n-gari tooni zaŋ o niriba maa chaŋ Yalim Vinvamli la ni nti ku Ɛdomnim maa ninvuɣ tuhi pia.
en: Amaziah summoned up his courage and led his army to Salt Valley. There they fought and killed ten thousand Edomite soldiers.

dag: N ni chɛ ka sida tihi mini akasia tihi ni mitil tihi ni olivi tihi ni sipirɛs ni oki tihi ni gahi ti galisi mɔɣu ni.
en: I will fill the desert with all kinds of trees— cedars, acacias, and myrtles; olive and cypress trees; fir trees and pines.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Di lan booni ya ma Naomi, amaa bolimiya ma la Mara, dama Kpiɔŋlan Naa chɛ ka n nya naŋgbantom.
en: Then she told them, Don't call me Naomi any longer! Call me Mara, because God has made my life bitter.

dag: dindina n gba ni chɛn ya, ka mmaŋmaŋ ni ti ŋmɛn ya buyopɔin yi daalahichi zuɣu.
en: then I will also turn against you. I—yes, I myself—will punish you seven times for your sins.

dag: Jɔab ni daa chɛ ka bɛ teei gili tiŋ maa, ka o zaŋ Yuria zali o ni mi ni tɔbutuhiri biinsi be shɛli polo.
en: So while Joab was besieging the city, he sent Uriah to a place where he knew the enemy was strong.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni chɛ ka muɣisigu ŋɔ paai niriba ka bɛ ti chani kaman zoomba la, bɛ ni tum alahichi man Yawɛ sani zuɣu. Bɛ ʒim ni yi n-zɔri kaman kom la. Ka bɛ niŋgbuna ti dɔni tiŋgban ni pooi.
en: The Lord says, I will bring such disasters on the human race that everyone will grope about like someone blind. They have sinned against me, and now their blood will be poured out like water, and their dead bodies will lie rotting on the ground.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Hal Musa mini Samuɛl yi di ʒe n tooni, n naan ku ŋmaligi n suhu kpa niriba ŋɔ polo. Zaŋmi ba miligi n sani n-chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: Then the Lord said to me, Even if Moses and Samuel were standing here pleading with me, I would not show these people any mercy. Make them go away; make them get out of my sight.

dag: O daa lan zali Obɛdɛdom min o mabihi ninvuɣ pisopɔinayika la gba; ka Obɛdɛdom ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛdutun bia la mini Hɔsa mi daa nyɛ dunɔguliba.
en: Obed-Edom and of his relatives were their assistants, and Hosah and Obed-Edom the son of Jeduthun were the guards.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ maa gba chɛmi ka n suhu dam, ka yiɣi yi di biɛhigu shee.
en: The storm makes my heart beat wildly.

dag: A yiŋ bindira din galisi la ka bɛ dira; ka a tiri ba bin suma din be kaman mɔɣili kom din zɔra ka bɛ nyura.
en: They feast on the bounty of your house; you let them drink from your river of pure joy.

dag: Yisa daa lan bɔhi ba, Bɔ ka n lee kul yɛn zaŋ ŋmahindi Naawuni nam?.
en: Again he said, To what can I compare Gods kingdom?.

dag: Di simdi ni karimbia bemi kaman o karimba; ka dabili mi be kaman o duuma. Ka bɛ yi zaŋ alizin biɛri naa yuli Biilzibul m-boli yil yidana, wula ka bɛ lee ni bol o yiŋnim bɛna.
en: So a pupil should be satisfied to become like his teacher, and a slave like his master. If the head of the family is called Beelzebul, the members of the family will be called even worse names!.

dag: Yawɛ, ti zaa nyɛla a niriba, dinzuɣu, di chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi hal ti yaɣi. A mi di gbibi ti taali sahakam.
en: Don't be so furious or keep our sins in your thoughts forever! Remember that all of us are your people.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ din ni tiɣi Yawɛ nini gari nir yi zaŋ naɣila lantabili bee naɣilaa ni yila ni takarifiɛma mali sara.
en: The Lord will be happier with this than with the offering of an ox or a full-grown bull as a sacrifice.

dag: Ka so shɛli din kuni nyɛvili shee dolibu mi to, ka di dunoli nyɛ duno muɣiliŋga, ka niriba bɛn mi dol li bi yaɣ lala.
en: But the gate that opens the way to true life is narrow. And the road that leads there is hard to follow. Only a few people find it.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda daa yɛli, Bolimiya maligumaana Zadok mini anabi Neetan ni Bɛnaaya Jɛhɔiada bia la ti ma. Ka bɛ daa ka naa sanna.
en: Then King David sent for Zadok, Nathan, and Benaiah. When they came in.

dag: Hal o ni fa bɛn mali taali bahi. Dinzuɣu yihim daɣiri a kɔbili ni ka o tilig a.
en: Even those who are guilty will be forgiven, because you obey God.

dag: Yawɛ, niŋmi alibarika niŋ o ni mali shɛli ni, ka chɛ ka a nini tiɣi o nuhi tuma. Kum o dimnim bɛn je ba la zuliya, ka bɛ ku lan neei yaha.
en: Lord , help their tribe to grow strong; Be pleased with what they do. Crush all their enemies; Let them never rise again.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi n-kɔri ba ti alizinnima.
en: They offered their own sons and daughters as sacrifices to the idols of Canaan.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Jɛrusalɛmnim mini Judanim ni daa chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi zuɣu ka o daa kari ba o sani bahi.
en: It was Zedekiah who finally rebelled against Nebuchadnezzar. The people of Judah and Jerusalem had made the Lord so angry that he turned his back on them. That's why these horrible things were happening.

dag: N daa zaŋla nirilim mihi vo ba chaŋ. N daa zaŋla yurilim mihi niŋ ba, ka leei ŋun yihi bin tibisi shɛŋa din ga bɛ noya la, ka silim tiŋa n-dihi ba bindirigu.
en: I drew them to me with affection and love. I picked them up and held them to my cheek; I bent down to them and fed them.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔsia daa bo o dahalali piɛbihi pola mini bubihi pola, ka bɛ zaa kalinli daa yiɣisi tuhi pihita ni naɣilahi tusaata n-zaŋ ba ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be nimaani ni bɛ mali Yaɣigari chuɣu sara.
en: For the use of the people at the Passover, King Josiah contributed from his own herds and flocks , sheep, lambs, and young goats, and , bulls.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni ti di yi tuma nyɔri, ka di yi nia biɛri tiɣi.
en: They will eat from the fruit of their way, and theyll be full of their own schemes.

dag: Dauda bia Sulemaana ŋun daa nyɛ Izraɛl naa la ŋaha.
en: The proverbs of Solomon, King Davids son, from Israel.

dag: Nuhu daa nyɛla pukpara, ŋuna n-daa nyɛ ŋun tuui biri wain tihi. O daa birila wain tihi.
en: Noah, a farmer, made a new start and planted a vineyard.

dag: Nir yi gbaag omaŋa ka chɛ zabili, di tir o jilima, amaa jɛrigu kam ŋun bɔrila zabili yomyom.
en: Any fool can start arguments; the honorable thing is to stay out of them.

dag: Di bi simdi ni nir di shiri pam bee m-bɔri jilima ti yaɣi.
en: Too much honey is bad for you, and so is trying to win too much praise.

dag: Yisa min o tuumba maa ni daa ti lan laɣim ka bɛ bɔh o, Ti Duuma, a ni chɛ ka lzraɛlnim nam lan kpe bɛ nuu ni pumpɔŋɔ.
en: As a result, those who had gathered together asked Jesus, Lord, are you going to restore the kingdom to Israel now.

dag: Ka shihir karili daa puhi zani alizanda ni. Paɣ so n-daa ye wuntaŋa kaman chinchini la, ka goli be o naba tiŋli, ka nam zuɣupiligu din mali saŋmarisi pinaayi pil o zuɣu.
en: Something important appeared in the sky. It was a woman whose clothes were the sun. The moon was under her feet, and a crown made of twelve stars was on her head.

dag: Naawuni ni yɛri alikauli palli yɛla maa, di wuhiya ni o lihi tuuli din maa la zaɣ kurili. Ka binshɛli din kurigiri ka kpaari mi ku yuui ka leei din ku lan beni yaha.
en: God called this a new agreement, so he has made the first agreement old. And anything that is old and useless is ready to disappear.

dag: Ka kpatoonsi maa daa shini, ka kul kpaŋdi bɛmaŋ ni bɛ kpiɔŋ zaa ni bɛ zaŋ ŋarin titali maa lab du duli. Amaa ka teeku maa dambu kpiɔŋ daa kul maan pahirimi, ka bɛ kɔŋ chandi.
en: The men rowed to reach dry land, but they couldnt manage it because the sea continued to rage against them.

dag: ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ li gahigahi Yawɛ tooni din ni chɛ ka o deei ya. Di simdi ka maligumaana maa zaŋ li gahila Vuhim Dabisili di n-kaai biɛɣu.
en: He shall present it as a special offering to the Lord , so that you may be accepted. The priest shall present it the day after the Sabbath.

dag: Dinzuɣu di chɛliya ka ti lan tiri ti tab zalige, yi mi di chɛliya ka ti tum din ni gu ti kpee soli bee n-chɛ ka o tuui lu.
en: So stop judging each other. Instead, this is what you should decide: never put a stumbling block or obstacle in the way of your brother or sister.

dag: Tiŋgbɔŋ maa niriba ni ti kurim dunɔdali maa shee Yawɛ tooni vuhim dabisa dali mini goli palli dabisa dali.
en: Each Sabbath and each New Moon Festival all the people are also to bow down and worship the Lord in front of the gate.

dag: Bidibisi ayɔbu ka o daa dɔɣi Hiburɔn, o ni daa di nam ʒini nimaani yuma ayopɔin ni chira ayɔbu la. O daa di nam n-ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pihitanaata.
en: Six were born to him in Hebron, where he reigned for seven and a half years. He also reigned in Jerusalem for thirty-three years.

dag: ka bi tɛhi ni napɔŋ ni tooi no ŋ-ŋma li, ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri gba ni tooi no li.
en: then forgets that a foot may crush them or a wild animal trample them.

dag: Zara daa niŋla yuun kɔbiga ni pisinaayopɔin. Zara yuma ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bala.
en: When Sarah was years old, she died in Kiriath-Arba, better known as Hebron, in the land of Canaan. After Abraham had mourned for her.

dag: ka tiŋkpaŋ maa nim daa ti zaɣisi ni bɛ ku deeg o, o ni daa pun lo nia ni o gari chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm zuɣu.
en: But the people there would not receive him, because it was clear that he was on his way to Jerusalem.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ nyɛla buɣim din dira, o nyɛla Naawuni ŋun zabiri nyuli.
en: because the LORD your God is an all-consuming fire. He is a passionate God.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa wum bɛ fabila maa, ka teeg o ni daa lo Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu alikauli shɛl la yɛla.
en: God heard their painful cries and remembered the agreement he made with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

dag: Dama a nyɛla ŋun fari tarimba bahira; amaa ka siɣisiri karimbaannima.
en: You save those who are humble, but you humble those who are proud.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N yɛn namla zuɣusaa zaɣ palli mini dunia palli, ka so ku lan teei binshɛŋa din pun gari la yɛla.
en: I am creating a new heaven and a new earth. The troubles of the past will be forgotten. No one will remember them.
