dag: Do so ŋun daa nya alahiziba tibbu maa yuma daa gari yuun pihinahi.
en: The man on whom this miracle of healing had been performed was over forty years old.

dag: Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa daa be Filistianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni la chira ayopɔin.
en: After the Lord 's Covenant Box had been in Philistia for seven months.

dag: Dinzuɣu binshɛɣukam zaa yi ni diri ka nyura bee binshɛɣukam zaa yi ni niŋda, niŋmiya li ka di tiri Naawuni jilima.
en: So, whether you eat or drink or whatever you do, you should do it all for Gods glory.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa kpuɣ o zuɣu ŋmaligi lihi n-nya piɛlaa ka o ʒiɛya, ka o yila shɛbi tiwula ni. Ka Ibrahimma daa chaŋ ti gbaai piɛlaa maa na nti zaŋ o mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la, ka chɛ o bia maa.
en: Then Abraham noticed a ram whose horns were caught in a bush. So Abraham went and took the ram. He offered it, instead of his son, as a sacrifice to God.

dag: kumiya bɛ zaa, Hitinim mini Amɔrinim ni Keenannim ni Pɛrizinim ni Hivinim ni Jɛbusinima kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ya shɛm.
en: He has commanded you to completely wipe out the Hittites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim Suɣa Tibu Chuɣu puhibu daa ti mirina.
en: When it was almost time for the Jewish Festival of Booths.

dag: Hal o daa mɛla buɣa jɛmbu shee Juda zoya tinsi ni, ka daa chɛ ka Jɛrusalɛmnim bi lan ʒe yim, ka lan chɛ ka Judanim birigi.
en: Jehoram even built local shrines in the hills of Judah and let the people sin against the Lord by worshiping foreign gods.

dag: N zali zaligu n nam sulinsi ŋɔ ni zaa ni sokam lum Daniɛl Naawuni ŋɔ sizuura. O nyɛla Naawuni ŋun be, ka ni su nam hal ni saha din ka bahigu. O nam maa kul ku saɣim, ka o yiko mi ku mali tariga.
en: I command everyone in my kingdom to worship and honor the God of Daniel. He is the living God, the one who lives forever. His power and his kingdom will never end.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla n daa zaŋ zalikpan shɛŋa din bi viɛla mini zaligu shɛŋa din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku be n-ti ba.
en: I also issued regulations that were not good and case laws by which they could not live.

dag: Amaa ti ni bi bɔri ni ti miligi bɛ suhuri zuɣu, cham teeku ni nti zaŋ ziŋgoo bahi, ka di ni ti tuui gbaai zin so, a yi yaag o noli, a ni nya liɣiri di ni n-zaŋ ti tɔhi m min a zuɣu.
en: But we don't want to offend these people. So go to the lake and drop in a line. Pull up the first fish you hook, and in its mouth you will find a coin worth enough for my Temple tax and yours. Take it and pay them our taxes.

dag: Ka Ɛlifaz ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛman nir maa mini Bilidad ŋun daa nyɛ Shua nir la ni Zɔfar ŋun daa nyɛ Naama nir la daa chaŋ ti niŋ Yawɛ ni yɛli ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm maa. Ka Yawɛ daa deei Ayuba suhigu.
en: Eliphaz from Teman, Bildad from Shuah, and Zophar from Naamah did what the LORD told them; and the LORD acted favorably toward Job.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔahaz tɔbbihi daa bi lan yaɣ lala. Kulla wɔribariba pihinu mini chɛchɛbunsi pia ni tinchandiba tuhi pia, dama Siria naa daa ku bɛn kpalim maa zaa n-no ba taai tiŋa kaman kabɔɣili ni taŋkpaɣu la.
en: Jehoahaz had no armed forces left except fifty cavalry troops, ten chariots, and ten thousand foot soldiers, because the king of Syria had destroyed the rest, trampling them down like dust.

dag: Binnɛma zaa niŋgbuŋ bela kɔŋkɔbakɔŋkɔba: Ninsalinim niŋgbuŋ bela di ko, ka biŋkɔbiri niŋgbuŋ be di ko, ka noonsi niŋgbuŋ be di ko, ka zahim niŋgbuŋ mi be di ko.
en: And the flesh of living beings is not all the same kind of flesh; human beings have one kind of flesh, animals another, birds another, and fish another.

dag: Ka Izraɛl daa lan gbaai chandi n-kana ti ti o suɣa zali Ɛda pii tooni.
en: Israel continued his trip and pitched his tent farther on near the tower of Eder.

dag: Ka o mini ba daa ti ʒini ni bɛ di bindirigu, ka o zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro kpilli n-niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni ka ŋmahiŋmahi li tari ba.
en: After Jesus sat down to eat, he took some bread. He blessed it and broke it. Then he gave it to them.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ yɛm nyɛla jɛrilim Naawuni sani, dama di sabiya: Naawuni gbahiri yɛnnim la bɛ yɛŋkiŋkabina puuni.
en: For what this world considers to be wisdom is nonsense in God's sight. As the scripture says, God traps the wise in their cleverness;.

dag: Maaka ŋun daa nyɛ Kalɛb mam la n-daa dɔɣi Shɛbɛr mini Tirihana.
en: Maacah was another slave woman of Caleb. Maacah was the mother of Sheber and Tirhanah.

dag: Alibarika ni ti be yi bihi ni. Alibarika ni ti be yi puri atam ni, alibarika ni ti be yi biŋkɔbiri bihi ni. Yi niɣi mini yi biŋkɔbbaligu bihi ni ti nabi.
en: You will have many children. You will harvest large crops, and your herds of cattle and flocks of sheep and goats will produce many young.

dag: Duhimaŋtali lihigu mini karimbaani suhu nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛri firila, ka nyɛ alahichi.
en: Evil people are proud and arrogant, but sin is the only crop they produce.

dag: Ka Ibram ni daa ti kpe Ijipti, Ijiptinim daa shiri nyaya ka paɣ maa nyɛla paɣ viɛlli.
en: When Abram entered Egypt, the Egyptians saw how beautiful his wife was.

dag: Bɛnjamin ŋmanila kundun biɛɣu. O gbahiri binyara asiba ni zaawuni ŋubira.
en: Benjamin is like a hungry wolf. In the morning he kills and eats. In the evening he shares what is left.

dag: ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni chɛ ka saa tahibu mini tiŋgbani dambu ni pɔhim biɛɣu ni buɣim biɛɣu kana nti fa a bahi.
en: the Lord Almighty will rescue you with violent thunderstorms and earthquakes. He will send windstorms and raging fire;.

dag: Amaa zuɣulan maa daa yi ti kpi, bɛ lan ŋmaligirimi tumdi tuumbiɛ shɛŋa din bie n-gari bɛ yaannim dini. Bɛ daa kul jɛmdila wuna ka damdir li tiŋa. Bɛ daa bi saɣi chɛ bɛ tuumbiɛri maa shɛli bee n-chɛ bɛ tipawumli soya la dolibu.
en: But then when the leader died, they would once again act in ways that werent as good as their ancestors, going after other gods, to serve them and to worship them. They wouldnt drop their bad practices or hardheaded ways.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛli ba Yisa ni di yɛli ba shɛm la, ka bɛ chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o chaŋ.
en: They told them what Jesus had said, and the people let them take it.

dag: Maliya suhupiɛlli dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu, hal di pa shɛli yi ni yɛn nya wahala din ku yuui zahimbu balibu shɛŋa din yɛn paai ya la zuɣu la zaa yoli;.
en: You now rejoice in this hope, even if its necessary for you to be distressed for a short time by various trials.

dag: hal ka bɛ je ni bɛ zaŋ li bahi, ka zaŋ li gbabi bɛ noya maa zaa yoli.
en: He hates to let it go and holds it in his mouth.

dag: Dabili ŋun mali yɛm ni ti su bidɔɣiro ŋun tumdi vi tuma, ka ni ti di fali kaman daŋ ni nir la.
en: A shrewd servant will gain authority over a master's worthless son and receive a part of the inheritance.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti di bɛ ni daa ʒi kawaan shɛli Ijipti na maa naai saha shɛli ka bɛ ba yɛli ba, Labimiya ti da bindirigu biɛla na nti ti ti yaha.
en: and when the family of Jacob had eaten all the grain which had been brought from Egypt, Jacob said to his sons, Go back and buy a little food for us.

dag: Ka puu maa atam kpuɣibu saha daa ti paai, ka o tim o yiŋbi so padiriba maa sani ni bɛ ti zaŋ o puu maa daatam shɛli ti o na.
en: Later, it was time for the grapes to be picked. So the man sent a servant to the farmers to get his share of the grapes.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa ti neerina asibaasi, ka Ilaisha sɔŋda yina nti nya ka tɔbbihi mini yuri ni chɛchɛbunsi n-kul teei gili bɛ tiŋ maa zaa. Ka Ilaisha sɔŋda maa kuhi yɛli, Mbaye, n dana! Ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ.
en: Elishas servant got up early that morning. When he went outside, he saw an army with horses and chariots all around the city. The servant said to Elisha, Oh, my master, what can we do.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yinim Izraɛlnim bɛn pɔri ka ka yaa ŋɔ, di zɔriya dabiɛm, n ni sɔŋ ya. Mani Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ n-nyɛ yi Tiligira.
en: People of Israel, descendants of Jacob, you may be weak and worthless, but do not be afraid. I myself will help you. This is what the Lord himself says. I am the Holy One of Israel, the one who saves you.

dag: ni di chɛ ka sokam zaa ti Bia maa jilima kaman bɛ ni tir o Ba maa jilima shɛm. Ŋunkam bi tiri Bia maa jilima bi tirila o Ba ŋun tim o maa na jilima.
en: so that everyone will honor the Son just as they honor the Father. Whoever doesnt honor the Son doesnt honor the Father who sent him.

dag: Amaa tinim bɛna, Yawɛ n-nyɛ ti Naawuni, ka ti na ʒi n-zaɣis o. Aduna bidibisi n-nyɛ ti maligumaaniba bɛn maani sara tiri Yawɛ ka Lɛvinim nyɛ bɛn sɔŋdi ba.
en: But as for us, the Lord is our God. We people of Judah have not refused to obey God. We have not left him. The priests who serve the Lord are Aarons sons, and the Levites help the priests in their work.

dag: A min a paɣa ni a bidibisi la ni bɛ paɣiba yim ŋariŋ maa ni na.
en: Go out of the boat with your wife, your sons, and their wives.

dag: Sapashini maa ni daa wum Pool ni yɛli shɛm maa ka o chaŋ ti bɔhi sapashin kpɛm la, Tuun bɔ ka a lee yɛn tum ŋɔ? Doo maa nyɛla Rom tiŋbia.
en: When the officer heard this, he went to the commander and asked him, What are you doing? That man is a Roman citizen.

dag: ka Amasai nyɛ Ɛlikana bia, ka Ɛlikana nyɛ Joɛl bia, ka Joɛl nyɛ Azaria bia, ka Azaria nyɛ Zɛfania bia.
en: Elkanah, Joel, Azariah, Zephaniah.

dag: Ka di mi pala bɛn zaa yi ti yab Ibrahimma zuliya ni na n-nyɛ Ibrahimma yaan maŋa. Naawuni daa yɛli Ibrahimma, Yisahaku zuliya n-yɛn nyɛ a yaan maŋa.
en: And only some of Abrahams descendants are true children of Abraham. This is what God said to Abraham: Your true descendants will be those who come through Isaac.

dag: Paɣimiya Naawuni laɣiŋgu titali ni. Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim kɔbil nini ŋɔ!.
en: Praise God in the meeting of his people; praise the Lord , all you descendants of Jacob.

dag: Tirimiya wuhi soli din kuni Ziɔn. Zomiya yomyom tiligi, ka di niŋya zinchili, dama n yɛn chɛmi ka zaɣ biɛɣu yi nuzaa polo na. Ka di ni ti di niriba pam.
en: Set up a flag to Zion; take cover, dont just stand there! Im bringing disaster from the north, massive devastation.

dag: Dama tinim ku tooi chɛ ti ni daa nya ka wum shɛli maa yɛla tɔɣisibu.
en: For we cannot stop speaking of what we ourselves have seen and heard.

dag: ka kawaan kɔr ayopɔin din nyɛ biisim ni kpe shɛli ka di kul zaɣizaɣimi to n-yina pahi di zuɣu.
en: Then seven other heads of grain came up. They were thin and scorched by a wind from the desert.

dag: dama nir yi bi mi o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm n-gbib omaŋmaŋ yiŋnima, wula ka o ni tooi gbibi Naawuni cheechi?.
en: If a man does not know how to lead his own family, he will not be able to take care of Gods church.

dag: N tarigimi do tiŋa; tim ma nyɛvili palli kaman a yɛligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: My life is stuck in the dirt. Now make me live again according to your promise!.

dag: amaa ka bɛ zaŋ nyini bahila katiŋ kaman bimpɔŋ la ka chɛ a gballi; ka bɛ ni daa zaŋ takɔb ku ninvuɣ shɛb pa a zuɣu, ka bɛ zaŋ ba bahi kuɣa bɔɣili ni kaman niriba ni nɔri kpiin shɛb garita.
en: but you have no tomb, and your corpse is thrown out to rot. It is covered by the bodies of soldiers killed in battle, thrown with them into a rocky pit, and trampled down.

dag: A kparima ŋmanila pumpɔrinchi bɔɣa m-be a sariga ni.
en: Like a slice of pomegranate is the curve of your face behind the veil of your hair.

dag: Dama di nyɛla nɛma labisi ti yuuni yi sani; di ni ti nyɛla yuuni din be kasi; yi ni ti dila binshɛŋa din bili mɔɣu ni di yuuni maa.
en: In this time of sacred celebration you may eat only what grows on its own.

dag: Dama Naa Dauda maŋmaŋ daa na bi chaŋ alizanda ni, amaa ka daa yɛli: Ti Duuma yɛli n Duuma, ʒinimi n nudirigu polo.
en: David didn't go up to heaven. So he wasn't talking about himself when he said, The Lord told my Lord to sit at his right side.

dag: Naa Hɛzɛkia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pinaanahi saha ka Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib daa kana ti liri Judanim ni daa me birininim gili fɔntin shɛŋa zaa n-tuhi deei li.
en: In the fourteenth year of Hezekiah's rule in Judah, King Sennacherib of Assyria invaded the country and captured every walled city, except Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa pirig o binyɛrigu m-pɔripɔri li zaŋ fiɛb kom maa, ka kom maa daa pirigi buyi n-daai ti dɔni di yaɣ ayi maa zaa hal ka bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa ti doli tiŋgban kuŋ zuɣu du duli.
en: Then Elijah took off his cloak, rolled it up, and struck the water with it; the water divided, and he and Elisha crossed to the other side on dry ground.

dag: O daa chɛ ka dɔro be o tooni chana, ka alɔbo doli nyaaŋa.
en: Dreadful diseases and plagues marched in front and followed behind.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani. Bɛ daa tam Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa yɛla, ka ŋmaligi jɛmdila Baalnim mini Ashɛranima.
en: The people of Israel forgot the Lord their God; they sinned against him and worshiped the idols of Baal and Asherah.

dag: Kurig ata maa saha ka Yisa daa kuhi pam yɛli, Ilai, Ilai, lama sabakitani? Di gbinni nyɛla, N Duuma Naawuni, n Duuma Naawuni, bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ma.
en: About three oclock Jesus cried out loudly, Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani? This means My God, my God, why have you left me alone.

dag: Ka paɣ maa yɛli wahu maa, Ti ni tooi di ti shɛŋa din be puu ŋɔ ni wala;.
en: We may eat the fruit of any tree in the garden, the woman answered.

dag: Ka Ɛsta yɛl o, N ni bɔri shɛli mini n ni yɛn suh a shɛli nyɛla:.
en: Esther answered, This is my wish and this is what I want.

dag: Bɛ tiŋgbani palo daa zaŋla Mahanaim hal ti paai Bashan tiŋgbani zaa din daa nyɛ Bashan Naa Ogi ni daa su luɣ shɛlikam zaa la ni Jair fɔntinsi zaa din be Bashan ka di kalinli nyɛ pihiyɔbu.
en: Their territory ran from Mahanaim, all Bashan, the whole kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all sixty of the tent villages of Jair that are in Bashan.

dag: N zaŋmi m bɔrɔbɔro mini ko shɛli ni nim shɛli n ni ku n-zali bɛn chɛri m piɛri kɔbiri maa ti ninvuɣ shɛba n ni bi mi bɛ ni yi shɛl na.
en: I have bread and water, and I have the meat I killed for my servants who cut the wool from my sheep. But I wont give them to men I dont even know.

dag: Miri ka a yɛli, N ni niŋ a zaɣ biɛɣu labisi. Guhimi Yawɛ, o ni sɔŋ a.
en: Dont ever say, Ill pay them back for what they did to me! Wait for the Lord . He will make things right.

dag: Ʒiɛmani ŋɔ zuɣulaannim ni so daa ʒi yɛm ŋɔ yɛla, dama bɛ yi di daa mi li, bɛ daa naan ku kpahi ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ jilimalan la tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: None of the rulers of this world understood this wisdom. If they had understood it, they would not have killed our great and glorious Lord on a cross.

dag: Ka n lan chɛ ka tins ayi bee tins ata niriba chani tin yin ni ni bɛ ti nya kom nyu, ka bɛ yi chaŋ, bɛ ti bi nyari nyuri ka di saɣiri ba; di zaa yoli, ka yi bi labi n sanna. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: So two or three thirsty towns went to one city to drink water, and werent satisfied; yet you didnt return to me, says the LORD.

dag: Ti Duuma zaɣis o sara maligu bimbini, ka chɛ o jɛmbu duu bahi. O zaŋ di nayili goma la niŋ bɛ bɛ dimnim nuu ni. Bɛ ʒiɛla Yawɛ jɛmbu duu n-yɔri nasara dibu vuri kaman chuɣu dal la.
en: The Lord abandoned his altar and his temple; he let Zion's enemies capture her fortresses. Noisy shouts were heard from the temple, as if it were a time of celebration.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa ti neerina ka malaikanim maa kpam Lɔt jaande yɛra, Yiɣisim zaŋ a paɣ min a bipuɣins ayi bɛn be a sani ŋɔ n-zo n-yi yaŋɔ, di yi pa lala, yaŋɔnim ni yɛn nya tibidarigibo shɛli maa ni tabili ya.
en: When dawn broke, the messengers urged Lot, Get up and take your wife and your two daughters who are here so that you are not swept away because of the evil in this city.

dag: Naawuni fukumsi zaligu din daa lo ni di tahi nyɛvili na la, man sani di tahila kum na.
en: and I died spiritually. The command was meant to bring life, but for me it brought death.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o ba ni daa zaŋ pin shɛŋa zaa ti Naawuni la mini ŋun maŋmaŋ ni mali pin shɛŋa din daa nyɛ anzinfa mini salima binyɛra la zaa nti zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni.
en: He placed in the temple all the silver and gold objects that he and his father had dedicated to God.

dag: Bɛ daanzinfa bee bɛ salima ti ku tooi tiligi ba Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili dabisili maa dali. O suhuyiɣisili buɣim ni ti di dunia ŋɔ zaa. Dama o ni ti chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ binshɛɣukam naai naari biɛɣu.
en: Their gold and silver will not help them! At that time the Lord will become very upset and angry. The Lord will destroy the whole world ! He will completely destroy everyone on earth.

dag: Ka biŋkɔbigu ŋun pah ayi la daa ti binnani maa vuhim hal ka binnani maa ni tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa gba, ka daa chɛ ka bɛ ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa zaɣisi binnani maa jɛmbu.
en: The second beast was allowed to breathe life into the image of the first beast, so that the image could talk and put to death all those who would not worship it.

dag: Di pa shɛli o turi ŋɔ zuɣu ni chɛ ka Yawɛ lihi n wahala ŋɔ ka niŋ ma din viɛli zuŋɔ.
en: Perhaps the Lord will notice my misery and give me some blessings to take the place of his curse.

dag: Di saha ka Yɛhudianim maa daa lan pihi kuɣa ni bɛ lab Yisa.
en: Once again the people picked up stones in order to kill Jesus.

dag: M mali suhupiɛlli pam, dama n niŋ ya naani zaa.
en: How happy I am that I can depend on you completely!.

dag: Wuntaŋ yi ti lu saha shɛli ka o ni yi daɣiri ni, di nyaaŋa ka o ni tooi di bin kasinim la, dama o bindirigu m-bala.
en: Once the sun has set and he has become clean again, he may eat of the holy things, for that is his food.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, chɛliya ka lala niŋ; dama Yawɛ daa lo Naa Dauda alikauli yɛli, N dabili Dauda nuu ka n ti yɛn zaŋ fa n niriba Izraɛlnim Filistianim mini bɛ dimnim zaa nuu ni bahi. .
en: Now do it! The Lord was talking about David when he said, I will save my people the Israelites from the Philistines and all their other enemies. I will do this through my servant David.

dag: Lan zaŋm bula yino m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara Yawɛ sani m-pahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim dabisili kam mini di binnyura sara zuɣu.
en: In addition to the regular daily burnt offering and drink offering, you must also give male goat to the Lord . That goat will be a sin offering.

dag: Daadam, zaŋm a nini kpa Jɛrusalɛm polo n-yihi waazu jɛndi bɛ luɣ shɛŋa din be kasi. Tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ.
en: Mortal man, he said, denounce Jerusalem. Denounce the places where people worship. Warn the land of Israel.

dag: Kaman kom ni yi zo n-liilii kuɣa, ka kopaliga ʒi tiŋgbani taŋkpaɣu chaŋ shɛm, lala ka a saɣindi daadam tahima.
en: streams wear away stones and wash away soil. And you destroy our hopes!.

dag: Yi yi ti paai tiŋ kam ka bɛ deei ya, yin dimiya bɛ ni kul tin ya shɛlikam;.
en: If you go into a town and the people welcome you, eat the food they give you.

dag: Ka n ni daa nya ka yi bi kanna maa, ka n daa zaŋ n nyɛvili pa talima chaŋ bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni ti tuhi ba; ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ ba niŋ n nuu ni. Ka di chaŋ wula ka yi ti kana zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni yi ti tuhi ma.
en: So when we realized you weren't coming, we risked our lives and attacked the Ammonites. And the Lord let us defeat them. There's no reason for you to come here today to attack me.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee sɔŋ ya ka yi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ? Ka ŋuni shia n-lee yi yi sanna maa.
en: With whom have you spoken; whose breath was expelled from you?.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔ zaa yoli, yi daa bi niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: But you had no faith in the LORD your God about this matter.

dag: Yawɛ kɔŋko ka m mali, ka a tiri ma n ni bɔri shɛlikam, ka n dahin shɛli ha biɛhigu yɛla zaa bela a nuu ni.
en: Lord , you give me all that I need. You support me. You give me my share.

dag: Ka mɔɣ shɛli din pah ata yuli booni Tigiris. Dina n-zɔri kpari Asiria wulimpuhili polo. Ka mɔɣ shɛli din pah anahi mi yuli booni Yufretiiz.
en: The name of the third river is the Tigris, flowing east of Assyria; and the name of the fourth river is the Euphrates.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi ma alaka di vi. Amaa di chɛ ka man di vi. Chɛ ka dabiɛm gbahi ba, amaa di chɛ ka dabiɛm gbaai ma. Chɛ ka alɔbo lu bɛ zuɣu n-ku ba pam.
en: People are hurting me. Make them ashamed, but dont disappoint me. Let them be filled with fear, but dont give me any reason to fear. Bring the terrible day of disaster to my enemies. Break them, and break them again.

dag: Shɛlini, sagbani maa daa yi zaani Yawɛ jɛmbu shee maa zuɣusaa la dabisa biɛla, ka bɛ daa doli Yawɛ zaligu ni wuhi shɛm kpalim doya, di nyaaŋa ka bɛ ti lan doli Yawɛ zaligu maa ni wuhi shɛm yiɣisi chaŋ.
en: Sometimes the cloud was over the Holy Tent for only a few days. So the people obeyed the Lord s command—they followed the cloud when it moved.

dag: O bi ŋmani wun so tuumbaŋdiba ni mali zali, ka salindoora dooi salima pa di zuɣu, ka bɛ niŋ anzinfa zoligɔnim yɛliyɛl li la?.
en: An idol? A craftsman pours it, a metalworker covers it with gold, and fashions silver chains.

dag: Ansarisimaaniba ni ti nya tibidarigibo, ka jɛra mi yaansi zuɣu ti nya fiɛbiga.
en: Punishments were made for mockers, and blows for the backs of fools.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa nya ka naa zaɣisi bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa ka bɛ daa yɛli, Ti malila tarili Dauda yilinim sani? Ti mi bi diri Jɛsi bia fali. Dinzuɣu Izraɛlnima, Kulimiya yi yinsi. Dauda yilinim lihim bɛmaŋ yɛla. Ka Izraɛlnim daa ŋmaligi kuli.
en: When the people saw that the king would not listen to them, they shouted, Down with David and his family! What have they ever done for us? People of Israel, let's go home! Let Rehoboam look out for himself! So the people of Israel rebelled.

dag: O ni daa kari ninsal yihi Idɛn puu maa ni maa, o daa zaŋla chɛrubinim mini takɔbi din nyɛ buɣim niɛm ka ŋmaligiri luɣilikam zali Idɛn puu maa wulimpuhili polo ni bɛ gu so shɛli din chani ti shɛli din tiri nyɛvil maa gbini.
en: God forced the man to leave the garden. Then he put Cherub angels and a sword of fire at the entrance to the garden to protect it. The sword flashed around and around, guarding the way to the tree of life.

dag: Bɛ ni yiini yila ni suhupiɛlli, amaa yinima ni kum ni suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: They will sing for joy, but you will cry with a broken heart.

dag: Ka Farisiinim bɔh o, Nyama! Bɔzuɣu ka bɛ tumdi din chihiri Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: The Pharisees said to Jesus, Look! Why are they breaking the Sabbath law.

dag: ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ o yi bɛ biɛhigu shee maa kpaŋa nti lih o, ka niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu maa yi naai dilan ni.
en: and the priest shall take you outside the camp and examine you. If the disease is healed.

dag: N kul dolila o ni wuhi ma shɛm; n kul dolila o soli ka na ʒi m-birigi.
en: I have never refused to follow any of his commands.

dag: Dama o luhi niriba pam n-ti ba dansi. Ka o ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb ka tariga.
en: She has caused many corpses to fall; she has killed many people.

dag: Samarianim suhuri zɔhirimi Bɛtavɛn naɣibil la zuɣu. Di niriba ni ti kum naɣibil maa zuɣu. Ka di tindaannim la ti kum di zuɣu pam. Bɛ ni ti kum pam di ni kɔŋ jilima shɛl la zuɣu.
en: The people who live in the city of Samaria will be afraid and will mourn the loss of the gold bull at Bethaven. They and the priests who serve the idol will weep over it. They will wail when it is stripped of its golden splendor.

dag: Amaa ka yɛl shɛŋa n-yi beni pahi, di ni tooi mali jintɔriba laɣiŋgu ni.
en: But if there is something more that you want, it will have to be settled in a legal meeting of citizens.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Niriba pam tooni ka n yɛn zaŋ laŋa n-labi pir a n-vo a n laŋ maa ni du na.
en: The LORD God proclaims: In the company of many peoples I will spread my net over you, and I will haul you up in my dragnet.

dag: Ka o kpamba daa yi o nyaaŋa n-ku o o yiŋa.
en: Some of Amon's officials plotted against him and killed him in his palace.

dag: Paɣ so daa be Jɔpa n-nyɛ Yisa nyaandola ka o yuli booni Tabita. O daa tumdi tuun suma pam, ka lan tumdi nambɔzɔbo tuma gba lala.
en: In Joppa there was a woman named Tabitha, who was a believer. She spent all her time doing good and helping the poor.

dag: Aizaia daa yɛli ba mi, Yɛlimiya yi dana ni Yawɛ yɛliya, Di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa a ni wum ka Asiria naa tuumba kana ti yɛli tu ma maa zuɣu.
en: he sent back this answer: The Lord tells you not to let the Assyrians frighten you by their claims that he cannot save you.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ m birini mini n yurilim din bi naara. Ŋuna n-nyɛ n kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛli mini n tiligira. Ŋuna n-nyɛ n nyɔtaɣirigu ni n ni sɔɣiri so sani. O nyaŋ niriba ti ma ni n su ba.
en: You are my friend, my fortress, where I am safe. You are my shield, and you made me the ruler of our people.

dag: Di saha ka nabihi bɛn daa kpalim yina, ka Yawɛ niriba daa yina ni bɛ ti tuhi wɔɣira ti o.
en: The Lord 's people who were left joined with their leaders and fought at my side.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, yiɣisim ka a min a yiko Alikauli Adaka ŋɔ kpe a vuhim shee. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, yiɣisim chɛ ka a maligumaaniba ŋɔ nya tiliginsim, ka chɛ ka bɛn ʒe a yim mali suhupiɛlli a ninvuɣ suntali puuni.
en: Now, Lord God, get up and come to your special place, the Box of the Agreement that shows your strength. Lord God, may your priests be dressed with salvation, and may your true followers be happy about these good things.

dag: Joɛl bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Shɛmaya mini Gɔg ni Shimɛi.
en: Joels family: his son Shemaiah, his son Gog, his son Shimei.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa gbibi ŋariŋtuurisi daa yi bɛ ŋarima ni na. Ka kpatoonsi mini ŋariŋduhiriba zaa bɛn be teeku ni du nti ʒe duli.
en: Every ship is now deserted, And every sailor has gone ashore.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun ka yɛm n-ni saɣi po pɔri n-zan o kpee nyaaŋa ni o di samli.
en: Only a fool would promise to pay for someone elses debts.

dag: ni kɔniŋdi bin yin la ni naɣilahi pinaayi shɛb zuɣu kɔniŋdi bini maa ni daa tamya la.
en: one Sea; twelve oxen beneath the Sea.

dag: Ka n daa ti yiɣis asiba ni o mɔɣi, ka nya ka o kpimi. Amaa ka n daa lih o viɛnyɛliŋga asiba maa n-nya ka o pala m bi so n ni daa dɔɣi maa.
en: When I got up in the morning to nurse my son, he was dead! But when I looked more closely in the daylight, it turned out that it wasnt my son—not the baby I had birthed.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o mabia maa gba daa yina ka gali ʒee maa lo o nuu, ka bɛ daa bol o mi yuli Zɛra.
en: After this, the other baby was born. This was the baby with the red string on his hand. They named him Zerah.

dag: Nyamiya, o ni ku ma; n lan ka tahima yaha. Amaa n ni zabi n soli zuɣu hal ni o tooni.
en: I've lost all hope, so what if God kills me? I am going to state my case to him.

dag: ka suhi Naawuni yɛli, Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun chɛ ka m bihi ni yino ʒini n nam ʒiishee zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka mmaŋmaŋ nini nya li ŋɔ.
en: and prayed, Let us praise the Lord , the God of Israel, who has today made one of my descendants succeed me as king, and has let me live to see it.

dag: Firawuna daa lan yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ bɛ galisiya pam, ka yi bɔri ni bɛ chɛ tuma bebɔ.
en: There are very many workers, and you are keeping them from doing their jobs.

dag: Ka o daa dɔɣi Jɛushi mini Shɛmaria ni Zaham.
en: Mahalath gave Rehoboam these sons: Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham.

dag: Tampiŋ yini daa dola nuzaa polo zaŋ labi Mikimash tooni poli, ka yini mi do nudirigu poli zaŋ labi Gɛba tooni polo.
en: One was on the north side of the pass, facing Michmash, and the other was on the south side, facing Geba.

dag: Ŋahili ŋɔ ka Yisa daa lan ŋahi ba bɔhi, Paɣ ŋuni n-lee ni mal anzinfa laɣibaligu pia, ka di zaɣ yini ti bɔrigi, ka o ku nyo firila kolikol o yiŋ zaa m-bo li ni nimmoo hal ti nya li?.
en: Or suppose a woman who has ten silver coins loses one of them—what does she do? She lights a lamp, sweeps her house, and looks carefully everywhere until she finds it.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ galima be n niriba maa ni, bɛ nyɛla bɛn fari bɛ tab nɛma. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn bariti zana kaman nooŋgbahiriba la n-gbahiri ninsalinima.
en: There are evil men among my people. They are like men who make nets for catching birds. They set their traps, but they catch people instead of birds.

dag: O daa lan mali me Bɛtihɔrɔn din daa be zoli zuɣu la mini Bɛtihɔrɔn din daa be zolɔŋni la, ka me goondahi gil li, ka niŋ dunɔdaya mini binyara din kpariti dunɔdaya maa niŋ di ni.
en: He rebuilt the towns of Upper Beth Horon and Lower Beth Horon. He made them into strong forts with strong walls, gates, and bars in the gates.

dag: ni shinshingooro ni wɔɣivaanigu min o balibu zaa ni napakoli ni zɔŋ.
en: the stork, any kind of heron, the hoopoe, and the bat.

dag: dama bɛ wahala dibu zahimbu pam nyabu puuni mini bɛ ni kul nyɛ faranim la zaa yoli, bɛ suhupiɛlli din galisi pam zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ tɔhiri tɔto ni bɛ suhuri zaa.
en: They have been severely tested by the troubles they went through; but their joy was so great that they were extremely generous in their giving, even though they are very poor.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti tum tuun shɛli dindali, dama di nyɛla sanyoo dali, ka bɛ ni yo yi daalahichi samli tin ya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: You must not do any work on that day, because it is the Day of Atonement. On that day the priests will go before the Lord and perform the ceremony that makes you pure.

dag: n-daa ti kpɛri tiŋkpan shɛl ni ka kɔnsi pia chirig o sol ni n-kaɣ ti ʒe katiŋ ha.
en: He came into a small town, and ten men met him there. They did not come close to him, because they all had leprosy.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ a ni mɛri du shɛli ŋɔ polo, a yi ni doli n fukumsi zaligunim mini zaligu shɛŋa n ni zali pahi la zaa, n ni niŋ a kaman n ni daa lo a ba Dauda alikauli ni n ni niŋ a shɛm la.
en: If you obey all my laws and commands, I will do for you what I promised your father David.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ suhuyiɣisili puuni ka o chɛ ka buɣim di tiŋgbɔŋ maa, ka daadamnim be kaman kpam la ka buɣim di ba, ka so bi lan zɔr o kpee nambɔɣu.
en: The Lord All-Powerful was angry, so the land was burned. The people were fuel for the fire. No one showed any compassion to anyone else.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka ti niŋ naani ka vu m-miri Naawuni ŋun nyɛ alibarikalan ŋɔ nam ʒiishee, ka di chɛ ka o zo ti nambɔɣu ka ti nya alibarika din ni sɔŋ ti saha shɛli ti ni bɔri li.
en: With Jesus as our high priest, we can feel free to come before Gods throne where there is grace. There we receive mercy and kindness to help us when we need it.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ lala siɣimsiɣim buta ka lan lab zuɣusaa.
en: This happened three times, then the object was suddenly pulled back into heaven.

dag: Kaman tɔrili ni damd o tiɛɣu ka yiɣiri gind o bihi, ka teer o kpiŋkpama kpuɣiri ba, ka zaŋ o kpiŋkpan yiɣira gbib ba zuɣusaa shɛm la, lala ka Yawɛ daa gbibi Izraɛl ka o bi lu.
en: The Lord was like an eagle teaching its young to fly, always ready to swoop down and catch them on its back.

dag: Ka o daa lan zaŋ takɔbi chaŋ ti lu Nɔb din daa nyɛ maligumaaniba tiŋ la nim zuɣu n-ku dɔbba mini paɣiba ni bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi ni biliɛri ni naɣilahi ni bunsi ni piɛri. O daa zaŋla takɔbi ku bɛ zaa.
en: Nob was the city of the priests. Doeg killed all the people of Nob. He used his sword and killed men, women, children and small babies. He even killed their cattle, donkeys, and sheep.

dag: Ka bɛn daa guli Yisa maa maan o ansarisi ka ŋmɛr o.
en: The men who were guarding Jesus made fun of him and beat him.

dag: Izraɛlnima, yɛlimiya, M bilim ni ka bɛ pun nahindi ma pam;.
en: All my life enemies have attacked me. Say it again, Israel.

dag: Cham Naa Dauda sani yomyom ti bɔh o, N dan naa, a daa bi po pɔri man ŋun nyɛ a dab paɣ ŋɔ sani ni a ni chɛ ka m bia Sulemaana ti di nam n-ʒin a nam ʒiishee? Ka di chaŋ wula ka Adɔnija nti di nam.
en: Go to King David and say, Didnt my master the king swear to your servant, Your son Solomon will certainly rule after me. He will sit on my throne? Why then has Adonijah become king.

dag: amaa di bahigu ni o tomi kaman yabiga ka diri kaman takɔb din mali naŋgbana ayi.
en: But in the end, she will bring only bitterness and pain. It will be like bitter poison and a sharp sword.

dag: Yihim ma sarika ni, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka m paɣ a yuli. Wuntizɔriba ni laɣim gili ma, dama a ni niŋ ma nirilim pam.
en: Get me out of this prison so I can give thanks to your name. Then the righteous will gather all around me because of your good deeds to me.

dag: N kul yɛn kariti ba la biɛlabiɛla hal ka yi daadam biɛligu ti nabi n-su tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa.
en: Ill drive them out before you little by little, until your numbers grow and you eventually possess the land.

dag: Ka maligumaana Finɛhas mini Izraɛlnim daŋ kam ni dɔɣirikpamba bɛn daa pah o zuɣu maa ni daa wum Rubin mini Gaad ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili maa ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka di niŋ ba nyaɣisim pam.
en: Phinehas the priest and the leaders with him heard what the people from Reuben, Gad, and Manasseh said. They were satisfied that they were telling the truth.

dag: O daa na bi ʒini tiŋ gba ka paɣ so pun wum o yɛla ka kana nti gban o tooni, dama alizin biɛɣu n-daa ʒi o bipuɣim bil zuɣu.
en: A woman, whose daughter had an evil spirit in her, heard about Jesus and came to him at once and fell at his feet.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛl o, N yi yu ni o kul kpalim beni hal ka n ti labina, di lee nya a ya? Nyin dee doli ma.
en: Jesus replied, If I want him to remain until I come, what difference does that make to you? You must follow me.

dag: Ka a lan yɛli ba: Yi ni ti yɛn zaŋdi pin shɛŋa nyɔri buɣim dabisili kam tiri Yawɛ ka di nyɛ yi sahakam sara n-nyɛ yuun yini piɛlabih ayi bɛn ka dansi.
en: These are gifts that they must give to the Lord . Every day they must give lambs that are one year old. There must be nothing wrong with them.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛr a, zuŋɔ yuŋ ŋɔ a ni ti chihi siɣimsiɣim buta ni a bi mi ma, ka nolɔɣu na bi kum.
en: Jesus said to Peter, I tell you that before the rooster crows tonight, you will say three times that you do not know me.

dag: Amaa ka Jɛrimia daa yɛli Rɛkabinim maa, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ni daa deei yi yab Jɔnadab ni wuhi ya shɛm, ka dol o zaligunim zaa, ka niŋ o ni daa yɛli ni yi niŋ shɛm zaa la zuɣu.
en: Then the Lord told me to say to the Rechabite clan: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel. You have obeyed your ancestor Jonadab.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla n ni chɛ ka a zani dabari, ka leei zuliya kam bɛn gil a ni yɛn maani so ansarisi bɛnkam gariti ninni.
en: God said, Jerusalem, I will destroy you—you will be nothing but a pile of rocks. The people around you will make fun of you. Everyone who walks by will make fun of you.

dag: Ka Yisifu zuliya niriba gba daa chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi Bɛtɛlnima, ka Yawɛ daa sɔŋ ba.
en: The descendants of Joseph went to fight against the city of Bethel, and the Lord was with them.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna, ka bɛ ni ti kana ti zaŋ binshɛɣukam din be a yiŋ puuni min a yaannim ni daa bo binshɛɣukam zali hal ni zuŋɔ la n-kuli Babilɔn, ka di shɛli ku kpalim. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Days are coming when all that is in your house, which your ancestors have stored up until this day, will be carried to Babylon. Nothing will be left, says the LORD.

dag: Dinzuɣu a biɛhigu daa be di ko ka chɛ paɣ shɛb dini a pagɔrisigu tuma maa ni. Pa so m-puh a ni a tummi pagɔrisigu tuma. Pa bɛna n-daa yɔr a, amaa nyini n-daa lee yɔri ba, a biɛhigu daa shiri be di ko.
en: You're not like other prostitutes. Men don't ask you for sex—you offer to pay them!.

dag: Ka Izraɛl Naa daa garigi yɛli, Yɛlimiy o, Tɔbbi so ŋun na lɔri kpara bi simdi ka o nyuri bara kaman tɔbbi so ŋun lɔrigi kpara ni nyuri bara shɛm. .
en: King Ahab answered, Tell Ben-Hadad that the man who puts on his armor should not boast as much as the man who lives long enough to take it off.

dag: Lɔris anahi maa zaa puuni, bɛ daa zaŋla kuɣa me goma, ka me daansi tabili goma maa m-pie taba ti gili.
en: Around the inside of these smaller courtyards was a low wall of stones, and against the wall were places to build fires.

dag: Bɛ bihi ni ti be kaman bɛ ni daa pun be shɛm kurimbuni ha la, bɛ ʒilɛli maa ni ti nya zaa zani n sani, ka n ti darigi bɛn zaa daa nahindi ba la tibili.
en: I will restore the nation's ancient power and establish it firmly again; I will punish all who oppress them.

dag: Gbilisimiya tibili viɛnyɛliŋga n-wum n yɛtɔɣa, ka chɛliya ka n ni tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ŋɔ kpe yi tiba ni.
en: Listen carefully to what I say. Let me explain.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pɔri Samaria buɣili Ashima yɛra, Dan, a buɣili din be ŋɔ zuɣu, bee n-yɛra, Bɛrishiiba buɣili din be ŋɔ zuɣu; bɛ ni lu ka ku lan yiɣisi yaha.
en: Those who swear by the idols of Samaria, who say, By the god of Dan or By the god of Beersheba—those people will fall and not rise again.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Biɛhiŋ kani, n ni chɛ ka alɔbo lu bɛ zuɣu, ka bɛ ku tooi zo n-yi di ni, hal bɛ yi kuhi niŋ ma gba n ku garigi ba.
en: Therefore, the LORD proclaims: I will bring upon them a disaster from which they wont be able to escape. They will cry out to me, but I wont listen to them.

dag: Dinzuɣu lomiya ania n-doli dinkam sabi Musa zaligu ni la, ka miriya ka yi ŋmaligi kpa nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo ka chɛ li.
en: Be very strong. Carefully obey everything written in the Instruction scroll from Moses. Dont deviate a bit from it either to the right or to the left.

dag: Dinzuɣu niŋmiya m-bahi naai li! Chɛliya ka yi suhuri ye di naabu zuɣu kaman yi suhuri ni daa ye di piligibu zuɣu shɛm la; zaŋmiya yi ni mali shɛli niŋ li.
en: So now finish the work you started. Then your doing will be equal to your wanting to do. Give from what you have.

dag: A yɛtɔɣa daa taɣiri bɛn tuuri zaana. A daa kpaŋsi bɛn duna ni ka yaa la.
en: Your words have raised up the falling; youve steadied failing knees.

dag: Sabbu din be litaafi ŋɔ ni nyɛla yɛl shɛŋa Naawuni ni daa zaŋ ti Yisa Masia ni o kahigi binshɛŋa din yɛn niŋ wuh o daba. O daa timla o malaika o dabili Jɔn sani ka o ti kahigi li n-wuh o.
en: This is what God showed to Jesus Christ, so that he could tell his servants what must happen soon. Christ then sent his angel with the message to his servant John.

dag: Ka o daa ti zahim zahindi nya ka darigu ʒe tiŋa ka di zuɣusaa chaŋ ti tɔri alizanda, ka o nya ka Naawuni malaikanim dol li duri ka siɣirina.
en: In a dream he saw a ladder that reached from earth to heaven, and God's angels were going up and down on it.

dag: Bundana tɛhiya ni o mali yɛm omaŋ duhibu ni, amaa faralan ŋun mali fahim ni nya li o biɛhigu ni.
en: The rich always think they are wise, but a poor person who is wise can see the truth.

dag: Amaa ka namɔɣilisi maa daa chaŋ ti yɛli Napaɣ Vashiti naa ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka o daa zaɣisi ni o ku kana. Ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka Naa maa suhu yiɣisi pam.
en: The king's servants told Queen Vashti what he had said, but she refused to go to him, and this made him terribly angry.

dag: Amaa ka Babilɔn tɔbbihi daa kari doli ba nti gbaai Zɛdɛkia Jɛriko bɔpiɛligu ni n-zaŋ o tahi ti ti Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza Ribila din daa be Hamat tiŋgbɔŋ ni la. Ka o daa kar o saria nimaani.
en: But the Babylonian troops caught up with them near Jericho. They arrested Zedekiah and took him to the town of Riblah in the land of Hamath, where Nebuchadnezzar put him on trial, then found him guilty.

dag: Ka o daa me goondahi gili Juda fɔntinsi, vuhim ni daa be tiŋgbani maa ni saha shɛli, dama o mini so daa bi zabira. O daa bi tuhi tɔbu di yuma maa ni, dama Yawɛ daa ti o vuhim.
en: Asa built strong cities in Judah while there was peace in Judah. He had no war in these years because the Lord gave him peace.

dag: Ka a yɛli Izraɛlnima, Doo yi kpi ka ka bidibiga, yin zaŋmiya o fali ti o bipuɣiŋga.
en: Tell the Israelites that when a man dies without a son, his daughter will inherit his land.

dag: Ka Gɛra bia Shimɛi ŋun nyɛ Bɛnjamin zuliya ni nira, ka yi Bahurim na la gba beni. O daa tu ma tu biɛri dahin shɛli n ni daa chaŋ Mahanaim la, amaa o ni daa kana nti tuhi ma soli Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni la, n daa po Yawɛ yɛl o, N ku zaŋ takɔb ku a.
en: And remember, Shimei son of Gera is still around. He is the Benjamite from Bahurim who cursed me when I ran away to Mahanaim. But when he came down to meet me at the Jordan River, I made a promise to him before the Lord that I would not kill him.

dag: Ŋunkam tu o ba bee o ma, bɛn kum o, o ni tu o ba bee o ma maa zuɣu, o ʒim yihibu maa taali ʒila o zuɣu.
en: If you curse your father or mother, you will be put to death, and it will be your own fault.

dag: O bihi ni yiɣisi paɣ o ka o yidan gba paɣ o, yɛli.
en: Her children say good things about her. Her husband brags about her and says.

dag: Ka saa daa ti mi ka kom kpe, ka sanʒiɛɣu ʒɛna nti ʒe yili maa, ka di bi lu la, dama o daa me li tamla tampiŋ zuɣu.
en: Rain poured down, rivers flooded, and winds beat against that house. But it was built on solid rock, and so it did not fall.

dag: Bɛ ni ti suui bɛ wain wal kaha bahi kaman wain tia la; ka suui bɛ puma bahi kaman olivi tia la.
en: He will be like a vine that loses its grapes before they ripen. He will be like an olive tree that loses its buds.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ biŋkpam mini zugbini kpam ni biŋkpam din zaa be namanama ni ni binsabili yaɣ shɛli din viɛla ni yaannina ayi mini di biŋkpam ni nudirigu biŋgbalipuɣili.
en: Then he took the fat—the fat tail, all the fat that was around the insides, the lobe of the liver, the two kidneys and their fat—as well as the right thigh.

dag: Yawɛ kpihim a saria karibu la, ka kar a dimnima. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl naa ŋɔ be yi sunsuuni, di lan zɔriya barina shɛli dabiɛm yaha.
en: Zion, your punishment is over. The Lord has forced your enemies to turn and retreat. Your Lord is King of Israel and stands at your side; you don't have to worry about any more troubles.

dag: Yawɛ n-kul nyɛ naa sahakam. Ziɔn, Naawuni n-kul nyɛ ʒiɛmani kam Naawuni. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: The Lord will rule forever! Zion, your God will rule forever and ever! Praise the Lord !.

dag: Bimbira kpila tiŋgban ni, ka ti kambɔna kpalim zaɣ kuma, ka ti kunchuna zaa saɣim, dama ti chi zaa kuuya.
en: We planted seeds, but the seeds became dry and dead lying in the soil. Our plants are dry and dead. Our barns are empty and falling down.

dag: M mali baŋsim gari n karimbanima, dama n kul tɛhirila a zaligunim maa yɛla.
en: I have greater insight than all my teachers because I contemplate your laws.

dag: Amaa chɛliya ka sokam buɣis omaŋmaŋ tuma nya, di nyaaŋa o ni mali dalir shɛli ni o nyu bara ni bela omaŋmaŋ tuma ni, ka pa ni o ʒiʒiinikpee tuma ni.
en: You should each judge your own conduct. If it is good, then you can be proud of what you yourself have done, without having to compare it with what someone else has done.

dag: Yawɛ, n tarigimi, zom ma nambɔɣu. Yawɛ, n kɔba ni zaa chɔɣisimi dabiɛm zuɣu, tibimi ma.
en: Lord , be kind to me. I am sick and weak. Heal me, Lord ! My bones are shaking.

dag: Naa Zɛdɛkia mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa ni daa lo alikauli ni bɛ ni moli faako tibu molo la nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia.
en: King Zedekiah, his officials, and everyone else in Jerusalem made an agreement to free all Hebrew men and women who were slaves. No Jew would keep another as a slave. And so, all the Jewish slaves were given their freedom.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa siɣi teeku maa ni n-doli tiŋ kuŋ maa chana, ka koma maa be kaman goma la n-ʒe bɛ nudirigu mini bɛ nuzaa polo.
en: The Israelites walked into the sea on dry ground. The waters formed a wall for them on their right hand and on their left.

dag: Anab maa daa lan tɔɣisi shihirili shɛli yɛla dindali maa yɛli, Yawɛ ni yɛli shihirili shɛli yɛla m-bɔŋɔ: Nyama, bimbini ŋɔ, a ni ti wurim, ka tampiligim din pa a zuɣu kpaai bahi.
en: The man of God gave proof to the people that this would happen. He said, This is the proof that the Lord told me about. He said, This altar will break apart, and the ashes on it will fall onto the ground.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri sara maligu nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ sani, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi din tuhi suhigu nyɛla din tiɣir o nini.
en: The Lord hates the offerings of the wicked, but he is happy to hear the prayers of those who live right.

dag: Di simdi ka a zaŋ daba ayopɔin tum Aduna min o bidibisi maligumaaniba leebu tuma kaman n ni zal a shɛm maa.
en: You must do all these things for Aaron and his sons. You must do them exactly as I told you. The ceremony for appointing them to be priests must continue for seven days.

dag: Di daa ʒiɛla Ijipti tɔbbihi mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi sunsuuni. Sagbani maa daa nyɛla zibisim Ijiptinim polo, ka nyɛ neesim Izraɛlnim polo yuŋ zaa ka bɛ so daa bi tooi mir o kpee yuŋ maa zaa.
en: but now it moved between the Egyptians and the Israelites. The cloud gave light to the Israelites, but made it dark for the Egyptians, and during the night they could not come any closer.

dag: ka di be kaman n zo sumo bee m mabia zuɣu ka m mali nandahima maa. N daa kul gbami ni suhugarigu, ka chani gindi fabindi kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun ma kpi.
en: as I would for a friend or a relative. I was in sorrow and mourned, as I would for my mother.

dag: Shɛm mini Aripakishad ni Shɛla.
en: Shems descendants were Arphaxad, Shelah.

dag: Ka n yɛli n suhu ni, Naawuni ni ti kari wuntizɔriba mini ninvuɣ biɛri saria, dama o zali yɛlli kam mini tuuni kam saha.
en: I thought to myself, God will judge both righteous and wicked people, because theres a time for every matter and every deed.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa daa lan yi Lakishi gari chaŋ Ɛgilɔn ti teei gil li n-liri ba.
en: Then Joshua and all the Israelites traveled from Lachish to Eglon. They camped around Eglon and attacked it.

dag: Nyini n-zali zoya a kpiɔŋ puuni. A mali yiko pam.
en: You are strong, and your mighty power put the mountains in place.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa kpe du shɛli din daa be puuni ha la ni nti buɣisi di dunoya pilanima, ka di nyɛ mita yiniyini, ka dunɔdali maa yɛliŋ daa nyɛ mita ata. Ka goma din barilim nyɛ mita ata ni pirigili daa be di luɣa zuɣu.
en: Then he went to the innermost room. He measured the passageway into it: it was feet deep and feet wide, with walls on either side feet thick.

dag: Ka Absalom tumtumdiba maa daa shiri niŋ Amnɔn kaman Absalom ni wuhi ba ni bɛ niŋ o shɛm maa. Di saha ka nabihi maa zaa daa dii yiɣisi ba bɛ buntaansi zo.
en: So Absaloms servants did to Amnon just what he had commanded. Then all the princes got up, jumped onto their mules, and fled.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: The word of the Lord came to me. He said.

dag: Nyamiya, yinim ninʒeensinim ŋɔ, tɛhimiya ka naanyi bahi yoli, dama n tum tuun karili yi ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni, tuun kar shɛli so ni yɛli ya di yɛla ka yi ku niŋ yɛda. .
en: Look, you scoffers! Be astonished and die! For what I am doing today is something that you will not believe, even when someone explains it to you.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa du nayili dufahirili zuɣusaa nti ti suɣili zali Absalom, ka Absalom daa mal o ba mamanim maa dooni nimaani Izraɛlnim zaa ninni.
en: Absalom had a tent set up on the flat roof of the palace, and everyone watched as he went into the tent with his father's wives.

dag: Ka o daa lan ŋahi ba ŋaha ŋɔ yɛli, So ku saɣi zaŋ tan palli din na bi tiri n-liɣi binyɛr kurili, dama o yi niŋ lala, tan palli maa ni yaai di ko n-cheei ka chɛ binyɛr kurili maa, ka di maan chɛhi pahi.
en: When someone sews a patch over a hole in an old coat, they never use a piece of cloth that has not already been shrunk. If they do, the patch will shrink and pull away from the coat. Then the hole will be worse.

dag: O kpani maa daa ŋmanila kpalu dapua, ka o kpani maa zuɣu tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ayopɔin. Ka ŋun ʒir o nyɔtaɣirigu be o tooni.
en: His spear was as thick as the bar on a weaver's loom, and its iron head weighed about fifteen pounds. A soldier walked in front of him carrying his shield.

dag: N leela n niriba zaa ni lari ninvuɣ so; bɛ yiini yila maani ma ansarisi dabisi muni puuni zaa.
en: I am a joke to everyone— no one ever stops making fun of me.

dag: N ni zaŋ bɛ ni shɛb leei maligumaaniba ni Lɛvinima. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will make some of them priests and Levites.

dag: Chɛliya ka sokam be kaman Naawuni ni bɔri ni o be shɛm min o ni daa pun be shɛm ka ti Duuma bol o la. N ni zali shɛm cheechi kam ni m-bala:.
en: Nevertheless, each person should live the kind of life that the Lord assigned when he called each one. This is what I teach in all the churches.

dag: Ti kul suhiri Naawuni tiri yi zaa, ka kul paɣiri Naawuni yi zuɣu sahakam;.
en: We thank God for you and always mention you in our prayers. Each time we pray.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi darigi yaag o noli? Dabiɛm n kul be o nyina ni ti gili.
en: Who would try to open its jaws, full of fearsome teeth? *.

dag: Ka Hɛrɔdias bipuɣiŋga daa yi salo maa ni na nti wa waa, ka di niŋ Naa Hɛrɔd mini bɛn daa ʒi o sani maa zaa nyaɣisim pam. Ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa yɛli bipuɣiŋga maa, Yɛlim ma a suhu ni kul bɔri shɛlikam zaa, ka n ti a li.
en: The daughter of Herodias came in and danced for Herod and his guests. She pleased them so much that Herod said, Ask for anything, and it's yours!.

dag: Bɛ daa yi yɛn kpe Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa ni bee n-chaŋ sara maligu bimbin la gbini, bɛ paɣirila bɛ nuhi mini bɛ naba kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm la.
en: In fact, they washed each time before entering the tent or offering sacrifices at the altar. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.

dag: Ka o mini ba daa ti ʒini ni bɛ di bindirigu, ka o zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro kpilli n-niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni ka ŋmahiŋmahi li tari ba.
en: Joining them at the supper table, Jesus took some bread and gave thanks. Then he broke some off and gave it to them.

dag: Filistianima, yi zaa di maliya suhupiɛlli, jaaŋgbe shɛli din yi fiɛbiri ya la ni kabigi la zuɣu. Waɣ yino yi kpi, so n-yirina zan o zaashee. Ka o galli waɣiri waɣ biɛɣu.
en: Philistines, don't be happy just because the rod that punished you is broken. That rod will become a poisonous snake, and then a flying fiery dragon.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli ma shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Cham ti da yaɣimɛr yaɣiri duɣu, ka zaŋ niriba kpamba mini maligumaaniba kpamba pahi amaŋ zuɣu.
en: The Lord said: Jeremiah, go to the pottery shop and buy a clay jar. Then take along some of the city officials and leading priests.

dag: Ka yili shɛli din pɔri ka ku tooi ŋubi piɛbila muni naai, bɛn chɛ ka bɛ mini bɛ ʒiʒiinitaba bɛn baɣi ba laɣim bo piɛbil yino, di simdi ka bɛ pirigi piɛbil maa saɣisi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛn ŋub o kalinli.
en: If his family is too small to eat a whole animal, he and his next-door neighbor may share an animal, in proportion to the number of people and the amount that each person can eat.

dag: Amaa zaŋ chaŋ taali ni yibu Naawuni sani din yi yɛda niŋbu ni na polo di sabiya: Di bɔhi a suhi ni, Ŋuni n-lee ni du alizanda ni? .
en: But what the scripture says about being put right with God through faith is this: You are not to ask yourself, Who will go up into heaven? .

dag: Ka Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la mini Jɔsis ma Mariama daa nya bɛ ni sɔɣi Yisa luɣ shɛli maa.
en: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joseph were watching and saw where the body was placed.

dag: Saha shɛli ha o daa ka a buchi, amaa pumpɔŋɔ o nyɛla ŋun mali buchi m min a zaa sani.
en: Before this, he was useless to you, but now he is useful both to you and to me.

dag: Zuɣulaannim bɛn nyɛ karimbaannim ni bɛn nyu wain buɣi la, bɛ ni ti no n-taai ba.
en: The pride of those drunken leaders will be trampled underfoot.

dag: Karimbia bi garit o karimba; amaa karimbia ŋun nya wuhibu viɛnyɛliŋga, o baŋsim min o karimba baŋsim ti saɣirila taba.
en: Students are not better than their teacher. But when they have been fully taught, they will be like their teacher.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun tumdi tuma yɔri pala pini, amaa di nyɛla o tuma yɔri.
en: Workers salaries arent credited to them on the basis of an employers grace but rather on the basis of what they deserve.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka n daa zaŋ yi ni mali naɣibil so ka di nyɛ alahichi bini maa nyo buɣim wurim li, ka baɣisi li zaa hal ka di ti be kaman zim la, ka n daa zaŋ di zim maa bahi kulibɔn shɛli din kom zɔri yiri zoli zuɣu sirigirina la ni.
en: I took that terrible thing, the calf you made, and burned it in the fire. I broke it into small pieces. And I crushed the pieces until they were dust. Then I threw the dust into the river that came down from the mountain.

dag: Ka niŋmiya tab nirilim, ka mali nambɔzɔbo biɛhigu, ka chɛri yi tab taali paŋdi ba kaman Naawuni ni daa chɛ m-paŋ yi gba Masia zuɣu shɛm la.
en: Be kind and loving to each other. Forgive each other the same as God forgave you through Christ.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔhi Ahimɛlɛk, A ka takɔbi bee kpani kpe n-zaŋ ti ma? Dama naa tuma maa ni bɔri yomyom shɛm zuɣu chɛ ka m bi tooi zaŋ n takɔbi bee m bidibbin shɛli.
en: David asked Ahimelech, Do you have a spear or a sword? I had to leave so quickly on this mission for the king that I didn't bring along my sword or any other weapons.

dag: O zuliya kul ni beni sahakam, ka n chɛ ka o nam kul ba n-ʒe n sani kaman wuntaŋ la.
en: His dynasty will last forever. His throne will be like the sun, always before me.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Dum zoli maa ka n sanna nti guhiri nimaani, ka n zaŋ n ni sabi n zaligunim niŋ kuɣ parilan shɛŋa ni niriba maa wuhibu zuɣu la ti a.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Come up on the mountain and stay here for a while. I will give you the two flat stones on which I have written the laws that my people must obey.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa o ni ti chaŋ ti liri zuliya shɛb bɛn ʒi m-baɣi teeku la n-tuhi nyaŋ bɛ pam. Amaa tinshee sapashin so ni ti kana ti nyaŋ o n-chɛ ka o karimbaani maa zan tariga. Yɛlimaŋli, o shiri ni ti labis o karimbaani maa yɛl biɛri ʒil o.
en: Afterwards, this proud king of the north will invade and conquer many of the nations along the coast, but a military leader will defeat him and make him lose his pride.

dag: Di yi pa lala, yi ni kɔŋ yi jilima yi tab sani, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi zɔri nambɔɣu kun ya ŋmaai yi yuma jia.
en: You will lose your self-respect and end up in debt to some cruel person for the rest of your life.

dag: Amaa dɔr shɛli din zaɣisir maa yi lan yɛlig o niŋgbuŋ maa ni o daɣiri ni yibu maa nyaaŋa.
en: But if the sore spreads after you have been pronounced clean.

dag: N suhuyiɣisili pam puuni n ni ti bɔhi zuliya shɛb bɛn bi deei n noli biɛri.
en: I will become furious and take revenge on the nations that refuse to obey me.

dag: Ka so ni daa kani simdi ni o bɔɣi litaafi maa n-lihi di puuni maa zuɣu daa chɛ ka n kum pam.
en: I cried and cried because there was no one who was worthy to open the scroll or look inside.

dag: A mi ni m ba Dauda min o dimnim bɛn gil o daa kul tuhirila taba hal ka Yawɛ daa ti chɛ ka o nyaŋ ba. Lala zuɣu n-daa chɛ ka o bi tooi me Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu.
en: You remember that my father, King David, had to fight many wars all around him. So he was never able to build a temple to honor the Lord his God. King David was waiting until the Lord allowed him to defeat all his enemies.

dag: Naa ti ku lan beni n-su bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa, ka nabihi zaa ti ku lan beni.
en: Edom will be called Kingdom of Nothing. Its rulers will also be nothing.

dag: Viri ni ti te bɛ tɛri nimaani n-nye gala wɔɣi, ka dihiri bɛ bihi maa nimaani. Juri gba ni ti laɣindi nimaani.
en: Owls will nest there to raise their young among its shadows, while families of vultures circle around.

dag: Bɛ ni niriba anu daa nyɛla yɛnnima, ka niriba anu la mi nyɛ jɛra.
en: Five of them were foolish and five were wise.

dag: Di piligirila zuɣusaa yaɣ shɛli tariga, n-zaŋ ti kpa yaɣ din la tariga. Ka binshɛli ku tooi sɔɣi ka di biisim ku paa li.
en: It starts at one end of the sky and runs all the way to the other end. Nothing can hide from its heat.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla yi bibihi shɛb yi ni yɛli ni bɛ ni ŋme ŋ-gbahi ba la, yi bi shɛb bɛn bi mi din viɛla ni din bie zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n-ni ti kpe di ni, bɛna ka n ni ti zaŋ li ti ka bɛ deei li su.
en: Then the Lord spoke to you again: People of Israel, you said that your innocent young children would be taken prisoner in the battle for the land. But someday I will let them go into the land, and with my help they will conquer it and live there.

dag: Ti Duuma, neema! Bɔ n-niŋ ka a gbihira? Neema! Di chɛ ti bahi sahakam!.
en: Wake up! Do something, Lord! Why are you sleeping? Don't desert us forever.

dag: Ka malaika so ŋun daa yɛli ma yɛtɔɣa maa daa lan kana ti yɛli ma, Nyama, binshɛl lan yina chana.
en: The angel who was talking to me went outside and said, Look! What do you see coming.

dag: O mabihi n-daa nyɛ Gabai mini Sallai. Bɛ zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiwɛi ni pihitaayika.
en: and those who followed Jeshaiah were Gabbai and Sallai. All together there were men.

dag: Di saha ka a pii di biɛla gbini a binyɛrigu naŋgbambili.
en: From that third, take a few strands and hide them in your garment.

dag: O ni zali ti shɛm n-nyɛ ni ti niŋ o Bia Yisa Ba Masia yuli yɛda ka yuri taba kaman o ni zali ti shɛm.
en: This is his commandment, that we believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love each other as he commanded us.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ma, Nyama, n ni chɛ ka a zaŋ naɣ bindi she bɔrɔbɔro maa ka chɛ ninsal bindi maa.
en: He answered me: Then Ill let you use cow dung instead of human excrement. You can make your bread over that.

dag: ni Joɛla mini Zɛbadia bɛn daa nyɛ Jɛrɔham Gɛdɔr nir bihi la.
en: and Joelah and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham from the town of Gedor.

dag: Ka Naawuni yiko tuuni ŋɔ daa niŋ niriba maa zaa alahiziba pam. Niriba maa ni daa na kul tɛhiri Yisa ni tumd alahiziba tuun shɛlikam zaa yɛla maa ka o daa yɛl o nyaandoliba.
en: Everyone was amazed at God's great power. While everyone was still amazed at what Jesus was doing, he said to his disciples.

dag: Ka o deemba ŋun daa nyɛ paɣ maa ba yɛli Lɛvi zuliya doo maa ni o kpalimmi gbe, ka o daa kpalim gbe daba ata. Ka bɛ daa laɣindi diri ka nyura, ka o gbɛri nimaani.
en: The womans father led the Levite into his house. The Levites father-in-law invited him to stay. So he stayed for three days. He ate, drank, and slept in his father-in-laws house.

dag: Nyin ka n kul zaŋ mmaŋ dalim n dɔɣibu saha hal ni wayo, nyini n-daa yihi ma m ma puli ni na. N kul ni paɣir a sahakam.
en: I have relied on you from the day I was born. You brought me safely through birth, and I always praise you.

dag: ka niŋmi paɣikura kaman a manim la; ka niŋmi paɣisara mi kaman a tizɔpaɣiba la biɛr kasi zaa puuni.
en: and treat older women as you would your own mother. Show the same respect to younger women that you would to your sister.

dag: N ni ti ti maligumaaniba bindir suma, ka n niriba ti di m pina din galisi tiɣi. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will lavish the priests with abundance and shower my people with my gifts, declares the LORD.

dag: Nyama, ŋunkam zaa jɛmdi li ni di vi. Daadamnim bɛn nyɛ tuumbaŋdiba m-me wuna bee n-kpe li zali. Chɛ ka bɛ zaa laɣimna nti yiɣisi zani. Dabiɛm ni ti gbahi ba ka bɛ zaa di vi.
en: Workers made them, and the workers are only human. If they all would come together before me, we could discuss this. Then they would all be ashamed and afraid.

dag: N Naawuni, n suhu yɛmi ni n tumla a yubu, a zaligu be n suhu ni.
en: My God, I am happy to do whatever you want. I never stop thinking about your teachings.

dag: Ka siliga guliba maa daa deei liɣiri maa, ka chaŋ ti shiri niŋ bɛ ni wuhi ba shɛm maa, ka Yɛhudianim daa deei yɛlli ŋɔ niŋ yɛlimaŋli hal ni pɔŋɔ.
en: So the soldiers took the money and did as they were told. And this report has spread throughout all Judea to this very day.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Akishi daa bɔh o kpambaliba maa, Nyamiya, yi nya ka doo ŋɔ nyɛla yinyaa, ka yi zaŋ o kani n sanna?.
en: Cant you see hes crazy? Achish asked his servants. Why bring him to me?.

dag: Bɛ daa gbahi Dauda paɣiba ayi la gba chaŋ; Ahinɔam ŋun daa yi Jɛziriil na la mini Abigeel Nabal pakoli ŋun daa yi Kamɛl na la.
en: David's two wives, Ahinoam and Abigail, had been taken captive with everyone else.

dag: Dinzuɣu n labila Jɛrusalɛm na nti zo li nambɔɣu, bɛ ni lab me n jɛmbu duu la yaha, ka n chɛ ka bɛ teei bimbuɣisirigu m-buɣisi Jɛrusalɛm. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: And so, I will have pity on Jerusalem. The city will be completely rebuilt, and my temple will stand again.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa na. Bɛ daa kul tahirimi ka piɛbiri kikahi ni piɛlahi yila, ka ŋmɛri guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisa, ka daa lan ŋmɛri mɔɣilɔnim mini goonjɛnim pampam.
en: So all Israel brought up the chest containing the LORDs covenant with shouts of joy, accompanied by the blast of the rams horn, by trumpets and cymbals, and playing on harps and lyres.

dag: Ŋun chɛ soli bahi ni ti nya tibidarigibo pam, ka ŋunkam mi je ni bɛ kpah o zuɣu ni ni kpi.
en: If you do what is wrong, you will be severely punished; you will die if you do not let yourself be corrected.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, N lan yɛri ya mi, ŋunkam ʒe n nyaaŋa niriba ni, Daadam Bia gba ni ti ʒe dilan nyaaŋa Naawuni malaikanim sani;.
en: I tell you, everyone who acknowledges me before humans, the Human Onewill acknowledge before Gods angels.

dag: Abijam ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam zaa bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi ni. Abijam mini Jɛrɔbɔam daa kul tuhirila tab tɔbu.
en: And everything else that Abijah did is recorded in The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: ka chɛbisi taba. Di nyaaŋa ka ti daa kpe ŋariŋ, ka bɛ mi lab kuli.
en: We said good-bye to each other, then we boarded the ship and they returned to their homes.

dag: Di ni yɛli ni o daa du zuɣusaa ha la gbinni lee nyɛ wula? Di gbinni nyɛla ni o daa tuui siɣimi na hal n-gari siɣi tiŋgbani puuni ha.
en: Now, what does he went up mean? It means that first he came down to the lowest depths of the earth.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Musa daa chaŋ ti zaŋ Yawɛ yɛtɔɣa maa yɛli niriba maa; ka daa laɣim Izraɛlnim kpamba ninvuɣ pisopɔin na nti chɛ ka bɛ zani gili suɣili maa.
en: So Moses went out to speak with the people. He told them what the Lord said. Then he gathered of the elders together and told them to stand around the Tent.

dag: M mabihi n suhiri ya, benya kaman mani, dama n gba bemi kaman yinima. Yi bi tum ma taali.
en: I beg you to be like me, brothers and sisters, because I have become like you! You havent wronged me.

dag: dindina nyin chɛ ka m bɔɣusapiŋ kɔbili kparigi ka m bɔɣu kabi.
en: I hope that arm will fall from its socket.

dag: Hɛzɛkia daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani kaman o yab Naa Dauda ni daa niŋ shɛm la.
en: Hezekiah did what the Lord said was right, just as David his ancestor had done.

dag: Dama daba ayɔbu ka man Yawɛ daa zaŋ nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ni teeku ni binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni, ka daa vuhi daba ayopɔin dali. Lala zuɣu man Yawɛ niŋla alibarika niŋ di ni, ka zaŋ li leei dabisili kasi.
en: In six days I made the sky, the earth, the oceans, and everything in them, but on the seventh day I rested. That's why I made the Sabbath a special day that belongs to me.

dag: Ti Duuma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, N ni chɛ ka dabiɛm gbahi ya luɣilikam, ka yi wurim, ka sokam kpa o kpabu polo, ka so ku lan beni ŋun ni laɣim kuŋkɔɣinzɔriba luɣ yini.
en: Im the one who will terrify you from every side, declares the LORD of heavenly forces. Every one of you will be scattered about; no one will gather those who fled.

dag: So daa ka Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ zaa ni n-viɛli paai Absalom. O daa ka dalinli o napɔnvari ni zaŋ hal ni o zuɣu ni.
en: No one in all Israel was as handsome and well-built as Absalom.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Faashee a nya shihira mini alahiziba tumtumsa, di yi pa lala, a ku niŋ yɛda.
en: Jesus said to him, None of you will ever believe unless you see miracles and wonders.

dag: Dama Naawuni ni ti kari tuuni kam saria zaŋ tabili ashilɔni tuuni kam, di yi nyɛla zaɣ suŋ bee zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: God will definitely bring every deed to judgment, including every hidden thing, whether good or bad.

dag: Dama n ni kari zuliya shɛb bɛn be yi tooni, ka yɛligi yi tiŋgbani, ka chɛ ka so ti ku niŋ yi tiŋgbani maa kɔre.
en: I will drive out nations before you and extend your borders. No one will desire and try to take your land if you go up and appear before the LORD your God three times a year.

dag: Amaa ka Babilɔn tɔbbihi maa daa kari doli Naa Zɛdɛkia nti gbaag o Jɛriko bɔpiɛligu ni, ka o tɔbbihi zaa daa zo ka chɛ o.
en: However, the Babylonian army chased down Zedekiah and caught him in the plains of Jericho.

dag: Bɛ yi kpe Baka vinvamli la ni ni bɛ gari, bɛ chɛrimi ka di puhigir kom zɔra; ka siɣili saa ŋun daŋ mibu chɛri ka di kpɛri paana.
en: When they reach Dry Valley, springs start flowing, and the autumn rain fills it with pools of water.

dag: Yawɛ, a sani ka nasara dibu yirina, niŋm alibarika niŋ a niriba ni.
en: Rescue comes from the LORD! May your blessing be on your people! Selah.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ kom din tahiri tibidarigibo ŋɔ na ni kpe a pul nyɔri ni n-chɛ ka a dɔɣibu soli ŋari, ka a leei paɣiŋoo. Ka paɣ maa ni garigi yɛli, Ami Ami.
en: May this water enter your stomach and cause it to swell up and your genital organs to shrink. The woman shall respond, I agree; may the Lord do so.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ lan bɔhi, Yi bi nya din niŋdi ya maa?.
en: This is what the LORD of heavenly forces says: Take your ways to heart.

dag: M mi a ni ʒiini shɛm ni a ni yiɣisiri shɛm, ka mi a ni yiri chani ka labirina shɛm. N lan mi a ni je suli niŋ ma shɛm.
en: But I know everything about you, what you do and where you go. I know how you rage against me.

dag: Ka tumtumdi kpeem bilikɔɣino ŋɔ dan maa daa paɣ o pam o dahin shɛli tɛha maa zuɣu, dama bɛn doli zibisim soli dunia ŋɔ ni mali yɛmbimbiɛri bɛ tuma ni gari bɛn doli neesim soli.
en: The master praised his dishonest manager for looking out for himself so well. That's how it is! The people of this world look out for themselves better than the people who belong to the light.

dag: Nyin ŋun be Zallakudura Naa sani sɔɣibu shee mini ŋun kpalim be Kpiɔŋlan Naa mahim ni.
en: You can go to God Most High to hide. You can go to God All-Powerful for protection.

dag: Ka hal yɛlli maa yi lula Gomna tibili ni gba, ti ni bo shɛli ti o ka o ku niŋ ya shɛli.
en: If the governor hears about this, we will talk to him. You won't have anything to worry about.

dag: Yaa ti Duuma Naawuni, wummi mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ suhigu mini m balima ŋɔ; a yuli zuɣu ŋmaligim a nini lihi nya a jɛmbu duu la ni wurim doya shɛm.
en: I am your servant, Lord God, and I beg you to answer my prayers and bring honor to yourself by having pity on your temple that lies in ruins.

dag: Ka o daa bɔhi ba, Yi nya dimbɔŋɔnim zaa bee yi bi nya li? Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, di zaa ni ti wurim hal ka di kuɣ yini gba ti ku lan pa di kpee zuɣu.
en: He asked them, Are you looking at these buildings? The fact is, they will be destroyed. Every stone will be thrown down to the ground. Not one stone will be left on another.

dag: kaman bɛ ni daa nya li di piligu ni shɛm, ka moli di lahibal la.
en: What they have written agrees with what we learned from the people who saw those events from the beginning. They also served God by telling people his message.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ni lan deei Juda n-su tiŋgbɔŋ kasi maa, ka lan pii Jɛrusalɛm yaha.
en: Then Judah will be his part of the holy land, and Jerusalem will again be his chosen city.

dag: Ka m mini m paɣa ŋun nyɛ anabi la daa dɔni, ka o niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga. Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Bolim o yuli Mahɛshalalihashibaz.
en: I then had sex with the prophetess, and she became pregnant and gave birth to a son. Then the LORD said to me, Name him Maher-shalal-hash-baz.

dag: ni Zɔra ni Aijalɔn ni Hiburɔn. O ni daa me goondahi gili Juda mini Bɛnjamin fɔntin shɛŋa m-bala.
en: Zorah, Aijalon, and Hebron. After he had fortified these cities in the territories of Judah and Benjamin.

dag: Ka Samaria paɣ maa bɔh o, Di chaŋ wula ka nyin Yɛhudia nir ti suhiri man Samaria paɣ kom? Dama Yɛhudianim bi saɣiri ka bɛ mini Samarianim laɣindi timdi dira.
en: You are a Jew, she replied, and I am a Samaritan woman. How can you ask me for a drink of water when Jews and Samaritans won't have anything to do with each other.

dag: Miriya ka yi zo nambɔɣu, di ni ti nyɛla nyɛvil la nyɛvili, nin la nini, nyin la nyini, nuu la nuu, napɔŋ la napɔŋ.
en: Dont feel sorry about punishing someone who does wrong. If a life is taken, a life must be paid for it. The rule is an eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth, a hand for a hand, a foot for a foot—the punishment must equal the crime.

dag: M bi lan je suli niŋ wain tihi puu maa. Di yi mali gɔhi mini suligunyinyari, dindina n ni mali shili lu di zuɣu, ka nyo li buɣim.
en: Im not angry, but if it yields thorns and thistles for me, I will march to battle against it; I will torch it completely.

dag: Ka sagbana din be yi zuɣusaa ŋɔ ni ti leei daanya, ka tiŋgbani din be yi tiŋli ŋɔ ti leei kurugu.
en: The sky over your head will be as hard as bronze; the earth under your feet will be like iron.

dag: Adam n-daa nyɛ Shɛt ba, ka Shɛt nyɛ Ɛnɔsh ba.
en: Adam, Seth, Enosh.

dag: hal ka piɛm ti nyɔɣ o gbaag o nyɔri. O ŋmanila noombil so ŋun zɔri chani zana ni ka bi mi ni di nyɛla din yɛn di o nyɛvili.
en: where an arrow would pierce its heart. He was like a bird going into a net—he did not know that his life was in danger.

dag: Jɛra n-tɛhi ni bɛmaŋmaŋ soli n-tuhi, amaa yɛnnim bɛn gbilisirila tibili wumda.
en: Fools think they know what is best, but a sensible person listens to advice.

dag: Di saha goli ti ku piɛla, ka wuntaŋ ti zibigi, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni ti di nam ʒini Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu ni Jɛrusalɛm, ka o ti kahig o jilima wuh o niriba toondaannima.
en: The moon will be diminished, and the sun will fade, since the LORD of heavenly forces will rule on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, glorious before his elders.

dag: di saha yin bom zim viɛlli lita ata n-zaŋ kpam lita ayi ŋmir li;.
en: you will present with the bull a grain offering of three-tenths of a measure of fine flour mixed with a half hin of oil.

dag: Ka yi lan zaŋ bula yino mali alahichi sanyoo sara pahi yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim sahakam la mini di chi sara ni di binnyura sara la zuɣu.
en: There will be one male goat for a purification offering in addition to the regular entirely burned offering with its grain offering and its drink offerings.

dag: Dinzuɣu miriya ka yi jiɣindi m-bɔhira, Bɔ ka ti yɛn di bee n-nyu bee bɔ ka ti yɛn ye.
en: Dont worry and say, What will we eat? or What will we drink? or What will we wear.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa yɛli Jɔnatan, Yɛlim ma a ni niŋ shɛli. Ka Jɔnatan yɛl o, N di zaŋla jaaŋgbee din be n nuu ni n-suɣi shiri di, dinzuɣu n-nyɛ ma, m mali shili ni n kpi.
en: Tell me what youve done, Saul said to Jonathan. So Jonathan told him. I only took a very small taste of honey on the end of my staff, he said. And now Im supposed to die.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa ti lo tɔbu chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi Filistianima, ka ti suɣa n-do luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Ɛbɛnɛza la, ka Filistianim maa mi daa ti bɛ suɣa do Afɛk.
en: And Samuels word went out to all Israel. In those days the Philistines gathered for war against Israel, so Israel went out to engage the Philistines in war. Israel camped at Ebenezer, while the Philistines camped at Aphek.

dag: ninvuɣ biɛtali lɔɣu lɛbigirila bɛ puya ni, ka leei sapaɣ binsom bɛ puya maa ni.
en: Food turns their stomachs, becoming a cobras poison inside.

dag: A ni je suli niŋ ma ka a karimbaani yɛla kana ti lu n tibili ni shɛm zuɣu, n ni zaŋ n ziŋgoo niŋ a nyee ni, ka zaŋ n galige le a ŋ-ŋmalig a ka a dol a ni daa doli so shɛli kana labi.
en: I have seen your pride and the tremendous hatred you have for me. Now I will put a hook in your nose, a bit in your mouth, then I will send you back to where you came from.

dag: Dama pumpɔŋɔ bɛ ni yɛli, Ti lan ka naa, dama ti bi zɔri Yawɛ, ka bɔ ka naa lee yɛn niŋ ti ti.
en: Now the Israelites say, We have no king. We dont honor the Lord . And his king cannot do anything to us.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda min o niriba maa daa lu solɔɣu chana, ka Shimɛi daa be zolɔŋni m-baɣisir o luɣili polo dol o chani tur o, ka labir o kuɣa, ka toori taŋkpaɣu chɛr o.
en: So David and his men continued along the road. Shimei kept up with them, walking on the hillside; he was cursing and throwing stones and dirt at them as he went.

dag: Yi nyɛla bɛn bi mi din sa yɛn niŋ yi nyɛviya biɛɣuni; dama yi ŋmanila paɣili din yi kpe, ka di bi yuui ka di lan yi la.
en: You don't even know what your life tomorrow will be! You are like a puff of smoke, which appears for a moment and then disappears.

dag: ni laakumnim kɔbisinahi ni pihitanaanu ni bunsi tusaayɔbu ni kɔbisiyopɔin ni pisi.
en: camels, and , donkeys.

dag: Naa Sulemaana yilli din nyɛ yila puuni yili viɛlli.
en: The Song of Songs, which is for Solomon.

dag: Ka niriba maa garigi yɛli Gidiɔn, Ti ni zaŋ li ti a ni ti suhuri zaa. Ka bɛ daa teei binyɛrigu sɔŋ, ka sokam zaa zaŋd o ni ŋme n-di tibikpar shɛŋa na ti pari di zuɣu.
en: The Israelite soldiers replied, Of course we will give you the earrings. Then they spread out a robe on the ground and tossed the earrings on it.

dag: Yuun pisopɔin maa saha yi ti paai, Yawɛ ni chɛ ka Taai tiŋgbɔŋ maa lan lab di tuun kura ni yaha n-lan zaŋ dimaŋ kɔhi dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa zuɣu kaman pagɔrili la.
en: When the seventy years are over, the Lord will let Tyre go back to her old trade, and she will hire herself out to all the kingdoms of the world.

dag: Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, dabili bi gar o duuma; tumo mi bi gari ŋun tim o.
en: Believe me, servants are not greater than their master. Those who are sent to do something are not greater than the one who sent them.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa daa yi Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu maa ni na, ka o mini Jeemsi ni Jɔn daa chaŋ ti kpe Saimɔn mini Anduru yiŋa.
en: Jesus and the followers left the synagogue. They all went with James and John to the home of Simon and Andrew.

dag: Ka bɛ ni so ti ku wuhi o kpee bee o mabia yɛra, Baŋmi ti Duuma! Sokam zaa ni ti mi ma, hal bɛn nyɛ tarimba zaŋ tabili wɔɣira.
en: And each person wont ever teach a neighbor or their brother or sister, saying, Know the Lord, because they will all know me, from the least important of them to the most important; .

dag: Ka Zilla mi daa dɔɣi Tubalikeen ŋun daa nyɛ ŋun zaŋ daanya mini kuriti m-mali tuma nɛma balibu kam zaa la. Ka Tubalikeen tizɔpaɣ daa nyɛ Naama.
en: Zillah gave birth to Tubal-Cain. Tubal-Cain was the father of people who work with bronze and iron. The sister of Tubal-Cain was named Naamah.

dag: Mani n-daa nam li ka di viɛla, ka mali wula pam. Ka Idɛn tihi zaa din daa be Naawuni tihi puu la ni daa zabiri li nyuli.
en: I, the Lord , gave this tree its beauty, and I helped the branches grow strong. All other trees in Eden wanted to be just like it.

dag: Yawɛ daa chɛ ka o dabili zooi kaman bimbilin shɛli din jila ba tiŋa tiŋkuŋ ni. Ti ni daa nya o, o daa ka dariza bee viɛlim. Shɛli daa ka o niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu lihibu ni din ni chɛ ka ti bɔr o.
en: It was the will of the Lord that his servant grow like a plant taking root in dry ground. He had no dignity or beauty to make us take notice of him. There was nothing attractive about him, nothing that would draw us to him.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Musa daa yihi li bɛ nuhi ni n-zaŋ li pahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la zuɣu n-nyo li buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu, ka di leei Maligumaana leebu sara maligu din nyom viɛla, ka nyɛ sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ nyo buɣim ti Yawɛ.
en: Then Moses took the food from them and burned it on the altar, on top of the burnt offering, as an ordination offering. This was a food offering, and its odor was pleasing to the Lord .

dag: ni di chɛ ka Sulemaana yɛm maa gari wulimpuhili polɔnim zaa yɛm zaŋ tabili Ijiptinim zaa yɛm.
en: Solomon was wiser than the wise men of the East or the wise men of Egypt.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ni Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya: N niriba bɛn be Ziɔn, di zɔriya Asirianim dabiɛm saha shɛli bɛ yi ti zaŋ fiɛbisi fiɛbiri ya, ka kpuɣi jaaŋgbɛbihi fiɛbiri ya kaman Ijiptinim ni daa niŋ shɛm la.
en: Now the Lord God All-Powerful says to his people in Jerusalem: The Assyrians will beat you with sticks and abuse you, just as the Egyptians did. But don't be afraid of them.

dag: N zaŋmi m bɔrɔbɔro mini ko shɛli ni nim shɛli n ni ku n-zali bɛn chɛri m piɛri kɔbiri maa ti ninvuɣ shɛba n ni bi mi bɛ ni yi shɛl na.
en: What makes you think I would take my bread, my water, and the meat that I've had cooked for my own servants and give it to you? Besides, I'm not sure that David sent you!.

dag: N Naawuni, n suhir a ni a kul tim ma bini diba ayi kɔŋko, di nyaaŋa n ku lan sɔɣi mmaŋa a sani.
en: I ask only two things of you, my God, and I will no longer hide from you—.

dag: Ka o ti bɔhi ba, Alizam bɔ ka yi lee diri chani maa? Ka bɛ kpalim zani ni suhugarigu.
en: Jesus asked them, What were you talking about as you walked along? The two of them stood there looking sad and gloomy.

dag: Ka Haman daa zaŋ kpariti maa mini wɔhu maa chaŋ ti zaŋ kpariti maa yɛli Mɔdɛkai ka chɛ ka o ba wɔhu maa, ka ŋun Haman gari tooni zaŋ o doli tiŋ puuni solɔri, ka kuhiri yɛra, Nyamiya naa ni niŋ o ni yu ni o duhi ninvuɣ so shɛm.
en: So Haman got the robes and the horse, and he put the robes on Mordecai. Mordecai got on the horse, and Haman led him through the city square, announcing to the people as they went: See how the king rewards a man he wishes to honor.

dag: A yurilim maŋli la so nyɛvili. N ni yaai n noli paɣ a.
en: Your faithful love is better than life, so my lips praise you.

dag: Ŋun daa yɛli zaŋ chaŋ o banim min o manim polo, M bi lihi nya ba. O daa zaɣisi o mabihi, ka zaɣisi o bihi. Dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn dol a yɛligu, ka gbib a daalikauli.
en: Protecting Israel's agreement with the Lord was more important to you than the life of your father or mother, or brothers or sisters, or your own children.

dag: Paɣiba pam tum din viɛla, amaa nyini n-gari bɛ zaa.
en: Many women act competently, but you surpass them all.

dag: Dama nandaamba kul ni be yi sani sahakam; amaa man kul ku be yi sani sahakam.
en: You will always have the poor with you, but you won't always have me.

dag: Zaŋmi dam din kpɛma n-ti ninvuɣ so ŋun yɛn kpi, ka zaŋ wain ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be nandahima pam ni.
en: Give strong drink to those who are perishing and wine to those whose hearts are bitter.

dag: ka su kom luɣ kasi shee maa, ka zaŋ omaŋmaŋ binyɛra ye n-yina ti mal o sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la mini niriba sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la n-yo omaŋmaŋ daalahichi mini niriba maa daalahichi samli.
en: He will wash his whole body with water in a holy place. Then he will put on his clothes. He will come out and offer his burnt offering and the peoples burnt offering. He will make himself and the people pure.

dag: A yi nyɛla wuntizɔra, nyaɣisim bɔ ka di lee tiri Kpiɔŋlan Naa? Bee a yi nyɛla ŋun ka galimi, nyo bɔ ka o yɛn nya di zuɣu?.
en: Does your doing right benefit God, or does your being good help him at all?.

dag: Daba ata maa dali asiba, ka saa daa gbaai tahibu, ka nyaɣisira, ka sagban tibisili daa be zoli maa zuɣu, ka kika titali din yo vuri pam kum, ka niriba bɛn daa be sansani maa ni zaa niŋgbuna sɔhira.
en: When morning dawned on the third day, there was thunder, lightning, and a thick cloud on the mountain, and a very loud blast of a horn. All the people in the camp shook with fear.

dag: Ka bɛ suhuri pali ninvuɣ biɛtali balibu kam. Dina n-nyɛ: Tuumbiɛri mini bina ni kɔre kpɛbu ni biɛr biɛɣu ni nyuli ni ninvuɣ kubo ni naŋgbankpeeni ni yɔhiŋ ni jɛlinsi. Bɛ nyɛla munaafichinim mini.
en: So they were filled with all injustice, wicked behavior, greed, and evil behavior. They are full of jealousy, murder, fighting, deception, and malice. They are gossips.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yi kpi, bɛ nyarila vuhim bɛ kum maa puuni.
en: But peace will come too, and those who trust him will get to rest in their own beds.

dag: Yawɛ, fam ma ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni bahi; guli ma, ka duŋtaariba ku paai ma.
en: Lord , save me from people who are evil. Protect me from those who are cruel.
