dag: Pumpɔŋɔ a saɣimya teeku puuni, kɔbulli ni. Ka a min a daguya ni a tumtumdiba zaa laɣim shim.
en: But now you are broken by the seas and by the deep waters. All the things you sell and all your people have fallen.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda suhu daa yiɣisi pam bahi ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋ lala maa zuɣu, ka o yɛli Neetan, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋ lala maa simdila kubu.
en: David was furious with the rich man and said to Nathan, I swear by the living Lord that the man who did this deserves to die!.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn min o tɔbbihi maa zaa daa kul ba n-ʒe bɛ zaashɛhi ni gili Midiannim sansani maa, ka Midiannim maa daa kuhi ka yiɣisi guui.
en: The enemy soldiers started yelling and tried to run away. Gideon's troops stayed in their positions surrounding the camp.

dag: ni Adama ni Rama ni Hazɔr.
en: Adamah, Ramah, Hazor.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba daa dim salo maa tiba ni yɛli ni bɛ yɛlim o ni o yihimila Barabas bahi ka ku Yisa.
en: But the chief priests and the elders persuaded the crowds to ask for Barabbas and kill Jesus.

dag: M mi yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm. M mi yi yurilim mini yi yɛda niŋbu ni yi ni tumdi shɛlikam n zuɣu zaŋ tabili yi daania niŋbu yɛla, ka lan mi yi pumpɔŋɔ tuma ni gari yi tuuli tuma shɛm la gba yɛla.
en: I know your works, your love and faithfulness, your service and endurance. I also know that the works you have done most recently are even greater than those you did at first.

dag: Yawɛ mali shili ni o saɣim dunia ŋɔ n-dahimdahim li sɔŋ. O ni chɛ ka tiŋgbani dam ka sokam gbaai zɔbu.
en: The Lord is going to devastate the earth and leave it desolate. He will twist the earth's surface and scatter its people.

dag: Yisa daa kpe ŋariŋ ni, ka o nyaandoliba gba dol o kpe.
en: When Jesus got into a boat, his disciples followed him.

dag: O ni daa yɛl o lala bahi ka kpe yili maa ni, o nya ka niriba pam m-pun laɣim ʒiya.
en: As they continued to talk, Peter went inside and found a large gathering of people.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi la daa lo ni bɛ ku dansarikanim maa, dama ni di yi pa lala bɛ ni duɣi kom maa du n-zo n-tiligi.
en: The soldiers decided to kill the prisoners to keep them from swimming to shore and escaping.

dag: Ka Dauda daa tim tuumba Jabɛshigiliadnim maa sani ti yɛli ba, Yawɛ niŋmi alibarika niŋ yi ni yi ni daa wuhi yi ʒiɛyimtali ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ yi dan Naa Sool sani, ka sɔɣ o la zuɣu.
en: David sent messengers to the men of Jabesh Gilead. These messengers told the men in Jabesh: The Lord bless you, because you have shown kindness to your lord Saul by burying him.

dag: ka yɛra, Timiya ma yiko ŋɔ, ka n gba zaŋdi n nuhi pari niriba zuɣu ka bɛ deeri Naawuni Shia Kasi.
en: and said, Give this power to me too, so that anyone I place my hands on will receive the Holy Spirit.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sab gbana ti Yɛhudianim zaa bɛn daa be Naa Ahasivɛrɔs tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣa kɔbiga ni pisinaayopɔin la zaa ni. Gbaŋ maa puuni yɛtɔɣa daa nyɛla Yɛhudianim suhudoo mini yɛlimaŋli puhigu.
en: The letter was addressed to all the Jews, and copies were sent to all the provinces of the Persian Empire. It wished the Jews peace and security.

dag: Iso bia Riuɛl bidibisi bɛn daa nyɛ nanima n-daa nyɛ: Nahat mini Zɛra ni Shamma ni Miza. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Riuɛl bidibisi bɛn nyɛ nanima Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Bɛ daa nyɛla Iso paɣ Basɛmat yaansi.
en: Esau's son Reuel was the ancestor of the following tribes: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were all descendants of Esau's wife Basemath.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi yi yɛn suhi Naawuni, yin suhimiya ŋ-ŋɔ: Ti Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni, chɛ ka a yuli du;.
en: So this is how you should pray: Our Father in heaven, we pray that your name will always be kept holy.

dag: Ka di zuɣu chɛ ka n wuhi n kpiɔŋ mini n kasitali ka zuliya pam nya li, ka baŋ ma. Di saha ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will do these things to show the world that I, the Lord , am holy.

dag: Ka o daa pir o tɔbbihi ʒii buta zuɣu n-zaŋ ba chaŋ mɔɣu maa ni ti sɔɣi do n-gu ba. Ka Abimilɛk daa ti lihi nya ba ka bɛ yi tiŋ maa ni kanna, ka o yiɣisi lu bɛ zuɣu ku ba.
en: Abimelech divided his army into three groups and set up an ambush in the fields near Shechem. When the people came out of the town, he and his army rushed out from their hiding places and attacked.

dag: Ka bɛ daa balim Yisa ni o yim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Then the people started begging Jesus to leave their part of the country.

dag: N suhu ni yuri so, yɛlim ma, Ya polo ka a zaŋd a piɛri chani ka bɛ ti ŋubiri mɔri? Ya polo ka a chɛ ka bɛ dooni vuhiri wuntaŋ ni? Bɔzuɣu ka m be kaman paɣ so ŋun pa sariga dol a tab biŋkɔbbaligu.
en: My darling, I love you! Where do you feed your sheep and let them rest at noon? Don't let the other shepherds think badly of me. I'm not one of those women who shamelessly follow after shepherds.

dag: Amaŋmaŋ cham ti tuhi, mali kpiɔŋ tɔb maa tuhibu ni. Di yi pa lala Naawuni ni ŋme a luh a dimnim maa tooni. Dama Naawuni mali yiko din ni sɔŋ nira bee n-ŋme o luhi.
en: You may think that they will make you stronger in battle, but it is God who has the power to give victory or defeat, and he will let your enemies defeat you.

dag: Bɛ zaŋm di biŋkpam zaa mali sara, di zuli ni kpam mini kpam din pili namanama.
en: All of its fat will be offered: the fat tail; the fat that covers the insides.

dag: Dama o kul wuhirila zaligu yiniyini mini wuhibu yiniyini ni kuligakuliga ni biɛlifu kpe, biɛlifu kpe.
en: He speaks to us as though we were babies: Saw lasaw saw lasaw Qaw laqaw qaw laqaw Zeer sham zeer sham.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ tuma nyɔri labisi ti ka ku di li, bɛ ni wolim nya nyɔ shɛl la, bɛ ku di di nyaɣisim.
en: He will be forced to give back his profits. He will not be allowed to enjoy what he worked for.

dag: ni noonsi bɛn yiɣiri zuɣusaa ŋɔ ni teeku ni zahim ni binnɛɔŋ kam ŋun be teeku ni.
en: the birds in the sky, the fish of the ocean, everything that travels the pathways of the sea.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni zaŋ o Shi so tin ya maa pala ŋun ni zaŋ ya leei daba n-lan kpɛhiri ya dabiɛm yaha, amaa Naawuni Shia maa lee chɛ ka yi leerila Naawuni bihi. Ka ti kuhiri yɛra, M Ba! M Ba.
en: You didnt receive a spirit of slavery to lead you back again into fear, but you received a Spirit that shows you are adopted as his children. With this Spirit, we cry, Abba, Father.

dag: Di saha ka malaika ŋun pah ayopɔin la piɛb o kikaa, ka kukol kara kul kuhiri pampam alizanda ni yɛra, Dunia nam leela ti Duuma Naawuni min o Masia dini hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Then the seventh angel blew his trumpet, and there were loud voices in heaven saying, The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and his Christ, and he will rule forever and always.

dag: Ka kum daa ti lu bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. Ka Ibram daa yiɣisi chaŋ Ijipti ni o ti ʒini nimaani n-niŋ daba ayi, dama kum maa daa miiya pam bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: When a famine struck the land, Abram went down toward Egypt to live as an immigrant since the famine was so severe in the land.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ ya leei dari mali buɣim, ka yi ʒim ti kpe tiŋgban ni, ka so ku lan teei yi yɛla. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You will be like fuel for the fire. Your blood will flow deep into the earth—people will never remember you again. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Dabo shɛŋa zaa zuɣu bɛ ni daa kɔri bindira, gɔhi mini suligunyinyaɣu ni ti zooi lim nimaani ka so ku tooi kpe di ni, amaa nimaani ni ti leela niɣi mini piɛri gɔrim shee.
en: The hills where you once planted crops will be overgrown with thorns and thistles. You will be afraid to go there, and your cattle, sheep, and goats will be turned loose on those hills.

dag: N daa lari niŋdi ba saha shɛli bɛ daa yi ti lan ka yɛda, ka n suhupiɛlli lihigu kpaŋsiri bɛ suhuri.
en: I smiled on them when they had lost confidence; my cheerful face encouraged them.

dag: Ka n daa tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa kaman o ni daa zali ma shɛm maa, ka vuhim daa kana ti kpe bɛ ni, ka bɛ leei nyɛviyanima n-yiɣisi zani bɛ naba zuɣu. Bɛ daa galisiya pam.
en: As soon as I said this, the wind blew among the bodies, and they came back to life! They all stood up, and there were enough to make a large army.

dag: O nyaya ka nimaani vuhim shee viɛla, ka di tiŋgbani biɛhigu mali kɔre. Dinzuɣu ka o deei talahi n-tumdi tuma kaman dabili la.
en: You found them so pleasant that you worked too hard and became a slave.

dag: Hɛbɛr ŋun nyɛ Kɛn nir la paɣa Jaɛl mal alibarika pam paɣiba ni. Paɣ shɛb bɛn be tanti suɣa puuni, ŋuna m-mal alibarika.
en: But honor Jael, the wife of Heber from the Kenite clan. Give more honor to her than to any other woman who lives in tents. Yes, give more honor to her than to any other woman.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Pihahirɔt n-chaŋ ti tim teeku sunsuuni gari kpe tiŋgban nɛl la ni n-daa chaŋ daba ata chandi Itam tiŋgban nɛli ni n-chaŋ ti dɔni Mara.
en: They marched from Pi-hahiroth and they crossed through the sea toward the desert. Then they traveled three days in the Etham desert and they camped at Marah.

dag: dama Manaasa bipuɣinsi daa deei tiŋgbana pah o bidibisi zuɣu. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Giliad ti Manaasa zuliya niriba bɛn kpalim la.
en: This was because the daughters of Manasseh received a legacy along with his sons. The land of Gilead belonged to the rest of the people of Manasseh.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka n daa sabi gbaŋ la tin ya ni m buɣisi ya nya yi deeri noli binshɛɣukam ni.
en: This is another reason why I wrote you. I wanted to test you and see if you are obedient in everything.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa zaŋ biŋkɔbiri gbana n-she n-ti Adam min o paɣ maa ka bɛ so.
en: The LORD God made the man and his wife leather clothes and dressed them.

dag: Hal o ni daa kul yur o paɣ Hanna maa zaa yoli, o daa kul ŋmaarila ninvuɣ yino kɔŋko tarili tir o, dama Yawɛ daa na bi ti o bia.
en: Elkanah always gave an equal share of the food to Hannah. He did this because he loved her very much, even though the Lord had not let Hannah have any children.

dag: Ka Ribɛka tizɔdoo maa min o ma daa yɛli, Chɛ ka paɣisarili maa na kpalim be ti sani daba ayi kaman biɛɣu pia pahi ka naanyi chaŋ.
en: Let Rebekah stay with us for a week or ten days, they answered. Then she may go.

dag: Ka nachimbihi maa ni yino garigi yɛli, Nyama, n daa nya Jɛsi ŋun nyɛ Bɛtilihɛm nir la dapala, ka o mi mɔɣilo ŋmɛbu pam, ka nyɛ do so ŋun mali suhukpeeni, ka ni tooi tuhi tɔbu; o tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa viɛnyɛliŋga, ka lan nyɛ ŋun viɛla, ka Yawɛ be o sani.
en: A man named Jesse who lives in Bethlehem has a son who can play the harp, one official said. He's a brave warrior, he's good-looking, he can speak well, and the Lord is with him.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa chɛ ka Yaakubu kuli Mɛsopoteemia Leeban ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtuɛl Aram nir bia, ka nyɛ Yaakubu mini Iso ma Ribɛka tizɔdoo la sani.
en: So Isaac sent Jacob off, and he traveled to Paddan-aram, to Laban son of Bethuel the Aramean and brother of Rebekah, Jacob and Esaus mother.

dag: O ni daa ti paai ti Asɔs ka ti zaŋ o niŋ ŋariŋ maa ni chaŋ Mitilin.
en: When he met us in Assos, he came aboard, and we sailed on to Mitylene.

dag: Di saha maa ka Naa Sulemaana daa tim Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya ka o chaŋ ti ŋme o luhi ka o kpi.
en: Benaiah, Solomon shouted, go kill Adonijah. So Adonijah died.

dag: Di saha ka o daa ŋmaligi yɛl o bidib tuuli Jɛta, Yiɣisim ku ba. Amaa ka bia maa daa bi saɣi ŋ-ŋoog o takɔbi. O daa zɔrila dabiɛm, o ni daa na nyɛ bipolli la zuɣu.
en: So he ordered his oldest son Jether, Stand up and kill them. But the young man didnt draw his sword because he was afraid, since he was still young.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ baŋ ni o bi yɛri ba mi ni bɛ miri bɔrɔbɔro dabindi, amaa ni Farisiinim mini Sadusiinim wuhibu yɛla ka o yɛri maa.
en: Then the disciples understood that he was not warning them to guard themselves from the yeast used in bread but from the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

dag: Izraɛl ni daa ti miri kum, o daa bolila o bia Yisifu ti yɛl o, A yi ni niŋ n ni bɔri shɛm ŋɔ, nyin zaŋm a nuu tim n gbalipini lɔŋni ka lo alikauli ni a ni tum ma ʒiɛyimtali tuma ni yɛlimaŋli. Di sɔɣi ma Ijipti ŋɔ.
en: When the time drew near for him to die, he called for his son Joseph and said to him, Place your hand between my thighs and make a solemn vow that you will not bury me in Egypt.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti yɛn darigiri bɛ tibili saha shɛli maa ti yɛn nyɛla o niriba ni yɛn ŋmɛri guŋgɔna mini mɔɣilɔnim saha shɛli. Naawuni maŋmaŋ ni tuhi Asirianim maa.
en: He will attack them in battle, and each time he strikes them, it will be to the music of tambourines and harps.

dag: Izraɛlnima, maliya tahima Yawɛ sani! Dama yurilim maŋli be Yawɛ sani, ka o mali yiko pam din ni tiligi niriba.
en: Israel, trust in the Lord , because his love is constant and he is always willing to save.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ zaɣa zaa niŋ o ni, dama o daa pun chɛ ka o bukpahitali maa tabibi tuma niŋ ba alahiziba pam ka di wɔɣa.
en: Simon amazed the people with his magic for so long that the people became his followers.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, Yawɛ ni pii so n-leei naa ka o su Izraɛlnima; ka lala naa maa kpihim Jɛrɔbɔam daŋ niriba birili zuŋɔ.
en: The Lord will soon choose a new king of Israel, who will destroy Jeroboam's family. And I mean very soon.

dag: Sapashin kpamba maa ni lan yɛli tɔbbihi maa yaha, Dabiɛm yi gbaai so bee so suhu yi fuŋ, dilana ŋun labimi kul o yiŋa, di yi pa lala o ni chɛ ka o tab suhuri fuŋ kaman o suhu ni fuŋ shɛm maa.
en: The officials will continue to address the troops, stating: Is there anyone here who is afraid and discouraged? He can leave and go back to his house; otherwise, his comrades might lose courage just as he has.

dag: O ni daa yɛl lala naai ka o kuhi pam yɛli, Lazarɔs, yimina.
en: Having said this, Jesus shouted with a loud voice, Lazarus, come out.

dag: Dinzuɣu kahigimiya yi daalahichi maa n-wuhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ, ka tum din ni tiɣ o nini. Woligimiya yimaŋ ka chɛ tinzunnim bɛn be ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni la, ka lan woligi yimaŋ ka chɛ tinzun paɣiba.
en: Now then, confess your sins to the Lord , the God of your ancestors, and do what pleases him. Separate yourselves from the foreigners living in our land and get rid of your foreign wives.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah ata daa kpaag o laa ni dini bahi mɔɣa mini kɔbilisirima ni, ka di leei ʒim.
en: The third angel emptied his bowl into the rivers and streams. At once they turned to blood.

dag: Saimɔn ni daa nya ka tuumba maa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa bɛ zuɣu ka bɛ deei Naawuni Shia Kasi maa zuɣu ka o daa bɔ liɣiri ni o ti ba.
en: Simon saw that the Spirit had been given to the believers when the apostles placed their hands on them. So he offered money to Peter and John.

dag: To, fukumsi zaligu ni, Anabi Musa yɛliya ni ŋun niŋ lala, ti n-labim o kuɣa. Ka wula ka a mi lee yɛli.
en: In our Law Moses commanded that such a woman must be stoned to death. Now, what do you say.

dag: Di yi daa nyɛla n zaɣisila n daba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba bee paɣiba fabila wumbu.
en: When any of my servants complained against me, I would listen and treat them fairly.

dag: Di saha maa ka o daa kana ti paɣiri Naawuni ka tɔɣisiri bia maa yɛla bɛnkam zaa daa yuuni Jɛrusalɛmnim tiliginsim nyabu sol la sani.
en: Anna was there when Joseph and Mary came to the Temple. She praised God and talked about Jesus to all those who were waiting for God to free Jerusalem.

dag: Bɛ zaŋla zaɣ biɛɣu yo ma zaɣ viɛlli samli, ka zaŋ jɛlinsi yo ma yurilim samli.
en: They repay me evil for good, hatred in return for my love.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Yi ni tooi chɛ ka aŋgo zɔnim lo noli aŋgo ni be bɛ sani saha shɛli?.
en: Jesus answered, Do you think you can make the guests at a wedding party go without food as long as the bridegroom is with them? Of course not!.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa saɣim alikauli maa Adam tiŋgban ni, nimaani ka bɛ daa bi lan ʒe ma yim.
en: But the people broke the agreement as Adam did. They were unfaithful to me in their country.

dag: Ka Yisa gba daa ti yɛli do so, Doli ma! Ka dilan yɛli, N Duuma, chɛ ka n kuli ka m ba ti di saɣim saɣ o tariga ka n sɔɣ o pɔi ka naanyi kana ti dol a.
en: Jesus said to another man, Follow me! But the man said, Lord, let me go and bury my father first.

dag: Yuma ayi nyaaŋa ka Firawuna daa ti zahim zahindi n-nya ka o ʒiɛla Nail Mɔɣili duli.
en: Two years later Pharaoh dreamed that he was standing by the Nile River.

dag: Yuuni kam Ɛlikana daa yi yirila o ya n-chani Shilo ti jɛmdi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, ka maani sara nimaani. Ɛli bihi ayi bɛn yuya daa booni Hofini ni Finɛhas la n-daa nyɛ Yawɛ maligumaaniba nimaani.
en: Every year Elkanah went from Ramah to worship and offer sacrifices to the Lord Almighty at Shiloh, where Hophni and Phinehas, the two sons of Eli, were priests of the Lord .

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Dindali maa n ni ti zaŋ nyin Shialtiɛl bia Zɛrubabɛl ŋun nyɛ n dabili ŋɔ n-zali zaashe tital ni ka a be kaman n nintu shɛli din dihiri gbana la, dama mani m-piig a. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: On that day, says the LORD of heavenly forces: I will take you, Zerubbabel, Shealtiels son, my servant, says the LORD; I will make you like a signet ring because I have chosen you, says the LORD of heavenly forces.

dag: O ni daa pii ninvuɣ pinaayi shɛb maa yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Saimɔn, Yisa ni daa pa so yupaa Pita la.
en: Simon was one of the twelve, and Jesus named him Peter.

dag: Yawɛ ni tiligi ma, ka ti zaŋ goonjɛnim ŋme m-paɣ o. Ti kul ni paɣir o o jɛmbu duu hal ni ti nyɛviya tariga.
en: Lord , you have healed me. We will play harps and sing your praise, Sing praise in your Temple as long as we live.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Dindina n gba ku yɛli ya ŋun ti ma yiko shɛli n ni mali niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa maa.
en: And Jesus said to them, Neither will I tell you, then, by what right I do these things.

dag: Noli ni di ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa zaŋ bɛmaŋ dalim Naawuni fukumsi zaligu dolibu, dama di sabiya: Noli ni di ŋunkam bi deei binshɛɣukam zaa din sabi Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni n-dol li.
en: All those who rely on the works of the Law are under a curse, because it is written, Everyone is cursed who does not keep on doing all the things that have been written in the Law scroll .

dag: Yirigimiya yimaŋ zuɣu, ka suhimiya Naawuni ni yi di ti lu zahimbu puuni; yi suhuri din bɔra, amaa ka yi niŋgbuna lee ka yaa.
en: Stay awake and pray for strength against temptation. Your spirit wants to do what is right, but your body is weak.

dag: M pun yɛli ya dimbɔŋɔ yɛla siɣimsiɣim paai shɛm, ka pumpɔŋɔ n ni lan labi yɛli ya di yɛla ni nintam. Niriba pam beni ka bɛ biɛhigu zaŋ ba leela Masia dapulli zuɣu kum la dimnima.
en: I have told you this many times before, and now I repeat it with tears: there are many whose lives make them enemies of Christ's death on the cross.

dag: ka daa boli nachimbil so ŋun daa tumd o tuma na ti yɛl o, Zaŋm paɣ ŋɔ yihi ka kpari dunoli.
en: he called in his personal servant and said, Get this woman out of my sight! Throw her out and lock the door.

dag: Nuzaa polo mini nudirigu polo pɔhim, yiɣisimiyana! Ʒiɛmiya kpe m puu maa ni, ka di tulaale nyom gili luɣ shɛlikam zaa. Chɛ ka n yura ka o puu maa ni na nti di di tiwal suma.
en: Let the north wind blow, the south wind too! Let them spread the aroma of my garden, so the one I love may enter and taste its delicious fruits.

dag: Buni palila wuntizɔriba yinsi, amaa ashaara kul lurila ninvuɣ biɛri nyamma zuɣu.
en: Great treasure is in the house of the righteous, but the gain of the wicked brings trouble.

dag: Hɛzɛkia ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o tuun suma, bɛ sab li niŋla Amɔz bia anabi Aizaia ni daa nya ʒii shɛli ka di be Juda mini Izraɛl nanim litaafi puuni la.
en: Everything else Hezekiah did as king and the ways he served God faithfully are written in the book, The Vision of the Prophet Isaiah Son of Amoz and in the book, The History of the Kings of Judah and Israel .

dag: Di saha ka Aizaia daa yɛli Hɛzɛkia, Wummi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm:.
en: Then I told Hezekiah: I have a message for you from the Lord All-Powerful.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka niriba maa lab kuli bɛ ya gol so ŋun daa pahir ayopɔin maa biɛɣu pisinaata dali, ka di niŋ ba nyaɣisim ka bɛ mali suhupiɛlli, Yawɛ ni daa wuh o nirilim ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Dauda mini Sulemaana ni o niriba Izraɛlnim zaa san la zuɣu.
en: On the twenty-third day of the seventh month, Solomon dismissed the people to their tents, happy and content because of the goodness the LORD had shown to David, to Solomon, and to his people Israel.

dag: Di saha ka Gidiɔn daa yɛli Yawɛ. A yɛliya ni a ni zaŋ ma tuhi fa Izraɛlnim bahi.
en: Then Gideon said to God, You said that you would help me save the Israelites. Give me proof.

dag: Malimi shili kaman doo la, ka m bɔh a ka a yɛli ma.
en: Brace yourself and get ready to answer the questions I will ask you.

dag: Ŋuni ka n lee yɛn zaŋ saɣisigu yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ tɔɣisi ka o chɛ ka bɛ wum? Nyama, bɛ tiba ŋarimi, bɛ ku tooi wum. Yawɛ yɛligu nyɛla ansarisi bini bɛ sani. Bɛ baɣa ka di ni.
en: I have told the people that you, Lord , will punish them, but they just laugh and refuse to listen.

dag: O tim o yiŋ bipuɣinsi ni bɛ chaŋ tiŋ puuni luɣ shɛŋa din du pam shee ti boli niriba.
en: She has sent her servant women to call out from the highest place in town:.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun mali Naawuni Shia Kasi vihiri binshɛɣukam zaa baŋdi di gbinni, amaa ka so ku tooi vihi baŋ ŋun yɛla gbinni.
en: Whoever has the Spirit, however, is able to judge the value of everything, but no one is able to judge him.

dag: nti zaŋ ya chaŋ niriba maa tiŋgban nɛli ni, ka m mini ya gbɛri ti kpa taba, ka n kari ya saria.
en: I will bring you into the Desert of the Nations, and there I will condemn you to your face.

dag: Ka Amnɔn daa zaŋ di yɛla muɣis omaŋ hal ti gbaai dɔro o tizɔpaɣ Tama maa zuɣu. Dama Tama daa na ʒi doo, ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka Amnɔn kɔŋ o ni yɛn niŋ o shɛm.
en: Amnon was so upset over his half sister that he made himself sick. She was a virgin, and it seemed impossible in Amnons view to do anything to her.

dag: N yaa kuumi kaman salichee la, ka n zilinli chaŋ ti tabili n yɛno; a zaŋ ma sɔŋ la kum taŋkpaɣu ni.
en: My throat is as dry as dust, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You have left me for dead in the dust.

dag: Ka Naa Ɛgilɔn daa laɣim Ammɔnnim mini Amalɛknima m-pah o min o niriba zuɣu chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ Izraɛlnima, ka fa dɔbino tihi tiŋ la bɛ sani.
en: Eglon joined the Ammonites and the Amalekites; they defeated Israel and captured Jericho, the city of palm trees.

dag: n-lan yi nimaani zaŋ kpa nuzaa polo ti du Bɛtaraba Zoli m-mali lala hal ti siɣi Araba.
en: It passed on to the slope of Beth-arabah on the north and went down into the desert plain.

dag: M bi zaɣisi ka bɛ di sabi n yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ sɔŋ! M bi zaɣisi ka bɛ di sab li niŋ kundi ni!.
en: How I wish that someone would remember my words and record them in a book!.

dag: N yi darigi yi tibili ŋ-ŋɔ ka yi bi labi n sanna ka na kul kpɛrila yɔɣu.
en: If, despite these things, you still do not accept my discipline and continue to oppose me.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri yiɣisi bah a zuɣu ni di vi; ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tuhir a mi ni kpalim yoli ka kpi.
en: Everyone who hates you will be terribly disgraced; those who attack will vanish into thin air.

dag: Ka Jɔab niriba maa ni yino daa chaŋ ti zani Amasa sani ka yɛli, Ŋunkam bɔr Jɔab ka nyɛ ŋun be Naa Dauda polo, ŋun doli Jɔab.
en: One of Joabs men stood by Amasa and said, Whoever favors Joab, and whoever is for David, follow Joab.

dag: N yi nya din daa niŋ tiŋ ŋɔ ni paɣisara la, di biɛri ma mi.
en: My eyes make me sad, when I see what happened to the young women in my city.

dag: ka ba bɛ nanim bandi, ka zaŋ zoligɔnim lo bɛ nabihi.
en: Put chains of iron on their kings and rulers.

dag: Ka Daniɛl daa dii chaŋ naa sani nti suh o ni o tim o saha pahi ka o wuh o zahindi maa gbinni.
en: When Daniel heard the story, he went to King Nebuchadnezzar. Daniel asked the king to give him some more time. Then he would tell the king what the dream meant.

dag: A tɛhiya ni nol ni yɛtɔɣa kɔŋko nyɛla tɔbutuhiri baŋsim mini kpiɔŋ din ni tooi tuhi tɔbu? Bee ŋuni ka a lee du m-ba ka zaɣisi n noli maa?.
en: He demanded, Do you think that words can take the place of military skill and might? Who do you think will help you rebel against Assyria?.

dag: So ni yɛli, Binshɛɣukam zaa luhiya n sani. Yɛlimaŋli, amaa pa binshɛɣukam zaa m-mali nir buchi. Binshɛɣukam shiri luhiya, amaa pa binshɛɣukam zaa n-kpaŋsiri nir suhu.
en: Everything is permitted, but everything isnt beneficial. Everything is permitted, but everything doesnt build others up.

dag: Yisa daa wuhi shihira pam o nyaandoliba maa ninni, ka din yɛla bi sabi niŋ litaafi ŋɔ ni.
en: In his disciples' presence Jesus performed many other miracles which are not written down in this book.

dag: Asa mini Izraɛl Naa Baasha daa kul tuhirila tab tɔbu hal ni bɛ nyɛviya tariga.
en: King Asa of Judah and King Baasha of Israel were constantly at war with each other as long as they were in power.

dag: Yɛligim a suɣili. Di niŋ zinchili. Kpam a kpahi ka di kpɛma, ka voog a mihi ka di kpaŋ.
en: Make your tent bigger. Open your doors wide. Dont think small! Make your tent large and strong.

dag: Ka yɛli, Laɣimmiya n niriba bɛn ʒe ma yim la ti ma na, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lo ma sara maligu alikauli la.
en: He says, Gather my faithful people to me, those who made a covenant with me by offering a sacrifice.

dag: Jɛhɔash ni daa tum shɛlikam pahi min o kpiɔŋ tuun shɛŋa zaa o ni daa zaŋ tuhi Juda Naa Amazia la, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: Everything else Jehoash did while he was king, including his war against King Amaziah of Judah, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Amaa ka naa yɛligu maa daa ŋme n-kpihim Jɔab min o sapashin kpamba dini. Di saha ka Jɔab mini sapashin kpamba maa daa yiɣisi naa sani yi n-chaŋ ni bɛ ti kali Izraɛlnim maa.
en: But the kings word overruled Joab and the military commanders. So Joab and the commanders left the kings presence to take a census of the Israelites.

dag: Ka ti Duuma malaika daa ti puhi yi bɛ zuɣu, ka ti Duuma jilima neesim neei gil ba ka dabiɛm kpe ba pam.
en: The Lords angel stood before them, the Lords glory shone around them, and they were terrified.

dag: Amaa man yɛri ya mi, di kul pɔnya gba. Di pɔ alizanda, dama di nyɛla Naawuni nam ʒiishee.
en: But I tell you, when you make a promise, dont try to make it stronger with a vow. Dont make a vow using the name of heaven, because heaven is Gods throne.

dag: Mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri daa yi gbaag a piɛɣu, m bi zaŋd o na ti wuhir a, amaa n daa yi gbaarila mmaŋmaŋ piɛɣu zal o zaani. Bɛ daa yi zu binshɛli wuntaŋ ni bee yuŋ, a chɛrimi ka n yo a li.
en: If a wild animal killed one of your sheep or goats, I paid for it myself. In fact, you demanded the full price, whether the animal was killed during the day or at night.

dag: O chɛ ka sakuɣa luri nahiri tiŋgbani m-be kaman gbaŋ ka bɛ yɛrigi sɔŋ la. O chɛ ka gulisigu be kaman taŋkpaɣu la n-gili luɣilikam.
en: God spreads snow like it was wool; God scatters frost like it was ashes.

dag: Amaa kaman paɣ so ŋun bi ʒe o yidan yim ni zo ka chɛ o shɛm, lala ka yinim lzraɛlnim gba bi ʒe ma yim. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But like an unfaithful wife, you have not been faithful to me. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Yawɛ yɛm puuni ka o daa nam tiŋgbani ŋɔ. O yɛla baŋbu puuni ka o daa nam zuɣusaa.
en: With wisdom and understanding, the Lord created the earth and sky.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa lab o nachimba maa sani ka o mini ba ti lab kuli Bɛrishiiba, ka Ibrahimma ti kpalim be nimaani.
en: Then Abraham went back to his servants. They all traveled back to Beersheba, and Abraham stayed there.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli paɣ maa, Lab kuli, ka n lihi a yɛlli maa zuɣu.
en: Then the king said to the woman, Go home. I will take care of things for you.

dag: Nahimmiya Midiannima, ka ku ba.
en: The Midianites are your enemies. You must kill them.

dag: Ʒiɛmana kanimina ka vuura, amaa dunia ŋɔ din kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Generations come and generations go, but the world stays just the same.

dag: Bɛ ni lu Filistianim bɛn be wulinluhili polo la zuɣu. Bɛ ni ti laɣim di ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be wulimpuhili polo nim nɛma. Bɛ ni ti nyaŋ Ɛdomnim mini Mɔabnima, ka Ammɔnnim ti jɛmdi ba.
en: Together they will attack the Philistines on the west and plunder the people who live to the east. They will conquer the people of Edom and Moab, and the people of Ammon will obey them.

dag: Pa a Naawuni zɔbo zuɣu n-chɛ ka a niŋ o naani? Pa a nimmaŋtali zuɣu n-chɛ ka a mali tahima?.
en: You worship God. You trust him. You are a good man, so let that be your hope.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Bɛ ni ti nyɛla n ni su shɛba n ni ti yɛn bɔhi biɛri dabisi shɛli dali maa, ka nyɛ n ninvuɣ gahinda, ka n ni ti tiligi ba kaman bihilaamba ni tiligiri bɛ bihi bɛn jɛmdi ba shɛm la.
en: They will be my people, says the Lord Almighty. On the day when I act, they will be my very own. I will be merciful to them as parents are merciful to the children who serve them.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Ɛbɛdimɛlɛk daa zaŋ niriba maa pah omaŋ zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ nayili nɛma duu nti zaŋ situr chɛra n-zaŋ gabisi lo li n-zaŋ li ti Jɛrimia kɔbiliga maa ni ha.
en: So Ebedmelech went with the men to the palace storeroom and got some worn-out clothing which he let down to me by ropes.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa yɛli Filip, Guumi paai chɛchɛbuŋ ŋɔ lana.
en: The Spirit said to Philip, Go to that chariot and stay near it.

dag: Tiŋ maa ni paɣ tuumbiɛrilan so ni daa wum ni Yisa be Farisii maa yiŋa n-diri bindirigu maa ka o zaŋ luɣilu viɛlli din pali tulaale.
en: When a sinful woman in that town found out that Jesus was there, she bought an expensive bottle of perfume.

dag: Ka Balaam daa yɛli Balak, To, n kana! Ka m malila yiko din ni tooi yɛli shɛli? Naawuni ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛli niŋ n nol ni, dina ka n yɛn tɔɣisi.
en: I'm here now, Balaam answered. But I will say only what God tells me to say.

dag: A mini Dɛdannim daa niŋdila wɔrinyaampara daabiligu.
en: The people of Dedan traded saddle blankets for your goods.

dag: Ka namɔɣili maa daa bɔhi Filip, Ŋun yɛla ka Anabi maa lee yɛri maa, omaŋmaŋ yɛla bee so yɛla.
en: The official asked Philip, Tell me, of whom is the prophet saying this? Of himself or of someone else.

dag: Ka Yisa daa saɣisi ba yɛli ni bɛ di chɛ ka so wum li; ka yɛli bipuɣiŋga maa ba min o ma ni bɛ tim bia maa bindirigu ka o di.
en: Jesus gave the father and mother very strict orders not to tell people about this. Then he told them to give the girl some food to eat.

dag: Di saha ka wain booriba kpɛm la daa yɛli Firawuna, N teegi n galimi ni nyɛ shɛli zuŋɔ.
en: Then the wine steward said to the king, I must confess today that I have done wrong.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ ŋun yɛli Sairus; A nyɛla m piɛgula, ka ni niŋ n ni yɛl a ni a niŋ shɛli. A ni yɛli ka bɛ lan me Jɛrusalɛm zali; ka chɛ ka bɛ sɔŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu tampuɣili. .
en: I am also the one who says, Cyrus will lead my people and obey my orders. Jerusalem and the temple will be rebuilt.

dag: Di saha ka Rabishake daa yiɣisi zani n-kuhi pam yɛli Judanim yɛligu ni, Wummiya na titali ŋun nyɛ Asiria naa la ni yɛli shɛm! O ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Then the official stood up and shouted in Hebrew, Listen to what the emperor of Assyria is telling you!.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa yiɣisi ni doli Galili tiŋgbɔŋ polo. Ka o bi bɔri ni so baŋ ni o be nimaani.
en: Jesus left with his disciples and started through Galilee. He did not want anyone to know about it.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ zuɣulaannima, yi zaani zaligu shɛŋa din tuhi? Yi kariti niriba saria ka di doli soli?.
en: Do you really speak what is right, you gods? Do you really judge humans fairly?.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Pumpɔŋɔ n ni yiɣisi wuhi ni m mali yiko; bɛ ni tibigi ma pumpɔŋɔ.
en: The Lord says, Now, I will stand and show people how great and powerful I am.

dag: Yi nyɛla ti shɛhiranima, ka Naawuni gba di ti shɛhira m-pahi yi zuɣu ni zaŋ chaŋ yinim bɛn nyɛ yɛdaniŋdiba ŋɔ polo, ti biɛhigu wuhiya ni ti dolila wuntia soli ka tumdi din tuhi ka ka galimi.
en: Both you and God are witnesses that we were pure and honest and innocent in our dealings with you followers of the Lord.

dag: Shɛlomɔt ŋɔ min o mabihi n-daa nyɛ bɛn su Naa Dauda min o dɔɣirikpamba ni sapashinnim bɛn daa su tɔbbihi tuhilituhili ni bɛn su kɔbigakɔbiga fukumsi ni sapashin kpamba ni daa yi zaŋdi pin shɛŋa zaa na ti maani sara la fukumsi.
en: Shelomith and his relatives were responsible for everything that David had collected for the Temple. The officers of the army also gave things for the Temple.

dag: N yɛn zaŋla ziŋgoo kuhi a yɛno, ka chɛ ka a kɔsoya ni zahim kpe n-shɛbis a salichɛhi ni, ka n voog a yih a kɔsoya maa ni na n-tabil a kɔsoya maa ni zahim shɛb zaa bɛn be a salichɛhi maa ni zaa du duli.
en: I will put a hook in your jaw and pull you out of the water, and all the fish in your river will stick to your scaly body.

dag: n ni mali suhupiɛlli Yawɛ sani. N ni mali suhupiɛlli Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n tiligira ŋɔ sani.
en: but I will still celebrate because the Lord God is my Savior.

dag: Ka Batishiiba daa gbani n-lu naa sizuura, ka naa bɔh o, Bɔ ka a bɔra.
en: Bathsheba bowed down on her face before the king. The king asked, What do you want.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, N yɛri ya la dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ni yi di ti birigi.
en: I have told you all this so that you wont lose your faith when you face troubles.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa shiri ti Naa Sulemaana yɛm kaman o ni daa lo o alikauli shɛm, ka suhudoo daa be o mini Hiram sunsuuni; ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa niŋ naŋgban yini.
en: Now the LORD made Solomon wise, just as he had promised. Solomon and Hiram made a covenant and had peace.

dag: A kpahiri karimbaannim bɛn mali taali ka bi dol a zaligunim la zuɣu ni.
en: You reprimand the proud; cursed are those who disobey your commands.

dag: Jɔahaz daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani kaman o yaannim ni daa tum shɛm la.
en: He did what was evil in the LORDs eyes, just as all his ancestors had done.

dag: Zɛbadia mini Arad ni Ɛda.
en: Beriahs family: Zebadiah, Arad, Eder.

dag: N nyɛla Yɛhudia nira. Bɛ dɔɣi ma la Taasus, Kilikia tiŋgbɔŋ ni, amaa n zoola Gamaliɛl sani ya ŋɔ; ka bɔhim n yaannim zaligunim mini bɛ kaya yɛla o sani, ka n suhu ye Naawuni zuɣu kaman yi zaa ni niŋdi shɛm pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: I am a Jew, born in Tarsus in the country of Cilicia. I grew up in this city. I was a student of Gamaliel, who carefully taught me everything about the law of our fathers. I was very serious about serving God, the same as all of you here today.

dag: Ka Yisa daa piligi yɛri ba, Yɛla ŋɔ yipa niŋ pali yi sani zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: he began to speak to them. He said, While you heard me reading these words just now, they were coming true.

dag: Dali gba bɛ daa ni bɔ a pam kɔŋ, dinzuɣu cham yɛla ŋɔ ni daa yiɣisina ka a sɔɣi luɣ shɛl la nti ŋuni kuɣa din duhiya la lɔŋni.
en: On the third day go to the same place you hid when this trouble began. Wait by that hill.

dag: Di saha ka naa maa tahi yɛli, Di bemi kaman n ni pun tɛhi shɛm! Yi bɔrila saha, dama yi baŋya ni n lo n suhu ni.
en: The king replied, You're just stalling for time.

dag: Ka baŋdiba bɛn be bɛ ni la ni ti nyɛlisira, ka ne kaman sagban piɛla la. Ka bɛn mi nyɛ bɛn daa wuhi niriba pam din tuhi la ti ne kaman saŋmarisi la hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: The wise leaders will shine with all the brightness of the sky. And those who have taught many people to do what is right will shine like the stars forever.

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli she pateesa, ka chɛ ka tuumbaŋda wuɣi chɛrubinim pa di zuɣu.
en: They made the inside curtain of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool, and embroidered with figures of winged creatures.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ lan yɛli, Saha kanna ka niriba ni ti yi tinsi pam ni kana.
en: I tell you that people will come here from cities everywhere.

dag: Di saha ka n yɛli, Din niŋ ma suhugarigu nyɛla, Zallakudura Naa nudirigu yiko la taɣimi.
en: Then I said to myself, What bothers me most is the thought that God Most High has lost his power.

dag: dama bɛ tiligira nyɛla ŋun mali yaa. O ni zab bɛ zuɣu.
en: God All-Powerful is there to defend them against you.

dag: Dinzuɣu di zaŋya yi naani niŋbu bahi, dama di mali laara pam.
en: So dont throw away your confidence—it brings a great reward.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa chaŋ o sani, ka paɣ maa ti bɔh o, Nyini n-nyɛ Jɔab maa? Ka Jɔab saɣi, Iin mani. Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, Wummi mani ŋun nyɛ a dabipaɣ ŋɔ ni yɛn yɛl a shɛm ŋɔ. Ka Jɔab yɛl o, N wumda.
en: So Joab approached her, and the woman said, Are you Joab? I am, he answered. Pay close attention to the words of your female servant, she said. Im listening, Joab replied.

dag: A ni tooi lo o mihi n-chɛ ka o ko a? Bee o ni tooi yɛbisi a kɔbu ti a ka a biri?.
en: Will he let you put ropes on him to plow your fields?.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Sulemaana daa tim ka bɛ chaŋ ti siɣis o bimbini maa zuɣu na. Ka o daa kana nti damdi lu Naa Sulemaana sizuura. Ka Sulemaana daa yɛl o, Kulim a yiŋa.
en: King Solomon then sent for Adonijah and had him brought down from the altar. Adonijah went to the king and bowed low before him, and the king said to him, You may go home.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim yi be yi ni galisi pam, di ni chɛ ka yi nyɛla bɛn tumdi viɛnyɛliŋga, ka nyɛ bɛn mali buchi baŋbu shɛli din yiri ti Duuma Yisa Masia ni na la puuni.
en: If you keep growing in this way, it will show that what you know about our Lord Jesus Christ has made your lives useful and meaningful.

dag: ka kaari ba asiba kam, ka zahindi ba saha shɛlikam?.
en: Why do you test us from sunrise to sunset?.

dag: Toondaannim ni daa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa a zuɣu ka Naawuni ti a pin shɛli anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu puuni la, miri ka a zaŋ li niŋ a baɣaka.
en: Do not neglect the spiritual gift that is in you, which was given to you when the prophets spoke and the elders laid their hands on you.

dag: dama n zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa a ni daa tɔɣisi ma la tɔɣisi ba, ka bɛ dee li ka baŋ ni n shiri yila a sanna, ka niŋ yɛda ni nyini n-shiri tim ma na.
en: This is because I gave them the words that you gave me, and they received them. They truly understood that I came from you, and they believed that you sent me.

dag: Mbusim be yinim Farisiinim zuɣu! Dama yi yuri kpamba ʒiishee ʒinibu yi jɛmbu duri ni, ka lan yuri puhigu dahi ni.
en: How terrible for you Pharisees! You love the reserved seats in the synagogues and to be greeted with respect in the marketplaces.

dag: Dama n dimnim kul tɔɣisirila n yɛla, ka bɛn puɣisiri ni bɛ ku ma laɣindi gbaari saawara.
en: My enemies want to kill me; they talk and plot against me.

dag: Lihimi zuɣusaa ka a nya, nyam sagbana din be a zuɣusaa ŋɔ ha.
en: Look at the heavens and see; scan the clouds high over you.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Filistianim daa ti lo tɔbu ni bɛ tuhi Izraɛlnima. Ka Akishi daa yɛli Dauda, Baŋmi ni di simdi ka a min a niriba ŋɔ pahi n tɔbbihi ŋɔ zuɣu doli ma chaŋ.
en: At that time, the Philistines gathered their troops for war to fight against Israel. Achish said to David, Count on you and your soldiers marching out with me in the army.

dag: A chɛ ka kɔbil nina kom puhiri yiri vinvama ni na n-zɔri gariti daboya sunsuuni.
en: You make springs flow in the valleys, and rivers run between the hills.

dag: Amaa yi yi bi yuri ka kɔŋ zaligu shɛŋa zaa Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ ti Musa la dolibu.
en: As you try to obey all the commands that the Lord gave Moses, you might fail and make a mistake.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa yiɣisi Sinai mɔɣu ni n-doli tab gbilligbilli chana; ka sagbani maa daa chaŋ ti kpalim zani Paran mɔɣu ni.
en: So the Israelites broke camp and left the Sinai Desert. And some time later, the cloud stopped in the Paran Desert.

dag: Bɛ nyo li buɣim; bɛ ŋma li luhi. Lihim ba suhuyiɣisili lihigu ka bɛ kpi.
en: Our enemies have cut it down and burned it up. Show them how angry you are and destroy them.

dag: Yi zaa laɣim ʒiɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ tooni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Yi daŋ ni kpamba mini yi zuɣulaannim ni yi sapashin kpamba ni Izraɛl dɔbba zaa.
en: Right now, all of you are in the presence of the LORD your God—the leaders of your tribes, your elders, and your officials, all the Israelite males.

dag: Yi ni ti nya dimbɔŋɔ, ka di niŋ ya suhupiɛlli. Bɛ ni ti ʒi teeku ni azichi na ti tin ya, ka ʒi zuliya shɛb gba daazichi na ti tin ya.
en: At that time you will see your people, and your faces will shine with happiness. First, you will be afraid, but then you will be excited. All the riches from across the seas will be set before you. The riches of the nations will come to you.

dag: O mi o ni yɛn ŋmahi kuɣ viɛla shɛm kpɛhi binyara ni, ka lan mi dari zaŋ kpe m-mali binyɛra mini nuhi tuumbaŋsim kam.
en: for cutting jewels to be set; for carving wood; and for every other kind of artistic work.

dag: Bɛ daa me duu maa naala gol so bɛ ni daa booni Ada la daba ata dali, yuun shɛli din daa pahiri Naa Darius nam dibu yuma ayɔbu la ni.
en: This house was completed on the third day of the month of Adar, in the sixth year of the rule of King Darius.

dag: Vinnyaɣilana soli zuɣu kul zibigila gɔhi, amaa ŋun tumdi din tuhi soli nyɛla solɔɣu.
en: If you are lazy, you will meet difficulty everywhere, but if you are honest, you will have no trouble.

dag: Arivadnim mini Hɛlɛchinim daa nyɛla bɛn ʒi a goma zuɣu ti gili, ka Gamadinim mi daa ʒe a binchunchuna gbini. Bɛ daa zaŋdila bɛ lɔɣubuya yiini a dukpina zuɣu ti tuui. Bɛna n-daa chɛ ka a viɛl zaa.
en: Men from Arvad and Cilicia were guards standing on the wall around your city. Men from Gammad were in your towers. They hung their shields on the walls around your city and made your beauty complete.

dag: Amaa ka doo maa daa chaŋ ti mol o kpaŋbu maa yɛla gili luɣilikam, dina n-daa chɛ ka Yisa ku lan tooi yi palɔni kpe tiŋ kam ni yaha, amaa ka kul bela mɔɣu ni, ka niriba yiri luɣ shɛlikam chan o sani.
en: But the man went away and began to spread the news everywhere. Indeed, he talked so much that Jesus could not go into a town publicly. Instead, he stayed out in lonely places, and people came to him from everywhere.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa niŋ ŋun Keenan Naa Jabin maa muɣisigu hal ti ku o.
en: And the power of the Israelites grew greater and greater over Canaans King Jabin until they defeated him completely.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri kul puɣisirila wuntizɔriba m-bɔri ni bɛ ku ba.
en: The wicked, on the other hand, target the righteous, seeking to kill them.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga bol o yuli Samuɛl, dama Hanna daa yɛlimi, N suh o la Yawɛ sani.
en: So in the course of time, Hannah conceived and gave birth to a son. She named him Samuel, which means I asked the LORD for him.

dag: Dama bɛ nyɛla tipawumlinima ni bɛn ka yɛda ni bɛn bi deeri Yawɛ wuhibu.
en: These people are like children who refuse to obey. They lie and refuse to listen to the Lord s teachings.

dag: ka yɛli, Yawɛ, amaŋmaŋ daa yɛli ni a ni wurim kpe ŋɔ, ka ninsalinim bee biŋkɔbiri ku lan be di ni, ka kpe ti zani dabari sahakam. .
en: Then say, LORD, you declared that this place will be destroyed and nothing will remain in it—neither human nor animal; that it will forever be a wasteland.

dag: Yisa nyaandol shɛb bɛn daa wurim bɛ nahiŋgu din daa doli Stiivin kubu nyaaŋa la zuɣu daa chaŋ hal ni Fɔnisia mini Saipurus ni Antiɔk. Bɛ daa mali Naawuni yɛligu n-tɔɣisirila Yɛhudianim kɔŋko.
en: The believers were scattered by the persecution that began when Stephen was killed. Some of them went as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch. They told the Good News in these places, but only to Jews.

dag: Amaa a yi zaɣisi ni a ku chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ, n ni chɛ ka poloya yina yɛrigi a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni zaa.
en: If you refuse to let my people go, then I will fill Egypt with frogs.

dag: O daa wurim tinzun buɣa maligu bimbina la mini buɣa jɛmbu shee, ka ŋme n-kabisi di daantalisi, ka wurim Ashɛrim.
en: He removed the foreign altars and the pagan places of worship, broke down the sacred stone columns, and cut down the symbols of the goddess Asherah.

dag: Ka Matitia ŋun daa nyɛ Lɛvinim ni yino ka nyɛ Shallum ŋun daa nyɛ Kɔra daŋ nir la bituuli la daa su mahi parilana malibu fukumsi.
en: Mattithiah, Shallum's oldest son, was a member of the Levite clan of Korah, and he was in charge of baking the bread used for offerings.

dag: Amaa zaŋ chaŋ Juda naa ŋun tim ya na ni yi ti bɔhi baŋ din be Yawɛ sani ŋɔ polo, Yɛlimiy o: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya: Zaŋ chaŋ a ni wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa la polo.
en: Josiah, listen to what I am going to do. I noticed how sad you were when you heard that this country and its people would be completely wiped out. You even tore your clothes in sorrow, and I heard you cry.

dag: Yurilim diri suɣilo, ka niŋdi nirilim; yurilim bi zabiri nyuli, di bi nyuri bara, di mi bi duhiri dimaŋa.
en: Love is patient and kind. Love is not jealous, it does not brag, and it is not proud.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Babilɔn leei yuɣimpina biɛhigu shee ni ko dooshee, ka zaŋ sɔɣu din ni saɣim li n-kol li bahi. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will make it the home of herons, a swampland. I will sweep it away with the broom of destruction, says the LORD of heavenly forces.

dag: Ka Pool mini Silas daa yi sarika duu maa ni n-chaŋ Lidia yiŋa nti puh o; ka daa nya bɛ yɛdaniŋditab bɛn be nimaani n-kpaŋsi bɛ suhuri ka naanyi yi n-chaŋ.
en: Paul and Silas left the prison and made their way to Lydias house where they encouraged the brothers and sisters. Then they left Philippi.

dag: N ni daa nya ʒii shɛli maa daa ŋmanila n ni daa pun nya ʒii shɛli saha shɛl o ni daa kana ni o ti wurim tiŋ maa la, ka lan ŋmani n ni daa nya ʒii shɛli n ni daa be Kɛba Mɔɣili noli la. Ka n daa teei dɔni n-zaŋ n nini kpa tiŋa.
en: This vision was like the one I had seen when God came to destroy Jerusalem and like the one I had seen near the Chebar River. I immediately bowed with my face to the ground.

dag: O daa di nam be Hiburɔn n-su Judanim la yuma ayopɔin ni chira ayɔbu. Ka o daa lan ʒini Jɛrusalɛm n-su Izraɛlnim mini Judanim zaa yuun pihitanaata.
en: He ruled in Hebron over Judah for seven and a half years, and in Jerusalem over all Israel and Judah for thirty-three years.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli, O beni, ka lan yɛli, Nyamiya, ŋuna kul be yi tooni chani maa ha; kpaŋ chamiya, pumpɔŋɔ ka o na yoli paana, dama bɛ yɛn malila sara daboli zuɣu zuŋɔ.
en: Hes just ahead of you, they answered. Hurry up! He has just come to town because there is a sacrifice today for the people at the shrine.

dag: Amaa Izraɛlnim daa bi nyo tin shɛŋa din daa me n-tam zoya zuɣu la buɣim, gbaai yihila Hazɔr kɔŋko ka Jɔshua daa chɛ ka bɛ nyo m-bahi.
en: But Israel didnt burn any of the cities that still are standing on their mounds. Joshua burned only Hazor.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla naa, O zaŋla jilima ye. Yawɛ yɛla kparibu, ka zaŋ kpiɔŋ leei shɛlɔrigu lo o shee ni. Ŋuna n-nam dunia ŋɔ zali, ka di kul ku vuui.
en: The Lord is king. He is clothed with majesty and strength. The earth is set firmly in place and cannot be moved.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa, Nyama, a yi ti paai Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, nyin tummi alahiziba tuun shɛŋa zaa n ni niŋ a yiko ni a tum maa Firawuna tooni, amaa n ni ti chɛ ka o suhu kpaŋ pam, ka o ku chɛ ka niriba maa chaŋ.
en: While Moses was traveling back to Egypt, the Lord spoke to him, When you talk to Pharaoh remember to show him all the miracles that I have given you the power to do. But I will cause Pharaoh to be very stubborn. He will not let the people go.

dag: Yawɛ niriba bɛn tiligi ni ti yili yila kpe Jɛrusalɛm. Bɛ suhugarigu mini bɛ nandahima ni ti naai, ka bɛ leei bɛn mali suhupiɛlli sahakam.
en: The people the Lord has rescued will come back singing as they enter Zion. Happiness will be a crown everyone will always wear. They will celebrate and shout because all sorrows and worries will be gone far away.

dag: M bi sabiri dimbɔŋɔ ni n dihi ya la vi, amaa n sab li mi ni n saɣisi ya yi ni nyɛ m biyurisi la zuɣu.
en: Im not writing these things to make you ashamed but to warn you, since you are my loved children.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa chaŋ ti ŋmahi tihi balibu diba ata wula n-kɔrisikɔrisi di paɣiri ka chɛ ka di mali piɛlimpiɛlim, ka chɛ ka di piɛlimpiɛlim maa be palo ni ka di piɛlipiɛla.
en: Then Jacob cut green branches from poplar and almond trees. He stripped off some of the bark so that the branches had white stripes on them.

dag: Di chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa niŋ a naani di vi; amaa chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn taari duŋ niŋd a ka di ka daliri la n-di vi.
en: For that matter, dont let anyone who hopes in you be put to shame; instead, let those who are treacherous without excuse be put to shame.

dag: Ka m mali tahima ti Duuma sani ni di ku yuui ka mmaŋmaŋ gba tooi ka yi sanna.
en: And I feel sure the Lord will also let me come soon.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛli Ɛlizabɛt, So ka yi zuliya ni ka o yuli booni Jɔn.
en: They said to her, But you don't have any relative with that name.

dag: Ka di bi simdi ni a zaŋ pakoya bɛn nyɛ paɣisara la gba yuya pahi pakoya kalinli ni, dama bɛ kɔre yi ti kpe dɔbba kulibu ni bɛ ŋmaligirimi ka chɛ Masia.
en: Don't put young widows on the list. They may later have a strong desire to get married. Then they will turn away from Christ.

dag: O suhu daa yiɣisiya, ka o lan je ma, ka dari tɔhi ma. O daa dim o nyina ni niŋ ma. O mirig o nina niŋ ma kaman o dima n-nyɛ ma la.
en: God attacks me; he is angry with me and tears my body apart. He grinds his teeth against me. My enemy looks at me with hate.

dag: Ka o daa pirigi ba gbilligbilli n-zaŋ ba niŋ o tumtumdiba nuu ni, ka bɛ taɣiri ba gbilligbilli dol taba ka o yɛli ba, Garimiya n tooni chani ka chɛ ka larigim be yi sunsuuni.
en: Jacob put servants in charge of each herd and told them, Go ahead of me and keep a space between each herd.

dag: Ka Juda daa yɛl o, Chɛ ka o zaŋ nɛma maa leeg o dini, di yi pa lala, niriba ni la ti; nyama, n-chɛ ka a zaŋ bubil polli maa ni a ti ti o, ka a bi tooi bo n-nya o.
en: Judah said, Let her keep the things. We don't want people to laugh at us. I did try to pay her, but you couldn't find her.

dag: O ni daa wolisira, ka bi yino zaŋ o nuu tirina, ka paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣinda daa zaŋ gali ʒee lo o nuu maa ka yɛli, Ŋumbɔŋɔ ka bɛ daŋ dɔɣibu.
en: While she was in labor, one of them put out an arm; the midwife caught it, tied a red thread around it, and said, This one was born first.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ti nya ka ninsalinim ninvuɣ biɛtali galisi pam dunia ŋɔ ni, ka bɛ suhuri ni tɛha zaa kul nyɛla din bie sahakam.
en: The Lord saw that the people on the earth were very evil. He saw that they thought only about evil things all the time.

dag: Ka o daa mali nti kpe yil shɛli, ka zoomba maa dol o kpe; ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Yi niŋ yɛda ni n ni tooi niŋ yi ni bɔri shɛli maa? Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Iin, ti Duuma.
en: Jesus went inside, and the blind men went with him. He asked them, Do you believe that I am able to make you see again? They answered, Yes, Lord, we believe.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Ka yi yi ti nya ka yɛlibiɛ shɛli din chihira ʒe di ni bi simdi ni di ʒe luɣ shɛli polo, ŋunkam ti karim sabbu ŋɔ, ŋun baŋmi di ni wuhi shɛm! Di saha maa bɛn ti be Judia, bɛn zom ti du zoya.
en: You will see the terrible thing that causes destruction. You will see this thing standing in the place where it should not be. Everyone in Judea at that time should run away to the mountains.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka di yɛli Yawɛ tɔbu tuhibu Litaafi ni, Wahɛb fɔntiŋ din be Sufa bɔbili mini vinvama ni Arinɔn Mɔɣili.
en: That is why The Book of the Lord 's Battles speaks of ... the town of Waheb in the area of Suphah, and the valleys; the Arnon River.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa nyaandoliba daa labina nti nya o mini paɣ maa ni diri alizama maa ka di gari ba pam, amaa bɛ ni so daa bi bɔhi paɣ maa, Bɔ ka a lee bɔra? Bɛ mi daa bi bɔhi Yisa, Bɔzuɣu ka a mini paɣ maa diri alizama.
en: Just then Jesus followers came back from town. They were surprised because they saw Jesus talking with a woman. But none of them asked, What do you want? or Why are you talking with her.

dag: O ni ti kana ti saɣim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ, ka chɛ ka alɔbo di di ni yɛn di shɛba, ka chɛ ka bɛ gbahi bɛ ni yɛn gbahi shɛb daba, ka chɛ ka tɔbu mi di di ni yɛn di shɛba.
en: He will come and ravage the land of Egypt: those marked for disaster, to disaster, and those marked for exile, to exile. and those marked for war, to war.

dag: Amaa nyin wuhimila din mini wuhibu maŋli taɣili tab la.
en: Titus, you must teach only what is correct.

dag: Bɛ yi ti kurigi, bɛ na kul ni wandi wala; ka mali sum, ka bɛ vari kul nyɛ vamaha.
en: that still bear fruit in old age and are always green and strong.

dag: N ni daa nyɛ bidibbila ka na pɔra m-be m ba sani, ka nyɛ m ma ni daa yuri so pam.
en: When I was a son to my father, tender and my mothers favorite.

dag: Na so ŋun nyɛ putɔɣulana yi su tarimba, o ŋmanila gbuɣinli ŋun ŋumda bee jɛŋgbini ŋun yiɣina ni o gbaai so.
en: A wicked ruler over the poor is like a growling lion or a prowling bear.

dag: Yi ni tooi ŋma ti shɛŋa yi ni mi ka di bi wandi wala. Yi ni tooi ŋma li n-zaŋ li mali bindura tabili tiŋ maa gooni din ni chɛ ka yi tooi kpe di ni ti nyaŋ ba.
en: You may cut down the other trees and use them in the siege mounds until the city is captured.

dag: Ninsalinim biɛhigu ŋmanila mɔri. Bɛ zoorimi kaman mɔɣu ni tipum la;.
en: He knows our lives are short, that they are like grass. He knows we are like a little wildflower that grows so quickly.

dag: Pa bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn turi jilima yu shɛli Naawuni ni zaŋ boli ya la?.
en: Aren't they the ones who make fun of your Lord?.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, N ni duh a Izraɛlnim zaa ninni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ; ka bɛ baŋ ni n ni be a sani kaman n ni daa be Musa sani shɛm la.
en: Then the Lord said to Joshua, Today I will begin to make you a great man for all the Israelites to see. Then the people will know that I am with you just as I was with Moses.

dag: Amaa nyini Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia, wummi Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm. Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ a polo m-bɔŋɔ: A ku kpi tɔbu ni.
en: Zedekiah, listen to what I say about you. You will not be killed in battle.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ yɛli, N ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai Jɛrusalɛm mini Judanima, ka di chɛ ka ŋunkam wum di yɛla niŋgbuna sɔhigi.
en: So I, the Lord God of Israel, will bring such a disaster on Jerusalem and Judah that everyone who hears about it will be stunned.

dag: Banima n-lee ni tooi du n-tam Yawɛ dabol la zuɣu? Bee banima n-lee ni tooi zan o luɣ kasi la shee?.
en: Who has the right to go up the Lord 's hill? Who may enter his holy Temple?.

dag: M bia, di kpe yɔɣu ka chɛ baŋsim yɛtɔɣa, ka di chɛ ka a wum wuhibu.
en: My son, if you stop listening to instructions, you will keep making stupid mistakes.

dag: Bɛ bi tɛhiri bɛ suhuri ni yɛra, Chɛliya ka ti jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, ŋuna n-chɛ ka siɣili saa mini sheen saa mira bɛ mibu saha. Ŋuna n-zaani ti puri atam kpuɣibu saha tiri ti.
en: The people of Judah never say to themselves, Lets fear and respect the Lord our God. He gives us autumn and spring rains at just the right time. He makes sure that we have the harvest at just the right time.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa ni daa nya lala maa, ka bɛ teei dɔni n-zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tiŋa ka yɛra, Yawɛ n-shiri nyɛ Naawuni, Yawɛ n-shiri nyɛ Naawuni.
en: All the people saw this happen and bowed down to the ground and began saying, The Lord is God! The Lord is God.

dag: TƐKƐL gbinni nyɛla, Naawuni zaŋ a pa sania zuɣu n-zahim a ka a tibisim pɔra.
en: weight, you have been weighed on the scales and found to be too light;.

dag: M mabihi, teemiya yi ni daa nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛba ka Naawuni boli ya la yɛla. Zaŋ chaŋ dunia ŋɔ yɛla polo, yi ni pam daa pala yɛnnima bee yikolaannima bee nam zuliyanima.
en: Now remember what you were, my friends, when God called you. From the human point of view few of you were wise or powerful or of high social standing.

dag: Di zɔrimi duri zoya, ka zɔri siɣiri vinvama ni n-chani ti dooni a ni zali ni di dɔni luɣ shɛli.
en: They flowed over the mountains, streaming down the valleys to the place you established for them.

dag: O daa zaŋ sagbana niŋ bɛ zuɣusaa, ka chɛ ka buɣim tiri neesim yuŋ.
en: God spread out clouds as a covering; gave lightning to provide light at night.

dag: mini dundɔŋ din gil li maa daantalisi ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu ni dundɔŋ maa dunɔdali daantalisi ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu ni Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili kpahi zaa ni dundɔŋ din daa gil li maa kpahi zaa.
en: the stands for the posts that surrounded the courtyard, including those at the entrance to the courtyard, and the pegs for the tent and the courtyard.

dag: Ka Izraɛl Naa Jɛhɔash daa chɛ ka bɛ lab ti yɛli Juda Naa Amazia ni dahin shɛli ka Lɛbanɔn goo tutuɣu daa ti tim ti yɛli Lɛbanɔn sida, Zaŋm a bipuɣiŋga ti ma ka n-niŋ m paɣa; ka Lɛbanɔn mɔɣu ni biŋkɔb so daa kana ti no goo tutuɣu maa sɔŋ tiŋa.
en: But Israels King Joash responded to Judahs King Amaziah, Once upon a time, a thistle in Lebanon sent a message to a cedar, Give your daughter to my son as a wife. But then a wild beast in Lebanon came along and trampled the thistle.

dag: Di saha ka yɛri bɛ taba, Ti nyɛla bɛn be kasi; miligimiya ka chɛ ti. M mini niriba bɛn be lala ku tooi kpe. N suhuyiɣisili zaŋ chaŋ bɛ sani ŋmanila buɣim din bi kpiri dabisili puuni zaa.
en: But they tell others, Dont come near me! Dont touch me because I am holy! They are like smoke in my eyes, and their fire burns all the time.

dag: Man Pool mini Silvanus ni Timoti n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri Tɛsalɔnaika cheechi niriba bɛn nyɛ ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia ni su shɛb la. Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Ba mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka tin ya suhudoo!.
en: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God the Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ. I pray that God will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Puhimiya Yawɛ, dama o nyɛla ŋun viɛla, ka o yurilim maŋli bi naara.
en: We will celebrate and praise you, Lord ! You are good to us, and your love never fails.

dag: Pita daa kul gɔrimi gindi luɣilikam kaari Yisa nyaandoliba, ka daa ti chaŋ Yisa nyaandol shɛb bɛn daa be Lida la gba sani.
en: While Peter was traveling from place to place, he visited the Lord's followers who lived in the town of Lydda.

dag: Yisa ni daa yi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni na ka o nyaandoliba ni yino yɛl o, Karimba, nyam kuɣa ŋɔ mini duri ŋɔ ni viɛl shɛm.
en: Jesus was leaving the Temple area. One of his followers said to him, Teacher, look how big those stones are! What beautiful buildings.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbaag o n-zaŋ o doli yuri dunoli polo nti kpe nayili n-ku o nimaani.
en: They arrested her when she reached the entrance of the Horse Gate at the royal palace. She was executed there.

dag: Di dabisi tuuli dali, di simdi ka yi laɣim laɣiŋgu kasi, ka miriya ka yi tum tuma.
en: On the first day you will hold a holy occasion and must not do any job-related work.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ n-daa zaŋ a ba Nɛbukadnɛza leei na titali, ka ti o di viɛlim mini di tibiginsim ni di jilima.
en: Sir, the Most High God made your father a great and powerful man and brought him much honor and glory.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ binnamda zaa Duuma Naawuni la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Niriba ni doli solɔri n-kumdi ka fabindi yɛra, Mbaye! mbaye! Bɛ ni ti boli pukpariba na ti pahi bɛ ni tiri shɛb liɣiri ka bɛ kumdi kuyila zuɣu, ka bɛ kum ka fabili.
en: And so the Sovereign Lord Almighty says, There will be wailing and cries of sorrow in the city streets. Even farmers will be called to mourn the dead along with those who are paid to mourn.

dag: Amaa m piila Jɛrusalɛm ni bɛ tiri n yuli jilima nimaani ka pii Dauda ni o su n niriba Izraɛlnima. .
en: But now I have chosen Jerusalem as a place for my name, and I have chosen David to lead my people Israel.

dag: Ka Pita yɛl o, Hal sokam zaa yi ni zo ka chɛ a, man kul ku zo ka chɛ a.
en: Peter answered, I will never leave you, even though all the rest do.

dag: ka wuntaŋ ti zibigi ka goli mi ti niŋ kaman ʒim la pɔi, ka ti Duuma dabisi titali din mali jilima pam la naanyi kana.
en: The sun will be changed into darkness, and the moon will be changed into blood, before the great and spectacular day of the Lord comes. .

dag: Ka a yi nyɛla wuntizɔra, bɔ ka a yɛn ti o? Bee bɔ ka o yɛn nya di ni?.
en: And if you are good, that does not help God. He gets nothing from you.

dag: Binnani maa zuɣu daa nyɛla salima din nyɛ alali; ka o nyɔɣu min o bɔɣiri nyɛ anzinfa; ka o puli min o gbalipina nyɛ daanya;.
en: The statues head was made of pure gold; its chest and arms were made from silver; its abdomen and hips were made of bronze.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zali saha shɛl o ni yɛn niŋ li maa ka yɛli, Biɛɣuni ka man Yawɛ sa yɛn niŋ dimbɔŋɔ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: The LORD set a time and said, Tomorrow the LORD will do this in the land.

dag: Piɛguliba maa ni daa nya biliɛɣu maa, ka bɛ yɛli malaika la ni daa yɛli ba bia maa yɛla shɛm zaa.
en: When the shepherds saw Jesus, they told his parents what the angel had said about him.

dag: Nimdi mini gbaŋ dina, o daa zaŋ li yila bɛ biɛhigu maa shee kpaŋa ti nyo li buɣim.
en: But he burned the flesh and hide with fire outside the camp.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ yuuni daa ti yɛn giligi, ka Siria tɔbbihi daa lo tɔb na ti liri Naa Jɔash. Bɛ daa lirila Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima n-ku bɛ zuɣulaannim zaa, ka di nɛma n-zaŋ li chaŋ ti ti Damaskus naa.
en: When autumn came that year, the Syrian army attacked Judah and Jerusalem, killed all the leaders, and took large amounts of loot back to Damascus.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri firila na mi n-kpi? Bɛ na mi n-nya ashaara? Ka Naawuni suhu na mi n-yiɣisi ka o chɛ ka biɛrim paai ba?.
en: How often does God become angry and send disaster and darkness to punish sinners?.

dag: Shɛb mali bɛ tab paɣiba doon a ni, ka shɛb mi tumdi daɣiri tuma, ka mali bɛ bihi paɣiba doon a ni, ka shɛb mi mali bɛ tizɔpaɣiba bɛn nyɛ bɛ manim nyintahi bipuɣinsi doon a ni.
en: Every man engages in detestable practices with his neighbors wife, every man defiles his daughter-in-law with obscene acts, and every man violates his sister, his own fathers daughter.

dag: Ka Rɛkab bia Malikija ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtihakɛrɛm yaɣili polo naa la daa mali me Saɣiri Dunɔdali maa, ka mali pununim kpɛhi li, ka niŋ dunokparita mini kurimulima niŋ li.
en: Malchijah son of Rechab, ruler of the Beth Haccherem District, rebuilt the Rubbish Gate. He put the gates in place, and put in the bolts and the bars for locking the gate.

dag: Di daa paai yuma ata ka Izraɛlnim mini Sirianim bi lan tuhi taba.
en: There was peace between Israel and Syria for the next two years.

dag: Dama m bi niŋ n tɔbu naani bee n-niŋ n takɔb yɛda ni di ni tiligi ma.
en: No, I wont trust in my bow; my sword wont save me.

dag: Jashub daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Jashubnima; ka Shimrɔn daŋ niriba nyɛ Shimirɔnnima.
en: Jashub—the Jashubite family group; Shimron—the Shimronite family group.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ tipawumlinim bɛn tɛhi ni tiliginsim be katiŋ ŋɔ, wummiya!.
en: You people are stubborn and far from being safe, so listen to me.

dag: Bɛ ni ti yi Ijipti kana ka bɛ ni sɔhiri kaman noombihi la. Ka shɛb ti yi Asiria kana kaman ŋmana la, ka n ti zaŋ ba labisi bɛ yinsi. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: They will come trembling like a bird, and like a dove from the land of Assyria; and I will return them to their homes, says the LORD.

dag: Wuhim ma n ni bi nyari shɛli, di yi nyɛla n tumla tuumbiɛri, n ku lan tum lala yaha?.
en: Then ask him to point out what you did wrong, so you won't do it again.

dag: Ka o daa lan tirisi tooni biɛla ha nti nya Zɛbidii bihi Jeemsi min o tizo Jɔn, ka bɛ be ŋariŋ ni liɣiri bɛ lansi.
en: Jesus continued walking by Lake Galilee. He saw two more brothers, James and John, the sons of Zebedee. They were in their boat, preparing their nets to catch fish.

dag: N teeri yi yɛla zaa, ka kul paɣiri Naawuni yi zuɣu.
en: I thank my God for you every time I think of you;.

dag: N tɛha ni daa labi n ni na saha shɛli maa, ka n jilima mini n dariza ni n nam maa tibiginsim gba daa lan labi n sanna. Ka n jintɔriba mini n kpambaliba daa lan deei ma, ka n nam maa yiko mini di jilima din gari di ni daa pun be shɛm lan labi n sanna.
en: At that time God gave me my right mind again, and he gave back my great honor and power as king. My advisors and the royal people began to ask my advice again. I became the king again—even greater and more powerful than before.

dag: Yilimiya yila ka ŋmɛm guŋgombihi, ka ŋmɛm goonjɛnim mini mɔɣilɔnim din kumsi nyaɣisa.
en: Begin the music. Play the tambourines. Play the pleasant harps and lyres.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa yiɣisi niŋ kaman Naawuni nir maa ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa n-zaŋ o yiŋnim kuli Filistianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni nti be nimaani yuma ayopɔin.
en: She had followed his instructions and had gone with her family to live in Philistia for the seven years.

dag: Ka naa suhu daa yiɣisi pam, ka o yiɣisi bindira dibu mini binnyura nyubu duu maa ni yi nayili tihi puu ni. Ka Haman daa baŋ ni naa ni darig o tibili yɛlli maa zuɣu, ka daa kpalim ni o suh o nyɛvili Napaɣ Ɛsta sani.
en: The king was very angry. He got up, left his wine, and went out into the garden. But Haman stayed inside to beg Queen Esther to save his life. He begged for his life because he knew that the king had already decided to kill him.

dag: Karimbaannim bari ma la tɔŋ, ka teei bɛ mihi sɔŋ kaman laŋ la, bɛ bari ma la zana soli zuɣu.
en: The proud have set a trap for me; they have laid their snares, and along the path they have set traps to catch me.

dag: Shɛhira maa n-nyɛ ni Naawuni ti ti nyɛvili din ka bahigu, ka nyɛvili maa mi bela o Bia maa ni.
en: And this is the testimony: God gave eternal life to us, and this life is in his Son.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda nachimba maa ŋmaligi labi ti yɛl o dimbɔŋɔ zaa.
en: The men returned to their camp and told David everything Nabal had said.

dag: Ʒiri sanianim mini ʒiri binzahindisi zaa nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ sani.
en: The Lord hates for people to use the wrong weights and measures to cheat others.

dag: ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ ni zaŋ yabiga gari wain shɛl ni ti o ni o nyu; amaa ka o lam li ka zaɣisi li nyubu.
en: they gave Jesus wine mixed with vinegar to drink. But after tasting it, he didnt want to drink it.

dag: Ka o ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Ka yi mi lee yɛli ni n nyɛla ŋuni.
en: What about you? he asked them. Who do you say I am.

dag: Miriya ka yi damdi binyɛra maa tooni bee n-jɛm binyɛra maa, dama man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ nyɛla ŋun zabiri nyuli, ka darigiri bihi tibili bɛ banim mini bɛ manim bɛn je ma taali zuɣu hal zaŋ tabili bɛ yaantibichɛhi gba.
en: Don't bow down and worship idols. I am the Lord your God, and I demand all your love. If you reject me, I will punish your families for three or four generations.

dag: Ka di tintariga maa daa lan kpuɣi Sarid n-zaŋ kpa di wulimpuhili polo hal ti paai Chisilɔtabo n-zaŋ gari hal ni Dabɛrat n-chaŋ hal ti paai Jafia.
en: Then the border turned to the east. It went from Sarid to Kisloth Tabor. Then it went on to Daberath and to Japhia.

dag: M Ba Naawuni yubu nyɛla ni ŋunkam nya o Bia la ka niŋ o yɛda ni nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu, ka n ti neeg o kum ni zaadali.
en: Everyone who sees the Son and believes in him has eternal life. I will raise them up on the last day. This is what my Father wants.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka alɔbo lu Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka Izraɛlnim ninvuɣ tuhi pisopɔin daa kpi.
en: So the Lord sent terrible sicknesses to Israel, and , people died.

dag: Lihimiya daboya zuɣusaa nya, luɣ dini ka yi mini so lee bi dɔni? Yi daa ʒila soya naŋgban kpansi n-guhiri yi mamanima kaman Laribu m-be tiŋgban nɛli ni la. Yi zaŋ zina niŋbu mini yi ninvuɣ biɛtali n-ta tiŋgbani maa daɣiri.
en: Look to the well-traveled paths and see! Where havent you committed adultery? On the roadsides you sit in wait for lovers, like a nomad in the wilderness. You have corrupted the land with your cheap and reckless behavior.

dag: Dinzuɣu alizanda nam ŋmanila na so ŋun daa bol o yiŋbihi na ni o ti mal o liɣiri din be bɛ sani laasabu.
en: Therefore, the kingdom of heaven is like a king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa ti lan yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu, ka o piɛli Dauda bahi bɛ zuɣu ka yɛl o, Cham ti kali Izraɛlnim mini Judanima.
en: The Lord was angry with Israel again, and he made David think it would be a good idea to count the people in Israel and Judah.

dag: Vinnyaɣilan bi kɔri kɔbu saha, ka puri atam kpuɣibu saha yi ti paai o bi nyari shɛli.
en: A farmer too lazy to plow his fields at the right time will have nothing to harvest.

dag: Dama Daadam Bia gba bi kamina ni o ti ʒiya ka niriba tumdi tir o; amaa ni ŋun lee ti tumdi tiri ba, ka zaŋ o nyɛvili pa talima niriba pam nyɛviya zuɣu.
en: The Son of Man did not come to be a slave master, but a slave who will give his life to rescue many people.

dag: O me o tiŋa n-tam zoli din be kasi zuɣu.
en: The Lord built his city on the holy hills.

dag: Nyamiya, Sintani jɛmdiba bɛn yɛli ni bɛ nyɛla Yɛhudianima amaa ka pa Yɛhudianim la nyɛla ʒiŋmariba. N ni chɛ ka bɛ kana nti gbani yi tooni m-baŋ ni n yuri ya.
en: Because of this I will make the people from Satans synagogue —I will make them come and bow down at your feet and realize that I have loved you.

dag: Bɛ daa yiɣi du zuɣusaa ha n-lab ti lu bulli ni, ka dabiɛm daa kpe ba bɛ barina maa puuni.
en: You were tossed to the sky and to the ocean depths, until things looked so bad that you lost your courage.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa buɣisi dunɔdali maa yɛliŋ, ka di nyɛ mita anu. Ka o daa buɣisi foliŋga din kpe dunɔdali maa ni, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita ayɔbu ni pirigili.
en: Then he measured the width of the gate opening, which was fifteen feet, and the gates length, which was nineteen and a half feet.

dag: Ka Gibiɔnnim daa tim Giligal sansan la ni ti yɛli Jɔshua, Di chɛ tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ bahi. Kamina yomyom ti sɔŋ ti tiligi ti; dama Amɔri nanim zaa bɛn be zoya polo tinsi la ni laɣim bɛ tɔbbihi kana ti teei gili Gibiɔn n-doya ni bɛ tuhi ti.
en: The men of Gibeon sent word to Joshua at the camp in Gilgal: Do not abandon us, sir! Come at once and help us! Save us! All the Amorite kings in the hill country have joined forces and have attacked us.

dag: Ti kpamba mini ti tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim zaa daa yɛlimi, Bomiya bindira niŋ yi nuu ni n-gbaai soli chaŋ ti nya ba yɛli ba, Ti nyɛla yi daba, ka chɛ m-bɔri ni ti mini ya lo tab alikauli.
en: Our leaders and everyone who lives in our country told us to meet with you and tell you that all of us are your servants. They said to ask you to make a peace treaty with our people. They told us to be sure and take along enough food for our journey.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ yɛmbimbiɛtali maa ka yɛli ba.
en: Jesus knew they were trying to trick him. So he told them.

dag: Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa zaligu m-bɔŋɔ: Luɣ shɛlikam zaa din gili zoli maa zuɣusaa nyɛla din be kasi zaa. Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa zaligu m-bala.
en: The temple area on my holy mountain must be kept sacred! This is the most important law about the temple.

dag: Yawɛ, a binnamda zaa ni paɣ a, ka a niriba bɛn zaa ʒe yim ni paɣ a.
en: Lord , all you have made will give thanks to you. Your loyal followers will praise you.

dag: M mabia, a yurilim maa zuɣu chɛ ka n nya suhupiɛlli mini suhukpaŋsibo, dama Yisa nyaandoliba nyari suhukpaŋsibo a sani.
en: Your love, dear brother, has brought me great joy and much encouragement! You have cheered the hearts of all of God's people.

dag: Ka o mam ŋun daa be Shɛkɛm gba daa dɔɣ o bidib yino, ka o bol o yuli Abimilɛk.
en: He had a slave woman who lived in the city of Shechem. He had a son by her. He named that son Abimelech.

dag: Bɛ ni ti yɛrila ninsala ŋun nyɛ binneembila, ka nyɛ daadam ŋun nyɛ zunzuli ŋɔ.
en: People are much less pure. They are like maggots, as worthless as worms.

dag: Ka Musa deemba Jɛtro daa mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Naawuni. Ka Aduna mini Izraɛl kpamba zaa daa kana, ka bɛ mini Musa deemba maa ti laɣim di bindirigu Naawuni tooni.
en: Jethro got some sacrifices and offerings to honor God. Then Aaron and all the elders of Israel came to eat with Moses father-in-law Jethro. They all ate together there with God.

dag: Ɛlam daŋ ni: Matania mini Zakaria ni Jɛhiɛl ni Abidi ni Jɛrɛmɔt ni Ɛlia.
en: From the descendants of Elam, these men: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah.

dag: Di saha ka kpamba maa ni yino yɛli ma, Di kumda! Nyama, Naa Dauda zuliya ni bɛ ni booni so Juda zuliya ni Gbuɣinli la di nasara. Dinzuɣu o ni tooi tabigi bintabinda ayopɔin maa ka bɔɣi litaafi maa.
en: But one of the elders said to me, Dont cry! The Lion from the tribe of Judah has won the victory. He is Davids descendant. He is able to open the scroll and its seven seals.

dag: Di saha ka nu shɛli daa gbaai ma n-kpuɣi ma gbani n duna zuɣu ka n nuhi dihi tiŋa, ka n ni sɔhira.
en: He raised me to my hands and knees.

dag: Ŋuna n-chɛ ka kom yi tampima ni na zɔra, ka chɛ ka kɔzɔrim yi chɛbili kuɣili ni na.
en: the one who turned that rock into a pool of water, that flint stone into a spring of water!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lo o zoligɔnima n-zaŋ o niŋ gampiliga ni n-zaŋ o tahi ti ti Babilɔn naa. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o niŋ duu ni di chɛ ka bɛ ku lan wum o kukoli Izraɛl zoya zuɣu yaha.
en: They put a collar on him and brought him with hooks. They brought him with nets to the king of Babylon so that his voice would no longer be heard on the mountains of Israel.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa yɛl o, Karimba, mami daba ayi ŋɔ ni ka Yɛhudianim daa bɔri ni bɛ lab a kuɣa la, ka a ti lan yɛn lab nimaani yaha.
en: The disciples replied, Rabbi, the Jewish opposition wants to stone you, but you want to go back.

dag: Ka bɛ daa boli Yisa min o nyaandoliba gba ni bɛ ka amiliya maa ni na.
en: and Jesus and his disciples had also been invited to the wedding.

dag: N Duuma, sɔŋm ma ka n yaai n noli paɣ a.
en: My Lord, I will open my mouth and sing your praises!.

dag: Ibrahimma mam ŋun yuli daa booni Kɛtuura la ni daa dɔɣi bidib shɛba n-daa nyɛ: Zimiran mini Jokishan ni Mɛdan ni Midian ni Ishibak ni Shua. Jokishan bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Shiiba mini Dɛdan.
en: Abraham also had sons by Keturah, his slave woman. They were Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. Jokshans sons were Sheba and Dedan.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni daa lo ti yab Ibrahimma alikauli shɛl la palibu saha daa ti miri, ka bɛ zuliya maa daa nab pam Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: When it was time for God to keep the promise he made to Abraham, the number of our people in Egypt had greatly expanded.

dag: Amaa n nahindila n niŋgbuŋ ni n nyaŋ li su, dama di yi pa lala, n ni yihi lahibal suŋ waazu ti niriba ŋɔ nyaaŋa, Naawuni ni ti daai ma baɣili kpaŋa.
en: I keep my body under control and make it my slave, so I won't lose out after telling the good news to others.

dag: Di tahi dokurili zuɣu, amaa zaŋm zilim balli n-tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa kaman a ba la; ka niŋmi nachimbihi kaman a mabihi la;.
en: Don't correct an older man. Encourage him, as you would your own father. Treat younger men as you would your own brother.

dag: Gbilisimiya tibili viɛnyɛliŋga n-wum n yɛtɔɣa, ka chɛliya ka n ni tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ŋɔ kpe yi tiba ni.
en: Listen carefully to my words!.

dag: Ka Musa daa niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni zal o ni o niŋ shɛm maa.
en: So Moses did what the Lord commanded him.

dag: Pa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa wumdi Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa ni yɛli shɛm n-nyɛ bɛn yiri taali ni Naawuni sani, amaa bɛn doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa n-nyɛ bɛn yiri taali ni Naawuni sani.
en: For it is not by hearing the Law that people are put right with God, but by doing what the Law commands.

dag: Miriya ka yi niŋ paɣisarili maa shɛli. Paɣisarili maa bi tum tuun shɛli din simdi kubu; dama yɛlli ŋɔ ŋmanila doo ni yi chaŋ ti lir o kpee n-ku o la.
en: Do not punish the woman at all; she has done nothing wrong, and certainly nothing deserving death. This crime is like murder.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa kari doli Naa Sool min o bidibisi nti ku Jɔnatan mini Abinadab ni Malikishua.
en: The Philistines continued chasing Saul and his sons. They caught them and killed them. The Philistines killed Sauls sons Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malki Shua.

dag: Yɔnahu ni saɣi tum a tuma? O ni saɣi gbe a naɣikpahi ni yuŋ?.
en: Will a wild bull agree to serve you? Will he stay in your barn at night?.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti kpalim a yili ŋɔ ni ti chaŋ o sani ti maani bara n-suhir o liɣiri bee bɔrɔbɔro kpilli, ka ni ti yɛli, N suhir a, zaŋm ma zali maligumaana so zaani din ni chɛ ka n nyari bindirigu dira.
en: Any of your descendants who survive will have to go to that priest and ask him for money and food, and beg to be allowed to help the priests, in order to have something to eat.

dag: Ka Judianim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa daa kabi chaŋ o sani nti kaŋka bɛ daalahichi ka o naanyi baptaizi ba Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili ni.
en: From all Judea and Jerusalem crowds of people went to John. They told how sorry they were for their sins, and he baptized them in the Jordan River.

dag: Ka a zaŋ binyɛra yɛli Aduna. Dina n-nyɛ: zabbanim mini alichɛbba ni binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa ni nyolɔrigu; ka zaŋ binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la shɛlɔrigu lo o.
en: Dress Aaron in the priestly shirt, the robe that goes under the sacred vest, the vest itself, the breastpiece, and the sash.

dag: Di saha ka omaŋmaŋ daa yiɣisi chaŋ Rama nti chaŋ kɔbil titali din be Sɛku la gbini ti bɔhi, Ya ka Samuɛl mini Dauda lee be la? Ka so yɛl o, Nyama bɛ be Naiɔt Rama tiŋgban ni.
en: Finally, Saul himself went to Ramah. Saul came to the big well by the threshing floor at Secu. He asked, Where are Samuel and David? The people answered, In the camps near Ramah.

dag: Di saha Yawɛ jilima ni yi zahira ka sokam zaa nya li. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala.
en: Then the glory of the Lord will appear for all to see. The Lord has promised this.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ ʒiishee leei dabari, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ ku lan be bɛ yinsi.
en: May their camps be left deserted; may no one be left alive in their tents.

dag: Ka n daa zaŋ Giliad ti Makiri.
en: I gave Gilead to Makir.

dag: Ka Aduna bidibisi maa zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu m-pahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim, ka di pa dari zuɣu m-be sara maligu bimbini zuɣu la, ka di leei bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl Yawɛ sani la.
en: Some of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me, together with the sacrifice that is offered to please me.

dag: Yi ni tooi ŋma ti shɛŋa yi ni mi ka di bi wandi wala. Yi ni tooi ŋma li n-zaŋ li mali bindura tabili tiŋ maa gooni din ni chɛ ka yi tooi kpe di ni ti nyaŋ ba.
en: But you may cut down the trees that you know are not fruit trees. You may use these trees to build weapons for making war against that city. You may use them until the city falls.

dag: Yawɛ, wumma, zom ma nambɔɣu! Yawɛ, leemi ŋun sɔŋdi ma!.
en: Hear me, Lord , and be merciful! Help me, Lord .

dag: Bɛ daa yi bela Naawuni biɛhigu shee tooni Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la ni n-yiini yila hal ka Sulemaana daa ti naanyi me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu Jɛrusalɛm la. Bɛ daa kul tumdila bɛ tuma maa n-doli di soli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: These musicians served at the sacred tent and later at the Lord 's temple that King Solomon built.

dag: O daa malila paɣiba kɔbisiyopɔin bɛn nyɛ nabipuɣinsi, ka mali mamanim mi kɔbisita; ka o paɣiba maa daa ti chɛ ka o birigi.
en: He had seven hundred royal wives and three hundred secondary wives. They turned his heart.

dag: Dinzuɣu gbaamiya yimaŋa ni yɛliwumsa, dama ŋunkam mali ni lan nya m-pahi, ka ŋun mi ka ni ti bahi kɔŋ o ni tɛhi ni o mali shɛl la.
en: Therefore, listen carefully. Those who have will receive more, but as for those who dont have, even what they seem to have will be taken away from them.

dag: Wummi n suhigu shɛli n ni suhir a ni a zo ma nambɔɣu ŋɔ. N kuhirimi niŋd a bɔri sɔŋsim; ka kpuɣiri n nuhi zuɣusaa tiriti a jɛmbu du kasi la.
