en: I lift my hands and pray toward your Most Holy Place. Hear me when I call to you. Show mercy to me.

dag: Amaa yinim yiɣisimi lu n niriba zuɣu kaman yi dimnim la. Yi darigi fuɣi suhudoolan binyɛrigu, ka darigi fuɣi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn garita ka bi lan tɛhiri tɔbu tuhibu yɛla binyɛra.
en: But yesterday, my people, the LORD rose up as an enemy. You strip off the glorious clothes from trusting passersby, those who reject war.

dag: n ti a yɛm mini baŋsim. N ni lan ti a buni mini azichi ni jilima, ka di galisi gari na shɛb bɛn daa daŋ a tooni la zaa dini, ka na shɛb bɛn ti yɛn dol a nyaaŋa na mi so dini ti ku paai li.
en: So I will give you wisdom and knowledge, but I will also give you wealth, riches, and honor. No king who lived before you has ever had so much wealth and honor, and no king in the future will have as much wealth and honor.

dag: ka o suhu yiɣisi ka o bɔh a, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi chaŋ miri tiŋ maa ni yi ti tuhi ba? Yi bi mi ni bɛ ni tɔn ya piɛma goma zuɣu na?.
en: he may get angry and ask you, Why did you go so near the city to fight them? Didn't you realize that they would shoot arrows from the walls?.

dag: N ni lan chɛ ka a zaŋ anzinfa mini salima din nyɛ m mini n saawaranim maa ni zaŋ ti Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun jɛmbu duu be Jɛrusalɛm maa ka di nyɛ ti suhuyubu pina la m-mali chaŋ.
en: You are to take with you the gold and silver offerings which I and my counselors desire to give to the God of Israel, whose Temple is in Jerusalem.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Akishi daa bɔh o kpambaliba maa, Nyamiya, yi nya ka doo ŋɔ nyɛla yinyaa, ka yi zaŋ o kani n sanna?.
en: Achish said to his officers, Look at the man! He is crazy. Why did you bring him to me?.

dag: Ka bɛ yi saɣi suhumahili yɛtɔɣa maa, ka zaŋ bɛmaŋ tin ya, dindina ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be nimaani zaa ni tum dabitim tuma tin ya.
en: If they accept your offer and open their gates, all the people in that city will become your slaves and be forced to work for you.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun va naɣisaa maa tampiligim maa, o paɣim o binyɛra ka leei ŋun bi be nyam hal ni zaawuni. Ka dimbɔŋɔ kul ni nyɛ Izraɛlnim mini tinzunnim bɛn be bɛ sani zaligu sahakam.
en: The one who collected the ashes must wash his clothes, but he remains unclean until evening. This regulation is valid for all time to come, both for the Israelites and for the foreigners living among them.

dag: Ka a nimbil mi yi chɛ ka a yɛn birigi tum alahichi, nyin kpɔɣim li bahi, dama a yi kɔŋ a nimbil yini ka ti be, di so ni a mali nina ayi ka bɛ ti zaŋ a kpɛhi buɣim din bi kpiri ni.
en: If your eye causes you to sin, poke it out and get rid of it. You would be better off to go into life with only one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into the fires of hell.

dag: O daa buɣisi li la di luɣa anahi zuɣu. Bɛ daa mɛla gooni gil li, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita kɔbisiyi ni pihinu, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita kɔbisiyi ni pihinu, ka di woligi din be kasi ka chɛ din bi be kasi.
en: so that the wall enclosed a square feet on each side. The wall served to separate what was holy from what was not.

dag: Nyamiya, ti chanila Jɛrusalɛm, ka bɛ ni ti zaŋ Daadam Bia niŋ maligumaaniba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdib nuu ni, ka bɛ ti di o saria yɛli ni bɛ kum o.
en: We are going to Jerusalem. The Son of Man will be handed over to the leading priests and the teachers of the law, and they will say he must die.

dag: Bimbɔ zuɣu ka di daantalisi daa lee tamiya? Bee ŋuni n-daa lee sɔŋ di tuuli tampuɣili?.
en: What is the earth resting on? Who put the first stone in its place.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli Itai ŋun daa nyɛ Gaat nir la, Bɔzuɣu ka yi mi dol ti chana? Labimiya ka yi mini naa maa ti be, dama yinim nyɛla tinzunnima, ka lan nyɛ yi yanim ni kari shɛb bahi na.
en: David spoke to Ittai and said, You're a foreigner from the town of Gath. You don't have to leave with us. Go back and join the new king!.

dag: O darigiri bɛ tibili ka niriba nyara bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali zuɣu;.
en: He strikes them because of their wickedness at a place where people can see it.

dag: Ka n daa wum ka kukol shɛli yi bimbin ni na yɛra, Yɛlimaŋli, ti Duuma Naawuni Zallakudura Naa, a saria karibu nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni din tuhi.
en: And I heard the altar say, Yes, Lord God All-Powerful, your judgments are true and right.

dag: N duhi n yee kum niŋ Naawuni, n duhi n yee kum niŋ Naawuni ni o deei n suhigu.
en: I cry out to God for help. I cry out to you, God; listen to me!.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa zali Izraɛlnim zaa ni bɛ bom tumtumdiba na ka bɛ ti tum tuma, ka bɛ ni daa bo tumtumdib shɛb na kalinli daa yiɣisi ninvuɣ tuhi pihita.
en: Solomon ordered , people from all over Israel to cut logs for the temple.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Judanim mini Izraɛlnim polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: The Lord spoke this message about the people of Israel and Judah.

dag: n-yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ, pa nyini n-nyɛ alizanda Naawuni? Pa nyin n-nyɛ ŋun su zuliya kam zaa nam fukumsi? Kpiɔŋ mini yiko bela a nuu ni, ka so ku tooi mo a.
en: and prayed aloud, O Lord God of our ancestors, you rule in heaven over all the nations of the world. You are powerful and mighty, and no one can oppose you.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka sokam zahim omaŋ pɔi ka naanyi ŋub bɔrɔbɔro ŋɔ ka nyu pipia ŋɔ ni binnyurigu ŋɔ.
en: So then, you should each examine yourself first, and then eat the bread and drink from the cup.

dag: Ka yi zaa daa ka n sanna ti yɛli, Chɛ ka ti tim niriba ka bɛ daŋ ti tooni chaŋ ti puɣisi kaai tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti ti, ka ʒi lahibali labina ti yɛli ti ti ni yɛn doli so shɛli chaŋ fɔntiŋ shɛŋa ni ti ni yɛn chaŋ.
en: But you came to me and said, Let's send men ahead of us to spy out the land, so that they can tell us the best route to take and what kind of cities are there.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, N ni labisi Yaakubu zuliya azichi ti ba, ka zo bɛ ni be luɣ shɛŋa zaa nambɔɣu. Tiŋ maa ni lan me n-tam di daboli zuɣu, ka nayil la ti lan be di ni daa pun be luɣ shɛl la.
en: The Lord said: Israel, I will be kind to you and let you come home. Jerusalem now lies in ruins, but you will rebuild it, complete with a new palace.

dag: Saimɔn Isikariɔt bia Judas la yɛla ka o daa yɛri maa, dama ŋuna n-daa nyɛ ŋun ti yɛn yi o nyaaŋa ka mi nyɛ bɛ pinaayi maa ni yino la.
en: Jesus was talking about Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot. He would later betray Jesus, even though he was one of the twelve disciples.

dag: M bia, binshɛli din yaɣi dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu, nyin zom li. Litaafinim pam sabbu nyɛla din ka zanibu shee, ka bɔhimbu pam nyɛ din gbarigiri nira.
en: So, son, study these sayings, but be careful about other teachings. People are always writing books, and too much study will make you very tired.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ ma alahiziba n ni daa bi nya ninvuɣ so ŋun ni sɔŋ ma maa; amaa ka n suhuyiɣisili maa daa ti ma kpiɔŋ ka n di nasara n toli.
en: I looked around, but I saw no one to help me. I was surprised that no one supported me. So I used my own power to save my people. My own anger supported me.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia daa ŋmalig o nini bahi dukpini polo n-suhi Yawɛ yɛli:.
en: Hezekiah turned toward the wall and prayed.

dag: Gbuɣimbihi yi bɔri bindirigu Naawuni sani, bɛ chanimi ŋumdi ginda.
en: Lions roar as they hunt for the food you provide.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ sandaantimdiba mal alibarika, dama ti Duuma Naawuni ni ti boli ba o bihi.
en: God blesses those people who make peace. They will be called his children!.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri lu bɛmaŋmaŋ zana ni, amaa ka chɛ ka man kɔŋko tiligi.
en: Let the wicked fall into their own traps, while I walk away unharmed.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n nyee nyɔni biɛhigu, dama binshɛlikam din niŋdi dunia ŋɔ ni nyɛla din tiri ma suhugarigu, dinzuɣu di zaa nyɛla din ka buchi, ka ŋmani nir yi zɔri doli pɔhim.
en: So I hated life, because the things that happen under the sun were troublesome to me. Definitely, everything is pointless—just wind chasing.

dag: Ti paɣiri Zallakudura Naa ŋun chɛ ka a nyaŋ a dimnim ŋɔ! Ka Ibram daa zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa pia puuni zaɣ yiniyini yihi Mɛlikizɛdɛk zaka.
en: All praise belongs to God Most High for helping you defeat your enemies. Then Abram gave Melchizedek a tenth of everything.

dag: Ka Sintani daa zaŋ o du zo shɛli zuɣu nti wuh o dunia ŋɔ nama zaa nini kahimbu ni neebu yim ni.
en: Then the devil led Jesus up to a high place and quickly showed him all the nations on earth.

dag: Ka Yaakubu yɛli Firawuna, N ni gɔri gindi ŋɔ, n yuma nyɛla yuun kɔbiga ni pihita. N yuma maa mini di dabisa bi galisi, amaa ka yɛl biɛri lee be di puuni. Di bi be kaman yuma mini dabisa shɛŋa n yaannim ni daa zaŋ gɔri gindi la.
en: Jacob answered, I have lived only years, and I have had to move from place to place. My parents and my grandparents also had to move from place to place. But they lived much longer, and their life was not as hard as mine.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti nyaya ni di nyɛla bɛ biɛhiŋ zuɣu ka bɛ daa bi tooi nya vuhim maa.
en: We see that those people did not enter the place of rest because they did not have faith.

dag: Di saha Sɔdomnim daa nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛri ni bɛn tumd alahichi pam Yawɛ sani.
en: whose people were wicked and sinned against the Lord .

dag: Tiŋgbani maa daa yaai di noli n-vali bɛ mini bɛ yiŋnima ni Kɔra ni daa su ninvuɣ shɛb zaa zaŋ tabili bɛ binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: and swallowed them and their families, together with all of Korah's followers and their possessions.

dag: Naa Dauda ni daa ʒin o yiŋa ka Yawɛ ti o vuhim o dimnim bɛn daa gil o zaa sani.
en: King David was settled in his palace, and the Lord kept him safe from all his enemies.

dag: Di saha ka Manɔa daa balim Yawɛ yɛli, Yawɛ, n suhir a, chɛ ka a ni daa tim do so na la lan lab ti sanna nti wuhi ti ti ni ti yɛn niŋ bi so ti ni yɛn dɔɣi maa shɛm.
en: Then Manoah prayed to the Lord . He said, Lord, I beg you to send the man of God to us again. We want him to teach us what we should do for the boy who will soon be born.

dag: Bɛn guli Izraɛlnim zaa nyɛla zoomba, bɛ ka baŋsim. Bɛ ŋmanila ba shɛb bɛn doya gbihiri ka bi wahira. Bɛ kul domi gbihiri ka zahindi zahima.
en: He says, All the leaders, who are supposed to warn my people, are blind! They know nothing. They are like watch dogs that don't bark—they only lie around and dream. How they love to sleep!.

dag: Ti Duuma Naawuni ŋun tiri ti suhudoo la malimi yi luɣili pinaayi zaa ka di be kasi, ka gbibi yi niŋgbuna zaŋ tabili yi suhuri ni yi shihi zaa ka di mali yaa ka ti ku mali taali hal baabiɛla ti Duuma Yisa Masia labbuna dali.
en: May the God who gives us peace make you holy in every way and keep your whole being—spirit, soul, and body—free from every fault at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Ka Balaam daa kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi nya Izraɛlnim daŋ kam niriba ni ti bɛ suɣa doya gbilligbilli. Di saha ka Naawuni Shia daa siɣ o zuɣu na.
en: and saw the tribes of Israel camped below. Just then, God's Spirit took control of him.

dag: Yawɛ, deemi n wumpaɣibo pini ŋɔ, ka wuhi ma a zaligunim la.
en: Please, LORD, accept my spontaneous gifts of praise. Teach me your rules!.

dag: N yurilim zaŋ chaŋ yi zaa ha polo kul zoorimi pahira Yisa Masia zuɣu. Ami!.
en: I love everyone who belongs to Christ Jesus.

dag: Dindali maa tikpiranim ni ti wum bɛ ni karindi litaafi puuni yɛri shɛm, ka zoomba bɛn be zibisim ni ti neei bɛ nina lihi nya.
en: The deaf will be able to hear whatever is read to them; the blind will be freed from a life of darkness.

dag: Ka ŋun pa yɛdaniŋda yi bɔri ni o woligi ka chɛ ŋun nyɛ yɛdaniŋda, ŋun niŋmi lala, dimbɔŋɔ puuni doo bee paɣa ŋun nyɛla yɛdaniŋda mali soli ni o niŋ o ni yu shɛm. Dama Naawuni bɔri ni ti malila suhudoo.
en: But if a spouse who doesnt believe chooses to leave, then let them leave. The brother or sister isnt tied down in these circumstances. God has called you to peace.

dag: N daa zaŋ salima min anzinfa dih a paɣisarilim. Ka a mali tan viɛlli liiga mini tan nyɛlisirili chinchina ni bɛ ni wuɣi chinchin shɛli. A bindirigu daa nyɛla zim viɛla mini shiri ni kpam, ka a daa niŋ viɛlim pam, ka simdi ni a niŋ napaɣa.
en: Your jewelry was gold and silver, and your clothes were made of only the finest material and embroidered linen. Your bread was baked from fine flour, and you ate honey and olive oil. You were as beautiful as a queen.

dag: Chɛ ka din ni bahi ba yoli kana nti bahi ba yoli libigi ba; ka chɛ ka bɛ ni bari tɔn shɛŋa la ŋmaligi gbahi ba, ka chɛ ka bɛ lu di ni bahi yoli!.
en: Surprise them with disaster! Trap them in their own nets and let them fall and rot in the pits they have dug.

dag: O ʒiɛman ni ka Judanim ni ti nya tiliginsim, ka Izraɛlnim mi be ni alaafee. O yuli ti yɛn boonila, Yawɛ n-nyɛ ti wuntia. .
en: During his lifetime, Judah will be saved and Israel will live in safety. And his name will be The LORD Is Our Righteousness.

dag: o nyɛla karimbaandana ŋun duh omaŋa, ka nyɛ ŋun ʒi shɛli. O lan nyɛla kɔribiɛrilana ŋun suhu kul yɛla bɔhigu chɔɣima mini yɛtɔɣ yoya tɔɣisibu zuɣu. Ka dimbɔŋɔ tahirila nyuli zabbu mini woligibu ni turi ni tab zilisibu.
en: Those people who disagree are proud of themselves, but they don't really know a thing. Their minds are sick, and they like to argue over words. They cause jealousy, disagreements, unkind words, evil suspicions.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa bɔh o, A shiri nyɛla Yɛhudianim Naa? Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, A ni yɛli shɛm maa n-nyɛ li.
en: Pilate asked Jesus, Are you the king of the Jews? Jesus answered, Yes, what you say is true.

dag: Ka Leeban daa yɛli Yaakubu, Kuɣ duli ŋɔ nyɛla shɛhira m min a sunsuuni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli di yuli Galiid.
en: Laban said to Jacob, This pile of rocks will be a reminder for both of us. That is why that place was named Galeed.

dag: Binshɛŋa din be ashilɔni nyɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ dini, amaa binshɛŋa din yi zahira nyɛla ti mini ti bihi dini sahakam ni di chɛ ka ti doli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa din be zaligu ŋɔ puuni.
en: There are some things that the Lord our God has kept secret; but he has revealed his Law, and we and our descendants are to obey it forever.

dag: Tinzunnim ni ti yiɣisi guui kaman tɔhinima n-kari doli ba la bee kaman piɛri bɛn ka gul la n-kuli bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbana ni mini bɛ niriba sani.
en: They will be like hunted gazelles, like sheep without a shepherd; all will turn to their own people and flee to their own lands.

dag: Ka o yi ti lan kana zaawuni ni o ti nyo firilanim maa, di simdi ka o lan tuɣili tulaale zim maa, ka di nyɛ tulaale zim shɛli bɛ ni yɛn tuɣindi sahakam Yawɛ tooni yi ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: He must do the same when he lights the lamps in the evening. This offering of incense is to continue without interruption for all time to come.

dag: Ka Musa mini Aduna ni Izraɛlnim zaa daa niŋ Lɛvinim maa kaman di ni wuhi shɛm. Izraɛlnim maa daa niŋ Lɛvinim maa mi kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa ni o niŋ shɛlikam zaa zaŋ chaŋ Lɛvinim maa polo la.
en: So Moses, Aaron, and all the people of Israel dedicated the Levites, as the Lord commanded Moses.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Zaŋm anzinfa mali kikah ayi.
en: The Lord said to Moses.

dag: ka sakuɣa lu n-sabigi ŋari di kɔsoya la.
en: The streams are choked with snow and ice.

dag: ka kul fo n-ʒiya saha shɛli ti Duuma ni chɛ ka di paag o maa.
en: He should sit alone and be silent when God lays it on him.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya Nyini karimbaandan ŋɔ, n yi n-zan a zuɣu. A biɛɣu neeya, n ni yɛn darig a tibili saha shɛli maa paaya.
en: Babylon, you are too proud, and I am against you, says the Lord GOD All-Powerful. I am against you, and the time has come for you to be punished.

dag: Ka Zara daa niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga ti Ibrahimma o ninkurilim ni, saha shɛli Naawuni ni daa pun yɛl o la.
en: and she became pregnant and bore a son to Abraham when he was old. The boy was born at the time God had said he would be born.

dag: Ka ŋunkam daa mali kuɣ viɛla zaŋ li ti niŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa daazichi ni be luɣ shɛli, ka Jɛhiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Gɛrishɔn zuliya nir la daa gul li.
en: Anyone who had precious stones donated them to the treasury of the LORDs temple under the care of Jehiel the Gershonite.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔsia daa bo o dahalali piɛbihi pola mini bubihi pola, ka bɛ zaa kalinli daa yiɣisi tuhi pihita ni naɣilahi tusaata n-zaŋ ba ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be nimaani ni bɛ mali Yaɣigari chuɣu sara.
en: On behalf of the laypeople, Josiah donated from his personal holdings thirty thousand lambs and young goats, and three thousand bulls, all for the Passover offerings.

dag: Amaa ka Pita yɛli, N Duuma, n ku tooi niŋ lala, dama n na ʒi n-di bin yoya ŋɔ tatabo bee n ni chihiri binshɛŋa.
en: But Peter said, Certainly not, Lord! I have never eaten anything ritually unclean or defiled.

dag: Hal o nini ni bi nya wuntaŋa, ka o mi ʒi shɛli maa, o so ŋun pun beni maa.
en: The baby never saw the sun and never knew anything. But the baby finds more rest than the man who never enjoyed what God gave him.

dag: ka o daa pun lo ni o ni zaŋ ti tah omaŋmaŋ sani n-chɛ ka ti leeg o bihi Yisa Masia zuɣu; o ni daa lo shɛm min o yubu ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bala.
en: And before the world was made, God decided to make us his own children through Jesus Christ. This was what God wanted, and it pleased him to do it.

dag: Bɛ daa piripirila taba, ka zuliya ŋɔ tuhiri zuliya ŋɔ, ka tiŋ ŋɔ nim mi tuhiri tiŋ ŋɔ nima, dama Naawuni n-daa chɛ ka suhugarigu balibu kam ŋɔ paai ba.
en: One nation would destroy another nation and one city would destroy another city. This was happening because God gave them all kinds of trouble.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka anabinim shɛb daa ti yɛli Ilaisha, Nyama, luɣ shɛli ti ni be ka a wuhiri ti ŋɔ pɔri pam.
en: One day the prophets said to Elisha, The place where we meet with you is too small.

dag: Kpihimmi alahichinim birili dunia ni, ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri ku lan beni. M paɣiri Yawɛ n suhu ni! Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: Let sinners be wiped clean from the earth; let the wicked be no more. But let my whole being bless the LORD! Praise the LORD!.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Ijiptinim maa niŋ ba nirilim. Musa daa nyɛla ninvuɣ titali Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni ni Firawuna min o kpamba ni o niriba sani.
en: The Lord caused the Egyptians to be kind to the Israelites. The Egyptians, even Pharaohs own officials, already considered Moses to be a great man.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun va naɣisaa maa tampiligim maa, o paɣim o binyɛra ka leei ŋun bi be nyam hal ni zaawuni. Ka dimbɔŋɔ kul ni nyɛ Izraɛlnim mini tinzunnim bɛn be bɛ sani zaligu sahakam.
en: The man who collected the cows ashes must wash his clothes. He will be unclean until evening. This rule will continue forever. This rule is for the citizens of Israel and for the foreigners living with you.

dag: Ti ni daa tum alahichi shɛli Pɛɔr ka alɔbo lu ti zuɣu, ka ti na kul diri di wahala la bi galisi nyaŋ ti?.
en: Wasnt the offense of Peor enough for us? Even today we still havent cleansed ourselves from that sin, when there was a plague on the LORDs community!.

dag: ka din pahi pisiniyini gbaai Jachin, ka din pahi pisinaayi gbaai Gamul.
en: The twenty-first was Jakins group. The twenty-second was Gamuls group.

dag: N ni bɔhi ba biɛri pam, ka darigi bɛ tibili ni suhuyiɣisili fiɛbiga. N yi bɔhi ba biɛri, di saha bɛ ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. .
en: I will punish them—I will get even. I will let my anger teach them a lesson. Then they will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Ka Ɛliakim daa nyɛ Milia bia, ka Milia nyɛ Mɛna bia, ka Mɛna nyɛ Matata bia, ka Matata nyɛ Neetan bia, ka Neetan mi nyɛ Naa Dauda bia.
en: Eliakim was the son of Melea. Melea was the son of Menna. Menna was the son of Mattatha. Mattatha was the son of Nathan. Nathan was the son of David.

dag: Ka Sisɛra ma daa vɔbisiri lihiri takɔro ni. O daa kul vɔbisiri lihirila takɔro maa voya ni ka bɔhira, Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka o chɛchɛbuŋ maa ti yuui kundina lala? Bee bɔ n-lee chɛ ka di yuui ka ti kul bi wumd o yuri napɔn chinchiba damli.
en: Through the window she watched, Siseras mother looked longingly through the lattice. Why is his chariot taking so long to come? Why are the hoofbeats of his chariot horses delayed.

dag: ka Malikija nyɛ Ɛtini bia, ka Ɛtini nyɛ Zɛra bia, ka Zɛra nyɛ Adaya bia.
en: Ethni, Zerah, Adaiah.

dag: A chɛ ka niriba ŋmanila teeku ni zahim, ka ŋmani biŋgbamda bɛn ka naa.
en: You made humans like the fish of the sea, like creeping things with no one to rule over them.

dag: N nyɛla bɛn mali suhudoo ka ʒe yim Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni yino. Ka yi ti bɔri ni yi wurim tin shɛli din nyɛ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni tinsi ma? Bɔzuɣu ka a bɔri ni a saɣim Yawɛ ni su binshɛli.
en: We are Israelites, and we want peace! You can trust us. Why are you trying to destroy a town that's like a mother in Israel? Why do you want to wipe out the Lord 's people.

dag: Nyini n-daa ti ma pal yɛlinli ka n yaari n naba chana, ka n naba daa bi sarigi.
en: Youve let me walk fast and safe, without even twisting an ankle.

dag: Di simdi ni tiŋgbani dam dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu, ka ŋunkam be di ni fabili. Di simdi ni di kpuɣi du zuɣusaa kaman Nail Mɔɣili la n-lalilali gili nti lab ti fim; ka lan kpuɣi zuɣusaa n-lab lu tiŋa kaman Ijipti mɔɣili la.
en: There will be an earthquake that will shake the whole land because of what they did. Everyone living there will cry for those who died. The land will be tossed around. The whole land will rise and fall like the Nile River in Egypt.

dag: O daa daŋ tɔɣisirila Ijipti yɛla zaŋ chaŋ Ijipti Naa Nɛko tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli Karikɛmish, ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa nyaŋ ba Juda naa Jɔsia bia Naa Jɛhoyakim nam dibu yuma anahi ni la.
en: In the fourth year that Jehoiakim was king of Judah, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia defeated King Neco of Egypt in a battle at the city of Carchemish near the Euphrates River. And here is what the Lord told me to say about the Egyptian army:.

dag: Yinim Chɛrɛti zuliya bɛn be teeku noli ŋɔ, mbusim be yi zuɣu. Yawɛ yɛligu nyɛla din jɛndi nyini Keenan din nyɛ Filistianim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ; n ni saɣim a zaa hal ka so ti ku lan kpalim be a ni.
en: You Cretans living by the sea, this message from the Lord is about you. Canaan, land of the Philistines, you will be destroyed—no one will live there!.

dag: Daanya kɔniŋdi bini maa yaɣimɛri mii barilim daa nyɛla sɛntimita ayopɔin ni pirigili, ka di noli daa be kaman pipia nol la, ka be kaman paɣiviɛligakushihikom pum la. Di daa deerila kom lita tuhi pihiyɔbu.
en: The Sea was as thick as the width of a hand. Its rim was shaped like a cup or an open lily blossom. It could hold three thousand baths.

dag: Amaa ka maligumaana Azaria daa zaŋ Yawɛ maligumaaniba pihinii bɛn mali suhukpeeni m-pa omaŋ zuɣu, ka bɛ doli Naa Uzia kpe.
en: Azariah the priest and brave priests who served the Lord followed Uzziah into the Temple.

dag: N naɣ mali yɛm yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisirila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ba n-zani, amaa di pala ʒiɛmani ŋɔ yɛm bee ʒiɛmani ŋɔ zuɣulaannim bɛn ni ti vuui ŋɔ yɛm.
en: We do use wisdom when speaking to people who are mature in their faith. But it isn't the wisdom of this world or of its rulers, who will soon disappear.

dag: Bɛ ni zaɣisi ni bɛ ku labi n sanna maa zuɣu, bɛ ni labi Ijipti, ka Asiria naa ti leei bɛ naa.
en: They refuse to return to me, and so they must return to Egypt, and Assyria will rule them.

dag: O daa chɛ ka poloya waɣi pam bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-kpe m-pali bɛ nanim dugbɛra ni.
en: God made their land swarm with frogs— even in the bedrooms of their king!.

dag: Fɔŋ kara din daa nyɛ Bɛnjamin daŋ niriba tinsi n-nyɛ: Jɛriko mini Bɛtihɔgila ni Ɛmɛkɛziiz.
en: One region of Benjamin's tribal land had twelve towns with their surrounding villages. Those towns were Jericho, Beth-Hoglah, Emek-Keziz, Beth-Arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel, Avvim, Parah, Ophrah, Chephar-Ammoni, Ophni, and Geba.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti kum niŋ Yawɛ, amaa ka o ku garigi ba; di saha maa, o ni ti lɛb o nyaaŋa biri ba bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛri zuɣu.
en: Someday you will beg the Lord to help you, but he will turn away because of your sins.

dag: Ka Ilaiud daa nyɛ Ɛliɛza ba, ka Ɛliɛza nyɛ Matan ba, ka Matan mi nyɛ Yaakubu so ba.
en: Eliud was the father of Eleazar. Eleazar was the father of Matthan. Matthan was the father of Jacob.

dag: O daa bi baŋ ni mani n-tir o kawana mini wain ni kpam ni anzinfa ni salin shɛli bɛ ni mali jɛmdi Baal la.
en: She didn't know that her grain, wine, and olive oil were gifts from me, as were the gold and silver she used in worshiping Baal.

dag: Ti Duuma Naawuni daa bi boli ti ni ti ti tumdila niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma, amaa o daa boli ti ni ti ti dolila kasitali biɛhigu soli.
en: God did not call us to live in immorality, but in holiness.

dag: M mabihi, n suhiri ya, di tumiya tuumbiɛɣu ŋɔ.
en: He said to the men, No, my friends, I beg you, please dont do this evil thing!.

dag: Mushi bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Mahili mini Ɛda ni Jɛrimɔt. Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-daa nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya maa n-doli bɛ yaannim dunoya ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: Mushi had three sons: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth. These are the families of the Levites.

dag: Bɔhim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni niriba maa mini maligumaaniba maa, Yi ni daa lɔri noli, ka fabindi gol so ŋun pah anu ni mini gol so ŋun pah ayopɔin ni zaŋ ti paai yuun pisopɔin la, mani ka yi daa niŋdi lala tiri maa?.
en: Say to all the lands people and to the priests: When you fasted and lamented in the fifth month and the seventh month for these past seventy years, did you fast for me?.

dag: Ka o dɔbilim maa yi shihi situra kam mini biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ kam, bɛn paɣimi li, ka di ni nyɛ din be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: Any clothing or skin on which there is an emission of semen must be washed in water and will be unclean until evening.

dag: O daa yi Pita zuɣu, ka daa ti yi o nyaandoliba pinaayi la gba zuɣu.
en: Christ appeared to Peter, then to the twelve.

dag: Di ti ku be kaman yinim putɔɣunim ti chaŋ ti liri ŋun ka taali o yiŋa n-ku o o gom shee pa o bindoo zuɣu, ka n ku bɔhi ya o ʒim yihibu maa biɛri ka kun ya dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: What do you think Ill do when evil people kill a righteous person in his own house on his own bed? Why shouldnt I demand his blood from your hands and rid the earth of you both.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Mara n-chaŋ Ɛlim. Kɔbilisi pinaayi mini abie tihi pisopɔin n-daa be Ɛlim maa, ka bɛ daa dɔni nimaani.
en: From there they went to Elim, where they camped, because there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees there.

dag: Amaa yinima nina mal alibarika, dama di nyara; ka yi tiba gba mal alibarika, dama di wumda.
en: As for you, how fortunate you are! Your eyes see and your ears hear.

dag: M mabihi, n kpamdi ya jaande ni yi kpahimmi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tahiri naŋgbankpeeni mini woligibu din chihiri wuhibu shɛli yi ni daa pun dee la nol la. Kaɣimiya ba!.
en: My friends, I beg you to watch out for anyone who causes trouble and divides the church by refusing to do what all of you were taught. Stay away from them!.

dag: Zɛbulɔn zuliya ni toondana n-nyɛ Parinak bia Ɛlizafan.
en: from the tribe of Zebulun—Elizaphan son of Parnach;.

dag: Naawuni Shia Kasi ni daa tim ba maa bɛ daa chaŋla Sɛlusia nti yi ni kpe ŋariŋ chaŋ Saipurus teeku kom ni do n-gili tiŋgban shɛl la.
en: After Barnabas and Saul had been sent by the Holy Spirit, they went to Seleucia. From there they sailed to the island of Cyprus.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Kpahimiya yi nuhi, ka zaŋ yi naba tɔri tiŋa, ka yɛra: Mbaye! Izraɛlnim ni tum zaɣ biɛ shɛli din chihiri la zuɣu. Dama bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku bɛ shɛba, ka kum ti ku bɛ shɛba, ka alɔbo mi ti di bɛ shɛba.
en: The Lord God then said: Ezekiel, beat your fists together and stomp your feet in despair! Moan in sorrow, because the people of Israel have done disgusting things and now will be killed by enemy troops, or they will die from starvation and disease.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli din beni nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: Masia daa shiri neei kum ni, ka leei bɛn gbihiri kum ni la toondana.
en: But in fact Christ has been raised from the dead. Hes the first crop of the harvest of those who have died.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Lɛvinim zaŋ laɣiŋgu suɣili la be suɣa maa sunsuuni doli kaman bɛ ni daa ti bɛ suɣa maa zali shɛm, ka sokam ʒe o zaashee o tuuta gbini.
en: Then, between the first two divisions and the last two the Levites are to march carrying the Tent. Each division shall march in the same order as they camp, each in position under its banner.

dag: Yawɛ, m paɣir a; wuhim ma a zaligunima.
en: I praise you, O Lord ; teach me your ways.

dag: Ka wuntia tuma maa tahi suhudoo mini biɛri baalimtali ni naani niŋbu na sahakam.
en: and justice will produce lasting peace and security.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla naa kpambaliba kana ni bɛ ti puhi ti dan Naa Dauda ni o zuɣusuŋ ka yɛra, A Naawuni ŋɔ chɛ ka Sulemaana yuli du n-gar a yuli, ka chɛ ka o nam gar a nam. Ka Naa Dauda maŋmaŋ daa zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa o bindoo zuɣu;.
en: The royal attendants blessed our master King David: May your God make Solomons name better than your name. May God elevate his throne above your throne. The king then worshipped on his bed.

dag: Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni leei tiŋgbɔn shɛli din ka bukaata, ka Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ mi leei tiŋgbɔn shɛli din bahi yoli, bɛ ni daa liri Judanima n-ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni la zuɣu.
en: Egypt and Edom were cruel and brutal to Judah, without a reason. Now their countries will become a barren desert.

dag: ni Hɛshibɔn ni Jaza ni di zaa biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: Heshbon, and Jazer, with their pasture lands.

dag: ni Uri bia Gɛba ŋun daa be Giliad din nyɛ Amɔrinim naa Sihɔn mini Bashan naa Ogi tiŋgbɔŋ ni la. Ka zuɣulaan yino daa be Juda tiŋgban ni.
en: Geber son of Uri was in charge of Gilead, where King Sihon of the Amorites and King Og of Bashan had lived. And one officer was in charge of the territory of Judah.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Yɛlimiya ninvuɣ so ŋun tim ya n sani ŋɔ na.
en: she replied, This is what the LORD, Israels God, says: Tell this to the man who sent you to me.

dag: Ka Dauda mini Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa kuli Jɛrusalɛm din yuli daa lan nyɛ Jɛbusi la, dama nimaani ka Jɛbusinim daa be, bɛna n-daa nyɛ di tiŋbihi.
en: Jerusalem was called Jebus at the time, and David led Israel's army to attack the town.

dag: O ni daa na kul yɛri maa, ka so lan paana ti yɛli A bidibisi la min a bipuɣinsi la bela bɛ biɛlikpɛm la yiŋ diri bindira, ka nyuri wain.
en: While this messenger was speaking, another arrived and said: Your sons and your daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brothers house.

dag: Nir yi zani sana nyaaŋa ka o di samli, di tahirila yɛla na, amaa o yi zaɣisi lala niŋbu, o ni yi yɛla ni.
en: It's a dangerous thing to guarantee payment for someone's debts. Don't do it!.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ n dana, nyama, Adɔnija n-nyɛ naa, hal a ni kul bi mi di yɛla maa zaa yoli.
en: But now, look, Adonijah has become king, and my master the king doesnt know about it.

dag: Ka Kɛnan maa daa nyɛ Ɛnɔs bia, ka Ɛnɔs nyɛ Sɛt bia, ka Sɛt mi nyɛ Adam bia, ka Adam mi nyɛ Naawuni bia.
en: the son of Enosh, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.

dag: nti zaŋ ya chaŋ niriba maa tiŋgban nɛli ni, ka m mini ya gbɛri ti kpa taba, ka n kari ya saria.
en: I will march you out to the wilderness nations, and there I will judge you face-to-face.

dag: Ka Musa daa lan zaŋ tiŋgbani maa shɛli ti Manaasa zuliya pirigili la kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm ni bɛ su li.
en: This is the land Moses gave to half the tribe of Manasseh. Half of all the families in the tribe of Manasseh got this land:.

dag: Malimiya m biɛhigu shee mini di puuni nɛma ka di be kaman n ni yɛn wuh a ka yi mal li shɛm.
en: Make it and its furnishings exactly like the pattern I will show you.

dag: Maligumaana ni ti zaŋ biŋkpam maa nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu, amaa bimbihili maa din ni ti nyɛla Aduna min o bidibisi la dini.
en: The priest shall burn the fat on the altar, but the breast shall belong to the priests.

dag: Ka yɛli ba, Jɔn Baptaizira daa baptaiziri niriba la kom ni, amaa yinim ni deela Naawuni Shia Kasi baptaizibu daba ayi ŋɔ sunsuuni.
en: John baptized with water, but in only a few days you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.

dag: a mi di pɔ a zuɣu, dama a ku tooi chɛ ka di zabigu zaɣ yini lɛbigi zaɣ piɛlli bee zaɣ sabinli.
en: Do not even swear by your head, because you cannot make a single hair white or black.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, N yi yɛlila din bi tuhi, nyin wuhim di ni nyɛ shɛli; ka n yi yɛlila din tuhi, di chaŋ wula ka a ŋme ma.
en: Jesus answered him, If I have said anything wrong, tell everyone here what it was. But if I am right in what I have said, why do you hit me.

dag: bɛ ni ti mali bihim pam ka o ŋubiri waagasi; dama ŋunkam ti kpalim be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ni ti diri waagasi mini shiri.
en: they will give so much milk that he will have all he needs. Yes, the few survivors left in the land will have milk and honey to eat.

dag: Ka Nan bia Jɔshua mini Jɛfune bia Kalɛb bɛn daa pahi chaŋ ti puɣisi nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa la daa dari tɔhi bɛ binyɛra.
en: And Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh, two of the spies, tore their clothes in sorrow.

dag: Di saha maa ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa dii zaŋ Yisa tahi mɔɣu ni.
en: At once the Spirit made him go into the desert.

dag: Amaa ka Ammɔn naa maa daa zaɣisi ni o ku wum Jɛfita ni tim na ti yɛl o shɛm maa.
en: But the king of Ammon paid no attention to this message from Jephthah.

dag: Ka bɛ daa dii chaŋ ti zaŋ salima min anzinfa pipihi ni la shɛŋa bɛ ni daa kpuɣi Jɛrusalɛm Naawuni jɛmbu duu na maa, ka naa min o kpambaliba ni o paɣiba ni o mamanim ti mal li nyuri wain maa;.
en: So the gold equipment that had been carried out of the temple, Gods house in Jerusalem, was brought in; and the king, his princes, his consorts, and his secondary wives drank out of it.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa zɔri Yɛhudianim kpamba la zuɣu ka so daa bi saɣi tɔɣis o yɛla palɔni.
en: But no one talked about him openly, because they were afraid of the Jewish authorities.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa zali shɛm maa daa tiɣi naa mini niriba maa zaa nini.
en: Since the plan seemed good to the king and the entire congregation.

dag: Zaɣisimiya zaɣ biɛɣu ka yu zaɣ viɛlli, ka doliya din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli. Di pa shɛli yi yi niŋ lala, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ binnamda zaa Naawuni ŋɔ ni zo Yisifu zuliya bɛn kpalim la nambɔɣu.
en: Hate evil and love goodness. Bring justice back into the courts. Maybe then the Lord God All-Powerful will be kind to the survivors from Josephs family.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa tim tuumba ka bɛ yi Jɛriko chaŋ Ai din daa miri Bɛtavɛn, ka be Bɛtɛl wulimpuhili polo la. O daa yɛli ba mi, Chamiya ti puɣisi kaai tiŋ maa. Ka tuumba maa daa chaŋ ti kaai Ai;.
en: Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is near Beth-aven to the east of Bethel. He said to them, Go up. Scout out the land. So the men went up and scouted out Ai.

dag: M paɣiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n tampiŋ ŋɔ! O wuhi ma tɔbu tuhibu, o wuhi n nuhi tɔbu tuhibu.
en: Bless the LORD, my rock, who taught my hands how to fight, who taught my fingers how to do battle!.

dag: Chu shɛli din yuli booni Yaɣigari Chuɣu ka lan booni Bɔrɔbɔro din ka Dabindi Chuɣu la puhibu daa ti miri.
en: The time was near for the Festival of Unleavened Bread, which is called the Passover.

dag: Ka Nɛbukadnɛza daa zaŋ Naa Jɛhoyachin min o ma ni o paɣiba ni o kpambaliba ni bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni ninvuɣ zuɣuri n-yi Jɛrusalɛm kuli Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni nti leei daba.
en: Nebuchadnezzar exiled Jehoiachin to Babylon; he also exiled the queen mother, the kings wives, the officials, and the lands elite leaders from Jerusalem to Babylon.

dag: Gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin dahin yini dali ka bɛ daa piligi maani sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim tiri Yawɛ la. Amaa bɛ daa na bi sɔŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa tanzaa tampuɣili.
en: Although work on the temple itself had not yet begun, the people started offering sacrifices on the Lord 's altar on the first day of the seventh month of that year.

dag: Di saha ka Yisahaku daa boli Yaakubu na ti niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni ka yɛl o, Miri ka a kpuɣi Keenan paɣa.
en: Isaac called Jacob, greeted him, and told him, Don't marry a Canaanite.

dag: Shiina Naa Amirafɛl mini Ɛlasa Naa Ariok ni Ɛlam Naa Chɛdolaoma ni Goiim Naa Tidal.
en: Four kings, Amraphel of Babylonia, Arioch of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer of Elam, and Tidal of Goiim.

dag: Bɛ dɔbba bɛn daa nyɛ gol yini zaŋ chani zaa kalinli daa yiɣisila tusaayopɔin ni kɔbisinu.
en: The total number of males one month old or older that were enrolled was .

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Bɛ ni booni do so Yisa la n-gari taŋkpaɣu n-zaŋ ʒe n nina maa, ka yɛli ma ni n cham Sailom biaŋ la ni nti paɣi n nina maa. Ka n chaŋ ti paɣi, ka n nina maa dii neei.
en: He answered, The man they call Jesus made mud, smeared it on my eyes, and said, Go to the pool of Siloam and wash. So I went and washed, and then I could see.

dag: A yurilim maŋli la puuni, deemi n suhigu. Yawɛ, dolimi n nyɛvili kaman a ni lo ma alikauli shɛm.
en: Listen to my voice, according to your faithful love. LORD, make me live again, according to your justice.

dag: Ka bɛ daa paag o sani nti balim o pam yɛra, Sapashini maa simdi ni a sɔŋ o.
en: The men went to Jesus. They begged Jesus to help the officer. They said, This officer is worthy to have your help.

dag: Ka sapashin so dabiyurigu daa biɛra n-tarigi.
en: In this town an army officer's servant was sick and about to die. The officer liked his servant very much.

dag: Jɛhɔshafat yuma daa nyɛla yuun pihitanaanu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-ʒila Jɛrusalɛm. O daa niŋla o nam maa ni yuun pisinaanu. O ma daa nyɛla Shilihi bipuɣiŋga; ka o yuli booni Azuba.
en: at the age of thirty-five, and he ruled in Jerusalem for twenty-five years. His mother was Azubah, the daughter of Shilhi.

dag: Niriba yɛri a yurilim maŋli yɛla gballi ni? Bee a ʒiɛyimtali tumdi tuma saɣiŋgu shee?.
en: Are your love and loyalty announced in the world of the dead?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli naa, Nyama, Itiɔpia Naa Tirihaka lola tɔbu kanna ni o ti tuh a. Ka o daa sabi gbaŋ lan tim tuumba Hɛzɛkia sani n-yɛli ba.
en: About this same time the king of Assyria learned that King Tirhakah of Ethiopia was on his way to attack him. Then the king of Assyria sent some messengers with this note for Hezekiah:.

dag: Din yɛn ku Jɛrusalɛmnim maa yɛn yila nudirigu polo na, ka o ti me tɔbutuhiri bimbina din sirigi tiŋa. O ni ti moli ninvuɣ kubo molo, ka bu tɔbu zambu. O ni kɔri tɔbutuhiri bimbina duhiduhi dunɔdaya ni, ka me bimbina, ka me teei gili binwɔɣila.
en: On his right side appeared the omen for Jerusalem: to put battering rams in place, to proclaim war and raise the alarm, to place battering rams against the gates, and to set up siege ramps and build towers.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab daa chaŋ naa sani ti yɛl o, ka naa daa chɛ ka bɛ boli Absalom, ka o kana ti damdi naa tooni, ka naa daa mɔɣis o kpariŋ.
en: Then Joab came to the king and told him what Absalom said. The king called for Absalom. Absalom came to the king and bowed low on the ground before the king. The king kissed him.

dag: Di saha ka nabihi bɛn daa kpalim yina, ka Yawɛ niriba daa yina ni bɛ ti tuhi wɔɣira ti o.
en: Then the faithful ones came down to their leaders; the Lord 's people came to him ready to fight.

dag: maligumaana maa ŋun chɛ ka bɛ bo noombihi nɛma ayi bɛn ka daɣiri mini sida dari ni mi ʒee ni taaŋkɔro na.
en: the priest shall order that two ritually clean birds be brought, along with a piece of cedar wood, a red cord, and a sprig of hyssop.

dag: O ni daa vuui Amasa niŋgbuŋ solɔɣu maa zuɣu maa nyaaŋa ka niriba maa daa naanyi doli Jɔab n-lan gbaai Bikiri bia Shiiba la naba biɛhibu.
en: After this, no one else stopped. They all walked straight past him on their way to help Joab capture Sheba.

dag: O teem a pina zaa yɛla, ka chɛ ka o nini tiɣ a sar shɛŋa zaa a ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim.
en: May he remember your gifts and be pleased with what you bring.

dag: Yawɛ ni guli Ziɔn Zoli, amaa niriba ni no n-taai Mɔabnima kaman bɛ ni nɔri mɔri niŋdi kulim bɔɣili ni shɛm la.
en: The Lord s power is on this mountain, and Moab will be defeated. The Lord will trample the enemy like someone walking on straw in a pile of waste.

dag: O yoom ti suhuri zaŋ chaŋ o polo ka ti dol o soya, ka dol o zaligunim mini zaligu shɛŋa zaa o ni daa zali ti yaannim la.
en: May the Lord help us obey him and follow all the laws and teachings he gave our ancestors.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: The Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron in Egypt:.

dag: Dama ʒii maa saha na kparimi. Di yɛrila naabu saha yɛla, ka bi ŋmari ʒiri. Di yi ŋmanila di bi niŋdi yomyom, nyin kul guhim li. Biɛhiŋ kani, di ni niŋ, di ku yuui.
en: At the time I have decided, my words will come true. You can trust what I say about the future. It may take a long time, but keep on waiting— it will happen!.

dag: Farisiinim ni daa wum ka salo maa tɔɣisiri Yisa yɛla lala maa zuɣu ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Farisiinim daa tim Naawuni duu tuumba ni bɛ ti gbaag o na.
en: The Pharisees heard what the people were saying about Jesus. So the leading priests and the Pharisees sent some Temple police to arrest him.

dag: Nimaani ka o daa yihi nabi yino n-lo o alikauli, ka chɛ ka o po pɔri. Ka o daa zaŋ tiŋ maa ni ninvuɣ zuɣuri zaa chaŋ.
en: Then he took a prince from the royal line, made an agreement with him, and made him take a solemn pledge of loyalty. He also took away the lands officials.

dag: Ifriimnim ni daa nya bɛ dɔro maa, ka Judanim mi nya bɛ daŋ la, di saha ka Ifriimnim daa chaŋ Asiria natital la sani ti bo sɔŋsim. Amaa o ku tooi chɛ ka yi kpaŋ bee n-tibi yi daŋ maa.
en: When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah his wound, then Ephraim went to Assyria, and Ephraim sent for the great king. But he could not heal them; nor could he cure their wound.

dag: Sara maligu yini ŋɔ zuɣu ka Masia chɛ ka Naawuni ni mali shɛb ka bɛ be kasi la be dɛde hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: With one sacrifice Christ made his people perfect forever. They are the ones who are being made holy.

dag: A ni daa wum shɛli n sani shɛhiranim pam ninni la, zaŋm li tom wuhi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim ka nyɛ bɛn gba ni tooi zaŋ li wuhi bɛ tab la.
en: You have often heard me teach. Now I want you to tell these same things to followers who can be trusted to tell others.

dag: Ka dabili mi na ʒi n-kpalim be ŋun su o yiŋa sahakam, amaa yilibia ŋun kul ni beni sahakam.
en: A slave does not stay with a family forever. But a son belongs to the family forever.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Ilaija ŋun nyɛ Tishibi nir la.
en: The LORDs word came to Elijah from Tishbe.

dag: Ka Babilɔnnim maa daa kana ka o mini ba ti dɔni, ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ kɔre maa saɣim o, o ni daa saɣim omaŋ maa nyaaŋa, ka o daa yi bɛ sani chaŋ ni suhuyiɣisili.
en: Men from Babylonia came and had sex with her so many times that she got disgusted with them.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛliya, Namɔɣili so ŋun gbibi n vuhim dabisa, ka niŋdi din tiɣiri n nini, ka gbibi n daalikauli.
en: To them, I, the Lord , say: Respect the Sabbath, obey me completely, and keep our agreement.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, O be wula? Ka bɛ yɛl o, O mal alaafee; ka lan yɛli, O bipuɣiŋga Reechɛl n-taɣiri piɛri kanna ŋɔ.
en: He said to them, Is he well? They said, Hes fine. In fact, this is his daughter Rachel now, coming with the flock.

dag: Naawuni pin gahindi shɛl o ni daa ti ma o yiko puuni la zuɣu ka o daa zaŋ ma leei lahibal suŋ la tumtumda.
en: I was made a servant of the gospel by God's special gift, which he gave me through the working of his power.

dag: Hanania bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Pɛlatia mini Jɛshaya ni o bia Rɛfaya ni o bia Arinan ni o bia Obadia ni o bia Shɛkania.
en: Hananiah's descendants were Pelatiah, Jeshaiah, Rephaiah, Arnan, Obadiah, and Shecaniah.

dag: Ka di mundili din mali yaa daa leei nam jaaŋgbee, ka daa zooi zuɣusaa tibɔŋ ni, ka di daa niŋ wɔɣilim, ka mali wula pam.
en: Then she grew large branches. They were like a strong walking stick. They were like a kings scepter. The vine grew taller and taller. It had many branches and reached to the clouds.

dag: O daa lan zali sariakaritiba bɛ ni daa me goondahi gili Juda tiŋgban ni fɔntin shɛŋa la zaa yiniyini ni.
en: He assigned judges to each of the fortified cities in Judah.

dag: Naawuni, n suhir a, chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri kpi, ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri zo ka chɛ ma.
en: How I wish that you would kill all cruel and heartless people and protect me from them!.

dag: Dindali maa, n ni ti kpihim buɣa yuli tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka so ku lan teei di yɛla yaha. N ni ti lan vuui anab ʒirinim mini buɣijɛmbo tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: On that day, says the LORD of heavenly forces, I will eliminate the names of the idols from the land; they will no longer be remembered. Moreover, I will remove the prophets and the sinful spirit from the land.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ a ni yɛn zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa ti Izraɛlnima m-bɔŋɔ.
en: These are the case laws that you should set before them.

dag: ni Libina naa ni Adulam naa.
en: the king of Libnah, the king of Adullam.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa wum ni Shɛkɛm saɣim o bipuɣiŋga Daina, amaa ka o daa di suɣilo shini hal ka o bidibisi bɛn daa mali niɣi be mɔɣu ni la ti kuna.
en: Meanwhile, Jacob heard what had happened. But his sons were out in the fields with the cattle, so he did not do anything at the time.

dag: Niriba maa daa na kul bi niŋ tuuba Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋun darigi bɛ tibili maa sani bee ŋ-ŋmaligi lab o sanna.
en: The people did not stop sinning. They did not come to the Lord All-Powerful for help.

dag: Ka Rɛkab bia Malikija ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtihakɛrɛm yaɣili polo naa la daa mali me Saɣiri Dunɔdali maa, ka mali pununim kpɛhi li, ka niŋ dunokparita mini kurimulima niŋ li.
en: Malchiah, Rechabs son, ruler of the district of Beth-haccherem, repaired the Dung Gate. He rebuilt it and set up its doors, bolts, and bars.

dag: Ka n daa wum kukol shɛli damli alizanda ni, ka di vuri kaman kokpɛɣu bee saa ni yi tahiri shɛm la. N ni daa wum kukol shɛli maa daa ŋmanila mɔɣilo ŋmɛriba ni yi ŋmɛri bɛ mɔɣilɔnim ka di kumsi vuri shɛm la.
en: Then I heard a sound from heaven that was like a roaring flood or loud thunder or even like the music of harps.

dag: Paɣ so daa beni n-nyɛ anabi, ka o yuli booni Anna. O daa nyɛla Fanuɛl bia, ka nyɛ Asha zuliya ni nira. O daa kurigiya pam; o daa ʒini doo yil la yuma ayopɔin.
en: There was a very old prophet, a widow named Anna, daughter of Phanuel of the tribe of Asher. She had been married for only seven years and was now eighty-four years old. She never left the Temple; day and night she worshiped God, fasting and praying.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa na ti ti Musa, ka daa lan zaŋ suɣili maa mini di nɛma zaa ni di bansi ni di dapaɣa ni di dapuhi ni di daantalisi mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu.
en: Then they showed the Holy Tent and everything in it to Moses. They showed him the rings, the frames, the braces, the posts, and the bases.

dag: Dabisili din pah ayɔbu dali, Diuɛl bia Ɛliasaf ŋun daa nyɛ Gaad zuliya zuɣulan la n-daa mali sara.
en: On the sixth day Gads Chief Eliasaph, Deuels son.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi Musa yɛtɔɣa Sinai mɔɣu ni bɛ ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la nyaaŋa yuma ayi puuni gol so ŋun daŋ tooni la ni n-yɛli.
en: During the first month of Israel's second year in the Sinai Desert, the Lord had told Moses.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zaŋ li lee kali ni zaligu Izraɛlnim zaa sani, ka bɛ dol li hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: So from that day forward, David made that a regulation and a law in Israel, which remains in place even now.

dag: Pa Jɛhoyachin ŋɔ n-nyɛ bɛ ni lihi ʒiɛm duɣu ŋmaŋ shɛli, ni duɣ shɛli so ni je la? Bɔzuɣu ka bɛ zaŋ o min o bihi vil labi bɛ ni bi mi tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni?.
en: Is this man Coniah merely a defiled and broken pottery jar that no one wants? Why then have he and his children been hurled out and cast into an unfamiliar land?.

dag: Amaa niriba pam bɛn daŋ tooni ni ti leei nyaannima, ka bɛn be nyaaŋa mi ti leei toonnima.
en: But many who are first will be last. And many who are last will be first.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka zuɣusaa ŋari ka saa bi lan mira, ka binshɛɣukam kɔŋ niŋbu.
en: That is why there is no rain and nothing can grow.

dag: dindina n gba ni chɛn ya, ka mmaŋmaŋ ni ti ŋmɛn ya buyopɔin yi daalahichi zuɣu.
en: then I will continue to oppose you. I will strike you for your sins seven more times.

dag: Ka bɛ daa mali nti paai jɛmbu duu zuɣulan maa yiŋa, ka o nya ka salo be nimaani yarindi ka mɔhiri vuri, ka kumdi ka fabinda.
en: They went home with Jairus and saw the people crying and making a lot of noise.

dag: Ka Sool daa bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a mini Jɛsi bia ŋɔ gbiri ma zamba bɔɣa? Bɔzuɣu ka a daa ti o bindirigu ka ti o takɔbi ka lan bɔhi Naawuni n-nya o yɛla ti o ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o yiɣisi lu n zuɣu n-sɔɣi do n-gu ma kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Saul asked him, Why are you and David plotting against me? Why did you give him some food and a sword, and consult God for him? Now he has turned against me and is waiting for a chance to kill me.

dag: Di pa shɛli Yawɛ ni wum bɛ fabila, ka bɛ zaa chɛ bɛ tuumbiɛri soya maa. Dama Yawɛ je suli, ka o suhu yiɣisi pam bahi niriba ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Perhaps they will pray to the Lord and turn from their evil ways, because the Lord has threatened this people with his terrible anger and fury.

dag: N wum lahibali Yawɛ sani. O tim tumo zuliya kam sani ti yɛli ba, Laɣimmiya taba n kana ti lir o. Yiɣisimiya tuhi tɔbu.
en: I have sent a messenger to command the nations to prepare for war against you people of Edom.

dag: Ka Ɛhab ŋun daa nyɛ Omri bia la daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani n-gari na shɛb bɛn zaa daa daŋ o tooni la.
en: and did evil in the LORDs eyes, more than anyone who preceded him.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Ɛbɛl daa mali sara din so Keen dini, ka di daa tiɣi Naawuni nini, ka o deeg o pini maa ka lih o wuntizɔra. Ɛbɛl pun kpi, amaa o yɛda niŋbu puuni o na kul tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa.
en: It was faith that made Abel offer to God a better sacrifice than Cain's. Through his faith he won God's approval as a righteous man, because God himself approved of his gifts. By means of his faith Abel still speaks, even though he is dead.

dag: Wahala mini nandahima m-mali ma, amaa a zaligunima n-nyɛ n suhu ni yu shɛli.
en: Stress and strain have caught up with me, but your commandments are my joy!.

dag: Amaa a yi bi zaŋ amaŋ ti Babilɔn naa kpambaliba maa, dindina bɛ ni zaŋ tiŋ ŋɔ niŋ Babilɔnnim maa nuu ni, ka bɛ nyo li buɣim, ka a ku tooi zo n-yi bɛ nuu ni.
en: But if you do not surrender, then this city will be handed over to the Babylonians, who will burn it down, and you will not escape from them.

dag: Maliya suhukpeeni ka ti zabi ti niriba mini ti Naawuni tinsi ŋɔ zuɣu, ka chɛ ka ŋun Yawɛ niŋ o ni nya ka shɛli viɛl o sani.
en: Be strong, and let us fight bravely for our people and for the cities of our God. The Lord will do what he decides is right.

dag: Bɛ kpaai ma mi bahi kaman kom la, ka n kɔbituɣa zaa miligimiligi; ka n suhu be kaman kpam din nyɛligi la n nyɔɣu ni.
en: I have no more strength than a few drops of water. All my bones are out of joint; my heart is like melted wax.

dag: Ka n yi ti kana, ka yi pii yi ni ninvuɣ shɛba n-sab gbana ti ba, n ni chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ yi pini maa tahi Jɛrusalɛm.
en: After I come, I shall give letters of introduction to those you have approved, and send them to take your gift to Jerusalem.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb ni ti kpalim Jɛrusalɛm mini Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ loya ni o chɛ ka di niŋ lala.
en: There will be people in Jerusalem and on Mount Zion who will survive, because the Lord Almighty is determined to make this happen.

dag: dindina yi ni zɔri tɔb shɛli maa ni liri ya nimaani Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. Ka yi ni zɔri kum shɛl la ni doli ya kpe Ijipti, ka yi ti kpi nimaani.
en: then the war that you fear will overtake you, and the hunger you dread will follow you, and you will die there in Egypt.

dag: Ɛnɔsh ni daa ti paai yuun pihiwɛi saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Kɛnan.
en: When Enosh was years old, he became the father of Kenan.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-yɛn nyɛ n tiliginsim; dina n-nyɛ ni ninvuɣ biɛɣu ku paag o sanna.
en: And if he lets me live, it will be because I had the confidence to speak. No guilty person would dare meet God face to face.

dag: Ka alizin biɛri ni daa zo ka chɛ do so maa daa balim Yisa ni o chɛ ka o dol o chaŋ. Amaa ka Yisa daa bi saɣi ka yɛl o.
en: The man from whom the demons had gone begged to come along with Jesus as one of his disciples. Jesus sent him away, saying.

dag: Ti mini Yisa Masia ni laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yini zuɣu ka Naawuni daa neei ti min o kum ni ni ti min o laɣim ʒin o nam ʒiishee alizanda ni.
en: Yes, it is because we are a part of Christ Jesus that God raised us from death and seated us together with him in the heavenly places.

dag: Bɛ kul mɛrila buɣili Tɔfɛt din be Hinnom Vinvamli ni la jɛmbu shee ni bɛ zaŋdi bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi nyɔri buɣim, ka di pala n ni zali shɛli, ka mi pala din yi n tɛha ni na.
en: The people of Judah built the high places of Topheth in the Valley of Ben Hinnom where they killed their own sons and daughters and burned them as sacrifices. This is something I never commanded. Something like this never even entered my mind!.

dag: Bɛ daa suh o ka o ti ba kɔrinsi, ka ti ba bindir shɛli din yi zuɣusaa na pam.
en: They asked, and he sent quails; he gave them food from heaven to satisfy them.

dag: Bɛ daa lan mali biŋgolinsi pihinu niŋ pateesa shɛli din be tooni naŋgbambili, ka lan mali biŋgolinsi pihinu niŋ pateesa shɛli din bahindi nyaaŋa gba naŋgbambili.
en: Fifty loops were put along one of the wider sides of each panel.

dag: Ŋun be tibi n-lihiri nyari din be ninvuɣ biɛri yinsi; ŋuna n-chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri lura m-bahiri yoli.
en: God is good. He knows what the wicked are doing, and he will punish them.

dag: Jɛhɔshafat daa lan pii Lɛvinim mini maligumaaniba ni Izraɛl daŋ kam puuni kpɛma n-leei Jɛrusalɛm sariakaritiba ni bɛ kariti saria tiri Yawɛ, ka maani niriba yɛla. Bɛ daa ʒila Jɛrusalɛm.
en: In Jerusalem, Jehoshaphat chose some of the Levites, priests, and heads of the families of Israel to be judges. These men lived in Jerusalem and used the law of the Lord to settle problems among the people.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ be ti sani. Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ ti ni sɔɣiri so sani.
en: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zaŋ ya mi tahiri tiŋgbɔn viɛlli ni, tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali kulibɔna din kom zɔri mini kɔbil nina ni tiŋgbani puuni kom din puhiri yiri vinvama ni mini daboya ni na;.
en: The Lord your God is bringing you into a good land with streams that flow from springs in the valleys and hills.

dag: Ka o yi zaŋ o puu ti Yawɛ yi nɛma labisi ti yuuni puuni yi ni zal li da shɛli, di daa n-kul yɛn bala.
en: If you dedicate the land immediately after a Year of Restoration, the full price applies.

dag: Di saha ka Amɔri nanima anu bɛn daa nyɛ: Jɛrusalɛm naa mini Hiburɔn naa ni Jarimut naa ni Lakishi naa ni Ɛgilɔn naa daa laɣim bɛ tɔbbihi chaŋ ti liri Gibiɔnnima n-teei gili ba.
en: These five Amorite kings, the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish, and Eglon, joined forces, surrounded Gibeon, and attacked it.

dag: Naawuni Shia Kasi yihi yɛli ni ʒiɛmana din bahindi nyaaŋa puuni, ninvuɣ shɛb ni ti chɛ yɛda niŋbu soli dolibu ka wumdi tirila shi biɛri bɛn yɔhindi niriba la ka ni dolila alizin biɛri wuhibu.
en: The Spirit clearly says that in latter times some people will turn away from the faith. They will pay attention to spirits that deceive and to the teaching of demons.

dag: ni Jaala daŋ ni Darikɔn daŋ ni Gidɛl daŋ.
en: Jaalah, Darkon, Giddel.

dag: Yisa ni daa kul yɛli ba, Mani m-bɔŋɔ maa, ka bɛ tiŋsi lab nyaaŋa ti lu tiŋa.
en: When he said, I Am, they shrank back and fell to the ground.

dag: Ka Dauda daa ka Sool sanna nti pilig o tuma tumbu, ka Sool daa yu o pam, ka o zaŋ o leeg o tɔbutuhiri neenʒira.
en: So David went to Saul and stood in front of him. Saul loved David very much. David became the helper who carried Sauls weapons.

dag: Amaa a yi kpuɣ paɣa, a bi tum alahichi; ka paɣisarili gba yi kuli doo, o bi tum alahichi. Amaa bɛ lee ni di wahala dunia ŋɔ ni yɛla zuɣu. M mi bɔrimi ni n yihi ya wahala shɛli lala niriba ni diri maa ni.
en: But if you do marry, you havent sinned; and if someone who hasnt been married gets married, they havent sinned. But married people will have a hard time, and Im trying to spare you that.

dag: N yi daa niŋ kpibiga zaɣ biɛɣu, n ni mali nyaanzaaniba dunɔdali gbini zuɣu.
en: if I have lifted my hand against the orphans, when I saw that I had help in the city gate.

dag: N dabiɛm zɔbu puuni, n daa yɛliya ni so ku tooi niŋ so naani.
en: Yes, even when I was upset and said, There is no one I can trust.

dag: Ka Yisa daa do ŋariŋ maa nyol ni difiɛli zuɣu gbihira; ka bɛ neeg o m-bɔh o, Karimba, bɔ n-niŋ ka kom diri ti ka a baɣa kani.
en: Jesus was in the back of the boat with his head on a pillow, and he was asleep. His disciples woke him and said, Teacher, don't you care that we're about to drown.

dag: Ti ni daa be Tabɛra mini Masa ni Kiburɔtihataava la gba, yi daa lan chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisimi.
en: Also at Taberah, again at Massah, and then again at Kibroth-hattaavah, you have been the kind of people who make the LORD angry.

dag: Jɛra n-tɛhi ni bɛmaŋmaŋ soli n-tuhi, amaa yɛnnim bɛn gbilisirila tibili wumda.
en: Fools see their own way as right, but the wise listen to advice.

dag: Yi tiŋ daa lumi dahim leei dabari, amaa di pɔri pam pumpɔŋɔ, ka bɛn kanna ni bɛ ti be di ni ni muɣi li. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa wurim li maa ni zo n-chaŋ katiŋ ka chɛn ya.
en: You are destroyed and defeated now. Your land is useless. But after a short time, you will have many people in your land. And those who destroyed you will be far, far away.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa tizɔbihi min o ma daa kana nti ʒe samban ni ka tim ni bɛ ti boli Yisa na.
en: Jesus' mother and brothers came and stood outside. Then they sent someone with a message for him to come out to them.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa daa yɛli Naa Jɛhɔshafat, Man ni ye binyar shɛŋa taɣi m biɛhigu chaŋ ti kpe tɔb maa ni, amaa nyin yɛm a nam binyɛra. Ka Izraɛl naa maa daa shiri ye binyara n-taɣ o biɛhigu chaŋ ti kpe tɔb gɔɣu maa ni.
en: Israels king said to Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself when we go into battle, but you should wear your royal attire. When Israels king had disguised himself, they entered the battle.

dag: Amaa bɛ yi ku tooi gbib bɛmaŋa, bɛn kpuɣimi paɣiba, ka paɣiba la mi kuli dɔbba, dama bɛ yi niŋ lala di so ni bɛ kɔre diri ba bɛ niŋgbuna ni kaman buɣim la.
en: But if you cannot restrain your desires, go ahead and marry—it is better to marry than to burn with passion.

dag: N yuya ni Naawuni noli di ma ka m mini Masia woligi tab gba mmaŋmaŋ zuliya bɛn nyɛ m mabihi la zuɣu.
en: for my own people. They are my brothers and sisters, my earthly family. I wish I could help them. I would even have a curse on me and cut myself off from Christ if that would help them.

dag: Amaa di nyɛla nyini ŋun nyɛ n kpee ni m mini ŋun doli ni n zo simo.
en: No. Its you, my equal, my close companion, my good friend!.

dag: Yi ni ti yɛn pirigi tiŋgbani maa ti Izraɛl zuliya maa shɛm m-bala.
en: Divide this land among your tribes;.

dag: O daa niŋ Asiria ninvuɣ gahinda zaa nirilim, ka saɣim omaŋa o ni niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb kɔre maa buɣa jɛmbu ni.
en: She had sex with all the important Assyrian officials and even worshiped their disgusting idols.

dag: Yi puhiri dabisa mini goya ni saha ni yuma churi!.
en: You pay special attention to certain days, months, seasons, and years.

dag: Amaa nyini Bɛtilihɛm din be Ɛfirata, ka nyɛ tin shɛli din pɔri Juda tinsi puuni ŋɔ, a ni ka n ninvuɣ so ŋun ni su Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni ti yina. O piligu yila kurimbuni na.
en: Bethlehem Ephrath, you are one of the smallest towns in the nation of Judah. But the Lord will choose one of your people to rule the nation— someone whose family goes back to ancient times.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yi ti zaŋ ya tahi yi ni kpɛri tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni ni yi ti ʒini maa, yin zaŋmiya alibarika ŋɔ ti tam Gɛrizim Zoli zuɣu, ka zaŋya noli dibu ŋɔ mi ti tam Ɛbal Zoli zuɣu.
en: When the Lord brings you into the land that you are going to occupy, you are to proclaim the blessing from Mount Gerizim and the curse from Mount Ebal. .

dag: Ka o daa tirisi tooni biɛla ha nti teei dɔn o pul zuɣu suhiri Naawuni ni di yi ni nani, saha ŋɔ din miligim o zuɣu.
en: He went a little farther on, threw himself on the ground, and prayed that, if possible, he might not have to go through that time of suffering.

dag: A bahiri ʒiŋmariba yoli, nyin Yawɛ je ninvuɣ kuriba mini ninvuɣ yɔhindiba.
en: you destroy liars. The LORD despises people who are violent and dishonest.

dag: Yisa n-nyɛ ŋun kpihim ninsalinim daalahichi ka mali ba ka bɛ be kasi, ka o min o ni mali shɛb ka bɛ be kasi maa zaa laɣim mali Ba yino. Dina n-chɛ ka vi bi mal o ni o bol ba o mabihi.
en: Jesus, the one who makes people holy, and those who are made holy are from the same family. So he is not ashamed to call them his brothers and sisters.

dag: Dama yi yɛliya, Tiŋgbana ayi ŋɔ mini di fɔntinsi ayi ŋɔ nyɛla ti dini, ka ti ni deei li su, hal Yawɛ ni kul be di ni maa zaa yoli.
en: You said that the two nations, Judah and Israel, together with their lands, belonged to you and that you would possess them, even though I, the Lord , was their God.

dag: Sulemaana daa piila zuɣulaannim pinaayi ni bɛ su Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ zaa. Bɛ tuma daa nyɛla bɛ bɔri bindira na nti tiri ŋun naa min o yiŋnima, bɛ zaa yinoyino daa yi sula bindira maa bɔbu goli yiniyini yuuni kam puuni.
en: Solomon appointed twelve men as district governors in Israel. They were to provide food from their districts for the king and his household, each man being responsible for one month out of the year.

dag: Naawuni, a soli nyɛla din be kasi; wun ŋuni n-lee galisi paai ti Naawuni ŋɔ?.
en: God, all that you do is holy. No god is as great as you are.

dag: ni Sibɛkai ŋun daa nyɛ Husha nir la ni Ilai ŋun daa nyɛ Aho nir la.
en: Sibbecai the Hushathite; Ilai from Ahoah;.

dag: Dindali maa ka Sool daa tim ninvuɣ shɛba ni bɛ chaŋ ti gu Dauda o yiŋa, o daa lomi ni o ku o asiba. Amaa ka Dauda paɣa Mikal daa yɛl o, A yi bi tilig a nyɛvili yuŋ ŋɔ, biɛɣuni bɛ sa ni ku a.
en: Saul sent men to watch Davids house. They stayed there all night. They were waiting to kill David in the morning, but Davids wife Michal warned him. She said, You must run away tonight and save your life. If you dont, you will be killed tomorrow.

dag: dama sokam tum alahichi ka kɔŋ soli din ni chɛ ka bɛ paai Naawuni sani.
en: All have sinned and are not good enough to share Gods divine greatness.

dag: ka pii mah shɛŋa din ka dabindi la zaɣ yini mini bɔrɔbɔro din mali kpam zaɣ yini ni karikaasi zaɣ yini piɛ shɛli din ʒe Yawɛ tooni la puuni n-zaŋ li pa biŋkpam la mini nudirigu biŋgbalipuɣili la zuɣu.
en: A basket of unleavened bread is put before the Lord each day. Moses took one of those loaves of bread, one loaf of bread mixed with oil, and one unleavened wafer. He put these pieces of bread on the fat and on the right thigh of the ram.

dag: Ʒiɛman shɛŋa din gari la ni, o daa chɛ ka zuliya kam doli bɛ suhu yubu.
en: In the past he allowed all people to go their own way.

dag: Judanim mini Izraɛlnim daa galisimi kaman teeku duli bihigu la, ka bɛ daa diri ka nyuri ka mali suhupiɛlli.
en: In Judah and Israel there were as many people as sand on the seashore. The people were happy and had plenty to eat and drink.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa ti laɣim Mizipa m-po pɔri yɛli, Ti ni so ku zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga ti Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba ni doo.
en: The Israelites had made a pledge at Mizpah, declaring, None of us will allow his daughter to marry a Benjaminite.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbaag o yiŋbia maa fiɛb o, ka kar o ka o kuli ni nuzaŋa.
en: The tenants grabbed the slave, beat him, and sent him back without a thing.

dag: Zuɣu ni kpahibu ka a mali darigiri ninsalinim tibili bɛ daalahichi zuɣu, ka saɣindi bɛ ni yuri binshɛŋa zaa kaman binneembihi n-nyɛ li la. Yɛlimaŋli, ninsal biɛhigu shiri ŋmanila vuhim.
en: You punish our sins by your rebukes, and like a moth you destroy what we love. Indeed we are no more than a puff of wind!.

dag: M mali tahima ti Duuma Yisa sani ni di ku yuui ka n tim Timoti yi sanna, ka di chɛ ka m baŋ yi yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm, ka di kpaŋsi n suhu.
en: With the blessing of the Lord Jesus, I hope I will be able to send Timothy to you soon. I will be glad to learn how you are.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛli Sool, Yawɛ n-daa tim ma na ka n ti booi kpam bah a zuɣu ni ka a leeg o niriba naa; dinzuɣu wummi ŋun Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Samuel said to Saul, The LORD sent me to anoint you king over his people Israel. Listen now to the LORDs words!.

dag: ka o chɛ ka bɛ bu Jɛrimia, ka ba o bandi ʒili Bɛnjamin dunɔdali din daa be zuɣusaa din be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu polo la.
en: and so he hit me. Then he had me arrested and put in chains at the Benjamin Gate in the Lord 's temple.

dag: Ka Zakaria yɛli malaika maa, N kurigiya, ka m paɣ gba kurigi pam. Ka wula ka n ni tooi niŋ yɛlli ŋɔ yɛda.
en: Zechariah said to the angel, How shall I know if this is so? I am an old man, and my wife is old also.

dag: Amaa ka man ti tuui, ka bɛn laɣimmi mali suhupiɛlli di zuɣu; ka lan laɣim lu n zuɣu. Ka ninvuɣ yoya pahi m-maani ma ansarisi ka bi chɛra.
en: I have stumbled, and worthless liars I don't even know surround me and sneer.

dag: O ni daa ti paai nimaani n-nya Naawuni daalibarika tuma, di daa niŋ o nyaɣisim pam, ka o kpam bɛ zaa jaande ni bɛ kul ʒe yim Naawuni sani, ka di birigi.
en: When Barnabas got there and saw how God had blessed them with undeserved grace, he was very glad. So he begged them to remain faithful to the Lord with all their hearts.

dag: Yi yi tuɣi ma ka n yɛligu be yi suhuri ni, ka yi suhi yi ni bɔri shɛlikam zaa, yi ni nya li.
en: If you remain in me and my words remain in you, ask for whatever you want and it will be done for you.

dag: Bundaannim mini faranim zaa malila bin yini, Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun nam bɛ zaa.
en: The rich and the poor are the same. The Lord made them all.

dag: N daa kuhi boli Yawɛ ŋun simdi paɣibu ŋɔ, ka tiligi n dimnim nuu ni.
en: I praise you, our Lord ! I prayed to you, and you rescued me from my enemies.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ti ma noli din ni tooi wuhi niriba ni di chɛ ka n tooi kpaŋsi bɛn gbarigi suhuri. O neeri ma la asiba kam, ka yoori n tiba ni n wum kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun deeri wuhibu.
en: The Lord God gives me the right words to encourage the weary. Each morning he awakens me eager to learn his teaching;.

dag: Di saha maa ka Gidiɔn daa baŋ ni Yawɛ malaika m-bala; ka kuhi yɛli, Mbaye! Yaa n Duuma NAAWUNI, dama n nini nya Yawɛ malaika.
en: Then Gideon realized that it had been the LORDs messenger. Gideon exclaimed, Oh no, LORD God! I have seen the LORDs messenger face-to-face.

dag: Yinima ŋ-ŋubiri n niriba ka shiri bɛ niŋgbuŋ gbana, ka ŋmari bɛ kɔba ka ŋmahiŋmahi ba kaman nimdi din be ʒɛduɣubil ni bee kaman nimdi din be ʒɛduɣutitali ni la.
en: who devour the flesh of my people, tear off their skin, break their bones in pieces, and spread them out as if in a pot, like meat in a kettle.

dag: Ti bɔri ni a vii sagbana ka siɣina. Ka zoya nya a, ka dabiɛm gbaai li ka di sɔhigi.
en: Rip the heavens apart! Come down, Lord ; make the mountains tremble.

dag: Ti mali suhukpeeni, ka paɣi ni ti yi ti niŋgbuŋ ŋɔ ni n-chaŋ ti be ti Duuma sani.
en: We are confident, and we would prefer to leave the body and to be at home with the Lord.

dag: O kɔŋko n-nyɛ n tampiŋ ni n tiliginsim ni m birini, ka so ku tooi nyaŋ ma.
en: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe and the fortress where I am secure.

dag: Ka n daa ti lan gariti a sani ka yul a n-nya ka a saɣi bɔbu, ka n daa zaŋ n chinchini pil a limsi a zaɣim maa, ka po pɔri lo a alikauli, ka a leei n ni su so. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: When I saw you again, you were old enough to have sex. So I covered your naked body with my own robe. Then I solemnly promised that you would belong to me and that I, the Lord God, would take care of you.

dag: O daa yɛliya, Yawɛ n-nyɛ n tampiŋ ni m birini ni ŋun fari ma bahira.
en: The Lord is my Rock, my fortress, my place of safety.

dag: Bɛna n-daa ka Filip so ŋun daa yi Bɛtisaida Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la sani ti yɛl o, N dana, ti bɔri ni ti nyala Yisa.
en: They went to Philip, who was from Bethsaida in Galilee. They said, Sir, we want to meet Jesus.

dag: Tarim ŋɔ daa kuhiya, ka Yawɛ wum, ka yih o o muɣisigu kam zaa ni.
en: This suffering person cried out: the LORD listened and saved him from every trouble.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sabi Yisifu niriba bɛn nyɛ bɛ ni booni shɛb Ifriim zuliya la yuya kaman bɛ daŋ ni bɛ malibu ni bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm, bɛn paai yuun pisi bee n-gar lala, ka nyɛ bɛn ni tooi chaŋ tɔbu ni.
en: The tribe of Ephraim was counted. The names of all the men who were years old or older and able to serve in the army were listed. They were listed with their families and family groups.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa dii tuhiri nintɔri viɛr o ninni, ka ŋmɛr o nutala, ka shɛb labir o tapaɣisi.
en: Then they spit in his face and hit him with their fists. Others slapped him.

dag: N zɔsimnim zaa zaŋ ma mi bahi, ka n ni daa yuri ninvuɣ shɛb la zaŋ ma bahi.
en: All my close friends hate me. Even my loved ones have turned against me.

dag: Ka o ŋmaligi yɛli, Ŋunkam suhu bi miligi n zuɣu mal alibarika.
en: Happy is anyone who doesnt stumble along the way because of me.

dag: Ka bɛ bihi pirigili daa tɔɣisirila Ashidɔdnim yɛtɔɣa ka ku tooi tɔɣisi Judanim yɛtɔɣa, amaa ka daa naɣ tɔɣisirila zuliya balibu pam yɛtɔɣa.
en: About half of their children could not speak Hebrew—they spoke only the language of Ashdod or some other foreign language.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ naa maa nambɔɣu, ka o ku samli maa zaa o min o sunsuuni, ka chɛ ka o chaŋ.
en: The master felt sorry for him. So he told the servant he did not have to pay. He let him go free.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa yɛri Naawuni mini Musa finafina, Bɔzuɣu ka yi yihi ti Ijipti na ni ti ti kpi mɔɣu ŋɔ ni? Dama bindirigu mini kom ka kpe, ka ti nyee nyɔni bindir chɔɣima ŋɔ.
en: The people spoke against God and Moses: Why did you bring us up from Egypt to kill us in the desert, where there is no food or water. And we detest this miserable bread.

dag: Nyamiya, n yɛn tumla tuun pala. Di niŋdi pumpɔŋɔ gba; yi bi nya li? N yɛn ŋmɛla soli sɔŋ mɔɣu ni, ka chɛ ka mɔɣa dɔni tiŋgban nɛl ni.
en: because I am doing something new! Now you will grow like a new plant. Surely you know this is true. I will even make a road in the desert, and rivers will flow through that dry land.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi be nyam yi bi mali bɛmaŋ niŋ nyam ta Yawɛ sara maligu shee daɣiri, bɛ ni bi niŋ ko shɛli din yihiri nir daɣiri ni mihi ba la zuɣu, bɛ nyɛla bɛn bi be nyam, ka di simdi ni bɛ yihi ba Naawuni niriba ni.
en: Those who have become ritually unclean and do not purify themselves remain unclean, because the water for purification has not been thrown over them. They defile the Lord 's Tent and will no longer be considered God's people.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ salima mali bans ayi niŋ di yaɣ ayi zuɣu salima din kɔɣili li gili la lɔŋni, ka lan mali bans ayi niŋ yaɣ din la gba ni bɛ zaŋdi dapuhi la turi di ni n-kpuɣiri bimbini maa.
en: He made two gold rings for the altar. He put the gold rings below the trim on each side of the altar. These gold rings held the poles for carrying the altar.

dag: N Naawuni, n Naawuni, bɔ n-niŋ ka a zaŋ ma bahi? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a be katiŋ ka chɛ ma sɔŋbu n ŋuhigu yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ saha.
en: My God, my God, why have you left me? You seem too far away to save me, too far to hear my cries for help!.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim maa daa chaŋ Bɛtɛl ti teei ʒini Naawuni tooni nimaani n-duhi bɛ yee kum pam ka fabili yɛli.
en: So now the people of Israel went to Bethel and sat there in the presence of God until evening. Loudly and bitterly they mourned:.

dag: Amaa nyini n-nyɛ ŋun be kasi, ka ʒi a nam ʒiishee, ka Izraɛlnim paɣir a.
en: But you are enthroned as the Holy One, the one whom Israel praises.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa daa yɛl o kpambaliba, Yi mi ni Ramɔtigiliad nyɛla ti ni su luɣ shɛli, ka ti kul shini ka bi deei li Siria Naa sani maa.
en: Ahab asked his officials, Why is it that we have not done anything to get back Ramoth in Gilead from the king of Syria? It belongs to us.

dag: Lee di taaya duŋ niŋ Yawɛ, ka di zɔriya tiŋgbɔŋ maa niriba dabiɛm, ti ni nyaŋ ba. Binshɛli din guli ba vuuya ka chɛ ba; ka Yawɛ mi be ti sani, di zɔriya dabiɛm.
en: So don't rebel. We have no reason to be afraid of the people who live there. The Lord is on our side, and they won't stand a chance against us!.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli naa, Di yi niŋ nyin naa nyaɣisim, nyin tim ma gbana ka n ti ti gomnanim bɛn be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli yaɣili polo la din ni chɛ ka bɛ ti ma soli ka n gari hal ti paai Juda.
en: I also said to him, If it pleases the king, may letters be given me addressed to the governors of the province Beyond the River to allow me to travel to Judah.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Samsin mabihi min o dɔɣiriba zaa daa chaŋ ti kpuɣ o ti sɔɣ o ba Manɔa siliga shɛli din daa be Zɔra mini Ɛshitaol sunsuuni la ni. O daa niŋ Izraɛlnim zuɣulan la yuun pisi.
en: His brothers and the rest of his family went to Gaza and took his body back home. They buried him in his father's tomb, which was located between Zorah and Eshtaol. Samson was a leader of Israel for years.

dag: Wula ka yi lee yɛn tooi yɛli, Ti mali yɛm, ka Yawɛ zaligunim be ti sani? Zaligubaŋdib ʒirinim zaŋ li leei ʒiri.
en: You say, We are wise because we have the teachings and laws of the Lord . But I say that your teachers have turned my words into lies!.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, n lo nia ni n niŋ alibarika niŋ Jɛrusalɛmnim mini Judanim ni, dinzuɣu di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira.
en: But now I am planning to bless the people of Jerusalem and Judah. So don't be afraid.

dag: A ni ti yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Tin shɛli puuni bɛ ni kuri niriba, ka maani buɣa n-ta bɛmaŋ daɣiri la saha paaya.
en: and tell them I am saying: Jerusalem, you have murdered many of your own people and have worshiped idols. You will soon be punished!.

dag: Zaŋmiya biŋgolinsi pihinu niŋ pateesa yini naŋgbambili, ka lan zaŋ biŋgolinsi pihinu niŋ pateesa shɛli din pahi ayi la gba naŋgbambili.
en: Put fifty loops on the edge of the last piece of one set, and fifty loops on the edge of the other set.

dag: Saamba bɛn be yi sani biɛhigu ni ti du pam gari ya, amaa ka yinim biɛhigu ti labi nyaaŋa pam.
en: Foreigners in your towns will become wealthy and powerful, while you become poor and powerless.

dag: Ka naa daa bɔh o So na be Sool daŋ ni ka n ni niŋ o nirilim kaman Naawuni ni bɔri shɛm? Ka Ziba daa yɛli naa, Jɔnatan bidibiga na beni, o mi nyɛla gbarigu.
en: The king asked, Is there anyone left from Sauls family that I could show Gods kindness to? Yes, Ziba said to the king, one of Jonathans sons, whose feet are crippled.

dag: A ni daa wum shɛli n sani shɛhiranim pam ninni la, zaŋm li tom wuhi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim ka nyɛ bɛn gba ni tooi zaŋ li wuhi bɛ tab la.
en: What you have heard me teach publicly you should teach to others. Share these teachings with people you can trust. Then they will be able to teach others these same things.

dag: O mali so palli din nyɛ nyɛvili soli din doli kpɛri chinchin tibisili la ni ti ti. Chinchin tibisili maa nyɛla o niŋgbuŋ ŋmahinli.
en: by a new way that leads to life! And this way takes us through the curtain that is Christ himself.

dag: N ni mali Naawuni ni daa lo ti yaannim alikauli shɛl la tahima zuɣu ka n ʒe kpe ŋɔ saria karibu shee pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: Now I am on trial because I hope for the promise that God made to our fathers.

dag: Amaa Dauda daa yi kul yirila Sool sani n-kun o ba sani Bɛtilihɛm ti gul o piɛri saha saha ka labira.
en: He took care of his father's sheep, and he went back and forth between Bethlehem and Saul's camp.

dag: Ka Jona garigi yɛli ba, N nyɛla Hiburu, ka jɛmdi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ alizanda Naawuni, ka nyɛ ŋun nam tiŋgbani mini teeku ŋɔ.
en: I am a Hebrew, Jonah answered. I worship the Lord , the God of heaven, who made land and sea.

dag: O lan yɛli luɣ shɛli yaha: A nyɛla maligumaana ŋun tuma ni be kaman Mɛlikizɛdɛk tuma la hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: as he also says in another place, You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek. .

dag: Ka bɛ ba Yaakubu yɛli ba, Yi chɛ ka n kɔŋ m bihi. Yisifu lan kani, ka Simiɔn gba kani, ka yi yɛn zaŋ Bɛnjamin mi chaŋ pumpɔŋɔ, n zuɣu ka yɛla ŋɔ zaa ʒini.
en: Jacob said to them, Do you want me to lose all of my children? Joseph is gone. Simeon is gone, and now you want to take Benjamin away too.

dag: Zaŋmiya tiliginsim kaman tɔbutuhir zuɣupila la pili, ka zaŋ Naawuni yɛligu din nyɛ Shia Kasi takɔb la gbibi.
en: And accept salvation as a helmet, and the word of God as the sword which the Spirit gives you.

dag: Ka Naftali zuliya maa niriba kalinli daa yiɣisi ninvuɣ tuhi pihinunaata ni kɔbisinahi.
en: The total number of men counted from the tribe of Naphtali was .

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Yi nyɛla n ni dihiri m piɛ shɛba, ka n nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: You are my sheep, the sheep of my grassland. You are only human beings, and I am your God. This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: Cham yaɣimɛra yiŋa ka n ti zaŋ n yɛtɔɣa tɔɣis a nimaani.
en: Go down to the potters house, and Ill give you instructions about what to do there.

dag: Hal bihi tuma ni ka niriba baŋdi bɛ ni nyɛ shɛba, bɛ tuma yi nyɛla din viɛl ka tuhi.
en: Even children show what they are like by the things they do. You can see if their actions are pure and right.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka niriba maa noya daa woli.
en: So the people did not agree with each other about Jesus.

dag: Ka Dan bidibiga daa nyɛ Hushim.
en: Dan and his son Hushim.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrimia daa boli Nɛria bia Baruk na nti yɛl o Yawɛ ni yɛl o yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa zaa, ka Baruk daa sabi li niŋ gbaŋ ni.
en: So Jeremiah sent for Baruch, Neriahs son. As Jeremiah dictated all the words that the LORD had spoken to him, Baruch wrote them in the scroll.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni bɛ nyɛla bɛn suhuri ni tɛha ka galimi, ka lan nyɛ bɛn gbib yɛlimaŋa din yi zahira ti wuhibu puuni la.
en: They must follow the true faith that God has now made known to us and always do what they know is right.

dag: bɛn daa nyɛ tɔbbihi bɛn ye binyɛr sabilifaa la ni. Bɛ shɛb daa nyɛla Gomnanima, ka shɛb nyɛ sapashinnima. Bɛ zaa daa nyɛla nachimbihi viɛla bɛn nyɛ wɔribariba.
en: She offered herself to soldiers in purple uniforms: handsome, high-ranking officers and cavalry troops.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa daa chaŋ Giligal, ka bɛ ti zaŋ Sool n-leei naa Yawɛ tooni Giligal ka mali suhudoo sara Yawɛ tooni nimaani. Ka Sool mini Izraɛlnim zaa suhuri daa paligi pam.
en: So they all went to Gilgal, and there at the holy place they proclaimed Saul king. They offered fellowship sacrifices, and Saul and all the people of Israel celebrated the event.

dag: Bɛ daa lan yɛli o tuun viɛla yɛla n-sani, ka daa zaŋ n yɛtɔɣa tɔɣis o. Ka Tɔbaya daa kul sabiri gbana tiri ma na ni o kpɛhi ma dabiɛm.
en: They also kept talking about his good deeds in my presence and then reported back to him what I said. In addition, Tobiah sent letters to intimidate me.

dag: Ka Manaasa zuliya mini Ifriim zuliya ni ti lu tab zuɣu. Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ ti laɣim lu Juda zuliya zuɣu. Amaa dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ku chɛ ka Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili maa zan tariga. O na kul loya ni o darigi bɛ tibili.
en: Manasseh devoured Ephraim and Ephraim Manasseh; together they turned against Judah. Even then Gods anger didnt turn away; Gods hand was still extended.

dag: O daa ti lan ku Ijipti do viɛl so gba. Ijipti doo maa daa gbibila kpani o nuu ni, amaa ka Bɛnaaya daa zaŋ jaaŋgbee chaŋ ti lir o n-fa kpani maa o nuu ni n-zaŋ omaŋmaŋ kpani maa ŋmaligi ku o.
en: He also killed an Egyptian, a huge man who was armed with a spear. Benaiah attacked him with his club, snatched the spear from the Egyptian's hand, and killed him with it.

dag: Izraɛlnima, yɛlimiya, M bilim ni ka bɛ pun nahindi ma pam;.
en: Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! Let everyone in Israel say:.

dag: Ka naa daa ti yɛli ba, Zaŋmiya yi dan kpambaliba m-pahi yimaŋ zuɣu n-chɛ ka m bia Sulemaana ba mmaŋmaŋ buntaaŋa la, ka yi zaŋ o chaŋ Gihɔn.
