en: who said to them, Take with you the servants of your masters. Put my son Solomon on my mule and bring him down to Gihon.

dag: Naa Hɛzɛkia tuumba maa ni daa paai Aizaia sani.
en: When King Hezekiahs servants got to Isaiah.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa dol o naɣikɔra yi puuni kunna ti wum kuhigu maa ka bɔhi, Ka bɔ n-niŋ niriba maa ka bɛ zaa ti kuhiri lala? Ka bɛ daa yɛl o Jabɛshinim ni ʒi lahiba shɛli maa na.
en: Saul had been out in the field with his oxen. When he came in from the field he heard the people crying and asked, Whats wrong with the people? Why are they crying? Then the people told Saul what the messengers from Jabesh said.

dag: Ka lan bɔhi ba, Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yi jiɣindi situra zuɣu? Yulimiya paɣiviɛligakushihikom ni zoori shɛm: Di bi tumda, di mi bi miri gumdi.
en: And why do you worry about clothes? Look at the wildflowers in the field. See how they grow. They dont work or make clothes for themselves.

dag: N Duuma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, di chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali tahima a sani di vi n zuɣu. Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, di chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmd a ŋɔ nya filiŋ n zuɣu.
en: Lord God All-Powerful, ruler of Israel, don't let me embarrass anyone who trusts and worships you.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun zaŋ o tɛha niŋ o ninsalitali biɛhigu yɛla ni nyɛla Naawuni dima, dama o bi doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu, hal ka shiri ku tooi dol li.
en: So the attitude that comes from selfishness is hostile to God. It doesnt submit to Gods Law, because it cant.

dag: A je ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi buɣa, amaa nyin Yawɛ ka man niŋ naani.
en: I hate the worshipers of worthless idols, but I trust you, Lord .

dag: Ka bɔzuɣu ka yi daa chaŋ? Nira ŋun bɔbi ka yi daa chaŋ ni yi ti nya? Nyamiya, bɛn bɔbiri bela nanim yinsi.
en: What did you go out to see? A man dressed up in fancy clothes? People who dress like that live in palaces!.

dag: Amaa ka Mikaya yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, ŋun Yawɛ ni yɛli ma shɛm, lala ka n yɛn yɛli.
en: But Micaiah answered, As surely as the Lord lives, I can say only what the Lord says.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa ha daa di li tiɣi, ka bɛ daa laɣisi bɔrɔbɔro chɛhi mini zimburisa din guui pal piɛr ayopɔin.
en: Everybody ate and had enough—there were about four thousand people. Then the disciples took up seven baskets full of pieces left over. Jesus sent the people away.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli m ba Dauda, A ni lo ni a me jɛmbu duu ti n yuli jilima maa, di viɛla.
en: But the Lord said to my father, David, it is good that you want to build a temple for my name.

dag: ka baŋ ni ŋuna n-yi nyɛ gbarigu n-ʒiini Naawuni jɛmbu duu duno shɛli din yuli booni Duno Viɛlli la shee maani bara la. Ka din daa niŋ o maa niŋ ba alahiziba ka gari ba pam.
en: They recognized him as the same one who used to sit at the temples Beautiful Gate asking for money. They were filled with amazement and surprise at what had happened to him.

dag: Ka n ti ka a sanna nimaani, chɛrubinim ayi bɛn be Alikauli Adaka yɔrigu maa zuɣu la sunsuuni nti tɔɣis a n ni yɛn zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa zaa ti a ka a ti Izraɛlnim maa yɛtɔɣa.
en: There I will meet with you. From there above the cover, from between the two winged heavenly creatures that are on top of the chest containing the covenant, I will deliver to you all that I command you concerning the Israelites.

dag: Ka ŋunkam nya ma, o nya ŋun tim ma na maa.
en: Everyone who sees me is really seeing the one who sent me.

dag: Di saha Yisahaku daa yila Bɛrilahairoi na nti be Nɛgɛb.
en: At that time Isaac was living in the southern part of Canaan near a place called The Well of the Living One Who Sees Me.

dag: Ka Musa daa wum o deemba yɛligu maa, ka niŋ o ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa zaa.
en: So Moses did what Jethro told him.

dag: Zaŋm Aduna min o bia Ɛliɛza du Hɔr Zoli zuɣu na;.
en: Moses, go with Aaron and his son Eleazar to the top of the mountain.

dag: Di zɔri dabiɛm, a ku di vi, di chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira, a ku nya filiŋ. A ni tam a bipalitali saha vi yɛla, ka tam saha shɛli a ni daa nyɛ pakoli ka nya filiŋ shɛl la yɛla.
en: Do not be afraid—you will not be disgraced again; you will not be humiliated. You will forget your unfaithfulness as a young wife, and your desperate loneliness as a widow.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka yi kanna ti zaani n tooni du shɛli din nyɛ n jɛmbu duu ŋɔ ni yɛra, Ti tiligiya. Ka lan yi n-chaŋ ti tumdi din chihirinim ŋɔ yaha.
en: and then come and stand before me in this temple that bears my name, and say, We are safe, only to keep on doing all these detestable things?.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A ni tɛhi ni a mali yɛm kaman wuni maa zuɣu.
en: So this is what the Lord GOD says: Tyre, you thought you were like a god.

dag: N yi bol o ka o saɣi, m bi niŋ yɛda ni o ni gbilisi tibili wum n yɛtɔɣa maa.
en: And if God came into court when I called him, he would not hear my case.

dag: Naa Sulemaana daa yuri tinzun paɣiba pam. O ni daa kpuɣi Ijipti Firawuna bipuɣiŋga la nyaaŋa, o daa lan kpuɣi Mɔab paɣiba mini Ammɔn paɣiba ni Hiti paɣiba ni Sidɔn paɣiba ni Ɛdom paɣiba.
en: Solomon loved many foreign women. Besides the daughter of the king of Egypt he married Hittite women and women from Moab, Ammon, Edom, and Sidon.

dag: Firilanim pam daa be jirambisa du shɛl ni ti ni daa laɣim maa.
en: In the upstairs room where we were meeting, there were a lot of lamps.

dag: Ka o daa to piɛma n-wurim ba bahi; ka chɛ ka saa nyaɣisi niŋ ba ka bɛ ŋmaligi guui.
en: He shot his arrows and scattered his enemies; with flashes of lightning he sent them running.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, A tizɔdoo maa ni neei kum ni yaha.
en: Jesus told her, Your brother will rise again.

dag: Ka Hamat din mini Hadirak di tintarisi la gba nyɛla o ni su shɛli zaŋ tabili Taai mini Sidɔn hal bɛ ni mali baŋsim la zaa yoli.
en: Hamath, which borders on Hadrach, also belongs to him, and so do the cities of Tyre and Sidon, with all their skill.

dag: Alizin biɛri daa yi nya o saha shɛlikam, bɛ lurila o tooni ka kuhiri yɛra, A nyɛla Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ Bia.
en: Whenever the evil spirits saw him, they fell down at his feet and shouted, You are Gods Son.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa nya Yawɛ ni tum tuun kar shɛŋa jɛndi Ijiptinim maa, ka Yawɛ yɛla daa gbahi ba dabiɛm, ka bɛ niŋ Yawɛ min o dabili Musa yɛda.
en: Because of the mighty power he had used against the Egyptians, the Israelites worshiped him and trusted him and his servant Moses.

dag: N-daa lan yi biɛɣu yaha ka Yisa yɛn chaŋ Galili; ka daa ti nya Filip yɛl o, Doli ma.
en: The next day Jesus decided to go to Galilee. He met Philip and said to him, Follow me.

dag: Ka alizin biɛri maa daa balim Yisa pam ni o di kari ba kpɛhi bahiyoli shee.
en: They begged Jesus not to send them to the deep pit, where they would be punished.

dag: Yawɛ, daadamnim lee nyɛla bɔ ka a baɣa ti be bɛ ni bee ninsalinim lee nyɛla bɔ ka a tɛhiri bɛ yɛla?.
en: What are human beings, LORD, that you know them at all? What are human beings that you even consider them?.

dag: Ka Taainim shɛb bɛn daa be tiŋ maa ni daa ʒi zahim mini nɛma balibu kam na ti kɔhi Judanim zuɣu ka kɔhi li Jɛrusalɛm puuni Vuhim Dabisili dali maa.
en: There were some men from the city of Tyre living in Jerusalem. They were bringing fish and all kinds of things into Jerusalem and selling them on the Sabbath day. And the Jews were buying them.

dag: Tihi nyɔŋ mini tiŋgbani din mal atam, Yawɛ ni ti saɣim li, o ni ti saɣim niŋgbuŋ min o shia, ka di ni be kaman dɔr biɛɣu ni saɣindi ninsal niŋgbuŋ shɛm la.
en: The Lord will make your beautiful forests and fertile fields slowly rot.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ dundɔŋ gili Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa mini sara maligu bimbini maa, ka zaŋ pateesa yili di dunoli. Lala ka Musa daa niŋ naai tuma maa.
en: Then Moses set up the curtains around the courtyard of the Holy Tent. He put the altar in the courtyard. Then he put the curtain at the entrance to the courtyard. So he finished all the work.

dag: Bi so ŋun mali yɛm tir o ba suhupiɛlli, amaa bi so ŋun nyɛ jɛrigu tirila o ma suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: Here are some proverbs of Solomon: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children make them sad.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔiada daa chɛ ka Naa Jɔash mini niriba lo Yawɛ alikauli ni bɛ ni nyɛla ŋun Yawɛ niriba; ka lan chɛ ka niriba maa mini naa gba lo tab alikauli.
en: Then Jehoiada made the agreement between the Lord and the king and the people. This agreement showed that the king and the people belonged to the Lord . Jehoiada also made the agreement between the king and the people.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa su nanim bɛn be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli mini Ijipti sunsuuni nanim zaa zaŋ tabili Filistia tiŋgbɔŋ.
en: He ruled all the kings from the Euphrates to the Philistines land and the border of Egypt.

dag: Ka o paɣ Jɛzibɛl bɔh o, Pa nyini n-nyɛ Izraɛl Naa? Yiɣisim di ni suhupiɛlli. N ni zaŋ Nabɔt ŋun nyɛ Jɛziriil nir maa wain tihi puu maa ti a.
en: Well, are you the king or aren't you? Jezebel replied. Get out of bed, cheer up, and eat. I will get you Naboth's vineyard.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o maani maligu tir o laŋ maa, ka zaŋdi pina tir o daasau maa, dama dina n-tir o azichi, ka chɛ ka o diri bindir viɛla.
en: that he offers sacrifices to his fishing nets, because they make him rich and provide choice foods.

dag: ka ŋun saɣisiri niriba, ŋun saɣisim ba; ka ŋun tɔhiri tɔto, ŋun tɔhimi ni o suhu zaa; ka ŋun ʒe fukumsi zaashee, ŋun tummi viɛnyɛliŋga; ka ŋun mi niŋdi nirilim, ŋun niŋmi li ni suhupiɛlli.
en: If your gift is encouragement, devote yourself to encouraging. The one giving should do it with no strings attached. The leader should lead with passion. The one showing mercy should be cheerful.

dag: o min o bidibis ayi la ʒili. Bɛ ni yino yuli n-daa booni Gɛrishom, dama o daa yɛlimi, N nyɛla sana m-be saan tiŋa.
en: along with her two sons. One was named Gershom because he said, I have been an immigrant living in a foreign land.

dag: ni Jɛbusinim ni Amɔrinim ni Gɛrigashinima.
en: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites.

dag: Amaa ka Ilaisha daa yɛl o, Wummi Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm. O yɛliya ni biɛɣuni ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha, bɛ sa ni kɔhi zim balli din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ata anzinfa laɣibaligu zaɣ yini, ka kɔhi chi kilɔgiram ayɔbu mi anzinfa laɣibaligu zaɣ yini Samaria ŋɔ dunɔdal ni.
en: Elisha said, Hear the LORDs word! This is what the LORD says: At this time tomorrow a seah of wheat flour will sell for a shekel at Samarias gate, and two seahs of barley will sell for a shekel.

dag: Ka do so ŋun yuli daa booni Ananias min o paɣ Safira bɛn daa zaŋ bɛ ni su shɛli kɔhi.
en: However, a man named Ananias, along with his wife Sapphira, sold a piece of property.

dag: Amaa bɛ nyina ni daa na gbab nimdi maa ka di na bi lu bɛ puuni saha shɛli, ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi niriba maa zuɣu, ka o chɛ ka alɔbo titali lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: But before the meat could be eaten, the Lord became angry and sent a deadly disease through the camp.

dag: O daa tahi tɔbbihi ti ʒili Ɛdom, ka Ɛdomnim zaa daa leei Dauda ni su shɛba. Dauda daa yi chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam zaa Yawɛ chɛ ka o dirila nasara.
en: He set up military camps throughout Edom, and the people there became King David's subjects. The Lord made David victorious everywhere.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa ti Shiiba naa ŋun nyɛ paɣ maa o ni daa suh o bɔri binshɛŋa zaa. O daa ti o pina ka di gari ŋun paɣ maa ni daa ʒi pin shɛŋa na ti ti ŋun naa, di nyaaŋa ka o min o niriba maa daa lab kuli bɛ ya.
en: King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba everything she wanted, even more than she had brought the king. Then she and her servants returned to her homeland.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa ŋmaligi yul o nyaandoliba maa ti tuui taba ka yɛli ba, Di to ni bundaannim kpe Naawuni nam ni.
en: Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, It's hard for rich people to get into God's kingdom.

dag: Daadamnim mini yɔnaɣila kara ni naɣila pola zaa ni ti lu n-doya. Bɛ ʒim ni ti zo n-tiɛli bɛ tiŋgbani, ka tiŋgbani maa nyu bɛ kpam tiɣi.
en: The people will fall like wild oxen and young bulls, and the earth will be red with blood and covered with fat.

dag: Ka Ɛliakim daa nyɛ Milia bia, ka Milia nyɛ Mɛna bia, ka Mɛna nyɛ Matata bia, ka Matata nyɛ Neetan bia, ka Neetan mi nyɛ Naa Dauda bia.
en: the son of Melea, the son of Menna, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David.

dag: Nyama, n ni pii n dab so m-bɔŋɔ; n ni yuri so ni n nini ni tiɣ so pam m-bala. N ni zaŋ n Shia niŋ o ni, ka o zaŋ yɛlimaŋli kari saria ti zuliya shɛb bɛn pa Yɛhudianima.
en: Look, my Servant whom I chose, the one I love, in whom I find great pleasure . Ill put my Spirit upon him, and hell announce judgment to the Gentiles.

dag: Naa Dauda ni daa wum yɛla ŋɔ zaa o suhu daa yiɣisiya pam.
en: King David heard the news and became very angry, but he did not want to say anything to upset Amnon, because he loved him since he was his firstborn son.

dag: A zaligunim maa nyɛla n fali sahakam. Dina n-tiri ma suhupiɛlli.
en: Your laws are my possession forever because they are my hearts joy.

dag: O daa kpihim binnɛma balibu kam bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni birili; ninsalinim zaŋ tabili biŋkɔbiri ni biŋgbamda ni noonsi zaa bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni. Kulla Nuhu mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be o sani ŋariŋ maa ni kɔŋko n-daa naɣ tiligi.
en: In this way God wiped the earth clean—he destroyed every living thing on the earth—every human, every animal, everything that crawls, and every bird. All that was left was Noah and his family and the animals that were with him in the boat.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sab bɛ ni yɛli ni Yisa tum taal shɛli maa tabil o dapulli maa zuɣusaa. Di ni daa sab shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yɛhudianim Naa.
en: On it was a sign that told why he was nailed there. It read, This is the King of the Jews.

dag: Naawuni, ti kul tɛhir a yurilim maŋli la yɛla a jɛmbu duu la puuni.
en: Inside your Temple, O God, we think of your constant love.

dag: Ti Duuma ni yihi Ziɔn paɣiba daɣiri ni, ka zaŋ saria karibu mini buɣim paɣi ʒim din yi n-do Jɛrusalɛm puuni la ka di yi.
en: after the Lord sends a fiery judgment to clean the city and its people of their violent deeds.

dag: Izraɛl ninvuɣ so bee saan shɛb bɛn be bɛ sani ninvuɣ so yi ti ŋubi bin so ŋun kpi nyiŋgo muni, n suhu ni yiɣisi bahi dilan zuɣu, ka yih o n niriba ni.
en: I will turn against any of my people who eat blood. This also includes any foreigners living among you.

dag: ka o nyaandoliba bɔh o, Karimba, doo ŋɔ laamba daalahichi zuɣu n-chɛ ka bɛ dɔɣ o zom ŋɔ bee omaŋmaŋ daalahichi zuɣu.
en: His disciples asked him, Teacher, whose sin caused him to be born blind? Was it his own or his parents' sin.

dag: Daba ayopɔin nyaaŋa ka kokpɛɣu daa kpe m-pali dunia ŋɔ.
en: Seven days later the flood started. The rain began to fall on the earth.

dag: Ijipti yiɣisirimi m-be kaman Nail mɔɣili; di bemi kaman kulibɔna din kpe m-pali. Di yɛliya, Chɛ ka n yiɣisi, chɛ ka n yiɣisi lim dunia, chɛ ka n wurim tinsi tabili di niriba.
en: It is Egypt that comes like the rising Nile River. It is Egypt that comes like that strong, fast river. Egypt says, I will come and cover the earth. I will destroy the cities and the people in them.

dag: Zɔrinima! Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi niŋdi lala? Ti nyɛla ninsalinim kaman yi gba, ka zaŋ lahibal suŋ na ni ti ti tin ya, ka yi chɛ bin yoya ŋɔ jɛmbu ka niŋ Naawuni ŋun be ka nam zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani ni teeku ni binshɛɣukam din be di ni ŋɔ yɛda.
en: Why are you doing this? We are humans just like you. Please give up all this foolishness. Turn to the living God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and everything in them.

dag: Dinzuɣu man Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi zaɣisi n noli yi ni bi bahi yi ʒiʒiinitab mini yi zɔnim maa zuɣu. N yɛn tin ya la faako. Faako din nyɛ tɔbu mini alɔbo ni dimpooi. N ni chɛ ka yi yɛla gbahi dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa dabiɛm. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Therefore, the LORD proclaims: Since you have defied me by not setting your fellow citizens free, Im setting you free, declares the LORD, free to die by the sword, disease, and famine! And I will make you an object of horror for all nations on earth.

dag: Bɛ gahindila bindira pu shɛŋa din pa bɛ dina ni, ka yihiri wain tiwal yiha ninvuɣ biɛɣu wain tihi puu ni.
en: If they want grain or grapes, they must go to the property of these sinners.

dag: Saa mini sakuɣa ni yiri zuɣusaa lurina, ka bi lan labiri zuɣusaa amaa ka mahigiri tiŋgbani n-chɛ ka bindira bimbira tɔri yirina n-zoori niŋdi bindira tiri bindiridiriba, ka niŋdi bimbira tiri bɛn biriti shɛm la.
en: Just as the rain and the snow come down from the sky and dont return there without watering the earth, making it conceive and yield plants and providing seed to the sower and food to the eater.

dag: Tummiya din viɛla ka chɛ din bie, ka tiligi. Di saha ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ binnamda zaa Naawuni ŋɔ ni be yi sani kaman yi ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Seek good and not evil, that you may live; and so the LORD, the God of heavenly forces, will be with you just as you have said.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ m baŋya ni Yawɛ galisiya gari wuna zaa, o ni daa tiligi niriba maa Ijiptinim nuu ni saha shɛli bɛ ni daa niŋdi ba fitiina la zuɣu.
en: Now I know that the LORD is greater than all the gods, because of what happened when the Egyptians plotted against them.

dag: Naawuni daa zaŋ Midiannim nanim niŋ yi nuu ni. Bɛna n-nyɛ: Orɛb mini Ziib. Ka n ni tum shɛli lee nyɛla dini, ka n-ni tooi zaŋ li buɣisi yi dini? Ka o ni daa yɛli shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ suhuyiɣisili zaŋ chaŋ o sani maa kpi.
en: In the same way you have a better harvest now. God allowed you to capture Oreb and Zeeb, the leaders of Midian. How can I compare my success with what you did? When the men of Ephraim heard Gideons answer, they were not as angry as they had been.

dag: Yuun piniyini puuni gol so ŋun pahir ata dahin yini dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: On the first day of the third month in the eleventh year of exile, the word of the Lord came to me. He said.

dag: Bɛ gahindila bindira pu shɛŋa din pa bɛ dina ni, ka yihiri wain tiwal yiha ninvuɣ biɛɣu wain tihi puu ni.
en: They have to harvest fields they don't own, and gather grapes in vineyards of the wicked.

dag: Ka Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ŋun daa nyɛ Ifriim zuliya ni nir ŋun yi Zɛrɛda na, ka nyɛ Sulemaana kpambala, ka o ma nyɛ pako so ŋun yuli daa booni Zɛrua la gba daa leei naa dima.
en: Now Nebats son Jeroboam was an Ephraimite from Zeredah. His mothers name was Zeruah; she was a widow. Although he was one of Solomons own officials, Jeroboam fought against the king.

dag: Jɔn daa di shɛhira n-lan yɛli, N nya Naawuni Shia Kasi ka o yi zuɣusaa na kaman ŋmani la nti tam o zuɣu.
en: And John gave this testimony: I saw the Spirit come down like a dove from heaven and stay on him.

dag: O daa pilila daanya zuɣupiligu ka ye kurigu gbaɣino din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram pihinu ni ayopɔin.
en: and wore bronze armor that weighed about pounds and a bronze helmet.

dag: Daadam, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Ti Duuma ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ sahi takɔbi, ka nyɛhi li ka di neei.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Jerusalem: I have sharpened my sword to slaughter you; it is shiny and will flash like lightning! Don't celebrate— punishment is coming, because everyone has ignored my warnings.

dag: Ka sapashini maa daa zaŋ o tahi sapashin kpɛm maa sani ti yɛl o, Dansarika so ŋun yuli booni Pool la m-boli ma nti yɛli ma ni n zaŋ nachimbil ŋɔ tahi a sanna ni o malila yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni o yɛl a.
en: The officer took him to the commander and said, The prisoner named Paul asked me to bring this young man to you, because he has something to tell you.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun daa yɛn kpi daa suhi alibarika niŋ n ni, ka n daa chɛ ka pakoya yili yila ni suhupiɛlli.
en: People who were in deepest misery praised me, and I helped widows find security.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu soli ni daa na bi kana, ti daa bela Naawuni fukumsi zaligu sulinsi ni ni di gbibi ti hal ti paai yɛda niŋbu soli maa palo yibu saha.
en: The Law controlled us and kept us under its power until the time came when we would have faith.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka gbariti maa leei ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim; ka bɛ ni daa kari ninvuɣ shɛb bahi la ti leei zuliya shɛli din mali yaa, ka Yawɛ ti su ba Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu sahakam.
en: The people of that crippled city will be the only ones left alive. They were forced to leave, but I will make them into a strong nation. The Lord will be their king. He will rule from Mount Zion forever.

dag: Ka niriba yi mi ni nahu maa pun ʒiɛrila o taba ka o lan maa bi lɔr o zaana, dindina o ni bo nahu yo nahu maa zuɣu, ka zaŋ naɣ kpiŋ maa.
en: But if the ox was known for goring in the past and its owner hadnt watched out for it, the owner must make good the loss, an ox for an ox, but may keep the dead animal.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ n Naawuni; n ni paɣ a. Nyini n nyɛ n Naawuni; n ni tibig a.
en: You are my God—I will give thanks to you! You are my God—I will lift you up high!.

dag: Ka Musa daa kɔŋ Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa ni kpɛbu sagbani maa ni daa sirigina ti pil li maa mini Yawɛ jilima ni daa pal o biɛhigu shee maa zuɣu.
en: Moses couldn’t enter the meeting tent because the cloud had settled on it, and the LORD’s glorious presence filled the dwelling.

dag: Nyamiya, n di kul guhirila yi ni yɛn yɛli shɛm, ka gbilisiri tibili ni n wum yi yɛtɔɣa, saha shɛli yi ni di na tɛhiri yi ni yɛn yɛli shɛm la.
en: Look, I waited while you spoke, listened while you reasoned, while you searched for words.

dag: Naawuni noli ni di binshɛɣukam ti ku be tiŋ maa ni. Kulla Naawuni mini Piɛbil maa nam ʒiishee la n-yɛn beni, ka o daba ni jɛmd o.
en: Nothing that is under God's curse will be found in the city. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in the city, and his servants will worship him.

dag: N nyɛla ŋun daa birita, ka Apolɔs mi nyɛ ŋun daa mihiri li kom, amaa Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun chɛ ka di zoora.
en: I planted the seeds, Apollos watered them, but God made them sprout and grow.

dag: ka ninvuɣ pihinii daa yi Shɛkɛm mini Shilo ni Samaria paana. Bɛ daa pinila bɛ teensi, ka chahichahi bɛ situra, ka zaŋ bini ŋmaŋŋma bɛ niŋgbuna. Bɛ daa zaŋla kawana mini tulaale zim na ni bɛ ti niŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu.
en: eighty men with shaved beards, torn clothes, and gashed bodies arrived from Shechem, Shiloh, and Samaria. They were bringing grain offerings and incense to present at the LORDs temple.

dag: Jɔtam ni daa ti faai siɣ o yaannim sani, bɛ daa sɔɣ o la Dauda tiŋ la ni. Ka o bia Ahaz daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Then Jotham died and was buried with his ancestors. The people buried him in the City of David. Jothams son Ahaz became king in his place.

dag: N shia, Neema! Mɔɣilo mini goonje, neemiya! N ni ŋme biɛɣunaayo.
en: Wake up, my soul! Harps and lyres, wake up, and lets wake the dawn!.

dag: Ninsal dunia ŋɔ yili biɛhigu zaa puuni, o tuma zaa nyɛla din tir o biɛrim mini suhugarigu, hal ka o bi tooi vuhir o yubu yuŋ gba. Dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: Our bodies ache during the day, and work is torture. Then at night our thoughts are troubled. It just doesn't make sense.

dag: Ka o bɔh o, Zɔri, wula ka a lee niŋ hal ti kpe kpe na ni ka bi ye amiliya lɔbu chuɣu ŋɔ binyɛrigu? Ka o kɔŋ garigibu.
en: Friend, how did you get in here without wedding clothes? the king asked him. But the man said nothing.

dag: Di saha maa zuliya pam ni ti zo n-ka Yawɛ sanna nti leeg o niriba. Ka ŋun Yawɛ ni be yi sani, ka yi baŋ ni ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-shiri tim ma yi sanna maa.
en: At that time many nations will come to the Lord and become his people. He will live among you, and you will know that he has sent me to you.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, ti ni bo bin gbaliŋ shɛŋa zaa ni ti me jɛmbu duu n-ti a yuli din be kasi ŋɔ zaa nyɛla din yi a nuu ni na, ka nyɛ a ni su shɛli.
en: LORD, our God, all this abundance that we have provided to build you a temple for your holy name comes from your hand and belongs to you.

dag: Kuruchu bɔbigu daa ʒe zol luɣili ni gbiri binyara ŋubira;.
en: There was a large herd of pigs near by, feeding on a hillside.

dag: N ni chɛ ka n zaŋsim be jɛmbu duu ŋɔ ni, ka n gbilisiri tibili wumdi bɛ ni yɛn suhiri suhigu shɛli kpe ŋɔ.
en: Now, my eyes are open, and my ears will pay attention to the prayers prayed in this place.

dag: Amaa teemiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yɛla, dama ŋuna n-niŋdi ya yiko ka yi nyari buni maa ni di chɛ ka o pal o ni daa po pɔri lo yi yaannim alikauli shɛl la kaman o ni niŋdi shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Remember the LORD your God! Hes the one who gives you the strength to be prosperous in order to establish the covenant he made with your ancestors—and thats how things stand right now.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka dabiɛm gbahi ba! Chɛ ka zuliya kam baŋ ni bɛ kul nyɛla ninsalinima.
en: Strike them with fear, LORD. Let the nations know they are only human. Selah.

dag: Ka yi daa garigi yɛli ma, Ti tum alahichi Yawɛ sani. Ti ni chaŋ ti tuhi tɔbu maa kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ti shɛm maa. Ka yi ni doo kam daa zaŋ o tɔbutuhiri nɛma niŋ omaŋa, ka daa tɛhi ni zoya ni tiŋ maa ni chandi yɛn nyɛla asama.
en: Then you told me, We disobeyed the Lord our God, but now we want to obey him. We will go into the hill country and fight, just as he told us to do. So you picked up your weapons, thinking it would be easy to take over the hill country.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ gabiga m-pɔripɔri li n-zaŋ kari bɛ mini bɛ biŋkɔbiri maa zaa yihi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, ka daai laɣitaɣiriba la teebuya maa luhi n-kpahi bɛ liɣiri bahi.
en: Jesus made a whip with some pieces of rope. Then he forced all these men and the sheep and cattle to leave the Temple area. He turned over the tables of the money traders and scattered their money.

dag: Bɛ daa sabi bɛ yuya dolila bɛ daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm. Juda zuliya ni sapashin kpamba bɛn daa su tɔbbihi tusatusa fukumsi puuni, Adina daa sula tɔbutuhiri biinsi tuhi kɔbisita.
en: registered by their clans as follows: Judahs officers over units of a thousand included Commander Adnah with three hundred thousand soldiers.

dag: Yaa n Naawuni, teemi dimbɔŋɔnim yɛla, dama bɛ ta maligumaaniba tuma zaŋ tabil a ni daa lo maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim alikauli shɛl la daɣiri.
en: My God, punish these people. They made the priesthood unclean. They treated it as if it was not important. They did not obey the agreement that you made with the priests and Levites.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka gbariti maa leei ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim; ka bɛ ni daa kari ninvuɣ shɛb bahi la ti leei zuliya shɛli din mali yaa, ka Yawɛ ti su ba Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu sahakam.
en: Then the lame and the outcasts will belong to my people and become a strong nation. I, the Lord , will rule them from Mount Zion forever.

dag: Kpahim mɔɣu ni biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn be gbiŋgbaŋ ni la zuɣu ni; ka kpahi zuliya kam naɣilahi mini bɛ naɣibihi la zuɣu ni. Nom taai ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yu farigu deebu pam la. Wurimmi zuliya shɛb bɛn yuri tɔbu tuhibu yɛla pam la.
en: Rebuke Egypt, that wild animal in the reeds; rebuke the nations, that herd of bulls with their calves, until they all bow down and offer you their silver. Scatter those people who love to make war!.

dag: Yi ni be luɣ shɛlikam zaa, yi fɔntinsi ni bahi yoli, ka yi ni jɛmdi buɣa luɣ shɛŋa zaa bahi yoli, ka yi maligu bimbina wurim bahi yoli, ka yi buɣa la wurim saɣim, ka yi ni tuɣindi tulaale zim bimbin shɛŋa zuɣu la wurim ka yi tuma kpihim.
en: Wherever you live, cities will be in ruins, shrines made desolate, turned into utter ruin. Your altars will be punished and then broken down. Your idols will be demolished, your incense altars shattered, and all your works wiped out.

dag: Chɛ ka Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu nim mali suhupiɛlli, ka chɛ ka Juda tinsinim mali suhupiɛlli, a saria karibu zuɣu.
en: Let Mount Zion be glad; let the towns of Judah rejoice because of your acts of justice!.

dag: Ka Mɔab kpamba maa daa yiɣisi labi Balak sani ti yɛl o, Balaam zaɣisiya ni o ku dol ti kana.
en: The officials of Moab arose, they went to Balak, and they said, Balaam refused to come with us.

dag: Dina n-chɛ ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Bokim. Ka bɛ daa mali sara ti Yawɛ nimaani.
en: So they named that place Bochim, and they offered a sacrifice to the LORD there.

dag: Ka o daa yɛl o, Pom n nini ŋɔ ni; ka Yisifu daa shiri po. Di saha ka Izraɛl daa zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa o bindoo zuɣusaa polo.
en: Then Jacob said, Make a vow to me. And Joseph vowed to him that he would do this. Then Israel laid his head back down on the bed.

dag: Dauda ni daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani, ka bi zaɣis o noli o ni zal o zaligu shɛŋa zaa ni, naɣila Yuria Hiti nir la yɛla la zuɣu ka o daa niŋ lala maa.
en: This was because David did the right thing in the LORDs eyes. David didnt deviate from anything the LORD commanded him throughout his life—except in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.

dag: ni bimmɔriŋ bee yuma zaligu.
en: These are the rules for swellings, rashes, or bright spots on the skin.

dag: Apolɔs ni daa be Kɔrinti saha shɛli maa ka Pool daa gari chaŋ tin shɛŋa din be nuzaa polo n-daa mali hal ti paai Ɛfɛsus. Nimaani ka o daa nya Yisa nyaandol shɛba.
en: While Apollos was in the city of Corinth, Paul was visiting some places on his way to Ephesus. In Ephesus he found some other followers of the Lord.

dag: ka yi ti bo bɛ bipuɣinsi ti yi bidibisi, ka bɛ bipuɣinsi maa ni ti jɛmdi bɛ buɣa maa, ka yi bidibisi maa gba ti jɛm bɛ buɣa maa.
en: You might choose some of their daughters as wives for your sons. Those daughters serve false gods. They might lead your sons to do the same thing.

dag: ni piɛlahi gbana din niŋ moonsi ni teeku ni biŋkɔb bal shɛb gbana ni gɔpiɛliga dari.
en: rams skins dyed red; beaded leather; acacia wood.

dag: Ka Yisa ni daa tim ninvuɣ pisopɔin shɛb la daa ti labina ni suhupiɛlli ti yɛl o, Ti Duuma, hal ti nyaŋ alizin biɛri gba a yuli zuɣu.
en: The seventy-two returned joyously, saying, Lord, even the demons submit themselves to us in your name.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti kuhiri yɛri zoya, Lumiya ti zuɣu na! Ka ni ti yɛri kuŋkuna mi, Limsimiya ti! .
en: Then the people will say to the mountains, Fall on us! They will say to the hills, Cover us.

dag: N ni bɔhim a zaligunim maa, ka zaŋ n zaɣa niŋ a soya ni.
en: I will study your teachings and follow your footsteps.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ tarimba ŋɔ, bomiya yɛm. Yinim bɛn ka fahim ŋɔ, bomiya li.
en: Good sense and sound judgment can be yours.

dag: Dama yi dolila Omri zaligunima, ka tumdi Ɛhab daŋ niriba ni tumdi tuun shɛŋa zaa, ka doli bɛ kaya. Dinzuɣu ka n yɛn chɛ ka yi yiya kpalim zani dabari, ka di niriba nya filiŋ, ka zuliya kam zaa ti mali ya ansarisi.
en: Jerusalem, this will happen because you followed the sinful example of kings Omri and Ahab. Now I will destroy you and your property. Then the people of every nation will make fun and insult you.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ni ti be mɔɣu ni mooni molo yɛra, Malimiya ti Duuma kandina soli gu o, ka mal o soya ka di tuhi. .
en: There is someone shouting in the desert: Prepare the way for the Lord. Make the road straight for him. Isaiah :.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ ti gbahi ba na ti ti o ma; ka o ma daa zaŋ ba duɣi bindir nyaɣisili shɛli o ba ni yuri pam.
en: So Jacob brought the meat to his mother, and she cooked the tasty food that his father liked.

dag: Ka a yi nyɛla wuntizɔra, bɔ ka a yɛn ti o? Bee bɔ ka o yɛn nya di ni?.
en: Do you help God by being so righteous? There is nothing God needs from you.

dag: Ka Yisifu zuliya la daa ti bɔhi Jɔshua, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a zaŋ tiŋgbani maa yaɣ yini polo din nyɛ din bi galisi ti ti? Yawɛ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ ti ni zuɣu, ti galisiya pam.
en: The descendants of Joseph said to Joshua, Why have you given us only one part of the land to possess as our own? There are very many of us because the Lord has blessed us.

dag: Bɛcha bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Zɛmira mini Jɔash ni Ɛliɛza ni Ɛliɔnai ni Omri ni Jɛrimɔt ni Abija ni Anatɔt ni Alɛmɛt. Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Bɛcha bidibisi.
en: Bekers sons were Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. They all were Bekers children.

dag: O daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ ni kpe kuɣ shɛŋa m-me zɔŋ kulis ata tam taba, ka zaŋ sida dari n-kpahi li kul yini tam di zuɣu.
en: The inner courtyard of the temple had walls made out of three layers of cut stones with one layer of cedar beams.

dag: Susa din nyɛ bɛ tinzuɣu maa puuni, Yɛhudianim daa kula dɔbba kɔbisinu.
en: In Susa, the capital city itself, the Jews killed five hundred people.

dag: Ka Mariama ŋun daa nyɛ Magdala tiŋbia maa daa chaŋ ti yɛli Yisa nyaandoliba maa, N nya ti Duuma! Ka yɛli ba Yisa ni daa yɛl o shɛm la zaa.
en: Mary Magdalene went to the followers and told them, I saw the Lord! And she told them what he had said to her.

dag: Niriba bɛn daa ʒi zibisim ni la yipa nya neesim titali; ka bɛn daa ʒi kum zibisim ni be luɣ shɛli polo la gba nya ka neesim maa neei m-paai ba.
en: the people who lived in the dark have seen a great light, and a light has come upon those who lived in the region and in shadow of death.

dag: N daa ka galimi o sani, dama n daa bi tum taal shɛli.
en: I have lived with integrity before him; Ive kept myself from wrongdoing.

dag: Kpihimmi alahichinim birili dunia ni, ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri ku lan beni. M paɣiri Yawɛ n suhu ni! Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: Destroy all wicked sinners from the earth once and for all. With all my heart I praise you, Lord ! I praise you!.

dag: Gɛrishom bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Libini mini Shimɛi.
en: The names of Gershons sons were Libni and Shimei.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ wuna zaa Naawuni mini duumanim zaa Duuma. Ŋuna n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun galisi ka mali kpiɔŋ ka o yɛla mali dabiɛm, ŋun bi gaŋdi so bee n-diri birapu.
en: The Lord is your God. He is the God of gods and the Lord of lords. He is the great God. He is the amazing and powerful fighter. To him everyone is the same. He does not accept money to change his mind.

dag: Nimmaŋtali yɛtɔɣa nyɛla din mali yaa! Amaa ka bɔzuɣu ka yi galindi ma?.
en: Honest words are powerful, but your arguments prove nothing.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli Baruk bɛ nini maa ni.
en: I told Baruch that the Lord had said: Take both copies of this bill of sale, one sealed shut and the other open, and put them in a clay jar so they will last a long time.

dag: A niriba ni mali suhupiɛlli! Ka a kpambaliba bɛn kul ʒiini a tooni sahakam n-wumd a yɛm maa yɛtɔɣa gba mali suhupiɛlli.
en: How fortunate are those who serve you, who are always in your presence and are privileged to hear your wise sayings!.

dag: Dinzuɣu zuliya kam wummiya, ka baŋ binshɛli din yɛn niŋ ba.
en: Therefore, pay attention, nations; take notice, assembly, what is ahead of them.

dag: Ka o ni daa yɛli shɛm maa zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ bi tooi gbaag o o yɛtɔɣa ni niriba maa ninni, amaa ka o ni garigi ba shɛm maa daa gari ba pam, ka bɛ fo.
en: Jesus' enemies could not catch him saying anything wrong there in front of the people. They were amazed at his answer and kept quiet.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna, ka Yawɛ jɛmbu duu zoli la ni ti mali jilima n-gari zoya zaa, ka du n-gari daboli kam. Zuliya kam ni ti zo n-ka di gbinna.
en: In the future, the mountain with the Lord 's temple will be the highest of all. It will reach above the hills; every nation will rush to it.

dag: N sabila yɛla ŋɔ ti yinim bɛn niŋ Naawuni Bia maa yuli yɛda la ni di chɛ ka yi baŋ ni yi mali nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: I am writing this to you so that you may know that you have eternal life—you that believe in the Son of God.

dag: Ka paɣiri ti Ba Naawuni ŋun mali ya ka yi simdi ni yi nya tarili ŋun Naawuni ni zaŋ shɛli zal o ninvuɣ gahinda o neesim nam ni la.
en: I pray that you will be grateful to God for letting you have part in what he has promised his people in the kingdom of light.

dag: ni di tintan ni tinsi din be Halak Zoli gbin la zaŋ ti paai Ɛdom n-zaŋ hal ti paai Baaligad din be Lɛbanɔn vinvamli ni Hɛrimɔn Zolɔŋni la. Ka o daa gbahi bɛ nanima ŋ-ŋme n-ku ba.
en: Joshua had control of all the land from Mount Halak near Seir to Baal Gad in the Valley of Lebanon below Mount Hermon. He captured all the kings in that land and killed them.

dag: Di chɛliya ka peentɔra nya soli to piɛm, yi mi di chɛliya ka o nya soli ye kuriti gbaɣino. Di chɛnya o nachimba. Kummiya o tɔbbihi zaa.
en: I will tell these soldiers, Attack quickly, before the Babylonians can string their bows or put on their armor. Kill their best soldiers and destroy their army.

dag: Ka ti daa labi ti nyaaŋa n-kpe tiŋgban nɛli maa ni zaŋ labi Teeku Ʒiɛɣu polo kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛli ma shɛm, ka ti daa baɣisi Ɛdom Zoli chana n-niŋ dabisi gbaliŋ.
en: Then we did what the Lord told me to do. We went back into the desert on the road that leads to the Red Sea. We traveled for many days to go around the mountains of Seir.

dag: Nandaamba bɛn dabisa zaa nyɛla wahala dabisa, amaa bɛn suhuri piɛla kul puhirila chuɣu sahakam.
en: The life of the poor is a constant struggle, but happy people always enjoy life.

dag: O ŋmanila kɔhigɔriba ŋarima; o ʒir o bindirigu yirila katiŋ na.
en: She is like a fleet of merchant ships, bringing food from a distance.

dag: Abinɛr mini ninvuɣ pisi bɛn daa dol o la ni daa ti paai Naa Dauda sani Hiburɔn, Dauda daa chɛ ka bɛ duɣila bindira ti Abinɛr mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be o sani maa ka bɛ laɣim tab di ka nyu.
en: When Abner, along with twenty others, reached David at Hebron, David threw a celebration for Abner and his men.

dag: ka sab bɛ puhigu gbaŋ ti ba. Bɛ ni daa sab yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi mabihi bɛn nyɛ Yisa tuumba mini cheechi kpamba puhiri yinim bɛn nyɛ bɛ mabihi bɛn pa Yɛhudianima m-be Antiɔk mini Siria ni Kilikia zaa ha.
en: The group sent the letter with these men. The letter said: From the apostles and elders, your brothers, To all the non-Jewish brothers in the city of Antioch and in the countries of Syria and Cilicia. Dear Brothers:.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni yi kul ŋmari bilichiisi shɛm maa, lala ka bɛ na kul yɛn ŋmari li, di filimya li; bɛ nyɛla vinnyaɣinima, dina n-chɛ ka bɛ yɛli, Chɛ ka ti chaŋ ti mali sara jɛm ti Naawuni.
en: But still require them to make the same number of bricks as before, not one brick less. They don't have enough work to do, and that is why they keep asking me to let them go and offer sacrifices to their God!.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa yɛli Naawuni, A daa wuh a yurilim din galisi ka ka tariga ŋɔ ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ m ba Dauda sani, ka zaŋ ma leei naa zal o zaani.
en: Solomon said to God, You were very kind to my father David when you allowed me to rule on his throne after him.

dag: Teem niriba maa ni bɛ doli zuɣulaannim mini bɛn su fukumsi yɛligu ka deeri bɛ noli, ka mali shili n-tum tuun suŋ kam zaa.
en: Remind your people to obey the rulers and authorities and not to be rebellious. They must always be ready to do something helpful.

dag: Kpaŋm amaŋ chɛ ka Ziinas ŋun nyɛ zaligubaŋda la mini Apolɔs niŋ yomyom gbaai soli chaŋ, ka zaŋ di ni simdi ni bɛ mali shɛli ti ba.
en: Do your best to help Zenas the lawyer and Apollos to get started on their travels, and see to it that they have everything they need.

dag: Yawɛ mi ti tɛha, ka di nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: The Lord knows what people are thinking. He knows that their thoughts are like a puff of wind.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Aizaia.
en: Then the Lord commanded Isaiah.

dag: Ka Babilɔnnim maa ni labina ti tuhi tiŋ ŋɔ nima. Bɛ ni tuhi deei li, ka nyo li buɣim.
en: Then the Babylonians will come back, attack the city, capture it, and burn it down.

dag: Sool ni daa bɔhi Yawɛ ni o baŋ yɛlli maa ni nyɛ shɛm, Yawɛ daa bi garig o zahindi puuni bee Urim puuni bee n-chɛ ka anab so yɛl o shɛli.
en: When Saul questioned the LORD, the LORD didnt answer him—not by dreams, not by the Urim, and not by the prophets.

dag: Ka a zaŋ li yili gɔpiɛliga daantalis anahi shɛŋa zuɣu yi ni niŋ salima pa, ka di mali salima bansi ka tam anzinfa bintamdisi zuɣu la.
en: Hang it on four posts of acacia wood covered with gold, fitted with hooks, and set in four silver bases.

dag: di saha yi ni ti boli ma, amaa ka n ku garigi ya. Yi ni ti bo ma ni nimmoo, amaa ka ku nya ma.
en: Then they will call me, but I wont answer; they will seek me, but wont find me.

dag: Yisifu daa laɣim bindira maa sɔŋ ka di galisim ti ŋmanila teeku ni bihigu hal ka o ti bi lan niŋdi di laasabu, dama nir daa naan ku tooi lan niŋ di laasabu.
en: There was so much grain that Joseph stopped measuring it—it was like the sand of the sea.

dag: Bɛna n-nyɛ olivi tih ayi mini firilatamdis ayi din ʒe dunia tiŋgbani Duuma tooni la.
en: The two witnesses are the two olive trees and the two lamps that stand before the Lord of the earth.

dag: Di saha maa ka Pita nini daa neei ka o yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ m baŋya ni Naawuni n-tim o malaika na ka o ti fa ma Naa Hɛrɔd mini Yɛhudianim zaa ni lɔri nia ni bɛ niŋ ma bɛ ni yu shɛm la nuu ni bahi.
en: Then Peter realized what had happened to him, and said, Now I know that it is really true! The Lord sent his angel to rescue me from Herod's power and from everything the Jewish people expected to happen.

dag: A chɛ ka ti ŋmanila piɛ shɛb bɛ ni kɔrita; ka wurim ti kpɛhi tinzun tinsi ni.
en: Youve handed us over like sheep for butchering; youve scattered us among the nations.

dag: O ni daa na kul tɛhiri di yɛla maa, ka ti Duuma malaika ka o sanna zahindi ni nti yɛl o, Nyin Yisifu ŋun nyɛ Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ, di zɔri dabiɛm ni a chɛ ka bɛ kulisi Mariama a yiŋ na, dama o ni mali pu shɛli maa yila Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni na.
en: While he was thinking about this, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream and said, Joseph, descendant of David, do not be afraid to take Mary to be your wife. For it is by the Holy Spirit that she has conceived.

dag: N ni ti yihi ya yi daɣiri zaa ni, ka chɛ ka yi bindira niŋ pam ka kum ku lan lu yi zuɣu.
en: Also, I will save you and keep you from becoming unclean. I will command the grain to grow. I will not bring a famine against you.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa ŋmaligi nya ba, ka zaŋ Yawɛ yuli yɛli ba noli. Ka gbuɣin nyama ayi daa yi tibɔŋ ni na nti dim ku bidibbihi pihinahinaayi.
en: Elisha turned around, glared at them, and cursed them in the name of the Lord . Then two she-bears came out of the woods and tore forty-two of the boys to pieces.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Ti wumla dabiɛm mini abirima lubu kuhigu, pa suhudoo kuhigu.
en: The LORD proclaims: I hear screams of panic and terror; no one is safe.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba maa daa mali ti paai Bɛtani, ka o daa kpuɣ o nuhi zuɣusaa n-niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni.
en: Then he led them out of the city as far as Bethany, where he raised his hands and blessed them.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa zaŋ o nudirigu gbaai Ifriim n-zaŋ o zali tuhi Izraɛl nuzaa, ka zaŋ o nuzaa gbaai Manaasa n-zaŋ o mi zali tuhi Izraɛl nudirigu n-zaŋ ba na ti chɛ ka bɛ damd o tooni.
en: After Joseph got up, he brought his two sons over to Jacob again. He led his younger son Ephraim to the left side of Jacob and his older son Manasseh to the right.

dag: Dauda bapira Jɔnatan n-daa nyɛ saawaralana ŋun mi niriba yɛlimuɣisira, ka lan nyɛ gbansabira karimba. O mini Jɛhiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Hachimɔni bia la n-daa nyɛ bɛn lihiri naa bidibisi.
en: Jonathan, King David's uncle, was a skillful adviser and a scholar. He and Jehiel son of Hachmoni were in charge of the education of the king's sons.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛligu nyɛla din be tibi, ka o tuma zaa nyɛ din tuhi.
en: The words of the Lord are true, and all his works are dependable.

dag: Magibish — kɔbiga ni pihinunaayɔbu.
en: from the town of Magbish:.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa bi kali Lɛvinim pahi Izraɛlnim kalinli ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun zali Musa shɛm la.
en: The only Israelites not included were the Levites, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.

dag: Wuntizɔriba mi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din niŋ kamaata yɛlibu, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn yɛtɔɣa kul nyɛla yɛtɔɣ kaha.
en: Good people know the right things to say, but the wicked say things to make trouble.

dag: Man Yawɛ maŋmaŋ ni chɛ ka n ni niŋ n tɔbbi shɛb naani, ka mali ba nyuri bara la tuhi n suhu ni yiɣisi bahi ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu.
en: I have separated these men from the people, and I myself will command them. I have gathered these proud, happy soldiers of mine to show how angry I am.

dag: Di saha ka Taai Naa Hiram daa sabi gbaŋ ti Sulemaana n-garigi yɛl o, Yawɛ ni yur o niriba maa zuɣu n-chɛ ka o zaŋ a leei bɛ naa maa.
en: Then Hiram answered Solomon and sent this message to him: Solomon, the Lord loves his people. That is why he chose you to be their king.

dag: N nyɛla a ni su so. Tiligim ma, dama n loya ni n dol a zaligunim maa.
en: I am yours, so save me! I have done my best to know your instructions.

dag: Yi tɛhiya ni yi ni tooi galim yɛtɔɣa, ka di be kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun ka tahima yɛtɔɣa nyɛla pɔhim?.
en: You think I am talking nothing but wind; then why do you answer my words of despair?.

dag: nti yɛli Musa, Niriba maa zaŋ nɛma maa na pam n-gari ti ni bɔri shɛm tariga ni ti zaŋ tum Yawɛ ni zali ti ni ti tum tuun shɛli maa.
en: The people have brought too much. We have more than we need to finish the work the Lord told us to do.

dag: Ka naŋgbanyintali bɔ n-lee be Naawuni jɛmbu duu mini buɣa sunsuuni? Ti nyɛla Naawuni ŋun kul be ŋɔ jɛmbu duu kaman ŋun Naawuni ni yɛli shɛm la: N ni be bɛ ni, ka chani gindi bɛ sunsuuni, ka nyɛ bɛ Naawuni, ka bɛ mi nyɛ n niriba.
en: How can God's temple come to terms with pagan idols? For we are the temple of the living God! As God himself has said, I will make my home with my people and live among them; I will be their God, and they shall be my people.

dag: Dinzuɣu zaligu maa lan ka yaa, ka saria karibu gba bi lan tumdi tuma. Dama ninvuɣ biɛri gilila wuntizɔriba, dinzuɣu ka saria karibu bi lan tumdi tuma.
en: The Instruction is ineffective. Justice does not endure because the wicked surround the righteous. Justice becomes warped.

dag: Yawɛ, deemi n suhigu yomyom; n gbarigiya zaa. Di lɛb a nyaaŋa biri ma. Di yi niŋ lala, n ni bemi kaman bɛn pun kpi la.
en: Hurry and answer me, Lord ! I have lost my courage. Dont turn away from me. Dont let me die and become like the people lying in the grave.

dag: Ninsal noli ni yɛtɔɣa nyɛla kom din zilima, ka yɛm kɔbilinini nyɛ kulibɔŋ kom din zɔra.
en: The words of a persons mouth are deep waters, a bubbling stream, a fountain of wisdom.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli, Oi, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ! Bɛ kul yɛrila n yɛla yɛra, Pa saliŋ lɔha ka o lɔhi maa? .
en: Then I said, Oh, Lord GOD! If I say this, the people will say that I am only telling them stories.

dag: ni yaannina ayi mini di kpam din be binshee ni, ka yihi binsabili yaɣ shɛli din viɛl pahi binyaannin shɛŋa o ni yihi maa zuɣu.
en: He must offer the two kidneys and the fat covering them at the lower back muscle. He must also offer the fat part of the liver. He must remove it with the kidneys.

dag: Bɛ daa gbahi paɣiba mini bɛnkam daa be nimaani n-nyɛ bihi ni ninkura zaa. Bɛ daa bi ku so, amaa bɛ daa kul gbahi ba mi n-zaŋ ba chaŋ bɛ chandi.
en: and captured all the women; they had not killed anyone, but had taken everyone with them when they left.

dag: Ka o lan yɛli, Niŋmiya lala pahi buyi. Ka bɛ niŋ lala pahi buyi. Ka o lan yɛli, Niŋmiya lala pahi buta. Ka bɛ niŋ lala pahi buta.
en: he told them to do it two more times. They did exactly as he said.

dag: Amaa ŋun pa piɛgula ka mi bi su piɛri ka nyɛla bɛ ni bu so paa ka o guli ba yi ti nya kunduŋ ka o kanna, o chɛrila piɛri maa bahi ka zo, ka kunduŋ maa gbahi piɛri maa ni shɛba, ka wurim bɛn kpalim bahi.
en: When the hired hand sees the wolf coming, he leaves the sheep and runs away. Thats because he isnt the shepherd; the sheep arent really his. So the wolf attacks the sheep and scatters them.

dag: dama yi na kul dolila daadam biɛhigu. Nyuli zabbu mini naŋgbankpeeni ŋmɛbu yi be yi sunsuuni, pa daadam biɛhigu ka yi doli ka niŋdi kaman dunianim ni niŋdi shɛm?.
en: You are still not following the Spirit. You are jealous of each other, and you are always arguing with each other. This shows that you are still following your own selfish desires. You are acting like ordinary people of the world.

dag: Yuŋ nyoorila n kɔb tuɣa ni; ka biɛrim shɛli din dimdi ma bi naara.
en: At night my bones all ache; the pain that gnaws me never stops.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ be ti sani. Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ ti ni sɔɣiri so sani.
en: The Lord Almighty is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge.

dag: dama kaman Naawuni ni daa yihi paɣa doo ni na shɛm, lala zuɣu ka paɣ gba dɔɣiri doo pumpɔŋɔ. Amaa binshɛɣukam zaa nyɛla Naawuni ni nam shɛli.
en: For as woman was made from man, in the same way man is born of woman; and it is God who brings everything into existence.

dag: Yisa mini ba ni daa laɣim maa ka o yɛli ba ni bɛ di yi Jɛrusalɛm chaŋ luɣ shɛli, amaa ni bɛ kul guhim hal ka bɛ ni wum ŋun Yisa sani ni o ba Naawuni lo ba alikauli shɛl la ti niŋ pali.
en: While they were eating together, he ordered them not to leave Jerusalem but to wait for what the Father had promised. He said, This is what you heard from me.

dag: dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa baɣisi Misia gari chaŋ Troas.
en: So they passed by Mysia and went to the city of Troas.

dag: Di saha ka Farisiinim mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdib maa daa bɔhi Yisa, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a nyaandoliba bi doli ti yaannim kali? Dama bɛ bi doli bɛ ni paɣibu kal la paɣiri bɛ nuhi ka diri bindirigu.
en: The Pharisees and teachers of the law said to Jesus, Your followers dont follow the traditions we have from our great leaders who lived long ago. They eat their food with hands that are not clean. Why do they do this.

dag: Amaa ka Yisahaku biŋkɔbiguliba daa gbi kɔbiliga vinvamli maa ni n-nya kom.
en: Isaac's servants dug a well in the valley and found water.

dag: Ijipti naa Firawuna daa pun chaŋ ti tuhi deela Gɛza ka ku Keenannim bɛn daa be tiŋ maa ni, ka nyo li buɣim; ka zaŋ li ti o bipuɣin so Sulemaana ni daa kpuɣila ka di leeg o daamiliya lɔbu pini;.
en: The king of Egypt had attacked Gezer and captured it, killing its inhabitants and setting fire to the city. Then he gave it as a wedding present to his daughter when she married Solomon.

dag: ni Zɛlɛk ŋun daa nyɛ Ammɔn nir la ni Naharai ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛrɔt nira ka nyɛ Zɛruya bia Jɔab tɔbutuhiri neen ʒira la.
en: Zelek the Ammonite; Naharai the officer from Beeroth, who carried the armor for Joab son of Zeruiah;.

dag: Puhimiya ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ duumanim zaa Duuma ŋɔ. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Praise the Lord of lords. God's love never fails.

dag: A yɛtɔɣa nyaɣisi pam n sani, hal di nyaɣisi n nol ni pam gari shiri!.
en: Your teachings are sweeter than honey.

dag: dama o zaŋ o nyɛvili pa talima Masia tuma zuɣu hal ti kpi. O daa niŋ lala ni o ti ma la sɔŋsim shɛli yi ni daa naan ku tooi ti ma.
en: because he risked his life and nearly died for the sake of the work of Christ, in order to give me the help that you yourselves could not give.

dag: A ni zaŋ ti yi tiŋgban shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam ni na ni a ti ku ti yɔɣu ŋɔ ni la nyɛla yɛlibila, ka a ti lan bɔri ni a zaŋ amaŋ leei naa su ti?.
en: You have brought us out of a land filled with many good things. You brought us to the desert to kill us. And now you want to show that you have even more power over us.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ ba kul o yiŋa nti chɛ ka bɛ paɣi bɛ naba, ka di ka nyu. Ka o daa bo difu ti bɛ bunsi la gba.
en: The old man brought them into his house and fed their donkeys. Then he and his guests washed their feet and began eating and drinking.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lih o ka yɛli, Di to ni bundaannim kpe Naawuni nam ni!.
en: When Jesus saw that the man was sad, he said, It will be very hard for rich people to enter Gods kingdom.

dag: Naa bi diri nasara tɔb ni la o tɔbbihi galisim zuɣu, ka tɔbutuhiri biiŋa mi bi diri nasara la o kpiɔŋ zuɣu.
en: A king is not saved by the power of his army. A soldier does not survive by his own great strength.

dag: Gbibiya n vuhim dabisa la, ka timiya m biɛhigu shee jilima. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Remember my special days of rest and honor my holy place. I am the Lord .

dag: N suhu daa yiɣisiya bahi n niriba zuɣu, ka n daa niŋ ba kaman bɛ pala n niriba la. N daa zaŋ ba niŋla yi nuu ni, ka yi daa bi zo ba nambɔɣu, hal ka daa nahim bɛ ninkura pam.
en: I was angry with my people. They were mine, but I turned against them. I let you punish them, but you showed them no mercy. Even for those who were old you made the work hard.

dag: Dama pumpɔŋɔ bɛ ni yɛli, Ti lan ka naa, dama ti bi zɔri Yawɛ, ka bɔ ka naa lee yɛn niŋ ti ti.
en: For now they will say: We have no king, because we dont love the LORD. What then could a king do for us.

dag: Nir yi ŋme o dabipaɣ bee o dabidoo nimbila ka di saɣim, ŋun chɛ ka dabili maa chaŋ yoli, o nimbil maa zuɣu.
en: If you hit one of your slaves and cause the loss of an eye, the slave must be set free.

dag: Maligumaaniba daŋ bɛn daa yi Babilɔn n-lab kuli maa kalinli m-bɔŋɔ: Jɛdaya — kɔbisiwɛi ni pisopɔinnaata.
en: The family of Jedaiah, namely the house of Jeshua.

dag: Ifriimnim daa ŋmanila bɛ ni wuhi naɣisa so ka o bɔri ni bɛ zaŋ o bu chi, ka n daa bi zaŋ binshɛli pa o nyiŋgoli din viɛl la zuɣu. Amaa pumpɔŋɔ n ni zaŋ dapua n-ga Ifriimnim nyiŋgoya ni. Judanim ni jari, ka Yaakubu zuliya yɛbisi bɛmaŋmaŋ puu.
en: Ephraim was a trained cow that loved to pull a plow; I spared her fair neck; but I will make Ephraim break through the ground; Judah will plow; Jacob will turn the soil for himself.

dag: Amaa di simdi ka o ti zaŋ kom paɣi namanama mini bimbiɛhi dina, ka chɛ ka maligumaana zaŋ di zaa nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu n-ti Yawɛ, ka di leei bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl Yawɛ sani la.
en: You must wash the legs and inner parts of the animal with water. Then the priest will bring all these parts to the altar to be offered as a burnt offering, a sweet-smelling gift to the Lord .

dag: Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wummi Naawuni Shia Kasi ni yɛli cheechinim shɛm.
en: Everyone who hears this should listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.

dag: Bundaannim di yo n-gari lala, faranim mi di yo ka di pooi laɣifu pirigili maa saha shɛli yi yi ti yɛn yo li yi nyɛviya zuɣu kaman sara maligu la Yawɛ sani.
en: The rich man is not to pay more, nor the poor man less, when they pay this amount for their lives.

dag: ni Jɔa ni Iddo ni Zɛra ni Jiatɛrai.
en: his son Joah, his son Iddo, his son Zerah, and his son Jeatherai.

dag: Ka bɛ daa paɣ o chɛchɛbuŋ maa sɔŋ miri Samaria biaŋ, ka bahi daa kana ti lɛl o ʒim; ka pagɔra gba kana nti su di kom kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli shɛm la.
en: Some workers washed his chariot near a spring in Samaria, and prostitutes washed themselves in his blood. Dogs licked Ahab's blood off the ground, just as the Lord had warned.

dag: di zaa yoli, pa nyini n-yɛn me n jɛmbu duu maa, amaa a ni ti yɛn dɔɣi bidib so nti yɛn me n jɛmbu duu maa ti ma.
en: But you are not the one to build my temple. Your son will build my temple.

dag: Ka Naaman daa chaŋ o naa sani nti yɛl o, Izraɛl bipuɣimbil la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ.
en: When Naaman heard of this, he went to the king and told him what the girl had said.

dag: Amaa goli biɛɣ pinaanu dali ka Yɛhudianim bɛn daa be Susa puuni maa bɛn daa zaŋ leei bɛ Vuhim Dabisili. Bɛ ni daa na kul be bɛ dimnim maa kubu ni biɛɣ pinaata mini biɛɣ pinaanahi dali, ka daa ti chɛ ba kubu la biɛɣ pinaanu dal la zuɣu.
en: The Jews of Susa, however, made the fifteenth a holiday, since they had slaughtered their enemies on the thirteenth and fourteenth and then stopped on the fifteenth.

dag: Yinim bɛn be dabitim ni ka mali tahima pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ, labimiya yi birini ni na. N yɛri ya mi, n ni niŋ alibarika ʒii buyi zuɣu niŋ yi ni.
en: Return to the stronghold, prisoners of hope. Moreover, declare today that I will return double to you.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim nyaaŋa ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa kpaŋsi Pool suhu ka o lo nia ni o ni doli Masidɔnia mini Akaia polo chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm; ka daa lan yɛli ni o yi paai Jɛrusalɛm, shee ka o gari Rom gba.
en: After this, Paul made plans to go to Jerusalem. He planned to go through the regions of Macedonia and Achaia, and then go to Jerusalem. He thought, After I visit Jerusalem, I must also visit Rome.

dag: Ka o daa laɣim maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim na ti yɛli ba, Chamiya Juda fɔntinsi ni ti chɛ ka Izraɛlnim zaa tɔhi liɣiri ka yi zaŋ li na ka ti ti maani yi Naawuni jɛmbu duu ŋɔ yuuni kam. Niŋmiya lala yomyom. Amaa ka Lɛvinim maa daa bi niŋdi yomyom.
en: He ordered the priests and the Levites to go to the cities of Judah and collect from all the people enough money to make the annual repairs on the Temple. He told them to act promptly, but the Levites delayed.

dag: Ti tum a taali pam, ka bi dol a ni zali ti zaligu shɛl la zaŋ tabili zaligu shɛŋa din pahi n-nyɛ a ni daa zaŋ shɛŋa ti a dabili Musa la.
en: We have acted wickedly against you and have not done what you commanded. We have not kept the laws which you gave us through Moses, your servant.

dag: Nyamiya, m mali bipuɣins ayi bɛn na ʒi dɔbba, chɛliya ka n zaŋ ba tin ya na ka yi niŋ ba yi ni bɔri shɛm; ka di niŋ ya niriba ŋɔ shɛli, bɛ ni kpe n yili ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: I have two daughters who have never had sex. I'll bring them out, and you can do what you want with them. But don't harm these men. They are guests in my home.

dag: A mi ni bɛnkam be Ɛsha daa zoya ka chɛ ma, bɛ ni shɛba n-nyɛ Faijɛlus mini Hɛrimɔjɛneez.
en: You know that everyone in the province of Asia, including Phygelus and Hermogenes, has deserted me.

dag: O ni chɛ ka a wuntitali ne kaman wuntaŋ la, ka chɛ ka a yɛlimaŋli be kaman wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha neesim ni be shɛm la.
en: and will make your righteousness shine like the dawn, your justice like high noon.

dag: Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli yaɣili gomna Tatɛnai mini Shɛtaribɔzɛnai ni o zuɣulaantab bɛn daa nyɛ tuumba, ka be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili wulinluhili polo yaɣili ni la daa sabi gbaŋ tim Naa Darius sani.
en: This is a copy of the letter that Tattenai, the governor of the province Beyond the River, and Shethar-bozenai and his colleagues the officials who were in the province Beyond the River sent to King Darius.

dag: Ti bi lihirila binshɛŋa ti nini ni nyara, amaa ti lihirila binshɛŋa ti nini ni bi nyara, dama nir nini ni nyari binshɛŋa nyɛla din ku yuui, amaa binshɛŋa nir nini ni bi nyari nyɛla din ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Things that are seen don't last forever, but things that are not seen are eternal. This is why we keep our minds on the things that cannot be seen.

dag: Naawuni yɛligu din mali nyɛvili ka ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu la zuɣu ka yi nya dɔɣim palli, ka yɛligu maa ŋmanila bimbiɛlim din bi kpira, ka mi ku pooi.
en: Do this because God has given you new birth by his message that lives on forever.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ kuɣ viɛla pie taba kulis anahi zuɣu. Yi ni ti zaŋ kuɣ viɛl shɛŋa bɛ ni booni kanɛlian mini kirisolait ni ɛmɛrald m-pie taba kul shɛli din daŋ tooni.
en: Mount four rows of precious stones on it; in the first row mount a ruby, a topaz, and a garnet;.

dag: Chɛchɛbunsi sapashin kpamba maa ni daa ti nya Jɛhɔshafat, bɛ daa yɛlimi, Izraɛl naa maa m-bala. Di saha ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi lu o zuɣu ni bɛ tuh o, ka o daa kuhi, ka Yawɛ sɔŋ o n-kari ba bahi ka chɛ o.
en: When the chariot officers saw Jehoshaphat, they assumed that he must be Israels king, so they turned to attack him. But when Jehoshaphat cried out, the LORD helped him, and God lured them away from him.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ nahu mini buŋa n-tabili taba ni bɛ ko.
en: You must not plow with an ox and a donkey together.

dag: Yisa ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai saha shɛli maa, ka o dii wuɣiri duri zuɣusaa, ka bɛ kul lihir o hal ka sagbani ti lim o, ka bɛ bi lan nya o.
en: After saying this, he was taken up to heaven as they watched him, and a cloud hid him from their sight.

dag: Dinzuɣu man Yawɛ sujee ni n suhuyiɣisili maa dali, n ni ti chɛ ka zuɣusaa dam, ka chɛ ka tiŋgbani dam pam di biɛhigu shee.
en: I will make the heavens tremble, and the earth will be shaken out of its place on that day when I, the Lord Almighty, show my anger.

dag: Yuŋ ti ku lan beni; bɛ mi ti ku bɔri firila bee wuntaŋ neesim, dama ti Duuma Naawuni maŋmaŋa nti yɛn nyɛ bɛ neesim, ka bɛ ni ti di nam hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Night will be no more. They wont need the light of a lamp or the light of the sun, for the Lord God will shine on them, and they will rule forever and always.

dag: Babilɔn daa ŋmanila salima pipia m-be Yawɛ nuu ni, ka o daa chɛ ka dunia zuliya kam nyu o wain buɣi ka di zuɣu chɛ ka zuliya kam kpe yinyari.
en: Babylon was like a golden cup in the Lord s hand. Babylon made the whole world drunk. The nations drank Babylons wine, so they went crazy.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa yɛl o, N-hii, pumpɔŋɔ a yipa kahigiri yɛri ti, ka di pa ŋaha puuni yaha!.
en: Then his disciples said to him, Now you are speaking plainly, without using figures of speech.

dag: ni taataa ni gbarizam ni laɣipiɛliga ni wubiga min o balibu zaa.
en: the eagle owl, the short-eared owl, the long-eared owl, any kind of hawk.

dag: Ka kpatoonsi maa daa shini, ka kul kpaŋdi bɛmaŋ ni bɛ kpiɔŋ zaa ni bɛ zaŋ ŋarin titali maa lab du duli. Amaa ka teeku maa dambu kpiɔŋ daa kul maan pahirimi, ka bɛ kɔŋ chandi.
en: The sailors tried their best to row to the shore. But they could not do it, and the storm kept getting worse every minute.

dag: Chuɣu maa ni daa ti puhi yaɣi di puhibu pirigili saha ka Yisa daa chaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu nti wuhiri niriba.
en: When the festival was about half over, Jesus went into the temple and started teaching.

dag: Ka Izraɛl kpamba pisopɔin daa ʒe bɛ tooni, ka Jaazania ŋun daa nyɛ Shafan bidibiga la be bɛ ni. Bɛ zaɣ yino kam daa gbibila o tulaale zim tuɣilibu daaŋa o nuu ni, ka tulaale zim maa nyɔhi kpuɣi du zuɣusaa.
en: Seventy Israelite leaders were standing there, including Jaazaniah son of Shaphan. Each of these leaders was holding an incense burner, and the smell of incense filled the room.

dag: ka zaŋ o nuu pa bua maa zuɣu ni, ka kɔrig o Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa tooni, ka Aduna bidibisi zaŋ o ʒim kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini maa luɣilikam.
en: at the entrance to the sacred tent. Lay your hand on its head and have it killed there. A priest will then splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.

dag: Kaman bɛ ni gbahi jɛŋgbini bihi ka o suhu yiɣisi shɛm la, lala ka n suhu ni yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu. N ni dari tɔhi ba, ka ŋub ba kaman gbuɣinli la, kaman mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ŋ-ŋub ba la.
en: I will attack them like a bear whose cubs were robbed from her. I will attack them and rip open their chests. I will be like a lion or other wild animal tearing and eating its prey.

dag: Ti yab Ibrahimma daa nyɛla yuun kɔbiga nira, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o niŋgbuŋ gbarigi zaa, ka o paɣa Zara daa nyɛ paɣiŋoo, amaa di zaa yoli, o daa bi chɛ ka o yɛda gbarigi di zuɣu.
en: Abraham's faith never became weak, not even when he was nearly years old. He knew he was almost dead and that his wife Sarah could not have children.

dag: Jɛhɔzadak ka bɛ daa gbaai chaŋ tinzun tiŋa saha shɛli Naawuni ni daa zaŋ Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim niŋ Nɛbukadnɛza nuu ni ka o gbahi ba chaŋ la.
en: King Nebuchadnezzar deported Jehozadak along with the other people of Judah and Jerusalem whom the Lord sent into exile.

dag: Amaa Dauda daa naan ku tooi chaŋ nimaani ni o ti bɔhi Naawuni shɛli yɛla, dama o daa zɔrila Yawɛ malaika la takɔbi la dabiɛm.
en: but David was not able to go there to worship God, because he was afraid of the sword of the Lord 's angel.

dag: Zalim Izraɛlnim zaligu n-yɛli ba, M pina din nyɛ bindir shɛŋa yi ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim tiri ma ka di nyom niŋdi ma nyaɣisim la, zaŋmiya li tim ma di tibu saha.
en: to say to the people of Israel: Offer sacrifices to me at the appointed times of worship, so that I will smell the smoke and be pleased.

dag: Tuumbiɛrinim maa zaa so ʒimi? Bɛ zaŋla n niriba n-leei bindirigu dira, ka bi jɛmdi ma.
en: Don't they know? asks the Lord . Are all these evildoers ignorant? They live by robbing my people, and they never pray to me.

dag: Kum mini kpiimba biɛhigu shee ni na ʒi n-tiɣi shɛm la, lala ka ninsal nina gba na ʒi n-tiɣi.
en: Death and the grave are never satisfied, and neither are humans.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla dunia ŋɔ ni kɔŋko ka ti mali tahima Masia ni, dindina ti nyɛla nambɔ niriba gari sokam zaa.
en: If our hope in Christ is only for this life here on earth, then people should feel more sorry for us than for anyone else.

dag: Ka Yisa ni daa yuri nyaandol so la yɛli Pita, Ti Duuma m-bala! Pita daa pirigila o binyɛrigu sɔŋ ka tumdi tuma, ka o ni daa ti wum ni di nyɛla bɛ Duuma maa, ka o zaŋ o binyɛrigu maa ye n-kpilim lu teeku kom maa ni ha.
en: Jesus' favorite disciple told Peter, It's the Lord! When Simon heard it was the Lord, he put on the clothes he had taken off while he was working. Then he jumped into the water.

dag: Ka di gari bɛnkam zaa daa wum o baŋsim yɛtɔɣa min o ni daa garigiri ba shɛm maa.
en: Everyone who heard him was amazed at his understanding and wise answers.

dag: Bɛ ni wum kikaa maa kumsi, ka zaŋ li niŋ bɛ baɣaka zuɣu, bɛ kum zambu ni ʒila bɛmaŋmaŋ zuɣu. Amaa bɛ yi di deei saɣisigu maa, bɛ naan tiligi bɛ nyɛviya.
en: His death is his own fault, because he paid no attention to the warning. If he had paid attention, he could have escaped.

dag: Di simdi ni yi zaŋ biɛhigu pal shɛli Naawuni ni daa nam ka di ŋmani ŋun Naawuni maŋmaŋ biɛhigu ka nyɛ din tuhi ka be kasi n-ye kaman binyɛrigu la.
en: and you must put on the new self, which is created in God's likeness and reveals itself in the true life that is upright and holy.

dag: Ka o daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ salima mali nyɔtaɣirisi kɔbisita, ka zaɣ yini kam daa di salima din tibisim nyɛ kaman kilɔgiram ata, ka o daa zaŋ di zaa niŋ Lɛbanɔn dakuɣuri yil la ni.
en: and three hundred small shields of hammered gold, using seven and a half pounds of hammered gold in each shield. The king placed these in the Forest of Lebanon Palace.

dag: Ka bɛn be ŋariŋ maa ni daa jɛm o ka yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni Bia n-shiri nyɛ a.
en: Then the disciples in the boat worshiped Jesus. Truly you are the Son of God! they exclaimed.

dag: O daa chɛ ka kɔzɔrim yi tampiŋ ni na n-zɔri kaman mɔɣa kom la.
en: God made streams flow from the rock, made water run like rivers.

dag: Hɛzɛkia yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaanu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pihitayinika. O ma yuli n-daa booni Abija, o daa nyɛla Zakaria bipuɣiŋga.
en: Hezekiah became king when he was years old, and he ruled for twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Abijah; she was Zechariahs daughter.

dag: Amaa di nyaaŋa n ni ti labisi Ammɔnnim daazichi ti ba. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Afterward, though, I will bring back the Ammonites from captivity, declares the LORD.

dag: N yura maa n su ma ka n gba su o. O chɛ ka o biŋkɔbbaligu ŋubiri mɔri Paɣiviɛligakushihikom shee.
en: I belong to my lover and my lover belongs to me— the one grazing among the lilies.

dag: Ka bɛ dii ŋmaligi lihi bɛ luɣa zuɣu, ka bi lan nya so naɣ pahila Yisa ko.
en: They took a quick look around but did not see anyone else; only Jesus was with them.

dag: Ka o yɛli, Saamba sani. O ni daa yɛli ni saamba sani maa, ka Yisa yɛli, Ka dindina tiŋbihi bɛn nuu kani.
en: Peter answered, The other people pay the taxes. Jesus said, Then the children of the king dont have to pay taxes.

dag: O yi kana ti gbaag a kpɛhi duu, ka kar a saria, ŋuni n-leei ni tooi ŋme o naŋgbankpeeni?.
en: If God decides to arrest you and take you to court, no one could stop him.

dag: Amaa tin shɛli din yuli daa booni Ɛkibatana ka di be Miidia tiŋgbɔŋ yaɣili la ni ka bɛ daa ti nya litaafi shɛli ka sabbu ŋɔ be di ni:.
en: Finally, a scroll was found in Ecbatana, the capital of Media Province, and it said: This official record will show.

dag: Ti Duuma lan yɛli: Dinzuɣu yimiya buɣa ni na n-woligi yi ko ka chɛ ba; ka di niŋya din ni ta nir daɣiri, ka n deei ya.
en: And so the Lord says, You must leave them and separate yourselves from them. Have nothing to do with what is unclean, and I will accept you.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa dii guui chaŋ ti du n-tam Filistia doo maa zuɣu, ka darigi ŋooi ŋun Filistia doo maa maŋmaŋ takɔbi di tɔɣu ni n-zaŋ li ku o, ka ŋma o zuɣu. Filistianim maa ni daa nya ka bɛ tiyaawumya maa kpi maa, ka bɛ ŋmaligi guui.
en: David ran over and pulled out Goliath's sword. Then he used it to cut off Goliath's head. When the Philistines saw what had happened to their hero, they started running away.

dag: Bɛ zaa nyɛla zinaniŋdiba. Bɛ ŋmanila bɔrɔbɔro du shɛli bɛ ni mali buɣim niŋ ka di bii, ka bɔrɔbɔromaana bi lan niŋ buɣim niŋ di ni bɔrɔbɔro ŋɔribu saha hal ti paai di dubu saha la.
en: A baker presses dough to make bread. He puts the bread in the oven. He does not make the fire hotter while the bread is rising. But the people of Israel are not like that. They are always making their fire hotter.

dag: Piimiya zuliya kam ni toondaan yino ka bɛ pahi piri tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti ba ka bɛ su li.
en: and the leaders of all the tribes. There will be one leader from each tribe. These men will divide the land.

dag: O maari suhugarigunim suhuri, ka tibiri bɛ dansi.
en: He heals the broken-hearted and bandages their wounds.

dag: Bimbɔ ka tumtumdiba lee nyari bɛ tuma puuni?.
en: What do workers gain from all their hard work?.

dag: Ka bɛ nini daa mooi ka bɛ mɔhiri vuri yɛri ni o kul kpahim o mi tabili dapulli zuɣu. Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa saɣi ti bɛ ni bɔri shɛm maa.
en: But they were adamant, shouting their demand that Jesus be crucified. Their voices won out.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim daa yi bɛ ni be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni luɣ shɛŋa zaa ni kul o sani.
en: The priests and Levites from the northern tribes of Israel gave their support to King Rehoboam.

dag: Bɛ maanila nazuɣuri ansarisi, ka mali nanim diɛmda. Bɛ larila bɛ ni me gooni gili tin shɛŋa, ka kɔriti taŋkpaɣu duhiri ni bɛ dee li.
en: They make fun of rulers and laugh at fortresses, while building dirt mounds so they can capture cities.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, Bɛ nya nanima anu la ka bɛ sɔɣi bela vol ni Makɛda.
en: but someone found them hiding in that cave. Joshua learned about this.

dag: Ka Jɛhu daa lan yɛli, Molimiya Baal jɛmbu dabisili molo. Ka bɛ daa moli di molo maa.
en: Then Jehu ordered, Proclaim a day of worship in honor of Baal! The proclamation was made.

dag: Ka yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa din be Naawuni Kundi ni yila Naawuni nol ni na, ka nyɛ din mali buchi pam zaŋ chaŋ wuhibu mini saɣisibu ni zuɣu ni kpahibu ni wuntia soli wuhibu polo.
en: All Scripture is given by God. And all Scripture is useful for teaching and for showing people what is wrong in their lives. It is useful for correcting faults and teaching the right way to live.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ ti deei litaafi maa ŋun ʒi nam ʒiishee maa nudirigu ni.
en: The Lamb went and took the scroll from the right hand of the one who sits on the throne.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yɛli ni o bɔri shɛli ka di shiri niŋ, ka di pala ti Duuma n-zal li?.
en: Who ever spoke and it happened if my Lord hadnt commanded the same?.

dag: Yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ ka Dauda daa zaŋ yɛl o niriba maa, ka daa bi saɣi ni bɛ chaŋ ti liri Sool Ka Sool daa ti yiɣisi voli maa ni yina chaŋ o chandi.
en: So David held his soldiers in check by what he said, and he wouldnt allow them to attack Saul. Saul then left the cave and went on his way.

dag: N ku chɛ yimaŋmaŋ nyɛviya yihibu biɛri bɔhibu. Ka biŋkɔbigu yi ku ninsala, bɛn kum o yo. Ka so yi ku o mabia, bɛn kum o yo.
en: I created humans to be like me, and I will punish any animal or person that takes a human life. If an animal kills someone, that animal must die. And if a person takes the life of another, that person must be put to death.

dag: Ka ti Duuma malaika daa ti puhi zani Zakaria sani n-ʒe tulaale zim maa tuɣilibu shee nudirigu polo.
en: All at once an angel from the Lord appeared to Zechariah at the right side of the altar.

dag: Ka toli maa daa ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na n-yɛrigi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa. Ka bɛ galisim maa kpee daa na ʒi n-niŋ, ka di kpee mi ku lan niŋ.
en: were swarming everywhere. Never before had there been so many locusts in Egypt, and never again will there be so many.

dag: Ti bemi kaman suhugarigunima, amaa ka lee kul mali suhupiɛlli. Ti bemi kaman faranima, amaa ka lee nyɛ bɛn chɛ ka niriba pam leeri bundaannima. Ti bemi kaman bɛn ka shɛli, amaa ka lee nyɛ bɛn su binshɛɣukam.
en: as going through pain but always happy, as poor but making many rich, and as having nothing but owning everything.

dag: Amaa ka Jona daa yiɣisi n-zaŋ kpa Speen polo ni o zo Yawɛ sani. O daa chaŋla tin shɛli din yuli booni Jɔpa la nti nya ŋarin tital shɛli din chani Speen, ka o yo di samli ka kpe ŋariŋ maa ni pahi ŋariŋ maa tumtumdib zuɣu ni o zo Yawɛ sani chaŋ Speen.
en: So Jonah got up—to flee to Tarshish from the LORD! He went down to Joppa and found a ship headed for Tarshish. He paid the fare and went aboard to go with them to Tarshish, away from the LORD.

dag: Sulemaana ni daa sɔŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa tampuɣili dahin shɛli ka tum tuun shɛŋa m-mali hal ti me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa naai zaa shɛm m-bala.
en: By this time all of Solomon's projects had been completed. From the laying of the foundation of the Lord 's Temple to its completion, all the work had been successful.

dag: N ni ti yihi yi ni bɛn nyɛ duŋtaariba la mini bɛn birigi n sani la bahi. N ni ti yihi ba bɛ ni be tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni nyɛ saamba la na, amaa bɛ ti ku kpe Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Di saha ka yi ni ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will separate the sinful rebels from the rest of you, and even though I will bring them from the nations where they live in exile, they won't be allowed to return to Israel. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Yawɛ, a yuli kul ni beni sahakam. Yawɛ, a niriba kul ni mi a yɛla ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: Lord , your name will be famous forever! Lord , people will remember you forever and ever.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ a ni lihi ʒiɛm ma ka kpuɣi Yuria ŋun nyɛ Hiti nir la paɣa maa zuɣu, ninvuɣ kubo kul ku milig a yili ŋɔ.
en: Because you wouldn't obey me and took Uriah's wife for yourself, your family will never live in peace.

dag: Ka bundan maa lan yɛli, N yab Ibrahimma, pa lala n-nyɛ li. So n-yi di neei kum ni chaŋ bɛ sani nti yɛli ba, bɛ naan niŋ tuuba.
en: The rich man answered, That is not enough, father Abraham! But if someone were to rise from death and go to them, then they would turn from their sins.

dag: Bɛ puhim chuɣu maa ka di di bindirigu mini bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi ni vari din to gol so ŋun pah ayi biɛɣ pinaanahi dali.
en: But it must be done in the second month, in the evening of the fourteenth day. Eat the Passover lamb with thin bread and bitter herbs.

dag: N yi ti yɛn darig a tibili dahin shɛli, a ni tooi mali suhukpeeni bee a nuhi ni tooi mali yaa? Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa, ka mi ni niŋ li.
en: Will your strength and courage endure when I deal with you? I am the LORD: I speak, and I act!.

dag: Yi yɛm bi yaɣi lala? Yinim bɛn daa piligi Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni ŋɔ, yi yɛn zaŋla yimaŋmaŋ yiko naai?.
en: How can you be so stupid? Do you think that by yourself you can complete what God's Spirit started in you?.

dag: Yɛlimaŋ shɛli n ni wum Naawuni sani, dina ka m mali tɔɣisiri ya ka yi bɔri ni yi ku ma maa, amaa Ibrahimma daa bi niŋdi lala.
en: Instead, you want to kill me, though I am the one who has spoken the truth I heard from God. Abraham didnt do this.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Hɛzɛkia mini Amɔz bia anabi Aizaia daa kuhi pam suhi Naawuni yɛlli ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Then King Hezekiah and the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz prayed to God and cried out to him for help.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Di saha maa kpa shɛli din daa kpa luɣ viɛlli shee la ti ku lan beni, bɛ ni ti ŋma li luhi, ka ʒi shɛli din daa ʒi di zuɣu la kpalim yoli. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: On that day, says the LORD of heavenly forces, the peg that is fastened securely will give way; it will be cut down, and it will fall, and all the load hanging on it will be lost. The LORD has spoken.

dag: Asaf n-daa nyɛ bɛ kpɛma, ka bɛn daa dol o nyaaŋa nyɛ Zakaria mini Jɛiɛl ni Shɛmiramɔt ni Jɛhiɛl ni Matitia ni Ɛliab ni Bɛnaaya ni Obɛdɛdom ni Jɛiɛl bɛn daa nyɛ mɔɣilo mini goonjɛŋmɛriba la. Asaf n-daa nyɛ ŋun yɛn ŋmɛri guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisa la.
en: Asaph was their leader, and Zechariah was his assistant. Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom, and another man named Jeiel were appointed to play small harps and stringed instruments. Asaph himself played the cymbals.

dag: Jɔn ni daa ti mirit o tuma naabu o daa bɔhi niriba, Yi lee tɛhiya ni n nyɛla ŋuni? Ka lan ŋmaligi yɛli ba, M pala yi ni yuuni so sol la. Ŋun na be n nyaaŋa kanna, hal man pɔri ni n ti damd o tooni n-gbaag o namda mal o ka o pirigi gba. .
en: And as John was about to finish his mission, he said to the people, Who do you think I am? I am not the one you are waiting for. But listen! He is coming after me, and I am not good enough to take his sandals off his feet.

dag: Ka Ɛsta daa yɛli, Naa, a yi saɣi, nyin chɛ ka Yɛhudianim bɛn be Susa ŋɔ sa niŋ bɛ ni niŋ shɛm zuŋɔ ŋɔ biɛɣuni yaha; ka lan chɛ ka bɛ sa zaŋ Haman bidibisi pia la ti yili dari.
en: Esther answered, If the king wishes, let the Jews who are in Susa also have tomorrow to do what the law allows for today. And let them also impale the ten sons of Haman on pointed poles.

dag: N ni dɔni gbihi ni suhudoo; dama nyin Yawɛ kɔŋko n-chɛ ka n dooni ni alaafee.
en: When I go to bed, I sleep in peace, because, Lord , you keep me safe.

dag: N timla Tikikus Ɛfɛsus.
en: I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb nyɛ namɔɣilisi la bɛ dɔɣibu ni, ka salinim niŋ shɛb lala, ka shɛb mi zaŋ bɛmaŋ leei lala niriba la alizanda nam zuɣu. Ŋun ni tooi deei wuhibu ŋɔ, ŋun deem li.
en: Some people are unable to marry because of birth defects or because of what someone has done to their bodies. Others stay single in order to serve God better. Anyone who can accept this teaching should do so.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa ti neerina ka malaikanim maa kpam Lɔt jaande yɛra, Yiɣisim zaŋ a paɣ min a bipuɣins ayi bɛn be a sani ŋɔ n-zo n-yi yaŋɔ, di yi pa lala, yaŋɔnim ni yɛn nya tibidarigibo shɛli maa ni tabili ya.
en: Early the next morning the two angels tried to make Lot hurry and leave. They said, Take your wife and your two daughters and get away from here as fast as you can! If you don't, every one of you will be killed when the Lord destroys the city.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ma, Daansi ŋɔ ni ka bɛn tumdi tuma Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni yɛn duɣiri niriba maa sara maligu binyara.
en: The man said to me, These are the kitchens where those who serve at the Temple cook the sacrifices for the people.

dag: Ka sokam daa kpuɣ o laa m-mooi buɣim niŋ di ni, ka niŋ tulaale zim pa di zuɣu. Ka bɛ mini Musa ni Aduna daa zani Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni.
en: So they each took their fire pans, put live coals and incense on them, and stood at the entrance of the Tent with Moses and Aaron.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Bɛrishiiba; dama nimaani ka bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa daa laɣim po pɔri.
en: So after that, the well was called Beersheba. Abraham gave the well this name because it was the place where they made a promise to each other.

dag: Amaa a yi kpuɣ paɣa, a bi tum alahichi; ka paɣisarili gba yi kuli doo, o bi tum alahichi. Amaa bɛ lee ni di wahala dunia ŋɔ ni yɛla zuɣu. M mi bɔrimi ni n yihi ya wahala shɛli lala niriba ni diri maa ni.
en: But if you do marry, you haven't committed a sin; and if an unmarried woman marries, she hasn't committed a sin. But I would rather spare you the everyday troubles that married people will have.

dag: Ti yaannim mini ti nanim ni ti zuɣulaannim ni ti maligumaaniba daa zaɣis a fukumsi zaligu la dolibu, ka daa lan zaɣisi a zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la mini zuɣu ni kpahibu yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa a ni daa zaŋ ti ba la.
en: Our kings, our officials, our priests, and our ancestors havent kept your Instruction. They havent heeded your commandments and the warnings that you gave them.

dag: O daa bɔh o bipalitab maa mi, Yi lee tɛhiya ni wula ka di simdi ni ti yɛli niriba bɛn yɛli ma, Filimmi ʒi tibisi shɛl a ba ni daa ʒil ti la? .
en: What do you advise me to do? he asked. What shall I say to the people who are asking me to make their burdens lighter.

dag: Di saha ka Ilaija daa lan yɛli niriba maa, N kɔŋko n-kul kpalim nyɛ Yawɛ daanabi, amaa ka Baal ŋun mali anabinim kɔbisinahi ni pihinu.
