en: Then Elijah said, I am the only prophet of the Lord still left, but there are prophets of Baal.

dag: Di ku yuui ka ninvuɣ biɛri vuui; hal a yi lihi viɛnyɛliŋga m-bo ba, bɛ ku beni.
en: In just a little while the wicked wont exist! If you go looking around their place, they wont be there.

dag: Amaa ka Ibram daa yɛli, M pun po Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ.
en: Abram answered, I solemnly swear before the Lord , the Most High God, Maker of heaven and earth.

dag: Bɛ daa dala chɛchɛbunsi tuhi pihitanaayi, ka daa lan da Maaka naa min o tɔbbihi pahi, ka bɛ daa kana ti dɔni Mɛdɛba tooni. Ka Ammɔnnim daa yi bɛ tinsi ni na ni bɛ ti tuhi tɔbu.
en: The thirty-two thousand chariots they hired and the army of the king of Maacah came and camped near Medeba. The Ammonites too came out from all their cities and got ready to fight.

dag: bee n-zo nandan nambɔɣu o saria karibu ni o ni nyɛ nandan zuɣu.
en: And don't favor the poor, simply because they are poor.

dag: Zaŋmiya li lo yi nuhi ni ka di leei shihirili, ka zaŋ li lo m-pa yi gbɛri zuɣu kaman saba la.
en: Tie them on your hand as a sign. They should be on your forehead as a symbol.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali suhuyini mal alibarika, dama bɛ ni ti nya Naawuni.
en: Happy are the pure in heart; they will see God!.

dag: Ka yi ni tooi zaŋ paɣiba mini biliɛri ni niɣi ni binshɛɣukam din be tiŋ maa ni zaa leei yi ni tuhi tɔbu di neen shɛŋa. Yi ni tooi di Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ yi dimnim neen shɛŋa tin ya maa.
en: But you may take for yourselves the women, the children, the cattle, and everything else in the city. You may use all these things. The Lord your God has given these things to you.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ma la di vi ka birim. Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ni bɛ niŋ ma zaɣ biɛɣu la di vi ka ŋmaligi labi.
en: Disappoint and confuse all who want to kill me. Turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla din kpaŋsi ti suhuri. Ka din pahi timaŋmaŋ suhukpaŋsibo ŋɔ zuɣu nyɛla, ti mali suhupiɛlli pam Taitus suhupiɛlli nyabu la zuɣu, dama o tɛha dɔniya yi zaa zuɣu.
en: Because of this we have been encouraged. And in addition to our own encouragement, we were even more pleased at how happy Titus was. His mind has been put at rest by all of you.

dag: Lala mi ka ti Duuma zali ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mooni lahibal suŋ ŋɔ molo gba dirila lahibal suŋ maa tuma ni.
en: It is the same with those who have the work of telling the Good News. The Lord has commanded that those who tell the Good News should get their living from this work.

dag: Amaa n ni ti teei n ni daa lo a alikauli shɛli a bipolitali saha la yɛla, ka lan lo a alikauli shɛli din ku naai.
en: But I remember the agreement I made with you when you were young, and so I will make you a promise that will last forever.

dag: Suhimiya Naawuni, ka tɛhiya din yɛn niŋ ya pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chani yɛla nya. Yi ni daa na bi piligi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ŋɔ mɛbu tuma.
en: So now, take it to heart from this day forward. Before stone was placed on stone in the LORDs temple.

dag: Pomiya pɔri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani, ka niŋya kaman yi ni po shɛm maa. Chɛliya ka zuliya shɛb bɛn kɔɣilikɔɣili la nim zaa zaŋ pina na ti ti ŋun nyɛ binzɔrigu maa.
en: Make promises to the LORD your God and keep them! Let all around him bring gifts to the awesome one.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka a ʒim zo n-tiɛli tiŋgbani hal ti taɣi zoya, ka a ti pali kulibɔna.
en: I will pour out your blood until it spreads over the mountains and fills the streams.

dag: Chɛ ka ti chaŋ Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni, ka ti zaa ti ŋma dari na nti me duri pahi beni. Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Chamiya.
en: Why don't we build a new meeting place near the Jordan River? Each of us could get some wood, then we could build it. That's a good idea, Elisha replied, get started.

dag: Babilɔn nyɛla nam tiŋgban suŋ gari nam tiŋgbana zaa. Di nyɛla Kalidianim jilima ni bɛ ni mali shɛli nyuri bara. Man Naawuni ni wurim li kaman n ni daa wurim Sɔdom mini Gomɔra shɛm la.
en: So Babylon, a jewel among kingdoms, the Chaldeans splendor and pride, will be like Sodom and Gomorrah, destroyed by God.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni sa gɔhi ŋar o soli, ka me gooni gu o soli, ka o ku lan tooi nya soli.
en: So I, the Lord, will block Israels road with thorns, and I will build a wall. Then she will not be able to find her path.

dag: O daa ku tiŋgbana pam niriba, ka ku nanim bɛn mali yaa.
en: He defeated many nations and killed powerful kings.

dag: Naa Darius ŋun daa nyɛ Miidia tiŋgbɔŋ ni nir la nam dibu yuun tuuli la ni ka n daa yiɣisi n-niŋ nia kpaŋs o.
en: You also need to know that I protected and helped Darius the Mede in his first year as king.

dag: Bindir maŋli nyɛla ninkura bɛn zaŋ bɛ tɛha bɔhim baŋ zaɣ suŋ mini zaɣ biɛɣu woligibu ni nyɛ shɛm dini.
en: But solid food is for the mature, whose senses are trained by practice to distinguish between good and evil.

dag: Aruna daa bela o kabɔɣili maa ni buri alikama, ka daa ti ŋmaligi lihi nya malaika maa, ka o bidibis anahi bɛn daa be o sani daa zo n-sɔɣi.
en: There at the threshing place Araunah and his four sons were threshing wheat, and when they saw the angel, the sons ran and hid.

dag: N kul je ba la jɛri maŋli; n zaŋ ba leela n dimnima.
en: Yes, I hate them—through and through! Theyve become my enemies too.

dag: nti be nimaani hal ka a biɛli suhuyiɣisili maa ti chɛ.
en: Live with him for a short while until your brothers rage subsides.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa pun be kurimbuni ha la, so bi lan teeri bɛ yɛla. Lala n-nyɛ li ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ti yɛn doli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn na yɛn yi dunia palo ŋɔ ni na nyaaŋa ti ku teei bɛ gba yɛla.
en: No one remembers what has happened in the past, and no one in days to come will remember what happens between now and then.

dag: Izraɛlnim Naawuni tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa. Izraɛl tampiŋ la yɛli ma: So yi doli yɛlimaŋli soli n-su o niriba, ka su ba ni Naawuni zɔbo.
en: Our Mighty Rock, the God of Jacob, told me, A ruler who obeys God and does right.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa yɛl o yiŋ tumtumdiba kpɛma, Niŋm bindira su niriba maa kpalansi ni ka di saɣi bɛ ʒibu tariga, ka zaŋ bɛ zaa yinoyino liɣiri niŋ bɛ kpalansi noya ni;.
en: Joseph commanded the servant in charge of his house, Fill the men's sacks with as much food as they can carry, and put each man's money in the top of his sack.

dag: ka o yidan maa wum li ka bi yɛl o shɛli, ka mi bi galim li, dindina o pɔri maa min o ni lo alikauli shɛŋa zaa ni o ni niŋ shɛli maa ni zani.
en: and her husband hears, keeps silent, and doesnt express disapproval to her—then all her solemn promises will stand and all her binding obligations for herself will stand.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: Just then, the Lord God said:.

dag: Amaa yinim bɛn daa kul ʒe Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yim la zaa n-na be yi nyɛviya ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: But all of you that were faithful to the Lord your God are still alive today.

dag: Bɛ zuliya maa ni ninvuɣ zuɣuri yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Mɛshɔbab mini Jamlɛk ni Amazia bia Jɔsha.
en: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah son of Amaziah.

dag: Ifriim tiŋgbɔŋ ku lan mali birini, ka Damaskusnim kɔŋ nam. Ka Aramnim bɛn kpalim ni kɔŋ jilima kaman Izraɛlnim ni kɔŋ shɛm la. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Israel will be defenseless, and Damascus will lose its independence. Those Syrians who survive will be in disgrace like the people of Israel. I, the Lord Almighty, have spoken.

dag: Dama ti yab Ibrahimma yi daa yi taali ni Naawuni sani la o tuma zuɣu, o daa naan mal li kuuna, amaa ka pa ni Naawuni sani.
en: If he was put right with God by the things he did, he would have something to boast about—but not in God's sight.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ nudirigu gbali ti maligumaana, ka di leeg o tarili a suhudoo sara maligu maa ni.
en: You will give the right thigh of your communal sacrifice of well-being to the priest as a gift.

dag: Naŋgban shɛli din ŋmari ʒiri je di ni ŋmari ʒiri pari shɛb maa, ka naŋgbammalisim tahiri saɣiŋgu na.
en: Watch out for anyone who tells lies and flatters— they are out to get you.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan yɛli Ibrahimma, Di simdi ni a min a zuliya maa gbibi n daalikauli maa bɛ ʒiɛmana zaa ni.
en: Abraham, you and all future members of your family must promise to obey me.

dag: ka bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a daa chaŋ bɛn bi gundi sani, ka a mini ba ti laɣindi timdi dira.
en: They accused him, You went into the home of the uncircumcised and ate with them.

dag: Ka Dauda suhu daa saɣim pam, dama o niriba maa suhuri daa yiɣisimi, ka bɛ yɛli ni bɛ ni lab o kuɣa. Dama sokam daa kul fabindila o bidibisi min o bipuɣinsi zuɣu. Amaa ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Dauda Naawuni ŋɔ daa kpaŋs o suhu.
en: All the men in the army were sad and angry because their sons and daughters were taken as prisoners. The men were talking about killing David with stones. This upset David very much, but he found strength in the Lord his God.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa ti yɛli Yisifu, N zahimla zahindi ka bi nya so ŋun ni wuhi ma di gbinni; ka n wum ka bɛ yɛli ma ni bɛ yi yɛl a zahindi ni nyɛ shɛm, a ni tooi wuhi di gbinni.
en: The king said to him, I have had a dream, and no one can explain it. I have been told that you can interpret dreams.

dag: Amaa Sool ni daa nya ka Yawɛ be Dauda sani, ka o bipuɣiŋga Mikal gba yur o maa.
en: Saul realized clearly that the Lord was with David and also that his daughter Michal loved him.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛla ba yaha, Dinzuɣu di zɔriya ba dabiɛm, dama binshɛɣu kani din sɔɣiya ka ti ku yi palo, binshɛɣu mi kani m-be ashilɔni ka bɛ ti ku baŋ li.
en: Therefore, dont be afraid of those people because nothing is hidden that wont be revealed, and nothing secret that wont be brought out into the open.

dag: Ka Bɔrɔbɔro din ka Dabindi Chuɣu la piligu dali daa ti paai, bɛ ni daa yi kɔrigiri Yaɣigari Chuɣu piɛbihi dahin shɛl la.
en: The Day of Unleavened Bread arrived, when the Passover had to be sacrificed.

dag: O chɛ ka goli mini saŋmarisi su yuŋ. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He lets the moon and the stars rule each night. God's love never fails.

dag: O tizo Oholiba daa nya dimbɔŋɔ, amaa ka o pagɔrisigu tumbu min o kɔre daa bie n-gar o biɛli maa dini.
en: Her younger sister Oholibah saw all these things happen. But Oholibah sinned more than her sister did! She was more unfaithful than Oholah.

dag: Di saha ka Abimilɛk daa boli Ibrahimma na nti bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ ti lala? Taal bɔ ka n lee tum a ka a ti chɛ ka m mini n nam ŋɔ tum alahichi titali ŋɔ? A niŋ ma di ni bi simdi ni nir niŋ o kpee shɛm.
en: Then Abimelech called Abraham and asked, What have you done to us? What wrong have I done to you to make you bring this disaster on me and my kingdom? No one should ever do what you have done to me.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Fukumsi zaligunim zaa ni, din nyɛ kpɛma nyɛla, Izraɛlnima, wummiya! Ti Duuma Naawuni nyɛla Duuma yino.
en: Jesus answered, The most important command is this: People of Israel, listen! The Lord our God is the only Lord.

dag: nyin Naawuni naan dii nya, dama a mi ti daashili tɛha din be ti suhuri ni.
en: If we did, then God knows it, because he knows our deepest secrets.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli, N yi bi ŋma Shafat bia Ilaisha la zuɣu zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, Naawuni ŋun niŋm ma din gari lala.
en: He said, So may God do to me, and more, if the head of Elisha, Shaphats son, remains on his shoulders today.

dag: Ka naa daa ti chaŋ Gibiɔn ni o ti mali sara shɛli nimaani, dama nimaani n-daa nyɛ sara maligu shee din galisi pam. Sulemaana daa yi zaŋdila bɛ ni mali sara maligu shɛli nyɔri buɣim la bin tuhili m-maani sara bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: The most important shrine was in Gibeon, and Solomon had offered more than , sacrifices on that altar.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti ti din viɛla, ka ti puri atam niŋ pam.
en: The Lord will give us many good things. The ground will grow many good crops.

dag: Ka bɛ gba daa yɛl o yɛtɔɣ yinsi maa ka yɛli, Lala ka bɛ shiri yɛn niŋ ti ninvuɣ so ŋun ku doo ŋɔ.
en: They told him what would be done for the man who killed Goliath.

dag: ni o wuh o kpambaliba o ni bɔri shɛm, ka wuh o kpamba mi yɛm.
en: to make sure his princes acted according to his will, and to teach wisdom to his advisors.

dag: Dina n-ni chɛ ka a niŋ Yawɛ naani. N chɛ ka a baŋ li zuŋɔ, iin, n chɛ ka a baŋ li.
en: I am teaching them today, so that you may trust the Lord .

dag: Ka niriba daa yi daŋdi yibu chan o sani Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni ti wumd o yɛtɔɣa.
en: Everyone got up early and came to the temple to hear him teach.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Naawuni daa ti yɛn zahim Ibrahimma ka bol o, Ibrahimma! Ka Ibrahimma garigi yɛli, N-nyɛ ma.
en: Some years later God decided to test Abraham, so he spoke to him. Abraham answered, Here I am, Lord .

dag: Amaa ka Karia bia Jɔhanan mini tɔbbihi sapashin kpamba maa zaa daa zaŋ Judanim zaa bɛn daa kpalim ka nyɛ bɛn yi bɛ ni daa kari ba tahi tin shɛŋa ni zaa n-labina ni bɛ ti ʒini Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: Johanan, Kareahs son, and all the army officers took the remaining Judeans who had returned to the land of Judah after being scattered among the nations.

dag: Ka tiŋgul maa daa lan nya ka do so zɔrina ka o boli dunɔgula n-yɛl o, Nyama, do so lan zɔrina o kɔŋko. Ka naa yɛli, o gba ʒirila lahibali na.
en: Then the lookout saw another man running alone, and he called down to the gatekeeper, Look! There's another man running! The king answered, This one also is bringing good news.

dag: ka zaŋ yi tizɔbil maa ti ma na, dina n-ni chɛ ka m baŋ ni yi pala puɣisiriba, amaa ka nyɛla yɛlimaŋyɛriba, ka n naanyi zaŋ yi mabia maa tin ya ka yi gɔri kɔhigu tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni. .
en: But bring back your youngest brother to me. Then I will know that you are not spies but honest men. I will give your brother back to you, and you may travel throughout the country.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ gali sabilifaa ni gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain mali pumpɔrinchihi kɔtomsi niŋ di tiŋli ti tuui ka mali salima buɣilimbuɣilimbihi n-zaŋ li yiliyili di sunsuuni gili.
en: All around its lower hem put pomegranates of blue, purple, and red wool, alternating with gold bells.

dag: ka soli be di tooni. Duri maa daa bemi kaman nuzaa polo duri la. Di wɔɣilim mini di yɛliŋ zaa daa kul nyɛla yim. Ka niriba ni yɛn doli luɣ shɛŋa yira mini di mɛbu ni di dunoya zaa kul nyɛ yim.
en: In front of the rooms there was a passageway just like the one on the north side. It had the same measurements, the same design, and the same kind of entrances.

dag: Yɛhudianim bɛn daa be Bɛria daa nyaŋ niriba gari bɛn daa be Tɛsalɔnaika la, dama bɛ daa taɣi deei yɛligu maa ni suhupiɛlli, ka vihiri Naawuni litaafinim ni biɛɣukam ni bɛ nya yɛla maa shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: The people in Berea were more open-minded than those in Thessalonica. They were so glad to hear the message Paul told them. They studied the Scriptures every day to make sure that what they heard was really true.

dag: Ka ŋunkam yur o mabia nyɛla ŋun be neesim ni, ka shɛli ka di ni din ni chɛ ka so tuui.
en: Those who love their brothers and sisters live in the light, and there is nothing in them that will make them do wrong.

dag: chɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa bɔri nyini Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni ni bɛ suhu zaa ŋɔ taali, hal bɛ yi bi doli Naawuni jɛmbu duu kasitali zaligu la.
en: O Lord , the God of our ancestors, in your goodness forgive those who are worshiping you with all their heart, even though they are not ritually clean.

dag: Ibram daa mali buni pam. O daa mali biŋkɔbiri mini anzinfa ni salima.
en: Abram was very wealthy in livestock, silver, and gold.

dag: Ka o daa yɛl o tɔbbihi bɛn mali kpiɔŋ ni bɛ lom bɛ niriba ata maa mihi n-zaŋ ba ti bahi buɣim duu din buɣim diri pam maa ni.
en: And he commanded the strongest men in his army to tie the three men up and throw them into the blazing furnace.

dag: Kul paɣimiya Yawɛ ka duhimiy o yuli, ka molimiy o tuma yɛla zuliya kam ni.
en: Praise the Lord and pray in his name! Tell everyone what he has done.

dag: Ka n daa wum yɛtɔɣa kukolibil ni, ka n tibili daa wum di ni sɔɣiri yɛra.
en: A secret was told to me in a faint whisper—.

dag: Izraɛl naa ni daa nya ba, o daa bɔhila Ilaisha, M ba, n kum ba? N kum ba.
en: When the king of Israel saw the Syrians, he asked Elisha, Shall I kill them, sir? Shall I kill them.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yɛli, Mani m-mali n suhu ka di yi daɣiri ni, n yi n daalahichi ni.
en: Who can say, Im innocent to the core; Im cleansed from my sin?.

dag: Di saha ka n ni chaŋ nyin Naawuni sara maligu bimbin la gbini, luɣ shɛli din nyɛ nyin Naawuni ŋun tiri ma suhupiɛlli pam ŋɔ sani la; ka ŋme m mɔɣilo paɣi nyin Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Let me come to Gods altar— let me come to God, my joy, my delight— then I will give you thanks with the lyre, God, my God!.

dag: O daa bi niŋ bɛ sani n-gari biɛɣ pia bee biɛr anii, ka yiɣisi lab Siizaria. N-daa yi biɛɣu ka o chaŋ ti ʒin o sariadibo ʒiishee, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ Pool na.
en: Festus stayed in Jerusalem another eight or ten days and then went back to Caesarea. The next day Festus told the soldiers to bring Paul before him. Festus was seated on the judgment seat.

dag: Bɛ daa nyɛla Yawɛ ni zaŋ shɛb ni o buɣisi Izraɛlnim nya bɛ ni dol o zaligu shɛŋa o ni daa zaŋ ti Musa ka o ti bɛ yaannim la bee bɛ ku dol li.
en: He left those nations in the land to test the Israelites. He wanted to see if the Israelites would obey the Lord s commands that he had given to their ancestors through Moses.

dag: Nimaani ka n yɛn kahigi mmaŋ wuhi Izraɛlnima, ka n jilima ni ti chɛ ka nimaani mali be kasi.
en: There I will meet the people of Israel, and the dazzling light of my presence will make the place holy.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ wumma, Yawɛ piig a ni a me o jɛmbu duu din nyɛ luɣ kasi shee. Mali yaa n-tum di tuma.
en: The Lord has chosen you to build a temple for worshiping him. Be confident and do the work you have been assigned.

dag: Amaa ka Pool daa kuhi pam yɛl o, Di niŋ amaŋ shɛli, dama ti zaa be kpe.
en: But Paul shouted, Don't harm yourself! No one has escaped.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa tim tuumba Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa zaa sani nti bɔhi ba, Tuumbiɛ bɔ ka yi lee tum la?.
en: The Israelite tribes sent men throughout the whole tribe of Benjamin with this message: What about this evil act that happened among you?.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka daa doli Jɛrɔbɔam daalahichi tumbu soli min o ni daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi shɛl la soli.
en: but he did what the Lord said was wrong. He did the same sins that Jeroboam had done that caused the Israelites to sin.

dag: ka yɛri ba, Di sabiya, Man Naawuni duu nyɛla wunsuhigu duu. Amaa yinim zaŋ li leela ŋmɛnditoya duu! .
en: He said, The Scriptures say, My Temple will be a house of prayer. But you have changed it into a hiding place for thieves. .

dag: ka zaŋ firilanim la tamtam di zuɣu Yawɛ tooni kaman Yawɛ ni daa wuh o shɛm.
en: Then Moses put the lamps on the lampstand before the Lord . He did this just as the Lord had commanded him.

dag: Ka di daa ti lu o suhu ni ka o bɔh omaŋa, Padiriba ala n-lee be m ba yiŋa m-mali bindira diri tiɣiri ka chɛra, ka man ti be kpe kpiri kum?.
en: At last he came to his senses and said, All my father's hired workers have more than they can eat, and here I am about to starve!.

dag: Di saha ka Balak suhu daa yiɣisi pam bahi Balaam zuɣu, ka o zaŋ o nuhi kpahi taba ka yɛli Balaam, N zaŋ a mi na ni a ti yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛri bahi n dimnim ŋɔ zuɣu, amaa ka a ti niŋla alibarika niŋ bɛ ni siɣimsiɣim buta ŋɔ zaa.
en: Balak clenched his fists in anger and said to Balaam, I called you to curse my enemies, but three times now you have blessed them instead.

dag: Amaa teemiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yɛla, dama ŋuna n-niŋdi ya yiko ka yi nyari buni maa ni di chɛ ka o pal o ni daa po pɔri lo yi yaannim alikauli shɛl la kaman o ni niŋdi shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Remember the Lord your God is the one who gives you power to do these things. He does this because he wants to keep the agreement that he made with your ancestors, as he is doing today!.

dag: Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ ni wuhi ni o bɔri shɛlikam ni di zaŋ tum o jɛmbu duu maa tuma, nyin bom lala binyara maa ka di zaŋ tum di tuma maa viɛnyɛliŋga, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o suhu ku yiɣisi bahi m mini bɛn ti yɛn doli n nyaaŋa di nam zuɣu.
en: Whatever the God of heaven commands will be done carefully for the house of the God of heaven, or wrath will come upon the realm of the king and his heirs.

dag: Ka Farisiinim daa nya lala ka yɛli Yisa, Nyam a nyaandoliba maa ni tumdi din chihiri ni bɛ tum Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: The Pharisees saw this. They said to Jesus, Look! Your followers are doing something that is against the law to do on the Sabbath day.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Asha zuliya ni dɔbba, ka daa nyɛ bɛ daŋ ni dɔɣirikpamba ni tɔbutuhiri biinsi, ka lan nyɛ ninvuɣ gahinda. Bɛ dɔbba bɛn daa naan tooi chaŋ tɔbu ni kalinli daa nyɛla dɔbba tuhi pisinaayɔbu.
en: All of these were descendants of Asher. They were heads of families, famous fighting men, outstanding leaders. Asher's descendants included , men eligible for military duty.

dag: Ka bɛ daa paag o sani nti balim o pam yɛra, Sapashini maa simdi ni a sɔŋ o.
en: When they came to Jesus, they earnestly pleaded with Jesus. He deserves to have you do this for him, they said.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋdi buhi mini naɣilahi ʒim ni naɣisa so bɛ ni daa zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la tampiligim mihiri niriba niŋgbuna ni di chɛ ka bɛ mali be kasi, ka yi bɛ daadiini kaya dolibu taali ni.
en: According to the Law of Moses, those people who become unclean are not fit to worship God. Yet they will be considered clean, if they are sprinkled with the blood of goats and bulls and with the ashes of a sacrificed calf.

dag: Ɛhud kum nyaaŋa, Izraɛlnim daa lan tum alahichi zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ sani yaha.
en: After Ehud had died, the Israelites again did things that the LORD saw as evil.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi yi ni niŋ n dan maa din tuhi ni din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli, yin yɛlim ma, ka yi yi ku niŋ o, yin lan yɛlim ma. Ka n zaŋ kpa n nudirigu polo bee n nuzaa polo.
en: Now please tell me if you are willing to do the right thing for my master. Will you treat him fairly, or do I have to look for another young woman?.

dag: N kahigi n ni tum shɛlikam wuh a, ka a deei n suhigu; wuhim ma a zaligunima.
en: I confessed all I have done, and you answered me; teach me your ways.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka buɣim di Tɛman n-saɣim bɛ ni me goma gili luɣ shɛŋa Bɔzira la.
en: So I will send a fire on Teman; it will devour the fortresses of Bozrah.

dag: Yinim Chɛrɛti zuliya bɛn be teeku noli ŋɔ, mbusim be yi zuɣu. Yawɛ yɛligu nyɛla din jɛndi nyini Keenan din nyɛ Filistianim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ; n ni saɣim a zaa hal ka so ti ku lan kpalim be a ni.
en: You Philistines are doomed, you people who live along the coast. The Lord has passed sentence on you. He will destroy you, and not one of you will be left.

dag: Amaa naa ni mali suhupiɛlli Naawuni sani, ka bɛnkam zaa zaŋ Naawuni yuli m-po pɔri ni mali suhupiɛlli dama ʒiŋmariba ni fo bɛ noya.
en: But the king will be happy with his God, and those who promised to obey him will praise him when he defeats those liars.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, niriba ŋɔ nyɛla bɛn namdi tuumbiɛri tumbu, ka wuhiri niriba yikombiɛlim tuma tiŋ maa ni.
en: He said to me: Human one, these men devise evil plans and give wicked advice in this city.

dag: Yi ni dɔɣi bi shɛb tinzun tiŋ ni maa ni ti yɛli ya, Ti ni be luɣ shɛli ŋɔ pɔra; bomiya palo pahi ti ka ti ʒini.
en: Your people who were born in exile will one day say to you, This land is too small— we need more room to live in.

dag: Ka Yisa kpah o zuɣu ni yɛli, Miri ka a yɛli so di yɛla; amaa cham ti zaŋ amaŋ wuhi maligumaana, ka mali sara shɛli Anabi Musa ni daa sab zali zaŋ chaŋ kɔŋ tibbu polo la; dina n-ni niŋ a kpaŋbu maa shɛhira niriba sani.
en: Then Jesus said, Dont tell anyone about what happened. But go and let the priest look at you. And offer a gift to God for your healing as Moses commanded. This will show people that you are healed.

dag: Wuna maa ku tooi tiligi bɛmaŋa. Bɛ gbahi ba kaman daba la chaŋ. Babilɔn wuna maa bahigu m-bala!.
en: They crouch down and cower together. They arent able to rescue the burden, but they themselves go into captivity.

dag: Zuliya kam zaa, paɣimiya ti Naawuni ŋɔ; chɛliya ka niriba wum o paɣibu maa yɛla.
en: Praise our God, all nations; let your praise be heard.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa paai Dauda tiŋ maa ni, ka Sool bipuɣiŋga Mikal la daa lihi takɔro ni na n-nya ka Naa Dauda kul wari waa, ka yiɣiri jamdi Yawɛ tooni, ka o lihi ʒiɛm Dauda o suhu ni.
en: As the Box was being brought into the city, Michal, Saul's daughter, looked out of the window and saw King David dancing and jumping around in the sacred dance, and she was disgusted with him.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Molimi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa Juda fɔntinsi ni mini Jɛrusalɛm pala zuɣu n-yɛra, Wummiya alikauli ŋɔ yɛtɔɣa ka gbibi li.
en: Then the Lord told me to say to everyone on the streets of Jerusalem and in the towns of Judah: Pay attention to the commands in my agreement with you.

dag: O noli daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka ninvuɣ shɛb daa yi Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu zuɣulan maa yiŋ na nti yɛl o, A bipuɣiŋga maa bahiya. Ka wula ka a na kul doli suhiri karimba maa.
en: While Jesus was still speaking with her, messengers came from the synagogue leaders house, saying to Jairus, Your daughter has died. Why bother the teacher any longer.

dag: Di saha ka o ba Yisahaku daa yɛl o, A tiŋgbani ku vuhira, ka maligim mi ku lur a tiŋgban ni.
en: So his father said: Your home will be far from that fertile land, where dew comes down from the heavens.

dag: Bɛ daa ŋmaligi dolila buɣa n-jɛmdi li. Di nyɛla buɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni daa pun bi mi ni o ni daa bi zaŋ buɣ shɛŋa ti ba.
en: and decided to worship gods that had never helped them. The Lord had forbidden Israel to worship these gods.

dag: M mabihi, yi zuɣu ka n zaŋ dimbɔŋɔnim ŋmahindi m mini Apolɔs yɛla ni di chɛ ka yi doli di ni sabi yɛli shɛm, Miriya ka yi yaɣi Naawuni ni zali shɛm zuɣu. Di mi bi simdi ni yi ni so duhi karimba yino ka ʒiɛm karimba ŋun la.
en: Brothers and sisters, I have used Apollos and myself as examples for you. I did this so that you could learn from us the meaning of the words, Follow what the Scriptures say. Then you will not brag about one person and criticize another.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Keen, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi, ka a zuŋ a ninni?.
en: The LORD said to Cain, Why are you angry, and why do you look so resentful?.

dag: Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi baŋ din be daadam suhu ni ka pa ni daadam maŋmaŋ shia din be o ni maa zuɣu? Lala ka so gba ku tooi baŋ din be Naawuni suhu ni ka pa ni Naawuni Shia Kasi zuɣu.
en: You are the only one who knows what is in your own mind, and God's Spirit is the only one who knows what is in God's mind.

dag: N daa mooi n nini n-yɛri Yɛhudianim mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ni bɛ niŋm tuuba Naawuni sani ka niŋ ti Duuma Yisa yɛda.
en: I told Jews and Gentiles to turn to God and have faith in our Lord Jesus.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ lan bɔhi, Yi bi nya din niŋdi ya maa?.
en: Can't you see why this has happened?.

dag: N ku lan tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa pam, dama dunia ŋɔ naa kanna, amaa o ka n yiko.
en: I wont say much more to you because this worlds ruler is coming. He has nothing on me.

dag: Amaa ka naa daa yɛli, Yinim Zɛruya bihi ŋɔ, wula ka n yɛn niŋ ya? Di yi nyɛla Yawɛ n-yɛl o, Tum Dauda, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋdi lala.
en: But the king answered, What can I do, sons of Zeruiah? Yes, Shimei is cursing me, but the Lord told him to curse me. And who can ask him why he did that.

dag: Ka maligumaana yi mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti so, ŋun maligumaana maa n-su o ni mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maa biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ.
en: He will also get the skin from the burnt offering.

dag: Naa maa ni daa garigi yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Man Naa n-sab gbaŋ ŋɔ puhiri gomna Rɛhum mini yaɣili maa polo gbaŋŋmara Shimshai ni yi tab bɛn kpalim be Samaria zaŋ tabili bɛn zaa be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli wulinluhili polɔnima.
en: The emperor sent this answer: To Rehum, the governor, to Shimshai, secretary of the province, and to their associates who live in Samaria and in the rest of West-of-Euphrates, greetings.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ma, Daadam, ŋubimi n ni zaŋ gban shɛli ti a ŋɔ pali a puli. Di saha ka n daa ŋub li, ka di nyaɣisi n noli ni kaman shiri la.
en: He said, Mortal man, eat this scroll that I give you; fill your stomach with it. I ate it, and it tasted as sweet as honey.

dag: Yinim bɛn be tiŋ maa vinvamli ni, fabilimiya, dama kɔhigɔriba la zaa kpiya, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa yi zahindi anzinfa sania zuɣu la kpi.
en: Everyone in Lower Hollow will mourn loudly, because merchants and money changers will be wiped out.

dag: O daa shiri kpila sokam zaa zuɣu ni bɛn mali nyɛviya la di lan be bɛmaŋmaŋ yubu tumbu zuɣu, amaa ka ni bela ŋun daa kpi bɛ zuɣu ka lan neei maa yubu tumbu zuɣu.
en: He died for the sake of all so that those who are alive should live not for themselves but for the one who died for them and was raised.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Mani n-nam binshɛɣukam din beni ŋɔ. N nini ni tiɣi ninvuɣ shɛb nyɛla bɛn siɣisiri bɛmaŋa ka niŋdi tuuba, ka luri n yɛligu sizuura, ka doli n yɛligu maa.
en: My hand made all these things and brought them into being, says the LORD. But here is where I will look: to the humble and contrite in spirit, who tremble at my word.

dag: O dimnima n-leei bɛn su o; o dimnim maa kul tɔŋdimi, dama Yawɛ chɛ ka o nya wahala. O biriginsim din galisi zuɣu; o dimnim gbah o bihi chaŋ ti leei daba.
en: Jerusalems enemies have won. Her enemies have been successful. This happened because the Lord punished her. He punished Jerusalem for her many sins. Her children have gone away. Their enemies captured them and took them away.

dag: Ka Pita lan chihi yaha; ka nolɔɣu dii kum.
en: Once more Peter denied it, and right then a rooster crowed.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa yɛli Leeban, N tum tuma maa paai di tariga, zaŋmi m paɣa maa ti ma ka n zaŋ o niŋ m paɣa.
en: After seven years Jacob said to Laban, Give me Rachel so that I can marry her. My time of work for you is finished.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa ti yiɣisi nimaani chaŋ Bɛrishiiba.
en: Isaac left and went to Beersheba.

dag: ni yi chirimya pam. Dama yimaŋmaŋ n-daa tim ma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani yɛra, Suhimi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ti ti, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ yi yɛli shɛli, nyin yɛlimi ti ka ti niŋ li.
en: You are putting your lives at risk by sending me to the LORD your God, saying, Pray for us to the LORD our God; tell us everything the LORD our God says, and well do it.

dag: Ti ba maa ni ka bidibisi maa zuɣu ka o yuli yɛn kpi o daŋ ni maa? Timiya ti ti tarili ni nyɛ shɛli ti ba maa mabihi sani.
en: Why should our fathers name be taken away from his clan because he didnt have a son? Give us property among our fathers brothers.

dag: Yisifu daa laɣim bindira maa sɔŋ ka di galisim ti ŋmanila teeku ni bihigu hal ka o ti bi lan niŋdi di laasabu, dama nir daa naan ku tooi lan niŋ di laasabu.
en: In fact, there was so much grain that they stopped keeping record, because it was like counting the grains of sand along the beach.

dag: ka bɛ yi yɛli ti zilima, ti zaŋdila zilim balli yɛtɔɣa labisi ba. Ti kul bemi kaman dunia ŋɔ bin chɔɣima la, hal ti ŋmanila saɣiri dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: When people say bad things about us, we try to say something that will help them. But people still treat us like the worlds garbage—everyones trash.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛɣu kul jiɣindimi biɛɣu kam ni o nya pam pahi, ka wuntizɔra mi kul tiri pini ka bi vil o ni su shɛli gbini.
en: But people who obey God are always generous.

dag: Di di dii bi simdi ni n lan sabi gbaŋ tin ya zaŋ chaŋ tɔto tɔhi ti Yisa nyaandoliba la yɛla polo;.
en: I don't need to write you about the money you plan to give for God's people.

dag: Atɛr daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbigaayika.
en: the descendants of Ater through the family of Hezekiah:.

dag: Nir yi mali biɛla ka zɔri Yawɛ, di so ni nir mali buni pam ka di mal o muɣisigu.
en: Better a little with fear of the LORD than a great treasure with turmoil.

dag: A ni kpab li kaman biŋŋmaa la, ka di ni taɣi m-be kaman situra la; amaa nyin kul ku taɣi, ka a mi kul ku kurigi.
en: You will fold them up like a coat. They will be changed like a person changes clothes, but you stay the same, and the years of your life wont come to an end. .

dag: Ka bɛ daa daŋ yiɣisibu asiba m-mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la, ka daa zaŋ suhudoo sara maligu pina na; ka niriba maa daa ʒini tiŋa ni bɛ di ka nyu, ka yiɣisi diɛmdi kɔr biɛri mini vi diɛma.
en: Early the next morning they brought some animals to burn as sacrifices and others to eat as fellowship offerings. The people sat down to a feast, which turned into an orgy of drinking and sex.

dag: Dama niriba ŋɔ leela suhutunanima: Bɛ ŋari bɛ tiba ni di chɛ ka bɛ ku wum. Bɛ pɔb bɛ nina ni di chɛ ka bɛ ku nya. Di yi pa lala, bɛ nina ni nya, ka bɛ tiba wum, ka bɛ baŋ bɛ suhuri ni, ka ŋmaligi labi n sanna ka n tib ba.
en: because their minds are dull, and they have stopped up their ears and have closed their eyes. Otherwise, their eyes would see, their ears would hear, their minds would understand, and they would turn to me, says God, and I would heal them.

dag: O ni daa mali tɔrokɔnim maa shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: di daa malila dapaɣa, ka o zaŋ li kpɛhi firimnim ni.
en: They were made of square panels which were set in frames.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi be nyam yi bi mali bɛmaŋ niŋ nyam ta Yawɛ sara maligu shee daɣiri, bɛ ni bi niŋ ko shɛli din yihiri nir daɣiri ni mihi ba la zuɣu, bɛ nyɛla bɛn bi be nyam, ka di simdi ni bɛ yihi ba Naawuni niriba ni.
en: Whoever becomes unclean and does not become clean must be separated from the community. If an unclean person is not sprinkled with that special water and does not become clean, that person might make the Lord s Holy Tent unclean.

dag: Kom ni daa di dunia maa nyaaŋa, Nuhu daa niŋla yuun kɔbisita ni pihinu pahi.
en: After the flood, Noah lived years.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Ti Duuma Naawuni pun kahigi alizanda nam daashili yɛla wuhi yinima, amaa o bi kahigi li wuhi bɛn kpalim bɛna.
en: Jesus answered: I have explained the secrets about the kingdom of heaven to you, but not to others.

dag: Ninvuɣ so beni n-diri binshɛɣukam, ka ninvuɣ so ŋun yɛda bi kpɛm mi kul dirila bindir gahinda.
en: Some people believe they can eat any kind of food, but those who have doubts eat only vegetables.

dag: ŋuna n-nyɛ ti Naawuni, ŋuna n-nyɛ ti Naawuni hal ni saha din ka bahigu; ŋuna n-kul yɛn wuhiri ti soli sahakam.
en: This God is our God forever and ever; he will lead us for all time to come.

dag: O ni ti lan niŋ suhukpeeni n-laɣim tɔbbihi pam chaŋ ti liri Ijipti naa, ka Ijipti naa maa gba ni ti zaŋ o tɔbbihi pam bɛn mali kpiɔŋ n-chɛ ka bɛ lu tab zuɣu. Amaa bɛ ni ti yɔhim Ijipti naa maa ka o ku di nasara.
en: Then with a large army he will gather his strength and courage against the southern king. The southern king, with a large and super powerful army, will prepare for war, but he wont endure because they will make plans against him.

dag: Ka Yisa kpah o zuɣu ni yɛli, Miri ka a yɛli so di yɛla; amaa cham ti zaŋ amaŋ wuhi maligumaana, ka mali sara shɛli Anabi Musa ni daa sab zali zaŋ chaŋ kɔŋ tibbu polo la; dina n-ni niŋ a kpaŋbu maa shɛhira niriba sani.
en: Jesus ordered him not to tell anyone. Instead, Jesus said, go and show yourself to the priest and make an offering for your cleansing, as Moses instructed. This will be a testimony to them.

dag: Di saha ka Liya daa yɛli, Naawuni ti ma pin suŋ, pumpɔŋɔ n yidan ni ti ma jilima, dama n dɔɣi bidibis ayɔbu ti o; ka daa boli bia maa yuli Zɛbulɔn.
en: She said, God has given me a fine gift. Now my husband will accept me, because I have borne him six sons; so she named him Zebulun.

dag: N Duuma, a nyɛla Naawun suŋ, ka chɛri niriba taali, ka a yurilim maŋli galisi zaŋ chaŋ bɛnkam zaa suhir a sani.
en: because, my Lord, you are good and forgiving, full of faithful love for all those who cry out to you.

dag: Bɛ daa bɔh o mi, A yi pala Masia bee Anabi Ilaija bee bɛ ni daa yɛli anab so yɛla la, di chaŋ wula ka a baptaiziri niriba.
en: They asked him, Why are you baptizing people, if you are not the Messiah or Elijah or the Prophet.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun guli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lur o sizuura mini bɛn mali tahima zaŋ chaŋ o yurilim maŋli ŋɔ polo.
en: The Lord watches over his followers, those who wait for him to show his faithful love.

dag: Jɛramiil ŋun daa nyɛ Hɛzirɔn bituuli san la bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ram ŋun daa nyɛ o bituuli san la mini Buna ni Orɛn ni Ozɛm ni Ahija.
en: The family of Jerahmeel, Hezrons oldest son: Ram his oldest, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.

dag: ŋun di kpihim man Jɔnatan yuli nyin Dauda daŋ ni. Yawɛ bɔhimi nyin Dauda dimnim biɛri ti a.
en: Jonathan and David made an agreement that even David's descendants would have to keep. Then Jonathan said, I pray that the Lord will take revenge on your descendants if they break our promise.

dag: Di yi ti wali yuuni na di viɛla; ka di mi yi ti bi wali, man naanyi ŋmaa li luhi. .
en: Maybe it will produce fruit next year; if not, then you can cut it down.

dag: Bɛ ni shɛb daa tɛhimi ni Judas ni gbib bɛ liɣiri kolibil la zuɣu ka Yisa yɛl o ni o cham ti da bɛ ni bɔri binshɛŋa ni bɛ zaŋ puhi chuɣu maa na bee ni o pii liɣiri maa shɛli ti ti nandaamba.
en: But because Judas was in charge of the money, some of them thought that Jesus had told him to buy something they needed for the festival. Others thought that Jesus had told him to give some money to the poor.

dag: Lihimi n nahiŋgu mini n wahala ŋɔ, ka chɛ n daalahichi zaa.
en: Consider my distress and suffering and forgive all my sins.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ bɛn daa pun diri nam Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni hal ka Izraɛlnim ti naanyi mali naa.
en: These are the kings who ruled in the land of Edom before a king ruled over the Israelites.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa boli Ziba ŋun daa nyɛ Sool tumtumda la na ti yɛl o, Sool min o daŋ zaa ni daa su shɛlikam zaa n ni zaŋ li ti a dan yaaŋa ŋɔ.
en: Then David summoned Sauls servant Ziba and said to him, I have given your masters grandson everything belonging to Saul and his family.

dag: Amaa ka Lɔt paɣ ŋun daa be o nyaaŋa daa ti ŋmaligi lih o nyaaŋa, ka leei yalim kuɣili.
en: When Lots wife looked back, she turned into a pillar of salt.

dag: Di simdi ni yi yu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yi suhuri zaa ni yi shia zaa ni yi yaa zaa.
en: Love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your strength.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ matarika n-kuri salima chɛrubinim ayi tam di yɔrigu maa tarisi yaɣ ayi zuɣu.
en: Then Bezalel hammered gold to make two Cherub angels. He put the Cherub angels on each end of the mercy-cover.

dag: Di saha maa ka o daa tim Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat sani ti yɛl o, Mɔab naa zaɣisi ma jɛmbu. A ni pahi n zuɣu ka ti chaŋ ti tuh o? Ka o garigi yɛl o, N ni chaŋ. A ni be shɛm lala n-nyɛ ma. N niriba bemi ka a niriba, ka n yuri be ka a yuri.
en: He sent word to King Jehoshaphat of Judah: The king of Moab has rebelled against me; will you join me in war against him? I will, King Jehoshaphat replied. I am at your disposal, and so are my men and my horses.

dag: Yɛtɔɣ viɛla tɔɣisibu bi mili jɛrigu, ka ʒiri gba yɛtɔɣa bi simdi nabia.
en: Respected people do not tell lies, and fools have nothing worthwhile to say.

dag: amaa gol muni zaa hal ka di ti yiri yi nyɛhi ni, ka nyɔni yi nyee, dama yi zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun be yi sani ŋɔ ka kumdi niŋd o yɛra, Bɔzuɣu ka ti daa lee yi Ijipti na? .
en: but for a whole month, until it comes out of your ears, until you are sick of it. This will happen because you have rejected the Lord who is here among you and have complained to him that you should never have left Egypt.

dag: Ka Hanna daa yɛli, N dana, Naawuni dolim a nyɛvili. Ka lan yɛli, N dana, mani n-nyɛ paɣ so ŋun daa ʒe a tooni kpe n-suhiri Yawɛ la.
en: She said to him, Pardon me, sir. I am the same woman who stood near you praying to the Lord . I promise that I am telling the truth.

dag: Di saha ka Ibrahimma daa yɛl o nachimba maa, Ʒiɛnya buŋ ŋɔ sani, ka m mini bia ŋɔ chaŋ kpe ha ti jɛm Naawuni ka labina.
en: Then he said to his servants, Stay here with the donkey. The boy and I will go to that place and worship. Then we will come back to you later.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Mitika maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Hashimɔna.
en: They left Mithcah and camped at Hashmonah.

dag: Dindali maa, fabila ni ti galisi Jɛrusalɛm kaman bɛ ni daa fabili Hadadirimɔn zuɣu Mɛgido vinvamli ni shɛm la.
en: There will be a time of great sadness and crying in Jerusalem. It will be like the time people cry over the death of Hadad Rimmon in Megiddo Valley.

dag: Amaa yinim yɛliya ni so yi yɛl o ba bee o ma ni o ni di naan nya shɛli o sani nyɛla Kɔɔban .
en: But you let people get by without helping their parents when they should. You let them say that what they own has been offered to God.

dag: Ka Hadad daa ti kpi. O kalinsi nyaaŋa na shɛb bɛn daa di Ɛdom n-daa nyɛ: Timna mini Aliva ni Jɛtɛt.
en: Then Hadad died. The leaders of Edom were Timna, Alvah, Jetheth.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi zaŋ ŋun pah ayi maa mi mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la kaman zaligu ni wuhi shɛm, ka maligumaana zaŋ li yo o daalahichi maa samli ka o daalahichi maa kpihim.
en: Then he will offer the second bird according to the rules for a burnt offering. The priest will do this to make you pure from the sin you did, and God will forgive you.

dag: Zaŋm salima mali kuɣa maa ni yɛn taɣili binshɛŋa ni.
en: Then make gold settings.

dag: Amaa zuliya shɛb bee nam shɛli din niriba zaɣisi ya jɛmbu, bɛ ni bahi yoli zaa.
en: But nations that do not serve you Will be completely destroyed.

dag: Hal o ni daa kul wuhi shihira pam niriba maa sani maa zaa yoli, bɛ daa bi niŋ o yɛda.
en: The people saw all these miraculous signs Jesus did, but they still did not believe in him.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika daa yi o zuɣu mɔɣu ni kulibɔn shɛli din daa be Shur soli polo.
en: Hagar stopped to rest at a spring in the desert on the road to Shur. While she was there, the angel of the Lord came to her.

dag: Yawɛ, viim sagbana ka sheena. Shihimi zoya n-chɛ ka nyɔhi yi di ni na.
en: O Lord , tear the sky open and come down; touch the mountains, and they will pour out smoke.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa zaŋ Jɛrimia bia Jaazania ŋun daa nyɛ Habazinia yaaŋa la min o mabihi bɛn nyɛ dɔbba ni o bidibisi zaa ni Rɛkab daŋ niriba zaa na.
en: So I went to Jaazaniah, the leader of the clan, and I invited him and all the men of his clan.

dag: O mɛla gooni ŋari n soli, ka di chɛ ka n kɔŋ garibu, ka chɛ ka n soli leei liɣa.
en: God has me trapped with a wall of darkness.

dag: Yinim maligumaaniba, wummiya! Yinim Izraɛlnima, gbilisimiya tibili! Yinim nayilinima, luɣimiya yi tiba wum! Saria karibu maa ʒila yi zuɣu, dama yi leela zana Mizipa, ka leei laŋa n-yɛrigi pa Tabo Zoli zuɣu.
en: Hear this, priests! Pay attention, house of Israel! Listen, house of the king! The judgment concerns you because you have been a trap at Mizpah, and a net spread out upon Tabor.

dag: ni sapashinnim bɛn su tɔbbihi pihinunu fukumsi ni zuɣulaannima ni bɛn wuhiri niriba din niŋ kamaata ni alahiziba tumtumsa tumdiba ni bukpahinima.
en: He will take away the army officers and important officials. He will take away the skilled counselors, the magicians, and those who try to tell the future.

dag: Ka firila ti ku lan ne a ni; ka so mi ti ku lan wum amiliya aŋgo min o daamiliya kukoya a ni, dama a kɔhigɔriba daa nyɛla dunia ŋɔ wɔɣira, ka a daa zaŋ a baɣibuɣibo yɔhim zuliya kam.
en: The light of a lamp will never shine in you again. The voices of a bridegroom and bride will never be heard in you again. Your merchants were the worlds great people. All the nations were tricked by your magic.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa tim ti boli Shimɛi na nti yɛl o, Mɛm a yili Jɛrusalɛm ŋɔ n-ʒi kpe, ka miri ka a yi kpe n-chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam.
en: Solomon sent for Shimei and said, Build a house here in Jerusalem and live in it. But whatever you do, don't leave the city!.

dag: O darigiri deera, ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi gu o soli? Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi bɔh o, Bɔ ka a lee niŋdi maa.
en: If he seizes, who can bring back? Who can say to him, What are you doing.

dag: Sandaantimdiba bɛn biri bimbira ni suhudoo ni ti kpuɣila atam din nyɛ wuntia.
en: Those who make peace sow the seeds of justice by their peaceful acts.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, N ni chɛ ka tɔbu mini kum ni alɔbo lu bɛ zuɣu, ka n chɛ ka bɛ be kaman fiig tiwal poma din bie pam ka so ku tooi di li la.
en: The LORD of heavenly forces proclaims: Im going to send the sword, famine, and disease against them. I will make them like rotten figs that are too spoiled to eat.

dag: Naawuni, ti paɣir a, ti paɣir a; dama a miri ti. Sokam yɛr a daalahiziba tuma yɛla.
en: We give thanks to you, O God, we give thanks to you! We proclaim how great you are and tell of the wonderful things you have done.

dag: Dama a yi bi dol ti chaŋ, wula ka bɛ ni ti baŋ ni a nini tiɣi m min a niriba ŋɔ? Ka bɔ n-leei yɛn woligi m min a niriba ŋɔ biɛhigu ka chɛ dunia ŋɔ niriba zaa biɛhigu.
en: But if you do go with us, everyone will know that you are pleased with your people and with me. That way, we will be different from the rest of the people on earth.

dag: Ka dɔbba mini paɣiba bɛn zaa suhuri daa yu lala zaŋ nachiinsi nɛma din nyɛ tibikpara mini nintuhi ni bansi ni salima nɛma zaa na. Sokam daa zaŋla salima na nti mali sara ti Yawɛ.
en: All who wanted to, both men and women, brought decorative pins, earrings, rings, necklaces, and all kinds of gold jewelry and dedicated them to the Lord .

dag: Ka kapinta yɛli machɛle, A niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga. Ka ŋun kpɛri dari ka di niŋdi polipoli kpaŋsi ŋun kpahiri li tuɣiri taba ka yɛra, Di tuɣibu maa viɛla; ka bɛ zaŋ kpahikpahi li tuɣi taba, ka di ku tooi yihi.
en: The craftsman encourages the metalworker; the one who smoothes with the hammer encourages the one who strikes the anvil, saying of the welding, Thats good, and strengthening it with nails so it wont move.

dag: Jɛrilim tuma tirila ŋun ka yɛm suhupiɛlli, amaa ŋun mali tɛhi zilima ŋun tumdila din tuhi.
en: Folly is joy to those who lack sense, but those with understanding walk straight ahead.

dag: Amaa tinim nyɛla Naawuni niriba. Ka ŋunkam nyɛ Naawuni nir nyɛla ŋun wumdi tiri ti; ka ŋunkam mi pa Naawuni nir pala ŋun wumdi tiri ti. Dinzuɣu dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka ti ni tooi baŋ Shi so ŋun nyɛ yɛlimaŋli Shia, ka lan baŋ shi so ŋun nyɛ biriginsim shia.
en: But we are from God. So the people who know God listen to us. But the people who are not from God dont listen to us. This is how we know the Spirit that is true and the spirit that is false.

dag: Gɛrishom bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Libini mini Shimɛi.
en: These are the names of Gershoms family: Libni and Shimei.

dag: Ka yinim Kapɛriniumnima, yi mi bɔri ni yi duhila yimaŋa hal ni Naawuni nam ʒiishee? Naawuni ni ti siɣisi ya kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: And as for you, Capernaum! Did you want to lift yourself up to heaven? You will be thrown down to hell.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ salima niŋ dapaɣa maa, ka mali salima bansi niŋ li ka di gbibi dapuhi maa, ka niŋ salima niŋ dapuhi maa.
en: They covered the boards with gold. They made gold rings to house the bars and covered the bars with gold.

dag: Hurai ŋun daa nyɛ Gaash Vinvamli ni nir la ni Abiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Ariba nir la.
en: Hurai from the Gaash ravines; Abiel the Arbathite.

dag: A jɛmbu duu din be Jɛrusalɛm la zuɣu ka nanim ʒiri pina na ti tir a.
en: Then kings will bring gifts to your temple in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa ti bol o ba Ibrahimma, M ba! Ka o garigi yɛli, M bia, n-nyɛ ma. Ka o bɔh o, Buɣim mini dari m-bɔŋɔ, ka piɛ so ti ni ti yɛn zaŋ mali sara maa lee be ya.
en: Isaac said to his father Abraham, My father? Abraham said, Im here, my son. Isaac said, Here is the fire and the wood, but where is the lamb for the entirely burned offering.

dag: Dama bɛ ni zaɣi kaman mɔri la; ka suui kaman vari la.
en: They are like grass and other green plants that dry up quickly and then die.

dag: n-chaŋ omaŋmaŋ ya n-daa ti kpe bɛ jɛmbu duu nti wuhiri niriba, ka di daa gari ba pam ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Ya ka doo ŋɔ lee nya yɛm ŋɔ mini tuun kara ŋɔ?.
en: When he came to his hometown, he taught the people in their synagogue. They were surprised and said, Where did he get this wisdom? Where did he get the power to work miracles?.

dag: Dinzuɣu di simdi ni yi gbibi n zaligunima ka dol li: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: You must keep my commands and do them; I am the LORD.

dag: Ka o daa zo n-chaŋ Saimɔn Pita mini nyaandol so Yisa ni daa yuri la sani nti yɛli ba, Bɛ yihi ti Duuma siliga la ni, ka ti bi mi bɛ ni zaŋ o ti sɔŋ luɣ shɛli.
en: So she ran to Simon Peter and the other follower . She said, They have taken the Lord out of the tomb, and we dont know where they put him.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛl o, Bɔhimi nya ŋun bia bala.
en: King Saul said, Find out who his father is.

dag: Nir yi zaŋ o nyɛvili taɣ o zɔnim dini, yurilim shɛl lan kani gari li.
en: The greatest love you can have for your friends is to give your life for them.

dag: Yɛlim Ziɔnnima, Nyamiya! Yi naa kani yi sanna. O nyɛla maŋsiɣisibulana, ka bari buŋ min o bia.
en: Tell the people of Zion, Now your king is coming to you. He is humble and riding on a donkey. He is riding on a young donkey, born from a work animal. Zechariah :.

dag: Ka o nachin kpɛm maa daa bɔh o, Ka paɣ maa yi ti bi saɣi ni o doli ma kuli tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni a ni be ŋɔ na, man zaŋm a bia maa kulis a ya maa.
en: But the servant asked, What if the young woman will not leave home to come with me to this land? Shall I send your son back to the land you came from.

dag: M mali tahima ti Duuma Yisa sani ni di ku yuui ka n tim Timoti yi sanna, ka di chɛ ka m baŋ yi yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm, ka di kpaŋsi n suhu.
en: I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to see you soon so that I may be encouraged by hearing about you.

dag: Yawɛ lab me Jɛrusalɛm, ka laɣindi bɛ ni daa kari Izraɛl ninvuɣ shɛb kpɛhi yɔɣu la na.
en: The LORD rebuilds Jerusalem, gathering up Israels exiles.

dag: Dinzuɣu sum kom n-niŋ tulaale niŋ a ni, ka zaŋ a situr suma so n-chaŋ o ni be luɣ shɛli yeeni o chi maa. Amaa di chɛ ka o baŋ ni a be nimaani hal ka o ti di ka nyu n-naai.
en: So wash yourself, put on some perfume, and get dressed in your best clothes. Then go where he is threshing, but don't let him know you are there until he has finished eating and drinking.

dag: mini dundɔŋ ni duri la sunsuuni yɛliŋ daa nyɛ mita pia n-gili Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa luɣilikam.
en: the other chambers was thirty feet wide all the way around the temple.

dag: Ka bɛ yi zaɣisi ni bɛ ku deei pipia maa a nuu ni nyu, di saha nyin yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Di nyɛla talahi ni yi nyu li.
en: The Lord told me that if any of them refused to drink from the cup, I must tell them that he had said, I, the Lord All-Powerful, command you to drink.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa darig a tibili, ka filim a tarili, ka chɛ ka a tumd a dimnim bɛn nyɛ Filistianim yubu, bɛn nyɛ vi ni gbahi shɛba a biɛriyoli tuma maa zuɣu la.
en: So I punished you by letting those greedy Philistine enemies take over some of your territory. But even they were offended by your repulsive behavior.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ya ka a ba maa lee be? Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yi ʒi ma bee m Ba. Yi yi di mi ma, yi naan mi m Ba maa gba.
en: The people asked, Where is your father? Jesus answered, You dont know me or my Father. But if you knew me, you would know my Father too.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti yaannim bɛn nyɛ Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ, ŋmaligim a niriba ŋɔ suhuri kpa a polo, ka chɛ ka bɛ ni mali nia shɛŋa mini tɛhi shɛŋa ŋɔ kul ni be bɛ suhuri ni sahakam.
en: Lord God of our ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, keep such devotion forever strong in your people's hearts and keep them always faithful to you.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi tizo maa n-yiɣisi lab doo maa sani yaha.
en: Take Benjamin, and go back to the man.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima: Yi yi ti paai n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya la ni na, tiŋgbɔŋ maa yɛn malila di vuhim yuuni Yawɛ sani.
en: to give the following regulations to the people of Israel. When you enter the land that the Lord is giving you, you shall honor the Lord by not cultivating the land every seventh year.

dag: Ka tumtumda maa garigi yɛli Sool, M mali anzinfa laɣifu kpe, n ni zaŋ li ti Naawuni nir maa ka o wuhi ti ti ni yɛn doli so shɛli.
en: I have a small piece of silver, the servant answered. We can give him that, and then he will tell us where to look for the donkeys.

dag: Di yi pa lala, o na kpee maa yi ti na be katiŋ kanna o ni tim ti balim o ni o chɛ ka bɛ ku zabili maa.
en: If he thinks he won't be able to defend himself, he will send messengers and ask for peace while the other king is still a long way off.

dag: Ka o yɛtɔɣa maa daa paligi Absalom mini Izraɛl kpamba zaa suhuri.
en: Absalom and all the leaders of the tribes of Israel agreed that Ahithophel had a good plan.

dag: Ti mabihi, ti ni daa woligi ya daba ayi la puuni, kulla ti niŋgbuna tab woligibu ko yɛla ka n yɛri maa, ka pa ni ti tɛha tab Woligibu. Ti naɣi ya nyabu, ka mi kul kpaŋdi timaŋa ni ti lan nyan ya yaha.
en: My friends, we were kept from coming to you for a while, but we never stopped thinking about you. We were eager to see you and tried our best to visit you in person.

dag: Doli wuhibu maŋ shɛŋa n ni daa zaŋ wuh a la yɛda niŋbu mini yurilim shɛli din be Yisa Masia ni la puuni.
en: Hold on to the pattern of sound teaching that you heard from me with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.

dag: Ka n yɛri ya mi ni yi ku lan nya ma hal ni saha shɛli yi ni ti yɛn yɛli, Ŋun mali ti Duuma yuli kanna ŋɔ mal alibarika. .
en: I tell you, you will not see me again until that time when you will say, Welcome! God bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord. .

dag: Ka sapashini maa daa wum Yisa yɛla, ka tim Yɛhudianim kpeen shɛba ni bɛ ti suhi Yisa ka o kana ti tib o dabili maa ti o.
en: And when he heard about Jesus, he sent some Jewish leaders to ask him to come and heal the servant.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Di nyɛla yi yɛda pɔrilim zuɣu. Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi yi mali yɛda ka di be kaman zabiliga tibiɛlim la, yi ni tooi yɛli zoli ŋɔ, Yiɣisim a dooshee ŋɔ nti dɔni kpe ha, ka di shiri yiɣisi; ka shɛli ku kɔŋ nanibu yi sani. .
en: Jesus replied: It is because you don't have enough faith! But I can promise you this. If you had faith no larger than a mustard seed, you could tell this mountain to move from here to there. And it would. Everything would be possible for you.

dag: Naa Ahasivɛrɔs nam dibu piligu ni, ka bɛ daa ŋma gbaŋ fiɣisi Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima.
en: These enemies even wrote letters to the king of Persia trying to stop the Jews. They wrote a letter the year that Xerxes became the king of Persia.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa yiɣisi chaŋchaŋ gili duu maa ni, ka ti lan lab ti teei dɔni bia maa zuɣu yaha. Ka bia maa daa tihim siɣimsiɣim buyopɔin, ka neeg o nina.
en: Then Elisha turned away and walked around the room. He went back and lay on the child until the child sneezed seven times and opened his eyes.

dag: ni salima alali firilatamdigu la mini di zuɣu firilanim din pie tab la ni di nɛma zaa ni firila kpam.
en: the pure lampstand with its lamps set on it and all its equipment, and the oil for the light.

dag: M mabihi, dunianim yi jɛn ya, yin di chɛliya ka di gari ya.
en: Brothers and sisters, dont be surprised when the people of this world hate you.

dag: Bɛ chi sara yɛn nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ kpam ŋmiri zim viɛl shɛli, ka yi zaŋ di kilɔgiram ata pahi naɣilahi pinaata maa zaɣ yino kam zuɣu, ka zaŋ di kilɔgiram ayi pahi piɛlah ayi maa zaɣ yino kam zuɣu;.
en: Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with each bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the rams.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, yi yi tum niriba gaŋbu tuun shɛli ashilɔni, o ni darigi yi tibili.
en: You know that God would criticize you if you chose someones side simply because they were important.

dag: Zuɣusaa kahigi Naawuni wuntitali wuhi, dama Naawuni maŋmaŋa n-nyɛ sariakarita.
en: God is the judge, and the skies tell how fair he is. Selah.

dag: A bɔhiya, Ŋuni n-lee beni n-sɔɣiri yɛm yɛtɔɣa, ka bi mi di gbinni ŋɔ? Yɛlimaŋli, mani n-daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ka bi mi di gbinni. N daa tɔɣisila binshɛŋa yɛla ka di niŋ ma alahiziba pam, ka m bi baŋ li.
en: You asked why I talk so much when I know so little. I have talked about things that are far beyond my understanding.

dag: ka niriba dooi anzinfa mini salima pa di zuɣu, ka zaŋ kpahi mini matarika n-kpahi li zali, din ni chɛ ka di ku dam.
en: cover it with silver and gold, and then nail it down so it won't fall over.

dag: Bɛna n nyɛ Jɛrusalɛmnim mini Juda fɔntinsinim ni di nanima ni bɛ kpambaliba ni di chɛ ka di leei dabari, ka niriba maani ba ansarisi ka turi ba kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Jerusalem and the towns of Judah, its kings and officials. This was to make them a wasteland, an object of horror, shock, and cursing, as it is today.

dag: Ka Akishi daa garigi yɛli Dauda, M mi ni a ka galimi shɛli kaman Naawuni malaika ni ka galimi shɛm la, amaa di zaa yoli, Filistia sapashinnim maa yɛliya ni a di dol ti chaŋ tɔb maa ni.
en: I agree, Achish answered David. I think youre as good as one of Gods own messengers. Despite that, the Philistine commanders have ordered, He cant go into battle with us.

dag: Di ku yuui ka n kana; gbib a ni mali shɛli kirikiri ka so ti ku fa a nam zuɣupiligu.
en: I am coming soon. Keep safe what you have, so that no one will rob you of your victory prize.

dag: Ka naa yɛli, Pirigimiya bi nɛɔŋ maa buyi n-zaŋ o pirigili ti yino, ka zaŋ o pirigili din la n-ti ŋun la mi.
en: Then the king said, Cut the living child in two! Give half to one woman and half to the other woman.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla a daba ni a ninvuɣ shɛb a ni daa zaŋ a yiko min a nuu din mali kpiɔŋ tiligi.
en: The Israelites are your servants and your people. You used your great power and rescued them.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Juda daa yɛli Onan, Zaŋm a biɛli pakoli maa dɔni, ka niŋ di ni simdi ni a niŋ shɛm wuhi ni o yidan tizo n-nyɛ a, ka zaŋ o dɔɣi bihi ti a biɛli maa.
en: Then Judah said to Er's brother Onan, Go and sleep with your brother's widow. Fulfill your obligation to her as her husband's brother, so that your brother may have descendants.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli, N wumla a damli puu ŋɔ ni ka dabiɛm gbaai ma, dama m bela n zaɣim, dina n-chɛ ka n sɔɣi maa.
en: He answered, I heard you in the garden; I was afraid and hid from you, because I was naked.

dag: Ka Pool mini Silas daa yi sarika duu maa ni n-chaŋ Lidia yiŋa nti puh o; ka daa nya bɛ yɛdaniŋditab bɛn be nimaani n-kpaŋsi bɛ suhuri ka naanyi yi n-chaŋ.
en: But when Paul and Silas came out of the jail, they went to Lydias house. They saw some of the believers there and encouraged them. Then they left.

dag: Dama Ɛdomnim daa lan kamina ti liri Judanim maa n-tuhi nyaŋ ba, ka gbahi ba chaŋ ti leei daba.
en: Once again, the Edomites had invaded Judah, defeating Judah and carrying off captives.

dag: Niriba maa daa jɛmdi Yawɛ, ka daa lan pii bɛ ni ninvuɣ shɛba n-leei maligumaaniba ka bɛ maani maligu bɛ ni jɛmdi buɣa luɣ shɛŋa la tiri ba.
en: They worshiped their own gods, just as they had before they were taken away to Israel. They also worshiped the Lord , but they chose their own people to be priests at the shrines.

dag: N tɛhiya ni di simdi ni n chɛ ka ti mabia Ɛpafurɔditus ŋun nyɛ n tumtumdikpee mini n tɔbbikpee, ka lan nyɛ yi tumo ŋun sɔŋ ma la lab kuli yi sanna.
en: I think it is also necessary to send Epaphroditus to you. He is my brother, coworker, and fellow soldier; and he is your representative who serves my needs.

dag: Naawuni, a wuntitali zaŋmi hal ti paai sagbana ni. Nyini n-tum tuun kara ŋɔ. Ŋuni n-lee be kaman nyini?.
en: Your righteousness, God, reaches the skies. You have done great things; there is no one like you.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Bɛ yi kanimina ni bɛ ti tuhi ti bee bɛ yi kanimina ni bɛ ti niŋ sandaani niŋ ti yin gbahimiya ba zaɣ nɛma.
en: He said, If they have come out in peace, take them alive; if they have come out for war, take them alive as well.

dag: Ka tiŋgbani fabindi ka mali suhugarigu. Ka Lɛbanɔn nyɔŋ tihi suui; ka Sharɔn vinvamli niŋ kaman tiŋgban nɛl la; ka Bashan mini Kamɛl Zoli zuɣu tihi suura.
en: The land lies idle and deserted. The forests of Lebanon have withered, the fertile valley of Sharon is like a desert, and in Bashan and on Mount Carmel the leaves are falling from the trees.

dag: Ka o gba daa fuɣ o situra zaa ka tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa Samuɛl tooni, ka daa do o zaɣim dindali maa wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa. Dindali maa ka bɔhigu ŋɔ daa piligi, Sool gba nyɛla anabi.
en: Saul even took off his clothes. He lay there naked all day and through the night. So even Saul prophesied there in front of Samuel. That is why people say, Is Saul also one of the prophets.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka naa guliba sapashin kpɛm Nɛbuzaradan daa zaŋ ba chaŋ Ribila nti ti Babilɔn naa.
en: Nebuzaradan took them to the king of Babylonia, who was in the city of Riblah.

dag: Ninsalinim azichi ku tooi tiligi ba kum ni; bɛ ni bahi kpi kaman biŋkɔbiri ni kpiri shɛm la.
en: Wealthy people? They just dont understand; theyre just like the animals that pass away.

dag: Ka Ham ŋun daa nyɛ Keenan ba la daa nya o ba ni do o zaɣim maa, ka yi samban ni nti yɛl o mabih ayi la.
en: Ham, Canaans father, saw his father naked and told his two brothers who were outside.

dag: M bia, alahichinim yi kpɛhir a kɔre, nyin di saɣi.
en: My son, dont let sinners entice you. Dont go.

dag: Ka Adɔram daa nyɛ ŋun su tumtumdiba fukumsi; ka Ahilud bia Jɛhɔshafat daa nyɛ ŋun su gbana sabbu fukumsi.
en: Adoram was in charge of the slave-labor force. Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud kept government records.

dag: N ni ti lo ba suhudoo alikauli, ka kari mɔɣu ni biŋkɔb biɛri zaa tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni din ni chɛ ka bɛ ti be mɔɣu maa ni, ka gbɛri nimaani ka barina shɛli kani.
en: The people of Israel are my sheep, and I solemnly promise that they will live in peace. I will chase away every wild animal from the desert and the forest, so my sheep will not be afraid.

dag: di saha yin bɔhimiya ka vihi di zuɣu viɛnyɛliŋga; di yi shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni bɛ tum din chihiri ŋɔ yi sunsuuni.
en: at that point you must look into this situation very carefully to see if its true. And if its definitely true that this detestable thing was done in your community.

dag: Ka bindirigu kam din be di puuni ka nyɛ kom ni kpaai bahi shɛli zuɣu nyɛla din ni leei daɣiri, ka binnyurigu kam din yi duɣu maa puuni na ni leei daɣiri.
en: If water from the unclean clay dish touches any food, that food will become unclean. Any drink in the unclean dish will become unclean.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti zaŋ bindirigu na ti zali nachin kpɛm maa ni o di, ka o yɛli, Di yi pa ni n yɛlila daliri din tahi ma na, n ku di bindirigu maa. Ka Leeban yɛl o, Yɛlima.
en: When food was brought, the man said, I will not eat until I have said what I have to say. Laban said, Go on and speak.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka ti bi gbarigira. Hal ti niŋgbuna yi filinda, ti suhuri ni biɛhigu din kul leerila zaɣ pala biɛɣukam.
en: That is why we never give up. Our physical body is becoming older and weaker, but our spirit inside us is made new every day.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ zaŋ chinchin ʒee pil li, ka zaŋ biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ yɛrigi pil li, ka zaŋ di dapuhi tu li.
en: They are to cover all of this with a bright red cloth, and then with a piece of fine leather, before putting the carrying poles in place.

dag: Dama hal mmaŋmaŋ ni kul ka yi sani maa zaa yoli, n suhu din be yi sani, ka m mali suhupiɛlli yi biɛrisuŋ mini yi ʒiɛyimtali zaŋ chaŋ yi ni niŋ Masia yɛda shɛm la polo.
en: Even though I am not with you, I keep thinking about you. I am glad to know that you are living as you should and your faith in Christ is strong.

dag: Ŋun maŋmaŋa n-lan nyɛ sara maligu din kpihindi ti daalahichi, ka o pala ti kɔŋko daalahichi sara maligu, amaa o nyɛla dunianim zaa daalahichi sara maligu.
en: Jesus is the way our sins are taken away. And he is the way all people can have their sins taken away too.

dag: ka yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Sidɔn, m bi ʒe a nyaaŋa. N ni nya jilima a ni. N yi kar a saria a ni, ka chɛ ka n kasitali yi zahira a ni, bɛ ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: and say, The LORD God proclaims: Im against you, Sidon, and I will manifest my glory in you. When Ive executed judgment against it and through it have manifested my holiness, they will know that I am the LORD.

dag: Judanim ni ŋmanila tɔbbi shɛb bɛn di nasara ka no bɛ dimnim firi soli zuɣu baɣiri ni; dama Yawɛ be bɛ sani. Bɛ ni tuhi nyaŋ bɛ dimnim bɛn nyɛ tɔbutuhiri wɔribariba la.
en: They will join in the fighting, and together they will trample their enemies like mud. They will fight, because I, the Lord , will be on their side. And they will crush the enemy cavalry.

dag: Yɛlim Aduna min o bidibisi, ŋ-ŋɔ ka yi yɛn suhiri alibarika niŋdi Izraɛlnim ni: yɛlimiya ba.
en: When Aaron and his sons bless the people of Israel, they must say:.

dag: Ka tiŋgbani fabindi ka mali suhugarigu. Ka Lɛbanɔn nyɔŋ tihi suui; ka Sharɔn vinvamli niŋ kaman tiŋgban nɛl la; ka Bashan mini Kamɛl Zoli zuɣu tihi suura.
en: The land is sick and dying. Lebanon is dying and Sharon Valley is dry and empty. Bashan and Carmel once grew beautiful plants—but now those plants have stopped growing.

dag: Ka zom maa kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi ka yɛli, N nya niriba ka bɛ chana; amaa bɛ ŋmanila tihi.
en: The man looked up and said, Yes, I see people. They look like trees walking around.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnim ni bɛ ŋmaligi labi bɛ nyaaŋa nti dɔni Pihahirɔt tooni polo, Migidol mini teeku sunsuuni luɣ shɛli din miri Baalizɛfɔn la; dɔnimiya miri teeku maa noli.
en: Tell the people of Israel to turn back and camp across from Pi-Hahiroth near Baal-Zephon, between Migdol and the Red Sea.

dag: Saa malila ba? Bee ŋuni n-daa lee chɛ ka bɛ dɔɣi maligim din tɔɣiri luri ŋɔ?.
en: Has the rain a father who brought forth drops of dew?.

dag: Ka naa maa mini ba zaa daa ti di alizama, ka o nya ka Daniɛl mini Hanania ni Mishɛl ni Azaria yɛla n-kpe o nyaɣisim gari bɛ tab la zaa. Ka bɛ daa leei bɛn ʒiini naa tooni nayili.
en: The king interviewed them and discovered that none of the others were as outstanding as Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah. So they were given positions in the royal court.

dag: Ka paɣ yino yɛli, N dana, m mini paɣ ŋɔ n-laɣim be yil yini, ka n daa ti dɔɣi, ka o kul bela yili maa ni.
en: One of the women said, Sir, this woman and I live in the same house. We were both pregnant and ready to give birth to our babies. I had my baby while she was there with me.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Ammɔnnim naa daa ti kpi ka o bia Hanun daa di nam zan o ba zaani.
en: Some time later, King Nahash of Ammon died, and his son Hanun became king.

dag: Miriya ka yi dihi yɔhiŋgu yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ tabili. Dina n-nyɛ: Yawɛ jɛmbu duu m-bɔŋɔ, Yawɛ jɛmbu duu m-bɔŋɔ, Yawɛ jɛmbu duu m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Dont trust the lies that some people say. They say, This is the Temple of the Lord , the Temple of the Lord , the Temple of the Lord ! .

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu chɛ ka daadam ku tooi nyu bara Naawuni sani.
en: So no human being can brag in Gods presence.

dag: Yawɛ ni guli ba ka ba bɛ nyɛviya zali; ka chɛ ka bɛ mal alibarika dunia ŋɔ ni; o mi ku chɛ ba niŋ bɛ dimnim nuu ni.
en: The Lord will protect them and save their lives. He will bless them in this land. He will not let their enemies harm them.

dag: Ka bulaa maa daa kul duhir omaŋ pahira, amaa o ni daa mali kpiɔŋ pam maa ka o yilli la kabi. Ka yila anahi daa bili yina n-zani di zaashee, ka nir ni tooi nya li viɛnyɛliŋga, di mi zaa noya daa kpala dunia ŋɔ yaɣa anahi ŋɔ zaa yiniyini polo.
en: So the goat became very powerful. But after he became strong, his big horn broke off. Then four horns grew in place of the one big horn. Those four horns were easy to see. They pointed in four different directions.

dag: A yi tɔɣisiri yɛlimaŋli yɛtɔɣa, di ni niŋ ma nyaɣisim.
en: I will be proud when I hear you speaking words of wisdom.

dag: Amaa o ba yi bi saɣ o ni lo ni o niŋ shɛm maa o ni wum li saha shɛli maa, o ni po pɔ shɛŋa min o ni lo alikauli ni o niŋ shɛli maa zaa shɛli ku zani; ka Yawɛ ni chɛ o taali o ba ni bi saɣi maa zuɣu.
en: But if her father forbids her to fulfill the vow when he hears about it, she is not required to keep it. The Lord will forgive her, because her father refused to let her keep it.

dag: Mbaye Sidɔn, a di vi, dama teeku birini yɛliya, N na ʒi n-wolisi bee n-dɔɣi. M mi na ʒi n-wumsi nachimpola bee paɣipiɛlisi.
en: Be ashamed, Sidon, because the sea has spoken; the fortress of the sea has said, I havent been in labor; I didnt give birth; I never raised young men or brought up young women.

dag: Bɛ ba daa ti ba pina pam din nyɛ salima mini anzinfa ni anfaani binyara, ka daa zaŋ bɛ ni me goondahi gili Juda tin shɛŋa la ti ba pahi, amaa o daa zaŋ o nam maa tila Jɛhɔram, dama ŋuna n-daa nyɛ o bituuli.
en: Their father had given them many gifts of silver, gold, and other valuables, along with fortified cities in Judah, but he gave the kingdom to Jehoram because he was the oldest son.

dag: Musa ni daa nya ka bɛ tum tuma maa zaa kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ba ni bɛ tum li shɛm maa, ka o daa suhi alibarika niŋ bɛ ni.
en: Moses examined everything and saw that they had made it all just as the Lord had commanded. So Moses blessed them.

dag: Amaa n daa bi niŋ n ni wum shɛm maa yɛda naɣila n ni kana ka mmaŋmaŋ nini ti dii nya li ŋɔ. Hal bɛ daa bi yɛli ma a yɛm din galisi pam ŋɔ yɛla pirigili gba; a biɛhigu maa gari n ni daa wum a yɛla shɛm maa.
en: I did not believe what they told me until I came and saw for myself. I had not heard of even half your wisdom. You are even wiser than people say.

dag: Ka Leeban daa kana ti paai Yaakubu. Yaakubu daa tila o suɣa zali zoya ni, ka Leeban mi min o dɔɣiriba maa daa ti bɛ suɣa zali zoya ni tin shɛli din yuli booni Giliad la.
en: Laban reached Jacob after Jacob had pitched his tent in the mountains. So Laban and his brothers also pitched theirs in the mountains of Gilead.

dag: Di zuɣu ka ti mali m-be kasi Yisa Masia ni daa tum Naawuni yubu, ka zaŋ omaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ mali sara yim ka di yɛla naai zaa la zuɣu.
en: So we are made holy because Christ obeyed God and offered himself once for all.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Dauda bidibisi nti pahi o mamanim bidibisi zuɣu, bɛ tizɔpaɣa n-daa nyɛ Tama.
en: This was all of Davids family, except for his secondary wives children. Tamar was their sister.

dag: Di saha bɛn ti be Judia, bɛn zom ti du zoya; ka bɛn ti be Jɛrusalɛm puuni, bɛn ti yim di ni, ka tiŋkpannim mi di ti ka di ni na.
en: Then those who are in Judea must run away to the hills; those who are in the city must leave, and those who are out in the country must not go into the city.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa daba ata dali ka so daa ti niŋdi amiliya Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni tiŋkpan shɛli din yuli booni Kɛna la. Yisa ma daa be amiliya maa ni.
en: On the third day there was a wedding in Cana of Galilee. Jesus mother was there, and.

dag: Bɛ ni ti yɛli, Kulla Yawɛ kɔŋko sani ka wuntia ni kpiɔŋ be. Amaa ŋunkam zaa je ma ni di vi.
en: they will say, Righteousness and strength come only from the LORD. All who are angry with him will come to shame.

dag: Ka Dan zuliya niriba maa yɛl o, Miri ka a chɛ ka ti niriba ŋɔ wum a damli, ka bɛ puuni suhuyiɣisilinim lu a zuɣu n-ku a min a yiŋnima.
en: But the Danites said to him, Dont raise your voice with us or else hotheaded men will attack you, and you and your household will lose your lives.

dag: Bɛ daa zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la jɛmbu, ka ŋmaligi jɛmdila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa gil ba la wuna. Ka bɛ ni daa niŋ shɛm maa chɛ ka Yawɛ suhi yiɣisi.
en: It was the Lord , the God their ancestors worshiped, who had brought the Israelites out of Egypt. But they stopped following him and began to worship the false gods of the people living around them. This made the Lord angry.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda garigi yɛli, Bolimiya Batishiiba ti ma. Ka o daa kpe naa sanna nti zan o tooni.
en: King David said, Ask Bathsheba to come back in—and she came and stood before him.

dag: Ka Chɛrubi ŋun maa gba kpiŋkpaŋ yini din wɔɣilim daa nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla la daa chaŋ ti shihi dukpini. Ka kpiŋkpaŋ din la, din gba wɔɣilim daa nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla maa mi daa chaŋ ti shih o kpee la kpiŋkpaŋa.
en: And the other wing of the second Cherub angel touched the wall on the other side of the room.

dag: Bɛnkam zaa gariti kpahirila bɛ nuhi niŋd a. Bɛ maan a la ansarisi, ka gbaɣisiri bɛ zuɣuri niŋd a, nyin Jɛrusalɛm bipuɣiŋga. Tin shɛli bɛ ni daa booni tin viɛlli zaa, ka nyɛ dunia zaa suhupiɛlli shee la m-bɔŋɔ.
en: All who pass by on the road clap their hands about you; they whistle, shaking their heads at Daughter Jerusalem: Could this be the city called Perfect Beauty, the Joy of All the Earth.

dag: UFARISIN gbinni nyɛla, Naawuni pirigi a nam maa n-ti Miidianim mini Pɛriʒianima.
en: PERES means your kingship is divided and given to the Medes and the Persians.

dag: Dama Naawuni mi ni yi yi di li, yi nini ni neei, ka yi be kaman ŋun Naawuni, ka mi zaɣ suŋ ni zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: God knows that if you eat the fruit from that tree you will learn about good and evil, and then you will be like God.

dag: N daa tiligi ya Ijiptinim mini bɛnkam zaa daa nahindi ya nuu ni, ka kari ba ka zaŋ bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tin ya.
en: I delivered you from the power of the Egyptians and from the power of all your oppressors. I drove them out before you and gave you their land.

dag: Napɔŋ buta ka n kani yi sanna pahiri ŋɔ. So taali nyabu kam ni, di simdi ni niriba ayi bee ata n-di shɛhira.
en: This will be my third time to visit you. And remember, For every complaint there must be two or three people to say that they know it is true.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti pii din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli, chɛliya ka ti maŋmaŋ lihi n-nya din viɛla.
en: It is up to us to decide the case.

dag: Yi daa yɛliya, Tim ti naa mini kpambaliba. Yi naa maa lee be ya pumpɔŋɔ n-ni tooi tiligi ya? Yi kpambaliba maa lee be ya n-ni tooi zabi yi zuɣu?.
en: Where is your king now, so that he can save you? Where in all your cities are your judges, of whom you said, Give me a king and rulers?.

dag: Ka tiŋgbani daa sɔŋ paɣ maa bɔɣi, ka waɣ titali maa ni daa tuhi ko shɛli o nol ni na ka di be kaman mɔɣili kom maa zɔna ti kpe di ni, ka di nyu di zaa.
en: But the earth helped her and swallowed the water that had come from the dragon's mouth.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn shihi ninsal ŋun kpi, bɛ ni leei bɛn bi be nyam daba ayopɔin.
en: The person who touches the dead body of any human will be unclean for seven days.

dag: Dinzuɣu baŋmiya ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ yɛda n-nyɛ Ibrahimma yaansi.
en: those who believe are the children of Abraham.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yinim Izraɛlnim bɛn pɔri ka ka yaa ŋɔ, di zɔriya dabiɛm, n ni sɔŋ ya. Mani Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ n-nyɛ yi Tiligira.
en: Dont fear, worm of Jacob, people of Israel! I will help you, says the LORD. The holy one of Israel is your redeemer.

dag: Ka paɣ maa yɛli wahu maa, Ti ni tooi di ti shɛŋa din be puu ŋɔ ni wala;.
en: The woman answered the snake, No, we can eat fruit from the trees in the garden.

dag: N daa nyala Shiina binyɛr suŋ mini anzinfa kpila, ka di tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram pirigili ni salin kpilli din mi tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram pirigili ka n kɔre kpe di ni, ka n kpuɣ li n-zaŋ li ti pi tiŋa n suɣili ni ka anzinfa maa be di gbinni.
en: Among the things we seized I saw a beautiful Babylonian cloak, about five pounds of silver, and a bar of gold weighing over one pound. I wanted them so much that I took them. You will find them buried inside my tent, with the silver at the bottom.

dag: Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la min o tɔɣima la daa ʒiɛla kpaŋ ha tuhi siliga maa.
en: All this time Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were sitting across from the tomb.

dag: Suhugarigu chɛmi ka n gbarigi zaa; n kul malila nandahima m biɛhigu puuni. Ka n ni be nandahima shɛŋa ni maa zuɣu chɛ ka n gbarigi zaa ka n kɔba ni zaa kul chɔɣisichɔɣisi.
en: My life is consumed with sadness; my years are consumed with groaning. Strength fails me because of my suffering; my bones dry up.

dag: ka kari saria din tuhi n-sɔŋ kpibisi mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari nahiŋgu, ka lala chɛ ka dabiɛm ku lan mali daadamnim yaha.
en: You defend orphans and everyone else in need, so that no one on earth can terrify others again.

dag: Ibram ni daa chaŋ ti ʒini Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni la yuun pia nyaaŋa, ka Ibram paɣ Zarai daa zaŋ o dabili Haga ŋun daa nyɛ Ijipti bipuɣiŋga la n-ti o yidana Ibram ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: So she gave Hagar to him to be his concubine.

dag: Ka Stiivin garigi yɛli, M banim mini m mabihi, wummiya! Ti yab Ibrahimma ni daa na be Mɛsopoteemia tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka na bi yiɣisi looi Haran tiŋgbɔŋ ni la ka Naawuni ŋun nyɛ jilimalan ŋɔ daa yi o zuɣu.
en: Stephen answered: Friends, listen to me. Our glorious God appeared to our ancestor Abraham while he was still in Mesopotamia, before he had moved to Haran.

dag: Bɛ ni bi lihi nya Yawɛ ni pun tum tuun shɛŋa bee n-lihi nya o nuhi tuma la zuɣu, o ni daai ba luhi ka ku lan yiɣisi ba zali.
en: They take no notice of what the Lord has done or of what he has made; so he will punish them and destroy them forever.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa yiɣisi Bɛrɔtibɛnɛjaakan n-chaŋ Mɔsɛra. Nimaani ka Aduna daa kpi, ka bɛ daa sɔɣ o nimaani, ka o bidibiga Ɛliɛza daa leei maligumaana zan o zaani.
en: Now, the Israelites had set out from Beeroth-bene-jaakan to Moserah. It was there that Aaron died and was buried. His son Eleazar succeeded him in the priestly role.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiri ni tinim kul bela kum barina ni ni di chɛ ka yinim mali nyɛvili.
en: This means that death is working in us, but life is working in you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sabi Bɛnjamin zuliya yuya ni bɛ daŋ ni bɛ malibu ni bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm, bɛn paai yuun pisi bee n-gar lala, ka nyɛ bɛn ni tooi chaŋ tɔbu ni.
en: There were the descendants of Benjamin, registered by their clans and their households. The men years old and above eligible for military service were recorded by name.

dag: Ka yi yi bi pal alikauli ni so bini, ŋuni n-lee ni zaŋ yimaŋmaŋ dini ni nyɛ shɛli tin ya?.
en: If you havent been faithful with someone elses property, who will give you your own?.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti lan yɛli, Bɛ ni zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la jɛmbu, ka taɣi deela wuna n-gbaani tiŋ jɛmdi li la zuɣu ka o chɛ ka yɛlibiɛri ŋɔ zaa paai ba maa. .
en: The answer will come, Because they abandoned the LORD, the God of their ancestors, who brought them out of Egypt. They embraced other gods, worshipping and serving them. This is why God brought all this disaster on them.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli anabi Shɛmaya.
en: But the LORDs word came to Shemaiah the man of God.

dag: Niriba pam bɛn nyɛ tipawumlinima, ka lan nyɛ bɛn tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ chɔɣima ni bɛn yɔhindi niriba beni, di bahi bamdi yɛdaniŋdiba bɛn na kul doli Yɛhudianim adiini soli kaya la.
en: For there are many, especially the converts from Judaism, who rebel and deceive others with their nonsense.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Naawuni daa pii ma n-leei lahibal suŋ ŋɔ molomoona mini di tumo ni di karimba.
en: My work is to be a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher.

dag: Yi mi di zaŋya yimaŋ tabili zuliya shɛb bɛn na kpalim be yi ni la bee m-boli bɛ buɣa la yuya bee m-po ba bee n-jɛm ba bee n-damdi di tooni.
en: Don't have anything to do with the nations that live around you. Don't worship their gods or pray to their idols or make promises in the names of their gods.

dag: Dama Naawuni ni ti kari tuuni kam saria zaŋ tabili ashilɔni tuuni kam, di yi nyɛla zaɣ suŋ bee zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: God is going to judge everything we do, whether good or bad, even things done in secret.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kpe ŋariŋ ni yiri kpaŋa.
en: They left in a boat for a place where they could be alone.
