dag: Ka Dauda daa lan kpuɣi Ahinɔam ŋun nyɛ Jɛziriil nir la pahi, ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa leeg o paɣiba.
en: David had earlier married Ahinoam from the town of Jezreel, so both she and Abigail were now David's wives.

dag: O yihiri nanim nam ni, ka chɛri ka bɛ leeri bɛn pa shɛli.
en: God brings down rulers and turns them into nothing.

dag: Zuliya kam mini nanim ni gbib a kaman paɣ ni gbib o bia ŋun mɔɣiri shɛm la. Ka a baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun tilig a. Ka lan baŋ ni Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun nyɛ kpiɔŋlan ŋɔ n-fa a bahi maa.
en: You will suck the milk of nations, and nurse at royal breasts. You will know that I am the LORD, your savior and your redeemer, the mighty one of Jacob.

dag: Shutɛla zuliya ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ɛran daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Ɛrannima.
en: These are Shuthelahs descendants: from Eran, the Eranite clan.

dag: Yaa ti Duuma Naawuni, a daa wuh a yiko ni nyɛ shɛm yih a niriba Ijipti na, ka bɛ na kul teer a yiko tuma maa yɛla. Ti tum alahichi ka tum din bi tuhi.
en: O Lord our God, you showed your power by bringing your people out of Egypt, and your power is still remembered. We have sinned; we have done wrong.

dag: O daa kul chanila buɣa jɛmbu shee mini zoya zuɣu ni ti mahili kam gbini nti maani maligu ka tuɣindi tulaale zim.
en: At the pagan places of worship, on the hills, and under every shady tree, Ahaz offered sacrifices and burned incense.

dag: Ka so ti ku lan wum mɔɣilo ŋmɛriba mini bana ni alijeeta piɛbiriba ni kika piɛbiriba damli a ni; ka tuuni kam tuumbaŋda ti ku lan be a ni, ka so ti ku lan wum nɛli vubu a ni!.
en: O Babylon, the music of people playing harps and other instruments, flutes and trumpets will never be heard in you again. No worker doing any job will ever be found in you again. The sound of a millstone will never be heard in you again.

dag: Ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa dii tim zuɣuŋmara ni o cham ti ŋma Jɔn Baptaizira zuɣu na. Ka o daa chaŋ sarika duu nti ŋma o zuɣu.
en: So he ordered a guard to bring Johns head. The guard went to the prison, cut off Johns head.

dag: So ni yɛli, Binshɛɣukam zaa luhiya n sani. Yɛlimaŋli, amaa pa binshɛɣukam zaa m-mali nir buchi. N gba ni tooi yɛli ni binshɛɣukam zaa luhiya n sani, amaa n ku saɣi chɛ ka di shɛli zaŋ ma leei di dabili.
en: Someone will say, I am allowed to do anything. Yes; but not everything is good for you. I could say that I am allowed to do anything, but I am not going to let anything make me its slave.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni ti o tarili wɔɣira puuni. O mini bɛn mali yaa ni ti laɣim pirigi bɛ ni ŋme n-di neen shɛŋa. Dama o daa saɣiya kpi, ka bɛ daa kal o pahi alahichinim ni. O daa ʒi niriba pam daalahichi, ka tim sandaani ti alahichinima.
en: The Lord will reward him with honor and power for sacrificing his life. Others thought he was a sinner, but he suffered for our sins and asked God to forgive us.

dag: Nyin Naawuni n-nyɛ n ni sɔɣiri so sani; ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ma bahi? Bɔzuɣu ka a chɛ ka n fabindi n dimnim ni nahindi ma shɛm zuɣu?.
en: You are my protector; why have you abandoned me? Why must I go on suffering from the cruelty of my enemies?.

dag: Ka din pah ayɔbu gbaai Bukia min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: the sixth to Bukkiah, his family, and his relatives.

dag: Anabi Musa n-daa nyɛ ŋun daa lan yɛli Izraɛlnima, Naawuni ni ti pii so yi mabihi ni n-chɛ ka o niŋ anabi kaman o ni daa pii ma shɛm la.
en: This is the same Moses who said these words to the people of Israel: God will give you a prophet. That prophet will come from among your own people. He will be like me.

dag: O ni yɛli, N ni lan chɛ ka ŋɔ nyɛla yɛtɔɣ shɛli din wuhiri ni binshɛŋa din nyɛ binnamda ka damdi la ni vuui ni di chɛ ka binshɛŋa din ku tooi dam la kpalim be.
en: The words once again clearly show us that everything that was created will be destroyed—that is, the things that can be shaken. And only what cannot be shaken will remain.

dag: Ka Naawuni ŋun vihiri ninsalinim suhuri mi din be o Shia Kasi tɛha ni, dama Naawuni Shia Kasi n-deeri suhiri tiri Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda kaman Naawuni yubu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: And God, who sees into our hearts, knows what the thought of the Spirit is; because the Spirit pleads with God on behalf of his people and in accordance with his will.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan boli do so ŋun daa nyɛ zom maa na m-pahi buyi nti yɛl o, Paɣimi Naawuni; amaa ti lee mi ni doo ŋɔ nyɛla alahichilana.
en: A second time they called back the man who had been born blind, and said to him, Promise before God that you will tell the truth! We know that this man who cured you is a sinner.

dag: Ka so yi zaŋ jaaŋgbee ŋme o dabipaɣ bee dabidoo ka o kpi o nuu ni, bɛn darigim o tibili.
en: If a slave owner takes a stick and beats his slave, whether male or female, and the slave dies on the spot, the owner is to be punished.

dag: Yisahaku ni daa ti kurigi ka o nina niŋ liti, ka o bi lan tooi nyari viɛnyɛliŋga saha shɛli, ka o daa bol o bituuli Iso na ti yɛl o, M bia. Ka o saɣi yɛli, N nyɛ ma.
en: Isaac was now old and had become blind. He sent for his older son Esau and said to him, Son! Yes, he answered.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa neei Balaam nina ka o nya Yawɛ malaika maa ni ʒe soli ni ŋ-ŋooi takɔbi gbib o nuu ni shɛm maa, ka o silim o zuɣu n-zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋa.
en: Just then, the Lord let Balaam see the angel standing in the road, holding a sword, and Balaam bowed down.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd ni daa yɛn chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ Pita tah o sanna dahin shɛli dazɔhigu dali yuŋ, Pita daa dola dansarika guliba ayi sunsuuni gbihira. Bɛ daa zaŋla zoligɔnim ayi lo o, ka dugul shɛb ʒe n-guli dunoli.
en: The night before Herod was going to bring him out to the people, Peter was sleeping between two guards. He was tied with two chains, and there were guards on duty at the prison gate.

dag: Di saha yi ni ti saɣim yi wuna mini di binnan shɛŋa zuɣu bɛ ni dooi salima mini anzinfa pa, ka va li labi kaman binchɛr biɛr la ka yɛli, Wari ya.
en: You will defile your silver-plated idols and your gold-covered priestly vest, and you will scatter them like menstrual rags. Get out, you will say to them.

dag: A chɛ ka saa miri pam niŋdi puri ka di maara, ka chɛ ka vuɣisi doya baalim, ka sakom chɛ ka di bala, ka bimbilli kam zoora.
en: You pour rain on the plowed fields; you soak the fields with water. You make the ground soft with rain, and you make the young plants grow.

dag: Ka o daa zani paɣ maa zuɣusaa n-tahi dɔro maa zuɣu, ka paɣ maa niŋgbun biisim maa maai, ka o dii yiɣisi niŋ ba saani.
en: So Jesus went over to her and ordered the fever to go away. Right then she was able to get up and serve them a meal.

dag: n-yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ, pa nyini n-nyɛ alizanda Naawuni? Pa nyin n-nyɛ ŋun su zuliya kam zaa nam fukumsi? Kpiɔŋ mini yiko bela a nuu ni, ka so ku tooi mo a.
en: LORD, the God of our ancestors, you alone are God in heaven. You rule all the kingdoms of the nations. You are so powerful that no one can oppose you.

dag: Dauda ni daa wum di yɛla, o daa chɛ ka Jɔab zaŋla tɔbutuhiri biinsi zaa chaŋ.
en: When David heard this, he sent Joab and the entire army of warriors.

dag: Nyam dabisili maa! Nyama, di kanna, yi bahiyoli biɛɣu neeya. Tibidarigibo jaaŋgbee yirigi puma, ka karimbaani tiri.
en: That time of punishment has come like a plant sprouting, budding, and flowering. God has given the signal, the enemy is prepared, and their proud king is ready.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ ba na ti zali maa nyaaŋa, ka bɛ daa yɛli ba, Zomiya tiligi! Yi mi miriya ka yi ŋmaligi lihi yi nyaaŋa bee n-zani vinvamli ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛli. Kul zomiya ti du zoya ŋɔ ha, di yi pa lala, buɣim ni din ya.
en: After getting them out, the men said, Save your lives! Dont look back! And dont stay in the valley. Escape to the mountains so that you are not swept away.

dag: Yaakubu zuliya ninvuɣ so ni ti di nam, ka ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim be Iri.
en: A new ruler will come from the family of Jacob. That ruler will destroy the people left alive in that city.

dag: N ni yihiri lahibal suŋ shɛli waazu ŋɔ wuhiri ni lala nti shiri yɛn niŋ dahin shɛli Naawuni ni ti yɛn kari ashiya din be ninsalinim suhuri ni saria Yisa Masia zuɣu la.
en: And so, according to the Good News I preach, this is how it will be on that Day when God through Jesus Christ will judge the secret thoughts of all.

dag: Salima kpahi tibisim daa nyɛla kilɔgiram giram kɔbisinu ni pisopɔin ni biɛla. Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ dooi salima pa di zuɣusaa duri la dukpina zaa zuɣu.
en: twenty ounces of gold were used for making nails, and the walls of the upper rooms were also covered with gold.

dag: Ka yɛl biɛ shɛli ti kana ti ŋme n-ku li, hal ka bɛ ti bi chɛ shɛli zali bɛ bihi gba.
en: Suddenly they lose everything in a bad business deal, then have nothing to leave for their children.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa yɛli niriba maa, Nyamiya, n da yi mini yi puri n-ti Firawuna zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Pumpɔŋɔ deemiya bimbira ŋɔ zali nti biri.
en: Joseph said to the people, You see, I have now bought you and your lands for the king. Here is seed for you to sow in your fields.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa yɛli Yɛhudianim bɛn niŋ o yɛda maa, Yi yi doli n yɛligu, yi ni niŋ n nyaandol maŋa.
en: Jesus told the people who had faith in him, If you keep on obeying what I have said, you truly are my disciples.

dag: Naawuni yino ŋun nyɛ ti zaa Ba, ka nyɛ ti zaa Duuma ŋun be ti zaa ni ka tumdi ti zaa ni la m-beni.
en: there is one God and Father of all people, who is Lord of all, works through all, and is in all.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daa galim alikauli kurili ʒiɛmani maa ni niriba yɛli: Yi Duuma yɛliya, Dabisi shɛŋa saha kanna, ka n ni ti lo Izraɛlnim mini Judanim alikauli palli.
en: But the Lord found fault with it and said, I tell you the time will come, when I will make a new agreement with the people of Israel and the people of Judah.

dag: Di saha ka ŋun nyɛ ŋun pun be tum kurimbuni ha la daa kana ti kari saria sɔŋ Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ wuntizɔriba, ka saha daa paai ni wuntizɔriba maa deei nam su.
en: Then God Most High, the Eternal God, came and judged in favor of his chosen ones, because the time had arrived for them to be given the kingdom.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa ti lan laɣim ka Rɛfaim vinvamli maa ni na ti doya yaha.
en: Some time later, the Philistines came back into the hill country and camped in Rephaim Valley.

dag: Ka niriba nya teeku puuni kɔsoya, ka dunia ni tam tanza shɛŋa zuɣu yi zahira Yawɛ tahigu mini pɔhim shɛli din yiri o nyɛvoya ni na vuri zuɣu.
en: The Lord shouted his command, and a powerful wind began to blow. Then the bottom of the sea could be seen, and the earths foundations were uncovered.

dag: Amaa miriya! Bɛ ni ti gbahi ya tahi ʒiishɛhi, ka fiɛbi ya Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni, ka zaŋ ya tahi gomnanim mini nazuɣuri tooni n zuɣu, ka yi ti niŋ n shɛhiranim bɛ sani.
en: You yourselves must watch out. You will be arrested and taken to court. You will be beaten in the synagogues; you will stand before rulers and kings for my sake to tell them the Good News.

dag: Bɛ ti ku lan bol a, Chɛ m-bahi, bee m-bol a tiŋgbani, Zaɣ nɛli. Amaa bɛ ni ti bol a la, Naawuni nini ni tiɣi so, ka boli a tiŋgbani, Dooyililana. Dama Yawɛ nini tiɣ a, ka a tiŋgbɔŋ ni ti mali yidana.
en: You will no longer be called Abandoned, and your land will no longer be called Deserted. Instead, you will be called My Delight Is in Her, and your land, Married. Because the LORD delights in you, your land will be cared for once again.

dag: Daadam napɔŋ ti ku lan no di ni, ka biŋkɔbiri gba napɔna ti ku lan no di ni. Binvuhirigu ti ku lan be di ni hal ni yuun pihinahi.
en: No human or animal will even dare travel through Egypt, because no sign of life will be found there for years.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa mali alahichi sanyoo sara maa n-yo ŋun yi daɣiri ni maa daalahichi samli. Di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi kɔrigi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara biŋkɔb so nyɔri buɣim la.
en: Then the priest must offer the sin offering to make that person pure. After that he will kill the animal for the burnt offering.

dag: ka yɛli Taai din be teeku noli, ka bɛ mini tin shɛŋa din be teeku duli nim niŋdi daabiligu la, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyin Taai, a yɛliya, N viɛl zaa.
en: Say this about Tyre, who sits enthroned at the entrance to the sea, the peoples agent for trade throughout the coastlands. The LORD God proclaims: Tyre, you say, Im perfectly beautiful.

dag: Ɛli ni daa wum kuhigu maa, ka o bɔhi, Ka bo vuri n-lee bala? Ka doo maa daa zɔna yomyom ti yɛli Ɛli di ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Eli was years old. He was blind, so he could not see what was happening, but he could hear the loud noise of the people crying. Eli asked, Why are the people making this loud noise? The Benjamite man ran to Eli and told him what happened.

dag: Ka o ni daa wuhiri ba shɛm maa daa gari bɛnkam wum li pam, dama o yɛtɔɣa maa daa nyɛla din mali yiko.
en: They were all amazed at the way he taught, because he spoke with authority.

dag: Yisa daa ti chaŋ Nazarɛt bɛ ni daa wubis o tin shɛl ni la n-daa ti chaŋ Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu Vuhim Dabisili dali kaman o ni daa yi pun niŋdi shɛm la. Ka o daa ti yiɣisi zani ni o karim.
en: Then Jesus went to Nazareth, where he had been brought up, and on the Sabbath he went as usual to the synagogue. He stood up to read the Scriptures.

dag: N ŋmanila bɛ ni chɛ kpiin shɛb bahi, ka ŋmani bɛ ni ku shɛb ka bɛ do gbala puuni, ka lan ŋman a ni bi lan teeri shɛb yɛla yaha, dama bɛ nyɛla a baɣa ni lan ka shɛb sɔŋsim ni.
en: Look for me among the dead, like a body in the grave. I am one of those you have forgotten, cut off from you and your care.

dag: Yi mi ni dali nyɛla Yaɣigari Chuɣu, ka bɛ ni ti zaŋ Daadam Bia ti ninvuɣ shɛb ni bɛ kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: You know that the day after tomorrow is Passover. On that day the Son of Man will be handed over to his enemies to be killed on a cross.

dag: Dauda ni daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb zali ni bɛ su Yawɛ jɛmbu duu jɛma yila fukumsi bɛ ni daa zaŋ Alikauli Adaka la labisina la nyaaŋa m-bɔŋɔ.
en: These are the men David chose to take care of the music at the tent of the Lord s house after Gods Holy Box was put there.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yi chɛ ka a kpalim zani dabari kaman niriba ni na ʒi n-ʒini tin shɛŋa ni, n yi zaŋ a niŋ kɔbulli ni, ka ko titali lim a.
en: The Sovereign Lord says: I will make you as desolate as ruined cities where no one lives. I will cover you with the water of the ocean depths.

dag: Di saha ka Amnɔn daa dɔni n-shiri niŋ kaman o biɛrimi la. Ka naa daa ti kana ni o ti kaag o, ka Amnɔn yɛl o, Naa, chɛ ka Tama kana ti mali maha ti ma n ninni, ka zaŋ li na ti gbib o nuu ni ka n ŋubi.
en: So Amnon pretended that he was sick and went to bed. King David went to see him, and Amnon said to him, Please let Tamar come and make a few cakes here where I can see her, and then serve them to me herself.

dag: ni pateesa shɛŋa din yɛn yiini ni mini di daantalisi ni di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu ni pateesa shɛli din yɛn yiini dundɔŋ maa dunoli.
en: the curtains around the yard, their posts and bases, and the curtain that covers the entrance to the yard;.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi maa daa chaŋ na sɔasɔa ti kpe tiŋ maa puuni dindali maa kaman tɔbbi shɛb bɛn ŋmaligi guui tɔbu ni n-kuli ti kpɛri bɛ ya ni vi la.
en: They went back into the city quietly, like soldiers who are ashamed because they are running away from battle.

dag: Di pala yi zuɣu ka n yɛn tum tuuni ŋɔ. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa. Di simdi ni yi baŋ lala. Yinim Izraɛlnima, chɛliya ka vi gbahi ya, ka yi kɔba ni chɔɣisi yi tuma maa zuɣu.
en: Not for your sake do I act. This is what the LORD God proclaims. Let that be known to you! Be ashamed and be humiliated because of all your ways, house of Israel.

dag: Di ni kpamba kul ŋumdimi kaman gbuɣima la, ka di sariakaritiba be kaman zaawuni kunduna bɛn bi guuri binshɛli zaana hal ni asiba la.
en: The princes in her midst are roaring lions. Her judges are wolves of the evening; they leave nothing for the morning.

dag: Ka Musa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza daa deei bɛ ni daa zaŋ salima mali binshɛŋa maa zaa.
en: Moses and Eleazar accepted the jewelry from the commanders.

dag: M ba daa ʒili ya ʒi tibisili, amaa pumpɔŋɔ man yɛn maan pahi li la tibisim. M ba daa malila barazim fiɛbiri ya, amaa man yɛn zaŋla nɔnsi fiɛb ya! .
en: My father forced you to work hard, but I will make you work much harder! My father punished you with whips, but I will punish you with whips that have sharp metal tips.

dag: Ka o daa bɔhi Firawuna tumtumdib shɛb bɛn min o daa be duu o dan yiŋ maa, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi mali suhugarigu lihigu zuŋɔ.
en: He asked the officers of Pharaoh who were under arrest with him in his masters house, Why do you look so distressed today.

dag: n-zaŋ niŋ pɔŋ ni na ti ti bipuɣiŋga maa; ka bipuɣiŋga maa mi daa zaŋ li ti ti o ma.
en: He brought the head back on a plate and gave it to the girl, and the girl gave it to her mother.

dag: N kpalimla kɔba noli, biɛla n-chɛ n naan kpi.
en: I am skin and bones— just barely alive.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd ni daa diri Judia saha shɛl la, ka maligumaani so daa beni ka o yuli booni Zakaria. O daa nyɛla Abija daŋ ni nira, ka o paɣ mi daa nyɛ Aduna daŋ ni nira, ka o yuli booni Ɛlizabɛt.
en: During the time when Herod ruled Judea, there was a priest named Zechariah. He belonged to Abijahs group. His wife came from the family of Aaron. Her name was Elizabeth.

dag: Sool ʒiɛman ni zaa, o mini Filistianim daa kul tuhirimi ni nimmoo, dinzuɣu o daa yi kul nya do so ŋun mali kpiɔŋ bee suhukpeeni o zaŋd o mi leeg o tɔbbia.
en: There was fierce warfare against the Philistines throughout Sauls lifetime. So whenever Saul saw any strong or heroic man, he would add him to his troops.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Mani ŋun tɔɣisir a yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ m-bala.
en: I am that one, Jesus told her, and I am speaking to you now.

dag: Yawɛ po o nudirigu din mali kpiɔŋ la yɛli: N ku lan zaŋ yi chi ti yi dimnim ka bɛ di. M mi ku lan chɛ ka tinzunnim zaŋ yi ni di wahala tɔɣi yi wain shɛli nyu.
en: The Lord made a promise and guaranteed it by his own power. And he will use that power to keep his promise. The Lord said, I promise that I will never again give your food to your enemies. I promise that they will never again take the wine you make.

dag: A daa bi dolila bɛ naba n-tum bɛ ni daa tum din chihiri shɛŋa maa kɔŋko, amaa saha biɛla ka a daa zaŋ tum din bie n-gari bɛ dini a soya zaa ni.
en: You followed their way of life and their wicked customs, and soon you were more repulsive than they were.

dag: Ti nyɛla saamba bɛn go n-chani gind a tooni kaman ti yaannim la. Ti dunia ŋɔ ni biɛhigu ŋmanila shilinshia, ka tahima kani.
en: To be sure, we are like all our ancestors, immigrants without permanent homes. Our days are like a shadow on the ground, and theres no hope.

dag: Yi ŋmari ʒiri n-chɛ ka wuntizɔriba suhuri gbarigira, hal n ni bi gbarigir bɛ suhuri maa zaa yoli; ka kpaŋsiri ninvuɣ biɛri kɔba ni ka bɛ bi niŋdi tuuba din ni chɛ ka bɛ tiligi bɛ nyɛviya.
en: By your lies you discourage good people, whom I do not wish to hurt. You prevent evil people from giving up evil and saving their lives.

dag: ka tɔɣisiri binshɛɣukam zaa din daa niŋ maa yɛla.
en: They were talking to each other about everything that had happened.

dag: Zanimi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dunɔdali gbini n-yɛli ba nimaani, Judanim zaa bɛn doli dunoya ŋɔ kpɛri ti jɛmdi Yawɛ, wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Jeremiah, stand at the gate of the Lord s house. Teach this message at the gate: Hear the message from the Lord , all you people of the nation of Judah. All you who come through these gates to worship the Lord , hear this message.

dag: Nanim ŋɔ zaa daa naala noli n-laɣim bɛ tɔbbihi ti do Siddim vinvamli ni luɣ shɛli bɛ ni booni Teeku Kpiŋ pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: These five kings had formed an alliance and joined forces in Siddim Valley, which is now the Dead Sea.

dag: Ti suhuri fuŋmi, ka ti luri bɔɣa ni, yɛl biɛɣu paai ti, ka ti bahi yoli zaa.
en: We have been through disaster and ruin; we live in danger and fear.

dag: Dinzuɣu n suhu zaa saɣimla Mɔabnim mini Kirihɛrɛsinim zuɣu kaman bɛ ni zaŋ mɔɣilo ŋmɛri nandahima yil shɛli.
en: I groan with sadness for Moab, with grief for Kir Heres.

dag: Nahu yi ʒe n-ku doo bee paɣa, bɛn labimi nahu maa kuɣa ku o, ka di bi simdi ka so ŋubi nahu maa nimdi, ka nahu maa lana ku mali taali.
en: A bull that kills someone with its horns must be killed and its meat destroyed, but the owner of the bull isn't responsible for the death.

dag: Di saha ka o daa laɣim bɔba ni yaɣa ni gomnanim maa tɔbbihi maa, ka bɛ kalinli daa yiɣisi kɔbisiyi ni pihitanaayi. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa laɣim Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa, ka bɛ kalinli yiɣisi tusaayopɔin.
en: So Ahab assembled the servants of the district officials. There were two hundred thirty-two of them. Next he assembled the entire Israelite army, seven thousand total.

dag: Ti Duuma yɛliya ni o ni kari Yaakubu zuliya saria, ka di kana ti lu Izraɛlnim zuɣu.
en: The Lord has pronounced judgment on the kingdom of Israel, on the descendants of Jacob.

dag: Rubin zuliya niriba mini Gaad zuliya ni niriba ni Manaasa zuliya ni niriba pirigili bɛn daa be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili dul la tɔbbihi bɛn daa gbibi bidibbina balibu kam din ni tuhi tɔbu daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pisi.
en: from the other side of the Jordan, the Reubenites, Gadites, and the other half of the tribe of Manasseh, , armed with all the weapons of war.

dag: Chɛ ka ti kambɔna pali bindira balibu kam. Chɛ ka ti biŋkɔbbaligu bɛn be mɔɣu ni la nabi n-niŋ tuhilituhili ni tuhi piapia.
en: May our barns be filled with crops of all kinds. May our sheep produce so many lambs, that thousands of sheep will fill our fields.

dag: O nam sulinsi ni zaŋla teeku noli hal ti kpa teeku shɛli noli yaha, ka lan zaŋ Yufretiiz Mɔɣili noli hal ti kpa dunia tariga zaa.
en: Let his kingdom grow from sea to sea, from the Euphrates River to the faraway places on earth.

dag: Di chɛ ka bɛ ni bari ma tɔn shɛli gbaai ma, a mi di chɛ ka tuumbiɛtumdiba ni bari ma zana shɛli gbaai ma.
en: Protect me from the trap theyve set for me; protect me from the snares of the evildoers.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim yi ni doli n zaligu shɛŋa zaa n ni zali ba la mini n dabili Musa ni daa zali ba la zaa, n ku chɛ ka bɛ lan yi n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli n-ti bɛ yaannim maa ni n-chani dari ginda.
en: If my people will faithfully obey all the commands in the Law of my servant Moses, I will never make them leave the land I gave to their ancestors.

dag: ka o daa kuli ti yɛl o ba min o ma, N nyala Filistia do so bipuɣiŋga Timna, dinzuɣu bomiy o ti ma ka n niŋ m paɣa.
en: When he returned home, he said to his father and mother, I saw a Philistine woman in Timnah. I want you to get her for me. I want to marry her.

dag: Di saha ka nachin kpɛm maa daa guui ti tuh o soli yɛl o, N suhir a, tim ma a koyuli ŋɔ ni kom biɛla ka n nyu.
en: Then the servant ran to her and said, Please give me a little water to drink from your jar.

dag: ka bɔhira, O labbuna alikauli lɔbu palibu la lee be ya? Dama ti banim kalinsi nyaaŋa hal ni pɔŋɔ, binshɛɣukam na kul bemi kaman di ni daa be shɛm dunia nambu saha la.
en: They will say, Jesus promised to come again. Where is he? Our fathers have died, but the world continues the way it has been since it was made.

dag: Bɛna n-nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi saɣim bɛmaŋa paɣiba bɔbu ni la; bɛn ʒi paɣiba n-nyɛ ba. Ka Piɛbil maa yi kul chani luɣ shɛlikam bɛ min o dolila taba, bɛna n-nyɛ bɛ ni daa tuui tiligi ninvuɣ shɛba n-ti Naawuni mini Piɛbil maa.
en: They werent defiled with women, for these people who follow the Lamb wherever he goes are virgins. They were purchased from among humankind as early produce for God and the Lamb.

dag: amaa ŋun doli dunoli kpɛra, ŋuna n-nyɛ piɛgula.
en: The one who enters through the gate is the shepherd of the sheep.

dag: Dina n-yɛn nyɛ yi gba zaka, ka di be kaman kabɔɣili ni chi bee wain tɔɣiri bɔɣili ni wain zaka la.
en: It will be considered your gift offering, like the grain of the threshing floor and what fills the winepress.

dag: Yawɛ, a daa po pɔri n-lo Dauda alikauli, ka mi ku lan yi di nyaaŋa. A daa yɛliya, N ni ti zaŋ a bidibisi ni yino n-leei naa ʒil a nam ʒiishee.
en: The LORD swore to David a true promise that God wont take back: I will put one of your own children on your throne.

dag: A ni yɛligi kpa nudirigu mini nuzaa polo, ka a niriba ni su zuliya shɛba, ka yi ti ʒini tin shɛŋa din daa nyɛ dabari la ni.
en: To the right and to the left you will burst out, and your children will possess the nations land and settle their desolate cities.

dag: amaa ka chɛbisi ba ka yɛli, Naawuni yi saɣi, n ni lan lab yi sanna yaha; ka daa yiɣisi kpe ŋariŋ chaŋ.
en: He left them and said, I will come back to you again if God wants me to. And so he sailed away from Ephesus.

dag: Dama n dabisa kul chanimi gariti kaman nyɔhi la, ka n kɔba ni mi diri buɣim kaman daaŋa ni buɣim la.
en: Because my days disappear like smoke, my bones are burned up as if in an oven.

dag: Yi ni ti dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi, amaa yi ti ku su ba, dama bɛ ni ti gbahi ba leei daba chaŋ.
en: You might have sons and daughters, but they wont be yours for long because they will be taken away as prisoners.

dag: Yi vinvam shɛŋa din mali kulim puuni zaa daa palila chɛchɛbunsi, ka wɔribariba ʒe dunɔdaya ni.
en: Your most beautiful valleys were covered with chariots; your cities were surrounded by cavalry troops.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ ti nyaya ka ninvuɣ biɛri n-lee mali suhupiɛlli. Tuumbiɛtumdiba biɛhigu kul tɔŋdimi, ka pa di kɔŋko, hal bɛ yi buɣisi Naawuni ni bɛ nya, binshɛli bi niŋdi ba. .
en: As we see it, proud people are the ones who are happy. Evil people not only prosper, but they test God's patience with their evil deeds and get away with it.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, Naawuni ŋun nam dunia mini binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni ŋɔ n-nyɛ zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani Duuma. O bi be bimbin shɛŋa daadam ni zaŋ o nuhi me zuɣu.
en: God, who made the world and everything in it, is Lord of heaven and earth and does not live in temples made by human hands.

dag: Amaa ka padiriba maa daa ti nya o bia maa ka yɛli taba, O falidir la m-bɔŋɔ na; chɛliya ka ti ku o, ka fali maa leei ti dini.
en: But when they saw the man's son, they said, Someday he will own the vineyard. Let's kill him! Then we can have it all for ourselves.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ ni chɛ ka yi nya soli kpe ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira Masia nam din ka bahigu la ni.
en: In this way you will receive a rich welcome into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and savior Jesus Christ.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Di ŋumdiya yi kparima ni.
en: But Jesus said, Stop complaining to each other.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni, di simdi ni yi niŋ n ni zali ya shɛm n-gbibi n zaligunim ka dol li.
en: No, my regulations and my rules are the ones you must keep by following them: I am the LORD your God.

dag: Ka Ilaisha yɛl o, Cham a ʒiʒiinitab sani nti suhi kpaŋman kuma pam na, pa biɛla.
en: Then Elisha said, Go and borrow bowls from all your neighbors. They must be empty. Borrow plenty of bowls.

dag: hal ka Yawɛ ti chɛ ka bɛ gba deei ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba maa, ka yi naanyi labi Yawɛ dabili Musa ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli din be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo ŋɔ n-tin ya ŋɔ ni na ti ʒini.
en: conquer the land that the Lord is giving them. The Lord will give peace to them as he has given peace to you, and then you can come back and settle here in the land that Moses promised you.

dag: Daadam Bia mi kamina ni o ti bo n-nya bɛn bɔrigi la n-tiligi ba.
en: The Son of Man came to find lost people and save them.

dag: yin miriya ka yi ti doli bɛ tuma, ka zana gbahi ya. Di ti bɔhiya bɛ wuna yɛla n-yɛra, Wula ka niriba ŋɔ daa lee jɛmdi bɛ wuna ŋɔ? Ti gba bɔri ni ti jɛm li.
en: then watch yourself! Dont be trapped by following their practices after theyve been wiped out before you. Dont go investigating their gods, thinking, How did these nations worship their gods? I want to do the very same thing!.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa maa daa yɛli, Gbaamiya Mikaya n-zaŋ o ti ti Amɔn ŋun nyɛ tiŋ ŋɔ Gomna la mini nabia Jɔash.
en: Then King Ahab ordered one of his officers to arrest Micaiah. Ahab said, Arrest him and take him to Amon the governor of the city and prince Joash.

dag: m bɔri ni zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani dinya shɛhira zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni di ku yuui ka yi kpi zaa yi ni yɛn du Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili chaŋ ti ʒini tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni maa; yi ti ku yuui di ni, amaa yi ni ti kpi zaa.
en: I call heaven and earth as my witnesses against you today: You will definitely disappear—and quickly—from the land that you are crossing over the Jordan River to possess. You wont extend your time there but will instead be totally destroyed.

dag: N-yi biɛɣu ka bɛ chaŋ ti miri Jɔpa, di saha ka Pita mi daa du jirambisa zuɣusaa ni o ti suhi Naawuni. Di daa nyɛla agbaa saha.
en: The next day about noon these men were coming near Joppa. Peter went up on the roof of the house to pray.

dag: Yisa ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai saha shɛli maa, ka o dii wuɣiri duri zuɣusaa, ka bɛ kul lihir o hal ka sagbani ti lim o, ka bɛ bi lan nya o.
en: After Jesus said this, he was lifted up into the sky. While they were watching, he went into a cloud, and they could not see him.

dag: Maligumaana bidibbil kam ni tooi ŋub li. Di simdi ka bɛ ti ŋub li la luɣ kasi shee, di nyɛla din be kasi zaa.
en: This sacrifice for making things right is very holy. Only the priests may eat it, and they must eat it in a holy place.

dag: Ka n yi kariti alizin biɛri Biilzibul yiko ni, ka ŋun mi yiko ni ka yi niriba lee kariti ba bahira? Dinzuɣu yimaŋmaŋ niriba maa ni zaŋ yi nol ni yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi luhi ya.
en: If I use the power of Beelzebul to force out demons, whose power do your own followers use to force them out? Your followers are the ones who will judge you.

dag: Satahins ayopɔin maa ni daa tahi saha shɛli maa ka n niŋ shili ni n sabi, amaa ka daa wum kukol shɛli ka di yi zuɣusaa na n-yɛra, Gbib satahins ayopɔin maa ni yɛli shɛm maa ashilɔni, ka di sab li sɔŋ.
en: As soon as they spoke, I was about to write. But I heard a voice speak from heaven, Keep secret what the seven thunders have said; do not write it down.

dag: n-zaŋ o dalinli tabili ti, ka zaŋ o Shia Kasi niŋ ti ni ni o chɛ ka ti baŋ ti ni ti yɛn nya shɛl la.
en: God also sealed us and gave the Spirit as a down payment in our hearts.

dag: Ŋmɛnditɔya ni ti liri Gaad, amaa o ni ti kari doli ba ti fa bɛ nɛma.
en: Gad, you will be attacked, then attack your attackers.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani yinima n-nyɛ niriba maa, ka yi yi kpi, yɛm ni kpi.
en: Surely you are the people, and wisdom will die with you.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila tibihi din nyaɣa na bi ba tiŋa, ka Naawuni yi chɛ ka tulim kana ti kpe li, di kuurimi ka pɔhim ʒe li ti bahi kaman wurigu la.
en: They are like flowers freshly sprung up and starting to grow. But when God blows on them, they wilt and are carried off like straw in a storm.

dag: Dama nir tibiginsim bi yirila wulimpuhili polo na bee wulinluhili polo na; ka di mi bi yirila mɔɣu ni na.
en: Our Lord and our God, victory doesn't come from the east or the west or from the desert.

dag: Ɛvilmɛrɔdak daa tɔɣisi Naa Jɛhoyachin nirilim yɛtɔɣa, ka ti o jilima ʒiishee n-gari na shɛb bɛn daa be o sani Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Awil-merodach spoke kindly to Jehoiachin and seated him above the other kings who were with him in Babylon.

dag: Di ni nyɛla sara shɛli bɛ ni yɛn zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim Yawɛ tooni Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili dunol ŋɔ ni sahakam yi ʒiɛmana zaa ni. Di nyɛla luɣ shɛli m mini ya ni yɛn laɣim ka n tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa nimaani.
en: This should be the regular entirely burned offering in every generation at the meeting tents entrance in the LORDs presence. There I will meet with you, and there I will speak to you.

dag: ka bo wain lita ayi din nyɛ binnyura sara la ni sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim ka di ʒiɛɣu niŋdi Yawɛ nyaɣisim la mali sara.
en: together with pints of wine. The odor of this sacrifice is pleasing to the Lord .

dag: Dinzuɣu mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri mini kunduna ni taatahi n-ni ti be Babilɔn. Niriba ti ku lan be di ni yaha, ka so mi ku lan ʒini di ni ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: Therefore, Babylon will become a ghost town, a place for desert animals, hyenas, and ravenous birds. No one will live there again; no one will make it their home.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Daadam Bia n-nyɛ ŋun biri alikama biɛlin suma la.
en: Jesus replied, The one who plants the good seed is the Human One.

dag: Naftali tiŋgban ni bɛ daa yihila Kɛdɛshi din be Galili la mini Hamɔn ni Kiriataim ni di momaha tiŋgbana zaa ti ba.
en: and from the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee with its pasturelands, Hammon with its pasturelands, and Kiriathaim with its pasturelands.

dag: Ka Jahaziɛl bia Shɛkania la daa nyɛ Zatu daŋ zuɣulana, ka dɔbba kɔbisita daa pah o zuɣu.
en: from the descendants of Zattu: Shecaniah son of Jahaziel, and other men;.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ bɛ ni kpe binnan shɛŋa zali yɛda, ka yɛli ni binnana maa n-nyɛ bɛ wuna, bɛ ni di vi ka ŋmaligi lab bɛ nyaaŋa.
en: Turned backward, utterly shamed are those who trust in idols, who say to a cast image, You are our god.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini ka n kumdi niŋd a. Dama buɣim di mɔɣu zaa, ka buɣim zilima di mɔɣu ni tihi zaa.
en: Lord , I am calling to you for help. Fire has changed our green fields into a desert. Flames have burned all the trees in the field.

dag: Yila pia la mi nyɛla nanim pia bɛn ti yɛn su fukumsi nam maa ʒiɛman ni. Di nyaaŋa na so ni ti yiɣisi n-nyɛ ŋun be o ko ni o tab bɛn daŋ o tooni na la, ka ni ti yihi nanim ata nam ni.
en: The ten horns are ten kings that will come from this fourth kingdom. After those ten kings are gone, another king will come. He will be different from the kings who ruled before him. He will defeat three of the other kings.

dag: dama bɛn zaa piila bɛ bun ni na ti tɔhi, amaa pakoli ŋɔ ŋun zaŋla o duu ni o yiŋ zaa na ti tɔhi.
en: Everyone else gave what they didn't need. But she is very poor and gave everything she had. Now she doesn't have a cent to live on.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Amaa yi yi ni wum n yɛligu, ka ku ʒi ʒiya doli yaŋɔ dunɔdaya ŋɔ kpɛna Vuhim Dabisili dali, amaa ka ni gbibi Vuhim Dabisili maa ka di nyɛ dabisili kasi, ka bi tum tuma dindali.
en: But you must be careful to obey me, says the Lord . You must not bring a load through the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath. You must make the Sabbath day a holy day. You will do this by not doing any work on that day.

dag: O daa ʒe yim ŋun piig o maa sani kaman Anabi Musa ni daa ʒe yim o tuma ni Naawuni niriba sani shɛm la.
en: God made him our high priest, and he was faithful to God just as Moses was. He did everything God wanted him to do in Gods house.

dag: Yiɣisim kpuɣi bia maa n-gbib o a nuu ni viɛnyɛliŋga, dama n ni chɛ ka o zuliya ti galisi pam.
en: Help him up and hold his hand, because I will make him the father of a great nation.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ malaika daa yɛli Ilaija, Dol o chaŋ ka di zɔr o dabiɛm. Ka Ilaija daa yiɣisi dol o chaŋ naa sani ti yɛl o.
en: The angel of the Lord said to Elijah, Go down with him, and don't be afraid. So Elijah went with the officer to the king.

dag: Ka Juda zuliya niriba maa daa lan yi nimaani chaŋ ti liri Dɛbirinima. Bɛ daa tuui booni li la Kiriatisɛfa.
en: The men of Judah left that place. They went to the city of Debir to fight against the people there.

dag: amaa ka niŋ tipawumli n-dolila bɛmaŋmaŋ suhuyubu n-jɛmdi Baalinima kaman bɛ yaannim ni daa wuhi ba shɛm la zuɣu.
en: The people of Judah lived their own way. They were stubborn. They followed the false god Baal. Their fathers taught them to follow those false gods.

dag: N daa wum a yɛla la n tibili ni, amaa pumpɔŋɔ n nini nya a;.
en: In the past I heard about you, but now I have seen you with my own eyes.

dag: Di ti piniya yi tapaɣisi kɔbiri bee n-kɔrisi taɣi yi teeŋkɔbiri.
en: I forbid you to shave any part of your head or beard or to cut and tattoo yourself as a way of worshiping the dead.

dag: Ka Sool tumtumdiba maa daa yɛli Dauda yɛtɔɣa maa. Ka Dauda bɔhi ba, Yi tɛhiya ni di nyɛla asama ni n leei naa deemba? Dama yi nya ka n nyɛla faralana, ka pa yulilana.
en: So they told this to David, and he answered, It's a great honor to become the king's son-in-law, too great for someone poor and insignificant like me.

dag: Ka a nimbil mi yi chɛ ka a yɛn birigi tum alahichi, nyin kpɔɣim li bahi, dama a yi kɔŋ a nimbil yini ka ti be, di so ni a mali nina ayi ka bɛ ti zaŋ a kpɛhi buɣim din bi kpiri ni.
en: If your eye causes you to fall into sin, tear it out and throw it away. Its better to enter into life with one eye than to be cast into a burning hell with two eyes.

dag: M mabiyurisi, teemiya dimbɔŋɔ. Di simdi ni sokam wumdi yomyom, ka gbaam omaŋa o yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu ni, ka mi di jɛri suli yomyom.
en: My dear brothers and sisters, always be more willing to listen than to speak. Keep control of your anger.

dag: ni kom baptaizibu ni nuhi zaŋ pa niriba zuɣu mini kpiimba kum ni neebu ni tibidarigibo din ka bahigu yɛla.
en: of teaching about ritual ways to wash with water, laying on of hands, the resurrection from the dead, and eternal judgment—all over again.

dag: Ka Gomna Fɛstus daa yɛli, Naa Agiripa mini yi zaa bɛn be kpe ŋɔ, doo ŋɔ yɛla ka Yɛhudianim bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm mini ya ŋɔ zaa kul mali doli ma n-kuhiri yɛri ni o bi simdi ni o be la.
en: and said: King Agrippa and other guests, look at this man! Every Jew from Jerusalem and Caesarea has come to me, demanding for him to be put to death.

dag: Ŋuna n-ni ti me jɛmbu duu ti ma jilima. N ni ti leeg o ba, ka o mi leei m bia, ka n chɛ ka o nam mali yaa Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni sahakam.
en: Solomon will build a temple for my name. He will be my son, and I will be his Father. I will make his kingdom strong, and someone from his family will rule Israel forever.

dag: Ka o daa gbaai Sukɔt nachimbil so m-bɔh o bɔhigu. Ka nachimbil maa daa kali Sukɔt kpamba pisopɔinnaayopɔin wuhi Gidiɔn.
en: he caught a young man who lived in Succoth. Gideon asked him who the town officials of Succoth were, and the young man wrote down names.

dag: O ni ti wuhi ya jirambisa du kar shɛli bɛ ni pun malimali binshɛɣukam zali, ka yi mali chuɣu maa shili nimaani gul ti.
en: The owner will take you upstairs and show you a large room furnished and ready for you to use. Prepare the meal there.

dag: Ka Bɔaz daa ti di ka nyu n-naai, ka o suhu dɔni luɣ yini, ka o chaŋ kaʒee gbini ti dɔni ni o gbihi. Ka di daa tooi biɛla ha, ka Rut ti puɣisi chaŋ o naba polo ti viig o chinchini baalim ka dɔni o naba tiŋli.
en: After eating and drinking, Boaz was very satisfied. He went to lie down near the pile of grain. Then Ruth went to him very quietly and lifted the cover from his feet and lay down by his feet.

dag: Ka Batishiiba yɛl o, Yɛlima. Ka o yɛl o, N suhir a, yɛlim Naa Sulemaana ni o zaŋm Abishag Shunɛm paɣisarili la ti ma ka n niŋ m paɣa, ka o mi ku zaɣis a ni yɛli shɛm.
en: He answered, Please ask King Solomon—I know he won't refuse you—to let me have Abishag, the young woman from Shunem, as my wife.

dag: Dama ŋuni n-lee lan nyɛ Naawuni ka pa ni nyini Yawɛ? Ka ŋuni n-lee lan nyɛ tampiŋ ka pa ni ti Naawuni ŋɔ?.
en: Now really, who is divine except the LORD? And who is a rock except our God?.

dag: N ni bahi ba noli ka zaŋ ba labisi tiŋ ŋɔ ni na, ka bɛ ŋme n-deei li, ka nyo li buɣim. N ni ti chɛ ka Juda tinsi leei dabari, ka so ku lan be di ni. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will give the order, and they will return to this city. They will attack it, capture it, and burn it down. I will make the towns of Judah like a desert where no one lives. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: dama n zo so m-paai n yiŋ na pumpɔŋɔ, ka n ka bindir shɛli din ni ti o ka o di.
en: A friend of mine has dropped in, and I don't have a thing for him to eat.

dag: Yawɛ kɔŋko n-daa wuh o soli, ka tinzun buɣili daa ka o sani.
en: The Lord alone led his people. They had no help from any foreign god.

dag: Ka saa daa miri sakuɣ kara ka nyaɣisira, ka lala tatabo daa na ʒi n-niŋ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni saha shɛli di ni daa leei di dahalali tiŋa.
en: The hail and the lightning flashing in the middle of the hail were so severe that there had been nothing like it in the entire land of Egypt since it first became a nation.

dag: O yi di nyɛla dikili, ti naan me anzinfa pia tam o zuɣu; ka o yi di nyɛla dunoli, ti naan zaŋ sida dapaɣa yo o.
en: If she were a wall, we would put silver trim around her. If she were a door, we would put a cedar board around her.

dag: Di saha o ni tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa ni suhuyiɣisili, ka kpɛhi ba dabiɛm o suhuyiɣisili puuni yɛli.
en: The Lord becomes furious and threatens them. His anger terrifies them as he says.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔshafat bɔh o, Yawɛ anab so ka kpe ka ti ni bɔh o baŋ Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm? Di saha ka Izraɛl naa sapashinnim ni yino daa garigi yɛli, Shafat bia Ilaisha, ŋun daa nyɛ Ilaija sɔŋda la be kpe.
en: Jehoshaphat said, Isnt there any prophet of the LORD around, so we could question the LORD through him? One of the servants of Israels king answered, Elisha, Shaphats son, is here. He used to pour water on Elijahs hands.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa niŋ ŋun Keenan Naa Jabin maa muɣisigu hal ti ku o.
en: Jabin grew weaker while the Israelites kept growing stronger, until at last the Israelites destroyed him.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun lihiri tiŋgbani ka di sɔhiri ŋɔ. Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun shihi zoya, ka di tuɣiri nyɔhi.
en: He has only to look at the earth, and it shakes. God just touches the mountains, and they erupt in smoke.

dag: Ka Aduna min o bidibisi maa daa niŋ Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Musa zali ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛlikam zaa maa.
en: Aaron and his sons did everything the LORD commanded through Moses.

dag: Nyin biɛŋmariga ŋun ne pam ŋɔ, nyam a ni yi zuɣusaa lu tiŋ na shɛm! Nyin ŋun daa dihi zuliya pam vi ŋɔ, bɛ daag a luhi tiŋa.
en: You were like the morning star, but you have fallen from the sky. In the past, all the nations on earth bowed down before you, but now you have been cut down.

dag: So ku tooi kpe kpiɔŋlan yiŋa nti fa o nɛma ka pa ni o daŋ o la mii lɔbu pɔi. Di nyaaŋa ka o ni tooi fa o nɛma maa.
en: Whoever wants to enter a strong mans house and steal his things must first tie him up. Then they can steal the things from his house.

dag: Ka lan yɛli bɛ zaa, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi ni ti nya ka alizanda dunoli yooi, ka Naawuni malaikanim siɣiri Daadam Bia sanna ka labiri dura.
en: Then he said, Believe me when I say that you will all see heaven open. You will see angels of God going up and coming down on the Son of Man.

dag: N ni teegi n nuu n-tum alahiziba tuma n-darigi Ijiptinim maa tibili, di nyaaŋa ka o ni chɛ ka yi chaŋ.
en: So I will use my mighty power to perform all kinds of miracles and strike down the Egyptians. Then the king will send you away.

dag: O daa bi gbaag omaŋa o sujee ni, o mi daa bi tiligi bɛ nyɛviya, amaa ka daa chɛ ka alɔbo di ba.
en: He did not restrain his anger or spare their lives, but killed them with a plague.

dag: Di ni ti niŋ kpaluhi alahiziba, ka bɛnkam zaa tumdi tuma deeri yɔri ni ti mali suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: Makers of cloth will be crushed; all who earn money will become distressed.

dag: Ka o ya kpamba maa mini ninvuɣ zuɣuri bɛn min o daa laɣim be tin yini maa ni daa niŋ kaman Jɛzibɛl ni daa sab gbana wuhi ba shɛm maa.
en: After receiving her letters, they did exactly what she had asked.

dag: O daa chɛ ka sanʒiɛɣu maa chɛ ʒiɛbu, ka teeku kɔgbana daa fo n-dɔni baalim.
en: He stopped the storm and calmed the waves.

dag: Yi ta ma daɣiri n niriba sani, chi nukurigu pali mini bɔrɔbɔro chɛhi zuɣu. Yi kuri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi simdi kubu, ka chɛri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi simdi ni bɛ be, yi ni ŋmari ʒiri n niriba bɛn wumdi ʒiri yɛtɔɣa sani la zuɣu.
en: You make them think I am not important. You turn them against me for a few handfuls of barley and a few scraps of bread. You tell lies to my people. They love to listen to lies. You kill those who should live, and you let people live who should die.

dag: Amaa mɔɣu ni buŋ yi ni dɔɣi ninsala, jɛrigu ni niŋ yɛm.
en: A stupid person becomes intelligent when a wild ass of a person is born tame.

dag: A daa bi kpaai ma mi bahi kaman bihim la, ka kahim ma kaman waagasi la?.
en: As cheese is made from milk, you created my body from a tiny drop.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yisa tahi maligumaaniba zuɣulan yiŋa. Ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba ni Naawuni zaligubaŋdib zaa daa laɣimna.
en: They led Jesus away to the high priest, and all the chief priests, elders, and legal experts gathered.

dag: Bɛn guuri pam ku tooi zo n-tiligi, ka tɔbbihi ku tooi zo n-tiligi, Bɛ tuuya lu Yufretiiz Mɔɣili nuzaa polo.
en: You are strong and run fast, but you can't escape. You fall in battle near the Euphrates River.

dag: Bɛnjamin zuliya ni do so daa beni ka o yuli booni Kish, o daa nyɛla Abiɛl bia, ka Abiɛl mi nyɛ Zɛro bia, ka Zɛro nyɛ Bɛkɔrat bia, ka Bɛkɔrat mi daa nyɛ Afia ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛnjamin zuliya ni nir la bia, o daa mali buni pam.
en: Kish was a wealthy man who belonged to the tribe of Benjamin. His father was Abiel, his grandfather was Zeror, his great-grandfather was Becorath, and his great-great-grandfather was Aphiah.

dag: Tii maa vari daa viɛli pam ka kul wali gbilim; ka dunia ŋɔ ni daadam kam ni tooi paai li di n-tiɣi. Ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri kanna nti dooni di mahim vuhira, ka noonsi tɛri bɛ tɛri di wula zuɣu.
en: Its leaves were beautiful, and it had enough fruit on it to feed the whole world. Wild animals rested under it, and birds made their nests in its branches.

dag: Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa yoobu maa ni, bɛ daa zaŋla naɣilahi kɔbiga mini piɛlahi kɔbisiyi ni piɛbihi kɔbisinahi mali sara, ka lan zaŋ bulahi pinaayi mali sara Izraɛlnim zaa daalahichi zuɣu; kaman bɛ zuliya maa kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: This is the way they dedicated Gods Temple: They offered bulls, rams, and male lambs. And they offered twelve male goats for all Israel for a sin offering. That is one goat for each of the twelve tribes of Israel.

dag: Paɣ so daa beni n-nyɛ anabi, ka o yuli booni Anna. O daa nyɛla Fanuɛl bia, ka nyɛ Asha zuliya ni nira. O daa kurigiya pam; o daa ʒini doo yil la yuma ayopɔin.
en: The prophet Anna was also there in the temple. She was the daughter of Phanuel from the tribe of Asher, and she was very old. In her youth she had been married for seven years, but her husband died.

dag: M mali tahima ni di ku yuui ka n kana ti kaag a, amaa n sabiri yɛl shɛŋa din be gbaŋ ŋɔ ni n-tir a mi.
en: I hope I can come to you soon. But I am writing this to you now.

dag: Bɛn nyɛ dunia ŋɔ nima bemi kaman Naawuni ni daa zaŋ taŋkpaɣu nam so la, ka bɛn nyɛ alizanda ni nim mi be kaman ŋun yi alizanda ni na la.
en: All people belong to the earth. They are like that first man of earth. But those who belong to heaven are like that man of heaven.

dag: Amaa o daa bi wurim buɣa la; ka niriba daa na kul maani maligu nimaani, ka tuɣindi tulaale zim.
en: He did not tear down the pagan places of worship, and the people continued to offer sacrifices and burn incense there.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord gave this command to Moses for the people:.

dag: Amaa niɣi mini piɛri ni buhi bɛna, di deeya binshɛli zali bɛ ni tuui dɔɣi bi shɛb zaashee n-tiligi ba, bɛ nyɛla bɛn be kasi. Niŋmiya bɛ ʒim mihi sara maligu bimbini, ka zaŋ bɛ kpam nyo buɣim mali sara; di ʒiɛɣu niŋdi Yawɛ nyaɣisim.
en: But the oldest offspring of a cow, sheep, or goat you may not redeem. They are holy. You must dash their blood on the altar and turn their fat into smoke for a soothing smell to the LORD.

dag: Maligumaaniba: Jɛdaya daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiwɛi ni pisopɔinnaata.
en: These are the priests: the descendants of Jedaiah through the family of Jeshua:.

dag: Ka Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa damdi tiŋa n-jɛm Daniɛl, ka yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm pina mini tulaale viɛlli na ti mal o maligu.
en: Then King Nebuchadnezzar bowed low and honored Daniel. The king ordered that grain and incense offerings be made to Daniel.

dag: O ni ti zaŋ bɛ nanim niŋ yi nuu ni, ka yi ti kpihim bɛ yuya dunia ŋɔ ni. So ti ku tooi zaŋ o nyɔɣu yɔn ya hal ka yi ti ku bɛ zaa.
en: He will put their kings in your power. You will kill them, and they will be forgotten. No one will be able to stop you; you will destroy everyone.

dag: O kpee ka dunia ni, o nyɛla binnɛɔŋ ŋun bi zɔri dabiɛm.
en: None on earth can compare to him; he is made to be without fear.

dag: Bɛ ni daa diri maa ka o yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi ni yino ni yi n nyaaŋa.
en: They were all eating. Then Jesus said, Believe me when I say that one of you twelve here will hand me over to my enemies.

dag: ni Danna ni Kiriatisɛfa.
en: Dannah, Kiriath Sepher .

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni chɛ ka bɛ duɣi chuɣu bindir suma, ka bo wain kura mini bindir suma din mali kpam ni wain shɛli bɛ ni te viɛnyɛliŋga n-ti zuliya kam zaa zoli ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: The Lord All-Powerful will give a feast for all the people on this mountain. At the feast, there will be the best foods and wines. The meat will be good and tender, the wine pure and clear.

dag: O daa zaŋla niriba niŋ sapashin kpamba nuu ni, ka daa chɛ ka bɛ zaa laɣim fɔŋ maa dunɔdali palo ni, ka o daa tɔɣisi ba suhukpaŋsibo yɛtɔɣa yɛli.
en: He placed all the men in the city under the command of army officers and had them assemble in the open square at the city gate. He said to them.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee yɛn zaŋ ma ti kpɛhi bɛ ni me gooni gili tin shɛli ŋɔ ni? Ka ŋun n-lee yɛn zaŋ ma tahi Ɛdom?.
en: But, God, it seems that you have left us! You do not go out with our army. So who will lead me into the strong, protected city? Who will lead me into battle against Edom?.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ Urim mini Tumim niŋ sariakaribo nyolɔrigu maa ni, ka di ti pa Aduna nyɔɣu zuɣu saha shɛl o yi ti ka Yawɛ tooni na. Dina n-ni chɛ ka lzraɛlnim saria karibu yɛla kul be Aduna suhu ni Yawɛ tooni.
en: Put the Urim and Thummim in the breastpiece, so that Aaron will carry them when he comes into my holy presence. At such times he must always wear this breastpiece, so that he can determine my will for the people of Israel.

dag: O ni kana nti ku padiriba maa, ka zaŋ o tihi puu maa niŋ padir shɛb nuu ni. Niriba maa ni daa wum lala maa ka bɛ yɛli, Naawuni tiligim ti ni ŋ-ŋɔ.
en: He will come and kill those farmers. Then he will lease the land to some other farmers. When the people heard this story, they said, This should never happen.

dag: Kɔhat daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ bɛ ni daŋ shɛb tinsi tibu. Bɛ daa piila fɔntinsi pinaata Juda mini Simiɔn ni Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba tiŋgbana ni ti Aduna ŋun daa nyɛ Maligumaana la daŋ niriba.
en: The Kohath family groups were descendants of Aaron the priest from the tribe of Levi. Part of the Kohath family was given towns in the areas that belonged to Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ba, Tamiya duu maa daɣiri, ka ku niriba sɔŋ dundɔna ni, chamiya! Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa chaŋ tiŋ puuni ti ku niriba.
en: He said to them, Make this Temple unclean—fill this courtyard with dead bodies! Now go! So they went and killed the people in the city.

dag: M mabihi, di maliya yɛtɔɣ bihibihi ni yi taba, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka Naawuni ti kari ya saria. Nyamiya, sariakarita maa ʒiɛla dunoli ni.
en: Don't grumble about each other or you will be judged, and the judge is right outside the door.

dag: Ka o daa ka kɔbo din ni yo, ka naa maa yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm sandira maa min o paɣa ni o bihi n-tabil o ni mali shɛlikam zaa ti kɔhi na nti yo o samli maa.
en: He was not able to pay the money to his master, the king. So the master ordered that he and everything he owned be sold, even his wife and children. The money would be used to pay the king what the servant owed.

dag: Ka Jɛtro ŋun daa nyɛ Midian maligumaana ka lan nyɛ Musa deemba la daa wum Naawuni ni daa tum tuun shɛlikam zaa ti Musa mini Izraɛlnima ni Yawɛ ni daa yihi Izraɛlnim Ijipti shɛm la yɛla.
en: Jethro, Midians priest and Moses father-in-law, heard about everything that God had done for Moses and for Gods people Israel, how the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt.

dag: di ŋmalig a nini bahi kpaŋa ka chɛ ma. Di je suli n-kari man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ bahi. Nyini m-pun nyɛ n sɔŋda. Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n tiliginsim ŋɔ, di chɛ ma bee n-zaŋ ma bahi.
en: so don't hide from me. I am your servant, Lord , and you have helped me. Don't turn from me in anger. You alone keep me safe. Don't reject or desert me.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa pii zuɣulaannim ti ba; ka zuɣulaannim maa daa tiligi ba ŋmɛnditoya maa nuu ni.
en: Then the LORD raised up leaders to rescue them from the power of these raiders.

dag: Yi yi ti teei gili tin shɛli ni yi tuhi deei li ka di ti yuui, yin di ŋmahi di tiwala tihi bahi. Yi ni tooi di di wala, amaa miriya ka yi ti ŋmahi li luhi. Tihi din be puri ni maa nyɛla ninsalinima ka yi kana ti teei gil li?.
en: When you are trying to capture a city, do not cut down its fruit trees, even though the siege lasts a long time. Eat the fruit, but do not destroy the trees; the trees are not your enemies.

dag: Dabiɛm ni ti gbaai bɛ naa ka o guui, ka o kpamba gba ti zaŋ bɛ tuutanim bahi ka guui dabiɛm zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun buɣim diri Ziɔn, ka o sara maligu buɣim shee be Jɛrusalɛm la n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Their fortress will fall when terror strikes; their army officers will be frightened and run from the battle. This is what the Lord has said, the Lord whose fiery furnace is built on Mount Zion.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Yaakubu, A bia Yisifu kana; ka o daa kpaŋ omaŋ yiɣisi ʒin o bindoo zuɣu.
en: When Jacob was told that his son Joseph had come to see him, he gathered his strength and sat up in bed.

dag: Dama zuliya kam ni ti tuhiri taba, ka tiŋgbana zuɣulaannim ti yiɣisi tuhiri taba, ka kum mini tiŋgbani dambu ti be bɔb shɛŋa polo.
en: Nations and kingdoms will fight against each other, and there will be famines and earthquakes in all sorts of places.

dag: Naawuni, darigim bɛ tibili bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu; nyaŋmi lala zuliyanim maa a suhuyiɣisili puuni!.
en: They won't get away with these crimes, God, because when you get angry, you destroy people.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa teei Yawɛ dabili Musa ʒiɛman la yɛla ka bɔhira, Yawɛ ŋun daa tilig o niriba toondaannim teeku ni la lee be ya pumpɔŋɔ? Yawɛ ŋun daa zaŋ o shia kasi ti Musa la lee be ya?.
en: But his people remembered what had happened during the time of Moses. Didn't the Lord bring them and their leaders safely through the sea? Didn't he give them his Holy Spirit?.

dag: Ka Yisa daa chaŋ ti shihi ba ka yɛli ba, Yiɣisimiya! Di zɔriya dabiɛm.
en: Jesus came to them and touched them. Get up, he said. Don't be afraid.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri kul ye ni bɛ niŋ bundaannim zaŋ bɛmaŋ kpɛhi zahimbu ni ka jɛritali mini barina kɔre zana din saɣindi daadamnim ka bahiri ba yoli zaa kahikahi la gbahi ba.
en: People who want to be rich fall into all sorts of temptations and traps. They are caught by foolish and harmful desires that drag them down and destroy them.

dag: Kamiyana nti sɔŋ ma ka ti chaŋ ti liri Gibiɔnnima n-ku ba, bɛ ni chaŋ ti niŋ sandaani niŋ Jɔshua mini Izraɛlnim la zuɣu.
en: Come and help me attack Gibeon, because its people have made peace with Joshua and the Israelites.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Zuliya ayi m-be a pul maa ni. Niriba ayi ka a ti yɛn dɔɣi, ka bɛ ni ti woligi. Yino ni ti mali kpiɔŋ gari yino; ka kpɛm ni ti ŋmaligi jɛm biasani.
en: and he told her: Your two sons will become two separate nations. The younger of the two will be stronger, and the older son will be his servant.

dag: Ka o daa ti lan labina nya ka o nyaandoliba maa lan gbihirimi, dama gom n-daa wum ba pam, ka bɛ daa bi mi bɛ ni yɛn yɛl o shɛm.
en: Then he went back to the followers and again found them sleeping. They could not stay awake. They did not know what they should say to him.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa yɛli; Mbaye! Yaa n Duuma NAAWUNI, bɔzuɣu ka a daa zaŋ ti du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ na? A zaŋ ti mi na ni a ti ti Amɔrinim ka bɛ ku ti? Ti yi di daa chɛ ka ti nini tiɣi Jɔɔdɛn yaɣili wulimpuhili polo la ka kpalim nimaani di di so.
en: Then Joshua said, Oh no, LORD God! Why did you ever bring this people across the Jordan? Was it to hand us over to the power of the Amorites, to destroy us? If only we had been prepared to live on the other side of the Jordan!.

dag: Nimaani ka o daa me sara maligu bimbini zali, ka boli di yuli Ɛl Ɛlɔhi Izraɛl .
en: then he set up his tents and built an altar there to honor the God of Israel.

dag: Amaa ka Jɛhu daa lee bi chɛ Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam daalahichi tumbu so shɛli o ni daa doli n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la dolibu. Dina n-nyɛ salima naɣibihi shɛb bɛn daa be Bɛtɛl mini Dan la jɛmbu.
en: but he did not completely turn away from the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat that caused Israel to sin. Jehu did not destroy the golden calves in Bethel and in Dan.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ daa yɛli ma, Cham Shɛbina ŋun nyɛ nayili tumtumdiba zuɣulan la sani nti bɔh o.
en: The Lord GOD All-Powerful told me to go to Shebna, the palace manager.

dag: N nintam kul zɔrimi, niriba ni bi dol a zaligunim maa zuɣu.
en: I have cried a river of tears because people dont obey your teachings.

dag: Ka bɛ yi wuh o la samli, di simdi ka o yo bɛ ni wuh o sam shɛli maa zaa o nyɛvili tiligibu zuɣu.
en: If the owner has to pay compensation instead, he must pay the agreed amount to save his life.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa kahigi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa wuhi anabi Habakuk m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is the message that was given to Habakkuk the prophet.

dag: Nuhu daa malila bidibis ata, bɛ yuya n-daa booni Shɛm mini Ham ni Jafɛt.
en: He had three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

dag: N ni saɣim Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga ŋun viɛlim ŋmani momaha la.
en: Jerusalem is a lovely pasture.

dag: Ka yi yi saɣi, ŋuna n-nyɛ Anabi Ilaija so ŋun yɛn kana la.
en: and if you are willing to believe their message, John is Elijah, whose coming was predicted.

dag: So yi chɛ bɔɣili yali bee so yi gbi bɔɣili ka bi ŋari li, ka nahu bee buŋ lu di puuni kpi.
en: Suppose someone's ox or donkey is killed by falling into an open pit that you dug or left uncovered on your property.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa ti yi nimaani n-chani Bɛtɛl. O ni daa yi soli n-chani ha, ka bidibbihi nya o m-maani o ansarisi yɛra, Zuɣupalo ŋɔ lana, chama! Zuɣupalo ŋɔ lana, chama.
en: Elisha went from that city to Bethel. He was walking up the hill to the city, and some boys were coming down out of the city. They began making fun of him. They said, Go away, you bald-headed man! Go away, you bald-headed man.

dag: Ŋuna n-lan su saha mini saha taɣibu; o vuuri nanima ka zaani nanima; ŋuna n-tiri yɛnnim yɛm, ka tiri baŋdiba baŋsim.
en: God is the one who changes times and eras, who dethrones one king, only to establish another, who grants wisdom to the wise and knowledge to those with insight.

dag: Amaa dindali maa yuŋ ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Neetan.
en: But that night, the Lord s word came to Nathan:.

dag: Naawuni ŋun ni tooi gbibi ya ka yi ku lu, ka ni zaŋ ya tah omaŋmaŋ tooni din mali jilima shee ni suhupiɛlli, ka yi ku mali taali la.
en: To him who is able to keep you from falling and to bring you faultless and joyful before his glorious presence—.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli bɛ ni daa gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb chaŋ maa Yawɛ ni daa wuhi ma binshɛŋa zaa.
en: Then I spoke to the people in exile. I told them about everything the Lord showed me.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim daa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka Naawuni Kundi yɛligu niŋ pali. Di ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Hal o kɔb yini gba ti ku kabi.
en: All this happened so that the Scriptures would come true, which say, No bone of his body will be broken.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ tin shɛli yi ni yɛra, Tɔbu mini kum ni alɔbo ŋɔ zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ li niŋ Babilɔn naa nuu ni la polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: You have been saying, This city will be handed over to the king of Babylon through sword, famine, and disease. But this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says.

dag: Ka di daa tooi biɛla ha, ka Bɔaz maŋmaŋ gba yi Bɛtilihɛm paana nti puhi kachɛriba maa n-yɛli, Yawɛ kul kpalimmi be yi sani! Ka bɛ garigi yɛli, Yawɛ niŋm alibarika niŋ a ni.
en: Just then Boaz arrived from Bethlehem. He said to the harvesters, May the LORD be with you. And they said to him, May the LORD bless you.

dag: Ka n yi ti na be n nyɛvili ni, nyin kul gbibi Yawɛ yurilim ŋɔ ni mani, ka ʒe ma yim din ni chɛ ka n ku kpi.
en: As long as I live, show me the same kindness the Lord does. And if I die, never stop showing this kindness to my family. Be faithful to us, even when the Lord destroys all your enemies from the earth.

dag: Di saha ka dabipaɣiba maa mini bɛ bihi daa kana ti gban o tiŋa.
en: The women servants and their children came forward and bowed down.

dag: Ŋunkam wuhi zom soli kpɛhi yɔɣu, noli din dim o. Ka sokam yɛli, Ami.
en: Cursed is anyone who misleads a blind person on a road. All the people will reply: We agree.

dag: O ni balim a pam? O ni tɔɣis a suhumahili yɛtɔɣa?.
en: Will he beg you at length or speak gentle words to you?.

dag: ka pɔhim yi ti ʒe li, di kpahirimi lu, ka so ku lan tooi baŋ di ni di be shɛli.
en: but when the wind blows through it, its gone; even the ground where it stood doesnt remember it.

dag: Ka o daa kpe ŋariŋ maa ni pahi bɛ zuɣu; ka pɔhim maa dii chɛ ʒiɛbu, ka di daa niŋ ba alahiziba pam ti yaɣi.
en: He then got into the boat with them, and the wind died down. The disciples were completely confused.

dag: Dinzuɣu yihimiya dinkam nyɛ daɣiri mini biɛribiɛtali zaa yi bebu ni, ka doliya tarimtali soli n-deei Naawuni ni zaŋ yɛligu shɛli biri yi suhuri ni, ka di nyɛ din ni tooi tiligi ya la.
en: Therefore, with humility, set aside all moral filth and the growth of wickedness, and welcome the word planted deep inside you—the very word that is able to save you.

dag: Di pala zuliya shɛb bɛn galisi, ka bɛ yɛtɔɣa bi ne, ka di wumbu to ka a ku tooi wum li. Biɛhiŋ kani n yi tim a bɛ sani, bɛ ni wum a yɛligu.
en: No, not to many peoples who speak difficult and obscure languages, whose words you wouldnt understand. If I did send you to them, they would listen to you.

dag: Maligumaana maa ni zaŋ ʒim maa shɛli n-ʒe ninvuɣ so ŋun yɛn yi daɣiri ni maa nudirigu tibinyaɣili min o nudirigu nubililɔɣu zuɣu ni o nudirigu napombililɔɣu zuɣu.
en: The priest will smear some of the blood from this sacrifice on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot.

dag: Ka yi bihi yi ti bɔhi ya, Yi ni niŋdi shɛli ŋɔ gbinni lee nyɛla dini.
en: And when your children ask you, What does this ritual mean to you.

dag: Amaa niriba kul ni be Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni sahakam, ka niriba kul ni be Jɛrusalɛm ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: but Judah and Jerusalem will always have people.

dag: Ka yi ti ŋmahiŋmahi li ka booi kpam niŋ di ni, dama di nyɛla biŋkuma sara maligu.
en: Crumble it up and pour the oil on it when you present it as an offering.

dag: ka bɔhi ba, Ya polo ka yi lee sɔɣ o? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti Duuma, kamina ti nya ti ni sɔɣ o luɣ shɛli.
en: and asked, Where have you put his body? They replied, Lord, come and you will see.

dag: Yisa daa ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ wuhi ni di simdi ni niriba suhiri Naawuni sahakam ka di niŋdi anyinsi.
en: Then Jesus told his disciples a parable to teach them that they should always pray and never become discouraged.

dag: Ka shɛb mi daa bɔri ni bɛ zahim o, ka yɛl o ni o wuhim ba alizanda ni shihirili.
en: Others were testing him, seeking a sign from heaven.

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa ti lan yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu, ka o piɛli Dauda bahi bɛ zuɣu ka yɛl o, Cham ti kali Izraɛlnim mini Judanima.
en: On another occasion the Lord was angry with Israel, and he made David bring trouble on them. The Lord said to him, Go and count the people of Israel and Judah.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa lan tim tuumba Sool bia Ishibɔshɛt sani ti yɛl o, Zaŋmi m paɣ Mikal ŋun nyɛ n ni daa zaŋ Filistianim yokol gbana kɔbiga yo so zuɣu la ti ma na.
en: Then David sent messengers to Sauls son Ishbosheth. Give me my wife Michal, he demanded. I became engaged to her at the cost of one hundred Philistine foreskins.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum lala maa ka bɛ zaa laɣim duhi bɛ yɛhi n-suhiri Naawuni yɛra, Zallakudura Naa ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani ni teeku ni binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni ŋɔ.
en: They listened, then lifted their voices in unison to God, Master, you are the one who created the heaven, the earth, the sea, and everything in them.

dag: Dama n yɛn chɛmi ka zuliya shɛb bɛn mali kpiɔŋ yi nuzaa polo tiŋgbɔŋ ni kana ti liri Babilɔn. Bɛ ni ti pie tab zani liri li n-ŋme n-deei li. Bɛ piɛma tɔbu ŋmanila tɔbbi yɛndaan so ŋun na ʒi n-to n-ziŋ.
en: I am going to stir up a group of strong nations in the north and make them attack Babylonia. They will line up in battle against the country and conquer it. They are skillful hunters, shooting arrows that never miss the mark.

dag: Hal muɣisigu yi gili ma niŋ sunsuuni gba, a yihiri ma di puuni ni alaafee. A kul yihiri ma n dimnim bɛn suhu yiɣisi bahi n zuɣu nuu ni. A teer a nudirigu n-fari ma bahira.
en: If I am in trouble, you keep me alive. If my enemies are angry, you save me from them.

dag: O daa lan yɛli yaha: N ti ku lan teei bɛ daalahichi mini bɛ biriginsim tuma yɛla hal abada.
en: Then I will forget about their sins and no longer remember their evil deeds.

dag: N ni saɣim kikaa saha yiya, ka saɣim woligu saha yiya, ka chɛ ka bɛ ni zaŋ wɔbinyina mali yiya shɛŋa lu n-dahim, ka chɛ ka yiya din nyɛ zaɣ kara wum. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will tear down winter homes and summer homes. Houses decorated with ivory and all other mansions will be gone forever. I, the Lord , have spoken!.

dag: A biha ayi ŋmanila muli zaɣ pola ayi, ka ŋmani saŋkpalima ayi.
en: Your breasts are like twin deer, like two gazelles.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lan zaŋ ma chaŋ nuzaa polo dunɔdali ni nti buɣisi li. Ka di mini dina la zaa nyɛ yim.
en: Then he brought me to the north gate and took the same measurements of the.

dag: bɛn Izraɛlnim maa bɛn ŋmaligim zani ka bɛ mini ba tuhi. Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa pun daŋ kula Izraɛlnim ninvuɣ pihita ka yɛra, Ti yaa nyaŋ ba kaman ti ni daa pun nyaŋ ba shɛm piligu ni la.
en: the Israelites would turn around in battle. The Benjaminites had begun to defeat some of the Israelites and had killed about thirty men, thinking, They are definitely going to be wiped out before us, as in the first battle!.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛl o suhu ni, Pumpɔŋɔ Sool ni ti bahi ku ma dahin shɛli. N lan ka n ni yɛn niŋ shɛm pahila n zo n-kuli Filistianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni din ni chɛ ka Sool yihi n shee bɔbu tahima Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka n yi o nuu ni.
en: But David thought to himself, Saul will catch me some day. The best thing I can do is to escape to the land of the Philistines. Then Saul will give up looking for me in Israel. That way I will escape from Saul.

dag: Yawɛ chɛ ka bɛ baŋ o nasara dibu yɛla. O kahig o tiliginsim yiko wuhi zuliya kam.
en: The Lord has shown the nations that he has the power to save and to bring justice.

dag: Di ku yuui ka nyɔŋ puuni leei kɔbu shee kɔbu shee mi leei nyɔŋ.
en: As the saying goes, before long the dense forest will become farmland, and the farmland will go back to forest.

dag: Naa Hɛzɛkia tuumba maa ni daa paai Aizaia sani.
en: When Isaiah received King Hezekiah's message.

dag: Ka o daa lan buɣisi mita kɔbisinu, ka zaŋ ma siɣi kom maa ni, ka di ziliŋ nyɛ duna tariga. Ka o lan buɣisi mita kɔbisinu, ka zaŋ ma siɣi kom maa ni, ka di ziliŋ nyɛ shee tariga.
en: Then he measured another meters downstream, and told me to wade through it there. The water came up to my knees. Another meters downstream the water came up to my waist.

dag: N ni chɛ ka kum mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri lu a zuɣu n-ku a bihi. Alɔbo mini ninvuɣ kubo ni lu a zuɣu, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi lu a zuɣu. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will send hunger and wild animals to kill your children, and will send sickness, violence, and war to kill you. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka mɔɣu ni tihi zaa ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. Mani n-zaŋdi ti wɔɣinli leeri ti jia. Mani zaŋdi ti jia leeri ti wɔɣinli. Mani n-chɛ ka ti mahili leeri ti kuŋ, ka chɛ ka ti kuŋ leeri ti mahili. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa, ka shiri ni niŋ li.
en: Every tree in the forest will know that I, the Lord , can bring down tall trees and help short ones grow. I dry up green trees and make dry ones green. I, the Lord , have spoken, and I will keep my word.

dag: Saŋmariga maa yuli daa boonila Yabiga. Ka kom pirigibu ʒii buta puuni yim leei kɔtɔɣu yabiga maa zuɣu, ka niriba pam daa nyu li ka kpi, kom maa ni daa to maa zuɣu.
en: The name of the star was Bitter, and a third of the water turned bitter. Many people died because the water was so bitter.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari nahiŋgu nya li ka bɛ suhuri paligi; ka yi bɛn jɛmdi Naawuni ŋɔ mi chɛliya ka yi suhuri paligi.
en: When the oppressed see this, they will be glad; those who worship God will be encouraged.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun tuhiri tɔbu. O yuli n-shiri nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: The Lord is his name, and he is a warrior!.

dag: Yawɛ, bɛ ni yili yila yɛl a tuma yɛla, dama nyin Yawɛ jilima galisiya pam.
en: Let them sing about the LORDs ways because the LORDs glory is so great!.

dag: Pa yi zaa yɛla ka n yɛri maa, dama m mi n ni pun pii shɛba; amaa di kpala talahi ni Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. Dina n-nyɛ: N ni dihiri so gbi ma zamba bɔɣili.
en: I am not talking about all of you. I know the people I have chosen. But what the Scriptures say must happen: The man who shared my food has turned against me.

dag: Teemiy o daalikauli yɛla sahakam. O ni daa zaŋ yɛligu shɛli zali ʒiɛmana tuhili nim la;.
en: God remembers his covenant forever, the word he commanded to a thousand generations.

dag: ka bindana maa yi beni, dindina samli yɔbu kani; ka di yi nyɛla o haayila biŋkɔbigu maa, dindina haayibu liɣiri maa ni zani biŋkɔbigu maa zaani.
en: If the owner was present, no payment needs to be made. If the animal was hired, only the fee for hiring the animal is due.

dag: Biɛɣuni sa siɣimiya ti tuhi ba. Bɛ sa yɛn dolila Ziz polo duna. Yi sa ni tuhi ba soli vinvamli maa tariga Jɛruɛl tiŋgban nɛl la ni.
en: Tomorrow, they will come up through the Ziz Pass. You must go down to them. You will find them at the end of the valley on the other side of the desert of Jeruel.

dag: Filistianim ni daa wum ni Izraɛlnim laɣimla Mizipa, ka bɛ nanim daa lo tɔbu n-chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi ba. Ka Izraɛlnim daa wum li ka dabiɛm gbahi ba.
en: When the Philistine rulers found out about the meeting at Mizpah, they sent an army there to attack the people of Israel. The Israelites were afraid when they heard that the Philistines were coming.

dag: Ka chinchin shɛli din daa yili Naawuni jɛmbu duu sunsuuni la daa cheei di zuɣusaa hal ti siɣi di tiŋli.
en: The curtain hanging in the Temple was torn in two, from top to bottom.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani kaman o yaannim ni daa niŋ shɛm la. O daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ alahichi shɛŋa Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la.
en: Zechariah did what the Lord said was wrong. He did the same things his ancestors did. He did not stop committing the sins of Jeroboam son of Nebat who caused Israel to sin.

dag: Yuma ata kam puuni, zaŋmiya yi puri atam pirigibu bupia zuɣu yim sɔŋ yi tinsi ni.
en: At the end of every three years, you must gather one-tenth of your harvest for that year. Store this food in your towns.

dag: Ka naa daa lan yɛl o, A mi amaŋmaŋ suhu ni a ni daa tum m ba Dauda tuumbiɛ shɛŋa la zaa, dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni labis a tuumbiɛri maa zaa ʒil a.
en: You know very well all the wrong that you did to my father David. The Lord will punish you for it.

dag: Sɛt ni daa ti paai yuun kɔbiga ni anu saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Ɛnɔsh.
en: When Seth was years old, he became the father of Enosh.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim puuni Naawuni Shia Kasi kahigi wuhi ni tuuli tanti duu la ni daa na kul ʒiɛya la zuɣu, di wuhiya ni Luɣ Kasi Zaa Kasi Shee la soli na bi yooi.
en: The Holy Spirit uses those two separate rooms to teach us that the way into the Most Holy Place was not open while the first room was still there.

dag: Daadam, n zaŋ a leela Izraɛlnim gula. A yi ti wum ka n yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛli, nyin zaŋmi saɣisigu din yi n sanna saɣisi ba.
en: Human one, Ive made you a lookout for the house of Israel. When you hear a word from me, deliver my warning.

dag: Bɛ ni ti me bɛ yinsi n-kpe m-be di ni, ka sa tihi ka di wali ka bɛ di di wala maa.
en: In that city whoever builds a house will live there; whoever plants a vineyard will eat the grapes from that garden.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl naa daa laɣim anabinim kaman kɔbisinahi na nti bɔhi ba, N cham ti tuhi Ramɔtigiliadnim bee n di chaŋ? Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Cham ti tuhi ba, Yawɛ ni zaŋ ba niŋ nyin naa nuu ni.
en: So Israels king gathered about four hundred prophets, and he asked them, Should I go to war with Ramoth-gilead or not? Attack! the prophets answered. The LORD will hand it over to the king.

dag: Biɛɣuni ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha n sa ni chɛ ka sakuɣ kara luna, ka sakuɣa lala na ʒi n-lu Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni di piligu ni hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: Tomorrow at this time Ill cause the heaviest hail to fall on Egypt that has ever fallen from the day Egypt was founded until now.

dag: Yi bi ka la din nyɛ Izraɛlnim ni daa naan ku tooi shihi shɛl la gbin na, dina n-nyɛ: Zo shɛli buɣim ni diri mini zibisim ni sagbana zibigibu ni sanʒiɛɣu ʒiɛbu.
en: You have not come, as the people of Israel came, to what you can feel, to Mount Sinai with its blazing fire, the darkness and the gloom, the storm.

dag: Di saha ka ti Duuma daa vaai yiɣisi kaman o neela gom ni la bee m-be kaman tɔbutuhira ni yi nyu wain buɣi n-tahiri shɛm la.
en: At last the Lord woke up as though from sleep; he was like a strong man excited by wine.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zaŋ tampiɛlli din ŋmani mukuru la lo o shee ni n-wa waa ni o yaa zaa Yawɛ tooni.
en: David, dressed in a linen priestly vest, danced with all his strength before the LORD.

dag: Ti yaannim daa tum alahichi, bɛ lan kani, ka ti diri wahala bɛ daalahichi maa zuɣu.
en: Our ancestors sinned, but they are dead, and we are left to pay for their sins.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa yɛli ba, Ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nim kpuɣiri paɣiba ka zaŋdi bɛ bipuɣinsi tiri dɔbba.
en: Jesus answered them, The men and women of this age marry.

dag: Ka Pita daa kpalim Jɔpa, Saimɔn ŋun daa nyɛ gbanzab la yiŋa n-niŋ daba ayi nimaani.
en: Peter stayed on in Joppa for many days with a tanner of leather named Simon.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛl o, Aai, n nyɛla Yawɛ tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛma, dina n-chɛ ka n kana maa. Ka Jɔshua daa lu n-gbani zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋa n-lu o sizuura ka bɔh o, N dana, ka bɔ ka a lee bɔri ni man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ niŋ.
en: The man answered, I am not an enemy. I am the commander of the Lord s army. I have just now come to you. Then Joshua bowed his face to the ground to show respect and said, I am your servant. Does my master have a command for me.

dag: Amaa din yiri ninsal nol ni na yirila o suhu ni na; dina n-nyɛ din tar o daɣiri.
en: But the words that come out of your mouth come from your heart. And they are what make you unfit to worship God.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri pun birigi ka na bela bɛ manim puya ni. Bɛ dɔɣibu saha ka bɛ pun birigi; ka nyɛ ʒiŋmariba.
en: Evildoers go wrong all their lives; they tell lies from the day they are born.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia daa tɔɣisi Lɛvinim maa zaa suhukpaŋsibo yɛtɔɣa bɛ ni daa zaŋ yɛm shɛli tum Yawɛ tuma maa zuɣu. Ka niriba maa daa di chuɣu maa bindirigu daba ayopɔin, ka daa kɔri suhudoo sara maligu biŋkɔbiri, ka paɣiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Hezekiah congratulated all the Levites who had performed so skillfully for the LORD. They feasted throughout the seven days of the festival, sacrificing well-being offerings and praising the LORD, the God of their ancestors.

dag: Ka Pita yɛl o, Bɔzuɣu ka a min a yidan naai noli ni yi zahim ti Duuma Shia Kasi? Nyama, bɛn zaŋ a yidan yi nti sɔɣi n-na be soli kanna ŋɔ; bɛ ni zaŋ a gba yi.
en: Then Peter said, Why did the two of you agree to test the Lord's Spirit? The men who buried Ananias are by the door, and they will carry you out.

dag: Yawɛ niŋdi ninvuɣ suma nirilim, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali nia biɛri, o wuhiya ni bɛ mali taali.
en: It is good to learn what pleases the Lord , because he condemns those who plan to do wrong.

dag: Paɣ so daa be Jɔpa n-nyɛ Yisa nyaandola ka o yuli booni Tabita. O daa tumdi tuun suma pam, ka lan tumdi nambɔzɔbo tuma gba lala.
en: In Joppa there was a disciple named Tabitha . Her life overflowed with good works and compassionate acts on behalf of those in need.

dag: N ni saɣim o wain tihi min o fiig tihi pu shɛli o ni yɛra, M mamanim ni zaŋ shɛli yo ma samli m-bɔŋɔ la. N ni zaŋ li leei yɔɣuni, ka yɔɣuni biŋkɔbiri ŋubi di zaa.
en: She said, My lovers gave me vineyards and fig trees as payment for sex. Now I, the Lord , will ruin her vineyards and fig trees; they will become clumps of weeds eaten by wild animals.

dag: Di nyɛla ti ni pun wum binshɛŋa yɛla ka mi li. Di nyɛla ti yaannim ni daa pun yɛli ti shɛli yɛla.
en: We have heard the story, and we know it well. Our fathers told it to us.

dag: ka m mi ni a kul deeri n suhigu sahakam; amaa niriba bɛn ʒe kpe ŋɔ zuɣu ka n suhir a maa ni di chɛ ka bɛ niŋ yɛda ni nyini n-shiri tim ma na.
en: I know you always hear me. I say this for the benefit of the crowd standing here so that they will believe that you sent me.

dag: Ɛmim zuliya bɛn daa nyɛ wɔɣira ka wɔɣawɔɣa kaman Anaki zuliya, ka nyɛ bɛn galisi pam la n-daa pun be nimaani.
en: Before the Lord gave the Moabites their land, a large and powerful tribe lived there. They were the Emim, and they were as tall as the Anakim.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa: Yɛlim a mabia Aduna ni o di kanna luɣ kasi shee din be pateesa ŋɔ puuni ŋɔ waawaayili nti zaani Alikauli Adaka pindigu la gbini, di yi pa lala o ni kpi, dama n yirila zahira sagban ni di pindigu maa zuɣu.
en: He said, Tell your brother Aaron that only at the proper time is he to go behind the curtain into the Most Holy Place, because that is where I appear in a cloud above the lid on the Covenant Box. If he disobeys, he will be killed.

dag: Ka a baŋsim maa zuɣu ni chɛ ka Masia ni daa kpi a mabi so ŋun ka kpiɔŋ zuɣu bahi yoli.
en: Then what you know has destroyed someone Christ died for.

dag: nti pahi Ramɔt mini Anɛm ni di momaha tiŋgbana zaa din be Isaka tiŋgban ni la ti ba.
en: Ramoth, and Anem.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm Naa Dauda bia ŋun nyɛ karimba la yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ.
en: When the son of David was king in Jerusalem, he was known to be very wise, and he said:.

dag: Bɛ nolɔbo maa mini bɛ Naawuni suhibu nyaaŋa, ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa bɛ zuɣu n-suhi alibarika niŋ bɛ ni, ka chɛbisi ba ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: Everyone prayed and went without eating for a while longer. Next, they placed their hands on Barnabas and Saul to show that they had been appointed to do this work. Then everyone sent them on their way.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa paai yili maa ni nti nya ka bia maa kpi n-dola o garo zuɣu.
en: Elisha went into the house, and there was the child, lying dead on his bed.

dag: Nyamiya, n yɛn zaŋ ba la nuzaa polo tiŋgbɔŋ ni na, ka yihi ba dunia ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛlikam na. Zoomba mini gbariti ni paɣipuhinim ni paɣ shɛb bɛn wolisiri ni bɛ dɔɣi zaa ni ti be bɛ ni. Bɛ ni ti galisi pam labi kpe na.
en: I will bring them from the north and gather them from the ends of the earth. The blind and the lame will come with them, pregnant women and those about to give birth. They will come back a great nation.

dag: ni Abialibɔn ŋun daa nyɛ Araba nir la ni Azimavɛt ŋun daa nyɛ Bahurim nir la.
en: Abi Albon the Arbathite; Azmaveth the Barhumite;.

dag: Dabiɛm ni ti kpe ba pam nimaani, dama Naawuni be wuntizɔriba sani.
en: They will have plenty to fear, because God is with those who do what is right.

dag: Di pa shɛli ka bɛ ti nyɛla yɛnnim bee jɛra, so n-ku tooi baŋ. Amaa bɛna nti yɛn su n ni zaŋ n yɛm niŋ wahala nya shɛlikam dunia ŋɔ ni ŋɔ. Dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: Some other person will control everything I worked and studied for. And I dont know if that person will be wise or foolish. This is also senseless.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa bi zaŋ bɛ ni daa tahi laɣ shɛli Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa na m-mali anzinfa taha mini firilakpihindi bina ni lahi ni kikahi bee salima bee anzinfa lahi n-zali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni.
