en: While the repairs were being made, the money that was given to the temple was not used to make silver bowls, lamp snuffers, small sprinkling bowls, trumpets, or anything gold or silver for the temple.

dag: Di simdi ni bɛ niŋ daɣiri yihibu kom niŋ bɛmaŋa daba ata dali mini dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin dali, ka leei bɛn be nyam. Amaa bɛ yi bi niŋ lala daba ata mini dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin maa dali, bɛ ku leei bɛn be nyam.
en: They must wash themselves with the special water on the third day and again on the seventh day. If they dont do this, they will remain unclean.

dag: Dindali maa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni fɔntins anu nim ni ti tɔɣisi Keenannim yɛtɔɣa, ka po pɔri ni bɛ ni jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ. Ka tinsi maa ni zaɣ yini yuli ni ti boonila Wuntaŋ tiŋa.
en: When that time comes, the Hebrew language will be spoken in five Egyptian cities. The people there will take their oaths in the name of the Lord Almighty. One of the cities will be called, City of the Sun.

dag: Ka kom gili ma niŋ sunsuuni ka teeku maa kom kul lim ma zaa. Ka teeku kɔtiŋ mɔri vilivili n zuɣu.
en: The seawater closed over me. The water covered my mouth, and I could not breathe. I went down, down into the deep sea. Seaweed wrapped around my head.

dag: ka nyo bɛ buɣa buɣim; dama buɣa maa pala Naawuni; amaa di nyɛla ninsalinim ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali shɛli, ka di nyɛ dari mini kuɣa, dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa saɣim li maa.
en: They destroyed the idols of wood and stone that the people of those nations had made and worshiped.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa dol o naɣikɔra yi puuni kunna ti wum kuhigu maa ka bɔhi, Ka bɔ n-niŋ niriba maa ka bɛ zaa ti kuhiri lala? Ka bɛ daa yɛl o Jabɛshinim ni ʒi lahiba shɛli maa na.
en: Saul was just then coming in from the field with his oxen, and he asked, What's wrong? Why is everyone crying? They told him what the messengers from Jabesh had reported.

dag: Tinzunnim yi be zuliya shɛb sani, yin tim ba bɛ tarili nimaani. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The tribe where that resident lives must give him some land. This is what the Lord GOD said!.

dag: Pirigim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tari niriba maa kaman bɛ yuya kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The land will be apportioned to these as an inheritance according to the number of names.

dag: O ni daa di nam ka di ti paai yuma ata saha shɛli, ka o daa tim o kpambaliba, Bɛnheel mini Obadia ni Zakaria ni Nɛtanɛl ni Mikaya ni bɛ chaŋ Juda fɔntinsi ni ti wuhi niriba.
en: In the third year of his rule, Jehoshaphat sent his officials Ben-hail, Obadiah, Zechariah, Nethanel, and Micaiah to teach in the cities of Judah.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni mali binshɛŋa maani buɣa polo, ti mi ni di nyɛla kaman shɛb ni yɛli shɛm la: Ti zaa mali baŋsim. Amaa baŋsim ŋɔ tatabo tahirila maŋduhibu na; yurilim n-naɣ nyɛ din kpaŋsiri nir suhu.
en: Now, concerning what you wrote about food offered to idols. It is true, of course, that all of us have knowledge, as they say. Such knowledge, however, puffs a person up with pride; but love builds up.

dag: Ɛliasa daa nyɛla Sisimai ba, ka Sisimai nyɛ Shallum ba.
en: Eleasah was the father of Sismai, Sismai was the father of Shallum.

dag: Anabi Musa daa yɛliya, Ti Duuma Naawuni ni ti pii so yi mabihi ni n-chɛ ka o niŋ anabi kaman o ni daa pii ma shɛm la. O yi ti yɛli ya shɛlikam, yin doliya li.
en: Moses said, The Lord your God will raise up from your own people a prophet like me. Listen to whatever he tells you. .

dag: Yɛm chɛ ka nir nyari jilima, amaa bɛn ka li soli nyɛla din bahiri ba yoli.
en: Sound judgment is praised, but people without good sense are on the way to disaster.

dag: N ni yu shɛm mini n tahima nyɛla ni n di kɔŋ n tuma tumbu, amaa ka kul ni tumdi li mi sahakam, di bahi bamdi pumpɔŋɔ. N ni mali suhukpeeni ka di chɛ ka n ti Masia jilima n niŋgbuŋ zaa puuni, n yi be bee n yi kpimi.
en: It is my expectation and hope that I wont be put to shame in anything. Rather, I hope with daring courage that Christs greatness will be seen in my body, now as always, whether I live or die.

dag: Lala n-yɛn niŋ zuliya kam zaa bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni. Di ni ti ŋmanila bɛ ni yi wɔbi olivi tiwala din bahindi nyaaŋa ka yihiri wain tiwal yiha bɛ ni yi wɔbi li naai saha shɛli la.
en: Nations will be stripped bare, like olive trees or vineyards after the harvest season.

dag: A min a tɔbbihi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be a sani zaa ni ti lu Izraɛl zoya maa ni. Ka n ti zaŋ ya ti juri balibu kam mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ka bɛ di.
en: You will fall on Israels mountains, you, all your troops, and the peoples who are with you. I will give you to the birds of prey, to every kind of bird and wild animal as food.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ n suhir a mi, niŋmi alibarika niŋ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ zuliya ni, ka chɛ ka bɛ kul be a sani sahakam. Dama nyini Yawɛ yi niŋ alibarika niŋ binshɛli ni, alibarika maa kul ni kpalim be di ni sahakam.
en: So now willingly bless your servants dynasty so that it might continue forever before you, because you, LORD God, have promised. Let your servants dynasty be blessed forever by your blessing.

dag: N yuun kɔbiga ni pisi m-bɔŋɔ pumpɔŋɔ. N lan ka yaa din ni chaŋ shɛli. Ka Yawɛ pun yɛli ma, A ku du Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili ŋɔ.
en: Moses said to them, I am now years old. I cannot lead you anymore. The Lord said to me, You will not go across the Jordan River.

dag: Ti Duuma ni chɛ ninvuɣ so daalahichi taali paŋ o ka bi lan maani di laasabu mal alibarika.
en: Happy is the person whose sins the Lord will not keep account of.

dag: Ka zaŋ chaŋ Jɛzibɛl mi polo, Naawuni yɛliya, Bahi ni ŋub o Jɛziriil tiŋ puuni.
en: As for Jezebel, the LORD says this: Dogs will devour Jezebel in the area of Jezreel.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa ti daŋ yiɣisibu asibaasi m-pa o buŋ nyaampara, ka zaŋ o nachimba ayi min o bia Yisahaku pah omaŋ zuɣu, ka bo dari pahi ni o ti mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la n-daa yi n-chaŋ katiŋa Naawuni ni daa wuh o luɣ shɛli maa.
en: Abraham got up early in the morning, harnessed his donkey, and took two of his young men with him, together with his son Isaac. He split the wood for the entirely burned offering, set out, and went to the place God had described to him.

dag: Zahindi ni mini yuŋ ʒii puuni, saha shɛli gom yi ti gbaai niriba, ka bɛ do bɛ bindɔhi zuɣu gbihiri la.
en: Sometimes in the night, he uses terrifying dreams.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ni bah a yoli zaa; o ni to n-kpuɣ a a yiŋ puuni yi nti chɛris a; o ni yih a dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: So God will ruin you forever! He will grab you and pull you from your home, like someone pulling up a plant by the roots! Selah.

dag: Naawuni biɛhigu mali dabiɛm pam o jɛmbu duu puuni, ŋuna n-nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni! O tir o niriba yiko mini kpiɔŋ. Paɣimiya Naawuni!.
en: The God of Israel is fearsome in his temple, and he makes us strong. Let's praise our God!.

dag: Hiram ni daa wum Sulemaana ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka di niŋ o nyaɣisim pam, ka o yɛli, Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ m paɣiri Yawɛ ŋun ti Dauda bi yɛndana ni o su ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn galisi pam ŋɔ.
en: Hiram was so happy when he heard Solomon's request that he said, I am grateful that the Lord gave David such a wise son to be king of that great nation.

dag: Ka Nuhu daa guhi daba ayopɔin, ka lan chɛ ka ŋmani maa yi ŋariŋ maa ni chaŋ.
en: He waited another seven days and sent out the dove again.

dag: Ka kum bee kɔnyuri ku lan gbaai ba, ka wuntaŋ tulim bee biisim shɛli mi ku lan kpe ba.
en: They will never be hungry again. They will never be thirsty again. The sun will not hurt them. No heat will burn them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Sinai tiŋgban nɛl maa ni n-chaŋ ti dɔni Kiburɔtihataava.
en: They left the desert of Sinai and camped at Kibroth Hattaavah.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tahi ma bɛ ni me birini gili tin shɛl la ni? Ŋuni n-lee ni tahi ma Ɛdom?.
en: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress, or lead me to Edom?.

dag: Dama n shee kul tulimi ka biɛra, ka alaafee ka n niŋgbuna ni.
en: I am burning with fever, and my whole body hurts.

dag: Yi na ʒi n-wum di yɛla bee m-mi li. Piligu ni ha ka yi pun nyɛ tipawumlinima. Dama m mi ni yi ni tum yɛŋkiŋkabina tuma, ka lan mi ni yi bilim ni ha ka yi pun nyɛ duŋtaariba.
en: You have never been willing to listen to what I say; from the moment of your birth, I knew you would rebel.

dag: Ka Dauda daa ka Sool sanna nti pilig o tuma tumbu, ka Sool daa yu o pam, ka o zaŋ o leeg o tɔbutuhiri neenʒira.
en: That is how David came to Saul and entered his service. Saul liked David very much, and David became his armor-bearer.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni daa neeg o kum maa ni ka yih o di biɛrim ni, dama o daa pala ŋun ni kpi n-kpalim kum ni.
en: Jesus suffered the pain of death, but God made him free. He raised him from death. There was no way for death to hold him.

dag: Nyin naa ni bɔri ni ti wuh a shɛli ŋɔ to pam, ka so ku tooi wuh a li naɣila wuna din mini ninsalinim bi laɣim bela n-ni tooi niŋ lala.
en: The king is asking something that is too hard to do. Only the gods could tell the king his dream and what it means. But the gods dont live with people.

dag: Yi Duuma lan yɛli yaha, Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ alikauli shɛli n ni ti yɛn lo Izraɛlnima dabisi shɛŋa din kanna ni: N ni ti zaŋ n zaligunim niŋ bɛ tɛha ni, ka sab li niŋ bɛ suhuri ni; ka n ni ti nyɛ bɛ Naawuni, ka bɛ mi ti nyɛ n niriba.
en: But now I tell the people of Israel this is my new agreement: The time will come when I, the Lord, will write my laws on their minds and hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

dag: Chɛ ka o doli wuntia soli kariti a niriba saria, ka doli zaligu kariti a tarimba saria.
en: Let him be honest and fair with all your people, especially the poor.

dag: Dindali maa yuŋ ka Naawuni daa ka Naa Sulemaana sanna ti yɛl o, Suhimi ma a ni bɔri ni n ti a shɛli.
en: That night God appeared to Solomon and asked, What would you like me to give you.

dag: Nyama, n ni dihi ya sɔŋ tiŋa yi biɛhigu shee kaman bɛ ni vari kabɔba m-marigiri taba tɔroko lɔɣu ni shɛm la.
en: And so I will crush you, just as a wagon full of grain crushes the ground.

dag: Ti mi ni timaŋmaŋ biɛr kurili daa pahila o zuɣu ka bɛ kpahi ti tabili dapulli zuɣu ni di chɛ ka ti daalahichi biɛr kurili maa kpi, ka ti ku lan nyɛ alahichi daba.
en: This is what we know: the person that we used to be was crucified with him in order to get rid of the corpse that had been controlled by sin. That way we wouldnt be slaves to sin anymore.

dag: Ka Nagai daa nyɛ Maat bia, ka Maat nyɛ Matatias so bia, ka Matatias maa nyɛ Sɛmɛin bia ka Sɛmɛin nyɛ Josɛk bia, ka Josɛk mi nyɛ Jɔda bia.
en: Naggai was the son of Maath. Maath was the son of Mattathias. Mattathias was the son of Semein. Semein was the son of Josech. Josech was the son of Joda.

dag: Di saha ka Sintani daa yiɣisi Yawɛ sani n-chaŋ ti chɛ ka yumaha gbaai Ayuba, o zuɣutaliga ni zaŋ hal ni o naba puuni.
en: The Adversary departed from the LORDs presence and struck Job with severe sores from the sole of his foot to the top of his head.

dag: Dinzuɣu kom maa na kul nyɛla ko viɛlli hal ni zuŋɔ kaman Ilaisha ni daa yɛli shɛm maa.
en: The water became pure and is still good today. It happened just as Elisha had said.

dag: naɣila o talahi nira, kaman o ba bee o ma bee o bidibiga bee o bipuɣiŋga bee o mabidoo.
en: But if the dead person was one of his close relatives, he can touch the dead body. The priest can make himself unclean if the dead person is his mother or father, his son or daughter, his brother or.

dag: Dauda daa yɛlila Sulemaana, M bia, m pun lo n suhu ni ni m me jɛmbu duu ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ jilima.
en: David said to him, Son, I wanted to build a temple to honor the Lord my God.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ a paɣiba zaa min a bidibisi yi nti ti Babilɔnnima, ka amaŋmaŋ ku tiligi bɛ nuu ni. Amaa Babilɔn naa ni chɛ ka bɛ gbaag a, ka nyo tiŋ ŋɔ buɣim.
en: All your wives and children will be led out to the Babylonians, and you yourself wont escape from them. The king of Babylon will capture you, and this city will be burned down.

dag: Amaa di yi ti niŋ a viɛnyɛla, n suhir a, nyin teemi n yɛla, ka niŋ ma nirilim n-zaŋ n yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi Firawuna; ka lala chɛ ka n yi sarika ŋɔ ni.
en: But when you are free, remember me. Be good to me and help me. Tell Pharaoh about me so that I can get out of this prison.

dag: Tɔbu lu baɣisi zuɣu ni di chɛ ka bɛ leei jɛra. Tɔbu lu bɛ tɔbbihi zuɣu ka bɛ suhuri fuŋ.
en: This war will prove that your prophets are liars and fools. And it will frighten your warriors.

dag: Bɛ kul yɛrimi, Kamiyana ka ti nyu wain; chɛliya ka ti nyu binnyuri kpɛma. Biɛɣuni sa ni be kaman zuŋɔ, hal di sa ni gari lala gba.
en: Come! Ill get some wine! Lets drink beer! Tomorrow will be like today, or even much better.

dag: Ka pateesa shɛŋa din yɛn yili dunɔdali yaɣ yini polo wɔɣilim ti pooi mita ayopɔin biɛla, ka di ti mali daantalis ata mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu diba ata.
en: On each side of the entrance there are to be 1⁄2 yards of curtains, with three posts and three bases.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Naa Hɛrɔd mini Pɔntius Pailɛt ni chɛfirinim zaŋ tabili Izraɛlnim zaa daa shiri laɣim ya n-zaɣisi a Wundab Suŋ Yisa, a ni daa zaŋ so leei Masia.
en: Here in Jerusalem, Herod and Pontius Pilate got together with the Gentiles and the people of Israel. Then they turned against your holy Servant Jesus, your chosen Messiah.

dag: Ka timanim maa daa yɛli Firawuna, Dimbɔŋɔ din nyɛla Naawuni yiko tuma. Amaa ka Firawuna daa niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni o ku wum kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli shɛm la.
en: The magicians told the king, God has done this. But, as the Lord had said, the king was too stubborn to listen.

dag: Di saha ka shia daa kpuɣi ma zuɣusaa, ka Yawɛ jilima daa yiɣisi di biɛhigu shee, ka n daa wum vuri pam n nyaaŋa.
en: Then a wind lifted me up, and I heard behind me a great quaking sound from his place. Blessed is the LORDs glory!.

dag: So yi zaŋ o buŋa bee o nahu bee o piɛɣu bee o biŋkɔb so ti o kpee ni o zali, ka biŋkɔbigu maa ti kpi bee n-nya daŋa bee bɛ taɣ o pah o tab ni chaŋ ka so bi nya o.
en: A man might ask his neighbor to take care of an animal for a short time. It might be a donkey, a bull, or a sheep. But what should you do if that animal is hurt or dies or someone takes the animal while no one is looking?.

dag: Amaa ka sapashin la daa bɔri ni o tiligi Pool ka gɔŋ ba ni bɛ di niŋ lala, ka naɣ yɛli ba mi ni bɛn mi kɔduɣili, bɛn lum kom maa ni n-daŋ duɣi du.
en: But Julius the army officer wanted to let Paul live. So he did not allow the soldiers to kill the prisoners. He told the people who could swim to jump into the water and swim to land.

dag: Ka o yɛli, N ni chɛ ka n jilima zaa gar a tooni, ka m boli n yuli a tooni, Yawɛ. N ni bɔri ni n niŋ ninvuɣ so nirilim, n ni niŋ o nirilim. N ni lan bɔri ni n zo ninvuɣ so nambɔɣu, n ni zo o nambɔɣu.
en: Then the Lord answered, I will show my love and mercy to anyone I want to. So I will cause my perfect goodness to pass by in front of you, and I will speak my name, YAHWEH, so that you can hear it.

dag: Amaa sara maligunim ŋɔ daa kul teerila niriba maa bɛ daalahichi yɛla yuuni kam;.
en: As it is, however, the sacrifices serve year after year to remind people of their sins.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa yɛli, A nini yi tiɣi ma, nyin wuhim ma shihirili din wuhiri ni nyin Yawɛ n-tɔɣisiri ma yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ.
en: Then Gideon said to him, If you would, please give me some proof that you really are the Lord.

dag: O ʒiɛman ni ka Ɛdomnim daa zaɣisi ni Judanim ku lan su ba; ka daa pii so n-leei bɛmaŋmaŋ naa.
en: In Jehorams time Edom broke away from Judahs rule. The people of Edom chose a king for themselves.

dag: Yi yi da Yɛhudia nira ka o leei dabili, o ni tum yi tuma yuma ayɔbu, ka yuun shɛli din pahir ayopɔin ni, di simdi ka yi chɛ ka o chaŋ yoli, ka ku yo shɛli.
en: If you buy a Hebrew slave, he must remain your slave for six years. But in the seventh year you must set him free, without cost to him.

dag: Yisa Masia nyɛla ŋun daa kana ni kom mini ʒim, ka di pala ni kom kɔŋko, amaa di nyɛla kom mini ʒim. Naawuni Shia mi di li shɛhira, dama ŋun Naawuni Shia nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: This is the one who came by water and blood: Jesus Christ. Not by water only but by water and blood. And the Spirit is the one who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.

dag: Ka lala ka yi shiri yuri yi mabihi zaa bɛn be Masidɔnia tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa; amaa ti mabihi, ti kpamdi ya jaande ni yi kul niŋmi lala pahima.
en: In fact, you love all the believers in Macedonia. We encourage you now, brothers and sisters, to show your love more and more.

dag: Yinim Izraɛlnima, labimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani, dama yi tuumbiɛri zuɣu ka yi daa tuui lu.
en: Return to the Lord your God, people of Israel. Your sin has made you stumble and fall.

dag: Ka o daa dii yiɣisi zani chana, dama o daa nyɛla yuun pinaayi bia, ka di daa niŋ ba alahiziba pam ti yaɣi.
en: Suddenly the young woman got up and began to walk around. She was years old. They were shocked!.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma nachin kpɛm maa daa zaŋ o nuu niŋ Ibrahimma gbalipina lɔŋni, ka po pɔri zaŋ chaŋ o ni yɛli shɛm maa polo.
en: So the servant gave Abraham his word that he would do everything he had been told to do.

dag: mini Gɛbalnim tiŋgban la ni Lɛbanɔn tiŋgban la zaa zaŋ kpa wulimpuhili polo ni Baaligad din be Hɛrimɔn zolɔŋni la ni zaŋ ti paai Lɛbohamat kpɛbu shee la.
en: The land of the Gebalites and the whole Lebanon eastward, stretching from Baal-gad at the foot of Mount Hermon to Lebo-hamath.

dag: Zaɣ biɛɣu yi be a nuu ni, nyin yihimi li kpaŋa, ka miri ka a chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu be a yiŋa.
en: Put away the sin that you still hold on to. Dont keep evil in your tent.

dag: Ka di bi simdi ni yi ŋubi bɔrɔbɔro bee kawaan chimda bee zaɣ maha hal ni dindali maa, naɣila yi ti zaŋ Naawuni sara maligu maa na pɔi. Di nyɛla zaligu sahakam yi ʒiɛmani kam ni luɣ shɛlikam zaa yi ni be.
en: You must not eat any bread, roasted grain, or fresh grain until the exact day when you bring your Gods offering. This is a permanent rule throughout your future generations, wherever you live.

dag: Di saha ka Filistianim daa kana ti dɔni Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-chaŋ ti liri Lɛhinima.
en: The Philistines went to the land of Judah and stopped near a place named Lehi. Their army camped there.

dag: Yɛm puuni ka nir mɛri yili, tɛhi zilima puuni ka yili mɛri zaana.
en: Use wisdom and understanding to establish your home;.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n yɛli Izraɛlnima, Yinim lzraɛlnim bee tinzunnim bɛn be yi sani, miriya ka yi ŋubi bin so ŋun kpi nyiŋgo muni.
en: That is why I have told the Israelites: No one among you can consume blood, nor can the immigrant who lives with you consume blood.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka paɣ maa daa yiɣisi kuli nti paai sariga maa sɔŋ, ka lan zaŋ o pako chinchina maa so.
en: Then she got up, left, and took off her veil, dressing once again in the clothing she wore as a widow.

dag: Ka Leeban daa laɣim nimaaninim zaa na ka bɛ ti puhi chuɣu.
en: So Laban gave a big feast and invited all their neighbors.

dag: Ka Yisa daa wum lala maa ka yɛli, Bɛn mal alaafee bi bɔri dɔɣite naɣila bɛn biɛra.
en: Jesus heard them and answered, Healthy people don't need a doctor, but sick people do.

dag: Shɛla ni daa ti paai yuun pihita saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Ɛba.
en: When Shelah was years old, he became the father of Eber.

dag: Ka Yisa daa wum lala ka yɛli, O dɔro maa pala kum dɔro, amaa di nyɛla din ni chɛ ka Naawuni nya jilima, ka Naawuni Bia gba nya jilima di zuɣu.
en: When Jesus heard this he said, The end of this sickness will not be death. No, this sickness is for the glory of God. This has happened to bring glory to the Son of God.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan daa boli Dauda na ti yɛl o dimbɔŋɔ zaa, ka zaŋ o tahi Sool sani, ka Dauda ti lan be o sani kaman o ni daa yi pun be o sani shɛm la.
en: So Jonathan called David and told him everything; then he took him to Saul, and David served the king as he had before.

dag: Yinim Aroanima, zanimiya palli noli lihira! Doo bee paɣa yi ti zɔri garita, ka yi bɔh o, Bɔ n-lee niŋ.
en: You that live in Aroer, stand by the road and wait; ask those who are running away, find out from them what has happened.

dag: Dauda bia Absalom daa mali tizɔpaɣ viɛlli ka o yuli booni Tama. Dahin shɛli ka Dauda bia Amnɔn kɔre daa ti kpe o ni.
en: David's son Absalom had a beautiful unmarried sister named Tamar. Amnon, another of David's sons, fell in love with her.

dag: Yawɛ sani ka bɛn nyari nahiŋgu sɔɣira, o sani n-nyɛ sɔɣibu shee muɣisigu saha.
en: The LORD is a safe place for the oppressed— a safe place in difficult times.

dag: O yi ti nya wɔribariba ayiyi bee bumbariba bee laakumbariba ka bɛ kanna, ŋun gbilisim o tibili wum viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Whether he sees a chariot and a team of horses or men riding donkeys or camels, he must listen carefully.

dag: Amaa ka Zara daa ti nya ka Haga ŋun daa nyɛ Ijipti paɣ la ni daa dɔɣi bi so ti Ibrahimma la min o bia Yisahaku diɛmda.
en: One day Ishmael, whom Hagar the Egyptian had borne to Abraham, was playing with Sarah's son Isaac.

dag: Ka Mariama daa zaŋ tulaale alali lita pirigili ka Yisa sanna ti booi li niŋ o naba, ka zaŋ o zabiri nyɛhinyɛhi o naba maa, ka tulaale maa nyom deei yili maa zaa. Bɛ ni booni ti shɛli naad la ka bɛ daa zaŋ mali tulaale maa, ka di mali shaara pam.
en: Mary brought in a pint of expensive perfume made of pure nard. She poured the perfume on Jesus feet. Then she wiped his feet with her hair. And the sweet smell from the perfume filled the whole house.

dag: Bee a kul zaɣisi ti mi zaa, ka a suhuyiɣisili maa lan ka maabu?.
en: unless you have completely rejected us, or have become too angry with us.

dag: Di saha ka Daniɛl daa kuli nti yɛl o taba Hanania mini Mishɛl ni Azaria yɛla maa ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Then Daniel went home and told his friends Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah what had happened.

dag: Amaa nyin Yawɛ ka n guhira. Nyini n Duuma Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ ŋun ni garigi ma.
en: Lord , you must defend me. Lord my God, you must speak for me.

dag: Zɛra bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Zimiri mini Ɛtan ni Hɛman ni Kalikol ni Dara, bɛ daa nyɛla niriba anu.
en: His brother Zerah had five sons: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Darda.

dag: M mabihi, di benya kaman bihi la yi tɛha ni, amaa benyami kaman bihi la zaŋ chaŋ din nyɛ biɛr biɛɣu polo, ka lee bi dɔbba yi tɛha ni.
en: Brothers and sisters, dont think like children. In evil things be like babies, but in your thinking you should be like full-grown adults.

dag: Ka ŋunkam bi yur o mabia pala ŋun mi Naawuni, dama Naawuni nyɛla yurilim.
en: Whoever does not love does not know God, for God is love.

dag: Amaa a nambɔzɔbo din galisi la zuɣu, a daa bi zaɣisi ba bee m-bahi ba yoli. A nyɛla nirilimlana ni nambɔzɔbo Naawuni!.
en: But you are merciful and kind, and so you never forgot them or let them be destroyed.

dag: Lala ka Naawuni Shia Kasi sɔŋdi ti ti chɔɣinsi ni, dama ti ʒi di ni simdi ni ti suhiri Naawuni shɛm, amaa Naawuni Shia Kasi maŋmaŋa n-deeri suhiri Naawuni ni ŋuhibu din ka yɛtɔɣa tiri ti.
en: Also, the Spirit helps us. We are very weak, but the Spirit helps us with our weakness. We dont know how to pray as we should, but the Spirit himself speaks to God for us. He begs God for us, speaking to him with feelings too deep for words.

dag: Jafilɛt bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Pasak mini Bimhal ni Ashivat. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Jafilɛt bidibisi.
en: Japhlets sons were Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. These were Japhlets children.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa zaa dam, ka salo kabi chaŋ ti gbaai Gaiɔs mini Aristakus bɛn daa yi Masidɔnia na ka nyɛ Pool dolintab la n-dari ba tahi tiŋ maa nim laɣiŋgu shee.
en: Soon the whole city was in a riot, and some men grabbed Gaius and Aristarchus, who had come from Macedonia with Paul. Then everyone in the crowd rushed to the place where the town meetings were held.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa niŋ Yawɛ ni zal o ni o niŋ shɛm maa, ka chaŋ Bɛtilihɛm. Ka tiŋ maa ni kpamba daa kana ti tuh o soli ka bɛ niŋgbuna sɔhira, ka bɛ bɔh o, Alaafee ka a kana.
en: Samuel did what the LORD instructed. When he came to Bethlehem, the city elders came to meet him. They were shaking with fear. Do you come in peace? they asked.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa bɔ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni ninvuɣ tusaata bɛn nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi n-chaŋ ni o ti bɔ Dauda min o niriba maa shee Yɔbuhi Tampima tooni polo.
en: Saul led , of Israel's best soldiers out to look for David and his men near Wild Goat Rocks at En-Gedi.

dag: Naawuni, a yuli nyɛla din du n-gari sagbana. Chɛ ka a jilima be dunia ŋɔ zaa ni.
en: Exalt yourself, God, higher than heaven! Let your glory be over all the earth!.

dag: Bia maa ni daa ti ŋmaai bihili, ka o bo yuma ata naɣilaa mini zim din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram pia ni wain gaɣili pali m-pahi bia maa zuɣu chaŋ Shilo Yawɛ jɛmbu duu, ka bia maa daa na nyɛla ŋun pɔra.
en: After she had weaned him, she took him to Shiloh, taking along a three-year-old bull, a bushel of flour, and a leather bag full of wine. She took Samuel, young as he was, to the house of the Lord at Shiloh.

dag: Ka bɛ daa wurim, ka sokam kul o yiŋa.
en: Everyone else went home.

dag: Farisiinim ni daa wum ni Yisa tɔɣisi luhi Sadusiinim maa, ka bɛ daa laɣim tab ka o sanna.
en: The Pharisees learned that Jesus had made the Sadducees look so foolish that they stopped trying to argue with him. So the Pharisees had a meeting.

dag: nti pahi Ɛliɛl mini Obɛd ni Jaasiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Mɛzɔba nir la.
en: Eliel; Obed; and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.

dag: Ka bɛ daa wurim maligu bimbina din daa be Jɛrusalɛm la mini bɛ ni daa tuɣindi tulaale zim bimbin shɛŋa zuɣu la zaa n-va li ti bahi Kidirɔn Vinvamli ni.
en: They took all the foreign altars and incense altars in Jerusalem and threw them into Kidron Valley.

dag: O chɛ ka tom pali n ni, ka chɛ ka n di wahala.
en: Bitter suffering is all he has given me for food and drink.

dag: N ni labi laŋ piri ba saha shɛli bɛ ni chani maa. N ni siɣisi ba tiŋ na kaman noombihi la. N ni fiɛb ba bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu.
en: They go to those countries for help, but I will trap them. I will throw my net over them, and I will bring them down like the birds of the sky. I will punish them for their agreements.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛl o, Nyama, a ni zaɣisi Yawɛ noli zuɣu, a yi ŋmaligi n sani chana, di ku yuui ka gbuɣinli gbaag a ku. Ka o ni daa kul ŋmalig o sani, ka gbuɣinli shiri chirig o gbaag o ku.
en: and the prophet told him, You disobeyed the Lord , and as soon as you walk away, a lion will kill you. The friend left, and suddenly a lion killed him.

dag: Di saha ka n daa zaŋ wain duɣuri mini pipihi zali Rɛkabinim maa ka yɛli ba, Nyumiya wain.
en: Then I put some bowls full of wine and some cups in front of the Recabite family. And I said to them, Drink some wine.

dag: M mabihi, baŋmiya ni so ku tooi nya yolisim Anabi Musa zaligu dolibu zuɣu. Dinzuɣu ka ti yihiri ya alahichi chɛ m-paŋ waazu doo ŋɔ zuɣu maa, ŋunkam niŋ o yɛda ni nya yolisim binshɛɣukam zaa ni.
en: Brothers, understand what we are telling you. You can have forgiveness of your sins through this Jesus. The Law of Moses could not free you from your sins. But you can be made right with God if you believe in Jesus.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ. Ka o daa ti lan yiɣisi chaŋ kurigu pinaayi saha ni kurig ata saha ti nya shɛba n-lan yɛli bɛ gba lala.
en: And they went. Again around noon and then at three in the afternoon, he did the same thing.

dag: Kum ni kɔnyuri ti ku muɣisi ba, ka wuntaŋ tulim mini pɔhim tulli ti ku kpe ba. Dama ŋun yuri ba n-yɛn mali ba chana. O ni zaŋ ba tahi kɔzɔrim shee.
en: They will not be hungry or thirsty. The hot sun and wind will not hurt them. Their Comforter will lead them. He will lead them by springs of water.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi maa daa ŋma n-chihi ŋarin bil maa bahi kom maa ni ka di chaŋ.
en: The soldiers then cut the ropes that held the lifeboat and let it fall into the sea.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n kpiɔŋ mini m birini ŋɔ, a ninni ka n-kul lihira.
en: I keep looking for you, my strength, because God is my stronghold.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa ti kpi, ka bɛ niŋ tim ʒe o niŋgbuŋ n-zaŋ o niŋ kum adaka ni Ijipti. O daa niŋ dunia yil la yuun kɔbiga ni pia.
en: Joseph died in Egypt when he was years old. Doctors prepared his body for burial and put the body in a coffin in Egypt.

dag: Di saha ka Farisiinim mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba daa yi Jɛrusalɛm ka Yisa sanna ti bɔh o.
en: Then some Pharisees and teachers of the law came to Jesus. They came from Jerusalem and asked him.

dag: Ka naa daa tim ti yih o na. Tiŋ maa niriba maa naa n-daa yih o.
en: The king sent for Joseph and set him free; the ruler of many people released him.

dag: ni yɛlimaŋli yɛlibu ni Naawuni yiko ni ni wuntitali din nyɛ ti bidibbina m-be ti nudiriti mini ti nuzahi ni la puuni.
en: We have spoken the truth, and God's power has worked in us. In all our struggles we have said and done only what is right.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ naɣilaa maa mini piɛlaa maa biŋkpam ni zugbini kpam ni kpam din pili namanama ni binyaannina ni binsabili yaɣ shɛli din viɛla.
en: Aaron put the fat parts of the bull and the ram.

dag: Ŋuni n-daa lee gbi kɔsoli n-ti sa titali bee m-mali soli ti sakpani?.
en: Who dug a channel for the pouring rain and cleared the way for the thunderstorm?.

dag: Yawɛ, niŋmi bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ suma ka be tibi bɛ suhuri ni la zaɣ viɛlli.
en: Lord , be good to those who are good, to those who have pure hearts.

dag: Bɛ ni daa na kul bɔhir o lala maa zuɣu ka o yiɣisi zani yɛli ba, Ŋun na ʒi n-tum alahichi yi ni, ŋun daŋm o kuɣili labbu.
en: The Jewish leaders continued to ask him their question. So he stood up and said, Anyone here who has never sinned should throw the first stone at her.

dag: Ka naa bɔh o, Napaɣ Ɛsta, wula? Bɔ ka a bɔra? N ni ti a a ni bɔri shɛli maa, hal di yi nyɛla n nam ŋɔ pirigili gba, n ni zaŋ li ti a.
en: Then the king said to her, What is it, Queen Esther? What do you want? Ill give you anything—even half the kingdom.

dag: ni salima alali firilatamdisi mini di firilanima ni bɛ nyɔri li zaani luɣ kasi zaa kasi shee la kaman di ni daa wuhi shɛm.
en: the lampstands and the lamps of fine gold that were to burn in front of the Most Holy Place, according to plan;.

dag: Amaa yi yi bi yuri ka kɔŋ zaligu shɛŋa zaa Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ ti Musa la dolibu.
en: The Lord also told Moses to tell the people what must be done if they ever disobey his laws:.

dag: Chamiya ti tum tuma maa, dama bɛ bi lan yɛn tin ya mɔri, amaa yi mi kul yɛn ŋmarila bilichiisi maa kaman yi ni yi pun ŋmari li shɛm tariga la.
en: Go and get back to work! No straw will be given to you, but you still need to make the same number of bricks.

dag: M mabihi ŋmarila ʒiri kaman kulibɔŋ kɔzɔrim la, bee kaman saa ni yi mi ka kom zɔri garita.
en: My companions are treacherous like a stream in the desert, like channels that overrun their streambeds.

dag: Amaa ka o tab maa yɛli, Guhim pɔi! Chɛ ka ti nya Anabi Ilaija ni kana ti tilig o bee o ku kana.
en: But the rest of them said, Lets see if Elijah will come and save him.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, Zaŋmi Lɛvinim zaa ti ma ka chɛ Izraɛlnim bidibikpamba zaa, ka zaŋ Lɛvinim niɣi ti ma ka chɛ Izraɛlnim niɣi ni tuui dɔɣi naɣibihi shɛb zaa.
en: Take the Levites for me, in place of all the oldest sons of the Israelites, for I am the LORD, and the cattle of the Levites in place of all the oldest cattle of the Israelites.

dag: Ka Zɛra ŋun daa nyɛ Itiɔpia nir la tɔbbihi tuhi tuhili mini chɛchɛbunsi kɔbisita kana ti liri ba Marɛsha.
en: Zerah the Cushite marched against him with an army of one million men and three hundred chariots. When he got as far as Mareshah.

dag: ka chɛbisi taba. Di nyaaŋa ka ti daa kpe ŋariŋ, ka bɛ mi lab kuli.
en: and said goodbye. Then we got on the ship, and the followers went home.

dag: Di simdi ni yi chɛ ka dapaɣili kam mali dashɛbira ayi din ni chɛ ka yi zaŋ dapaɣa maa tuɣi taba. Niŋmiya m biɛhigu shee dapaɣa maa zaa lala.
en: Put two pegs on each board for joining them to each other. Do this for all the dwellings boards.

dag: A ni lo nia ni a niŋ bin suŋ shɛŋa ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lur a sizuura galisiya pam. Ka a lan nyɛ ŋun lo nia ni a niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zo na ti sɔɣ a sani din viɛli pam sokam zaa ninni.
en: Lord, you have hidden away many wonderful things for your followers. You have done so many good things for those who trust in you. You have blessed them so that all the world can see.

dag: ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka n tooi zani Ziɔn dunɔdaya ni n-yɛli n ni paɣir a shɛlikam zuɣu shɛm yɛla, n ni mali suhupiɛlli a ni tiligi ma la zuɣu.
en: that I may stand before the people of Jerusalem and tell them all the things for which I praise you. I will rejoice because you saved me.

dag: Dinzuɣu tim man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ yɛm din ni zaŋ gbib a niriba maa, ka tooi baŋ zaɣ suŋ ni zaɣ biɛɣu woligibu; dama ŋuni n-lee ni tooi gbib a niriba bɛn galisi pam ŋɔ.
en: So give me the wisdom I need to rule your people with justice and to know the difference between good and evil. Otherwise, how would I ever be able to rule this great people of yours.

dag: Ka Otiniɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Kalɛb tizo Kɛnaz bidibiga la daa chaŋ ti tuhi deei tiŋ maa, ka Kalɛb daa shiri zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga Akisa maa ti o ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: Othniel, the son of Caleb's younger brother Kenaz, captured the city, so Caleb gave him his daughter Achsah in marriage.

dag: Bɛ daa tam o yiko yɛla, ka tam o ni daa tiligi ba bɛ dimnim nuu ni dahin shɛl la yɛla;.
en: They forgot about his power. They forgot the many times he saved them from the enemy.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn darigila Babilɔn naa tibili n-tabil o tiŋgbɔŋ kaman n ni daa darigi Asiria naa tibili shɛm la.
en: Therefore, the LORD of heavenly forces, the God of Israel, proclaims: Im going to punish the king of Babylon and his land, just as I punished the king of Assyria.

dag: Ka Zipɔr bia Balak daa nya Izraɛlnim ni niŋ Amɔrinim shɛlikam zaa.
en: When King Balak of Moab and his people heard how many Israelites there were and what they had done to the Amorites, he and the Moabites were terrified and panicked.

dag: Ka Ɛlikana min o yiŋnim maa daa daŋ yiɣisibu asiba n-jɛm Yawɛ ka lab kuli bɛ ya Rama. Ka Ɛlikana min o paɣ Hanna daa ti dɔni, ka Yawɛ teei Hanna yɛla.
en: They got up early the next morning and worshipped the LORD. Then they went back home to Ramah. Elkanah had sex with his wife Hannah, and the LORD remembered her.

dag: Teebuya anahi n-daa ʒe di puuni, ka diba anahi ʒe samban ni dunɔdali yaɣili. Teebuya anii n-daa nyɛ li, ka bɛ kɔriti sara maligu biŋkɔbiri di zuɣu.
en: There were four tables on each side of the gate, eight tables in all, for preparing the animal offerings.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n kpiɔŋ mini m birini ŋɔ, a ninni ka n-kul lihira.
en: You are my mighty fortress, and I depend on you.

dag: Ka lan ti o yiko ni o kari saria, o ni nyɛ Daadam Bia la zuɣu.
en: And he has given the Son the right to judge, because he is the Son of Man.

dag: Musa ni daa tɔɣisi Izraɛlnim zaa yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli tiŋgban nɛli ni bɔpiɛligu din daa be Suf tooni, ka be Paran mini Tɔfɛl ni Leeban ni Hazɛrɔt ni Dizahab sunsuuni la m-bɔŋɔ.
en: These are the words that Moses spoke to all Israel across the Jordan River, in the desert, on the plain across from Suph, between Paran and Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth, and Di-zahab. .

dag: Man Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yi di bi lo biɛkaali mini yuŋ alikauli, ka zali zuɣusaa mini dunia zaligunima.
en: The LORD proclaims: I would no sooner break my covenant with day and night or the laws of heaven and earth.

dag: ni Ahilud bia Baana ŋun daa su Taanak mini Mɛgido ni bɔb shɛli zaa din zaŋ ti miri Bɛtishɛan din baɣi Zarɛtan ka be Jɛziriil tooni n-yi Bɛtishɛan n-zaŋ ti paai Ɛbɛlimɛhola n-zaŋ nimaani hal ti paai Jokimiam yaɣili polo la.
en: Baana son of Ahilud was in charge of the towns of Taanach and Megiddo. He was also in charge of the whole region of Beth-Shan near the town of Zarethan, south of Jezreel from Beth-Shan to Abel-Meholah to the other side of Jokmeam.

dag: dama Naawuni ni nam dunia ŋɔ hal ni zuŋɔ ka ti nin na bi nya wahala shɛŋa zaa ni ti beni, ka di tatabo mi ku lan niŋ.
en: For the trouble of those days will be far worse than any the world has ever known from the very beginning when God created the world until the present time. Nor will there ever be anything like it again.

dag: Ti ni daa yuui soli maa ni zuɣu ka barina daa ti yɛn paai ti, ka nolɔbo saha mi pun gari, ka Pool daa saɣisi ba yɛli.
en: We spent a long time there, until it became dangerous to continue the voyage, for by now the Day of Atonement was already past. So Paul gave them this advice:.

dag: Yɛhudianim bɛn daa be Naa Ahasivɛrɔs tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni tiŋ kam ni daa laɣimmi mali shili gu ni bɛ mini ŋunkam kana ni o ti liri ba zaŋ nya taba. Ka niriba bɛn daa be luɣ shɛlikam daa zɔri ba ka so ku tooi zani bɛ tooni.
en: In the Jewish quarter of every city in the empire the Jews organized to attack anyone who tried to harm them. People everywhere were afraid of them, and no one could stand against them.

dag: Ka tibimiya barinima, ka neemiya kpiimba, ka chɛliya ka kɔnsi kpaŋda, ka karimiya alizin biɛri bahira. Yi dee li la yoli, yi gba timiya li yoli.
en: Heal the sick, bring the dead back to life, heal those who suffer from dreaded skin diseases, and drive out demons. You have received without paying, so give without being paid.

dag: Zoya sɔhirila o tooni, ka daboya nyɛligira ka tiŋgbani mini dunia ni binshɛɣukam din be di ni ŋuhir o tooni.
en: The Lord will come, and the mountains will shake and the hills will melt away. He will come, and the earth will shake with fear. The earth and everyone on it will shake with fear.

dag: Ka o daa lab o sani ti nya ka o mini Mɔab kpamba ʒiɛla o sara maligu shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maa gbini. Ka Balak daa bɔh o, Wula ka Yawɛ lee yɛli.
en: Balaam went back and saw him and his officials standing beside the offerings. Balak asked, What did the Lord say.

dag: Di ti ŋubiya niŋkaha bee n-duɣ li, amaa ti shɛmiya binzuɣuri ni biɛhi zaa n-tabili puuni nɛma zaa.
en: Don't eat the meat raw or boiled. The entire animal, including its head, legs, and insides, must be roasted.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb ni ti yiɣisi yimaŋmaŋ gba ni n-tɔɣisi ya chirimbu yɛtɔɣa ni bɛ lɛbigi nyaandoliba maa suhuri n-zu ba chaŋ.
en: Some of your own people will tell lies to win over the Lord's followers.

dag: Saha shɛli Izraɛlnim ni daa do Giligal bɔpiɛligu ni Jɛriko maa, ka bɛ daa puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu di goli maa biɛɣ pinaanahi dali zaawuni.
en: The Israelites camped in Gilgal. They celebrated Passover on the evening of the fourteenth day of the month on the plains of Jericho.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ wuna zaa Naawuni mini duumanim zaa Duuma. Ŋuna n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun galisi ka mali kpiɔŋ ka o yɛla mali dabiɛm, ŋun bi gaŋdi so bee n-diri birapu.
en: The Lord your God is supreme over all gods and over all powers. He is great and mighty, and he is to be obeyed. He does not show partiality, and he does not accept bribes.

dag: Ka di bi simdi ni a zaŋ pakoya bɛn nyɛ paɣisara la gba yuya pahi pakoya kalinli ni, dama bɛ kɔre yi ti kpe dɔbba kulibu ni bɛ ŋmaligirimi ka chɛ Masia.
en: But do not include younger widows in the list; because when their desires make them want to marry, they turn away from Christ.

dag: ni bɛ niŋm binzusa niŋ bɛ binyɛra luɣa ni bɛ ʒiɛmana zaa ni, ka niŋ mi sabilitim niŋ binzusa kam din be bɛ luɣa ni maa.
en: Speak to the Israelites and say to them: Make fringes on the edges of your clothing for all time. Have them put blue cords on the fringe on the edges.

dag: Gol so ŋun daŋ tooni biɛɣ pinaanu dali din daa nyɛ Yaɣigari chuɣu puhi kaai biɛɣu dal la, ka Izraɛlnim daa yi Ramɛsis n-chani nasara dibu chandi Ijiptinim zaa ninni.
en: The people of Israel left Egypt on the fifteenth day of the first month of the year, the day after the first Passover. Under the Lord 's protection they left the city of Rameses in full view of the Egyptians.

dag: Ka ŋunkam daa mɛri tandi mi daa zaŋla takɔbi n-so o shee ni ka mɛra. Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun daa piɛbiri kikaa gba daa kul baɣi ma.
en: and everyone who was building kept a sword strapped to their waist. The man who was to sound the alarm on the bugle stayed with me.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ daa lan zaŋ Bashan Naa Ogi min o niriba zaa niŋ ti nuu ni, ka ti daa ku ba hal ka o ninvuɣ yino gba daa bi kpalim.
en: And so the LORD our God also handed Og, Bashans king, along with his forces, over to us. We struck them down until no survivor was left.

dag: Bɛ zilima ŋmanila piɛm din mali lɔɣu, di tɔɣisirila ʒiri yɛtɔɣa. Bɛ zaa tɔɣisirila zɔsimdi yɛtɔɣa bɛ ʒiʒiinitab sani, amaa bɛ suhuri ni, bɛ nyɛla bɛn sɔɣi dɔni gu ni bɛ tum barina.
en: They say they want peace, but this lie is deadly, like an arrow that strikes when you least expect it.

dag: Ka Ɛbɛd bia Gaal maa daa ti yina ti zani tiŋ maa gooni dunol ni, ka Abimilɛk min o niriba maa yiɣisi bɛ sɔɣibu shee maa yina.
en: When Gaal, Ebeds son, came out and stood in the entrance of the citys gate, Abimelech and the men with him sprang up from the ambush.

dag: Sirianim daa ti chaŋ ti tuhi Izraɛlnima, ka gbaai bipuɣimbil so kuli ka o ti tumdi tuma sɔŋdi Naaman paɣa.
en: Now Aramean raiding parties had gone out and captured a young girl from the land of Israel. She served Naamans wife.

dag: Yiɣisima, dama di nyɛla a tuma, ka ti gba ʒe a nyaaŋa, mali yaa, ka niŋ li.
en: Get up, for it is your duty to deal with this matter; we will support you. Be strong and act.

dag: Ka paɣiviɛligakushihikom kɔtomsi tam daantalisi maa zuɣusaa. Lala ka o daa niŋ n-naai daantalisi maa tuma.
en: The lily-shaped bronze capitals were on top of the columns. And so the work on the columns was completed.

dag: Ka Musa daa chɛ ka bɛ ninvuɣ tuhilituhili bɛn yi Izraɛl zuliya kam ni na maa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza bia Finɛhas ŋun daa gbibi Naawuni jɛmbu shee lahi mini kikahi din ni piɛbi boli niriba o nuu ni la chaŋ tɔb maa ni.
en: Moses sent them off to war. Phinehas the son of Eleazar went with them and took along some things from the sacred tent and the trumpets for sounding the battle signal.

dag: Ka Hilikia bia Ɛliakim ŋun daa su nayili fukumsi la mini Shɛbina ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la ni Asaf bia Jɔa ŋun daa sabiri bina yɛla zaani la daa ka sapashin kpɛm maa sanna.
en: Three Judeans came out to meet him: the official in charge of the palace, Eliakim son of Hilkiah; the court secretary, Shebna; and the official in charge of the records, Joah son of Asaph.

dag: Ka ti Duuma daa nya pakoli maa ka di niŋ o nambɔɣu ka o yɛl o, Di kuhira.
en: When the Lord saw the woman, he felt very sorry for her and said, Dont cry.

dag: Ka binnɛma maa ʒe binfalafala maa lɔŋni, ka bɛ kpiŋkpama teei tuhi, ka yino kpiŋkpaŋ kpa o kpee polo. Ka binnɛma maa zaɣ yino kam daa zaŋ o kpiŋkpama ayi pɔbi omaŋa.
en: There under the dome stood the creatures, each stretching out two wings toward the ones next to it and covering its body with the other two wings.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka ti yi n-chaŋ o sani tin tariga maa ha nti pah o zuɣu di vi.
en: So now, lets go to him outside the camp, bearing his shame.

dag: Yaa ti Naawuni, hal binshɛlikam din niŋ ti ti daalahichi mini ti taali zuɣu ŋɔ ti mi ni a bi darigi ti tibili kaman ti tuumbiɛri ni simdi shɛm, ka chɛ ka ti ni shɛb tiligi ŋɔ.
en: After all that has happened to us because of our evil deeds and our great guilt—although you, our God, have punished us less than our iniquities deserve and have allowed us to survive as we do.

dag: Ɛliɛza bia Finɛhas ŋun nyɛ maligumaana Aduna yaaŋa ŋɔ niŋ suhukpeeni Izraɛlnim ni n-zani n zaani mahi n suhu, ka m bi chɛ ka n suhuyiɣisili di Izraɛlnima.
en: Phinehas has turned back my rage toward the Israelites. Because he was jealous for me among you, I didnt consume the Israelites due to my jealousy.

dag: M bia, wumma, niŋmi yɛm, ka niŋ tɛha niŋ a suhu ni zaŋ chaŋ a biɛhigu polo.
en: So listen, my son, and be wise. Always be careful to follow the right path.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ li niŋ binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa maa bɔɣusapima zuɣu tan tolima la ni ka di nyɛ kuɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn mali teeri Izraɛl bidibisi maa yɛla kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali shɛm.
en: Then these were attached to the shoulder straps of the vest, so the Lord would never forget his people. Everything was done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Dauda, ka o tim ni bɛ ti tuhi ba soli, dama vi daa mali tuumba maa pam. Ka naa daa yɛli ba, Kpalimmiya be Jɛriko hal ka yi teensi maa ti bili, ka yi naanyi kuna.
en: When the people told David, he sent messengers to meet his officers. He did this because these men were very ashamed. King David said, Wait at Jericho until your beards grow again. Then come back home.

dag: N zɔnim ni m mini bɛn doli bi lan miriti ma n yuma maa zuɣu; hal n ʒiʒiinitab gba kaɣiri ma mi.
en: My friends and neighbors will not come near me, because of my sores; even my family keeps away from me.

dag: Dama bɛ daa chɛ ka o suhu miligi, ka o yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din bi simdi.
en: because they made him bitter so that he spoke rashly with his lips.

dag: Di saha ka Amɔrinim bɛn daa be zoya ni tiŋ maa ni daa ti kar doli ya kaman shihi la nti ŋmɛri ya luhira Ɛdom hal ti paai Hɔrima.
en: And the Amorites who lived in those hills came out to meet you in battle. They chased you like bees give chase! They gave you a beating from Seir all the way to Hormah.

dag: O daa yɛli ma, Izraɛl nyɛla n dabili, a sani ka n yɛn nya jilima.
en: He said to me, Israel, you are my servant; because of you, people will praise me.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti mali di lahi mini di parante shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn mali tuɣindi tulaale zim, ka mali duɣuri ni kuruwa shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn mali boori sara maligu wain. Di simdi ka yi ti zaŋ salima alali mal li.
en: The table is to be kept in the holy place, and the sacred loaves of bread must always be on it. All bowls, plates, jars, and cups for wine offerings are to be made of pure gold and set on this table.

dag: Yaakubu daa di n-tiɣi. Jɛshurun daa ŋmɛlimya ka tiri gbini. A ŋmɛlimya piri m-muɣi lɔŋ. O daa zaɣisi Naawuni ŋun nam o, ka maani o tiliginsim tampiŋ ansarisi.
en: But Jeshurun became fat and kicked like a bull. They left the God who made them! They ran away from the Rock who saved them.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a tiligira la yɛliya, N suhu n-daa yiɣisi pam saha biɛla puuni, ka n chɛ a bahi. Amaa n yurilim din bi naari la zuɣu, n ni zo a nambɔɣu.
en: In an outburst of rage, I hid my face from you for a moment, but with everlasting love I have consoled you, says your redeemer, the LORD.

dag: Ka Nataniɛl bɔh o, Ya polo ka a lee mi ma? Ka Yisa garigi n-yɛl o, A ni di be fiig tia gbini ka Filip na bi nya a la, ka n di nya a.
en: Nathanael asked him, How do you know me? Jesus answered, I saw you when you were under the fig tree before Philip called you.

dag: Yɛhudianim bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm daa ti tim maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinima ni bɛ ti bɔhi Jɔn ni o lee nyɛla ŋuni.
en: The Jewish leaders in Jerusalem sent some priests and Levites to John to ask him, Who are you? He told them the truth.

dag: A yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ ŋɔ ni tooi chɛ ka niriba fo bɛ noya? Ka a yi maani niriba ansarisi so ŋun di dih a vi?.
en: Your words have silenced others and made them ashamed; now it is only right for you to be put to shame.

dag: Nyini n-daa zaŋ ba na ti ʒil amaŋmaŋ zoli zuɣu, nyini Yawɛ ni pii luɣ shɛli n-leeg a biɛhigu shee la. Nyin Yawɛ ni zaŋ amaŋmaŋ nuhi me a jɛmbu du shɛl la ni.
en: You will let your people settle on your own mountain, where you chose to live and to be worshiped.

dag: N yiɣisirila nolɔɣu kukoli saha n kumdi niŋd a, n zaŋ n tahima niŋla a yɛligu ni.
en: I get up early in the morning to pray to you. I trust what you say.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ daa kul teei gilila tiŋ maa hal ti paai Naa Zɛdɛkia nam dibu yuun piniyini saha.
en: After a year and a half, all the food in Jerusalem was gone. Then on the ninth day of the fourth month.

dag: Ka Kɛnania ŋun daa nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya maa biŋkumdiŋmɛriba zuɣulan la daa nyɛ ŋun yɛn wuhiri bɛ ni yɛn ŋmɛri biŋkumda maa shɛm, dama ŋuna n-daa mi di ŋmɛbu.
en: Chenaniah was chosen to be the music director, because he was a skilled musician.

dag: A ni zaŋ kurigu jaaŋgbee ŋme n-wurim ba; ka to n-wurisi ba kaman yaɣimɛr duɣu la.
en: You will rule over them with great power. You will scatter your enemies like broken pieces of pottery.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia Tapanhɛs maa.
en: In the town of Tahpanhes, Jeremiah received this message from the Lord :.

dag: Niriba anu maa ni daa lab Zɔra mini Ɛshitaol bɛ mabihi maa sani, bɛ daa bɔhi ba mi, Ka lahibal bɔ ka yi lee ʒina.
en: The five men went back to Zorah and Eshtaol, where their relatives asked, Did you find any land.

dag: ni sapashinnim bɛn su tɔbbihi pihinunu fukumsi ni zuɣulaannima ni bɛn wuhiri niriba din niŋ kamaata ni alahiziba tumtumsa tumdiba ni bukpahinima.
en: their military and civilian leaders, their politicians and everyone who uses magic to control events.

dag: Ŋun biriti mini ŋun mihiri kom zaa nyɛla yim, ka bɛ zaa ni ti deei bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm laara.
en: The one who plants and the one who waters have the same purpose. And each one will be rewarded for his own work.

dag: O neen ʒira maa ni daa nya ka Sool kpi maa, ka o gba lu o takɔbi zuɣu kpi.
en: When the soldier realized that Saul was dead, he killed himself in the same way.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa chɛ salo maa ka kul o yilikpɛrili. Ka o nyaandoliba daa ka o sanna ti yɛl o, Wuhim ti piriŋkpana din be puu ni la yɛla ŋahili la gbinni.
en: Jesus left the crowds and went into the house. His disciples came to him and said, Explain to us the parable of the weeds in the field.

dag: Ŋunkam deei n zaligu ka dol li, dilana n-nyɛ ŋun yuri ma; ka m Ba ni yuri ŋun yuri ma maa, ka n gba ni yuri dilana ka kahigiri mmaŋ wuhir o.
en: Whoever has my commandments and keeps them loves me. Whoever loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love them and reveal myself to them.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ daa yɛli ma.
en: Then the word of the LORD of heavenly forces came to me.

dag: Ka Ibram daa niŋ Yawɛ yɛda, ka Yawɛ daa lih o niŋsim maa ka di nyɛla wuntia.
en: Abram trusted the LORD, and the LORD recognized Abrams high moral character.

dag: Di chɛ ka n suhu kpe zaɣ biɛɣu niŋbu ni, ka m pahi ninvuɣ biɛri zuɣu tum zaɣ biɛɣu. Di chɛ ka n zaŋ mmaŋ bali tuumbiɛtumdiba ni; di chɛ ka m pahi bɛ zuɣu di bɛ bindir nyaɣisa.
en: Take away any desire to do evil. Keep me from joining the wicked in doing wrong. Help me stay away from their feasts.

dag: Ka o daa ba buŋa chaŋ ti ŋmaligi zolɔŋni n-tuhi Dauda min o niriba maa soli ka bɛ kanna.
en: Abigail was riding her donkey on the path that led around the hillside, when suddenly she met David and his men heading straight at her.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, a daa tiligi ba a yuli zuɣu, ni lala chɛ ka a wuh a yiko tuma ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: But he saved them, as he had promised, in order to show his great power.

dag: Hɛman mini Jɛdutun n-daa nyɛ bɛn piɛbiri kikahi ka ŋmɛri guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisa ni biŋkumdi shɛŋa din pahi n-yiini yila din be kasi la. Ka bɛ daa pii Jɛdutun bidibisi n-leei dunɔguliba.
en: Heman and Jeduthun also had charge of the trumpets and cymbals and the other instruments which were played when the songs of praise were sung. The members of Jeduthun's clan were in charge of guarding the gates.

dag: Ka di simdi ni dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla zaligu yi sani sahakam ni bɛ yɔri Izraɛlnim daalahichi zaa samli tiri ba yim yuuni puuni. Ka Musa daa niŋ Yawɛ ni zal o shɛm maa.
en: That law will continue forever. Once every year you will purify the Israelites from all their sins. So they did everything that the Lord had commanded Moses.

dag: Yuŋ nyoorila n kɔb tuɣa ni; ka biɛrim shɛli din dimdi ma bi naara.
en: All my bones ache at night. Pain never stops chewing on me.

dag: Ka Ai naa ni daa nya Izraɛl tɔbbihi maa, o min o tiŋ maa ni niriba zaa daa niŋla yomyom n-daŋ yibu asibaasi n-kab sirigi Araba zolɔŋni ni bɛ mini Izraɛlnim ti tuhi. Amaa bɛ daa bi mi ni tɔbbihi sɔɣ do bɛ tiŋ maa gulinyaaŋa.
en: Later, the king of Ai saw the army of Israel. The king and his people hurried out to fight the army of Israel. The king of Ai went out the east side of the city toward the Jordan Valley, so he did not see the soldiers hiding behind the city.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim bɛn daa pa Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba la daa laɣim tɔbbihi tuhi kɔbisinahi bɛn nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi.
en: The other Israelite tribes organized their army and found they had , experienced soldiers.

dag: Ka o ti lan lab o nyaandoliba maa sanna nti nya ka bɛ lan gbihirimi, dama gom n-daa mali ba pam.
en: Then he went back to the followers. Again he found them sleeping. They could not stay awake.

dag: Di saha Sɔdomnim daa nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛri ni bɛn tumd alahichi pam Yawɛ sani.
en: where the people were evil and sinned terribly against the Lord .

dag: Shimɛi bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Jahat mini Zina ni Jɛushi ni Bɛraya, bɛ niriba anahi maa n-daa nyɛ Shimɛi bidibisi.
en: Shimeis family: Jahath, Ziza, Jeush, and Beriah. These four were Shimeis family.

dag: ka boli yil maa ni bi so na nti bɔh o diɛma maa daliri.
en: So he called one of the servants over and asked, What's going on here.

dag: Niriba maa daa na kul maanila sara buɣa jɛmbu shee maa, amaa bɛ daa maani li n-tirila Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa.
en: The people obeyed Manasseh, but they worshiped the Lord at their own shrines.

dag: A nini ti yɛn nya li la, ka di chaŋ; dama yim ka di yɛn bili kpiŋkpama yiɣi kpe zuɣusaa kaman tɔrili la.
en: In the blink of an eye, money can disappear, as if it grew wings and flew away like a bird.

dag: Yi yi ti kul nya ka di wula puhiri va mama, di saha yi baŋya ni siɣili miriya.
en: When you see their leaves beginning to appear, you know that summer is near.

dag: Dunianima, wummiya, n yɛn chɛmi ka alɔbo lu niriba ŋɔ zuɣu, ka di leei bɛ tuma nyɔri, dama bɛ zaɣisi n yɛligu wumbu, ka zaɣisi n wuhibu gba.
en: Hear this, people of the earth: I am going to bring disaster to the people of Judah because of all the evil they planned, and because they ignored my messages. They refused to obey my law.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Yaakubu Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Zaŋmiya yi yɛtɔɣa na, ka zaŋ yi ni mali yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni yi yɛli zaŋ chaŋ di polo na.
en: The Lord , the king of Israel, has this to say: You gods of the nations, present your case. Bring the best arguments you have!.

dag: Naawuni daa nam ninsala ŋ-ŋmahindila omaŋa, ka o be kaman Naawuni ni be shɛm. O daa nam ba la doo mini paɣa.
en: God created humanity in Gods own image, in the divine image God created them, male and female God created them.

dag: Ka o dan maa yɛl o, Ti ku zani tinzunnim bɛn pa Izraɛlnim ŋɔ tiŋ ŋɔ ni, amaa ti ni gari paala Gibia. Ka o daa lan yɛl o tumtumda maa, Chɛ ka ti tirisi chaŋ luɣ shɛŋa dimbɔŋɔ ha nti gbe Gibia bee Rama.
en: But his master said, We're not going to stop in a city where the people are not Israelites. We'll pass on by and go a little farther and spend the night at Gibeah or Ramah.

dag: Bɛn daa ŋubi bɛ sara maligu biŋkɔbiri kpam ka nyu bɛ sara maligu wain la lee be ya? Chɛ ka bɛ yiɣisi zani sɔŋ ya, chɛ ka bɛ guli ya.
en: Those false gods ate the fat of your sacrifices. And they drank the wine of your offerings. So let them get up and help you! Let them protect you!.

dag: Bipolitali ni daa kul pali bɛ niŋgbuŋ shɛŋa ni maa; bɛ mini li ni ti dɔni taŋkpaɣu ni.
en: Indeed, the wicked will die and go to their graves in the prime of life.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, M bia, a yɛda niŋbu n-chɛ ka a kpaŋ; kulimi ni suhudoo, a yipa kpaŋya zaa.
en: Jesus said to her, My daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace, and be healed of your trouble.

dag: Teem a ni daa pun piig a ninvuɣ shɛb kurimbuni ha la yɛla, a ni daa tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb ni bɛ nyɛ a ni su zuliya shɛb la. Teem Ziɔn Zo shɛli zuɣu a ni daa be la yɛla.
en: Remember your people, whom you chose for yourself long ago, whom you brought out of slavery to be your own tribe. Remember Mount Zion, where once you lived.

dag: Miri ka a leei ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali bɛ nɛma pari talima la ni yino bee n-zani ti so ni o di samli.
en: Don't promise to be responsible for someone else's debts.

dag: Neesim neeri wuntizɔriba sani, ka bɛn biɛhigu be tibi bɛ suhuri ni mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Light is planted like seed for the righteous person; joy too for those whose heart is right.

dag: Yɛndan tɔɣisirila baŋsim yɛtɔɣa, amaa jɛrilim n-yiri jɛra noya ni na.
en: When wise people speak, they make knowledge attractive, but stupid people spout nonsense.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni a yihi ba di ni, dama di nyɛla vi ni bɛ mali wuhibu shɛŋa bɛ ni ka soli ni bɛ zaŋ wuhi so m-birigiri yiya pam puuni niriba liɣiri nyabu zuɣu.
en: It is necessary to stop their talk, because they are upsetting whole families by teaching what they should not, and all for the shameful purpose of making money.

dag: O daa fa ma n dim ŋun nyɛ yaalan nuu ni bahi, ka tiligi ma bɛn je ma nuu ni, dama bɛ daa gari ma yaa.
en: He rescued me from my powerful enemies and from all those who hate me— they were too strong for me.

dag: Ka n chɛ ka wuntaŋ mini maligu ni sakuɣa kanna ti kuri yi ni biri binshɛlikam, amaa ka yi na kul bi bɔri ni yi ŋmaligi lab n sanna. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: That was because I punished you. I sent the diseases that killed your plants and the hail that destroyed the things you made with your hands. I did this, but still you did not come to me. This is what the Lord said.

dag: Di biɛɣ pinaanahi dali yuŋ ti ni daa chani ka pɔhim kul ʒiɛri ti bahiri Adria teeku ni la, ka di daa ti niŋ yuntisuɣu, ka kpatoonsi maa tɛhi ni ti mirila duli.
en: On the fourteenth night we were still being blown around in the Adriatic Sea. The sailors thought we were close to land.

dag: Nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ni Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun ʒi Chɛrubinim zuɣusaa ŋɔ, a kɔŋko n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun su dunia ŋɔ nama zaa fukumsi. Nyini n-nam tiŋgbani mini zuɣusaa.
en: Lord All-Powerful, God of Israel, you sit as King above the Cherub angels. You alone are the God who rules all the kingdoms on earth. You made heaven and earth.

dag: A chɛ ka ti leela daɣiri mini saɣiri zuliya shɛb sani.
en: You made us like garbage and dirt to the other nations.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri n nasara dibu la suhuri paligi ka bɛ tahiri suhupiɛlli tahigu yɛri sahakam, Yawɛ ŋun bɔr o dabili nasara dibu ŋɔ galisiya pam.
en: Let all who want me to win be happy and joyful. From now on let them say, The Lord is wonderful! God is glad when all goes well for his servant.

dag: Ka o daa lan zaŋ salima alali mali tipuma kɔtomsi mini firilanima ni gbabɔnima.
en: He used pure gold to make the flowers, lamps, and tongs.

dag: Nyin ŋun nyari niriba galimi ŋɔ ni tooi mo Kpiɔŋlan Naa? Ŋunkam ŋmɛri Naawuni naŋgbankpeeni ŋun garigima.
en: You wanted to argue with God All-Powerful. You wanted to correct me and prove that I was wrong. So give me your answer.

dag: Kom maa kpaŋmi kaman kuɣili la, ka teeku bulli ni kom zuɣusaa kilim.
en: Thats when the water freezes as hard as a rock. Even the deep sea freezes over!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa boli Ribɛka na nti bɔh o, A ni doli doo ŋɔ chaŋ? Ka o garigi yɛli, N ni dol o chaŋ.
en: They called her and asked, Are you willing to leave with this man at once? Yes, she answered.

dag: Amaa ka Onan daa mi ni o bi yɛn su bihi maa. Dinzuɣu o min o biɛli pakoli maa daa yi ti dɔni, o daa yihirila o kom bahi tiŋa ni di chɛ ka o ku dɔɣi bihi ti o biɛli maa.
en: Onan knew the children wouldnt be his so when he slept with his brothers wife, he wasted his semen on the ground, so he wouldnt give his brother children.

dag: Haman daa lan yɛli, Ka din gari lala nyɛla, n kɔŋko n-nyɛ Napaɣ Ɛsta ni boli so pahi naa zuɣu ni ti kana nti di bindira ka nyu binnyura. Hal o lan bol ti ni ti sa labina biɛɣuni yaha.
en: What is more, Haman went on, Queen Esther gave a banquet for no one but the king and me, and we are invited back tomorrow.

dag: Niriba pam daa nya o ka di gari ba pam. O biɛhigu daa taɣimi, ka o bi ŋmani ninsala.
en: Many people were shocked when they saw him; he was so disfigured that he hardly looked human.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi tɛha be kaman tɛhi shɛli din be Masia ni la:.
en: In your life together, think the way Christ Jesus thought.

dag: Amaa Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa ti kana ni o ti tuhi tiŋgbɔŋ maa nima, ka ti daa yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti zo n-kuli Jɛrusalɛm, ti ni daa zɔri Babilɔn tɔbbihi mini Siria tɔbbihi dabiɛm maa zuɣu. Lala zuɣu ka ti be Jɛrusalɛm maa.
en: except now we have to live inside Jerusalem because Nebuchadnezzar has taken over the countryside with his army from Babylonia and Syria.

dag: Tiligim ma bɛ ninkuunsi takɔbi ŋɔ ni; fam ma tinzunnim nuu ni bahi. Bɛ nyɛla ʒiŋmariba. Hal bɛ yi po pɔri, bɛ ŋmarila ʒiri.
en: Won't you keep me safe from those lying foreigners who never tell the truth?.

dag: Ti Duuma Naawuni, niŋm ti nirilim ka chɛ ka ti nuhi tuma tɔŋ. Iin, chɛ ka ti nuhi tuma tɔŋ!.
en: Lord, our God, be kind to us. Make everything we do successful. Yes, make it all successful.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ka Ibram sanna ti yɛl o, N ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ti a zuliya. Di saha ka Ibram daa me sara maligu bimbini nimaani zali Yawɛ ŋun daa ka o sani maa na.
en: The LORD appeared to Abram and said, I give this land to your descendants, so Abram built an altar there to the LORD who appeared to him.

dag: Di daa nyɛla binnɛma la kpiŋkpama din daa shihiri taba la mini kalima din baɣi li la vuri. Di daa vurimi kaman tiŋgbani n-damdi pampam la.
en: The sound was the creatures wings beating against each other and the sound of the wheels beside them; it was a great rumbling noise.

dag: Ka doo gbɛɣu zabiri min o tapaɣisi kɔbiri yi guhi, o malila gbɛ palo, amaa o pala ŋun be daɣiri ni.
en: A man might lose hair from the sides of his head. He is clean. It is only another kind of baldness.

dag: Yɛndan yi tahi jɛra ʒiishee, vuri yɔbu mini ansarisi ku mali tariga.
en: When an intelligent person brings a lawsuit against a fool, the fool only laughs and becomes loud and abusive.

dag: Daba ayopɔin nyaaŋa ka kokpɛɣu daa kpe m-pali dunia ŋɔ.
en: After seven days, the floodwaters arrived on the earth.

dag: Miri ka a mali jɛlinsi a suhu ni ni a kpee, amaa chɛ ka a min a kpee maa tɔɣisi mali yi yɛtɔɣa, di yi pa lala a ni ti tum alahichi o zuɣu.
en: Do not bear a grudge against others, but settle your differences with them, so that you will not commit a sin because of them.

dag: Judanim ni ti niŋ ayɛi, niriba maa ni daa bi tooi sɔŋ ba la zuɣu. Bɛ ni chɛ ka Judanim maa di vi.
en: But they will be disappointed. They are depending on a nation that cannot help them. Egypt is useless—it will not help. Egypt will bring nothing but shame and embarrassment.

dag: Suhimiya Yawɛ saa salan saa mibu saha. Yawɛ n-chɛ ka saa sagbana zaani mira, ka di chɛ ka sokam puri bindira niŋda.
en: Ask the Lord for rain in the spring of the year. It is the Lord who sends rain clouds and showers, making the fields green for everyone.

dag: O daa piila tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣ shɛli din viɛla n-leeg o dini; dama nimaani ka bɛ daa zaŋ zali sapashin kpɛma. O daa ka niriba maa zuɣulaannim sanna. O daa zaŋ Yawɛ fukumsi zaligunim min o ni daa zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa ti Izraɛlnim pahi la tum tuma.
en: Your leaders met together and chose the best land for your tribe, but you obeyed the Lord and helped the other tribes.

dag: A ku chɛ ka sula a wuni Chɛmɔshi ni zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti a ni a su la? Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgban shɛŋa zaa ti ti la, ka ti mi su li.
en: Are you going to try to take it back? You can keep whatever your god Chemosh has given you. But we are going to keep everything that the Lord , our God, has taken for us.

dag: m bilim ni ka bɛ pun nahindi ma pam. Amaa bɛ bi tooi nyaŋ ma.
en: Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! But they have not defeated me.

dag: Ŋun tumdi din bi tuhi ni ti deela o ni tum din bi tuhi shɛli maa laara; dama Naawuni bi yaai so yuri ka chɛ so.
en: And all wrongdoers will be repaid for the wrong things they do, because God judges everyone by the same standard.

dag: O ni kana nti ku padiriba maa, ka zaŋ o tihi puu maa niŋ padir shɛb nuu ni. Niriba maa ni daa wum lala maa ka bɛ yɛli, Naawuni tiligim ti ni ŋ-ŋɔ.
en: He will come and destroy those tenants and give the vineyard to others. When the people heard this, they said, May this never happen.

dag: Bee di yi nyɛla buɣim nyooi so ka buɣim yum maa ti liɣisi zaɣ piɛlli din mooi bee zaɣ piɛlli.
en: If you have a burn that gets infected and turns red or reddish-white.

dag: Ka jintɔriba maa daa lan kpɛhi ba dabiɛm pahi, ka bahi ba ka bɛ chaŋ. Bɛ daa ʒi bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm darigi bɛ tibili, dama bɛ daa zɔrila niriba dabiɛm, sokam zaa ni daa paɣiri Naawuni tuun shɛli din tum ka bɛ nini nya maa zuɣu la.
en: They threatened them further, then released them. Because of public support for Peter and John, they couldnt find a way to punish them. Everyone was praising God for what had happened.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa zaŋ salima dooi naɣibil kɔtomsi zali, ka kɔrigi biŋkɔbigu mal li; ka bɛ suhuri daa paligi pam bɛ ni daa zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali binshɛli maa zuɣu.
en: So the people made an idol that looked like a calf. Then they brought sacrifices to it. They were very happy with what they had made with their own hands.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti labina, salo maa zaa daa yiɣisimi m-puh o ni o paabuna, dama bɛ daa pun yuun o la soli.
en: Everyone had been waiting for Jesus, and when he came back, a crowd was there to welcome him.

dag: Di simdi ni yi chɛ ka dapaɣili kam mali dashɛbira ayi din ni chɛ ka yi zaŋ dapaɣa maa tuɣi taba. Niŋmiya m biɛhigu shee dapaɣa maa zaa lala.
en: with two wooden pegs near the bottom.

dag: Yi bi chaŋ dikiya din lu maa ni ti gu voya shee bee m-mali me gooni ti Izraɛlnima din ni chɛ ka tɔbu ti ku daai li luhi Yawɛ dabisili dali.
en: You havent gone up into the breach or reinforced the wall of the house of Israel, so that it might withstand the battle on the day of the LORD.

dag: Yawɛ yɛm puuni ka o daa nam tiŋgbani ŋɔ. O yɛla baŋbu puuni ka o daa nam zuɣusaa.
en: The Lord created the earth by his wisdom; by his knowledge he set the sky in place.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa yɛli Zara mi, Nyama, n zaŋ anzinfa laɣibaligu tuhili ti a tizɔdoo maa ni di wuhi bɛnkam zaa be a sani mini sokam zaa ni a bi tum taali.
en: Abimelech said to Sarah, I gave your brother Abraham pieces of silver. I did this to show that I am very sorry. I want everyone to see that I did the right thing.

dag: Dama Keenannim mini bɛnkam be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni yi wum li, bɛ ni kana ti teei gil ti, ka kpihim ti birili dunia ŋɔ ni; ka di yi niŋ lala, wula ka a lee yɛn niŋ a yuli din galisi ŋɔ.
en: The Canaanites and the whole population of the land will hear of it. They will surround us and make our name disappear from the earth. What will you do about your great name then.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Miri ka a yɛli so di yɛla; amaa cham ti zaŋ amaŋ wuhi maligumaana, ka mali sara shɛli Anabi Musa ni daa sab zali zaŋ chaŋ kɔŋ tibbu polo la; dina n-ni niŋ a kpaŋbu maa shɛhira niriba sani.
en: Jesus said to him, Dont say anything to anyone. Instead, go and show yourself to the priest and offer the gift that Moses commanded. This will be a testimony to them.

dag: Dinzuɣu Izraɛlnima, N ni darigi yi tibili, ka n ni yɛn niŋ ya lala maa zuɣu, malimiya shili gu man ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: So, Israel, this is what I will do to you. You people of Israel, prepare to meet your God.

dag: Ka a napɔŋ yi chɛ ka a yɛn birigi tum alahichi, nyin ŋmaam li bahi, dama a yi kɔŋ a napɔn yini ka ti be, di so ni a mali napɔna ayi ka bɛ ti zaŋ a kpɛhi buɣim din bi kpiri ni, .
en: If your foot makes you sin, cut it off. It is better for you to lose part of your body and have eternal life than to have two feet and be thrown into hell.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka o zɔri ninvuɣ so o ni bɔri nambɔɣu, ka chɛ ka o ni bɔri ninvuɣ so mi suhu kul kpɛma.
en: So then, God has mercy on whomever he wants to, but he makes resistant whomever he wants to.

dag: Ŋunkam deei liɣiri ka ku ŋun ka taali, noli din dim o. Ka sokam yɛli, Ami.
en: The Levites will say, Cursed is the one who takes money to kill an innocent person! Then all the people will say, Amen.

dag: Di yi pa lala ŋuni n-lee ni wuhi ni n nyɛla ʒirilana, ka wuhi ni n ni yɛli shɛm maa kani.
en: If I haven't spoken the truth, then prove me wrong.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Cham ti yɛli Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn zaŋla tiŋ ŋɔ niŋ Babilɔn naa nuu ni, ka o nyo li buɣim.
en: The LORD, the God of Israel, proclaims, Go and speak to Judahs King Zedekiah and say to him: The LORD proclaims, Im handing this city over to the king of Babylon, and he will burn it down.

dag: N ni chɛ ka o zaŋ o nuu pa teeku zuɣu; ka chɛ ka o zaŋ o nudirigu pa mɔɣa zuɣu.
en: I will let him rule the lands across the rivers and seas.

dag: Miriya ka yi zura bee n-niŋdi tab bilikɔnsi bee ŋ-ŋmar tab ʒiri.
en: You must not steal. You must not cheat people. You must not lie to each other.

dag: Ti mabihi, teemiya ti ni daa tum ni ti yaa tariga ka di wahala shɛm la yɛla. Ti daa kul tumdimi wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa ni di chɛ ka ti yɛla ku muɣisi ya ka ti tooi yihi lahibal suŋ din yi Naawuni sanna la waazu tin ya.
en: My dear friends, you surely haven't forgotten our hard work and hardships. You remember how night and day we struggled to make a living, so we could tell you God's message without being a burden to anyone.

dag: Ka n daa ti yɛli piɛri maa, N ku lan nyɛ yi gula. Yi ni bɛn yɛn kpi, kpima; ka bɛn yɛn bahi yoli, bahi yoli; ka chɛ bɛn kpalim ka bɛ ŋmaligi ŋub taba.
en: Then I said to the flock, I will not be your shepherd any longer. Let those die who are to die. Let those be destroyed who are to be destroyed. Those who are left will destroy one another.

dag: Wummiya, yinim bɛn yɛra, Zuŋɔ bee biɛɣuni ti ni chaŋ tiŋ yaakaza nti be nimaani yuun muni n-wolindi nyari nyɔri la.
en: You should know better than to say, Today or tomorrow we will go to the city. We will do business there for a year and make a lot of money.

dag: Ka yɛdaniŋdib bɛn daa be Bɛria daa dii chɛ ka Pool chaŋ teeku noli, amaa ka Silas mini Timoti bɛn daa kpalim nimaani.
en: At once the believers sent Paul away to the coast; but both Silas and Timothy stayed in Berea.

dag: A dabili Dauda zuɣu, di zaɣis a ni pii na so ŋɔ.
en: And for the sake of your servant David, do not reject your anointed one.

dag: dama n suhu kul yɛmi ni n nyan ya n-zaŋ Naawuni Shia Kasi pin shɛli kpaŋsi ya.
en: I want to see you and share with you the same blessings that God's Spirit has given me. Then you will grow stronger in your faith.

dag: Puhimi Prisila mini Akuila ni Onɛsifɔrus yiŋnima.
en: I send greetings to Priscilla and Aquila and to the family of Onesiphorus.

dag: Ka o daa lan ŋahi ba ŋaha ŋɔ yɛli, So ku saɣi zaŋ tan palli din na bi tiri liɣi binyɛr kurili, dama o yi niŋ lala, tan palli maa ni yaai di ko cheei ka chɛ binyɛr kurili maa, ka di maan chɛhi pahi.
en: No one uses a piece of new cloth to patch up an old coat, because the new patch will shrink and tear off some of the old cloth, making an even bigger hole.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga bol o yuli Samuɛl, dama Hanna daa yɛlimi, N suh o la Yawɛ sani.
en: So it was that she became pregnant and gave birth to a son. She named him Samuel, and explained, I asked the Lord for him.

dag: O daa yila Bɛtilihɛm din be Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa n-chani bɔri luɣ shɛli ni o ʒini. Ka o daa chaŋchaŋ ti kana ti kpɛla Maika ŋun daa be Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya zuɣu maa yiŋa.
en: He left Bethlehem to find another place to live. While he was traveling, he came to Micah's house in the hill country of Ephraim.

dag: amaa chamiyala Izraɛlnim bɛn bɔrigi kaman piɛri la sani.
en: Go instead to the lost sheep, the people of Israel.

dag: Ŋunkam deei liɣiri ka ku ŋun ka taali, noli din dim o. Ka sokam yɛli, Ami.
en: Cursed is anyone who accepts money to kill an innocent person. All the people will reply: We agree.

dag: Sana daa ʒi n-gbe samban ni, n daa kul yoola n dunoya ti sochandiba.
en: A stranger didnt spend the night in the street; I opened my doors to the road.

dag: Ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ zani dabari, ka lan ka buchi shɛli. Di saha ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. Dama a yɛliya, Nail nyɛla n ni su shɛli, mani n-daa gbi li.
en: Egypt will become an empty wasteland. Then you will know that I am the Lord . Because you said that the Nile is yours and you made it.

dag: Bɛ yi ti bi niŋ a yɛda bee n-zaɣisi ni bɛ dihi a ni tuui niŋ shɛli ŋɔ tabili; di pa shɛli bɛ ni niŋ din pahi ayi ŋɔ yɛda.
en: Then the Lord said, If no one believes either of these miracles, take some water from the Nile River and pour it on the ground. The water will immediately turn into blood.

dag: Ti Duuma yi di bi filim di dabisa maa, so naan ti ku tiligi; amaa o ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn nyɛ o ni pii shɛb la zuɣu, o filim di dabisa maa.
en: If the Lord doesn't make the time shorter, no one will be left alive. But because of his chosen and special ones, he will make the time shorter.

dag: M mi ni n chandi nyaaŋa ninvuɣ kundun biɛri ni ti kana ti kpe yi ni, ka ku chɛ Naawuni piɛri maa.
en: I know that after I leave, fierce wolves will come among you, and they will not spare the flock.

dag: M mabihi, m bɔri ni n zaŋla ninsala yɛla buɣisi yɛlli ŋɔ: Ninsalinim yi laɣim lo alikauli ka zani di nyaaŋa, so ku tooi saɣim li bee m-pahi shɛli di zuɣu.
en: My friends, I will use an everyday example to explain what I mean. Once someone agrees to something, no one else can change or cancel the agreement.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira nyaandoliba daa ti ka Yisa sanna nti bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka ti mini Farisiinim lɔri noli, ka nyin nyaandoliba bi lɔra.
en: Some followers of John the Baptist came and asked Jesus, Why do we and the Pharisees often go without eating, while your disciples never do.

dag: Yawɛ daa ti ma laara n wuntitali zuɣu; o yo ma samli n ni ka galimi zuɣu.
en: The Lord rewards me because I do what is right; he blesses me because I am innocent.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, nyini Ayuba, wummi n yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, ka gbilisi tibili wum n yɛtɔɣa maa zaa.
en: And now, Job, listen carefully to all that I have to say.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa lan chɛ ka bɛ mali daanya daantalis ayi, zaɣ yini kam wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita pinaanu, ka bɛ daa mali zuɣuri tamtam di zuɣu, ka zuɣu yini kam wɔɣilim daa nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla; ka bɛ daa zaŋ li sa duu maa tooni.
en: Then he made two columns in front of the temple, fifty-two and a half feet high, with a seven and a half foot cap on top of each.

dag: ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka palo pɔri ni bɛ zaa tooi laɣim be nimaani; dama bɛ ni daa su binshɛŋa daa galisiya pam, lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa naan ku tooi laɣim be luɣ yini.
en: They had so many possessions between them that the land couldnt support both of them. They could no longer live together.

dag: O daɣiri maa daa yila palo, ka o baɣa daa ka yɛl shɛŋa din yɛn paag o ni. O lubu maa daa mali alahiziba, ka so daa kani ŋun ni maag o suhu. Yawɛ, lihimi n ni nyari nahiŋgu shɛm, dama n dimnim di nasara.
en: Her sins had made her filthy, but she wasn't worried about what could happen. And when Jerusalem fell, it was so tragic. No one gave her comfort when she cried out, Help! I'm in trouble, Lord ! The enemy has won.

dag: O miri ka o di binshɛlikam din yi wain tia zuɣu na bee n-nyu wain bee n-nyu binnyuri kpiɔŋ bee n-di binshɛli din chihiri dibu. Chɛ ka o doli n ni zal o shɛlikam maa zaa.
en: She must not consume anything that comes from the grapevine, drink wine or brandy, or eat anything that is ritually unclean. She must be careful to do everything I have commanded her.

dag: ka bantabiga din daa vili Yisa zuɣu la gba kpabikpabi do di ko ha ka chɛ bimpiɛlli maa.
en: He also saw the cloth that had been around Jesus head. It was folded up and laid in a different place from the pieces of linen.

dag: Di saha maa ka bɛ daa kpuɣ kuɣa ni bɛ lab Yisa, ka o ŋoli yi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: When he said this, they picked up stones to throw at him. But Jesus hid, and then he left the Temple area.

dag: O ni daa di nam ti paai yuma anahi ni gol so ŋun pahir ayi daba ayi dali ka o daa piligi duu maa mɛbu.
en: in the second month of the fourth year that he was king.

dag: Ka Balaam garigi yɛl o, N di yɛli Yawɛ ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛli niŋ n nol ni..
en: Balaam answered, I can say only what the Lord tells me.

dag: Tiŋ ŋɔ niriba zaa kul tahirimi. Bɛ kul malila suhupiɛlli ka yɔri vuri. Yi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpi pala bɛ ni zaŋ takɔb ku shɛba, bɛ mi pala bɛn kpi tɔbu ni.
en: Your city is filled with noisy shouts. Those who lie drunk in your streets were not killed in battle.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka m ma daa gbani dɔɣi ma? Bee bɔzuɣu ka o daa mɔɣisi ma bihim?.
en: Why was I accepted and allowed to nurse at my mother's breast?.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa yi Kadɛshi m-mali ti paai Hɔr Zoli gbini.
en: After the Israelites had left Kadesh and had gone as far as Mount Hor.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa na ti zali di zaashee Dauda ni daa pun chɛ ka bɛ ti suɣ shɛli zal li la puuni. Ka Dauda daa mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la mini suhudoo sara maligu Yawɛ tooni.
en: They put the chest inside a tent that David had set up for it. David worshiped the Lord by sacrificing animals and burning them on an altar.

dag: Ka o daa lan wurim bɛ ni daa me binshɛli zali nayili Vuhim Dabisili zuɣu la, ka ŋari Yawɛ jɛmbu duu sambani polo duno shɛli bɛ ni daa chib ti naa ni o doli kpɛr la. Asiria naa zuɣu ka o daa niŋ shɛm maa.
en: He also took away the sabbath canopy that had been built in the temple. He removed the royal entrance outside the LORDs temple. This was done because of the Assyrian king.

dag: Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Ti mi ka biɛhiŋ kani ni Yawɛ be a sani, dinzuɣu chɛ ka ti min a laɣim lo tab alikauli.
en: They said, We now see that the LORD was with you. We propose that there be a formal agreement between us and that we draw up a treaty with you.

dag: Ka naa daa po pɔri yɛli Shimɛi, A ku kpi.
en: Then the king said to Shimei, You will not die. The king made a promise to Shimei that he himself would not kill Shimei.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ ni ninsalinim zaa baŋ Yawɛ yiko ni galisi shɛm. Ka di chɛ ka yi lu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sizuura sahakam.
en: because he wants everyone on earth to know how powerful he is. And he wants us to worship only him.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Anabi Musa ba min o ma daa dɔɣ o n-zaŋ o sɔɣi chir muna ata ka bi zo dabiɛm ni bɛ zaɣisi naa zaligu, dama bɛ daa nyaya ka bia maa nyɛla bi viɛlli.
en: Because Moses' parents had faith, they kept him hidden until he was three months old. They saw that he was a beautiful child, and they were not afraid to disobey the king's orders.

dag: Sulemaana daa laɣim chɛchɛbunsi mini wɔribariba. O daa malila chɛchɛbunsi tuhili ni kɔbisinahi mini wɔribariba tuhi pinaayi, ka daa zaŋ chɛchɛbunsi maa shɛŋa zali tin shɛŋa ni, ka zaŋ di shɛŋa mi zali Jɛrusalɛm ŋun naa sani.
en: Solomon had , chariots and , horses that he kept in Jerusalem and other towns.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ bɛ zaa alahiziba, ka dabiɛm kpe ba pam, ka bɛ paɣiri Naawuni yɛra, Ti nya alahiziba tuuni zuŋɔ.
en: All the people were beside themselves with wonder. Filled with awe, they glorified God, saying, Weve seen unimaginable things today.

dag: Pita ni daa baŋ lala maa, ka o chaŋ Jɔn ŋun yuli lan booni Maak la ma Mariama yiŋa. Niriba pam n-daa laɣim be nimaani suhiri Naawuni.
en: Then Peter went to the house of Mary the mother of John whose other name was Mark. Many of the Lord's followers had come together there and were praying.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni yɛli shɛm la: Yi yi wum Naawuni kukoli zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, yin miriya ka yi niŋ tipawumlinima kaman bɛ ni daa niŋ shɛm taai duŋ la.
en: Thats why the Spirit said, If you hear Gods voice today, dont be stubborn as in the past when you turned against God. Psalm :-.

dag: Chɛliya ka Masia yɛligu ba jila yi suhuri ni pam. Wuhimiya taba ka kpammiya tab jaande yɛm zaa puuni, ka zaŋmiya adiini yila mini Naawuni paɣibu yila ni Yila litaafi ni yila n-yiini paɣiri Naawuni yi suhuri ni.
en: Let the message about Christ completely fill your lives, while you use all your wisdom to teach and instruct each other. With thankful hearts, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs to God.
