dag: Tiŋgbɔŋ maa tintariga ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nuzaa polo, di ti yɛn zaŋla Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku noli n-doli Hɛtilɔn nti gari Lɛbɔhamat n-zaŋ hal ni Zɛdad.
en: These are the borders of the land: On the north side, it goes from the Mediterranean Sea by way of Hethlon where the road turns toward Hamath and on to Zedad.

dag: Ifriim zuliya mini bɛ daŋ niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Shutɛla daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Shutɛlanima; ka Bɛcha daŋ niriba nyɛ Bɛchanima; ka Tahan mi daŋ niriba nyɛ Tahannima.
en: There were , men from the tribe of Ephraim son of Joseph; they were from the clans of Shuthelah, Becher, Tahan, and Eran the son of Shuthelah.

dag: Amaa niriba biɛla be yinim Saadisinim ni n-na bi gabisi bɛ binyɛra. M mini ba ni ye binyɛr piɛla n-laɣim dol taba, dama bɛ simdi lala.
en: But you do have a few people in Sardis who havent stained their clothing. They will walk with me clothed in white because they are worthy.

dag: Dama a bi bɔri sara; ka n yi mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la, a nini ku tiɣi li.
en: You do not want sacrifices, or I would offer them; you are not pleased with burnt offerings.

dag: Amaa ka o yɛl o ba maa, Nyama, man ŋun kul be a sani nahindi yuun bɔbili ŋɔ zaa ka na ʒi n-zaɣis a noli ŋɔ, a na ʒi n-gbaai hal bubil gba ti ma ni n kɔrigi ka m mini n zɔnim laɣim di ka diɛm.
en: He answered his father, Look, Ive served you all these years, and I never disobeyed your instruction. Yet youve never given me as much as a young goat so I could celebrate with my friends.

dag: Ka niriba daa yi n-chaŋ ni bɛ ti nya din niŋ maa, ka daa paai Yisa sani nti nya alizin biɛri ni daa ʒi do so zuɣu maa, ka o leela ninvuɣ maŋli n-ye situra ʒi Yisa tooni; ka dabiɛm daa kpe ba pam.
en: People came to see what had happened. They came to Jesus and found the man from whom the demons had gone. He was sitting at Jesus feet, fully dressed and completely sane. They were filled with awe.

dag: Di ni sab Naawuni Kundi ni shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: So pa wuntizɔra, hal ninvuɣ yino gba kani.
en: The Scriptures tell us, No one is acceptable to God!.

dag: Hal n yi yɛli ni n nya wahala pam, n kul gbibila yɛda.
en: I have remained faithful, even when I said, I am suffering so badly.

dag: Di bi simdi ni bɛ deei Ammɔn nira bee Mɔab nira niŋ Yawɛ niriba laɣiŋgu ni hal kul zaŋ ti paai ʒiɛmani din pahiri bupia ni, soli kani ni bɛ deei bɛ zuliya niŋ Yawɛ niriba laɣiŋgu ni.
en: No Ammonite or Moabite—or any of their descendants, even in the tenth generation—may be included among the Lord 's people.

dag: Ka o yi ti ʒin o nam ʒiishee, ŋun chɛ ka bɛ yaai zaligu ŋɔ niŋ litaafi ni Lɛvinim bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la ninni ti o.
en: When he becomes king, he is to have a copy of the book of God's laws and teachings made from the original copy kept by the levitical priests.

dag: Ilaisha kum dɔro ni daa ti gbaag o saha shɛli, ka Izraɛl Naa Jɛhɔash daa chaŋ o sani nti ʒi o tooni kumdi yɛra, M ba! M ba! Izraɛl chɛchɛbunsi ni di wɔribariba.
en: Some time before the death of King Jehoash, Elisha the prophet was very sick and about to die. Jehoash went in and stood beside him, crying. He said, Master, what will Israel's chariots and cavalry be able to do without you.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa gbaai Sool zaŋ chaŋ Dauda polo, dama Yawɛ daa chɛ ŋun Sool, ka bela Dauda sani.
en: Saul was afraid of David because the Lord was with David but had abandoned him.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam chɛ o yili bee o paɣa bee o mabi dɔbba bee o ba min o mabihi Naawuni nam zuɣu.
en: Jesus said to them, I assure you that anyone who has left house, husband, wife, brothers, sisters, parents, or children because of Gods kingdom.

dag: N yi teei dahin shɛli ha yɛla, n suhu saɣindimi. Dina n-nyɛ: m mini salo ni daa yi doli chani Naawuni jɛmbu duu, ka mani n-nyɛ bɛ toondan la. Bɛ mi daa yi nyɛla salo bɛn mali suhupiɛlli yiini yila, ka duhiri bɛ yɛhi m-paɣiri Naawuni.
en: But I remember these things as I bare my soul: how I made my way to the mighty ones abode, to Gods own house, with joyous shouts and thanksgiving songs— a huge crowd celebrating the festival!.

dag: Ka Naa Sool daa yɛli Samuɛl, N doli Yawɛ yɛligu maa, n chaŋ Yawɛ timsim maa, n gbaai Amalɛknim Naa Agag na ka ku Amalɛknim maa zaa.
en: But I did obey the LORD! Saul protested to Samuel. I went on the mission the LORD sent me on. I captured Agag the Amalekite king, and I put the Amalekites under the ban.

dag: Ka do so daa be nimaani n-garigi bɔhi ba, Ka anabinim maa ba lee nyɛ ŋuni? Dinzuɣu lala yɛtɔɣili maa daa leei yɛtɔɣ ŋahili ka bɛ mal li yɛra, Sool gba nyɛla anabi.
en: A man living in Gibeath Elohim said, Yes, and it seems that he is their leader. That is why this became a famous saying: Is Saul also one of the prophets.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa zaŋ naŋgbammalisim yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ dol o hal ka o ti saɣi. O yɛtɔɣ nyaɣisa maa ka o daa zaŋ gbaag o.
en: And so, she tricked him with all of her sweet talk and her flattery.

dag: Ka o daa paɣi bimbiɛhi mini namanama n-zaŋ li pahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim maa zuɣu n-nyo li buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: Then he washed the internal organs and the hind legs and burned them on the altar on top of the rest of the burnt offering.

dag: Ka Jɔtam daa ti kani, ka bɛ zaŋ o sɔɣi pah o yaannim zuɣu o yab Dauda tiŋ la ni; ka o bia Ahaz daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Jotham died and was buried with his ancestors in Davids City. His son Ahaz succeeded him as king.

dag: dama zuliya kam pun nyu o kɔr biɛri wain la, ka dunia nanim niŋ zina o sani, ka dunia kɔhigɔriba niŋ bundaannima o kɔr biɛri din galisi pam maa zuɣu.
en: For all the nations have drunk her wine—the strong wine of her immoral lust. The kings of the earth practiced sexual immorality with her, and the merchants of the world grew rich from her unrestrained lust.

dag: Dama o chɛ ka sanʒiɛɣu ʒe n-kabisi ma, ka kul chɛ ka n dansi pahira, ka di ka daliri.
en: He would just send storms to crush me. He would give me more wounds for no reason.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Ilaisha daa ti chaŋ Shunɛm ka paɣ bundaan so daa be nimaani m-balim o ni o dim bindirigu. Dinzuɣu o daa yi ti doli nimaani polo saha shɛlikam, o kpɛrila yili maa ni ti diri bindirigu.
en: One day Elisha went to Shunem, where an important woman lived. She asked Elisha to stop and eat at her house. So every time Elisha went through that place, he stopped there to eat.

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu, ka o chɛ ka Siria Naa Hazaɛl min o bia Bɛnhadad kul tuhiri nyandi ba waawaayili.
en: So the LORD was angry at Israel. Time after time God handed them over to Arams king Hazael, and to Hazaels son Ben-hadad.

dag: Niriba ayi noya yi bi pa taba, bɛ ni tooi laɣim doli?.
en: Can two people walk together without agreeing to meet?.

dag: ka Farisiinim mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba daa ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni yɛra, Doo ŋɔ kul chɛri ka alahichinim kanila o sanna hal ka o mini ba ti laɣindi dira.
en: the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law started grumbling, This man welcomes outcasts and even eats with them.

dag: Naawuni n-daa neei ti Duuma kum ni, ka ni ti neei ti gba kum ni o yiko ni.
en: God raised the Lord from death, and he will also raise us by his power.

dag: O ni ti kari zuliya ni zuliya yɛla saria ka mali niriba pam yɛla ti ba. Bɛ ni ti zaŋ bɛ takɔbiri kuri naɣikɔra kubiɛlima, ka zaŋ bɛ kpana kuri gɔriti. Ka zuliya ni zuliya ti ku lan zaŋ takɔbiri tuhi taba bee m-bɔhim tɔb tuhibu yaha.
en: He will settle disputes among great nations. They will hammer their swords into plows and their spears into pruning knives. Nations will never again go to war, never prepare for battle again.

dag: Dama zaligu maa nyɛla firila, ka wuhibu maa mi nyɛ neesim, ka zuɣu ni kpahibu din wuhiri biɛrisuŋ la mi nyɛ nyɛvili.
en: Their instructions are a shining light; their correction can teach you how to live.

dag: Naa Zɛdɛkia mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa ni daa lo alikauli ni bɛ ni moli faako tibu molo la nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia.
en: Jeremiah received the LORDs word after King Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people in Jerusalem to proclaim liberty for their slaves.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa siɣi zoli maa zuɣu na nti chɛ ka niriba maa paɣi bɛ situra, ka o mali ba ka bɛ be kasi.
en: So Moses climbed down the mountain and went to the people. He got them ready for the special meeting and they washed their clothes.

dag: Ŋuna n-kahigiri yɛl shɛŋa din baŋbu to min ashili yɛla wuhiri niriba; o mi din sɔɣi bumbɔn ni, neesim mi n-gil omaŋmaŋa.
en: You explain deep mysteries, because even the dark is light to you.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, M bia, a yɛda niŋbu n-chɛ ka a kpaŋ. Kulimi ni suhudoo.
en: Daughter, your faith has healed you, Jesus said. Go in peace.

dag: Di chɛ ka n yɛla gbaag a dabiɛm, m bi yɛn nahim a pam.
en: Surely fear of me shouldnt scare you; my pressure on you shouldnt be heavy.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Ahaz yaha.
en: Once again the Lord God spoke to King Ahaz. This time he said.

dag: Ka n ti chɛ ka yi leei maligumaaniba ni zuliya kasi. A ni yɛn yɛli Izraɛlnim maa yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa m-bala.
en: but you will be my holy nation and serve me as priests. Moses, that is what you must tell the Israelites.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, so di lan muɣisiri ma, dama m mali wulɛ shɛŋa din be n niŋgbuŋ ni n-wuhiri ni n nyɛla Yisa ni su so.
en: To conclude: let no one give me any more trouble, because the scars I have on my body show that I am the slave of Jesus.

dag: Ka Sool daa wum Jɔnatan ni yɛl o shɛm maa zaa, ka po pɔri yɛli, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, n ku lan ku o.
en: Saul listened to Jonathan and made a promise. He said, As surely as the Lord lives, David wont be put to death.

dag: Ka Sool daa bɔhi Mikal, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɔhim ma lala n-chɛ ka n dim maa zo n-tiligi? Ka Mikal garigi yɛl o, O yɛli ma mi, Chɛ ka n chaŋ; a yi bi chɛ ka n chaŋ n ni ku a. .
en: Saul asked Michal, Why have you tricked me like this and let my enemy escape? She answered, He said he would kill me if I didn't help him escape.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa nyaŋ Itiɔpianim maa ti Asa mini Judanima ka Itiɔpianim maa daa ŋmaligi guui.
en: So the LORD struck the Cushites before Asa and Judah, and the Cushites fled.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa be o sani, ka o daa yi kul chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam zaa o dirila nasara. O daa zaɣisi Asiria naa jɛmbu.
en: So the Lord was with him, and he was successful in everything he did. He rebelled against the emperor of Assyria and refused to submit to him.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ka Zara sanna nti niŋ o kaman o ni daa pun lo o alikauli yɛli ni o ni niŋ o shɛm la.
en: The Lord blessed Sarah, as he had promised.

dag: Di zaɣisi ma n kuriginsim saha, a mi di chɛ ma bahi n gbariginsim saha.
en: Dont cast me off in old age. Dont abandon me when my strength is used up!.

dag: Dinzuɣu n suhiri ya ni yi dim bindirigu n-nya kpiɔŋ, dama yi ni so zabigu zaɣ yini ku bɔrigi.
en: Now I beg you to eat something. You need it to stay alive. None of you will lose even one hair off your heads.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ niŋbu zuɣu ni chɛ ka bɛn be kpaŋa lun ya sizuura, ka yi mi ku lihiri so ninni ni o dihi ya.
en: In this way you will win the respect of those who are not believers, and you will not have to depend on anyone for what you need.

dag: zaɣ yino ku paai n ni daa po ni n ni chɛ ka yi be tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni la naɣila Jɛfune bia Kalɛb mini Nan bia Jɔshua kɔŋko.
en: will enter the land in which I promised to settle you, with the exception of Caleb, Jephunnehs son, and Joshua, Nuns son.

dag: Chɛ ka n dol a zaligunim soli, dama n suhu yuri li pam.
en: Lead me on the trail of your commandments because that is what I want.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ ni di neen shɛŋa zaa m-pahi ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri.
en: They took all the loot that they had captured, including the prisoners and the animals.

dag: N kul kuhirimi bɔri sɔŋsim hal ni asiba. O bemi kaman gbuɣinli la n-kul ŋmari n kɔba wuntaŋ ni zaŋ hal ni yuŋ, o kul ŋmaarila n nyɛvili.
en: All night I cried out with pain, As if a lion were breaking my bones. I thought that God was ending my life.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Lɛvi bidibisi maa, Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, yi mali yimaŋa m-be kasi ni yi tumdi Yawɛ tuma, yi zaa yinoyino bidibisi mini yi mabihi kubu ŋɔ zuɣu chɛ ka yi nya alibarika zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Moses said to the Levites, Today you have consecrated yourselves as priests in the service of the Lord by killing your sons and brothers, so the Lord has given you his blessing.

dag: Di luhiya ni ti suhuri paligi ka ti diɛm, dama a tizɔbil maa kpimi ka lan neena; o daa bɔrigimi, ka ti lan nya o maa.
en: But we should be glad and celebrate! Your brother was dead, but he is now alive. He was lost and has now been found.

dag: Bɛ lɔri ʒi tibisa din ʒibu to ʒiini niriba, amaa ka bɛmaŋmaŋ ku saɣi zaŋ bɛ nubil gba wuɣi li.
en: They pile heavy burdens on people's shoulders and won't lift a finger to help.

dag: nti yɛl o, N wum a suhigu shɛli a ni suhi ma la. M mali jɛmbu du shɛli a ni me ŋɔ ka di be kasi ni di nyɛ bɛ ni yɛn jɛmdi ma luɣ shɛli sahakam. N kul ni gul li ka chɛ ka n suhu be di ni sahakam.
en: The Lord said to him, I have heard your prayer. I consecrate this Temple which you have built as the place where I shall be worshiped forever. I will watch over it and protect it for all time.

dag: bɛ ni daa bi deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ noli, ka yi o daalikauli la nyaaŋa zaŋ tabili Yawɛ dabili Musa ni daa zali ba zaligu shɛŋa la zaa zuɣu. Bɛ daa zaɣisi li wumbu, ka zaɣisi li dolibu.
en: Samaria fell because the Israelites did not obey the Lord their God, but broke the covenant he had made with them and disobeyed all the laws given by Moses, the servant of the Lord . They would not listen and they would not obey.

dag: Ka bɛ shɛb mi daa baai du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli n-zo nti kpe Gaad mini Giliad tiŋgbana ni. Di saha Naa Sool ŋun daa na bela Giligal, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be o sani maa zaa niŋgbuna ti sɔhira.
en: Some Hebrews even went across the Jordan River to the land of Gad and Gilead. Saul was still at Gilgal. All the men in his army were shaking with fear.

dag: N ni paɣi Yawɛ paɣibu shɛli din nyɛ o dini o wuntitali zuɣu, ka yili yila paɣi ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ yuli.
en: But I will thank the LORD for his righteousness; I will sing praises to the name of the LORD Most High.

dag: Miriya ka yi di ʒiri shɛhira n-jɛndi yi kpee.
en: Do not tell lies about others.

dag: Bee m mini Baanabas kɔŋko n-ka soli ni ti chɛ ti nuhi tuumbaŋsim tuma tum dihi timaŋa?.
en: Or is it only I and Barnabas who dont have the right to not work for our living?.

dag: Maika bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Pitɔn mini Mɛlɛk ni Taria ni Ahaz.
en: Micahs family: Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.

dag: Amaa n yɛri ya mi ni zaadali Sɔdomnim azaaba nyabu ni ti sɔ yi dini.
en: But I tell you, it will be worse for you in the day of judgment than for Sodom.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, chɛ ka a zaŋsim be mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ suhigu ŋɔ ni, ka wum n kuhigu mini n suhigu shɛli mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni suhir a zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: But I ask you to answer my prayer.

dag: Ka yi gba be biɛr yoli n-gari yi yaannim maa ni daa be shɛm maa. Yinim m-bɔŋɔ: yi zaɣ yino kam niŋla tipawumli n-doli zaɣ biɛɣu soli, ka zaɣisi n yɛligu wumbu.
en: And you have done even worse! You are stubborn, and instead of obeying me, you do whatever evil comes to your mind.

dag: dindina n ni teei n ni daa lo Yaakubu mini Yisahaku ni Ibrahimma alikauli shɛŋa la yɛla, ka lan teei tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ yɛla.
en: I'll keep the promise I made to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I will bless your land.

dag: Bɛ nyaŋ Izraɛlnima, bɛ kpalim bela zuliyanim maa sani kaman duɣu kpiŋ din lan ka buchi la.
en: Israel has become like any other nation and is as useless as a broken pot.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa nyaandoliba daa chaŋ ti zani gil o, ka o yiɣisi n-lan kpe tiŋ maa ni n-daa kaai biɛɣu ka o mini Baanabas yi nimaani chaŋ Dɛɛbi.
en: But when the Lord's followers gathered around Paul, he stood up and went back into the city. The next day he and Barnabas went to Derbe.

dag: Nir yi chaŋ kumsi ni be yil shɛli, di so ni o chaŋ dimma ni nyubu ni be yil shɛli. Dinzuɣu di simdi ni bɛn be bɛ nyɛviya ni baŋ ni kum nyɛla din yɛn paai sokam zaa.
en: It is better to go to a home where there is mourning than to one where there is a party, because the living should always remind themselves that death is waiting for us all.

dag: Amaa ka Firawuna yɛli, Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Yawɛ, ka n ni wum o yɛligu ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa chaŋ? M bi mi Yawɛ maa, dinzuɣu n ku chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa chaŋ.
en: Who is the Lord ? the king demanded. Why should I listen to him and let Israel go? I do not know the Lord ; and I will not let Israel go.

dag: Bɛna bɛn zaa nyɛ n niriba maa, mani n-daa nam ba n jilima zuɣu. Bɛ nyɛla n ni nam shɛba.
en: They are my people— I created each of them to bring honor to me.

dag: Ka Ada daa dɔɣi Jabal. Ŋuna n-daa nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tanti suɣa ni ka guli niɣ la yaba.
en: Adah gave birth to Jabal; he was the ancestor of those who live in tents and own livestock.

dag: O ni daa zaŋ ma paai nimaani, do so daa be nimaani ka o niŋgbuŋ daa nyɛlisira kaman daanya la. O daa gbibila mi piɛlli mini bɛ ni zaŋdi binshɛli buɣisiri binyara la o nuu ni. O daa ʒiɛla dunɔdali gbini.
en: He took me closer, and I saw a man who shone like bronze. He was holding a linen tape measure and a measuring rod and was standing by a gateway.

dag: Bum ansarisimaana, ka bɛn bi mi bɔhim yɛm, kpahimi bɛn mali baŋsim zuɣu ni, ka bɛ nya baŋsim pahi.
en: Punish a rude, arrogant person, and even slow learners will become wiser. But just a little correction is enough to teach a person who has understanding.

dag: Ka Ɛhab daa bɔhi Ilaija, Wɛi, n dima, a nya ma? Ka Ilaija garigi yɛl o, A ni lo a suhu ni ni a tum tuun biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ sani maa zuɣu n-chɛ ka n nya a maa.
en: Ahab said to Elijah, So youve found me, my old enemy! I found you, Elijah said, because youve enslaved yourself by doing evil in the LORDs eyes.

dag: m-mali maligu zaŋ li nyo buɣim, ka zaŋ chi mali maligu di zuɣu; ka booi binnyura mali sara di zuɣu; ka lan kɔrig o suhudoo sara maligu biŋkɔbigu n-yih o ʒim bahi bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: and poured wine over it. Then he offered sacrifices to please the Lord , to give him thanks, and to ask for his blessings.

dag: Naa Hanun mini Ammɔnnim maa ni daa baŋ ni bɛ leei Dauda dimnim maa, ka bɛ daa bo anzinfa laɣibaligu din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram tuhi pihitanaanahi n-chaŋ Siria tinsi din nyɛ Mɛsopoteemia mini Arammaaka ni Zɔba ni bɛ ti da chɛchɛbunsi mini di yuri na.
en: King Hanun and the Ammonites realized that they had made David their enemy, so they paid nearly forty tons of silver to hire chariots and charioteers from Upper Mesopotamia and from the Syrian states of Maacah and Zobah.

dag: Dabisili din pah anahi dali, zaŋmiya naɣilahi pia mini piɛlah ayi ni yuun yini piɛlabihi pinaanahi bɛn ka dansi mali sara;.
en: On the fourth day offer ten young bulls, two rams, and fourteen one-year-old male lambs, all without any defects.

dag: mini nolɔɣu ŋun cheena ni bulaa ni na so ŋun be o niriba tooni gamdi giŋgaani.
en: goats, strutting roosters, and kings in front of their people.

dag: Ka di simdi ni ŋun nyo li maa paɣ o situra ka su kom, di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi kpe bɛ sansani maa ni na.
en: Then the man who burns them must wash his clothes and bathe his whole body with water. After that he may come into the camp.

dag: Yawɛ, n tarigimi, zom ma nambɔɣu. Yawɛ, n kɔba ni zaa chɔɣisimi dabiɛm zuɣu, tibimi ma.
en: I am worn out, O Lord ; have pity on me! Give me strength; I am completely exhausted.

dag: Tɔbaya ŋun daa nyɛ Ammɔn nir la daa ʒiɛmi tab o, ka gba daa yɛli, Kuɣa goon shɛli bɛ ni mɛri maa, hal ŋɔɣu yi du n-tam di zuɣu, o ni daai li luhi.
en: Tobiah the Ammonite, who was beside him, added: If even a fox climbs on whatever they build, their wall of stones will crumble.

dag: Bɛ suhuri kul ʒiɛla yim; bɛ ku zo dabiɛm. Di bahigu ni, bɛ ni ti di nasara bɛ dimnim sani.
en: Their hearts are firm; they arent afraid. In the end, they will witness their enemies defeat.

dag: Dama nyamiya, Yawɛ yɛn yila o biɛhigu shee na. O ni ti siɣina ti tam dunia ni daboya zuɣu chana.
en: And he will come down to crush underfoot every pagan altar.

dag: Di saha ka Juda daa chaŋ Yisifu sani ti yɛl o, N dana, n suhir a, chɛ ka mani a dabili ŋɔ tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛli niŋ a tibili ni, a mi di chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi bahi mani a dabili ŋɔ zuɣu, dama a ŋmanila Firawuna maŋmaŋa.
en: Judah went up to Joseph and said, Please, sir, allow me to speak with you freely. Don't be angry with me; you are like the king himself.

dag: n gba ni lan ya yi zaɣ biɛɣu nyabu saha, ka mali ya ansarisi yi dabiɛm saha.
en: So Ill laugh at your disaster; Ill make fun of you when dread comes over you.

dag: Ka ŋun daa zaɣisi, ka chɛ ka bɛ kpɛh o kpee maa duu, ka yɛli ni faashee o yo samli maa zaa.
en: But he refused; instead, he had him thrown into jail until he should pay the debt.

dag: Ka o ti zaŋ Zɛdɛkia kuli Babilɔn, ka o ti be nimaani hal ka n ti lan zaŋ n zaɣa labis o polo. Hal yi yi tuhi Babilɔnnim maa, yi ku di nasara. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.?.
en: Zedekiah will be taken to Babylonia, and he will remain there until I deal with him. Even if he fights the Babylonians, he will not be successful. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Amaa nyin ŋun nyɛ Naawuni nir ŋɔ, gbaam amaŋ ni dimbɔŋɔnim zaa, ka kpaŋ amaŋa m-malila biɛr kasi mini wuntitali ni yɛda ni yurilim ni ania niŋbu ni biɛribaalimtali.
en: But you belong to God. So you should stay away from all those things. Always try to do what is right, to be devoted to God, and to have faith, love, patience, and gentleness.

dag: Ka shɛb daa niŋ o ni yɛli shɛm maa yɛda, ka bɛn kpalim mi biɛhim li.
en: Some of the Jews believed what he said, but others did not believe.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli, Di lan pahi lala! Ka daa zaŋ o nuu shihi doo maa tibili maa ka di lab tabili yaha.
en: But Jesus said, Enough of this! He touched the man's ear and healed him.

dag: Hal di wumdi bipala ka bɛ gbarigira, ka di wumdi nachimba ka bɛ lura.
en: Youths will become tired and weary, young men will certainly stumble.

dag: Ka bɛ daa laɣisi bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu shɛŋa bɛ ni daa ŋub maa zaɣ chɛhi pali piɛri pinaayi.
en: So they gathered up the pieces that were left. The people had started eating with only five loaves of barley bread. But the followers filled twelve large baskets with the pieces of food that were left.

dag: dama di sabiya, Naawuni ni bah o malaikanim noli ka bɛ gbib a ka gul a.
en: For the scripture says, God will order his angels to take good care of you.

dag: A mi ni Nɛr bia Abinɛr maa kamina ni o ti yɔhim a baŋ a ni doli so shɛli yiri min a ni doli so shɛli kpɛra; ka lan baŋ a ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa.
en: He came here to deceive you and to find out everything you do and everywhere you go. Surely you know that.

dag: Dauda ni daa chani Aruna sani ka Aruna nya o, o daa yila kabɔɣili maa ni chaŋ ti damd o tiŋa n-lu o sizuura.
en: When David approached Ornan, Ornan looked up, recognized David, left the threshing floor, and bowed to David with his face to the ground.

dag: Ka o daa boli kɔbiliga maa yuli Shiiba. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ booni tiŋ maa yuli Bɛrishiiba hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: He named the well Vow. That is how the city of Beersheba got its name.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Iyim n-chaŋ ti dɔni Dibɔngaad.
en: They left Iye Abarim and camped at Dibon Gad.

dag: Dauda daa lan tuhi nyaŋ Hadadɛza ŋun daa nyɛ Zɔba naa la, zaŋ labi Hamat polo, o ni daa chaŋ ni o ti zaŋ bini zal o Sulinsi tariga Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli luɣ shɛli la.
en: While King Hadadezer of Zobah was trying to gain control of the territory near the Euphrates River, David met him in battle at Hamath and defeated him.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa tim Taai nti zaŋ Huram na.
en: King Solomon sent for a man named Huram, a craftsman living in the city of Tyre, who was skilled in bronze work.

dag: ka o yina nti yɔhim zuliya kam bɛn be dunia luɣ anahi ŋɔ ni. Bɛna n-nyɛ bɛ ni booni shɛb Gɔg mini Magɔg. O ni ti laɣim ba lo tɔbu; ka bɛ kalinli ni ŋmanila mɔɣ bihigu.
en: He will go out to deceive the nations that are at the four corners of the earth—Gog and Magog. He will gather them for battle. Their number is like the sand of the sea.

dag: saha shɛli zaa n ni na kul vuhira, ka Naawuni shia be n nyɛvoya ni ŋɔ.
en: as long as God gives me breath.

dag: Ka Naa Zɛdɛkia daa tim ti boli Jɛrimia ka o kana Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dunoli din pahir ata la gbini. Ka naa daa yɛli Jɛrimia, N yɛn bɔh a la yɛtɔɣ shɛli, a mi di sɔɣi ma shɛli.
en: On another occasion King Zedekiah had me brought to him at the third entrance to the Temple, and he said, I am going to ask you a question, and I want you to tell me the whole truth.

dag: O ni zali ti shɛm n-nyɛ ni ti niŋ o Bia Yisa Masia yuli yɛda ka yuri taba kaman o ni zali ti shɛm.
en: This is what God commands: that we believe in his Son Jesus Christ, and that we love each other as he commanded.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yi nimaani chaŋ ti kpe Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu.
en: Jesus left and went into one of their synagogues.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka yi yɛn niŋ tipawumli kaman Ijiptinim mini Firawuna ni daa niŋ tipawumli shɛm la? O ni daa chɛ ka bɛ tum jɛrilim la nyaaŋa, pa bɛmaŋmaŋa n-daa ti chɛ ka niriba maa chaŋ?.
en: Dont be stubborn like Pharaoh and the Egyptians. God punished the Egyptians. That is why the Egyptians let the Israelites leave Egypt.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim nyɛla bɛn doli adiini soli kaya, amaa ka lee chihi di yiko. Gbaam amaŋ ni niriba ŋɔ tatabo.
en: They will look like they are religious but deny Gods power. Avoid people like this.

dag: Ŋum paya mi yuli n-daa booni Ɛliɛza, dama o daa yɛlimi, M banim Naawuni n-daa nyɛ n sɔŋda ka tiligi ma Firawuna takɔbi ni.
en: He had also said, The God of my father helped me and saved me from being killed by the king of Egypt; so he had named the other son Eliezer. .

dag: A bia maa ni ti bemi kaman mɔɣu ni buŋ la. O ti ku bɔri so yɛla, ka so gba ti ku bɔr o yɛla; ka o min o dɔɣiriba zaa ti ku tooi laɣim be.
en: Ishmael will be wild and free like a wild donkey. He will be against everyone, and everyone will be against him. He will move from place to place and camp near his brothers.

dag: Ka naa daa zali Jɛrusalɛmnima ni bɛ tim maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim bɛ tarili kaman di ni simdi shɛm din ni chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ zaŋsim zaa niŋ Yawɛ zaligu tuma ni.
en: He ordered the people living in Jerusalem to provide the required portion for the priests and the Levites so they could devote themselves to the LORDs Instruction.

dag: Ka yi nya ka wum ka di pala Ɛfɛsus ŋɔ kɔŋko, amaa Ɛsha tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa ka Pool ŋɔ kul yɛri niriba ni salinim ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali buɣ shɛŋa pala shɛli; lala ka o niŋdi lɛbigiri niriba pam suhuri.
en: But look at what this man Paul is doing. Listen to what he is saying. He has convinced many people in Ephesus and all over Asia to change their religion. He says the gods that people make by hand are not real.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni zaligu sulinsi ʒiɛman ni, kul gbaai yihi bina biɛla kɔŋko, ʒim n-daa yi maani binshɛɣukam din kpalim ka di be kasi; ka ʒim yi bi yi, alahichi chɛ m-paŋ kani.
en: Almost everything is cleansed by blood, according to the Laws regulations, and there is no forgiveness without blood being shed.

dag: Ka n daa niŋ kaman pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga n-wurim ba kpɛhi tinzun tinsi ni din nyɛ luɣ shɛli so ni bi mi ba. Ka tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ daa kpalim zani dabari, ka so bi lan kpɛri di ni gariti yira. Lala ka di daa niŋ ka tiŋgban suŋ maa ti leei so ni ka shɛl ni.
en: I scattered them throughout the nations whom they didnt know. The land was devastated behind them, with no one leaving or returning. They turned a delightful land into a wasteland.

dag: M bia, a yi deei n yɛligu, ka doli n zaligunim din be a suhu ni.
en: My son, accept my words and store up my commands.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnima n-yɛn nyɛ yi zaligunima yi ni yɛn be luɣ shɛlikam yi ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: These rules apply to you and your descendants wherever you may live.

dag: ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti gbaai Yuria Ijipti na ti ti Naa Jɛhoyakim, ka o daa zaŋ takɔbi ku o n-zaŋ ti bahi tintarimba gbala ni.
en: They brought Uriah back from Egypt to the king who had him killed, and his body was thrown into the common burial ground.

dag: Amaa ka o yidan maa daa dol o kuhiri hal ni Bahurim. Ka Abinɛr daa ti yɛl o, Ŋmaligi lab kuli, ka o daa lab kuli.
en: Paltiel followed Michal and the men all the way to Bahurim, crying as he walked. But he went back home after Abner ordered him to leave.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yimaŋmaŋ nya n ni daa chɛ ka alɔbo lu Jɛrusalɛm mini Juda fɔntinsi ni shɛm. Lihimiya li, zuŋɔ di zaa leela dabari, ka so lan ka di ni.
en: The LORD of heavenly forces, the God of Israel, proclaims: You have seen the disaster I brought on Jerusalem and the towns of Judah. They are now a wasteland with no one left.

dag: ka dabiɛm kpe ba, ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ zuɣuri silim tiŋa. Ka dɔbba ayi maa bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bɔri ninvuɣ nɛɔŋ kpiimba ni?.
en: The women were very afraid. They bowed down with their faces to the ground. The men said to them, Why are you looking for a living person here? This is a place for dead people.

dag: O daa tuhi deei Izraɛl tintariga tinsi Lɛbohamat dunol shee zaŋ hal ti paai Araba Teeku ni kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa chɛ ka o dabili anabi Jona Amitai bia ŋun daa yi Gatihɛfa la na yɛli shɛm la.
en: Jeroboam took back Israels land, which ran from the Lebo Hamath to the Arabah Sea. This happened as the Lord of Israel had told his servant Jonah son of Amittai, the prophet from Gath Hepher.

dag: Naa ŋun yuli booni Yawɛ, ka o nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Ŋun yɛn wurim Mɔabnim fɔntinsi ka ku bɛ nachimbihi viɛla la kana.
en: Moab and its cities are destroyed; its finest young men have been slaughtered. I am the king, the Lord Almighty, and I have spoken.

dag: Din bahindi nyaaŋa nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: Maliya yaa ti Duuma min o kpiɔŋ ni o yiko ni.
en: Finally, let the mighty strength of the Lord make you strong.

dag: Ka ti zaŋ ti zaa yinoyino ni nya salima binshɛŋa din nyɛ nuhi ni bansi ni zoligɔnim ni nintuhi din dihiri gbana zuɣu ni tibikpara ni yɛri na ni ti ti mali sara ti daalahichi zuɣu Yawɛ sani.
en: We have brought the LORDs offering that each found, gold articles—anklets, bracelets, signet rings, earrings, and necklaces—to seek reconciliation for ourselves before the LORD.

dag: Gbilisimiya tibili viɛnyɛliŋga n-wum n yɛtɔɣa, ka chɛliya ka n ni tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ŋɔ kpe yi tiba ni.
en: Listen closely to my words so that my remarks will be in your ears.

dag: Ka yi ni ti no ninvuɣ biɛri maa sɔŋ tiŋa, dama bɛ ni ti ŋmanila tampiligim n-do yi naba ni dahin shɛli n yi ti tum n tuma maa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: When I come to bring justice, you will trample those who are evil, as though they were ashes under your feet. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ŋmanila kom din kpe nti taɣi ninsal yɛno tariga n-kpe Juda tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ti ʒi binshɛɣukam zaa chaŋ. Bɛ ni ti yɛrigi nyin Imanuɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: Enemy soldiers will cover Judah like a flood reaching up to your neck. But God is with us. He will spread his wings and protect our land.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabihi, Naawuni ni zɔn ya nambɔɣu zuɣu, n kpamdi ya jaande ni yi zaŋ yi niŋgbuna kaman sar nɛɔŋ din be kasi ka tiɣiri Naawuni nini la n-ti ŋun Naawuni. Dina n-nyɛ jɛmbu maŋli Naawuni sani.
en: So then, my friends, because of God's great mercy to us I appeal to you: Offer yourselves as a living sacrifice to God, dedicated to his service and pleasing to him. This is the true worship that you should offer.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa lan laɣim maligumaaniba kpamba mini zuɣulaannima ni salo maa zaa na.
en: Pilate called together the chief priests, the leaders, and the people.

dag: A ni daa darigi n tibili maa, di viɛla. Di ni chɛ ka m baŋ a zaligunim maa yɛla.
en: When you corrected me, it did me good because it taught me to study your laws.

dag: Molimi molo Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm yɛli: Piɛbimi kikaa gili tiŋgbani maa ni, ka tahiri pampam yɛra, Laɣimmiya taba ka ti chaŋ ti kpe bɛ ni me goma gili fɔntin shɛŋa ni.
en: Sound the trumpets, my people. Warn the people of Judah, Run for your lives!.

dag: Ka bɛn daa ʒi nimaani maa zaa mirigi bɛ nina kpa o, ka nya o ninni ka di ŋmanila malaika ninni.
en: Everyone there in the council meeting was staring at Stephen. They saw that his face looked like the face of an angel.

dag: Man Yawɛ ni kpɛh o dabiɛm, ka di chɛ ka o wum vu shɛli damli ka ŋmaligi lab omaŋmaŋ tiŋgban ni, ka n ti chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi ku o omaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Look, I will send a spirit against the king of Assyria. He will get a report that will make him return to his own country. And I will cut him down with a sword in his own country.

dag: N daa wurim ba kpɛhi zuliya shɛli ni, ka bɛ ti wurim kpe tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni, ka n daa kari ba saria kaman bɛ tuma mini bɛ biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: I condemned them for the way they lived and acted, and I scattered them through foreign countries.

dag: Bɛ daa lan pii Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba kɔbisiyi ni pisi bɛn yaannim daa nyɛ Naa Dauda min o kpambaliba ni daa pii shɛb zali ni bɛ sɔŋdi Lɛvinim la. Ka bɛ daa sab bɛ zaa yinoyino yuya sɔŋ.
en: Besides these, there were Temple workers whose ancestors had been chosen by David and his officials to help the Levites. The names of all these men were written on the list.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nya din niŋ maa yɛli sokam din daa niŋ alizin biɛri ni daa ʒi do so zuɣu maa mini kuruchunim maa.
en: Everyone who had seen what had happened told about the man and the pigs.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ timmi laɣim Izraɛlnim zaa mini Baal anabinim kɔbisinahi ni pihinu ni Ashɛra anabinim kɔbisinahi bɛn diri Jɛzibɛl yiŋ la n-zaŋ ba ka n sanna Kamɛl Zoli zuɣu.
en: Now send a message and gather all Israel to me at Mount Carmel. Gather the four hundred fifty prophets of Baal and the four hundred prophets of Asherah who eat at Jezebels table.

dag: Teemiya n dabili Musa wuhibu la yɛla; n ni daa zal o zali kpan shɛŋa mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi Sinai Zoli gbini ni o zaŋ ti Izraɛlnim zaa la.
en: Remember the teachings of my servant Moses, the laws and commands which I gave him at Mount Sinai for all the people of Israel to obey.

dag: Naawuni n-chɛ ka n suhu ŋooi; Kpiɔŋlan Naa n-chɛ ka dabiɛm gbaai ma.
en: makes me tremble with fear.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa yɛli, M malila yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni n yɛl a. Ka Batishiiba yɛl o, Yɛlima.
en: I have something to say to you. She said, Say it.

dag: Varanda shɛli din daa be wulinluhili polo la, niriba anahi n-daa ʒe di palli zuɣu, ka niriba ayi mi ʒe di samban ni gul li.
en: There were four guards at the western court and two guards on the road to the court.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Jɛrusalɛm leei tampuli, ka leei kunduna biɛhigu shee. N ni chɛ ka Juda fɔndi zan dabari, ka so ku lan be di ni.
en: The Lord says, I will make the city of Jerusalem a pile of garbage. It will be a home for jackals. I will destroy the cities in the land of Judah, so no one will live there.

dag: Yi ni yɛn niŋ shɛm ku li m-bɔŋɔ: Ŋunkam samli dol o ʒiʒiinikpee, ŋun kum li, ka di lan yɛli ni o ʒiʒiinikpee maa yom li, dama bɛ moli Yawɛ ni zali ni bɛ kum sama saha shɛli molo.
en: This is how the cancellation is to be handled: Creditors will forgive the loans of their fellow Israelites. They wont demand repayment from their neighbors or their relatives because the LORDs year of debt cancellation has been announced.

dag: Ka zama maa zaa daa jɛm Naawuni, ka baansi yiini yila, ka kikapiɛbiriba piɛbira hal ka buɣim ti di sara maligu binyara maa naai.
en: All the assembly bowed down, the musicians sang, and the trumpet players blew their trumpets until the burnt offering was finished.

dag: Ka n yɛri ya mi ni yi ku lan nya ma hal ni saha shɛli yi ni ti yɛn yɛli, Ŋun mali ti Duuma yuli kanna ŋɔ mal alibarika. .
en: I tell you, you wont see me until you say, Blessings on the one who comes in the Lords name .

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, piim ninvuɣ so ŋun mali dahin shɛli tɛha ni yɛm n-zaŋ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ yɛla niŋ o nuu ni.
en: Your Majesty, you should find someone who is wise and will know what to do, so that you can put him in charge of all Egypt.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa ka o sanna ti yɛl o, Nyin ŋun nyɛ suhukpeendana ni kpiɔŋlan ŋɔ, Yawɛ be a sani.
en: The Lord 's angel appeared to him there and said, The Lord is with you, brave and mighty man.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa yɛli ba, Chamiya Bɛtilihɛm nti bo bia maa viɛnyɛliŋga; yi yi ti nya o ni be shɛli, yin labimiyana ti yɛli ma, ka n gba chaŋ ti jɛm o.
en: Then he sent them to Bethlehem. He said, Go and look carefully for the child. When you find him, come tell me. Then I can go worship him too.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira nyaandoliba mini Farisiinim daa ti lɔri noli; ka ninvuɣ shɛb kana nti bɔhi Yisa, Bɔ niŋ ka Jɔn nyaandoliba mini Farisiinim nyaandoliba lɔri noli, ka nyin nyaandoliba bi lɔra.
en: The followers of John the Baptist and the Pharisees often went without eating. Some people came and asked Jesus, Why do the followers of John and those of the Pharisees often go without eating, while your disciples never do.

dag: O daa saɣim bɛ wain tihi mini bɛ fiig tihi, ka chɛ ka bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni tihi zaa kab lu.
en: God destroyed their vines and their fig trees; shattered the trees of their countryside.

dag: Di saha ka o yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka ti yi kpaŋa chaŋ luɣ shɛli ti vuhi biɛla. Dama niriba daa kul kanila o sanna ka chana, hal ka o min o nyaandoliba ti kɔŋ dahima diri bindirigu.
en: Many people were coming and going, so there was no time to eat. He said to the apostles, Come by yourselves to a secluded place and rest for a while.

dag: Lɔtan bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Hɔri mini Hɛman. Lɔtan tizɔpaɣa n-daa nyɛ Timna.
en: Lotan was the father of Hori and Heman.

dag: Amaa pakoli bee paɣ so ŋun yi dooyili yi po pɔri ni o niŋ shɛli, fashee ka di zani.
en: Widows and divorced women must keep every promise they make to the Lord .

dag: Bɛ ni daa ʒiya diri bindirigu maa saha shɛli, ka Yawɛ yɛligu daa ka anabi kurili ŋun bol anab ŋuni maa labisina maa sanna.
en: During the meal the Lord gave the old prophet.

dag: N ni ku bɛ naa, ka ku bɛ nabihi zaa pah o zuɣu. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will kill the ruler of Moab and all the leaders of the land.

dag: Sɛrug ni daa ti paai yuun pihita saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Nahɔr.
en: When Serug was , he had a son named Nahor.

dag: Ibrahimma ka di leei Ibrahimma dini Hitinim bɛn daa ʒi tiŋ maa dunoli shee maa zaa ninni.
en: It was recognized as Abraham's property by all the Hittites who were there at the meeting.

dag: di yi niŋ ka a nya paɣ viɛlli yi ni gbahi shɛb daba maa ni, ka bɔri ni a zaŋ o leeg a paɣa.
en: if you see among the captives a beautiful woman, and you fall in love with her and take her as your wife.

dag: Ka kpamba maa daa lan yɛli ba, Chɛliya ba, amaa ka bɛ lee kabiri dari ka ŋɔŋdi kom tiri Izraɛlnim zaa. Kpamba maa ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bala.
en: So let them live, but they will be our servants. They will cut wood for us and carry water for all our people. So the leaders did not break their promise of peace to them.

dag: dama niriba pam ni ti zaŋ n yuli kana ti yɛra, Mani n-nyɛ Masia! Mani n-nyɛ Masia! Bɛ ni ti birigi niriba pam.
en: Many will come and claim to be me. They will say they are the Messiah, and they will fool many people.

dag: Zalim Izraɛlnim ni bɛ bom bɛ ni dooi olivi kpa shɛli din nyɛ alali na nti niŋdi firilanim maa puuni din ni chɛ ka firilanim maa diri saha shɛlikam.
en: Command the Israelites to bring pure, pressed olive oil to you for the lamp, to keep a light burning constantly.

dag: Ka yɛlli maa daa muɣisi Siria naa maa pam ka o bol o sapashinnim na nti bɔhi ba, Yi ni ŋuni n-lee be Izraɛl naa polo.
en: The king of Aram was very upset about this. He called his army officers and said to them, Tell me who is spying for the king of Israel.

dag: Ka naa daa zaŋ bini pɔb o ninni ka kuhiri pampam yɛra, Mbaye m bia Absalom, mbaye Absalom, m bia, m bia!.
en: The king had covered his face and was crying loudly, O my son Absalom, O Absalom, my son, my son.

dag: Ka Juda bidibisi daa nyɛ: Ɛr mini Onan ni Shɛla ni Pɛrɛz ni Zɛra, amaa ka Ɛr mini Onan daa kpi Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni; ka Pɛrɛz bidibisi daa nyɛ: Hɛzirɔn mini Hamul.
en: Judahs sons were Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah. Er and Onan both died in the land of Canaan. Perezs sons were Hezron and Hamul.

dag: Amaa Yisa ni daa nya lala maa ka di ku o suli, ka o yɛl o nyaandoliba maa, Chɛliya ka bihi kam n sanna, ka di karitiya ba, dama Naawuni nam nyɛla bɛ tatabo dini.
en: When Jesus saw this, he grew angry and said to them, Allow the children to come to me. Dont forbid them, because Gods kingdom belongs to people like these children.

dag: Sabbu maa ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: MENE, MENE, TƐKƐL UFARISIN.
en: This is what was written down: MENE, MENE, TEKEL , and PARSIN.

dag: Ka n-daa bɔhi ba, Pa tinzun paɣiba n-daa chɛ ka Izraɛl Naa Sulemaana tum alahichi? Zuliya pam nanim ni so daa bi ŋman o, ka o Naawuni daa yur o ka zaŋ o leei Izraɛlnim zaa naa, amaa tinzun paɣiba n-daa ti chɛ ka o tum alahichi.
en: God dearly loved King Solomon of Israel and made him the greatest king on earth, but Solomon's foreign wives led him into sin.

dag: Ka o paɣ Jɛzibɛl daa kpe o sani nti bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a je suli, ka zaɣisi bindirigu dibu.
en: Jezebel his wife came in and asked, What's wrong? Why won't you eat.

dag: Shamga Anat bia saha la mini Jaɛl saha la, sochandiba bɛn daari doli taba daa bi lan chana, ka bɛn gɔri mi kpalim baɣisirila sokpansi.
en: In the days of Shamgar, Anaths son, in the days of Jael, caravans ceased. Those traveling by road kept to the backroads.

dag: N ni daa nya ʒii shɛli yuŋ la ni, n daa nya so ka o ŋmanila ninsala n-yi zuɣusaa be sagbana ni sirigiri na n-daa ka ŋun pun be tum kurimbuni ha la sanna, ka bɛ daa zaŋ o wuh o.
en: In my vision at night I looked, and there in front of me was someone who looked like a human being. He was coming on the clouds in the sky. He came up to the Ancient King, and the Kings servants brought him before the King.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, To, cham a chandi! A yɛda niŋbu n-neeg a nina maa. Ka o nina maa daa dii neei, ka o doli Yisa chana.
en: Jesus said, Go, your faith has healed you. At once he was able to see, and he began to follow Jesus on the way.

dag: Doo yi goli biŋkɔbigu, bɛn kum o, ka ku biŋkɔbigu maa gba.
en: If a man has sexual relations with an animal, both the man and the animal must be put to death.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Dindali maa, tɛha ni ti kpe a suhu ni, ka a bo zaɣ biɛɣu niŋbu soya.
en: This is what the Sovereign Lord says to Gog: When that time comes, you will start thinking up an evil plan.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ; Niŋmiya tuuba, ka chɛ yi buɣa ŋɔ jɛmbu, ka zo n-yi din chihiri la tumbu ni.
en: Now, Ezekiel, tell everyone in Israel: I am the Lord God. Stop worshiping those idols I hate so much and come back to me.

dag: N ni yɛli sarikanima, N tin ya yolisim! Ka yɛli bɛn be zibisim ni, Kamiya neesim ni na! Bɛ ni ti ŋmanila piɛ shɛb bɛn be zoya zuɣu tiŋgban nɛl ni ŋubiri mɔri la.
en: You will set prisoners free from dark dungeons to see the light of day. On their way home, they will find plenty to eat, even on barren hills.

dag: Ti zaŋ Naa Ahaz ni daa bi lan ʒe Naawuni yim ka kahi neen shɛŋa zaa la labisi nti mali di zaa ka di niŋ kasi. Nyama di ʒe Yawɛ sara maligu bimbini la tooni.
en: We have also brought back all the equipment which King Ahaz took away during those years he was unfaithful to God, and we have rededicated it. It is all in front of the Lord 's altar.

dag: O vuui Izraɛlnim yaa o suhuyiɣisili puuni. O daa yih o nuu ka chɛ ba bɛ dimnim ninni. O ŋmanila buɣim niɛm din diri Yaakubu zuliya sunsuuni n-di n-gili luɣilikam.
en: In his burning rage, he cut off each of Israels horns; right in front of the enemy, he withdrew his strong hand; he burned against Jacob like a flaming fire that ate up everything nearby.

dag: Ŋunkam kahind o tab nini nyɛla ŋun tahiri yɛla na, amaa ŋunkam mali suhukpeeni kpahiri niriba zuɣuri ni nyɛla ŋun tahiri suhudoo na.
en: Someone who holds back the truth causes trouble, but one who openly criticizes works for peace.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ, Ŋuni n-lee mali kpiɔŋ paai nyin Yawɛ? A ʒiɛyimtali kul gilila a luɣilikam zaa.
en: Who is like you, LORD God of heavenly forces? Mighty LORD, your faithfulness surrounds you!.

dag: N pun wum dimbɔŋɔnim pam; yi zaa bɛn di yɛn maai n suhu ŋɔ nyɛla bɛn lan saɣindi n suhu pam.
en: Ive heard many things like these. All of you are sorry comforters.

dag: Turi mini putɔɣu m-pali bɛ noya ni.
en: Their mouths are full of cursing and angry words. Psalm :.

dag: Ti mabi shɛb ni daa ti paana nti yɛl a ni doli yɛlimaŋli shɛm min a ni shiri kul be yɛlimaŋli maa ni sahakam shɛm, di daa niŋ ma suhupiɛlli pam.
en: It makes me very happy when the Lord's followers come by and speak openly of how you obey the truth.

dag: Bɔ ka a lee mi ka tinim bi mi li? Bɔ gbinni ka a lee baŋ ka tinim bi baŋ li?.
en: We know as much as you do! We understand as well as you.

dag: Leedan ŋun daa nyɛ Gɛrishɔn bidibisi ni yino la daa nyɛla zuliya pam zaŋ tabil o bia Jɛhiɛl daŋ niriba yabidoo.
en: Ladan, one of the sons of Gershon, was the ancestor of several family groups, including the family of his son Jehiel.

dag: A daa ku m bihi nyo buɣim mali buɣa maa.
en: without taking my children and sacrificing them to idols?.

dag: Ti yab Naa Dauda nam din kanna ti Duuma yuli ni ŋɔ mal alibarika! Paɣimiya Zallakudura Naa.
en: God bless the kingdom of our father David. That kingdom is coming! Praise to God in heaven.

dag: Yawɛ daa lo ba la alikauli n-yɛli ba, Miriya ka yi jɛm buɣa bee n-damdi di tooni bee n-jɛm li bee m-mal li.
en: The Lord had made a covenant with them and had ordered them: Do not worship other gods; do not bow down to them or serve them or offer sacrifices to them.

dag: ka wuɣi gɔhi zuɣupiligu pil o, ka zaŋ kaɣili gbibil o nudirigu ni; ka damdir o tooni maan o ansarisi yɛra, Ti puhir a, nyin Yɛhudianim Naa.
en: Then they made a crown out of thorny branches and placed it on his head, and put a stick in his right hand; then they knelt before him and made fun of him. Long live the King of the Jews! they said.

dag: Jɛrusalɛmnima, ŋuni n-lee yɛn zɔn ya nambɔɣu? Bee ŋuni n-lee ni fabili yi zuɣu? Ŋuni n-lee ni zani ni o bɔhi yi daalaafee yɛla?.
en: Who will pity you, Jerusalem? Who will shed tears over you? Who will stop and ask how youre doing?.

dag: Di zuɣu ka Naawuni daa pii ma leei di molomoona mini tumo ni karimba ŋun ni wuhi bɛn pa Yɛhudianim yɛda niŋbu mini yɛlimaŋli soli yɛla. Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri maa; m bi ŋmarila ʒiri!.
en: This is why God chose me to be a preacher and an apostle of the good news. I am telling the truth. I am not lying. God sent me to teach the Gentiles about faith and truth.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ gbinni lee nyɛ wula? N ni suhi Naawuni n shia ni, ka lan suhi Naawuni m milinsi ni; n ni yili yila n shia ni, ka lan yili yila m milinsi ni gba.
en: What should I do? Ill pray in the Spirit, but Ill pray with my mind too; Ill sing a psalm in the Spirit, but Ill sing the psalm with my mind too.

dag: Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, N dana, dindina ka tim ma kom maa ka n nyu, ka kɔnyuri ku lan gbaai ma bee ka n ti lan ka kpe na ni n ti ŋɔŋ kom yaha.
en: The woman said to Jesus, Sir, give me this water. Then I will never be thirsty again and wont have to come back here to get more water.

dag: Dama o zaligunim zaa kul dola n tooni, ka n na ʒi n-zaɣis o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la gba.
en: I always remembered his laws. I never rejected his rules.

dag: Shɛb yɛra, Pool gbana puuni yɛtɔɣa nyɛla yɛl kpɛma ni din mali yiko, amaa o yi ti be ti sani o niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu ni, o nyɛla ninvuɣ gbariŋ ka o yɛtɔɣa bi ŋmani shɛli.
en: Some of you are saying, Paul's letters are harsh and powerful. But in person, he is a weakling and has nothing worth saying.

dag: Naa, ka n daa ti deei yiko maligumaaniba kpamba sani m-be soli chani Damaskus;.
en: One time the leading priests gave me permission and the authority to go to the city of Damascus.

dag: Piɛbimiya kikaa Ziɔn puuni. Ŋmɛmiya kuŋa n zoli din be kasi la zuɣu. Bɛnkam zaa be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, chɛliya ka yi ni sɔhira! Dama Yawɛ dabisili la kanna, hal di miriya.
en: Sound the trumpet on Zion, the Lord 's sacred hill. Warn everyone to tremble! The judgment day of the Lord is coming soon.

dag: Di bi tuhi ni nir ŋubi nimdi bee n-nyu dam bee n-niŋ binshɛli din ni chɛ ka o kpee tuui lu.
en: Its a good thing not to eat meat or drink wine or to do anything that trips your brother or sister.

dag: Daliri dini zuɣu ka ti lee ni nyu bara? Daliri shɛli kani. Bɔ n-niŋ ka di kani? Ti ni doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu zuɣu? Aai! Di nyɛla ti ni niŋ yɛda la zuɣu!.
en: What happens to our bragging? Its thrown out. With which law? With what we have accomplished under the Law?.

dag: Ti mali mɔri mini difu din ni ti ti bunsi ŋɔ, ka mali m min a bipuɣiŋga ŋɔ ni nachimbil so ŋun be tinim a daba ŋɔ sani ŋɔ bindirigu mini wain. Ti mali ti ni bɔri binshɛlikam.
en: Weve got our own straw and feed for our donkeys, plus food and wine to provide for me, the woman, and my servant with us. We dont need anything.

dag: Ka Ada daa dɔɣi Ɛlifaz ti Iso; ka Basɛmat dɔɣi Riuɛl ti o;.
en: Adah bore Eliphaz; Basemath bore Reuel;.

dag: O yaar o noli yɛra, ka di nyɛligira, ka chɛ ka pɔhim ʒiɛri li, ka di leeri kom zɔra.
en: At his command the ice melts, the wind blows, and streams begin to flow.

dag: Bomiya Yawɛ ni o kpiɔŋ; Doliya din ni chɛ ka yi kul be o sani sahakam.
en: Trust the Lord and his mighty power.

dag: Di saha ka naazɔnim bɛn daa kul be o san la yɛl o, Naa, chɛ ka bɛ vihi nya paɣisara bɛn nyɛ paɣipiɛl viɛla na ti ti a.
en: So some of the king's advisers who were close to him suggested, Why don't you make a search to find some beautiful young virgins?.

dag: Neesim din be bɛ suɣili ni leei zibisim, ka firila din yili bɛ zuɣusaa kpi.
en: The lamp in their tents will be darkened.

dag: Dama molo yi Dan tiŋgbani polo na n-yɛra ni alɔbo yi Ifriim tiŋgbani zoli polo na.
en: before a message of disaster arrives from the hills of Ephraim and the town of Dan.

dag: paɣimiy o cheechi ni mini Yisa Masia ni, ʒiɛmani kam ni hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: glory to him in the church and in Christ Jesus for all generations, forever and always. Amen.

dag: Ka zoya daa yiɣiri jɛmdi kaman piɛlahi la, ka daboya daa yiɣiri jɛmdi kaman piɛbihi la.
en: The mountains and the hills skipped around like goats.

dag: Ka yi yi ti wum ni bɛ tuhiri tɔbu, ka wumdi ŋumaŋuma ni tɔb shɛŋa na yɛn tuhi, yin di chɛliya ka yi suhiri zɔhira; dama faashee dimbɔŋɔnim zaa bahi niŋ, amaa di ti bi yɛn wuhi ni dunia yiɣisibu saha paami maa.
en: When you hear about wars and threats of wars, don't be afraid. These things will have to happen first, but that isn't the end.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, Tuun shɛli Naawuni ni bɔri ni yi tum nyɛla ni yi niŋ o ni tim so na la yɛda.
en: Jesus answered, The work God wants you to do is this: to believe in the one he sent.

dag: Niriba pam mini zuliya shɛb bɛn mali yiko pam ni ti ka Jɛrusalɛm na nti jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, ka suh o ka o niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni.
en: Many peoples and powerful nations will come to Jerusalem to worship the Lord Almighty and to pray for his blessing.

dag: Di chaŋ wula? Yi ka yinsi din ni di ka nyu nimaani bee yi ʒiɛmla Naawuni cheechi ka dihiri bɛn ka shɛl la gba vi? Ka wula ka n lee yɛn yɛli ya? N ni paɣi ya dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu? Aai! N ku paɣi ya!.
en: You can eat and drink in your own homes. It seems that you think Gods church is not important. You embarrass those who are poor. What can I say? Should I praise you? No, I cannot praise you for this.

dag: Amaa ka o yɛl o, N ku chaŋ; n ni labi n dɔɣiriba sani ni n tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Hobab answered, No, I am going back to my native land.

dag: Manna maa daa ŋmanila tiwal shɛli din biɛlim pɔripɔra, ka di kɔtomsi nyɛ zaɣ piɛlifaa kaman dɔzim la.
en: Manna was like small seeds, whitish yellow in color.

dag: Fɔŋ kara anahi ka bɛ daa zaŋ ti ba. Dina n-nyɛ: Shɛkɛm din nyɛ ninvuɣ so ŋun ku o kpee ni zɔri kuni tin shɛli tiligiri la mini di biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee din be Ifriim zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni zoya zuɣu la ni Gɛza.
en: They gave them: Shechem, the refuge city for a killer, and its pastures in the highlands of Ephraim; Gezer and its pastures.

dag: amaa n daa bi nya Yisa Masia tuumba maa ni so naɣila ti Duuma tizo Jeemsi.
en: I did not see any other apostle except James, the Lord's brother.

dag: Yi tɛhiya ni yi ni tooi galim yɛtɔɣa, ka di be kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun ka tahima yɛtɔɣa nyɛla pɔhim?.
en: Do you plan to criticize me? Will you speak more tiring words?.

dag: Yi yi doli n zaligu, yi nyɛla n zɔnima.
en: You are my friends if you do what I tell you to do.

dag: Dindali maa Izraɛlnim daa zanila Mikimash n-ku Filistianim maa lala hal ti paai Aijalɔn. Ka di daa gbarigi Izraɛlnim maa pam.
en: By evening the Israelite army was exhausted from killing Philistines all the way from Michmash to Aijalon.

dag: ka yi nina ni ti yɛn nya shɛli ni ti kpɛhi ya yinyari.
en: The things you see will make you go crazy.

dag: N ni tib n niriba maa, ka ti bɛn be yoma mini bɛn be katinsi zaa suhudoo. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will teach them a new word: peace. I will give peace to those who are near and to those who are far away. I will heal them. The Lord himself said this.

dag: Dabiɛm ni kpe ba kaman kokpɛɣu la, ka pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga ti ʒe ba chaŋ yuŋ.
en: Terrors overtake them like waters; a tempest snatches them by night.

dag: Ka tɔb maa daa kpaɣi mii Sool, ka peentɔriba daa to o piɛm ti o daŋa.
en: The battle was fierce around Saul, and when the archers located him, he trembled in fear.

dag: Ninsal noli ni yɛtɔɣa puuni ka o puli paana, o noli ni yɛtɔɣa puuni ka o lan tiɣira.
en: You will have to live with the consequences of everything you say.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi, a wuhiri ba ni a gba bela kasi, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mi nyɛ ninvuɣ biɛri, a wuhiri ba a ninkuunsi ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: You are pure toward the pure, but toward the crooked, you are tricky.

dag: Ka yi mini Shiiba daabihi ni Raama daabihi daa niŋdi daabiligu ni taba. Ka bɛ daa zaŋdi tulaale viɛla balibu kam mini kuɣ viɛla ni salima na ti taɣiri yi nɛma.
en: For your goods the merchants of Sheba and Raamah traded jewels, gold, and the finest spices.

dag: Ŋuna n-chɛ ka Naa min o saawaranim ni o tuma zuɣulaannim bɛn mali yiko pam la niŋ ma nirilim. N daa niŋ suhukpeeni, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ nuu daa pa n zuɣu, ka n daa laɣim Izraɛl zuɣulaannima ni m mini ba lab kuli.
en: God has told the king, his advisors, and his powerful officials to treat me with kindness. The Lord God has helped me, and I have been able to bring many Jewish leaders back to Jerusalem.

dag: A zaligunim nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. Niriba nahindi ma ka di ka soli. Sɔŋm ma!.
en: Your commandments are all trustworthy; people persecute me with lies—help me!.

dag: ka daa chaŋ luɣ shɛli katiŋa din nyɛ daba ata soli chandi ka chɛ Yaakubu, ka Yaakubu daa gbib ŋun Leeban biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn kpalim la.
en: and then went away from Jacob with this flock as far as he could travel in three days. Jacob took care of the rest of Laban's flocks.

dag: Lihimiya n nuhi mini n naba, ka baŋ ni mani m-bala. Tabisimiya ma nya, dama alizini ka niŋgbuŋ mini kɔba ka n ni mali shɛm ŋɔ. .
en: Look at my hands and my feet. Its really me! Touch me and see, for a ghost doesnt have flesh and bones like you see I have.

dag: Dinzuɣu di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira; yi mali buchi pam gari jahinjɛya.
en: So don't be afraid! You are worth much more than many sparrows.

dag: Ɛlizafan bidibisi ni, Shɛmaya n-daa nyɛ kpɛma, ka bɛ daŋ maa ni niriba kɔbisiyi pah o zuɣu.
en: Shemaiah, the leader of the Elizaphan clan, and of his relatives;.

dag: Izar daŋ ni Shɛlomɔt n-daa nyɛ kpɛma, Shɛlomɔt bidibisi ni, Jahat n-daa nyɛ kpɛma.
en: Jahath, a descendant of Izhar through Shelomith;.

dag: Yawɛ, ti dolila a yubu ni nyɛ shɛli, ka niŋ a ni doli so shɛŋa kariti saria naani. A kɔŋko ka ti kul bɔra.
en: But, Lord , we are waiting for your way of justice. We want to honor you and your name.

dag: Naawuni, zuliya shɛb kana ti kpe a tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Bɛ ta a jɛmbu du kasi la daɣiri, ka ŋme n-wurim Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Our God, foreign nations have taken your land, disgraced your temple, and left Jerusalem in ruins.

dag: N yɛri ya mi ni zaadali Sɔdomnim azaaba nyabu ni ti so tiŋ maa nim dini.
en: I assure you that Sodom will be better off on Judgment Day than that city.

dag: din nyɛ zaligu shɛŋa zaa Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Musa zali ya dahin shɛli Yawɛ ni daa zali zaligunim maa zaŋ chaŋ yi ʒiɛmani kam ni polo la.
en: And suppose that in the future the community fails to do everything that the Lord commanded through Moses.

dag: Ka tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni so yi bɔri alibarika, Naawuni ŋun ʒe yim ŋɔ n-ni niŋ alibarika maa niŋ o ni. Ka ŋunkam mi yɛn po pɔri, ŋun pom li dalim la Naawuni ŋun ʒe yim maa. Dama n tam yɛl shɛŋa din pun gari la yɛla. Di zaa yiɣiya ka firi.
en: Anyone in the land who asks for a blessing will ask to be blessed by the faithful God. Whoever takes an oath will swear by the name of the faithful God. The troubles of the past will be gone and forgotten.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd ni daa wum dimbɔŋɔnim zaa, di daa birim o pam; dama ninvuɣ shɛb daa yɛliya ni Jɔn Baptaizira n-neei kum ni na maa. Luk .-.
en: Herod the ruler heard about everything that was happening. He was confused because some people were saying that John had been raised from the dead.

dag: Be baalim Yawɛ sani, ka di suɣilo guhir o; di chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lɔri nia biɛri tɔŋsim yɛla muɣis a.
en: Be patient and trust the Lord . Don't let it bother you when all goes well for those who do sinful things.

dag: N ni chɛ li ka di bahi yoli. N ku wahi di nyoya ni bahi bee m-mali di ni, ka suligunyinyari mini gɔhi zooi lim li. N ni chɛ ka sagbana ku tɔɣisi kom bahi di ni.
en: I will let it be overgrown with weeds. I will not trim the vines or hoe the ground; instead, I will let briers and thorns cover it. I will even forbid the clouds to let rain fall on it.

dag: Naŋgbankpeeni maa ni daa mali ti mooi nini saha shɛli ka sapashin kpɛm maa zɔri ni bɛ ti bu Pool n-chɛrisi o nimdi gari taŋkpaɣu ni zuɣu daa chɛ ka o yɛli tɔbbihi ni bɛ cham ti fa Pool bɛ sani n-zaŋ o tahi bɛn tɔbbihi maa biɛhigu shee.
en: The dispute became so heated that the commander feared they might tear Paul to pieces. He ordered soldiers to go down and remove him by force from their midst. Then they took him back to the military headquarters.

dag: Amaa ka Zara daa chihi yɛli, M bi la, dama dabiɛm n-daa gbaag o. Ka o yɛli, Aai, a laya.
en: Sarah said, I didnt laugh! Then the Lord said, No, I know that is not true. You did laugh.

dag: Bɛ tim a anzinfa kilɔgiram tusaata ni kɔbisinahi, ka ti a alikama din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram tuhi pia, ka ti a wain lita tusaayi, ka ti a kpam lita tusaayi, ka ti a yalim pam kaman di ni simdi shɛm.
en: even up to one hundred kikkars of silver, one hundred kors of wheat, one hundred baths of wine, one hundred baths of oil, and unlimited salt.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kpahi Yisa tabili dapulli maa zuɣu ka bɛ zaŋ o binyɛra pumpu n-sɔŋ tɔri tɛte ni bɛ nya bɛ zaa yinoyino ni yɛn di shɛli.
en: They nailed Jesus to a cross and gambled to see who would get his clothes.

dag: Bɛ dari ba yihi bɛ ni niŋ yili shɛli yɛda ni, ka zaŋ ba tahi na so ŋun yɛla mali dabiɛm sani.
en: They are torn from the tents where they lived secure, and are dragged off to face King Death.

dag: O ni daa nya salo maa, ka bɛ yɛla niŋ o nambɔɣu pam, dama bɛ daa nyɛla bɛn nyari nahiŋgu ka bi nyari sɔŋsim; bɛ daa ŋmanila piɛri bɛn ka gula.
en: Now when Jesus saw the crowds, he had compassion for them because they were troubled and helpless, like sheep without a shepherd.

dag: Naawuni fukumsi zaligu bi dalimla yɛda niŋbu, dama di sabiya: Ŋunkam dol li ni be di zuɣu.
en: The Law isnt based on faith; rather, the one doing these things will live by them .

dag: Amaa Yawɛ, n kuhirimi niŋd a bɔri sɔŋsim, n suhigu paar a asiba.
en: But I cry out to you, LORD! My prayer meets you first thing in the morning!.

dag: Ka Pasɛa bia Joyada mini Bɛsɔdɛya bia Mɛshulam daa mali me Dunɔdal Kurili la. Bɛ daa lan zaŋ dunɔpaɣiri dari sa, ka mali pununim kpɛhi di dunoya, ka niŋ dunokparita mini kurimulima niŋ li.
en: Joiada and Meshullam fixed the Old Gate. Joiada is the son of Paseah and Meshullam is the son of Besodeiah. They set the beams in place. They put the doors on the hinges. Then they put the locks and bolts on the doors.

dag: Izraɛlnima, niŋmiya Yawɛ naani, pumpɔŋɔ kul mali we!.
en: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord now and forever.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka buɣim di Judanima n-saɣim bɛ ni me goma gili luɣ shɛŋa Jɛrusalɛm la.
en: Now I will send fire on Judah and destroy the fortresses of Jerusalem.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lo tɔb na ti liri Judanima, ka kpe nayili ti ʒe bɛ ni nya binshɛɣukam zaa nayili maa ka gbah o paɣiba min o bidibisi zaa chaŋ. Bɛ daa gbah o bidibisi zaa ka ti naɣ chɛla o kaluɣi ŋun yuli daa booni Ahazia la kɔŋko.
en: They attacked Judah and carried away all the riches in the kings palace. They also took Jehorams sons and wives. Only Jehorams youngest son, Ahaziah, was left.

dag: Pa yi zaa yɛla ka n yɛri maa, dama m mi n ni pun pii shɛba; amaa di kpala talahi ni Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. Dina n-nyɛ: N ni dihiri so gbi ma zamba bɔɣili.
en: I am not talking about all of you; I know those I have chosen. But the scripture must come true that says, The man who shared my food turned against me.

dag: Yɛm yɛla nyɛla din kpɛm pam ŋun ka yɛm sani. O yi be dunɔdali shee o bi yaar o noli.
en: Wise sayings are too deep for stupid people to understand. They have nothing to say when important matters are being discussed.

dag: Amaa man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Di ku zani, di mi ku niŋ pali.
en: But the Lord GOD says, Their plan will not succeed. It will not happen.

dag: N daa di yi zuɣu nyɔri n ni daa tim shɛb yi sanna la ni?.
en: Did I cheat you by using any of the men I sent to you? You know I didnt.

dag: Fɔndi ŋɔ mini tiŋkpansi ŋɔ zaa daa bela Zɛbulɔn zuliya ni daa deei tiŋgban shɛli ka di leei bɛ dini kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm la puuni.
en: These cities and their towns were in the land which the families of the tribe of Zebulun received as their possession.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ bo kuɣ shɛŋa zali bɛ ni daa yihi kuɣ shɛŋa la zaani, ka lan bo tari na ti ta yili maa.
en: Afterwards the wall must be repaired with new stones and fresh plaster.

dag: Ka m mɔŋ ya saa saha shɛli yi bindira ni bɔri saa pam. N chɛ ka saa miri tin shɛlinima, ka bi miri tin shɛlinima; ka chɛ ka saa miri pu shɛl ni, ka chɛ ka o bi miri pu shɛl ni ka di bindira kpira.
en: I also stopped the rain, and it was three months before harvest time. So no crops grew. Then I let it rain on one city, but not on another city. Rain fell on one part of the country, but on the other part of the country, the land became very dry.

dag: Ka tizɔra bi deeri tizɔbo laara naɣila o dolila tizɔbo zaligunim ni wuhi shɛm.
en: No one wins an athletic contest without obeying the rules.

dag: Ka Yisa daa tim tuumba pinaayi maa ka kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni yɛli, Miriya ka yi chaŋ bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani, yi mi di kpɛnya Samarianim tin shɛl ni.
en: Jesus sent these twelve out and commanded them, Dont go among the Gentiles or into a Samaritan city.

dag: Ka Samsin ba daa chaŋ paɣisarili maa yiŋa, ka Samsin ti chɛ ka bɛ puhi chuɣu nimaani; dama lala ka nachimba daa yi niŋda.
en: Samsons father went down to see the Philistine woman. The custom was for the bridegroom to give a party. So Samson gave a party.

dag: Sɛgub daa nyɛla Jair ba, ka Jair daa nyɛ ŋun su tinsi pisinaata fukumsi Giliad tiŋgban ni.
en: was the father of Jair, who ruled villages in the region of Gilead.

dag: Amaa ka yi daa zaɣisi ni yi ku wum n yɛligu, ka zaŋ yi nuhi tum tuma n-chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi tum yimaŋ barina. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But you wouldnt listen to me, making me angry by what you do and bringing disaster upon yourselves, declares the LORD.

dag: Ka peentɔriba daa to Naa Jɔsia piɛm ka di gbaag o, ka o daa yɛl o kpambaliba bɛn be o sani, Zaŋmiya ma yi kpaŋa, dama n nya daŋ pam.
en: During the battle King Josiah was struck by Egyptian arrows. He ordered his servants, Take me away; I'm badly hurt.

dag: Ka a lihi bɛ ni m-piig a nin ni tiɣi paɣisar so n-zaŋ o leei napaɣa n-zali Vashiti zaashee. Ka dimbɔŋɔ daa tiɣi naa nini ka o shiri niŋ lala.
en: Then take the young woman you like best and make her queen in Vashti's place. The king thought this was good advice, so he followed it.

dag: Yawɛ, n ni paɣ a niriba ni, ka yili yila paɣ a zuliya kam ni.
en: I will thank you, O Lord , among the nations. I will praise you among the peoples.

dag: Tinsi maa yɛn nyɛla nir ni yɛn zo n-kuli shɛli n-yi ŋun yɛn bɔhi biɛri nuu ni, ka lala chɛ ka ninvuɣ so ŋun ku ninsala ku kpi hal ti zani salo ni ka bɛ kar o saria.
en: If the victim's relatives think it was murder, they might try to take revenge. Anyone accused of murder can run to one of these Safe Towns for protection and not be killed before a trial is held.

dag: Dinzuɣu sokam bɔɣiri ni cheei kom, ka bɛ ku lan mali suhukpeeni.
en: All people will be terrified. Hands will grow limp; courage will melt away.

dag: Kul be tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni, ka m be a sani, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni, ka zaŋ tiŋgbana ŋɔ zaa ti a min a zuliya, ka chɛ ka n ni daa lo a ba Ibrahimma alikauli shɛl la pali.
en: Live here, and I will be with you and bless you. I am going to give all this territory to you and to your descendants. I will keep the promise I made to your father Abraham.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛl o bidibisi, Pamiya buŋ nyaampara ti ma. Ka bɛ daa niŋ lala.
en: Then he said to his sons, Saddle my donkey for me. They did so.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Zaŋmi gbaŋ n-sabi sabbu shɛli sɔŋ. Sabimi li bachibihi kara n yɛli, Mahɛshalalihashibaz dini.
en: The Lord told me, Get a large scroll, and use an ordinary pen to write these words: This is for Maher Shalal Hash Baz. .

dag: Dinzuɣu ka niriba ŋmaligi paɣiri ba, ka bi nya bɛ taali.
en: Even Gods people turn to them and do what they say.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa kpe cheechi niriba zaa pam zaŋ tabili bɛnkam zaa daa wum di yɛla.
en: The whole church and all the others who heard of this were terrified.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, di saha maa Juda ninvuɣ zuɣuri daa sabila gbana pam ti Tɔbaya, ka Tɔbaya gba daa sabi gbana ti ba.
en: All this time the Jewish leaders and Tobiah had been writing letters back and forth.

dag: ka yɛli, Nyin Sintani bia ŋɔ, nyin ŋun nyɛ wuntia tuuni kam dima, ka yɔhiŋgu mini bilikɔnsi tuma pal a kɔbili ni ŋɔ, a nyɛla ŋun kul kpaŋd amaŋ ni a zaŋ ti Duuma yɛlimaŋli soya leei ʒiri.
en: and said, You son of the devil! You are a liar, a crook, and an enemy of everything that is right. When will you stop speaking against the true ways of the Lord?.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daa zaliya ni Jɔram kaabu maa n-yɛn nyɛ Ahazia bahigu. Dama o ni daa yi nimaani ka o mini Jɔram doli tab chana, ka bɛ daa chirigi Nimshi bia Jɛhu, Yawɛ ni daa zali so ni o kum Ɛhab daŋ ni niriba zaa la.
en: God caused Ahaziahs death when he went to visit Joram. Ahaziah arrived and went out with Joram to meet Jehu son of Nimshi. The Lord chose Jehu to destroy Ahabs family.

dag: Ka o dii suug o koyuli maa o bɔɣusapiŋ zuɣu na ti ma ka yɛli, Nyuma, ka chɛ ka n ŋɔŋ shɛli ti a laakumnim ŋɔ gba ka bɛ nyu. Ka n di nyu ka chɛ ka o ŋɔŋ na ti ti n laakumnim maa gba ka bɛ nyu.
en: She quickly lowered her jar from her shoulder and said, Drink, and I will also water your camels. So I drank, and she watered the camels.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa yi yɛn yiɣisi chaŋ ka doli tab gbilligbilli chani shɛm m-bala.
en: This was the order in which the Israelites marched each time they moved their camp.

dag: Ka Makiri daa bo paɣiba ti Hupim mini Shupim. O tizɔpaɣ yuli n-daa booni Maaka. O bidib so ŋun daa pahi ayi n-daa nyɛ Zɛlɔfɛhad, ŋun daa dɔɣila bipuɣinsi noli.
en: Machir found a wife for Huppim and one for Shuppim. His sister's name was Maacah. Machir's second son was Zelophehad, and he had only daughters.

dag: Ka Ahaz daa zaŋ anzinfa mini salima shɛli bɛ ni daa nya Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini nayili azichi biɛhigu shee la n-tim ti ti Asiria naa pini.
en: Along with the message, Ahaz sent silver and gold from the Lord 's temple and from the palace treasury as a gift for the Assyrian king.

dag: A tɛhiya ni a ni zɔr o zuɣu n-chɛ ka o kpahir a zuɣu ni, ka kariti a saria ŋɔ?.
en: Is he correcting you for worshiping him?.

dag: Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o Aramaik yɛtɔɣa ni, Naa, Naawuni dolim a nyɛvili! Yɛlim ti a zahindi maa ka ti wuh a di gbinni.
en: They answered in Aramaic, Your Majesty, we hope you live forever! We are your servants. Please tell us your dream, and we will explain what it means.

dag: Maligumaaniba zuɣulan kam yirila o tab sunsuuni na ni o ʒe bɛ zaani n-zaŋdi pina mini sara maani maligu niriba daalahichi zuɣu Naawuni sani.
en: Every high priest is appointed to help others by offering gifts and sacrifices to God because of their sins.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim shɛb daa yi Antiɔk mini Aikɔnium na nti lɛbigi niriba maa suhuri, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ lab Pool kuɣa hal ti tɛhi ni o kpimi ka vu o yihi bɛ tiŋ maa tariga.
en: Then some Jews came from Antioch and Iconium and persuaded the people to turn against Paul. So they threw stones at him and dragged him out of the town. They thought they had killed him.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ doli Naawuni ni daa yɛli shɛm la: Yaakubu ka n yura, ka je Iso.
en: As the scripture says, I loved Jacob, but I hated Esau.

dag: Di pa shɛli ka m ba ti shihi ma, ka di yi niŋ lala, di ni wuhi ni n mal o la ansarisi maa; ka di ni chɛ ka o yɛli noli ti ma ka pa ni o niŋ alibarika niŋ n ni.
en: Perhaps my father will touch me and find out that I am deceiving him; in this way, I will bring a curse on myself instead of a blessing.

dag: Adam daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiwɛi ni pihita, ka naanyi yi dunia yili.
en: In all, Adam lived years, and he died.

dag: ka Ɛnɔsh nyɛ Kɛnan ba, ka Kɛnan nyɛ Mahalalɛl ba, ka Mahalalɛl nyɛ Jafɛt ba;.
en: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared.

dag: Di saha Yisahaku daa yila Bɛrilahairoi na nti be Nɛgɛb.
en: Isaac had come into the wilderness of The Well of the Living One Who Sees Me and was staying in the southern part of Canaan.

dag: Ka o bɔh o, Bɔ ka a lee bɔri ni n niŋ ti a? Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, Chɛ ka m bihi ŋɔ ni yino ti ʒin a nudirigu polo, ka yino mi ti ʒin a nuzaa polo a nam ʒiishee.
en: What do you want? he asked. She responded, Say that these two sons of mine will sit, one on your right hand and one on your left, in your kingdom.

dag: Ka bɔhi ba, Yi tɛhiya ni n kamina ni n ti ti dunia ŋɔ nim suhudoo? Aai, n yɛri ya mi ni ninvuɣ tuɣilibo ka n tahina.
en: Do you think that I have come to bring peace to the earth? No, I tell you, I have come instead to bring division.

dag: Yinim sowuhiriba bɛn nyɛ zoomba ŋɔ, yi nyɛla bɛn lɔŋdi nanviɣu, amaa ka lee vaani laakum.
en: Blind guides! You strain a fly out of your drink, but swallow a camel!.

dag: ka tɛh o suhu ni ni o dii zaŋ kpani maa to Dauda tabili dukpini, amaa ka Dauda daa fɔhi li buyi zaa.
en: and he threw it, thinking, Ill pin David to the wall. But David escaped from him two different times.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛliya, N tɛha pala yi tɛha, ka yi soya mi pala n soya.
en: The Lord says, My thoughts are not like yours. Your ways are not like mine.

dag: Lala mi n-nyɛ li, yi yi ti nyari ka shihira ŋɔ zaa niŋda, yin baŋmiya ni di saha miriya hal ka di ku lan yuui gba.
en: So when you see all these things happening, you will know that the time has almost come.

dag: Di ŋmanila nir yi zɔri ni o yi gbuɣinli gbaabu ni nti tuhi biŋkɔb so ŋun bie n-gari gbuɣinli soli bee nir yi kpe duu nti zaŋ o nuu dihi dukpini, ka wahu dim o la.
en: You will run from a lion, only to meet a bear. You will escape to your house, rest your hand on the wall, and be bitten by a snake.

dag: Ka Yisa ŋmaligi yɛli Pita, Sintani ŋɔ! Garimi n nyaaŋa! A nyɛla tigbirigu n soli zuɣu, dama a bi tɛhiri yɛl shɛŋa din nyɛ Naawuni dini yɛla, amaa din nyɛ salinim dini yɛla ka a tɛhira.
en: Then Jesus said to Peter, Get away from me, Satan ! You are not helping me! You dont care about the same things God does. You care only about things that people think are important.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ gbaŋ maa nti ti Izraɛl naa. O ni daa sabi gbaŋ maa n-yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Gbaŋ ŋɔ yi paag a, nyin baŋmi ni mani n-chɛ ka Naaman ŋun nyɛ n tumtumda ŋɔ ka a sanna ni a ti tib o kɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: He brought the letter to Israels king. It read, Along with this letter Im sending you my servant Naaman so you can cure him of his skin disease.

dag: Hal muɣisigu yi gili ma niŋ sunsuuni gba, a yihiri ma di puuni ni alaafee. A kul yihiri ma n dimnim bɛn suhu yiɣisi bahi n zuɣu nuu ni. A teer a nudirigu n-fari ma bahira.
en: I am surrounded by trouble, but you protect me against my angry enemies. With your own powerful arm you keep me safe.

dag: Dinzuɣu di chɛ ka din nyɛ zaɣ suŋ a sani leei niriba ni galindi shɛli.
en: Do not let what you regard as good get a bad name.

dag: Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba n-daa nyɛ: Ziha daŋ niriba mini Hasufa daŋ niriba ni Tabayɔt daŋ niriba.
en: These are the special Temple servants: the descendants of Ziha, Hasupha, Tabbaoth.

dag: Jɛrikɔnim daa kparila Jɛriko goondaa dunoya Izraɛlnim zuɣu; ka so ku tooi gari yi bee n-gari kpe di ni.
en: Now Jericho was closed up tightly because of the Israelites. No one went out or came in.

dag: Zɛdɛkia daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani kaman Jɛhoyakim ni daa tum shɛm la.
en: King Zedekiah sinned against the Lord , just as King Jehoiakim had done.

dag: O daŋdila yiɣisibu di ni na bi neei saha shɛli n-niŋdi bindirigu tir o yiŋnima, ka tir o tumtumdiba bɛn nyɛ bipuɣinsi tuma.
en: She gets up before daylight to prepare food for her family and for her servants.

dag: Ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni bidib kpɛm kam ti kpi. Firawuna bikpɛm ŋun ti yɛn di nam o kalinsi nyaaŋa gba ni kpi hal zaŋ tabili dab paɣ ŋun gba nɛli zuɣu niɛmdi bikpɛm ni kpi ni bɛ ni tuui dɔɣi naɣilabihi shɛb zaa.
en: and every firstborn son in Egypt will die, from the firstborn son of Pharaoh, the ruler of Egypt, to the firstborn son of the slave girl grinding grain. Even the firstborn animals will die.

dag: Kaman saa pɔhim ni tahiri sakom na shɛm, lala ka nyaanzum tahiri suhuyiɣisili na.
en: As surely as rain blows in from the north, anger is caused by cruel words.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla kpiimba kum ni neebu yɛla, hal Anabi Musa daa wuhi di yɛla o ni daa sabi Naawuni ni daa tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa tutuɣu ni n-yɛli shɛm la puuni. O daa boli ti Duuma la, Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu Naawuni.
en: In the story about the burning bush, Moses clearly shows that people will live again. He said, The Lord is the God worshiped by Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

dag: Chɛliya Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuma maa baalim. Chɛliya Juda gomna mini Yɛhudia zuɣulaannim maa baalim ka bɛ lab me Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa n-zali di zaashe kurili la ni.
en: Leave the work on this house of God alone. Let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews rebuild this house of God on its original site.

dag: Ka niriba daa yi n-chaŋ ni bɛ ti nya din niŋ maa, ka daa paai Yisa sani nti nya alizin biɛri ni daa ʒi do so zuɣu maa, ka o leela ninvuɣ maŋli n-ye situra ʒi Yisa tooni; ka dabiɛm daa kpe ba pam.
en: People went out to see what had happened, and when they came to Jesus, they found the man from whom the demons had gone out sitting at the feet of Jesus, clothed and in his right mind; and they were all afraid.

dag: Yino daa bela adaka yɔrigu maa tariga yaɣ yini polo, ka yino la mi be yaɣ din la polo. O daa kuri ba tabili la adaka yɔrigu maa, ka bɛ mini li nyɛ zaɣ yini.
en: He put one angel on one end and the other angel on the other end. The angels were joined together with the mercy-cover to make one piece.

dag: Dama yi yi chɛri niriba taali paŋdi ba, yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni mi ni chɛ yi taali paŋ ya.
en: Yes, if you forgive others for the wrongs they do to you, then your Father in heaven will also forgive your wrongs.

dag: Di saha ka tumo daa kana ti yɛli Sool, Kulimina yomyom, dama Filistianim kana ti liri ti.
en: Then a messenger arrived and told Saul, Come quickly! The Philistines are attacking.

dag: Ka n ti pii maligumaana so ŋun ni ʒe ma yim ka tumdi n suhu mini n tɛha ni bɔri shɛlikam zaa; biɛhiŋ kani, n ni ti me o yili ti o, ka o ti be n ninvuɣ gahindili sani n-tumdi tuma sahakam.
en: Then I will establish for myself a trustworthy priest who will act in accordance with my thoughts and desires. I will build a trustworthy household for him, and he will serve before my anointed one forever.

dag: Bɛ yi ti yɛn doli dundɔŋ ni polo dunɔdal la kpe, di simdi ni bɛ yɛla binyɛr piɛla. Bɛ di ti ye biŋkɔbiri kɔbiri binyɛra, bɛ yi ti be dundɔŋ ni dunoya ni bee di puuni n-tumdi tuma.
en: When they enter the gateway to the inner courtyard of the Temple, they are to put on linen clothing. They must not wear anything made of wool when they are on duty in the inner courtyard or in the Temple.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ chamiya ti du Zɛrɛd kulibɔŋ. Di saha ka ti daa chaŋ ti du Zɛrɛd kulibɔŋ maa.
en: So then, get going. Cross the Zered ravine. So we crossed the Zered ravine.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa nya ba lala maa ka kab laɣim taba; ka bɛ ni shɛb daa zo nti sɔɣi vokaba ni, ka shɛb sɔɣi voya ni, ka shɛb sɔɣi tampima lɔna ni, ka shɛb sɔɣi silisi ni, ka shɛb sɔɣi kɔbilisi ni.
en: When the Israelites saw that they were in trouble and that their troops were threatened, they hid in caves, in thickets, among rocks, in tunnels, and in cisterns.

dag: O daa dila nam maa yuun pihinahi ni yini Jɛrusalɛm. O yabipaɣa n-daa nyɛ Absalom bipuɣiŋga Maaka.
en: and he ruled forty-one years in Jerusalem. His grandmother was Maacah, the daughter of Absalom.

dag: ka Zimiri daa kana nti ŋme o luhi ku o; ka daa di nam zan o zaani. Juda Naa Asa ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisinaayopɔin saha ka dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋ maa.
en: Zimri came, attacked, and killed Elah in the twenty-seventh year of Judahs King Asa. Zimri succeeded him as king.

dag: A ba Naawuni ni sɔŋ a. Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Kpiɔŋlan Naa ŋɔ ni chɛ ka saa mi a. O ni chɛ ka kom yi tiŋgbani puuni na a zuɣu. O ni ti a bihi mini niɣi pam.
en: the God of your father who helps you. May God All-Powerful bless you and give you blessings from the sky above and from the deep below. May he give you blessings from breast and womb.

dag: Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa ti bɔh o ŋahili maa gbinni.
en: Jesus' disciples asked him what the story meant.

dag: Ŋuna ka Naawuni tibigi n-zaŋ o ʒili o nudirigu polo ni o leei ti toondana ni ti tiligira n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim niŋ tuuba ka nya alahichi chɛ m-paŋ.
en: God raised him to his right side as Leader and Savior, to give the people of Israel the opportunity to repent and have their sins forgiven.

dag: Ka dɔbba bɛn zaa daa be o yiŋ puuni, ka nyɛ bɛ ni dɔɣi bidib shɛb mini bɛ ni daa zaŋ bɛ liɣiri da shɛb tinzunnim sani zaa gba daa guni.
en: Also, on that day all the men in Abrahams house were circumcised. All the slaves born in his house and all the slaves he had bought were circumcised.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba pinaayi maa laɣim ʒini ni bɛ di bindirigu maa.
en: That evening he took his place at the table with the twelve disciples.

dag: Ka Sool daa baŋ Dauda kukoli maa ka bɔh o, M bia Dauda, a kukoli m-bala? Ka Dauda garigi yɛli, N dan naa, n kukoli m-bala.
en: Saul knew Davids voice and said, Is that your voice, David my son? David answered, Yes, it is my voice, my lord the king.

dag: Dama do so ŋun pa yɛdaniŋda leeri Naawuni ni deeri so la o paɣ zuɣu, ka paɣ so ŋun pa yɛdaniŋda gba leeri Naawuni ni deeri so la o yidan zuɣu; dama di yi pa lala, bɛ bihi ni nyɛla Naawuni ni ku deei shɛba, amaa ka bɛ di pun nyɛla o ni deei shɛba.
