en: Your husband or wife who isn't a follower is made holy by having you as a partner. This also makes your children holy and keeps them from being unclean in God's sight.

dag: Hilikia ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛnjamin tiŋgban ni tin shɛli din yuli booni Anatɔt la maligumaaniba ni yino la bia Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ.
en: This book is the account of what was said by Jeremiah son of Hilkiah, one of the priests of the town of Anathoth in the territory of Benjamin.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi daa zaŋ Yisa kpe Gomna Pailɛt yiŋ dundɔŋ ni nti laɣim bɛ tɔbbi tab zaa na.
en: The soldiers took Jesus inside to the courtyard of the governor's palace and called together the rest of the company.

dag: Nimaani ka o daa ti nya do so ŋun yuli booni Ɛnias, ka o gbaya kpi ka o do tiŋa yuma anii zaa.
en: There he met a man named Aeneas, who for eight years had been sick in bed and could not move.

dag: A nyina piɛlimi kaman bɛ ni chɛ piɛ nyaan shɛb kɔbiri ka su ba kom ka bɛ piɛli shɛm la. Zaɣ yini kam malila jaa, ka zaɣ yini bi pooi di ni.
en: Your teeth are white like ewes just coming from their bath. They all give birth to twins; not one of them has lost a baby.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti yɛli Jɛrusalɛmnima, Pɔhim tulli ni ti yi n sani daboya zuɣusaa n-ʒe n-yi tiŋgban nɛli ni na nti ʒe n-kpa n niriba bɛn yɛla mali nambɔɣu ŋɔ polo, di pala pɔhim shɛli din ni yɛli binyara bee din ni pɔbisi binyara saɣiri chaŋ.
en: At that time, this people and Jerusalem will be told: A blistering wind from the bare heights; it rages in the desert toward my people, not merely to winnow or cleanse.

dag: Juda zuliya ni, ninvuɣ tuhi pinaayi ka bɛ daa tabili, Rubin zuliya ni tuhi pinaayi, Gaad zuliya ni tuhi pinaayi.
en: twelve thousand from each tribe: Judah, Reuben, Gad, Asher, Naphtali, Manasseh, Simeon, Levi, Issachar, Zebulun, Joseph, and Benjamin.

dag: N zaŋ n fabila sɔŋla o tooni. N yɛli n yɛlimuɣisira ni nyɛ shɛli o tooni.
en: I tell you all my worries and my troubles.

dag: Wulimpuhili zaŋ chaŋ wulinluhili ni waɣ shɛm, lala ka o yihi ti daalahichi bahi katiŋa.
en: And he has taken our sins as far away from us as the east is from the west.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia daa kpe n ni n-yiɣisi ma zali n naba zuɣu. Ka o daa tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣa yɛli ma, Kulimi ti kpari amaŋ niŋ a yiŋa.
en: But the Spirit came into me and lifted me up on my feet. He said to me, Go home and lock yourself in your house.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum Naa maa yɛligu maa bahi ka bɛ yi n-gbaai chandi; bɛ ni daa chani maa ka saŋmar so bɛ ni daa nya wulimpuhili polo maa dii gari bɛ tooni hal nti kpalim zani bia maa ni daa be yil shɛli maa dɛde.
en: The wise men listened to what the king said and then left. And the star they had seen in the east went on ahead of them until it stopped over the place where the child was.

dag: M bi daai Naawuni daalibarika baɣili, dama taali ni yibu Naawuni sani yi yila Naawuni fukumsi zaligu dolibu ni na, dindina Masia kum la ka daliri.
en: I dont ignore the grace of God, because if we become righteous through the Law, then Christ died for no purpose.

dag: yurilim zuɣu chɛ ka n naɣ suhir a mi. Man Pool ŋun nyɛ ninkurigu ka lan nyɛ dansarika Yisa Masia zuɣu la.
en: But because I love you, I make a request instead. I do this even though I am Paul, the ambassador of Christ Jesus, and at present also a prisoner for his sake.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, Zɔri, ŋuni n-lee zaŋ ma leei yi sariakarita bee yi falitarita.
en: Jesus answered him, Friend, who gave me the right to judge or to divide the property between you two.

dag: Yuuni puuni gol so ŋun be tooni biɛɣ pisinaanahi dali ka n daa ʒe Tigiris Mɔɣ tital la duli.
en: Then, on the twenty-fourth day of the first month, as I was on the bank of the great Tigris River.

dag: n ni daa na mali yaa, ka Naawuni zɔtali na be n yiŋ la.
en: I was in the prime of life, God All-Powerful was my closest friend.

dag: Bɛ naa daa nyɛla bɔɣ zilinli din ziliŋ ka tariga la malaika ŋun Hiburu yuli booni Abadɔn, ka o Giriiki yuli mi booni Apoliɔn la. Di gbinni nyɛla, Saɣinda.
en: They had a ruler, who was the angel of the bottomless pit. His name in Hebrew is Abaddon. In Greek it is Apollyon.

dag: Ka n ni pii ninvuɣ so jaaŋgbee ni puhi vari. Lala ka n yɛn niŋ ka Izraɛlnim chɛ bɛ kparima ni ŋumbu shɛli bɛ ni ŋumdi niŋdi ya sahakam maa.
en: I will then choose a man to be my priest, and his stick will sprout. After that happens, I won't have to listen to any more complaints about you.

dag: N yila m Ba sani n-ka dunia ŋɔ ni na; ka lan yɛn yi dunia ŋɔ ni labi m Ba maa sani.
en: I came from the Father into the world. Now I am leaving the world and going back to the Father.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa guli tiŋ maa dunɔdali maa daa moli bahi ha, ka bɛ daa zaŋ li yɛli nayilinima.
en: The guards reported the news to the king's palace.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛli n taali a yuli zuɣu, dama n daalahichi galisiya pam.
en: Lord , I have done many wrong things. But I ask you to forgive them all to show your goodness.

dag: Amaa a dabili maa yi yɛl a, N ku chaŋ ka chɛ a, ka di nyɛla o ni yur a mini a yiŋnima yi ni gbib o viɛnyɛliŋga zuɣu.
en: But one of your slaves may say, I love you and your family, and I would be better off staying with you, so please don't make me leave.

dag: Ka Dauda daa ŋmalig o sani n-chaŋ shɛb sani nti lan yɛli lala yaha; ka niriba maa gba garigi yɛl o kaman bɛn la ni pun yɛl o shɛm maa.
en: Then he turned and asked another soldier the same thing he had asked the others, and he got the same answer.

dag: Naa Dauda daa tum Naawuni yubu o ʒiɛman ni, ka daa ti paɣi Naawuni, ka bɛ sɔɣ o o yaannim siliga ni ka o pooi;.
en: For David served God's purposes in his own time, and then he died, was buried with his ancestors, and his body rotted in the grave.

dag: Zaŋ lab nuzaa polo, bɛ tiŋgbani maa daa piligila Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni n-zaŋ hal ti du Jɛriko nuzaa polo kuŋkuni n-zaŋ kpa wulinluhili polo ti du zoya zuɣu m-mali hal ti paai di tariga Bɛtavɛn yɔɣu ni.
en: Benjamin's northern border started at the Jordan River and went up the ridge north of Jericho, then on west into the hill country as far as the Beth-Aven Desert.

dag: O ni daa ti nya Yisa ka o be katiŋa, ka o guui ti damd o tooni.
en: He was some distance away when he saw Jesus; so he ran, fell on his knees before him.

dag: hal n ni nyɛla ŋun daa yɛr o zilima ka niŋd o alaka ka tur o la zaa yoli. Amaa Naawuni daa zo ma nambɔɣu, dama n daa niŋ li la ʒilinsi ni n ni daa na bi niŋ yɛda la zuɣu.
en: I used to say terrible and insulting things about him, and I was cruel. But Christ had mercy on me because I didn't know what I was doing, and I had not yet put my faith in him.

dag: Mɔɣa kom zɔri ti lurila teeku ni, amaa ka di bi paana. Kɔzɔrima maa ni zɔri yiri luɣ shɛŋa na, nimaani ka di na kul zɔri yirina.
en: All streams flow to the sea, but the sea is never full; to the place where the rivers flow, there they continue to flow.

dag: Din dali maa wain ni ti tɔɣiri zoya zuɣusaa luri na; ka bihim ti zɔri daboya zuɣu; ka Juda kulibɔna zaa ti pali kom zɔra. Ka kɔbil nini ti yooi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu, ka kom zɔri ti luri Akasia Vinvamli ni.
en: In that day the mountains will drip sweet wine, the hills will flow with milk, and all the streambeds of Judah will flow with water; a spring will come forth from the LORDs house and water the Shittim Valley.

dag: Di saha ka n daa nya niriba ayi ka bɛ ʒe m-baɣi mɔɣili, yino daa ʒɛla yaɣ yini polo, ka ŋun la mi ʒe yaɣ din la polo.
en: Then I, Daniel, noticed two other men. One man was standing on my side of the river, and the other was standing on the other side.

dag: Naa Sulemaana daa malila kpambaliba kɔbisiyi ni pihinu ka bɛ su niriba fukumsi.
en: There were officials in charge of the forced labor working on the various building projects.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlimiya Izraɛlnim zaa ni goli ŋɔ biɛɣu pia dali yiliyidan kam ŋun bom piɛbila o min o malibu zuɣu, ka yili kam ti mali piɛbila.
en: Tell the people of Israel that on the tenth day of this month the head of each family must choose a lamb or a young goat for his family to eat.

dag: Ka dabili maa yi niŋ a ni wuh o shɛm maa, a ni puh o di zuɣu? Aai!.
en: Servants don't deserve special thanks for doing what they are supposed to do.

dag: Ka daa yɛli sapashini ni o zaŋm Pool ti kpɛhi duu, amaa ka lee wɔɣis o, ka chɛ ka o zɔnim bɛn bɔri ni bɛ sɔŋd o kan o sanna.
en: He then ordered the army officer to keep Paul under guard, but not to lock him up or to stop his friends from helping him.

dag: Ka n daa na kul suhiri Naawuni, ka kahigiri m mini n niriba Izraɛlnim daalahichi wuhiri Naawuni, ka balindi ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ ni o chɛ ka o Jɛmbu du kasi la lan me n-zali yaha.
en: I was still confessing my sins and those of all Israel to the Lord my God, and I was praying for the good of his holy mountain.

dag: Ka ninsalinim yi yi dunia ŋɔ binyara din tari ba daɣiri ni, bɛ ni baŋ ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira Yisa Masia la puuni, di yi lan gbahi ba nyaŋ ba, di nyaaŋa bɛ ni be barina ni di saha maa gari di piligu ni.
en: If people escape the moral filth of this world through the knowledge of our Lord and savior Jesus Christ, then get tangled up in it again and are overcome by it, they are worse off than they were before.

dag: O yi ti labina o dabisili la dali ni o ti nya tibiginsim o ninvuɣ gahinda sani, ka nya jilima bɛn zaa niŋ o yɛda la sani, yinim gba ni ti be bɛ ni, yi ni daa niŋ ti ni zaŋ shɛhira shɛli yɛla na nti yɛli ya la yɛda la zuɣu.
en: This will happen on the day when the Lord Jesus comes to receive honor with his holy people. He will be admired among all who have believed. And this includes you because you believed what we told you.

dag: Nir jɛrilim tuma bahir o yoli, di zaa yoli ka o suhu yiɣisiri bahiri Yawɛ zuɣu.
en: Peoples own folly corrupts their way, but their hearts rage against the LORD.

dag: Ka n kurim n-teei dɔni m puli zuɣu, ka kul chani gindi n-fabindi dabisi muni puuni zaa.
en: My body is twisted and bent, and I groan all day long.

dag: Bɛ ni ti bela fɔntiŋ shɛŋa din kpalim dabari ni, ka be yiya shɛŋa din nyɛ nir ni ku be yiya shɛŋa ni, din nyɛ bɛ ni lo nia ni bɛ wurim shɛŋa la.
en: They are the ones who captured cities and seized houses whose owners had fled, but war will destroy those cities and houses.

dag: Ka ŋmahi piɛlaa maa, ka paɣ o nyɔri min o biɛhi n-zaŋ li pahi nimdi maa mini binzuɣu la zuɣu.
en: Then cut the ram into several pieces. Wash all the parts from inside the ram and the legs. Put these things with the head and the other pieces of the ram.

dag: Teemiy o daalikauli yɛla sahakam. O ni daa zaŋ yɛligu shɛli zali ʒiɛmana tuhili nim la;.
en: Never forget God's covenant, which he made to last forever.

dag: Malimiya firilanim ayopɔin tam di zuɣu, ka di ne di tooni.
en: Then make seven lamps to go on the lampstand. These lamps will give light to the area in front of the lampstand.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛl kpamba zaa daa ka naa sanna Hiburɔn, ka Dauda ti lo ba alikauli Yawɛ tooni Hiburɔn. Ka bɛ daa booi kpam bahi Dauda zuɣu ni n-zaŋ o leei Izraɛl naa kaman Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Samuɛl yɛli shɛm la.
en: So all the leaders of Israel came to King David at Hebron. He made a sacred alliance with them, they anointed him, and he became king of Israel, just as the Lord had promised through Samuel.

dag: Yawɛ, yiɣisima n-lu bɛ zuɣu nyaŋ ba. Zaŋm a takɔbi n-fa n nyɛvili ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni bahi.
en: Come, Lord ! Oppose my enemies and defeat them! Save me from the wicked by your sword;.

dag: Suhimiya Naawuni n-tim ti gba ka Naawuni mali soli ti ti ka ti tɔɣisi o yɛligu n-kahigi Masia ashili yɛtɔɣa gbinni ni nyɛ shɛm wuhiri niriba. Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka m be sarika ni ŋɔ.
en: At the same time pray also for us, so that God will give us a good opportunity to preach his message about the secret of Christ. For that is why I am now in prison.

dag: Tin shɛli nim daa bi tim sandaani n-niŋ Izraɛlnima, naɣila Hivinim bɛn daa be Gibiɔn la kɔŋko. Amaa ka bɛ daa ŋme n-ku bɛn zaa kpalim la tɔb ni.
en: Only one city in all the land made a peace agreement with Israel. That was the Hivite city of Gibeon. All the other cities were defeated in war.

dag: dama buni bi beni sahakam, ka nam zuɣupiligu mi kul ku beni ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: because wealth and honor don't last forever.

dag: Daadam, kummi ka fabili, dama di nyɛla din yɛn lu n niriba zuɣu, di nyɛla din yɛn lu Izraɛl nanim zaa zuɣu. Bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi maa ku bɛ mini n niriba. Mbaye! Kpahimiya yi gbalipina.
en: Howl in grief, mortal man; this sword is meant for my people and for all the leaders of Israel. They are going to be killed with all the rest of my people. Beat your breast in despair!.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, o mali buɣim shɛli din yɛn di Asiria naa sɔŋ ka di waɣa. Buɣim maa dari kul pumi, ka doya yɛlim ka zilim pam. Yawɛ ni vuhi o vuhim din ŋmani chilibi bahi di zuɣu, ka di taai buɣim.
en: His place for burning was arranged long ago; it is indeed made ready for a king. God has made its wood pile wide and deep, fire and wood in abundance. The breath of the LORD, like a stream of brimstone, ignites it.

dag: ka ania niŋbu tahiri biɛrisuntali na, ka biɛrisuntali tahiri tahima na.
en: endurance brings God's approval, and his approval creates hope.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ kumiya bidibbihi mini paɣ shɛb bɛn pun baŋ dɔbba la zaa.
en: Now kill every male child and every female who has known a man intimately by sleeping with him.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛli Kɛnnima, Yimiya chaŋ ka chɛ Amalɛknim ŋɔ, di so ni n ti ku ba tabili ya; dama yi daa niŋ Izraɛlnim zaa nirilim pam saha shɛli bɛ ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la. Di saha ka Kɛnnim maa daa yi ka chɛ Amalɛknim maa.
en: Saul told the Kenites, Get going! Leave the Amalekites immediately because you showed kindness to the Israelites when they came out of Egypt. Otherwise, Ill destroy you right along with them. So the Kenites left the Amalekites.

dag: bee so yi tum alahichi ka baŋ ni o tum taali, di simdi ka o labis o ni zu shɛli bee o ni fa shɛli bee bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛli puh o zalibu maa bee o ni pihi binshɛli.
en: When you sin in any of these ways, you must repay whatever you got by dishonest means. On the day you are found guilty, you must repay the owner in full, plus an additional percent.

dag: Hal pumpɔŋɔ lɛhu domi gu tihi; dinzuɣu tia kam din bi wandi wal suma, bɛ ni ŋmaa li luhi n-zaŋ nyo buɣim.
en: The ax is already at the root of the trees. Therefore, every tree that doesnt produce good fruit will be chopped down and tossed into the fire.

dag: Bɛ bi zɔri lahiba biɛri. Bɛ suhuri kul ʒiɛla yim, ka bɛ nyɛ bɛn niŋ Yawɛ naani.
en: Bad news won't bother them; they have decided to trust the Lord .

dag: Yi yi du m-bala Ijiptinim bɛ yuri mini bɛ chɛchɛbunsi zuɣu, wula ka yi lee yɛn tooi niŋ kari n dan sapashinnim ni ŋun pɔri gba.
en: You are no match for even the lowest ranking Assyrian official, and yet you expect the Egyptians to send you chariots and horsemen.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ sipirɛs dari pili pie tab tabili duu maa puuni dukpini, ka dooi salima alali pa di zuɣu, ka chɛ ka bɛ mali abie tihi mini zoligɔnim kɔtomsi pa di zuɣu.
en: He put panels made of cypress wood on the walls of the larger room. Then he put pure gold over the cypress panels and then put pictures of palm trees and chains on the gold.

dag: Ka Nuhu min o paɣa ni o bidibisi ni bɛ paɣiba maa daa yi ŋariŋ maa ni na.
en: After Noah and his family had left the boat.

dag: Ka o daa wum yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ ka o suhu saɣim pam, dama o daa nyɛla bundana.
en: But when the man heard this, he became very sad, because he was very rich.

dag: dama nyɛvili gari bindirigu, ka niŋgbuŋ mi gari situra.
en: There is more to life than food and more to the body than clothing.

dag: Yɛhudianim pam ni daa wum ni Yisa be nimaani maa ka bɛ daa kana. Pa Yisa kɔŋko zuɣu ka bɛ daa kana, amaa bɛ daa kamina ni bɛ ti nya Lazarɔs so Yisa ni daa neei kum ni la.
en: A large number of people heard that Jesus was in Bethany, so they went there, not only because of Jesus but also to see Lazarus, whom Jesus had raised from death.

dag: Buɣa ni naai kahikahi.
en: All the idols will be gone.

dag: A du zoli din du pam zuɣu ka zaŋ daba pam mali chaŋ; ka deei pina niriba sani hal zaŋ tabili ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ duŋtaariba bɛn je ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ be nimaani la sani.
en: You ascended the heights, leading away your captives, receiving tribute from people, even from those who rebel against the LORD Gods dwelling there.

dag: N daa lan yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na m mali ya be mɔɣu ni yuun pihinahi ni yi deei Amɔrinim tiŋgbɔŋ su.
en: I was the one who brought you from the land of Egypt. For years I led you through the desert. I helped you take the Amorites land.

dag: Dinzuɣu wummiya Yawɛ ni lo nia shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ Babilɔn polo ni o ni yɛn niŋ Babilɔnnim shɛm. Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ ni ti dari bɛ bihi chaŋ, ka bɛ yɛla ti gbaai bɛ tiŋ maa nim dabiɛm.
en: Listen to my plans for you, people of Babylonia. Your children will be dragged off, and your country destroyed.

dag: N ni darigi bɛ tibili bɛ daalahichi mini bɛ yaannim daalahichi zuɣu, dama bɛ tuɣindi tulaale zim buɣa maligu zoya zuɣu, ka tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri zaŋ chaŋ m polo. N shiri ni darigi bɛ tibili pam bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I, the Lord , will make them pay for their sins and for those of their ancestors— they have disgraced me by burning incense on mountains.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, a tɛhiya ni Yawɛ ʒila n ni kana ni n ti saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ yɛla? Yawɛ n-yɛli ma ni n kamina ti saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: Don't forget that it was the Lord who sent me here with orders to destroy your nation!.

dag: Ka tumo maa daa chaŋ ti yɛli Dauda Jɔab ni daa yɛl o ni o ti yɛli shɛm zaa.
en: So the messenger went to David and told him what Joab had commanded him to say.

dag: Ka anabinim maa daa kul kuhiri pampam, ka mali suhi mini kpana ŋ-ŋmari bɛmaŋa ka chɔhiri bɛmaŋa kaman bɛ taara ni daa nyɛ shɛm hal ka ʒim ti puhiri yiri bɛ niŋgbuna ni na.
en: So the prophets prayed louder. They cut themselves with swords and spears. They cut themselves until they were bleeding all over.

dag: Ka n lan nya shɛli dunia ni, ka di gba nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: I have noticed something else in life that is useless.

dag: Yuun shɛli din pahiri yuma awɛi ni gol so ŋun pahiri pia la biɛɣu pia dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: The word of the Lord came to me. This was on the tenth day of the tenth month in the ninth year of exile. He said.

dag: Lala ka n daa shiri niŋ Jɛrusalɛm. Maligumaaniba kpamba daa ti ma yiko, ka n gbahi Yisa nyaandoliba pam ti kpɛhi duu, amaa pa lala kɔŋko ka n daa niŋ. Bɛ ni daa ti yɛn ku bɛ ni shɛb la n gba daa ʒiɛla bɛn yɛn ku ba maa nyaaŋa.
en: I did this first in Jerusalem, and with the authority of the chief priests I put many of God's people in jail. I even voted for them to be killed.

dag: Ti bemi kaman bɛ ni ʒi shɛba, amaa ka lee nyɛ bɛ ni mi shɛb viɛnyɛliŋga. Ti bemi kaman bɛn kpira, amaa nyamiya, ka lee nyɛ bɛn be. Ti bemi kaman bɛ ni darigi shɛb tiba, amaa ka lee nyɛ bɛ ni bi ku shɛba.
en: as unknown and well known, as dying—and look, we are alive! We were seen as punished but not killed.

dag: Dunia salinim zaa, yilimiya suhupiɛlli yila paɣi Yawɛ!.
en: Shout triumphantly to the LORD, all the earth!.

dag: Ka Sool daa ti zaŋ kpani maa m-bɔr ni o to Dauda tabili dukpini, amaa ka Dauda daa fɔhi Sool, ka o zaŋ kpani maa to n-nyɔɣila dukpini. Ka Dauda daa guui n-zo n-tiligi yuŋ maa.
en: Saul tried to pin David to the wall with his spear, but David dodged, and the spear stuck in the wall. David ran away and escaped.

dag: Amaa Naawuni chɛ ka o Shia Kasi kahigi li wuhi tinima; dama Naawuni Shia Kasi n-nyɛ ŋun vihiri binshɛɣukam hal zaŋ tabili Naawuni yɛla din gbinni zilima.
en: But God has shown us these things through the Spirit. The Spirit knows all things. The Spirit even knows the deep secrets of God.

dag: Ka yi mini yi yiŋnim zaa ni tooi di li luɣ shɛlikam zaa; dama yi ni tumdi tuun shɛŋa Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili ni la yɔri m-bala.
en: Your share may be eaten anywhere by anyone in your family, because it is your pay for working at the sacred tent.

dag: Yawɛ, di chɛ ma nambɔɣu zɔbu. Chɛ ka a yurilim maŋli min a ʒiɛyimtal la kul guli ma.
en: So now you, LORD— dont hold back any of your compassion from me. Let your loyal love and faithfulness always protect me.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun ti wum dabiɛm maa yɛla ka zɔri ni ti lu bɔɣili ni, ka ŋun mi ti zo n-yi bɔɣili maa ni na, zana ni gbaag o. Dama sa kurili ni ti luna, ka tiŋgbani zaa sɔhira.
en: Whoever flees from the sound of terror will fall into the trench; whoever climbs from the trench will be caught in the trap. Heavens windows will open, and the earths foundations will quake.

dag: ti yɛl o, Ti dana, ti teeya ni ʒirilan la ni daa be o nyɛvil ni la, o daa yɛliya ni o ni ti neei kum ni daba ata dali.
en: They said, Sir, we remember that while that deceiver was still alive he said, After three days I will arise.

dag: Ti mabihi, suhimiya Naawuni tiri ti gba.
en: Pray also for us, friends.

dag: Ka Shɛkɛmnim daa bo niriba n-chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ ti sɔɣi do zoya zuɣu gu Abimilɛk, ka daa kul fari bɛnkam zaa doli nimaani gariti nɛma. Ka bɛ daa yɛli Abimilɛk di yɛla.
en: The men of Shechem put men in ambush against Abimelech on the mountaintops, and they robbed everyone who passed their way. Abimelech was told about this.

dag: Malimiya sara shɛli yi ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl Yawɛ san la. Dina n-nyɛ: naɣilabih ayi mini piɛla yino ni yuun yini piɛlabih ayopɔin.
en: Offer two young bulls, one full-grown ram, and seven rams a year old as sacrifices to please me.

dag: Deemiya saɣisigu kaman din yi yi ba sanna, dama di wuhiri ni Naawuni lihi ya la o bihi. Bi ŋuni n-lee beni ka o ba bi saɣisir o?.
en: Endure what you suffer as being a father's punishment; your suffering shows that God is treating you as his children. Was there ever a child who was not punished by his father?.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, n suhir a, chɛ ka mani a dabili ŋɔ kpalim leegi n dan dabili ka chɛ bia maa, ka a chɛ ka o dol o biɛyanim maa kuli.
en: Sir, I am your slave. Please let me stay here in place of Benjamin and let him return home with his brothers.

dag: Dama m mi ni yi nyɛla tipawumlinima, ka yi nyiŋgoya kpɛm gari kurigu, ka yi gbɛri mi be kaman daanya la.
en: I knew you were stubborn and hardheaded.

dag: Di simdi ka suhuyiɣisililan nya tibidarigibo, amaa a yi fa o bahi, shee ka a lan niŋ lala yaha.
en: People with bad tempers are always in trouble, and they need help over and over again.

dag: Yi daa wum di yɛla la ti tumtumdikpee Ɛpafiras so ti ni yura, ka o nyɛ Masia tumtumda ŋun ʒe yim ka ʒe ti zaani la sani.
en: You learned it from Epaphras, who is the fellow slave we love and Christs faithful minister for your sake.

dag: Juda Naa Jɔsia bia Jɛhoyakim nam dibu yuma anahi ni ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ:.
en: In the fourth year of Judahs King Jehoiakim, Josiahs son, this word came to Jeremiah from the LORD.

dag: Amaa yi kpalim jɛmdila yi wuni din nyɛ yi naa ka yi booni li Sakut la mini yi saŋmariga wuni din yuli booni Kaiwan la binnana.
en: You will take up Sakkuth your king, and Kaiwan your star-god, your images, which you made for yourselves.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ daa nya Yawɛ ni niŋ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Pɛɔr Baal polo la, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daa ku yi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa doli Pɛɔr Baal maa.
en: You yourselves saw what the Lord did at Mount Peor. He destroyed everyone who worshiped Baal there.

dag: Ka n tarili lee nyɛ dini Naawuni ŋun be zuɣusaa ŋɔ sani? Ka n fali lee nyɛ dini Kpiɔŋlan Naa ŋun be zuɣusaa ŋɔ sani?.
en: What does Almighty God do to us? How does he repay human deeds?.

dag: ka bɛn mi nuu be dunia ŋɔ dibu yɛla ni be kaman bɛn nuu ka di ni. Dama dunia ŋɔ biɛhigu garitimi maa.
en: You should use the things of the world without letting them become important to you. This is how you should live, because this world, the way it is now, will soon be gone.

dag: N teeya ni n ni daa naɣ lan baptaizi shɛb nyɛla Stɛfanas yiŋnima, din mi nyaaŋa m bi tɛhi ni n lan baptaizi so yaha.
en: Oh yes, I also baptized Stephanas and his family; but I can't remember whether I baptized anyone else.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni deei n kawana, kawana ŋahibu saha, ka deei n wain, wain tɔɣibu saha, ka deei n daago mini atampa shɛli n ni daa zaŋ ti o ni o lir o gbin la.
en: So I will return and take back my grain at the time it is ready to be harvested. I will take back my wine at the time the grapes are ready. I will take back my wool and linen. I gave those things to her so that she could cover her naked body.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Naawuni ŋ-ŋman a, ka nyɛ ŋun chɛr o niriba bɛn kpalim taali, ka bi lan doli bɛ biriginsim tuma? A suhu yi yiɣisi, di lan maara; dama a yuri nambɔzɔbo.
en: Who is a God like you, pardoning iniquity, overlooking the sin of the few remaining for his inheritance? He doesnt hold on to his anger forever; he delights in faithful love.

dag: ka nyɛ ŋun niŋdi binshɛŋa o ba ni daa bi niŋ, ka diri bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa mali buɣa zoya zuɣu la, ka zaŋdi o kpee paɣa doona.
en: his father never did. He eats meat at local shrines, has sex with someone else's wife.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ n labisir o mi na ni n ti ti a, dimbɔŋɔ wuhiri ni n zaŋla n suhu m-pah o zuɣu ti a.
en: I am sending him back to you now, and with him goes my heart.

dag: N ni yɛli shɛm ŋɔ nyɛla din yɛn mali soli tin ya, amaa di pala zaligu.
en: In my opinion that is what should be done, though I don't know of anything the Lord said about this matter.

dag: Yawɛ zɔbu n-nyɛ baŋsim piligu, jɛra bɛn lihi ʒiɛmla yɛm mini wuhibu.
en: To have knowledge, you must first have reverence for the Lord . Stupid people have no respect for wisdom and refuse to learn.

dag: Ka Abinɛr min o niriba maa daa chaŋ yuŋ maa zaa n-gari Araba ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du, zaŋ chaŋ wuntaŋ daa ti yɛn zani zuɣu ni ka bɛ paai Mahanaim.
en: Abner and his men then marched all night through the wilderness, crossing the Jordan River and marching all morning until they got to Mahanaim.

dag: ni teebul la mini di dapuhi ni di lahi zaa ni bɔrɔbɔro din be kasi.
en: the table with its carrying poles and all that goes on it, including the sacred bread;.

dag: N ni kpuɣi n tiliginsim pipia zuɣusaa, ka kuhi boli Yawɛ yuli.
en: Ill lift up the cup of salvation. Ill call on the LORDs name.

dag: Na so ŋun pahi n-nyɛ Bashan Naa Ogi ŋun daa nyɛ Rɛfaimnim ni yino ŋun kpalim ka be Ashitarɔt mini Ɛdirɛi;.
en: They also defeated King Og of Bashan. Og was from the Rephaites. He ruled the land in Ashtaroth and Edrei.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi kali Yaakubu zuliya? Bee ŋuni n-lee ni tooi kali Izraɛl zuliya maa pirigibu bunahi puuni yim? Chɛ ka n kpila wuntizɔra kum, ka chɛ ka m bahigu ti be kaman o bahigu.
en: Who can count Jacobs people? They are as many as the grains of dust. No one can count even a fourth of the Israelites. Let me die like a good man. Let my life end as happy as theirs.

dag: Ka o bipalitab bɛn min o daa laɣim zooi maa yɛl o, Di ni simdi ni a yɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛl a, A ba daa ʒil ti ʒi tibisa pam, amaa nyin filimmi li ti ti la shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, yɛlim ba, Man nubil kpaliŋga bari gari m ba shee!.
en: Then the young men who grew up with him answered, Those people came to you and said, Your father forced us to work very hard. Now make our work easier. So you should tell them, My little finger is stronger than my fathers whole body.

dag: M bia, mali yɛm, ka chɛ ka n suhu piɛla, ka n ni tooi garigi ŋunkam galindi ma yɛtɔɣa.
en: Be wise, my child, and I will be happy; I will have an answer for anyone who criticizes me.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa ti chɛ ka ŋmani yiɣi yi ni o nyaa kom maa nyuuya.
en: Then he sent out a dove to see if the waters on all of the fertile land had subsided.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Musa daa zaŋ bɛ ni boori kpa shɛli bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni la m-booi li bahi Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili la mini binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni la zuɣu m-mali di zaa.
en: Then Moses took the anointing oil and put it on the Tent of the Lord 's presence and everything that was in it, and in this way he dedicated it all to the Lord .

dag: Ɛtan bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Azaria.
en: Ethan's son was Azariah.

dag: Dama ninsal suhu ni ka dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha yirina. Dina n-nyɛ: Tɛhi biɛri mini zina niŋbu balibu kam ni tayiɣisigu ni ninvuɣ kubo.
en: All these bad things begin inside a person, in the mind: bad thoughts, sexual sins, stealing, murder.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kana, ka o yɛli ba ni bɛ cham ti chɛ ka Napaɣ Vashiti zaŋ o napaɣ nam zuɣupiligu pili, ka bɛ zaŋ o na. Napaɣ maa daa nyɛla paɣ viɛlli, ka naa maa daa bɔri ni o zaŋ o viɛlim maa wuh o tuma zuɣulaannim min o saamba maa zaa.
en: They were to bring Queen Vashti before him wearing the royal crown. She was gorgeous, and he wanted to show off her beauty both to the general public and to his important guests.

dag: Mbusim be yi zuɣu, yi zaŋla ʒiri gabisi vɔri tuumbiɛri, ka vɔri alahichi kaman tɔroko din mali gabisi la.
en: Doom to those who drag guilt along with cords of fraud, and haul sin as if with cart ropes.

dag: Ka Dan zuliya niriba maa yɛl o, Miri ka a chɛ ka ti niriba ŋɔ wum a damli, ka bɛ puuni suhuyiɣisilinim lu a zuɣu n-ku a min a yiŋnima.
en: We don't want to hear any more about it, the people of Dan said. And if you make us angry, you'll only get yourself and your family killed.

dag: Yi mi Naawuni ni daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛli nti yɛli Izraɛlnim la yɛla; bɛ daa yihi lahibal suŋ waazu wuhi ni suhudoo yirila Yisa Masia sanna. Ŋuna n-nyɛ sokam zaa Duuma.
en: God has spoken to the people of Israel. He sent them the Good News that peace has come through Jesus Christ, the Lord of all people.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa tam Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋun daa tiligi ba bɛ dimnim bɛn gili bɛ luɣilikam zaa nuu ni la yɛla.
en: The Israelites forgot that the Lord was their God, and that he had rescued them from the enemies who lived around them.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: The Lord said to me:.

dag: a yi yɛli, Nyama, ti di bi mi dimbɔŋɔ. Ŋun mi din be ninsal suhu ni la nya li. Ŋun gul a bi mi li? O ku yo nira o tuma samli?.
en: You cannot say, Its none of my business. The Lord knows everything, and he knows why you do things. He watches you, and he will pay you back for what you do.

dag: Ka shɛb mi daa bɔri ni bɛ zahim o, ka yɛl o ni o wuhim ba alizanda ni shihirili.
en: Some others there wanted to test Jesus. They asked him to do a miracle as a sign from God.

dag: Ka Sool daa me sara maligu bimbini zali Yawɛ; dina n-daa nyɛ o ni tuui me sara maligu bimbin shɛli zali Yawɛ.
en: Saul built an altar to the Lord , the first one that he built.

dag: O ni yihi ma zaɣ biɛɣukam ni, ka ni gbib ma hal nti paag o daalizanda nam ni. Ŋuna n-simdi tibigibu hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: And the Lord will rescue me from all evil and take me safely into his heavenly Kingdom. To him be the glory forever and ever! Amen.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli do so ŋun ye binyɛr piɛlli la, Cham kalima shɛŋa din be chɛrubinim tiŋli la gbini nti mooi buɣimsal nɛma chɛrubinim maa sunsuuni pali a nuhi n-zaŋ li yaɣiri tiŋ maa zuɣu. Ka n daa yuun o ka o chaŋ.
en: He said to the man clothed in linen: Go in between the wheels under the winged creatures. Fill your hands with fiery coals from between the winged creatures, and scatter them over the city. As I watched, he went in.

dag: Ka baŋ daa be binzaa maa zuɣusaa, ka di dubu nyɛ sɛntimita pisinaayi. Binzaa maa zuɣusaa polo mini di bintaɣirisi ni di dapaɣa daa nyɛla zaɣ mundili yini.
en: There was a strip of bronze around the top of each cart. It was made as one piece with the cart.

dag: Dinzuɣu zaŋmiya yimaŋ zaa ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, ka dol o zalikpana la min o fukumsi zaligunim la kaman yi ni niŋ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: You people must be loyal and true to the Lord our God. You must always follow and obey all of his laws and commands. You must continue to obey in the future as you do now.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yi di nasara, niriba malila suhupiɛlli pam, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri yi di nasara, niriba sɔɣirimi.
en: When the righteous rejoice, there is great respect, but people hide when the wicked prosper.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa yɛli Naawuni, N suhir a, dolimi Ishimail nyɛvili.
en: He asked God, Why not let Ishmael be my heir.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ka di chaŋ wula ka Anabi Musa daa bahi noli ni so yi yɛn yih o paɣa, ŋun tim o amiliya lɔrigibu gbaŋ ka yih o.
en: The Pharisees asked, Then why did Moses give a command allowing a man to divorce his wife by writing a certificate of divorce .

dag: Saha shɛli naa ni daa ka Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, ka Lɛvi zuliya do so daa zaŋ o mam ŋun yi Bɛtilihɛm Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-kuli Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya zuɣu tinshee din be katiŋa.
en: In those days before Israel had a king, there was a Levite living far back in the hill country of Ephraim. He took a young woman from Bethlehem in Judah to be his concubine.

dag: Ka n daa lihi nya ka nuu teei tiri ma na, ka bɛ ni sabi gbaŋ shɛli kpabikpabi be di ni.
en: Then I saw a hand reach out toward me. It was holding a scroll with words written on it.

dag: Ka di ni daa be shɛm di saha maa, bɛ ni daa dɔɣ so kaman daadamnim ni dɔɣiri bihi shɛm ni daa muɣisiri bɛ ni dɔɣ so Naawuni Shia yiko ni shɛm la, lala n-na kul nyɛ li pumpɔŋɔ.
en: But the other son of Abraham, who was born in the normal way, caused trouble for the one who was born by the power of the Spirit. It is the same today.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa Izraɛlnim daa pirigila buyi; bɛ pirigili daa bɔri ni bɛ zaŋla Ginat bia Tibini leei naa, ka pirigili mi bɔri ni bɛ zaŋla Omri leei naa.
en: Then the Israelites were divided. Half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath and wanted to make him king. The other half of the people followed Omri.

dag: Ka wula ka niriba lee ni tooi yihi waazu, ka pa ni bɛ tim ba mi? Di nyɛla kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Bɛn mali lahibal suŋ waazu na ni bɛ ti yihi ŋɔ paabuna tiri suhupiɛlli.
en: And how can anyone tell them without being sent by the Lord? The Scriptures say it is a beautiful sight to see even the feet of someone coming to preach the good news.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka sanʒiɛɣu maa na kul ʒiɛri pampam, ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ pii neen shɛŋa din daa be ŋariŋ maa ni bahi kom ni.
en: The violent storm continued, so on the next day they began to throw some of the ship's cargo overboard.

dag: Tikuba kul chani moonila ashili yɛtɔɣa, amaa niriba ni dihi so tabili ŋun gbibila ashili.
en: A gossip tells everything, but a true friend will keep a secret.

dag: Ifriimnim ŋmanila ŋmani. Bɛ jɛrigiya zaa, ka ka yɛm. Bɛ boonila Ijiptinim ni bɛ ti sɔŋ ba, ka lan booni Asirianim ni bɛ ti sɔŋ ba.
en: So Ephraim has become like a silly dove without understanding. The people called to Egypt for help. They went to Assyria for help.

dag: Masia yurilim n-gbibi ti, dama ti tɛha nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: Ninvuɣ yino yi daa kpi sokam zaa zuɣu, dindina sokam zaa kpimi m-bala.
en: The love of Christ controls us, because we have concluded this: one died for the sake of all; therefore, all died.

dag: A mi ti yaannim ni daa kuli Ijipti, ka ti be nimaani yuui pam, ka Ijiptinim maa daa nahim ti mini ti yaannim maa pam shɛm la yɛla.
en: How our ancestors went down to Egypt and lived in Egypt for a long time. The Egyptians oppressed us as they had our ancestors.

dag: Yi chɛ Naawuni zaligunima, ka dolila salinim kaya.
en: You put aside God's command and obey human teachings.

dag: Bɛ ka bihi bee zuliya bɛ niriba sunsuuni, ka so lan ka bɛ ni daa be luɣ shɛli maa.
en: without any children to carry on their name.

dag: Ka yil yidan maa yiŋbihi daa kana ti bɔh o, Ti dana, pa alikama suma ka a daa biri a puu la ni? Ka di chaŋ wula ka piriŋkpana ti be di ni.
en: Then the mans servants came to him and said, You planted good seed in your field. Where did the weeds come from.

dag: Wuntizɔriba ku vuui bɛ zaashee; bɛ kul ni teeri bɛ yɛla sahakam.
en: Yes, these sorts of people will never be shaken; the righteous will be remembered forever!.

dag: Naa Rɛhɔbɔam ni daa di nam ka di ti paai yuma anu, ka Ijipti Naa Shishak daa lo tɔb na ti tuhi Jɛrusalɛmnima, bɛ ni daa zaɣisi Yawɛ zaligu maa zuɣu.
en: So in the fifth year of Rehoboam's rule, the Lord punished them for their unfaithfulness and allowed King Shishak of Egypt to invade Judah.

dag: ka yɛli, Yawɛ, din kariya ni n niŋ lala. N ni tooi nyu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋ bɛ nyɛviya pa talima chaŋ ŋɔ ʒim? Dinzuɣu ka o daa bi nyu kom maa. Wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa m-bala.
en: and said to the Lord , I can't drink this water! It's like the blood of these men who risked their lives to get it for me. The Three Warriors did these brave deeds.

dag: Ka din gari shɛlikam zaa nyɛla, zaŋmiya yurilim din lɔri binshɛɣukam laɣindi taba ka di leeri zaɣ yin la pahi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa zuɣu.
en: And to all these qualities add love, which binds all things together in perfect unity.

dag: Kɔniŋdi bini maa yaɣimɛr mia barilim daa nyɛla sɛntimita ayopɔin ni pirigili. Ka di noli daa be kaman pipia nol la, ka lan be kaman paɣiviɛligakushihikom pum la, ka di daa kpɛrila kom litanim tuhi pihinahi.
en: The sides of the tank were inches thick. Its rim was like the rim of a cup, curving outward like the petals of a lily. The tank held about , gallons.

dag: Di zɔriya ba dabiɛm, kul teemiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa niŋ Firawuna mini Ijiptinim zaa shɛm la yɛla.
en: dont be afraid of them! Remember, instead, what the LORD your God did to Pharaoh and all Egypt.

dag: Di ni nyɛ nyini n-fa bɛ yɛm ka bɛ bi lan mi shɛli maa, dinzuɣu a ku chɛ ka bɛ di nasara.
en: You have closed their minds to reason; don't let them triumph over me now.

dag: Ka sapashin kpɛm maa daa yɛli nachimbil maa, Miri ka a yɛli so ni a kana ti yɛli ma yɛlli maa. Ka daa chɛ ka o yi n-kuli.
en: The commander said, Don't tell anyone that you have reported this to me. And he sent the young man away.

dag: Ka a ni yɛn mali tulaale zim maa shɛm maa, miri ka a ti mali di tatabo n-leeg amaŋmaŋ dini. Zaŋm li leei din be kasi, ka nyɛ Yawɛ dini.
en: You must use it only in this special way for the Lord . You must also make it in a special way. Dont make any other incense in this way.

dag: Dama n nyɛla faralana ni nandana. N suhu saɣimya pam.
en: I am poor and helpless, and I have lost all hope.

dag: Ka di simdi ka o ti zaŋ suhudoo maligu biŋkɔbigu maa biŋkpam din pili namanama zuɣu la mini kpam din be namanama maa ni zaa.
en: Offer all of the fat on the animal's insides.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbaag o yi tihi puu maa kpaŋ ha ti ku o.
en: They grabbed him, threw him out of the vineyard, and killed him.

dag: Ka Ijipti naa suhu ni ti yiɣisi pam, ka o lo tɔbu n-tuhi Siria naa hal ti gbah o tɔbbihi maa pam.
en: Then the southern king will become very angry and march out to fight against the northern king. The northern king will have a large army, but he will lose the war.

dag: Ʒiɛnya yim yi yɛda niŋbu puuni ka zaɣis o, dama yi mi ni yi mabihi bɛn be dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam zaa nyarila wahala shɛŋa yi gba ni nyari maa tatabo.
en: But you must resist the devil and stay strong in your faith. You know that all over the world the Lord's followers are suffering just as you are.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni daa teei Reechɛl yɛla n wum o fabila ka yoog o dɔɣim soli ti o.
en: Then God remembered Rachel; he answered her prayer and made it possible for her to have children.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o lab kuli o ya Rama. Ŋuna n-daa lan maani Izraɛlnim yɛla nimaani gba. O daa lan me sara maligu bimbini nimaani ti Yawɛ.
en: Then he would go back to his home in Ramah, where also he would serve as judge. In Ramah he built an altar to the Lord .

dag: O ni ti lan niŋ suhukpeeni n-laɣim tɔbbihi pam chaŋ ti liri Ijipti naa, ka Ijipti naa maa gba ni ti zaŋ o tɔbbihi pam bɛn mali kpiɔŋ n-chɛ ka bɛ lu tab zuɣu. Amaa bɛ ni ti yɔhim Ijipti naa maa ka o ku di nasara.
en: He will boldly raise a large army to attack the king of Egypt, who will prepare to fight back with a huge and powerful army. But the king of Egypt will be deceived and will not be successful.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa kana ni o ti nya ninsalinim ni me tin shɛli ka me pii tam di zuɣu maa.
en: Then the Lord came down to see the city and the tower which they had built.

dag: Zaŋmiya daanya mali kurupooti, ka zaŋ daanya mali bans anahi niŋ di tarisi bunahi zuɣu.
en: Halfway up the altar build a ledge around it, and cover the bottom half of the altar with a decorative bronze grating. Then attach a bronze ring beneath the ledge at the four corners of the altar.

dag: Ka vuri daa mɔni, ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdi shɛb bɛn nyɛ Farisiinim daa yiɣisi zani n-zaɣisi ka yɛli, Ti bi nya doo ŋɔ galimi ni nyɛ shɛli. Di pa shɛli shi so bee malaika n-shiri tɔɣis o di yɛla.
en: All these Jews began shouting louder and louder. Some of the teachers of the law, who were Pharisees, stood up and argued, We find nothing wrong with this man. Maybe an angel or a spirit really did speak to him.

dag: Haman ni daa nya ka Mɔdɛkai zaɣisi ni o ku ti o jilima bee n-damd o tiŋ maa, ka o suhu yiɣisi pam.
en: Haman was furious to learn that Mordecai refused to kneel down and honor him.

dag: Chɛ ka Naawuni yiɣisi, chɛ ka o dimnim wurim; chɛ ka bɛnkam je o ŋmalig o tooni guui.
en: God rises up and scatters his enemies. Those who hate him run away in defeat.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ kawana bee chi m-mali sara maligu shɛlikam, kpam yi be di ni bee kpam yi ka di ni, di nyɛla Aduna bidibisi la zaa dini, di ni kul nyɛ yino dini shɛm, lala ka di nyɛ ŋun la gba dini.
en: The grain offerings will belong to Aarons sons. It doesnt make any difference if the grain offerings are dry or mixed with oil. The sons of Aaron will all share this food.

dag: Ka bɛn zaa daa be yili maa ni kuhiri ka fabindi kpim maa zuɣu yɔri vuri. Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Di kuhiriya, dama bipuɣiŋga maa bi kpi, amaa o gbihirimi.
en: Everyone was crying and feeling sad because the girl was dead. But Jesus said, Dont cry. She is not dead. She is only sleeping.

dag: Yawɛ zaŋm o nina lihi ya, ka niŋ ya nirilim.
en: May the Lord be kind and gracious to you;.

dag: Kaiafas maa n-daa nyɛ ŋun yɛli Yɛhudianim ni di nyɛla talahi ni ninvuɣ yino kpi sokam zaa zuɣu la.
en: Caiaphas was the one who had advised the Jewish leaders that it was better for one person to die for the people.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: Then the LORD said to Moses.

dag: Timoti, gbib Naawuni ni zaŋ shɛli niŋ a nuu ni ni a yuuni li la viɛnyɛliŋga. Gbaam amaŋa ni din bi luri Naawuni sizuura mini naŋgbankpeeni yɛtɔɣ yo shɛŋa ninvuɣ shɛb ni chirim booni baŋsim la.
en: Timothy, God has trusted you with many things. Keep these things safe. Stay away from people who talk about useless things that are not from God and who argue against you with a knowledge that is not knowledge at all.

dag: dama Naawuni ni nam dunia ŋɔ hal ni zuŋɔ ka ti nin na bi nya wahala shɛŋa zaa ni ti beni, ka di tatabo mi ku lan niŋ.
en: because those days will be full of trouble. There will be more trouble than has ever happened since the beginning, when God made the world. And nothing that bad will ever happen again.

dag: Amaa mani n-daa wuhi Ifriimnim chandi. Mani n-daa kpuɣi ba gbibi n nuhi ni. Amaa bɛ daa bi baŋ ni mani n-chɛ ka bɛ kpaŋ maa.
en: Yet I was the one who taught Israel to walk. I took my people up in my arms, but they did not acknowledge that I took care of them.

dag: Ka yi yi yɛn zaŋ kuɣa me sara maligu bimbini ti ma, yin di zaŋya kuɣ kpɛra me li, dama yi yi zaŋ chiriga shihi kuɣ shɛli, di ni leei kuɣ shɛli din mali daɣiri.
en: If you ever build an altar for me out of stones, do not use any tools to chisel the stones, because that would make the altar unfit for use in worship.

dag: ka booi kom din be kasi niŋ laa ni, ka tooi taŋkpaɣu din do Naawuni jɛmbu shee tiŋgban ni n-zaŋ li niŋ kom maa ni.
en: He will then pour sacred water into a clay jar and stir in some dust from the floor of the sacred tent.

dag: Ka Musa daa kpe kuɣ parilana ayi kaman tuuli dina la n-daŋ yiɣisibu asibaasi n-zaŋ kuɣ parilana ayi maa gbib o nuu ni n-du Sinai Zoli maa zuɣu kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa.
en: So Moses cut two flat stones like the first ones, and early the next morning he carried them to the top of Mount Sinai, just as the Lord had commanded.

dag: Ti mi ni binnamda zaa kul ŋuhirimi ka wolisiri biɛrim zuɣu hal ni pɔŋɔ;.
en: We know that the whole creation is groaning together and suffering labor pains up until now.

dag: N yɛn chɛmi ka zuliya shɛb yi katiŋ kana ti liri yinim Izraɛlnima. Bɛ nyɛla zuliya shɛb bɛn mali yaa. Bɛ zuliya maa nyɛla zuliya kurili. Yi bi mi zuliya maa yɛtɔɣa bee yi ti tooi baŋ bɛ ni yɛri shɛm gbinni. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: People of Israel, I have made my decision. An army from a distant country will attack you. I've chosen an ancient nation, and you won't understand their language.

dag: Zɔrinima! Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi niŋdi lala? Ti nyɛla ninsalinim kaman yi gba, ka zaŋ lahibal suŋ na ni ti ti tin ya, ka yi chɛ bin yoya ŋɔ jɛmbu ka niŋ Naawuni ŋun be ka nam zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani ni teeku ni binshɛɣukam din be di ni ŋɔ yɛda.
en: People, what are you doing? We are humans too, just like you! We are proclaiming the good news to you: turn to the living God and away from such worthless things. He made the heaven, the earth, the sea, and everything in them. .

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Kpɛm kuɣ parilana ayi kaman tuuli dina la, ka n sabi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din daa be tuuli kuɣ parilan shɛŋa a ni daa ŋma la ni m-pa di zuɣu.
en: One day the Lord said to Moses, Cut two flat stones like the first ones I made, and I will write on them the same commandments that were on the two you broke.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka lahibal suŋ waazu daa yihi ti bɛn kpi la, ka hal bɛ ni nya saria karibu bɛ niŋgbuna ni kaman daadam kam la zaa yoli, bɛ shihi lee ni nya nyɛvili m-be kaman Naawuni ni be shɛm.
en: Indeed, this is the reason the good news was also preached to the dead. This happened so that, although they were judged as humans according to human standards, they could live by the Spirit according to divine standards.

dag: Ka Filistia nanim anu maa ni daa nya lala maa, ka bɛ lab kul Ɛkurɔn dindali maa.
en: When the five Philistine rulers witnessed this, they went straight back to Ekron.

dag: Ka bɛn fabindi be kaman bɛn bi fabinda, ka bɛn mali suhupiɛlli be kaman bɛn ka suhupiɛlli. Ka bɛn dari nɛma be kaman bɛn bi su nɛma maa;.
en: those who weep, as though they were not sad; those who laugh, as though they were not happy; those who buy, as though they did not own what they bought;.

dag: Niɣi mini bɛ ni booni biŋkɔb so bɛɛr la ni ti laɣim ŋubiri mɔri, ka bɛ bihi ti laɣim doya. Ka gbuɣinli ni ti ŋubiri mɔri kaman nahu la.
en: Bears and cattle will eat together in peace, and all their young will lie down together and will not hurt each other. Lions will eat hay like cattle.

dag: Kalɛb ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛramiil mabia la bidibisi m-bɔŋɔ: Masha ŋun daa nyɛ Zif ba la n-daa nyɛ o bituuli. Marɛsha bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Hiburɔn.
en: The family of Caleb, Jerahmeels brother: Mesha his oldest son and Ziphs father; and his second son Mareshah, Hebrons father.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti tiliginsim ŋɔ, labisim ti na yaha, ka ku a suhuyiɣisili la zaŋ chaŋ ti sani.
en: Our Lord and our God, you save us! Please bring us back home and don't be angry.

dag: To, m mabihi, n chɛbisiri ya mi ŋɔ. Kpaŋmiya yimaŋa m-be dɛde! Doliya n saɣisigu; maliya naŋgban yini; maliya suhudoo ka di chɛ ka Naawuni ŋun nyɛ yurilimlana mini suhudoolana ŋɔ be yi sani.
en: And now, my friends, good-bye! Strive for perfection; listen to my appeals; agree with one another; live in peace. And the God of love and peace will be with you.

dag: amaa ti shɛli din chɛri ka nir baŋdi zaɣ suŋ mini zaɣ biɛɣu la, miri ka a di li, dama a yi ti di li dahin shɛli, a ni kpi.
en: except the one that has the power to let you know the difference between right and wrong. If you eat any fruit from that tree, you will die before the day is over.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Babilɔn bipuɣiŋga, yiɣisim a nam ʒiishee nti ʒini tiŋ taŋkpaɣu ni. Bɛ ku lan bol a ninvuɣ gahindili.
en: Fall down and sit in the dirt, Virgin Daughter Babylon. You have no throne, so sit on the ground, daughter of the Chaldeans. You are not the ruler now. You are no longer the beautiful young princess that people said you were.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun fa ma duŋtaariba nuu ni, ka chɛ ka n leei niriba naa; ka n ni ʒi ninvuɣ shɛb leei bɛn jɛmdi ma.
en: You rescued me from stubborn people, and you made me the leader of foreign nations, who are now my slaves.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ sara maligu bimbini maa zali pateesa shɛli din yili Alikauli Adaka tooni la mi tooni. Alikauli Adaka maa ni be luɣ shɛli maa n-nyɛ luɣ shɛli n ni yɛn kahigi mmaŋ wuh a.
en: Put the altar just outside the special curtain that hangs in front of the Box of the Agreement. So the altar will be in front of the mercy-cover that is above the Agreement. This is the place where I will meet with you.

dag: Nimrim kulibɔŋ nyuuya zaa, ka di duli mɔri kuui, ka momahili lan ka nimaani yaha.
en: Nimrim Brook is dry, the grass beside it has withered, and nothing green is left.

dag: ka bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a wumdi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛr a, Nyama, Dauda lo a zaɣ biɛɣu la yɛtɔɣa.
en: David said to Saul, Why do you listen when people say, David wants to ruin you?.

dag: Ti mini Masia ni laɣim di wahala din galisi shɛm, lala ka ti lan laɣindi nyari suhumaabo din galisi Masia zuɣu.
en: That is because we receive so much comfort through Christ in the same way that we share so many of Christs sufferings.

dag: Dama niriba lala tatabo bi doli ti Duuma Yisa Masia, amaa bɛmaŋmaŋ kɔre ka bɛ doli, ka mali yɛtɔɣ suma mini naŋgbammalisim yɔhindi bɛn tɛha bi zilima.
en: For those who do such things are not serving Christ our Lord, but their own appetites. By their fine words and flattering speech they deceive innocent people.

dag: Ka Zɛrubabɛl daa nyɛ Abiiud ba, ka Abiiud nyɛ Ɛliakim ba, ka Ɛliakim mi nyɛ Azɔr ba.
en: Zerubbabel was the father of Abiud. Abiud was the father of Eliakim. Eliakim was the father of Azor.

dag: Mɛrari zuliya maa tuma zaa ni yɛn nyɛ shɛli m-bala. Maligumaana Aduna bia Itama n-yɛn gbib ba ka bɛ tumdi tuma.
en: and Ithamar son of Aaron will make sure they do their work.

dag: Ka yɛtɔɣa maa daa gari Mariama pam ka o bɔhir o suhu, ka bɔ puhigu n-lee bɔŋɔ.
en: But Mary was very confused about what the angel said. She wondered, What does this mean.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini ka n kumdi niŋd a. Dama buɣim di mɔɣu zaa, ka buɣim zilima di mɔɣu ni tihi zaa.
en: I cry out to you, Lord , because the pastures and trees are dried up, as though a fire had burned them.

dag: So daa naan ku tooi woligi suhupiɛlli tahigu vuri ka chɛ kuhigu vuri maa, dama niriba maa daa kul tahirila pampam, ka di vuri maa daa chaŋ katiŋ pam.
en: Their shouting and crying were so noisy that it all sounded alike and could be heard a long way off.

dag: N lɔn ya alikauli ni n ku lan chɛ ka kom di binnɛma zaa, ka m mi ku lan chɛ ka kom di dunia ŋɔ yaha.
en: I will set up my covenant with you so that never again will all life be cut off by floodwaters. There will never again be a flood to destroy the earth.

dag: Dama bɛ ni daa zaŋ bɛ bihi maa mali bɛ buɣa dahin shɛli maa, dindali maa ka bɛ daa kpe n jɛmbu duu ti ta li daɣiri. Lala ka bɛ daa niŋ n duu maa ni.
en: They killed their children for their idols, and then they went into my holy place and made it filthy too! They did this inside my Temple!.

dag: Hal yi zabiri zaa mali kalinli.
en: Even the hairs of your head are all counted.

dag: Lala ka bɛ daa niŋ yiɣisi niriba mini bɛ kpamba ni Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba suhuri, ka bɛ daa kabina nti gbaai Stiivin tahi jintɔriba sani.
en: By doing this, these Jews upset the people, the older Jewish leaders, and the teachers of the law. They became so angry that they came and grabbed Stephen and took him to a meeting of the high council.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn wuhi ba soli birigi ba, ka bɛ ni birigi ninvuɣ shɛb maa birim.
en: They had led the nation down the wrong path, and the people were confused.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, Paɣa, bɔ n-niŋ ka a kumda? Ŋuni ka a bɔra? Mariama daa tɛhiya ni puu maa lana m-bala ka yɛl o, N dana, nyini n-yi yih o, nyin wuhim ma a ni zaŋ o ti sɔŋ luɣ shɛli, ka n chaŋ ti zaŋ o.
en: Jesus asked her, Why are you crying? Who are you looking for? She thought he was the gardener and said, Sir, if you have taken his body away, please tell me, so I can go and get him.

dag: O daa lan yɛli, Ŋunkam yih o paɣa ka kpuɣi paɣ so tum zina; ka ŋunkam mi kpuɣi paɣiyihiŋ maa gba tum zina.
en: It is a terrible sin for a man to divorce his wife and marry another woman. It is also a terrible sin for a man to marry a divorced woman.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Yawɛ daba, paɣimiy o; paɣimiya Yawɛ yuli.
en: Praise the LORD! You who serve the LORD—praise! Praise the LORDs name!.

dag: Wuntizɔra yɛla teebu mali alibarika. Amaa ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋun yuli ni kpi.
en: Good people are remembered long after they are gone, but the wicked are soon forgotten.

dag: A ni ti baŋ ni n wum a turi yɛtɔɣa shɛŋa a ni tɔɣisiri turi Izraɛl zoya yɛra, Di kpalimla dabari doya. Bɛ zaŋ li ti ti ni ti va li.
en: And then you, too, will know that I am the Lord . I have heard you making fun of Israels hill country. You said, It is in ruins, just waiting for us to swallow it up.

dag: Kpambaliba bɛn be di ni ŋmanila kunduna n-dariti tɔhiri bɛ ni gbahi binshɛŋa, ka kuri niriba ni bɛ doli bibiɛlim soya nya buni.
en: The officials in her are like wolves ripping up prey. They shed blood and destroy lives for unjust riches.

dag: Bɛtɛl mini Ai niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbiga ni pisinaata.
en: of Bethel and Ai.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi dunia ŋɔ ni yɛla viɛli pam. Ka m mali suhupiɛlli pam bɛ zuɣu.
en: Your people are wonderful, and they make me happy.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka a yihi li bɛ nuhi maa ni n-zaŋ li pahi sara shɛli din yɛn nyo buɣim maa zuɣu n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu, ka di leei sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom tiɣiri Yawɛ nini.
en: Then take them from their hands and turn them into smoke by burning them on the altar with the entirely burned offering as a soothing smell in the LORDs presence. It is a food gift for the LORD.

dag: Ka zuliya shɛb bɛn pa Yɛhudianim mali tahima o yuli zuɣu.
en: And the Gentiles will put their hope in his name.

dag: Ka pakoli maa daa kpe nti shiri niŋ kaman Ilaija ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka o min o bidibiga maa ni o yiŋnim zaa kul nyari bindirigu diri dabisi gbaliŋ.
en: The widow went and did what Elijah said. So the widow, Elijah, and the widows household ate for many days.

dag: Ka Dilaila daa chɛ ka Samsin zaŋ o zuɣu pa o naba zuɣu gbihi, ka o bol do so na ti chɛ ka o pini Samsin zuɣu ni zab kpila ayopɔin maa. Ka o daa piligi damdi Samsin, ka o kpiɔŋ maa daa shiri yi o ni.
en: She got him to fall asleep with his head on her lap. Then she called a man and had him shave off the seven braids of Samsons hair. He began to weaken, and his strength left him.

dag: Javan bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ɛlisha mini Tarishish ni Kitim ni Rodanim.
en: The descendants of Javan were the people of Elishah, Spain, Cyprus, and Rhodes.

dag: Ka bɛ daa shiri niŋ lala n-zaŋ talim Baanabas mini Sool ni bɛ ti ti cheechi kpamba.
en: They sent Barnabas and Saul to take this gift to the elders.

dag: Yuun pinaayi shɛŋa ni zaa bɛ ni daa zaŋ ma leei bɛ gomna Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni Naa Atazɛrikisɛs nam dibu yuun pisi la saha zaŋ hal ti paag o yuun pihitanaayi la saha, mmaŋmaŋ bee m mabihi daa bi di bindir shɛŋa din nyɛ gomna tarili.
en: During all the twelve years that I was governor of the land of Judah, from the twentieth year that Artaxerxes was emperor until his thirty-second year, neither my relatives nor I ate the food I was entitled to have as governor.

dag: Ti nyɛla saamba bɛn go n-chani gind a tooni kaman ti yaannim la. Ti dunia ŋɔ ni biɛhigu ŋmanila shilinshia, ka tahima kani.
en: We are only foreigners living here on earth for a while, just as our ancestors were. And we will soon be gone, like a shadow that suddenly disappears.

dag: ka Dauda yiɣisi zaŋ o tɔbbihi pa omaŋ zuɣu chaŋ ti ku Filistianim kɔbisiyi, ka ŋmahi bɛ yokol gbana n-zaŋ di zaa ti ti naa din ni chɛ ka o leei naa deemba. Ka Sool daa zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga Mikal ti o ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: he and his men went out to fight the Philistines. They killed Philistines. David took these Philistine foreskins and gave them to Saul. He did this because he wanted to become the kings son-in-law. Saul let David marry his daughter Michal.

dag: Amaa biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn gbuɣiri ŋubira, ka bɛ takarifiɛma bi wɔrigi, yin di ŋubiya ba. Bɛna n-nyɛ laakuma mini soonsi ni ŋɔŋa, dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn gbuɣiri ŋubira, amaa bɛ ka takarifiɛma din wɔrigi, bɛ nyɛla bɛn bi be nyam yi sani.
en: But dont eat camels, rabbits, or rock badgers. These animals chew the cud, but they dont have split hooves. So these animals are not a clean food for you.

dag: ni Shimirɔnmɛrɔn naa ni Akishaf naa.
en: the king of Shimron-meron one.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n naan zaŋ li buɣi m bɔɣusapiŋ zuɣu, n naan zaŋ li pili kaman nam zuɣupiligu la.
en: I would wear them proudly on my shoulder and place them on my head like a crown.

dag: Bɛ ni ti me o tɔbutuhiri bimbina tabili yi goma, ka zaŋ kpandi wurim yi binwɔɣila.
en: They will pound in your walls with battering rams and tear down your towers with iron bars.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yisahaku daa kpalim be Gɛra. Ka nimaani nim ni daa ti bɔh o bɔhigu zaŋ chaŋ o paɣ polo.
en: So Isaac lived at Gerar.

dag: Ka Ɛhab daa boli Obadia ŋun daa su nayili tuma fukumsi la na. Obadia daa nyɛla ninvuɣ so ŋun jɛmdi Yawɛ viɛnyɛliŋga;.
en: So King Ahab told Obadiah to come to him. Obadiah was the man in charge of the kings palace. Obadiah was a true follower of the Lord .

dag: Ka bɛn daa pahi bɛ zuɣu kaman bɛ daŋ kam mini bɛ yaannim dunoya ni daa nyɛ shɛm daa nyɛla tɔbbihi bɔŋbɔŋ ninvuɣ tuhi pihitanaayɔbu, dama bɛ daa mali paɣiba pam ni bidibisi.
en: According to the family records of their households, they had , troops in the units of their fighting force, since they had many wives and children.

dag: M mabihi, m mi n suhu ni ka biɛhiŋ kani ni yi mali biɛrisuŋ, ka mali baŋsim zaa, ka ni tooi wuhi taba.
en: My friends, I am sure that you are very good and that you have all the knowledge you need to teach each other.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn daa zaŋ bɛ nyɛviya zali barina shee n zuɣu, ka m puhiri ba pam di zuɣu, ka di pala n kɔŋko, amaa bɛn pa Yɛhudianim cheechinim zaa gba puhiri ba viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: they risked their lives for me. I am grateful to them—not only I, but all the Gentile churches as well.

dag: N ni chɛ ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa zani dabari n-dahim doya, ka bɛ ni daa mali yiko shɛli nyuri bara maa zani tariga; ka Izraɛl zoya zaa ti kpalim zaɣ nɛya hal ka so ku lan gari di gbini.
en: I will make the country a desolate wasteland, and the power they were so proud of will come to an end. The mountains of Israel will be so wild that no one will be able to travel through them.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yo Aruna salima laɣibaligu kɔbisiyɔbu o kabɔɣili maa zuɣu.
en: Then David gave Ornan six hundred shekels of gold by weight for the site.

dag: n-gari chaŋ hal ni Azimɔn n-zaŋ lala hal ti paai Ijipti kulibɔŋ m-mali hal ti paai di tariga teeku ni. Yi nudirigu polo tiŋgbani tariga n-yɛn bala.
en: went on to Azmon, and followed the stream on the border of Egypt to the Mediterranean Sea, where the border ended. That was the southern border of Judah.

dag: Ka Iso yɛl o, Ka chɛ ka n niriba ŋɔ shɛb kpalim pah a zuɣu. Amaa ka Yaakubu yɛl o, N dana, lala bi kpa, n kul bɔri ni a chɛ ka a suhu m-maai ni mani.
en: Esau said, Then let me leave some of my men with you. But Jacob answered, There is no need for that for I only want to gain your favor.

dag: Bɛ bihi ka o daa zaŋ zali bɛ zaashee n-chɛ ka Jɔshua guni ba maa. Bɛ ni daa bi guni ba sol ni la zuɣu n-chɛ ka bɛ daa nyɛ bɛn na bi guni maa.
en: The sons of these men had never been circumcised, and it was this new generation that Joshua circumcised.

dag: ka nyɛ ŋun niŋdi binshɛŋa o ba ni daa bi niŋ, ka diri bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa mali buɣa zoya zuɣu la, ka zaŋdi o kpee paɣa doona.
en: that the father never did. He eats sacrifices offered at forbidden shrines and seduces other men's wives.

dag: O tizo yuli n-daa booni Jubal. Ŋun mi n-daa nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ŋmɛri mɔɣilɔnim mini yupiɛbiriba yaba.
en: His brother was Jubal, the ancestor of all musicians who play the harp and the flute.

dag: N yura maa viɛlimi pam ka mali yaa. Ninvuɣ tuhili puuni so bi ŋman o.
en: My lover is handsome and strong; he is one in ten thousand.

dag: Di saha ka Pita yɛl o, Nyama, ti chɛla binshɛɣukam ka dol a.
en: Peter replied, Remember, we left everything to be your followers.

dag: Binshɛɣukam din kpɛri ninsal nol ni pala din tar o daɣiri; amaa din yiri ninsal nol ni na n-naɣ tar o daɣiri.
en: Its not what goes into the mouth that contaminates a person in Gods sight. Its what comes out of the mouth that contaminates the person.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa tim tuumba luɣ shɛli polo Naawuni nir maa ni yɛli maa. Lala ka o daa yi pun daŋdi yɛr o n-chɛ ka o tilig omaŋ nimaani n-gari buyi.
en: The king of Israel sent a message to his men at the place that the man of God warned him about. And the king of Israel saved quite a few men.

dag: Ka di daa kpaŋsi nimaani yɛdaniŋdib suhuri, ka niriba kul pahiri bɛ zuɣu dabisili kam.
en: So the churches were becoming stronger in their faith, and the number of believers was growing every day.

dag: Ka a yɛli Izraɛlnima, N kpa kasi shɛli n ni yɛn boori bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni yi ʒiɛmani kam ni m-bala.
en: and say to the people of Israel: This oil must always be used in the ordination service of a priest. It is holy because it is dedicated to the Lord .

dag: Amaa ti ni bi bɔri ni ti miligi bɛ suhuri zuɣu, cham teeku ni nti zaŋ ziŋgoo bahi, ka di ni ti tuui gbaai zin so, a yi yaag o noli, a ni nya liɣiri di ni n-zaŋ ti tɔhi m min a zuɣu.
en: But we don't want to cause trouble. So go cast a line into the lake and pull out the first fish you hook. Open its mouth, and you will find a coin. Use it to pay your taxes and mine.

dag: Na shɛb bɛn daa di Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ nam hal ka Izraɛlnim ti naanyi mali nanima yuya m-bɔŋɔ. Bɛɔr bia Bɛla ŋun ya daa nyɛ Dinhaba la.
en: There were kings in Edom long before there were kings in Israel. These are the names of the kings of Edom: Bela was the son of Beor. The name of Belas city was Dinhabah.

dag: Yi zura, ka kuri niriba, ka niŋdi zina, ka ŋmari ʒiri pɔri pɔri, ka maani maligu tiri Baal, ka jɛmdi buɣ shɛŋa yi ni daa pun bi mi.
en: Will you steal and murder, commit adultery and perjury, sacrifice to Baal and go after other gods that you dont know.

dag: Mbusim be tin shɛli din varim daɣiri, ka saɣim dimaŋa, ka nahindi niriba ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Too bad for that disgusting, corrupt, and lawless city!.

dag: N dɔɣiriba mini n zɔnim zoya ka chɛ ma.
en: and I am forgotten.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn lo nia biɛri bɛ suhuri ni, ka kul bɔrila zabili.
en: They are always plotting evil, always stirring up quarrels.

dag: Nyini n-nam zibisim, ka di nyɛ yuŋ, ka biŋkɔbiri bɛn be yɔɣu ni yirina gɔra.
en: You made darkness to be the night— the time when wild animals come out and roam around.

dag: ka o zaŋ Makipɛla siliga din be o palo la tariga la ti ma yi ninni; ka n yo o di liɣiri ka di leegi n dini, ka m mali n kpiimba sɔɣiri nimaani.
en: to sell me Machpelah Cave, which is near the edge of his field. Ask him to sell it to me for its full price, here in your presence, so that I can own it as a burial ground.

dag: Dindali maa zaawun yuŋ ka Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba, Chɛliya ka ti baai du duli ha.
en: Later that day, when evening came, Jesus said to them, Lets cross over to the other side of the lake.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ biɛri mini karimba ʒirinim kul ni chani tooni n-tumdi din bie nti yaɣi, ka yɔhindi niriba, ka bɛmaŋmaŋ gba ni ti lu yɔhiŋgu ni.
en: People who are evil and cheat others will become worse and worse. They will fool others, but they will also be fooling themselves.

dag: O daa bi tooi tum tuun kar shɛli nimaani n-naɣ pahila o daa kul zaŋla o nuhi pa barinim biɛla zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ kpaŋ zaa.
en: He was unable to do any miracles there, except that he placed his hands on a few sick people and healed them.

dag: Banima n-lee be kaman mani? Bɛ wuhim li, bɛ wuhim li n tooni. Banima n-daa lee yɛli binshɛŋa din ti yɛn niŋ yɛla zali kurimbuni ha. Bɛ yɛlim ti binshɛŋa din na yɛn niŋ yɛla.
en: Can anyone compare with me? If so, let them speak up and tell me now. Let them say what has happened since I made my nation long ago, and let them tell what is going to happen.

dag: Dinzuɣu di kariya so saria ka saha na bi paai bee ka ti Duuma na bi labina. Ŋuna n-ni ti chɛ ka binshɛɣukam din be zibisim ni yi palo, ka ni ti vii daadamnim suhuri ni ashiya wuhi palɔni. Di saha maa ka sokam ni ti nya paɣibu din simd o Naawuni sani.
en: So dont judge anything before the right time—wait until the Lord comes. He will bring things that are hidden in the dark to light, and he will make peoples motivations public. Then there will be recognition for each person from God.

dag: Ka Musa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza daa yɛli niriba maa Mɔab bɔpiɛligu din daa miri Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili, ka be Jɛriko tooni polo la.
en: Israel was now camped in the hills of Moab across the Jordan River from the town of Jericho. Moses and Eleazar told them.

dag: Ŋunkam tumd alahichi nyɛla zaliguchihira, dama alahichi tumbu nyɛla zaligu chihibu.
en: Everyone who sins breaks God's law, because sin is the same as breaking God's law.

dag: Chɛ ka a min a ʒiʒiinikpee ʒini m-mali yi yɛtɔɣa, ka miri ka a zaŋ so daashili yɛla moli;.
en: When you and someone else can't get along, don't gossip about it.

dag: Naawuni jɛmbu duu yiliyiiniba — kɔbiga ni pihitaayika.
en: These are the singers: the descendants of Asaph:.

dag: n ku lan kari zuliya shɛb Jɔshua ni daa bi kari ka kpi la ti ba.
en: so I'll stop helping them defeat their enemies. Israel still had a lot of enemies when Joshua died.

dag: Bɛ tiŋkpansi mi n-daa nyɛ Itam mini Ain ni Rimɔn ni Tochɛn ni Ashan, di daa nyɛla tins anu.
en: They also lived in the five villages of Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan.

dag: Dama bɛ daa lan mɛla buɣa jɛmbu shee mini binchunchuna zali, ka me buɣili Ashɛrim binnana n-tamtam zoli kam zuɣu; ka me shɛŋa mi zali timahili kam gbini.
en: They also built shrines, standing stones, and sacred poles on top of every high hill and under every green tree.

dag: Cheechi shɛŋa din be Ɛsha tiŋgbɔŋ ni nim puhiri ya. Akuila mini Prisila ni cheechi din laɣindi bɛ yiŋ puuni la puhiri ya pam ti Duuma ni.
en: The churches in the province of Asia send you their greetings; Aquila and Priscilla and the church that meets in their house send warm Christian greetings.

dag: Ka o daa gbaai zom maa nuu ni vo o yi tiŋ maa tariga nti tuhi nintɔri ta o nina, ka zaŋ o nuhi shih o ka bɔh o, A nya shɛli.
en: So Jesus held the blind mans hand and led him out of the village. Then he spit on the mans eyes. He laid his hands on him and asked, Can you see now.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa zaŋ li tahi nimaani, ka Yawɛ daa lan darigi di tiŋ maa nim gba tibili n-chɛ ka sokam suhu saɣim. O daa chɛ ka bintɔra tɔri bihi mini ninkura zaa.
en: But once they moved it, the LORDs hand came against the city, causing a huge panic. God struck the citys inhabitants, both young and old, and tumors broke out on them.

dag: Fɔndi ŋɔ mini tiŋkpansi ŋɔ zaa daa bela Zɛbulɔn zuliya ni daa deei tiŋgban shɛli ka di leei bɛ dini kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm la puuni.
en: So these are the towns and fields around them that were given to Zebulun. Each family in Zebulun got its part of the land.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa dihili ni ti nyɛla dɛde hal bɛ ni mali tarili bɛ dɔɣiriba ni kɔhiri bɛ daŋ ni neen shɛŋa ni la zaa yoli.
en: Some Levites may have money from selling family possessions, and others may not. But all Levites serving at the place of worship will receive the same amount of food from the sacrifices and gifts brought by the people.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm paɣiba, pomiya ni yi ku chɛ ka ti tab bɔbu kɔre yiɣisi bee n-kpaŋsi li.
en: Young women of Jerusalem, promise me never to awaken love before it is ready.

dag: Sokam zaa pin shɛŋa din be kasi nyɛla o ni su shɛli, ka so yi zaŋ binshɛli na ti ti maligumaana, di nyɛla ŋun maligumaana maa dini.
en: Each priest shall keep the offerings presented to him.

dag: Yawɛ daa chɛ ka kum lu bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka saɣim binshɛɣukam din tiri bindirigu.
en: God kept crops from growing until food was scarce everywhere in the land.

dag: Yi yi chɛ yi chi ka tam kabɔbili sɔŋ yi puuni, yin di lan labiya ti zaŋ li; di ni leela sana bee kpibiga bee pakoli dini, ka lala chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ niŋ alibarika niŋ yi tuma zaa ni.
en: Whenever you are reaping the harvest of your field and you leave some grain in the field, dont go back and get it. Let it go to the immigrants, the orphans, and the widows so that the LORD your God blesses you in all that you do.

dag: Daamiya maligu bimbina la luhi, ka wurim bɛ buɣa bin wɔɣila la, ka nyo bɛ wuni Ashɛra binnana la buɣim, ka lala chɛ ka yi kpihim bɛ yuli nimaani.
en: Tear down their altars and smash their sacred stone pillars to pieces. Burn their symbols of the goddess Asherah and chop down their idols, so that they will never again be worshiped at those places.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kali Lɛvinim maa bɛn yuma paai pihita zaŋ chana, ka bɛ kalinli daa nyɛ ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahaayika.
en: David counted the Levites who were years old and older. All together there were , Levites.

dag: Ti yi yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti kpe tiŋ ŋɔ puuni, kum be di ni, ka ti ni kpi; ka ti mi yi ʒi kpe, ti ni kpi. Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka ti chaŋ Sirianim sansani ŋɔ ni, bɛ yi ti chɛ ti, ti ni be; ka bɛ yi ti ku ti, ka ti dii kpi.
en: It's no use going into the city, because we would starve to death in there; but if we stay here, we'll die also. So let's go to the Syrian camp; the worst they can do is kill us, but maybe they will spare our lives.

dag: O noli daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka naa maa paag o sanna ti yɛl o, Ti muɣisigu ŋɔ yila Yawɛ sanna! Ka bɔzuɣu ka n lan yɛn guhi ŋun Yawɛ yaha.
en: Before Elisha finished talking, the messenger came up and said, The Lord has made all these terrible things happen to us. Why should I think he will help us now.

dag: ka tiri kum ni kuri shɛb bindira, ka tiri nandaamba bɛ ni kɔŋ shɛli, dindina yi neesim ni neei zibisim ni m-be kaman wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha neesim la.
en: if you open your heart to the hungry, and provide abundantly for those who are afflicted, your light will shine in the darkness, and your gloom will be like the noon.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Asiria naa polo m-bɔŋɔ: O ku kpe tiŋ ŋɔ ni na bee n-to piɛm di ni bee ka o tɔbbihi ti gbib nyɔtaɣirisi kpe di ni bee ka bɛ ti me bimbin dura gil li.
en: And this is what the Lord has said about the Assyrian emperor: He will not enter this city or shoot a single arrow against it. No soldiers with shields will come near the city, and no siege mounds will be built around it.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ŋmaligi lihi nya ba ka bɔhi ba, Bɔ ka yi bɔra? Ka bɛ bɔh o, Rabai, ya polo ka a kpɛra.
en: Jesus turned and saw the two men following him. He asked, What do you want? They said, Rabbi, where are you staying.

dag: ni di chɛ ka cheechi maa viɛla, ka ka liɣisibu bee gurimbu, ka ni bela kasi ka ka galimi, ka o zaŋ li ti omaŋa.
en: Christ did this, so he would have a glorious and holy church, without faults or spots or wrinkles or any other flaws.

dag: Cham biŋkɔbiri la sani ti gbahi bubihi pol ayi ti ma na ka n zaŋ ba duɣi bindir nyaɣisili shɛli a ba ni yuri pam;.
en: Go to the flock and pick out two fat young goats, so that I can cook them and make some of that food your father likes so much.

dag: Kul teemiya bɛn be sarika ni yɛla ka di be kaman yi mini ba ka bɛ laɣim kpɛhi sarika maa la. Teemiya bɛn diri wahala yɛla ka di be kaman yi mini ba n-laɣim diri wahala maa la.
en: Remember the Lord's people who are in jail and be concerned for them. Don't forget those who are suffering, but imagine you are there with them.

dag: Lihimi zuɣusaa ka a nya, nyam sagbana din be a zuɣusaa ŋɔ ha.
en: Look up to the heavens.

dag: Lala ka a daa yu pagɔrisigu tuma a bilim ni, ka Ijiptinim daa tabisi a paɣisari biha ka zaŋ a saɣim la.
en: Oholibah, you wanted to repeat the immorality you were guilty of as a young woman in Egypt, where men played with your breasts and you lost your virginity.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia daa kpe n ni n-yiɣisi ma zali n naba zuɣu. Ka o daa tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣa yɛli ma, Kulimi ti kpari amaŋ niŋ a yiŋa.
en: When a wind came to me and stood me on my feet, he spoke to me and said: Go, shut yourself up inside your house.

dag: Nyam bɛ ni lo zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu shɛm, ka lo barina tumbu nia, ka ŋmari ʒiri.
en: But look how the wicked hatch evil, conceive trouble, give birth to lies!.

dag: Amaa lee ti wurimmiya bɛ maligu bimbina, ka kabisi bɛ binwɔɣila, ka wurim bɛ buɣili Ashɛra la.
en: Instead, you must destroy their altars and tear down the sacred poles they use in the worship of the goddess Asherah.

dag: N ni darigi Jɛrusalɛmnim tibili kaman n ni daa darigi Samarianim mini Ɛhab daŋ niriba tibili shɛm la. N ni kpimsi Jɛrusalɛm niriba birili, ka chɛ ka di puuni neei kaman nir ni yi paɣi laa n-nyahi neei di puuni ka zaŋ li pili shɛm la.
en: Jerusalem is as sinful as Ahab and the people of Samaria were. So I will wipe out Jerusalem and be done with it, just as someone wipes water off a plate and turns it over to dry.

dag: Naa Sulemaana daa malila yuri mini chɛchɛbunsi duri tusaanahi. O daa malila yuri tuhi pinaayi, ka daa piripiri ba niŋ chɛchɛbunsi ni be tin shɛŋa ni, ka chɛ ka shɛb mi be ŋun naa sani Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Solomon had stalls to keep horses and chariots. He had , horse soldiers. Solomon built special cities for these chariots. So the chariots were kept in these cities. King Solomon also kept some of the chariots with him in Jerusalem.

dag: Yawɛ, a wum bɛ ni maani ma ansarisi shɛm zaa mini bɛ ni lɔri ma nia biɛri shɛm.
en: You have heard them insult me, O Lord ; you know all their plots.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa chɛ ka o nyaandoliba kpe ŋariŋ daŋ o tooni baari duri Bɛtisaida polo, ka ŋun kpalim ni o chɛbisi salo maa.
en: At once, Jesus made his disciples get into the boat and start back across to Bethsaida. But he stayed until he had sent the crowds away.

dag: O sani, jaambɔna ŋmanila kaɣa. Bɛ yi to kpani ka o wum di damli, o lari li mi.
en: it simply smiles at spears, and striking it with a stick is like slapping it with straw.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Sairus ŋun nyɛ o ni pii so la, N niŋ a yiko ni a tuhi nyaŋ zuliya kam, ka fa nanim yaa. N ni yooi dunoli kam ti a, ka bɛ ku kpari duno shɛli.
en: This is what the Lord said to Cyrus, his chosen king : I took you by your right hand to help you defeat nations, to strip other kings of their power, and to open city gates that will not be closed again.

dag: ka lan yɛl o, Ka din pahi nyɛla, a dabili Yaakubu doli ti nyaaŋa na. Dama Yaakubu daa yɛlila o suhu ni, N yi chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ pini ŋɔ daŋ n tooni ti ti o, n ni maag o suhu, ka di nyaaŋa m min o nini yi ti nya taba, di pa shɛli o ni deei ma.
en: You must say, Yes, your servant Jacob is right behind us. Jacob was thinking, I will win him over with the gifts, and when I meet him, perhaps he will forgive me.

dag: Nanima, wummiya! Zuɣulaannima, wummiya! N ni yili yila niɣim n kukoli paɣi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Listen, kings. Pay attention, rulers. I will sing. I myself will sing to the Lord . I will make music to the Lord , to the God of the Israelites.

dag: N ni yɛli ya shɛli zibisim ni, yɛlimiya li neesim ni; ka yi ni wum shɛli ashilɔni, yin molimiya li gili luɣilikam.
en: What I say to you in the darkness, tell in the light; and what you hear whispered, announce from the rooftops.

dag: A ti ba pam, ka chɛ ka vuhirigu kam di n-tiɣi.
en: You give them enough and satisfy the needs of all.

dag: Di chɛliya ka yi suhuri jiɣindi shɛli zuɣu, amaa yi suhigu zaa puuni, yɛlimiya Naawuni yi ni bɔri shɛli, ka kul balimmiya Naawuni ni wumpaɣibo din yiri yi suhuri ni na.
en: Dont worry about anything, but pray and ask God for everything you need, always giving thanks for what you have.

dag: Niŋmiya dimbɔŋɔ pahi asiba sara shɛli yi ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim ka di nyɛ yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim sahakam la zuɣu.
en: You must give these offerings in addition to the morning burnt offerings that you give every day.

dag: Daadam Bia dabisili ti yɛn ŋmanila saa ni yi nyaɣisi di pilibu shee m-mali ti ba di naabu shee shɛm la.
en: The Human Onewill appear on his day in the same way that a flash of lightning lights up the sky from one end to the other.

dag: Ɛdom daa ka naa; wulana n-daa nyɛ naa.
en: In those days Edom did not have a king; it was ruled by a governor who was chosen by the king of Judah.

dag: Ka Asha zuliya maa niriba kalinli daa yiɣisi ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahi ni yini ni kɔbisinu.
en: Those enlisted from the tribe of Asher were .

dag: A ni niŋ o naani o ni mali kpiɔŋ zuɣu ka chɛ a tuma jɛl o?.
en: A wild bull is very strong, but can you trust him to do your work?.

dag: ka di chɛ ka yi mini Yisa nyaandoliba zaa laɣim nya yiko m-baŋ Masia yurilim yɛliŋ mini di wɔɣilim ni di dubu ni di ziliŋ ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: And I pray that you and all Gods holy people will have the power to understand the greatness of Christs love—how wide, how long, how high, and how deep that love is.

dag: Daantalisi maa ni daa yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu daa nyɛla daanya, amaa daantalisi maa bansi mini di mihi la din daa nyɛla anzinfa, ka bɛ daa niŋ anzinfa pa daantalisi maa zuɣuri ni, ka lɔndo maa daantalisi mihi zaa daa nyɛ anzinfa.
en: The bases for the posts were made from bronze. The hooks and the curtain rods were made from silver. The tops of the posts were covered with silver also. All the posts in the courtyard had silver curtain rods.

dag: Ka di daa ti Yɛhudianim suhupiɛlli mini tahima din wuhi ni bɛ di nasara.
en: and the Jews were no longer afraid. In fact, they were very happy and felt that they had won a victory.

dag: Ka ŋunkam daa mali gali sabilifaa bee gali ʒiɛkpeein bee gali ʒiɛkpain bee tan piɛl viɛlli bee buhi kɔbiri bee bɛ ni niŋ moonsi mɔhi piɛ gban shɛŋa bee teeku ni biŋkɔb bal shɛb gbana daa zaŋ li na.
en: Everyone brought their blue, purple, and red wool, their fine linen, and their cloth made of goat hair, as well as their ram skins dyed red and their fine leather.

dag: Ti Duuma Shia Kasi be n zuɣu, dama o pii ma ni n yihi lahibal suŋ waazu ti tarimba. O tim ma na ni n ti chɛ ka bɛn nyɛ daba la yi dabitim ni, ka chɛ ka zoomba nina neei, ka fa bɛn be muɣisigu ni la bahi.
en: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because the Lord has anointed me . He has sent me to preach good news to the poor, to proclaim release to the prisoners and recovery of sight to the blind, to liberate the oppressed.

dag: Nuhu gba ni daa ti paai yuun kɔbisinu saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Shɛm mini Ham ni Jafɛt.
en: After Noah was years old, he had sons named Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

dag: Nyini n-daa zaŋ kɔba mini jila tuɣituɣi ma, ka zaŋ niŋgbuŋ mini gbaŋ pili ma.
en: Then you tied my bones together with muscles and covered them with flesh and skin.

dag: Lala n-shiri niŋ Babilɔn maa bɛ ni daa nya anabinim mini Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda zaŋ tabili bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb zaa dunia ŋɔ ni la ʒim di puuni la zuɣu.
en: Babylon was punished because the blood of prophets and of God's people was found in the city; yes, the blood of all those who have been killed on earth.

dag: Jɔshua ni daa be luɣ shɛli din miri Jɛriko maa, ka o daa ti kpuɣ o zuɣu n-lihi nya do so ka o ŋooi takɔbi gbib o nuu ni ʒe o tooni. Ka Jɔshua daa chaŋ o sani ti bɔh o, A lee bela ti polo bee a bela ti dimnim polo.
en: When Joshua was near Jericho, he looked up. He caught sight of a man standing in front of him with his sword drawn. Joshua went up and said to him, Are you on our side or that of our enemies.

dag: mini Judas Isikariɔt ŋun daa ti yi Yisa nyaaŋ la.
en: Judas Iscariot .

dag: Ka Bɔaz yɛli, Di viɛla, amaa a yi da tiŋgbani maa Naomi sani, shee ka a zaŋ Rut ŋun nyɛ pakoli ka lan nyɛ Mɔab nir la gba pahi, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka ŋun kpi la zuliya na kul su tiŋgbani maa.
