en: Boaz said, Very well, if you buy the field from Naomi, then you are also buying Ruth, the Moabite widow, so that the field will stay in the dead man's family.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Nyama, n ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu yi a yiŋ dundɔŋ ni na n-lu a zuɣu; ka n ti zaŋ a paɣiba ti a ʒiʒiinikpee ka o zaŋ ba dɔni palo ni wuntaŋ ni a ninni.
en: This is what the LORD says: I am making trouble come against you from inside your own family. Before your very eyes I will take your wives away and give them to your friend, and he will have sex with your wives in broad daylight.

dag: Wuntaŋ ni daa ti miri lubu saha shɛli, ka gom daa gbaai Ibram pam ka o dɔni gbihi, ka zibisim titali din mali dabiɛm pam daa zibig o sani.
en: As the sun was setting, Abram fell into a deep sleep, and everything became dark and frightening.

dag: nti darig o tibili darigiri biɛɣu, ka zaŋ o pahi bilikɔɣinim ni. Nimaani ka niriba ni ti fabili ka dim bɛ nyina.
en: This servant will then be punished and thrown out with the ones who only pretended to serve their master. There they will cry and grit their teeth in pain.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛl o, Tim ma pini. A ni zaŋ Nɛgɛb tiŋgbani n-ti ma la zuɣu, tim ma kulibɔna din kom zɔri gba pahi. Ka Kalɛb daa zaŋ zuɣusaa polo mini naɣiliŋga ni kulibɔna ti o pahi.
en: Acsah answered, Give me a blessing. You gave me dry desert land in the Negev. Please give me some land with water on it. So Caleb gave her what she wanted. He gave her the upper and lower pools of water in that land.

dag: Ka n ni ti be yi sani, ka ku lan zaɣisi ya.
en: I will place my dwelling among you, and I will not despise you.

dag: Di saha ka tihi maa zaa daa chaŋ ti yɛli tanyibiga, Ti bɔri ni nyini n-leei ti naa.
en: Finally, all the trees said to the thornbush, Come and be our king.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ tizɔpaɣ Ribɛka min o yiŋ dab paɣa doli Ibrahimma nachin kpɛm maa mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa dol o maa.
en: So they sent off their sister Rebekah, her nurse, Abrahams servant, and his men.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi lihi paɣ maa ka bɔhi Saimɔn, A nya paɣ ŋɔ? N ni kpe a yili ŋɔ na, a bi ti ma kom ni m paɣi n naba; amaa paɣ ŋɔ zaŋ o nintam paɣi n naba, ka zaŋ o zabiri nyɛhi li.
en: Then he turned to the woman and said to Simon, Do you see this woman? When I came into your house, you gave me no water for my feet. But she washed my feet with her tears and dried my feet with her hair.

dag: ka bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a wumdi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛr a, Nyama, Dauda lo a zaɣ biɛɣu la yɛtɔɣa.
en: and said: Your Majesty, why do you listen to people who say that I'm trying to harm you?.

dag: ni Rɛmɛt ni Ɛnganim ni Ɛnhada ni Bɛtipazɛz daa be.
en: Remeth, En-gannim, En-haddah, and Beth-pazzez.

dag: O ni yi nyam, ka o ni sɔhira, o varila tiŋa. Bɛ yi ti piɛbi kikaa, o bi tooi zaani luɣ yini.
en: Excitedly, trembling, he swallows the ground; cant stand still at a trumpets blast.

dag: Dunia ni daa na bi nam saha shɛl la, ka Naawuni daa pun pii ti leeg o niriba Masia zuɣu ni di chɛ ka ti be kasi ka ka galimi ŋun Naawuni sani. Naawuni yurilim zuɣu.
en: Even before the world was made, God had already chosen us to be his through our union with Christ, so that we would be holy and without fault before him. Because of his love.

dag: Ka daa lan zaŋ nimaani hal ti paai Jafilɛtinim tiŋgban ni n-zaŋ lala hal ti paai Bɛtihɔrɔnnim tiŋgbani din daa be zolɔŋni la m-mali lala hal ni Gɛza n-yi nimaani chaŋ ti naai Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku ni.
en: It then went west to the area of the Japhletites, as far as the area of Lower Beth Horon. It went on from there to Gezer and ended at the Mediterranean Sea.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni liri ba kaman gbuɣinli ni liriti binyara shɛm la, n ni dɔni sol naŋgban kpaŋ gu ba kaman jɛŋgbini ni doya gu binyara shɛm la.
en: So I will become like a lion to them; like a leopard I will lurk beside the road.

dag: O daa zaŋ ba chaŋ ni alaafee, ka dabiɛm bi mali ba, ka teeku daa zaŋ bɛ dimnim la vali.
en: He guided them safely. They had nothing to fear. He drowned their enemies in the sea.

dag: Baŋmiya ni Yawɛ n-nyɛ Naawuni. Ŋuna n-nam ti, ka ti nyɛ o ni su shɛba. Ti nyɛla o niriba, ka nyɛ o ni gul shɛba kaman piɛri la.
en: Know that the Lord is God. He made us, and we belong to him. We are his people, the sheep he takes care of.

dag: O daa zaŋ li ti o daba Izraɛlnima. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: he gave them to Israel, his servant; his love is eternal.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n yur a zaligunim maa gari salima din viɛlli pam.
en: I love your commands more than gold, more than the purest gold.

dag: Juda naa Jɔsia bia Jɛhoyakim nam dibu piligu saha ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o yɛligu ŋɔ yɛli ma.
en: Early in the rule of Judahs King Jehoiakim, Josiahs son, this word came from the LORD.

dag: O daa daŋ tɔɣisirila Ijipti yɛla zaŋ chaŋ Ijipti Naa Nɛko tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli Karikɛmish, ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa nyaŋ ba Juda naa Jɔsia bia Naa Jɛhoyakim nam dibu yuma anahi ni la.
en: beginning with Egypt. This is what he said about the army of King Neco of Egypt, which King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia defeated at Carchemish near the Euphrates River in the fourth year that Jehoiakim was king of Judah:.

dag: Di pa ni ti kuunimi ni tinim su yi ni niŋ yɛda shɛm fukumsi, dama yi ʒiɛla dɛde yi ni niŋ yɛda shɛm puuni, amaa tinim lee pahila yi zuɣu n-tumdi yi suhupiɛlli nyabu zuɣu.
en: We are not trying to dictate to you what you must believe; we know that you stand firm in the faith. Instead, we are working with you for your own happiness.

dag: Yɛlim Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni o wuhim a shihirili; di ni tooi nyɛ din zilima kaman kpiimba biɛhigu shee bee din du kaman zuɣusaa la.
en: Ask the Lord your God to give you a sign. It can be from deep in the world of the dead or from high up in heaven.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛmiya Naawuni gbaɣino mini di nɛma zaa, ka di chɛ ka yi tooi ba n-zani dabisi biɛɣu dali, ka yi yi niŋ dimbɔŋɔnim zaa, yi shiri ni ba n-zani.
en: So put on all the armor that God gives. Then when that evil day comes, you will be able to defend yourself. And when the battle is over, you will still be standing firm.

dag: Dama n yi ti zaŋ ba tahi tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam maa ni, n ni daa po pɔri bɛ yaannim sani ni n zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba la ni, ka bɛ ti di n-tiɣi ŋmɛlim, bɛ ni yuli ʒiɛm ma, ka saɣim m-mini ba daalikauli maa, ka chaŋ ti jɛm wuna.
en: I will take them into this rich and fertile land, as I promised their ancestors. There they will have all the food they want, and they will live comfortably. But they will turn away and worship other gods. They will reject me and break my covenant.

dag: Ɛhab kum nyaaŋa ka Mɔabnim daa zaɣisi Izraɛlnim jɛmbu.
en: After Ahab died, Moab rebelled against Israel.

dag: Amaa ka bidibbil so daa ti nya ba ka chaŋ ti yɛli Absalom, ka bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa daa zo yomyom ti kpe Bahurim do so yiŋa, doo maa daa malila kɔbiliga o yiŋa ka bɛ siɣi di puuni.
en: But one day a boy happened to see them, and he told Absalom; so they hurried off to hide in the house of a certain man in Bahurim. He had a well near his house, and they got down in it.

dag: ni Madɔn naa ni Hazɔr naa.
en: the king of Madon, the king of Hazor.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ya ka a ba maa lee be? Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yi ʒi ma bee m Ba. Yi yi di mi ma, yi naan mi m Ba maa gba.
en: They asked him, Where is your Father? Jesus answered, You dont know me and you dont know my Father. If you knew me, you would also know my Father.

dag: N lɔri nol la buyi dakulo kam, ka yihiri n ni nya shɛlikam zaka.
en: I fast twice a week. I give a tenth of everything I receive.

dag: O ni daa nya ka Farisiinim mini Sadusiinim pam gba kanna ni o ti baptaizi ba ka o bɔhi ba, Yinim garinsi zuliya ŋɔ, ŋuni n-lee saɣisi yi mi ni yi zo n-yi mbusim shɛli din ti yɛn kana ŋɔ ni?.
en: Many Pharisees and Sadducees came to be baptized by John. He said to them, You children of snakes! Who warned you to escape from the angry judgment that is coming soon?.

dag: Dama Masia bi tim ma ni n ti baptaizi niriba, amaa o tim ma ni n ti yihila lahibal suŋ waazu, ka di mi pala baŋsim yɛtɔɣa puuni; dama di yi nyɛla baŋsim yɛtɔɣa zuɣu, dindina Yisa Masia dapulli zuɣu kum yiko ni gbarigi.
en: Christ did not give me the work of baptizing people. He gave me the work of telling the Good News. But he sent me to tell the Good News without using clever speech, which would take away the power that is in the cross of Christ.

dag: Amaa ka Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ wuntizɔriba ni ti deei nam maa n-su li sahakam hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: but the holy ones of the Most High will receive the kingship. They will hold the kingship securely forever and always.

dag: N ni zaŋ n shia niŋ yi ni, ka chɛ ka yi doli n zalikpana mini n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: because I will put my Spirit in you and make you eager to obey my laws and teachings.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa yɛli Gaad ni o yɛlim Dauda ni o cham ti me sara maligu bimbini zali Yawɛ Aruna ŋun nyɛ Jɛbusi nir la kabɔɣili ni.
en: Then the angel of the Lord spoke to Gad. He said, Tell David to build an altar to worship the Lord . David must build that altar near the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

dag: Aizaia daa yɛli ba mi, Yɛlimiya yi dana ni Yawɛ yɛliya, Di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa a ni wum ka Asiria naa tuumba kana ti yɛli tu ma maa zuɣu.
en: I told them that the Lord had this message for Hezekiah: I am the Lord . Don't worry about the insulting things that have been said about me by these messengers from the king of Assyria.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri suhu din be kasi, ka tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ suma ni tooi nyɛ naa zɔnima.
en: Those who love a pure heart— their speech is gracious, and the king is their friend.

dag: Sokam zaa tamla n yɛla, kaman bɛ ni tamdi ŋun kpi yɛla shɛm la, hal n ŋmanila salichee gba.
en: People want to forget me like someone already dead, thrown away like a broken dish.

dag: Ka n yɛli n suhu ni zaŋ chaŋ ninsalinim polo, Naawuni buɣisiri ba mi ni o wuhi ni ninsalinim ŋmanila biŋkɔbiri.
en: I decided that God is testing us, to show us that we are no better than animals.

dag: Ifriimnim daa yi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, niriba niŋgbuna sɔhirimi, bɛ daa tibigi ba pam Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Amaa ka bɛ daa ti jɛmdi Baal, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ tum alahichi ka kpi.
en: In the past, when the tribe of Ephraim spoke, the other tribes of Israel were afraid; they looked up to Ephraim. But the people sinned by worshiping Baal, and for this they will die.

dag: Dama o zaɣisila Naawuni m-pah o ni tum alahichi shɛli maa zuɣu. O bela ti sani m-maani Naawuni ansarisi, ka yɛr o zilima pahira.
en: You have rebelled against God, time after time, and have even insulted us.

dag: Kpaŋm amaŋ chɛ ka Ziinas ŋun nyɛ zaligubaŋda la mini Apolɔs niŋ yomyom gbaai soli chaŋ, ka zaŋ di ni simdi ni bɛ mali shɛli ti ba.
en: When Zenas the lawyer and Apollos get ready to leave, help them as much as you can, so they won't have need of anything.

dag: Kunduna mini piɛri ni ti laɣim doya, ka jɛŋgbina mini bubihi ti laɣim doya, ka naɣibihi mini gbuɣimbihi ni gbuɣim pola ti laɣim doya, ka bihi ti vɔri ba chana.
en: Wolves and sheep will live together in peace, and leopards will lie down with young goats. Calves and lion cubs will feed together, and little children will take care of them.

dag: yi yɛra, Bɔ saha ka goli palli dabisili lee yɛn gari, ka chɛ ka ti kɔhi ti kawana, ka bɔ saha ka Vuhim Dabisili lee yɛn gari ka chɛ ka ti kɔhi ti alikama? Ti ni doli ŋarili soli n-filim kaŋmɛri ŋmani, ka lee kpaŋsi di daa.
en: You merchants say, When will the New Moon be over so that we can sell grain? When will the Sabbath be over so that we can bring out more wheat to sell? We can raise the price and make the measure smaller. We can fix the scales and cheat the people.

dag: Ka Haran daa ti kani ka chɛ o ba, o dɔɣiritiŋ din daa nyɛ Ur ka be Kalidianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: Haran died in his hometown, Ur of Babylonia, while his father Terah was still alive.

dag: Di saha ka n yɛli, Din niŋ ma suhugarigu nyɛla, Zallakudura Naa nudirigu yiko la taɣimi.
en: Its my misfortune, I thought, that the strong hand of the Most High is different now.

dag: Malimiya sara shɛli din tuhi, ka niŋ Yawɛ naani.
en: Give the right sacrifices to the Lord , and put your trust in him!.

dag: Bɛ tum tuumbiɛri pam kaman bɛ ni daa be Gibia la. Naawuni ni ti teei bɛ tuumbiɛri maa yɛla, ka darigi bɛ tibili bɛ daalahichi maa zuɣu.
en: You are brutal and corrupt, as were the men of Gibeah. But God remembers your sin, and you will be punished.

dag: Ka Shɛshibaza daa kana nti sɔŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa tampuɣili Jɛrusalɛm ŋɔ; ka mɛbu maa tuma kul tumdi di saha maa zaŋ kana pumpɔŋɔ, amaa ka di na lee bi me n-naai.
en: Then Sheshbazzar came and laid the foundations of Gods house in Jerusalem. From then until now the rebuilding work has continued but is not yet complete.

dag: tiri Timoti ŋun nyɛ m bi maŋli ti daadiini soli yɛda niŋbu ni la. Ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia zom a nambɔɣu, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni, ka ti a suhudoo!.
en: To Timothy, my true son in the faith: May God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord give you grace, mercy, and peace.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa ti yi Ramɛsis maa n-chaŋ ti dɔni Sukɔt.
en: After the Israelites left Rameses, they camped at Succoth.

dag: Amaa ya polo ka nir lee yɛn bɔ n-nya yɛm? Ka luɣ dini ka baŋsim be?.
en: But where is wisdom found?.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ a nini kpa bɛ ni teei gili Jɛrusalɛm shɛm la polo, ka teeg a nu zaŋli n-tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi li.
en: With your arm stretched out, face the siege of Jerusalem directly and prophesy against it.

dag: Ka anabi Ilaija daa sabi gbaŋ ti o na yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a yab Dauda Naawuni la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A bi dol a ba Jɛhɔshafat soli bee n-doli Juda Naa Asa naba.
en: The prophet Elijah sent Jehoram a letter, which read as follows: The Lord , the God of your ancestor David, condemns you, because you did not follow the example of your father, King Jehoshaphat, or that of your grandfather, King Asa.

dag: Dinzuɣu deemiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ noli, ka dol o fukumsi zaligunim min o zaligu shɛŋa zaa n ni zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: So you must obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Kaman fiig tiwal viɛla maa ni be shɛm maa, lala ka n lihi Juda ninvuɣ shɛb n ni daa chɛ ka bɛ gbahi n-zaŋ ba kpe chaŋ Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni la ka bɛ viɛla.
en: The Lord , the God of Israel, said, The people of Judah were taken from their country. Their enemy brought them to Babylon. Those people will be like these good figs. I will be kind to them.

dag: Ka kul doliya n zalikpana la mini n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ka nyɛ n ni daa sab shɛŋa tin ya la. Kul doliya li viɛnyɛliŋga. Miriya ka yi jɛm buɣa.
en: You shall always obey the laws and commands that I wrote for you. You shall not obey other gods.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, ŋun niŋdi alibarika niŋdi niriba ni gari o ni niŋ li niŋ ninvuɣ so ni.
en: Without question, the less important person is blessed by the more important person.

dag: N daa zaŋ n zaɣa niŋ baŋsim bɔbu ni ni m bo n-nya yɛm mini binyara pam, ka m baŋ ni ninvuɣ biɛtali nyɛla jɛrilim, ka jɛrilim nyɛ yinyari.
en: I studied and I tried very hard to find true wisdom. I tried to find a reason for everything. I did learn that it is foolish to be evil, and it is crazy to act like a fool.

dag: Ka nabihi kukoya daa fo, ka bɛ kɔŋ yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu.
en: Even the most important leaders were quiet, as if their tongues were stuck to the roof of their mouths.

dag: Abiata ŋun nyɛ Ahimɛlɛk bia la ni daa yɛn zo n-chaŋ Dauda sani Kɛila maa, o daa zaŋla tan shɛli din ŋmani mukuru la mali chaŋ.
en: When Abiathar son of Ahimelech escaped and joined David in Keilah, he took the ephod with him.

dag: Anabi Musa zaligu daa zalila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi be tibi ni bɛ nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulaannima, amaa Naawuni pɔri din daa doli fukumsi zaligu nyaaŋa la daa zalila ŋun Naawuni maŋmaŋ Bia ŋun be tibi hal ni saha din ka bahigu la.
en: The Law of Moses appoints men who are imperfect to be high priests; but God's promise made with the vow, which came later than the Law, appoints the Son, who has been made perfect forever.

dag: Yawɛ Shia tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa n sani, ka o yɛligu be n zilinli zuɣu.
en: The Lord s Spirit spoke through me. His word was on my tongue.

dag: Ka Absalom min o niriba zaa ni Izraɛlnim daa chaŋ ti kpe Jɛrusalɛm, ka Ahitɔfɛl gba daa be o sani.
en: Now Absalom and all the Israelites entered Jerusalem, and Ahithophel was with him.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa deei nyuli zabbu sara chi zim maa paɣ maa nuu ni n-zaŋ li gahi zuɣusaa Yawɛ tooni, ka zaŋ li pa sara maligu bimbini zuɣu;.
en: The priest will take the grain offering for jealousy from the womans hands, elevate the grain offering before the LORD, and bring it to the altar.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n chɛ ka anabinim daa kana ti saɣisi ba. Ka n zaŋ n nol ni yɛtɔɣa ku ba, n saria karibu kul nɛmi kaman neesim la.
en: That's why I slaughtered you with the words of my prophets. That's why my judgments blazed like the dawning sun.

dag: Amaa yi yi ku deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ noli bee n-doli n ni zaŋ o fukumsi zaligunim ŋɔ min o zaligu shɛŋa n ni zaŋ tiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga, dindina noli dibu ŋɔ zaa ni lu yi zuɣu din ya.
en: But if you disobey the Lord your God and do not faithfully keep all his commands and laws that I am giving you today, all these evil things will happen to you:.

dag: Ka ŋun pah ayɔbu mi nyɛ Itiriam, o ma n-daa nyɛ Ɛgila ŋun daa nyɛ Dauda paɣ la, Hiburɔn ka bɛ daa dɔɣi bɛ zaa.
en: The sixth son was Ithream. Ithreams mother was Davids wife Eglah. These sons were all born at Hebron.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yɛtɔɣa nyɛla yɛm yɛtɔɣa. Ka bɛ kul tɔɣisirila din tuhi yɛla.
en: The words of good people are wise, and they are always fair.

dag: A zaligunim kul nyɛla din tuhi sahakam. Tim ma baŋsim din ni chɛ ka m be.
en: Your instructions are always just; give me understanding, and I shall live.

dag: Zuliya kam kul taarila duŋ ka nam kam damda. O yi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, tiŋgbani nyɛligirimi.
en: Nations will shake with fear and kingdoms will fall when God shouts and makes the earth move.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ, nyin zom ma nambɔɣu, ka n yiɣisi zani, m-bɔhi ba biɛri labisi.
en: Lord , please be kind to me. Let me get up, and I will pay them back.

dag: Zom ma nambɔɣu, ka m be, dama n suhu yu a zaligunim maa pam.
en: Have mercy on me, and I will live because I take pleasure in your law.

dag: Ɛli ni daa wum kuhigu maa, ka o bɔhi, Ka bo vuri n-lee bala? Ka doo maa daa zɔna yomyom ti yɛli Ɛli di ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Eli heard the noise and asked, What is all this noise about? The man hurried to Eli to tell him the news. .

dag: Duɣu ka bɛ mali buɣisiri anzinfa, ka zaŋdi buɣim pam buɣisiri salima, amaa Yawɛ m-buɣisiri ninsal suhu.
en: Gold and silver are tested by fire, and a person's heart is tested by the Lord .

dag: Nyam tumo ŋun mali lahiba suŋ mini suhudoo yɛtɔɣa n-zɔri duri zoya kanna ŋɔ naba ni viɛli pam shɛm! O moonila tiliginsim molo yɛri Ziɔnnima, Yi Naawuni nyɛla naa.
en: How wonderful it is to see someone coming over the hills to tell good news. How wonderful to hear him announce, There is peace! We have been saved! and to hear him say to Zion, Your God is the king.

dag: Ka anab maa daa bo tani n-lo o nini n-taɣ o biɛhigu ŋ-ŋmaligi yi sol ni ti ʒiɛya guhiri naa.
en: The prophet left and put a bandage over his face to disguise himself. Then he went and stood beside the road, waiting for Ahab to pass by.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa lo ni o ni kun ya la, n daa teemi dɔni m puli zuɣu Yawɛ tooni wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ biɛɣ pihinahi.
en: So I lay face downward in the Lord 's presence those forty days and nights, because I knew that he was determined to destroy you.

dag: dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka soya niŋ Mɔab luɣili zuɣu tintariga tinsi din nyɛ Bɛtijɛshimɔt mini Baalimiɔn ni Kiriataim din nyɛ bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa jilima tinsi la ni.
en: I will let the cities that defend the border of Moab be attacked, including even the finest cities—Beth Jeshimoth, Baal Meon, and Kiriathaim.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛl o, Di simdi ka a ti ti sara maligu biŋkɔbiri mini ti ni yɛn zaŋ binshɛŋa ti nyo buɣim ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni maa.
en: No! Moses replied. You must let us offer sacrifices to the Lord our God.

dag: Bɛ yi gbaai jɛŋgbin nyaŋ bia ka chɛ o ka o chirig a, di so ni a zaŋ a nyɔɣu yo jɛrigu o jɛrilim tuma saha.
en: It is better to meet a bear robbed of her cubs than a fool who is busy doing foolish things.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ŋmaligi lihi nya paɣ maa ka yɛl o, M bia, chɛ ka a suhu kpɛma, a yɛda niŋbu n-chɛ ka a kpaŋ. Ka o dɔro maa daa dii naai.
en: Jesus turned and saw the woman. He said, Be happy, dear woman. You are made well because you believed. Then the woman was healed.

dag: Shɛkania bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Shɛmaya. Ka Shɛmaya bidibisi daa nyɛ Hatush mini Igal ni Baria ni Niaria ni Shafat, bɛ daa nyɛla niriba ayɔbu.
en: the father of Shemaiah and the grandfather of Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat.

dag: ka kom maa daa gbaai nyuubu biɛlabiɛla. Zaŋ chaŋ biɛɣ kɔbiga ni pihinu dali, ka kom maa daa filim.
en: For days the water slowly went down.

dag: Ka Yawɛ chɛ ka o kukoli be o tɔbbihi tooni tahira. Dama o tɔbbihi galisiya pam, ka bɛn deer o noli ka kalinli. Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ dabisili nyɛla dabisili titali ka mali dabiɛm pam. Ka ŋuni n-lee ni ti tooi zaŋ o nyɔɣu yo li?.
en: The Lord thunders commands to his army. The troops that obey him are many and mighty. How terrible is the day of the Lord ! Who will survive it?.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, doo bee paɣ yi bi ʒe Yawɛ yim ka tum o kpee taali, dilan maa leei ŋun tum alahichi.
en: Tell the Israelites: When a man or a woman commits any sin against anyone else, thus breaking faith with the LORD, that person becomes guilty.

dag: O nyɛla ŋun bɔri piɛri kɔbiri mini gumdi shee, ka zaŋ o nuhi tumdi tuma ni o suhu zaa.
en: and with her own hands she gladly makes clothes.

dag: Ka Zilla mi daa dɔɣi Tubalikeen ŋun daa nyɛ ŋun zaŋ daanya mini kuriti m-mali tuma nɛma balibu kam zaa la. Ka Tubalikeen tizɔpaɣ daa nyɛ Naama.
en: Lamech and Zillah had a son named Tubal Cain who made tools out of bronze and iron. They also had a daughter, whose name was Naamah.

dag: Dɛbɔra, yiɣisima, yiɣisima. Yiɣisima, yiɣisima, Yilimi yilli! Barak Abinɔam bia, yiɣisim zaŋ a ni gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb daba la kuli!.
en: Wake up, wake up, Deborah! Wake up, wake up, sing the song! Get up, Barak! Go capture your enemies, son of Abinoam!.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Aduna daa duh o bɔɣiri zuɣusaa kpa niriba maa polo n-suhi alibarika niŋ bɛ ni, ka daa yi alahichi sanyoo sara maligu mini bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ni suhudoo sara malibu shee maa siɣina.
en: When Aaron had finished all the sacrifices, he raised his hands over the people and blessed them, and then stepped down.

dag: Bɛ ni me birini gili tin shɛl la lumi dahim zaa, ka bɛ chɛ li bahi kaman tiŋgban nɛl la. Di leela biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee ni bɛ ni dooni luɣ shɛli vuhira.
en: The fortified city lies alone, a hut forsaken, abandoned like the desert. Calves graze there; they lie down there and feed on its boughs.

dag: Ka bɔzuɣu ka yi daa chaŋ? Anabi ka yi daa chaŋ ni yi ti nya? Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, hal o gari anabi gba.
en: What did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and more than a prophet.

dag: Nuhu bidibisi, bɛn yuya daa booni Shɛm mini Ham ni Jafɛt la zuliya m-bɔŋɔ. Kom ni daa di dunia maa nyaaŋa, ka bɛ daa dɔɣi bidibisi.
en: These are the descendants of Noahs sons Shem, Ham, and Japheth, to whom children were born after the flood.

dag: O ba min o ma ni daa ti nya o, di daa gari ba pam, ka o ma bɔh o, M bia, bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ ti lala? A bi nya m min a ba ni lihiri bɔr a shee ni suhusaɣiŋgu shɛm.
en: When his parents found him, they were amazed. His mother said, Son, why have you done this to us? Your father and I have been very worried, and we have been searching for you.

dag: Sulemaana daa me omaŋmaŋ yili. Yuun pinaata ka o daa zaŋ me li naai.
en: Solomon also built a palace for himself, and it took him thirteen years.

dag: Ka bɛ daa me goon ŋmaa zali du bila kam tooni, ka di dubu nyɛ sɛntimita pihinu, ka di barilim nyɛ sɛntimita pihinu di yaɣa zaa, ka dubihi buɣisibu nyɛ mita atata di yaɣa zaa.
en: A border running along the front of the rooms on each side was eighteen inches wide, and each of the rooms was nine feet square.

dag: Dishan bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Uzi mini Aran.
en: These are Dishans sons: Uz and Aran.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa zaŋ anzinfa laɣibaligu pinaanu mini chi kilɔgiram kɔbiga ni pihinu yo o zuɣu.
en: So I paid fifteen pieces of silver and seven bushels of barley to buy her.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn bia Abimilɛk la daa ti chaŋ Shɛkɛm o ŋahinim min o ma daŋ niriba zaa sani ti yɛli ba.
en: Abimelech the son of Gideon went to Shechem. While there, he met with his mother's relatives.

dag: N zaŋ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ti o ka di leeg o tuma yɔri, dama n tuma ka bɛ daa tum ti ma maa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Egypt will be his reward, because he and his army have been following my orders. I, the Lord God, have spoken.

dag: Ti yab Ibrahimma daa guhirila tin shɛli Naawuni maŋmaŋ ni zali di tanzaa ka lan nyɛ ŋun me li, ka di ku vuui.
en: For Abraham was waiting for the city which God has designed and built, the city with permanent foundations.

dag: Amaa yum maa yi ti lan taɣi m-paligi, di saha ŋun kam maligumaana sanna.
en: But when the sore heals and becomes white again, you shall go to the priest.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, Firawuna daa lan yɛli Yisifu, Mani n-nyɛ Firawuna, so ku tooi kpuɣ o nuu zuɣusaa bee n-vuug o napɔŋ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa ni, ka pa ni nyini m-bah o noli.
en: The king said to him, I am the king—and no one in all Egypt shall so much as lift a hand or a foot without your permission.

dag: Yɛlimiy o ni n wumya ni o chɛrila o piɛri kɔbiri ni o piɛguliba maa mi yi kul bela ti sani, ka ti bi niŋ ba zaɣ biɛ shɛli, bɛ mi binshɛli daa bi bɔrigi bɛ ni daa be ti sani Kamɛl saha shɛli maa.
en: I heard that you are cutting wool from your sheep. Your shepherds were with us for a while, and we did nothing wrong to them. We never took anything from your shepherds while they were at Carmel.

dag: Ka yil yin nim yi ŋmaligi zabira, bɛ yili maa mi wurindimi.
en: And a family that fights won't last long either.

dag: Ka di tiŋgbɔŋ maa salima viɛl pam; ka tulaale tihi mini kuɣ viɛla gba be nimaani.
en: where pure gold, rare perfumes, and precious stones are found.

dag: Dama n ni chɛ ka a nya filiŋ zuliya kam sani, ka ninsalinim lihi ʒiɛm a.
en: Edom, I will make you become unimportant. Everyone will hate you.

dag: Ŋunkam nini nya ma ku lan nya ma yaha. A nina kul yɛn lihiri ma mi, ka n chaŋ.
en: Those who see me now will never see me again. You watch me for a while, but then I am gone.

dag: Amaa chɛ ka bɛnkam nya sɔɣibu shee a sani mali suhupiɛlli; chɛ ka bɛ kul yiini suhupiɛlli yila sahakam. Guli ba, ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yur a yuli nya suhupiɛlli a sani.
en: Let all who run to you for protection always sing joyful songs. Provide shelter for those who truly love you and let them rejoice.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Mɔabnim tuumbiɛri buta ni bunahi zuɣu n ku chɛ bɛ tibili darigibu; bɛ ni daa zaŋ Ɛdom naa kɔba nyo buɣim la zuɣu.
en: The Lord said: I will punish Moab for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They made lime from the bones of the king of Edom.

dag: O ni daa paai Nazarɛt, o daa bi yuui, ka yi nimaani gari chaŋ Kapɛrinium din be teeku duli Zɛbulɔn mini Naftali tiŋgbana ni la.
en: He did not stay in Nazareth, but went to live in Capernaum, a town by Lake Galilee, in the territory of Zebulun and Naphtali.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa ŋmaligi yɛli Adam mi, A ni deeg a paɣ noli, ka di ti shɛli n ni yɛl a ni a miri ka a di la zuɣu, n yɛli noli niŋ tiŋgban ni a zuɣu; a yɛn tumdila tuun kpɛma di ni n-nyari bindirigu diri hal ni a nyɛvil tariga.
en: Then God said to the man, I commanded you not to eat from that tree. But you listened to your wife and ate from it. So I will curse the ground because of you. You will have to work hard all your life for the food the ground produces.

dag: Yawɛ niŋdi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ o naani mini bɛnkam jɛmd o zaɣ viɛlli.
en: The Lord is good to everyone who trusts in him.

dag: Ka o daa gbahi buɣa maa maligumaaniba bɛn daa be nimaani zaa n-ku ba pa bimbina zuɣu, ka daa nyo ninsalinim kɔba buɣim bimbina maa zuɣu. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa ŋmaligi lab Jɛrusalɛm.
en: He actually slaughtered on those altars all the priests of the shrines who were there, and he burned human bones on them. Then Josiah returned to Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Liya daa yɛli, Zuɣusuŋ; ka daa boli bia maa yuli Gaad.
en: Leah said, I have been lucky; so she named him Gad.

dag: Bɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ tuma yiɣisi Yawɛ suhu, ka o daa chɛ ka alɔbo lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: They stirred up the Lord 's anger by their actions, and a terrible disease broke out among them.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛhoyakim daa tim Akibɔr bia Ɛlnatan mini do shɛba Ijipti.
en: King Jehoiakim, however, sent Elnathan son of Achbor and some other men to Egypt to get Uriah.

dag: Man yɛn bela Mizipa n-ʒe yi zaani Babilɔnnim bɛn yɛn ka kpe na sani. Amaa yinim kul benya yi ni be tin shɛŋa ni maa, ka tɔɣimiya wain mini kpam, ka pɔhiri tiwala n-zaŋdi li niŋdi binyara ni zaana.
en: I will stay here at Mizpah and meet with the Babylonian officials on each of their visits. But you must go back to your towns and bring in the harvest, then store the wine, olive oil, and dried fruit.

dag: O ni daa ti nya ka Pita mini Jɔn yɛn kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni saha shɛli maa, ka o maani ba bara.
en: When he saw Peter and John about to enter, he began to ask them for a gift.

dag: amaa paɣ ŋun yi mali zab wɔɣila, di pahir o la jilima. Dama Naawuni ti o zabiri maa la o zuɣu pilibu zuɣu.
en: but on a woman it is a thing of beauty. Her long hair has been given her to serve as a covering.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋun tɛhi ni o ʒe dɛde, ŋun miri ka o ti niŋ lu.
en: Even if you think you can stand up to temptation, be careful not to fall.

dag: Ka Pool ŋahiŋga daa wum bɛ ni to jina gbaai shɛm maa, ka chaŋ ti kpe tɔbbihi biɛhigu shee maa nti zaŋ yɛlli maa yɛli Pool.
en: When Paul's nephew heard about the plot, he went to the fortress and told Paul about it.

dag: Wulimpuhili polo din ti yɛn nyɛ kilomita ayi ni mita kɔbisiyi ni pihinu la ni ti malila dunɔdaya ata. Yisifu zuliya dunɔdali mini Bɛnjamin zuliya dunɔdali ni Dan zuliya dunɔdali.
en: The east side of the city will be cubits long. There will be three gates: Josephs Gate, Benjamins Gate, and Dans Gate.

dag: Ka Ɛsta daa yɛli ba ni bɛ labimi ti yɛli Mɔdɛkai:.
en: Esther sent Mordecai this reply:.

dag: Ka Jɔshua min o tɔbbihi daa chaŋ ti liri ba Mɛrom kulibɔŋ maa ni libigi ba.
en: So Joshua and his whole army surprised the enemy and attacked them at the river of Merom.

dag: Dinzuɣu a yi yɛn ti nandaamba pini, nyin di mooni li kaman bilikɔɣinim ni niŋdi shɛm Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni mini pala zuɣu ni niriba nyari ba m-paɣiri ba la. Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, bɛn pun nya bɛ laara.
en: When you give to the poor, don't blow a loud horn. That's what show-offs do in the synagogues and on the street corners, because they are always looking for praise. I can assure you that they already have their reward.

dag: Ka paɣ maa dii lu Pita tooni kpi. Ka nachimba maa daa kpɛna nti nya ka o kpimi doya, ka bɛ kpuɣ o gba yi nti sɔɣ o baɣil o yidan maa gballi.
en: At that moment Sapphira fell down by his feet and died. The young men came in and saw that she was dead. They carried her out and buried her beside her husband.

dag: Dama nir yi nya o dindana ŋ-ŋɔ, o ni chɛ o ni alaafee? Dinzuɣu a ni niŋ ma shɛm zuŋɔ ŋɔ, Yawɛ ni yo a sam viɛlli.
en: If you really were my enemy, you wouldn't have let me leave here alive. I pray that the Lord will give you a big reward for what you did today.

dag: Juda bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Pɛrɛz mini Hɛzirɔn ni Karimi ni Hur ni Shɔbal.
en: Judah was the father of five sons: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa tɔɣisi Yaakubu yɛtɔɣa ʒii puuni yuŋ. O daa bol o mi, Yaakubu, Yaakubu. Ka o saɣi ka yɛli, N nyɛ ma.
en: That night, God spoke to him in a dream and said, Jacob! Jacob! Here I am, Jacob answered.

dag: Nyini n-daa nam dunia ŋɔ kurimbuni ha, a nuhi ka a daa zaŋ nam zuɣusaa.
en: You laid the earths foundations long ago; the skies are your handiwork.

dag: Amaa a yi labi tiŋ maa puuni nti yɛli Absalom, N dan naa, n ni leeg a kpambala. Kaman n ni yi kul nyɛ a ba kpambala shɛm, lala ka n yɛn nyɛ a gba kpambala, dina n-ni chɛ ka a nyaŋ Ahitɔfɛl yikombiɛlim maa ti ma.
en: But if you go back to Jerusalem, you can disagree with Ahithophel and make his advice useless. Tell Absalom, King, I am your servant. I served your father, but now I will serve you.

dag: Ka n daa bɔhi malaika maa, N dana, bɔ ka binyara ŋɔ lee wuhira.
en: Then I asked the angel who was speaking with me, Sir, what do these things mean.

dag: Ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka tin ya suhudoo!.
en: May God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ give you grace and peace.

dag: Dama n nya ka a mali putɔɣu, ka be alahichi bandi ni.
en: I can see that you are jealous and bound by your evil ways.

dag: N Duuma, a nyɛla Naawun suŋ, ka chɛri niriba taali, ka a yurilim maŋli galisi zaŋ chaŋ bɛnkam zaa suhir a sani.
en: My Lord, you are good and merciful. You love all those who call to you for help.

dag: Ka a bih ayi shɛb a ni pun dɔɣi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni pɔi ka n naanyi kul a sanna Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni na la nyɛla m bihi. Ifriim mini Manaasa nyɛla m bihi kaman Rubin mini Simiɔn ni nyɛ m bihi shɛm la.
en: Jacob continued, Joseph, your two sons, who were born to you in Egypt before I came here, belong to me; Ephraim and Manasseh are just as much my sons as Reuben and Simeon.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali maa ka bɔhi ba, Yinim bilikɔɣinim ŋɔ, bɔ n-niŋ ka yi zahindi ma?.
en: Knowing their evil motives, Jesus replied, Why do you test me, you hypocrites?.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa yiɣisi ka Izraɛl kpamba daa dol o ka bɛ chaŋ Datan mini Abiram sani.
en: Then Moses, accompanied by the leaders of Israel, went to Dathan and Abiram.

dag: Ka Hitinim maa daa zaŋ palo maa mini siliga din daa be di ni maa ti Ibrahimma, ka di leeg o dini, ka o zaŋ li leeg o kpiimba sɔɣibu shee.
en: Abraham bought the field and the cave in it from the Hittites. So this became his property to be used as a burial place.

dag: O daa zaŋ ba doli soli din tuhi hal ti paai bɛ ni yɛn ʒini tin shɛl ni.
en: He led them straight to the city where they would live.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti yaba n-nyɛ Ibrahimma. Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yi yi di nyɛla Ibrahimma yaansi, yi naan tumdi kaman Ibrahimma ni daa tumdi shɛm.
en: They answered him, Our father is Abraham. If you really were Abraham's children, Jesus replied, you would do the same things that he did.

dag: Yi yaannim ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni dahin shɛl la hal ni zuŋɔ n kul timdila n daba zaa bɛn nyɛ anabinim la yi sanna dabisili kam.
en: From the day that your ancestors left Egypt to this day, I have sent my servants to you. My servants are the prophets. I sent them to you again and again.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ takɔbi maa ti ni bɛ nyɛhi li ka di neei, ka bɛ zaŋ li gbibi nuu ni. Bɛ sahi takɔbi maa, ka nyɛhi li ka di neei ni bɛ zaŋ li niŋ ninvuɣ so ŋun kuri niriba nuu ni.
en: So the sword has been polished. Now it can be used. The sword was sharpened and polished. Now it can be put in the hand of the killer.

dag: Yi daa bi ŋubi bɔrɔbɔro bee n-nyu wain bee binnyur kpiɔŋ ni di chɛ ka yi baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Neither have you eaten bread nor drunk wine or beer during this time—so that you would know that I am the LORD your God.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Piim Nan bia Jɔshua ŋun mali biɛrisuŋ la n-zaŋ a nuu pa o zuɣu;.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Take Joshua son of Nun, a capable man, and place your hands on his head.

dag: ni m ba daa yɛli ma, N saɣi kpibu; ka n yi ti kani, nyin zaŋm ma ti sɔɣi n ni daa gbi sil shɛli Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni ni bɛ ti zaŋ ma sɔɣi di ni la puuni; ka daa chɛ ka m-po di pɔri. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, n-suhir o ni o chɛ ka n chaŋ ti sɔɣi m ba ka labina.
en: When my father was near death, I made a promise to him. I promised that I would bury him in a cave in the land of Canaan. This is the cave that he prepared for himself. So please let me go and bury my father. Then I will come back here to you.

dag: N suhiri Naawuni ni a ni mali yurilim shɛli din yi a yɛda niŋbu ni na maa ni kpaŋs a ka a baŋ bin sun shɛŋa zaa ti ni mali Masia ni la viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: I pray that your partnership in the faith might become effective by an understanding of all that is good among us in Christ.

dag: Dama o ni tilig a bɛn bariti zana nuu ni mini alɔbo din kuri niriba ni.
en: God will save you from hidden dangers and from deadly diseases.

dag: Yawɛ niŋsim m-bala, ka di mali ti alahiziba.
en: This was done by the Lord ; what a wonderful sight it is!.

dag: O chɛ ka Lɛbanɔn zoya yiɣiri jɛmdi kaman naɣibil la; ka chɛ ka Siriɔn Zoli gba yiɣiri jɛmdi kaman yɔnaɣila bil la.
en: He makes Lebanon jump around like a young bull, makes Sirion jump around like a young wild ox.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa boli Ziba ŋun daa nyɛ Sool tumtumda la na ti yɛl o, Sool min o daŋ zaa ni daa su shɛlikam zaa n ni zaŋ li ti a dan yaaŋa ŋɔ.
en: David called in Ziba, Saul's chief servant, and told him, Since Mephibosheth is Saul's grandson, I've given him back everything that belonged to your master Saul and his family.

dag: Ka Lɔt min o bipuɣins ayi la daa ti yiɣisi Zɔa n-chaŋ ti du zoya zuɣu n-kpe m-be vokabili ni, dama o daa zɔrila dabiɛm ni o be Zɔa.
en: Since Lot had become fearful of living in Zoar, he and his two daughters headed up from Zoar and settled in the mountains where he and his two daughters lived in a cave.

dag: M mabihi, m mi n suhu ni ka biɛhiŋ kani ni yi mali biɛrisuŋ, ka mali baŋsim zaa, ka ni tooi wuhi taba.
en: My brothers and sisters, I know without a doubt that you are full of goodness and have all the knowledge you need. So you are certainly able to counsel each other.

dag: Paɣiba ni paɣ viɛlli, a yura maa bela o ko ka chɛ shɛba? Bɔ ka a yura maa lee zaŋ gar o taba ka a ti yɛli ti lala?.
en: Most beautiful of women, why is the one you love more special than others? Why do you ask us to tell him how you feel?.

dag: Hal ninvuɣ biɛtali ni nyaɣisi bɛ noya ni, ka bɛ zaŋ li sɔɣi bɛ zilima lɔna ni;.
en: Though wickedness is sweet in their mouths, they hide it under their tongues.

dag: Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa sab gbaŋ tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa niŋ di ni n-ti zuliya kam mini niriba balibu kam ni tinzun yɛtɔɣa balibu kam nim bɛn be dunia ŋɔ zaa ni yɛli, Naawuni timiya suhudoo!.
en: King Nebuchadnezzar sent this letter to the many nations and language groups living around the world. Greetings:.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya maa niriba kalinli daa yiɣisi ninvuɣ tuhi pihitanaanu ni kɔbisinahi.
en: Those enlisted from the tribe of Benjamin were .

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Aduna, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni wuhi ni n nyɛla ŋun be kasi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn miri ma sani, ka chɛ ka sokam nya n jilima. Ka Aduna daa kul shini.
en: Then Moses said to Aaron, This is what the Lord was speaking about when he said, All who serve me must respect my holiness; I will reveal my glory to my people. But Aaron remained silent.

dag: Ti ku zaŋ ti bipuɣinsi ti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba bee n-kpuɣi bɛ bipuɣinsi ti ti bidibisi.
en: We will not intermarry with the foreigners living in our land.

dag: Ka Masia yi daa bi neei kum ni, dindina ti waazu yihibu nyɛla yoli, ka yi yɛda niŋbu gba nyɛ yoli.
en: and if Christ has not been raised from death, then we have nothing to preach and you have nothing to believe.

dag: Kul yumiya taba kaman yi nyɛla mabi yinsi la.
en: Continue loving each other as brothers and sisters in Christ.

dag: Ka di daa bi niŋ Ibrahimma nyaɣisim, dama o gba daa nyɛla o bia.
en: This upset Abraham terribly because the boy was his son.

dag: Sɔdom nanima, Wummiya Yawɛ yɛligu! Gomɔranima, wummiya Naawuni ni wuhiri ya shɛli.
en: You are no better than the leaders and people of Sodom and Gomorrah! So listen to the Lord God:.

dag: Ka Musa daa niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni zal o shɛm maa. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti du Hɔr Zoli maa niriba maa zaa ninni.
en: Moses did what the Lord had commanded. They went up Mount Hor in the sight of the whole community.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa wurim Yawɛ jɛmbu shee suɣili maa nɛma sɔŋ, ka Gɛrishɔn mini Mɛrari zuliya bɛn ʒiri Yawɛ jɛmbu shee suɣili maa nɛma la daa yiɣisi gbaai chandi.
en: Then the Holy Tent was taken down. And the men from the Gershon and the Merari families carried the Holy Tent. So the people from these families were next in line.

dag: Din daa chɛ ka bɛ yɛl lala maa nyɛla bɛ daa zɔrila Yɛhudianima, dama Yɛhudianim maa daa pun yɛli ni so yi ti yɛli ni Yisa nyɛla Masia, bɛ ni kar o bɛ jɛmbu duu.
en: His parents said this because they feared the Jewish authorities. This is because the Jewish authorities had already decided that whoever confessed Jesus to be the Christ would be expelled from the synagogue.

dag: Ka shɛŋa mi lu vuhim shee n-zooi viɛnyɛliŋga m-mali hal ti dɔɣi n-niŋ biɛlim kɔbigakɔbiga, shɛŋa pihiyɔbuyɔbu, shɛŋa mi pihitata.
en: Other seed fell on good soil and bore fruit, in one case a yield of one hundred to one, in another case a yield of sixty to one, and in another case a yield of thirty to one.

dag: O neen ʒira maa ni daa nya ka Sool kpi maa, ka o gba lu o takɔbi zuɣu kpi.
en: When the helper saw that Saul was dead, he also fell on his own sword and died.

dag: Ka Balaam daa yɛli Balak, Mɛm sara maligu bimbina ayopɔin zali ma kpe, ka bo naɣilah ayopɔin mini piɛlah ayopɔin ti ma kpe na.
en: Balaam said to Balak, Build me seven altars here and prepare for me seven bulls and seven rams.

dag: dama dina n-ni chɛ ka ti Duuma niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka tim Yisa Masia so o ni daa pun lo ni o ni tim yi sanna la.
en: Then the time will come when the Lord will give you fresh strength. He will send you Jesus, his chosen Messiah.

dag: M mabihi mini n zɔnim zuɣu, n ni yɛli, Chɛ ka suhudoo be a ni.
en: For the sake of my relatives and friends I say to Jerusalem, Peace be with you.

dag: Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi bahi zuliya kam niriba zuɣu. O suhu yiɣisi bahi bɛ tɔbbihi zuɣu, ka zali ni o ni ku ba.
en: The Lord is angry with all the nations and their armies. He will destroy them all and put them to death.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa ti lo nia ni o ku Jɛrɔbɔam, amaa ka Jɛrɔbɔam daa zo n-kuli Ijipti Naa Shishak sani nti be Ijipti maa hal ka Sulemaana ti kpi.
en: Solomon tried to kill Jeroboam, but Jeroboam ran away to Egypt. He went to King Shishak of Egypt and stayed there until Solomon died.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa ti nya kpiɔŋ, ka muɣisi Keenannim maa ka bɛ tumdi tuma tiri ba, amaa ka lee bi kari ba.
en: When Israel became stronger they forced the Canaanites to work for them, but they didnt completely drive them out.

dag: Dinzuɣu yimaŋmaŋ suhuri ni ye Shia Kasi pina bɔbu zuɣu shɛm, chɛliya ka yi suhuri ye din ni kpaŋsi cheechi ni niriba gba zuɣu lala.
en: Thats why you who want spiritual gifts so much should prefer those gifts that help the church grow stronger.

dag: Ka Adɔnibɛzɛk daa yɛli, Nanim pisopɔin bɛn nubihilɔri mini bɛ napombihilɔri ŋmahiŋmahi n-yi gahindi bindir burisa din luri tiŋa n tooni, n ni niŋ shɛm ka Naawuni niŋ ma labisi maa. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o tahi Jɛrusalɛm ka o ti kpi nimaani.
en: He said, Seventy kings with severed thumbs and big toes used to pick up scraps under my table, so God has paid me back exactly for what I did. They brought him to Jerusalem, where he died.

dag: Ka tuuli malaika daa piɛb o kikaa, ka sakuɣa mini buɣim ni ʒim daa gari taba luri dunia ni, ka dunia tiŋgbani pirigibu ʒii buta puuni yim di buɣim, ka tihi pirigibu ʒii buta puuni yim di buɣim, ka momaha zaa di buɣim.
en: The first angel blew his trumpet. Hail and fire, mixed with blood, came pouring down on the earth. A third of the earth was burned up, a third of the trees, and every blade of green grass.

dag: Amaa yi yi gbilisi tibili viɛnyɛliŋga n-wum o yɛligu ka niŋ n ni yɛli ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam zaa, dindina n ni zaŋ yi dimnim leei n dimnima, ka tuhi bɛn tuhiri ya.
en: If you listen to what he says and do everything I tell you, then I will be an enemy to all of your enemies. I will be against everyone who is against you.

dag: Dama ŋunkam suhira, o deerimi; ka ŋunkam bɔra, o nyarimi; ka ŋunkam mi niŋdi gaafara, o nyarila soli kpɛra.
en: Yes, whoever continues to ask will receive. Whoever continues to look will find. And whoever continues to knock will have the door opened for them.

dag: ka yɛli, N dan naa, nyini n-daa yɛli, Adɔnija ni di nam n kalinsi nyaaŋa n-ʒini n nam ʒiishee.
en: and said: Your Majesty, did you say that Adonijah would be king?.

dag: Yɛlim niriba maa, miligimiya Kɔra mini Datan ni Abiram biɛhigu shee.
en: Speak to the community and say, Withdraw from around the dwellings of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.

dag: Di saha ka Naa maa daa duhi Shadirak mini Mɛshak ni Abɛdnɛgo n-zaŋ ba zali zaashe kara ni Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Then the king made Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego prosperous in the province of Babylon.

dag: Ka Jona garigi yɛli ba, Zaŋmiya ma bahi teeku ŋɔ ni ka teeku maa fo n-dɔni baalim, dama m mi ni n zuɣu ka sanʒiɛɣu ŋɔ ʒiɛri ya maa.
en: He said to them, Pick me up and hurl me into the sea! Then the sea will become calm around you. I know its my fault that this great storm has come upon you.

dag: Amaa m bɔri ni yi baŋ ni doo kam zuɣulana nyɛla Masia; ka paɣ zuɣulana nyɛ o yidana; ka Masia mi zuɣulana nyɛ Naawuni.
en: But I want you to understand this: The head of every man is Christ. And the head of a woman is the man. And the head of Christ is God.

dag: Ka bipuɣiŋga maa lan yɛl o ba, Bin yini ka n naɣ bɔri ni n suh a. Dina n-nyɛ: chɛl ma ka n niŋ chira ayi pahi, ka n chɛ ka m mini n tab du zoya zuɣu n-fabili n ni yɛn kpi ni m paɣipiɛlital ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Then she said to her father, Let this one thing be done for me: hold off for two months and let me and my friends wander the hills in sadness, crying over the fact that I never had children.

dag: Kamina pumpɔŋɔ nti chɛ ka a mini n dan Asiria naa puli. N ni ti a yuri tusaayi, a yi ni tooi nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ni ba ba.
en: I will make a bargain with you in the name of the emperor. I will give you two thousand horses if you can find that many men to ride them!.

dag: Mɔɣili maa kom yi zo n-chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam, binnɛɔŋ kam ŋun gbamda ni niŋ nyɛvili, kom maa yi paai nimaani zahim pam ni beni. Di ni niŋ nyaɣisim. Ka mɔɣili maa kom yi paai luɣ shɛlikam binshɛɣukam ni niŋ nyɛvili.
en: Wherever this water flows, there will be all kinds of animals and fish, because it will bring life and fresh water to the Dead Sea.

dag: Ka yɛnnim maa daa garigi yɛli ba, Di pa shɛli di ku saɣ ti mini ya zaa; dinzuɣu chamiya kpakɔhiriba sani nti da yi dintol dini na.
en: But the wise bridesmaids replied, No, because if we share with you, there wont be enough for our lamps and yours. We have a better idea. You go to those who sell oil and buy some for yourselves.

dag: mini naɣ tuhi pihitanaayɔbu.
en: , oxen.

dag: Zimiri ni daa kul di n-ʒin o nam ʒiishee, di daa bi yuui ka o ku Baasha daŋ niriba zaa. O daa ku dɔbba bɛn nyɛ o daŋ ni niriba min o zɔnim zaa.
en: Once Zimri became king and sat on the throne, he attacked all of Baashas house. He didnt spare anyone who urinates on a wall, whether relative or friend.

dag: Amaa n kuhi boli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ ni o sɔŋ ma, ka o mi ni tiligi ma.
en: I ask for your help, Lord God, and you will keep me safe.

dag: Dunianim zaa, yilimiya yila paɣi Yawɛ, molimiy o tiliginsim molo dabisili kam.
en: Sing to the Lord , all the world! Proclaim every day the good news that he has saved us.

dag: O daa lan bo sida dakuɣiri din ka kalinli, dama Sidɔnnim mini Taainim daa ʒi sida dakuɣiri maa pam na ti ti Dauda.
en: and innumerable cedar logs from the Sidonians and the Tyrians, who gave them to David.

dag: Ka bɛ kɔŋ o garigibu.
en: But they had no response.

dag: Yuun pihinahi zaa ka n daa je suli niŋ bɛ ʒiɛmani maa nima ka yɛli, Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kul birigiri bɛ suhuri ni ka zaɣisiri n soya dolibu.
en: Then God got tired of them and said, You never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.

dag: ka zaŋ o nuu pa bua maa zuɣu ni, ka kɔrig o Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa tooni, ka Aduna bidibisi zaŋ o ʒim kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini maa luɣilikam.
en: you shall put your hand on its head and kill it in front of the Tent. The priests shall throw its blood against all four sides of the altar.

dag: ni ŋun saɣisiri jɛra ni bihi karimba, ka di nyɛla a ni mi ni baŋsim mini yɛlimaŋli zaa bela Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni zuɣu.
en: And since there is knowledge and truth in God's Law, you think you can instruct fools and teach young people.

dag: N ni chɛ ka yi lab me goon shɛli din daa lu n-dahim la zali. Yi ni me li tam di tanza kura zuɣu. Ka niriba ti wuhi ni yinima n-nyɛ bɛn lab me goma maa mini yiya shɛŋa din daa lu n-dahim la.
en: Your cities have been destroyed for many years, but you will rebuild them and their foundations will last for a long time. You will be called Fence Fixer and Builder of Roads and Houses.

dag: Ka paɣa yi po pɔri Yawɛ sani ka lo alikauli ni o niŋ shɛli o paɣisarilim ni saha shɛl o ni be o ba yiŋa.
en: When a woman makes a solemn promise to the LORD or a binding obligation while she is young and in her fathers household.

dag: O ni daa niŋ lala maa ka yɛli, Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛli ni yi gbib la shɛhira ʒim.
en: He said, This is the blood which seals the covenant that God has commanded you to obey.

dag: Yi zuɣuri ni zaŋ ti siɣi yi naba ni zaa ka alaafee. Amaa dansi mini yuma din kabiri ʒim m-beni; di bi paɣi bee m-pɔbi, kpam mi bi niŋ bɔbili li ka di maha.
en: From the bottom of your feet to the top of your head, every part of your body has wounds, cuts, and open sores. You have not taken care of them. Your wounds have not been cleaned and bandaged.

dag: Amaa a ni yɛli, Naawuni daa ŋmahila tiwula maa bahi ni di chɛ ka o zaŋ ma tuɣi.
en: Maybe you think those branches were cut away, so you could be put in their place.

dag: a yi shiri bo yɛm, ka moog a nini bahi tɛhi zilima zuɣu.
en: Ask for good judgment. Cry out for understanding.

dag: Kumsi saha beni, ka lari saha beni. Fabila saha beni, ka waa wabu saha beni.
en: a time for crying and a time for laughing, a time for mourning and a time for dancing.

dag: Rɛhɔbɔam nam maa ni daa nya zaa zani ka niŋ yaa, di daa bi yuui ka o mini Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn daa be o sani maa zaɣisi Yawɛ zaligu.
en: Soon after Rehoboam had control of his kingdom, he and everyone in Judah stopped obeying the Lord .

dag: Di saha ka bɛ ni yino ŋun daa zo n-tiligi daa kana ti yɛli Ibram ŋun daa nyɛ Hiburu nira ka be Mamri ŋun daa nyɛ Amɔri nir la oki tihi gbini. Mamri min o mabihi bɛn daa nyɛ Ɛshikol mini Anɛr la daa nyɛla Ibram zɔnima.
en: When a survivor arrived, he told Abram the Hebrew, who lived near the oaks of the Amorite Mamre, who was the brother of Eshcol and Aner, Abrams treaty partners.

dag: Yi vihiri Naawuni Kundi, dama yi tɛhiya ni di ni ka yi ni nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu; ka Naawuni Kundi maa maŋmaŋ gba diri ma shɛhira.
en: You study the Scriptures, because you think that in them you will find eternal life. And these very Scriptures speak about me!.

dag: Ŋunkam zaɣisi ni o ku niŋ o zo nirilim, zaŋla Kpiɔŋlan Naa zɔbu bahi.
en: My friends, I am desperate, and you should help me, even if I no longer respect God All-Powerful. *.

dag: Yaakubu ni daa tɔɣis o bihi maa yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai, o daa vuui la o naba pa o bindoo zuɣu dɔni n-leei Naawuni dini pah o yaannim zuɣu.
en: After he finished giving orders to his sons, he put his feet up on the bed, took his last breath, and joined his people.

dag: Yi duri zoya din du pam zuɣu nti maani maligu, ka zaŋdi paɣiba dooni nimaani.
en: On a very high mountain you made your bed. You went up there to offer a sacrifice.

dag: Ka bɛ daa nya paɣisar shɛb bɛn nyɛ paɣipiɛlisi kɔbisinahi Jabɛshigiliadnim maa ni n-zaŋ ba kuli Shilo sansani din be Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni la na.
en: They found four hundred young virgins among the people in Jabesh, so they brought them to the camp at Shiloh, which is in the land of Canaan.

dag: Ka Yisifu Arimatia tiŋbia ŋun daa nyɛ bilichin titali ka lan nyɛ Yɛhudianim jintɔriba ni yino ka daa guli Naawuni nam kandina saha la daa niŋ suhukpeeni n-chaŋ Gomna Pailɛt sani ti suh o soli ni o chɛ ka o zaŋ Yisa ti sɔɣi.
en: A man named Joseph from Arimathea was brave enough to go to Pilate and ask for Jesus body. Joseph was an important member of the high council. He was one of the people who wanted Gods kingdom to come.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla biŋkɔb so bɛ ni zaŋdi maani sara tiri Yawɛ, ninsal yi zaŋ biŋkɔbigu ti Yawɛ, o nyɛla ŋun be kasi.
en: If your vow concerns an animal that is acceptable as an offering to the Lord , then every gift made to the Lord is sacred.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Di zɔr o; dama n zaŋ o min o niriba ni o tiŋgbɔŋ zaa niŋ a nuu ni, niŋm o kaman a ni daa niŋ Amɔrinim Naa Sihɔn ŋun daa be Hɛshibɔn la shɛm la.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Do not be afraid of him. I will give you victory over him, all his people, and his land. Do to him what you did to Sihon, the Amorite king who ruled at Heshbon.

dag: ka ŋmaligi yɛli mmaŋa n suhu ni, M mali nɛma pam din ni gbib ma yuun bɔbigu; n ni ʒini vuhi n-dira ka nyura, ka mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Ill say to myself, You have stored up plenty of goods, enough for several years. Take it easy! Eat, drink, and enjoy yourself.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni; o saria karibu be dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam zaa.
en: The Lord is our God; his commands are for all the world.

dag: Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ yi deei Yawɛ daalikauli ni o nyɛ yi Naawuni ka yi ni dol o soli ka gbib o fukumsi zaligunim mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ka deeg o noli.
en: Today you have affirmed that the LORD will be your God and that you will walk in his ways and follow his regulations, his commandments, and his case laws, and that you will obey his voice.

dag: Wuntizɔra yi di nasara, tiŋ zaa malila suhupiɛlli, ka ninvuɣ biɛɣu yi kpi, niriba warila waa.
en: When good people are successful, the whole city is happy, and they all shout with joy when evil people are destroyed.

dag: Dauda ni daa chaŋ Zikilag, ka Manaasa zuliya ni ninvuɣ shɛb zo n-chaŋ o sani n-daa nyɛ: Adina mini Jɔzabad ni Jɛdiayɛl ni Maikil ni Jɔzabad ni Ɛlihu ni Zilɛtai bɛn daa su tɔbbihi tuhilituhili fukumsi Manaasa zuliya niriba ni la.
en: When he went to Ziklag some joined him from Manasseh: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai, leaders of units of a thousand in Manasseh.

dag: Dindali maa ka Sadusiinim bɛn daa nyɛ bɛn yɛri ni kum ni neebu kani la daa ka Yisa sanna.
en: That same day Sadducees, who deny that there is a resurrection, came to Jesus.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti niŋ yɛda ka deei baptaizibu ni tiligi, amaa ŋun ti bi niŋ yɛda ni mali taali.
en: Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved; whoever does not believe will be condemned.

dag: Di yi pa lala, nyini n dan naa yi ti di saɣim saɣ a tariga, bɛ ni wuhi ni m mini m bia Sulemaana nyɛla bɛ nyaanyiriba.
en: If you don't, they will say that Solomon and I have rebelled. They will treat us like criminals and kill us as soon as you die.

dag: M paɣiri Naawuni so n ni jɛmdi n suhu ni tɛha din ka galimi puuni kaman n yaannim ni daa jɛm o shɛm la. N kul teer a yɛla n wunsuhigu ni yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni, ka paɣiri Naawuni di zuɣu.
en: I give thanks to God, whom I serve with a clear conscience, as my ancestors did. I thank him as I remember you always in my prayers night and day.

dag: Nimdi din shihi binshɛli din bi be kasi bi simdi ni bɛ ŋub li. Di simdi ni bɛ zaŋ li nyo buɣim. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa be kasi ni tooi ŋubi Yawɛ suhudoo sara maligu nimdi.
en: If the meat comes into contact with anything ritually unclean, it must not be eaten, but must be burned. Any of you that are ritually clean may eat the meat.

dag: Saɣimmi ninvuɣ biɛri mini tuumbiɛtumdiba yiko; darigim bɛ tibili bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu hal ka bɛ tuumbiɛri maa ti ku lan beni yaha.
en: Break the power of wicked and evil people; punish them for the wrong they have done until they do it no more.

dag: Bɛ yi kul saɣisiri nira, ka o kul niŋdi tipawumli, o ni ti kabisi yim ka ku lan tooi tib kpaŋ.
en: If you keep being stubborn after many warnings, you will suddenly discover you have gone too far.

dag: O chɛ ka suhudoo be yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka zaŋ alikama viɛlli dihiri ya.
en: He keeps your borders safe and satisfies you with the finest wheat.

dag: Kaɣili ni tooi zooi luɣ shɛli ka pa ni baa ni? Kaɣili ni tooi zooi viɛnyɛliŋga ka pa ni kom ni be luɣ shɛli?.
en: Papyrus reeds grow healthy only in a swamp.

dag: Ka bia maa ma maa daa yɛli Ilaisha, Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ mini nyin ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, n ku chaŋ ka chɛ a. Ka Ilaisha daa yiɣisi dol o.
en: But the boys mother said, I swear by your life and by the LORDs life, I wont leave you! So Elisha got up and followed her.

dag: ka pɔhim yi ti ʒe li, di kpahirimi lu, ka so ku lan tooi baŋ di ni di be shɛli.
en: then the wind blows on it, and it is gone— no one sees it again.

dag: Ka alizin biɛri maa daa yi doo maa ni n-chaŋ ti kpe kuruchunim maa ni, ka bɛ daa dii zo wuriwuri nti sirigi kuligbiriŋ ni ha n-faai lu teeku ni, ka kom di ba.
en: Then the demons left the man and went into the pigs. The whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and drowned.

dag: Abimilɛk daa bela Aruma, ka Zɛbul daa kari Gaal min o dɔɣiriba maa ti bahi ka bɛ ku tooi lan be Shɛkɛm.
en: Afterward, Abimelech stayed in Arumah, and Zebul drove away Gaal and his relatives so they couldnt stay in Shechem.

dag: Chɛ ka so m-paɣ a ka pa ni nyin yaag a noli paɣ amaŋa; chɛ ka sana m-paɣ a ka pa ni nyin paɣ amaŋa.
en: Don't brag about yourself— let others praise you.

dag: o biɛhigu shee mini di suɣili ni din yɛn pil li ni di bansi ni di dapaɣa ni di dapuhi ni di daantalisi ni di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu.
en: the sacred tent with its covering and hooks, its framework and crossbars, and its post and stands;.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ pagɔr liɣiri bee bɛ tuma liɣiri ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu na ti yo yi ni po pɔri shɛli samli, dama bina ayi ŋɔ zaa nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: The Lord your God is disgusted with men and women who are prostitutes of any kind, and he will not accept a gift from them, even if it had been promised to him.

dag: N ni chɛ ka dabiɛm gbaai yi mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛnkam yɛn tuhi, ka bɛ birim, ka chɛ ka yi dimnim ŋmaligi guui ka chɛn ya.
en: When you fight against your enemies, I will send my great power before you. I will help you defeat all your enemies. The people who are against you will become confused in battle and run away.

dag: A yi kpahi ansarisimaana zuɣu ni, o ni leei ŋun je a. A yi kpahi ŋun mali yɛm zuɣu ni, o ni yur a.
en: Never correct conceited people; they will hate you for it. But if you correct the wise, they will respect you.

dag: Yinim paɣ shɛb bɛn nya vuhim, ka tɛhi ni shɛli bi mali ya la, yiɣisimiya wum n ni yɛn yɛli shɛm.
en: Listen to what I say, you women who are carefree and careless!.

dag: Di saha ka Pita daa bɔhi Yisa, Ti Duuma, tinim ka a lee ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ bee sokam zaa.
en: Peter said, Lord, are you telling this parable for us or for everyone.

dag: Zɛdɛkia yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisiniyini saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun piniyini.
en: Zedekiah was years old when he became king of Judah. He was king in Jerusalem for eleven years.

dag: Amaa biŋkɔbigu ni tuui dɔɣi bi so nyɛla Yawɛ ni su so, di bi simdi ka so ti lan zaŋ o ti Yawɛ. Di yi nyɛla nahu bee piɛɣu, o nyɛla Yawɛ dini.
en: You can give cattle and sheep as special gifts to the Lord . But if the animal is the firstborn, it already belongs to the Lord . So you cannot give these animals as special gifts.

dag: Ka Iso yɛl o, Ka chɛ ka n niriba ŋɔ shɛb kpalim pah a zuɣu. Amaa ka Yaakubu yɛl o, N dana, lala bi kpa, n kul bɔri ni a chɛ ka a suhu m-maai ni mani.
en: Esau said, Let me leave some of my people with you. But Jacob said, Why should you do this since my master has already been so kind to me.

dag: Yinim bɛn zaa nyɛ tuumbiɛrinim ŋɔ, Zomiya n sani! dama Yawɛ wum n kumsi maa;.
en: You, Lord , heard my crying, and those hateful people had better leave me alone.

dag: Dauda ni daa yi Hiburɔn na nyaaŋa o daa kpuɣi paɣiba Jɛrusalɛm pahi, ka bo mamanim pahi, ka bɛ daa dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pah o.
en: After he left Hebron, David married more secondary wives in Jerusalem and fathered more sons and daughters.

dag: Amaa ka Barizillai daa yɛli, Yuma ala ka n lee lan yɛn niŋ dunia yili ŋɔ, ka lan doli nyin naa kuni Jɛrusalɛm?.
en: But Barzillai answered, I don't have long to live; why should I go with Your Majesty to Jerusalem?.

dag: Ka bia maa ba daa kuhi ni nintam yɛli, N Duuma, n niŋ yɛda; ka n yɛda niŋbu ni pooi shɛli ni, nyin sɔŋm ma di puuni.
en: At that the boys father cried out, I have faith; help my lack of faith.

dag: Yawɛ zaligu ka Izraɛlnim maa daa doli yiɣisira, ka lan doli Yawɛ zaligu n-tiri bɛ suɣa doona. Sagbani maa daa yi kul kpalim ʒe Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili maa zuɣusaa, bɛ mi kpalindimi doya.
en: This was the way the Lord showed the Israelites when to move and when to stop and set up camp. While the cloud stayed over the Holy Tent, the people continued to camp in that same place.

dag: O daa yɛliya, Sariakarita so n-daa be tinshee; o daa bi zɔri Naawuni, ka mi bi lan lihiri nyari daadam kam.
en: Once there was a judge in a town. He did not care about God. He also did not care what people thought about him.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa kpe ba ka bɛ ni sɔhira, dama bɛ daa tɛhiya ni alizini ka bɛ nya maa.
en: They were frightened and terrified because they thought they were seeing a ghost.

dag: ka daa zaŋ maha tari Izraɛl salo bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba maa zaa, ka sokam daa deei mahi yiniyini mini nim kpillikpilli ni bɛ ni zaŋ wain tihi wala m-pahi mali mahi shɛŋa zaɣ yiniyini pahi. Di nyaaŋa ka sokam daa wurim kuli bɛ yinsi.
en: He gave all the men and women in the crowd a small loaf of bread, some meat, and a handful of raisins, then everyone went home.

dag: Ziɔn Zoli ni kpalim dabari, ka kunduna be di zuɣu gɔra.
en: because Mount Zion lies lonely and deserted, and wild jackals prowl through its ruins.

dag: Kaman nɔhi ni pali nɔsuɣu shɛm la, lala ka bɛ di nɛma ti pali bɛ yinsi. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ leei wɔɣira ni bundaamba.
en: Like a cage full of birds, so their houses are full of loot. No wonder they are rich and powerful.

dag: Bɛ ni daa baptaizi ya saha shɛl la, yi mini Masia ka bɛ daa laɣim sɔɣi maa, ka yi mini Masia laɣim n-neei kum ni yi ni daa niŋ Naawuni ŋun daa neei Masia kum ni yiko tuma yɛda la zuɣu.
en: When you were baptized, you were buried with Christ, and you were raised up with him because of your faith in Gods power. Gods power was shown when he raised Christ from death.

dag: Ka bɛ lan garigi yɛli naa yaha, Naa, a yi ni yɛli ti a zahindi maa ni nyɛ shɛm, ti mi ni wuh a di gbinni.
en: They answered him again: The king must tell his servants the dream. We will then explain the meaning.

dag: Ka yi mini yi bidibisi ni yi bipuɣinsi ni yi daba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba ni Lɛvinim bɛn be yi tinsi ni ti mali suhupiɛlli, dama Lɛvinim maa ka tarili bee fali yi sani.
en: Then you will rejoice in the LORD your Gods presence: each of you, your sons and daughters, your male and female servants, and the Levites who dwell in your cities because they have no designated inheritance.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Sukɔt maa n-chaŋ ti dɔni Itam din miri tiŋgban nɛl la.
en: Their next camp was at Etham on the edge of the desert.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu la zuɣu n ni bɔr a zaɣ viɛlli.
en: And because of the house of the Lord our God, I will work for your good.

dag: Ka o ni daa niŋ shɛm maa chɛ ka Anabi Aizaia ni daa yɛl o yɛla shɛm la niŋ pali, Anabi Aizaia ni daa yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ, Omaŋmaŋ n-daa deei ti niŋgbun biisim mini ti dɔriti zaa ʒi.
en: He did this to make come true what the prophet Isaiah had said, He himself took our sickness and carried away our diseases.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba maa ni daa ti be soli n-chana, ka do so ti yɛl o, N ni dol a chaŋ a ni chani luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: As Jesus and his disciples traveled along the road, someone said to him, I will follow you wherever you go.

dag: Ka Pool mini Baanabas daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ni suhukpeeni yɛli, Di di simdi ni Naawuni yɛligu ŋɔ daŋ tɔɣisila yi sani, amaa yi ni daa li bahi ka tɛhi ni yi bi simdi nyɛvili din ka bahigu zuɣu, nyamiya, ti ni chɛn ya ka chaŋ bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani.
en: But Paul and Barnabas spoke out even more boldly: It was necessary that the word of God should be spoken first to you. But since you reject it and do not consider yourselves worthy of eternal life, we will leave you and go to the Gentiles.

dag: Ka sapashini maa ni daa yɛl o ni Yisa shiri kpiya maa, ka Gomna Pailɛt daa saɣi ni Yisifu zaŋm Yisa ti sɔɣi.
en: After hearing the officer's report, Pilate told Joseph he could have the body.

dag: Ka bɛ ni zaŋ kawana bee chi zim mali binshɛli bɔrɔbɔro duu puuni mini bɛ ni chim shɛli zaa tahilaa bee mahilaa puuni, maligumaana ŋun mali di sara maa n-su li.
en: Every grain offering that has been baked in an oven or prepared in a pan or on a griddle belongs to the priest who has offered it to God.

dag: Ka di chaŋ wula ka nandahima mali ma pam? Di chaŋ wula ka n suhu kul zɔhira? N ni mali tahima Naawuni sani, dama n ni ti lan paɣ o yaha. Ŋuna n-nyɛ n sɔŋsim ni n Naawuni.
en: Why, I ask myself, are you so depressed? Why are you so upset inside? Hope in God! Because I will again give him thanks, my saving presence and my God.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa kpe bɛn guli siliga maa pam, ka bɛ ni sɔhira, ka bɛ be kaman kpiimba la.
en: The guards were so afraid that they trembled and became like dead men.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka tɔbu daa ti lan lu bɛ mini Filistianim sunsuuni, ka Dauda daa chaŋ ti liri ba n-tuhi nyaŋ ba, ka bɛ ŋmaligi guui.
en: War broke out again. When David went out to fight the Philistines, he struck them with such force that they ran from him.

dag: Ka salo pam bɛn daa yi Galili mini Tinsi Pia tiŋgbana ni na mini bɛn yi Jɛrusalɛm ni Judia zaŋ tabili Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili dulinim zaa daa kabiri dol o.
en: Large crowds followed Jesus from Galilee and the region around the ten cities known as Decapolis. They also came from Jerusalem, Judea, and from across the Jordan River.

dag: Ka daantalis ayi mini kɔniŋdi bini ni tɔroko shɛŋa Sulemaana ni daa mali niŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la, di zaa daanya daa galisiya pam hal ka bɛ ku tooi buɣisi baŋ di tibisim ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: So Nebuzaradan took the large bronze tank and the bronze columns. He also took the carts that Solomon made for the Lord s Temple. The bronze from these things was too heavy to be weighed.

dag: M mini ŋun doli gbaai mani ŋun nyɛ o zo ŋɔ, ka yiɣisi o ni daa lo ma alikauli shɛli.
en: My friend turned against me and broke his promise.

dag: Sulemaana ni daa buɣisi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa mɛbu shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Di wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita pisinaayopɔin, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita awɛi kaman kurimbuni ha binyɛra buɣisibu ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: The inside of the temple was meters long and meters wide, according to the older standards.

dag: Ka Abiata maa daa yɛli Dauda ni Sool ku Yawɛ maligumaaniba la.
en: He told him how Saul had slaughtered the priests of the Lord .

dag: Ka ti Duuma ŋun ʒi alizanda ni la lara, ka maani ba ansarisi.
en: From his throne in heaven the Lord laughs and mocks their feeble plans.

dag: Di saha maa, do so daa beni n-nyɛ ŋun yi Zɔra na, ka o yuli booni Manɔa. O daa nyɛla Dan zuliya ni nira, ka o paɣ nyɛ paɣiŋoo, ka ka bihi.
en: Now there was a certain man from Zorah, from the Danite clan, whose name was Manoah. His wife was unable to become pregnant and had not given birth to any children.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ daa jɛmdi Yawɛ, amaa ka lan jɛmdi bɛmaŋmaŋ buɣa kaman bɛ ni daa zaŋ ba yi tin shɛŋa na maa niriba ni daa niŋdi shɛm.
en: So they worshiped the Lord , but they also worshiped their own gods according to the customs of the countries from which they had come.

dag: Neemiya n-kpaŋsi din kpalim be yi ni n-yɛn kpi maa, dama n nya ka yi tuma bi be dɛde n Duuma Naawuni sani.
en: Wake up! You have only a little strength left, and it is almost gone. So try to become stronger. I have found that you are not completely obeying God.

dag: O daa be ka binshɛɣukam na kani, ka binshɛɣukam tuɣ taba la o ni.
en: The Son was there before anything was made. And all things continue because of him.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, A shiri ni saɣi kpi n zuɣu? Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛr a, a ni ti chihi paai siɣimsiɣim buta ni a bi mi ma ka nolɔɣu na bi kum.
en: Jesus replied, Will you give up your life for me? I assure you that you will deny me three times before the rooster crows.

dag: Wuntitali mini yɛlimaŋli soli n-nyɛ a nam ʒiishee tanzaa, ka yurilim maŋli mini ʒiɛyimtali be a tooni.
en: Your kingdom is ruled by justice and fairness with love and faithfulness leading the way.

dag: Musa daa yi ti kpe suɣili maa puuni, sagban daantaliga sirigirimina ti zani suɣili maa dunol ni, ka Yawɛ tɔɣisiri Musa yɛtɔɣa.
en: Whenever Moses went into the tent, the tall cloud would come down and stay at the entrance to the tent. And the Lord would speak with Moses.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Asha zuliya ni dɔbba, ka daa nyɛ bɛ daŋ ni dɔɣirikpamba ni tɔbutuhiri biinsi, ka lan nyɛ ninvuɣ gahinda. Bɛ dɔbba bɛn daa naan tooi chaŋ tɔbu ni kalinli daa nyɛla dɔbba tuhi pisinaayɔbu.
en: These were the descendants of Asher, and they were all respected family leaders and brave soldiers. The tribe of Asher had a total of , soldiers.

dag: Ti yi kul tumd alahichi milinsi puuni, ti ni baŋ yɛlimaŋli ni nyɛ shɛl la nyaaŋa, sara maligu shɛli lan kani din ni kpihim ti daalahichi.
en: No sacrifices can be made for people who decide to sin after they find out about the truth.

dag: Yɛlim ba ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Niŋmiya wain pali wain duɣu kam. Bɛ ni bɔh a, A tɛhiya ni ti bi mi ni di simdi ni ti niŋ wain pali wain duɣu kam.
en: Jeremiah, tell the people of Judah, The Lord God of Israel orders you to fill your wine jars with wine. They will answer, Of course we fill our wine jars with wine! Why are you telling us something we already know.

dag: Yɛndan ni tɔɣisir yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa balimbalim wumbu so naa ŋun tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa n-tahiri jɛra sani.
en: Words of wisdom spoken softly make much more sense than the shouts of a ruler to a crowd of fools.

dag: Ka yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa din be Naawuni Kundi ni yila Naawuni nol ni na, ka nyɛ din mali buchi pam zaŋ chaŋ wuhibu mini saɣisibu ni zuɣu ni kpahibu ni wuntia soli wuhibu polo.
en: Everything in the Scriptures is God's Word. All of it is useful for teaching and helping people and for correcting them and showing them how to live.

dag: Mushi daa dɔɣi la bidibisi ata, Mahili mini Ɛda ni Jɛrimɔt.
en: Merari's second son, Mushi, had three sons: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth.

dag: Chɛ ka o paɣa leei pakoli, ka o bihi leei kpibisi.
en: Let his children become orphans; let his wife turn into a widow.

dag: Musa yuma daa nyɛla yuun pihinii, ka Aduna mi yuma nyɛ yuun pihiniinaata saha shɛli bɛ ni daa chaŋ ti tɔɣisi Firawuna yɛtɔɣa maa.
en: Moses was years old at the time, and Aaron was .

dag: dama ŋunkam bi galindi ti bela ti polo.
en: For whoever is not against us is for us.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri kul nyurila bara bɛ suhuri ni kɔr biɛri zuɣu; ka bɛn nyɛ diribarilimnim mi kul zaɣisiri Yawɛ ka tur o.
en: The wicked brag about their bodys cravings; the greedy reject the LORD, cursing.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba bɔh o, A ni nya ka salo daar a ŋ-ŋɔ, ka a ti bɔhi ni ŋuni n-lee shih a.
en: The followers said to Jesus, There are so many people pushing against you. But you ask, Who touched me.

dag: Bɛ nol ni yɛtɔɣa zuɣu, o ni chɛ ka bɛ bahi ba yoli zaa, ka bɛnkam zaa nya ba, dabiɛm gbahiri ba mi, ka bɛ ni sɔhira.
en: He will use their own words against them, and they will be destroyed. Then everyone who sees them will shake their heads in amazement.

dag: Ka Ɛzra daa yɛli, A kɔŋko n-nyɛ Yawɛ; nyini n-nam zuɣusaa mini zuɣusaa ha ni di tɔbbihi. Nyini n-nam tiŋgbani mini binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni; ka nam teeku ni binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni. Nyini n-ti di zaa nyɛvili, ka zuɣusaa tɔbbihi zaa jɛmd a.
en: You alone are the LORD. You alone made heaven, even the heaven of heavens, with all their forces. You made the earth and all that is on it, and the seas and all that is in them. You preserve them all, and the heavenly forces worship you.

dag: Ka di simdi ka o ti nyo di biŋkpam zaa buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu kaman suhudoo sara maligu la din ni chɛ ka maligumaana zaŋ li yo alahichi maa samli ka o daalahichi maa kpihim.
en: The priest will burn all the goats fat on the altar, just as he does for the fellowship offerings. In this way the priest will make the ruler pure, and God will forgive him.

dag: Amaa nyin Naawuni shiri ni tooi be dunia ŋɔ ni? Nyama, zuɣusaa mini di galisim ŋɔ zaa pɔri ni a biɛhigu shee, di ni ti be ka n ni me du shɛli ŋɔ?.
en: But, God, will you really live here with us on the earth? The whole sky and the highest heaven cannot contain you. Certainly this Temple that I built cannot contain you either.

dag: Izraɛl ninvuɣ so yi kɔrigi nahu bee piɛɣu bee bua yi sansani ŋɔ ni bee kpaŋa.
en: Any Israelites who kill a cow or a sheep or a goat as an offering to the Lord anywhere except at the entrance of the Tent of the Lord 's presence have broken the Law. They have shed blood and shall no longer be considered God's people.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti dɔni ti vi zuɣu, ka zaŋ ti filiŋ pili timaŋa. Dama ti mini ti yaannim tum alahichi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ sani ti bilim ni hal ni zuŋɔ, ka bi saɣi doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni maa noli.
en: We should lie down in shame and let our disgrace cover us. We and our ancestors have always sinned against the Lord our God; we have never obeyed his commands.

dag: Ka dunia nanim mini tiŋgbana zuɣulaannima ni sapashinnima ni bundaannima ni yikolaannima ni sokam zaa bɛn nyɛ daba bee bilichinnima zo nti sɔɣi zoya voya ni mini tampima lɔna ni.
en: Then the kings of the earth, the rulers and the military chiefs, the rich and the powerful, and all other people, slave and free, hid themselves in caves and under rocks on the mountains.

dag: N Duuma, n yiŋ bia bɔɣu min o gbali zaa n-kpi, ka di muɣis o pam ka o do yiŋa.
en: pleading with him, Lord, my servant is flat on his back at home, paralyzed, and his suffering is awful.

dag: Mbusim be tin shɛli nim bɛn kuri niriba ŋɔ zuɣu, yɔhiŋgu mini faɣiri dibu kul palila di ni, ka nɛma ʒiɛbu ku naai.
en: Doom to the crime capital! Nineveh, city of murder and treachery.

dag: Ka Taainim shɛb bɛn daa be tiŋ maa ni daa ʒi zahim mini nɛma balibu kam na ti kɔhi Judanim zuɣu ka kɔhi li Jɛrusalɛm puuni Vuhim Dabisili dali maa.
en: Some people from the city of Tyre were living in Jerusalem, and they brought fish and all kinds of goods into the city to sell to our people on the Sabbath.

dag: Daabi so ŋun mali ʒiri kuruwa nyɛla ŋun bɔri niriba ŋaribu.
en: He is a merchant; the means to cheat are in his hands; he loves to take advantage of others.

dag: Di saha ka o ba Yisahaku daa yɛl o, M bia, mirim na ti mɔɣisi n kpariŋ.
en: Then his father said to him, Come closer and kiss me, son.

dag: O kalinsi nyaaŋa ka o bia Amazia daa di nam zan o zaani. Bɛ sabi o bidibisi yɛla mini bɛ ni daa tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa pam jɛnd o la ni o ni daa mali Naawuni jɛmbu duu me shɛm la, niŋ Nanim yɛlikura litaafi ni.
en: The Commentary on the Book of Kings contains the stories of the sons of Joash, the prophecies spoken against him, and the record of how he rebuilt the Temple. His son Amaziah succeeded him as king.

dag: Kamina ti pahi ti zuɣu, ti zaa ni laɣim mal liɣiri kolibil yini.
en: If you join our gang, you'll get your share.

dag: Yi zaŋla yi wuna ŋmahima n-zali baɣili yi duri puuni dunoya. Yi zaɣisi ma, ka mali yi gariti ka di yɛlim pam, ka ti yi mamanim liɣiri, ka pirigiri yi situra ka mali ba dooni nyari bɛ zaɣim.
en: Behind the door and the doorpost you placed your symbols. You abandoned me and lay down, making room in your bed and making deals for yourself with them. You loved their bed; you saw their nakedness.

dag: ka Sabinim kana ti lu bɛ zuɣu n-zaŋ takɔbi ku tumtumdiba maa ka taɣi ba chaŋ, n kɔŋko n-nyɛ ŋun zo n-tiligi kana ni n ti yɛl a.
en: a gang of Sabeans attacked and stole the oxen and donkeys! Your other servants were killed, and I am the only one who escaped to tell you.

dag: Din daa lu sol zuɣu la ŋmanila bɛn wum Naawuni yɛligu maa, ka Sintani kana nti yihi li bɛ suhuri ni ka bɛ ku niŋ li yɛda n-tiligi.
en: and the seeds that fell along the road are the people who hear the message. But the devil comes and snatches the message out of their hearts, so they will not believe and be saved.

dag: Gbib ma kaman a ni lo alikauli shɛm la, ka m be. Di chɛ ka n di vi n tahima niŋbu ni.
en: Give me strength, as you promised, and I shall live; don't let me be disappointed in my hope!.

dag: Di niŋ ma yoli n ni daa zaŋ Sool leei naa maa zuɣu, dama o chɛ ma dolibu ka bi lan doli n zaligunima. Ka Samuɛl suhu daa yiɣisi, ka o kuhi niŋ Yawɛ dindali maa yuŋ zaa.
en: I regret making Saul king because he has turned away from following me and hasnt done what I said. Samuel was upset at this, and he prayed to the LORD all night long.

dag: Zuɣulaannim bɛn daa su Sulemaana tuma fukumsi m-bɔŋɔ, bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisinu ni pihinu bɛn lihiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumd o tuma.
en: There were supervisors over Solomons projects. They supervised the men who did the work.

dag: Ka maligumaana Finɛhas mini Izraɛlnim daŋ kam ni dɔɣirikpamba bɛn daa pah o zuɣu maa ni daa wum Rubin mini Gaad ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili maa ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka di niŋ ba nyaɣisim pam.
en: Phinehas the priest and the ten leading men of the community who were with him, the heads of families of the western tribes, heard what the people of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh had to say, and they were satisfied.

dag: Amaa ka Hanna yɛl o, N dana, Aai, n nyɛla paɣ so ŋun be muɣisigu ni pam. M bi nyu wain bee binnyur kpiɔŋ, amaa n zaŋdila n suhu ni yɛlimuɣisira zaa wuhiri Yawɛ.
en: No sir! Hannah replied. Im just a very sad woman. I havent had any wine or beer but have been pouring out my heart to the LORD.

dag: dama tibili zahindi yɛtɔɣa kaman zilinli ni zahindi bindira shɛm la.
en: Your tongue tastes the food it touches, and your ear tests the words it hears.

dag: nti zaŋ o nubil tim ʒim maa ni n-zaŋ li mihi Yawɛ tooni buyopɔin tantolinli din yiliya la tooni.
en: dip a finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred chest behind the curtain.

dag: Ka dim so ŋun biri piriŋkpana biɛlim maa nyɛla Sintani; ka chɛbu saha la nyɛ dunia ŋɔ yiɣisibu saha, ka malaikanim mi nyɛ bɛn chɛri li maa.
en: The enemy who planted them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the present age. The harvesters are the angels.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa wum ni Shɛkɛm saɣim o bipuɣiŋga Daina, amaa ka o daa di suɣilo shini hal ka o bidibisi bɛn daa mali niɣi be mɔɣu ni la ti kuna.
en: Now Jacob heard that Shechem defiled his daughter Dinah; but his sons were with the animals in the countryside, so he decided to keep quiet until they got back.

dag: ka ashili yuli sab pa o gbɛɣu zuɣu. Di ni daa sab shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Babilɔn titali, pagɔra mini dunia chihi biɛri ma.
en: She had a title written on her forehead. This title has a hidden meaning. This is what was written: the great babylon mother of prostitutes and the evil things of the earth.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Di tɛhiya ni n kamina ni nti kpihim Naawuni fukumsi zaligunima bee anabinim yɛligu; m bi kamina ni nti kpihim di shɛli, amaa n kamina ni n ti chɛ ka di zaa niŋ pali.
