en: Dont even begin to think that I have come to do away with the Law and the Prophets. I havent come to do away with them but to fulfill them.

dag: Zaŋmi jaaŋgbee ŋɔ niŋ a nuu ni mali chaŋ, dina ka a ti yɛn mali tumdi alahiziba tumtumsa maa.
en: So go and carry your walking stick with you. Use it and the other miracles to show the people that I am with you.

dag: O daa zaŋ salima alali mali teebuli maa zuɣu duɣuri mini di parantɛnima ni di lahi din ni tuɣindi tulaale zim ni pipi shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn mali boori sara maligu wain.
en: Then he made everything that was used on the table. He made the plates, the spoons, the bowls, and the pitchers from pure gold. The bowls and pitchers are used for pouring the drink offerings.

dag: Ka o daa kpuɣi neen shɛŋa din be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini neen shɛŋa din be nayili zaa chaŋ; ka daa lan kpuɣi salima nyɔtaɣirisi shɛŋa Sulemaana ni daa chɛ ka bɛ mali la.
en: He took everything of value from the temple and the palace, including Solomon's gold shields.

dag: Yinim Shafirinima, zaŋmiya yi zaɣim mini yi vi gari chaŋ. Zaanannima, di yin ya na. Bɛtɛzɛlnim kuhirimi, ka ku lan sɔŋ ya.
en: Pass by , inhabitants of Shaphir! In nakedness and shame she will not go out, inhabitants of Zaanan. The cry of Beth-ezel will take away from you any place to stand.

dag: Di saha ka Juda daa chaŋ Yisifu sani ti yɛl o, N dana, n suhir a, chɛ ka mani a dabili ŋɔ tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛli niŋ a tibili ni, a mi di chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi bahi mani a dabili ŋɔ zuɣu, dama a ŋmanila Firawuna maŋmaŋa.
en: Judah went over to Joseph and said: Sir, you have as much power as the king himself, and I am only your slave. Please don't get angry if I speak.

dag: ka yi ŋme n-nyaŋ bɛ ni me birininim gili bɛ tin shɛŋa la nim mini tiŋ gahinda la, ka ŋma bɛ ti suŋ kam zaa luhi; ka ŋari bɛ kɔbil nina zaa, ka kahi kuɣa sɔŋ luɣ shɛŋa din tam vuhiri shee zaa n-saɣim li.
en: You will conquer all their beautiful fortified cities; you will cut down all their fruit trees, stop all their springs, and ruin all their fertile fields by covering them with stones.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli Musa.
en: Finally, the Lord said to Moses:.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn wumdi n yɛligu ku be barina ni, bɛ ni be ni alaafee ka ku zɔri dabiɛm zaŋ chaŋ zaɣ biɛɣu polo.
en: But whoever listens to me will have security. He will be safe, with no reason to be afraid.

dag: Ka yɛl o nyaandola maa mi, N-nyɛ a ma! Di saha maa zaŋ chana, ka nyaandola maa daa zaŋ Yisa ma maa mali kul o yiŋa.
en: Then he said to the disciple, She is now your mother. From then on, that disciple took her into his own home.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka alɔbo lu niriba maa zuɣu bɛ ni daa chɛ ka Aduna mali naɣibil so la zuɣu.
en: So the Lord punished the people of Israel with a terrible disease for talking Aaron into making the gold idol.

dag: Ka yi nɔdeebo yi ti niŋ pali, ti mali shili ni ti darigi bɛn tumdi nɔzaɣisibo tuma la tibili.
en: And after you have proved your complete loyalty, we will be ready to punish any act of disloyalty.

dag: ka ŋun maligumaana maa ti zaŋ o nubil tim ʒim maa ni n-zaŋ li mihi Yawɛ tooni buyopɔin tantolinli din yili luɣ kasi shee la tooni.
en: He shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle it in front of the sacred curtain seven times.

dag: Daba anii dali ka Musa daa boli Aduna min o bidibisi maa ni Izraɛl kpamba na.
en: On the eighth day, Moses called for Aaron, Aarons sons, and Israels elders.

dag: Ka n ni daa nya ka yi bi kanna maa, ka n daa zaŋ n nyɛvili pa talima chaŋ bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni ti tuhi ba; ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ ba niŋ n nuu ni. Ka di chaŋ wula ka yi ti kana zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni yi ti tuhi ma.
en: When I saw that you were not going to, I risked my life and crossed the border to fight them, and the Lord gave me victory over them. So why are you coming up to fight me now.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm, zuliya kam ni ti nya a nasara dibu, ka nanim zaa ti nya a jilima. Ka bɛ ti zaŋ yu palli shɛli Yawɛ ni zaŋ ti a la bol a.
en: Nations will see your righteousness, all kings your glory. You will be called by a new name, which the LORDs own mouth will determine.

dag: Jɛiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Gibiɔn ba la daa bela Gibiɔn, ka o paɣa yuli daa booni Maaka.
en: Jeiel settled the town of Gibeon. He and his wife Maacah lived there.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa, Cham Firawuna sani ti yɛl o, Yawɛ yɛliya, Chɛ ka n niriba maa chaŋ ti jɛm ma.
en: Then the LORD said to Moses, Go to Pharaoh and tell him: This is what the LORD says: Let my people go so that they can worship me.

dag: Yawɛ, wummi n suhigu, ka gbilis a tibili wum n kuhigu. Di nya n kumsi nintam ka chɛ ma sɔŋbu. N leela saan garito a sani, ka nyɛ sochanda kaman n yaannim la.
en: Hear my prayer, LORD! Listen closely to my cry for help! Please dont ignore my tears! Im just a foreigner— an immigrant staying with you, just like all my ancestors were.

dag: Ka o ti zaŋ kpam chim li mahilaa ni zaɣ bihi, ka a gar li viɛnyɛliŋga n-zaŋ li mali sara shɛli din nyom viɛl Yawɛ sani.
en: The fine flour must be mixed with oil and baked on a pan. After it is cooked, you must bring it in, break it into pieces, and offer it as a sweet-smelling gift to Lord .

dag: Yi ni yɛn niŋ shɛm ku li m-bɔŋɔ: Ŋunkam samli dol o ʒiʒiinikpee, ŋun kum li, ka di lan yɛli ni o ʒiʒiinikpee maa yom li, dama bɛ moli Yawɛ ni zali ni bɛ kum sama saha shɛli molo.
en: This is how it is to be done. Each of you who has lent money to any Israelite is to cancel the debt; you must not try to collect the money; the Lord himself has declared the debt canceled.

dag: Bɛ daa jɛm bɛ wuna, ka di daa leei zana gbahi ba.
en: God's people worshiped idols, and this caused their destruction.

dag: Nimaani ka o kabisi piɛma din nyɛlisiri mini nyɔtaɣirisi ni takɔbiri ni tɔbutuhiri bidibbina.
en: There he shattered the arrows, shields, swords, and other weapons of war. Selah.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ daa leeg alahichi Jɛrɔbɔam daŋ ni; ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka di simdi ni bɛ yaag o daŋ maa n-kpihim di birili dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: This sinful thing led to the downfall of his kingdom.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, a nyaŋ Ɛdomnima, ka karimbaani kpe a suhu ni n-chɛ ka a duh amaŋa. Chɛ ka a nini tiɣ a jilima, ka ʒi a yiŋa. Bee bɔzuɣu ka a bɔri vuri ni a chɛ ka bɛ ku a tabili Judanima.
en: Now Amaziah, you have defeated the Edomites, and you are filled with pride. Be satisfied with your fame and stay at home. Why stir up trouble that will only bring disaster on you and your people.

dag: daba ayopɔin m-mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ. Dabisi shɛli din pahir anii dali, di simdi ka yi laɣim laɣiŋgu kasi, ka mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ, di nyɛla laɣiŋgu tibisili; di ti tumiya tuma dindali maa.
en: Each day for seven days you shall present a food offering. On the eighth day come together again for worship and present a food offering. It is a day for worship, and you shall do no work. .

dag: Ka kum yi ti lu tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni bee alɔbo yi ti lu bee bindira yi ti kuura bee maligu bee toli yi ti yina bee zunzuya, ka bee bɛ dimnim yi ti kana nti teei gili ba bɛ tinsi ŋɔ ni zaɣ yin ni, ka alɔbo kam bee dɔr shɛlikam yi ti lu.
en: Sometimes the crops may dry up or rot or be eaten by locusts or grasshoppers, and your people will be starving. Sometimes enemies may surround their towns, or your people will become sick with deadly diseases.

dag: Ti ku zaŋ li sɔɣi ti bihi, ti ni zaŋ Yawɛ jilima tuma min o tuun kara ni o daalahiziba tuun shɛŋa o ni tum la yɛla yɛli ʒiɛmana din kanna niriba.
en: We wont hide them from their descendants; well tell the next generation all about the praise due the LORD and his strength— the wondrous works God has done.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, kum n-nyɛ a sanyoo, ka a mi ku tooi yi di ni. Ninvuɣ kubo taali ʒi a zuɣu, ka ninvuɣ kubo maa ni dol a.
en: So now the LORD God proclaims: As surely as I live, I will prepare you for blood, and blood will pursue you. Because you dont hate bloodshed, bloodshed will pursue you.

dag: N lan bɔri ni paɣiba gba zaŋdi situra din veeni ba ka ku mali galimi ka nyɛ din simdi m-maani bɛmaŋa, ka pa ni zuɣuri pambu mini salima ni waya yɛri yɛbu ni binyara din mali shaara zaŋ niŋ bɛmaŋa;.
en: In the same way, I want women to enhance their appearance with clothing that is modest and sensible, not with elaborate hairstyles, gold, pearls, or expensive clothes.

dag: M mabihi, yi mi n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ, dama n yɛrila yinim bɛm mi zaligu yɛla. Zaligu lo nir la kulla o ni na be o nyɛvil ni la.
en: Certainly you will understand what I am about to say, my friends, because all of you know about law. The law rules over people only as long as they live.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Izraɛlnim Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa tahi Ɛkurɔn. Amaa Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa ni daa paai Ɛkurɔn na, ka Ɛkurɔnnim daa kuhi yɛli, Bɛ zaŋ Izraɛlnim Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka la tahi ti ya ŋɔ na ni di ti ku ti mini ti niriba.
en: so they sent the sacred chest to Ekron. But before they could take it through the town gates, the people of Ekron started screaming, They've brought the sacred chest that belongs to the God of Israel! It will kill us and our families too.

dag: Ka Farisiinim maa bɔhi ba, O birigila yi gba?.
en: Did he fool you, too? the Pharisees asked them.

dag: Tinim bɛn nyɛ Yɛhudianim malila so shɛli din so ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim dini? Aai, ti bi mali so shɛli din so. Di bemi kaman n ni pun yɛli shɛm la, di yi nyɛla Yɛhudianim bee bɛn pa Yɛhudianima, alahichi nyaŋ bɛ zaa.
en: So are we Jews better than other people? No, we have already said that those who are Jews, as well as those who are not Jews, are the same. They are all guilty of sin.

dag: Ti Duuma, bɛ ŋmanila zahindi shɛli nir ni yi zahim ka neei la, o yi neei di bemi kaman shilinshia la.
en: They will disappear, Lord, despised like a bad dream the morning after.

dag: Ka Ɛkan daa yɛli Jɔshua, Yɛlimaŋli, n tum alahichi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ sani; N ni tum alahichi shɛli maa m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Achan answered, It is true! I sinned against the Lord , the God of Israel. This is what I did:.

dag: Ka n yi nyɛ yi Duuma ni yi karimba ka paɣi yi naba, dindina di simdi ni yi gba paɣiri tab naba lala;.
en: And if your Lord and teacher has washed your feet, you should do the same for each other.

dag: Ka bɛ daa me goon ŋmaa zali du bila kam tooni, ka di dubu nyɛ sɛntimita pihinu, ka di barilim nyɛ sɛntimita pihinu di yaɣa zaa, ka dubihi buɣisibu nyɛ mita atata di yaɣa zaa.
en: In front of the guardrooms, which were three meters square, was a railing about centimeters high and centimeters thick.

dag: N ni bo biɛhigu shee ti n niriba Izraɛlnima, ka zaŋ ba ʒili nimaani ka bɛ be bɛ dahalali tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka so ku lan dam ba yaha; ka ninvuɣ galima ku lan nahim ba kaman bɛ ni daa yi niŋdi ba shɛm.
en: I have given my people Israel a land of their own where they can live in peace, and they won't have to tremble with fear any more. Evil nations won't bother them, as they did.

dag: Yi yɛliya, Naawuni jɛmbu ka buchi. Ka o zaligunim dolibu bee ti yi be Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ sani kaman ti kumdila kuli la, di daanfaani nyɛ ti dini?.
en: You have said, It's useless to serve God. What's the use of doing what he says or of trying to show the Lord Almighty that we are sorry for what we have done?.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ wumya ni Sool ni ka Kɛila ŋɔ na nti wurim li n zuɣu.
en: David prayed, Lord , God of Israel, I have heard that Saul plans to come to Keilah and destroy the town because of me.

dag: bee kpalua ni bahi mi shɛŋa ni bee bɛ ni wuɣi tan piɛl shɛli ni bee bɛ ni wuɣi ago shɛli ni bee biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ ni bee bɛ ni zaŋ biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ mali binshɛlikam ni.
en: in the weaving of the linen or wool, or on a skin or skin item.

dag: ni Hɛfɛr ŋun daa nyɛ Mɛkɛra nir la ni Ahija ŋun daa nyɛ pɛlɔn nir la.
en: Hepher the Mecherathite; Ahijah the Pelonite.

dag: Zomiya dinkam nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Avoid every kind of evil.

dag: Ka Musa mini Aduna ni Aduna bidibisi maa daa mal li paɣiri bɛ nuhi mini bɛ naba.
en: Moses, Aaron, and his sons washed their hands and their feet there.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ o lan pala dabili kɔŋko, amaa o gari dabili; o yipa nyɛla ti mabiyurigu Masia ni. O mali ma buchi pam, amaa nyini ka o lee ni mali buchi pam, o ni nyɛ a dabili la min o ni nyɛ a mabia ti Duuma zuɣu la puuni.
en: no longer as a slave but more than a slave—that is, as a dearly loved brother. He is especially a dearly loved brother to me. How much more can he become a brother to you, personally and spiritually in the Lord!.

dag: Ka o daa kɔrigi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la biŋkɔbigu, ka Aduna bidibisi daa taɣi binʒim n-zaŋ ti o, ka o kpaai li vie sara maligu bimbini maa luɣilikam.
en: Then Aaron slaughtered the entirely burned offering. Aarons sons handed him the blood, and he tossed it against all sides of the altar.

dag: Yi ni yɛn pirigi tiŋgban shɛli ti Izraɛlnim maa m-bala, ka di leei bɛ ni su shɛli. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The Sovereign Lord said, That is the way the land is to be divided into sections for the tribes of Israel to possess.

dag: Wuntizɔriba kul dolila yɛlimaŋli soli, ka bihi bɛn doli bɛ naba mali alibarika.
en: Children are fortunate if they have a father who is honest and does what is right.

dag: Ka yi yi ti be Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya ni yi su maa ni, yin ti miriya ka yi vuɣi yi kpee tiŋgbani tariga kpaa din nyɛ kurimbuni ha niriba ni daa kpa shɛli, ka di be bɛ ni yɛn piri tiŋgban shɛŋa tin ya la ni.
en: Now in the land the LORD your God is giving you, in your allotted property that you will receive there, you must not tamper with your neighbors property line, which has been previously established.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa buɣisi dundɔŋ maa. Di wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita pihinu, ka di yɛliŋ gba nyɛ mita pihinu. Di daa nyɛla mɔɣumɔɣu, ka sara maligu bimbini be Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa tooni.
en: Now the man measured the inner courtyard; it was meters square. I also saw an altar in front of the temple.

dag: Ka Annas daa chɛ ka bɛ lo o mihi n-zaŋ o tahi maligumaaniba zuɣulan Kaiafas sani.
en: Jesus was still tied up, and Annas sent him to Caiaphas the high priest.

dag: Amaa Naawuni so be alizanda ni ka nyɛ ŋun kahigiri ashiya gbinni wuhiri niriba. Dina n-chɛ ka o kahigi yɛl shɛŋa din ti yɛn niŋ dahin shɛli ha n-wuhi nyin Naa Nɛbukadnɛza. N ni yɛl a a zahindi maa min a ni daa nya ʒii shɛli a gom puuni maa.
en: But there is a God in heaven who tells secret things. God has given King Nebuchadnezzar dreams to show him what will happen later. This was your dream, and this is what you saw while lying on your bed:.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yɛn zaŋ Pool kpe tɔbbihi maa biɛhigu shee saha shɛli ka o daa bɔhi sapashin kpɛm maa, A ni ti ma noli ka n yɛl a shɛli? Ka sapashin maa bɔh o, A wumdi Giriikili.
en: When Paul was about to be taken into the fortress, he asked the commander, Can I say something to you? How do you know Greek? the commander asked.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yiɣisi Obɔt maa n-chaŋ ti dɔni Abarim yɔɣu din daa miri Mɔabnim tintariga zaŋ lab wulimpuhili polo la ni.
en: They marched from Oboth and camped at Iye-abarim in the desert on the border of Moab toward the east.

dag: Ka bɔh o, Bɔ n-lee muɣis a? Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, Paɣ ŋɔ n-daa yɛli ma, Zaŋm a bidibiga ŋɔ ka ti duɣi ŋubi zuŋɔ; ka sa zaŋ m mi bidibiga duɣi ŋubi biɛɣuni.
en: Then he said to her, What is your trouble? She answered, This woman said to me, Give me your son so that we can eat him today. Then we will eat my son tomorrow.

dag: Benya ni suhu yini ni taba; di lihiya ʒiɛm so, amaa zaŋmiya yimaŋ tabili tarimba; di kuuniya yi baŋsim.
en: Be friendly with everyone. Don't be proud and feel that you know more than others. Make friends with ordinary people.

dag: Di saha ka o daa zaŋ nabia maa na nti zaŋ nam zuɣupiligu pil o, ka zaŋ nam fukumsi litaafi ti o, ka bɛ leeg o nam. Ka Jɛhɔiada min o bidibisi daa booi kpam bah o zuɣu ni. Ka sokam daa kuhi yɛli, Naawuni dolimi naa ŋɔ nyɛvili.
en: They brought out the kings son and put the crown on him. They gave him a copy of the agreement. Then they made Joash king. Jehoiada and his sons anointed Joash and said, Long live the king.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira nyaandoliba maa ni daa kuli naai, ka Yisa piligi tɔɣisiri salo maa Jɔn yɛla ka bɔhiri ba, Bɔ ka yi daa lee chaŋ mɔɣu ni ni yi ti nya la? Gbiŋgban shɛli pɔhim ni ʒɛra?.
en: When Johns followers left, Jesus began talking to the people about John: What did you people go out into the desert to see? Someone who is weak, like a stem of grass blowing in the wind?.

dag: Di pa shɛli o ni ŋmala sida tia bee ka o piila oki bee siɣirili n-zaŋ li sa nyɔŋ puuni, ka saa mi n-niŋ li ka di zooi niŋ kpiɔŋ.
en: To split the cedar tree, the worker took some oak or cypress wedges . To make sure he had plenty of wood, he planted some pines. But it was the rain that made them grow.

dag: Wulinluhili polɔnim ni lu Yawɛ yuli sizuura, ka wulimpuhili polɔnim mi lu o sizuura o jilima zuɣu; dama dimnim maa yi ti kana kaman kokpɛɣu mini sanʒiɛɣu la, Yawɛ Shia ni ti yiɣisi tuhi ba.
en: so those in the west will fear the LORDs name, and those in the east will fear Gods glory. It will come like a rushing river that the LORDs wind drives on.

dag: O bi chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri mali nyɛvili, amaa o zaŋdi bɛn diri wahala yɛlimaŋli tiri ba.
en: He doesnt let the wicked live, but grants justice to the poor.

dag: Hal pumpɔŋɔ n shɛhiralana bela alizanda ni, ka ŋun ʒe n nyaaŋa nyɛla ŋun be zuɣusaa.
en: Even now, God in heaven is both my witness and my protector.

dag: Di saha ka tɔbbihi sapashin kpamba zaa mini Karia bia Jɔhanan ni Hɔshaya bia Azaria ni niriba maa zaa, bihi zaŋ tabili ninkura daa chaŋ.
en: Then all the army officers, including Johanan, Kareahs son, and Jezaniah, Hoshaiahs son, and the rest of the people, from the least to the greatest, approached.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa ŋmɛnditoya shɛb daa ti yi bɛ suɣa maa ni m-piri tab ʒii buta zuɣu; ka yim zuɣu daa ŋmaligi kpa tin shɛli din yuli booni Ofira ka di be Shual tiŋgban ni la polo.
en: Each day they sent out patrols to attack and rob villages and then destroy them. One patrol would go north along the road to Ophrah in the region of Shual.

dag: A yɛtɔɣa daa taɣiri bɛn tuuri zaana. A daa kpaŋsi bɛn duna ni ka yaa la.
en: have guided and encouraged many in need.

dag: Amaa o bihi bɛn kpalim maa ni daa nya ka bɛ ba yuri Yisifu pam gari bɛn nyɛ o biɛyanim maa zaa maa, ka bɛ daa je Yisifu di zuɣu, ka bi tɔɣisir o yɛtɔɣa ni suhumahili.
en: which showed that Joseph was his favorite son, and so Joseph's brothers hated him and would not be friendly to him.

dag: Naawuni n-daa zal o ni o nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulan ŋun tuma ni be kaman Mɛlikizɛdɛk tuma ni daa be shɛm.
en: He was appointed by God to be a high priest according to the order of Melchizedek.

dag: So bi lan teeri bɛ yɛla dunia ni, ka bɛ yuya lan ka solɔɣu zuɣu.
en: People on earth will not remember them. Their names will be forgotten.

dag: Yi daa lo ma la zaɣ biɛɣu, amaa ka Naawuni daa zaŋ li leei zaɣ suŋ ni di chɛ ka niriba pam ti tiligi kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: It is true that you planned to do something bad to me. But really, God was planning good things. Gods plan was to use me to save the lives of many people. And that is what happened.

dag: Chɛ ka di dabisili maa leei zibisim. Naawuni ŋun be zuɣusaa ŋɔ di lan teei di yɛla bee n-chɛ ka neesim neei di ni.
en: Forget about that day, cover it with darkness.

dag: Amaa dilan yi bɔr ni o yo o zuɣu ka deeg o, ŋun yom daa maa pirigibu ʒiibunu yim zuɣu pahi bɛ ni zali da shɛli maa zuɣu.
en: If the promise maker wishes to buy it back, they must add one-fifth to its value.

dag: Do so daa lan beni ŋun mali Yawɛ yuli tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa. O yuli n-daa booni Yuria. O daa nyɛla Shɛmaya ŋun daa nyɛ Kiriatijiarim nir la bia. O daa tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi tiŋ ŋɔ mini tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ kaman Jɛrimia ni kul tɔɣisiri shɛm ŋɔ.
en: There was another man, Uriah son of Shemaiah from Kiriath Jearim, who spoke in the name of the Lord against this city and nation just as Jeremiah did.

dag: Amaa nyin Naawuni shiri ni tooi be dunia ŋɔ ni? Nyama, zuɣusaa mini di galisim ŋɔ zaa pɔri ni a biɛhigu shee, di ni ti be ka n ni me du shɛli ŋɔ?.
en: But can you, O God, really live on earth? Not even all of heaven is large enough to hold you, so how can this Temple that I have built be large enough?.

dag: Ŋunkam mini yɛnnim be leerila yɛndana, amaa ŋun mini jɛra be nyarila biɛrim.
en: Wise friends make you wise, but you hurt yourself by going around with fools.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa ti labina nti yɛli Yisa bɛ ni daa niŋ shɛlikam zaa, ka o daa zaŋ ba yi kpaŋa n-chaŋ tin shɛli din yuli booni Bɛtisaida.
en: When the apostles came back, they told Jesus what they had done on their trip. Then he took them away to a town called Bethsaida. There, he and his apostles could be alone together.

dag: Di sab Naawuni zaligu ni ni ti Duuma yɛliya: N ni zaŋ niriba bɛn tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa mini tinzunnim noya ni yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi niriba ŋɔ, amaa di zaa yoli, bɛ ku bahi wum n yɛligu.
en: In the Scriptures it is written, By means of people speaking strange languages I will speak to my people, says the Lord. I will speak through lips of foreigners, but even then my people will not listen to me.

dag: Bɛ daa lan ʒini wulimpuhili polo luɣ shɛli din mini bihigu shee bi wɔɣ ni taba, ka di be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli zaŋ labi tiŋgban nɛli ŋ-ŋɔ polo na la. Dama bɛ niɣi daa yɛligiya m-pali Giliad zaa.
en: and as far east as the desert just west of the Euphrates River. They needed this much land because they owned too many cattle to keep them all in Gilead.

dag: Ninsalinim ni daa ti piligi nabbu dunia ŋɔ ni saha shɛli, ka bɛ daa dɔɣi bipuɣinsi.
en: More and more people were born, until finally they spread all over the earth. Some of their daughters were so beautiful that supernatural beings came down and married the ones they wanted.

dag: Kpuɣim a kpan titali min a kpam bila n-lu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kariti doli ma la zuɣu; ka yɛli ma, Mani n-nyɛ a tiligira.
en: Lift up your spear and war ax against those who pursue me. Promise that you will save me.

dag: Zuliya pam niriba ni ka yi neesim maa ni na, ka nanim ka yi biɛkaali neesim ni na.
en: Nations will be drawn to your light, And kings to the dawning of your new day.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila teeku kɔgbana din laŋsiri ginda, ka bɛ vi tuma ŋmanila kɔfuɣifuɣi. Bɛ lan ŋmanila saŋmar shɛb bɛn chani ginda. Naawuni pun mali biɛhigu shee zali ba bumbɔn ni.
en: wild waves of the sea foaming up their own shame; wandering stars for whom the darkness of the underworld is reserved forever.

dag: Ka nyin naa ni ti dɔɣi bidibisi; ka bɛ zani a yaannim zaani, ka a ti zaŋ ba leei nanim dunia ŋɔ zaa ni.
en: Your sons and your grandsons will also be kings as your ancestors were. You will make them rulers everywhere on earth.

dag: A yu zaɣ biɛɣu gari zaɣ viɛlli, ka yu ʒiri ŋmabu gari yɛlimaŋli yɛlibu.
en: You love evil more than goodness. You love lies more than truth. Selah.

dag: Zuliya ayi ni pirigili maa daa pun deei bɛ tarili ka di be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli zaŋ lab Jɛriko wulimpuhili polo.
en: These two and a half tribes took the land near Jericho—they took the land east of the Jordan River.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka ti puhi di chuɣu, ka di pa ni ti zaŋ dabin kurili din nyɛ biɛr biɛɣu mini tuumbiɛtali puhi li, amaa di simdi ni ti zaŋla bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi ka nyɛ bɔrɔbɔro din nyɛ alali mini yɛlimaŋli la puhi li.
en: So let us eat our Passover meal, but not with the bread that has the old yeast, the yeast of sin and wrongdoing. But let us eat the bread that has no yeast. This is the bread of goodness and truth.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa lan zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapaɣa niŋ Naawuni biɛhigu shee suɣili maa.
en: Then the workers made frames from acacia wood to support the Holy Tent.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka yi dimnim nyaŋ ya. Yi ni ti doli so yini chaŋ ni yi ti tuhi ba, amaa ka ni ti ŋmaligi bɛ sani n-zo n-doli soya ayopɔin. Yi ni ti leei dunia nanim zaa ni je shɛba.
en: The Lord will let your enemies defeat you. You will go to fight against your enemies one way, but you will run away from them seven different ways. The bad things that happen to you will make all the people on earth afraid.

dag: Di saha ka o daa chɛbis o biɛyanim maa. Bɛ ni daa yiɣisi ni bɛ chaŋ, ka Yisifu yɛli ba, Miriya ka yi ŋme tab naŋgbankpeeni sol ni.
en: Then Joseph told his brothers to go. While they were leaving, he said to them, Go straight home, and dont fight on the way.

dag: Ka Bɔrɔbɔro din ka Dabindi Chuɣu la daa puhi gari, ka ti mi kpe ŋariŋ Filipai n-zaŋ daba anu chaŋ ti paai ba Troas; ka ti daa niŋ daba ayopɔin nimaani.
en: We sailed from Philippi after the Festival of Unleavened Bread, and five days later we joined them in Troas, where we spent a week.

dag: Miriya ka yi leei buɣijɛmdiba kaman bɛ ni shɛb ni daa niŋ shɛm la; dama di sabiya, Niriba daa ʒiya diri ka nyura, ka bembe nti yiɣisi diɛmda.
en: Dont worship false gods like some of them did, as it is written, The people sat down to eat and drink and they got up to play .

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Ilaija ŋun nyɛ Tishibi nir la.
en: Then the Lord spoke to Elijah, the prophet from Tishbe:.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ ʒirilana ka pa ni ŋun chihi ni Yisa pala Masia? Ninvuɣ so ŋun chihi ti Ba Naawuni min o Bia maa, dilana n-nyɛ Masiachihira.
en: And a liar is anyone who says Jesus isn't truly Christ. Anyone who says this is an enemy of Christ and rejects both the Father and the Son.

dag: Ti ni mali maligumaaniba zuɣulan titali so maa nyɛla ŋun ni tooi baŋ ti chɔɣinsi yɛla ka di niŋ o nambɔɣu, dama o nyɛla ŋun daa nya zahimbu kaman ti gba ni nyari zahimbu shɛm, amaa o daa bi tum alahichi di puuni.
en: Jesus, our high priest, is able to understand our weaknesses. When Jesus lived on earth, he was tempted in every way. He was tempted in the same ways we are tempted, but he never sinned.

dag: Zaŋmi salima mali bansi anahi n-zaŋ niŋ di yaɣa anahi maa gbaya anahi la.
en: Make four gold rings and attach one to each of the legs.

dag: ka Jeesɔn deei ba kpɛh o yiŋa. Bɛ mi nyɛla bɛn saɣindi Naa Siiza zaligunima, ka yɛri ni na so lan beni m-pahi Naa Siiza zuɣu ni ŋuna n-nyɛ Yisa.
en: What is more, Jason has welcomed them into his home. Every one of them does what is contrary to Caesars decrees by naming someone else as king: Jesus.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu asiba ka Yawɛ bɔhi ma.
en: The next morning, the word of the Lord came to me. He said.

dag: Dinzuɣu chira awɛi ni biɛɣ pisi ka bɛ daa zaŋ gili tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa ka labi Jɛrusalɛm.
en: After they had gone through the whole land, they went back to Jerusalem. It had taken them months and days.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ku o min o bihi ni o niriba zaa hal ka o ninvuɣ yino gba bi tiligi; ka daa deeg o tiŋgbɔŋ maa su.
en: So the Israelites killed Og, his sons, and all his people, leaving no survivors, and then they occupied his land.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl naa, ka lan nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋun nyɛ tiligira la yɛliya, Mani n-nyɛ piligu, mani n-lan nyɛ bahigu. Naawuni so kani pahi n zuɣu.
en: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the first and the last, the one and only God. Israel, I have rescued you! I am your King.

dag: Nyama, n niriba ni ti yi katiŋa nuzaa polo mini wulinluhili polo ni Asiwan din be nudirigu polo la na.
en: Look! People are coming to me from faraway places. They are coming to me from the north and from the west. They are coming to me from Aswan in Egypt.

dag: Niriba yi zabira, ka yino ti zaŋ kuɣili lab o kpee bee n-kpilim o nuu ŋme o kpee, ka o nya daŋa ka bi kpi, amaa ka lee dɔni.
en: Suppose two of you are arguing, and you hit the other with either a rock or your fist, without causing a fatal injury. If the victim has to stay in bed.

dag: Hal n ni pa so dabili maa zaa yoli, n zaŋ mmaŋ leela sokam zaa dabili din ni chɛ ka n tooi tiligi niriba pahi.
en: Although Im free from all people, I make myself a slave to all people, to recruit more of them.

dag: Naa Sulemaana daa lan kpahi ŋarima din zɔri pam zali Ɛziɔngɛba din miri Ɛlat, ka be Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni Teeku Ʒiɛɣu kulinol ni la.
en: King Solomon also built a fleet of ships at Eziongeber, which is near Elath on the shore of the Gulf of Aqaba, in the land of Edom.

dag: Di bi simdi ni yidana zaɣisir o min o paɣa laɣimbu; ka paɣ gba di zaɣisir o min o yidana laɣimbu.
en: The husband should meet his wifes sexual needs, and the wife should do the same for her husband.

dag: Amaa maligumaana maa yi kana ti lihi yili maa, ka dɔro maa bi lan yɛligi pahi yili maa ni bɛ ni lab ta li maa nyaaŋa, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun wuhimi ni yili maa nyɛla din ka daɣiri ni, dama dɔro maa naaya.
en: On the other hand, if the priest discovers that mildew hasn't reappeared after the house was newly plastered, he will say, This house is clean—the mildew has gone.

dag: Ka yi yi yɛli yi suhu ni, Zuliyanim ŋɔ galisiya gari ti, wula ka ti lee yɛn tooi niŋ kari ba.
en: If you happen to think to yourself, These nations are greater than we are; how can we possibly possess their land?.

dag: Shɛshan daa dɔɣila bipuɣinsi kɔŋko, o daa bi dɔɣi bidibiga. Amaa o daa mal o dabili ŋun daa nyɛ Ijipti nira, ka o yuli booni Jariha.
en: Sheshan did not have sons. He only had daughters. Sheshan had a servant from Egypt named Jarha.

dag: Dama di ni leei jilima zuɣupiligu a zuɣu ni, ka leei dolibi a nyiŋgol ni.
en: What you learn from your parents will bring you honor and respect, like a crown or a gold medal.

dag: Mɔɣ shɛli beni ka di kom nyɛla din tiri Naawuni tiŋ la suhupiɛlli, luɣ kasi shee din nyɛ Zallakudura Naa biɛhigu shee la.
en: There is a river that brings joy to the city of God, to the sacred house of the Most High.

dag: Gɛbalnima ni Ammɔnnima ni Amalɛknima ni Filistianima mini Taainima.
en: the people of Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek, and of Philistia and Tyre.

dag: Bɛ daa buɣisi Naawuni siɣimsiɣim bushɛm ni bɛ nya, ka daa chɛ ka Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ suhu yiɣisi.
en: They kept testing him and caused terrible pain for the Holy One of Israel.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ŋmaligi jɛmdi buɣa bo wahala pam ti bɛmaŋa. N ku pahi bɛ ni n-kɔrigi binyara ʒim vie buɣa maa; m mi kul ku yaai n noli boli di yuya.
en: let their suffering increase because they hurried after a different god. I wont participate in their blood offerings; I wont let their names cross my lips.

dag: Ka o daa bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a nya bimburiginli a mabia ninni, ka daantaliga lee sa amaŋmaŋ ninni ka a bi nya li?.
en: Why do you see the splinter thats in your brothers or sisters eye, but dont notice the log in your own eye?.

dag: M-pahi bɛ ni daa nya ka do so ŋun kpaŋ maa ʒe bɛ sani maa zuɣu ka bɛ daa naan ku tooi ŋme ba naŋgbankpeeni.
en: But they could not deny what had happened. The man who had been healed was standing there with the apostles.

dag: Ka yi daa vu m-mirina ti zani zoli maa gbini, ka zoli maa daa taai buɣim n-kpuɣi du sagbana ni, ka sagbana daa zibigi lim li.
en: You came near and stood at the bottom of the mountain. The mountain burned with fire that reached up to the sky. There were thick black clouds and darkness.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa ni daa ti wum ni Jɛrɔbɔam kuna, ka bɛ daa laɣim ka tim ti bol o na nti zaŋ o leei Izraɛlnim zaa naa. Dinzuɣu Juda zuliya niriba la kɔŋko n-daa doli Dauda yilinim maa, amaa ka bɛn kpalim la zaa daa zaɣisi ba dolibu.
en: When the people of Israel heard that Jeroboam had returned from Egypt, they invited him to a meeting of the people and made him king of Israel. Only the tribe of Judah remained loyal to David's descendants.

dag: m-pahi maligumaaniba, Ɛliakim mini Maasɛya ni Miniamin ni Mikaya ni Ɛliɔnai ni Zakaria ni Hanania bɛn daa piɛbiri kikahi la.
en: Also there were the priests Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah with trumpets.

dag: Ka wuntizɔriba daa nya li ka bɛ suhuri paligi, amaa ka ninvuɣ biɛri daa fo bɛ noya.
en: The righteous see this and are glad, but all the wicked are put to silence.

dag: niriba ayi n-daa chaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu ni bɛ ti jɛm Naawuni; bɛ ni yino daa nyɛla Farisii, ka ŋun la mi nyɛ farigudeera.
en: Once there were two men who went up to the Temple to pray: one was a Pharisee, the other a tax collector.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa ti yiɣisi nimaani chaŋ Bɛrishiiba.
en: From there Isaac went to Beersheba.

dag: Tiŋ ŋɔ nim kul kuri ma la suli ka chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisira saha shɛli bɛ ni daa me li hal ni zuŋɔ, dinzuɣu n ni wurim li;.
en: From the time that Jerusalem was built until now, the people of this city have made me angry. This city has made me very angry, so I must remove it from my sight.

dag: Suhimiya Naawuni ka o yihi ma bɛn bi niŋ yɛda ka be Judia la nuu ni, ka n ni ti yɛn tum tuun shɛli Jɛrusalɛm la ti tiɣi Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn be nimaani la nini.
en: Pray that I may be kept safe from the unbelievers in Judea and that my service in Jerusalem may be acceptable to God's people there.

dag: Di saha ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa chɛ ka o tɔbbihi kana ti liri Jɛrusalɛmnima n-teei gili bɛ tiŋ maa.
en: At that time the officers of King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon came to Jerusalem and surrounded it.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ʒini tiŋa o sani wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ hal ni daba ayopɔin, ka bɛ ni so daa bi yɛl o shɛli, dama bɛ daa nyaya ka o be biɛrim pam ni.
en: For seven days and nights, they sat silently on the ground beside him, because they realized what terrible pain he was in.

dag: Bɛ ni tooi waɣa ti kpɛri sagbana ni, ka bɛ zuɣuri tɔri sagbana.
en: Though their pride and power may reach to the sky.

dag: Ka n daa yihi ba tinzun yɛlli kam daɣiri ni; ka daa zali maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim tuma ni nyɛ shɛm ni sokam tuuni ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: So I made the priests and Levites clean and pure. I took away all the foreigners and the strange things they taught. And I gave the Levites and priests their own duties and responsibilities.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yi ʒi yi ni suhiri shɛli maa. Yi ni ti tooi nyu binnyur shɛli din be m pipia la ni ka n yɛn nyu la? Ka tooi deei baptaizibu shɛli bɛ ni ti yɛn baptaizi ma la.
en: Jesus said to them, You don't know what you are asking for. Can you drink the cup of suffering that I must drink? Can you be baptized in the way I must be baptized.

dag: Yi yi ti yɛn sibigi suɣili maa chaŋ, Lɛvinim n-yɛn sibigi li; ka yi yi ti yɛn sa li, Lɛvinim maa n-yɛn zaŋ li sa. Ka ninvuɣ zino yi miri suɣili maa na, yin kum o.
en: When its time to break camp, the Levites will take down the dwelling; and when its time to make camp, the Levites will set up the dwelling. Any other person who approaches will be put to death.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ maŋmaŋ daa yɛli ma, N ku chɛ bɛ tuumbiɛɣu ŋɔ taali hal ka bɛ ti yi dunia yili. Mani yi Duuma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The Sovereign Lord Almighty himself spoke to me and said, This evil will never be forgiven them as long as they live. I, the Sovereign Lord Almighty, have spoken.

dag: N ni lo ni n niŋ dunia ŋɔ zaa shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N teegi n nuu ni n-darigi niriba tibili.
en: I have planned this for the whole world, and my mighty arm controls every nation.

dag: Teem o yɛla pɔi ka anzinfa mia la naanyi yihi, ka salima laa la ŋma; ka koyul la ŋma kɔbiliga ni bee ka kalinli la kabi kɔbiliga ni.
en: Remember your Creator while you are young, before the silver rope snaps and the golden bowl is crushed like a jar broken at the well, like a stone cover on a well that breaks and falls in.

dag: Lahibal suŋ ŋɔ ka ti zaŋ na ni ti ti tin ya: Naawuni ni daa lo ti yaannim alikauli shɛl la.
en: We tell you the Good News about the promise God made to our ancestors.

dag: Zaŋmi nam mini tibiginsim ye kaman salima nɛma la, ka zaŋ nam dariza mini yaa ye kaman situra la.
en: If so, you can be proud and wear glory and honor like clothes.

dag: ka booi kom niŋ tahili ni n-gbaag o nyaandoliba maa naba paɣibu, ka mali bɔdu shɛli din mil o shee ni maa nyɛhiri bɛ naba maa.
en: He put some water into a large bowl. Then he began washing his disciples' feet and drying them with the towel he was wearing.

dag: Di saha ka malaika maa daa yɛli ma, A ni nya kulisi ko shɛŋa ka pagɔrili la du n-ʒi di zuɣu la nyɛla salo bɛn yi niriba balibu pam ni mini zuliyanim pam ni ni tinzun yɛligu pam nim ni na.
en: Then the angel said to me, You saw the waters where the prostitute sits. These waters are the many peoples, the different races, nations, and languages in the world.

dag: Amaa a halibiɛɣu min a tipawumli zuɣu chɛ ka a bɔri Naawuni suhuyiɣisili zaani gur amaŋ zaadali din nyɛ Naawuni ni ti yɛn kari saria din tuhi dahin shɛl la.
en: But you have a hard and stubborn heart, and so you are making your own punishment even greater on the Day when God's anger and righteous judgments will be revealed.

dag: Dindali maa ka Sadusiinim bɛn daa nyɛ bɛn yɛri ni kum ni neebu kani la daa ka Yisa sanna.
en: That same day some Sadducees came to Jesus and claimed that people will not rise from death.

dag: Amaa so beni ŋun diri ma shɛhira, ka m mi ni o ni diri ma shɛhira shɛli maa nyɛla shɛhira maŋli.
en: But there is someone else who speaks for me, and I know what he says is true.

dag: O daa zaŋ li ti o daba Izraɛlnima. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He gave it as a gift to Israel, his servant. His faithful love will last forever.

dag: Amaa kul ʒiɛnya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yim kaman yi ni pun niŋdi shɛm hal ni zuŋɔ la.
en: You must continue to follow the Lord your God as you have done in the past.

dag: dama a tahi yɛl pal shɛŋa ti ni na ʒi n-wum di yɛla na. Dinzuɣu ti bɔri ni ti baŋ yɛla maa gbinni.
en: Youve told us some strange things and we want to know what they mean. .

dag: Di saha ka Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim ni bɛ zuɣulan Jɛhɔshafat daa lab kuli Jɛrusalɛm ni suhupiɛlli, dama Yawɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ nya suhupiɛlli o ni daa nyaŋ bɛ dimnim ti ba maa zuɣu.
en: All the men from Judah and Jerusalem were very happy as they marched back to Jerusalem with Jehoshaphat in the front. The Lord made them very happy when he defeated their enemy.

dag: Ŋun Naa Dauda daa daŋ nya Masia kum ni neebu ka tɔɣisi di yɛla yɛli: O ti ku kpalim be kpiimba biɛhigu shee bee o niŋgbuŋ ti pooi. .
en: Having seen this beforehand, David spoke about the resurrection of Christ, that he wasnt abandoned to the grave, nor did his body experience decay .

dag: Buni ku tooi tiligi nir Naawuni suhuyiɣisili dali, amaa wuntitali tiligiri nir kum ni.
en: Riches dont help in the day of wrath, but righteousness rescues from death.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi pina na ti ti Yawɛ. Ŋunkam mali yurilim o suhu ni, ŋun zaŋmi Yawɛ pina din nyɛ: salima mini anzinfa ni daanya.
en: Gather special gifts for the Lord . Each of you should decide in your heart what you will give. And then you should bring that gift to the Lord . Bring gold, silver, and bronze;.

dag: O zuliya ni ninvuɣ shɛb mini bɛ malibu yuya m-bɔŋɔ saha shɛli bɛ ni daa kali ba m-baŋ bɛ kalinli la. Naa mini Jɛiɛl ni Zakaria.
en: The family records also include Jeiel, who was a clan leader, Zechariah, and Bela son of Azaz and grandson of Shema of the Joel clan. They lived in the territory around the town of Aroer, as far north as Nebo and Baal-Meon.

dag: N ni chɛ ka a zuliya ti bemi kaman bihigu la, ka nir yi ni tooi kali bihigu, o ni ti tooi kal a zuliya gba.
en: I am going to give you so many descendants that no one will be able to count them all; it would be as easy to count all the specks of dust on earth!.

dag: Dinzuɣu n gba ni chɛ ka alɔbo din nyɛ bɛ ni zɔri shɛl la lu bɛ zuɣu. Dama n kuhi boli ba ka so bi saɣi, ka tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa ka so bi saɣi wum li, amaa ka tumdila tuumbiɛri, ka niŋdi din bi piɛli n suhu.
en: You refused to answer when I called out; you paid no attention to my instructions. Instead, you did what I hated, knowing it was wrong. Now I will punish you in a way you dread the most.

dag: Zilinli ŋmanila buɣim. Zilinli lan ŋmanila dunia ŋɔ yɛl biɛri m-be ti niŋgbuna yaɣa ni n-tari ti niŋgbuna maa zaa daɣiri, ka zaŋdi buɣim n-juuri ti dunia ŋɔ biɛhigu, ka buɣim din bi kpiri la mi taari li.
en: The tongue is like a spark. It is an evil power that dirties the rest of the body and sets a person's entire life on fire with flames that come from hell itself.

dag: Timna daa nyɛla Iso bia Ɛlifaz mam. Ŋuna n-daa dɔɣi Ɛlifaz bia Amalɛk. Iso paɣ Ada bihi n-daa bala.
en: Eliphaz also had a slave woman named Timna. Timna and Eliphaz had a son named Amalek.

dag: Doli dimbɔŋɔnima, ka zaŋ amaŋ ti li, ka di chɛ ka sokam nya a tooni chandi a tuma puuni ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Practice these things, and live by them so that your progress will be visible to all.

dag: Yɛlim Ammɔnnim maa, Wummiya ti Duuma Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya: N jɛmbu duu ni daa saɣim ka yi mali suhupiɛlli la mini Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni kpalim dabari ni bɛ ni daa gbahi Judanim chaŋ ka yi mali suhupiɛlli la zuɣu.
en: Tell them to listen to what I, the Sovereign Lord , am saying: You were delighted to see my Temple profaned, to see the land of Israel devastated, to see the people of Judah go into exile.

dag: Ka ŋariŋ maa kpatoonsi maa daa bɔri ni bɛ yi n-zo n-tiligi, ka daa sirigi ŋarim bil din be ŋariŋ maa ni la pa kom zuɣu n-niŋ kaman bɛ yɛn zaŋla kur tibisa din bari ŋariŋ maa zaani la bahi ŋariŋ maa tooni polo ka zaŋ ŋarim bil maa n-zo n-tiligi.
en: Some of the sailors wanted to leave the ship, and they lowered the lifeboat to the water. They wanted the other men to think that they were throwing more anchors from the front of the ship.

dag: N ni chɛ ka o kpambaliba min o ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali yɛm ni o gomnanim ni wulaannim ni tɔbbihi nyu dam buɣi. Bɛ ni gbihi go titali, ka ku lan yiɣisi. Naa ŋun yuli booni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Ill make her leaders and sages drunk, her governors, officials, and warriors as well. They will sleep forever, never to get up, declares the king, whose name is the LORD of heavenly forces.

dag: Niriba maa daa jɛmdi Yawɛ, ka daa lan pii bɛ ni ninvuɣ shɛba n-leei maligumaaniba ka bɛ maani maligu bɛ ni jɛmdi buɣa luɣ shɛŋa la tiri ba.
en: These people also worshiped the Lord and chose from among their own number all sorts of people to serve as priests at the pagan places of worship and to offer sacrifices for them there.

dag: Nyama, Mani n-nam machɛle, ka ti zuɣiri pɔhim, ka di chɛ ka buɣimsala buɣim nyɛligira, ka machɛli kuriti bidibbini din ni ku di bukaata. Mani n lan nam ŋun bɔhiri biɛri ka o kuri niriba.
en: I create the blacksmith, who builds a fire and forges weapons. I also create the soldier, who uses the weapons to kill.

dag: Amaa m mabihi, din gari shɛlikam zaa nyɛla: Miriya ka yi po alizanda bee dunia ŋɔ bee m-po pɔ shɛli pahi. Chɛliya ka yi Iin kul nyɛla Iin, ka yi Aai mi kul nyɛla Aai, ka di chɛ ka yi ku kpe taali ni.
en: My friends, above all else, don't take an oath. You must not swear by heaven or by earth or by anything else. Yes or No is all you need to say. If you say anything more, you will be condemned.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, Wummi mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ fabila mini n suhigu ŋɔ. Gbilisim tibili wum a dabili fabila ni o suhigu shɛli o ni suhir a ŋɔ.
en: But please listen to my prayer and my request. I am your servant, and you are the Lord my God. Hear this prayer that I am praying to you today.

dag: Ifriimnim taɣirila pɔhim chana, ka zɔri doli wulimpuhili polo pɔhim dabisili kam. Bɛ ʒiri mini bɛ suhuyiɣisili kul pahirimi. Ka bɛ mini Asirianim niŋdi daabiligu, ka bɛ tiri Ijiptinim kpam.
en: Ephraim herds the wind, and pursues the east wind all day long; they multiply lies and violence; they make a treaty with Assyria, and oil is carried to Egypt.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa, Jɛrɔbɔam daa na kul bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ o daalahichi tumbu soli maa, amaa ka na kul lihirila niriba maa zaa ni m-piiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ni saɣi n-leei buɣa tindaannima.
en: But Jeroboam kept on doing evil things. He appointed men to be priests at the local shrines, even if they were not Levites. In fact, anyone who wanted to be a priest could be one.

dag: Di saha maa ka o daa kana ti paɣiri Naawuni ka tɔɣisiri bia maa yɛla bɛnkam zaa daa yuuni Jɛrusalɛmnim tiliginsim nyabu sol la sani.
en: That very same hour she arrived and gave thanks to God and spoke about the child to all who were waiting for God to set Jerusalem free.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Kamiyana ti nya. Ka bɛ daa dol o nti nya o ni kpɛri shɛli, ka kpalim o sani dindali maa, dama di daa nyɛla zaawuni kurig anahi saha.
en: He answered, Come with me and you will see. So the two men went with him. They saw the place where he was staying, and they stayed there with him that day. It was about four oclock.

dag: Ka Babilɔn Naa Sairus daa ti zali zaligu o nam dibu yuun yini saha ni bɛ lab me Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa zali.
en: But, in the first year that Cyrus was king of Babylon, King Cyrus gave a special order for Gods Temple to be rebuilt.

dag: Ka Ibram daa yiɣisi nimaani n-chaŋ ti ti o suɣili Bɛtɛl wulimpuhili polo zoli zuɣu ʒini; ka chɛ Bɛtɛl bahi wulinluhili polo, ka chɛ Ai mi bahi wulimpuhili polo. Ka o daa me sara maligu bimbini zali Yawɛ nimaani gba n-jɛmd o di gbini.
en: From there he traveled toward the mountains east of Bethel, and pitched his tent with Bethel on the west and Ai on the east. There he built an altar to the LORD and worshipped in the LORDs name.

dag: Dina n-ni chɛ ka Izraɛlnim ku lan kpe yɔɣu ka chɛ ma bee n-lan zaŋ bɛ daalahichi ŋɔ zaa ta bɛmaŋ daɣiri. Di saha bɛ ni ti leei n niriba, ka m mi leei bɛ Naawuni. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Why? So that those prophets will stop leading my people away from me, and my people will stop being filthy with sin. Then they will be my special people, and I will be their God. This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka m pun yɛli ya ni yi ni ti kpi ni yi daalahichi, dama yi yi bi niŋ yɛda ni n nyɛla n ni pun yɛli ya ni n nyɛ so la, yi shiri ni ti kpi ni yi daalahichi.
en: This is why I said you will die with your sins unforgiven. If you don't have faith in me for who I am, you will die, and your sins will not be forgiven.

dag: daa ti lo tɔbu bɛ ʒiɛman ni n-chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi Sɔdom Naa Bɛra mini Gomɔra Naa Birisha ni Adima Naa Shinab ni Zɛbɔiim Naa Shɛmɛba ni Bɛla bee Zɔa naa.
en: attacked King Bera of Sodom, King Birsha of Gomorrah, King Shinab of Admah, King Shemeber of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela, a city also known as Zoar.

dag: Ziɔn Zoli ni kpalim dabari, ka kunduna be di zuɣu gɔra.
en: our city is in ruins, overrun by wild dogs.

dag: Wuntizɔra yɛtɔɣa sɔŋdi niriba pam, amaa jɛra kpirila bɛ yɛm kalinsi zuɣu.
en: Many are helped by useful instruction, but fools are killed by their own stupidity.

dag: Dama Masia bi tim ma ni n ti baptaizi niriba, amaa o tim ma ni n ti yihila lahibal suŋ waazu, ka di mi pala baŋsim yɛtɔɣa puuni; dama di yi nyɛla baŋsim yɛtɔɣa zuɣu, dindina Yisa Masia dapulli zuɣu kum yiko ni gbarigi.
en: Christ did not send me to baptize. He sent me to tell the Good News, and to tell it without using the language of human wisdom, in order to make sure that Christ's death on the cross is not robbed of its power.

dag: Yawɛ, so lan kani ŋ-ŋman a, ka Naawuni so mi lan kani pah a zuɣu kaman ti tiba ni wum shɛm.
en: There is no one like you, Lord . There is no God except you. We have never heard of any god doing wonderful things like those!.

dag: Dauda daa lan yɛli, Yawɛ tim ninsal kam laara o wuntitali min o ʒiɛyimtali zuɣu; dama Yawɛ zaŋ a niŋ n nuu ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka man lee bi saɣi teegi n nuu shihi ŋun Yawɛ ni booi kpam bahi nyin ninvuɣ so zuɣu ni ŋɔ.
en: The Lord pays every man for what he does—he rewards him if he does right, and he punishes him if he does wrong. The Lord gave you to me today, but I wouldnt harm the Lord s chosen king.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ tatabo ŋmanila kulibɔŋ kuma mini sagban shɛŋa sanʒiɛɣu ni ʒiɛri chana, ka Naawuni mali biɛhigu shee bumbɔn ni zali gu ba.
en: These false teachers are like springs that have no water. They are like clouds that are blown by a storm. A place in the deepest darkness has been kept for them.

dag: Huram daa lan zaŋ daanya mali binzahi pia, ka di zaɣ yini kam wɔɣilim pooi mita ayi biɛla, ka di yɛliŋ pooi mita ayi biɛla, ka di dubu mi nyɛ mita yini ni biɛla.
en: Then Huram made ten bronze carts. Each cart was cubits long, cubits wide, and cubits high.

dag: Binshɛɣukam din be Nail Mɔɣili maa duli ni ti kuui, ka bɛ ni biri binshɛlikam dolisi mɔɣili maa ti kuui zaa, ka pɔhim ʒe li chaŋ.
en: Fields along the Nile will be completely barren; every plant will disappear.

dag: Di daa nyɛla zaɣ mɔɣu, ka kpabi yim zuɣu ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ sɛntimita pisinaayi, ka di yɛliŋ gba nyɛ sɛntimita pisinaayi.
en: It was centimeters square and folded double.

dag: ni Jarimut naa ni Lakishi naa.
en: the king of Jarmuth one.

dag: Naa maa ni daa wum yɛlli ŋɔ, di daa niŋ o muɣisigu pam, ka o kpaŋ omaŋa m-bɔri soli ni o yihi Daniɛl, ka daa kul be lala nia niŋbu ni hal ka wuntaŋ ti lu.
en: The king became very sad and upset when he heard this. He decided to save Daniel. He worked until sunset trying to think of a way to save him.

dag: Nyamiya, pumpɔŋɔ n zaŋ zalikpana mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi wuhi ya ni yi ti dol li yi ni chani ni yi ti ʒini tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni maa kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ma shɛm.
en: So pay attention! I am teaching all of you the regulations and the case laws exactly as the LORD my God commanded me. You must do these in the land you are entering to possess.

dag: Di saha ka Musa min o sɔŋda Jɔshua daa lu soli, ka Musa daa du Naawuni zoli maa zuɣu.
en: So Moses and his helper, Joshua, went up the mountain of God.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yi kumdi bɔri sɔŋsim, Yawɛ wumda, ka yihiri ba bɛ muɣisigu kam zaa ni.
en: When the righteous cry out, the LORD listens; he delivers them from all their troubles.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni ti zaŋ ba niŋ yi nuu ni ka chɛ ka bɛ suhuri fuŋ hal ka yi ti ku ba naai.
en: But the Lord your God will let you defeat those nations. He will confuse them in battle, until they are destroyed.

dag: Yi mi di chɛliya ka niriba booni ya bɛ duumanima, dama Duuma yino kɔŋko ka yi mali, ŋuna n-nyɛ Masia.
en: And you should not be called Master. You have only one Master, the Messiah.

dag: bɛ ni daa tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa n-chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi la zuɣu. Dina n-nyɛ: bɛ daa maani maligu ka jɛmdi buɣ shɛŋa bɛ mini bɛ yaannim ni daa bi mi ka yi gba bi mi li.
en: because the people of Judah made me angry by worshiping gods that had never helped them or their ancestors.

dag: Ka Aduna daa niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm maa n-zaŋ li ti zali baɣili shɛhira bini la.
en: Aaron did as the LORD commanded Moses, and he put it in front of the covenant document for safekeeping.

dag: Yawɛ zaligu ka Izraɛlnim maa daa doli yiɣisira, ka lan doli Yawɛ zaligu n-tiri bɛ suɣa doona. Sagbani maa daa yi kul kpalim ʒe Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili maa zuɣusaa, bɛ mi kpalindimi doya.
en: At the LORDs command, the Israelites would march, and at the LORDs command they would camp. As long as the cloud settled on the dwelling, they would camp.

dag: A chɛ ka nintam leei bɛ bindirigu, ka zaŋ nintam leei binnyurigu ti ba ka bɛ nyu pam.
en: You gave us tears for food, and you made us drink them by the bowlful.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, Shihira ni ti be wuntaŋ mini goli ni saŋmarisi ni; ka wahala ni ti be dunia ni hal ka zuliya kam ti birim teeku kɔgbana vubu zuɣu;.
en: Strange things will happen to the sun, moon, and stars. The nations on earth will be afraid of the roaring sea and tides, and they won't know what to do.

dag: Ŋuna ka n ti yɛn nya ka o baɣi ma, ka n nina ti nya o, ka pa ni so yaha. N suhu kul yɛla di zuɣu.
en: whom Ill see myself— my eyes see, and not a strangers. I am utterly dejected.

dag: Dinzuɣu di simdi ka yi woligi biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn pa daɣiri ka chɛ bɛn nyɛ daɣiri ni noombihi shɛb bɛn pa daɣiri ka chɛ bɛn nyɛ daɣiri. Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ biŋkɔbigu bee noombil bee binshɛli n ni wuhi ni di nyɛla daɣiri la kpɛhi yimaŋ daɣiri ni.
en: So you must treat clean animals differently from unclean animals. You must also treat clean birds differently from unclean birds. Dont eat any of these unclean birds or animals or things that crawl on the ground. I have made these things unclean.

dag: Niriba maa daa yi ti nya ka sagbani maa ʒe suɣili maa dunol ni, sokam yiɣisirimi zan o suɣili dunol ni n-zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa n jɛmdi Naawuni.
en: When all the people saw the column of cloud standing at the tents entrance, they would all rise and then bow down at the entrances to their tents.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam saɣi deeg o yɛligu maa ni dihi tabili ni Naawuni nyɛla yɛlimaŋlilana.
en: But whoever accepts his message confirms by this that God is truthful.

dag: Jɔab min o mabia Abishai ni daa ku Abinɛr shɛm m-bala. O ni daa ku bɛ mabia Asahɛl Gibiɔn tɔb la ni zuɣu.
en: So Joab and his brother Abishai took revenge on Abner for killing their brother Asahel in the battle at Gibeon.

dag: O daa lan yɛli bia maa yaha, Kpaŋmina, niŋmi yomyom, di lan ʒiɛya. Di saha ka Jɔnatan bia maa daa pih o piɛma maa n-zaŋ ka o sanna.
en: Then he shouted, Hurry! Go get them. Dont just stand there. The boy picked up the arrows and brought them back to his master.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, dimbɔŋɔnim ŋmanila yɛm tuma din kpaŋsiri jɛmbu muɣisigu puuni mini ʒiri maŋsiɣisibutali ni niŋgbuŋ nahimbu, amaa di zaa yoli, di bi kuri buchi zaŋ chaŋ maŋgbaabu niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma tumbu puuni.
en: Obeying these rules may seem to be the smart thing to do. They appear to make you love God more and to be very humble and to have control over your body. But they don't really have any power over our desires.

dag: Ka Sool mini Izraɛlnim mi daa laɣim lo tɔbu chaŋ ti ti bɛ suɣa Ɛla Vinvamli ni n-doya ni bɛ tuhi Filistianim maa.
en: Saul and the Israelite soldiers also gathered together. Their camp was in the Valley of Elah. Sauls soldiers were lined up and ready to fight the Philistines.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawuni, ka kɔrinsi kana ti lu bɛ suɣa maa gbini luɣ shɛlikam zaa. N-daa yi biɛɣu asiba ka maligim lu suɣa maa shee.
en: In the evening a flock of quail flew down and covered the camp. And in the morning there was a layer of dew all around the camp.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ mini bɛ bidibisi n-daa su Naawuni jɛmbu duu dunoli maa fukumsi. Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiya ni bɛna n-daa nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dunɔguliba.
en: The gatekeepers and their descendants had the responsibility of guarding the gates of the Lord s house, the Holy Tent.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ di o shɛhira o ni tumdi ni nimmoo yi mini Laodisianim ni Hiɛrapolisnim zuɣu shɛm.
en: I know that he has worked hard for you and the people in Laodicea and in Hierapolis.

dag: Amaa ka Dauda niriba maa daa bɔh o, Nyama, ti na be Juda tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni ŋɔ ka dabiɛm mali ti mi, ka ti yi ti chaŋ Kɛila ni ti ti tuhi Filistia tɔbbihi ŋɔ, wula ka di lee yɛn be.
en: But David's men said, Look, even here in Judah we're afraid of the Philistines. We will be terrified if we try to fight them at Keilah.

dag: Ka ti Duuma daa yɛl o, Yinim Farisiinim paɣirila pipihi mini lahi nyaansi, amaa ka yi puuni lee pali ninvuɣ fabo mini ninvuɣ biɛtali.
en: So the Lord said to him, Now then, you Pharisees clean the outside of your cup and plate, but inside you are full of violence and evil.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam yɛli zoli ŋɔ, Yiɣisim a dooshee ŋɔ nti lu teeku ni ha, ka bi biɛhim o suhu ni, amaa ka niŋ yɛda ni o ni yɛli shɛm maa ni niŋ pali, o ni nya ka di shiri niŋ lala.
en: I assure you that whoever says to this mountain, Be lifted up and thrown into the sea—and doesnt waver but believes that what is said will really happen—it will happen.

dag: Di kalinli ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Salima taha pihita min anzinfa taha tuhili ni tahi shɛŋa pihitayinika.
en: Included among them were: large gold dishes; , large silver dishes; other dishes; gold bowls; silver bowls; and , other articles.

dag: Tiŋgban shɛŋa din be katiŋ mini Speen ŋarima ʒirila Naawuni niriba kulisirina. Bɛ zaŋla salima mini anzinfa pahi bɛ zuɣu na ni bɛ ti tibigi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni, ka nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ yuli, dama o chɛ ka yi nya jilima.
en: They are ships coming from distant lands, Bringing God's people home. They bring with them silver and gold To honor the name of the Lord , The holy God of Israel, Who has made all nations honor his people.

dag: Di saha ka Hushai daa yɛli Zadok mini Abiata bɛn daa nyɛ maligumaaniba la, Ahitɔfɛl ni yɛli Absalom mini Izraɛl kpamba shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, ka m mi yɛli ba shɛm m-bɔŋɔ.
en: At once, Hushai went to Zadok and Abiathar. He told them what advice Ahithophel had given to Absalom and to the leaders of Israel. He also told them about the advice he had given.

dag: Hal kabiɛlli bee wain din ni zaŋ ti mali sara Yawɛ jɛmbu duu gba kani. Maligumaaniba fabindimi, ka Yawɛ tumtumdiba gba fabinda.
en: The grain offering and the drink offering are gone from the LORDs temple. The priests and the LORDs ministers mourn.

dag: Nudirigu polo tintariga yɛn zaŋla Tama hal ni Mɛribatikadɛshi koma dooshee n-zaŋ nimaani hal ni Ijipti kulibɔŋ ni Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku ni. Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ nudirigu polo yaɣili.
en: On the south side, the border will go from Tamar all the way to the oasis at Meribah-kadesh. Then it will go along the Brook of Egypt to the Mediterranean Sea. This will be the southern border.

dag: Yɛl tibisili fukumsi n-ʒi n zuɣu zaŋ chaŋ sokam zaa polo: Bɛn mi biɛhigu soli mini bɛn ʒi biɛhigu soli ni bɛn mi gbaŋ mini bɛn ʒi gbaŋ.
en: It doesn't matter if people are civilized and educated, or if they are uncivilized and uneducated. I must tell the good news to everyone. That's why I am eager to visit all of you in Rome.

dag: Kɔra, a min a nyaandoliba maa zaa ni yɛn niŋ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is what must be done. Korah and your entire community: Take censers for yourselves.

dag: A biha ayi ŋɔ ŋmanila muli bɛba ayi, ka ŋmani saŋkpalima ayi bɛn ʒe paɣiviɛligakushihikom puuni ŋubira.
en: Your breasts are perfect; they are twin deer feeding among lilies.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ n kpiɔŋ ni n nyɔtaɣirigu; ka n niŋ o naani. Ka n nyari sɔŋsim, ka n suhu piɛla; ka n yiini yila paɣir o.
en: The Lord protects and defends me; I trust in him. He gives me help and makes me glad; I praise him with joyful songs.

dag: Bɛ ti ma dansi n yaaŋa zuɣu. Bɛ niŋ li la zaɣ wɔɣila kaman pukpara ni wɔriti vuɣisi shɛm la.
en: They beat me until I had deep cuts. My back looked like a freshly plowed field.

dag: Malaika maa ni daa yɛl o lala ka chaŋ naai, ka o bol o yiŋbih ayi mini tɔbbi so ŋun daa nyɛ wuntizɔra ka gul o sahakam la na.
en: Then the angel went away, and Cornelius called two of his house servants and a soldier, a religious man who was one of his personal attendants.

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ Jɔɔdɛn tooni tin shɛli din yuli booni Jɛriko, ka di be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo ka be Rubin zuliya tiŋgban ni la tinsi din yuya daa booni Bɛza ka di be tiŋgban pasi ni la mini Jaaza ni di momaha tiŋgbana zaa ti ba.
en: on the other side of the Jordan at Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, from the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the desert with its pasturelands, Jahzah with its pasturelands.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-zaŋ ba chaŋ tiŋgban nɛli ni.
en: I brought the family of Israel out of Egypt. I led them into the desert.

dag: bɛ ni yɛn yo ti sam shɛli nyɛla bɛ kana ni bɛ ti kari ti a ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ti ni ti su maa ni.
en: But see the kind of reward those people give us for not destroying them. They have come to force us out of your land that you gave to us.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Aai, di pa shɛli yi yi yɛn sib li, yi ni ti sib alikama maa gba pahi.
en: He answered, No, because when you pull up the weeds, you might also pull up the wheat.

dag: Bom yɛm, bom tɛhi zilima. Mira ka a tam bee n-zaŋ a ni wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa n noli ni bahi.
en: Get wisdom and insight! Do not forget or ignore what I say.

dag: A yɛm min a baŋsim maa ka a zaŋ bo buni ti amaŋa, ka laɣisi salima min anzinfa niŋ a daazichi duri ni.
en: Your wisdom and skill made you rich with treasures of gold and silver.

dag: Ka sapashin kpɛm maa daa chaŋ ti gbaai Pool ka yɛli ni bɛ lom o zoligɔnima ayi; di nyaaŋa ka o daa bɔhi ni o baŋ Pool ni nyɛ so min o ni tum shɛli.
en: The commander went over to Paul and arrested him. He told his soldiers to tie him up with two chains. Then he asked, Who is this man? What has he done wrong.

dag: Ka zuliya pam ti tim ya ŋɔ tiŋ puuni garita ka bɔhiri taba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka Yawɛ ti darigi tin titali ŋɔ nim tibili lala? .
en: People from many nations will pass by this city and ask each other: Why has the LORD treated that great city like this.

dag: Lala ka di simdi ni yidaannim gba yuri bɛ paɣiba kaman bɛ ni yuri bɛmaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ shɛm la. Ŋun yur o paɣa yurila omaŋa.
en: Thats how husbands ought to love their wives—in the same way as they do their own bodies. Anyone who loves his wife loves himself.

dag: Pashihur daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhili ni kɔbisiyi ni pihinahinaayopɔin.
en: of Pashhur .

dag: Ŋuna n-chɛ ka bɛ be ni alaafee, amaa ka o lee pa nina lihiri bɛ tuma.
en: God may let them feel secure, but they are never out of his sight.

dag: Yi ni ti yi nimaani gba n-kahi yi nuhi pa yi zuɣuri ni zɔna. Dama man Yawɛ zaɣisi yi ni niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb naani maa, ka yi ku tɔŋ bɛ sani.
en: So you will eventually leave Egypt too, and you will hide your face in shame. You trusted these countries, but the Lord rejected them, so they cannot help you win.

dag: A ŋmaag o bipolitali saha dabisa jia, ka chɛ ka o di vi.
en: You cut his life short. You shamed him. Selah.

dag: O dimnima n-leei bɛn su o; o dimnim maa kul tɔŋdimi, dama Yawɛ chɛ ka o nya wahala. O biriginsim din galisi zuɣu; o dimnim gbah o bihi chaŋ ti leei daba.
en: Her adversaries have become rulers; her enemies relax. Certainly the LORD caused her grief because of her many wrong acts. Her children have gone away, captive before the enemy.

dag: Bɛzai daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisita ni pisinaanahi.
en: the descendants of Bezai:.

dag: O tahigu maa vuri ni gili dunia luɣilikam, dama Yawɛ mini zuliya kam malila yɛtɔɣa. O ni kari ninsalinim zaa saria, ka zaŋ takɔbi ku bɛn mali taali. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The uproar is heard far and wide, because the LORD is bringing a lawsuit against the nations. Hes entering into judgment with all people, sentencing the guilty to death, declares the LORD.

dag: Lala ka o daa lan me omaŋmaŋ fɔntinsi zali. O daa mali niɣi mini piɛri pam, dama Naawuni daa ti o buni pam.
en: Besides all this, God gave him sheep and cattle and so much other wealth that he built many cities.

dag: Bia maa ni daa kul ŋmaligi naai, di daa bi yuui ka Dauda yi kuɣa maa lɔŋni na nti lu n-gbani n-zaŋ o nini kpa tiŋa, ka silim o zuɣu buta; ka bɛ va m-bibigi taba, ka kum niŋ taba. Dauda n-daa kum pam gari Jɔnatan.
en: As soon as the boy was gone, David came out from behind the mound and fell down, face on the ground, bowing low three times. The friends kissed each other, and cried with each other, but David cried hardest.

dag: A nina ni nya alahiziba binyara, ka a tɛha yɛtɔɣa gabi.
en: Wine will cause you to see strange things and to say things that make no sense.

dag: Ka Dauda paɣiba daa dɔɣi bidibisi ti o Hiburɔn; o bidib kpɛm sani n-daa nyɛ Amnɔn, o ma n-daa nyɛ Ahinɔam ŋun daa yi Jɛziriil na la.
en: These are Davids sons who were born at Hebron: The first son was Amnon. Amnons mother was Ahinoam from Jezreel.

dag: Nimaani ka yi ni ti jɛmdi wuna din nyɛ kuɣa mini dari, ka nyɛ ninsalinim ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali binshɛŋa, ka di ku tooi nya bee n-wum bee n-di bee n-wum nyom ŋɔ.
en: There you will have to worship gods made of wood and stone, and these are nothing but idols that can't see or hear or eat or smell.

dag: Yisa ni daa yɛli shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu daa chɛ ka Yɛhudianim noya lan woli.
en: The people took sides because of what Jesus had told them.

dag: N ni chɛ ka a kul nyɛ dabari sahakam, ka so ku lan ʒini a fɔntinsi ni yaha. Di saha ka a baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will make you desolate forever, and no one will live in your cities again. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Yɛhudianim bi be bɛ ko ka chɛ bɛn pa Yɛhudianima; kulla Duuma yino n-nyɛ bɛ zaa Duuma, ka o niŋdi alibarika din galisi n-niŋdi bɛnkam kuhiri boon o ni.
en: There is no distinction between Jew and Greek, because the same Lord is Lord of all, who gives richly to all who call on him.

dag: Nyini n-daa ti ma nyɛvili mini yurilim maŋli ka nyɛ ŋun guli n nyɛvili.
en: You have given me life and constant love, and your care has kept me alive.

dag: Amaa ka o tumtumda maa daa yɛl o, Nyama, Naawuni ninvuɣ gahindili be tiŋ ŋɔ ni ka bɛ tir o jilima pam. O yɛligu bi yiɣisira. Chɛ ka ti chaŋ o sani, di pa shɛli o ni tooi wuhi ti ti chandi ŋɔ ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm.
en: Wait! the servant answered. There's a man of God who lives in a town near here. He's amazing! Everything he says comes true. Let's talk to him. Maybe he can tell us where to look.

dag: Naawuni, nyini n-nyɛ n Naawuni, ka n kul bɔr a. N suhu zaa kul yɛla a zuɣu. N niŋgbuŋ luɣili pinaayi zaa kul bɔr a mi. Di bemi kaman tiŋgban kuŋ din chaɣisi ka kom ka nimaani la.
en: God! My God! Its you— I search for you! My whole being thirsts for you! My body desires you in a dry and tired land, no water anywhere.

dag: Yawɛ, yihim ma ʒirinim mini bɛn yɔhindi niriba nuu ni.
en: LORD, deliver me from lying lips and a dishonest tongue.

dag: Naa suhu yi ti piɛla, alaafee benimi. Ka o nirilim ŋmanila sagbana din tahiri siɣili saa na.
en: When the king is happy, life is better for everyone. When he is pleased, it is like a refreshing spring rain.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ! Kul paɣimiy o ʒiɛmani kam ni. Ami! Ami!.
en: Bless the LORD, the God of Israel, from forever to forever! Amen and Amen!.

dag: o daa yɛli ma mi, Daadam, n timd a la Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ duŋtaariba bɛn taai duŋ niŋ ma ŋɔ sani. Bɛ mini bɛ yaannim pun birigi n sani zaŋ na hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Ezekiel, I am sending you to the people of Israel. They are just like their ancestors who rebelled against me and refused to stop.

dag: N ni daa paai Troas ni n ti yihi Masia lahibal suŋ waazu, n Duuma daa mali soli ti ma.
en: When I went to Troas to preach the good news about Christ, I found that the Lord had already prepared the way.

dag: N yɛri ya mi ni zaadali Naawuni ni ti kari niriba saria yɛtɔɣ yo shɛŋa zaa bɛ ni tɔɣisi zuɣu;.
en: I promise you on the day of judgment, everyone will have to account for every careless word they have spoken.

dag: Sool gbaɣinɔʒiri maa ni daa nya ka Sool kpi maa, ka o gba lu o takɔbi zuɣu kpi m-pah o zuɣu.
en: When the armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he also impaled himself on his sword and died with Saul.

dag: A yurilim maŋli la puuni, deemi n suhigu. Yawɛ, dolimi n nyɛvili kaman a ni lo ma alikauli shɛm.
en: Show that you love me, Lord , and answer my prayer. Please do the right thing and save my life.

dag: Wula ka a yɛn tooi niŋ tuhi nyaŋ n dan sapashin bil yino gba, a yi du m-bala Ijiptinim ni bɛ ti a chɛchɛbunsi mini wɔribariba?.
en: How could you even defeat our lowest ranking officer, when you have to depend on Egypt for chariots and cavalry?.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi vihi baŋ ti tuumbiɛri maa? Ti lo yɛmbimbiɛri nia biɛɣu ŋɔ. Dama ninsal suhu ni tɛha zilim pam.
en: No one will discover our crime. We have the perfect plan! Yes, people can be very tricky and hard to understand.

dag: Di daa nyɛla kuɣa pinaayi, ka bɛ daa zaŋ chiriga n-chirigi Izraɛl bidibisi la yinoyino yuli pa kuɣili kam zuɣu, di daa ŋmanila nintu shɛŋa bɛ ni mali dihiri binyɛra zuɣu la, ka zuliya pinaayi la zuliya yini kam yuli pa kuɣili kam zuɣu.
en: Each of the twelve stones had engraved on it the name of one of the sons of Jacob, in order to represent the twelve tribes of Israel.

dag: Bɛn daa di li maa daa nyɛla kaman niriba tusaanahi laasabu.
en: There were about men who ate. After they ate, Jesus told them to go home.

dag: Ka Sɔdom naa maa daa yɛli Ibram, Zaŋm niriba ŋɔ ti ma, amaa ka mali nɛma ŋɔ zaa.
en: Then the king of Sodom said to Abram, Give me the people and take the property for yourself.

dag: Yi bi mi ni yi sandiriba maa ni ti yiɣisi libigi ya, ka bɛn ni chɛ ka yi ni sɔhigi yiɣisi? Di saha ka yi leei bɛ ni yɛn ʒe ninvuɣ shɛba.
en: But without warning, those you owe will demand payment. Then you will become a frightened victim.

dag: Nyamiya, tiŋgbɔŋ maa ka n zaŋ sɔŋ yi tooni maa, kpɛmiya di ni ti deei n ni daa po pɔri zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti yi yaannim Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu ni bɛ zuliya la.
en: Look, I am giving you this land. Go and take it. It is the land that I, the Lord , promised to give to your ancestors—Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I promised to give this land to them and to their descendants.

dag: A ni daa ku Sool so min o yiŋnim shɛba, ka di nam zan o zaani la biɛri ka Yawɛ bɔhir a, ka fa a nam maa ti a bia Absalom maa. Nyama a bahila yoli maa, dama a nyɛla ninvuɣ kura.
en: The Lord is punishing you because you killed people in Sauls family. You stole Sauls place as king. But now the same bad things are happening to you. The Lord has given the kingdom to your son Absalom, because you are a murderer.

dag: ka di nyɛla n daa zɔrila zama dabiɛm zuɣu bee n-zɔri ni niriba ti lihi ʒiɛm ma zuɣu, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka n fo n noli ka bi yi samban ni na.
en: I was never so afraid of what people might say or of making enemies that I kept my sins secret and avoided going out.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa chani gindi tiŋkpan shɛŋa din be Siizaria Filipai tiŋgbɔŋ ni; bɛ ni daa chani maa ka o ti bɔhi ba, Niriba lee yɛri ni n nyɛla ŋuni.
en: Jesus and his disciples went to the villages near the town of Caesarea Philippi. As they were walking along, he asked them, What do people say about me.

dag: O nam dibu yuma awɛi ni gol so ŋun pahiri pia biɛɣu pia dali, ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa zaŋ o tɔbbihi zaa kana ti liri Jɛrusalɛmnima. Bɛ daa teemi gil li, ka me bindura gil li ti tuui.
en: and so Nebuchadnezzar came with all his army and attacked Jerusalem on the tenth day of the tenth month of the ninth year of Zedekiah's reign. They set up camp outside the city, built siege walls around it.

dag: Di luhiya ni bɛ ŋmɛri naŋgbankpeen shɛli din ka nyɔri bee m-mali yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din ku niŋ ba zaɣ viɛlli?.
en: you would stop spreading all of this hot air.

dag: dama Naawuni bi zaŋla shia ŋun ni chɛ ka ti zɔri dabiɛm ti ti, amaa shi so ŋun ni chɛ ka ti mali yiko mini yurilim ni maŋgbibbu ka o zaŋ ti ti.
en: The Spirit God gave us does not make us afraid. His Spirit is a source of power and love and self-control.

dag: ka mali binyila tam di tarisi bunahi zuɣu, ka di mini di binyila maa zaa nyɛ zaɣ yini, ka yi ti niŋ daanya pa di zuɣu.
en: and make each of the four top corners stick up like the horn of a bull. Then cover the whole altar with bronze, including the four horns.

dag: Fomiya ti Duuma Yawɛ tooni, d amaa Yawɛ dabisili la miriya. Yawɛ niŋla sara maligu shili, o mal o ni boli ninvuɣ shɛba ka bɛ be kasi.
en: Be silent! I am the Lord God, and the time is near. I am preparing to sacrifice my people and to invite my guests.

dag: Ka Juda bidibisi daa nyɛ: Ɛr mini Onan ni Shɛla ni Pɛrɛz ni Zɛra, amaa ka Ɛr mini Onan daa kpi Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni; ka Pɛrɛz bidibisi daa nyɛ: Hɛzirɔn mini Hamul.
en: Judahs sons were Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah. Perezs sons were Hezron and Hamul.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba maa, Ŋunkam bɔri ni o doli ma, ŋun zaɣisim omaŋa ka kpuɣ o dapulli buɣi doli ma.
en: Then Jesus said to his disciples, All who want to come after me must sayno to themselves, take up their cross, and follow me.

dag: N nya yɛl biɛ shɛli dunia ŋɔ ni, ka di nyɛ din ʒi daadamnim zuɣu.
en: There is something else terribly unfair, and it troubles everyone on earth.

dag: bee n-kpuɣiri bɛ neem bihibihi. Amaa bɛ lee chɛ ka bɛ bebu kahigi wuhi ni bɛ nyɛla bɛn ʒe yim ni yɛlimaŋli ni be shɛb ni, ka di chɛ ka Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira ŋɔ yɛla wuhibu la nya jilima bɛ ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa puuni.
en: or steal from them. Instead, they must show that they are always good and faithful, so as to bring credit to the teaching about God our Savior in all they do.

dag: Hagai daa yɛliya ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Di ku yuui ka n dam zuɣusaa mini dunia ni teeku ni tiŋgbani;.
en: Soon I will again shake the heavens and the earth, the sea and the dry land.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ daba ayi ka Yawɛ lan yɛli ma, Cham Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni pumpɔŋɔ nti yihi n ni daa yɛl a ni a zaŋ jinjɛŋŋma shɛli ti sɔɣi nimaani la na.
en: Some time later the Lord said, Go back and get the shorts.

dag: Kaman bɛ nina ni biɛhigu ni daa nyɛ shɛm: Bɛ nina maa ni daa kul bemi kaman n ni daa nya shɛba Kɛba Mɔɣili duli la nina ni. Ka bɛ zaa yinoyino daa kul tuhi chana.
en: Their faces looked exactly like the faces I had seen by the Chebar River. Each creature moved straight ahead.

dag: Ka Judas ŋun daa yi Yisa nyaaŋa maa daa pun wuhi ba shihir shɛli yɛli, N yi ti kul puhi so ka mɔɣis o kpariŋ, ŋuna m-bala; yin gbaamiy o zaŋ o chaŋ.
en: Judas had told them ahead of time, Arrest the man I greet with a kiss. Tie him up tight and lead him away.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni zal li saha shɛli yi ti paai, Siria naa maa ni lan labina ti liri Ijiptinim yaha, amaa din yɛla ni ti be di ko.
en: At the time God has decided, the king of the north will invade the southern kingdom again, but this time, things will be different.

dag: tutuɣu daa na kani, ka binshɛli mi daa na bi bili yi tiŋgban ni na, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa bi chɛ ka saa mira, ka so mi daa kani kɔra;.
en: there were no plants on the earth and no seeds had sprouted, because he had not sent any rain, and there was no one to cultivate the land;.

dag: O ni ti taɣi bihi laamba suhuri ti bɛ bihi, ka taɣi bihi suhuri ti bɛ laamba din ni chɛ ka n ku kana ti yɛli noli niŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: He will lead children and parents to love each other more, so that when I come, I won't bring destruction to the land.

dag: Ka doo maa min o paɣa Awa daa laɣim ka o niŋ pua n-dɔɣi Keen ka yɛli, N nya ninsala Yawɛ sɔŋsim zuɣu.
en: Then Adam had intercourse with his wife, and she became pregnant. She bore a son and said, By the Lord 's help I have gotten a son. So she named him Cain.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ zaŋ bɛ nɛma pam n-zɔri ni bɛ du kulitihi kulibɔŋ tiligi.
en: The people go across the Valley of Willows, trying to escape with all their possessions.

dag: O daa lan wuh o bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ salima shɛm tariga mali Naawuni jɛma balibu kam salima lahi ni bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ anzinfa shɛm tariga mali Naawuni jɛma kam anzinfa lahi.
en: He told Solomon how much gold and silver was to be used in making the sacred objects.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim yi yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka ninvuɣ maŋli lan kani. Bɛ zaa domi gu ni bɛ ku niriba, ka zaŋ lansi gbahiri taba.
en: By this I mean that all the faithful people are gone. There are no good people left. Everyone is planning to kill someone. Everyone is trying to trap their brother.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ, a yi ku niriba ŋɔ zaa yim, di saha zuliya shɛb bɛn pun wum a yuli dubu la ni yɛli.
en: Now if you kill all your people, the nations who have heard of your fame will say.

dag: Amaa ka o daŋ ni nir maa ni ti kuhi yɛli dindali maa, N ku tooi leei yi tibira. N ka bindirigu bee binyɛrigu n yiŋa; yi ku zaŋ ma leei niriba zuɣulana.
en: But he will answer, Not me! I can't help you. I don't have any food or clothes either. Don't make me your leader.

dag: ka boli Lɔt m-bɔh o, Saamba bɛn kpe a yil ŋɔ yuŋ ŋɔ la lee be ya? Zaŋm ba na ka ti goli ba.
en: Where are the two men who came to you tonight? Bring them out to us. We want to have sex with them.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni yɛligu din daa kul maan chanila tooni pahira.
en: Meanwhile the word of God continued to spread and grow.

dag: Kpiimba biɛhigu shee nim malila shili ni bɛ deei Babilɔn naa. Bɛnkam zaa daa nyɛ nanim dunia ŋɔ ni yiɣisiya ni bɛ puh a. Bɛn zaa daa nyɛ zuliya shɛb nanim ni yiɣisi bɛ nam ʒiishɛhi puh a.
en: The world of the dead is getting ready to welcome the king of Babylon. The ghosts of those who were powerful on earth are stirring about. The ghosts of kings are rising from their thrones.

dag: Bɛ daa lan mali sunsuuni dapua din be dapaɣa maa pirigili zuɣusaa polo la, ka di zaŋ yaɣ yini hal ti paai yaɣ din la tariga.
en: The middle crossbar, set halfway up the frames, extended from one end of the Tent to the other.

dag: Samarianim daa bi tum a daalahichi ŋɔ pirigili, a tum din chihiri gari ba. Ka a ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa maa zuɣu chɛ ka a mabihi maa ŋmanila wuntizɔriba.
en: Samaria did not sin half as much as you have. You have acted more disgustingly than she ever did. Your corruption makes your sisters look innocent by comparison.

dag: O daa yɛli ba, N wumya ni kawana be Ijipti, chamiya nimaani nti da li ti ti na, ka ti tiligi ka ku kpi.
en: Ive just heard that theres grain in Egypt. Go down there and buy some for us so that we can survive and not starve to death.

dag: Di saha Izraɛl naa mini Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat daa yɛla bɛ alichɛbbanim ʒi bɛ nam ʒiishɛhi kabɔɣili din daa be Samaria dunɔdali gbin la ni ka anabinim maa zaa daa ʒe bɛ tooni n-tɔɣisiri ba anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: All this time, Ahab and Jehoshaphat were dressed in their royal robes and were seated on their thrones at the threshing place near the gate of Samaria, listening to the prophets tell them what the Lord had said.

dag: Ka tiŋgul maa daa boli naa n-yɛl o. Ka naa daa yɛli, Di yi nyɛ o kɔŋko n-zɔrina maa dindina o ʒirila lahibali na. Ka o daa ti zo m-mirina.
en: He called down and told the king, and the king said, If he is alone, he is bringing good news. The runner kept coming closer.

dag: O zaŋ m malibu chaŋ katiŋa ka chɛ ma, ka n leei sana bɛn daa mi ma la zaa sani.
en: He has distanced my family from me; my acquaintances are also alienated from me.

dag: O yi di be dunia ŋɔ ni, o naan ku nyɛla maligumaana hal baabiɛla, maligumaaniba bɛn zaŋdi pina maani maligu kaman Yɛhudianim zaligu ni wuhi shɛm ni beni la zuɣu.
en: If he were here on earth, he would not be a priest at all, because here the Law appoints other priests to offer sacrifices.

dag: Lala ka o yɛn bɔri piɛri mini chi ni kpam asiba kam ka di nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la m-pari taba.
en: The lamb, the flour, and the olive oil are to be offered to the Lord every morning forever.

dag: Ka hal bɛ dimnim yi gbahi ba kuli bɛ ya ka bɛ ti nyɛ daba, n ni chɛ ka be zaŋ takɔbi ku ba nimaani. N ni pa n nini lihiri ba n-niŋ ba zaɣ biɛɣu, ka pa ni zaɣ suŋ.
en: If they are captured and taken away by their enemies, I will command the sword, and it will kill them there. Yes, I will watch over them, but I will watch for ways to give them troubles, not for ways to do good things.

dag: Ti Naawuni a ku darigi bɛ tibili ti ti? Dama ti ka yiko din ni tooi tuhi salo pam bɛn kanna ni bɛ ti tuhi ti ŋɔ. Ti bi mi ti ni yɛn niŋ shɛm, amaa nyini ka ti kul lihira.
en: Our God, wont you punish them? We are powerless against this mighty army that is about to attack us. We dont know what to do, and so we are looking to you for help.

dag: Ka n tin ya suhudoo yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka yi ti dɔni tiŋa, ka so ku varisi ya. N ni ti yihi biŋkɔb biɛri tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka so ti ku lo tɔbu n-kpe yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: I will bless your country with peace, and you will rest without fear. I will wipe out the dangerous animals and protect you from enemy attacks.

dag: Anabi Jona ni daa nyɛ Ninivenim shihirili shɛm la, lala ka Daadam Bia gba nyɛ ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nim shihirili.
en: Just as Jonah became a sign to the people of Nineveh, so the Human Onewill be a sign to this generation.

dag: ka zaŋ noonsi gba zaɣ lɔri ayopɔin mini zaɣ nyama ayopɔin niŋ ŋariŋ maa ni n-gbib ba ka bɛ birili ku kpihim dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Also take seven pairs of every kind of bird with you. Do this so there will always be animals and birds on the earth.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛli, Bɛ ni zaɣisi n ni daa zali ba zaligu shɛŋa la dolibu, ka bi deei n noli.
