en: The Lord answered, It is because the people of Judah stopped following my teachings. I gave them my teachings, but they refused to listen to me. They did not follow my teachings.

dag: ka n chɛ ka a po Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni a ku kpuɣi n ni kana ti be Keenannim shɛb ni ŋɔ bipuɣiŋga n-ti m bia Yisahaku ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: in the name of the Lord , who rules heaven and earth, that you won't choose a wife for my son Isaac from the people here in the land of Canaan.

dag: Amiram bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Aduna mini Musa. Ka bɛ daa pii Aduna min o bidibisi ni bɛ su jɛmbu duu puuni neen kasi la fukumsi sahakam, ka tuɣindi tulaale zim tiri Yawɛ, ka tumd o tuma, ka lan zaŋd o yuli suhiri alibarika niŋdi niriba ni sahakam.
en: His oldest son, Amram, was the father of Aaron and Moses. Aaron and his descendants were set apart to be in charge of the sacred objects forever, to burn incense in the worship of the Lord , to serve him, and to bless the people in his name.

dag: N yi ti tim Aritimas bee Tikikus a sanna, nyin kpaŋm amaŋ ka n sanna Nikɔpolis, dama n loya ni m be nimaani kikaa saha.
en: When I send Artemas or Tychicus to you, try to come to me in Nicopolis, because Ive decided to spend the winter there.

dag: Siɣisimiya yimaŋ ti Duuma sani, ka o duhi ya.
en: Humble yourselves before the Lord, and he will lift you up.

dag: A nyina piɛlimi kaman bɛ ni chɛ piɛ nyaan shɛb kɔbiri ka su ba kom ka bɛ piɛli shɛm la. Zaɣ yini kam malila jaa, ka zaɣ yini bi pooi di ni.
en: Your teeth are whiter than sheep freshly washed; they match perfectly, not one is missing.

dag: n-chɛ ka o suhu ni daashiya zaa yi zahira. Ka di zuɣu ni chɛ ka o gban tiŋ jɛm Naawuni, ka yihi yɛli ni Naawuni shiri be yi sani.
en: their secret thoughts will be brought into the open, and they will bow down and worship God, confessing, Truly God is here among you.

dag: Suhimiya Naawuni Jɛrusalɛm suhudoo zuɣu yɛra, Chɛ ka bɛn yuri li tɔŋ.
en: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: May those who love you prosper.

dag: Ka Jɛrimia daa kul be yiliguliba dundɔŋ maa ni hal ni dahin shɛli bɛ ni daa ti ŋme n-deei Jɛrusalɛm.
en: And I was kept in the palace courtyard until the day Jerusalem was captured.

dag: Takɔriti kulis ata daa beni. Takɔriti maa daa tuhila taba, ka tam tab ʒii buta zuɣu.
en: Three rows of windows on each side faced each other.

dag: ni Sidɔnnim ni Amalɛknim ni Maɔnim ni daa nahindi ya, ka yi kum niŋ ma la, n daa bi fan ya bɛ nuu ni bahi?.
en: You cried to me when the people of Sidon, the Amalekites, and the Midianites hurt you. I also saved you from those people.

dag: Kum maa ni daa ti mii Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa saha shɛli, ka niriba daa kuhiri niŋdi Firawuna ni o tim ba bindira. Ka Firawuna daa yɛli Ijiptinim zaa, Chamiya Yisifu sani, o yi ti yɛli ya ni yi niŋm shɛli, yin niŋmiya li.
en: When the Egyptians began to be hungry, they cried out to the king for food. So he ordered them to go to Joseph and do what he told them.

dag: Ka Musa daa kɔrig o n-zaŋ o ʒim maa shɛli niŋ Aduna nudirigu polo tibinyaɣili min o nudirigu nubililɔɣu ni o nudirigu napombililɔɣu.
en: Moses slaughtered it, then took some of its blood and put it on Aarons right earlobe, on his right thumb, and on his right big toe.

dag: A tɛhiya ni nol ni yɛtɔɣa kɔŋko nyɛla tɔbutuhiri baŋsim mini kpiɔŋ din ni tooi tuhi tɔbu? Bee ŋuni ka a lee du m-ba ka zaɣisi n noli maa?.
en: Does he think he can plan and win a war with nothing but words? Who is going to help him, now that he has turned against the king of Assyria?.

dag: Ka yi ti sab li pa yi yinsi dunɔpaɣirisi zuɣu mini yi dunɔdaya zuɣu.
en: Write them on the door frames of your homes and on your town gates.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi suhuri kul yɛla binshɛŋa din be nimaani zuɣu, ka pa ni binshɛŋa din be dunia ŋɔ ni zuɣu.
en: Think only about what is up there, not what is here on earth.

dag: dama yi pun baŋ ti Duuma nirilim nyaɣisim ni nyɛ shɛm yɛla.
en: since you have tasted that the Lord is good.

dag: ka kɔŋlan so daa kana nti damd o tooni yɛra, N dana, a yi di saɣi, a naan chɛ ka n kɔŋ ŋɔ naai ka n kpe n tab ni.
en: Then a man sick with leprosy came to him. The man bowed down before Jesus and said, Lord, you have the power to heal me if you want.

dag: ka Bɛnaaya mini Jahaziɛl bɛn daa nyɛ maligumaaniba la mi nyɛ bɛn yɛn piɛbiri kikahi m-be Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa tooni.
en: and the priests Benaiah and Jahaziel blowing trumpets regularly before the chest containing Gods covenant.

dag: Lahibal suŋ ŋɔ zuɣu ka n nyɛ Masia tumo ŋun ʒe o zaani, ka bɛ lo ma zoligɔnim di zuɣu ŋɔ. Kul suhimiya Naawuni tiri ma ka n tooi mali suhukpeeni n-kul tɔɣisiri lahibal suŋ maa yɛla kaman di ni simdi ni n tɔɣisiri li shɛm.
en: For the sake of this gospel I am an ambassador, though now I am in prison. Pray that I may be bold in speaking about the gospel as I should.

dag: n-zaŋ li yɛrigi wuntaŋ mini goli ni saŋmarisi zaa ni, din nyɛ bɛ ni daa yuri binshɛŋa ka tumdi di tuma, ka dol li, ka jɛmdi li la, ka so ti ku lan va bɛ kɔba maa bee n-zaŋ li pi. Di ti kul yɛn dola tiŋgban ni kaman naɣibindi la.
en: who loved and worshiped the sun, moon, and stars. These bones will be scattered and left lying on the ground like trash, where the sun and moon and stars can shine on them.

dag: M mi na kul malila yaa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ kaman n ni daa mali yaa shɛm saha shɛli Musa ni daa tim ma maa. Ka n na kul mali yaa din ni tooi chaŋ ti tuhi tɔbu.
en: I'm just as strong today as I was then, and I can still fight as well in battle.

dag: Ka n daa niŋ kaman pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga n-wurim ba kpɛhi tinzun tinsi ni din nyɛ luɣ shɛli so ni bi mi ba. Ka tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ daa kpalim zani dabari, ka so bi lan kpɛri di ni gariti yira. Lala ka di daa niŋ ka tiŋgban suŋ maa ti leei so ni ka shɛl ni.
en: I will bring the other nations against them like a storm. They didnt know those nations, but the country will be destroyed after those nations pass through. This pleasant country will be destroyed.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa lo kpara m-mali shili zani Yawɛ tooni ni bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi tɔbu maa kalinli daa nyɛla kaman tuhi pihinahi laasabu n-chaŋ Jɛriko bɔpiɛligu ni.
en: About , soldiers, prepared for war, passed before the Lord . They were marching toward the plains of Jericho.

dag: ka yi ŋmaligi labi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani ka yi mini yi bihi ti deeg o noli ni yi suhuri zaa mini yi shihi zaa kaman n ni zaani ya shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: If you and your descendants will turn back to the Lord and with all your heart obey his commands that I am giving you today.

dag: Leeban daa chaŋla o piɛri kɔbiri chɛbu, ka Reechɛl daa zu n-kpuɣ o ba wuna.
en: Laban had gone to shear his sheep, and during his absence Rachel stole the household gods that belonged to her father.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba, Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu bɛn nyɛ ti yaannim la Naawuni n-ti o tumo Yisa jilima maa; Yisa so yi ni daa zaŋ tahi Gomna Pailɛt sani nti di o saria ka o daa bɔri ni o bah o ka yi zaɣisi la.
en: The God that Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and our other ancestors worshiped has brought honor to his Servant Jesus. He is the one you betrayed. You turned against him when he was being tried by Pilate, even though Pilate wanted to set him free.

dag: Piɛ yini daa malila fiig tiwal viɛla kaman fiig tiwal daŋda din mooi, amaa piɛ din la din daa malila fiig tiwala din bie pam, ka di biɛbu maa zuɣu chɛ ka so ku tooi di li.
en: One basket had very good figs in it, the kind that ripen early in the season. But the other basket had rotten figs. They were too rotten to eat.

dag: Nam ʒiishee maa daa malila dura diba ayɔbu, ka napɔna tambu shee din daa tuɣi nam ʒiishee maa nyɛ salima. Nam ʒiishee maa yaɣili kam daa malila nuhi pabu shee, ka bɛ daa mali gbuɣima ayi kɔtomsi n-zali baɣili nuhi pabu shee maa.
en: It had a gold footstool attached to it and armrests on each side. There was a statue of a lion on each side of the throne.

dag: N Duuma Naawuni, M paɣir a ni n suhu zaa, ka ni tibigir a yuli sahakam.
en: With all my heart I thank you. I praise you, Lord God.

dag: M bi ʒiini ninvuɣ yoya sani, bee ka m mini bilikɔɣinim ti mali jina ni taba.
en: I dont run around with troublemakers. I have nothing to do with hypocrites.

dag: Izraɛl anab shɛb tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa zaŋ chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm polo, ka nyari ʒiinima zaŋ chaŋ di suhudoo polo, ka suhudoo mi kani. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala ma.
en: All these things will happen to the false prophets of Israel. They speak to the people of Jerusalem and say there will be peace, but there is no peace. This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yɛl o, Doli ma, ka chɛ ka kpiimba sɔɣimi bɛ kpiin taba.
en: But Jesus said to him, Follow me, and let those who are dead bury their own dead.

dag: N yɛli ya la dimbɔŋɔnima ni di chɛ ka n suhupiɛlli be yi ni, ka yi suhupiɛlli maa yaɣi.
en: I have told you these things so that you can have the true happiness that I have. I want you to be completely happy.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n zuɣu kul ʒiɛla ya n-gari n dimnim bɛn gil ma. Ka n ni mali sara o jɛmbu duu, ka tahi suhupiɛlli tahigu; n ni yili yila n-niɣim n-lɔŋni paɣi Yawɛ.
en: You will let me defeat all my enemies. Then I will celebrate, as I enter your tent with animal sacrifices and songs of praise.

dag: Naawuni ŋun ni tooi gbibi ya ka yi ku lu, ka ni zaŋ ya tah omaŋmaŋ tooni din mali jilima shee ni suhupiɛlli, ka yi ku mali taali la.
en: God is strong and can keep you from falling. He can bring you before his glory without any wrong in you and give you great joy.

dag: ka Naomi yɛli ba, Labimiya kuli yi manim sani. Yawɛ ŋɔ niŋmi ya nirilim kaman yi ni niŋ m mini yi yidaannim bɛn kpi la nirilim shɛm la.
en: Naomi said to her daughters-in-law, Go, turn back, each of you to the household of your mother. May the LORD deal faithfully with you, just as you have done with the dead and with me.

dag: Bɛ zaa yinoyino gbib bɛ bidibbina bɛ nuhi ni n-ʒe n-gil naa, ka ŋunkam kani bɛ sanna, bɛn kum o. Naa yi ti chani luɣ shɛlikam, bɛn kul be o sani.
en: Make sure they follow him wherever he goes, and tell them to keep their swords ready to kill anyone who tries to get near him.

dag: Doo maa ni daa na kul ʒe n sani maa, ka n daa wum ka so tɔɣisiri ma yɛtɔɣa Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni na.
en: A man was standing next to me, but the voice that I heard came from inside the temple.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun mali tɛhi zilima suhu yɛla baŋsim zuɣu, amaa jɛrilim m-be jɛra noya ni.
en: Intelligent people want more knowledge, but fools only want more nonsense.

dag: Yi nyuri piɛri maa bihim, ka yɛri bɛ ni zaŋ piɛri kɔbiri wuɣi situr shɛŋa, ka kɔriti biŋkɔb pola bɛn mali kpam. Amaa yi bi dihiri piɛri.
en: You eat the fat sheep and use their wool to make clothes for yourselves. You kill the fat sheep, but you dont feed the flock.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yi ʒi yi ni suhiri shɛli maa. Yi ni ti tooi nyu binnyur shɛli din be m pipia la ni ka n yɛn nyu la? Ka tooi deei baptaizibu shɛli bɛ ni ti yɛn baptaizi ma la.
en: Jesus told them, You don't really know what you're asking! Are you able to drink from the cup that I must soon drink from or be baptized as I must be baptized.

dag: Biliɛɣu ku lan kpi nimaani bee ka ninkurigu ti kpi ka o saha na bi paai; dama nir yi ti niŋ yuun kɔbiga ka kpi, bɛ ni yɛli ni o nyɛla bipolli, ka so mi yi bi paai yuun kɔbiga ka kpi, bɛ ni yɛli ni noli n-di o.
en: No more will babies live only a few days, or the old fail to live out their days. The one who dies at a hundred will be like a young person, and the one falling short of a hundred will seem cursed.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Samsin paɣ maa ti do so ŋun daa nyɛ Samsin aŋgo zo.
en: So Samsons wife was given to his best man.

dag: Dama ti ku tooi niŋ din ni chihi yɛlimaŋli; faashee din kul ni doli yɛlimaŋli maa ka ti ni niŋ.
en: All we can do is to follow the truth and not fight against it.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa yɛl o, Paɣa, a yɛda galisiya pam! Di ni niŋ kaman a ni bɔri shɛm maa. Ka o bipuɣiŋga maa daa dii kpaŋ di saha maa.
en: Then Jesus answered, Woman, you have great faith! You will get what you asked for. And right then the womans daughter was healed.

dag: Teemiya n ni daa yɛli ya shɛm la, Ye dabili bi gar o duuma. Bɛ yi daa niŋ ma wahala, lala ka bɛ ni niŋ yi gba wahala; bɛ mi yi daa deei n noli, bɛ ni deei yi gba dini.
en: Remember what I told you, Servants arent greater than their master. If the world harassed me, it will harass you too. If it kept my word, it will also keep yours.

dag: Di saha ka n daa nya malaika so ka o ʒe wuntaŋa n-kuhiri pampam booni noonsi bɛn yiɣiri zuɣusaa ha yɛra: Laɣimmiya na nti di Naawuni ni tin ya bindir shɛli ŋɔ!.
en: I then saw an angel standing on the sun, and he shouted to all the birds flying in the sky, Come and join in God's great feast!.

dag: Bɛ daa dɔɣila dab paɣ bia maa kaman daadamnim ni dɔɣiri bia kam shɛm, ka daa dɔɣi bilichin paɣ bia maa mi alikauli lɔbu puuni.
en: His son by the slave woman was born in the usual way, but his son by the free woman was born as a result of God's promise.

dag: Ti Naawuni, ka pumpɔŋɔ wula ka ti lee yɛn yɛli dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa? Dama ti lan zaɣisi a zaligu shɛŋa.
en: Now, God, what can we say to you? We have stopped obeying you again.

dag: Ka o yɛl ba, Yi nyɛla vinnyaɣinima, dina n-chɛ ka yi yɛli, Chɛ ka ti chaŋ ti mali sara jɛm Yawɛ.
en: The king replied, You are lazy—nothing but lazy! That's why you keep asking me to let you go and sacrifice to your Lord .

dag: Niriba yi diri ʒiɛvari kɔŋko ka mali yurilim ni taba, di so ni niriba ŋubiri naɣ kpaba ka je taba.
en: A simple meal with love is better than a feast where there is hatred.

dag: Ka a yi yɛn suhi Naawuni, nyin di niŋdi kaman bilikɔɣinim ni niŋdi shɛm la, dama bɛ yuri ni bɛ zani bɛ jɛmbu duri ni mini sochira zuɣu n-suhiri Naawuni ni niriba nyari ba. Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, bɛn pun nya bɛ laara.
en: When you pray, don't be like those show-offs who love to stand up and pray in the synagogues and on the street corners. They do this just to look good. I can assure you that they already have their reward.

dag: Ka Dauda daa gbahi wɔribariba tuhili ni kɔbisiyopɔin mini tɔbbihi bɛn chani tiŋa tuhi pisi; ka daa yihi chɛchɛbunsi kɔbiga yuri zali ka chɛ n-chihi wɔr shɛb bɛn kpalim zaa jila.
en: David captured one thousand chariots, seven hundred charioteers, and twenty thousand foot soldiers. He cut the hamstrings of all but one hundred of the chariot horses.

dag: Ti ni daa lu soli chani Bashan saha shɛli ka Bashan Naa Ogi min o niriba zaa daa yina ti liri ti ni bɛ tuhi ti tɔbu Ɛdirɛi.
en: Next, we moved north toward the region of Bashan, and King Og came out with all his men to fight us near the town of Edrei.

dag: Ka Musa daa kpe sagbani maa ni n-du zoli maa zuɣu. Musa daa be zoli maa zuɣu la wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ biɛɣu pihinahi.
en: Moses entered the cloud and went up the mountain. Moses stayed on the mountain for forty days and forty nights.

dag: N kul malila suhupiɛlli a yɛligu zuɣu kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun ŋme n-di nɛma pam.
en: Im overjoyed at your word, like someone who finds great treasure.

dag: Di daa nyɛla kuɣa pinaayi, ka bɛ daa zaŋ chiriga n-chirigi Izraɛl bidibisi la yinoyino yuli pa kuɣili kam zuɣu, di daa ŋmanila nintu shɛŋa bɛ ni mali dihiri binyɛra zuɣu la, ka zuliya pinaayi la zuliya yini kam yuli pa kuɣili kam zuɣu.
en: and on each of them was engraved the name of one of the twelve tribes of Israel.

dag: Ka ŋunkam mali tahima ŋɔ kul maanila omaŋa m-be kasi kaman o ni be kasi shɛm.
en: This hope makes us keep ourselves holy, just as Christ is holy.

dag: ka zaɣisi n saɣisigunima, ka lihi ʒiɛm n ni kpahi yi zuɣu ni shɛm la zuɣu.
en: They didnt want my advice; they rejected all my corrections.

dag: Amaa ka Naa Hɛzɛkia daa niŋ karimbaani, ka bi wuh o wumpaɣibo ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni ni daa niŋ shɛm ti o maa polo. Dinzuɣu ka Naawuni suhu daa yiɣisi pam bah o mini Judanim ni Jɛrusalɛmnim zuɣu.
en: But Hezekiah was so proud that he refused to thank the Lord for everything he had done for him. This made the Lord angry, and he punished Hezekiah and the people of Judah and Jerusalem.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni tulila zaliŋ, ka bi tuli viɛnyɛliŋga ka mi bi mahi la zuɣu, n ni tuhi ya n nol ni bahi.
en: So because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, Im about to spit you out of my mouth.

dag: Bɛ bi tɛhiri bɛ suhuri ni yɛra, Chɛliya ka ti jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, ŋuna n-chɛ ka siɣili saa mini sheen saa mira bɛ mibu saha. Ŋuna n-zaani ti puri atam kpuɣibu saha tiri ti.
en: You refuse to say, Let's worship the Lord ! He's the one who sends rain in spring and autumn and gives us a good harvest.

dag: Farisiinim ni so daa ti boli Yisa ni o ka o yiŋ na ka bɛ ti laɣim di bindirigu; ka Yisa daa chaŋ o yiŋa nti ʒini bindirigu maa dibu shee ni bɛ di.
en: A Pharisee invited Jesus to have dinner with him. So Jesus went to the Pharisee's home and got ready to eat.

dag: Ka o daa dɔɣi Zimiran mini Jokishan ni Mɛdan ni Midian ni Ishibak ni Shua.
en: She gave birth to Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa pihi kuɣa m-me bimbini zali Naawuni ni daa tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa luɣ shɛli maa, ka booi wain mini kpam bahi di zuɣu ti Naawuni.
en: Jacob set up a memorial stone there. He made the rock holy by pouring wine and oil on it. This was a special place because God spoke to Jacob there, and Jacob named the place Bethel.

dag: Ka Yawɛ nuu daa pa n zuɣu, ka Yawɛ shia daa zaŋ ma ti zali vinvamli sunsuuni. Kɔba n-daa pali di ni.
en: The Lord s power came on me. The Spirit of the Lord carried me out of the city and put me down in the middle of the valley. The valley was full of dead mens bones.

dag: Ka biɛɣ daa neei ka bɛ daŋ yiɣisibu lo tab alikauli, ka Yisahaku daa chɛbisi ba ka bɛ kuli ni suhudoo.
en: They got up early in the morning, and they gave each other their word. Isaac sent them off, and they left peacefully.

dag: Ka o yiɣisi zani n-chani doli ba hal ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, ka kul gbaai chandi ka yiɣiri jɛmdi ka paɣiri Naawuni.
en: he jumped up, stood on his feet, and started walking around. Then he went into the Temple with them, walking and jumping and praising God.

dag: ka tim ti mabia Timoti yi sanna. O nyɛla Naawuni tumtumdi so ti min o ni laɣindi tumdi Masia lahibal suŋ waazu yihibu tuma la. Ti daa tim o mi na ni o ti kpaŋsi ya yi yɛda niŋbu puuni, ka kpam ya jaande.
en: while we sent Timothy, our brother who works with us for God in preaching the Good News about Christ. We sent him to strengthen you and help your faith.

dag: mani yi Duuma ni chɛ ka Asiria naa min o tɔbbihi zaa kana ti liri Judanima. Bɛ ni ti kana kaman Yufretiiz Mɔɣili kom din galisi ka mali kpiɔŋ pam m-pali hal ti puuri bahiri la.
en: Now I will send the king of Assyria against them with his powerful army, which will attack like the mighty Euphrates River overflowing its banks.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Samsin daa ti chaŋ Timna ti nya Filistia do so bipuɣiŋga;.
en: Samson went down to the city of Timnah. He saw a young Philistine woman there.

dag: O ku yihi tahima bee n-gbarigi, hal ka o ti wuhi zaligu soli ni nyɛ shɛm dunia ŋɔ ni, ka tin shɛŋa din be katinsi nim ti ʒiya guhir o wuhibu.
en: He will not lose hope or courage; he will establish justice on the earth. Distant lands eagerly wait for his teaching.

dag: Ka Yawɛ bɔh o, Tuun bɔ ka a lee tum maa? A tizo maa ʒim kukoli kuhigu n-yi tiŋgban ni ka n sanna.
en: Then the Lord said: Why have you done this terrible thing? You killed your own brother, and his blood flowed onto the ground. Now his blood is calling out for me to punish you.

dag: Amaa ka Naaman daa je suli ŋ-ŋmaligi chani ka yɛra, Man di mi ni o yɛn yimina nti zani n-suhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni maa, ka zaŋ o nuu gahigahi kpe, ka chɛ ka n kɔŋ maa naai.
en: Naaman became angry and left. He said, I thought Elisha would at least come out and stand in front of me and call on the name of the Lord his God. I thought he would wave his hand over my body and heal the leprosy.

dag: Ka di daa ti lu Vuhim Dabisili dali yaha ka Yisa lan kpe Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu ti wuhiri niriba, ka do so ŋun nudirigu bɔɣu kpi daa beni.
en: On another Sabbath Jesus went into a synagogue and taught. A man was there whose right hand was paralyzed.

dag: O ni daa paai nimaani, Ɛli daa ʒila o kuɣ zuɣu sɔnaŋgbanyee lihira, dama o suhu daa bi doya Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa zuɣu. Doo maa ni daa kpe tiŋ puuni nti moli lahibali maa, tiŋ maa nim zaa daa duhila kuŋa.
en: Eli was worried about the Holy Box, so he was sitting there by the city gate waiting and watching when the Benjamite man came into Shiloh and told the bad news. All the people in town began to cry loudly.

dag: Ka o daa lan ŋahi ba ŋaha ŋɔ yɛli, So ku saɣi zaŋ tan palli din na bi tiri liɣi binyɛr kurili, dama o yi niŋ lala, tan palli maa ni yaai di ko cheei ka chɛ binyɛr kurili maa, ka di maan chɛhi pahi.
en: When someone sews a patch over a hole in an old coat, they never use a piece of cloth that is not yet shrunk. If they do, the patch will shrink and pull away from the coat. Then the hole will be worse.

dag: Ka o ya kpamba maa mini ninvuɣ zuɣuri bɛn min o daa laɣim be tin yini maa ni daa niŋ kaman Jɛzibɛl ni daa sab gbana wuhi ba shɛm maa.
en: So the elders and important men of Jezreel obeyed the command.

dag: Ka puu maa atam kpuɣibu saha daa ti paai, ka o tim o yiŋbi so padiriba maa sani ni bɛ ti zaŋ o puu maa daatam shɛli ti o na.
en: When it was time, he sent a servant to collect from the tenants his share of the fruit of the vineyard.

dag: Ka o daa vaai yiɣisi n-lɛb lu tiŋa n-fo n-do paɣ maa naba ni. Paɣ maa naba maa ni ka o daa yiɣ lɛb lu. O ni daa yiɣ lɛb lu luɣ shɛli maa, nimaani ka o daa dii kpi.
en: At her feet he sank, fell, and lay flat; at her feet he sank, he fell; where he sank, there he fell—dead.

dag: Yinim bɛn be alizanda ni, paɣimiya Yawɛ, paɣimiy o o jilima min o kpiɔŋ zuɣu.
en: You, divine beings! Give to the LORD— give to the LORD glory and power!.

dag: nti yihiri lahibal suŋ waazu nimaani.
en: There they preached the Good News.

dag: Ti mabihi, suhimiya Naawuni tiri ti gba.
en: Friends, please pray for us.

dag: Nyama, Naawuni nya daliri jɛndi ma, ka kali ma pah o dimnim ni.
en: You claim that God has made you his enemy.

dag: O kɔba ŋmanila daanya mulima din mali yɔri, ka o gbaya min o bɔɣiri ŋmani kurimulima.
en: His bones are like bronze tubes, his limbs like iron bars.

dag: Ka ti daa labi ti nyaaŋa n-kpe tiŋgban nɛli maa ni zaŋ labi Teeku Ʒiɛɣu polo kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛli ma shɛm, ka ti daa baɣisi Ɛdom Zoli chana n-niŋ dabisi gbaliŋ.
en: Next, we turned around and headed back toward the wilderness along the Reed Sea road, exactly as the LORD instructed me. We traveled all around Mount Seir for a long time.

dag: N ni zaŋ azichi shɛli din be zibisim ni mini ashili shee ti a. Ka di chɛ ka a baŋ ni man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ m-bol a yuli.
en: I will give you hidden treasures of secret riches, so you will know that I am the LORD, the God of Israel, who calls you by name.

dag: Ka n ni ti ka nimaani na nti to piɛma ata kaman n zahimla binshɛli ka tɔr la.
en: On the third day I will shoot an arrow to the side of the mound as if aiming at a target.

dag: A wuntitali la zuɣu, yihim ma ka fa ma bahi. Wummi n suhigu ka tiligi ma.
en: You always do what is right, so come and save me. Listen to me and save me.

dag: Ka Babilɔn naa maa daa ku Zɛdɛkia bidibisi mini Juda kpambaliba zaa o ninni Ribila maa.
en: At Riblah he put Zedekiah's sons to death while Zedekiah was looking on and he also had the officials of Judah executed.

dag: Amaa n ni lan chɛ ka bɛ nya tibbu mini alaafee, ka tib ba, ka kahigi tɔŋsim pam mini binshɛŋa din ni taɣi ba barina ni wuhi ba.
en: but now I will heal and mend them. I will make them whole and bless them with an abundance of peace and security.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa boli nimaani yuli, Yawɛ ni tahi na. Ka niriba na kul booni li lala hal ni zuŋɔ. Yawɛ zol la zuɣu, ŋun Yawɛ ni tahi na.
en: Abraham named that place The Lord Provides. And even today people say, On the Lord 's mountain he provides.

dag: Ifriim nyɛla m biyurigu. O nyɛla n suhu ni yuri so pam. N yi kul galim o bushɛm, lala ka n lan teer o yɛla. Dinzuɣu m puu biɛri o zuɣu pam. Biɛhiŋ kani, n ni zo o nambɔɣu. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: People of Israel, you are my own dear children. Don't I love you best of all? Though I often make threats, I want you to be near me, so I will have mercy on you. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: M bihi, kul kpalimmiya be o ni pumpɔŋɔ, ka di chɛ ka o ti yi palo ka ti tooi mali suhukpeeni, ka ti ku tiri gbini n-zo o sani vi zuɣu o labbuna dali.
en: Children, stay one in your hearts with Christ. Then when he returns, we will have confidence and won't have to hide in shame.

dag: Chamiya ti du zoya zuɣu ŋ-ŋma dari na ti me n jɛmbu duu maa; ka n suhu paligi di zuɣu, ka lan nya jilima di ni.
en: But first, go to the hills and get wood for my temple, so I can take pride in it and be worshiped there.

dag: O nyɛla ŋun bɔri ni sokam zaa tiligi ka bɔhim baŋ yɛlimaŋli ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: God wants everyone to be saved and to know the whole truth, which is.

dag: Dinzuɣu zaŋmiya n yɛligu ŋɔ niŋ yi suhuri ni mini yi biɛhigu ni, zaŋmiya li lo yi nuhi ni ka di leei shihirili, ka zaŋ li lo m-pa yi gbɛri zuɣu kaman saba la.
en: Memorize these laws and think about them. Write down copies and tie them to your wrists and your foreheads to help you obey them.

dag: Ka ti daa ŋme n-deeg o fɔntinsi zaa di saha maa, ka bɛ ni me goma gili tin shɛli daa kani ka ti bi dee li bɛ sani. Di daa nyɛla fɔntinsi pihiyɔbu, Arigɔb yaɣili zaa mini Bashan din daa nyɛ Naa Ogi nam ʒiishee la.
en: At the same time we captured all his towns—there was not one that we did not take. In all we captured sixty towns—the whole region of Argob, where King Og of Bashan ruled.

dag: Ka Zɛbulɔn zuliya niriba daa bi kari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Kitirɔn bee ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Nahalol, ka Keenannim maa daa kpalim be nimaani pahi bɛ zuɣu; amaa ka bɛ daa lee muɣisiri ba ka bɛ tumdi tuma tiri ba.
en: Some Canaanites lived in the cities of Kitron and Nahalol. The people of Zebulun did not force those people to leave their land. They stayed and lived with the people of Zebulun. But the people of Zebulun made them work as slaves.

dag: O ni daa paɣi bɛ naba maa naai, ka o zaŋ o kparibu ye n-lab ti ʒini ka bɔhi ba, Yi baŋ n ni niŋ ya shɛm ŋɔ gbinni?.
en: After Jesus had washed their feet, he put his outer garment back on and returned to his place at the table. Do you understand what I have just done to you? he asked.

dag: Dinzuɣu di chɛliya ka dabiɛm mali ya, n ni gbib yi mini yi bihi. Lala ka o daa lan lo ba alikauli ka kpaŋsi bɛ suhuri.
en: Now, dont be afraid. I will take care of you and your children. So he put them at ease and spoke reassuringly to them.

dag: Tarim mini ŋun nahindi niriba zaa malila bin yini, Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun chɛ ka bɛ zaa nina ne.
en: In one way the poor and those who steal from them are the same—the Lord made them both.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Zuliya ayi m-be a pul maa ni. Niriba ayi ka a ti yɛn dɔɣi, ka bɛ ni ti woligi. Yino ni ti mali kpiɔŋ gari yino; ka kpɛm ni ti ŋmaligi jɛm biasani.
en: The Lord said to her, Two nations are within you; You will give birth to two rival peoples. One will be stronger than the other; The older will serve the younger.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Aai, di pa shɛli yi yi yɛn sib li, yi ni ti sib alikama maa gba pahi.
en: No, he answered, because as you gather the weeds you might pull up some of the wheat along with them.

dag: Ka Naomi daa yɛli Rut, M bia, a yi shiri chani Bɔaz puu maa ni nti yihiri kayiha maa, di so. Di pa shɛli ka a chaŋ so puu ni ka puu maa lan ti yih a halibiɛɣu.
en: Naomi replied, My daughter, it's good that you can pick up grain alongside the women who work in his field. Who knows what might happen to you in someone else's field.

dag: Amaa ka Musa daa suhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni maa yɛli, Yawɛ, bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi bahi a ni daa zaŋ a nuu din mali kpiɔŋ mini yiko n-yih a ninvuɣ shɛb Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na maa zuɣu?.
en: But Moses pleaded with the LORD his God, LORD, why does your fury burn against your own people, whom you brought out of the land of Egypt with great power and amazing force?.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa zaɣisi Samuɛl yɛligu maa wumbu ka yɛli, Aai! Ti bɔri ni ti mali naa ka o su ti.
en: The people would not listen to Samuel. No! they said. We want to be like other nations. We want a king to rule us and lead us in battle.

dag: Amaa Ɛhab kum nyaaŋa, ka Mɔab naa maa daa zaɣisi ni o ku lan niŋ lala ti Izraɛl naa.
en: But when Ahab died, the king of Moab broke away from the rule of the king of Israel.

dag: Sulemaana daa laɣim chɛchɛbunsi mini wɔribariba. O daa malila chɛchɛbunsi tuhili ni kɔbisinahi mini wɔribariba tuhi pinaayi, ka daa zaŋ chɛchɛbunsi maa shɛŋa zali tin shɛŋa ni, ka zaŋ di shɛŋa mi zali Jɛrusalɛm ŋun naa sani.
en: Solomon built up a force of fourteen hundred chariots and twelve thousand cavalry horses. Some of them he kept in Jerusalem and the rest he stationed in various other cities.

dag: Bɛ daa ku Hamɔr min o bia Shɛkɛm gba, ka zaŋ Daina Shɛkɛm yiŋa n-chaŋ bɛ chandi.
en: including Hamor and his son Shechem. Then they took Dinah from Shechem's house and left.

dag: Di saha ka Ayuba daa garigi yɛli.
en: Then Job said.

dag: Ka Neetan daa yɛli Dauda yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa min o ni nya shɛli ʒii maa ni zaa.
en: Nathan told David exactly what the Lord had said.

dag: O daa lan yɛl o, Mani n-nyɛ a yaannim Naawuni. Mani n-nyɛ Ibrahimma Naawuni; mani n-nyɛ Yisahaku Naawuni; mani n-nyɛ Yaakubu Naawuni. Di saha ka Musa daa pɔb o nina, dama o daa zɔrila dabiɛm ni o yuuni Naawuni.
en: I am the God who was worshiped by your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Moses was afraid to look at God, and so he hid his face.

dag: N yi ti kuhi bol a dahin shɛli, n dimnim maa ni ŋmaligi zo. Dama m mi ni nyin Naawuni be m polo.
en: The day I call to you, my enemies will be turned back. I know this: God is on my side—.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyamiya, kom yi nuzaa polo zɔrina ni di ti leei kokpɛɣu. Di ni ti lim tiŋgbɔŋ maa n-tabili binshɛlikam din be di ni, ka lim tiŋ maa ni bɛn be di ni. Niriba ni ti kum pam, ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba zaa ti fabili.
en: He said: Look! Waters are rising in the north and will rush like a river in flood. They will cover the land and everything on it, cities and the people who live there. People will call out for help; everyone on earth will cry bitterly.

dag: Bɛn nyari nahiŋgu mini nandaamba ni be di ni chani gindi ka mali bɛ naba nɔri li.
en: The feet trample it, the feet of the poor, the steps of the needy.

dag: Yawɛ bela alizanda ni, ka lihiri dunia ŋɔ ni na n-nyari ninsalinim zaa.
en: The Lord looks down from heaven and sees all of us humans.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni ti ku ninvuɣ biɛri la tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka darigi yihi bɛn bi ʒe yim di ni.
en: if you do wrong and can never be trusted, you will be rooted out.

dag: Lala ka Asiria naa ti yɛn gbahi Ijiptinim leei daba, ka gbahi Itiɔpianim ninkura mini bipola n-zaŋ ba bɛ zaɣim ni bɛ napɔn zaŋa, ka bɛ gbina do palo ni, n-kuli o yiŋa, ka di dihi Ijiptinim vi.
en: Everyone in these two countries will be led away naked and barefoot by the king of Assyria. Young or old, they will be taken prisoner, and Egypt will be disgraced.

dag: Ti yab Ibrahimma daa nyɛla yuun kɔbiga nira, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o niŋgbuŋ gbarigi zaa, ka o paɣa Zara daa nyɛ paɣiŋoo, amaa di zaa yoli, o daa bi chɛ ka o yɛda gbarigi di zuɣu.
en: Abraham was almost a hundred years old, so he was past the age for having children. Also, Sarah could not have children. Abraham was well aware of this, but his faith in God never became weak.

dag: Ka Liya bɔh o, A ni fa n yidan maa nyɛla yɛli bila? Ka a lan bɔri ni a fa n ŋmaankpihiga gba pahi? Ka Reechɛl yɛl o, Kpɛm o sani zuŋɔ yuŋ ŋɔ a bia ŋmaankpihiga maa zuɣu.
en: Leah answered, You have already taken away my husband. Now you are trying to take away my sons flowers. But Rachel answered, If you will give me your sons flowers, you can sleep with Jacob tonight.

dag: O tiri bɛn zɔr o bindirigu; o bi tamd o daalikauli yɛla.
en: God gives food to those who honor him. God remembers his covenant forever.

dag: Yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ nyaaŋa zaŋ chaŋ kaman daba anii dali ka Yisa daa zaŋ Pita mini Jɔn ni Jeemsi pah omaŋ zuɣu n-du zo shɛli zuɣu ni o ti suhi Naawuni.
en: About eight days after Jesus said these things, he took Peter, John, and James, and went up on a mountain to pray.

dag: Tumo ni daa kana ti yɛl o, Bɛ zaŋ naa bidibisi maa zuɣuri na, o daa yɛlimi, Zaŋmiya li sɔŋ duya ayi tiŋ ŋɔ dunol ni hal ka biɛɣu ti neei.
en: When Jehu was told what had happened, he said, Put the heads in two piles at the city gate, and leave them there until morning.

dag: Amaa n daa kul pii ya mi kaman wain ti viɛlli bira la n-zaŋna ti sa, ka bɔzuɣu ka yi taɣi n-lee mɔɣu ni wain tia?.
en: I planted you like a choice vine from the very best seed. But look what you have become! You are like a rotten, worthless vine.

dag: Chɛ ka Izraɛlnim bɛn kpalim ti bɛ suɣa gbilligbilli zalizali.
en: The Israelites will make their camps in separate divisions. Everyone must camp near their family flag.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri bi nyari nyɔri zaɣ maŋli, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn biri wuntitali nyari laara maŋli.
en: The wicked earn false wages, but those who sow righteousness receive a true reward.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa da tiŋgbani Hamɔr ŋun daa nyɛ Shɛkɛm ba la bihi sani anzinfa laɣibaligu kɔbiga n-ti o suɣa zali nimaani.
en: He bought the field where he camped from the family of Hamor, father of Shechem. He paid pieces of silver for it.

dag: A ni bɔr a ba yiŋ la zuɣu ka a yiɣisi zɔri maa, ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a zu n-kpuɣi n wuna.
en: I know that you left because you were so anxious to get back home, but why did you steal my household gods.

dag: A yi yɛn niŋ shɛlikam, nyin di niŋ li o nyaaŋa, ka o chɛ ka a soya tuhi.
en: Always let him lead you, and he will clear the road for you to follow.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa mali hal ti zooi, ka Yawɛ be o sani, ka chɛ ka o yɛtɔɣa zaa nyɛ yɛlimaŋli.
en: As Samuel grew up, the Lord was with him and made come true everything that Samuel said.

dag: Duhimiya yi zuɣuri lihi zuɣusaa. Ŋuni n-lee nam saŋmarisi? Ŋuna ŋun zali ba zaɣ bɔbili maa mi bɛ kalinli, ka mi bɛ zaa yuya. O yaa ni o yiko ni galisi zuɣu, o na ʒi n-kali pooi bɛ ni so.
en: Look up to the skies. Who created all those stars? Who created all those armies in the sky? Who knows every star by name? He is very strong and powerful, so not one of these stars is lost.

dag: Ka n daa nya ka paɣ maa nyu Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda mini bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛba Yisa dolibu zuɣu la ʒim n-kuli. N ni daa nya o lala maa, ka di niŋ ma alahiziba pam.
en: I saw that the woman was drunk. She was drunk with the blood of Gods holy people. She was drunk with the blood of those who told about their faith in Jesus. When I saw the woman, I was fully amazed.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Ŋun pun su kom bi lan bɔr o luɣ shɛli polo paɣibu n-naɣ pahila o naba, dama o ni zaa pun viɛlimi. Ka yɛli ba, Yi zaa ha viɛla, kul gbaai yihila yi ni yino.
en: Jesus responded, Those who have bathed need only to have their feet washed, because they are completely clean. You disciples are clean, but not every one of you.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔshua daa yɛli maligumaaniba, Kpuɣimiya Alikauli Adaka maa m-be niriba maa tooni chana. Ka bɛ daa kpuɣi Alikauli Adaka maa m-be niriba maa tooni chana.
en: Then Joshua said to the priests, Lift up the covenant chest. Go along in front of the people. So they lifted up the covenant chest and went in front of the people.

dag: Yumiya taba kaman mabi yinsi la, ka timiya tab jilima viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Love each other like the members of your family. Be the best at showing honor to each other.

dag: Ka Naa maa yɛli, Amaa n nya ka niriba anahi n-lɔrigi be buɣim maa sunsuuni chani ginda, ka shɛli bi niŋ ba; ka ŋun pah anahi maa ŋmanila wuni.
en: He replied, Look! I see four men, unbound, walking around inside the fire, and they arent hurt! And the fourth one looks like one of the gods.

dag: Buɣim mini nyɔhi ni chilibi din daa yiri yuri maa noya ni maa na n-daa nyɛ alɔbo diba ata din ku daadamnim pirigibu ʒii buta puuni yim la;.
en: One third of all people were killed by the three terrible troubles caused by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ma, Di zaŋ binshɛɣu n-tabili limsi anabitali yɛligu din be litaafi ŋɔ ni, dama saha miriya.
en: And he said to me, Do not keep the prophetic words of this book a secret, because the time is near when all this will happen.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnim zaa: Gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin maa biɛɣ pinaanu dali, zaŋmiya daba ayopɔin m-puhi Naawuni chuɣu din nyɛ suɣa tibu chuɣu la.
en: Tell the Israelites: On the th day of the seventh month is the Festival of Shelters. This festival to the Lord will continue for seven days.

dag: Yinim bɛn zaa gariti ŋɔ, yi baɣa kani? Lihimiya nya, so suhugarigu na mi m-paai n suhugarigu ŋɔ? Suhugarigu shɛli din paai ma, ka nyɛ Yawɛ ni zaŋ shɛli ti ma o suhu ni daa yiɣisi pam dahin shɛl la.
en: Look at me! she cries to everyone who passes by. No one has ever had pain like mine, Pain that the Lord brought on me in the time of his anger.

dag: ni Jɛturi ni Nafish ni Kɛdɛma. Ishimail bidibisi ni daa nyɛ shɛba m-bala.
en: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These were Ishmaels sons.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli, Biɛhiŋ kani, tiŋ maa ni zo ma dabiɛm, ka deei saɣisigu, ka ku tam n ni niŋ li shɛlikam zaa la yɛla. Amaa ka bɛ suhuri kul yɛmi ni bɛ chɛ ka bɛ tuma zaa nyɛ tuumbiɛri.
en: I said, Surely, she will fear me; she will take instruction so that her habitation wont be cut off because of everything I did to her. However, they rose early to corrupt their deeds.

dag: Ka Musa mini Aduna daa chaŋ ti kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni. Bɛ ni daa ti yi suɣili maa ni na, bɛ daa suhila alibarika niŋ niriba maa ni; ka Yawɛ jilima daa yi zahira niriba maa zaa sani.
en: He and Moses went into the sacred tent, and when they came out, they gave the people their blessing. Then the Lord appeared to the people in all of his glory.

dag: N ni tumdi Naawuni so tuma ni n suhu zaa o Bia lahibal suŋ tuma ni la di ma shɛhira ni n suhiri Naawuni tiri ya sahakam.
en: God has seen how I never stop praying for you, while I serve him with all my heart and tell the good news about his Son.

dag: Ka Halɔhɛshi bia Shallum ŋun gba daa nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm yaɣili pirigili polo naa la min o bipuɣinsi daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu.
en: Next to them Shallum, Halloheshs son, ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, made repairs, along with his daughters.

dag: Maligumaaniba daŋ bɛn daa yi Babilɔn n-lab kuli maa kalinli m-bɔŋɔ: Jɛdaya — kɔbisiwɛi ni pisopɔinnaata.
en: This is the list of the priestly clans that returned from exile: Jedaiah - Immer - , Pashhur - , Harim - .

dag: Ka yi yi ti wum ka bɛ yɛli ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ fɔntiŋ shɛŋa tin ya ni yi be di ni la tin yin ni.
en: After the Lord your God gives you towns to live in, you may hear a rumor about one of the towns.

dag: Bɛ ni mɔɣisi sapaɣ lɔɣu; gariŋga zilinli ni ku ba.
en: They will die from the fangs of poisonous snakes.

dag: Duumanima, yi gba niŋmiya yi daba lala, ka chɛ ba dabiɛm kpɛhibu, dama yi mi ni yi mini ba zaa Duuma be alizanda ni, ka o mi bi yaai so yuri ka chɛ so.
en: Masters, in the same way, be good to your slaves. Dont say things to scare them. You know that the one who is your Master and their Master is in heaven, and he treats everyone the same.

dag: A tiŋguliba ŋmanila sakɔri, ka a zaligubaŋdiba ŋmani toli bɛn galisi ni yi tabili gariche di ni maha pam dahin shɛli, ka wuntaŋ ti nyee, ka bɛ yiɣi chaŋ, ka so bi mi bɛ ni chaŋ luɣ shɛl la.
en: Your guards are like grasshoppers, your marshals like swarms of cicadas that encamp on stone fences on a chilly day; when the sun rises, they take flight; no one knows where they have gone.

dag: O kɔr o biŋkɔbiri, ka zaŋ o wain gabi taba, ka mali bindira dibu shili zali.
en: She has cooked meat, mixed wine, and put food on the table.

dag: Ka di lahibali daa ti nti to Jɔab, dama Jɔab daa nyɛla ŋun ʒe Adɔnija nyaaŋa hal o ni daa bi ʒe Absalom ŋun nyaaŋa la zaa yoli. Ka ŋun Jɔab daa zo n-chaŋ Yawɛ Jɛmbu Duu nti gbaai sara maligu bimbini binyila gbibi.
en: Joab had supported Adonijah, but not Absalom. But when Joab heard what happened to Abiathar, he was frightened and ran to the tent of the Lord to hold onto the horns of the altar.

dag: Ka gomna Rɛhum gba mini Shimshai ŋun daa nyɛ bɛ yaɣili maa polo gbaŋŋmar la daa sab gbaŋ ti Naa Atazɛrikisɛs zaŋ chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm yɛla polo. Bɛ ni daa sab yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Also Rehum, the governor, and Shimshai, the secretary of the province, wrote the following letter to Emperor Artaxerxes about Jerusalem:.

dag: Ka Yuria bia Mɛrɛmɔt ŋun daa nyɛ Hakɔz yaaŋa la daa mali me Ɛliashib yiŋ dunoli maa shee hal ti paai o yiŋ maa tariga m-pan o zuɣu.
en: After him, Meremoth, Uriahs son and Hakkozs grandson, repaired another section from the door to the back of Eliashibs house.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa pii niriba maa zuliyazuliya n-zali gooni maa nyaaŋa Palɔni naɣilima ni mini paliyari ni, ka bɛ gbibi takɔbiri mini kpana ni tɔbiri.
en: So I armed the people with swords, spears, and bows, and stationed them by clans behind the wall, wherever it was still unfinished.

dag: Pɛriʒianim mini Itiɔpianim ni Putinim be bɛ sani. Bɛ zaa gbibila nyɔtaɣiri bihi, ka pili kuriti zuɣupila.
en: Soldiers from Persia, Ethiopia, and Put will be with them. They will all be wearing their shields and helmets.

dag: A suhuyiɣisili puuni ka a daa no tiŋgbani. A sujee puuni ka a daa du n-tam zuliya shɛb zuɣu no ba.
en: In your furious anger, you trampled on nations.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun mali tɛhi zilima suhu yɛla baŋsim zuɣu, amaa jɛrilim m-be jɛra noya ni.
en: Intelligent people want to learn, but stupid people are satisfied with ignorance.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yɛli Jɔab mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be o sani maa zaa, Darimiya chahi yi situra, ka zaŋ buri so n-kum Abinɛr kuli. Ka Naa Dauda daa doli kum adaka maa nyaaŋa.
en: Then David ordered Joab and his men to tear their clothes, wear sackcloth, and mourn for Abner. And at the funeral King David himself walked behind the coffin.

dag: ni di chɛ ka o yihi ba kpaŋa, ka bɛ chɛ bɛ tuumbiɛri, ka yihi ba karimbaani ni.
en: God speaks to make them stop their sinning and to save them from becoming proud.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan ti o bɛ ni zaŋ fiig tihi wala m-pahi mali mahi shɛŋa mini wain wal kuma yila ayi. O ni daa di n-naai ka o nini neei, dama o daa bi di shɛli bee n-nyu kom wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ dabisi muna ata.
en: some dried figs, and two handfuls of raisins. This was the first time in three days he had tasted food or water. Now he felt much better.

dag: Bɛ yi ti yɛn kpe, di simdi ni bɛ mini naa kpe, ka bɛ yi ti lan yɛn yi, di simdi ni bɛ min o yi.
en: The ruler should be there among the people. When the people go in, the ruler will go in with them, and when they go out, the ruler will too.

dag: Bɛ mi ma ka di yuui, ka hal bɛ yi ni saɣi tɔɣisi yɛlimaŋli, bɛ mi ni n daa doli Farisiinim daadiini soli din dolibu kpɛm pam la.
en: These Jews have known me for a long time. If they want to, they can tell you that I was a good Pharisee. And the Pharisees obey the laws of the Jewish religion more carefully than any other group.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa baɣisi mɔɣu maa tariga zaŋ kpa Nɔba mini Jɔgbɛha wulimpuhili polo nti lu bɛ tɔbbihi maa zuɣu, dama tɔbbihi maa daa bi mali shili gu.
en: Gideon and his men used Tent Dwellers Road, which is east of the cities of Nobah and Jogbehah and attacked the enemy at Karkor. The enemy army did not expect the attack.

dag: Ka o tizo daa gbib o napɔŋkpaa n-dol o yina; ka bɛ daa bol o mi yuli Yaakubu. Yisahaku daa nyɛla yuun pihiyɔbu nira saha shɛli Ribɛka ni daa dɔɣi jahi maa.
en: Immediately afterward, his brother came out gripping Esaus heel, and she named him Jacob. Isaac was years old when they were born.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa yiɣisi Rɛfidim chaŋ ti paai Sinai tiŋgban nɛli maa ni. Bɛ daa ti bɛ suɣa dɔnila tiŋgban nɛli maa ni. Bɛ daa ti bɛ suɣa maa la Sinai Zoli gbini.
en: They traveled from Rephidim, came into the Sinai desert, and set up camp there. Israel camped there in front of the mountain.

dag: Jɛhoyakim ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sabi di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛŋa bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafinim la ni.
en: The other things that Jehoiakim did are written in the book, The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: Bɛ chanila bɛ zaɣim, ka ka situra, ka ʒiri kabɔba, ka kum mali ba.
en: The poor go around naked, without clothes, carry bundles of grain while hungry.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, Kpahimmiya fiig tia: Yi yi ti kul nya ka di wula puhiri va mama, di saha yi baŋya ni siɣili miriya.
en: The fig tree teaches us a lesson: When its branches become green and soft, and new leaves begin to grow, then you know that summer is very near.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ chɛli ma, ka n yiɣisi n suhu bahi bɛ zuɣu n-ku bɛ zaa. Amaa nyin ŋuna, n ni chɛ ka a zuliya yɛligi n-niŋ zuliya titali.
en: Now, don't try to stop me. I am angry with them, and I am going to destroy them. Then I will make you and your descendants into a great nation.

dag: ni piɛlahi gbana din niŋ moonsi ni teeku ni biŋkɔb bal shɛb gbana ni gɔpiɛliga dari.
en: tanned ram skins; fine leather; acacia wood;.

dag: Aduna bihi ni ŋun mali niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu bee ʒim ni yiri so ni mir ka o di bin yɛr kasinim la, faashee o ti yi daɣiri ni. Ŋunkam ti shihi bin shɛli din nyɛ daɣiri ka di nyɛla kpima ka o shihi bee do so ŋun dɔbilim yi o tooni na.
en: If any of Aarons descendants has a serious skin disease or a discharge, he cannot eat the holy food until he becomes clean. This rule is for any priest who becomes unclean. That priest can become unclean from a dead body or from his own semen.

dag: Di lan simdi ni a pii kpambal shɛb ka bɛ su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tuma fukumsi, ka bɛ ti laɣim bindira pirigibu bunu puuni yim zuɣu zali bindira ni ti yɛn niŋ pam yuma ayopɔin shɛŋa puuni la.
en: Then appoint some other officials to collect one fifth of every crop harvested in Egypt during the seven years when there is plenty.

dag: ka zaŋ tahili la zali Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa mini sara maligu bimbin la sunsuuni n-niŋ kom niŋ di ni.
en: Put the washbasin between the meeting tent and the altar and put water in it.

dag: Ka o daa garigi yɛl o, Aai, m biɛli, di zaŋ kiŋkansi doli ma, dama tuuni ŋɔ na ʒi n-tum Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, di tum jɛrilim tuuni ŋɔ.
en: But she said to him, No, my brother! Dont rape me. Such a thing shouldnt be done in Israel. Dont do this horrible thing.

dag: Nɛr daa nyɛla Kish ba, ka Kish nyɛ Sool ba. Sool daa nyɛla Jɔnatan mini Malikishua ni Abinadab ni Ɛshibaal ba.
en: Ner was Kishs father. Kish was Sauls father, and Saul was the father of Jonathan, Malki Shua, Abinadab, and Esh Baal.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ti yɛn bɛ suɣa wulimpuhili polo kaman di ni simdi ni bɛ ʒiishee nyɛ luɣ shɛli n-nyɛ: Juda zuliya. Juda niriba maa toondana n-yɛn nyɛ Aminadab bia Nashɔn.
en: The flag of the camp of Judah will be on the east side, where the sun rises. The people of Judah will camp near its flag. The leader of the people of Judah is Nahshon son of Amminadab.

dag: O daa chɛ ka teeku pirigi ka chɛ ka bɛ siɣi di ni gari, o daa chɛ ka kom laɣim ti dɔni kaman kunkuni la.
en: He split the Red Sea and led the people across. The water stood like a solid wall on both sides of them.

dag: Di chaŋya ti tuhi Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ yi mabihi maa. Labimiya kuli, n sani ka din niŋ maa yina. Ka bɛ daa wum Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa ka lab kuli kaman Yawɛ ni daa shiri yɛli ba shɛm maa.
en: Say to them, The Lord says that you must not go to war against your brothers. Everyone, go home! I made all this happen. So all the men in Rehoboams army obeyed the Lord . They went home, just as the Lord had commanded.

dag: Bɛ bihi ka o daa zaŋ zali bɛ zaashee n-chɛ ka Jɔshua guni ba maa. Bɛ ni daa bi guni ba sol ni la zuɣu n-chɛ ka bɛ daa nyɛ bɛn na bi guni maa.
en: Joshua circumcised their children, the ones the LORD had set in their place. They were uncircumcised because they hadnt been circumcised on the way.

dag: yɛli, Doo ŋɔ daa yɛliya ni o mali yiko din ni tooi wurim Naawuni jɛmbu duu la, ka lan me li daba ata sunsuuni.
en: who said, This man said, I can destroy Gods temple and rebuild it in three days.

dag: Ŋunkam mali ansarisimaana n-zali dɛde, o kpa turi. Ŋunkam kpahi ninvuɣ biɛɣu zuɣu ni ni nya daŋa.
en: Correct a worthless bragger, and all you will get are insults and injuries.

dag: Ka Saimɔn yɛl o, N dana, ti sa pun lab li mi yuŋ la zaa ka bi gbaai hal zin yino gba; amaa a ni kul yɛli ma shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu, n ni lab li.
en: Simon answered, Master, we worked hard all night trying to catch fish and caught nothing. But you say I should put the nets into the water, so I will.

dag: Deem pina maa bɛ sani n-zaŋ ba ti Lɛvinima kaman sokam tuma ni nyɛ shɛm, ka bɛ zaŋ ba tum suɣili maa ni tuma.
en: Take these from them and use them for service in the meeting tent. Give them to the Levites according to their duties.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ tiŋ ŋɔ ni daazichi zaa mini di nyamma zaa ni di binshɛɣukam zaa din mali anfaani ni Juda nanim daazichi zaa niŋ bɛ dimnim nuu ni, ka bɛ ŋme n-di li n-zaŋ li kuli Babilɔn.
en: I will also let their enemies plunder all the wealth of this city and seize all its possessions and property, even the treasures of the kings of Judah, and carry everything off to Babylonia.

dag: Di pa shɛli Onɛsimus daa yi a sani n-zomi ni o yi kpaŋ biɛla, ka ti lan lab a sanna n-yipa ti beni sahakam.
en: It may be that Onesimus was away from you for a short time so that you might have him back for all time.

dag: Di yuuni maa siɣili saha ka Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa timna ti gbaag o kuli Babilɔn ka daa zaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu neen viɛla pahi kuli, ka zaŋ Jɛhoyakin mabia Zɛdɛkia leei Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm naa zal o zaani.
en: When spring came, King Nebuchadnezzar took Jehoiachin to Babylonia as a prisoner and carried off the treasures of the Temple. Then Nebuchadnezzar made Jehoiachin's uncle Zedekiah king of Judah and Jerusalem.

dag: Daadam ŋun mali bahigu ŋɔ ni tooi be tibi gari Naawuni? Daadamnim ni tooi be kasi gari ŋun nam ba?.
en: Can anyone be righteous in the sight of God or be pure before his Creator?.

dag: Niriba maa ni da n-gili tiŋgbɔŋ maa puuni ni tahima kalinsi, ka kum wum ba. Kum din yɛn wum ba maa mini bɛ suhuyiɣisili maa puuni, bɛ ni tu bɛ naa mini bɛ wuni. Bɛ ni ti kpuɣi bɛ zuɣuri lihi zuɣusaa.
en: They will go around in great pain and will become so hungry that they will angrily curse their king and their gods. And when they try to find help in heaven.

dag: Ka so ku tooi zaŋ o nyɔɣu yo a hal ni a nyɛvili tariga. N ni be a sani kaman n ni daa be Musa sani shɛm la. N ku chɛ ka a ti bɔri ma ka bi nya ma, m mi ku chɛ a.
en: Joshua, I will always be with you and help you as I helped Moses, and no one will ever be able to defeat you.

dag: So dini n-lee kuni neesim ni woligiwoligi luɣ shɛli bee wulimpuhili polo pɔhim ni yɛligiri gindi dunia ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛli polo?.
en: What is the way to the place where light is divided up; the east wind scattered over earth?.

dag: A ni daa tim ma dunia ŋɔ ni na shɛm, lala ka n gba tim ba.
en: I sent them into the world, just as you sent me into the world.

dag: Ka ti Duuma malaika daa ti kpe duu maa ni na, ka neesim neei duu maa puuni zaa; ka malaika maa daa chaŋ ti kpahi Pita luɣili n-neeg o yɛli, Yiɣisim yomyom! Ka zoligɔnim din daa lo o nuhi la surigi lu tiŋa.
en: Suddenly an angel from the Lord appeared, and light flashed around in the cell. The angel poked Peter in the side and woke him up. Then he said, Quick! Get up! The chains fell off his hands.

dag: Ka daba ayɔbu dali bɛ ni tooi pihi daba ayi dibu tariga na ti duɣi.
en: Every day the people will gather only enough food for one day. But on Friday, when the people prepare their food, they will see that they have enough food for two days.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Jɛriko naa, Nyama, Izraɛlnim shɛb ka kpe na yuŋ ŋɔ ni bɛ ti puɣisi nya ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni be shɛm.
en: But someone told the king of Jericho, Last night some men from Israel came to look for weaknesses in our country.

dag: Amaa ti Duuma yi saɣi, di ku yuui ka n ka yi sanna; ka n yi ti kana, n ni baŋ bɛn duhiri bɛmaŋ maa ni mali shɛli, ka di pala bɛ ni yɛli shɛm kɔŋko, amaa bɛ yiko gba ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: But, if the Lord is willing, Ill come to you soon. Then I wont focus on what these arrogant people say, but Ill find out what power they possess.

dag: Yi malila nina din bi nyara? Ka mali tiba din bi wumda? Ka yi bi lan teei yaha?.
en: You have eyes—can't you see? You have ears—can't you hear? Don't you remember.

dag: Ka o daa bi tooi baŋ o, dama o nuhi daa malila kɔbiri ŋ-ŋman o biɛli Iso nuhi. Ka o daa yɛn niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni.
en: And so Isaac blessed Jacob, thinking he was Esau.

dag: N dimnim kul yɛri ma la zilima dabisili kam puuni; ka bɛn maani ma ansarisi zaŋ n yuli leei turi.
en: My enemies insult me all the time. They make fun of me and use me as an example in their curses.

dag: A ni ti leei bɛ ni maani so ansarisi mini bɛ ni turi so, ka di leei saɣisigu mini dabiɛm zuliya shɛb bɛn gil a la sani saha shɛlikam, ka darigi a tibili pam. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: When I am angry and furious with you and punish you, all the nations around you will be terrified. They will look at you with disgust and make fun of you.

dag: N kul ni yiini yila yɛr a yɛligu yɛla, dama a zaligunim zaa nyɛla din tuhi.
en: and sing about your promise, because all your teachings are what they ought to be.

dag: Di daba anu dali ka o daa ti daŋ yiɣisibu asibaasi ni o kuli, ka paɣ maa ba maa lan yɛl o, Niŋm suɣilo suug a noli, ka chɛ ka di bii na pɔi ka a naanyi chaŋ. Ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa laɣim ʒini di.
en: Then, on the fifth day, the Levite got up early in the morning. He was ready to leave. But the womans father said to his son-in-law, Eat something first. Relax and stay until this afternoon. So they both ate together again.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli niriba maa, Di zɔriya dabiɛm, dama Naawuni kamina ni o ti zahim ya, dina n-nyɛ ni o chɛ ka dabiɛm be yi suhuri ni ka yi ku tum alahichi.
en: Moses replied, Don't be afraid; God has only come to test you and make you keep on obeying him, so that you will not sin.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa bi kali Lɛvinim pahi Izraɛlnim kalinli ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun zali Musa shɛm la.
en: Moses obeyed the Lord and did not count the Levites with the other Israelites.

dag: dama yi daazichi ni be shɛli, nimaani ka yi suhuri gba ni be.
en: Your heart will be where your treasure is.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa kpe Maika yiŋ ti kpuɣi dari binnani mini tan shɛli din ŋmani mukuru ni binnan bihi ni anzinfa binnani maa, ka maligumaana maa bɔhi ba, Tuun bɔ ka yi lee tumdi maa.
en: when these five entered Micahs sanctuary and took the sculpted image, the priestly vest, the divine images, and the molded image. The priest said to them, What are you doing.

dag: Ka Jɔab mini Chɛrɛtinim ni Pɛlɛtinim ni wɔɣira zaa daa pahi Abishai zuɣu ka bɛ yi Jɛrusalɛm chaŋ ni bɛ ti biɛhi Bikiri bia Shiiba maa naba.
en: So Joab took the Kerethites and Pelethites and the other soldiers with him and left Jerusalem to chase after Sheba son of Bicri.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim yi yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka ninvuɣ maŋli lan kani. Bɛ zaa domi gu ni bɛ ku niriba, ka zaŋ lansi gbahiri taba.
en: No one is loyal to God; no one does right. Everyone is brutal and eager to deceive everyone else.

dag: Amaa nyin Yawɛ n-su nam sahakam. A nam kul ʒiɛla ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: But you, LORD, will rule forever; your throne lasts from one generation to the next.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔnatan daa lo Dauda alikauli, dama o daa yur o mi kaman o ni yur omaŋ shɛm la.
en: Jonathan loved David as much as himself, so they made a special agreement.

dag: Ti daalahichi galisiya nyaŋ ti, amaa ka a chɛ li paŋ ti.
en: on account of their sins. Our faults defeat us, but you forgive them.

dag: N ni zaŋ azichi shɛli din be zibisim ni mini ashili shee ti a. Ka di chɛ ka a baŋ ni man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ m-bol a yuli.
en: I will give you the wealth that is stored in secret places. I will give you those hidden treasures. Then you will know that I am the Lord , the God of Israel, who calls you by name.

dag: Amaa hal ni pɔŋɔ, yi na ʒi n-zaŋ n yuli suhi shɛli; dinzuɣu suhimiya, Naawuni ni tin ya, ka yi suhuri pali suhupiɛlli.
en: You have not asked for anything in this way before, but now you must ask in my name. Then it will be given to you, so you will be completely happy.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa kana ti lu n-gbani Ilaisha naba ni n-zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa, ka kpuɣ o bia maa yi.
en: Then the Shunammite woman went into the room and bowed down at Elishas feet. Then she picked up her son and went out.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni wuh a so shɛli a ni yɛn doli; n shiri ni wuh a a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm ka gul a.
en: I will instruct you and teach you about the direction you should go. Ill advise you and keep my eye on you.

dag: Bɛ duhimi bɛ yee paɣi Naawuni, ka zaŋ takɔbiri din mali noya ayiyi gbibi.
en: Praise God with songs on your lips and a sword in your hand.

dag: Ka di lan nyɛla kom din daa nyɛ kokpɛɣu la ka Naawuni daa zaŋ saɣim tuuli dunia la.
en: and it was also by water, the water of the flood, that the old world was destroyed.

dag: Bɛ yi yɛl a, Kamina ti pahi ti zuɣu, chɛ ka ti dɔni gu n-ku so, ka chɛ ka ti liri bɛn ka taali.
en: when they say, Come on! Let's gang up and kill somebody, just for the fun of it!.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ daa na bi mi o, amaa lala zuɣu ka n daŋna nti baptaiziri niriba kom ni ni o ti yi palo ka Izraɛlnim baŋ o.
en: I did not know who he would be, but I came baptizing with water in order to make him known to the people of Israel.

dag: Naawuni chɛ ka a nini nya a yaansi. Naawuni tim Izraɛlnim suhudoo!.
en: May you live long enough to see your grandchildren. Let's pray for peace in Israel!.

dag: N ni daa ŋmahi bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu dihi niriba tusaanu la, piɛr ala ka yi daa lee laɣisi di zaɣ chɛhi pali? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Piɛri pinaayi.
en: I divided five loaves of bread for people. Remember how many baskets you filled with pieces of food that were not eaten? The followers answered, We filled twelve baskets.

dag: Doliya duno muɣiliŋga kpe, dama so shɛli din kuni bahi yoli shee dolibu be asama ka di dunoli yɛlima, ka niriba pam dol li.
en: Go in through the narrow gate. The gate to destruction is wide, and the road that leads there is easy to follow. A lot of people go through that gate.

dag: Bɛ loya ni bɛ yihi ma la dunia ŋɔ ni, amaa m bi zaɣis a zaligunim maa.
en: Theyve almost wiped me off the face of the earth! Meanwhile, I havent abandoned your precepts!.

dag: Dama Yawɛ daa pun yɛli Musa.
en: because the Lord had said to Moses:.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ malaika daa yɛli Ilaija, Dol o chaŋ ka di zɔr o dabiɛm. Ka Ilaija daa yiɣisi dol o chaŋ naa sani ti yɛl o.
en: Then the LORDs messenger said to Elijah, Go down with him. Dont be afraid of him. So Elijah set out to go with him to the king.

dag: Abija tuun shɛŋa din pahi min o yɛtɔɣa ni o tuma zaa, bɛ sabi li niŋ anab Iddo yɛlikura litaafi ni.
en: Everything Abijah said and did while he was king is written in the records of Iddo the prophet.

dag: N tiŋ kasi maa ŋmanila paɣ so ŋun dɔɣi ka bi wolisi.
en: Have you ever heard of a woman who gave birth to a child before having labor pains?.

dag: Ka a ti she binyɛr shɛŋa din be kasi ti a mabia Aduna din ni nyɛ o jilima min o nachiinsi binyɛra.
en: Make Aaron some beautiful clothes that are worthy of a high priest.

dag: Dinzuɣu sum kom n-niŋ tulaale niŋ a ni, ka zaŋ a situr suma so n-chaŋ o ni be luɣ shɛli yeeni o chi maa. Amaa di chɛ ka o baŋ ni a be nimaani hal ka o ti di ka nyu n-naai.
en: You should bathe, put on some perfume, wear nice clothes, and then go down to the threshing floor. Dont make yourself known to the man until he has finished eating and drinking.

dag: N kɔre daa bi kpe yi ni so daanzinfa bee salima bee situra ni.
en: I have not wanted anyone's silver or gold or clothing.

dag: Ka Naawuni ŋun nyɛ suhudoo ni yiri so sanna ŋɔ ni chɛ ka di ku yuui ka yi du n-tam Sintani zuɣu n-no m-bɔr o. Ti Duuma Yisa Masia daalibarika kpalimmi be yi ni!.
en: The God who brings peace will soon defeat Satan and give you power over him. The grace of our Lord Jesus be with you.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb zaa Juda n-zaŋ ba kuli Babilɔn la yi ti yɛn yɛli noli ti so, bɛ ni yɛli, Yawɛ niŋm a kaman Babilɔn Naa ni daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ Zɛdɛkia mini Ɛhab she buɣim ni shɛm la.
en: Because of them, all the Judean exiles in Babylon will use this curse: The LORD make you like Zedekiah and Ahab, who were burned alive by the king of Babylon.

dag: Amaa ka Lɔt daa bi lɛbira, ka Yawɛ daa zo ba nambɔɣu n-chɛ ka malaikanim maa gbah o min o paɣ ni o bipuɣins ayi maa nuhi ni n-vo ba yihi tiŋ maa tariga ti zali.
en: He hesitated, but because the LORD intended to save him, the men grabbed him, his wife, and two daughters by the hand, took him out, and left him outside the city.

dag: O ni ti zaŋ o ni woligi shɛb kaman piɛri la zal o nudirigu polo, ka zaŋ o ni woligi shɛb mi kaman buhi la zal o nuzaa polo.
en: He will put the righteous people at his right and the others at his left.

dag: dama nir yi sabi wuh o yubu ni nyɛ shɛm zali, di bi tumdi tuma o yi na be o nyɛvil ni.
en: This is because a will takes effect only after a death, since its not in force while the one who made the will is alive.

dag: Naa Asa ni daa di nam ka di ti paai yuun pihitanaayɔbu saha shɛli, ka Izraɛl Naa Baasha daa kana ti liri Judanima, ka me goma gili Rama ni di chɛ ka so ku tooi yi Juda Naa Asa tiŋgban ni bee n-kana ti kpe di ni.
en: In the thirty-sixth year of Asas rule, Israels King Baasha attacked Judah and fortified Ramah to prevent Judahs King Asa from moving into that area.

dag: Di saha ka malaikanima ayopɔin shɛb bɛn daa mali kikah ayopɔin la niŋ shili ni bɛ piɛb bɛ kikahi maa.
en: Then the seven angels who held the seven trumpets got ready to blow them.

dag: Amaa ka Sool daa zaŋ kpani to o ni o ku o; di saha ka Jɔnatan daa baŋ ni o ba shiri loya ni o ku Dauda.
en: But Saul threw his spear at Jonathan and tried to kill him. So Jonathan knew that his father wanted very much to kill David.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Amɔn sɔɣ omaŋmaŋ gbal shɛli din daa be Yuza puu la ni. Ka o bia Jɔsia daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Amon was buried in his grave at the Garden of Uzza. His son Josiah became the new king.

dag: Ka o daa ti yɛl o ba, Wɛi, n zuɣu n-yaara, n zuɣu n-yaara! Ka bia maa ba yɛl o tumtumdi so, Zaŋm bia maa kuli ti ti o ma.
en: Suddenly he cried out to his father, My head hurts! My head hurts! Carry the boy to his mother, the father said to a servant.

dag: Yɛlima, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Di ni baai? O ku darigi vuɣi di mini di nyaɣa, ka di wala pooi ka kuui ka chɛ ka di va maha paligi? Di pala nuu din mali kpiɔŋ bee tɔbbihi pam ka bɛ yɛn bona ka bɛ ti sibigi di mini di nyaɣa.
en: Say, The LORD God proclaims: Will it thrive? Wont he tear out its roots, strip its fruit, and cause all the leaves of its branches to wither? It will dry up, and no one will need a strong arm or a mighty army to uproot it.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa niŋ alibarika pam niŋ Ayuba ni dabisa shɛŋa din daa bahindi nyaaŋa maa ni n-gari o ni daa pun niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni shɛm piligu ni la. O daa malila piɛri tuhi pinaanahi mini laakumnim tusaayɔbu ni naɣilahi tusaayi ni bunnyama tuhili.
en: Then the LORD blessed Jobs latter days more than his former ones. He had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, one thousand yoke of oxen, and one thousand female donkeys.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ Sool min o bia Jɔnatan kɔba maa na nti laɣisi bɛ ni ku shɛb maa kɔba m-pahi di zuɣu.
en: David took the bones of Saul and Jonathan and also gathered up the bones of the seven men who had been hanged.

dag: ni daanya sara maligu bimbini la mini di daanya kurupooti ni di dapuhi ni di zuɣu nɛma zaa ni tahili la ni di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛli zuɣu.
en: the bronze altar with its bronze grating, its poles, and all its equipment; the washbasin and its base;.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim ni nya alibarika pam, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔri ni o nya buni yomyom ku yi tibidarigibo ni.
en: God blesses his loyal people, but punishes all who want to get rich quick.

dag: Di wuhir o ni daa di nam shɛm min o kpiɔŋ ni binshɛŋa din daa niŋ o mini Izraɛlnim zaa zaŋ tabili dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa yɛla.
en: Those writings tell all about what David did as king of Israel. They tell about Davids power and what happened to him and to Israel and to all the kingdoms around them.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, Nir yi yuri ma, o ni doli n yɛligu, ka m Ba ni yur o, ka ti ni ka dilan sanna ka ti min o ti laɣim be.
en: Jesus answered, Whoever loves me will keep my word. My Father will love them, and we will come to them and make our home with them.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, Yi yi ti nya ka Sirianim maa yɛn nyaŋ ma, yin zomiya n kuŋa, ka m mi yi ti nya ka Ammɔnnim maa yɛn nyaŋ ya, n ni zo yi kuŋa.
en: If the Arameans prove too strong for me, you must help me, and if the Ammonites prove too strong for you, Ill help you.

dag: Di kul tuɣituɣila taba kirikiri, ka so ku tooi woligi li.
en: They all are fastened so firmly together that nothing can ever pull them apart.

dag: Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba, Biriginsim din ni kpɛhi nir alahichi ni ku chɛ, amaa mbusim be ŋun chɛ ka o kpee birigi tum alahichi zuɣu!.
en: Jesus said to his followers, Things will surely happen that will make people sin. But it will be very bad for anyone who makes this happen.

dag: Kpambal so ŋun mali yɛm, ŋuna ka naa yura, amaa kpambal so ŋun tumdi vi tuma, o suhu yiɣisirimi bahir o zuɣu.
en: The king favors an insightful servant, but is furious at a shameful one.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ yuli din mali jilima ŋɔ. Jɛmmiya Yawɛ ni jilima din be kasi.
en: Praise the Lord and honor his name! Worship the Lord in all his holy beauty.

dag: Firawuna chɛchɛbunsi min o tɔbbihi zaa ka o zaŋ niŋ teeku ni, ka o sapashin kpɛma zaa shim Teeku Ʒiɛɣu ni.
en: Pharaohs chariots and his army he hurled into the sea; his elite captains were sunk in the Reed Sea.

dag: N ni zaŋ suhu palli tin ya, ka zaŋ shi palli niŋ yi ni. N ni yihi yi suhu din be ka kuɣili ŋɔ yi ni, ka zaŋ suhu balli niŋ yi ni.
en: I will give you a new heart and a new mind. I will take away your stubborn heart of stone and give you an obedient heart.

dag: Ti zaɣisi dinkam tahiri vi na mini yɔhiŋgu tuma; ka zaɣisi yɛmbimbiɛri tuma, ka mi bi zaŋdi yɔhiŋgu kpɛhiri Naawuni yɛligu ni. Amaa yɛlimaŋli wuhibu puuni ti zaŋ timaŋ wuhi sokam bɛ suhuri ni tɛha ni ni ti dolila din tuhi Naawuni sani.
en: We don't do shameful things that must be kept secret. And we don't try to fool anyone or twist God's message around. God is our witness that we speak only the truth, so others will be sure we can be trusted.

dag: Ka yi yi lihi zuɣusaa nya wuntaŋa mini goli ni saŋmarisi ni zuɣusaa binyara zaa, yin miriya ka yi damdi tiŋa n-jɛm li ka di chɛ ka yi birigi. Di nyɛla binshɛŋa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni zaa.
en: And when you see the sun or moon or stars, don't be tempted to bow down and worship them. The Lord put them there for all the other nations to worship.

dag: Ti Duuma Naawuni ŋun nyɛ suhudoo ni yiri so sanna ŋɔ kpalimmi be yi zaa sani. Ami!.
en: The God who gives peace be with you all. Amen.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ; Niŋmiya tuuba, ka chɛ yi buɣa ŋɔ jɛmbu, ka zo n-yi din chihiri la tumbu ni.
en: Now then, tell the Israelites what I, the Sovereign Lord , am saying: Turn back and leave your disgusting idols.

dag: Yawɛ, bɔ saha ka di kul yɛn be lala? A suhuyiɣisili kul yɛn beni la sahakam? A nyuli zabbu suhuyiɣisili maa yɛn dirimi kaman buɣim la?.
en: Lord , will you be angry with us forever? Will your strong feelings continue to burn like a fire?.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka Lɛhi tiŋgban ni vinvamli tahi bɔɣi, ka kom yi di ni na, ka Samsin nyu ka o ni maai, ka o kpiɔŋ lan labina yaha. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli kɔbili nini maa yuli Ɛnhakɔr. Ka di na kul be Lɛhi hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: Then God opened a hollow place in the ground there at Lehi, and water came out of it. Samson drank it and began to feel much better. So the spring was named Hakkore; it is still there at Lehi.

dag: Ka o daa bol o yidana n-yɛl o, Chɛ ka tumtumdi yino zaŋ bun yino ti ma na, ka n chaŋ yomyom ti nya Naawuni nir ŋɔ ka labina.
en: She called to her husband and said, Please send me one of the servants and a donkey. Then I will go quickly to get the man of God and come back.

dag: Maligim maa ni daa ti vuui, ka Izraɛlnim maa nya ka binkpil bihi piɛla yɛrigi tiŋgban ni zaa.
en: When the layer of dew lifted, there on the desert surface were thin flakes, as thin as frost on the ground.

dag: A yiŋ bindira din galisi la ka bɛ dira; ka a tiri ba bin suma din be kaman mɔɣili kom din zɔra ka bɛ nyura.
en: We feast on the abundant food you provide; you let us drink from the river of your goodness.

dag: Izraɛl ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim ti ku lan tum tuumbiɛri, bɛ mi ti ku ŋma ʒiri, ka yɔhiŋ yɛtɔɣa mi ti ku be bɛ noya ni. Di saha bɛ ni ti di ka dɔni, ka so ti ku lan kpɛhi ba dabiɛm.
en: The people of Israel who survive will do no wrong to anyone, tell no lies, nor try to deceive. They will be prosperous and secure, afraid of no one.

dag: Ŋ-ŋɔ m mini nanim ni dunia saawaranima, bɛn daa lan lab me tin shɛŋa din wurim zaa ti bɛmaŋ la.
en: sleeping like the kings and rulers who rebuilt ancient palaces.

dag: Ka yi yi yɛn kpuɣi yi puri atam, yin di kpuɣiya putariga bindira, yi mi di ti labiya ti yihi binyiha di ni yaha. Chɛliya li ti nandaamba mini saamba. Mani Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Also, when you harvest the crops on your land, dont cut all the way to the corners of your field. Dont pick up the grain that falls on the ground. Leave it for poor people and for foreigners traveling through your country. I am the Lord your God.

dag: ka zo yomyom ti yɛl o nyaandoliba ni o neei kum ni n-daŋ yi tooni chaŋ Galili; nimaani ka yi ni ti nya o. Nyamiya, mani n-yɛli ya lala maa.
en: Go quickly now, and tell his disciples, He has been raised from death, and now he is going to Galilee ahead of you; there you will see him! Remember what I have told you.

dag: Bɛ ni yɛl a nam dariza yɛla, ka yɛl a yiko yɛla.
en: They speak of the glory of your kingdom; they talk all about your power.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ dɔro gbaai Naa Uzia m-mal o hal ka o ti kpimi ni dina. O daa yi nayili n-taɣi ti bela yil shɛli. Ka o bia Jɔtam daa be nayili n-lihiri li, ka gbibi Juda tiŋgbɔŋ maa niriba.
en: Now the LORD afflicted the king with a skin disease that he had until his dying day, so he lived in a separate house. The kings son Jotham supervised the palace administration and governed the people of the land.

dag: Di saha ka malaikanima ayopɔin bɛn daa mali lah ayopɔin din pal alɔbo balibu ayopɔin din bahindi nyaaŋ la ni yino daa ka n sanna ti yɛli ma, Kamina ka n ti wuh a Piɛbil la Daamiliya Paɣa.
en: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls full of the seven last plagues came to me and said, Come, and I will show you the Bride, the wife of the Lamb.

dag: Di saha ka Tomas ŋun daa nyɛ jaa la yɛl o nyaandolitab maa, Dindina chɛliya ka ti zaa dol o chaŋ ka ti min o ti laɣim kpi.
en: Then Thomas said to the other disciples, Let us go too so that we may die with Jesus.

dag: Ka o daa paɣi bimbiɛhi mini namanama n-zaŋ li pahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim maa zuɣu n-nyo li buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: Then he washed the insides and lower legs and completely burned them on the altar along with the rest of the entirely burned offering.

dag: Ka Siria naa daa zal o chɛchɛbunsi sapashin kpamba zaligu n-yɛli ba, Di ti tuhiya dabirisi, yi mi di ti tuhiya wɔɣira, amaa ti kul tuhimiyala Izraɛl naa maa kɔŋko.
en: The king of Syria had ordered his chariot commanders to attack only Ahab.

dag: Piimi noonsi balibu kam zaa, ka pii biŋkɔbiri balibu kam zaa, ka pii biŋgbamda balibu kam zaa. Bɛ zaa bɛba ayiyi ni kpe a sanna din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku kpi.
en: From each kind of bird, from each kind of livestock, and from each kind of everything that crawls on the ground—a pair from each will go in with you to stay alive.

dag: Puhimiya tab puhiri suŋ. Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda la zaa puhiri ya.
en: Greet one another with the kiss of peace. All of God's people send you their greetings.

dag: Ka Farisiinim shɛb daa bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi tumdi din chihiri Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: Some Pharisees said, Why are you breaking the Sabbath law.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli naa Ninvuɣ so ŋun daa ku ti ka lo ni o kpihim ti birili Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa maa.
en: The Gibeonites said to King David, The person who plotted against us was Saul. He is the one who tried to destroy all our people living in the land of Israel.

dag: Amaa yi yi na kul tumdi tuumbiɛri, dindina o ni kpihim yi mini yi naa maa zaa birili.
en: But if you continue to do evil, then both you and your king will be destroyed.

dag: Di saha ka Sulemaana daa ʒini Yawɛ nam ʒiishee maa zuɣu n-zan o ba Dauda zaani leei naa. O daa tɔŋya, ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa deeg o noli.
en: Thus Solomon sat on the LORDs throne as king, succeeding his father David, and he prospered. All Israel obeyed him.

dag: Zaŋmi m paɣiba mini m bi shɛb zuɣu n ni jɛm a ŋɔ ti ma ka n kuli, dama a mi n ni tum tuun shɛli ti a.
en: Give me my wives and children that I have earned by working for you, and I will leave. You know how well I have served you.

dag: Ŋuna n-simdi yiko subu hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: God will be in control forever! Amen.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun zaŋ o tɛha niŋ o ninsalitali biɛhigu yɛla ni nyɛla Naawuni dima, dama o bi doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu, hal ka shiri ku tooi dol li.
en: And so people become enemies of God when they are controlled by their human nature; for they do not obey God's law, and in fact they cannot obey it.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa di manna maa yuun pihinahi hal ti paai bɛ ni daa yɛn ʒini tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni maa. Bɛ daa kul dirila manna maa hal ti paai Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: The Israelites ate manna for forty years, until they came to a livable land. They ate manna until they came to the border of the land of Canaan. .

dag: ka o daa ku doo kam ŋun be Ɛdom ;.
en: Joab and the men of Israel stayed in Edom for six months until they killed all the men of Edom.

dag: Ka bɛn daa dol o liɣi ʒiɛya n-wumdi kukoli maa, amaa ka lee bi nya so.
en: The men with Saul stood there speechless. They had heard the voice, but they had not seen anyone.

dag: Ka bɛ daa maani niriba maa yɛla sahakam. Ka bɛ daa zaŋdi yɛtɔɣ kpɛma n-kani Musa sanna, amaa yɛtɔɣ bihi dina, bɛmaŋmaŋa n-daa maani li.
en: They acted as judges for the people at all times. They would refer the hard cases to Moses, but all of the minor cases they decided themselves.

dag: Hal n ni daa yɛli ya lala maa, yi daa zaɣisi wumbu ka zaɣisi Yawɛ zaligu, ka ŋme nyɔɣu chaŋ zoya ni tiŋ maa ni.
en: I told you what the Lord had said, but you paid no attention. You rebelled against him, and in your pride you marched into the hill country.

dag: Abimilɛk kum nyaaŋa ka ninvuɣ so ŋun daa yɛn fa Izraɛlnim bahi yi palo. Lala nir maa n-daa nyɛ Pua bia Tola ŋun daa nyɛ Dɔdo yaaŋa la. O daa yila Isaka zuliya ni na, ka be Shamir din be Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya zuɣu la.
en: After Abimelech died, God sent another judge to save the Israelites. His name was Tola. He was the son of Puah, who was the son of Dodo. Tola was from the tribe of Issachar and lived in the city of Shamir, in the hill country of Ephraim.

dag: N yura maa chaŋla o puu ni, o chaŋla tulaale tihi puu vuɣisi ni ni o ti chɛ ka o piɛri ŋub mɔri ka o bo paɣiviɛligakushihikom na.
en: My lover has gone down to his garden, to the fragrant plantings, to graze in the gardens, to gather the lilies.

dag: Ŋmaligim a nini ka chɛ ma, ka n nya suhupiɛlli pɔi ka naanyi chaŋ n chandi shee n-leei ŋun ku lan beni yaha.
en: Leave me alone and let me be happy before I am dead and gone.

dag: N kul ni dol a zaligu sahakam.
en: I will keep obeying your Law forever and ever.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zani dubil yini nyaaŋa m-buɣisi dunɔdali zaŋ ti paai dubil din la nyaaŋa, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pinaayi ni pirigili zaŋ goon yini hal ti paai goon dini la.
en: The man measured the gateway from the outside edge of the roof of one room to the outside edge of the roof of the opposite room. It was cubits. Each door was directly opposite the other door.

dag: Yinima ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ jɛra ka ka yɛm ŋɔ, yi ni yo Yawɛ sam shɛli m-bala? Pa ŋuna n-nyɛ yi ba ŋun nam ya? Pa ŋuna n-nam ya, ka zali ya?.
en: Is this the way you should treat the Lord , you foolish, senseless people? He is your father, your Creator, he made you into a nation.

dag: Ti paɣiba mini ti bihi ni ti piɛri ni buhi ni ti niɣi zaa ni kpalim be Giliad tinsi maa ni.
en: Our wives and children and our cattle and sheep will remain here in the towns of Gilead.

dag: Di zɔntua maa daa kpala dundɔntitali polo, ka bɛ ŋme abie tihi pa di pilanim zuɣu. Ka di daa mali dunɔdura anii zaŋ chaŋ dunɔdali gbini.
en: Its entrance room faced the other courtyard, and palm trees were carved on the walls along the passageway. Eight steps led up to this gate.

dag: Piimiya ninvuɣ tuhilituhili Izraɛl zuliya kam ni n-chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ tɔb maa ni.
en: You will send out for battle one thousand from each of the tribes of Israel.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa saɣim alikauli maa Adam tiŋgban ni, nimaani ka bɛ daa bi lan ʒe ma yim.
en: But like Adam they broke the covenant; then they acted in bad faith against me.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, faashee yi ŋub Daadam Bia niŋgbuŋ ka nyu o ʒim, di yi pa lala yi ku mali nyɛvili.
en: Jesus said to them, I am telling you the truth: if you do not eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you will not have life in yourselves.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Wummiya n yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ: Anabinim yi be yi ni, man Yawɛ ni kahigi mmaŋ wuhi ba ʒii puuni, ka tɔɣis ba yɛtɔɣa zahindi ni.
en: Then after commanding them to listen carefully, he said: I, the Lord , speak to prophets in visions and dreams.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm, A daa ŋmanila paɣiŋoo, amaa pumpɔŋɔ, yilimi yila pampam ni suhupiɛlli. Nyini ŋun na ʒi n-wolisi ŋɔ! Yawɛ yɛliya, Pumpɔŋɔ, a ni mali bihi gari paɣ so ŋun mali yidana.
en: Woman, be happy! You have not had any children, but you should be very happy. Yes, the woman who is alone will have more children than the woman with a husband. This is what the Lord says.

dag: ka a yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn timmi nti zaŋ n dabili Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza na ka o ti me o nam ʒiishee tam n ni pi kuɣ shɛŋa ŋɔ zuɣu, ka ti o sampaa gil li.
en: Then tell them that I, the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, am going to bring my servant King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia to this place, and he will put his throne over these stones that you buried, and will spread the royal tent over them.

dag: Ka Izraɛl kpamba maa daa kana, ka Lɛvinim daa kpuɣi Alikauli Adaka maa.
en: Then the priests and the Levites picked up the sacred chest, the sacred tent, and the objects used for worship, and they carried them to the temple.

dag: Ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa bahi Nɛbuzaradan ŋun daa nyɛ yiliguliba sapashin kpɛm maa noli zaŋ chaŋ Jɛrimia polo yɛli.
en: Nebuchadnezzar also gave an order about Jeremiah to commander Nebuzaradan:.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun suhu bi yiɣisiri yomyom nyɛla tɛhi zilimalana, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun suhu yiɣisiri yomyom kpaŋsirila jɛrilim.
en: A patient person is very smart. A quick-tempered person makes stupid mistakes.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Tɔbu lu Sirianim zuɣu. Tɔbu lu bɛn be Babilɔn zuɣu, ka lu bɛ kpambaliba mini bɛ yɛnnim zuɣu.
en: A sword against Babylon and its people, declares the LORD, along with its officials and sages.

dag: O wuhiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn siɣisiri bɛmaŋa din tuhi, ka wuhiri ba o soli.
