en: God guides the weak to justice, teaching them his way.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri suhu din be kasi, ka tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ suma ni tooi nyɛ naa zɔnima.
en: Love a pure heart and kind words, and the king will be your friend.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ tarimba ŋmanila nyee ni pɔhim, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ wɔɣira mi ka buchi. Nir yi zaŋ ba pa sania zuɣu, bɛ tibisim bi yaɣ lala; hal bɛ zaa tibisim yi laɣim, di bi paai nyee ni pɔhim tibisim gba.
en: We humans are only a breath; none of us are truly great. All of us together weigh less than a puff of air.

dag: Izraɛl daa kul bela kasi Yawɛ sani. Ŋuna n-daa nyɛ o tiwala din daŋ moobu. Bɛnkam daa di li daa kpe taali ni, ka alɔbo daa lu bɛ zuɣu. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You belonged to me alone, like the first part of the harvest, and I severely punished those who mistreated you.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Dauda daa chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ Lɔdɛba Ammiɛl bia Makiri maa yiŋ ti zaŋ o na.
en: Then King David sent some of his officers to Lo Debar to bring Jonathans son from the house of Makir son of Ammiel.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ yɛlimaŋli zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni yɛla polo taɣi ʒiri, ka doli binnamda n-jɛmdi li ka chɛ Naawuni ŋun nyɛ binnamda zaa namda ŋɔ. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun simdi paɣibu hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: They traded Gods truth for a lie, and they worshipped and served the creation instead of the creator, who is blessed forever. Amen.

dag: Di saha ka o daa niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni dindali maa ka yɛli, Izraɛlnim yi ti yɛn suhi alibarika, bɛ ni zaŋla yi yuya suhi li. Bɛ ni ti yɛli, Naawuni chɛ ka yi be kaman Ifriim mini Manaasa. Lala ka o daa niŋ n-zaŋ Ifriim leei toondana ka chɛ Manaasa.
en: Israel blessed them that day, saying, Through you, Israel will pronounce blessings, saying, May God make you like Ephraim and Manasseh. So Israel put Ephraim before Manasseh.

dag: Yinima n-nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu, ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu bela kasi. Ka so yi saɣim Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa, Naawuni ni saɣim dilan gba.
en: If you destroy Gods temple, God will destroy you, because Gods temple is holy. You yourselves are Gods temple.

dag: Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba, Biriginsim din ni kpɛhi nir alahichi ni ku chɛ, amaa mbusim be ŋun chɛ ka o kpee birigi tum alahichi zuɣu!.
en: Jesus said to his disciples, Things that make people fall into sin are bound to happen, but how terrible for the one who makes them happen!.

dag: Izraɛlnima, di maliya suhupiɛlli. Miriya ka yi chɛ ka yi suhu paligi kaman zuliya shɛb la. Dama yi zaɣisi yi Naawuni ka tumdila yolimyolim. Yi yuya ni yi tum yolimyolim maa ka deei yi sanyoo kabɔɣili kam ni.
en: Dont rejoice, Israel! Dont celebrate as other nations do; for as whores you have gone away from your God. You have loved a prostitutes pay on all threshing floors of grain.

dag: Ka ti daa lan bɔhi ba bɛ yuya ni di chɛ ka ti sabi bɛ yuya, ka wuh a bɛn nyɛ tuma maa zuɣulaannima.
en: We also asked for the names of their leaders, so that we could write them down for you.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋun ka buchi kul chanimi gindi ŋmari ʒiri.
en: Some people are just troublemakers. They are always thinking up some crooked plan and telling lies.

dag: Paɣimiy o yuli din mali jilima ŋɔ sahakam. O chɛ ka o jilima pali dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam zaa. Ami! Ami!.
en: We will always praise your glorious name. Let your glory be seen everywhere on earth. Amen and amen.

dag: ka booi kpam bahi Nimshi bia Jɛhu zuɣu ni ka o leei Izraɛl naa; ka lan booi kpam bahi Shafat ŋun nyɛ Ɛbɛlimɛhola nir la bia Ilaisha zuɣu ni, ka o mi leeg anabi zani a zaani.
en: Then anoint Jehu son of Nimshi as king over Israel. Next, anoint Elisha son of Shaphat from Abel Meholah. He will be the prophet who takes your place.

dag: Ʒii maa nyabu puuni, n daa nya ka m bela Susa nayili tin shɛli din be vinvamli ni Ɛlam tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, ka daa lan nya ka n ʒɛla Ulai Mɔɣili noli.
en: In the vision I saw that I was in the city of Susa. Susa was the capital city in the province of Elam. I was standing by the Ulai River.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda daa tim ti yɛli Zadok mini Abiata bɛn daa nyɛ maligumaaniba la, Bɔhimiya Juda kpamba, Bɔzuɣu ka yinim nyɛ bɛn ti yɛn bahindi nyaaŋa naa zaŋ kulis o yiŋa, hal ka Izraɛlnim zaa yɛtɔɣa ti paai man naa?.
en: The news of what the Israelites were saying reached King David. So he sent the priests Zadok and Abiathar to ask the leaders of Judah, Why should you be the last to help bring the king back to his palace?.

dag: dama o bipuɣimbil gaŋa ŋun daa nyɛ kaman yuun pinaayi bia n-daa tarigi n-yɛn kpi. Yisa ni daa chani maa ka niriba pam muɣ o sani n-kabiri dol o.
en: because his only daughter, who was twelve years old, was dying. As Jesus went along, the people were crowding him from every side.

dag: A dol a ni daa lo a dabili m ba Dauda alikauli shɛl la. Yɛlimaŋli, a zaŋ a nuu tum tuma m-pal a ni daa yaag a noli yɛli shɛm maa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: You made a promise to your servant, my father David, and you kept that promise. You made that promise with your own mouth, and with your own hands you made it come true today.

dag: So ni tooi mɔŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn deei Naawuni Shia Kasi kaman ti gba ni daa deei shɛm la kom baptaizibu.
en: These people have received the Holy Spirit, just as we also did. Can anyone, then, stop them from being baptized with water.

dag: Yidaannima, yumiya yi paɣiba kaman Masia ni yuri cheechi maa ka zaŋ omaŋ pa talima di zuɣu shɛm la.
en: As for husbands, love your wives just like Christ loved the church and gave himself for her.

dag: Yi ni yɛn bɔhi tab shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Wula ka Yawɛ lee garigi yɛli? bee Wula ka Yawɛ lee yɛli.
en: This is what you will say to one another: What did the Lord answer? or What did the Lord say.

dag: Ka bɛn daa pahi bɛ zuɣu kaman bɛ daŋ kam mini bɛ yaannim dunoya ni daa nyɛ shɛm daa nyɛla tɔbbihi bɔŋbɔŋ ninvuɣ tuhi pihitanaayɔbu, dama bɛ daa mali paɣiba pam ni bidibisi.
en: Their families were so large that they had , soldiers in their clans.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi zaawuni saha n-chaŋ Sirianim sansani maa ni. Amaa ka bɛ daa mali ti paai Sirianim sansani maa ni n-nya ka so ka nimaani.
en: So, as it began to get dark, they went to the Syrian camp, but when they reached it, no one was there.

dag: Di saha ka Mariama yɛli malaika maa, N na ʒi doo. Ka wula ka dimbɔŋɔ ni tooi nani.
en: Mary said to the angel, I am a virgin. How, then, can this be.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ ti nyaya ka ninvuɣ biɛri n-lee mali suhupiɛlli. Tuumbiɛtumdiba biɛhigu kul tɔŋdimi, ka pa di kɔŋko, hal bɛ yi buɣisi Naawuni ni bɛ nya, binshɛli bi niŋdi ba. .
en: So now we consider the arrogant fortunate. Moreover, those doing evil are built up; they test God and escape.

dag: N ku kpi, amaa n ni be, ka moli Yawɛ tuma yɛla.
en: I wont die—no, I will live and declare what the LORD has done.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla dunia ŋɔ ni kɔŋko ka ti mali tahima Masia ni, dindina ti nyɛla nambɔ niriba gari sokam zaa.
en: If our hope in Christ is good for this life only and no more, then we deserve more pity than anyone else in all the world.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim ba dimbɔŋɔnim zaa, amaa bɛ ku wum a yɛligu. A ni boli ba, amaa bɛ ku garig a.
en: So, Jeremiah, you will speak all these words to my people, but they will not listen to you; you will call them, but they will not answer.

dag: Ka Naa Jɔsia daa puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu Jɛrusalɛm n-jɛm Yawɛ, ka bɛ daa kɔri Yaɣigari chuɣu biŋkɔbiri gol so ŋun daŋ tooni biɛɣu pinaanahi dali.
en: Then Josiah celebrated the LORDs Passover in Jerusalem. They slaughtered the Passover lambs on the fourteenth day of the first month.

dag: Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bi tooi baŋ ni pa bɔrɔbɔro yɛla ka n yɛri maa? Ka daa lan yɛli ba yaha, Miriya Farisiinim mini Sadusiinim dabindi la.
en: How is it that you don't understand that I was not talking to you about bread? Guard yourselves from the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti yi mali bindirigu mini situra, ti n-chɛ ka ti nini tiɣ li.
en: So we should be satisfied just to have food and clothes.

dag: Yi daa nya n ni daa niŋ Ijiptinim shɛm la mini n ni daa zaŋ ya tam tɔra kpiŋkpama zuɣu n-zaŋ ya tahi mmaŋmaŋ sanna la.
en: You people saw what I did to the people of Egypt. You saw that I carried you out of Egypt like an eagle and brought you here to me.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Asiria naa polo m-bɔŋɔ: O ku kpe tiŋ ŋɔ ni na bee n-to piɛm di ni bee ka o tɔbbihi ti gbib nyɔtaɣirisi kpe di ni bee ka bɛ ti me bimbin dura gil li.
en: So the Lord says this about the king of Assyria: He will not come into this city or shoot an arrow here. He will not bring his shields up against this city or build up a hill of dirt to attack its walls.

dag: Dama ʒii maa saha na kparimi. Di yɛrila naabu saha yɛla, ka bi ŋmari ʒiri. Di yi ŋmanila di bi niŋdi yomyom, nyin kul guhim li. Biɛhiŋ kani, di ni niŋ, di ku yuui.
en: There is still a vision for the appointed time; it testifies to the end; it does not deceive. If it delays, wait for it; for it is surely coming; it will not be late.

dag: Bɛ ni daa suui bɛ noli maa naai ka Yisa bɔhi Saimɔn Pita, Saimɔn Jɔn bia, a yuri ma gari bɛmbɔŋɔ? Ka o saɣi, Iin n Duuma, a mi ni n yur a. Ka Yisa yɛl o, Dihimi m piɛbihi.
en: When they finished eating, Jesus said to Simon Peter, Simon, son of John, do you love me more than these other men love me? Peter answered, Yes, Lord, you know that I love you. Then Jesus said to him, Take care of my lambs. .

dag: Maligumaana bidibbil kam ni tooi ŋub li. Di simdi ka bɛ ti ŋub li la luɣ kasi shee, di nyɛla din be kasi zaa.
en: Any male priest can eat it. It must be eaten in a holy place; it is most holy.

dag: ka bɛ bɔh o, A wum bɛ ni yɛri shɛm maa bebɔ? Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, Iin. Amaa yi na bi karim din sabi Naawuni Kundi ni? Di sabiya: Bihi mini bimɔɣirisi noya ni ka Naawuni nyari paɣibu ni yɛlimaŋli. .
en: The men said to Jesus, Don't you hear what those children are saying? Yes, I do! Jesus answered. Don't you know that the Scriptures say, Children and infants will sing praises.

dag: Gbuɣindaa dooshee din nyɛ gbuɣim polli dibu shee, ka nyɛ gbuɣindaa ni chani luɣ shɛli, ka gbuɣimbihi be ni, ka so ku tooi dam ba la lee be ya?.
en: Where is that great city now? It was like a den where the lions feed their young. It was a place where people felt safe, like lions in a cave with no one there to harm them.

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ piɛlahi gbana din niŋ moonsi pili suɣili maa, ka zaŋ teeku ni biŋkɔbbal shɛb gbana pili pa di zuɣu.
en: They also made a covering for the tent of rams skins dyed red and an outer covering of beaded leather.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ yi mini Masia ni laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yin la zuɣu, yinim bɛn daa be katiŋ la yipa vu m-miri Naawuni Masia ʒim zuɣu.
en: Yes, at one time you were far away from God, but now in Christ Jesus, you are brought near to him. You are brought near to God through the blood sacrifice of Christ.

dag: Ka Mikaya garigi yɛl o, N nya ka Izraɛlnim zaa kul yɛrigila zoya zuɣu m-be kaman piɛ shɛb bɛn ka gula. Ka Yawɛ yɛli, Niriba ŋɔ ka zuɣulana; chɛ ka bɛ zaa yinoyino lab kuli ni suhudoo. .
en: Then Micaiah replied, I saw all Israel scattered on the hills like sheep without a shepherd! And then the LORD said: They have no master. Let them return safely to their own homes.

dag: Toli maa kɔtomsi daa ŋmanila yuri bɛn mali shili gu tɔbu tuhibu, ka binshɛŋa din be kaman salima nam zuɣupila la pil bɛ zuɣuri, ka bɛ ninani ŋmani daadam ninni.
en: The locusts looked like horses prepared for battle. On their heads they wore something that looked like a gold crown. Their faces looked like human faces.

dag: Ka di daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb suli pam ka bɛ yɛri bɛ suhuri ni, Bɔzuɣu ka paɣ ŋɔ saɣim tulaale ŋɔ lala?.
en: Some of the followers there saw this. They were upset and complained to each other. They said, Why waste that perfume?.

dag: Ka saa daa gbaai nyaɣisibu ka tahira, ka vuri mɔni, ka tiŋgbani daa dam pam, ka tiŋgbani dambu lala tatabo daa na ʒi n-niŋ daadamnim nambu piligu ni zaŋ kana di saha maa.
en: Then there were flashes of lightning, noises, thunder, and a big earthquake. This was the worst earthquake that has ever happened since people have been on earth.

dag: O daa paɣiya ni o pahi Naawuni niriba zuɣu n-di wahala gar o di alahichi nyaɣisim din ku yuui.
en: He chose to be mistreated with Gods people instead of having the temporary pleasures of sin.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, Wummi mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ fabila mini n suhigu ŋɔ. Gbilisim tibili wum a dabili fabila ni o suhigu shɛli o ni suhir a ŋɔ.
en: But I ask you to answer my prayer.

dag: Ŋun bɔri ni o jɛm ma, ŋun doli ma. N ni be luɣ shɛli, nimaani ka n yiŋbia gba ni ti be. Ŋun jɛmdi ma, dilana ka m Ba Naawuni tiri jilima.
en: Whoever serves me must follow me. My servants must be with me everywhere I am. My Father will give honor to anyone who serves me.

dag: Ka yi ni su tiŋgbɔŋ maa luɣ shɛlikam zaa, zalimiya nir ni yɛn kɔh o tiŋgbani ka ti lan yo di zuɣu ka deei li saha shɛli.
en: When land is sold, the right of the original owner to buy it back must be recognized.

dag: yo yaɣimɛr palo zuɣu kaman n Duuma Naawuni ni daa pun wuhi ma shɛm.
en: They used those silver coins to buy the potters field, as the Lord commanded me.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu ka o zaŋ ba niŋ Mɛsopoteemia naa Kushanrishataim nuu ni ka Izraɛlnim daa jɛm o yuma anii.
en: So the Lord became angry with Israel and let King Cushan Rishathaim of Mesopotamia conquer them. They were subject to him for eight years.

dag: Ka o daa mir o ti mɔɣis o kpariŋ; ka Yisahaku wum o binyɛra ʒiɛɣu ka niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni ka yɛli, Wummi m bia ʒiɛɣu, di ŋmanila Yawɛ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ mɔ shɛl ni ʒiɛɣu.
en: While Jacob was kissing him, Isaac caught the smell of his clothes and said: The smell of my son is like a field the Lord has blessed.

dag: Ŋun nyɛ nyɛvili maa ni daa ti yi palo, ti daa nya o ka di o shɛhira, ka yɛri ya ŋuna ŋun nyɛ nyɛvili din ka bahigu ka daa be ti Ba Naawuni sani, ka ŋun Naawuni daa kahig o wuhi ti la yɛla.
en: Yes, the one who is life was shown to us. We saw him, and so we can tell others about him. We now tell you about him. He is the eternal life that was with God the Father and was shown to us.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa ti gbahi tab zuɣuri, ka zaŋ takɔbiri kuhi tab puluɣa ni, ka bɛ zaa laɣim lu n-kpi. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani Hɛlikatihazurim, ka di be Gibiɔn.
en: They grabbed each other by the hair and stabbed each other in the side with their daggers. They all died right there! That's why the place in Gibeon is called Field of Daggers.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka yi nya filiŋ, ka niriba zaa ʒiɛm ya ka filim ya yi ni bi doli n soya, amaa ka chɛ ka niriba gaŋbu be yi wuhibu ni la zuɣu.
en: You dont live the way I told you. You have not accepted my teachings. So I will cause people to hate you and think you are worth nothing.

dag: Fɔntiŋ kar shɛŋa din daa be zolɔna ni n-nyɛ: Ɛshitaol mini Zɔra ni Ashina.
en: The cities in the foothills were Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Amaa di nyaaŋa n ni ti yɛn lo Izraɛlnim alikauli shɛli m-bɔŋɔ: N ni ti zaŋ n zaligu ti ba, ka sab li niŋ bɛ suhuri ni, ka n ti nyɛ bɛ Naawuni, ka bɛ mi nyɛ n niriba.
en: In the future I will make this agreement with the people of Israel. This message is from the Lord . I will put my teachings in their minds, and I will write them on their hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

dag: Di saha ka o ni ti garigi yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi ni daa bi niŋ m mabihi ŋɔ nirilim hal zaŋ tabili bɛ ni bɛn daa pɔri la, mani ka yi daa bi niŋ maa.
en: Then he will answer, I assure you that when you havent done it for one of the least of these, you havent done it for me.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ bɛ ŋarima maa na ti zali duli, bɛ daa chɛla bɛ binshɛɣukam maa zaa ka doli Yisa.
en: The men brought their boats to the shore. They left everything and followed Jesus.

dag: ka yɛli li, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: M bi ʒe a nyaaŋa, nyini Seir Zoli. N teela n nuu jɛnd a ni n chɛ ka a zani dabari bahi yoli.
en: and say to them: I, the Lord God, am now your enemy! And I will turn your nation into an empty wasteland.

dag: N daa niŋ bɛn doli soli ŋɔ alaka, hal ka chɛ ka bɛ ku bɛ shɛba, ka chɛ ka bɛ lo bɛ shɛb bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba mihi kpɛhi duu.
en: I persecuted to the death the people who followed this Way. I arrested men and women and threw them into prison.

dag: amaa chamiyala Izraɛlnim bɛn bɔrigi kaman piɛri la sani.
en: Go only to the people of Israel, because they are like a flock of lost sheep.

dag: Ka nanim mini bɛ tɔbbihi gbaai zɔbu! Ka paɣiba bɛn be yiŋa zaŋ bɛ ni ŋme n-di neen shɛŋa pirigi ti taba.
en: The kings of armies are on the run! The women back home divide the spoil.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla dunia ŋɔ ni, n nyaya ka zaligu dolibu ni be shɛli ninvuɣ biɛtali bela nimaani; ka lan nya ka wuntitali ni be shɛli ninvuɣ biɛtali lan bela nimaani gba.
en: In addition, I have also noticed that in this world you find wickedness where justice and right ought to be.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum Judas ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka di niŋ ba nyaɣisim pam, ka bɛ lo o alikauli ni bɛ ni ti o liɣiri. Ka o daa piligi bɔri so shɛli o ni yɛn doli yi Yisa nyaaŋa chɛ ka bɛ gbaag o.
en: They were very happy about this, and they promised to pay him. So he waited for the best time to hand Jesus over to them.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Zaligu dini ka Anabi Musa daa lee zali ya.
en: Jesus answered, What did Moses command you to do.

dag: Ka din daa lu vuhim shee la, din ŋmanila bɛn wum Naawuni yɛligu maa ka gbib li kirikiri bɛ suhuri ni ni yɛlimaŋli, ka di dɔɣira n-niŋdi biɛlim pam bɛ suɣilo dibu puuni la.
en: The seed that fell on good soil are those who hear the word and commit themselves to it with a good and upright heart. Through their resolve, they bear fruit.

dag: Dindali maa, paɣiba ayopɔin ni ti gbaai do yino n-yɛl o, Saɣimi ni ti yidana n-nyɛ a, ka ti yi vi ni; amaa ti ni dihiri timaŋa, ka sooni timaŋa.
en: When this happens, seven women will grab the same man, and each of them will say, I'll buy my own food and clothes! Just marry me and take away my disgrace.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira nyaandoliba daa chaŋ ŋun Jɔn sani nti yɛl o Yisa ni daa niŋdi shɛlikam maa zaa yɛla.
en: Johns followers told him about all these things. John called for two of his followers.

dag: M mabihi n suhiri ya, niŋmiya suɣilo n-deei n saɣisigu yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, dama yɛtɔɣa biɛla ka n zaŋ n-sabi gbaŋ ŋɔ tin ya.
en: I urge you, brothers and sisters, to put up with this message of encouragement, since Ive only written a short letter to you!.

dag: O daa lan mali bintamdisi, ka mali taha tam di zuɣu.
en: ten stands with ten basins on them.

dag: Amaa n chɛmi ka n suhu be baalim kaman bia ŋun ŋmaai bihili ni be o ma sani baalim shɛm la. N suhu ŋmanila bia ŋun ŋmaai bihili suhu.
en: No. But I have calmed and quieted myself like a weaned child on its mother; Im like the weaned child that is with me.

dag: O vuui Izraɛlnim yaa o suhuyiɣisili puuni. O daa yih o nuu ka chɛ ba bɛ dimnim ninni. O ŋmanila buɣim niɛm din diri Yaakubu zuliya sunsuuni n-di n-gili luɣilikam.
en: The Lord was so furiously angry that he wiped out the whole army of Israel by not supporting them when the enemy attacked. He was like a raging fire that swallowed up the descendants of Jacob.

dag: M mabihi, teemiya yi ni daa nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛba ka Naawuni boli ya la yɛla. Zaŋ chaŋ dunia ŋɔ yɛla polo, yi ni pam daa pala yɛnnima bee yikolaannima bee nam zuliyanima.
en: Look at your situation when you were called, brothers and sisters! By ordinary human standards not many were wise, not many were powerful, not many were from the upper class.

dag: O daa galim Naa Hɛrɔd ŋun Naa Hɛrɔd tizɔbil paɣa Hɛrɔdias yɛla zuɣu m-pah o ni daa tum tuun biɛ shɛŋa la zuɣu.
en: But John reprimanded Governor Herod, because he had married Herodias, his brother's wife, and had done many other evil things.

dag: N yura, kamina ka ti yi kpaŋa nti gbɛri tiŋkpansi.
en: Let's stroll through the fields and sleep in the villages.

dag: Ka ti yi kahigi ti daalahichi wuhi Naawuni, o nyɛla ŋun ʒe o daalikauli nyaaŋa ka niŋdi din tuhi, ka ni chɛ ti daalahichi paŋ ti, ka kul ni kpihindi dinkam zaa bi doli wuntia soli ti biɛhigu ni bahira.
en: But if we confess our sins to God, he can always be trusted to forgive us and take our sins away.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, bɛ nyɛla bɛn chani kpɛri yiya ni n-saɣindi bɛ dahima; ka di pala di kɔŋko, bɛ lan nyɛla bɛn leei niriba nyaanzuriba mini bɛn dari gindi kpɛri niriba yɛla ni n-yɛri din bi simdi ni bɛ yɛli.
en: Also, these younger widows begin to waste their time going from house to house. They also begin to gossip and try to run other peoples lives. They say things they should not say.

dag: Ka Adɔram daa nyɛ ŋun su tumtumdiba fukumsi; ka Ahilud bia Jɛhɔshafat daa nyɛ ŋun su gbana sabbu fukumsi.
en: Adoniram was in charge of the forced labor; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was in charge of the records;.

dag: Ka Dauda suhu daa ti lu yiŋ ni ka o yɛli, so yi di naan chaŋ Bɛtilihɛm ti tooi kɔbil shɛli din do di samban ni dunɔdali shee la ni kom na ti ti ma ka n nyu.
en: David got homesick and said, How I wish someone would bring me a drink of water from the well by the gate in Bethlehem.

dag: O bia Yisahaku maa daba anii dali ka ŋun Ibrahimma daa gun o kaman Naawuni ni daa zal o shɛm.
en: Abraham circumcised his son Isaac when he was eight days old just as God had commanded him.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ; o saria karibu la bela dunia ni zaa.
en: The Lord is our God. He rules the whole world.

dag: N ni saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ maa, ka di ti gari yi dimnim bɛn ti yɛn kana ti be di ni.
en: I will personally devastate the land so much that your enemies who resettle it will be astonished by it.

dag: N ku zo dabiɛm muɣisigu saha, saha shɛli n dimnim yi ti teei gili ma.
en: Why should I be afraid in times of trouble, when the wrongdoing of my bullies engulfs me.

dag: Ka Izraɛl zuɣulaannim bɛn nyɛ bɛ yaannim dunoya ni dɔɣirikpamba mini bɛ ni daa kali zuliya shɛb la zuɣulaannim daa mali sara.
en: Then the clan chiefs who were leaders in the tribes of Israel, the same men who were in charge of the census.

dag: dama n wum a ni niŋ ti Duuma Yisa yɛda shɛm min a ni yuri Yisa nyaandoliba shɛm la yɛla.
en: For I hear of your love for all of God's people and the faith you have in the Lord Jesus.

dag: Daadam, kummi Ijipti tɔbbihi zuɣu, ka zaŋ bɛ mini zuliya shɛb bɛn mali yaa niŋ tiŋgban ni m-pahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pun be kpiimba biɛhigu shee la zuɣu.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, mourn for the Egyptians and condemn them to the world of the dead, where they will be buried alongside the people of other powerful nations.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kali Izraɛlnim kaman bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm m-bala. Niriba bɛn daa be nimaani gbilligbilli zaa kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbisiyɔbunaata ni kɔbisinu ni pihinu.
en: So these were the Israelites. They were counted by families. The total number of Israelite men in the camps, counted by divisions, is .

dag: Di pala ninkura kɔŋko m-mali yɛm bee bɛn gbaai kpamli kɔŋko m-mi din tuhi.
en: It is not growing old that makes us wise or helps us to know what is right.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa bi kali Lɛvinim ni bɛ daŋ niriba pahi bɛ ni.
en: But those from the Levi tribe were not included.

dag: Shɛkania bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Shɛmaya. Ka Shɛmaya bidibisi daa nyɛ Hatush mini Igal ni Baria ni Niaria ni Shafat, bɛ daa nyɛla niriba ayɔbu.
en: This is a list of Shecaniahs descendants: Shemaiah. Shemaiah had six sons: Shemaiah, Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ mali takɔriti niŋ li, ka di sambani polo yɛlima, ka di puuni polo nyɛ zaɣ muɣilinga.
en: The walls of the Temple had openings in them, narrower on the outside than on the inside.

dag: Naa Ahasivɛrɔs zaligu maa ni daa moli gili, bɛ daa laɣim paɣisara pam tahi Susa din daa nyɛ tinzuɣu maa ni na, ka Ɛsta gba daa be bɛ ni. Bɛ daa zaŋ ba kpɛhila nayili maa puuni nti zaŋ ba niŋ Hɛgai ŋun daa su napaɣiba fukumsi la nuu ni ni o lihiri ba.
en: When the king had issued his new proclamation and many young women were being brought to Susa, Esther was among them. She too was put in the royal palace in the care of Hegai, who had charge of the harem.

dag: Bɛ mali noya, amaa bɛ ku tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa. Bɛ mali nina, amaa bɛ ku tooi nya.
en: They have mouths, but cannot speak. They have eyes, but cannot see.

dag: O zuliya ni ninvuɣ shɛb mini bɛ malibu yuya m-bɔŋɔ saha shɛli bɛ ni daa kali ba m-baŋ bɛ kalinli la. Naa mini Jɛiɛl ni Zakaria.
en: The family records list the following clan leaders in the tribe of Reuben: Jeiel, Zechariah.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia daa kpuɣi ma zuɣusaa n-zaŋ ma ti kpe dundombil ni. Ka Yawɛ jilima daa pali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa.
en: The Lord 's Spirit lifted me to my feet and carried me to the inner courtyard, where I saw that the Lord 's glory had filled the temple.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa yiɣisi Ɛlim n-chaŋ ti kpe Sin tiŋgban nɛli din daa be Ɛlim mini Sinai sunsuuni la ni gol so ŋun daa pahir ayi bɛ Ijipti yibu maa nyaaŋa biɛɣ pinaanu dali.
en: The whole Israelite community set out from Elim and came to the Sin desert, which is located between Elim and Sinai. They set out on the fifteenth day of the second month after they had left the land of Egypt.

dag: Sanʒiɛɣu pɔhim yirila gbinni polo na, ka wari yiri kikaa pɔhim ni na.
en: Whirlwinds come from the south. The cold winds come from the north.

dag: Ka Abinɛr daa yɛli Jɔab, Chɛ ka nachimba maa yiɣisi diɛm ka ti nya. Ka Jɔab yɛli, Chɛ ka bɛ yiɣisi.
en: Abner yelled to Joab, Let's get some of our best soldiers to stand up and fight each other! Joab agreed.

dag: Ka duu maa dunol ni kazala puuni ziliŋ daa nyɛ mita anahi ni pirigili; ka di yɛliŋ daa nyɛ mita awɛi; ka di mini jɛmbu duu maa maŋmaŋ yɛliŋ nyɛ yim.
en: The porch in front of the temples main hall was thirty feet long. It ran across the whole width of the temple and extended fifteen feet in front of the temple.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Kalɛb zuliya: Hur ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛfirat bituuli la bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Shɔbal ŋun daa nyɛ Kiriatijiarim ba la.
en: The following are also descendants of Caleb. Hur was the oldest son of Caleb and his wife Ephrath. Hur's son Shobal founded Kiriath Jearim.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba maa bidibisi mi daa su tulaalɛnim maa zaŋ gari tab tuma fukumsi.
en: But it was the priests who had the job of mixing the special oil.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri yiɣisi bah a zuɣu ni di vi; ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tuhir a mi ni kpalim yoli ka kpi.
en: Those who are angry with you will know the shame of defeat. Those who fight against you will die.

dag: Aduna ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana la bia Ɛliɛza n-daa nyɛ Lɛvinim kpamba maa zuɣulana; ŋuna n-daa lihiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn su luɣ kasi shee la.
en: The chief of the Levites was Eleazar son of Aaron the priest. He was in charge of those who carried out the duties in the Holy Place.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o ŋum o lɔŋni, ka zaŋ o jilima kukoli ŋɔ tahi, ka o bi goori saanyaɣisibu saha shɛli ti yi wum o kukoli maa.
en: God's majestic voice thunders his commands.

dag: Dinzuɣu ninvuɣ so ŋun ti bi lo noli dindali maa, bɛn yihim o n niriba ni.
en: Any who eat anything on that day will no longer be considered God's people.

dag: Jake bia Agur yɛtɔɣ kpɛma m-bɔŋɔ. Di nyɛla anabitali yɛtɔɣa. Doo maa ni daa yɛli Itiɛl mini Ukal shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Naawuni, n gbarigiya, Naawuni, n gbarigiya; wula ka n yɛn niŋ di nasara?.
en: These are the solemn words of Agur son of Jakeh: God is not with me, God is not with me, and I am helpless.

dag: Dama Naawuni Kundi yɛliya, Miri ka a zaŋ naŋgbampɔbirigu pɔbi naɣikɔrigu ŋun nɔri buri chi noli. Di lan yɛli yaha, Tumtumda kam simdi yɔri.
en: It is just as the Scriptures say, Don't muzzle an ox when you are using it to grind grain. You also know the saying, Workers are worth their pay.

dag: Dama yɛlimaŋli ka bɛ noya ni; bɛ suhuri kul yula saɣiŋgu. Bɛ lɔna ŋmanila gbal kaba, ka bɛ lan mali naŋgban malisim.
en: My enemies never tell the truth. They only want to destroy people. Their words come from mouths that are like open graves. They use their lying tongues to deceive others.

dag: Ka shia maa daa kpalim zani, amaa n daa bi tooi baŋ di ŋmahiŋgbana ni nyɛ shɛm. Kɔtomsi shɛli n-daa ʒe n tooni, ka vuri daa fo, di saha ka n daa wum kukol shɛli ni yɛli.
en: The spirit stood still, but I could not see what it was. A shape stood before my eyes, and there was silence. Then I heard a quiet voice:.

dag: Ka Haman daa yɛli naa, Chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ amaŋmaŋ nam kpar shɛŋa a ni pun ye min amaŋmaŋ wɔribaro ni nam zuɣupiligu din ni zaŋ pili dilan na;.
en: So he replied, Your Majesty, if you wish to honor a man.

dag: Yawɛ daa booni ya la olivi ti mahali din mali wal viɛla, amaa sanʒiɛ titali puuni o ni niŋ buɣim dab li, ka di di di wula.
en: The LORD named you, A blossoming olive tree, fair and fruitful; but with the blast of a powerful storm he will set it ablaze, until its branches are completely consumed.

dag: ka tiŋgbani mi ti saɣi ti kawana mini wain ni kpam, ka di mi ti saɣi ti Jɛziriil.
en: and it will produce grain, grapes, and olives in Jezreel Valley.

dag: Ka bɛ ni ti zaŋ yiko mini dunia ŋɔ nama zaa zoosim ti Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ wuntizɔriba, ka bɛ nam maa ku mali tariga, ka dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa ni ti kana ti tumdi tuma tiri ba, ka deei bɛ noli.
en: The kingship, authority, and power of all kingdoms under heaven will be given to the people, the holy ones of the Most High. Their kingship is an everlasting one; every authority will serve them and obey.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ gabiga m-pɔripɔri li n-zaŋ kari bɛ mini bɛ biŋkɔbiri maa zaa yihi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, ka daai laɣitaɣiriba la teebuya maa luhi n-kpahi bɛ liɣiri bahi.
en: So he took some rope and made a whip. Then he chased everyone out of the temple, together with their sheep and cattle. He turned over the tables of the moneychangers and scattered their coins.

dag: Chɛ ka n di wain tiwala n-nya kpiɔŋ, ka di apil ka n nini neei, dama doo bɔbu chɛmi ka n ni chɔɣisi zaa.
en: Strengthen me with raisins ; refresh me with apples, because I am weak with love.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli ma.
en: The Lord spoke to me.

dag: Di simdi ni yi tumdi din tuhi mini din viɛli Yawɛ sani, ka binshɛɣukam niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani, ka yi ti chaŋ ti ʒini tiŋgbɔn viɛl shɛli ŋun Yawɛ ni daa po yi yaannim sani ni o ni zaŋ tin ya la ni.
en: and live in a way that pleases him. Then you will be able to go in and take this good land from your enemies, just as he promised your ancestors.

dag: Bɛ daa kar o saria, ka mɔŋ o yɛlimaŋli, ka zaŋ o chaŋ ni bɛ ti ku o. Bɛ daa di o nyɛvili dunia ŋɔ ni. N niriba daalahichi zuɣu ka bɛ daa ku o.
en: He was taken away by force and judged unfairly. The people of his time did not even notice that he was killed. But he was put to death for the sins of his people.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Miriya ka yi bɔhim zuliya shɛb biɛhigu bee n-chɛ ka zuɣusaa shihira niŋ ya alahiziba, dama shihira maa niŋla zuliya shɛba alahiziba.
en: The LORD proclaims: Dont follow the ways of the nations or be troubled by signs in the sky, even though the nations are troubled by them.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli Naawuni nyɛla ŋun galisi ka mi bi ʒiɛm so, o yɛm galisiya pam.
en: God is very powerful, but he does not hate people. He is very powerful, but he is also very wise.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa zaŋ gabisi maa vo Jɛrimia kɔbiliga maa ni yihina. Ka Jɛrimia daa kpalim be yiliguliba dundɔŋ maa ni.
en: they pulled him up by the ropes and got him out of the cistern. After that Jeremiah remained in the prison quarters.

dag: Ka Jɛrimia daa yɛli niriba maa zaa zaŋ tabili paɣiba maa zaa, Yinim Judanim zaa bɛn be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni ŋɔ, wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Then Jeremiah spoke to all the men and women. He said, All you people of Judah who are now in Egypt, listen to this message from the Lord .

dag: Suhugarigu chɛmi ka n yɛma ŋma; kpaŋsim ma kaman a yɛligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: I am overcome with sorrow. Encourage me, as you have promised to do.

dag: N ni lan kpaŋsi bɛ ʒiɛyimtali n sani. N ni yuri ba ni n suhu zaa, dama n suhuyiɣisili zaŋ chaŋ bɛ sani maaya.
en: The Lord says, I will forgive them for leaving me. I will show them my love without limits, because I have stopped being angry.

dag: Yaakubu zuliya ninvuɣ so ni ti di nam, ka ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim be Iri.
en: The king of Israel will rule and destroy the survivors of every town there.

dag: A tɛhiya ni nol ni yɛtɔɣa nyɛla yɛm soya ni yiko din tuhiri tɔbu? Ŋuni ka a lee du m-ba ka mɔri ma maa?.
en: Do you think that empty words are the same as good strategy and the strength to fight? Who are you trusting that you now rebel against me?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa dii chɛ bɛ lansi maa ka dol o.
en: So they immediately left their nets and followed Jesus.

dag: ka yi pirigibu buta zuɣu yim guli Sur Dunɔdal la, ka yi pirigibu buta zuɣu yim be dunɔdali din be guliba nyaaŋa la zaa n-guli nayili.
en: Another third will be at the Sur Gate, and the other third will be at the gate behind the guard. This way you will stand guard over the palace on all sides.

dag: O ni daa mali ti paai yiŋa, ka o yidan ma bɔh o, M bia, ka di nyɛ wula zaŋ chaŋ a polo? Ka Rut daa yɛl o Bɔaz ni yɛl o shɛlikam zaa.
en: She came to her mother-in-law, who said, How are you, my daughter? So Ruth told her everything the man had done for her.

dag: Dama n suhu daa zɔhirimi ni Yawɛ suhu ni yiɣisi pam bahi yi zuɣu shɛm maa, o ni kun ya. Amaa ka Yawɛ daa lan wum n suhigu di saha maa gba.
en: I was afraid of the massive anger and rage the LORD had for you—he was going to wipe you out! However, the LORD listened to me again in that moment.

dag: Di ni daa be shɛm hal ka kom ti kana ti di bɛ zaa ha la: Bɛ daa diri ka nyura; ka kpuɣiri paɣiba, ka zaŋdi bɛ bipuɣinsi tiri dɔbba hal ti paai Anabi Nuhu ni daa kpe ŋariŋ ni dahin shɛli.
en: People were eating, drinking, and getting married right up to the day the flood came and Noah went into the big boat.

dag: Bɔ saha ka a yɛn chɛ biɛhiŋ, nyin bipuɣiŋga ŋun ka yɛda ŋɔ? Dama n yɛn namla bin palli niŋ dunia ni. Di ni ti ŋmanila paɣa n-ni ti nyɛ ŋun taɣiri doo barina ni.
en: How long will you hem and haw, my rebellious daughter? The LORD has created something new on earth: Virgin Israel will once again embrace her God!.

dag: Ka Farisiinim maa gba ti bɔh o yaha, Wula ka a lee niŋ ka a nina maa neei? Ka o yɛli ba, O zaŋla tandi ʒe n nina maa, ka m paɣi li ka neei.
en: The Pharisees, then, asked the man again how he had received his sight. He told them, He put some mud on my eyes; I washed my face, and now I can see.

dag: Ka a ni ti na kul yɛn tɔɣisiri naa yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ saha shɛli maa, n gba ni dol a nyaaŋa kpɛna nti di a shɛhira.
en: And Nathan added, Then, while you are still talking with King David, I will come in and confirm your story.

dag: ni Bɛtipɛɔr ni Pisiga zolɔŋni ni Bɛtijɛshimɔt.
en: Bethpeor, the slopes of Mount Pisgah, and Beth Jeshimoth.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Zaŋmi bɛ ni buɣisi yɛli shɛm maa buɣisi n ni yɛli shɛm. Bɛ ni buɣisi yɛli shɛm maa yi be di ko ka chɛ n dini maa di wuhiya ni neesim bee yɛlimaŋli ka bɛ ni.
en: for instruction and for testimony—they will surely say such things, but they will never see the dawn.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, cham Izraɛlnim sani nti zaŋ n yɛtɔɣa maa yɛli ba.
en: Then God said to me, Son of man, go to the family of Israel. Speak my words to them.

dag: Di viɛl ni ti paɣi nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Zallakudura Naa, ka yili yila paɣ a yuli;.
en: It is wonderful to be grateful and to sing your praises, Lord Most High!.

dag: N niŋla lala ni di chɛ ka niriba bɛn be wulimpuhili mini wulinluhili polo baŋ ni so kani pahi n zuɣu. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, ka so bi lan pahi n zuɣu.
en: so all will know, from the rising of the sun to its setting, that there is nothing apart from me. I am the LORD; theres no other.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa Yisifu ni tɔɣisi ba n-yɛl o, ka o nya tɔroko shɛŋa Yisifu ni daa zaŋ ti na ni bɛ ti kpuɣ o na la, ka o suhu daa kpaŋ;.
en: But then they told him everything Joseph had said. Then their father saw the wagons that Joseph had sent to bring him back to Egypt, and he became excited and very happy.

dag: ni Chɛfaramɔni ni Ofini ni Gɛba: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔŋ kara pinaayi m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Chepharammoni, Ophni, and Geba: twelve cities, along with the towns around them.

dag: Jɛrimia daa yɛliya, Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: Jeremiah said, The LORDs word came to me.

dag: Daŋ kam ni zuɣulaannim bɛn daa nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi kalinli daa nyɛla niriba tusaayi ni kɔbisiyɔbu.
en: The army was commanded by , officers.

dag: Gbilisimiya tibili n-wumm o yɛligu ka di zaɣisiy o noli, dama yi yi birigi, o ku chɛ yi taali, dama n yuli be o ni.
en: Carefully obey everything the angel says, because I am giving him complete authority, and he won't tolerate rebellion.

dag: Ka Filistia doo maa daa nya Dauda ka ʒiɛm o, dama o daa kul nyɛla bisariŋga ka mal alaafee, ka viɛli pam.
en: Goliath looked at David with disgust. He saw that David was only a handsome, healthy boy.

dag: Bɛ ni daa garigi yɛli ti shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ti nyɛla Naawuni ŋun su zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani ŋɔ daba, ka lab mɛri du shɛli Izraɛl na so ŋun mali yiko pam ni daa pun me n-naai zali yuun gbaliŋ din gari la ni ha.
en: This is the answer they gave us: We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth. We are rebuilding the Temple that a great king of Israel built and finished many years ago.

dag: O daa chɛ ka tampima bɔɣi yɔɣu sunsuuni, ka o daa ti ba kom pam din be kaman teeku kɔbulli ni kom la, ka bɛ nyu.
en: God split rocks open in the wilderness, gave them plenty to drink— as if from the deep itself!.

dag: ka n ti lan labi m ba yiŋ yaha ni suhudoo, dindina Yawɛ n-ni nyɛ n Naawuni.
en: and if I return safely to my father's home, then you will be my God.

dag: Ka Shafan daa lab Naa Jɔsia sanna nti yɛl o, A tumtumdiba yihi laɣ shɛli zaa din be Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni n-zaŋ li ti tuma zuɣulaannim bɛn lihiri ka bɛ tumdi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu tuma maa.
en: Shaphan the secretary then went to the king and reported this to him: Your officials have released the money that was found in the temple and have handed it over to those who supervise the work in the LORDs temple.

dag: Nir yi nya o suhu ni bɔri shɛli, di nyaɣisila o sani, amaa nir yi chɛ zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu, di nyɛla din chihira jɛra sani.
en: A desire fulfilled is pleasant, but fools find deviating from evil disgusting.

dag: yɛra, Mbaye! Mbaye, tin titali din daa ye binyɛr piɛlli mini ago ni mulifu, ka salima ni waya ni kuɣ viɛla bina nyaɣim di luɣilikam la!.
en: Then they shouted, Pity the great city of Babylon! She dressed in fine linen and wore purple and scarlet cloth. She had jewelry made of gold and precious stones and pearls.

dag: Ka Yisa daa bɔhi ba, Yi yipa baŋ yɛla ŋɔ zaa gbinni bebɔ? Ka bɛ saɣi, Iin, ti Duuma.
en: Do you understand these things? Jesus asked them. Yes, they answered.

dag: Naawuni ʒila o nam ʒiishee din be kasi la. Ŋuna n-nyɛ zuliya kam zaa naa.
en: God rules the nations from his sacred throne.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan laɣim Izraɛl tɔbutuhiri biinsi ninvuɣ tuhi pihita.
en: David again gathered all the best soldiers in Israel. There were , men.

dag: Bɛ maanila niriba ansarisi ka tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri; bɛ nyɛla karimbaannim bɛn lɔri niriba nahiŋgu nia biɛri.
en: They scoff and talk so cruel; from their privileged positions they plan oppression.

dag: Gadamanim yɔhindi bɛ ʒiʒiinitaba n-zaŋdi ba doli so shɛli din bi viɛla.
en: Violent people deceive their friends and lead them to disaster.

dag: Dama bindirigu bi kpɛrila ninsal suhu ni, amaa o pul ni ka di kpɛra, ka gariti yira.
en: Thats because it doesnt enter into the heart but into the stomach, and it goes out into the sewer. By saying this, Jesus declared that no food could contaminate a person in Gods sight.

dag: ka Gomna Pailɛt lan bɔh o yaha, A ka noli din ni garigi? A bi wum bɛ ni fiɣisir a shɛm maa.
en: Pilate asked him again, Arent you going to answer? What about all these accusations.

dag: Ka ti niŋ yɛda ka mi ni nyini n-nyɛ Naawuni Ninvuɣ Suŋ so o ni timna.
en: And now we believe and know that you are the Holy One who has come from God.

dag: Ka Mɔab kpamba mini Midian kpamba maa daa zaŋ baɣibuɣiri liɣiri chaŋ Balaam sani ti yɛl o Balak ni yɛli shɛm.
en: The leaders of Moab and Midian left. They went to talk to Balaam. They carried with them money to pay him for his service. Then they told him what Balak had said.

dag: ka turi Naawuni ŋun su alizanda ŋɔ bɛ ni daa nya biɛrim shɛli maa mini yuma din gbahi ba la zuɣu, ka zaɣisi ni bɛ ku niŋ tuuba bɛ tuumbiɛri zuɣu.
en: And because of their painful sores, they cursed the God who rules in heaven. But still they did not stop doing evil things.

dag: A bi nya bɛ ni tumdi tuun shɛŋa Juda fɔntinsi ni mini Jɛrusalɛm pala zuɣu?.
en: I know you see what they are doing in the towns of Judah. You can see what they are doing in the streets of the city of Jerusalem.

dag: Nir yi zu nahu bee piɛɣu nti kɔhi bee nti kɔrigi, di simdi ka o yo niɣ anu naɣ yino maa zuɣu, ka yo piɛr anahi piɛ yino maa zuɣu. Di simdi ka o yo di samli maa, ka o yi ka binshɛli din ni yo samli maa, dindina bɛn kɔhim o n-yo o zubu maa samli.
en: When someone steals an ox or a sheep and then slaughters or sells it, the thief must pay back five oxen for the one ox or four sheep for the one sheep.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd ni daa ti nya Yisa di daa niŋ o nyaɣisim pam, dama o daa pun wum o yɛla ka di wɔɣa, ka bɔri ni o nya o ni o nini, ka daa lan tɛhiri ni di pa shɛli Yisa ni tum alahiziba tuun shɛli ka o nya.
en: Herod was very pleased when he saw Jesus, because he had heard about him and had been wanting to see him for a long time. He was hoping to see Jesus perform some miracle.

dag: Nyama, ti ni daa nya laɣ shɛli ti kpalansi noya ni la, ti daa ʒi li yi Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni labina ti ti a, ka bɔzuɣu ka ti ni ti zu anzinfa bee salima a dan yiŋa?.
en: The silver that we found at the top of our sacks, weve just brought back to you from the land of Canaan. We didnt steal silver or gold from your masters house.

dag: Ka Mikaya daa garigi yɛl o, Nyama, a yi ti zo n-kpe duu puuni ti sɔɣi, dindali maa ka a yɛn baŋ.
en: Micaiah answered, You will find out on the day you try to hide in an inner room.

dag: Zaŋm a nini lab kpaŋa ka chɛ ba, ka bɛ di bɛ dabisa nyaɣisim kaman tumtumdiba la.
en: Why don't you leave us alone and let us find some happiness while we toil and labor?.

dag: ka o lan labi kpe saria karibu shee maa ti bɔhi Yisa, Tiŋkani ka a yina? Ka Yisa bi garig o shɛli.
en: So he went back inside the palace and asked Jesus, Where are you from? But Jesus did not answer him.

dag: Dinzuɣu dindali maa ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim nyaŋ Keenan Naa Jabin.
en: That same day God defeated the Canaanite King Jabin while the Israelites looked on, and his army was no longer powerful enough to attack the Israelites.

dag: O ni daa yuri yi yaannim la zuɣu ka o daa pii bɛ bihi bɛ kalinsi nyaaŋa, ka daa be yi sani n-yihi ya Ijipti na. O daa zaŋ o yiko.
en: He loved your ancestors. That is why he chose you, their descendants. And that is why he brought you out of Egypt. He was with you and brought you out with his great power.

dag: Di nyɛla talahi ni ŋun pahi, ka man filim.
en: Jesus must become more important, while I become less important.

dag: N daa yɛn malila sara, ka zuŋɔ n niŋ n ni daa po pɔri ni n niŋ shɛli maa.
en: Ive made a sacrifice of well-being; today I fulfilled my solemn promises.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni dɔɣiri bidib shɛb mini bipuɣin shɛb kpe mini bɛ manim ni bɛ banim bɛn dɔɣi ba polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: I will tell you what is going to happen to the children who are born here and to their parents.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Nazari nir maa pini o zuɣu din nyɛ o ni zaŋ shɛli ti Naawuni maa Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni, ka zaŋ o zuɣu din nyɛ o ni zaŋ shɛli ti Naawuni maa zabiri maa niŋ biɛrisuŋ sara maligu la buɣim ni.
en: After that, you will stand at the entrance to the sacred tent, shave your head, and put the hair in the fire where the priest has offered the sacrifice to ask my blessing.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma yi dundɔntitali ni zaŋ kpa nuzaa polo nti zaŋ ma kpe du shɛŋa din daa be Naawuni jɛmbu duu sambani tooni polo mini du shɛli din daa be nuzaa polo tooni.
en: Then he led me north to the outer courtyard and brought me into the set of chambers opposite the yard and the structure to the north.

dag: Ka a ŋariŋduhiriba kuhigu vuri daa chɛ ka teeku duli sɔhigi.
en: The shouts of your drowning crew were heard on the shore.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ din ni tiɣi Yawɛ nini gari nir yi zaŋ naɣila lantabili bee naɣilaa ni yila ni takarifiɛma mali sara.
en: because that is more pleasing to the LORD than an ox, more pleasing than a young bull with full horns and hooves.

dag: Neemi n nina ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka n nya alahiziba binshɛŋa din be a zaligu puuni.
en: Open my eyes so I can examine the wonders of your Instruction!.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Aduna, A bi yɛn mali tiŋgbani bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bee m-mali tarili bɛ sani. Mani n-nyɛ a tarili ni a ni su shɛli Izraɛlnim sani.
en: You will not receive any land in Israel as your own. I am the Lord , and I will give you whatever you need.

dag: Ijipti ŋmanila naɣisa viɛlli, ka viɛbiga yi nuzaa polo na ni o ti tabil o.
en: An enemy from the north will attack you, beautiful Egypt, like a fly biting a cow.

dag: Amaa chɛ ka bɛnkam zaa ka a sanna suhuri paligi ka bɛ mali suhupiɛlli. Chɛ ka bɛnkam zaa yur a tiliginsim la kul yɛra, Yawɛ galisiya.
en: But may those who come to you be happy and rejoice. May those who love being saved by you always be able to say, Praise the Lord .

dag: Yi ni so shiri zaŋd o mabia tahiri sariakaritiba bɛn pa Yisa yɛdaniŋdiba sani ni bɛ ti kari ba saria?.
en: But now one believer goes to court against another, and you let people who are not believers judge their case!.

dag: Jɔn daa di o shɛhira kuhi yɛli, Ŋumbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ n ni daa yɛli so yɛla ni ŋun be n nyaaŋa kanna gari ma la, dama o daa be saha shɛli n ni daa na kani.
en: John told people about him. He said loudly, This is the one I was talking about when I said, The one who is coming after me is greater than I am, because he was living before I was even born.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl tuma kpamba maa daa chaŋ Firawuna sani nti fabili niŋ o ka yɛl o, Wula ka a niŋdi tinim bɛn nyɛ a tumtumdiba ŋɔ lala?.
en: Then the Israelite supervisors came and pleaded to Pharaoh, Why do you treat your servants like this?.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Otiniɛl Kɛnaz bia maa daa kpi.
en: and Israel was at peace until Othniel died about years later.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛlnim na kul mali duŋ ni Dauda yilinim hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Ever since that time the people of the northern kingdom of Israel have been in rebellion against the dynasty of David.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Abishai, Di ku o, dama ŋuni n-lee ni tooi zaŋ o nuu shihi Yawɛ ni booi kpam bahi ninvuɣ so zuɣu ni, ka ku mali taali.
en: Don't kill him! David whispered back. The Lord will punish anyone who kills his chosen king.

dag: Di zaŋya bɛ ni ja biŋkɔb so lana bee bɛ ni ŋmahim biŋkɔb so lana bee bɛ ni chahi biŋkɔb so lana bee bɛ ni ŋmaai biŋkɔb so lana m-mali sara ti Yawɛ bee m-mali sara yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Do not offer to the Lord any animal whose testicles have been crushed, cut, bruised, or torn off. This is not permitted in your land.

dag: Di saha yin yɛlimiy o, A dabili Yaakubu n-su ba, ka zaŋ ba ti ti ni ti zaŋ ba na ti ti nyini n-dan Iso pini, ka din pahi nyɛla, omaŋmaŋ doli ti nyaaŋa na. .
en: say, They are your servant Jacobs, a gift sent to my master Esau. And Jacob is actually right behind us.

dag: Di saha ka n daa tɛhi n ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa yɛla ni n ni daa kpaŋ mmaŋ shɛm niŋ li, ka di zaa kul nyɛla din ka buchi. Di ŋmanila nir yi zɔri doli pɔhim, ka binshɛli ka dunia ŋɔ ni mali buchi.
en: But when I surveyed all that my hands had done, and what I had worked so hard to achieve, I realized that it was pointless—a chasing after wind. Nothing is to be gained under the sun.

dag: Ka Liya daa niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol o yuli Rubin. Dama o daa yɛliya, Yawɛ nya m muɣisigu ni nyɛ shɛli; Yɛlimaŋli, n yidan ni yu ma pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Leah became pregnant and gave birth to a son. She named him Reuben because she said, The LORD saw my harsh treatment, and now my husband will love me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa mali salima bans ayi n-zaŋ li gɔhi binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la bɔɣusapima zuɣu tan tolima ayi la tiŋli di tooni polo miri di tuɣibu shee binyɛribila maa shɛlɔrigu la zuɣusaa polo.
en: They also put two gold rings on the bottom of the shoulder pieces on the front of the ephod. These rings were near the fastener, just above the cloth belt.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni zaŋ o chaŋ luɣ shɛli maa ka o ti yɛn kpi. O nini ku lan nya o tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ yaha.
en: He will die where hes been exiled and never see this land again.

dag: Ninvuɣ suma chɛri fali zaani bɛ yaansi, amaa alahichinim buni nyɛla wuntizɔriba ni ti yɛn su shɛli.
en: It is good to have something to pass down to your grandchildren. But wealth hidden away by sinners will be given to those who live right.

dag: Niriba daa mi tiŋgbɔŋ maa gba la Rɛfaim, dama Rɛfaimnima n-daa pun be nimaani, amaa Ammɔnnim daa yi booni ba la Zamzumimnima.
en: That country is also known as the Land of Rephaim. The Rephaites lived there in the past. The people of Ammon called them the Zamzummites.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sab bɛ ni yɛli ni Yisa tum taal shɛli maa tabil o dapulli maa zuɣusaa. Di ni daa sab shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yɛhudianim Naa.
en: There was a sign with the charge against him written on it. It said, the king of the jews .

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa lan tirisi tooni ha ti zani luɣ muɣiliŋga shee ka palo lan kani ka nir ni tooi birigi nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo.
en: The angel moved once more and stood in a spot so narrow that there was no room for the donkey to go around.

dag: Ka lala ka yi shiri yuri yi mabihi zaa bɛn be Masidɔnia tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa; amaa ti mabihi, ti kpamdi ya jaande ni yi kul niŋmi lala pahima.
en: and you already have shown your love for all his people in Macedonia. But, my dear friends, we ask you to do even more.

dag: Bɛ ni ti kpi m-pahi bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu. Bɛ zaŋ Ijiptinim tila takɔbi ni bɛ gbahi bɛ mini bɛ tɔbbihi n-zaŋ ba chaŋ.
en: Egypt will go to be with all the other men who were killed in battle. The enemy has pulled her and all her people away.

dag: Amaa man kul tumdila din tuhi. Zom ma nambɔɣu, ka fa ma bahi.
en: But I am innocent, so be kind to me and save me.

dag: Bihi banim mini bihi manim nya filiŋ a ni. Ka bɛ fari saamba bɛn be bɛ sani nɛma, ka niŋdi kpibisi mini pakoya din bi tuhi.
en: None of you honor your parents, and you cheat foreigners, orphans, and widows.

dag: Niriba pam n-nyɛ naa jilima, amaa niriba yi kani, naa pala shɛli.
en: A kings glory is a large population, but a dwindling people is a rulers ruin.

dag: Mani m-mi o, dama n yila o sanna, ŋun mi n-nyɛ ŋun tim ma na.
en: I know him because I am from him. He is the one who sent me.

dag: Di lan chaŋya ti chɛ mɔri na ti ti ba ka bɛ ŋma bilichiisi maa. Chɛliya ka bɛ maŋmaŋ chani ti chɛri mɔri maa na.
en: Stop giving the people straw for making bricks. Make them go and find it for themselves.

dag: ni Arivadnim ni Zɛmarinim ni Hamatinima. Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Keenannim daa ti yɛligi chaŋ katiŋa.
en: Arvadites, Zemarites, and Hamathites. The families of Canaan spread to different parts of the world.

dag: Yisa nyaandoliba maa ni daa wum lala maa ka dabiɛm kpe ba, ka bɛ gbani n-zaŋ bɛ nini kpa tiŋa.
en: When the disciples heard the voice, they were so afraid they fell flat on the ground.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kul piligi yiini wumpaɣibo yilli maa, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka mbusim lu Ammɔnnim mini Mɔabnim ni Ɛdom zoli zuɣunim bɛn daa laɣim kana ti liri Judanim maa zuɣu, ka bɛ daa birim ka ŋmaligi lu tab zuɣu ku taba.
en: When they began to sing, the Lord threw the invading armies into a panic.

dag: Mira! Di lan tum tuumbiɛri; di zuɣu ka bɛ zaŋ wahala zahim a maa.
en: Be on guard! Don't turn to evil as a way of escape.

dag: Hal n ni kul mali yɛlimaŋli maa zaa yoli, bɛ boli ma ʒirilana. Hal n ni bi tum alahichi maa yoli, n dɔro maa ka tibi kpaŋ.
en: He asks, How could I lie and say I am wrong? I am fatally wounded, but I am sinless.

dag: Dinzuɣu deemiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ noli, ka dol o fukumsi zaligunim min o zaligu shɛŋa zaa n ni zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: so obey him and keep all his laws that I am giving you today.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka a jilima kul be sahakam. Yawɛ, chɛ ka a suhu piɛl a tuma zuɣu.
en: May the glory of the Lord last forever! May the Lord be happy with what he has made!.

dag: Zom ma nambɔɣu, ka m be, dama n suhu yu a zaligunim maa pam.
en: I love to obey your Law! Have mercy and let me live.

dag: ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu n-nya ka naɣikɔhiriba mini piɛkɔhiriba ni ŋmaŋkɔhiriba be di puuni m-pahi laɣitaɣiriba bɛn ʒi bɛ teebuya gbini.
en: There in the Temple area he saw men selling cattle, sheep, and doves. He saw others sitting at tables, exchanging and trading peoples money.

dag: Ka n nyee daa ti nyɔni piɛguliba ata shɛb bɛn daa je ma, ka n kari ba gol yini puuni.
en: I fired the three shepherds all in one month. I got angry at the sheep, and they began to hate me.

dag: Bɛ daa yi ŋmɛrila mɔɣilɔnim jɛmd a, amaa pumpɔŋɔ nyini m-be kpiimba biɛhigu shee ŋɔ. Binneen yiɣira bɛn ŋmani zunzuya n-nyɛ a bindoo, ka zunzuya nyɛ a chinchini ka a zaŋ pili.
en: Your pride and your music have ended here in the world of the dead. Worms are your blanket, maggots are your bed.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ mali zoligɔnim kaman nyiŋgokɔriti la n-zaŋ li pa daantalisi maa zuɣusaa, ka daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ daanya mali pumpɔrinchihi kɔtomsi bini kɔbiga n-zaŋ li yiliyili zoligɔnim maa.
en: He made chains in a necklace and put them on the tops of the columns. He made pomegranates and put them on the chains.

dag: din galisi neei Masia kum ni n-zaŋ o ʒili o nudirigu polo alizanda ni la nyɛla yim.
en: Gods power was at work in Christ when God raised him from the dead and sat him at Gods right side in the heavens.

dag: Ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba daa be Ofɛl, ka daa mali me hal ti paai Kom Dunɔdali din daa be wulimpuhili polo la mini pia din daa du pam la shee.
en: and the temple servants living on Ophel made repairs up to the point opposite the Water Gate to the east and the projecting tower.

dag: Musa ni daa tim ninvuɣ shɛb ka bɛ chaŋ ti puɣisi nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa, bɛ puuni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa ʒi lahiba biɛɣu na nti yɛli zaŋ chaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa polo n-chɛ ka niriba maa zaa ŋum bɛ kparima ni niŋ Yawɛ la.
en: The men Moses had sent to explore the land brought back a false report which caused the people to complain against the Lord . And so the Lord struck them with a disease, and they died.

dag: Man ŋun nyɛ kpɛm la n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri n zo Gaiɔs ŋun nyɛ n ni yuri so ni yɛlimaŋli la.
en: From the Elder— To my dear Gaius, whom I truly love.

dag: Bɛ daa lan yɛli, Ka yi nini yi tiɣi tinim bɛn nyɛ yi daba ŋɔ, yin zaŋmiya tiŋgbani maa ti ti ka di leei ti dini, ka di zaŋya ti du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ.
en: Please give us this land as our property, and do not make us cross the Jordan River and settle there.

dag: Yi yi kariti ma saria bee dunianim yi kariti ma saria m baɣa kani; hal n gba kariti mmaŋ saria.
en: Now, I am not at all concerned about being judged by you or by any human standard; I don't even pass judgment on myself.

dag: M mabihi, din bahindi nyaaŋa nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: Maliya suhupiɛlli ti Duuma ni. Di pala yɛl tibisili n sani ni n lab sabi n ni daa pun sab yɛl shɛŋa tin ya la n-lan tin ya, dama di nyɛla din ni gbibi ya.
en: Finally, my dear friends, be glad that you belong to the Lord. It doesn't bother me to write the same things to you that I have written before. In fact, it is for your own good.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa zaŋ ya tim tiŋgban nɛli din galisi ka mali dabiɛm, ka nyɛ tiŋgban kuŋ puuni gari wɔɣ biɛri mini nɔnsi ni be tiŋgban shɛli ni. O daa chɛ ka kom yi chɛribo kuɣa ni na ka yi nyu.
en: He led you through that great and terrible desert where there were poisonous snakes and scorpions. The ground was dry, and there was no water anywhere. But he gave you water out of a solid rock.

dag: Dɔbba kalinli daa nyɛla kaman tusaanu laasabu. Ka Yisa yɛl o nyaandoliba maa ni bɛ chɛ ka salo maa ʒini gbilligbilli kaman ninvuɣ pihinunu laasabu.
en: There were about , men in the crowd. Jesus said to his disciples, Tell the people to sit in groups of .

dag: A buhi bihim ni saɣ a min a yiŋnim bindirigu, ka dih a daba bɛn nyɛ paɣiba.
en: There will be enough goats milk for your food, for the food of your house, and to nourish your young women.

dag: ka bɛ ba Ifriim daa kum bɛ zuɣu dabisi gbaliŋ, ka o dɔɣiriba daa kana ti maag o suhu la.
en: Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him.

dag: Ka tin shɛŋa din gba lan pahi n-daa nyɛ: Halihul mini Bɛtizur ni Gɛdɔr.
en: Halhul, Beth-zur, Gedor.

dag: Ka Firawuna pipia daa be n nuu ni, ka m pɔhi wain tiwala maa kahim di kom niŋ Firawuna pipia maa ni n-zaŋ li ti ti ŋun Firawuna.
en: I held the king's cup and squeezed the grapes into it, then I gave the cup to the king.

dag: Zaligu shɛŋa yi ni yɛn doli viɛnyɛliŋga Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya ni yi ʒini di ni saha shɛli zaa yi ni yɛn be dunia yili m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Now I'll tell you the laws and teachings that you have to obey as long as you live. Your ancestors worshiped the Lord , and he is giving you this land.

dag: Bɛn tɛha bi zilima bɛn kul niŋdila binshɛɣukam yɛda, amaa yɛnnim bɛn kpahindila yɛla ni chani shɛm.
en: Fools believe every word they hear, but wise people think carefully about everything.

dag: Hal Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-su zuɣusaa ni zuɣusaa mi zuɣusaa mini dunia ni binshɛɣukam din be di ni zaa;.
en: To the Lord belong even the highest heavens; the earth is his also, and everything on it.

dag: Ka di ni yiri ninvuɣ so tooni na maa yi ti nya omaŋa, ŋun zaŋmi daba ayopɔin niŋ o daɣiri ni yibu dabisa, ka paɣ o situra, ka su ko viɛlli n-yi daɣiri ni.
en: After the man is cured of his discharge, he must wait seven days and then wash his clothes and take a bath in fresh spring water, and he will be ritually clean.

dag: Binzusa maa yi be yi sani, yi ni lihiri li ka teeri Yawɛ zaligunim yɛla ka dol li, ka ku doli yi suhuyubu ni yi nini ni tiɣi shɛli.
en: You will be able to look at these tassels and remember all the commands that the Lord has given you. Then you will obey the commands. You will not do wrong by forgetting about the commands and doing the things that your own bodies and eyes want.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa yɛliya, Nyama, di ku yuui ka n kana! Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli anabitali yɛligu din be litaafi ŋɔ ni mal alibarika.
en: Listen, I am coming soon! Great blessings belong to the one who obeys the words of prophecy in this book.

dag: Ka malaika maa lan yɛli Zakaria, Mani n-nyɛ malaika Gabirɛl ŋun ʒe Naawuni tooni la, ka o tim ma na ni n ti ti a lahibal suŋ ŋɔ.
en: The angel replied, I am Gabriel. I stand in Gods presence. I was sent to speak to you and to bring this good news to you.

dag: Amaa a yi saɣisi ninvuɣ biɛri ni bɛ zo n-yi bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali maa ni, ka ninvuɣ biɛri maa bi chɛ bɛ tuumbiɛri maa, bɛ ni kpi bɛ tuumbiɛri maa ni, amaa ka nyini lee tiligi a nyɛvili.
en: If you do warn an evil person and he doesn't stop sinning, he will die, still a sinner, but your life will be spared.

dag: A zaligu maa yi di pala n suhu ni yu shɛli, n naan bahi yoli n nandahima ŋɔ ni.
en: If your law had not been the source of my joy, I would have died from my sufferings.

dag: Dahin shɛli yuŋ ka o daa ti chaŋ Yisa sani ti yɛl o, N dana, ti mi ni a nyɛla karimba ŋun yi Naawuni sanna, dama so kani ŋun ni tooi wuhi shihir shɛŋa a ni wuhiri ŋɔ ka pa ni Naawuni m-be o sani.
en: One night he came to Jesus and said, Teacher, we know that you are a teacher sent from God. No one can do these miraculous signs that you do unless they have Gods help.

dag: Barizillai daa nyɛla yuun pihinii nira, ŋuna n-daa ti bo bindira n-zaŋ ti Naa Dauda saha shɛl o ni daa be Mahanaim la, dama o daa nyɛla bundana.
en: Barzillai was very old, years of age. He had supported the king during his stay at Mahanaim because Barzillai was a very wealthy man.

dag: Bɛ kul niŋdila nirilim sahakam, ka zaŋdi bɛ liɣiri paŋdi niriba, ka alibarika be bɛ bihi ni.
en: They are always gracious and generous. Their children are a blessing.

dag: Nyin ŋun be puri ni ŋɔ, n zɔnim wumd a yɛtɔɣa; chɛ ka n gba wum li.
en: There you are, sitting in the garden. Friends are listening to your voice. Let me hear it too!.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila yuri; bɛ guurimi kaman bɛ ni bari wɔr shɛb tuhiri tɔbu la.
en: They look like horses; they run like war-horses.

dag: Paɣimiya yi nuhi maa ka di yi. Chɛliya yi ni tumdi tuumbiɛ shɛŋa ka n nini nyari maa tumbu. Chɛliya tuumbiɛri maa tumbu.
en: Wash! Be clean! Remove your ugly deeds from my sight. Put an end to such evil.

dag: Amaa Ɛlihu ni daa nya ka niriba ata maa ni so bi yaag o noli garigi maa zuɣu ka o suhu daa yiɣisi.
en: When Elihu saw that there had been no response in the speeches of the three men, he became very angry.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ baŋ ni o bi yɛri ba mi ni bɛ miri bɔrɔbɔro dabindi, amaa ni Farisiinim mini Sadusiinim wuhibu yɛla ka o yɛri maa.
en: Finally, the disciples understood that Jesus wasn't talking about the yeast used to make bread, but about the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

dag: Lɛvinim tiŋgbani ni ti do m-baɣi maligumaaniba tiŋgbani maa, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ kilomita pinaayi ni pirigili, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ kilomita anu. Di wɔɣilim zaa ni ti nyɛla kilomita pinaayi ni pirigili, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ kilomita pia.
en: Next to the land for the priests, the Levites will have a share of the land. It will be , cubits long and , cubits wide. They will get the full length and width of this land—, cubits long and , cubits wide.

dag: Ka Jɛrubaal Jɔash bia maa daa kul omaŋmaŋ yiŋ ti ʒini.
en: Gideon went back to his own home and lived there.

dag: Ka Imɛr bia Zadok daa mali me o yiŋ tooni m-pani bɛ zuɣu. Ka Shɛkania bia Shɛmaya ŋun daa guli Wulimpuhili polo Dunɔdal la daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu.
en: Zadok son of Immer repaired the section in front of his house. Shemaiah son of Shecaniah repaired the next section. Shemaiah was the guard of the East Gate.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ li ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nyɛ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa malibu tuma zuɣulaannim maa ka bɛ mi daa zaŋ li ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa maani Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni bɛ zaŋ li mal li ka di niŋ yaa.
en: Then the money was turned over to the men who supervised the repairs to the temple. They used some of it to pay the workers.

dag: A yɛliya ni a ni du nti tam sagbana zuɣu n-zaŋ amaŋ leei kaman Zallakudura Naa.
en: Ill go up to the cloud tops; Ill be like the Most High!.

dag: Lala ka yi ni ti niŋ n-yihi ŋun ka taali maa ʒim yihibu taali yi sunsuuni. Dama di simdi ni yi niŋ din tuhi Yawɛ sani.
en: And so, by doing what the Lord requires, you will not be held responsible for the murder.

dag: Bɛ ni teei wula, ka bɛ viɛlim ti ŋman olivi tihi viɛlim. Ka bɛ nyom ti viɛl kaman Lɛbanɔn nyom la.
en: His branches will grow, and he will be like a beautiful olive tree. He will be like the sweet smell from the cedar trees of Lebanon.

dag: O tɔbutuhiriba nyɔtaɣirisi nyɛla zaɣ ʒiɛhi, ka o tɔbbihi ye gbaɣino ʒiɛhi. Bɛ yi mali bɛ chɛchɛbunsi shili zali dahin shɛli kur shɛŋa din tab li nyaɣisirimi. Ka sapashinnim yuri yiɣira.
en: The enemy soldiers carry red shields and wear uniforms of red. They are preparing to attack! Their chariots flash like fire! Their horses prance!.

dag: Aripakishad ni daa ti paai yuun pihitanaanu saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Shɛla.
en: When Arpachshad was years old, he had a son, Shelah;.

dag: Nyama, Yawɛ ni gbib buɣim kana. O chɛchɛbunsi yuri zɔbu yɛn ŋmanila pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga, ka o zaŋ li kana ti darig o suhu ni yiɣisi bahi ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu tibili.
en: The LORD will come with fire, Gods chariots like a windstorm, to repay in hot anger, to rebuke with fiery flames.

dag: Tinim bɛn nyɛ Yɛhudianim malila so shɛli din so ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim dini? Aai, ti bi mali so shɛli din so. Di bemi kaman n ni pun yɛli shɛm la, di yi nyɛla Yɛhudianim bee bɛn pa Yɛhudianima, alahichi nyaŋ bɛ zaa.
en: What does all this mean? Does it mean that we Jews are better off than the Gentiles? No, it doesn't! Jews, as well as Gentiles, are ruled by sin, just as I have said.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Wula ka a lee niŋ ka a nina maa neei.
en: They asked, What happened? How did you get your sight.

dag: Ahazia ma Atalia ni daa nya ka o bia lan kani maa, ka o bahi noli ni bɛ kum Juda nabihi zaa.
en: Athaliah was Ahaziahs mother. When she saw that her son was dead, she killed all the kings children in Judah.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa ti kani, ka Izraɛlnim zaa laɣimna nti kum o kuli ka sɔɣ o omaŋmaŋ ya Rama. Sool daa pun karila bukpahinim mini jinwariba Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa.
en: Now Samuel had died, and all Israel mourned him and buried him in Ramah, his hometown. And Saul had banned all mediums and diviners from the land.

dag: Yɛlim nachimbihi la gba ni bɛ gbib bɛmaŋa.
en: Likewise, encourage the younger men to be sensible.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yi yi yɛn suhi Naawuni, yin yɛlimiya ŋ-ŋɔ: Ti Ba Naawuni, chɛ ka a yuli du, ka chɛ ka a nam kana.
en: Jesus said to them, When you pray, say this: Father: May your holy name be honored; may your Kingdom come.

dag: Ka naa guliba sapashin kpɛm maa daa gbahi maligumaaniba zuɣulan Sɛraya mini Zɛfania ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana m-pa o zuɣu la ni dunɔguliba ata.
en: Next, Nebuzaradan arrested Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah his assistant, and three temple officials.

dag: Zuliya shɛb ku lan kana ti ŋme ba tɔbu ka di bɛ nɛma, ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni biŋkɔbiri ku lan gbahi ba. Bɛ ni ti beni ni alaafee ka so ku lan kpɛhi ba dabiɛm.
en: The nations will no longer prey on them, and wild animals will no longer devour them. They will live in safety, with no one to trouble them.

dag: N ni darigi dunia ŋɔ nim tibili bɛ tuumbiɛri zuɣu, ka darigi ninvuɣ biɛri tibili bɛ tuumbiɛri zuɣu. N ni siɣisi karimbaannim mini bɛnkam duhiri bɛmaŋa ni putɔɣunima.
en: The Lord says, I will cause bad things to happen to the world. I will punish the evil people for their sin. I will make proud people lose their pride. I will stop the bragging of cruel people.

dag: Gɔhi ni ti zibigi bɛ nam yiya ni mini goma ni gili bɛ tin shɛŋa ni, ka yɔbahi mini viri ni be nimaani.
en: Thorns and thistles will grow up in all the palaces and walled towns, and jackals and owls will live in them.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ dunia ŋɔ nanim ni tum zina ni paɣ so, ka dunianim zaa nyu o zina maa wain n-kul la.
en: The kings of the earth have committed sexual immorality with her, and those who live on earth have become drunk with the wine of her whoring.

dag: Nyini n-wuhiri niriba tusatusa a yurilim din bi taɣira, amaa ka lee darigiri bihi tibili bɛ laamba taali zuɣu. Nyini Naawuni ŋun galisi, ka mali yiko, ka a yuli booni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ.
en: You have shown constant love to thousands, but you also punish people for the sins of their parents. You are a great and powerful God; you are the Lord Almighty.

dag: Nyini n-daa zaŋ a kpiɔŋ pirigi teeku kom buyi; ka daa ŋme m-bɔri wɔɣ biɛri la zuɣuri kom ni.
en: By your power you made a path through the sea, and you smashed the heads of sea monsters.

dag: Di saha di simdi ni maligumaana lih o. Ka dɔro din mɔr o zuɣu palo maa ni bee o gbɛ palo maa ni yi nyɛla zaɣ piɛlli din mooi, ka ŋmani niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu din be niŋgbuŋ ni.
en: The priest shall examine you, and if there is a reddish-white sore.

dag: M mabihi, ti bɔri ni yi baŋ Naawuni daalibarika din be Masidɔnia tiŋgbɔŋ ni cheechinim ni yɛla.
en: My friends, we want you to know that the churches in Macedonia have shown others God's gift of undeserved grace.

dag: ka zaŋ namda kura din chahi ka bɛ shɛnshe li piri; ka zaŋ binyɛr chɛra ye, ka bɛ bindira zaa kul kuui mili ka kpe yue.
en: They had worn-out, patched sandals on their feet and were wearing worn-out clothes. All the bread in their supplies was dry and crumbly.

dag: Ka Batishiiba yɛli, Di viɛla, n ni yɛli naa ti a.
en: Bathsheba said, Okay; Ill speak to the king for you.

dag: Zɛdɛkia daa lan zaɣisi ni o ku jɛm Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ŋun daa chɛ ka o po Naawuni ni o ni jɛm o la, ka daa lan niŋ karimbaani ni tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni o ku labi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni la sani.
en: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia had forced Zedekiah to promise in God's name that he would be loyal. Zedekiah was stubborn and refused to turn back to the Lord God of Israel, so he rebelled against Nebuchadnezzar.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni daalikauli pal shɛli o ni lo n ʒim ni. Dina n-nyɛ n ʒi shɛli din ti yɛn yi n niŋgbuŋ ni niriba pam zuɣu.
en: Then he said, This is my blood, which is poured out for many people, and with it God makes his agreement.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli ba, Guhimiya ka m-bɔhi Yawɛ wum o ni yɛn yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ yi polo.
en: Moses said to them, Wait while I listen for what the LORD will command concerning you.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Yi ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb sɔŋ di puuni maa n-nyɛ nimdi, ka tiŋ maa mi nyɛ duɣu. Amaa bɛ ni ti yihi yinim di puuni.
en: Therefore, the LORD God proclaims: The city is the cooking pot, and the ones you have slain in it are the meat. But you will be taken out of it.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli daadamnima, Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni zɔbo n-nyɛ yɛm ka tuumbiɛri chɛbu mi nyɛ baŋsim.
en: Then he said to humans, To fear and respect the Lord is wisdom. To turn away from evil is understanding.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Musa, O ba yi di tuhi nintɔri vie o ninni, vi naan ku gbaag o paai daba ayopɔin? Chɛ ka bɛ yih o kpaŋ daba ayopɔin, di nyaaŋa ka yi naanyi zaŋ o labina.
en: But the Lord replied, Miriam would be disgraced for seven days if her father had punished her by spitting in her face. So make her stay outside the camp for seven days, before coming back.

dag: ni n ku zaŋ a gali bee a namdili mia bee a ni su binshɛlikam, ka a ti yɛli, Mani n-chɛ ka Ibram leei bundana.
en: that I will not keep anything of yours, not even a thread or a sandal strap. Then you can never say, I am the one who made Abram rich.

dag: Ka maligumaana ni zaŋ o nubil suɣi ʒim maa n-zaŋ vie binyila din be bɛ ni nyɔri sara maligu buɣim bimbin shɛli zuɣu la, ka kpaai ʒi shɛli din kpalim bahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara maligu nyɔri buɣim sara maligu bimbin shɛli zuɣu la gbini.
en: The priest will take some of the blood of the sin offering on his finger and put it on the corners of the altar of burnt offering. He will pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa da tiŋgbani Hamɔr ŋun daa nyɛ Shɛkɛm ba la bihi sani anzinfa laɣibaligu kɔbiga n-ti o suɣa zali nimaani.
en: The land where he camped was owned by the descendants of Hamor, the father of Shechem. So Jacob paid them pieces of silver for the property.

dag: Ka o garigi bɔhi ba, Yi na bi karim ni Naawuni ŋun daa nam ninsalinim piligu ni la daa nam ba la doo mini paɣa?.
en: Jesus answered, Surely you have read this in the Scriptures: When God made the world, he made people male and female.

dag: Ka bɛ daa labi nti yɛli bɛ nyaandol tab la, amaa ka bɛ daa bi niŋ bɛ gba yɛda.
en: These followers went back to the other followers and told them what happened. Again, the followers did not believe them.

dag: Yɛm shee wɔɣa, ka di biɛhigu shee zilim pam; ka di bo n-nya to pam.
en: I cannot understand why things are as they are. It is too hard for anyone to understand.

dag: ka yɛra, Na so ŋun mali ti Duuma yuli kanna ŋɔ mal alibarika! Suhudoo be alizanda ni! Paɣimiya Zallakudura Naa.
en: They said, Blessings on the king who comes in the name of the Lord. Peace in heaven and glory in the highest heavens.

dag: ka Asiriɛl daŋ niriba nyɛ Asiriɛlnima, ka Shɛkɛm daŋ niriba nyɛ Shɛkɛmnima.
en: from Asriel, the Asrielite clan; from Shechem, the Shechemite clan.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, N ni chaŋ ka yi ti bo ma kɔŋ, ka yi ni ti kpi ni yi daalahichi. N ni chani luɣ shɛli yi ku tooi ka nimaani na.
en: Jesus continued, Im going away. You will look for me, and you will die in your sin. Where Im going, you cant come.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yɛli, Mani m-mali n suhu ka di yi daɣiri ni, n yi n daalahichi ni.
en: Can anyone really say that his conscience is clear, that he has gotten rid of his sin?.

dag: Miriya anab ʒirinim bɛn kani yi sanna m-be kaman piɛri n-nyɛ ba, amaa ka lee nyɛ kunduna bɛ suhuri ni la.
en: Be careful of false prophets. They come to you and look gentle like sheep. But they are really dangerous like wolves.

dag: Ka Jaɛl daa yina tuhi Sisɛra soli yɛl o, N dana, ŋmaligim kpe kpe na, ka di chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira. Ka o daa ŋmaligi kpe o sani tanti maa ni; ka paɣ maa ti zaŋ chinchini pil o.
en: She came out to greet him and said, Come in, sir! Please come on in. Don't be afraid. After they had gone inside, Sisera lay down, and Jael covered him with a blanket.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka noli di dunia, ka niriba bɛn be di ni di wahala bɛ taali zuɣu; ka di chɛ ka daadamnim kul filinda hal ka niriba biɛla nti kpalim.
en: Therefore, a curse devours the earth; its inhabitants suffer for their guilt. Therefore, the earths inhabitants dwindle; very few are left.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa tɔɣisi Yaakubu yɛtɔɣa ʒii puuni yuŋ. O daa bol o mi, Yaakubu, Yaakubu. Ka o saɣi ka yɛli, N nyɛ ma.
en: God spoke to him in a vision at night and called, Jacob, Jacob! Yes, here I am, he answered.

dag: O darigi n tibili siɣimsiɣim bushɛm dabisi muni puuni zaa.
en: He turned his hand even against me, over and over again, all day long.

dag: Ka o daa pirigi ba gbilligbilli n-zaŋ ba niŋ o tumtumdiba nuu ni, ka bɛ taɣiri ba gbilligbilli dol taba ka o yɛli ba, Garimiya n tooni chani ka chɛ ka larigim be yi sunsuuni.
en: He divided them into herds and put one of his servants in charge of each herd. He said to them, Go ahead of me, and leave a space between each herd and the one behind it.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti yoog o daazichi duu din nyɛ zuɣusaa ŋɔ tin ya saa yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni saa mibu saha, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ yi tuma zaa ni; ka yi ti dihi zuliya pam samli, amaa yinim ti ku di so samli.
en: He will send rain in season from his rich storehouse in the sky and bless all your work, so that you will lend to many nations, but you will not have to borrow from any.

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ bɛ niɣi mini bɛ neen shɛŋa bɛ ni daa nya Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni la n-kuli Ijipti. Yaakubu daa zaŋla o daŋ zaa bɛn nyɛ.
en: They also had their cattle and everything they owned in the land of Canaan. So Israel went to Egypt with all his children and his family.

dag: Nyama, timbil din ʒiɛya ŋɔ nyɛla din mirina ka nir ni zo nti kpe di ni. Chɛliya ka n zo nti kpe di ni tiligi. Yi nya di ni nyɛ timbil shɛm, ka m mi ni tooi zo nti kpe di ni tiligi.
en: This city here is close enough to flee to, and its small. Its small, right? Let me escape there, and my life will be saved.

dag: A naɣ ni zaŋla a nina lihi nya ninvuɣ biɛri tibidarigibo.
en: You will look and see how the wicked are punished.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ n tampiŋ mini n gooni din gili ma ni ŋun fari ma bahira. Ŋuna n-nyɛ n Naawuni ni n tampiŋ. Naawuni n-nyɛ n ni sɔɣiri so sani ni n nyɔtaɣirigu ni n tiliginsim yiligu ni m birini.
en: You are my mighty rock, my fortress, my protector, the rock where I am safe, my shield, my powerful weapon, and my place of shelter.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Nyamiya, n lɔrila nia ni n chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu lu yi daŋ ŋɔ niriba zuɣu, ka yi ku tooi yi di ni, ka yi mi ku lan tooi chaŋ karimbaan chandi, dama di ti yɛn nyɛla zaɣ biɛɣu saha.
en: That is why the Lord says: Look, I am planning trouble against this family. You will not be able to save yourselves. You will stop being proud, because bad times are coming.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm, yiɣisima, yiɣisima, niŋmi yaa! Naawuni tiŋ kasi ŋɔ, zaŋm a situr suma ye. Chɛfirinim mini daɣirinim ku lan kpe a puuni yaha.
en: Awake, awake, put on your strength, Zion! Put on your splendid clothing, Jerusalem, you holy city; for the uncircumcised and unclean will no longer come into you.

dag: Ka Haga daa boli Yawɛ ŋun tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa maa yuli, Naawuni ŋun nyara; dama o daa yɛlimi, Ka daɣila n shiri nyala Naawuni ka na be n nyɛvil ni n ni nya o maa nyaaŋa.
en: Hagar named the LORD who spoke to her, You are El Roi because she said, Can I still see after he saw me.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa zaɣisi wumbu, ka kul dolila bɛ kal kura la.
en: But the Israelites did not listen. They kept on doing the same things they did before.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa yɛli Samuɛl, Kul suhimi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ tim ti, ka o fa ti Filistianim ŋɔ nuu ni bahi.
en: and said to Samuel, Dont stop praying to the Lord our God for us. Ask him to save us from the Philistines.

dag: Ka bɛnkam nyɛ Yisa Masia ni su shɛba pun zaŋ bɛ niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu mini di kɔre ni di yubu zaa n-kpahi tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: And those who belong to Christ Jesus have put to death their human nature with all its passions and desires.

dag: N ni chɛ li ka di bahi yoli. N ku wahi di nyoya ni bahi bee m-mali di ni, ka suligunyinyari mini gɔhi zooi lim li. N ni chɛ ka sagbana ku tɔɣisi kom bahi di ni.
en: Ill turn it into a ruin; it wont be pruned or hoed, and thorns and thistles will grow up. I will command the clouds not to rain on it.

dag: Lɛvinim mi, Shɛmaya daa nyɛla Hashub bia, ka Hashub nyɛ Azirikam bia, ka Azirikam nyɛ Hashabia bia, ka Hashabia daa nyɛ Mɛrari bia.
en: These are the people from the tribe of Levi who lived in Jerusalem: Hasshubs son, Shemaiah. Hasshub was Azrikams son. Azrikam was Hashabiahs son. Hashabiah was a descendant of Merari.

dag: Dama o yɛliya, Mmaŋmaŋ kpiɔŋ puuni ka n niŋ lala. M mali yɛm, ka mali baŋsim. N daai tiŋgbana tintarisi nahi taba, ka va bɛ nɛma. N niŋmi kaman naɣilaa la n-ʒe n-yiɣisi nanima bɛ nam ʒiishɛhi.
en: He said, By my own strength I have achieved it, and by my wisdom, since Im so clever. I disregarded national boundaries; I raided their treasures; I knocked down their rulers like a bull.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, Wurimmiya Naawuni jɛmbu duu ŋɔ, ka n lan labi me li zali daba ata sunsuuni.
en: Destroy this temple, Jesus answered, and in three days I will build it again.

dag: Ka anabi Aizaia daa ka Naa Hɛzɛkia sanna nti bɔh o, Ya ka niriba ŋɔ lee yina, ka wula ka bɛ lee yɛl a? Ka Hɛzɛkia garigi yɛl o, Bɛ yila katiŋ na; Babilɔn ka bɛ yina.
en: Then the prophet Isaiah went to King Hezekiah and asked, Where did these men come from and what did they say to you? Hezekiah answered, They came from a very distant country, from Babylonia.

dag: Ka yɛndana ŋun nyɛ nandana daa be tiŋ maa ni; ka daa zaŋ o yɛm maa fa tiŋ maa nim bahi. Amaa ka so daa bi teei nandana maa yɛla.
en: Now there lived in that town a poor but wise man who saved everyone by his wisdom. But no one remembered that poor man.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, yiɣisim zani a naba zuɣu ka n tɔɣis a yɛtɔɣa.
en: The voice said to me: Human one, stand on your feet, and Ill speak to you.

dag: Daadam, kummi Ijipti tɔbbihi zuɣu, ka zaŋ bɛ mini zuliya shɛb bɛn mali yaa niŋ tiŋgban ni m-pahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pun be kpiimba biɛhigu shee la zuɣu.
en: Son of man, cry for the people of Egypt. Lead Egypt and the daughters from powerful nations to the grave. Lead them to the world below where they will be with the other people who went down into that deep hole.

dag: Naawuni Shi yino maa zuɣu ka ti zaa deei baptaizibu niŋgbun yini maa ni, di yi nyɛla Yɛhudianim bee bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ka di yi nyɛla daba bee bilichinnima, Shi yino maa ka ti zaa daa laɣim deei.
en: We were all baptized by one Spirit into one body, whether Jew or Greek, or slave or free, and we all were given one Spirit to drink.

dag: Ka o daa yi bɛ sani chaŋ o chandi.
en: When Paul left the council meeting.

dag: N kahig a yuli wuhi ninvuɣ shɛb a ni zaŋ ti ma dunia ŋɔ ni la; nyini n-su ba ka daa zaŋ ba ti ma, ka bɛ mi deeg a yɛligu.
en: I have revealed your name to the people you gave me from this world. They were yours and you gave them to me, and they have kept your word.
