dag: Wain kola ŋɔ daa nyɛla zaɣ pala ka ti yi yiŋ na, ka nyam di ni chahi shɛm. Ka ti binyɛra ŋɔ mini ti namda ŋɔ gba chahila so wɔɣinli maa chandi ni.
en: Look at our wineskins. When we left home, they were new and filled with wine. But now you can see that they are cracked and old. Look at our clothes and sandals. You can see that the long journey has almost destroyed the things we wear.

dag: Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam niŋ ma yɛda, o gba ni ti tum tuun shɛŋa n ni tumdi ŋɔ, hal ka ni ti tum tuun shɛŋa din gari dimbɔŋɔnima, dama n chanila m Ba maa sani.
en: I am telling you the truth: those who believe in me will do what I do—yes, they will do even greater things, because I am going to the Father.

dag: Ka o daa boli maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba na nti bɔhi ba, Ya polo ka bɛ daa lee yɛli ni bɛ ni ti dɔɣi Masia la.
en: He gathered all the chief priests and the legal experts and asked them where the Christ was to be born.

dag: N chaŋmi kaman zaawuni shilinshia la. Bɛ pihigi ma mi bahi kaman sakɔɣu la.
en: Like a lengthening shadow, Im passing away; Im shaken off, like some locust.

dag: N suhiri Naawuni ni o chɛ ka Izraɛl nasara dibu yi Ziɔn na. Naawuni yi chɛ ka o niriba tɔŋ, Yaakubu zuliya ni mali suhupiɛlli; ka Izraɛlnim suhuri paligi.
en: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our God, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.

dag: Yi nyɛla ti shɛhiranima, ka Naawuni gba di ti shɛhira m-pahi yi zuɣu ni zaŋ chaŋ yinim bɛn nyɛ yɛdaniŋdiba ŋɔ polo, ti biɛhigu wuhiya ni ti dolila wuntia soli ka tumdi din tuhi ka ka galimi.
en: You are our witnesses, and so is God, that our conduct toward you who believe was pure, right, and without fault.

dag: Zoya nyɛligirimi kaman kpam la, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ dunia zaa Duuma ŋɔ tooni.
en: The mountains melt like wax before the Lord , before the Lord of all the earth.

dag: Wummi bɛ ni bɔhiri ma shɛm, Yawɛ yɛligu maa lee be ya? Chɛ ka ti wum li.
en: See how they harass me: Wheres the LORDs word? Let it come now.

dag: Mbusim be yinim bɛn yɛri dari, Neemiya gom ni! Bee n-yɛri kuɣili din fo n-doya, Yiɣisim zan a tolitoli! ŋɔ zuɣu. Di ni tooi wuhi so binshɛli? Nyama, salima mini anzinfa ka bɛ zaŋ mal li, ka di bi vuhiri hal baabiɛla.
en: Doom to the one saying to the tree, Wake up! or Get up to the silent stone. Does it teach? Look, it is overlaid with gold and silver, but there is no breath within it.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa niŋ ti hal ti ni kul bi tam a yɛla bee n-saɣim a ni daa lo ti alikauli shɛl la zaa.
en: We have not forgotten you. But you do all those things to us. We did not break the agreement you gave us.

dag: Hal jɛra bɛn fo n-ʒiya, bɛ ni boli ba yɛnnima, bɛ yi bi yaai bɛ noya bɛ ni kali ba pahi yɛnnima ni.
en: Even fools seem smart when they are quiet.

dag: Do so daa be Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya zuɣu tinshee ka o yuli booni Maika.
en: There was a man named Micah who lived in the hill country of Ephraim.

dag: Saha paaya ni yi me yimaŋmaŋ yinsi n-kpe n-doya ka chɛ ka man jɛmbu duu lu n-dahim doya?.
en: You people think the right time has come for you to live in nice houses. You live in houses with beautiful wooden paneling on the walls, but the Lords house is still in ruins.

dag: Amaa ka o yɛl o, N ku chaŋ; n ni labi n dɔɣiriba sani ni n tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: But Hobab answered, No, I will not go with you. I will go back to my homeland and to my own people.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka a dimnim zaa kpi lala, amaa ka chɛ ka a zɔnim mi ne kaman wuntaŋ ni puhirina ni yaa n-ne shɛm la. Ka Izraɛlnim daa nya vuhim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni yuun pihinahi.
en: Our Lord , we pray that all your enemies will die like Sisera. But let everyone who loves you shine brightly like the sun at dawn. There was peace in Israel for about years.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa yɛl o, Cham ti sɔɣ a ba kaman o ni daa chɛ ka a po ni a ni niŋ shɛm maa.
en: Pharaoh answered, Keep your promise. Go and bury your father.

dag: Amaa lee ti wurimmiya bɛ maligu bimbina, ka kabisi bɛ binwɔɣila, ka wurim bɛ buɣili Ashɛra la.
en: You must tear down their altars, smash their sacred stone pillars, and cut down their sacred poles.

dag: Dinzuɣu lihimiya yimaŋ zuɣu sahakam, ka suhimiya Naawuni din ni chɛ ka yi nya kpiɔŋ nti tiligi din ti yɛn niŋ maa ni, ka ti zani Daadam Bia tooni.
en: Be on watch and pray always that you will have the strength to go safely through all those things that will happen and to stand before the Son of Man.

dag: Ka n daa da puu din be Anatɔt maa m mabia Hanamɛl sani, ka daa kali liɣiri maa ti o. Di daa nyɛla anzinfa laɣibaligu pinaayopɔin.
en: I bought the field at Anathoth from my cousin Hanamel. I weighed out shekels of silver for him.

dag: Ti Duuma pala ŋun bi niŋdi yomyom zaŋ chaŋ o daalikauli palibu polo kaman ninvuɣ shɛb ni tɛhiri shɛm la, amaa o lee nyɛla ŋun mali suɣilo zaŋ chaŋ yi polo, dama o bi yu ni so ti bahi yoli, amaa o bɔri ni sokam zaa lee niŋla tuuba.
en: The Lord isn't slow about keeping his promises, as some people think he is. In fact, God is patient, because he wants everyone to turn from sin and no one to be lost.

dag: O daa nyɛla yɛndana n-gari yɛnnim zaa. Hal o daa nyɛla yɛndana n-gari Ɛtan ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛzra nir la mini Hɛman ni Kalikol ni Darida bɛn daa nyɛ Mahol bihi la. Ka o yuli daa du pam zuliya shɛb bɛn gili ba zaa ni.
en: He was wiser than anyone on earth, even Ethan the Ezrahite and the sons of Mahol—Heman, Calcol, and Darda. King Solomon became famous in all the surrounding countries.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa yɛli, Hal ka Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, a yi di bi yɛli shɛli, biɛhiŋ kani, n niriba ŋɔ naan kari doli bɛ mabihi maa hal ni biɛɣuni asiba.
en: Then Joab said, As surely as God is alive, if you had not said something, people would still be chasing their brothers in the morning.

dag: ni shihira wuhibu ni ni alahiziba tumtumsa mini Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni la. Lala zuɣu ka n yihi Masia lahibal suŋ waazu Jɛrusalɛm zaŋ hal ti kpa Ilirikum zaa.
en: Indeed, I will tell how Christ worked miracles and wonders by the power of the Holy Spirit. I have preached the good news about him all the way from Jerusalem to Illyricum.

dag: bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ suma ka ka dalima bɛ niŋgbuna ni, ka mali yɛm ni baŋsim din ni tooi bɔhim baŋ viɛnyɛliŋga; ka bɛ zaŋ ba niŋ nayili ka bɛ tumdi tuma. Ashpɛnaz n-daa nyɛ ŋun yɛn wuhi ba Babilɔnnim yɛtɔɣa karimbu mini di sabbu.
en: good-looking young men without defects, skilled in all wisdom, possessing knowledge, conversant with learning, and capable of serving in the kings palace. Ashpenaz was to teach them the Chaldean language and its literature.

dag: Di saha ka Abimilɛk min o saawaralana Ahuzat ni o sapashin kpɛm Fikol daa yi Gɛra chaŋ Yisahaku sani.
en: Abimelech came from Gerar to see Isaac. He brought with him Ahuzzath, his advisor, and Phicol, the commander of his army.

dag: Ninsal shia yi mali yaa di deeri dɔro, amaa nira kɔba ni yi chɔɣisi, ŋuni n-leei ni tooi gbibi li?.
en: Being cheerful helps when you are sick, but nothing helps when you give up.

dag: ka di pa ni yi doli niŋgbuŋ kɔre soli kaman bɛn bi doli Naawuni zaligu ni niŋdi shɛm la.
en: Dont let your sexual desires control you like the people who dont know God.

dag: Ka yinim bɛn nyɛ tuumbiɛrinim ŋɔ yi mi ni yi zaŋ bin suma ti yi bihi, bɔ n-ni chɛ ka yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ ŋun ku zaŋ o Shia Kasi ti bɛn suhir o o Shia Kasi maa.
en: As bad as you are, you still know how to give good gifts to your children. But your heavenly Father is even more ready to give the Holy Spirit to anyone who asks.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:.
en: The Lord said to Moses.

dag: N daa kul dolila o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi zaa, ka bi birig o zaligunim maa shɛli.
en: I always remembered his laws. I never stopped following his rules.

dag: Yi yi yuri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka dol o noli, ka zaŋ yimaŋ tabil o, dina n-ni chɛ ka yi be tiŋgbɔn shɛli Yawɛ ni daa po pɔri n-zaŋ ti yi yaannim bɛn nyɛ Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu la ni.
en: Love the Lord your God, obey him and be faithful to him, and then you and your descendants will live long in the land that he promised to give your ancestors, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

dag: Amaa nir yi daag o kpee luhi, ka di pala o dima n-nyɛ o bee n-zaŋ binshɛli lab o kpee ka di pala o dɔnimi gu o.
en: But if you are not angry and accidentally kill someone in any of these ways, the townspeople must hold a trial and decide if you are guilty.

dag: O daa lan buɣisi zɔŋ la mini dunɔdali din daa baɣi daantalisi la ni dundɔŋ ni luɣilikam, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pia.
en: He measured the faces of all the side walls, including the side walls on either side of the porch at the courtyard. The total was cubits.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛm maa daa zaŋ ba niŋ Yisifu nuu ni ka o sɔŋdi ba. Ka bɛ daa be duu maa ni n-niŋ daba ayi.
en: The commander of the royal guard assigned Joseph to assist them. After they had been under arrest for some time.

dag: Di simdi ka yi be kasi n sani; dama man Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun be kasi, ka woligi ya zuliyanim ni ni yi nyɛ n dahalali.
en: I have separated you from other nations to be my own special people. So you must be holy because I am the Lord , and I am holy.

dag: A tumd alahiziba tuma tiri kpiimba? Kpiimba ni tooi yiɣisi zani paɣ a?.
en: Do you work miracles for the dead? Do they stand up and praise you?.

dag: Ka Nɔba daa chaŋ ti ŋme n-deei Kɛnat mini di tiŋkpansi, ka zaŋ omaŋmaŋ yuli Nɔba boli tinsi maa.
en: Nobah went and captured Kenath and its surrounding villages. He renamed it Nobah after himself.

dag: O yi yɛli, Di viɛla, binshɛli ku lan niŋ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ; o mi suhu yi yiɣisi, dindina nyin baŋmi ni o lo zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: If your father says it's all right, then I'm safe. But if he gets angry, you'll know he wants to harm me.

dag: Maligumaaniba kɔŋko puri ka Yisifu daa bi da. Dama Firawuna daa tirila maligumaaniba maa laɣidira, dina ka bɛ daa mali dira, dinzuɣu ka bɛn daa bi kɔhi bɛ puri maa.
en: The only land he did not buy was the land that belonged to the priests. They did not have to sell their lands, because the king gave them an allowance to live on.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba maa daa laɣim tiŋ maa ni kpamba ka bɛ niŋ tab saawara bahi, ka bo liɣiri ti siliga guliba maa.
en: The chief priests met with the elders and made their plan; they gave a large sum of money to the soldiers.

dag: Di luhiya ni ti suhuri paligi ka ti diɛm, dama a tizɔbil maa kpimi ka lan neena; o daa bɔrigimi, ka ti lan nya o maa.
en: But we had to celebrate and be happy, because your brother was dead, but now he is alive; he was lost, but now he has been found.

dag: Amaa lee daŋmiya m-bola Naawuni nam dubu min o wuntia, ka o naanyi zaŋ dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha pahi ya.
en: But more than anything else, put God's work first and do what he wants. Then the other things will be yours as well.

dag: Ka zuɣulaannima ayi maa mini kpambaliba la daa naai noli chaŋ naa sani nti yɛl o, Naa Darius, Naawuni dolim a nyɛvili.
en: So they went to see the king and said, King Darius, may Your Majesty live forever!.

dag: Yinim Samaria paɣiba bɛn ŋmɛlim be kaman Bashan naɣ shɛb bɛ ni dihiri viɛnyɛliŋga la, wummiya, yi nahindi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka yaa mini nandaamba, ka yɛri yi yidaannima, Timiya ti wain ka ti nyu.
en: You women of Samaria are fat cows! You mistreat and abuse the poor and needy, then you say to your husbands, Bring us more drinks.

dag: Chɛ ka di zambu ʒi Jɔab min o ba daŋ zuɣu. Chɛ ka Jɔab daŋ ni kul ku kɔŋ ʒim ni yiri ninvuɣ so ni bee niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ dɔr biɛɣu ni mali so bee do so ŋun miri gumdi bee bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku so bee ninvuɣ so ŋun kpiri kum.
en: May the punishment for it fall on Joab and all his family! In every generation may there be some man in his family who has gonorrhea or a dreaded skin disease or is fit only to do a woman's work or is killed in battle or doesn't have enough to eat.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni daa nya ka n ku tooi lan guhi pahi zuɣu ka n daa tim Timoti yi sanna ni di chɛ ka m baŋ yi yɛda niŋbu yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm. Dama n suhu daa kul zɔhirimi ni di pa shɛli ka Sintani ti zahim ya ka ti tuma la zaa kpalim yoli.
en: That is why I had to send Timothy. I could not bear it any longer, so I sent him to find out about your faith. Surely it could not be that the Devil had tempted you and all our work had been for nothing!.

dag: Nyama, ka niriba daa gariti nya ka o do sol ni, ka gbuɣinli ʒe m-baɣ o. Ka bɛ daa ka anabi kurili maa ni be tin shɛli maa ni na nti yɛli bɛ ni nya shɛm.
en: Some people were traveling nearby, and they discovered the body thrown down on the road and the lion standing beside it. They entered the town where the old prophet lived and were talking about it.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Naawuni zaŋ alizanda mini dunia ŋɔ yiko zaa niŋ n nuu ni.
en: So he came to them and said, All authority in heaven and on earth is given to me.

dag: Ka di daa gari Ɛdom nanima; ka Mɔab zuɣulaannim niŋgbuna sɔhira ka Keenannim zaa kɔba ni chɔɣisi.
en: Then Edoms tribal chiefs were terrified; panic grabbed hold of Moabs rulers; all of Canaans inhabitants melted in fear.

dag: ka yɛli ba, Chamiya tiŋkpan shɛli din be yi tooni ŋɔ ha; yi yi ti paai ni, yi ni nya bunnyaŋ min o bia ka bɛ loya ka yi lɔrigi ba na.
en: He said to them, Go into the village over there. As soon as you enter, you will find a donkey tied up and a colt with it. Untie them and bring them to me.

dag: Di zaa yoli Yawɛ daa bi bɔr ni o bahi Dauda daŋ maa yoli, o ni daa lo Dauda alikauli shɛl la zuɣu. O daa lo Dauda alikauli ni o ni zaŋ nam ti o min o zuliya ka bɛ be kaman firila la sahakam.
en: But the Lord would not destroy Davids family because of the agreement he made with David. He had promised to keep a lamp burning for David and his children forever.

dag: amaa paɣ ŋun yi mali zab wɔɣila, di pahir o la jilima. Dama Naawuni ti o zabiri maa la o zuɣu pilibu zuɣu.
en: But long hair is a beautiful way for a woman to cover her head.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti dana, ti bɔri ni a neela ti nina ŋɔ ti ti.
en: They answered, Lord, we want to see.

dag: N daa lo mmaŋmaŋ suhu ni ni n ni yɛn kana ti kaai ya kaari shɛl la ku nyɛla din ni tin ya suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: So I made up my mind not to come to you again to make you sad.

dag: Di chɛliya ka Hɛzɛkia yɔhim ya yɛli, Yawɛ ni tiligi ti. Zuliya shɛb wuna na mi n-fa bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ Asiria naa nuu ni?.
en: Hezekiah claims the Lord will save you. But don't be fooled by him. Were any other gods able to defend their land against the king of Assyria?.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa zali Izraɛlnim zaa ni bɛ bom tumtumdiba na ka bɛ ti tum tuma, ka bɛ ni daa bo tumtumdib shɛb na kalinli daa yiɣisi ninvuɣ tuhi pihita.
en: King Solomon drafted , men as forced labor from all over Israel.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa teei dɔni n-zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋa ka la ka yɛl o suhu ni, Wula ka ninvuɣ so ŋun paai yuun kɔbiga ni tooi lan dɔɣi bia? Ka Zara ŋun paai yuun pihiwɛi ŋɔ ni tooi lan dɔɣi bia.
en: Abraham fell on his face and laughed. He said to himself, Can a -year-old man become a father, or Sarah, a -year-old woman, have a child?.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ ni yino yɛl o, Biɛhiŋ kani, zaŋ chaŋ yuuni na ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha, n ni lab a sanna, ka a paɣ Zara ni ti dɔɣi bidibiga. Ka Zara daa be o nyaaŋa tanti suɣili dunol ni n-wumda.
en: Then one of them said, I will come again in the spring. At that time your wife Sarah will have a son. Sarah was listening in the tent and heard these things.

dag: Ka Atalia daa wum bɛ ni zɔri gindi ka paɣiri naa maa, ka o daa kpe Yawɛ duu maa ni niriba maa sani.
en: Athaliah heard the noise of the people running to the Temple and praising the king. She came into the Lord s Temple to the people.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa yɛli Jɔnatan, Yɛlim ma a ni niŋ shɛli. Ka Jɔnatan yɛl o, N di zaŋla jaaŋgbee din be n nuu ni n-suɣi shiri di, dinzuɣu n-nyɛ ma, m mali shili ni n kpi.
en: Then Saul asked Jonathan, What have you done? Jonathan answered, I ate a little honey with the stick I was holding. Here I am—I am ready to die.

dag: Yɛlim Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni o wuhim a shihirili; di ni tooi nyɛ din zilima kaman kpiimba biɛhigu shee bee din du kaman zuɣusaa la.
en: and said, Ask for a sign from the Lord your God to prove to yourself that this is true. You can ask for any sign you want. The sign can come from a place as deep as Sheol or as high as the skies. .

dag: Chɛ ka Speen mini teeku ni tiŋgban bihi nanim kana ti jɛm o, ka chɛ ka Shiiba nanima mini Siiba nanim ʒi pina na ti ti o.
en: Force the rulers of Tarshish and of the islands to pay taxes to him. Make the kings of Sheba and of Seba bring gifts.

dag: n-chaŋ ti dɔni sansani Kiriatijiarim Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ boli nimaani yuli, Mahanɛdan hal ni zuŋɔ. Di mi bela Kiriatijiarim wulinluhili polo.
en: On their way to the city of Laish, they stopped near the city of Kiriath Jearim in the land of Judah. They set up a camp there. That is why the place west of Kiriath Jearim is named Mahaneh Dan to this very day.

dag: Yɛndana suhu bɔrila kumsi ni be yil shɛli, amaa jɛra suhuri bɔrila suhupiɛlli ni be yil shɛli.
en: Someone who is always thinking about happiness is a fool. A wise person thinks about death.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, n lo nia ni n niŋ alibarika niŋ Jɛrusalɛmnim mini Judanim ni, dinzuɣu di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira.
en: so now I have changed course and again plan to do good to Jerusalem and the house of Judah. Dont be afraid.

dag: Ka ti yi yihi yɛli ni ti ka alahichi, ti yɔhimla timaŋa ka yɛlimaŋli ka ti ni.
en: If we say that we have no sin, we are fooling ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

dag: N daa lihiya n-nya ka so kani, ka noonsi zaa yiɣi.
en: I looked and there was no one left; every bird in the sky had taken flight.

dag: Kiriatibaal mini Raba gba daa beni: di daa nyɛla fɔntiŋ kara ayi m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: There were Kiriath Baal and Rabbah: two cities, along with the towns around them.

dag: Bɛla bidibisi daa nyɛla: Adda mini Gɛra ni Abihud.
en: Bela was the father of Addar, Gera, Abihud.

dag: Izraɛlnima, ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yi yɛri ni Yawɛ ʒi yi muɣisigu ni nyɛ shɛli bee bɛ yi ŋari ya, yi Naawuni baɣa kani?.
en: Israel, why then do you complain that the Lord doesn't know your troubles or care if you suffer injustice?.

dag: A ni bi mi vuhim ni kpɛri bia kɔba ni o ma puuni shɛm, lala ka a ku tooi baŋ Naawuni ŋun nam binshɛɣukam zaa ŋɔ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: You dont know where the wind blows. And you dont know how a baby grows in its mothers womb. In the same way, you dont know what God will do—and he makes everything happen.

dag: Yila pia shɛŋa mi a ni nya la mini biŋkɔbigu la ni laɣim je pagɔrili maa, bɛ ni bah o yoli zaa hal ka o ti kpalim o zaɣim. Bɛ ni ti dari tɔh o ŋ-ŋubi ka chɛ din kpalim n-zaŋ nyo buɣim.
en: The ten horns and the beast will start hating the shameless woman. They will strip off her clothes and leave her naked. Then they will eat her flesh and throw the rest of her body into a fire.

dag: Keenan nir ŋun daa nyɛ Arad naa m-be Nɛgɛb ni daa wum ni Izraɛlnim dolila Atarim polo kanna, ka o daa chaŋ ti ŋme ba tɔbu, ka gbahi bɛ shɛba ti leei daba.
en: The Canaanite king of Arad lived in the Southern Desert of Canaan, and when he heard that the Israelites were on their way to the village of Atharim, he attacked and took some of them hostage.

dag: O ni daa yɛli ma lala maa, ka n zaŋ n zuɣu ba tiŋa, ka kɔŋ yɛligu.
en: While this angel was speaking to me, I stared at the ground, speechless.

dag: Di saha ka yɛri bɛ taba, Ti nyɛla bɛn be kasi; miligimiya ka chɛ ti. M mini niriba bɛn be lala ku tooi kpe. N suhuyiɣisili zaŋ chaŋ bɛ sani ŋmanila buɣim din bi kpiri dabisili puuni zaa.
en: who say, Keep to yourself! Keep away from me! Im too holy for you. These people ignite my anger like a fire that burns all day.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli, O tum zina hal ti gbarigi, amaa ka dɔbba na kul bɔr o.
en: Then I thought, For a foolish woman they become adulterers! Incited by her seduction, they prostitute themselves—for her!.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa yɛli, Hal ka Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, a yi di bi yɛli shɛli, biɛhiŋ kani, n niriba ŋɔ naan kari doli bɛ mabihi maa hal ni biɛɣuni asiba.
en: As surely as God lives, Joab replied, if you hadnt just said that, the soldiers would have continued after their brothers until morning.

dag: Di ni naɣ simdi ni yi niŋ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yɛlimiya tab yɛlimaŋli, ka karimiya saria ka di doli yɛlimaŋli soli, ka lan nyɛ din tiri suhudoo yi kootunim ni.
en: These are the things you should do: Speak the truth to each other; make truthful, just, and peaceable decisions within your gates.

dag: Yawɛ n-kul nyɛ naa sahakam. Ziɔn, Naawuni n-kul nyɛ ʒiɛmani kam Naawuni. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: The Lord is king forever. Your God, O Zion, will reign for all time. Praise the Lord !.

dag: O daa zaŋla salima alali din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram pihitanaanu mali firilatamdigu maa mini di nɛma zaa.
en: He used seventy-five pounds of pure gold to make the lampstand and all its equipment.

dag: Ka o daa tim ŋmaai shikpam maa niŋ o nuu ni diri chana; ka daa zaŋ di shɛli nti ti o ba min o ma, ka bɛ di. Amaa ka Samsin daa bi yɛli ba ni gbuɣin kpiɔŋ ni ka o yihi shiri maa na.
en: He scooped up the honey in his hands and ate some of it as he walked along. When he got back to his parents, he gave them some of the honey, and they ate it too. But he didn't tell them he had found the honey in the skeleton of a lion.

dag: Ka doo maa bɔh o, A yuli? Ka o yɛl o, N yuli Yaakubu.
en: And the man said to him, What is your name? And Jacob said, My name is Jacob.

dag: Ka o lan bɔhi ba pahi, Ka daɣila yi na kul bi baŋ.
en: Jesus said to them, And you still dont understand.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Mariama daa yiɣisi chaŋ yomyom ti paai zoya ni tin shɛli din be Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: A short time later Mary hurried to a town in the hill country of Judea.

dag: Chɛ ka ti yɛli ni so yi ti ye binyɛr suma, ka piri salima nintuhi kpe yi laɣiŋgu ni na, ka nandana ŋun ye binchɛra gba kpɛna.
en: Suppose someone comes into your meeting wearing very nice clothes and a gold ring. At the same time a poor person comes in wearing old, dirty clothes.

dag: Amaa paɣ maa yi bi tum daɣiri tuma, ka nyɛla ŋun ka taali, dindina di ku niŋ o shɛli, o ni tooi dɔɣi bihi.
en: But if she is innocent, her body will not be harmed, and she will still be able to have children.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ tariga ka m be ka kuhiri boon a n nandahima saha maa. Zaŋm ma tahi kuɣ shɛli din du n-gari ma gbini.
en: From a faraway land I call to you for help. I feel so weak and helpless! Carry me to a high rock where no one can reach me.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan daa yɛl o, Din kariya, n yi di mi ni m ba lo a zaɣ biɛɣu n naan ku yɛl a.
en: Don't worry, Jonathan said. If I find out that my father wants to kill you, I'll certainly let you know.

dag: Bɛ tizɔpaɣiba n-daa nyɛ: Zɛruya mini Abigeel. Zɛruya bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Abishai mini Jɔab ni Asahɛl. Bɛ daa nyɛla niriba ata.
en: He also had two daughters, Zeruiah and Abigail. Jesse's daughter Zeruiah had three sons: Abishai, Joab, and Asahel.

dag: Ka Naomi daa kpuɣi bia maa ʒil o naba zuɣu m-mal o.
en: Naomi took the boy, held him in her arms, and cared for him.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa yɛli ninsal maa, Dim tihi din be puu ŋɔ ni wala;.
en: The Lord God gave him this command: You may eat from any tree in the garden.

dag: dama binshɛɣu kani din sɔɣiya ka ti ku yi palo, binshɛɣ mi kani m-be ashilɔni ka bɛ ti ku baŋ li.
en: Everything that is hidden will be shown, and everything that is secret will be made known.

dag: Dama yi bɔhira, Nabia maa yil la be ya? Ninvuɣ biɛɣu maa ni daa be yili shɛl ni la lee be ya.
en: You might say, Show me a good mans house. Now, show me where evil people live.

dag: ka ku yɛl o mi ni o malim shili n-zaŋ a bindirigu na ti zal a, ka a di ka nyu pɔi ka o mi naanyi chaŋ ti ʒini di ka nyu?.
en: Of course not! You would say to your servant, Prepare something for me to eat. Then get ready and serve me. When I finish eating and drinking, then you can eat.

dag: Di bi simdi ni bɛ deei Ammɔn nira bee Mɔab nira niŋ Yawɛ niriba laɣiŋgu ni hal kul zaŋ ti paai ʒiɛmani din pahiri bupia ni, soli kani ni bɛ deei bɛ zuliya niŋ Yawɛ niriba laɣiŋgu ni.
en: An Ammonite or Moabite may not join with the men of Israel when they gather to worship the Lord . And none of their descendants, to the tenth generation, may join in the worship of the Lord .

dag: Yinim bɛn zaa nyɛ bɛ ʒiʒiinitab ŋɔ mini yinim bɛn zaa mi bɛ yuli ŋɔ, fabilimiya bɛ zuɣu. Yɛlimiya, Nyamiya nam jaaŋgbe kpiɔŋ din mali jilima la ni kabigi shɛm.
en: All you who live around Moab should cry for that country. You know how famous Moab is. So cry for it. Say, The rulers power is broken. Moabs power and glory are gone.

dag: Ŋunkam zaa ka n sanna ti wum n yɛligu ka dol li, n ni wuhi ya o ni ŋmani so.
en: Anyone who comes to me and listens to my words and obeys them—I will show you what he is like.

dag: Saimɔn Pita mini Tomas ŋun daa nyɛ jaa la ni Nataniɛl ŋun daa yi Kɛna din be Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la ni Zɛbidii bihi la m-pahi nyaandoliba ayi n-daa laɣim taba.
en: Simon Peter, Thomas the Twin, Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, and the brothers James and John, were there, together with two other disciples.

dag: Ka o daa lab ti yɛli Juda, M bi nya paɣ maa; ka tiŋ maa nim yɛli ma ni pagɔr so na ʒi n-ka kpe na.
en: He returned to Judah and said, I couldn't find her. The men of the place said that there had never been a prostitute there.

dag: M bia, zaŋm a suhu ti ma, ka kpahim m biɛhigu;.
en: My child, give your mind to me and let your eyes keep to my path.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Ɛlim maa n-chaŋ ti dɔni miri Teeku Ʒiɛɣu.
en: They left Elim and camped near the Gulf of Suez.

dag: N ni ti daai yi maligu bimbina la luhi, ka wurim yi ni tuɣindi tulaale zim bimbin shɛŋa zuɣu la. Ka n ni ti zaŋ bɛ ni ku yi ninvuɣ shɛba bahi yi buɣa maa tooni.
en: Your altars will be destroyed, your incense altars broken. And Ill make your slain fall in front of your idols.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Sulemaana, Nyama, Adɔnija zɔrila nyin Naa Sulemaana, dama nyama, o gbaala sara maligu bimbini bin yila la gbibi ka yɛra, Faashee Naa Sulemaana daŋ po pɔri yɛli ma ni o ku ku man ŋun nyɛ o dabili ŋɔ. .
en: Solomon was told, Look! Adonijah is afraid of King Solomon and has grabbed the horns of the altar. Hes saying, King Solomon must swear to me first that he wont execute his servant with the sword.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa wuhi ba zahindi ni ni bɛ di lan lab Naa Hɛrɔd sani; ka bɛ daa taɣi so shɛli kuli bɛ ya.
en: But God warned the wise men in a dream not to go back to Herod. So they went home to their own country a different way.

dag: Ka o daa yɛl o pukpar kpɛma, Nyama, zuŋɔ yuma ata m-bɔŋɔ ka n kul kanna ti bɔri tia ŋɔ wala ka bi nyara; dinzuɣu ŋmaam li bahi! Bɔzuɣu ka nir ni chɛ li zali ka di kul nyuri tam yoli.
en: So he said to his gardener, Look, for three years I have been coming here looking for figs on this fig tree, and I haven't found any. Cut it down! Why should it go on using up the soil.

dag: Ɛhud ni daa zaŋ bɛ farigu binyara maa yo n-naai, o daa chɛmi ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒi li tahi na kuli.
en: After offering the gift, Ehud left the palace with the men who had carried the gift.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla wuntialana. O chihi ninvuɣ biɛri ni lo ti mi shɛŋa.
en: But the LORD is righteous— God cut me free from the ropes of the wicked!.

dag: O kɔŋko n-nyɛ nyɛvili din bi naari ni be so ni; ka nyɛ ŋun be neesim shɛl ni so ni ku tooi miri. So na ʒi n-nya o, ka so mi ku tooi nya o. Ŋuna n-simdi jilima tibu mini yiko subu hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Ami!.
en: He alone has immortality and lives in light that no one can come near. No human being has ever seen or is able to see him. Honor and eternal power belong to him. Amen.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa daa kari doli ba nti fa bɛ yuri mini bɛ chɛchɛbunsi, ka ku Sirianim maa pam.
en: but Ahab and his soldiers followed them and captured their horses and chariots. Ahab and Israel's army crushed the Syrians.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa chɛ ka tɔbbihi tusaata laasabu n-yi bɛ ni chaŋ; ka bɛn daa chaŋ maa ti ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ Ainim maa.
en: So about three thousand Israelites made the attack, but they were forced to retreat.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, N tum tuun yini ka di gari yi zaa ha.
en: Jesus replied, I did one work, and you were all astonished.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli, N suhir a, di chɛ ti, dama nyini m-mi ti ni yɛn dooni luɣ shɛli mɔɣu ŋɔ ni, leemi ti sowuhira.
en: Moses said, Please dont abandon us, for you know where we can camp in the desert, and you can be our eyes.

dag: O ni daa lihi ʒiɛm o ni po pɔri shɛŋa, ka saɣim alikauli maa, ka lan zaŋ o nuu kpɛhi tuun shɛŋa ni ŋɔ zuɣu, o ku tiligi.
en: But the king of Judah will not escape, because he ignored his agreement. He broke his promise to Nebuchadnezzar.

dag: Naawuni chɛ ka bɛnkam je Ziɔn di vi, ka ŋmaligi lab bɛ nyaaŋa.
en: I pray that all who hate the city of Zion will be made ashamed and forced to turn and run.

dag: Bɛ daa yi zaŋ bɛ nuhi gbaag a, a bɔɣirimi ŋ-ŋmahi bɛ bɔɣusapima. Bɛ daa yi zaŋ bɛmaŋ jɛm a, a kabigirimi ka chɛ ka bɛ naba kɔŋ zanibu.
en: When they leaned on you, you broke, pierced their armpits, and made them wrench their backs.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sab sabbu shɛli Giriikili ni mini Latinli ni ni Hiburuli ni n-tabili o dapulli maa zuɣusaa. Ŋ-ŋɔ ka bɛ daa sab li: Yɛhudianim Naa la m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Above him was a sign that said, This is the King of the Jews.

dag: So yi kpɛh a kɔre ashilɔni yɛl a, Ti jɛmmi wuna, yi mini yi yaannim ni bi mi wun shɛŋa, hal o yi nyɛla a mabia ŋun nyɛ doo ka nyɛ a ba bia bee a ma bia bee a amaŋmaŋ bidibiga bee bipuɣiŋga bee a paɣ yura bee a zo simo.
en: Even your brother or your son or your daughter or the wife you love or your closest friend may secretly encourage you to worship other gods, gods that you and your ancestors have never worshiped.

dag: Bɛ ni daa nya Pita mini Jɔn suhukpeeni, ka mi ni bɛ nyɛla tarimba ni zuɣusabila maa ka di gari ba pam, ka bɛ baŋ ni bɛ mini Yisa n-daa be.
en: The council was caught by surprise by the confidence with which Peter and John spoke. After all, they understood that these apostles were uneducated and inexperienced. They also recognized that they had been followers of Jesus.

dag: Ka yi yi suhiri Naawuni, yin di mali yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ din ka gbinni kaman bɛn pa Yɛhudianim ni niŋdi shɛm la, dama bɛ tɛhiri ni bɛ yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ zuɣu ka Naawuni ni deei bɛ suhigu.
en: When you pray, dont pour out a flood of empty words, as the Gentiles do. They think that by saying many words theyll be heard.

dag: Lala n-shiri niŋ Babilɔn maa bɛ ni daa nya anabinim mini Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda zaŋ tabili bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb zaa dunia ŋɔ ni la ʒim di puuni la zuɣu.
en: You are guilty of the death of the prophets, of Gods holy people, and of all those who have been killed on earth.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Ka ŋuni n-lee tum tuuni ŋɔ? Ka bɛ daa vihi di zuɣu hal ka so ti yɛli ba ni Gidiɔn Jɔash bia la n-tum tuuni maa.
en: They asked each other, Who did this? They investigated and found out that Gideon son of Joash had done it.

dag: niriba ayi n-daa chaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu ni bɛ ti jɛm Naawuni; bɛ ni yino daa nyɛla Farisii, ka ŋun la mi nyɛ farigudeera.
en: One time there was a Pharisee and a tax collector. One day they both went to the Temple to pray.

dag: Ka Zara daa yɛli, Naawuni bo lari ti ma, ka ŋunkam zaa wum di yɛla ni la n-sɔŋ ma.
en: Sarah said, God has given me laughter. Everyone who hears about it will laugh with me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kpahi tayiɣis ayi gba tabili dapula n-zaŋ sa m-pahi Yisa zuɣu: Yino o nudirigu polo, ŋun la mi o nuzaa polo. .
en: The soldiers also nailed two criminals on crosses, one to the right of Jesus and the other to his left.

dag: Yɛhudianim Yaɣigari Chuɣu puhibu daa ti miri, ka Yisa daa chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm.
en: It was nearly time for the Jewish Passover, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali suhu yini, a wuhiri ba ni a nyɛla ŋun mali suhu yini; ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ bilikɔɣinima, a nyɛla ŋun nyandi ba.
en: With all who are sincere, you are sincere, but you treat the unfaithful as their deeds deserve.

dag: Yinim Iso zuliya, bɛ ni ʒiɛn ya n-zaŋ yi daazichi chaŋ.
en: Everything you treasure most will be taken from you.

dag: Ka ŋun zaŋ li ti Yawɛ maa yi bɔr ni o yo di zuɣu ka dee li, o ni yo di daa maa pirigibu ʒiibunu yim zuɣu pahi di daa maa zuɣu, ka di leeg o dini.
en: If the one who dedicates the house wishes to buy it back, they must add one-fifth to its valued price, and it will be theirs again.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu n ni kum ka fabili. N ni chaŋ napɔnzaŋa ni n zaɣim. N ni fabili kaman yɔbahi la, ka kum kaman taatahi la.
en: On account of this, I will cry out and howl; I will go about barefoot and stripped. I will cry out like the jackals, and mourn like the ostriches.

dag: N yi bol o ka o saɣi, m bi niŋ yɛda ni o ni gbilisi tibili wum n yɛtɔɣa maa.
en: Yet even then, if he lets me speak, I can't believe he would listen to me.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ di zaa niŋ piɛ yin ni n-zaŋ di mini naɣilaa maa mini piɛlah ayi maa na.
en: Put them in a basket and offer them to me when you sacrifice the bull and the two rams.

dag: Dama n zaŋ n nuu tiri zuɣusaa, ka po pɔri ni mani ŋun be sahakam ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: As surely as I am the living God, I raise my hand and I vow.

dag: N Duuma, dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu ka niriba be, din nim zaa zuɣu ka n nyɛvili be. Tim ma alaafee, ka n lan be!.
en: Your words and your deeds bring life to everyone, including me. Please make me healthy and strong again.

dag: Ka a ni ti na kul yɛn tɔɣisiri naa yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ saha shɛli maa, n gba ni dol a nyaaŋa kpɛna nti di a shɛhira.
en: While you are speaking there with the king, Ill come along and support your words.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, dabisili kanna ka n ni ti darigi Babilɔn binnana tibili. N ni ti dihi di tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa vi. Bɛ ni ti yɛn ku di ninvuɣ shɛb zaa ni ti lula di puuni.
en: The time will come when I will punish Babylon's false gods. Everyone there will die, and the whole nation will be disgraced.

dag: Di bemi kaman yi ni daa nyɛ nɔzaɣisiriba Naawuni sani, amaa ka yipa nya nambɔzɔbo pumpɔŋɔ Izraɛlnim nɔzaɣisibo maa zuɣu la.
en: Once you were disobedient to God, but now you have mercy because they were disobedient.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sabi Izraɛl daŋ niriba zaa yuya niŋ Izraɛl Nanim litaafi ni. Ka bɛ daa gbahi Judanim daba n-zaŋ ba kuli Babilɔn bɛ ni daa bi ʒe yim la zuɣu.
en: So all Israel was listed in the official records of Israels kings. Judah was carried into exile in Babylon because of their unfaithfulness.

dag: O tiligiri niriba, ka lan fari niriba bahira; o wuhiri shihira, ka tumd alahiziba tumtumsa alizanda ni mini dunia ŋɔ ni. O fa Daniɛl gbuɣima nuu ni bahi.
en: He saves and rescues; he performs wonders and miracles in heaven and on earth. He saved Daniel from being killed by the lions.

dag: N suhu kul yɛla nyin Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu. Naawuni, ka bɔ saha ka n yɛn kana ti nya a ninni?.
en: My whole being thirsts for God, for the living God. When will I come and see Gods face?.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni, di simdi ni yi niŋ n ni zali ya shɛm n-gbibi n zaligunim ka dol li.
en: Obey my laws and do what I command. I am the Lord your God.

dag: Ŋunkam mali maligu ti buɣili ka pa ni Yawɛ kɔŋko, yin kum dilana.
en: Death is the punishment for offering sacrifices to any god except me.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila tibihi din nyaɣa na bi ba tiŋa, ka Naawuni yi chɛ ka tulim kana ti kpe li, di kuurimi ka pɔhim ʒe li ti bahi kaman wurigu la.
en: They are like plants that are planted in the ground. But before they can send their roots into the ground, God blows on the plants; they become dead and dry, and the wind blows them away like straw.

dag: Ka yuma ayopɔin shɛŋa puuni bindira ni daa niŋ pam Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa daa ti gari.
en: For seven years people had all the food they needed, but those years ended.

dag: N ni daa lɔnya alikauli shɛli ni ʒim yihibu sara maligu shɛhira la zuɣu, n ni ti yi niriba bɛn be dabitim ni la yolisim. N ni yihi ba dabitim kɔbil kuŋ la ni.
en: When I made a sacred agreement with you, my people, we sealed it with blood. Now some of you are captives in waterless pits, but I will come to your rescue.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Maata! Maata! A jiɣirimi ka nahind amaŋ bina pam zuɣu.
en: But the Lord answered her, Martha, Martha, you are getting worried and upset about too many things.

dag: Ka Gaad zuliya daa lab mali me tin shɛŋa din yuya booni Dibɔn mini Atarɔt ni Aroa.
en: The Gadites built Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daba ayi ha yuun shɛli din pahir ata ni, ka Yawɛ daa ti yɛli Ilaija, Cham ti zaŋ amaŋ wuhi Ɛhab, ka n chɛ ka saa mi dunia ni.
en: For three years no rain fell in Samaria, and there was almost nothing to eat anywhere. The Lord said to Elijah, Go and meet with King Ahab. I will soon make it rain. So Elijah went to see Ahab.

dag: Naawuni Shia Kasi mini kom ni ʒim, ka shɛhira diba ata ŋɔ zaa mi yɛla saɣisila taba.
en: the Spirit, the water, and the blood. These three witnesses agree.

dag: Zuɣusaa, wumma, tiŋgbani, wumma! Yawɛ yɛliya: N ni wumsi bi shɛb zaɣisi ma.
en: Hear you heavens, and listen earth, for the LORD has spoken: I reared children; I raised them, and they turned against me!.

dag: O daa ti bɛ ni yino la pɔŋ tusaanu, ka ti yino pɔŋ tusaayi, ka ti ŋun kpalim la mi pɔŋ tuhili. O daa ti bɛ zaa la kaman bɛ yaa tariga ni nyɛ shɛm ka naanyi chaŋ.
en: He decided how much each servant would be able to care for. The man gave one servant five bags of money. He gave another servant two bags. And he gave a third servant one bag. Then he left.

dag: Yawɛ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb ni ni ti su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ, amaa o ni kari o ni yɛli noli ti ninvuɣ shɛb la bahi.
en: Everyone the Lord blesses will get the land he promised. Everyone he curses will be destroyed.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Musa, A deemba Jɛtro min a paɣa ni a bidibis ayi la kanna.
en: He had sent word to Moses that they were coming.

dag: N ni zaŋ n yuli boli jɛmbu du shɛli ŋɔ, yi pa leela ŋmɛnditoya duu yi sani? Yawɛ yɛliya, N kul pala nina lihiri ya.
en: This Temple is called by my name. Is this Temple nothing more to you than a hideout for robbers? I have been watching you. This message is from the Lord .

dag: Zɛbulɔn ni ti ʒini n-tabila teeku noli. O kulinoli ni ti nyɛla ŋariŋ kara zaashee. O tintariga ti yɛn zaŋmi hal ni Sidɔn.
en: Zebulun will live at the seashore; hell live at the harbor of ships, his border will be at Sidon.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Mɛriba kom, luɣ shɛli Izraɛlnim mini Yawɛ ni daa yɛl tab finafina ni luɣ shɛli o ni daa wuhi ni o nyɛla ŋun be kasi.
en: The Israelites had complained against the Lord , and he had shown them his holy power by giving them water to drink. So they named the place Meribah, which means Complaining.

dag: Teemiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa niŋ Miriam shɛm saha shɛli yi ni daa yi Ijipti m-be soli chanila yɛla.
en: Remember what the Lord your God did to Miriam on your trip out of Egypt.

dag: Di saha ka binshɛɣu din be kaman zahim paɣiri la daa dii yi o nina ni luna, ka o nina maa dii neei. Ka o daa yiɣisi deei kom baptaizibu.
en: At once something like fish scales fell from Saul's eyes, and he was able to see again. He stood up and was baptized;.

dag: Yawɛ, Nyini ka ti niŋ naani, zom ti nambɔɣu. Guli ti dabisili kam. Tiligim ti ti muɣisigu nyabu saha.
en: Please, Lord , be kind to us! We depend on you. Make us strong each morning, and come to save us when we are in trouble.

dag: Zaligunim ŋɔ ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Musa zali Izraɛlnima Mɔab bɔpiɛligu ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli zaŋ labi Jɛriko polo la.
en: These are the commandments and the case laws that the LORD commanded the Israelites through Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.

dag: Ka Yawɛ nuu daa pa n zuɣu, ka Yawɛ shia daa zaŋ ma ti zali vinvamli sunsuuni. Kɔba n-daa pali di ni.
en: Some time later, I felt the Lord 's power take control of me, and his Spirit carried me to a valley full of bones.

dag: Ti ni daa doli ti niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu la, Naawuni fukumsi zaligu daa chɛ ka ti kɔr biɛri yiɣisi, ka ti tumdi tuun shɛŋa din nyɛ kum dini ti niŋgbuŋ yaɣili kam ni.
en: When we were self-centered, the sinful passions aroused through the Law were at work in all the parts of our body, so that we bore fruit for death.

dag: Di saha ka Pita yɛl o, Nyama, ti chɛla binshɛɣukam ka dol a. Ka bɔ ka ti lee ti yɛn nya di zuɣu.
en: Then Peter replied, Look, weve left everything and followed you. What will we have.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino garigi yɛl o, N dan naa, ti ni so bi be o polo. Amaa anabi Ilaisha ŋun be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni la n-yɛri Izraɛl naa a ni be a duu tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ shɛlikam.
en: One of them answered, No one is, Your Majesty. The prophet Elisha tells the king of Israel what you say even in the privacy of your own room.

dag: Ka o daa kpe ŋariŋ ni ni o chaŋ, ka alizin biɛri ni daa zo ka chɛ do so maa balim o ni o chɛ ka o dol o chaŋ.
en: While he was climbing into the boat, the one who had been demon-possessed pleaded with Jesus to let him come along as one of his disciples.

dag: Nyin naa, a yi shiri ni niŋ ma nirilim ka ti ma n ni bɔri shɛli, dindina m bɔri ni a mini Haman sa labina biɛɣuni nti di ka nyu binnyur shɛŋa n ni sa yɛn niŋ zali ya. Yi yi sa kana, n sa ni yɛl a n ni bɔri shɛli maa.
en: If Your Majesty is kind enough to grant my request, I would like you and Haman to be my guests tomorrow at another banquet that I will prepare for you. At that time I will tell you what I want.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛl o, Tim ma pini. A ni zaŋ Nɛgɛb ti ma la zuɣu, tim ma kulibɔna din kom zɔri gba pahi. Ka Kalɛb daa zaŋ zuɣusaa polo mini naɣiliŋga ni kulibɔna ti o.
en: She answered, I want some water holes. The land you have given me is in the dry country. So Caleb gave her the upper and lower springs.

dag: Dama Naawuni bindirigu nyɛla din yi alizanda ni na, ka nyɛ din tiri dunianim nyɛvili.
en: For the bread that God gives is he who comes down from heaven and gives life to the world.

dag: Naa Hɛzɛkia tuumba maa ni daa ka Aizaia sanna.
en: When King Hezekiahs servants got to Isaiah.

dag: Ka ti ni shɛb chaŋ siliga maa gbini nti nya ka paɣiba maa ni yɛli shɛm maa nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, dama bɛ shiri bi nya o.
en: Some of those who were with us went to the tomb and found things just as the women said. They didnt see him.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ yi bela Babilɔn, ka bɛ gba zaŋ ya leei bɛ daba yoli. Ka bɛn sun ya maa nyuri bara ka diri dari, ka kul maani ma ansarisi sahakam, ka ʒiɛmdi n yuli dabisili kam.
en: And now in Babylonia the same thing has happened: you are captives, and nothing was paid for you. Those who rule over you boast and brag and constantly show contempt for me.

dag: Saha shɛli n ni daa yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na hal ni zuŋɔ, bɛ tuma zaa kul wuhirila lala, bɛ zaɣisi ma ka jɛmdila buɣa, lala ka bɛ niŋd a gba maa.
en: They are doing the same thing they have always done. I took them out of Egypt, but they left me and served other gods. They are doing the same to you.

dag: Yi zaa nya li yimaŋmaŋa, ka wula ka yi zaa leei bɛn ka buchi.
en: All of you have seen these things for yourselves. So you have no excuse.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu zuɣulan so ŋun yuli daa booni Jairus daa ka o sanna nti damd o tooni balind o ni o kam o yiŋ na.
en: Just then the man in charge of the synagogue came and knelt down in front of Jesus. His name was Jairus, and he begged Jesus to come to his home.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa, saha shɛli Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib min o tɔbbihi zaa ni daa do Lakishi la ka o daa tim o tuumba Jɛrusalɛm Juda Naa Hɛzɛkia mini Judanim zaa bɛn daa be Jɛrusalɛm la sani nti yɛli ba.
en: When Sennacherib and his troops were camped at the town of Lachish, he sent a message to Hezekiah and the people in Jerusalem. It said:.

dag: Dinzuɣu di chɛliya ka ti lan tiri ti tab zalige, yi mi di chɛliya ka ti tum din ni gu ti kpee soli bee n-chɛ ka o tuui lu.
en: So we should stop judging each other. Lets decide not to do anything that will cause a problem for a brother or sister or hurt their faith.

dag: O nyaandoliba maa ni daa nya o ka o tam kom zuɣu chani maa, ka dabiɛm gbahi ba pam, ka bɛ yɛri ni alizini m-bala, ka kuhi dabiɛm kuhigu.
en: When they saw him walking on the water, they were terrified. It's a ghost! they said, and screamed with fear.

dag: Dama hal so ku lan be nayili, bɛ ni ti zo zaa ka chɛ tiŋ maa. Ka tiŋgula biɛhigu shee mini yiya lu n-dahim zaa n-kul doya sahakam. Ka nimaani leei mɔɣu ni bunsi gɔrim shee ni piɛri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: The palace will be deserted, the crowded city abandoned. Stronghold and watchtower will become empty fields forever, suited for the pleasure of wild donkeys, and a pasture for flocks.

dag: N kahigi n ni tum shɛlikam wuh a, ka a deei n suhigu; wuhim ma a zaligunima.
en: I confessed my ways and you answered me. Now teach me your statutes!.

dag: O ni daa chɛ ka sagbana din be zuɣusaa ŋɔ zani viɛnyɛliŋga ka yɔhi teeku ni kɔbilinina.
en: when he thickened the clouds above, when he secured the fountains of the deep.

dag: Ka ti daa ti paai ti gbɛbu shee n-yooi ti kpalansi nya ka ti zaa yinoyino liɣiri noli bela ti kpalansi maa noya ni, dinzuɣu ka ti ʒi li mali na.
en: but when we stopped to spend the night and opened our sacks, there was the exact amount of each mans silver at the top of his sack. Weve brought it back with us.

dag: Jɛrimia daa yɛliya, Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: Later, when I was in prison, the Lord said:.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ ti Naawuni ka pa ni Yawɛ? Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ ti tampiŋ pahi ti Naawuni ŋɔ zuɣu?.
en: The Lord alone is God; God alone is our defense.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa kana ti bɔhi naa, Wula ka ti mabihi Judanim ŋɔ lee sɔɣi zaŋ a min a malibu ni a niriba ŋɔ zaa baai du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili na.
en: Then everyone in Israel came and said to the king, Why did our relatives the people of Judah steal you away, and bring the king and his household across the Jordan River, along with all of his soldiers.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛlnima, Chɛliya ka yi ni shɛb lo kpara n-chaŋ ti tuhi Midiannima m-bɔhi ba biɛri ti Yawɛ.
en: So Moses spoke to the people. He said, Choose some of your men to be soldiers. The Lord will use these men to do to the Midianites what they did to you.

dag: Ka o daa gɔri gindi Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa yihiri waazu Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni, ka kariti alizin biɛri bahira.
en: So he traveled all over Galilee, preaching in the synagogues and driving out demons.

dag: M mi ni Naawuni ni tum shɛlikam kul ni beni sahakam. So ku tooi zaŋ shɛli pahi di ni bee n-yihi shɛli di ni. Naawuni n-tum lala ni di chɛ ka sokam zaa zo o.
en: I learned that anything God does will continue forever. People cannot add anything to the work of God, and they cannot take anything away from it. God did this so that people would respect him.

dag: Ka ninsal yi zaɣisi tuuba niŋbu, Naawuni ni sah o takɔbi; ka gur o tɔbu.
en: If they do not change their ways, God will sharpen his sword. He bends his bow and makes it ready;.

dag: O daa zaŋ ma kpe o bindira dibu duu, ka o ni daa lo shɛm zaŋ chaŋ m polo nyɛla o bɔri ma mi.
en: He brought me to his banquet hall and raised the banner of love over me.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika daa ti kana ti ʒi oki tia din daa be Ofira ka nyɛ Jɔash ŋun daa nyɛ Abiɛza zuliya ni nir ni su shɛl la gbini. Ka o bia Gidiɔn daa sɔɣi be nimaani wain tɔɣiri bɔɣili ni buri alikama ka bi bɔri ni Midiannim nya o.
en: Then the Lord 's angel came to the village of Ophrah and sat under the oak tree that belonged to Joash, a man of the clan of Abiezer. His son Gideon was threshing some wheat secretly in a wine press, so that the Midianites would not see him.

dag: ka ŋun pahi anahi daa nyɛ Nɛtanɛl, ka ŋun pahi anu daa nyɛ Radai.
en: Nethanel his fourth, Raddai his fifth.

dag: Di saha ka salo maa zaa daa tim tuumba Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba bɛn daa be Rimɔn tampiŋ gbin la sani nti yɛli ba ni bɛ ku bɛ mini ba zabili la.
en: The Israelites met and sent messengers to the men of Benjamin at Rimmon Rock, telling them that the Israelites were willing to make peace with them.

dag: Di yi nyɛla yi bun shɛb bɛn bɔrigi zuŋɔ daba ata la bɛna, di lan chɛ ka bɛ yɛla muɣis a, dama bɛ nya ba. Ka ŋuni ka Izraɛlnim zaa lee yuuni bɔra? Pa a min a zuliya zaa.
en: Don't worry about your donkeys that ran off three days ago. They've already been found. Everything of value in Israel now belongs to you and your family.

dag: Ka yi kul ni mali pam din ni chɛ ka yi tiri nirilim niŋbu pina, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka Naawuni nya paɣibu ti ni niŋdi shɛm puuni;.
en: He will always make you rich enough to be generous at all times, so that many will thank God for your gifts which they receive from us.

dag: Ti sabirila dimbɔŋɔnim tiri ya ni di chɛ ka ti mali suhupiɛlli zaa.
en: We are writing these things so that our joy can be complete.

dag: Chɛ ka ti laɣ tab zɔri m-be kaman m ba min a ba ni daa be shɛm la. Nyama, n zaŋla anzinfa mini salima ŋɔ ti a pini. Saɣimm a mini Izraɛl Naa Baasha zɔtal la, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o zaŋ o tɔbbihi yiɣisi ka chɛ ma.
en: Our fathers signed a peace treaty. Why don't we do the same thing? This silver and gold is a present for you. So, would you please break your treaty with Baasha and force him to leave my country.

dag: O daa yɛl lala ni o wuhi la kum shɛli o ni daa ti yɛn kpi la yɛla.
en: Jesus was talking about the way he would be put to death.

dag: n-chaŋ omaŋmaŋ ya n-daa ti kpe bɛ jɛmbu duu nti wuhiri niriba, ka di daa gari ba pam ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Ya ka doo ŋɔ lee nya yɛm ŋɔ mini tuun kara ŋɔ?.
en: and went to his hometown. He taught in their synagogue, and the people were so amazed that they asked, Where does he get all this wisdom and the power to work these miracles?.

dag: O chanila kum shee, o ni doli so shɛli kunila kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: She is on a path leading to death, and she will lead you straight to the grave.

dag: Man Pool mini Silvanus ni Timoti n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri Tɛsalɔnaika cheechi niriba bɛn nyɛ ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia ni su shɛb la.
en: From Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy: To the church of the Thessalonians, which is in God our Father, and in the Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Ka yiliguliba sapashin kpɛm maa daa yihi Jɛrimia ka yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ daa yɛli ni o ni chɛ ka alɔbo ŋɔ lu tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: The captain of the special guard located Jeremiah and said to him, The LORD your God declared that a great disaster would overtake this place.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa yɛliya, Nyama, di ku yuui ka n kana, ka mali laara na ni n ti ti sokam kaman o tuma ni simdi shɛm!.
en: Listen! says Jesus. I am coming soon! I will bring my rewards with me, to give to each one according to what he has done.

dag: Di saha maa ha yi daa dolila dunia ŋɔ tuumbiɛri soli, ka deei Sintani ŋun su sagbana tiŋli ŋɔ na yiko la noli. Ŋuna n-nyɛ shi biɛ so ŋun su ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣisi Naawuni nol la.
en: You used to live like people of this world. You followed the rule of a destructive spiritual power. This is the spirit of disobedience to Gods will that is now at work in persons whose lives are characterized by disobedience.

dag: Amaa ka Judanim daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ Naa Amɔn polo maa, ka zaŋ o bia Jɔsia n-leei naa zal o ba zaani.
en: He was buried in Uzza Garden. Soon after that, the people of Judah killed the murderers of Amon, then they made his son Josiah king. Everything else Amon did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: Ka Musa daa teeg o nuu tiri teeku maa, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka pɔhim kpiɔŋ yi wulimpuhili polo na nti ʒe teeku maa kom labisi nyaaŋa yuŋ maa zaa m-pirigi li buyi ka chɛ tiŋ kuŋ.
en: Then Moses stretched out his hand over the sea. The LORD pushed the sea back by a strong east wind all night, turning the sea into dry land. The waters were split into two.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Neetan daa yiɣisi kul o yiŋa. Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka dɔro gbaai Yuria paɣ ni dɔɣi bidib so ti Dauda maa.
en: Then Nathan went home. The LORD struck the child that Uriahs wife had borne for David, and he became very sick.

dag: O daa zaŋ sagbana niŋ bɛ zuɣusaa, ka chɛ ka buɣim tiri neesim yuŋ.
en: God put a cloud over his people and a fire at night to give them light.

dag: Ka nyin naa ni ti dɔɣi bidibisi; ka bɛ zani a yaannim zaani, ka a ti zaŋ ba leei nanim dunia ŋɔ zaa ni.
en: Your sons, great king, will succeed your fathers; you will appoint them as princes throughout the land.

dag: Aruna daa bela o kabɔɣili maa ni buri alikama, ka daa ti ŋmaligi lihi nya malaika maa, ka o bidibis anahi bɛn daa be o sani daa zo n-sɔɣi.
en: Araunah was threshing the wheat. He turned around and saw the angel. His four sons ran away to hide.

dag: Zaŋmiya binyara sa n-dalim yi pala, malimiya dapaɣa din mali sabbu. Kpahimmiya palidaa la viɛnyɛliŋga, yi ni daa doli shɛli chaŋ la. Yinim Izraɛlnim bɛn ŋmani paɣipiɛliga ŋɔ labimiyana. Labimiya yi tinsi ŋɔ ni na.
en: Set up markers, put up signs; think about the road you have traveled, the path you have taken. Return, virgin Israel; return to these towns of yours.

dag: A yi tim a ʒiʒiinikpee wain tihi puu ni chana, a ni tooi pɔhi di wala maa a suhu ni bɔri shɛm tariga di, amaa miri ka a pɔhi shɛli niŋ a nɛma ni.
en: If you go into a vineyard that belongs to someone else, you are allowed to eat as many grapes as you want while you are there. But don't take any with you when you leave.

dag: Ka ŋun pah ata mi kana nti yɛl o, N dana, n-nyɛ a pɔŋli la. N daa zaŋ li gbinila binchɛra ni sɔɣi.
en: Another servant came and said, Master, here is your money. I wrapped it up in a scarf for safekeeping.

dag: A je ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi buɣa, amaa nyin Yawɛ ka man niŋ naani.
en: I hate those who worship false gods. I trust only in the Lord .

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa garigi yɛli ma, Bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa tuhiya.
en: So the Lord said to me, They have made a wise request.

dag: Ka o daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ daanya mali gaɣa kɔtomsi m-pie taba ʒiibuyi zuɣu n-zaŋ li zali kɔniŋdi bini maa lɔŋni, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pinaata ni pirigili, ka di daa tuɣituɣi taba.
en: Under the rim were two rows of oxlike figures completely encircling it, ten every eighteen inches, each cast in its mold.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Judanim mali kpiɔŋ; ka fa Izraɛlnim mi bahi. N ni zo ba nambɔɣu, ka zaŋ ba labisi yiŋ na. Bɛ ni be kaman n na ʒi n-zaɣisi ba. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni; ka ni wum bɛ suhigu.
en: I will make the people of Judah strong; I will rescue the people of Israel. I will have compassion on them and bring them all back home. They will be as though I had never rejected them. I am the Lord their God; I will answer their prayers.

dag: N gom shee ka n daa nya ti titali ʒii puuni ka di kul ʒe dunia sunsuuni.
en: While I was asleep, I had a vision of a huge tree in the middle of the earth.

dag: M Ba ni yuri ma shɛm, lala ka n gba yuri ya. Benya n yurilim ni.
en: As the Father loved me, I too have loved you. Remain in my love.

dag: Musa daa laɣim Izraɛlnim zaa n-yɛli ba, Yawɛ ni zali ya ni yi niŋ binshɛŋa m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Moses gathered all the Israelites together and said to them, I will tell you what the Lord has commanded you to do:.

dag: dama yi yɛtɔɣa puuni ka yi ni ti yi taali ni, yi yɛtɔɣa puuni mi ka yi ni ti lan mali taali.
en: By your words you will be either judged innocent or condemned as guilty.

dag: M mi ni n chandi nyaaŋa ninvuɣ kundun biɛri ni ti kana ti kpe yi ni, ka ku chɛ Naawuni piɛri maa.
en: I know that, after my departure, savage wolves will come in among you and wont spare the flock.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, Yawɛ ni pii so n-leei naa ka o su Izraɛlnima; ka lala naa maa kpihim Jɛrɔbɔam daŋ niriba birili zuŋɔ.
en: The Lord is going to place a king over Israel who will put an end to Jeroboam's dynasty.

dag: N Duuma, chɛ ka bɛ birim, ka chɛ ka bɛ yɛtɔɣa woli. Dama n nya ka girigiri niŋbu mini duŋ taabu be tiŋ puuni.
en: My Lord, confuse their words and stop their plans. I see so much cruelty and fighting in this city.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ zim viɛlli mali bɔrɔbɔro kpil pinaayi. Zaŋm zim kilɔgiram yini m-mali bɔrɔbɔro kpilli kam.
en: You will take choice flour and bake twelve loaves of flatbread, two-tenths of an ephah for each loaf.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yi zoli maa zuɣu n-siɣirina ka Yisa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni yɛli, Miriya ka yi yɛli so yi ni nya shɛli ʒii maa ni maa yɛla, faashee Daadam Bia kum ni neebu nyaaŋa.
en: As they were coming down the mountain, Jesus commanded them, Dont tell anybody about the vision until the Human One is raised from the dead.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ puuni yi di yimaŋ shɛhira ni yi nyɛla bɛn daa ku anabinim maa yaansi.
en: So you give proof that you are descendants of those who killed the prophets.

dag: Zaŋ kana pumpɔŋɔ di di simdi ni yi nyɛla yi tab sowuhiriba, amaa ka yi ti na bɔrimi ni so n-wuhi ya Naawuni yɛtɔɣa bɔhimbu piligu ni yɛla. Yi na kul nyurila bihim, ka pa ni bindir maŋli.
en: By now you should have been teachers, but once again you need to be taught the simplest things about what God has said. You need milk instead of solid food.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa wum o ni wuhi shihir shɛli maa zuɣu ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti tuh o soli maa.
en: That was why the crowd met him—because they heard that he had performed this miracle.

dag: Ka ŋun pa o zuɣu kana ti yɛl o, N dana, a pɔŋli la dɔɣila pɔŋa anu.
en: The second servant said, Sir, with your one bag of money I earned five bags.

dag: Amaa lahaba shɛli din ti yɛn yi wulimpuhili mini nuzaa polo na ni ti kpɛh o dabiɛm, ka o yiɣis o suhu n-tuhi ku niriba pam.
en: But that northern king will hear news from the east and the north that will make him afraid and angry. He will go to completely destroy many nations.

dag: Dindali maa zaŋ na hal ni zuŋɔ Naawuni n-kul sɔŋdi ma, dinzuɣu ka n ʒe kpe n-diri di shɛhira wɔɣira mini tarimba sani n-kul yɛrila Anabi Musa min anabinim ni daa yɛli ni shɛli ni ti niŋ pali la yɛla kɔŋko.
en: God has helped me up to this very day. Therefore, I stand here and bear witness to the lowly and the great. Im saying nothing more than what the Prophets and Moses declared would happen.

dag: Ka so ti ku lan wum mɔɣilo ŋmɛriba mini bana ni alijeeta piɛbiriba ni kika piɛbiriba damli a ni; ka tuuni kam tuumbaŋda ti ku lan be a ni, ka so ti ku lan wum nɛli vubu a ni!.
en: The sound of harpists and musicians, of pipers and trumpeters, will never be heard among you again. No craftsman of any kind will ever be found among you again. The sound of the hand mill will never be heard among you again.

dag: Salo ŋɔ yɛla niŋ ma nambɔɣu pam, dama zuŋɔ daba ata m-bɔŋɔ ka bɛ kul be n sani ka lan ka bindirigu dira.
en: I feel sorry for the crowd because they have been with me for three days and have nothing to eat.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛri ya mi, zaŋmiya yi dunia ŋɔ laɣ yoya ŋɔ bo simdi, ka di yi ti naai, yi ni tooi kpe nyɛvili din ka bahigu shee.
en: My disciples, I tell you to use wicked wealth to make friends for yourselves. Then when it is gone, you will be welcomed into an eternal home.

dag: Ka Musa deemba maa daa nya lala ka bɔh o, Bɔ ka a lee niŋdi tiri niriba maa? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a kɔŋko ʒiya ka niriba maa zaa ʒe n-gil a asiba hal ni zaawuni.
en: When Moses father-in-law saw all that he was doing for the people, he said, Whats this that you are doing for the people? Why do you sit alone, while all the people are standing around you from morning until evening.

dag: Dama kum daa mali ma, ka yi mɔŋ ma bindirigu; ka kɔnyuri daa mali ma, ka yi bi ti ma kom;.
en: I was hungry, but you did not give me anything to eat, and I was thirsty, but you did not give me anything to drink.

dag: Zɛra daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Zɛranima; ka Shaul mi daŋ niriba nyɛ Shaulnima.
en: Zerah—the Zerahite family group; Shaul—the Shaulite family group.

dag: Ka Jɛrimia daa yɛli Sɛraya, A yi ti paai Babilɔn, nyin karimmi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa.
en: I gave the scroll to Seraiah and said: When you get to Babylon, read this scroll aloud.

dag: Amaa Sool min o niriba maa daa bi ku Agag mini piɛ viɛla ni naɣ viɛla ni naɣibihi viɛla ni piɛbihi viɛla. Binshɛɣukam din daa viɛla, bɛ daa bi saɣim li, amaa binshɛɣukam din daa bi viɛla, bɛ daa saɣim di zaa.
en: Saul and the troops spared Agag along with the best sheep, cattle, fattened calves, lambs, and everything of value. They werent willing to put them under the ban; but anything that was despised or of no value they placed under the ban.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Ahija, Nyama, Naa Jɛrɔbɔam paɣ kanna ni o ti bɔh a nya din yɛn niŋ o bia ŋun ka alaafee. A ni ti yɛn yɛl o shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: O ni daa ti paai, o daa taɣila o biɛhigu ni o be kaman paɣ so la.
en: but the Lord told him, Jeroboam's wife is coming to ask about her son. I will tell you what to say to her. Jeroboam's wife came to Ahijah's house, pretending to be someone else.

dag: Bɛ diri birapu ka kuri niriba a ni. Yi paŋdi niriba binyara ka niŋdi ba nyɔri, ka pahiri yi nɛma daa n-fari yi taba nyari buni ka tam n yɛla. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Others of you accept money to murder someone. Your own people charge high interest when making a loan to other Israelites, and they get rich by cheating. Worst of all, you have forgotten me, the Lord God.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda yɛli Yuria, Kulimi yiŋ ti paɣ a naba. Ka Yuria daa yiɣisi nayili maa yi, ka naa daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ pini dol o nyaaŋa ni bɛ ti ti o.
en: Then he said to Uriah, Go on home and rest a while. Uriah left, and David had a present sent to his home.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka dol o ba min o ma ni Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam bɛn daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la naba.
en: He did evil in the LORDs eyes. He walked in his fathers ways and his mothers ways—that is, in the ways of Jeroboam, Nebats son, who had caused Israel to sin.

dag: Tan yini kam wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita pinaata, ka di yɛliŋ mi nyɛ mita ayi. Tan tolima piniyini maa zaa buɣisibu daa nyɛla yim.
en: They made them all the same size, yards long and yards wide.

dag: Di simdi ka dilan zaŋ o nuhi pa nahu maa zuɣu ni ka kɔrig o Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni, ka Aduna bidibisi bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la zaŋ o ʒim kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini.
en: You must press your hand on the head of the offering and slaughter it at the meeting tents entrance. Aarons sons the priests will toss the blood against every side of the altar.

dag: Naawuni, a nam nyɛla din kul ni beni sahakam. A nam jaaŋgbee tumdila din tuhi.
en: God, your kingdom will last forever. You use your authority for justice.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa wuɣi lans ayi din nyɛ zaɣ bɔribɔri ka mali zoligo bansi niŋ li n-zaŋ li pili biŋkpila din tam daanya daantalisi maa zuɣu la. Daantaliga kam daa malila di laŋa.
en: He made two nets of chain to cover the capitals on top of the two columns.

dag: Ka n daa kuhi boli Yawɛ m muɣisigu maa puuni; n daa kuhimi boli n Naawuni ni o sɔŋ ma. Ka n kuhigu maa daa chaŋ ti lu o tibili ni; ka o daa wum n kuhigu maa o jɛmbu duu puuni.
en: In my trouble I called to the Lord ; I called to my God for help. In his temple he heard my voice; he listened to my cry for help.

dag: A dimnim yi lu, nyin di chɛ ka di niŋ a nyaɣisim, bɛ yi tuui, nyin di chɛ ka a suhu piɛla.
en: Don't be glad when your enemies meet disaster, and don't rejoice when they stumble.

dag: O daa niŋ Izraɛlnim zuɣulana la yuun pisinaata. Ka o daa ti kpi, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Shamir.
en: For twenty-three years he led Israel; then he died and was buried in Shamir.

dag: Ka ti daa ti yiɣisi ni n-yi biɛɣu paai Kiɔs n-naanyi yi biɛɣu paai Samɔs n-kaai biɛɣu paai Milɛtus.
en: The next day we sailed from there and arrived opposite Chios. On the day after, we sailed to Samos, and on the following day we came to Miletus.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Batishiiba daa chaŋ naa sani o dudoonigu ni. Di saha maa naa daa kurigiya pam, ka Abishag ŋun daa nyɛ Shunɛm paɣ la m-be o sani gbib o.
en: So Bathsheba went to see the king in his bedroom. He was very old, and Abishag, the young woman from Shunem, was taking care of him.

dag: Malaikanim la daa yɛliya ni bɛ chɛli di tigbirigu la firi tiŋa. Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiri ni a ni ti lan lab a nam maa ni na saha shɛli a yi ti baŋ ni Naawuni n-su dunia ŋɔ zaa fukumsi.
en: But he gave orders not to disturb the stump and roots. This is to show that you will be king once again, after you learn that the God who rules from heaven is in control.

dag: N yɛli barinyuriba, Di nyuriya bara. Ka yɛli ninvuɣ biɛri mi, Di maliya karimbaani.
en: I tell the wicked not to be arrogant;.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa pali Sool ŋun yuli daa lan booni Pool la, ka o mirig o nina niŋ bukpaha maa.
en: Empowered by the Holy Spirit, Saul, also known as Paul, glared at Bar-Jesus and.

dag: O dari tɔhi n yaɣa zaa, ka n yɛla naai, ka darigi vuɣi n tahima kaman tia la.
en: God rips me apart, uproots my hopes.

dag: ŋun daa chɛ o yidaan tuuli, ka tam o ni daa lo Naawuni alikauli shɛli yɛla la.
en: She leaves behind the partner of her youth; she even forgets her covenant with God.

dag: Ka Barizillai ŋun daa nyɛ Giliad nir la daa yi Rɔgɛlim n-chaŋ naa sani Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa ni ni o ti doli naa du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa.
en: Barzillai, from Gilead, had also come down from Rogelim to escort the king across the Jordan.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa saɣi, ka chɛ ka amiliya niŋbu dakulo maa naai, ka Leeban daa lan zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga Reechɛl ti o ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: Jacob agreed, and when the week of marriage celebrations was over, Laban gave him his daughter Rachel as his wife. .

dag: Ka yi ni daa wuhi shɛm maa daa viɛli n sani, ka n daa pii yi daŋ kam ni ninvuɣ yinoyino, ka bɛ kalinli yiɣisi ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: That seemed like a good thing to do, so I selected twelve men, one from each tribe.

dag: Simiɔn zuliya ni, Zurishadai bia Shɛlumiɛl n-yɛn sɔŋ ya;.
en: from Simeon, Shelumiel, Zurishaddais son.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni chɛ ka n ni daa yɛli alɔbo shɛŋa zaa yɛla la lu tiŋ ŋɔ mini di tiŋkpansi zaa zuɣu bɛ ni niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi n yɛligu wumbu maa zuɣu.
en: that the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, had said, I am going to bring on this city and on every nearby town all the punishment that I said I would, because you are stubborn and will not listen to what I say.

dag: Timiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ jilima din ni chɛ ka o ku tahi zibisim na, ka yi tuui zoya zuɣu wuntaŋ ni; yi yi ti bɔri neesim saha shɛli, o chɛrimi ka di niŋ zibisim titali, ka chɛ ka di niŋ bumbɔni.
en: Honor the Lord , your God, before he brings darkness, and you stumble on the mountains; before he turns into deep darkness the light you hoped for.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, ŋun guli Izraɛlnim pala gom ni gbaari so bee ŋun ni gbihi.
en: The protector of Israel doesn't doze or ever get drowsy.

dag: ka daa zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro kpila ayopɔin mini zahim maa n-niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka ŋmahiŋmahi li ti o nyaandoliba maa, ka bɛ mi zaŋ li tari salo maa.
en: he took the seven loaves of bread and the fish and gave thanks. He then broke them and handed them to his disciples, who passed them around to the crowds.

dag: Gɛbal kpamba mini di yɛnnim daa bela a sani m-maani a shee kpatuɣa zaana. Teeku puuni ŋarima zaa mini di kpatoonsi zaa daa nyɛla bɛn be a ni dar a nɛma.
en: The elders and wise men from Byblos were on board to help put caulking between the boards on your ship. All the ships of the sea and their sailors came to trade and do business with you.

dag: O chɛ n daalahichi zaa, ka tibi n dɔriti zaa.
en: The Lord forgives our sins, heals us when we are sick.

dag: Ka bɛnkam nyɛ Yisa Masia ni su shɛba pun zaŋ bɛ niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu mini di kɔre ni di yubu zaa n-kpahi tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: Those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified the self with its passions and its desires.

dag: Amaa tinim ni nyɛ wuntaŋ ni niriba la zuɣu, chɛliya ka ti gbibi ti maŋa ka zaŋ yɛda mini yurilim leei nyɔtaɣirigu m-pa ti nyɔri zuɣu, ka zaŋ ti tiliginsim tahima kaman tɔbutuhiri zuɣupila la pili.
en: But we belong to the day. So we must stay sober and let our faith and love be like a suit of armor. Our firm hope that we will be saved is our helmet.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan yɛli, Chɛ ka binnɛma pam be kom ni, ka chɛ ka noonsi be zuɣusaa sagbana tiŋli yiɣiri gindi dunia ni.
en: Then God commanded, Let the water be filled with many kinds of living beings, and let the air be filled with birds.

dag: Ka Jɛhoyachin daa pirig o dansarika binyɛra sɔŋ; ka daa kul diri nayili bindirigu hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: So Jehoiachin took off his prisoner clothes and ate regularly in the kings presence for the rest of his life.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi siliga maa gbini zo yomyom, dama di daa gari ba mi pam ka bɛ ni sɔhira; bɛ mi daa bi yɛli so shɛli sol ni, dama dabiɛm daa kpe ba. .
en: The women were very afraid and confused. They left the tomb and ran away. They did not tell about what happened, because they were afraid.

dag: ka bɛ ti ku o, amaa o ni ti neei kum ni daba ata dali. Ka di daa niŋ ba nandahima pam.
en: who will kill him; but three days later he will be raised to life. The disciples became very sad.

dag: Manaasa zuliya niriba tiŋgbani maa daa zaŋmi hal ti paai Asha mini Mikimɛtat din be Shɛkɛm wulimpuhili polo la. Ka di tintariga bɔbili daa zaŋ kpa nudirigu polo m-mali hal ti paai Ɛntapuanima.
en: The territory of Manasseh reached from Asher to Michmethath, east of Shechem. The border then went south to include the people of Entappuah.

dag: Ka Balak daa lan tim kpamba bɛn mali jilima pam, ka zooi gar o ni daa tuui tim shɛb maa.
en: So Balak sent other leaders to Balaam. This time he sent many more than the first time. And these leaders were much more important than the first ones he sent.

dag: Ka bɛ ti zaŋ takɔbi ku o tɔbutuhiri biinsi zaa, ka bɛn mi ti gali ni wurim kpe luɣilikam. Ka yi ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: and I will destroy his army. I will destroy his best soldiers and scatter them to the wind. Then you will know that I am the Lord and that I told you these things.

dag: Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba maa, Yi ŋmanila yalim dunia ŋɔ ni. Yalim mi yi ti niŋ piti, binshɛl lan kani din ni tooi chɛ ka di niŋ nyaɣisim yaha; bɛ ni kpaa li mi bahi ka niriba nɔri li, dama di lan ka buchi.
en: You are the salt of the earth. But if salt loses its saltiness, how will it become salty again? Its good for nothing except to be thrown away and trampled under peoples feet.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lan yɛli, N Duuma Naawuni, n kana ni n ti tumla a yubu. Naawuni daa kpihim tuuli sara maligunim la ka zalila din pah ayi.
en: Then he said, Here I am, God. I have come to do what you want. So God ends that first system of sacrifices and starts his new way.

dag: Ahazia gba daa dolila Ɛhab daŋ niriba naba n-tum alahichi Yawɛ sani kaman Ɛhab daŋ niriba maa ni daa tum shɛm la, dama o daa nyɛla Ɛhab daŋ niriba maa deemba.
en: Since Ahaziah was related to King Ahab by marriage, he sinned against the Lord , just as Ahab's family did.

dag: N ni yiini yila paɣiri Yawɛ hal ni n nyɛvili tariga; n ni kul be ŋɔ, n ni yiini yila paɣiri n Naawuni.
en: I will sing to the LORD as long as I live; I will sing praises to my God while Im still alive.

dag: daa chaŋ Gomna Pailɛt sani ti suh o soli ni o chɛ ka o zaŋ Yisa ti sɔɣi. Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm o ti o.
en: went and asked for Jesus' body. Pilate gave orders for it to be given to Joseph.

dag: lala ka daadamnim doya ka ku lan yiɣisi yaha, hal ka sagbana ti lan kani, bɛ ku lan yiɣisi, bee n-neei bɛ gom maa ni.
en: we fall into the sleep of death, never to rise again, until the sky disappears.

dag: Bɛ tibidarigibo ni ti yɛn nyɛ shɛm bɛ karimbaani zuɣu m-bala, dama bɛ maani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ niriba ansarisi, ka nyuri bara niŋdi ba.
en: This will happen to the people of Moab and Ammon because they were so proud and cruel and humiliated the people of the Lord All-Powerful.

dag: N-daa lan yi biɛɣu ka Jɔn min o nyaandoliba ayi ʒiɛya;.
en: The next day John was there again and had two of his followers with him.

dag: Amaa ka Jona daa yiɣisi n-zaŋ kpa Speen polo ni o zo Yawɛ sani. O daa chaŋla tin shɛli din yuli booni Jɔpa la nti nya ŋarin tital shɛli din chani Speen, ka o yo di samli ka kpe ŋariŋ maa ni pahi ŋariŋ maa tumtumdib zuɣu ni o zo Yawɛ sani chaŋ Speen.
en: Instead, Jonah ran from the Lord . He went to the seaport of Joppa and found a ship that was going to Spain. So he paid his fare, then got on the ship and sailed away to escape.

dag: Abimilɛk daa bela Aruma, ka Zɛbul daa kari Gaal min o dɔɣiriba maa ti bahi ka bɛ ku tooi lan be Shɛkɛm.
en: Then Abimelech returned to the city of Arumah. Zebul forced Gaal and his brothers to leave the city of Shechem.

dag: amaa chɛliya ka yimaŋ malibu nyɛla binshɛli din be yi suhuri ni, ka pa ni din saɣinda. Dina n-nyɛ tarimtali mini suhumahili, dama dimbɔŋɔnima m-mali buchi pam Naawuni sani.
en: Instead, your beauty should consist of your true inner self, the ageless beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is of the greatest value in God's sight.

dag: ni bɛ ni mali binshɛŋa kpihiri firilanima ni taha ni chɛrisi. O daa lan zaŋ salima alali mali buɣim moori lahi. Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dunoli pundi mini luɣ kasi zaa kasi shee dunoli pundi zaa daa nyɛla salima.
en: lamp snuffers, small sprinkling bowls, ladles, fire pans, and the doors to the most holy place and the main room of the temple.

dag: Maliya suhukpeeni ka ti zabi ti niriba mini ti Naawuni tinsi ŋɔ zuɣu, ka chɛ ka ŋun Yawɛ niŋ o ni nya ka shɛli viɛl o sani.
en: Be brave! We must be courageous for the sake of our people and the cities of our God. The LORD will do what is good in his eyes.

dag: O ku ŋme naŋgbankpeeni bee n-yo vuri, ka so ku wum o kukoli solɔri zuɣu.
en: He will not argue or shout, or make loud speeches in the streets.

dag: Ka ninsal yi zaɣisi tuuba niŋbu, Naawuni ni sah o takɔbi; ka gur o tɔbu.
en: If the wicked will not change, then God is ready to punish them. He has prepared his deadly weapons. His sword is sharp. His bow is strung, drawn back, and ready to shoot its flaming arrow.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, N yi yɛlila din bi tuhi, nyin wuhim di ni nyɛ shɛli; ka n yi yɛlila din tuhi, di chaŋ wula ka a ŋme ma.
en: Jesus replied, If I speak wrongly, testify about what was wrong. But if I speak correctly, why do you strike me.

dag: Bimɔɣiriga ni ti be gariŋga voli gbini diɛmda, ka bia ŋun ŋmaai bihili ni ti zaŋ o nuu tim bahiga voli ni.
en: Even snakes will not hurt people. Babies will be able to play near a cobras hole and put their hands into the nest of a poisonous snake.

dag: Ka Zɛbul ŋun daa nyɛ tiŋ maa naa ni daa wum Ɛbɛd bia Gaal maa ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka o suhu yiɣisi pam.
en: Zebul was angry when he found out what Gaal had said.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ ma alahiziba n ni daa bi nya ninvuɣ so ŋun ni sɔŋ ma maa; amaa ka n suhuyiɣisili maa daa ti ma kpiɔŋ ka n di nasara n toli.
en: No one was there to help me or to give support; my mighty arm won the battle, strengthened by my anger.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti ku tooi niŋ lala ka pa ni piɛri maa zaa laɣimmina pɔi ka bɛ naanyi paai kuɣili maa kɔbiliga maa noli, ka ti ŋɔŋ kom maa ti ba.
en: But they said, We cannot do that until all the flocks are gathered together. Then we will move the rock from the well, and all the sheep will drink.

dag: Amaa yinim bɛn nyɛ m piɛri ŋɔ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni ti kari saria wuhi din be piɛɣu min o kpee sunsuuni, ka wuhi din be piɛlahi mini buhi sunsuuni.
en: Now then, my flock, I, the Sovereign Lord , tell you that I will judge each of you and separate the good from the bad, the sheep from the goats.

dag: Yi mi dɔɣimiya bihi pam, ka bɛ nabi pali dunia ŋɔ.
en: As for you, be fertile and multiply. Populate the earth and multiply in it.

dag: ka chɛbisi taba. Di nyaaŋa ka ti daa kpe ŋariŋ, ka bɛ mi lab kuli.
en: Then we said good-bye to one another, and we went on board the ship while they went back home.

dag: N daa bi nya Naawuni jɛmbu duu tiŋ maa ni, dama ti Duuma Naawuni Zallakudura Naa mini Piɛbil la n-nyɛ di jɛmbu duu.
en: I did not see a temple there. The Lord God All-Powerful and the Lamb were its temple.

dag: Nyɔtaɣirisi n-kul gil o yaaŋa zuɣu zaa, di shɛbila tab ni kaman bɛ dihi li mi tabili la.
en: His back has rows of shields tightly sealed together.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni n-kuli Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni bɛ ba Yaakubu sani.
en: Joseph's brothers left Egypt, and when they arrived in Canaan.

dag: ni Isaka ni Zɛbulɔn ni Bɛnjamin.
en: Issachar, Zebulun, Benjamin.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛn daŋ tooni ni ti lab nyaaŋa, ka bɛn be nyaaŋa mi ti leei toonnima, dama niriba pam ka bɛ boli nti gahimla biɛla.
en: Jesus then said, So it is. Everyone who is now last will be first, and everyone who is first will be last.

dag: Yinim bɛn mi din tuhi ŋɔ, wummiya! Yinim bɛn gbibi n wuhibu yi suhuri ni ŋɔ, di zɔriya niriba ni maani ya ansarisi shɛli. Ka bɛ yi turi ya, yin di chɛliya ka di muɣisi ya.
en: If you want to do right and obey my teaching with all your heart, then pay close attention. Don't be discouraged when others insult you and say hurtful things.

dag: Di daanabinim baɣa ka shɛli ni, ka nyɛ bɛn ka yɛda. Ka di maligumaaniba saɣim binshɛŋa din be kasi, ka nyɛ bɛn birigi zaligu.
en: Her prophets are always making secret plans to get more and more. Her priests have treated holy things as if they were not holy. They have done bad things to Gods teachings.

dag: Jɔsia daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani, ka daa dol o yab Dauda naba o tuma ni ka bi ŋmaligi kpa nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo ka chɛ li.
en: He did what was right in the LORDs eyes, and walked in the ways of his ancestor David—not deviating from it even a bit to the right or left.

dag: O daa dolila solɔɣu m-miri paɣa maa lɔndo polo. O daa dolila soli chani o yiŋa.
en: He was walking along the street near the corner where a certain woman lived. He was passing near her house.

dag: Izraɛl tɔbbihi maa mini bɛ tab bɛn daa sɔɣ doya la ni daa wuhi tab shihirili shɛli nyɛla ni bɛ yi ti nya ka nyɔhi yiɣisi mɔni tiŋ maa puuni.
en: The plan between the main force of the Israelites and those in the ambush was that when they sent up a big cloud of smoke from the city.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun fa ma duŋtaariba nuu ni, ka chɛ ka n leei niriba naa; ka n ni ʒi ninvuɣ shɛb leei bɛn jɛmdi ma.
en: You delivered me from struggles with many people; you appointed me the leader of many nations. Strangers come to serve me.

dag: N ni zaŋ daɣiri lab a, ka dih a vi, ka chɛ ka niriba lih a ka mal a ansarisi.
en: I will throw dirty things on you and treat you in a hateful way. People will look at you and laugh.

dag: Zom jɛrigu sani, dama a ku nya baŋsim yɛtɔɣa nimaani.
en: Stay away from fools, or you won't learn a thing.

dag: Ka Sintani lan zaŋ o chaŋ nti du zo shɛli din du pam zuɣu n-wuh o dunia ŋɔ nama mini di jilima zaa.
en: Finally, the devil took Jesus up on a very high mountain and showed him all the kingdoms on earth and their power.

dag: Dabisili din daŋ tooni dali yin laɣimmiya jɛm Naawuni, ka di tumiya tuun shɛli.
en: The first day will be a holy occasion. You will not do any job-related work.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ ba alahiziba pam ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Bɔtaa nira n-lee bɔŋɔ hal ka sanʒiɛɣu mini kɔgbana ti wumd o noli.
en: But they were terribly afraid and began to say to one another, Who is this man? Even the wind and the waves obey him.

dag: O kul tiri ma la dansi, o karitimi doli ma kaman tɔbbia la.
en: Again and again he attacks me. He runs at me like a soldier in battle.

dag: Ka Absalom mini Izraɛlnim daa dɔni sansani Giliad tiŋgban ni.
en: Absalom and his men camped in the land of Gilead.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ, noli yɛlibu ni yi tiŋgban shɛli din yaai di noli n-deeg a tizo maa ʒim a nuu ni maa na di a.
en: You are now cursed from the ground that opened its mouth to take your brothers blood from your hand.

dag: Yinim bɛn be Rom gba be Naawuni ni boli shɛba ni bɛ leei Yisa Masia niriba maa kalinli ni.
en: You are some of those who have been chosen to belong to Jesus Christ.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpiɔŋ yir a sanna mal alibarika, bɛ nyɛla bɛn suhuri kul bɔri ni bɛ chaŋ Ziɔn ti jɛm a.
en: Great blessings belong to those who depend on you for strength! Their hearts desire is to make the trip to your Temple.
