dag: Ka yi ni daa tumdi tuun shɛŋa ka di yipa nyɛ vi yi sani pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ, nyɔ bɔ ka yi daa lee nya di ni? Dama dimbɔŋɔnim zaa bahigu nyɛla kum.
en: What consequences did you get from doing things that you are now ashamed of? The outcome of those things is death.

dag: Firawuna yi ti zaɣisi ni o ku wum yi yɛligu maa, di saha ka n ni ti darigi Ijiptinim maa tibili, ka tum tuun kara pam yihi n niriba Izraɛlnim maa zaa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni gbilligbilli.
en: But he will still refuse to listen. So then I will punish Egypt very much. And I will lead my army, my people, out of that land.

dag: O yaar o noli n-tɔɣisiri yɛm yɛtɔɣa, ka nirilim niŋbu wuhibu be o noli ni.
en: She speaks with a gentle wisdom.

dag: Lɛla ni ŋub ba kaman bɛ ni ŋubiri situra shɛm la. Zunzuya ni di ba kaman piɛkɔbiri la. Amaa n faako tibu mini n tiliginsim din nyɛ zuliya kam zaa dini la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: They will be like old clothes eaten by moths. They will be like wool eaten by worms. But my goodness will last forever. My salvation will continue forever and ever.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Musa, Yawɛ yiko malila tariga? To, a ni nya n yɛligu maa ni niŋ yɛlimaŋli yi sani bee di ku niŋ.
en: Is there a limit to my power? the Lord answered. You will soon see whether what I have said will happen or not.

dag: ni tayiɣisi ni kɔrɛnima ni danyuriba ni ninvuɣ turiba ni ninvuɣ fariba zaa ku kpe Naawuni nam ni.
en: or who steal or are greedy or are drunkards or who slander others or are thieves—none of these will possess God's Kingdom.

dag: O ni daa yɛri maa, o noli daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka tiŋgbani bɔɣi bɛ naba ni.
en: As soon as Moses said this, the ground under the men opened up.

dag: O ni vuui suhugarigu sagban shɛli din sirigina ti pili zuliya kam zaa maa zoli ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: But now there is a veil covering all nations and people. This veil is called death.

dag: Ka bɛ nini daa mooi ka bɛ mɔhiri vuri yɛri ni o kul kpahim o mi tabili dapulli zuɣu. Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa saɣi ti bɛ ni bɔri shɛm maa.
en: But the people continued to shout. They demanded that Jesus be killed on a cross. Their shouting got so loud that.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla yɛl bila Yawɛ sani. O ni lan zaŋ Mɔabnim niŋ yi nuu ni;.
en: This is an easy thing for the Lord to do. He will also help you defeat the Moabites.

dag: dama bɛ tiligira nyɛla ŋun mali yaa. O ni zab bɛ zuɣu.
en: The Lord is their powerful defender, and he will argue their case against you.

dag: Yi yi ti du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili chaŋ ti ʒi tiŋgbɔn shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiri ya maa ni, yi yi ti ʒini di ni ka be di ni.
en: So then, once you cross the Jordan River to enter and possess the land that the LORD your God is giving you, and you take possession of it, settling down in it.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kɔri bɛ tiŋgban ni, bɛ ni nya bindirigu pam, amaa bɛn doli binshɛŋa din ka buchi nyɛla bɛn ka yɛm.
en: Hard working farmers have more than enough food; daydreamers are nothing more than stupid fools.

dag: Bɛ ni me birini gili tin shɛl la lumi dahim zaa, ka bɛ chɛ li bahi kaman tiŋgban nɛl la. Di leela biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee ni bɛ ni dooni luɣ shɛli vuhira.
en: The great city will be empty; it will be like a desert. All the people will be gone—they will run away. The city will be like an open pasture. Young cattle will eat grass there. The cattle will eat leaves from the branches of the vines.

dag: Ka o yi yɛn zaŋla piɛɣu na ti mali sara, ŋun zaŋmi piɛnyaŋ ŋun ka dalinli na.
en: If you bring a lamb as your sin offering, then you must bring a female lamb that has nothing wrong with it.

dag: So mi ku saɣi zaŋ da palli le dakol kura ni, dama o yi niŋ lala, kola maa ni chɛhichɛhi, ka dam maa kpaai bahi, ka kola maa gba saɣim. Dinzuɣu bɛ zaŋdi da palli n-lɛrila kol pala ni, ka di bina ayi maa zaa shɛli ku saɣim.
en: Also, people never pour new wine into old wineskins. They would break, the wine would spill out, and the wineskins would be ruined. People always put new wine into new wineskins, which wont break, and the wine stays good.

dag: Ŋunkam je ma, ka bi deei n yɛligu mali sariakarita. Yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa n ni pun tɔɣisi la nti yɛn kar o saria zaadali.
en: But there is a judge for all those who refuse to believe in me and do not accept what I say. The message I have spoken will judge them on the last day.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa yɛli; Mbaye! Yaa n Duuma NAAWUNI, bɔzuɣu ka a daa zaŋ ti du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ na? A zaŋ ti mi na ni a ti ti Amɔrinim ka bɛ ku ti? Ti yi di daa chɛ ka ti nini tiɣi Jɔɔdɛn yaɣili wulimpuhili polo la ka kpalim nimaani di di so.
en: Then Joshua said: Our Lord , did you bring us across the Jordan River just so the Amorites could destroy us? This wouldn't have happened if we had agreed to stay on the other side of the Jordan.

dag: Bɛ zaŋla anzinfa viɛlli yi Speen na, ka zaŋ salima yi Ufaz na. Di nyɛla tuumbaŋdiba mini salindooriba nuhi tuma. Di situra nyɛla zaɣ sabilifaa mini zaɣ ʒiɛhi. Di zaa nyɛla tuumbaŋdiba ni mali binshɛŋa.
en: They use silver from the city of Tarshish and gold from the city of Uphaz and make their statues. Carpenters and metalworkers make the idols. They put blue and purple clothes on them. Wise men make these gods.

dag: Ka n zaŋ o tah a nyaandoliba ŋɔ sanna, ka bɛ bi tooi tib o.
en: I brought him to your disciples, but none of them could heal him.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kul yɛr o di yɛla dabisili kam, ka o zaɣisi. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ yɛlli maa yɛli Haman ni bɛ nya Mɔdɛkai yɛligu maa ni zani, dama o daa pun yɛli ba ni o nyɛla Yɛhudia nira.
en: Day after day, the kings leaders spoke to Mordecai, but he refused to obey the command to bow down to Haman. So they told Haman about it. They wanted to see what Haman would do about Mordecai. Mordecai had told them that he was a Jew.

dag: Ti mali suhukpeeni Naawuni sani, dama ti mi ni ti yi suh o shɛlikam ka di dol o yubu, o deeri ti suhigu.
en: This is the confidence that we have in our relationship with God: If we ask for anything in agreement with his will, he listens to us.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa chɛ Filistianim kari doli; ka Filistianim maa daa labi bɛ biɛhigu shee.
en: After that, Saul stopped pursuing the Philistines, and they went back to their own territory.

dag: Ka Bɔaz daa bɔh o tumtumdib kpɛma, Ka paɣisar ŋuni n-lee bɔŋɔ.
en: Then Boaz asked the man in charge of the harvest workers, Who is that young woman.

dag: N yɛli Yawɛ, Nyini n-nyɛ n Naawuni. Yawɛ, gbilisim tibili wum n suhigu.
en: I say to the Lord , You are my God. Hear my cry for help, Lord !.

dag: Di chɛ ka a baɣa be kurimbuni lahibaya din bi luri Naawuni sizuura ka nyɛ din pa yɛlimaŋli la ni. Kul zaŋm amaŋ niŋla wuntia soli yɛla bɔhimbu ni.
en: But keep away from those godless legends, which are not worth telling. Keep yourself in training for a godly life.

dag: Yihim yɛlimuɣisira n suhu ni, ka yihi ma n nandahima ni.
en: Free me from my troubles. Help me solve my problems.

dag: So ku tooi ka n sanna ka pa ni m Ba Naawuni ŋun tim ma na maa n-vo o tahina; ka n ti neeg o kum ni zaadali.
en: No one can come to me unless they are drawn to me by the Father who sent me, and I will raise them up at the last day.

dag: yɛra, Yɛlimaŋli ti Duuma shiri neei kum ni; hal o yi Saimɔn zuɣu.
en: and saying, The Lord is risen indeed! He has appeared to Simon.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa yɛli Zara mi, Nyama, n zaŋ anzinfa laɣibaligu tuhili ti a tizɔdoo maa ni di wuhi bɛnkam zaa be a sani mini sokam zaa ni a bi tum taali.
en: He said to Sarah, I am giving your brother a thousand pieces of silver as proof to all who are with you that you are innocent; everyone will know that you have done no wrong.

dag: Ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka tin ya suhudoo!.
en: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!.

dag: N ni be a tooni, ka dahim zoya ti a. N ni kabi daanya dunoya ti a, ka kabi dunoya ni kuriti ti a.
en: I myself will prepare your way, leveling mountains and hills. I will break down bronze gates and smash their iron bars.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n ŋmanila ninvuɣ so ŋun bi tooi wumda, di zuɣu ka n ku tooi garigi yɛli shɛli.
en: Ive become like a person who doesnt hear what is being said, whose mouth has no good comeback.

dag: Nyama, a pun wum Asiria naa ni pun niŋ tiŋgbɔna pam shɛm n-saɣim li zaa la yɛla. Ka a tɛhiya ni nyin ni tiligi?.
en: You have heard how we Assyrian kings have completely wiped out other nations. What makes you feel so safe?.

dag: Di takɔriti mini di zɔntua ni di abie tihi kɔtomsi daa bemi kaman dunɔdali din be wulimpuhili polo la dina ni daa be shɛm. Di daa malila dunɔdura ayopɔin zaŋ chaŋ dunɔdali maa gbini, ka di zɔŋ be di puuni.
en: The windows, porch, and palm decorations had the same measurements as those of the east gate. Seven steps led up to the entrance, and the porch was at the other end.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa be o sani, ka o daa yi kul chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam zaa o dirila nasara. O daa zaɣisi Asiria naa jɛmbu.
en: The Lord helped Hezekiah, so he was successful in everything he did. He even rebelled against the king of Assyria, refusing to be his servant.

dag: Ka Sool daa tim tuumba ni bɛ chaŋ ti nya Dauda, ka lan yɛli ba Ʒimiy o min o garo maa zaa na ka n ti ku o.
en: The men went and told Saul, but he sent the messengers back to see David. Saul told these men, Bring David to me. Bring him lying on his bed if you must, even if it kills him.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka maligumaaniba maa mini Lɛvinim maa daa mali bɛmaŋa ni bɛ kpuɣi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ Daalikauli Adaka maa.
en: Then the priests and the Levites purified themselves in order to move the Covenant Box of the Lord God of Israel.

dag: din nyɛ sagbana ni kpaari shɛli bahira, ka di luri ninsalinim zuɣu na pampam.
en: He lets the rain pour from the clouds in showers for all human beings.

dag: Biɛɣ pihinahi ka bɛ daa zaŋ chaŋ ti puɣisi nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa ka labina.
en: After exploring the land of Canaan for days.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan yiŋbihi ni yino ŋun daa nyɛ Pita ni daa chɛ n-shɛligi so tibili la dɔɣim bɔh o, N di bi nya a o sani tihi puu la ni.
en: One of the High Priest's slaves, a relative of the man whose ear Peter had cut off, spoke up. Didn't I see you with him in the garden? he asked.

dag: Hɛman mini Jɛdutun n-daa nyɛ bɛn piɛbiri kikahi ka ŋmɛri guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisa ni biŋkumdi shɛŋa din pahi n-yiini yila din be kasi la. Ka bɛ daa pii Jɛdutun bidibisi n-leei dunɔguliba.
en: With them were also the trumpets and the cymbals for the musicians and the instruments for Gods songs. Jeduthuns family was at the gate.

dag: Di darigi ti tibili ti yaannim daalahichi zuɣu. Zom ti nambɔɣu yomyom; dama ti nya filiŋ pam.
en: Please dont punish us for the sins of our ancestors. Hurry, show us your mercy! We need you so much!.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ lɔɣu din chaɣisira n-nyaɣil o, ka zaŋ kpan titali din nyaɣisira mini banchiriga n-nyaɣil o pahi.
en: The weapons which their riders carry rattle and flash in the sun.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa yɛli ba, Chɛliya paɣ ŋɔ baalim! Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi kaɣil o lala? Tuun suŋ ka o tum ma maa.
en: Jesus said, Leave her alone. Why do you make trouble for her? She has done a good thing for me.

dag: Di daa bi yuui ka Yawɛ yɛli Musa mini Aduna ni Miriam, Yi niriba ata maa kam Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la gbin na. Ka bɛ niriba ata maa daa kana.
en: and told Moses, Aaron, and Miriam to come to the entrance of the sacred tent.

dag: A zaŋ a ni nam binshɛɣukam niŋ bɛ nuu ni, ka zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa fukumsi niŋ bɛ nuu ni:.
en: Youve let them rule over your handiwork, putting everything under their feet.

dag: M mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa chaŋ chandi maa bɛn daa chɛ ka dabiɛm kpɛla Izraɛlnima, amaa ka man daa kul ʒe Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ yim.
en: My companions who had gone up with me made the peoples heart melt. But I remained loyal to the LORD my God.

dag: Piɛɣu maa daa malila liŋa. Ka n daa kul lihiri hal ti nya ka di liŋ maa wuɣi zuɣusaa, ka paɣa ʒi piɛɣu maa puuni.
en: The lead cover of the basket was opened, and in the basket was a woman.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa tɔɣisi Anab Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ zuliya shɛb polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: These messages about different nations came to Jeremiah the prophet from the Lord .

dag: Dahin shɛli ka do so daa ti yi Baalishalisha n-ʒi bindir pala din nyɛ kapala bɔrɔbɔro kpil pisi mini kawaan maha o kpalaŋ ni na nti ti Naawuni nir maa. Ka Ilaisha daa yɛl o sɔŋda, Zaŋm li ti niriba maa ka bɛ ŋubi.
en: A man came from Baal-shalishah, bringing the man of God some bread from the early produce—twenty loaves of barley bread and fresh grain from his bag. Elisha said, Give it to the people so they can eat.

dag: O ni ti deei yi bindira mini yi wain tihi wala pirigibu bupia kam puuni vaabu yim ti o kpambaliba min o tumtumdiba.
en: He will take a tenth of your grain and of your grapes for his court officers and other officials.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn chɛmi ka a yi dunia ni. A ni kpi yuuni ŋɔ puuni a ni tɔɣisi duŋtaabo yɛtɔɣa jɛndi Yawɛ maa zuɣu. .
en: And so the Lord himself says that he is going to get rid of you. Before this year is over you will die because you have told the people to rebel against the Lord .

dag: Ka a ti she zabbanim mini shɛlɔriti ni zuɣupila n-ti Aduna bidibisi. Di simdi ka a mal li ka di nyɛla bɛ jilima mini bɛ nachiinsi situra.
en: For Aarons sons, you should also make tunics, sashes, and turbans to mark their honor and dignity.

dag: Gomna Filiksi ni daa wum lala ka mi mi soli ŋɔ yɛla viɛnyɛliŋga la zuɣu ka o daa chɛ bɛ yɛtɔɣa maa zali soli ka yɛli ba, Sapashin kpɛm Lisias n-ni kana ka n naanyi ŋmaai yi yɛtɔɣa maa.
en: Felix, who had an accurate understanding of the Way, adjourned the meeting. He said, When Lysias the commander arrives from Jerusalem, I will decide this case.

dag: Ka niriba pam ni ti doli karimba ʒirinim ŋɔ kɔr biɛri soya, ka bɛ biɛhigu zuɣu ni chɛ ka niriba tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ biɛri dalim yɛlimaŋli sol la.
en: Many people will follow their evil ways and cause others to tell lies about the true way.

dag: Bɛ bi mali noli ni yɛtɔɣa kɔŋko saɣisiri tumtumdiba, dama hal bɛ yi kul baŋ a ni yɛli shɛm, bɛ baɣa ku bɛ di ni.
en: Servants will not learn a lesson if you only talk to them. They might understand you, but they will not obey.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee gbarigi, ka o gbariginsim maa bi tabili ma? Ŋuni ka so lee luhi, ka n suhu bi yiɣisi bahi ŋun luh o maa zuɣu?.
en: When someone is weak, then I feel weak too; when someone is led into sin, I am filled with distress.

dag: Di yuma anahi nyaaŋa ka Absalom daa chaŋ ti yɛli naa, Naa, n suhir a mi, chɛ ka n chaŋ Hiburɔn nti pali n ni daa lo Yawɛ alikauli shɛli nimaani.
en: After four years, Absalom said to King David, Please let me go to Hebron to complete a special promise that I made to the Lord .

dag: Biŋkɔbiri maa tab dubu saha ka n daa ti zahim zahindi nya ka bulahi bɛn duri buhi maa nyɛla zaɣ bomaboma mini bɛn liɣisiliɣisi ni bɛn nyɛ zaɣ bɔribɔri.
en: During the breeding season I had a dream, and I saw that the male goats that were mating were striped, spotted, and speckled.

dag: Ka bua maa ni deei bɛ tuumbiɛri zaa ʒi n-chaŋ tiŋgban nɛli ni, ka o ti zaŋ bua maa bahi mɔɣu maa ni.
en: The goat will carry all their sins away with him into some uninhabited land.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli shɛm la: Di yi nyɛla din to ni wuntizɔra tiligi, wula ka di ni be bɛn bi luri Naawuni sizuura mini alahichinim la sani.
en: As the scripture says, It is difficult for good people to be saved; what, then, will become of godless sinners.

dag: Ka Ɛbɛd bia Gaal maa daa ti yina ti zani tiŋ maa gooni dunol ni, ka Abimilɛk min o niriba maa yiɣisi bɛ sɔɣibu shee maa yina.
en: The next morning, Gaal went out and stood in the opening of the town gate. Abimelech and his soldiers left their hiding places.

dag: Saha shɛli Samuɛl ni daa be Ɛli sani n-tumdi Yawɛ tuma maa, Yawɛ daa bi lan tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa waawaayili, ka niriba daa bi lan nyari ʒiinim waawaayili.
en: The boy Samuel was Elis helper and served the Lord with him. At that time the Lord did not speak directly to people very often. There were very few visions.

dag: Ka Musa daa kpalim be Yawɛ sani wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ biɛɣu pihinahi, o daa bi di bindirigu bee n-nyu kom. Ka o daa sabi alikauli maa yɛtɔɣa din nyɛ fukumsi zaligunim pia la pa bimparilana ayi maa zuɣu.
en: Moses stayed there with the Lord for days and nights. Moses did not eat any food or drink any water. And he wrote the words of the agreement on the two stone tablets.

dag: kaman chuɣu dal la. N ni vuui barina ka chɛn ya, ka yi ku lan di vi yaha.
en: like people at a party. I will take away your shame. I will make them stop hurting you.

dag: ka di zuɣu chɛ ka a nya alibarika, dama bɛ ku tooi niŋ a lala labisi. Amaa ka a lee ti nya laara wuntizɔriba kum ni neebu dali.
en: Then you will have great blessings, because these people cannot pay you back. They have nothing. But God will reward you at the time when all godly people rise from death.

dag: Ti ba daa kpila mɔɣu la ni. O daa ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa laɣim pahi Kɔra zuɣu taai duŋ niŋ Yawɛ la kalinli ni, amaa omaŋmaŋ daalahichi zuɣu ka o daa kpi; ka mi ka bidibisi.
en: Our father died in the desert. He wasnt part of the community who gathered against the LORD with Korahs community. He died for his own sin, but he had no sons.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrusalɛmnim mini Judianim zaŋ tabili Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili dulinim zaa daa kab chaŋ o sani.
en: From Jerusalem and all Judea and from the Jordan River Valley crowds of people went to John.

dag: Zaŋm a gbaɣino min a nyɔtaɣirigu yiɣisi zani sɔŋ ma.
en: Grab a shield and armor; stand up and help me!.

dag: Ka gomna maa daa nya din niŋ maa ka niŋ yɛda, dama ti Duuma yɛligu maa wuhibu daa gar o pam.
en: When the governor saw what had taken place, he came to believe, for he was astonished by the teaching about the Lord.

dag: ka tin yin nim ni ti yɛli tin shɛlinima, Ti chanimi ni ti ti jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, ka suh o ka o niŋ alibarika niŋ ti ni. Kamiyana ka ti mini ya chaŋ.
en: The inhabitants of one city will go to another saying, Lets go and seek the favor of the LORD, and look for the LORD of heavenly forces. Im going too.

dag: O zuli kpɛmmi kaman sida tia la; ka o gbalipina ni jila kpɛnkpe tab ni.
en: He stiffens his tail like a cedar; the tendons in his thighs are tightly woven.

dag: O daa po pɔri n-lo Yaakubu alikauli. O daa lo Izraɛl alikauli din ku vuui.
en: The Lord made a covenant with Jacob, one that will last forever.

dag: ni Umma ni Afɛk ni Rɛhɔb gba daa pahi: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔntiŋ kara pisinaayi m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Ummah, Aphek, and Rehob: twenty-two cities, along with the towns around them.

dag: Ka bɛ ni shɛb daa bɔri ni bɛ gbaag o, amaa ka so daa lee bi zaŋ o nuu shih o.
en: Some of the people wanted to arrest him. But no one tried to do it.

dag: Di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni n nyɛla a dɔɣim puuni ninvuɣ so ŋun su a gbibbu fukumsi, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun nyɛ dɔɣim maa puuni nira ka miri dɔɣim maa gari ma gba beni.
en: And it is true that I am a close relative. But there is a man who is a closer relative to you than I am.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Mbusim be yinim Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba mini Farisiinim bɛn nyɛ bilikɔɣinim ŋɔ zuɣu! Dama yi yo alizanda nam dunoli ni niriba di kpe di ni. Yimaŋmaŋ bi kpɛri di ni, ka mi bi saɣiri ni bɛn bɔri ni bɛ kpe di ni kpe. .
en: How terrible it will be for you legal experts and Pharisees! Hypocrites! You shut people out of the kingdom of heaven. You dont enter yourselves, and you wont allow those who want to enter to do so.

dag: Ti suhuri fuŋmi, ka ti luri bɔɣa ni, yɛl biɛɣu paai ti, ka ti bahi yoli zaa.
en: We are terrified and trapped, caught and crushed.

dag: ni chuɣu dali binyɛra ni binyɛr shɛŋa din yɛri pari zuɣusaa ni binyɛr kara ni nuhi ni kolibihi.
en: the fine dresses, robes, veils, and purses.

dag: O yi di deeg o shia, ka deeg o vuhim.
en: If God took back the breath of life.

dag: Yawɛ, n suhir a, teemi n ni jɛm a ni ʒiɛyimtali ni n suhu zaa ka tum din tuhi a sani shɛm yɛla; ka daa kum pam.
en: Lord , remember that I have faithfully served you with all my heart. I have done what you say is good. Then Hezekiah cried very hard.

dag: Bɛ mabihi bɛn daa nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi ninvuɣ kɔbiga ni pihitaayika n-daa be bɛ daŋ maa ni. Bɛ zuɣulana n-daa nyɛ Zabidiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Hagɛdolim bia la.
en: and of Amashsais brothers.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, duumanim shɛba n-yi su ti, amaa a kɔŋko ka ti mi.
en: LORD our God, other masters besides you have ruled us, but we will profess your name alone.

dag: Nyini n-daa zaŋ omaŋmaŋ piɛma to o tɔbbihi zuɣulana, bɛn daa kana kaman pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga ni bɛ ti wurim ti, ka bɛ pulaantali be kaman bɛn mali shili ni bɛ ku tarimba bɛn sɔɣi la.
en: You pierce the head of his warrior with his own spear. His warriors are driven off, those who take delight in oppressing us, those who take pleasure in secretly devouring the poor.

dag: Zaŋmiya daba ayɔbu tum yi tuma zaa.
en: You have six days when you can do your work.

dag: Ka Anabi Aizaia gba daa sabi yɛli pahi: Ninvuɣ so ŋun ni ti su bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ni ti yila Jɛsi zuliya ni na. O ni ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim tahima ni ti be.
en: And again, Isaiah says, There will be a root of Jesse, who will also rise to rule the Gentiles. The Gentiles will place their hope in him .

dag: Harim daŋ ni: Maasɛya so mini Ɛlia ni Shɛmaya ni Jɛhiɛl ni Uzia.
en: Clan of Harim: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah.

dag: Kaman tampiŋ sabinli ni kpɛm gari chɛribo kuɣili shɛm, lala ka n yɛn chɛ ka a suhu kpɛma. Di zɔri ba bee n-chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira bɛ lihigu zuɣu, dama bɛ nyɛla duŋtaariba.
en: I will make you as firm as a rock, as hard as a diamond; don't be afraid of those rebels.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya: A yi ni doli n zaligunima ka tumdi n ni zal a tuun shɛŋa ni a tum, n ni chɛ ka a su n jɛmbu duu tuma, ka ti a zaashee bɛn ʒe kpe ŋɔ sunsuuni.
en: This is what the Lord All-Powerful said: Live the way I tell you, and do everything I say. And you will be in charge of my Temple. You will take care of its courtyard. You will be free to go anywhere in my Temple, just as these angels standing here.

dag: Ka sapashin kpɛm maa daa gbaai nachimbil maa nuu ni n-zaŋ o yi kpaŋa nti bɔh o ashilɔni, Yɛtɔɣ bɔ ka a mali ni a yɛli ma.
en: The commander took him by the hand, led him off by himself, and asked him, What do you have to tell me.

dag: O daa po pɔri n-lo Yaakubu alikauli. O daa lo Izraɛl alikauli din ku vuui.
en: God set it up as binding law for Jacob, as an eternal covenant for Israel.

dag: Di chaŋ wula? Yi sani ka Naawuni yɛligu yina? Bee yi kɔŋko sani ka di kana?.
en: Or could it be that the word of God came from you? Or are you the only ones to whom it came?.

dag: ka daa zaŋ a dan maa yili ti a, ka zaŋ o paɣiba ti a, ka zaŋ Izraɛl mini Juda ti a pahi. Ka dimbɔŋɔ yi di pɔra, n naan ti a din gari lala pahi.
en: I gave you his kingdom and his wives; I made you king over Israel and Judah. If this had not been enough, I would have given you twice as much.

dag: Di ni sab Naawuni Kundi ni shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: So pa wuntizɔra, hal ninvuɣ yino gba kani.
en: As the Scriptures say: There is no one who is righteous.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ titali nyɛla ŋun tumdi din doli yɛlimaŋli soli, ka ʒe din tuhi nyaaŋa.
en: But an honorable person acts honestly and stands firm for what is right.

dag: Ka n daa lihi li viɛnyɛliŋga n-nya ka yiŋ biŋkɔbiri mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri balibu kam ni tinvura ni yiŋ biŋgbamda ni noonsi m-be di ni.
en: When I looked in it, I saw animals, wild beasts, reptiles, and birds.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun daa yi fari niriba, ŋun chɛli fabu maa ka tummila omaŋmaŋ nuu zuɣu tuma n-dihir omaŋa hal ka ni tooi sɔŋdi nandaamba.
en: Thieves should no longer steal. Instead, they should go to work, using their hands to do good so that they will have something to share with whoever is in need.

dag: Tarimba mini wɔɣira zaa be nimaani, ka daba nya bɛmaŋ bɛ duumanim sani.
en: Everyone—from the greatest to the least important—will be there, and even the slave is free from his master.

dag: Paɣ so a ni daa nya maa ni nyɛla tin tital shɛli din su dunia nanim zaa yiko.
en: The woman whom you saw is the great city that rules over the kings of the earth.

dag: So shɛli beni ŋ-ŋmani din tuhi nir sani, amaa ka di bahigu ti nyɛla kum.
en: There is a way that people think is right, but it leads only to death.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ɛdomnim daa bɔhi Judanim biɛri ka dinzuɣu chɛ ka bɛ kpe taali ni bɛ ni bɔhi ba biɛri maa zuɣu.
en: This is what the Lord GOD says: The people of Edom turned against the family of Judah and tried to get even. The people of Edom are guilty.

dag: N kul bela filiŋ ni dabisili kam; ka vi kul mali ma;.
en: I am always in disgrace; I am covered with shame.

dag: Yawɛ mali yaa gari kokpɛɣu din mali kpiɔŋ vubu. O mali yaa gari teeku kɔgbana. Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun mali yaa zuɣusaa!.
en: Its mighty waves are majestic, but you are even more majestic, and you rule over all.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ pala binshɛli din ka buchi yi sani, amaa di nyɛla yimaŋmaŋ nyɛvili. Di puuni ka yi ni ti mali nyɛvili wɔɣinli m-be yi ni yɛn du Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili chaŋ ti deei tiŋgbɔn shɛli su maa ni.
en: Dont think these teachings are not important. They are your life! Through these teachings you will live a long time in the land across the Jordan River that you are ready to take.

dag: A yɛliya ni a ni du nti tam sagbana zuɣu n-zaŋ amaŋ leei kaman Zallakudura Naa.
en: I will go up to the altar above the tops of the clouds. I will be like God Most High.

dag: Ka bɛn zaa daa laɣim maa fo baalim wumdi Baanabas mini Pool ni daa kahigiri shihir shɛŋa bɛ ni wuhi mini alahiziba tumtumsa shɛŋa Naawuni ni daa chɛ ka bɛ tum bɛn pa Yɛhudianim maa sani yɛla wuhiri ba.
en: The entire assembly fell quiet as they listened to Barnabas and Paul describe all the signs and wonders God did among the Gentiles through their activity.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, N gba ni bɔhi ya bɔhigu ka yi garigi ma.
en: Jesus replied, I want to ask you a question.

dag: Ka Azaria ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa min o maligumaanitab maa daa lihi nya ka kɔŋ wulig o gbɛɣu zuɣu. Ka bɛ daa daag o yihi yomyom, ka o gba maŋmaŋ daa niŋ yomyom yi, dama Yawɛ n-daa chɛ ka kɔŋ maa wulig o maa.
en: Azariah the leading priest and all the priests looked at Uzziah. They could see the leprosy on his forehead. The priests quickly forced him out from the Temple. Uzziah himself hurried out because the Lord had punished him.

dag: N ni yihi ba Ijipti mini Asiria labisina ti ʒili bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni. N ni zaŋ ba ʒili Giliad mini Lɛbanɔn, ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ti pali niriba hal ka palo ti ku lan beni.
en: I will bring them back from Egypt and Assyria. I will bring them to the area of Gilead. And since there will not be enough room, I will also let them live in nearby Lebanon.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔahaz tɔbbihi daa bi lan yaɣ lala. Kulla wɔribariba pihinu mini chɛchɛbunsi pia ni tinchandiba tuhi pia, dama Siria naa daa ku bɛn kpalim maa zaa n-no ba taai tiŋa kaman kabɔɣili ni taŋkpaɣu la.
en: No, nothing was left of Jehoahazs army except fifty chariot riders, ten chariots, and ten thousand foot soldiers, because Arams king had decimated them, trampling them as if they were dirt.

dag: dama bɛn kpalim maa ni ti yi Jɛrusalɛm mini Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu na n-galisi pam. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ loya ni o ni chɛ ka lala niŋ.
en: That is because a few people will come out of Jerusalem alive. There will be survivors coming from Mount Zion. The strong love of the Lord All-Powerful will do this.

dag: M pala ŋun mali yolisim? M pala tumo? N nini daa bi nya ti Duuma Yisa? Yi pala n tuma nyɔri ti Duuma ni?.
en: I am free. I am an apostle. I have seen the Lord Jesus and have led you to have faith in him.

dag: Dinzuɣu m bɔri ni yi baŋ ni ninvuɣ so ŋun tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni na ʒi n-yɛli noli ti Yisa, ka so mi ku tooi yɛli ni Yisa nyɛla o Duuma, ka pa ni Shia Kasi yiko ni.
en: Now I want you to know that if you are led by God's Spirit, you will say that Jesus is Lord, and you will never curse Jesus.

dag: O suhi ma mi ni n chɛ ka o doli kachɛriba maa nyaaŋa yihiri kayiha. Ka o kul bela o tuma ni asibaasi la zaa zaŋ kana pɔŋɔ, o na kul bi ʒini vuhi biɛla gba.
en: She came early this morning and asked me if she could follow the workers and gather the grain that was left on the ground. She rested only a short time in that shelter.

dag: Ŋuna n-chɛ ka Naa min o saawaranim ni o tuma zuɣulaannim bɛn mali yiko pam la niŋ ma nirilim. N daa niŋ suhukpeeni, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ nuu daa pa n zuɣu, ka n daa laɣim Izraɛl zuɣulaannima ni m mini ba lab kuli.
en: God showed his faithful love to me in front of the king, his advisors, and the kings important officials. The Lord my God was with me, and that gave me courage. I gathered together the leaders of Israel to go with me to Jerusalem.

dag: ka lan nyɛ ŋun be nyɛvili ni; nyama, n daa pun kpimi ka neei, ka mi ku lan kpi hal abada. Mani n-su kum mini kpiimba biɛhigu shee saafɛbihi fukumsi.
en: and the living one. I died, but now I am alive forever, and I have the keys to death and the world of the dead.

dag: Ka ninsal yi zaɣisi tuuba niŋbu, Naawuni ni sah o takɔbi; ka gur o tɔbu.
en: If someone doesnt change their ways, God will sharpen his sword, will bend his bow, will string an arrow.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n lo nia ni m me jɛmbu duu ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ kaman ŋun Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli m ba Dauda, N ni ti yɛn zaŋ a bi so leei naa zal a zaashee n-ni ti me jɛmbu duu ti ma.
en: The Lord God promised my father that when his son became king, he would build a temple for worshiping the Lord . So I've decided to do that.

dag: N yi daa niŋ salima yɛda bee n-niŋ salima din viɛla naani.
en: If Ive made gold my trust, said to fine gold: My security.

dag: Bɛ di ti kpuɣi pakoli bee n-kpuɣi paɣ so ŋun yi doo yili. Amaa di simdi ni bɛ ti kpuɣila paɣisara bɛn na ʒi dɔbba Izraɛlnim zuliya ni bee bɛ ni tooi kpuɣi maligumaana pakoli.
en: No priest may marry a divorced woman; he is to marry only an Israelite virgin or the widow of another priest.

dag: Ka bɛ lar o, bɛ ni daa mi ni o kpiya zuɣu.
en: They all made fun of him, because they knew that she was dead.

dag: Ka saamba di yi buni, ka yi tuma nyɔri kuli tinzun nir yiŋa;.
en: Strangers will get your money and everything else you have worked for.

dag: Ninsalinim suhuyiɣisili ni ŋmaligi paɣ a, a yi ti chɛ ka a suhuyiɣisili din bahindi nyaaŋa la biɛla gil a.
en: Even human rage will turn to your praise when you dress yourself with whatever remains of your wrath.

dag: Yi booni ma la yi karimba ni yi Duuma; yɛlimaŋli mi n-shiri nyɛ li, dama lala n-nyɛ ma.
en: You call me Teacher and Lord, and it is right that you do so, because that is what I am.

dag: Di saha ka Ilaisha daa suhi Yawɛ yɛli, Neem o nina ka o nya. Ka Yawɛ daa neei nachimbil maa nina ka o lihi nya ka yuri mini buɣim chɛchɛbunsi n-kul pali zoli zuɣu n-teei gili Ilaisha.
en: Then he prayed, Lord , please help him to see. And the Lord let the servant see that the hill was covered with fiery horses and flaming chariots all around Elisha.

dag: N ni mali suhupiɛlli Jɛrusalɛm mini n niriba zuɣu, ka so ku lan kum bee n-fabili di ni.
en: I will rejoice in Jerusalem and be glad about my people. No one will ever hear the sound of weeping or crying in it again.

dag: Dama alɔbo n-lu n zuɣu dabisi muni puuni zaa; ka n nyari tibidarigibo asiba kam.
en: I am sick all day, and I am punished each morning.

dag: Ka Lɛvinim bɛn daa nyɛ Kɔhat daŋ niriba mini Kɔra daŋ niriba la daa yiɣisi zani ŋ-ŋme kuŋ pam paɣi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: The members of the Levite clans of Kohath and Korah stood up and with a loud shout praised the Lord , the God of Israel.

dag: Ka naa daa bɔhi Ziba, Ka a dan bia la lee be ya polo? Ka Ziba garigi yɛli naa, Nyama, o kpalim Jɛrusalɛm, dama o yɛlimi, Pumpɔŋɔ Izraɛlnim ni zaŋ n yab nam ŋɔ ti ma. .
en: Where is Mephibosheth, the grandson of your master Saul? the king asked him. He is staying in Jerusalem, Ziba answered, because he is convinced that the Israelites will now restore to him the kingdom of his grandfather Saul.

dag: Wula ka yi lee tɛhiri Masia yɛla? Ŋun yaaŋa n-lee nyɛ o? Ka bɛ yɛl o, O nyɛla Naa Dauda yaaŋa.
en: What do you think about the Messiah? Whose descendant is he? He is David's descendant, they answered.

dag: Ka Jɔn daa niŋ Naawuni yɛligu maa mini Yisa Masia shɛhira ni omaŋmaŋ nini ni daa nya shɛlikam zaa shɛhiralana.
en: who has told everything he saw. It is the truth that Jesus Christ told him; it is the message from God.

dag: Ka o daa ŋmaligi yɛli bɛn ʒe nimaani maa, Deemiya pɔŋli maa o sani n-zaŋ pahi ŋun mali pɔŋ pia la.
en: Then he said to those who were standing there, Take the gold coin away from him and give it to the servant who has ten coins.

dag: Di saha ka Zadok bia Ahimaaz daa yɛli, Chɛ ka man guui kuli nti ti naa lahibali ni Yawɛ fa o o dimnim nuu ni bahi.
en: Ahimaaz the son of Zadok said, Joab, let me run and tell King David that the Lord has rescued him from his enemies.

dag: Bɛ loya ni bɛ zaŋ bɛ zahima maa n-chɛ ka n niriba tam n yɛla saha shɛli bɛ ni tɔɣisiri tab di yɛla maa, kaman bɛ yaannim ni daa tam n yɛla ka jɛmdi Baal shɛm la.
en: They are trying to make the people of Judah forget my name by telling each other these false dreams. They are trying to make my people forget me, just as their ancestors forgot me and worshiped the false god Baal.

dag: Yawɛ, a kpiɔŋ zuɣu ka naa mali suhupiɛlli; a sɔŋsim zuɣu ka o mali suhupiɛlli pam maa.
en: The king celebrates your strength, LORD; look how happy he is about your saving help!.

dag: amaa ka Yisa yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka bihi kam n sanna ka di karitiya ba, dama alizanda nam nyɛla bɛ tatabo dini.
en: But Jesus said, Let the little children come to me. Dont stop them, because Gods kingdom belongs to people who are like these children.

dag: N yi ti kpihim a birili, n ni chɛ ka zuɣusaa zibigi, ka saŋmarisi ku lan ne. N ni ti chɛ ka sagbana limsi wuntaŋa, ka goli ti ku lan paligi.
en: I will make you disappear. I will cover the sky and make the stars dark. I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon will not shine.

dag: Hal o ni daa ti ti wahala maa zaa yoli, o ni zo ti nambɔɣu, o yurilim maŋli din galisi pam ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Although he has caused grief, he will show compassion in measure with his covenant loyalty.

dag: Di bi simdi ka yi zaŋ binshɛli din chihiri niŋ yi yinsi puuni, di yi pa lala bɛ ni woligi ya kun ya kaman di ni simdi ni bɛ saɣim li shɛm maa. Di simdi ka yi ti siŋ li ka zaɣisi li, dama di nyɛla di ni simdi ni yi saɣim binshɛli.
en: so destroy it. If you bring it home with you, both you and your house will be destroyed. Stay away from those disgusting idols!.

dag: Ka Jɛhoyachin daa pirig o dansarika binyɛra sɔŋ; ka daa kul diri nayili bindirigu hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: Jehoiachin was even allowed to wear regular clothes, and he ate at the king's table every day.

dag: Kaman kurimbuni ha yɛtɔɣ ŋahili ni yɛli shɛm la, Ninvuɣ biɛɣu kɔbili ni ka ninvuɣ biɛtali yirina. Amaa man ku zaŋ n nuu shih a.
en: As the old proverb goes, Evil deeds come from evildoers! but I wont lift a hand against you.

dag: Haga n-nyɛ Sinai Zoli din be Areebia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la ŋmahinli; o lan nyɛla Jɛrusalɛm din be pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ ŋmahinli, dama o min o bihi bela dabitim ni.
en: Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and she corresponds to the present-day Jerusalem, because the city is in slavery with her children.

dag: Bɛn nyɛ dunia ŋɔ nima bemi kaman Naawuni ni daa zaŋ taŋkpaɣu nam so la, ka bɛn nyɛ alizanda ni nim mi be kaman ŋun yi alizanda ni na la.
en: The nature of the person made of dust is shared by people who are made of dust, and the nature of the heavenly person is shared by heavenly people.

dag: A chɛ ka saa miri mahigiri tiŋgbani, ka chɛ ka di mali kulim pam. Nyin Naawuni mɔɣili palila kom, nyini n-tiri niriba bindira. A ni zal li shɛm m-bala.
en: You show your care for the land by sending rain; you make it rich and fertile. You fill the streams with water; you provide the earth with crops. This is how you do it:.

dag: Di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. Bɛ ni daa bi niŋ yɛda zuɣu ka Naawuni daa ŋmahi ba bahi, amaa nyin gba kpalim ʒiɛla a yɛda niŋbu kɔŋko zuɣu. Dinzuɣu di nyuri bara; amaa chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira.
en: That's true enough. But they were cut away because they did not have faith, and you are where you are because you do have faith. So don't be proud, but be afraid.

dag: Ka Shadirak mini Mɛshak ni Abɛdnɛgo daa garigi yɛli naa, Nɛbukadnɛza, di bi kpa ni ti garig a shɛli yɛla ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego answered the king, Nebuchadnezzar, we dont need to explain these things to you.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni ti zaŋ ba niŋ yi nuu ni ka chɛ ka bɛ suhuri fuŋ hal ka yi ti ku ba naai.
en: The LORD your God will lay these nations before you, throwing them into a huge panic until they are destroyed.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔnatan daa yɛli, M ba zaŋ muɣisigu zali tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ nima, nyamiya n ni di shiri biɛla ŋɔ ka nya yaa shɛm.
en: Jonathan said, My father has brought a lot of trouble to the land. See how much better I feel after tasting just a little of this honey.

dag: Bɛ ni ti tuuri taba kaman bɛ yɛn zomi yi takɔbi kum ni la, ka so bi kari doli ba, ka yi ti ku mali yiko din ni tuhi yi dimnima.
en: You will stumble over one another when no one is chasing you, and you will be unable to fight against any enemy.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yuun pisopɔin maa yi ti naai, n ni darigi Babilɔn naa maa min o niriba ni bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ din nyɛ Kalidianim tiŋgbɔŋ maa tibili, bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu, ka chɛ ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa kpalim zani dabari sahakam.
en: After that I will punish Babylonia and its king for their sin. I will destroy that country and leave it in ruins forever.

dag: Doli n ni zal a shɛm, ka be. Gbibi n ni wuhir a shɛli kaman a nimbil biɛlim la.
en: Consider my teaching as precious as your own eyes. Obey my commands, and you will have a good life.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti mali di lahi mini di parante shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn mali tuɣindi tulaale zim, ka mali duɣuri ni kuruwa shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn mali boori sara maligu wain. Di simdi ka yi ti zaŋ salima alali mal li.
en: Make plates, cups, jars, and bowls to be used for the wine offerings. All of these are to be made of pure gold.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa lan yɛli Jɔshua, Aai, ti ni jɛm Yawɛ.
en: Then the people said to Joshua, No, we will serve the Lord .

dag: Bee o yi shihi daadam daɣiri, din dee yi kul nyɛ daɣ shɛlikam din chɛ ka ninsal bi be kasi ka bi baŋ li, o yi ti baŋ li o mali taali.
en: or by touching human uncleanness—any uncleanness that makes one unclean—and the fact goes unknown, but you later learn of it and become guilty of sin.

dag: Dabiɛm mini suhuchihibo n-daa lu bɛ zuɣu. A nuu din galisi ŋɔ zuɣu, bɛ kul fomi doya chichi kaman kuɣili la hal ka nyin Yawɛ niriba ti gari; hal ka a ni daa tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb la ti gari.
en: struck down by fear. Our Lord , your powerful arm kept them still as a rock until the people you rescued to be your very own had marched by.

dag: o ni daa lo Ibrahimma alikauli shɛl la; o ni daa po pɔri n-lo Yisahaku alikauli shɛli.
en: the covenant he made with Abraham, the promise he made to Isaac.

dag: Ka ŋunkam shihi dilan ni ʒini binshɛlikam zuɣu ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni, ka ŋunkam ʒi bini maa, ŋun paɣim o situra ka su kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: If you touch or carry anything that was under him, you will be unclean until evening.

dag: Bɛ daa bi ku niriba maa zaa kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛm.
en: The Lord told the people to destroy the other nations living in Canaan. But the Israelites did not obey him.

dag: M bi zaɣisi ka bɛ di sabi n yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ sɔŋ! M bi zaɣisi ka bɛ di sab li niŋ kundi ni!.
en: I wish that my words could be written down.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ yino nɔzaɣisibo zuɣu yi chɛ ka niriba pam leeg alahichinima, lala zuɣu n-chɛ ka ninvuɣ yino mi nɔdeebo zuɣu gba ni chɛ ka niriba pam yi taali ni Naawuni sani.
en: Adam disobeyed God and caused many others to be sinners. But Jesus obeyed him and will make many people acceptable to God.

dag: N yi tum alahichi, a nyari ma mi, ka ku chɛ n-taali.
en: You were watching to see if I would sin, so that you could refuse to forgive me.

dag: Nyin Naawuni ŋun nyɛ wuntialana, ka mi din be ninsalinim suhuri ni mini bɛ tɛha ni ŋɔ, chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri tuumbiɛri zan tariga, ka niŋ wuntizɔriba zaɣ viɛlli.
en: Stop those who do evil. Support those who do good. God, you are fair. You know what people are thinking.

dag: luɣ shɛli o ni daa be n-lihir o piɛ shɛb bɛn mali bihi la ni o ti leei ŋun su Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ ŋun Naawuni niriba Izraɛlnim la.
en: and from caring for lambs. Then God made him the leader of Israel, his own nation.

dag: N dimnim yi ŋmaligi, bɛ tuurimi lu n-kpi a tooni.
en: When my enemies turn and retreat, they fall down and die right in front of you.

dag: n-gbahi ba ti kpɛhi duu.
en: They grabbed the apostles and put them in jail.

dag: N ni siɣina ti tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa nimaani; ka zaŋ shi so ŋun be a zuɣu maa yiko shɛli niŋ bɛ ni, ka bɛ ʒi niriba maa ʒili maa sɔŋ a, ka a kɔŋko ku lan ʒi li.
en: Then Ill descend and speak with you there. Ill take some of the spirit that is on you and place it on them. Then they will carry the burden of the people with you so that you wont bear it alone.

dag: Jɔn ni daa ti mirit o tuma naabu o daa bɔhi niriba, Yi lee tɛhiya ni n nyɛla ŋuni? Ka lan ŋmaligi yɛli ba, M pala yi ni yuuni so sol la. Ŋun na be n nyaaŋa kanna, hal man pɔri ni n ti damd o tooni n-gbaag o namda mal o ka o pirigi gba. .
en: When John was finishing his work, he said, Who do you think I am? I am not the Messiah. He is coming later, and I am not worthy to be the slave who unties his sandals.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum lala maa ka bɛ zaa laɣim duhi bɛ yɛhi n-suhiri Naawuni yɛra, Zallakudura Naa ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani ni teeku ni binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni ŋɔ.
en: When the believers heard it, they all joined together in prayer to God: Master and Creator of heaven, earth, and sea, and all that is in them!.

dag: Kum ni kɔnyuri ti ku muɣisi ba, ka wuntaŋ tulim mini pɔhim tulli ti ku kpe ba. Dama ŋun yuri ba n-yɛn mali ba chana. O ni zaŋ ba tahi kɔzɔrim shee.
en: they will never be hungry or thirsty. Sun and desert heat will not hurt them, for they will be led by one who loves them. He will lead them to springs of water.

dag: O daa yi chɛ o zabiri o zaŋdila nayili sania zahim li ka di tibisim nyɛ kaman kilɔgiram ayi.
en: His hair was very thick, and he had to cut it once a year, when it grew too long and heavy. It would weigh about five pounds according to the royal standard of weights.

dag: Yɛnnim wuhibu nyɛla nyɛvili kɔbiliga, di ni chɛ ka nir yi kum zana ni.
en: Sensible instruction is a life-giving fountain that helps you escape all deadly traps.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: M poya, zuliya shɛb bɛn gili ya ŋɔ zaa gba ni ti nya turi.
en: So this is what the Lord GOD says: I am the one making this promise! I swear that the nations around you will have to suffer for those insults.

dag: Yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, ka simdi deebu zaa.
en: Here is a true statement that should be accepted without question:.

dag: O ʒiɛla fɔntinsi dunɔdaya ni, o bela dunɔdaya maa gbini n-kuhiri boona:.
en: She stands by the city gate where everyone enters the city, and she shouts:.

dag: Dauda bia Sulemaana ni daa ʒin o nam ʒiishee, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ŋɔ daa be o sani ka chɛ ka o mali yiko pam.
en: Solomon, the son of King David, took firm control of the kingdom of Israel, and the Lord his God blessed him and made him very powerful.

dag: Bɛ tiŋgban ni tiwal shɛŋa din daŋ moobu zaa, ka bɛ zaŋ li na ti ti man Yawɛ, di nyɛla yi dini; ka ŋunkam be a yiŋa ka be nyam ni tooi di li.
en: When the people gather a harvest, they bring all the first things to the Lord . So these things I will give to you. And everyone in your family who is clean may eat it.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chɛ ka Juda nam maa niŋ yaa pam, ka bɛ daa kul ʒe Sulemaana bia Rɛhɔbɔam maa nyaaŋa hal ni yuma ata, dama yuma ata maa ni zaa bɛ daa kul dolila Dauda mini Sulemaana naba.
en: These people made the kingdom of Judah strong, and they supported Solomons son Rehoboam for three years. They did this because during that time they lived the way David and Solomon had lived.

dag: N-yi biɛɣu ka niriba bɛn daa kpalim duli din la polo kpahim baŋ ni ŋariŋ yini kɔŋko n-sa ʒe nimaani, ka lan mi ni Yisa sa bi kpe ŋariŋ maa ni pah o nyaandoliba maa zuɣu, amaa kulla bɛ kɔŋko n-sa kpe li chaŋ.
en: The next day the crowd that remained on the other side of the lake realized that only one boat had been there. They knew Jesus hadnt gone with his disciples, but that the disciples had gone alone.

dag: Ka ti zaŋ ti zaa yinoyino ni nya salima binshɛŋa din nyɛ nuhi ni bansi ni zoligɔnim ni nintuhi din dihiri gbana zuɣu ni tibikpara ni yɛri na ni ti ti mali sara ti daalahichi zuɣu Yawɛ sani.
en: So we are bringing the Lord s gift from every soldier. We are bringing things that are made of gold—armbands, bracelets, rings, earrings, and necklaces. This gift to the Lord is to make us pure.

dag: Taainim ni zaŋ pina na ti ti a m-bɔri ni a niŋ ba nirilim, ka bundaannim gba ni zaŋ pina balibu kam na ti ti a.
en: All of the richest people from the city of Tyre will try to influence you.

dag: Amaa n ni zaŋ n daalikauli n-lola Yisahaku so Zara ni yɛn dɔɣi ti a yuuni na ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha la.
en: But your son Isaac will be born about this time next year, and the promise I am making to you and your family will be for him and his descendants forever.

dag: Bɛ mabihi bɛn daa nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi ninvuɣ kɔbiga ni pihitaayika n-daa be bɛ daŋ maa ni. Bɛ zuɣulana n-daa nyɛ Zabidiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Hagɛdolim bia la.
en: Altogether, there were brave warriors from their clans, and their leader was Zabdiel son of Haggedolim.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ anzinfa kpila maa bahi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, ka yi n-chaŋ ti yil omaŋ mia.
en: Judas threw the coins down in the Temple and left; then he went off and hanged himself.

dag: Yisa ni daa wuh o nyaandoliba pinyaayi maa bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm naai, o daa yiɣisimi n-chaŋ tin shɛŋa din miri nimaani nti wuhiri niriba ka yihiri ba waazu.
en: When Jesus finished giving these instructions to his twelve disciples, he left that place and went off to teach and preach in the towns near there.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ba, Gbaamiya yimaŋa ni yɛliwumsa. Yi ni buɣisiri tiri yi tab shɛm, lala ka Naawuni mi ni ti buɣisi tin ya hal di ni ti gari lala gba.
en: He said to them, Listen carefully! God will evaluate you with the same standard you use to evaluate others. Indeed, you will receive even more.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb daalahichi yiri palo ka kpɛhiri ba saria karibu ni; amaa ka ninvuɣ shɛb mi daalahichi sɔɣiri ni di ti yi palo dahin shɛli ha.
en: The sins of some people are obvious, and the sins are judged before the people must face judgment, but the sins of other people show up later.

dag: Ka Dauda daa ti yɛli Akishi, A suhu yi yu ma, nyin tim ma a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni tinsi ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛli ka n ʒini, dama wula ka man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ min a lee yɛn laɣim ʒi na tiŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: David said to Achish, If you are pleased with me, give me a place in one of the country towns. I am only your servant. I should live there, not here with you in this royal city.

dag: Amaa yuun shɛli din pahiri yuma anu ni, yi ni tooi di di wala, ka lala chɛ ka di woli wala pam tin ya: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: In the fifth year you can eat the fruit. This is so as to increase its produce for you; I am the LORD your God.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa chɛ ka o nyaandoliba kpe ŋariŋ daŋ o tooni baari duri Bɛtisaida polo, ka ŋun kpalim ni o chɛbisi salo maa.
en: Right then, Jesus made his disciples get into a boat and go ahead to the other side of the lake, toward Bethsaida, while he dismissed the crowd.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli, Mbusim be n zuɣu, n lan ka tahima, dama yɛtɔɣ biɛri n-yiri n nol ni na, ka m mini yɛtɔɣ biɛri ni yiri ninvuɣ shɛb noya ni na laɣim be; amaa ka n nini nya naa ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ.
en: I said, There is no hope for me! I am doomed because every word that passes my lips is sinful, and I live among a people whose every word is sinful. And yet, with my own eyes I have seen the King, the Lord Almighty.

dag: Gbib ma kaman a ni lo alikauli shɛm la, ka m be. Di chɛ ka n di vi n tahima niŋbu ni.
en: Be true to your word, Lord . Keep me alive and strong; don't let me be ashamed because of my hope.

dag: Ka a yi kali ninvuɣ so, di simdi ka dilan yo anzinfa laɣifu pirigili kaman luɣ kasi shee sania zahimbu ni nyɛ shɛm, ka o zaŋ li mali sara ti Yawɛ. .
en: Everyone included in the census must pay the required amount of money, weighed according to the official standard. Everyone must pay this as an offering to me.

dag: Ka Naawuni nam lahibal suŋ ŋɔ waazu ni ti yihi gili dunia ŋɔ zaa n-lee shɛhira zuliya kam sani pɔi ka dunia yiɣisibu saha naanyi paai.
en: And this Good News about the Kingdom will be preached through all the world for a witness to all people; and then the end will come.

dag: ka bɛ yi yɛli ti zilima, ti zaŋdila zilim balli yɛtɔɣa labisi ba. Ti kul bemi kaman dunia ŋɔ bin chɔɣima la, hal ti ŋmanila saɣiri dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: When someone curses us, we answer with kind words. Until now we are thought of as nothing more than the trash and garbage of this world.

dag: Kamiyana nti sɔŋ ma ka ti chaŋ ti liri Gibiɔnnima n-ku ba, bɛ ni chaŋ ti niŋ sandaani niŋ Jɔshua mini Izraɛlnim la zuɣu.
en: Come up and help me. We will strike at Gibeon, because it has made peace with Joshua and with the Israelites.

dag: N Duuma, zom ma nambɔɣu, dama nyini ka n kuhiri niŋda dabisi muni zaa.
en: Have mercy on me, Lord, because I cry out to you all day long.

dag: Mbayooi! Ti min a bɔ ni, nyin Yisa Nazarɛt nira ŋɔ? A kamina ni a ti bahi ti yoli? M mi a ni nyɛ so: A nyɛla Naawuni Ninvuɣ Suŋ so o ni tim na.
en: Hey, Jesus of Nazareth, what do you want with us? Are you here to get rid of us? I know who you are! You are God's Holy One.

dag: A yɛla gari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be teeku duli maa tinsi ni zaa, ka dabiɛm pam gbahi bɛ nanima a zuɣu, ka bɛ nina ni maligi.
en: All the people living on the coast are shocked about you. Their kings are terrified. Their faces show their shock.

dag: O nyɛla ŋun bi ʒe na so nyaaŋa ka chɛ so, bee n-lihi nya bundaamba ka chɛ nandaamba, dama bɛ zaa nyɛla o nuhi tuma.
en: Who shows no favor to princes nor regards the rich over the poor, for they are all the work of Gods hands?.

dag: Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ yi yɛn dolila Ar polo ti gari Mɔabnim tintariga.
en: Today you are to pass through the territory of Moab by way of Ar.

dag: Duuma yino mini ti ni niŋ yɛda yin shɛl la ni baptaizibu yini m-beni.
en: There is one Lord, one faith, one baptism.

dag: Ka Ɛhab daa yɛl o, Cham gili tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ kulibɔna mini vinvama zaa ni nti lihi nya ti ni nya mɔri ti ti yuri mini ti buntaansi ŋɔ n-tiligi ba din ni chɛ ka ti ku kɔŋ bɛ shɛba.
en: King Ahab said to Obadiah, Come with me. We will look at every spring and every stream in the land. We will see if we can find enough grass to keep our horses and mules alive. Then we will not have to kill our animals.

dag: n-kpe bɛ tiŋ maa ni ti ŋme n-deei li; dama yi Duuma NAAWUNI ni zaŋ li niŋ yi nuu ni.
en: But you will rise up from the ambush and take over the city. The LORD your God will give it into your power.

dag: Ka Yisa daa bɔhi ba, Yi ni ŋuni n-lee ni mali dabili, ka o nyɛla ŋun kɔri bee ŋun guli biŋkɔbiri ka ti kuna, ka a dii yɛl o, Kamina ti ʒini di bindirigu.
en: If your servant comes in from plowing or from taking care of the sheep, would you say, Welcome! Come on in and have something to eat?.

dag: M mabihi, m bɔri ni n zaŋla ninsala yɛla buɣisi yɛlli ŋɔ: Ninsalinim yi laɣim lo alikauli ka zani di nyaaŋa, so ku tooi saɣim li bee m-pahi shɛli di zuɣu.
en: My friends, I am going to use an everyday example: when two people agree on a matter and sign an agreement, no one can break it or add anything to it.

dag: Yisifu daa baŋ o biɛyanim maa, amaa ka bɛn lee bi baŋ o.
en: Joseph recognized his brothers, but they did not know who he was.

dag: Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa sab gbaŋ tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa niŋ di ni n-ti zuliya kam mini niriba balibu kam ni tinzun yɛtɔɣa balibu kam nim bɛn be dunia ŋɔ zaa ni yɛli, Naawuni timiya suhudoo!.
en: King Nebuchadnezzar sent the following letter to the people of all nations and races on the earth: Greetings to all of you!.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, A yi di mi Naawuni pini, ka mi ŋun suhir a ni a niŋ kom ti o ka o nyu ŋɔ, a gba naan suh o ka o ti a nyɛvili kom.
en: Jesus answered, You don't know what God wants to give you, and you don't know who is asking you for a drink. If you did, you would ask me for the water that gives life.

dag: Ti mi ni Naawuni mini Anabi Musa daa tɔɣisi taba yɛtɔɣa, amaa ti bi mi doo maa ŋun ni yi shɛl na.
en: We know that God spoke to Moses; as for that fellow, however, we do not even know where he comes from.

dag: Ka di daa tooi biɛla kaman awa yini laasabu yaha ka so lan yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, doo ŋɔ gba yi bela Yisa sani, dama o nyɛla Galili nira.
en: About an hour later another man insisted, This man must have been with Jesus. They both come from Galilee.

dag: Di zɔntua maa daa kpala dundɔntitali polo, ka bɛ ŋme abie tihi pa di pilanim zuɣu. Ka di daa mali dunɔdura anii zaŋ chaŋ dunɔdali gbini.
en: The entrance room of this gate faced the outer courtyard, and carvings of palm trees decorated the walls of the passageway. Eight steps led up to this gate.

dag: ka yi yi gbib li viɛnyɛliŋga, dina n-nyɛ yi ni tiligi shɛli zuɣu, ka naɣila yi daa naɣ niŋla yɛda yoli.
en: You are being saved through it if you hold on to the message I preached to you, unless somehow you believed it for nothing.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa zaŋ ba golimgolim tiŋgban nɛli ni kpa Teeku Ʒiɛɣu polo. Izraɛlnim daa lola tɔbu n-yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: So God led the people by the roundabout way of the Reed Sea desert. The Israelites went up out of the land of Egypt ready for battle.

dag: Mɔɣ shɛli din daŋ tooni yuli m-booni Pishɔn. Dina n-zɔri gindi Havila tiŋgbɔŋ zaa, ka salima be nimaani.
en: The first river is the Pishon; it flows around the country of Havilah. .

dag: Yawɛ soli dolibu nyɛla gooni din mali kpiɔŋ bɛn biɛhigu be tibi sani, amaa di nyɛla din kuri ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: The Lord protects everyone who lives right, but he destroys anyone who does wrong.

dag: Naawuni ni yɛri alikauli palli yɛla maa, di wuhiya ni o lihi tuuli din maa la zaɣ kurili. Ka binshɛli din kurigiri ka kpaari mi ku yuui ka leei din ku lan beni yaha.
en: By speaking of a new covenant, God has made the first one old; and anything that becomes old and worn out will soon disappear.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli ma ni bɛn daa tiligi ka bɛ bi gbahi ba daba maa be muɣisigu ni pam ni vi ni bɛ yaɣili maa ni, ka Jɛrusalɛm gooni la lu, ka buɣim di di dunɔdaya.
en: They told me, Those in the province who survived the captivity are in great trouble and shame! The wall around Jerusalem is broken down, and its gates have been destroyed by fire.

dag: O ni daa paai Rom na, o daa bo n shee ni nimmoo hal ti nya ma.
en: Then after he arrived in Rome, he searched everywhere until he found me.

dag: N lɔri nol la buyi dakulo kam, ka yihiri n ni nya shɛlikam zaka.
en: I fast twice a week, and I give a tenth of everything I get.

dag: Bɛ daa teeri ni Naawuni n-nyɛ bɛ Tampiŋ Kpiɔŋ ŋun tiligiri ba, ka lan teeri ni Zallakudura Naa n-nyɛ ŋun fari ba bahira.
en: They remembered God Most High, the mighty rock that kept them safe.

dag: Dama saha shɛli kanna ka tiŋguliba ni ti be Ifriim zoya zuɣu ka kuhi bahina, Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ sani Ziɔn. .
en: Someday those who guard the hill country of Ephraim will shout, Let's go to Zion and worship the Lord our God.

dag: Ka Yisa daa zaŋ o nyaandoliba pinaayi maa yi kpaŋ ti yɛli ba, Nyamiya, ti chanila Jɛrusalɛm; ka anabinim ni daa sab shɛlikam zaŋ chaŋ Daadam Bia polo la ni ti niŋ pali.
en: Then Jesus talked to the twelve apostles alone. He said to them, Listen, we are going to Jerusalem. Everything that God told the prophets to write about the Son of Man will happen.

dag: Amaa di zaɣisi n zalikpana la mini n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la, ka leei din bie n-gari zuliya shɛŋa mini tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa din gil li zaa ka zaɣisi n zalikpana la, ka bi doli n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la.
en: But the people of Jerusalem rebelled and refuse to obey me. They ignored my laws and have become even more sinful than the nations around them.

dag: Amaa ka Kalɛb daa chɛ ka niriba maa zaa fo baalim Musa tooni, ka o yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ yomyom ti deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa ʒini; dama ti ni tooi nyaŋ ba.
en: Caleb silenced the people who were complaining against Moses, and said, We should attack now and take the land; we are strong enough to conquer it.

dag: Dɔb ŋɔ zaa daa kpuɣila tinzun paɣiba, ka bɛ daa kari bɛ paɣiba maa mini bɛ bihi ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: These men divorced their foreign wives, then sent them and their children away.

dag: Bɛ di chɛ ka bɛ suhuri zɔhiri zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni mali shɛlikam ʒibu na polo, dama Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ luɣ viɛlli shee ka bɛ yɛn ʒini. .
en: Dont worry about bringing all of their belongings. We can give them the best of Egypt.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka buɣim di Judanima n-saɣim bɛ ni me goma gili luɣ shɛŋa Jɛrusalɛm la.
en: So I will send fire upon Judah and burn down the fortresses of Jerusalem.

dag: A yi di nyɛla jɛrigu ŋun duhir amaŋa bee a yi di lɔrila zaɣ biɛɣu, nyin zaŋm a nuu pɔb a noli;.
en: If you have been foolish enough to be arrogant and plan evil, stop and think!.

dag: Ɛliɔnai bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Hɔdavia mini Ɛliashib ni Pɛlaya ni Akub ni Jɔhanan ni Dalaiya ni Anani, bɛ daa nyɛla niriba ayopɔin.
en: Elioenais family: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani—seven in all.

dag: dama yi na kul dolila daadam biɛhigu. Nyuli zabbu mini naŋgbankpeeni ŋmɛbu yi be yi sunsuuni, pa daadam biɛhigu ka yi doli ka niŋdi kaman dunianim ni niŋdi shɛm?.
en: because you still live as the people of this world live. When there is jealousy among you and you quarrel with one another, doesn't this prove that you belong to this world, living by its standards?.

dag: Ka Huram daa zaŋ daanya daantalisi maa zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu zɔŋ ni. O daa zaŋla daantal yini zali nudirigu polo, ka boli di yuli Jachin; ka zaŋ daantal yini zali nuzaa polo, ka boli di mi yuli Bɔaz.
en: Huram placed these two bronze columns in front of the entrance of the Temple: the one on the south side was named Jachin and the one on the north was named Boaz.

dag: Amaa yi yi zaɣisi wumbu, n ni kum ashilɔni yi karimbaani maa zuɣu. N ni kum pam hal ka nintam ti zɔri n nina ni, bɛ ni gbahi Yawɛ niriba leei daba maa zuɣu.
en: If you are too proud to listen, I will weep alone. Tears will stream from my eyes when the Lord 's people are taken away as prisoners.

dag: Ka Jɔn yɛli ba, So ku tooi mali shɛli ka di pa ni Naawuni n-ti o li.
en: John replied: No one can do anything unless God in heaven allows it.

dag: Nyama, n ni ti tim bi so ka yɛl o, Cham ti bo piɛma maa shee. N yi ti yɛl o, Nyama, piɛma maa be a luɣili ŋɔ polo, kpuɣimi li na, di saha nyin yim na, dama hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu binshɛli ku lan niŋ a, ka barina shɛli mi lan kani.
en: Then I will tell my servant to go and find them. And if I tell him, Look, the arrows are on this side of you; get them, that means that you are safe and can come out. I swear by the living Lord that you will be in no danger.

dag: Miriya ka yi pahi yɛtɔɣ shɛli n ni zali ya zaligu shɛli ŋɔ ni bee n-yihi shɛli di ni. Amaa doliya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa n ni zaŋ tiri ya ŋɔ.
en: You must not add to what I command you. And you must not take anything away. You must obey the commands of the Lord your God that I have given you.

dag: Dama Naa Dauda gba daa tɔɣisi ŋun Yisa yɛla n-yɛli: N kul nyarila n Duuma n sani sahakam; o bela n nudirigu polo ni di chɛ ka n suhu ku zɔhira:.
en: David says about him, I foresaw that the Lord was always with me; because he is at my right hand I wont be shaken. .

dag: Ka Yisa daa zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro la ti ba, ka daa zaŋ zahim la gba pahi ba.
en: Jesus took the bread in his hands and gave some of it to his disciples. He did the same with the fish.

dag: Ka o daa lan mali pumpɔrinchihi kɔtomsi n-zaŋ li pie tab kulis ayi n-gili lansi maa zaɣ yini n-zaŋ li pili biŋkpilli din tam daanya daantalisi la zaɣ yini zuɣu; ka daa lan niŋ din la gba lala.
en: and two rows of bronze pomegranates.

dag: Ka o daa yi Nɛgɛb n-chaŋ hal ti paai Bɛtɛl luɣ shɛli o ni daa tuui kpa o tanti suɣili zali piligu ni, ka di be Bɛtɛl mini Ai sunsuuni la.
en: Abram traveled, making and breaking camp, from the arid southern plain to Bethel and to the sacred place there, where he had first pitched his tent between Bethel and Ai.

dag: N ni zaŋ a kuli m ma yiŋa, n ni zaŋ a ti kpɛhi ŋun daa dɔɣi ma du gbɛrili ni. N ni ti a wain viɛlli mini m pumpɔrinchihi wala kom ka a nyu.
en: I would lead you, I would bring you to my mothers house; she would teach me what to do. I would give you spiced wine to drink, some of my fresh pomegranate juice.

dag: Ka Izraɛl daa ti yɛli Yisifu, A biɛyanim zaŋ biŋkɔbiri chaŋ Shɛkɛm ni bɛ ti ŋub mɔri. Kamina ka n tim a bɛ sani. Ka o yɛli, To.
en: Jacob said to Joseph, I want you to go to Shechem, where your brothers are taking care of the flock. Joseph answered, I am ready.

dag: Ka o yɛla daa dii moli gili Galili tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: So the news about Jesus spread quickly everywhere in the area of Galilee.

dag: Siɛr bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Lɔtan mini Shɔbal ni Zibiɔn ni Ana ni Dishɔn ni Ɛzɛr ni Dishan.
en: Seir was the father of Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛ ka ti lo ti Naawuni maa alikauli, ka yihi tinzun paɣiba mini bɛ bihi n-chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ kaman n dana mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa wum ti Naawuni zaligu ka bɛ ni sɔhiri la ni daa wuhi shɛm, ka chɛ ka di niŋ kaman zaligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: Now we must make a solemn promise to our God that we will send these women and their children away. We will do what you and the others who honor God's commands advise us to do. We will do what God's Law demands.

dag: Bɛ daa yi tuhi tɔbu ka di nɛma shɛŋa, bɛ piirila di ni shɛli n-zaŋ li mali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa.
en: They had dedicated some of the valuable objects won in battle to repair the LORDs temple.

dag: Sulemaana daa nyarila salima din tibisim nyɛ kaman kilɔgiram tuhi pisinaata yuun yini puuni.
en: Every year King Solomon received almost tons of gold.

dag: O yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ buŋ yɛno kɔbili maa bahi. Ka bɛ daa bol o ni zaŋ li bahi luɣ shɛli maa yuli Ramatilɛhi.
en: When Samson finished speaking, he threw the jawbone down. So that place was named Ramath Lehi.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti ŋub li ni nya tibidarigibo. Dama o saɣim Yawɛ binshɛli din be kasi, ka di simdi ka bɛ yihi lala nir maa o niriba ni.
en: In fact, you will be punished for not respecting what I say is holy, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.

dag: Izraɛl zuliya zaa ni ti di nasara man Yawɛ zuɣu ka paɣi ma.
en: I, the Lord , will give victory and great honor to the people of Israel.

dag: Yi ni ti di di suhumaabo daazichi din galisi pam la daanfaani kaman bia ni mɔɣiri o ma bihili shɛm la.
en: She will nurse and comfort you, just like your own mother, until you are satisfied. You will fully enjoy her wonderful glory.

dag: Ka zama bɛn yɔri vuri yiriŋ gil a. Ka duŋtaariba pam daa zaŋ dɔbba bɛn nyɛ danyuriba n-yi tiŋgban nɛli ni na. Ka bɛ ti zaŋ bansi piri paɣiba maa nuhi ni, ka zaŋ nam zuɣupili viɛla pili ba.
en: The noise in Jerusalem sounded like a crowd of people having a party. Many people came to the party. People were already drinking as they came in from the desert. They gave bracelets and beautiful crowns to the women.

dag: Dinzuɣu man Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn zaŋla tiŋ ŋɔ niŋ Kalidianim mini Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza nuu ni, ka o ŋme n-dee li.
en: It is true that I am going to let King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia capture Jerusalem.

dag: Zɛdɛkia ni daa di Juda nam, di piligu ni yuun shɛli din pahiri yuma anahi gol so ŋun pahir anu puuni ka Azur ŋun daa nyɛ Gibiɔn nir la bia anabi Hanania daa tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣa Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maligumaaniba mini niriba zaa sani yɛli.
en: Later that same year, in the fifth month of the fourth year that Zedekiah was king, the prophet Hananiah son of Azzur from Gibeon came up to me in the temple. And while the priests and others in the temple were listening.

dag: Bɛ daa mali sara tila alizinnima, pa Naawuni, ka mali maliŋ ti wun shɛb bɛ ni pun bi mi. Bɛ daa lan mali wun pal shɛb bɛn na yoli yina ka nyɛ yi yaannim ni daa bi lu shɛb sizuura.
en: They offered sacrifices to demons—gods that are not God. These were new gods they had not known before, gods their ancestors never knew.

dag: Wula ka a tah o ʒiishee ka yɛra, O ku garigi n yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ shɛli.
en: Why do you contend with him, saying that he doesnt answer all your words?.

dag: Zaŋna hal ni zuŋɔ, kum mini kɔnyuri n-kul mali ti, ka ti chani gbinfini, ka nyari buri, ka ka biɛhigu shee.
en: To this very moment we go hungry and thirsty; we are clothed in rags; we are beaten; we wander from place to place;.

dag: Aripakishad ni daa dɔɣi Shɛla maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinahinaata. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: Arpachshad had more children and died at the age of .

dag: ka zaŋ chi sara mini binnyura sara pahi naɣilaa maa mini piɛlaa maa ni piɛbihi la zuɣu kaman bɛ kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: You must also offer the proper grain sacrifices and drink offerings of wine with each animal.

dag: Nir yi bɔri ni o mali binshɛli n-zaŋ ti pini, o bɔrila da shɛli din bi dura n-zaŋ ti tuumbaŋda ka o mal li zali ka di ku lu.
en: The one who sets up an image chooses wood that wont rot and then seeks a skilled artisan to set up an idol that wont move.

dag: Bɛ daa naɣ kul wummi ka ninvuɣ shɛb yɛra, Ŋun daa niŋdi ti alaka la yipa yihirila o ni daa kpaŋd omaŋ ni o saɣim adiini so shɛl la waazu pumpɔŋɔ.
en: They had only heard this about me: This man was persecuting us. But now he is telling people about the same faith that he once tried to destroy.

dag: Ka Kalɛb daa lan yi nimaani chaŋ ti lu Dɛbirinim zuɣu. Dɛbir tuuli yuli n-daa nyɛ Kiriatisɛfa.
en: Then Caleb fought against the people living in Debir.

dag: Di saha ka Bɔaz daa yɛli tiŋ maa kpamba mini bɛn zaa daa be nimaani maa, Yi zaa di ma shɛhira zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni n da Ɛlimɛlɛk min o bidibis ayi Kiliɔn ni Malɔn ni su binshɛɣukam zaa Naomi sani.
en: Then Boaz said to the elders and all the people, You are witnesses today that I am buying from Naomi everything that belonged to Elimelech, Kilion, and Mahlon.

dag: Ka salo daa pahi bɛ zuɣu liri ba; ka sariakaritib maa daa dari tɔhi Pool mini Silas binyɛra, ka bahi noli ni bɛ zaŋm jaaŋgbɛbihi fiɛb ba.
en: The whole crowd turned against Paul and Silas. The officials tore the clothes off both men and ordered that they be beaten with rods.

dag: Amaa Ashurinim ni ti gbahi yinim Kɛnnim ti leei daba, ka kun ya.
en: Yet Kain will burn when Asshur takes you away captive.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan pirigi maligumaaniba zalizali bɛ zaashɛhi, ka pirigi Lɛvinima zalizali bɛ zaashɛhi ni bɛ tumdi Naawuni tuma Jɛrusalɛm kaman di ni sabi shɛm Musa litaafi ni la.
en: Then they chose the priests in their groups and the Levites in their groups to serve in Gods Temple in Jerusalem. They did these things as it is written in the Book of Moses .

dag: Amaa yinim Judanim zaa bɛn be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni ŋɔ, wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm. Yawɛ yɛliya, M po n yuli din galisi ŋɔ, Juda ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Ijipti ŋɔ so ku lan boli n yuli yɛli, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Keep these promises! But let me tell you what will happen. As surely as I am the Lord God, I swear that I will never again accept any promises you make in my name.

dag: Ka a yi lan ko puu tiŋgbani maa ni, di bindira ku lan niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga. A ni leei ŋun ka kpɛhili shee, ka leei ŋun dari gindi dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Now when you work the soil, the ground will not help your plants grow. You will not have a home in this land. You will wander from place to place.

dag: Ka Abinɛr ti lan yɛl o, Ŋmaligim ka chɛ ma dolibu; bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɛn chɛ ka n ku a? N yi ku a wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ lih a biɛli Jɔab ninni.
en: Abner again said to Asahel, Stop chasing me, or I will have to kill you. Then I will not be able to look your brother Joab in the face again.

dag: O daa yi Pita zuɣu, ka daa ti yi o nyaandoliba pinaayi la gba zuɣu.
en: and that he appeared to Peter and then to the twelve apostles.

dag: Ka lan zaŋ wain pipia niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka zaŋ li ti ba ka yɛli, Yi zaa nyumiya li.
en: Jesus picked up a cup of wine and gave thanks to God. He then gave it to his disciples and said, Take this and drink it.

dag: N daa bela yi sani ni chɔɣinsi mini dabeenzɔbo ni ni sɔhibu.
en: At first, I was weak and trembling with fear.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Nir yi bɔri tiwal suma, faashee o malila ti suŋ; amaa o yi malila ti biɛɣu, tiwal biɛri ka o ni nya, dama bɛ baŋdi tia kam la di wala ni.
en: If you want good fruit, you must make the tree good. If your tree is not good, it will have bad fruit. A tree is known by the kind of fruit it produces.

dag: Wummi n suhigu ka tiligi ma yomyom! Leemi n ni sɔɣiri tampin shɛli gbini mini birini shɛli din mali kpiɔŋ din ni tiligi ma.
en: Hear me! Save me now! Be my refuge to protect me; my defense to save me.

dag: Di chɛ ka bɛ ŋmaligi yɛli bɛ suhuri ni, Mbo, ti suhuyubu niŋya! A mi di chɛ ka bɛ yɛli, Ti nyaŋ o.
en: Don't let them say to themselves, We are rid of him! That's just what we wanted.

dag: Yi nini na kul bi neei? N ni daa ŋmahi bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu n-dihi niriba tusaanu la, yi bi teei yi ni daa laɣisi li pali piɛ shɛŋa tariga la yɛla?.
en: Do you still not understand? Remember the five loaves of bread that fed the people and the many baskets you filled with the bread that was left?.

dag: Rɛhɔbɔam ni daa paai Jɛrusalɛm, o daa laɣimla Juda mini Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba tɔbbihi tuhi kɔbiga ni tusaanii ni bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi Izraɛlnima n-fa nam maa ti ŋun Naa Sulemaana bia Rɛhɔbɔam.
en: When Rehoboam arrived in Jerusalem, he called together , of the best soldiers from the tribes of Judah and Benjamin. He intended to go to war and restore his control over the northern tribes of Israel.

dag: Ka wula ka niriba lee ni tooi kuhi boli bɛ ni bi niŋ so yɛda? Bee wula ka bɛ lee ni tooi niŋ bɛ ni na bi wum so yɛla yɛda? Bee wula ka bɛ lee ni tooi wum ka pa ni waazuyihira m-beni?.
en: How can people have faith in the Lord and ask him to save them, if they have never heard about him? And how can they hear, unless someone tells them?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa Abinadab yiŋ din daa be zoli zuɣu la na nti tam naɣ tɔroko palli zuɣu; ka Yuza mini Ahio bɛn daa nyɛ Abinadab bidibisi la daa be tooni vɔri tɔroko palli maa;.
en: Davids men brought the Holy Box out of Abinadabs house on the hill. Then they put Gods Holy Box on a new wagon. Uzzah and Ahio, sons of Abinadab, were driving the new wagon.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti Duuma, ka dindina tim ti bindirigu maa sahakam.
en: They said, Sir, give us this bread all the time.

dag: Ka Pita yɛl o, N ka laɣifu din ni ti a, amaa n ni mali shɛli, dina ka n yɛn ti a: Yisa Masia Nazarɛt nir yuli zuɣu, yiɣisim zani n-leei ŋun chana.
en: But Peter said to him, I have no money at all, but I give you what I have: in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth I order you to get up and walk.

dag: Binnui daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu ni pihinuayika.
en: of Binnui.

dag: Ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim mini Yɛhudianim zaŋ tabili bɛ kpamba daa lo nia ni bɛ nahim Yisa tuumba maa, hal ka bɔri ni bɛ lab ba kuɣa.
en: Finally, some Gentiles and Jews, together with their leaders, decided to make trouble for Paul and Barnabas and to stone them to death.

dag: Ka sokam daa chaŋ ti zaŋ o suhu ni kul yu ni o zaŋ shɛli na ti ti Yawɛ, ka bɛ zaŋ tum Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa tuma mini neen shɛŋa zaa bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ tumdi tuma di puuni ni bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ binshɛŋa she binyɛr kasi la.
en: All the people who wanted to give came and brought a gift to the Lord . These gifts were used for making the Meeting Tent, everything in the Tent, and the special clothes.

dag: ka Naawuni yi di yiɣisi zani, wula ka n di yɛn niŋ? Ka o yi bɔhi ma, wula ka n yɛn garigi yɛl o?.
en: Otherwise, what answer would I give to God when he judges me?.

dag: Yi ni zaŋdi yi pin shɛŋa na maa ka buchi. Chɛliya li zaŋbuna. Yi tulaale zim nyɛla zaɣ biɛɣu n sani. Yi goli palli churi puhibu mini vuhim dabisa ni yi ni booni laɣiŋgu shɛŋa puuni, n je alahichi ni be yi jɛmbu laɣiŋgu shɛŋa ni.
en: Stop bringing worthless offerings. Your incense repulses me. New moon, sabbath, and the calling of an assembly— I cant stand wickedness with celebration!.

dag: Ifriimnima, buɣa bukaata lee nyɛ bɔ yi sani? Mani n-nyɛ ŋun wumdi yi suhigu, ka lihiri ya. N ŋmanila sipirɛs tia din vari kul mahi ʒiɛya sahakam la. Yi bidɔɣiligu yirila n kɔbili ni na.
en: Israel, give up your idols! I will answer your prayers and take care of you. I am that glorious tree, the source of your fruit.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ku Gɛdalia naai yi biɛɣu ka so na bi baŋ di yɛla.
en: The next day, before anyone knew about Gedaliah's murder.

dag: O ni daa ti be muɣisigu ni maa, ka o daa naanyi bo sɔŋsim Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ŋɔ sani, ka siɣis omaŋ pam o yaannim Naawuni sani.
en: While Manasseh was held captive there, he asked the Lord God to forgive him and to help him.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛli, Zaŋmiya takɔbi ti ma na. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ takɔb na nti ti naa.
en: Then King Solomon sent his servant to get a sword.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ maani niriba maa yɛla saha shɛlikam. Di simdi ni bɛ zaŋ yɛtɔɣ kpeeni kam ka a sanna, amaa yɛtɔɣ bihi dina, di simdi ka bɛmaŋmaŋ baŋ bɛ ni yɛn mal li shɛm din ni chɛ ka tuma maa niŋ valimbo a sani, ka a mini ba zaa laɣim ʒiri ʒili maa.
en: Let them serve as judges for the people on a permanent basis. They can bring all the difficult cases to you, but they themselves can decide all the smaller disputes. That will make it easier for you, as they share your burden.

dag: Di saha maa ka ti Duuma daa niŋ anfaani din galisi pam niŋ n ni, ka ti ma yɛda mini yurilim din be Yisa Masia ni la.
en: Christ Jesus our Lord treated me with undeserved grace and has greatly blessed my life with faith and love just like his own.

dag: O ni ti kpa o nam tanti suɣ kara teeku mini zo shɛli din be kasi la sunsuuni. Amaa o ni ti kpi, ka so ku be o sani sɔŋ o.
en: After this, he will set up camp between the Mediterranean Sea and Mount Zion. Then he will be destroyed, and no one will be able to save him.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa nim mini bɛ kpamba maa daa wum bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa ka bɛ suhuri zɔhira.
en: With these words they threw the crowd and the city authorities in an uproar.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n ni yiɣisi n suhu pam bahi yi zuɣu. N ni kari ya saria kaman yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm, ka darigi yi tibili yi ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa zaa zuɣu.
en: Very soon now you will feel all the force of my anger. I am judging you for what you have done, and I will pay you back for all your disgusting conduct.

dag: Buŋ maa ni daa nya Yawɛ malaika maa, ka o chaŋ ti tabili gooni n-zaŋ Balaam napɔnvaɣu sooi gooni maa; ka o daa lan fiɛbi buŋ maa.
en: When the donkey saw the angel, it moved over against the wall and crushed Balaam's foot against it. Again Balaam beat the donkey.

dag: Yisa daa ti ʒe teeku duli lan piligi wuhiri niriba. Ka salo pam daa laɣim o sanna, ka bɛ galisim maa zuɣu daa chɛ ka o kpe n-ʒini ŋariŋ puuni teeku maa ni, ka salo maa zaa daa kpalim ʒe duli.
en: The next time Jesus taught beside Lake Galilee, a big crowd gathered. It was so large that he had to sit in a boat out on the lake, while the people stood on the shore.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapuhi n-zaŋ dapuh anu niŋ m biɛhigu shee maa luɣ yini polo dapaɣa.
en: Make five crossbars for each of the wooden frames.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, so yi po pɔri n-zaŋ daadam ti Yawɛ kaman yi ni zal o da shɛli.
en: Speak to the Israelites and say to them: When a person makes a solemn promise to the LORD involving the value of a person.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli, Naawuni jilima yi Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, dama bɛ fa Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka la.
en: The glory has left Israel because Gods chest has been taken, she said.

dag: Ka o daa lan pii Daniɛl mini niriba ayi shɛba m-pahi ni bɛ lihiri kpambaliba maa ka bɛ tumdi ŋun naa maa tuma ka di mali nyɔri.
en: In addition, he chose Daniel and two others to supervise the governors and to look after the king's interests.

dag: Ka yaɣ din la gba daa mali lala; lɔndo maa dunoli nudirigu mini nuzaa polo zaa daa malila pateesanim din wɔɣilim daa pooi mita ayopɔin biɛla, ka di mali daantalis ata mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu.
en: Likewise, there were twenty-two and a half feet of drapes on the other side of the plazas gate with three posts and three bases for them.

dag: Bɛ yi kpe Baka vinvamli la ni ni bɛ gari, bɛ chɛrimi ka di puhigir kom zɔra; ka siɣili saa ŋun daŋ mibu chɛri ka di kpɛri paana.
en: They travel through Baca Valley, which God has made into a place of springs. Autumn rains form pools of water there.

dag: N nya n niriba ni diri wahala shɛŋa Ijiptinim nuu ni, ka lan wum bɛ fabila la, lala zuɣu ka n kana ni n ti fa ba bahi. Ka yɛl o, Dinzuɣu kamina ka n tim a Ijipti.
en: I have seen my people suffer much in Egypt. I have heard my people crying and have come down to save them. Come now, Moses, I am sending you back to Egypt.

dag: A dabili yɛn guhi hal ti paai bɔ saha? Bɔ saha ka a yɛn darigi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi ma alaka la tibili?.
en: How much more time does your servant have? When will you bring my oppressors to justice?.

dag: Ka din chɛ ka saria karibu beni maa nyɛla, neesim ni ka dunia ŋɔ ni na ka salinim ni yu tuumbiɛri tumbu zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ bɔrila zibisim gari neesim maa la.
en: This is the basis for judgment: The light came into the world, and people loved darkness more than the light, for their actions are evil.

dag: nti yi ŋariŋ ni nimaani chaŋ Filipai din daa nyɛ Masidɔnia tiŋgbɔŋ ni tinzuɣu ka Romnim su li la. Ka ti daa niŋ daba ayi nimaani.
en: From there we went inland to Philippi, a city of the first district of Macedonia; it is also a Roman colony. We spent several days there.

dag: O zaŋ li bahi sagbana tiŋli zaa, ka chɛ ka o saanyaɣisibu paai dunia ŋɔ ni luɣilikam zaa.
en: He sends his lightning to flash across the whole sky. It lights up the earth from one end to the other.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm tuuya, ka Juda lu, dama bɛ yɛtɔɣa mini bɛ tuma bi viɛli Yawɛ sani; bɛ turila Naawuni maŋmaŋa.
en: Jerusalem and Judah, you rebelled against your glorious Lord — your words and your actions, made you stumble and fall.

dag: Zaŋmiya piɛlahi gbana din niŋ moonsi mini teeku ni biŋkɔb bal shɛb gbana pili pa di zuɣu.
en: Make two more coverings, one of rams' skin dyed red and the other of fine leather, to serve as the outer cover.

dag: Ka Dauda daa tim tuumba Jabɛshigiliadnim maa sani ti yɛli ba, Yawɛ niŋmi alibarika niŋ yi ni yi ni daa wuhi yi ʒiɛyimtali ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ yi dan Naa Sool sani, ka sɔɣ o la zuɣu.
en: David sent messengers to tell them: The Lord bless you! You were kind enough to bury Saul your ruler.

dag: Bɛ ni ti yɛli, Kamiyana ka ti labi Yawɛ sani ka o ti tibi ti, dama ŋuna n-daa darigi tooi ti. Ŋuna n-daa ti daŋa, o ni niŋ tim niŋ ti daŋ maa.
en: Let's return to the Lord . He has torn us to shreds, but he will bandage our wounds and make us well.

dag: Ti Duuma kpalim ŋmanila ti dima. O wurim Izraɛl; O wurim di nanim yiya la zaa, ka wurim bɛ kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛŋa la. O chɛ ka Juda bipuɣiŋga fabila min o kuhigu maan pahi.
en: The Lord has become like an enemy. He has swallowed up Israel. He has swallowed up all her palaces and all her fortresses. He has made much sadness and crying for the dead in Daughter Judah.
