dag: Ka Firawuna kpamba daa yɛl o Bɔ saha ka doo ŋɔ yɛn chɛ ti zana baribu? Chɛ ka niriba maa chaŋ ti jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa, a na kul bi baŋ ni Ijipti bahi yoli zaa.
en: The king's officials said to him, How long is this man going to give us trouble? Let the Israelite men go, so that they can worship the Lord their God. Don't you realize that Egypt is ruined.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa ti zali Naa Dauda ni daa ti suɣ shɛli zal li la puuni, ka daa mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini suhudoo sara ti Naawuni.
en: They brought in Gods chest and placed it inside the tent David had pitched for it. Then they brought entirely burned offerings and well-being sacrifices before God.

dag: Di saha ka Amazia daa tim tuumba nti yɛli Jɛhɔahaz bia Naa Jɛhɔash ŋun daa nyɛ Izraɛl Naa Jɛhu yaaŋa la, Kamina ka ti ti zaŋ ti gbɛri kpa taba.
en: Then Amaziah sent messengers to King Jehoash of Israel, challenging him to fight.

dag: Ka niŋgbuŋ din poori ŋɔ yi ti leei din bi poora, ka niŋgbuŋ din kpiri ŋɔ mi ti leei din bi kpira, di saha maa di ni ti niŋ kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Kum kɔŋ nasara!.
en: So this body that ruins will clothe itself with that which never ruins. And this body that dies will clothe itself with that which never dies. When this happens, the Scriptures will be made true: Death is swallowed in victory. Isaiah :.

dag: Jɔnatan ni daa yɛn doli so shɛli chaŋ Filistia tɔbbihi maa sani maa zuɣu tampiŋ kara ayi n-daa doya; yini daa dola yaɣili ka yini mi do yaɣ din la. Tampiŋ yini yuli daa boonila Bɔzɛz ka yini mi yuli booni Sɛne.
en: There were two stone outcroppings in the pass where Jonathan planned on crossing over to the Philistine fort—one on each side. One of these was named Bozez; the other was named Seneh.

dag: Lala ka Yawɛ daa yi zaani Musa tooni n-tɔɣisir o yɛtɔɣa kaman nir ni tɔɣisir o zo yɛtɔɣa shɛm la. Musa daa yi ti yi suɣili maa ni n-labi sansani maa ni, o sɔŋda Jɔshua ŋun daa nyɛ Nan bia, ka nyɛ nachimbil la n-daa yi kpalindi be suɣili maa ni.
en: The Lord would speak with Moses face-to-face, just as someone speaks with a friend. Then Moses would return to the camp. But the young man who was his helper, Joshua son of Nun, stayed in the Tent.

dag: Makiri paɣ so ŋun yuli daa booni Maaka la daa dɔɣi bidibiga, ka bol o yuli Pɛrɛsh. O mabia yuli n-daa booni Shɛrɛsh; o mi mabihi yuya n-daa booni Ulam mini Rɛkɛm.
en: Machir and his wife Maacah were the parents of Peresh and Sheresh. Peresh was the father of Ulam and Rekem.

dag: N ni chɛ ka a nam zuliya pam, ka chɛ ka a zuliya yɛligi, ka nanim ti yi a zuliya ni na.
en: I will give you many descendants. New nations and kings will come from you.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa jɛm Yawɛ Jɔshua ni daa be o nyɛvil ni saha shɛl la zaa zaŋ tabili zuɣulaannim shɛb bɛn daa be Jɔshua kum nyaaŋa, ka daa mi Yawɛ ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa ti Izraɛlnim la yɛla.
en: As long as Joshua lived, the people of Israel served the Lord , and after his death they continued to do so as long as those leaders were alive who had seen for themselves everything that the Lord had done for Israel.

dag: Yɛli shɛŋa din mali dabiɛm pam niŋya tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: An awful, a terrible thing has happened in the land.

dag: Saha shɛli Samuɛl ni daa be Ɛli sani n-tumdi Yawɛ tuma maa, Yawɛ daa bi lan tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa waawaayili, ka niriba daa bi lan nyari ʒiinim waawaayili.
en: Samuel served the Lord by helping Eli the priest, who was by that time almost blind. In those days, the Lord hardly ever spoke directly to people, and he did not appear to them in dreams very often. But one night, Eli was asleep in his room.

dag: Yulimiya zuliya shɛba n-nya alahiziba, ka di gari ya. Dama n yɛn tumla tuun shɛli yi ʒiɛman ŋɔ ni, ka yi yi wum li yi ku niŋ li yɛda.
en: Look among the nations and watch! Be astonished and stare because something is happening in your days that you wouldnt believe even if told.

dag: Ka n daa laɣim Juda zuɣulaannima n-zaŋ ba du n-tam gooni maa zuɣu m-pirigi ba gbilligbilli ʒii buyi n-chɛ ka bɛ chani gindi gooni maa zuɣu m-paɣiri Naawuni. Bɛn daŋ tooni daa zaŋ kpala gooni maa zuɣu nudirigu polo n-zaŋ doli Saɣiri Dunɔdal la polo.
en: I told the leaders of Judah to go up and stand on top of the wall. I also chose two large singing groups to give thanks to God. One group was to start going up on top of the wall on the right side, toward the Ash Pile Gate.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Dauda di yɛla, ka o daa laɣim Izraɛlnim zaa ka bɛ chaŋ ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du n-chaŋ bɛ sani nti zaŋ o tɔbbihi maa lu bɛ zuɣu. Dauda ni daa piɛl o tɔbbihi bahi Sirianim maa zuɣu maa, ka bɛ min o daa gbaai tab tuhibu.
en: Upon hearing this, David gathered all Israel and crossed the Jordan. David advanced and took up positions against the Arameans to meet them in battle. After initiating the battle.

dag: N ni labisi yi sariakaritiba zali kaman di ni daa nyɛ shɛm piligu ni, ka labisi yi saawarimaaniba zali kaman di ni daa nyɛ shɛm piligu ni. Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ ni lan boli tiŋ maa wuntitali mini ʒiɛyimtali tiŋa.
en: I will bring back the kind of judges you had in the beginning. Your counselors will be like those you had long ago. Then you will be called The Good and Faithful City.

dag: Di saha maa zaŋ chana ka o daa bɔri so shɛli o ni yɛn doli yi Yisa nyaaŋa chɛ ka bɛ gbaag o.
en: From then on Judas was looking for a good chance to hand Jesus over to them.

dag: ka o kuhi yɛl anab so ŋun daa yi Juda na maa, Yawɛ yɛliya ni a ni zaɣis o noli, ka bi doli ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni zal a zaligu shɛŋa.
en: and he cried out to the prophet from Judah, The Lord says that you disobeyed him and did not do what he commanded.

dag: Yisa ni daa yi zoli maa zuɣu siɣina ka salo pam kul kabiri dol o;.
en: Jesus came down from the hill, and a large crowd followed him.

dag: Dinzuɣu malimiya shili yi tɛha ni ka gbibi yimaŋa, ka zaŋ yi tahima niŋ anfaan shɛli Naawuni ni ti yɛn niŋ niŋ yi ni Yisa Masia ni ti yɛn yi palo dabisi shɛli dal la.
en: Be alert and think straight. Put all your hope in how God will treat you with undeserved grace when Jesus Christ appears.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: So kul ku kɔŋ Dauda daŋ ni ŋun ni ʒini Izraɛl nam ʒiishee.
en: The LORD proclaims: David will always have one of his descendants sit on the throne of the house of Israel.

dag: Kpalimmiya be ti sani. Yi ni tooi be yi suhuri ni bɔri ni yi be luɣ shɛlikam tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni, ka gɔri kɔhigu yi yubu, ka su tiŋgbani maa luɣ shɛŋa polo.
en: You can share this land with us. Move freely about until you find the property you want; then buy it and settle down here.

dag: Naawuni di wuhi gba! Wula ka tinim bɛn kpi zaŋ chaŋ alahichi tumbu polo ŋɔ na kul ni kpalim be di tumbu ni?.
en: Absolutely not! All of us died to sin. How can we still live in it?.

dag: Kul zahimmiya binyɛra sania zuɣu ka di paara ni yɛlimaŋli, ka zaŋmiya kuruwa maŋli zahindi yi binyɛra ka di paana din ni chɛ ka yi yuui Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya maa ni.
en: If you weigh and measure things honestly, the Lord your God will let you enjoy a long life in the land he is giving you.

dag: Ka Nikɔdimus bɔh o, Ninsal yi kurigi, wula ka o lan yɛn niŋ ka bɛ dɔɣ o yaha? O ni lan tooi kpe o ma puuni ka o dɔɣ o yaha.
en: Nicodemus asked, How is it possible for an adult to be born? Its impossible to enter the mothers womb for a second time and be born, isnt it.

dag: A yi chana, binshɛli ku gabi a naba, ka a yi guui, a ku tuui.
en: When you walk, you wont be hindered; when you run, you wont stumble.

dag: Ti Duuma NAAWUNI ŋmaligi po omaŋa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ binnamda zaa Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya: N je Yaakubu karimbaani la. N je bɛ ni me bɛ yiya suma shɛŋa la. N ni zaŋ bɛ tin tital la niŋ bɛ dimnim nuu ni.
en: The Sovereign Lord Almighty has given this solemn warning: I hate the pride of the people of Israel; I despise their luxurious mansions. I will give their capital city and everything in it to the enemy.

dag: Kpihimmi bɛ ni daa dɔɣi ma dabisi shɛli maa birili, ka kpihim yuŋ shɛli bɛ ni daa yɛli, Bɛ zali bidibbil puu la gba birili.
en: Blot out the day of my birth and the night when my parents created a son.

dag: Saliŋgbiriba zaŋdi bɛ firilanima n-nyandi zibisim tiŋgbani puuni, ka gbiri chani bɛ ni ni tooi paai luɣ shɛli tariga m-bɔri tahiʒiɛɣu kuɣa bumbɔn ni.
en: Miners carry lights deep into caves to search for these rocks in the deepest darkness.

dag: Dina n-chɛ ka Yawɛ wuhiri ya la zaligu yiniyini mini wuhibu yiniyini ni kuligakuliga ni biɛlifu kpe ni biɛlifu kpe. O niŋla lala ni di chɛ ka yi lɛb lu yi kpaya zuɣu n-nya dansi, ka zana gbahi ya, ka bɛ zaŋ ya chaŋ ti leei daba.
en: Now his message to you will be senseless sound after senseless sound. Then you will fall backwards, injured and trapped.

dag: Dauda daa yɛlila Sulemaana, M bia, m pun lo n suhu ni ni m me jɛmbu duu ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ jilima.
en: David said to Solomon, My son, I had intended to build a temple for the name of the LORD my God.

dag: Naawuni, hal n yi ti kurigi ka n zuɣu paligi, nyin di chɛ ma bahi! Be n sani hal ka n ti zaŋ a yiko min a kpiɔŋ yɛla moli ʒiɛman shɛŋa din kanna nim zaa sani.
en: Now that I am old and my hair is gray, dont leave me, God. I must tell the next generation about your power and greatness.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Babilɔn naa ni ti zaŋ o takɔbi na ti lu a zuɣu.
en: That will happen because of what the Lord GOD said: The sword of the king of Babylon will come to fight against you.

dag: Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wummi Naawuni Shia Kasi ni yɛli cheechinim shɛm.
en: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.

dag: Pirigili din daa nyɛ Izraɛlnim tarili maa ni, Musa daa yihila ninsalinim ninvuɣ yino ninvuɣ pihinu kam puuni, ka yihi biŋkɔbiri pihinu kam puuni biŋkɔb yino n-zaŋ ba ti Lɛvinim bɛn daa su Yawɛ biɛhigu shee tuma la kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm.
en: Moses took from the Israelites half one out of every fifty, from humans and animals. He gave them to the Levites who carry out the duties of the LORDs dwelling, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

dag: Ka Jeemsi mini Jɔn, Zɛbidii bihi la, daa ka Yisa sanna ti yɛl o, Karimba, ti di bɔri ni a niŋ ti la ti ni bɔri shɛm ŋɔ.
en: Then James and John, sons of Zebedee, came to Jesus and said, Teacher, we want to ask you to do something for us.

dag: Ka ti zaŋdi ti mabi so ti ni buɣisi waawaayili n-nya ka o nyɛla ŋun suhu kul ye o tab sɔŋbu zuɣu yɛla pam puuni la n-dolisiri ba na. Ka pumpɔŋɔ o nyɛla ŋun suhu na kul ye o tab sɔŋbu zuɣu gari lala, o ni niŋ ya naani pam la zuɣu.
en: So we are sending our brother with them; we have tested him many times and found him always very eager to help. And now that he has so much confidence in you, he is all the more eager to help.

dag: Maligumaana zuɣulana Ɛliashib bia Joyada bidibisi ni yino daa nyɛla Sanbalat ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtihɔrɔn nir la bipuɣiŋga yidana, ka n daa kar o n sani.
en: Now one of the sons of Joiada son of the high priest Eliashib was a son-in-law of Sanballat the Horonite. So I chased him away from me.

dag: Ka Haman daa kpɛna, ka naa ti bɔh o, Ninvuɣ so m-beni ka m bɔri ni n duh o, a lee tɛhiya ni bɔ ka n ni niŋ ti dilana? Ka Haman daa yɛl o suhu ni, Ŋuni ka naa lee lan yɛn bɔri ni o duhi pam ka pa ni mani.
en: When Haman entered the room, the king asked him, What should I do for a man I want to honor? Haman was sure that he was the one the king wanted to honor.

dag: A ni ti zaŋ n yɛligu yɛli ba, bɛ yi ni wum li bee bɛ yi ni zaɣisi li wumbu, dama bɛ nyɛla duŋtaariba.
en: Youll speak my words to them whether they listen or whether they refuse. They are just a household of rebels!.

dag: Lala ka ninvuɣ so ŋun luri Yawɛ sizuura nyari alibarika.
en: This is how the Lord will bless everyone who respects him.

dag: ka nyɛ bɛn bi zuri bɛ taba nyaaŋa, ka bi tumdi bɛ zɔnim taali, ka mi bi mali bɛ ʒiʒiinitab yɛla n-chani moona.
en: and don't spread gossip; they treat others fairly and don't say cruel things.

dag: A yi zahim n suhu, a yi ka n sanna yuŋ ti buɣisi ma viɛnyɛliŋga, a ni nya ka ninvuɣ biɛtali ka n ni; ka m mi noli bi tumd alahichi.
en: You have examined my heart, testing me at night. Youve looked me over closely, but havent found anything wrong. My mouth doesnt sin.

dag: Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali yaa, ka zooi pam ka wɔɣawɔɣa kaman Anakinim la. Amaa ka Yawɛ daa ku ba ka chɛ ka Ammɔnnim maa deei bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ʒini n-zani bɛ zaani.
en: They were large, numerous, and tall, just like the Anakim. But the LORD completely destroyed the Zamzummim before the Ammonites, and they took possession of that area, settling in their place.

dag: Ka Ada daa dɔɣi Ɛlifaz ti Iso; ka Basɛmat dɔɣi Riuɛl ti o;.
en: Esau and his three wives had five sons while in Canaan. Adah's son was Eliphaz; Basemath's son was Reuel; Oholibamah's three sons were Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

dag: Ka Ɛliɛza bia Finɛhas ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana Aduna yaaŋa la daa nya lala ka yiɣisi niriba maa ni kpuɣi kpani.
en: When Phinehas, the son of Eleazar and grandson of Aaron the priest, saw this, he got up and left the assembly. He took a spear.

dag: Di sab Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli ni ti yab Ibrahimma daa niŋ Naawuni yɛda, ka Naawuni zaŋ o zali wuntia zaani o yɛda niŋbu maa zuɣu.
en: Understand that in the same way that Abraham believed God and it was credited to him as righteousness, .

dag: Chɛliya ka ti paɣi Naawuni o ni niŋ anfaan shɛli din mali jilima niŋ ti ni yoli o Biyurigu zuɣu la.
en: And this brings praise to God because of his wonderful grace. God gave that grace to us freely. He gave us that grace in Christ, the one he loves.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti kpalim a yili ŋɔ ni ti chaŋ o sani ti maani bara n-suhir o liɣiri bee bɔrɔbɔro kpilli, ka ni ti yɛli, N suhir a, zaŋm ma zali maligumaana so zaani din ni chɛ ka n nyari bindirigu dira.
en: Then whoever is left in your family will come and bow down before this priest and beg for a little money or a piece of bread. They will say, Please give me a job as priest so that I can have some food to eat.

dag: N dila suɣilo guhiri Naawuni; o kɔŋko sani ka n tiliginsim yirina.
en: I wait patiently for God to save me; I depend on him alone.

dag: Zaŋ kpa Manaasa tintarisi polo, Yisifu ŋun daa nyɛ Yaakubu bia la mi bidibisi n-daa ʒini nimaani n-su Bɛtishɛan mini di tiŋkpansi ni Taanak mini di tiŋkpansi ni Mɛgido mini di tiŋkpansi ni Dɔri mini di tiŋkpansi zaa.
en: Along the borders of Manassehs land were the towns of Beth Shan, Taanach, Megiddo, and Dor, and the small towns near them. The descendants of Joseph lived in these towns. Joseph was the son of Israel.

dag: ka zaŋ diba anu n-niŋ luɣ din la mi polo dapaɣa, ka zaŋ diba anu niŋ m biɛhigu shee maa nyaaŋa wulinluhili polo dapaɣa.
en: And there should be five braces for the frames on the other side of the Holy Tent. And there should be five braces for the frames at the back of the Holy Tent.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yɛli ba, Pa sokam zaa n-ni tooi doli dimbɔŋɔ naɣila Naawuni ni zaŋ lala ti shɛba.
en: Jesus told them, Only those people who have been given the gift of staying single can accept this teaching.

dag: Yɛlim Juda nayilinima, Wummiya Yawɛ yɛligu.
en: House of Judah! This is what the LORD says.

dag: ka daa zaŋ salima gabisi ayi la gɔhi bans ayi din daa goligoli nyolɔrigu maa naŋgbambiya la.
en: They attached the two gold cords to the two rings at the edges of the chest pendant.

dag: Di saha maa n ni ti yɛli ba, Yinim tuumbiɛrinim ŋɔ, m bi min ya. Wariya! .
en: Then I will say to them, I never knew you. Get away from me, you wicked people.

dag: Simiɔn bidibisi ni bɛ zuliya niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nɛmuɛl daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Nɛmuɛlnima; ka Jamin daŋ niriba nyɛ Jaminnima; ka Jachin daŋ niriba mi nyɛ Jachinnima.
en: These are the family groups from the tribe of Simeon: Nemuel—the Nemuelite family group; Jamin—the Jaminite family group; Jakin—the Jakinite family group;.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum Naa maa yɛligu maa bahi ka bɛ yi n-gbaai chandi; bɛ ni daa chani maa ka saŋmar so bɛ ni daa nya wulimpuhili polo maa dii gari bɛ tooni hal nti kpalim zani bia maa ni daa be yil shɛli maa dɛde.
en: After the wise men heard the king, they left. They saw the same star they had seen in the east, and they followed it. The star went before them until it stopped above the place where the child was.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabihi, chɛliya ka yi suhuri kul ye anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu zuɣu, ka di zaɣisiya tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni gba.
en: So then, my friends, set your heart on proclaiming God's message, but do not forbid the speaking in strange tongues.

dag: So dini n-lee kuni neesim ni woligiwoligi luɣ shɛli bee wulimpuhili polo pɔhim ni yɛligiri gindi dunia ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛli polo?.
en: Have you ever gone to the place where the sun comes up, where it makes the east wind blow all over the earth?.

dag: Amaa ka Jabɛshigiliadnim daa wum Filistianim ni niŋ Sool shɛm maa.
en: The people who lived in Jabesh in Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul's body.

dag: O min o biɛyanim maa ni daa na mali alizama saha shɛli maa, ka Filistianim tiyaawumya ŋun yuli booni Goliat ka o nyɛ Gaat nir la daa yi Filistianim maa sanna nti lan yɛr o ni daa pun yɛri yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa la. Ka Dauda daa wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: While David was talking with them, Goliath came out from the line of Philistines and started boasting as usual. David heard him.

dag: N lee yɛli dimbɔŋɔ maa la ninsal suhu yubu puuni bee lala ka Naawuni zaligu puuni gba yɛli?.
en: Im not saying these things just based on common sense, am I? Doesnt the Law itself say these things?.

dag: M bia Timoti, n zaŋ niriba zuɣu ni kpahibu yɛla ŋɔ niŋ a nuu ni. Di nyɛla anabitali yɛtɔɣa ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ a polo. Chɛ ka di yɛtɔɣa maa leeg a bidibbina ka a zaŋ li tuhi tuhiri suŋ.
en: Timothy, my son, the instructions I am giving you are based on what some prophets once said about you. If you follow these instructions, you will fight like a good soldier.

dag: ka lan nyɛ nanima ayopɔin shɛb bɛn niriba anu pun lu, ka bɛ niriba ayi bɛn kpalim maa ni yino be nam ni pumpɔŋɔ, ka yino la ŋun na bi di, amaa o yi ti di, o ku yuui.
en: Five of the kings are dead. One is ruling now, and the other one has not yet come. But when he does, he will rule for only a little while.

dag: O ni daa suhiri Naawuni maa, ka o niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu ti taɣi, ka o binyɛrigu mi paligi paratɛte kaman gol la;.
en: While he was praying, his face changed its appearance, and his clothes became dazzling white.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yisifu sani bindir shɛŋa nti ti ba. Amaa Bɛnjamin dini daa gar o tab maa dini ʒiibunu zuɣu. Ka bɛ daa nyu binnyura, ka bɛ min o zaa suhuri paligi.
en: Servants were taking food from Josephs table and bringing it to them. But the servants gave Benjamin five times more than the others. The brothers continued to eat and drink with Joseph until they were drunk.

dag: Yuŋ yi paai, bɛ chani kabirila yiya kpɛra, ka biɛɣu neei, ka bɛ kpari bɛmaŋ niŋ duri; bɛ bi mi neesim.
en: At night thieves break into houses, but by day they hide and avoid the light.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi yɛli ŋun labina maa, Yiɣisim chaŋ a chandi; a yɛda niŋbu zuɣu n-chɛ ka a kpaŋ.
en: Then Jesus told the man, You may get up and go. Your faith has made you well.

dag: Ka Ɛsa daa nyɛ Jɛhɔshafat ba, ka Jɛhɔshafat nyɛ Jɔram ba, ka Jɔram mi nyɛ Yuzaia ba.
en: Asaph was the father of Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat was the father of Joram. Joram was the father of Uzziah.

dag: Ka karimbanim bɛn nyɛ diribarilimnim ŋɔ ni zaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ ni nam yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa tɔɣisi ya ni bɛ zaŋ ya bo liɣiri. Amaa bɛ Sariakarita ŋun ni bahi ba yoli pun mali shili ka di wɔɣa; ka mi bi gbihira.
en: They will be greedy and cheat you with smooth talk. But long ago God decided to punish them, and God doesn't sleep.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ wɔbinyina mali nam ʒiishe titali, ka zaŋ salima alali dihi li nachiinsi.
en: His throne was made of ivory and covered with pure gold.

dag: Biŋkpil shɛŋa din daa tam daanya daantalisi maa zuɣu zɔŋ ni la daa nyɛla paɣiviɛligakushihikom kɔtomsi, ka di dubu pooi mita ayi biɛla.
en: The capitals were shaped like lilies, feet tall.

dag: O daa tila Bɛtɛlnim mini Ramɔt din be Nɛgɛb Jatir tiŋgban ni la nima.
en: David sent some of the gifts to the leaders in Bethel, Ramoth in the Negev, Jattir.

dag: A paɣibu yɛla kul bela n nol ni, ka n yɛr a tibiginsim yɛla dabisili puuni zaa.
en: All day long I praise you and proclaim your glory.

dag: Doo yi yɛn zaŋ binshɛli paŋ o kpee, ŋun di deeg o nɛli bee o nɛkaŋ sɔŋ pɔi ka naanyi paŋ o li, dama o yi niŋ lala, nyɛvili ka o deei sɔŋ talima pabu ni maa.
en: Millstones or even just the upper millstone must not be pawned, because that would be pawning someones livelihood.

dag: Man ŋun nyɛ kpɛm la n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri n ni yuri paɣ gahindi so min o bihi ni yɛlimaŋli la. Ka di pala n kɔŋko n-yuri ya, amaa bɛnkam zaa mi yɛlimaŋli la gba yuri ya.
en: From the Elder— To the dear Lady and to her children, whom I truly love. And I am not the only one, but all who know the truth love you.

dag: ka o daa nya ba ka yɛli, Naawuni sansani m-bɔŋɔ! Dinzuɣu ka o daa boli nimaani yuli Mahanaim.
en: When he saw them, he said, This is God's camp; so he named the place Mahanaim.

dag: Yi yi nya ka ʒili marigi yi dim buŋ sɔŋ tiŋa, yin di chɛ o mini ʒili maa sɔŋ, amaa yin sɔŋm o yiɣisi buŋ maa zali.
en: When you see a donkey that belongs to someone who hates you and its lying down under its load and you are inclined not to help set it free, you must help set it free.

dag: Ka n daa kpuɣi n zuɣu lihi nya paɣiba ayi ka bɛ yiɣiri kpari m polo na, ka bɛ kpiŋkpama ŋmani shinshingooro kpiŋkpama. Ka bɛ daa kpuɣ piɛɣu maa zuɣusaa n-zaŋ li yiɣi chaŋ.
en: Then I looked up and saw two women with wings like a stork. They flew out, and with the wind in their wings, they picked up the bucket. They flew through the air carrying the bucket.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, A ku tooi baŋ n ni niŋdi ya shɛli ŋɔ gbinni pumpɔŋɔ, amaa saha shɛli ka a ni ti baŋ di gbinni.
en: Jesus answered him, You do not understand now what I am doing, but you will understand later.

dag: Hiburɔn bidibisi ni, Ɛliɛl n-daa nyɛ kpɛma, ka bɛ daŋ maa ni niriba pihinii pah o zuɣu.
en: There were people from the tribe of Hebron. Eliel was their leader.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ ka Yawɛ daa zali Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni ni bɛ piri tiŋgbana maa tari Izraɛlnima ka bɛ su li.
en: These are the men that the Lord assigned to divide the property for the people of Israel in the land of Canaan.

dag: Amaa ka Yɛhudianim daa bi saɣi lala, dina n-daa chɛ ka di kpama talahi ni n yɛli ni n ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣa maa ka Naa Siiza sanna. Di mi pala n kamina ni n ti fiɣisi mmaŋmaŋ zuliya.
en: The Jewish leaders disagreed, so I asked to be tried by the Emperor. But I don't have anything to say against my own nation.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ n yipa leela yi dima n ni yɛli ya yɛlimaŋli zuɣu?.
en: Am I now your enemy because I tell you the truth?.

dag: Niriba daa tahirila bɛ zuɣu, Wariya, daɣirinim ŋɔ. Wariya, wariya, di shihiya ti. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa leei kuŋkɔɣinzɔriba mini bɛn dari ginda. Ka zuliya shɛb daa yɛri taba, Bɛ ku lan be kpe yaha.
en: Instead, everyone shouted, Go away! Don't touch us! You're filthy and unfit to belong to God's people! So they had to leave and become refugees. But foreign nations told them, You can't stay here.

dag: O daa lan zali Lɛvinim maa shɛba ni bɛ nyɛ bɛn yɛn su Yawɛ Alikauli Adaka maa tuma, ka suhiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ka puhir o ka paɣir o.
en: David appointed some of the Levites to serve before the LORDs chest in order to remember, to give thanks, and to praise the LORD, Israels God.

dag: Ka yuma ayopɔin shɛŋa puuni bindira ni daa niŋ pam Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa daa ti gari.
en: The seven years of plenty that the land of Egypt had enjoyed came to an end.

dag: Yawɛ, yiɣisim chaŋ a vuhim shee, a min a kpiɔŋ alikauli adaka maa.
en: Lord , get up and go to your resting place; go with the Box that shows your power.

dag: mini Salima ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtilihɛm ba la ni Harɛf ŋun mi daa nyɛ Bɛtigadɛr ba la.
en: Salma, Bethlehems father; and Hareph, Beth-gaders father.

dag: ka daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi ku Jɔn mabia Jeemsi.
en: He had James, Johns brother, killed with a sword.

dag: Ka maligumaana Zɛfania daa karim gbaŋ maa ka anabi Jɛrimia wum.
en: The priest Zephaniah read this letter to the prophet Jeremiah.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lan zaŋ ma chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu duno shɛli din be nuzaa polo la gbini. Paɣiba n-daa ʒi nimaani n-kumdi Tammuz kuli.
en: He brought me to the entrance of the north gate of the temple, where women were sitting and performing the Tammuz lament.

dag: Amaa n daa je ni n yuli saɣim bɛ mini zuliya shɛb bɛn be maa sani, dama bɛ zaa ninni ka n daa zaŋ mmaŋ wuhi ba, ka yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: But I did not, since that would have brought dishonor to my name, for in the presence of the people among whom they were living I had announced to Israel that I was going to lead them out of Egypt.

dag: Mirim ma, tiligim ma; fam ma n dimnim nuu ni bahi.
en: Come and save me from my enemies.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa dɔɣi bidibiga n-ti Hadad, ka bɛ bol o yuli Gɛnubat, ka napaɣ maa daa wums o nayili maa; ka bia maa mini Firawuna bidibisi daa laɣim be nayili maa.
en: This sister of Tahpenes bore Hadad a son, Genubath. Tahpenes weaned him in Pharaohs house. So it was that Genubath was raised in Pharaohs house, among Pharaohs children.

dag: Yawɛ, nyin Naawuni ŋun bɔhiri biɛri, nyin Naawuni ŋun bɔhiri biɛri ŋɔ, yiɣisim zani!.
en: The Lord is a God who punishes people. God, come punish them.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa pihi kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya, ka zaŋ fɔntinsi ŋɔ mini di tiŋkpansi m-pahi di biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee ti Lɛvinim kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli Musa shɛm la.
en: So the Israelites gave the Levites these towns and the fields around them, just as the Lord had told Moses.

dag: Bɛn guuri pam ku tooi zo n-tiligi, ka tɔbbihi ku tooi zo n-tiligi, Bɛ tuuya lu Yufretiiz Mɔɣili nuzaa polo.
en: The swift cant flee; the mighty cant escape. Up north by the Euphrates River, they stagger and fall.

dag: Yɛm nyɛla nyɛvili tia ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔbi gbaai li gbibi sani. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbibi li kirikiri nyɛ bɛn mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Those who become wise are happy; wisdom will give them life.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛli, Bɛ ni zaɣisi n ni daa zali ba zaligu shɛŋa la dolibu, ka bi deei n noli.
en: The Lord answered, This has happened because my people have abandoned the teaching that I gave them. They have not obeyed me or done what I told them.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ suhu ni tɛha bi wuhi ma ni m mali galimi, amaa dimbɔŋɔ bi wuhiri ni m bebu tuhiya zaa. N Duuma n-nyɛ ŋun kariti ma saria.
en: My conscience is clear, but that does not prove that I am really innocent. The Lord is the one who passes judgment on me.

dag: Paɣimiy o yuli din mali jilima ŋɔ sahakam. O chɛ ka o jilima pali dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam zaa. Ami! Ami!.
en: Praise his glorious name forever! May his glory fill the whole world. Amen! Amen!.

dag: Ka Musa daa kali ba kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛl o ni o niŋ shɛm.
en: So Moses obeyed and counted them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pihi kuɣa sɔŋ ni bɛ lihi nya sokam talahi tuma ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm, ninkura mini bihi ni karimbanim ni karimbihi zaa.
en: David assigned them their duties by asking the Lord what he wanted. Everyone was responsible for something, whether young or old, teacher or student.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔiada daa zali dunɔguliba Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa dunoya ni ni bɛ kariti bɛn bi be kasi.
en: Jehoiada put guards at the gates of the Lord s Temple to prevent any unclean person from entering the Temple.

dag: ka Ammiɛl pah ayɔbu, ka Isaka pah ayopɔin, ka Pɛulɛtai daa pah anii; dama Naawuni daa niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni.
en: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, and Peullethai the eighth. God truly blessed him.

dag: maa ŋunkam nyu ko shɛli n ni yɛn ti o maa, kɔnyuri ku lan gbaag o hal abada; dama ko shɛli n ni yɛn ti o maa ni leei nyɛvili din ka bahigu kɔbilisirim o pul ni.
en: But anyone who drinks the water I give will never be thirsty again. The water I give people will be like a spring flowing inside them. It will bring them eternal life.

dag: Ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdib mini Farisiinim daa ti zaŋ paɣ so ŋun tum zina ka bɛ gbaag o n-tahina ti zaŋ o zali sunsuuni.
en: The teachers of the law and the Pharisees brought a woman they had caught in bed with a man who was not her husband. They forced her to stand in front of the people.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Zadok mini Abiata daa zaŋ Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa labisi Jɛrusalɛm, ka daa kpalim be nimaani.
en: So Zadok and Abiathar took the Covenant Box back into Jerusalem and stayed there.

dag: Di chɛliya ka so yɔhim ya baabiɛla, dama di dabisili maa ku kana faashee Naawuni zaɣisibu din bahindi nyaaŋa la ti niŋ, ka Zaliguzaɣisir so Naawuni ni pun lo ni o bah o yol la gba ti yi zahira.
en: Dont be fooled by anything they might say. That day of the Lord will not come until the turning away from God happens. And that day will not come until the Man of Evil appears, the one who belongs to hell.

dag: Juda Naa Asa ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ata saha ka Baasha daa ku Nadab, ka di nam zan o zaani.
en: This happened during Asas third year as king of Judah. So Baasha became the next king of Israel.

dag: nyin wummi bɛ fabila a biɛhigu shee alizanda ni ka chɛ bɛ taali, ka niŋ kaman a ni mi ka sokam biɛhigu nyɛ shɛm o suhu ni ti o.
en: then listen from heaven where you live. Forgive, act, and repay each person according to all their conduct because you know their hearts. You alone know the human heart!.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa bɔh o, Ka a paɣ Zara be ya? Ka o yɛli ba, O be tanti suɣili ŋɔ ni.
en: Then the men said to Abraham, Where is your wife Sarah? Abraham said, She is there, in the tent.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka yi kanna ti zaani n tooni du shɛli din nyɛ n jɛmbu duu ŋɔ ni yɛra, Ti tiligiya. Ka lan yi n-chaŋ ti tumdi din chihirinim ŋɔ yaha.
en: If you commit these sins, do you think that you can stand before me in this house that is called by my name? Do you think you can stand before me and say, We are safe, just so you can do all these terrible things?.

dag: Yisa ni daa neei kum ni bakɔi piligu dali asibaasi maa o daa tuui yila Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la zuɣu. Ŋuna n-nyɛ Yisa ni daa kari alizin biɛri ayopɔin so zuɣu la.
en: Jesus rose from death early on the first day of the week. He appeared first to Mary Magdalene. One time in the past Jesus had forced seven demons out of Mary.

dag: Gbaamiya piɛ viɛlli biŋkɔbbaligu maa ni. Niŋmiya dari kuli daaŋa ni; duɣimiya nimdi maa; duɣimiya o kɔba gba.
en: Use the meat of the finest sheep; pile the wood under the pot. Let the water boil; boil the bones and the meat.

dag: Ka kikaa ni ti tahi pam, ka o ti tim malaikanima ka bɛ chaŋ ti laɣim o ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛlikam zaa na.
en: The great trumpet will sound, and he will send out his angels to the four corners of the earth, and they will gather his chosen people from one end of the world to the other.

dag: Miri ka a zabiri alahichinim nyuli, amaa kul jɛmmila Yawɛ.
en: Never envy evil people, but always respect the Lord .

dag: Niriba maa ni daa duri maa, maligumaaniba bɛn daa ʒiri Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka la daa kul kpalim ʒiɛla mɔɣili maa sunsuuni tiŋkuŋ zuɣu hal ka niriba maa zaa ti du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa naai.
en: While the people walked across on dry ground, the priests carrying the Lord 's Covenant Box stood on dry ground in the middle of the Jordan until all the people had crossed over.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni zali ma ni n tum shɛm o daalibarika ni zuɣu ka n niŋ tammɛr yɛndana ŋun zali duu gbinni tanzaa, ka so mɛri tamdi di zuɣu. Ka ŋunkam gba yɛn me n-tam di zuɣu, ŋun mɛm viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: God treated me with undeserved grace and let me become an expert builder. I laid a foundation on which others have built. But we must each be careful how we build.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Yisa gba daa kpi tin tariga ni o zaŋ omaŋmaŋ ʒim mali niriba ka bɛ be kasi.
en: Jesus himself suffered outside the city gate, so his blood would make people holy.

dag: dama o daa tib barinim pam, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka ŋunkam mali dɔro ŋaɣisiri niriba maa ni ni o ti shih o.
en: After Jesus had healed many people, the other sick people begged him to let them touch him.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa dari yuri Ijipti mini Silisia tiŋgbana ni, ka naa kɔhigɔriba daa dari ba Silisia na kaman bɛ daa ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The king's agents controlled the export of horses from Musri and Cilicia.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn saɣim n daalikauli, ka bi gbibi alikauli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni daa yɛli n san la, n ni niŋ ba kaman bɛ ni yi pirigi naɣisaa buyi sɔŋ, ka tim pirigibu maa sunsuuni gari shɛm la.
en: I will hand over those who broke my agreement and have not kept the promises they made before me. They cut a calf into two pieces before me and walked between the two pieces.

dag: Nasara dibu suhupiɛlli yila be wuntizɔriba suɣa shee, Yawɛ nudirigu n-tum tuun kara maa.
en: Listen to the glad shouts of victory in the tents of God's people: The Lord 's mighty power has done it!.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu soli ni daa na bi kana, ti daa bela Naawuni fukumsi zaligu sulinsi ni ni di gbibi ti hal ti paai yɛda niŋbu soli maa palo yibu saha.
en: Before this faith came, the law held us as prisoners. We had no freedom until God showed us the way of faith that was coming.

dag: Ka Yisa daa zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro maa m-paɣi Naawuni di zuɣu, ka zaŋ li tari salo maa; ka lan niŋ zahim la gba lala hal ka bɛ zaa ti nya bɛ ni bɔri shɛm tariga.
en: Jesus took the bread in his hands and gave thanks to God. Then he passed the bread to the people, and he did the same with the fish, until everyone had plenty to eat.

dag: Ka o daa be mɔɣu maa ni biɛɣ pihinahi, ka Sintani daa ti zahim o. Yisa mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri n-daa be mɔɣu maa ni, ka malaikanim daa kanna nti kpaŋsir o suhu.
en: He was there for days, being tempted by Satan. During this time he was out among the wild animals. Then angels came and helped him.

dag: Yisifu daa beni hal ti nya Ifriim bihi ni o yaantibichahi. O daa lan beni hal ti nya Manaasa bihi ni Makiri gba bihi n-zaŋ ba ʒil o naba zuɣu.
en: He lived to see Ephraim's children and grandchildren. He also lived to receive the children of Machir son of Manasseh into the family.

dag: ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka ʒiɛmana din kanna niriba ti mi li, ka bɛ ni na bi dɔɣi bi shɛb gba ti yiɣisina n-zaŋ li wuhi bɛ bihi.
en: Then the next generation, even the children not yet born, would learn the law. And they would be able to teach it to their own children.

dag: Amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn suhuri ni paligi ka bɛ mali suhupiɛlli Naawuni sani. Bɛ suhuri shiri ni paligi ka bɛ wa waa ni suhupiɛlli.
en: But let your people be happy and celebrate because of you.

dag: A ni ti baŋ ni n wum a turi yɛtɔɣa shɛŋa a ni tɔɣisiri turi Izraɛl zoya yɛra, Di kpalimla dabari doya. Bɛ zaŋ li ti ti ni ti va li.
en: and you will know that I am the LORD. Ive heard the lies and libels that you uttered against Israels highlands when you said, They are laid waste. Theyve been given to us to consume.

dag: Yi daa ku niriba pam bo vi niŋ yi yiŋa. Yi kɔŋ yi nyɛviya.
en: You plan shame for your own house, cutting off many peoples and sinning against your own life.

dag: dama m bipolitali saha ka n daa wums o kaman o ba la, ka kul sɔŋdi pakoli sahakam.
en: All my life I have taken care of them.

dag: Yawɛ, n dimnim zuɣu wuhim ma a wuntia soli; malim a soli maa ka di tuhi ti ma.
en: Lord , show me your right way of living, and make it easy for me to follow. People are looking for my weaknesses, so show me how you want me to live.

dag: Ka Baalihanan ŋun daa nyɛ Gɛda nir la daa lihiri sinsabisi mini olivi tihi din daa be Shɛfɛla la, ka Jɔash daa su kpam ni be du shɛŋa ni fukumsi.
en: Baal Hanan from Geder was in charge of the olive trees and sycamore trees in the western hill country. Joash was in charge of storing the olive oil.

dag: Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni ka Yisa daa lab Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka bɛ daa mol o yɛla gili di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: Jesus returned to Galilee with the power of the Spirit. News about him spread everywhere.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, zaɣ viɛlli mini yurilim din galisi kul ni be m biɛhigu ni n nyɛvili ni zaa, ka n kul ni be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: I know that your goodness and love will be with me all my life; and your house will be my home as long as I live.

dag: Ka Sool daa ti tim ti yɛli Jɛsi, Chɛ ka Dauda kpalim n yili ŋɔ n-tumdi n tuma; dama n suhu yu o pam.
en: Then Saul sent a message to Jesse: I like David. Let him stay here in my service.

dag: Wuntizɔriba mi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din niŋ kamaata yɛlibu, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn yɛtɔɣa kul nyɛla yɛtɔɣ kaha.
en: If you obey the Lord, you will always know the right thing to say. But no one will trust you if you tell lies.

dag: Chɛliya ka bɛn tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa puuni niriba ata bee ayi tɔɣisi; ka chɛ ka bɛn kpalim buɣisi bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Two or three who are given God's message should speak, while the others are to judge what they say.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila ba shɛb bɛn nyɛ diribarilimnima ka bi diri tiɣiri la. Zuɣulaannim ŋɔ gba ka baŋsim. Bɛ zaa dolila bɛ suhuyubu soli, ka kul niŋdila din ni sɔŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ kɔŋko.
en: You stupid leaders are a pack of hungry and greedy dogs that never get enough. You are shepherds who mistreat your own sheep for selfish gain.

dag: Ka Filip daa bɔ n-nya Nataniɛl yɛl o, Ti nya Anabi Musa ni daa sab so yɛla o zaligu kundinim ni min anabinim gba ni daa sab so yɛla la. Ŋuna n-nyɛ Yisa Yisifu bia ŋun yi Nazarɛt na la.
en: Philip then found Nathanael and said, We have found the one that Moses and the Prophets wrote about. He is Jesus, the son of Joseph from Nazareth.

dag: Ka o mini do so yi dɔni, ka o daɣiri maa tabil o, doo maa ni be daɣiri ni daba ayopɔin, ka bindo shɛlikam zuɣu doo maa ni dɔni ni nyɛla din be daɣiri ni.
en: If a man has sexual intercourse with her during her period, he is contaminated by her impurity and remains unclean for seven days, and any bed on which he lies is unclean.

dag: Dama yi ni ti di vi yi ni yuri buɣa oki ti shɛŋa la zuɣu, ka yi suhuri ti saɣim yi ni pii yi sambani pu shɛŋa ti yi wuna la zuɣu.
en: You will be ashamed of the oaks you once desired, and embarrassed by the gardens you once chose.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa zaŋ ya tim tiŋgban nɛli din galisi ka mali dabiɛm, ka nyɛ tiŋgban kuŋ puuni gari wɔɣ biɛri mini nɔnsi ni be tiŋgban shɛli ni. O daa chɛ ka kom yi chɛribo kuɣa ni na ka yi nyu.
en: He led you through that vast and terrifying desert where there were poisonous snakes and scorpions. In that dry and waterless land he made water flow out of solid rock for you.

dag: Hal n ni kul ka taali maa zaa yoli n ku tooi garig o. N naɣ ni suhila ŋun zaŋ ma taali maa, ka o zo ma nambɔɣu.
en: Though I am innocent, all I can do is beg for mercy from God my judge.

dag: Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa, bɛ ni ti mi o niriba la, Bɛ ni pirigi so namdili yiŋnima.
en: Subsequently, that mans family will be known throughout Israel as the house of the removed sandal.

dag: Ka n daa ti lan kpuɣi n zuɣu lihi nya gban shɛli ka di be pɔhim ni yiɣira.
en: When I looked the next time, I saw a flying scroll.

dag: N ni ti vuɣi Ashɛra binwɔɣila la yi sani, ka wurim yi fɔntinsi.
en: I will pull down the images of the goddess Asherah in your land and destroy your cities.

dag: Zɛdɛkia yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisiniyini saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuun piniyini Jɛrusalɛm. O ma yuli n-daa booni Hamutal. Hamutal mi ba n-daa nyɛ Jɛrimia ŋun daa nyɛ Libina nir la.
en: Zedekiah was years old when he was appointed king of Judah, and he ruled from Jerusalem for years. His mother Hamutal was the daughter of Jeremiah from Libnah.

dag: Dama o mi ninvuɣ yoya, ka o yi nya zaɣ biɛɣu, o ku niŋ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ di polo?.
en: He knows worthless people, sees sin, and certainly takes note.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ neen yinsi din nyɛ salima kɔtomsi gali mini gali sabilifaa ni gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli n-wuɣi shɛlɔrigu ka di mini binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la nyɛ zaɣ yini.
en: The men will very carefully weave a cloth belt for the ephod. This belt must be made the same way as the ephod—use gold threads, fine linen, and blue, purple, and red yarn.

dag: O ni wurim pihi din du mini birini goma zaa;.
en: or like the tall towers and high walls, but they will be brought down.

dag: Lɛvi bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Gɛrishom mini Kɔhat ni Mɛrari.
en: Levis sons were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

dag: Zaŋmiya bula yino mal alahichi sanyoo sara pahi sara shɛli din kpihindi alahichi la mini yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim sahakam la ni di chi sara ni di binnyura sara la zuɣu.
en: You will also offer male goat as a sin offering. This will be in addition to the sin offering for the Day of Atonement. This will also be in addition to the daily sacrifice and its grain offerings and drink offerings.

dag: Ka din daa lu vuhim shee la, din ŋmanila bɛn wum Naawuni yɛligu maa ka gbib li kirikiri bɛ suhuri ni ni yɛlimaŋli, ka di dɔɣira n-niŋdi biɛlim pam bɛ suɣilo dibu puuni la.
en: The seeds that fell in good soil stand for those who hear the message and retain it in a good and obedient heart, and they persist until they bear fruit.

dag: N ni ti yiɣisi n suhu pam bahi yi zuɣu, ka pɔbisi n suhuyiɣisili buɣim bahi yi zuɣu, ka zaŋ ya niŋ putɔɣunim bɛn mi niriba kubu looloochi nuu ni.
en: I will pour out my wrath against you. With a raging fire I will blow against you, and I will hand you over to those who burn and forge destruction.

dag: Ka n daa gari a sani n-nya a ni be a ʒim ni talinda, a ni daa do a ʒim ni maa, ka n yɛl a, Niŋmi nyɛvili.
en: Then I passed by and saw you squirming in your own blood. You were covered with blood, but I wouldn't let you die.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri biriginsim yɛtɔɣa nyɛla zana din gbahiri ba, amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn yiri yɛla ni.
en: The wicked are trapped by the transgressions of their lips, but the righteous escape from distress.

dag: ka pii mah shɛŋa din ka dabindi la zaɣ yini mini bɔrɔbɔro din mali kpam zaɣ yini ni karikaasi zaɣ yini piɛ shɛli din ʒe Yawɛ tooni la puuni n-zaŋ li pa biŋkpam la mini nudirigu biŋgbalipuɣili la zuɣu.
en: Then he took from a basket some of each of the three kinds of bread that had been made without yeast and had been dedicated to the Lord .

dag: Amaa ka n daa ti zahim dabiɛm zahindi n-nya ʒii shɛŋa n gom shee ka di muɣisi ma pam.
en: But I had a frightening dream and saw terrifying visions while I was asleep.

dag: Naawuni ŋun chɛ ka ti mali tahima ŋɔ timiya suhupiɛlli mini suhudoo zaa yi ni niŋ yɛda zuɣu, din ni chɛ ka yi mali tahima din galisi Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni.
en: May God, the source of hope, fill you with all joy and peace by means of your faith in him, so that your hope will continue to grow by the power of the Holy Spirit.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ ni ŋun daa bo vuri maa daag o bahi ha ka bɔh o, Ŋuni n-lee zaŋ a leei ti toondana mini ti sariakarita?.
en: But the one who was mistreating the other pushed Moses aside. Who made you ruler and judge over us? he asked.

dag: Ŋunkam yɛri yɛlimaŋli dirila shɛhira maŋli, amaa ʒiri shɛhiralana ŋmarila ʒiri.
en: When you tell the truth, justice is done, but lies lead to injustice.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa ti tuhi deei Hamatizɔba.
en: Solomon attacked and captured the town of Hamath-Zobah.

dag: Bɛzalɛl mini Oholiab ni Naawuni ni daa zaŋ yiko mini fahim niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb zaa ni ni bɛ baŋ bɛ ni yɛn tumdi tuma shɛm luɣ kasi shee la malibu ni ti tum bɛ tuma kaman Yawɛ ni zali ba shɛm.
en: The Lord has given to Bezalel, Oholiab, and others the skills needed for building a place of worship, and they will follow the Lord 's instructions.

dag: Anab ŋuni ka yi yaannim maa daa lee bi niŋ alaka? Bɛna n-daa ku Naawuni ni daa tim o daanab shɛb bɛn daa daŋ na ni bɛ ti moli ŋun Naawuni wuntialana kandina molo la, ka yi mi yi o nyaaŋa ku o.
en: Is there one prophet that your ancestors didn't mistreat? They killed the prophets who told about the coming of the One Who Obeys God. And now you have turned against him and killed him.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Ka ŋunkam lu kuɣili maa zuɣu ni chɛrisichɛrisi, amaa kuɣili maa mi yi lu so zuɣu, di ni niɛm o buɣibuɣi kaman zim la.
en: Anyone who stumbles over this stone will get hurt, and anyone it falls on will be smashed to pieces.

dag: Bɛ zaa nyɛla bɛn yɔhindi bɛ ʒiʒiinitaba, ka so bi yɛri yɛlimaŋli. Bɛ wuhila bɛ zilima ʒiri ŋmabu. Bɛ tum tuumbiɛri ka di gbarigi ba hal ka bɛ ku lan tooi niŋ tuuba.
en: Everyone lies to their neighbor. No one speaks the truth. The people of Judah have taught their tongues to lie. They sinned until they were too tired to come back.

dag: Di saha ka Abimilɛk daa zaŋ piɛri mini naɣilahi ni dabidɔbba ni paɣiba ti Ibrahimma, ka zaŋ o paɣ Zara gba labisi ti o.
en: After Abimelech had given Abraham some sheep, cattle, and slaves, he sent Sarah back.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Ŋun pun su kom bi lan bɔr o luɣ shɛli polo paɣibu n-naɣ pahila o naba, dama o ni zaa pun viɛlimi. Ka yɛli ba, Yi zaa ha viɛla, kul gbaai yihila yi ni yino.
en: Jesus said, After a person has a bath, his whole body is clean. He needs only to wash his feet. And you are clean, but not all of you.

dag: A kari pakoya bahi ni nuzaŋa, ka kabisi kpibisi bɔɣiri.
en: You have sent widows away empty; crushed orphans resources.

dag: Di dabisa maa ni, Judanim ni ti chaŋ ti pahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu ka bɛ laɣim taba n-yi nuzaa polo tiŋgban ni n-ka n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti yi yaannim ni bɛ su li la ni na.
en: In those days the family of Judah will join the family of Israel. They will come together from a land in the north to the land I gave to their ancestors.

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi pam dindali maa, ka o po n-yɛli.
en: The Lord became angry that day and made a promise:.

dag: Amaa leemiyala bɛn tumdi yɛligu maa ni wuhi shɛm, ka pa ni bɛn yɔhim bɛmaŋ wumdila di ni yɛli shɛm kɔŋko.
en: Do what Gods teaching says; dont just listen and do nothing. When you only sit and listen, you are fooling yourselves.

dag: Maika bia Matania daa nyɛla Zabidi ŋun daa yi Asaf daŋ ni na la yaaŋa. Ŋuna n-daa gari ti tooni m-piligiri wumpaɣibo wunsuhigu. Bakibukia n-daa nyɛ o tab ni ninvuɣ so ŋun pa o zuɣu. Shammua bia Abida daa nyɛla Galal yaaŋa ka nyɛ Jɛdutun yaantibichee.
en: also Mattaniah son of Mica son of Zabdi son of Asaph the leader who began the thanksgiving with prayer, and Bakbukiah, who was the second among his associates; and Abda son of Shammua son of Galal son of Jeduthun.

dag: Yawɛ, n ni daa zahim nya ka di be kaman n yɛn kɔŋ la n nyɛvili maa, ka n daa teeg a yɛla ka suh a, ka a be a jɛmbu du kasi la ni ka wum n suhigu.
en: When I felt my life slipping away, then, O Lord , I prayed to you, and in your holy Temple you heard me.

dag: dama ti nyɛla bɛn mini Masia laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yini, ti yi kul niŋ ti ni daa tuui mali tahima shɛl la naani viɛnyɛliŋga hal ni di bahigu ni.
en: For we are all partners with Christ if we hold firmly to the end the confidence we had at the beginning.

dag: amaa ka daa ti wum ni Arikilɔs n-di nam zan o ba Hɛrɔd zaani Judia, ka dabiɛm daa mal o ni o kul ni; ka Naawuni daa lan wuh o zahindi ni ni o ŋmaligim chaŋ Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: But when he heard that Herod's son Archelaus was now ruler of Judea, he was afraid to go there. Then in a dream he was told to go to Galilee.

dag: Ka Gomna Gɛdalia daa lo ba alikauli yɛli, Di zɔriya Babilɔn sapashinnim dabiɛm, kpalimmiya be ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni n-jɛmdi Babilɔn naa, ka binshɛlikam niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani.
en: Gedaliah said to them, I give you my word that there is no need for you to be afraid of the Babylonian officials. Settle in this land, serve the king of Babylonia, and all will go well with you.

dag: Yi mi bi chɛ yi mabihi ŋɔ bahi di saha maa hal ni zuŋɔ, amaa ka kul doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zaligunima.
en: All this time you have never once deserted the other Israelites. You have been careful to obey the commands of the Lord your God.

dag: Amaa o cham maligumaana Ɛliɛza sani ka o lihi Urim puuni Yawɛ sani m-baŋ o ni yɛli shɛm ti o. O mini Izraɛlnim zaa doli Ɛliɛza ni yɛli ba shɛm, o yi yɛli ni bɛ yima, bɛn yima, ka o yi yɛli ni bɛ labimina, bɛn labimina.
en: But Joshua must depend on Eleazar to find out from me what I want him to do as he leads Israel into battle.

dag: O daa niŋ lala ni o wuhila Izraɛl ʒiɛmani kam niriba tɔbu tuhibu yɛla, di bahi bamdi bɛ ni shɛb bɛn nini daa na ʒi n-nya tɔbu tuhibu la.
en: He did this only in order to teach each generation of Israelites about war, especially those who had never been in battle before.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛlila taba, Zahin zahinda la n-kanna ŋɔ.
en: The brothers said to each other, Here comes the big dreamer.

dag: O ni zali ti shɛm n-nyɛ ni ti niŋ o Bia Yisa Ba Masia yuli yɛda ka yuri taba kaman o ni zali ti shɛm.
en: What he commands is that we believe in his Son Jesus Christ and love one another, just as Christ commanded us.

dag: Bɛ ni ti nyo a yiya buɣim, ka kar a saria paɣiba pam ninni. N ni chɛ ka a ku lan tum pagɔrisigu tuma, ka a gba ku lan ti so pina.
en: They will burn down your houses and execute judgments against you in the sight of many women. I will bring an end to your prostitution; indeed, you will never again give payment.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ ya tahi n ni daa po pɔri ni n zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu la ni. N ni ti zaŋ li tin ya ka di leei yi ni su shɛli. Dama mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I made a great promise to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I promised to give them a special land. So I will lead you to that land. I will give you that land. It will be yours. I am the Lord .

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa mali ti paai Izraɛlnim sansan ni, ka Izraɛlnim maa daa yiɣisi lu bɛ zuɣu, ka Mɔabnim maa ŋmaligi guui, ka Izraɛlnim kari doli ba ŋ-ŋmɛri kuri ba chana.
en: But when they arrived at Israel's camp, the Israelite soldiers came out and attacked them, until they turned and ran away. Israel's army chased them all the way back to Moab, and even there they kept up the attack.

dag: Firilatamdigu maa daa malila jaba ayɔbu: jaba ata daa bela yaɣ yini polo, ka jaba ata be yaɣ din la mi polo.
en: Six branches extended from its sides, three from each side.

dag: Ka bɛ banim bee bɛ tizɔdɔbba yi ti kana ti yɛl ti di yɛla, ti ni yɛli ba, Pahimiya suɣilo ka chɛ ba ti ba, dama ti bi tuhila tɔbu gbahi ba n-ti bɛ zaa yinoyino ni bɛ niŋ bɛ paɣiba maa, ka di mi pala yinima n-zaŋ ba ti ba, ka ni mali taali di zuɣu. .
en: When their fathers or brothers come to us to object, well tell them, Do us a favor for their sake. We didnt capture enough women for every man during the battle, and this way you are not guilty because you didnt give them anything willingly.

dag: Ka Naa Sool daa guhi hal ni daba ayopɔin kaman Samuɛl ni daa zal o shɛm, amaa ka Samuɛl daa na bi ka Giligal na, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be Sool sani maa ti zɔri ka chɛr o.
en: Samuel said he would meet Saul at Gilgal. Saul waited there seven days. But Samuel had not yet come to Gilgal, and the soldiers began to leave Saul.

dag: Aduna bihi ni ŋun mali niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu bee ʒim ni yiri so ni mir ka o di bin yɛr kasinim la, faashee o ti yi daɣiri ni. Ŋunkam ti shihi bin shɛli din nyɛ daɣiri ka di nyɛla kpima ka o shihi bee do so ŋun dɔbilim yi o tooni na.
en: None of you may take part in the sacred meals while you have a skin disease or an infected penis, or after you have been near a dead body or have had a flow of semen.

dag: Ka bɛ daa laɣisi bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu shɛŋa bɛ ni daa ŋub maa zaɣ chɛhi pali piɛri pinaayi.
en: The disciples gathered them up and filled twelve large baskets with what was left over from the five barley loaves.

dag: ka mali tahima ni mmaŋmaŋ gba ni ti neei kum ni.
en: so that somehow I also may be raised to life.

dag: O kɔba ŋmanila daanya mulima din mali yɔri, ka o gbaya min o bɔɣiri ŋmani kurimulima.
en: His bones are as strong as bronze. His legs are like iron bars.

dag: Ka n daa kpahim yɛlli maa nti baŋ ni di pala Naawuni n-wuh o ni o yɛli lala, amaa ka daa baŋ ni Tɔbaya mini Sanbalat n-daa ti o liɣiri m-puh o ni o tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ jɛndi ma.
en: When I thought it over, I realized that God had not spoken to Shemaiah, but that Tobiah and Sanballat had bribed him to give me this warning.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Sara maligu bimbini zaligunim m-bɔŋɔ: dahin shɛli di yi ti naai, ka yi yɛn mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la di zuɣu, ka zaŋ ʒim vie li.
en: The Sovereign Lord said to me, Mortal man, listen to what I tell you. When the altar is built, you are to dedicate it by burning sacrifices on it and by sprinkling on it the blood of the animals that were sacrificed.

dag: Ka Liya daa ti lan niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga ŋun pah ayɔbu ti Yaakubu.
en: Leah became pregnant again and gave birth to a sixth son.

dag: Ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa tooni zaŋ labi wulimpuhili polo mini di sambani gba yɛliŋ daa nyɛ mita pihinu.
en: The restricted area on the east side, in front of the Temple, was cubits long.

dag: Chɛ ka tuumba bɛn ka Juda naa Zɛdɛkia sanna Jɛrusalɛm maa zaŋ lahibali ti ti Ɛdom naa mini Mɔab naa ni Ammɔn naa ni Taai naa ni Sidɔn naa.
en: Then send a message to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon, Tyre, and Sidon. Some officials from these countries are in Jerusalem, meeting with Zedekiah.

dag: Amaa Naawuni nambɔzɔbo galisiya, ka o yurilim gba galisi zaŋ chaŋ ti polo.
en: However, God is rich in mercy. He brought us to life with Christ while we were dead as a result of those things that we did wrong. He did this because of the great love that he has for us. You are saved by Gods grace!.

dag: Miriya ka yi chɛ ka ninvuɣ so labisi ya nyaaŋa o ni nyari ʒii shɛŋa zuɣu bee o ni kpaŋsiri ʒiri maŋsiɣisibu soli dolibu mini malaikanim jɛmbu yɛla zuɣu. Lala nir nyɛla ŋun duhir omaŋa o ninsalitali tɛha puuni ka di ka daliri.
en: Dont let anyone who wants to practice harsh self-denial and worship angels rob you of the prize. They go into detail about what they have seen in visions and have become unjustifiably arrogant by their selfish way of thinking.

dag: Yi mi ni yi ni daa nyɛ chɛfirinim saha shɛl la, buɣa din ku tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa n-daa sun ya ka birigi ya.
en: I want you to remember that before you became followers of the Lord, you were led in all the wrong ways by idols that cannot even talk.

dag: Amaa ka maligumaaniba kpamba maa daa dim salo maa tiba ni yɛli ni bɛ yɛlim o ni o yihimila Barabas bahi, ka pa ni Yisa.
en: But the chief priests stirred up the crowd to have him release Barabbas to them instead.

dag: Yɛlim Aduna min o bidibisi, ŋ-ŋɔ ka yi yɛn suhiri alibarika niŋdi Izraɛlnim ni: yɛlimiya ba.
en: to tell Aaron and his sons to use the following words in blessing the people of Israel:.

dag: Ka Yawɛ jilima daa du zuɣusaa n-yi tiŋ maa sunsuuni chaŋ ti zani zo shɛli din be tiŋ maa wulimpuhili polo la zuɣu.
en: The LORDs glory ascended from the middle of the city, and it stopped at the mountain east of the city.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yi yi di nyɛla zoomba, yi naan ku mali taali, amaa pumpɔŋɔ yi yɛliya ni yi nyara, dinzuɣu yi taali kpalim ʒi yi zuɣu.
en: Jesus answered, If you were blind, then you would not be guilty; but since you claim that you can see, this means that you are still guilty.

dag: Di saha maa ka sanʒiɛɣu maa ʒiɛbu daa kul moorila nini pahira. Ka bɛ daa bɔhi Jona, Ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ a ka teeku ŋɔ fo n-dɔni baalim.
en: The storm was getting worse all the time, so the sailors asked him, What should we do to you to stop the storm.

dag: N kɔba zaa kul yimi paya. Bɛ kul kpaala bɛ nina kpa ma lihiri ma.
en: I can count all my bones! Meanwhile, they just stare at me, watching me.

dag: O chɛ ka binshɛɣukam mali di saha; ka din pahi nyɛla, o chɛ ka ti mi din pun niŋ, din saha gari mini din na yɛn niŋ dahin shɛli ha yɛla. Amaa ka ti lee ku tooi baŋ ŋun Naawuni ni pun niŋ shɛm kurimbuni ha ni o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm di bahigu ni.
en: He has set the right time for everything. He has given us a desire to know the future, but never gives us the satisfaction of fully understanding what he does.

dag: Amaa wula ka Naawuni daa lee garigi yɛl o? O daa yɛl o, M mali niriba tusa ayopɔin bɛn na bi jɛm buɣili Baal.
en: What answer did God give him? I have kept for myself seven thousand men who have not worshiped the false god Baal.

dag: O daa tum tuun kara Juda fɔntinsi ni. O daa zaŋ tɔbutuhiri biinsi ti ʒili Jɛrusalɛm.
en: and had many supplies in the cities of Judah. He also had an army of mighty warriors in Jerusalem.

dag: Piɛguliba ti ku tooi zo n-tiligi, ka zuɣulaannim gba ti ku tooi zo n-tiligi.
en: There will be no place for the shepherds to hide. They will not escape.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Yisifu biɛyanim maa daa zaŋ bɛ ba biŋkɔbiri chaŋ luɣ shɛli din miri Shɛkɛm ni bɛ ti ŋub mɔri.
en: One day Josephs brothers went to Shechem to care for their fathers sheep.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa saai kpani maa ka kpuɣi ko gaɣili maa Sool zuɣusaa ka bɛ chaŋ. So daa bi nya ba bee m-baŋ di yɛla bee so ti neei, bɛ zaa daa gbihirimi, dama Yawɛ n-daa chɛ ka go titali gbahi ba.
en: So David took the spear and the water jug that were by Sauls head, and he and Abishai left. No one saw them, no one knew they were there, and no one woke up. All of them remained asleep because a deep sleep from the LORD had come over them.

dag: Zaŋmi li lo a nubihi ka sabi li niŋ a suhu ni.
en: Tie them around your finger. Write them on your heart.

dag: Ka Yisa daa do ŋariŋ maa nyol ni difiɛli zuɣu gbihira; ka bɛ neeg o m-bɔh o, Karimba, bɔ n-niŋ ka kom diri ti ka a baɣa kani.
en: Jesus was in the back of the boat, sleeping with his head on a pillow. The disciples woke him up and said, Teacher, don't you care that we are about to die.

dag: Ka ŋunkam nyɛ Naawuni bia nyɛla ŋun nyandi dunia ŋɔ. Ti yɛda niŋbu mi n-nyɛ din nyandi dunia ŋɔ.
en: because everyone who is born from God defeats the world. And this is the victory that has defeated the world: our faith.

dag: Yawɛ di tam o ba tuumbiɛri yɛla, ka di kpihim o ma daalahichi.
en: Don't let the Lord forgive the sins of his parents and his ancestors.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ nina niŋ liti, ka bɛ ku tooi nya; ka chɛ ka bɛ yaaŋkɔba gbarigi sahakam.
en: Let them go blind and their backs become weak.

dag: Baŋmiya ni ninvuɣ biɛri ku yi tibidarigibo ni, amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn ni yi.
en: The truth is, evil people will be punished, and good people will be set free.

dag: Amaa di ni chɛri ka daadamnim tumdi kɔr biɛri tuma zuɣu, di niŋ kamaata ni doo kam mal o dahalali paɣa, ka paɣ kam mi mal o dahalali yidana.
en: But because there is so much immorality, every man should have his own wife, and every woman should have her own husband.

dag: Ka n daa chaŋ tiwala tihi puu ni, ni n ti nya vinvamli ni tipuma, ka nya wain tihi puma, ka nya pumpɔrinchihi tihi puma.
en: I went down to the grove of walnut trees, to see the fruit of the valley, to see if the vines were in bloom, to see if the pomegranates had budded.

dag: Di saha ka o daa zaŋ nabia maa na nti zaŋ nam zuɣupiligu pil o, ka zaŋ nam fukumsi litaafi ti o, ka bɛ leeg o nam. Ka Jɛhɔiada min o bidibisi daa booi kpam bah o zuɣu ni. Ka sokam daa kuhi yɛli, Naawuni dolimi naa ŋɔ nyɛvili.
en: Then they brought out the kings son, crowned him, gave him the royal law, and made him king. Jehoiada and his sons anointed him as everyone cried out, Long live the king.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ka Musa mini Aduna ni Izraɛlnim zaa sanna Kadɛshi Paran mɔɣu ni. Bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ chandi yɛtɔɣa n-yɛli bɛ mini niriba maa zaa, ka zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni tiwala wuhi ba.
en: the twelve men returned to Kadesh in the Paran Desert and told Moses, Aaron, and the people what they had seen. They showed them the fruit.

dag: Ka yɛli ba, Jɔn Baptaizira daa baptaiziri niriba la kom ni, amaa yinim ni deela Naawuni Shia Kasi baptaizibu daba ayi ŋɔ sunsuuni.
en: John baptized with water, but in a few days you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.

dag: Yi yi ti kuli yiŋ na, noli ni din ya, ka yi yi ti yi samban ni, noli ni din ya.
en: The Lord will make you fail in everything you do.

dag: Yawɛ, gbilisim a tibili wum, ka neeg a nina nya, ka wum Sɛnachɛrib ni tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa ti na tu nyin Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ.
en: Now, Lord , hear us and look at what is happening to us. Listen to all the things that Sennacherib is saying to insult you, the living God.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti yɛli ba, N kul yɛn be yi san la daba ayi kɔŋko ka lan labi ŋun tim ma na maa sani.
en: Jesus said, I shall be with you a little while longer, and then I shall go away to him who sent me.

dag: Yi nyɛla bɛn bi mi din sa yɛn niŋ yi nyɛviya biɛɣuni; dama yi ŋmanila paɣili din yi kpe, ka di bi yuui ka di lan yi la.
en: You dont really know about tomorrow. What is your life? You are a mist that appears for only a short while before it vanishes.

dag: Kɔhat daŋ niriba maa tuma Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni daa nyɛla bɛ lihiri binshɛŋa din be kasi pam la.
en: The Kohathites will be responsible for carrying the sacred objects used in worship at the sacred tent.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbiri lu a zuɣu n-ku ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri bɛn be a ni.
en: So I, the Lord God, will send troops to attack you, king of Egypt. They will kill your people and livestock.

dag: Jɛhɔram yuma daa nyɛla yuun pihitanaayi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa, o daa di nam maa la yuma anii Jɛrusalɛm.
en: He was years old when he became king, and he ruled eight years from Jerusalem.

dag: Yinima ninvuɣ shɛb o ni pun yɛli, N tin ya vuhim mini suhudoo, amaa ka yi zaɣisi ni yi ku wum ti ma.
en: He promised you perfect peace and rest, but you refused to listen.

dag: Ka paɣiba maa daa yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, tinim kul yɛn maanila alizanda ni paɣa ŋun nyɛ naa maa ka boori kom bahir o. A tɛhiya ni ti ni daa maani maha, ka niŋd o kɔtomsi niŋdi di ni, ka boori kom bahir o la, ti yidaannim nuu daa ka di ni.
en: And the women added, When we baked cakes shaped like the Queen of Heaven, offered sacrifices to her, and poured out wine offerings to her, our husbands approved of what we were doing.

dag: Ka tihi maa daa chɛ ka ŋmaligi yɛli wain tia, Ti bɔri ni nyini n-leei ti naa.
en: So the trees then said to the grapevine, You come and be our king.

dag: Filistianim maa daa ŋari kɔbil shɛŋa o ba Ibrahimma ni daa na be o nyɛvili ni ka o tumtumdiba gbi la.
en: So they destroyed all the wells that Isaacs father Abraham and his servants had dug many years before. They filled them with sand.

dag: Ka Juda zuliya niriba maa daa lan yi nimaani chaŋ ti liri Dɛbirinima. Bɛ daa tuui booni li la Kiriatisɛfa.
en: From there they moved against those who lived in Debir, known before as Kiriath-sepher.

dag: Bɛmaŋmaŋ nira n-ti yɛn nyɛ bɛ naa, bɛ naa ti yɛn yila bɛ sunsuuni na. N ni voog o mirina, ka o ti be n sani. Dama so ku tooi ka n sanna omaŋmaŋ yiko ni. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The Lord says, One of their own people will lead them. That ruler will come from my people. People can come close to me only if I ask them to. So I will ask that leader to come to me, and he will be close to me.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ lan yɛli, Yinim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim beni pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ sani, di pa shɛli ka yi tɛhi ni yɛlli ŋɔ ku tooi nani, amaa man sani, di ni tooi nani.
en: The Lord All-Powerful says, The survivors will think it is wonderful, and so will I.

dag: Bakɔi piligu dali asibaasi, di ni daa na bi neei zaa saha shɛli ka Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la daa chaŋ siliga maa gbini nti nya ka kuɣili din daa yo siliga maa nol la biligimi doya.
en: Early on Sunday morning, while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene went to the tomb and saw that the stone had been taken away from the entrance.

dag: Dinzuɣu zomiya nambɔɣu kaman yi Ba Naawuni ni zɔri nambɔɣu shɛm.
en: Have pity on others, just as your Father has pity on you.

dag: Ka fara yi gbaag a mabia ka o ku lan tooi gbib omaŋa, nyin gbib o ka chɛ ka o be a sani kaman sana bee tinzun nir la.
en: If any Israelites living near you become poor and cannot support themselves, you must provide for them as you would for a hired worker, so that they can continue to live near you.

dag: Ka o daa lan zaŋ daanya m-mali binkpila ayi n-zaŋ tam daanya daantalis ayi maa zuɣusaa, ka binkpila maa zaɣ yini dubu nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla.
en: He also made two bronze capitals, each one 1⁄2 feet tall, to be placed on top of the columns.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ya polo ka a lee bɔri ni ti mal ʒiishee ti a maa.
en: They said to him, Where do you want us to prepare the meal? He said to them.

dag: Yawɛ tiligir o daba nyɛviya; ka bɛnkam zo nti sɔɣ o sani so ku nya tibidarigibo.
en: The Lord will save his people; those who go to him for protection will be spared.

dag: A bela n tooni ni n nyaaŋa, ka zaŋ a nuu pa n zuɣu.
en: You surround me—front and back. You put your hand on me.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Ŋunkam ʒe n nyaaŋa niriba ni, n gba ni ti ʒe dilan nyaaŋa m Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ sani;.
en: Those who declare publicly that they belong to me, I will do the same for them before my Father in heaven.

dag: ka zaŋ bimbuɣisirigu bahi kom ni ni bɛ zahim kom maa ziliŋ, ka daa nya ka di nyɛla mita pihinahi. Ka bɛ daa tirisi tooni biɛla n-lan buɣisi n-nya ka di ziliŋ nyɛla mita pihita.
en: They measured and found that the water was about meters deep. A little later they measured again and found it was only about meters.

dag: Amaa ti mi ku tooi zaŋ ti bipuɣinsi ti ba. Dama tinim Izraɛlnim pun po n-yɛli ni ti ni so yi zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga n-ti Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa, noli din dim o.
en: But we can't let the men of Benjamin marry any of our daughters. We made a sacred promise not to do that, and if we break our promise, we will be under our own curse.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli, Di viɛla, n ni lo a alikauli; amaa bin yini ka n naɣ bɔri ni a niŋ, dina n-nyɛ: a yi ti yɛn kana ti nya ma nyin zaŋm Mikal Sool bipuɣiŋga la mali na, di yi pa lala a yi ti kana a ku nya n ninni.
en: David sent this message back: Good! I'll make an agreement with you. But before I will even talk with you about it, you must get Saul's daughter Michal back for me.

dag: Dan zuliya ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa mali shili, ka ni tooi tuhi tɔbu daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihitaayika ni kɔbisiyɔbu.
en: From the tribe of Dan there were , men ready for war.

dag: Ka o yɛla daa moli gili di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: News about Jesus spread all over that part of the country.

dag: N Duuma Naawuni, vihim ma m-baŋ n suhu biɛhigu. Buɣisim ma baŋ n tɛha.
en: Look deep into my heart, God, and find out everything I am thinking.

dag: Yawɛ, di kpahi n zuɣu ni a suhuyiɣisili puuni. A mi di saɣisi ma a suhuyiɣisili saha!.
en: Don't punish me, Lord , or even correct me when you are angry!.

dag: Ka sapashini maa daa zaŋ o tahi sapashin kpɛm maa sani ti yɛl o, Dansarika so ŋun yuli booni Pool la m-boli ma nti yɛli ma ni n zaŋ nachimbil ŋɔ tahi a sanna ni o malila yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni o yɛl a.
en: So the army officer brought Pauls nephew to the commander. The officer said, The prisoner Paul asked me to bring this young man to you. He has something to tell you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ naa zaligu maa moli gili Susa din nyɛ bɛ tinzuɣu maa ni, ka tuumba daa zaŋ di lahibali zo n-tahi yaɣili kam ni. Di saha maa Haman mini naa daa ʒimi nyuri dam, amaa ka Susa tiŋ puuninim zaa bɛn yɛma ŋma.
en: At the kings command the messengers hurried off. The command was given in the capital city of Susa. The king and Haman sat down to drink, but the city of Susa was in confusion.

dag: Bɛ zuɣu ka o daa teeg o daalikauli la yɛla, ka daa taɣi o tɛha o yurilim maŋli la zuɣu.
en: For their sake he remembered his covenant, and because of his great love he relented.

dag: Wummi n suhigu shɛli n ni suhir a ni a zo ma nambɔɣu ŋɔ. N kuhirimi niŋd a bɔri sɔŋsim; ka kpuɣiri n nuhi zuɣusaa tiriti a jɛmbu du kasi la.
en: Listen to my request for mercy when I cry out to you, when I lift up my hands to your holy inner sanctuary.

dag: O ni daa na kul yɛri maa, ka so lan kana ti yɛli, Naawuni buɣim n-yi zuɣusaa na ti di n-ku piɛri la mini piɛguliba la zaa, n kɔŋko n-nyɛ ŋun zo n-tiligi kana ni n ti yɛl a.
en: While this messenger was speaking, another arrived and said: A raging fire fell from the sky and burned up the sheep and devoured the young men. I alone escaped to tell you.

dag: N ni ti be Izraɛlnim sani n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: I will live among you as your God.

dag: Ninsalinim ni yɛn niŋ shɛm tooi baŋ Naawuni yɛla zaa dola palɔni bɛ sani, dama Naawuni maŋmaŋa m-pun kahigi li wuhi ba.
en: They know everything that can be known about God, because God has shown it all to them.

dag: Bɛ daa pihila kuɣa sɔŋ ni bɛ lihi nya ŋun yɛn su n niriba; ka daa zaŋ bidibbihi n-kɔhi bo pagɔra, ka zaŋ bipuɣinsi mi n-kɔhi nyu wain.
en: and gambled to see who would get my people; they sold boys and girls to pay for prostitutes and wine.

dag: Yawɛ, a yurilim maŋli la n-kul pali dunia ŋɔ zaa. Wuhim ma a zaligunim maa.
en: Our Lord , your love is seen all over the world. Teach me your laws.

dag: Chɛl barinyubo yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu, ka di lan chɛ ka karimbaan yɛtɔɣa yi a nol ni na yaha. Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ mi binshɛɣukam, ka mi daadam ni niŋdi shɛlikam.
en: I can tell those proud people, Stop your boasting! Nothing is hidden from the Lord , and he judges what we do.

dag: Ka Izraɛl ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be Jɛrusalɛm maa daa zaŋ daba ayopɔin puhi Bɔrɔbɔro Din ka Dabindi Chuɣu maa ni suhupiɛlli pam. Ka Lɛvinim mini maligumaaniba daa kul yiini yila ka ŋmɛri Yawɛ biŋkumda din kumdi pampam m-paɣiri Yawɛ dabisili kam.
en: The worshipers in Jerusalem were very happy and celebrated the Festival for seven days. The Levites and priests sang praises to the Lord every day and played their instruments.

dag: Ka n chɛ ka Ijiptinim maa niŋ tipawumli siɣi doli ba na, ka di chɛ ka n nya jilima Firawuna min o tɔbbihi zaa ni o chɛchɛbunsi ni o chɛchɛbunduhiriba zuɣu.
en: I will make the Egyptians so stubborn that they will go in after them, and I will gain honor by my victory over the king, his army, his chariots, and his drivers.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa tim ti boli Ahimɛlɛk ŋun daa nyɛ Ahitub bia, ka nyɛ maligumaana la min o daŋ zaa bɛn daa nyɛ maligumaaniba m-be Nɔb maa na. Ka bɛ zaa daa ka naa sanna.
en: Then King Saul ordered some men to bring the priest to him. Saul told them to bring Ahimelech son of Ahitub and all his relatives who were priests at Nob. So all of them came to the king.

dag: Dama o ni ŋubiri mɔ shɛŋa bela zoya ni luɣ shɛli mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri zaa ni diɛmda.
en: Indeed, the hills bring him tribute, places where all the wild animals play.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa ti faai siɣi o yaannim sani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o o ba Dauda tiŋ la ni; ka o bia Rɛhɔbɔam daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: He died and was buried in David's City, and his son Rehoboam succeeded him as king.

dag: Ka di bi simdi ka yi chɛ di shɛli zali hal ni asiba. Ka shɛli yi guui zani hal ni biɛɣ asiba, yin zaŋmiya li nyo buɣim.
en: Dont let any of it remain until morning, and burn any of it left over in the morning.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan yɛli, So na ʒi n-nyo firila zaŋ lɔɣu pil li bee n-zaŋ li zali garo lɔŋni, amaa o ni zaŋ li mi tam binshɛli zuɣu ni bɛnkam kpɛri yili maa ni na nyari li.
en: No one lights a lamp and covers it with a bowl or puts it under a bed. Instead, it is put on the lampstand, so that people will see the light as they come in.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ bɛ wuna din nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋ anzinfa mini salima mali ni bɛ jɛmdi li la bahi nantarisi mini zɔna dindali maa.
en: On that day everyone will throw to the moles and bats their idols of silver and gold they made to worship.

dag: Di saha maa Yisa ma Mariama min o tizo Mariama ŋun daa nyɛ Klɔpas paɣa la ni Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la daa ʒiɛla Yisa dapulli maa gbini.
en: Jesus' mother stood beside his cross with her sister and Mary the wife of Clopas. Mary Magdalene was standing there too.

dag: dindali maa ninvuɣ so ŋun ti zo n-tiligi ni ti zo n-ka a sanna nti ti a di lahibali.
en: on that day, a refugee will come to you so that you yourself will hear the news.

dag: Aizaia daa yɛli ba mi: Labimiya ti yɛli yi dana ni Yawɛ yɛliya, Di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a, a ni wum ka Asiria naa tuumba kana ti tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa tu ma la zuɣu.
en: he told them that the Lord had this message for Hezekiah: I am the Lord . Don't worry about the insulting things that have been said about me by these messengers from the king of Assyria.

dag: Zaŋmiya bula yino mal alahichi sanyoo sara pahi sara shɛli din kpihindi alahichi la mini yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim sahakam la ni di chi sara ni di binnyura sara la zuɣu.
en: Also offer one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the goat offered in the ritual of purification for the people, and the daily burnt offering with its grain offering and wine offering.

dag: Tiŋgbɔŋ maa niriba ni ti kurim dunɔdali maa shee Yawɛ tooni vuhim dabisa dali mini goli palli dabisa dali.
en: Each Sabbath and on the first day of each month, the people of Israel must also come to the east gate and worship me.

dag: Ka nyini daadam, dahin shɛli n ni ti yɛn deei bɛ kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛli din nyɛ bɛ suhupiɛlli mini bɛ jilima, ka bɛ nini tiɣi li, ka bɛ suhuri yu li pam m-pahi bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi la.
en: And you, human one: On the day that I take from them their proud stronghold—their crowning joy, the delight of their eyes—and their sons and daughters, whose fate weighs on them.

dag: Ka Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ŋun daa zo n-kuli Ijipti ni o yi Naa Sulemaana nuu ni ka o ku paag o ku o la daa wum di yɛla, ka yi Ijipti maa kuna.
en: Jeroboam son of Nebat heard what was happening, and he stayed in Egypt, where he had gone to hide from Solomon.

dag: Bihi, deemiya yi banim mini yi manim noya ti Duuma zuɣu, dama dina n-tuhi.
en: Children, you belong to the Lord, and you do the right thing when you obey your parents. The first commandment with a promise says.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu: Bɛ ni lihi m-maan lab lihi, amaa ka ku nya shɛli. Ka wum m-maan lab wum, amaa ka ku baŋ bɛ ni wum shɛli maa gbinni. Dama bɛ yi niŋ lala bɛ ni ŋmaligi lab Naawuni sani, ka o chɛ bɛ daalahichi paŋ ba. .
en: so that, They may look and look, yet not see; they may listen and listen, yet not understand. For if they did, they would turn to God, and he would forgive them.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn pa lala, bɛ ŋmanila wurigu shɛli pɔhim ni ʒiɛri bahira.
en: But evil people are not like this at all; they are like straw that the wind blows away.

dag: O tiri binnɛɔŋ kam bindirigu. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He provides food for all living things. His faithful love will last forever.

dag: Ka a zaŋ li sɔŋ pie taba kulis ayi salima teebuli la zuɣu. Kul yini kam zuɣu zaɣ kpil ayɔbu.
en: then take them into the sacred tent and lay them on the gold table in two rows of six loaves.

dag: ni Jɛshua ni Molada ni Bɛtipɛlɛt.
en: and in Jeshua, in Moladah, in Beth Pelet.

dag: Bɛ chɛ ka nandaamba kumdi niŋd o, ka o wum bɛ ni niŋdi shɛb alaka kuhigu.
en: The persons they mistreated had prayed for help, until God answered their prayers.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla n daa lan zaŋ n vuhim dabisa ti ba ka di leei shihirili m mini ba sunsuuni din ni chɛ ka bɛ baŋ ni man Yawɛ m-maani ba ka bɛ be kasi.
en: I also gave them my sabbaths as a sign between us that I, the LORD, have set them apart for my purpose.

dag: Ka Zara daa yɛli Ibrahimma, Karim dab paɣ ŋɔ min o bia ŋɔ, dama dab paɣ maa bia maa mini m bia Yisahaku ku laɣim di fali.
en: So she said to Abraham, Send this servant away with her son! This servants son wont share the inheritance with my son Isaac.

dag: Ka pukpara ŋun mi tumdi viɛnyɛliŋga nyɛla ŋun simdi ni o daŋ bindir pala dibu.
en: The farmer who works hard deserves the first part of the harvest.

dag: Yi ni ti ŋubi yuri mini chɛchɛbumbariba ni tɔbutuhiriba ni tɔbbihi balibu kam n yiŋa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You will have plenty of meat to eat at my table. There will be horses and chariot drivers, powerful soldiers, and all the other fighting men. This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: N suhu zaa kul yɛla a jɛmbu duu zuɣu, ka di yɛla kul nyamdi n ni. Bɛ ni tur a tu shɛŋa zaa ʒila n zuɣu.
en: Because passion for your house has consumed me, the insults of those who insult you have fallen on me!.

dag: Ka di simdi ni dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla zaligu yi sani sahakam ni bɛ yɔri Izraɛlnim daalahichi zaa samli tiri ba yim yuuni puuni. Ka Musa daa niŋ Yawɛ ni zal o shɛm maa.
en: This will be a permanent rule for you, in order to make reconciliation for the Israelites from all their sins once a year. It was done just as the LORD commanded Moses.

dag: Di saha ka Reechɛl daa kpuɣi wuna maa n-zaŋ niŋ laakum gal ni n-du n-ʒi di zuɣu. Ka Leeban daa vihi suɣili maa ni zaa bo li ka bi nya li.
en: Rachel had taken the household gods and put them in a camel's saddlebag and was sitting on them. Laban searched through the whole tent, but did not find them.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni yɛli ni bɛ di yɛli so o yɛla.
en: Jesus sternly ordered the evil spirits not to tell anyone who he was.

dag: a nyɛla ŋun saɣisiri niriba viɛnyɛliŋga, ka tumdi tuun kara. A nyari ninsal kam biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm, ka tiri bɛ zaa laara kaman bɛ biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm ni bɛ tuma ni simdi shɛm.
en: With great wisdom you make plans, and with your great power you do all the mighty things you planned. Nothing we do is hidden from your eyes, and you reward or punish us as we deserve.

dag: Di yuma ayi nyaaŋa ka Absalom daa ti yɛn chɛ o piɛri kɔbiri Baalihazɔr din mini Ifriim bi wɔɣ ni tab la, ka daa boli nabihi zaa ni bɛ kana.
en: Two years later, Absalom was shearing sheep at Baal-hazor near Ephraim, and he invited all the kings sons.

dag: dama yɛlimaŋli maa be ti ni, ka kul ni kpalim be ti ni hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: because of the truth that remains with us and will be with us forever.

dag: N ni daa nya o maa, ka n lu n-dɔni o tooni m-be kaman kpim la. Amaa ka o zaŋ o nudirigu m-pa n zuɣu ka yɛli ma, Di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a; mani n-nyɛ piligu ni bahigu.
en: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead man. But he put his right hand on me and said, Dont be afraid. Im the first and the last.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa chaŋ ni bɛ ti zaŋ o sɔɣi, bɛ daa bi lan nya o, ka naɣ nyala o zuɣuŋmaŋ min o napɔnvari ni o nuchɛhi.
en: But when they went out to bury her body, they found only her skull, her hands, and her feet.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa yiɣisi Firawuna sani yi tiŋ maa tariga nti duh o nuhi zuɣusaa suhi Yawɛ, ka satahinsi maa mini sakuɣa maa daa chɛ, ka saa maa baai.
en: After Moses left the royal palace and the city, he lifted his arms in prayer to the Lord , and the thunder, hail, and drenching rain stopped.

dag: Ka alizanda ni tɔbbihi ye binyɛr piɛla din piɛli ka be kasikasi m-bari wɔr piɛla dol o.
en: He was followed by armies from heaven that rode on white horses and were dressed in pure white linen.

dag: Ka daa zaŋ Kum mini Kpiimba Biɛhigu Shee maa bahi buɣim teeku ni. Buɣim teeku maa ni kpɛbu n-nyɛ kum din pahi buyi la.
en: And Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This lake of fire is the second death.

dag: Ka bɛ garigi yɛli ba, Yiɣisimiya ka ti chaŋ ti liri ba. Ti nya bɛ tiŋgbani maa ka di vuhiri pam. Di ʒin ya kpe yoli. Niŋmiya yomyom chaŋ ti deei bɛ tiŋgbani maa.
en: Come on, they replied. Let's attack Laish. We saw the land, and it's very good. Don't stay here doing nothing; hurry! Go on in and take it over!.

dag: Di saha ka Sool bipuɣiŋga ŋun pah ayi ka o yuli daa booni Mikal la suhu daa yu Dauda pam, ka bɛ daa yɛli Sool di yɛla, ka di daa niŋ o nyaɣisim pam.
en: Saul had another daughter. Her name was Michal, and Saul found out that she was in love with David. This made Saul happy.

dag: Dauda daa gbahila chɛchɛbunsi tuhili mini wɔribariba tusaayopɔin ni tɔbbi tinchandiba tuhi pisi. O daa yihi chɛchɛbunsi kɔbiga yuri zali, ka chɛ n-chihi wɔr shɛb bɛn kpalim zaa napɔn jila.
en: David captured a thousand of his chariots, seven thousand cavalry troops, and twenty thousand foot soldiers. He kept enough horses for a hundred chariots and crippled all the rest.
