dag: Juda Naa Uzia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihinunaayi saha ka Rɛmalia bia Pɛka daa di Izraɛl nam Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuun pisi.
en: Pekah, Remaliahs son, became king of Israel in the fifty-second year of Judahs King Azariah. Pekah ruled for twenty years in Samaria.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli Naa. Di yi niŋ nyin Naa nyaɣisim, ka a yu ni a niŋ man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ nirilim, n suhir a ni a timmi ma Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni n yaannim gbala ni do tin shɛli ni la ka n ti lab me li zali.
en: Then I told the king, Sir, if it's all right with you, please send me back to Judah, so that I can rebuild the city where my ancestors are buried.

dag: Yɛlimiya Izraɛlnima: Binneen shɛba yi ni yɛn diri biŋkɔbiri bɛn zaa be dunia ni n-nyɛ:.
en: Say to the Israelites: These are the creatures that you are allowed to eat from the land animals.

dag: O daa niŋ Izraɛlnim zuɣulana la yuun pisinaata. Ka o daa ti kpi, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Shamir.
en: He was Israel's leader for twenty-three years. Then he died and was buried at Shamir.

dag: Yawɛ, sɔŋm ti! Dama wundaba lan kani; ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim lan ka daadamnim ni.
en: Please help me, Lord ! All who were faithful and all who were loyal have disappeared.

dag: Daadam, tɔɣisim Izraɛl kpamba maa yɛtɔɣa yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɔzuɣu ka yi kana? Yi yɛn bɔhi ma mi baŋ binshɛli? Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, yi ku bɔhi ma baŋ binshɛli.
en: Human one, speak to Israels elders and say to them, The LORD God proclaims: Have you come to petition me? As surely as I live, I reject your petitions. This is what the LORD God says!.

dag: Dinzuɣu zaŋmiya yimaŋ zaa ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, ka dol o zalikpana la min o fukumsi zaligunim la kaman yi ni niŋ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: May you, his people, always be faithful to the Lord our God, obeying all his laws and commands as you do today.

dag: Ka wuntizɔriba maa yi nyɛla pihinahinaanu, a ni saɣim tiŋ maa niriba anu maa ni pooi maa zuɣu? Ka o yɛli, N yi nya wuntizɔriba pihinahinaanu tiŋ maa ni, n ku saɣim li.
en: But suppose there are only good people in Sodom. Would you still wipe out the whole city? If I find good people, the Lord replied, I won't destroy the city.

dag: Sokam nyɛla jɛra ka ka yɛm; salima tuumbaŋdib zaa buɣa dihi ba vi, dama bɛ binnana maa nyɛla ʒiri binyara ka bi vuhira.
en: At the sight of this, people feel stupid and senseless; those who make idols are disillusioned, because the gods they make are false and lifeless.

dag: O daa pun daŋ timla ninvuɣ so ka o daŋ bɛ tooni. Dilana n-daa nyɛ Yisifu so bɛ ni daa zaŋ kɔhi ka o leei dabili la.
en: But he sent a man ahead of them, Joseph, who had been sold as a slave.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa ni yino mi ti yɛl o, N Duuma, chɛ ka n kuli ka m ba ti di saɣim saɣ o tariga ka n sɔɣ o pɔi ka naanyi kana ti dol a.
en: Another man, one of his disciples, said to him, Lord, first let me go and bury my father.

dag: ni a ku niŋ ti zaɣ biɛɣu kaman ti gba ni daa bi shih a bee n-niŋ a shɛli, amaa ka naɣ niŋ a la zaɣ viɛlli hal ti chɛ ka a yi n-chaŋ ni alaafee la. Pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni.
en: We did not hurt you; now you should promise not to hurt us. We sent you away, but we sent you away in peace. Now it is clear that the Lord has blessed you.

dag: Bɛ lɔri ʒi tibisa din ʒibu to ʒiini niriba, amaa ka bɛmaŋmaŋ ku saɣi zaŋ bɛ nubil gba wuɣi li.
en: They make strict rules that are hard for people to obey. They try to force others to obey all their rules. But they themselves will not try to follow any of those rules.

dag: Yi ni ti biri yi bimbira yuma ayɔbu, ka wahi yi wain tihi wula nyoya ni bahi, ka pɔhi di wala hal ni yuma ayɔbu.
en: You shall plant your fields, prune your vineyards, and gather your crops for six years.

dag: Ka yi biɛhigu bemi kaman ti biɛhigu zaŋ tabili ti Duuma gba biɛhigu, dama hal yi ni daa di wahala pam la zaa yoli, yi daa deei ti yɛligu maa ni suhupiɛl shɛli din yiri Naawuni Shia Kasi sanna la.
en: And you became like us and like the Lord. You suffered much, but still you accepted the teaching with joy. The Holy Spirit gave you that joy.

dag: Saha shɛli Pool ni daa be Milɛtus maa ka o daa tim ti boli Ɛfɛsus Cheechi kpamba.
en: From Miletus he sent a message to Ephesus calling for the churchs elders to meet him.

dag: O bi nya ka zuɣubiɛɣu be Yaakubu zuliya ni; bee n-nya ka muɣisigu shɛli be Izraɛlnim sani. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa be bɛ sani. Ka bɛ yɛri ni ŋuna n-nyɛ bɛ naa m-be bɛ sani.
en: Israel's king is the Lord God. He lives there with them and intends them no harm.

dag: Jɔsia nam dibu yuun pisaayika ni ka bɛ daa puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu maa.
en: in the eighteenth year of Josiah's reign.

dag: Di saha maa ka ti Duuma daa niŋ anfaani din galisi pam niŋ n ni, ka ti ma yɛda mini yurilim din be Yisa Masia ni la.
en: Our Lords favor poured all over me along with the faithfulness and love that are in Christ Jesus.

dag: nti yɛli Aduna, Zaŋm naɣila polli mali alahichi sanyoo sara, ka zaŋ piɛlaa mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la. Di simdi ni bɛ zaa nyɛla bɛn ka dalima, ka a zaŋ ba mali sara ti Yawɛ.
en: He said to Aaron, Take a bull and a ram. There must be nothing wrong with them. The bull will be a sin offering, and the ram will be a burnt offering. Offer these animals to the Lord .

dag: Wuntizɔriba ni bɔri shɛli bahigu nyɛla din viɛla kɔŋko, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn ni bɔri shɛli bahigu nyɛla suhuyiɣisili.
en: What good people want brings more good. What evil people want brings more trouble.

dag: Hal bɛ daa yi zaŋ anchitinima bee situra din shihi ŋun Pool nti pa barinim zuɣu bɛ nyarila alaafee, ka alizin biɛri gba daa zɔri ka chɛri bɛ ni ʒi shɛb zuɣu.
en: People even took handkerchiefs and aprons that had touched Paul's body, and they carried them to everyone who was sick. All of the sick people were healed, and the evil spirits went out.

dag: Ka kum daa ti mali ba, ka a ti ba bindiri shɛli din yi alizanda ni na. Ka kɔnyuri daa ti mali ba, ka a ti ba kom din yi tampiŋ ni na. Ka a daa yɛli ba ni bɛ cham ti deei tiŋgbɔn shɛli a ni daa po pɔri ni a ni zaŋ ti ba fali la su.
en: They were hungry, so you gave them food from heaven. They were thirsty, so you gave them water from a rock. You told them, Come, take this land. You used your power, and took the land for them.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yi yila dunia ŋɔ ni na, amaa man yila alizanda ni na; yi nyɛla dunia ŋɔ niriba, amaa man pala dunia ŋɔ nira.
en: Jesus answered, You belong to this world here below, but I come from above. You are from this world, but I am not from this world.

dag: Di simdi ni tinim bɛn zaa bi niriba malila tɛhi yini ŋɔ tatabo, ka yi ni shɛb yi mali tɛhi kɔŋkɔba, Naawuni ni kahigi di yɛla wuhi ya.
en: All of us who have grown to be spiritually mature should think this way too. And if there is any of this that you dont agree with, God will make it clear to you.

dag: N ni lan labisi bɛ daazichi ti ba. N ni labisi Sɔdom mini di tiŋkpansi daazichi ti ba, ka labisi Samaria mini di tiŋkpansi daazichi ti ba. N ni labisi a gba maŋmaŋ daazichi ti a pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: Someday I will bless Sodom and Samaria and their nearby villages. I will also bless you, Jerusalem.

dag: Yi yi ti lo tɔbu chaŋ ni yi ti tuhi yi dimnima, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zaŋ ba niŋ yi nuu ni, ka yi gbahi ba daba.
en: You might fight against your enemies, and the Lord your God might let you defeat them and take them as captives.

dag: amaa Farisiinim mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba bɛn daa zaɣisi Naawuni ni zali ba shɛm, ka bɛn daa bi deei kom baptaizibu Jɔn sani.
en: But the Pharisees and experts in the law refused to accept Gods plan for themselves; they did not let John baptize them.

dag: Di saha ka wuntizɔriba maa ni ti garigi bɔh o, Ti Duuma, bɔ saha ka ti daa lee nya a ka kum mal a, ka ti ti a bindirigu? Bee ka kɔnyuri daa mal a, ka ti ti a kom?.
en: Then the ones who pleased the Lord will ask, When did we give you something to eat or drink?.

dag: Di saha ka Hɛzɛkia daa bahi ba noli ni bɛ malimi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa puuni nɛma niŋbu duri; ka bɛ daa mal li.
en: On the king's orders they prepared storerooms in the Temple area.

dag: Dinzuɣu gbibiya fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa zaa n ni zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, dina n-ni chɛ ka yi nya yaa n-chaŋ ti ʒini tiŋgbɔn shɛli yi ni yɛn du n-chaŋ ti ʒini maa ni.
en: Obey everything that I have commanded you today. Then you will be able to cross the river and occupy the land that you are about to enter.

dag: Tinzunnim kanna ti damdiri ma la tiŋa. Bɛ yi kul wum ka n yɛli shɛlikam, bɛ deerila n noli.
en: Foreigners grovel before me; after hearing about me, they obey me.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Ilaija ŋun nyɛ Tishibi nir la.
en: The LORDs word then came to Elijah from Tishbe.

dag: nti nya ka o nyaandol shɛb bi doli bɛ kali soli paɣiri bɛ nuhi ka diri bindirigu.
en: They noticed that some of his disciples were eating their food with hands that were ritually unclean—that is, they had not washed them in the way the Pharisees said people should. .

dag: Ya ka zabili mini naŋgbankpeeni ŋmɛbu zaa lee yina nti be yi sunsuuni? Pa yi niŋgbuŋ kɔre nyaɣisim bɔbu din be yi niŋgbuna yaɣa ni n-zabiri la ni ka di yina?.
en: What is the source of conflict among you? What is the source of your disputes? Dont they come from your cravings that are at war in your own lives?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, Ti ni niŋ a ni yɛl ti shɛlikam maa zaa, ka ni chaŋ a ni kul yɛl ti ni ti cham luɣ shɛlikam.
en: Then the people answered Joshua, We will do whatever you command us to do. We will go wherever you tell us to go.

dag: Yawɛ ti ti nasara. Chɛliya ka ti moli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni tum tuun shɛli ti ti ŋɔ Ziɔn.
en: The people of Israel said, Tell everyone in Zion! The Lord has taken revenge for what Babylon did to us.

dag: Asha zuliya mini bɛ daŋ niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Imna daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Imnanima; ka Ishivi daŋ niriba nyɛ Ishivinima; ka Bɛraya daŋ niriba nyɛ Bɛrayanima.
en: The tribe of Asher: the clans of Imnah, Ishvi, and Beriah.

dag: Zɛrubabɛl mini Nɛhimia saha la, Izraɛlnim zaa daa tirila pina dabisili kam ka bɛ mal li tiri yiliyiiniba mini dunɔguliba. Bɛ daa yihiri Lɛvinim tarili tiri ba, ka Lɛvinim maa mi daa yihiri Aduna daŋ tarili tiri ba.
en: In the days of Zerubbabel and of Nehemiah all Israel gave the daily portions for the singers and the gatekeepers. They also set aside the portion for the Levites, and the Levites set aside the portion for the Aaronites.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa bɔh o, Wula ka n lee yɛn tooi niŋ chaŋ? Dama Sool yi wum di yɛla o ni ku ma. Ka Yawɛ yɛl o, Bom naɣisaa chaŋ ti yɛli, N kamina ni n ti mali sara ti Yawɛ.
en: Samuel answered, If I do that, Saul will find out and have me killed. Take a calf with you, the Lord replied. Tell everyone that you've come to offer it as a sacrifice to me.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka ŋun daa ye binyɛr piɛlli, ka bɛ ni mali binshɛli sabira be kolibil ni baɣi o luɣili la daa ti labina ti yɛli, N tum a ni zali ma ni n tum shɛli maa.
en: Just then the man who was dressed in linen with the writing case at his side returned and said, Ive done just as you commanded.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa ti yi o nyaaŋa, ka chɛ ka o shia kasi suhu saɣim pam. Dinzuɣu ka o daa leei bɛ dima, ka ŋmaligi tuhi ba o toli.
en: But they turned against him and made his Holy Spirit very sad. So the Lord became their enemy and fought against them.

dag: Mani n-su mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri zaa mini naɣ shɛb bɛn be zoya tusatusa shɛm zuɣu la.
en: I already own all the animals in the forest. I own all the animals on a thousand hills.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, a daa deei bɛ suhigu. A nyɛla Naawuni ŋun daa chɛ bɛ taali, amaa a nyɛla ŋun daa darigi bɛ tibili bɛ tuumbiɛri zuɣu.
en: O Lord , our God, you answered your people; you showed them that you are a God who forgives, even though you punished them for their sins.

dag: Ka yi yi ti yihi li daɣiri ni naai, yin zaŋmiya naɣilaa ŋun ka daŋa mini biŋkɔbbaligu ni piɛlaa ŋun ka daŋa m-mali sara.
en: When you have finished doing that, take a young bull and a young ram, both of them without any defects.

dag: ka Jɛzibɛl ni daa ti kuri Yawɛ daanabinim la, ŋuna n-daa zaŋ anabinim kɔbiga m-pirigi ba pihinunu n-sɔɣi vokaba ni, ka tiri ba bindirigu mini kom.
en: One time when Jezebel was killing all the Lord s prophets, Obadiah hid prophets in two caves. He put prophets in one cave and prophets in another cave. Then he brought them food and water.

dag: Ka o kpambaliba daa kpuɣ o Mɛgido maa niŋ chɛchɛbuŋ ni n-ʒi o kuli Jɛrusalɛm nti sɔɣ o omaŋmaŋ siliga ni. Ka Judanim daa zaŋ Jɔsia bia Jɛhɔahaz n-leei naa zal o ba zaani.
en: His officials placed his body in a chariot and took it back to Jerusalem, where he was buried in the royal tombs. The people of Judah chose Josiah's son Joahaz and anointed him king.

dag: Amaa ka do so daa to piɛm ka di chaŋ ti nyɔɣi Izraɛl naa kurigu gbaɣino tuɣibu shee, ka ŋun to li maa bi mi; dinzuɣu ka o daa yɛl o chɛchɛbun duhira, N nya daŋa, ŋmaligim zaŋ ma yi tɔb gɔɣu ŋɔ ni.
en: However, during the fighting a soldier shot an arrow without even aiming, and it hit Ahab where two pieces of his armor joined. He shouted to his chariot driver, I've been hit! Get me out of here.

dag: Amaa Izraɛlnim tarili la ni, yihimiya bin yini bini pihinu kam puuni, di yi nyɛla ninsalinim bee niɣi bee bunsi bee piɛri bee buhi bee biŋkɔbiri balibu kam bɛn pahi n-zaŋ ba ti Lɛvinim bɛn su Yawɛ biɛhigu shee tuma fukumsi la.
en: And then, from the peoples half, take one thing for every items. This includes people, cattle, donkeys, sheep, or any other animal. Give that share to the Levites, because they take care of the Lord s Holy Tent.

dag: Yi daa zɔrila takɔbi, n ni chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi lu yi zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: and I'll send armies to attack you, just as you fear.

dag: ni Dibɔn ni Nɛbo ni Bɛtidibilateem.
en: Judgment has come to the towns of Dibon, Nebo, and Beth Diblathaim.

dag: o yi ti nya ka bia maa bi dol ti labina, o ni kpi; ka tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ ni chɛ ka ti ba ŋun nyɛ a dabili maa kpi ni zab piɛla ni suhugarigu.
en: that he will die if Benjamin doesn't come back with me.

dag: N Duuma Naawuni, vihim ma m-baŋ n suhu biɛhigu. Buɣisim ma baŋ n tɛha.
en: Examine me, O God, and know my mind; test me, and discover my thoughts.

dag: Juda naa Ahaz ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔtam bia, ka nyɛ Uzia yaaŋa la ʒiɛman ni ka Aram naa Rɛzin mini Izraɛl naa Pɛka ŋun daa nyɛ Rɛmalia bia la daa chaŋ ti liri Jɛrusalɛmnima, amaa ka daa bi tooi nyaŋ ba.
en: When King Ahaz, the son of Jotham and grandson of Uzziah, ruled Judah, war broke out. Rezin, king of Syria, and Pekah son of Remaliah, king of Israel, attacked Jerusalem, but were unable to capture it.

dag: amaa ŋun doli dunoli kpɛra, ŋuna n-nyɛ piɛgula.
en: The man who goes in through the gate is the shepherd of the sheep.

dag: Izraɛlnim karimbaani yi zahira, ka bɛ nini nya li. Izraɛlnim ni ti tuui lu bɛ tuumbiɛri maa ni. Ka Judanim gba ni ti tuui lu m-pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: Israels pride is a witness against them, so Israel and Ephraim will stumble in their sin. But Judah will also stumble with them.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ n neesim mini n tiliginsim; ka ŋuni ka n lee ni zɔra? Yawɛ n-nyɛ n nyɛvili birini; ka ŋuni ka n lee ni zɔra?.
en: You, Lord , are the light that keeps me safe. I am not afraid of anyone. You protect me, and I have no fears.

dag: Tiŋgbɔŋ yi be ka soli wuhibu ka di ni, di lurimi, amaa saawarimaaniba ni galisi luɣ shɛli, nimaani ka niriba be ni alaafee.
en: Without guidance, a people will fall, but there is victory with many counselors.

dag: Bɛn mali yɛm suhu bi yiɣisiri yomyom, ka bɛ ni bi zaŋdi so taali zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ nyari jilima.
en: If you are sensible, you will control your temper. When someone wrongs you, it is a great virtue to ignore it.

dag: Yawɛ zɔbu n-nyɛ baŋsim piligu, jɛra bɛn lihi ʒiɛmla yɛm mini wuhibu.
en: Knowledge begins with fear and respect for the Lord , but stubborn fools hate wisdom and refuse to learn.

dag: Amaa di zaɣisi n zalikpana la mini n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la, ka leei din bie n-gari zuliya shɛŋa mini tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa din gil li zaa ka zaɣisi n zalikpana la, ka bi doli n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la.
en: The people rebelled against my commands. They were worse than any of the other nations! They broke more of my laws than any of the people in the countries around them. They refused to listen to my commands. They did not obey my laws.

dag: A nina be kasi ni di lihi zaɣ biɛɣu, ka a ku tooi lihiri zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu. Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a lihiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka yɛda, ka shini ka ninvuɣ biɛri kuri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ wuntizɔriba gari ba?.
en: Your eyes are too pure to look on evil; you are unable to look at disaster. Why would you look at the treacherous or keep silent when the wicked swallows one who is more righteous?.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋ ania zahimbu puuni mal alibarika, dama zahimbu maa yi buɣis o ka o nyaŋ li, o ni ti nya laara din nyɛ nyɛvil shɛli Naawuni ni zaŋ lo bɛn yur o alikauli la.
en: Those who stand firm during testing are blessed. They are tried and true. They will receive the life God has promised to those who love him as their reward.

dag: Miri ka a di jɛrigu alizama, o ni lihi ʒiɛm a yɛm yɛtɔɣa maa.
en: Dont try to teach fools. They will make fun of your wise words.

dag: Mira! Di lan tum tuumbiɛri; di zuɣu ka bɛ zaŋ wahala zahim a maa.
en: Job, dont let your suffering cause you to choose evil. Be careful not to do wrong.

dag: ni m ba daa yɛli ma, N saɣi kpibu; ka n yi ti kani, nyin zaŋm ma ti sɔɣi n ni daa gbi sil shɛli Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni ni bɛ ti zaŋ ma sɔɣi di ni la puuni; ka daa chɛ ka m-po di pɔri. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, n-suhir o ni o chɛ ka n chaŋ ti sɔɣi m ba ka labina.
en: Just before my father died, he made me promise to bury him in his burial cave in Canaan. If the king will give me permission to go, I will come back here.

dag: Ka bia maa ma maa daa yɛli Ilaisha, Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ mini nyin ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, n ku chaŋ ka chɛ a. Ka Ilaisha daa yiɣisi dol o.
en: The woman said to Elisha, I swear by my loyalty to the living Lord and to you that I will not leave you! So the two of them started back together.

dag: Dinzuɣu doli ninvuɣ suma soli, ka doli wuntizɔriba soli.
en: So you must follow the example of good people and live a righteous life.

dag: Zuŋɔ gba n fabila maa lan kɔŋla tim. Di mini n ŋuhibu ŋɔ zaa yoli, Naawuni na kul pahiri ma la biɛrim.
en: Today I complain bitterly, because God has been cruel and made me suffer.

dag: N suhuyiɣisili maa puuni ka n daa no m-bɔribɔri zuliya kam niriba, ka bɛ ʒim yi n-do tiŋgban ni.
en: In my anger I trampled down the nations. I punished them in anger and spilled their blood on the ground.

dag: ka din pahi pinaayi daa gbaai Hashabia min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: the twelfth to Hashabiah, his family, and his relatives.

dag: ka labina ti yɛli Jɔshua, Ainim bi yaɣ lala. Lala zuɣu di chɛ ka tɔbbihi maa zaa chaŋ, amaa chɛ ka tɔbbihi tusaayi bee tusaata laasabu chaŋ.
en: they reported back to Joshua: There is no need for everyone to attack Ai. Send only about two or three thousand men. Don't send the whole army up there to fight; it is not a large city.

dag: Ka chanya yɛtɔɣ yoya mini yɛtɔɣ chɔɣima tɔɣisibu ni asahi kpɛma niŋbu. Di zaa ŋɔ shɛli bi simdi niŋbu, amaa din simdi niŋbu nyɛla wumpaɣibo.
en: Obscene language, silly talk, or vulgar jokes arent acceptable for believers. Instead, there should be thanksgiving.

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa di Izraɛl nam ka di ti paai yuun pisaayika saha shɛli, ka Abija mi daa leei Juda naa.
en: Abijah became king of Judah in Jeroboam's eighteenth year as king of Israel.

dag: Bɛ zuɣu chɛ ka niriba ni sɔhirimi, ka sokam ninni biɛhigu taɣira.
en: The very sight of them is frightening.

dag: Jɛrusalɛmnima, deemiya saɣisigu, di yi pa lala n ni je suli ŋ-ŋmaligi ka chɛn ya, ka chɛ ka yi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zani dabari, ka so ku lan be di ni.
en: Hear me out, Jerusalem, or else Ill turn away from you and reduce you to ruins, a land unfit to live in.

dag: A ni ti lula palɔni, dama man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: They will fall dead in the open field. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, wain booriba kpɛm la daa tam Yisifu yɛla ka bi teeg o yɛla.
en: But the wine server did not remember to help Joseph. He said nothing about him to Pharaoh. The wine server forgot about Joseph.

dag: N suhu je yi goli pala churi mini yi ni zali chu shɛŋa puhibu la. Di leela ʒitibisili n sani, di ʒibu wum ma pam.
en: I hate your New Moon Festivals and holy days; they are a burden that I am tired of bearing.

dag: Ka Ijipti naa daa bi lan yi o ya kana, dama Babilɔn naa daa deeg o ni su tiŋgban shɛli zaa din zaŋ Ijipti kulibɔŋ shee hal ti paai Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni.
en: King Nebuchadnezzar defeated King Neco of Egypt and took control of his land from the Egyptian Gorge all the way north to the Euphrates River. So Neco never invaded Judah again.

dag: O ti zaŋm o nuu pa bua maa zuɣu ni, ka kɔrig o luɣ shɛli bɛ ni kɔriti biŋkɔb shɛb bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim Yawɛ san la, ka di leei alahichi sanyoo sara maligu.
en: The ruler must put his hand on the goats head and kill the goat at the place where they kill the burnt offering before the Lord . The goat is a sin offering.

dag: Ka Yaakubu bidib shɛb bɛn kpalim daa chaŋ ti kpe tiŋ maa puuni n-di nɛma bɛ tizɔpaɣ maa zuɣu.
en: When Jacobs other sons discovered the dead, they looted the city that had defiled their sister.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ʒe Gomna Pailɛt tooni, ka Gomna Pailɛt maa bɔh o, A shiri nyɛla Yɛhudianim naa? Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, A ni yɛli shɛm maa n-nyɛ li.
en: Jesus was brought before the governor. The governor said, Are you the king of the Jews? Jesus replied, Thats what you say.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu ka n kuhira, ka nintam zɔri n ninni maa; dama ŋun yɛn maai n suhu be katiŋa. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun yɛn ti ma suhukpeeni. Bɛ zaɣisi m bihi; dama n dim nyaŋ ma.
en: Because of this, I mourn, and tears flood my eyes. No one is here to comfort or to encourage me; we have lost the war— my people are suffering.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa daa chaŋ fɔŋ maa ni nti shiri nya Yisa ni yɛli ba shɛm maa zaa, ka mali Yaɣigari Chuɣu maa bindirigu dibu shili.
en: So the followers left and went into the city. Everything happened the way Jesus said. So the followers prepared the Passover meal.

dag: A ni sɔɣi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni Zallakudura Naa sani ka zaŋ o leeg a biɛhigu shee la zuɣu.
en: You trust in the Lord for protection. You have made God Most High your place of safety.

dag: Di saha ka Ibrahimma daa yɛli Abimilɛk o tumtumdiba ni daa fa ŋun Ibrahimma kɔbil shɛl la yɛla.
en: One day, Abraham told Abimelech, Some of your servants have taken over one of my wells.

dag: Di saha ka o daa kpe ni o ti mali maligu, ka mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la. Jɛhu daa zaŋla ninvuɣ pihinii zali samban ni di saha maa ka yɛli ba, Ŋun chɛ ka n ni zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb niŋ yi nuu ni ŋɔ ni so zo n-tiligi, dilan ni kɔŋ o nyɛvili.
en: Then he and Jonadab went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings to Baal. He had stationed eighty men outside the temple and had instructed them: You are to kill all these people; anyone who lets one of them escape will pay for it with his life.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Bom tulaale shɛŋa din nyom viɛla, ka nyɛ bɛ ni booni shɛŋa stakiti mini onika ni galibanom ni tulaale zim shɛli bɛ ni booni firanki tulaale la alali din nyom viɛla.
en: The LORD said to Moses: Take an equal amount of each of these spices: gum resin, onycha, galbanum, and pure frankincense.

dag: Kootaali tandɔri n-daa kul yɛrigi Siddim vinvamli maa ni; ka Sɔdom mini Gomɔra nanim la daa ŋmaligi guuri ka bɛ ni shɛb faai lu kootaali tandɔri maa ni, ka bɛn kpalim mi zo nti du zoli.
en: There were many holes filled with tar in the Valley of Siddim. When the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah and their armies ran away, some of the soldiers fell into these holes, but the others ran away to the mountains.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛlnim maa, Nyamiya, Yawɛ bolila Uri bia Bɛzalɛl ŋun nyɛ Hur yaaŋa ka nyɛ Juda zuliya ni nir la.
en: Moses said to the people of Israel: The Lord has chosen Bezalel of the Judah tribe.

dag: Ti ni ti wum wumpaɣibo yila din tibigiri Wuntialan ŋɔ dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam zaa. Amaa ka n yɛli, Mbusim paai ma. N lan ka tahima, dama bilikɔɣinim kul tumdila bɛ bilikɔnsi tuma pahira.
en: We hear songs of praise for God from every place on earth. They praise the God who does what is right. But I say, Enough! I have had enough. What I see is terrible. Traitors are turning against people and hurting them.

dag: Ka Yisa daa duh o zuɣu n-nya ka salo pam kani o sanna, ka o naanyi bɔhi Filip, Ya polo ka ti lee yɛn nya bindirigu n-da n-ti niriba ŋɔ zaa ka bɛ di n-tiɣi.
en: Jesus looked up and saw a crowd of people coming toward him. He said to Philip, Where can we buy enough bread for all these people to eat.

dag: ni Kɛdɛshi ni Ɛdirɛi ni Ɛnhazɔr.
en: Kedesh, Edrei, Enhazor.

dag: Lihimi n nahiŋgu mini n wahala ŋɔ, ka chɛ n daalahichi zaa.
en: Look at my trials and troubles. Forgive me for all the sins I have done.

dag: Ka Kalɛb daa ŋme n-kari Anaki bidibis ata bɛn daa nyɛ: Shɛshai mini Ahiman ni Talimai bɛn daa nyɛ ŋun Anaki zuliya la bahi.
en: Caleb drove the descendants of Anak out of the city—the clans of Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.

dag: Man Jɔn kpahiri ŋunkam wum anabitali yɛligu din be litaafi ŋɔ ni zuɣu ni: Ŋunkam pahi shɛli di ni, Naawuni ni zaŋ alɔbo balibu kam din sab litaafi ŋɔ ni la m-pah o tibidarigibo zuɣu;.
en: I, John, solemnly warn everyone who hears the prophetic words of this book: if any add anything to them, God will add to their punishment the plagues described in this book.

dag: Niriba ni ti yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, wuntizɔriba mali laara. Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni ŋun kariti dunianim saria shiri beni.
en: Then people will say, Good people really are rewarded. Yes, there is a God judging the world.

dag: Ka o daa yɛl o, Pumpɔŋɔ, cham ti nya a biɛyanim maa mini biŋkɔbiri maa mal alaafee, ka labina ti yɛli ma. Di saha ka o daa tim o ka o yi Hiburɔn vinvamli ni chaŋ Shɛkɛm.
en: Jacob said to him, Go! Find out how your brothers are and how the flock is, and report back to me. So Jacob sent him from the Hebron Valley. When he approached Shechem.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa lan zaŋ o nuhi shihi o nina maa; ka zom maa lan neeg o nina lihi yaha, ka o nina maa dii neei zaa, ka o nyari binshɛɣukam viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Once again Jesus placed his hands on the man's eyes, and this time the man stared. His eyes were healed, and he saw everything clearly.

dag: O ni daa na kul tɛhiri di yɛla maa, ka ti Duuma malaika ka o sanna zahindi ni nti yɛl o, Nyin Yisifu ŋun nyɛ Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ, di zɔri dabiɛm ni a chɛ ka bɛ kulisi Mariama a yiŋ na, dama o ni mali pu shɛli maa yila Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni na.
en: But after Joseph thought about this, an angel from the Lord came to him in a dream. The angel said, Joseph, son of David, dont be afraid to accept Mary to be your wife. The baby inside her is from the Holy Spirit.

dag: ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba daa bɔri so shɛli bɛ ni yɛn doli ku Yisa, dama bɛ daa zɔrila niriba.
en: The chief priests and the teachers of the Law were afraid of the people, and so they were trying to find a way of putting Jesus to death secretly.

dag: Ŋuni n-daa lee taɣi teeku kom zali saha shɛli di ni daa tahi yi tiŋgbani puuni la na?.
en: Who closed the flood gates as the sea gushed from the womb?.

dag: Ka o daa kab dari pa bimbin maa zuɣu, ka ŋmahiŋmahi naɣilaa maa nimdi pa dari maa zuɣu, ka yɛli ba, Niŋmiya kom pali koyuya anahi n-kpaai li tɛli sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim ŋɔ mini dari maa.
en: Then Elijah put the wood on the altar. He cut the bull into pieces and laid the pieces on the wood.

dag: O daa lan mali pipih anahi ka di ŋmani alimɔnd pum mini di bintira kɔtomsi ni tipuma kɔtomsi n-zaŋ li tam firilatamdigu maa maŋmaŋ zuɣu.
en: The shaft of the lampstand had four more flowers. They were also made like almond flowers with buds and petals.

dag: O kuhi boli zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani ni di di o shɛhira, ka o kar o niriba saria.
en: God calls out to the skies above and to the earth in order to judge his people.

dag: N kukoli daa niŋla kukol bila ka bi kpɛma, ka n daa bamdi kaman ŋmani la. N daa lihila zuɣusaa hal ka n nina ti fulim. N Duuma, yihim ma muɣisigu ŋɔ ni.
en: Like a swallow I chirp; I moan like a dove. My eyes have grown weary looking to heaven. Lord, Im overwhelmed; support me.

dag: Ka bɛ kul maani bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la bɛ ni nyɔr li buɣim bimbin shɛli zuɣu la n-tiri Yawɛ asiba mini zaawuni sahakam kaman di ni sabi Yawɛ fukumsi zaligu shɛl o ni daa zaŋ ti Izraɛlnim la puuni shɛm.
en: Every morning and evening they were to burn sacrifices whole on the altar in accordance with what was written in the Law which the Lord gave to Israel.

dag: Niŋgbuŋ pala yaɣ yini ko, amaa di nyɛla yaɣ bɔbili.
en: For the body itself is not made up of only one part, but of many parts.

dag: Di daa nyɛla Yawɛ ni yuri ya, ka gbib o ni daa po yi yaannim pɔri shɛl la zuɣu ka ŋun Yawɛ daa zaŋ o nuu din mali kpiɔŋ n yihi ya dabitim ni, ka fan ya Ijipti naa Firawuna nuu ni bahi maa.
en: but the Lord chose you because he loves you and because he had made a promise to your ancestors. Then with his mighty arm, he rescued you from the king of Egypt, who had made you his slaves.

dag: Ka Sool min o niriba maa daa ti paai Hachila zolɔŋni zaŋ labi Jɛshimɔn wulimpuhili polo nti ti bɛ suɣa do nimaani palli noli. Amaa Dauda daa na bela mɔɣu maa ni. O ni daa ti wum ni Sool kar o naba na mɔɣu maa ni.
en: Saul set up camp on Mount Hachilah, which is across the road from Jeshimon. But David was hiding out in the desert. When David heard that Saul was following him.

dag: Amaa ka Iso daa guuina ti tuh o soli m-bɔb gbaag o n-zaŋ o zuɣu ti pa o nyingol zuɣu m-mɔɣis o kpariŋ, ka bɛ zaa dii kuhira.
en: But Esau ran toward Jacob and hugged and kissed him. Then the two brothers started crying.

dag: Alibarika ni ti be yi ni saha shɛli yi yi ti yi, ka alibarika ti lan be yi ni saha shɛli yi yi ti lab kpɛna.
en: He will bless you at all times in everything you do.

dag: O ni daa ti wum ni Yisa Nazarɛt nira n-gariti maa ka o dii gbaai kuhiri yɛra, Yisa, nyin ŋun nyɛ Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ, zom ma nambɔɣu.
en: When he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to shout, Jesus! Son of David! Have mercy on me.

dag: Ka Pita daa yaag o noli yɛli ba, Pumpɔŋɔ m baŋya ni Naawuni shiri bi gaŋdi niriba;.
en: Peter began to speak: I really understand now that God does not consider some people to be better than others.

dag: Dama n ni daa yi Mɛsopoteemia labirina saha shɛli, ka Reechɛl daa kpi sol ni Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka nimaani mini Ɛfirat daa na wɔɣa. Ka n daa sɔɣ o Ɛfirat soli maa ni ; ka di daa ti ma suhugarigu pam.
en: I am doing this because of your mother Rachel. To my great sorrow she died in the land of Canaan, not far from Ephrath, as I was returning from Mesopotamia. I buried her there beside the road to Ephrath.

dag: N ni chɛ ka n zaŋsim be jɛmbu duu ŋɔ ni, ka n gbilisiri tibili wumdi bɛ ni yɛn suhiri suhigu shɛli kpe ŋɔ.
en: From now on my eyes will be open and my ears will pay attention to the prayers offered in this place.

dag: Dinzuɣu nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, n suhir a, tiligim ti o nuu ni, ka di chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam nanim baŋ ni nyin Yawɛ kɔŋko n-nyɛ Naawuni.
en: Now, Lord our God, rescue us from the Assyrians, so that all the nations of the world will know that only you, O Lord , are God.

dag: Izraɛlnima, yɛlimiya, M bilim ni ka bɛ pun nahindi ma pam;.
en: From youth, people have constantly attacked me— let Israel now repeat!.

dag: di saha yi ni ti boli ma, amaa ka n ku garigi ya. Yi ni ti bo ma ni nimmoo, amaa ka ku nya ma.
en: Then you will call for wisdom, but I will not answer. You may look for me everywhere, but you will not find me.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa bi bɔri wuntaŋ bee goli ni di ne di ni, dama Naawuni jilima n-nyɛ di neesim, ka Piɛbil maa mi nyɛ di firila.
en: The city did not need the sun or the moon to shine on it. The glory of God gave the city light. The Lamb was the citys lamp.

dag: N yɛri ya mi ni di ni sab shɛm Naawuni Kundi ni n-yɛli ni bɛ kali ma pahila tuumbiɛrinim ni la ni bahi niŋ pali m bebu ni; dama di kpala talahi ni di ni sabi n yɛla shɛm maa niŋ pali.
en: The Scriptures say, He was considered a criminal. Isaiah : This Scripture must happen. It was written about me, and it is happening now.

dag: bee so yi tum alahichi ka baŋ ni o tum taali, di simdi ka o labis o ni zu shɛli bee o ni fa shɛli bee bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛli puh o zalibu maa bee o ni pihi binshɛli.
en: at that point, once you have sinned and become guilty of sin, you must return the property you took by robbery or fraud, or the deposit that was left with you for safekeeping, or the lost property that you found.

dag: Bɛ daa lo nanim nuhi n-zaŋ ba yili zuɣusaa. Bɛ bi tiri kpamba jilima.
en: Officials have been hung up by their hands; elders have been shown no respect.

dag: N daa na ʒi m-mɔŋ nandaamba bɛ ni bɔri shɛli bee n-chɛ ka pakoli kɔŋ tahima.
en: I have never refused to help the poor. I always gave widows what they needed.

dag: Ka a zaŋ Lɛvinim maa na ti zali laɣiŋgu suɣili la tooni, ka laɣim Izraɛlnim zaa na.
en: You will bring the Levites before the meeting tent and gather the entire Israelite community.

dag: Ti yi ti nya saɣisigu, di saha maa di bemi kaman din to ka pa din tiri suhupiɛlli; amaa di nyaaŋa bɛn deei saɣisigu tibidarigibo puuni ti nyari suhudoo din nyɛ wuntia biɛhigu laara.
en: When we are punished, it seems to us at the time something to make us sad, not glad. Later, however, those who have been disciplined by such punishment reap the peaceful reward of a righteous life.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ daba la, deemiya yi duumanim noya ka luri ba sizuura zaa, ka di pala bɛn niŋdi nirilim ka mali biɛribaalimtali la kɔŋko, amaa zaŋ tabili bɛn mali hal biɛɣu la gba.
en: Household slaves, submit by accepting the authority of your masters with all respect. Do this not only to good and kind masters but also to those who are harsh.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti baptaizibu deebu zuɣu wuhiya ni ti pahila o zuɣu kpi ka bɛ sɔɣ ti, ka di bemi kaman Masia ni daa neei kum ni ti Ba Naawuni jilima yiko zuɣu shɛm la, lala zuɣu ka ti gba yipa mali nyɛvili palli biɛhigu.
en: By our baptism, then, we were buried with him and shared his death, in order that, just as Christ was raised from death by the glorious power of the Father, so also we might live a new life.

dag: O zaŋla dunia ŋɔ niŋ ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni; o pɔbila di sariakaritiba nina; di yi pala ŋuna, ka ŋuni?.
en: And who else but God blindfolds the judges, then lets the wicked take over the earth?.

dag: Ka o daa mali binyila tam di naŋgbani tarisi bunahi zuɣu, ka di mini di binyila maa zaa nyɛ zaɣ yini, ka o daa niŋ daanya niŋ li.
en: with each of its four corners sticking up like the horn of a bull, and it was completely covered with bronze.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika daa ti puhi yi o zuɣu buɣim niɛm puuni tutuɣu ni, ka Musa daa lihi nya ka buɣim diri tutuɣu ni, amaa ka lee bi diri tutuɣu maa.
en: There the angel of the Lord appeared to him as a flame coming from the middle of a bush. Moses saw that the bush was on fire but that it was not burning up.

dag: N ni chɛ ka dabiɛm gbaai yi mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛnkam yɛn tuhi, ka bɛ birim, ka chɛ ka yi dimnim ŋmaligi guui ka chɛn ya.
en: I will terrify those nations and make your enemies so confused that they will run from you.

dag: N nya bɛ tuma, amaa n ni tib ba. N ni wuhi ba soli, ka sɔŋ ba, ka maai bɛn be fabila ni suhuri.
en: I have seen how they acted, but I will heal them. I will lead them and help them, and I will comfort those who mourn.

dag: Amaa saŋkpambil maa yi kul kpalim bela luɣ yini, ka bi yɛligi, di nyɛla bintɔrili maa wuliɛɣu m-bala, ka di simdi ka maligumaana maa yɛli ni o nyɛla ŋun ka daɣiri ni.
en: But if the shiny spot remains where it was and does not spread, it is just a scar from the boil. The priest will declare the person clean.

dag: Mɛrari bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Mahili mini Libini ni Shimɛi ni Yuza.
en: These are the descendants of Merari from generation to generation: Mahli, Libni, Shimei, Uzzah.

dag: Di yi pa lala, o na kpee maa yi ti na be katiŋ kanna o ni tim ti balim o ni o chɛ ka bɛ ku zabili maa.
en: If he thinks he cannot defeat the other king, he will send some men to ask for peace while that kings army is still far away.

dag: Yawɛ, niŋm mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ zaɣ viɛlli kaman a yɛligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: I am your servant, Lord , and you have kept your promise to treat me with kindness.

dag: M-pahi, Uzia daa lan mali tɔbbihi bɛn ni tooi chaŋ tɔbu, ka bɛ piripiri ba ka bɛ kalinli dolila Hanania ŋun daa nyɛ naa sapashin kpɛm la ni daa wuhi Jɛiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la mini Maasɛya ŋun daa nyɛ naa sapashin kpamba ni yino la shɛm.
en: He had a large army ready for battle. Its records were kept by his secretaries Jeiel and Maaseiah under the supervision of Hananiah, a member of the king's staff.

dag: Ka o yɛla daa dii moli gili Galili tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: Right away the news about him spread throughout the entire region of Galilee.

dag: ka yi yi zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ fukumsi zalikpana maa, ka ŋmaligi ka chɛ n ni zaani ya ni yi doli so shɛli zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka chaŋ ti jɛmdi wun shɛŋa yi ni bi mi, din mi n-nyɛ noli dibu maa.
en: But if you disobey him and worship those gods that have never done anything for you, the Lord will put a curse on you.

dag: Amaa yi yi bi chɛri niriba taali paŋdi ba, yi Ba Naawuni gba ku chɛ yi taali paŋ ya.
en: But if you dont forgive others, neither will your Father forgive your sins.

dag: N zɔri dolila a zaligunim soli, dama a yɛligi m baŋsim.
en: I will eagerly obey your commands, because you will give me more understanding.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔhi taba, O ni di tɔɣisiri ti yɛtɔɣa sol ni ka kahigiri Naawuni litaafinim wuhiri ti la, di di bi kpe ti suhuri ni pam.
en: They said to each other, When he talked with us along the road and explained the Scriptures to us, didn't it warm our hearts.

dag: Naa Ahasivɛrɔs yuli ka Mɔdɛkai daa zaŋ sab gbana maa, ka zaŋ ŋun naa nintua dalinli dihi di zuɣu n-zaŋ li tim wɔribariba bɛn daa bari nayili wɔrikpaa ni wɔr shɛb bɛn zɔri pam, ka bɛ zaŋ li tahi.
en: They were written in the name of King Xerxes and sealed with his ring. Then they were taken by messengers who rode the king's finest and fastest horses.

dag: Bɛ ni daa deei Jɛhu gbaŋ maa, ka bɛ gbahi naa bidibisi pisopɔin maa n-ku ba, ka ŋmahi bɛ zuɣuri niŋ piɛri ni n-zaŋ li tahi Jɛziriil ti ti o.
en: When the leaders of the city received the letter, they took the kings sons and killed all of them. Then the leaders put the heads of the kings sons in baskets and sent the baskets to Jehu at Jezreel.

dag: Ka o daa kar o dimnim maa bahi; ka chɛ ka bɛ di vi din ku naai.
en: God scattered his enemies and made them ashamed forever.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zaŋ ya mi tahiri tiŋgbɔn viɛlli ni, tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali kulibɔna din kom zɔri mini kɔbil nina ni tiŋgbani puuni kom din puhiri yiri vinvama ni mini daboya ni na;.
en: The Lord your God is bringing you into a fertile land—a land that has rivers and springs, and underground streams gushing out into the valleys and hills;.

dag: Dina n-nyɛ: Di niŋ kamaata ni cheechi toondana malila biɛrisuŋ; di simdi ni o malila paɣ yino; ka di mi simdi ni o bihi nyɛla yɛdaniŋdiba, ka pa ni niriba ni ni tooi galim shɛba bɛ ni bi gbaari bɛmaŋ shɛm bee bɛ tipawumli zuɣu.
en: Elders should be without fault. They should be faithful to their spouse, and have faithful children who cant be accused of self-indulgence or rebelliousness.

dag: dɔbba bɛn zaa be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka paai yuun pisi bee n-gar lala, ka nyɛ bɛn ni tooi chaŋ tɔbu ni. A mini Aduna sabimi bɛ yuya kaman bɛ daŋ kam ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: You and Aaron must count the men of Israel who are years old or older. List them by their divisions.

dag: Ʒiɛman yini niriba ni paɣ a a ni tum shɛm zuɣu ʒiɛman shɛli niriba sani, ka yɛl a yiko tuma yɛla.
en: One generation will praise your works to the next one, proclaiming your mighty acts.

dag: Dinzuɣu Pumpɔŋɔ Izraɛlnima, bɔ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ lee bɔri yi sani? Lumiyala ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sizuura, ka dol o soya zaa ka yur o ka jɛmdi ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yi suhuri zaa ni yi shihi zaa.
en: Now, Israelites, listen! What does the Lord your God really want from you? The Lord your God wants you to respect him and do what he says. He wants you to love him and to serve the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

dag: Shɛla ni daa dɔɣi Ɛba maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinahinaata. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: after that, he lived another years and had other children.

dag: Ka o daa kpuɣi Ilaija binyɛr shɛli din daa yi o sani luna n-lab ti zani Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili naŋgbaŋgbiriŋ.
en: Elijahs coat had fallen to the ground, so Elisha picked it up. He went back and stood at the edge of the Jordan River.

dag: Naawuni Shia Kasi ni daa tim ba maa bɛ daa chaŋla Sɛlusia nti yi ni kpe ŋariŋ chaŋ Saipurus teeku kom ni do n-gili tiŋgban shɛl la.
en: Having been sent by the Holy Spirit, Barnabas and Saul went to Seleucia and sailed from there to the island of Cyprus.

dag: Bɛ bɔbindimi gindi liɣa, ka ka firila, ka o chɛ ka bɛ ʒiɛhiri gindi kaman nir ni nyu dam kul la.
en: They feel their way in the dark without light; he makes them stumble like drunks.

dag: Ka Ada daa dɔɣi Jabal. Ŋuna n-daa nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tanti suɣa ni ka guli niɣ la yaba.
en: Adah gave birth to Jabal. Jabal was the father of people who live in tents and earn their living by keeping cattle.

dag: Dama n suhu bi doya, ka n lan ka alaafee. M bi nyari nyee vuhira, amaa ka muɣisigu n-kul paari ma.
en: I have no peace, no rest, and my troubles never end.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa ti taai duŋ niŋ a n-zaɣis a noli; ka daa lɛb bɛ nyaaŋa bir a fukumsi zaligu la. Bɛ daa ku a daanabinim shɛb bɛn kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni din ni chɛ ka bɛ lab a sanna la. Bɛ daa mo a pam.
en: And then they turned against you. They threw away your teachings. They killed your prophets. Those prophets warned the people. They tried to bring them back to you. But our ancestors said terrible things against you.

dag: Ŋuna ŋun me o dufahira zali zuɣusaa, ka zali di tanzahi dunia ni ŋɔ; ŋuna n-zaŋdi teeku kom n-kpaari li bahiri tiŋgban ni na. O yuli m-booni Yawɛ.
en: The Lord builds his home in the heavens, and over the earth he puts the dome of the sky. He calls for the waters of the sea and pours them out on the earth. His name is the Lord !.

dag: Daadamnim zaa tumdila bɛ tuma zaa dibu zuɣu, amaa bɛ na ʒi n-di n-tiɣi.
en: We struggle just to have enough to eat, but we are never satisfied.

dag: Amaa n niriba dimnim yi bɔri ni n tiligi ba, dindina bɛn niŋmi sandaani niŋ ma, Iin, bɛn niŋmi sandaani niŋ ma.
en: Yet if the vineyard depends on me for protection, it will become my friend and be at peace with me.

dag: Miriya ka yi jɛm wun so yaha; miriya ka yi gbani n-jɛm tinzunnim wuni.
en: Don't worship foreign gods or bow down to gods you know nothing about.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ salinim zaa, yomiya suhupiɛlli vuri paɣi Naawuni.
en: Praise God with shouts of joy, all people!.

dag: Man Pool ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia tumo Naawuni yubu puuni la n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn be Ɛfɛsus ka nyɛ bɛn ʒe yim Yisa Masia san la.
en: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus. To God's people who live in Ephesus and are faithful followers of Christ Jesus.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa yɛli Yawɛ malaika so ŋun daa ʒe tuturi ni maa, Ti chaŋ gili dunia zaa n-nya ka dunianim zaa malila suhudoo.
en: Then the riders spoke to the Lord 's angel, who was standing among the myrtle trees, and they said, We have gone everywhere and have discovered that the whole world is at peace.

dag: Biliha ŋun daa nyɛ Leeban ni daa zaŋ so ti o bipuɣiŋga Reechɛl la ni daa dɔɣi bidib shɛb ti Yaakubu m-bala; ka bɛ zaa kalinli daa nyɛla niriba ayopɔin.
en: These seven are the descendants of Jacob by Bilhah, the slave woman whom Laban gave to his daughter Rachel.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa yɛli ba, Yɛlimiya Dauda, Naa bi bɔri paɣibɔr liɣiri a sani n-naɣi pahila Filistianim yokol gbana kɔbiga din ni chɛ ka ŋun naa bɔh o dimnim maa biɛri. Sool daa tɛhiya ni lala ni chɛ ka Filistianim maa ku Dauda.
en: and Saul ordered them to tell David: All the king wants from you as payment for the bride are the foreskins of a hundred dead Philistines, as revenge on his enemies.

dag: Yi na bi baŋ? Yi na ʒi n-wum? Yawɛ n-kul nyɛ kurimbuni Naawuni. Ŋuna n-daa nam dunia ŋɔ zaa. Di bi wumd o, o mi bi gbarigira. So mi ku tooi baŋ o tɛha.
en: Don't you know? Haven't you heard? The Lord is the everlasting God; he created all the world. He never grows tired or weary. No one understands his thoughts.

dag: Chɛ ka ti mini ya kpuɣiri tab bihi niŋdi ti paɣiba. Zaŋmiya yi bipuɣinsi tiri ti, ka kpuɣimi ti gba bipuɣinsi niŋdi yi paɣiba.
en: This marriage will show we have a special agreement. Then our men can marry your women, and your men can marry our women.

dag: Ka Ribɛka daa kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi nya Yisahaku, ka sheei laakum zuɣu zani.
en: Rebekah also looked and saw Isaac. Then she jumped down from the camel.

dag: N ni mali n yuli din galisi maa ka di niŋ kasi, n yu shɛli zuliya shɛb ni daa saɣim ka yi gba daa saɣim li bɛ sani la. Ka n yi kahigi n kasitali yi sani bɛ ninni, bɛ ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: and to show foreign nations that I am holy. Then they will know that I am the Lord God. I have spoken.

dag: M bi zɔri ninvuɣ tuhi piapia bɛn ʒe n-gili n luɣilikam la.
en: I wont be afraid of thousands of people surrounding me on all sides.

dag: Ka so yi zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga kɔhi ka o leei dabili, di bi simdi ka o ti chaŋ kaman dɔbba ni chani shɛm.
en: If a man sells his daughter as a slave, she is not to be set free, as male slaves are.

dag: Ka n yɛli, N ni du abie tia maa, n-gbaai di wula gbibi. N suhigu nyɛla a biha kul be kaman wain wala yila la, ka a vuhim ʒiɛɣu ŋmani apil nyom.
en: I would love to climb that tree and take hold of its branches. May your breasts be like clusters of grapes and your fragrance like apples.

dag: Dinzuɣu di niŋ kamaata ni ti gbibi ti ni daa pun wum yɛlimaŋ shɛŋa la viɛnyɛliŋga din ni chɛ ka binshɛɣu ti ku ʒi ti chaŋ ka chɛ li.
en: This is why its necessary for us to pay more attention to what we have heard, or else we may drift away from it.

dag: Bɛ daa malila dapaɣa ayi niŋ Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa nyaaŋa lɔris ayi la ni.
en: They made two additional boards for the dwellings rear corners.

dag: Dama o ʒiɛm Yawɛ yɛligu ka tum birig o zaligu, ka di simdi ni bɛ shiri ku dilana, ka o daalahichi ʒi o zuɣu.
en: They thought the Lord s word was not important, so they broke his commands. That is why they must be separated from their people—they must bear the responsibility for their guilt.

dag: Ti Duuma ni yihi Ziɔn paɣiba daɣiri ni, ka zaŋ saria karibu mini buɣim paɣi ʒim din yi n-do Jɛrusalɛm puuni la ka di yi.
en: By his power the Lord will judge and purify the nation and wash away the guilt of Jerusalem and the blood that has been shed there.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ poya yɛli, Biɛhiŋ kani, n ni chɛ ka tɔbbihi pali a ni kaman tol la. Bɛ ni ti ŋme nasara dibu kuŋa m-bah a zuɣu.
en: I, the Lord All-Powerful, swear by my own life that enemy soldiers will fill your streets like a swarm of locusts. They will shout and celebrate their victory.

dag: Ti Duuma Zallakudura Naa ŋun be, ka daa pun be, ka ni ti kana la yɛliya: N nyɛla Alfa mini Omega. Di gbinni nyɛla ŋun nyɛ piligu ni bahigu.
en: I am the first and the last, says the Lord God Almighty, who is, who was, and who is to come.

dag: So ni tooi zaŋ ziŋgoo gbaag o bee n-zaŋ tɔŋ nyini kuh o nyee?.
en: Who can blind his eyes and capture him? Or who can catch his snout in a trap?.

dag: Ka Sool daa bɔh o, Nachimbila, ŋun dapala n-lee nyɛ a? Ka Dauda daa garigi yɛl o, A dabili Jɛsi ŋun nyɛ Bɛtilihɛm nir la dapala n-nyɛ ma.
en: and Saul asked, Who are you? I am David the son of Jesse, a loyal Israelite from Bethlehem.

dag: Dama Yawɛ n-tiri yɛm. O noli ni ka baŋsim mini yɛla baŋbu yirina.
en: It is the Lord who gives wisdom; from him come knowledge and understanding.

dag: Amaa o daa lee bi wurimla bɛ ni daa jɛmdi buɣa luɣ shɛŋa la, ka niriba daa na kul chani nimaani nti maani maligu, ka tuɣindi tulaale zim.
en: But he did not destroy the high places. People still made sacrifices and burned incense in these places of worship.

dag: Ka n ni kul booni ba waawaayili shɛm, lala ka bɛ kpɛri yɔɣu ka chɛri ma. Bɛ maanila buɣili Baalnima, ka tuɣindi tulaale zim niŋdi binnana.
en: But the more I called to him, the more he turned away from me. My people sacrificed to Baal; they burned incense to idols.

dag: amaa bɛ daa ka bia, dama Ɛlizabɛt daa nyɛla paɣiŋoo m-pahi ka bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa daa lan kurigi pam.
en: But they did not have children. Elizabeth could not have any, and both Zechariah and Elizabeth were already old.

dag: Machɛle yi zaŋ kurigu she buɣim ni, o zaŋdila o nuu din mali kpiɔŋ n-kpuɣi zali ŋ-ŋme li hal ti mal li ka di niŋ o ni bɔri li shɛm. O yi tumda, kum mini kɔnyuri gbaar o, ka di wumd o pahi.
en: The metalworker takes a piece of metal and works with it over a fire. His strong arm swings a hammer to pound the metal into shape. As he works, he gets hungry, thirsty, and tired.

dag: Tiŋgban ni ka bɛ gbiri yihiri kuriti, ka nyɛligiri tahiʒiɛɣu mi kuɣa ni.
en: Iron is taken from the earth; rock is smelted into copper.

dag: Zaŋm amaŋa n-niŋ Yawɛ nuu ni; ka niŋ o naani ka o tum di ni simdi ni o tum shɛm.
en: Let the Lord lead you and trust him to help.

dag: Ka maligumaana Pashihur ŋun daa nyɛ Imɛr bia, ka nyɛ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu kpɛm la daa wum Jɛrimia anabitali yɛtɔɣa zaŋ chaŋ binyara ŋɔ polo.
en: Pashhur son of Immer was a priest. He was the highest officer in the Temple of the Lord . When he heard Jeremiah say those things in the Temple yard.

dag: M bihi, chɛliya ka yi baɣa be yi tuma ni, dama Yawɛ m-pii ya ni yi zaan o tooni tumd o tuma, ka leeg o tumtumdiba m-maani sara tir o.
en: Let's not waste any time, my friends. You are the ones who were chosen to be the Lord 's priests and to offer him sacrifices.

dag: Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba, Biriginsim din ni kpɛhi nir alahichi ni ku chɛ, amaa mbusim be ŋun chɛ ka o kpee birigi tum alahichi zuɣu!.
en: Jesus said to his disciples, Things that cause people to trip and fall into sin must happen, but how terrible it is for the person through whom they happen.

dag: N niriba alahichi tumbu puuni ka bɛ nyari bindirigu, ka bɔri ni bɛ kul tumdi alahichi.
en: They feed on the sin of my people; they set their hearts on evil things.

dag: Maligumaaniba daa ʒi m-bɔhi, Yawɛ lee be ya? Zaligubaŋdiba daa bi mi ma, ka nanim tum din bi tuhi n-jɛndi ma. Ka anabinim daa mali Baal yuli tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa, ka doli binshɛŋa din ka ba nyɔri.
en: The priests did not ask, Where is the Lord ? My own priests did not know me. The rulers rebelled against me; the prophets spoke in the name of Baal and worshiped useless idols.

dag: Ŋuna n-damdi dunia ŋɔ di zaashee, ka di daantalisi sɔhira.
en: Who shakes the earth from its place, and its pillars shudder?.

dag: Dama Yɛhudianim bɔri ni bɛ nyala shihira, ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim mi bɔri yɛm.
en: Jews ask for signs, and Greeks look for wisdom.

dag: ni o ni daa tum tuun shɛli tin ya tiŋgban nɛl ni hal ka yi ti paai kpe ŋɔ na.
en: what the Lord did for you in the desert, until you arrived at this place.

dag: Ka Naawuni shia maa daa kpuɣi ma zuɣusaa zaŋ ma chaŋ, ka n daa chaŋ ni suhugarigu pam mini suhuyiɣisili, dama Yawɛ nuu daa pa n zuɣu pam.
en: The Spirit lifted me and took me away. I was very sad and upset in my spirit, but I felt the Lord s power in me.

dag: Niriba maa tɛha daa zommi; ka di saha maa hal ni zuŋɔ bɛ yi karindi Naawuni daalikauli kurili la yɛla, lala chinchin yini maa na kul pilimi liri bɛ tɛha, dama Masia kɔŋko zuɣu ka di ni tooi piligi.
en: But their minds were closed. And even today, when those people read the writings of the old agreement, that same covering hides the meaning. That covering has not been removed for them. It is taken away only through Christ.

dag: Dinzuɣu di simdi ka yi woligi biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn pa daɣiri ka chɛ bɛn nyɛ daɣiri ni noombihi shɛb bɛn pa daɣiri ka chɛ bɛn nyɛ daɣiri. Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ biŋkɔbigu bee noombil bee binshɛli n ni wuhi ni di nyɛla daɣiri la kpɛhi yimaŋ daɣiri ni.
en: So then, you must make a clear distinction between animals and birds that are ritually clean and those that are not. Do not eat unclean animals or birds. I have declared them unclean, and eating them would make you unclean.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnim maa zaa: Bɛnya kasi, dama man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ bela kasi.
en: to say to the community of Israel: I am the Lord your God. I am holy, and you must be holy too!.

dag: Ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa bɔri ni o ku Jɔn, amaa ka zɔri niriba, dama sokam daa saɣiya ni o nyɛla anabi.
en: Herod wanted to kill John. But the people thought John was a prophet, and Herod was afraid of what they might do.

dag: M birimmi zaa ka dabiɛm kpe ma. N suhu kul yɛla yuŋ zibbu zuɣu, amaa ka di tahiri ma la dabiɛm na.
en: My head is spinning, and I am trembling with fear. I had been longing for evening to come, but it has brought me nothing but terror.

dag: Miriya ka yi tum alahichi yi sujee puuni, tɛhimiya dimbɔŋɔ yɛla viɛnyɛliŋga saha shɛli yi yi ti do yi gom shee, ka shini.
en: But each of you had better tremble and turn from your sins. Silently search your heart as you lie in bed.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa daa ti doli tiŋ maa gooni zuɣusaa n-chani garita, ka paɣ so kuhi yɛl o, N dan naa, sɔŋm ma.
en: Israels king was passing by on the city wall when a woman appealed to him, Help me, Your Majesty.

dag: Ka Mikaya daa garigi yɛl o, Nyama, a yi ti zo n-kpe duu puuni ti sɔɣi, dindali maa ka a yɛn baŋ.
en: Micaiah answered, You'll find out on the day you have to hide in the back room of some house.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yi nimaani chaŋ ti kpe Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu.
en: Jesus left that place and went to a synagogue.

dag: Yilimiya yila jɛm Yawɛ. Paɣimiya Yawɛ, dama o tiligi tarimba nyɛviya tuumbiɛrinim nuu ni.
en: Sing to the LORD, praise the LORD, for he has rescued the needy from the clutches of evildoers.

dag: Di ti ku be kaman n ni daa zaŋ n nuu yihi bɛ yaannim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka lo ba alikauli shɛl la, alikauli shɛli bɛ ni daa saɣim la, hal n ni daa kul gbib ba kaman yili yidana maa zaa yoli. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: It will be different from the agreement I made with their ancestors when I led them out of Egypt. Although I was their God, they broke that agreement.

dag: Ŋunkam niŋ yɛda ni Yisa nyɛla Masia, dilana nyɛla Naawuni bia, ka ŋunkam yuri ba so ŋun dɔɣi bia ni yur o bia maa gba.
en: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born from God. Whoever loves someone who is a parent loves the child born to the parent.

dag: Yawɛ zaligunim nyɛla din kul tuhi, ka tiri suhupiɛlli. Yawɛ zaligu nyɛla din do palo ni; ka neeri niriba nini.
en: The LORDs regulations are right, gladdening the heart. The LORDs commands are pure, giving light to the eyes.

dag: Yilimiya yila paɣ o, yilimiya wumpaɣibo yila paɣ o. Molimiy o daalahiziba tuma zaa yɛla.
en: Sing to him; sing praises to him. Tell about the amazing things he has done.

dag: Pa doo ka Naawuni daa nam ti paɣa, amaa paɣ ka Naawuni daa nam ti doo.
en: and man wasnt created for the sake of the woman, but the woman for the sake of the man.

dag: O mabia Ɛliɛza bia n-daa nyɛ Rɛhabia, ka Rɛhabia bia nyɛ Jɛshaya, ka Jɛshaya bia nyɛ Jɔram, ka Jɔram bia nyɛ Zikiri, ka Zikiri bia nyɛ Shɛlomɔt.
en: The descendants of Gershom's brother Eliezer included Rehabiah, Jeshaiah, Joram, Zichri, and Shelomoth.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka ŋun daa ye binyɛr piɛlli, ka bɛ ni mali binshɛli sabira be kolibil ni baɣi o luɣili la daa ti labina ti yɛli, N tum a ni zali ma ni n tum shɛli maa.
en: Just then, the man in the linen robe returned and said, I have done what you commanded.

dag: dinzuɣu ka n siɣisi mmaŋa n-niŋ tuuba ka do taŋkpaɣu mini tampiligim ni ŋɔ.
en: That's why I hate myself and sit here in dust and ashes to show my sorrow.

dag: Ɛhab daa malila bidibisi pisopɔin, ka bɛ be Samaria. Ka Jɛhu daa sab gbana zaŋ tim Samaria nti ti tiŋ maa nanim mini tiŋ kpamba ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbibi Ɛhab bidibisi maa n-yɛli.
en: Ahab still had descendants living in Samaria. So Jehu wrote a letter to each of the important leaders and officials of the town, and to those who supported Ahab. In the letters he wrote:.

dag: Binshɛɣukam din niŋ ti maa zuɣu ka ti lɔri alikauli ŋɔ, ka sabi li sɔŋ, ka ti zuɣulaannim mini ti Lɛvinim ni ti maligumaaniba yuya sabi pa bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa tabili alikauli gbaŋ maa zuɣu.
en: Because of all this, we are making a firm agreement in writing, with the names of our officials, our Levites, and our priests on the seal.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ nina niŋ liti ka bɛ ku tooi nya, ka chɛ ka bɛ wahala leei ʒi tibisili m-marigi ba sahakam.
en: Blindfold their eyes! Don't let them see. Bend their backs beneath a burden that will never be lifted.

dag: Ka alizin biɛri maa daa yi doo maa ni n-chaŋ ti kpe kuruchunim maa ni, ka bɛ daa dii zo wuriwuri nti sirigi kuligbiriŋ ni ha n-faai lu teeku ni, ka kom di ba.
en: They went out of the man and into the pigs. The whole herd rushed down the side of the cliff into the lake and was drowned.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim ni bɛ pɔri Naawuni sani mal alibarika, dama alizanda nam nyɛla bɛ dini.
en: Great blessings belong to those who know they are spiritually in need. Gods kingdom belongs to them.

dag: ni Bɛtiharam vinvamli ni Bɛtinimira ni Sukɔt ni Zafɔn ni Hɛshibɔn Naa Sihɔn ni daa su luɣ shɛlikam zaa, ka Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili noli daa nyɛ di tiŋgbani tariga zaŋ chaŋ ti paai Kinɛrɛt Teeku tariga ha sirigili zaŋ lab Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo la.
en: Gad also received the eastern half of the Jordan River valley, which had been ruled by King Sihon of Heshbon. This territory stretched as far north as Lake Galilee, and included the towns of Beth-Haram, Beth-Nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon.

dag: Ka ŋariŋ maa kpatoonsi maa daa bɔri ni bɛ yi n-zo n-tiligi, ka daa sirigi ŋarim bil din be ŋariŋ maa ni la pa kom zuɣu n-niŋ kaman bɛ yɛn zaŋla kur tibisa din bari ŋariŋ maa zaani la bahi ŋariŋ maa tooni polo ka zaŋ ŋarim bil maa n-zo n-tiligi.
en: The sailors tried to abandon the ship by lowering the lifeboat into the sea, pretending they were going to lower anchors from the bow.

dag: N naɣ ni niŋla ŋ-ŋɔ: N ni wurim n kambɔna ŋɔ, ka taɣi me zaɣ kara n-zaŋ m bindira mini m binkparisi zaa niŋ di ni;.
en: Then he said, I know what I will do. I will tear down my barns and build bigger barns! I will put all my wheat and good things together in my new barns.

dag: Yi ni tooi ŋub ba yi tinsi ni, bɛn be nyam mini bɛn bi be nyam zaa yi ni tooi ŋub ba kaman yi ni kul ŋubiri kparibuhi mini wolisi shɛm la.
en: You are allowed to eat those in your own cities, whether you are polluted or purified, just as you would eat gazelle or deer.

dag: Inhii, n suhuyiɣisili fiɛbiga bela Asirianim nuu ni.
en: The Lord says: I am furious! And I will use the king of Assyria as a club.

dag: Dama ŋunkam zaa ŋubiri li ka nyuri li ka bi zahim baŋ ti Duuma niŋgbuŋ yɛla gbinni, o ŋubiri li ka nyuri li bɔrila tibidarigibo tir omaŋa.
en: Those who eat and drink without correctly understanding the body are eating and drinking their own judgment.

dag: Amaa ka Jɛhu daa lee bi doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ zaligu ni o suhu zaa. O daa bi chɛ Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la soli dolibu.
en: But Jehu did not obey with all his heart the Law of the Lord , the God of Israel; instead, he followed the example of Jeroboam, who led Israel into sin.

dag: Jɔab ni daa nya ka tɔb maa be n-gil o tooni ni nyaaŋa zaa maa, ka o daa pii Izraɛl tɔbutuhiri biinsi ni bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi Sirianima.
en: Joab saw that there were two army groups ready to fight against him. One group was in front of him and the other group was behind him. So Joab chose some of the best soldiers of Israel and sent them out to fight against the Aramean army.

dag: ni o ni daa tum tuun shɛli tin ya tiŋgban nɛl ni hal ka yi ti paai kpe ŋɔ na.
en: You saw what the Lord did for you while you were in the desert, right up to the time you arrived here.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa ti yiɣisi asibaasi n-yi Akasia chaŋ Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni nti dɔn nimaani ni bɛ gbaai li du.
en: The next morning Joshua and all the people of Israel got up early, left the camp at Acacia, and went to the Jordan, where they camped while waiting to cross it.

dag: Amaa maligumaana maa yi lihi n-nya ka dɔr shɛli din zaɣisiri ka loori maa naai, ka kɔbiri bili di ni, o pala ŋun be daɣiri ni, di simdi ni maligumaana maa yɛli ni o nyɛla ŋun ka daɣiri ni.
en: But if in the priest's opinion the sore has not spread and healthy hairs are growing in it, the sore has healed, and the priest shall pronounce you ritually clean.

dag: Dama n wum ka niriba pam sɔɣiri yɛra; ka dabiɛm kul be luɣilikam zaa. Bɛ laɣimmi lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ m polo m-bɔri ni bɛ ku ma.
en: I hear them whispering about me. They have turned against me and plan to kill me.

dag: O mi bi kpe di ni mi ni o ti zaŋd omaŋ maani maligu yuuni kam kaman maligumaaniba zuɣulana ni daa yi zaŋdi biŋkɔbigu ʒi shɛli din pa ŋun maŋmaŋ ʒim kpɛri Luɣ Kasi Zaa Kasi Shee nti maani maligu shɛm la.
en: Christ did not have to offer himself many times. He wasn't like a high priest who goes into the most holy place each year to offer the blood of an animal.

dag: Amaa yi daalahichi n-leei kuɣituurili be yi mini yi Naawuni maa sunsuuni. Yi daalahichi maa zuɣu ka o lɛb o nyaaŋa biri ya, ka ku wum yi suhigu.
en: but your misdeeds have separated you from your God. Your sins have hidden his face from you so that you arent heard.

dag: Ka bɛ kuhi pam yɛl o, Kpahim o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: They yelled, Nail him to a cross.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa bɔhi Yaakubu, A yuma ala.
en: and Pharaoh said to Jacob, How old are you.

dag: Yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni zaa o daa kul bela gbala maa shee mini zoya zuɣu kuhiri ka mali kuɣa jɛr omaŋa.
en: Night and day he was in the graveyard or on the hills, yelling and cutting himself with stones.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa yɛli Yawɛ malaika so ŋun daa ʒe tuturi ni maa, Ti chaŋ gili dunia zaa n-nya ka dunianim zaa malila suhudoo.
en: Then the horses spoke to the Lord s angel standing among the myrtle bushes and said, We have walked here and there on the earth, and everything is calm and quiet.

dag: A chɛ ka saa miri pam niŋdi puri ka di maara, ka chɛ ka vuɣisi doya baalim, ka sakom chɛ ka di bala, ka bimbilli kam zoora.
en: you send abundant rain on the plowed fields and soak them with water; you soften the soil with showers and cause the young plants to grow.

dag: O ni ti deei yi bindira mini yi wain tihi wala pirigibu bupia kam puuni vaabu yim ti o kpambaliba min o tumtumdiba.
en: He will give one-tenth of your grain and your vineyards to his officials and servants.

dag: Di simdi ni tiŋgbani dam dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu, ka ŋunkam be di ni fabili. Di simdi ni di kpuɣi du zuɣusaa kaman Nail Mɔɣili la n-lalilali gili nti lab ti fim; ka lan kpuɣi zuɣusaa n-lab lu tiŋa kaman Ijipti mɔɣili la.
en: Your country will tremble, and you will mourn. It will be like the Nile River that rises and overflows, then sinks back down.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa ka Balaam sanna dindali maa yuŋ ti yɛl o, Niriba maa yi kamina ni bɛ ti bol a, nyin yiɣisim doli ba chaŋ; amaa kul niŋmila n ni yɛl a ni a niŋ shɛm.
en: That night God came to Balaam and said, If these men have come to ask you to go with them, get ready and go, but do only what I tell you.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn saɣi yɛli ŋ-ŋɔ wuhiya ni bɛ bɔrila tiŋgbɔn shɛli din ni nyɛ bɛmaŋmaŋ dini.
en: Those who say such things make it clear that they are looking for a country of their own.

dag: Ka so mi daa ti lan yɛli Yisa, N Duuma, n ni dol a; amaa lee chɛ ka n kuli nti chɛbisi n yiŋnim pɔi ka naanyi kana ti dol a.
en: Someone else said to Jesus, I will follow you, Lord, but first let me say good-bye to those in my house.

dag: Di zɔri yɛlibiɛ libigirili dabiɛm bee sanʒiɛɣu din ʒiɛri ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: You will not have to worry about sudden disasters, such as come on the wicked like a storm.

dag: Amaa pako so ŋun tumdi niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma, hal o ni na ne maa zaa yoli, o nyɛla ŋun kpi.
en: But a widow who gives herself to pleasure has already died, even though she lives.

dag: Ka so yi wum n yɛligu ka bi dol li, n ku kar o saria, dama m bi kamina ni n ti kari dunianim saria, amaa n kamina ni n ti tiligi dunianima.
en: I am not the one who will judge those who refuse to obey my teachings. I came to save the people of this world, not to be their judge.

dag: O yi ti kana, o ni wuhi dunianima alahichi ni nyɛ shɛli, ka wuhi ba wuntia ni nyɛ shɛli, ka lan wuhi ba saria karibu ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: The Spirit will come and show the people of this world the truth about sin and God's justice and the judgment.

dag: Dindali maa ka Nuhu min o paɣa ni o bidibisi bɛn yuya daa booni Shɛm mini Ham ni Jafɛt ni o bidibisi maa paɣiba ata la daa kpe ŋariŋ maa ni.
en: That same day Noah, with his sons Shem, Ham, and Japheth, Noahs wife, and his sons three wives, went into the ark.

dag: Ka paɣisarili maa daa guui chaŋ ti zaŋ yɛlli ŋɔ yɛl o ma yiŋnima.
en: Then Rebekah ran and told her family about all these things.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔnatan daa bɔh o ba Sool, Bɔ zuɣu ka a yɛn ku o? Bɔ ka o lee niŋ.
en: Jonathan asked his father, Why should David be killed? What did he do wrong.

dag: Ifriim zuliya ni bɛn daa nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi, ka mali suhukpeeni, ka sokam mi bɛ yɛla bɛ daŋ dunoya ni kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pisi ni kɔbisinii.
en: from Ephraim, . mighty warriors, famous in their households.

dag: Bɛ bihi ni ti tim sandaani niŋ nandaamba, ka labisi bɛ buni ti ba.
en: His children will have to give back what he took from the poor. His own hands will give up his wealth.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam chɛ o yili bee o paɣa bee o mabi dɔbba bee o ba min o mabihi Naawuni nam zuɣu.
en: Yes, Jesus said to them, and I assure you that anyone who leaves home or wife or brothers or parents or children for the sake of the Kingdom of God.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, Timiya ba bindirigu ka bɛ di. Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ti zaŋm tumtumda chira anii yɔri chaŋ ti da bindirigu na ti ti ba.
en: Jesus replied, You give them something to eat. But they asked him, Don't you know it would take almost a year's wages to buy all of these people something to eat.

dag: Lahibal suŋ maa zuɣu ka n diri wahala, ka bɛ ba ma bandi kaman tuumbiɛrilana n-nyɛ ma la, amaa so ku tooi ba Naawuni yɛligu bandi.
en: This is the reason Im suffering to the point that Im in prison like a common criminal. But Gods word cannot be imprisoned.

dag: N ni kpaŋsi yi suhuri kaman paɣ ni kpaŋsir o bia suhu shɛm la. Yi ni nya suhukpaŋsibo Jɛrusalɛm.
en: As a mother comforts her child, so I will comfort you; in Jerusalem you will be comforted.

dag: Chɛliya ka yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ kpe yi tiba ni viɛnyɛliŋga: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ Daadam Bia niŋ salinim nuu ni.
en: Take these words to heart: the Human Oneis about to be delivered into human hands.

dag: Paɣ jɛrigu kul tahirila pampam, o nyɛla ŋun be ʒilinsi ni, ka bi mi shɛli.
en: Stupidity is reckless, senseless, and foolish.

dag: Yawɛ ni sabi niriba maa yuya sɔŋ. O ni sabi, Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa leela Jɛrusalɛm tiŋbihi.
en: The Lord will write a list of the peoples and include them all as citizens of Jerusalem.

dag: Ka kukol shɛli daa kuhi yɛli, Molimi molo! Ka m bɔhi, M molimi molo bɔ? Ka o yɛli ma, Molimi molo yɛli ni ninsalinim zaa ŋmanila mɔri; bɛ bi yuuri gari tipum.
en: A voice was saying: Call out! And another said, What should I call out? All flesh is grass; all its loyalty is like the flowers of the field.

dag: dilan ŋun baŋmi ni ŋunkam ŋmaligi alahichilana o biriginsim sol ni n-labisi zali yɛlimaŋli sol ni ni tiligi alahichilan maa kum ni, ka chɛ ka alahichi pam nya chɛ m-paŋ.
en: If you turn sinners from the wrong way, you will save them from death, and many of their sins will be forgiven.

dag: N ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu lu bɛ zuɣu, ka chɛ ka m piɛma nyɔɣi ba:.
en: I'll send disaster after disaster to strike you like arrows.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ ti ba, ti ŋmanila yaɣiri a sani, ka a mi ŋmani yaɣimɛra. Ti zaa nyɛla a ni zaŋ a nuhi nam shɛba.
en: But now, LORD, you are our father. We are the clay, and you are our potter. All of us are the work of your hand.

dag: Ka daantalis ayi mini kɔniŋdi bini ni tɔroko shɛŋa Sulemaana ni daa mali niŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la, di zaa daanya daa galisiya pam hal ka bɛ ku tooi buɣisi baŋ di tibisim ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The bronze objects that King Solomon had made for the Temple—the two columns, the carts, and the large tank—were too heavy to weigh.

dag: ni Hadad ni Tɛma ni Jɛturi ni Nafish ni Kɛdɛma.
en: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.

dag: Ti mali suhukpeeni Naawuni sani, dama ti mi ni ti yi suh o shɛlikam ka di dol o yubu, o deeri ti suhigu.
en: We have courage in God's presence, because we are sure that he hears us if we ask him for anything that is according to his will.

dag: Ka doo maa dii yiɣisi zaŋ o daamaŋka maa yi bɛ zaa ninni n-kuni ka paɣiri Naawuni.
en: The man immediately stood up in front of everyone. He picked up his mat and walked home, praising God.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa va nti bɔb gbaag o ba n-kumdi ka mɔɣisir o kpariŋ.
en: Joseph fell across his fathers body, wept over him, and kissed him.

dag: N ni daa kari yi yaannim saria Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni tiŋgban nɛli ni shɛm la, lala ka n yɛn kari yi gba saria. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: and punish you, just as I punished your ancestors in the desert near Egypt.

dag: dindina yin zaŋmiya do so bee paɣ so ŋun tum tuumbiɛɣu maa ti zali tiŋ maa dunɔdali gbini n-labi doo maa bee paɣa maa kuɣa ku o.
en: then take them outside the town and stone them to death.

dag: Ka chɛrubi yino daa teeg o nuu chɛrubinim maa sanna n-tim buɣim shɛli din daa be chɛrubinim maa sunsuuni la ni m-mooi di shɛli n-zaŋ li niŋ do so ŋun daa ye binyɛr piɛlli maa nuu ni, ka o zaŋ li yi.
en: One of the creatures reached his hand into the fire that was there among them, picked up some coals, and put them in the hands of the man in linen. The man took the coals and left.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ mini zuliya kam ni ti bɔhi, Bɔzuɣu ka Yawɛ lee niŋ tiŋgbani ŋɔ shɛm ŋɔ? Bɔ n-daa lee chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi pam lala.
en: Then the whole world will ask, Why did the Lord do this to their land? What was the reason for his fierce anger.

dag: Ka guliba maa zaa daa gbib bɛ bidibbina n-ʒiɛya gu Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa nudirigu polo zaŋ ti kpa nuzaa polo m-mali ti gili sara maligu bimbini mini Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa.
en: and he stationed the men with drawn swords all around the front of the Temple, to protect the king.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa lan yɛli Jɔnatan, Ka a ba suhu yi ti yiɣisi bah a zuɣu, ŋuni n-lee yɛn yɛli ma.
en: David said, Who will warn me if your father says bad things to you.

dag: Yinim paɣ shɛb bɛn nya vuhim ŋɔ, chɛliya ka yi ni sɔhira. Tɛhi shɛli ni bi mali yinim shɛb ŋɔ, chɛliya ka dabiɛm mali ya. Pirigimiya yi situra sɔŋ, ka zaŋ buri so yi shɛhi ni.
en: Women, you are calm now, but you should be afraid. You feel safe now, but you should be worried. Take off your nice clothes and put on sackcloth. Wrap it around your waist.

dag: Dinzuɣu kaman alahichi ni nyaŋ sokam kum puuni shɛm, lala ka Naawuni daalibarika gba nyaŋ di nasara wuntia puuni, ka tahi nyɛvili din ka bahigu na ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu. Bɛn niŋ Yisa yɛda kpimi zaŋ chaŋ alahichi tumbu polo.
en: So then, just as sin ruled by means of death, so also God's grace rules by means of righteousness, leading us to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa yi lihi ka dɔro maa bi yɛligi situra maa ni bee kpalua ni bahi mi shɛŋa maa ni bee bɛ ni wuɣi tan shɛŋa maa ni bee bɛ ni zaŋ biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ mali shɛli maa ni.
en: If the priest sees that the mildew did not spread on the object, it must be washed. It doesnt matter if it is leather or cloth, or if the cloth is knitted or woven, it must be washed.

dag: A tihi ŋmanila pumpɔrinchihi tihi puu din wandi wal suma din nyɛ hɛnna mini naad.
en: Your limbs are like a garden filled with pomegranates and other pleasant fruit, with all the best spices: henna.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣ asibaasi ka Ashidɔdnim daŋ yiɣisibu n-nya ka buɣili Dagɔn lu m-pilila o puli zuɣu Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa tooni. Ka bɛ daa kpuɣi buɣili Dagɔn n-lan zal o zaashee.
en: The next morning, the people of Ashdod got up and found Dagon lying face down on the ground before the Lord s Box. The people of Ashdod put the statue of Dagon back in its place.

dag: N ni yɛli ya dimbɔŋɔnim maa zuɣu n-chɛ ka yi suhuri saɣim.
en: And now that I have told you, your hearts are full of sadness.

dag: Ka o daa ti lab o nyaandoliba maa sanna nti nya ka bɛ gbihirimi ka o bɔhi Pita, Saimɔn, yi gbihirimi? Yi ku tooi gali gom biɛla n zuɣu?.
en: When Jesus came back and found the disciples sleeping, he said to Simon Peter, Are you asleep? Can't you stay awake for just one hour?.

dag: Naawuni daa ti nachimbih anahi ŋɔ baŋsim mini yɛn bɔhimbu balibu kam puuni. Ka din pahi nyɛla o daa lan ti Daniɛl baŋsim shɛli din chɛ ka o tooi kahigiri ʒiinim mini zahima gbinni wuhira.
en: God made the four young men smart and wise. They read a lot of books and became well educated. Daniel could also tell the meaning of dreams and visions.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Pool daa be o mabihi bɛn be Kɔrinti maa sani n-yuui pam, ka daa naanyi ti chɛbisi ba ka kpe ŋariŋ chaŋ Siria; ka Akuila mini Prisila gba daa dol o chaŋ. Ka Pool daa ti pin o zuɣu Sɛnkiria, dama o daa pola pɔri.
en: After Paul had stayed for a while with the Lord's followers in Corinth, he told them goodbye and sailed on to Syria with Aquila and Priscilla. But before he left, he had his head shaved at Cenchreae because he had made a promise to God.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka n daa yiɣisi n suhu bahi bɛ zuɣu bɛ ni daa ku niriba tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni mini bɛ buɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni daa zaŋ ta li daɣiri la zuɣu.
en: They spilled blood on the ground when they murdered people in the land. They made the land filthy with their idols, so I showed them how angry I was.

dag: Ka Vuhim Dabisili dali daa ti paai, ka ti yi tiŋ maa ni chaŋ mɔɣili noli luɣ shɛli ti ni daa tɛhi ni Naawuni suhibu shee be n-daa ti ʒini paɣ shɛb bɛn daa laɣim sani n-tɔɣisiri ba Naawuni yɛtɔɣa.
en: On the Sabbath we went out of the city to the riverside, where we thought there would be a place where Jews gathered for prayer. We sat down and talked to the women who gathered there.

dag: Tuuni kam nyɛla din tuhi ŋun tum li sani, amaa Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun zahindi suhu.
en: People think that whatever they do is right, but the Lord judges the reasons for everything they do.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ nyɛla bɛn birigi n niriba ka yɛra, Suhudoo beni. ka suhudoo mi kani. Ka n niriba maa yi me gooni, anabinim ŋɔ zaŋdila bimpiɛlli paligi li.
en: The prophets mislead my people by saying that all is well. All is certainly not well! My people have put up a wall of loose stones, and then the prophets have come and covered it with whitewash.

dag: Dunia ni ti laani kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun nyu dam kuli, ka viini kaman suɣili la. Di tuumbiɛri tibisim nti yɛn marigi li ka di lu, ka ku lan yiɣisi yaha.
en: The sins of the world are very heavy, so the earth will fall under the weight. It will shake like an old house. It will fall like a drunk. It will not be able to stand.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔr a ka mi a zaligunim ka n sanna.
en: Let the people who honor you come back to me; let those who know your precepts return to me.

dag: Ka saamba di yi buni, ka yi tuma nyɔri kuli tinzun nir yiŋa;.
en: People you dont know will take all your wealth. Others will get what you worked for.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa ti neerina ka malaikanim maa kpam Lɔt jaande yɛra, Yiɣisim zaŋ a paɣ min a bipuɣins ayi bɛn be a sani ŋɔ n-zo n-yi yaŋɔ, di yi pa lala, yaŋɔnim ni yɛn nya tibidarigibo shɛli maa ni tabili ya.
en: The next morning at dawn, the angels were trying to make Lot hurry. They said, This city will be punished, so take your wife and your two daughters who are still with you and leave this place. Then you will not be destroyed with the city.

dag: Ka o ni daa niŋ shɛm maa bi niŋ Yawɛ nyaɣisim, ka o daa ku o gba.
en: What he did displeased the Lord , and the Lord killed him also.

dag: Dama saha shɛli kanna ka tiŋguliba ni ti be Ifriim zoya zuɣu ka kuhi bahina, Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ sani Ziɔn. .
en: The time will come when the watchmen shout from the highlands of Ephraim: Get ready! Were going up to Zion to the LORD our God.

dag: Siprɛs tihi ni ti bili zani gɔhi zaashee. Ka ti shɛli bɛ ni booni mitil la mi ti bili suligunyinyari zaashee. Dina nti yɛn nyɛ Yawɛ shihirili shɛli din ni beni sahakam ka ku vuui.
en: In place of the thorn the cypress will grow; in place of the nettle the myrtle will grow. This will attest to the LORDs stature, an enduring reminder that wont be removed.

dag: Mani n-daa nam li ka di viɛla, ka mali wula pam. Ka Idɛn tihi zaa din daa be Naawuni tihi puu la ni daa zabiri li nyuli.
en: I gave it many branches and made it beautiful. And all the trees in Eden, Gods garden, were jealous.

dag: Yawɛ yi ti sahi o takɔbi maa naai alizanda ni, o ni zaŋ li lu Ɛdomnim bɛn nyɛ o ni zali ni o ku shɛb la zuɣu.
en: The Lord has prepared his sword in heaven, and now it will strike Edom, those people whom he has condemned to destruction.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka buɣim di Tɛman n-saɣim bɛ ni me goma gili luɣ shɛŋa Bɔzira la.
en: Now I will send fire to wipe out the fortresses of Teman and Bozrah.

dag: Ŋun daa pa Ɛhud zuɣu n-daa nyɛ Anat bia Shamga ŋun daa zaŋ naɣikpar kpaa ku Filistianim ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu la. Ŋun gba daa fa Izraɛlnim bahi.
en: After Ehud, Shamgar, Anaths son, struck down six hundred Philistines with an animal prod. He too rescued Israel.

dag: nti be nimaani hal ka a biɛli suhuyiɣisili maa ti chɛ.
en: and stay with him for a while, until your brother's anger cools down.

dag: Dama o daa yɛlimi, ka di niŋ. O daa zal li zaligu, ka di ba n-zani.
en: As soon as he spoke the world was created; at his command, the earth was formed.

dag: Zoya zuɣu tinsi mi n-daa nyɛ: Shamir mini Jatir ni Soko.
en: In the highlands: Shamir, Jattir, Socoh.

dag: Bɛ nia zaa nyɛla bɛ daai ninvuɣ so ŋun ʒe zaashe titali ni luhi; bɛ nyɛla bɛn yu ʒiŋmabo. Alibarika yɛtɔɣa m-be bɛ noya ni, amaa ka turi yɛtɔɣa lee be bɛ suhuri ni.
en: The only desire of this people is to bring others down low; they delight in deception. With their mouths they bless, but inside they are cursing. Selah.

dag: Dinzuɣu yihimiya dinkam nyɛ daɣiri mini biɛribiɛtali zaa yi bebu ni, ka doliya tarimtali soli n-deei Naawuni ni zaŋ yɛligu shɛli biri yi suhuri ni, ka di nyɛ din ni tooi tiligi ya la.
en: You must stop doing anything immoral or evil. Instead be humble and accept the message planted in you to save you.

dag: N ni chɛ ka bɛ yɛla gbaai dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam dabiɛm, Hɛzɛkia bia Manaasa ŋun daa nyɛ Juda naa la ni daa tum shɛm Jɛrusalɛm la zuɣu.
en: I will make all the people of the world horrified at them because of what Hezekiah's son Manasseh did in Jerusalem when he was king of Judah.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Kaman fiig tiwal viɛla maa ni be shɛm maa, lala ka n lihi Juda ninvuɣ shɛb n ni daa chɛ ka bɛ gbahi n-zaŋ ba kpe chaŋ Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni la ka bɛ viɛla.
en: I, the Lord , the God of Israel, consider that the people who were taken away to Babylonia are like these good figs, and I will treat them with kindness.

dag: M bi bɔri ni n ti nyan ya la biɛla ka gari; ti Duuma yi saɣi n niŋdi tahima ni n ni ti yuui yi sani.
