en: I dont want to make a quick visit to you, since I hope to spend some time with you if the Lord lets it happen.

dag: Hal pumpɔŋɔ bɛ sɔɣimi do n-gu ni bɛ di n nyɛvili; kpiɔŋlaannim taala duŋ bahi n zuɣu. Yawɛ, di mi pala n tuumbiɛri bee n daalahichi zuɣu.
en: Merciless enemies, Lord , are hiding and plotting, hoping to kill me. I have not hurt them in any way at all.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima: Izraɛl do so bee saamba bɛn be Izraɛl do so yi ti zaŋ o bia ti Molɛk, bɛn kum o; tiŋ maa nim bɛn labim o kuɣa.
en: You will also say to the Israelites: Any Israelite or any immigrant living in Israel who gives their children to Molech must be executed. The common people will stone such a person.

dag: Yawɛ maŋmaŋ tarili nyɛla o niriba. Yaakubu n-nyɛ o tarili.
en: but Jacob's descendants he chose for himself.

dag: Lahibali ni daa ti nti to Firawuna yiŋa ni Yisifu biɛyanima n-kana, di daa niŋ Firawuna min o kpambaliba nyaɣisim pam.
en: Pharaoh learned that Josephs brothers had come to him. This news spread throughout Pharaohs house. Pharaoh and his servants were very excited!.

dag: Di biɛɣ pinaanahi dali yuŋ ti ni daa chani ka pɔhim kul ʒiɛri ti bahiri Adria teeku ni la, ka di daa ti niŋ yuntisuɣu, ka kpatoonsi maa tɛhi ni ti mirila duli.
en: On the fourteenth night, we were being carried across the Adriatic Sea. Around midnight the sailors began to suspect that land was near.

dag: Ka Pool daa siɣi nti kurim o sani m-bɔbind o ka yɛli, Di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira, dama o na nyɛla nyɛvililana.
en: Paul went down and bent over Eutychus. He took him in his arms and said, Don't worry! He's alive.

dag: Ka bɛ dimnim maa daa kana ti kpuɣi bɛn Sɔdomnim mini Gomɔranim maa nɛma mini bɛ binshɛɣukam zaa chaŋ.
en: They took everything from Sodom and Gomorrah, including its food supplies, and left.

dag: Ka Musa daa yi n-chaŋ ti tuh o deemba maa soli lu o sizuura, ka mɔɣis o kpariŋ. Ka bɛ daa puhi tab bɔhi tab daalaafee yɛla; ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti kpe Musa suɣili ni.
en: Moses went out to meet his father-in-law, and he bowed down and kissed him. They asked each other how they were doing, and then they went into the tent.

dag: N Duuma, sɔŋm ma ka n yaai n noli paɣ a.
en: Help me to speak, and I will praise you, Lord.

dag: Naftali bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Jaziɛl mini Guni ni Jɛzar ni Shallum, bɛ daa nyɛla Biliha zuliya.
en: Naphtalis family: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum. These were Bilhahs family.

dag: Di yuuni maa ni gol so ŋun pahir anahi daba awɛi dali, ka bindirigu daa lan ka tiŋ maa ni, ka kum lu niriba maa zuɣu.
en: The famine was getting worse and worse in the city. By the th day of the fourth month, there was no more food for the common people in the city.

dag: Ti lan wuhiri li ti biɛr kasi puuni mini baŋsim ni ni suɣilo dibu ni ni nirilim niŋbu ni ni Naawuni Shia Kasi ni yurilim maŋli ni.
en: We show that we are Gods servants by our pure lives, by our understanding, by our patience, and by our kindness. We show it by the Holy Spirit, by genuine love.

dag: Binshɛli daa ka Alikauli Adaka maa puuni, naɣila Musa ni daa zaŋ kuɣ parilana ayi shɛŋa niŋ di puuni Sinai Zoli zuɣu luɣ shɛli Yawɛ ni daa lo Izraɛlnim alikauli bɛ ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na nyaaŋa la.
en: There was nothing inside the Covenant Box except the two stone tablets which Moses had placed there at Mount Sinai, when the Lord made a covenant with the people of Israel as they were coming from Egypt.

dag: Yawɛ, n teeg a tuun kara la yɛla; ka teeg a ni daa pun tum alahiziba tuun shɛŋa la gba yɛla.
en: Lord , I remember what you have done. I remember the amazing things you did long ago.

dag: N daa kpam Taitus jaande ni o ka yi sanna, ka daa lan chɛ ka ti mabi so pah o zuɣu na. Taitus daa di yi zuɣu nyɔri? Pa biɛhigu yini ka ti mali? Pa so yini ka ti doli?.
en: I asked Titus to go to you, and I sent our brother with him. Titus did not cheat you, did he? No, you know that his actions and his attitude were the same as ours.

dag: Ka Firawuna bipuɣiŋga daa ti ka mɔɣili maa ni na ni o ti su kom. Ka o min o paɣisara daa baɣisiri mɔɣili maa chana, ka o daa ti nya piɛɣu maa ni su kaɣili ni, ka o tim o paɣisara maa ni yino ni o chaŋ ti zaŋ li na.
en: The king's daughter came down to the river to bathe, while her servants walked along the bank. Suddenly she noticed the basket in the tall grass and sent a slave woman to get it.

dag: Ninsalinim suhuyiɣisili ni ŋmaligi paɣ a, a yi ti chɛ ka a suhuyiɣisili din bahindi nyaaŋa la biɛla gil a.
en: Even human anger can bring you honor when you use it to punish your enemies.

dag: ka yɛli, Lala ka Babilɔn ti yɛn shim ka ku lan puhi na yaha, n ni yɛn chɛ ka yɛlibiɛ shɛŋa lu di zuɣu maa zuɣu. Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣa maa tariga m-bala.
en: Then say, In the same way, Babylon will sink and never rise again because of the disaster Im bringing against it. Jeremiahs words end here.

dag: Sanʒiɛɣu yi ti ʒiɛra, ninvuɣ biɛri ku lan beni, amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn kul ni beni sahakam.
en: The wicked are destroyed when trouble comes, but good people stand strong forever.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa yiɣisi daŋ Sool tooni chaŋ Zif. Di saha Dauda min o niriba daa bela Maɔn yɔɣu ni luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Araba, ka di be Jɛshimɔn nudirigu polo la.
en: So they got up and left for Ziph ahead of Saul. Meanwhile, David and his soldiers were in the Maon wilderness in the desert plain south of Jeshimon.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya ni zim maa ku naai di duɣu ni, ka kpam la gba ku naai di ŋman ni hal ti paai dahin shɛli ŋun Yawɛ ni yɛn chɛ ka saa mi.
en: This is what Israels God, the LORD, says: The jar of flour wont decrease and the bottle of oil wont run out until the day the LORD sends rain on the earth.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Hal n yi di mmaŋ shɛhira, n shɛhira maa nyɛla shɛhira maŋli, dama m mi n ni yi shɛl na, ka lan mi n ni chani shɛli, amaa yinim ʒi n ni yi shɛl na bee n ni chani shɛli.
en: Jesus replied: Even if I do speak for myself, what I say is true! I know where I came from and where I am going. But you don't know where I am from or where I am going.

dag: Ka Ɛba daa dɔɣi bidibis ayi. Yino yuli n-daa booni Pɛlɛg , dama o saha ka tiŋgbani daa pirigi la; ka o tizo mi yuli daa booni Jokitan.
en: Eber was the father of two sons. One son was named Peleg. He was given this name because the earth was divided during his life. The other son was named Joktan.

dag: Ka Ribɛka dɔɣibu dali daa ti paai, ka jahi m-be o pul ni.
en: When she reached the end of her pregnancy, she discovered that she had twins.

dag: N yi yɛli, N garo ni maai n suhu, n garibil ni chɛ ka n fabila naai;.
en: My bed should bring me comfort. My couch should give me rest and relief.

dag: O yi yɛli, Bu shɛb bɛn liɣisiliɣisi ka n yɛn zaŋ yo a, buhi maa zaa ti dɔɣirila bubihi shɛb bɛn liɣisiliɣisi; ka o yi lan yɛli, Bu shɛb bɛn mali bomaboma ka n yɛn zaŋ yo a, buhi maa zaa ti dɔɣirila bubihi shɛb bɛn mali bomaboma.
en: Whenever Laban said, The speckled goats shall be your wages, all the flocks produced speckled young. When he said, The striped goats shall be your wages, all the flocks produced striped young.

dag: Shimɛi bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Jahat mini Zina ni Jɛushi ni Bɛraya, bɛ niriba anahi maa n-daa nyɛ Shimɛi bidibisi.
en: Shimei had four sons: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah, in order of age. Jeush and Beriah did not have many descendants, so they were counted as one clan.

dag: Di simdi ka suhuyiɣisililan nya tibidarigibo, amaa a yi fa o bahi, shee ka a lan niŋ lala yaha.
en: If someone has a hot temper, let him take the consequences. If you get him out of trouble once, you will have to do it again.

dag: Ti Naawuni, ka pumpɔŋɔ wula ka ti lee yɛn yɛli dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa? Dama ti lan zaɣisi a zaligu shɛŋa.
en: But now, O God, what can we say after all that has happened? We have again disobeyed the commands.

dag: ka zaŋ ya tahi gomnanim mini nazuɣuri tooni n zuɣu, ka yi ti niŋ n shɛhiranima bɛ mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani.
en: For my sake you will be brought to trial before rulers and kings, to tell the Good News to them and to the Gentiles.

dag: Ka o kpamba maa zaa daa kana ti gar o zuɣu, ka Chɛrɛtinim mini Pɛlɛtinim ni Gaatinim ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu bɛn daa doli naa yi Gaat la na zaa daa gar o tooni.
en: All the kings officers passed by him. And all the Kerethites, all the Pelethites, and the Gittites passed by the king.

dag: Nyin ka ti yaannim daa niŋ naani; ka bɛ ni daa niŋ a naani maa zuɣu daa chɛ ka a tiligi ba.
en: Our ancestors trusted you. Yes, they trusted you, and you saved them.

dag: amaa ka bɛ ŋariŋ maa pun chaŋ katiŋ ha ka chɛ duli, ka kɔgbana ŋmɛri li, dama bɛ daa tuhila pɔhim.
en: Meanwhile, the boat, fighting a strong headwind, was being battered by the waves and was already far away from land.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm, yiɣisima n-chɛ ka a neesim neei; dama a neesim kana. Yawɛ jilima neeg a sani.
en: Jerusalem, stand up! Shine! Your new day is dawning. The glory of the Lord shines brightly on you.

dag: Wain tihi kuuya; ka fiig tihi vari suui. Ka pumpɔrinchihi tihi mini kpikpal tihi ni apil tihi ni tihi balibu kam zaa kuui. Ka suhupiɛlli din be niriba sani naai.
en: Grapevines have dried up and so has every tree— figs and pomegranates, date palms and apples. All happiness has faded away.

dag: Ka Farisiinim maa ni shɛb yɛli, Dindina doo maa pala Naawuni nira, dama o bi doli Vuhim Dabisili dali zaligu. Ka bɛ ni shɛb mi bɔhi, Ka wula ka alahichilana ni tooi wuhi shihira ŋɔ tatabo? Ka bɛ noya woli.
en: Some of the Pharisees said, That man does not obey the law about the Sabbath day. So he is not from God. Others said, But someone who is a sinner cannot do these miraculous signs. So they could not agree with each other.

dag: Amaa Hanna ŋun daa bi chaŋ, dama o daa yɛlila o yidana, Faashee bia maa ti ŋmaai bihili ka n zaŋ o tahi Yawɛ sani ka o ti kpalim be nimaani hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: But Hannah did not go. She told Elkanah, When the boy is old enough to eat solid food, I will take him to Shiloh. Then I will give him to the Lord . He will become a Nazirite. He will stay there at Shiloh.

dag: Judanim naa Jɔtam mini Izraɛl naa Jɛrɔbɔam ʒiɛmana ni ka bɛ daa sabi bɛ daŋ maa ni niriba ŋɔ yuya maa sɔŋ.
en: During the time of Jotham and Jeroboam, all these peoples names were written in the family history of Gad. Jotham was the king of Judah and Jeroboam was the king of Israel.

dag: Amaa di yi nyɛla tiŋgban shɛli din bindila gɔhi mini mɔri din ka buchi, dindina Naawuni ni yɛli noli ti li, ka buɣim di li.
en: But other people are like land that grows only thorns and weeds. It is worthless and in danger of being cursed by God. It will be destroyed by fire.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Ŋuna n-tiri nandaamba pina pam luɣilikam. O nirilim niŋbu kul ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: As it is written, He scattered everywhere; he gave to the needy; his righteousness remains forever. .

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ n nyaandoliba ŋɔ, gbibiya ka guliya n wuhibu viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: You, my disciples, are to guard and preserve the messages that God has given me.

dag: Dama Dauda mini Asaf saha la kurimbuni maa ni ha, yiliyiiniba toondana daa beni, ka wumpaɣibo mini Naawuni puhigu yila daa beni.
en: Long ago, in the days of David and Asaph, there was a leader of the singers, and there were songs of praise and thanks to God.

dag: Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba mini Farisiinima n-zani Anabi Musa zaashee;.
en: The teachers of the Law and the Pharisees are the authorized interpreters of Moses' Law.

dag: Ka yi yi di wahala ka di yuui biɛla, Naawuni ŋun nyɛ anfaanizaalana ka boli ya ni yi mini Masia ti laɣim nya o jilima din ka bahigu la maŋmaŋ chɛ ka yi nya din simdi ya sɔŋbu zaa, ka chɛ ka yi ʒe yim, ka tin ya yiko mini kpiɔŋ.
en: But God shows undeserved kindness to everyone. That's why he appointed Christ Jesus to choose you to share in his eternal glory. You will suffer for a while, but God will make you complete, steady, strong, and firm.

dag: Di saha ka Batishiiba daa yɛli naa, M bɔri ni n suh a la bimbil yini, a mi di mɔŋ ma li. Ka naa yɛl o, M ma, yɛlim ma a ni bɔri shɛli maa, dama n ku mɔŋ a li.
en: She said, I have just one small request for you. Dont refuse me. The king said to her, Mother, ask me. I wont refuse you.

dag: Ka Balaam daa yɛli Balak, Mɛm sara maligu bimbina ayopɔin zali ma kpe, ka bo naɣilah ayopɔin mini piɛlah ayopɔin ti ma kpe na.
en: Balaam said, Build seven altars here. And prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me.

dag: Dinzuɣu zaŋmiya n yɛligu ŋɔ niŋ yi suhuri ni mini yi biɛhigu ni, zaŋmiya li lo yi nuhi ni ka di leei shihirili, ka zaŋ li lo m-pa yi gbɛri zuɣu kaman saba la.
en: Remember these commands and cherish them. Tie them on your arms and wear them on your foreheads as a reminder.

dag: Yaakubu zuliya, yi suɣa viɛli pam. Izraɛlnima, yi doo viɛli pam!.
en: People of Jacob, your tents are beautiful! Israelites, your homes are beautiful!.

dag: Di pala lahibal sun shɛli n-shiri lan beni pahi, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb beni chirindi ya yi tɛha ni, ka bɔri ni bɛ taɣi Masia lahibal suŋ maa.
en: There is no other message that is the Good News, but some people are confusing you. They want to change the Good News about Christ.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, Mani n-nyɛ soli maa, mani n-nyɛ yɛlimaŋli, mani n-lan nyɛ nyɛvili; ka so ku tooi chaŋ m Ba sani, ka pa ni o paala mani.
en: Jesus answered, I am the way, the truth, and the life. The only way to the Father is through me.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla dunia zaa daa kala Ijipti na Yisifu sani ni bɛ ti da kawana, dama kum maa daa miila dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam zaa.
en: Every country came to Egypt to buy grain from Joseph, because in every country the famine had also become more severe.

dag: N suhu saɣimmi zaa, ka kum dabiɛm gbaai ma.
en: My heart is racing fast, and I am afraid of dying.

dag: Yi ni tooi pihi li hal ni daba ayɔbu dali, amaa daba ayopɔin dali din nyɛ Vuhim Dabisili dali maa, di shɛli ku beni.
en: You must gather food for six days, but on the seventh day, the day of rest, there will be none.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ninsalinim ni tooi nya alahichi balibu kam tumbu mini Naawuni mɔbu zaa taali chɛ m-paŋ Naawuni sani.
en: I assure you that people can be forgiven all their sins and all the evil things they may say.

dag: Dama niŋgbuŋ nyɛvili bela ʒim puuni, ka n chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ li pa sara maligu bimbini zuɣu tin ya ni di yo yi nyɛviya tiliginsim samli. Dama ʒim n-nyɛ din yɔri alahichi samli, di ni nyɛ nyɛvili la zuɣu.
en: This is because the life of the body is in the blood. I have told you that you must pour the blood on the altar to purify yourselves. It is the blood that makes a person pure.

dag: Yawɛ, Garigim ma, garigim ma din ni chɛ ka niriba ŋɔ baŋ ni nyini Yawɛ n-nyɛ Naawuni, ka lan nyɛ ŋun ŋmaligi bɛ suhuri labis a sanna.
en: Answer me, Lord , answer me, so that this people will know that you, the Lord , are God and that you are bringing them back to yourself.

dag: Bɛla ni daa ti kpi, Jɔbab ŋun daa nyɛ Zɛra bia, ka o ya nyɛ Bɔzira la n-daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: After Bela's death, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah became king.

dag: Ka o daa bɔhi ba, Yi ni ŋuni n-ni tooi wuhi n daalahichi ni nyɛ shɛli? Ka n yi tɔɣisirila yɛlimaŋli, bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bi niŋdi ma yɛda?.
en: Can any of you accuse me of sin? If you cannot, why won't you have faith in me? After all, I am telling you the truth.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n kana pumpɔŋɔ ni n tuh a soli. M bo a ni nimmoo, ka ti nya a maa.
en: So I came out looking for you. I wanted to find you, and here you are!.

dag: Di saha ka Absalom daa yɛli naa, N suhir a mi, a yi ku chaŋ, nyin lee chɛ ka ti mini m mabia Amnɔn chaŋ. Ka naa daa bɔh o, Bɔzuɣu ka a lee bɔri ni yi min o chaŋ.
en: Absalom said, If you won't go, at least let my brother Amnon come with us. David asked, Why should he go with you.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa daa ʒini gbilligbilli: Shɛb kɔbigakɔbiga, shɛb mi pihinunu.
en: So all the people sat in groups. There were about or people in each group.

dag: Dabisili din daŋ tooni dali yin laɣimmiya jɛm Naawuni, ka di tumiya tuun shɛli.
en: On the first day of this festival, you must rest from your work and come together for worship.

dag: Amaa bɛ zaa ni ti kpila bɛmaŋmaŋ daalahichi zuɣu. Ŋunkam di wain tiwala din miha nyina ni nyɛmda.
en: Instead, those who eat sour grapes will have their own teeth set on edge; and everyone will die because of their own sin.

dag: Amaa ka Dauda daa chaŋ ti du Olivi tihi Zoli n-chani ka kumda. O daa zaŋla bini pil o zuɣu, ka chani napɔn zaŋa. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be o sani gba zaŋ bina pil bɛ zuɣuri n-kumdi dol o chana.
en: David went on up the Mount of Olives crying; he was barefoot and had his head covered as a sign of grief. All who followed him covered their heads and cried also.

dag: Ka Jɛfita daa bɔhi Giliad kpamba maa, Pa yinima n-daa je ma hal ka kari ma m ba yiŋ la? Ka di chaŋ wula ka yi ti kani n sanna yi wahala nyabu saha.
en: Didn't you hate me? Jephthah replied. Weren't you the ones who forced me to leave my family? You're only coming to me now because you're in trouble.

dag: Di saha ka paɣ yɛndaan so daa be tiŋ maa ni ka kuhi yɛl ba na, Wummiya! Wummiya! Yɛlimiya Jɔab ni o kana ka n ti yɛl o yɛtɔɣ shɛli.
en: But there was a very wise woman in that city who shouted out to them and said, Listen to me! Tell Joab to come here. I want to talk with him.

dag: Ka yi mali salima bans ayi n-zaŋ li gɔhi binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa maa bɔɣusapima zuɣu tan tolima ayi la tiŋli di tooni polo miri di tuɣibu shee binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa maa shɛlɔrigu la zuɣusaa polo.
en: Make two more gold rings and put them on the bottom of the shoulder pieces on the front of the ephod. Put the gold rings above the cloth belt of the ephod.

dag: Zaŋ kpa Manaasa tintarisi polo, Yisifu ŋun daa nyɛ Yaakubu bia la mi bidibisi n-daa ʒini nimaani n-su Bɛtishɛan mini di tiŋkpansi ni Taanak mini di tiŋkpansi ni Mɛgido mini di tiŋkpansi ni Dɔri mini di tiŋkpansi zaa.
en: Beth-shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, and Dor and its towns were under Manassite authority. The family of Joseph, Israels son, lived in them.

dag: Teeku kom yiɣisiya pili Babilɔn, ka di kɔgbana din mali vuri pam la lim li.
en: The sea will rise over Babylon. Its roaring waves will cover her.

dag: Ka Yisa ni daa niŋ shɛm maa lahibali moli gili Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni mini tin shɛŋa din gili nimaani zaa.
en: This news about Jesus spread throughout Judea and the surrounding region.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa yɛli Rubin zuliya mini Gaad zuliya ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili la.
en: Joshua said to the tribes of Reuben and Gad and to half the tribe of Manasseh.

dag: Yawɛ ni guli ba ka ba bɛ nyɛviya zali; ka chɛ ka bɛ mal alibarika dunia ŋɔ ni; o mi ku chɛ ba niŋ bɛ dimnim nuu ni.
en: The LORD protects them and keeps them alive; they are widely regarded throughout the land as happy people. You wont hand them over to the will of their enemies.

dag: Ka Hamɔr daa yɛl o, M bia Shɛkɛm bɔr a bipuɣiŋga, n suhir a, zaŋm o ti o ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: Hamor said to Jacob and his sons: My son Shechem really loves Dinah. Please let him marry her.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka ti ni saɣi zaŋdi ti bipuɣinsi tiri ya, ka ti gba kpuɣiri yi bipuɣinsi, ka kpalim be yi tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni ka ti mini ya leei ninvuɣ yinsi.
en: Then your men can marry our women, and our men can marry your women. Then we will become one people.

dag: Bɛ ni daa tumdi buɣijɛmbo tuma niriba maa sani, ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim birigi n-tum alahichi la zuɣu. Dinzuɣu m poya zaŋ chaŋ bɛ polo ni bɛ ni nya tibidarigibo. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Because they ministered to them before their idols, they brought about the downfall of the house of Israel. For that reason I made a solemn pledge against them—this is what the LORD God says—and they will bear their guilt.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Musa zaŋ alikauli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa lo Izraɛlnim alikauli Mɔabnim tiŋgbɔŋ ni m-pah o ni daa lo ba alikauli shɛli Sinai Zoli gbin la m-bɔŋɔ.
en: So Moses finished telling the Israelites what they had to do in order to keep the agreement the Lord was making with them in Moab, which was in addition to the one the Lord had made with them at Mount Sinai.

dag: Yi gba maŋmaŋ daa bela zibisim ni, amaa ti Duuma ni, yi yipa leela bɛn be neesim ni pumpɔŋɔ. Dinzuɣu benya kaman neesim ni niriba.
en: You were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord, so live your life as children of light.

dag: Yihimiya tins ata zali Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli, ka yihi tins ata zali Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka di nyɛ tiliginsim tinsi.
en: Three of them will be east of the Jordan River and three of them will be in the land of Canaan, west of the Jordan River.

dag: Ka di lahibali daa ti nti to Ninive naa, ka o yiɣis o nam ʒiishee m-pirig o nam binyɛrigu sɔŋ, ka zaŋ buɣu pili n-teei ʒini tampiligim mahili ni wuhi bɛ suhusaɣiŋgu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: When the king of Nineveh heard about this, he left his throne, removed his robe, put on special clothes to show that he was sorry, and sat in ashes.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kpe Naa Hɛzɛkia sani ti yɛl o, Ti mali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa zaa, ka mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la bimbini mini di lahi zaa; ni bɛ ni zaŋdi bɔrɔbɔro kasi tamdi teebuli shɛli zuɣu la mini di lahi zaa.
en: The Levites made the following report to King Hezekiah: We have completed the ritual purification of the whole Temple, including the altar for burnt offerings, the table for the sacred bread, and all their equipment.

dag: Dindali maa bɛ ni ti yɛli Jɛrusalɛm, Nyin Ziɔn, di zɔri dabiɛm; di chɛ ka a baɣiri ni cheei kom.
en: At that time Jerusalem will be told, Be strong, dont be afraid!.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ gabiga m-pɔripɔri li n-zaŋ kari bɛ mini bɛ biŋkɔbiri maa zaa yihi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, ka daai laɣitaɣiriba la teebuya maa luhi n-kpahi bɛ liɣiri bahi.
en: He made a whip from ropes and chased them all out of the temple, including the cattle and the sheep. He scattered the coins and overturned the tables of those who exchanged currency.

dag: Dinzuɣu n nyaya ka ninsalitali biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm zuɣu chɛ ka n yi kul bɔri ni n tum din tuhi, zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu n-nyɛ din miriti ma.
en: So I find that, as a rule, when I want to do what is good, evil is right there with me.

dag: ka ku yɛl o mi ni o malim shili n-zaŋ a bindirigu na ti zal a, ka a di ka nyu pɔi ka o mi naanyi chaŋ ti ʒini di ka nyu?.
en: No, you wouldn't say that. You would say, Prepare me something to eat. Get ready to serve me, so I can have my meal. Then later on you can eat and drink.

dag: Ka Jɔn daa yɛli Yisa, Karimba, ti nyala so ka o mal a yuli karit alizin biɛri, ka ti kar o, o ni pa ti ni yino zuɣu.
en: John said to Jesus, Teacher, we saw someone throwing demons out in your name, and we tried to stop him because he wasnt following us.

dag: N dana, a daa bɔhila tinim a daba ŋɔ, Yi mali ba bee tizo.
en: My master asked his servants, Do you have a father or brother.

dag: Amaa Naawuni tiligim ma ka n nyu bara shɛli zuɣu ka pa ni ti Duuma Yisa Masia dapulli la kɔŋko zuɣu. Masia dapulli maa zuɣu dunia nyɛla binkpiŋ n sani, ka n gba nyɛ binkpiŋ dunia ŋɔ sani.
en: As for me, however, I will boast only about the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ; for by means of his cross the world is dead to me, and I am dead to the world.

dag: Daba ayopɔin maa dali, di simdi ka maligumaana maa lan kana ti nya, dɔro maa yi yɛligi yili maa dukpina maa zuɣu.
en: On the seventh day the priest must come back and check the house. If the mildew has spread on the walls of the house.

dag: Kul maliya suhupiɛlli ti Duuma zuɣu sahakam; n lan yɛri ya mi yaha, kul maliya suhupiɛlli!.
en: Always be glad because of the Lord! I will say it again: Be glad.

dag: Daliri din ni chɛ ka n ku duhi mmaŋa n-yaɣi n ni daa nya kahigibunim pam shɛŋa la zuɣu, ka go shɛli din be kaman Sintani tumo la kuhi ma n-kpalim be n niŋgbuŋ ni ni di muɣisi ma n-chɛ ka n ku duhi mmaŋ yaɣi.
en: But to keep me from being puffed up with pride because of the many wonderful things I saw, I was given a painful physical ailment, which acts as Satan's messenger to beat me and keep me from being proud.

dag: Yi ni shɛb booni tinim la ninvuɣ gbarima, ka hal di ni dihi ma vi la zaa yoli, n saɣi lala! N tɔɣisirimi kaman jɛrigu n-nyɛ ma la. Ka so yi bɔri ni o nyu bara binshɛli zuɣu, n gba ni tooi nyu bara lala:.
en: I am ashamed to say we are too weak to behave in such a way. If they can brag, so can I, but it is a foolish thing to do.

dag: Amaa Dauda tɔbbihi maa bɛn daa kula Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba bɛn daa nyɛ Abinɛr tɔbbihi maa ninvuɣ kɔbisita ni pihiyɔbu.
en: But Davids officers had killed of Abners men from the tribe of Benjamin.

dag: Di saha ka Aizaia daa yɛli, Baɣisimiya fiig tia wala na nti ʒe o bintɔrigu maa ka o nya alaafee.
en: Then Isaiah said, Crush figs together and put them on your sore; you will get well. So they took the mixture of figs and put it on Hezekiahs sore place, and he got well.

dag: ka di chɛ ka yi ni so ku labi nyaaŋa alakanim ŋɔ nyabu zuɣu. Yimaŋmaŋ mi ni di nyɛla Naawuni yubu ni ti nya alakanim ŋɔ tatabo.
en: We didnt want any of you to be shaken by these problems. You know very well that we were meant to go through this.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ, Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka yɛlli ŋɔ tatabo ti niŋ Izraɛlnim ni? Di chaŋ wula ka daŋ yini niriba ti ka Izraɛlnim kalinli ni.
en: They said to God, Lord , you are the God of the Israelites. Why has this terrible thing happened to us? Why has one tribe of the Israelites been taken away.

dag: Ka teeku daa yihi kpiimba bɛn be di ni na, ka Kum mini Kpiimba Biɛhigu Shee yihi kpiimba bɛn be di ni na, ka o daa zaŋ bɛ zaa ni tum tuun shɛŋa n-kari ba saria.
en: Then the sea gave up its dead. Death and the world of the dead also gave up the dead they held. And all were judged according to what they had done.

dag: M banima mini m mabihi, wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli shɛm zabi mmaŋ zuɣu ŋɔ.
en: My friends and leaders of our nation, listen as I explain what happened.

dag: Dinzuɣu zomiya Yawɛ, ka gbaamiya yimaŋ yi tuma ni; dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ bi bɔri ŋaribu bee gaŋbu bee yi bɔri ni niriba tiri ya birapu.
en: So do your work in honor of him and know that he won't allow you to be unfair to anyone or to take bribes.

dag: Amaa ka Nabal nachimba maa ni yino daa chaŋ ti yɛli Nabal paɣ Abigeel, Nyama, Dauda timla tuumba ka bɛ yi o sani mɔɣu maa ni na ni bɛ ti puhi ti kpɛm maa, ka o tu ba.
en: One of Nabal's servants said to Nabal's wife Abigail, Have you heard? David sent some messengers from the wilderness with greetings for our master, but he insulted them.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ŋuni n-lee yɛl a ni a kpuɣim a bindoo chaŋ maa.
en: They asked him, Who is the man who told you to do this.

dag: Ka wula ka nir yɛn niŋ? Dama bɛ ni wum ni a kana.
en: They are sure to hear that you have arrived. What should be done, then?.

dag: Bɛ ni daa nya saŋmariga maa ka bɛ suhuri paligi pam.
en: They were thrilled and excited to see the star.

dag: Ka Jɔbab daa ti kpi, ka Husham ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛmannim tiŋgbɔŋ ni nir la di nam zan o zaani.
en: After Jobab's death, Husham from the land of Teman became king.

dag: Ka o kpambaliba daa kpuɣ o Mɛgido maa niŋ chɛchɛbuŋ ni n-ʒi o kuli Jɛrusalɛm nti sɔɣ o omaŋmaŋ siliga ni. Ka Judanim daa zaŋ Jɔsia bia Jɛhɔahaz n-leei naa zal o ba zaani.
en: A few of Josiah's servants put his body in a chariot and took it back to Jerusalem, where they buried it in his own tomb. Then the people of Judah found his son Jehoahaz and poured olive oil on his head to show that he was their new king.

dag: ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi ti zaŋ tiŋ maa niŋ yi nuu ni, yin zaŋmiya takɔbi ku dɔbba zaa.
en: Then, when the Lord your God lets you capture the city, kill every man in it.

dag: amaa ka ŋmani maa daa yiɣi chaŋ ti bi nya o ni yɛn tam binshɛli zuɣu, dama kom maa daa na kul tɛlila tiŋgbani luɣilikam zaa. Ka o daa lab o sani ŋariŋ maa ni, ka o ti zaŋ o nuu tiri takɔro maa ni n-gbaag o kpɛh o sani ŋariŋ maa ni.
en: Deep water was still everywhere, and when the dove could not find a place to land, it flew back to the boat. Then Noah held out his hand and helped it back in.

dag: Ka o daa ʒini ka boli bɛ pinaayi maa na ti yɛli ba, Ŋun bɔri ni o gari sokam zaa, ŋun zaŋm omaŋ leei bia sokam zaa sani, ka zaŋ omaŋ leei sokam zaa dabili.
en: After Jesus sat down and told the twelve disciples to gather around him, he said, If you want the place of honor, you must become a slave and serve others.

dag: Yisa nyaandoliba zaa bɛn be kpe ŋɔ puhiri ya, di bahi bamdi bɛn be Naa Siiza yiŋ la.
en: All God's people here send greetings, especially those who belong to the Emperor's palace.

dag: Di saha ka Dɔdavahu ŋun daa nyɛ Marɛsha nir la bia Ɛliɛza daa tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi Jɛhɔshafat yɛli, A ni zaŋ amaŋ tabili Ahazia maa zuɣu Yawɛ ni saɣim a tuma maa. Ka ŋarima maa daa chaŋ ti saɣim sol ni ka bi paai Speen.
en: Eliezer, Dodavahus son from Mareshah, prophesied against Jehoshaphat: Because you have formed an alliance with Ahaziah, the LORD will destroy what you have made. The ships were wrecked and couldnt sail to Tarshish.

dag: ka bɛ daa lan mali gbuɣima pinaayi n-tamtam dura maa yaɣ ayi maa zaa naŋgbaŋgbirima zuɣu. O nam ʒiishee maa ŋmali daa ka na so sani.
en: and there were two lion statues on each of the six steps leading up to the throne. No other throne in the world was like Solomon's.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ o. Di saha ka paɣ maa daa yɛli, Gunibu ŋɔ zuɣu a shiri nyɛla n yidana ni yɛlimaŋli ʒim yihibu puuni.
en: So the LORD let him alone. At that time, she announced, A bridegroom because of bloodshed by circumcision.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yɛli Sisɛra ni Barak Abinɔam bia la be Tabo Zoli zuɣu.
en: When Sisera learned that Barak had gone up to Mount Tabor.

dag: O daa zaŋ ba niŋ zuliya shɛb nuu ni, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je ba su ba.
en: God handed them over to the nations; people who hated them ruled over them.

dag: Ka o yɛli salo maa ni bɛ ʒinim tiŋa;.
en: After Jesus had told the people to sit down.

dag: Ti ni daa paai Jɛrusalɛm, ti daa kpalim be nimaani la daba ata.
en: Then we arrived in Jerusalem. We rested there for three days.

dag: N ni yihi ya zuliyanim maa ni mini tiŋgbɔna maa zaa ni n-zaŋ ya labisi yimaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni na.
en: I will take you from every nation and country and bring you back to your own land.

dag: Mbusim be yinim Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba mini Farisiinim bɛn nyɛ bilikɔɣinim ŋɔ zuɣu! Dama yi mɛri duri gindi anabinim gbala, ka maani wuntizɔriba yɛla teebu binyara zaana.
en: It will be bad for you teachers of the law and you Pharisees! You are hypocrites! You build tombs for the prophets. And you show honor to the graves of the godly people who were killed.

dag: Wuhim ma ka n niŋ a yubu, dama nyini n-nyɛ n Naawuni. Chɛ ka a Shi suŋ maa wuhi ma soli din tuhi.
en: You are my God; teach me to do your will. Be good to me, and guide me on a safe path.

dag: Tuumbiɛrinim maa zaa so ʒimi? Bɛ zaŋ n niriba leei bindirigu dira, ka bi jɛmdi ma.
en: Those who are evil treat my people like bread to be eaten. And they never ask for Gods help. Dont they understand what they are doing?.

dag: o yi ti nya ka bia maa bi dol ti labina, o ni kpi; ka tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ ni chɛ ka ti ba ŋun nyɛ a dabili maa kpi ni zab piɛla ni suhugarigu.
en: and when he sees that the young man isnt with us, he will die, and your servants will have sent our father your servant—old as he is—to his grave in grief.

dag: Bɛ nini nyabu yim ka ninsal nuchee daa ti puhi yina n-sabiri sabbu shɛli pari nayili maa dukpini zuɣu m-miri firila ni ʒe luɣ shɛli polo ne viɛnyɛliŋga. Ka naa maa daa nya nuchee maa ni sabiri sabbu maa.
en: Suddenly, a persons hand appeared and began writing on the wall. The fingers scratched words into the plaster on the wall, near the lampstand in the kings palace. The king was watching the hand as it wrote.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ zaŋmi alikama mini chi ni tuya ni sima ni za ni alikama bali shɛli n-niŋ ŋman yini ni m-mali amaŋmaŋ bɔrɔbɔro. Dabisa shɛŋa a ni yɛn do a luɣili zuɣu maa, di nyɛla dabisa kɔbisita ni pihiwɛi, dina ka a ti yɛn ŋubira.
en: You, gather some wheat and barley, beans and lentils, and millet and spelt. Put them in a bowl and make your bread from them. Eat it during the three hundred ninety days that you lie on your side.

dag: Gbaam amaŋ ni jɛritali yɛtɔɣ gbalin chɔɣima tɔɣisibu, dama a mi ni di bahigu tahirila naŋgbankpeeni ŋmɛbu na.
en: Stay away from stupid and senseless arguments. These only lead to trouble.

dag: Zaŋmi gɔpiɛliga dari mali teebuli ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ sɛntimita pihinii ni anii, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ sɛntimita pihinahinaanahi, ka di dubu mi nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: Make a table from acacia wood. The table must be cubits long, cubit wide, and / cubits high.

dag: Yawɛ niŋdi ninvuɣ suma nirilim, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali nia biɛri, o wuhiya ni bɛ mali taali.
en: The Lord likes everyone who lives right, but he punishes everyone who makes evil plans.

dag: a mi di pɔ a zuɣu, dama a ku tooi chɛ ka di zabigu zaɣ yini lɛbigi zaɣ piɛlli bee zaɣ sabinli.
en: Don't swear by your own head. You cannot make one hair white or black.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa ti bɔhi Sool zuɣu, ka zaŋ Dauda so o ni daa di shɛhira suŋ la leei bɛ naa. Naawuni daa yɛliya, N nya Jɛsi bia Dauda ka o nyɛla n nin ni tiɣ so, ka lan nyɛ ŋun ni tum n yubu zaa.
en: Later, God removed Saul and let David rule in his place. God said about him, David the son of Jesse is the kind of person who pleases me most! He does everything I want him to do.

dag: Naawuni nia lɔbu min o ni zali shɛm puuni ka binshɛɣukam zaa niŋda; ka ŋun Naawuni pii ti leeg omaŋmaŋ niriba ti mini Masia ni laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yini kaman ŋun Naawuni ni daa pun lo ka zal li shɛm omaŋmaŋ yubu puuni piligu ni ha la zuɣu.
en: All things are done according to God's plan and decision; and God chose us to be his own people in union with Christ because of his own purpose, based on what he had decided from the very beginning.

dag: ka zaŋ o zali maligumaana Ɛliɛza mini niriba maa zaa tooni n-zaŋ o leei bɛ toondana bɛ zaa ninni.
en: Tell him to stand before Eleazar the priest and all the people. Then make him the new leader.

dag: Jɛsi dapala maa ŋun dee yi be o nyɛvili ni, nyini bee a nam kul ku nya zaashee zani. Dinzuɣu timmi ka bɛ ti zaŋ o na, dama di kpala talahi ni o kpi.
en: As long as Jesses son lives on this earth, neither you nor your dynasty will be secure. Now have him brought to me because hes a dead man.

dag: Ka o daa lan tɔɣis o daanabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Mbaye, Naawuni yi ti niŋ dimbɔŋɔ, ŋuni n-lee ni be?.
en: No one can survive if God plans destruction.

dag: Ŋunkam bɔri ni o doli ma ka bi zaɣis o ba min o ma ni o paɣa ni o mabi dɔbba ni o tizɔpaɣiba ni hal zaŋ tabili omaŋmaŋ nyɛvili gba, o ku tooi niŋ n nyaandola.
en: Those who come to me cannot be my disciples unless they love me more than they love father and mother, wife and children, brothers and sisters, and themselves as well.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm din lu dahim ŋɔ, yilimi suhupiɛlli yila! Dama Yawɛ tilig o tiŋa, ka maag o niriba suhuri.
en: Ruins of Jerusalem, be happy again! Rejoice because the Lord comforted his people and set Jerusalem free.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, Iin, lala n-nyɛ ma; ka yi ni ti nya Daadam Bia ka o ʒila Kpiɔŋlan Naa nudirigu polo m-be sagbana ni kanna.
en: Jesus said, I am. And you will see the Human One sitting on the right side of the Almighty and coming on the heavenly clouds.

dag: Bɛ ni yo a a pagɔrisigu tuma maa samli, ka a nya yi buɣijɛmbo alahichi tibidarigibo, ka baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ a Duuma Yawɛ.
en: And you two sisters—I will punish you for your immorality and your sin of worshiping idols. Then you will know that I am the Sovereign Lord .

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛl o zilima pam ka tur o.
en: And they shouted all kinds of insults at him.

dag: Ka o daa lɔrigi malaikanim anahi shɛb bɛn daa pun mali shili gu di saha maa ni di dabisili maa ni di goli maa ni di yuuni maa ni bɛ ku daadamnim pirigibu ʒii buta puuni yim la.
en: The four angels had been prepared for this very hour and day and month and year. Now they were set free to kill a third of all people.

dag: ka zaŋ tani n-yirigi pili Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa, ka kpuɣi binshɛli din yɛn pili suɣili maa pil li kaman Yawɛ ni daa wuh o shɛm.
en: then the two layers of coverings were hung over them.

dag: Ka wula ka yi lee tɛhira? So yi mali piɛri kɔbiga, ka bɛ ni yino ti bɔrigi, o ku chɛ kɔbigayinika la zoya zuɣu bɛ mɔri ŋubbu shee ka gbaai ŋun bɔrigi maa shee bɔbu?.
en: What do you think? If someone had one hundred sheep and one of them wandered off, wouldnt he leave the ninety-nine on the hillsides and go in search for the one that wandered off?.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Yɛl bɔ? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Nazarɛt do so ŋun yuli booni Yisa, ka o daa nyɛ anab titali o tumtumsa min o yɛtɔɣa ni zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni mini salinim zaa san la yɛla.
en: What things? he asked. The things that happened to Jesus of Nazareth, they answered. This man was a prophet and was considered by God and by all the people to be powerful in everything he said and did.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Ka di chaŋ wula ka Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni ka Naa Dauda daa bol o o Duuma? O daa yɛliya:.
en: Why, then, Jesus asked, did the Spirit inspire David to call him Lord? David said.

dag: M ba, nyam a binyɛrigu naŋgbambili n nuu ni. Yɛlimaŋli, n ni ŋmaag a binyɛrigu naŋgbambili ka bi ku a ŋɔ, di simdi ni a baŋ ni taali bee zaɣ biɛ shɛli ka n sani ni nyini. M bi tum a taal shɛli, hal a ni kul kariti dol ma ni a ku ma maa zaa yoli.
en: Look here, my protector! See the corner of your robe in my hand? I cut off the corner of your robe but didnt kill you. So know now that I am not guilty of wrongdoing or rebellion. I havent wronged you, but you are hunting me down, trying to kill me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti zaŋ bindirigu na ti zali nachin kpɛm maa ni o di, ka o yɛli, Di yi pa ni n yɛlila daliri din tahi ma na, n ku di bindirigu maa. Ka Leeban yɛl o, Yɛlima.
en: and set out a meal for him. But the man said, I wont eat until Ive said something. Laban replied, Say it.

dag: Molimi molo Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka mol li Migidol. Molimi li Mɛmfisi mini Tapanhɛs. Yɛlim ba, Zanimiya yi zaashɛhi, ka maliya shili, dama tɔbu ni di ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa gili ya.
en: Announce this message in Egypt. Tell it in the city of Migdol. Tell it in Memphis and Tahpanhes. Get ready for war, because people all around you are being killed with swords.

dag: Ka bɛ daa tuhiri nintɔri viɛr o, ka deei kaɣili maa fiɛbir o zuɣu ni.
en: They spat on him, and took the stick and hit him over the head.

dag: Yawɛ, a ni ti ti suhudoo; dama yɛlimaŋli, nyini n-chɛ ka ti niŋ ti ni niŋ shɛlikam zaa.
en: LORD, grant us peace, because all that we have done has been your doing.

dag: Ka dabisi shɛli din pahir ata maa dali daa ti paai, ka Jɛrɔbɔam mini niriba maa zaa daa ka Rɛhɔbɔam sanna kaman o ni daa yɛli ba shɛm la, Labimiyana dabisi shɛli din pahir ata dali.
en: Three days later, Jeroboam and the others came back.

dag: Ka Pool daa kul kpɛri Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu nti tɔɣisiri ba Naawuni nam yɛla ni suhukpeeni, ka kul wuhiri ba hal ni chira ata.
en: Paul went into the synagogue and spoke very boldly. He continued doing this for three months. He talked with the Jews, trying to persuade them to accept what he was telling them about Gods kingdom.

dag: Tii maa vari daa viɛli pam ka kul wali gbilim; ka dunia ŋɔ ni daadam kam ni tooi paai li di n-tiɣi. Ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri kanna nti dooni di mahim vuhira, ka noonsi tɛri bɛ tɛri di wula zuɣu.
en: Its leaves were beautiful, and it produced enough fruit for all living creatures; animals lived in its shade, and birds nested in its branches.

dag: Ka Aduna min o bidibisi maa ti mal li paɣiri bɛ nuhi mini bɛ naba.
en: Aaron and his sons will use it to wash their hands and their feet.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa wum yi ni yɛli ma yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa, ka yɛli ma, N wum niriba maa ni yɛl a yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa, bɛ mali yɛlimaŋli bɛ ni tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa shɛŋa maa zaa puuni.
en: The Lord heard what you said and told me, I heard what the people said. And that is fine.

dag: Yi yi yuri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka dol o noli, ka zaŋ yimaŋ tabil o, dina n-ni chɛ ka yi be tiŋgbɔn shɛli Yawɛ ni daa po pɔri n-zaŋ ti yi yaannim bɛn nyɛ Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu la ni.
en: You must love the Lord your God and obey him. Never leave him, because he is your life. And he will give you a long life in the land that he, the Lord , promised to give to your ancestors—Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

dag: Ka a daa yi kul chani luɣ shɛlikam, m bela a sani, ka nyaŋ a dimnim zaa ti a, ka duh a yuli kaman dunia ŋɔ ninvuɣ kara yuya ni du shɛm.
en: I have been with you every place you went. I have defeated your enemies for you. I will make you one of the most famous people on earth.

dag: Ka o ti zaŋ o nubila n-niŋ naɣilaa maa ʒim m-mihi bimpindigu maa tooni, ka lan zaŋ o nubil suɣi ʒim maa m-mihi bimpindigu maa tooni buyopɔin.
en: He will take some of the bulls blood and sprinkle it with his finger on the cover from the east side. He will then sprinkle some of the blood with his finger seven times in front of the cover.

dag: Dabiɛm kpe Ziɔn alahichinim ka bɛ ni sɔhira. Ka bɛ yɛra, Naawuni saria karibo ŋmanila buɣim din diri sahakam. Ka ti ni ŋuni n-lee ni tooi tiligi buɣim maa ni.
en: The sinful people of Zion are trembling with fright. They say, God's judgment is like a fire that burns forever. Can any of us survive a fire like that.

dag: Ti Duuma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, N ni chɛ ka dabiɛm gbahi ya luɣilikam, ka yi wurim, ka sokam kpa o kpabu polo, ka so ku lan beni ŋun ni laɣim kuŋkɔɣinzɔriba luɣ yini.
en: But this is what the Lord GOD All-Powerful says: I will bring troubles to you from every side. You will all run away, and no one will be able to bring you together again.

dag: Paɣisarili mi daa yi yɛn yi paɣiba yili maa ni kpe nayili maa, o ni yɛli ni o bɔri shɛlikam, dina ka bɛ tir o ka o zaŋdi mali kpɛra.
en: When she went from the harem to the palace, she could wear whatever she wanted.

dag: Ka Maata tizo so ŋun yuli daa booni Mariama la daa chaŋ ti ʒini Yisa tooni wumd o yɛtɔɣa;.
en: She had a sister named Mary, who sat down in front of the Lord and was listening to what he said.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, a daa deei bɛ suhigu. A nyɛla Naawuni ŋun daa chɛ bɛ taali, amaa a nyɛla ŋun daa darigi bɛ tibili bɛ tuumbiɛri zuɣu.
en: Lord our God, you answered their prayers. You showed them that you are a forgiving God and that you punish people for the evil they do.

dag: O daa kaai gili nimaani tinsi zaa n-kpaŋsiri Yisa nyaandoliba suhuri pam m-mali ti paai Giriis.
en: He went through those regions and encouraged the people with many messages. Then he came to Achaia.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛl o, Hiburunim Naawuni n-daa ka ti sanna, dinzuɣu ti suhir a mi, chɛ ka ti chaŋ tiŋgban nɛli ni daba ata chandi ti mali sara jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, di yi pa lala o ni chɛ ka alɔbo lu ti zuɣu bee n-chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi ku ti.
en: Moses and Aaron replied, The God of the Hebrews has revealed himself to us. Allow us to travel three days into the desert to offer sacrifices to the Lord our God. If we don't do so, he will kill us with disease or by war.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla n daa zaŋ zalikpan shɛŋa din bi viɛla mini zaligu shɛŋa din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku be n-ti ba.
en: I gave them laws that bring punishment instead of life.

dag: Kamiya n sanna nti zaŋ n naɣikɔra dapua ye n-zaŋ yimaŋ tabili ma m-bɔhim biɛhigu n sani ka nya vuhim; dama n nyɛla tarima zaa.
en: Take my yoke and put it on you, and learn from me, because I am gentle and humble in spirit; and you will find rest.

dag: Yawɛ mi ti tɛha, ka di nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: The LORD does indeed know human thoughts, knows that they are nothing but a puff of air.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ma la di vi, ka birim. Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ni wahala paai ma la ŋmaligi labi ni vi.
en: Disgrace and confuse all who want me dead; turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.

dag: M pun po n kasitali pumpɔŋɔ ni sahakam; n ku ŋma Dauda ʒiri.
en: By my own holiness Ive sworn one thing: I will not lie to David.

dag: Ka a yi yɛn bah o ka o chaŋ, nyin di chɛ ka di muɣis a, dama o tum tuma yuma ayɔbu ti a, ka di gar a ni di yɛn zaŋ laɣ shɛli bu padiriba paa ʒii buyi, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ niŋ alibarika niŋ a tuuni kam ni.
en: Do not be resentful when you set slaves free; after all, they have served you for six years at half the cost of hired servants. Do this, and the Lord your God will bless you in all that you do.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-daa zali ni Izraɛlnim zaŋm li tiri ba dahin shɛli bɛ ni daa booi kpam bahi bɛ zuɣuri ni la. Di nyɛla zaligu din kul yɛn beni bɛ ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: The Lord commanded the Israelites to give those parts to the priests once they have been anointed. That will be their share from the Israelites forever.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa zaŋ salima maa dooi mali binnan shɛli n-zaŋ li zal o ya Ofira, ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa chani ti jɛmdi li. Ka di daa leei zana Gidiɔn min o malibu sani.
en: Gideon fashioned a priestly vest out of it, and put it in his hometown of Ophrah. All Israel became unfaithful there because of it, and it became a trap for Gideon and his household.

dag: Niriba pam kul yɛri ma mi, Naawuni ku sɔŋ a.
en: They talk about me and say, God will not help him.

dag: Amaa dɔr shɛli din zaɣisir maa yi lan yɛlig o niŋgbuŋ maa ni o daɣiri ni yibu maa nyaaŋa.
en: But if the scabies continues to spread over the skin after the persons purification.

dag: Zomiya yi zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu ni, ka tummila din viɛla, dina n-ni chɛ ka yi kul be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni sahakam.
en: If you stop sinning and start doing right, you will keep living and be secure forever.

dag: Dauda ni daa ti miri kum saha shɛli, ka o daa saɣis o bia Sulemaana yɛli.
en: The time came for David to die, so he gave these commands to Solomon.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Izraɛlnima, yi yi ni labi n sanna, yi yi chɛ din chihira n sani maa tumbu, ka chɛnya ʒiɛhi gili.
en: The Lord says, People of Israel, if you want to turn, then turn back to me. If you are faithful to me and remove the idols I hate.

dag: Ti dunia ŋɔ ni banim daa saɣisi ti saha biɛla puuni kaman bɛ ni tɛhi ni di tuhiya shɛm zuɣu; amaa Naawuni niŋdi lala la ti zaɣ viɛlli nyabu zuɣu ni di chɛ ka ti min o laɣim mal o biɛrikasitali.
en: Our human fathers punished us for a short time, as it seemed right to them; but God does it for our own good, so that we may share his holiness.

dag: Nyamiya, yi jɛmbu duu yipa leela dabɔɣu. Ka n yɛri ya mi ni yi ku lan nya ma hal ni saha shɛli yi ni ti yɛn yɛli, Ŋun mali ti Duuma yuli kanna ŋɔ mal alibarika! .
en: Look, your house is abandoned. I tell you, you wont see me until the time comes when you say, Blessings on the one who comes in the Lords name .

dag: A bela alizanda ni ha ka kari saria; ka dabiɛm kpe dunianima, ka bɛ fo baalim.
en: You made your judgment known from heaven; the world was afraid and kept silent.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Jɔn daa bɔhi salo bɛn ka o sanna ni o ti baptaizi ba maa, Yinim garinsi zuliya ŋɔ, ŋuni n-lee saɣisi yi mi ni yi zo n-yi mbusim shɛli din ti yɛn kana ŋɔ ni?.
en: Then John said to the crowds who came to be baptized by him, You children of snakes! Who warned you to escape from the angry judgment that is coming soon?.

dag: ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ŋmaligi ka chɛ Yawɛ dolibu ka bi lan jɛmd o bee m-bɔhir o binshɛli yɛla la birili.
en: I will destroy those who have turned back and no longer follow me, those who do not come to me or ask me to guide them.

dag: O daa chɛ ka wulimpuhili polo pɔhim ʒiɛri zuɣusaa. O yiko puuni ka o daa chɛ ka nudirigu polo pɔhim ʒɛna;.
en: God set the east wind moving across the skies and drove the south wind by his strength.

dag: Juda bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Pɛrɛz mini Hɛzirɔn ni Karimi ni Hur ni Shɔbal.
en: This is a list of Judahs sons: They were Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.

dag: Amaa ka Ibram daa yɛli Zarai Nyama, o nyɛla a dabili, ka a su o fukumsi; niŋm o a ni yu shɛm. Ka Zarai daa yihi Haga halibiɛɣu ka o zo.
en: Abram said, All right! She's your slave—do whatever you want with her. Then Sarai began treating Hagar so harshly that she finally ran away.

dag: Di saha ka Reehab daa zaŋ mii tir o yiŋ maa takɔro ni n-chɛ ka tuumba maa dol li yi tiŋ maa ni, dama o yiŋ maa daa me n-tabilila tiŋ maa gooni.
en: Rahabs house was built into the city wall, so she used a rope to let the men down through a window.

dag: Daadamnim saɣim dunia, dama bɛ birigi Naawuni zalikpana min o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi, ka saɣim o ni daa lo alikauli shɛli ni di kul beni sahakam la.
en: The people have defiled the earth by breaking God's laws and by violating the covenant he made to last forever.

dag: A mi ni Nɛr bia Abinɛr maa kamina ni o ti yɔhim a baŋ a ni doli so shɛli yiri min a ni doli so shɛli kpɛra; ka lan baŋ a ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa.
en: You know Abner son of Ner. He came to trick you. He came to learn all about what you are doing.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa ti me Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa naai.
en: So Solomon finished building the Temple.

dag: M bi simd a yurilim maŋli min a ʒiɛyimtali shɛl a ni ʒe man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ biɛlifu gba, dama n jaaŋgbee kɔŋko ka n daa zaŋ na ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ du; amaa pumpɔŋɔ m malila buni balibu buyi.
en: I dont deserve how loyal and truthful youve been to your servant. I went away across the Jordan with just my staff, but now Ive become two camps.

dag: Ŋuni ka Izraɛl naa lee yina kariti doli ŋɔ? Ŋuni ka a lee kariti doli ni a ku ŋɔ? A kariti dolila ba kpiŋ! A kariti dolila buduli zaɣ bila.
en: Why should the king of Israel be out chasing me, anyway? I'm as worthless as a dead dog or a flea.

dag: Lɛvi zuliya niriba m-bɔŋɔ: Libini daŋ niriba mini Hiburɔn daŋ niriba ni Mahili daŋ niriba ni Mushi daŋ niriba ni Kɔra daŋ niriba. Amiram ba n-daa nyɛ Kɔhat.
en: These are the Levite clans: the Libnite clan, the Hebronite clan, the Mahlite clan, the Mushite clan, and the Korahite clan. Now Kohath fathered Amram.

dag: ka Abishua nyɛ Buki ba, ka Buki nyɛ Uzi ba.
en: Bukki, Uzzi.

dag: Bɛ yi di daa tɛhirila bɛ ni daa pun yi tin shɛl na la yɛla, bɛ daa naan nya soli n-lan lab nimaani.
en: If they had been talking about the land where they had once lived, they could have gone back at any time.

dag: Juda zuliya niriba mini Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba dimnim ni daa wum ni bɛn labina maa mɛrila Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ duu la.
en: The enemies of the people of Judah and Benjamin heard that those who had returned from exile were rebuilding the Temple of the Lord , the God of Israel.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa ti dɔɣi bipuɣiŋga m-bol o yuli Daina.
en: Later, Leah had a daughter and named her Dinah.

dag: Zaŋmi li lo a nubihi ka sabi li niŋ a suhu ni.
en: Keep them at your fingertips and write them in your mind.

dag: Ka yi yi ti be Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya ni yi su maa ni, yin ti miriya ka yi vuɣi yi kpee tiŋgbani tariga kpaa din nyɛ kurimbuni ha niriba ni daa kpa shɛli, ka di be bɛ ni yɛn piri tiŋgban shɛŋa tin ya la ni.
en: Do not move your neighbor's property line, established long ago in the land that the Lord your God is giving you.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Sulemaana daa po Yawɛ n-yɛli, Adɔnija yi bi kɔŋ o nyɛvili yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ zuɣu, Naawuni ŋun niŋm ma zaɣ biɛɣu gar lala!.
en: I swear in the name of the Lord that Adonijah will die because he asked for this! If he doesn't, I pray that God will severely punish me.

dag: N yura, a viɛli pam, a shiri viɛli pam; a nina bemi kaman ŋmana la.
en: My darling, you are lovely, so very lovely— your eyes are those of a dove.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ tuma ni chɛ ka yi kɔŋ n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya la, ka n chɛ ka yi chaŋ ti tumdi tuma tiri yi dimnima yi ni bi mi tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni. Dama n suhuyiɣisili ŋmanila buɣim, ka di kul ni diri sahakam.
en: You will lose the land that I gave you, and I will make you slaves in a foreign country, because you have made my anger blaze up like a fire that won't stop burning.

dag: Miriya ka yi pahi yɛtɔɣ shɛli n ni zali ya zaligu shɛli ŋɔ ni bee n-yihi shɛli di ni. Amaa doliya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa n ni zaŋ tiri ya ŋɔ.
en: Dont add anything to the word that I am commanding you, and dont take anything away from it. Instead, keep the commands of the LORD your God that I am commanding all of you.

dag: Wuntizɔriba nyari bindirigu diri tiɣira, amaa ka kum mali ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: Good people will have plenty to eat, but the wicked will go hungry.

dag: Masia ni daa di wahala o niŋgbuŋ ni shɛm la zuɣu, di simdi ni yi gba zaŋ o tɛha maa tatabo kpaŋsi yimaŋa, dama ŋunkam diri wahala o niŋgbuŋ ni, o bi lan zaŋd o nuu kpɛhiri alahichi tumbu ni.
en: Therefore, since Christ suffered as a human, you should also arm yourselves with his way of thinking. This is because whoever suffers is finished with sin.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba mini Farisiinim shɛb daa yɛli Yisa, Karimba, ti bɔri ni a wuhi ti la shihirili.
en: Some Pharisees and teachers of the Law of Moses said, Teacher, we want you to show us a sign from heaven.

dag: Bɛraya bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Hɛbɛr mini Malikiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Birizait ba la.
en: Beriah was the father of Heber and Malchiel the father of Birzaith.

dag: Wahala mini nandahima m-mali ma, amaa a zaligunima n-nyɛ n suhu ni yu shɛli.
en: Even though I have troubles and hard times, your commands give me joy.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan labi nti suhiri Naawuni n-kul yɛrila yɛtɔɣ yini maa o suhigu maa ni.
en: Again Jesus went away and prayed the same thing.

dag: Ka Dauda daa garigi yɛl o, N dan naa, a kpani maa m-bɔŋɔ, chɛ ka nachimba maa ni yino kana ti zaŋ li.
en: Your Majesty, here's your spear! Let one of your soldiers come and get it.

dag: ka suhi Yawɛ n-yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun ʒi o nam ʒiishee chɛrubinim zuɣu ŋɔ, a kɔŋko n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun su dunia ŋɔ nama zaa, ka nyɛ ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ.
en: Hezekiah prayed to the LORD, saying, LORD God of Israel, you sit enthroned on the winged creatures. You alone are God over all the earths kingdoms. You made both heaven and earth.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Bom tulaale shɛŋa din nyom viɛla, ka nyɛ bɛ ni booni shɛŋa stakiti mini onika ni galibanom ni tulaale zim shɛli bɛ ni booni firanki tulaale la alali din nyom viɛla.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Take an equal part of each of the following sweet spices—stacte, onycha, galbanum, and pure frankincense.

dag: O ni chɛ ka a wuntitali ne kaman wuntaŋ la, ka chɛ ka a yɛlimaŋli be kaman wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha neesim ni be shɛm la.
en: He will make it as clear as day that you are right. Everyone will see that you are being fair.

dag: Hɛzɛkia ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o kpiɔŋ ni o ni daa gbi mɔɣili ka niŋ kɔsoli n-vo kom kpɛhi tiŋ puuni na la zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛŋa bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafinim la ni.
en: Everything else that King Hezekiah did, his brave deeds, and an account of how he built a reservoir and dug a tunnel to bring water into the city, are all recorded in The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ o ni bi yiɣisiri o suhu darigiri niriba tibili, ka mi bi doli bɛ ni tumdi alahichi shɛŋa maa zuɣu.
en: You think that God does not punish, that he pays little attention to sin.

dag: O ni daa wuhiri ba shɛm maa daa gari bɛnkam wum li pam; dama o daa wuhiri ba mi kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun su fukumsi, ka pa ni Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba ni daa wuhiri ba shɛm la.
en: The people were amazed by his teaching, for he was teaching them with authority, not like the legal experts.

dag: Amaa Yisa maligumaanitali tuma nyɛla din gari bɛ maligumaanitali tuma kaman o ni mali alikauli shɛli Naawuni mini ninsalinim sunsuuni ni so alikauli kurili la shɛm, dama di tam la alikaulinim din so zuɣu.
en: But now, Jesus has received a superior priestly service just as he arranged a better covenant that is enacted with better promises.

dag: Ka so yi zaŋla piɛ polli ni o mali sara maa, dindina ŋun malimi li Yawɛ tooni.
en: If you offer a sheep, you must present it to me at the entrance to the sacred tent.

dag: Ka o daa ti lan suhi Naawuni, ka sagbana kpaai kom bahina, ka tiŋgbani zuɣu bimbila lan niŋdi bindira yaha.
en: Once again he prayed, and the sky poured out its rain and the earth produced its crops.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli anabi Zakaria: Yɛlim ba.
en: The LORDs word came to Zechariah.

dag: Di saha ka n daa wum kukol tital shɛli damli Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni ka di yɛri malaikanima ayopɔin la, Zaŋmiya Naawuni suhuyiɣisili ni pali lah ayopɔin shɛŋa la n-chaŋ ti kpaai bahi dunia ni.
en: From the temple I heard a voice shout to the seven angels, Go and empty the seven bowls of God's anger on the earth.

dag: A yi chɛ ka nahu buri a chi, nyin miri ka a zaŋ bini pɔb o noli.
en: When an animal is being used to separate grain, you must not cover its mouth to stop it from eating.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri kul zɔrimi hal so yi bi kariti doli ba, amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn kul malila suhukpeeni kaman gbuɣinli la.
en: The wicked run when no one is chasing them, but an honest person is as brave as a lion.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ʒini Amɔrinim tiŋgbani maa ni hal ni di tintariga Arinɔn Mɔɣili noli shee la zaŋ hal ti paai Jabok n-yi di yɔɣu maa ni m-mali hal ti paai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni.
en: from the Arnon River in the south to the Jabbok River in the north, and from the desert in the east to the Jordan River in the west.

dag: Di saha ka nachimbil so daa ka Yisa sanna ti bɔh o, Karimba, tuun sun bɔ ka n lee yɛn tum ti nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: Once a man came to Jesus. Teacher, he asked, what good thing must I do to receive eternal life.

dag: Ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ suhuri ni tɛha maa ka boli bibil na nti zaŋ o zali baɣil omaŋa.
en: Jesus knew what they were thinking, so he took a little child and stood the child beside him.

dag: Nyini n-su Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ fukumsi, zaŋm a ba min a biɛyanim maa ʒili luɣ viɛlli shee; chɛ ka bɛ ʒini Goshɛn tiŋgban ni. Ka a yi mi bɛ ni bɛn mi biŋkɔbiri gbibbu, nyin chɛ ka bɛ guli n niɣi.
en: the land of Egypt is theirs. Let them settle in the region of Goshen, the best part of the land. And if there are any capable men among them, put them in charge of my own livestock.

dag: Amaa ka naa daa yɛli Absalom, Aai, m bia, di chɛ ka ti zaa kana, di yi nyɛ lala, ti yɛla ni ti muɣis a pam. Ka Absalom daa kpaŋ omaŋa ni o chɛ ka o chaŋ, amaa ka o daa zaɣisi, ka naɣ suhila alibarika niŋ o ni.
en: King David said to Absalom, No, son. We will not all go. It will be too much trouble for you. Absalom begged David to go. David did not go, but he did give his blessing.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka wɔɣ shɛb bɛn mal lɔɣu pam yina ti dimdi Izraɛlnima ka bɛ pam daa kpi.
en: Then the Lord sent poisonous snakes that bit and killed many of them.

dag: Yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni zaa o daa kul bela gbala maa shee mini zoya zuɣu kuhiri ka mali kuɣa jɛr omaŋa.
en: Day and night he stayed around the burial caves and on the hills. He would scream and cut himself with rocks.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn yɛri noya tiri niriba, amaa nyin niŋdila alibarika niŋdi niriba ni. Naawuni, chɛ ka bɛn nahindi ma maa di vi, amaa ka chɛ ka a dabili mali suhupiɛlli.
en: They curse me, but you can bless me. They attacked me, so defeat them. Then I, your servant, will be happy.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ zuliya bahila yoli zaŋ Hɛshibɔn hal ni Dibɔn, ka ti ŋmani saɣiri doya hal ka buɣim ti di m-paai Mɛdɛba.
en: But we defeated those Amorites. We destroyed their towns from Heshbon to Dibon, from Nashim to Nophah, near Medeba.

dag: Bɛ ni booni kuɣ viɛl shɛli jasipa la ka bɛ daa zaŋ me gooni maa, ka tiŋ maa maŋmaŋ nyɛ salima din nyɛ alali n-ne kaman diɣi la.
en: The wall was built of jasper, and the city was pure gold, like pure glass.

dag: Nooŋa ni yiɣiri gind o tiɛɣu shɛm la, lala ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni guli Jɛrusalɛm. O ni fa li bahi, ka gul li.
en: Just as a bird hovers over its nest to protect its young, so I, the Lord Almighty, will protect Jerusalem and defend it.

dag: Zuɣusaa wuhir o wuntitali; ka zuliya kam zaa nyar o jilima.
en: The heavens announce, The Lord brings justice! Everyone sees God's glory.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan zaŋ o yɛligu ti Hagai m-pahi buyi kulla gol yino maa biɛɣ pisinaanahi dali n-yɛl o.
en: On that same day, the twenty-fourth of the month, the Lord gave Haggai a second message.

dag: ni Patirusinima ni Kasilunima ni Kriitinima .
en: Pathrusim, Casluhim, from whom the Philistines came, and Caphtorim.

dag: Naa Sulemaana ni daa me Yawɛ jɛmbu du shɛli maa puuni wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita pisinaayopɔin; ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita awɛi ka di dubu mi nyɛ mita pinaata ni pirigili.
en: The temple that King Solomon built for the LORD was ninety feet long, thirty feet wide, and forty-five feet high.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ di o shɛhira o ni tumdi ni nimmoo yi mini Laodisianim ni Hiɛrapolisnim zuɣu shɛm.
en: I can vouch for him that he has worked hard for you and for those in Laodicea and Hierapolis.

dag: Ka paɣ so ŋun nyɛ yɛdaniŋda yi mali pakoya o dɔɣiriba ni, di simdi ni o lihiri ba, ka di zaŋ di yɛla ʒili cheechi, ka lala niŋbu ni chɛ ka cheechi mi tooi lihi pako shɛb bɛn nyɛ pako maŋa la.
en: If a woman who is a follower has any widows in her family, she should help them. This will keep the church from having that burden, and then the church can help widows who are really in need.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti ŋme solɔɣu yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni kuli Asiria tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Ka Asirianim ti kani Ijipti na, ka Ijiptinim gba kani Asiria na; ka Ijiptinim mini Asirianim ti laɣim jɛm Yawɛ.
en: At that time a good road will run from Egypt to Assyria. The Egyptians and the Assyrians will travel back and forth from Egypt to Assyria, and they will worship together.

dag: Amaa Azazɛl kuɣili ni gbaai bula so la ŋuna o ni ti zaŋ o la zaɣ nɛɔŋ ti Yawɛ n-yo bɛ daalahichi samli, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o tahi mɔɣu ni nti ti Azazɛl.
en: But the goat chosen by the lot for Azazel will be brought alive before the Lord . Then this goat will be sent out to Azazel in the desert. This is to make the people pure.

dag: Ti paɣiri Zallakudura Naa ŋun chɛ ka a nyaŋ a dimnim ŋɔ! Ka Ibram daa zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa pia puuni zaɣ yiniyini yihi Mɛlikizɛdɛk zaka.
en: May the Most High God, who gave you victory over your enemies, be praised! And Abram gave Melchizedek a tenth of all the loot he had recovered.

dag: A ba daalibarika mali kpiɔŋ gari zoya din doya sahakam ŋɔ mini kuŋkuna din kul beni sahakam ŋɔ daalibarika. Naawuni chɛ ka o daalibarika ŋɔ zaa be Yisifu ŋun min o mabihi daa woligi ŋɔ zuɣu ni, ka be o gbɛɣu zuɣu.
en: The blessings of your father exceed the blessings of the eternal mountains, the wealth of the everlasting hills. May they all rest on Josephs head, on the forehead of the one set apart from his brothers.

dag: Bɛ zaa yinoyino gbib bɛ bidibbina bɛ nuhi ni n-ʒe n-gil naa, ka ŋunkam kani bɛ sanna, bɛn kum o. Naa yi ti chani luɣ shɛlikam, bɛn kul be o sani.
en: Surround the king completely, each of you with your weapons drawn. Whoever comes near your ranks must be killed. Stay near the king wherever he goes.

dag: Ka tɔb maa daa kpaɣi mii Sool, ka peentɔriba daa nya o n-to o piɛm ti o daŋ pam.
en: The battle grew even more intense around Saul. The archers closed in on Saul and wounded him with many arrows.

dag: Ka nachimba pia bɛn daa nyɛ Jɔab gbaɣino ʒiriba daa laɣim gili Absalom m-bahi jɛh o.
en: Then ten young armor-bearers of Joab surrounded Absalom, struck him, and killed him.

dag: Yinim Izraɛlnima, wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm, dama tiŋgbani ŋɔ nim mali galimi o sani. Ʒiɛyimtali lan kani, ka nirilim lan kani, ka so bi lan mi Naawuni tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: The Lord has an accusation to bring against the people who live in this land. Listen, Israel, to what he says: There is no faithfulness or love in the land, and the people do not acknowledge me as God.

dag: O daa zaŋdila o bidibisi nyɔri buɣim maani sara Hinnom Bidibisi Vinvamli la ni, ka daa buɣiri baɣisi, ka niŋdi laasabu, ka chani jinwariba mini timanim sani. O daa tum alahichi pam Yawɛ sani n-chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi pam.
en: He sacrificed his sons in Hinnom Valley as burnt offerings. He practiced divination and magic and consulted fortunetellers and mediums. He sinned greatly against the Lord and stirred up his anger.

dag: Yɛlimiya Izraɛlnima: Binshɛli yi yi doo tooni na, din yi o tooni na maa nyɛla daɣiri.
en: to say to the community of Israel: Any man with an infected penis is unclean.

dag: Chɛchɛbunsi sapashin kpamba maa ni daa ti nya Jɛhɔshafat, bɛ daa yɛlimi, Izraɛl naa maa m-bala. Di saha ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi lu o zuɣu ni bɛ tuh o, ka o daa kuhi, ka Yawɛ sɔŋ o n-kari ba bahi ka chɛ o.
en: So when they saw King Jehoshaphat, they all thought that he was the king of Israel, and they turned to attack him. But Jehoshaphat gave a shout, and the Lord God rescued him and turned the attack away from him.

dag: Ka hal bɛn daa lu maa yi chɛ biɛhiŋ, Naawuni ni zaŋ ba labisi tuɣi, dama o mali yiko din ni tooi lan labisi ba tuɣi yaha.
en: And even those who were cut off will be grafted back in if they dont continue to be unfaithful, because God is able to graft them in again.

dag: o ni bela a sani kaman padira bee tumtumda n-tumd a tuma hal ni nɛma labisi ti yuuni la ni.
en: They will be like hired workers and visitors with you until the year of Jubilee.

dag: Ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba kpɛm mini maligumaaniba daa wum lala ka di gari ba pam, ka bɛ bi mi yɛlli maa ni yɛn bahindi shɛm.
en: The captain of the temple police and the chief priests listened to their report, but they did not know what to think about it.

dag: Ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni kpamba shɛb daa yiɣisi zani n-yɛli salo bɛn daa laɣim maa zaa.
en: A few of the community elders got up and addressed the whole crowd.

dag: Ka ŋun ʒi nam ʒiishee maa yɛli, Nyama, m mali binshɛɣukam zaa ka di niŋ zaɣ pala! Ka lan yɛli ma, Sabimi dimbɔŋɔ sɔŋ, dama yɛligu ŋɔ nyɛla nira ni ni niŋ shɛli naani, ka lan nyɛ yɛlimaŋli.
en: Then the one sitting on the throne said: I am making everything new. Write down what I have said. My words are true and can be trusted.

dag: Dama bɔhimi ninkura nya bɛ yaannim ni daa mi shɛli.
en: Ask those who are now old. Find out what their ancestors learned.

dag: Ti yab Naa Dauda nam din kanna ti Duuma yuli ni ŋɔ mal alibarika! Paɣimiya Zallakudura Naa.
en: God bless the coming kingdom of King David, our father! Praise be to God.

dag: Ka Giliadnim daa kpalim be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli. Ka bɔ n-chɛ ka Dan zuliya niriba la mi daa kpalim be bɛ ŋarima gbini? Asha zuliya niriba gba daa kpalim be teeku duli. Bɛ daa kpalim ʒinila teeku duli maa.
en: The people of Gilead stayed across the Jordan. Why did the tribe of Dan remain on their ships and the tribe of Asher stay along the coast near the harbors?.

dag: Di sɔɣi bɛ taali maa, a mi di kpihim bɛ daalahichi maa a sani, dama bɛ yɛli zilima pam tammɛriba maa ninni.
en: Don't forgive the evil they do and don't forget their sins, for they have insulted us who are building.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa daa yiɣisi zani salo maa sunsuuni m-bɔhi Yisa, A ka noli din ni garigi? Shɛhira bɔ ka bɛ lee dir a ŋɔ.
en: The High Priest stood up in front of them all and questioned Jesus, Have you no answer to the accusation they bring against you.

dag: O daa lan chɛ ka bɛ lab mali Yawɛ sara maligu bimbin la, ka o daa mali suhudoo mini wumpaɣibo sara di zuɣu, ka daa zali Judanima ni bɛ jɛmmi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni maa.
en: He restored the LORDs altar, offered well-being sacrifices and thank offerings on it, and ordered the people of Judah to worship the LORD, Israels God.

dag: Saha shɛli n ni daa kumdila, n daa bi di li; saha shɛli n ni daa be daɣiri ni la, n daa bi pii di shɛli. Ka m mi daa bi zaŋ li mali kpiimba. Ti deei nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ noli. Ti tum a ni zali ti ni ti tum shɛm zaa.
en: I havent eaten from the holy portion while mourning, nor did I remove it while I was polluted, nor have I dedicated any of it to the dead. Ive obeyed the LORD my Gods voice. Ive done everything just as you commanded me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kpe siliga maa ni nti nya ka nachimbil so ye binyɛr piɛlli ʒi bɛ nudirigu polo, ka di gari ba pam.
en: The women went into the tomb, and on the right side they saw a young man in a white robe sitting there. They were alarmed.

dag: Ka ŋun daa ʒi wɔhu zuɣu maa zaŋ takɔbi din yir o nol ni na ku bɛn kpalim, ka noonsi zaa daa di nimdi tiɣi.
en: But the rest of their army was killed by the sword that came from the mouth of the rider on the horse. Then birds stuffed themselves on the dead bodies.

dag: O yiko ka o zaŋ su nam sahakam, ka pa o nina lihiri zuliya kam. Duŋtaariba miri ka bɛ taai duŋ niŋ o.
en: His mighty power rules forever, and nothing the nations do can be hidden from him. So don't turn against God.

dag: Rubin mini Simiɔn ni Lɛvi ni Juda.
en: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah.

dag: Ka Musa deemba maa daa nya lala ka bɔh o, Bɔ ka a lee niŋdi tiri niriba maa? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a kɔŋko ʒiya ka niriba maa zaa ʒe n-gil a asiba hal ni zaawuni.
en: When Jethro saw everything that Moses had to do, he asked, What is all this that you are doing for the people? Why are you doing this all alone, with people standing here from morning till night to consult you.

dag: Puhimiya Naawuni ŋun be zuɣusaa ŋɔ. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Give thanks to the God of heaven; his love is eternal.

dag: Yi yi di fo yi noya, di naan leei yi baŋsim.
en: Say nothing, and someone may think you are wise!.

dag: Ka Nan bia Jɔshua mini Jɛfune bia Kalɛb bɛn daa pahi chaŋ ti puɣisi nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa la daa dari tɔhi bɛ binyɛra.
en: Joshua and Caleb tore their clothes in sorrow.

dag: O gba daa dolila Naa Ɛhab daŋ niriba naba, dama o ma n-daa nyɛ o saawaralana n-wuhir o ka o tumdi tuumbiɛri.
en: Ahaziah walked in the ways of Ahabs dynasty, encouraged in this wickedness by his mother.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ yuli ni ka ti sɔŋsim yirina.
en: Our help is in the name of the LORD, the maker of heaven and earth.

dag: ka suhi Yawɛ yɛra.
en: Hezekiah prayed to the LORD.

dag: dama Jɔn daa yɛl o ni di chihiri ni o fa o tizo Filip paɣa.
en: John told Herod, It is not right for you to be married to your brothers wife.

dag: Ninsalinim biɛhigu soli wuhiri ya ni doo yi mali zab wɔɣila di nyɛla vi.
en: Why, nature itself teaches you that long hair on a man is a disgrace.

dag: Yawɛ ku chɛ ba niŋ bɛ nuu ni, bee n-chɛ ka bɛ kari ba saria n-wuhi ni bɛ kum ba.
en: But the LORD wont leave the righteous to the power of the wicked, and wont let the righteous be found guilty when they are judged.

dag: Yawɛ chɛ ka yi zaa yinoyino nya biɛhigu shee yi yidaannim yinsi. Ka Naomi daa chɛbisi ba ka ŋmaligi. Ka paɣiba ayi maa zaa dii kuhiri.
en: May he give each of you another husband and a home of your own. Naomi kissed them. They cried.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Samsin paɣ maa ti do so ŋun daa nyɛ Samsin aŋgo zo.
en: The father of the bride made Samson's wife marry one of the young men that had been at Samson's party.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Daina ŋun daa nyɛ Yaakubu mini Liya bipuɣiŋga la daa ti chaŋ ni o ti puhi tiŋ maa ni paɣiba;.
en: Dinah, the daughter of Jacob and Leah, went to visit some of the women who lived nearby.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa yɛl o yiŋ tumtumdiba kpɛma, Niŋm bindira su niriba maa kpalansi ni ka di saɣi bɛ ʒibu tariga, ka zaŋ bɛ zaa yinoyino liɣiri niŋ bɛ kpalansi noya ni;.
en: Later, Joseph told the servant in charge of his house, Fill the men's grain sacks with as much as they can hold and put their money in the sacks. Also put my silver cup in the sack of the youngest brother. The servant did as he was told.

dag: N ni daa ti gbaai yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu saha shɛli ka Naawuni Shia Kasi kana nti kpe bɛ ni kaman o ni daa kpe ti ni shɛm di piligu ni la.
en: When I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell on them, just as the Spirit fell on us in the beginning.

dag: Ka Krispus ŋun daa nyɛ Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu zuɣulan la min o yiŋnim zaa daa niŋ ti Duuma yɛda ka Kɔrintinim pam bɛn daa wum Pool yɛligu maa gba daa niŋ yɛda ka deei kom baptaizibu.
en: Crispus was the leader of the synagogue. He and everyone in his family put their faith in the Lord. Many others in Corinth also heard the message, and all the people who had faith in the Lord were baptized.

dag: A bidibisi yi ni gbibi n daalikauli maa mini n ni yɛn zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa wuhi ba, bɛ bidibisi gba ni ti ʒiini a nam ʒiishee maa zuɣu sahakam.
en: And if your children keep my covenant and the laws that I will teach them, then their children too will rule on your throne forever.

dag: Binshɛɣukam yɛla wumdi daadam ka di ka yɛtɔɣa. Nini bi nyari tiɣira, ka tibili mi bi wumdi tiɣira.
en: All of life is far more boring than words could ever say. Our eyes and our ears are never satisfied with what we see and hear.

dag: Nahimmiya Midiannima, ka ku ba.
en: Attack the Midianites and destroy them.

dag: Hal n yi kuhi, Famiya ma! so bi garigiri ma. N daa duhi n yee pam, amaa ka so daa bi ti ma yɛlimaŋli.
en: Though I pray to be rescued from this torment, no whisper of justice answers me.

dag: Lala ka n yɛn niŋ n-chɛ ka a kɔre min a pagɔrisigu tuun shɛli a ni daa ʒi n-yi Ijipti na la zani tariga. Ka a kɔre ku lan kpe bɛ ni bee n-lan teei bɛ yɛla.
en: I will put a stop to your lust and to the obscenities you have committed ever since you were in Egypt. You won't look at any more idols or think about Egypt any more.

dag: Yaakubu daa yɔhim Leeban ŋun daa nyɛ Aram nir maa, o ni daa bi yɛl o ŋun Yaakubu ni daa lo ni o yiɣisi nimaani la zuɣu.
en: Jacob tricked Laban the Aramean. He did not tell Laban he was leaving.

dag: O daa tum tuumbiɛri Yawɛ sani kaman o ba Manaasa ni daa tum shɛm la. Amɔn daa kɔri biŋkɔbiri m-mali binnan shɛŋa zaa o ba Manaasa ni daa mali zal la, ka jɛmdi li.
en: Amon did evil before the Lord , just as his father Manasseh had done. Amon offered sacrifices for all the carved idols and statues that Manasseh his father made. Amon worshiped those idols.

dag: Ka Firawuna min o kpambaliba nini daa tiɣ o ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: This advice seemed wise to Pharaoh and all his servants.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa ti paai Bɛtisaida, ka bɛ zaŋ zoon so tah o sanna nti balim o ni o zaŋ o nuu shih o.
en: They came to Bethsaida, where some people brought a blind man to Jesus and begged him to touch him.

dag: Ka so shɛli din kuni nyɛvili shee dolibu mi to, ka di dunoli nyɛ duno muɣiliŋga, ka niriba bɛn mi dol li bi yaɣ lala.
en: But the gate that leads to life is narrow and the road difficult, so few people find it.

dag: Ŋunkam be nyam niŋm li mihi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi be nyam daba ata dali ni daba ayopɔin dali. O niŋm lala yihi ba daɣiri ni daba ayopɔin dali, di nyaaŋa ka bɛ paɣi bɛ binyɛra ka su kom, zaŋ chaŋ zaawuni ka bɛ leei bɛn be nyam.
en: If this is done on the third day and on the seventh day, you will be clean. Then after you take a bath and wash your clothes, you can worship that evening.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa zo Izraɛlnim nambɔɣu ka niŋ ba nirilim; ka sɔŋ ba; o ni daa lo Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu alikauli shɛl la zuɣu ka o daa bi chɛ ka bɛ zaa kpi. O mi daa bi zaɣisi ba hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: But the LORD was gracious to Israel and had compassion on them, turning back to them because of his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; he didnt want to destroy them or throw them out of his presence until now.

dag: Ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa lan lo tab alikauli Yawɛ tooni, ka Jɔnatan daa kuli, ka Dauda mi kpalim be Hɔrɛshi.
en: The two of them made a sacred promise of friendship to each other. David stayed at Horesh, and Jonathan went home.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka niriba mini bɛ paɣiba daa ti piligi kumdi pampam niŋdi bɛ dɔɣiriba bɛn nyɛ Yɛhudianim la.
en: Many of the poor people began to complain against their fellow Jews.

dag: Yi ni tahi ninvuɣ shɛb ŋɔ na bi ʒiɛmdi buɣili Aritɛmis ŋun nyɛ ti ni jɛmdi buɣ so la n-tur o.
en: You brought these men here, but they have not said anything bad against our goddess. They have not stolen anything from her temple.

dag: N daa pii chɛrubi zali ka o gul a, ka a be Naawuni zoli din be kasi zuɣu. A daa bela buɣim kuɣa ni chana.
en: I appointed a winged creature to guard your home on my holy mountain, where you walked among gems that dazzled like fire.

dag: N fabili yi zuɣu gari n ni fabindi Jazanim zuɣu shɛm. Yinim Sibimanima, yi ŋmanila wain tia din wula baai du teeku n-zo hal ti paai Jaza. Ŋun saɣindi la lu yi siɣili saha tiwala mini yi wain tiwala zuɣu.
en: I cry with the people of Jazer for Jazer. Sibmah, in the past your vines spread all the way to the sea. They reached as far as the town of Jazer. But the Destroyer has taken your fruit and grapes.

dag: Amɔn yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaayi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam, o daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuma ayi.
en: Amon was years old when he became king of Judah. He was king for two years in Jerusalem.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka ti paai Sidɔn, ka sapashini Julius daa niŋ Pool nirilim wɔɣis o ka o chaŋ o zɔnim sani ka bɛ ti niŋ o saani.
en: The next day we landed in Sidon. Julius treated Paul kindly and permitted him to go to some friends so they could take care of him.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la. Yi daa bi mi Naawuni so, naɣila mani. Ka tiligira so kani pahi n zuɣu.
en: I have been the Lord your God since the time you were in the land of Egypt. You did not know any other god except me. I am the one who saved you.

dag: Di yi pa lala, bɛ ni be kaman gbuɣinli la n-gbaai ma vu n-chaŋ luɣ shɛli ŋun ni fa ma bahi ni kani nti dari tɔhitɔhi ma.
en: Otherwise, they will rip me apart, dragging me off with no chance of rescue.

dag: Lahibali ni daa ti nti to Firawuna yiŋa ni Yisifu biɛyanima n-kana, di daa niŋ Firawuna min o kpambaliba nyaɣisim pam.
en: When the news reached the palace that Joseph's brothers had come, the king and his officials were pleased.

dag: Ka Dauda daa kpuɣi Filistia doo maa zuɣu maa n-kuli Jɛrusalɛm, amaa ka daa lee zaŋ o tɔbutuhiri nɛma ti niŋ ŋun Dauda maŋmaŋ suɣili ni.
en: David took the Philistines head to Jerusalem, but he kept the Philistines weapons at home.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni zaŋ o chaŋ luɣ shɛli maa ka o ti yɛn kpi. O nini ku lan nya o tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ yaha.
en: He will die in the country where they have taken him, and he will never again see this land.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa wum di yɛla, ka bɔri ni o ku Musa. Amaa ka Musa daa zo Firawuna sani n-kuli Midian tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Dahin shɛli ka o daa ti ʒi kɔbiliga gbini.
en: When Pharaoh heard about it, he tried to kill Moses. But Moses ran away from Pharaoh and settled down in the land of Midian. One day Moses was sitting by a well.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, Yiŋbi yino ku tooi jɛm duumanima ayi: O kul ni zaɣisila yino ka yuri ŋun la bee n-tibigi yino n-jɛm o, ka ʒiɛm ŋun la. Yi ku tooi jɛm Naawuni mini liɣiri.
en: You cannot serve two masters at the same time. You will hate one and love the other, or you will be loyal to one and not care about the other. You cannot serve God and Money at the same time.

dag: Di saha ka Ila bia Hɔshia daa lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ Rɛmalia bia Pɛka polo ŋ-ŋme o luhi n-ku o, ka deei nam maa di n-zan o zaani, Uzia bia Jɔtam ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisi saha.
en: Then Hoshea, Elahs son, plotted against Pekah, Remaliahs son. He struck Pekah down, murdering him. Hoshea became king after Pekah in the twentieth year of Uzziahs son Jotham.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu o nyɛla ŋun ni tooi tiligi bɛn vu m-miri Naawuni o zuɣu la sahakam, dama o nyɛla ŋun kul be ni o timdi sandaani tiri ba Naawuni sani.
en: And so he is able, now and always, to save those who come to God through him, because he lives forever to plead with God for them.

dag: ka fara lu a zuɣu kaman ŋmɛnditol la, ka fakari lu a zuɣu kaman tɔbbia ŋun gbibi bidibbina la.
en: and poverty will come on you like a prowler, destitution like a warrior.

dag: Piimiya sariakaritiba mini tuma kpamba Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ fɔntin shɛŋa tin ya maa zaa ni kaman yi daŋdaŋ ni nyɛ shɛm, ka bɛ ti doli zaligu soli maani niriba yɛla.
en: Appoint judges and officials for each of your tribes in every city that the LORD your God gives you. They must judge the people fairly.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ, dabiɛm yi ti mali ma, nyini ka n ni niŋ naani.
