en: but even when I am afraid, I keep on trusting you.

dag: Di saha ka Ayuba daa garigi yɛli.
en: If my troubles and griefs were weighed on scales.

dag: Dina n-chɛ ka Manaasa zuliya niriba maa daa deei tiŋgbana taribu maa bupia m-pahi Giliad mini Bashan din daa be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli din la polo la zuɣu;.
en: Manasseh had ten parcels in addition to the land of Gilead and Bashan on the other side of the Jordan.

dag: Kurimbuni ha ka a nam ʒiishee pun mali ʒiɛya. Kurimbuni ha ka a pun be.
en: Your throne is set firm for a very long time. You are eternal!.

dag: M mi ni bin sun shɛli ka n ni. N ninsalitali biɛhigu yɛla ka n yɛri maa. Hal n ni yu zaɣ suŋ tumbu n suhu ni maa zaa yoli, n kul bi tooi tumdi li.
en: I know that good doesnt live in me—that is, in my body. The desire to do good is inside of me, but I cant do it.

dag: Di zaa yoli, ka o zaŋ bin suma pali bɛ yinsi. Amaa ninvuɣ biɛri ni lo shɛli ka n je.
en: And yet it was God who made them prosperous— I can't understand the thoughts of the wicked.

dag: Amaa ti ni daa zaŋ Absalom so leei ti naa maa kpi tɔb ni. Ka pumpɔŋɔ bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bi yɛli shɛli zaŋ chaŋ naa maa zaŋbuna polo.
en: We anointed Absalom to be the king, but he was killed in battle. So we should bring David back to be the king again.

dag: Naawuni, chɛ ka a tibiginsim du n-gari zuɣusaa, ka chɛ ka a jilima be dunia ni zaa.
en: Rise above the heavens, God. Let all the world see your glory.

dag: Ti ni nyɛ bɛn mini Naawuni laɣim tumdi zuɣu, ti suhiri ya ni yi di deeya Naawuni daalibarika la yoli.
en: We work together with God, and we beg you to make good use of God's gift of undeserved grace.

dag: Piim dɔbba pinaayi bɛn nyɛ Izraɛl zuliya pinaayi la ni niriba.
en: Pick twelve men from the people, one man per tribe.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ guhirimi ni o zɔn ya nambɔɣu. O bɔri ni o zɔn ya nambɔɣu, dama o nyɛla ŋun kul niŋdi din tuhi. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ Yawɛ naani mal alibarika.
en: So the Lord is waiting to show his mercy to you. He wants to rise and comfort you. The Lord is the God who does the right thing, so he will bless everyone who waits for his help.

dag: Ka n ni daa ŋmahi bɔrɔbɔro kpila ayopɔin dihi niriba tusaanahi la, yi bi teei yi ni daa laɣisi di gba pali piɛ shɛŋa tariga la yɛla?.
en: And what about the , people and all those baskets of leftovers from only seven loaves of bread?.

dag: Amaa di yi pa lala, buɣim din yim Abimilɛk ni na ti di yinim Shɛkɛmnim mini Bɛtimilɔnima; ka chɛ ka buɣim yi yinim Shɛkɛmnim mini Bɛtimilɔnim gba ni na ti di Abimilɛk.
en: But if not, may fire blaze out from Abimelech and burn up the men of Shechem and Bethmillo. May fire blaze out from the men of Shechem and Bethmillo and burn Abimelech up.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Ka ŋunkam lu kuɣili maa zuɣu ni chɛrisichɛrisi, amaa kuɣili maa mi yi lu so zuɣu, di ni niɛm o buɣibuɣi kaman zim la.
en: Everyone who falls on that stone will be cut to pieces; and if that stone falls on someone, that person will be crushed to dust.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa ti faai siɣi o yaannim sani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o o ba Dauda tiŋ la ni; ka o bia Rɛhɔbɔam daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Solomon lay down with his ancestors and was buried in Davids City with his father. His son Rehoboam succeeded him as king.

dag: Saŋmariga maa yuli daa boonila Yabiga. Ka kom pirigibu ʒii buta puuni yim leei kɔtɔɣu yabiga maa zuɣu, ka niriba pam daa nyu li ka kpi, kom maa ni daa to maa zuɣu.
en: The name of the star was Bitterness. And a third of all the water became bitter. Many people died from drinking this bitter water.

dag: Ka o daa lan wurim bɛ ni daa me binshɛli zali nayili Vuhim Dabisili zuɣu la, ka ŋari Yawɛ jɛmbu duu sambani polo duno shɛli bɛ ni daa chib ti naa ni o doli kpɛr la. Asiria naa zuɣu ka o daa niŋ shɛm maa.
en: He took down the special tent that was used for worship on the Sabbath and closed up the private entrance that the kings of Judah used for going into the temple. He did all these things to please Tiglath Pileser.

dag: Cheechi shɛŋa din be Ɛsha tiŋgbɔŋ ni nim puhiri ya. Akuila mini Prisila ni cheechi din laɣindi bɛ yiŋ puuni la puhiri ya pam ti Duuma ni.
en: Greetings from the churches in Asia. Aquila and Priscilla, together with the church that meets in their house, send greetings in the name of the Lord.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ takɔbi maa ti ni bɛ nyɛhi li ka di neei, ka bɛ zaŋ li gbibi nuu ni. Bɛ sahi takɔbi maa, ka nyɛhi li ka di neei ni bɛ zaŋ li niŋ ninvuɣ so ŋun kuri niriba nuu ni.
en: The sword is being polished, to make it ready for use. It is sharpened and polished, to be put in the hands of a killer.

dag: Ka Ɛbɛd bia Gaal maa daa yɛli, Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Abimilɛk, ka tinim Shɛkɛmnim ti jɛmd o? Gidiɔn bia mini Zɛbul ŋun nyɛ o sapashin kpɛm la daa bi jɛmdila Hamɔr ŋun daa nyɛ Shɛkɛmnim yab la niriba? Ka bɔzuɣu ka ti yɛn jɛm o?.
en: Gaal said, What kind of men are we in Shechem? Why are we serving Abimelech? Who is he, anyway? The son of Gideon! And Zebul takes orders from him, but why should we serve him? Be loyal to your ancestor Hamor, who founded your clan!.

dag: Lɛvi mabia Asaf ŋun daa be o nudirigu polo jɛmbu duu maa ni la daa nyɛla Bɛrɛkia bia, ka Bɛrɛkia nyɛ Shimia bia.
en: Asaph was Heman's relative and served as his assistant. Asaph's ancestors included Berechiah, Shimea, Michael, Baaseiah, Malchijah, Ethni, Zerah, Adaiah, Ethan, Zimmah, Shimei, Jahath, Gershon, and Levi.

dag: Dindali maa Sool tumtumdib ni do so daa bela nimaani ni o mali maligu shɛli Yawɛ tooni, o daa nyɛla Ɛdom nira ka o yuli booni Doɛg, ŋuna n-daa nyɛ Sool piɛgul kpɛma.
en: Saul's chief herdsman, Doeg, who was from Edom, happened to be there that day, because he had to fulfill a religious obligation.

dag: Buɣim daa di n-ku bɛ nachimbihi, ka paɣisara daa kɔŋ amiliya lɔbu yila.
en: Fire destroyed the young men, and the young women were left with no one to marry.

dag: Saha shɛli Judas ŋun daa yi Yisa nyaaŋa la ni daa ti wum ka bɛ yɛli ni bɛ kum Yisa, ka o daa galim omaŋa, ka zaŋ anzinfa kpil pihita la labisi ti ti maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba.
en: Judas saw that they had decided to kill Jesus. He was the one who had handed him over. When he saw what happened, he was very sorry for what he had done. So he took the silver coins back to the leading priests and the older leaders.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Naa Bɛlishaaza daa ti laɣim o kpambaliba tuhili na ni bɛ ti puhi chu titali ka nyu wain.
en: One night King Belshazzar invited a thousand noblemen to a great banquet, and they drank wine together.

dag: Ka Samsin daa chaŋ ka o mini paɣisarili maa ti nya taba, ka Samsin suhu daa yu o pam.
en: Then he traveled down and talked with the woman; she was the one Samson wanted.

dag: Ka pɔhim maa ʒiɛri ba, ka bi chɛra, ka bɛ zo yomyom ni bɛ yi pɔhim kpiɔŋ maa ni.
en: throws itself on them without mercy; they flee desperately from its force.

dag: Ka Dibɔn Mɔɣili kom daa deei ʒim mɔhi, amaa di zaa yoli, n ni niŋ Dibɔnnim din bie n-gari lala. Iin, gbuɣinli ni doli Mɔab ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim, ka nyɛ bɛn zɔri ni bɛ tiligi la.
en: The water of Dimon is full of blood, and I will bring even more troubles to Dimon. A few people living in Moab have escaped the enemy, but I will send lions to eat them.

dag: Dindali maa, n ni boli Hilikia bia Ɛliakim ŋun nyɛ n dabili la na.
en: At that time I will call for my servant Eliakim son of Hilkiah.

dag: Teemiya yi zuɣulaannim bɛn daa wuhi ya Naawuni yɛtɔɣa la yɛla, ka kpahimya bɛ biɛhigu ni daa nyɛ shɛm hal ti paai kum la, ka chɛliya ka yi yɛda niŋbu be kaman bɛ yɛda niŋbu.
en: Remember your leaders. They taught Gods message to you. Remember how they lived and died, and copy their faith.

dag: Ka Yisa daa gbaai niriba wuhibu biɛɣukam Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni. Ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba ni tiŋ maa ni kpamba daa bɔri so shɛli bɛ ni yɛn doli ku o;.
en: Jesus taught the people in the Temple area every day. The leading priests, the teachers of the law, and some of the leaders of the people wanted to kill him.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yisifu sani bindir shɛŋa nti ti ba. Amaa Bɛnjamin dini daa gar o tab maa dini ʒiibunu zuɣu. Ka bɛ daa nyu binnyura, ka bɛ min o zaa suhuri paligi.
en: Portions of food from Josephs table were brought to them, but Benjamins portion was five times as large as theirs. So they drank together and were at ease.

dag: nti yɛli ba: Yinim Juda nanim mini Judanim zaa ni Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa bɛn doli dunɔdaya ŋɔ kpɛra, Wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Say to the people, Listen to this message from the Lord . Listen, kings of Judah. Listen, all you people of Judah. All you who come through these gates into Jerusalem, listen to me!.

dag: Naa Atazɛrikisɛs nam dibu yuma ayopɔin saha ka Izraɛlnim shɛb mini Maligumaaniba ni Lɛvinim ni yiliyiiniba ni dunɔguliba ni Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba gba daa kuli Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Other Jews, including priests, Levites, musicians, the temple guards, and servants, came to Jerusalem with Ezra. This happened during the seventh year that Artaxerxes was king.

dag: Di daba ata dali ka bɛ daa ti yɛli Leeban ni Yaakubu yiɣisiya zo.
en: Three days later Laban found out that Jacob had gone.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Naa Dauda ni Yawɛ niŋla alibarika niŋ Obɛdɛdom min o malibu zaa ni, Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa zuɣu. Di saha ka Dauda daa chaŋ ti kpuɣi Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa Obɛdɛdom yiŋa n-zaŋ li kuli ŋun Dauda tiŋ la ni ni suhupiɛlli.
en: King David was told, The LORD has blessed Obed-edoms family and everything he has because of Gods chest being there. So David went and brought Gods chest up from Obed-edoms house to Davids City with celebration.

dag: Bɔ ka yɛnnim lee zaŋ so jɛra? Ka nyɔ bɔ ka tarimba lee nya bɛ ni niŋdi shɛm ni bɛ gbib bɛmaŋa niriba ni?.
en: In the same way a wise person is no better than a fool is. It is better to be a poor person who knows how to accept life as it is.

dag: ni salima lahi pihita ni anzinfa la shɛŋa kɔbisinahi ni pia ni la shɛŋa yaha, ka di gba nyɛ tuhili.
en: gold bowls, silver bowls similar to the gold bowls, and other dishes.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ tipawumlinim bɛn tɛhi ni tiliginsim be katiŋ ŋɔ, wummiya!.
en: Listen to me, you stubborn people who think that victory is far away.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa yɛli, Nyamiya o ni yuri Lazarɔs shɛm.
en: See how much he loved him! the people said.

dag: Cham ti yɛli n dabili Dauda ni man Yawɛ bɔhir o, A yɛn mɛla duu ti ma ka m be di ni.
en: Go and tell my servant David that I say to him, You are not the one to build a temple for me to live in.

dag: Naa Jɔsia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisaayika saha, ka o daa tim Azalia bia Shafan ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmara, ka nyɛ Mɛshulam yaaŋa la Yawɛ jɛmbu duu n-yɛl o.
en: During the th year that Josiah was king, he sent Shaphan son of Azaliah son of Meshullam, the secretary, to the Lord s Temple. Josiah said.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Din ku tooi nani ninsalinim sani nyɛla din ni tooi nani Naawuni ŋun sani.
en: Jesus replied, What is impossible for humans is possible for God.

dag: Tiŋ kam daa malila di biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee ka di gil li. Lala n-daa nyɛ di tinsi maa zaa.
en: Each of these cities had its pastures around it. This was the case for all these cities.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ daba ayi ka Yawɛ lan yɛli ma, Cham Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni pumpɔŋɔ nti yihi n ni daa yɛl a ni a zaŋ jinjɛŋŋma shɛli ti sɔɣi nimaani la na.
en: After a long time, the LORD said to me: Return to the Euphrates and dig up the undergarment that I commanded you to bury there.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, Chɛ ka di niŋ lala pumpɔŋɔ, dama di simdi ni ti tum din ni chɛ ka Naawuni ni zali shɛm zaa niŋ pali. Di saha ka Jɔn daa saɣi ka baptaiz o.
en: Jesus answered, Allow me to be baptized now. This is necessary to fulfill all righteousness. So John agreed to baptize Jesus.

dag: Bɛ yihi ba neesim ni m-bahi zibisim ni, ka kari ba yihi dunia yili.
en: thrown far from the light into a world of darkness.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa gbaai Yaakubu pam ka o suhu zɔhira. Ka o daa pirig o niriba bɛn be o sani min o biŋkɔbbaligu ni o niɣi ni o laakumnim ʒii buyi.
en: Jacob was so frightened that he divided his people, sheep, cattle, and camels into two groups.

dag: Ka o daa ti be o buɣili Nisirok duu n-jɛmdi li, ka o bidibisi bɛn nyɛ Adirammɛlɛk mini Sharɛza daa zaŋ takɔbi ku o ka zo n-kuli Ararat tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Ka o bia Ɛsarihadɔn daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: One day Sennacherib was in the temple of his god Nisroch, worshiping him. His sons Adrammelech and Sharezer killed him with a sword and ran away to Ararat. So his son Esarhaddon became the new king of Assyria.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni n ti zaŋ Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tin ya; ka nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Remember—I am the Lord your God! I rescued you from Egypt and gave you the land of Canaan, so that I would be your God.

dag: Naawuni, tim ma suhu yini, ka ti ma tɛh pala din tuhi n suhu ni.
en: Create a pure heart in me, O God, and put a new and loyal spirit in me.

dag: Ka salo maa bɔh o, Ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ.
en: The crowds asked John, What should we do.

dag: Yilimiya wumpaɣibo yila paɣi Naawuni. Yilimiya wumpaɣibo yila! Yilimiya wumpaɣibo yila paɣi ti naa maa. Yilimiya wumpaɣibo yila!.
en: Sing praises to God our King.

dag: Yuma ata nyaaŋa ka n daa ti chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ni n ti kaai Pita. Biɛɣ pinaanu ka n daa niŋ o sani.
en: Three years later I went to visit Peter in Jerusalem and stayed with him for days.

dag: Dunianim zaa ni ti nya ka bɛ zaŋla Yawɛ yuli booni ya, ka bɛ ti zɔri ya.
en: Then all the peoples on earth will see that the Lord has chosen you to be his own people, and they will be afraid of you.

dag: Bindirigu maa dibu nyaaŋa, ka o daa lan zaŋ wain pipia ka yɛli, Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni daalikauli shɛli o ni lo n ʒim ni. Dina n-nyɛ n ʒi shɛli din ti yɛn yi n niŋgbuŋ ni yi zuɣu.
en: In the same way, after supper, Jesus took the cup of wine and said, This wine represents the new agreement from God to his people. It will begin when my blood is poured out for you.

dag: Gol so ŋun pahir ayi ni ka niriba pam daa laɣim Jɛrusalɛm ni bɛ ti puhi Bɔrɔbɔro Din ka Dabindi Chuɣu la. Bɛ daa galisiya pam.
en: A great number of people gathered in Jerusalem in the second month to celebrate the Festival of Unleavened Bread.

dag: A min a zuliya maa ni yɛn doli n daalikauli shɛli maa m-bɔŋɔ: Di simdi ni yi puuni doo kam guni.
en: This is my agreement that all of you must obey. This is the agreement between me and you and all your descendants. Every male must be circumcised.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka dɔro balibu kam ni mali ninvuɣ shɛb pam kpaŋ, ka daa kari alizin biɛri niriba pam zuɣu bahi, ka bi saɣi ni alizin biɛri maa yɛli shɛli, dama bɛ daa mi o ni nyɛ so.
en: He healed many who were sick with all kinds of diseases, and he threw out many demons. But he didnt let the demons speak, because they recognized him.

dag: Di saha ka Sulemaana daa yi jɛmbu shee din be Gibiɔn Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la ni n-labi Jɛrusalɛm ti su Izraɛlnima.
en: Solomon then left Gibeon and returned to Jerusalem, the capital city of Israel.

dag: Daadam, zaŋm a nini kpa Sidɔn polo n-tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi li.
en: Son of man, look toward Sidon and speak for me against that place.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Ziɔn paɣiba nyɛla karimbaannima, bɛ duhila bɛ zuɣuri zuɣusaa chani lihiri kɔre lihigu. Bɛ yaarila bɛ naba n-nɔri nyamnyam sarisiri chana.
en: The Lord said, Look how proud the women of Jerusalem are! They walk along with their noses in the air. They are always flirting. They take dainty little steps, and the bracelets on their ankles jingle.

dag: Bin ayi ka n suhir a ni a ti ma li pɔi ka n naanyi kpi.
en: Two things I ask of you; dont keep them from me before I die.

dag: Bɛ daa bela mɔɣu ni kuhiri kaman bunsi la, ka laɣim do gɔhi tihi gbinni.
en: where they bray like donkeys gathering around shrubs.

dag: Bɛn nyari nahiŋgu mini nandaamba ni be di ni chani gindi ka mali bɛ naba nɔri li.
en: Now the poor and abused trample all over that city.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Galimi dini ka yi yaannim daa lee nya n sani, ka zo n-chaŋ katiŋ ti jɛmdi binyoya ka chɛ ma, ka bɛ gba maŋmaŋ daa leei ninvuɣ yoya la?.
en: This is what the LORD says: What wrong did your ancestors find in me that made them wander so far? They pursued what was worthless and became worthless.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa yɛli Izraɛlnim maa, Naawuni yi ti yihi ya tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, yin ʒimiya n kɔba mali kuli; ka daa chɛ ka bɛ po di pɔri.
en: Then Joseph asked his people to make a vow. Promise me, he said, that when God leads you to that land, you will take my body with you.

dag: Di lan sabi yaha, Bɛ ni gbib a bɛ nuhi ni, ka a napɔŋ ku tuui kuɣili kam. .
en: It also says, They will hold you up with their hands so that not even your feet will be hurt on the stones.

dag: ka chɛ a niriba bɛn tum alahichi a sani maa mini biriginsim shɛli bɛ ni birig a sani maa zaa taali, ka zo ba nambɔɣu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbahi ba leei daba maa sani, ka lala chɛ ka bɛ gba zo ba nambɔɣu.
en: Forgive all their sins and their rebellion against you, and make their enemies treat them with kindness.

dag: Yɛndana suhu bɔrila kumsi ni be yil shɛli, amaa jɛra suhuri bɔrila suhupiɛlli ni be yil shɛli.
en: The wise heart is in the house that mourns, but the foolish heart is in the house that rejoices.

dag: Ka o daa duh o yee pam kuhi yɛli, Babilɔn din nyɛ tin tital la luya! Di leela alizin biɛri biɛhigu shee ka leei tabizahim shia kam zaŋ tabili noom biɛɣ kam bɛn mali daɣiri biɛhigu shee.
en: He cried out in a loud voice: She has fallen! Great Babylon has fallen! She is now haunted by demons and unclean spirits; all kinds of filthy and hateful birds live in her.

dag: Buni mini azichi ni be bɛ yinsi, ka bɛ wuntitali kul ni beni sahakam.
en: His family will be wealthy and rich, and he will be prosperous forever.

dag: Bimbira kpila tiŋgban ni, ka ti kambɔna kpalim zaɣ kuma, ka ti kunchuna zaa saɣim, dama ti chi zaa kuuya.
en: The grain shrivels under the shovels; the barns are empty. The granaries are in ruin because the grain has dried up.

dag: Wula ka yi ni tooi yɛli, Ti nyɛla gandammoya ka nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi.
en: You cannot say, We are good soldiers. We are brave men in battle.

dag: ka bo o biŋkɔbbaligu ni piɛnyaŋ bee bunyaŋ na nti ti Yawɛ o ni tum alahichi shɛli maa zuɣu, ka di leeg o daalahichi maa sanyoo sara maligu, ka maligumaana zaŋ li yo o daalahichi maa samli.
en: Then you must bring a female sheep or goat to me as the price for your sin. A priest will sacrifice the animal, and you will be forgiven.

dag: Nandaamba kul ku kɔŋ dunia ŋɔ ni, dinzuɣu ka n zali ya, Teemiya yi nuu n-tim faranim mini yi ʒiʒiinitab bɛn nyɛ nandaamba bɛn be yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni pina.
en: Poor persons will never disappear from the earth. Thats why Im giving you this command: you must open your hand generously to your fellow Israelites, to the needy among you, and to the poor who live with you in your land.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, ansarisi maaniba ʒiɛla n sani, ka n lihiri bɛ ni kuri ma suli shɛm.
en: People stand around me and laugh at me. I watch them as they tease and insult me.

dag: A nyɛla ŋun yuri din tuhi, ka je zaɣ biɛɣu. Dinzuɣu ka Naawuni ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ piig a, ka zaŋ suhupiɛlli niŋ a ni n-gari a na taba.
en: you love what is right and hate what is evil. That is why God, your God, has chosen you and has poured out more happiness on you than on any other king.

dag: Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba maa, Wummiya pukpar bimbira ŋahili la gbinni:.
en: Consider then the parable of the farmer.

dag: n yi di di daatam ka bi yo di zuɣu, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛn su li kpi.
en: I always paid the workers for the food I got from the land. I never let any of them starve.

dag: A kul malila shɛhira pala jɛndiri ma, ka a suhuyiɣisili kul pahiri zaŋ chaŋ m polo; ka a kul zaŋdi tɔbbi pala liriti ma.
en: You always have some witness against me; your anger toward me grows and grows; you always plan some new attack.

dag: Yilimiya yil palli, ka ŋme mɔɣilɔnim viɛnyɛliŋga n-yo suhupiɛlli vuri paɣ o!.
en: Sing a new song to him, play the harp with skill, and shout for joy!.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli, Dimbɔŋɔ n-yɛn chɛ ka yi baŋ ni Yawɛ n-shiri tim ma na ni n ti tum tuma ŋɔ zaa, ka di pala mmaŋmaŋ yubu ka n tumda.
en: Moses said to the crowd, The Lord has chosen me and told me to do these things—it wasn't my idea. And here's how you will know:.

dag: Puu atam kpuɣibu saha naaya, ka wuuni du, ka ti na bi tiligi.
en: The people complain, Spring and summer have come and gone, but still the Lord hasn't rescued us.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kɔrigi Yaɣigari chuɣu piɛbil la goli so ŋun pahir ayi maa biɛɣu pinaanahi dali. Ka vi daa gbahi maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinima, ka bɛ daa mali bɛmaŋ kasi, ka zaŋ bɛ ni nyɔri sara shɛli buɣim la kpe Yawɛ jɛmbu duu.
en: Then they killed the Passover lamb on the th day of the second month. The priests and the Levites felt ashamed. They made themselves ready for holy service. The priests and the Levites brought burnt offerings into the Lord s Temple.

dag: Bɛ ni ti bahi yoli, dama bɛ ni zaŋ shɛli leei bɛ bin jɛmdili nyɛla be niŋgbuŋ kɔre; bɛ nyuri bara la di ni simdi ni vi mali ba shɛli zuɣu, ka bɛ baɣa kul bela dunia ŋɔ binyara ni kɔŋko.
en: They are going to end up in hell, because their god is their bodily desires. They are proud of what they should be ashamed of, and they think only of things that belong to this world.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, pa nyini n-yɛn me n jɛmbu duu maa, amaa a ni ti yɛn dɔɣi bidib so n-ti yɛn me jɛmbu duu maa ti n yuli jilima.
en: you yourself wont build that temple. Instead, your very own son will build the temple for my name.

dag: Yawɛ, kari doli ba ni suhuyiɣisili nti kpihim bɛ birili dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Get angry and go after them until not a trace is left under the heavens.

dag: Anabinim tɔɣisirila anabitali yɛtɔɣa din nyɛ ʒiri, ka maligumaaniba doli anabinim maa ni wuhiri ba shɛm n-tumdi bɛ tuma. N niriba maa n-yu lala. Amaa di yi ti paai di tariga, wula ka yi yɛn niŋ.
en: prophets speak nothing but lies; priests rule as the prophets command, and my people offer no objections. But what will they do when it all comes to an end.

dag: So yi bɔr ni o yo pia kam puuni yim maa zuɣu ka dee li, o ni yo di daa pirigibu ʒiibunu yim zuɣu pahi.
en: If someone wishes to buy back part of their tenth-part gift, they must add one-fifth to it.

dag: n-yaai li mahilaa ni ti zal o tooni, ka o zaɣisi li ŋubbu, ka yɛl o, Karimi sokam ka bɛ yi ka chɛ ma, ka bɛ zaa daa yi.
en: and emptied them out of the pan for him to eat, but he wouldn't. He said, Send everyone away—and they all left.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ bɛ me gooni gili ya, ka teei gili ya. Bɛ zaŋ jaaŋgbee fiɛbi Izraɛl naa tapaɣa.
en: Jerusalem, enemy troops have surrounded you; they have struck Israel's ruler in the face with a stick.

dag: Yi ni sɔɣ yɛli shɛlikam zibisim ni ni ti yi neesim ni; ka yi ni sɔɣ ŋumsi shɛli duu puuni, bɛ ni mol li gili luɣilikam.
en: What you say in the dark will be told in the light. And what you whisper in a private room will be shouted from the top of the house.

dag: A yurilim maŋli la kul bela n tooni, ka n dol a ni ʒiɛyimtali.
en: I never forget your kindness, and I am always faithful to you.

dag: amaa n yi tumdi li, hal yi yi bi niŋ ma yɛda, yin niŋmiya n tuma maa yɛda, ka di chɛ ka yi shiri baŋ ka niŋ yɛda ni m Ba be n ni ka n gba be o ni.
en: But if I do what my Father does, you should believe because of that, even if you don't have faith in me. Then you will know for certain that the Father is one with me, and I am one with the Father.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛliya, N tɛha pala yi tɛha, ka yi soya mi pala n soya.
en: The Lord says: My thoughts and my ways are not like yours.

dag: Dabisili kam yɛrila dabisili din dolina di yɛla, ka yuŋ kam yɛri yuŋ din dolina di yɛla.
en: Each day announces it to the following day; each night repeats it to the next.

dag: Ka naa daa pirig o nintu shɛli zuɣu o dalinli ni daa dihi tabili, ka nyɛ o ni daa deei shɛli Haman san la ti Mɔdɛkai. Ka Ɛsta daa zaŋ Haman yili maa ti Mɔdɛkai ni o su di fukumsi.
en: The king had gotten his ring back from Haman. The king took the ring off his finger and gave it to Mordecai. Then Esther put Mordecai in charge of everything that belonged to Haman.

dag: Nyini n-daa chɛ ka teeku kom nyuui, ka a mali soli kom puuni sɔŋ, ka a ni daa tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb la dol li du.
en: Didnt you dry up the sea, the waters of the great deep? And didnt you make the redeemed a road to cross through the depths of the sea, a road for the redeemed to pass?.

dag: Bindira balibu kam din daŋ niŋbu ka nyɛ din viɛla mini sara maligu balibu kam nyɛla maligumaaniba dini. Di lan simdi ka yi zaŋ yi ni tuui ŋɔri zim shɛli ti maligumaaniba maa din ni chɛ ka alibarika be yi yinsi.
en: The best of the early produce of every kind, and every contribution, all of them, belong to the priests. You will give the best of your bread dough to the priest so that a blessing may come to rest on your household.

dag: Ka ŋun daa zaŋ yɛmbimbiɛri n-nahindi ti yaannim maa ka muɣisiri ba ka bɛ zaŋdi bɛ biliɛri bahira ni bɛ zuliya maa kpihim.
en: He tricked our ancestors and was cruel to them. He even made them leave their babies outside, so they would die.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la. N ni lan chɛ ka yi be suɣa ni yaha kaman yi ni daa pun be di ni shɛm yi chuɣu puhibu dabisa saha la.
en: I am the LORD your God from the land of Egypt; I will make you live in tents again, as in former days.

dag: A ti ma a tiliginsim nyɔtaɣirigu, ka a nudirigu sɔŋ ma. A chɛ ka n leei ninvuɣ titali a sɔŋsim zuɣu.
en: You alone are my shield. Your right hand supports me, and by coming to help me, you have made me famous.

dag: Binshɛli ku niŋ ba n zoli din be kasi la zuɣu. Dama Yawɛ baŋsim ni ti pali dunia ŋɔ ni kaman kom ni pali teeku shɛm la.
en: On Zion, God's sacred hill, there will be nothing harmful or evil. The land will be as full of knowledge of the Lord as the seas are full of water.

dag: Chɛ ka ti niɣi kpe baɣa pam, ka di chɛ ka bɛ zaŋdi bahira. Di chɛ ka ti doli solɔri kuhiri nandahima kumsi.
en: so that our cattle can be loaded with calves; so that there wont be any breach in the walls, no exile, no outcries in our streets!.

dag: Wummiya, dama n yɛn tɔɣisila bintitaŋa yɛtɔɣ viɛla, ka din yɛn yi n noli ni na nyɛla din tuhi.
en: Listen, because what I say is worthwhile and right.

dag: Bee wula ka a ni tooi yɛl a mabia ni o chɛ ka a yihi bimburigin shɛli din be o ninni ka daantaliga lee sa amaŋmaŋ ninni?.
en: How dare you say to your brother, Please, let me take that speck out of your eye, when you have a log in your own eye?.

dag: dama nyɛvili gari bindirigu, ka niŋgbuŋ mi gari situra.
en: Life is more important than food, and the body is more important than what you put on it.

dag: Dinzuɣu n suhiri ya ni yi lan wuhimiy o yi yurilim ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ o sani.
en: You should make them sure of your love for them.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi baɣa be yi taba yɛla ni kaman di ni be yimaŋmaŋ yɛla ni shɛm.
en: Dont be interested only in your own life, but care about the lives of others too.

dag: N ni zaŋ o kpa luɣ viɛlli shee viɛnyɛliŋga kaman kpaa la, ka o leeg o daŋ niriba jilima nam ʒiishee.
en: I will fasten him firmly in place like a peg, and he will be a source of honor to his whole family.

dag: O daa chɛ ka sagbana bɔɣi ka o siɣina; ka zibisim titali be o naba tiŋli.
en: He tore open the sky and came down. He stood on a thick, dark cloud.

dag: Yi ni nya kpahimbu shɛŋa pam la zaa kpalimla yoli? Di yi shiri nyɛla yoli, m bɔri ni m baŋ.
en: Did you experience so much for nothing? I wonder if it really was for nothing.

dag: Ka o bol o nyaandoliba na ti yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, pako faralan ŋɔ tɔhiya gari bɛnkam zaa tɔhi liɣiri maa;.
en: He called his disciples together and said to them, I tell you that this poor widow put more in the offering box than all the others.

dag: Gɛrishɔn daŋ niriba ni daa deei fɔntin shɛŋa zaa kalinli daa yiɣisila tinsi pinaata m-pahi di zaa biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee zuɣu.
en: This is the total of all cities of the Gershonites for their clans: thirteen cities with their pastures.

dag: Ka ninsal daa boli niɣi zaa mini noonsi zaa ni mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri zaa yuya; amaa ka ninsal ŋun daa lee ka sɔŋda ŋun nyɛ o kpee.
en: The man gave names to all the tame animals, to all the birds in the air, and to all the wild animals. He saw many animals and birds, but he could not find a companion that was right for him.

dag: n yi yɛli gballi, M ba n-nyɛ a, ka yɛli zunzuli, M ma n-nyɛ a, bee, N tizɔpaɣa n-nyɛ a.
en: Ive called corruption my father, the worm, my mother and sister.

dag: Bɛ kali ma pahila kpiimba ni; n ŋmanila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka sɔŋsim.
en: I am considered as one of those plummeting into the pit. I am like those who are beyond help.

dag: Miriya ka yi ŋub nimdi ka ʒim na be di ni. Di ti bɔhimya baɣitali bee sotali.
en: You must not eat anything with its blood. You must not participate in divination or fortune-telling.

dag: Nɛbuzaradan ŋun daa nyɛ yiliguliba sapashin kpɛm maa daa chɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ nandaamba ka ka binshɛli niŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. Di saha maa o daa ti ba wain tihi puri mini pu shɛŋa pahi.
en: But commander Nebuzaradan left behind some of the poor people of Judah who owned nothing. Nebuzaradan gave them vineyards and farmland in Judah.

dag: Dinzuɣu yinima nanima, niŋmiya yɛm, yinim dunia ŋɔ zuɣulaannima, deemiya saɣisigu ŋɔ.
en: Now listen to this warning, you kings; learn this lesson, you rulers of the world:.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sab gbana ti Yɛhudianim zaa bɛn daa be Naa Ahasivɛrɔs tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣa kɔbiga ni pisinaayopɔin la zaa ni. Gbaŋ maa puuni yɛtɔɣa daa nyɛla Yɛhudianim suhudoo mini yɛlimaŋli puhigu.
en: Copies of this letter were sent to Jews in the provinces of King Xerxes. In the letter they said: We pray that all of you will live in peace and safety.

dag: Amaa bɛn zo n-tiligi ni ti be Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu, ka di be kasi. Ka Yaakubu zuliya ni ti lan deei bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ la su yaha.
en: But on Mount Zion there will be those who escape, and it will be holy; and the house of Jacob will drive out those who drove them out.

dag: Bɛ yi yɛl a, Kamina ti pahi ti zuɣu, chɛ ka ti dɔni gu n-ku so, ka chɛ ka ti liri bɛn ka taali.
en: Suppose they say, Come on; let's find someone to kill! Let's attack some innocent people for the fun of it!.

dag: N ni paɣi Yawɛ paɣibu shɛli din nyɛ o dini o wuntitali zuɣu, ka yili yila paɣi ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ yuli.
en: I praise the Lord because he is good. I praise the name of the Lord Most High.

dag: Ka o ni ti yɛn bahi nyaŋ o dim so ŋun bahindi nyaaŋa nyɛla kum.
en: The last enemy to be destroyed will be death.

dag: Ka n ti chɛ ka yi ya ŋɔ leei dabiɛm shee mini ansarisi malibo shee, ka ŋunkam ti gari kpe, dabiɛm ni gbaag o, ka o mal li ansarisi zaɣ biɛ shɛŋa din niŋ maa zaa zuɣu.
en: I will turn Jerusalem into a pile of rubble, and every passerby will be shocked and horrified and will make insulting remarks.

dag: nti yɛl o paɣ Zɛrɛshi min o zɔnim la zaa dinkam niŋ o. Di saha ka o yɛndaannim la min o paɣ Zɛrɛshi yɛl o, A mini Mɔdɛkai so ŋun kpa tab ŋɔ ni nyɛ Yɛhudia nir la zuɣu, o pilig a la luhibu maa. A kul ku tooi nyaŋ o, amaa ŋuna n-naɣ ni nyaŋ a.
en: He told his wife and all his friends everything that had happened to him. Then she and those wise friends of his told him, You are beginning to lose power to Mordecai. He is a Jew, and you cannot overcome him. He will certainly defeat you.

dag: Ka Babilɔn naa daa ti chɛ ka bɛ bu ba, ka ku ba Ribila din be Hamat tiŋgbɔŋ ni la. Bɛ ni daa gbahi Judanim maa bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni kuli tinzun tiŋgbɔŋ ni shɛm m-bala.
en: in the territory of Hamath. There the king had them beaten and put to death. So the people of Judah were carried away from their land into exile.

dag: Ka bɛn daa ʒiri Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa daa yi kul chaŋ napɔŋ yaabu buyɔbu zuɣu, o chɛrimi ka bɛ zani ka o kɔrigi naɣilaa mini naɣilalantabili mali sara.
en: When the men who carried the Lord s Holy Box had walked six steps, they stopped and David sacrificed a bull and a fat calf.

dag: Pɛriʒia Naa Sairus ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ alizanda Naawuni ŋɔ n-zaŋ ma leei dunia ŋɔ zaa naa, ka zali ma ni m me duu ti o Jɛrusalɛm, Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: This is the command of Cyrus, Emperor of Persia. The Lord , the God of Heaven, has made me ruler over the whole world and has given me the responsibility of building a temple for him in Jerusalem in Judah.

dag: Ŋunkam zaa tumdi tuumbiɛri je neesim ka mi ku saɣi chaŋ neesim ni, o tuumbiɛri maa ti yi palo zuɣu.
en: Everyone who does evil hates the light. They will not come to the light, because the light will show all the bad things they have done.

dag: Di simdi ni bɛ paɣi Yawɛ yuli; dama o noli ni yɛligu ka o daa zaŋ nam ba.
en: Let all things praise the name of the Lord , because they were created at his command.

dag: Dan ni ti ŋmanila sokpaŋ tinvurigu. O nyɛla sokpaŋ gariŋga ŋun dimdi wɔhu napɔŋkpaa, ka ŋun bar o lɛbiri lur o kpali zuɣu.
en: Dan will be like a snake at the side of the road. He will be like a dangerous snake lying near the path. That snake bites a horses foot, and the rider falls to the ground.

dag: Rɛkab Jɔnadab bihi maa doli bɛ yabidoo maa ni zali ba shɛm, amaa niriba ŋɔ bɛn bi deei n noli.
en: The Rechabites have obeyed the command of their ancestor Jonadab, but you have not obeyed me.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ŋme n-deei bɛ fɔntinsi mini bɛ kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛŋa la. Dindali maa Mɔab tɔbbihi suhuri ni ti bemi kaman paɣa ni wolisiri ni o dɔɣi ka o suhu be shɛm la.
en: and the towns and fortresses will be captured. On that day Moab's soldiers will be as frightened as a woman in labor.

dag: Di bi simdi ka dabindi be yi yinsi daba ayopɔin maa ni. Ka ŋunkam di binshɛli din mali dabindi, dilan ni yi Izraɛlnim laɣiŋgu ni, dilan yi nyɛla sana bee tiŋbia.
en: During these seven days no yeast is allowed in anyone's home, whether they are native Israelites or not. If you are caught eating anything made with yeast, you will no longer be part of Israel.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛlnima, Tiŋgbɔn shɛli yi ni yɛn pihi kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya ka piri ti tab maa m-bɔŋɔ. Dina ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ni o ni zaŋ li ti zuliya awɛi ni pirigili la.
en: So Moses gave this command to the Israelites, That is the land that you will get. You will throw lots to divide the land among the nine tribes and half the tribe of Manasseh, as the Lord commanded.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ n shia niŋ yi ni, ka yi leei nyɛviyanima, ka n zaŋ ya niŋ yimaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Di saha ka yi ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-daa yɛli lala, ka mi shiri ni niŋ li. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa. .
en: I will put my Spirit in you, and you will come to life again. Then I will lead you back to your own land. Then you will know that I am the Lord . You will know that I said this and that I made it happen. This is what the Lord said.

dag: Amaa n ni zaŋ n daalikauli n-lola Yisahaku so Zara ni yɛn dɔɣi ti a yuuni na ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha la.
en: But I will set up my covenant with Isaac, who will be born to Sarah at this time next year.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisahaku biŋkɔbiguliba maa daa lan gbi kɔbil shɛli, ka bɛ daa lan niŋ ba naŋgbankpeeni di zuɣu; dinzuɣu ka Yisahaku daa boli kɔbiliga maa yuli dimdi kɔbiliga.
en: Isaac's servants dug another well, and there was a quarrel about that one also, so he named it Enmity.

dag: Kaman kom ni yi zo n-liilii kuɣa, ka kopaliga ʒi tiŋgbani taŋkpaɣu chaŋ shɛm, lala ka a saɣindi daadam tahima.
en: Water will wear down rocks, and heavy rain will wash away the soil; so you destroy our hope for life.

dag: Naa guliba sapashin kpɛm maa daa lan kpuɣi la bihi mini buɣim moori bina ni taha ni duɣuri ni firilatamdisi ni chɛriti ni salima mini anzinfa la shɛŋa bɛ ni daa mali niŋdi sara maligu kom la.
en: The commander of the guard took whatever gold or silver he could find as well: the small bowls, the fire pans, the sprinkling bowls, the pots, the lampstands, the basins, and the offering bowls.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa wum o ni wuhi shihir shɛli maa zuɣu ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti tuh o soli maa.
en: Thats why so many people went out to meet him—because they had heard about this miraculous sign he did.

dag: Shɛb daa zaŋla ŋariŋ kara n-kpe teeku puuni nti tumdi daabiligu tuma ko titali maa ni.
en: Some sailed over the ocean in ships, earning their living on the seas.

dag: yɛli, Ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ niriba ŋɔ? Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ tum alahiziba tuun karili ka Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa nya li, ka ti ku tooi chihi li.
en: What can we do with these men? Everyone in Jerusalem knows about this miracle, and we cannot say it didn't happen.

dag: N ni zaŋ a kuli m ma yiŋa, n ni zaŋ a ti kpɛhi ŋun daa dɔɣi ma du gbɛrili ni. N ni ti a wain viɛlli mini m pumpɔrinchihi wala kom ka a nyu.
en: I would take you to my mother's house, where you could teach me love. I would give you spiced wine, my pomegranate wine to drink.

dag: La shɛli daa ʒe nimaani ka komihigu pali li, ka bɛ daa zaŋ gumdi tim di ni n-zaŋ taaŋkɔro gbab li n-zaŋ tiri ha n-niŋ o nol ni.
en: A bowl was there, full of cheap wine; so a sponge was soaked in the wine, put on a stalk of hyssop, and lifted up to his lips.

dag: Dinzuɣu Sihɔn min o niriba zaa ni daa yina ti liri ti n-tuhi ti Jahaz.
en: Sihon came out with all his men to fight us near the town of Jahaz.

dag: Ka n kul ni be n niriba Izraɛlnim sani, ka ku bahi ba.
en: I will live among the Israelites. I wont abandon my people Israel.

dag: Dinzuɣu niŋmiya tuuba! Di yi pa lala, di ku yuui ka n ka yi sanna nti zaŋ n nol ni takɔb la tuhi bɛn niŋdi lala maa tɔbu.
en: Now turn from your sins! If you don't, I will come to you soon and fight against those people with the sword that comes out of my mouth.

dag: Ka o mini ba daa laɣim doli kuli Nazarɛt, ka o daa deeri bɛ noli. Ka o ma daa zaŋ yɛla ŋɔ zaa niŋ o suhu ni.
en: Jesus went back to Nazareth with his parents and obeyed them. His mother kept on thinking about all that had happened.

dag: Bɛ ni daa mali sara maa naai, ka naa mini bɛn zaa daa be o sani gbani n-jɛm Naawuni.
en: After the entirely burned offering was complete, the king and all who were with him bowed down in worship.

dag: M Ba ŋun nyɛ wuntialan ŋɔ, dunianim bi mi a, amaa man mi a, ka bɛmbɔŋɔ gba mi ni nyini n-shiri tim ma na.
en: Good Father, the people of this world don't know you. But I know you, and my followers know that you sent me.

dag: Dama o daa bi ku ma niŋ m ma pul ni, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka m ma puli maa leei n gballi, ka o puli maa kul bara sahakam.
en: for not killing me before I was born. Then my mother's womb would have been my grave.

dag: dɔbba bɛn zaa be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka paai yuun pisi bee n-gar lala, ka nyɛ bɛn ni tooi chaŋ tɔbu ni. A mini Aduna sabimi bɛ yuya kaman bɛ daŋ kam ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: years old and above, who is eligible for military service in Israel. These you and Aaron will enlist in their military units.

dag: Dama bɛ daa yi zaŋdila bɛ tantinim mini bɛ niɣi ni bɛ laakumnim kanna ti luri bɛ zuɣu, ka bɛ galisim ŋmanila toli. Ka bɛ mini laakumnim maa daa ka kalinli. Dinzuɣu bɛ daa yi ti kana bɛ saɣindila bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni binshɛɣukam.
en: They would come with their livestock and tents, as thick as locusts. They and their camels were too many to count. They came and devastated the land.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛlnim polo m-bɔŋɔ: Yawɛ ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ ka ti daadam nyɛvil la yɛliya.
en: A pronouncement. The LORDs word against Israel, an utterance of the LORD who stretches out the heavens, who establishes the earth, and who fashions the spirit of humanity within it.

dag: Dinzuɣu yiɣisim siɣi doli ba chaŋ ka di biɛhind a suhu ni, dama mani n-tim ba a sanna.
en: Get up and go downstairs. Go with these men without wondering if its all right, because I sent them.

dag: Tinim mi pala bɛn tiri gbini bahi yoli; amaa ti nyɛla bɛn lee niŋ yɛda ka tiligi.
en: We are not people who turn back and are lost. Instead, we have faith and are saved.

dag: Amaa ka Amazia daa zaɣisi wumbu, dama Naawuni n-daa niŋ lala ni o zaŋ ba niŋ Jɛhɔash nuu ni bɛ ni daa jɛmdi Ɛdomnim buɣa la zuɣu.
en: But Amaziah refused to listen. God made this happen. God planned to let Israel defeat Judah, because the people of Judah followed the gods the people of Edom followed.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yiri tiŋ maa tariga, ka Samuɛl yɛli Sool, Yɛlim a tumtumda maa ni o cham ti tooni, o yi chaŋ naai nyin zanim kpe biɛla, ka n yɛl a Naawuni ni yɛli shɛm.
en: and had almost reached the edge of town when Samuel stopped and said, Tell your servant go on. Stay here with me for a few minutes, and I'll tell you what God has told me. After the servant had gone.

dag: Ti Duuma kpaŋsim a suhu! Naawuni daalibarika kpalimmi be yi ni!.
en: I pray that the Lord will bless your life and will be kind to you.

dag: Hal ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yuui pam, di simdi ni bɛ mali suhupiɛlli di yuma zaa puuni, amaa di simdi ni bɛ teei ni zibisim saha dabisa ni ti galisi pam. Dinkam zaa niŋdi nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: Even those who live many years should take pleasure in them all. But they should be mindful that there will also be many dark days. Everything that happens is pointless.

dag: Yi daanabinim ŋmanila ŋɔri m-be Izraɛl dikilijina ni.
en: Israel, your prophets are false prophets. They are like jackals hunting for food among the ruins of a city.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa daŋ yibu asibaasi m-bol o kpambaliba na nti zaŋ yɛla maa zaa yɛli ba, ka dabiɛm daa gbaai ba pam.
en: So very early the next morning, Abimelech called all his servants and told them about the dream. The servants were very afraid.

dag: Ka Vuhim Dabisili dali maa daa ti gari, ka Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la mini Jeemsi ma Mariama ni Salomi daa da tulaale viɛlli ni bɛ chaŋ siliga maa ni ti mihi Yisa.
en: After the Sabbath, Mary Magdalene, Salome, and Mary the mother of James bought some spices to put on Jesus' body.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses.

dag: Kpuɣim a kpan titali min a kpam bila n-lu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kariti doli ma la zuɣu; ka yɛli ma, Mani n-nyɛ a tiligira.
en: Take a spear and javelin and fight those who are chasing me. Tell me, I will rescue you.

dag: O daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani kaman o ba Amazia ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa shɛm la.
en: He did what was right in the LORDs eyes, just as his father Amaziah had done.

dag: Ka bɛ yi zaɣisi ni bɛ ku deei pipia maa a nuu ni nyu, di saha nyin yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Di nyɛla talahi ni yi nyu li.
en: And if they refuse to take the cup from your hand and drink from it, then tell them that the Lord Almighty has said that they will still have to drink from it.

dag: Ka o bi so yi ti leei maligumaana n-zan o ba zaani, o yi ti yɛn ka Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili ŋɔ ni na nti tum o tuma luɣ kasi ŋɔ shee, ŋun yɛm binyɛra maa daba ayopɔin.
en: Aarons son will become the next high priest after him. That son will wear these clothes seven days when he comes to the Meeting Tent to serve in the Holy Place.

dag: Sal ni dɔɣ shɛli nyɛla sala; ka Naawuni Shia mi ni dɔɣ shɛli nyɛla shia.
en: Humans give life to their children. Yet only God's Spirit can change you into a child of God.

dag: dama kaman zabigu ni zaani lɔŋni shɛm la, lala n-nyɛ ba. Bɛ ni yɛl a, Dim ka nyu. amaa di bi paai bɛ puu ni.
en: because they are like a hair in the throat. They say to you, Eat and drink! but they dont mean it.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, a bi zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam ti ti bee n-zaŋ puri mini tihi puri ti ti ka di leei ti dini. Pumpɔŋɔ a bɔrimi ni a yɔhim ti. Ti ku kana.
en: Why should we follow you? You did not bring us into the new land filled with many good things. You did not give us the land God promised. You did not give us the fields or the vineyards. Will you make these men your slaves? No! We will not come.

dag: Ka Bɛnhadad daa wum Naa Asa ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka tim o sapashin kpamba mini bɛ tɔbbihi ka bɛ chaŋ ti liri Izraɛlnim fɔntinsi n-tuhi nyaŋ Ijɔn mini Dan ni Ɛbɛlibɛtimaaka ni Kinɛrɔt zaa zaŋ tabili Naftali tiŋgbani zaa.
en: King Ben-Hadad made the agreement with King Asa and sent his army to fight against the Israelite towns of Ijon, Dan, Abel Beth Maacah, the towns near Lake Galilee, and the area of Naphtali.

dag: Ana bihi n-daa nyɛ: Dishɔn mini Oholibama ŋun daa nyɛ Ana maa bipuɣiŋga la.
en: Anah was the father of Dishon, who was the ancestor of the clans of Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran. Anah also had a daughter named Oholibamah.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ saha din ka bahigu Naa ŋɔ ni deei n suhigu, ka nyaŋ ba ti ma, dama bɛ bi taɣi, ka mi bi zɔri Naawuni.
en: You have always ruled, and you will hear me. You will defeat my enemies because they won't turn and worship you.

dag: Hal zibisim pala zibisim a sani; yuŋ kul nɛmi kaman wuntaŋ ni la, dama zibisim bemi kaman neesim la a sani.
en: But you see in the dark because daylight and dark are all the same to you.

dag: Mɔɣu ni biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn mali karimbaani na ʒi n-dol li, ka gbuɣinli gba na ʒi n-dol li.
en: proud beasts havent trodden on it; a lion hasnt crossed over it.

dag: Yi ni ti nya dimbɔŋɔ, ka di niŋ ya suhupiɛlli. Bɛ ni ti ʒi teeku ni azichi na ti tin ya, ka ʒi zuliya shɛb gba daazichi na ti tin ya.
en: When you see this, your faces will glow; your hearts will pound and swell with pride. Treasures from across the sea and the wealth of nations will be brought to you.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yi baŋ din yɛn niŋ ma kpe ŋɔ ni nyɛ shɛli, n ni lo nia tim o yi sanna.
en: So he is the one that I hope to send as soon as I find out how things turn out here for me.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ n niriba ŋɔ, wummiya n saɣisigu; Izraɛlnima, n di yuya ni yi wum n yɛligu!.
en: Listen, my people, while I, the Lord, correct you! Israel, if you would only pay attention to me!.

dag: N Naawuni, tiligim ma n dimnim nuu ni; fam ma bɛn yiɣisi wuɣili n zuɣu la nuu ni bahi.
en: Oh, my God, deliver me from my enemies; put me out of reach from those who rise up against me.

dag: Ka Hushai daa kana, ka Absalom ti yɛl o, Ahitɔfɛl ni yɛl ni ti niŋ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, ti niŋm o ni yɛli shɛm maa? Di yi pa lala, nyin yɛlim ti.
en: When Hushai arrived, Absalom said to him, This is the advice that Ahithophel has given us; shall we follow it? If not, you tell us what to do.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm zuɣu ka o daa zali sokam o ni yɛn tum tuun shɛli bee o ni yɛn ʒi ʒi shɛli. Lala ka o daa kali ba kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ŋun Musa shɛm.
en: Each man was registered as the Lord had commanded Moses; and at the command of the Lord given through Moses, each man was assigned responsibility for his task of serving or carrying.

dag: M mali baŋsim gari ninkura, dama n kul gbibila a zaligunim maa.
en: I have greater wisdom than those who are old, because I obey your commands.

dag: Ka wahu maa daa tuhi kom o nol ni na kaman mɔɣili kom la ni di zo n-doli paɣ maa ti di o.
en: And then from his mouth the dragon poured out a flood of water after the woman, so that it would carry her away.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛl o, N dana, a daa po Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ man ŋun nyɛ a dab paɣ ŋɔ sani yɛli, A bia Sulemaana ni ti di nam n kalinsi nyaaŋa n-ʒini n nam ʒiishee.
en: Bathsheba answered, Sir, you used the name of the Lord your God and made a promise to me. You said, Your son Solomon will be the next king after me. He will sit on my throne.

dag: ka chɛ ka dɔro gbaag a nyɔri, ka dɔro maa ni nyɛla din kul yɛn pahiri dabisili kam hal ka a nyɔri ti yirina.
en: You will be struck with a painful stomach disease and suffer until you die.

dag: Dindali maa, n ni ti kpɛhi bɛ yuri dabiɛm, ka kpɛhi bɛn bari ba mi yinyari. Amaa n ni ti guli Judanima, ka chɛ ka bɛ dimnim yuri zom.
en: On that day, says the LORD, I will strike every horse with confusion and its rider with madness. I will keep my eyes open for the house of Judah; I will strike blind every horse of the peoples.

dag: ka kula ŋun tiri nyɛvili; amaa ka Naawuni daa neeg o kum ni. Tinima n-nyɛ di shɛhiranima.
en: And so you killed the one who gives life! But God raised him from death. We are witnesses of this—we saw it with our own eyes.

dag: Di bi simdi ka jɛrigu mali buni pam, di mi bi simdi ni dabili su nabihi.
en: Fools should not live in luxury, and slaves should not rule over noblemen.

dag: Ka o ʒim maa yi na yir o, ka o dɔni bindo shɛlikam zuɣu, di ni bemi kaman o ni yi pun nyari sɔrilim ka dooni bindo shɛli zuɣu ka di nyɛ shɛm la. Ka o ni ʒini binshɛlikam zuɣu ni nyɛla din be daɣiri ni kaman o ni yi nya sɔrilim la.
en: Anything that she rests on or sits on during this time is also unclean, just as it would be during her period.

dag: Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ ŋun bi be lala, dama ŋuna n-nam binshɛɣukam, ka Izraɛlnim nyɛ o ni su zuliya shɛba. O yuli n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa.
en: Jacobs portion is utterly different because God has formed all things, including Israel, his very own people— the LORD of heavenly forces is his name!.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Bom yuma ata naɣilaa mini yuma ata bunyaŋ ni yuma ata piɛlaa ni ŋmanʒee ni yiŋ ŋmani ti ma.
en: Then the Lord told him, Bring me a three-year-old cow, a three-year-old female goat, a three-year-old ram, a dove, and a young pigeon.

dag: Bina ayɔbu m-beni ka Yawɛ je li, ka bina ayopɔin nyɛ din chihir o sani:.
en: There are six things that the LORD hates, seven things detestable to him.

dag: Yawɛ dabisili dali miriya. Kpiɔŋlan Naa ni yɛn tahi saɣiŋgu na dabisi shɛli dali maa miriya. Fabilimiya!.
en: Wail, for the day of the LORD is near. Like destruction from the Almighty it will come.

dag: Zuɣusaa daantalisi sɔhigimi, ka di gari ba o ni kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni maa zuɣu.
en: The foundations that hold up the sky shake with fear when God threatens them.

dag: ka nya ka pɔhim ʒɛra, ka dabiɛm gbaag o, ka o piligi shimdi ka kuhi yɛli, N Duuma, tiligim ma.
en: But when Peter saw the strong wind, he became frightened. As he began to sink, he shouted, Lord, rescue me.

dag: Ka n garigi yɛl o, N dana, m bi mi. Wuhim ma! Ka o yɛli ma, Bɛmbɔŋɔ maa nyɛla bɛn yi wahala titali dibu ni na ka nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋ Piɛbil la ʒim paɣ shɛb binyɛra ka di paligi zaa la.
en: I don't know, sir. You do, I answered. He said to me, These are the people who have come safely through the terrible persecution. They have washed their robes and made them white with the blood of the Lamb.

dag: Ka n daa zaŋ n nina kpa n Duuma Naawuni ni nimmoo m-balim o ni nolɔbo, ka pili buɣu n-teei ʒi tampiligim ni.
en: And I prayed earnestly to the Lord God, pleading with him, fasting, wearing sackcloth, and sitting in ashes.

dag: O daa sabila gbaŋ maa yɛli Jɔab, Zaŋmi Yuria zali tooni tɔb maa ni mali kpiɔŋ luɣ shɛli polo, ka miligi ka chɛ o ka bɛ ku o.
en: He wrote in the letter, Place Uriah at the front of the fiercest battle, and then pull back from him so that he will be struck down and die.

dag: Dinzuɣu lala n-nyɛ li, ŋunkam bi chɛ o ni mali shɛlikam ku tooi niŋ n nyaandola.
en: In the same way, none of you who are unwilling to give up all of your possessions can be my disciple.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ paɣi Yawɛ yuli, dama o kɔŋko yuli tibisi gari yuli kam. O jilima galisiya dunia ni mini zuɣusaa.
en: Praise the Lord s name! Honor his name forever! His name is greater than any other. He is more glorious than heaven and earth.

dag: Ka Dauda bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a daa yɛn ku Yawɛ ni pii ninvuɣ so maa ka dabiɛm bi mal a.
en: Then David said to him, How is it that you werent afraid to raise your hand and destroy the LORDs anointed.

dag: Amaa Yisa daa lan tum tuun shɛŋa pam pahi, ka di yɛla bi sabi niŋ kpe. Di zaa yi di sabi, n tɛhi n suhu ni ni di litaafinim naan ku nya palo dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Now, there are many other things that Jesus did. If they were all written down one by one, I suppose that the whole world could not hold the books that would be written.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli shɛhiralana nyɛla ŋun tiligiri nyɛviya, amaa ŋun ŋmari ʒiri ŋun nyɛla nyaanyira.
en: An honest witness can save your life, but liars can't be trusted.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabia, n suhir a, Niŋm ma nirilim ŋɔ ti Duuma zuɣu. Kpaŋsimi n suhu Masia ni.
en: So, my brother, please do me this favor for the Lord's sake; as a brother in Christ, cheer me up!.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛlnim maa daa kul be Keenannim mini Hitinim ni Amɔrinim ni Pɛrizinim ni Hivinim ni Jɛbusinim maa ni.
en: But they refused. And some of them even married Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites who lived all around them. That's how they started worshiping foreign gods.

dag: Yi bo biŋkumda, ka ŋma yila kaman Dauda ni daa ŋma yila shɛm la n-yiini li.
en: You play your harps, and like David, you practice on your musical instruments.

dag: N ni daa kul tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa maa saha shɛli maa, ka Bɛnaaya bia Pɛlatia daa kpi. Di saha ka n daa lu tiŋa n-zaŋ n nini kpa tiŋa, ka kuhi pam yɛli, Mbaye, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ, a yɛn bahi naala Izraɛl ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim ŋɔ.
en: Before I finished speaking, Pelatiah dropped dead. I bowed down and cried out, Please, Lord God, don't kill everyone left in Israel.

dag: Ka Reehab yɛli ba, Kpamiya zoya ŋɔ polo, ka bɛn biɛhiri yi naba maa ku chirigi ya; kul sɔɣimiya be nimaani daba ata hal ka bɛn biɛhiri yi naba maa ti labina pɔi ka yi naanyi yiɣisi kuli.
en: Then she said to them, Go into the hills so that the kings men will not accidentally find you. Hide there for three days. After the kings men come back, you can go on your way.

dag: Amaa ka yi ti malila suhupiɛlli ka puhiri chuɣu, ka kɔri naɣilahi mini piɛri ŋ-ŋubiri bɛ nimdi ka nyuri wain ka yɛra, Chɛliya ka ti di ka nyu, dama biɛɣuni ti sa ni kpi.
en: But instead there was fun and frivolity, killing of cattle and slaughtering of sheep, eating of meat and drinking of wine: Eat and drink! Tomorrow we will die.

dag: Yawɛ dunoli m-bɔŋɔ; wuntizɔriba kɔŋko n-ni tooi dol li kpe.
en: This is the LORDs gate; those who are righteous enter through it.

dag: Nir yi niŋ binshɛli tahima ka ti bi nya li, di damdila o suhu, amaa nir yi bɔri shɛli ka nya li, di nyɛla nyɛvili tia.
en: Hope delayed makes the heart sick; longing fulfilled is a tree of life.

dag: kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Naawuni daa chɛ ka bɛ leei suhutunanima, ka chɛ ka bɛ mali nina ka bi nyara, ka mali tiba ka bi wumdi hal ni pɔŋɔ.
en: As the scripture says, God made their minds and hearts dull; to this very day they cannot see or hear.

dag: Dauda yuma daa nyɛla yuun pihita ka o naanyi di nam, o daa dila nam maa yuun pihinahi.
en: David was thirty years old when he became king, and he ruled for forty years.

dag: Ŋuna n-yiɣisiri tarimba taŋkpaɣu ni, ka kpuɣiri nandaamba tampuli zuɣu ni o chɛ ka bɛ mini nabihi laɣim ʒini n-di kuɣ din mali jilima fali. Dama Yawɛ n-su dunia ŋɔ daantalisi, ka zaŋ dunia ŋɔ n-tam di zuɣu.
en: He raises the poor from the dust, and he takes away their sadness. He makes them important and seats them with princes and at the places for honored guests. The Lord made the whole world, and the whole world belongs to him.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Yisa, Jɔn Baptaizira mini Farisiinim nyaandoliba lɔri noli waawaayili ka suhiri Naawuni, amaa ka nyin nyaandoliba bɛn kul diri ka nyura.
en: They said to Jesus, Johns followers often fast and pray, the same as the followers of the Pharisees. But your followers eat and drink all the time.

dag: Yawɛ suhu ni ti yiɣisi pam bahi bɛ zuɣu. O ni ti bahi dunia ŋɔ ni wuna zaa yoli, ka zuliya shɛb bɛn be teeku noli mini kom ni gili zuliya shɛba ti gban o tooni jɛm o bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔna ni.
en: They will be afraid of the Lord , because he will destroy their gods. Then everyone in all the faraway lands will worship the Lord.

dag: Dinzuɣu zomiya nambɔɣu kaman yi Ba Naawuni ni zɔri nambɔɣu shɛm.
en: Be compassionate just as your Father is compassionate.

dag: Dama yi yi shiri ni doli yɛligu ŋɔ ni wuhi shɛm, dindina na shɛb bɛn ʒini Dauda nam ʒiishee ka nyɛ bɛn kpɛri chɛchɛbunsi ka bari yuri mini bɛ kpamba ni bɛ niriba ni ti doli yili ŋɔ dunɔdaya ŋɔ ni kpe.
en: If you obey this command, then through the gates of this palace will come kings who occupy the throne of David, riding on chariots and horses along with their entourage and subjects.

dag: Dindali maa yi zaa ni ti zaŋ yi daanzinfa buɣa mini salima buɣa din nyɛ yi nuhi ni tum alahichi m-malila labi.
en: A time is coming when all of you will throw away the sinful idols you made out of silver and gold.

dag: O ni saɣim Lɛbanɔn sida tiwɔɣila zaa mini Bashan oki tihi zaa.
en: He will destroy the tall cedars of Lebanon and all the oaks in the land of Bashan.

dag: N suhu zaa kul yɛla Naawuni fukumsi zaligu zuɣu.
en: In my mind I am happy with Gods law.

dag: Daŋ kam ni niriba daa pihila kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya bɛ ni yɛn guli duno shɛŋa, bihi mini ninkura zaa.
en: Each group, no matter how large or small, was assigned a gate to guard, and they let the Lord show them what he wanted done.

dag: Ka o daa ti lan suhi Naawuni, ka sagbana kpaai kom bahina, ka tiŋgbani zuɣu bimbila lan niŋdi bindira yaha.
en: But when he did pray for rain, it fell from the skies and made the crops grow.

dag: Dama yi ni ti di vi yi ni yuri buɣa oki ti shɛŋa la zuɣu, ka yi suhuri ti saɣim yi ni pii yi sambani pu shɛŋa ti yi wuna la zuɣu.
en: You will be sorry that you ever worshiped trees and planted sacred gardens.

dag: Ka Jɔn daa yɛli Yisa, N Duuma, ti nyala so ka o mal a yuli kariti alizin biɛri, ka ti kar o o ni pa ti ni yino maa zuɣu.
en: John answered, Master, we saw someone using your name to force demons out of people. We told him to stop because he does not belong to our group.

dag: Man Pool maŋmaŋa n-sabi ŋɔ: N ni yo a li. Hal n ni tooi yɛli ni n samli dol a zaŋ chaŋ amaŋmaŋ nyɛvili polo.
en: I, Paul, am writing this in my own handwriting: I will pay back anything Onesimus owes. And I will say nothing about what you owe me for your own life.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ dabisili din pahir ayopɔin dali daa ti yɛn paai, ka Naawuni pun naai o ni daa nam binshɛɣukam zaa maa tuma; ka vuhi o ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa maa zaa vuhim daba ayopɔin maa dali.
en: God finished the work he was doing, so on the seventh day he rested from his work.

dag: Dama Izraɛlnim ni tuui dɔɣi bi shɛb zaa zaŋ tabili biŋkɔbiri tuuli bihi nyɛla n ni su shɛba. N ni daa ku bikpamba zaa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni dahin shɛl la, ka n daa mali ba kasi ti mmaŋa.
en: Every oldest male among the Israelites is mine, whether human or animal. When I killed all the oldest males in the land of Egypt, I dedicated them to myself.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Yiɣisim lu m piɛgul ŋɔ zuɣu ku o, ka piɛri maa wurim, ka n lu bɛ zaɣ bihi gba zuɣu.
en: Sword, arise against my shepherd, against the man responsible for my community, says the LORD of heavenly forces! Strike the shepherd in order to scatter the flock! I will turn my hand against the little ones.

dag: Di lan simdi ka yi booi kpam maa bahi bɛ ni nyɔri sara maligu buɣim bimbin shɛli zuɣu la gba mini di nɛma la zaa zuɣu, ka malimali sara maligu bimbini maa ka di leei din be kasi zaa.
en: Anoint the altar for entirely burned offerings and all its equipment. Make the altar holy, and the altar will be most holy.

dag: Bɛ daa lan pihi kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya ka yihi Juda zuliya mini Simiɔn zuliya ni Bɛnjamin zuliya tiŋgbana ni ti ni boli tin shɛŋa yuya ŋɔ tinsi shɛŋa ti ba.
en: All those cities came from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin. They decided which Levite family got which city by throwing lots.

dag: Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia ni daa di nam ka di ti paai yuun pia saha shɛli din daa nyɛ Nɛbukadnɛza nam dibu yuun pisaayika ni ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ.
en: Jeremiah received the LORDs word in the tenth year of Judahs King Zedekiah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzars rule.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba daa kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni ha ni bɛ ti mal li, ka daa va binyar shɛŋa din zaa bi be kasi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni n-yihi ti zali jɛmbu duu maa dundɔŋ ni, ka Lɛvinim daa va li ti bahi Kidirɔn Vinvamli ni.
en: The priests went in to purify the inner portion of the LORDs temple. They brought out to the courtyard of the LORDs temple all the impurities they discovered inside. Then the Levites took them out to the Kidron Valley.

dag: N ni ti yihi bukpahigu yi kɔbili ni, ka baɣisi ti ku lan beni.
en: I will demolish the sorceries you perform; you will have no more diviners!.

dag: Bɛnjamin daŋ ni; Ɛliada ŋun daa nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biiŋa la daa sula tɔbbihi tuhi kɔbisiyi bɛn nyɛ peentɔriba ka gbibi nyɔtaɣirisi la.
en: The commander of the troops from the clans of Benjamin was Eliada, an outstanding soldier, in command of , men armed with shields and bows.

dag: Saha shɛli n ni daa ti be Tɛsalɔnaika la yi daa tim sɔŋsim na ti ti ma, ka daa lan niŋ lala di nyaaŋa zaŋ chana.
en: More than once when I needed help in Thessalonica, you sent it to me.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔshafat bɔh o, Yawɛ anab so ka kpe ka ti ni bɔh o baŋ Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm? Di saha ka Izraɛl naa sapashinnim ni yino daa garigi yɛli, Shafat bia Ilaisha, ŋun daa nyɛ Ilaija sɔŋda la be kpe.
en: Jehoshaphat said, Which of the Lord 's prophets is with us? We can find out from him what the Lord wants us to do. One of Joram's officers answered, Elisha son of Shaphat is here. He was one of Elijah's closest followers.

dag: ka dabiɛm gbahi ba, dama bɛ daa yɛlimi, Buɣili ka bɛ zaŋ ka bɛ sansani maa ni na, ka lan yɛli; Mbusim be ti zuɣu, dama lala na ʒi n-niŋ.
en: they were afraid, and said, A god has come into their camp! We're lost! Nothing like this has ever happened to us before!.

dag: O lan bom bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi piɛɣu pali mini bɛ ni zaŋ kpam ŋmiri zim viɛlli shɛli maha ni karikaasi din ka dabindi, ka nyɛ bɛ ni niŋ kpam pa shɛli zuɣu ni chi sara, ni binnyura sara.
en: a basket of bread made without yeast—bread made with fine flour mixed with oil and wafers with oil spread on top; and the grain offerings and drink offerings that are a part of these gifts.

dag: Lɛvi zuliya ni nira yi yi tin shɛl ni o ni pun be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-ka Yawɛ ni yɛn pii luɣ shɛli na .
en: Any Levite can leave his hometown, and go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped.

dag: Dama yi mi ni Naawuni ni daa zaŋ shɛli pa talima n-tiligi ya biɛr yo shɛli yi ni daa deei yi yaannim san la ni pala din nyɛ binshɛŋa din saɣindi kaman anzinfa bee salima.
en: You know that in the past the way you were living was useless. It was a way of life you learned from those who lived before you. But you were saved from that way of living. You were bought, but not with things that ruin like gold or silver.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Jɔshua daa ŋme n-ku nanim maa n-zaŋ ba yili tih anu zuɣu. Ka bɛ daa yili tihi maa zuɣu hal ti paai zaawuni.
en: Next, Joshua struck them down. He put them to death and then hanged them on five trees. They were hanging on the trees until evening.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabihi, kpaŋmiya yimaŋ niŋ nimmoo n-chɛ ka yi bolibu mini yi piibu la ba n-zani, dama yi yi niŋ lala yi ku lu.
en: Therefore, brothers and sisters, be eager to confirm your call and election. Do this and you will never ever be lost.

dag: Mɛrari zuliya n-daa nyɛ Mahilinim daŋ mini Mushinim daŋ. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Mɛrari zuliya.
en: The two Merari clans were the Mahlites and the Mushites.

dag: N yurinima, di bɔhiya biɛri yi toli, amaa chɛliya biɛri bɔhibu tila Naawuni ŋun su tibidarigibo yɛla ŋɔ, dama di sabiya ni ti Duuma yɛliya, Mani n-su biɛri bɔhibu, m mi shiri ni bɔhi biɛri labisi.
en: Dear friends, don't try to get even. Let God take revenge. In the Scriptures the Lord says, I am the one to take revenge and pay them back.

dag: Ka kum daa ti lu, ka Ilaisha lab Giligal na. Ka anabinim daa ti ʒi o sani, ka o yɛl o sɔŋda, Zaŋm duɣ titali tam n-duɣi ʒiɛri ti anabinim ŋɔ.
en: Once, when there was a famine throughout the land, Elisha returned to Gilgal. While he was teaching a group of prophets, he told his servant to put a big pot on the fire and make some stew for them.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛl ba, Di zɔriya dabiɛm, yinima n-tum tuumbiɛri ŋɔ zaa, amaa di zaa yoli, di ŋmaligiya ka chɛ Yawɛ dolibu, amaa kul jɛmmiy o ni yi suhuri zaa.
en: Samuel answered: Even though what you did was wrong, you don't need to be afraid. But you must always follow the Lord and worship him with all your heart.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yɛli Jɔab mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be o sani maa zaa, Darimiya chahi yi situra, ka zaŋ buri so n-kum Abinɛr kuli. Ka Naa Dauda daa doli kum adaka maa nyaaŋa.
en: David said to Joab and to all the people with Joab, Tear your clothes and put on sackcloth. Cry for Abner. They buried Abner in Hebron. David went to the funeral. King David and all the people cried at Abners grave.

dag: A ni ti nyu li zaa n-lɛlilɛli di puuni, ka dim cheei li ka zaŋ di ŋmama maa ŋme m-bɔɣ a biha. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You will drink the poison in that cup. You will drink it to the last drop. You will throw down the glass and break it to pieces. You will tear at your breasts from the pain. This will happen because I am the Lord GOD, and this is what I said.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa ti lo tɔbu chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi Filistianima, ka ti suɣa n-do luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Ɛbɛnɛza la, ka Filistianim maa mi daa ti bɛ suɣa do Afɛk.
en: At that time the Philistines gathered to go to war against Israel, so the Israelites set out to fight them. The Israelites set up their camp at Ebenezer and the Philistines at Aphek.

dag: ka mali dapaɣa ayi niŋ di nyaaŋa lɔrisi la ni.
en: Make two frames for the corners at the back of the Holy Tent.

dag: Pa ninvuɣ shɛba n-lan beni pahi yi zuɣu, amaa yinima n-kul nyɛ ti tahima mini ti suhupiɛlli ni ti nasara dibu barinyubo shɛli ti ni ti yɛn mali ti Duuma Yisa tooni o labbuna dali.
en: You are our hope, our joy, and the crown we will be proud of when our Lord Jesus Christ comes.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Naawuni chɛ ba bahi ka bɛ doli bɛ suhuri ni kɔr biɛri soli n-tumdi tuun shɛŋa ni bɛ taba, ka di dihiri bɛmaŋmaŋ nama vi.
en: So God let these people go their own way. They did what they wanted to do, and their filthy thoughts made them do shameful things with their bodies.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabihi, ti pala dab paɣ maa bihi, amaa ti nyɛla bilichin paɣ la bihi.
en: So then, my friends, we are not the children of a slave woman but of a free woman.

dag: Mani n-ni ti nyɛ o ba ka o mi nyɛ m bia, ka o yi ti tum taali, n ni zaŋ fiɛbiga fiɛb o n-saɣis o kaman ninsalinim ni saɣisiri bɛ bihi shɛm.
en: I will be his father, and he will be my son. When he does wrong, I'll see that he is corrected, just as children are corrected by their parents.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa yi nimaani chaŋ Pɛnuɛl nti lan suhi bɛ gba bindirigu. Ka Pɛnuɛluɛlnim daa garigi yɛl o kaman Sukɔtinim ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa.
en: From there he went up to Penuel and made the same request. And the people of Penuel responded in the same way the people of Succoth had.

dag: Suhupiɛlli nyɛla din chɛ ka nir lara, amaa suhugarigu nyɛla din chɛ ka nandahima mali nira.
en: A joyful heart brightens ones face, but a troubled heart breaks the spirit.

dag: Dama Yawɛ pun pii Ziɔn. O bɔri ni o zaŋ li leeg o biɛhigu shee. O daa yɛliya.
en: You have gladly chosen Zion as your home, our Lord .

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiya ni Naawuni fukumsi zaligu chihila Naawuni daalikaulinima? Naawuni di wuhi gba! Dama Naawuni yi daa zali fukumsi zaligu shɛli ni di tooi tahi nyɛvili na, dindina taali ni yibu Naawuni sani naan shiri yi fukumsi zaligu maa dolibu ni na.
en: So, is the Law against the promises of God? Absolutely not! If a Law had been given that was able to give life, then righteousness would in fact have come from the Law.

dag: Di bi simdi ni di nyɛ lala yinim sani; amaa chɛliya ka ŋun nyɛ yi zaa kpɛma lee zaŋ omaŋa zalila bia zaani, ka yi zaa zuɣulana zaŋ omaŋa leei ŋun tumdi bia tuma yi zaa ha sani.
en: But don't be like them. The most important one of you should be like the least important, and your leader should be like a servant.

dag: Ka o daa gbahi Sukɔt kpamba n-zaŋ ba pa mɔɣu ni gɔhi zuɣu n-du n-tam bɛ zuɣu n-no ba. O daa niŋla lala ni o wuhi Sukɔtinim maa yɛm.
en: Gideon made a whip from thorn plants and used it to beat the town officials.

dag: Yawɛ, teem a dimnim maa ni maani a ansarisi shɛm la yɛla; ka jɛra gba ʒiɛm a yuli.
en: Remember your enemies, Lord ! They foolishly sneer and won't respect you.

dag: Amaa yɛda niŋbu soli maa ni yipa kana pumpɔŋɔ zuɣu, ti bi lan be gula maa sulinsi ni yaha.
en: Now that the way of faith has come, we no longer need the law to be our guardian.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni darigi Hadirak tiŋgbɔŋnim mini Damaskusnim tibili. Pa Izraɛlnim zuliya kɔŋko ka Yawɛ su, amaa ŋuna n-su Siria tiŋgbɔŋ gba.
en: A pronouncement. The LORDs word is against the land of Hadrach, and Damascus is its resting place, for the city of Aram and all the tribes of Israel belong to the LORD.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naawuni ni laɣim shɛba, sal ŋun miri ka o woligi ba.
en: No human being must separate, then, what God has joined together.

dag: Dama Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni Naa Dauda maŋmaŋ daa yɛliya: Ti Duuma yɛli n Duuma: Ʒinimi n nudirigu polo hal ka n ti nyaŋ a dimnima ti a ka a du n-tam bɛ zuɣu.
en: The Holy Spirit inspired David to say: The Lord said to my Lord: Sit here at my right side until I put your enemies under your feet.

dag: Amaa baŋmiya ni Yawɛ m-pii wuntizɔra ti omaŋa; ka n yi bol o, ŋun Yawɛ wumdi m boligu.
en: The Lord has chosen everyone who is faithful to be his very own, and he answers my prayers.

dag: Ka Nuhu min o paɣa ni o bidibisi ni bɛ paɣiba daa kpe ŋariŋ maa ni ni bɛ yi kom maa dibu ni.
en: Noah, his sons, his wife, and his sons wives with him entered the ark to escape the floodwaters.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka bindirigu pam be di ni. N ni ti ti di nandaamba bindirigu.
en: I will bless Zion with food, and even the poor will eat until they are full.

dag: Ka ŋmalig o nyaandoliba maa polo yɛli ba ashilɔni, Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nina nyari yi ni nyari shɛli ŋɔ mal alibarika!.
en: Jesus then turned to his disciples and said to them in private, You are really blessed to see what you see!.

dag: Dinzuɣu wummiya Yawɛ ni lo nia shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ Babilɔn polo ni o ni yɛn niŋ Babilɔnnim shɛm. Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ ni ti dari bɛ bihi chaŋ, ka bɛ yɛla ti gbaai bɛ tiŋ maa nim dabiɛm.
en: Therefore, listen to the counsel that the LORD has for Babylon and the plans hes devised against the land of Babylon: The little ones of the flock will be dragged off, as their pasture watches in utter disbelief.

dag: A jɛmbu duu din be Jɛrusalɛm la zuɣu ka nanim ʒiri pina na ti tir a.
en: from your Temple in Jerusalem, where kings bring gifts to you.

dag: Dinzuɣu tɔɣisimiya ka niŋmiya kaman bɛn nyɛ Naawuni ni ti yɛn zaŋ o zaligu shɛli din tiri yolisim la kari shɛb saria.
en: Speak and act as people who will be judged by the law that sets us free.

dag: Bɛ ni daa dɔɣi Yisa Masia shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Saha shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋ o ma Mariama ti Yisifu ka na bi kulis o la, ka bɛ ti nya o ka o malila pua Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni.
en: This is how the birth of Jesus Christ took place. When Mary his mother was engaged to Joseph, before they were married, she became pregnant by the Holy Spirit.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa ti bɛ zaa yinoyino chuɣu puhibu binyɛra, amaa ka daa bo anzinfa laɣibaligu pihita mini chuɣu puhibu binyɛra ata ti Bɛnjamin.
en: To all of them he gave a change of clothing, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver and five changes of clothing.

dag: dama kaman Naawuni ni daa yihi paɣa doo ni na shɛm, lala zuɣu ka paɣ gba dɔɣiri doo pumpɔŋɔ. Amaa binshɛɣukam zaa nyɛla Naawuni ni nam shɛli.
en: As woman came from man so also man comes from woman. But everything comes from God.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ gali sabilifaa ni gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain mali pumpɔrinchihi kɔtomsi niŋ di tiŋli ti tuui ka mali salima buɣilimbuɣilimbihi n-zaŋ li yiliyili di sunsuuni gili.
en: On its lower hem add pomegranates made of blue, purple, and deep red yarns all around the lower hem, with gold bells between the pomegranates all around it.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli Yaakubu, Yiɣisim chaŋ ti ʒini Bɛtɛl, ka me sara maligu bimbini zali man Naawuni ŋun daa yi a zuɣu saha shɛli a ni daa yi a biɛli Iso sani zɔri la.
en: God said to Jacob, Go to Bethel at once, and live there. Build an altar there to me, the God who appeared to you when you were running away from your brother Esau.

dag: O yi bi niŋ bini ata ŋɔ ti o, dindina paɣ maa ŋun yim chaŋ yoli, ka di yo shɛli.
en: If he doesnt do these three things for her, she will go free without any payment, for no money.

dag: ni n Naawuni. N suhu kul saɣindimi. Dinzuɣu ka n teer a yɛla Jɔɔdɛn tiŋgbɔŋ ni mini Hɛrimɔn Zoli zuɣu ni Mizar Zoli zuɣu.
en: and you are my God. I am deeply discouraged, and so I think about you here where the Jordan begins at Mount Hermon and at Mount Mizar.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa taɣ o tɛha ka yɛli, N ku chɛ ka lala niŋ.
en: Then the Lord changed his mind about this. The Lord GOD said, It will not happen either.

dag: Ka tumtumda maa garigi yɛli Sool, M mali anzinfa laɣifu kpe, n ni zaŋ li ti Naawuni nir maa ka o wuhi ti ti ni yɛn doli so shɛli.
en: Again the servant answered Saul. Look, I have a little bit of money. Lets give it to the man of God. Then he will tell us where we should go.

dag: Judanim kuhirimi, ka bɛ fɔntinsinim tarigi; bɛ dola tiŋgban ni ni suhugarigu, ka Jɛrusalɛmnim kuhigu chaŋ haliya.
en: Judah and Jerusalem weep as the land dries up.

dag: Dinzuɣu di niŋ kamaata ni nir doli ŋun be nam fukumsi ni yɛligu, ka di pa ni o yi Naawuni suhuyiɣisili tibidarigibo ni kɔŋko zuɣu, amaa o suhu ni tɛha gba dɔnibu zuɣu.
en: So you must obey the government, not just because you might be punished, but because you know it is the right thing to do.

dag: Ŋuna ka dunɔgula yoori dunoli tira; ka o boon o piɛri maa yuya ka be bɛ tooni, ka piɛri maa wumd o boligu ka dol o.
en: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him; the sheep hear his voice as he calls his own sheep by name, and he leads them out.

dag: Di saha n suhu ni ti paligi Yawɛ zuɣu, ka m mali suhupiɛlli o ni tiligi ma zuɣu.
en: But I will rejoice in the LORD; I will celebrate his salvation.

dag: Dama bɛ nyurila bara zaŋ chaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ biɛhigu polo, ka tɛhiri ni Naawuni ku tooi nya bɛ tuumbiɛri maa, ka kari ba saria di zuɣu.
en: because in their own eyes they are slick with talk about their guilt ever being found out and despised.

dag: Di saha niriba ni ti yɛli, Bɛ ni daa zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa lo ba alikauli shɛli saha shɛl o ni daa yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la zuɣu.
en: The answer will be, This happened because the Israelites left the agreement of the Lord , the God of their ancestors. They stopped following the agreement he made with them when he brought them out of Egypt.

dag: Amaa ka do so daa to piɛm ka di chaŋ ti nyɔɣi Izraɛl naa kurigu gbaɣino tuɣibu shee, ka ŋun to li maa bi mi; dinzuɣu ka o daa yɛl o chɛchɛbun duhira, N nya daŋa, ŋmaligim zaŋ ma yi tɔb gɔɣu ŋɔ ni.
en: But someone randomly shot an arrow that struck Israels king between the joints in his armor. Turn around and get me out of the battle, the king told his chariot driver. Ive been hit.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa lan chɛ ka bɛ mali daanya daantalis ayi, zaɣ yini kam wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita pinaanu, ka bɛ daa mali zuɣuri tamtam di zuɣu, ka zuɣu yini kam wɔɣilim daa nyɛ mita ayi ni biɛla; ka bɛ daa zaŋ li sa duu maa tooni.
en: Two columns were made for the entrance to the temple. Each one was meters tall and had a cap on top that was over meters high.

dag: Ŋuna n-fa ti zibisim yiko ni bahi, ka zaŋ ti ni alaafee nti kpɛhi o Biyurigu la nam ni.
en: God rescued us from the dark power of Satan and brought us into the kingdom of his dear Son.

dag: N nyari suhupiɛlli a zaligunim maa dolibu ni, dama n yuri li pam.
en: What joy your commands give me! How I love them!.

dag: Ka bɛn yi dɔɣim kam zaa ni mini zuliya balibu kam ni ni niriba balibu kam ni ni tinzun yɛligu kam nim ni na ni ti lihiri ba ka zaɣisi ba sɔɣibu, ka bɛ ni do nimaani dabisi muna ata ni pirigili.
en: People from every race of people, tribe, language, and nation will look at the bodies of the two witnesses for three and a half days. The people will refuse to bury them.

dag: Yi yi ka n tooni na ni yi ti jɛm ma, ŋuni n-lee yɛli ya ni yi zaŋ biŋkɔbiri maa na? Ŋuni n-lee puhi ya ni yi be n jɛmbu duu n-nɔri ginda?.
en: Who asked you to bring me all this when you come to worship me? Who asked you to do all this tramping around in my Temple?.

dag: Fam ma gbuɣinli nol ni bahi! Fam ma yɔnaɣilahi yila ni bahi.
en: Rescue me from the lions mouth. Protect me from the horns of the bulls.

dag: Yawɛ kpihim a saria karibu la, ka kar a dimnima. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl naa ŋɔ be yi sunsuuni, di lan zɔriya barina shɛli dabiɛm yaha.
en: The LORD has removed your judgment; he has turned away your enemy. The LORD, the king of Israel, is in your midst; you will no longer fear evil.

dag: Dama pumpɔŋɔ n ni chɛ ka n daalɔbɔnim lu amaŋmaŋ min a kpamba ni a niriba zaa zuɣu din ni chɛ ka a baŋ ni n kpee ka dunia yili zaa.
en: This time Im going to send all my plagues on you, your officials, and your people so that you will know that there is no one like me in the whole world.

dag: Ŋunkam tumd alahichi nyɛla zaliguchihira, dama alahichi tumbu nyɛla zaligu chihibu.
en: Whoever sins is guilty of breaking God's law, because sin is a breaking of the law.

dag: Yisifu daa nyɛla yuun pihita nira saha shɛl o ni daa kpe Ijipti Firawuna tuma ni maa. Ka Yisifu daa yiri Naa Firawuna sani n-chani gindi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ zaa.
en: Joseph was years old when he began to serve Pharaoh, Egypts king, when he left Pharaohs court and traveled through the entire land of Egypt.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti ŋma li n-zaŋ niŋ pɔŋ ni na ti ti bipuɣiŋga maa, ka o daa zaŋ li nti ti o ma.
en: They brought his head on a plate and gave it to the young woman, and she brought it to her mother.

dag: Ka Daniɛl daa suhi naa ka o zaŋ Shadirak mini Mɛshak ni Abɛdnɛgo zali Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni tuma zaashɛhi ni. Amaa ka Daniɛl ŋun daa kul kpalim be nayili.
en: At Daniel's request, the king appointed Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego to high positions in Babylon Province, and he let Daniel stay on as a palace official.

dag: Hal a ni kul yɛn nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa ka di do katiŋ maa zaa yoli, a ku kpe n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri Izraɛlnim maa ni.
en: You can look at the land from the other side of the river, but you wont enter there.

dag: Amaa ka shɛb daa ti chaŋ daba ayopɔin maa dali ni bɛ ti pihi li ka bi nya shɛli.
en: On Saturday, some of the people went out to gather some of the food, but they could not find any.

dag: Naa ni ti fabili, ka nabia ti yihi tahima, ka bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim zaa bɔɣiri ti sɔhira. N ni ti yɛn niŋ ba kaman bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm, ka kari ba saria kaman bɛ saria karibu ni nyɛ shɛm zuɣu. Ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Even your king and his officials will lose hope and cry in despair. Your hands will tremble with fear. I will punish you for your sins and treat you the same way you have treated others. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Doo bee paɣ yi ti po pɔri din nyɛ Nazari pɔri ni o wolig omaŋ ti Yawɛ.
en: Tell the Israelites this: If there are people, men or women, who want to make a vow dedicating themselves to the Lord as Nazirites for a time, this is what they must do:.

dag: O ni yɛn nyɛ Nazari nir dabisa shɛŋa ŋɔ zaa puuni, o miri ka o pini o zuɣu hal ka o ni wolig omaŋ ti Yawɛ saha shɛli maa ti gari. Di simdi ka o be kasi, ka chɛ ka o zabiri zooi wɔɣawɔɣa.
en: For the term of the nazirite promise, no razor may be used on the head until the period of dedication to the LORD is fulfilled. The person is to be holy, letting his or her hair grow untrimmed.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, zaɣ viɛlli mini yurilim din galisi kul ni be m biɛhigu ni n nyɛvili ni zaa, ka n kul ni be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Yes, goodness and faithful love will pursue me all the days of my life, and I will live in the LORDs house as long as I live.

dag: Bɛ yi nahindi sarikanim bɛn zaa be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Now crushing underfoot all the earths prisoners.

dag: Ka yi yi ti paai tin shɛli ka bɛ bi deei ya, yi yi ti yɛn yi di tiŋ maa ni, yin pihimiya yi napɔna taŋkpaɣu bahi tiŋ maa nim zuɣu, ka di niŋ shɛhira biɛɣu jɛndi ba.
