en: wherever people don't welcome you, leave that town and shake the dust off your feet as a warning to them.

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Yuza zuɣu, ka o ku o nimaani sɔŋ Alikauli Adaka maa luɣili ni o ni daa zaŋ o nuu gbaai Alikauli Adaka maa zuɣu.
en: But the Lord was angry with Uzzah and killed him for that mistake. Uzzah showed he did not honor God when he touched the Holy Box, so he died there by Gods Holy Box.

dag: Miriya ka yi zo n-doli wuna n-jɛmdi li, ka tumdi di tuma. Ka miriya ka yi zaŋ yi nuhi mali binshɛŋa din ni chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka n niŋ ya zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Dont follow other gods. Dont serve or worship them. Dont worship idols that someone has made. That only makes me angry with you. By doing this you only hurt yourselves.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa lu soli chani Naiɔt Rama tiŋgban ni, ka Naawuni Shia daa siɣ o zuɣu na, ka o gba dii gbaai anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu m-mali lala hal ti paai Naiɔt Rama tiŋgbani maa ni.
en: Saul left for Ramah. But as he walked along, the Spirit of God took control of him, and he started prophesying. Then, when he reached Prophets Village.

dag: Ka kahiŋkɔri maa daa shiri tahiri bindirigu mini nimdi na nti tir o asiba ni zaawuni; ka o daa nyuri kulibɔŋ maa ni kom.
en: Ravens brought him bread and meat twice a day, and he drank water from the creek.

dag: Yi yɛliya, Naawuni jɛmbu ka buchi. Ka o zaligunim dolibu bee ti yi be Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ sani kaman ti kumdila kuli la, di daanfaani nyɛ ti dini?.
en: You said, Serving God is useless. What do we gain by keeping his obligation or by walking around as mourners before the LORD of heavenly forces?.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi baŋ ni ninsal shia durila zuɣusaa, ka biŋkɔbigu shia siɣiri tiŋgban ni?.
en: How can anyone be sure that the human spirit goes upward while an animal's spirit goes down into the ground?.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam saɣi deeg o yɛligu maa ni dihi tabili ni Naawuni nyɛla yɛlimaŋlilana.
en: But everyone who does believe him has shown that God is truthful.

dag: Ka bɛ daa woligi n-kpuɣi yɛŋkiŋkabina soli. Bɛ daa bola bindira niŋ bɔto kura din chahi ka bɛ liɣiliɣi li ni n-zaŋ pa bunsi zuɣu; ka zaŋ wain kol kura din chahi ka bɛ liɣiliɣi li pahi;.
en: they acted cleverly. They set out pretending to be messengers. They took worn-out sacks for their donkeys and worn-out wineskins that were split and mended.

dag: Niriba ni ti yi wulimpuhili polo n-zaŋ kpa wulinluhili polo, ka shɛb yi nuzaa polo n-zaŋ kpa nudirigu polo n-zɔri gindi bɔri Yawɛ yɛligu, amaa ka ti ku nya li.
en: People will wander from the Dead Sea to the Mediterranean and then on around from the north to the east. They will look everywhere for a message from the Lord , but they will not find it.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi maa daa ŋma n-chihi ŋarin bil maa bahi kom maa ni ka di chaŋ.
en: So the soldiers cut the ropes and let the lifeboat fall into the water.

dag: Paɣ maa nini ni daa ti nya Samuɛl, o daa ŋmɛla kuŋ pam ka bɔhi Sool, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɔhim ma? Nyini n-nyɛ Sool.
en: When the woman saw Samuel, she screamed. Then she turned to Saul and said, You've tricked me! You're the king.

dag: Dinzuɣu yihimiya dinkam nyɛ daɣiri mini biɛribiɛtali zaa yi bebu ni, ka doliya tarimtali soli n-deei Naawuni ni zaŋ yɛligu shɛli biri yi suhuri ni, ka di nyɛ din ni tooi tiligi ya la.
en: So get rid of everything evil in your lives—every kind of wrong you do. Be humble and accept Gods teaching that is planted in your hearts. This teaching can save you.

dag: Naawuni pun zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa sɔŋ Masia naba ni, ka zaŋ o leei cheechi zuɣu ni o su cheechi binshɛɣukam zaa fukumsi.
en: God has put all things under the power of Christ, and for the good of the church he has made him the head of everything.

dag: Niriba pam ni ti mali bɛmaŋa m-be kasi. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn ti ku baŋ di ni nyɛ shɛm, amaa ka kul ni kpalim bela ninvuɣubiɛtali maa tuma ni. Naɣila bɛn mali yɛm kɔŋko n-ni ti baŋ di ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Many people will be purified. Those who are wicked will not understand but will go on being wicked; only those who are wise will understand.

dag: Ka zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, Pɛriʒia mini Miidia paɣiba yi wum Napaɣ Vashiti ni niŋ shɛm maa, bɛ ni zaŋ di yɛla yɛri naa kpambaliba. Ka paɣiba ni lihi ʒiɛm bɛ yidaannima, ka bɛ yidaannim maa suhuri ni yiɣisi pam bahi paɣiba maa zuɣu.
en: Today the wives of the Persian and Median leaders have heard what the queen did, and these women will be influenced by what she did. They will do the same thing to the kings important leaders. And there will be plenty of disrespect and anger.

dag: Lihimiya yi yab Ibrahimma mini Zaratu bɛn dɔɣi ya la. N daa piig o ka o nyɛla o ko, amaa ka n daa niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni ka o tuŋ teei.
en: God chose Abraham and Sarah to be your ancestors. The Lord blessed Abraham, and from that one man came many descendants.

dag: Yawɛ, a wum bɛ ni maani ma ansarisi shɛm zaa mini bɛ ni lɔri ma nia biɛri shɛm.
en: You heard them insult me, Lord . You have heard all the evil plans that they made against me.

dag: Vinnyaɣili chɛ ka gom gbaarila nira, ka ŋun je ni o ni bii ni gbe kum.
en: Laziness brings on sleep, and an appetite for rest brings on hunger.

dag: Ka Baanabas daa yi ni chaŋ Taasus ni o ti bo Sool shee.
en: Then Barnabas went to Tarsus to look for Saul.

dag: Ka naa daa chɛ ka bɛ kpe kuɣ viɛla zaɣ kara ni bɛ zaŋ li me duu maa tanzaa m-pahi kuɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni daa mali ka di viɛla.
en: At King Solomon's command they cut fine large stones for the foundation of the Temple.

dag: Ka Yisifu yɛl o, N lihiri bɔrila m biɛyanima, ka yɛli, N suhir a, wuhim ma bɛ ni zaŋ biŋkɔbiri maa be luɣ shɛli polo ka bɛ ŋubiri mɔri maa.
en: Joseph said, Im looking for my brothers. Tell me, where are they tending the sheep.

dag: Di saha maa ka Abimilɛk min o sapashin kpɛm Fikol daa yɛli Ibrahimma, Naawuni be a sani a ni niŋdi shɛlikam ni.
en: About this time Abimelech and his army commander Phicol said to Abraham, God blesses everything you do!.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ nyamiya, ŋuna n-nyɛ yi naa, ka m mi kurigi ka n zuɣu paligi zaa, ka m bidibisi be yi sani. N nachimbilim ni mi ka n kul be yi sani hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: You have seen how I have led you ever since I was a young man. I'm already old. My hair is gray, and my own sons are grown. Now you must see how well your king will lead you.

dag: Ka Jɛrikɔnim daa me m-pan o zuɣu. Ka Imri bia Zakur daa me m-pani bɛ zuɣu.
en: The people of Jericho built next to them, and Zaccur, Imris son, built next to them.

dag: Pɛriʒia Naa daa zalila zaligu zaŋ chaŋ yiliyiiniba polo, ka sabi wuhi bɛ ni yɛn yiini yila maa shɛm dabisili kam.
en: The singers obeyed orders from the king, which told them what to do from day to day.

dag: Ka Batishiiba yɛl o, Yɛlima. Ka o yɛl o, N suhir a, yɛlim Naa Sulemaana ni o zaŋm Abishag Shunɛm paɣisarili la ti ma ka n niŋ m paɣa, ka o mi ku zaɣis a ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Adonijah said, I know that King Solomon will do whatever you ask. So please ask him to let me marry Abishag, the woman from Shunem.

dag: m-balind o yɛra, M bipuɣiŋga n-tarigi yɛn kpi. Kamina nti zaŋ a nuhi pa o zuɣu ka o kpaŋ n-lan niŋ nyɛvililana yaha.
en: and pleaded with him, My daughter is about to die. Please, come and place your hands on her so that she can be healed and live.

dag: Ka Yisa daa bɔhi ba, Yi yipa baŋ yɛla ŋɔ zaa gbinni bebɔ? Ka bɛ saɣi, Iin, ti Duuma.
en: Have you understood all these things?Jesus asked. They said to him, Yes.

dag: Dama Kpiɔŋlan Naa piɛma nyɔɣi ma, ka di lɔɣu kpe n ni. Naawuni zaŋla dabiɛm sɔŋ tuɣi tab gu ma.
en: God All-Powerful has shot me with his arrows. My spirit feels their poison! Gods terrible weapons are lined up against me.

dag: Ka Abinɛr daa ti kuhi bahi Jɔab ha bɔh o, Ti kul yɛn zaŋla takɔbiri ŋɔ n-kuri tab hal ni saha din ka bahigu? A bi mi ni di bahigu ti yɛn nyɛla dimdi din ku naai? Bɔ saha ka a yɛn yɛl a niriba maa ka bɛ chɛ bɛ mabihi ŋɔ kari doli.
en: Abner shouted to Joab, Aren't we ever going to stop killing each other? Don't you know that the longer we keep on doing this, the worse it's going to be when it's all over? When are you going to order your men to stop chasing their own relatives.

dag: Dama Ɛhab daŋ niriba zaa ni kpi. N ni ku Ɛhab daŋ ni dɔbba bɛn nyɛ bilichinnim mini daba zaa Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: All of Ahab's family and descendants are to die; I will get rid of every male in his family, young and old alike.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa yɛli Yisifu, Yɛlim a biɛyanim maa ni bɛ ʒilim bɛ bunsi ʒiya n-lab Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: He said to Joseph, Tell your brothers to load their animals and to return to the land of Canaan.

dag: Zaŋmi kikaa kpa a noli, dama juɣu tam Yawɛ jɛmbu duu zuɣu, bɛ ni saɣim n daalikauli ka birigi n zaligu la zuɣu.
en: Put a trumpet to your lips! Its as if a bird of prey has flown over the LORDs house, because they have broken my covenant, and have not kept my Instruction.

dag: Malimiya zoligo! Dama ninvuɣ kubo kul palila tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka damli dambu pali tiŋ puuni.
en: Your whole country is in confusion! Murder and violence are everywhere in Israel.

dag: Napombihi maa shɛli polo ni nyɛ kuriti, ka di shɛli polo mi nyɛ yaɣiri la, lala ka di nam maa yaɣ shɛli polo ni ti mali kpiɔŋ, ka di yaɣ shɛli polo mi gbarigi.
en: The toes of the statue were partly iron and partly clay. So the fourth kingdom will be partly strong like iron and partly weak like clay.

dag: So yi lab a tapaɣa, nyin lɛbigim din la gba pah o; ka so yi fa a binyɛrigu, nyin di mɔŋ o a chinchini gba.
en: If someone hits you on the side of your face, let them hit the other side too. If someone takes your coat, dont stop them from taking your shirt too.

dag: Daadam, yɛlim di tiŋgbani maa ni di nyɛla tiŋgban shɛli din bi yi daɣiri ni bee saa ni bi mi n-niŋ tiŋgban shɛli ni suhuyiɣisili dabisili dali.
en: Mortal man, he said, tell the Israelites that their land is unholy, and so I am punishing it in my anger.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni zaŋ bɛ paɣiba ti shɛba, ka zaŋ bɛ puri ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyaŋ ba maa, dama bɛ ninkura mini bihi zaa suhu kul yɛla alaha dibu zuɣu. Anabinim zaŋ tabili maligumaaniba zaa bi lan gbibi yɛlimaŋli.
en: So I will give their wives to other men. I will give their fields to new owners. All the people of Israel want more and more money. All of them, from the least important to the most important, are like that. Even the prophets and priests tell lies.

dag: Niriba ayi maa ni daa ti ŋmaligi chani saha shɛli ka Pita yɛli Yisa, N Duuma, di viɛli ni ti be kpe. Chɛ ka ti ti suɣa ata: A zaɣ yini; Anabi Musa zaɣ yini; Anabi Ilaija mi zaɣ yini. Ŋun Pita daa ʒi o ni yɛli shɛm maa gbinni.
en: As the men were leaving Jesus, Peter said to him, Master, how good it is that we are here! We will make three tents, one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa daa laɣim garigi yɛli, Ti ni niŋ Yawɛ ni yɛli ni ti niŋ shɛlikam zaa. Ka Musa daa zaŋ niriba maa ni yɛli shɛm maa yɛli Yawɛ.
en: The people all responded with one voice: Everything that the LORD has said we will do. Moses reported to the LORD what the people said.

dag: Ka Yaakubu bihi maa daa niŋ lala, ka Yisifu daa zaŋ tɔrokɔnim maa ti ba kaman Firawuna ni daa zali shɛm, ka bo bɛ sol ni bindira ti ba.
en: Jacob's sons did as they were told. Joseph gave them wagons, as the king had ordered, and food for the trip.

dag: M mabihi, n kul bela kum barina ni dabisili kam. N ni nyuri bara yi zuɣu zaŋ chaŋ ti ni mali biɛhigu shɛli ti Duuma Yisa Masia ni la zuɣu n-chɛ ka n yɛl lala maa.
en: My friends, I face death every day! The pride I have in you, in our life in union with Christ Jesus our Lord, makes me declare this.

dag: Ka paɣ shɛb bɛn daa doli Yisa yi Galili na la daa doli Yisifu chaŋ ti nya siliga maa ni bɛ ni sɔɣi Yisa shɛm;.
en: The women who had come with Jesus from Galilee followed Joseph and watched how Jesus' body was placed in the tomb.

dag: Hiburɔn daŋ ni bɛ daa piila Hashabia min o mabihi niriba tuhili ni kɔbisiyopɔin bɛn daa mali kpiɔŋ viɛnyɛliŋga ni bɛ lihiri Izraɛlnim bɛn daa be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulinluhili polo la Yawɛ tuma zaa mini naa tuma.
en: Hashabiah was from the Hebron family. Hashabiah and his relatives were responsible for all the Lord s work and for the kings business in Israel west of the Jordan River. There were powerful men in Hashabiahs group.

dag: O kari ma bahi zibisim ni, ka neesim shɛli kani.
en: He led and brought me into darkness, not light.

dag: Yi daa lari Izraɛlnima, hal yi ni daa kul bi gbahi ba tayiɣisi ni maa zaa yoli, yi daa yi tɔɣisiri bɛ yɛla yi viinila yi zuɣuri.
en: Wasnt Israel the butt of your jokes? Didnt you shake your head as if they were thieves caught in the act?.

dag: Ka a zaŋ a noli yɛtɔɣa duhiri amaŋa n-niŋdi ma, ka tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa pam jɛndiri ma, n wum li.
en: With your mouths you exalted yourselves against me and spoke your words against me. I myself heard it!.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, n zaŋ n ni daa zaŋ n takɔb mini n tɔbu tuhi Amɔrinim ka fa bɛ tiŋgban shɛli din nyɛ Shɛkɛm la ti a, ka a mabihi la nuu ka di ni.
en: It is to you and not to your brothers that I am giving Shechem, that fertile region which I took from the Amorites with my sword and my bow.

dag: Yi mi ni dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa o ni daa ti bɔri alibarika o ba san la, o daa bi tooi nya li, dama o daa bi nya soli din ni doli taɣi o ni daa tum shɛm la hal o ni daa kul bo li ni nintam la zaa yoli.
en: You know how he later wanted it back. But there was nothing he could do to change things, even though he begged his father and cried.

dag: Chɛ ka ti yɛli ni yi mabia ŋun nyɛ doo bee paɣa beni n-nyɛla ŋun chani gbinfini ka ka bindirigu din ni di.
en: Suppose a brother or sister in Christ comes to you in need of clothes or something to eat.

dag: Di bi tuhi ni a zani ninvuɣ biɛɣu nyaaŋa saria karibu ni, ka mɔŋ ŋun ka taali yɛlimaŋli saria karibu ni.
en: You must be fair in judging others. It is wrong to favor the guilty and rob the innocent of justice.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa kuli yiŋa nti nya ka alizin biɛɣu maa shiri zo ka chɛ o bia maa, ka o dola o bindoo zuɣu.
en: When she returned to her house, she found the child lying on the bed and the demon gone.

dag: Di yuriya dunia ŋɔ bee binshɛŋa din be dunia ŋɔ ni. So yi yuri dunia ŋɔ, ti Ba Naawuni yurilim ka o ni.
en: Dont love the world or the things in the world. If anyone loves the world, the love of the Father is not in them.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ ma gili di zaa, di daa galisiya pam be vinvamli maa ni, di daa nyɛla din kuui zaa.
en: He led me all around the valley, and I could see that there were very many bones and that they were very dry.

dag: Ka ŋun Yaakubu maŋmaŋ daa daŋ bɛ tooni n-chaŋ ti damdi tiŋ napɔŋ buyopɔin hal ti mir o biɛli maa tooni.
en: Jacob himself walked in front of them all, bowing to the ground seven times as he came near his brother.

dag: Ka Jɔbab daa ti kpi, ka Husham ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛmannim tiŋgbɔŋ ni nir la di nam zan o zaani.
en: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites succeeded him.

dag: M mi ni Naawuni daa zaŋ doo maa du alizanda ni. O yi daa bela o niŋgbuŋ ni bee o yi daa ka o niŋgbuŋ ni, m bi mi; Naawuni m-mi.
en: As I said, only God really knows if this man was in his body at the time.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb daa ti zaŋ bihi ka Yisa sanna ni o ti zaŋ o nuhi pa bɛ zuɣu n-suhi Naawuni ti ba. Ka o nyaandoliba daa tahiri bihinim maa zuɣu;.
en: Some people brought children to Jesus so that he would place his hands on them and pray. But the disciples scolded them.

dag: Amaa ka Firawuna tɔbbihi daa yi Ijipti na, ka Babilɔnnim bɛn daa teei gili Jɛrusalɛm maa daa wum bɛ yɛla ka zo n-yi Jɛrusalɛm.
en: The Babylonian army had been besieging Jerusalem, but when they heard that the Egyptian army had crossed the Egyptian border, they retreated.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni ku tum tuumbiɛɣu; Kpiɔŋlan Naa ku ti nimmira yɛlimaŋli.
en: Surely God doesnt act wickedly; the Almighty doesnt distort justice.

dag: ŋun daa be yi tooni mali ya be soli chana ni o ti bo palo tin ya ka yi ti yi suɣa dɔni la yɛda. O daa bela buɣim ni yuŋ, ka be sagban ni wuntaŋ ni ni o wuhi ya yi ni yɛn doli so shɛli.
en: But he was always in front, going ahead to find a place for you to camp. At night, he was in the fire that showed you where to go. And during the day, he was in the cloud.

dag: Naawuni jɛmbu duu yiliyiiniba — kɔbiga ni pihitaayika.
en: The family of Asaph.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ bi simdi ni di gari ti, dama Sintani gba lɛbigir omaŋa m-be kaman neesim malaika n-nyɛ o la.
en: That does not surprise us, because even Satan changes himself to look like an angel of light.

dag: A chɛ ka saa miri mahigiri tiŋgbani, ka chɛ ka di mali kulim pam. Nyin Naawuni mɔɣili palila kom, nyini n-tiri niriba bindira. A ni zal li shɛm m-bala.
en: You visit the earth and make it abundant, enriching it greatly by Gods stream, full of water. You provide people with grain because that is what youve decided.

dag: O ni zali ti shɛm n-nyɛ ni ti niŋ o Bia Yisa Ba Masia yuli yɛda ka yuri taba kaman o ni zali ti shɛm.
en: This is what God commands: that we believe in his Son Jesus Christ, and that we love each other as he commanded.

dag: Kamiyana ka yi mini n dan Asiria naa maa puli. Yi yi ni tooi nya wɔribariba, n ni tin ya yuri tusaayi.
en: The king of Assyria wants to make a bet with you people! He will give you , horses, if you have enough troops to ride them.

dag: ka paɣiri bɛ wuna din nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋ salima min anzinfa ni daanya ni kuriti ni dari ni kuɣa mali shɛŋa.
en: They drank a lot of wine; and they praised the gods of gold, silver, bronze, iron, wood, and stone.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka a kumdi pampam? A lan kala naa? A saawaranim kpimi, ka biɛrim mal a kaman paɣ ni yɛn dɔɣi ka biɛrim shɛli mal o la?.
en: Now why do you cry out so loudly? Isnt the king in you? Or has your counselor perished, so that pain has seized you like that of a woman in labor?.

dag: Zaŋmiya bula yino m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara yi daalahichi zuɣu.
en: You must also give a male goat as a sin offering to make you pure.

dag: N ni daa ti gbaai yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu saha shɛli ka Naawuni Shia Kasi kana nti kpe bɛ ni kaman o ni daa kpe ti ni shɛm di piligu ni la.
en: After I began speaking, the Holy Spirit came on them just as he came on us at the beginning.

dag: Ka Rubin zuliya daa lab mali me Hɛshibɔn mini Ɛliale ni Kiriataim.
en: The Reubenites built Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim.

dag: Ka naa daa tim ti yih o na. Tiŋ maa niriba maa naa n-daa yih o.
en: Then the king of Egypt had him released; the ruler of nations set him free.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, biɛhiŋ kani, na so ŋun daa leeg o nam ka o yuli ʒiɛm o ni daa po pɔri shɛli la, ka saɣim alikauli maa ni be luɣ shɛli din nyɛ Babilɔn maa ni ka o ni kpi.
en: As surely as I live, says the LORD God, he will die in Babylon, in the place of the king who gave him the authority to rule, whose solemn pledge he scorned and whose agreement he overturned.

dag: amaa sara maligu maa nimdi yi zani hal ni daba ata, bɛn zaŋm li nyo buɣim.
en: Any meat that still remains on the third day must be burned.

dag: Ti ni daa na be yi san la, ti daa pun yɛli ya ni ti ni nya alaka, ka yi zaa mi ni lala n-shiri niŋ.
en: because when we were with you, we told you this would happen. And we did suffer, as you well know.

dag: Maligumaana yi yɛn kpe dundɔŋ maa ni, di bi simdi ka o nyu wain.
en: None of the priests may drink wine when they go into the inner courtyard.

dag: Ti kul suhiri Naawuni tiri yi zaa, ka kul paɣiri Naawuni yi zuɣu sahakam;.
en: We always thank God for you all and always mention you in our prayers.

dag: Amaa hal o yi bi yihi ti, Naa, nyin baŋmi ni ti ku jɛm a wuna ŋɔ min a ni mali salima binnan shɛli zali maa.
en: But even if God does not save us, we want you to know, King, that we refuse to serve your gods. We will not worship the gold idol you have set up.

dag: Taainim mini Sidɔnnim ni tin shɛŋa din zaa be Filistia tiŋgbɔŋ ni ŋɔ, bɔ ka yi lee bɔri ni yi niŋ ma maa? Yi bɔrimi ni yi bɔhi ma biɛri binshɛli zuɣu? Yi yi bɔrimi ni yi bɔhi ma biɛri, n ni chɛ ka yi tuma maa ŋmaligi lu yi zuɣu yomyom!.
en: What are you to me, Tyre and Sidon, and all the regions of Philistia? Are you paying me back for something? If you are paying me back, then in a flash I will turn your deeds back upon your own heads.

dag: Ŋuna n-lan nyɛ ŋun maari ti suhuri ti wahala dibu puuni ni di chɛ ka ti gba tooi zaŋ suhumaabo shɛli ŋun Naawuni ni mali maari ti suhuri maa m-maari bɛn zaa nyari wahala balibu kam suhuri.
en: He comforts us when we are in trouble, so that we can share this same comfort with others in trouble.

dag: Bɛna n-yɛn su laɣiŋgu suɣili maa puuni nɛma fukumsi, ka tumdi tuma Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili ni, ka lan tumdi tuma tiri Izraɛlnima.
en: The Levites will serve the community by being responsible for the furnishings of the tent.

dag: ka mi bi simdi ni o ka Yisa sanna. Amaa ni o kul yɛlim yɛtɔɣ shɛli o ni yɛn yɛli ka o dabili maa kpaŋ.
en: In fact, I didnt even consider myself worthy to come to you. Just say the word and my servant will be healed.

dag: M mabihi, suhimiya sɔŋ yi ma, dama o lan pala m paɣa, m mi lan pala o yidana. Suhimiya ka o yihi pagɔrisigu o kɔbili ni ka yihi zina niŋbu o suhu ni.
en: Argue with your mother. Argue with her because she is no longer my wife, and I am no longer her husband! Tell her to stop being like a prostitute. Tell her to take away her lovers from between her breasts.

dag: Yinim bɛn be tiŋ maa vinvamli ni, fabilimiya, dama kɔhigɔriba la zaa kpiya, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa yi zahindi anzinfa sania zuɣu la kpi.
en: You people living in the lower part of town will cry, because all the traders and rich merchants will be destroyed.

dag: Ka lala bindira maa ni nyɛ a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni bindira n-ʒiɛya gu yuma ayopɔin shɛŋa ni kum ni ti yɛn lu Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni maa, ka di chɛ ka kum ti ku ku tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ nima.
en: This food will be reserved for the seven years of famine to follow in the land of Egypt so that the land wont be ravaged by the famine.

dag: Saha shɛli n ni daa tɛhi, N napɔŋ yɛn sarigi la, Yawɛ, ka a yurilim maŋli la gbaai ma zali.
en: When I felt my feet slipping, you came with your love and kept me steady.

dag: Ka Jɛfita daa po pɔri n-lo Yawɛ alikauli yɛli, A yi ni zaŋ Ammɔnnim maa niŋ n nuu ni.
en: Jephthah made a solemn promise to the LORD: If you will decisively hand over the Ammonites to me.

dag: A chɛ ka n nini kɔŋ pɔbbu, ka di muɣisi ma pam hal ka n ti kɔŋ yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu.
en: Because of you, Lord God, I can't sleep. I am restless and can't even talk.

dag: ka zo n-chaŋ tin shɛŋa din baɣibaɣi nimaani zaa ni nti zaŋ barinim niŋ amaŋkanim ni ʒiri chani bɛ ni daa wum ni o be luɣ shɛlikam polo.
en: So they ran all over that part of the country to bring their sick people to him on mats. They brought them each time they heard where he was.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nahim a la ni ka a sanna. Bɛ ni kana ti damdi tiŋ lu a sizuura. Bɛnkam zaa daa ʒiɛm a la ni kana ti jɛm a. Bɛ bol a Yawɛ tiŋa; ka lan bol a Ziɔn din nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi la tin titali.
en: In the past, people hurt you, but they will bow down before you. In the past, people hated you, but they will bow down at your feet. They will call you The City of the Lord s, Zion of the Holy One of Israel.

dag: bɛ ni kpi n-chaŋ ti pahi bɛ yaannim ni m-be luɣ shɛli din nyɛ zibisim shee hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: But the time will come for him to die and go to his ancestors. And he will never again see the light of day.

dag: Ka so ti ku mi ni bindira daa niŋya pam kum shɛli din yɛn doli di nyaaŋa na maa zuɣu, dama kum maa ni ti mii pam.
en: The time of plenty will be entirely forgotten, because the famine which follows will be so terrible.

dag: ni man Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, N ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai yiya ŋɔ nima mini di niriba kaman kundi maa puuni ni yɛli shɛlikam zaa, ka Juda naa karim li maa.
en: the following message from the Lord : I am going to punish Jerusalem and all its people, as written in the book that the king has read.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa bi kali Lɛvinim ni bɛ daŋ niriba pahi bɛ ni.
en: The families from the tribe of Levi were not counted with the other Israelites.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli, Di karitiy o; dama so kani ŋun ni tooi zaŋ n yuli tum alahiziba tuma ka dii lan ŋmaligi galim ma.
en: Jesus replied, Dont stop him. No one who does powerful acts in my name can quickly turn around and curse me.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Malimi wahu ŋun mali lɔɣu n-zaŋ tabili da wɔɣinli; ka wahu yi dim sokam ka o lihi li, o ni tiligi.
en: and the Lord answered, Make a snake out of bronze and place it on top of a pole. Anyone who gets bitten can look at the snake and be saved from death.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ baŋ ni a kɔŋko ŋun yuli nyɛ Yawɛ ŋɔ, n-nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋun su dunia ŋɔ zaa.
en: Let them know that you— your name is the LORD!— you alone are Most High over all the earth.

dag: Wuntizɔriba nya li, ka bɛ suhuri paligi, ka bɛn ka taali lara, ka maani ba ansarisi yɛra.
en: Good people are glad and the innocent laugh when they see the wicked punished.

dag: Ka niriba maa ni shɛb daa kpahindi Yisa ni bɛ nya o ni tib o Vuhim Dabisili dali maa, dama bɛ daa bɔrimi ni bɛ nya o taali ka fiɣis o.
en: Some people were there who wanted to accuse Jesus of doing wrong; so they watched him closely to see whether he would cure the man on the Sabbath.

dag: Ka yi nya ka wum ka di pala Ɛfɛsus ŋɔ kɔŋko, amaa Ɛsha tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa ka Pool ŋɔ kul yɛri niriba ni salinim ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali buɣ shɛŋa pala shɛli; lala ka o niŋdi lɛbigiri niriba pam suhuri.
en: Now, you can see and hear for yourselves what this fellow Paul is doing. He says that hand-made gods are not gods at all, and he has succeeded in convincing many people, both here in Ephesus and in nearly the whole province of Asia.

dag: Ka Rɛhɔbɔam daa sula Izraɛlnim shɛb bɛn daa be Juda tinsi ni la kɔŋko.
en: leaving Rehoboam as king only of the people who lived in the territory of Judah.

dag: Amaa a nam ba ka bɛ biɛhigu pooi nyin Naawuni biɛla. A zaŋ jiri mini jilima pili ba kaman zuɣupila la.
en: You made us a little lower than you yourself, and you have crowned us with glory and honor.

dag: Ka timanim maa daa yɛli Firawuna, Dimbɔŋɔ din nyɛla Naawuni yiko tuma. Amaa ka Firawuna daa niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni o ku wum kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli shɛm la.
en: The religious experts said to Pharaoh, This is something only God could do! But Pharaoh was stubborn, and he wouldnt listen to them, just as the LORD had said.

dag: Dindali maa Siria naa maa ʒi tibisa ti ku lan tam yi bɔɣusapima zuɣu; n ni ti kab o naɣikɔra dapuhi din be yi nyiŋgoya ni la.
en: Then they will no longer rule your nation. All will go well for you, and your burden will be lifted.

dag: Jɛhoyachin yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisaayika saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam maa niŋla chira ata Jɛrusalɛm. O ma yuli n-daa booni Nɛhushita. Ka Nɛhushita mi ba daa nyɛ Ɛlnatan ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm nir la.
en: Jehoiachin was years old when he became king, and he ruled for three months in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Nehushta; she was Elnathans daughter and was from Jerusalem.

dag: Ka tihi puu maa lana daa yɛli, Ka wula ka n yɛn niŋ? N ni timla mmaŋmaŋ biyurigu ŋɔ; di pa shɛli bɛ ni ti ti ŋun jilima.
en: The owner of the vineyard said, What should I do? Ill send my son, whom I love dearly. Perhaps they will respect him.

dag: Ka naa daa bɔhi Daniɛl la, A ni tooi yɛli ma zahindi maa ni nyɛ shɛm, ka wuhi ma di gbinni.
en: The king asked Daniel a question. He said, Are you able to tell me about my dream, and what it means.

dag: Naɣilahi pam n-teei gili ma. Bashan naɣilahi bɛn mali kpiɔŋ n-kul teei gili ma.
en: Many enemies surround me like bulls; they are all around me, like fierce bulls from the land of Bashan.

dag: Yawɛ, wuhim ma a ni bɔri ni n niŋ shɛli, ka zaŋ ma doli so viɛlli, n dimnim zuɣu.
en: I have enemies, Lord , so teach me your ways. Show me the right way to live.

dag: O di kpuɣi pakoli bee paɣ so ŋun yi o yidan yili bee bɛ ni pun saɣim paɣ so bee pagɔrili, amaa o kpuɣim o zuliya ni paɣ so ŋun na ʒi doo.
en: He cannot marry a widow, a divorced woman, or a woman defiled by promiscuity. He can only marry a virgin from his own people.

dag: Ka Naa Ahasivɛrɔs daa yɛli Napaɣ Ɛsta mini Mɔdɛkai ŋun nyɛ Yɛhudia nir maa, Nyama, m pun chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ Haman yili gar dari, o ni daa lo nia biɛ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Yɛhudianim polo la zuɣu, ka zaŋ o yiŋ ti Ɛsta.
en: King Ahasuerus said to Queen Esther and to Mordecai the Jew, Look, Ive given Esther everything Haman owned. And Haman himself my servants have impaled on the pole because he planned to attack the Jews.

dag: Ka bintɔrili yi to so nti naai.
en: Whenever someone has a boil on their skin, it heals.

dag: Yi ni daa bi kpuɣi li tuuli la zuɣu n-daa chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ daa yiɣisi o suhu bahi ti zuɣu n-darigi ti tibili la, dama ti daa bi niŋ li kaman di ni simdi ni ti niŋ li shɛm.
en: The first time we tried to bring the chest to Jerusalem, we didn't ask the Lord what he wanted us to do. He was angry with us, because you Levites weren't there to carry the chest.

dag: Hal ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kahiri tandi nɛma n-tiri daa zaŋla bɛ nu yiniyini tumdi tuma, ka zaŋ nu yiniyini mi gbib bidibbina.
en: who were building the wall. The carriers did their work with a load in one hand and a weapon in the other.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛl o paɣ maa, N yɛlila Nabɔt ŋun nyɛ Jɛziriil nir la, Zaŋm a wain tihi puu ŋɔ n-kɔhi n zuɣu bee a yi bɔra, n ni taɣ a wain tihi pu shɛli, ka o yɛli ma, N ku zaŋ n wain tihi ti a. .
en: I asked Naboth to sell me his vineyard or to let me give him a better one, Ahab replied. And he told me I couldn't have it.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa yɛli ni o ni ku ba, ka Musa ŋun nyɛ o ninvuɣ gahindili daa zan o tooni n-taɣ o ni o maag o suhu; ka o ku ku ba.
en: You were angry and started to destroy them, but Moses, your chosen leader, begged you not to do it.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa daa yiɣisi zani bɔh o, A ka noli din ni garigi? Shɛhira bɔ ka bɛ lee dir a ŋɔ?.
en: Then the high priest stood and said to Jesus, Arent you going to respond to the testimony these people have brought against you.

dag: Noli deebu mini ʒiɛyimtali zuɣu ni chɛ ka nir daalahichi kpihim, ka Yawɛ jɛmbu ni chɛ ka nir yi zaɣ biɛɣu ni.
en: Be loyal and faithful, and God will forgive your sin. Obey the Lord and nothing evil will happen to you.

dag: Yawɛ, a ni daa yiɣisi Seir zoya zuɣu, a ni daa yi Ɛdom tiŋgban ni chana, tiŋgbani daa dammi, ka saa luna. Iin, ka sagbana daa chɛ ka saa luna.
en: Our Lord , God of Israel, when you came from Seir, where the Edomites live.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ a yurilim yɛla yɛli cheechi din be kpe ŋɔ. Niŋmi ania sɔŋ ba ka bɛ bahi chaŋ bɛ chandi maa, dama lala niŋbu nyɛla din tiɣiri Naawuni nini.
en: They spoke highly of your love in front of the church. You all would do well to provide for their journey in a way that honors God.

dag: Yinim bɛn no n-taai nandaamba, ka nahindi tiŋgbani ŋɔ tarimba ŋɔ, wummiya.
en: Listen to this, you that trample on the needy and try to destroy the poor of the country.

dag: Di bi simdi ni nir di shiri pam bee m-bɔri jilima ti yaɣi.
en: Eating too much honey isnt good, nor is it appropriate to seek honor.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyamiya, kom yi nuzaa polo zɔrina ni di ti leei kokpɛɣu. Di ni ti lim tiŋgbɔŋ maa n-tabili binshɛlikam din be di ni, ka lim tiŋ maa ni bɛn be di ni. Niriba ni ti kum pam, ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba zaa ti fabili.
en: The LORD proclaims: Waters are rising from the north and turning into a raging flood. They will engulf the land and everything in it, the towns and those living in them. The people cry out; all who live there scream.

dag: Hiburɔn bidibisi ni, Jɛria n-daa nyɛ kpɛma n-zaŋ Amaria pa, Jahaziɛl n-daa pah ata, ka Jɛkamiam pah anahi.
en: Hebrons family: Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

dag: M bi zɔri ninvuɣ tuhi piapia bɛn ʒe n-gili n luɣilikam la.
en: I am not afraid of the thousands of enemies who surround me on every side.

dag: Dama daliri din chɛ ka Masia daa kpi ka lan neei kum ni nyɛla ni di chɛ ka o leei bɛn kpi mini bɛn ne Duuma.
en: This is why Christ died and lived: so that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ li yɛl a mabia Aduna min o bidibisi maa, ka booi kpam bahi bɛ zuɣuri ni n-zaŋ ba leei maligumaaniba, ka chɛ ka bɛ be kasi din ni chɛ ka bɛ leei maligumaaniba n-tumdi n tuma.
en: Put these garments on your brother Aaron and on his sons with him. Anoint them with oil, ordain them, and make them holy to serve me as priests.

dag: Ka o daa ti wumis o bi yino, ka o niŋ yaa, ka bɔhim binyara gbahibu, ka daa ŋubiri ninsalinima.
en: One of her cubs gets up. He has grown to be a strong young lion. He has learned to catch his food. He killed and ate a man.

dag: Ka Pirɔs bia Sɔpata ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛria tiŋbia la mini Aristakus ni Sɛkundus bɛn daa nyɛ Tɛsalɔnaika tiŋbihi la ni Gaiɔs ŋun daa nyɛ Dɛɛbi tiŋbia la ni Timoti m-pahi Tikikus mini Trɔfimus bɛn daa yi Ɛsha na la daa dol o chaŋ.
en: These men were traveling with him: Sopater, the son of Pyrrhus, from the city of Berea; Aristarchus and Secundus, from the city of Thessalonica; Gaius, from the city of Derbe; Timothy; and two men from Asia, Tychicus and Trophimus.

dag: N yi ti chɛ ka Ijipti zani dabari, ka chɛ ka binshɛŋa zaa din daa be di ni vuui, n yi ti ku binshɛɣukam din be di ni, di saha ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: When I make Egypt a desolate wasteland and destroy all who live there, they will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Naawuni, a yuli nyɛla din du n-gari sagbana. Chɛ ka a jilima be dunia ŋɔ zaa ni.
en: May you, my God, be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu nti gbaai Naawuni yɛla tɔɣisibu ni suhukpeeni; ka Akuila mini Prisila daa wum o wuhibu maa, ka zaŋ o ti maan wuh o Naawuni yɛla viɛnyɛliŋga pahi.
en: Apollos started speaking bravely in the synagogue. But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him to their home and helped him understand God's Way even better.

dag: Bɛtani do so ŋun yuli daa booni Lazarɔs daa ti biɛra. O min o tizɔpaɣiba Mariama mini Maata zaa ya n-daa bala.
en: There was a man named Lazarus who was sick. He lived in the town of Bethany, where Mary and her sister Martha lived.

dag: N niriba bɛn yɛla mali nambɔɣu ŋɔ, pilimiya buri, ka niŋ tampiligim buɣi yimaŋa n-kum kaman nira bi gaŋa ni yi kpi ka o kumdi shɛm la. Fabilimiya pam, dama bɛn kuri niriba maa ni libigi ti.
en: The Lord says to his people, Put on sackcloth and roll in ashes. Mourn with bitter tears as you would for an only child, because the one who comes to destroy you will suddenly attack.

dag: Zuliya shɛb ku lan kana ti ŋme ba tɔbu ka di bɛ nɛma, ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni biŋkɔbiri ku lan gbahi ba. Bɛ ni ti beni ni alaafee ka so ku lan kpɛhi ba dabiɛm.
en: The heathen nations will not plunder them any more, and the wild animals will not kill and eat them. They will live in safety, and no one will terrify them.

dag: dama Naawuni fukumsi zaligu daa bi tooi chɛ ka binshɛli niŋ dɛde; amaa din lee beni nyɛla, tahima suŋ din gari li yipa kana, ka ti ni tooi miri Naawuni di zuɣu.
en: The Law of Moses could not make anything perfect. But now a better hope has been given to us. And with that hope we can come near to God.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yiɣisi Giligal chaŋ Gibia din be Bɛnjamin tiŋgban ni la. Ka Sool daa kali ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o sani maa kaman ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu laasabu.
en: Then Samuel left Gilgal. Part of Saul's army had not deserted him, and he led them to Gibeah in Benjamin to join his other troops. Then he counted them and found that he still had men.

dag: zaŋ tabili tiŋkpan shɛŋa zaa din gil li zaŋ hal ti paai Baalatibeer . Simiɔn zuliya niriba ni daa deei tiŋgban shɛli ka di leei bɛ dini m-bala.
en: They also got all the fields around the cities as far as Baalath Beer . So this was the area that was given to the tribe of Simeon. Each family got its land.

dag: Lala ka Izraɛlnim daa niŋ. Bɛ daa niŋmi kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm.
en: The Israelites did everything exactly as the LORD commanded Moses.

dag: M bia, binshɛli din yaɣi dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu, nyin zom li. Litaafinim pam sabbu nyɛla din ka zanibu shee, ka bɔhimbu pam nyɛ din gbarigiri nira.
en: Be careful, my child, of anything beyond them! Theres no end to the excessive production of scrolls. Studying too much wearies the body.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: Then the Lord spoke to me.

dag: Gomna Pailɛt ni daa zahim nya ka o ku tooi yihi ba bɛ ni bɔri shɛm maa ni, ka nya ka bɛ maan piligirila duŋ taabu maa zuɣu, ka o daa zaŋ kom paɣ o nuhi salo maa ninni ka yɛli, N nuu ka doo ŋun ka taali ŋɔ ʒim yihibu ni. Yi yɛla m-bala.
en: When Pilate saw that it was no use to go on, but that a riot might break out, he took some water, washed his hands in front of the crowd, and said, I am not responsible for the death of this man! This is your doing.

dag: Bi so ŋun mal o ba ansarisi ka ʒiɛm o ma, ka zaɣis o noli, vinvamli ni kahiŋkɔri ni kpuɣ o chaŋ ka juri ti di o.
en: If you make fun of your father or despise your mother in her old age, you ought to be eaten by vultures or have your eyes picked out by wild ravens.

dag: Di saha ka Batishiiba daa yɛli naa, M bɔri ni n suh a la bimbil yini, a mi di mɔŋ ma li. Ka naa yɛl o, M ma, yɛlim ma a ni bɔri shɛli maa, dama n ku mɔŋ a li.
en: Bathsheba sat down and then asked, Would you do me a small favor? Solomon replied, Mother, just tell me what you want, and I will do it.

dag: O duhir o yee zama pam ni, ka tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa fɔntinsi dunɔdaya gbini.
en: calling loudly at the city gates and wherever people come together:.

dag: Hal yi ni to tɛte ni yi di kpibisi, ka yi mini niriba tɔɣisi gbaai yi zɔsimo daa ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm.
en: Would you even gamble over an orphan, barter away your friend?.

dag: N di yɛlimi, Chɛ ka ninkura tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, ka chɛ ka bɛn yuma galisi pam mi wuhi yɛm.
en: I thought to myself, Older people should speak first. They have lived many years, so they have learned many things.

dag: Ka n daa bɔhi ba, Buɣ din ni ka yi lee chani maa? Dinzuɣu ka bɛ booni nimaani yuli Bama hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: I asked them where they went to worship those gods, and they answered, At the local shrines. And those places of worship are still called shrines.

dag: Toli nyɛla bɛn ka naa, amaa bɛ nyɛla bɛn doli tab chana sariasaria.
en: locusts, who have no king, but march like an army;.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ zanimiya baalim ka m mini ya laɣim suhi Yawɛ o ni tum tiliginsim tuun shɛŋa ti yi mini yi yaannim zaa la zuɣu.
en: Now the Lord will be your judge. So stand here and listen, while I remind you how often the Lord has saved you and your ancestors from your enemies.

dag: ni Anab ni Ɛshitɛmo ni Anim.
en: Anab, Eshtemoa, Anim.

dag: Yi puhiri dabisa mini goya ni saha ni yuma churi!.
en: You even celebrate certain days, months, seasons, and years.

dag: O yuri ni o yɛli noli din bie ti niriba. Chɛ ka noli di o. O je alibarika, dinzuɣu di chɛ ka alibarika mir o.
en: He cursed others. Now place a curse on him! He never wished others well. Wish only trouble for him!.

dag: Bɛ puri ni tihi ni ti wali wala, ka tiŋgbani ni bindira niŋ. Bɛ ni ti be bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ni alaafee. N yi kabisi dapuhi din pa bɛ nyiŋgoya zuɣu la, ka fa ba ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋ ba leei daba nuu ni bahi, bɛ ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: The trees will bear fruit, the fields will produce crops, and everyone will live in safety on his own land. When I break my people's chains and set them free from those who made them slaves, then they will know that I am the Lord .

dag: O ni daa di wahala kpi la nyaaŋa o daa lan zaŋ omaŋa wuhi ba shihira balibu pam puuni ni o shiri neei kum ni. Ka bɛ nina daa nya o ka bɛ min o be hal ti paai biɛɣ pihinahi, ka o daa wuhi ba Naawuni nam yɛla pam.
en: For days after Jesus had suffered and died, he proved in many ways that he had been raised from death. He appeared to his apostles and spoke to them about God's kingdom.

dag: Zaŋmiya nim viɛla zaa niŋ di ni, dina n-nyɛ: gbalipuɣa mini gaba, ka zaŋya boligo kɔba gba niŋ di ni.
en: Put in the best pieces of meat— the shoulders and the legs— fill it with choice bony pieces too.

dag: Dɔbba mini paɣiba bɛn pun lo amiliya, n zali ya zaligu, amaa pa mani n-zali ya lala, ti Duuma n-zali ya li. Dina n-nyɛ: Paɣ miri ka o yi o yidana yiŋa.
en: Now, I have a command for those who are married. Actually, it is not from me; it is what the Lord commanded. A wife should not leave her husband.

dag: ka suhi Naawuni yɛli, Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun chɛ ka m bihi ni yino ʒini n nam ʒiishee zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka mmaŋmaŋ nini nya li ŋɔ.
en: and prayed, I praise you, Lord God of Israel. You have made my son Solomon king and have let me live to see it.

dag: Ka Ɛba daa dɔɣi bidibisi ayi: yino yuli n-daa booni Pɛlɛg , ka o mabia yuli daa booni Jokitan.
en: Eber had two sons. One son was named Peleg, because the people on the earth were divided into different languages during his lifetime. Pelegs brother was named Joktan.

dag: Ka a ti deei nyɛviya tiliginsim liɣiri maa Izraɛlnim sani n-chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ li tum tuma Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili ni, ka di leei yi nyɛviya tiligibu sara maligu, ka lala chɛ ka Izraɛlnim kul teeri di yɛla Yawɛ sani.
en: This money is to be used for the upkeep of the sacred tent, and because of it, I will never forget my people.

dag: Shɛma daa nyɛla Raham ba, ka Raham nyɛ Jokiam ba, ka Rɛkɛm mi daa nyɛ Shammai ba.
en: Shema was the father of Raham and the grandfather of Jorkeam. Rekem, Shema's brother, was the father of Shammai.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ kpiimba kum ni neebu gba. Bɛ ni zaŋ niŋgbuŋ shɛli sɔɣi nyɛla din poora, ka din neerina mi nyɛ din bi poora.
en: It will be the same when those who have died are raised to life. The body that is planted in the grave will ruin and decay, but it will be raised to a life that cannot be destroyed.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n ni yɛli ya n ni yɛn niŋ n tihi puu maa shɛm. N ni sibigi di gariche bahi, ka wurim gooni din gil li, ka chɛ ka binsaɣinda kana ti saɣim li, ka daai li luhi.
en: Now I will let you know what I am going to do. I will cut down the hedge and tear down the wall. My vineyard will be trampled and left in ruins.

dag: Mbusim be ti zuɣu! Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi fa ti buɣ shɛb bɛn mali kpiɔŋ ŋɔ nuu ni bahi? Buɣ shɛŋa din daa zaŋ alɔbo balibu kam luhi Ijiptinim zuɣu n-ku ba mɔɣu ni la m-bala.
en: Who can save us from those powerful gods? They are the gods who slaughtered the Egyptians in the desert!.

dag: Ka a ti lan yɛli ba yaha ni Izraɛl ninvuɣ so bee saan shɛb bɛn be bɛ sani ninvuɣ so yi yɛn mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la bee sara maligu.
en: You will also say to them: Anyone from Israels house or from the immigrants who live with you who offers up an entirely burned offering or communal sacrifice.

dag: Dama niriba ŋɔ leela suhutunanima. Bɛ ŋari bɛ tiba ni di chɛ ka bɛ ku wum. Bɛ pɔb bɛ nina ni di chɛ ka bɛ ku nya. Di yi pa lala, bɛ nina ni nya, ka bɛ tiba wum, ka bɛ baŋ bɛ suhuri ni, ka ŋmaligi labi n sanna, ka n tib ba.
en: because this people's minds are dull, and they have stopped up their ears and closed their eyes. Otherwise, their eyes would see, their ears would hear, their minds would understand, and they would turn to me, says God, and I would heal them.

dag: O daa doli o ba ni daa doli so shɛŋa zaa, ka jɛm o ba ni daa jɛm buɣ shɛŋa zaa.
en: he imitated his father's actions, and he worshiped the idols that his father had worshiped.

dag: N ku kuli n yiŋa bee n-dɔni m bindoo zuɣu.
en: I will not go home or go to bed;.

dag: dama ti Duuma ni niŋ kaman o ni zali ni o ni niŋ shɛm o sariakaribo puuni dunianim zaa sani ŋ-ŋmaai li jia.
en: for the Lord will quickly settle his full account with the world.

dag: Yawɛ tooni, dama o kanna. O kanimina ni o ti kari dunianim saria. O mi yɛn zaŋla wuntitali mini yɛlimaŋli kari niriba saria.
en: when they see the Lord coming! He is coming to rule the world. He will rule all the nations of the world with justice and fairness.

dag: Ti mi zɔri niriba ni ti yɛli ni ninsalinima n-daa zal li, dama sokam zaa saɣiya ni Jɔn Baptaizira daa nyɛla anab maŋli.
en: But if we say, From human beings, we are afraid of what the people might do, because they are all convinced that John was a prophet.

dag: Jɛhoyachin yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisaayika saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam maa niŋla chira ata Jɛrusalɛm. O ma yuli n-daa booni Nɛhushita. Ka Nɛhushita mi ba daa nyɛ Ɛlnatan ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm nir la.
en: Jehoiachin was years old when he became king of Judah, and he ruled only months from Jerusalem. His mother Nehushta was the daughter of Elnathan from Jerusalem.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri sara maligu nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ sani, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi din tuhi suhigu nyɛla din tiɣir o nini.
en: The LORD detests the sacrifices of the wicked, but favors the prayers of those who do right.

dag: Yi daa tim tuumba Jɔn Baptaizira sani, ka o gba daa di yɛlimaŋli ŋɔ shɛhira.
en: You sent men to John, and he told you what is true.

dag: Yaa ti Duuma ni ti Naawuni, nyini n-simdi tibigibu ni jilima tibu ni yiko malibu, dama nyini n-nam binshɛɣukam zaa, a yubu ni ka a daa nam li, ka chɛ ka di be.
en: Our Lord and God, you are worthy to receive glory, honor, and power. You created all things, and by your decision they are and were created.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri ye wuntia zuɣu mal alibarika, dama Naawuni ni ti ba bɛ suhuri ni ye shɛli zuɣu maa.
en: Great blessings belong to those who want to do right more than anything else. God will fully satisfy them.

dag: dama yɛlimaŋli maa be ti ni, ka kul ni kpalim be ti ni hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: because the truth remains in us and will be with us forever.

dag: Ka Ɛlihu daa lan yɛli.
en: Elihu said:.

dag: ka zaŋ zuliya pia ti a, ka zaŋ zuliya yini n-ti o n dabili Dauda mini Jɛrusalɛm din nyɛ n ni pii tin shɛli Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ zaa ni la zuɣu.
en: But I will leave him one tribe on account of my servant David and on account of Jerusalem, the city I have chosen from all the tribes of Israel.

dag: Dama n yi suhuri Naawuni tinzun yɛtɔɣ shɛl ni, n shia n-suhiri maa, amaa di ka buchi zaŋ chaŋ m milinsi polo.
en: If I pray in a tongue, my spirit prays but my mind isnt productive.

dag: N ni lo ba alikauli din ka bahigu din ni chɛ ka n ku lan chɛ ba zaɣ viɛlli niŋbu. N ni ti chɛ ka bɛ luri ma sizuura bɛ suhuri ni din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku lan ŋmaligi ka chɛ ma.
en: I will make an agreement with the people of Israel and Judah that will last forever. In this agreement I will never turn away from them. I will always be good to them. I will make them want to respect me. Then they will never turn away from me.

dag: Bɛ yiya ni ti leei shɛb dini, ka bɛ puri mini bɛ paɣiba leei shɛb dini, dama n ni darigi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ nim tibili. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Their houses will be given to others. Their fields and their wives will be given to other people. I will raise my hand and punish the people of Judah. This message is from the Lord .

dag: Wɛi, yɛl biɛɣu ni paai Jɛrusalɛm din nyɛ Naawuni sara maligu bimbini, ka nyɛ Dauda ni daa be tin shɛli ni la. Chɛ ka churi ŋɔ kul puhiri yuuni kam.
en: God's altar, Jerusalem itself, is doomed! The city where David camped is doomed! Let another year or two come and go, with its feasts and festivals.

dag: Ka o daa dii gbaai nachimbil maa m-mɔɣis o kpariŋ, ka lih o ninni ka bi zɔri vi ka yɛl o.
en: She grabbed him and kissed him, and with no sense of shame, she said:.

dag: Ka hal bɛn daa lu maa yi chɛ biɛhiŋ, Naawuni ni zaŋ ba labisi tuɣi, dama o mali yiko din ni tooi lan labisi ba tuɣi yaha.
en: If those other branches will start having faith, they will be made a part of that tree again. God has the power to put them back.

dag: Amaa di yi niŋ daba ayi ha, n ni lan labisi Ɛlamnim nyamma ti ba. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But later on I will make the people of Elam prosperous again. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: O daa tɔɣis o nirilim yɛtɔɣa, ka ti o nam din du n-gari na shɛb bɛn daa be o sani Babilɔn maa nama.
en: Evil-merodach treated him kindly and gave him a position of greater honor than he gave the other kings who were exiles with him in Babylonia.

dag: Ka o bɔhi n ni nyɛ ninvuɣ so, ka n yɛl o, N nyɛla Amalɛk nira.
en: He asked who I was, and I told him that I was an Amalekite.

dag: Ka Mariama daa ti paai Yisa sani n-gban o tooni yɛl o, N Duuma, a yi di daa be ya ŋɔ, n tizɔdoo ŋɔ daa naan ku kpi.
en: When Mary arrived where Jesus was and saw him, she fell at his feet and said, Lord, if you had been here, my brother wouldnt have died.

dag: Ka daliri din chɛ ka o daa leei Naa Sulemaana dim maa m-bɔŋɔ: Sulemaana daa mɛla Millo gooni ŋari foliŋga din daa be o ba Dauda tiŋ la ni la.
en: This is the story of the revolt. Solomon was filling in the land on the east side of Jerusalem and repairing the city walls.

dag: Di veeni ni nir kul maag o ni baalim guhiri Yawɛ tiliginsim.
en: It is good to wait patiently for the Lord to save us.

dag: O kɔŋko n-nyɛ n tampiŋ kpiɔŋ ni n tiliginsim ni m birini, ka so ku tooi nyaŋ ma.
en: He is my Rock, the only one who can save me. He is my high place of safety, where no army can defeat me.

dag: Ka dansarika gul maa daa bi lan lihir o ni zaŋ binshɛlikam niŋ Yisifu nuu ni maa, dama Yawɛ daa be Yisifu sani, ka o daa yi niŋ shɛlikam, Yawɛ chɛrimi ka di tɔŋ.
en: The jailer did not worry about anything, because the Lord was with Joseph and made him successful in all that he did.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka o zɔri ninvuɣ so o ni bɔri nambɔɣu, ka chɛ ka o ni bɔri ninvuɣ so mi suhu kul kpɛma.
en: So then, God has mercy on anyone he wishes, and he makes stubborn anyone he wishes.

dag: Ka o biɛyanim maa gba daa kana ti damd o tooni ka yɛli, Ti nyɛla a daba.
en: Right then, Joseph's brothers came and bowed down to the ground in front of him and said, We are your slaves.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi maa daa niŋ sapashin kpɛm maa ni wuhi ba shɛm maa n-zaŋ Pool yuŋ m-mali ti paai Antipatiris.
en: The soldiers carried out their orders. They got Paul and took him that night as far as Antipatris.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah ata daa kpaag o laa ni dini bahi mɔɣa mini kɔbilisirima ni, ka di leei ʒim.
en: The third angel poured his bowl into the rivers and springs of water, and they turned into blood.

dag: Chɛrubinim maa daa yirigila bɛ kpiŋkpama zuɣusaa, ka bɛ kpiŋkpama maa mahim luri adaka yɔrigu maa zuɣu, ka bɛ nina kpa taba. Adaka yɔrigu maa dɛde ka chɛrubinim maa nina daa kpa.
en: The wings of the angels were spread up toward the sky. The angels covered the Box with their wings and faced each other, looking toward the mercy-cover.

dag: Babilɔn bipuɣiŋga, a ni nya tibidarigibo, a ni daa niŋ ti shɛm la zuɣu. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ti yɛn bɔh a biɛri ni ti mali suhupiɛlli!.
en: Babylon, you will be destroyed! Bless the one who pays you back for what you did to us.

dag: Naa Hɛzɛkia tuumba maa ni daa ka Aizaia sanna.
en: When Isaiah received King Hezekiah's message.

dag: Yawɛ n-chɛ ka wuntizɔriba bi gbɛri kum, amaa o chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri bi nyari bɛ ni bɔri shɛli.
en: The Lord will not let good people go hungry, but he will keep the wicked from getting what they want.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim kum nyɛla yɛlikpani Yawɛ sani.
en: You are deeply concerned when one of your loyal people faces death.

dag: Yinima n niriba Izraɛlnima, n ni lan zaŋ ya labisi yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ka yi ti be di ni n-su li yaha. Ka yi bihi ku lan kpi di ni.
en: Yes, I will lead many people—my people, Israel—to your land. You will be their property, and you will not take away their children again.

dag: Yi karitila nimmira saria, amaa man bi kariti so saria.
en: You judge according to human standards, but I judge no one.

dag: Bɛ daa wum n ni ŋuhiri shɛm, ka so kani ŋun ni maai n suhu. N dimnim zaa daa wum m muɣisigu maa yɛla. A ni niŋ shɛm maa mali ba la suhupiɛlli. Chɛ ka a ni daa yɛli dabisi shɛli yɛla la paana, ka chɛ ka bɛ gba be kaman n ni be shɛm ŋɔ.
en: Everyone heard my groaning, but no one offered comfort. My enemies know of the trouble that you have brought on me, and it makes them glad. Hurry and punish them, as you have promised.

dag: N-yi biɛɣ asiba ka Yisa labiri Jɛrusalɛm ka kum ti gbaag o.
en: On his way back to the city early next morning, Jesus was hungry.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun mi bi tumdi tuma, amaa ka niŋ ŋun chɛ ka alahichilana yiri taali ni Naawuni sani yɛda, Naawuni zaŋd o gba zaani wuntia zaani o yɛda niŋbu maa zuɣu.
en: But people cannot do any work that will make them right with God. So they must trust in him. Then he accepts their faith, and that makes them right with him. He is the one who makes even evil people right.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ a mini niriba ŋɔ zaa wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ŋɔ.
en: But listen to what I say to you and to the people.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa gbaag o ka o kpaag o nina kpa malaika maa ka bɔh o, N dana, wula? Ka malaika maa yɛl o, Naawuni deeg a suhigu, ka nya a ni tiri nandaamba pina la, di zaa leei ŋun Naawuni ni ku tam shɛli yɛla.
en: He stared at the angel in fear and said, What is it, sir? The angel answered, God is pleased with your prayers and works of charity, and is ready to answer you.

dag: Di saha ka n daa lan nya malaika so ŋun mali yiko pam ka o yi zuɣusaa siɣirina ka zaŋ sagbani n-ye kaman chinchin la, ka sagani booi gil o zuɣu, ka o ninni be kaman wuntaŋa, ka o biɛhi mi be kaman buɣim zilima la.
en: I saw another powerful angel come down from heaven. This one was covered with a cloud, and a rainbow was over his head. His face was like the sun, his legs were like columns of fire.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, a nyaŋ Ɛdomnima, ka karimbaani kpe a suhu ni n-chɛ ka a duh amaŋa. Chɛ ka a nini tiɣ a jilima, ka ʒi a yiŋa. Bee bɔzuɣu ka a bɔri vuri ni a chɛ ka bɛ ku a tabili Judanima.
en: You have definitely defeated Edom and have now become conceited. Enjoy the honor, but stay home. Why invite disaster when both you and Judah will fall.

dag: Ti Duuma ŋun daa kahigi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha piligu ni wuhi la n-yɛl lala.
en: I promised it long ago.

dag: N Duuma, n yiŋ bia bɔɣu min o gbali zaa n-kpi, ka di muɣis o pam ka o do yiŋa.
en: Lord, my servant is at home in such terrible pain that he can't even move.

dag: Bɛ chani gindila zoya zuɣu bɔri mɔri, ka chani bɔri momaha kam.
en: searches the hills for food and seeks any green sprout.

dag: Amaa goli biɛɣ pinaanu dali ka Yɛhudianim bɛn daa be Susa puuni maa bɛn daa zaŋ leei bɛ Vuhim Dabisili. Bɛ ni daa na kul be bɛ dimnim maa kubu ni biɛɣ pinaata mini biɛɣ pinaanahi dali, ka daa ti chɛ ba kubu la biɛɣ pinaanu dal la zuɣu.
en: On the fifteenth day of the month the Jews in Susa held a holiday and celebrated, after killing their enemies on the thirteenth and the fourteenth.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa suhi Yawɛ bɛ wahala maa puuni, ka o daa tiligi ba bɛ nandahima maa ni.
en: So they cried out to the LORD in their distress, and God saved them from their desperate circumstances.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana mini Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn daa laɣim o sani na maa pah o zuɣu n-laɣim zani Alikauli Adaka maa tooni n-kɔri piɛri mini naɣilahi pam bɛn ka kalinli m-mali sara.
en: King Solomon and all Israel met together before the Box of the Agreement and sacrificed so many sheep and cattle that no one was able to count them all.

dag: kaman di ni daa sab ti Duuma zaligu ni shɛm la. Dina n-nyɛ ni bɛ zaŋmi bidib tuuli kam ti ti Duuma Naawuni.
en: It is written in the law of the Lord: When a mothers first baby is a boy, he shall be called special for the Lord.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ ba na nti zali jintɔriba maa tooni, ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa gbaai ba vihibu ka yɛli ba.
en: The soldiers brought the apostles in and made them stand before the council. The high priest questioned them.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka a biɛhigu mali dabiɛm pam, ka a ti ku lan beni. Hal bɛ yi ti bo a shee, bɛ ku lan nya a yaha. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will terrify you, and you will disappear. You will be sought but never found again. This is what the LORD God says.

dag: Bɛ chɛ ka nandaamba kumdi niŋd o, ka o wum bɛ ni niŋdi shɛb alaka kuhigu.
en: causing the cry of the poor to reach him, he hears the cry of the afflicted.

dag: Yi yi ti kpuɣi yi puri atam, ka kahim yi wain naai, yin zaŋmiya daba ayopɔin puhi suɣa tibu chuɣu.
en: Seven days after you have gathered your harvest in from your threshing floor and from your winepress, you should celebrate the Festival of Shelters.

dag: O daa ku na shɛb bɛn yuya du. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He defeated strong kings. His faithful love will last forever.

dag: Ka lan bɔh o pahi buta yaha, Saimɔn Jɔn bia, a yuri ma? Ka Pita suhu saɣim o ni bɔh o m-pahi buta ni o yur o maa zuɣu, ka yɛl o, N Duuma, a mi binshɛɣukam zaa; a mi ni n yur a. Ka Yisa yɛl o, Dihimi m piɛri.
en: Jesus asked a third time, Simon son of John, do you love me? Peter was hurt because Jesus had asked him three times if he loved him. So he told Jesus, Lord, you know everything. You know I love you. Jesus replied, Feed my sheep.

dag: kaman bɛ yaannim la, bɛ daa bemi kaman tɔb shɛli din naɣilimnaɣilim.
en: but were rebellious and disloyal like their ancestors, unreliable as a crooked arrow.

dag: Ka gbarigu maa daa kul vili Pita mini Jɔn gbibi kirikiri, ka di niŋ niriba alahiziba, ka bɛ kab doli ba hal ni kazal shɛli bɛ ni daa booni Sulemaana Kazala la ni.
en: While the man kept holding on to Peter and John, the whole crowd ran to them in amazement at the place known as Solomon's Porch.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ yinim bɛn niŋ yɛda sani, o mali buchi; amaa zaŋ chaŋ bɛn bi niŋ o yɛda la sani, o nyɛla bɛ ni booni so: Kuɣ shɛli tammɛriba ni zaɣisi, ka di yipa leei kuɣ gahindili la.
en: So God honors you who believe. For those who refuse to believe, though, the stone the builders tossed aside has become the capstone.

dag: Diri ka nyuri nyɛla din tahiri lari na; ka wain nyɛ din tiri nir suhupiɛlli; amaa liɣiri n-chɛ ka nir nyar o suhuyubu.
en: People enjoy eating, and wine makes life happier. But money solves a lot of problems.

dag: O daa chɛ ka mɔɣa leei tiŋgban nɛli doya, ka chɛ ka kɔbil nina kuui.
en: God turns rivers into desert, watery springs into thirsty ground.

dag: Ka Jɛrimia daa yɛli Zɛdɛkia, N yi yɛl a, a ni ku ma bee a ku ku ma? Ka n yi wuh a a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm a ku dee li.
en: Why? I replied. You won't listen, and you might even have me killed.

dag: Ka Pool mini Silas daa yi sarika duu maa ni n-chaŋ Lidia yiŋa nti puh o; ka daa nya bɛ yɛdaniŋditab bɛn be nimaani n-kpaŋsi bɛ suhuri ka naanyi yi n-chaŋ.
en: But Paul and Silas went straight to the home of Lydia, where they saw the Lord's followers and encouraged them. Then they left.

dag: Yi nyɛla neesim mini wuntaŋ ni niriba. Ti pala yuŋ bee zibisim ni niriba.
en: All of you are people who belong to the light, who belong to the day. We do not belong to the night or to the darkness.

dag: O ŋmanila tammɛr so ŋun daa gbi tiŋa n-zal o yili tampiŋ zuɣu. Ka kom daa ti kpe n-gili yili maa ka bi tooi dam li la, dama di daa me n-tamla tampiŋ zuɣu.
en: He is like a man who, in building his house, dug deep and laid the foundation on rock. The river flooded over and hit that house but could not shake it, because it was well built.

dag: Nyin ŋun nyɛ Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ, A tahi bɛ zuɣu, ka bɛ wɔribariba mini bɛ yuri zaa lu n-kpi n-doya.
en: The God of Jacob shouted at them, and their army of chariots and horses fell dead.

dag: Bɛ gbala n-nyɛ bɛ yinsi sahakam. Nimaani ka bɛ kul yɛn be ʒiɛmani kam ni hal bɛ ni daa kul deei tiŋgbani paliti n-leei bɛ din la zaa yoli.
en: The grave will be their home forever and ever, although they once had land of their own.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ka Zara sanna nti niŋ o kaman o ni daa pun lo o alikauli yɛli ni o ni niŋ o shɛm la.
en: The LORD was attentive to Sarah just as he had said, and the LORD carried out just what he had promised her.

dag: ka n ti sabi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din daa be tuuli kuɣ parilan shɛŋa a ni daa wurim la zuɣu m-pa kuɣ parilana ayi maa zuɣu, ka a zaŋ li niŋ adaka maa puuni.
en: He told me that he would write on the new stones the same words he had written on the ones I broke, and that I could put these stones in this sacred chest.

dag: Ka Sool daa ti paai Jɛrusalɛm m-bɔri ni o zaŋ omaŋ bali Yisa nyaandoliba ni, ka bɛ daa zɔr o, dama bɛ daa bi niŋ yɛda ni o shiri nyɛla Yisa nyaandola.
en: Then Saul went to Jerusalem. He tried to join the group of followers, but they were all afraid of him. They did not believe that he was really a follower of Jesus.

dag: Do shɛb bɛn na bi kpuɣ paɣiba mini paɣ shɛb bɛn na bi kuli dɔbba ni pakoya la mi ka n yɛri ŋɔ: Bɛ yi ni kpalim be kaman n ni be shɛm ŋɔ, di viɛla.
en: Now, to the unmarried and to the widows I say that it would be better for you to continue to live alone as I do.

dag: Naawuni ni zaŋ o suhuyiɣisili din zooi pam niŋ bɛ puya ni ka di pali, ka o chɛ ka di lu bɛ zuɣu na kaman saa la, ka di leei bɛ bindirigu.
en: and God will make them swallow his blazing anger.

dag: Yaa n Yawɛ, n suhir a, teemi n ni dol a ni ʒiɛyimtali ni n suhu zaa, ka tumdi din tuhi a sani shɛm la yɛla. Ka Hɛzɛkia daa kum pam.
en: Don't forget that I have been faithful to you, Lord . I have obeyed you with all my heart, and I do whatever you say is right. After this, he cried bitterly.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti ni tooi niŋ suhukpeeni yɛli: N Duuma nyɛla n sɔŋda; n ku zo dabiɛm. Bɔ ka ninsal ni tooi niŋ ma.
en: This should make you feel like saying, The Lord helps me! Why should I be afraid of what people can do to me.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Shɛfa Zoli maa gbini, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Harada.
en: They marched from Mount Shepher and camped at Haradah.

dag: Nyamiya, n zaŋla alibarika mini noli dibu zali ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ:.
en: You have a choice—do you want the Lord to bless you, or do you want him to put a curse on you?.

dag: N daa zaɣis a la saha biɛla puuni, amaa n nambɔzɔbo din galisi pam puuni, n ni lan zaŋ a labisi n sanna.
en: For a short time I turned away from you, but with all my love I will welcome you again.

dag: Yi ma daa ŋmanila wain tia m-be wain tihi puu ni, ka bɛ daa zaŋ o sa m-baɣili kom. Ka kom pam maa daa chɛ ka o teei wula n-wali wala pam.
en: Your mother was like a vine in a vineyard planted beside the waters; she bore lush fruit and foliage because of the plentiful water.

dag: N tarigimi do tiŋa; tim ma nyɛvili palli kaman a yɛligu ni wuhi shɛm.
en: I am at the point of death. Let your teachings breathe new life into me.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpiɔŋ yir a sanna mal alibarika, bɛ nyɛla bɛn suhuri kul bɔri ni bɛ chaŋ Ziɔn ti jɛm a.
en: How happy are those whose strength comes from you, who are eager to make the pilgrimage to Mount Zion.

dag: O daa chɛ ka bɛ kpaɣila Zɛdɛkia nina, ka ba o bandi. Ka Babilɔn naa maa daa zaŋ o kuli Babilɔn nti niŋ sarika ni hal ka o ti kpi.
en: After that, he had Zedekiah's eyes put out and had him placed in chains and taken to Babylon. Zedekiah remained in prison in Babylon until the day he died.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ ti ma vuhim luɣilikam, ka n ka dima bee zuɣubiɛɣu yɛl shɛli.
en: Now the LORD my God has given me peace on every side, without enemies or misfortune.

dag: Jɛra tuma nyɛla din gbarigiri ba, hal ka bɛ bi lan mi yiŋ soli gba.
en: Fools arent smart enough to find their way home, so they must work hard all their lives.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, Wurimmiya Naawuni jɛmbu duu ŋɔ, ka n lan labi me li zali daba ata sunsuuni.
en: Jesus answered, Destroy this temple and I will build it again in three days.

dag: Sɛraya ni Azaria ni Jɛrimia ni.
en: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah.

dag: Ka n daa nya binshɛli o shee ni zaŋ du zuɣusaa polo ka di be kaman daanya din nyaɣisira la, ka be kaman buɣim n-gili o luɣilikam zaa la. Ka n daa nya o shee tiŋli polo ka di ŋmanila buɣim. Ka neesim din ne pam daa ne n-gili o.
en: Above what looked like his waist, I saw something like gleaming amber, something like fire enclosing it all around. Below what looked like his waist, I saw something that appeared to be fire. Its brightness shone all around.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa yiɣisi Ramɛsis n-chaŋ Sukɔt, dɔbba kɔŋko kalinli daa nyɛla tuhi kɔbisiyɔbu m-pahi paɣiba mini bihi.
en: The Israelites walked from the city of Rameses to the city of Succoth. There were about , of them, not counting women and children.

dag: A situra tulimi, pɔhim tulli ni ʒiɛri zuɣu.
en: All you know is that you sweat, your clothes stick to you, and all is still and quiet when the heat wave comes from the south.

dag: A zaligunim kul nyɛla din tuhi sahakam. Tim ma baŋsim din ni chɛ ka m be.
en: Your rules are always right. Help me understand them so that I can live.

dag: Nyin ka ti yaannim daa niŋ naani; ka bɛ ni daa niŋ a naani maa zuɣu daa chɛ ka a tiligi ba.
en: Our ancestors trusted you— they trusted you and you rescued them.

dag: O ni daa di nam Jɛrusalɛm saha shɛli maa, o daa nyɛla yuun pihitanaayi nira. O daa dila nam maa n-ʒini Jɛrusalɛm yuma anii.
en: He was years old when he became king, and he ruled for eight years in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa deei Ilaija suhigu, ka chɛ ka bia maa nyɛvili lab o ni na ka o neei.
en: The Lord answered Elijah's prayer, and the boy started breathing again.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma yɛl o, N ni po pɔri maa.
en: Abraham said, I promise.

dag: Sokam zaa kul lihir a mi, ka a tiri ba bindirigu bɛ ni bɔri li saha shɛli.
en: All living things look to you for their food, and you give them their food at the right time.

dag: Ka Ayuba daa bo salichee kɔriti omaŋa. O daa ʒila tampiligim ni.
en: Job went and sat by the garbage dump and took a piece of broken pottery to scrape his sores.

dag: Lala ka n yɛn niŋ n-chɛ ka a kɔre min a pagɔrisigu tuun shɛli a ni daa ʒi n-yi Ijipti na la zani tariga. Ka a kɔre ku lan kpe bɛ ni bee n-lan teei bɛ yɛla.
en: So I will stop your dreams about your love affair with Egypt. You will never again look for them. You will never remember Egypt again.

dag: Doo zabiri yi guhi, o nyɛla ŋun mali zuɣupalo, amaa o pala ŋun be daɣiri ni.
en: If you become bald on any part of your head, you are still clean.

dag: ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Miri ka a muɣisi Mɔabnima bee n-tuhi ba tɔbu, dama n ku zaŋ bɛ tiŋgban shɛli tin ya ka yi su li, n ni pun zaŋ Ar ti Lɔt zuliya la zuɣu. .
en: The Lord said to me, Dont bother the Moabites. Dont start a war against them. I will not give you any of their land. They are the descendants of Lot, and I gave them the city of Ar.

dag: Tarim mini ŋun nahindi niriba zaa malila bin yini, Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun chɛ ka bɛ zaa nina ne.
en: A poor person and his oppressor have this in common—the Lord gave eyes to both of them.

dag: Dindali maa ni ti nyɛla suhuyiɣisili dabisili; di ni ti nyɛla nandahima mini biɛrim dabisili. Di ni ti nyɛla saɣiŋgu mini dabari zalibu dabisili, ka ni ti nyɛla zibisim mini bumbɔni dabisili. Di ni ti nyɛla sagbana mini zibisim titali dabisili.
en: The Lord will show his anger at that time. It will be a time of terrible troubles and a time of destruction. It will be a time of darkness—a black, cloudy, and stormy day.

dag: Ka Pool daa yaa chaŋ bɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni Vuhim Dabisa buta pa taba, ka o mini ba ti tɔɣisiri Naawuni yɛla.
en: According to his usual habit Paul went to the synagogue. There during three Sabbaths he held discussions with the people, quoting.

dag: Maligumaana ni ti zaŋ alahichi sanyoo sara maligu maa binʒim shɛli n-vie Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dunɔpaɣira mini sara maligu bimbini naŋgbaŋkuɣila bunahi zuɣu ni dundombila dunɔdali dunɔpaɣira la.
en: The priest will take some blood from this sacrifice and smear it on the doorposts of the temple, as well as on the four corners of the altar and on the doorposts of the gates that lead into the inner courtyard.

dag: ka daa tim ba ni bɛ chaŋ ti yihi Naawuni nam waazu, ka chɛ ka barinim kpaŋda.
en: He sent them out to proclaim Gods kingdom and to heal the sick.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord said to Moses.

dag: Yawɛ, zom ti nambɔɣu. Kul zom ti nambɔɣu, dama bɛ dihi ti vi ti yaɣi.
en: Please have mercy, Lord ! We have been insulted more than we can stand.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Siɣimi ti zaŋ Aduna pah amaŋ zuɣu duna, amaa di chɛ ka maligumaaniba mini niriba maa kab ka man Yawɛ sanna, ka n suhu ti yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: The Lord said to him, Go down to the people. Get Aaron and bring him back with you. But dont let the priests or the people come near me. I will punish them if they come too close.

dag: Ka a saha yi ti paai ni a pah a yaannim zuɣu, n ni piig amaŋmaŋ zuliya ni so ŋun nyɛ amaŋmaŋ bidɔɣiro ka o leei naa.
en: When you die and are buried with your ancestors, I will make one of your sons king and will keep his kingdom strong.

dag: paɣipiɛl so ŋun yuli daa booni Mariama la sani. Bɛ daa zaŋ Mariama tila Naa Dauda zuliya ni do so ŋun yuli daa booni Yisifu la.
en: to a virgin who was engaged to a man named Joseph, a descendant of Davids house. The virgins name was Mary.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ be yi sani yi sansani maa ni chana ni o tiligi ya, ka zaŋ yi dimnim niŋ yi nuu ni. Dinzuɣu di simdi ni yi chɛ ka yi sansani maa ni be kasi din ni chɛ ka o ku nya binshɛli din nyɛ daɣiri bini yi sani ka zo ka chɛn ya.
en: You must keep your camp clean of filthy and disgusting things. The Lord is always present in your camp, ready to rescue you and give you victory over your enemies. But if he sees something disgusting in your camp, he may turn around and leave.

dag: Dama bɛ suhuri kul palila nia biɛri n-diri kaman bɔrɔbɔro duu buɣim la. Yuŋ yi paai bɛ suhuyiɣisili ŋmanila wurigu buɣim doya, ka biɛɣu ti neei ka di taai kaman buɣim zibizibi la.
en: Yes, they burned like an oven with their plotting. All night their anger smoldered, and in the morning it burst into flames.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee zaŋ nasaridira ŋɔ yi wulimpuhili polo na, ka chɛ ka o diri nasara luɣ shɛlikam ŋɔ? O chɛ ka o nyaŋ nanim mini zuliya kam. O zaŋ o takɔbi tim bɛ ni n-niŋ ba kaman taŋkpaɣu la. Ka zaŋ o piɛma to n-wurim ba kaman wurigu la.
en: Who has awakened one from the east and has authority to summon him to serve— giving him nations, conquering kings, making them like dust with his sword, like scattered straw with his bow?.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Di zɔr o dabiɛm, dama n zaŋ o min o niriba maa zaa ni o tiŋgbɔŋ maa niŋ a nuu ni. Niŋm o kaman a ni daa niŋ Amɔrinim Naa Sihɔn ŋun daa be Hɛshibɔn shɛm la.
en: But the Lord told me, Moses, don't be afraid of King Og. I am going to help you defeat him and his army and take over his land. Destroy him and his people, just as you did with the Amorite King Sihon of Heshbon.

dag: Ka o daa shiri zaŋ o dab bipuɣiŋga Biliha maa ti Yaakubu ni o zaŋ o leeg o paɣa, ka Yaakubu daa zaŋ o niŋ o paɣa.
en: So Rachel gave her servant Bilhah to Jacob as his wife, and he slept with her.

dag: Ka maligumaana ŋun yɛn yih o daɣiri ni maa ni zaŋ dilan mini binyɛra maa ti zali Yawɛ tooni Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni.
en: The priest must bring that person and those sacrifices before the Lord at the entrance of the Meeting Tent.

dag: Kaman yinyaa ni zaŋdi buɣim datɛhi labiri ka tɔri piɛma din mali lɔɣu shɛm la.
en: Anyone who would trick someone and then say, I was only joking is like a fool who shoots flaming arrows into the air and accidentally kills someone.

dag: N saha yɛla zaa bela a nuu ni; tiligim ma n dimnim mini bɛn niŋdi ma alaka nuu ni.
en: My future is in your hands. Dont hand me over to my enemies, to all who are out to get me!.

dag: Niŋgbuŋ pala yaɣ yini ko, amaa di nyɛla yaɣ bɔbili.
en: Certainly the body isnt one part but many.

dag: Amaa m bi lihi n nyɛvili ka di nyɛ shɛli, man dee yi ni tooi naai tuun shɛli ti Duuma Yisa ni ti ma la; dina n-nyɛ ni m moli Naawuni daalibarika lahibal suŋ hal ti paai n nyɛvili tariga.
en: But nothing, not even my life, is more important than my completing my mission. This is nothing other than the ministry I received from the Lord Jesus: to testify about the good news of Gods grace.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka ti chaŋ Siizaria nti kpe Filip ŋun daa nyɛ Yisa lahibal suŋ molomoona la yiŋa. O daa nyɛla tuuli cheechi -amba ayopɔin la ni yino.
en: The next day we left and came to Caesarea. We went to the house of Philip the evangelist, one of the Seven, and stayed with him.

dag: ka a zaŋ li ti ti a ba ka o di, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni pɔi ka naanyi kpi.
en: You can bring it to your father, he will eat, and then he will bless you before he dies.

dag: Ka n ti chɛ ka a zilinli tabili a noli puuni, ka a leei birigu, ka ku lan kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni, dama bɛ nyɛla duŋtaariba.
en: and I will make you unable to talk or to warn those who have rebelled against me.

dag: Ka n daa lihi nya kɔtomsi shɛli ka di biɛhigu ŋmani daadam. Din daa be kaman o shee la tiŋli polo daa nyɛla buɣim, ka shee maa zaŋ du zuɣusaa polo mi daa kul piɛli paratɛte, ka be kaman daanya din nyaɣisiri la.
en: and I saw something in the shape of a human. This figure was like fire from the waist down, and it was bright as polished metal from the waist up.

dag: Ka Dauda zɔsimo Hushai daa labi tiŋ puuni ti saɣisi saha shɛli Absalom ni kpɛri Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: David's advisor Hushai slipped back into Jerusalem, at just about the same time Absalom was coming in.

dag: Sool bia Ishibɔshɛt ni daa wum ni bɛ ku Nɛr bia Abinɛr la Hiburɔn, o kɔba ni daa chɔɣisimi, ka Izraɛlnim zaa suhuri zɔhira.
en: Sauls son Ish Bosheth heard that Abner had died at Hebron. Ish Bosheth and all his people became very afraid.

dag: M mabihi, miriya ka yi ni so mali suhu biɛɣu din biɛhinda, ka nyɛ din ni birigi ya Naawuni ŋun nyɛ nyɛvililan ŋɔ sani.
en: Watch out, brothers and sisters, so that none of you have an evil, unfaithful heart that abandons the living God.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa yɛl o yiŋnim mini bɛnkam zaa daa be o sani, Yihimiya tinzun tiŋ wuna din be yi sani bahi, ka mali yimaŋa, ka taɣi binyɛra ye.
en: Jacob said to his family and to everyone else who was traveling with him: Get rid of your foreign gods! Then make yourselves acceptable to worship God and put on clean clothes.

dag: Bimbir shɛŋa din daa lu gɔhi ni la mi ŋmanila bɛn wum Naawuni yɛligu.
en: The seeds that fell among the thornbushes are also people who hear the message.

dag: Ka bɛ ni teeri nam zuɣupiligu maa yɛla Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni. Hɛlidai mini Tɔbija ni Jɛdaya ni Jɔsia n-yɛn su di fukumsi.
en: The crown will be a memorial in the LORDs temple for Helem, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and for Hen, Zephaniahs son.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Ŋɔri malila voya, ka noonsi mi mali tɛri, amaa Daadam Bia ka luɣ shɛli din ni zaŋ o zuɣu n-sɔŋ gba.
en: He answered, The foxes have holes to live in. The birds have nests. But the Son of Man has no place where he can rest his head.

dag: Ifriimnim gba kpɛla buɣ jɛmbo ni, chɛliya ba.
en: You people of Israel are charmed by idols. Leave those people alone!.

dag: Ka Yawɛ gba ni tuhi lala zuliyanim maa tɔbu kaman o ni daa pun niŋ shɛm tɔbu tuhibu dal la.
en: The LORD will go out and fight against those nations as when he fights on a day of battle.

dag: Ka bɛn daa lab kulina maa daa puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu gol so ŋun daŋ tooni biɛɣu pinaanahi dali.
en: Everyone who had returned from exile celebrated Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.

dag: O ku kabigi gbiŋgbaŋ din dalim. O mi ku kpihi firila mia din diri biɛlabiɛla. O ni wuhi zaligu soli ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: He will not break even a crushed reed. He will not put out even the weakest flame. He will bring true justice.

dag: A zaŋ ʒim ti bɛn daa yih a wuntizɔriba mini anabinim ʒim la ni bɛ nyu. Di ni simdi ni a niŋ ba shɛm m-bala.
en: They poured out the blood of your people and your prophets. So you gave them blood to drink as they deserve.

dag: Yɛhudianim maligumaana kam kul ʒiɛmi tumd o sara maligu tuma dabisili kam n-kul maanila sara maligu yini maa napɔn bɔbili. Ka sara maligunim ŋɔ mi ku tooi kpihim niriba daalahichi;.
en: The priests do their work each day, and they keep on offering sacrifices that can never take away sins.

dag: Ka o daa gbaai zom maa nuu ni vo o yi tiŋ maa tariga nti tuhi nintɔri ta o nina, ka zaŋ o nuhi shih o ka bɔh o, A nya shɛli.
en: Jesus took him by the hand and led him out of the village, where he spit into the man's eyes. He placed his hands on the blind man and asked him if he could see anything.

dag: Di chɛliya ka so zaŋ ninsalinim yɛm mini yɛtɔɣ yoya din yi ninsalinim kaya yɛla ni na, ka pa Masia din la yɔhim ya n-zaŋ ya leei alizinnim bɛn su dunia ŋɔ yɛliniŋda fukumsi la daba.
en: See to it that nobody enslaves you with philosophy and foolish deception, which conform to human traditions and the way the world thinks and acts rather than Christ.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ lan yɛli, Yinim bɛn wumdi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa anabinim ni daa yɛli bɛ ni daa zali n jɛmbu duu ŋɔ tanzaa saha shɛl la wuhiya ni n jɛmbu duu maa ni me, kpaŋsimiya yimaŋa.
en: I am the Lord All-Powerful! So don't give up. Think about the message my prophets spoke when the foundation of my temple was laid.

dag: Ka o yɛli ma, Dimbɔŋɔ maa wuhirila bɛ ni booi kpam bahi shɛb zuɣuri ni ni bɛ tum ŋun nyɛ dunia ŋɔ zaa Duuma la tuma.
en: So he said, They represent the two men chosen to serve the Lord of the whole world.

dag: Di nyaaŋa Naa Dauda ni daa wum di yɛla o daa yɛlimi, M mini n nam ŋɔ ka taali shɛli Yawɛ sani zaŋ chaŋ Nɛr bia Abinɛr ŋɔ ʒim yihibu ŋɔ polo hal baabiɛla gba.
en: When David heard about this later, he said, I and my kingdom are forever innocent before the LORD concerning the shedding of the blood of Abner, Ners son.

dag: Ahitɔfɛl ni daa nya ka bɛ bi deeg o yikombiɛlim soli maa, ka o dii pa o buŋ gali n-kul o ya nti malimal o yiŋ binshɛɣukam zali dɛde ka yil omaŋ mia kpi, ka bɛ daa zaŋ o sɔɣ o yaannim siliga ni.
en: Meanwhile, once Ahithophel saw that his advice hadnt been followed, he saddled his donkey and went home to his own town. He gave instructions to his household, then hanged himself and died. He was buried in his fathers tomb.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa ni kum o kuli, ka sɔɣ o, dama o kɔŋko n-nyɛ Jɛrɔbɔam bi so bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ sɔɣi gballi ni; dama o kɔŋko ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ nini tiɣi Jɛrɔbɔam daŋ ni.
en: All Israel will mourn for him and will bury him. Out of the whole line of Jeroboam, he alone will have a tomb, because only in him did Israels God, the LORD, find something good.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛr a, zuŋɔ yuŋ ŋɔ a ni ti chihi siɣimsiɣim buta ni a bi mi ma, ka nolɔɣu na bi kum.
en: Jesus replied, I promise you before a rooster crows tonight, you will say three times that you don't know me.

dag: Yawɛ niriba bɛn tiligi ni ti yili yila kpe Jɛrusalɛm. Bɛ suhugarigu mini bɛ nandahima ni ti naai, ka bɛ leei bɛn mali suhupiɛlli sahakam.
en: The LORDs ransomed ones will return and enter Zion with singing, with everlasting joy upon their heads. Happiness and joy will overwhelm them; grief and groaning will flee away.

dag: Ka yi bihi yi ti bɔhi ya saha shɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa zali ya fukumsi zalikpan shɛŋa mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi ŋɔ gbinni lee nyɛla wula.
en: In the future, your children might ask you, The Lord our God gave you teachings, laws, and rules. What do they mean.

dag: Bɛ yɛri yɛtɔɣ biɛri zaŋ chaŋ a polo, ka ŋmari ʒiri zaŋ chaŋ a polo.
en: They say wicked things about you; they speak evil things against your name.

dag: M bi chɛ a zaligu shɛŋa dim pahi la dolibu, dama nyini n wuhi ma li.
en: I havent deviated from any of your rules because you are the one who has taught me.

dag: Yi yi ti kul nya ka di wula puhiri va mama, di saha yi baŋya ni siɣili miriya.
en: When they sprout leaves, you can see for yourselves and know that summer is near.

dag: O daa kurigimi zaa, ka daa ti kpi, ka o bidibisi, Iso mini Yaakubu sɔɣ o.
en: and died at a ripe old age; and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.

dag: Ka o ti zaŋ o suhudoo pina din nyɛ bɔrɔbɔro kpila din mali dabindi m-pahi o wumpaɣibo sara maligu maa zuɣu na.
en: You must also make some bread with yeast.

dag: Yawɛ yuli nyɛla din du pam ka mali yaa, ka wuntizɔriba zɔri kpɛri di ni tiligira.
en: The LORDs name is a strong tower; the righteous run to it and find refuge.
