dag: Dama bɛ tɔɣisiri ya la ʒiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa ni di chɛ ka bɛ yihi ya yi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni n-zaŋ ya tahi katiŋa. N ni kari ya bahi ka yi ti kpi.
en: But they are telling you lies. They will only cause you to be taken far from your homeland. I will force you to leave your homes, and you will die in another land.

dag: nyaanzuriba ni bɛn je Naawuni ni ninʒeensinima ni karimbaannima ni barinyuriba ni tuumbiɛri so pala bɔriba ni bɛn bi deeri bɛ laamba noli.
en: they slander people, and they hate God. They are rude and proud, and they brag. They invent ways to be evil, and they are disobedient to their parents.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, N chɛ ka yi shɛb kpimi kaman n ni daa chɛ ka Sɔdomnim mini Gomɔranim kpi shɛm la; ka yi ni shɛb mi daa tiligi ka di ŋmanila bɛ ni darigi yihi da shɛli buɣim ni. Di zaa yoli, ka yi bi labi n sanna.
en: I destroyed many of you, just as I did the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah. You were a burning stick I rescued from the fire. But even then you rejected me. I, the Lord , have spoken!.

dag: bee n-ʒin ya adiikunima n-chaŋ yi chandi maa bee n-yɛnya daliyanima ayiyi; yi mi di piriya namda bee n-gbibi jaaŋgbɛhi, dama tumtumda kam simdi ni bɛ ti o bindirigu.
en: Dont carry a bag. Take only the clothes and sandals you are wearing. And dont take a walking stick. A worker should be given what he needs.

dag: Ka Zɛruya bia Jɔab ni daa ti baŋ ni Naa Dauda suhu lu Absalom ni.
en: Now Joab, Zeruiahs son, could see that the kings mind was on Absalom.

dag: Dunia zuliya kam, paɣimiya Yawɛ. Zaŋmiya jilima ti Yawɛ ka wuhi ni o mali kpiɔŋ.
en: Tell everyone of every nation, Praise the glorious power of the Lord .

dag: Di saha ka doo maa daa yɛli, Mmaŋmaŋ kɔbili mini mmaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ m-bɔŋɔ. O yuli m-booni paɣa, dama doo niŋgbuŋ ni ka o yina.
en: and the man exclaimed, Here is someone like me! She is part of my body, my own flesh and bones. She came from me, a man. So I will name her Woman.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kul yɛri lala chani maa, yim, ka chɛchɛbuŋ din mali buɣim mini di yuri din mali buɣim dii kana ti kpe bɛ niriba ayi maa sunsuuni n-woligi ba, ka pɔhim din mali kpiɔŋ dii kpuɣi Ilaija du zuɣusaa.
en: Elijah and Elisha were walking and talking together. Suddenly, some horses and a chariot came and separated Elijah from Elisha. The horses and the chariot were like fire. Then Elijah was carried up into heaven in a whirlwind.

dag: M paɣa nyee nyɔni ma, ka m mabihi gba nyee nyɔni ma.
en: My breath stinks to my wife; I am odious to my children.

dag: Di saha, Izraɛlnim bɛn kpalim ka nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya la ti ku lan zaŋ bɛmaŋ dalim zuliya shɛb bɛn bahiri ba yol la, amaa bɛ ni ti zaŋ bɛmaŋ dalimla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ ka biɛhiŋ kani.
en: A time is coming when the people of Israel who have survived will not rely any more on the nation that almost destroyed them. They will truly put their trust in the Lord , Israel's holy God.

dag: Ka Ibram daa yɛli Lɔt, Di chɛ ka naŋgbankpeeni kpe m min a sunsuuni; a mi di chɛ ka naŋgbankpeeni kpe a biŋkɔbiguliba mini m biŋkɔbiguliba sunsuuni, dama ti nyɛla dɔɣim.
en: So Abram said to Lot, There should be no arguing between you and me or between your people and my people. We are all brothers.

dag: O ni daa siɣis omaŋ zuɣu daa chɛ ka Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili maa milig o zuɣu, ka o daa bi ku ba zaa, ka biɛhigu daa lan niŋ nyaɣisim viɛnyɛliŋga Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Rehoboam turned back to the Lord , and so the Lord did not let Judah be completely destroyed, and Judah was prosperous again.

dag: Ka paɣiba ayi ni ti laɣim niɛmda; ka Naawuni ti kpuɣ yino ka chɛ ŋun la.
en: Two women will be at a mill grinding meal: one will be taken away, the other will be left behind.

dag: Yinim bɛn zaa lo nia biɛri ni yi saɣim yi tab la, yi nia biɛri maa ni ŋmaligi din ya. Man Yawɛ ni chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔ niŋ ya. Yi bahigu ti ku viɛla.
en: Go ahead and walk in the light of the fires you have set. But with his own hand, the Lord will punish you and make you suffer.

dag: Yisa daa ti chaŋ Nazarɛt bɛ ni daa wubis o tin shɛl ni la n-daa ti chaŋ Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu Vuhim Dabisili dali kaman o ni daa yi pun niŋdi shɛm la. Ka o daa ti yiɣisi zani ni o karim.
en: Jesus went to Nazareth, where he had been raised. On the Sabbath he went to the synagogue as he normally did and stood up to read.

dag: Ka bɛ dii mɔhiri vuri, ka ŋari bɛ tiba n-kabi chaŋ o sani.
en: The council members shouted and covered their ears. At once they all attacked Stephen.

dag: Yɛlimiya Izraɛlnima: Binshɛli yi yi doo tooni na, din yi o tooni na maa nyɛla daɣiri.
en: for the people of Israel. When any man has a discharge from his penis, the discharge is unclean.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim maa daa ti niŋdi ti putɔɣu, ka muɣisiri ti n-chɛ ka ti tumdi tuun kpɛma.
en: The Egyptians treated us terribly, oppressing us and forcing hard labor on us.

dag: Ka nyini daadam, dahin shɛli n ni ti yɛn deei bɛ kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛli din nyɛ bɛ suhupiɛlli mini bɛ jilima, ka bɛ nini tiɣi li, ka bɛ suhuri yu li pam m-pahi bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi la.
en: The Lord said, Now, mortal man, I will take away from them the strong Temple that was their pride and joy, which they liked to look at and to visit. And I will take away their sons and daughters.

dag: Ka Manaasa daa ti faai siɣ o o yaannim sani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o o yiŋa, ka o bia Amɔn daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Manasseh died and was buried at the palace, and his son Amon succeeded him as king.

dag: M bi yɛli dimbɔŋɔ mi ni n nya yi taali, dama m pun yɛli ya ni yi yɛla be ti suhuri ni, ka ti mini ya nyɛla zaɣ yini, di yi nyɛ nyɛvil ni bee kum puuni.
en: I do not say this to blame you. I told you before that we love you so much we would live or die with you.

dag: Ka a ni tum din chihiri mini pagɔrisigu tuun shɛŋa ŋɔ zaa, a bi teeg a ni daa nyɛ bia saha shɛli, ka be a zaɣim n-do a ʒim ni talindi la yɛla.
en: During your disgusting life as a prostitute you never once remembered your childhood—when you were naked, squirming in your own blood.

dag: Fiɛbisi vuri mini chɛchɛbunsi kalima vuri. Yuri balisira, ka chɛchɛbunsi yiɣiri tɔra!.
en: You can hear the sounds of whips and the noise of wheels. You can hear horses galloping and chariots bouncing along!.

dag: Amaa biha maa mini nudirigu gbalipuɣa dina Aduna daa zaŋ li mi gahigahi Yawɛ tooni ka di leei sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ gahi kaman Musa ni daa zali shɛm.
en: and presented the breasts and the right hind legs as the special gift to the Lord for the priests, as Moses had commanded.

dag: ka lihiri buɣim ni dir o ka di nyɔhi kpuɣiri duri zuɣusaa maa ka kuhiri yɛra, Tin dini n-yi lee beni ŋ-ŋmani tin titali ŋɔ.
en: They cried out as they saw the smoke from her burning and said, What city was ever like the great city.

dag: ka zaŋ alahichi sanyoo sara maligu ŋmani maa ʒim shɛli mihi sara maligu bimbini luɣili zuɣu, ka chɛ ka ʒi shɛli din kpalim yi m-bahi sara maligu bimbini maa gbini, di nyɛla alahichi sanyoo sara maligu.
en: and sprinkle some of its blood against the side of the altar. The rest of the blood will be drained out at the base of the altar. This is an offering to take away sin.

dag: Bɛ yurilim mini bɛ jɛlinsi ni bɛ nyuli zabbu zaa ku lan beni, ka bɛn nuu kul ku lan be yɛl shɛlikam zaa niŋbu ni dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Their loves, their hates, and their jealous feelings have all disappeared with them. They will never again take part in anything that happens on this earth.

dag: Bɛ tiŋkpansi mi n-daa nyɛ Itam mini Ain ni Rimɔn ni Tochɛn ni Ashan, di daa nyɛla tins anu.
en: The five villages near these towns were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Token, and Ashan.

dag: ka bɛn mi nuu be dunia ŋɔ dibu yɛla ni be kaman bɛn nuu ka di ni. Dama dunia ŋɔ biɛhigu garitimi maa.
en: It won't make any difference how much good you are getting from this world or how much you like it. This world as we know it is now passing away.

dag: Dama yi yɛliya, Yawɛ yihi anabinim ti ti Babilɔn.
en: You feel secure, because you think I have sent prophets to speak for me in Babylonia.

dag: Di ŋmariya ʒiri ka mali n yuli pɔri pɔri, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi dihi yi Naawuni yuli vi. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Do not make a promise in my name if you do not intend to keep it; that brings disgrace on my name. I am the Lord your God.

dag: Ka Rut daa gbani n-zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋa ka bɔhi Bɔaz, Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka a ti niŋdi ma nirilim lala? Ka bee bɔ n-lee chɛ ka a ti lihi nya man ŋun nyɛ tinzun nir ŋɔ lala.
en: Then she bowed down, face to the ground, and replied to him, How is it that Ive found favor in your eyes, that you notice me? Im an immigrant.

dag: Ashili maa m-bɔŋɔ: Lahibal suŋ la zuɣu ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim mini Yɛhudianim laɣim nya Naawuni daalibarika; bɛ daa nyɛla niŋgbun yini yaɣa, ka laɣim diri Naawuni ni daa lo alikauli shɛli Yisa Masia zuɣu la nyɔri.
en: And this is the secret truth: that by hearing the Good News, those who are not Jews will share with the Jews in the blessings God has for his people. They are part of the same body, and they share in the promise God made through Christ Jesus.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ naa! Dunia zaa, maliya suhupiɛlli; teeku duli tiŋgbana nima, maliya suhupiɛlli!.
en: The LORD rules! Let the earth rejoice! Let all the islands celebrate!.

dag: Yawɛ, a mi binshɛɣukam, teemi n yɛla, ka sɔŋ ma, ka bɔhi bɛn niŋdi ma alaka ŋɔ biɛri ti ma. Di di suɣilo hal ka bɛ ti di n nyɛvili. Baŋmi ni a zuɣu ka bɛ turi ma maa.
en: You can see how I suffer insult after insult, all because of you, Lord . Don't be so patient with my enemies; take revenge on them before they kill me.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ bɛ wuna din nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋ anzinfa mini salima mali ni bɛ jɛmdi li la bahi nantarisi mini zɔna dindali maa.
en: When that day comes, they will throw away the gold and silver idols they have made, and abandon them to the moles and the bats.

dag: Amaa di sabiya ni ninsalinim nambu piligu ni, Naawuni daa nam ba la doo mini paɣa.
en: But in the beginning, at the time of creation, God made them male and female, as the scripture says.

dag: Di saha ka Zarai daa yɛli Ibram, N ʒiɛmbu ŋɔ taali ʒi a zuɣu. Mani n-zaŋ n dab bipuɣiŋga ŋɔ ti a, ka o ti nya ka o mali pua, ka lihi ʒiɛm ma. Yawɛ ni woligi ti m min a.
en: Sarai said to Abram, This harassment is your fault. I allowed you to embrace my servant, but when she realized she was pregnant, I lost her respect. Let the LORD decide who is right, you or me.

dag: Zɛbulɔn zuliya niriba m-bala: Bɛ ni daa sab bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb yuya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihiyɔbu ni kɔbisinu.
en: These are the Zebulunite clans. Their enrollment was .

dag: A yi nya shiri, nyin dim li a kum tariga, a yi di li yaɣi, a ni ti li bahi.
en: If you find honey, eat just the right amount; otherwise, youll get full and vomit it up.

dag: A ti o dimnim nasara; a chɛ ka o dimnim zaa suhuri paligi.
en: You made his enemies powerful and let them celebrate.

dag: N daa bela yi sani ni chɔɣinsi mini dabeenzɔbo ni ni sɔhibu.
en: When I came to you, I was weak and shook with fear.

dag: ni Kɛdɛshi naa ni Jokiniam naa.
en: the king of Kedesh, the king of Jokneam in Carmel.

dag: Nyin Musa kɔŋko n-ni miri man Yawɛ; bɛ ni so di ti mirina; niriba maa di pah a zuɣu du na.
en: Only Moses may come near to the LORD. The others shouldnt come near, while the people shouldnt come up with him at all.

dag: Ka n daa nya biŋkɔb so ka o yiri teeku ni na; o daa malila yila pia, ka mali zuɣur ayopɔin, ka nam zuɣupila pia pili o yila maa, ka Naawuni mɔbu yuya sab pa o zuɣuri maa zuɣu.
en: Then I saw a beast coming up out of the sea. It had ten horns and seven heads; on each of its horns there was a crown, and on each of its heads there was a name that was insulting to God.

dag: Ka yi yi bi doli zaligu ŋɔ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din sabi be kundi ŋɔ ni ŋɔ n-luri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yuli din mali jilima mini dabiɛm ŋɔ sizuura.
en: If you dont carefully keep all the words of this Instruction that are written in this scroll, by fearing the awesome and glorious name of the LORD your God.

dag: daa ti lo nia n tɛha puuni ni n vihi baŋ binshɛɣukam din niŋdi dunia ni. Di nyɛla Naawuni ni zaŋ tuun shɛli ti daadamnim ka bɛ tumdi ka di tiri ba suhugarigu.
en: I determined that I would examine and study all the things that are done in this world. God has laid a miserable fate upon us.

dag: Bɛn yɛn pa bɛ zuɣu n-nyɛ Manaasa zuliya. Manaasa niriba maa toondana n-yɛn nyɛ Pɛdazu bia Gamaliɛl.
en: On one side of Ephraim will be the tribe of Manasseh, with Gamaliel son of Pedahzur as the leader of its , troops.

dag: O kɔba ŋmanila daanya mulima din mali yɔri, ka o gbaya min o bɔɣiri ŋmani kurimulima.
en: The bones in its legs are like bronze or iron.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, A yuli? Ka o garigi yɛl o, N yuli m-booni Bɔbigu, dama ti galisiya.
en: Then Jesus asked the man, What is your name? The man answered, My name is Legion, because there are many spirits inside me.

dag: O daa tahi tɔbbihi ti ʒili bɛ ni daa me goondahi gili Juda fɔntin shɛŋa la zaa puuni, ka lan zali tɔbbihi Juda tiŋgban ni min o ba Asa ni daa tuhi deei tin shɛŋa Ifriim zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni la puuni.
en: He assigned troops to the fortified cities in Judah, as well as to other towns in Judah and to those towns in Ephraim that his father Asa had captured.

dag: Ŋunkam ŋubi n niŋgbuŋ ka nyu n ʒim, dilana be n ni ka n gba be o ni.
en: Those who eat my body and drink my blood live in me, and I live in them.

dag: ka ni deei ti ni suhi shɛlikam o sani, ti ni dol o zaligunim ka tumdi din tiɣir o nini la zuɣu.
en: We receive from him whatever we ask, because we obey his commands and do what pleases him.

dag: Ka Pita yɛl o, Yɛlim ma yɛlimaŋli, yi ni shiri kɔhi yi puu la laɣ shɛli zaa m-bɔŋɔ? Ka o saɣi, Iin, di zaa m-bala.
en: Peter said to her, Tell me how much money you got for your field. Was it this much? Sapphira answered, Yes, that was all we got for the field.

dag: A ti o o suhu ni bɔri shɛli; ka bi mɔŋ o o ni suh a bɔri binshɛli.
en: Youve given him what his heart desires; you havent denied what his lips requested. Selah.

dag: Di saha ka Sulemaana daa yɛli, Yawɛ daa pun yɛli ni o yɛn bela sagban sabila ni.
en: Solomon prayed: Our Lord , you said that you would live in a dark cloud.

dag: ka ku lan doli Yɛhudianim kurimbuni lahibaya din pa yɛlimaŋli la mini ninsalinim zaligunima din nyɛ bɛn zaɣisi yɛlimaŋli ni zali shɛl la.
en: They shouldnt pay attention to Jewish myths and commands from people who reject the truth.

dag: Ŋmɛmiya guŋgombihi n-wa waa paɣ o. Ŋmɛmiya goonjɛnima, ka piɛbi yuhi paɣ o.
en: Praise him with drums and dancing. Praise him with harps and flutes.

dag: Yɛlimuɣisira nyɛla din gbarigiri nira, amaa yɛtɔɣ viɛlli nyɛla din kpaŋsiri nira.
en: Anxiety leads to depression, but a good word encourages.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka m ma daa gbani dɔɣi ma? Bee bɔzuɣu ka o daa mɔɣisi ma bihim?.
en: Why did knees receive me and breasts let me nurse?.

dag: Di saha ka ŋarin shɛŋa din daa yi Taibɛrias na kana ti zani miri luɣ shɛli ti Duuma Yisa ni sa paɣi Naawuni bɔrɔbɔro zuɣu ka zaŋ li ti niriba ka bɛ ŋub la.
en: some boats from Tiberias sailed near the place where the crowd had eaten the bread for which the Lord had given thanks.

dag: N yɛlila n suhu ni, Yawɛ n-kul nyɛ n ni bɔri so. Dinzuɣu n ni mali tahima o sani.
en: Deep in my heart I say, The Lord is all I need; I can depend on him.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, tinzun yɛligu balibu paai shɛm be dunia ŋɔ ni, ka di shɛli mi kani ka bi mali gbinni.
en: There are many different languages in the world, yet none of them is without meaning.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, So bi mi dindali bee di saha, hal malaikanim bɛn be alizanda ni mini Naawuni Bia la gba bi mi li; faashee o Ba maa kɔŋko n-naɣ mi li.
en: But nobody knows when that day or hour will come, not the heavenly angels and not the Son. Only the Father knows.

dag: Yinim Gilibɔa zoya, maligim bee saa ku lan lu yi zuɣu na bee bimbilima ti lan bili yi zolɔna ni. Dama nimaani ka kpiɔŋlaannim bidibbina nya filiŋ. Ka Sool nyɔtaɣirigu bi lan nya kpam ʒe.
en: Don't let dew or rain fall on the hills of Gilboa. Don't let its fields grow offerings for God. There the warriors' shields were smeared with mud, and Saul's own shield was left unpolished.

dag: Wulimpuhili polo tintariga ni ti zaŋla Damaskus mini Hauran sunsuuni la m-baɣisi Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili n-tim Giliad mini Izraɛl tiŋgbana sunsuuni gari n-zaŋ hal ni wulimpuhili polo teeku ni n-zaŋ hal ti paai Tama. Dina n-yɛn nyɛ wulimpuhili polo yaɣili.
en: The eastern boundary runs south from a point between the territory of Damascus and that of Hauran, with the Jordan River forming the boundary between the land of Israel on the west and Gilead on the east, as far as Tamar on the Dead Sea.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa chaŋ Tɛbiz ti teei gil li ŋ-ŋme n-deei li.
en: Then Abimelech moved on to Thebez, set up camp against it, and captured it.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun be tibi ni ŋun niŋdi din viɛla, dinzuɣu ka o wuhiri alahichinima di soli maa.
en: The LORD is good and does the right thing; he teaches sinners which way they should go.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti daa yi tumdi tuma maa, bɛ ni pirigili gbibila kpana asibaasi ŋaraŋara saha zaŋ hal ti paai yuŋ saŋmarisi peebu saha.
en: Every day from dawn to dark, half of the workers rebuilt the walls, while the rest stood guard with their spears.

dag: Nir karimbaani n-tahir o filiŋ na, amaa ŋun siɣisir omaŋ ni nya jilima.
en: Arrogance will bring your downfall, but if you are humble, you will be respected.

dag: N ni chɛ ka a zuliya galisi pam. N ni niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni, ka chɛ ka a yuli du pam, ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb gba ti nya alibarika a zuɣu.
en: I will give you many descendants, and they will become a great nation. I will bless you and make your name famous, so that you will be a blessing.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni niŋ ya dimbɔŋɔnim zaa n zuɣu, dama bɛ bi mi ŋun tim ma na.
en: But they will do all this to you because you are mine; for they do not know the one who sent me.

dag: Di saha ka kpamba maa ni yino yɛli ma, Di kumda! Nyama, Naa Dauda zuliya ni bɛ ni booni so Juda zuliya ni Gbuɣinli la di nasara. Dinzuɣu o ni tooi tabigi bintabinda ayopɔin maa ka bɔɣi litaafi maa.
en: Then one of the elders said to me, Don't cry. Look! The Lion from Judah's tribe, the great descendant of David, has won the victory, and he can break the seven seals and open the scroll.

dag: Pa shia ni tiri niŋgbun shɛli nyɛvili maa n-nyɛ tuuli, amaa dunia ŋɔ ni niŋgbuŋ la n-nyɛ tuuli, ka shia ni tiri niŋgbun shɛli nyɛvili maa naanyi paya.
en: The spiritual man did not come first. It was the physical man that came first; then came the spiritual.

dag: Ka o paɣ maa daa lan niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol o yuli Onan.
en: She became pregnant again and bore another son and named him Onan.

dag: Ka ti yi kahigi ti daalahichi wuhi Naawuni, o nyɛla ŋun ʒe o daalikauli nyaaŋa ka niŋdi din tuhi, ka ni chɛ ti daalahichi paŋ ti, ka kul ni kpihindi dinkam zaa bi doli wuntia soli ti biɛhigu ni bahira.
en: But if we confess our sins, God will forgive us. We can trust God to do this. He always does what is right. He will make us clean from all the wrong things we have done.

dag: ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka m pah a ninvuɣ gahinda maa zuɣu tɔŋ, ka pah a zuliya zuɣu nya suhupiɛlli, ka pah a niriba zuɣu tibig a.
en: Let me share in the good things that you do for your chosen people. Let me rejoice with your nation. Let me join with your people in praise.

dag: nti yɛl o, N wum a suhigu shɛli a ni suhi ma la. M mali jɛmbu du shɛli a ni me ŋɔ ka di be kasi ni di nyɛ bɛ ni yɛn jɛmdi ma luɣ shɛli sahakam. N kul ni gul li ka chɛ ka n suhu be di ni sahakam.
en: The LORD said to him, I have heard your prayer and your cry to me. I have set apart this temple that you built, to put my name there forever. My eyes and my heart will always be there.

dag: ka zaŋ ninvuɣ biɛr ayi ʒil tuh o; ka chɛ ka bɛ fiɣis o yɛli, A turi Naawuni mini naa; di saha ka yi zaŋ o yi nti lab o kuɣa ku.
en: Find some men who will tell lies about Naboth. They should say that they heard Naboth speak against the king and against God. Then take Naboth out of the city and kill him with stones.

dag: Din ni chɛ ka n tooi nyaŋ niŋ dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka n kul tumdi ka mɔra, yiko shɛli Masia ni ti ma ka di tumdi di tuma pam n ni la zuɣu.
en: To get this done I toil and struggle, using the mighty strength which Christ supplies and which is at work in me.

dag: Ŋuna n-tiri dansi, ŋuna n-lan lɔri dansi maa yuma. Ŋuna n-ŋmɛri tiri dansi, amaa ka o nuu tibiri dansi maa.
en: God might injure you, but he will bandage those wounds. He might hurt you, but his hands also heal.

dag: Amaa yi suhukpeeni niŋbu puuni ka yi ni ti nya yi nyɛviya.
en: Stand firm, and you will save yourselves.

dag: Naawuni, darigim bɛ tibili bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu; nyaŋmi lala zuliyanim maa a suhuyiɣisili puuni!.
en: God, send them away because of the bad things they did. Show your anger and defeat those people.

dag: Kurigu n-sahiri di kpee, ka ninsalinim gba nyari baŋsim tab sani.
en: People learn from one another, just as iron sharpens iron.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Yisa, Jɔn Baptaizira mini Farisiinim nyaandoliba lɔri noli waawaayili ka suhiri Naawuni, amaa ka nyin nyaandoliba bɛn kul diri ka nyura.
en: Some people said to Jesus, The disciples of John fast frequently and offer prayers, and the disciples of the Pharisees do the same; but your disciples eat and drink.

dag: yinim bɛn zaŋ ʒim me Ziɔn, ka zaŋ tuumbiɛri me Jɛrusalɛm ŋɔ.
en: who build Zion with bloodshed and Jerusalem with injustice!.

dag: Ka wuntaŋ daa ti bii na, ka Naawuni chɛ ka pɔhim tulli yi wulimpuhili polo ʒiɛna, n-chɛ ka wuntaŋ kpe Jona hal ka o ti yɛn pabigi. Ka Jona daa bɔri ni o kpi, ka yɛli, N kum so o bebu.
en: During the day the Lord sent a scorching wind, and the sun beat down on Jonah's head, making him feel faint. Jonah was ready to die, and he shouted, I wish I were dead.

dag: Mɛrari bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Mahili mini Mushi. Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya ni niriba kaman bɛ dɔɣirikpamba ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: Meraris sons were Mahli and Mushi. All these families were from Israels son Levi.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Taai polo m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ yi ti kuri niriba a puuni, ka bɛn dɛhi dansi la ŋuhira, ka bɛ ti daag a luhi, a lubu damli ni ti sɔhigi tin shɛŋa din ʒe teeku duli.
en: The LORD God proclaims to Tyre: Wont the coastlands quake at the news of your downfall, when the wounded groan, and when the slaughter in your midst goes on and on?.

dag: Chɛliya ka Izraɛlnim ti bɛ suɣa gbilligbilli zali di ni simdi ni bɛ ʒi luɣ shɛŋa mini bɛ yaannim dunoya tuutanim ni sa luɣ shɛŋa. Bɛ chɛ ka bɛ suɣa maa noya kpa laɣiŋgu suɣili maa luɣilikam polo.
en: When the Israelites set up camp, each man will camp under the banner of his division and the flag of his own clan. The camp is to be set up all around the Tent.

dag: Turi tubu zuɣu ka bɛn bi wumdi yɛlimaŋli zabira, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali yɛm nyɛla bɛn deeri saɣisigu.
en: Arrogance causes nothing but trouble. It is wiser to ask for advice.

dag: Ŋmɛmiya biɛri paɣi Yawɛ, ka ŋme mɔɣilɔnim din mali mihi piapia paɣ o.
en: Praise the Lord with harps! Use harps with ten strings to make music for him.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim mini Judanim bɛn daa be Juda tiŋgbani maa ni fɔntinsi ni daa zaŋ bɛ naɣ pia kam puuni naɣ yino na mini piɛri pia kam puuni piɛ yino m-pahi bɛ ni daa zaŋ pin kasi shɛŋa zaa ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni la na nti zaŋ li sɔŋsɔŋ gbilligbilli.
en: The people of Israel and Judah, living in the cities of Judah, also brought in a tenth of their herds and flocks and a tenth of the items that had been dedicated to the LORD their God, stacking it up in piles.

dag: Puhimiya Naawuni ŋun be zuɣusaa ŋɔ. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Praise the God of heaven! His faithful love will last forever.

dag: ni gali sabilifaa ni gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛl viɛlli ni buhi kɔbiri.
en: blue, purple, and deep red yarns; fine linen; goats hair.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ma, Daniɛl, di zɔri dabiɛm. Naawuni pun deeg a suhigu dabisi shɛli dali a ni daa tɛhi baŋ ka siɣis amaŋa ni di chɛ ka a baŋ yɛla maa la. A suhigu maa deebu zuɣu ka n kana maa.
en: Daniel, don't be afraid! God has listened to your prayers since the first day you humbly asked for understanding, and he has sent me here.

dag: Ka Musa deemba Jɛtro daa zaŋ Musa paɣ min o bidibis ayi maa n-ka o sanna tiŋgban nɛli maa ni bɛ ni daa ti bɛ suɣa be Naawuni zoli maa gbini luɣ shɛli maa.
en: Jethro, Moses father-in-law, brought Moses sons and wife back to him in the desert where he had set up camp at Gods mountain.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ʒe bɛ daazichi ka bɛ yiya wurim. Hal bɛ ni mɛri yiya ŋɔ zaa yoli, bɛ ku kpe di ni. Hal bɛ ni sari wain tihi ŋɔ zaa yoli, bɛ ku nyu di wain.
en: Their wealth will be looted and their houses destroyed. They will never live in the houses they are building or drink wine from the vineyards they are planting.

dag: Bina anahi m-beni damdi dunia ŋɔ, ka di ku tooi deei li. Dina n-nyɛ:.
en: At three things the earth trembles, at four it cant bear up.

dag: Ka o bol o nyaandoliba na ti yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, pako faralan ŋɔ tɔhiya gari bɛnkam zaa tɔhi liɣiri maa;.
en: Jesus called his followers to him and said, This poor widow put in only two small coins. But the truth is, she gave more than all those rich people.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka n kul gbaani ti Ba Naawuni ŋun mi nyɛ ti Duuma Yisa Masia Ba ŋɔ tooni.
en: So I bow in prayer before the Father.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka di daa yuui ha, ka Ammɔnnim daa ti lo tɔbu kana ni bɛ ti tuhi Izraɛlnima.
en: After a time the Ammonites fought with the Israelites.

dag: N ni zaŋ piɛbihi pola mali sara n-zaŋ ba nyo buɣim ti a, ka zaŋ piɛlahi sara nyɔhi ti a, ka zaŋ naɣilahi mini buhi mali sara.
en: I will offer the best burned offerings to you along with the smoke of sacrificed rams. I will offer both bulls and goats. Selah.

dag: ni a ku niŋ ti zaɣ biɛɣu kaman ti gba ni daa bi shih a bee n-niŋ a shɛli, amaa ka naɣ niŋ a la zaɣ viɛlli hal ti chɛ ka a yi n-chaŋ ni alaafee la. Pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni.
en: you must not treat us badly since we havent harmed you and since we have treated you well at all times. Then we will send you away peacefully, for you are now blessed by the LORD.

dag: N Duuma, a nyɛla Naawun suŋ, ka chɛri niriba taali, ka a yurilim maŋli galisi zaŋ chaŋ bɛnkam zaa suhir a sani.
en: You are good to us and forgiving, full of constant love for all who pray to you.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ ti Naawuni ka pa ni Yawɛ? Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ ti tampiŋ pahi ti Naawuni ŋɔ zuɣu?.
en: Now really, who is divine except the LORD? And who is a rock but our God?.

dag: dama o ni ti nyɛla ninvuɣ titali ti Duuma sani. O ti ku nyu wain bee binnyura din mali kpiɔŋ. Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi ni ti pal o la saha shɛl o ma ni dɔɣ o.
en: Your son will be a great servant of the Lord. He must never drink wine or beer, and the power of the Holy Spirit will be with him from the time he is born.

dag: Amaa ka Judanim daa bi tooi kari Jɛbusinim bɛn daa pun be Jɛrusalɛm la bahi. Dina n-chɛ ka Jɛbusinim mini Judanim na kul laɣim be Jɛrusalɛm hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: The army of Judah was not able to force out the Jebusites living in Jerusalem. So today there are still Jebusites living among the people of Judah in Jerusalem.

dag: Yɛnnim gbaarila bɛmaŋa n-yiri zaɣ biɛɣu ni, amaa jɛra bɛn baɣa kani, ka bi gbaari bɛmaŋa.
en: Wise people are careful and avoid trouble; fools are too confident and careless.

dag: Ka Musa daa tim ba ni bɛ cham ti puɣisi nya Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ maa, ka yɛli ba, Chamiya Nɛgɛb tooni ha n-gari chaŋ zoya ni tinsi ni.
en: Before Moses sent them into Canaan, he said: After you go through the Southern Desert of Canaan, continue north into the hill country.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa tim tuumba Kiriatijiarimnim sani ti yɛli ba, Filistianim labisi Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka la na, kamiyana ti kpuɣi li.
en: They sent messengers to tell the people of Kiriath-Jearim, The Philistines have sent back the sacred chest. Why don't you take it and keep it there with you.

dag: Bɛ lubu vuri ni ti dam tiŋgbani, ka bɛ kuhigu ti paai Teeku Ʒiɛɣu ni.
en: The sounds of your destruction will reach the Red Sea and cause the earth to shake.

dag: ka ŋun pahi ayɔbu daa nyɛ Ozɛm, ka Dauda daa nyɛ ŋun pahi ayopɔin.
en: Ozem was Jesses sixth son, and David was his seventh son.

dag: n-chani kpaŋsiri Yisa nyaandoliba suhuri ka kpamdi ba jaande ni bɛ kul gbibi yɛda, ka yɛli ba ni nir yi bɔri ni o kpe Naawuni nam ni, o ni bahi di wahala.
en: In those cities they helped the followers grow stronger in their faith and encouraged them to continue trusting God. They told them, We must suffer many things on our way into Gods kingdom.

dag: O daa mali nyolɔrigu ka di be kaman bɛ ni daa she binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la shɛm la. Bɛ daa zaŋla salima gali mini gali sabilifaa ni gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli mal li.
en: They made the breastpiece of the same materials as the ephod and with similar embroidery.

dag: Ka buɣim daa dii yi Yawɛ biɛhigu shee na ti di ba ka bɛ kpi Yawɛ tooni.
en: So fire came from the Lord and destroyed Nadab and Abihu, and they died there in front of the Lord .

dag: Ka Musa yɛli, N suhir a mi, chɛ ka n nya a jilima.
en: Then Moses said, I pray that you will let me see you in all of your glory.

dag: Hal yi yi yiɣi kpe zuɣusaa kaman tɔrili la, ka yi tɛri be saŋmarisi biɛhigu shee, n ni siɣisi ya tiŋ na. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will still bring you down, even if you fly higher than an eagle or nest among the stars. I, the Lord , have spoken!.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ o ni lo ni o niŋ o niriba maa zaɣ biɛ shɛli maa niŋbu.
en: So the Lord changed his mind and did not bring on his people the disaster he had threatened.

dag: Wuntizɔra yɛtɔɣa nyɛla naa ni yu shɛli, ka o yuri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛri yɛlimaŋli.
en: Kings favor those with righteous lips; they love words of integrity.

dag: Amaa a min a bidibisi n-yɛn su maligumaanitali tuma ni sara maligu bimbini zuɣu tuma zaa ni chinchin tibisili la puuni tuma n-tumda. N zaŋ yi maligumaanitali maa tin ya pini, ka ninvuɣ so ŋun bi kpin li yi zaŋ omaŋ bali yi ni, bɛn kum o.
en: You and your sons must perform the duties of your priesthood for all the matters of the altar and the area behind the curtain. I give you your priestly service as a gift. But an outsider who approaches will die.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛl o, M min a ku labi, dama a zaɣisi Yawɛ yɛligu, ka Yawɛ gba zaɣisi ni a ku lan nyɛ Izraɛlnim naa.
en: I will not go back with you, Samuel answered. You rejected the Lord 's command, and he has rejected you as king of Israel.

dag: Chɛ ka yɛnnim gba wum li, ka nya yɛm pahi, ka leei ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn woligiri binyara.
en: If you are already wise, you will become even wiser. And if you are smart, you will learn to understand.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ puuni yi di yimaŋ shɛhira ni yi nyɛla bɛn daa ku anabinim maa yaansi.
en: You testify against yourselves that you are children of those who murdered the prophets.

dag: Gol tuuli maa biɛɣ pinaanahi dali zaawuni, di simdi ka yi ŋubiri bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi hal ni goli maa biɛɣ pisiniyini dali zaawuni.
en: In the first month, from the evening of the fourteenth day until the evening of the twenty-first day, you should eat unleavened bread.

dag: N niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa la lahibal suŋ maa zuɣu ni n di di daanfaani.
en: All the things I do are for the sake of the gospel, so I can be a partner with it.

dag: Ka bipuɣiŋga maa daa ti lan nya o ka yɛli bɛn ʒe nimaani maa, Doo ŋɔ gba nyɛla bɛ ni yino.
en: The female servant saw him and began a second time to say to those standing around, This man is one of them.

dag: ka n dimnim yɛli, Ti nyaŋ o. Ka n dimnim suhuri ni paligi n lubu zuɣu.
en: and my enemy will say, I won! My foes will rejoice over my downfall.

dag: Dama bɛ zaɣisi ma, ka tuɣindi tulaale zim n-jɛmdi buɣa ni bɛ chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi tum tuun shɛŋa maa polo. Dinzuɣu ka n suhu yiɣisi bahi ya ŋɔnim zuɣu ka kɔŋ maabu.
en: They have rejected me and have offered sacrifices to other gods, and so have stirred up my anger by all they have done. My anger is aroused against Jerusalem, and it will not die down.

dag: N dimnim zaa ni di vi, ka dabiɛm gbahi ba pam; di ku yuui ka bɛ di vi maa, ka ŋmaligi zo.
en: My enemies will be ashamed and terrified, as they quickly run away in complete disgrace.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa tim tuumba ka bɛ yi Kɛdɛmɔt tiŋgban nɛli ni n-chaŋ Hɛshibɔn naa Sihɔn sani nti zaŋ suhudoo yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ yɛl o.
en: While we were in the desert of Kedemoth, I sent messengers to King Sihon of Heshbon. The messengers offered peace to Sihon. They said.

dag: Ti ni ŋma a ni bɔri Lɛbanɔn dakuɣ shɛŋa zaa ti a, ka lo li n-zaŋ niŋ teeku ni n-dolisi kom tahi Jɔpa na, ka yi kana ti kpuɣi li kuli Jɛrusalɛm.
en: we will cut as much timber as you need from Lebanon and bring it by raft on the sea to you at Joppa, where you can take it up to Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Yisa ni daa ŋahi ninvuɣ shɛb ŋahili ŋɔ bɔri ni bɛ gbaag o, dama bɛ daa baŋya ni bɛna ka o ŋahi ŋahili maa dalim, amaa ka daa lee zɔri salo maa ka chɛ o ka chaŋ.
en: They wanted to arrest Jesus because they knew that he had told the parable against them. But they were afraid of the crowd, so they left him and went away.

dag: Miriya ka yi tum alahichi yi sujee puuni, tɛhimiya dimbɔŋɔ yɛla viɛnyɛliŋga saha shɛli yi yi ti do yi gom shee, ka shini.
en: So be afraid, and dont sin! Think hard about it in your bed and weep over it! Selah.

dag: Bɛ ni daa bi niŋ Naawuni yɛda, ka bi lan niŋ o tiliginsim yiko naani la zuɣu.
en: because they had no faith in God, because they didnt trust his saving power.

dag: N daa je suli n-tin ya nanima, ka n suhu ti yiɣisi, ka n lan deei ba ka chɛn ya.
en: I gave you a king in my anger, and I took him away in my wrath.

dag: Naa Hanun mini Ammɔnnim maa ni daa baŋ ni bɛ leei Dauda dimnim maa, ka bɛ daa bo anzinfa laɣibaligu din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram tuhi pihitanaanahi n-chaŋ Siria tinsi din nyɛ Mɛsopoteemia mini Arammaaka ni Zɔba ni bɛ ti da chɛchɛbunsi mini di yuri na.
en: When the Ammonites realized that they had offended David, Hanun and the Ammonites sent one thousand kikkars of silver to hire chariots and cavalry for themselves from Aram-naharaim, Aram-maacah, and Zobah.

dag: Ka ŋun Naa Ahaz daa vuui daanya bimbin shɛli din daa be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu tooni la. O daa vuui li la omaŋmaŋ bimbin la mini Yawɛ jɛmbu duu bimbin la sunsuuni n-zaŋ li zal omaŋmaŋ bimbini maa nuzaa polo.
en: After that, he had the bronze altar moved aside, so his new altar would be right in front of the Lord 's temple.

dag: O zuliya kul ni beni sahakam, ka n chɛ ka o nam kul ba n-ʒe n sani kaman wuntaŋ la.
en: His family will always rule. I will let his kingdom last as long as the sun.

dag: Ka di simdi ka o yo o ni tum shɛm maa zuɣu, ka yo pirigibu ʒiibunu zuɣu vaabu yim pahi di zuɣu n-zaŋ li ti maligumaana, ka maligumaana maa ni zaŋ piɛlaa maa mali taali sanyoo sara maligu n-yo o daalahichi maa samli, ka o daalahichi maa kpihim.
en: In addition, you must pay what you owe plus a fine of percent. Then the priest will offer the ram as a sacrifice to make things right, and you will be forgiven.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa lihi nya ka dɔbba ata ʒiɛya mir o. O ni daa nya ba maa, ka o yiɣis o tanti suɣili dunoli maa ni n-zo n-chaŋ bɛ sani nti damdi ba tiŋa.
en: he looked up and saw three men standing there. As soon as he saw them, he ran out to meet them. Bowing down with his face touching the ground.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu nti gbaai Naawuni yɛla tɔɣisibu ni suhukpeeni; ka Akuila mini Prisila daa wum o wuhibu maa, ka zaŋ o ti maan wuh o Naawuni yɛla viɛnyɛliŋga pahi.
en: Apollos began to speak very boldly in the synagogue. When Priscilla and Aquila heard him speak, they took him to their home and helped him understand the way of God better.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa yɛli Izraɛlnima, Yi bihi yi ti bɔhi bɛ banim dahin shɛli ha, Ka kuɣ bɔnima n-lee bɔŋɔ.
en: Then Joshua told the Israelites, In the future your children will ask you, What do these rocks mean.

dag: Yi mi di deeya biŋkɔbigu tinzun nir sani n-zaŋ o mali sara shɛli din nyɛ yi Naawuni bindirigu sara la. Dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn mali dansi; bɛ ni mali ba tumdi din bi tu kamaata zuɣu, n ku deei ba yi sani.
en: You must not take animals from foreigners as sacrifices to your God. The animals might have been hurt in some way. They might have something wrong with them, so they will not be accepted.

dag: Nir yi nyɛ faralana ka mali biɛri suŋ, di so jɛrigu ŋun ŋmari ʒiri.
en: Better to be poor and walk in innocence than to have dishonest lips and be a fool.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim maa daa doli ba na ti siɣi teeku maa sunsuuni, Firawuna yuri zaa min o chɛchɛbunsi ni o chɛchɛbunduhiriba la zaa.
en: The Egyptians pursued them and went after them into the sea with all their horses, chariots, and drivers.

dag: Di saha maa ka bɛ zaa daa dii pirigi bɛ binyɛra n-yɛrigi sɔŋ dunɔdura zuɣu ni o no li gari, ka piɛb kikaa ka kuhi yɛli, Jɛhu n-nyɛ naa.
en: Then each officer quickly took his robe off and put it on the steps in front of Jehu. Then they blew the trumpet and made the announcement, Jehu is king.

dag: N ni mali suhupiɛlli Jɛrusalɛm mini n niriba zuɣu, ka so ku lan kum bee n-fabili di ni.
en: I myself will be filled with joy because of Jerusalem and her people. There will be no weeping there, no calling for help.

dag: Dinzuɣu m bia, mali yaa anfaan shɛli din be Yisa Masia ni la zuɣu.
en: So, my child, draw your strength from the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

dag: Bɛ nini yi ti nya bi shɛba n ni yɛn ti ba, di saha bɛ ni baŋ ni mani ŋun nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ n-tum lala maa, ka ti ma jilima ka lu man ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ sizuura.
en: When they see how great I have made their nation, they will praise and honor me, the holy God of Israel.

dag: A nyuɣu bela polipoli kaman pipi shɛli din puuni na ʒi n-kɔŋ wain shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋ gab taba. A puli ŋmanila alikama mɔri din laɣisi puya, ka paɣiviɛligakushihikom ʒe n-gil li.
en: A bowl is there, that never runs out of spiced wine. A sheaf of wheat is there, surrounded by lilies.

dag: Di saha Yisahaku daa yila Bɛrilahairoi na nti be Nɛgɛb.
en: Isaac had left Beer Lahai Roi and was now living in the Negev.

dag: Ka kom maa daa zo n-gili bimbini maa, ka pali bɔɣili la gba.
en: The water ran down around the altar and filled the trench.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka ti doli din ni chɛ ka naŋgban yini be ti sunsuuni mini din ni kpaŋsi tab suhuri.
en: So then, we must always aim at those things that bring peace and that help strengthen one another.

dag: Dama ŋunkam bo n-nya ma, o nya nyɛvili, ka Yawɛ ni niŋ o nirilim.
en: By finding me, you find life, and the Lord will be pleased with you.

dag: n-yɛli, Yi ma daa ŋmanila gbuɣinnyaŋ gahindili gbuɣima sunsuuni. O daa dola gbuɣim pola sunsuuni n-wumisir o bihi.
en: Say: What a lioness among lionesses was your mother! She bedded down among the strong young lions and reared her cubs.

dag: Amaa yi zaa yi lan labina, n ku nya yɛndana yi ni.
en: But if all of them came and stood before me, I would not find even one of them wise.

dag: N dimnim maa kul duri tamdila n zuɣu dabisili kam puuni, dama bɛn tuhiri ma maa galisiya pam.
en: Many of them are pursuing and attacking me.

dag: Ka o ni ti yɛn bahi nyaŋ o dim so ŋun bahindi nyaaŋa nyɛla kum.
en: Death is the last enemy to be brought to an end.

dag: Ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni bidib kpɛm kam ti kpi. Firawuna bikpɛm ŋun ti yɛn di nam o kalinsi nyaaŋa gba ni kpi hal zaŋ tabili dab paɣ ŋun gba nɛli zuɣu niɛmdi bikpɛm ni kpi ni bɛ ni tuui dɔɣi naɣilabihi shɛb zaa.
en: Every oldest child in the land of Egypt will die, from the oldest child of Pharaoh who sits on his throne to the oldest child of the servant woman by the millstones, and all the first offspring of the animals.

dag: A biha ayi ŋɔ ŋmanila muli bɛba ayi, ka ŋmani saŋkpalima ayi bɛn ʒe paɣiviɛligakushihikom puuni ŋubira.
en: Your breasts are like gazelles, twin deer feeding among lilies.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka tihi daa laɣim ni bɛ bɔ ŋun yɛn nyɛ bɛ naa. Ka bɛ daa yɛli Olivi tia, Ti bɔri ni nyini n-leei ti naa.
en: Once the trees searched for someone to be king; they asked the olive tree, Will you be our king.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, Yawɛ ni zaŋ a mini Izraɛlnim niŋ Filistianim nuu ni, dinzuɣu biɛɣuni a min a bidibisi sa ni be n sani, dama Yawɛ ni zaŋ Izraɛl tɔbbihi niŋ Filistianim nuu ni.
en: The Lord will let the Philistines defeat you and the army of Israel today. Tomorrow, you and your sons will be here with me.

dag: A biɛhigu ni ti ne kaman wuntaŋ ni la, ka di zibisim ti ne kaman asiba neesim la.
en: Your life will be brighter than the sunshine at noon. Lifes darkest hours will shine like the morning sun.

dag: Jɛhɔram daa mali tizɔbihi bɛn nyɛ Jɛhɔshafat bidibisi, bɛna n-daa nyɛ: Azaria mini Jɛhiɛl ni Zakaria ni Azaria ni Maikil ni Shɛfatia. Bɛmbɔŋɔ zaa daa nyɛla Jɛhɔshafat ŋun daa nyɛ Juda naa maa bidibisi.
en: Jehoram son of King Jehoshaphat of Judah had six brothers: Azariah, Jehiel, Zechariah, Azariahu, Michael, and Shephatiah.

dag: ni Hɔrima naa ni Arad naa.
en: the king of Hormah, the king of Arad.

dag: Ka Musa mini Izraɛl kpamba maa daa lab yiŋa.
en: Then Moses and the seventy leaders of Israel went back to camp.

dag: Di pa shɛli n ni ti kpalim yi sani hal ka kikaa ti gari, di nyaaŋa ka yi ti sɔŋ ma ka n chaŋ luɣ shɛli n ni ti yɛn chaŋ.
en: I may stay with you or even spend the winter there in Corinth so that you can send me on my way to wherever Im off to next.

dag: Ka Samuɛl yɛl o, Mani n-nyɛ nyar maa, daŋmi n tooni chaŋ daboli ŋɔ zuɣu, dama zuŋɔ m min a ni laɣim di bindirigu, ka n sa yɛl a din be a zuɣu ni biɛɣuni asiba ka chɛ ka a kuli.
en: Samuel answered, I am the seer. Go on ahead of me to the place of worship. Both of you are to eat with me today. Tomorrow morning I will answer all your questions and send you on your way.

dag: A ni ti yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Tin shɛli puuni bɛ ni kuri niriba, ka maani buɣa n-ta bɛmaŋ daɣiri la saha paaya.
en: You must say, This is what the Lord GOD says: The city is full of murderers, so her time of punishment will come. She made filthy idols for herself, and those idols made her filthy!.

dag: Tiligim ma ninsalinim nahiŋgu ni, ka n dol a zaligunima.
en: Save me from those who want to hurt me, and I will obey your instructions.

dag: Sagbani maa daa yi ti vuui suɣili maa zuɣusaa, di nyaaŋa Izraɛlnim yiɣisirimi gbaai chandi; ka sagbani maa daa yi ti kpalim zani luɣ shɛli, nimaani ka Izraɛlnim maa tiri bɛ suɣa doona.
en: When the cloud moved from its place over the Holy Tent, the Israelites followed it. When the cloud stopped, that is the place where the Israelites camped.

dag: A bi bɔri biŋkɔbiri sara maligu mini sara maligu balibu kam; a mi bi bɔri alahichi kpihimbu sara maligunima bee bɛ ni zaŋdi biŋkɔb shɛba m-maani sara nyɔri ba buɣim bimbini zuɣu la; amaa a luɣila n tiba ti ma.
en: Sacrifices and offerings are not what please you; gifts and payment for sin are not what you demand. But you made me willing to listen and obey.

dag: Juda ni daa nya o, o daa tɛhiya ni o nyɛla pagɔrili, dama o daa zaŋla sariga m-pil lims o ninni.
en: When Judah saw her, he thought that she was a prostitute, because she had her face covered.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ, a yuli galisiya dunia ŋɔ zaa ni! A chɛ ka a jilima yi zahira zuɣusaa.
en: O Lord , our Lord, your greatness is seen in all the world! Your praise reaches up to the heavens;.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n dan Ibrahimma Naawuni ŋɔ, n suhir a, tim ma nasara zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka niŋ n dan Ibrahimma nirilim maŋli.
en: He prayed, Lord , God of my master Abraham, give me success today and keep your promise to my master.

dag: Di dunoya pinaayi la daa nyɛla waya pinaayi, waya zaɣ yiniyini ka bɛ daa zaŋ mali dunoli kam, ka tiŋ maa puuni solɔɣu nyɛ salima din nyɛ alali n-doya ne kaman takɔriti diɣisi la.
en: The twelve gates were twelve pearls. Each gate was made from one pearl. The street of the city was made of pure gold, as clear as glass.

dag: Wula ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yi nyaaŋa ni tooi lan labi niŋ tuuba yaha? Bɔzuɣu? Bɛ nyɛla bɛn daa pun be Naawuni neesim ni, ka nyɛ bɛn daa pun deei Naawuni Shia Kasi, ka baŋ alizanda ni pini ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: For how can those who abandon their faith be brought back to repent again? They were once in God's light; they tasted heaven's gift and received their share of the Holy Spirit;.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒiɛm wuhibu ni bo bahiyoli ti bɛmaŋa, amaa bɛn tiri zaligu jilima ni nya laara.
en: If you refuse good advice, you are asking for trouble; follow it and you are safe.

dag: O ni daa mali ti miriti Damaskus, o nini nyabu yim ka neesim shɛli yi zuɣusaa na ti neei gil o;.
en: So Saul went to Damascus. When he came near the city, a very bright light from heaven suddenly shined around him.

dag: Ka bɛ zaŋ o na. Alizin birigu maa ni daa nya Yisa ka o dii yiɣisi bia maa, ka o lu m-bilinda, ka nintɔfuɣifuɣi ŋar o noli.
en: So the followers brought the boy to Jesus. When the evil spirit saw Jesus, it attacked the boy. The boy fell down and rolled on the ground. He was foaming at the mouth.

dag: O ni ti gbib o kayeeni ŋmani o nuu ni na ni o ti yɛl o chi kabɔɣili ni zaŋ kabiɛlim su o kunchuna ni, ka zaŋ buɣim din bi kpiri nyo wurigu mi.
en: He has his winnowing shovel with him, to thresh out all the grain and gather the wheat into his barn; but he will burn the chaff in a fire that never goes out.

dag: N suhi Yawɛ, ka o deei n suhigu; ka yihi ma n dabeenzɔbo zaa ni.
en: I prayed to the Lord , and he answered me; he freed me from all my fears.

dag: amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun bi be kasi ka ŋubi Yawɛ sara maligu nimdi ni daɣiri, bɛn yihim dilan o daŋ ni.
en: But don't eat any of this meat if you have become unclean by touching something unclean from a human or an animal or from any other creature. If you do, you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.

dag: Tim a ba mini a ma jilima kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni zal a shɛm din ni chɛ ka a mali nyɛvili wɔɣinli ka binshɛɣukam niŋ viɛnyɛla a sani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya ŋɔ ni.
en: Honor your father and your mother, exactly as the LORD your God requires, so that your life will be long and so that things will go well for you on the fertile land that the LORD your God is giving you.

dag: N leela n niriba zaa ni lari ninvuɣ so; bɛ yiini yila maani ma ansarisi dabisi muni puuni zaa.
en: People laugh at me all day long; I am a joke to them all.

dag: kaman bɛ ni daa nya li di piligu ni shɛm, ka moli di lahibal la.
en: They wrote what we had been told by the ones who were there in the beginning and saw what happened.

dag: Yawɛ daa lan yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ n yɛn bolila zuliya shɛb bɛn be nuzaa polo ŋɔ nanima, ka bɛ zaa kana ti kpa bɛ nam ʒiishɛhi Jɛrusalɛm dunɔdaya gbini. Bɛ ni ti teei gili di goondahi din gil li la mini Juda fɔntinsi zaa.
en: Just watch while I send for the kings of the north. They will attack and capture Jerusalem and other towns, then set up their thrones at the gates of Jerusalem.

dag: N yi daa niŋ salima yɛda bee n-niŋ salima din viɛla naani.
en: I have never trusted the power of wealth.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli ni bɛ ni niriba tuhi pisinaanahi n-yɛn su Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuma fukumsi, ka niriba tusaayɔbu nyɛ zuɣulaannim mini sariakaritiba.
en: Of these, there were , to supervise the work on the LORDs temple, , officers and judges.

dag: Ka Jona garigi yɛli ba, Zaŋmiya ma bahi teeku ŋɔ ni ka teeku maa fo n-dɔni baalim, dama m mi ni n zuɣu ka sanʒiɛɣu ŋɔ ʒiɛri ya maa.
en: Jonah answered, Throw me into the sea, and it will calm down. I know it is my fault that you are caught in this violent storm.

dag: Obɛd daa nyɛla Jɛhu ba, ka Jɛhu nyɛ Azaria ba.
en: Obed was the father of Jehu, Jehu was the father of Azariah.

dag: Di saha maa ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa zaŋ Yisa n-tahi mɔɣu ni ni Sintani ti zahim o.
en: Then the Spirit led Jesus into the desert. He was taken there to be tempted by the devil.

dag: Bɛ lan zaŋm chinchin sabilitim pili salima sara maligu bimbin la, ka yɛrigi biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ pil li, ka zaŋ di dapuhi tu li.
en: Next they shall spread a blue cloth over the gold altar, put a fine leather cover over it, and then insert the carrying poles.

dag: Ka n kpamdi ya jaande ni yi kul suhim Naawuni ka o chɛ ka di ku yuui ka n lab yi sanna.
en: I especially want you to pray that I can visit you again soon.

dag: Bɛ naɣilahi kul durila viɛnyɛliŋga, ka bɛ naɣinyama kul dɔɣira, ka na ʒi n-zaŋ bahi.
en: Yes, all their cattle breed and give birth without trouble.

dag: dama nyini n Duuma Naawuni, a ku chɛ ma ka n kpalim be kpiimba biɛhigu shee; ka a mi ku chɛ ka a Ninvuɣ suŋ niŋgbuŋ pooi.
en: because you will not abandon me in the world of the dead; you will not allow your faithful servant to rot in the grave.

dag: Ka Taainim shɛb bɛn daa be tiŋ maa ni daa ʒi zahim mini nɛma balibu kam na ti kɔhi Judanim zuɣu ka kɔhi li Jɛrusalɛm puuni Vuhim Dabisili dali maa.
en: In addition, people from Tyre who lived in the city were bringing in fish and all kinds of merchandise and selling them to the people of Judah on the Sabbath. This happened in Jerusalem itself!.

dag: Sagbani maa mini teeku maa ni ka bɛ zaa daa deei baptaizibu din wuhiri ni bɛ nyɛla Anabi Musa nyaandoliba.
en: In the cloud and in the sea they were all baptized as followers of Moses.

dag: Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa daa be Filistianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni la chira ayopɔin.
en: After the sacred chest had been in Philistia for seven months.

dag: Dindali maa vi ti ku din ya yi ni daa tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa ka zaɣisi n noli la zuɣu; dama di saha n ni ti yihi karimbaannim bɛn be yi ni ka mali suhupiɛlli di zuɣu la, ka yi ti ku lan mali karimbaani n zoli din be kasi ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Then, Jerusalem, you will no longer be ashamed of the wrong things your people do against me. That is because I will remove all the bad people from Jerusalem. I will take away all the proud people. There will not be any of them on my holy mountain.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni daa lo ni o ni zo ti yaannim nambɔɣu shɛm la niŋ pali, ka teeg o daalikauli suŋ.
en: He has shown the mercy promised to our ancestors, and remembered his holy covenant.

dag: Ka n yi chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka yaa sani, m bemi kaman ŋun ka yaa ni di chɛ ka n tooi tiligi bɛn ka yaa maa gba. N chɛ ka m biɛhigu mini sokam biɛhigu taɣilila taba ni di zuɣu chɛ ka n tum din ni chɛ ka n tooi tiligi shɛba.
en: When I am with people whose faith is weak, I live as they do to win them. I do everything I can to win everyone I possibly can.

dag: Zalim Izraɛlnim zaligu. Yɛlim ba, yi yi ti paai Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, Keenan tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni yɛn zaŋ tin ya maa tintarisi n-yɛn bɔŋɔ.
en: Command the Israelites and say to them: When you enter the land of Canaan, this is the land that will fall to you as an inheritance. The land of Canaan according to its boundaries.

dag: Deemiya bɛ suɣa mini bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu ni bɛ pateesanima ni bɛ nɛma zaa. Taɣimiya bɛ laakuma chaŋ ti leei yi dini. Ka bɛ ŋme kuŋ yɛli, Yɛlibiɛɣu gili ti luɣilikam zaa.
en: Seize their tents and their flocks, their tent curtains and everything in their tents. Take their camels and tell the people, Terror is all around you.

dag: Jɛhɔshafat ni daa di nam n-su Judanim shɛm m-bala. O yuma daa nyɛla yuun pihitanaanu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam, o daa dila nam maa yuun pisinaanu Jɛrusalɛm. O ma yuli n-daa booni Azuba, o daa nyɛla Shilihi bipuɣiŋga.
en: Jehoshaphat ruled over Judah. He was years old when he became king, and he ruled for twenty-five years in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Azubah; she was Shilhis daughter.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Gazanim ni Samsin be nimaani, ka bɛ laɣimna ti teei gil o ni be shɛli maa, ka chaŋ ti gu o tiŋ maa gooni dunol ni yuŋ zaa. Bɛ daa kul fomi chichi dindali maa yuŋ maa, ka yɛra Ti ni do n-gul o hal ka biɛɣu ti neei ka ti ku o.
en: The people of Gaza found out that Samson was there, so they surrounded the place and waited for him all night long at the city gate. They were quiet all night, thinking to themselves, We'll wait until daybreak, and then we'll kill him.

dag: Di saha maa ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu din be alizanda ni la daa yooi ka o Daalikauli Adaka la be di puuni; ka saa daa nyaɣisiri ka tahira, ka vuri yiɣisi mɔni ka tiŋgbani damda, ka sakuɣ kara luri na.
en: God's temple in heaven was opened, and the Covenant Box was seen there. Then there were flashes of lightning, rumblings and peals of thunder, an earthquake, and heavy hail.

dag: Di wuhi ni a nyɛla wuntizɔra ti yaɣi, a mi di wuhi ni a nyɛla yɛndan ti yaɣi. Di niŋ lala ku amaŋa.
en: So why ruin your life? Dont be too good or too bad, and dont be too wise or too foolish. Why should you die before your time?.

dag: Ka buɣim yi ti di so mi tuma zaa, o ni kɔŋ di laara, ka ŋun maŋmaŋ lee ni tiligi, amaa ka di naɣ ni bemi kaman ŋun zo n-yi buɣim ni tiligi.
en: But if anyones work goes up in flames, theyll lose it. However, they themselves will be saved as if they had gone through a fire.

dag: Musa ni daa yɛli Izraɛlnim zaa yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa naai.
en: When Moses finished speaking all these words to all Israel.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Izraɛlnim polo m-bɔŋɔ: Yawɛ ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ ka ti daadam nyɛvil la yɛliya.
en: This is a message from the Lord about Israel. The Lord is the one who made the earth and the sky, and he put the human spirit in people. And this is what the Lord said:.

dag: Jɛhoyakim yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaanu saha shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋ o lee naa maa. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun piniyini. O daa tum alahichi pam Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni la sani.
en: Jehoiakim was years old when he was appointed king, and he ruled years from Jerusalem. Jehoiakim disobeyed the Lord his God by doing evil.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lan yɛli ma, Daadam, n yɛn filimla Jɛrusalɛmnim bindirigu. Bɛ ni ti zahindila bɛ bindira tiri ba, ka bɛ diri li ni dabiɛm, ka zahindi kom tiri ba, ka bɛ nyuri li ni suhuzɔhibo.
en: And he added, Mortal man, I am going to cut off the supply of bread for Jerusalem. The people there will be distressed and anxious as they measure out the food they eat and the water they drink.

dag: Ka saa daa miri sakuɣ kara ka nyaɣisira, ka lala tatabo daa na ʒi n-niŋ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni saha shɛli di ni daa leei di dahalali tiŋa.
en: a heavy hailstorm, with lightning flashing back and forth. It was the worst storm that Egypt had ever known in all its history.

dag: Ka yi ti boori li mihiri Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la puuni mini Alikauli Adaka la zuɣu.
en: Pour this oil on the Meeting Tent and on the Box of the Agreement. This will show that these things have a special purpose.

dag: Yinim ninsalinima, saha yuusim wula puuni ka yi kul yɛn dihiri ma vi? Saha yuusim wula puuni, ka yi kul yɛn yuri yɛtɔɣ yoya, ka doli din nyɛ ʒiri?.
en: How long will you people insult me? How long will you love what is worthless and go after what is false?.

dag: Yi ni dɔɣi bi shɛb zaa puuni, so kani n-nyɛ ŋun ni tooi wuhi ya soli. So mi ka yi ni wumsi bi shɛb maa zaa puuni n-nyɛ ŋun ni tooi vɔn ya.
en: Jerusalem had many people, but none of them became leaders for her. None of the children she raised became guides to lead her.

dag: Bɛ yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛnhur ŋun daa be Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya zuɣu tinsi ni la.
en: These are the names of the twelve governors: Ben Hur was governor of the hill country of Ephraim.

dag: O min o niriba bɛn be o sani nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛri gari zuliya kam. O ni ti zaŋ ba na ka bɛ ti saɣim tiŋgbɔŋ maa. Bɛ ni ti ŋɔhi takɔbiri lu Ijiptinim zuɣu n-ku niriba yɛrigi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: He and his cruel troops will invade and destroy your land and leave your dead bodies piled everywhere.

dag: Naawuni ŋun zaŋ o Shia Kasi tin ya ka tumd alahiziba tuma yi san la, Naawuni fukumsi zaligu dolibu zuɣu bee lahibal suŋ yɛla wumbu mini yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka o niŋdi lala maa?.
en: So does the one providing you with the Spirit and working miracles among you do this by you doing the works of the Law or by you believing what you heard?.

dag: dama niriba pam ni ti zaŋ n yuli kana ti yɛra, Mani n-nyɛ Masia! Mani n-nyɛ Masia! Ka bɛ ni ti birigi niriba pam.
en: Many people will come and use my name. They will say, I am the Messiah, and they will fool many people.

dag: O daa deei bɛ yɛligu hal ti dolila Izraɛl Naa Ɛhab bia Jɔram ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl naa la chaŋ Ramɔtigiliad nti tuhi Siria naa Hazaɛl. Ka Sirianim maa daa ti Jɔram daŋa.
en: Following their advice, he joined King Joram of Israel in a war against King Hazael of Syria. The armies clashed at Ramoth in Gilead, and Joram was wounded in battle.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa lan chɛ ka Firawuna niŋ tipawumli ka bi chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: This time the Lord made the king so stubborn.

dag: Di simdi ka o zaŋ suhudoo sara maligu maa biŋkpam, ka ŋmaai zugbini miri yaaŋ kɔbili n-zaŋ di mini di kpam maa zaa mali sara ni biŋkpam din pili namanama zuɣu la ni biŋkpam din be namanama maa ni zaa.
en: Offer the fat on the tail, the tailbone, and the insides.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ nina niŋ liti, ka bɛ ku tooi nya; ka chɛ ka bɛ yaaŋkɔba gbarigi sahakam.
en: Blind them with darkness and make them tremble.

dag: Paɣ maa mi daa mali naɣipol kpabili o yiŋa, ka o daa dii yiɣisi yomyom chɛ ka bɛ kɔrigi naɣipolli maa, ka o niŋ zim ŋɔri mali bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi.
en: The woman quickly killed a calf which she had been fattening. Then she took some flour, prepared it, and baked some bread without yeast.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun daa nyɛ Sool tumtumda ka o yuli booni Ziba la daa be nimaani, ka bɛ daa bol o ti Naa Dauda ka o ti bɔh o, Nyini n-nyɛ Ziba? Ka o garigi yɛli, Naa, mani.
en: There was a servant named Ziba from Sauls family. Davids servants called Ziba to David. King David said to Ziba, Are you Ziba? Ziba said, Yes, I am your servant Ziba.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa pii wun pala la, di saha ka tɔbu daa be bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. Ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahi bɛn be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni ŋuni n-daa lee mali nyɔtaɣirigu bee kpani?.
en: God chose new leaders to fight at the city gates. No one could find a shield or a spear among the , soldiers of Israel.

dag: ka ti yiɣisi chaŋ Bɛtɛl. M bɔri ni m mɛla bimbini nimaani zali Naawuni so ŋun daa deei n suhigu n nandahima nyabu dali, ka be n sani n ni chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam la.
en: We will leave here and go to Bethel. There I will build an altar to the God who has always helped me during times of trouble. He has been with me wherever I have gone.

dag: Lan bomiya zim viɛlli din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ata n-niŋ kpam ŋmiri li ka di leei chi sara m-pahi naɣilaa kam zuɣu; ka lan zaŋ zim viɛlli din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ayi n-niŋ kpam ŋmiri li ka di leei chi sara m-pahi piɛla yino zuɣu;.
en: As a grain offering, offer flour mixed with olive oil: with each bull, pounds of flour; with the ram, pounds;.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk daa di nam maa su Izraɛlnim yuma ata.
en: Abimelech ruled Israel for three years.

dag: O yi kul ko o kɔbu, o biritila o bimbira din nyɛ nili mini buŋgu, ka biri alikama doli vuɣisi, ka biri chi di biribu shee, ka biri binshɛŋa din pahi dolisi putarisi.
en: When he has smoothed its surface, doesnt he scatter fennel, and sow cumin, and plant wheat and barley in their places, and spelt as a border?.

dag: Yaakubu zuliya bɛn daa dol o kuli Ijipti yuya m-bɔŋɔ. Yaakubu min o bidibisi. Rubin ŋun daa nyɛ Yaakubu bituuli la.
en: These are the names of Israels sons and family who went to Egypt with him: Reuben was Jacobs first son.

dag: Dabiɛm ka bɛ yinsi puuni, ka Naawuni bi darigiri bɛ tibili.
en: They have no worries at home, and God never punishes them.

dag: Amaa Musa mini maligumaana Aduna ni daa pun sab Izraɛlnim shɛb yuya Sinai mɔɣu ni la so daa ka bɛ ni daa sab shɛb yuya ŋɔ kalinli maa ni.
en: None of the people that Moses and Aaron had counted in the Sinai Desert were still alive.

dag: N ni zaŋ ko viɛlli mihi ya ka yi yi yi daɣiri zaa ni mini yi buɣ jɛmbo zaa ni.
en: Then I will sprinkle pure water on you and make you pure. I will wash away all your filth, the filth from those nasty idols, and I will make you pure.

dag: ka benya kaman dunɔguliba bɛn mali shili ʒi n-guli bɛ duuma ni o ti yi amiliya chuɣu ni na n-niŋ gaafara ka bɛ yoog o yom ka o gari.
en: Be like people waiting for their master to come home from a wedding celebration, who can immediately open the door for him when he arrives and knocks on the door.

dag: Di saha o ni suhi Naawuni ka o deeg o suhigu, ka o ni tooi chaŋ Naawuni tooni ni suhupiɛlli, ka Naawuni ti o wuntia tuma maa laara.
en: and we ask God to accept us. Then we joyfully worship God, and we are rewarded because we are innocent.

dag: Di sɔɣirimi ni din kɔŋ jilima, ka neeri ni jilima. Di sɔɣirimi ni chɔɣinsi, ka neeri ni yiko.
en: When buried, it is ugly and weak; when raised, it will be beautiful and strong.

dag: Chɛ ka tuumba bɛn ka Juda naa Zɛdɛkia sanna Jɛrusalɛm maa zaŋ lahibali ti ti Ɛdom naa mini Mɔab naa ni Ammɔn naa ni Taai naa ni Sidɔn naa.
en: Then send word to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon, Tyre, and Sidon through their representatives who have come to Jerusalem to Judahs King Zedekiah.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ lala yihi nanima anu maa vol maa ni na ti ti o. Nanim maa n-daa nyɛ: Jɛrusalɛm naa mini Hiburɔn naa ni Jarimut naa ni Lakishi naa ni Ɛgilɔn naa.
en: The soldiers opened the entrance to the cave and brought out the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish, and Eglon.

dag: Teemiya ni yi daa nyɛla daba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, dinzuɣu ka n zali ya ni yi niŋdi dimbɔŋɔ.
en: You lived in poverty as slaves in Egypt until the Lord your God rescued you. That's why I am giving you these laws.

dag: Yi yi ti yɛn sibigi suɣili maa chaŋ, Lɛvinim n-yɛn sibigi li; ka yi yi ti yɛn sa li, Lɛvinim maa n-yɛn zaŋ li sa. Ka ninvuɣ zino yi miri suɣili maa na, yin kum o.
en: Whenever the Holy Tent is moved, the Levites must do it. Whenever the Holy Tent is set up, the Levites must do it. They are the men who will take care of the Holy Tent. Anyone else who tries to take care of the tent must be killed.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Dauda ni Ahitɔfɛl gba pahila Absalom zuɣu. Ka Dauda yɛli, Yawɛ, n suhir a mi, chɛ ka Ahitɔfɛl ni yɛn wuhi yikombiɛlim yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa leei jɛrilim.
en: Someone told David, Ahithophel is helping Absalom plot against you! David said, Please, Lord , keep Ahithophel's plans from working.

dag: Amaa nyini n-chɛ ka a shia kanna ti kpɛri bɛ ni, ka bɛ leeri a ni nam shɛba; ka a ti tiŋgbani nyɛvil palli.
en: When you let loose your breath, they are created, and you make the surface of the ground brand-new again.

dag: Yi yi ni doli n ni zaŋ fukumsi zalikpan shɛŋa zaa zaani ya ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga, ka yuri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka dol o soya zaa, ka zaŋ yimaŋ ti o.
en: Be careful to obey every command I have told you to follow: Love the Lord your God, follow all his ways, and be faithful to him.

dag: Nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni. Yiɣisim darigi zuliya kam zaa tibili. Di chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lɔri nia biɛri ŋɔ ni ninvuɣ yino gba tiligi.
en: Rise, Lord God Almighty, and come to my aid; see for yourself, God of Israel! Wake up and punish the heathen; show no mercy to evil traitors!.

dag: Yuun piniyini puuni gol so ŋun pahir ata dahin yini dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: Eleven years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the Lord spoke to me on the first day of the third month. He said:.

dag: Bɛn daa gbahi ti maa daa yɛli ti mi ni ti yilim yila, ka bɛn daa nahindi ti maa daa yɛli ti ni ti yilimi yila ka di niŋ ba nyaɣisim, ka yɛra, Yilimiya Ziɔn yilli ka ti wum.
en: Those who captured us told us to sing; they told us to entertain them: Sing us a song about Zion.

dag: Di saha doo maa ya kpamba maa ni boli doo maa na ti tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa, ka o yi na kul vili ʒiɛla lala ka yɛli, N je ni n kpuɣ o.
en: The citys elders will summon him and talk to him about this. If he doesnt budge, insisting, I dont want to marry her.

dag: Ka Filistia tɔbbi shɛba daa chaŋ ti gu Mikimash solɔɣu zuɣu.
en: A group of Philistine soldiers guarded the mountain pass at Micmash.

dag: Bɛ nam maa ni ti gbarigi gari nam kam, ka bɛ ti ku lan duhi bɛmaŋ gari zuliya shɛba, ka n ti chɛ ka bɛ kpalim biɛla din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku lan su zuliya shɛba yaha.
en: It will be the least important kingdom. It will never again lift itself above the other nations. I will make them so small that they will not rule over the nations.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛl o, Mani n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun nyɛ a ba Naawuni. Di zɔri dabiɛm ni a kuli Ijipti, dama n ni chɛ ka a daŋ niriba ti leei zuliya bɛn galisi pam.
en: God said, I am God, the same God your father worshiped. Don't be afraid to go to Egypt. I will give you so many descendants that one day they will become a nation.

dag: N yi ti chɛ ka sagbana zibigi ka sagani booi sagbana maa ni.
en: When I send clouds over the earth, and a rainbow appears in the sky.

dag: Dama m mi ni n tiligira nyɛla ŋun be, o nyɛla ŋun kul ni ti bahi ka dunia ni na.
en: But I know there is someone in heaven who will come at last to my defense.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, a chɛ ka o takɔbi noli gbilim; ka bi zan o nyaaŋa tɔbu ni.
en: But you forced him to retreat because you did not fight on his side.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim mini Judanim bɛn daa be Juda tiŋgbani maa ni fɔntinsi ni daa zaŋ bɛ naɣ pia kam puuni naɣ yino na mini piɛri pia kam puuni piɛ yino m-pahi bɛ ni daa zaŋ pin kasi shɛŋa zaa ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni la na nti zaŋ li sɔŋsɔŋ gbilligbilli.
en: The people from the other towns of Judah brought a tenth of their herds and flocks, as well as a tenth of anything they had dedicated to the Lord .

dag: Lab kul a yiŋa nti yɛli tuun kar shɛl a Duuma Naawuni ni tum ti a ŋɔ yɛla. Ka o daa chaŋ ti moli Yisa ni tum o tuun kar shɛli maa yɛla gili tiŋ maa zaa.
en: Go back home and tell people what God did for you. So the man went all over town telling what Jesus had done for him.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa ti tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ ba niŋ Midiannim nuu ni yuma ayopɔin.
en: The Israelites did things that the LORD saw as evil, and the LORD handed them over to the Midianites for seven years.

dag: Dinzuɣu yihimiya dabin kura la yi sunsuuni din ni chɛ ka yi leei bɔrɔbɔro ziŋŋɔriti palli din ka dabindi kaman di ni simdi ni yi be shɛm. Dama Masia ŋun nyɛ ti Yaɣigari Chuɣu Piɛbil la pun zaŋ omaŋ mali sara.
en: Take out all the old yeast, so that you will be a new batch of dough. You really are bread without yeast—Passover bread. Yes, Christ our Passover Lamb has already been killed.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Pumpɔŋɔ, kamiyana ka ti tɔɣisi mali ti yɛla maa. Hal yi daalahichi ni kul be kaman mulifu maa, di ni paligi kaman sakuɣa la; hal di ni kul be kaman zom maa, di ni paligi kaman piɛ piɛlli kɔbiri la.
en: I, the Lord , am the one speaking to you. Come, lets discuss this. Even if your sins are as dark as red dye, that stain can be removed and you will be as pure as wool that is as white as snow.

dag: Naa suhu yi yiɣisi bah a zuɣu, nyin di yɛli ni a lan je o tuma, dama a yi gbaag amaŋ be balim, di ni ku taali maa.
en: Dont quit your job simply because the boss is angry with you. If you remain calm and helpful, you can correct even great mistakes.

dag: Zibisim shɛli kani bee bumbɔni, ka alahichinim ni tooi sɔɣi di ni.
en: Theres no darkness, no deep darkness, where evildoers can hide themselves.

dag: ka tumo daa ti kana ti yɛli Ayuba, Ti di malila naɣilahi la kɔra, ka bunsi la ʒe m-baɣi ba ŋubiri mɔri.
en: a messenger came running to Job. We were plowing the fields with the oxen, he said, and the donkeys were in a nearby pasture.

dag: Ka Yisa ni daa tim ninvuɣ pisopɔin shɛb la daa ti labina ni suhupiɛlli ti yɛl o, Ti Duuma, hal ti nyaŋ alizin biɛri gba a yuli zuɣu.
en: The seventy-two men came back in great joy. Lord, they said, even the demons obeyed us when we gave them a command in your name.

dag: Niŋmiya bɛ ni zali ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam: Ŋun simdi ni a yo lampoo zuɣu o sani, nyin yom o; ka ŋun deerila farigu, nyin tim o; ka ŋun simdi ni a lu o sizuura, nyin lum o sizuura; ka ŋun mi simdi ni a ti o jilima, nyin tim o jilima.
en: Pay, then, what you owe them; pay them your personal and property taxes, and show respect and honor for them all.

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ daanya mali bansi pihinu n-zaŋ gɔhigɔhi suɣili maa tabili taba, ka di niŋ zaɣ yini.
en: and the two panels were fastened at the loops with bronze hooks.

dag: Toli nyɛla bɛn ka naa, amaa bɛ nyɛla bɛn doli tab chana sariasaria.
en: locusts have no king, but they are able to work together;.

dag: ka o chɛ ka manna lu bɛ sanna ni bɛ di, ka o daa ti ba zuɣusaa bindirigu.
en: From heaven he sent grain that they called manna.

dag: Di yuri gbihibu, di yi pa lala fara ni gbaag a. Neem a nina, a ni nya bindirigu pam.
en: Dont love sleep or you will be poor; stay alert and you will have plenty to eat.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi zɔri dabiɛm lala? Yi yɛda niŋbu bi yaɣi lala.
en: Jesus asked them, Why are you frightened? Dont you have faith yet.

dag: O ti o naa nasara pam, ka wuh o yurilim ni galisi shɛm zaŋ chaŋ o ninvuɣ gahindili Dauda min o zuliya sani hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: You are the one who gives great victories to your king, who shows faithful love to your anointed one— to David and to his descendants forever.

dag: Ohola ni daa kul nyɛ m paɣa maa zaa yoli, o daa na kul tumdila pagɔrisigu tuma. O kɔre daa kul bela o mamanim bɛn nyɛ Asirianim.
en: Even though Oholah was my wife, she continued to be a prostitute and chased after Assyrian lovers.

dag: Fɔntinsi ŋɔ zaa daa nyɛla bɛ ni me goon wɔɣila gili tin shɛŋa, ka di mali dunoyɔriti din mali kpiɔŋ ni dunokparitisi m-pahi tiŋkpansi pam zuɣu.
en: All these towns were fortified with high walls, gates, and bars to lock the gates, and there were also many villages without walls.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa laɣim naŋgban yini ni bɛ chaŋ ti liri Gibianima.
en: So all the men in Israel assembled with one purpose—to attack the town.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi yi maani yɛla ŋɔ tatabo, di chaŋ wula ka yi zaŋdi yi yɛla tahiri cheechi ni bi dihi ninvuɣ shɛb bebu tabili sani?.
en: So if you have such matters to be judged, why do you take them to those who are not part of the church? They mean nothing to you.

dag: O zaani tiŋgbani zaligu, ka o ni yɛli shɛm niŋdi yomyom.
en: He gives a command to the earth, and it quickly obeys.

dag: Riu ni daa dɔɣi Sɛrug maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiyinaayopɔin. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: After Serug was born, Reu lived years; he had other sons and daughters.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yiɣisi chaŋ ti ʒin o ʒiishee dunɔdali gbini. Ka bɛ daa yɛli niriba maa, Nyamiya, naa ʒin o ʒiishee dunɔdal la gbini. Ka bɛ zaa daa ka naa tooni na. Di saha maa Izraɛlnim zaa yinoyino daa pun zomi kuli bɛ yinsi.
en: So the king went to the city gate. The news spread that the king was at the gate, so all the people came to see him, except for the Israelites who had run away to their homes.

dag: Amaa miriya ka yi deei binshɛli zali ninvuɣ kura ŋun simdi kubu zaani. Ninvuɣ kura simdi kubu.
en: You may not accept a ransom for the life of a killer, who is guilty of a capital crime, for he must definitely be put to death.

dag: A yi ti nya bɛ biɛhigu mini bɛ tuma, a ni baŋ ni n ni daa niŋ shɛlikam maa, pa yoli ka n daa niŋ lala di ni maa, ka a suhu ni maai. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: then you will know that there was good reason for everything I did. The Sovereign Lord has spoken.

dag: Ka Zabai bia Baruk daa niŋ nimmoo mali me gooni maa gɔŋbu shee yaɣ shɛli hal ti paai maligumaaniba zuɣulana Ɛliashib yiŋ dunoli shee m-pan o zuɣu.
en: Baruch son of Zabbai repaired the next section. Baruch worked very hard and repaired the section of wall from the corner to the entrance to the house of Eliashib the high priest.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ti yɛli Musa, Siɣimi ti saɣisi niriba maa, di yi pa lala bɛ ni kab kana ni bɛ ti nya man Yawɛ, ka bɛ pam ni kpi.
en: The LORD said to Moses, Go down and warn the people not to break through to try to see the LORD, or many of them will fall dead.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, yi ni yɛn puhiri chu shɛŋa ka di nyɛ laɣiŋgu kasinim yi sani, ka nyɛ man Yawɛ ni zali chu shɛŋa m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Speak to the Israelites and say to them: These are my appointed times, the LORDs appointed times, which you will declare to be holy occasions.

dag: Di yi niŋ ka doo kpuɣi paɣa, amaa ka o nini ti bi lan tiɣ o, ka di nyɛla binshɛli ka o nya ka di bi viɛl o sani, ka dinzuɣu chɛ ka o sabi paɣ yihibu gbaŋ ti o, ka yih o o yiŋa ka o chaŋ.
en: A man might marry a woman, and then find some secret thing about her that he does not like. If that man is not pleased with her, he must write the divorce papers and give them to her. Then he must send her from his house.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ yi mini Masia ni laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yin la zuɣu, yinim bɛn daa be katiŋ la yipa vu m-miri Naawuni Masia ʒim zuɣu.
en: But now, in union with Christ Jesus you, who used to be far away, have been brought near by the blood of Christ.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka tihi daa laɣim ni bɛ bɔ ŋun yɛn nyɛ bɛ naa. Ka bɛ daa yɛli Olivi tia, Ti bɔri ni nyini n-leei ti naa.
en: Once upon a time the trees went out to choose a king for themselves. They said to the olive tree, Be our king.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: On the first day of the seventh month observe a special day of rest, and come together for worship when the trumpets sound.

dag: nyin be alizanda ni ka wum, ka niŋ din tuhi, ka kar a daba saria n-wuhi ŋun tum taali, ka chɛ ka o tuuni maa ʒin o zuɣu. Ka a zani wuntizɔra maa nyaaŋa, ka ti o laara o wuntitali maa zuɣu.
en: O Lord , listen in heaven and judge your servants. Punish the guilty one as he deserves, and acquit the one who is innocent.

dag: Ka niriba pam tah o zuɣu ni o foma; amaa ka o maan kuhi pam yɛli, Nyin ŋun nyɛ Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ, zom ma nambɔɣu.
en: Many people told the man to stop, but he shouted even louder, Son of David, have pity on me.

dag: Ka Yisa daa gbaai bia maa nuu ni yiɣis o ʒili, ka o yiɣisi zani.
en: But Jesus took his hand, lifted him up, and he arose.

dag: Naawuni, deemi n suhigu n fabila ŋɔ puuni. Fam n nyɛvili bahi, dama n zɔrila n dimnima.
en: I am in trouble, God—listen to my prayer! I am afraid of my enemies—save my life!.

dag: Yawɛ, guli n noli, gbibi n naŋgbampiba.
en: Set a guard over my mouth, LORD; keep close watch over the door that is my lips.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Abigeel, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun tim a na ka a ti tuhi ma soli ŋɔ mali alibarika!.
en: David said to Abigail, Bless the LORD God of Israel, who sent you to meet me today!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Alimɔndibilataim maa n-chaŋ ti dɔni Abarim zoya ni miri Nɛbo.
en: They left Almon Diblathaim and camped on the mountains of Abarim near Nebo.

dag: Amaa ka doo maa daa garigi yɛli Jɔab, Hal anzinfa laɣibaligu tuhili yi kpe n nuu ni gba, n ku zaŋ n nuu shihi nabia maa, dama ti di wum naa ni yɛl a mini Abishai ni Itai, N zuɣu miriya ka yi niŋ nachimbil Absalom maa shɛli.
en: But the man answered, Even if you gave me a thousand pieces of silver, I wouldn't lift a finger against the king's son. We all heard the king command you and Abishai and Ittai, For my sake don't harm the young man Absalom.

dag: Hal yi daa chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi pam, Sinai Zoli gbini, ka o daa je suli n- yɛn kun ya.
en: At Mount Sinai you made the Lord so angry that he was going to destroy you.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa kpe m-pali Pita ka o yɛli ba, Yinim bɛn nyɛ zuɣulaannim mini kpamba ŋɔ.
en: Then Peter, inspired by the Holy Spirit, answered, Leaders of the people and elders.

dag: Miri ka a nyuri bara biɛɣuni zuɣu, dama a bi mi dabisili maa ni yɛn tahi yɛl shɛli na.
en: Don't brag about tomorrow! Each day brings its own surprises.

dag: Ka Saimɔn min o tab la daa chani bɔr o shee.
en: Later, Simon and his friends went to look for Jesus.

dag: A dabili Jɔab bɔrimi ni o mali yɛla zali dɛde, dina n-chɛ ka o niŋ lala maa. Amaa n dan mali yɛm kaman Naawuni malaika ni mali yɛm shɛm la din ni tooi baŋ binshɛɣukam din be dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Joab did this so that you would see things differently. My lord, you are as wise as Gods angel. You know everything that happens on earth.

dag: Kpiimba shihi sɔhirimi, ka bɛn be kpiimba biɛhigu shee sɔhira.
en: The ghosts and their neighbors in the underworld shake with fear.

dag: Di nyɛla vi ni nir tɔɣisi niriba ni niŋdi binshɛŋa ashilɔni yɛla.
en: Actually, it is shameful to even talk about the things those people do in secret.

dag: ka o chɛ ka bɛ bu Jɛrimia, ka ba o bandi ʒili Bɛnjamin dunɔdali din daa be zuɣusaa din be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu polo la.
en: he had me beaten and placed in chains near the upper Benjamin Gate in the Temple.

dag: Duhimiya tuuta din nyɛ Babilɔn liribu shihirili la zuɣusaa. Bomiya guliba pahi; zalimiya tiŋ guliba, ka chɛ ka shɛb sɔɣi doya gu. Dama Yawɛ lo nia ka niŋ o ni daa yɛli ni o ni niŋ Babilɔnnim shɛm la.
en: Raise the signal flag and attack the city walls. Post more guards. Have soldiers watch the city and set up ambushes. I have made plans to destroy Babylon, and nothing will stop me.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa chaŋ Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka o ti kpalim be bɛ sani nimaani m-baptaiziri niriba.
en: After this Jesus and his disciples went into Judea, where he spent some time with them and was baptizing.

dag: A na mi n-siɣi teeku kɔbilnin ni bee n-tam teeku bulli ni tiŋgbani zuɣu chaŋ?.
en: Have you ever gone to the deepest parts of the sea? Have you ever walked on the ocean bottom?.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ saa tahigu daa be zuɣusaa; ka Zallakudura Naa daa chɛ ka o kukoli yɛra.
en: Then the Lord thundered from the sky; and the voice of the Most High was heard.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa yɛli Simiɔn mini Lɛvi, Yi bo yɛla ti ma, di ni chɛ ka jɛlinsi kpe m mini tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni nim bɛn nyɛ Keenannim mini Pɛrizinim ŋɔ sunsuuni, ka m mi niriba bi zooi. Bɛ yi laɣim kana ti liri ma, bɛ ni ku m mini n nyaaŋa zaa.
en: Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, Youve put me in danger by making me offensive to those who live here in the land, to the Canaanites and the Perizzites. I have only a few men. They may join forces, attack me, and destroy me, me and my household.

dag: dimbɔŋɔ ka n yɛn niŋ ya, n ni chɛ ka dabiɛm gbahi ya, ka chɛ ka dɔr shɛli din bahiri nir yoli lu yi zuɣu, dɔr shɛli din saɣindi nina ka nyɛ din diri nyɛvili. Ka yi ti biri yi bimbira yoli, dama yi dimnima n-ni ti di li.
en: I will punish you terribly, and you will be ruined. You will be struck with incurable diseases and with fever that leads to blindness and depression. Your enemies will eat the crops you plant.

dag: Pita ni daa nya o maa ka o bɔhi Yisa, N Duuma, ka ŋumbɔŋɔ mi yɛla lee nyɛla wula.
en: When Peter saw this disciple, he said to Jesus, Lord, what about him.

dag: ka yina. Bɛn daa tum tuun suma ni ti neei kum ni n-nya nyɛvili; ka bɛn mi daa tum tuumbiɛri ti neei kum ni n-nya saria karibu.
en: Then they will come out of their graves. Those who did good in this life will rise and have eternal life. But those who did evil will rise to be judged guilty.

dag: Pita daa lan yɛli ba yaha, Yi gba nyɛla anabinim maa yaansi, ka su alikauli shɛli Naawuni ni daa lo yi yaannim maa. O daa yɛli ti yab Ibrahimma ni o zuliya zuɣu ka dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam ni ti nya alibarika.
en: You are really the ones God told his prophets to speak to. And you were given the promise God made to your ancestors. He said to Abraham, All nations on earth will be blessed because of someone from your family.

dag: Ka n yi ti kana, ka yi pii yi ni ninvuɣ shɛba n-sab gbana ti ba, n ni chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ yi pini maa tahi Jɛrusalɛm.
en: When I arrive, I will send some men to take your gift to Jerusalem. These will be the ones you all agree should go. I will send them with letters of introduction.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ ʒirilana ka pa ni ŋun chihi ni Yisa pala Masia? Ninvuɣ so ŋun chihi ti Ba Naawuni min o Bia maa, dilana n-nyɛ Masiachihira.
en: So who is the liar? It is the one who says Jesus is not the Messiah. Whoever says that is the enemy of Christ—the one who does not believe in the Father or in his Son.
