dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Sairus ŋun nyɛ o ni pii so la, N niŋ a yiko ni a tuhi nyaŋ zuliya kam, ka fa nanim yaa. N ni yooi dunoli kam ti a, ka bɛ ku kpari duno shɛli.
en: The LORD says to his anointed, to Cyrus, whom I have grasped by the strong hand, to conquer nations before him, disarming kings, and opening doors before him, so no gates will be shut.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisifu ŋun daa nyɛ Arimatia tiŋbia ka nyɛ Yisa nyaandola ashilɔni Yɛhudianim zɔbu zuɣu la daa chaŋ Gomna Pailɛt sani nti suh o soli ni o chɛ ka o zaŋ Yisa ti sɔɣi, ka Gomna Pailɛt daa saɣi. Ka o daa chaŋ ti zaŋ o.
en: Joseph from Arimathea was one of Jesus' disciples. He had kept it secret though, because he was afraid of the Jewish leaders. But now he asked Pilate to let him have Jesus' body. Pilate gave him permission, and Joseph took it down from the cross.

dag: Naawuni, a chandi mali jiri pam ka niriba nyari li. N Naawuni ni n Naa maa chanimi ni o ti kpe o jɛmbu duu.
en: We have seen crowds marching to your place of worship, our God and King.

dag: Ka Ibram ni daa ti kpe Ijipti, Ijiptinim daa shiri nyaya ka paɣ maa nyɛla paɣ viɛlli.
en: As soon as Abram and Sarai arrived in Egypt, the Egyptians noticed how beautiful she was.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa ti yi Ramɛsis maa n-chaŋ ti dɔni Sukɔt.
en: The people of Israel left Rameses and set up camp at Sukkoth.

dag: Ka Yisifu biɛyanim maa daa ʒini tuhi Yisifu. Ŋun nyɛ bɛ kpɛma n-daa daŋ ʒinibu, ka bɛn paya ʒini tuɣi hal ti paai bɛ biasani, ka di daa gari niriba maa, ka bɛ ŋmaligi lihi taba.
en: Josephs brothers were seated at a table facing him. The brothers were looking at each other because, to their surprise, they had been seated in order, from the oldest to the youngest.

dag: Ka Shɛkɛm ba Hamɔr daa kana ni o ti tɔɣisi Yaakubu di yɛtɔɣa.
en: Hamor arrived at Jacob's home.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma kpe dundombila din be wulimpuhili polo ni nti buɣisi dunɔdali, ka di mini dina la zaa nyɛ yim.
en: The man took me through the east gateway into the inner courtyard. He measured the gateway, and it was the same size as the others.

dag: O chɛ ka bɛ mini nanim ʒiina, nanim bɛn nyɛ o niriba nanima.
en: and he lets them take part in ruling his people.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa ti neerina ka malaikanim maa kpam Lɔt jaande yɛra, Yiɣisim zaŋ a paɣ min a bipuɣins ayi bɛn be a sani ŋɔ n-zo n-yi yaŋɔ, di yi pa lala, yaŋɔnim ni yɛn nya tibidarigibo shɛli maa ni tabili ya.
en: At dawn the angels tried to make Lot hurry. Quick! they said. Take your wife and your two daughters and get out, so that you will not lose your lives when the city is destroyed.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa yɛli Yisa tuumba ayi maa ni bɛ na yim kpaŋ pɔi. Ka jintɔriba maa daa niŋ tab saawara.
en: The Jewish leaders told them to leave the council meeting. Then the leaders talked to each other about what they should do.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ. O kɔŋko n-nyɛ ŋun tumd alahiziba tuma.
en: Praise the Lord , the God of Israel! He alone does these wonderful things.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi maa daa ti zaŋ Simiɔn chaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu. Dindali maa ka Yisifu mini Mariama gba daa zaŋ Yisa chaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni ni bɛ ti niŋ kaman Anabi Musa zaligu ni daa wuhi shɛm la.
en: Led by the Spirit, he went into the temple area. Meanwhile, Jesus parents brought the child to the temple so that they could do what was customary under the Law.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Cham Firawuna sani, dama mani n-chɛ ka o min o kpambaliba zaa suhuri kpɛma ni di chɛ ka n tum alahiziba tuma ŋɔ bɛ sani.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses, Go and see the king. I have made him and his officials stubborn, in order that I may perform these miracles among them.

dag: Di saha ka n daa ŋmaligi lihi ni n nya ŋun yɛli ma lala maa. N ni daa lihi maa, ka n nya salima firilatamdis ayopɔin.
en: I turned to see who was speaking to me, and when I turned, I saw seven oil lamps burning on top of seven gold stands.

dag: Ka Pool yɛl o, N dana, m bi kpɛla yinyari, amaa nimmaŋtali yɛtɔɣa mini yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛra.
en: Paul answered, I am not mad, Your Excellency! I am speaking the sober truth.

dag: Keenan bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Sidɔn ŋun daa nyɛ o bituuli la mini Hɛt.
en: Canaan's oldest son was Sidon; his other son was Heth.

dag: Ka maligumaana ti zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu, ka di leei bɛ ni zaŋdi bindir shɛli nyɔri buɣim tiri Yawɛ.
en: One of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke as a food offering for me.

dag: O yi ti zaŋ o paai yiŋa, o boonila o zɔnim min o ʒiʒiinitab na ti yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka yi suhuri paligi pahi n zuɣu, dama n nya m piɛ so ŋun daa bɔrigi la.
en: and carry it home. Then you will call in your friends and neighbors and say, Let's celebrate! I've found my lost sheep.

dag: Ka o daa lan kpuɣi bɔrɔbɔro n-niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka ŋmahiŋmahi li n-zaŋ ti ba ka yɛli, N niŋgbuŋ m-bala; n niŋgbun shɛli n ni zaŋ pa talima yi zuɣu. Niŋmiya dimbɔŋɔ n-teemi n yɛla.
en: Then he took a piece of bread, gave thanks to God, broke it, and gave it to them, saying, This is my body, which is given for you. Do this in memory of me.

dag: Nyama, a kari ma tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni, ka kari ma a sani; ka n leei ŋun ka kpɛhili shee, ka leei ŋun dari gindi dunia ŋɔ ni, ka ŋunkam ti nya ma ni ku ma.
en: You're making me leave my home and live far from you. I will have to wander about without a home, and just anyone could kill me.

dag: A bidibisi yi ni gbibi n daalikauli maa mini n ni yɛn zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa wuhi ba, bɛ bidibisi gba ni ti ʒiini a nam ʒiishee maa zuɣu sahakam.
en: If they keep our agreement and follow my teachings, then someone in your family will rule forever.

dag: ka ku lan doli Yɛhudianim kurimbuni lahibaya din pa yɛlimaŋli la mini ninsalinim zaligunima din nyɛ bɛn zaɣisi yɛlimaŋli ni zali shɛl la.
en: and they will stop paying attention to the stories told by those Jews. They will stop following the commands of those who have turned away from the truth.

dag: Ka nachimbil so ŋun yuli daa booni Yutikus daa ʒi takɔro zuɣu. Pool ni daa tɔɣisi yuui maa zuɣu ka nachimbil maa daa ti ʒeei gom n-gbihi biligi lu tiŋ ha. Zuɣusaa duu din pah ata ni ka o daa yi n-lu maa ha, ka bɛ daa kpuɣ o la kpima.
en: A young man named Eutychus was sitting in the window, and as Paul kept on talking, Eutychus got sleepier and sleepier, until he finally went sound asleep and fell from the third story to the ground. When they picked him up, he was dead.

dag: Daniɛl daa lo o suhu ni ni o ku di nayili bindirigu maa bee n-nyu wain shɛli naa ni daa nyurila n-saɣim omaŋa; dinzuɣu ka o daa suhi namɔɣilisi kpɛm maa n-yɛl o ni o bi lo ni o saɣim omaŋa nayili bindirigu maa dibu ni, lala zuɣu ni o sɔŋm o.
en: Daniel did not want to eat the kings rich food and wine because it would make him unclean. So he asked Ashpenaz for permission not to make himself unclean in this way.

dag: Ka Musa mini Aduna daa zaŋ bɛ ni boli ninvuɣ shɛb yuya ŋɔ.
en: With the help of these twelve men Moses and Aaron.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa kpe bɛn guli siliga maa pam, ka bɛ ni sɔhira, ka bɛ be kaman kpiimba la.
en: The guards were so terrified of him that they shook with fear and became like dead men.

dag: Tɛhimi n ni yɛli shɛm ŋɔ yɛla, dama ti Duuma ni chɛ ka a baŋ shɛlikam zaa gbinni.
en: Think about what I am saying. The Lord will help you understand it all.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ daa chɛ ka Yawɛ ni daa lo Jɛhu alikauli shɛli yɛli, A bihi ni ti diri Izraɛl nam zaŋ hal ti paai ʒiɛmani din pahir anahi ni la niŋ pali.
en: This was exactly what the LORD spoke to Jehu: Your descendants will sit on Israels throne for four generations. And thats exactly what happened.

dag: ni Taai nanim zaa ni Sidɔn nanim zaa ni teeku duli tiŋgbɔna din nyɛ.
en: all the kings of Tyre and Sidon, and the kings of the coastlands across the sea.

dag: Juda min o mabihi maa ni daa paai Yisifu yiŋa, o daa na be yiŋa, ka bɛ daa damd o tooni.
en: When Judah and his brothers got there, Joseph was still at home. So they bowed down to Joseph.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:.
en: The Lord gave Moses the following regulations.

dag: Bin viɛla kul palila yɛndan yiŋa, amaa jɛrigu ŋun dirila di zaa.
en: Wise people save the nice things they have. Fools use up everything as soon as they get it.

dag: O daa po pɔri n-lo Yaakubu alikauli. O daa lo Izraɛl alikauli din ku vuui.
en: to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

dag: Ka Pita daa gbaai yɛla maa yiniyini n-kahigiri wuhiri ba yɛra:.
en: So Peter explained the whole story to them. He said.

dag: N ni sabi gbaŋ ŋɔ tin ya maa bi wuhi ni yi ʒila yɛlimaŋli, amaa yi ni lee mi li ka baŋ ni ʒiri ka yɛlimaŋli ni la zuɣu.
en: I write you, then, not because you do not know the truth; instead, it is because you do know it, and you also know that no lie ever comes from the truth.

dag: A mini Damaskusnim daa niŋdi daabiligu a nɛma pam min a daazichi ni daa galisi la zuɣu, dina n-nyɛ: Hɛlibɔn wain mini gumdi.
en: For many of your finished products, Damascus traded out of its great wealth the wine of Helbon and white wool.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma nachin kpɛm maa daa yɛli Yisahaku o ni niŋ shɛlikam zaa.
en: The servant told Isaac everything he had done.

dag: Amaa ka Yisahaku biŋkɔbiguliba daa gbi kɔbiliga vinvamli maa ni n-nya kom.
en: Isaacs servants also dug a well near the little river and found fresh water.

dag: Di zuɣu ka m boli ya na ni n ti nyan ya ka m mini ya tɔɣisi, dama Izraɛlnim zaa ni mali tahima shɛl la zuɣu ka bɛ lo ma zoligo ŋɔ.
en: That is why I asked to see you and talk with you. As a matter of fact, I am bound in chains like this for the sake of him for whom the people of Israel hope.

dag: Babilɔnnima n-daa niŋ lala maa; pa Asirianim n-daa zaŋ Taai leei mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri biɛhigu shee. Babilɔnnim n-daa me bimbina din du n-tabili bɛ goma, ka daai Taai birini mini di nayiya luhi; ka di lu n-dahim.
en: Look what the Assyrians have done to Babylonia! They have attacked, destroying every palace in the land. Now wild animals live among the ruins.

dag: Turi maa nyɛla din saɣim n suhu; ka n lan ka tahima. N daa lihi bo nambɔzɔbo, amaa ka bi nya li; ka lihi bo bɛn ni maai n suhu, ka bi nya so.
en: I am crushed by insults, and I feel sick. I had hoped for mercy and pity, but there was none.

dag: Ka nyɔhi daa yi o nyee ni na; ka buɣim niɛm din diri yi o nol ni na; ka sala buɣim niɛm yi o sanna.
en: and breathed out smoke. Scorching heat and fiery flames spewed from your mouth.

dag: Nyamiya o ni daa nyɛ ninvuɣ titali shɛm! Hal ka ti yab Ibrahimma daa yih o ni ŋme tɔbu di shɛlikam pia puuni zaɣ yiniyini ti o.
en: Notice how great Melchizedek was! Our famous ancestor Abraham gave him a tenth of what he had taken from his enemies.

dag: bɔɣili maa lan ni yo samli. Di simdi ka o yo biŋkɔbigu maa lana, ka zaŋ biŋkɔb kpiŋ maa.
en: he must pay for the animal. He is to pay the money to the owner and may keep the dead animal.

dag: Kush daa mali bidib so ka o yuli booni Nimrɔd. Ŋuna n-daa nyɛ tuuli ninvuɣ so ŋun mali yaa pam dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Cush had a son named Nimrod, who became the world's first great conqueror.

dag: Di saha kokpɛɣu daa naan ʒi ti chaŋ; kopaliga daa naan du ti gari.
en: then the flood would have carried us away, the water would have covered us.

dag: m-pahi daabihi mini kɔhigɔriba ni daa yɔr o farigu shɛli zuɣu. Ka Areebia nanim zaa mini tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni gomnanim zaa daa ʒiri salima mini anzinfa na ti tiri Sulemaana.
en: not counting what the merchants and traders brought him. The kings of Arabia and the leaders of Israel also gave him gold and silver.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zaŋ li lee kali ni zaligu Izraɛlnim zaa sani, ka bɛ dol li hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: David made this a law for Israel, and it has been the same ever since.

dag: Piɛbimiya kikaa Ziɔn puuni. Ŋmɛmiya kuŋa n zoli din be kasi la zuɣu. Bɛnkam zaa be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, chɛliya ka yi ni sɔhira! Dama Yawɛ dabisili la kanna, hal di miriya.
en: Blow the trumpet on Zion. Shout a warning on my holy mountain. Let all the people who live in the land shake with fear. The Lord s special day is coming; it is near.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd daa tim ti gbaai Jɔn na ti kpɛhi duu, ŋun Hɛrɔd ni daa fa omaŋmaŋ tizo Filip paɣ Hɛrɔdias niŋ o paɣa la zuɣu.
en: Herod himself had ordered John's arrest, and he had him tied up and put in prison. Herod did this because of Herodias, whom he had married, even though she was the wife of his brother Philip.

dag: Gomna Pailɛt ni daa wum ni Yisa pun kpi maa ka di gar o pam, ka o daa boli sapashin la na nti bɔh o ni Yisa shiri kpiya?.
en: Pilate was surprised to hear that Jesus was already dead. So he called for the army officer in charge and asked him if Jesus was already dead.

dag: Nyama, ninvuɣ biɛri suhupiɛlli soya m-bala, ka bɛ yi yi dunia yili, shɛb ni kana ti zani bɛ zaani.
en: their life slips away, and other plants grow there.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ŋɔ daa zaŋ o niŋ Siria naa nuu ni, ka bɛ daa tuhi nyaŋ o, ka gbah o niriba pam n-zaŋ ba kuli Damaskus. Naawuni daa lan zaŋ o niŋ Izraɛl naa nuu ni, ka o gba tuhi nyaŋ o, ka ku o niriba pam.
en: So the LORD his God handed him over to Arams king, who defeated him and carried off many prisoners, bringing them to Damascus. Ahaz was also handed over to Israels king, who defeated him with a severe beating.

dag: Ti ba daa kpila mɔɣu la ni. O daa ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa laɣim pahi Kɔra zuɣu taai duŋ niŋ Yawɛ la kalinli ni, amaa omaŋmaŋ daalahichi zuɣu ka o daa kpi; ka mi ka bidibisi.
en: You know that our father died in the desert. But it was for something he did wrong, not for joining with Korah in rebelling against the Lord . Our father left no sons.

dag: Ka Hamɔr daa yɛl o, M bia Shɛkɛm bɔr a bipuɣiŋga, n suhir a, zaŋm o ti o ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: Hamor said to them, My son Shechems heart is set on your daughter. Please let him marry her.

dag: ni m mini ya ti laɣim ʒini n nam ʒiishee n-diri ka nyura, ka yi ti ʒini nam kuɣisi zuɣu n-kari Izraɛl zuliya pinaayi la saria.
en: Thus you will eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and you will sit on thrones overseeing the twelve tribes of Israel.

dag: Musa daa lan zali niriba maa zaligu dindali maa yɛli:.
en: That same day, Moses gave them the following instructions:.

dag: Dama Naawuni daa na ʒi n-yɛl o malaikanim ni so: A nyɛla m Bia; zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka n leeg a Ba. Naawuni mi daa bi yɛli malaika so: Man Naawuni ni leeg a Ba, ka a mi leegi m Bia.
en: For God never said to any of his angels, You are my Son; today I have become your Father. Nor did God say about any angel, I will be his Father, and he will be my Son.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun bi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa yiriŋ nyɛla ŋun mali baŋsim, ka ninvuɣ so ŋun mali suɣilo nyɛ ŋun mali tɛhi zilima.
en: Those who are sure of themselves do not talk all the time. People who stay calm have real insight.

dag: Yi yuri yɛtɔɣ biɛri tɔɣisibu; ka ŋmari ʒiri.
en: You set your mouth free to do evil, then harness your tongue to tell lies.

dag: Bɔbu saha beni, ka kɔŋbu saha beni. Gbibbu saha beni, ka zaŋ bahi saha beni.
en: There is a time for finding and losing, keeping and giving.

dag: Musa daa yɛli ba, Gaad zuliya mini Rubin zuliya bɛn zaa lo kpara ni bɛ chaŋ tɔbu ni Yawɛ ninni ŋɔ, yi doli ya gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ du, ka yi ti tuhi deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa, dindina yin zaŋmiya Giliad tiŋgbɔŋ ti ba ka bɛ su li.
en: Make sure that the tribes of Gad and Reuben prepare for battle and cross the Jordan River with you. If they do, then after the land is in your control, give them the region of Gilead as their tribal land.

dag: Hal nandaamba ʒiʒiinitab je ba, amaa bundaannim bɛn mali zɔnim pam.
en: The poor have no friends, not even their neighbors, but the rich have many friends.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa nim daa yina ka bɛ mini Jɔab ti zaŋ nya taba, ka Dauda tɔbbihi maa shɛb daa lu nimaani, ka bɛ daa ku Yuria ŋun nyɛ Hiti nir la gba nimaani.
en: The enemy troops came out of the city and fought Joab's forces; some of David's officers were killed, and so was Uriah.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Izraɛlnima, ŋmaligimiya lab yi ni yi man so nyaaŋa pam la sanna.
en: People of Israel, you should come back to the God you turned away from.

dag: amaa paɣ kam ŋun suhiri Naawuni bee n-tɔɣisir anabitali yɛtɔɣa, ka bi zaŋ bini pil o zuɣu ʒiɛmdila o zuɣu, ka di bemi kaman o pin la o zuɣu maa la.
en: Every woman who prays or prophesies with her head uncovered disgraces her head. It is the same thing as having her head shaved.

dag: Yi ni ti lan niŋ lala goli maa daba ayopɔin dali n-ti ŋunkam tum alahichi o chirimbu puuni bee o ʒilinsi puuni din ni chɛ ka yi mali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ka di niŋ kasi.
en: You will do the same thing on the seventh day of that month for anyone who has sinned by mistake or without knowing it. So you will make the Temple pure.

dag: Ka Abija min o tɔbbihi maa daa ku ba pam, ka bɛ ni daa ku Izraɛlnim maa ninvuɣ shɛb daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biinsi tuhi kɔbisinu.
en: Abijahs army greatly defeated the army of Israel, and , of the best men of Israel were killed.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Hashimɔna maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Mɔsɛrɔt.
en: They marched from Hashmonah and camped at Moseroth.

dag: Nyama, n dabili ni tɔŋ. Bɛ ni duh o, ka ti o jilima pam.
en: The Lord says, Look, my servant will succeed in what he has to do, and he will be raised to a position of high honor.

dag: Ka bɛ yi ti yɛl ti, Guhimiya hal ka ti ti ka yi sanna, di saha ti ni kpalim ʒe nimaani ka ku lan chaŋ bɛ sani.
en: If they say to us, Stay there until we come to you, we will stay where we are. We wont go up to them.

dag: Bɛ tizɔpaɣiba n-daa nyɛ: Zɛruya mini Abigeel. Zɛruya bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Abishai mini Jɔab ni Asahɛl. Bɛ daa nyɛla niriba ata.
en: Their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. Zeruiahs three sons were Abishai, Joab, and Asahel.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ piɛla yino m-pahi kpam lita pirigibu ʒiibuta yim la zuɣu m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara, ka zaŋ li gahigahi, ka di leei bɛ ni zaŋ sara shɛli gahigahi Yawɛ tooni.
en: The priest will take one of the male sheep and present it as a compensation offering, along with the log of oil, and will lift them as an uplifted offering before the LORD.

dag: Juda nanim ŋmanila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn sɔɣi vuɣi tintariga kpahi. N suhuyiɣisili ni ti lu bɛ zuɣu kaman saa la.
en: The leaders of Judah are like thieves trying to steal someones property, so I will pour out my anger on them like water.

dag: Piɛgul shɛb daa be tiŋ maa ni mɔɣu ni gul bɛ piɛri yuŋ.
en: There were some shepherds in that part of the country who were spending the night in the fields, taking care of their flocks.

dag: Dama yi ni so yi yɛli, Man dolila Pool; ka so mi yɛli, N dolila Apolɔs; di yi nyɛ lala, yi gba bi bemi kaman dunianima?.
en: When one of you says, I follow Paul, and another, I follow Apollos—aren't you acting like worldly people?.

dag: Dama Naawuni yuri dunianim hal ti zaŋ o Bi gaŋa ti ba ni ŋunkam niŋ o yɛda ti ku bahi yoli, amaa o ni ti nyala nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: God loved the people of this world so much that he gave his only Son, so that everyone who has faith in him will have eternal life and never really die.

dag: Ka Pita daa gbaag o nuu ni yiɣis o zali ka yɛl o, Yiɣisima! Man gba kul nyɛla ninsala kaman nyin la.
en: But Peter took hold of him and said, Stand up! I am nothing more than a human.

dag: N niriba ni wuhi ni yi yuli leela noli n-din ya, ka man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni chɛ ka yi kpi, amaa n ni ti n niriba maa yuli din nyɛ zaɣ palli.
en: I, the Lord God, promise to see that you are killed and that my chosen servants use your names as curse words. But I will give new names to my servants.

dag: Nimrim kulibɔŋ nyuuya zaa, ka di duli mɔri kuui, ka momahili lan ka nimaani yaha.
en: But Nimrim Brook is as dry as a desert. The grass has dried up, and the plants are all dead. Nothing is green.

dag: Amaa yi yi ku niŋ lala, dindina yi tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka biɛhiŋ kani, yi daalahichi maa ku chɛn ya.
en: But if you dont do these things, you will be sinning against the Lord . And know for sure that you will be punished for your sin.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa yɛli, M Ba Naawuni, nyin ŋun su alizanda mini dunia ŋɔ, m paɣir a, dama a zaŋ dimbɔŋɔnima n-sɔɣi yɛnnim mini baŋdiba, ka lee kahigi li wuhila biliɛri;.
en: At that time Jesus said, Father, Lord of heaven and earth! I thank you because you have shown to the unlearned what you have hidden from the wise and learned.

dag: O daa buɣisi li la di luɣa anahi zuɣu. Bɛ daa mɛla gooni gil li, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita kɔbisiyi ni pihinu, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita kɔbisiyi ni pihinu, ka di woligi din be kasi ka chɛ din bi be kasi.
en: and so the temple area was a perfect square. The wall around this area separated what was sacred from what was ordinary.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ suhuyini n-gbib ba, ka daa doli yɛm soli wuhi ba din tuhi.
en: David shepherded them with a heart of integrity; he led them with the skill of his hands.

dag: Ka Shɛkɛm ba Hamɔr daa kana ni o ti tɔɣisi Yaakubu di yɛtɔɣa.
en: Meanwhile, Hamor, Shechems father, went out to Jacob to speak with him.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrimia daa chaŋ Ahikam bia Gɛdalia sani Mizipa nti be o sani pahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zuɣu.
en: Jeremiah went to Gedaliah, Ahikams son at Mizpah, and he stayed with him and the people who remained in the land.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, dim n ni zaŋ binshɛli ti a maa, ŋubimi gbaŋ maa ka chaŋ ti tɔɣisi Izraɛlnim yɛtɔɣa.
en: God said to me, Son of man, eat what you see. Eat this scroll, and then go tell these things to the family of Israel.

dag: Ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka tin ya suhudoo!.
en: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Di yi nyɛla yaa, ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun mali yaa. Di yi nyɛla din tuhi dolibu, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi tah o ʒiishee?.
en: I cannot defeat God. He is too powerful! I cannot take him to court for justice. Who could force him to come?.

dag: Napɔŋ buta ka n kani yi sanna pahiri ŋɔ. So taali nyabu kam ni, di simdi ni niriba ayi bee ata n-di shɛhira.
en: I am on my way to visit you for the third time. And as the Scriptures say, Any charges must be proved true by at least two or three witnesses.

dag: Isaka zuliya ni, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa mi di ni simdi ni Izraɛlnim niŋ shɛm ni saha shɛli di ni simdi ni bɛ niŋ li daa nyɛla zuɣulaannim kɔbisiyi mini bɛ dɔɣiriba bɛn daa be bɛ sulinsi ni.
en: From the family of Issachar there were wise leaders. These men understood the right thing for Israel to do at the right time. Their relatives were with them and under their command.

dag: Yawɛ malaika maa ni daa chaŋ ka chɛ Manɔa min o paɣ saha shɛli maa, ka bɛ daa baŋ ni Yawɛ malaika m-bala.
en: The LORDs messenger didnt reappear to Manoah or his wife, and Manoah then realized that it had been the LORDs messenger.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa kpuɣ o zuɣu ŋmaligi lihi n-nya piɛlaa ka o ʒiɛya, ka o yila shɛbi tiwula ni. Ka Ibrahimma daa chaŋ ti gbaai piɛlaa maa na nti zaŋ o mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la, ka chɛ o bia maa.
en: Abraham looked around and saw a ram caught in a bush by its horns. He went and got it and offered it as a burnt offering instead of his son.

dag: Hɛzɛkia daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani kaman o yab Naa Dauda ni daa niŋ shɛm la.
en: Hezekiah obeyed the Lord , just as his ancestor David had done.

dag: Ka Dauda daa po lala pɔri maa Sool sani. Di saha ka Sool daa kuli, ka Dauda min o niriba maa mi labi bɛ sɔɣisili maa shee.
en: So David promised, and Saul went home. David and his men returned to their hideout.

dag: Ka Pool garigi yɛl o, N nyɛla Yɛhudia nira, ka nyɛ Taasus din be Kilikia tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka bi pɔri la tiŋbia. Ka lan yɛl o, N suhir a noli ni a chɛ ka n tɔɣisi niriba ŋɔ yɛtɔɣa. .
en: Paul said, No, I am a Jew from Tarsus in the country of Cilicia. I am a citizen of that important city. Please, let me speak to the people.

dag: Ka malaika maa yɛli, Paɣ ŋɔ nyɛla tuumbiɛri kɔtomsi. Ka o daa dihi paɣ maa ʒili piɛɣu maa ni ka zaŋ di liŋ maa pil li.
en: He said, This is wickedness. He shoved her back into the basket, and he put the lead stone over its opening.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Gaad ŋun daa nyɛ Dauda daanab la.
en: The LORD told Gad, Davids seer.

dag: Ka o daa ŋmaligi yɛli sapashin maa, Kulima! A ni niŋ yɛda shɛm maa zuɣu, di ni niŋ lala. Ka o yiŋbia maa daa shiri kpaŋ di saha maa.
en: Then Jesus said to the officer, You may go home now. Your faith has made it happen. Right then his servant was healed.

dag: N suhu yiɣisiya pam bahi tinzunnim bɛn yi su n niriba maa zuɣu. N ni darigi bɛ tibili. Judanim nyɛla n niriba, ka man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni gbib ba. Bɛna n-yɛn nyɛ n tɔbutuhiri yuri bɛn mali yiko pam.
en: The Lord says, I am angry with those foreigners who rule my people, and I am going to punish them. The people of Judah are mine, and I, the Lord Almighty, will take care of them. They will be my powerful war-horses.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri ni zɔri shɛli dina m-paari ba, amaa wuntizɔriba nyarila bɛ ni bɔri shɛli.
en: The wicked will be defeated by what they fear, but good people will get what they want.

dag: ti yɛl o, A bi mi ni Ammɔnnim naa Baalis timla Nɛtania bia Ishimail na ni o ti ku a? Amaa ka Ahikam bia Gɛdalia daa bi niŋ ba yɛda.
en: Johanan and the officers with him said to Gedaliah, Do you know that Baalis, the king of the Ammonites, wants to kill you? He has sent Ishmael son of Nethaniah to kill you. But Gedaliah son of Ahikam didnt believe them.

dag: Sagbana yi ti pali kom, saa lurimina, ka tia yi lu n-kpala nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo, di ni lu luɣ shɛli maa, nimaani ka di yɛn doya.
en: If clouds fill up, they will empty out rain on the earth. If a tree falls, whether to the south or to the north, wherever it falls, there it will lie.

dag: Nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ni Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun ʒi Chɛrubinim zuɣusaa ŋɔ, a kɔŋko n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun su dunia ŋɔ nama zaa fukumsi. Nyini n-nam tiŋgbani mini zuɣusaa.
en: Lord God All-Powerful of Israel, your throne is above the winged creatures. You created the heavens and the earth, and you alone rule the kingdoms of this world.

dag: Di simdi ni yi puhiri bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi maa chuɣu, dama dindali maa ka n daa yihi yi zuliya maa gbilligbilli Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Dinzuɣu di simdi ka yi gbibi dabisili maa yi ʒiɛmani kam ni ka di nyɛ zaligu sahakam.
en: Keep this festival, because it was on this day that I brought your tribes out of Egypt. For all time to come you must celebrate this day as a festival.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai Kapɛrinium ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu tɔto deeriba kana ti bɔhi Pita, A karimba ŋɔ bi tɔhiri Naawuni jɛmbu duu tɔto la.
en: Jesus and his followers went to Capernaum. There the men who collect the two-drachma Temple tax came to Peter and asked, Does your teacher pay the Temple tax.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa boli Yisifu yuli Zafɛnatipania, ka zaŋ Pɔtifɛra ŋun daa nyɛ Hɛliopolis tindan la bipuɣiŋga Asɛnat n-ti Yisifu ni o niŋ o paɣa. Ka Yisifu daa yiri chani gindi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa.
en: He gave Joseph the Egyptian name Zaphenath Paneah. And he let him marry Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera, a priest in the city of Heliopolis. Joseph traveled all over Egypt.

dag: Di lan sabi: Bɛn pa Yɛhudianima, maliya suhupiɛlli pah o niriba zuɣu.
en: Again it says, Rejoice, Gentiles, with God's people.

dag: Shɔbal bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Alivan mini Manahat ni Ɛbal ni Shɛfo ni Onam.
en: Shobal was the ancestor of the clans of Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.

dag: N ni zaŋ yi bidibisi mini yi bipuɣinsi n-kɔhi Judanim zuɣu; ka bɛ mi zaŋ ba kɔhi Sabinim bɛn nyɛ zuliya shɛb bɛn be katiŋ la nim zuɣu. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will sell your sons and daughters to the people of Judah. Then they will sell them to the faraway Sabeans. This is what the Lord said.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Di ŋumdiya yi kparima ni.
en: Jesus responded, Dont grumble among yourselves.

dag: Ka Yisa lan bɔhi ba, Yi tɛhiya ni wula ka tihi puu maa lana lee yɛn niŋ? O ni kana nti ku padiriba maa ka zaŋ o tihi puu maa niŋ padir shɛb nuu ni.
en: So what will the man who owns the vineyard do? He will go and kill those farmers. Then he will lease the land to others.

dag: Bɛ maanila niriba ansarisi ka tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri; bɛ nyɛla karimbaannim bɛn lɔri niriba nahiŋgu nia biɛri.
en: They sneer and say cruel things, and because of their pride, they make violent threats.

dag: Ka nudirigu polo tintariga mi kpuɣi Kiriatijiarim tintariga n-zaŋ hal ti paai Ɛfurɔn m-mali hal ti paai Nɛfitɔa kulibɔŋ ni.
en: The south side ran from the limits of Kiriath-jearim. The border went out westward. It then proceeded to the waters of Nephtoah Spring.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa tir o ba min o yiŋnim zaa ni o biɛyanim maa bindira n-saɣisiri bɛ ni daa su ninvuɣ shɛb kalinli tariga.
en: Joseph also gave his father, his brothers, and all their people the food they needed.

dag: Niriba pam yɛr ni bɛ nyɛla bɛn ʒe yim, amaa bɛ ni ŋuni n-lee nyɛ nir ni yɛn dihi so tabili?.
en: There are many who say, You can trust me! But can they be trusted?.

dag: Yi ni yɛn ti Lɛvinim tin shɛŋa zaa kalinli nyɛla tinsi pihinuayika ni bɛ biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: so they will have a total of towns with their surrounding pastures.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, N yi ti ŋmaai bɔrɔbɔro suɣ ʒiɛri n-zaŋ ti so, ŋuna m-bala. Ka daa ŋmaai bɔrɔbɔro suɣ ʒiɛri n-zaŋ ti Judas ŋun daa nyɛ Saimɔn Isikariɔt bia la.
en: Jesus answered him, I will dip this bread into the dish. The man I give it to is the one. So Jesus took a piece of bread, dipped it, and gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.

dag: N yi kpi n-do gballi ni, nyɔ bɔ ka n kum maa lee yɛn ti a? Taŋkpaɣu ni tooi paɣ a? Di ni tooi yɛl a ʒiɛyimtali yɛla?.
en: What is to be gained by my spilled blood, by my going down into the pit? Does dust thank you? Does it proclaim your faithfulness?.

dag: N daa lihiya n-nya ka so kani, ka noonsi zaa yiɣi.
en: I looked, but there were no people. All the birds of the sky had flown away.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba, Yinima n-nyɛ bɛn be n sani n wahala dibu ni hal ni pɔŋɔ;.
en: You have stayed with me all through my trials;.

dag: O niŋdila o yidana din viɛla o biɛhigu ni zaa, ka pa ni zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: She is good to him every day of her life.

dag: Yɛm shɛli kani, tɛhi zilima shɛli kani, saawara shɛli mi kani din ni tooi nyaŋ Yawɛ.
en: No matter how much you know or what plans you make, you can't defeat the Lord .

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan yɛli, Kom din be foliŋga tiŋli ŋɔ laɣimmi dɔni luɣ yini, ka chɛ ka tiŋgban kuŋ yi n-dɔni. Ka di daa shiri niŋ lala.
en: God said, I command the water under the sky to come together in one place, so there will be dry ground. And that's what happened.

dag: Ibrahimma yuma daa nyɛla yuun kɔbigayinika saha shɛl o ni daa guni;.
en: Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised.

dag: Ka o daa ka naa Ɛhab sanna, ka naa bɔhi, Mikaya, ti cham ti tuhi Ramɔtigiliadnim bee ti di chaŋ? Ka o daa garigi yɛl o, Chamiya, yi ni nya nasara, Naawuni ni zaŋ ba niŋ yi nuu ni.
en: When Micaiah arrived, the king asked him, Micaiah, should we go to war with Ramoth-gilead or not? Attack and win! Micaiah answered. The LORD will hand it over to the king.

dag: Keenan bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Sidɔn ŋun daa nyɛ o bituuli la mini Hɛt.
en: Canaan was the father of Sidon. Sidon was his first child. Canaan was also the father of the Hittites.

dag: Daadam, yɛlim Ijipti naa Firawuna min o niriba zaa: A galisim lee ŋmanila ŋuni?.
en: Mortal man, he said, say to the king of Egypt and all his people: How powerful you are! What can I compare you to?.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia daa ŋmalig o nini bahi dukpini polo n-suhi Yawɛ yɛli:.
en: Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed:.

dag: Bɛ wala ni ka yi ni baŋ ba. Yi na mi n-nya ka goo wali gaya bee ka pirinkpaŋ wali fiig tia wala?.
en: You will know them by their fruit. Do people get bunches of grapes from thorny weeds, or do they get figs from thistles?.

dag: Miri ka a chɛ ka a kɔre kpe o viɛlim ni a suhu ni, ka miri ka a chɛ ka o gbaag a o nina ni lihiri shɛm puuni.
en: Don't be tempted by their beauty; don't be trapped by their flirting eyes.

dag: Babilɔn bipuɣiŋga, a ni nya tibidarigibo, a ni daa niŋ ti shɛm la zuɣu. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ti yɛn bɔh a biɛri ni ti mali suhupiɛlli!.
en: Daughter Babylon, you destroyer, a blessing on the one who pays you back the very deed you did to us!.

dag: N niriba bɛn suhiri ma, ka wurim be Itiɔpia mɔɣa duya la ni ti zaŋ pina na ti ti ma.
en: From beyond the rivers of Cush, my daughter, my dispersed ones, will bring me offerings.

dag: N dimnim kul karitimi doli ma. Bɛ loya ni bɛ di n nyɛvili. Bɛ chɛ ka n ʒila zibisim ni kaman bɛn pun kpi la.
en: The enemy is chasing me, crushing my life in the dirt, forcing me to live in the dark like those whove been dead forever.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ sapashin kpamba mini ninvuɣ zuɣuri ni gomnanima ni tiŋgbani maa ni niriba zaa ka bɛ chaŋ ti zaŋ naa maa Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni yi n-doli zuɣusaa polo dunol la n-kuni nayili. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ naa maa ʒili nayili nam ʒiishee.
en: Then he took the unit commanders, the officials, the rulers of the people, and all the people of the land, and they led the king down from the LORDs temple, processing through the Upper Gate to the palace, where the king sat upon the royal throne.

dag: Ka bɛ daa bi baŋ o ni yɛli ba shɛm maa gbinni.
en: But they did not understand what he meant.

dag: nti zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ti ba, a ni daa lo bɛ yaannim alikauli ni a ni zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli din mali atam mini anfaani ti ba la.
en: You gave the Israelites this land that you promised to give to their ancestors long ago. It is a very good land filled with many good things.

dag: ni Ɛlifɛlɛt ŋun daa nyɛ Ahasibai Maaka nir la bia ni Iliam ŋun daa nyɛ Ahitɔfɛl Gilo nir la bia.
en: Eliphelet son of Ahasbai the Maacathite; Eliam son of Ahithophel the Gilonite;.

dag: Bɛ ni ŋuni n-lee bi mi ni Naawuni nuu n-tum tuuni ŋɔ?.
en: All of them know that the Lord 's hand made them.

dag: Bɛ ni ŋuni n-lee bi mi ni Naawuni nuu n-tum tuuni ŋɔ?.
en: Among all these, who hasnt known that the LORDs hand did this?.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kpaai bɛ kawana, bɛ zaa liɣiri daa lɔnlomi be bɛ kpalansi ni, bɛ mini bɛ ba ni daa nya liɣiri maa, ka di gari ba.
en: When they opened their sacks, each man found a pouch of his silver in his sack. When they and their father saw their pouches of silver, they were afraid.

dag: Nir yi zaŋ zaɣ biɛɣu yo zaɣ viɛlli samli, zaɣ biɛɣu ku milig o yiŋa.
en: If you do wrong to those who were good to you, you will have trouble the rest of your life.

dag: Ka Musa daa teeg o nuu tiri teeku maa, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka pɔhim kpiɔŋ yi wulimpuhili polo na nti ʒe teeku maa kom labisi nyaaŋa yuŋ maa zaa m-pirigi li buyi ka chɛ tiŋ kuŋ.
en: Moses stretched his arm over the sea, and the Lord sent a strong east wind that blew all night until there was dry land where the water had been. The sea opened up.

dag: Saha shɛli ha a daa kana ti tum tuun shɛŋa din mali dabiɛm pam, ka ti bi tɛhi ni a ni niŋ lala, ka zoya daa sɔhig a tooni.
en: But you have done awesome things that we did not expect. You came down, and mountains shook in fear before you.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi yurilim nyɛ yurilim maŋli. Di niŋ kamaata ni yi je din bie, ka gbibiya din viɛli kirikiri.
en: Love must be completely sincere. Hate what is evil, hold on to what is good.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ ŋma dakuɣiri maa pam ti ma, dama n ni yɛn me du shɛli maa ni galisi pam ka viɛla.
en: I will need lots of wood because the Temple I am building will be very large and beautiful.

dag: Ti ni tooi paɣi Naawuni yi zuɣu pumpɔŋɔ. Ti paɣir o ti ni mali suhupiɛl shɛli yi zuɣu ŋun ti Duuma Naawuni san la zuɣu.
en: How can we thank God enough for you, given all the joy we have because of you before our God?.

dag: Siria Naa Hazaɛl daa kul nahindila Izraɛlnima Naa Jɛhɔahaz ʒiɛman ni zaa.
en: King Hazael of Syria oppressed the Israelites during all of Jehoahaz' reign.

dag: Ka di wulinluhili polo daa mali pateesanim din wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pisinaayi, ka mali daantalisi pia ni di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu pia, ka daantalisi maa bansi mini di mihi la daa nyɛ anzinfa.
en: On the west side the drapes stretched seventy-five feet, with their ten posts, their ten bases, and silver hooks and bands for the posts.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya su tɔbbi shɛb bɛ ni daa booni Chɛrɛtinim mini Pɛlɛtinim la fukumsi. Ka Dauda bidibisi gba daa nyɛ maligumaaniba.
en: Jehoiadas son Benaiah was in command of the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and Davids sons were priests.

dag: Ka Pita daa bol o yi kpaŋa nti kpahir o zuɣu ni yɛra, N Duuma, Naawuni tiligim ti! Di ku niŋ a lala.
en: Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him. God forbid it, Lord! he said. That must never happen to you.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa tiligi tɔb ni la daa nya nambɔzɔbo tiŋgban nɛl la ni. Izraɛlnim ni daa bɔri vuhim shee la.
en: This is what the Lord says: The people who escaped the enemys sword will find comfort in the desert. Israel will go there looking for rest.

dag: ni o chɛ ka binshɛɣukam mali zani dɛde daadam mini Naawuni sani kaman nir min o ʒiʒiinikpee la.
en: He speaks to God for me, like someone presenting an argument for a friend.

dag: Jɛrigu n-zaɣisir o ba ni wuh o shɛli, amaa ŋunkam deeri saɣisigu nyɛla ŋun mali yɛm.
en: A fool doesnt like a fathers instruction, but those who heed correction are mature.

dag: N daa kuhi boli Yawɛ n nandahima puuni. N Naawuni ka n daa boli maa. Ka o daa be o jɛmbu duu puuni ka wum n kukoli; ka n kuhigu maa daa lu o tiba ni.
en: I was in terrible trouble when I called out to you, but from your temple you heard me and answered my prayer.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ n shɛhiralana ni di nyɛla yi fa m-bahi zuɣu ka n daa chɛ Kɔrinti kandina.
en: I tell you this, and I ask God to be my witness that this is true: The reason I did not come back to Corinth was that I did not want to punish or hurt you.

dag: Ka Nɛbukadnɛza daa bɔhi ba, Shadirak mini Mɛshak ni Abɛdnɛgo, di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni yi shiri zaɣisi n wun la mini n ni mali salima binnan shɛli zal la jɛmbu?.
en: And Nebuchadnezzar said to them, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, is it true that you dont worship my gods? And is it true that you didnt bow down and worship the gold idol I have set up?.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun galisi ka be zuɣusaa. O chɛ ka yɛlimaŋli mini wuntitali be Jɛrusalɛm.
en: The LORD is exalted; he lives on high, filling Zion with justice and righteousness.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yinima n-nyɛ n shɛhiranima, ka nyɛ n ni pii n dab shɛba ni di chɛ ka yi baŋ ka niŋ ma yɛda. Ka lan baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Naawuni. Naawuni so ka n tooni, ka so mi ka n nyaaŋa.
en: My people, you are my witnesses and my chosen servant. I want you to know me, to trust me, and understand that I alone am God. I have always been God; there can be no others.

dag: Ka Nuhu daa niŋ Yawɛ ni yɛl o ni o niŋ shɛm maa zaa.
en: Noah did everything the LORD commanded him.

dag: ka zaŋ firilanim la tamtam di zuɣu Yawɛ tooni kaman Yawɛ ni daa wuh o shɛm.
en: He set up the lamps in the LORDs presence, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

dag: Saha shɛli paɣiba ni siɣiri kuliga zaawuni ka o daa chɛ ka laakumnim maa gbani tiŋ tariga kɔbiliga gbini.
en: He had the camels kneel down outside the city at the well in the evening, when women come out to draw water.

dag: Amaa ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba daa bi kari Jɛbusinim bɛn daa be Jɛrusalɛm la, dina n-chɛ ka Jɛbusinim mini Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa na kul laɣim be Jɛrusalɛm hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: The Jebusites were living in Jerusalem, and the Benjamin tribe did not defeat them or capture the town. That's why Jebusites still live in Jerusalem along with the people of Benjamin.

dag: N lihila a daalikauli soli hal ka n nina ti fulim; ka m bɔhira, Ka bɔ saha ka a yɛn kpaŋsi n suhu.
en: My eyes are worn out looking for your word. When will you comfort me? I ask.

dag: ka fara lir a kaman tayiɣ la, ka kum lu a zuɣu kaman tɔbbi so ŋun lo kpara la.
en: these things will make you poor very quickly. Soon you will have nothing, as if a thief broke in and took everything away.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, N gba ni bɔhi ya bɔhigu ka yi garigi ma.
en: He replied, I have a question for you. Tell me.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ bɛ paɣiba gba: Di niŋ kamaata ni bɛ gba mali biɛrisuŋ, ka pa ni bɛn nyɛ munaafichinima, amaa di simdi ni bɛ gbib bɛmaŋa ka ʒe yim binshɛɣukam puuni.
en: In the same way, the women must have the respect of others. They must not be women who speak evil about other people. They must have self-control and be women who can be trusted in everything.

dag: M bɔhiri ya, Masia pirigimi ʒii bu shɛm? Pool ka bɛ daa zaŋ kpahi tabili dapulli yi zuɣu la? Bee Pool yuli ka bɛ daa zaŋ baptaizi ya?.
en: Christ cannot be divided into different groups. It wasnt Paul who died on the cross for you, was it? Were you baptized in Pauls name?.

dag: A niŋ amaŋ naani a tuumbiɛri tumbu ni, ka tɛhi ni so bi nya a. A yɛm min a baŋsim m-birig a, ka a yɛri a suhu ni, Mani, ka so kani pahi n zuɣu.
en: You do bad things but still feel safe. You say to yourself, No one sees the wrong I do. You thought that your wisdom and knowledge would save you. You tell yourself, I alone am important, and no one else matters.

dag: Dama dunia ŋɔ nanim lo tɔbu, ka nazuɣuri laɣim n-zaɣisi ti Duuma Naawuni min o Masia.
en: The kings of earth prepare for war, and the rulers join together against the Lord and his Messiah.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ yɛliya, Biɛhiŋ kani, dabisa kanna ka yi ti ku lan po n-yɛli Yawɛ ŋun be ka nyɛ ŋun daa yihi Izraɛlnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ŋɔ zuɣu. .
en: The Lord says, The time is coming when people will no longer swear by me as the living God who brought the people of Israel out of the land of Egypt.

dag: N niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ leela zaɣ sabinli ŋ-ŋmaari lura, ka tulim diri n kɔba.
en: My skin is so parched, that it peels right off, and my bones are burning.

dag: Di saha ka so daa kana ti yɛli ba, Yi ni sa kpɛhi ninvuɣ shɛb duu la be Naawuni jɛmbu duu wuhiri niriba.
en: Then a man came in and said to them, Listen! The men you put in prison are in the Temple teaching the people.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nyɛ tumtumdiba maa ni tuumbaŋdiba zaa daa zaŋ tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli tan tolima pia mali Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa; ka zaŋ gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain n-chɛ ka tuumbaŋda zaŋ li wuɣi.
en: The skilled workers got together to make the sacred tent and its linen curtains that were woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered with figures of winged creatures. Each of the ten panels was twelve meters long and two meters wide.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Tahat maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Tɛra.
en: They marched from Tahath and camped at Terah.

dag: Dinzuɣu di chɛliya ka so zaŋ salinim ni ni tooi niŋ shɛli nyuri bara, dama binshɛɣukam nyɛla yi dini.
en: So stop bragging about what anyone has done. Paul and Apollos and Peter all belong to you. In fact, everything is yours, including the world, life, death, the present, and the future. Everything belongs to you.

dag: Ka naa maa daa bo tɔbbihi zuɣulaannim mini tɔbbi wɔribariba pa n zuɣu, ka n daa lu soli m-mali hal ti paai Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli yaɣili polo maa gomnanim sani n-daa zaŋ naa gbana maa ti ba.
en: So I went to the governors of the area west of the Euphrates River and gave them the letters from the king. The king had also sent army officers and soldiers on horses with me.

dag: dama m mabih anu na beni, ka o chaŋ ti lee saɣisi bɛna, ka bɛn ti ku kana ti kpe azaaba shɛl ni n ni be ŋɔ.
en: I have five brothers. He could warn my brothers so that they will not come to this place of pain.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun gbibi tɔbu ti ku tooi zani, ka ŋun tooi zɔri pam ti ku tooi tilig omaŋa, ka wɔribara gba ti ku tooi tilig omaŋa.
en: Even if you are an expert with a bow and arrow, you will retreat. And you won't get away alive, not even if you run fast or ride a horse.

dag: Nyamiya, biŋkura la zaa gariya; pumpɔŋɔ bimpala yɛla ka n yɛra. N yɛn daŋmi yɛli ya di yɛla pɔi, ka di naanyi kana.
en: Everything has happened just as I said it would; now I will announce what will happen next.

dag: amaa bɛ ni ti yɛrimi, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be, ka nyɛ ŋun daa yihi Izraɛlnim o ni daa kari ba tahi nuzaa polo tin shɛŋa zaa ni la zuɣu. Di saha bɛ ni ti be bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: But people will say something new: As surely as the Lord lives, the one who brought the Israelites out of the land of the north and out of all the countries where he had sent them .... Then the people of Israel will live in their own land.

dag: Amaa nyin Izraɛl ŋun nyɛ n dabili ŋɔ, nyin Yaakubu ŋun nyɛ n ni pii so, ka lan nyɛ n zo Ibrahimma zuliya ŋɔ;.
en: But you, Israel my servant, Jacob, whom I have chosen, offspring of Abraham, whom I love.

dag: Izraɛl ni daa nya Yisifu bihi maa, o daa bɔhimi, Ka banima n-lee bɔŋɔ.
en: Then Israel saw Josephs sons. Israel said, Who are these boys.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm niŋ pali ti bebu puuni; dama ti nyɛla bɛn bi lan doli ti ninsalitali biɛhigu yubu, amaa ka naɣ dolila Naawuni Shia Kasi ni wuhiri ti shɛm.
en: He did this so that we could be right just as the law said we must be. Now we dont live following our sinful selves. We live following the Spirit.

dag: Bɛ gbibila tɔbiri mini kpana. Bɛ nyɛla ninkuunsinima, ka bi zɔri nambɔɣu. Bɛ vuri ŋmanila teeku kɔgbana vubu. Bɛ barila yuri m-pie taba kaman tɔbbihi ni chani tɔbu ni shɛm la n-kanna ni bɛ ti liri yinim Babilɔnnima.
en: Equipped with bow and spear, they are cruel and show no mercy. Their horsemen sound like the roaring sea, arrayed in battle formation against you, Daughter Babylon.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka ti daa lo noli suhi ti Naawuni di zuɣu, ka o daa deei ti suhigu maa.
en: So we fasted and prayed for God to protect us, and he answered our prayers.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim bɛn daa pa Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba la daa laɣim tɔbbihi tuhi kɔbisinahi bɛn nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi.
en: Not counting Benjamin, the Israelites called up four hundred thousand men armed with swords, and every one of them was a trained warrior.

dag: Dindali maa niriba ni ti yi Asiria zaŋ hal ni Ijipti tinsi ni n-ka yi sanna, ka shɛb mi yi Ijipti zaŋ hal ni Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni na, ka shɛb yi teeku shɛl ni zaŋ ti kpa teeku shɛl ni na, ka shɛb mi yi zo shɛli gbini zaŋ ti kpa zo shɛli gbini na.
en: People will flock to you from Assyria and Egypt, from Babylonia and everywhere else.

dag: Ka Saimɔn Pita daa chaŋ ti kpe ŋariŋ maa n-vo laŋ din pali ziŋ kara maa duna. Zahim maa kalinli daa nyɛla kɔbiga ni pihinunaata, amaa bɛ ni daa zooi shɛm maa zaa yoli, laŋ maa daa bi cheei.
en: Simon Peter got into the boat and pulled the net to the shore. It was full of big fish— of them! But even with that many fish, the net did not tear.

dag: Ka saŋmarisi daa yi zuɣusaa na ti tuhi tɔbu; bɛ daa yila bɛ biɛhigu shee na ti tuhi Sisɛra.
en: The stars fought from the sky; from their orbits they fought against Sisera.

dag: Ka so yi ti yɛn nahim ba, buɣim ni yi bɛ ni na n-di bɛn nyɛ bɛ dimnim maa, ka ŋunkam ti yɛn nahim ba lala n-yɛn niŋ o ka o kpi.
en: If anyone tries to harm them, fire comes out of their mouths and destroys their enemies; and in this way whoever tries to harm them will be killed.

dag: O daa tuɣindila tulaale zim Hinnom Bidibisi Vinvamli la ni, ka doli Yawɛ ni daa kari ninvuɣ shɛb tiŋgbɔn maa ni ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim ʒini la ni daa tumdi din chihiri shɛl la soli n-zaŋd o bidibisi nyɔri buɣim maani buɣa.
en: and he offered sacrifices in Hinnom Valley. Worst of all, Ahaz sacrificed his own sons, which was a disgusting custom of the nations that the Lord had forced out of Israel.

dag: Ka Pita daa zaŋ ba kpe duu ka o mini ba ti gbe. N-yi biɛɣu ka Pita yiɣisi ni o mini Kɔniilius tuumba maa chaŋ, ka Yisa nyaandol shɛb bɛn daa be Jɔpa pahi Pita zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: Peter invited them to spend the night. The next morning, Peter and some of the Lord's followers in Joppa left with the men who had come from Cornelius.

dag: Dama bɛ nyɛla tipawumlinima ni bɛn ka yɛda ni bɛn bi deeri Yawɛ wuhibu.
en: They are always rebelling against God, always lying, always refusing to listen to the Lord 's teachings.

dag: Bɔ ka n niŋ ya ka di be di ko ni cheechi shɛŋa din kpalim la n-naɣ pahila n ni bi zaŋ n yɛla doli ya la? Chɛliya dimbɔŋɔ taali paŋ ma!.
en: So you received everything that the other churches have received. Only one thing was different: I was not a burden to you. Forgive me for this!.

dag: A bela n tooni ni n nyaaŋa, ka zaŋ a nuu pa n zuɣu.
en: and with your powerful arm you protect me from every side.

dag: Ka chanya yɛtɔɣ yoya mini yɛtɔɣ chɔɣima tɔɣisibu ni asahi kpɛma niŋbu. Di zaa ŋɔ shɛli bi simdi niŋbu, amaa din simdi niŋbu nyɛla wumpaɣibo.
en: Also, there must be no evil talk among you. Dont say things that are foolish or filthy. These are not for you. But you should be giving thanks to God.

dag: Ka Hɛshibɔnnim mini Ɛlialɛnim daa kuhi pam, ka Jahaznim wum bɛ kuhigu maa, hal ka bɛ tɔbbihi ni sɔhira.
en: The people of Heshbon and Elealeh cry out, and their cry can be heard as far away as Jahaz. Even the soldiers tremble; their courage is gone.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka Musa kpe suɣili maa ni nti nya ka Aduna jaaŋgbee din daa nyɛ Lɛvinim din la puhila vari, ka daai pum n-wali alimɔnd wal moma.
en: The next day Moses entered the Tent. He saw that Aarons walking stick, the stick from the family of Levi, was the one that had grown new leaves. That walking stick had even grown branches and made almonds.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Miriya ka yi ʒiɛm bibihi ŋɔ ni yino gba, dama n yɛri ya mi ni bɛ malaikanim kul chola m Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ ninni. .
en: Don't be cruel to any of these little ones! I promise you their angels are always with my Father in heaven.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni daa yɛli ma, Daadam, pumpɔŋɔ kpuɣim a zuɣu zuɣusaa lihi nuzaa polo. Di saha ka n daa kpuɣi n zuɣu lihi nuzaa polo n-nya ka nyuli zabbu binnani la ʒe sara maligu bimbini nuzaa polo dunoli ni.
en: God said to me, Mortal man, look toward the north. I looked, and there near the altar by the entrance of the gateway I saw the idol that was an outrage to God.

dag: Nyama, n lɔr a la mihi, ka a ku tooi lan lɛbigi yaɣ yini polo dɔni yaɣ din la hal ka a ti naai a teei gili dabisa maa.
en: Ive now bound you with cords so that you cant turn from one side to the other until you have completed the days of your siege.

dag: O vuhibu pɔhim din be kaman kokpɛɣu din ʒiri binshɛɣukam chani la be o tooni n-kuri zuliya shɛba, ka chɛ ka bɛ ni lo nia biɛ shɛŋa zaani tariga.
en: he breathes out a flood that comes up to the neck. He sifts the nations and destroys them. Then he puts a bridle in every foreigner's mouth and leads them to doom.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ n suhir a mi, chɛli n taali, ka chɛ ka m min a labi, ka n ti jɛm Yawɛ.
en: Please forgive me and come back with me so I can worship the Lord .

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa daa kari doli ba nti fa bɛ yuri mini bɛ chɛchɛbunsi, ka ku Sirianim maa pam.
en: Israels king went out and attacked the horses and chariots. He attacked the Arameans with a fierce assault.

dag: Yawɛ, a yurilim maŋli la kul dumi hal ti kpe zuɣusaa; ka a ʒiɛyimtali mi du hal ni sagbana ni.
en: Lord , your faithful love reaches to the sky. Your faithfulness is as high as the clouds.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira nyaandoliba daa chaŋ ŋun Jɔn sani nti yɛl o Yisa ni daa niŋdi shɛlikam maa zaa yɛla.
en: When John's disciples told him about all these things, he called two of them.

dag: Yinim wuntizɔriba, tahimiya suhupiɛlli tahigu Yawɛ sani. Di simdi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn biɛhigu be tibi paɣir o.
en: Rejoice in the Lord , good people! It is only right for good people to praise him.

dag: Niriba gaŋbu bi viɛla, amaa bindirigu biɛla zuɣu ni tooi chɛ ka nir tum gala.
en: Prejudice is wrong. But some judges will do wrong to get even the smallest bribe.

dag: Mɛrari zuliya n-daa nyɛ Mahilinim daŋ mini Mushinim daŋ. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Mɛrari zuliya.
en: To Merari belonged the clans of Mahli and Mushi. These were the clans of the Merarites.

dag: n-yɛri malaika ŋun pah ayɔbu m-mali kikaa maa, Lɔrigim malaikanim anahi shɛb bɛ ni lo n-zali mɔɣ titali din yuli booni Yufretiiz ni la bahi.
en: The voice spoke to this angel and said, Release the four angels who are tied up beside the great Euphrates River.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni dabitim ni na. .
en: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.

dag: Cham ti yɛli Dauda ni man Yawɛ yɛliya: Bin diba ata ka n zal a ni a pii di ni zaɣ yini, ka n niŋ li ti a.
en: Tell David that I will punish him in one of three ways. But he will have to choose which one it will be.

dag: Bɛ zuɣu ka o daa teeg o daalikauli la yɛla, ka daa taɣi o tɛha o yurilim maŋli la zuɣu.
en: He always remembered his agreement, and because of his faithful love, he comforted them.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-zaŋ ba chaŋ tiŋgban nɛli ni.
en: So I led them out of the land of Egypt and brought them into the desert.

dag: ka di nyɛla o chaŋmi ti jɛm wuna, di yi nyɛla wuntaŋa bee goli bee saŋmarisi din nyɛ din chihiri n san la.
en: that they have worshiped other gods or maybe the sun, the moon or the stars. I never told you to do that!.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa zaŋ kom niŋ o sagban tibisa ni, ka sagbana maa bi cheei.
en: He fills the thick clouds with water. But he does not let its heavy weight break the clouds open.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka a ti zaŋ Aduna min o bidibisi maa ka Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa dunol ni na nti chɛ ka bɛ niŋ kom paɣi bɛ ni.
en: Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the Tent, and have them take a ritual bath.

dag: Lala ka Zara daa be; o daa deei ti yab Ibrahimma noli, hal ka boon o la o duuma. Ka pumpɔŋɔ yi yi tumdi din viɛla ka bi chɛ ka yi suhuri zɔhiri shɛli zuɣu, dina n-ni wuhi ni yi nyɛla Zara yaansi.
en: I am talking about women like Sarah. She obeyed Abraham, her husband, and called him her master. And you women are true children of Sarah if you always do what is right and are not afraid.

dag: Naawuni n-chɛ ka n leei cheechi tumtumda ka ti ma tuuni ŋɔ ni n tum yi sɔŋbu zuɣu. Dina n-nyɛ o lahibal suŋ zaa molo molibu tuma la.
en: I became a servant of the church by Gods commission, which was given to me for you, in order to complete Gods word.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ laɣimmi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim la na nti tuhi deei tiŋ maa amaŋmaŋa, di yi pa lala n yi tuhi deei tiŋ maa, bɛ ni zaŋ n yuli bol li.
en: Call the rest of the army together. Then surround the city, and capture it yourself. If you don't, everyone will remember that I captured the city.

dag: Di bi simdi ka a ti zaŋ li leei niŋgbina kpaʒiɛrim, di mi bi simdi ka a lan niŋ di tatabo yaha. Di nyɛla din be kasi, ka kul ni be kasi a sani.
en: It must not be poured on ordinary men, and you must not use the same formula to make any mixture like it. It is holy, and you must treat it as holy.

dag: A daabiligu maa ni daa ti yɛligi, a daa zaŋla gadama kpɛh a kɔbili ni, ka tum alahichi, dinzuɣu ka n kar a Naawuni zoli maa zuɣu bahi kaman daɣiri bini maa, ka chɛrubi ŋun daa gul a maa mi kar a yihi buɣim kuɣa maa ni.
en: You traded with other nations and became more and more cruel and evil. So I forced you to leave my mountain, and the creature that had been your protector now chased you away from the jewels.

dag: Ka o daa bɔri ni o baŋ Yisa, amaa ka salo zoosim zuɣu daa chɛ ka o kɔŋ o nyabu, dama ŋun Zakius daa nyɛla ninvuɣ jia.
en: He wanted to see who Jesus was. There were many others who wanted to see Jesus too. Zacchaeus was too short to see above the people.

dag: Yɔɣu ni bunsi tamla daboya zuɣu n-taɣiri ʒiɛɣu kaman yɔbahi la, ka bɛ nina niŋ liti, mɔri ni kani zuɣu.
en: Wild donkeys go blind from starvation. So they stand on barren hilltops and sniff the air, hoping to smell green grass.

dag: Nyin ŋun bol amaŋa Yɛhudia ŋɔ, wula n-lee nyɛ li a sani? A niŋ Naawuni fukumsi zaligu naani ka nyuri bara a Naawuni milinsi zuɣu.
en: Some of you call yourselves Jews. You trust in the Law and take pride in God.

dag: Amaa o bihi maa bɛn daa bi dol o naba, ka zaŋ bɛ zaŋsim niŋla bun ni, ka deeri birapu niriba sani, ka bi doli yɛlimaŋli soli maani bɛ yɛla.
en: But they did not follow their father's example; they were interested only in making money, so they accepted bribes and did not decide cases honestly.

dag: Yinim Lakishinima, zaŋmiya chɛchɛbunsi ga yuri, di daa nyɛla alahichi piligu Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga sani, dama a ni ka bɛ daa nya Izraɛlnim biriginsim.
en: You that live in Lachish, hitch the horses to the chariots. You imitated the sins of Israel and so caused Jerusalem to sin.

dag: Ninvuɣ suma yɛtɔɣa puuni ka din viɛl yirina ka bɛ dira, amaa bibiɛhi suhuri yɛla zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu zuɣu.
en: People get good things for the words they say, but those who cannot be trusted say only bad things.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛl o, Chɛ ka o be omaŋmaŋ yiŋa, o di chɛ ka n nini nya o. Dinzuɣu ka Absalom daa be omaŋmaŋ yiŋa, ka bi chani naa sani.
en: But King David said, Absalom must go back to his own house. He cannot come to see me. So Absalom went back to his own house, but he could not go to see the king.

dag: ka bɛn pun kpi Masia ni la gba bahi yoli.
en: and whats more, those who have died in Christ are gone forever.

dag: Gol ŋɔ biɛɣ pinaanahi dali zaawuni doliya di kaya ni di zaligunim zaa soli m-puhi li di puhibu saha.
en: They must eat the Passover meal just before dark on the th day of this month. They must do this at the chosen time, and they must follow all the rules about Passover.

dag: Ti Duuma, bɔ saha ka dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ti yɛn niŋ, ka shihir bɔ nti yɛn wuhi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa niŋbu saha? Ti bɔri ni a yɛl ti.
en: They asked, When will these things happen? What will be the sign that they are about to take place.

dag: Ka nandan maa daa ti kpi, ka malaikanim kpuɣ o tahi ti yab Ibrahimma sani. Ka bundan maa gba daa ti kpi ka bɛ sɔɣ o;.
en: The poor man died and was carried by angels to Abrahams side. The rich man also died and was buried.

dag: Dansarika so daa beni ka o yuli booni Barabas, ka o nyɛ bɛ ni mi so yɛla pam.
en: At that time there was a well-known prisoner named Jesus Barabbas.

dag: O ni daa kum o yidan kuli maa naai, ka Dauda daa tim ka bɛ ti zaŋ o kul o yiŋ na ka o ti zaŋ o leeg o paɣa, ka o daa ti dɔɣi bidibiga. Amaa ka Dauda ni daa niŋ shɛm maa daa bi niŋ Yawɛ nyaɣisim.
en: After her time of sadness, David sent servants to bring her to his house. She became Davids wife and gave birth to a son for David. But the Lord did not like what David had done.

dag: Yi niriba anu ni ti kar doli niriba kɔbiga, ka yi niriba kɔbiga ni ti kar doli niriba tuhi pia n-zaŋ takɔbi ku yi dimnim maa.
en: Five of you will chase away a hundred, and a hundred of you will chase away ten thousand, and your enemies will fall before you in battle.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ ni yino yɛl o, Biɛhiŋ kani, zaŋ chaŋ yuuni na ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha, n ni lab a sanna, ka a paɣ Zara ni ti dɔɣi bidibiga. Ka Zara daa be o nyaaŋa tanti suɣili dunol ni n-wumda.
en: Then one of the men said, I will definitely return to you about this time next year. Then your wife Sarah will have a son! Sarah was listening at the tent door behind him.

dag: Dauda ni daa chaŋ Zikilag, ka Manaasa zuliya ni ninvuɣ shɛb zo n-chaŋ o sani n-daa nyɛ: Adina mini Jɔzabad ni Jɛdiayɛl ni Maikil ni Jɔzabad ni Ɛlihu ni Zilɛtai bɛn daa su tɔbbihi tuhilituhili fukumsi Manaasa zuliya niriba ni la.
en: These were the men from Manasseh who joined David when he went to the town of Ziklag: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai. All of them were generals from the tribe of Manasseh.

dag: Ŋun yi zuɣusaa na gari sokam zaa; ŋun yi dunia ŋɔ ni na nyɛla dunia ŋɔ nira, ka tɔɣisiri dunia ŋɔ yɛla; amaa ŋun yi alizanda ni na gari sokam zaa.
en: He who comes from above is greater than all. He who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks about earthly matters, but he who comes from heaven is above all.

dag: Ka n ni zaŋ dimdi niŋ a mini paɣ sunsuuni ni a zuliya min o zuliya sunsuuni, ka paɣ zuliya maa ni ti ŋme m-bɔr a zuɣu, ka a mi zuliya ti dim o zuliya napɔŋkpaa.
en: I will make you and the woman hate each other; her offspring and yours will always be enemies. Her offspring will crush your head, and you will bite her offspring's heel.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ ŋuna m-be palli zuɣu la, pumpɔŋɔ ŋuna m-be daa ni la. O daa kul dola lɔriga kam ni guhira.
en: or stood waiting at a corner, sometimes in the streets, sometimes in the marketplace.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛli ba, Yi yi kul nya ka shɛli viɛli yi sani, dina ka n ni niŋ. Ka naa daa kana ti ʒe tiŋ maa dunoli naŋgbanyee ka tɔbbihi maa zaa daa doli tab yirina kɔbigakɔbiga ni tuhilituhili.
en: I will do whatever you think best, the king answered. Then he stood by the side of the gate as his men marched out in units of a thousand and of a hundred.

dag: O chɛ ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa be viɛnyɛliŋga yi ʒiɛman ni. Tiliginsim mini yɛm ni baŋsim din galisi bela o sani. Yawɛ zɔbu n-nyɛ Ziɔn azichi.
en: you are the foundation on which we stand today. You always save us and give true wisdom and knowledge. Nothing means more to us than obeying you.

dag: n-ʒiya diri bindirigu, ka paɣ so zaŋ luɣulu viɛlli din pali tulaale din mali shaara pam ka o sanna ti kpaa li niŋ o zuɣu ni.
en: a woman came to him with a vase made of alabaster containing very expensive perfume. She poured it on Jesus head while he was sitting at dinner.

dag: Jɛra n-zaŋdi bɛ nuhi taɣindi tab ʒiya, ka chɛ ka kum kuri ba.
en: Fools fold their hands and eat their own flesh.

dag: Dina n-ni chɛ ka a niriba maa lur a sizuura, ka gbib a zaligunim saha shɛlikam bɛ ni yɛn be a ni daa zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti bɛ yaannim ŋɔ ni.
en: Do this that they may revere you by following your ways all the days they live on the fertile land that you gave to our ancestors.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan yɛli Sool, Dauda suhi ma la soli ni o chaŋ Bɛtilihɛm.
en: Jonathan answered, He begged me to let him go to Bethlehem.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa nim daa lihir o ka tɛhiri ni o nuu maa ni mɔri bee ni o ni yiɣi lu n-kpi; amaa bɛ ni daa lih o yuui nti nya ka shɛli bi niŋ o maa, ka bɛ daa lan taɣ zilinli yɛli ni o nyɛla buɣili.
en: They expected him to swell up with fever or suddenly drop dead. After waiting a long time and seeing nothing unusual happen to him, they changed their minds and began to claim that he was a god.

dag: Napɔŋ din pahir ayopɔin maa ni, ka o daa ti yɛli, N nya sagban bila ka di be kaman ninsal nuu la n-yi teeku polo na. Ka o yɛl o, Cham ti yɛli Ɛhab, Malim a chɛchɛbuŋ shili n-yiɣisi kuli, di yi pa lala saa ni taɣ a sɔŋ. .
en: The seventh time he returned and said, I saw a little cloud no bigger than a man's hand, coming up from the sea. Elijah ordered his servant, Go to King Ahab and tell him to get in his chariot and go back home before the rain stops him.

dag: Bɛ daa pihila kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya pɔi ka naanyi piri ba. Bɛ daa niŋla bɛ zaa lala, dama luɣ kasi shee tumtumdiba bɛn daa tumdi Naawuni tuma daa be Ɛliɛza mini Itama bidibisi maa zaa ni.
en: Since there were Temple officials and spiritual leaders among the descendants of both Eleazar and Ithamar, assignments were made by drawing lots.

dag: Yi mini Masia ni laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yin la zuɣu ka yi daa guni gunibu shɛli din pa ninsal ni niŋ shɛli, amaa ka nyɛla Masia maŋmaŋ ni niŋ shɛli ka di nyɛ o ni yihi ya niŋgbuŋ din tumd alahichi ŋɔ alahichi maa yiko dabitim puuni la zuɣu.
en: Christ has also taken away your selfish desires, just as circumcision removes flesh from the body.

dag: Sulemaana wain tihi puu daa bela Baalihamɔn ka pukpariba daa haayi li o sani, bɛ zaa yinoyino daa yɔrila anzinfa laɣibaligu tuhilituhili.
en: Solomon had a vineyard in Baal-hamon. He gave charge of the vineyard to keepers; one would bring in exchange for its fruit a thousand pieces of silver.

dag: Dama, naa kul ni tumla na shɛb bɛn pun daŋ o tooni ni tum shɛli. Di saha ka n daa tɛhi yɛm mini biɛri yoli ni jɛrilim yɛla.
en: My reflections then turned to wisdom, madness, and folly. What can the kings heir do but what has already been done?.

dag: Amaa man tɛha ni, o yi kpalim ʒiya o ni mali suhupiɛlli gar o yi kuli doo, ka n tɛhi ni Naawuni Shia Kasi be n ni zaŋ chaŋ yɛla ŋɔ polo.
en: She will be happier, however, if she stays as she is. That is my opinion, and I think that I too have God's Spirit.

dag: Jeemsi daa lan yɛli, Dinzuɣu n tɛha nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: Di bi simdi ni ti nahim bɛn pa Yɛhudianim bɛn niŋ tuuba maa;.
en: It is my opinion, James went on, that we should not trouble the Gentiles who are turning to God.

dag: Ka Zɛra ŋun daa nyɛ Itiɔpia nir la tɔbbihi tuhi tuhili mini chɛchɛbunsi kɔbisita kana ti liri ba Marɛsha.
en: Zerah from Ethiopia led an army of . soldiers and chariots to the town of Mareshah in Judah.

dag: Ti mi ni Naawuni bi deeri alahichilan suhigu, amaa so yi jɛmdi ŋun Naawuni ka tumd o yubu, o deeri dilan suhigu.
en: We know that God does not listen to sinners; he does listen to people who respect him and do what he wants them to do.

dag: Lahibal suŋ daa kala ti sanna kaman di ni daa chaŋ bɛ sani shɛm; ka bɛ ni daa wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa daa bi ku ba buchi, dama bɛn daa wum li maa daa bi niŋ li yɛda.
en: We also had the good news preached to us, just as the Israelites did. However, the message they heard didnt help them because they werent united in faith with the ones who listened to it.

dag: Teemiya din daa niŋ Lɔt paɣ la.
en: Remember what happened to Lot's wife.

dag: Nazari nir zaligu m-bɔŋɔ: saha shɛl o ni zaŋ wolig omaŋ maa tariga yi ti paai, bɛn zaŋm o na ti zali Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni.
en: This is the Instruction for the nazirite. When the term as a nazirite is completed, the person will be brought to the entrance of the meeting tent.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa chaŋ o sani ti bɔh o, A shiri yɛn laɣimla wuntizɔriba mini ninvuɣ biɛri ku?.
en: Abraham approached and said, Will you really sweep away the innocent with the guilty?.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi ti niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni kaman o ni lɔn ya alikauli shɛm la, yi ni ti dihi zuliyanim pam samli; amaa yinim ti ku paŋ shɛli. Yi ni ti su zuliyanim pam, amaa bɛn ti ku sun ya.
en: Then the Lord your God will bless you, as he promised. And you will have enough money to make loans to many nations. But you will not need to borrow from anyone. You will rule over many nations. But none of these nations will rule over you.

dag: ka Kallai daa nyɛ Sallai daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma; ka Ɛba daa nyɛ Amok daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma;.
en: Kallai of Sallai, Eber of Amok.

dag: Ka Saimɔn yɛli, N tɛhiya ni ŋun samli galisi pam la. Ka Yisa yɛl o, A shiri baŋya.
en: I suppose, answered Simon, that it would be the one who was forgiven more. You are right, said Jesus.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ bɔ n-niŋ ka a bi kpahi Jɛrimia ŋun nyɛ Anatɔt nira, ka zaŋ omaŋ leeg anabi yi sani la zuɣu ni?.
en: Jeremiah from the town of Anathoth is pretending to be a prophet there in Jerusalem, so why haven't you punished him?.

dag: So yi tɛhi ni o mi shɛli, o na bi mi di ni simdi ni o mi shɛli gba.
en: If anyone thinks they know something, they dont yet know as much as they should know.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa gbahi Midian paɣiba mini bɛ bihi, ka gbahi bɛ niɣi mini bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu zaa, ka di bɛ nɛma zaa chaŋ.
en: The people of Israel captured the Midianite women and children, took their cattle and their flocks, plundered all their wealth.

dag: n-daa ti kpɛri tiŋkpan shɛl ni ka kɔnsi pia chirig o sol ni n-kaɣ ti ʒe katiŋ ha.
en: He was going into a village when he was met by ten men suffering from a dreaded skin disease. They stood at a distance.

dag: Ka a zaligu ŋɔ yi moli gili a sulinsi tiŋgbɔn titali ŋɔ zaa ni, di ni chɛ ka paɣ kam lu o yidan sizuura, o yidana yi nyɛla wɔɣirili bee tarima.
en: When the order becomes public through the whole empire, vast as it is, all women will treat their husbands properly. The rule should touch everyone, whether from an important family or not.

dag: Ti ni daa puhi ba naai ka Pool kahigi Naawuni ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa yiniyini o waazu yihibu ni bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani yɛli ba.
en: After greeting them, Paul told them point by point all that God had used him to do among the non-Jewish people.

dag: Miriya ka yi zu.
en: You must not steal anything.

dag: Ka Dan zuliya niriba maa daa ŋmaligi chaŋ. Maika ni daa nya ka bɛ mali kpiɔŋ gar o maa, ka o ŋmaligi lab kuli.
en: After saying this, they turned and left. Micah realized there was no way he could win a fight with them, and so he went back home.

dag: dindina maligumaana ni zali di daa ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm hal ti paai nɛma labisi ti yuuni maa ni, ka dilan ni yo di liɣiri dindali maa ka di leei din be kasi Yawɛ sani.
en: its value will be decided by a priest, according to the number of years before the next Year of Celebration, and the money you pay will be mine.

dag: tarimtali ni maŋgbibbutali. Ka zaligu shɛli kani din galindi dimbɔŋɔnima.
en: humility, and self-control. There is no law against such things as these.

dag: Bɛ daa lan yo Naawuni jɛmbu duu zɔŋ dunoya, ka kpihi di puuni firilanima, ka daa bi lan tuɣindi tulaale zim bee m-maani bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la luɣ kasi shee la tiri Izraɛlnim Naawuni.
en: They shut the doors of the porch of the Temple and let the fire go out in the lamps. They stopped burning incense and offering burnt offerings in the Holy Place to the God of Israel.

dag: Ninvuɣ pihita maa yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Asahɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔab mabia la mini Ɛlhanan ŋun ba daa nyɛ Dɔdo Bɛtilihɛm nir la.
en: The following men were among the Thirty Heroes: Asahel, the brother of Joab; Elhanan son of Dodo from Bethlehem;.

dag: Ka o gba ŋmaligi bɔhi ma, A bi mi di ni nyɛ shɛli? Ka n garigi yɛli, N dana, m bi mi.
en: The angel speaking with me said, Dont you know what these things are? No sir, I said.

dag: Ka Dauda daa ku tinsi maa niriba zaa, ka bi chɛ ka paɣa bee doo kpalim; ka daa gbahi bɛ piɛri mini niɣi, ni bunsi ni laakumnima, ka va bɛ situra pahi n-lab Akishi sanna.
en: killing all the men and women and taking the sheep, cattle, donkeys, camels, and even the clothes. Then he would come back to Achish.

dag: Ka Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa daa kpalim be Obɛdɛdom min o yiŋnim sani o yiŋa chira ata. Ka Yawɛ daa niŋ alibarika niŋ Obɛdɛdom min o yiŋnim ni ni o ni daa mali binshɛlikam zaa ni.
en: The chest stayed there for three months, and the Lord blessed Obed-Edom, his family, and everything he owned.

dag: Rɛhabia daŋ ni, ŋun Rɛhabia bidibisi ni, Ishia n-daa nyɛ kpɛma.
en: Isshiah, a descendant of Rehabiah;.

dag: O ni gah o nuu boli zuliya shɛb bɛn be katiŋa, ka vulim vuliŋga boli dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam niriba, ka bɛ zɔri yomyom kanna!.
en: God will raise a signal to a nation from far away and whistle to them from the end of the earth— now look—hurrying, swiftly they come!.

dag: Yawɛ ni sabi niriba maa yuya sɔŋ. O ni sabi, Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa leela Jɛrusalɛm tiŋbihi.
en: The Lord keeps a list of all his people, and he knows where each of them was born. Selah.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa zaŋ bimbuɣisirigu din ŋmani jaaŋgbee ti ma ka yɛli ma: Yiɣisima m-buɣisi Naawuni jɛmbu duu mini di bimbini, ka kali bɛn jɛmdi Naawuni di ni.
en: I was then given a stick that looked like a measuring-rod, and was told, Go and measure the temple of God and the altar, and count those who are worshiping in the temple.

dag: Hamat mini Aripad ni Sɛfarivaim wuna la lee be ya? Bɛ daa tooi fa Samaria n nuu ni bahi?.
en: Where are they now, the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim? Did anyone save Samaria?.

dag: Yi yi ti paai Keenan tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni zaŋ tin ya ni yi su maa ni, ka n ti zaŋ dɔr biɛɣu niŋ so yil ni yi ni su tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa ni.
en: When you enter the land of Canaan, which I am giving to you as a possession, and I put an infection of skin disease on a house in the land you possess.

dag: Di saha ka o daa boli Gɛhaazi na ti yɛl o, Bolim Shunɛm paɣ maa na. Ka o bol o. Ka paɣ maa kana, ka o ti yɛl o, Kpuɣim a bia.
en: Elisha called Gehazi and said, Call the Shunammite woman! Gehazi called her, and she came to Elisha. Elisha said, Pick up your son.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, Naawuni ŋun nam dunia mini binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni ŋɔ n-nyɛ zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani Duuma. O bi be bimbin shɛŋa daadam ni zaŋ o nuhi me zuɣu.
en: God, who made the world and everything in it, is Lord of heaven and earth. He doesnt live in temples made with human hands.

dag: Ka yi ti kari doli yi dimnima n-zaŋ takɔbi ku ba.
en: You will chase your enemies and defeat them. You will kill them with your swords.

dag: Amaa yi suhukpeeni niŋbu puuni ka yi ni ti nya yi nyɛviya.
en: You will save yourselves by continuing strong in your faith through all these things.

dag: Shia maa daa yi kul chani luɣ shɛlikam, bɛ gba chanimi, ka kalima maa gba wuɣi du n-doli ba. Dama binnɛma maa shia daa bela kalima maa ni.
en: The creatures went wherever they wished, and the wheels did exactly what the creatures did, because the creatures controlled them.

dag: Di saha maa ka n ni tɔɣis a wuntitali yɛla, ka tɔɣis a paɣibu yɛla dabisi muni zaa puuni.
en: Then I will shout all day, Praise the Lord God! He did what was right.

dag: Yinim bɛn zaa nyɛ tuumbiɛrinim ŋɔ, Zomiya n sani! dama Yawɛ wum n kumsi maa;.
en: Keep away from me, you evil people! The Lord hears my weeping;.

dag: Ka m mali tahima ti Duuma sani ni di ku yuui ka mmaŋmaŋ gba tooi ka yi sanna.
en: I am sure the Lord will help me come to you soon.

dag: Ka yinim bɛn nyɛ tuumbiɛrinim ŋɔ yi mi ni yi zaŋ bin suma ti yi bihi, bɔ n-ni chɛ ka yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ ŋun ku zaŋ bin suma ti bɛn suhir o li?.
en: If you who are evil know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give good things to those who ask him.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni daa ka Abimilɛk sanna zahindi puuni yuŋ ti yɛl o, Nyama, a nyɛla kpima, a ni kpuɣi paɣ so la na zuɣu; dama o nyɛla do so paɣa.
en: But God appeared to Abimelech that night in a dream and said to him, You are as good as dead because of this woman you have taken. She is a married woman.

dag: Dinzuɣu zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa mali buɣa dibu polo, di bemi kaman ninvuɣ shɛb ni yɛli ni buɣili kam ʒiɛla binshɛɣu din ka dunia ŋɔ ni zaani la, ka Naawuni so mi lan kani pahila Naawuni yino ŋɔ ko.
en: So concerning the actual food involved in these sacrifices to false gods, we know that a false god isnt anything in this world, and that there is no God except for the one God.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ nyama, m bela yi polo, ka ni ŋmaligi kpa yi polo na, ka yi ko m-biri.
en: I am on your side, and I will make sure that your land is plowed again and crops are planted on it.

dag: ka maligumaana maa ti zal o daa ka di dol o ni viɛl shɛm bee o ni bi viɛl shɛm. Kaman ŋun maligumaana ni zal o daa shɛm, lala n-yɛn nyɛ li.
en: The priest will decide a price for that animal. It doesnt make any difference if the animal is good or bad. If the priest decides on a price, that is the price for the animal.

dag: ka o ti kɔrig o sara maligu bimbini la nuzaa polo Yawɛ tooni, ka Aduna bidibisi bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba maa ti zaŋ ʒim kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini maa luɣilikam.
en: You must kill the animal on the north side of the altar in front of the Lord . Then Aarons sons, the priests, will splash the animals blood on all four sides of the altar.

dag: Daabihi ni saɣi di o daa? Bɛ ni saɣi pirig o ti kɔhigɔriba?.
en: Is it ever chopped up and its pieces bargained for in the fish-market?.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa daa chaŋ bɛ wain puri ni ti pihi wain wala na nti kahim di kom niŋ wain n-zaŋ li chaŋ bɛ wuni jɛmbu duu ti puhi chuɣu nimaani, ka diri ka nyura, ka turi Abimilɛk.
en: One day the people of Shechem went out to the vineyards to pick grapes. They squeezed the grapes to make wine. And then they had a party at the temple of their god. The people ate and drank and cursed Abimelech.

dag: m-pahi o yiko shɛli din tumdi tuma tinim bɛn niŋ yɛda ŋɔ ni ni galisi shɛm la. Yiko shɛli din be ti ni ŋɔ mini Naawuni ni daa zaŋ yiko shɛli.
en: I want you to know about the great and mighty power that God has for us followers. It is the same wonderful power he used.

dag: amaa ŋumbɔŋɔ ŋun kul tumdila o maligumaanitali tuma, dama o kul ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: But Jesus will never die, and so he will be a priest forever!.

dag: Bɛ laɣiŋgu maa ni daa ti wurim naai ka Yɛhudianim mini niriba pam bɛn daa doli Yɛhudianim daadiini soli kabiri doli Pool mini Baanabas. Ka Pool mini Baanabas daa kpaŋsi bɛ suhuri ni bɛ kul kpalimmi be Naawuni daanfaani ni.
en: After the meeting, many of the people followed Paul and Barnabas, including many Jews and people who had changed their religion to be like Jews and worship the true God. Paul and Barnabas encouraged them to continue trusting in Gods grace.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa kpe o ka o yɛli, Kpe nyɛla dabiɛm zɔbu shee! Kpe nyɛla Naawuni yiŋa. Alizanda dunoli m-bɔŋɔ.
en: He was terrified and thought, This sacred place is awesome. Its none other than Gods house and the entrance to heaven.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ alahichinim ŋɔ, teemiya dimbɔŋɔ yɛla, ka zaŋ li niŋ yi tɛha ni.
en: Remember this and take courage; take it to heart, you rebels.

dag: Man Jud ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia dabili ni Jeemsi mabia la n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri ninvuɣ shɛb Naawuni ni boli ka bɛ nyɛ ŋun ti Ba Naawuni ni yuri shɛba, ka lan nyɛ Yisa Masia ni gbib shɛb la:.
en: Greetings from Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and a brother of James. To those who have been chosen and are loved by God the Father and have been kept safe in Jesus Christ.

dag: o ŋmanila biɛkaali neesim bɛ sani, ka be kaman sagbana ni yi kani ka wuntaŋ puhi na asiba ka o neesim be shɛm la; ka be kaman saa ni yi mi ka mɔri bili tiŋgban ni yina shɛm la.
en: is like the morning light at dawn, like a morning without clouds. He is like sunshine after a rain that makes tender grass grow from the ground.

dag: Naawuni, nyini n-nyɛ n Naawuni, ka n kul bɔr a. N suhu zaa kul yɛla a zuɣu. N niŋgbuŋ luɣili pinaayi zaa kul bɔr a mi. Di bemi kaman tiŋgban kuŋ din chaɣisi ka kom ka nimaani la.
en: You are my God. I worship you. In my heart, I long for you, as I would long for a stream in a scorching desert.

dag: Di saha ka Sintani daa zo ka chɛ Yisa, ka malaikanim kana ti kpaŋs o suhu.
en: The devil left him, and angels came and took care of him.

dag: Di saha ka alizin biɛɣu ni daa ʒi do so zuɣu daa dii kpe bɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni na nti kuhi bɔhi.
en: Just then a man with an evil spirit came into the synagogue and screamed.

dag: Naa Jɔsia ʒiɛman ni ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, A nya Izraɛlnim bɛn ka ba maa ni daa niŋ shɛm, bɛ ni daa chaŋ daboli kam din du zuɣu mini ti mahali kam gbini ti niŋ zina shɛm bebɔ?.
en: During the rule of King Josiah, the LORD said to me: Have you noticed what unfaithful Israel has done? Shes gone about looking for lovers on top of every high hill and under every lush tree.

dag: Ka Neetan daa yɛli naa, Cham ti niŋ a ni lo a suhu ni ni a niŋ shɛm, Yawɛ ʒe a nyaaŋa.
en: Nathan answered, Do whatever you have in mind, because the Lord is with you.

dag: Binshɛŋa din ŋmani sakuɣa la na mi n-kɔŋ Lɛbanɔn tampima la lɔna ni? Ka zoya ni kulibɔŋ maha la kɔzɔrim na mi n-nyuui?.
en: It is as strange as not finding snow on Lebanons mountains or seeing the cool streams that come from there stop flowing. That just does not happen!.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ salima naɣibil yino zali Bɛtɛl, ka zaŋ yino mi zali Dan.
en: He put one calf in Bethel, and the other he placed in Dan.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiya ni di daa kpala talahi ni o be kaman o mabihi ni be shɛm shɛlikam puuni, ka di chɛ ka o tooi leei maligumaani titali ŋun ʒe yim ni ŋun nyɛ nambɔzɔra o tuma ni zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni sani, ka di chɛ ka niriba nya alahichi chɛ m-paŋ.
en: For this reason, Jesus had to be made like us, his brothers and sisters, in every way. He became like people so that he could be their merciful and faithful high priest in service to God. Then he could bring forgiveness for the peoples sins.

dag: Di saha ka Abimilɛk daa zaŋ piɛri mini naɣilahi ni dabidɔbba ni paɣiba ti Ibrahimma, ka zaŋ o paɣ Zara gba labisi ti o.
en: Abimelech took flocks, cattle, male servants, and female servants, and gave them to Abraham; and Abimelech returned his wife Sarah.
