dag: Dama a yɛliya, M biɛhigu nyɛla din be kasi, ka n ka daɣiri Naawuni sani!.
en: You say to God, My arguments are right, and you can see I am pure.

dag: Ka anab maa daa viligi tan shɛli o ni zaŋ lo o ninni maa, ka Izraɛl naa maa baŋ ni o nyɛla anabinim ni yino.
en: Then the prophet quickly took the cloth from his face, and the king of Israel saw that he was one of the prophets.

dag: Zɛdɛkia yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisiniyini saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuun piniyini Jɛrusalɛm. O ma yuli n-daa booni Hamutal. Hamutal mi ba n-daa nyɛ Jɛrimia ŋun daa nyɛ Libina nir la.
en: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king of Judah, and he ruled in Jerusalem for eleven years. His mother was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah from the city of Libnah.

dag: Amaa ka naa daa yɛli Absalom, Aai, m bia, di chɛ ka ti zaa kana, di yi nyɛ lala, ti yɛla ni ti muɣis a pam. Ka Absalom daa kpaŋ omaŋa ni o chɛ ka o chaŋ, amaa ka o daa zaɣisi, ka naɣ suhila alibarika niŋ o ni.
en: But the king said to Absalom, No, my son. We shouldnt all go, or we would be a burden on you. Although Absalom urged him, the king wasnt willing to go, although he gave Absalom a blessing.

dag: Mani ka Yawɛ daa daŋ nambu o tuma piligu ni, din daa nyɛ o tuuli tuma kurimbuni ha.
en: The LORD created me at the beginning of his way, before his deeds long in the past.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka tɔbbihi tusaanu laasabu chaŋ ti dɔni Ai wulinluhili polo luɣ shɛli din be Bɛtɛl mini Ai sunsuuni.
en: He took about five thousand men and put them in hiding west of the city, between Ai and Bethel.

dag: Amazia daa nyɛla o bia, ka Azaria nyɛ o bia, ka Jɔtam nyɛ o bia.
en: Joashs son was Amaziah. Amaziahs son was Azariah. Azariahs son was Jotham.

dag: N ni zaŋ piɛbihi pola mali sara n-zaŋ ba nyo buɣim ti a, ka zaŋ piɛlahi sara nyɔhi ti a, ka zaŋ naɣilahi mini buhi mali sara.
en: I will sacrifice my best sheep and offer bulls and goats on your altar.

dag: Di zaŋya yimaŋ bali bɛn pa Yisa yɛdaniŋdiba ni, dama wula ka wuntia mini din pa wuntia ni tooi laɣim be bee zɔtali bɔ m-be neesim mini zibisim sunsuuni?.
en: Stay away from people who are not followers of the Lord! Can someone who is good get along with someone who is evil? Are light and darkness the same?.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Pumpɔŋɔ a ni nya n ni yɛn niŋ Firawuna shɛm: N yi niŋ o firimiinsi o ni chɛ ka bɛ yi, yɛlimaŋli, n ni niŋ o firimiinsi, ka o kari ba yih o tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: The Lord God told Moses: Soon you will see what I will do to the king. Because of my mighty power, he will let my people go, and he will even chase them out of his country.

dag: Mɔdɛkai bapir so bipuɣiŋga daa beni ka o yuli booni Ɛsta. O Hiburu yuli mi daa nyɛla Hadasa. O daa viɛli pam. O ba min o ma zaa daa kpimi ka chɛ o, ka Mɔdɛkai zaŋ o n-wums o kaman omaŋmaŋ bipuɣiŋga la.
en: Mordecai had a very beautiful cousin named Esther, whose Hebrew name was Hadassah. He had raised her as his own daughter, after her father and mother died.

dag: Di ni ti nyɛla bɛ ni mali maligumaaniba shɛba ka bɛ be kasi, ka nyɛ Zadok zuliya bɛn doli n zaligu la dini. Bɛna n-daa bi birigi kaman Lɛvinim ni daa niŋ shɛm saha shɛli Izraɛlnim ni daa birigi la.
en: This holy area is to be for the priests who are descendants of Zadok. They served me faithfully and did not join the rest of the Israelites in doing wrong, as the other members of the tribe of Levi did.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Obɔt maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Abarim din daa be Mɔab tintariga la.
en: They left Oboth and camped at Iye Abarim. This was at the border of the country of Moab.

dag: Ka bɛ dimnim maa daa nahim ba pam, ka zaŋ bɛ yiko su ba.
en: They were mistreated and abused by their enemies.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb daa ti zaŋ bibihi ka Yisa sanna ni o ti zaŋ o nuu pa bɛ zuɣu; ka o nyaandoliba daa nya lala ka tahiri bihinim maa zuɣu.
en: Some people brought their little children for Jesus to bless. But when his disciples saw them doing this, they told the people to stop bothering him.

dag: N ni yili yil palli paɣi nyin Naawuni. N ni ŋme mɔɣilo din mali mihi pia paɣ a.
en: God, I will sing a new song for you. I will play a ten-stringed harp and sing praise to you.

dag: Nyamiya n ni zaŋ mmaŋmaŋ nuu n-sab bachibihi kar shɛŋa tin ya!.
en: You can see what big letters I make when I write with my own hand.

dag: Nyama, ka tiŋ maa nim zaa daa kabina ni bɛ ti nya Yisa; bɛ ni daa ti nya o, ka bɛ balim o ni o yim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Then the whole city came out and met Jesus. When they saw him, they pleaded with him to leave their region.

dag: Dinzuɣu n dana, chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ n ni ʒi pin shɛli na ŋɔ n-ti nachimba bɛn be a sani ŋɔ.
en: Here is a gift, which your servant has brought to my master. Please let it be given to the young men who follow you, my master.

dag: Hɛzɛkia mini kpambaliba ni daa kana ti nya di ni doya gbilligbilli shɛm maa, ka bɛ paɣi Yawɛ min o niriba Izraɛlnim di zuɣu.
en: When Hezekiah and the officials saw the piles, they blessed the LORD and his people Israel.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Timmi niriba ka bɛ chaŋ ti puɣisi nya Keenan tiŋgbɔn.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses.

dag: Ka a yi yɛn suhi Naawuni, nyin di niŋdi kaman bilikɔɣinim ni niŋdi shɛm la, dama bɛ yuri ni bɛ zani bɛ jɛmbu duri ni mini sochira zuɣu n-suhiri Naawuni ni niriba nyari ba. Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, bɛn pun nya bɛ laara.
en: When you pray, dont be like the hypocrites. They love to stand in the synagogues and on the street corners and pray loudly. They want people to see them. The truth is, thats all the reward they will get.

dag: Saha shɛli niriba maa ni daa yi bɛ tantinim ni na chani ni bɛ ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du, ka maligumaaniba bɛn daa ʒiri Alikauli Adaka maa daa gari bɛ tooni chana.
en: The people marched out from their tents to cross over the Jordan. The priests carrying the covenant chest were in front of the people.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda yi daa bol o o Duuma, di chaŋ wula ka o ni lan nyɛ ŋun Naa Dauda yaaŋa.
en: If, then, David called him Lord, how can the Messiah be David's descendant.

dag: Yinim bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ka n yɛri pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ. N ni nyɛ Naawuni ni tim tuun so bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani zuɣu ka m mali n tuma maa kuuna.
en: Im speaking to you Gentiles. Considering that Im an apostle to the Gentiles, I publicize my own ministry.

dag: Sool ni daa ŋmaligi Samuɛl sani ni o chaŋ, ka Naawuni taɣ o suhu. Ka shihira ŋɔ zaa daa niŋ pali dindali maa.
en: Just as Saul turned to leave Samuel, God turned Sauls life around. All these things happened that day.

dag: Lala ka Lɛvi zuliya ni so gba daa ti doli soli maa na nti nya o, ka lɔɣ o gari.
en: Next, a Levite came near. He saw the hurt man, but he went around him. He would not stop to help him either. He just walked away.

dag: Dinzuɣu a yi tahi sara sara malibu shee ka ti teei ni a mali taali a kpe so sani.
en: So if you are about to offer your gift to God at the altar and there you remember that your brother has something against you.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ dali ka bɛ mali shili, dama dali man Yawɛ ni yi Sinai Zoli maa zuɣu siɣina niriba maa zaa ninni.
en: Be ready for the third day, because on the third day the LORD will come down on Mount Sinai for all the people to see.

dag: Ti Naawuni maa nyɛla tiliginsim Naawuni. Ti Duuma Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun tiligiri niriba kum ni.
en: Our God is a God who saves; he is the Lord , our Lord, who rescues us from death.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Zɔri, niŋm a ni kana ni a ti niŋ shɛli maa. Di saha ka salo maa dii kana ti gbaai Yisa.
en: Jesus answered, Be quick about it, friend! Then they came up, arrested Jesus, and held him tight.

dag: Miriya ka yi birigi mɔɣu bee n-doli pala, dama yi dimnim maa gbibila takɔbiri ka dabiɛm be luɣilikam.
en: The Lord said, Don't work in your fields or walk along the roads. It's too dangerous. The enemy is well armed.

dag: Dina n-nyɛ ni di nyɛla talahi ni Masia di wahala n-leei ŋun tuui neei kum ni, ka moli tiliginsim lahibal suŋ Yɛhudianim mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani n-neei bɛ nina.
en: I told them how the Messiah would suffer and be the first to be raised from death, so he could bring light to his own people and to the Gentiles.

dag: Yi galim ma yimyim bupia zuɣu, yi ni miligi n suhu shɛm maa vi bi mali ya?.
en: You have insulted me ten times now. You have attacked me without shame!.

dag: Bɛ ni baŋ Naawuni maa zaa yoli: Bɛ bi tir o jilima kaman Naawuni; bɛ mi bi puhir o taalitaali; amaa ka bɛ tɛha zaa naɣ leela tɛhi yoya, ka zibisim zibigi bɛ tɛhi yoya maa ni.
en: They know God, but they do not give him the honor that belongs to him, nor do they thank him. Instead, their thoughts have become complete nonsense, and their empty minds are filled with darkness.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla gɔpiɛliga dari mali di daantalis anahi, ka niŋ salima niŋ li, ka zaŋ salima mali di bansi. Bɛ daa lan zaŋ anzinfa mali daantalisi maa ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu ni bɛ zaŋ pateesa maa yili li.
en: They made for it four acacia-wood posts covered in gold with gold hooks and cast four silver bases for them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ daba ayi nimaani, ka yɛdaniŋdiba maa daa ti chɛbisi ba ni suhupiɛlli ka bɛ lab bɛn daa tim ba na maa sani. .
en: The men from Jerusalem stayed on in Antioch for a while. And when they left to return to the ones who had sent them, the followers wished them well.

dag: Ka buŋ maa nya ma, ka birigi siɣimsiɣim buta ŋɔ zaa. O yi di bi birigi, yɛlimaŋli, ŋ-ŋɔ n di pun ku a, ka chɛ o.
en: your donkey saw me and turned away from me. That happened three times. If the donkey had not turned away, I probably would have killed you already. And I would have let your donkey live.

dag: Amaa man ni mali shɛli nyɛla, a chɛ ka Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn be Dan zaŋ hal ni Bɛrishiiba zaa laɣim a sanna kaman teeku noli bihigu la, ka a maŋmaŋ yina n-gari tooni zaŋ ba chaŋ.
en: So I would advise that all the Israelites, from Dan to Beer-sheba—a group as countless as sand on the seashore—be summoned to join you, and that you yourself go into battle.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ neen yinsi din nyɛ salima kɔtomsi gali mini gali sabilifaa ni gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli n-wuɣi shɛlɔrigu ka di mini binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la nyɛ zaɣ yini.
en: A finely woven belt made of the same materials is to be attached to the ephod so as to form one piece with it.

dag: O daa va malaika n-nyaŋ o, ka kuhi niŋ o n-suh o bɔri sɔŋsim. Ka o daa ti nya Naawuni Bɛtɛl, ka Naawuni daa tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa nimaani.
en: At Bethel, Jacob wrestled with an angel and won; then with tears in his eyes, he asked for a blessing, and God spoke to us there.

dag: Yisa Masia nyɛla ŋun daa kana ni kom mini ʒim, ka di pala ni kom kɔŋko, amaa di nyɛla kom mini ʒim. Naawuni Shia mi di li shɛhira, dama ŋun Naawuni Shia nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: Jesus Christ is the one who came with the water of his baptism and the blood of his death. He came not only with the water, but with both the water and the blood. And the Spirit himself testifies that this is true, because the Spirit is truth.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Ibram daa vuɣ o tanti suɣili n-chaŋ ti kpa Mamri oki ti shɛŋa din be Hiburɔn la gbini; ka daa me sara maligu bimbini zali nimaani jɛm Yawɛ.
en: Abram took down his tents and went to live near the sacred trees of Mamre at Hebron, where he built an altar in honor of the Lord .

dag: O zaŋ bin suma dihi ma n ni yɛn be saha shɛli puuni, ka di chɛ ka m bipolitali kpiɔŋ labina kaman tɔrili kpiɔŋ la.
en: He gives us plenty of good things. He makes us young again, like an eagle that grows new feathers.

dag: A daa tɛhiya ni nyini n-kul yɛn su nam sahakam, ka bi tɛhi a suhu ni ni di nyɛla shɛli bee n-tɛhi di zaa ni ti yɛn bahindi shɛm.
en: You thought you would always be a queen, and did not take these things to heart or think how it all would end.

dag: Giliad nyɛla tuumbiɛrinim tiŋa, ka ninvuɣ kubo kul pali nimaani.
en: Gilead is a city of people who do evil— people who have tricked and killed others.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ nina ni ti nya dimbɔŋɔ, ka yɛli, Yawɛ galisiya Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaŋ tabili tinduya ni.
en: You people saw these things, and you said, The Lord is great, even outside of Israel.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kul karim gbaŋ shɛli din yi Naa Atazɛrikisɛs sanna maa n-wuhi Rɛhum mini Shimshai ni bɛ tab la, bɛ daa dii zola yomyom chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm nti zaŋ kpiɔŋ muɣisi Yɛhudianim maa ka bɛ chɛ mɛbu.
en: As soon as this letter from Emperor Artaxerxes was read to Rehum, Shimshai, and their associates, they hurried to Jerusalem and forced the Jews to stop rebuilding the city.

dag: Kɔhat bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Aminadab mini Kɔra ni Asir.
en: These were Kohaths descendants: Amminadab was Kohaths son. Korah was Amminadabs son. Assir was Korahs son.

dag: Ka dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa daa yi chani naa Sulemaana sani ti wumdi Naawuni ni daa zaŋ yɛm shɛli niŋ o suhu ni maa yɛtɔɣa.
en: People everywhere wanted to see King Solomon. They wanted to hear the great wisdom that God had given him.

dag: O daa laɣim teeku kom kaman luɣuluɣu ni kom la n-sɔŋ luɣ yini. O daa nam bula niŋ di biɛhigu shɛhi.
en: He gathered together the water of the sea. He put the ocean in its place.

dag: ti bɔh o, Ŋun yiko ni ka a lee tumdi dimbɔŋɔnima bee ŋuni n-lee ti a di yiko maa.
en: They said, Tell us: What kind of authority do you have for doing these things? Who gave you this authority.

dag: A paɣ ni ŋmanila ti shɛli din wandi wala a yiŋ puuni. A bihi ni ŋmanila olivi tia wula n-ʒi n-gil a, ka yi laɣim diri ŋman yini ni.
en: At home, your wife will have many children, like a vine full of grapes. The children around your table will be like an orchard full of olive trees.

dag: O ni daa ti paai nimaani n-nya ka sapashinnim ʒiya tɔri jina, ka o yɛli, Sapashini, m malila yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni n yɛl a. Ka Jɛhu bɔh o, Ti ni ŋuni ka a lee yɛri maa? Ka o yɛli Jɛhu, N dana, nyini ka n yɛri maa.
en: When the young man arrived, he saw the captains of the army sitting. He said, Captain, I have a message for you. Jehu asked, Which one of us is the message for? The young man said, For you, sir.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daba ayi ka Yɛhudianim maa daa to jina yɛli ni bɛ kum Sool.
en: Later some of them made plans to kill Saul.

dag: Ŋun wuhiri shɛli omaŋmaŋ yiko ni bɔrila omaŋmaŋ jilima nyabu, amaa ŋun bɔri ŋun tim o na jilima nyabu nyɛla yɛlimaŋlilana, ka ʒiri ka o nol ni.
en: Those who speak on their own authority are trying to gain glory for themselves. But he who wants glory for the one who sent him is honest, and there is nothing false in him.

dag: Bɛ daa chaŋ Nɛgɛb n-zaŋ ti paai Hiburɔn, ka Ahiman mini Shɛshai ni Talimai bɛn daa nyɛ Anaki zuliya niriba la daa be nimaani. .
en: They went first into the southern part of the land and came to Hebron, where the clans of Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the descendants of a race of giants called the Anakim, lived.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ yi lan lo ni yi zaŋ Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm dɔbba mini paɣiba zaa leei yi daba. Yi bi mi ni yi gba tumla alahichi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani maa?.
en: If you make slaves of the people of Judah and Jerusalem, you will be as guilty as they are of sinning against the Lord .

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, daboya mini zoya zuɣu buɣa jɛmbu nyɛla yɔhiŋ. Yɛlimaŋli, Izraɛlnim tiliginsim bela Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: We were not helped at all by our pagan worship on the hilltops. Help for Israel comes only from the Lord our God.

dag: So bi lan nyuri wain ka yiini yila; ka binnyuri kpɛma leei din to bɛn nyuri li sani.
en: They no longer sing as they drink their wine, and it tastes sour.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim daa yila Gaat tiyaawumyanim la zuliya ni na. Ka Dauda min o niriba daa ku ba.
en: These were descended from the Raphah in Gath, and they fell by the hands of David and his servants.

dag: Shɛlini, sagbani maa daa yi zaani Yawɛ jɛmbu shee maa zuɣusaa la dabisa biɛla, ka bɛ daa doli Yawɛ zaligu ni wuhi shɛm kpalim doya, di nyaaŋa ka bɛ ti lan doli Yawɛ zaligu maa ni wuhi shɛm yiɣisi chaŋ.
en: Sometimes the cloud remained over the Tent for only a few days; in any case, they remained in camp or moved, according to the command of the Lord .

dag: A kpahiri karimbaannim bɛn mali taali ka bi dol a zaligunim la zuɣu ni.
en: You rebuke the arrogant, accursed people who stray from your commandments.

dag: Nyin biɛŋmariga ŋun ne pam ŋɔ, nyam a ni yi zuɣusaa lu tiŋ na shɛm! Nyin ŋun daa dihi zuliya pam vi ŋɔ, bɛ daag a luhi tiŋa.
en: King of Babylon, bright morning star, you have fallen from heaven! In the past you conquered nations, but now you have been thrown to the ground.

dag: Yawɛ, m bela muɣisigu pam ni ka kumdi niŋd a.
en: Lord , I am in deep trouble, so I am calling to you for help.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be o sani daa vu m-miri ni bɛ ti tuhi Sirianim maa, ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi guui.
en: When Joab and the troops who were with him advanced into battle against the Arameans, they fled from him.

dag: ka kɔrigi noombil yino niŋ ko viɛlli din be yaɣiri duɣu ni.
en: He will kill one bird in a clay bowl over running water.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa daa chaŋ fɔŋ maa ni nti shiri nya Yisa ni yɛli ba shɛm maa zaa, ka mali Yaɣigari Chuɣu maa bindirigu dibu shili.
en: The two disciples went into the city and found everything just as Jesus had told them. So they prepared the Passover meal.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nuhi bi tum daɣiri tuma mini daɣiri ni ka shɛb suhuri ni, ka bɛ bi jɛmdi buɣa, ka mi bi doli yɔhiŋgu soli alikauli lɔbu ni.
en: Only those who have not done evil, who have pure hearts, who have not used my name to hide their lies, and who have not made false promises.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛn biriti ka kumdi ti chɛ bɛ ni biri shɛli maa ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Let those who wept as they planted their crops, gather the harvest with joy!.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Bɛ ni yɛli shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu, pumpɔŋɔ n yɛn chɛmi ka n yɛligu din yiri a noli ni na be kaman buɣim la, ka niriba maa mi be kaman dari la, ka buɣim maa di ba.
en: The Lord God All-Powerful said these things: The people said I would not punish them. So, Jeremiah, the words I give you will be like fire, and these people will be like wood. That fire will burn them up completely.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni ti jɛmdi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ mini Dauda ŋun nyɛ bɛ na so n ni yɛn pii ti ba la.
en: The people of Israel and Judah will not serve foreign countries. No, they will serve the Lord their God. I will send them David their king, and they will serve him.

dag: Dama Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, N ni be m biɛhigu shee ka lihina baalim kaman maligim ni lurina yuŋ kachɛɣu saha shɛm ni kaman biisim ni be wuntaŋ ni shɛm la.
en: The Lord said to me, I will calmly look down from my home above— as calmly as the sun at noon or clouds in the heat of harvest season.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, Alizin biɛɣu bi ʒi n zuɣu; n tirila m Ba Naawuni jilima, amaa ka yinim lee ʒiɛmdi ma.
en: Jesus answered, I have no demon in me. I give honor to my Father, but you give no honor to me.

dag: N tuhi tuhiri suŋ; n zo tizɔbo la naai; n gbib yɛda niŋbu la.
en: I have fought the good fight, finished the race, and kept the faith.

dag: Ka n daa chɛ ka tabilakpihi lu bɛ zuɣu n-dim kari Amɔrinim nanima ayi la bahi; ka di daa pala yi takɔbiri bee yi tɔbiri zuɣu.
en: I sent the hornet before you. It drove them out before you and did the same to the two kings of the Amorites. It wasnt your sword or bow that did this.

dag: O yi kul ko o kɔbu, o biritila o bimbira din nyɛ nili mini buŋgu, ka biri alikama doli vuɣisi, ka biri chi di biribu shee, ka biri binshɛŋa din pahi dolisi putarisi.
en: When a field is ready, they scatter the seeds of dill and cumin; they plant the seeds of wheat and barley in the proper places and sow other grains around the edges.

dag: Kɔz daa nyɛla Anub mini Zɔbɛba ba, ka daa lan nyɛ Harum bia Aharihɛl daŋ niriba yaba.
en: Koz was the father of Anub and Hazzobebah. Koz also was the father of the tribes of Aharhel. Aharhel was Harums son.

dag: Na shɛb bɛn daa di Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ nam hal ka Izraɛlnim ti naanyi mali nanima yuya m-bɔŋɔ. Bɛɔr bia Bɛla ŋun ya daa nyɛ Dinhaba la.
en: These were the kings who ruled in the land of Edom before any king ruled over the Israelites: Bela, Beors son, whose city was called Dinhabah.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa Yisa ni daa baŋ ni binshɛɣukam niŋya naai maa ka o daa yɛli, Kɔnyuri mali ma. O daa yɛlila lala ni di chɛ ka Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali.
en: Later, Jesus knew that everything had been done. To make the Scriptures come true he said, I am thirsty.

dag: Ka sokam ni ti jɛn ya n yuli zuɣu. Amaa ŋunkam ti niŋ suhukpeeni hal ni wahala ŋɔ bahigu ni ti tiligi.
en: Everyone will hate you because of my name. But whoever stands firm until the end will be saved.

dag: dama yi ni kariti tab saria shɛm, lala ka Naawuni ni ti kari yi gba saria, ka yi ni buɣisiri tiri yi tab shɛm, lala ka Naawuni ni ti buɣisi ti yi gba.
en: for God will judge you in the same way you judge others, and he will apply to you the same rules you apply to others.

dag: Dansarika so daa beni ka o yuli booni Barabas; o daa nyɛla bɛn daa taai duŋ ku nir ni yino.
en: At that time a man named Barabbas was in prison with the rebels who had committed murder in the riot.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mbusim paai Nɛbonima, di zani dabari. Kiriataimnim di vi, bɛ ŋme n-deei li. Bɛ daai di goondaa luhi n-dihi ba vi.
en: This is what the Lord Almighty said about Moab: Pity the people of Nebo— their town is destroyed! Kiriathaim is captured, its mighty fortress torn down, and its people put to shame;.

dag: Tuumba ayi maa ni daa ti yɛn dɔni gbihi saha shɛli, ka Reehab du bɛ sani dufahirili maa zuɣusaa.
en: Before the spies bedded down, Rahab went up to them on the roof.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yisa n-zaŋ mɛɛr maa mini aloosi tia sum maa n-niŋ o, ka bo bimpiɛlli niŋ o kaman Yɛhudianim kum sɔɣibu kali ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: The two men took Jesus' body and wrapped it in linen cloths with the spices according to the Jewish custom of preparing a body for burial.

dag: Ka n ni chɛ ka m min a ni a zuliya mali alikauli din ni ʒiɛya sahakam bɛ ʒiɛmana ni. Ka n ni nyɛ a min a zuliya maa Naawuni.
en: I will always keep the promise I have made to you and your descendants, because I am your God and their God.

dag: Dansarika so daa beni ka o yuli booni Barabas; o daa nyɛla bɛn daa taai duŋ ku nir ni yino.
en: A man named Barabbas was locked up with the rebels who had committed murder during an uprising.

dag: Ka Naa Azaria daa me Ɛlat n-labisi li ti Judanima, o ba kum maa nyaaŋa.
en: He rebuilt Elath, restoring it to Judah after King Amaziah had lain down with his ancestors.

dag: Mɔɣu ni biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn mali karimbaani na ʒi n-dol li, ka gbuɣinli gba na ʒi n-dol li.
en: they walk on soil unknown to the proudest lions.

dag: Ka naa yɛl o, Ŋmaligim zani kpaŋ kpe. Ka o daa ŋmaligi zani kpaŋa.
en: Stand over there, the king told him; and he went over and stood there.

dag: Tiŋgbani maa sɔhigiya ka dam, dama Yawɛ ni lo nia ni o chɛ ka Babilɔn zani dabari, ka so ku lan be di ni la n-yɛn niŋ pali.
en: The earth trembles and shakes because the Lord is carrying out his plan to make Babylonia a desert, where no one lives.

dag: Ka Simiɔn bidibisi daa nyɛ: Jɛmuɛl mini Jamin ni Ohad ni Jachin ni Zɔhar ni Shaul ŋun daa nyɛ Keenan paɣ bia la.
en: Simeon and his sons: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul, the son of a Canaanite woman.

dag: ka po Naawuni ŋun ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu, ka nyɛ ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni ni dunia ŋɔ mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni ni teeku mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni ŋɔ n-yɛli ni guhibu lan kani.
en: He swore by the one who lives forever and always, who created heaven and what is in it, the earth and what is in it, and the sea and what is in it, and said, The time is up.

dag: Dama ŋun nyɛ Yɛhudia la palɔni kɔŋko pala Yɛhudia alali, ka gunibu maŋli mi pala din niŋ niŋgbuŋ palɔni kɔŋko.
en: After all, who is a real Jew, truly circumcised? It is not the man who is a Jew on the outside, whose circumcision is a physical thing.

dag: Ka so yi wum n yɛligu ka bi dol li, n ku kar o saria, dama m bi kamina ni n ti kari dunianim saria, amaa n kamina ni n ti tiligi dunianima.
en: If people hear my words and dont keep them, I dont judge them. I didnt come to judge the world but to save it.

dag: Dama Naawuni nam yɛla pala yɛtɔɣa kɔŋko, amaa di nyɛla yiko yɛla.
en: Gods kingdom isnt about words but about power.

dag: Ka bɛ ni booi kpam bahi maligumaana so zuɣu ni ti zaŋ naɣilaa maa ʒim kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni.
en: The priest will take a bowl of the animal's blood inside the sacred tent.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ni ŋme n-wurim o dimnim la zuɣuri, o ni saɣim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣisi ka kul doli bɛ daalahichi soya la zuɣutalisi.
en: God will smash the heads of his enemies. He will punish those who fight against him.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, N yilikpɛrinima, yi nya zahim? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Aai.
en: Then he asked them, Young men, haven't you caught anything? Not a thing, they answered.

dag: ni a doli zaligu biɛr kasi puuni, ka ku mali galimi di ni hal ti paai ti Duuma Yisa Masia ni ti yɛn yi palo dahin shɛl la.
en: Do what you were commanded to do without fault or blame until the time when our Lord Jesus Christ comes again.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, n ni darigi a tibili ka di dol a suhuyiɣisili min a nyuli zabbu ni a ni je ba shɛm la soli. N yi kar a saria, n ni chɛ ka a baŋ n ni nyɛ so.
en: and as surely as I live, I will punish you for treating my people with anger and hatred. Then they will know that I, the Lord , am punishing you!.

dag: Pool ni daa yɛl lala naai ka zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro n-suhi Naawuni daalibarika niŋ di ni bɛ zaa ninni, ka zaŋ li ŋubi.
en: After he said these things, he took bread, gave thanks to God in front of them all, then broke it and began to eat.

dag: Ka Sool daa yi kul tim Dauda luɣ shɛlikam zaa, o ti nyarila nasara, lala zuɣu ka Sool daa zaŋ Dauda leei tɔbbihi zuɣulana, ka lala daa tiɣi niriba zaa nini, ka lan tiɣi Sool tumtumdiba zaa nini.
en: David went out and was successful in every mission Saul sent him to do. So Saul placed him in charge of the soldiers, and this pleased all the troops as well as Sauls servants.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa gbahi bɛ mabihi Judanim maa niriba tuhi kɔbisiyi bɛn daa nyɛ paɣiba mini bidibisi ni bipuɣinsi, ka di nɛma pam n-zaŋ kuli Samaria.
en: Even though the Judeans were their own relatives, the Israelite army captured , women and children as prisoners and took them back to Samaria, along with large amounts of loot.

dag: Wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa, ti kul suhir o ni o chɛ ka ti mini ya lan nya taba, ka ti tooi zaŋ din pooi ya yi yɛda niŋbu ni la sɔŋ ya.
en: Day and night we ask him with all our heart to let us see you personally and supply what is needed in your faith.

dag: Ka Tɛkɔanim daa mali me m-pani bɛ zuɣu, amaa ka bɛ nabihi bɛn daa zaɣisi ni bɛ ku zaŋ bɛ nyɔɣu yo bɛ kpamba tuma.
en: Next to them the people from Tekoa made repairs, but their officials wouldnt help with the work of their supervisors.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri lɔri nia biɛri zaŋ chaŋ wuntizɔriba polo, ka dimdi bɛ nyina niŋdi ba.
en: Merciless people make plots against good people and snarl like animals.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi bɔhi ba, Wuntaŋ puhibu saha zaŋ ti paag o lua saha pala awa pinaayi? Dinzuɣu ŋunkam chani wuntaŋ ni bi tuura, ka di nyɛla o ni nyari dunia ŋɔ neesim la zuɣu.
en: Jesus answered, Aren't there twelve hours in each day? If you walk during the day, you will have light from the sun, and you won't stumble.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri suhuri kul yɛla ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma zuɣu, amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn nyaɣa nyɛla din tahiri wala na.
en: All that wicked people want is to find evil things to do, but the righteous stand firm.

dag: Aduna bidib shɛb bɛ ni daa pii ka booi kpam bahi bɛ zuɣu ni ni bɛ leei maligumaaniba n-tumdi tuma maligumaana tuma duu yuya m-bala.
en: These sons were the chosen priests. They were given the special work of serving the Lord as priests.

dag: Ka o yɛli salo maa ni bɛ ʒinim tiŋa; ka daa zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro kpila ayopɔin maa niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka ŋmahiŋmahi li ti o nyaandoliba maa ni bɛ zaŋ li tari salo maa; ka bɛ daa zaŋ li tari salo maa zaa.
en: He ordered the crowd to sit down on the ground. Then he took the seven loaves, gave thanks to God, broke them, and gave them to his disciples to distribute to the crowd; and the disciples did so.

dag: Ka Akishi daa yi bɔh o, Banim ka a lee liri zuŋɔ? Dauda yɛr o mi, Nɛgɛb din be Juda tiŋgban ni la nim ka n liri. Bee ŋun yɛli, Nɛgɛb din be Jɛramiil polo la nim ka n liri bee Nɛgɛb din be Kɛn tiŋgban ni la nim ka n liri.
en: who would ask him, Where did you go on a raid this time? and David would tell him that he had gone to the southern part of Judah or to the territory of the clan of Jerahmeel or to the territory where the Kenites lived.

dag: Wuntizɔra yɛtɔɣa nyɛla naa ni yu shɛli, ka o yuri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛri yɛlimaŋli.
en: Kings want to hear the truth. They like those who are honest.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba maa bidibisi mi daa su tulaalɛnim maa zaŋ gari tab tuma fukumsi.
en: But the responsibility for mixing the spices belonged to the priests.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun zaŋ o tɛha niŋ o ninsalitali biɛhigu yɛla ni nyɛla Naawuni dima, dama o bi doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu, hal ka shiri ku tooi dol li.
en: Our desires fight against God, because they do not and cannot obey God's laws.

dag: N yura nyɛla n ni su so, ka n gba nyɛ o ni su so. O zaŋd o biŋkɔbbaligu chani ka bɛ ti ŋubiri mɔri Paɣiviɛligakushihikom puuni.
en: My darling, I am yours, and you are mine, as you feed your sheep among the lilies.

dag: m bilim ni ka bɛ pun nahindi ma pam. Amaa bɛ bi tooi nyaŋ ma.
en: Ever since I was young, my enemies have persecuted me cruelly, but they have not overcome me.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ni zaŋ o piɛma to ba; bɛ ni nya dansi ka di libigi ba.
en: But God will shoot his arrows and quickly wound them.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, A ni tam n yɛla, ka zaŋ ma niŋ a baɣaka zuɣu, dim a pagɔrisigu min a kɔre tuma maa nyɔri.
en: You have completely rejected me, and so I promise that you will be punished for the disgusting things you did as a prostitute.

dag: O ni daa na kul yɛri maa, ka so lan paana ti yɛli A bidibisi la min a bipuɣinsi la bela bɛ biɛlikpɛm la yiŋ diri bindira, ka nyuri wain.
en: Before he had finished speaking, another servant came and said, Your children were having a feast at the home of your oldest son.

dag: Ka so yi ti yi a yiŋ maa ni na m-be soli zuɣu chana, dilan kum taali ni ti ŋmaligi ʒila omaŋmaŋ zuɣu, ka ti nuu kani. Amaa so yi ti ku bɛn be a sani a yiŋ maa puuni, dilan kum taali ni ti ʒila ti zuɣu.
en: If anyone goes out of the house, his death will be his own fault, and we will not be responsible; but if anyone in the house with you is harmed, then we will be responsible.

dag: Di fɔntinsi leela dabiɛm shee. Di nyɛla saa ni bi miri tiŋgban shɛl ni, ka lan nyɛ tiŋgban nɛli. So lan ka tiŋgbani maa ni, ka so mi bi lan doli nimaani garita.
en: Her towns are devastated; her land is scorched and barren, a place where no one lives or dares to pass through.

dag: Ŋun daa pah ayɔbu n-su gol so ŋun pah ayɔbu ni n-daa nyɛ Ira. O daa nyɛla Ikɛsh ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛkɔa nir la bia; ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi ka o daa su.
en: in the sixth month, Ira the son of Ikkesh from Tekoa;.

dag: O mi o ni yɛn ŋmahi kuɣ viɛla shɛm kpɛhi binyara ni, ka lan mi dari zaŋ kpe m-mali binyɛra mini nuhi tuumbaŋsim kam.
en: He can cut and set beautiful jewels. And he can work with wood. He can do all kinds of work.

dag: Di daba ayɔbu nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa zaŋ Pita mini Jeemsi ni Jɔn pah omaŋ zuɣu du zo shɛli din du pam zuɣu bɛ kɔŋko; bɛ nini maa ni ka Yisa niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu daa taɣi.
en: Six days later, Jesus took Peter, James, and John and went up on a high mountain. They were all alone there. While these followers watched him, Jesus was changed.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yooi n tiba, ka m mi bi niŋ tipawumli bee n-lab nyaaŋa.
en: The Lord GOD helps me learn, and I have not turned against him. I will not stop following him.

dag: Naa yi doli zaligu soli n-kariti nandaamba saria, o nam ni zani yuui.
en: If a king defends the rights of the poor, he will rule for a long time.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Sulemaana.
en: The LORDs word came to Solomon.

dag: Ka Musa daa kɔŋ Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa ni kpɛbu sagbani maa ni daa sirigina ti pil li maa mini Yawɛ jilima ni daa pal o biɛhigu shee maa zuɣu.
en: Moses could not go into the Meeting Tent because the cloud had settled on it, and the Glory of the Lord had filled the Holy Tent.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, Alizin biɛɣu bi ʒi n zuɣu; n tirila m Ba Naawuni jilima, amaa ka yinim lee ʒiɛmdi ma.
en: I have no demon, Jesus answered. I honor my Father, but you dishonor me.

dag: Nyama, n kpahi n nuhi bah a zuɣu a ni zaŋ zalinsi soya nya bun shɛŋa maa min a ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb a ni la zuɣu.
en: I will shake my fist in anger at your violent crimes.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ binnyɔɣ shɛli a ni zaŋ gahi zuɣusaa maa mini maligumaaniba leebu piɛlaa maa gbalipuɣ shɛli a ni zaŋ gahi zuɣusaa maa ti Aduna min o bidibisi maa.
en: Make holy the breast that was lifted for the uplifted offering and the thigh that was raised for the gift offering from the ram for the ordination. They belong to Aaron and his sons.

dag: Nir yi guni bee o yi bi guni di zaa pa shɛli, amaa Naawuni zaligu dolibu n-nyɛ din mali buchi.
en: Circumcision is nothing; not being circumcised is nothing. What matters is keeping Gods commandments.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ jilima daa yi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dunɔbia zuɣu n-chaŋ ti zani chɛrubinim maa zuɣusaa.
en: Then the LORDs glory went out from above the temples threshold and it stood over the winged creatures.

dag: Ka bɛn daa guli kuruchunim maa nya din niŋ maa, ka zo n-chaŋ ti yɛli fɔnnim mini tiŋkpannima dinkam daa niŋ maa zaa.
en: The men who had been taking care of the pigs saw what happened, so they ran off and spread the news in the town and among the farms.

dag: Amaa Yisa daa lan tum tuun shɛŋa pam pahi, ka di yɛla bi sabi niŋ kpe. Di zaa yi di sabi, n tɛhi n suhu ni ni di litaafinim naan ku nya palo dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: There are many other things that Jesus did. If every one of them were written down, I think the whole world would not be big enough for all the books that would be written.

dag: Anabi Aizaia ni daa nya Yisa jilima zuɣu ka o daa yɛl o yɛla lala maa.
en: Isaiah said this because he saw Jesus divine greatness. So he spoke about him.

dag: Luɣ shɛlikam zaa daa zibigimi agbaa dɛde zaŋ ti paai kurig ata saha.
en: At noon the sky turned dark and stayed that way until three o'clock.

dag: A yɛliya ni a ni du nti tam sagbana zuɣu n-zaŋ amaŋ leei kaman Zallakudura Naa.
en: You said you would climb to the tops of the clouds and be like the Almighty.

dag: Ka n daa yiɣisi ni n yoog o ka o gari. N ni daa zaŋ n nuu gbaai bɛ ni gbaari binshɛli yoori dunoli ni n yooi, n nuhi daa puɣila mɛɛr zim, ka n nubihi daa tɔɣiri mɛɛr kom.
en: I was ready to let him come in. My hands were covered with myrrh, my fingers with liquid myrrh, as I grasped the handle of the door.

dag: Bɛna n-daa kana ti zani Musa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza ni kpamba ni salo zaa tooni Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni yɛli.
en: They stood before Moses, Eleazar the priest, the chiefs, and the entire community at the entrance of the meeting tent and said.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ ni shɛb daa yɛli, Alizin biɛri naa ŋun yuli booni Biilzibul la n-niŋ o yiko ka o kariti alizin biɛri bahiri maa.
en: But some of the people said, He uses the power of Satan to force demons out of people. Satan is the ruler of demons.

dag: Amaa biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn gbuɣiri ŋubira, ka bɛ takarifiɛma bi wɔrigi, yin di ŋubiya ba. Bɛna n-nyɛ laakuma mini soonsi ni ŋɔŋa, dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn gbuɣiri ŋubira, amaa bɛ ka takarifiɛma din wɔrigi, bɛ nyɛla bɛn bi be nyam yi sani.
en: However, heres a list of animals that either rechew food or have hooves divided in two parts that you are not allowed to eat: the camel, the hare, and the rock badger—because these rechew food but dont have divided hoofs, they are off-limits for you.

dag: Sokam nyɛla jɛra ka ka yɛm. Salima machɛlinim zaa ni di vi bɛ ni mali buɣ shɛŋa la zuɣu; dama bɛ binnana maa nyɛla ʒiri binnana ka bi vuhira.
en: People who make idols are stupid! They will be disappointed, because their false gods cannot breathe.

dag: A ni tiligi pagɔrili ŋun nyɛ zinalana naŋgbammalisim ni.
en: Wisdom will protect you from the smooth talk of a sinful woman.

dag: Ti Duuma, bɛ ŋmanila zahindi shɛli nir ni yi zahim ka neei la, o yi neei di bemi kaman shilinshia la.
en: As quickly as a dream departs from someone waking up, my Lord, when you are stirred up, you make them disappear.

dag: Dinzuɣu yinim Izraɛlnima, wummiya, ka dol li viɛnyɛliŋga din ni chɛ ka binshɛɣukam niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani, ka yi nab pam pahi tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam ŋɔ ni kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛm la.
en: Listen to them, Israel! Follow them carefully so that things will go well for you and so that you will continue to multiply exactly as the LORD, your ancestors God, promised you, in a land full of milk and honey.

dag: Lala ka yi ni ti niŋ yi mini tiŋ shɛŋa din wɔɣa ni taba, ka pa zuliya shɛb bɛn be kpe ŋɔ tinsi la nima.
en: That is how you are to deal with those cities that are far away from the land you will settle in.

dag: Dama ti kul nyɛla sɔhila niriba, ka bi mi shɛli; ti biɛhigu dunia ŋɔ ni ŋmanila mahim din vuura.
en: for we are only recently here and dont know because our days on earth are a shadow.

dag: Kaman nɔhi ni pali nɔsuɣu shɛm la, lala ka bɛ di nɛma ti pali bɛ yinsi. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ leei wɔɣira ni bundaamba.
en: You are evil, and you lie and cheat to make yourselves rich. You are powerful.

dag: Dama di simdi ni yɛm yɛtɔɣa yiri maligumaana nol ni na, ka niriba ni bɔr o wuhibu, dama o nyɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ tumo.
en: A priest should know Gods teachings. People should be able to go to a priest and learn Gods teachings. A priest should be the Lord s messenger to the people.

dag: Amaa alahichi sanyoo sara maligu maa biŋkɔbigu kpam min o binyaannina ni binsabili yaɣ shɛli din viɛla, o daa zaŋ li nyola buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu kaman Naawuni ni daa zali Musa shɛm.
en: But he sent up in smoke the fat, the kidneys, and the lower part of the liver, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.

dag: O ni ti deei yi bindira mini yi wain tihi wala pirigibu bupia kam puuni vaabu yim ti o kpambaliba min o tumtumdiba.
en: He will take one-tenth of your grain and grapes, and he will give them to his officers and servants.

dag: Bɛ ni daa me bɛ yiya dunoya baɣili n dunoli, ka bɛ dunɔpaɣira baɣi n dunɔpaɣira, ka gooni daa be m mini ba sunsuuni saha shɛl la ka bɛ daa tum din chihira n-saɣim n yuli din be kasi ŋɔ. Dinzuɣu ka n daa ku ba n suhuyiɣisili puuni maa.
en: When they set their plazas with mine and their doorposts next to mine, the wall was between us. They defiled my holy name with their detestable practices, so I consumed them in my anger.

dag: Ka ŋun maligumaana Ɛliɛza zaŋ o nubil tim o ʒim ni n-zaŋ li mihi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la tooni polo siɣimsiɣim buyopɔin.
en: Then Eleazar is to take some of its blood and with his finger sprinkle it seven times in the direction of the Tent.

dag: Ka di mundili din mali yaa daa leei nam jaaŋgbee, ka daa zooi zuɣusaa tibɔŋ ni, ka di daa niŋ wɔɣilim, ka mali wula pam.
en: and she produced mighty branches, fit for rulers scepters. She grew tall, and her crown went up between the clouds. Because of her height and thick growth, she became conspicuous.

dag: Dama mani n-daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na, ka fan ya dabitim bandi ni bahi, ka daa chɛ ka Musa mini Aduna ni Miriam nyɛ yi toondaannima.
en: I brought you up out of the land of Egypt; I redeemed you from the house of slavery. I sent Moses, Aaron, and Miriam before you.

dag: Alɔbɔnim ŋɔ ka Yawɛ ti yɛn chɛ ka di di ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lo tɔbu na ni bɛ ti tuhi Jɛrusalɛm. Bɛ ti yɛn nɛmi ka bɛ niŋgbuna piligi poobu; ka bɛ nina ti be bɛ nimbɔɣa ni ka piligi poobu; ka bɛ zilima gba ti be bɛ noya ni ka piligi poobu.
en: This will be the plague with which the LORD will strike all the peoples who swarmed against Jerusalem: their flesh will rot, even while standing on their feet; their eyes will rot in their sockets; and their tongues will rot in their mouths.

dag: Amaa ka Zɛruya bia Abishai daa kana ti sɔŋ Dauda n-ku Filistia doo maa. Di saha ka Dauda niriba maa daa po pɔri yɛl o, A ku lan doli ti chaŋ tɔb ni, di yi pa lala a ni ti chɛ ka Izraɛlnim firila kpi.
en: But Abishai son of Zeruiah came to David's help, attacked the giant, and killed him. Then David's men made David promise that he would never again go out with them to battle. You are the hope of Israel, and we don't want to lose you, they said.

dag: Zaŋmiya gali sabilifaa n-she biŋgolinsi niŋ tuuli pateesa la naŋgbambili, ka lan niŋ pateesa shɛli din pah ayi naŋgbambili gba lala.
en: Make loops of blue thread on the edge of the outer curtain in the first set. Do the same on the edge of the outer curtain in the second set.

dag: Dama ti Duuma nina kul kpala wuntizɔriba, ka o tiba kul wumdi be suhigu. Amaa ti Duuma kul lihirila bɛn tumdi tuumbiɛri nimbiɛɣu.
en: The Lords eyes are on the righteous and his ears are open to their prayers. But the Lord cannot tolerate those who do evil. .

dag: O ti ku zaŋ o ni ŋubiri o bi shɛb maa nim shɛli ti bɛ ni so, dama o ti ku lan mali binshɛli yaha yi dimnim maa ni teei gili ya, ka niŋdi ya alaka shɛli yi fɔntinsi zaa ni maa zuɣu.
en: He wont want to give them any of his childrens flesh that he will be eating because he has no other food due to the desperate and dire circumstances that your enemy has brought on you in all your cities.

dag: Dunianim mini zuɣusaa binnamda, maliya suhupiɛlli; teeku mini binnɛma bɛn be di ni, yomiya vuri;.
en: Tell the heavens and the earth to be glad and celebrate! Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ fɔŋ maa ni nti shiri nya Yisa ni yɛli ba shɛm maa zaa, ka mali Yaɣigari Chuɣu maa bindirigu dibu shili.
en: They went off and found everything just as Jesus had told them, and they prepared the Passover meal.

dag: hal n ni kul yɛli ni biɛhiŋ kani wuntizɔriba ni be maa zaa yoli, bɛ yi niŋ bɛ wuntitali maa naani ka tum alahichi, n ku lan teei bɛ wuntitali tuun shɛli yɛla. Amaa bɛ ni kpi bɛ ni tum alahichi shɛŋa maa puuni.
en: I may promise life to someone good, but if he starts thinking that his past goodness is enough and begins to sin, I will not remember any of the good he did. He will die because of his sins.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti di biŋgbamda bɛn gbamdi tiŋgban ni ŋɔ n-filim yimaŋa, ka miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka bɛ saɣim ya, di yi pa lala yi ni leei bɛn be daɣiri ni.
en: Dont let them make you filthy. You must not become unclean.

dag: Piligu ni, Naawuni daa namla zuɣusaa mini dunia.
en: When God began to create the heavens and the earth.

dag: Ka Goma bidibisi daa nyɛ: Ashikɛnaz mini Rifat ni Tɔgarima.
en: The descendants of Gomer were the people of Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.

dag: Ka ŋun Yawɛ daa zaŋ o nuu din mali yaa ka teeg o bɔɣu n-tum yiko tuma din mali dabiɛm, ka tum alahiziba tuma ka wuhi shihira n-yihi ti Ijipti maa.
en: Then you terrified the Egyptians with your mighty miracles and rescued us from Egypt.

dag: Firawuna kpambaliba ni daa nya o, bɛ daa paɣ o pam Firawuna sani. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o tahi Firawuna yiŋa.
en: Even some of Pharaohs officials noticed her and told Pharaoh how beautiful she was. So they took her to Pharaohs house.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yooi n tiba, ka m mi bi niŋ tipawumli bee n-lab nyaaŋa.
en: The Lord has given me understanding, and I have not rebelled or turned away from him.

dag: Ham bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Kush mini Ijipti ni Put ni Keenan.
en: Hams sons were Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

dag: N dɔni n gom shee yuŋ tɛhi n suhu ni yuri so pam yɛla; m bo o, amaa ka bi nya o.
en: Upon my bed, night after night, I looked for the one whom I love with all my heart. I looked for him but couldnt find him.

dag: ka yɛli, N dana, a nini yi tiɣi ma, yin zanim mani yi dabili ŋɔ sani.
en: and said, Please come to my home where I can serve you.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa deei Liya suhigu ka o niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga ŋun pah anu ti Yaakubu.
en: God responded to Leah. She became pregnant and gave birth to a fifth son for Jacob.

dag: Taali sanyoo sara maligu zaligu m-bɔŋɔ. Di nyɛla din be kasi zaa.
en: The following are the regulations for repayment offerings, which are very holy.

dag: Jɛrusalɛmnima, deemiya saɣisigu, di yi pa lala n ni je suli ŋ-ŋmaligi ka chɛn ya, ka chɛ ka yi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zani dabari, ka so ku lan be di ni.
en: Listen to this warning, Jerusalem, or I will turn my back on you. I will make your land an empty desert. No one will be able to live there.

dag: Di zaŋ ma pahi ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn tumdi tuumbiɛri ni dari ma chaŋ, bɛn tɔɣisiri bɛ ʒiʒiinitab suhudoo yɛtɔɣa, amaa ka jɛlinsi be bɛ suhuri ni la.
en: Do not condemn me with the wicked, with those who do evil— those whose words are friendly, but who have hatred in their hearts.

dag: Amaa ka o yɛl o, A tizo pun kana ti yɔhim ma deeg a daalibarika.
en: Isaac said, Your brother has already come deceitfully and has taken your blessing.

dag: N ni zaŋ ya bahi kaman pɔhim din yi tiŋgban nɛli polo na ni ʒiɛri wurigu bahiri shɛm la.
en: I will force you to leave your homes. You will run in all directions. You will be like chaff blown away by the desert wind.

dag: Dama Aram mini Ifriim zuliya ni Rɛmalia bia maa lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ yi polo ka yɛra.
en: and made plans against you. They said.

dag: ka yɛli Samsin, Man daa tɛhiya ni a lan je o mi, ka zaŋ o ti a daaŋgo zo la. O tizɔbil ŋɔ viɛli gar o, dinzuɣu jaande, zaŋm o tizɔbil maa ka chɛ o.
en: He said, I thought you hated her, so I let her marry the best man at the wedding. Her younger sister is more beautiful. Take her younger sister.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ Naa Dauda piligu ni o bahigu tuma zaa sab bela anabi Samuɛl yɛlikura yɛla teebu litaafi ni, ka lan sab be anabi Neetan mini anabi Gaad yɛlikura yɛla teebu litaafinim ni.
en: The things that King David did, from beginning to end, are in the books written by Samuel the seer, Nathan the prophet, and Gad the seer.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim daa yiɣisi chaŋ ti dɔni Mɔab bɔpiɛligu ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli zaŋ lab Jɛriko polo.
en: Israel moved from there to the hills of Moab, where they camped across the Jordan River from the town of Jericho.

dag: Tɛma kɔhigɔriba lihirimi bɔri kom, ka Shiiba sochandiba mali tahima ni bɛ gba ni nya kom.
en: Caravans from Sheba and Tema search.

dag: Ka Halɔhɛshi bia Shallum ŋun gba daa nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm yaɣili pirigili polo naa la min o bipuɣinsi daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu.
en: Shallum son of Hallohesh repaired the next section of the wall. His daughters helped him. Shallum was the governor of the other half of Jerusalem.

dag: Abijam mini Jɛrɔbɔam daa kul tuhirila tab tɔbu hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: The war that had broken out between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continued during the time that Abijam was king. Everything else Abijam did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: Ka paɣiba maa daa yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, tinim kul yɛn maanila alizanda ni paɣa ŋun nyɛ naa maa ka boori kom bahir o. A tɛhiya ni ti ni daa maani maha, ka niŋd o kɔtomsi niŋdi di ni, ka boori kom bahir o la, ti yidaannim nuu daa ka di ni.
en: Then the women said, When we lived in Judah, we worshiped the Queen of Heaven and offered sacrifices of wine and special loaves of bread shaped like her. Our husbands knew what we were doing, and they approved of it.

dag: Ka Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa zaŋ Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa mini nabihi ni tɔbutuhiri biinsi tuhi pia ni tuumbaŋsimnim ni machɛlinim zaa kul o ya; ka so daa bi kpalim naɣila bɛn nyɛ nandaamba kɔŋko n-daa kpalim be bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: He also led away as prisoners the Jerusalem officials, the military leaders, and the skilled workers—, in all. Only the very poorest people were left in Judah.

dag: M bi saɣi ni paɣiba nyɛ karimbanima bee n-su dɔbba fukumsi; di niŋ kamaata ni bɛ shini baalim.
en: I dont allow a wife to teach or to control her husband. Instead, she should be a quiet listener.

dag: Jɛhɔshafat ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o ni daa wuh o kpiɔŋ shɛm ni o ni daa tuhi tɔb shɛŋa zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: Everything else that Jehoshaphat did, all his bravery and his battles, are recorded in The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia daa yɛli Aizaia, Yawɛ yɛtɔɣ shɛli a ni yɛli maa viɛla. Dama o daa yɛlila o suhu ni, Suhudoo mini alaafee yi ni be n ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni, di viɛla.
en: Hezekiah thought, At least our nation will be at peace for a while. So he told Isaiah, The message you brought me from the Lord is good.

dag: ka o niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga, ka o bol o yuli Ɛr.
en: and she bore him a son, whom he named Er.

dag: Di zɔntua maa daa kpala dundɔntitali polo, ka bɛ ŋme abie tihi pa di pilanim zuɣu di yaɣa zaa, ka di daa mali dunɔdura anii zaŋ chaŋ dunɔdali gbini.
en: The entrance room faced the outer courtyard. Palm trees were carved on the walls along the passageway. Eight steps led up to this gate.

dag: Hal m bi lan simdi ni a boli ma a bia gba; amaa lihim ma kaman a padiriba ŋɔ ni yino.
en: I am no longer good enough to be called your son. Treat me like one of your workers. .

dag: Ka tiŋgbani daa dam pam, ka tiŋ maa yiya pia kam puuni zaɣ yini lu, ka ninvuɣ tusaayopɔin daa kpi tiŋgbani dambu maa ni, ka dabiɛm gbahi bɛn kpalim, ka bɛ ti Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ jilima.
en: At that very moment there was a violent earthquake; a tenth of the city was destroyed, and seven thousand people were killed. The rest of the people were terrified and praised the greatness of the God of heaven.

dag: Naawuni, deemi n suhigu n fabila ŋɔ puuni. Fam n nyɛvili bahi, dama n zɔrila n dimnima.
en: Listen to my concerns, God, and protect me from my enemies' threats.

dag: Di pa shɛli Yawɛ ni wum bɛ fabila, ka bɛ zaa chɛ bɛ tuumbiɛri soya maa. Dama Yawɛ je suli, ka o suhu yiɣisi pam bahi niriba ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Perhaps they will ask the Lord to help them. Perhaps each person will stop doing bad things. The Lord has announced that he is very angry with them.

dag: ka di daa kpa o talahi ni o doli yi Samaria.
en: On the way to Galilee, he had to go through the country of Samaria.

dag: Ka bikpɛm maa daa je suli zaɣisi duu kpɛbu; ka o ba daa yina ti balim o.
en: Then the older son was furious and didnt want to enter in, but his father came out and begged him.

dag: Bɛ daa suh o ka o ti ba kɔrinsi, ka ti ba bindir shɛli din yi zuɣusaa na pam.
en: The people asked, and God brought quail; God filled them full with food from heaven.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ be kaman wurigu la pɔhim tooni, ka Yawɛ malaika kari ba bahi.
en: Make them like chaff blown by the wind. Let them be chased by the Lord s angel.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa gbaai bua n-kɔrigi zaŋ Yisifu binyɛrigu tim bua maa ʒim ni.
en: The brothers killed a goat and put the goats blood on Josephs beautiful coat.

dag: Ka pakoli maa daa kpe nti shiri niŋ kaman Ilaija ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka o min o bidibiga maa ni o yiŋnim zaa kul nyari bindirigu diri dabisi gbaliŋ.
en: The widow went and did as Elijah had told her, and all of them had enough food for many days.

dag: Ka naa daa fabili Abinɛr zuɣu yɛli, Bɔ n-niŋ ka Abinɛr ti kpi kaman jɛrigu la?.
en: Then the king sang this funeral song for Abner: Should Abner have died like a fool dies?.

dag: Yɛtɔɣ viɛla tɔɣisibu bi mili jɛrigu, ka ʒiri gba yɛtɔɣa bi simdi nabia.
en: Too much talking isnt right for a fool; even less so false speech for an honorable person.

dag: Ka shɛb yɛli, O nyɛla Masia la. Ka shɛb mi bɔhi, Di wuhiya ni Masia yɛn yila Galili na?.
en: Other people said, He is the Messiah. And others said, The Messiah will not come from Galilee.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Izraɛlnim maa, Ijiptinim mini Amɔrinim ni Ammɔnnim ni Filistianim.
en: The Lord gave them this answer: The Egyptians, the Amorites, the Ammonites, the Philistines.

dag: Zomiya yi yi ni tumdi tuumbiɛ shɛŋa zaa zaŋ chaŋ n sani la tumbu ni, ka chɛ ka yi suhuri mini yi shihi leei zaɣ pala. Izraɛlnima, bɔzuɣu ka yi yɛn kpi?.
en: Throw away all the terrible idols with which you committed your crimes! Change your heart and spirit. People of Israel, why should you do things that will cost you your life?.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa chɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu din be Jɛrusalɛm maa mɛbu tuma, di daa kul kpalim ʒiɛla lala hal ti paai Pɛriʒia Naa Darius nam dibu yuma ayi saha.
en: At that time the work on Gods house in Jerusalem stopped and was suspended until the second year of the rule of Persias King Darius.

dag: A suhu yi ye bindirigu maa dibu zuɣu, nyin gbaam amaŋa.
en: Place a knife at your throat to control your appetite.

dag: Chɛ ka ʒiŋmariba bɛn tɔɣisiri ʒeensi yɛtɔɣa zaŋ chaŋ wuntizɔriba polo mini karimbaannim bɛn ʒiɛmdi bɛ taba la fo.
en: Let their lying lips be shut up whenever they speak arrogantly against the righteous with pride and contempt!.

dag: ka o daa yɛli ma, Kpɛm di puuni nti nya bɛ ni niŋdi vi binshɛŋa din chihiri shɛm kpe.
en: And he said to me: Go in and see what wicked and detestable things they are doing in there.

dag: n zaliya ni Izraɛlnim zaa bee bɛ maligumaaniba bee bɛ Lɛvinim bɛn be n nam sulinsi ni ka bɛ suhu yu ni bɛ kuli Jɛrusalɛm, bɛn dol a kuli.
en: I give this order: Any of the Israelites living in my kingdom, including priests and Levites, who want to go with you to Jerusalem, may go.

dag: Izraɛl Naa Ɛhab ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma anahi saha, ka Asa bia Jɛhɔshafat daa di Juda nam.
en: Jehoshaphat, Asas son, became king over Judah in the fourth year of Israels King Ahab.

dag: N dimnim mini bɛn nahindi ma galisiya pam, amaa m bi chɛ a zaligunim dolibu.
en: I have a lot of brutal enemies, but still I never turn from your laws.

dag: Ka tumo maa daa yi n-chaŋ labina ti yɛl o dana maa, N niŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa, amaa ka palo na kul beni.
en: When the servant returned, he said, Master, I've done what you told me, and there is still plenty of room for more people.

dag: Nɛbo din pahi la niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pihinunaayi.
en: from the other town of Nebo:.

dag: N ni daa deei shɛli n Duuma san la, dina ka m mali wuhiri ya ŋɔ: Dahin shɛli yuŋ bɛ ni daa yi ti Duuma nyaaŋa la, ka o daa kpuɣi bɔrɔbɔro.
en: The teaching I gave you is the same that I received from the Lord: On the night when the Lord Jesus was handed over to be killed, he took bread.

dag: Di bemi kaman yi ni daa nyɛ nɔzaɣisiriba Naawuni sani, amaa ka yipa nya nambɔzɔbo pumpɔŋɔ Izraɛlnim nɔzaɣisibo maa zuɣu la.
en: As for you Gentiles, you disobeyed God in the past; but now you have received God's mercy because the Jews were disobedient.

dag: Amaa Sɔŋda so n ni yɛn tim ka o yi m Ba sani n-ka yi sanna la nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni be so ni. O yi ti kana, o ni leei n shɛhiralana.
en: I will send you the Helper from the Father. The Helper is the Spirit of truth who comes from the Father. When he comes, he will tell about me.

dag: Gɔhi ni ti zibigi bɛ nam yiya ni mini goma ni gili bɛ tin shɛŋa ni, ka yɔbahi mini viri ni be nimaani.
en: Thorns and wild bushes will grow in all the beautiful homes there. Wild dogs and owls will live in them. Wild animals will make their homes there. Big birds will live in the grasses that grow there.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Ŋmamiya di tihi luhi. Kahimiya kuɣa duhi gili Jɛrusalɛm. Tiŋ shɛli din simdi tibidarigibo m-bala. Shɛli ka di puuni naɣila alaka niŋbu.
en: This is what the Lord All-Powerful says: Cut down the trees around Jerusalem, and build a siege mound against it. This city should be punished because inside there is no justice—only slavery.

dag: Ka Mɔabnim daa zɔri Izraɛlnim pam, dama Izraɛlnim maa daa galisiya pam. Dabiɛm daa kpe Mɔabnim pam Izraɛlnim maa zuɣu.
en: he and all his people became terrified.

dag: ka daa boli bia maa yuli Yisifu ka yɛli, Yawɛ tim ma bidib so pahi.
en: Rachel named the son Joseph, saying, May the Lord give me another son.

dag: Ka o bipalitab bɛn min o daa laɣim zooi maa yɛl o, Di ni simdi ni a yɛli bɛn yɛl a, A ba daa ʒili ti ʒi tibisa, amaa filimmi li ti ti la shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yɛlim ba, Man nubil kpaliŋga bari gari m ba shee.
en: The young people who had grown up with Rehoboam said to him, This people said to you, Your father made our workload heavy. Lighten it for us! Now this is what you should say to them, My baby finger is thicker than my fathers waist!.

dag: O daa chɛ ka sagbana bɔɣi ka o siɣina; ka zibisim titali be o naba tiŋli.
en: He tore the sky open and came down, with a dark cloud under his feet.

dag: Ka doo maa daa wuhi ba so shɛli din kuni tiŋ maa ni, ka Yisifu zuliya niriba maa daa kpe tiŋ maa ni ti zaŋ takɔbi ku tiŋ maa nima. Amaa ka daa chɛ do so ŋun wuhi ba tiŋ maa soli maa min o malibu ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: So he showed them the way into the city. They killed the citys people with their swords, but they let that man and all his relatives go.

dag: Ka bɔba ni yaɣa ni gomnanim tɔbbihi mini tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa dol ba daa yi n-chaŋ.
en: The young soldiers led Israel's troops into battle.

dag: Amaa ka paɣ maa daa zaŋ tuumba ayi maa sɔɣi ka yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, do shɛb di kpe n yili ŋɔ na, amaa m bi mi bɛ ni yi shɛl na.
en: But the woman had taken the two men and hidden them. Then she said, Of course the men came to me. But I didnt know where they were from.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be bɛ nyɛviya ni n-nyɛ bɛn paɣir a kaman n ni paɣir a shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Bihi banim yɛri bɛ bihi a ʒiɛyimtali yɛla.
en: The living, the living can thank you, as I do today. Parents will tell children about your faithfulness.

dag: Nyini n-nam nuzaa polo mini nudirigu polo; Tabo Zoli mini Hɛrimɔn Zoli paɣir a yuli ni suhupiɛlli.
en: You created the north and the south; Mount Tabor and Mount Hermon sing to you for joy.

dag: Nyamiya, n zaŋla nyɛvili mini tɔŋsim ni kum mini ashaara n-zali yi tooni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Today I am giving you a choice. You can choose life and success or death and disaster.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa chɛ ka bɛ wuɣi tan ʒiɛkpeein mini tan sabilifaa ni zaɣ ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛl viɛlli, ka mali chɛrubinim kɔtomsi pa di zuɣu n-zaŋ li yili dunoli maa.
en: A curtain for the Most Holy Place was made of linen and of other material, which was dyed blue, purple, and red, with designs of the winged creatures worked into it.

dag: Yi ni ti ŋɔŋ kom tiliginsim kɔbilisi puuni ni suhupiɛlli.
en: With great joy, you people will get water from the well of victory.

dag: ka Naawuni nira Ilaisha sɔŋda Gɛhaazi yɛl o suhu ni, N dana fa Naaman ŋun nyɛ Siria nir ŋɔ bahi, o ni zaɣis o ni ʒi pin shɛŋa na nti ti o la zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, n ni kar o naba ti deei shɛli o sani.
en: when Elisha's servant Gehazi said to himself, My master has let Naaman get away without paying a thing! He should have accepted what that Syrian offered him. By the living Lord I will run after him and get something from him.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim nyaŋ Amɔrinim dahin shɛli maa, ka Jɔshua daa tɔɣisi Yawɛ yɛtɔɣa, ka ŋmaligi yɛli Izraɛlnim ninni: Wuntaŋa, kpalimmi zani luɣ yini Gibiɔn dɛde, ka nyin Goli gba, kpalim zani Aijalɔn vinvamli dɛde.
en: On that day the Lord gave Israel the victory against the Amorites. Joshua stood before all the Israelites and said to the Lord : Sun, stop over Gibeon. Moon, stand still over the Valley of Aijalon.

dag: Ka ŋunkam shih o bindoo, dilan ŋun paɣim o situra ka su kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: Any who touch her bed or anything on which she has sat must wash their clothes and take a bath, and they remain unclean until evening.

dag: Ka nyini ŋun niŋ yɛda ni ti Duuma ni yɛl a shɛlikam zaa shiri ni niŋ pali ŋɔ gba mal alibarika.
en: How happy you are to believe that the Lord's message to you will come true.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa teei dɔni n-zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋa ka la ka yɛl o suhu ni, Wula ka ninvuɣ so ŋun paai yuun kɔbiga ni tooi lan dɔɣi bia? Ka Zara ŋun paai yuun pihiwɛi ŋɔ ni tooi lan dɔɣi bia.
en: Abraham bowed his face to the ground to show he respected God. But he laughed and said to himself, I am years old. I cannot have a son, and Sarah is years old. She cannot have a child.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Hal n yi di mmaŋ shɛhira, n shɛhira maa nyɛla shɛhira maŋli, dama m mi n ni yi shɛl na, ka lan mi n ni chani shɛli, amaa yinim ʒi n ni yi shɛl na bee n ni chani shɛli.
en: Jesus replied, Even if I testify about myself, my testimony is true, since I know where I came from and where Im going. You dont know where I come from or where Im going.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa chɛ Filistianim kari doli; ka Filistianim maa daa labi bɛ biɛhigu shee.
en: Saul stopped hunting down the Philistines, and they went home.

dag: Chamiya ti bɔhim dimbɔŋɔ gbinni: M paɣi nambɔzɔbo gari sara malibu. Pa wuntizɔriba zuɣu ka n kana, amaa alahichinim tuuba niŋbu zuɣu ka n kana.
en: Go and find out what is meant by the scripture that says: It is kindness that I want, not animal sacrifices. I have not come to call respectable people, but outcasts.

dag: Ka nachimbil maa yɛl o, M pun doli dimbɔŋɔnim zaa, ka bɔ n-lee lan kpalim ma.
en: The young man said, I have obeyed all of these. What else must I do.

dag: Di saha ka Amnɔn daa yɛli Tama, Zaŋmi bindirigu maa kpɛhi n dugbɛrili puuni nti gbib li a nuu ni ka n di. Ka Tama daa zaŋ o ni mali mahi shɛŋa maa kpɛh o tizɔdoo Amnɔn dugbɛrili maa ni.
en: Then Amnon said to Tamar, Bring the food into the bedroom so I can eat from your hand. So Tamar took the heart-shaped cakes she had made and brought them to her brother Amnon in the bedroom.

dag: Nahɔr ni daa dɔɣi Tɛra maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbiga ni pisiyinika. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: after that, he lived another years and had other children.

dag: N ni lan zaŋ Jɛhoyakim bia Jɛhoyachin ŋun nyɛ Juda naa la mini bɛ ni daa gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb zaa Juda n-zaŋ ba kul Babilɔn la labisi kpe na; dama n ni kabi Babilɔn Naa naɣikɔra dapua. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will also bring back the king of Judah, Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim, along with all of the people of Judah who went into exile in Babylonia. Yes, I will break the power of the king of Babylonia. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Di simdi ka a daa beei chɛriga gili zoli maa, ka di chɛ ka so baai yaɣ li, ka yɛli ba ni so di miri zoli maa gbini bee so ti du li. Ka ŋunkam ti shihi zoli maa, bɛn kum o.
en: Mark a boundary around the mountain that the people must not cross, and tell them not to go up the mountain or even get near it. If any of you set foot on it, you are to be put to death;.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa be sagban ni n-siɣina ti zan o sani nimaani ka yɛli, N yuli m-booni Yawɛ.
en: The LORD came down in the cloud and stood there with him, and proclaimed the name, The LORD.

dag: Yisa daa ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli, Alizanda nam ŋmanila azichi shɛli din sɔɣi tiŋgban ni so puu ni, ka do so kana nti nya li ka daai tam pi li, ka chaŋ ni suhupiɛlli nti zaŋ o ni mali shɛlikam kɔhi n-lab ti da puu maa.
en: The Kingdom of heaven is like this. A man happens to find a treasure hidden in a field. He covers it up again, and is so happy that he goes and sells everything he has, and then goes back and buys that field.

dag: N yura maa chaŋla o puu ni, o chaŋla tulaale tihi puu vuɣisi ni ni o ti chɛ ka o piɛri ŋub mɔri ka o bo paɣiviɛligakushihikom na.
en: My lover has gone to his garden, where the balsam trees grow. He is feeding his flock in the garden and gathering lilies.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa o ni ti ŋmaligi yɛli bɛn ʒe o nuzaa polo la mi, Yinim bahiyolinim ŋɔ, wariya ti kpe azaaba buɣim shɛl ni Naawuni ni daa mali gu Sintani min o malaikanim la.
en: Then he will say to those on his left, Away from me, you that are under God's curse! Away to the eternal fire which has been prepared for the Devil and his angels!.

dag: Ka o bia maa yɛl o, M ba, m birigi n Duuma Naawuni sani ni a gba sani; hal m bi lan simdi ni a boli ma a bia gba.
en: The son said, Father, I have sinned against God and have done wrong to you. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.

dag: Ka Makiri zuliya ni ninvuɣ so ŋun daa nyɛ Manaasa bia daa chaŋ ti liri Giliadnima ŋ-ŋme n-deei li ka kari Amɔrinim bɛn daa be nimaani la.
en: People from Makirs family group went to Gilead. They defeated the city. They defeated the Amorites who lived there.

dag: Hal yi ya ŋɔ taŋkpa shɛli din puɣ ti naba ŋɔ, ti ni pihi li bahi yi zuɣu, amaa lee baŋmiya ni Naawuni nam miri ya.
en: Even the dust from your town that sticks to our feet we wipe off against you. But remember that the Kingdom of God has come near you.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔshua daa boli dɔbba pinaayi bɛn nyɛ Izraɛl zuliya pinaayi maa ni niriba, ka nyɛ o ni daa pun pii shɛb zuliya yini kam ni la na.
en: Joshua chose twelve men; then he called them together.

dag: O daa zali maligumaaniba ka ti ba bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛli Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni, ka kpaŋsi ba bɛ tuma maa ni.
en: On that day, Josiah made sure the priests knew what duties they were to do in the temple.

dag: O suh a nyɛvili, ka a ti o li; ka di nyɛ nyɛvil wɔɣinli din ka bahigu.
en: He asked to live a long time, and you promised him life that never ends.

dag: Ka o nya ti shɛli bɛ ni booni fiig tia, ka di puhi vari ʒiɛya ha, ka o chaŋ di gbini ni o ti nya o ni nya binshɛɣu di zuɣu di; o ni daa paai di gbini o daa bi nya binshɛɣu naɣ pahila vari kɔŋko, dama fiig tihi walibu saha daa na bi paai.
en: From a distance Jesus saw a fig tree covered with leaves, and he went to see if there were any figs on the tree. But there were none, because it wasn't the season for figs.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ yuli pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chani hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Let the name of the Lord be praised now and forever.

dag: Tiliginsim ŋɔ yɛla zuɣu ka anabinim daa vihi, ka bo ni bɛ baŋ li. Bɛ daa tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛlila anfaan shɛli Naawuni ni yɛn zaŋ tin ya la yɛla.
en: It was concerning this salvation that the prophets made careful search and investigation, and they prophesied about this gift which God would give you.

dag: O ku lan tooi zaŋ binshɛli zal o zaani bee n-zaŋ binshɛli taɣ o n-zaŋ zaɣ suŋ taɣi zaɣ biɛɣu bee n-zaŋ zaɣ biɛɣu taɣi zaɣ suŋ. Ka o yi zaŋla biŋkɔbigu ni o taɣi biŋkɔbigu, dindina o ni zaŋ so na ni o ti taɣ o maa min o zaa ni leei bɛn be kasi.
en: The promise maker cannot replace or substitute for it, either good for bad or bad for good. But if one should substitute one animal for another, both it and the substitute will be holy.

dag: Bin yini mi kɔŋko n-simdi bɔbu. Mariama pii din viɛli maa, ka di mi ku lan yi o nuu ni.
en: but just one is needed. Mary has chosen the right thing, and it will not be taken away from her.

dag: Pin suma mini pina din be tibi zaa yirila Naawuni ŋun nam alizanda mini neesim, ka nyɛ ŋun ka taɣibu, ka mi ka shilinshia din limsiri neesim maa la sanna.
en: Every good gift, every perfect gift, comes from above. These gifts come down from the Father, the creator of the heavenly lights, in whose character there is no change at all.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun bi ʒe n nyaaŋa pala ŋun bɔri n zaɣ viɛlli; ka ŋunkam mi bi sɔŋdi ma naɣ wurindila m bini bahira.
en: If you are not on my side, you are against me. If you don't gather in the crop with me, you scatter it.

dag: Yawɛ yɛli yinim Judanim bɛn kpalim ŋɔ, Di chaŋya Ijipti. Baŋmiya viɛnyɛliŋga ni n wuhi ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: I told the people: You escaped the disaster that struck Judah, but now the Lord warns you to stay away from Egypt.

dag: amaa zaŋm ma ti sɔŋla m banim dooshee. Ʒimiya ma yi Ijipti ŋɔ kuli nti sɔɣi ma bɛ sɔɣibu shee. Ka Yisifu yɛl o, N ni niŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Bury me in the place where my ancestors are buried. Carry me out of Egypt and bury me in our family grave. Joseph answered, I promise that I will do what you say.

dag: Pɔhim ni ti ʒe yi zuɣulaannim chaŋ, ka bɛ ti gbahi yi ni yuri shɛba leei daba n-zaŋ ba chaŋ, ka vi ti gbahi ya ka di gari ya yi ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma zaa zuɣu.
en: Now you will be disgraced because of your sins. Your leaders will be swept away by the wind, and the nations you trusted will be captured and dragged to a foreign country.

dag: Ɛhab kum nyaaŋa ka Mɔabnim daa zaɣisi Izraɛlnim jɛmbu.
en: After the death of King Ahab of Israel the country of Moab rebelled against Israel.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu zuɣusaa polo dunɔdal la, ka daa lan me Ofɛl goondaa la pahi.
en: Jotham rebuilt the Upper Gate of the LORDs temple and did extensive work on the wall of the elevated fortress.

dag: Nyini n-daa chɛ ka kɔbil nina puhigi zɔra; ka daa chɛ ka mɔɣa din kom kul zɔri sahakam la nyuui.
en: You make the springs and rivers flow, and you make the rivers dry up.

dag: Zuɣusaa ni ti kahigi bɛ tuumbiɛri ni nyɛ shɛli wuhi, ka dunia zaa ti yiɣisi jɛndi ba.
en: Heaven reveals their sin, and the earth gives testimony against them.

dag: Ka di sabi yɛli, Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka doo ŋmaligir o ba min o ma sani n-zaŋd omaŋ tabind o paɣa, ka bɛ niriba ayi maa be kaman ninvuɣ yino la.
en: And God said, For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and unite with his wife, and the two will become one.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli, N shia kul ku kpalim be ninsal ni sahakam, o nyɛla ŋun ni kpi, ka o yuma ni nyɛla yuun kɔbiga ni pisi.
en: Then the Lord said, I will not allow people to live forever; they are mortal. From now on they will live no longer than years.

dag: Ka Balak yɛl o, Kamina ka ti chaŋ luɣ shɛli polo a ni yɛn nya ba; a ku tooi nya bɛ zaa, a kul ni nyala bɛ ni shɛb kɔŋko; ka a yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi bɛ zuɣu ti ma.
en: Balak said to Balaam, Let's go somewhere else. Maybe if you see a smaller part of the Israelites, you will be able to curse them for me.

dag: N dɔni n gom shee yuŋ tɛhi n suhu ni yuri so pam yɛla; m bo o, amaa ka bi nya o.
en: While in bed at night, I reached for the one I love with heart and soul. I looked for him, but he wasn't there.

dag: Nyini ka n zaŋ ŋme n-ku piɛguliba mini bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu. Nyini ka n zaŋ ŋme n-ku pukpariba mini bɛ naɣikɔra. Nyini ka n zaŋ ŋme n-ku gomnanim mini bɛ wulaannima.
en: to slaughter shepherds and their flocks, to slaughter farmers and their plow horses, to crush rulers and high officials.

dag: ka Sulemaana daa nyɛ Rɛhɔbɔam ba, ka Rɛhɔbɔam nyɛ Abija ba, ka Abija mi nyɛ Ɛsa ba.
en: Solomon was the father of Rehoboam. Rehoboam was the father of Abijah. Abijah was the father of Asa.

dag: Dolimi naa nyɛvili; ka chɛ ka o kul be ʒiɛmani kam ni!.
en: Add many years to the king's life; let him live on and on!.

dag: Bɛ ni daa pii dunɔguliba ŋɔ ka di doli bɛ zuɣulaannim ni nyɛ shɛm maa, bɛ gba daa malila bɛ tuma Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni kaman bɛ dɔɣiriba maa ni daa tumdi shɛm maa.
en: The Temple guards were divided into groups, according to families, and they were assigned duties in the Temple, just as the other Levites were.

dag: Naawuni daa ti nachimbih anahi ŋɔ baŋsim mini yɛn bɔhimbu balibu kam puuni. Ka din pahi nyɛla o daa lan ti Daniɛl baŋsim shɛli din chɛ ka o tooi kahigiri ʒiinim mini zahima gbinni wuhira.
en: God gave the four young men knowledge and skill in literature and philosophy. In addition, he gave Daniel skill in interpreting visions and dreams.

dag: Ka di teeri Izraɛlnima ni ninvuɣ so ŋun pa maligumaana, ka mi pa ŋun yi Aduna zuliya ni na ku lan kana ni o ti tuɣili tulaale zim Yawɛ tooni, ka din niŋ Kɔra min o nyaandoliba maa ti niŋ o kaman Yawɛ ni daa ka chɛ Musa yɛl o shɛm maa.
en: just as the LORD instructed him through Moses. This was a reminder for the Israelites that no outsider who isnt one of Aarons descendants should approach to burn incense in the LORDs presence, so as not to be like Korah and his community.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa zaŋ do so ŋun daa yi nyɛ zom maa tahi Farisiinim sani.
en: The day when Jesus made the mud and healed the man was a Sabbath. So the people took the man to the Pharisees.

dag: Amaa nyini ka n naɣ ni lo alikauli. Zaŋm a paɣ min a bidibisi ni bɛ paɣiba n-kpe ŋariŋ maa ni.
en: but I will make a covenant with you. Go into the boat with your wife, your sons, and their wives.

dag: Tinima n-nyɛ dimbɔŋɔnim shɛhiranima m-pahi Shia Kasi so Naawuni ni zaŋdi tiri bɛn deeri ŋun Naawuni nol la.
en: We are witnesses to these things—we and the Holy Spirit, who is God's gift to those who obey him.

dag: Ka bɛ tiŋgbani maa zaŋ kpa wulinluhili polo mi daa kpuɣi Tapua m-mali hal ti paai Kana kulibɔŋ n-zaŋ lala hal ti paai di tariga Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku ni. Dina n-nyɛ bɛ ni daa zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti Ifriim min o daŋ niriba ni bɛ su la.
en: The border went from Tappuah west to Kanah Ravine and ended at the sea. This is all the land that was given to the Ephraimites. Each family in that tribe got a part of this land.

dag: ka o niŋgbuna ni ti do tiŋa Jɛziriil tintariga kaman saɣiri la; ka so ti ku tooi yɛli, Jɛzibɛl m-bɔŋɔ. .
en: Jezebels corpse will be like dung spread out in a field in that plot of land in Jezreel, so no one will be able to say, This was Jezebel.

dag: Dama di daa bi ŋari m ma bidɔɣirisurigu noli, din ni chɛ ka m bi nya wahala.
en: Curse that night for letting me be born, for exposing me to trouble and grief.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa bol o bihi na nti yɛli ba, Laɣimmiya na ka n ti yɛli ya din ti yɛn niŋ ya dahin shɛli ha yɛla.
en: Jacob called his sons together and said: My sons, I am Jacob, your father Israel.

dag: ka o lihi n-nya Yisa ni chani ha ka yɛli, Nyamiya Naawuni Piɛbil la ha.
en: He saw Jesus walking by and said, Look, the Lamb of God.

dag: Ka binshɛɣu din ti yɛn niŋ a bidibis ayi bɛn nyɛ Hofini mini Finɛhas ti yɛn nyɛla shihirili a sani. Bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa ti yɛn kpila dahin yini.
en: To prove to you that I will do these things, your two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, will die on the same day.

dag: Chɛliya ka m bɔhi ya bin yini ŋɔ kɔŋko yɛla: Naawuni fukumsi zaligu dolibu zuɣu ka yi daa deei Naawuni Shia Kasi bee lahibal suŋ yɛla wumbu mini di yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka yi daa deei Naawuni Shia Kasi maa?.
en: I want to know only one thing. How were you given God's Spirit? Was it by obeying the Law of Moses or by hearing about Christ and having faith in him?.

dag: Ninsal ni tooi mali buchi Naawuni sani? Ka hal ŋun mali yɛm ni tooi mali buchi o sani?.
en: What use are we humans to God, even the wisest of us?.

dag: O yi ti kana, yin deemiy o kaman Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda ni deeri niriba shɛm ti Duuma zuɣu la; ka o yi ti bɔri shɛli yi sani, yin sɔŋmiy o, dama o nyɛla ŋun sɔŋ niriba pam zaŋ tabili mmaŋmaŋ gba.
en: Welcome her in a way that is proper for someone who has faith in the Lord and is one of God's own people. Help her in any way you can. After all, she has proved to be a respected leader for many others, including me.

dag: Di wumya bɛ yɛtɔɣa. Jɛmmiya Babilɔn Naa ka be. Bɔzuɣu ka yi yɛn chɛ ka tiŋ ŋɔ zani dabari?.
en: If you choose to obey the king of Babylonia, you will live. But if you listen to those prophets, this whole city will be nothing but a pile of rubble.

dag: Zakur ni Shɛrɛbia ni Shɛbania so mi ni.
en: Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah.

dag: Zaŋmiya daba ayopɔin puhi chuɣu maa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn pii luɣ shɛli maa, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ yi puri atam mini yi ni tum tuun shɛlikam zaa ni. Ka di simdi ni yi shiri puhi chuɣu maa.
en: Honor the Lord your God by celebrating this festival for seven days at the one place of worship. Be joyful, because the Lord has blessed your harvest and your work.

dag: ka n suhu kul be yiriŋ. N ni daa kul tɛhiri di yɛla shɛm, lala ka di yɛla maa daa niŋ ma muɣisigu. Di saha ka n daa yaai n noli yɛli.
en: and I was overcome with anxiety. The more I thought, the more troubled I became; I could not keep from asking:.

dag: Amaa ka Pita yɛli, N Duuma, n ku tooi niŋ lala, dama n na ʒi n-di bin yoya ŋɔ tatabo bee n ni chihiri binshɛŋa.
en: Peter exclaimed, Absolutely not, Lord! I have never eaten anything impure or unclean.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yiɣisi chaŋ vinvamli maa ni, ka Yawɛ jilima ʒe nimaani ŋ-ŋmani n ni daa pun nya jilima shɛli Kɛba Mɔɣili dul la. Ka n daa lu n-zaŋ n nini kpa tiŋa.
en: So I went out into the valley, and there I saw the glory of the Lord , just as I had seen it beside the Chebar River. I fell face downward on the ground.

dag: Ŋunkam tumd alahichi nyɛla zaliguchihira, dama alahichi tumbu nyɛla zaligu chihibu.
en: Anyone who sins breaks Gods law. Yes, sinning is the same as living against Gods law.

dag: Ka n yɛli, N Duuma, ka wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ? Ka n Duuma yɛli ma, Yiɣisim bahi paai Damaskus tiŋ puuni, nimaani ka bɛ ni ti wuh a n ni zal a ni a niŋ shɛm.
en: I asked, Lord, what do you want me to do? Then he told me, Get up and go to Damascus. When you get there, you will be told what to do.

dag: Niriba ayi yi do n-tab taba, bɛ ni ni tula, amaa nir yi do o ko, wula ka o yɛn niŋ ka o ni tula?.
en: If two people sleep together, they will be warm. But a person sleeping alone will not be warm.

dag: o daa yɛlimi, O nyɛla n tizɔpaɣa, dama o daa zɔrila dabiɛm ni o yɛli ni o paɣa m-bala. O daa tɛhimi ni o yi yɛl lala, di pa shɛli ka nimaani nim maa ti ku o Ribɛka zuɣu, dama o daa nyɛla paɣ viɛlli.
en: with his beautiful wife Rebekah. He was afraid that someone might kill him to get her, and so he told everyone that Rebekah was his sister.

dag: Ka Hushai daa garigi yɛli Absalom, Aai Yawɛ min o niriba ŋɔ ni Izraɛlnim ni pii ninvuɣ so, o sani ka n yɛn be ka o su ma.
en: Hushai said, I belong to the one that the Lord chooses. These people and the people of Israel chose you. I will stay with you.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Nyamiya, niriba yi nuzaa polo tiŋgbɔŋ ni kanna. Bɛ nyɛla zuliya shɛb bɛn mali kpiɔŋ ka lo tɔbu n-yi katiŋ damdi dunia ŋɔ bɔba ni yaɣa ni.
en: The LORD proclaims: An army is on the move from the northern regions; a great nation is roused from the ends of the earth.

dag: Ka din pah awɛi daa gbaai Matania min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: Ninth, there were men chosen from Mattaniahs sons and relatives.

dag: N ni yɛli shɛm ŋɔ nyɛla din yɛn mali soli tin ya, amaa di pala zaligu.
en: I tell you this not as an order, but simply as a permission.

dag: Dinzuɣu nira daa yi yɛn kpe duri maa nudirigu polo dunoya maa ni, a ni dolila duu maa tariga so shɛli din baɣisiri gooni maa wulimpuhili polo.
en: The entrance to the lower rooms was at the east end of the building so that people could enter from the open end of the path by the wall.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn fiɣisiri ma la di vi ka bahi yoli. Chɛ ka bɛn bɔri ni bɛ niŋ ma zaɣ biɛɣu la di vi ka nya filiŋ.
en: Let my accusers be put to shame, completely finished off! Let those who seek my downfall be dressed in insults and disgrace!.

dag: Binshɛli ti ku pooi yi ni so, dama Yawɛ shiri niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya ni yi ʒini maa ni.
en: There should not be any poor people in your country, because the Lord your God is giving you this land. And the Lord will greatly bless you.

dag: Asha zuliya ni toondana n-nyɛ Shalomi bia Ahihud.
en: from the tribe of the Asherites, a chief, Ahihud, Shelomis son.

dag: amaa ka bɛn daa mali yɛm la bɛn daa ʒi kpam pahi bɛ firilanim zuɣu.
en: The ones who were wise took along extra oil for their lamps.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli Ibrahimma, Zaŋ chaŋ a paɣ Zarai mi polo, di lan bol o Zarai, amaa pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana bolim o la Zara.
en: Abraham, from now on your wife's name will be Sarah instead of Sarai.

dag: A yi ti yi palo, a ni bahi ba yoli kaman buɣim n-di ba la. Yawɛ ni bahi ba yoli zaa o suhuyiɣisili puuni, ka buɣim di ba.
en: They will be destroyed by fire once you are here, and because of your anger, flames will swallow them.

dag: dama pako shɛb pun birigi doli Sintani.
en: Look what's already happened to some of the young widows! They have turned away to follow Satan.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa booi kpam maa shɛli niŋ ŋun maŋmaŋ nuzaa ni.
en: He will then pour some of the olive oil into the palm of his left hand.
