dag: Saha shɛli Amazia ni daa chɛ Yawɛ jɛmbu maa, ka bɛ daa lo ni bɛ ku o Jɛrusalɛm, ka o daa zo n-kuli Lakishi. Amaa ka bɛ daa chɛ ka shɛb chaŋ Lakishi maa nti ku o nimaani.
en: When Amaziah stopped obeying the Lord , the people in Jerusalem made plans against Amaziah. He ran away to the town of Lachish. But the people sent men to Lachish and they killed Amaziah there.

dag: Ka Nɛbukadnɛza daa bɔhi ba, Shadirak mini Mɛshak ni Abɛdnɛgo, di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni yi shiri zaɣisi n wun la mini n ni mali salima binnan shɛli zal la jɛmbu?.
en: I hear that you refuse to worship my gods and the gold statue I have set up.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa Sinai Zoli zuɣu.
en: The LORD said to Moses on Mount Sinai.

dag: Di saha ka Mikaya daa yɛli, Dinzuɣu wummiya Yawɛ yɛligu: N nya Naawuni ni ʒi o nam ʒiishee, ka malaikanim zaa ʒe o nudirigu min o nuzaa polo.
en: Then Micaiah said, Listen now to the LORDs word: I saw the LORD enthroned with all the heavenly forces stationed at his right and at his left.

dag: Ka Abinɛr daa ti kuhi bahi Jɔab ha bɔh o, Ti kul yɛn zaŋla takɔbiri ŋɔ n-kuri tab hal ni saha din ka bahigu? A bi mi ni di bahigu ti yɛn nyɛla dimdi din ku naai? Bɔ saha ka a yɛn yɛl a niriba maa ka bɛ chɛ bɛ mabihi ŋɔ kari doli.
en: Abner called out to Joab, Do we have to go on fighting forever? Can't you see that in the end there will be nothing but bitterness? We are your relatives. How long will it be before you order your men to stop chasing us.

dag: Shɔbal bia Reeya n-daa nyɛ Jahat ba, ka Jahat daa nyɛ Ahumai mini Lahad ba. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Zɔranim zuliya.
en: Shobal was the father of Reaiah, who was the father of Jahath, the father of Ahumai and Lahad, the ancestors of the people who lived in Zorah.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, Izraɛlnima, Yawɛ ŋun nam ya ŋɔ yɛliya, Di zɔriya dabiɛm, n ni tiligi ya. M bolila yi yuli, mani n-sun ya.
en: But now, says the LORD— the one who created you, Jacob, the one who formed you, Israel: Dont fear, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by name; you are mine.

dag: M pun pirigi n situra, n lan zaŋm li so yaha? M pun paɣi n naba, n lan niŋmi n-chɛ ka di daɣi?.
en: I have taken off my tunic— why should I put it on again? I have bathed my feet— why should I get them dirty.

dag: Amaa n zaŋsim daa be n yuli din be kasi ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim ni daa saɣim shɛli bɛ ni daa be zuliya shɛb ni la.
en: I care what those foreigners think of me.

dag: Zuliya kam ŋmanila kom biɛla din tɔɣ lu bokati puuni, ka be kaman taŋkpa zim din pa sania zuɣu o sani. Nyama, ŋuna n-zahindi teeku ni gili tiŋgban bihi shɛŋa kaman taŋkpaɣu biɛla la.
en: To the Lord the nations are nothing, no more than a drop of water; the distant islands are as light as dust.

dag: Ka do so daa be nimaani n-garigi bɔhi ba, Ka anabinim maa ba lee nyɛ ŋuni? Dinzuɣu lala yɛtɔɣili maa daa leei yɛtɔɣ ŋahili ka bɛ mal li yɛra, Sool gba nyɛla anabi.
en: Why not? one of them answered. Saul has as much right to be a prophet as anyone else! That's why everyone started saying, How can Saul be a prophet.

dag: Nyin Bɛlitishaaza ŋun nyɛ timanim kpɛm ŋɔ, dama m mi ni wun shɛŋa din be kasi la shia be a ni, ka a tooi baŋdi ashiya gbinni. N ni daa zahim zahin shɛli maa m-bɔŋɔ: Wuhim ma di gbinni.
en: Belteshazzar, chief of the fortunetellers, I know that the spirit of the holy gods is in you and that you understand all mysteries. This is my dream. Tell me what it means.

dag: Ka naa maa daa bahi noli ni bɛ cham ti gbaai Daniɛl na nti niŋ gbuɣima bɔɣili maa ni. Naa maa daa yɛli Daniɛl, A ni jɛmd a Naawuni so viɛnyɛliŋga maa ni fa a bahi.
en: So King Darius gave the order. They brought Daniel and threw him into the lions den. The king said to Daniel, May the God you serve save you.

dag: Bɛ yirimi chani bɛ tuma ni kaman mɔɣu ni bunsi m-be tiŋgban nɛli ni la m-bɔri bindirigu tiŋgban shɛli din chaɣisi puuni ni bɛ ti ti bɛ bihi.
en: They are like the wild donkeys in the desert; they go forth at dawn searching for prey; the wasteland is food for their young.

dag: Dama yɛlimaŋli, m bi ŋmarila ʒiri, ŋun mi viɛnyɛliŋga be n sani.
en: Nothing I say to you is false; you see before you a truly wise man.

dag: N zɔri dolila a zaligunim soli, dama a yɛligi m baŋsim.
en: I run the same path as your commandments because you give my heart insight.

dag: Juda nabihi ni daa wum din niŋ maa, ka bɛ daa yi nayili n-kabi chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni nti ʒini bɛ ʒiishɛhi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa Dunɔdal Palli la shee.
en: When the leaders of Judah heard what had happened, they hurried from the royal palace to the Temple and took their places at the New Gate.

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa di Izraɛl nam ka di ti paai yuun pisaayika saha shɛli, ka Abija mi daa leei Juda naa.
en: Abijah became king over Judah in the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛli Amasa, Cham ti boli Judanim zaa ka bɛ laɣim n sanna daba ata sunsuuni, ka a gba beni pahi.
en: The king told Amasa, Tell the people of Judah to meet with me in three days. You must be here, too.

dag: Ka bɛ daa na bi kpe gom, ka Sɔdom tiŋ puuni dɔbba bɛn nyɛ ninkura mini bipola zaa daa laɣimna nti teei gili yili maa.
en: That evening, just before bedtime, men from every part of town came to Lots house. They stood around the house and called to Lot. They said.

dag: Ka zaŋ alahichi sanyoo sara maligu biŋkpam la nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu.
en: He shall burn on the altar the fat of the animal for the sin offering.

dag: Yɛlim ba, Yi bihi zaa bɛn be yi ʒiɛmani kam ni so yi ti mali daɣiri ka miri binyɛr kasi shɛŋa Izraɛlnim ni zaŋ ti man Yawɛ la, n ni yihi dilana n sani. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: If any of your descendants, while he is ritually unclean, comes near the sacred offerings which the people of Israel have dedicated to me, he can never again serve at the altar. This applies for all time to come. I am the Lord .

dag: Hal a ni kul yɛn nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa ka di do katiŋ maa zaa yoli, a ku kpe n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri Izraɛlnim maa ni.
en: So now you may see the land that I am giving to the Israelites. But you cannot go into that land.

dag: Ka salo maa zaa daa saɣi ni bɛ niŋmi lala, dama di daa nyɛla din tiɣi niriba maa zaa nini.
en: The whole assembly agreed to do so, because all the people thought it was the right thing to do.

dag: Salima kpahi tibisim daa nyɛla kilɔgiram giram kɔbisinu ni pisopɔin ni biɛla. Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ dooi salima pa di zuɣusaa duri la dukpina zaa zuɣu.
en: The gold nails weighed fifty shekels. He also covered the upper rooms with gold.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Yi na ʒi n-karim Naa Dauda ni daa niŋ shɛm kum ni daa ti wum o mini bɛn be o san la yɛla?.
en: But he said to them, Havent you read what David did when he and those with him were hungry?.

dag: ka yɛra, Aai, ti ni kuli Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni luɣ shɛli ti ni ku lan nya tɔbu tuhibu bee n-wum kikahi kumsi bee ka kum ti lan gbahi ti, nimaani ka ti yɛn be.
en: And if you insist, No, were going to live in Egypt, where theres no war, battle alarms, or hunger, and there we will stay.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ biŋkpam mini zugbini kpam ni biŋkpam din zaa be namanama ni ni binsabili yaɣ shɛli din viɛla ni yaannina ayi mini di biŋkpam ni nudirigu biŋgbalipuɣili.
en: He took the animal's fat tail, the fat on its insides, and the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and the right hind leg.

dag: Lala ka o daa yih o niriba bɛn nyɛ o ninvuɣ gahinda maa ni suhupiɛlli, ka bɛ daa yiini yila.
en: So he led his chosen people out, and they sang and shouted for joy.

dag: O daa mɛla buɣili Baal maligu bimbini zali o ni daa me Baal jɛmbu du shɛli zali Samaria la puuni.
en: Ahab built an altar and temple for Baal in Samaria.

dag: Bɛ daa malila salima bansi pihinu n-zaŋ gɔhigɔhi pateesanim maa tuɣi taba, ka di daa chɛ ka Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa niŋ zaɣ mun yini.
en: They also made fifty gold clasps, and they used the clasps to join the curtains to each other so that the dwelling was one whole structure.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa gbaala Ai naa zaɣ nɛɔŋ n-zaŋ o ti ti Jɔshua.
en: But the king of Ai was left alive. Joshuas men brought him to Joshua.

dag: A yurilim din ka bahigu puuni ka a daa zaŋ a ni tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb maa chaŋ. A yiko ka a daa zaŋ wuhi ba soli ka bɛ chaŋ ti ʒini tiŋgbɔŋ kasi la ni.
en: But with your kindness you led the people you saved. And with your strength you led them to your holy land.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yɛl o dɔɣiriba, Pihimiya kuɣa na, ka bɛ daa pihi kuɣa maa na nti kahi li duhi, ka daa ʒini kuɣ duli maa gbini di bindirigu.
en: He told his men to find some more rocks and to make a pile of rocks. Then they ate beside the pile of rocks.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa bɔhi ninvuɣ so ŋun daa yɛl o maa, A shiri nya o? Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a di bi chɛ o sua luhi tiŋ na nimaani? N suhu naan paligi ka n ti a anzinfa laɣibaligu pia mini gbaŋ din lɔr sheeni.
en: Joab said to the man, Why didnt you kill him and let him fall to the ground? I would have given you a belt and ten pieces of silver.

dag: Ka o daa lab o sani ti nya ka o mini Mɔab kpamba ʒiɛla o sara maligu shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maa gbini. Ka Balak daa bɔh o, Wula ka Yawɛ lee yɛli.
en: Balaam approached Balak, who was standing by his entirely burned offering with the officials of Moab. Balak said to him, What did the LORD say.

dag: Anabi Aizaia daa lan yɛli: Zallakudura Naa yi di daa bi chɛ ti shɛba, ti naan kpi zaa kaman Sɔdomnim mini Gomɔranim la.
en: Isaiah also said, If the Lord All-Powerful had not spared some of our descendants, we would have been destroyed like the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah.

dag: Yinim Itiɔpianima bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi ku yi gba.
en: The Lord will also put the people of Ethiopia to death.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, biɛhiŋ kani, na so ŋun daa leeg o nam ka o yuli ʒiɛm o ni daa po pɔri shɛli la, ka saɣim alikauli maa ni be luɣ shɛli din nyɛ Babilɔn maa ni ka o ni kpi.
en: As surely as I am the living God, says the Sovereign Lord , this king will die in Babylonia because he broke his oath and the treaty he had made with the king of Babylonia, who put him on the throne.

dag: di daa nyɛla wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha, ka n ti nya neesim din ne pam gari wuntaŋa ka di yi zuɣusaa na ti neei gili m mini bɛn daa laɣim chani maa soli maa ni.
en: About noon I saw a light brighter than the sun. It flashed from heaven on me and on everyone traveling with me.

dag: Naawuni dan ya la shaara, dinzuɣu di leeya ninsalinim daba.
en: God bought you for a price; so do not become slaves of people.

dag: Yi yi gbibi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ fukumsi zaligunima, ka dol o soli, ŋun Yawɛ ni zaŋ ya leeg o niriba bɛn be kasi kaman o ni daa po pɔri yɛli ya shɛm la.
en: The LORD will establish you as his own, a holy nation, just as he swore to you, if you keep the LORD your Gods commandments and walk in his ways.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa kahigi yɛli Simiɔn ni o ku kpi faashee ka o nini ti nya ti Duuma ni daa lo ni o ni ti ba Masia so la.
en: and had assured him that he would not die before he had seen the Lord's promised Messiah.

dag: Babilɔn yɛla yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ: Kaman pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga ni ʒiɛri tiŋgban nɛli ni shɛm, lala ka mbusim pɔhim yɛn yi tiŋgban shɛli din mali dabiɛm ni na.
en: This is a message about a desert beside the sea: Enemies from a hostile nation attack like a whirlwind from the Southern Desert.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ garigi yɛli naa maa, Daniɛl ŋun nyɛ Juda daba la ni yino la bi lihi nya a bee n-dol a ni zali zaligu shɛli maa. O kul suhirila o Naawuni siɣimsiɣim butata dahin yini puuni.
en: So they said to the king, One of the Judean exiles, Daniel, has ignored you, Your Majesty, as well as the law you signed. He says his prayers three times a day.

dag: Miriya ka yi mɔŋ sana bee kpibiga o yɛlimaŋli ni nyɛ shɛli, ka miriya ka yi deei pakoli chinchini sɔŋ pɔi ka naanyi zaŋ binshɛli paŋ o.
en: Make sure that orphans and foreigners are treated fairly. And if you lend money to a widow and want to keep something of hers to guarantee that she will pay you back, don't take any of her clothes.

dag: Ka sakuɣa maa daa saɣim bɛ mihi mini bɛ chi zaa, dama bɛ chi maa daa bimi ka mihi maa pum puma.
en: The flax had already developed its seeds, and the barley was already blooming. So these plants were destroyed.

dag: Ka Sirianim maa daa kana ni bɛ ti liri Ilaisha, ka Ilaisha suhi Yawɛ yɛli, N suhir a, chɛ ka niriba ŋɔ zom! Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ shiri zom kaman Ilaisha ni daa suh o yɛli shɛm maa.
en: When the Syrians attacked, Elisha prayed, O Lord , strike these men blind! The Lord answered his prayer and struck them blind.

dag: Ka tulaale zim shɛŋa bɛ ni booni mɛɛr mini aloosi ni kasia nyom be a situra ni; ka bɛ ni zaŋ wɔbinyina mali a nam yil shɛl la ni biŋkumda chɛ ka a mali suhupiɛlli.
en: All your clothes have the pleasing scent of myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon. The music of stringed instruments coming from ivory palaces entertains you.

dag: Yi bi mi ni bɛ ni daa baptaizi ti la wuhiya ni ti be Yisa Masia ni, ka lan wuhi ni ti pahila o zuɣu kpi gba?.
en: Don't you know that all who share in Christ Jesus by being baptized also share in his death?.

dag: ka di shiri niŋ pali, ka bɛ yɛli ya, Chɛliya ka ti doli wun shɛŋa ka jɛmdi li.
en: And the sign or miracle they told you about might come true. Then they might ask you to follow other gods and say to you, Lets serve these gods.

dag: Zuliya shɛb bɛn daa kpalim maa n-nyɛ: Filistia nanima anu mini Keenannim zaa ni Sidɔnnim ni Hivinim bɛn be Lɛbanɔn Zoli zuɣu n-zaŋ Baalihɛrimɔn Zoli zuɣu hal ti paai Lɛbohamat dunoli shee la.
en: the Philistines and their five rulers, as well as the Canaanites, the Sidonians, and the Hivites that lived in the Lebanon Mountains from Mount Baal-Hermon to Hamath Pass.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yi Pɛɛga maa chaŋ Antiɔk din be Pisidia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la n-daa ti chaŋ Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu Vuhim Dabisili dali ti ʒini.
en: They went on from Perga and arrived at Antioch in Pisidia. On the Sabbath, they entered and found seats in the synagogue there.

dag: amaa chamila n ya n dɔɣiriba sani ti bo paɣ na ti ti m bia maa ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: Instead, go back to the land where I was born and find a wife for my son from among my relatives.

dag: Ka Mɔdɛkai daa sab yɛl shɛŋa din niŋ maa zaa sɔŋ. O daa sab gbana ti Yɛhudianim bɛn zaa be yoma mini katinsi Naa Ahasivɛrɔs tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni.
en: Mordecai had these events written down and sent letters to all the Jews, near and far, throughout the Persian Empire.

dag: O daa mali piɛri mini niɣi pam ni tumtumdiba gba pam, ka Filistianim daa ti zabir o nyuli di zuɣu.
en: He had livestock, both flocks and cattle, and many servants. As a result, the Philistines envied him.

dag: Yi ni yɛn ti Lɛvinim tin shɛŋa maa puuni, timiya ba tins ayɔbu din yɛn nyɛ nir ni yɛn ku ninsala ka zo n-kuli di ni tiligi, ka ti ba tinsi pihinahinaayi pahi.
en: Six of those cities will be cities of safety. If a person accidentally kills someone, that person can run to those towns for safety. In addition to those six cities, you will also give more cities to the Levites.

dag: Ka ti yi zaɣisila Yawɛ ka me sara maligu bimbini ŋɔ ni ti zaŋdi biŋkɔbiri maani sara pari di zuɣu nyɔri buɣim bee n-zaŋdi bindira sara bee suhudoo sara pari di zuɣu, ŋun Yawɛ maŋmaŋ ŋun darigim ti tibili.
en: If we disobeyed the Lord and built our own altar to burn sacrifices on or to use for grain offerings or fellowship offerings, let the Lord himself punish us.

dag: Bɛ daa gbahi paɣiba mini bɛnkam daa be nimaani n-nyɛ bihi ni ninkura zaa. Bɛ daa bi ku so, amaa bɛ daa kul gbahi ba mi n-zaŋ ba chaŋ bɛ chandi.
en: taking the women and everyone in the city prisoner, whether young or old. They hadnt killed anyone but carried them off and went on their way.

dag: ka di chɛ ka yi laɣim taba ni naŋgban yini m-paɣiri Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma Yisa Masia Ba ŋɔ.
en: Then you will all be joined together. And all together you will give glory to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi Ayuba yɛtɔɣa sanʒiɛɣu puuni yɛli.
en: Then the Lord spoke to Job from a whirlwind and said.

dag: Wuntizɔra wuhir o zɔnim din viɛla, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri soli kpɛhirila nir yɔɣu.
en: You are better off to do right, than to lose your way by doing wrong.

dag: Yi pun wum ka n yɛli ya ni n ni chaŋ ka ti lan lab yi sanna yaha. Yi yi di yuri ma, yi naan mali suhupiɛlli n ni chani m Ba sani maa zuɣu, dama m Ba maa gari ma.
en: You have already heard me say I am going and I will also come back to you. If you really love me, you should be glad I am going back to the Father, because he is greater than I am.

dag: Ka Daniɛl daa yɛli naa maa, Mal a pina maa bee zaŋmi li ti so. Amaa n ni karim sabbu maa, ka wuhi nyin naa di gbinni.
en: Daniel answered the king: Keep your gifts. Give the rewards to someone else. But I will still read the writing to the king and interpret it for him.

dag: Ka n chɛ ka Ijiptinim maa niŋ tipawumli siɣi doli ba na, ka di chɛ ka n nya jilima Firawuna min o tɔbbihi zaa ni o chɛchɛbunsi ni o chɛchɛbunduhiriba zuɣu.
en: But me, Ill make the Egyptians stubborn so that they will go in after them, and Ill gain honor at the expense of Pharaoh, all his army, his chariots, and his cavalry.

dag: Nyini n-fa ma n dimnim nuu ni bahi. Yɛlimaŋli, a duhi ma ka n gari n dimnima; ka yihi ma duŋtaariba nuu ni.
en: who delivers me from my enemies. Yes, you lifted me high above my adversaries; you delivered me from violent people.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima ni bɛ piim tinsi bɛ ni deei tiŋgban shɛŋa la ni n-ti Lɛvinim ka bɛ be di ni, ka ti ba biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee tiŋgbana ka di do n-gili tinsi maa.
en: Command the Israelites that they give cities from their inherited property to the Levites in which to live. You will also give the Levites pastures around their cities.

dag: Dinzuɣu di simdi ka bɛ gbibi n zaligunima, di yi pa lala bɛ yi birigi li, bɛ ni kpe alahichi ni di zuɣu ka kpi. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun mali ba ka bɛ be kasi.
en: The priests must be very careful when it comes time to serve me. They must be careful not to dishonor the holy things. If they are careful, they will not die. I, the Lord , have separated them from the rest of the people for this special job.

dag: Yawɛ daa ti ma laara n wuntitali zuɣu; o yo ma samli n ni ka galimi zuɣu.
en: The Lord rewarded me for doing what is right. He was good to me because I am innocent.

dag: O ni ti tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ kara m-mo Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ, ka ni ti no n-taai wuntizɔriba. O ni ti kpaŋ omaŋa ni o taɣi bɛ daadiini zaligunim mini churi puhibu saha, ka ni ti su wuntizɔriba yuma ata ni pirigili.
en: He will say things against the Most High and will exhaust the holy ones of the Most High. He will try to change times set by law. And for a period of time, periods of time, and half a period of time, they will be delivered into his power.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋun nyɛ yɛndana ni shini tuumbiɛri ŋɔ saha; dama tuumbiɛri saha n-shiri bala!.
en: Therefore, the one who is wise will keep silent in that time; it is an evil time.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛhab bia Ahazia daa yɛli Jɛhɔshafat, Chɛ ka n niriba pah a niriba zuɣu ka bɛ zaŋ ŋarima maa chaŋ; amaa ka Jɛhɔshafat daa bi saɣi.
en: Then King Ahaziah of Israel offered to put some of his own sailors with Jehoshaphats men on the ships, but Jehoshaphat refused to accept his help.

dag: Ka Naawuni suhu daa paligi Sulemaana ni suhi binshɛli maa zuɣu.
en: It pleased the LORD that Solomon had made this request.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu ŋɔ, bɛ daa kuhirimi, ka bɛ ni so daa bi lan zaŋ salima nɛma niŋ omaŋa.
en: When the people heard this, they began to mourn and did not wear jewelry any more.

dag: Balak ni daa wum ni Balaam kanna, o daa yimi chaŋ ti tuh o soli Ar fɔntiŋ shɛli din ʒi m-baɣi Arinɔn Mɔɣili Mɔab tintariga polo la.
en: When Balak heard that Balaam was coming, he went out to meet him at Ir-moab, which is on the border of the Arnon at the farthest point of the border.

dag: ka yi ti zaŋ li yɛli yi bihi mini yi yaansi n ni daa chɛ ka Ijiptinim maa tum jɛrilim shɛm, ka n tum alahiziba tuun shɛŋa ni di chɛ ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: and so that you can tell your children and grandchildren how I overpowered the Egyptians with the signs I did among them. You will know that I am the LORD.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Zaŋmiya li ti ma na.
en: He said, Bring them here to me.

dag: O daa lan mali sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu binyara zaa. Di duɣuri mini di soobuya ni di taha ni di dirijaba ni lahi din ni moori buɣim. Daanya ka o daa zaŋ mali di zaa.
en: The equipment for the altar was also made of bronze—the pans for the hot ashes, the shovels, the bowls, the meat forks, and the fire pans.

dag: O daa lan wuh o bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ salima shɛm tariga mali Naawuni jɛma balibu kam salima lahi ni bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ anzinfa shɛm tariga mali Naawuni jɛma kam anzinfa lahi.
en: David told Solomon how much gold and silver should be used to make all the things to be used in the Temple.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli kul ka ti sani hal biɛla gba, ka ninvuɣ so ŋun je zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu nyɛla ŋun be barina ni. Ka Yawɛ daa nya yɛlimaŋli biɛhigu ni kani maa, ka di bi niŋ o nyaɣisim.
en: There is so little honesty that those who stop doing evil find themselves the victims of crime. The Lord has seen this, and he is displeased that there is no justice.

dag: O daa di tarimba mini nandaamba saria ka di viɛla. Pa nira ni yɛn niŋ shɛm wuhi ni o mi ma m-bala? Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: He gave the poor a fair trial, and all went well with him. That is what it means to know the Lord .

dag: Ka o daa lan ŋahi ba ŋaha ŋɔ yɛli, So na ʒi n-tooi binyɛr palli tani n-liɣi binyɛr kurili; dama o yi niŋ lala o cheei binyɛr palli maa, ka tam palli din liɣi binyɛr kurili maa mi ku ŋman li.
en: Jesus also told them this parable: You don't tear a piece off a new coat to patch up an old coat. If you do, you will have torn the new coat, and the piece of new cloth will not match the old.

dag: O ni ti fa yi tumtumdi dɔbba mini paɣiba, ka deei yi naɣ viɛla mini yi bun viɛla zaa ka bɛ tumd o tuma.
en: The king will take your slaves and your best young men and your donkeys and make them do his work.

dag: N suhu ni ti yiɣisi pam. Ka n suhuyiɣisili maa ti lu bɛ zuɣu hal ka n nini ti tiɣi li. Ka bɛ baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala n nyuli zabbu puuni, n suhu yi ti yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: My anger will be complete. I will exhaust my wrath against them and take my revenge. Then they will know that I, the LORD, have spoken against them in my zeal and consumed them in my wrath.

dag: ka yɛli ba, N yi ti paai sansani maa shee, yin lihimiya ma ka niŋ n ni niŋdi shɛm.
en: Then Gideon told the men, Watch me and do what I do. Follow me to the edge of the enemy camp. When I get to the edge of the camp, do exactly what I do.

dag: O kari doli ba chani ni alaafee, ka di bi ŋman o naba shihiri tiŋa.
en: He goes after them so quickly that his feet barely touch the ground— he doesn't even get hurt.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisifu daa niŋ yomyom bo luɣ shɛli o ni yɛn zani kum, dama o suhu n-daa palig o tizo maa zuɣu ti yaɣi. O daa kpɛla o duu puuni ti kum.
en: Josephs feelings for his brother were so strong he was about to weep, so he rushed to another room and wept there.

dag: Ka Naawuni malaika ŋun daa be Izraɛlnim maa tooni la daa gari ti zani bɛ nyaaŋa polo, ka sagban daantaliga la gba daa gari ti zani bɛ nyaaŋa polo.
en: Gods messenger, who had been in front of Israels camp, moved and went behind them. The column of cloud moved from the front and took its place behind them.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla halibiɛrinima, amaa man yur a zaligunim pam.
en: They have no understanding, but I find pleasure in your law.

dag: Paɣimiya Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma Yisa Masia Ba ŋun niŋ alibarika kam din nyɛ alizanda ni alibarika niŋ ti ni Masia zuɣu ŋɔ!.
en: Bless the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! He has blessed us in Christ with every spiritual blessing that comes from heaven.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ n ni suui bɛ ni zaŋ ʒi tibisa shɛŋa ʒili ya la, ka kabi bɛ ni ban ya bandi shɛŋa la.
en: I'll snap your chains and set you free from the Assyrians.

dag: Yurilim maŋli mini ʒiɛyimtali ni tuhi taba soli; ka wuntitali mini suhudoo mi puhi taba.
en: Love and faithfulness will meet; righteousness and peace will embrace.

dag: Bɛ biɛhi daa kul tuhimi, ka bɛ naba puuni be kaman naɣibila napɔŋ puuni la, ka nyaɣisira kaman daanya shɛli bɛ ni nyahi ka di nyaɣisir la.
en: Their feet looked like proper feet, but the soles of their feet were like calves hooves, and they shone like burnished bronze.

dag: Di ni daa ti kpalim daba ayɔbu ni bɛ puhi Yaɣigari Chuɣu, ka Yisa daa chaŋla Bɛtani din nyɛ o ni daa neei Lazarɔs so la ni daa be tin shɛl la.
en: Six days before the Passover, Jesus went to Bethany, the home of Lazarus, the man he had raised from death.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti ka o tooni na ni wumpaɣibo; ka chɛ ka ti yɔnya suhupiɛlli vuri yili yila paɣ o!.
en: Come and worship him with songs of thanks. Let us sing happy songs of praise to him.

dag: Vihimi Yawɛ kundi ni n-karim di ni yɛli shɛm. Biŋkɔbiri ŋɔ zaɣ yino ku pooi, ka bɛ mi zaa so ku kɔŋ bala. Dama Yawɛ n-zali ni di niŋ lala. Omaŋmaŋ Shia ni laɣim ba na.
en: Look in the Lord s scroll and read what it says: Not one of these will be missing. Not one will be without its mate. God said he would make this happen, so his Spirit will bring them together.

dag: Hal jɛra bɛn fo n-ʒiya, bɛ ni boli ba yɛnnima, bɛ yi bi yaai bɛ noya bɛ ni kali ba pahi yɛnnima ni.
en: Silent fools seem wise. They say nothing and appear to be smart.

dag: Izraɛl zuliya nam be barina ni. Di tipum zuɣupiligu din mali jilima, ka pili bɛ zuɣulaannim bɛn yu nam pam zuɣuri ni la nyɛla din kpaara. Bɛ zuɣuri zaa nyola tulaale, amaa ka bɛ lee nyu wain buɣi do nimaani.
en: The kingdom of Israel is doomed! Its glory is fading like the crowns of flowers on the heads of its drunken leaders. Their proud heads are well perfumed, but there they lie, dead drunk.

dag: Ka ninsal daa boli niɣi zaa mini noonsi zaa ni mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri zaa yuya; amaa ka ninsal ŋun daa lee ka sɔŋda ŋun nyɛ o kpee.
en: The human named all the livestock, all the birds in the sky, and all the wild animals. But a helper perfect for him was nowhere to be found.

dag: Lala mi n-nyɛ li, ti suŋ kam wandila wal suma, ka ti biɛɣukam mi wandi wal biɛri.
en: A good tree produces good fruit, and a bad tree produces bad fruit.

dag: O ni zaŋ a niŋ o kpiŋkpama lɔŋni, ka a nya sɔɣibu shee o kpiŋkpama maa ni. O ʒiɛyimtali nyɛla gbaɣino mini din taɣiri nira.
en: God will protect you with his pinions; youll find refuge under his wings. His faithfulness is a protective shield.

dag: Amaa ka nachin kpɛm maa yɛli ba, Yawɛ ni ti ma nasara shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu, di bi simdi ni yi chɛ ka n lan kpalim be kpe, timiya ma soli ka n labi n dan sani.
en: But he said, Don't make me stay any longer. The Lord has already helped me find a wife for my master's son. Now let us return.

dag: ka tumdi timaŋmaŋ nuu zuɣu tuma n-dihiri timaŋa. Niriba yi turi ti, ti niŋdila alibarika niŋdi bɛ ni; ka bɛ yi niŋ ti alaka, ti zaŋdila suɣilo dee li;.
en: We work hard with our own hands, and when people abuse us, we wish them well. When we suffer, we are patient.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-yɛli maa, yɛlimaŋli, n ni niŋ ninvuɣ biɛ shɛb bɛn laɣim lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ n sani maa lala. Bɛ biɛhigu ni zan tariga, ka bɛ kpi mɔɣu ŋɔ ni.
en: I the LORD have spoken. I will do this to the entire wicked community who gathered against me. They will die in this desert. There theyll meet their end.

dag: Fiɛbisi vuri mini chɛchɛbunsi kalima vuri. Yuri balisira, ka chɛchɛbunsi yiɣiri tɔra!.
en: here is your fate— cracking whips, churning wheels; galloping horses, roaring chariots;.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka niriba maa daa yi Hazɛrɔt n-chaŋ ti dɔni Paran mɔɣu ni.
en: Afterward the people marched from Hazeroth, and they camped in the Paran desert.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli Baruk bɛ nini maa ni.
en: With all the people watching, I said to Baruch.

dag: Azimavɛt ŋun daa nyɛ Adiɛl bia la n-daa su nayili azichi fukumsi, ka Jɔnatan ŋun daa nyɛ Uzia bia la mi daa nyɛ ŋun su bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni mini bɛ fɔntinsi ni tiŋkpansi du shɛŋa din du pam azichi fukumsi.
en: Azmaveth the son of Adiel was in charge of the king's personal storage rooms. Jonathan the son of Uzziah was in charge of the king's other storerooms that were in the towns, the villages, and the defense towers in Israel.

dag: Bɛnjamin zuliya tiŋgban ni, bɛ daa zaŋla Gɛba mini di momaha tiŋgbana ni Alɛmɛt mini di momaha tiŋgbana ni Anatɔt mini di momaha tiŋgbana ti ba. Bɛ ni daa su tin shɛŋa bɛ daŋ maa zaa ni daa nyɛla tinsi pinaata.
en: From Benjamins tribe: Gibeon with its pasturelands, Geba with its pasturelands, Alemeth with its pasturelands, and Anathoth with its pasturelands. They had thirteen towns within their clan.

dag: Pirigim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tari niriba maa kaman bɛ yuya kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Divide the land among the tribes, according to their size.

dag: Dama yi yi taɣi yi biɛhigu mini yi tuma ka be yɛlimaŋli biɛhigu zaŋ chaŋ tab sani.
en: Change the way you are living and stop doing the things you are doing. Be fair in your treatment of one another.

dag: Ti Duuma yɛliya, Niriba ŋɔ yɛri ni bɛ jɛmdila mani, amaa ka bɛ ni yɛri shɛm ka gbinni, dama bɛ suhuri bela katiŋ ka chɛ ma. Ninsalinim zaligunim mini bɛ kaya soli ka bɛ doli jɛmdi ma.
en: The Lord says, These people come to honor me with words, but I am not really important to them. The worship they give me is nothing but human rules they have memorized.

dag: Ka bee binshɛli beni, ka bɛ ni yɛli, Nyamiya, bini ŋɔ din nyɛla bin palli? Di nyɛla binshɛli din pun beni hal ka bɛ na bi dɔɣi ti gba.
en: Someone might say, Here is something new! But it happened before, long before we were born.

dag: Ka n teei n nuu jɛndi ba n-saɣim tiŋgbani ka di bahi yoli, bɛ ni be luɣ shɛlikam zaa, zaŋ tiŋgban nɛli ni hal ti paai Ribila. Di saha ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: But I will raise my arm over you and punish you and your people, wherever they live! I will destroy your country! It will be completely empty from the desert in the south to Riblah in the north. Then they will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Nyini n-chɛ ka teeku vuri fɔra, ka chɛ ka kɔgbana vuri fɔra; nyini n-lan chɛ ka niriba bɛn taai duŋ gba fɔra.
en: You silence the roaring waves and the noisy shouts of the nations.

dag: Lee baŋmiya ni yi yi ku ma, ŋun ka taali ʒim yihibu taali ni ʒi yi mini ya ŋɔ tiŋgbani ni ya ŋɔ nim zuɣu, dama yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ n-tim ma yi sanna ni n ti zaŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa yɛli ya ka yi wum.
en: But if you kill me, be sure of one thing. You will be guilty of killing an innocent person. You will make this city and everyone living in it guilty too. The Lord really did send me to you. The message you heard really is from the Lord.

dag: Vinnyaɣilan kɔre ni be shɛli ni pam nyɛla din kur o. Dama vinnyaɣilana nuhi je tuma.
en: The desires of the lazy will kill them, because their hands refuse to do anything.

dag: kaman tɔŋ la, dama di ni ti paai ŋunkam be dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: like a trap. It will come upon everyone who lives on the face of the whole earth.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti doli soya ŋɔ n-jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Do not worship the Lord your God in the way that these people worship their gods.

dag: ni Patirusinima ni Kasilunima ni Kriitinima .
en: Pathrus, Casluh, and of Crete .

dag: Dindali maa dɔbba ayi ni ti be puu ni; ka Naawuni ti kpuɣ yino ka chɛ ŋun la.
en: At that time there will be two men in the field. One will be taken and the other left.

dag: N ni ku Asirianim bɛn be n tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka du n-tam bɛ zuɣu no ba n zoya la zuɣu, ka tiligi n niriba Asirianim maa ʒi tibisa ʒibu ni.
en: I will wipe out every Assyrian in my country, and I will crush those on my mountains. I will free my people from slavery to the Assyrians.

dag: Di daa bi simdi ni yi kpe n niriba dunɔdaya ni bɛ daashaara nyabu dali. Di daa bi simdi ni yi mali ba ansarisi bɛ wahala dibu mini bɛ daashaara nyabu dali. Ka di mi daa bi simdi ni yi fa bɛ daazichi bɛ daashaara nyabu dali.
en: You shouldnt have entered the gate of my people on the day of their defeat; you shouldnt have even looked on his suffering on the day of his disaster; you shouldnt have stolen his possessions on the day of his distress.

dag: Ka o mini Mariama so bɛ ni daa zaŋ ti o ka o mali puu la kuli bɛ ya Bɛtilihɛm ni bɛ ti sab bɛ yuya.
en: He went to be enrolled together with Mary, who was promised to him in marriage and who was pregnant.

dag: Ka Filip daa chaŋ Samaria nti yihiri waazu yɛri ba ni Yisa n-nyɛ Masia.
en: Philip went to the city of Samaria and told people about the Messiah.

dag: Ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa bɔri ni o ku Jɔn, amaa ka zɔri niriba, dama sokam daa saɣiya ni o nyɛla anabi.
en: Herod wanted to kill him, but he was afraid of the Jewish people, because they considered John to be a prophet.

dag: Ka n ni daa dɔɣi maa nyaaŋa, di daba ata dali, ka paɣ ŋɔ gba daa dɔɣi, m min o kɔŋko n-kul be yili maa ni, ka so ka ti sani n-kul pahila ti niriba ayi maa kɔŋko.
en: Two days after my child was born, she also gave birth to a baby boy. Only the two of us were there in the house—no one else was present.

dag: Yuŋ zahima yɛla tɛhibu puuni, saha shɛli niriba ni gbihi maai la.
en: Like a nightmare it disturbed my sleep.

dag: Ka Liya dab bipuɣiŋga Zilipa maa daa dɔɣi bidibiga ti Yaakubu.
en: and they had a son.

dag: Amaa ka Shafan bia Ahikam daa zaŋ o zaŋsim niŋ Jɛrimia ni, ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ bi zaŋ o ti niriba ni bɛ ku o.
en: But because I had the support of Ahikam son of Shaphan, I was not handed over to the people and killed.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa ŋmaligi yul o nyaandoliba maa, ka kpahi Pita zuɣu ni yɛli, Sintani ŋɔ! Garimi n nyaaŋa! Dama a bi tɛhiri yɛl shɛŋa din nyɛ Naawuni dini yɛla, amaa din nyɛ salinim dini yɛla ka a tɛhira.
en: But when Jesus turned and saw the disciples, he corrected Peter. He said to him, Satan, get away from me! You are thinking like everyone else and not like God.

dag: Ka Adɔnija daa ti zaŋ piɛri mini naɣilalantaba ni naɣibihi pol kpaba n-kɔri ba Wahu Kuɣili din daa do m-baɣi Ɛnrɔgɛl la, ka boli nabihi bɛn nyɛ o mabihi zaa mini Juda nabihi zaa na.
en: So Adonijah prepared lamb, oxen, and fattened cattle at the Stone of Zoheleth, next to En-rogel. He invited his brothers and all the citizens of Judah who were the royal servants to come.

dag: A nuhi ka a zaŋ me ma, ka lan ŋmaligi kuri ma pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Your hands made me and shaped my body. But now they are closing around me and squeezing me to death!.

dag: Doliya n ni zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa tiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Nyama, n ni kari Amɔrinim mini Keenannim ni Hitinim ni Pɛrizinim ni Hivinim ni Jɛbusinima, ka chɛ palo tin ya.
en: Be sure to obey what I command you today. Im about to drive out before you the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

dag: Ka Zɛra ŋun daa nyɛ Itiɔpia nir la tɔbbihi tuhi tuhili mini chɛchɛbunsi kɔbisita kana ti liri ba Marɛsha.
en: An Ethiopian named Zerah invaded Judah with an army of a million men and three hundred chariots and advanced as far as Mareshah.

dag: Yawɛ n-tim ba ni bɛ cham gili kaai dunia ŋɔ nya.
en: The Lord sent them to go and inspect the earth.

dag: Bɛ ni daa chani maa ka o ʒeei gom, ka sanʒiɛɣu ti yiɣisi teeku maa ni n-ʒiɛri kom niŋdi bɛ ŋariŋ maa ni hal ka di ti yɛn tum ba barina.
en: As they were sailing, Jesus fell asleep. Suddenly a strong wind blew down on the lake, and the boat began to fill with water, so that they were all in great danger.

dag: Yi nya nir ni yiri taali ni Naawuni sani o tuma tumbu zuɣu shɛm, ka pa ni o yɛda niŋbu kɔŋko zuɣu.
en: So you see that people are made right with God by what they do. They cannot be made right by faith alone.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti kum niŋ Yawɛ, amaa ka o ku garigi ba; di saha maa, o ni ti lɛb o nyaaŋa biri ba bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛri zuɣu.
en: Then you will pray to the Lord , but he will not answer you. No, he will hide his face from you, because what you do is evil.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ malaika daa yɛli Ilaija, Tishibi nir la, Yiɣisim chaŋ ti tuhi Samaria naa tuumba ŋɔ soli m-bɔhi ba, Naawuni n-lee ka Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni bee di chaŋ wula ka yi ti chanila Baalizibub ŋun nyɛ Ɛkurɔn buɣili la sani ni a ti bɔh o nya.
en: But an angel of the Lord commanded Elijah, the prophet from Tishbe, to go and meet the messengers of King Ahaziah and ask them, Why are you going to consult Baalzebub, the god of Ekron? Is it because you think there is no god in Israel?.

dag: Zuɣusaa, chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔ yɛla mal a dabiɛm; sɔhigima, kul di chɛ ka binshɛli be a ni. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: And so I command the sky to shake with horror, to be amazed and astonished.

dag: Chɛliya ma vuri ka n yɛli, ka chɛ ka din yɛn niŋ ma niŋ ma.
en: Be quiet while I speak, and we'll see what happens.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Zanimiya sochira zuɣu lihi, bɔhimiya baŋ kurimbuni ha soya la, ka bɔhi baŋ so viɛlli ni nyɛ shɛli n-dol li ka nya suhudoo. Amaa ka bɛ yɛli, Ti ku dol li.
en: The LORD proclaims: Stop at the crossroads and look around; ask for the ancient paths. Where is the good way? Then walk in it and find a resting place for yourselves. But you said, We wont go.

dag: Ka o daa lab ti yɛli Juda, M bi nya paɣ maa; ka tiŋ maa nim yɛli ma ni pagɔr so na ʒi n-ka kpe na.
en: Hirah went back and told Judah, I couldn't find the woman, and the people of Enaim said no prostitute had ever been there.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla m min a ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛl la dina, Yawɛ ni be m min a sunsuuni sahakam.
en: As for the promise we have made to each other, the Lord will make sure that we will keep it forever.

dag: Ka anab Gaad daa ti yɛli Dauda, Di kpalim be vokabili ŋɔ ni, yiɣisim kpe kuli Juda tiŋgban ni. Ka Dauda daa yi nimaani chaŋ Hɛrɛt yɔɣu ni.
en: But the prophet Gad said to David, Dont stay in the fort. Go to the land of Judah. So David left and went to Hereth Forest.

dag: Tarim so ŋun nahind o tarim taba ŋmanila sa so ŋun mi n-ʒi bindira zaa chaŋ.
en: A leader who takes advantage of the poor is like a hard rain that destroys the crops.

dag: Di saha ka Zɔfar ŋun daa nyɛ Naama nir la daa garigi yɛli.
en: Will no one answer all this nonsense? Does talking so much put you in the right?.

dag: O daa zali Yaakubu zuliya zaligu, ka zali zaligu Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Di nyɛla o ni daa zali ti yaannim zaligu shɛli ni bɛ zaŋ wuhi bɛ bihi.
en: He made an agreement with Jacob. He gave the law to Israel. He gave the commands to our ancestors. He told them to teach the law to their children.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa nya shihir shɛli Yisa ni wuhi maa ka bɛ yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ ni daa yɛli ni anab so ni ti ka dunia ŋɔ ni na la n-shiri bala.
en: Seeing this miracle that Jesus had performed, the people there said, Surely this is the Prophet who was to come into the world.

dag: Gbib amaŋ viɛnyɛliŋga, ka lihim a wuhibu viɛnyɛliŋga. Kul niŋmi dimbɔŋɔnima, dama a yi niŋdi lala, a ni tilig amaŋa zaŋ tabili bɛn wumd a wuhibu.
en: Focus on working on your own development and on what you teach. If you do this, you will save yourself and those who hear you.

dag: Ka maligumaana Jɛhɔiada daa zaŋ kpana mini nyɔtaɣirisi din daa nyɛ Naa Dauda dini, ka be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni n-ti sapashinnim maa.
en: Jehoiada brought out the swords and shields that had belonged to King David and gave them to the commanders.

dag: Ka bɛ ni shɛb daa bɔri ni bɛ gbaag o, amaa ka so daa lee bi zaŋ o nuu shih o.
en: Some wanted to arrest him, but no one grabbed him.

dag: Hiburɔn bidibisi ni, Ɛliɛl n-daa nyɛ kpɛma, ka bɛ daŋ maa ni niriba pihinii pah o zuɣu.
en: Eliel, the leader of Hebrons family, and of his relatives.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa Abinadab yiŋ din daa be zoli zuɣu la na nti tam naɣ tɔroko palli zuɣu; ka Yuza mini Ahio bɛn daa nyɛ Abinadab bidibisi la daa be tooni vɔri tɔroko palli maa;.
en: They took it from Abinadab's home on the hill and placed it on a new cart. Uzzah and Ahio, sons of Abinadab, were guiding the cart.

dag: Ka Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa daa kpalim be Obɛdɛdom min o yiŋnim sani o yiŋa chira ata. Ka Yawɛ daa niŋ alibarika niŋ Obɛdɛdom min o yiŋnim ni ni o ni daa mali binshɛlikam zaa ni.
en: Gods chest stayed with Obed-edoms household for three months, and the LORD blessed Obed-edoms household and all that he had.

dag: Ka bɛ suhuri daa ti paligi pam ka bɛ yɛli, Bolimiya Samsin na ka o ti diɛm wuhi ti. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ sarika ni ti zaŋ Samsin na, ka o daa kana ti diɛm wuhi ba. Bɛ daa chɛ ka o ʒiɛla daantalisi sunsuuni.
en: At the height of the celebration, they said, Call for Samson so he can perform for us! So they called Samson from the prison, and he performed in front of them. Then they had him stand between the pillars.

dag: A nyina piɛlimi kaman bɛ ni su piɛ nyaan shɛb kom ka bɛ zaɣ yino kam mali jaa, ka bɛ ni so bi kɔŋ o bala.
en: Your teeth are as white as a flock of sheep that have just been washed. Not one of them is missing; they are all perfectly matched.

dag: Ka Mariama daa yɛli, N tibigiri n Duuma n suhu ni.
en: Mary said: With all my heart I praise the Lord.

dag: Bɛnjamin bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Bɛla mini Bɛcha ni Jɛdiayɛl, bɛ daa nyɛla niriba ata.
en: Benjamins family: Bela, Becher, and Jediael—three in all.

dag: A daa lan tum pagɔrisigu tuma Kalidia din nyɛ kɔhigɔriba tiŋgbɔŋ la ni, hal ka a nini na kul bi tiɣi dimbɔŋɔ gba.
en: so you went after Babylonians. But those merchants could not satisfy you either.

dag: ni Jaala daŋ niriba ni Darikɔn daŋ niriba ni Gidɛl daŋ niriba.
en: Jaala, Darkon, Giddel.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Dinzuɣu nyamiya, n je anabi shɛb bɛn zuri n yɛligu bɛ tab sani la.
en: This message is from the Lord : So I am against the false prophets. They keep stealing my words from each other.

dag: Ka anabi kurili maa daa kpuɣi anab ŋuni maa pa buŋ zuɣu n-zaŋ o kuli yiŋa ni bɛ ti kum o kuli ka sɔɣ o.
en: The prophet lifted the body of the man of God and put it on the donkey. He brought it back, arriving in the old prophets town to mourn and bury the man of God.

dag: Wuntitali nyɛla din guli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi din tuhi, amaa alahichi nyɛla din bahiri ninvuɣ biɛri yoli.
en: Righteousness guards the innocent on the path, but wickedness misleads sinners.

dag: Bɛ ni ti pirig a situra, ka yeeg a yɛ viɛla zaa.
en: They will take your nice clothes and jewelry.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a boli ma ninvuɣ suŋ? Ninvuɣ suŋ kani n-naɣ pahila Naawuni.
en: Jesus replied, Why do you call me good? No one is good except the one God.

dag: Man Yawɛ ni ti nyɛ bɛ Naawuni, ka n dabili Dauda ti nyɛ bɛ naa be bɛ sunsuuni. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: He will be your leader, and I will be your God. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Di saha ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan Hilikia daa yɛli gbaŋŋmara Shafan, N nyala Naawuni zaligu kundi la Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ŋɔ ni; ka daa zaŋ kundi maa ti Shafan ka o karim li.
en: Hilkiah the high priest said to Shaphan the secretary, Look, I found the Book of the Law in the Lord s Temple! Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and Shaphan read it.

dag: Doliya yi ni bɔhim shɛli mini yi ni deei shɛli n san la zaŋ tabili n yɛtɔɣa mini n tuma; ka Naawuni ŋun tiri ti suhudoo la ni be yi sani.
en: And do what you learned and received from me—what I told you and what you saw me do. And the God who gives peace will be with you.

dag: Amaa ka niriba maa daa kul shini, ka bi garigi yɛl o shɛli, dama Naa Hɛzɛkia daa pun yɛli ba, Di garigiy o.
en: The people kept quiet, just as King Hezekiah had told them to; they did not say a word.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Yinim bɛn kalinli pɔri ŋɔ, di zɔriya dabiɛm, dama di nyɛla yi Ba Naawuni yubu ni o tin ya nam.
en: Dont be afraid, little flock, because your Father delights in giving you the kingdom.

dag: Yawɛ zɔbu nyɛla nyɛvili kɔbilinini din ni chɛ ka nir yi kum zana ni.
en: Do you want to avoid death? Reverence for the Lord is a fountain of life.

dag: N nyɛla a dabili; tim ma baŋsim, din ni chɛ ka m baŋ a zaligunima.
en: Im your servant! Help me understand so I can know your laws.

dag: Chi sara dina, o bom chi lita pinaayopɔin ni pirigili pahi naɣilaa zuɣu, ka bo chi lita pinaayopɔin ni pirigili pahi piɛlaa zuɣu, o ni kul bɔri shɛm tariga ti, ka lan bo kpam lita ata pali pahi chi tahili kam zuɣu.
en: With the bull and the ram, he is to offer nine kilograms of grain, and with each of the lambs, he can offer as much as he wants. He must also offer three liters of olive oil with every nine kilograms of grain.

dag: Kpalimmiya be ti sani. Yi ni tooi be yi suhuri ni bɔri ni yi be luɣ shɛlikam tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni, ka gɔri kɔhigu yi yubu, ka su tiŋgbani maa luɣ shɛŋa polo.
en: Then you may stay here in our country with us; you may live anywhere you wish, trade freely, and own property.

dag: M mali yiko ni n di niŋ a zaɣ biɛɣu, amaa a ba Yisahaku Naawuni la sa yɛli ma yuŋ la, Miri ka a yɛli Yaakubu yɛtɔɣ viɛlli bee zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: I could easily hurt you, but the God your father worshiped has warned me not to make any threats or promises.

dag: Nir suhu yi bɔri binshɛli ka o ka yɛm, di bi viɛla, ka nir ŋun chani yomyom ti yaɣi bahirila soli.
en: Enthusiasm without knowledge is not good; impatience will get you into trouble.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi nirilim zaŋdi bɛ binyara paŋdi niriba mali alibarika. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli yɛlimaŋli soli tumdi bɛ tuma mali alibarika.
en: Those who lend generously are good people— as are those who conduct their affairs with justice.

dag: Ka Juda zuliya niriba shɛb mini Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba ni Ifriim zuliya niriba ni Manaasa zuliya niriba daa be Jɛrusalɛm.
en: People from the tribes of Judah, Benjamin, Ephraim, and Manasseh went to live in Jerusalem.

dag: Yinim Izraɛlnima, niŋmiya Yawɛ naani! Ŋuna n-nyɛ yi sɔŋda ni ŋun guli ya.
en: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ bɛ zaa alahiziba ka bɛ yɛri taba, Nyamiya, bɛn zaa tɔɣisiri ŋɔ pala Galilinima?.
en: They were all amazed at this. They did not understand how the apostles could do this. They said, Look! These men we hear speaking are all from Galilee.

dag: Amaa a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm yi pɔri ŋɔ taali ni nyɛla a yi chaŋ n dɔɣiriba maa sani, ka bɛ ti zaɣisi ni bɛ ku ti a paɣ na, dindina a yi m pɔri maa taali ni.
en: If you go to my relatives, you will be free from your obligation to me. Even if they provide no one for you, you will be free from your obligation to me.

dag: Man Pool ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia tumo Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira ŋɔ mini Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ ti tahima la ni zal li shɛm la puuni n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ.
en: From Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by order of God our Savior and Christ Jesus our hope—.

dag: Hal maligumaaniba mini anabinim gba nyurila wain n-chani laana. Bɛ nyula wain maa mini binnyur kpɛma n-chani laani ka birim. Bɛ bi lan baŋdi ʒii nyabu gbinni, bɛ mi bi lan kariti saria din tuhi.
en: Priests and prophets stumble because they are drunk. Their minds are too confused to receive God's messages or give honest decisions.

dag: Ŋuni n-leei beni ka ku kpi? Ka ŋuni n-leei ni tooi tiligi kpiimba biɛhigu shee yiko ni?.
en: Who lives their life without seeing death? Who is ever rescued from the grip of the grave? Selah.

dag: Yawɛ chɛ ka yi zaa yinoyino nya biɛhigu shee yi yidaannim yinsi. Ka Naomi daa chɛbisi ba ka ŋmaligi. Ka paɣiba ayi maa zaa dii kuhiri.
en: And may the Lord make it possible for each of you to marry again and have a home. So Naomi kissed them good-bye. But they started crying.

dag: Ka Iso yɛl o, M mini kum kul chɛ tab la kpe ni kpe, ka buchi bɔ ka kpamdi lan yɛn ku ma.
en: I'm about to die, Esau answered. What good will those rights do me.

dag: O daa lan mali sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu binyara zaa. Di duɣuri mini di soobuya ni di taha ni di dirijaba ni lahi din ni moori buɣim. Daanya ka o daa zaŋ mali di zaa.
en: He also made all the equipment for the altar: the pans, the shovels, the bowls, the hooks, and the fire pans. All this equipment was made of bronze.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N yɛn namla zuɣusaa zaɣ palli mini dunia palli, ka so ku lan teei binshɛŋa din pun gari la yɛla.
en: The Lord says, I am making a new earth and new heavens. The events of the past will be completely forgotten.

dag: Naawuni yino m-beni, ka sandaantimda yino kɔŋko mi m-be Naawuni mini salinim sunsuuni, ŋuna n-nyɛ Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ daadam.
en: There is only one God, and there is only one way that people can reach God. That way is through Christ Jesus, who as a man.

dag: N Duuma Yisa zuɣu, m mi ka biɛhiŋ kani ni binshɛɣ kani m-mali daɣiri dimaŋmaŋ puuni, amaa so yi tɛhi ni binshɛli mali daɣiri, o sani di shiri mali daɣiri.
en: I know that there is no food that is wrong to eat. The Lord Jesus is the one who convinced me of that. But if someone believes that something is wrong, then it is wrong for that person.

dag: A dol a ni daa lo a dabili m ba Dauda alikauli shɛl la. Yɛlimaŋli, a zaŋ a nuu tum tuma m-pal a ni daa yaag a noli yɛli shɛm maa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: My father David was your servant, and today you have kept every promise you made to him.

dag: O ni ti wurim kuɣa binnana din be Hɛliɔpolis Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, ka nyo Ijiptinim buɣa jɛmbu duri buɣim.
en: He will destroy the memorial stones that are in the temple of the Sun God in Egypt, and he will burn down the temples of the false gods of Egypt.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Yisa gba daa kpi tin tariga ni o zaŋ omaŋmaŋ ʒim mali niriba ka bɛ be kasi.
en: For this reason Jesus also died outside the city, in order to purify the people from sin with his own blood.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ biɛri yi chɛ bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali ka tumdi din doli zaligu soli mini din tuhi, bɛ ni be di zuɣu.
en: And if wicked people stop sinning and start doing right, they will save themselves from punishment.

dag: Ka nyini daadam, lum a niriba bɛn bipuɣinsi zaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ tɛha tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa la zuɣu. Tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi ba.
en: God said, Son of man, look at the women prophets in Israel. They say the things they want to say, so you must speak against them for me. You must say this to them:.

dag: Ka yi yaannim maa be ya pumpɔŋɔ? Ka anabinim maa mi, bɛ gba na kul beni?.
en: Your ancestors are gone, and those prophets did not live forever.

dag: Ka di daa bi tooi biɛla ka bɛn daa ʒe nimaani maa kana ti yɛli Pita, A shiri nyɛla bɛ ni yino, dama a yɛtɔɣa n-viig a gbini.
en: A little while later some people standing there walked over to Peter and said, We know you are one of them. We can tell it because you talk like someone from Galilee.

dag: Nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ni Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun ʒi Chɛrubinim zuɣusaa ŋɔ, a kɔŋko n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun su dunia ŋɔ nama zaa fukumsi. Nyini n-nam tiŋgbani mini zuɣusaa.
en: LORD of heavenly forces, God of Israel: you sit enthroned on the winged creatures. You alone are God over all the earths kingdoms. You made both heaven and earth.

dag: Yi nya nir ni yiri taali ni Naawuni sani o tuma tumbu zuɣu shɛm, ka pa ni o yɛda niŋbu kɔŋko zuɣu.
en: So you see that a person is shown to be righteous through faithful actions and not through faith alone.

dag: M bi daai Naawuni daalibarika baɣili, dama taali ni yibu Naawuni sani yi yila Naawuni fukumsi zaligu dolibu ni na, dindina Masia kum la ka daliri.
en: I am not the one destroying the meaning of Gods grace. If following the law is how people are made right with God, then Christ did not have to die.

dag: Yisa ni daa mali ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba ka o sanna o ni daa wuhiri niriba saha shɛli ti bɔh o, Ŋun yiko ni ka a lee tumdi dimbɔŋɔnima bee ŋuni n-lee ti a di yiko maa.
en: Jesus came back to the Temple; and as he taught, the chief priests and the elders came to him and asked, What right do you have to do these things? Who gave you such right.

dag: Ahaz yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pinaayɔbu. O daa bi tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani kaman o yab Dauda ni daa tum shɛm la.
en: Ahaz was years old when he became king. He ruled years in Jerusalem. He did not live right, as David his ancestor had done. Ahaz did not do what the Lord wanted him to do.

dag: Di yi pa lala, nyini n dan naa yi ti di saɣim saɣ a tariga, bɛ ni wuhi ni m mini m bia Sulemaana nyɛla bɛ nyaanyiriba.
en: If you dont decide, then after you are buried, these men will say that Solomon and I are criminals.

dag: Ka Yisa daa bo bumbila m-ba kaman di ni daa sab shɛm la. Di sabiya:.
en: Jesus found a donkey and rode on it, just as the Scriptures say.

dag: Yi ni ti biri yi bimbira yuma ayɔbu, ka wahi yi wain tihi wula nyoya ni bahi, ka pɔhi di wala hal ni yuma ayɔbu.
en: You may raise grain and grapes for six years.

dag: ka mɛnya kuɣa sara maligu bimbini nimaani n-ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ; di ti yɛn nyɛla kuɣa sara maligu bimbini, ka pa yi ni zaŋ kurugu bini shihi kuɣ shɛŋa.
en: and build an altar there for the LORD your God—an altar of stones that havent been cut with iron tools.

dag: Ka di shɛŋa mi lu vuhim shee zooi viɛnyɛliŋga m-mali hal ti dɔɣi niŋ biɛlim kɔbigakɔbiga. Ka Yisa daa naai ŋahili ŋɔ ka ŋmaligi yɛli, Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wumma.
en: And some seeds fell in good soil; the plants grew and bore grain, one hundred grains each. And Jesus concluded, Listen, then, if you have ears.

dag: Adin daŋ — kɔbisinahi ni pihinunaanahi.
en: of Adin.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi darigiri bɛ bihi tibili je ba mi, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yuri bɛ bihi saɣisiri ba mi viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: If you don't punish your children, you don't love them. If you do love them, you will correct them.

dag: Ni o bɔhim o nachimba maa, bɛ ni yɛl o. Dinzuɣu n suhir o mi ni o niŋmi n nachimba ŋɔ nirilim, dama chuɣu dali ka ti kana maa. N suhir o mi, din kul be o nuu ni, ŋun zaŋ ti yinim bɛn nyɛ o tumtumdiba ŋɔ ka yi zaŋ na ti ti o bia Dauda.
en: Just ask them, and they will tell you. We have come on a feast day, and David asks you to receive us kindly. Please give what you can to us your servants and to your dear friend David.

dag: Amaa zaŋmiya Masia niŋ yi suhuri ni ka o nyɛ yi Duuma. Ka kul malimiya shili guri ni yi garigi ŋunkam bɔhi ya bɔhigu zaŋ chaŋ yi ni mali tahima shɛli yi ni la polo.
en: But have reverence for Christ in your hearts, and honor him as Lord. Be ready at all times to answer anyone who asks you to explain the hope you have in you.

dag: Mɛshɛlɛmia daa mali bidibisi. Zakaria n-daa nyɛ kpɛma n-zaŋ Jɛdiayɛl pa, ka Zɛbadia daa pah ata, ka Jatiniɛl pahi anahi;.
en: He had seven sons, who were born in the following order: Zechariah, Jediael, Zebadiah, Jathniel.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ. O kɔŋko n-nyɛ ŋun tumd alahiziba tuma.
en: Bless the LORD God, the God of Israel— the only one who does wondrous things!.

dag: Ka Firawuna suhu daa yu Hadad pam hal ka o ti gbaag o paɣ Tapɛnis tizo n-ti o paɣ pini.
en: Pharaoh liked Hadad so much that he gave Hadad a wife. She was Pharaohs sister-in-law.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa nim daa yina ka bɛ mini Jɔab ti zaŋ nya taba, ka Dauda tɔbbihi maa shɛb daa lu nimaani, ka bɛ daa ku Yuria ŋun nyɛ Hiti nir la gba nimaani.
en: When the citys soldiers came out and attacked Joab, some of the people from Davids army fell. Uriah the Hittite was also killed.

dag: Yɛm tiri yɛndan kpiɔŋ gari nanim pia bɛn be tiŋ puuni.
en: Wisdom does more for a person than ten rulers can do for a city.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa kpaŋsi Shialtiɛl bia Zɛrubabɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Juda gomna la mini Jɛhɔzadak bia Jɔshua ŋun daa nyɛ Maligumaaniba Zuɣulaan la ni niriba maa zaa suhuri, ka bɛ yiɣisi n-gbaai Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu maa mɛbu.
en: The Lord inspired everyone to work on the Temple: Zerubbabel, the governor of Judah; Joshua, the High Priest, and all the people who had returned from the exile. They began working on the Temple of the Lord Almighty, their God.

dag: Ka Mɛfibɔshɛt daa yɛli naa, Nyini n dan naa ni kul lab yiŋ na ni alaafee ŋɔ, chɛ ka o zaŋ di zaa.
en: Mephibosheth said to the king, Let him take all of it, since my master and king has come home safely.

dag: Yi ni ŋubi bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi daba ayopɔin di dabisa maa ni. Di bi simdi ka yi chɛ ka so nya dabindi bɔrɔbɔro yi sani yi biɛhigu shee zaa.
en: During those seven days, you must not eat anything made with yeast or even have yeast anywhere near your homes.

dag: ka zaŋ o nudirigu nubila n-tim kpa shɛli din be o nuzaa ni maa n-zaŋ mihi Yawɛ tooni buyopɔin.
en: He will use the finger of his right hand to sprinkle some of the oil that is in his left palm seven times before the Lord .

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam daa nyɛla nachimbil so ŋun mali kpiɔŋ, ka Sulemaana daa kpahim nya o ni nyɛ tumtumdi biiŋa maa, ka zaŋ o leei Yisifu zuliya niriba tuun kpɛma zaa zuɣulana.
en: Solomon noticed that Jeroboam was a hard worker. So he put Jeroboam in charge of the work force from Manasseh and Ephraim.

dag: Amaa Ashurinim ni ti gbahi yinim Kɛnnim ti leei daba, ka kun ya.
en: But you Kenites will be destroyed, just as the Lord destroyed Cain. Assyria will make you prisoners.

dag: Bɛ ŋari n soli, ka luhi ma, ka bi bɔri so sɔŋsim.
en: They guard the road so that I cannot escape. They succeed in destroying me, without help from anyone.

dag: Di daa ti lu Vuhim Dabisili dali, ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba tim so puu ni garita; ka kum wum o nyaandoliba maa, ka bɛ piligi kabisiri chi ŋubiri chana.
en: Not long afterward Jesus was walking through some wheat fields on a Sabbath. His disciples were hungry, so they began to pick heads of wheat and eat the grain.

dag: Di saha ka o daa zaŋ omaŋ ti tabili tiŋ maa ni tiŋbi so, ka o timd o o puu ni ka o ti dihir o kuruchunima.
en: So he went and got a job with one of the people who lived there. The man sent him into the fields to feed pigs.

dag: Shɛhira dira ŋun nyɛ nia biɛɣulana yi kana ti wuhi ni so tum tuumbiɛɣu.
en: If you accuse someone of a crime, but seem to be lying.

dag: Alɔbo maa ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi pinaanahi ni kɔbisiyopɔin ka naanyi chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpi Kɔra duŋ taabu ni la.
en: But , people died from that sickness—and that is not counting the people who died because of Korah.

dag: Mirimiya ma na ti wum n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm. Piligu ni zaŋ kana, n na ʒi n-yɛli shɛli ashilɔni. N daa pun beni ka yɛlli ŋɔ na bi niŋ. Pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-zaŋ o shia niŋ n ni n-tim ma.
en: Come close to me; listen to this: Since the very beginning I havent spoken in secret. Whenever anything happens, I am there.

dag: Niriba pam daa ti yi tinsi gari shɛm ni laɣim Yisa sanna, ka o daa ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli.
en: When a large crowd from several towns had gathered around Jesus, he told them this story:.

dag: ni o zaŋ omaŋ pa talima n-tiligi bɛn be fukumsi zaligu maa sulinsi ni, ka zaŋ ti leei ŋun Naawuni bihi.
en: to redeem those who were under the Law, so that we might become God's children.

dag: Bɛ daa zaliya ni di saha maa zaŋ chaŋ ʒiɛmana din kanna puuni, Yɛhudia nir kam min o yiŋnim bɛn be tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣili kam ni mini tiŋ kam ni bɛn kul teemi puhimi Purim dabisa chuɣu maa, ka kul niŋmi lala zaŋ chana.
en: So forever every family, province, and town remembers to keep these days. These days of Purim wont die out among the Jews. They will remember to keep them forever.

dag: Dinzuɣu n nyaya ka binshɛli kani n-so m-pahila di simdi ni ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri zaa di bɛ tuma nyɔri, bɛ tarili m-bala. Dama ŋuni n-lee ni ti tooi zaŋ ba labisina ka bɛ ti nya din yɛn be bɛ kalinsi nyaaŋa?.
en: So I realized then that the best thing we can do is enjoy what we have worked for. There is nothing else we can do. There is no way for us to know what will happen after we die.

dag: Ka Rɛhɔbɔam daa ti paɣ Naawuni, ka bɛ zaŋ o sɔɣi pah o yaannim zuɣu Dauda tiŋ la ni. O ma ŋun daa nyɛ Ammɔn paɣ la yuli n-daa booni Naama. Ka o bia Abijam daa di nam zan o ba zaani.
en: Rehoboam's mother Naamah was from Ammon, but when Rehoboam died, he was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem. His son Abijam then became king.

dag: m-pahi maligumaaniba, Ɛliakim mini Maasɛya ni Miniamin ni Mikaya ni Ɛliɔnai ni Zakaria ni Hanania bɛn daa piɛbiri kikahi la.
en: as well as the priests Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, who were blowing trumpets.

dag: Ka bee a tɛhiya ni a gari la Mɔab Naa Balak Zipɔr bia la? O daa ŋme Izraɛlnim naŋgbankpeeni bee n-lo tɔbu ni o tuhi ba?.
en: Do you think you are any better than Balak son of Zippor, king of Moab? He never challenged Israel, did he? Did he ever go to war against us?.

dag: Ka Liya bɔh o, A ni fa n yidan maa nyɛla yɛli bila? Ka a lan bɔri ni a fa n ŋmaankpihiga gba pahi? Ka Reechɛl yɛl o, Kpɛm o sani zuŋɔ yuŋ ŋɔ a bia ŋmaankpihiga maa zuɣu.
en: but Leah said, It's bad enough that you stole my husband! Now you want my son's love flowers too. All right, Rachel answered. Let me have the flowers, and you can sleep with Jacob tonight.

dag: Wuntaŋ ni daa ti lu ka di zibiri saha shɛli, ka buɣim nyokpilli mini buɣim mokpalli daa kana ti kpe nimdi din ŋmahiŋmahi doya maa sunsuuni gari.
en: When the sun had set and it was dark, a smoking fire pot and a flaming torch suddenly appeared and passed between the pieces of the animals.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti wummi tin ya n-tum tuumbiɛ titali ŋɔ, ka yi ti Naawuni nyaaŋa kpuɣi tinzun paɣiba maa.
en: And now, we hear that you also are doing this terrible sin. You are not being true to our God. You are marrying foreign women.

dag: amaa ka yipa kahigi wuhi palɔni pumpɔŋɔ la. Yɛlimaŋli maa kahigi wuhila palɔni pumpɔŋɔ anabinim sabbu puuni, ka Naawuni ŋun nyɛ saha din ka bahigu lan ŋɔ chɛ ka zuliya kam zaa baŋ li ni di chɛ ka niriba niŋ yɛda ka deeg o noli.
en: It has now been shown to us. It was made known by what the prophets wrote, as God commanded. And it has now been made known to all people so that they can believe and obey God, who lives forever.

dag: Jabɛz daa nyɛla ninvuɣ so ŋun mali jilima gar o mabihi zaa, o ma n-daa bol o yuli Jabɛz, ka yɛli ni dama o daa nya biɛrim pam o dɔɣibu ni.
en: Jabez was a man who got his name because of the pain he caused his mother during birth. But he was still the most respected son in his family.

dag: M pun nyaŋ Kalino mini Karikɛmish, ka nyaŋ Hamat mini Aripad, ka nyaŋ Samaria mini Damaskus.
en: Isnt Calno like Carchemish? Isnt Hamath like Arpad? Isnt Samaria like Damascus?.

dag: So be yi ni m-biɛra? O bolimi cheechi toondaannima, ka bɛ ti zaŋ kpam ʒe o ti Duuma yuli zuɣu ka suhi Naawuni ti o.
en: If any of you are sick, they should call for the elders of the church, and the elders should pray over them, anointing them with oil in the name of the Lord.

dag: M Ba, m bɔri ni a chɛ ka a ni daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛba ti ma la ti be n sani n ni ti yɛn be luɣ shɛl la n-nya jilima shɛli a ni daa zaŋ ti ma ka di nyɛla a ni daa pun yuri ma ka dunia na bi nam la zuɣu.
en: Father, I want everyone you have given me to be with me, wherever I am. Then they will see the glory you have given me, because you loved me before the world was created.

dag: Waazuyihira maa yɛliya, Din ka buchi mi din ka buchi; di zaa nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: Perfectly pointless, says the Teacher, everything is pointless.

dag: Musa daa pirigi tiŋgbani shɛli ti Rubin zuliya ni bɛ su li.
en: Moses had given a part of the land to the families of the tribe of Reuben as their possession.

dag: Naawuni Shi yino maa zuɣu ka ti zaa deei baptaizibu niŋgbun yini maa ni, di yi nyɛla Yɛhudianim bee bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ka di yi nyɛla daba bee bilichinnima, Shi yino maa ka ti zaa daa laɣim deei.
en: In the same way, all of us, whether Jews or Gentiles, whether slaves or free, have been baptized into the one body by the same Spirit, and we have all been given the one Spirit to drink.

dag: dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ ninʒeensinim liriti ma mi. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ ninkuunsinim lo nia ni bɛ ku ma. Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn baɣa ka Naawuni ni.
en: The proud have come up against me; violent people want me dead. They pay no attention to God. Selah.

dag: Naawuni Bia Yisa Masia lahibal suŋ m-bɔŋɔ.
en: The Good News about Jesus the Messiah, the Son of God, begins.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yinim bi shɛb bɛn bi ʒe yim ŋɔ, labimiyana, dama mani n-sun ya. N ni yihi yi ninvuɣ yinoyino yi fɔntinsi ni na, ka yihi yi niriba ayiyi yi daŋ kam ni na n-zaŋ ya ka Ziɔn na.
en: The Lord says, You people are unfaithful, but come back to me because I am your master. I will take one person from every city and two people from every family and bring you to Zion.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt yɛli ba, Yi mali tɔbbihi bɛn ni gul li; chamiya ti niŋ yi ni ni niŋ shɛm gul li viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Pilate replied, You have soldiers for guard duty. Go and make it as secure as you know how.

dag: A ni ti bo a dimnim shee, amaa ka ku nya ba; ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tuhir a ni ti bahi yoli.
en: You will look for your opponents, and wont find them. Those who fight you will be of no account and will die.

dag: Ka n yi pirigi n ni mali shɛlikam zaa zaŋ tari, hal ka zaŋ n niŋgbuŋ ti ni bɛ nyo li buɣim, ka ka yurilim, dindina di ku ku ma buchi.
en: I may give away everything I have, and even give up my body to be burned —but if I have no love, this does me no good.

dag: N Naawuni maa yɛliya, Alahichinim ka suhudoo.
en: There is no safety for sinners, says the Lord .

dag: Naawuni daa niŋ lala ni o kahigila o daanfaani din galisi pam la wuhi palɔni ʒiɛman shɛŋa din kanna ni, ka di yila o ni wuhi ti yurilim shɛli Yisa Masia zuɣu la ni na.
en: God did this to show future generations the greatness of his grace by the goodness that God has shown us in Christ Jesus.

dag: Pa ti yaannim kɔŋko ka Yawɛ daa lo alikauli ŋɔ, amaa tinim bɛn zaa na be ti nyɛviya ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: That agreement wasn't only with our ancestors but with us, who are here today.

dag: Kpiimba biɛhigu shee malila shili guli ba. Di yaala di noli gu ni di vali Jɛrusalɛm zuɣulaannim mini di tarimba bɛn galisi ni bɛnkam zaa mali suhupiɛlli be di ni.
en: Therefore, the grave opens wide its jaws, opens its mouth beyond all bounds, and the splendid multitudes will go down, with all their uproar and cheering.

dag: Di simdi ni Izraɛl tiŋbia kam ŋun yɛn mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim ka di ʒiɛɣu niŋdi Yawɛ nyaɣisim la niŋ dimbɔŋɔnima.
en: Every citizen will perform these rituals in bringing a food gift that is a soothing smell to the LORD.

dag: Kulla di saha maa ka o daa paɣi bɛ fiɛbbu dansi la, ka Pool mini Silas daa baptaizi dansarika gula maa min o yiŋnim zaa.
en: It was late at night, but the jailer took Paul and Silas and washed their wounds. Then the jailer and all his people were baptized.

dag: Yawɛ, a chɛ ka a tuma ti ma suhupiɛlli; a ni tum tuun shɛŋa chɛ ka n yili yila ni suhupiɛlli.
en: because youve made me happy, LORD, by your acts. I sing with joy because of your handiwork.

dag: Amaa ka aŋgo maa garigi yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, n ʒin ya.
en: But he replied, I tell you the truth, I dont know you.

dag: O daa lan zaŋ nyɔtaɣirisi mini kpana n-niŋ tinsi maa zaa ni n-chɛ ka di niŋ yaa pam. O ni daa su Juda mini Bɛnjamin zuliyanim shɛm m-bala.
en: He also stored shields and spears in each of the cities, making them very strong. This is how Judah and Benjamin remained under his control.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yihi bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ sara shɛli nyo buɣim la zali di ko, ka daa tar li ka di doli bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm, ka bɛ daa zaŋ li mali sara ti Yawɛ kaman di ni sabi shɛm Musa litaafi ni la, ka bɛ daa lan niŋ naɣilahi la gba lala.
en: Then they divided among the people, by family groups, the animals for burnt offerings, so that they could offer them according to the instructions in the Law of Moses.

dag: Ka n daa ŋmahiŋmahi m mam maa jilajila n-zaŋ tari Izraɛlnim ni su luɣ shɛlikam zaa, dama bɛna n-tum din chihiri ŋɔ mini biŋkɔb tuuni ŋɔ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni maa.
en: It was a terrible thing for Israelites to do! So I cut up her body and sent the pieces everywhere in Israel.

dag: Di saha nyin yɛlim ba, Yawɛ yɛliya, Yi yaannim ni daa zaɣisi ma ka jɛmdi buɣa ka lan zaɣisi n zaligu dolibu la zuɣu.
en: Then tell them I have said: People of Judah, your ancestors turned away from me; they rejected my laws and teachings and started worshiping other gods.

dag: Dina n-daa chɛ ka n dii tim a sanna maa, ka a mi ni kana maa a niŋ viɛnyɛla. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ ti zaa bela Naawuni tooni ni ti wum ŋun Naawuni ni ti a zilin shɛli ni a ti ti. .
en: I sent for you at once, and you have been good enough to come. All of us are here in the presence of the Lord God, so that we can hear what he has to say.

dag: Yinim bɛn daa ʒe n niriba ka di niŋ ya nyaɣisim ka yi suhuri paligi, ka yi ŋumda kaman naɣisaa n-nɔri buri chi la bee n-kuhiri kaman yuri la.
en: People of Babylonia, you were glad to rob my people. You had a good time, making more noise than horses and jumping around like calves threshing grain.

dag: Amaa ka o daa yihi nandaamba bɛ nandahima ni, ka chɛ ka bɛ malibu nabi kaman biŋkɔbbaligu la.
en: When you are suffering and in need, he will come to your rescue, and your families will grow as fast as a herd of sheep.

dag: ka di zuɣu chɛ ka a mali yɛm, ka baŋsim yɛtɔɣa be a noli ni.
en: you will have sound judgment, and you will always know the right thing to say.

dag: N gbilisi tibili ni n wum, amaa ka bɛ bi tɔɣisi yɛlimaŋli yɛtɔɣa. Bɛ ninvuɣ so bi niŋ tuuba o tuumbiɛri zuɣu yɛra, Bɔzuɣu ka n niŋ lala? Bɛ zaa kparila bɛ kpabu kaman wɔhu ni sibigi ʒi n-kpɛri tɔb gɔɣu ni shɛm la.
en: I have listened to them very carefully, but they dont say what is right. They are not sorry for their sins. They dont think about the evil they have done. They do things without thinking. They are like horses running into a battle.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n zali ya ni yi piim fɔntins ata maa.
en: This is why I order you to set aside three cities.

dag: Bɛ bi lan tiri ti mɔri, amaa ka na kul yɛra, Ŋmamiya bilichiisi maa! Nyam bɛ ni buri a tumtumdiba shɛm, amaŋmaŋ niriba maa tum din bi tuhi.
en: No straw is supplied to your servants, yet they say to us, Make bricks! Look at how your servants are being beaten! Your own people are to blame.

dag: Dama nyama, Yawɛ ni zali zaligu, ka yiya kara ŋma n-lu, ka yiya bihi mi lu m-burisiburisi.
en: Look, the Lord will give the command, and the large houses will be broken to pieces, and the small houses will be broken to small pieces.

dag: Ka Jaɛl daa kpuɣi tanti kpaa niŋ o nu yin ni, ka kpuɣi zali niŋ o nudirigu ni n-zaŋ tanti kpaa maa ba Sisɛra tapaɣa n-kpahi li ti ba tiŋa.
en: She took a tent peg in one hand, a worker's hammer in the other; she struck Sisera and crushed his skull; she pierced him through the head.

dag: Ka di gari ba pam ka bɛ bɔhi taba, Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi tiligi.
en: At this the disciples were completely amazed and asked one another, Who, then, can be saved.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Yisa daa ti ʒe Gɛnɛsarɛt Teeku noli, ka niriba pam kpaɣiri chan o sani ni bɛ ti wum Naawuni yɛligu.
en: One day Jesus was standing beside Lake Gennesaret when the crowd pressed in around him to hear Gods word.

dag: Ka o daa dɔni o naba tiŋli maa, amaa ka daa ti daŋ yiɣisibu asibaasi ŋaraŋara saha shɛli so ni ku tooi nya o baŋ o, dama Bɔaz daa bi bɔri ni so baŋ ni o ka nimaani na.
en: So Ruth lay near Boazs feet until morning. She got up while it was still dark, before it was light enough for people to recognize each other. Boaz said to her, We will keep it a secret that you came here to me last night.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Abarim zoya maa ni, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Mɔab bɔpiɛligu ni miri Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili Jɛriko polo la.
en: They marched from the Abarim mountains and camped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.

dag: Ka Haman daa yɛli naa, Chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ amaŋmaŋ nam kpar shɛŋa a ni pun ye min amaŋmaŋ wɔribaro ni nam zuɣupiligu din ni zaŋ pili dilan na;.
en: So Haman answered the king, Do this for the man the king loves to honor:.

dag: Saha shɛli maligumaaniba maa ni daa yi luɣ kasi shee maa na, bɛ daa bi lan doli zaɣila nyɛla yaakaza, dama maligumaaniba maa zaa daa pun malila bɛmaŋa.
en: Then the priests left the holy place. All the priests who were present had sanctified themselves, regardless of their divisions.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Sabimiya ni doo ŋɔ bi dɔɣi bihi, do so ŋun kul ku di nasara o nyɛvili ni. Dama o bihi ni so ti ku nya soli n-ʒini Dauda nam ʒiishee n-lan su Judanim yaha.
en: The Lord says, Write this down about Jehoiachin: He does not have children anymore! Jehoiachin will not be successful because none of his children will sit on the throne of David. None of his children will rule in Judah.

dag: Ka o lan zaŋ ŋmanʒiɛhi ayi bee yiŋ ŋmambihi ayi, o ni kul ni tooi nyaŋ shɛli na ti mali sara.
en: Then the priest must offer one of the doves or young pigeons.

dag: Ka Rut yɛli, N ni niŋ a ni yɛl shɛlikam maa zaa.
en: Ruth answered, I'll do whatever you say.

dag: Dinzuɣu zalimiya zaligu n-yɛli ni niriba maa na chɛli bɛ tiŋ maa mɛbu, ka naɣila n ti lan zali zaligu yaha.
en: Therefore, issue an order to stop these people: this city is not to be rebuilt until I make a decree.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Dindali maa n ni ti zaŋ nyin Shialtiɛl bia Zɛrubabɛl ŋun nyɛ n dabili ŋɔ n-zali zaashe tital ni ka a be kaman n nintu shɛli din dihiri gbana la, dama mani m-piig a. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: On that day I will take you, Zerubbabel my servant, and I will appoint you to rule in my name. You are the one I have chosen. The Lord Almighty has spoken.

dag: Man ŋun nyɛ kpɛm la n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri n zo Gaiɔs ŋun nyɛ n ni yuri so ni yɛlimaŋli la.
en: Greetings from the Elder. To my dear friend Gaius, a person I truly love.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka n daa baŋ ni yɛm so jɛrilim kaman neesim ni so zibisim shɛm la.
en: And I discovered that wisdom is better than foolishness, just as light is better than darkness.

dag: Gɛrishɔn zuliya maa n-daa su Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni mini di nyaaŋa binshɛŋa bɛ ni mali pindi li tuma fukumsi. Bɛna n-daa lan su Pateesa shɛli din yili di dunol ni.
en: They were responsible for the Tent, its inner cover, its outer cover, the curtain for the entrance.

dag: Dabiɛm vuri kul bela bɛ tiba ni, azichi pam puuni ka bahiyolilan yɛn liri ba.
en: Every noise scares him. His enemy will attack him when he thinks he is safe.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti kulisi Akisa na dahin shɛli, ka Otiniɛl daa kpam o jaande ni o suhim o ba tiŋgbani palo. Ka Akisa daa ti sheeg o buŋ zuɣu na; ka Kalɛb bɔh o, Bɔ ka a bɔra.
en: Right after the wedding, Achsah started telling Othniel that he ought to ask her father for a field. She went to see her father, and while she was getting down from her donkey, Caleb asked her, What's bothering you.

dag: Biŋkpila maa daa tamla daantalis ayi la zuɣu, ka be duu maa gɔŋbu shee zuɣusaa lansi luɣili ni, ka pumpɔrinchihi kɔbisiyi kulis ayi gili biŋkpil yini, ka lan gili biŋkpil din la gba lala.
en: and were placed on a rounded section which was above the chain design. There were pomegranates in two rows around each capital.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa chaŋ ti zani wain tihi puri sunsuuni luɣ shɛli din bi yɛlim shee ka goma be di yaɣa ayi zaa.
en: Then the LORDs messenger stood in the narrow path between vineyards with a stone wall on each side.

dag: bɛ ni ti bahi yoli kaman bɛmaŋmaŋ bindi la. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pun nya ba ni ti bɔhira, Bɛ lee be ya ni.
en: But he will be gone forever like his own body waste. People who knew him will say, Where is he.

dag: Dama bɛ tarimba mini wɔɣira zaa nyɛla diribarilimnima bɛn suhuri kul yɛla zalinsi dibu zuɣu. Anabinim mini maligumaaniba zaa bi lan doli yɛlimaŋli soli.
en: Everyone is greedy and dishonest, whether poor or rich. Even the prophets and priests cannot be trusted.

dag: Yisa ni daa mali ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba ka o sanna o ni daa wuhiri niriba saha shɛli ti bɔh o, Ŋun yiko ni ka a lee tumdi dimbɔŋɔnima bee ŋuni n-lee ti a di yiko maa.
en: Jesus went into the Temple area. While Jesus was teaching there, the leading priests and the older leaders of the people came to him. They said, Tell us! What authority do you have to do these things you are doing? Who gave you this authority.

dag: Hal bɛ ni daa je a ka zaɣis a, ka so bi kpɛr a ni la zaa yoli, n ni chɛ ka a galisi ka mali jilima, ka lan chɛ ka a nyɛ luɣ shɛli suhupiɛlli ni yɛn be sahakam.
en: Instead of being abandoned, hated, and forbidden, I will make you majestic forever, a joy for all generations.

dag: O ni daa paai ni, o daa kuhila fabila kuhigu m-boli Daniɛl bɔh o, Daniɛl, nyin ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ dabili ŋɔ, a Naawuni so a ni jɛmdi viɛnyɛliŋga maa tooi fa a gbuɣima maa nuu ni bahi.
en: He was very worried. When he got to the lions den, he called to Daniel. He said, Daniel, servant of the living God, has your God been able to save you from the lions? You always serve your God.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la ni Naawuni yɛliya: Di ku lan yuui ka ŋun yɛn kana maa ku kpalim, ka shiri kana.
en: He says, Very soon now, the one who is coming will come and will not be late.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋunkam zɔri vi m mini n yɛligu zuɣu ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn bi ʒe Naawuni yim ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni, Daadam Bia mini malaika kasinim yi ti labina o Ba jilima ni, o gba ni ti zo vi ni o zaŋ dilan pah o niriba ni.
en: Don't be ashamed of me and my message among these unfaithful and sinful people! If you are, the Son of Man will be ashamed of you when he comes in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.

dag: Nyini n-chɛ ka goli wuhiri saha, ka chɛ ka wuntaŋ mi o lubu saha.
en: God made the moon for the seasons, and the sun too, which knows when to set.

dag: N yuri a zaligu pam! N kul tɛhirila di yɛla dabisili kam.
en: Oh, how I love your teachings! I talk about them all the time.

dag: Yiɣisim chaŋ Mɛsopoteemia a ma ba Bɛtuɛl yiŋa nti kpuɣi a ma tizɔdoo Leeban bipuɣinsi ni yino niŋ a paɣa.
en: Go instead to Mesopotamia, to the home of your grandfather Bethuel, and marry one of the young women there, one of your uncle Laban's daughters.

dag: Ka Nashɔn daa nyɛ Aminadab bia, ka Aminadab nyɛ Adimin bia, ka Adimin nyɛ Arini bia, ka Arini nyɛ Hɛzirɔn bia, ka Hɛzirɔn nyɛ Pɛrɛz bia, ka Pɛrɛz mi nyɛ Juda so bia.
en: Nahshon was the son of Amminadab. Amminadab was the son of Admin. Admin was the son of Arni. Arni was the son of Hezron. Hezron was the son of Perez. Perez was the son of Judah.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Naa Ahasivɛrɔs daa ti duhi do so ŋun yuli booni Haman n-zaŋ o leei zuɣulaampaa. Haman daa nyɛla Hamɛdata bia, ka lan nyɛ ŋun yi Agag zuliya ni na.
en: Sometime later, King Ahasuerus promoted Haman, Hammedatha the Agagites son, by promoting him above all the officials who worked with him.

dag: Ka o mini do so yi dɔni, ka o daɣiri maa tabil o, doo maa ni be daɣiri ni daba ayopɔin, ka bindo shɛlikam zuɣu doo maa ni dɔni ni nyɛla din be daɣiri ni.
en: Any man who has sex with her during this time becomes unclean for seven days, and anything he rests on is also unclean.

dag: Yisa Masia zuɣu m mali daliri din ni chɛ ka n nyu bara n ni tum tuun shɛŋa ti Naawuni la puuni.
en: In union with Christ Jesus, then, I can be proud of my service for God.

dag: M pala ŋun mali yolisim? M pala tumo? N nini daa bi nya ti Duuma Yisa? Yi pala n tuma nyɔri ti Duuma ni?.
en: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Havent I seen Jesus our Lord? Arent you my work in the Lord?.

dag: ka bindira balibu kam din nyɛ bɛ ni daa she shɛli ti Firawuna be piɛ shɛli din tam zuɣusaa ni, amaa ka noombihi lee kana ti diri li n zuɣu ni piɛri maa ni.
en: In the top basket there were all kinds of baked goods for the king, and the birds were eating them.

dag: Ka di chaŋ wula ka nandahima mali ma pam? Di chaŋ wula ka n suhu kul zɔhira? N ni mali tahima Naawuni sani, n ni ti lan paɣ o yaha, ŋuna n-nyɛ n sɔŋsim.
en: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I should trust you, Lord . I will praise you again because you help me.

dag: O ni daa yaɣindi li maa ka shɛŋa lu sol zuɣu, ka noonsi kana nti gahim li di.
en: As he was scattering seed, some fell on the path, and birds came and ate it.

dag: Ti mali bimbin shɛli ka maligumaaniba bɛn tumdi sara maligu malibu tuma tanti jɛmbu duu la ni ka soli ni bɛ di binshɛli din pa di zuɣu.
en: We have a sacrifice. And those priests who serve in the Holy Tent cannot eat from the sacrifice we have.
