dag: Ŋuni n-lee yɛn zaŋ ma ti kpɛhi bɛ ni me gooni gili tin shɛli ŋɔ ni? Ka ŋun n-lee yɛn zaŋ ma tahi Ɛdom?.
en: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress or lead me to Edom?.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa lan labina ti yɛl o, Naa, A mi ni Miidianim mini Pɛriʒianim zaligu shɛŋa naa ni zali ku tooi taɣi.
en: At sunset the men returned and said, Your Majesty, remember that no written law of the Medes and Persians can be changed, not even by the king.

dag: Gaad zuliya mini bɛ zuliya niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Zɛfɔn daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Zɛfɔnnima; ka Hagi daŋ niriba nyɛ Haginima; ka Shuni daŋ niriba nyɛ Shuninima.
en: Gads descendants according to their clans: from Zephon, the Zephonite clan; from Haggi, the Haggite clan; from Shuni, the Shunite clan.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa teeg o nuu shihi n noli ka yɛli ma, Pumpɔŋɔ n zaŋ n yɛtɔɣa niŋ a noli ni.
en: Then the LORD stretched out his hand, touched my mouth, and said to me, Im putting my words in your mouth.

dag: Lala mi n-nyɛ li, yi yi ti nyari ka shihira ŋɔ zaa niŋda, yin baŋmiya ni di saha miriya hal ka di ku lan yuui gba.
en: In the same way, when you see all these things happening, you will know that the time is very near, already present.

dag: Bɛ daa bi baŋ ni Naawuni ŋun nyɛ o Ba yɛla ka o tɔɣisiri ba maa.
en: They didnt know he was speaking about his Father.

dag: Shulam paɣa, labimina, labimina! Labimina, labimina ka ti ti nya a. Bɔzuɣu ka yi lihiri man Shulam paɣa, kaman m bela tɔbbihi bɛn pie tab ʒiɛya buyi sunsuuni wari waa ŋɔ?.
en: Come back, come back, Shulamith ! Come back, come back, so we may look at you. Why are you staring at Shulamith, as she dances the Mahanaim dance ?.

dag: Juda Naa Jɔsia bia Jɛhoyakim nam dibu yuma anahi saha, ka anabi Jɛrimia daa tɔɣisi Nɛria bia Baruk yɛtɔɣa, ka Baruk daa sabi yɛtɔɣa maa niŋ gbaŋ ni saha shɛli Jɛrimia ni daa tɔɣisiri maa.
en: In the fourth year that Jehoiakim was king of Judah, Baruch wrote down everything I had told him.

dag: Ka o garigi bɔhi ba, Yi na bi karim ni Naawuni ŋun daa nam ninsalinim piligu ni la daa nam ba la doo mini paɣa?.
en: Jesus answered, Havent you read that at the beginning the creator made them male and female?.

dag: Ka n daa ti tim Musa mini Aduna Ijipti maa; ka chɛ ka alɔbo lu Ijiptinim zuɣu m-muɣisi ba pam, di nyaaŋa ka n daa yihi ya nimaani na.
en: Then I sent Moses and Aaron to Egypt. I wanted them to bring my people out of Egypt. I caused many terrible things to happen to the people of Egypt. Then I brought your people out of Egypt.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka n timdi m biyurigu Timoti ŋun ʒe yim ti Duuma dolibu ni la yi sanna ni o ti teei ya n ni doli so shɛŋa Masia dolibu ni, ka wuhiri li shɛm luɣ shɛlikam cheechinim ni la.
en: This is why Ive sent Timothy to you; hes my loved and trusted child in the Lord; hell remind you about my way of life in Christ Jesus. Hell teach the same way as I teach everywhere in every church.

dag: Di mɔŋya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka yaa mini kpibisi saria karibu din doli zaligu soli; ka di mɔŋya tarima mini nandana bɛ yɛlimaŋli soli.
en: Defend the rights of the poor and the orphans; be fair to the needy and the helpless.

dag: Yɛlimuɣisira pam paai ma, ka m mini kum bi lan wɔɣ ni taba.
en: So many troubles have fallen on me that I am close to death.

dag: O daa lan chɛ ka bɛ dooi salima mali duu maa puuni tiŋa n-tabili di puuni duri mini di samban polo duri tiŋgban ni.
en: He also covered the floor of the temple with gold, in both the inner and the outer rooms.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim yi ni tum n ni zali ba ni bɛ tum shɛm, ka gbibi n ni daa zaŋ n zaligu shɛŋa zaa ti Musa ni o ti ba la, dindina n ku lan chɛ ka bɛ vuui bɛ napɔŋ yi n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti bɛ yaannim la ni.
en: And if the people of Israel will obey all my commands and keep the whole Law that my servant Moses gave them, then I will not allow them to be driven out of the land that I gave to their ancestors.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yi yi di mali yɛda ka di be kaman zabiliga tibiɛlim la, yi naan tooi yɛli sinsabiga ŋɔ ni di vuɣim di zaashee ŋɔ chaŋ ti zani teeku ni, ka di di niŋ lala.
en: The Lord answered, If you had faith as big as a mustard seed, you could say to this mulberry tree, Pull yourself up by the roots and plant yourself in the sea! and it would obey you.

dag: ni nabihi bɛn mali salima, ka zaŋ anzinfa pali bɛ yinsi la n-di vuhira.
en: or with princes who have gold, who fill their houses with silver.

dag: M mabihi bɛn mali be kasi ka saɣi alizanda ni boligu ŋɔ, tɛhimiya Yisa ŋun nyɛ ti daadiini tumo ni maligumaani tital la yɛla.
en: My Christian friends, who also have been called by God! Think of Jesus, whom God sent to be the High Priest of the faith we profess.

dag: Di bi simdi ka yi ti ŋubi biŋkpam bee binʒim yi ni be luɣ shɛlikam zaa, dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla zaligu din ni be yi ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: This is a permanent rule for your future generations, wherever you live: you must not eat any fat or blood.

dag: ni Magidiɛl ni Iram. Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ Ɛdom nanima; di gbinni nyɛla Iso ŋun nyɛ Ɛdomnim yab la kaman bɛ biɛhigu shee ni daa nyɛ luɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni daa su tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa ni.
en: Chief Magdiel, and Chief Iram. These are Edoms tribal chiefs according to their settlements in the land they possessed. This is Esau, the ancestor of the Edomites.

dag: Ka n ti wum lahibali ni Yɛhudianim dɔni n-gu o soli, dinzuɣu ka n chɛ ka bɛ tah o a sanna yomyom maa; ka yɛli bɛn fiɣisir o maa ni bɛ kam a sanna nti yɛl a bɛ ni fiɣisir o shɛli zuɣu maa.
en: As soon as I learned that there was a plot against him, I sent him to you and told their leaders to bring charges against him in your court.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, a chɛ ti bahi yɔbahi sunsuuni, ka lan chɛ ti niŋ zibisim tital ni.
en: But you crushed us, and you covered us with deepest darkness where wild animals live.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ yimaŋmaŋ mini n tizo Bɛnjamin zaa nini nyaya ni mmaŋmaŋa n-yaagi n noli yɛli ya yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ.
en: Joseph continued, Now all of you, and you too, Benjamin, can see that I am really Joseph.

dag: Amaa miriya ka yi deei binshɛli zali ninvuɣ kura ŋun simdi kubu zaani. Ninvuɣ kura simdi kubu.
en: Murderers must be put to death. They cannot escape this penalty by the payment of money.

dag: N ni mali suhupiɛlli Jɛrusalɛm mini n niriba zuɣu, ka so ku lan kum bee n-fabili di ni.
en: Then I will rejoice with Jerusalem. I will be happy with my people. There will never again be crying and sadness in that city.

dag: amaa ka bɛ ŋariŋ maa pun chaŋ katiŋ ha ka chɛ duli, ka kɔgbana ŋmɛri li, dama bɛ daa tuhila pɔhim.
en: and by this time the boat was far out in the lake, tossed about by the waves, because the wind was blowing against it.

dag: Dahin shɛli man Yawɛ ni ti yɛn kari zuliya kam zaa saria la miriya. Yi ni nya yi ni daa zaŋ shɛli ti yi tab la tatabo. Yi ni daa niŋ shɛm la ni ŋmaligi lu yi zuɣu.
en: The day of the LORD is near against all the nations. As you have done, so it will be done to you; your actions will make you suffer!.

dag: Bɛ daa ku niriba pam, dama tɔb maa daa nyɛla Naawuni ni bɔr shɛli. Ka bɛ daa ʒini bɛ tiŋgbani maa ni hal ti paai saha shɛli bɛ ni daa gbahi ba kuli tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni la.
en: They killed many of the enemy, because the war was God's will. And they went on living in that territory until the exile.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni daa yɛli Ibrahimma, Di chɛ ka a bia maa min a dab paɣ maa yɛla muɣis a. Zara ni kul yɛl a ni a niŋm shɛlikam zaa, nyin niŋm o ni yɛl a shɛm maa, dama Yisahaku zuɣu ka a zuliya yɛn yɛligi.
en: But God said to Abraham, Don't be worried about the boy and your slave Hagar. Do whatever Sarah tells you, because it is through Isaac that you will have the descendants I have promised.

dag: A yi ka binshɛli din ni zaŋ yo, bɛ ni kpuɣi a bindoo chaŋ ka chɛ a.
en: If you cannot pay, you will lose everything you have. So why should you lose the bed you sleep on?.

dag: Ka naa daa bɔhi, Ka bɔ ka ti lee niŋ ti Mɔdɛkai din ni ti o jilima? Ka o naazɔnim bɛn be o sani yɛl o, Ti bi niŋ shɛl ti o.
en: The king asked, How have we honored and rewarded Mordecai for this? His servants answered, Nothing has been done for him.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛl o zahindi maa ni, Iin, m mi ni a bi tɛhi a suhu ni ni a tum taali, amaa mani n-chɛ ka a bi tum alahichi n sani maa; di zuɣu ka m bi chɛ ka a shih o maa.
en: God said to him in the dream, I know that your intentions were pure when you did this. In fact, I kept you from sinning against me. Thats why I didnt allow you to touch her.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Yaakubu, Labim a ba min a dɔɣiriba tiŋgban ni. N ni be a sani.
en: The Lord said to Jacob, Go back to your own land where your ancestors lived. I will be with you.

dag: Ka ŋun yɛli ni o be Naawuni ni, di niŋ kamaata ni o be kaman Masia ni daa be shɛm la.
en: if we say that we remain in union with God, we should live just as Jesus Christ did.

dag: Miriya ka yi mɔŋ nandaamba yɛlimaŋli bɛ saria karibu ni.
en: Dont undermine the justice that your poor deserve in their lawsuits.

dag: O daa yɛl o tumtumdiba kpɛma, M biɛli Iso yi ti tuhi ya soli bɔhi ya, Ŋuni n-lee sun ya? Ka ya polo ka yi lee chana? Ka ŋuni n-lee su biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn be yi tooni ŋɔ.
en: Jacob gave them their orders. To the servant with the first group of animals he said, When Esau my brother comes to you and asks you, Whose animals are these? Where are you going? Whose servant are you.

dag: Ka Filip yɛl o, Ti Duuma, wuhim ti a Ba maa ni nyɛ so! Dina ka ti kul bɔra.
en: Philip said to him, Lord, show us the Father. That is all we need.

dag: Di chɛliya ka yimaŋ malibu bela palɔni kaman zabiri pambu mini salima yɛri yɛbu bee situr viɛla yɛbu.
en: You should not use outward aids to make yourselves beautiful, such as the way you fix your hair, or the jewelry you put on, or the dresses you wear.

dag: Nyɔhi ni tuɣiri chani shɛm la, karim ba ka bɛ chaŋ lala. Shigbaŋ ni miriti buɣim ka nyɛligiri shɛm la, chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri nyɛligi lala Naawuni tooni.
en: Scatter them like smoke! When you come near, make them melt like wax in a fire.

dag: O sani, jaambɔna ŋmanila kaɣa. Bɛ yi to kpani ka o wum di damli, o lari li mi.
en: When a wood club hits him, it feels to him like a piece of straw. He laughs when anyone throws a spear at him.

dag: Bɛn pa Yɛhudianim la ni daa wum lala maa ka di paligi bɛ suhuri pam ka bɛ paɣi ti Duuma yɛligu maa; ka Naawuni ni daa zali shɛb ni bɛ nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu la niŋ yɛda.
en: When the Gentiles heard this, they rejoiced and honored the Lords word. Everyone who was appointed for eternal life believed.

dag: Ka n daa bɔhi malaika so ŋun daa yɛli ma yɛtɔɣa maa, Ka binyila ŋɔ mi yɛla lee nyɛla wula? Ka o garigi yɛli ma, Yila maa nyɛla din ʒe dunia ŋɔ yikonim bɛn daa wurim Judanim mini Izraɛlnim ni Jɛrusalɛmnima kpɛhi yɔɣu la zaani.
en: I said to the messenger speaking with me, What are these? He said to me, These are the horns that scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Musa daa yi ti kul chani suɣili maa ni niriba zaa yiɣisirimi, ka sokam ʒe o suɣili dunol ni lihir o hal ka o ti kpe suɣili maa puuni.
en: Whenever Moses went out there, the people would stand at the door of their tents and watch Moses until he entered it.

dag: Fiɛbisi vuri mini chɛchɛbunsi kalima vuri. Yuri balisira, ka chɛchɛbunsi yiɣiri tɔra!.
en: Listen! The crack of the whip, the rattle of wheels, the gallop of horses, the jolting of chariots!.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ Lɛbanɔn nyɔŋ puuni ti viɛla din nyɛ paain mini junipa ni sipirɛs dari n-kana ti mali n jɛmbu duu ka di viɛla, ka ti chɛ ka n naba tambu shee mali jilima.
en: Wood from Lebanon's best trees will be brought to you— the pines, the firs, and the cypress trees. It will be used in my temple to make beautiful the place where I rest my feet.

dag: Bɛ ni daa na kul kpaai bɛ nina kpa zuɣusaa lihir o ni chani maa ha, ka bɛ nya ka niriba ayi ye binyɛr piɛla ʒe bɛ sani ka bɔhi ba.
en: They were staring into the sky where he had gone. Suddenly two men wearing white clothes were standing beside them.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa tim tuumba Yisifu sani ti yɛl o, Zaligu ŋɔ ka a ba daa zali ti pɔi ka naanyi kpi.
en: So the brothers sent this message to Joseph: Before your father died, he told us to give you a message.

dag: Di chɛ ka ti kpe zahimbu ni, amaa yihim ti zaɣ biɛɣu ni. Dama nyini n-su nam mini yiko ni jilima hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Ami.
en: Keep us from being tempted and protect us from evil.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli Izraɛlnim zaa, Labimiya yaɣ yini polo, ka m mini m bia Jɔnatan mi labi yaɣ yini polo. Ka niriba maa daa yɛli Sool, A ni nya ka shɛli viɛl a sani, nyin niŋmi li.
en: So Saul said to all Israel, You be on one side, and my son Jonathan and I will be on the other. Do whatever you think is best, the troops said.

dag: Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yi ŋmɛri Naawuni naŋgbankpeeni, ka zaŋdi ʒi tibisi shɛŋa ti mini ti yaannim ni bi tooi ʒi ni yi ʒili ba?.
en: Why then are you now challenging God by placing a burden on the shoulders of these disciples that neither we nor our ancestors could bear?.

dag: Amaa nyin Yawɛ ka n guhira. Nyini n Duuma Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ ŋun ni garigi ma.
en: I trust you, Lord God, and you will do something.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛli ma mi, Malim buɣili ŋun yɛn be ti tooni ti ti, dama Musa ŋun daa yihi ti Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na maa ŋuna, ti bi mi din niŋ o. .
en: They said to me, Make us gods who can lead us. As for this man Moses who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we dont have a clue what has happened to him.

dag: Ka Ɛsta yɛl o, N ni bɔri shɛli mini n ni yɛn suh a shɛli nyɛla:.
en: Esther replied.

dag: Bɛ ni bi lihi nya Yawɛ ni pun tum tuun shɛŋa bee n-lihi nya o nuhi tuma la zuɣu, o ni daai ba luhi ka ku lan yiɣisi ba zali.
en: They don't pay any attention to your wonderful deeds. Now you will destroy them and leave them in ruin.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa yɛli.
en: Then God spoke all these words.

dag: Di saha ka doo maa daa yɛli, Mmaŋmaŋ kɔbili mini mmaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ m-bɔŋɔ. O yuli m-booni paɣa, dama doo niŋgbuŋ ni ka o yina.
en: And the man said, Finally! One like me, with bones from my bones and a body from my body. She was taken out of a man, so I will call her woman.

dag: Ka duɣuri mini lahi din zaa ʒe zaɣiyari ka binshɛli bi pil li, di gba ni leei din bi be nyam.
en: Any open jar without a sealed cover on it is unclean.

dag: N suui ʒitibisi shɛŋa din yi tam yi bɔɣusapima zuɣu la; ka yihi ya piɛri ʒiya la ʒibu ni.
en: I lifted the burden from your shoulder and took the heavy basket from your hands.

dag: Suhu ni nia lɔbu nyɛla daadamnim dini, amaa zilinli ni yɛn garigi shɛm yirila Yawɛ sanna.
en: People might plan what they want to say, but it is the Lord who gives them the right words.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi doli Bashan polo; ka Bashan Naa Ogi min o tɔbbihi zaa daa kana ti lu bɛ zuɣu Ɛdirɛi n-tuhi ba.
en: Then they turned and ascended the road of Bashan. Og, Bashans king, came out at Edrei to meet them in battle, he and all his people.

dag: Ŋun suhu bi yiɣisiri yomyom so ŋun mali kpiɔŋ. Ka nir yi ni tooi gbaag omaŋ o suhuyiɣisili saha, di so ŋun ŋme n-deei tin muni.
en: Better to be patient than a warrior, and better to have self-control than to capture a city.

dag: Ka kukol shɛli daa yɛri sagbani maa ni, M Bia m-bɔŋɔ, n ni pii so m-bala; wummiy o noli.
en: A voice came from the cloud and said, This is my Son. He is the one I have chosen. Obey him.

dag: Naawuni zaligunim min anabinim yɛligu daa pun benimi hal ka Jɔn ti kana.
en: Until the time of John all the prophets and the Law of Moses spoke about the Kingdom;.

dag: Man Yawɛ maŋmaŋ ni wuh a zuliya maa zaa, ka chɛ ka bɛ nyamma yɛligi pam.
en: I, the Lord , will teach your children, and they will have real peace.

dag: M bihi, n sabirila gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri ya yi ni nya yi daalahichi chɛ m-paŋ Masia zuɣu la zuɣu.
en: Little children, Im writing to you because your sins have been forgiven through Jesus name.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti ye bɛ ni zaŋ piɛkɔbiri mini gali piɛlli gari tab wuɣi situr shɛŋa.
en: You must not wear clothes made by weaving together wool and linen.

dag: Bɛ tɛhirila bɛ suhuri ni, Naawuni tamiya. O ŋmaligila o nini bahi kpaŋa, o kul ku nya li sahakam.
en: They say to themselves, God has forgotten about us. He is not watching. He will never see what we are doing.

dag: Jashub daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Jashubnima; ka Shimrɔn daŋ niriba nyɛ Shimirɔnnima.
en: from Jashub, the Jashubite clan; from Shimron, the Shimronite clan.

dag: Miriya ka yi zahim Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ kaman yi ni daa zahim o shɛm Masa la.
en: You must not test the Lord your God like you tested him at Massah.

dag: Bɛ mi di yɛli zaɣ biɛɣu n-dalim so, ka di ŋmɛri naŋgbankpeeni, amaa ka lee be baalim, ka mali sizuura lubu biɛhigu zaŋ chaŋ sokam zaa sani.
en: Tell them not to speak evil of anyone but to live in peace with others. They should be gentle and polite to everyone.

dag: Bahiyoli mini kum yɛliya, Ti tiba daa wum di ŋumaŋuma.
en: Destruction and Death have said, Weve heard a report of her.

dag: O daa lan yɛli yaha, Ŋunkam deeri ya deerila mani, ka ŋunkam deeri ma deerila ŋun tim ma na.
en: Anyone who welcomes you welcomes me. And anyone who welcomes me also welcomes the one who sent me.

dag: Ka so yi zaŋ omaŋ dalim kpatinariga yili di ni lu, ka so yi gbaa li di ku tooi zani.
en: If they lean on a web, will it hold them up? If they grab for a thread, will it help them stand.

dag: A ku tooi zo n-tilig o nuu ni, amaa biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ ni ti gbaag a n-zaŋ a ti ti o. A mini Babilɔn naa maa nini ni ti nya taba, ka a zani o tooni, ka a min o tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, ka bɛ ti zaŋ a kuli Babilɔn.
en: Zedekiah, you will not escape from the king of Babylon. You will surely be caught and given to him. You will see the king of Babylon with your own eyes. He will talk to you face to face, and you will go to Babylon.

dag: Kɔbilinini Dunɔdali din daa be bɛ tooni la gbini ka bɛ daa yi n-chaŋ ti du Naa Dauda Tiŋ la dunɔdura din be gooni din be Dauda yiŋ zuɣusaa polo la gbini m-mali ti paai Kom Dunɔdali din daa be wulimpuhili polo la gbini.
en: They went to the Fountain Gate and walked up the stairs all the way to the City of David. They were on top of the city wall. They walked over the house of David and went toward the Water Gate.

dag: Jɛta bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Jɛfune ni Pisipa ni Ara.
en: The descendants of Jether were Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.

dag: Dina n-yɛn nyɛ yi gba zaka, ka di be kaman kabɔɣili ni chi bee wain tɔɣiri bɔɣili ni wain zaka la.
en: That tenth will be your offering to the Lord. It will be like grain from your own threshing floor or wine from your own winepress.

dag: bee ŋ-ŋumdi ti kparima ni kaman bɛ ni shɛb ni daa niŋ shɛm ka malaika ŋun su kum fukumsi daa bahi ba yol la.
en: We must not complain, as some of them did—and they were destroyed by the Angel of Death.

dag: ka duhi bɛ yee kum pam a zuɣu. Bɛ ni ti kɔri taŋkpaɣu puɣi bɛ zuɣuri ka dɔni tampiligim ni bilim.
en: mourning for you. They show their sorrow by putting dust on their heads and rolling in ashes;.

dag: Dinzuɣu so yi ti bol a ka a chaŋ, nyin ʒinim tariŋ ʒiishee, ka ŋun bol a maa yi ti yina ti yɛl a, Zɔri, yiɣisim chaŋ ti ʒini jilima ʒiishee ŋɔ ha! Di saha maa a ni nya jilima a mini bɛnkam laɣim ʒiya diri maa sani.
en: When you are invited to be a guest, go and sit in the worst place. Then the one who invited you may come and say, My friend, take a better seat! You will then be honored in front of all the other guests.

dag: Dama di dabisa maa ni mini di saha maa n yi ti chɛ ka Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim lan tɔŋ.
en: The Lord says, At that time I will restore the prosperity of Judah and Jerusalem.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, Yawɛ suhu daa na kul bi maai. O suhu daa yiɣisiya pam bahi Judanim zuɣu Manaasa ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa n-chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi pam la zuɣu.
en: But the Lord was still furious with the people of Judah because Manasseh had done so many things to make him angry.

dag: Ninsal ni tooi mali buchi Naawuni sani? Ka hal ŋun mali yɛm ni tooi mali buchi o sani?.
en: Can a human being be useful to God? Can an intelligent person bring profit?.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka a kumdi pampam? A lan kala naa? A saawaranim kpimi, ka biɛrim mal a kaman paɣ ni yɛn dɔɣi ka biɛrim shɛli mal o la?.
en: Now, why are you crying so loudly? Is your king gone? Have you lost your wise leader? Is that why you are suffering like a woman in labor?.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa ti be puu maa ni zaawun mahili saha n-chani ginda, ka doo maa min o paɣ maa wum o damli, ka zo nti sɔɣi puu maa ni tihi ni ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ di nya ba.
en: Late in the afternoon, when the breeze began to blow, the man and woman heard the Lord God walking in the garden. So they hid behind some trees.

dag: Nyini n-daa teeg a nuu din mali yiko n-tum shihira mini alahiziba tuma din mali dabiɛm n-yih a niriba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na.
en: By means of miracles and wonders that terrified our enemies, you used your power and might to bring your people Israel out of Egypt.

dag: Ka ŋmahi piɛlaa maa, ka paɣ o nyɔri min o biɛhi n-zaŋ li pahi nimdi maa mini binzuɣu la zuɣu.
en: Cut up the ram into parts. Wash its inner organs and legs, and put them together with its parts and its head.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, Kpahimmiya fiig tia: Yi yi ti kul nya ka di wula puhiri va mama, di saha yi baŋya ni siɣili miriya.
en: Let the fig tree teach you a lesson. When its branches become green and tender and it starts putting out leaves, you know that summer is near.

dag: Ka yi yi mali sara, di simdi ka yi ŋub li dindali maa bee dindali cheei biɛɣu, ka di shɛli yi guui zani hal ni daba ata dali, yin zaŋmiya li nyo buɣim.
en: You may eat it the same day you offer it and on the next day. But if any of that sacrifice is left on the third day, you must burn it in the fire.

dag: Ka o bihi maa daalahichi daa ti galisi pam Yawɛ sani, dama bɛ daa bi tiri Yawɛ sara maligu pina maa jilima.
en: In this way Hophni and Phinehas showed that they did not respect the offerings made to the Lord . This was a terrible sin against the Lord .

dag: Dinzuɣu kpuɣimiya yi bɔɣiri din zali ŋɔ zuɣusaa, ka kpaŋsi yi dun gbarima ŋɔ.
en: You have become weak, so make yourselves strong again.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kpe ŋariŋ maa ni m-baai du teeku duli kul o ya.
en: Jesus got into a boat and went back across the lake to his own town.

dag: Ka yi daa gbi kɔbɔɣili sɔŋ goma ayi sunsuuni ni beeŋ kurili la ni kom zɔrina ti luri di ni. Amaa ka bi lihi nya ŋun daa pun niŋ li bee n-chɛ ka yi baɣa be ŋun daa pun lo di nia zali ka di waɣ la ni.
en: You made a reservoir between the walls for the water of the earlier pool. But you didnt trust its maker; you didnt consider the one who planned it long ago.

dag: n-kpe Zakaria yiŋ ti puhi Ɛlizabɛt.
en: She entered Zechariahs home and greeted Elizabeth.

dag: ka tumo daa ti kana ti yɛli Ayuba, Ti di malila naɣilahi la kɔra, ka bunsi la ʒe m-baɣi ba ŋubiri mɔri.
en: when someone rushed up to Job and said, While your servants were plowing with your oxen, and your donkeys were nearby eating grass.

dag: Chɛ ka o bihi chanimi gindi maani bara, ka bɛ kari ba yihi bɛ yili chɛra ni.
en: make his children beg for food and live in the slums.

dag: Ti yi dol o zaligunima, dina n-ni chɛ ka ti baŋ ni ti mi o.
en: If we obey what God has told us to do, then we are sure that we know him.

dag: Ka Yisa daa piligi yɛri ba, Miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka so birigi ya;.
en: Jesus answered: Watch out and don't let anyone fool you!.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Yi ni chɛ ka bɛ teei yi tuumbiɛri yɛla, ka yi biriginsim yi palo, ka yi daalahichi yi palo yi tuuni kam puuni, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ teei yi yɛla la zuɣu, bɛ ni gbahi ya bɛ nuhi ni.
en: Ezekiel, tell the people of Jerusalem and their ruler that I, the Lord God, am saying: Everything you do is wicked and shows how sinful you are. You are guilty and will be taken away as prisoners.

dag: A daa pala shɛli ka n duh a ka piig a leei n niriba Izraɛlnim zuɣulana. Ka a mi ti dolila Jɛrɔbɔam soli n-chɛ ka n niriba Izraɛlnim maa tum alahichi, ka bɛ ni tum alahichi shɛŋa maa zuɣu chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi.
en: You were a nobody, but I made you the leader of my people Israel. And now you have sinned like Jeroboam and have led my people into sin. Their sins have aroused my anger.

dag: Lan zaŋm bula yino m-mali alahichi sanyoo sara Yawɛ sani m-pahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim dabisili kam mini di binnyura sara zuɣu.
en: There will be one male goat for a purification offering to the LORD in addition to the regular entirely burned offering and its drink offering.

dag: M bi saɣi ni paɣiba nyɛ karimbanima bee n-su dɔbba fukumsi; di niŋ kamaata ni bɛ shini baalim.
en: I do not allow them to teach or to have authority over men; they must keep quiet.

dag: Anabi Musa n-daa zaŋ gunibu zaligu tin ya, amaa pa Anabi Musa sani ka di daa yina, yi yaannim sani ka di daa yina, hal ka yi gundi yi bidibbihi Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: But you obey the law Moses gave you about circumcision—and sometimes you do it on a Sabbath day. Yes, you often circumcise baby boys on a Sabbath day.

dag: ka zaŋ tahili la zali Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa mini sara maligu bimbin la sunsuuni n-niŋ kom niŋ di ni.
en: Put the washbasin between the Tent and the altar and fill it with water.

dag: Amaa ka yi yɛra, Ti Duuma ni niŋdi shɛm bi tuhi. Pumpɔŋɔ yinim Izraɛlnima wummiya, n ni niŋdi shɛm m-bi tuhi? Pa yinima ni niŋdi shɛm n-lee bi tuhi?.
en: You people might say, The Lord isnt fair! But listen, family of Israel. I am fair. You are the ones who are not fair!.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Rɛfidim maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Sinai tiŋgban nɛl ni.
en: They left Rephidim and camped in the desert of Sinai.

dag: O nyɛla ninvuɣ so ŋun wumdi Naawuni yɛtɔɣa, ka mali baŋsim shɛli din yiri Zallakudura Naa sanna. O nyɛla ŋun nyari Kpiɔŋlan Naa ʒii. O luya, amaa ka bi pɔb o nina.
en: The oracle of one who hears Gods speech, and understands the Most Highs knowledge, who perceives the Almightys visions, who falls down with eyes uncovered.

dag: A ni ti bo a dimnim shee, amaa ka ku nya ba; ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tuhir a ni ti bahi yoli.
en: and will disappear from the earth.

dag: Amaa Giliad min o paɣ gba daa dɔɣi bidib shɛba. Ka o paɣ bidibisi maa ni daa ti zooi, bɛ daa karila Jɛfita ka yɛl o, Ti min a ku laɣim di ti ba fali, dama a nyɛla paɣ so bia.
en: Gileads wife had several sons. When they grew up, they did not like Jephthah. They forced Jephthah to leave his hometown. They said to him, You will not get any of our fathers property, because you are the son of another woman.

dag: Bɛ bi muɣiri taba, bɛ zaa dolila bɛ soya. Bɛ tooi gariti bɛ ni gu ba soli luɣ shɛli, ka binshɛli ku tooi taɣ ba zali.
en: They charge straight ahead, without pushing each other; even arrows and spears cannot make them retreat.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa yɛli, A nini yi tiɣi ma, nyin wuhim ma shihirili din wuhiri ni nyin Yawɛ n-tɔɣisiri ma yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ.
en: Gideon replied, If you are pleased with me, give me some proof that you are really the Lord .

dag: ni Bɛra, ŋuna ka Tiligatipilinɛza ŋun daa nyɛ Asiria naa la daa zaŋ kuli tinzun tiŋ ni la. Ŋuna n-daa nyɛ Rubin zuliya naa.
en: and his son Beerah, whom Assyrias King Tilgath-pilneser carried away into exile. He was a chief of the Reubenites.

dag: Ɛmim zuliya bɛn daa nyɛ wɔɣira ka wɔɣawɔɣa kaman Anaki zuliya, ka nyɛ bɛn galisi pam la n-daa pun be nimaani.
en: A mighty race of giants called the Emim used to live in Ar. They were as tall as the Anakim, another race of giants.

dag: Amaa nyin wuhimila din mini wuhibu maŋli taɣili tab la.
en: But you must teach what agrees with sound doctrine.

dag: Ʒiri sanianim mini ʒiri binzahindisi zaa nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ sani.
en: The Lord hates people who use dishonest weights and measures.

dag: N ni tum shɛlikam zaŋ chaŋ yi polo ti kpalim yoli zuɣu chɛ ka n suhu kul zɔhirimi.
en: I am afraid I have wasted my time working with you.

dag: Maika ni Rɛhɔb ni Hashabia ni.
en: Mica, Rehob, Hashabiah.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, Zaŋmi Lɛvinim zaa ti ma ka chɛ Izraɛlnim bidibikpamba zaa, ka zaŋ Lɛvinim niɣi ti ma ka chɛ Izraɛlnim niɣi ni tuui dɔɣi naɣibihi shɛb zaa.
en: They belong to me, but I will accept the Levites as substitutes for them, and I will accept the Levites' livestock as substitutes for the Israelites' first-born livestock.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ Yawɛ naani ka chɛ buɣa jɛmbu bee n-woligi bɛmaŋ ka chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi buɣa mali alibarika.
en: Those who put their trust in the LORD, who pay no attention to the proud or to those who follow lies, are truly happy!.

dag: N zaŋla tulaale shɛŋa bɛ ni booni mɛɛr mini aloosi ni sinnamɔn tulaalɛnim la mihi li.
en: I've perfumed it with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa dɔbba mini paɣiba zaa bɛn suhuri daa yɛli ba ni bɛ zaŋmi binshɛli kana ka bɛ ti zaŋ li tum Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa ni o tum tuun shɛli maa zaa din nyɛ bɛ suhuyubu pina, bɛ daa zaŋdi li mi na ti tiri Yawɛ.
en: All the Israelite men and women who were eager to contribute something for the work that the LORD had commanded Moses to do brought it as a spontaneous gift to the LORD.

dag: ka ŋun pahi anahi daa nyɛ Nɛtanɛl, ka ŋun pahi anu daa nyɛ Radai.
en: Nethanel, Raddai.

dag: Balaam ni daa nya ka Yawɛ lo ni o niŋla alibarika niŋ Izraɛlnim ni maa zuɣu, o daa bi lan lihi o ni daa yi lihiri binshɛŋa ni baŋdi din yɛn niŋ kaman o ni daa yi pun niŋdi shɛm la, amaa ka zaŋ o zuɣu ʒila mɔɣu polo.
en: Balaam saw that the Lord wanted to bless Israel, so he did not try to change that by using any kind of magic. But Balaam turned and looked toward the desert.

dag: Hal bɛ kalinli ni daa bi galisi, ka bɛ lan nyɛ saamba nimaani.
en: At the time God said this, there were only a few of his people, and they were strangers there.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋdi binyɛra paŋdi ya, amaa yinim ti ku zaŋ shɛli paŋ ba. Bɛna nti yɛn nyɛ zuɣu, ka yi nyɛ zuli.
en: They will have money to lend you, but you will have none to lend them. In the end they will be your rulers.

dag: Yi ni daa je yɛm, ka bi zaŋ Yawɛ zɔbu kpɛhi yi kɔbili ni.
en: because they hated knowledge and didnt choose the fear of the LORD.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun kura, ka lan nyɛ ŋun tiri nyɛvili. Ŋuna n-tahiri niriba kpiimba biɛhigu shee, ka lan neeri ba.
en: You take away life, and you give life. You send people down to the world of the dead and bring them back again.

dag: n-fa o o wahala zaa ni bahi, ka ti o baŋsim, ka chɛ ka o nya jilima Firawuna ŋun daa nyɛ Ijipti naa la sani. Ka Firawuna daa leeg o nam, ka chɛ ka o guli ŋun Firawuna yili zaŋ tabili Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ zaa.
en: and rescued him from all his troubles. God made him so wise that the Egyptian king Pharaoh thought highly of him. The king even made Joseph governor over Egypt and put him in charge of everything he owned.

dag: Gol ŋɔ biɛɣ pinaanahi dali zaawuni doliya di kaya ni di zaligunim zaa soli m-puhi li di puhibu saha.
en: On the fourteenth day of this month at twilight you will keep it at its appointed time. Keep it according to all its regulations and its customary practices.

dag: Ka du shɛli din daa ʒe Luɣ Kasi Zaa Shee duu maa tooni wɔɣilim daa nyɛ mita pisaayika.
en: In front of the Most Holy Place was the main part of the Temple. This room was cubits long.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, Di mi lan sabi yɛli, Miri ka a zahim a Duuma Naawuni. .
en: But Jesus answered, The scripture says, Do not put the Lord your God to the test.

dag: Ka bɛ daa shiri niŋ lala n-zaŋ talim Baanabas mini Sool ni bɛ ti ti cheechi kpamba.
en: They gathered the money and gave it to Barnabas and Saul, who took it to the elders in Judea.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naawuni ni lo ti vuhim nyabu alikauli shɛl la ni na kul ʒiɛya zuɣu, chɛliya ka ti zo dabiɛm ka yi ni so ti ku kɔŋ vuhim maa shee paabu.
en: And we still have the promise that God gave those people. That promise is that we can enter his place of rest. So we should be very careful that none of you fails to get that promise.

dag: Yoomi wuntitali dunoya ti ma, ka n dol li kpe nti puhi Yawɛ.
en: Open the gates of justice! I will enter and tell the Lord how thankful I am.

dag: Di saha ka Samsin daa chaŋ ti gbahi ŋɔri kɔbisita n-zaŋ bɛ zuya gbin taba ka zaŋ buɣim mokpala shɛbisishɛbisi di gbina maa ni.
en: Then Samson went and caught three hundred foxes. He took torches, turned the foxes tail to tail, and put a torch between each pair of tails.

dag: Ka n yi kariti alizin biɛri Biilzibul yiko ni, ka ŋun mi yiko ni ka yi niriba lee kariti ba bahira? Dinzuɣu yimaŋmaŋ niriba maa ni zaŋ yi nol ni yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi luhi ya.
en: You say that I use the power of Satan to force out demons. If that is true, then what power do your people use when they force out demons? So your own people will prove that you are wrong.

dag: M biyurisi, Naawuni yi yuri ti ŋ-ŋɔ, dindina di simdi ni ti gba yuri taba.
en: Dear friends, if God loved us this way, we also ought to love each other.

dag: Ka o daa yiɣisi tirisi tooni nti lan gbi kɔbil shɛli, ka so daa bi lan niŋ o naŋgbankpeeni di zuɣu yaha; dinzuɣu ka o daa boli di mi yuli Rɛhɔbɔt ka yɛra, Yawɛ yipa ti ti luɣ shɛli din mali palo pumpɔŋɔ, ka ti ni tɔŋ tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni.
en: Finally, they dug one more well. There was no quarreling this time, and the well was named Lots of Room, because the Lord had given them room and would make them very successful.

dag: ni Mikilɔt . Bɛmbɔŋɔnim mini bɛ niriba daa ʒini baɣilila bɛ dɔɣim maa Jɛrusalɛm fɔŋ ni.
en: and Mikloth, the father of Shimeah. Their descendants lived in Jerusalem near other families of their clan.

dag: Ka malaika maa garigi yɛl o, Naawuni Shia Kasi ni ti siɣ a zuɣu na, ka Zallakudura Naa yiko mahim ti gil a; dinzuɣu a ni ti yɛn dɔɣi bi so maa, bɛ ni ti boon o la bi suŋ ni Naawuni Bia.
en: The angel answered, The Holy Spirit will come on you, and God's power will rest upon you. For this reason the holy child will be called the Son of God.

dag: Ka mɔɣili kom daa zɔri yiri Idɛn na n-teeni puu maa; ka di daa woligi n-niŋ mɔɣ anahi nimaani.
en: A stream flowed in Eden and watered the garden; beyond Eden it divided into four rivers.

dag: Ŋunkam je o mabia nyɛla ninvuɣ kura, ka yi mi ni ninvuɣ kura ka nyɛvili din ka bahigu o ni.
en: Everyone who hates a brother or sister is a murderer, and you know that murderers dont have eternal life residing in them.

dag: Dinzuɣu gbaamiya yimaŋa, ka tummiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ni yi tum shɛm maa, ka miriya ka yi birigi kpa yi nudirigu polo bee yi nuzaa polo.
en: So you people must be careful to do everything the Lord commanded you. Do not stop following God!.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan daa vaai yiɣisi bindirigu maa dibu shee ni suhuyiɣisili pam, ka daa bi di bindirigu goli palli daba ayi dali maa, dama Dauda yɛla daa muɣis o pam ni o ba ni daa dih o vi shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: Jonathan became angry and left the table. He was so upset and angry with his father that he refused to eat any food on the second day of the festival. He was angry because Saul humiliated him and because Saul wanted to kill David.

dag: Yi yi wali wala viɛnyɛliŋga, dina n-ni chɛ ka m Ba nya jilima pam, di mi n-ni lan wuhi ni yi nyɛla n nyaandoliba.
en: My Father's glory is shown by your bearing much fruit; and in this way you become my disciples.

dag: Di saha yi ni ti lan nya wuntizɔra mini ninvuɣ biɛɣu biɛhigu ni be kɔŋkɔba shɛm, ka lan nya ŋun jɛmdi Naawuni mini ŋun bi jɛmd o biɛhigu ni be kɔŋkɔba shɛm.
en: You people will come back to me, and you will learn the difference between good and evil. You will learn the difference between someone who follows God and someone who does not.

dag: Ka Jɛfita daa lan tim tuumba Ammɔn naa maa sani, ka bɛ chaŋ ti yɛl o.
en: Jephthah sent the messengers back to the king of Ammon.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa deei nyuli zabbu sara chi zim maa paɣ maa nuu ni n-zaŋ li gahi zuɣusaa Yawɛ tooni, ka zaŋ li pa sara maligu bimbini zuɣu;.
en: Then the priest will take the grain offering from her and raise it before the Lord . Then he will carry it to the altar.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa garigi yɛl o niriba maa, N ni tin ya chi mini wain ni kpam, ka yi tiɣi; ka chɛ ka zuliya shɛb ku tooi lan mali ya ansarisi yaha.
en: The LORD responded to the people: See, I am sending you the corn, new wine, and fresh oil, and you will be fully satisfied by it; and I will no longer make you a disgrace among the nations.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka buɣim di Magɔg mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒi teeku noli ni alaafee la, ka bɛ baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will start a fire in the land of Magog and along all the seacoasts where people live undisturbed, and everyone will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Bɛ yiinila yila saɣisiri guŋgombihi mini mɔɣilo, ka kalambua kumsi niŋdi ba nyaɣisim.
en: and dance to the music of harps and flutes.

dag: Dama bɛ ku Yaakubu zuliya, ka wurim bɛ biɛhigu shee.
en: Theyve devoured Jacob and demolished his pasture.

dag: Ka Ɛhab daŋ ni ŋunkam kpi yiŋa, bahi ni ŋub o; ka ŋunkam mi kpi mɔɣu ni, juri ni di o.
en: Dogs will also eat the bodies of your relatives who die in town, and vultures will eat the bodies of those who die in the country.

dag: bee n-suh o galli, ka o gbaai nɔŋa ti o?.
en: Which one of you would give your child a scorpion if the child asked for an egg?.

dag: ni bɛ ti yɛli ŋun Juda naa Hɛzɛkia maa: Di chɛ ka a ni zaŋ amaŋ dalim a Naawuni so maa yɔhim a n-lo a alikauli yɛri ni Asiria naa ku ŋme n-deei Jɛrusalɛm.
en: He told them, Tell King Hezekiah of Judah these things: Dont be fooled by the god you trust when he says, Jerusalem will not be defeated by the king of Assyria.

dag: Ka o gba daa fuɣ o situra zaa ka tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa Samuɛl tooni, ka daa do o zaɣim dindali maa wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa. Dindali maa ka bɔhigu ŋɔ daa piligi, Sool gba nyɛla anabi.
en: he stripped off his clothes and prophesied in front of Samuel. He dropped to the ground and lay there naked all that day and night. That's how the saying started, Is Saul now a prophet.

dag: ka yɛl o kpambaliba, Jɔn Baptaizira la n-ni bala; ŋuna n-lan neei kum ni na maa, dinzuɣu ka o mali yiko n-tumdi tuun kara ŋɔ.
en: So he said to his servants, This man is really John the Baptizer. He must have risen from death, and that is why he can do these miracles.

dag: Di yi di nyɛla n dimnima n-di maani ma ansarisi, n naan tooi deei li; ka n datahi n-yi di diri dari niŋdi ma, n naan tooi sɔɣi ka bɛ ku nya ma.
en: My enemies are not the ones who sneer and make fun. I could put up with that or even hide from them.

dag: Yɛndan yɛtɔɣa: Gbilisim tibili wum n yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, ka zaŋ a zaɣa niŋ n ni wuhir a shɛli ŋɔ ni.
en: Listen carefully to these words from the wise. Pay attention to what I have learned.

dag: Tɔŋ gbaai bɛ napɔŋkpahi, zana gbaai ba gbibi.
en: they are trapped in a net.

dag: Ka bɛ daa nya ka Anabi Ilaija mini Anabi Musa puhi zan o sani, ka bɛ min o tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa.
en: Then two men were there talking with Jesus. They were Elijah and Moses.

dag: Hamɛdata ŋun daa yi Agag zuliya ni na bia Haman ŋun daa nyɛ Yɛhudianim dim la n-daa ti chɛ ka bɛ pihi kuɣa sɔŋ ni bɛ lihi nya, ka ku Yɛhudianima. O daa lomi ni o bahi ba yoli zaa.
en: Haman was the son of Hammedatha and a descendant of Agag. He hated the Jews so much that he planned to destroy them, but he wanted to find out the best time to do it. So he cast lots.

dag: N dana, palo maa liɣiri kul nyɛla anzinfa laɣibaligu kɔbisinahi kɔŋko, ka dimbɔŋɔ lee nyɛ bɔ m min a sunsuuni? Zaŋm a kpim maa ti sɔɣi nimaani.
en: Sir, listen to me. Ten pounds of silver mean nothing to you or me. Take the land and bury your dead wife.

dag: Ka nyini Ziɔn Zoli, din nyɛ luɣ shɛli Naawuni ni be kaman piɛgula n-lihiri o niriba ŋɔ, a ni ti lan nya nam shɛli a ni daa pun su la.
en: As for you, Tower of Eder, hill of Daughter Zion, as for you it will come, the former dominion will come, the royal power belonging to Daughter Zion.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ŋmaligi yira, ka shɛb gba zaŋ alizin birigu ni daa ʒi do so zuɣu tahi Yisa sanna.
en: As these two men were leaving, some people brought another man to Jesus. This man could not talk because he had a demon inside him.

dag: Ka Balak daa yɛli Balaam, Kamina pumpɔŋɔ, ka n zaŋ a chaŋ luɣ shɛli polo, di pa shɛli ka Naawuni ti chɛ ka a yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi bɛ zuɣu nimaani ti ma.
en: Then Balak said to Balaam, So come with me to another place. Maybe God will be pleased and will allow you to curse them from that place.

dag: Naa ni daa wum zaligu kundi yɛtɔɣa maa, o daa darigimi cheeg omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu.
en: As soon as the king heard what the Instruction scroll said, he ripped his clothes.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Bɛ ni booni do so Yisa la n-gari taŋkpaɣu n-zaŋ ʒe n nina maa, ka yɛli ma ni n cham Sailom biaŋ la ni nti paɣi n nina maa. Ka n chaŋ ti paɣi, ka n nina maa dii neei.
en: He answered, Someone named Jesus made some mud and smeared it on my eyes. He told me to go and wash it off in Siloam Pool. When I did, I could see.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o kpamba daa yɛl o, N dan naa, chɛ ka ti bo paɣisarili na nti chɛ ka o be a sani gbib a, ka doon a sani, ka di chɛ ka nyini n dan naa ni tula.
en: They said to him, Allow us to find a young woman for our master the king. She will serve the king and take care of him by lying beside our master the king and keeping him warm.

dag: N ni saɣim kikaa saha yiya, ka saɣim woligu saha yiya, ka chɛ ka bɛ ni zaŋ wɔbinyina mali yiya shɛŋa lu n-dahim, ka chɛ ka yiya din nyɛ zaɣ kara wum. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will destroy the winter house with the summer house. The houses of ivory will be destroyed. Many houses will be destroyed. This is what the Lord said.

dag: Yino daa bela adaka yɔrigu maa tariga yaɣ yini polo, ka yino la mi be yaɣ din la polo. O daa kuri ba tabili la adaka yɔrigu maa, ka bɛ mini li nyɛ zaɣ yini.
en: one winged heavenly creature at one end and one winged heavenly creature at the other. He placed the winged heavenly creatures at the covers two ends.

dag: ka di me yiya m-be di ni la. Ti ka wain tihi bee puri bee bimbira.
en: We do not build houses for homes—we live in tents—and we own no vineyards, fields, or grain. We have fully obeyed everything that our ancestor Jonadab commanded us.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Obɔt maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Abarim din daa be Mɔab tintariga la.
en: They marched from Oboth and camped at Iye-abarim in the territory of Moab.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan chɛ ka Ɛliada bia Rɛzɔn ŋun daa zo o lan Zɔba Naa Hadadɛza san la leei Sulemaana dima.
en: Here is how God made Rezon son of Eliada an enemy of Solomon: Rezon had run away from his master, King Hadadezer of Zobah.

dag: Ka Sool daa tuhi nyaŋ Amalɛknim maa, Havila zaŋ hal ti kpa Shur tin shɛli din be Ijipti wulimpuhili polo la.
en: Saul defeated the Amalekites. He fought them and chased them all the way from Havilah to Shur, at the border of Egypt.

dag: Ka bɛnkam ti lan gariti du shɛli din yuli du pam ŋɔ gbini, di ni gari ba, ka bɛ bɔhira, Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka Yawɛ niŋ tiŋgbani ŋɔ mini jɛmbu duu ŋɔ lala.
en: Everyone who passes by this temple—so lofty now—will be shocked and will wonder, Why has the LORD done such a thing to this land and temple?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti nyuri wain dabisi shɛli din pahir ayi maa dali, ka naa lan bɔhi Ɛsta, Napaɣ Ɛsta, bɔ ka a lee kul bɔra? Bee bɔ ka a yɛn suhi ma? N ni zaŋ li ti a, hal di yi nyɛla n nam ŋɔ pirigili gba, n ni zaŋ li ti a.
en: and drinking wine during the second dinner, when the king again said, Esther, what can I do for you? Just ask, and I will give you as much as half of my kingdom.

dag: Siria naa maa saha tariga yi ti miri, Ijipti naa ni ti chaŋ ti lir o, ka Siria naa maa ni ti zaŋ chɛchɛbunsi mini wɔribariba ni sitimanim pam tuh o ni o kpiɔŋ zaa. Siria naa maa ni ti ŋmanila kokpɛɣu n-chaŋ ti liri tin bɔbili.
en: When the king of Syria's final hour has almost come, the king of Egypt will attack him, and the king of Syria will fight back with all his power, using chariots, horses, and many ships. He will invade many countries, like the waters of a flood.

dag: Nyini n-daa ti ma nyɛvili mini yurilim maŋli ka nyɛ ŋun guli n nyɛvili.
en: You gave me life and were very kind to me. You cared for me and watched over my spirit.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Jɔsia daa yɛli maligumaana Hilikia mini Shafan bia Ahikam ni Mikaya bia Akibɔr ni gbaŋŋmara Shafan ni naa kpambal Asaaya.
en: Then he gave a command to Hilkiah the priest, Ahikam son of Shaphan, Acbor son of Micaiah, Shaphan the secretary, and Asaiah the kings servant.

dag: Dama ŋun nam a ni be a kaman paɣ yidan ni be o shɛm la. O yuli n-nyɛ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa. Ŋuna n-nyɛ a tiligira ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi la. O yuli n-lan nyɛ, dunia zaa Naawuni.
en: Your Creator will be like a husband to you— the Lord Almighty is his name. The holy God of Israel will save you— he is the ruler of all the world.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa kpuɣ o zuɣu nya o tizo Bɛnjamin ŋun nyɛ o ma puuni bia la, ka bɔhi ba, Yi ni daa yɛli ma yi tizɔbil so yɛla la m-bɔŋɔ? Di saha ka o daa yɛli, M bia, Naawuni niŋm alibarika niŋ a ni! .
en: When Joseph looked around and saw his brother Benjamin, he said, This must be your youngest brother, the one you told me about. God bless you, my son.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Yisahaku zuliya jɛmbu shee saɣim; ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim sara maligu bimbin la shee saɣim; chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi ku Naa Jɛrɔbɔam zuliya zaa.
en: Their sacred places will be destroyed, and I will send war against the nation of King Jeroboam.

dag: O daa dila nam maa yuun pihinahi ni yini Jɛrusalɛm. O yabipaɣa n-daa nyɛ Absalom bipuɣiŋga Maaka.
en: He ruled in Jerusalem for years. His grandmothers name was Maacah, and she was the daughter of Absalom.

dag: Anabi Musa n-daa zaŋ gunibu zaligu tin ya, amaa pa Anabi Musa sani ka di daa yina, yi yaannim sani ka di daa yina, hal ka yi gundi yi bidibbihi Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: Moses commanded you to circumcise your sons. But it wasn't really Moses who gave you this command. It was your ancestors, and even on the Sabbath you circumcise your sons.

dag: Dama ŋuna n-yuuni dunia tarisi, ka nyari binshɛɣukam din be sagbana tiŋli.
en: Because he sees the ends of the earth, Sees everything under the sky.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yɛli Yisifu, Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Kpiɔŋlan Naa ŋɔ daa yi n zuɣu Luz Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-niŋ alibarika niŋ n ni.
en: Then Israel said to Joseph, God All-Powerful appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan. God blessed me there.

dag: O daa chɛ ka Judanim ku tooi zabi bɛmaŋ zuɣu. Dindali maa, yi daa chaŋla tibɔŋ ni bidibbina duu la ni nti yihi bidibbina.
en: Judahs covering has been stripped away. On that day, you trusted the weapons in the Forest House.

dag: Ka bindirigu kam din be di puuni ka nyɛ kom ni kpaai bahi shɛli zuɣu nyɛla din ni leei daɣiri, ka binnyurigu kam din yi duɣu maa puuni na ni leei daɣiri.
en: If you pour water from this pot on any food, that food becomes unclean, and anything drinkable in the pot becomes unclean.

dag: Yuun pihita puuni gol so ŋun pahir anahi daba anu dali, n daa bela bɛ ni gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb chaŋ la sani Kɛba Mɔɣili duli, ka zuɣusaa daa yooi, ka n nya ʒiinim din yi Naawuni sanna.
en: I am the priest, Ezekiel son of Buzi. I was in exile by the Kebar Canal in Babylonia when the skies opened up, and I saw visions of God. This was on the fifth day of the fourth month of the thirtieth year.

dag: Ka Musa bɔɣu daa ti ja, ka bɛ bo kuɣili na ti sɔŋ ka o ʒini di zuɣu, ka Aduna mini Hur daa gub gbaag o nuhi maa mali. Yino daa ʒiɛla o nudirigu polo, ka ŋun la mi ʒe o nuzaa polo, ka o nuhi maa daa kul ʒe tibi hal ka wuntaŋ ti lu.
en: But Moses hands grew tired. So they took a stone and put it under Moses so he could sit down on it. Aaron and Hur held up his hands, one on each side of him so that his hands remained steady until sunset.

dag: Ka wula ka Naawuni Kundi lee yɛli? Di yɛliya, Karim dab paɣa min o bia bahi, dama dab paɣ bia mini bilichin paɣ bia ku laɣim di fali.
en: But what do the Scriptures say? Throw out the slave woman and her son! The son of the free woman will receive everything his father has, but the son of the slave woman will receive nothing.

dag: Dunianima, paɣimiya Yawɛ, paɣimiy o jilima min o kpiɔŋ.
en: Give to the LORD, all families of the nations— give to the LORD glory and power!.

dag: Shɛla ŋun daa nyɛ Juda bia la bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ɛr ŋun daa nyɛ Lɛka ba la mini Laada ŋun daa nyɛ Marɛsha ba la ni kpalu shɛb bɛn daa be Bɛtashibia n-wuɣiri bimpiɛla la.
en: Shelah was one of Judah's sons. His descendants included Er, who founded the town of Lecah; Laadah, founder of the town of Mareshah; the clan of linen weavers, who lived in the town of Beth Ashbea;.

dag: Yi bi mi ni yi niŋgbuna maa nyɛla Shia Kasi so Naawuni ni zaŋ tin ya ka o be yi ni la duu? Yi bi su yimaŋa.
en: Don't you know that your body is the temple of the Holy Spirit, who lives in you and who was given to you by God? You do not belong to yourselves but to God;.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Mɔabnim tuumbiɛri buta ni bunahi zuɣu n ku chɛ bɛ tibili darigibu; bɛ ni daa zaŋ Ɛdom naa kɔba nyo buɣim la zuɣu.
en: This is what the Lord says: I will definitely punish the people of Moab for the many crimes they did. Moab burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime.

dag: Kaman dam din miha ni to noli ni, ka nyɔhi biɛri nimbihi ni shɛm, lala ka vinnyaɣinim gba be bɛ tumalaannim sani.
en: Having a lazy person on the job is like a mouth full of vinegar or smoke in your eyes.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim puuni Naawuni Shia Kasi kahigi wuhi ni tuuli tanti duu la ni daa na kul ʒiɛya la zuɣu, di wuhiya ni Luɣ Kasi Zaa Kasi Shee la soli na bi yooi.
en: With this, the Holy Spirit is showing that the way into the holy place hadnt been revealed yet while the first tent was standing.

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o ni daa tuhi tɔbu shɛm ni o ni daa di nam shɛm zaa yɛla sab niŋ Izraɛl nanim Litaafi ni.
en: Everything else Jeroboam did while he was king, including the battles he won, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Ka ti Duuma yiko daa be bɛ sani, ka niriba pam daa niŋ yɛda ŋ-ŋmaligi jɛmdi ti Duuma.
en: The Lord's power was with them, and many people turned to the Lord and put their faith in him.

dag: Ka naa daa fabili Abinɛr zuɣu yɛli, Bɔ n-niŋ ka Abinɛr ti kpi kaman jɛrigu la?.
en: Then the king sang a funeral song about Abner: Abner, why should you have died like an outlaw?.

dag: Ka laɣiŋgu maa ni kpamba ti zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa naɣilaa maa zuɣu ni Yawɛ tooni, ka bɛ kɔrig o Yawɛ tooni maa.
en: where your tribal leaders will lay their hands on its head, before having it killed in my presence.

dag: Bɛzai daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisita ni pisinaanahi.
en: of Bezai.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa ŋmaligi nimaani chaŋ ti nya Shafat bia Ilaisha maa ka o malila naɣikɔra siɣimsiɣim bupinaayi zuɣu ka bɛ be o tooni kɔra; omaŋmaŋ n-daa mali bɛn pahiri bupinaayi maa kɔra. Ka Ilaija daa chaŋ ti gar o sani ka pirig o binyɛrigu pa o zuɣu.
en: Elijah left and found Elisha plowing a field with a pair of oxen. There were eleven other men in front of him, and each one was also plowing with a pair of oxen. Elijah went over and put his own coat on Elisha.

dag: amaa tinim ni zaŋ ti dahima zaa n-niŋla Naawuni suhibu min o yɛligu tɔɣisibu tuma ni.
en: We can spend our time praying and serving God by preaching.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa lan zaŋ li ti sa tiŋgban nɛli ni, luɣ shɛli kom ni kani, ka di tiŋgbani kuui.
en: Then she was planted in a hot, dry desert.

dag: Jɛra yi bɔhi jɛrilim bɔhigu, nyin di garigi ba jɛrilim garigibu, di yi pa lala a gba ni leei jɛrigu.
en: There is no good way to answer fools when they say something stupid. If you answer them, then you, too, will look like a fool. If you dont answer them, they will think they are smart.

dag: Amaa ka Nadab mini Abihu daa ti zaŋ buɣim din bi viɛla n-nyo sara maligu ti Yawɛ ka kpi.
en: But Nadab and Abihu had died when they offered fire that was unacceptable to the Lord .

dag: Di saha ka Hushai daa yɛli Absalom, Ahitɔfɛl ni yɛli shɛm pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ din bi viɛla.
en: Hushai said: This time Ahithophel's advice isn't so good.

dag: Baasha ni daa kul di nam maa, di daa bi yuui ka o ku Jɛrɔbɔam yiŋnim zaa kaman Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka anabi Ahija Shilo nir la yɛli shɛm la. O daa bi chɛ hal bɛ ni ninvuɣ yino gba; o daa kula bɛ zaa.
en: When he became king, Baasha attacked the entire house of Jeroboam. He didnt allow any living person to survive in Jeroboams family; he wiped them out according to the LORDs word spoken by the LORDs servant Ahijah of Shiloh.

dag: Bɛ ti ma dansi n yaaŋa zuɣu. Bɛ niŋ li la zaɣ wɔɣila kaman pukpara ni wɔriti vuɣisi shɛm la.
en: though my back is like a field that has just been plowed.

dag: Ka n daa bɔhi ba, Buɣ din ni ka yi lee chani maa? Dinzuɣu ka bɛ booni nimaani yuli Bama hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: I asked the people of Israel why they were going to the high places. But that high place is still there today. .

dag: Sulemaana ni daa sɔŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa tampuɣili dahin shɛli ka tum tuun shɛŋa m-mali hal ti me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa naai zaa shɛm m-bala.
en: So Solomon completed his work on the Lord s Temple. Work began the day they laid the foundation and continued without stopping until the day the Temple was finished.

dag: Di sab Anabi Musa zaligu ni, Miri ka a zaŋ naŋgbampɔbirigu m-pɔbi naɣikɔrigu ŋun nɔri buri chi noli. Naɣikɔra zuɣu ka Naawuni yɛl lala maa?.
en: In Moses Law its written: You will not muzzle the ox when it is threshing . Is God worried about oxen.

dag: Chɛliya ka bɛn tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa puuni niriba ata bee ayi tɔɣisi; ka chɛ ka bɛn kpalim buɣisi bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: And only two or three prophets should speak. The others should judge what they say.

dag: Ka bɛ daa paai Yisa sani nti nya alizin biɛri ni daa ʒi do so zuɣu maa, ka o leela ninvuɣ maŋli ye situra ʒiya; ka dabiɛm daa kpe ba pam.
en: When they came to Jesus, they saw the man who had once been full of demons. He was sitting there with his clothes on and in his right mind, and they were terrified.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Amɔn sɔɣ omaŋmaŋ gbal shɛli din daa be Yuza puu la ni. Ka o bia Jɔsia daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Amon was buried in the tomb in the garden of Uzza, and his son Josiah succeeded him as king.

dag: N yi tumdi li la mmaŋmaŋ suhu yubu zuɣu, dindina n simdi yɔri yɔbu; amaa di yi pala mmaŋmaŋ suhu yubu zuɣu, dindina Naawuni ni zali ma ni n tum shɛm m-bala.
en: If I preach because I want to, I will be paid. But even if I don't want to, it is still something God has sent me to do.

dag: Amaa Aduna ni yɛn niŋ shɛm ka naanyi kpe luɣ kasi maa puuni m-bɔŋɔ: O bom naɣila polli ŋun ni mali alahichi sanyoo sara mini piɛlaa ŋun ni mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la na.
en: No, but Aaron must enter the holy area as follows: with a bull from the herd as a purification offering and a ram as an entirely burned offering.

dag: Babilɔnnima, yi bari yimaŋ zana ka di gbahi ya, amaa ka yi bi baŋ lala. Bɛ daa nyan ya n-gbahi ya yi ni daa mo Yawɛ la zuɣu.
en: Babylonia, you fought against me, and you have been caught in the trap I set for you, even though you did not know it.

dag: Miri ka a niŋ ninvuɣ biɛɣu, a mi di nyɛ jɛrigu. Di niŋ lala n-kpi ka a saha na bi paai.
en: Dont be too wicked and dont be a fool, or you may die before your time.

dag: Di zuɣu ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Farisiinim daa laɣim jintɔriba na ti bɔhi ba, Wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ? Dama doo ŋɔ wuhiri shihira pam.
en: Then the leading priests and Pharisees called a meeting of the high council. They said, What should we do? This man is doing many miraculous signs.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛliakim mini Shɛbina ni Jɔa daa yɛli Rabishake maa. Ti suhir a, yɛlim tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ Aramaik yɛtɔɣa ni, dama ti wumdi li, ka di lan yɛri ti Judanim yɛtɔɣa ni ka niriba bɛn be gooni zuɣu ŋɔ wumdi li.
en: Then Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said to the commander, Please, speak to us in Hebrew. We understand that language. Dont speak to us in the language of Judah. If you use our language, the people on the city walls will understand you.

dag: A yi zaŋ salima buɣilimbuɣilimbila yili, ka a zaŋ pumpɔrinchihi kɔtomsi yili pa di zuɣu; ka zaŋ salima kɔtomsi ni pumpɔrinchiya m-mali lala hal ti gili alichɛbba maa tiŋli zaa.
en: So around the bottom edge of the robe there should be bells and pomegranates. There should be a bell following each pomegranate.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla alizin biɛri n-chani dunia nanim zaa sani nti wuhiri shihira ni bɛ laɣim ba lo tɔbu gu Naawuni Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ dabisi tital la dali.
en: These evil spirits had the power to work miracles. They went to every king on earth, to bring them together for a war against God All-Powerful. But that will be the day of God's great victory.

dag: Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga kpamba fomi ʒi tiŋgban ni. Bɛ kɔrila taŋkpaɣu puɣi bɛ zuɣuri ka so buri. Jɛrusalɛm paɣisara zaŋla bɛ zuɣuri fi tiŋa.
en: Jerusalem's old men sit on the ground in silence, With dust on their heads and sackcloth on their bodies. Young women bow their heads to the ground.

dag: N ni daa be yi sani ka ti lan ka shɛl la, n daa bi zaŋ n yɛla doli yi ni so, dama m mabi shɛb bɛn daa yi Masidɔnia na la daa ti ma n ni kɔŋ shɛli maa. Dinzuɣu n daa bi zaŋ n yɛla doli yi ni so, ka na kul ku zaŋ n yɛla doli ya pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana.
en: And during the time I was with you I did not bother you for help when I needed money; the believers who came from Macedonia brought me everything I needed. As in the past, so in the future: I will never be a burden to you!.

dag: ka bɛ ʒin ya chaŋ kaman wurigu la pɔi ka Yawɛ suhu naanyi yiɣisi bahi yi zuɣu. Niŋmiya tab saawara ka laɣimmiya pɔi ka Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili titali dabisili la naanyi paai ya.
en: before it's too late. The Lord has set a time when his fierce anger will strike like a storm and sweep you away.

dag: Ka m bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee bala, n Duuma? Ka o yɛli, Man Yisa so a ni niŋdi alaka maa m-bala.
en: I said, Who are you, Lord? The Lord said, I am Jesus. I am the one you are persecuting.

dag: Din bahindi nyaaŋa zaŋ chaŋ dimbɔŋɔnim polo nyɛla, di simdi ni yi zaa mali naŋgban yini, ka chɛ ka yi baɣa be nandahima ni paai shɛb yɛla ni, ka yumiya mabihili, ka maliya suhuballi, ka siɣisimiya yimaŋa yi tab sani.
en: Finally, all of you be of one mind, sympathetic, lovers of your fellow believers, compassionate, and modest in your opinion of yourselves.

dag: Ka o suhu daa yiɣisi bah o niriba maa zuɣu, ka chɛ ka bɛ dimnim zaŋ takɔbiri ku ba.
en: He showed his anger against his people and let them be killed in war.

dag: Sapashini maa ni daa wum Pool ni yɛli shɛm maa ka o chaŋ ti bɔhi sapashin kpɛm la, Tuun bɔ ka a lee yɛn tum ŋɔ? Doo maa nyɛla Rom tiŋbia.
en: When the officer heard this, he went to the commander and said, What are you doing? This man is a Roman citizen.

dag: N ni gɔŋ Juda kaman tɔb la, ka zaŋ Ifriim mi leei di piɛma. N ni zaŋ Ziɔn leei takɔbi n-tuhi Giriisinima.
en: Judah, I will use you like a bow. Ephraim, I will use you like arrows. Israel, I will use you like a sword to fight against the men of Greece.

dag: Di saha ka o yɛli ma, Tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli kɔba maa, Yinim kɔb kuma ŋɔ, wummiya Yawɛ yɛligu.
en: He then told me to say: Dry bones, listen to what the Lord is saying to you.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim daa kul kpaŋsiri Izraɛlnim maa ni bɛ yim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni yomyom, dama bɛ daa yɛlimi, Di yi pa lala tinim gba kul kpimi maa.
en: The people of Egypt also asked them to hurry and leave. They said, If you dont leave, we will all die.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka tɔna do n-gil a, ka dabiɛm lu a zuɣu libig a.
en: For this reason, snares surround you; sudden dread brings panic to you.

dag: Di yi pa lala, nyini n dan naa yi ti di saɣim saɣ a tariga, bɛ ni wuhi ni m mini m bia Sulemaana nyɛla bɛ nyaanyiriba.
en: If you don't, as soon as you are dead, my son Solomon and I will be treated as traitors.

dag: Ti wum vuri zoya zuɣu. Di nyɛla Izraɛlnim fabila kuhigu bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa zuɣu. Bɛ tamla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ yɛla.
en: A noise is heard on the hilltops: it is the people of Israel crying and pleading because they have lived sinful lives and have forgotten the Lord their God.

dag: Izraɛl Naa Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisi saha ka Asa daa leei Juda naa.
en: In the twentieth year of the reign of King Jeroboam of Israel, Asa became king of Judah.

dag: Ka Mɔdɛkai daa baŋ bɛ ni lo shɛm maa ka zaŋ li yɛli Napaɣ Ɛsta, ka o mi yɛli Naa Ahasivɛrɔs Mɔdɛkai ni wum shɛm ka yɛl o.
en: Mordecai found out about their plans and asked Queen Esther to tell the king what he had found out.

dag: nti yɛl o, Nyama, pumpɔŋɔ a kurigiya, ka a bihi ŋɔ mi bi dol a naba, dinzuɣu bom naa ti ti ka o su ti kaman zuliya kam ni mali nanim shɛm ŋɔ.
en: They said to him, Listen. You are old now, and your sons dont follow in your footsteps. So appoint us a king to judge us like all the other nations have.

dag: Zahima pam zahimbu mini yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ ka buchi, amaa zomiyala Naawuni.
en: No matter how much you dream, how much useless work you do, or how much you talk, you must still stand in awe of God.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ yɛliya, Nyamiya, n ni zaŋ kuɣituurili sɔŋ bɛ soli zuɣu, ka bɛ ti tuui li; bihi mini bɛ laamba zaa, ka ʒiʒiinikpee min o zo zaa ti kpi.
en: And so I will make these people stumble and fall. Parents and children will die, and so will friends and neighbors.

dag: Bɛ ni ti yɛli ya, Nyamiya, o be kpe ha! Bee n-yɛli ya, Nyamiya, o be kpe! Ti miriya ka yi chaŋ bee nti doli ba.
en: When people say to you, Look there, or Look here, don't go looking for him.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ yɛda niŋbu kɔŋko gba, di yi bi tumdi tuma, di nyɛla yɛda kpiŋ.
en: So it is with faith: if it is alone and includes no actions, then it is dead.

dag: Gomna Pailɛt ni daa bɔri ni o niŋ niriba maa suhu yubu zuɣu ka o daa yihi Barabas bahi, ka chɛ ka bɛ fiɛb Yisa, ka o naanyi zaŋ o ti ba ni bɛ ti kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: Pilate wanted to satisfy the crowd, so he released Barabbas to them. He had Jesus whipped, then handed him over to be crucified.

dag: Amaa Izraɛlnim tarili la ni, yihimiya bin yini bini pihinu kam puuni, di yi nyɛla ninsalinim bee niɣi bee bunsi bee piɛri bee buhi bee biŋkɔbiri balibu kam bɛn pahi n-zaŋ ba ti Lɛvinim bɛn su Yawɛ biɛhigu shee tuma fukumsi la.
en: From the half that belongs to the people, set aside one out of every and give these to the Levites in charge of the sacred tent.

dag: Nir yi na bi wum yɛtɔɣili bahigu ka daŋ garigibu, di nyɛla jɛrilim mini vi.
en: Let people finish speaking before you try to answer them. That way you will not embarrass yourself and look foolish.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti nya Yisifu ka o be katiŋ ha kanna, o daa ti yɛn paai bɛ sani, ka bɛ pun lo nia wuhi ni bɛ kum o.
en: But before he got there, they saw him coming and made plans to kill him.

dag: Di zɔri yɛlibiɛ libigirili dabiɛm bee sanʒiɛɣu din ʒiɛri ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: So don't be afraid of sudden disasters or storms that strike those who are evil.

dag: Asha zuliya ni toondana n-nyɛ Shalomi bia Ahihud.
en: from the tribe of Asher—Ahihud son of Shelomi;.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛligu nyɛla din be tibi, ka o tuma zaa nyɛ din tuhi.
en: The Lord is truthful; he can be trusted.

dag: Ka bɛ tuumba maa daa chaŋ ti yɛl o, Karimba, ti mi ni a nyɛla yɛlimaŋyɛra ni ŋun wuhiri din tuhi ka bi gaŋdi so, amaa ka wuhiri Naawuni soli ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: So the men said to Jesus, Teacher, we know that what you say and teach is true. It doesnt matter who is listening—you teach the same to all people. You always teach the truth about Gods way.

dag: Zɛdɛkia daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani kaman Jɛhoyakim ni daa tum shɛm la.
en: Zedekiah disobeyed the Lord , just as Jehoiakim had done.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa lan damdi tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim tiŋa.
en: Abraham bowed before the local citizens.

dag: N daa na ʒi n-zaŋ n noli tum alahichi din nyɛ n yɛli noli ni bɛ kpi.
en: I never sinned by praying for their death.

dag: Wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ yinim Ifriimnima? Ka wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ yinim Judanima? Yi yurilim ŋmanila asiba sagbaŋ, di ŋmanila maligim din bi yuuri ka kpahiri luri la.
en: Ephraim, what should I do with you? Judah, what should I do with you? Your faithfulness is like a morning mist. Your faithfulness is like the dew that goes away early in the morning.

dag: A mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn laɣim gil a maa zaa niŋmiya shili gu ka a leei bɛ zuɣulana.
en: Stand ready and be prepared, you and all your assembly. You will watch out for those who gather against you.

dag: Ka Sintani yi ŋmaligi tuhir omaŋa o ku tooi be, amaa o bahigu n-yɛn bala.
en: So if Satan fights against himself, that will be the end of him.

dag: Yisa daa ti lihi nya bundaannim ni tɔhiri liɣiri shɛm Naawuni jɛmbu duu;.
en: Jesus looked around and saw rich people dropping their gifts in the Temple treasury.

dag: Teemiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa niŋ Miriam shɛm saha shɛli yi ni daa yi Ijipti m-be soli chanila yɛla.
en: Remember what the Lord your God did to Miriam as you were coming from Egypt.

dag: Mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ pun ku gbuɣima mini kunduna, ka Filistia do so ŋun bi guni ŋɔ gba ni lee bɛ ni yino, dama o ta Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ tɔbbihi daɣiri.
en: I have killed lions and bears, and I will do the same to this heathen Philistine, who has defied the army of the living God.

dag: Ɛhab bia Izraɛl Naa Jɔram ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pinaayi saha, ka Juda Naa Jɛhɔram bia Ahazia gba daa di nam.
en: Ahaziah son of Jehoram became the king of Judah in the th year that Joram son of Ahab was king of Israel.

dag: ni Lɛvinim ni su tiŋ shɛli la ni ti bela naa tiŋgbani maa sunsuuni. Naa tiŋgbani maa ni ti dola Juda zuliya tiŋgbani mini Bɛnjamin zuliya tiŋgbani sunsuuni.
en: but what belongs to the prince is separate from both the levitical property and the city property. The princes territory will be between the boundary of Judah and the boundary of Benjamin.

dag: Ka sokam daa kul omaŋmaŋ ya ni bɛ ti sab o yuli.
en: Everyone, then, went to register himself, each to his own hometown.

dag: Jɛrilim n-kul pali bia suhu ni, amaa tibidarigibo fiɛbiga n-kariti li bahiri katiŋa.
en: Children just naturally do silly, careless things, but a good spanking will teach them how to behave.

dag: amaa Naawuni ni boli shɛb bɛn sani, bɛ yi nyɛla Yɛhudianim bee bɛn pa Yɛhudianima, Masia yɛla nyɛla Naawuni yiko min o yɛm.
en: Our message is God's power and wisdom for the Jews and the Greeks that he has chosen.

dag: Nir ku tooi zaŋ Ofiri salima bee kuɣ viɛl shɛŋa bɛ ni booni oniɣisi la bee safaya buɣisi li.
en: The finest gold and jewels Cannot equal its value.

dag: Ka nyamiya o ni ʒe palɔni shɛm tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa ka so bi niŋ o shɛli! Di ni bɔŋɔ ti zuɣulaannim baŋya ni doo ŋɔ shiri nyɛla Masia yɔɣɔ?.
en: Here he is, speaking in public, yet they arent saying anything to him. Could it be that our leaders actually think he is the Christ?.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛlnim maa lala, ka bɛ daa zaŋ ninvuɣ so ŋun daa tu Naawuni maa yi bɛ sansani maa kpaŋa nti lab o kuɣa. Izraɛlnim maa daa tum Yawɛ ni zali Musa shɛm maa.
en: When Moses finished speaking, the people did what the Lord had told Moses, and they stoned to death the man who had cursed the Lord .

dag: ni di chɛ ka Anabi Aizaia ni daa yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ bɛ polo la niŋ pali. O ni daa yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This was done to make come true what the prophet Isaiah had said.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti karim Naawuni zaligu min anabinim sabbu naai ka Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu zuɣulaannim daa tim so ni o cham ti yɛli Pool min o nyaaŋa maa, Ti mabihi, yi yi mali yɛligu din ni kpaŋsi niriba ŋɔ suhuri, yin yɛlimiya li.
en: The Law of Moses and the writings of the prophets were read. Then the leaders of the synagogue sent a message to Paul and Barnabas: Brothers, if you have something to say that will help the people here, please speak.

dag: Naawuni n-daa neei ti Duuma kum ni, ka ni ti neei ti gba kum ni o yiko ni.
en: And God will raise our bodies from death with the same power he used to raise the Lord Jesus.

dag: amaa ka o yɛli ma, Di niŋ lala! N nyɛla a min a mabihi bɛn nyɛ anabinima ni bɛn dol litaafi ŋɔ puuni yɛligu la dab kpee. Jɛmmi la Naawuni.
en: But he said to me, Don't do it! I am a servant together with you and with your brothers the prophets and of all those who obey the words in this book. Worship God.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl naa daa laɣim Izraɛl kpamba zaa na nti yɛli ba, Pumpɔŋɔ, nyamiya doo ŋɔ ni bɔri ti vuri shɛm. O daa pun timna nti yɛli ma ni o bɔrila m paɣiba mini m bihi ni n daanzinfa ni n salima, ka m bi mɔŋ o.
en: Then Israels king called all the elders of the land and he said, Please know and understand the evil this man wants to do! He demanded from me my wives and sons, and my silver and gold; and I didnt refuse him.

dag: Ka anabi Jɛrimia yɛli ba, Di viɛla, n ni suhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ kaman yi ni yɛli ni n niŋ shɛm maa. Ka o ni garigi yɛli shɛm, n ni yɛli ya. N ku sɔɣi ya shɛli.
en: All right, I answered, I will pray to the Lord your God, and I will tell you everything he says.

dag: Bɛ nyaɣa vilivilila kuɣ duli, ka bɛ be tampima ni.
en: They wrap their roots tightly around rocks.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ zoon jɛra ŋɔ, bina ayi ŋɔ dini n-lee gari di kpee: Salima maa bee Naawuni jɛmbu duu din chɛ ka salima maa be kasi maa?.
en: Blind fools! Which is more important, the gold or the Temple which makes the gold holy?.

dag: Dina n-daa chɛ ka Farisiinim yɛri taba, Nyamiya, ti kul nahindila timaŋ yoli! Dunianim zaa n-kabiri dol o la.
en: So the Pharisees said to each other, Look! Our plan is not working. The people are all following him.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ ba suhugarigu pam, ka bɛ gbaag o bɔhibu yinoyino, N Duuma, mani? N Duuma, mani.
en: The followers were very sad to hear this. Each one said, Lord, surely I am not the one.

dag: Dama Yisa daa pun yɛl o mi, Nyin alizin biɛɣu ŋɔ, yim doo maa ni.
en: He said this because Jesus was saying, Evil spirit, come out of this man.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Kalidianim mini Sirianim ni Mɔabnim ni Ammɔnnim tɔbbihi kana ti liri Judanim ni bɛ ku ba kaman Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka o daba bɛn nyɛ anabinim pun yɛli shɛm la.
en: The Lord sent groups of Babylonians, Arameans, Moabites, and Ammonites to fight against Jehoiakim. He sent them to destroy Judah. This happened just as the Lord had said. He used his servants the prophets to say those things.

dag: Ka Anabi Aizaia daa niŋ suhukpeeni gari lala yɛli ni Naawuni yɛliya: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa bi yuuni bɔri ma la nya ma; n zaŋ mmaŋ wuhi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa bi bɔhi n yɛla.
en: Isaiah was fearless enough to tell that the Lord had said, I was found by people who were not looking for me. I appeared to the ones who were not asking about me.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa ti niŋ binchimda zim maa shɛli mini kpam ni di firanki tulaale zim maa zaa nyo buɣim n-yihi di chihili. Di nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ sara shɛli nyo buɣim ti Yawɛ.
en: A priest will sprinkle all of the incense and some of the grain and oil on the altar and send them up in smoke to show that the whole offering belongs to me.

dag: Dama n tumtumdiba n-nyɛ Izraɛlnima. Bɛ nyɛla n tumtumdi shɛba n ni daa yihi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: because the Israelites belong to me as servants. They are my servants—I brought them out of Egypts land; I am the LORD your God.

dag: Di saha ka Nan bia Jɔshua daa tim tuumba ayi ashilɔni n-yɛli ba, Chamiya ti puɣisi nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni be shɛm, di bamdi Jɛriko. Ka bɛ daa yi Akasia chaŋ ti kpe pagɔr so ŋun yuli daa booni Reehab la yiŋa.
en: Joshua, Nuns son, secretly sent two men as spies from Shittim. He said, Go. Look over the land, especially Jericho. They set out and entered the house of a prostitute named Rahab. They bedded down there.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛhɔshafat daa silim o zuɣu n-zaŋ o nini kpa tiŋa, ka Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa daa lu tiŋa Yawɛ tooni jɛm o.
en: Jehoshaphat bowed low to the ground and everyone worshiped the Lord .

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Ka mami m pun yɛli ya ka yi zaɣisi wumbu. Ka bɔzuɣu ka yi lan bɔri ni yi wum yaha? Yi gba bɔrimi ni yi leeg o nyaandoliba yɔɣɔ.
en: He replied, I already told you, and you didnt listen. Why do you want to hear it again? Do you want to become his disciples too.

dag: O daa yɛli Asha zuliya mi: Asha bidibisi mali alibarika pam. Chɛ ka bɛ mabihi zaa yuri ba, ka chɛ ka bɛ naba siɣi kpam ni.
en: Finally, he told Asher: Asher is the most blessed of sons. I pray that hes his brothers favorite— one who dips his foot in fine oil.

dag: ka di yɛra, Mani n-nyɛ a yaannim Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu Naawuni. Ka dabiɛm daa gbaag Anabi Musa ka o ni sɔhira, ka o bi lan saɣi ni o lihi li.
en: I am the God of your ancestors, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Moses trembled with fear and dared not look.

dag: Bɛ chi sara yɛn nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ kpam ŋmiri zim viɛl shɛli, ka yi zaŋ di kilɔgiram ata pahi naɣilaa maa zuɣu; ka zaŋ di kilɔgiram ayi pahi piɛla yino maa zuɣu;.
en: Their grain offering will be fine flour mixed with oil, three-tenths for the bull, two-tenths for the one ram.

dag: Bɛ daa lan yɛli, Ka yi nini yi tiɣi tinim bɛn nyɛ yi daba ŋɔ, yin zaŋmiya tiŋgbani maa ti ti ka di leei ti dini, ka di zaŋya ti du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ.
en: They said, If you approve our request, give this land to your servants as property. Dont make us cross the Jordan.

dag: dama o nyɛla Naawuni ni zali so a sɔŋsim zuɣu. Amaa a yi tum birigi, nyin zom dabiɛm, dama o bi sula fukumsi maa yoli; o nyɛla Naawuni ni zali so ni o zaŋ ŋun Naawuni suhuyiɣisili darigi bɛn tum birigi tibili.
en: Rulers are Gods servants to help you. But if you do wrong, you have reason to be afraid. They have the power to punish, and they will use it. They are Gods servants to punish those who do wrong.

dag: O chɛ ka sakuɣa luri nahiri tiŋgbani m-be kaman gbaŋ ka bɛ yɛrigi sɔŋ la. O chɛ ka gulisigu be kaman taŋkpaɣu la n-gili luɣilikam.
en: He spreads snow like a blanket and scatters frost like dust.

dag: Di saha zuliya kam ni ti booni ya la suhupiɛllinima, dama nyaɣisim ni ti be yi tiŋgban ni. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ŋun Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: All the nations will consider you fortunate, for you will be a desirable land, says the LORD of heavenly forces.

dag: Di nahindiya yimaŋ bindir shɛli din ni saɣim zuɣu, amaa bomiyala bindir shɛli din ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Dina n-nyɛ Daadam Bia ni mali shɛli tiri ya la, dama ŋuna ka ti Ba Naawuni zaŋ o dalinli dihi tabili.
en: Don't work for food that spoils. Work for food that gives eternal life. The Son of Man will give you this food, because God the Father has given him the right to do so.

dag: Yuun tuhili yi ti gari, di ŋmanila sɔhila a sani, bee ŋ-ŋmani kaman yuŋ saha biɛla yuusim.
en: A thousand years to you are like one day; they are like yesterday, already gone, like a short hour in the night.

dag: Yawɛ, zom ma nambɔɣu! Nyam bɛn je ma ni chɛ ka n di wahala shɛŋa! Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun yihiri ma kum ni.
en: Be merciful to me, O Lord ! See the sufferings my enemies cause me! Rescue me from death, O Lord .

dag: Naawuni daa kahig o daanfaani wuhi palɔni ni di chɛ ka sokam tooi nya tiliginsim.
en: God has shown us undeserved grace by coming to save all people.

dag: Di saha maa ka sanʒiɛɣu maa ʒiɛbu daa kul moorila nini pahira. Ka bɛ daa bɔhi Jona, Ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ a ka teeku ŋɔ fo n-dɔni baalim.
en: The storm kept getting worse, until finally the sailors asked him, What should we do with you to make the sea calm down.

dag: Di simdi ni ŋun deeri wuhibu zaŋdi bin suma balibu kam tiri ŋun wuhir o.
en: If you are being taught the Christian message, you should share all the good things you have with your teacher.

dag: Yɛlim paɣ kura la gba ni bɛ mali biɛhigu shɛli din luri Naawuni sizuura, ka pa ni munaafichinima bee bɛn nyɛ danyubo daba. Di simdi ni bɛ nyɛla bɛn wuhiri din nyɛ zaɣ viɛlli.
en: In the same way instruct the older women to behave as women should who live a holy life. They must not be slanderers or slaves to wine. They must teach what is good.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Biɛhiŋ kani, dabisa kanna ka n ni ti darigi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn guni bɛ niŋgbuna ni kɔŋko la tibili, bɛna n-nyɛ:.
en: The time is coming, declares the LORD, when I will deal with everyone who is physically circumcised.

dag: Ka a niriba ŋɔ yi ti tum alahichi a sani, , ka a suhu yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka a chɛ ka bɛ dimnim kana ti tuhi nyaŋ ba ka gbahi ba kuli bɛ ya din be katiŋ bee din be yoma.
en: When they sin against you and you become angry with them and hand them over to an enemy who takes them away as prisoners to enemy territory, whether distant or nearby.

dag: Ɛba ni daa ti paai yuun pihitanaanahi saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Pɛlɛg.
en: After Eber was years old, his son Peleg was born.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ daa nya Yawɛ ni niŋ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Pɛɔr Baal polo la, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daa ku yi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa doli Pɛɔr Baal maa.
en: You saw with your own eyes what the LORD did concerning the Baal of Peor. The LORD your God destroyed everyone who followed the Baal of Peor.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka dol o ba min o ma ni Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam bɛn daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la naba.
en: He sinned against the Lord just as his parents, Ahab and Jezebel, did. He caused Israel to sin just as Jeroboam son of Nebat did.

dag: Ka chɛrubinim maa kpiŋkpama ti yirigi zuɣusaa, ka di mahim luri yɔrigu maa zuɣu, ka bɛ nina kpa taba. Yɔrigu maa polo ka bɛ nina ti yɛn kpa.
en: The creatures must face each other with their wings spread over the chest.

dag: Chɛ ka n suhigu maa paag a, gbilisim tibili wum n kuhigu shɛli n ni kuhiri bɔri sɔŋsim ŋɔ.
en: let my prayer reach you! Turn your ear to my outcry.

dag: Dauda ni daa yi Hiburɔn na nyaaŋa o daa kpuɣi paɣiba Jɛrusalɛm pahi, ka bo mamanim pahi, ka bɛ daa dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pah o.
en: After David left Hebron and moved to Jerusalem, he married many women from Jerusalem, and he had a lot of children.

dag: Zaŋmi bɛ zaa laɣim sɔɣi tiŋgban ni, ka lo ba niŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: Bury them all in the dirt. Wrap their bodies up and put them in their graves.

dag: Amaa miriya! Bɛ ni ti gbahi ya tahi ʒiishɛhi, ka fiɛbi ya Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni, ka zaŋ ya tahi gomnanim mini nazuɣuri tooni n zuɣu, ka yi ti niŋ n shɛhiranim bɛ sani.
en: Be on your guard! You will be taken to courts and beaten with whips in their synagogues. And because of me, you will have to stand before rulers and kings to tell about your faith.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa garigi yɛli, O ʒim yihibu kpalimmi ʒi ti mini ti bihi zuɣu.
en: All the people replied, Let his blood be on us and on our children.

dag: Ka di yi kahigi wuhi bɛn ʒiya maa ni so ni o wuhi shɛli, yin chɛliya ka ŋun tuui tɔɣisirila fo;.
en: If someone sitting there receives a message from God, the speaker must stop and let the other person speak.

dag: Saha shɛli Izraɛlnim ni daa do Giligal bɔpiɛligu ni Jɛriko maa, ka bɛ daa puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu di goli maa biɛɣ pinaanahi dali zaawuni.
en: The Israelites celebrated Passover while they were camped at Gilgal on the plains of Jericho. This was on the evening of the th day of the month.

dag: Naawuni kul bela alizanda ni, ka lihiri ninsalinim dunia ŋɔ ni na ni o nya bɛ ni shɛb mali yɛm, ka nyɛ bɛn jɛmdi ŋun Naawuni.
en: From heaven God looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.

dag: Bahiyoli mini kum yɛliya, Ti tiba daa wum di ŋumaŋuma.
en: Death and destruction have merely heard rumors about where it is found.

dag: Baansi maa mi, Hɛman mini Asaf ni Ɛtan n-daa nyɛ bɛn ŋmɛri daanya guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisa la.
en: The singers Heman, Asaph, and Ethan were to make music with bronze cymbals.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n kul dol a zaligunim maa zaa. N je ʒiri soli kam.
en: And so I follow all your instructions; I hate all wrong ways.

dag: Di daba anu dali ka o daa ti daŋ yiɣisibu asibaasi ni o kuli, ka paɣ maa ba maa lan yɛl o, Niŋm suɣilo suug a noli, ka chɛ ka di bii na pɔi ka a naanyi chaŋ. Ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa laɣim ʒini di.
en: The fifth day, the man got up early to leave, but his wife's father said, You need to keep up your strength! Why don't you leave right after lunch? So the two of them started eating.

dag: Ka Farisiinim shɛb bɛn daa be nimaani wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa ka bɔh o, Ka daɣila ti gba nyɛla zoomba.
en: Some Pharisees who were with him heard what he said and asked, Surely we arent blind, are we.
