dag: Ka naa daa bɔhi, Nachimbil Absalom mal alaafee? Ka Ahimaaz daa garigi yɛl o, Jɔab ni di tim ma saha shɛli na maa, n di nya zama ni laɣim yo vuri, amaa n di bi baŋ di ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: Is the young man Absalom all right? the king asked. Ahimaaz answered, Sir, when your officer Joab sent me, I saw a great commotion, but I couldn't tell what it was.

dag: Gol maa biɛɣ pisinaanahi dali ka Izraɛlnim daa laɣimna ti lo noli, ka pili buri ka niŋ taŋkpaɣu puɣi bɛ zuɣuri.
en: Then on the th day of that same month, the Israelites gathered together for a day of fasting. They wore sackcloth and put ashes on their heads to show they were sad and upset.

dag: A nuu ni ka n zaŋ n shia niŋ; Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋun ʒe yim ŋɔ, nyini n-daa tiligi ma.
en: Lord , you are the God we can trust. I put my life in your hands. Save me!.

dag: So yi daa tum din tiri suhusaɣiŋgu, pa mani ka o ti suhusaɣiŋgu, ka m mi bi bɔri ni n tibigi li, dama nir yi lihi di puuni, di nyɛla yi zaa ka o ti suhusaɣiŋgu maa.
en: I don't want to be hard on you. But if one of you has made someone feel bad, I am not really the one who has been made to feel bad. Some of you are the ones.

dag: Bɛ zaŋla kurugu alikalimi sabi Judanim daalahichi, ka zaŋ daimɔnd chiriga n-chirigi li pa bɛ suhuri ni mini bɛ sara maligu bimbina binyila zuɣu.
en: The sins of Judah are written where they cannot be erased— cut into stone with an iron pen, cut deep with a hard tip into the stone that is the hearts of the people. Their sins are carved into the horns of their altars.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka a mini bɛn vari ma la va; ka chɛ ka a mini bɛn tuhiri ma la tuhi!.
en: Fight my enemies, Lord ! Attack my attackers!.

dag: Jɔtam ni daa ti faai siɣ o yaannim sani, bɛ daa sɔɣ o la Dauda tiŋ la ni. Ka o bia Ahaz daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Jotham lay down with his ancestors and was buried in Davids City. His son Ahaz succeeded him as king.

dag: Bɛn ka cheechi ni saria karibu yɛla bi kpa ma. Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun ni kari ba saria. Amaa bɛn be yi cheechi ni n-nyɛ yi ni kariti shɛb saria. Di nyɛla kaman di ni sab shɛm Naawuni Kundi ni la: Yihimiya ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋun be yi ni bahi.
en: After all, it is none of my business to judge outsiders. God will judge them. But should you not judge the members of your own fellowship? As the scripture says, Remove the evil person from your group.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun guli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lur o sizuura mini bɛn mali tahima zaŋ chaŋ o yurilim maŋli ŋɔ polo.
en: But look here: the LORDs eyes watch all who honor him, all who wait for his faithful love.

dag: Kaman ti ni daa pun wum shɛm, lala ka ti nini nya li. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ tiŋa din nyɛ ti Naawuni tiŋ la ni, ŋun Naawuni ni daa zali shɛli ni di beni sahakam la.
en: Just like we had heard, now weve seen it for ourselves in the city of the LORD of heavenly forces, in the city of our God. May God make it secure forever! Selah.

dag: Gol tuuli maa biɛɣ pinaanahi dali zaawuni, di simdi ka yi ŋubiri bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi hal ni goli maa biɛɣ pisiniyini dali zaawuni.
en: So on the evening of the th day of the first month, you will begin eating bread without yeast. You will eat this bread until the evening of the st day of the same month.

dag: ka yi zani Vuhim Dabisili dali neei biɛɣu maa n-kali hal ni biɛɣ pihinu, di nyaaŋa ka yi naanyi zaŋ chi mini kawaan pala na ti mali chi mini kawana sara ti Yawɛ.
en: Do this exactly days later, which is the day following the seventh Sabbath.

dag: Ka kpamba maa daa lan yɛli ba, Chɛliya ba, amaa ka bɛ lee kabiri dari ka ŋɔŋdi kom tiri Izraɛlnim zaa. Kpamba maa ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bala.
en: Let them live, but they will have to cut wood and carry water for us. This was what the leaders suggested.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan nam neesim kara ayi n-chɛ ka din galisi pam la ne wuntaŋ ni, ka chɛ ka din pa di zuɣu mi ne yuŋ; ka daa nam saŋmarisi gba.
en: God made two powerful lights, the brighter one to rule the day and the other to rule the night. He also made the stars.

dag: Ka Obadia bɔhi Ilaija, Tuumbiɛ bɔ ka n lee tum ka a bɔri ni a chɛ ka Ɛhab ku man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ?.
en: Obadiah said, If I tell Ahab that I know where you are, he will kill me! I have done nothing wrong to you. Why do you want me to die?.

dag: Bɛ suhuri daa bi ʒe yim zaŋ chaŋ o sani; ka bɛ mi daa bi dol o ni lo ba alikauli shɛl la soli.
en: Their hearts werent firmly set on him; they werent faithful to his covenant.

dag: A shihira chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni katinsi lur a la sizuura, a ni wuhiri shihira shɛŋa zuɣu. A chɛ ka biɛɣ neebu mini yuŋ zibbu yili suhupiɛlli yila.
en: The whole world stands in awe of the great things that you have done. Your deeds bring shouts of joy from one end of the earth to the other.

dag: Amaa duŋtaariba mini alahichinim zaa ni ti bahi yoli, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣisi Yawɛ mi ni ti kpi.
en: But those rebellious sinners who turn against me, the Lord , will all disappear.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A ni tɛhi ni a mali yɛm kaman wuni maa zuɣu.
en: You compared yourself to a god, so now I, the Lord God.

dag: Amaa zom a Naawuni, ka di zaŋ ninkuunsi gbib o.
en: You will not harshly rule over them but must fear your God.

dag: Bɛ gba daa zaŋla bɛ jaaŋgbɛhi bahi tiŋa, ka di leei waɣiri. Amaa ka Aduna jaaŋgbee maa daa zaŋ bɛ jaaŋgbɛhi maa vali.
en: They threw down their walking sticks, and the sticks turned into snakes. But Aaron's stick swallowed theirs.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb daalahichi yiri palo ka kpɛhiri ba saria karibu ni; amaa ka ninvuɣ shɛb mi daalahichi sɔɣiri ni di ti yi palo dahin shɛli ha.
en: The sins of some people are easy to see. Their sins show that they will be judged. But the sins of some others are seen only later.

dag: Ka maligumaana Yuria daa niŋ Naa Ahaz ni yɛli ni o niŋ shɛm maa zaa.
en: Uriah the priest did everything that King Ahaz commanded.

dag: ni bɛ ni nyɔri sara buɣim bimbin shɛli zuɣu la mini di nɛma zaa ni tahili la mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛli zuɣu la.
en: Also, pour the oil on the altar for burning offerings to God. Pour this oil on everything on that altar. Pour this oil on the bowl and on the base under the bowl.

dag: Ka n yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ Filistianim ŋɔ ni kana ti liri ma Giligal, ka n na bi suhi Yawɛ sɔŋsim; lala zuɣu ka m muɣisi mmaŋa m-mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maa.
en: and I was worried that they would attack me here at Gilgal. I hadn't offered a sacrifice to ask for the Lord 's help, so I forced myself to offer a sacrifice on the altar fire.

dag: Ka Gaal daa ti ŋmaligi guui, ka Abimilɛk kari dol o. Ka niriba pam daa nya dansi zaŋ lala hal ti paai tiŋ maa gooni dunoli shee.
en: Abimelech started after Gaal, and Gaal ran. Many were wounded, even at the city gate.

dag: Ka bipuɣimbil maa daa ti yɛli Naaman paɣa, N di bi zaɣisi ka n dana chaŋ anab so ŋun be Samaria ŋɔ sani! O naan tib o kɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: One day she said to her mistress, I wish that my master could go to the prophet who lives in Samaria! He would cure him of his disease.

dag: M bihi, chɛliya ka yi baɣa be yi tuma ni, dama Yawɛ m-pii ya ni yi zaan o tooni tumd o tuma, ka leeg o tumtumdiba m-maani sara tir o.
en: My sons, do not lose any time. You are the ones that the Lord has chosen to burn incense to him and to lead the people in worshiping him.

dag: ni Bɛtimaakabɔt ni Hazarisusim ni Bɛtibiri ni Shaaraim. Bɛ fɔntinsi ni daa nyɛ tiŋ shɛŋa m-bala hal ka Dauda ti naanyi di nam.
en: Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susim, Beth Biri, and Shaaraim. They lived in these towns until David became king.

dag: O ni daa ti nya ka Pita mini Jɔn yɛn kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni saha shɛli maa, ka o maani ba bara.
en: When he saw Peter and John going in, he begged them to give him something.

dag: O daa kurigiya zaa, ka mali azichi mini jilima, ka o dabisa daa ti pali, ka o naanyi kpi, ka o bia Sulemaana daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: He died at a good old age, having enjoyed a full life, wealth, and honor; and his son Solomon followed him as king.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka Musa daa ʒini ni o mali niriba yɛla, ka niriba maa daa ʒe n-gili Musa asiba hal ni zaawuni.
en: The next day Moses sat as a judge for the people, while the people stood around Moses from morning until evening.

dag: Molimiy o jilima yɛla zuliya kam sani, ka mol o ni tumd alahiziba tuun shɛŋa niriba zaa sunsuuni shɛm la gba yɛla.
en: Tell all the nations how wonderful he is! Tell people everywhere about the amazing things he does.

dag: N zaŋdi n yɛlimuɣisira n-yɛr o asiba mini wuntaŋ ni ni yuŋ zaa, ka ŋuhiri niŋd o, ka o mi ni wum n kuhigu maa.
en: Morning, noon, and night my complaints and groans go up to him, and he will hear my voice.

dag: nti yɛl o ni o tim o gbana ka o zaŋ chaŋ Damaskus Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o yi ti nya sokam ŋun doli soli ŋɔ, bɛ yi nyɛla dɔb bee paɣiba, ka o gbahi ba n-lo ba mihi tahi Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: and asked for letters of introduction to the synagogues in Damascus, so that if he should find there any followers of the Way of the Lord, he would be able to arrest them, both men and women, and bring them back to Jerusalem.

dag: Amaa ka Naomi yɛli ba, M bihi, labimiya kuli. Ka bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu ka yi bɔri ni yi doli ma kuli? Yi tɛhiya ni n ni lan tooi dɔɣi bidibisi yaha ka yi kuli ba?.
en: But she replied, My daughters, why don't you return home? What good will it do you to go with me? Do you think I could have more sons for you to marry?.

dag: O ni yi nyam, ka o ni sɔhira, o varila tiŋa. Bɛ yi ti piɛbi kikaa, o bi tooi zaani luɣ yini.
en: The horse gets very excited and races over the ground. When it hears the trumpet blow, it cannot stand still.

dag: ka gbaag o ansarisi malibu yɛra, Ti puhir a, nyin Yɛhudianim Naa.
en: Then they began to salute him: Long live the King of the Jews.

dag: Bɛ to tɛte di m binyɛrigu, ka piri n situra ti taba.
en: They divide my clothes among themselves, and they throw lots for what I am wearing.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi maa ku bɛ mini Itiɔpianima ni Putinima ni Ludinima ni Areebianim zaa ni Libianima ni tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa din niriba zaŋ bɛ noli ti naai ba.
en: Many people made peace agreements with Egypt. But all those people from Ethiopia, Put, Lud, all Arabia, Libya, and the people of Israel will be destroyed!.

dag: Aai Dama di yi nyɛ lala, wula ka Naawuni ni tooi kari dunianim saria?.
en: By no means! If God is not just, how can he judge the world?.

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Musa zuɣu ka o yɛl o, Pa a mabia n-nyɛ Aduna ŋun nyɛ Lɛvi nir la? M mi ni o nyɛla ŋun ni tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa viɛnyɛliŋga. Nyama, o nyɛla ŋun yɛn yina ti tuh a soli, ka o yi ti nya a, o suhu ni paligi pam.
en: Then the Lord became angry with Moses and said, All right! Ill give you someone to help you. Aaron the Levite is your brother, isnt he? He is a good speaker. In fact, Aaron is already coming to meet you, and he will be happy to see you.

dag: N suhuyiɣisili pam puuni n ni ti bɔhi zuliya shɛb bɛn bi deei n noli biɛri.
en: I will exact vengeance in anger and in wrath on the nations that dont obey!.

dag: Amaa ka Ibram daa yɛli Zarai Nyama, o nyɛla a dabili, ka a su o fukumsi; niŋm o a ni yu shɛm. Ka Zarai daa yihi Haga halibiɛɣu ka o zo.
en: Abram said to Sarai, Since shes your servant, do whatever you wish to her. So Sarai treated her harshly, and she ran away from Sarai.

dag: ti bɔh o, Karimba, Anabi Musa daa sab zali ni so biɛli yi kpuɣi paɣa ka na bi zaŋ o dɔɣi bihi ka kpi ka chɛ o, o tizo ŋun kpuɣim o pakoli maa n-dɔɣi bihi ti o biɛli maa.
en: Teacher, Moses wrote that if a married man dies and had no children, his brother must marry his widow. Then they will have children for the dead brother.

dag: Dan zuliya n-daa pah ayopɔin n-nyɛ bɛ ni ti shɛb tiŋgbani kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The seventh assignment made was for the families of the tribe of Dan.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ Naawuni ŋun be, ka nyɛ ŋun zaŋ ma ʒili m ba Dauda nam ʒiishee, ka me yili ti ma kaman o ni daa lo ma alikauli shɛm la zuɣu, n ni chɛ ka bɛ ku Adɔnija zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: The Lord has firmly established me on the throne of my father David; he has kept his promise and given the kingdom to me and my descendants. I swear by the living Lord that Adonijah will die this very day.

dag: Shi yino maa n-lan tiri so yɛda niŋbu pini, ka tiri so dɔriti tibbu pina;.
en: The same Spirit gives faith to one person and to another he gives gifts of healing.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka so daa bi lan buɣisi ni o bɔh o bɔhigu yaha.
en: From then on, no one dared to ask Jesus any questions.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa yɛli Izraɛlnima, Yi bihi yi ti bɔhi bɛ banim dahin shɛli ha, Ka kuɣ bɔnima n-lee bɔŋɔ.
en: Then Joshua told the people: Years from now your children will ask you why these rocks are here.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli, Ti ni niŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa. Ti ni labisi bɛ binshɛɣukam ti ba, ka ku lan bɔhi ba shɛli yɛla. Ka n daa boli maligumaaniba na nti chɛ ka bɛ po pɔri ni bɛ ni niŋ bɛ ni lo alikauli ni bɛ ni niŋ shɛm maa.
en: The leaders replied, We'll do as you say. We'll give the property back and not try to collect the debts. I called in the priests and made the leaders swear in front of them to keep the promise they had just made.

dag: Nyin ŋun mali Naawuni fukumsi zaligu nyuri bara, a nyɛla ŋun saɣindi Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa n-dihiri ŋun Naawuni vi?.
en: You are so proud that you have Gods law, but you bring shame to God by breaking his law.

dag: Ka paɣ maa dɔɣibu saha daa ti paai ka jahi m-be o puli ni.
en: When the time came for her to give birth, it was discovered that she was going to have twins.

dag: Aai Dama di yi nyɛ lala, wula ka Naawuni ni tooi kari dunianim saria?.
en: Absolutely not! If God werent just, how could he judge the world?.

dag: Ka o daa lan lu Dauda sizuura ka yɛli, Ka mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ mi lee nyɛ ŋuni, ka a ti lihi nya mani ŋun nyɛ ba kpiŋ ŋɔ lala.
en: Mephibosheth bowed low out of respect and said, Who am I, your servant, that you should care about a dead dog like me.

dag: Naawuni timiya yaa mini kpiɔŋ din yir o yiko din galisi pam ka mali jilima la ni na, ka di chɛ ka yi tooi niŋ ania ka mali suɣilo suhupiɛlli puuni.
en: that God will strengthen you with his own great power so that you will be patient and not give up when troubles come. Then you will be happy.

dag: N kul paɣiri Naawuni sahakam yi zuɣu, o ni niŋ alibarika shɛli niŋ yi ni Yisa Masia zuɣu la zuɣu.
en: I always thank my God for you because of the grace that he has given you through Christ Jesus.

dag: A suhu yi ye bindirigu maa dibu zuɣu, nyin gbaam amaŋa.
en: Never eat too much, even if you are very hungry.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ ni zo Rɛzin mini Pɛka dabiɛm ka zaɣisi Shilɔa kulibɔŋ kom din doya baalim la zuɣu.
en: Since this people has rejected the waters of Shiloah that flow gently, and instead rejoices over Rezin and Remaliahs son.

dag: Din daa lu sol zuɣu la ŋmanila bɛn wum Naawuni yɛligu maa, ka Sintani kana nti yihi li bɛ suhuri ni ka bɛ ku niŋ li yɛda n-tiligi.
en: The seed on the path are those who hear, but then the devil comes and steals the word from their hearts so that they wont believe and be saved.

dag: ni Makɛda naa ni Bɛtɛl naa.
en: the king of Makkedah one.

dag: Naawuni, labisim ti a sanna, Zom ti nambɔɣu, ka lala chɛ ka ti tiligi!.
en: Bring us back, O God! Show us your mercy, and we will be saved!.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, pa Yawɛ milinsi ni ka n kana ni n ti saɣim tiŋgbani ŋɔ? Yawɛ n-yɛli ma, Cham ti saɣim tiŋgbani maa. .
en: Now, do you think I came to this country to destroy it without the Lord s help. No, it was the Lord who said to me, Go up against this country and destroy it.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka jɛra gbibi liɣiri ni bɛ da yɛm, ka lee nyɛ bɛn ka yɛm din ni tooi bɔhim?.
en: Why should a fool have money to pay for wisdom? He has no mind.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yiɣisi Kalidianim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni n-looi Haran tiŋgbɔŋ ni; ka ŋun ti yab Ibrahimma ba daa ti kpi, ka Naawuni lan zaŋ o nimaani tahi yi ni be tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ na.
en: Then Abraham left the land of the Chaldeans and settled in Haran. After his father died, Abraham came and settled in this land where you now live.

dag: Dinzuɣu suhimiya Naawuni ka o chɛ ka yɛla ŋɔ ti ku niŋ tu kikaa saha bee Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: And pray that you won't have to escape in winter or on a Sabbath.

dag: Di saha maa ka Baladan bia Mɛrɔdakibaladan ŋun daa nyɛ Babilɔn naa la daa wum ni Hɛzɛkia biɛra, ka sabi gbaŋ m-bo pini pahi di zuɣu tim tuumba ni bɛ zaŋ ti ti Hɛzɛkia.
en: At that time Merodach Baladan son of Baladan was king of Babylon. He sent letters and a gift to Hezekiah when he heard that Hezekiah had been sick.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka yi lɔri Yawɛ nia biɛɣu? O ni chɛ ka di zani tariga; o dim ku tooi mo o buyi.
en: What are you plotting against the LORD? He is one who can annihilate! Distress will not arise twice.

dag: Anab so daa bi lan yiɣisi Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni ŋ-ŋmani Musa, ka Yawɛ min o nini daa nya taba.
en: There has never again been a prophet in Israel like Moses. The Lord spoke face to face with him.

dag: Ka a saa tahibu be pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga ni, ka a saa nyaɣisibu neei dunia ŋɔ ni zaa, ka dunia sɔhiri ka damda.
en: The crash of your thunder rolled out, and flashes of lightning lit up the world; the earth trembled and shook.

dag: Goli so ŋun daŋ tooni biɛɣu pia dali ka Izraɛlnim daa du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli n-chaŋ ti dɔni Giligal din daa be Jɛriko wulimpuhili polo la.
en: It was the tenth day of the first month of the year when Israel crossed the Jordan River. They set up camp at Gilgal, which was east of the land controlled by Jericho.

dag: Nandaamba mini faranima ni ti lan nya suhupiɛl shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ ni tiri la.
en: Poor and humble people will once again find the happiness which the Lord , the holy God of Israel, gives.

dag: Ti mi ni zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yuri Naawuni ka nyɛ o ni daŋ pii shɛb o nia lɔbu ni la sani, ŋun Naawuni chɛ ka binshɛɣukam niŋdila bɛ zaɣ viɛlli nyabu zuɣu.
en: We know that God is always at work for the good of everyone who loves him. They are the ones God has chosen for his purpose.

dag: Di daa nyɛla kuɣa pinaayi, ka bɛ daa zaŋ chiriga n-chirigi Izraɛl bidibisi la yinoyino yuli pa kuɣili kam zuɣu, di daa ŋmanila nintu shɛŋa bɛ ni mali dihiri binyɛra zuɣu la, ka zuliya pinaayi la zuliya yini kam yuli pa kuɣili kam zuɣu.
en: There were twelve stones with names corresponding to the names of Israels sons. They were engraved like official seals, each with its name for the twelve tribes.

dag: Musa daa bɔhi ba mi, Yi chɛla paɣiba ŋɔ zaa ka bi ku ba?.
en: He asked them, Why have you kept all the women alive?.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛl o, A yi doli ma, a yɛla ni ti muɣisi ma.
en: David said to him, If you come with me, you will be a burden to me.

dag: Mani ŋun nyɛ a dabipaɣ ŋɔ daa malila bidibis ayi, ka bɛ daa ti chaŋ puu ni ti zabi, ka so kani ŋun ni goo ba, ka yino daa ŋme n-ku ŋun la.
en: Sir, I had two sons, and one day they got into a quarrel out in the fields, where there was no one to separate them, and one of them killed the other.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka a bɔhira, Bɔ ka Naawuni lee mi? O ni tooi kari saria zibisim titali puuni?.
en: But you might say, What does God know? Can he see through the dark clouds to judge us?.

dag: Ka Naa Uzia daa ti kani, ka bɛ zaŋ o sɔɣi pah o yaannim zuɣu Dauda tiŋ la ni, ka o bia Jɔtam daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Azariah died and was buried with his ancestors in the City of David. Azariahs son Jotham became the new king after him.

dag: nyin wummi bɛ suhigu mini bɛ fabila a biɛhigu shee alizanda ni ka niŋ bɛ ni suh a bɔri shɛli maa ti ba, ka chɛ a niriba bɛn tum birig a maa taali.
en: Please listen from your home in heaven. Accept their prayers when they beg for help, and help them. Forgive your people who have sinned against you.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛhu daa laɣim sokam zaa na nti yɛli ba, Ɛhab daa jɛm Baal la biɛla, amaa man yɛn jɛm o la pam.
en: Then Jehu gathered all the people, saying to them, Ahab served Baal a little. Jehu will serve him a great deal!.

dag: Yinim pukpariba mini wain tihi kpariba, maliya nandahima. Kummiya alikama mini chi zuɣu. Dama puri atam saɣimiya.
en: Be sad, farmers! Cry loudly for the grapes, for the wheat, and for the barley, because the harvest in the field is ruined.

dag: Ka luɣa ni duri maa dunoya daa yoori bahiri pal shɛli din daa kpalim polo. Duno yini daa kpala nuzaa polo, ka duno din la mi kpa nudirigu polo. Ka pal shɛli din daa guui yɛliŋ daa nyɛ mita ayi ni pirigili.
en: There were two entrances from the side chambers to the free space, one facing north, the other facing south. And the width of the place that was left free was seven and a half feet all the way around.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ bɔhimi duŋtaariba maa, Yi bi mi dimbɔŋɔnim maa gbinni? Yɛlim ba, Babilɔn naa n-daa ka Jɛrusalɛm na nti gbaai di naa mini di kpambaliba n-zaŋ ba kuli Babilɔn.
en: Say now to the rebellious household: Dont you know what these things mean? Say: The king of Babylon came to Jerusalem and carried its king and its officers away with him to Babylon.

dag: Ka Finɛhas ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛliɛza bia la daa leei bɛ zuɣulan saha shɛli ha, ka Yawɛ daa be o sani.
en: Phinehas son of Eleazar had supervised their work because the Lord was with him.

dag: Binshɛɣukam din niŋ ti maa zuɣu ka ti lɔri alikauli ŋɔ, ka sabi li sɔŋ, ka ti zuɣulaannim mini ti Lɛvinim ni ti maligumaaniba yuya sabi pa bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa tabili alikauli gbaŋ maa zuɣu.
en: Because of all these things, we are making an agreement that cannot be changed. We are putting this agreement in writing. Our leaders, Levites, and priests are signing their names to this agreement and sealing it with a seal.

dag: Bɛn mali ba bemi kaman bɛ ni be shɛm. Lala n-nyɛ bɛnkam zaa niŋ wuna maa naani.
en: May all who made them and who trust in them become like the idols they have made.

dag: Dɛlaiya daŋ niriba mini Tɔbaya daŋ niriba ni Nɛkɔda daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu ni pihinahinaayi.
en: the descendants of Delaiah, Tobiah, and Nekoda, .

dag: N ni chɛ ka o dimnim di vi, amaa ka chɛ ka o nam mali jilima.
en: and wear a sparkling crown. But I will disgrace their enemies.

dag: Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, N ka yidana. Ka Yisa yɛl o, A ni yɛli ni a ka yidan maa di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli;.
en: I don't have a husband, she answered. Jesus replied, You are right when you say you don't have a husband.

dag: Ka bɛ chɛchɛbunsi zɔri yiriŋ doli solɔri, ka kabiri kpɛri niriba ni laɣindi luɣ shɛŋa n-chani tooni ka labiri nyaaŋa. Bɛ bemi kaman buɣim mokpala la, ka bɛ labiri kpana kaman saa nyaɣisibu la.
en: Chariots dash wildly through the streets, rushing back and forth in the city squares. They flash like torches and dart about like lightning.

dag: yin di chɛ ka o gbe tia maa zuɣu, amaa yin sɔɣimiy o dindali maa, dama bɛ ni yili ninvuɣ so mia nyɛla Naawuni noli ni di so, di bi simdi ni yi ta Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya ni yi su maa daɣiri.
en: it is not to remain there overnight. It must be buried the same day, because a dead body hanging on a post brings God's curse on the land. Bury the body, so that you will not defile the land that the Lord your God is giving you.

dag: Ka tuun biɛri ni ti yɛn zooi zuɣu ni chɛ ka niriba pam yurilim filim.
en: Evil will spread and cause many people to stop loving others.

dag: Di saha maa Masia cheechinim din be Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni nim daa na ʒi ma ni bɛ nini.
en: At that time the members of the churches in Judea did not know me personally.

dag: Anab maa daa lan tɔɣisi shihirili shɛli yɛla dindali maa yɛli, Yawɛ ni yɛli shihirili shɛli yɛla m-bɔŋɔ: Nyama, bimbini ŋɔ, a ni ti wurim, ka tampiligim din pa a zuɣu kpaai bahi.
en: At that time the man of God gave a sign: This is the sign that the LORD mentioned: Look! The altar will be broken apart, and its ashes will spill out.

dag: Puhimiya dakulɔdakulo churi mini ka daŋda chɛbu chuɣu ni wuuni atam kpuɣibu chuɣu.
en: Celebrate the Festival of Harvest. Use the first grain from the wheat harvest for this festival. And in the fall celebrate the Festival of Shelters.

dag: Niriba pam ni ti bɔhi ma zaadali, Ti Duuma, ti Duuma, ti daa bi malila a yuli yihiri waazu, ka mal a yuli kariti alizin biɛri, ka mal a yuli tumd alahiziba tuma.
en: On the Judgment Day, many people will say to me, Lord, Lord, didnt we prophesy in your name and expel demons in your name and do lots of miracles in your name.

dag: Bɛ daa lan niŋ o yiko ni o lo tɔbu tuhi Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda nyaŋ ba. Ka lan niŋ o yiko ni o su dɔɣim kam mini niriba balibu kam ni tinzun yɛligu kam nima.
en: It was allowed to fight against God's people and to defeat them, and it was given authority over every tribe, nation, language, and race.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tahiri woligibu na, ka nyɛ bɛn maŋmaŋ nama biɛhigu yubu su ba, ka Naawuni Shia ka bɛ ni.
en: These are the people who cause divisions, who are controlled by their natural desires, who do not have the Spirit.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ puuni o ni chɛ ka yi suhuri ba n-zani ka yi be tibi, ka be kasi ti Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Ba la sani, saha shɛli ti Duuma Yisa min o ninvuɣ gahinda yi ti labina.
en: May the love cause your hearts to be strengthened, to be blameless in holiness before our God and Father when our Lord Jesus comes with all his people. Amen.

dag: Bɛ yi zaŋ nɛ karili lo n-yili dilan nyiŋgoli n-zaŋ o bahi teeku ni, di naan so o zuɣu gar o chɛ ka bibihi ŋɔ ni yino birigi.
en: It would be better for him if a large millstone were tied around his neck and he were thrown into the sea than for him to cause one of these little ones to sin.

dag: O daa lan yɛli, N yi bi chɛ ka Naawuni ni daa lo Dauda alikauli yɛli.
en: The Lord promised David that he would take the kingdom away from Saul and his descendants and would make David king of both Israel and Judah, from one end of the country to the other. Now may God strike me dead if I don't make this come true.

dag: Ka o bɔh o, O biɛhigu lee nyɛla wula? Ka o yɛl o, Do kurili n-zaŋ kparibu pɔb omaŋa n-yirina. Di saha ka Sool daa baŋ ni Samuɛl m-bala, ka damdi zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋa n-lu o sizuura.
en: What does it look like? he asked. It's an old man coming up, she answered. He is wearing a cloak. Then Saul knew that it was Samuel, and he bowed to the ground in respect.

dag: Amaa ka n daa kul timdi n daba bɛn zaa nyɛ anabinim la yi sanna ti yɛri ya, Jaande, miriya ka yi tum din chihiri shɛli n ni je.
en: I kept sending you my servants the prophets, who told you not to do this terrible thing that I hate.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la ni Naawuni yɛliya: Di ku lan yuui ka ŋun yɛn kana maa ku kpalim, ka shiri kana.
en: In a little while longer, the one who is coming will come and wont delay; .

dag: Nuzaa polo mini nudirigu polo pɔhim, yiɣisimiyana! Ʒiɛmiya kpe m puu maa ni, ka di tulaale nyom gili luɣ shɛlikam zaa. Chɛ ka n yura ka o puu maa ni na nti di di tiwal suma.
en: Stir, north wind, and come, south wind! Blow upon my garden; let its perfumes flow! Let my love come to his garden; let him eat its luscious fruit!.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni me wuni bee n-kpe binnani zali ka di pa din mal o buchi?.
en: Who made these false gods? Who covered these useless statues?.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lan zaŋ ma chaŋ nuzaa polo dunɔdali ni nti buɣisi li. Ka di mini dina la zaa nyɛ yim.
en: Then the man led me to the north gate. He measured it, and it measured the same as the other gates.

dag: Dinzuɣu Pumpɔŋɔ Izraɛlnima, bɔ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ lee bɔri yi sani? Lumiyala ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sizuura, ka dol o soya zaa ka yur o ka jɛmdi ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yi suhuri zaa ni yi shihi zaa.
en: Now in light of all that, Israel, what does the LORD your God ask of you? Only this: to revere the LORD your God by walking in all his ways, by loving him, by serving the LORD your God with all your heart and being.

dag: Jɛkɔnia so bɛ ni daa kpɛhi duu la bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Shialtiɛl mini.
en: This is a list of Jehoiachins children after Jehoiachin became a prisoner in Babylon: His children were Shealtiel.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa chaŋ ti teei dɔni bia maa zuɣu n-zaŋ o noli min o nina kpa bia maa noli ni o nina, ka zaŋ o nuhi pa o nuhi zuɣu; ka teeg omaŋ dolisi bia maa, ka o niŋgbuna piligi biibu.
en: Elisha went to the bed and lay on the child. He put his eyes on the childs eyes, his mouth on the childs mouth, and his hands on the childs hands. He lay there on top of the child until the childs body became warm.

dag: Inok ni daa dɔɣi Mɛtusɛla maa nyaaŋa, o daa jɛmdi Naawuni viɛnyɛliŋga hal ti paai yuun kɔbisita. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: and during the next years he had more children. Enoch truly loved God.

dag: Di yi nyɛla dilan zaŋla nahu na ni o ti mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la, ŋun zaŋmi naɣilaa ŋun ka daŋa m-mali Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni din ni chɛ ka Yawɛ deeg o.
en: If you offer one of your cattle as a burnt offering, it must be a bull that has nothing wrong with it. You must take the animal to the entrance of the Meeting Tent where the Lord will accept the offering.

dag: Amaa yi zaa yi tɔɣisirila anabitali yɛtɔɣa, ka ŋun bi niŋ yɛda bee ŋun ka yi kalinli ni kpɛna, yi zaa ni yɛri shɛm maa ni chih o suhu, ka yi zaa ni yɛri shɛm maa ni lan vih o.
en: But suppose all of you are prophesying when those unbelievers and outsiders come in. They will realize that they are sinners, and they will want to change their ways because of what you are saying.

dag: Bɛ niriba anahi ŋɔ daa nyɛla bɛn yi Gaat tiyaawumyanim la zuliya ni na. Ka Dauda min o tɔbbihi maa daa ku bɛ zaa.
en: David and his soldiers killed these four men who were descendants of the Rephaim from Gath.

dag: Man Naa Atazɛrikisɛs zali laɣiguliba zaa bɛn be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili wulinluhili polo yaɣili la zaligu ni bɛ tim nyin Ɛzra ŋun nyɛ maligumaana ni Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ zaligubaŋda la a ni kul bɔri shɛlikam bɛ sani kaliŋkaliŋ.
en: Ezra, you are a priest and an expert in the laws of the God of heaven, and I order all treasurers in Western Province to do their very best to help you.

dag: nyin wummi bɛ fabila a biɛhigu shee alizanda ni ka chɛ bɛ taali, ka niŋ kaman a ni mi ka sokam biɛhigu nyɛ shɛm o suhu ni ti o.
en: hear their prayer. Listen to them in your home in heaven and forgive them. You alone know the thoughts of the human heart. Deal with each of us as we deserve.

dag: Di saha maa ka Abimilɛk min o sapashin kpɛm Fikol daa yɛli Ibrahimma, Naawuni be a sani a ni niŋdi shɛlikam ni.
en: Then Abimelech and Phicol spoke with Abraham. Phicol was the commander of Abimelechs army. They said to Abraham, God is with you in everything you do.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi ku tooi niŋ yɛda ni Naawuni neeri kpiimba?.
en: Why do you who are here find it impossible to believe that God raises the dead?.

dag: Nir yi kpe yɔɣu ka chɛ o yiŋa, di ŋmanila noombila n-kpe yɔɣu ka chɛ o tiɛɣu.
en: Like a bird wandering from its nest, so is one who wanders from home.

dag: Naa, mani Aruna zaŋ dimbɔŋɔ zaa ti a. Ka Aruna daa lan yɛli naa, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni deeg a suhigu maa.
en: Take them—they're yours! I hope the Lord your God will be pleased with you.

dag: ka taɣ o niɣi min o biŋkɔbbaligu shɛb zaa bɛn daa nyɛ o nyɔri m-pah o ni daa zali naɣ shɛb Mɛsopoteemia la zuɣu n-lu soli kuni Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni o ba Yisahaku sani.
en: Then they began traveling back to the land of Canaan, where his father lived. All the flocks of animals that Jacob owned walked ahead of them. He carried everything with him that he had gotten while he lived in Paddan Aram.

dag: Yinim wuntizɔriba, maliya suhupiɛlli Yawɛ sani, ka paɣ o yuli din be kasi ŋɔ!.
en: Good people, be happy in the Lord ! Praise his holy name!.

dag: ka o bia Ishimail mi daa nyɛ yuun pinaata bia saha shɛl o ni daa guni.
en: And Ishmael, his son, was years old when he was circumcised.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yaakubu daa gbaai Reechɛl kpariŋ mɔɣisi ka kum suhupiɛlli kuhigu pam.
en: Then Jacob kissed Rachel and cried.

dag: A gbilisi tibili wum Naawuni yɛm yɛtɔɣa? Ka a tɛhiya ni a kɔŋko m-mali yɛm?.
en: Have you ever been present when God's council meets? Do you alone have wisdom?.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daa pii ma zali hal ka bɛ na bi dɔɣi ma, ka boli ma o daalibarika zuɣu.
en: But even before I was born, God had chosen me by his gift of undeserved grace and had decided.

dag: Amaa yi yɛra, Ti Duuma ni niŋdi shɛm bi tuhi. Yinim Izraɛlnima, n ni kari yi zaa saria n-doli yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: But the Israelites still think I am unfair. So warn them that they will be punished for what they have done.

dag: Jɛsi bidib kpamba ata daa dolila Sool chaŋ tɔb maa ni; o bidibis ata bɛn daa doli chaŋ tɔb maa ni yuya n-daa booni Ɛliab, ŋun daa nyɛ o bidib kpɛm la, ka ŋun daa pa o zuɣu yuli booni Abinadab, ka ŋun pah ata mi yuli booni Shamma.
en: Jesses three oldest sons had gone with Saul to war. Their names were Eliab the oldest, Abinadab the second oldest, and Shammah the third oldest.

dag: Ka o daa lan niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol o yuli Juda ka yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ dina n ni paɣi Yawɛ. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa chɛ dɔɣibu.
en: She had one more son and named him Judah, because she said, I'll praise the Lord .

dag: O mi o tuma ni nyɛ shɛli, dama Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun wuh o.
en: They are properly ordered; their God directs them.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia daa bɔhi maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim maa bɔhigu zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni zaŋ binyar shɛŋa sɔŋ gbilligbilli maa polo.
en: Then Hezekiah asked the priests and the Levites about the piles of things.

dag: Bɛ daa lan malila ninsal nuhi bɛ kpiŋkpama maa lɔŋni bɛ luɣa anahinahi zuɣu. Bɛba anahi maa ninani mini bɛ kpiŋkpama maa ni daa be shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Under their wings were human arms. There were four living beings. Each living being had four faces and four wings.

dag: Di saha Naa Dauda daa bela zoli zuɣu birini puuni, ka Filistia tɔbbihi mi do Bɛtilihɛm.
en: and had taken over Bethlehem. David was in his fortress.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa ti wum ka Filip yihi Naawuni nam mini Yisa Masia yuli waazu maa ka bɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba daa niŋ yɛda ka deei kom baptaizibu.
en: After they came to believe Philip, who preached the good news about Gods kingdom and the name of Jesus Christ, both men and women were baptized.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o dɔɣi bidibiga ka yɛli, Sana n-nyɛ ma tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni. Dinzuɣu ka o daa boli bia maa yuli Gɛrishom.
en: Zipporah became pregnant and had a son. Moses named him Gershom because Moses was a stranger in a land that was not his own.

dag: Ka o daa mal litaafi bil shɛli ka di kpabigi be o nuu ni, ka o zaŋ o nudirigu napɔŋ zali teeku ni, ka zaŋ o nuzaa napɔŋ mi zali duli.
en: The angel was holding a small scroll. The scroll was open in his hand. He put his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.

dag: Ka Jɛrɔbɔam daŋ ni ŋunkam kpi yiŋa, bahi ni ŋub o; ka ŋunkam mi kpi mɔɣu ni, juri ni di o. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Dogs will eat any of Jeroboams family who die in town. Birds will eat those who die in the field. The LORD has spoken!.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ŋmaligi yɛli ba, N yɛri ya mi ni farigudeera maa daa yi n-kuli ka yi taali ni gari ŋun la; dinzuɣu ŋunkam tibigir omaŋ ni nya filiŋ; ka ŋunkam mi siɣisir omaŋ ni nya tibiginsim.
en: I tell you, this person went down to his home justified rather than the Pharisee. All who lift themselves up will be brought low, and those who make themselves low will be lifted up.

dag: Rɛhɔbɔam nam maa ni daa nya zaa zani ka niŋ yaa, di daa bi yuui ka o mini Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn daa be o sani maa zaɣisi Yawɛ zaligu.
en: Rehoboam became a strong king and made his kingdom strong. Then Rehoboam and the whole tribe of Judah refused to obey the law of the Lord .

dag: Ka yi yi mali sara, di simdi ka yi ŋub li dindali maa bee dindali cheei biɛɣu, ka di shɛli yi guui zani hal ni daba ata dali, yin zaŋmiya li nyo buɣim.
en: You may eat the meat either on the day of the sacrifice or on the next day, but you must burn anything left over on the third day.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni yi o biɛhigu shee alizanda ni kana ti darigi dunianim tibili bɛ tuumbiɛri zuɣu. Bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb ashilɔni zaa yɛla ni ti yi palo, ka tiŋgbani ti ku lan sɔɣi bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb maa.
en: The Lord will come out to punish everyone on earth for their sins. And when he does, those who did violent crimes will be known and punished.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma doli nuzaa polo dunɔdal la n-chaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa tooni, ka n ti lihi n-nya ka Yawɛ jilima m-pal o jɛmbu duu maa ni. Ka n daa lu n-zaŋ n nini kpa tiŋa.
en: Then the man led me through the north gate to the front of the Temple. I looked and saw the Glory of the Lord filling the Lord s Temple. I bowed with my face touching the ground.

dag: Yawɛ chɛ ka o ni yɛn ti a bi shɛba, ka paɣisarili ŋɔ dɔɣi ba ti a ni nyɛla bɛn ni ti chɛ ka a zuliya bemi kaman Pɛrɛz, Tama ni dɔɣ so ti Juda la.
en: And may your household be like the household of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah—through the children that the LORD will give you from this young woman.

dag: Ka Zɛdɛkia ŋun daa nyɛ Chɛnaana bia la daa zaŋ kuriti kuri binyila kɔtomsi ka yɛli, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Dimbɔŋɔ ka yi yɛn zaŋ ʒe n-ku Sirianim maa zaa. .
en: One of the prophets was named Zedekiah son of Kenaanah. Zedekiah made some iron horns and said to Ahab, The Lord says, You will use these iron horns to fight against the army of Aram. You will defeat them and destroy them.

dag: Amaa ka Samaria do so gba daa ti doli soli maa na nti paai nimaani nya o, ka di niŋ o nambɔɣu pam;.
en: But a Samaritan who was traveling that way came upon the man, and when he saw him, his heart was filled with pity.

dag: Kɔhat daŋ niriba maa tuma Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni daa nyɛla bɛ lihiri binshɛŋa din be kasi pam la.
en: Their job is to take care of the most holy things in the Meeting Tent.

dag: Ka o daa leei ŋun be naa sani gbib o. Paɣisarili maa daa viɛli pam; amaa naa daa bi baŋ o ni paɣitali.
en: She was very beautiful, and waited on the king and took care of him, but he did not have intercourse with her.

dag: Bipola kpiɔŋ n-nyɛ bɛ jilima, amaa ninkura mi zab piɛla n-nyɛ bɛ jilima.
en: Strength is the glory of young men; gray hair is the splendor of old age.

dag: Yawɛ daa lo ba la alikauli n-yɛli ba, Miriya ka yi jɛm buɣa bee n-damdi di tooni bee n-jɛm li bee m-mal li.
en: At the time when the Lord had made his solemn agreement with the people of Israel, he told them: Do not worship any other gods! Do not bow down to them or offer them a sacrifice.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli, Alizanda nam ŋmanila dabin shɛli paɣ ni yi zahim bɔrɔbɔro zim ŋmani buta n-zaŋ li gari di ni ŋɔri zali, ka di zaa ti mii m-piri la.
en: He told them another parable: The kingdom of heaven is like yeast, which a woman took and hid in a bushel of wheat flour until the yeast had worked its way through all the dough.

dag: Miri ka a zaŋ a zo bee a ba zo bahi, ka miri ka a ti chaŋ a dɔɣira yiŋa a muɣisigu saha. A ʒiʒiinikpee ŋun be yoma so a mabihi bɛn be katiŋa.
en: Do not forget your friends or your father's friends. If you are in trouble, don't ask a relative for help; a nearby neighbor can help you more than relatives who are far away.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka sapashinnim maa mini bɛ tɔbbihi ni niriba bɛn zaa nyɛ tarimba ni wɔɣira daa yiɣisi kuli Ijipti, dama bɛ daa zɔrila Babilɔnnima.
en: Then the army officers and all the people ran away to Egypt. Everyone, from the least important to the most important, ran away because they were afraid of the Babylonians.

dag: O daa gindila Bɛtɛl mini Giligal ni Mizipa yuuni kam nti maani Izraɛlnim yɛla nimaani zaa.
en: Every year he would go around to Bethel, Gilgal, and Mizpah, and in these places he would settle disputes.

dag: N Duuma, n nyɛla faralana ni nandana; amaa a bi tam n yɛla. N Naawuni, nyini n-nyɛ n sɔŋsim ni n tiligira. Niŋm yomyom sɔŋ ma!.
en: I am poor and needy, but, Lord God, you care about me, and you come to my rescue. Please hurry and help.

dag: Ka Leeban daa yɛli, Lala viɛla. Ti ni niŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Laban answered, Agreed. We will do as you suggest.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pii tiŋ shɛŋa din yuya dolina ŋɔ Juda mini Simiɔn zuliya niriba tiŋgbana ni ti.
en: They gave the following cities, identified here by name, from the tribe of the Judahites and the tribe of the Simeonites.

dag: Di saha ka n kuhi yɛli, N Duuma NAAWUNI, n suhir a, dim suɣilo. Yaakubu ku be. O pɔri pam.
en: Then I said, LORD God, I beg you, stop! How can Jacob survive? He is so small.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa ti bɔhi Izraɛl naa, M min a yɛla bi kpa. Cham a ba min a ma daanabinim la sani. Amaa ka Izraɛl naa maa yɛl o, Aai, Yawɛ n-zaŋ ti nanima ata ŋɔ na ni o ti niŋ Mɔabnim nuu ni.
en: Elisha said to Israels king, What do we have to do with each other? Go to your fathers or mothers prophets. Then Israels king said to him, Dont say that, because it is the LORD who has brought us three kings together—but only to hand us over to Moab.

dag: dama Yawɛ yɛli ma, Miri ka a di bindirigu bee n-nyu kom nimaani bee n doli so shɛli a ni di doli kana labi. .
en: The Lord commanded me not to eat or drink anything here. He also commanded me not to go back the same way I came.

dag: Di simdi ni yi bo kulagaa niŋ yi nɛma ni, ka yi yi ti yi kpaŋa ni yi ti damdi yɔɣuni, ka yi zaŋ li gbi bɔɣili pi yi bindi maa.
en: Among your weapons, you must also carry a stick to dig with. Then, when you relieve yourself, you must dig a hole and cover it up.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ, Zaŋmiya yi ni gbahi yi mabi shɛb daba ŋɔ na labisi, dama Yawɛ suhu yiɣisiya pam bahi yi zuɣu. .
en: Listen to me! Send back the captives you took from your relatives, because the LORD is furious with you.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ yi zɔnim zaa yɔhim ya. Bɛ kari ya tahi yi tiŋgbɔŋ tariga. Yi mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yi ka taali nyaŋ ya. Yi mini yi zɔnim bɛn laɣindi timdi diri bari ya zana, ka yi ku tooi baŋ li.
en: All those who are your friends will force you out of the land. Those who were at peace with you will trick you, and they will defeat you. The soldiers who fought by your side are planning a trap for you. They say, He doesnt expect a thing.

dag: O ʒiɛla fɔntinsi dunɔdaya ni, o bela dunɔdaya maa gbini n-kuhiri boona:.
en: By the gate before the city, at the entrances she shouts.

dag: O daa wuhi Musa o soya, ka wuhi Izraɛlnim o tuma.
en: God made his ways known to Moses; made his deeds known to the Israelites.

dag: Ti Duuma NAAWUNI ŋun nam binshɛɣukam ŋɔ yi shihi tiŋgbani, di tahirimi bɔɣira, ka bɛnkam be di ni fabinda, ka di kpuɣi zuɣusaa kaman Nail Mɔɣili la, ka lab lu kaman Ijipti mɔɣili la.
en: The LORD, God of heavenly forces, touches the earth and it melts, and all who live in it are sick to death. All of it rises up like the Nile and sinks again, like the Nile of Egypt.

dag: nyin wummi bɛ fabila mini bɛ suhigu alizanda ni ka niŋ bɛ ni bɔri shɛli maa ti ba.
en: then listen from heaven to their prayer and request and do what is right for them.

dag: N ni lan bɔhi bɔhigu ŋɔ yaha: Naawuni zaɣisila o niriba? Naawuni di wuhi gba! Mmaŋmaŋ nyɛla Izraɛl zuliya ŋun nyɛ ti yab Ibrahimma yaaŋa, ka nyɛ ŋun yi Bɛnjamin zuliya ni na.
en: So I ask, Did God force his people to leave him? Of course not. I myself am an Israelite. I am from the family of Abraham, from the tribe of Benjamin.

dag: Ka bɔhi ba, Yi ni ŋuni suhu n-lee ni ye o nyɛvili zuɣu, ka o tooi pahi li yuun yini?.
en: Who among you by worrying can add a single moment to your life?.

dag: Tiŋ ŋɔ ti ku nyɛ yi duɣu, ka yi mi ti ku nyɛ nimdi be di ni. N ni kari ya saria la Izraɛl tintariga.
en: Yes, this place will be the cooking pot, and you will be the meat cooking in it. I will punish you here in Israel.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ alahichi shɛŋa zaa Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la.
en: He sinned against the Lord , following the wicked example of his predecessor King Jeroboam son of Nebat, who led Israel into sin.

dag: Ka Azaria ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa min o maligumaanitab maa daa lihi nya ka kɔŋ wulig o gbɛɣu zuɣu. Ka bɛ daa daag o yihi yomyom, ka o gba maŋmaŋ daa niŋ yomyom yi, dama Yawɛ n-daa chɛ ka kɔŋ maa wulig o maa.
en: When Azariah the chief priest and all the other priests turned and saw the skin disease on his forehead, they rushed him out of there. Uzziah also was anxious to leave because the LORD had afflicted him.

dag: ka daa lo o mihi n-zaŋ o tahi Gomna Pailɛt sani.
en: They tied him, led him away, and handed him over to Pilate, the governor.

dag: Ka o mini gbuɣima daa doli, ka o niŋ yaa, ka bɔhim binyara gbahibu ka ŋubiri ninsalinima.
en: When he was full-grown, he prowled with the other lions. He too learned to hunt and eat people.

dag: Ka di tintariga bɔbili maa daa lan zaŋ nimaani n-kpa shɛli polo yaha nti ŋmaligi wulinluhili polo zoli gbini n-zaŋ kpa nudirigu polo hal ti paai Kiriatibaal .
en: The border then went in another direction, turning south from the western side of this mountain and going to Kiriath Baal , which belongs to the tribe of Judah. This was the western border.

dag: Ti Naawuni la kanna, o mi bi fo, ka buɣim din diri ni nimmoo be o tooni, ka sanʒiɛ titali ʒiɛri gind o.
en: Our God is coming; he wont keep quiet. A devouring fire is before him; a storm rages all around him.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kuhi yɛli, Ŋunkam niŋ ma yɛda, pa mani ka o niŋ yɛda, amaa ŋun tim ma na maa ka o niŋ yɛda maa.
en: In a loud voice Jesus said: Everyone who has faith in me also has faith in the one who sent me.

dag: Yawɛ doli yɛlimaŋli soli, ka tumdi wuntia tuma tiri bɛn nyari nahiŋgu.
en: The Lord does what is fair. He brings justice to all who have been hurt by others.

dag: ka din pahi pinaanu gbaai Biliga, ka din pahi pinaayɔbu gbaai Imɛr.
en: The fifteenth was Bilgahs group. The sixteenth was Immers group.

dag: A yi yɛn kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu, nyin lum o sizuura. A yi vu m-miri ti wum, di so jɛra ni maani sara shɛli, dama bɛ bi mi bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm chɛ zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu.
en: Watch your steps when you go to Gods house. Its more acceptable to listen than to offer the fools sacrifice—they have no idea that theyre acting wrongly.

dag: Ka Dauda mini tɔbbi kpamba bɛn daa su tɔbbihi tuhilituhili mini bɛn su tɔbbihi kɔbigakɔbiga fukumsi la ni kpamba zaa daa gbaai saawara.
en: David talked with all the officers of his army.

dag: Amaa ka ŋun maŋmaŋ daa kpe mɔɣu chaŋ dabisi muni chandi nti teei ʒini ti shɛli gbini n-suhiri Naawuni bɔri ni o kpi. O daa yɛlimi, Yawɛ, di saɣiya, deemi n nyɛvili pumpɔŋɔ, dama m bi so n yaannima.
en: Elijah walked a whole day into the wilderness. He stopped and sat down in the shade of a tree and wished he would die. It's too much, Lord , he prayed. Take away my life; I might as well be dead.

dag: Bɛ zaa m-mali dɔriti tibbu pina? Bɛ zaa n-tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni? Bɛ zaa n-kahigiri tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa gbinni wuhira?.
en: or to heal diseases or to speak in strange tongues or to explain what is said.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o dɔɣi bidibiga ka yɛli, Sana n-nyɛ ma tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni. Dinzuɣu ka o daa boli bia maa yuli Gɛrishom.
en: She gave birth to a son, and Moses named him Gershom, because, he said, Ive been an immigrant living in a foreign land.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi ti kari ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ zuliya shɛb tiŋgbɔŋ tiri ya maa, ka yi yihi ba, ka ʒini bɛ fɔntinsi ni n-kpe m-be bɛ yiya ni.
en: Once the LORD your God has eliminated those nations—whose land the LORD your God is giving you—and you displace them, settling into their cities and their houses.

dag: O dimnim fa o bin viɛla zaa. Hal o nya zuliya shɛba ni kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu la puuni; a ni daa zali ni di chihiri ni zuliya shɛb kpe a niriba laɣiŋgu ni la.
en: Zion's treasures were stolen. Jerusalem saw foreigners enter her place of worship, though the Lord had forbidden them to belong to his people.

dag: Chɛ ka o kul nyɛ naa nyin Naawuni sani sahakam. Chɛ ka a yurilim maŋli min a ʒiɛyimtali kul gul o.
en: May he rule forever in your presence, O God; protect him with your constant love and faithfulness.

dag: Di saha ka Ibrahimma daa biri ti shɛli bɛ ni booni tamarisik tia la Bɛrishiiba, ka jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ saha din ka bahigu Naawuni ŋɔ nimaani.
en: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba and worshiped the eternal Lord God.

dag: N ni ti yiɣisi n suhu pam bahi yi zuɣu, ka pɔbisi n suhuyiɣisili buɣim bahi yi zuɣu, ka zaŋ ya niŋ putɔɣunim bɛn mi niriba kubu looloochi nuu ni.
en: You will feel my anger when I turn it loose on you like a blazing fire. And I will hand you over to brutal men, experts at destruction.

dag: Ka Rut daa chaŋ kabɔɣili maa ni nti shiri niŋ kaman o yidan ma maa ni daa wuh o ni o niŋ shɛm maa.
en: She went out to the place where Boaz was working and did what Naomi had told her.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, o ni ti zaŋ o binshɛɣukam fukumsi niŋ o yiŋbia maa nuu ni.
en: I assure you that the master will put them in charge of all his possessions.

dag: Naawuni daalibarika kpalimmi be bɛnkam zaa yuri ti Duuma Yisa Masia yurilim shɛli din ku naai la ni!.
en: May God be kind to everyone who keeps on loving our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Yi nyɛla ninvuɣ gahinda, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi n sani. Miriya ka yi ŋubi mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ni ku binshɛli, di simdi ni yi zaŋ li tila bahi.
en: You are my people, so you must not eat the meat of any animal that has been killed by wild animals; instead, give it to the dogs.

dag: Ŋun mali yɛm, ŋun baŋmi dimbɔŋɔ gbinni. Ŋun nyɛ baŋda, ŋun baŋmi li. Dama Yawɛ soya nyɛla yɛlimaŋli soya, ka wuntizɔriba dol li, amaa alahichinim bɛn tuuri la di zuɣu.
en: May those who are wise understand what is written here, and may they take it to heart. The Lord 's ways are right, and righteous people live by following them, but sinners stumble and fall because they ignore them.

dag: Di fɔntinsi leela dabiɛm shee. Di nyɛla saa ni bi miri tiŋgban shɛl ni, ka lan nyɛ tiŋgban nɛli. So lan ka tiŋgbani maa ni, ka so mi bi lan doli nimaani garita.
en: The towns have become a horrifying sight and are like a waterless desert, where no one lives or even travels.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ kuɣ viɛla pie taba kulis anahi zuɣu. Yi ni ti zaŋ kuɣ viɛl shɛŋa bɛ ni booni kanɛlian mini kirisolait ni ɛmɛrald m-pie taba kul shɛli din daŋ tooni.
en: Put four rows of beautiful jewels on the judgment pouch. The first row of jewels should have a ruby, a topaz, and a beryl.

dag: Biɛɣu ni daa ti neerina saha shɛli ka Yisa kana ti ʒe teeku duli, ka o nyaandoliba maa daa na bi baŋ ni ŋun Yisa m-bala.
en: Early in the morning, Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples didnt realize it was Jesus.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ naa ni daa zaŋ gban shɛli ti Yufretiiz Mɔɣili wulinluhili polo gomnanim mini zuɣulaannim la ti ba, ka bɛ daa zani bɛ nyaaŋa ka sɔŋ ba Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa mɛbu tuma ni.
en: They also took the document the emperor had given them and gave it to the governors and officials of West-of-Euphrates Province, who then gave their support to the people and the Temple worship.

dag: Din bahindi nyaaŋa zaŋ chaŋ dimbɔŋɔnim polo nyɛla, di simdi ni yi zaa mali naŋgban yini, ka chɛ ka yi baɣa be nandahima ni paai shɛb yɛla ni, ka yumiya mabihili, ka maliya suhuballi, ka siɣisimiya yimaŋa yi tab sani.
en: To conclude: you must all have the same attitude and the same feelings; love one another, and be kind and humble with one another.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ biŋkɔb shɛb na ni bɛ ti nyo buɣim mali sara maa daa nyɛla naɣilahi pisopɔin mini piɛlahi kɔbiga ni piɛbihi kɔbisiyi. Bɛ zaa daa nyɛla bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ shɛb nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ.
en: All in all, the congregation brought seventy bulls, a hundred rams, and two hundred lambs as entirely burned offerings for the LORD.

dag: Naɣila Jɛfune bia Kalɛb kɔŋko n-ni nya li, ka n ni ti zaŋ o napɔna ni no tiŋgban shɛli zuɣu ti o min o bihi, o ni ʒe Yawɛ yim ni o suhu zaa zuɣu.
en: The only exception is Caleb, Jephunnehs son. He will see it. I will give the land he walked on to him and his children for this reason: he was completely devoted to the LORD. .

dag: n-ʒiya diri bindirigu, ka paɣ so zaŋ luɣulu viɛlli din pali tulaale din mali shaara pam ka o sanna ti kpaa li niŋ o zuɣu ni.
en: A woman came in with a bottle of expensive perfume and poured it on Jesus' head.

dag: Ka miriya ka yi ʒi ʒiya yi yinsi bee n-tum tuun shɛli Vuhim Dabisili dali, amaa gbibiya Vuhim Dabisili maa ka di nyɛ dabisili kasi kaman n ni daa zali yi yaannim shɛm la.
en: or carry anything out of their houses on the Sabbath. They must not work on the Sabbath; they must observe it as a sacred day, as I commanded their ancestors.

dag: Yi ni ŋuni n-lee ni mali piɛri kɔbiga, ka piɛ yino ti bɔrigi ka o ku chɛ piɛri kɔbigayinika la bɛ mɔri ŋubbu shee, ka gbaai ŋun bɔrigi maa shee bɔbu hal ti nya o?.
en: Suppose someone among you had one hundred sheep and lost one of them. Wouldnt he leave the other ninety-nine in the pasture and search for the lost one until he finds it?.

dag: Ka Naawuni nini ni tiɣi ŋun jɛmdi Masia lala, ka ninsalinim gba ni di o shɛhira suŋ.
en: Whoever serves Christ by living this way is pleasing God, and they will be accepted by others.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka buɣim di Taai goma n-saɣim bɛ ni me goma gili luɣ shɛŋa la zaa.
en: So I will start a fire at the walls of Tyre that will destroy the high towers in Tyre.

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ kpalua ni wuɣi tan piɛl viɛl shɛli n-she zabbanim ti Aduna min o bidibisi maa.
en: They made the shirts for Aaron and his sons.

dag: Ka bɛ ni shɛb daa bɔri ni bɛ gbaag o, amaa ka so daa lee bi zaŋ o nuu shih o.
en: Some of them wanted to arrest him, but no one laid a hand on him.

dag: O mabihi bɛn daa nyɛ bɛ daŋ maa ni dɔɣirikpamba zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiyi ni pihinahinaayi. Azarɛl bia Amashisai daa nyɛla Ahizai yaaŋa. O yaannim shɛba n-daa nyɛ Mɛshilɛmɔt mini Imɛr.
en: In all, members of this clan were heads of families. Amashsai, the son of Azarel and grandson of Ahzai. His ancestors included Meshillemoth and Immer.

dag: Bom binshɛli n-zaŋ pili ŋariŋ maa, ka chɛ ka di zuɣusaa dubu polo nyɛ sɛntimita pihinahinaanahi; ka chibi di dunoli di luɣili ni, ka kpahi li tambu buta tam taba.
en: Make a roof for the boat and leave a space of inches between the roof and the sides. Build it with three decks and put a door in the side.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ti yɛn kari dabisili kam sara maligu la, ka zaŋ din nyɛ chihi biɛɣu la zali di zaani la, di dabisa ti yɛn nyɛla biɛɣ tuhili ni kɔbisiyi ni pihiwɛi.
en: From the time the daily sacrifices are stopped, that is, from the time of The Awful Horror, , days will pass.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ ba suhugarigu pam, ka bɛ gbaag o bɔhibu yinoyino, N Duuma, mani? N Duuma, mani.
en: The disciples were very upset and began to ask him, one after the other, Surely, Lord, you don't mean me.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, ninvuɣ biɛri firila kpiya ka bɛ buɣim bi lan ne.
en: The light of the wicked will still be put out; its flame will never burn again.

dag: Ka naa daa zaŋ bini pɔb o ninni ka kuhiri pampam yɛra, Mbaye m bia Absalom, mbaye Absalom, m bia, m bia!.
en: The king covered his face and cried loudly, O my son! My son Absalom! Absalom, my son.

dag: Ti piɛb yuhi niŋ ya, ka yi zaɣisi waa wabu; ka kumda, ka yi bi fabinda.
en: We played flute music for you, but you did not dance; we sang a funeral song, but you were not sad.

dag: Dama n ni zɔri binshɛli pam n-ka n sanna, ka binshɛli din kpɛhiri ma dabiɛm lu n zuɣu.
en: I was afraid something terrible would happen, and what I feared most has happened.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa tim ti boli Jɛrɔbɔam na, ka Jɛrɔbɔam mini Izraɛlnim maa zaa ti chaŋ Rɛhɔbɔam sani ti yɛl o.
en: The people of the northern tribes sent for him, and then they all went together to Rehoboam and said to him.

dag: Izraɛlnima, yɛlimiya, O yurilim maŋli bi naara.
en: Israel, say it: His faithful love will last forever.

dag: ka yi ŋmaligi labi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani ka yi mini yi bihi ti deeg o noli ni yi suhuri zaa mini yi shihi zaa kaman n ni zaani ya shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: return to him with all your heart and soul and start obeying the commands I have given to you today.

dag: m-pahi fɔn shɛŋa mini tiŋkpan shɛŋa din daa be Manaasa min o zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni, ka bɛ daa lee zaŋ li n-ti Ifriim min o zuliya niriba maa la.
en: Ephraim also had some towns and villages that were inside Manasseh's tribal land.

dag: Amaa ka nyin Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ŋun nyɛ Dauda bia Sulemaana dabili ŋɔ ti zaɣis a duuma.
en: But Jeroboam, you were King Solomon's official, and you rebelled.

dag: Ninsalinim azichi ku tooi tiligi ba kum ni. Bɛ ni bahi kpi kaman biŋkɔbiri ni kpiri shɛm la.
en: Our greatness cannot keep us from death; we will still die like the animals.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ ŋun pɔri Yisa nyaandoliba zaa ni, amaa di zaa yoli, Naawuni pii ma, ka ti ma soli ni n zaŋ lahibal suŋ din nyɛ Masia daazichi din ka buɣisibu la yihi ti bɛn pa Yɛhudianima.
en: I am less than the least of all God's people; yet God gave me this privilege of taking to the Gentiles the Good News about the infinite riches of Christ.

dag: Zuŋɔ nyɛla gol so ŋun pahir awɛi biɛɣ pisinaanahi, dabisi shɛli dali yi ni sɔŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu tampuɣili. Kpahimmiya nya din yɛn niŋ pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana.
en: The Lord said, Today is the th day of the ninth month. You have finished laying the foundation of the Lord s Temple. So notice what happens from this day forward:.

dag: Di saha ka tɔbbihi maa daa chɛ bɛ ni gbahi shɛb maa mini bɛ ni daa di neen shɛŋa na maa zaa zali kpamba maa mini zama maa zaa tooni.
en: So in front of the leaders and the crowd, the troops handed over their prisoners and the property they had taken from Judah.

dag: Yawɛ, a sani ka nasara dibu yirina, niŋm alibarika niŋ a niriba ni.
en: Lord , the victory is yours! You are so good to your people. Selah.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ Judanim bɛn zaa daa be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni tin shɛŋa din yuya booni Magdol mini Tapanhɛs ni Mɛmfisi zaŋ tabili Patrɔs tiŋgbɔŋ ni shɛm m-bɔŋɔ.
en: The Lord spoke to me concerning all the Israelites living in Egypt, in the cities of Migdol, Tahpanhes, and Memphis, and in the southern part of the country.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ ti yɛn baŋ ka a pun chɛ ba luhi kaman mɔri la. Nyin Naawuni suhuyiɣisili puuni, a ni pɔbisi ba bahi ka bɛ na nɛmi.
en: Wipe them out quicker than a pot can be heated by setting thorns on fire.

dag: Pɛlatia ni Hanan ni Anaya ni.
en: Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah.

dag: Ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba maa yɛli ba, So na ʒi n-tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa kaman doo maa.
en: The Temple police answered, We have never heard anyone say such amazing things.

dag: Samuɛl ni daa ti kurigi, o daa zaŋla o bidibisi n-leei Izraɛlnim zuɣulaannima.
en: Now when Samuel got old, he appointed his sons to serve as Israels judges.

dag: Di saha yi yi ti na kul zaɣisi n noli ka ku doli ma, n ni chɛ ka alɔbo lu yi zuɣu ʒiibuyopɔin kaman yi daalahichi ni galisi shɛm tariga.
en: If you still turn against me and refuse to obey me, I will beat you seven times harder! The more you sin, the more you will be punished.

dag: Musa ni daa tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa naai, o daa zaŋla sariga pili lir o ninni.
en: When Moses had finished speaking with them, he covered his face with a veil.

dag: Guhimi Yawɛ, niŋmi yaa ka mali suhukpeeni. Guhimi Yawɛ!.
en: Wait for the Lord s help. Be strong and brave, and wait for the Lord s help.

dag: Amaa ka Ilaisha bɔh o, N shia di ka a sani saha shɛli doo la ni di yi o chɛchɛbuŋ ni n-kana ti tuh a sol la? Pumpɔŋɔ nyɛla saha shɛli di ni simdi ni a deeri liɣiri mini binyɛra ni olivi tihi ni tihi puri ni piɛri ni niɣi ni dabidɔbba ni dabipaɣiba?.
en: Elisha said to him, Wasnt my heart going along with you when the man got off his chariot to meet you? Is this the time to accept silver, clothes, olive trees, vineyards, sheep, cattle, or male and female servants?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbaai Yisa n-zaŋ o tahi maligumaaniba zuɣulan yiŋa; ka Pita daa puɣisiri doli nyaaŋa.
en: Jesus was arrested and led away to the house of the high priest, while Peter followed at a distance.

dag: Bɛ daa diri ka nyura, ka kpuɣiri paɣiba, ka zaŋdi bɛ bipuɣinsi tiri dɔbba hal ti paai Anabi Nuhu ni daa kpe ŋariŋ ni dahin shɛli ka kom kana ti di bɛ zaa ha la.
en: People were eating, drinking, marrying, and being given in marriage until the day Noah entered the ark and the flood came and destroyed them all.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa chaŋ ti ʒe teeku duli.
en: And the dragon stood on the seashore.

dag: Dama Hɛshibɔn daa nyɛla Amɔrinim Naa Sihɔn tiŋa. Ŋuna n-daa tuhi Mɔab na kuro ka fa o tiŋgbɔŋ zaa zaŋ hal ni Arinɔn.
en: Heshbon was the city where Sihon, the Amorite king, lived. In the past Sihon had fought with the king of Moab. Sihon had taken the land as far as the Arnon River.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ n suhir a mi, a nini yi shiri tiɣi ma, nyin wuhim ma a soya din ni chɛ ka m baŋ a, ka a nini maan tiɣi ma pahi. Lan teema ni niriba maa nyɛla a niriba.
en: If I have really pleased you, then teach me your ways. I want to know you. Then I can continue to please you. Remember that these people are your nation.

dag: Dabiɛm mini suhuchihibo n-daa lu bɛ zuɣu. A nuu din galisi ŋɔ zuɣu, bɛ kul fomi doya chichi kaman kuɣili la hal ka nyin Yawɛ niriba ti gari; hal ka a ni daa tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb la ti gari.
en: Terror and fear came over them; because of your great power, they were as still as a stone until your people, LORD, passed by, until the people you made your own passed by.

dag: Yawɛ baɣa be ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka galimi ni sahakam, ka bɛ zuliya kul ni beni hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: The Lord takes care of those who obey him, and the land will be theirs forever.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yɛli ni ti kpe ŋariŋ n-yiɣisi chaŋ Itali, ka bɛ daa zaŋ Pool m-pahi dansarika shɛb zuɣu n-ti sapashin so ŋun yuli daa booni Julius. O daa sula tɔbbi shɛb bɛ ni daa booni Naa Siiza Agasitus Maŋmaŋ Tɔbbihi la fukumsi.
en: When it was time for us to sail to Rome, Captain Julius from the Emperor's special troops was put in charge of Paul and the other prisoners.

dag: A zaligu zuɣu ka binshɛɣukam beni zuŋɔ, dama binshɛɣukam zaa nyɛla a daba.
en: All things are your servants, and the laws you made are still in effect today.

dag: Bɛ ni wum kikaa maa kumsi, ka zaŋ li niŋ bɛ baɣaka zuɣu, bɛ kum zambu ni ʒila bɛmaŋmaŋ zuɣu. Amaa bɛ yi di deei saɣisigu maa, bɛ naan tiligi bɛ nyɛviya.
en: They heard the sound of the trumpet but didnt heed the warning, so their blood is on them. If they had paid attention to the warning, they would have saved their lives.

dag: Dinzuɣu baŋmiya viɛnyɛliŋga ni tɔbu ni din ya, ka kum kun ya, ka alɔbo din ya luɣ shɛli yi ni bɔri ni yi chaŋ ti ʒini maa.
en: And so, you will die in Egypt from war, hunger, and disease.

dag: n-tuhi Juda Naa Ahazia dɔɣiriba soli m-bɔhi ba, Banima n-lee nyɛn ya? Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Ti nyɛla Naa Ahazia dɔɣiriba, ka kana ni ti ti kaai nabihi mini napaɣ Jɛzibɛl bidibisi.
en: There Jehu met up with the brothers of Judahs King Ahaziah. Who are you? he asked. Were Ahaziahs relatives, they replied. Weve come down for a visit with the kings sons and the queen mothers sons.

dag: M mini ŋun doli gbaai mani ŋun nyɛ o zo ŋɔ, ka yiɣisi o ni daa lo ma alikauli shɛli.
en: My friend attacked his allies, breaking his covenant.

dag: Ninvuɣ yoya bɛn daa be bɛ ni daa kpiri kɔre pam; ka Izraɛlnim gba daa lan kum ka yɛli, Ti bi zaɣisi ka ti di nya nimdi ŋubi.
en: One day some foreigners among the Israelites became greedy for food, and even the Israelites themselves began moaning, We don't have any meat!.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan laɣim Izraɛl tɔbutuhiri biinsi ninvuɣ tuhi pihita.
en: David brought together , of Israel's best soldiers and.

dag: Dama bɛ nyurila bara zaŋ chaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ biɛhigu polo, ka tɛhiri ni Naawuni ku tooi nya bɛ tuumbiɛri maa, ka kari ba saria di zuɣu.
en: They like themselves too much to hate their own sins or even to see them.

dag: ka yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi yi bi zaŋ yimaŋ zali bia zaani yi ti ku kpe alizanda nam ni.
en: and said, I assure you that unless you change and become like children, you will never enter the Kingdom of heaven.

dag: Ka zuliya kam ni zaŋ bɛ tibiginsim mini bɛ jilima na nti kpe tiŋ maa ni.
en: The greatness and the honor of the nations will be brought into the city.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa bi kali Lɛvinim ni bɛ daŋ niriba pahi bɛ ni.
en: The Levites were not registered with the other tribes.

dag: Bɛ tiɣila barina pua ka ni dɔɣi zaɣ biɛɣu, ka bɛ suhuri mali ʒiri ŋmabu shili.
en: They are always thinking of ways to do evil and cause trouble. They are always planning how they might cheat others.

dag: Dinzuɣu doo maa ni daa yɛli Bɔaz ni o dam li maa, o daa pirigila o namdili ti Bɔaz.
en: So after the man had agreed to let Boaz buy the property, he took off one of his sandals and handed it to Boaz.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka ti puhi di chuɣu, ka di pa ni ti zaŋ dabin kurili din nyɛ biɛr biɛɣu mini tuumbiɛtali puhi li, amaa di simdi ni ti zaŋla bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi ka nyɛ bɔrɔbɔro din nyɛ alali mini yɛlimaŋli la puhi li.
en: Let us celebrate our Passover, then, not with bread having the old yeast of sin and wickedness, but with the bread that has no yeast, the bread of purity and truth.

dag: Naa Siiza Agasitus daa ti bahi noli ni bɛ sab o tiŋgbɔŋ ni niriba zaa yuya baŋ bɛ kalinli.
en: At that time Emperor Augustus ordered a census to be taken throughout the Roman Empire.

dag: Ka buɣim daa yi di mundili maa ni n-di di wula mini di wala. Ka di daa lan ka mundili din mali yaa din ni niŋ nam jaaŋgbee, ka bɛ zaŋ li su nam. Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla fabila yilli, ka di simdi ni bɛ yiini li fabila saha.
en: A fire started in the large branch and spread to destroy all of its vines and fruit. So there was no strong walking stick. There was no kings scepter. This was a sad song about death, and it was sung as a sad song about death.

dag: Zaŋmiya bula yino mali alahichi sara pahi yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim sahakam la mini di chi sara ni di binnyura sara la zuɣu.
en: You must also offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin. These are to be offered in addition to the regular daily sacrifices.

dag: Jɛra maanila alahichi sanyoo sara maligu ansarisi, amaa Naawuni niŋdi wuntizɔriba nirilim.
en: Fools mock a compensation offering, but favor is with those who do right.

dag: Naa Darius daa pii kpambaliba kɔbiga ni pisi zal o tiŋgbɔŋ ni tuma zaashɛhi ni.
en: Darius decided to appoint a hundred and twenty governors to hold office throughout his empire.

dag: Dinzuɣu a yi tahi sara sara malibu shee ka ti teei ni a mali taali a kpe so sani.
en: So, what if you are offering your gift at the altar and remember that someone has something against you?.

dag: Nyamiya, Yawɛ pala ŋun ka yiko din ni tooi tiligi ya bee ŋun nyɛ tikpiralana, ka ku tooi wum yi suhigu.
en: Don't think that the Lord is too weak to save you or too deaf to hear your call for help!.

dag: Yi nahindi nandaamba ka fari bɛ chi. Dinzuɣu yi ku be yi ni zaŋ kuɣa me yi yiya shɛŋa la ni, yi mi ku nyu yi ni sa yi wain ti viɛl shɛŋa la wain.
en: you abuse the poor and demand heavy taxes from them. You have built expensive homes, but you won't enjoy them; you have planted vineyards, but you will get no wine.

dag: Ka a zaŋ Lɛvinim maa na ti zali laɣiŋgu suɣili la tooni, ka laɣim Izraɛlnim zaa na.
en: Then you, Moses, will call together all the people of Israel and send the Levites to my sacred tent.

dag: Ansarisimaaniba ni ti nya tibidarigibo, ka jɛra mi yaansi zuɣu ti nya fiɛbiga.
en: People who show no respect for anything must be brought to justice. You must punish such fools.

dag: O kparima ŋmanila tulaale tihi vuɣa din wandi tulaale din nyom viɛla. O naŋgbampiba ŋmanila paɣiviɛligakushihikom, ka mɛɛr kom be di ni.
en: His cheeks are like a garden of spices, like flowers used for perfume. His lips are like lilies, dripping with liquid myrrh.

dag: Ka yi yi ti paai Ammɔnnim tintariga, yin di muɣisiya ba bee n-tuhi ba tɔbu, dama n ku zaŋ Ammɔnnim tiŋgbɔŋ maa tin ya ni yi su li, dama n daa pun zaŋ li tila Lɔt zuliya ni bɛ su li. .
en: and you will come close to the Ammonites. Dont aggravate them. Dont fight with them because I wont give any part of the Ammonites land to you as your own. Ive given it to Lots descendants as their property.

dag: Kpihimmi bɛ yuya nyɛviyanim litaafi la ni, ka di chɛ ka bɛ sabi bɛ yuya pahi wuntizɔriba yuya ni.
en: May their names be erased from the book of the living; may they not be included in the list of your people.

dag: Ka sokam ti nya ka di nyɛla man Yawɛ n-juui buɣim maa, ka di ku kpi. .
en: Everyone will know that I started it, and that it cannot be stopped.

dag: Noli ni ti din ya yi fɔntinsi ni, ka din ya yi puri ni.
en: The Lord will curse your towns and your fields.

dag: amaa n suhu daa bi doya n ni daa bi nya ti mabia Taitus nimaani la zuɣu. Dina n-daa chɛ ka n chɛbisi bɛn be nimaani ka chaŋ Masidɔnia.
en: But I was deeply worried, because I could not find our brother Titus. So I said good-bye to the people there and went on to Macedonia.

dag: Bɛ ka buchi, ka nyɛ ʒiri binyara. Bɛ yi ti yɛn darigi bɛ tibili saha shɛli, bɛ ni bahi yoli zaa.
en: They are a delusion, a charade; at the appointed time they will be ruined!.

dag: Ka bipuɣiŋga maa daa doli ti mini Pool kuhiri yɛra, Niriba ŋɔ nyɛla Zallakudura Naa daba bɛn wuhiri ya tiliginsim soli.
en: She started following Paul and the rest of us around. She kept shouting, These men are servants of the Most High God! They are telling you how you can be saved.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni mali binshɛŋa maani buɣa polo, ti mi ni di nyɛla kaman shɛb ni yɛli shɛm la: Ti zaa mali baŋsim. Amaa baŋsim ŋɔ tatabo tahirila maŋduhibu na; yurilim n-naɣ nyɛ din kpaŋsiri nir suhu.
en: Now concerning meat that has been sacrificed to a false god: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge makes people arrogant, but love builds people up.

dag: Jɔnatan bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Pɛlɛt mini Zaza. Bɛmbɔŋɔ zaa daa nyɛla Jɛramiil daŋ niriba.
en: Jonathans family: Peleth and Zaza. These were Jerahmeels descendants.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa yɛl o biɛyanim maa, Man Yisifu m-bala. M ba na be o nyɛvil ni? Amaa ka di daa gar o biɛyanim maa pam, ka bɛ kɔŋ o garigibu.
en: He said to his brothers, I am your brother Joseph. Is my father doing well? But the brothers did not answer him because they were confused and afraid.

dag: Amaa ka wahu maa yɛli paɣ maa, Yi ku kpi.
en: The snake said to the woman, You wont die!.

dag: Ka bɛ mabihi maa ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nyɛ Kɔhat daŋ niriba la daa nyɛ bɛn maani bɔrɔbɔro kasi shɛŋa bɛ ni daa zaŋdi maani sara Vuhim Dabisili dali kam la.
en: Some of the gatekeepers who were in the Korah family had the job of preparing the bread put on the table every Sabbath.

dag: Amaa yi ni daa niŋ ma nirilim sɔŋ ma n wahala puuni la viɛli pam.
en: But it was very good of you to help me in my troubles.

dag: ni Lɔd ni Ono din daa nyɛ Nuhi Tuumbaŋdiba Vinvamli la ni.
en: Lod, and Ono, the valley of artisans.

dag: Chɛ ka a baɣa be wuhibu ni, ka gbilisi tibili wum baŋsim yɛtɔɣa.
en: Listen to your teacher and learn all you can.

dag: Ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri yi gbaai biŋkɔbigu maa, di simdi ka o zaŋ o chɛra na ti wuhi shɛhira, ka di bi simdi ni o yo mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ni gbaai biŋkɔb so maa zuɣu.
en: If it was killed by wild animals, the man is to bring the remains as evidence; he need not pay for what has been killed by wild animals.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan pii fɔntins anahi Gaad zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni ti ba. Tinsi maa n-nyɛ: Ramɔt din be Giliad, ka nyɛ ninvuɣ so ŋun ku o kpee ni zɔri kuni tin shɛli tiligiri la mini Mahanaim.
en: From the tribe of Gad: Ramoth in Gilead, the refuge city for a killer, and its pastures; Mahanaim and its pastures.

dag: Ka yi ni ŋuni n-lee bo paɣa ka bɛ na bi kulis o na? Dilan labimi kuli yiŋa, di pa shɛli ka o ti lu tɔb maa ni ka so kpuɣ o paɣ maa.
en: Is there anyone here who is engaged to be married? If so, he is to go home. Otherwise, if he is killed in battle, someone else will marry the woman he is engaged to.

dag: Mɛnahɛm ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o ni daa pun niŋ shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sabi di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: The rest of Menahems deeds and all that he accomplished, arent they written in the official records of Israels kings?.

dag: Di saha ka maligumaaniba maa daa zaŋ Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa ti kpɛhi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni luɣ kasi zaa kasi shee la nti zali di zaashee chɛrubinim la kpiŋkpama lɔŋni.
en: The priests brought the chest containing the LORDs covenant to its designated spot beneath the wings of the winged creatures in the inner sanctuary of the temple, the most holy place.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka n daa lan nya malaika so ŋun mali yiko pam ka o yi alizanda ni na, ka o jilima neesim daa neei dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam.
en: After this I saw another angel coming down from heaven. He had great authority, and the earth was filled with light because of his glory.

dag: M paɣiri Yawɛ n suhu ni. N niŋgbuŋ luɣili pinaayi zaa paɣir o yuli din be kasi ŋɔ.
en: Praise the Lord , my soul! All my being, praise his holy name!.

dag: Miriya ka yi niŋdi kaman yi ni daa be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka bɛ niŋdi shɛm la. Ka miriya ka yi ti niŋdi kaman n ni yɛn zaŋ ya kulisi Keenan tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni ŋɔ nim ni niŋdi shɛm la. Miriya ka yi ti niŋ bɛ ni niŋdi shɛm.
en: Do not follow the practices of the people of Egypt, where you once lived, or of the people in the land of Canaan, where I am now taking you.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ takɔbi lu yi zuɣu n-kun ya bɔhi biɛri alikauli la zuɣu. Ka yi yi ti zo n-kuli yi fɔntinsi ni, n ni chɛ ka alɔbo lu yi zuɣu, ka zaŋ ya niŋ yi dimnim nuu ni.
en: I will bring war on you to punish you for breaking our covenant, and if you gather in your cities for safety, I will send incurable diseases among you, and you will be forced to surrender to your enemies.

dag: N ni mali n yuli din galisi maa ka di niŋ kasi, n yu shɛli zuliya shɛb ni daa saɣim ka yi gba daa saɣim li bɛ sani la. Ka n yi kahigi n kasitali yi sani bɛ ninni, bɛ ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will make my great name holy, which was degraded among the nations when you dishonored it among them. Then the nations will know that I am the LORD. This is what the LORD God says. When I make myself holy among you in their sight.

dag: Naawuni zomi ya nambɔɣu, ka tin ya suhudoo mini yurilim din kul zoori pahira!.
en: May mercy, peace, and love be yours in full measure.

dag: Dindali maa yuŋ ka Yawɛ daa guli ni o yihi Izraɛlnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. Di yuŋ maa nyɛla Izraɛlnim zaa ni gbibi shɛli, ka di nyɛ Yawɛ guhibu yuŋ bɛ ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: The night they left, the Lord watched over them to bring them safely out of Egypt. So the Israelites will always celebrate this night each year to remember what the Lord did.

dag: Yawɛ kpe o niriba kpamba mini bɛ nanim saria karibu ni. O yɛliya, Yinima n-ʒe tihi puri, ka di tarimba nɛma ti niŋ yi yinsi.
en: The Lord is ready to present his case against the elders and leaders of his people. He says, You people have burned the vineyard, and what you stole from the poor is still in your houses.

dag: Chɛ ka n kpe a biŋkɔbiri maa ni zuŋɔ ti gahim piɛ shɛb bɛn liɣisiliɣisi mini bɛn mali sabilimsabilim ni piɛbihi sabila ni bu shɛb bɛn mali sabilimsabilim mini bɛn liɣisiliɣisi ni bubihi sabila; ka bɛ leei n yɔri.
en: But let me go through all your flocks today and take every lamb with spots or stripes. Let me take every black young goat and every female goat with stripes or spots. That will be my pay.

dag: Bɛ ni daa tuui ʒini nimaani, bɛ daa bi jɛmdi Yawɛ, dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka gbuɣima kana nti gbahi bɛ ni shɛb ku.
en: At first these people did not worship the Lord , so he sent lions to attack them, and the lions killed some of them.

dag: Ka pɔhim daa muɣisi ti ka ti kul chani biɛlabiɛla n-niŋ dabisa shɛm hal ti miri Kɛnaidus, ka ti ni daa tuhi pɔhim zuɣu chɛ ka ti zaŋ doli Kriit teeku noli polo n-chaŋ ti baɣisi Salimɔne gari.
en: We sailed along slowly for several days and had a hard time reaching Cnidus. The wind would not let us go any farther in that direction, so we sailed past Cape Salmone, where the island of Crete would protect us from the wind.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ a? A nyɛla Anabi Ilaija? Ka o yɛli ba, M pa o. Ka bɛ lan bɔh o, Bɛ ni daa yɛli anab so yɛla la n-nyɛ a? Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Aai.
en: They asked him, Then who are you? Are you Elijah? John said, Im not. Are you the prophet? John answered, No.

dag: Alikauli maa zuɣu ka ti zuliya pinaayi jɛmdi Naawuni yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni, ka mali tahima ni ti ti nya di palibu. Naa, tahima maa zuɣu ka Yɛhudianim ŋmari ma tiŋŋmaŋ maa.
en: This is the promise our twelve tribes hope to receive as they earnestly worship night and day. The Jews are accusing me, King Agrippa, because of this hope!.

dag: Ka Jabɛshi kpamba daa yɛl o, Tim ti daba ayopɔin ka ti tim Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa ti yɛl ba, ka so yi kani ŋun ni fa ti bahi, di saha ti ni zaŋ timaŋ ti a.
en: The elders of Jabesh replied to him, Leave us alone for seven days so we can send messengers thoughout Israels territory. If theres no one to save us, then well surrender to you.

dag: Doo yi kpuɣi paɣ min o bia leeg o paɣiba di nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛtali, ka di simdi ka bɛ nyo doo maa min o paɣiba maa buɣim din ni chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛtali maa ku lan be bɛ sunsuuni.
en: If a man marries a woman and her mother, all three shall be burned to death because of the disgraceful thing they have done; such a thing must not be permitted among you.

dag: Yisa daa lan bɔhi ba, Wula ka nir ni tooi kpe kpiɔŋlan yiŋa nti fa n nɛma ka pa ni o daŋ o la mii lɔbu pɔi? Di nyaaŋa ka o ni tooi fa o nɛma maa.
en: How can anyone break into a strong man's house and steal his things, unless he first ties up the strong man? Then he can take everything.

dag: A yi be mɔpilli zuɣusaa larigi ni di so ni a mini yidaampaɣ so ŋun bɔri zabili pam laɣim be yil ni.
en: It is better to live in a small corner of the roof than to share the house with a woman who is always arguing.

dag: Nyamiya, dahin shɛli kanna ka bɛ ni ti yɛli ni paɣiŋɔhi mini paɣ shɛb bɛn na bi dɔɣi ni bihi ni bi mɔɣi paɣ shɛb biha mal alibarika.
en: The time is coming when people will say, The women who cannot have babies are the ones God has blessed. Its really a blessing that they have no children to care for.

dag: Jɔn daa lan wuhi niriba maa yɛla pam pah o lahibal suŋ waazu maa puuni.
en: With many other words John appealed to them, proclaiming good news to the people.

dag: Dauda daa yɛla zabba piɛl viɛlli kaman Lɛvinim bɛn daa buɣiri Alikauli Adaka maa mini baansi maa ni Kɛnania ŋun daa nyɛ baan kpɛm maa ni daa ye zabba shɛŋa. Ka Dauda daa zaŋ tampiɛlli din ŋmani mukuru lo o shee ni.
en: David was wearing a robe made of the finest linen, and so were the musicians, Chenaniah their leader, and the Levites who carried the Box. David also wore a linen ephod.

dag: Yɛm kuhiri pampam solɔri zuɣu, o duhir o yee niriba laɣiŋgu shee.
en: Listen! Wisdom is calling out in the streets and marketplaces.

dag: Di saha, Izraɛlnim bɛn kpalim ka nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya la ti ku lan zaŋ bɛmaŋ dalim zuliya shɛb bɛn bahiri ba yol la, amaa bɛ ni ti zaŋ bɛmaŋ dalimla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ ka biɛhiŋ kani.
en: On that day, whats left of Israel and the survivors of the house of Jacob will no longer depend on the one who beat them. Instead, they will faithfully depend on the LORD, the holy one of Israel.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ tum tuun kpɛma. Bɛ daa tuui lu ka kɔŋ ŋun ni sɔŋ ba.
en: God made life hard for those people because of what they did. They stumbled and fell, and there was no one to help them.

dag: Dinzuɣu nyini pagɔrili ŋɔ, wummi Yawɛ yɛligu.
en: Jerusalem, you prostitute, listen to me.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka doo ŋmaligir o ba min o ma sani n-zaŋd omaŋ tabind o paɣa, ka bɛ niriba ayi maa be kaman ninvuɣ yino la.
en: That is why a man leaves his father and mother and is united with his wife, and they become one.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Bundaan so n-daa be n-yɛri ago kpariti mini binyɛr suma, ka dir o suhu yubu sahakam.
