en: There was a certain rich man who clothed himself in purple and fine linen, and who feasted luxuriously every day.

dag: Dama jɛra lari ŋmanila gɔhi ni be buɣim ni duɣu gbinni tahiri shɛm la; ka dimbɔŋɔ gba ka buchi.
en: Foolish laughter is stupid. It sounds like thorns crackling in a fire.

dag: O daa kari zuliya shɛba, ka piri bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ti Izraɛl zuliya, ka deei bɛ yinsi ti ba ka bɛ kpe m-beni.
en: He made nations run from the tribes of Israel, and he let the tribes take over their land.

dag: Ka o daa tim Izraɛl nachimba ka bɛ chaŋ ti mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la, ka daa kɔri naɣilahi mali suhudoo sara maligu ti Yawɛ.
en: Then he sent young men, and they burned sacrifices to the Lord and sacrificed some cattle as fellowship offerings.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi ni daa wum shɛli piligu ni la ha kul kpalim be yi suhuri ni. Yi ni daa wum shɛli piligu ni maa ha yi kul kpalim be yi ni, dindina yi gba ni be Bia maa min o Ba Naawuni ni.
en: Be sure that you continue to follow the teaching you heard from the beginning. If you do that, you will always be in the Son and in the Father.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa dɔbba mini paɣiba zaa bɛn suhuri daa yɛli ba ni bɛ zaŋmi binshɛli kana ka bɛ ti zaŋ li tum Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa ni o tum tuun shɛli maa zaa din nyɛ bɛ suhuyubu pina, bɛ daa zaŋdi li mi na ti tiri Yawɛ.
en: Moses had told the people what the Lord wanted them to do, and many of them decided to bring their gifts.

dag: Ka Batishiiba yɛl o, Yɛlima. Ka o yɛl o, N suhir a, yɛlim Naa Sulemaana ni o zaŋm Abishag Shunɛm paɣisarili la ti ma ka n niŋ m paɣa, ka o mi ku zaɣis a ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Please ask Solomon to let me marry Abishag. He won't say no to you.

dag: Ka Absalom daa bɔhi Hushai, A ʒiɛyimtali zaŋ chaŋ a zo maa sani ni bahindi shɛm m-bala? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a bi dol a zo maa chaŋ.
en: Absalom answered, Why are you not loyal to your friend David? Why did you not leave Jerusalem with your friend.

dag: Naawuni, bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ti bahi sahakam lala? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a je suli niŋ tinim bɛn nyɛ a piɛ shɛb a ni dihiri ŋɔ?.
en: Our God, why have you completely rejected us? Why are you so angry with the ones you care for?.

dag: Wuntizɔriba mi bɛ biŋkɔbiri ni bɔri shɛli, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛna, bɛ nambɔzɔbo nyɛla putɔɣu niŋbu.
en: The righteous care about their livestocks needs, but even the compassion of the wicked is cruel.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, di nyɛla talahi ni woligibu kpe yi sunsuuni n-chɛ ka di kahigi wuhi bɛn nyɛ yɛlimaŋlinim ni nyɛ shɛb yi ni.
en: No doubt there must be divisions among you so that the ones who are in the right may be clearly seen.

dag: Nir yi nyɛ faralana ka o biɛhigu be tibi, di so ni o nyɛ bundana ka nyɛ bilikɔɣino o tuma ni.
en: Better to be poor and walk in innocence than to be on crooked paths and wealthy.

dag: Yawɛ, wuhim ti a yurilim maŋli la, ka ti ti a tiliginsim.
en: Lord , save us and show us your love.

dag: Bɛ yɛtɔɣa nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛtali yɛtɔɣa, ka ʒiri gba be di ni; ka bɛ je ni bɛ tum yɛm tuma ni din viɛla.
en: They tell deceitful lies, and they don't have the sense to live right.

dag: Kɔŋ maa daa kul malila naa Uzia hal ni o nyɛvili tariga. Ka o ni daa nyɛ kɔŋlan maa zuɣu, o daa kul bela o kɔŋko yili ni ka ku lan tooi kpe Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni. Ka o bia Jɔtam daa be nayili maa n-su nayili maa mini tiŋgbɔŋ maa niriba.
en: So Uzziah the king was a leper. He could not enter the Lord s Temple. His son Jotham controlled the kings palace and became governor for the people.

dag: Ka bɛnkam wum pɔri ŋɔ puuni yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ ka tɛhi ni bɛ mali alibarika ka yɛri bɛ suhuri ni, Ti tiligiya, hal ti ni kul doli ti tipawumli soya ŋɔ zaa yoli, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka ashaara lu ninvuɣ biɛri mini ninvuɣ suma zuɣu.
en: Some people might hear these curses and comfort themselves by saying, I will continue doing what I want. Nothing bad will happen to me. But that attitude will bring total disaster.

dag: Zo kpima chɛ ka tulaale nyom niŋdila biɛribiɛri; lala ka jɛrilim biɛla saɣindi yɛm mini jilima.
en: Dead flies can make a whole bottle of perfume stink, and a little stupidity can cancel out the greatest wisdom.

dag: Ka a yi kɔhi binshɛli ti a kpee bee a yi da binshɛli a kpee sani, yin di ŋariya taba.
en: Dont cheat your neighbors when you sell your land to them. Dont cheat one another when you buy or sell land.

dag: Wula ka n lee yɛn chɛ yi taali? Yi bihi zaɣisi ma, ka jɛmdila binshɛŋa din pa Naawuni. N yi dihi ba ka bɛ tiɣi, bɛ tumdila zina, ka chani pagɔra yinsi.
en: The Lord asked, Why should I forgive the sins of my people? They have abandoned me and have worshiped gods that are not real. I fed my people until they were full, but they committed adultery and spent their time with prostitutes.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ yino nɔzaɣisibo zuɣu yi chɛ ka niriba pam leeg alahichinima, lala zuɣu n-chɛ ka ninvuɣ yino mi nɔdeebo zuɣu gba ni chɛ ka niriba pam yi taali ni Naawuni sani.
en: One man disobeyed God and many became sinners. But in the same way, one man obeyed God and many will be made right.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Ɛbɛdimɛlɛk daa yi nayili n-chaŋ ti yɛli naa.
en: Ebed Melech said, My lord and king, these officials have done evil. They have treated Jeremiah the prophet badly. They have thrown him into a cistern and left him there to die.

dag: Ifriimnim bela muɣisigu ni, ka diri wahala saria karibu ni, bɛ ni lo ni bɛ dolila binshɛŋa din ka buchi zuɣu.
en: Israel is suffering oppression; she has lost land that was rightfully hers, because she insisted on going for help to those who had none to give.

dag: Ka ti daa lan bɔhi ba bɛ yuya ni di chɛ ka ti sabi bɛ yuya, ka wuh a bɛn nyɛ tuma maa zuɣulaannima.
en: We also asked them their names so that we could write down the names of the leaders for your information.

dag: Ka a boli Jɛsi ka o ka sara maligu maa shee na, ka n ti wuh a a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm. Ka a ti booi kpam maa bahi n ni yɛn wuh a ninvuɣ so maa zuɣu ni ti ma.
en: Invite Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will make clear to you what you should do. You will anoint for me the person I point out to you.

dag: Ka Sintani daa zaŋ o du zo shɛli zuɣu nti wuh o dunia ŋɔ nama zaa nini kahimbu ni neebu yim ni.
en: Then the Devil took him up and showed him in a second all the kingdoms of the world.

dag: N Duuma, ka pumpɔŋɔ bɔ ka n lee lan guhira? Kulla a sani ka m mali tahima.
en: So now, Lord, what should I be waiting for? My hope is set on you.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses.

dag: Ka Nail Mɔɣili maa puuni zahim zaa daa kpi n-niŋ kom maa ni, ka di nyɔni, ka Ijiptinim daa kɔŋ Nail Mɔɣili maa ni kom maa nyubu; ka ʒim daa be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: The fish in the river died, and the river began to stink. So the Egyptians could not drink water from the river. The blood was everywhere in Egypt.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daba ayi ha, ka kulibɔŋ maa kom maa nyuui, saa ni daa bi lan miri bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni la zuɣu.
en: There was no rain, so after a while the stream became dry.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi nirilim zaŋdi bɛ binyara paŋdi niriba mali alibarika. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli yɛlimaŋli soli tumdi bɛ tuma mali alibarika.
en: Life will go well for those who freely lend and are honest in business.

dag: dama Izraɛlnim mini Judanima ni bɛ nanim ni bɛ kpamba ni bɛ maligumaaniba ni bɛ daanabinim tum zaɣ biɛɣu n-chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi.
en: because of all the evil that has been done by the people of Judah and Jerusalem, together with their kings and leaders, their priests and prophets.

dag: ka di nyɛ nir ni yɛn ku daadam ka zo n-kuli luɣ shɛli. Ŋun bi yuri ka ku o kpee ka di pala dimdi m-pun be bɛ sunsuuni, ŋun ku nira maa ni tooi zo n-kuli fɔntinsi maa zaɣ yin ni tilig o nyɛvili.
en: so that anyone who killed someone accidentally and without prior hatred could flee to one of these cities and be safe.

dag: Juda Naa Ahaz ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pinaayi saha ka Ɛla bia Hɔshia daa di Izraɛl nam Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuma awɛi.
en: Hoshea son of Elah began to rule in Samaria over Israel. This was during the th year that Ahaz was king of Judah. Hoshea ruled nine years.

dag: Bɛn daa pahi bɛ zuɣu n-nyɛ Hɛman mini Jɛdutun ni bɛ ni daa lan pii ninvuɣ shɛb zali ni bɛ paɣiri Yawɛ o yurilim din bi naara ŋɔ zuɣu la.
en: There with them were Heman and Jeduthun and the others who were specifically chosen to sing praises to the Lord for his eternal love.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa chɛ ka Yaakubu kuli Mɛsopoteemia Leeban ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtuɛl Aram nir bia, ka nyɛ Yaakubu mini Iso ma Ribɛka tizɔdoo la sani.
en: So Isaac sent Jacob to Rebekahs brother in Paddan Aram. Jacob went to Laban, son of Bethuel the Aramean. Laban was the brother of Rebekah, the mother of Jacob and Esau.

dag: Vinnyaɣilan zaŋ o nuu tim saɣ ŋman ni, ka wumsim mal o pam ni o zaŋ li ti kpar o noli ni.
en: Lazy people bury their hand into the bowl, too tired to return it to their mouth.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, bihilaamba ni ti ŋubi bɛ bihi, ka bihi gba ti ŋubi bɛ laamba. N ni ti kari ya saria, ka wurim yi bɛn kpalim la dolisi pɔhim kam.
en: People in Jerusalem will be so hungry that parents will eat their own children, and children will eat their own parents. I will punish you in many ways, and those who are left alive, I will scatter to the winds.

dag: M bɔri ni yi baŋ ni bɛ yihi ti mabia Timoti sarika ni; o yi paana tu n kandina saha, n ni zaŋ o pahi mmaŋ zuɣu na ti nyan ya.
en: I want you to know that our brother Timothy is out of prison. If he comes to me soon, we will both come to see you.

dag: Jɔsia daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani, ka daa dol o yab Dauda naba o tuma ni ka bi ŋmaligi kpa nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo ka chɛ li.
en: Josiah always obeyed the Lord , just as his ancestor David had done.

dag: Mɔabnim zaa ni daa wum ni nanim shɛb kana ni bɛ ti tuhi ba, bɛ daa laɣimla bipola zaŋ tabili ninkura zaa bɛn ni tooi ye gbaɣinɔnim na nti sɔŋ bɛ tintariga.
en: Now all the Moabites had heard how these kings had come to fight against them. So all who were able to fight were summoned, and they took up positions along the border.

dag: dindina o ni tooi zaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ŋɔ yuli tum tuma kaman o Lɛvi tab zaa ni zaani Yawɛ tooni tumdi tuma nimaani shɛm.
en: and then be a special servant of the Lord there, just like all the other Levites.

dag: nti bi nya Yisa siliga maa ni; ka labina ti yɛli ti ni bɛ naɣ nyala malaikanim ʒii, ka malaikanim maa yɛli ba ni o neei kum ni.
en: and didnt find his body. They came to us saying that they had even seen a vision of angels who told them he is alive.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Judanim tum alahichi n ninni. Bɛ zaŋ din chihiri kpe n ni zaŋ n yuli boli jɛmbu du shɛl la ni n-ta li daɣiri.
en: You have disobeyed me by putting your disgusting idols in my temple, and now the temple itself is disgusting to me.

dag: Ka Jɔab niriba maa ni yino daa chaŋ ti zani Amasa sani ka yɛli, Ŋunkam bɔr Jɔab ka nyɛ ŋun be Naa Dauda polo, ŋun doli Jɔab.
en: One of Joabs young soldiers stood by Amasas body and said, All of you who support Joab and David, lets follow Joab.

dag: O ni ti taɣi bihi laamba suhuri ti bɛ bihi, ka taɣi bihi suhuri ti bɛ laamba din ni chɛ ka n ku kana ti yɛli noli niŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Turn the hearts of the parents to the children and the hearts of the children to their parents. Otherwise, I will come and strike the land with a curse.

dag: Ka Mɔdɛkai daa ye nam kpariti din nyɛ zaɣ sabilifaa, ka piɛlipiɛla ni kpar shɛli din nyɛ tangari, ka pili salima zuɣupil titali n-yi nayili kuna. Ka niriba daa kab doli Susa tiŋ puuni solɔri yɔri vuri ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Mordecai left the palace, wearing royal robes of blue and white, a cloak of fine purple linen, and a magnificent gold crown. Then the streets of Susa rang with cheers and joyful shouts.

dag: Piɛbimiya gbɛri Gibia tiŋ puuni, ka piɛbiya kikahi Rama tiŋ puuni. Ŋmɛmiya tɔb chiriga Bɛtavɛn tiŋ puuni. Bɛnjamin zuliya, lumiya abirima.
en: Blow the horn in Gibeah. Blow the trumpet in Ramah. Give the warning at Beth Aven. The enemy is behind you, Benjamin.

dag: Dindali maa bɛ tin shɛŋa din mali kpiɔŋ ni ti bemi kaman Hivinim mini Amɔrinim ni daa zo ka chɛ tin shɛŋa bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu, ka di zani dabari la.
en: When that day comes, well-defended cities will be deserted and left in ruins like the cities that the Hivites and the Amorites abandoned as they fled from the people of Israel.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ba, N yɛri ya mi, bɛ yi fo, kuɣa ni deei kuhi yɛli.
en: He answered, I tell you, if they were silent, the stones would shout.

dag: Adiini alali din nyɛ din ka galimi ti Ba Naawuni sani nyɛla kpibisi mini pakoya lihibu bɛ wahala ni mini maŋgbaabu zaŋ chaŋ dunia ŋɔ yɛliniŋda din gabisiri niriba la polo.
en: What God the Father considers to be pure and genuine religion is this: to take care of orphans and widows in their suffering and to keep oneself from being corrupted by the world.

dag: Naawuni yɛliya, ʒiɛmani din bahindi nyaaŋa puuni n ni ti zaŋ n Shia Kasi niŋ daadam kam ni. Ka yi bidibisi mini yi bipuɣinsi ti tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa; ka yi nachimba ti nya ʒii; ka yi ninkura mi ti zahim zahima.
en: God says: In the last days I will pour out my Spirit on all people. Your sons and daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions. Your old men will have special dreams.

dag: Ti daa bi deei shɛli so sani ka bi yo di zuɣu, amaa ti daa kul tumdila wuntaŋ ni ni yuŋ zaa ni di chɛ ka ti yɛla ku ʒi yi ni so zuɣu.
en: We didnt eat anyones food without paying for it. Instead, we worked night and day with effort and hard work so that we would not impose on you.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Musa, Bɔ saha ka niriba ŋɔ lee yɛn chɛ ma ʒiɛmbu? Hal n ni wuhi ba shihira shɛŋa la zaa yoli, bɛ kul zaɣisiya ni bɛ ku niŋ ma yɛda.
en: The Lord said to Moses, I have done great things for these people, and they still reject me by refusing to believe in my power.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka sanʒiɛɣu yiɣisi teeku maa ni, ka sanʒiɛɣu maa ʒiɛbu kpiɔŋ daa galisi pam hal ka ŋarin titali maa ti be kaman di yɛn chɛrisimi la.
en: But the Lord made a strong wind blow, and such a bad storm came up that the ship was about to be broken to pieces.

dag: A chɛ ka daadamnim vuura kaman zahindi la. Bɛ lan ŋmanila mɔri din puhiri yirina asibaasi.
en: Our life is like a dream that ends when morning comes. We are like grass.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔahaz daa ti kani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Samaria; ka o bia Jɛhɔash daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Jehoahaz died and was buried with his ancestors. The people buried Jehoahaz in Samaria. His son Jehoash became the new king after him.

dag: Ŋun yɛn da kul yɛrimi, Di mali shaara, di mali shaara, di nyaaŋa ka o chaŋ ha ti nyuri bara.
en: Everyone likes to brag about getting a bargain.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ Amɔrinim Naa Sihɔn mini Bashan Naa Ogi tiŋgbana mini di fɔntinsi ni di tintarisi ni di tiŋgbana maa puuni fɔntinsi zaa ti Gaad zuliya mini Rubin zuliya ni Yisifu bia Manaasa zuliya pirigili la.
en: So Moses gave the tribes of Gad, Reuben, and half of Manasseh the territory and towns that King Sihon the Amorite had ruled, as well as the territory and towns that King Og of Bashan had ruled.

dag: M mi bɛ tɛha mini bɛ tuma. N kanimina ni n ti laɣim zuliya kam mini tinzun yɛtɔɣa balibu kam nim zaa ka bɛ kana ti nya n jilima.
en: I know their thoughts and their deeds. I am coming to gather the people of all the nations. When they come together, they will see what my power can do.

dag: Bɛ mi bi zɔri Naawuni.
en: nor have they learned reverence for God.

dag: Yi ku niriba pam yi tiŋ ŋɔ puuni, ka zaŋ yi ni ku shɛb maa pali di solɔri zuɣu.
en: You have murdered so many people that the city is filled with dead bodies!.

dag: ni di chɛ ka bɛ ku wum waɣigbahiriba kukoya, bee n-wum waɣigbahiriba yila.
en: so it cant hear the snake charmers voice or the spells of a skillful enchanter.

dag: Daadam ni daa tahi kum na shɛm, lala ka daadam lan tahi kpiimba kum ni neebu gba na;.
en: For just as death came by means of a man, in the same way the rising from death comes by means of a man.

dag: Zaŋm a yɛla niŋ Yawɛ nuu ni; ka chɛ ka o tilig a. Chɛ ka o fa o nini ni tiɣi so bahi.
en: They say, Call to the Lord for help. Maybe he will save you. If he likes you so much, surely he will rescue you.

dag: ka yɛli Kɔra min o nyaandoliba maa, Biɛɣuni asiba Yawɛ sa ni wuh o ni pii so ni ŋun be kasi ni o ni yɛn chɛ ka so ka o sanna. O ni pii so, o ni chɛ ka dilan ka o sanna.
en: Then he said to Korah and his followers, Tomorrow morning the Lord will show us who belongs to him; he will let the one who belongs to him, that is, the one he has chosen, approach him at the altar.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa kari Filistianim maa ti bahi, ka lab bɛ suɣa ni ti di nɛma.
en: After chasing the Philistines, the Israelites came back to the Philistine camp and took many things from that camp.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli ma shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Cham ti zani Niriba Dunɔdal la ni, Juda nanim ni doli shɛli yira, ka lan dol li kpɛri la, ka lan chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm dunɔdaya zaa ni.
en: The Lord said to me, Jeremiah, go and announce my message at the People's Gate, through which the kings of Judah enter and leave the city; then go to all the other gates of Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Aduna daa niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm maa n-zaŋ li ti zali baɣili Alikauli Adaka la.
en: As the Lord had commanded Moses, Aaron put it in front of the Covenant Box, so that it could be kept.

dag: Ka Judanim daa bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu ka yi kana ti liri ti? Ka bɛ yɛli, Ti kamina ni ti ti lo Samsin mihi n-zaŋ o chaŋ ti niŋ o o ni niŋ ti shɛm labisi.
en: The men of the tribe of Judah asked them, Why have you Philistines come here to fight us? They answered, We have come to get Samson. We want to make him our prisoner. We want to punish him for what he has done to our people.

dag: Ti yi nya wahala, di nyɛla yi suhumaabo mini yi tiliginsim nyabu zuɣu; ka ti yi nya suhumaabo, di nyɛla yi suhumaabo shɛli yi ni nyari yi ni niŋdi suɣilo n-diri wahala shɛŋa ti gba ni diri la zuɣu.
en: We suffer in the hope that you will be comforted and saved. And because we are comforted, you will also be comforted, as you patiently endure suffering like ours.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa garigi yɛli Iso, M pun zaŋ o leeg a dana, ka zaŋ o mabihi zaa leeg o daba; ka zaŋ kawana mini wain ti o. M bia, ka bɔ ka n ni tooi lan niŋ ti a mi.
en: Isaac replied to Esau, Ive already made him more powerful than you, and Ive made all of his brothers his servants. Ive made him strong with grain and wine. What can I do for you, my son.

dag: Ka o daa ti tim ti yɛli Dauda, N tuhi nyaŋ Rabanim maa hal ka fa bɛ tin shɛli din mali kom la gba.
en: Joab sent messengers to David and said, I have fought against Rabbah and have captured its water supply.

dag: Naawuni daa niŋ alibarika ŋɔ niŋla bɛn guni kɔŋko ni bee o daa niŋ li niŋ bɛn bi guni gba ni? Ti pun yɛli ni Naawuni daa zaŋ ti yab Ibrahimma zali wuntia zaani la o yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: Is this state of happiness only for the circumcised or is it also for those who arent circumcised? We say, Faith was credited to Abraham as righteousness.

dag: Amaa faɣiri dibu zuɣu yi zaŋdi bɛn mali taali bahira, ka lee mɔŋdi bɛn ka taali yɛlimaŋli.
en: You accept bribes to let the guilty go free, and you cheat the innocent out of a fair trial.

dag: siɣim dapulli maa zuɣu na tilig amaŋa.
en: Save yourself and come down from that cross.

dag: N ni yɛri ya shɛm ŋɔ, sokam zaa ka n yɛra, Di gbihiriya.
en: I tell you this, and I say it to everyone: Be ready.

dag: Niŋmiya bɛ ni zali ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam: Ŋun simdi ni a yo lampoo zuɣu o sani, nyin yom o; ka ŋun deerila farigu, nyin tim o; ka ŋun simdi ni a lu o sizuura, nyin lum o sizuura; ka ŋun mi simdi ni a ti o jilima, nyin tim o jilima.
en: Give everyone what you owe them. If you owe them any kind of tax, then pay it. Show respect to those you should respect. And show honor to those you should honor.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa yi Jeemsi zuɣu, ka daa lan yi o tuumba la zaa gba zuɣu.
en: Then he appeared to James, then to all the apostles.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti ka o tooni na ni wumpaɣibo; ka chɛ ka ti yɔnya suhupiɛlli vuri yili yila paɣ o!.
en: Lets come before him with thanks! Lets shout songs of joy to him!.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Ɛhud daa yi zɔntua maa ni na ka vooi di dunoya yo n-kpari li pa o zuɣu.
en: Then Ehud went outside, closed the doors behind him, locked them.

dag: ni Chɛsɛd ni Hazo ni Pilidash ni Jidilaf ni Bɛtuɛl.
en: Then there are Kesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel.

dag: N ni nyaŋ o dimnim ti o, ka ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je o.
en: I will destroy his enemies before his eyes. I will defeat those who hate him.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, yinima ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm ku lan kum. Yi Duuma nyɛla nambɔzɔra, ka yi yi kum niŋ o, o ni wum ka garigi ya.
en: People in Zion, who live in Jerusalem, you will weep no longer. God will certainly be merciful to you. Hearing the sound of your outcry, God will answer you.

dag: Ka Filistianim nanim daa ti laɣim ni bɛ mali bɛ buɣili Dagɔn; ka diɛm suhupiɛlli diɛma; dama bɛ daa yɛlimi, Ti buɣili n-zaŋ ti dim Samsin niŋ ti nuu ni maa.
en: The Philistine rulers threw a big party and sacrificed a lot of animals to their god Dagon. The rulers said: Samson was our enemy, but our god Dagon helped us capture him!.

dag: Yaakubu zuliya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ti kpalim ka zuliya pam gili ba ni ti bemi kaman gbuɣinli m-be mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri san la. Bɛ ni ti bemi kaman gbuɣin polli n-yi piɛri zuɣu n-tim bɛ ni n-no ba sɔŋ ka dari tɔhi ba, ka so kani ŋun ni fa ba bahi la.
en: At present they are scattered, but later they will attack, as though they were fierce lions pouncing on sheep. Their enemies will be torn to shreds, with no one to save them;.

dag: N ni daa ŋmahi bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu dihi niriba tusaanu la, piɛr ala ka yi daa lee laɣisi di zaɣ chɛhi pali? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Piɛri pinaayi.
en: when I broke the five loaves for the five thousand people? How many baskets full of leftover pieces did you take up? Twelve, they answered.

dag: M bia, di chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔnim faai ka chɛ a. Kul gbibi yɛm maŋli mini tɛhi wɔɣila.
en: My child, hold on to your wisdom and insight. Never let them get away from you.

dag: Di simdi ni yi gba yihi yi ni deei zaka binshɛŋa zaa Izraɛlnim sani maa mi zaka ti Yawɛ, ka zaŋ din nyɛ Yawɛ dini maa ti maligumaana Aduna.
en: In this way you also will present the special contribution that belongs to the Lord from all the tithes which you receive from the Israelites. You are to give this special contribution for the Lord to Aaron the priest.

dag: M min a yi nyaɣisi pam; ti yi pahila salo zuɣu be Naawuni jɛmbu duu.
en: It was so pleasant when together we entered Gods house with the crowd.

dag: ni Jɛrusalɛm naa ni Hiburɔn naa.
en: the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron.

dag: Kpiimba biɛhigu shee mini chiyaama buɣim kul dola palɔni Yawɛ sani, ka wula ka ninsalinim suhuri ni yɛla ku do palo ni o sani.
en: If the Lord can see everything in the world of the dead, he can see in our hearts.

dag: Sintani daa pun niŋ tɛha niŋ Judas ŋun daa nyɛ Saimɔn Isikariɔt bia la suhu ni ni o yi Yisa nyaaŋa. Yisa min o nyaandoliba ni daa ti laɣim diri yuŋ bindirigu saha shɛli.
en: Even before the evening meal started, the devil had made Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, decide to betray Jesus.

dag: Yɛlimiya Yisifu, Jaande chɛl a biɛyanim ŋɔ ni daa tum a taal shɛl la. Pumpɔŋɔ, tinim bɛn nyɛ a yaannim Naawuni daba ŋɔ suhir a mi, chɛl ti ni daa tum a taal shɛli maa ti ti. Bɛ ni daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ yɛli Yisifu, o daa kummi.
en: This is what you should say to Joseph. Please, forgive your brothers sins and misdeeds, for they did terrible things to you. Now, please forgive the sins of the servants of your fathers God. Joseph wept when they spoke to him.

dag: Ka Musa mini Aduna daa ka Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa tooni na.
en: Then Moses and Aaron went to the front of the Meeting Tent.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ nina niŋ liti ka bɛ ku tooi nya, ka chɛ ka bɛ wahala leei ʒi tibisili m-marigi ba sahakam.
en: Their eyes should be darkened so they cant see, and their backs always bent. .

dag: Anabi Musa daa ʒe yim Naawuni niriba zaa sani kaman yilibia la ni o di Naawuni ni ti yɛn yɛli binshɛŋa yɛla la shɛhira;.
en: Moses was a faithful servant and told God's people what would be said in the future.

dag: ka salo pam daa kul kabiri dol o, ka o daa tib barinim bɛn be bɛ ni.
en: Large crowds followed him, and he healed them.

dag: Ka bɛn ti nya a ni ti kpaai bɛ nina kpa a ka di gari ba ka bɛ bɔhira, Pa doo ŋɔ n-daa dam dunia zaa, ka chɛ ka dabiɛm kpe zuliya kam zaa la?.
en: The dead will stare and gape at you. They will ask, Is this the man who shook the earth and made kingdoms tremble?.

dag: Naawuni ni chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb tuumbiɛri taali paŋ ba min o ni kpihim shɛb daalahichi mal alibarika.
en: It is a great blessing when people are forgiven for the wrongs they have done, when their sins are erased!.

dag: ka naɣ kɔri bɛba ayopɔin shɛb bɛn kul gaŋsigaŋsi daa yina n-ka bɛ sanna, ka n nini daa na ʒi n-nya bɛ tatabo Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Then seven other cows came up which were thin and bony. They were the poorest cows I have ever seen anywhere in Egypt.

dag: Ka di zuɣu chɛ ka tarimba mali tahima, ka putɔɣunim fo bɛ noya.
en: So the poor have hope; God shuts the mouths of those who would cause them harm.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka n daa wum ka o tahi pam yɛli, Yinim bɛn yɛn darigi tiŋ ŋɔ tibili, vumiya mirina. Sokam zaŋm o bidibbini gbib o nuu ni.
en: Then God shouted to the leaders in charge of punishing the city. Each leader had his own destructive weapon in his hand.

dag: Di zuɣu ka ti mali m-be kasi Yisa Masia ni daa tum Naawuni yubu, ka zaŋ omaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ mali sara yim ka di yɛla naai zaa la zuɣu.
en: Jesus Christ did the things God wanted him to do. And because of that, we are made holy through the sacrifice of Christs body. Christ made that sacrifice one time—enough for all time.

dag: Ka Naa Rɛhɔbɔam daa zaɣisi kpamba la ni daa wuh o shɛm la, ka zaŋla yɛtɔɣ yoli yɛli niriba maa.
en: King Rehoboam did not listen to the advice from the older men, and he was rude to the people.

dag: M mabihi mini n zɔnim zuɣu, n ni yɛli, Chɛ ka suhudoo be a ni.
en: For the good of my family and neighbors, I pray that there will be peace here.

dag: Piɛbimiya kikaa goli palli dali, ka piɛbimi li goli maa yi ti niŋ goli muni ni ti chuɣu puhibu dali.
en: Blow the rams horn at the time of the new moon and at the time of the full moon, when our festival begins.

dag: ka chɛliya ka barinim bɛn be nimaani kpaŋ, ka yɛliya ba ni Naawuni nam miri ba.
en: heal the sick in that town, and say to the people there, The Kingdom of God has come near you.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa ti chɛ ka bɛ kɔrigi noombil yino niŋ yaɣiri duɣu ni kɔzɔrim kom ni.
en: The priest will order someone to kill one of the birds over a clay pot of spring water.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa chaŋ Sukɔt ti yɛli ba, N-nyɛ Zɛba mini Zalimuna. Yi daa mɔŋ m mini n tɔbbi shɛb di ni daa wum pam la bindirigu, ka maani ma ansarisi yɛra, A na bi gbahi Zɛba mini Zalimuna n-kpɛh a nuu ni, ka bɔzuɣu ka ti lee yɛn ti a bindirigu? .
en: Then Gideon went to the men of Sukkoth and said, Remember when you refused to help me? You said that you couldn't give any food to my exhausted army because I hadn't captured Zebah and Zalmunna yet. Well, here they are.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zaŋ o nuu tim o koligu ni yihi kuɣili niŋ o kuɣilɔŋ ni n-zaŋ labi Filistia doo maa gbɛɣu, ka kuɣili maa chaŋ ti firi o gbɛɣu maa ni, ka o lu m-pil o puli zuɣu, ka o nini kpa tiŋa.
en: He reached into his bag and took out a stone, which he slung at Goliath. It hit him on the forehead and broke his skull, and Goliath fell face downward on the ground.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Dinzuɣu Naa Siiza ni su shɛli, yin zaŋmiya li ti o; Naawuni mi ni su shɛli, yin zaŋmiya li ti ŋun Naawuni.
en: He said to them, Then give to Caesar what belongs to Caesar, and give to God what belongs to God.

dag: Pa ninsal yɛm yɛtɔɣa ka ti mali wuhiri yɛla ŋɔ maa, amaa di nyɛla yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa Naawuni Shia Kasi ni zaŋ wuhi ti, ka ti mi mal li kahigiri Naawuni Shia yɛla wuhiri bɛn mali Naawuni Shia.
en: So then, we do not speak in words taught by human wisdom, but in words taught by the Spirit, as we explain spiritual truths to those who have the Spirit.

dag: Ka o daa suhi Yawɛ, ka Yawɛ wuh o ti shɛli wulli ka o daa zaŋ li na ti lɔhi kom maa ni, ka di niŋ nyaɣisim. Nimaani ka Yawɛ daa zali ba zaligu, ka zahim ba.
en: Moses prayed earnestly to the Lord , and the Lord showed him a piece of wood, which he threw into the water; and the water became fit to drink. There the Lord gave them laws to live by, and there he also tested them.

dag: Yi daa be muɣisigu ni ka kuhi boli ma, ka n tiligi ya. N daa bela n daashili biɛhigu shee din nyɛ saa tahibu la puuni, ka garigi ya. N daa zahim ya Mɛriba kom la shee.
en: In distress you cried out, so I rescued you. I answered you in the secret of thunder. I tested you at the waters of Meribah. Selah.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ lala, dama binshɛŋa din chihira ka nyɛ Yawɛ ni je shɛŋa zaa, bɛ niŋdi li tiri bɛ wuna maa, dama hal bɛ daa mi n-zaŋ bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi nyo buɣim mali bɛ wuna maa.
en: Do not worship the Lord your God in the way they worship their gods, for in the worship of their gods they do all the disgusting things that the Lord hates. They even sacrifice their children in the fires on their altars.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri suhuri kul bɔrila zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu, bɛ bi zɔri bɛ ʒiʒiinitab nambɔɣu.
en: Wicked people desire evil; their neighbors receive no mercy from them.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yoli, a zaɣisi ti ka filim ti. Ka ti tɔbbihi yi chani tɔb tuhibu, a lan ka bɛ sani.
en: But now youve rejected and humiliated us. You no longer accompany our armies.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Paɣimiya Yawɛ yuli. Yinim bɛn nyɛ Yawɛ daba.
en: Praise the Lord ! Praise his name, you servants of the Lord .

dag: Yisa Masia yɛla ba jila yi sunsuuni ka yi palɔni.
en: This proves that what we told you about Christ is true.

dag: N yuya ni n ʒe yim n soya ni, ka lala chɛ ka n tooi dol a zaligunima!.
en: How I wish my ways were strong when it comes to keeping your statutes!.

dag: Saɣisim a bihi, ka bɛ ti a vuhim, ka ti a suhupiɛlli.
en: Correct your children whenever they are wrong. Then you will always be proud of them. They will never make you ashamed.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa bɔhi, O yɛn kula omaŋ zuɣu n-chɛ ka o yɛli ni o ni chani luɣ shɛli maa ti ku tooi ka nimaani na maa.
en: So the Jewish authorities said, He says that we cannot go where he is going. Does this mean that he will kill himself.

dag: Di saha ka Zɔfar ŋun daa nyɛ Naama nir la daa garigi yɛli.
en: Zophar from Naamah said.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ poya yɛli ka n wum: Yiya pam ni ti zani dabari, ka so ti ku be yiya din galisi mini yiya din viɛl ni.
en: But the Lord All-Powerful has made this promise to me: Those large and beautiful homes will be left empty, with no one to take care of them.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yi zoli maa zuɣu n-siɣirina ka Yisa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni yɛli, Miriya ka yi yɛli so yi ni nya shɛli ʒii maa ni maa yɛla, faashee Daadam Bia kum ni neebu nyaaŋa.
en: As they came down the mountain, Jesus ordered them, Don't tell anyone about this vision you have seen until the Son of Man has been raised from death.

dag: Yi mi di ŋmariya tab ʒiri, dama yi pun yihi biɛr kurili la mini di miligu yɛla bahi.
en: Dont lie to each other. Take off the old human nature with its practices.

dag: Din bi tuhi tumbu zaa nyɛla alahichi, amaa alahichi shɛŋa tumbu beni m-pala din tahiri nir kum ni.
en: Doing wrong is always sin. But there is sin that does not lead to eternal death.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka ti chaŋ Siizaria nti kpe Filip ŋun daa nyɛ Yisa lahibal suŋ molomoona la yiŋa. O daa nyɛla tuuli cheechi kpamba ayopɔin la ni yino.
en: The next day we left and came to Caesarea. We went to the house of Philip the evangelist, one of the Seven, and stayed with him.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ tummi sara maligu shee mini sara maligu bimbini maa gbini tuma, ka di chɛ ka n suhu ku lan yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu.
en: You and your sons alone must fulfill the responsibilities for the Holy Place and the altar, so that my anger will not again break out against the people of Israel.

dag: Pool ni daa tɔɣisiri ni o zab omaŋ zuɣu maa, ka Gomna Fɛstus ti duh o yee yɛl o, Pool, di ni bɔŋɔ a kpɛla yinyari! A baŋsim pam zuɣu n-chɛ ka a kpe yinyari maa.
en: As Paul defended himself in this way, Festus shouted at him, You are mad, Paul! Your great learning is driving you mad.

dag: Firawuna yuri min o chɛchɛbunsi ni o chɛchɛbunduhiriba la ni daa siɣi teeku maa puuni, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka teeku maa kom lan nahi taba n-lim ba, amaa Izraɛlnim maa bɛn daa dolila teeku tiŋ kuŋ zuɣu ti du.
en: The Israelites walked through the sea on dry ground. But when the Egyptian chariots with their horses and drivers went into the sea, the Lord brought the water back, and it covered them.

dag: Dama yɛm so salima nɛma, ka a ku tooi zaŋ a ni bɔri binshɛŋa zaa buɣisi yɛm.
en: I am Wisdom, I am better than jewels; nothing you want can compare with me.

dag: Dama n ni ti zo ba nambɔɣu bɛ biriginsim puuni, ka ti ku lan teei bɛ daalahichi yɛla hal abada.
en: because I will be lenient toward their unjust actions, and I wont remember their sins anymore. .

dag: Dama din yɛn niŋ ninsalinima, dina n-yɛn niŋ biŋkɔbiri gba. Ninsalinim kpirimi ka biŋkɔbiri gba kpira. Vuhim yini ka bɛ zaa mali. Ka ninsal bi so biŋkɔbigu. Dimbɔŋɔ zaa nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: The same thing happens to animals and to people—they die. People and animals have the same breath. Is a dead animal different from a dead person? It is all so senseless!.

dag: Ka Babilɔnnim daa nyo nayili mini niriba yiya buɣim, ka daai Jɛrusalɛm goma luhi.
en: The army of Babylon set fire to the kings palace and the houses of the people of Jerusalem. And they broke down the walls of Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa boli Ibram na nti bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ ma lala? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a bi yɛli ma ni o nyɛla a paɣa?.
en: So Pharaoh summoned Abram and said, Whats this youve done to me? Why didnt you tell me she was your wife?.

dag: yɛra, Mbaye! Mbaye, tin titali din daa ye binyɛr piɛlli mini ago ni mulifu, ka salima ni waya ni kuɣ viɛla bina nyaɣim di luɣilikam la!.
en: They will say, Terrible! How terrible for the great city! She was dressed in fine linen; she wore purple and scarlet cloth. She was shining with gold, jewels, and pearls!.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka maligumaana maa zaŋ paɣ maa mirina ti zali Yawɛ tooni;.
en: The priest will lead the woman to my altar and make her stand there.

dag: Apaim bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Ishi, Ishi bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Shɛshan, Shɛshan bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Ahilai.
en: Appaims son was Ishi. Ishis son was Sheshan. Sheshans son was Ahlai.

dag: Ka n daa lan bo da shɛŋa bɛ ni daa mali nyɔri sara maligu binyara buɣim la na di bɔbu saha; ka daa lan chɛ ka bɛ tahiri tiwala din daŋ moobu na. Yaa n Naawuni, teemi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha yɛla, ka niŋ ma zaɣ viɛlli.
en: And I made sure that people will bring gifts of wood and the first part of their harvest at the right times. My God, remember me for doing these good things.

dag: Ka Ɛhab daa yɛl o, Cham gili tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ kulibɔna mini vinvama zaa ni nti lihi nya ti ni nya mɔri ti ti yuri mini ti buntaansi ŋɔ n-tiligi ba din ni chɛ ka ti ku kɔŋ bɛ shɛba.
en: and said, We have to find something for our horses and mules to eat. If we don't, we will have to kill them. Let's look around every creek and spring in the country for some grass.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ wɔbinyina mali nam ʒiishe titali, ka zaŋ salima alali dihi li nachiinsi.
en: The king also had a large throne made. Part of it was covered with ivory and the rest of it was covered with pure gold.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Yɛlim ba, Di chaŋya ti tuhi ba, dama n ku be yi sani, di yi pa lala yi dimnim maa ni nyaŋ ya. .
en: But the Lord said, Moses, warn them not to go into the hill country. I won't help them fight, and their enemies will defeat them.

dag: Ka Naa Jɔsia ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛŋa bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafinim la ni.
en: Everything else Josiah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: Ti Naawuni daalibarika nuu daa pa ti zuɣu ka bɛ daa zaŋ Shɛrɛbia ŋun yi Mahili ŋun daa nyɛ Lɛvi bia ni Izraɛl yaaŋa zuliya ni na la ti ti. O min o dɔɣiriba ni o bidibisi kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pisaayika.
en: Through God's grace they sent us Sherebiah, an able man, a Levite from the clan of Mahli; and eighteen of his sons and brothers came with him.

dag: Wuntizɔriba je ninvuɣ biɛri yɛlli, ka ninvuɣ biɛri gba je wuntizɔriba yɛlli.
en: Good people think the wicked are disgusting, and the wicked feel disgust for those who are honest.

dag: Yi ni pun mi dimbɔŋɔ yɛla zaa la yoli, m bɔri ni n teei ya ni Naawuni ŋun daa tiligi Izraɛlnima n-yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, di nyaaŋa o daa ti bahi bɛ ni bɛn daa bi niŋ yɛda la yoli.
en: I want to help you remember some things you already know: Remember that the Lord saved his people by bringing them out of the land of Egypt. But later he destroyed all those who did not believe.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so yi be Masia ni, o biɛhigu leela biɛr palli; nyama, ka o biɛr kurili la din gari; ka biɛr palli maa deei di zaani zani.
en: When anyone is in Christ, it is a whole new world. The old things are gone; suddenly, everything is new!.

dag: Zaliguzaɣisibutali pun be di tuma tumbu ni, amaa din yɛn niŋ maa na ku niŋ faashee Naawuni ti vuui ŋun taɣi di niŋbu zali maa.
en: The hidden plan to live without any law is at work now, but it will be secret only until the one who is holding it back is out of the way.

dag: Naa Sulemaana daa nyɛla bundana ni yɛndana n-gari dunia ŋɔ ni nanim zaa.
en: King Solomon was richer and wiser than any other king.

dag: Kumiya bɛ naɣilahi zaa. Kɔrimiya ba. Mbusim be bɛ zuɣu, dama bɛ biɛɣu neeya, bɛ tibidarigibo saha paaya.
en: Kill all their soldiers! Slaughter them! The people of Babylonia are doomed! The time has come for them to be punished! .

dag: Di chɛ ka ʒiɛyimtali mini yɛlimaŋli yi a kɔbili ni. Zaŋmi li lo a nyiŋgol ni, ka sab li niŋ a suhu ni.
en: Dont let loyalty and faithfulness leave you. Bind them on your neck; write them on the tablet of your heart.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ pateesa yili Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa dunoli.
en: He also set up the screen at the entrance to the dwelling.

dag: Gbib a tima min a tabibi tima maa. A bilim ni ha ka a pun mal li tumdi tuma. Di pa shɛli di ni sɔŋ a bee di pa shɛli di ni kpɛh a dimnim dabiɛm.
en: Keep all your magic spells and charms; you have used them since you were young. Perhaps they will be of some help to you; perhaps you can frighten your enemies.

dag: Dinzuɣu di nyɛnya jɛra, amaa bomiya baŋ ti Duuma yubu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Because of this, dont be ignorant, but understand the Lords will.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab daa chaŋ naa sani ti yɛl o, ka naa daa chɛ ka bɛ boli Absalom, ka o kana ti damdi naa tooni, ka naa daa mɔɣis o kpariŋ.
en: Joab went to the king and reported this to him. Then the king called for Absalom, and Absalom came to the king. He bowed low out of respect, nose to the ground before the king. Then the king kissed Absalom.

dag: Nyama, m bolila Uri bia Bɛzalɛl ŋun nyɛ Hur yaaŋa ka nyɛ Juda zuliya ni nir la.
en: I have chosen Bezalel, the son of Uri and grandson of Hur, from the tribe of Judah.

dag: Naa Jɔsia ni daa wum Naawuni zaligu kundi maa ni yɛli shɛm, o daa darigimi toog omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu.
en: When Josiah heard what was in The Book of God's Law , he tore his clothes in sorrow.

dag: ka o ninni biɛhigu daa taɣi, ka di muɣis o pam hal ka o kɔba ni ti dii chɔɣisichɔɣisi, ka o duna ŋmɛri taba.
en: King Belshazzar was very afraid. His face became white from fear, and his knees were shaking and knocking together. He could not stand up because his legs were too weak.

dag: Paɣ viɛla ni paɣ viɛlli, a bi mi? Doli piɛri maa naba n-zaŋ a buhi chaŋ ka bɛ ti ŋub mɔri luɣ shɛli din miri piɛguliba tanti suɣa la.
en: You are such a beautiful woman. Surely you know what to do. Go, follow the sheep. Feed your young goats near the shepherds tents.

dag: Mɛnahɛm ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o ni daa pun niŋ shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sabi di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: Everything else that Menahem did is recorded in The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Dama n ni zab tiŋ ŋɔ zuɣu n-tiligi li mmaŋmaŋ zuɣu ni n dabili Dauda zuɣu. .
en: I will protect this city and save it. I will do this for myself and for my servant David.

dag: Yawɛ zaŋm o nina lihi ya, ka niŋ ya nirilim.
en: and that he will show you mercy and kindness.

dag: Naŋgban yini maa ni ka alibarika niŋbu mini turi zaa yirina. M mabihi, di bi niŋ kamaata ni di nyɛ lala!.
en: Words of thanksgiving and cursing pour out from the same mouth. My friends, this should not happen!.

dag: Di saha Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim pina ni lan tiɣiri Yawɛ nini kaman di ni daa pun tiɣir o nini shɛm kurimbuni ha mini yuun shɛŋa din gari ni la.
en: The offering of Judah and Jerusalem will be pleasing to the LORD as in ancient days and in former years.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa daa yi Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu maa ni na, ka o mini Jeemsi ni Jɔn daa chaŋ ti kpe Saimɔn mini Anduru yiŋa.
en: Jesus and his disciples, including James and John, left the synagogue and went straight to the home of Simon and Andrew.

dag: M bi ʒiini ninvuɣ yoya sani, bee ka m mini bilikɔɣinim ti mali jina ni taba.
en: I don't spend my time with worthless liars.

dag: Naawuni yi be ti sani, ti ni di nasara. Ŋuna n-yɛn du n-tam ti dimnim zuɣu.
en: With God we will triumph: God is the one who will trample our adversaries.

dag: Dimiya li luɣ kasi shee, dama di nyɛla a min a bidibisi maa dihili bɛ ni zaŋ shɛli nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ maa puuni, dama lala ka o zali ma.
en: The Lord has said that this belongs to you and your sons, and that it must be eaten in a holy place.

dag: Ka Manɔa bɔh o, A yɛligu maa yi ti niŋ pali, bia maa biɛhigu ti yɛn nyɛla wula, ka tuun bɔ ka o lee ti yɛn tum.
en: Manoah then asked, When your promise comes true, what rules must he obey and what will be his work.

dag: Di chɛliya ka so zaŋ yɛtɔɣ yoya yɔhim ya, dama dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu ka Naawuni suhu kul yiɣisiri bahiri bɛn bi deer o noli zuɣu.
en: Nobody should deceive you with stupid ideas. Gods anger comes down on those who are disobedient because of this kind of thing.

dag: O daa di nam su Izraɛlnim la yuun pihinahi, o daa di nam ʒini Hiburɔn la yuma ayopɔin, ka ʒini Jɛrusalɛm mi yuun pihitanaata.
en: for years. He ruled from Hebron for years and from Jerusalem for years.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti lan yiɣisi nimaani chaŋ ti dɔni Zɛrɛd vinvamli ni.
en: They left that place and camped in Zered Valley.

dag: Fara yi gbaag a mabia ka o kɔh o tiŋgban shɛli ti a, o daŋ ni ninvuɣ so ŋun pa o zuɣu n-ni kana ti yo o mabia maa ni kɔhi shɛli maa zuɣu ka deei li.
en: If someone in your country becomes very poor and must sell their property, a close relative must come and buy it back.

dag: Pita ni daa kul yɛri maa ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa siɣi bɛnkam daa wum yɛligu maa zuɣu na.
en: While Peter was still speaking, the Holy Spirit fell on everyone who heard the word.

dag: Bɔ saha ka a lee yɛn chɛ yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu? A noli ni yɛtɔɣa maa ŋmanila pɔhim.
en: How long will you talk and keep saying nothing?.

dag: Ŋuna n-chɛ ka kom yi tampima ni na zɔra, ka chɛ ka kɔzɔrim yi chɛbili kuɣili ni na.
en: He is the one who caused water to flow from a rock. He made a spring of water flow from that hard rock.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ kɔniŋdi bini maa zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa nudirigu polo zaŋ labi wulimpuhili polo lɔrigi ni.
en: Then he put the large bronze tank on the right side of the Temple on the southeast side.

dag: Asiba zaŋ chaŋ zaawuni bɛ pun kpi. Bɛ kul kpirimi zaa, ka bi mi di yɛla.
en: From dawn to sunset people are destroyed. They die—gone forever—and no one even notices.

dag: Ka Juda daa bɔh o, N dana, wula ka ti lee lan yɛn yɛl a? Ti ka ti ni yɛn yɛli shɛm. Bee wula ka ti yɛn tooi niŋ tɔɣisi yi? Naawuni nya tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ taali ni nyɛ shɛli; ti mini bɛ ni nya pipia ŋɔ so sani maa zaa leela nyini n dan daba.
en: Judah replied, What can we say to my master? What words can we use? How can we prove we are innocent? God has found your servants guilty. We are now your slaves, all of us, including the one found with the cup.

dag: Amaa ka o yɛl o, A tizo pun kana ti yɔhim ma deeg a daalibarika.
en: Isaac answered, Your brother came and deceived me. He has taken away your blessing.

dag: Nir ni tooi gbaai baandɔɣu niŋ o nuu ni, amaa o bela nanim yinsi.
en: lizards are small enough to catch with your hands, but you can find them living in kings palaces.

dag: Ka toli daa yi nyɔhi maa ni lu tiŋgban ni na, ka Naawuni daa zaŋ nɔnsi yiko tatabo ti ba.
en: Locusts came out of the smoke and covered the earth. They were given the same power that scorpions have.

dag: Cham maligumaaniba zuɣulan Hilikia sani nti chɛ ka o mali dunɔguliba bɛn zaani Naawuni jɛmbu duu dunol ni n-deeri laɣ shɛli niriba ni zaŋdi tahiri Yawɛ jɛmbu duu na la laasabu.
en: and ask Hilkiah the high priest to collect from the guards all the money that the people have donated.

dag: ni di taɣi Sintani bahi ka o ku nyaŋ ti, dama ti bi be ʒilinsi ni zaŋ chaŋ o yikombiɛri tuma la polo.
en: in order to keep Satan from getting the upper hand over us; for we know what his plans are.

dag: Ashaaranim kul yɛn tuɣila taba, ka bɛ kul wumdi ŋumaŋuma luɣilikam. Bɛ ti kul yɛn bɔrila ʒii nyabu anabinim sani. Maligumaaniba wuhibu ni ti naai, ka ninkura kpamli yɛtɔɣa ti naai.
en: One tragedy will follow another, and you'll hear only bad news. People will beg prophets to give them a message from me. Priests will stop teaching my Law, and wise leaders won't be able to give advice.

dag: yi mi miriya ka yi tam Man Yawɛ ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛl la yɛla. Kul miriya ka yi jɛm buɣa.
en: Dont forget the covenant that I made with you. Dont worship other gods.

dag: O kabiri daanya dunoyɔriti ka kabiri kuriti dunokparitisi.
en: He breaks down doors of bronze and smashes iron bars.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, N ku tooi zaŋ n ni tum shɛm buɣisi yi ni tum shɛm. Hal yinim Ifriim zuliya niriba ni tum biɛla shɛli maa gari tinim Abiɛza daŋ niriba ni tum shɛm zaa.
en: But Gideon answered the men of Ephraim, I have not done as well as you. You people of Ephraim have a much better harvest than my family, the Abiezers. At harvest time you leave more grapes in the vineyard than my family gathers! Isnt that true?.

dag: Bee bɔ ka yi daa lee chaŋ ni yi ti nya? Nira ŋun bɔbi? Ka o lan yɛli, Nyamiya, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔbiri ka niŋdi bɛ suhu yubu bela nanim yinsi.
en: Really, what did you expect to see? Someone dressed in fine clothes? Of course not. People who wear fancy clothes and live in luxury are all in kings palaces.

dag: Ka tumtumda maa garigi yɛli Sool, M mali anzinfa laɣifu kpe, n ni zaŋ li ti Naawuni nir maa ka o wuhi ti ti ni yɛn doli so shɛli.
en: The servant answered, I have a small silver coin. I can give him that, and then he will tell us where we can find them.

dag: Mbusim be ninvuɣ so ŋun daa yɛli m ba, A paɣa dɔɣi bidibiga ka o suhu paligi la zuɣu.
en: Cursed be the one who delivered the news to my father, You have a son!— filling him with joy.

dag: ni o wuh o kpambaliba o ni bɔri shɛm, ka wuh o kpamba mi yɛm.
en: Joseph was in command of the officials, and he taught the leaders how to use wisdom.

dag: Bɛ mini Zɛrubabɛl ni Jɛshua ni Nɛhimia ni Sɛraya ni Reelaya ni Mɔdɛkai ni Bilishan ni Misipa ni Biɣivai ni Rɛhum ni Baana n-daa labi kuli. Izraɛl niriba kalinli ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: They came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, and Baanah. The family of Parosh .

dag: Ka bɛ ti tan ya daɣiri zuliyanim maa ninni, ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. .
en: And so the other nations will dishonor you, but you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: N tuumbiɛri dumi yaɣi n zuɣu, di tibisim bemi kaman ʒi shɛli din tibisi nyaŋ ma.
en: I am drowning in the flood of my sins; they are a burden too heavy to bear.

dag: Gbaamiya yimaŋa ni laɣiyubo, ka chɛliya ka yi nini tiɣi yi ni mali shɛli, dama Naawuni yɛliya, N kul ku chɛ a, ka mi ku bah a.
en: Keep your lives free from the love of money. And be satisfied with what you have. God has said, I will never leave you; I will never run away from you. Deuteronomy :.

dag: Di boliya so yi ba dunia ŋɔ ni, dama Naawuni yino ŋun bɛ alizanda ni ŋɔ kɔŋko n-nyɛ yi ba.
en: And dont call anyone on earth Father. You have one Father. He is in heaven.

dag: Mani n-yi di nyɛ niriba ŋɔ toondana, n naan kpimsi Abimilɛk birili zaa. N naan yɛl o, Bom tɔbbihi pam pahi kana. .
en: If you make me the commander of these people, I will destroy Abimelech. I will say to him, Get your army ready and come out to battle.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yi yi ti bo ma ni yi suhuri zaa, yi ni nya ma.
en: When you search for me, yes, search for me with all your heart, you will find me.

dag: Piɛbil maa ni daa tabigi bintabinda maa ni din pah ata, ka n wum ka binnɛɔŋ ŋun pah ata yɛli, Kamina! Ka n daa lihi nya wɔr sabinli, ka ŋun bar o gbibi sania o nuu ni.
en: When he opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, Come! So I looked, and there was a black horse. Its rider held a balance for weighing in his hand.

dag: Ka di zuɣu chɛ ka n wuhi n kpiɔŋ mini n kasitali ka zuliya pam nya li, ka baŋ ma. Di saha ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Then I will show how great I am. I will prove that I am holy. Many nations will see me do these things, and they will learn who I am. Then they will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔ naŋgbankpeeni ka yi lee ŋmɛri maa.
en: Jesus asked, What are you arguing about with the teachers of the law.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ yuli din mali jilima ŋɔ. Jɛmmiya Yawɛ ni jilima din be kasi.
en: Give to the LORD the glory due his name! Bow down to the LORD in holy splendor!.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ garigi yɛli Yisa, Ti bi mi. Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Dindina n gba ku yɛli ya ŋun ti ma yiko shɛli n ni mali niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa maa.
en: and told Jesus, We don't know. Jesus replied, Then I won't tell you who gave me the right to do what I do.

dag: N yi be luɣ shɛlikam zaa, m malila a zaligunim maa yiini yila.
en: Your statutes have been my songs of praise wherever I lived as an immigrant.

dag: Nir yi niŋ ninvuɣ so ŋun bi ʒe yim naani a muɣisigu saha, di ŋmanila nyinvɔɣu bee napɔŋ din ka alaafee.
en: Depending on an unreliable person in a crisis is like trying to chew with a loose tooth or walk with a crippled foot.

dag: Yi niŋla yi takɔbiri naani, ka tumdi din chihira, ka yi zaa yinoyino bɔri yi tab paɣiba, yi ni tooi su tiŋgbɔŋ maa.
en: and spread violence throughout the land. Everything you do is wicked; you are even unfaithful in marriage. And you claim the land is yours!.

dag: Nyama, dabisi shɛŋa kanna ka n ni ti mɔŋ a min a yab yiŋnim zaa yaa, ka ninkurigu ti ku be yi daŋ maa ni yaha.
en: Listen, the time is coming when I will kill all the young men in your family and your clan, so that no man in your family will live to be old.

dag: nti duɣi n ni yuri bindir nyaɣisili shɛli n-zaŋ na ti ti ma ka n di, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni pɔi ka naanyi kpi.
en: Cook me some of that tasty food that I like, and bring it to me. After I have eaten it, I will give you my final blessing before I die.

dag: Yɛla ŋɔ zaa daa shiri niŋ Naa Nɛbukadnɛza.
en: All this happened to King Nebuchadnezzar.

dag: N tuumbiɛri dumi yaɣi n zuɣu, di tibisim bemi kaman ʒi shɛli din tibisi nyaŋ ma.
en: My wrongdoings are stacked higher than my head; they are a weight thats way too heavy for me.

dag: Zabimi n zuɣu n-tiligi ma. Dolimi n nyɛvili kaman a ni lo ma alikauli shɛm.
en: Argue my case and redeem me. Make me live again by your word.

dag: Amaa yinim Taiatiranim bɛn kpalim ka bi doli wuhibu maa, ka mi na bi bɔhim bɛ ni shɛb ni booni shɛli Sintani ashili yɛl kara tuma la, n yɛri ya mi ni n ku zaŋ ʒi tibisi shɛli n-ʒili ya.
en: As for the rest of you in Thyatira—those of you who dont follow this teaching and havent learned the so-called deep secrets of Satan—I wont burden you with anything else.

dag: Bɛ zaa kala damli dambu na. Ka bɛ nina kul lihiri tooni; ka laɣisiri daba kaman taŋkpaɣu la.
en: The one thing they all want to do is fight. Their armies will march fast like the wind in the desert. And the Babylonian soldiers will take many prisoners—as many as the grains of sand.

dag: Dama laɣiyubo nyɛla bin biɛɣukam nyaɣili; ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri daa kul ye liɣiri nyabu zuɣu la birigi ka chɛ yɛda niŋbu soli dolibu, ka suhugarigu balibu kam din be kaman piɛma la kuhi bɛ suhuri.
en: For the love of money is a source of all kinds of evil. Some have been so eager to have it that they have wandered away from the faith and have broken their hearts with many sorrows.

dag: Bɛ lan zaŋm la shɛŋa zaa bɛ ni mali tumdi tuma Luɣ kasi shee la n-guri chinchin sabilitim ni, ka zaŋ biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ pil li n-zaŋ li niŋ amaŋka maa ni.
en: Next, Aaron and his sons will take blue cloth and wrap all the objects used in worship at the sacred tent. These will need to be covered with a piece of fine leather, then placed on a carrying frame.

dag: Ka sokam ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-shiri ŋooi n takɔbi maa di tɔɣu ni ka ku lan labisi li su di tɔɣu maa ni yaha.
en: And everyone will know that I, the LORD, have taken my sword out of its sheath. It wont be put away again.

dag: Di saha maa Masia cheechinim din be Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni nim daa na ʒi ma ni bɛ nini.
en: But no one who belonged to Christ's churches in Judea had ever seen me in person.

dag: Ka yi lan wuhiri ni nir yi po sara maligu bimbini di pa taali, amaa ni nir yi po sara shɛli din pa bimbini maa zuɣu, shee ka o niŋ o ni po n-dalim yɛl shɛli maa.
en: You say, If people swear by the altar, its nothing. But if they swear by the gift on the altar, they are obligated to do what they swore.

dag: Pool daa ti chaŋ Dɛɛbi mini Listra gba. Yisa nyaandol so daa be nimaani ka o yuli booni Timoti. O ma daa nyɛla Yɛhudia paɣa ka nyɛ Yisa nyaandola, ka o ba mi nyɛ Giriiki doo.
en: Paul went to the city of Derbe and then to Lystra, where a follower of Jesus named Timothy lived. Timothys mother was a Jewish believer, but his father was a Greek.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Hazɔrinima, zomiya chaŋ katiŋa, sɔɣimiya voya ni. Dama Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ yi polo, ka mali shili gun ya.
en: People of Hazor, I, the Lord , warn you to run far away and hide. King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia has plotted against you, and this is what he says.

dag: Ka zama maa zaa daa jɛm Naawuni, ka baansi yiini yila, ka kikapiɛbiriba piɛbira hal ka buɣim ti di sara maligu binyara maa naai.
en: The whole congregation worshipped with singing choirs and blaring trumpets until the end of the entirely burned offering.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ zaɣ yino mali alahichi sanyoo sara, ka zaŋ ŋun la mi mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la; ka maligumaana maa mali sanyoo sara yo daɣ shɛli din daa yi o ni maa samli Yawɛ sani ti o.
en: The priest will perform a purification offering with one and an entirely burned offering with the other. In this way, the priest will make reconciliation for her before the LORD because of her unclean discharge.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ka a min a nyaandoliba maa zaa taai duŋ niŋ maa. Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Aduna ka yi ŋumdi yi kparima ni niŋd o.
en: You and your followers have rebelled against the Lord , not against Aaron.

dag: Bɛ lan ka yɛmbahiga bɛ chandi ni, ka bɛ ni lo nia shɛŋa luhi ba.
en: Their steps were firm, but now they stumble; they fall—victims of their own advice.

dag: Dinzuɣu Sihɔn min o niriba zaa ni daa yina ti liri ti n-tuhi ti Jahaz.
en: Sihon and all his forces came out to meet us in battle at Jahaz.

dag: Ka n ni daa du zoli zuɣu ni n ti deei kuɣ parilana ayi din nyɛ Yawɛ ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛli kuɣ parilana la, n daa kpalim be zoli maa zuɣu la wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ biɛɣ pihinahi. N daa bi di bindirigu bee n-nyu kom.
en: I went up the mountain to receive the stone tablets on which was written the covenant that the Lord had made with you. I stayed there forty days and nights and did not eat or drink anything.

dag: Hɛbɛr ŋun nyɛ Kɛn nir la paɣa Jaɛl mal alibarika pam paɣiba ni. Paɣ shɛb bɛn be tanti suɣa puuni, ŋuna m-mal alibarika.
en: Jael was the wife of Heber the Kenite. She will be blessed above all women.

dag: M bi zaɣisi ka n lili kpe zibisim ni, ka zibisim titali limsi n ninni.
en: Still Im not annihilated by darkness; he has hidden deep darkness from me.

dag: Azuba ni daa ti kpi, Kalɛb daa kpuɣila Ɛfirat, ka o daa dɔɣi Hur.
en: After the death of Azubah, Caleb married Ephrath, and they had a son named Hur.

dag: Yisa Masia yɛla ba jila yi sunsuuni ka yi palɔni.
en: The message about Christ has become so firmly established in you.

dag: Juda Naa Jɛhoyachin ni daa be tinzun tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihitanaayopɔin puuni gol so ŋun pahiri pinaayi biɛɣ pisinaayopɔin dali ka Ivilmɛrɔdak daa leei Babilɔn naa, ka niŋ Juda Naa Jɛhoyachin nirilim yih o sarika ni.
en: Jehoiachin was a prisoner in Babylon for years. Then Evil-Merodach became king of Babylonia, and in the first year of his rule, on the twenty-seventh day of the twelfth month, he let Jehoiachin out of prison.

dag: Kpiimba biɛhigu shee mihi gbaai ma, ka kum zana do n tooni.
en: The cords of the grave surrounded me; deaths traps held me tight.

dag: Ŋun boli ya maa nyɛla ŋun ni niŋ li, dama o nyɛla ŋun ʒe yim.
en: The one who chose you can be trusted, and he will do this.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa dii tuhiri nintɔri viɛr o ninni, ka ŋmɛr o nutala, ka shɛb labir o tapaɣisi.
en: Then some there spit in Jesus face, and they hit him with their fists. Others slapped him.

dag: Ka anabinim maa pihinu daa doli ba chaŋ ti kaɣ ʒe kpaŋ ha ka chɛ ba.
en: Fifty prophets followed Elijah and Elisha from Jericho, then stood at a distance and watched as the two men walked toward the river.

dag: Ka yi daa vu m-mirina ti zani zoli maa gbini, ka zoli maa daa taai buɣim n-kpuɣi du sagbana ni, ka sagbana daa zibigi lim li.
en: Tell your children how you went and stood at the foot of the mountain which was covered with thick clouds of dark smoke and fire blazing up to the sky.

dag: Bɛ ni daa sa Yawɛ jɛmbu shee suɣili maa dahin shɛli, ka sagbani daa sirigina ti pili Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili din nyɛ alikauli suɣili maa. Sagbani maa daa bela Yawɛ jɛmbu shee maa zuɣusaa m-be kaman buɣim la yuŋ zaŋ hal ni asiba.
en: On the day the Tent of the Lord 's presence was set up, a cloud came and covered it. At night the cloud looked like fire.

dag: ka zaŋ chi sara mini binnyura sara pahi naɣilahi maa mini piɛlahi maa ni piɛbihi maa zuɣu kaman bɛ kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Offer with them all the other offerings required for the first day.

dag: N daa nyala Shiina binyɛr suŋ mini anzinfa kpila, ka di tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram pirigili ni salin kpilli din mi tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram pirigili ka n kɔre kpe di ni, ka n kpuɣ li n-zaŋ li ti pi tiŋa n suɣili ni ka anzinfa maa be di gbinni.
en: In Jericho, I saw a beautiful coat from Babylonia, about pounds of silver, and about a pound of gold. I wanted these things for myself, so I took them. You will find them buried in the ground under my tent. The silver is under the coat.

dag: Paɣimi n tuumbiɛri zaa bahi, ka nyahi n daalahichi.
en: Wash away all my evil and make me clean from my sin!.

dag: Ijipti naa, a yɛnnim la lee be ya? Chɛ ka bɛ yɛl a Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛn niŋ Ijiptinim shɛm.
en: Where now are your wise ones? Let them tell you, let them inform you what the LORD of heavenly forces has planned concerning Egypt.

dag: N ni ti yɛn darigi Ijiptinim tibili shɛm m-bala. Di saha ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: When I punish Egypt in this way, they will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Di chɛ ka n ni yɛl a ni faashee bɛ maan labi dɔɣ a yaha maa niŋ a alahiziba.
en: Do not be surprised because I tell you that you must all be born again.

dag: Dinzuɣu di yi nyɛla n dan ni yɛli ma chi mini alikama ni wain ni kpa shɛli yɛla la dina, zaŋmi li ti tinim bɛn nyɛ n dan tumtumdiba ŋɔ na.
en: Go ahead and send the wheat, barley, olive oil, and wine you promised to pay my workers.

dag: Amaa ka Yɛhudianim daa zab nyuli n-chaŋ ti laɣim tiŋ maa ni ninvuɣ yoya n-chɛ ka bɛ dam tiŋ maa, ka chaŋ ti be n-gili Jeesɔn yiŋa n-yɛli ni bɛ yihim Pool mini Silas palɔni na ti ba.
en: But some Jews were jealous and gathered worthless loafers from the streets and formed a mob. They set the whole city in an uproar and attacked the home of a man named Jason, in an attempt to find Paul and Silas and bring them out to the people.

dag: Nyam n wahala ŋɔ, ka tiligi ma, dama m bi tam a zaligu yɛla.
en: I have not forgotten your Law! Look at the trouble I am in, and rescue me.

dag: Ka o daa mooni molo yɛra, Ŋun na be n nyaaŋa kanna mali yiko gari ma hal ka man pɔri gba ni n ti damd o tooni gbaag o namda mal o ka o pirigi.
en: He announced, One stronger than I am is coming after me. Im not even worthy to bend over and loosen the strap of his sandals.

dag: Ka o daa kpe duu maa ni, ka vooi dunoli yo bɛ niriba ayi maa niŋ, ka suhi Yawɛ.
en: He went in and closed the door behind the two of them. Then he prayed to the LORD.

dag: Dinzuɣu di gbihiriya, dama yi bi mi yil yidan ni ti yɛn kuna saha shɛli, amii zaawuni bee yuntisuɣu bee nolɔɣu kukoli bee biɛɣ asiba;.
en: Watch, then, because you do not know when the master of the house is coming—it might be in the evening or at midnight or before dawn or at sunrise.

dag: Ka Jokishan daa nyɛ Shiiba mini Dɛdan ba. Ka Dɛdan bihi daa nyɛ Ashurim mini Lɛtushim ni Liummim.
en: Jokshan became the father of Sheba and Dedan. Dedans sons were Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka buɣim di Gaza goma n-saɣim bɛ ni me goma gili luɣ shɛŋa zaa.
en: So I will send fire upon the city walls of Gaza and burn down its fortresses.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda maŋmaŋ yi daa bol o o Duuma, di chaŋ wula ka o ni lan nyɛ ŋun Naa Dauda yaaŋa? Ka Yisa yɛligu maa daa paligi salo maa suhuri pam.
en: David himself calls him Lord, so how can he be Davids son? The large crowd listened to him with delight.

dag: Dinzuɣu di gbihiriya, dama yi bi mi yil yidan ni ti yɛn kuna saha shɛli, amii zaawuni bee yuntisuɣu bee nolɔɣu kukoli bee biɛɣ asiba;.
en: You must always be ready. You dont know when the owner of the house will come back. He might come in the afternoon, or at midnight, or in the early morning, or when the sun rises.

dag: Yi yi ti tuui ŋɔri yi bɔrɔbɔro zim shɛli yin zaŋmiya di bɔrɔbɔro kpil yini ti pini kaman yi ni zaŋdi kabɔɣili ni chi tiri pini shɛm la.
en: When you bake bread, the first loaf of the first bread made from the new grain is to be presented as a special contribution to the Lord . This is to be presented in the same way as the special contribution you make from the grain you thresh.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛba n-yi Ijipti na, bɛ kul yɛrigila luɣ shɛlikam; kamina ti yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi bɛ zuɣu ti ma; di pa shɛli ka n tooi tuhi nyaŋ ba ka kari ba. .
en: to ask me to go to Moab and put a curse on the people who have come there from Egypt. They have settled everywhere around him, and he wants to run them off.

dag: Mɔdɛkai ni daa baŋ dinkam zaa niŋ maa, ka o suhu daa saɣim, ka o dar tɔh o situra, ka zaŋ buɣu pili, ka niŋ tampiligim puɣ o zuɣu n-yi n-kpe tiŋ puuni chani gindi kuhiri fabila kuhigu pampam ni suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: When Mordecai learned of all that had been done, he tore his clothes in anguish. Then he dressed in sackcloth, covered his head with ashes, and walked through the city, wailing loudly and bitterly.

dag: Ka naa daa zaŋ Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya maa n-leei tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛma n-zali Jɔab zaani, ka zaŋ maligumaana Zadok mi n-zali Abiata zaani.
en: The king made Benaiah commander of the army in Joab's place and put Zadok the priest in Abiathar's place.

dag: Do so daa be Jɛrusalɛm ka o yuli booni Simiɔn; o daa nyɛla ninvuɣ suŋ ka zɔri Naawuni ni o suhu zaa. Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa be o ni, ka o daa yuuni Izraɛlnim Tiligira kandina soli.
en: A man named Simeon was in Jerusalem. He was righteous and devout. He eagerly anticipated the restoration of Israel, and the Holy Spirit rested on him.

dag: M bihi, kul kpalimmiya be o ni pumpɔŋɔ, ka di chɛ ka o ti yi palo ka ti tooi mali suhukpeeni, ka ti ku tiri gbini n-zo o sani vi zuɣu o labbuna dali.
en: Yes, my dear children, live in him. If we do this, we can be without fear on the day when Christ comes again. We will not need to hide and be ashamed when he comes.

dag: Ka niriba maa yɛl o, Alizin biɛɣu n-naɣ ʒi a zuɣu! Ŋuni n-lee bɔri ni o ku a.
en: The crowd answered, You have a demon. Who wants to kill you.

dag: Di saha teeku ni nanim zaa ni ti yiɣisi bɛ nam ʒiishɛhi n-yeei bɛ nam kpariti mini bɛ ni wuɣi situr shɛŋa sɔŋ ni dabiɛm. Bɛ niŋgbuna ni ti sɔhira, ka bɛ teei ʒini tiŋa, ka a yɛla niŋ ba alahiziba, ka bɛ ni sɔhira sahakam.
en: The kings will step down from their thrones, then take off their royal robes and fancy clothes, and sit on the ground, trembling. They will be so shocked at the news of your defeat that they will shake in fear.

dag: Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili bɔpiɛligu ni yaɣibɔɣili din daa be Sukɔt mini Zarɛtan sunsuuni la ka naa daa chɛ ka bɛ mali nɛma maa zaa.
en: The king cast it in clay molds in the Jordan Valley between Succoth and Zarethan.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa mali ti du Gɛnɛsarɛt tiŋgbɔŋ ni teeku duli.
en: When they had crossed the lake, they landed at Gennesaret.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Mani n-nyɛ nyɛvili, mani n-lan su kum ni neebu yiko; ka ŋunkam niŋ ma yɛda, hal o yi kpi gba, o ni lan neei yaha.
en: Jesus then said, I am the one who raises the dead to life! Everyone who has faith in me will live, even if they die.

dag: Zaŋmiya li wuhi yi bihi, ka tɔɣisim di yɛla yi yi be yiŋa ni yi yi ti be luɣ shɛli polo ni yi yi ti doya ni yi yi ti yiɣisi.
en: and tell them to your children over and over again. Talk about them all the time, whether you're at home or walking along the road or going to bed at night, or getting up in the morning.

dag: Bee nir yi yaag o noli po yiriŋ ni o ni niŋ zaɣ biɛɣu bee zaɣ viɛlli, nir yi po pɔri kam yiriŋ ka bi baŋ, o yi ti baŋ, o mali taali di puuni.
en: You are guilty the moment you realize that you have made a hasty promise to do something good or bad.

dag: Yinim teeku noli tinsinim mini Sidɔnnima, maamiya yi ni. Yi daabihi bela teeku ni bɔri azichi tiri ya.
en: Be still, inhabitants of the coast, traders of Sidon, whose messengers crossed over the sea.

dag: Yɛhudianim bɛn daa be Mariama sani m-maar o suhu la ni daa nya ka o yiɣisi yomyom yiri maa ka bɛ gba yiɣisi dol o, dama bɛ daa tɛhiya ni o chanila gballi maa gbini ni o ti kum.
en: The people who were in the house with Mary comforting her followed her when they saw her get up and hurry out. They thought that she was going to the grave to weep there.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu maa mini zahim ayi maa, ka kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi zuɣusaa, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka ŋmahiŋmahi li ti o nyaandoliba maa ni bɛ tari salo maa.
en: Then Jesus took the five loaves of bread and two fish. He looked up into the sky and thanked God for the food. Then he broke it into pieces, which he gave to the followers to give to the people.

dag: Ka o daa piligi wuhiri ba Anabi Musa min anabinim zaa ha litaafinim ni daa yɛli ŋun Yisa yɛla shɛm.
en: And Jesus explained to them what was said about himself in all the Scriptures, beginning with the books of Moses and the writings of all the prophets.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Aduna: N zaŋ bɛ ni zaŋ sara maligu binshɛŋa ti ma, ka di nyɛ Izraɛlnim sara binshɛŋa din be kasi zaa ti a min a bidibisi ni di nyɛ yi maligumaaniba tarili sahakam.
en: The LORD spoke to Aaron: I now place you in charge of my gifts, including all the Israelites sacred offerings. I have given them to you and your sons as an allowance. This is a permanent regulation.

dag: So shɛli beni ŋ-ŋmani din tuhi nir sani, amaa ka di bahigu ti nyɛla kum.
en: What you think is the right road may lead to death.

dag: Yawɛ, daadamnim lee nyɛla bɔ ka a baɣa ti be bɛ ni bee ninsalinim lee nyɛla bɔ ka a tɛhiri bɛ yɛla?.
en: Lord , why are people important to you? Why do you even notice us?.

dag: Aai, lala ku niŋ. Yi dɔbba kɔŋko cham ti jɛm Yawɛ, dama yi ni bɔri shɛm m-bala. Ka bɛ daa kari ba Firawuna tooni yihi.
en: Do you want to worship the Lord ? All right, take only the men and go. Then Moses and Aaron were chased out of the palace.

dag: Bɛ yi kɔhi a ʒilɛl ni Yɛhudia doo bee paɣa a zuɣu, ka o tum tuma ti a yuma ayɔbu, yuun shɛli din pahira ayopɔin ni, nyin bahimi dilana ka o chaŋ.
en: If any of your fellow Hebrews, male or female, sell themselves into your service, they can work for you for six years, but in the seventh year you must set them free from your service.

dag: N Duuma, a mi n suhu ni ye shɛli zuɣu zaa, a mi n siɣimbu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: You, Lord, know every one of my deepest desires, and my noisy groans are no secret to you.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Samsin daa ti chaŋ Gaza ti nya pagɔr so nimaani ka o kɔre kpe o ni, ka o zaŋ o dɔni.
en: One day while Samson was in Gaza, he saw a prostitute and went to her house to spend the night.

dag: Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wumma!.
en: Whoever has ears must listen.

dag: Ka n-daa bɔhi ba, Pa tinzun paɣiba n-daa chɛ ka Izraɛl Naa Sulemaana tum alahichi? Zuliya pam nanim ni so daa bi ŋman o, ka o Naawuni daa yur o ka zaŋ o leei Izraɛlnim zaa naa, amaa tinzun paɣiba n-daa ti chɛ ka o tum alahichi.
en: Didnt Israels King Solomon sin on account of such women? Among the many nations there was no king like him. He was well loved by his God, and God made him king over all Israel. Yet foreign wives led even him into sin!.

dag: N ni kana ti liri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ tipawumli nim ŋɔ n-fiɛb ba. Ka n yi ti fiɛb ba bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛri buyi maa zuɣu, zuliya shɛb ni laɣisi tab na ti liri ba.
en: I will come to punish them. Armies will come together against them and punish the Israelites for both of their sins.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ma, Daadam, kɔba ŋɔ ni tooi lan niŋ nyɛvili? Ka n garigi yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ, nyini m-mi.
en: He said, Ezekiel, son of man, can these bones come back to life? I replied, Lord God, only you can answer that.

dag: Ka salo maa ni shɛb daa yɛl o, A tizɔbihi min a ma be samban ni bɔri ni bɛ nya a.
en: Someone told Jesus, Your mother and brothers are standing outside and want to see you.

dag: Ashihur ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛkɔanim yabidoo la daa malila paɣiba ayi, yino yuli n-daa booni Hɛla, ka ŋun la mi yuli booni Naara.
en: Tekoas father was Ashhur. Ashhur had two wives. Their names were Helah and Naarah.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi kawaan daŋda mini yi wain daŋda ni yi kpa daŋda ni yi ni tuui chɛ biŋkɔbiri kɔb shɛŋa ti o.
en: You must give the priests the first part of your harvest. You must give them the first part of your grain, your new wine, and your oil. You must give the Levites the first wool cut from your sheep.

dag: Di zɔntua daa kpala dundɔntitali polo. Ka bɛ daa ŋme abie tihi pa di pilanim zuɣu di yaɣili kam. Ka di daa mali dunɔdura anii zaŋ chaŋ dunɔdali maa gbini.
en: Its porch faced the outer courtyard. Palm trees decorated its arches on both sides, and its stairway had eight steps.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka n lo ni n kul teeri ya dimbɔŋɔnim yɛla, hal yi ni pun mi li ka ba n-zani yɛlimaŋ shɛli yi ni pun dee la ni zaa yoli.
en: And so I will always remind you of these matters, even though you already know them and are firmly grounded in the truth you have received.

dag: ka di chɛ ka nir kul ni beni sahakam, ka ku kpi.
en: to stay alive forever and safe from death.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ŋmaligi chaŋ naai ka niriba maa yi kɔbiliga maa ni na n-chaŋ ti yɛli Naa Dauda, bɛ daa yɛl o mi, Yiɣisim yomyom gbaai kulibɔŋ ŋɔ du, dama n-nyɛ Ahitɔfɛl ni wuhi yikombiɛlim shɛm zaŋ chaŋ a polo.
en: After Absaloms servants left, Jonathan and Ahimaaz climbed out of the well and went to King David. They said to David, Hurry, go across the river. Ahithophel is planning to do something to you.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Yɛlimiya ninvuɣ so ŋun tim ya n sani ŋɔ na.
en: she said: You were sent here by King Josiah, and this is what the Lord God of Israel says to him:.

dag: Ka yi ni so yi zaɣisi ti ni yɛli ya shɛm gbaŋ ŋɔ ni deebu, yin kpahimmiya dilana, ka di chɛliya ka yi min o lan mali jina, ka di ni chɛ ka vi gbaag o.
en: Be on your guard against any followers who refuse to obey what we have written in this letter. Put them to shame by not having anything to do with them.

dag: Naawuni, n suhir a, chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri kpi, ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri zo ka chɛ ma.
en: O God, how I wish you would kill the wicked! How I wish violent people would leave me alone!.

dag: Hal Juda ni daa kul mali kpiɔŋ gar o mabihi maa zaa, ka nabia lan yi o zuliya ni na maa zaa yoli, Yisifu n-daa kul nyɛ dɔɣirikpɛma.
en: Although Judah became the strongest among his brothers and a leader came from him, the birthright belonged to Joseph.

dag: Ka maligumaana mi kul ku kɔŋ Lɛvi zuliya ni ŋun ni zani n tooni mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini chi sara maligunim maani maligunim sahakam.
en: And there will always be priests from the family of Levi. They will always stand before me and offer burnt offerings and sacrifice grain offerings and give sacrifices to me.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa chɛ ka Babilɔn naa lo tɔbu na ti liri ba n-zaŋ takɔbi ku bɛ bipola bɛ jɛmbu duu luɣ kasi shee, ka bi zo nachimbil bee paɣisarili bee ninkurili bee barinim nambɔɣu. O daa zaŋ bɛ zaa niŋ o nuu ni.
en: So the Lord brought the king of Babylonia to attack them. The king killed the young men of Judah even in the Temple. He had no mercy on anyone, young or old, man or woman, sick or healthy. God handed them all over to him.

dag: Niŋgbun yini mini Shi yino m-beni kaman tahima yini din nyɛ Naawuni ni boli ya shɛli zuɣu ni beni shɛm la.
en: There is one body and one Spirit, and God chose you to have one hope.

dag: Bɛ daa nyɛla kaman ninvuɣ pinaayi laasabu.
en: There were about twelve men in this group.

dag: Ti tiligimi kaman nooŋa n-tiligi tɔha tɔŋ gbaabu ni la. Tɔha tɔŋ kabiya ka ti tiligi.
en: and we escaped like birds from a hunter's torn net.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ti yɛn zaŋ a bibihi fiɛbi tampima ni ti mali alibarika!.
en: Bless the one who grabs your babies and smashes them against a rock.

dag: amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun bi be kasi ka ŋubi Yawɛ sara maligu nimdi ni daɣiri, bɛn yihim dilan o daŋ ni.
en: But anyone who is unclean and eats the meat from the fellowship offerings that was offered to the Lord must be separated from their people.

dag: Ka o ni daa yɛli shɛm maa zuɣu chɛ ka vi gbahi o dimnim zaa; amaa ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim zaa suhuri daa paligi tuun kar shɛŋa o ni tum maa zuɣu.
en: His answer made his enemies ashamed of themselves, while the people rejoiced over all the wonderful things that he did.

dag: Bɛ ni baŋ Naawuni maa zaa yoli: Bɛ bi tir o jilima kaman Naawuni; bɛ mi bi puhir o taalitaali; amaa ka bɛ tɛha zaa naɣ leela tɛhi yoya, ka zibisim zibigi bɛ tɛhi yoya maa ni.
en: Although they knew God, they didnt honor God as God or thank him. Instead, their reasoning became pointless, and their foolish hearts were darkened.

dag: Doo maa min o paɣ maa daa bela bɛ zaɣim, amaa ka di bi mali ba vi.
en: The man and his wife were naked, but they were not ashamed.

dag: Samarianim pam daa niŋ Yisa yɛda paɣ la ni daa yɛli ni Yisa yɛl o binshɛɣukam zaa o ni pun niŋ la zuɣu.
en: Many of the Samaritans in that town believed in Jesus because the woman had said, He told me everything I have ever done.

dag: Hal Ijiptinim yi wum ni Taai wurimya, di ni niŋ ba nandahima pam.
en: When the Egyptians hear, they will be in anguish at the news about Tyre.

dag: yimaŋmaŋ di ʒiɛnya nimaani, amaa yinim karimiya doli yi dimnim maa nyaaŋa nti liri ba, ka di chɛliya ka bɛ zo m-paai bɛ ya, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-zaŋ ba niŋ yi nuu ni.
en: but don't stay there yourselves. Keep on after the enemy and attack them from the rear; don't let them get to their cities! The Lord your God has given you victory over them.

dag: Ka Hitinim maa yɛl o.
en: Sir, they answered, you are an important man. Choose the best place to bury your wife. None of us would refuse you a resting place for your dead.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri kul zɔrimi hal so yi bi kariti doli ba, amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn kul malila suhukpeeni kaman gbuɣinli la.
en: The wicked run away even though no one pursues them, but the righteous are as confident as a lion.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ anab shɛba bɛn birigi n niriba la polo m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ yi ti nya n-di saha shɛli, bɛ kuhirimi yɛra, Suhudoo beni. Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi ti ba ka bɛ di, bɛ yɛrimi ni bɛ ni tuhi ba.
en: My people are deceived by prophets who promise peace to those who pay them, but threaten war for those who don't. To these prophets the Lord says.

dag: Jɛmmiya Yawɛ ni suhupiɛlli! Yilimiya yila ka o sanna!.
en: Serve the LORD with celebration! Come before him with shouts of joy!.

dag: Wula ka yi lee tɛhiri Masia yɛla? Ŋun yaaŋa n-lee nyɛ o? Ka bɛ yɛl o, O nyɛla Naa Dauda yaaŋa.
en: What do you think about the Christ? Whose son is he? Davids son, they replied.

dag: Yi ni ŋma n-wurisiwurisi kaman yaɣiri duɣu la, hal ka salichee din ni mooi buɣim bee n-tooi kom kɔduɣu ni ku lan beni.
en: Its breaking is like the breaking of a storage jar that is totally shattered. No piece from among its fragments will be large enough to take fire from a hearth, or to dip water from a cistern.

dag: dama Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun kul tumdi lala yi ni ni o chɛ ka yi saɣ o yubu, ka tin ya yiko ka yi tooi tum o ni yu shɛm.
en: God is working in you to make you willing and able to obey him.

dag: o yi ti baŋ o ni tum alahichi shɛli maa, ŋun bom bulaa ŋun ka dalinli na ti mali sara.
en: then as soon as the sin is called to his attention, he shall bring as his offering a male goat without any defects.

dag: So na ʒi n-nya Naawuni, ka ti yi yuri taba Naawuni ni be ti ni ka o yurilim ni niŋ dɛde ti ni.
en: No one has ever seen God. But if we love each other, God lives in us. If we love each other, Gods love has reached its goal—it is made perfect in us.

dag: yɛlimaŋli m Ba, dama lala n-viɛl a sani.
en: Indeed, Father, this brings you happiness.

dag: Izraɛlnima n-tum alahichi; bɛ zaɣisila n ni zali ba zaligu shɛl la dolibu; ka kpuɣi binshɛŋa bɛ ni daa woligi ti Man Yawɛ la. Bɛ zu n-kpuɣ li pahi bɛ nɛma ni, ka ŋma ʒiri.
en: Israel has sinned! They have broken the agreement with me that I ordered them to keep. They have taken some of the things condemned to destruction. They stole them, lied about it, and put them with their own things.

dag: O bituuli yuli n-daa booni Abidɔn, ka Zur mini Kish ni Baal ni Nɛr ni Nadab.
en: Jeiels oldest son was Abdon. Other sons were Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab.

dag: Maliya biɛrisuŋ bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani, ka di chɛ ka bɛ yi tɔɣisiri n-dalindi ya ni yi nyɛla tuumbiɛtumdiba, bɛ ni bahi nya yi tuun suma ka ti Naawuni jilima o kandina dali.
en: Always let others see you behaving properly, even though they may still accuse you of doing wrong. Then on the day of judgment, they will honor God by telling the good things they saw you do.

dag: O daa daŋ kala omaŋmaŋ zuliya sanna, ka bɛ ti bi deeg o.
en: He came to his own country, but his own people did not receive him.

dag: Ka Jona daa yi tiŋ maa tariga wulimpuhili polo ti ʒini. O daa sa la gara n-kpe n-ʒi di mahim guhiri ni o nya din yɛn niŋ Ninive.
en: Jonah went out of the city to a place near the city on the east side. He made a shelter for himself and sat there in the shade, waiting to see what would happen to the city.

dag: ni Tapua naa ni Hɛfa naa.
en: the king of Tappuah, the king of Hepher.

dag: Ka Ibram daa teei dɔni n-zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋa, ka Naawuni yɛl o.
en: Abram fell on his face, and God said to him.

dag: Yɛlimiya Izraɛlnima: Binshɛli yi yi doo tooni na, din yi o tooni na maa nyɛla daɣiri.
