en: Speak to the Israelites and say to them: Whenever a man has a genital emission, that emission is unclean.

dag: Ka Yawɛ kari niriba maa tahi katiŋa, ka tiŋgbani maa kpalim zaɣ kuŋ.
en: and I have sent them far away, leaving their land in ruins.

dag: N kul malila shili n-guhiri sahakam ni n deei n niriba bɛn niŋ tipawumli n-tumdi din bi tuhi, ka doli bɛmaŋmaŋ suhuyubu soli maa.
en: All day long I stood ready to accept those who turned against me. But they kept doing whatever they wanted to do, and all they did was wrong.

dag: N chɛ ka baɣisi leei jɛra, ka chɛ ka baŋdiba bɛn yɛri binshɛŋa din yɛn niŋ dahin shɛli ha yɛla birinda; ka chɛ ka yɛnnim baŋsim leei jɛrilim.
en: False prophets tell lies, but the Lord shows that their lies are false. He makes fools of those who do magic. He confuses even the wise. They think they know a lot, but he makes them look foolish.

dag: Amaa ka Ifriim zuliya niriba maa daa lee bi kari Keenannim bɛn daa be Gɛza, dina n-chɛ ka Keenannim mini Ifriim zuliya niriba maa na kul laɣim be hal ni zuŋɔ; amaa ka bɛ lee chɛ ka Keenannim maa tumdi dabitim tuma tiri ba.
en: But they did not drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer, so the Canaanites have lived among the Ephraimites to this day, but they have been forced to work as slaves.

dag: Zaŋm gɔpiɛliga dari mali yi ni yɛn tuɣindi tulaale zim sara maligu bimbi shɛli zuɣu.
en: Make an altar from acacia wood. You will use this altar for burning incense.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ shɛb yi nya filiŋ, a yɛrimi ni bɛ malila karimbaani, dama o tiligiri tarimba.
en: When others are disgraced, God will clear their names in answer to your prayers.

dag: N Duuma, a pal a ni daa lo alikauli shɛl la, dinzuɣu chɛ ka man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ yi dunia ni ni suhudoo;.
en: Now, Lord, you have kept your promise, and you may let your servant go in peace.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli naa, Nyama, Itiɔpia Naa Tirihaka lola tɔbu kanna ni o ti tuh a. Ka o daa sabi gbaŋ lan tim tuumba Hɛzɛkia sani n-yɛli ba.
en: Word reached the Assyrians that the Egyptian army, led by King Tirhakah of Ethiopia, was coming to attack them. When the emperor heard this, he sent a letter to King Hezekiah of Judah.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa yi Ijipti saha shɛli, Yaakubu zuliya ni daa yi tinzun tiŋ ni saha shɛli.
en: God brought his people out of Egypt, that land with a strange language.

dag: Yawɛ nam binshɛlikam la ni di daliri, hal ninvuɣ biɛri benila bɛ wahala nyabu dali zuɣu.
en: The Lord has a plan for everything. In his plan, the wicked will be destroyed.

dag: Karimbaandan ŋun nyɛ nyarimaŋlana yuli m-booni Ansarisimaana. O kul tumdila karimbaani duhimaŋtali tuma.
en: If you are proud and conceited, everyone will say, You're a snob.

dag: A lee tɛhiya ni ŋuni ka a turi ka maani ansarisi maa? Mani ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ ka a niŋ karimbaani lihi ʒiɛm maa.
en: But who was it that you insulted and made fun of? Who was it that you spoke against? You were speaking against the Holy One of Israel. You acted like you were great and he was nothing.

dag: Amaa n yi ti yɛli bia maa, Nyama, piɛma maa be a tooni ha; dindina nyin zoma, dama Yawɛ n-wuh a ni a zom maa.
en: But if there is trouble, I will say to the boy, The arrows are farther away. Go get them. If I say that, you must leave. The Lord is sending you away.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun daŋ tooni daa chaŋ ti kpaag o laa ni dini bahi dunia ni, ka yuma din bie ka kabiri ʒim daa niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali biŋkɔbigu la dalinli ka jɛmd o binnan la.
en: The first angel left. He poured out his bowl on the land. Then all those who had the mark of the beast and who worshiped its idol got sores that were ugly and painful.

dag: Ka ti Duuma malaika daa ti yɛli Filip, Yiɣisima n-dol a nudirigu polo mɔɣu ni pal shɛli din yiri Jɛrusalɛm kuni Gaza la.
en: An angel from the Lord spoke to Philip, At noon, take the road that leads from Jerusalem to Gaza.

dag: Jɔtam ni daa lan tum tuun shɛŋa zaa min o ni daa tuhi tɔb shɛŋa zaa ni o biɛhigu ni daa nyɛ shɛm zaa, bɛ sab li niŋ Izraɛl mini Juda nanim litaafi ni.
en: Everything else Jotham did while he was king, including the wars he fought, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel and Judah .

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yɛl o, Kpalimmi kpe zuŋɔ yaha, ka n sa bah a ka a lab biɛɣuni. Ka Yuria daa kpalim Jɛrusalɛm dindali maa neei biɛɣu.
en: Then David said, Stay here in Jerusalem today, and I will send you back tomorrow. Uriah stayed in Jerusalem that day. Then the next day.

dag: Ka salo maa zaa daa daari taba ni bɛ paag o shihi, dama o niŋgbuŋ ni ka tibbu yiko maa daa yirina n-chɛ ka bɛ zaa kpaŋda.
en: Everyone was trying to touch him, because power was coming out from him. Jesus healed them all.

dag: Ka anabi kurili maa daa kpuɣi anab ŋuni maa pa buŋ zuɣu n-zaŋ o kuli yiŋa ni bɛ ti kum o kuli ka sɔɣ o.
en: The old prophet picked up the body, put it on the donkey, and brought it back to Bethel to mourn over it and bury it.

dag: Yi ninni ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa buɣim puuni zoli gbini la.
en: There on the mountain the Lord spoke to you face-to-face from the fire.

dag: Gbibiya n zaligunima ka tummiya di tuma; Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun maani ya ka yi be kasi.
en: Obey my laws, because I am the Lord and I make you holy.

dag: Dunɔguliba — kɔbiga ni pihinahiyinika.
en: These are the descendants of the Temple gatekeepers: the descendants of Shallum, Ater, Talmon, Akkub, Hatita, and Shobai:.

dag: Amaa binshɛɣukam zaa n ni daa lihi ni di mali nyɔri la, n yipa lihi li ka di nyɛla yoli n sani Masia zuɣu.
en: But all those things that I might count as profit I now reckon as loss for Christ's sake.

dag: Dindali maa Ijiptinim ni ti ŋmanila paɣiba, dabiɛm ni ti kpe ba ka bɛ ni sɔhira, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni ti yɛn doli so shɛli liri ba zuɣu.
en: A time is coming when the people of Egypt will be as timid as women. They will tremble in terror when they see that the Lord Almighty has stretched out his hand to punish them.

dag: ka yɛli ba, Yinim Lɛvinima, wummiya, Malimiya yimaŋa m-be kasi, ka maliya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu ŋɔ ka di be kasi, ka yihiya neen daɣiri din bi be kasi luɣ kasi shee la.
en: Listen to me, you Levites! he said. Make yourselves holy so you can make holy the temple of the LORD God of your ancestors by removing from the sanctuary any impure thing.

dag: Ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa gbaai chandi hal ti paai Bɛtilihɛm. Bɛ ni daa paai maa, di daa garila tiŋ maa nim zaa ka bɛ damna, ka paɣiba ti bɔhira, Naomi m-bala.
en: They reached Bethlehem, and the whole town was excited to see them. The women who lived there asked, Can this really be Naomi.

dag: Ka o daa ti paai Saimɔn Pita sani, ka Pita bɔh o, N Duuma, a yɛn paɣila n naba.
en: He came to Simon Peter. But Peter said to him, Lord, you should not wash my feet.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yisa nyɛla maligumaani tital so ŋun tumdi din sɔŋdi ti ni yɛlimaŋli. O nyɛla ŋun be kasi ka ka galimi, ka alahichi mi ka o ni; Naawuni n-wolig o ka o be o ko ka chɛ alahichinima, ka duh o gari sokam zaa bɛn be alizanda ni.
en: Jesus is the high priest we need. He is holy and innocent and faultless, and not at all like us sinners. Jesus is honored above all beings in heaven.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli shɛm la: Di yi nyɛla din to ni wuntizɔra tiligi, wula ka di ni be bɛn bi luri Naawuni sizuura mini alahichinim la sani.
en: If good people barely escape, what will happen to sinners and to others who don't respect God.

dag: Barina ni paai tin shɛli maa lumi dahim, ka yili kam zaa dunoya kpari, ka so ku tooi kpe di ni.
en: The town is in chaos, broken; every house is shut, without entrance.

dag: Naawuni Shi so ni yɛlimaŋli ni bela yi ti kana, o ni wuhi ya yɛlimaŋli zaa soli; dama o bi ti yɛn yɛli shɛli omaŋmaŋ yiko ni, amaa o ni wum shɛlikam, dina ka o ti yɛn zaŋ yɛli, ka ni ti wuhi ya binshɛŋa din ti yɛn niŋ.
en: When, however, the Spirit comes, who reveals the truth about God, he will lead you into all the truth. He will not speak on his own authority, but he will speak of what he hears and will tell you of things to come.

dag: ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni n ti leei yi Naawuni. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I brought you out of Egypt in order to be your God. I am the Lord .

dag: Ka o daa ti o niriba subu yiko mini jilima ni kpiɔŋ ni di chɛ ka zuliya kam mini niriba balibu kam ni tinzun yɛtɔɣa balibu kam nim tumdi tuma tir o. O yiko kul ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu, ka o nam mi ku mali tariga.
en: The one who looked like a human being was given authority, glory, and complete ruling power. People from every nation and language group will serve him. His rule will last forever. His kingdom will continue forever. It will never be destroyed.

dag: Amaa bimbir shɛŋa din daa lu vuhim shee la, din ŋmanila bɛn wum Naawuni yɛligu ka dee li niŋ bɛ suhuri ni, ka di ti dɔɣi niŋ biɛlim pihitata, shɛŋa pihiyɔbuyɔbu, shɛŋa mi kɔbigakɔbiga.
en: But other people are like seeds sown in good soil. They hear the message, accept it, and bear fruit: some thirty, some sixty, and some one hundred.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun bi ʒe n nyaaŋa pala ŋun bɔri n zaɣ viɛlli; ka ŋunkam mi bi sɔŋdi ma naɣ wurindila m bini bahira.
en: Whoever isnt with me is against me, and whoever doesnt gather with me, scatters.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee yɛn chaŋ ti niŋ Naa Ɛhab naŋgban malisim ka o chaŋ Ramɔtigiliad ka bɛ ti ku o? Ka ŋumbɔŋɔ yɛli ni ŋ-ŋɔ, ka ŋumbɔŋɔ mi yɛli ni ŋ-ŋɔ.
en: The Lord said, Which of you will go fool Ahab into attacking the Arameans at Ramoth Gilead so that he will be killed? The angels discussed many different plans.

dag: Amaa yi yi ku wum Yawɛ yɛligu, ka zaɣis o zaligu dolibu, dindina ŋun Yawɛ ni darigi yi tibili.
en: But if you dont obey the LORD and rebel against the LORDs command, then the LORDs power will go against you and your king to destroy you.

dag: Di niŋ zuɣulaannim naani, a mi di niŋ daadamnim bɛn ka sɔŋsim ŋɔ naani.
en: Don't put your trust in human leaders; no human being can save you.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yiɣisimiya, chamiya ti liri zuliya shɛb bɛn ka yɛlimuɣisir shɛli ŋɔ. Bɛ tiŋ maa ka dunɔdaya bee dunokparitisi. Di ʒiɛla di ko.
en: There is a nation that feels so safe and secure that it does not have gates or fences to protect it. And no one lives near enough to help them. So attack that nation! says the Lord .

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa kana ti bɔhi naa, Wula ka ti mabihi Judanim ŋɔ lee sɔɣi zaŋ a min a malibu ni a niriba ŋɔ zaa baai du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili na.
en: The soldiers from Israel came to him and said, Why did our relatives from Judah secretly take you and your family and your soldiers across the Jordan.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni ti o tarili wɔɣira puuni. O mini bɛn mali yaa ni ti laɣim pirigi bɛ ni ŋme n-di neen shɛŋa. Dama o daa saɣiya kpi, ka bɛ daa kal o pahi alahichinim ni. O daa ʒi niriba pam daalahichi, ka tim sandaani ti alahichinima.
en: Therefore, I will give him a share with the great, and he will divide the spoil with the strong, in return for exposing his life to death and being numbered with rebels, though he carried the sin of many and pleaded on behalf of those who rebelled.

dag: Lala ka n yɛli Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia, Zaŋm a nyiŋgoli niŋ Babilɔn Naa naɣikɔra dapua lɔŋni, ka jɛm o min o niriba ka be.
en: After I had spoken to the officials from the nearby kingdoms, I went to King Zedekiah and told him the same thing. Then I said: Zedekiah, if you and the people of Judah want to stay alive, you must obey Nebuchadnezzar and the Babylonians.

dag: Yisa daa lola noli biɛɣ pihinahi wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa, ka di dabisa maa daa ti gari ka kum wum o.
en: After spending forty days and nights without food, Jesus was hungry.

dag: Dauda ni daa su Izraɛlnim zaa shɛm m-bala. O daa zaŋla yɛlimaŋli mini fukumsi zaligu dolibu gbib o niriba zaa.
en: David ruled over all Israel, and he made good and fair decisions for all of his people.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri ye binyoya jɛmbu mini din chihiri tumbu zuɣu la, n ni chɛ ka bɛ tuumbiɛri maa ŋmaligi lu bɛmaŋmaŋ zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But I will punish the people who love to worship filthy, disgusting idols. I will punish them for what they have done. The Sovereign Lord has spoken.

dag: ka zaŋ chi sara mini binnyura sara pahi naɣilahi maa mini piɛlahi maa ni piɛbihi maa zuɣu kaman bɛ kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs will be as prescribed for their number.

dag: Ka n daa lan lo ni m baŋ yila pii din tam o zuɣu ni la mini yilibil din daa doli nyaaŋa na nti daai vuɣi yila ata la bahi la yɛla. Yilibil maa daa malila nina mini noli din tɔɣisiri karimbaan yɛtɔɣa, ka di lihibu daa mali dabiɛm gari di tab maa zaa.
en: And I wanted to know about the ten horns on its head and the horn that had come up afterward and had made three of the horns fall. It had eyes and a mouth and was boasting proudly. It was more terrifying than any of the others.

dag: A daa zaŋ a bidibisi min a bipuɣinsi shɛba a ni daa dɔɣi ti ma la m-mal a buɣa maa ni bɛ ŋubi, ka di be kaman a ni daa tum pagɔrisigu tuun shɛli maa nyɛla yɛlibil la.
en: You took your sons and daughters, which you had borne to me, and you sacrificed these to them so they could consume them. Was this promiscuity of yours a small thing?.

dag: Dinzuɣu baŋmiya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka zaŋ li niŋ yi suhuri ni ni Yawɛ n-nyɛ zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ Naawuni, ka so lan kani pah o zuɣu.
en: So remember today and never forget: the Lord is God in heaven and on earth. There is no other god.

dag: Di saha ka maligumaana ti zaŋ o nubil tim alahichi sanyoo maligu ʒim maa ni n-zaŋ li ti vie binyila din be bɛ ni nyɔri sara maligu buɣim sara maligu bimbin shɛli zuɣu la, ka kpaai ʒi shɛli din kpalim bahi sara maligu bimbini maa naba zaashee.
en: Then the priest will take some of the blood from the purification offering and, using his finger, will put it on the horns of the altar of entirely burned offerings. But he will pour all the rest of the blood out at the base of the altar.

dag: Ka ti Duuma yɛligu daa moli gili di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: And so the message of the Lord was being told throughout the whole country.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa zaŋ bɛ ni ŋɔri bɔrɔbɔro zim shɛli Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la maani maha, dama dabindi daa ka di ni, bɛ mi daa bi ʒi bindir shɛli mali chaŋ, bɛ ni daa kari ba yihi Ijipti yomyom shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: The people did not have time to put yeast in their bread or make any special food for their journey. So they had to bake their bread without yeast.

dag: Di saha ka peentɔriba daa tam gooni zuɣu ka tɔri ti piɛma na. Bɛ daa ku naa tɔbbihi maa shɛba, hal naa tɔbbia Yuria ŋun nyɛ Hiti nir la gba kpiya.
en: Archers shot down on your servants from the wall. Some of the kings servants died. And your servant Uriah the Hittite is dead too.

dag: ka o lan labi kpe saria karibu shee maa ti bɔhi Yisa, Tiŋkani ka a yina? Ka Yisa bi garig o shɛli.
en: He went back into the residence and spoke to Jesus, Where are you from? Jesus didnt answer.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee zaŋ yɛm niŋ nir puuni? Bee n-chɛ ka baŋsim be nir zuɣu ni?.
en: Who makes people wise? Who puts wisdom deep inside them?.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum kum ni neebu yɛla maa ka bɛ ni shɛb maani Pool ansarisi, ka shɛb mi yɛli ni dahin shɛli ka bɛ ni ti lan wum o yɛtɔɣa maa pahi.
en: When they heard about the resurrection from the dead, some began to ridicule Paul. However, others said, Well hear from you about this again.

dag: Ɛpafiras ŋun be sarika ŋɔ ni pahi n zuɣu Yisa Masia zuɣu la puhir a.
en: Epaphras is a prisoner with me for Christ Jesus. He sends you his greetings.

dag: Bɛ duhimi bɛ yee paɣi Naawuni, ka zaŋ takɔbiri din mali noya ayiyi gbibi.
en: Let them shout aloud as they praise God, with their sharp swords in their hands.

dag: A daa lan tum pagɔrisigu tuma Asirianim sani a ni nyɛ pulaandan la zuɣu. A daa tum pagɔrisigu tuma bɛ sani, ka a nini na kul bi tiɣi li.
en: Then you went to have sex with Assyria. You could not get enough. You were never satisfied.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ suhukpaŋsibo yɛtɔɣa n-garigi malaika so ŋun daa yɛli ma yɛtɔɣa maa.
en: The LORD responded to the messenger who was speaking with me with kind and compassionate words.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm paɣiba, n sabigimi, amaa ka viɛli pam. N sabigimi kaman tiŋgban nɛl ni Kɛdar tanti suɣa la, amaa ka viɛli pam kaman Naa Sulemaana pateesanima.
en: Dark am I, and lovely, daughters of Jerusalem— like the black tents of the Kedar nomads, like the curtains of Solomons palace.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Siria Naa Rɛzin mini Rɛmalia bia Pɛka daa kana ti tuhi Judanima.
en: It was in those days that the LORD began to send Arams King Rezin and Pekah, Remaliahs son, against Judah.

dag: Ziɔn zuɣu, n ku shini; Jɛrusalɛm zuɣu, n ku vuhi hal ka di ti di nasara, ka ne kaman biɛŋmariga la, ka di tiliginsim ne kaman buɣim mokpalli neesim la.
en: For Zions sake I wont keep silent, and for Jerusalems sake I wont sit still until her righteousness shines out like a light, and her salvation blazes like a torch.

dag: Bɛ di chɛ ka di shɛli kpalim ka biɛɣu neei paai li bee ŋ-ŋma di kɔbili. Bɛ doli Yaɣigari chuɣu maa zaligu puhi li.
en: Do not leave any of the food until the following morning and do not break any of the animal's bones. Observe the Passover according to all the regulations.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa yɛri taba, Yɛlimaŋli, ti ni daa niŋ ti mabia la shɛm la samli n-yɔri ti ŋɔ, o ni daa balim ti ka ti daa nya o suhusaɣiŋgu ni nyɛ shɛm, amaa ka zaɣisi wumbu la; dinzuɣu ka suhusaɣiŋgu ŋɔ ti paai ti gba maa.
en: and said to one another, We're being punished because of Joseph. We saw the trouble he was in, but we refused to help him when he begged us. That's why these terrible things are happening.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses.

dag: ka yina. Bɛn daa tum tuun suma ni ti neei kum ni n-nya nyɛvili; ka bɛn mi daa tum tuumbiɛri ti neei kum ni n-nya saria karibu.
en: and they will come out of their graves. Everyone who has done good things will rise to life, but everyone who has done evil things will rise and be condemned.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, o ni ti zaŋ o binshɛɣukam fukumsi niŋ o yiŋbia maa nuu ni.
en: I assure you that he will put them in charge of all his possessions.

dag: Di saha ka Sintani daa yiɣisi Yawɛ sani n-chaŋ ti chɛ ka yumaha gbaai Ayuba, o zuɣutaliga ni zaŋ hal ni o naba puuni.
en: Then Satan left the Lord 's presence and made sores break out all over Job's body.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa kalila Musa ŋun daa nyɛ Naawuni nir la bidibisi pahi Lɛvinim ni.
en: As for Moses the man of God, his sons were considered to be Levites.

dag: Di saha ka dɔro daa gbaai Hɛzɛkia hal ka di ti mii. Ka Amɔz bia anabi Aizaia daa ka o sanna ti yɛl o, Yawɛ yɛliya, malimi shɛlikam shili zali, dama a ku lan yiɣisi, a ni kpi.
en: About this time, Hezekiah got sick and was almost dead. So I went in and told him, The Lord says you won't ever get well. You are going to die, and so you had better start doing what needs to be done.

dag: Teeku kom yiɣisiya pili Babilɔn, ka di kɔgbana din mali vuri pam la lim li.
en: Babylon's enemies will rise like ocean waves and flood the city.

dag: Mɔdɛkai ni daa pun yɛli Ɛsta shɛm zuɣu daa chɛ ka o bi saɣi wuh o ni nyɛ zuliya shɛli bee o niriba ni nyɛ shɛba.
en: Mordecai had warned Esther not to tell anyone that she was a Jew, and she obeyed him.

dag: Ka sapashini maa ni daa yɛl o ni Yisa shiri kpiya maa, ka Gomna Pailɛt daa saɣi ni Yisifu zaŋm Yisa ti sɔɣi.
en: When he learned from the centurion that Jesus was dead, Pilate gave the dead body to Joseph.

dag: Ka kum ni mali ninvuɣ shɛb diri bɛ puri bindira, hal ka kpɛri gɔhi ni ti yihiri li; ka kɔnyuri ni mali ninvuɣ shɛb suhuri ye bɛ buni zuɣu.
en: Hungry people ate all his crops, even the grain growing among the thorns, and greedy people took all he had.

dag: Di saha ka Reechɛl daa yɛli Yaakubu, N dab bipuɣiŋga Biliha m-bɔŋɔ; zaŋm o dɔni ka o dɔɣi bihi ti ma, ka n zaŋ ba ʒili n naba zuɣu.
en: Then Rachel said, You can have my maid Bilhah. Sleep with her, and she will have a child for me. Then I can be a mother through her.

dag: Samarianim ni ti ʒi bɛ tuumbiɛri zambu, dama bɛ zaɣisi bɛ Naawuni. Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi ku ba, ka zaŋ bɛ biliɛri fiɛbi tiŋ chɛrisichɛrisi, ka karigi bɛ paɣipuhinim puya.
en: Samaria will be desolate, because she has rebelled against her God; by the sword they will fall— their babies will be dashed, and their pregnant women ripped open.

dag: Ninvuɣ suŋ ŋun suhu pali bin suma yihirila bin suma o suhu maa ni na, ka ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋun mi suhu pali bin biɛri yihirila bin biɛri o suhu maa ni na.
en: Good people bring out good things from their good treasure. But evil people bring out evil things from their evil treasure.

dag: ni Araba zaŋ hal ti paai Kinɛrɔt Teeku din daa be wulimpuhili polo la ni Bɛtijɛshimɔt polo zaŋ kpa Araba Teeku din nyɛ Yalim Teeku n-do n-lab nudirigu polo Pisiga tintan ni la.
en: He ruled the desert plain up to the east side of the Chinneroth Sea. This ran southward in the direction of Beth-jeshimoth at the foot of the Pisgah slopes as far as the east side of the desert plain and.

dag: Bɛ lɔɣu ŋmanila wahu lɔɣu. Bɛ ŋaritila bɛ tiba kaman sapaɣu ŋun ŋar o tiba.
en: Your words spread poison like the bite of a cobra.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbibi bɛ noya nyɛla bɛn tiligiri bɛ nyɛviya, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi gbibi bɛ noya nyɛla bɛn bahiri yoli.
en: People who are careful about what they say will save their lives, but those who speak without thinking will be destroyed.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu pam. Bɛ ni daa kana shɛm, lala ka bɛ ti lan yɛn yi n-chaŋ. Ka nyɔ bɔ ka bɛ lee di bɛ ni tum tuun shɛŋa ti pɔhim maa ni?.
en: It isn't right! We go just as we came. We labor, trying to catch the wind, and what do we get?.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa daa yɛli Naa Jɛhɔshafat, Man ni ye binyar shɛŋa taɣi m biɛhigu chaŋ ti kpe tɔb maa ni, amaa nyin yɛm a nam binyɛra. Ka Izraɛl naa maa daa shiri ye binyara n-taɣ o biɛhigu chaŋ ti kpe tɔb gɔɣu maa ni.
en: Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, Disguise yourself when you go into battle, but wear your own clothes. And I will disguise myself. The king of Israel went into battle dressed like an ordinary soldier.

dag: Tulaale zim tuɣilibu bimbini mini di dapuhi ni kpa shɛli bɛ ni boori bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni ni tulaale zim din nyom viɛla ni pateesa shɛli din yɛn yiini Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili dunol la.
en: the altar for burning incense and its poles; the anointing oil; the sweet-smelling incense; the curtain for the entrance of the Tent;.

dag: Saha shɛli n ni daa kumdila, n daa bi di li; saha shɛli n ni daa be daɣiri ni la, n daa bi pii di shɛli. Ka m mi daa bi zaŋ li mali kpiimba. Ti deei nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ noli. Ti tum a ni zali ti ni ti tum shɛm zaa.
en: I have not eaten this food when I was sad. I was not unclean when I collected this food. I have not offered any of this food for dead people. I have obeyed you, Lord my God. I have done everything you commanded me.

dag: Amaa n yɛr a mi ni n ni daa tuui boli ninvuɣ shɛb la ni yino gba noli ku to laɣiŋgu ŋɔ bindira maa. .
en: I tell you, not one of those people I invited first will eat any of this food I prepared.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n suhu yuya ni n lola alikauli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ sani, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o suhuyiɣisili maa miligi ti zuɣu.
en: But now I intend to make a covenant with the LORD, Israels God, so God will no longer be angry with us.

dag: Amaa miriya ka yi ti ŋubi bɛ ʒim; yi ni ti kpaai li mi bahi tiŋgban ni kaman kom la.
en: But do not use their blood for food; instead, you must pour it out on the ground like water.

dag: O daa chɛ ka sagbani n-wuhiri ba soli wuntaŋ ni, ka chɛ ka buɣim neesim mi wuhiri ba soli yuŋ hal ka biɛɣu ti neei.
en: By day he led them with a cloud and all night long with the light of a fire.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sabi Manaasa zuliya yuya ni bɛ daŋ ni bɛ malibu ni bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm, bɛn paai yuun pisi bee n-gar lala, ka nyɛ bɛn ni tooi chaŋ tɔbu ni.
en: The tribe of Manasseh was counted. The names of all the men who were years old or older and able to serve in the army were listed. They were listed with their families and family groups.

dag: Iso bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ɛlifaz mini Riuɛl ni Jɛushi ni Jalam ni Kɔra.
en: Esau's sons were Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

dag: Lihimi nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa mali karimbaani, ka a filim ba, ka bahi ninvuɣ biɛri yoli bɛ ni be luɣ shɛlikam.
en: Yes, look at them and bring them down; crush the wicked where they stand.

dag: Chɛ ka a nina kul lihiri tooni, ka a kul lihir a tooni tibi.
en: Look straight ahead with honest confidence; don't hang your head in shame.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan yɛli, Neesim shɛŋa neemiya zuɣusaa sagbana ni n-woligi wuntaŋ ni ka chɛ yuŋ, ka neesim maa wuhiri shihira ni saha ni dabisa ni yuma;.
en: God said, Let there be lights in the dome of the sky to separate the day from the night. They will mark events, sacred seasons, days, and years.

dag: Tan tolli kam wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita pinaata, ka di yɛliŋ mi nyɛ mita ayi. Tan tolima maa zaa buɣisibu daa nyɛla yim.
en: Each curtain was forty-two feet long and six feet wide. All the curtains were the same size.

dag: A chɛ ka tiŋ kara zani dabari; ka saɣim bɛ ni me bin shɛŋa taɣi bɛmaŋa. Tinzunnim ni me nayiya shɛŋa luya, ka so ku lan lab me li zali yaha.
en: You have destroyed the fortress of our enemies, leaving their city in ruins. Nothing in that foreign city will ever be rebuilt.

dag: So daa bi zo a nambɔɣu n-niŋ dimbɔŋɔnim shɛli ti a nambɔzɔbo zuɣu. Amaa bɛ daa zaŋ a mi ti bahi samban ni, dama bɛ daa zaɣis a mi bɛ ni daa dɔɣ a dahin shɛli maa.
en: No one felt sorry for you or took care of you. On the day you were born, your parents threw you out into the field, because no one wanted you.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli ni bɛ ni niriba tuhi pisinaanahi n-yɛn su Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuma fukumsi, ka niriba tusaayɔbu nyɛ zuɣulaannim mini sariakaritiba.
en: The king assigned twenty-four thousand to administer the work of the Temple, six thousand to keep records and decide disputes.

dag: . O daa nam ba la doo mini paɣa. Ka niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni ka boli ba ninsalinima saha shɛl o ni daa nam ba maa.
en: and created them male and female. He blessed them and called them humanity on the day they were created.

dag: Yi ni tooi gaŋ niriba ti o? Yi ni tooi zabi Naawuni zuɣu?.
en: Are you trying to defend God against me? You are not being fair. You are choosing Gods side simply because he is God.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ŋmaligi yɛl o, Saimɔn, m mali yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni n yɛl a. Ka Saimɔn yɛl o, N dana, yɛlim ma.
en: In response, Jesus said to the Pharisee, Simon, I have something to say to you. Simon said, Let me hear it, Teacher.

dag: Yi lee zahimla wula? Ka bɛ garigi yɛli, O simdila kubu.
en: What do you think? They answered, He is guilty and must die.

dag: Niriba yi ti neei kum ni, bɛ bi lan yɛn kpuɣiri paɣiba bee n-zaŋdi bɛ bipuɣinsi tiri dɔbba; bɛ ti kul yɛn bemi kaman malaikanim bɛn be alizanda ni la.
en: At the time when people rise from death, there will be no marriage. People will not be married to each other. Everyone will be like the angels in heaven.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ka Zara sanna nti niŋ o kaman o ni daa pun lo o alikauli yɛli ni o ni niŋ o shɛm la.
en: The Lord came back to visit Sarah as he said he would, and he kept his promise to her.

dag: A tɛhiya ni a ni zɔr o zuɣu n-chɛ ka o kpahir a zuɣu ni, ka kariti a saria ŋɔ?.
en: It is not because you stand in awe of God that he reprimands you and brings you to trial.

dag: Ka binnɛma maa daa kul chani tooni ka labiri nyaaŋa yomyom kaman saa nyaɣisibu la.
en: The living beings ran back and forth—as fast as lightning.

dag: A nyɛvoya ni pɔhim daa kahi kom duhi, ka kɔgbana daa yiɣisi zani zuɣusaa, ka teeku bulli maa sunsuuni daa kpaŋ diɣinli.
en: The wind you sent in anger piled the water high. The flowing water became a wall, solid to its deepest parts.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa lab o nachimba maa sani ka o mini ba ti lab kuli Bɛrishiiba, ka Ibrahimma ti kpalim be nimaani.
en: Abraham went back to his servants, and they went together to Beersheba, where Abraham settled.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔ puuni, a ka yɛlimaŋli, n ni garig a: Naawuni galisiya gari daadam kam.
en: But you are wrong about this, and I will prove it to you. God knows more than any of us.

dag: ka kawaan kɔr ayopɔin maa daa zaŋ kawaan kar ayopɔin maa vali. Ka n zaŋ li yɛli timanima, amaa ka bɛ ni so bi tooi wuhi ma di gbinni.
en: and the thin ears swallowed up the healthy ears. I told the religious experts, but they couldnt explain it to me.

dag: ka di dolibu zuɣu chɛ ka n daa niŋ cheechi alaka. Ka ninsal ni ni doli Yɛhudianim zaligunim ka tooi mali wuntia biɛhigu shɛli di zuɣu la puuni, n daa ka taali.
en: And I was so eager I even made trouble for the church. I did everything the Law demands in order to please God.

dag: Yawɛ niŋsim m-bala, ka di mali ti alahiziba.
en: The Lord has done this, and it is amazing to us.

dag: Ka Pita daa puɣisiri doli Yisa nyaaŋa mali nti paai maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa yiŋ dundɔŋ ni n-chaŋ ti ʒi yili maa ni dunɔguliba sani ni o nya di bahigu.
en: Peter followed Jesus but stayed back at a distance. He followed him to the yard of the high priests house. Peter went in and sat with the guards. He wanted to see what would happen to Jesus.

dag: Dindali maa kaai biɛɣu daa nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili dali, ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Farisiinim daa laɣim chaŋ Gomna Pailɛt sani.
en: That day was the day called Preparation day. The next day, the leading priests and the Pharisees went to Pilate.

dag: hal ti yi tuui, ti ku lu n-doya, dama Yawɛ nuu n-gbib ti.
en: If they stumble, they will not fall, because the Lord reaches out to steady them.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ʒe bɛ daazichi ka bɛ yiya wurim. Hal bɛ ni mɛri yiya ŋɔ zaa yoli, bɛ ku kpe di ni. Hal bɛ ni sari wain tihi ŋɔ zaa yoli, bɛ ku nyu di wain.
en: Then others will take their wealth and destroy their houses. Those who built houses will not live in them, and those who planted vineyards will not drink the wine from the grapes.

dag: Amaa a nini yi ti bi tiɣ o, nyin bahim o ka o chaŋ, ka di zaŋ o kɔhi. Di bi simdi ni a niŋ o kaman dabili la, a ni zaŋ o dɔni m-baŋ o daashil la zuɣu.
en: Later on, if you are not happy with the woman, you can divorce her, and she can go free. But you have slept with her as your wife, so you cannot sell her as a slave or make her into your own slave.

dag: N lan yɛri ya mi yaha ni ŋunkam guni, di nyɛla talahi ni o doli fukumsi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm zaa.
en: If you do, you must obey the whole Law.

dag: ka daa zaŋ tɔrokɔnim anahi mini naɣilah anii ti Mɛrari bihi kaman bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm, ka maligumaana Aduna bia Itama nyɛ bɛ tuma zuɣulana.
en: and four wagons and eight oxen to the Merarites. All their work was to be done under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa kali niriba maa naai nyaaŋa ka Dauda suhu daa saɣim pam, ka o yɛli Yawɛ, N tum alahichi n ni niŋ shɛm maa zuɣu. Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, Yawɛ, n suhir a mi, kpihimi man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ daalahichi maa; dama n tum jɛrilim pam.
en: After everyone had been counted, David realized he had done wrong. He told the Lord , What I did was stupid and terribly wrong. Lord , please forgive me.

dag: Sokam zaa tamla n yɛla, kaman bɛ ni tamdi ŋun kpi yɛla shɛm la, hal n ŋmanila salichee gba.
en: Everyone has forgotten me, as though I were dead; I am like something thrown away.

dag: Lala ka yi yɛn niŋ naɣilaa bee piɛlaa bee piɛlabil kam bee bubil kam sara maligu ni.
en: Each bull or ram, or lamb or young goat that you give must be prepared in this way.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa daa chaŋ Bɛtɛl ti teei ʒini Yawɛ tooni n-kum niŋ o, ka lo noli hal ni zaawuni; ka mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la mini suhudoo sara Yawɛ sani.
en: Then all the Israelites went up to the city of Bethel. There they sat down and cried to the Lord . They did not eat anything all day, until evening. They also offered burnt offerings and fellowship offerings to the Lord .

dag: Yuun shɛli din daa pahiri yuun pihinahi gol so ŋun pahiri piniyini dahin yini dali ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛlnim kaman Yawɛ ni daa zal o ni o yɛli ba shɛm.
en: On the first day of the eleventh month of the fortieth year after they had left Egypt, Moses told the people everything the Lord had commanded him to tell them.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka n lo ni n kul teeri ya dimbɔŋɔnim yɛla, hal yi ni pun mi li ka ba n-zani yɛlimaŋ shɛli yi ni pun dee la ni zaa yoli.
en: You are holding firmly to the truth you were given. But I am still going to remind you of these things.

dag: Ka Asha zuliya niriba maa mini Keenannim bɛn daa pun be tiŋgbani maa ni la kul laɣim be, bɛ ni daa bi kari ba maa zuɣu.
en: The people of Asher did not force those Canaanites to leave their land, so the Canaanites continued to live with them.

dag: Dinzuɣu a yi ni jɛm ma, di zaa ni leeg a dini.
en: All this will be yours, then, if you worship me.

dag: Mani n-daa guli ya mɔɣu ni tiŋgban kuŋ ni.
en: I took care of you in a thirsty desert.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n kana pumpɔŋɔ ni n tuh a soli. M bo a ni nimmoo, ka ti nya a maa.
en: So Ive come out to meet you, seeking you, and I have found you.

dag: Yɛlimiya Naawuni, A tuma mali dabiɛm pam. A yiko ni galisi zuɣu chɛ ka a dimnim gbaanila a tooni.
en: Say to God: How awesome are your works! Because of your great strength, your enemies cringe before you.

dag: Ka Amasa daa kpi n-do o ʒim ni solɔɣu maa zuɣu. Ka ŋunkam daa yi kana ti nya o, dilan kpalindimi zani. Ka doo maa ni daa nya ka niriba kanna ti kpalindi zaani maa, ka o daa vuui Amasa solɔɣu maa zuɣu nti sɔŋ mɔri ni, ka zaŋ binyɛrigu pa o zuɣu.
en: Amasa was writhing in blood in the middle of the road, and the man saw that everyone was stopping. When he saw this, he dragged Amasa from the road into a field and threw a robe over him.

dag: Abija tuun shɛŋa din pahi min o yɛtɔɣa ni o tuma zaa, bɛ sabi li niŋ anab Iddo yɛlikura litaafi ni.
en: Everything else Abijah did is written in the books of the prophet Iddo.

dag: N ni ti je suli niŋ a, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ suhuyiɣisili pam lu a zuɣu. Bɛ ni ti ŋmah a nyee min a tiba, ka zaŋ takɔbi ku a bi shɛb bɛn kpalim. Bɛ ni ti gbah a bidibisi min a bipuɣinsi nti zaŋ ba zaɣ nɛma nyo buɣim.
en: I am angry with you, so I will let them be very cruel. They will cut off your nose and ears; they will kill your children and burn alive anyone in your family who survives.

dag: Yawɛ je tuumbiɛtumdiba. O bɔri ni o kpihim bɛ birili dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: But the Lord is against those who do evil, so they are forgotten soon after they die.

dag: Dama zaɣ biɛɣu bi yirila taŋkpaɣu ni na, ka yɛlimuɣisira gba bi puhiri yiri tiŋgban ni na.
en: Surely trouble doesnt come from dust, nor does distress sprout from the ground.

dag: Machɛle yi zaŋ kurigu she buɣim ni, o zaŋdila o nuu din mali kpiɔŋ n-kpuɣi zali ŋ-ŋme li hal ti mal li ka di niŋ o ni bɔri li shɛm. O yi tumda, kum mini kɔnyuri gbaar o, ka di wumd o pahi.
en: A metalworker shapes an idol by using a hammer and heat from the fire. In his powerful hand he holds a hammer, as he pounds the metal into the proper shape. But he gets hungry and thirsty and loses his strength.

dag: N tumdila m Ba ni zali ma shɛm ni dunianim baŋ ni n yuri m Ba maa. Ka ŋmaligi yɛli ba, Yiɣisimiya ka ti chaŋ kpe ha.
en: Rather, he comes so that the world will know that I love the Father and do just as the Father has commanded me. Get up. Were leaving this place.

dag: Amaa yirigimiya yimaŋ zuɣu, ka gbibiya yi maŋ viɛnyɛliŋga din ni chɛ ka yi ku tam yi nina ni daa nya binshɛŋa la bee n-chɛ ka di yi yi suhuri ni saha shɛli zaa yi ni be yi nyɛviya ni ŋɔ; zaŋmiya li wuhi yi bihi mini yi yaansi.
en: You must be very careful not to forget the things you have seen God do for you. Keep reminding yourselves, and tell your children and grandchildren as well.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti ni tooi niŋ suhukpeeni yɛli: N Duuma nyɛla n sɔŋda; n ku zo dabiɛm. Bɔ ka ninsal ni tooi niŋ ma.
en: This is why we can confidently say, The Lord is my helper, and I wont be afraid. What can people do to me? .

dag: N yi di daa bi kana ti wuhi ba, bɛ naan ku mali taali, amaa pumpɔŋɔ bɛ ku tooi lan chihi yi bɛ taali maa ni.
en: If I hadnt come and spoken to the people of this world, they wouldnt be sinners. But now they have no excuse for their sin.

dag: Dinzuɣu nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, n suhir a, tiligim ti o nuu ni, ka di chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam nanim baŋ ni nyin Yawɛ kɔŋko n-nyɛ Naawuni.
en: But you are the Lord our God, so please save us from the king of Assyria. Then all the other nations will know that you, Lord , are the only God.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ suhuyiɣisili puuni ka o chɛ ka buɣim di tiŋgbɔŋ maa, ka daadamnim be kaman kpam la ka buɣim di ba, ka so bi lan zɔr o kpee nambɔɣu.
en: Because the Lord Almighty is angry, his punishment burns like a fire throughout the land and destroys the people, and it is each of us for ourselves.

dag: Nyama, ninvuɣ biɛtali yi be n ni, nyin wuhim ma so shɛli din tuhi, ka nyɛ din ni beni hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Look to see if there is any idolatrous way in me, then lead me on the eternal path!.

dag: Tiŋ maa daa nyɛla zaɣ mɔɣu, ka di wɔɣilim mini di yɛliŋ zaa nyɛ yim; ka o daa zaŋ o jaaŋgbee maa buɣisi tiŋ maa, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ kilomita tusaayi ni kɔbisinahi; ka di wɔɣilim mini di yɛliŋ ni di dubu zaa nyɛ yim.
en: Now the city was laid out as a square. Its length was the same as its width. He measured the city with the rod, and it was fifteen hundred miles. Its length and width and height were equal.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka a bɔhira, Bɔ ka Naawuni lee mi? O ni tooi kari saria zibisim titali puuni?.
en: Do you think the deep darkness hides you from God?.

dag: Ka n daa lan kab jaaŋgbe shɛli din pah ayi ka di yuli booni Naŋgban yini la, ka Juda mini Izraɛl naŋgbanyini biɛhigu la daa saɣim.
en: Then I chopped up my second staff Harmony, to break the alliance between Judah and Israel.

dag: Ka Liya dab bipuɣiŋga Zilipa maa daa dɔɣi bidibiga ti Yaakubu.
en: Then Zilpah had a son.

dag: Jɛhɔshafat min o niriba ni daa kana ni bɛ ti di bɛ nɛma maa, bɛ daa nya nɛma pam mini kpiimba ni binsuma bɛ sani, ka bɛ daa va li hal ti ku lan tooi ʒi li yaha. Bɛ daa zaŋla daba ata va nɛma maa, di ni daa galisi pam zuɣu.
en: Jehoshaphat and his troops moved in to take the loot, and they found many cattle, supplies, clothing, and other valuable objects. They spent three days gathering the loot, but there was so much that they could not take everything.

dag: Ka Pita yɛl o, Wuhim ti ŋahili la gbinni.
en: Peter replied, What did you mean when you talked about the things that make people unclean.

dag: Dindali maa, paɣiba ayopɔin ni ti gbaai do yino n-yɛl o, Saɣimi ni ti yidana n-nyɛ a, ka ti yi vi ni; amaa ti ni dihiri timaŋa, ka sooni timaŋa.
en: At that time seven women will grab one man and say, Please marry us! We will supply our own food and make our own clothes. You wont have to do anything else if you let us wear your name and take away our shame.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n yihi Ijipti vi shɛli yi ni diri la ka chɛn ya. Ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Giligal, ka di yuli n-na kul bala hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: Then the LORD said to Joshua, Today I have rolled away from you the disgrace of Egypt. So the place was called Gilgal, as it is today.

dag: Saha paaya, dabisili maa vu m-miri, ŋun dari miri ka o mali suhupiɛlli, ka ŋun kɔhiri miri ka o fabinda, dama suhuyiɣisili maa yɛn lula bɛ zaa zuɣu.
en: The time is coming when everyone will be ruined. Buying and selling will stop.

dag: Ka bɛ daa shiri moli nolɔbo molo, ka zaŋ Nabɔt ʒili jilima ʒiishee niriba maa ni.
en: They announced a fast and placed Naboth at the head of the people.

dag: Ka Yisa daa nya o m-bol o na ti yɛl o, A yipa nya amaŋa a dɔro ŋɔ ni.
en: When Jesus saw the woman, he called her over and said, You are now well.

dag: Wula ka yi yɛn niŋ bɛ ni zali chu shɛŋa la puhibu dali mini Yawɛ chuɣu puhibu dali?.
en: You will no longer be able to celebrate the festival of the Lord .

dag: Amaa ka tɔbbihi maa ni yino daa zaŋ kpani kuhi Yisa luɣili, ka ʒim mini kom dii zɔri yirina.
en: However, one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.

dag: Uziɛl bidibisi ni, Aminadab n-daa nyɛ kpɛma, ka bɛ daŋ maa ni niriba kɔbiga ni pinaayi pah o zuɣu.
en: There were people from the tribe of Uzziel. Amminadab was their leader.

dag: Dama n daa doli Yawɛ zaligunima, ka daa bi tum ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma ŋ-ŋmaligi ka chɛ ŋuna ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni maa.
en: because I have kept the LORDs ways. I havent acted wickedly against my God.

dag: Lɛvinima: Jɛshua mini Binnui ni Kadimiɛl ni Shɛrɛbia ni Juda ni Matania ŋun min o tab daa su wumpaɣibo yila yilibu fukumsi la.
en: The following were in charge of the singing of hymns of thanksgiving: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah.

dag: Jɔab mini tɔbbi shɛb bɛn zaa daa be o sani maa ni daa kuna ka bɛ daa yɛl o, Nɛr bia Abinɛr la kala naa sanna ka o bah o ka o chaŋ ni suhudoo.
en: When Joab and all the troops with him returned, Joab was told that Abner, Ners son, had come to the king and that David had sent him off in peace.

dag: Jɛhɔshafat min o niriba ni daa kana ni bɛ ti di bɛ nɛma maa, bɛ daa nya nɛma pam mini kpiimba ni binsuma bɛ sani, ka bɛ daa va li hal ti ku lan tooi ʒi li yaha. Bɛ daa zaŋla daba ata va nɛma maa, di ni daa galisi pam zuɣu.
en: When Jehoshaphat and his army came to take the loot, they found a great amount of cattle, goods, clothing, and other valuables—much more than they could carry. In fact, there was so much it took three days to haul it away.

dag: Dama mani n-daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na, ka fan ya dabitim bandi ni bahi, ka daa chɛ ka Musa mini Aduna ni Miriam nyɛ yi toondaannima.
en: I rescued you from Egypt, where you were slaves. I sent Moses, Aaron, and Miriam to be your leaders.

dag: Ka di daa ti lu o suhu ni ka o bɔh omaŋa, Padiriba ala n-lee be m ba yiŋa m-mali bindira diri tiɣiri ka chɛra, ka man ti be kpe kpiri kum?.
en: Finally, he came to his senses and said, My father's workers have plenty to eat, and here I am, starving to death!.

dag: amaa ka Yisa yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka bihi kam n sanna ka di karitiya ba, dama alizanda nam nyɛla bɛ tatabo dini.
en: Allow the children to come to me, Jesus said. Dont forbid them, because the kingdom of heaven belongs to people like these children.

dag: Kɔhat daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Amiram yiŋnima mini Izar yiŋnima ni Hiburɔn yiŋnima ni Uziɛl yiŋnima; Kɔhat daŋ niriba n-daa bala.
en: The four Kohath clans were the Amramites, Izharites, Hebronites, and the Uzzielites.

dag: ka bɛ daa nya niriba ayi o sani. Anabi Musa mini Anabi Ilaija.
en: Suddenly two men were there talking with him. They were Moses and Elijah.

dag: Ka Mariama daa kpalim Ɛlizabɛt sani kaman chira ata laasabu, ka naanyi kul o ya.
en: Mary stayed about three months with Elizabeth and then went back home.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni a yihi ba di ni, dama di nyɛla vi ni bɛ mali wuhibu shɛŋa bɛ ni ka soli ni bɛ zaŋ wuhi so m-birigiri yiya pam puuni niriba liɣiri nyabu zuɣu.
en: But you must make them be quiet. They are after money, and they upset whole families by teaching what they should not.

dag: Ka nyamiya o ni ʒe palɔni shɛm tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa ka so bi niŋ o shɛli! Di ni bɔŋɔ ti zuɣulaannim baŋya ni doo ŋɔ shiri nyɛla Masia yɔɣɔ?.
en: Look! He is talking in public, and they say nothing against him! Can it be that they really know that he is the Messiah?.

dag: Chɛ ka o niŋgbuŋ leei zaɣ palli kaman bipolli niŋgbuŋ la; ka chɛ ka o lan mali yaa kaman o ni daa nyɛ bipolli la.
en: Then that persons body will become young and strong again. He will be as he was when he was young.

dag: Pool ni daa yɛl lala naai ka o mini ba zaa gban tiŋa ka o suhi Naawuni.
en: When Paul finished speaking, he knelt down, and they all prayed together.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa zali ni bɛ ni mol li gili Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa, zaŋ Bɛrishiiba hal ni Dan ni sokam kana ka bɛ ti puhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ Yaɣigari chuɣu la Jɛrusalɛm, dama bɛ daa na bi laɣim pam puhi li kaman di ni wuhi shɛm.
en: so they invited all the Israelites, from Dan in the north to Beersheba in the south, to come together in Jerusalem and celebrate the Passover according to the Law, in larger numbers than ever before.

dag: Amaa saha shɛli bɛ ni daa ti yɛn zaŋ Mɛrab ti Dauda, bɛ daa ŋmalig o mi ti do so ŋun yuli booni Adiriɛl ka o nyɛ Mɛholat nir la, ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: So when the time came for David to marry Sauls daughter, Saul let her marry Adriel from Meholah.

dag: Hal bɛ nyɛla bɛn kul kpaŋdi bɛmaŋa ni bɛ chɛ ka ti ku yihi waazu din tahiri tiliginsim na la n-ti bɛn pa Yɛhudianima. Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ alahichi shɛli din bahindi nyaaŋa ni bɛ tum zan tariga; amaa Naawuni suhuyiɣisili la pun paai ba.
en: And they are trying to stop us from teaching those who are not Jews. They dont want them to be saved. But they are just adding more and more sins to the ones they already have. Now the time has come for them to suffer Gods anger.

dag: Yi mi di deeya biŋkɔbigu tinzun nir sani n-zaŋ o mali sara shɛli din nyɛ yi Naawuni bindirigu sara la. Dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn mali dansi; bɛ ni mali ba tumdi din bi tu kamaata zuɣu, n ku deei ba yi sani.
en: You are not allowed to offer such animals as your Gods food even if they come from a foreigner. Because these animals have blemishes and imperfections in them, they will not be acceptable on your behalf.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, Yi yi ti nya ka Sirianim maa yɛn nyaŋ ma, yin zomiya n kuŋa, ka m mi yi ti nya ka Ammɔnnim maa yɛn nyaŋ ya, n ni zo yi kuŋa.
en: Joab said to Abishai, If the Arameans are too strong for me, you will help me. If the Ammonites are too strong for you, I will come and help you.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti zɔri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ka jɛmd o, ka zaŋm o yuli kɔŋko pom pɔri.
en: Honor the Lord your God, worship only him, and make your promises in his name alone.

dag: Ka Anakinim maa ni so daa lan ka Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, naɣila Gaza mini Gaat ni Ashidɔd ka bɛ ni shɛb daa be.
en: There were not any Anakim left in the regions where the Israelites lived, although there were still some in Gaza, Gath, and Ashdod.

dag: Ka Yisa dɔɣim dali naba daa ti tuui ka bɛ gun o, ka bol o yuli Yisa, din nyɛ yu shɛli malaika ni daa pun ti o ka Mariama naanyi zal o puu la.
en: Eight days later Jesus' parents did for him what the Law of Moses commands. And they named him Jesus, just as the angel had told Mary when he promised she would have a baby.

dag: amaa kom daa puhiri yirila tiŋ na m-mahigiri tiŋgbani zaa.
en: but water would come up from beneath the surface and water the ground.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ n ni kpɛm ninvuɣ shɛba m-maani ma ansarisi la; n ni daa yuli ʒiɛm shɛb banima, ka ku saɣi zaŋ ba pahi m bahi zuɣu ka bɛ doli m piɛri la.
en: But men younger than I am make fun of me now! Their fathers have always been so worthless that I wouldn't let them help my dogs guard sheep.

dag: min o ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa piligu ni hal ni bahigu ni, nyama, bɛ sab li niŋ Izraɛl mini Juda nanim litaafi ni.
en: is written in The History of the Kings of Israel and Judah .

dag: O kabiri daanya dunoyɔriti ka kabiri kuriti dunokparitisi.
en: He breaks down bronze gates and shatters iron locks.

dag: O gurim ma ʒili, ka di leei shɛhira jɛndi ma; ka n kɔɣisibu nyɛ din di shɛhira jɛndi ma.
en: You have seized me; you are my enemy. I am skin and bones, and people take that as proof of my guilt.

dag: di daa nyɛla wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha, ka n ti nya neesim din ne pam gari wuntaŋa ka di yi zuɣusaa na ti neei gili m mini bɛn daa laɣim chani maa soli maa ni.
en: It was on the road at midday, Your Majesty, that I saw a light much brighter than the sun, coming from the sky and shining around me and the men traveling with me.

dag: Di simdi ni tinim bɛn zaa bi niriba malila tɛhi yini ŋɔ tatabo, ka yi ni shɛb yi mali tɛhi kɔŋkɔba, Naawuni ni kahigi di yɛla wuhi ya.
en: All of us who are mature should think in this same way. And if any of you think differently, God will make it clear to you.

dag: Dama m mi yi tipawumli mini yi noli zaɣisibu yɛla. Yi yi pun nyɛla bɛn zaɣisiri Yawɛ noli saha shɛli n ni na be n nyɛvili ni m-be yi sani ŋɔ, wula nti yɛn nyɛ li n kum nyaaŋa?.
en: I know how stubborn and rebellious you and the rest of the Israelites are. You have rebelled against the Lord while I have been alive, and it will only get worse after I am gone.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti zaŋ tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli n-she pateesa, ka bo gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain n-chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ shɛriga wuɣi binyɛra pa di zuɣu, ka yi zaŋ li yili suɣili maa dunoli.
en: For the entrance of the Tent make a curtain of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool and decorated with embroidery.

dag: Ka yi yi ti wum ni bɛ tuhiri tɔbu ka taari duŋ, yin di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira; dama faashee dimbɔŋɔnim zaa bahi niŋ, amaa di ti bi yɛn wuhi ni dunia yiɣisibu saha dii paami maa.
en: When you hear of wars and rebellions, dont be alarmed. These things must happen first, but the end wont happen immediately.

dag: A daa chɛ ka bɛ zuliya nabi n-galisi kaman saŋmarisi bɛn be zuɣusaa ŋɔ, ka a daa zaŋ ba na ti niŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli a ni daa lo bɛ yaannim alikauli ni a ni zaŋ li ti ba ka bɛ su li la ni.
en: You made their descendants as many as the stars in the sky. You brought them to the land you promised to give their ancestors. They went in and took that land.

dag: Yɛligu maa kɔbili ni ka Naawuni daa nam dunia ŋɔ, ka o daa ka dunia ŋɔ ni na, amaa ka dunianim ti bi baŋ o.
en: The Word was in the world, and though God made the world through him, yet the world did not recognize him.

dag: Ŋuni n-leei beni ka ku kpi? Ka ŋuni n-leei ni tooi tiligi kpiimba biɛhigu shee yiko ni?.
en: No one can escape the power of death and the grave.

dag: Amaa ka kɔnyuri daa wum ba pam nimaani, ka bɛ ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni niŋdi Musa yɛra, Bɔzuɣu ka a yihi ti Ijipti na ni kɔnyuri ti ku ti mini ti bihi ni ti biŋkɔbiri.
en: But the people were very thirsty, so they continued complaining to Moses. They said, Why did you bring us out of Egypt? Did you bring us out here so that we, our children, and our cattle will all die without water.

dag: Yihim daɣiri din be anzinfa ni, ka machɛli zaŋ li mali duɣu.
en: Take the impurities out of silver and the artist can produce a thing of beauty.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa piligi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa mɛbu Jɛrusalɛm Mɔria Zoli zuɣu Aruna ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛbusi nir la kabɔɣili la ni. O ba Dauda ni daa wuhi ni bɛ mɛm li luɣ shɛli din nyɛ Yawɛ ni daa yi ŋun Naa Dauda zuɣu la.
en: Solomon began to build the LORDs temple in Jerusalem on Mount Moriah, where the LORD had appeared to his father David, on the place David had prepared at the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

dag: Amaa n ni sabiri zaligu shɛli tiri ya ŋɔ bahi nyɛla zaligu palli, ka di yɛlimaŋtali yi palo Masia ni ni yi gba ni, dama zibisim kul vuurimi chana, ka neesim maŋli mi pum neei na.
en: However, the command I now write you is new, because its truth is seen in Christ and also in you. For the darkness is passing away, and the real light is already shining.

dag: O daa yɛliya, Biŋkɔb kara anahi maa wuhirila nanima anahi bɛn ti yɛn yiɣisi zani dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: He said, The four great animals are four kingdoms that will come from the earth.

dag: ka Shallum nyɛ Hilikia ba, ka Hilikia nyɛ Azaria ba.
en: Shallum of Hilkiah, Hilkiah of Azariah.

dag: Ka so yi zaɣisi kandina zaŋ chaŋ daba ata sunsuuni, zuɣulaannim mini kpamba bɛn bahim noli ka bɛ fa o binshɛɣukam zaa, ka dilan ku lan mali soli ni o be bɛn yi Babilɔn n-lab kulina maa kalinli ni.
en: Those who did not come to Jerusalem in three days like the officials and elders said would lose their property and be removed from the group.

dag: O ku chɛ ka n vuhi lu m puuni, ka chɛ ka naŋgbantom kul paari ma.
en: Before I could get my breath, my miseries would multiply.

dag: Kuɣ duli ŋɔ mini kuɣ shɛli din yɛn teeri ti ŋɔ nyɛla shɛhira din wuhiri ni n ku yaɣ kuɣ duli maa zuɣu ka a sanna ti niŋ a zaɣ biɛɣu, ka a gba ku yaɣ kuɣ duli maa zuɣu ka n sanna ti niŋ ma zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: This mound and the sacred pillar are witnesses that I wont travel beyond this mound and that you wont travel beyond this mound and this pillar to do harm.

dag: Naawuni ni boli ba bihi, ka bɛ mali niŋgbuna mini ʒim zuɣu ka Yisa daa leei bɛ tatabo ka bɛ min o laɣim mali niŋgbun yini. O daa niŋla lala ni o kum zuɣu chɛ ka o saɣim Sintani ŋun mali kum yiko la.
en: Therefore, since the children share in flesh and blood, he also shared the same things in the same way. He did this to destroy the one who holds the power over death—the devil—by dying.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa yɛri taba, Yi nya do so ŋun yina ŋɔ? O yaa yimina ni o ti mo Izraɛlnima, ka ninvuɣ so yi ku o, naa ni ti dilan buni pam, ka zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga ti o pahi, ka lan chɛ ka dilan daŋ zaa niŋdi bɛ yubu Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa ni.
en: They said to each other, Look how he keeps coming out to insult us. The king is offering a big reward to the man who kills Goliath. That man will even get to marry the king's daughter, and no one in his family will ever have to pay taxes again.

dag: Dama Naawuni mi ni yi yi di li, yi nini ni neei, ka yi be kaman ŋun Naawuni, ka mi zaɣ suŋ ni zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: God said that because he knows that when you eat it, you will be like God and know what is good and what is bad.

dag: O daa lan yɛli ba, Gbibiya yimaŋ viɛnyɛliŋga, ka guliya Naawuni Shia Kasi ni zaŋ ya leei Naawuni piɛ shɛb guliba la, ka dihiri bɛn nyɛ Naawuni Cheechi shɛli o ni daa zaŋ omaŋmaŋ Bia ʒim fa m-bahi la.
en: So keep watch over yourselves and over all the flock which the Holy Spirit has placed in your care. Be shepherds of the church of God, which he made his own through the blood of his Son.

dag: Ti Duuma daa yi Sinai Zoli zuɣu n-ka luɣ kasi shee la na ni chɛchɛbunsi din mali kpiɔŋ pam tusatusa din ka kalinli.
en: Gods chariots are twice ten thousand— countless thousands! My Lord came from Sinai into the sanctuary.

dag: Bɛnkam zaŋ bɛ ni wuhi ba shɛli niŋ bɛ baɣaka ʒiɛmdila bɛmaŋa, amaa bɛn wum saɣisigu ni nya tɛhi zilima.
en: If you refuse to be corrected, you are only hurting yourself. Listen to criticism, and you will gain understanding.

dag: Di nyaaŋa, ka a chɛ ka bɛ bo naɣilabila mini sara maligu zim viɛlli shɛli bɛ ni niŋ kpam ŋmiri, ka a mi bo naɣilabil so bɛ ni zaŋdi maani alahichi sanyoo sara la.
en: They will take a bull from the herd, with its grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil. You will take a second bull from the herd for a purification offering.

dag: Kɛnan ni daa ti paai yuun pisopɔin saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Mahalalɛl.
en: After Kenan was years old, he had a son named Mahalalel.

dag: yi ni guhi hal ni bɛ ti zooi bi dɔbba? Ka dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ni chɛ ka yi ku kuli dɔb shɛba? Aai, m bihi, yi mi ni dimbɔŋɔ ku tooi nani. Yawɛ ni niŋ ma shɛm maa biɛri ma pam yi zuɣu.
en: would you wait until they had grown up? Would this keep you from marrying someone else? No, my daughters, you know that's impossible. The Lord has turned against me, and I feel very sorry for you.

dag: Ka a niriba Izraɛlnim yi ti tum alahichi a sani, ka bɛ dimnim nyaŋ ba tɔbu ni, bɛ yi ŋmaligi lab a sanna n-kuhi bol a yuli ka suh a duu ŋɔ ni.
en: Suppose your people Israel sin against you, and then an enemy defeats them. If they come to this temple and beg for forgiveness.

dag: Ka o daa pii bɛ niriba ayi n-tim ba ti Duuma Yisa sani ni bɛ ti bɔh o, Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun yɛn kana la bee ti na yulim dilan soli.
en: and sent them to the Lord to ask him, Are you the one John said was going to come, or should we expect someone else.

dag: M mali tahima ni di ku yuui ka n nya a, ka ti nini nya taba ka ti tɔɣisi.
en: I hope to see you soon, and then we will talk personally.

dag: Gbibiya yimaŋ viɛnyɛliŋga! A mabia yi tum a taali, nyin saɣisim o; o yi deeg o galimi, nyin chɛl o taali paŋ o.
en: So watch what you do! If your brother sins, rebuke him, and if he repents, forgive him.

dag: Dama m mini Silvanus ni Timoti ni daa yihi Naawuni Bia ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia yɛla waazu shɛli yi sani la daa pala Iin mini Aai yɛla, amaa o ni, di kul nyɛla Iin.
en: This is because Jesus Christ the Son of God is always Yes and never No. And he is the one Silas, Timothy, and I told you about.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zaa nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka dɔr shɛli din ka tibbu gbaag o nyɔri.
en: After this happened, the Lord made Jehoram sick with a disease in his intestines that could not be cured.

dag: dama ŋunkam nya vuhim Naawuni sani chɛ o tuma ka vuhirimi kaman Naawuni ni daa chɛ omaŋmaŋ tuma ka vuhi shɛm la.
en: God rested after he finished his work. So everyone who enters Gods place of rest will also have rest from their own work just as God did.

dag: Tiŋgbɔn shɛli din naa nyɛ bia, ka di zuɣulaannim diri ka nyuri yuŋ hal ka biɛɣ ti neera; mbusim be di tiŋgbɔŋ maa zuɣu.
en: A country is in trouble when its king is a youth and its leaders feast all night long.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Samuɛl daa kuli Rama, ka Sool gba kul o ya Gibia.
en: Then Samuel went to Ramah, and King Saul went home to Gibeah.

dag: Ti yab Ibrahimma ni daa zaŋ o bia Yisahaku mali sara bimbini zuɣu la, pa o tuma tumbu zuɣu ka o daa yi taali ni Naawuni sani?.
en: How was our ancestor Abraham put right with God? It was through his actions, when he offered his son Isaac on the altar.

dag: pakoli ŋɔ ni kaɣindi ma sahakam ŋɔ zuɣu, n ni kari bɛ saria ŋɔ n-ti o nasara. Di yi pa lala, o waawaayili kandina ŋɔ ni nyɔni n nyee pam. .
en: but I will give this widow justice because she keeps bothering me. Otherwise, there will be no end to her coming here and embarrassing me.

dag: Amaa ka Jɔshua yɛli ba, Yi ku tooi jɛm Yawɛ dama o nyɛla Naawuni ŋun be kasi; ka nyɛ ŋun zabiri nyuli; ka ku chɛ yi tuumbiɛri bee yi daalahichi.
en: Joshua said: The Lord is fearsome; he is the one true God, and I don't think you are able to worship and obey him in the ways he demands. You would have to be completely faithful, and if you sin or rebel, he won't let you get away with it.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan yɛl o, Mani n-nyɛ Naawuni Kpiɔŋlan Naa, dɔɣim bihi ka yi nabi; ka zuliya pam yi a ni na; ka nanim pam gba ti yi a zuliya ni na.
en: And God said to him, I am Almighty God. Have many children. Nations will be descended from you, and you will be the ancestor of kings.

dag: M puhiri Yuribanus ŋun nyɛ ti tumtumdikpee Masia ni la mini Stachis n ni yuri so la.
en: and to Urbanus. He has worked together with me for Christ. Give greetings also to my dear friend Stachys.

dag: Amaa ka ninvuɣ yo shɛb daa yɛra, Wula ka doo ŋɔ yɛn tooi niŋ tiligi ti? Ka bɛ daa ʒiɛm o, ka zaɣis o pina tibu. Amaa ka o daa kul shini.
en: But some worthless fools said, How can someone like Saul rescue us from our enemies? They did not want Saul to be their king, and so they didn't bring him any gifts. But Saul kept calm.

dag: Ka Dilaila yɛl o, A boli ma la jɛrigu, ka ŋma ma ʒiri. Niŋm ania, yɛlim ma nir ni yɛn niŋ shɛm lo a mihi.
en: Then Delilah said to Samson, You lied to me. You made me look foolish. Please tell me the truth. How could someone tie you up.

dag: Di saha ka Farisiinim mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdib maa daa bɔhi Yisa, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a nyaandoliba bi doli ti yaannim kali? Dama bɛ bi doli bɛ ni paɣibu kal la paɣiri bɛ nuhi ka diri bindirigu.
en: So the Pharisees and legal experts asked Jesus, Why are your disciples not living according to the rules handed down by the elders but instead eat food with ritually unclean hands.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti mi ni bɛ yi lab me tiŋ maa ka me di goma maa gba naai, Naa, nyin baŋmi ni a ku lan tooi su Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli wulinluhili polo yaɣili maa nima.
en: If Jerusalem is rebuilt and its walls completed, you will no longer have control over Western Province.

dag: Ka n ni daa nya ka yi bi kanna maa, ka n daa zaŋ n nyɛvili pa talima chaŋ bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni ti tuhi ba; ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ ba niŋ n nuu ni. Ka di chaŋ wula ka yi ti kana zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni yi ti tuhi ma.
en: I saw that you would not help us, so I risked my own life. I went across the river to fight against the Ammonites. The Lord helped me defeat them. Now why have you come to fight against me today.

dag: Dama bɛ zaa daa bɔrimi ni bɛ kpɛhi ti dabiɛm ka tɛhira, Bɛ kɔba ni ni chɔɣisi, ka bɛ kɔŋ tuma tumbu. Ka n daa suhi Naawuni yɛli, N Naawuni, kpaŋsim n kɔba ni pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Our enemies were only trying to make us afraid. They are thinking to themselves, The Jews will be afraid and too weak to keep on working. Then the wall will not be finished. But I prayed, God, make me strong.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛl naa Jɔash daa chaŋ ka o mini Juda naa Amazia ti zaŋ bɛ nyɔri yo taba Juda tin shɛli din yuli booni Bɛtishɛmɛshi la ni.
en: So Israels King Joash moved against Judahs King Amaziah and went head-to-head in battle at Beth-shemesh in Judah.

dag: Amaa ka maligumaana Azaria daa zaŋ Yawɛ maligumaaniba pihinii bɛn mali suhukpeeni m-pa omaŋ zuɣu, ka bɛ doli Naa Uzia kpe.
en: Azariah the priest and other brave priests followed Uzziah into the temple.

dag: Amaa ka o nyaandolitab la bɛn daa be ŋariŋ maa ni n-du duli ka vɔri laŋ din daa pali zahim maa na, dama bɛ mini duli daa bi lan wɔɣa. Di daa kul nyɛla kaman mita kɔbiga zuɣu.
en: The other disciples followed in the boat, dragging the net full of fish, for they werent far from shore, only about one hundred yards.

dag: Ka tiŋgban ni kɔbil nina mini sagbana ni kɔsoya daa ŋari; ka saa chɛ mibu.
en: The springs of the deep sea and the skies closed up. The skies held back the rain.

dag: Di saha Yawɛ ni ti vulim vuliŋga m-boli Ijiptinim ka bɛ yi Nail Mɔɣili polo kana kaman zɔhi la, ka Asirianim gba ti kana kaman shihi la.
en: When that time comes, the Lord will whistle as a signal for the Egyptians to come like flies from the farthest branches of the Nile, and for the Assyrians to come from their land like bees.

dag: Di saha ka n ni daa pun wum kukol shɛli ka di yi zuɣusaa na la lan yɛli ma yaha, Cham ti deei litaafi bil shɛli din bɔɣi be malaika so ŋun tam teeku kom zuɣu mini duli zuɣu ŋɔ nuu ni.
en: Once again the voice from heaven spoke to me. It said, Go and take the open scroll from the hand of the angel standing on the sea and the land.

dag: Naawuni, ti yaannim daa pun yɛli ti ka ti wum a ni daa tum tuun kar shɛŋa bɛ ʒiɛman ni kurimbuni ha la yɛla.
en: Our God, our ancestors told us what wonders you worked and we listened carefully.

dag: Yinim maligumaaniba, wummiya! Yinim Izraɛlnima, gbilisimiya tibili! Yinim nayilinima, luɣimiya yi tiba wum! Saria karibu maa ʒila yi zuɣu, dama yi leela zana Mizipa, ka leei laŋa n-yɛrigi pa Tabo Zoli zuɣu.
en: Priests, nation of Israel, and people in the kings family, listen to me. You have been judged guilty! You were like a trap at Mizpah and like a net spread on the ground at Tabor.

dag: Dindali maa, maasim bee sakuɣa ti ku beni.
en: That will be a very special day. There will not be any light, cold, or frost. Only the Lord knows how, but there will not be any day or night. Then, when darkness usually comes, there will still be light.

dag: Yuun shɛli din pahiri pinaayi puuni, gol so ŋun daŋ tooni biɛɣu pinaanu dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: In the twelfth year, on the fifteenth day of the first month, the LORDs word came to me.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Zɛbulɔn zuliya paya. Zɛbulɔn niriba maa toondana n-yɛn nyɛ Hɛlɔn bia Ɛliab.
en: On the other side, the tribe of Zebulun: the chief of the people of Zebulun is Eliab, Helons son.

dag: Tiŋ maa ni ti mali pal yaɣu. Nuzaa polo, di ni ti nyɛla mita kɔbiga ni pisinaanu, ka nudirigu polo nyɛ mita kɔbiga ni pisinaanu, ka wulimpuhili polo nyɛ mita kɔbiga ni pisinaanu, ka wulinluhili polo gba nyɛ mita kɔbiga ni pisinaanu.
en: There will be pastures for the city, three hundred seventy-five feet on the north side, three hundred seventy-five feet on the south side, three hundred seventy-five feet on the east side, and three hundred seventy-five feet on the west side.

dag: Ka Nashɔn daa nyɛ Aminadab bia, ka Aminadab nyɛ Adimin bia, ka Adimin nyɛ Arini bia, ka Arini nyɛ Hɛzirɔn bia, ka Hɛzirɔn nyɛ Pɛrɛz bia, ka Pɛrɛz mi nyɛ Juda so bia.
en: the son of Amminadab, the son of Admin, the son of Arni, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah.

dag: Shɛm bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ɛlam mini Ashur ni Aripakishad ni Lud ni Aram.
en: Shems sons were Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla ŋmahinli. Paɣiba ŋɔ nyɛla alikauli diba ayi: Yino yila Sinai Zoli zuɣu na n-dɔɣiri bihi bɛn nyɛ daba. Ŋuna n-nyɛ Haga.
en: These things can be understood as a figure: the two women represent two covenants. The one whose children are born in slavery is Hagar, and she represents the covenant made at Mount Sinai.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ zilinli gba: di nyɛla din pɔra, amaa ka nyɛ din nyuri bara yɛri yɛl kara. Lihimiya buɣim biɛla ni yi taai tibɔŋ ni n-di li shɛm!.
en: So it is with the tongue: small as it is, it can boast about great things. Just think how large a forest can be set on fire by a tiny flame!.

dag: Ka dabiɛm ni gbaai sokam zaa, ka bɛ yɛli Naawuni ni niŋ shɛm maa yɛla, ka zaŋ o ni niŋ shɛm maa yɛla niŋ bɛ suhuri ni.
en: People will see what God has done. They will tell other people about him. Then everyone will learn more about God. They will learn to fear and respect him.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yuli ba ka bɔhi ba, Wula ka di lee sabi Naawuni Kundi ni yɛl la? Di sabiya: Kuɣ shɛli tammɛriba ni zaɣisi la n-yipa leei kuɣ gahindili. .
en: Staring at them, Jesus said, Then what is the meaning of this text of scripture: The stone that the builders rejected has become the cornerstone?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ nti shiri nya ka buŋ maa lo so yiŋ samban ni sokpaŋa, ka bɛ lɔrig o.
en: So they went and found a colt out in the street, tied to the door of a house. As they were untying it.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi ʒe yim, m mihirila n ninni niŋdi ba, bɛ ni bi dol a zaligunim maa zuɣu.
en: I look on the faithless, and I am disgusted because they havent kept your word.

dag: Tiŋgban shɛŋa din be teeku puuni daa sɔhigimi a ni daa lu dahin shɛli maa, ka di gari ba a ni daa naai shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: Now, on the day you fall, the countries along the coast will shake with fear. You started many colonies along the coast. Now those people will be afraid when you are gone.

dag: Ka Pita daa ŋmaligi lihi nya ka Yisa ni daa yuri nyaandol so la doli ba. Nyaandol maa n-daa nyɛ ŋun ʒi n-tab Yisa bɛ ni daa ʒiya diri bindirigu ka bɔh o, N Duuma, ŋuni n-lee nyɛ ŋun yɛn yi a nyaaŋ la.
en: Peter turned and saw the follower Jesus loved very much walking behind them.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: A yɛla ka n daa chɛ ka n daba bɛn nyɛ Izraɛl anabinim yɛli kurimbuni ha la, bɛn daa tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa di dabisa maa ni yuma pam puuni n-yɛli ni o ni ti chɛ ka a kana ti liri ba la. .
en: The LORD God proclaims: Are you the one about whom I spoke in former times through my servants, Israels prophets, the ones who prophesied for years in those days to bring you against them?.

dag: Ti bi nyuri bara n-yaɣiri di ni simdi ni ti nyu bara shɛm tariga ninvuɣ shɛb tuma zuɣu, amaa ti tahima nyɛla ni yi yɛda yi zooi pahi, ti tuma soya gba ni yɛligi yi sani.
en: We limit our boasting to the work that is ours. We dont boast about the work other people have done. We hope that your faith will continue to grow. We hope that you will help our work to grow much larger.

dag: Amaa maligumaana bipuɣiŋga yi na bi dɔɣi bia ka niŋ pakoli bee n-yi o yidan yiŋa n-lab o ba yiŋ na ti ʒiya kaman o ni daa nyɛ bia shɛm la, o ni tooi di o ba bindirigu maa, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun pa maligumaana yiŋ nira, ŋun miri ka o di li.
en: But a widowed or divorced daughter who has no children and who has returned to live in her father's house as a dependent may eat the food her father receives as a priest. Only a member of a priestly family may eat any of it.

dag: Pɛlɛg ni daa ti paai yuun pihita saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Riu.
en: After Peleg was years old, his son Reu was born.

dag: Ka Haman daa yɛli naa, Chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ amaŋmaŋ nam kpar shɛŋa a ni pun ye min amaŋmaŋ wɔribaro ni nam zuɣupiligu din ni zaŋ pili dilan na;.
en: So he answered the king, Have royal robes brought for this man—robes that you yourself wear. Have a royal ornament put on your own horse.

dag: Nyin ŋun be tibi ŋɔ m-mali soli din be polipoli ti wuntizɔriba. Bɛ ni doli so shɛli nyɛla so viɛlli.
en: The way of the righteous is level; you clear a path for the righteous.

dag: Ahazia yuma daa nyɛla yuun pihinahinaayi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun yini. O ma yuli n-daa booni Atalia, o daa nyɛla Omri bia.
en: He was years old at the time, and he ruled only one year from Jerusalem. Ahaziah's mother was Athaliah, a granddaughter of King Omri of Israel.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Naa Hɛrɔd mini Pɔntius Pailɛt ni chɛfirinim zaŋ tabili Izraɛlnim zaa daa shiri laɣim ya n-zaɣisi a Wundab Suŋ Yisa, a ni daa zaŋ so leei Masia.
en: For indeed Herod and Pontius Pilate met together in this city with the Gentiles and the people of Israel against Jesus, your holy Servant, whom you made Messiah.

dag: Dauda daa bi chɛ ka binshɛli kpalim nimaani. Neem bihi bee neen kara bee bidibisi bee bipuɣinsi ni bɛ ni daa tuhi di neen shɛŋa la mini Amalɛknim maa ni daa kpuɣi bɛ neen shɛŋa zaa, Dauda daa zaŋ di zaa lab kuli.
en: nothing at all was missing. David got back all his men's sons and daughters, and all the loot the Amalekites had taken.

dag: Kum daa ti lan lu tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. Di daa nyɛla kum din pahi din daa pun lu Ibrahimma ʒiɛman ni la zuɣu. Ka Yisahaku daa chaŋ Filistianim Naa Abimilɛk sani Gɛra.
en: Once during Abraham's lifetime, the fields had not produced enough grain, and now the same thing happened. So Isaac went to King Abimelech of the Philistines in the land of Gerar.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla a daba ni a ninvuɣ shɛb a ni daa zaŋ a yiko min a nuu din mali kpiɔŋ tiligi.
en: Lord, these are your servants, your own people. You rescued them by your great power and strength.

dag: Ka wula ka niriba lee ni tooi yihi waazu, ka pa ni bɛ tim ba mi? Di nyɛla kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Bɛn mali lahibal suŋ waazu na ni bɛ ti yihi ŋɔ paabuna tiri suhupiɛlli.
en: And how can they preach unless they are sent? As it is written, How beautiful are the feet of those who announce the good news. .

dag: Bɛ zaŋ ti fali ti saamba, ka zaŋ ti yiya ti tinzunnima.
en: Our property has been turned over to strangers; our houses belong to foreigners.

dag: dindina o ni tooi zaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ŋɔ yuli tum tuma kaman o Lɛvi tab zaa ni zaani Yawɛ tooni tumdi tuma nimaani shɛm.
en: and may serve there as a priest of the Lord his God, like the other Levites who are serving there.

dag: Ninvuɣ suma nimmaŋtali n-wuhiri ba soli, amaa bilikɔɣinim bilikɔnsi bahiri ba la yoli.
en: If you are good, you are guided by honesty. People who can't be trusted are destroyed by their own dishonesty.

dag: Di niŋya binshɛli nyuli zabbu tɛha puuni bee m-bɔri ni yi doli alaha soli nyu bara; amaa siɣisimiya yimaŋa yi tab sani ka miriya ka yi tɛhiri ni yi so yi taba.
en: Don't be jealous or proud, but be humble and consider others more important than yourselves.

dag: M bɔrila suhudoo, amaa n yi yɛli shɛli, bɛ zaŋdi li mi leei zabili.
en: I am in favor of peace, but when I speak of it, all they want is war.

dag: Bina anahi m-be dunia ni ka nyɛ bɛn pɔra, amaa ka lee mali yɛm pam.
en: On this earth four things are small but very wise:.

dag: Di saha ka Juda daa yi o mabihi maa sani chaŋ Adulam nti be do so ŋun yuli daa booni Hira la sani.
en: About that time, Judah left his brothers and went to stay with a man named Hirah from the town of Adullam.

dag: Ka Judas mini Silas bɛn daa nyɛ bɛn mal anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu pini la daa lan tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa pam kpaŋsi bɛ suhuri pahi.
en: Judas and Silas, who were themselves prophets, spoke a long time with them, giving them courage and strength.

dag: Bɛ chɛ ka nandaamba kumdi niŋd o, ka o wum bɛ ni niŋdi shɛb alaka kuhigu.
en: They forced the poor to cry out to God, and he heard their calls for help.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ dabili Jɔshua Nan bia maa daa kpi. O daa niŋ dunia yil la yuun kɔbiga ni pia.
en: After these events, Joshua, Nuns son, the LORDs servant, died. He was .

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa zaɣisi n yɛligu maa wumbu, ka bi deei li, ka niŋ tipawumli bɛ ni daa lo zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu zuɣu, ka bɛ daa dolila bɛ suhuri ni bɔri shɛm, ka lihirila bɛ nyaaŋa, ka bi lihiri bɛ tooni.
en: But your ancestors did not listen to me. They did not pay attention to me. They were stubborn and did what they wanted to do. They did not become good. They became even more evil—they went backward, not forward.

dag: Amaa pin kasi shɛŋa din yi yi sanna mini yi ni po pɔri ni yi zaŋ pin shɛŋa ti dina, zaŋmiya li chaŋ Yawɛ ni yɛn pii luɣ shɛli maa.
en: Note that you must bring your sacred offerings and your payments for solemn promises to the location the LORD selects.

dag: Yi ni ti di n-tiɣi ka paɣi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, o ni zaŋ tiŋgban viɛli shɛli tin ya maa zuɣu.
en: You will eat, you will be satisfied, and you will bless the LORD your God in the wonderful land that hes given you.

dag: Masia yurilim n-gbibi ti, dama ti tɛha nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: Ninvuɣ yino yi daa kpi sokam zaa zuɣu, dindina sokam zaa kpimi m-bala.
en: We are ruled by Christ's love for us. We are certain that if one person died for everyone else, then all of us have died.

dag: Banima n-nyɛ bɛn daa lee wum Naawuni kukoli, amaa ka ti taai duŋ la? Pa bɛna n-nyɛ Anabi Musa ni daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb yi Ijipti na la?.
en: Who were the people who heard God's voice and rebelled against him? All those who were led out of Egypt by Moses.

dag: Di simdi ni ŋun tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛtɔɣ shɛli suhi Naawuni ka o niŋ o yiko, ka o kahigi di gbinni wuhi.
en: The person who speaks in strange tongues, then, must pray for the gift to explain what is said.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chani ti pihiri li asiba kam sokam dibu tariga, amaa wuntaŋ daa yi ti bii, di nyɛligirimi.
en: Every morning the people gathered as much food as they could eat, but by noon the food melted and was gone.

dag: Juda zuliya ni daa deei tiŋgban shɛli ni bɛ su li m-bɔŋɔ.
en: The tribe of Judah got the land that God promised them. Each family group got part of the land.

dag: Di zuɣu ka ti kul suhiri Naawuni tiri ya. Ti suhiri Naawuni ni o chɛ ka yi leei bɛn simdi biɛhigu shɛli o ni boli ya ni yi ti mali la. Naawuni sɔŋmi ya n-chɛ ka yi nya yi ni bɔri zaɣ suŋ shɛlikam ka naai yi yɛda tuma la tin ya o yiko ni.
en: We are constantly praying for you for this: that our God will make you worthy of his calling and accomplish every good desire and faithful work by his power.

dag: A kpaʒiɛrima nyom viɛla; a yuli ŋmanila tulaale. Dinzuɣu ka paɣiba yur a maa.
en: and you smell so sweet. All the young women adore you; the very mention of your name is like spreading perfume. *.

dag: Dama a yi bi dol ti chaŋ, wula ka bɛ ni ti baŋ ni a nini tiɣi m min a niriba ŋɔ? Ka bɔ n-leei yɛn woligi m min a niriba ŋɔ biɛhigu ka chɛ dunia ŋɔ niriba zaa biɛhigu.
en: Because how will anyone know that we have your special approval, both I and your people, unless you go with us? Only that distinguishes us, me and your people, from every other people on the earth.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee zaŋ nasaridira ŋɔ yi wulimpuhili polo na, ka chɛ ka o diri nasara luɣ shɛlikam ŋɔ? O chɛ ka o nyaŋ nanim mini zuliya kam. O zaŋ o takɔbi tim bɛ ni n-niŋ ba kaman taŋkpaɣu la. Ka zaŋ o piɛma to n-wurim ba kaman wurigu la.
en: Who woke up the man who is coming from the east? He called Justice to march with him. He uses his sword to crush nations. He uses his bow and conquers kings— they run away like straw blown by the wind.

dag: Yi ŋmanila firila dunia ŋɔ ni. Tin shɛli din me n-tam zoli zuɣu mi bi sɔɣira.
en: You are the light that shines for the world to see. You are like a city built on a hill that cannot be hidden.

dag: Dindali maa ni ti nyɛla suhuyiɣisili dabisili; di ni ti nyɛla nandahima mini biɛrim dabisili. Di ni ti nyɛla saɣiŋgu mini dabari zalibu dabisili, ka ni ti nyɛla zibisim mini bumbɔni dabisili. Di ni ti nyɛla sagbana mini zibisim titali dabisili.
en: It will be a day of fury, a day of trouble and distress, a day of ruin and destruction, a day of darkness and gloom, a black and cloudy day.

dag: Bɔ saha ka yi yɛn chɛ ma nahimbu, ka chɛ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa yi ni mali dariti tɔhiri ma ŋɔ?.
en: How long will you harass me and crush me with words?.

dag: Bɛ nina kul kpala paɣiba bɛn nyɛ zinaniŋdiba, ka bɛ nina na ʒi n-tiɣi shɛli alahichi tumbu puuni. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn bariti zana ni bɛ gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi ʒe yim, ka nyɛ bɛn bɔhim baŋ diribarilim tuma yɛla. Mbusim be bɛ zuɣu!.
en: They are always looking for someone with whom to commit adultery. They are always on the lookout for opportunities to sin. They ensnare people whose faith is weak. They have hearts trained in greed. They are under Gods curse.

dag: ni Hushai bia Baana ŋun daa be Asha mini Biilɔt yaɣili polo la.
en: Baana son of Hushai: the region of Asher and the town of Bealoth.

dag: N ni chɛ ka yi tum tuma ti yi dimnima yi ni bi mi tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni, dama n suhu yiɣisiya, ka n dabi buɣim din kul ni diri sahakam.
en: I will make them serve their enemies in a land they know nothing about, because my anger is like fire, and it will burn forever.

dag: amaa ŋun mali paɣa baɣa bela dunia ŋɔ yɛla ni ni o tum din tiɣ o paɣ nini.
en: But a married man is concerned about the worlds concerns—how he can please his wife.

dag: Molimi molo Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka mol li Migidol. Molimi li Mɛmfisi mini Tapanhɛs. Yɛlim ba, Zanimiya yi zaashɛhi, ka maliya shili, dama tɔbu ni di ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa gili ya.
en: Proclaim it in the towns of Egypt, in Migdol, Memphis, and Tahpanhes: Get ready to defend yourselves; all you have will be destroyed in war!.

dag: Ka Samla daa ti kpi, ka Shaul ŋun daa nyɛ Rɛhɔbɔt din daa be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni nir la daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: After Samlah died, Shaul from Rehoboth on the river became king.

dag: Ti suhuri fuŋmi, ka ti luri bɔɣa ni, yɛl biɛɣu paai ti, ka ti bahi yoli zaa.
en: Terror and trap have come upon us, catastrophe and collapse!.

dag: O ni daa ti nya ka o ku lan tooi sɔɣ o yaha, ka o daa kpuɣi bɛ ni zaŋ kulikaɣa wuɣi piɛ shɛli n-zaŋ kootaali tanta li din ni chɛ ka kom ku tooi kpe di ni. Ka o daa zaŋ o bia maa niŋ di ni n-zaŋ li chaŋ ti zali kaɣili ni mɔɣili duli.
en: She hid him for as long as she could. After three months she made a basket and covered it with tar so that it would float. Then she put the baby in the basket and put the basket in the river in the tall grass.

dag: Dan zuliya ni, Ammishadai bia Ahiɛza n-yɛn sɔŋ ya;.
en: from the tribe of Dan—Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai;.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Zaŋmi bɛ ni buɣisi yɛli shɛm maa buɣisi n ni yɛli shɛm. Bɛ ni buɣisi yɛli shɛm maa yi be di ko ka chɛ n dini maa di wuhiya ni neesim bee yɛlimaŋli ka bɛ ni.
en: You are to answer them, Listen to what the Lord is teaching you! Don't listen to mediums—what they tell you cannot keep trouble away.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa yɛl o yiŋnim mini bɛnkam zaa daa be o sani, Yihimiya tinzun tiŋ wuna din be yi sani bahi, ka mali yimaŋa, ka taɣi binyɛra ye.
en: So Jacob told his family and all the other people with him, Destroy all these foreign gods that you have. Make yourselves pure. Put on clean clothes.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni la sani. O daa bi siɣis omaŋ anab Jɛrimia ŋun daa zaŋ Yawɛ yɛtɔɣa tɔɣis o la sani.
en: Zedekiah did what the Lord his God considered evil. Jeremiah the prophet told him messages from the Lord . But Zedekiah did not humble himself and obey what Jeremiah said.

dag: Yi yi yɛn mali suhudoo sara ti Yawɛ, yin malimiya li ka di nyɛ din ni chɛ ka o deei yi sara maa.
en: When you offer a sacrifice of fellowship offerings to the Lord , you must offer it in the right way so that you will be accepted.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n suhu yuya ni n lola alikauli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ sani, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o suhuyiɣisili maa miligi ti zuɣu.
