en: I have now decided to make a covenant with the Lord , the God of Israel, so that he will no longer be angry with us.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Nyama n yɛn chɛmi ka a be kaman Naawuni la Firawuna sani, ka chɛ ka a mabia Aduna mi nyɛ a daanabi.
en: The Lord said: I am going to let your brother Aaron speak for you. He will tell your message to the king, just as a prophet speaks my message to the people.

dag: N ni daa bi yɛli shɛli zaŋ chaŋ n daalahichi polo, n kɔba ni daa chɔɣisimi, ka n kul ŋuhiri hal ka wuntaŋ ti lu.
en: When I kept quiet, my bones wore out; I was groaning all day long— every day, every night!.

dag: Amaa Nadab mini Abihu daa na bi dɔɣi bihi, ka daa lan daŋ bɛ ba kpibu, ka Ɛliɛza mini Itama daa nyɛ maligumaaniba.
en: Nadab and Abihu died before their father did, and left no descendants, so their brothers Eleazar and Ithamar became priests.

dag: Ka Liya min o bihi kana ti gban o tiŋa, ka Yisifu mini Reechɛl gba doli nyaaŋa na ti gban o tiŋa.
en: Then Leah and the children with her went to Esau and bowed down. And then Rachel and Joseph went to him and bowed down.

dag: A daa nya ti yaannim ni diri wahala shɛm Ijipti; ka daa wum bɛ fabila Teeku Ʒiɛɣu ni.
en: You saw how our ancestors suffered in Egypt; you heard their call for help at the Red Sea.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa deei Manɔa suhigu maa, ka chɛ ka Naawuni malaika maa lan lab paɣ maa sanna saha shɛl o ni daa yi mɔɣ kpaŋ ti ʒiya. Amaa o yidan Manɔa daa ka o sani.
en: God listened to Manoah, and Gods messenger came once more to the woman. She was sitting in the field, but her husband Manoah wasnt with her.

dag: Ka Samsin daa ti yɛli ba, M bɔri ni n ŋahi ya la ŋahili, ka yi yi ni tooi wuhi ma di gbinni zaŋ chaŋ amiliya chuɣu daba ayopɔin ŋɔ dali, n ni tin ya silinchi kpar suma pihita mini binyɛr sun shɛŋa din nyɛ chuɣu dali binyɛra.
en: Then Samson said to them, Let me tell you a riddle. If you can figure it out and tell me the answer within the seven days of the feast, Ill give you thirty linen robes and thirty sets of clothes.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ loya ni o niŋ dimbɔŋɔ, ka so mi ku tooi yiɣisi li. O pun teeg o nuu, ka so mi ku tooi pɔri li.
en: I, the Lord All-Powerful, have made these plans. No one can stop me now!.

dag: Karimi saria n-ti ma nasara, lihimi din tuhi.
en: You will judge in my favor, because you know what is right.

dag: Mbusim be bɛ zuɣu! Bɛ dolila Keen biɛhigu soli. Liɣiri zuɣu ka bɛ doli Balaam biriginsim sol la. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn taai duŋ kaman Kɔra ni daa taai duŋ shɛm la; bɛ ni bahi yoli kaman o ni daa bahi yoli shɛm.
en: How terrible for them! They have followed the way that Cain took. For the sake of money they have given themselves over to the error that Balaam committed. They have rebelled as Korah rebelled, and like him they are destroyed.

dag: Dama Yawɛ nyari daadamnim tuma zaa, ka mi bɛ soya zaa.
en: The Lord sees everything, and he watches us closely.

dag: Ŋmɛmiya biɛri paɣi Yawɛ, ka ŋme mɔɣilɔnim din mali mihi piapia paɣ o.
en: Play the lyre and praise the Lord . Play the ten-stringed harp for him.

dag: Ka Baasha daa ti kani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Tiriza; ka o bia Ɛla daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Baasha died and was buried in Tirzah, and his son Elah succeeded him as king.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ʒi ba lab Shɛkɛm tiŋgbɔŋ ni ti sɔɣi ba ti yab Ibrahimma ni daa zaŋ anzinfa laɣipiɛligu da sil shɛli Hamɔr bihi san la ni.
en: Their bodies were brought back to Shechem and placed in the tomb that Abraham had purchased for a certain sum of money from Hamors children, who lived in Shechem.

dag: Ka n wurim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o sani zaa kpɛhi luɣilikam, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn sɔŋd o min o tɔbbihi zaa, ka ŋooi takɔbi doli ba.
en: I will force the kings people to live in the foreign countries around Israel, and I will scatter his army to the winds. The enemy soldiers will chase after them.

dag: A ni niŋ shɛm maa bi viɛla. Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, yi simdila kubu, dama yi bi gul yi dan naa ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ni booi kpam bahi ninvuɣ so zuɣu ni maa. Ka pumpɔŋɔ nyam naa kpan la min o ko gaɣili din ʒe o zuɣusaa la ni be luɣ shɛli.
en: You failed in your duty, Abner! I swear by the living Lord that all of you deserve to die, because you have not protected your master, whom the Lord made king. Look! Where is the king's spear? Where is the water jar that was right by his head.

dag: Ka o paɣ maa daa kum niŋ o bɛ daamiliya chuɣu daba ayopɔin maa ni zaa. Ka paɣ maa daa muɣisi Samsin hal ka o ti bahi wuh o ŋahili maa gbinni di daba ayopɔin maa dali. Ka paɣ maa daa zaŋ li chaŋ ti yɛl o niriba maa.
en: Samsons wife cried for the rest of the seven days of the party. So he finally gave her the answer to the riddle on the seventh day. He told her because she kept bothering him. Then she went to her people and told them the answer to the riddle.

dag: Hɛzɛkia ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o tuun suma, bɛ sab li niŋla Amɔz bia anabi Aizaia ni daa nya ʒii shɛli ka di be Juda mini Izraɛl nanim litaafi puuni la.
en: Everything else that King Hezekiah did and his devotion to the Lord are recorded in The Vision of the Prophet Isaiah Son of Amoz and in The History of the Kings of Judah and Israel .

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛlnim maa daa kul be Keenannim mini Hitinim ni Amɔrinim ni Pɛrizinim ni Hivinim ni Jɛbusinim maa ni.
en: And so the people of Israel settled down among the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

dag: o yi baŋ o ni tum alahichi shɛl maa, ŋun bom bunyaŋ ŋun ka dalinli m-mali sara o ni tum alahichi shɛli maa zuɣu.
en: As soon as you realize what you have done, you must sacrifice a female goat that has nothing wrong with it.

dag: Bɛ loya ni bɛ yihi ma la dunia ŋɔ ni, amaa m bi zaɣis a zaligunim maa.
en: They have almost destroyed me, but I have not stopped obeying your instructions.

dag: A ni saɣi diɛmd o kaman noombil la bee n-lo o zal a tumtumdiba bɛn nyɛ bipuɣinsi?.
en: Will you play with Leviathan as you would play with a bird? Will you put a rope on him so that your girls can play with him?.

dag: Naa daa chɛ ka o sapashin so ŋun gul o la n-ʒe n-guli dunɔdali, ka niriba daa no o dunɔdali maa ni hal ka o ti kpi kaman Naawuni nir maa ni daa pun yɛli shɛm saha shɛli naa ni daa ka o sanna la.
en: But the king had put the officer whom he leaned on for support in charge of the city gate. The people trampled the officer at the gate, and he died. This was just what the man of God said when the king had come down to him.

dag: Yisa daa ti be Naawuni jɛmbu duu wuhiri niriba ka daa ti bɔhi ba, Wula ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba lee ni tooi yɛli ni Masia nyɛla Naa Dauda yaaŋa?.
en: As Jesus was teaching in the temple, he said, How can the teachers of the Law of Moses say the Messiah will come from the family of King David?.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee gbarigi, ka o gbariginsim maa bi tabili ma? Ŋuni ka so lee luhi, ka n suhu bi yiɣisi bahi ŋun luh o maa zuɣu?.
en: Who is weak without me being weak? Who is led astray without me being furious about it?.

dag: Di saha ka tinim bɛn nyɛ a niriba ni a ni gul shɛb kaman piɛgul ŋɔ kul ni puhir a sahakam ka paɣir a ʒiɛmani kam puuni.
en: We are, after all, your people and the sheep of your very own pasture. We will give you thanks forever; we will proclaim your praises from one generation to the next.

dag: Yaa ti Duuma Naawuni, a daa wuh a yiko ni nyɛ shɛm yih a niriba Ijipti na, ka bɛ na kul teer a yiko tuma maa yɛla. Ti tum alahichi ka tum din bi tuhi.
en: But now, my Lord, our God—you who brought your people out of Egypt with a strong hand, making a name for yourself even to this day: We have sinned and done the wrong thing.

dag: Di saha ka Sanbalat mini Gɛshɛm daa tim na ti yɛli ma ni n chirigim ba tiŋkpan shɛli din be Ono Bɔpiɛligu ni la. Amaa bɛ daa lomi ni bɛ niŋ ma zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Then Sanballat and Geshem sent a message, asking me to meet with them in one of the villages in Ono Valley. I knew they were planning to harm me in some way.

dag: Yawɛ, yɛlimaŋli, Asiria nanim pun saɣim zuliya pam tiŋgbɔna.
en: It is true, our Lord , that Assyrian kings have turned nations into deserts.

dag: amaa sara maligu maa nimdi yi zani hal ni daba ata, bɛn zaŋm li nyo buɣim.
en: but any that is left over must be destroyed. If you eat any of it after the second day, your sacrifice will be useless and unacceptable, and you will be both disgusting and guilty.

dag: Di ku yuui ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be sarika ni maa nya yolisim. Bɛ ku kpi, bindirigu mi ku pooi ba.
en: Everyone crying out in pain will be quickly set free; they will be rescued from the power of death and never go hungry.

dag: ka gbihiri yuŋ kam, ka yiɣisiri asiba kam, ka bimbira maa mali hal nti bilina zooi, ka o bi mi din chɛ ka di niŋ lala maa.
en: He sleeps at night, is up and about during the day, and all the while the seeds are sprouting and growing. Yet he does not know how it happens.

dag: Do so daa be Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya zuɣu tinshee ka o yuli booni Maika.
en: Once there was a man named Micah who lived in the Ephraim highlands.

dag: N tum din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli ni din tuhi. Di chɛ ma ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nahindi ma.
en: I have done what is right and good. Dont let me fall into the hands of those who want to hurt me.

dag: amaa ŋun mali kpiɔŋ gar o yi ti lir o n-nyaŋ o, o farila o bidibbin shɛŋa o ni niŋ yɛda maa, ka fa o nɛma maa.
en: But suppose a stronger man comes and defeats him. The stronger man will take away the weapons that the first man trusted to keep his house safe. Then the stronger man will do what he wants with the other mans things.

dag: Pa mani ka o di tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa maa jɛndira, ka n ku zaŋ yi yɛtɔɣa maa garig o.
en: Job was arguing with you, not me, so I will not use your arguments to answer him.

dag: Nɛbo din pahi la niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pihinunaayi.
en: of the other Nebo.

dag: Zuliya kam ni zo Yawɛ yuli, ka dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa lu o sizuura o jilima zuɣu.
en: The nations will worship the Lord s name. All the kings on earth will honor you.

dag: Ka a zaŋ Lɛvinim maa na ti zali laɣiŋgu suɣili la tooni, ka laɣim Izraɛlnim zaa na.
en: Then assemble the whole community of Israel and have the Levites stand in front of the Tent of my presence.

dag: A daa zaŋ liiga shɛŋa bɛ ni wuɣi n-yɛli ba, ka zaŋ n kpam mini n tulaale zim la zali bɛ tooni.
en: You dressed them in the clothes you got from me, and you offered them the olive oil and incense I gave you.

dag: Zuɣusaa kahigi Naawuni wuntitali wuhi, dama Naawuni maŋmaŋa n-nyɛ sariakarita.
en: The heavens proclaim that God is righteous, that he himself is judge.

dag: Dabisili din pah ata dali, Hɛlɔn bia Ɛliab ŋun daa nyɛ Zɛbulɔn zuliya zuɣulan la n-daa mali sara.
en: On the third day Zebuluns Chief Eliab, Helons son.

dag: Zɔntuhi daa kul gilila di luɣilikam, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pinaayi ni pirigili, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita ayi ni pirigili.
en: There were porches all around, thirty-seven and a half feet long and seven and a half feet wide.

dag: Hal yi zabiri zaa mali kalinli.
en: Even the hairs on your head are counted.

dag: Di ni naɣ simdi ni yi niŋ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yɛlimiya tab yɛlimaŋli, ka karimiya saria ka di doli yɛlimaŋli soli, ka lan nyɛ din tiri suhudoo yi kootunim ni.
en: These are the things you should do: Speak the truth to one another. In the courts give real justice—the kind that brings peace.

dag: Hal pumpɔŋɔ, a dimnim taala duŋ; ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je a gba mal a gadama.
en: Look! Your enemies are in revolt, and those who hate you are rebelling.

dag: Daba ayopɔin nyaaŋa ka kokpɛɣu daa kpe m-pali dunia ŋɔ.
en: Seven days later a flood began to cover the earth.

dag: din ni chɛ ka yi woligi bɛn nyɛ daɣiri ni bɛn viɛla, ka lan baŋ yin ni di binnamdi so ŋun mali nyɛvili ni yin ku di binnamdi so ŋun mali nyɛvili.
en: These rules will help the people know which animals are unclean and which animals they are allowed to eat and which ones they cannot eat.

dag: Ŋuna ŋun me o dufahira zali zuɣusaa, ka zali di tanzahi dunia ni ŋɔ; ŋuna n-zaŋdi teeku kom n-kpaari li bahiri tiŋgban ni na. O yuli m-booni Yawɛ.
en: He built his upper rooms above the skies. He put his skies over the earth. He calls for the waters of the sea and pours them out as rain on the land. YAHWEH is his name.

dag: Kaman man ni nya shɛm, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kɔri zaɣ biɛɣu puu, ka biriti yɛlimuɣisira, dina ka bɛ ti yɛn chɛra.
en: Yes, I have seen people whose lives were cut short, but they were evil troublemakers.

dag: Ninsal ni tumdi tuma ka niŋdi wahala dunia ŋɔ ni m-bɔri ni o nya shɛli maa buchi lee nyɛla dini?.
en: What do people really have after all their work and struggling in this life?.

dag: Naftali zuliya ni sapashinnim tuhili mini tɔbbihi tuhi Pihitanaayopɔin n-daa buɣiri kpana ka gbibi nyɔtaɣira.
en: From the tribe of Naphtali there were officers. They had , men with them. These men carried shields and spears.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ bɛ sani nti chɛ ka bɛ yɛtɔɣa woli taba, ka di chɛ ka bɛ ku lan tooi wum tab yɛtɔɣa.
en: Lets go down and confuse their language. Then they will not understand each other.

dag: Di simdi ka n tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ka nya faako. Di simdi ni n yaai n noli garigi.
en: I can't stand it; I have to speak.

dag: N yi baŋ a wuntia zaligunim maa, n ni paɣ a ni suhu yini.
en: I will do right and praise you by learning to respect your perfect laws.

dag: M mali tahima Naawuni sani ni wuntizɔriba mini ninvuɣ biɛri ni neei kum ni, kaman bɛ gba ni mali di tahima shɛm.
en: I am just as sure as these people are that God will raise from death everyone, good or evil.

dag: Amaa ka Jɛrimia daa yɛli Rɛkabinim maa, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ni daa deei yi yab Jɔnadab ni wuhi ya shɛm, ka dol o zaligunim zaa, ka niŋ o ni daa yɛli ni yi niŋ shɛm zaa la zuɣu.
en: Then Jeremiah said to the Rechabite family: The LORD of heavenly forces, the God of Israel, proclaims: Because you have obeyed all Jonadabs instructions and you have done everything he commanded you.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n kana pumpɔŋɔ ni n tuh a soli. M bo a ni nimmoo, ka ti nya a maa.
en: and I still have plenty of food left. So I came out to find you, and here you are!.

dag: Amaa shee o di wahala balibu kam pɔi, ka ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nim ti zaɣis o.
en: However, first he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.

dag: Ka Ɛzra daa bɔɣi litaafi maa niriba maa zaa ninni, dama o ni daa ʒe luɣ shɛli maa daa du n-gari niriba maa ni daa ʒe luɣ shɛli. O ni daa bɔɣi litaafi maa, niriba maa zaa daa yiɣisimi zani.
en: Ezra was up on the high platform, where he could be seen by everyone, and when he opened the book, all the people stood up.

dag: Sanzali lu bɛ kulisi zuɣu ni di chɛ ka di koma nyuui. Dama di nyɛla binnana ni pali tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni. Ka bɛ suhuri zaa kul ye buɣa jɛmbu zuɣu.
en: Bring a drought on its land and dry up its rivers. Babylonia is a land of terrifying idols that have made fools of the people.

dag: Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bi tooi baŋ ni pa bɔrɔbɔro yɛla ka n yɛri maa? Ka daa lan yɛli ba yaha, Miriya Farisiinim mini Sadusiinim dabindi la.
en: So how could you think that I am concerned about bread? I am telling you to be careful and guard against the yeast of the Pharisees and the Sadducees.

dag: Pa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa wumdi Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa ni yɛli shɛm n-nyɛ bɛn yiri taali ni Naawuni sani, amaa bɛn doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa n-nyɛ bɛn yiri taali ni Naawuni sani.
en: God accepts those who obey his Law, but not those who simply hear it.

dag: Bɛ laakuma mini bɛ niɣi ni ti leei yi ni ŋme tɔbu di shɛba. N ni ti wurim buɣijɛmdiba bɛn pindi zuɣukpina ŋɔ kpɛhi yɔɣu, ka chɛ ka yɛlibiɛɣu yi luɣilikam na ti lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: Then your camels and large herds will be yours no longer. People of the Arabian Desert, disaster will strike you from every side, and you will be scattered everywhere on earth.

dag: Yi daa wum di yɛla la ti tumtumdikpee Ɛpafiras so ti ni yura, ka o nyɛ Masia tumtumda ŋun ʒe yim ka ʒe ti zaani la sani.
en: You heard it from Epaphras, our dear friend and co-worker. He is a faithful servant of Christ for us.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa tuui labina ti ʒini bɛ tiŋgbani maa ni n-daa nyɛ: Izraɛlnim mini maligumaaniba ni Lɛvinima ni Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba.
en: The first to resettle their property in their towns were the Israelite people, the priests, the Levites, and the temple servants.

dag: Di yɛn nyɛla shihirili ni shɛhira Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ sani Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Bɛ yi ti fabili niŋ Yawɛ niriba bɛn nahindi ba la, o ni tim ŋun ni fa ba bahi bɛ sani ka o ti fa ba bahi.
en: It will be a sign and a witness to the LORD of heavenly forces in the land of Egypt. When they cry out to the LORD because of oppressors, God will send them a savior and defender to rescue them.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee chɛ ka saa miri ninsalinim ni ka luɣ shɛli mini tiŋgban nɛli ni din nyɛ daadamnim ni ka luɣ shɛli?.
en: Who makes rain fall where no one lives?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ ba paai sariakaritib sani ti yɛli, Niriba ŋɔ nyɛla Yɛhudianima, ka saɣindi ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: They told the officials, These Jews are upsetting our city!.

dag: Ka bɛn daa ʒe nimaani maa shɛb wum lala ka yɛli, Doo maa boonila Anabi Ilaija.
en: Some of the people standing there heard Jesus and said, He's calling for Elijah.

dag: Ti Duuma Naawuni ŋun nyɛ suhudoo ni yiri so sanna ŋɔ kpalimmi be yi zaa sani. Ami!.
en: May the God of peace be with you all. Amen.

dag: Di saha ka malaika maa daa zaŋ tulaale laa maa m-mooi bimbini maa zuɣu buɣim m-pal li n-zaŋ kpaai bahi dunia ni, ka saa daa gbaai nyaɣisibu ni tahibu, ka vuri yiɣisi mɔni ka tiŋgbani damda.
en: Then the angel took the incense container, filled it with fire from the altar, and threw it on the earth. There were rumblings and peals of thunder, flashes of lightning, and an earthquake.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni ti ku ninvuɣ biɛri la tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka darigi yihi bɛn bi ʒe yim di ni.
en: But God will snatch the wicked from the land and pull sinners out of it like plants from the ground.

dag: Paɣimiya Izraɛlnim Duuma Naawuni, dama o kana ti kaag o niriba ka tiligi ba.
en: Praise to the Lord God of Israel. He has come to help his people and has given them freedom.

dag: Ka bɛ daa bi lan ʒe Jɛrubaal malibu yim, o ni daa tum tuun sun shɛli ti Izraɛlnim la gba zuɣu.
en: Besides all that, the Israelites were unkind to Gideon's family, even though Gideon had done so much for Israel.

dag: Ka Yisa ni daa ŋahi ninvuɣ shɛb ŋahili ŋɔ bɔri ni bɛ gbaag o, dama bɛ daa baŋya ni bɛna ka o ŋahi ŋahili maa dalim, amaa ka daa lee zɔri salo maa ka chɛ o ka chaŋ.
en: When these Jewish leaders heard this story, they knew it was about them. They wanted to find a way to arrest Jesus, but they were afraid of what the crowd would do. So they left him and went away.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila tibihi din nyaɣa na bi ba tiŋa, ka Naawuni yi chɛ ka tulim kana ti kpe li, di kuurimi ka pɔhim ʒe li ti bahi kaman wurigu la.
en: Scarcely are they planted, scarcely sown, scarcely is their shoot rooted in the earth when God breathes on them, and they dry up; the windstorm carries them off like straw.

dag: Dama hal so ku lan be nayili, bɛ ni ti zo zaa ka chɛ tiŋ maa. Ka tiŋgula biɛhigu shee mini yiya lu n-dahim zaa n-kul doya sahakam. Ka nimaani leei mɔɣu ni bunsi gɔrim shee ni piɛri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: Even the palace will be abandoned and the capital city totally deserted. Homes and the forts that guarded them will be in ruins forever. Wild donkeys will roam there, and sheep will find pasture there.

dag: Bɛ daa tɔɣisiri Jɛrusalɛmnim Naawuni maa yɛla mi kaman dunianim buɣ shɛŋa niriba ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali la.
en: The officials talked about the Lord God as if he were nothing but an ordinary god or an idol that someone had made.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ niriba alahiziba pam ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Naa Dauda yaaŋa n-ni bala yɔɣɔ.
en: All the crowds were amazed and said, This man couldnt be the Son of David, could he.

dag: Ka Gabirɛl daa kana ti zani baɣili ma. Ka dabiɛm daa gbaai ma pam, ka n lu n-dɔni tiŋa. Ka o yɛli ma, Daadam bia, n ni chɛ ka a baŋ di gbinni. Ʒii maa wuhirila dunia ŋɔ bahigu yɛla.
en: Gabriel came and stood beside me, and I was so terrified that I fell to the ground. He said to me, Mortal man, understand the meaning. The vision has to do with the end of the world.

dag: amaa yi ni daa deei Shia Kasi so Masia san la nyɛla ŋun kul kpalim be yi ni, ka di bi lan simdi ni so wuhi ya shɛli; Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi ni wuhiri ya binshɛɣukam ka di nyɛ yɛlimaŋli ka pa ʒiri la zuɣu, kul benya Masia ni.
en: But Christ has blessed you with the Holy Spirit. Now the Spirit stays in you, and you don't need any teachers. The Spirit is truthful and teaches you everything. So stay one in your heart with Christ, just as the Spirit has taught you to do.

dag: Dama bɛ daa ku o suli bɛ buɣa jɛmbu ni, ka daa chɛ ka nyuli gbaag o bɛ binnana jɛmbu zuɣu.
en: They angered God with their many shrines; they angered him with their idols.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka n shia siɣi Izraɛlnim zuɣu na, ka n ku lan ŋmaligi n nini bahi kpaŋa ka chɛ ba. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: When I pour my Spirit upon the house of Israel, I wont hide my face from them again. This is what the LORD God says.

dag: Ka maligumaana Zɛfania daa karim gbaŋ maa ka anabi Jɛrimia wum.
en: Zephaniah the priest read the letter to Jeremiah the prophet.

dag: N di bi zaɣisi ka bɛ zaŋ chiriga n-chirigi li pa tampiŋ zuɣu, ka di kul beni sahakam!.
en: Or with a chisel carve my words in stone and write them so that they would last forever.

dag: M biyurisi bɛn nyɛ n ni lan wolisiri shɛb zuɣu ni Masia be yi ni ŋɔ.
en: My little children, I am in pain again over you, like a mother giving birth. I will feel this pain until people can look at you and see Christ.

dag: ni tiŋgban ni pin suma mini di binshɛɣukam ni ŋun daa be tutuɣu din diri buɣim ŋɔ yurilim. Chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔnim siɣi Yisifu zuɣu na, ka chɛ ka di siɣi ŋun ŋun nyɛ nabia o mabihi sunsuuni ŋɔ ningbaɣu kɔbiri zuɣu na.
en: Let the earth give its best to Joseph. He was separated from his brothers. So may the Lord in the burning bush give his best to Joseph.

dag: Ka ŋun daa daŋ tooni ka o sanna ti yɛl o, N dana, a pɔŋli la dɔɣila pɔŋ pia.
en: The first servant came and said, Sir, I earned ten bags of money with the one bag you gave me.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri yi nya yaa, biriginsim pahirimi, amaa wuntizɔriba ni nya bɛ lubu.
en: Crime increases when crooks are in power, but law-abiding citizens will see them fall.

dag: Ka di simdi ka o lihi dɔro maa, ka dɔro maa yi be yili maa dukpina zuɣu, ka zaɣ baŋkom garisi di ni bee bin ʒiɛhi gari di ni, ka di kpe dukpini maa puuni.
en: If the priest discovers greenish or reddish spots that go deeper than the surface of the walls.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ʒi ba lab Shɛkɛm tiŋgbɔŋ ni ti sɔɣi ba ti yab Ibrahimma ni daa zaŋ anzinfa laɣipiɛligu da sil shɛli Hamɔr bihi san la ni.
en: Later their bodies were taken back to Shechem and placed in the tomb that Abraham had bought from the sons of Hamor.

dag: Dama ti nyɛla bɛn mini Naawuni laɣim tumda, ka yi mi nyɛ Naawuni puu. Yi lan nyɛla Naawuni duu.
en: We are Gods coworkers, and you are Gods field, Gods building.

dag: N yɛri ya mi, Doliya Naawuni Shia Kasi biɛhigu, ka miriya ka yi doli niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma soli.
en: I say be guided by the Spirit and you wont carry out your selfish desires.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yi ʒi yi ni suhiri shɛli maa. Yi ni ti tooi nyu binnyur shɛli din be m pipia la ni ka n yɛn nyu la? Ka tooi deei baptaizibu shɛli bɛ ni ti yɛn baptaizi ma la.
en: Jesus replied, You dont know what youre asking! Can you drink the cup I drink or receive the baptism I receive.

dag: Ka Pita lan chihi yaha; ka nolɔɣu dii kum.
en: Peter denied it again, and immediately a rooster crowed.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti sa Ashɛra tia baɣili yi ni ti yɛn me Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sara maligu bimbin shɛl la.
en: Dont plant any tree to serve as a sacred pole next to the altar you make for the LORD your God.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yo Yaakubu zuliya samli, ka tiligi ba bɛn mali yaa gari ba nuu ni.
en: The Lord will bring Jacob back. He will save his people from those who are stronger.

dag: Izraɛlnima, wummiya: Yawɛ n-nyɛ ti Naawuni, kulla Yawɛ kɔŋko.
en: Israel, remember this! The Lord —and the Lord alone—is our God.

dag: M mabiyurisi n suhiri ya, yi ni nyɛ saamba be tinzun tinsi ni la zuɣu, zomiya niŋgbuŋ kɔr biɛri tuma din mini yi biɛhigu tuhiri tɔbu la.
en: Dear friends, you are like visitors and strangers in this world. So I beg you to keep your lives free from the evil things you want to do, those desires that fight against your true selves.

dag: Ka Ishipan mini Ɛba ni Ɛliɛl.
en: Shashaks family: Ishpan, Eber, Eliel.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Bɛn be zuɣusaa, paɣimiya Yawɛ! Bɛn be zuɣusaa katiŋ ha, paɣimiy o!.
en: Praise the Lord ! Praise the Lord from heaven, you that live in the heights above.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa ni daa nya lala maa, ka bɛ teei dɔni n-zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tiŋa ka yɛra, Yawɛ n-shiri nyɛ Naawuni, Yawɛ n-shiri nyɛ Naawuni.
en: When the crowd saw what had happened, they all bowed down and shouted, The Lord is God! The Lord is God.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Izraɛl toondaannima n-daa gari tooni chaŋ ti tuhi tɔb maa, ka niriba maa daa zaŋ bɛ nyɛviya pa talima ni bɛ suhu yubu.
en: The men of Israel prepared for battle. They volunteered to go to war. Praise the Lord !.

dag: Di saha ka malaika maa daa yɛli ma, A ni nya kulisi ko shɛŋa ka pagɔrili la du n-ʒi di zuɣu la nyɛla salo bɛn yi niriba balibu pam ni mini zuliyanim pam ni ni tinzun yɛligu pam nim ni na.
en: Then he said to me, The waters that you saw, where the prostitute is seated, are peoples, crowds, nations, and languages.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun nyɛ Baasha daŋ ni nir yi kpi yiŋa, bahi n-yɛn ŋub o; ka ŋun mi kpi mɔɣu ni, juri n-yɛn di o.
en: Dogs will eat the bodies of those in your family who die in the city. And wild birds will eat the bodies of those who die out in the fields.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti be dufahirili zuɣu, ŋun di lan siɣina ni o ti kpe o duu kah o nɛma;.
en: They should run away without wasting time to stop for anything. If they are on the roof of their house, they must not go down to get anything out of the house.

dag: Paɣisarili maa daa viɛl pam, ka lan nyɛ paɣipiɛliga ŋun mini doo na bi dɔni. Ka o daa chaŋ kɔbiliga maa ni nti ŋɔŋ kom du na.
en: She was a very beautiful young woman and still a virgin. She went down to the well, filled her jar, and came back.

dag: Ka Naa Zɛdɛkia daa yɛli ba, Ŋuna m-bɔŋɔ; o bela yi nuu ni, dama man naa ka yi yiko.
en: So King Zedekiah said to the officials, Jeremiah is in your control. I cannot do anything to stop you.

dag: Di simdi ka di mali daanya daantalisi pisi mini di ni yɛn tam binshɛŋa zuɣu pisi, amaa ban shɛŋa din yɛn yili daantalisi maa mini di dapuhi dina, zaŋmiya anzinfa mal li.
en: with twenty posts, twenty copper bases, and silver hooks and bands for the posts.

dag: Ka Saimɔn Pita yɛl o, N Duuma, dindina pa n naba kɔŋko, amaa paɣimi n naba zaŋ tabili n nuhi ni n zuɣu zaa.
en: Peter said, Lord, don't wash just my feet. Wash my hands and my head.

dag: Yi ni ti zaŋ liɣiri da bindira bɛ sani di, ka lan zaŋ liɣiri da kom bɛ sani nyu.
en: You may buy food and water from them.

dag: N nyɛla bɛn mali suhudoo ka ʒe yim Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni yino. Ka yi ti bɔri ni yi wurim tin shɛli din nyɛ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni tinsi ma? Bɔzuɣu ka a bɔri ni a saɣim Yawɛ ni su binshɛli.
en: Ours is a great city, one of the most peaceful and loyal in Israel. Why are you trying to destroy it? Do you want to ruin what belongs to the Lord .

dag: Ka Dauda yɛl o, Yɛlim ma din niŋ. Ka o yɛl o, Tɔbbihi maa ŋmaligimi guui, ka bɛ pam lu tɔb maa ni, ka Sool min o bia Jɔnatan gba lu tɔb maa ni.
en: Tell me what happened, David said. Our army ran away from the battle, he replied, and many of our men were killed. Saul and his son Jonathan were also killed.

dag: Amaa ka Firawuna bipuɣiŋga la daa yiɣisi Dauda tiŋ la ni n-kul omaŋmaŋ yil shɛli Sulemaana ni daa me n-ti o la ni. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa me ŋ-ŋari luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Millo la.
en: When Pharaohs daughter went up from Davids City to the palace he had built for her, Solomon built the stepped structure.

dag: O daa chɛ ka sagbani n-wuhiri ba soli wuntaŋ ni, ka chɛ ka buɣim neesim mi wuhiri ba soli yuŋ hal ka biɛɣu ti neei.
en: He guided them during the day with a cloud, and each night he led them with a flaming fire.

dag: O bituuli yuli n-daa booni Abidɔn, ka Zur mini Kish ni Baal ni Nɛr ni Nadab.
en: His oldest son was Abdon, followed by Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab.

dag: Di simdi ka Izraɛlnim zaa dol li.
en: And all Israelites must take part in the meal.

dag: Dama m mini Silvanus ni Timoti ni daa yihi Naawuni Bia ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia yɛla waazu shɛli yi sani la daa pala Iin mini Aai yɛla, amaa o ni, di kul nyɛla Iin.
en: For Jesus Christ, the Son of God, who was preached among you by Silas, Timothy, and myself, is not one who is Yes and No. On the contrary, he is God's Yes;.

dag: Ka paɣiba maa daa booni Izraɛlnim maa chani bɛ buɣa maligunim ni, ka bɛ ti jɛmdi buɣa maa ka diri di maligu bindira.
en: These women then invited the men to ceremonies where sacrifices were offered to their gods. The men ate the meat from the sacrifices and worshiped the Moabite gods.

dag: O daa mi ni nyuli ka bɛ zab Yisa n-zaŋ o tahi na maa.
en: Pilate knew the leaders had brought Jesus to him because they were jealous.

dag: Di daa ti lu Vuhim Dabisili dali, ka Yisa chaŋ Farisiinim kpeen so yiŋa ni o min o ti laɣim di bindirigu, ka Farisiinim maa daa kul kpahind o.
en: On a Sabbath day, Jesus went to the home of a leading Pharisee to eat with him. The people there were all watching him very closely.

dag: Ka o daa yɛl o pukpar kpɛma, Nyama, zuŋɔ yuma ata m-bɔŋɔ ka n kul kanna ti bɔri tia ŋɔ wala ka bi nyara; dinzuɣu ŋmaam li bahi! Bɔzuɣu ka nir ni chɛ li zali ka di kul nyuri tam yoli.
en: He had a servant who took care of his garden. So he said to his servant, I have been looking for fruit on this tree for three years, but I never find any. Cut it down! Why should it waste the ground.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Naawuni, ka pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, mani n-kul nyɛ Naawuni. So ku tooi fa nira n nuu ni bahi; so ku tooi gu n ni yɛn tum shɛli soli.
en: I am God and always will be. No one can escape from my power; no one can change what I do.

dag: Ka Ibram daa bo biŋkɔbiri maa mini ŋmana maa zaa na nti kɔri ba m-pirigipirigi ba buyiyi n-zaŋ ba sɔŋ tuhi taba. Amaa o daa bi pirigi ŋmana la bɛn buyiyi.
en: Abram obeyed the Lord . Then he cut the animals in half and laid the two halves of each animal opposite each other on the ground. But he did not cut the doves and pigeons in half.

dag: Di daa bi yuui ka di niŋ Naa Nɛbukadnɛza alahiziba, ka o vaai yiɣisi zani ka bɔh o kpambaliba, Pa niriba ata ka ti lo mihi niŋ buɣim ŋɔ ni la? Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Naa, lala n-nyɛ li.
en: Then King Nebuchadnezzar jumped up in shock and said to his associates, Didnt we throw three men, bound, into the fire? They answered the king, Certainly, Your Majesty.

dag: A zaŋla neesim ye kaman binyɛrigu la. A teela sagbana sɔŋ kaman tanti la.
en: You wear light like a robe; you open the skies like a curtain.

dag: Ka o daa ba buŋ maa n-yi soli chani ha ka gbuɣinli chirig o n-gbaag o ku o, ka vu o sɔŋ sol ni; ka buŋ maa ʒe m-baɣ o; ka gbuɣinli maa gba ʒe m-baɣ o.
en: The man of God departed, and a lion found him on the road and killed him. His body was thrown down on the road. The donkey stood beside it, and the lion also stood beside the body.

dag: Yi zaŋla yi wuna ŋmahima n-zali baɣili yi duri puuni dunoya. Yi zaɣisi ma, ka mali yi gariti ka di yɛlim pam, ka ti yi mamanim liɣiri, ka pirigiri yi situra ka mali ba dooni nyari bɛ zaɣim.
en: You set up your obscene idols just inside your front doors. You forsake me; you take off your clothes and climb in your large beds with your lovers, whom you pay to sleep with you. And there you satisfy your lust.

dag: O tiligiri bɛ nyɛviya nahiŋgu mini duŋtaariba nuu ni; bɛ nyɛviya nyɛla din viɛl pam o sani.
en: He redeems their lives from oppression and violence; their blood is precious in his eyes.

dag: Bɛ bela zibisim ni wuntaŋ ni, ka bɔbindi gindi wuntaŋ ni kaman yuŋ la.
en: even at noon they grope in darkness.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kpahi tayiɣis ayi gba tabili dapula n-zaŋ sa m-pahi Yisa zuɣu: Yino o nudirigu polo, ŋun la mi o nuzaa polo. .
en: They also crucified two bandits with Jesus, one on his right and the other on his left.

dag: Amaa Izraɛlnim galisim ni ti ŋmanila teeku duli bihigu din ku tooi buɣisi ka mi ku tooi kali ŋɔ. Ka luɣ shɛli di ni yɛli ba, Yi pala n niriba ŋɔ, di ni ti lan boli ba, Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ bidibisi.
en: In the future the number of the people of Israel will be like the sand of the sea, which you cannot measure or count. In the same place that God told them, You are not my people, he will call them children of the Living God.

dag: Ŋuna n-ni tooi yɛli naa, A nyɛla ninvuɣ yoli ka yɛli kpambaliba, Yi nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: Will you say to a king, Worthless! to royalty, Evil.

dag: Amaa ka Lɔt paɣ ŋun daa be o nyaaŋa daa ti ŋmaligi lih o nyaaŋa, ka leei yalim kuɣili.
en: On the way, Lot's wife looked back and was turned into a block of salt.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa yi lihi niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ dɔr shɛli din zaɣisir maa, ka di bi kpe o niŋgbuŋ puuni, ka kɔb sabila ka di ni, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun zaŋmi ninvuɣ so ŋun mali niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ dɔr shɛli din zaɣisir maa niŋ duu hal ni daba ayopɔin.
en: When the priest examines the scabies infection, if it does not appear to be deeper than the skin, but there is no black hair in it, the priest will quarantine the person with the scabies infection for seven days.

dag: Guŋgombihi din kumsi tiri suhupiɛlli mini mɔɣilɔnim kumsi foya, ka bɛn yɔri suhupiɛlli vuri gba fo.
en: and the joyful music of their harps and drums has ceased.

dag: Yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ nyɛla yɛlimaŋli: So suhu yi yɛya ni o leei cheechi toondana, o ni bɔri tuun shɛli maa nyɛla tuun suŋ.
en: It is a true statement that anyone whose goal is to serve as an elder has his heart set on a good work.

dag: Ka bɛn daa dari piɛri ŋ-ŋmaligiri kɔhiri bu ma paa, ka n leei piɛ shɛb bɛ ni daa yɛn ku gula. Ka n daa bo jaaŋgbɛh ayi m-boli zaɣ yini yuli anfaani, ka boli din pah ayi mi yuli naŋgban yini. Ka n daa leei piɛri maa gula.
en: So I became a shepherd of those sheep doomed to be slaughtered by the sheep dealers. And I gave names to the two sticks I used for tending the sheep: One of them was named Mercy and the other Unity.

dag: Yi ni ti zaŋ bimbira pam chaŋ yi puri ni, amaa ka ti kpuɣila atam biɛla, dama toli ni ti ŋub di zaa.
en: You might scatter a lot of seed on the field, but you will gather almost nothing because the locusts will eat it all.

dag: Bɛ vihiri mɔɣa piligu shee n-yihiri binshɛŋa din sɔɣiya palo ni.
en: They dam up the sources of rivers; hidden things come to light.

dag: Bin yini ka n suhiri Yawɛ sani, ka n suhu kul ye di zuɣu: dina n-nyɛ ni m be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu hal ni n nyɛvili tariga, ka n nya Yawɛ viɛlim, ka jɛmd o o jɛmbu duu puuni.
en: I ask only one thing, Lord : Let me live in your house every day of my life to see how wonderful you are and to pray in your temple.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka n fabila paag a sanna. Tim ma baŋsim kaman a ni pun lo ma alikauli shɛm.
en: Let my cry for help reach you, Lord ! Give me understanding, as you have promised.

dag: ka chɛ ka bɛ bihi kpi tinzun tinsi ni, ka wurim ba ka bɛ chaŋ ti be tinduya ni.
en: I'll scatter your children everywhere in the world.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daa zo o niriba maa nambɔɣu, ka chɛ bɛ daalahichi maa, ka bi chɛ ka bɛ bahi yoli. O gbaar omaŋa o sujee puuni waawaayili, ka bi chɛ ka o suhuyiɣisili dii chani tooni.
en: But God was merciful. He forgave their sins and did not destroy them. Many times he held back his anger. He never let it get out of control.

dag: Yisifu ni daa nya o biɛyanim maa, o daa baŋ ba, amaa ka niŋ ba kaman saamba n-nyɛ ba la, ka daa bi tɔɣisi ba suhumahili yɛtɔɣa. O daa bɔhi ba mi, Ya ka yi lee yina? Ka bɛ yɛli, Ti yila Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni ti ti da bindirigu.
en: They did not recognize Joseph, but at once he knew who they were, though he pretended not to know. Instead, he spoke harshly and asked, Where do you come from? From the land of Canaan, they answered. We've come here to buy grain.

dag: Ka Izraɛl zuɣulaannim bɛn nyɛ bɛ yaannim dunoya ni dɔɣirikpamba mini bɛ ni daa kali zuliya shɛb la zuɣulaannim daa mali sara.
en: Then the leaders of Israel gave offerings to God. These men were the heads of their families and leaders of their tribes. These were the same men who were in charge of counting the people.

dag: Dindali maa ka Dɛbɔra mini Barak Abinɔam bia la daa yili yilli ŋɔ:.
en: At that time, Deborah and Barak, Abinoams son, sang.

dag: Ka yi daa ti nya ka Nahash Ammɔnnim naa la daa lo tɔb kana ni o ti tuhi ya, ka yi yɛli ma, Aai, ti bɔri ni naa n-su ti. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ mi n-daa nyɛ yi naa di saha maa.
en: But when you saw that Nahash the Ammonite king was coming against you, you said to me, No! There must be a king to rule over us. But the LORD your God was already your king!.

dag: Ka na shɛb zaa bɛn daa be Hadadɛza sulinsi ni nya Izraɛlnim ni tuhi nyaŋ ba maa, ka bɛ daa kana ti tim sandaani niŋ Izraɛlnim maa ka zaŋ bɛmaŋ ti ba. Di saha zaŋ chana ka Sirianim maa daa zɔri dabiɛm ni bɛ lan sɔŋ Ammɔnnim yaha.
en: The kings who served Hadadezer saw that the Israelites had defeated them, so they made peace with the Israelites and became their servants. The Arameans were afraid to help the Ammonites again.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl kpamba zaa daa laɣim taba n-chaŋ Samuɛl sani Rama.
en: Then all the leaders of Israel met together, went to Samuel in Ramah.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Aŋgo zɔnim ni fabili aŋgo ni be bɛ sani saha shɛli? Amaa saha kanna ka bɛ ni ti yihi aŋgo maa bɛ sani, di saha maa ka bɛ ni ti lo noli.
en: Jesus answered, At a wedding the friends of the bridegroom are not sad while he is with them. They cannot fast then. But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them. Then they will fast.

dag: Amaa a daa niŋ a viɛlim maa naani, ka gɔri pagɔrisigu a yudua maa zuɣu. A daa chɛ ka a mini ŋunkam gariti nimaani dɔni.
en: But you trusted in your beauty and traded on your fame. At every opportunity, you seduced all who came by.

dag: Yi pun zaɣisi ma, ka chɛ ma jɛmbu ka di waɣa, ka yɛra, Ti ku jɛm a. Yi daa jɛm buɣa daboli kam din du zuɣu mini ti mahali kam gbini.
en: Judah, long ago you broke free from me, like an ox that breaks its yoke and the ropes that held it. You said to me, I will not serve you! On every high hill and under every green tree, you acted like a prostitute.

dag: Amaa bɛn ti yɛn be tiŋ maa kpaŋa ti yɛn nyɛla bahi mini baɣisi ni zinaniŋdiba ni ninvuɣ kuriba ni buɣijɛmdiba ni bɛnkam yuri ʒiri, ka lan nyɛ ʒiŋmariba la.
en: But outside the city will be dogs, witches, immoral people, murderers, idol worshipers, and everyone who loves to tell lies and do wrong.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa taai bahi Musa zuɣu, ka yɛl o, Ti yi di daa pahi ti mabihi la zuɣu kpi Yawɛ tooni, di naan so.
en: The people argued with Moses and said, Maybe we should have died in front of the Lord like our brothers did.

dag: Ŋuna n-tumdi tuun kara ka so ku tooi baŋ di ni nyɛ shɛm, ka tumdi alahiziba tuma din ka kalinli.
en: His miracles are marvelous, more than we can count.

dag: Yawɛ galim Judanima. O ni darigi Yaakubu tibili ka di dol o biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm, ka yo o o tuma samli.
en: The LORD has a charge against Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways, and respond to him according to his deeds.

dag: N daa be zoli maa zuɣu la wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ biɛɣ pihinahi kaman n ni daa pun niŋ shɛm tuuli la. Ka Yawɛ daa lan deei n suhigu, ka daa bi lan lo ni o kun ya.
en: I stayed on the mountain forty days and nights, as I did the first time. The Lord listened to me once more and agreed not to destroy you.

dag: ka di nyɛla yi ni mali tahima shɛli alizanda ni la zuɣu. Yi daa pun wum dimbɔŋɔ yɛla la yɛlimaŋli lahibal suŋ din daa ka yi sanna la ni.
en: because what you hope for is kept safe for you in heaven. You first heard about this hope when you believed the true message, which is the good news.

dag: Ka dɔrolan maa garigi yɛl o, N Duuma, kom maa yi ti dam, n ka so ŋun ni zaŋ ma siɣi di ni, ka mmaŋmaŋ yi chani ni n ti siɣi, so daŋdi ma la di ni siɣibu.
en: The man answered, Sir, I don't have anyone to put me in the pool when the water is stirred up. I try to get in, but someone else always gets there first.

dag: Ka suhudoo daa be Naa Jɛhɔshafat ʒiɛmani maa ni, dama o Naawuni daa ti o vuhim luɣilikam zaa.
en: to invade Judah. The Lord let Jehoshaphat's kingdom be at peace.

dag: Di simdi ni yi yu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yi suhuri zaa ni yi shia zaa ni yi yaa zaa.
en: You must love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your strength.

dag: Saha shɛli ha yi gba daa bela katiŋ ni Naawuni, ka nyɛ o dimnima yi biɛhigu puuni yi ni daa tɛhiri bin biɛ shɛŋa yɛla ka tumdi li la zuɣu.
en: At one time you were far away from God and were his enemies because of the evil things you did and thought.

dag: Ka daa yɛli Aduna, Malimi buɣa ti ti ka di gul ti, dama ti bi lan mi Musa ŋun daa yihi ti Ijipti na maa ni kpalim shɛli.
en: The people said to Aaron, Make some gods to lead us! Moses led us out of Egypt, but we don't know what's happened to him now.

dag: dama yi yurilim tuuni ŋɔ pala din tiri Yisa nyaandoliba din simdi ba kɔŋko, amaa di nyɛla din chɛ ka Naawuni nyari paɣibu pam di zuɣu.
en: What you are doing is much more than a service that supplies God's people with what they need. It is something that will make many others thank God.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu? Tuumbiɛ bɔ ka o lee tum? Ka bɛ maan mɔhi vuri pam yɛli, Kpahim o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: But what crime has he committed? Pilate asked. They shouted all the louder, Crucify him.

dag: Bɛ wɔɣira mini tarimba zaa ni ti kpi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka so ti ku sɔɣi ba, ka so mi ti ku fabili bɛ zuɣu. So ti ku zaŋ bini ŋmaag omaŋ bee m-pini o zuɣu bɛ zuɣu.
en: Important people and common people will die in the land of Judah. No one will bury them or cry for them. No one will cut himself or shave his head to show sorrow for them.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn min o tɔbbihi maa zaa daa kul ba n-ʒe bɛ zaashɛhi ni gili Midiannim sansani maa, ka Midiannim maa daa kuhi ka yiɣisi guui.
en: Each man stood fast in his position around the camp, and the entire camp took off running, shouting, and fleeing.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti kuhiri yɛri zoya, Lumiya ti zuɣu na! Ka ni ti yɛri kuŋkuna mi, Limsimiya ti! .
en: Then they will say to the mountains, Fall on us, and to the hills, Cover us.

dag: Ifriimnim ŋmanila ŋmani. Bɛ jɛrigiya zaa, ka ka yɛm. Bɛ boonila Ijiptinim ni bɛ ti sɔŋ ba, ka lan booni Asirianim ni bɛ ti sɔŋ ba.
en: Ephraim has become like a dove, silly and without common sense; they call upon Egypt; they go to Assyria.

dag: Ti wum Mɔabnim karimbaani yɛla. Bɛ mali karimbaani pam. Ti lan wum bɛ duhimaŋtali mini bɛ karimbaani ni bɛ barinyubo ni bɛ nyarimaŋtali yɛla.
en: Moab is very proud! I have heard how proud, arrogant, and conceited the people are, how much they think of themselves.

dag: Puhimiya yi ni biri bindir shɛŋa din daŋ niŋbu kpuɣibu chuɣu. Yuuni yi ti giligi ka yi kpuɣi yi puri atam zaa naai, yin puhimiya yi puri atam kpuɣibu chuɣu.
en: Celebrate the Harvest Festival each spring when you start harvesting your wheat, and celebrate the Festival of Shelters each autumn when you pick your fruit.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: Some time later, the Lord said:.

dag: Ka o daa kar o dimnim maa bahi; ka chɛ ka bɛ di vi din ku naai.
en: He forced his enemies to turn back defeated. He brought them shame that will last forever.

dag: Anabi Musa ni daa zaŋ wahu kpahi tabili daɣu zuɣu n-zaŋ sa mɔɣu ni shɛm la, di nyɛla talahi ni bɛ ti zaŋ Daadam Bia gba sa zuɣusaa lala.
en: As Moses lifted up the bronze snake on a pole in the desert, in the same way the Son of Man must be lifted up.

dag: Amaa man ŋuna, di kul kpalimla biɛla ni n tuui; di kul kpalimla biɛla ni n sarigi.
en: But me? My feet had almost stumbled; my steps had nearly slipped.

dag: Di saha ka Judas ŋun daa yɛn yi o nyaaŋa maa bɔh o, Karimba, mani? Ka Yisa yɛl o, Iin, nyini.
en: Judas, the traitor, spoke up. Surely, Teacher, you don't mean me? he asked. Jesus answered, So you say.

dag: dama ti yɛn saɣimla yaŋɔ. Bɛ ni yɛri di niriba tuumbiɛri yɛla shɛm galisiya pam Yawɛ sani; dinzuɣu ka o tim ti na ni ti ti saɣim li.
en: because we are about to destroy this place. The LORD has found the cries of injustice so serious that the LORD sent us to destroy it.

dag: Saha shɛli Yisifu ni daa neei gom ni ka o niŋ kaman ti Duuma malaika ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa n-chɛ ka bɛ kulis o na.
en: When Joseph woke up, he did what the Lords angel told him to do. He married Mary.

dag: Ka a zaŋ firanki tulaale zim alali pahi kul yini kam zuɣu, ka yi ti zaŋ li pahi bɔrɔbɔro maa zuɣu nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ, ka di leei shɛhira.
en: Put pure frankincense on each row. This will help the Lord remember the gift.

dag: di saha yin bom zim viɛlli lita ata n-zaŋ kpam lita ayi ŋmir li;.
en: At that time you must also bring a grain offering with the bull. That grain offering should be cups of fine flour mixed with quarts of olive oil.

dag: Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba n-daa nyɛ: Mɛshulam bia Sallu ŋun daa nyɛ Joɛd yaaŋa la. O yaannim shɛba n-daa lan nyɛ Pɛdaya mini Kolaya ni Maasɛya so mi ni Itiɛl ni Jɛshaya.
en: Sallu, the son of Meshullam and grandson of Joed. His other ancestors included Pedaiah, Kolaiah, Maaseiah, Ithiel, and Jeshaiah.

dag: Pa nyini n-sa gariche gili Ayuba min o malibu ni o ni su shɛlikam zaa luɣilikam? Nyini n-niŋ alibarika niŋ o tuma ni, ka chɛ ka o buni galisi pam tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: You always protect him, his family, and everything he has. You have blessed him and made him successful in everything he does. He is so wealthy that his herds and flocks are all over the country.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa me sara maligu bimbini ti Yawɛ nimaani, ka bol li, Yawɛ nyɛla suhudoo. Ka di na kul ʒe Ofira Abiɛzanim ni su luɣ shɛl la hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: Gideon built an altar for worshiping the Lord and called it The Lord Calms Our Fears. It still stands there in Ophrah, a town in the territory of the Abiezer clan.

dag: Yi Duuma ni chɛ ka yi nya wahala ni nahiŋgu, amaa ŋuna ŋun maŋmaŋ nyɛ yi karimba maa ku lan sɔɣi ka chɛn ya, amaa o ni chɛ ka yi nini nya o, ka o wuhi ya.
en: The Lord might give you sorrow and pain like the bread and water you eat every day. But God is your teacher, and he will not continue to hide from you. You will see your teacher with your own eyes.

dag: Amaa o bihi maa bɛn daa bi dol o naba, ka zaŋ bɛ zaŋsim niŋla bun ni, ka deeri birapu niriba sani, ka bi doli yɛlimaŋli soli maani bɛ yɛla.
en: But Samuels sons did not live the same way he did. Joel and Abijah accepted bribes. They took money secretly and changed their decisions in court. They cheated people in court.

dag: Yi bi mi ni tizɔbo ni, tizɔriba zaa yi kul zɔra, ninvuɣ yino kɔŋko nti yɛn zo n-di? Dinzuɣu zomiya viɛnyɛliŋga din ni chɛ ka yi tooi zo n-di.
en: Dont you know that all the runners in the stadium run, but only one gets the prize? So run to win.

dag: ni o bɔrila a daanzinfa min a salima ni a paɣ viɛla ni a bihi.
en: The message was, Ben-Hadad says, Your silver and your gold are mine, and so are the best of your wives and children.

dag: Di ʒin ya liɣiri kolibihi bee adiikunima bee namdanima; yi mi di puhiya daadam kam sol ni.
en: Dont carry any money, a bag, or sandals. Dont stop to talk with people on the road.

dag: Bɛ ni daa nyɛ faranima ka ka bindirigu diri zuɣu, bɛ daa nyirila taŋkpa kuma tiŋgbani nɛli ni.
en: Stiff from want and hunger, those who gnaw dry ground, yesterdays desolate waste.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ zaŋ bɛ nɛma pam n-zɔri ni bɛ du kulitihi kulibɔŋ tiligi.
en: The people of Moab are leaving, crossing over Willow Creek, taking everything they own and have worked for.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ salima sara maligu bimbin shɛli zuɣu yi ni yɛn tuɣindi tulaale zim la zali Alikauli Adaka maa tooni, ka zaŋ pateesa yili Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa dunoli.
en: Put the golden altar for offering incense in the Tent in front of the Box of the Agreement. Then put the curtain at the entrance to the Holy Tent.

dag: Ka n daa wum tɔbbihi bɛn nyɛ wɔribariba kalinli, ka di nyɛla tuhi piapia ʒii tuhi pia.
en: I was told the number of the mounted troops: it was two hundred million.

dag: So yi zaŋ liɣiri bee binshɛli nti puh o kpee sɔŋbu, ka bɛ zu bini maa dilan yiŋa, ka bɛ gbaai tayiɣ maa, di simdi ka tayiɣ maa yo bini maa zuɣu ʒii buyi.
en: Someone might give some money or tools to a neighbor for safekeeping. What should you do if someone steals those things from the neighbors house? If you find the one who stole them, then that thief must pay twice as much as the things are worth.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ salima min anzinfa neen shɛŋa Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa kpuɣi Naawuni jɛmbu duu Jɛrusalɛm n-kuli Babilɔn na la n-labisi li ti zali di zaashe kura ni Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Then the gold and silver things that Nebuchadnezzar took from the temple and brought to Babylonia are to be returned to their proper places.

dag: Bɛ daa ŋmɛla binnɛma maa mini abie tihi pa sunsuuni duu maa dunoya zuɣu kaman bɛ ni daa ŋme li pa dukpina maa zuɣu shɛm la. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ dari mali varanda zɔntua maa tooni sambani polo.
en: Like the walls, the doors of the main hall were carved with winged creatures and palm trees. A single luxuriant tree stood outside, in front of the porch.

dag: O daa chɛ ka kum ni mali ninvuɣ shɛb me bɛ tiŋ ʒini nimaani.
en: where he settles the hungry. They even build a city and live there!.

dag: Kɔhat daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Amiram yiŋnima mini Izar yiŋnima ni Hiburɔn yiŋnima ni Uziɛl yiŋnima; Kɔhat daŋ niriba n-daa bala.
en: The clan of Kohath was composed of the families of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

dag: O ni daa be o ma pul ni, o daa gbaala o jabil kpee napɔŋkpaa; ka o ni daa ti bi doo, o daa vala Naawuni.
en: While Jacob was still in his mothers womb, he began to trick his brother. Jacob was a strong young man, and at that time he fought with God.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm Naawuni Kundi ni la: Ninsalinim zaa ŋmanila mɔri, ka bɛ jilima zaa ŋmanila mɔpuma. Mɔri kpira, ka di puma kpahiri lura.
en: As the scripture says, All human beings are like grass, and all their glory is like wild flowers. The grass withers, and the flowers fall.

dag: Benya kaman biliɛri la din ni chɛ ka yi suhuri kul ye Naawuni yɛligu din ŋmani bihim alal la zuɣu, ka di chɛ ka yi tooi zooi nya tiliginsim.
en: Like newborn babies hungry for milk, you should want the pure teaching that feeds your spirit. With it you can grow up and be saved.

dag: O daa ku Ijiptinim bidib kpamba zaa bɛn daa nyɛ bɛ ni tuui dɔɣi bi shɛba Ham suɣa ni la.
en: He killed the first-born sons of all the families of Egypt.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yiɣisi chaŋ Taai mini Sidɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni nti kpe yil shɛli, ka bi bɔri ni so baŋ o yɛla, amaa ka daa bi tooi sɔɣ omaŋa.
en: Jesus left that place and went into the region of Tyre. He didnt want anyone to know that he had entered a house, but he couldnt hide.

dag: Miri ka a tu naa, hal di sɔɣi tu o; a mi miri ka a tu bundana, hal di tu o a duu puuni gba, dama di pa shɛli ka nooŋa bee binyiɣirigu kam ti zaŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa chaŋ ti yɛli.
en: Don't criticize the king, even silently, and don't criticize the rich, even in the privacy of your bedroom. A bird might carry the message and tell them what you said.

dag: Ka so yi zaŋ chi bee kawana mali maha na ti mali sara, di simdi ka di nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ kpam gari zim viɛl shɛli ni m-mal li, ka dabindi ka di ni bee karikaasi shɛli din ka dabindi ka nyɛ bɛ ni niŋ kpam niŋ shɛli ni.
en: If you give a grain offering that was baked in the oven, it must be unleavened bread made from fine flour mixed with oil, or it must be wafers with oil poured over them.

dag: Naawuni daanfaani maa zuɣu ka yi tiligi yi yɛda niŋbu puuni. Ka di bi yila yi kɔbili ni na, amaa di nyɛla Naawuni pini.
en: You were saved by faith in God, who treats us much better than we deserve. This is God's gift to you, and not anything you have done on your own.

dag: Dama di daa simdi ni nyini n dan naa ku m ba daŋ niriba zaa, amaa ka a daa zaŋ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ m-pah a mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn laɣindi diri zuɣu. N lan malila n ni yɛn niŋ shɛm n-naɣ pahila n kum niŋ nyin naa.
en: After all, you could have killed my whole family and me. But instead, you let me eat at your own table. Your Majesty, what more could I ask.

dag: Izraɛl ni daa kurigi maa zuɣu daa chɛ ka o nina bi lan ne viɛnyɛliŋga, ka o ni tooi nya. Ka Yisifu daa zaŋ bihi maa mir o, ka o daa zaŋ o nuhi bɔb gbaai ba n-vooi ba tabil omaŋa, ka mɔɣisi bɛ kparima.
en: Because Israels eyesight had failed from old age and he wasnt able to see, Joseph brought them close to him, and he kissed and embraced them.

dag: N zaŋ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ti o ka di leeg o tuma yɔri, dama n tuma ka bɛ daa tum ti ma maa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will give him the land of Egypt as payment for his laboring for me. This is what the LORD God says.

dag: Shɛmida bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ahian mini Shɛkɛm ni Likihi ni Aniam.
en: Shemidas sons were Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa boli Ibram na nti bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ ma lala? Bɔ n-niŋ ka a bi yɛli ma ni o nyɛla a paɣa?.
en: Finally, the king sent for Abram and said to him, What have you done to me? Why didn't you tell me Sarai was your wife?.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ bindira leei tɔŋ gbahi ba; ka chɛ ka bɛ churi puhibu leei zana gbahi ba.
en: Their tables are covered with food. Let their fellowship meals destroy them.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni ti gbahi ya niŋ ya alaka, ka tahi ya bɛ jɛmbu duri mini sarikanim ni, ka ti zaŋ ya tahi nazuɣuri mini gomnanim tooni n yuli zuɣu pɔi ka dimbɔŋɔnim zaa naanyi niŋ.
en: But before all this occurs, they will take you into custody and harass you because of your faith. They will hand you over to synagogues and prisons, and you will be brought before kings and governors because of my name.

dag: Di saha Izraɛlnim ni ti pahi Ijiptinim mini Asirianim zuɣu, ka bɛ niŋ zuliya ata niriba; ka bɛ zuɣu chɛ ka dunia zaa nya alibarika.
en: Israel will join with these two countries. They will be a blessing to everyone on earth.

dag: N ni fa a mini tiŋ ŋɔ Asiria naa nuu ni bahi, ka guli tiŋ ŋɔ.
en: I will rescue you and this city from the power of the Assyrian king. I will defend this city.

dag: Dina n-ni chɛ ka bɛ ku wuhi ya ka yi tum bɛ ni tumdi tuun shɛŋa zaa tiri bɛ buɣa ka di nyɛ din chihiri la, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi ti tum alahichi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: So then they will not be able to teach you to sin against the Lord your God or to do any of the terrible things they do when they worship their gods.

dag: Ka yi mini yi yiŋnim zaa ni tooi di li luɣ shɛlikam zaa; dama yi ni tumdi tuun shɛŋa Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili ni la yɔri m-bala.
en: You and your families can eat all that is left. This is your payment for the work you do in the Meeting Tent.

dag: Amaa ka a dabili nini daa ti moog o tuma zuɣu, ka doo maa zo n-tiligi. Ka Izraɛl naa maa yɛl o, A saria karibu ni nyɛ shɛm m-bala; dama amaŋmaŋ pun wuhi samli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: But I got busy doing other things, and the prisoner escaped. Ahab answered, You will be punished just as you have said.

dag: Tiŋgbani mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni zaa yi ti sɔhira, mani n-nyɛ ŋun gbib di daantalisi.
en: The earth trembles, and its people shake; you alone keep its foundations firm.

dag: Nyama, mɔɣili kopaliga yi ti kpɛma, o bi zɔri dabiɛm; ka Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili kopaliga yi ŋmɛr o noli o suhu ʒimi.
en: He is not afraid of a rushing river; he is calm when the Jordan dashes in his face.

dag: Bɛ ŋme Ifriimnima, ka bɛ nyaɣa zaa kuui, bɛ ku lan dɔɣi bihi. Hal bɛ yi kul dɔɣi bihi gba, n ni ku bɛ biyurisi zaa.
en: Ephraim will be punished. Their root is dying. They will not have any more babies. They might give birth to babies, but I will kill the precious babies who come from their bodies.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ dooi salima pa duu maa dukpina mini di yɔɣira ni di dunɔbihi ni di pundi zaa zuɣu, ka daa lan chɛ ka bɛ kpe chɛrubinima n-zaŋ tabili dukpina maa zuɣu.
en: He used the gold to overlay the Temple walls, the rafters, the entryways, and the doors. On the walls the workers carved designs of winged creatures.

dag: N daa zaŋ salima min anzinfa dih a paɣisarilim. Ka a mali tan viɛlli liiga mini tan nyɛlisirili chinchina ni bɛ ni wuɣi chinchin shɛli. A bindirigu daa nyɛla zim viɛla mini shiri ni kpam, ka a daa niŋ viɛlim pam, ka simdi ni a niŋ napaɣa.
en: You had ornaments of gold and silver, and you always wore clothes of embroidered linen and silk. You ate bread made from the best flour, and had honey and olive oil to eat. Your beauty was dazzling, and you became a queen.

dag: Lala ka bɛ zaŋ chira din ka binshɛli ti ma, ka zaŋ yuŋ shɛŋa din mali wahala ti ma.
en: So I have inherited months of emptiness; nights of toil have been measured out for me.

dag: ka bɛ dɔbba bɛn zaa mali suhukpeeni daa yi n-chaŋ yuŋ ti yihi Sool min o bidibisi maa Bɛtishan gooni maa zuɣu n-zaŋ ba chaŋ Jabɛshi ti nyo ba buɣim nimaani.
en: the bravest of their men set out, traveled all night long, and took the bodies of Saul and his sons off the wall of Beth-shan. Then they went back to Jabesh, where they burned them.

dag: Dama o kul chɛrila o gala sɔŋ tiŋa, ka chɛ ka tiŋgbani biisim kpɛr li.
en: An ostrich lays her eggs on the ground and lets the sand keep them warm.

dag: Ka wula ka Naawuni Kundi lee yɛli? Di yɛliya, Karim dab paɣa min o bia bahi, dama dab paɣ bia mini bilichin paɣ bia ku laɣim di fali.
en: But what does the scripture say? It says, Send the slave woman and her son away; for the son of the slave woman will not have a part of the father's property along with the son of the free woman.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ, nyin zom ma nambɔɣu, ka n yiɣisi zani, m-bɔhi ba biɛri labisi.
en: But you, LORD, please have mercy on me and lift me up so I can pay them back!.

dag: Chɛ ka n suhigu maa paag a, gbilisim tibili wum n kuhigu shɛli n ni kuhiri bɔri sɔŋsim ŋɔ.
en: please listen carefully to each of my concerns.

dag: ka chɛbisi taba. Di nyaaŋa ka ti daa kpe ŋariŋ, ka bɛ mi lab kuli.
en: Then after saying goodbye to each other, we got into the ship, and they went back home.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa yi ti kul biri bimbirili kam, Midiannim maa mini Amalɛknim ni wulimpuhili polo nim kanimina ti lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: They did that because the Midianites and Amalekites from the east always came and destroyed their crops.

dag: M mabiyurisi, zaŋmiya yi daadiini wuhibu din be kasi la kpaŋsiri yimaŋa, ka kul suhimiya Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni.
en: But you, dear friends: build each other up on the foundation of your most holy faith, pray in the Holy Spirit.

dag: Amaa bɛ yi ku tooi gbib bɛmaŋa, bɛn kpuɣimi paɣiba, ka paɣiba la mi kuli dɔbba, dama bɛ yi niŋ lala di so ni bɛ kɔre diri ba bɛ niŋgbuna ni kaman buɣim la.
en: But if you don't have enough self-control, then go ahead and get married. After all, it is better to marry than to burn with desire.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ biɛri bɔɣiri ni ti kabi. Amaa Yawɛ ni sɔŋ wuntizɔriba.
en: because the Lord will take away the strength of the wicked, but protect those who are good.

dag: Dindali maa, bɛ ni ti yili yila mali ya ansarisi, ka kum ni fabila pam yɛli, Ti bahi yoli zaa, Yawɛ taɣi n niriba fali ti shɛba. O deei li n sani. O piripiri ti puri tari bɛn gbahi ti maa. .
en: Then people will sing songs about you. They will sing this sad song: We are ruined! The Lord took away our land and gave it to other people. Yes, he took my land away from me. He has divided our fields among our enemies.

dag: ka o bidibisi daa taɣi binʒim ti o, ka o zaŋ o nubil tim ʒim maa ni n-zaŋ li ʒe sara maligu bimbini zuɣu binyila la, ka kpaai binʒim maa bahi sara maligu bimbini maa naba zaashee.
en: His sons brought him the blood, and he dipped his finger in it, put some of it on the projections at the corners of the altar, and poured out the rest of it at the base of the altar.

dag: Ibrahimma daa lan kpuɣi paɣ so. O yuli n-daa booni Kɛtuura.
en: Abraham married Keturah.

dag: Zaŋmi gbaŋ n-sabi n ni daa yɛl a yɛtɔɣa shɛŋa zaa jɛndi Izraɛlnim mini Judanima ni zuliya kam la niŋ di ni. N ni daa kul yɛl a yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa Jɔsia ʒiɛman ni hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ la.
en: Get a scroll and write on it everything that I have told you about Israel and Judah and all the nations. Write everything that I have told you from the time I first spoke to you, when Josiah was king, up to the present.

dag: Inok daa jɛmdi Naawuni viɛnyɛliŋga, ka so daa ti bi lan nya o, dama Naawuni n-daa kpuɣ o.
en: One day Enoch was walking with God, and he disappeared. God took him.

dag: Di daa yi chana, di chanila luɣa anahi maa zaa ka bi ŋmaligira.
en: so that the wheels could move in any of the four directions.

dag: Ka bɛ ni zaɣ yino yi lu yaɣiri duɣu ni, binshɛɣukam din be di puuni leela daɣiri, ka di simdi ka yi ŋma li.
en: And if their bodies fall into a clay pot, everything that is in it shall be unclean, and you must break the pot.

dag: So ni ti gbaag o daŋ puuni ninvuɣ so n-yɛl o, A mali binyɛrigu, leemi ti zuɣulana n-su binshɛɣukam din wurim doya ŋɔ.
en: Someone will seize a family member, saying, You have clothing! You be our leader! This mess will be your responsibility.

dag: Ti yi saɣi ka bɛ be ti sani, bɛ niɣi mini bɛ binshɛɣukam ni bɛ biŋkɔbiri zaa ku leei ti dini.
en: Won't all their livestock and everything else they own be ours? So let us agree that they can live among us.

dag: Ka Naaman daa saɣi, ka chaŋ ti mim Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni siɣimsiɣim buyopɔin kaman Naawuni nir maa ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa, ka nya alaafee zaa. Ka o niŋgbuna lab dimaŋ ni m-be kaman bibil niŋgbuna la.
en: So Naaman went down and bathed in the Jordan seven times, just as the man of God had said. His skin was restored like that of a young boy, and he became clean.

dag: Kulibɔn shɛŋa din kom nyuui mini tiŋgbani voya ni ni tampima voya ni n-nyɛ bɛ biɛhigu shee.
en: Their only homes are ditches or holes between rocks.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni chɛ ka bɛ ŋmaligi yi tooni guui, ka kari ba ka bɛ zo ka chɛn ya. Ka yi deei bɛ tiŋgbana maa su kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa pun lɔn ya alikauli shɛm la.
en: The Lord your God will make them retreat from you, and he will drive them away as you advance. You shall have their land, as the Lord your God has promised you.

dag: Nia shɛŋa din be ninsal suhu ni ŋmanila kɔbil zilinli puuni kom, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun mali baŋsim ni tooi ŋɔŋ di kom maa.
en: Someone's thoughts may be as deep as the ocean, but if you are smart, you will discover them.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Goligɔta la .
en: They came to the place called Golgotha.

dag: Ka Jɔn daa yɛli Yisa, Karimba, ti nyala so ka o mal a yuli karit alizin biɛri, ka ti kar o, o ni pa ti ni yino zuɣu.
en: John said to him, Teacher, we saw a man who was driving out demons in your name, and we told him to stop, because he doesn't belong to our group.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali suɣilo tumdi din tuhi ka bɔri jilima mini paɣibu ni niŋgbuŋ din ku pooi la, Naawuni ni ti ti ba nyɛvili din ka bahigu;.
en: On the one hand, he will give eternal life to those who look for glory, honor, and immortality based on their patient good work.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni leei ti sariakarita, o ni woligi ti m min a. O ni lihi ti yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zuɣu, ka zani n nyaaŋa n-fa ma a nuu ni bahi.
en: The Lord will judge, and he will decide which one of us is wrong. May he look into the matter, defend me, and save me from you.

dag: Shɛlini, sagbani maa daa mi n-kpalim zani zaawuni hal ni asiba, ka sagbani maa daa yi ti vuui asiba saha shɛli, bɛ gba yiɣisirimi gbaai chandi bee di daa yi kpalim ʒiɛya wuntan yini bee yuŋ yini, di yi ti kul vuui, bɛ gba yiɣisirimi gbaai chandi.
en: Sometimes the cloud remained only from evening until morning, and they moved on as soon as the cloud lifted. Whenever the cloud lifted, they moved on.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ n dimnim ka di ka daliri la mali kpiɔŋ pam; ka bɛn je ma ka di ka soli gba galisi pam.
en: But my mortal enemies are so strong; those who hate me for no reason seem countless.

dag: Yawɛ miri ŋunkam zaa suh o mini ŋunkam zaa suh o ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: The Lord is near to everyone who sincerely calls to him for help.

dag: Bɛ ni daa chɛbisi salo maa, ka o nyaandoliba maa daa zaŋ ŋariŋ shɛl o ni daa pun kpe n-ʒiya la duri duli. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb gba daa kpe ŋariŋ shɛŋa ni dol o dura.
en: So they left the crowd; the disciples got into the boat in which Jesus was already sitting, and they took him with them. Other boats were there too.

dag: Man Pool n-nyɛ ninvuɣ so shɛb ni yɛli ni n siɣisiri mmaŋa n yi ti be yi sani, amaa ka lee ti ka yi sani ka wuhiri dɔbilim la. N suhiri ya Masia tarimtali min o baalimtali puuni.
en: I, Paul, am begging you with the gentleness and the kindness of Christ. Some say that I am bold when I am writing you from a distance, but not when I am there with you.

dag: Tiŋgbani maa atam bupia kam puuni yim zuɣu, di yi nyɛla tiŋgban ni bindira bee tihi wala, di nyɛla Yawɛ dini, ka nyɛ din be kasi Yawɛ sani.
en: Ten percent of everything you harvest is holy and belongs to me, whether it grows in your fields or on your fruit trees.

dag: Lɛvinima m-bɔŋɔ: Azania bia Jɛshua la mini Binnui Hɛnadad daŋ ni nir la ni Kadimiɛl.
en: And these are the Levites who put their names on the sealed agreement: Jeshua son of Azaniah, Binnui from the family of Henadad, Kadmiel.

dag: Ka o daa lan daai Pɛnuɛluɛlnim pii la luhi, ka ku tiŋ maa ni dɔbba.
en: Afterwards he went to Penuel, where he tore down the tower and killed all the town officials.

dag: Naa Dauda ni daa ti paai Bahurim, ka Sool daŋ ni do so ŋun daa nyɛ Gɛra bia ka o yuli booni Shimɛi la daa yina ti turi ba.
en: When King David arrived at Bahurim, one of Saul's relatives, Shimei son of Gera, came out to meet him, cursing him as he came.

dag: Ka niriba ni daa lihi bɛ ni shɛb zuɣulaannim la bi pahiri ma shɛli, man dee baɣa ka bɛ ni daa nyɛ shɛb ni, dama Naawuni bi gaŋdi so; ka n na kul yɛrimi ni niriba ni lihi shɛb zuɣulaannim maa bi pahiri ma shɛli.
en: The influential leaders didnt add anything to what I was preaching—and whatever they were makes no difference to me, because God doesnt show favoritism.

dag: dama bɛ daa zaŋla daba ayopɔin n-zaŋ sara maligu bimbini maa ti Naawuni, ka zaŋ daba ayopɔin mi m-puhi chuɣu, ka daa laɣim dabisi shɛli din pah anii dali jɛm Naawuni.
en: On the eighth day, they had a holy meeting because they had celebrated for seven days. They made the altar holy and it was to be used only for worshiping the Lord. And they celebrated the festival for seven days.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Izraɛlnim lan ka bidibisi? Bɛ lan ka falidiriba? Bɔzuɣu ka Milikom niriba kari Gaad zuliya ka ʒini bɛ fɔntinsi ni.
en: The Lord has this to say about the nation of Ammon: The people of Israel have plenty of children to inherit their lands. So why have you worshipers of the god Milcom taken over towns and land belonging to the tribe of Gad?.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa tim Neetan Dauda sani, ka o daa chaŋ ti yɛl o, Niriba ayi n-daa be tin shɛli, yino daa nyɛla bundana, ka ŋun la mi nyɛ faralana.
en: and he sent Nathan the prophet to tell this story to David: A rich man and a poor man lived in the same town.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba zaa mini salo zaa daa bi lan ʒe yim hal ti yaɣi. Bɛ daa kul tumdila din chihiri kam kaman zuliya shɛb ni tumdi shɛm, ka ta Yawɛ ni pun mal o jɛmbu du kasi shɛli zali Jɛrusalɛm la daɣiri.
en: In addition, the leaders of Judah, the priests, and the people followed the sinful example of the nations around them in worshiping idols, and so they defiled the Temple, which the Lord himself had made holy.

dag: Amaa paɣ maa yi ti bi saɣi ni o dol a na, dindina a yi m pɔri ŋɔ taali ni; ka lee miri ka a zaŋ m bia maa kulisi nimaani.
en: If the woman refuses to come along, you don't have to keep this promise. But don't ever take my son back there.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ ti ba, ti ŋmanila yaɣiri a sani, ka a mi ŋmani yaɣimɛra. Ti zaa nyɛla a ni zaŋ a nuhi nam shɛba.
en: But you are our father, Lord . We are like clay, and you are like the potter. You created us.

dag: Maliya suhupiɛlli yi tahima niŋbu puuni; ka maliya suɣilo yi muɣisigu nyabu ni; ka kul suhimiya Naawuni.
en: Let your hope keep you joyful, be patient in your troubles, and pray at all times.

dag: Ti ka soli ni ti kpuɣ paɣiba n-ʒiri ba kaman ti tuuntab mini ti Duuma tizɔbihi ni Pita ni niŋdi shɛm la?.
en: Don't I have the right to follow the example of the other apostles and the Lord's brothers and Peter, by taking a Christian wife with me on my trips?.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ yi ti yɛli ya, Nyamiya, o be mɔɣu ni, yin di chaŋya; ka bɛ mi yi ti yɛli ya, O be duu puuni, yin di niŋya li yɛda.
en: If you are told the Messiah is out in the desert, don't go there! And if you are told he is in some secret place, don't believe it!.

dag: Di sɔɣi bɛ taali maa, a mi di kpihim bɛ daalahichi maa a sani, dama bɛ yɛli zilima pam tammɛriba maa ninni.
en: Don't forgive the mean and evil way they have insulted the builders.

dag: Shihir shɛli yi ni ti yɛn nya ka baŋ nyɛla, yi ni ti nya ka bɛ zaŋ chinchini pili biliɛɣu maa sɔŋ wɔrimɔri piɛɣu ni.
en: This is how you will know him: You will find a baby wrapped in pieces of cloth and lying in a feeding box.

dag: Chɛ ka n naba yaabu doli soli ka n chani kaman a yɛligu ni wuhi shɛm, ka di chɛ ka tuumbiɛri nyaŋ ma.
en: Keep my steps steady by your word; dont let any sin rule me.

dag: Ka Jona garigi yɛli ba, N nyɛla Hiburu, ka jɛmdi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ alizanda Naawuni, ka nyɛ ŋun nam tiŋgbani mini teeku ŋɔ.
en: Jonah said to them, I am a Hebrew. I worship the Lord , the God of heaven, who made the land and the sea.

dag: Manaasa zuliya pirigili la daa bela tiŋgbani maa ni; bɛ daa galisiya pam n-ʒini Bashan zaŋ hal ni Baalihɛrimɔn ni Sɛnir zaŋ kpa Hɛrimɔn Zoli polo.
en: The members of half the tribe of Manasseh lived in the land from Bashan to Baal-hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon. They were very numerous.

dag: amaa di yi ti bilina, di zoorimi gari tutuɣ kam n-niŋ wul kara hal ka noonsi ni tooi te bɛ tɛri di wula maa zuɣu.
en: But once it is planted, it grows larger than any garden plant. It even puts out branches that are big enough for birds to nest in its shade.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa chaŋ nimaani daanya sara maligu bimbini din daa be Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la puuni Yawɛ tooni la gbini nti kɔri biŋkɔbiri tuhili m-mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la di zuɣu.
en: and there at the bronze altar, Solomon offered a thousand animals as sacrifices to please the Lord .

dag: Ka Naawuni shia maa daa kpuɣi ma zuɣusaa zaŋ ma chaŋ, ka n daa chaŋ ni suhugarigu pam mini suhuyiɣisili, dama Yawɛ nuu daa pa n zuɣu pam.
en: Then the Spirit carried me away. The Lord 's power had taken complete control of me, and I was both annoyed and angry.

dag: Yi mi di chɛliya ka Hɛzɛkia yɛli ya, Biɛhiŋ kani Yawɛ ni fa ti bahi, ka ku zaŋ tiŋ ŋɔ niŋ Asiria naa nuu ni, ka yi shiri niŋ Yawɛ naani di zuɣu.
en: Dont listen to him when he tells you to trust in the Lord . Dont believe him when he says, The Lord will save us. He will not let the king of Assyria defeat the city.

dag: Tihi pum puma mɔɣu ni. Noonsi kumbu saha paaya, ka ti wumdi ŋmambihi kumsi ti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: The flowers are blooming in the fields. Its time to sing! Listen, the doves have returned.

dag: Ka Azibuk bia Nɛhimia ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtizur yaɣili pirigili polo naa la daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu. O daa zaŋla lala hal ti paai Dauda siliga la tooni hal ti paai bɛ ni daa gbi mɔɣ shɛl la mini tɔbbihi biɛhigu shee la.
en: Nehemiah son of Azbuk, ruler of half of the Bethzur District, built the next section, as far as David's tomb, the pool, and the barracks.

dag: Ka n daa bɔh o, Ya polo ka a chana? Ka o garigi yɛli ma, N Chanimi ni n ti buɣisi Jɛrusalɛm m-baŋ di wɔɣilim mini di yɛliŋ ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: I said, Where are you going? He said to me, To measure Jerusalem to see how wide and long it will be.

dag: ka daa bi lan saɣi ni so ʒi binshɛɣu gari kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: Jesus would not let anyone carry things through the temple.

dag: Nir yi doli ʒiri soli bo n-nya buni, di nyɛla kaman gulisigu mini kum zana.
en: Cheating to get rich is a foolish dream and no less than suicide.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa ti yɛli ni o paɣ Zara nyɛla o tizɔpaɣa. Ka Gɛra Naa Abimilɛk daa tim ti zaŋ Zara na.
en: Abraham told people that Sarah was his sister. King Abimelech of Gerar heard this. Abimelech wanted Sarah, so he sent some servants to take her.

dag: A daa zaŋ nam tiŋgbana mini niriba ti ba, ka daa zaŋ luɣ shɛlikam zaa ti ba, ka bɛ daa deei Hɛshibɔn din daa nyɛ Naa Sihɔn tiŋgbɔŋ la mini Bashan din daa nyɛ Naa Ogi tiŋgbɔŋ la su.
en: You let them conquer kings and take their land, including King Sihon of Heshbon and King Og of Bashan.

dag: Lala ka tuun suma gba yiri palo, hal tuun sun shɛŋa yi bi yi palo viɛnyɛliŋga, di mi kul ku bahi kpalim sɔɣiya.
en: In the same way, the good that people do is also obvious and cant be hidden.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri ni zɔri shɛli dina m-paari ba, amaa wuntizɔriba nyarila bɛ ni bɔri shɛli.
en: What evil people dread most will happen to them, but good people will get what they want most.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee biɛhindi n yɛm ni nyɛ shɛm, ka tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa ka bi mi di gbinni ŋɔ?.
en: Who is this darkening counsel with words lacking knowledge?.

dag: Sanʒiɛɣu maa ni daa ʒiɛri tuhi ŋariŋ maa, ka di ku tooi lan kpa ti ni bɔri ni di doli shɛli polo zuɣu ka ti daa chɛ li ka pɔhim maa ʒiɛri li chana.
en: The wind struck the ship, and we could not sail against it. So we let the wind carry the ship.

dag: Di saha maa ka Baladan bia Mɛrɔdakibaladan ŋun daa nyɛ Babilɔn naa la daa wum ni Hɛzɛkia biɛra, ka sabi gbaŋ m-bo pini pahi di zuɣu tim tuumba ni bɛ zaŋ ti ti Hɛzɛkia.
en: About that same time the king of Babylonia, Merodach Baladan, the son of Baladan, heard that King Hezekiah had been sick, so he sent him a letter and a present.

dag: amaa benyala kasi yi biɛhigu zaa puuni kaman Naawuni ŋun boli ya la ni be kasi shɛm.
en: Always live as God's holy people should, because God is the one who chose you, and he is holy.

dag: Amaa wahu ni daa zaŋ o yɛmbimbiɛri n-yɔhim Awa shɛm la, n zɔri ni yi gba tɛha ti ŋmaligi kpe yɔɣu lala ka chɛ yi suhuyini mini yi ʒiɛyimtal shɛli yi ni mali zaŋ chaŋ Masia san la.
en: But now I fear that you will be tricked, just as Eve was tricked by that lying snake. I am afraid that you might stop thinking about Christ in an honest and sincere way.

dag: Dama a yurilim maŋli maa duya gari sagbana, ka a ʒiɛyimtali chaŋ hal ti tɔri sagbana.
en: Your constant love reaches above the heavens; your faithfulness touches the skies.

dag: Bɛ deei kulibɔna dubu shee la, ka nyo bɛ kpiɔŋ ni be luɣ shɛŋa la buɣim, ka tɔbbihi suhuri fuŋ.
en: The places where people cross the rivers have been captured. The swamplands are burning. All of Babylons soldiers are afraid.

dag: Mɔɣisim n kpariŋ; a yurilim so wain.
en: Your lips cover me with kisses; your love is better than wine.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Asahɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔab mabia la mini Ɛlhanan ŋun daa nyɛ Dɔdo Bɛtilihɛm nir bia la.
en: The following men were among the kings special forces: Asahel, Joabs brother; Elhanan son of Dodai from Bethlehem;.

dag: Cham ti yɛli Hɛzɛkia, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a yab Dauda Naawuni la yɛliya: N wum a kumsi maa, ka deeg a suhigu maa. N ni pah a yuun pinaanu.
en: with this message for Hezekiah: I am the Lord God, who was worshiped by your ancestor David. I heard you pray, and I saw you cry. I will let you live more years.

dag: Ka sabi li pa yi yiŋ dunɔpaɣirisi zuɣu mini yi dunɔdaya zuɣu.
en: Write them on your houses doorframes and on your citys gates.

dag: Ka Naawuni nyɛla ŋun ni tooi niŋ alibarika din galisi pam niŋ yi ni, ka di chɛ ka yi kul mali binshɛɣukam ka di saɣiri ya, ka chɛ ka yi tooi mali pam din ni zaŋ tum tuun suŋ kam.
en: And God can give you more blessings than you need, and you will always have plenty of everything. You will have enough to give to every good work.

dag: Ka Pita min o tuuntab maa garigi yɛli ba, Di simdi ni ti deela Naawuni noli ka pa ni ninsalinim noli;.
en: Peter and the apostles replied: We don't obey people. We obey God.

dag: Di saha Izraɛlnim zaa yi ti wum li, dabiɛm ni gbahi ba, ka bɛ ku lan tum zaɣ biɛɣu lala tatabo yaha.
en: Then all the Israelites will hear about it and be afraid. And they will not do those evil things anymore.

dag: dindina maligumaana maa ŋun lihim o, ka niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu maa yi niŋ dilan niŋgbuŋ zaa, ŋun yɛlim ni o nyɛla ŋun ka o dɔro maa daɣiri ni, o niŋgbuŋ zaa ni leei zaɣ piɛlli maa zuɣu, o lan pala ŋun be daɣiri ni.
en: the priest shall examine you again. If he finds that it actually has covered the whole body, he shall pronounce you ritually clean. If your whole skin has turned white, you are ritually clean.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Sool daa yɛli, Zaŋmiya sara maligu shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim mini suhudoo sara maligu pina la ti ma na.
en: so he said to them, Bring me the burnt sacrifices and the fellowship sacrifices. He offered a burnt sacrifice.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbaai Naa Zɛdɛkia n-zaŋ o tahi Babilɔn Naa sani Ribila, ka o daa kar o saria.
en: The Babylonians took King Zedekiah to the king of Babylon at Riblah. The Babylonians decided to punish Zedekiah.

dag: Dabisili ŋɔ nyɛla yin ni teeri dabisi shɛli yɛla, ka di simdi ni yi puhiri di chuɣu n-tiri Yawɛ jilima. Zaŋmiya li leei zaligu yi ʒiɛmani kam ni ka gbib li.
en: Remember this day and celebrate it each year as a festival in my honor.

dag: Amaa wula ka Naawuni daa lee garigi yɛl o? O daa yɛl o, M mali niriba tusa ayopɔin bɛn na bi jɛm buɣili Baal.
en: But the Lord told Elijah, I still have , followers who have not worshiped Baal.

dag: Zuɣusaa daantalisi sɔhigimi, ka di gari ba o ni kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni maa zuɣu.
en: Heavens pillars shook, terrified by his blast.

dag: Dama Naawuni ni zaŋ Pita tum tuun kara Yɛhudianim sani shɛm, lala ka o zaŋ man gba tum tuun kara bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani.
en: God gave Peter the power to work as an apostle for the Jewish people. God gave me the power to work as an apostle too, but for those who are not Jews.

dag: N daa tɔɣisi anabinim yɛtɔɣa ka chɛ ka bɛ nya ʒiinim pam. Mani n-daa chɛ ka anabinim maa ŋahi yɛtɔɣ ŋaha.
en: I spoke to the prophets and gave them many visions. I gave the prophets many ways to teach my lessons to you.

dag: ka guhiri ti tahima din mal alibarika dabisi shɛli dali ti Naawuni Natitamlana ŋun nyɛ tiligira Yisa Masia la jilima palo yibu saha.
en: We should live like that while we are waiting for the coming of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ. He is our great hope, and he will come with glory.

dag: Bɛ zaa nyɛla tipawumlinim bɛn nyɛ duŋtaariba ni nyaanzuriba. Bɛ ŋmanila tahiʒiɛɣu mini kurigu. Bɛ zaa tumdila tuumbiɛri.
en: They are all stubborn rebels, hard as bronze and iron. They are all corrupt, going around and spreading gossip.

dag: Ka ŋunkam dɔni tiŋa yili maa ni, ŋun paɣim o situra, ka ŋunkam di bindirigu yili maa ni, ŋun paɣim o situra.
en: And if you either slept or ate in the house, you must wash your clothes.

dag: N daanfaani so salima, hal salima alali gba. Ka n ni tiri niriba binshɛli gari anzinfa viɛlli.
en: What you receive from me is more valuable than even the finest gold or the purest silver.

dag: Yi ni daa nyɔri maligunim buɣim, ka tumdi alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka bi deer o noli bee n-dol o zaligunim zaa la zuɣu ka yɛlibiɛɣu ŋɔ paai ya kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm zuŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: The current dire situation occurred because you made offerings to other gods and sinned against the LORD—because you wouldnt obey the LORD or follow the LORDs instruction, laws, or warnings.

dag: Musa daa bɔhi ba mi, Yi chɛla paɣiba ŋɔ zaa ka bi ku ba?.
