en: and said, I can't believe you let the women live!.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Aduna: N zaŋ bɛ ni zaŋ sara maligu binshɛŋa ti ma, ka di nyɛ Izraɛlnim sara binshɛŋa din be kasi zaa ti a min a bidibisi ni di nyɛ yi maligumaaniba tarili sahakam.
en: The Lord said to Aaron, Remember that I am giving you all the special contributions made to me that are not burned as sacrifices. I am giving them to you and to your descendants as the part assigned to you forever.

dag: Ashaaranim kul yɛn tuɣila taba, ka bɛ kul wumdi ŋumaŋuma luɣilikam. Bɛ ti kul yɛn bɔrila ʒii nyabu anabinim sani. Maligumaaniba wuhibu ni ti naai, ka ninkura kpamli yɛtɔɣa ti naai.
en: One disaster comes after another, and rumor follows rumor. They seek a vision from the prophet. Instruction disappears from the priest, and counsel from the elders.

dag: Bɛ ni so nini ku nya li, naɣila Jɛfune ŋun nyɛ Kɛnizi nir la bia Kalɛb mini Nan bia Jɔshua, dama bɛn doli man Yawɛ viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: except Caleb, Jephunneh the Kenizzites son, and Joshua, Nuns son, because they remained true to the LORD.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, N yi tiri mmaŋ jilima, n jilima maa nyɛla yoli; m Ba so yi ni yɛli ni o nyɛla yi Naawuni la n-tiri ma jilima.
en: Jesus answered, If I were to honor myself, that honor would be worth nothing. The one who honors me is my Father—the very one you say is your God.

dag: Dama ninsal suhu ni ka dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha yirina. Dina n-nyɛ: Tɛhi biɛri mini ninvuɣ kubo ni zina niŋbu balibu kam ni tayiɣisigu ni ʒiri shɛhiradibo ni nyaanzubo.
en: For from your heart come the evil ideas which lead you to kill, commit adultery, and do other immoral things; to rob, lie, and slander others.

dag: Dama bɛ bi nyari biɛrim; ka bɛ niŋgbuna mal alaafee, ka kul nyɛlisira.
en: They never have to suffer, they stay healthy.

dag: N ni paɣiri Naawuni so yɛligu maa, ŋuna ka n niŋ naani ka bi zɔri dabiɛm. Ka bɔ ka ninsal lee ni tooi niŋ ma?.
en: in God, whose word I praise. I trust in God; I wont be afraid. What can mere flesh do to me?.

dag: Ka ŋmahi piɛlaa maa, ka paɣ o nyɔri min o biɛhi n-zaŋ li pahi nimdi maa mini binzuɣu la zuɣu.
en: Cut the ram in pieces; wash its internal organs and its hind legs, and put them on top of the head and the other pieces.

dag: Ka Pool mini Baanabas daa kpalim Yisa nyaandoliba maa sani niŋ daba ayi.
en: And they stayed there a long time with the Lords followers.

dag: lala n-nyɛ ti gba: Ti galisiya, amaa ti nyɛla niŋgbun yini Masia ni, ka ti zaa yinoyino nyɛ niŋgbuŋ yini maa yaɣ shɛŋa.
en: In the same way, we are many people, but in Christ we are all one body. We are the parts of that body, and each part belongs to all the others.

dag: Niriba ayi bɛn daa wum Jɔn ni yɛli shɛm ka doli Yisa maa ni yino n-daa nyɛ Anduru, Saimɔn Pita tizo.
en: These men followed Jesus after they had heard about him from John. One of them was Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter.

dag: Ka yuma din kpalim maa yi na galisi, ŋun yom o ni daa deei laɣ shɛli yuma maa zuɣu, ka di nyɛ o ni yo laɣ shɛli ni o deeg omaŋa.
en: If there are many years left before the Jubilee, the Israelite will pay for their purchase in proportion to their purchase price.

dag: Ŋunkam ku biŋkɔbigu, ŋun bom biŋkɔb so yo o samli; nyɛvili la nyɛvili.
en: and any who kill an animal belonging to someone else must replace it. The principle is a life for a life.

dag: N jɛmbu duu yi ti be bɛ sani saha shɛlikam, di saha zuliya kam ni ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ m-mali Izraɛlnim ka bɛ be kasi. .
en: The other nations will know that I am the Lord , and they will know that I make Israel my special people by putting my holy place there among them forever.

dag: Ti bi zaŋ binshɛli sɔŋ gu so soli ka lala zuɣu ni chɛ ka so ku tooi nya ti taali ti tuma puuni.
en: We don't want anyone to find fault with our work, and so we try hard not to cause problems.

dag: Ka di tooni zaŋ labi wulimpuhili polo pateesanim wɔɣilim daa nyɛ mita pisinaayi.
en: The front side facing east was seventy-five feet.

dag: Dama n loya ni n niŋla tiŋ ŋɔ zaɣ biɛɣu ka pa ni zaɣ viɛlli. N ni ti zaŋ li niŋ Babilɔn naa nuu ni, ka o nyo li buɣim. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa. .
en: I have made up my mind not to spare this city, but to destroy it. It will be given over to the king of Babylonia, and he will burn it to the ground. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: amaa ka di bi ba jila o suhu ni viɛnyɛliŋga. Lala nira niŋdila yɛda daba ayi, ka wahala bee muɣisigu yi ti paag o Naawuni yɛligu maa zuɣu, o dii zaŋdi li mi bahi.
en: But they don't have deep roots, and they don't last very long. As soon as life gets hard or the message gets them in trouble, they give up.

dag: A yi zaɣisi ni a ku chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ, ka na kul gbib ba.
en: If you refuse to let them go and you continue to hold them back.

dag: A mi n ʒinibu saha, ka mi n yiɣisibu saha. Hal n yi tɛhi ni m bela katiŋa, a mi n tɛha ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: You know when I sit down and when I stand up. Even from far away, you comprehend my plans.

dag: ka lihi di goma, ka kpahindi di birininima din ni chɛ ka yi ti tooi yɛli ʒiɛmani din payana niriba:.
en: Look at the tall walls, and see the palaces. Then you can tell the next generation about them.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla sara maligu shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim sahakam. Sinai Zoli gbini ka bɛ daa zali di niŋbu, ka di nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl Yawɛ sani.
en: This is the daily offering that is completely burned, which was first offered at Mount Sinai as a food offering, an odor pleasing to the Lord .

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ka a min a nyaandoliba maa zaa taai duŋ niŋ maa. Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Aduna ka yi ŋumdi yi kparima ni niŋd o.
en: You and your followers have joined together and turned against the Lord ! Did Aaron do anything wrong? No, so why are you complaining against Aaron.

dag: Dinzuɣu Mɛrari daŋ niriba bɛn nyɛ Lɛvinim bɛn daa kpalim la ni daa deei fɔntin shɛŋa zaa kalinli daa yiɣisila tinsi pinaayi.
en: As for the cities of the descendants of Merari for their clans, the remaining clans of the Levites, their total allotment was twelve cities.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda daa yɛl o, Doli ma kuli Jɛrusalɛm ka n ti gbib a.
en: David said to Barzillai, Come across the river with me. I will take care of you if you will live in Jerusalem with me.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni niŋ n ni zaŋ n yuli boli jɛmbu du shɛli yi ni niŋ naani ŋɔ mini n ni daa zaŋ luɣ shɛli ti yi mini yi yaannim la kaman n ni daa niŋ Shilo shɛm maa.
en: So I will destroy the house called by my name in Jerusalem. I will destroy that Temple as I destroyed Shiloh. And that house in Jerusalem that is called by my name is the Temple you trust in. I gave that place to you and to your ancestors.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa nim daa nya gariŋga maa ni kaai vil o nuu maa ka yɛli taba, Biɛhiŋ kani, doo ŋɔ nyɛla ninvuɣ kura; hal o ni tiligi kom dibu ni teeku ŋɔ ni maa zaa yoli, biɛr bɔhibu na kul bi saɣi ni o be.
en: When the people living on the island saw the snake hanging from his hand, they said, This man must be a murderer! He did not die in the sea, but Justice does not want him to live.

dag: Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili bɔpiɛligu ni yaɣiri tiŋgbani din daa be Sukɔt mini Zɛrɛda sunsuuni la ni ka Naa daa chɛ ka bɛ mali nɛma maa.
en: by pouring melted bronze into the clay molds he had set up near the Jordan River, between Succoth and Zeredah.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yuun pihinahi maa yi ti naai n ni yihi Ijiptinim maa bɛ ni daa wurim be ninvuɣ shɛb zaa ni na.
en: This is what the Lord GOD says: I will scatter the people of Egypt among many nations. But at the end of years, I will gather those people together again.

dag: A bela a biɛhigu shee ka chɛ ka saa yiri zuɣusaa luri zoya zuɣu na, ka tiŋgbani diri a tuma nyɔri.
en: From your home above you send rain on the hills and water the earth.

dag: bɛ yi yɛli ya di yɛla bee yi yi wum di yɛla, ka yi vihi li viɛnyɛliŋga, ka di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni din chihiri maa shiri tumiya Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: If you hear such a report, then investigate it thoroughly. If it is true that this evil thing has happened in Israel.

dag: Bɛ niŋ buɣim nyo a jɛmbu duu maa, ka ta a ni be luɣ shɛl la daɣiri. Bɛ daai li luhi zaa.
en: They set fire to your sanctuary, burned it to the ground; they defiled the dwelling place of your name.

dag: Dama ti Duuma ni boli so yi daa nyɛla dabili, o yipa nya yolisim ti Duuma sani. Lala n-nyɛ ŋun pun nyɛ bilichina ka ti Duuma bol o, dilan mi leela Masia dabili.
en: When the Lord chooses slaves, they become his free people. And when he chooses free people, they become slaves of Christ.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ zaa daa paai bɛ kpalansi yomyom sɔŋ tiŋa, ka lɔrigilɔrigi di noya.
en: Then every brother quickly opened his sack on the ground.

dag: N yuya ni n ʒe yim n soya ni, ka lala chɛ ka n tooi dol a zaligunima!.
en: I don't ever want to stray from your laws.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi yɛli, Dinzuɣu deemiya liɣiri maa o sani n-zaŋ pahi ŋun mali pɔŋ tuhi pia ŋɔ;.
en: Now, take the money away from him and give it to the one who has ten thousand coins.

dag: Amaa ka paɣ ŋuni maa yɛli, Aai! M bia n-nyɛ bi nɛɔŋ ŋɔ, ka a bia nyɛ bi kpiɔŋ ŋɔ! Ka paɣ so ŋun daŋ tooni maa yɛli, Aai! A bia n-nyɛ bi kpiɔŋ ŋɔ, ka m bia nyɛ bi nɛɔŋ ŋɔ! Lala ka bɛ daa yɛri naa maa tooni.
en: But the other woman said, No! The dead baby is yours, and the one still alive is mine! But the first woman said, No, you are wrong! The dead baby is yours! The one that is still alive is mine. So the two women argued in front of the king.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, o shiri nyɛla n tizɔpaɣa. O nyɛla m ba bipuɣiŋga, amaa ka lee pa m ma puuni bia, ka n zaŋ o leei m paɣa.
en: She is, truthfully, my sister—my fathers daughter but not my mothers daughter—and shes now my wife.

dag: Yi yi niŋ lala, yi tum alahichi yi mabihi sani ka gbarigi bɛ suhuri ni tɛha din ka kpiɔŋ la, ka lala niŋbu nyɛla alahichi tumbu Masia sani.
en: When you sin against your brothers and sisters in Christ in this way and you hurt them by causing them to do things they feel are wrong, you are also sinning against Christ.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi doli yɛlimaŋli soli bo n-nya buni ŋmanila noon so ŋun ŋuni o ni bi nye gal shɛŋa zuɣu wɔɣi li. Zaŋ chaŋ bɛ biɛhigu pirigili puuni, bɛ ni ti kɔŋ li, ka bɛ bahigu saha, niriba ni ti boli ba jɛra.
en: You cheated others, but everything you gained will fly away, like birds hatched from stolen eggs. Then you will discover what fools you are.

dag: Nyama, yi ni ti boli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒin ya, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒin ya ti zo n-ka yi sanna. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ ni tibigi ya shɛm la zuɣu.
en: You will call out to nations you have never known. And they have never known you, but they will come running because I am the Lord , the holy God of Israel, and I have honored you.

dag: N ni chɛ ka a zuliya nabi m-be kaman saŋmarisi la. N ni zaŋ tiŋgbana ŋɔ zaa ti a zuliya maa, ka dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam zaa ni ti nya alibarika la a zuliya maa zuɣu.
en: I will give you as many descendants as there are stars in the sky, and I will give your descendants all of this land. They will be a blessing to every nation on earth.

dag: Di daa nyɛla di daanabinim mini di maligumaaniba bɛn daa ku wuntizɔriba di puuni la daalahichi mini bɛ tuumbiɛri zuɣu.
en: Jerusalem was punished because her prophets and her priests had sinned and caused the death of innocent victims.

dag: Ka dilan maa daa bɔh o, Ŋuni n-lee zaŋ a leei ti zuɣulana ni ti sariakarita? A lomi ni a ku ma kaman a ni sa ku Ijipti doo la shɛm la? Di saha ka dabiɛm daa gbaai Musa, ka o tɛhi ni o ni sa niŋ shɛli maa yi palo.
en: The man answered, Who made you our ruler and judge? Are you going to kill me just as you killed that Egyptian? Then Moses was afraid and said to himself, People have found out what I have done.

dag: Piim a mabia Aduna min o bidibisi Izraɛlnim ni, n-chɛ ka bɛ yi n ka a sanna ti leei m maligumaaniba, n-tumdi n tuma; Aduna min o bidibisi bɛn yuya booni Nadab mini Abihu ni Ɛliɛza ni Itama.
en: Send for your brother Aaron and his sons Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar. They are the ones I have chosen from Israel to serve as my priests.

dag: n-daa yi gbala maa ni na Yisa kum ni neebu nyaaŋa n-chaŋ ti kpe Jɛrusalɛm din nyɛ Naawuni tiŋ kasi la puuni, ka niriba pam daa nya ba ni bɛ nini.
en: They left their graves, and after Jesus had risen to life, they went into the holy city, where they were seen by many people.

dag: Yawɛ yuli nyɛla din du pam ka mali yaa, ka wuntizɔriba zɔri kpɛri di ni tiligira.
en: The Lord is like a strong tower, where the righteous can go and be safe.

dag: Goma bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ashikɛnaz mini Difat ni Tɔgarima.
en: Gomer was the ancestor of Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛr a mi, a yuli m-booni Pita; tampiŋ ŋɔ zuɣu ka n yɛn me n cheechi tam hal ka kum mini di yiko ti ku tooi wurim li.
en: I tell you that you are Peter. And Ill build my church on this rock. The gates of the underworld wont be able to stand against it.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma doli nuzaa polo dunɔdal la n-chaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa tooni, ka n ti lihi n-nya ka Yawɛ jilima m-pal o jɛmbu duu maa ni. Ka n daa lu n-zaŋ n nini kpa tiŋa.
en: Then he brought me by way of the north gate to the front of the temple. I looked, and suddenly the LORDs glory filled the LORDs temple, and I fell on my face.

dag: Dinzuɣu di zaŋ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ŋmahindi paɣ yoli, dama n ni kul be kpe saha shɛli maa zaa, n yɛlimuɣisira mini n suhugarigu yɛla ka n yɛri maa.
en: Don't think I am a worthless woman. I have been praying like this because I'm so miserable.

dag: Bɛ ni daa pii bɛ mabihi maa shɛb ni bɛn pa bɛ zuɣu pahi n-daa nyɛ: Zakaria mini Jaaziɛl ni Shɛmiramɔt ni Jɛiɛl ni Unni ni Ɛliab ni Bɛnaaya ni Maasɛya ni Matitia ni Ɛlifɛlɛhu ni Mikinɛya; ka Obɛdɛdom mini Jɛiɛl daa nyɛ dunɔguliba.
en: There was also a second group of Levites. They were Zechariah, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed Edom, and Jeiel. These men were the Levite guards.

dag: Amaa naŋgbammalisim ka bɛ daa kul niŋd o, bɛ daa ŋmar o la ʒiri.
en: But they were just flattering him with lip service. They were lying to him with their tongues.

dag: Ŋun nyɛ yɛlimaŋli neesim maa n-daa yi palo dunia ni di saha maa ni o neei sokam zaa nina.
en: The true light that shines on everyone was coming into the world.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ koli binshɛɣukam gari kaman pɔhim la. Bɛ birigiya ka leei bɛn mali taali, bɛmaŋmaŋ yaa n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: He passes through like the wind and invades; but he will be held guilty, the one whose strength is his god.

dag: Dindali maa n ni daa yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Ɛli min o yiŋnim polo la ni ti niŋ pali, di piligu ni hal ni di bahigu ni.
en: I will do everything I said I would do against Eli and his family, everything from the beginning to the end.

dag: Ka Ada daa dɔɣi Jabal. Ŋuna n-daa nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tanti suɣa ni ka guli niɣ la yaba.
en: Lamech and Adah had two sons, Jabal and Jubal. Their son Jabal was the first to live in tents and raise sheep and goats. Jubal was the first to play harps and flutes.

dag: n ni ti zaŋ li niŋ zuliya shɛb naa nuu ni, ka o ti niŋ li kaman di tuumbiɛri ni simdi shɛm. N ni ti yihi li bahi.
en: So I handed it over to the most powerful nation, who continually acted treacherously against it. I banished it!.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka n daa bi kpi n dɔɣibu saha? N ni daa yi m ma puli ni na maa ka daa dii kpi.
en: I wish I had died in my mother's womb or died the moment I was born.

dag: Doo yi po pɔri Yawɛ sani bee m-po pɔri lo alikauli ni o niŋ shɛli, ŋun miri ka o yi o yɛligu maa nyaaŋa; amaa o niŋm o ni yaag o noli yɛli shɛlikam maa zaa.
en: When a man makes a vow to give something to the Lord or takes an oath to abstain from something, he must not break his promise, but must do everything that he said he would.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm, n ni pɔbisi tinzunnim bɛn lir a zaa bahi kaman taŋkpaɣu la, ka chɛ ka bɛ tɔbbihi bɛn zɔr dabiɛm zo yomyom kaman pɔhim n-ʒe wurigu chaŋ la. Nini pɔbbu ni neebu.
en: There will be so many foreigners that they will be like dust. Cruel people will be like the chaff blowing in the wind. Then suddenly.

dag: Pa wuntizɔriba zuɣu ka n kana, amaa alahichinim tuuba niŋbu zuɣu ka n kana.
en: I didnt come to call righteous people but sinners to change their hearts and lives.

dag: Ka fiig tia bɔhi ba, N chɛli n wal viɛla din nyaɣisi la wolibu, ka leei tihi naa.
en: But the fig tree replied, I won't stop growing my delicious fruit, just so my branches can wave above the other trees.

dag: Dindali maa Sool tumtumdib ni do so daa bela nimaani ni o mali maligu shɛli Yawɛ tooni, o daa nyɛla Ɛdom nira ka o yuli booni Doɛg, ŋuna n-daa nyɛ Sool piɛgul kpɛma.
en: One of Sauls officers was there that day. He was Doeg the Edomite, the leader of Sauls shepherds. He had been kept there before the Lord .

dag: Bi so ŋun bɔri yɛm, o tirila o ba bee o ma suhupiɛlli, amaa ŋun doli pagɔra ni bahi o buni yoli.
en: If you appreciate wisdom, your parents will be proud of you. It is a foolish waste to spend money on prostitutes.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa ŋme n-deei Makɛda dindali maa, ka zaŋ takɔbi ku di naa min o niriba. O daa ku sokam zaa, ka bi chɛ hal ninvuɣ yino gba; ka daa niŋ Makɛda naa kaman o ni daa niŋ Jɛriko naa shɛm la.
en: That day Joshua defeated Makkedah. He killed the king and the people in that city. No one was left alive. Joshua did the same thing to the king of Makkedah that he had done to the king of Jericho.

dag: Ka Uzia daa chɛ ka bɛ kuri nyɔtaɣirisi mini kpana ni kuriti woliɣisi ni kuriti gbaɣinɔnima ni tɔbiri ni kuɣilɔŋ kuɣa n-ti tɔbbihi maa zaa.
en: Uzziah supplied the army with shields, spears, helmets, coats of armor, bows and arrows, and stones for slinging.

dag: Di saha ka ŋun nyɛ ŋun pun be tum kurimbuni ha la daa kana ti kari saria sɔŋ Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ wuntizɔriba, ka saha daa paai ni wuntizɔriba maa deei nam su.
en: Then the one who had been living forever came and pronounced judgment in favor of the people of the Supreme God. The time had arrived for God's people to receive royal power.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa daa yihi saliŋ shɛŋa din be bɛ tiba ni n-zaŋ na ti ti Aduna.
en: So all the people took off their gold earrings and brought them to Aaron.

dag: Tarimtali mini Yawɛ zɔbo laara nyɛla buni mini jilima ni nyɛvili.
en: Obey the Lord , be humble, and you will get riches, honor, and a long life.

dag: A nyiŋgoli ŋmanila Dauda pii shɛli bɛ ni daa me di kulisi tam tab zuɣu ka nyɔtaɣirisi yiliyil li la. Di zaa daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiriba nyɔtaɣirisi.
en: Like Davids tower is your neck, splendidly built! A thousand shields are hung upon it— all the weapons of the warriors.

dag: ti bɔh o, Karimba, Anabi Musa daa yɛliya ni doo yi kpuɣi paɣa ka na bi zaŋ o dɔɣi bihi ka kpi ka chɛ o, o tizo ŋun kpuɣim o pakoli maa n-dɔɣ bihi ti o biɛli maa.
en: They said, Teacher, Moses told us that if a married man dies and had no children, his brother must marry the woman. Then they will have children for the dead brother.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Ka mami m pun yɛli ya ka yi zaɣisi wumbu. Ka bɔzuɣu ka yi lan bɔri ni yi wum yaha? Yi gba bɔrimi ni yi leeg o nyaandoliba yɔɣɔ.
en: I have already told you, he answered, and you would not listen. Why do you want to hear it again? Maybe you, too, would like to be his disciples.

dag: Bɛ daa bela bɛ suɣa ni ŋ-ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni, ka zaɣisi Yawɛ yɛligu.
en: They stayed in their tents and grumbled and would not listen to the Lord .

dag: Di saha ka Pita daa siɣi ninvuɣ shɛb Kɔniilius ni daa timna maa sani ti yɛli ba, Mani n-nyɛ yi ni bɔri so maa. Ka bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-lee tahi ya na.
en: So Peter went down and said to the men, I am the man you are looking for. Why have you come.

dag: Di saha ka Bilidad ŋun daa nyɛ Shua nir la daa garigi yɛli.
en: Bildad from Shuah replied.

dag: Ka yinim Judanima, n zali yi gba dabisili, saha shɛli n yi ti yɛn labisi n niriba daazichi ti ba.
en: People of Judah, your time is coming too. I, the Lord , would like to make my nation prosper again.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ, A yɛn je suli niŋ a niriba wunsuhigu hal ni bɔ saha?.
en: Lord God All-Powerful, when will you listen to our prayers? How long will you be angry with us?.

dag: Malimi tɔbbihi ni teei gili shɛm kɔtomsi tabili li, ka booi tɔbbihi ni me bindura tabili gooni shɛm gil li, ka mali goma din sirigina tabili li, ka lan mali tɔbutuhiriba bimbina baɣilibaɣili li gili ti tuui.
en: Then, to represent a siege, put trenches, earthworks, camps, and battering rams all around it.

dag: Amaa ka Jabɛshigiliadnim zaa daa wum Filistianim maa ni niŋ Sool shɛm maa zaa.
en: When the people of Jabesh in Gilead heard what the Philistines had done to Saul.

dag: Bɛ yɛli bɛmaŋa, Ti ni nyaŋ ba zaa. Bɛ daa nyo Naawuni jɛma laɣiŋgu shɛhi zaa din be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni buɣim.
en: They said to themselves, We'll crush them! Then they burned every one of your meeting places all over the country.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Yi ni ŋuni n-lee ni mali piɛ yino ka o ti lu bɔɣ zilinli ni Vuhim Dabisili dali ka o ku yaag o di ni?.
en: Jesus answered, If one of your sheep fell into a ditch on the Sabbath, wouldn't you lift it out?.

dag: Ti Duuma chɛ ka ti niŋ ya naani, ka mi ni yi niŋdi ti ni wuhi ya shɛm, ka kul ni niŋdi ti ni wuhi shɛm maa.
en: The Lord gives us confidence that you are doing what we told you and that you will continue to do it.

dag: Ka Hɛli daa nyɛ Matat bia, ka Matat nyɛ Lɛvi bia, ka Lɛvi nyɛ Mɛlikai bia, ka Mɛlikai nyɛ Jannai bia, ka Jannai mi nyɛ Yisifu so bia.
en: Matthat, Levi, Melchi, Jannai, Joseph.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ li kuli Babilɔn, ka di ti kpalim be nimaani hal ti paai dabisi shɛli n ni lan yɛn zaŋ n zaŋsim labisi di polo. Di saha ka n ti lan yɛn zaŋ li nimaani na ti zali kpe yaha. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: will be taken to Babylonia, where they will remain until I decide to bring them back to Jerusalem. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka ti chaŋ Siizaria nti kpe Filip ŋun daa nyɛ Yisa lahibal suŋ molomoona la yiŋa. O daa nyɛla tuuli cheechi kpamba ayopɔin la ni yino.
en: The next day we left Ptolemais and went to the city of Caesarea. We went into the home of Philip and stayed with him. He had the work of telling the Good News. He was one of the seven helpers.

dag: Amaa nyin yihirila Naawuni zɔbo a kɔbili ni. Ka guri Naawuni jɛmbo soli.
en: You are truly making religion ineffective and restraining meditation before God.

dag: Ka tinzun nir ŋun yɛn be yi sani niŋ daba ayi bee ŋun yɛn be yi sani sahakam o yi bɔri ni o mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di ʒiɛɣu niŋdi Yawɛ nyaɣisim la, ŋun niŋmi kaman yi ni niŋdi shɛm.
en: And the foreigners who live among you must also follow these rules.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun tum zina, o ka yɛm. Ŋun tum lala o saɣim omaŋa.
en: But a man who commits adultery doesn't have any sense. He is just destroying himself.

dag: Ka Azibuk bia Nɛhimia ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtizur yaɣili pirigili polo naa la daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu. O daa zaŋla lala hal ti paai Dauda siliga la tooni hal ti paai bɛ ni daa gbi mɔɣ shɛl la mini tɔbbihi biɛhigu shee la.
en: Nehemiah son of Azbuk ruled half of the district of Beth-Zur, and he rebuilt the next section of the wall. It went as far as the royal cemetery, the artificial pool, and the army barracks.

dag: Bɛ ni mi ni Naawuni zaligu wuhiya ni bɛn tumdi dimbɔŋɔnim simdi kum maa zaa yoli, bɛmaŋmaŋ gba kul tumdi li mi hal ka ʒe bɛn gba tumdi li nyaaŋa.
en: They know Gods law says that anyone who lives like that should die. But they not only continue to do these things themselves, but they also encourage others who do them.

dag: Ka Dauda bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a daa yɛn ku Yawɛ ni pii ninvuɣ so maa ka dabiɛm bi mal a.
en: David asked him, How is it that you dared kill the Lord 's chosen king.

dag: Ka Absalom mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa yɛli, Hushai ŋun nyɛ Ariki nir ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm ŋɔ ne nini gari Ahitɔfɛl ni yɛli shɛm la. Dama Yawɛ daa zaliya ni Ahitɔfɛl ni yɛli shɛm maa di nya nasara, ka di chɛ ka ŋun Yawɛ chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai Absalom.
en: Absalom and the others liked Hushai's plan better than Ahithophel's plan. This was because the Lord had decided to keep Ahithophel's plan from working and to cause trouble for Absalom.

dag: A dimnim zaa yaala bɛ noya niŋ a. Bɛ chahirimi, ka dimdi bɛ nyina, ka kuhiri yɛra, Ti naag o zaa. Ti ni daa guhiri dabisi shɛl la m-bala, ti bahi nya li.
en: All your enemies mock you and glare at you with hate. They curl their lips and sneer, We have destroyed it! This is the day we have waited for.

dag: di saha ka Judanim maa zaa daa yi bɛ ni woliwoli tab be luɣ shɛŋa ni n-labi Juda tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni Gɛdalia sani Mizipa nti tɔɣiri wain, ka pɔhiri tiwala pam.
en: So they left the places where they had been scattered, and returned to Judah. They came to Gedaliah at Mizpah, and there they gathered in large amounts of wine and fruit.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim daa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka Naawuni Kundi yɛligu niŋ pali. Di ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Hal o kɔb yini gba ti ku kabi.
en: These things happened to give full meaning to the Scriptures that said, None of his bones will be broken.

dag: Ka wuntaŋ daa ti bii na, ka Naawuni chɛ ka pɔhim tulli yi wulimpuhili polo ʒiɛna, n-chɛ ka wuntaŋ kpe Jona hal ka o ti yɛn pabigi. Ka Jona daa bɔri ni o kpi, ka yɛli, N kum so o bebu.
en: After the sun had risen, God sent a hot east wind, and Jonah was about to faint from the heat of the sun beating down on his head. So he wished he were dead. I am better off dead than alive, he said.

dag: Bɛ yi dɔɣi naɣibila bee piɛbila bee bubila, di simdi ka o be o ma sani n-niŋ daba ayopɔin, ka daba anii zaŋ chana, yi yi zaŋ o nyo buɣim mali sara ti man Yawɛ, n ni deei li.
en: When a calf, or a sheep, or a goat is born, it must stay seven days with its mother. Then from the eighth day on, this animal will be accepted as a sacrifice offered as a gift to the Lord .

dag: Lihimiya ŋarima gba: Di ni nyɛ zaɣ kara ka pɔhim din mali kpiɔŋ ʒiɛri li n-chani la zaa yoli, dabihi shɛŋa din lo di nyoya ni n-nyɛ din ŋmaligiri li kpari ŋun duhiri li ni bɔri shɛli polo.
en: Or think of a ship: big as it is and driven by such strong winds, it can be steered by a very small rudder, and it goes wherever the pilot wants it to go.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ʒi luɣ shɛŋa ka su li n-daa nyɛ: Bɛtɛl mini di tiŋkpansi ni Naaran din daa be wulimpuhili polo la ni Gɛza din daa be wulinluhili polo la mini di tiŋkpansi ni Aya mini di tiŋkpansi.
en: The descendants of Ephraim took over the territory as far south as Bethel, as far east as Naaran, and as far west as Gezer. Their territory included all the villages around these towns, as well as Shechem, Ayyah, and the nearby villages.

dag: Dama n ni gbahi Ifriimnim kaman gbuɣinli ni gbahiri binyara shɛm la, ka gbahi Judanim kaman gbuɣimbil ni gbahiri binyara shɛm la. Hal mmaŋmaŋ ni dari tɔhi ba n-zaŋ ba chaŋ, ka so ku tooi fa ba bahi.
en: So I'll become a fierce lion attacking Israel and Judah. I'll snatch and carry off what I want, and no one can stop me.

dag: Yiɣisim zabi n zuɣu, n Duuma ni n Naawuni! Yiɣisim mali n yɛla maa ti ma!.
en: Fight to defend me, Lord God.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum yɛtɔɣa maa zaa, ka dabiɛm gbahi ba, ka bɛ ŋmaligi lihi taba, ka yɛli Baruk, Di simdi ka ti zaŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ ti yɛli naa.
en: When the royal officials heard all the messages from the scroll, they were afraid and looked at one another. They said to Baruch, We must tell King Jehoiakim about these messages on the scroll.

dag: Ka Jɛshua bia Ɛzɛr ŋun daa nyɛ Mizipa naa la daa mali me gooni din be bɛ ni duri luɣ shɛli chani tɔb nɛma ni be luɣ shɛli gooni maa gɔŋbu shee tooni la m-pan o zuɣu.
en: Ezer son of Jeshua, ruler of Mizpah, built the next section in front of the armory, as far as the place where the wall turns;.

dag: Nyama, di pun sabimi ʒiɛya n sani, m bi yɛn shini, amaa n ni darigi bɛ tibili.
en: Look, this stands written before me. I wont be silent, but I will repay; I will repay in full measure.

dag: Yi nuzaa polo tintariga vulo yɛn zaŋla Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku duli hal ni Hɔr Zoli gbini.
en: Your northern border will begin at the Mediterranean Sea and go to Mount Hor.

dag: N daa lihiya n-nya ka tiŋgban shɛli din daa mali atam pam la leela tiŋgban nɛli, ka di fɔntinsi la zaa wurim do Yawɛ tooni, o suhuyiɣisili din galisi zuɣu.
en: The fertile land had become a desert; its cities were in ruins because of the Lord 's fierce anger. .

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mani, man maŋmaŋa kanimina ni n ti liri ya n-kari ya saria zuliya kam ninni.
en: Now all those nations will watch as I turn against you and punish you.

dag: Puhimiya yi ni biri bindir shɛŋa din daŋ niŋbu kpuɣibu chuɣu. Yuuni yi ti giligi ka yi kpuɣi yi puri atam zaa naai, yin puhimiya yi puri atam kpuɣibu chuɣu.
en: Observe the Harvest Festival for the early produce of your crops that you planted in the field, and the Gathering Festival at the end of the year, when you gather your crop of fruit from the field.

dag: Ka Shilɔnim bipuɣinsi yi ti yina ni bɛ ti wa wahi, yin yimiya wain tihi puri maa ni na, ka yi zaa yinoyino ti gbaag o paɣ ni yɛn nyɛ so Shilɔnim bipuɣinsi maa ni n-zaŋ ba kuli Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni.
en: Wait there for the young women of Shiloh to come out and perform their dances. Then rush out and grab one of the young women, then take her home as your wife.

dag: Ŋuna n-zali ba ni bɛ kul beni sahakam. O zali ba la zaligu, ka di mi ku yiɣisi.
en: God set them in place always and forever. God made a law that will not be broken.

dag: Hal sakpaleensi mɛrila bɛ duri, ka ŋmanʒiɛhi mali bɛmaŋmaŋ tɛri a jɛmbu duu puuni; ka mali bɛ bihi sɔŋdi baɣind a sara maligu bimbini; nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋun nyɛ n naa ni n Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Yes, the sparrow too has found a home there; the swallow has found herself a nest where she can lay her young beside your altars, LORD of heavenly forces, my king, my God!.

dag: Ka Musa daa boli Izraɛlnim zaa na nti yɛli ba, Yi daa nya Yawɛ ni tum tuun shɛŋa zaa yi ninni Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, o ni daa niŋ Firawuna min o sapashinnim ni o tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa shɛm.
en: Moses called together all the people of Israel and said to them, You saw for yourselves what the Lord did to the king of Egypt, to his officials, and to his entire country.

dag: Ŋunkam ŋubi n niŋgbuŋ ka nyu n ʒim, dilana be n ni ka n gba be o ni.
en: If you eat my flesh and drink my blood, you are one with me, and I am one with you.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri biriginsim puuni zana m-beni, amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn yiinila yila, ka mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Evil people are defeated by their sin, but good people will sing and be happy.

dag: Amaa ka Samaria do so gba daa ti doli soli maa na nti paai nimaani nya o, ka di niŋ o nambɔɣu pam;.
en: Then a Samaritan man traveled down that road. He came to the place where the hurt man was lying. He saw the man and felt very sorry for him.

dag: ka yi ŋmaligi labi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani ka yi mini yi bihi ti deeg o noli ni yi suhuri zaa mini yi shihi zaa kaman n ni zaani ya shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Then you and your descendants will turn back to the Lord your God. You will follow him with all your heart and completely obey all his commands that I have given you today.

dag: Bɛ biɛhigu maa yɛla garila wulinluhili polɔnima, ka dabiɛm gbahi wulimpuhili polɔnima.
en: Their successors are appalled at what happens to them; their predecessors pull their hair.

dag: Ka kɔhigɔriba maa yɛl o, A suhu ni yi yuri binshɛŋa la zaa zoya ka chɛ a, ka a buni min a bin suma zaa zo ka chɛ a, ka a ku lan nya li yaha.
en: The fruit your whole being craved has gone from you. All your glitter and glamour are lost to you, never ever to be found again.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu Anabi Musa ni daa ti bi doo, o daa zaɣisiya ni o pala Firawuna bipuɣiŋga bia.
en: Moses grew up and became a man. He refused to be called the son of Pharaohs daughter. He chose not to enjoy the pleasures of sin that last such a short time. Instead, he chose to suffer with Gods people. He did this because he had faith.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa zaŋ o jaaŋgbee tiri zuɣusaa, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka satahiŋga mini sakuɣa ni buɣim lu tiŋgban ni na. Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka sakuɣa lu Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: So Moses raised his walking stick into the air, and the Lord sent hail with thunder and lightning down on the earth. The Lord caused hail to fall all over Egypt.

dag: Daadam, zaŋm a nini kpa Jɛrusalɛm polo n-yihi waazu jɛndi bɛ luɣ shɛŋa din be kasi. Tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ.
en: Human one, face Jerusalem, preach against their sanctuary, and prophesy against Israels fertile land.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, n ni darigi a tibili ka di dol a suhuyiɣisili min a nyuli zabbu ni a ni je ba shɛm la soli. N yi kar a saria, n ni chɛ ka a baŋ n ni nyɛ so.
en: And the Lord GOD says, You were jealous of my people. You were angry and hateful to them. So by my life, I swear that I will punish you the same way you hurt them! I will punish you and let my people know that I am with them.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim bɛn kpalim la daa pah o zuɣu n-dol o bilikɔnsi soli maa hal ka Baanabas gba daa birigi pahi bɛ zuɣu n-doli bɛ bilikɔnsi soli maa.
en: He and the others hid their true feelings so well that even Barnabas was fooled.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni baansi. Bɛ daa nyɛla bɛ daŋ ni dɔɣirikpamba m-be Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni duri ni tumdi tuma wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa. Bɛ daa bi lan tumdi tuun shɛli pahi di zuɣu.
en: Some Levite families were responsible for the Temple music. The heads of these families lived in some of the Temple buildings and were free from other duties, because they were on call day and night.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa mɔɣisi Barizillai kpariŋ, ka suhi alibarika niŋ o ni, ka Barizillai daa labi kul o yiŋa, ka naa mini niriba maa zaa daa gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa du.
en: So all the people crossed over the Jordan River, and the king stayed behind. The king kissed Barzillai and blessed him, and then Barzillai went back to his home.

dag: ka lihi zuɣusaa, ka siɣim ka yɛli tikpiralan maa, Efata! Di gbinni nyɛla, Yooma.
en: Then Jesus looked up to heaven, gave a deep groan, and said to the man, Ephphatha, which means, Open up.

dag: Kum mini kɔnyuri n-daa yɛn ku ba, hal ka bɛ daa ti yihi tahima.
en: You were hungry and thirsty and about to give up.

dag: Ka Liya daa yɛli, Zuɣusuŋ; ka daa boli bia maa yuli Gaad.
en: I'm really lucky, Leah said, and she named the boy Gad.

dag: Ka o pirig o chinchini sɔŋ, ka vaai yiɣisi chaŋ Yisa sani.
en: So he threw off his cloak, jumped up, and came to Jesus.

dag: Di saha ka biŋkɔbiri chaŋ bɛ biɛhigu shee nti kpalim do bɛ lɛya ni.
en: The animals run into their dens and stay there.

dag: Yawɛ shia ni ti siɣ o zuɣu na nti ti o yɛm mini baŋsim, ka ti o yiko mini saɣisigu ni baŋsim mini Naawuni zɔbo.
en: The Spirit of the Lord will be with him to give him understanding, wisdom, and insight. He will be powerful, and he will know and honor the Lord .

dag: Chɛrubinim maa daa yirigila bɛ kpiŋkpama zuɣusaa, ka bɛ kpiŋkpama maa mahim luri adaka yɔrigu maa zuɣu, ka bɛ nina kpa taba. Adaka yɔrigu maa dɛde ka chɛrubinim maa nina daa kpa.
en: The winged creatures faced each other across the lid, and their outspread wings covered it.

dag: ka daa zaŋ fɔŋ maa puri mini di tiŋkpansi zaa ti Kalɛb ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛfune bia la.
en: But the farmland and villages around Hebron were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ tusa bɛn yuri ma, ka doli n fukumsi zaligunima, n wuhiri n yurilim maŋli bɛ sani.
en: But I am loyal and gracious to the thousandth generation of those who love me and keep my commandments.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa niŋ Ibram nirilim viɛnyɛliŋga Zarai zuɣu. O daa ti Ibram piɛri mini buhi ni niɣi ni bundibisi ni bunnyama ni daba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba ni laakumnima.
en: Pharaoh was kind to Abram because he thought Abram was Sarais brother. He gave Abram sheep, cattle, donkeys, camels, and men and women servants.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daba ayi ka Gomna Filiksi min o paɣ Drusila ŋun daa nyɛ Yɛhudia paɣ la daa ti kana n-tim ti boli Pool na ni bɛ ti wum Yisa Masia yɛla o sani.
en: After several days, Felix came with his wife Drusilla, who was Jewish, and summoned Paul. He listened to him talk about faith in Christ Jesus.

dag: O chɛ ka m bela zibisim ni kaman bɛn pun kpi ka di yuui la.
en: He put me in the dark, like someone who died long ago.

dag: Di saha ka Ilaisha daa je suli niŋ o, ka yɛli, Di di simdi ni a zaŋ li fiɛbila siɣimsiɣim bunu bee buyɔbu; dindina a naan ŋme Sirianim hal ti kpimsi bɛ birili, amaa a ni bi niŋ lala maa zuɣu, a ni ŋme n-nyaŋ ba la siɣimsiɣim buta kɔŋko.
en: The man of God became angry with him. He said, If only you had struck five or six times, you would have finished the Arameans off. As it is, you will defeat them only three times.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi puu ni bindir tuuli mini yi puu ni tiwala kom na ti ti ma di tibu saha, ka di niŋya zinchili. Zaŋmiya yi bidib tuuli kam ti ma.
en: Don't fail to give me the offerings of grain and wine that belong to me. Dedicate to me your first-born sons.

dag: Yi bi mi ni di nyɛla talahi ni ninvuɣ yino kpi sokam zaa zuɣu ka ti zuliya ŋɔ zaa ti ku bahi yoli.
en: Don't you realize that it is better for you to have one man die for the people, instead of having the whole nation destroyed.

dag: Dama zaŋ chaŋ daba ayopɔin dali, n ni chɛ ka saa lu dunia ni na m-mi wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa biɛɣ pihinahi n-ku n ni nam binshɛɣukam niŋ tiŋgban ni ŋɔ zaa.
en: Seven days from now I will send rain that will last for days and nights, and I will destroy all other living creatures I have made.

dag: Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ba Ijipti na maa ŋmanila yɔnaɣ yilli bɛ sani.
en: God brought them out of Egypt. They are as strong as a wild ox.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N daa chibi soli teeku ni, ka daa ŋme solɔɣu sɔŋ kom pam puuni.
en: Long ago the Lord made a road through the sea, a path through the swirling waters.

dag: Lala ka Naawuni niŋ zaŋ yi ba biŋkɔbiri ti ma.
en: So God has taken the animals away from your father and has given them to me.

dag: ka lan nyɛ nanima ayopɔin shɛb bɛn niriba anu pun lu, ka bɛ niriba ayi bɛn kpalim maa ni yino be nam ni pumpɔŋɔ, ka yino la ŋun na bi di, amaa o yi ti di, o ku yuui.
en: five of them have fallen, one still rules, and the other one has not yet come; when he comes, he must rule only a little while.

dag: ka mɛnya kuɣa sara maligu bimbini nimaani n-ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ; di ti yɛn nyɛla kuɣa sara maligu bimbini, ka pa yi ni zaŋ kurugu bini shihi kuɣ shɛŋa.
en: At this same place, build an altar for offering sacrifices to the Lord your God. But don't use stones that have been cut with iron tools.

dag: Amaa n ni chɛ ka bɛ gbibi n jɛmbu duu maa, ka tumdi di puuni tuun shɛli zaa din simdi tumbu.
en: They will be responsible for all the hard work that must be done in the temple.

dag: Aai, m bia! Aai, m pul ni bia! Aai, n nɔpoli bia!.
en: I prayed for a son, and you are the son I gave birth to.

dag: Ka Yisa daa piligi yɛri ba, Miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka so birigi ya;.
en: Jesus said to them, Watch out, and don't let anyone fool you.

dag: N niriba bɛn yɛla mali nambɔɣu ŋɔ, pilimiya buri, ka niŋ tampiligim buɣi yimaŋa n-kum kaman nira bi gaŋa ni yi kpi ka o kumdi shɛm la. Fabilimiya pam, dama bɛn kuri niriba maa ni libigi ti.
en: My people, put on funeral clothes and roll in ashes; weep and wail as for an only child, because the destroyer will suddenly descend upon us.

dag: Dama bɛ daa chɛ ka o suhu miligi, ka o yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din bi simdi.
en: They made him so bitter that he spoke without stopping to think.

dag: dindina yin zaŋmiya li kɔhi deei liɣiri n-zaŋ liɣiri maa mali chaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni pii luɣ shɛli ni bɛ jɛmd o maa.
en: then you can convert it to money. Take the money with you and go to the location the LORD your God selects.

dag: N-nyɛ kuɣ duli shɛli n ni pihi sɔŋ m min a sunsuuni.
en: Both this pile of rocks and this large rock have been set up between us as a reminder. I must never go past them to attack you, and you must never come past them to attack me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ naa ni daa zaŋ gban shɛli ti Yufretiiz Mɔɣili wulinluhili polo gomnanim mini zuɣulaannim la ti ba, ka bɛ daa zani bɛ nyaaŋa ka sɔŋ ba Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa mɛbu tuma ni.
en: Some of those who had returned took the king's orders to the governors and officials in Western Province. Then the officials did what they could for the people and for the temple of God.

dag: Dindali maa yi zaa ni ti zaŋ yi daanzinfa buɣa mini salima buɣa din nyɛ yi nuhi ni tum alahichi m-malila labi.
en: On that day, you will each reject the idols of silver and the idols of gold, which you have sinfully made for yourselves.

dag: Yi chaŋ gili zoya ni tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni ka di yuui, kpamiya yi nuzaa polo.
en: You have traveled around these mountains long enough. Turn north.

dag: Di saha nir ni ti yi o mabia nyaaŋa n-chɛ ka bɛ ku o; ka doo ni ti yi o bia nyaaŋa n-chɛ ka bɛ ku o, ka bihi gba ti zaɣisi bɛ banim mini bɛ manima, ka zaŋ ba puhi kubu.
en: People will hand over their own brothers to be put to death, and fathers will do the same to their children; children will turn against their parents and have them put to death.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ! Kul paɣimiy o ʒiɛmani kam ni. Ami! Ami!.
en: You, the Lord God of Israel, will be praised forever! Amen and amen.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Mɔabnim tuumbiɛri buta ni bunahi zuɣu n ku chɛ bɛ tibili darigibu; bɛ ni daa zaŋ Ɛdom naa kɔba nyo buɣim la zuɣu.
en: The Lord says, The people of Moab have sinned again and again, and for this I will certainly punish them. They dishonored the bones of the king of Edom by burning them to ashes.

dag: Ka Filistia doo maa daa lan yɛli, Yinim Izraɛl sapashin kpamba ka n ta daɣiri ŋɔ. Bomiya do so na ka m min o ti tuhi.
en: Here and now I challenge the Israelite army. I dare you to pick someone to fight me.

dag: Sool gbaɣinɔʒiri maa ni daa nya ka Sool kpi maa, ka o gba lu o takɔbi zuɣu kpi m-pah o zuɣu.
en: The young man saw that Saul was dead, so he too threw himself on his own sword and died with Saul.

dag: Mani n-su mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri zaa mini naɣ shɛb bɛn be zoya tusatusa shɛm zuɣu la.
en: because every forest animal already belongs to me, as do the cattle on a thousand hills.

dag: O chɛ ka m bela zibisim ni kaman bɛn pun kpi ka di yuui la.
en: He has forced me to live in the stagnant darkness of death.

dag: Ka so yi zaŋ o ni da pu shɛli ti Yawɛ, ka di pala o ni di tiŋgban shɛli fali yaɣ shɛli palo.
en: If you promise me a field that you have bought.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai zoli maa gbini, ka o deei li bɛ sani n-zaŋ kpɛhi duu; ka chɛbisi ba ka bɛ ŋmaligi labi.
en: When Gehazi came to the hill, he took these things from the servants. He sent the servants away, and they left. Then he hid those things in the house.

dag: N ni zaŋ n shia niŋ yi ni, ka chɛ ka yi doli n zalikpana mini n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: I will put my Spirit inside you and change you so that you will obey my laws. You will carefully obey my commands.

dag: Yawɛ, a tuma galisiya pam! A tɛha zilim pam!.
en: How awesome are your works, LORD! Your thoughts are so deep!.

dag: Ka nachin kpɛm maa daa kul maag o ni n-lihir o ni o nya Yawɛ chɛ ka o dila nasara o chandi maa ni maa bee.
en: The man stood gazing at her, wondering silently if the LORD had made his trip successful or not.

dag: So kani n-nyɛ ŋun mi, so mi kani n-nyɛ ŋun bɔri Naawuni.
en: Not one of them understands or even searches for God.

dag: Ka wula ka o yi darigi tinim bɛn be ti nyɛvil ni ŋɔ tibili ti daalahichi zuɣu ka ti fabinda?.
en: No one alive can complain when he punishes them for their sins.

dag: Ka sagbana daa kpabikpabi kaman gbaŋ la n-wurim zaa, ka zoli kam mini teeku puuni tiŋgban bihi daa vuui di biɛhigu shee.
en: The sky was split in the middle and both sides rolled up like a scroll. And every mountain and island was moved from its place.

dag: Ka puu atam kpuɣibu saha daa ti miri, ka wɔɣiri kɔba pihita la ni niriba ata daa chaŋ Dauda sani Adulam vo kabili ni. Ka Filistianim daa lo tɔb na ti do Rɛfaim vinvamli ni.
en: At harvesttime, three of the thirty chiefs went down and joined David at the fortress of Adullam, while a force of Philistines were camped in the Rephaim Valley.

dag: Gɛrishɔn bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Leedan mini Shimɛi.
en: The Gershonites included Ladan and Shimei.

dag: Mani n-daa tiɣi niriba ŋɔ zaa pua bee mani n-daa dɔɣi ba, ka a ni yɛli ma, Kpuɣim ba buɣi kaman biyol ni buɣiri bimɔɣiriga shɛm la tahi a ni daa lo alikauli ni a ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti bɛ yaannim la ni.
en: but they're not my children. You told me to nurse them along and to carry them to the land you promised their ancestors.

dag: Amazia daa nyɛla o bia, ka Azaria nyɛ o bia, ka Jɔtam nyɛ o bia.
en: Amaziah, Uzziah, Jotham.

dag: Lala ka yi yaannim daa niŋ ka Naawuni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai ti mini tiŋ ŋɔ la. Amaa ka yi lan tari Vuhim Dabisili maa daɣiri ni yi chɛ ka Naawuni suhu lan yiɣisi pam bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu.
en: Didn't God punish us and this city because our ancestors did these very same things? And here you are, about to make God furious again by disgracing the Sabbath.

dag: A mini niriba maa kul yɛn gbarigimi zaa. Tuma maa yaɣ a kɔŋko tuma, a kɔŋko ku tooi tumdi li.
en: You will end up totally wearing yourself out, both you and these people who are with you. The work is too difficult for you. You cant do it alone.

dag: Kamiyana ti nya Naawuni ni tum tuun shɛŋa, o tuma mali dabiɛm pam ninsalinim sani.
en: Come and see what God has done, his wonderful acts among people.

dag: O ni wurim zoya din du pam mini kunkuna din du pam zaa.
en: They might be like the tall mountains and high hills.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ binshɛɣukam ka yiɣisi dol o.
en: Levi got up, left everything, and followed him.

dag: Ka di daa ti lu Naa Hɛrɔd dɔɣim dabisili dali, ka Hɛrɔdias bipuɣiŋga yi salo ni na nti wa waa ka di niŋ Naa Hɔrɔd nyaɣisim pam.
en: When Herod's birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced for the guests. She pleased Herod.

dag: Dinzuɣu doliya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ fukumsi zalikpana maa ka dol o soya ka zɔr o.
en: So then, do as the Lord has commanded you: live according to his laws and obey him.

dag: A mi yuli ku lan booni Ibram, amaa a yuli ni boonila Ibrahimma; dama n zaŋ a leela zuliya pam yaba.
en: I will change your name from Abram to Abraham, because I am making you the father of many nations.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa zaŋ niriba maa mini bɛ ni daa di neen shɛŋa na maa nti ti Musa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza ni Izraɛlnima sansani din daa be Mɔab bɔpiɛligu din daa miri Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli Jɛriko polo la.
en: and they brought the captives, the valuable property, and the spoils of war to Moses, Eleazar the priest, and the Israelite community, at the camp on the plains of Moab by the Jordan across from Jericho.

dag: N daa tuui zaŋ li yɛl la Ziɔnnima, ka zaŋ di lahiba suŋ molo m-moli Jɛrusalɛmnim sani.
en: I was the first to tell the people of Jerusalem, Look, it's happening! I was the one who announced this good news to Zion.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ yɛli, A ni suhi ma ŋɔ zuɣu, n chɛ bɛ taali maa.
en: The Lord answered, I will forgive them, as you have asked.

dag: ni Tapua naa ni Hɛfa naa.
en: Tappuah, Hepher.

dag: Zibisim titali n-nyɛ bɛ daazichi n-doya guli ba, ka buɣim din pa so ni mali shɛli ni ti di ba. Ka binshɛlikam din ti kpalim bɛ yinsi ni ti di buɣim.
en: and what they treasure most will be lost in the dark. God will send flames to destroy them in their tents with all their property.

dag: Dindali maa, nyɛvili kom ni ti zɔri yiri Jɛrusalɛm na. Di pirigili ti yɛn zɔri ti lurila wulimpuhili polo teeku ni, ka di pirigili din kpalim mi zɔri ti luri wulinluhili polo teeku ni. Ka di kul ni zɔri lala wuuni kaman di ni zɔri shɛm shɛɣuni.
en: When that day comes, fresh water will flow from Jerusalem, half of it to the Dead Sea and the other half to the Mediterranean. It will flow all year long, in the dry season as well as the wet.

dag: Amaa Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba la daa bela Ofɛl, ka Ziha mini Gishipa daa nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba maa zuɣulaannima.
en: The Temple workers lived in the part of Jerusalem called Ophel and worked under the supervision of Ziha and Gishpa.

dag: Di saha Zɛba mini Zalimuna ni bɛ tɔbbihi daa bela Karikɔr. Wulimpuhili polɔnim maa tɔbbihi bɛn daa kpalim kalinli daa nyɛla kaman tuhi pinaanu, dama bɛ daa pun ku bɛ ni ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pisi bɛn daa gbib takɔbiri la.
en: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor with their camp, about fifteen thousand men, all the ones who were left from the easterners entire camp. One hundred twenty thousand armed men had fallen.

dag: Saha shɛli Amazia ni daa chɛ Yawɛ jɛmbu maa, ka bɛ daa lo ni bɛ ku o Jɛrusalɛm, ka o daa zo n-kuli Lakishi. Amaa ka bɛ daa chɛ ka shɛb chaŋ Lakishi maa nti ku o nimaani.
en: From the time Amaziah turned away from the LORD, some people conspired against him in Jerusalem. When Amaziah fled to Lachish, they sent men after him, and they murdered him in Lachish.

dag: Zuliya shɛb Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ni o zaŋ ba buɣisi Izraɛlnim shɛb bɛn zaa nini daa bi nya tɔb shɛŋa din tuhi Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni la m-bɔŋɔ.
en: So then, the Lord left some nations in the land to test the Israelites who had not been through the wars in Canaan.

dag: Man Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ni so yi ni tooi saɣim n ni lo biɛkaali mini yuŋ alikauli shɛl la, ka biɛɣu ku lan neei bee ka yuŋ ku lan zibi n ni zal li saha shɛli maa.
en: This is what the LORD says: If one could break my covenant with the day and my covenant with the night so that they wouldnt come at their proper time.

dag: Amaa o daa bi baŋ o ni paɣitali hal ka o ti dɔɣ o paɣisar dɔɣim bidibiga; ka Yisifu daa bol o yuli Yisa.
en: But he had no sexual relations with her before she gave birth to her son. And Joseph named him Jesus.

dag: Pa nyini n-sa gariche gili Ayuba min o malibu ni o ni su shɛlikam zaa luɣilikam? Nyini n-niŋ alibarika niŋ o tuma ni, ka chɛ ka o buni galisi pam tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: You are like a wall protecting not only him, but his entire family and all his property. You make him successful in whatever he does, and his flocks and herds are everywhere.

dag: Amaa ka a niriba maa yɛra, Ti Duuma ni niŋdi shɛm bi tuhi. Ka di mi nyɛla bɛ ni tumdi shɛm n-lee bi doli zaligu soli.
en: But your people say, Thats not fair! The Lord cannot be like that! But they are the people who are not fair! They are the people who must change!.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ yɛliya, Hal pumpɔŋɔ gba, niŋmiya tuuba ni yi suhuri zaa, ka ŋmaligi labi n sanna ni nolɔbo mini kumsi ni fabila.
en: The Lord said: It isn't too late. You can still return to me with all your heart. Start crying and mourning! Go without eating.

dag: Ka salindooriba mini kɔhigɔriba daa mali me zuɣusaa duu din be gɔŋbu shee la mini Piɛri Dunɔdali sunsuuni la.
en: The goldsmiths and the merchants repaired the section of wall from that corner to the Sheep Gate.

dag: Ti Duuma yɛliya, N yi naai n ni niŋdi shɛlikam Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu mini Jɛrusalɛm, n ni darigi Asiria naa tibili o karimbaani min o barinyubo zuɣu.
en: The Lord will do what he has planned against Jerusalem and Mount Zion. Then he will punish the proud and boastful king of Assyria.

dag: Daba ayopɔin ka bɛ ni ti zaŋ mali sara maligu bimbini maa ka di niŋ kasi, ka bɛ zaŋ li ti Naawuni.
en: The priests will purify the altar during those days, so that it will be acceptable to me and ready to use.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ suhudoolana ka daa neei ti Duuma Yisa ŋun nyɛ Piɛgul Suŋ o daalikauli din ka bahigu ʒim zuɣu kum ni la.
en: God gives peace, and he raised our Lord Jesus Christ from death. Now Jesus is like a Great Shepherd whose blood was used to make God's eternal agreement with his flock.

dag: Ka Huram daa mali daanya daantalis ayi sɔŋ. Zaɣ yini wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita anii. Ka booi booli pa di naŋgbanyɛhi zuɣu ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita anii. Ka di barilim nyɛ mita anu ni biɛla, ka daantaliga din pah ayi gba be lala.
en: Huram cast two bronze columns, each one feet tall and feet in circumference, and placed them at the entrance of the Temple.

dag: Kul teemiya bɛn be sarika ni yɛla ka di be kaman yi mini ba ka bɛ laɣim kpɛhi sarika maa la. Teemiya bɛn diri wahala yɛla ka di be kaman yi mini ba n-laɣim diri wahala maa la.
en: Remember those who are in prison, as though you were in prison with them. Remember those who are suffering, as though you were suffering as they are.

dag: Di daa ti lu Vuhim Dabisili dali, ka Yisa chaŋ Farisiinim kpeen so yiŋa ni o min o ti laɣim di bindirigu, ka Farisiinim maa daa kul kpahind o.
en: One Sabbath, Jesus was having dinner in the home of an important Pharisee, and everyone was carefully watching Jesus.

dag: Teemiya n ni daa yɛli ya shɛm la, Ye dabili bi gar o duuma. Bɛ yi daa niŋ ma wahala, lala ka bɛ ni niŋ yi gba wahala; bɛ mi yi daa deei n noli, bɛ ni deei yi gba dini.
en: Remember how I told you that servants are not greater than their master. So if people mistreat me, they will mistreat you. If they do what I say, they will do what you say.

dag: Chɛ ka suhudoo be di puuni, ka alaafee be di nanim yinsi.
en: May there be peace within your walls. May there be safety in your great buildings.

dag: Ninive ŋmanila biaŋ din kom zo n-yi ka chɛ li. Ka bɛ kuhiri yɛra, Zanimiya! Zanimiya! Amaa ka so bi ŋmaligi labina.
en: Like water from a broken dam the people rush from Nineveh! Stop! Stop! the cry rings out— but no one turns back.

dag: Nyamiya, ninvuɣ so ŋun zaɣisi ni o ku zo nti sɔɣi Naawuni sani tiligi, amaa ka naɣ niŋla o daazichi naani, ka zaŋ o daazichi maa n-leeg o sɔɣibu shee la.
en: Look what happened to the warrior who did not depend on God. That fool thought his wealth and lies would protect him.

dag: Amaa n Duuma, a nyɛla Naawuni ŋun zɔri nambɔɣu ni ŋun niŋdi nirilim, a bi jɛri suli yom, ka a yurilim maŋli min a ʒiɛyimtali mi galisi pam.
en: But you, the Lord God, are kind and merciful. You don't easily get angry, and your love can always be trusted.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Lɛvinim maa daa kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni nti sɔŋ Aduna min o bidibisi maa n-tum tuma. Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Lɛvinim maa polo, lala ka bɛ daa shiri niŋ ba.
en: After this, the Levites worked at the sacred tent as assistants to Aaron and his sons, just as the Lord had commanded.

dag: Sokam mi o yidana tiŋ maa dunɔdaya gbini, ka o mini tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni kpamba laɣindi ʒiina.
en: Her husband is a respected member of the city council, where he meets with the other leaders.

dag: ni a doli zaligu biɛr kasi puuni, ka ku mali galimi di ni hal ti paai ti Duuma Yisa Masia ni ti yɛn yi palo dahin shɛl la.
en: to obey your orders and keep them faithfully until the Day when our Lord Jesus Christ will appear.

dag: Yawɛ miri ŋunkam zaa suh o mini ŋunkam zaa suh o ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: and you are near to everyone whose prayers are sincere.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima: Paɣ yi niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga, o ni be daɣiri ni hal ni daba ayopɔin kaman o ni yi nya sɔrilim ka be daɣiri ni shɛm la.
en: Say to the Israelites: If a woman conceives a child and gives birth to a son, she will be unclean for seven days—just as she is during her menstrual period.

dag: Ka padiriba maa daa gbahi o yiŋbihi maa n-fiɛb bɛ yino, ka ku yino, ka lab yino mi kuɣa.
en: But the farmers grabbed the servants and beat one. They killed another one and then stoned to death a third servant.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Ilaisha daa ti chaŋ nimaani n-kpe duu maa ni ni o ti vuhi.
en: One day Elisha returned to Shunem and went up to his room to rest.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ Aduna min o bidibisi tarili bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛli nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ maa puuni, dahin shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋ ba zali ni bɛ leei man Yawɛ maligumaaniba la, ka n daa zaŋ li ti ba.
en: This is the part of the food offered to the Lord that was given to Aaron and his sons on the day they were ordained as priests.

dag: A ni bɔr a ba yiŋ la zuɣu ka a yiɣisi zɔri maa, ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a zu n-kpuɣi n wuna.
en: I know that you want to go back to your home. That is why you left. But why did you steal the gods from my house.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbiri lu a zuɣu n-ku ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri bɛn be a ni.
en: now the LORD God proclaims: Im bringing a sword against you, and I will cut off from you human and beast.

dag: Lan zaŋm anzinfa mini salima din kpalim la n-niŋ a min a dɔɣiriba ni nya ka di simdi shɛm, ka lee chɛ ka di nyɛla din doli yi Naawuni maa yubu.
en: You may use the silver and gold that is left over for whatever you and your people desire, in accordance with the will of your God.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma yɛl o, M bia, Naawuni maŋmaŋ ni ti ti piɛ so ti ni yɛn zaŋ mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maa. Ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa kul dol tab chana.
en: Abraham answered, God himself will provide one. And the two of them walked on together.

dag: N Duuma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, di chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali tahima a sani di vi n zuɣu. Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, di chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmd a ŋɔ nya filiŋ n zuɣu.
en: My Lord GOD All-Powerful, dont let me embarrass your followers. God of Israel, dont let me bring disgrace to those who worship you.

dag: Yawɛ yurilim din galisi ŋɔ zuɣu ka ti bi kpi; o nambɔzɔbo ka tariga.
en: The Lord 's kindness never fails! If he had not been merciful, we would have been destroyed.

dag: Ka o daa lan leei nyɛvililana n-dii yiɣisi zani; ka Yisa daa yɛli ni bɛ tim bipuɣiŋga maa bindirigu ka o di.
en: Her spirit came back into her, and she stood up immediately. Jesus said, Give her something to eat.

dag: Zaŋm Lɛvi zuliya na nti zali Aduna ŋun nyɛ maligumaana la tooni, ka bɛ sɔŋd o.
en: Assign the Levi tribe to Aaron the priest. They will be his assistants.

dag: Dinzuɣu m bɔri ni yi baŋ ni ninvuɣ so ŋun tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni na ʒi n-yɛli noli ti Yisa, ka so mi ku tooi yɛli ni Yisa nyɛla o Duuma, ka pa ni Shia Kasi yiko ni.
en: So I want to make it clear to you that no one says, Jesus is cursed! when speaking by Gods Spirit, and no one can say, Jesus is Lord, except by the Holy Spirit.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun ti wum dabiɛm maa yɛla ka zɔri ni ti lu bɔɣili ni, ka ŋun mi ti zo n-yi bɔɣili maa ni na, zana ni gbaag o. Dama sa kurili ni ti luna, ka tiŋgbani zaa sɔhira.
en: If you are terrified and run, you will fall into a pit; if you crawl out of the pit, you will get caught in a trap. The sky has split apart like a window thrown open. The foundations of the earth have been shaken;.

dag: Ka Gɛra biŋkɔbiguliba daa kana ti niŋ Yisahaku biŋkɔbiguliba maa naŋgbankpeeni yɛli, Ti kom m-bala. Dinzuɣu ka Yisahaku daa boli kɔbiliga maa yuli Ɛsɛk, bɛ ni daa niŋ o naŋgbankpeeni maa zuɣu.
en: Isaacs shepherds argued with Gerars shepherds, each claiming, This is our water. So Isaac named the well Esek because they quarreled with him.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti baptaizibu deebu zuɣu wuhiya ni ti pahila o zuɣu kpi ka bɛ sɔɣ ti, ka di bemi kaman Masia ni daa neei kum ni ti Ba Naawuni jilima yiko zuɣu shɛm la, lala zuɣu ka ti gba yipa mali nyɛvili palli biɛhigu.
en: When we were baptized, we died and were buried with Christ. We were baptized, so we would live a new life, as Christ was raised to life by the glory of God the Father.

dag: Pa omaŋmaŋ yubu ni ka o daa yɛl lala maa, amaa o ni daa nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulana di yuuni maa zuɣu ka o daa tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa n-wuhi ni Yisa ni ti kpi bɛ zuliya maa zuɣu;.
en: Caiaphas did not say this on his own. As high priest that year, he was prophesying that Jesus would die for the nation.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Maata! Maata! A jiɣirimi ka nahind amaŋ bina pam zuɣu.
en: The Lord answered her, Martha, Martha! You are worried and troubled over so many things.

dag: Bɛn nyɛ dunia ŋɔ nima bemi kaman Naawuni ni daa zaŋ taŋkpaɣu nam so la, ka bɛn nyɛ alizanda ni nim mi be kaman ŋun yi alizanda ni na la.
en: Everyone on earth has a body like the body of the one who was made from the dust of the earth. And everyone in heaven has a body like the body of the one who came from heaven.

dag: Ka Ammɔnnim daa yɔri farigu Naa Uzia sani, ka o yuli daa du hal ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ nim ti wum o yɛla, dama o daa niŋ yaa pam.
en: The Meunites paid taxes to Uzziah, whose fame spread even to Egypt because he had grown so powerful.

dag: Ka yil yin nim yi ŋmaligi zabira, bɛ yili maa mi wurindimi.
en: If a family divides itself into groups which fight each other, that family will fall apart.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ liɣiri da bindirigu a sani di, ka zaŋ liɣiri da kom a sani nyu. N kul bɔri ni a chɛ ka n chaŋla n naba zuɣu na ti gari.
en: Please sell us food for money so we can eat; sell us water for money so we can drink. Let us pass through on foot.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi do n-gbihira? Yiɣisimiya yirigimiya yimaŋ zuɣu, ka suhimiya Naawuni ni yi di ti lu zahimbu puuni.
en: Jesus said to them, Why are you sleeping? Get up and pray for strength against temptation.

dag: Di saha o daa yɛla saalo bɔɣiwɔɣila, dama di saha maa nabipuɣinsi bɛn daa na ʒi dɔbba ni daa yi yɛri saalo shɛŋa m-bala. Ka o tumtumda maa daa daag o yihi ka kpari dunoli.
en: So Amnons servant led Tamar out of the room and locked the door. Tamar was wearing a long robe with many colors. The kings virgin daughters wore robes like this.

dag: Amaa ka Jɛhu daa lee bi chɛ Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam daalahichi tumbu so shɛli o ni daa doli n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la dolibu. Dina n-nyɛ salima naɣibihi shɛb bɛn daa be Bɛtɛl mini Dan la jɛmbu.
en: However, Jehu didnt deviate from the sins that Jeroboam, Nebats son, had caused Israel to commit—specifically, the gold calves that were in Bethel and Dan.

dag: Dama yɛlikpan shɛli n ni daa zaŋ tin ya la nyɛla n gba ni daa tuui deei shɛli. Dina n-nyɛ: Yisa Masia daa kpila ti daalahichi zuɣu kaman Naawuni Kundi ni wuhi shɛm;.
en: I told you the most important part of the message exactly as it was told to me. This part is: Christ died for our sins, as the Scriptures say.

dag: Yawɛ ni chɛ ka yi tɔŋ pam yi bihi dɔɣibu ni mini yi biŋkɔbiri dɔɣibu ni ni yi puri atam ni tiŋgbɔn shɛli ŋun Yawɛ ni daa po pɔri yi yaannim sani ni o ni zaŋ tin ya la ni.
en: The LORD will make good things abound for you—whether the fertility of your womb, your livestocks offspring, or your fertile soils produce—on the very land that the LORD swore to your ancestors to give to you.

dag: Ka niriba pam daa laɣim ŋari kɔbilisi, ka taɣi kulibɔna din kom daa zɔri yiri tiŋgban maa ni zaa kom zali ka yɛra, Ti ku chɛ ka Asiria nanim maa ti kana ti nya kom pam.
en: Many people came together and stopped all the springs and the stream that flowed through the middle of the country. They said, The king of Assyria will not find much water when he comes here.

dag: Ka Jɔnadab daa yɛli naa, Nyama, nabihi maa kunna kaman mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni pun yɛl a shɛm la.
en: Jonadab said to David, Those are your sons coming, just as I said they would.

dag: N suhu zaa kul yɛla Naawuni fukumsi zaligu zuɣu.
en: I gladly agree with the Law on the inside.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli nachin kpɛm maa, Nyin ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ daalibarika nir ŋɔ, bɔ n-niŋ ka a kpalim ʒe sambani ŋɔ ni? Kpɛmina, dama m pun mali duu zal a, ka mali laakumnim ŋɔ gba biɛhigu shee zali.
en: Laban said, Come in, favored one of the LORD! Why are you standing outside? Ive prepared the house and a place for the camels.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ saguya ŋɔ, baŋmiya, jɛra ŋɔ, bɔ saha ka yi lee yɛn niŋ yɛm?.
en: You evil people are foolish. When will you learn your lesson? You are so stupid! You must try to understand.

dag: Dama o yɛliya, Nir yi jɛmdi Naawuni, di ka anfaani.
en: because he has said, It doesn't pay to please God.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yi diri nam, niriba malila suhupiɛlli, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri yi su fukumsi, niriba fabindimi.
en: When the righteous become numerous, the people rejoice, but when the wicked dominate, the people moan.

dag: Jɔash yuma daa nyɛla yuma ayopɔin o ni daa di nam saha shɛli maa.
en: Joash became king of Judah at the age of seven.

dag: Di chɛ ka m mali galimi n suhu ni zaŋ chaŋ a zaligunim maa polo, ka lala zuɣu ni chɛ ka n ku di vi.
en: Let me truly respect your laws, so I won't be ashamed.

dag: Ka yi ni daa wuhi ninvuɣ shɛb ni bɛ ti leei yi zɔnim la yi ti leei yi zuɣulaannima, wula ka yi lee yɛn yɛli? Di biɛrim maa ku ŋmanila paɣ ni wolisiri ni o dɔɣi ka biɛrim shɛli mal o la?.
en: What will you say when he appoints someone as head over you: your defenders, your trusted allies? Wont pain grip you like that of a woman in labor?.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ n-yɛn teei n nuu din mali kpiɔŋ ŋɔ ni sujee mini suhuyiɣisili pam n-tuhi ya.
en: I myself will fight against you people of Judah. I will fight against you with my own powerful hand. I am very angry with you, so I will fight against you with my own powerful arm. I will fight very hard against you and show how angry I am.

dag: N yi kpi n-do gballi ni, nyɔ bɔ ka n kum maa lee yɛn ti a? Taŋkpaɣu ni tooi paɣ a? Di ni tooi yɛl a ʒiɛyimtali yɛla?.
en: What good will it do you if I am in the grave? Once I have turned to dust, how can I praise you or tell how loyal you are?.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli ba, So di zaŋ li zali hal ni asiba.
en: Moses told them not to keep any overnight.

dag: Ka Rubin daa ti chaŋ mɔɣu ni alikama chɛbu saha ti bo ŋmaankpihiga na ti ti o ma Liya. Ka Reechɛl daa yɛli Liya, N suhir a, niŋm a bia ŋmaankpihiga maa shɛli ti ma.
en: During the wheat harvest Reuben went into the fields and found mandrakes, which he brought to his mother Leah. Rachel said to Leah, Please give me some of your son's mandrakes.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiya ni di daa kpala talahi ni o be kaman o mabihi ni be shɛm shɛlikam puuni, ka di chɛ ka o tooi leei maligumaani titali ŋun ʒe yim ni ŋun nyɛ nambɔzɔra o tuma ni zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni sani, ka di chɛ ka niriba nya alahichi chɛ m-paŋ.
en: Therefore, he had to be made like his brothers and sisters in every way. This was so that he could become a merciful and faithful high priest in things relating to God, in order to wipe away the sins of the people.

dag: Labisim a tiliginsim suhupiɛlli la ti ma, ka chɛ ka m mali pupiɛlim.
en: Give me again the joy that comes from your salvation, and make me willing to obey you.

dag: Di simdi ni a ti kɔrigiri naɣilaa dabisili kam m-maani alahichi sanyoo sara. Di lan simdi ka a maani alahichi kpihimbu sara maligu bimbini maa kasitali zuɣu; ka booi kpam bahi di zuɣu m-mal li ka di niŋ kasi.
en: Each day you must offer a bull as a sacrifice, so that sin may be forgiven. This will purify the altar. Then anoint it with olive oil to make it holy.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Mbo mfaaŋa, bi suŋ! A pal alikauli ni bin din pɔra, dinzuɣu n ni zaŋ tinsi pia fukumsi niŋ a nuu ni.
en: The king said to him, Thats great! You are a good servant. I see that I can trust you with small things. So now I will let you rule over ten of my cities.

dag: A ni ti yɛli n ni zal a ni a yɛlim shɛlikam zaa, ka a mabia Aduna mi ti yɛli Firawuna ni o chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa yi o tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Tell Aaron everything I say to you, and he will order the king to let my people leave his country.

dag: Lihimiya nya din niŋdi gili ya; sokam zaa laɣimmi ka yi sanna. Yi bidibisi ni yi katiŋ na, ka bɛ kpuɣi yi bipuɣinsi buɣ na nti tin ya.
en: Look around you! See all the people gathering around. Those are your sons coming from far away, and your daughters are there beside them.

dag: Yi daa yi niŋdi viɛnyɛliŋga; ka ŋuni n-lee kari ya ni yi di doli yɛlimaŋli maa?.
en: You were doing so well! Who made you stop obeying the truth? How did he persuade you?.

dag: Bɛ saɣim Mɔab, ka di bihi kuhira.
en: Moab will be shattered! Your children will sob.

dag: Nir yi wum yɛm saɣisigu, di ŋmanila salima nintua bee salima yɛri.
en: A warning given by an experienced person to someone willing to listen is more valuable than gold rings or jewelry made of the finest gold.

dag: Ka Ɛliakim daa nyɛ Milia bia, ka Milia nyɛ Mɛna bia, ka Mɛna nyɛ Matata bia, ka Matata nyɛ Neetan bia, ka Neetan mi nyɛ Naa Dauda bia.
en: son of Melea son of Menna son of Mattatha son of Nathan son of David.

dag: Yawɛ ni pii so, ka o nyɛ ti nyɛviya vuhim ŋɔ, bɛ daa gbaag o bɛ bɔɣa ni chaŋ. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ti ni daa yɛli ni ti ni kpe so mahim ni ka be dunia ŋɔ ni la.
en: They captured the source of our life, the king the Lord had chosen, the one we had trusted to protect us from every invader.

dag: Ka n nya ka wɔr ʒiɛɣu yina pahi, ka bɛ daa niŋ ŋun bar o maa yiko, ka ti o takɔb titali ni o yihi suhudoo dunia ni, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka daadamnim ku taba.
en: Out came another horse, fiery red. Its rider was allowed to take peace from the earth so that people would kill each other. He was given a large sword.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka ninvuɣ biɛri zaɣisi Naawuni, ka yɛri bɛ suhuri ni, A ku kari ti saria di zuɣu.
en: Why do the wicked reject God? Why do they think to themselves that you wont find out?.

dag: A chɛ ka ti ʒiʒiinitab nya a ni niŋ ti shɛm maa, ka maani ti ansarisi, ka bɛn gili ti lari ti.
en: Our neighbors see what you did to us, and they mock us and laugh at us.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Ammɔnnim tuumbiɛri buta ni bunahi zuɣu, n ku chɛ bɛ tibili darigibu. Dama bɛ ni tuhiri ni bɛ deei tiŋgbani palo pahi la zuɣu, bɛ daa kuhi karigi paɣipuhinim puya Giliad.
en: The Lord says, The people of Ammon have sinned again and again, and for this I will certainly punish them. In their wars for more territory they even ripped open pregnant women in Gilead.

dag: Maligumaana maa yi lihi li ka di nyɛla din kpe o niŋgbuŋ puuni, ka di kɔbiri paligi, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun yɛlim ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni, di nyɛla niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu n-zaŋ kpe bintɔrili maa ni maa.
en: If the priest sees that it appears to be lower than the skin, and its hair has turned white, the priest will declare the person unclean. It is an infection of skin disease that has broken out in the boil.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa ha daa di li tiɣi, ka bɛ daa laɣisi bɔrɔbɔro chɛhi mini zimburisa din guui pali piɛr ayopɔin.
en: Everyone ate until they were full. The disciples collected seven baskets full of leftovers.

dag: Amaa yinim Izraɛl zoya, yi ni teei wula n-wali yi wala ti n niriba Izraɛlnima. Dama di ku yuui, bɛ ni kuna pumpɔŋɔ.
en: But you, mountains of Israel, will extend your branches and bear your fruit for my people Israel, because they will come home very soon.

dag: Naa Dauda ni daa ʒin o yiŋa ka Yawɛ ti o vuhim o dimnim bɛn daa gil o zaa sani.
en: When the king was settled in his palace, and the LORD had given him rest from all his surrounding enemies.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti niŋ yɛda ka deei baptaizibu ni tiligi, amaa ŋun ti bi niŋ yɛda ni mali taali.
en: Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved. But those who do not believe will be judged guilty.

dag: Ka o daa ti zaŋ bɛ farigu tahi ti yo Mɔab Naa Ɛgilɔn. Naa Ɛgilɔn daa nyɛla ninvuɣ karili.
en: Then he presented the tribute payment to Moabs King Eglon, who was a very fat man.

dag: n-zaŋ Naawunitali shia niŋ o ni, ka ti o yiko mini fahim ni baŋsim ni nuhi tuumbaŋsim tuma zaa.
en: Not only has the Lord filled him with his Spirit, but he has given him wisdom and made him a skilled craftsman who can create objects of art with gold, silver, bronze, precious stones, and wood.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm, lala ka Izraɛlnim daa niŋ tum tuma maa zaa.
en: The Israelites did all of the work just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

dag: Ka Yisa lan yɛli ba yaha, Naawuni tim ya suhudoo! M Ba ni tim ma na shɛm, lala ka n gba timdi ya.
en: Then Jesus said again, Peace be with you. It was the Father who sent me, and I am now sending you in the same way.

dag: Amaa fɔntinsi maa ni biŋkɔbiri mini di nɛma zaa, ti daa zaŋ li ka di leei ti ni tuhi tɔbu di neen shɛŋa.
en: But we kept all the cattle and the valuable things from the cities for ourselves.

dag: ka dam zuliya kam, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ daazichi zaa kuli kpe na, ka n chɛ ka duu ŋɔ mali jilima.
en: I will make all the nations quake. The wealth of all the nations will come. I will fill this house with glory, says the LORD of heavenly forces.

dag: ni Kiriataim ni Bɛtigamul ni Bɛtimɛɔn.
en: Kiriathaim, Beth-Gamul, Beth-Meon.

dag: Di saha yi ni ti saɣim yi wuna mini di binnan shɛŋa zuɣu bɛ ni dooi salima mini anzinfa pa, ka va li labi kaman binchɛr biɛr la ka yɛli, Wari ya.
en: You will take your idols plated with silver and your idols covered with gold, and will throw them away like filth, shouting, Out of my sight.

dag: Maluk ni Harim ni Baana.
en: Malluch, Harim, Baanah.

dag: O daa yɛli Bɛnjamin zuliya, Yawɛ ni yuri so, barina ku tooi paag o. Naawuni ŋun galisi ŋɔ nyɛla ŋun be o luɣilikam dabisi muni puuni zaa. O ni yuri so ʒila o bɔɣusapima sunsuuni.
en: The Lord Most High loves you, tribe of Benjamin. He will live among your hills and protect you.

dag: Yinim bɛn bɔri ni yi yi taali ni Naawuni fukumsi zaligu zuɣu yihi yimaŋa Masia ni, ka lan ka Naawuni daalibarika puuni.
en: If you try to be made right with God through the law, your life with Christ is finished—you have left Gods grace.

dag: Nyini, miri ka a suhi ma n-ti niriba ŋɔ. Miri ka a duh a yee n-suhi bɛ zuɣu, a mi miri ka a balim ma, n ku deeg a suhigu.
en: Jeremiah, don't pray for these people! I, the Lord , would refuse to listen.

dag: A zaŋ sagbani lims amaŋa, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka ti suhigu bi lan paar a.
en: You are behind a wall of clouds that blocks out our prayers.

dag: Ka Jɛrimia daa yɛli Sɛraya, A yi ti paai Babilɔn, nyin karimmi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa.
en: Jeremiah said to Seraiah, Seraiah, go to Babylon. Be sure to read this message so that all the people can hear you.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Jɔshua, Piimi dɔbba n-sa chaŋ ti tuhi Amalɛknim maa. Biɛɣuni n sa ni zaŋ Naawuni jaaŋgbee ŋɔ niŋ n nuu ni n-chaŋ ti du n-tam daboli zuɣu.
en: So Moses told Joshua, Have some men ready to attack the Amalekites tomorrow. I will stand on a hilltop, holding this walking stick that has the power of God.

dag: ni putɔɣu ni ninvuɣ kubo ni danyubo ni vuyɔbo yiriŋ ni din ŋmani dimbɔŋɔnima. N kpahiri yi zuɣu ni kaman n ni daa pun kpahi yi zuɣu ni shɛm la: Bɛn niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnima ti ku kpe Naawuni nam ni.
en: jealousy, drunkenness, partying, and other things like that. I warn you as I have already warned you, that those who do these kinds of things wont inherit Gods kingdom.

dag: ka suhi Naawuni yɛli, Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun chɛ ka m bihi ni yino ʒini n nam ʒiishee zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka mmaŋmaŋ nini nya li ŋɔ.
en: and said, Bless Israels God, the LORD, who today has set my son on my throne, and has allowed my eyes to see it.

dag: Ŋun mali yɛm o suhu ni n-doli zaligunima. Amaa jɛrigu ŋun mali yɛtɔɣ yoya ni bahi yoli.
en: The skilled mind accepts commands, but a foolish talker is ruined.

dag: Ka n chɛ ka Jabin sapashin kpɛm Sisɛra zaŋ o chɛchɛbunsi min o tɔbbihi kana ti chirigi ya Kishɔn Mɔɣili ni; ka n zaŋ o niŋ a nuu ni.
en: I will bring Sisera, the commander of Jabin's army, to fight you at the Kishon River. He will have his chariots and soldiers, but I will give you victory over him.

dag: Yawɛ, zom ti nambɔɣu. Kul zom ti nambɔɣu, dama bɛ dihi ti vi ti yaɣi.
en: Be merciful to us, Lord , be merciful; we have been treated with so much contempt.

dag: Ti ni daa mali ti yaɣi Kilikia mini Pamfilia teeku noya zuɣu, ti daa paala Maira din be Lisia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: We sailed across the open sea off the coast of Cilicia and Pamphylia, and landed in Myra in Lycia.

dag: m-pahi Giliad pirigili ni Ashitarɔt ni Ɛdirɛi din daa nyɛ fɔntiŋ kar shɛŋa Bashan Naa Ogi ni daa su la. Musa daa zaŋ dimbɔŋɔnim tila Manaasa bia Makiri ni di nyɛ Makiri maa zuliya pirigili dini kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: It included half of Gilead, as well as Ashtaroth and Edrei, the capital cities of Og's kingdom in Bashan. All this was given to half the families descended from Machir son of Manasseh.

dag: Ka Dan zuliya niriba maa daa ŋmaligi chaŋ. Maika ni daa nya ka bɛ mali kpiɔŋ gar o maa, ka o ŋmaligi lab kuli.
en: Then the Danites went on their way. When Micah realized that they were too strong for him, he turned around and went home.

dag: Amaa ti Duuma sani, paɣ ku tooi be omaŋmaŋ zuɣu ka chɛ doo, ka doo gba ku tooi be omaŋmaŋ zuɣu ka chɛ paɣa;.
en: But in the Lord the woman needs the man, and the man needs the woman.

dag: Di saha ka Reechɛl mini Liya daa yɛl o, Binshɛli ka ti ba yiŋa ka ti yɛn di li fali.
en: Rachel and Leah answered Jacob, There is nothing left for us to inherit from our father.

dag: Yi ni ŋuni n-lee kpalim n-nyɛ ŋun nini daa nya n jɛmbu du kurili la jilima ni daa be shɛm? Yi ni nya jɛmbu du dini ŋɔ maa, wula ka di lee be yi sani? Di pa shɛli di bi ŋmani shɛli.
en: Who among you is left who saw this house in its former glory? How does it look to you now? Doesnt it appear as nothing to you?.

dag: Dama Yawɛ kul bɔrila din tuhi, ka mi kul ku chɛ o ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe o yim. O kul ni gul ba sahakam, amaa o ni kari ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn bihi bahi.
en: The LORD loves justice. He will never leave his faithful all alone. They are guarded forever, but the children of the wicked are eliminated.

dag: Dama bɛ maŋmaŋ naba n-zaŋ ba chaŋ ti kpɛhi zana ni, ka bɛ chaŋ ti lu bɔɣili ni.
en: Their own feet lead them into a net. They fall into its hidden pit and are caught.

dag: Mia pi tiŋgban ni guli ba, ka tɔŋ do sol ni guli ba.
en: A rope is hidden on the ground to trip them. A trap is waiting in their path.

dag: Yawɛ, n yi ti kuhi pam niŋ a, nyin wummi n kuhigu maa! Zom ma nambɔɣu, ka garigi ma!.
en: LORD, listen to my voice when I cry out— have mercy on me and answer me!.

dag: Ka ti Duuma malaika daa ti kpe duu maa ni na, ka neesim neei duu maa puuni zaa; ka malaika maa daa chaŋ ti kpahi Pita luɣili n-neeg o yɛli, Yiɣisim yomyom! Ka zoligɔnim din daa lo o nuhi la surigi lu tiŋa.
en: Suddenly an angel from the Lord appeared and a light shone in the prison cell. After nudging Peter on his side to awaken him, the angel raised him up and said, Quick! Get up! The chains fell from his wrists.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Amnɔn daa kul lan je Tama yɛlli zaa, hal ka o ni daa je o shɛm maa gar o ni daa yur o shɛm la gba. Di saha ka Amnɔn daa yɛl o, Yiɣisim yi.
en: Then Amnon began to hate Tamar. He hated her much more than he had loved her before. Amnon said to her, Get up and get out of here.

dag: Ka o pirig o chinchini sɔŋ, ka vaai yiɣisi chaŋ Yisa sani.
en: The blind man stood up quickly. He left his coat there and went to Jesus.

dag: O daa bi gbaag omaŋa o sujee ni, o mi daa bi tiligi bɛ nyɛviya, amaa ka daa chɛ ka alɔbo di ba.
en: God released his anger and slaughtered them in a terrible way.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti zaŋ ba tin ya, ka yi niŋ ba kaman n ni zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa zaa tin ya ŋɔ ni wuhi shɛm.
en: The LORD will lay them out before you, and you will do to them exactly what the command Ive given you dictates.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa zaŋ o yiko nam dunia ŋɔ, ka zaŋ o yɛm zali dunia ŋɔ, ka zaŋ o baŋsim nam zuɣusaa.
en: The Lord made the earth by his power; by his wisdom he created the world and stretched out the heavens.

dag: Di saha ka n kuhi yɛli, N Duuma NAAWUNI, n suhir a, dim suɣilo. Yaakubu ku be. O pɔri pam.
en: Then I said, Won't you please stop? How can our weak nation survive.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa zaŋ bia maa yi jirambisa maa zuɣu n-siɣina kpɛhi yili maa ni nti ti o ma maa ka yɛli, Nyama, a bia maa lan leei nyɛvililana yaha.
en: Elijah carried the boy downstairs, gave him to his mother, and said, Look, your son is alive.

dag: Ka Nabal daa garigi bɔhi Dauda tuumba maa, Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Dauda? Ka ŋuni mi n-lee nyɛ Jɛsi bia? Pumpɔŋɔ daba pam kul zɔrimi ka chɛri bɛ laamba.
en: and Nabal finally answered, David? Who is he? I've never heard of him! The country is full of runaway slaves nowadays!.

dag: Ka Sintani yi ŋmaligi tuhir omaŋa o ku tooi be, amaa o bahigu n-yɛn bala.
en: If Satan rebels against himself and is divided, then he cant endure. Hes done for.

dag: Ka Jɔab min o niriba zaa daa kana ti teei gili Ɛbɛl Bɛtimaaka n-kɔri taŋkpaɣu duhiduhi gili tiŋ maa ka di du nti saɣisi di gooni zuɣusaa, ka gbiri di gbinni ni bɛ daai li luhi.
