en: Then Joabs men arrived and attacked Sheba at Abel of Beth-maacah. They piled up a ramp against the city, and it stood against the outer wall. All of Joabs troops were hammering the wall, trying to bring it down.

dag: Ka di lan sabi yɛli, Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka doo ŋmaligir o ba min o ma sani n-zaŋd omaŋ tabind o paɣa.
en: And for this reason a man will leave his father and mother and unite with his wife.

dag: Ka Pita daa ka Yisa sanna ti bɔh o, N Duuma, bula ka m mabia lee yɛn tum ma taali ka n kul chɛri paŋd o? N chɛli paŋ o hal ti paai ʒii buyopɔin.
en: Peter came up to the Lord and asked, How many times should I forgive someone who does something wrong to me? Is seven times enough.

dag: O pun yɛli nyin daadam binshɛli din viɛla. Ka bɔ ka Yawɛ lee bɔri ni a niŋ? O bɔri ni a doli din tuhi, ka yuri nirilim niŋbu, ka jɛmd a Naawuni ni siɣisimaŋtali.
en: The Lord God has told us what is right and what he demands: See that justice is done, let mercy be your first concern, and humbly obey your God.

dag: Sokam mi o yidana tiŋ maa dunɔdaya gbini, ka o mini tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni kpamba laɣindi ʒiina.
en: Her husband is well known, one of the leading citizens.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa yiɣisi Ɛlim n-chaŋ ti kpe Sin tiŋgban nɛli din daa be Ɛlim mini Sinai sunsuuni la ni gol so ŋun daa pahir ayi bɛ Ijipti yibu maa nyaaŋa biɛɣ pinaanu dali.
en: The whole Israelite community set out from Elim, and on the fifteenth day of the second month after they had left Egypt, they came to the desert of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai.

dag: Dama so na mi n-yɛli Naawuni, N nyɛla alahichilana, amaa n ku lan tum lala yaha.
en: Job, have you confessed your sins to God and promised not to sin again?.

dag: N ni ŋmaligi lu yi zuɣu; n ni nyahi ya ka yi yi daɣiri ni kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi buɣim maani anzinfa ka di yiri shɛm la.
en: and I will turn my hand against you. I will refine your impurities as with lye, and remove all your cinders.

dag: Suhu m-mi biɛrim shɛli din be di ni, ka di mini zino ku tooi laɣim mali di suhupiɛlli.
en: The heart knows its own distress; another person cant share its joy.

dag: Ka o daa tuhi deei bɛ ni me goondahi gili fɔntin shɛŋa Juda tiŋgbɔn ni la zaa m-mali lala hal ni Jɛrusalɛm.
en: He captured the fortified cities of Judah and came toward Jerusalem.

dag: Ka daa ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli, Bundaan so n-daa ko n-nya bindirigu pam.
en: Then Jesus told them this parable: There was once a rich man who had land which bore good crops.

dag: Zalim Izraɛlnim ka bɛ bɔri olivi kpa viɛlli na nti niŋdi firila ni din ni chɛ ka firila maa kul ne n-ʒiɛya sahakam.
en: You must require the Israelites to bring you pure oil of crushed olives for the light so that the lamp may be set up to burn continually.

dag: Naa Ahaz muɣisigu ŋɔ ni daa ti kɔŋ tim saha shɛli o daa maan kpɛla din bie nti yaɣi tumbu ni zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ sani.
en: When his troubles were at their worst, that man Ahaz sinned against the Lord more than ever.

dag: Amaa ka Zɛruya bia Abishai daa kana ti sɔŋ Dauda n-ku Filistia doo maa. Di saha ka Dauda niriba maa daa po pɔri yɛl o, A ku lan doli ti chaŋ tɔb ni, di yi pa lala a ni ti chɛ ka Izraɛlnim firila kpi.
en: But Abishai son of Zeruiah killed this giant Philistine and saved Davids life. Then Davids men made him promise that he would not go out to battle anymore. They said, If you do, Israel might lose its brightest leader.

dag: ni Joɛla mini Zɛbadia bɛn daa nyɛ Jɛrɔham Gɛdɔr nir bihi la.
en: Joelah; and Zebadiah, Jerohams son from Gedor.

dag: Sokam nyɛla jɛra ka ka yɛm. Salima machɛlinim zaa ni di vi bɛ ni mali buɣ shɛŋa la zuɣu; dama bɛ binnana maa nyɛla ʒiri binnana ka bi vuhira.
en: At the sight of this, people feel stupid and senseless; those who make idols are disillusioned because the gods they make are false and lifeless.

dag: N daa to ba la kpani ka di pili yi, ka bɛ lu n naba ni ka kɔŋ yiɣisibu, ka n ku bɛ zaa.
en: I destroyed them! I stuck my sword through my enemies, and they were crushed under my feet.

dag: Ka sagbana daa kpabikpabi kaman gbaŋ la n-wurim zaa, ka zoli kam mini teeku puuni tiŋgban bihi daa vuui di biɛhigu shee.
en: Then the sky was rolled up like a scroll, and all mountains and islands were moved from their places.

dag: Di wɔɣilim din ti yɛn kpalim dolisi luɣ kasi shee la ni ti nyɛla kilomita anu wulimpuhili polo, ka nyɛ kilomita anu wulinluhili polo. Di ni ti do m-baɣila luɣ kasi shee. Di ni atam ni ti nyɛla tiŋ maa ni tumtumdiba bindirigu.
en: The land on the east and west sides of the city limits will be farmland for the people of Jerusalem; both sections will be five kilometers long and three kilometers wide.

dag: Di ni sabi ni ti Duuma san la, kpe ŋɔ di gbinni nyɛla Naawuni Shia sani; ka ti Duuma Shia maa ni be luɣ shɛli, nimaani ka yolisim be.
en: The Lord is the Spirit, and where the Lords Spirit is, there is freedom.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Ka yi yi ti nya ka yɛlibiɛ shɛli din chihira ʒe di ni bi simdi ni di ʒe luɣ shɛli polo, ŋunkam ti karim sabbu ŋɔ, ŋun baŋmi di ni wuhi shɛm! Di saha maa bɛn ti be Judia, bɛn zom ti du zoya.
en: When you see the disgusting and destructive thing standing where it shouldnt be , then those in Judea must escape to the mountains.

dag: A yi nyɛ tarima m-be nandaamba sani, di so ni a mini karimbaannim pirigiri bɛ ni ŋmɛri diri neen shɛŋa.
en: It is better to be a humble person living among the poor than to share the wealth among the proud.

dag: Yisa ni daa ka o nyaandoliba maa sanna saha shɛli maa o nyaandoliba pinaayi la ni yino ŋun daa nyɛ jaa, ka o yuli booni Tomas la daa ka o tab maa sani.
en: Although Thomas the Twin was one of the twelve disciples, he wasn't with the others when Jesus appeared to them.

dag: Ka o yiɣisi lihi nya ka bɛ ni she mahi kpil shɛli kuɣ tula zuɣu mini kɔgaɣili n-ʒe o zuɣu polo. Ka o daa di ka nyu, ka lan lab dɔni.
en: Elijah looked around, and by his head was a jar of water and some baked bread. He sat up, ate and drank, then lay down and went back to sleep.

dag: Ka chɛrubinim maa kpiŋkpama ti yirigi zuɣusaa, ka di mahim luri yɔrigu maa zuɣu, ka bɛ nina kpa taba. Yɔrigu maa polo ka bɛ nina ti yɛn kpa.
en: The winged creatures are to face each other across the lid, and their outspread wings are to cover it.

dag: Kaman Yawɛ ni daa kul chɛ ka zuliya shɛb bɛn be yi tooni kpiri shɛm la, lala ka yi gba yɛn kpi, yi ni zaɣisi ni yi ku wum Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yɛligu maa zuɣu.
en: The Lord is destroying other nations for you. But if you stop listening to the Lord your God, you will be destroyed just like them!.

dag: Ka Utai mini Zakur mi daa nyɛ Biɣivai daŋ zuɣulaannima, ka dɔbba pisopɔin daa pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: from the descendants of Bigvai: Uthai, Zaccur, and other men.

dag: Doo bee paɣ yi ti po pɔri din nyɛ Nazari pɔri ni o wolig omaŋ ti Yawɛ.
en: to give the following instructions to the people of Israel. Any of you, male or female, who make a special vow to become a nazirite and dedicate yourself to the Lord.

dag: Ka n daa wum di yɛla, ka n ni sɔhira, ka n naŋgbampiba ŋmɛri tab di vuri zuɣu, ka n kɔba ni chɔɣisi ka n naba sɔhira. N kul yɛn shinimi ka guhiri dahin shɛli mbusim ni ti yɛn lu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kana ti liri ti maa zuɣu.
en: I hear and my insides tremble. My lips quiver at the sound. Rottenness enters my bones. I tremble while I stand, while I wait for the day of distress to come against the people who attack us.

dag: Ka niriba daa nya o, ka bo nachimba pihita n-chɛ ka bɛ kana ti be o sani.
en: When the Philistines saw that he was having a party, they sent men to be with him.

dag: A yi tarigi yɛl biɛɣu nyabu dali, a yaa m-pun bi galisi.
en: If you are weak in a crisis, you are weak indeed.

dag: Nyama, buɣim pun yi zuɣusaa na ti di n-ku sapashinnima ayi la mini bɛ tɔbbihi pihinunu, amaa tiligim man nyɛvili.
en: Fire has already wiped out the other officers and their soldiers. Please don't let it happen to me.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛɣu deeri birapu ashilɔni ni di chɛ ka o taɣi zaligu soya.
en: Corrupt judges accept secret bribes, and then justice is not done.

dag: ni Dan ni Yisifu ni Bɛnjamin ni Naftali ni Gaad ni Asha.
en: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

dag: n-chani kpaŋsiri Yisa nyaandoliba suhuri ka kpamdi ba jaande ni bɛ kul gbibi yɛda, ka yɛli ba ni nir yi bɔri ni o kpe Naawuni nam ni, o ni bahi di wahala.
en: they strengthened the disciples and urged them to remain firm in the faith. They told them, If we are to enter Gods kingdom, we must pass through many troubles.

dag: Dinzuɣu m bi ʒe a nyaaŋa, ka bi ʒe a kɔsoya maa nyaaŋa, n ni chɛ ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ zaa bahi yoli n-leei dabari, zaŋ Migidol hal ni Sine n-zaŋ hal ti paai Itiɔpia tintariga.
en: Im against you and against the Niles canals. I will make the land of Egypt into an utter ruin, a wasteland, from Migdol to Syene and as far as its boundary with Cush.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa kalila Musa ŋun daa nyɛ Naawuni nir la bidibisi pahi Lɛvinim ni.
en: Moses, the man of God, was the father of Gershom and Eliezer, and their descendants were considered Levites.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ba, M Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ ni bi sa ti shɛlikam ni vuɣi lu.
en: Every plant which my Father in heaven did not plant will be pulled up, answered Jesus.

dag: Yi yi gbibi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ fukumsi zaligunima, ka dol o soli, ŋun Yawɛ ni zaŋ ya leeg o niriba bɛn be kasi kaman o ni daa po pɔri yɛli ya shɛm la.
en: If you obey the Lord your God and do everything he commands, he will make you his own people, as he has promised.

dag: Ka Yaakubu yɛli Firawuna, N ni gɔri gindi ŋɔ, n yuma nyɛla yuun kɔbiga ni pihita. N yuma maa mini di dabisa bi galisi, amaa ka yɛl biɛri lee be di puuni. Di bi be kaman yuma mini dabisa shɛŋa n yaannim ni daa zaŋ gɔri gindi la.
en: Jacob said to Pharaoh, Ive been a traveler for years. My years have been few and difficult. They dont come close to the years my ancestors lived during their travels.

dag: A nyuɣu bela polipoli kaman pipi shɛli din puuni na ʒi n-kɔŋ wain shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋ gab taba. A puli ŋmanila alikama mɔri din laɣisi puya, ka paɣiviɛligakushihikom ʒe n-gil li.
en: your navel is a wine glass filled to overflowing. Your body is full and slender like a bundle of wheat bound together by lilies.

dag: Ka kpamba pisinaanahi bɛn daa ʒi bɛ nam ʒiishɛhi Naawuni tooni la gbani n-jɛmdi Naawuni.
en: Then the elders bowed down on their faces and worshiped God. These are the elders who sit on their thrones before God.

dag: Ifriimnima, buɣa bukaata lee nyɛ bɔ yi sani? Mani n-nyɛ ŋun wumdi yi suhigu, ka lihiri ya. N ŋmanila sipirɛs tia din vari kul mahi ʒiɛya sahakam la. Yi bidɔɣiligu yirila n kɔbili ni na.
en: Ephraim, what do idols have to do with me? It is I who answer and look after you. I am like a green cypress tree; your fruit comes from me.

dag: Ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdib mini Farisiinim daa kpahindi Yisa ni bɛ nya o ni tib o Vuhim Dabisili dali maa bee o ku tib o, dama bɛ daa bɔri ni bɛ nyala o taali ka fiɣis o.
en: Some teachers of the Law and some Pharisees wanted a reason to accuse Jesus of doing wrong, so they watched him closely to see if he would heal on the Sabbath.

dag: O daa chɛ ka kum gbahi ya, ka yi siɣisi yimaŋa ka o zaŋ manna dihi ya, din daa nyɛ yi mini yi yaannim ni ʒi shɛli ni di chɛ ka yi baŋ ni pa bindirigu kɔŋko n-chɛ ka daadam be, amaa yɛtɔɣili kam din yiri Yawɛ nol ni na n-chɛ ka daadam be.
en: He humbled you by making you hungry and then feeding you the manna that neither you nor your ancestors had ever experienced, so he could teach you that people dont live on bread alone. No, they live based on whatever the LORD says.

dag: Wuntizɔriba bɛn ti ninvuɣ biɛɣu soli ŋmanila kɔbilinini din bilisiri ko biɛɣu bee bɛ ni saɣim kɔbil shɛli kom.
en: A righteous person giving in to the wicked is like a contaminated spring or a polluted fountain.

dag: N Duuma, ka pumpɔŋɔ bɔ ka n lee lan guhira? Kulla a sani ka m mali tahima.
en: What am I waiting for? I depend on you, Lord!.

dag: Yawɛ wumdi nandaamba suhigu, ka bi tamd o niriba bɛn be sarika ni yɛla.
en: The Lord listens to those in need and does not forget his people in prison.

dag: Ka bɛ daa dii chɛ bɛ lansi maa ka dol o.
en: At once they left their nets and went with him.

dag: N daa di yi zuɣu nyɔri n ni daa tim shɛb yi sanna la ni?.
en: How? Did I take advantage of you through any of the messengers I sent?.

dag: Yinim Samarianima, n zaɣisi yi naɣibil maa. N suhu yiɣisiya pam bahi yi zuɣu. Bɔ saha ka yi lee yɛn tooi yi taali ni?.
en: City of Samaria, I'm angry because of your idol in the shape of a calf. When will you ever be innocent again?.

dag: O chɛ ka n noli bemi kaman takɔbi dirili la. O daa zaŋ ma sɔɣila o nuu mahim ka daa chɛ ka m be kaman peen dirili la, ka o zaŋ ma su o lɔɣu ni.
en: He made my words pierce like a sharp sword or a pointed arrow; he kept me safely hidden in the palm of his hand.

dag: Ka Naa Zɛdɛkia daa tim Shɛlɛmia bia Jɛhukal mini Maasɛya bia Zɛfania ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana la anabi Jɛrimia sani ni bɛ ti yɛl o, Jaande, suhimi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ti ti.
en: King Zedekiah sent Jehucal son of Shelemiah and the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah to Jeremiah the prophet with a message. This was the message they brought to Jeremiah: Jeremiah, pray to the Lord our God for us.

dag: Di saha maa ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa wum Yisa yuli dubu yɛla.
en: About this time Herod the ruler heard the news about Jesus.

dag: Asiba kam, n ni ku ninvuɣ biɛri zaa tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni. N ni yihi tuumbiɛtumdiba zaa Yawɛ tiŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Every morning I will destroy all those who are wicked in the land in order to eliminate all evildoers from the LORDs city.

dag: Di bɔhiya so biɛri, amaa tummiyala din viɛla ka sokam zaa nya.
en: Dont pay back anyone for their evil actions with evil actions, but show respect for what everyone else believes is good.

dag: Ka bɛ daa nya ka di sabi Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ zaligu shɛli ti Musa ni o ti niriba maa la puuni ni Izraɛlnim yi ti yɛn puhi chuɣ shɛli bɛ ni puhiri chira ayopɔin ni la, bɛn be suɣa ni.
en: They discovered that the Law, which the Lord gave through Moses, ordered the people of Israel to live in temporary shelters during the Festival of Shelters.

dag: Do so daa be Siizaria ka o yuli booni Kɔniilius. O daa nyɛla sapashini n-su tɔbbi shɛb bɛ ni daa booni Italinim Bɔŋ la.
en: There was a man in Caesarea named Cornelius, who was a captain in the Roman army regiment called The Italian Regiment.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n ni yiɣisi n suhu pam bahi yi zuɣu. N ni kari ya saria kaman yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm, ka darigi yi tibili yi ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa zaa zuɣu.
en: Very soon now, I will show you how angry I am. I will show all of my anger against you. I will punish you for the evil things you did. I will make you pay for all the terrible things you did.

dag: Ka Musa suhu daa yiɣisi bahi sapashin kpamba bɛn daa yi tɔb maa ni na ka nyɛ bɛn su tɔbbihi tuhilituhili mini bɛn su tɔbbihi kɔbigakɔbiga fukumsi la zuɣu.
en: Moses was very angry with the leaders of the army, the commanders of men, and the commanders of men, who came back from the war.

dag: Dinzuɣu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ yɛda pahila ti yab Ibrahimma ŋun daa niŋ yɛda maa zuɣu nya alibarika.
en: Abraham believed and was blessed; so all who believe are blessed as he was.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ bɛ wuna din pa Naawuni n-chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi, ka zaŋ bɛ buɣa n-chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi. Lala ka n yɛn chɛ ka bɛn pa niriba niŋ ba ka bɛ suhuri yiɣisi, ka chɛ ka zuliya shɛb bɛn nyɛ jɛra niŋ ba ka bɛ suhuri yiɣisi.
en: They provoked me with no-gods, aggravated me with their pieces of junk. So I am going to provoke them with No-People, aggravate them with a nation of fools.

dag: Naa suhu yi yiɣisi bah a zuɣu, nyin di yɛli ni a lan je o tuma, dama a yi gbaag amaŋ be balim, di ni ku taali maa.
en: If your ruler becomes angry with you, do not hand in your resignation; serious wrongs may be pardoned if you keep calm.

dag: Zibiɔn bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Aiya mini Ana ŋun daa gul o ba Zibiɔn bunsi ka ti nya kɔbilisirim mɔɣu ni la.
en: Zibeon had two sons, Aiah and Anah. Anah is the man who found the springs in the desert while he was caring for his fathers donkeys.

dag: Chɛ ka n gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du n-chaŋ ti nya zoya ni tiŋgban viɛlli din be duli maa mini Lɛbanɔn.
en: The land west of the Jordan is such good land. Please let me cross the Jordan and see the hills and the Lebanon Mountains.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa dari yuri Ijipti mini Silisia tiŋgbana ni, ka naa kɔhigɔriba daa dari ba Silisia na kaman bɛ daa ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Solomon imported horses from Egypt and Kue. His merchants bought the horses in Kue for a set price.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛl o niriba maa, Sokam nyaɣim o takɔbi! Ka Dauda gba daa nyaɣ o takɔbi; ka niriba kɔbisinahi daa pah o zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ, ka chɛ niriba kɔbisiyi ka bɛ mi kpalim guli bɛ nɛma.
en: Davids response was, Put on your swords. So David and his men put on their swords. About men went with David while of them stayed with the supplies.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, N gba ni bɔhi ya bɔhigu ka yi garigi ma.
en: Jesus answered, I will ask you a question too. Tell me:.

dag: Dama Naa Dauda gba daa tɔɣisi ŋun Yisa yɛla n-yɛli: N kul nyarila n Duuma n sani sahakam; o bela n nudirigu polo ni di chɛ ka n suhu ku zɔhira:.
en: For David said about him, I saw the Lord before me at all times; he is near me, and I will not be troubled.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa daa chaŋ ti niŋ o ni yɛli ba shɛm maa, ka mali Yaɣigari Chuɣu maa bindirigu dibu shili.
en: The disciples did as Jesus had told them and prepared the Passover meal.

dag: Ka ŋun yur o ba bee o ma gari ma, o bi simdi ni o doli ma; ka ŋun yur o bidibiga bee o bipuɣiŋga gari ma, o bi simdi ni o doli ma.
en: If you love your father or mother or even your sons and daughters more than me, you are not fit to be my disciples.

dag: ni binyɛr viɛl shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn yɛri tumdi tuma luɣ kasi shee mini Aduna ŋun nyɛ maligumaana binyɛra din be kasi ni o bidibisi ni yɛn yɛri binyɛr shɛŋa tumdi maligumaaniba tuma.
en: and the magnificent garments the priests are to wear when they serve in the Holy Place—the sacred clothes for Aaron the priest and for his sons.

dag: Ka Ɛr daa nyɛ Jɔshua bia, ka Jɔshua nyɛ Ɛliɛza bia, ka Ɛliɛza nyɛ Jɔrim bia, ka Jɔrim nyɛ Matat so bia, ka Matat maa mi nyɛ Lɛvi so bia.
en: son of Joshua son of Eliezer son of Jorim son of Matthat son of Levi.

dag: Ka di gari bɛnkam zaa daa wum o baŋsim yɛtɔɣa min o ni daa garigiri ba shɛm maa.
en: Everyone who heard him was surprised at how much he knew and at the answers he gave.

dag: hal ka Yawɛ daa ti kari bɛn Izraɛlnim maa bahi kaman o ni daa pun chɛ ka o daba bɛn nyɛ anabinim yɛli shɛm la. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa gbahi Izraɛlnim bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-kuli Asiria tiŋgbɔŋ ni; ka bɛ na kul be nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: until at last the Lord banished them from his sight, as he had warned through his servants the prophets that he would do. So the people of Israel were taken into exile to Assyria, where they still live.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Ɛlikana daa lab kul o ya Rama, ka bia maa daa be Ɛli ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana maa sani n-tumdi Yawɛ tuma.
en: Then Elkanah went back home to Ramah, but the boy Samuel stayed in Shiloh and served the Lord under the priest Eli.

dag: Yi ŋmanila mɔɣu ni buŋa ŋun be tiŋgban nɛli ni. O yi ti kpabigi, o ʒiɛmi taɣiri ʒiɛɣu, ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yih o kɔre maa ni? Bɛnkam bɔr o bi lan yɛn nahim bɛmaŋa, o bɔbu goli yi zani, bɛ ni nya o.
en: You are a female donkey sniffing the desert air, wanting to mate with just anyone. You are an easy catch!.

dag: Nyama, ŋunkam ŋahiri ŋaha, ni ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ zaŋ chaŋ a polo yɛli, Ma ni be shɛm lala ka o bipuɣiŋga gba be.
en: The Lord said, People will use this proverb about you, Jerusalem: Like mother, like daughter.

dag: Dɔbba ŋɔ mi nyɛla bɛn tɛha bie ni bɛn yɛda niŋbu pa alali. Janeez mini Jambireez ni daa chihi Anabi Musa yɛligu shɛm la, lala ka bɛ gba chihiri din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli;.
en: As Jannes and Jambres were opposed to Moses, so also these people are opposed to the truth—people whose minds do not function and who are failures in the faith.

dag: Kaman nir ni ku tooi kali saŋmarisi bɛn be zuɣusaa ŋɔ bee teeku noli bihigu shɛm, lala ka n yɛn chɛ ka n dabili Dauda zuliya mini Lɛvinim bɛn tumdi n tuma maa nabi.
en: and there will be more descendants of David and of the priests from the Levi tribe than stars in the sky or grains of sand on the beach.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi kari doli ma kaman yinima n-nyɛ Naawuni maa? N niŋgbuŋ ni be shɛm ŋɔ kɔŋko bi saɣi lala yi sani?.
en: Hasn't he already done enough? Why do you join the attack?.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa yɛli, Nyama, Yawɛ chu shɛli bɛ ni puhiri yuuni kam la beni, ka bɛ ni puhi li Shilo din be Bɛtɛl nuzaa polo zaŋ lab wulimpuhili polo solɔɣu din yi Bɛtɛl kuni Shɛkɛm, ka be Lɛbɔna nudirigu polo la.
en: Then they thought, The yearly festival of the Lord at Shiloh is coming soon.

dag: ni buɣijɛmbo ni baɣibuɣibo ni dimdi ni zabili ni nyuli zabbu ni suhuyiɣisili ni zunyuŋ ni naŋgbankpeeni ni tab woligibu.
en: in worship of idols and witchcraft. People become enemies and they fight; they become jealous, angry, and ambitious. They separate into parties and groups;.

dag: Yawɛ bɔhiri ya, N nyɛla Naawuni ŋun kul be yomayoma ka pa Naawuni ŋun be katiŋ gba.
en: This message is from the Lord . I am God, and I am always near. I am not far away.

dag: Ka gbani tiŋ kuhi yɛli, N Duuma, chɛli niriba ŋɔ daalahichi ŋɔ paŋ ba. O ni daa yɛl lala naai ka dii bahi.
en: He knelt down and shouted, Lord, don't blame them for what they have done. Then he died.

dag: Yi ni daa yi Ijipti na saha shɛl la ka n daa pun lɔnya alikauli ni n kul ni be yi sani. Di zɔriya dabiɛm. .
en: just as I promised your ancestors when I brought them out of Egypt. Don't worry. My Spirit is right here with you.

dag: Zuɣulaannim bɛn nyɛ karimbaannim maa jilima la ni ti kpaai kaman fiig tihi walibu saha tiwal shɛŋa din daŋ moobu ni yi luna ka bɛ pihi li, ka di nuu ni paabu n-to ka bɛ pun di li la.
en: The withered flower, which is a thing of beauty as it sits on the head of those bloated with fat, will be like an early fig before the summer harvest: whoever sees it swallows it as soon as it is in hand.

dag: Ka so yi zaŋ o ni da pu shɛli ti Yawɛ, ka di pala o ni di tiŋgban shɛli fali yaɣ shɛli palo.
en: If you dedicate to the Lord a field that you have bought.

dag: Ka Izraɛl paɣisara chani yuuni kam ti zaŋdi daba anahi fabindi Jɛfita Giliad nir la bipuɣiŋga maa zuɣu.
en: every year, Israelite girls walk around for four days, weeping for Jephthah's daughter.

dag: Saha shɛli Yaakubu ni daa chaŋ ti ʒini Ijipti ka Ijiptinim maa daa ti muɣisiri ba ka bɛ fabili niŋ Yawɛ la, ka o daa tim Musa mini Aduna ka bɛ ti yihi yi yaannim maa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni n-zaŋ ba na ti ʒili kpe ŋɔ.
en: After Jacob went to Egypt, your ancestors cried out to the Lord for help, and he sent Moses and Aaron. They brought your ancestors out of Egypt and led them here to settle this land.

dag: Ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ wuhi ni o nyɛla wuntizɔra ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: This has been remembered in his favor ever since and will be for all time to come.

dag: Daadam ni tooi lo nianim pam o suhu ni, amaa Yawɛ ni yu shɛli n-niŋda.
en: Many plans are in a persons mind, but the LORDs purpose will succeed.

dag: Ka o daa lan lu Dauda sizuura ka yɛli, Ka mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ mi lee nyɛ ŋuni, ka a ti lihi nya mani ŋun nyɛ ba kpiŋ ŋɔ lala.
en: Mephibosheth knelt down again and said, Why should you care about me? I'm worth no more than a dead dog.

dag: A mini bɛn laɣim tum tuma a bilim ni hal ni pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ ni yɛn tooi niŋ shɛli ti a zaa m-bala. Bɛ zaa ni chɛ a ka zaŋ kpa bɛ ni chani shɛli polo, ka bɛ so ku tooi tilig a.
en: That is all the good they will do you— those astrologers you've consulted all your life. They all will leave you and go their own way, and none will be left to save you.

dag: Amaa ka jintɔriba maa ni yino ŋun daa nyɛ Farisii, ka o yuli booni Gamaliɛl ka o daa nyɛ Naawuni fukumsi zaligu karimba so sokam ni tiri jilima la daa yiɣisi zani n-yɛli ni bɛ na zaŋmi Yisa tuumba maa yi kpaŋ pɔi.
en: But one member of the council, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, stood up. He was a teacher of the law, and all the people respected him. He told the men to make the apostles leave the meeting for a few minutes.

dag: O tɔbbihi laɣimmina, nti gbi bɔɣa do n-guli ma. Bɛ teei gilila n yili.
en: He sends his army to attack me; they dig trenches and lay siege to my tent.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa baŋ ni o nyaandoliba maa ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni yɛtɔɣili maa zuɣu ka bɔhi ba, Yi suhuri miligimi yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ zuɣu?.
en: Jesus already knew that his followers were complaining about this. So he said, Is this teaching a problem for you?.

dag: O daa ku do shɛb bɛn daa kpalim be o ba Asa ʒiɛman ni, ka nyɛ bɛn laɣim tumdi dagɔr tuma la.
en: Additionally, Jehoshaphat purged the land of the consecrated workers who remained from the days of Asa.

dag: Nolɔɣu kukoli saha ka Samuɛl daa ti boli Sool pii maa zuɣu yɛl o, Yiɣisim ka m biɛl a zali soli. Ka Sool yiɣisi ka o mini Samuɛl daa lu soli.
en: Near dawn, Samuel called to Saul on the roof, Wake up! I will send you on your way. So Saul got up, and the two of them, he and Samuel, went outside.

dag: di nyɛla tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali alikama mini chi ni wain tihi ni fiig tihi ni pumpɔrinchihi tihi. Di lan nyɛla tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali olivi tihi mini shikpam.
en: a land that produces wheat and barley, grapes, figs, pomegranates, olives, and honey.

dag: Samarianim naa ni ti bahi yoli kaman tipɔɣu din pa kom zuɣu la.
en: Samarias false god will be destroyed. It will be like a piece of wood floating away on the waters surface.

dag: Di saha ka Amɔs daa garigi yɛli Amazia, M pala anabi, m mi pala anabi bia; amaa n nyɛla biŋkɔbigula ni ŋun sari fiig tihi.
en: Amos answered Amaziah, I am not a prophet, nor am I a prophets son; but I am a shepherd, and a trimmer of sycamore trees.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda daa yɛli, Bolimiya maligumaana Zadok mini anabi Neetan ni Bɛnaaya Jɛhɔiada bia la ti ma. Ka bɛ daa ka naa sanna.
en: Then David said, Tell Zadok, Nathan, and Benaiah to come here. When they arrived.

dag: Yawɛ ti ma bidibisi pam, ka m bidibisi maa zaa ni, Sulemaana ka Naawuni pii ni o ʒini Yawɛ nam ʒiishee n-su Izraɛlnima.
en: And from all the many sons the LORD has given me, he has chosen my son Solomon to sit on the throne of the LORDs kingdom over Israel.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yiɣisi n-zaŋ o nyaandoliba m-pa omaŋ zuɣu dol o.
en: So Jesus got up and followed him, and his disciples went along with him.

dag: Dinzuɣu piɛguliba, wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm:.
en: So I, the Lord , will punish you! I will rescue my sheep from you and never let you be their shepherd again or butcher them for food. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Bɛtani mini Jɛrusalɛm bi wɔɣa ni taba; di nyɛla kaman mail ayi laasabu.
en: Bethany was about two miles from Jerusalem.

dag: O daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ ni kpe kuɣ shɛŋa m-me zɔŋ kulis ata tam taba, ka zaŋ sida dari n-kpahi li kul yini tam di zuɣu.
en: An inner court was built in front of the Temple, enclosed with walls which had one layer of cedar beams for every three layers of stone.

dag: n-zaŋ suɣilo gbib ba mɔɣu ni kaman yuun pihinahi;.
en: and for forty years he endured them in the desert.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ dabisili din pahir ayopɔin dali daa ti yɛn paai, ka Naawuni pun naai o ni daa nam binshɛɣukam zaa maa tuma; ka vuhi o ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa maa zaa vuhim daba ayopɔin maa dali.
en: By the seventh day God finished what he had been doing and stopped working.

dag: Di saha ka do so ŋun nyɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa gomna maa yɛl ti, Yi ni yɛn niŋ shɛm chɛ ka m baŋ ni yi nyɛla yɛlimaŋyɛriba m-bɔŋɔ: chɛliya yi ni yino n sani, ka zaŋ kawana kuli ti ti yi yiŋnim shɛb kum ni muɣisi maa;.
en: The man, the countrys governor, told us, This is how I will know you are honest men: Leave one of your brothers with me, take grain for those in your households who are hungry, and go.

dag: A yi zab ti zuɣu, ka niriba wum zabili maa damli, bɛ zɔrimi.
en: Nations scatter when you roar and show your greatness.

dag: Dinzuɣu kpahimmiya yi ni be shɛm viɛnyɛliŋga, ka di benya kaman bɛn be ʒilinsi ni, amaa ka lee bemi kaman yɛnnima.
en: Act like people with good sense and not like fools.

dag: ka puu maa nyɛ dunia ŋɔ; ka alikama biɛlin suma maa nyɛ Naawuni nam ni bihi; ka piriŋkpana biɛlim la mi nyɛ Sintani bihi.
en: The field is the world, and the good seeds are the people who belong to the kingdom. The weeds are those who belong to the evil one.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa nyaŋ ba lala hal ni Kadɛshibarinia zaŋ ti paai Gaza zaŋ tabili Goshɛn tiŋgbɔŋ zaa m-mali lala hal ti paai Gibiɔn.
en: Joshua's campaign took him from Kadesh Barnea in the south to Gaza near the coast, including all the area of Goshen, and as far north as Gibeon.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naawuni zuɣu a lan pala dabili, amaa a nyɛla Naawuni bia, ka a yi nyɛla Naawuni bia, dindina a nyɛla ŋun dir o bini.
en: So then, you are no longer a slave but a child. And since you are his child, God will give you all that he has for his children.

dag: Lala ka niriba ŋɔ zahindi zahima, ka di chɛ ka bɛ tumdi niŋgbuŋ kɔr biɛri tuma ka ʒiɛm Naawuni fukumsi subu, ka turi bɛn mali jilima be alizanda ni la.
en: The people I am talking about are behaving just like those dreamers who destroyed their own bodies. They reject all authority and insult angels.

dag: Ka kpiin shɛb bɛn kpalim bɛn bi neei kum ni hal ti paai yuun tuhili maa tariga. Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ kum ni neebu din daŋ tooni la.
en: This is the first resurrection.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa ti chɛ ka bɛ kɔrigi noombil yino niŋ yaɣiri duɣu ni kɔzɔrim kom ni.
en: The priest will order that one bird be slaughtered over fresh water in a pottery jar.

dag: Bɛnkam suhuri ye buni zuɣu, ka zaŋ kiŋkansi bɔrili bahigu ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm m-bala. Di dirila bɛn su li nyɛviya.
en: This is what happens to those who are greedy. Whatever they get destroys them.

dag: Yi tɛhiya ni yi ni tumdi tuun shɛŋa viɛla, amaa di mi ku sɔŋ ya.
en: I will bring evidence about your righteousness and your actions; they wont help you.

dag: M bi suhir a tirila bɛmbɔŋɔ kɔŋko, amaa n suhir a tiri bɛn gba na yɛn niŋ ma yɛda bɛmbɔŋɔ yɛligu wumbu ni la.
en: I am not praying just for these followers. I am also praying for everyone else who will have faith because of what my followers will say about me.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, A tuhi tɔbu pam, ka ku niriba pam, di bi simdi ka a me jɛmbu duu n-ti ma jilima, dama a ku niriba pam dunia ŋɔ ni n ninni.
en: But some time ago, he told me, David, you have killed too many people and have fought too many battles. That's why you are not the one to build my temple.

dag: O daa bi tum tuun kara pam nimaani, bɛ biɛhiŋ maa zuɣu.
en: He was unable to do many miracles there because of their disbelief.

dag: Doliya duno muɣiliŋga kpe, dama so shɛli din kuni bahi yoli shee dolibu be asama ka di dunoli yɛlima, ka niriba pam dol li.
en: You can enter true life only through the narrow gate. The gate to hell is very wide, and there is plenty of room on the road that leads there. Many people go that way.

dag: Dama n yɛri ya mi, faashee yi wuntizɔbo zooi gari Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba mini Farisiinim dini, di yi pa lala yi ti ku kpe alizanda nam ni abada.
en: I tell you that you must do better than the teachers of the law and the Pharisees. If you are not more pleasing to God than they are, you will never enter Gods kingdom.

dag: A daa pahi gili di zaashee ka di nyaɣa ba tiŋa, ka di zooi yɛligi tiŋgbani maa ni.
en: Then you cleared the ground, and we put our roots deep, spreading over the land.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti nya Nataniɛl ka o kan o sanna, o daa yɛlimi, Nyama, n-nyɛ Izraɛl nir alali ŋun ka yɛmbimbiɛri biɛhigu o ni hal baabiɛla.
en: When Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, he said about him, Here is a real Israelite; there is nothing false in him.

dag: A ni niŋdi laasabu shɛŋa la zaa yoli, a gbarigiya. Chɛ ka bɛn mi zuɣusaa yɛla tilig a, ka chɛ ka saŋmaribaŋdiba bɛn mi zuɣusaa yɛla yɛl a goli kam puuni binshɛŋa din yɛn niŋ a.
en: You have worn yourself out, asking for advice from those who study the stars and tell the future month after month. Go ask them how to be saved from what will happen.

dag: Leeban daa lan yɛli, A yi nahim m bipuɣinsi ŋɔ bee a yi kpuɣi paɣiba pahi bɛ zuɣu, ka n ʒi di yɛla, nyin teemi ni Naawuni n nyɛ m min a shɛhiralana.
en: Then Laban said, If you hurt my daughters, remember that God will punish you. If you marry other women, remember that God is watching.

dag: Nir yi niŋ binshɛli tahima ka ti bi nya li, di damdila o suhu, amaa nir yi bɔri shɛli ka nya li, di nyɛla nyɛvili tia.
en: Hope that is delayed makes you sad, but a wish that comes true fills you with joy.

dag: A me binshɛŋa din dundu maa zali solɔɣu kam zuɣu, ka zaŋ a viɛlim maa tum pagɔrisigu tuma. A zaŋ amaŋ ti ninvuɣ so ŋunkam garita, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka a pagɔrisigu tuma maa galisi pam.
en: You dragged your beauty through the mud. You offered yourself to everyone who came by, and you were more of a prostitute every day.

dag: Paɣiba ni paɣ viɛlli, a yura maa bela o ko ka chɛ shɛba? Bɔ ka a yura maa lee zaŋ gar o taba ka a ti yɛli ti lala?.
en: Beautiful woman, how is your lover different from other lovers? Is your lover better than other lovers? Is that why you ask us to make this promise?.

dag: M mini bɛn be n sani yi ti kul piɛb ti kikahi; yi gba yin piɛbimiya yi kikahi bɛ sansani maa luɣilikam zaa ka kuhi yɛli, Tuhimiya ti Yawɛ mini Gidiɔn.
en: When my group and I blow our trumpets, then you blow yours all around the camp and shout, For the Lord and for Gideon.

dag: Di saha ka shia daa kpuɣi ma zuɣusaa, ka Yawɛ jilima daa yiɣisi di biɛhigu shee, ka n daa wum vuri pam n nyaaŋa.
en: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard a voice behind me. It was very loud, like thunder. It said, Blessed is the Glory of the Lord .

dag: O yi ti kana, yin deemiy o kaman Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda ni deeri niriba shɛm ti Duuma zuɣu la; ka o yi ti bɔri shɛli yi sani, yin sɔŋmiy o, dama o nyɛla ŋun sɔŋ niriba pam zaŋ tabili mmaŋmaŋ gba.
en: Welcome her in the Lord in a way that is worthy of Gods people, and give her whatever she needs from you, because she herself has been a sponsor of many people, myself included.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa laɣim Naa Sulemaana sanna Ɛtanim gol ni ŋun nyɛ goli so ŋun pahir ayopɔin la puuni chuɣu dali.
en: They all assembled during the Festival of Shelters in the seventh month, in the month of Ethanim.

dag: Nyama, ti vihi dimbɔŋɔ nya, di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. Wummi li, ka baŋ li amaŋmaŋa.
en: Job, we have learned this by long study. It is true, so now accept it.

dag: Daadam, wula ka tuŋ din be tibɔŋ ni wulli lee yɛn tooi gari tia wulli tibɔŋ maa ni?.
en: Son of man, are the pieces of wood from a grapevine any better than the little branches cut from trees in the forest?.

dag: Kɔra bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Asir mini Ɛlikana ni Abiasaf. Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Kɔra daŋ niriba.
en: Korah's sons were Assir, Elkanah, and Abiasaph.

dag: Dinzuɣu, poloya ŋɔ zaa ni yi a min a yiŋnim zaa yinsi, ka lan yi a kpamba min a niriba zaa yinsi. Bɛ ni bela Nail Mɔɣili la ni kɔŋko.
en: and frogs will no longer be found anywhere, except in the Nile.

dag: Labisimiya yi tɛha zali di zaashee, ka di lan tumdiya alahichi yaha. Di nyɛla vi zaŋ chaŋ yi polo ni n yɛli ni yi ni shɛb bi mi Naawuni yɛla baabiɛla.
en: Sober up by acting like you should and dont sin. Some of you are ignorant about God—I say this because you should be ashamed of yourselves!.

dag: Ka ti ni mali maligumaani titali ŋun su Naawuni jɛmbu duu fukumsi la zuɣu.
en: and we have a great high priest over Gods house.

dag: Naawuni duya nti ʒini o nam ʒiishee ni tahigu. Yawɛ duya ni kikaa kumsi.
en: God goes up to his throne. There are shouts of joy and the blast of trumpets, as the Lord goes up.

dag: N ku niŋ n suhu ni yiɣisi ka n yɛn niŋ shɛm maa. N ku lan ku Ifriimnim yaha, dama m pala daadam, n nyɛla Naawuni. Mani ŋun be kasi ŋɔ be yi sunsuuni, ka n ku kana ni n ti ku niriba.
en: Israel, I won't lose my temper and destroy you again. I am the Holy God— not merely some human, and I won't stay angry.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be teeku duli mini bɛn be katiŋa, wummiya! Yawɛ daa pun pii ma ka bɛ na bi dɔɣi ma; n daa na bela m ma pul ni, ka o pun boli n yuli.
en: Hear me, people by the sea. Listen to me, you faraway nations. The Lord called me before I was born. He called my name while I was still in my mothers womb.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai Atad kabɔɣili din be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili dul la shee, ka bɛ daa duhi bɛ yee n-kum nandahima kumsi nimaani; ka Yisifu daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ daba ayopɔin kum o ba kuli nimaani.
en: When they came to the threshing place at Atad east of the Jordan, they mourned loudly for a long time, and Joseph performed mourning ceremonies for seven days.

dag: Ŋuna n-saɣindi yɛmbimbiɛrinim ni lo nia ni bɛ tum tuun shɛli, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ nuhi bi diri nasara.
en: God swiftly traps the wicked.

dag: Dama Yawɛ daa yɛlila Musa, Yɛlim Izraɛlnim maa, Yi nyɛla tipawumlinima, n yi lan doli ya biɛla pahi n ni ti kun ya. Dinzuɣu yihimiya salima nɛma din be yi ni, ka m baŋ n ni yɛn niŋ ya shɛm. .
en: For the Lord had commanded Moses to tell them, You are a stubborn people. If I were to go with you even for a moment, I would completely destroy you. Now take off your jewelry, and I will decide what to do with you.

dag: Lamɛk ni daa dɔɣi Nuhu maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinu ni pihiwɛinaanu, ka lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: After Noah was born, Lamech lived years and had other sons and daughters.

dag: Ka Tomas kuhi yɛli, N Duuma ni n Naawuni.
en: Thomas said to Jesus, My Lord and my God.

dag: Di saha ka Iso daa zaŋ o paɣiba min o bidibisi ni o bipuɣinsi ni o yiŋ niriba zaa ni o niɣi min o biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn pahi zaa ni o ni daa bo n-nya binshɛɣukam zaa Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni n-yiɣisi chaŋ ti ʒini tiŋgban shɛl ni ha ka chɛ o tizo Yaakubu.
en: Esau took his wives, his sons, his daughters, and everyone in his household, and his livestock, all of his animals, and all of the property he had acquired in the land of Canaan; and he moved away from the land of Canaan and from his brother Jacob.

dag: bɛ ni daa zaɣisi n zalikpana la mini n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi, ka saɣim n vuhim dabisa la zuɣu. Dama bɛ suhuri daa kul bela bɛ buɣa jɛmbu ni.
en: The people of Israel refused to obey my rules or to follow my laws. They treated my days of rest as if they were not important. They did all these things because their hearts belonged to their filthy idols.

dag: Mɔɣisim n kpariŋ; a yurilim so wain.
en: If only he would give me some of his kisses ... Oh, your loving is sweeter than wine!.

dag: Hal bɛ yi ti zoori kaman momaha la, Yawɛ pɔhim ni yi wulimpuhili polo mɔɣu ni na nti ʒe nyuui bɛ kɔbilnina, ka bɛ kɔzɔrima nyuui. Ka di ʒe bɛ tiŋgbani maa ni daazichi zaa chaŋ.
en: No matter if you prosper more than the other tribes, I, the Lord , will wipe you out, just as a scorching desert wind dries up streams of water. I will take away your precious treasures.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa daa chaŋ fɔŋ maa ni nti shiri nya Yisa ni yɛli ba shɛm maa zaa, ka mali Yaɣigari Chuɣu maa bindirigu dibu shili.
en: The disciples left, came into the city, found everything just as he had told them, and they prepared the Passover meal.

dag: Nyini n-wuhi ma so shɛŋa din kuni nyɛvili shee, ka chɛ ka n suhu paligi zaa, n ni be a san la zuɣu. .
en: You taught me how to live. You will come close to me and give me great joy. Psalm :-.

dag: Ka Ɛlikana min o yiŋnim maa daa daŋ yiɣisibu asiba n-jɛm Yawɛ ka lab kuli bɛ ya Rama. Ka Ɛlikana min o paɣ Hanna daa ti dɔni, ka Yawɛ teei Hanna yɛla.
en: The next morning Elkanah and his family got up early, and after worshiping the Lord , they went back home to Ramah. Elkanah had intercourse with his wife Hannah, and the Lord answered her prayer.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛl niriba maa naa ni mali so shɛŋa min o talahi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm. Ka daa sab li niŋ litaafi ni n-zaŋ li ti sɔŋ Yawɛ tooni. Di saha ka Samuɛl daa bahi niriba maa zaa ka bɛ wurim, ka sokam kul o ya.
en: Samuel explained the rules of the kingdom to the people. He wrote the rules in a book and put the book before the Lord . Then Samuel told the people to go home.

dag: Filistianim ni daa fa Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa, bɛ daa zaŋ li yi Ɛbɛnɛza n-tahila Ashidɔd.
en: After the Philistines took Gods chest, they brought it from Ebenezer to Ashdod.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa me sara maligu bimbini zali nimaani jɛm Yawɛ, ka zaŋ o tanti suɣili kpa nimaani. Ka o tumtumdiba daa lan gbi kɔbil shɛli nimaani yaha.
en: Isaac built an altar there and worshiped the Lord . Then he set up camp, and his servants started digging a well.

dag: Ka Dauda mini Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa kuli Jɛrusalɛm din yuli daa lan nyɛ Jɛbusi la, dama nimaani ka Jɛbusinim daa be, bɛna n-daa nyɛ di tiŋbihi.
en: King David and all the Israelites went and attacked the city of Jerusalem. It was then known as Jebus, and the Jebusites, the original inhabitants of the land, were still living there.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ ŋun pɔri Yisa nyaandoliba zaa ni, amaa di zaa yoli, Naawuni pii ma, ka ti ma soli ni n zaŋ lahibal suŋ din nyɛ Masia daazichi din ka buɣisibu la yihi ti bɛn pa Yɛhudianima.
en: I am the least important of all Gods people. But he gave me this gift—to tell the non-Jewish people the Good News about the riches Christ has. These riches are too great to understand fully.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ n na zaŋdila pini tahiri Jɛrusalɛm ni n ti sɔŋ Yisa nyaandoliba.
en: Right now, however, I am going to Jerusalem in the service of God's people there.

dag: a noli ni yɛtɔɣa maa ni leei zana bar a, ka a noli ni yɛtɔɣa maa ni gbaag a.
en: Then you are trapped by your own words.

dag: Ka sapashini maa daa zaŋ o tahi sapashin kpɛm maa sani ti yɛl o, Dansarika so ŋun yuli booni Pool la m-boli ma nti yɛli ma ni n zaŋ nachimbil ŋɔ tahi a sanna ni o malila yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni o yɛl a.
en: He took him to the commander and said, The prisoner Paul asked me to bring this young man to you. He has something to tell you.

dag: Ka o yɛli, Iin, Alaafee; N kamina ni n ti mali sara ti Yawɛ, malimiya yimaŋa n-kana ti pahi n zuɣu sara maligu maa shee. Ka o daa chɛ ka Jɛsi min o bidibisi gba mali bɛmaŋa, ka o boli ba ni bɛ ka sara maligu maa shee na.
en: Yes, Samuel answered. Ive come to make a sacrifice to the LORD. Now make yourselves holy, then come with me to the sacrifice. Samuel made Jesse and his sons holy and invited them to the sacrifice as well.

dag: Puuni duu maa daa malila duno jaba, ka luɣ kasi shee la gba mali duno jaba.
en: Both the Holy Place and the Most Holy Place had a double door.

dag: Ka dilan yi nyɛla faralana, nyin di chɛ ka o chinchin shɛli a ni deei sɔŋ maa gbe a sani.
en: Moreover, if the person is poor, you are not allowed to sleep in their pawned coat.

dag: Bɛ ni daa chaŋ ni bɛ ti da kpam maa ka amiliya aŋgo maa dii paana, ka o mini bɛn daa pun mali shili gu o maa kpe amiliya lɔbu yili maa ni, ka bɛ kpari di dunoli.
en: So the foolish ones went off to buy some oil; and while they were gone, the bridegroom arrived. The five who were ready went in with him to the wedding feast, and the door was closed.

dag: ni bɛ taba Shɛbania ni Hɔdia ni Kɛlita ni Pɛlaya ni Hanan ni.
en: Shebaniah, Hodiah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan.

dag: yin miriya ka yi tam Yawɛ ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni dabitim ni na la yɛla.
en: make certain that you do not forget the Lord who rescued you from Egypt, where you were slaves.

dag: ka bipuɣins ayopɔin bɛn daa nyɛ Midian maligumaana so bihi daa ti kana ti toori kom niŋdi bɔɣili ni ni bɛ nyuhi bɛ ba biŋkɔbiri.
en: Now there was a Midianite priest who had seven daughters. The daughters came to draw water and fill the troughs so that their fathers flock could drink.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yi Pɛɛga maa chaŋ Antiɔk din be Pisidia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la n-daa ti chaŋ Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu Vuhim Dabisili dali ti ʒini.
en: They continued their trip from Perga and went to Antioch, a city near Pisidia. On the Sabbath day they went into the Jewish synagogue and sat down.

dag: Yawɛ, m paɣi n nuhi wuhi ni n ka taali, ka chani gind a sara maligu bimbini.
en: I wash my hands, Lord , to show my innocence, and I worship at your altar.

dag: N naɣ ni niŋla ŋ-ŋɔ: N ni wurim n kambɔna ŋɔ, ka taɣi me zaɣ kara n-zaŋ m bindira mini m binkparisi zaa niŋ di ni;.
en: This is what I will do, he told himself; I will tear down my barns and build bigger ones, where I will store the grain and all my other goods.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia daa ŋmalig o nini bahi dukpini polo, ka suhi Yawɛ yɛli.
en: Hezekiah turned his face to the wall and prayed:.

dag: Amaa ka Amazia ni daa zaɣisi ni tɔbutuhiriba shɛb di dol o chaŋ tɔb maa ni ka kari ba ni bɛ kulim maa daa kana ti liri Juda tin shɛŋa, zaŋ Samaria hal ni Bɛtihɔrɔn n-daa ku niriba tusaata ka di nɛma pam.
en: Meanwhile, the troops Amaziah had released from fighting alongside him raided cities in Judah from Samaria to Beth-horon, killing three thousand people and carrying off a large amount of loot.

dag: Di saha ka alizin biɛɣu maa daa garigi yɛli ba, M mi Yisa, ka mi Pool; ka banima n-lee nyɛ yi mi.
en: The evil spirit replied, I know Jesus and Im familiar with Paul, but who are you.

dag: Ka yi niŋ salima alali niŋ di puuni mini di nyaaŋa zaa, ka niŋ salima kɔɣili li gili.
en: Use pure gold to cover the Box inside and out. Put gold trim around the edges of the Box.

dag: Ti min a bɔ ni, nyin Yisa Nazarɛt nir ŋɔ? A kamina ni a ti bahi ti yoli? M mi a ni nyɛ so: A nyɛla Naawuni Ninvuɣ Suŋ so o ni timna.
en: What do you want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Are you here to destroy us? I know who you are—you are God's holy messenger.

dag: A biha ayi ŋmanila muli zaɣ pola ayi, ka ŋmani saŋkpalima ayi.
en: Your breasts are like twins of a deer.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ gbalikpimalan so n-niŋ amaŋka ni n-ʒi o ka Yisa sanna; ka Yisa daa nya bɛ ni niŋ o yɛda shɛm maa ka yɛli gbalikpimalan maa, M bia, chɛ ka a suhu kpɛma, n chɛ a daalahichi paŋ a.
en: Some people brought to him a man who was paralyzed and was lying on a mat. Jesus saw that these people had much faith. So he said to the paralyzed man, Young man, you will be glad to hear this. Your sins are forgiven.

dag: M bi yɛn kari ba yuun yini puuni, ka tiŋgbani maa doya yoli, ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri yɛligi nti muɣisi ya.
en: I will not drive them out within a year's time; if I did, the land would become deserted, and the wild animals would be too many for you.

dag: Ka Yawɛ bɔh o, Bɔ n-lee be a nuu ni ŋɔ? Ka o yɛli, Jaaŋgbee.
en: But the Lord said to Moses, What is that you have in your hand? Moses answered, It is my walking stick.

dag: Lihimi nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa mali karimbaani, ka a filim ba, ka bahi ninvuɣ biɛri yoli bɛ ni be luɣ shɛlikam.
en: Look on all the proud and debase them; trample the wicked in their place.

dag: Nyam salima la ni daɣi shɛm. Nyam salima alali la ni daɣi shɛm. Ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu kuɣ viɛla la wurim do soya zuɣu luɣilikam.
en: Our glittering gold has grown dull; the stones of the Temple lie scattered in the streets.

dag: Bɛ ni ti sɔɣ o mi kaman bɛ ni sɔɣiri buŋ shɛm la. Bɛ ni ti vu o ti labi Jɛrusalɛm dunɔdali tooni ha.
en: You will be given a burial fit for a donkey; your body will be dragged outside the city gates and tossed in the dirt. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka bɛ niriba ayi bɛn nyɛ Ijipti Naa wain boora min o bɔrɔbɔro shɛriba kpɛm bɛn daa be duu maa daa ti zahim zahima dahin shɛli yuŋ. Sokam zahindi daa bela di ko, ka mali di gbinni.
en: both of them—the wine steward and the baker for Egypts king who were imprisoned in the jail—had dreams one night, and each mans dream had its own meaning.

dag: Ka Bɛnaaya ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛhɔiada bia ka nyɛ Kabiziil nir la gba daa nyɛla suhukpeendan ŋun tum tuun kara. Ŋuna n-daa ku Mɔabnim wɔɣiri kɔba ayi, ka daa ti lan siɣi bɔɣili ni ti ku gbuɣinli paɣili ni daa kpe dahin shɛl la.
en: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was a brave man from Kabzeel who did some amazing things. He killed two of Moab's best fighters, and on a snowy day he went down into a pit and killed a lion.

dag: Salo maa ni daa yi n-naai, ka o kpe nti gbaai bipuɣiŋga maa nuu, ka o neei n-yiɣisi zani.
en: After the people were put out of the house, Jesus went into the girls room. He held the girls hand, and the girl stood up.

dag: Chɛ ka a ba min a ma mali suhupiɛlli; chɛ ka paɣ ŋun dɔɣ a mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Your father and your mother will rejoice; she who gave you birth will be happy.

dag: N ni labisi Judanim mini Izraɛlnim daazichi ti ba, ka mali ba zali kaman bɛ ni daa pun be shɛm piligu ni la.
en: I will make good things happen to Judah and Israel again and make them strong as in the past.

dag: Yi tamla yi yaannim ni daa tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa la mini Juda nanim mini bɛ paɣiba ni yimaŋmaŋ mini yi paɣiba ni daa tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni mini Jɛrusalɛm tiŋ puuni la yɛla?.
en: When you were living in Jerusalem and Judah, you followed the example of your ancestors in doing evil things, just like your kings and queens.

dag: Sapashin kpamba maa ni lan yɛli tɔbbihi maa yaha, Dabiɛm yi gbaai so bee so suhu yi fuŋ, dilana ŋun labimi kul o yiŋa, di yi pa lala o ni chɛ ka o tab suhuri fuŋ kaman o suhu ni fuŋ shɛm maa.
en: These Levite officials must also say to the people, Is there any man here who has lost his courage and is afraid? He should go back home. Then he will not cause the other soldiers to lose their courage too.

dag: Yi bi da tulaale viɛlli ti ma bee n-zaŋ yi sara maligu biŋkɔbiri kpam ti ma. Amaa yinim lee chɛmi ka yi daalahichi yɛla muɣisi ma, ka chɛ ka n nyee nyɔni yi tuumbiɛri.
en: So you did not use your money to buy things to honor me. But you did force me to be like your slave. You sinned until the bad things you did made me very tired.

dag: Yi yi ti kpe fɔntiŋ ni bee tiŋkpaŋa, yin bɔhimiya n-nya ninvuɣ chirichi n-kpe o yiŋa m-be nimaani hal nti yi tiŋ maa ni.
en: When you enter a city or town, find some worthy person there and stay in his home until you leave.

dag: Shihir shɛli yi ni ti yɛn nya ka baŋ nyɛla, yi ni ti nya ka bɛ zaŋ chinchini pili biliɛɣu maa sɔŋ wɔrimɔri piɛɣu ni.
en: And this is what will prove it to you: you will find a baby wrapped in cloths and lying in a manger.

dag: Ti Duuma kpaŋsim a suhu! Naawuni daalibarika kpalimmi be yi ni!.
en: The Lord be with your spirit. Grace be with you.

dag: Dama a yi zaɣisi ni a ku chɛ ka n niriba maa chaŋ, biɛɣuni n sa ni tahi toli a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni na.
en: Otherwise, if you refuse to let my people go, Im going to bring locusts into your country tomorrow.

dag: Bɛ tiŋgbani maa ni fɔŋ kara n-daa nyɛ: Bɛrishiiba mini Shiiba ni Molada.
en: They had in their legacy: Beer-sheba, Sheba, Moladah.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ m-pii Lɛvi yi zuliya zaa ni ni o min o bihi zani zaŋ ŋun Yawɛ yuli tumdi tuma sahakam.
en: The Lord chose from all your tribes the tribe of Levi to serve him as priests forever.

dag: Amaa yinim yɛliya ni so yi yɛl o ba bee o ma ni o ni di naan nya shɛli o sani, o pun zaŋ li ti Naawuni, ka di bi lan kpa ni o lu o ba sizuura gba.
en: But you let people get by without helping their parents when they should. You let them say that what they have has been offered to God.

dag: Ka o daa lan tɔɣis o daanabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Mbaye, Naawuni yi ti niŋ dimbɔŋɔ, ŋuni n-lee ni be?.
en: Then Balaam said this: No one can live when God does this.

dag: Di niŋ ma yoli n ni daa zaŋ Sool leei naa maa zuɣu, dama o chɛ ma dolibu ka bi lan doli n zaligunima. Ka Samuɛl suhu daa yiɣisi, ka o kuhi niŋ Yawɛ dindali maa yuŋ zaa.
en: I am sorry that I made Saul king; he has turned away from me and disobeyed my commands. Samuel was angry, and all night long he pleaded with the Lord .

dag: Binnɛma zaa niŋgbuŋ bela kɔŋkɔbakɔŋkɔba: Ninsalinim niŋgbuŋ bela di ko, ka biŋkɔbiri niŋgbuŋ be di ko, ka noonsi niŋgbuŋ be di ko, ka zahim niŋgbuŋ mi be di ko.
en: All things made of flesh are not the same: People have one kind of flesh, animals have another, birds have another, and fish have yet another kind.

dag: Naawuni pin gahindi shɛl o ni daa ti ma o yiko puuni la zuɣu ka o daa zaŋ ma leei lahibal suŋ la tumtumda.
en: God treated me with kindness. His power worked in me, and it became my job to spread the good news.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yɛl o, Doli ma, ka chɛ ka kpiimba sɔɣimi bɛ kpiin taba.
en: Jesus answered, Follow me, and let the dead bury their dead.

dag: Bɛ daa yi yɛn kpe Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa ni bee n-chaŋ sara maligu bimbin la gbini, bɛ paɣirila bɛ nuhi mini bɛ naba kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm la.
en: They washed themselves every time they entered the Meeting Tent. They also washed themselves every time they went near the altar. They did these things just as the Lord commanded Moses.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zaa yoli, n ku deei nam maa zaa o nuu ni, n ni chɛ ka o kul nyɛ naa hal ni o nyɛvili tariga n dabili Dauda ŋun nyɛ n ni daa pii so ka o doli n zalikpana mini n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la zuɣu.
en: But I will not take the whole kingdom away from Solomon, and I will keep him in power as long as he lives. This I will do for the sake of my servant David, whom I chose and who obeyed my laws and commands.

dag: Amaa malimiya bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la tiri Yawɛ hal ni daba ayopɔin, dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin n-nyɛ laɣiŋgu kasi dali, Miriya ka yi tum tuma dindali.
en: You will offer food gifts to the LORD for seven days. The seventh day will be a holy occasion; you must not do any job-related work.

dag: Yi puhiri dabisa mini goya ni saha ni yuma churi!.
en: It worries me that you follow teachings about special days, months, seasons, and years. I fear that my work for you has been wasted.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yi zaɣisi ma, yi lɛbila yi nyaansi biri ma, dinzuɣu ka n teegi n nuu m-bahi ya yoli. N niŋla suɣilo hal ka n nyee ti nyɔni.
en: Jerusalem, you left me. This message is from the Lord . Again and again you left me! So I will punish and destroy you. I am tired of holding back your punishment.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda gba daa yiɣisi voli maa ni yina nti kuhi boli Naa Sool, N dan naa! Ka Sool daa ŋmaligi lih o nyaaŋa, ka Dauda damdi zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa n-lu o sizuura.
en: Then David also went out of the cave and yelled after Saul, My master the king! Saul looked back, and David bowed low out of respect, nose to the ground.

dag: Kurimbuni ha ka a nam ʒiishee pun mali ʒiɛya. Kurimbuni ha ka a pun be.
en: Your throne, O Lord , has been firm from the beginning, and you existed before time began.

dag: Ninsal noli ni yɛtɔɣa puuni ka o puli paana, o noli ni yɛtɔɣa puuni ka o lan tiɣira.
en: Your words can be as satisfying as fruit, as pleasing as the food that fills your stomach.

dag: N ni kpuɣi n tiliginsim pipia zuɣusaa, ka kuhi boli Yawɛ yuli.
en: He saved me, so I will give him a drink offering, and I will call on the Lord s name.

dag: Pita ni daa kul yɛri maa ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa siɣi bɛnkam daa wum yɛligu maa zuɣu na.
en: While Peter was still speaking, the Holy Spirit took control of everyone who was listening.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N kabi Babilɔn Naa naɣikɔra dapua la.
en: that the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, had said: I have broken the power of the king of Babylonia.

dag: Nyama, ka Kush nir la gba daa ti paana nti yɛli, Lahibal suŋ ka n ʒina ni n ti ti nyini n dan naa, dama zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ Yawɛ fa a ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa yiɣisi wuɣil a zuɣu la nuu ni bahi.
en: Then the Ethiopian slave arrived and said to the king, I have good news for Your Majesty! Today the Lord has given you victory over all who rebelled against you.

dag: Ka yi yi pɔhi yi wain tihi wala, di nyaaŋa yin di lan chaŋ ti yihi di zaɣ yaha; di nyɛla sana mini kpibiga ni pakoli dini.
en: When you have gathered your grapes once, do not go back over the vines a second time; the grapes that are left are for the foreigners, orphans, and widows.

dag: Ka paɣa yi po pɔri Yawɛ sani ka lo alikauli ni o niŋ shɛli o paɣisarilim ni saha shɛl o ni be o ba yiŋa.
en: When a young woman still living in her father's house makes a vow to give something to the Lord or promises to abstain from something.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa bi deeg o. Amaa ka Yisa daa yɛli ba, Anabi nyari jilima luɣ shɛlikam zaa naɣila omaŋmaŋ ya min o yiŋnim sani ka o bi nyari jilima.
en: So the people were upset because of what he was doing. But Jesus said, Prophets are honored by everyone, except the people of their hometown and their own family.

dag: Yi lo nia shɛŋa din ka buchi, yimaŋmaŋ vuhim ni ŋmaligi din ya kaman buɣim la.
en: You conceive straw, give birth to stubble; your breath is a fire that devours you.

dag: Kalimiya yuma ayopɔin ʒiibuyopɔin. Di yuma maa ni ti nyɛla yuun pihinuyinika.
en: Count seven times seven years, a total of forty-nine years.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi zaa ni leei saɣiri maa zuɣu, n ni laɣim ya sɔŋ Jɛrusalɛm tiŋ sunsuuni.
en: So this is what the LORD God says: Because youve all become a waste product, Im now gathering you into the middle of Jerusalem.

dag: Shi yino maa n-lan tiri so yɛda niŋbu pini, ka tiri so dɔriti tibbu pina;.
en: One and the same Spirit gives faith to one person, while to another person he gives the power to heal.

dag: O ni daa paai yiŋa Ifriim zoya ni tinsi maa ni, o daa piɛb la kikaa; ka Izraɛlnim daa yi zoya tinsi maa ni laɣim o sanna, ka o leei bɛ zuɣulana.
en: When he arrived, he blew the rams horn in the Ephraim highlands. So the Israelites went down from the highlands with Ehud leading them.

dag: dama bɛ suhutuntali zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ bi tooi baŋ bɔrɔbɔro la alahiziba tuuni la gbinni ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Their minds were closed, and they could not understand the true meaning of the loaves of bread.

dag: Yi nyɛla bɛn jɛmdi buɣa, ka zaŋdi paɣiba dooni di timaha gbinni; ka zaŋdi yi bihi maani maligu vinvama mini tampima lɔna ni.
en: who console yourselves with idols under every green tree, who slaughter children in the valleys, under the rocky cliffs?.

dag: n ni daa na mali yaa, ka Naawuni zɔtali na be n yiŋ la.
en: when I was in my prime; when Gods counsel was in my tent.

dag: Jɛhɔshafat daa lan pii Lɛvinim mini maligumaaniba ni Izraɛl daŋ kam puuni kpɛma n-leei Jɛrusalɛm sariakaritiba ni bɛ kariti saria tiri Yawɛ, ka maani niriba yɛla. Bɛ daa ʒila Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Jehoshaphat also chose some Levites, some priests, and some of the family leaders, and he appointed them to serve as judges in Jerusalem.

dag: Haga n-nyɛ Sinai Zoli din be Areebia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la ŋmahinli; o lan nyɛla Jɛrusalɛm din be pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ ŋmahinli, dama o min o bihi bela dabitim ni.
en: Hagar also stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia and for the present city of Jerusalem. She and her children are slaves.

dag: Ka Sool mini Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa laɣim be Jɛrusalɛm, ka o daa chani gindi mali Yisa yuli yihiri waazu ni suhukpeeni.
en: And so Saul stayed with them and went all over Jerusalem, preaching boldly in the name of the Lord.

dag: Ka ŋunkam mi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri dalindi Daadam Bia ni tooi nya di chɛ m-paŋ, amaa ŋunkam tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri n-dalindi Naawuni Shia Kasi, dilana ŋun kul ku nya di chɛ m-paŋ dunia ŋɔ ni bee dunia shɛli din kanna ni.
en: And whoever speaks a word against the Human One will be forgiven. But whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit wont be forgiven, not in this age or in the age that is coming.

dag: Ka o daa shiri kpi kaman Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Ilaija yɛli shɛm maa. Ka o tizo Jɔram daa di nam zan o zaani, Juda Naa Jɛhɔram ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛhɔshafat bia la nam dibu yuma ayi saha, dama Ahazia daa ka bidibiga.
en: Ahaziah died, just as the Lord said through Elijah. Ahaziah did not have a son, so Joram became the new king after Ahaziah. He began to rule during the second year that Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat was the king of Judah.

dag: ka so ku baŋ ni a lɔri noli naɣila a Ba Naawuni ŋun be ashilɔni ŋɔ, ka a Ba Naawuni ŋun nyari ashilɔni maa ti a di laara.
en: Then no one will know you are fasting, except your Father, who is with you even in private. He can see what is done in private, and he will reward you.

dag: So yi zaŋ o buŋa bee o nahu bee o piɛɣu bee o biŋkɔb so ti o kpee ni o zali, ka biŋkɔbigu maa ti kpi bee n-nya daŋa bee bɛ taɣ o pah o tab ni chaŋ ka so bi nya o.
en: Suppose a neighbor who is going to be away asks you to keep a donkey or an ox or a sheep or some other animal, and it dies or gets injured or is stolen while no one is looking.

dag: Yi yi ti piligi kachɛɣu dahin shɛli, yin piligimiya kali dindali maa hal ni bakɔi ayopɔin.
en: Seven weeks after you start your grain harvest.

dag: Ka n daa niŋ kaman o ni daa zali ma ni n niŋ shɛm maa. N daa kahi n nɛma yina kaman kuŋkɔɣinzɔr la. N daa zaŋ n nuhi chibi gooni voli n-zaŋ n nɛma yina liɣa nti zaŋ li buɣi m bɔɣusapiŋ zuɣu bɛ ninni.
en: So I did as I was commanded. I carried out my backpack like an exiles backpack in the daytime. At night I dug a hole through the wall with my hands. In the darkness, I shouldered my backpack and carried it out while they watched.

dag: A ni mali yɛm pam zaŋ chaŋ daabiligu polo maa zuɣu ka a chɛ ka a buni nabi pahi, ka a mali karimbaani a buni maa zuɣu.
en: Through your great wisdom and trade, you have made your riches grow. And now you are proud because of those riches.

dag: Ka paɣ maa suh o ni o kari alizin biɛɣu maa o bia maa zuɣu bahi. Bɛ daa dɔɣ paɣ maa la Siria tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Ka o lee nyɛ Fɔnisia tiŋbia, ka nyɛ ŋun wumdi Giriikili.
en: The woman was Greek and had been born in the part of Syria known as Phoenicia. She begged Jesus to force the demon out of her daughter.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, N yilikpɛrinima, yi nya zahim? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Aai.
en: Jesus shouted, Friends, have you caught anything? No! they answered.

dag: M mini bɛn be n sani yi ti kul piɛb ti kikahi; yi gba yin piɛbimiya yi kikahi bɛ sansani maa luɣilikam zaa ka kuhi yɛli, Tuhimiya ti Yawɛ mini Gidiɔn.
en: When I blow the trumpet, along with all who are with me, then you blow the trumpets, all of you surrounding the whole camp. And then shout, For the LORD and for Gideon.

dag: Yinim zuliya shɛb bɛn pa Yɛhudianima, pahimiya o niriba zuɣu paɣ o. Dama o ni bɔhi biɛri o daba ʒim yihibu zuɣu, ka bɔhi o dimnim biɛri, ka darigi bɛn je o tibili ka mali tiŋgbɔŋ maa ka di viɛl ti o niriba.
en: The whole world should be happy for Gods people! God punishes people who kill his servants. He gives his enemies the punishment they deserve. And he makes his land and people pure.

dag: A chɛ ka kɔbil nina kom puhiri yiri vinvama ni na n-zɔri gariti daboya sunsuuni.
en: You put gushing springs into dry riverbeds. They flow between the mountains.

dag: Lala zuɣu bɛn bi guni, amaa ka doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa ni wuhi shɛm la ni wuhi ni yinim bɛn guni ka mali Naawuni fukumsi zaligu din sabi doya ka yi bi dol li ŋɔ mali taali.
en: The one who isnt physically circumcised but keeps the Law will judge you. You became a lawbreaker after you had the written Law and circumcision.

dag: Amaa ka o daa zaŋ o pagɔrisigu tuma maa chaŋ katiŋa. O daa nya bɛ ni mali dɔbba kɔtomsi pa dukpini zuɣu. Di daa nyɛla Babilɔnnim anfooni ka bɛ mali pa dukpina zuɣu, ka bɛ ye neen ʒiɛfaa.
en: But Oholibah behaved worse than her sister. Oholibah saw images of Babylonian men carved into walls and painted red.

dag: Kuriinius n-daa nyɛ Siria Gomna niriba yuya tuui sab maa saha.
en: This was the first counting of all the people while Quirinius was governor of Syria.

dag: Jɛhɔahaz ni daa tum shɛlikam pahi min o ni daa tum shɛlikam ni o kpiɔŋ tuma zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: All the great things that Jehoahaz did are written in the book, The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: ka yɛl o, N ni zaŋ nama ŋɔ sulinsi mini di jilima zaa ti a, dama mani n-su li ka ni tooi zaŋ li ti n ni bɔri so.
en: The devil said, I will give all this power and glory to you. It has been given to me, and I can give it to anyone I want to.

dag: Amaa ka ti daa yɛl o, Ti pala puɣisiriba, ti nyɛla yɛlimaŋyɛriba.
en: We are not spies, we answered, we are honest men.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ di chɛliya ka yi suhuri saɣim bee n-je suli niŋ taba, yi ni daa zaŋ ma kɔhi kpe ŋɔ maa zuɣu, dama Naawuni n-daa chɛ ka n daŋ yi tooni na ni n ti fa niriba nyɛviya bahi.
en: Now, dont be upset and dont be angry with yourselves that you sold me here. Actually, God sent me before you to save lives.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu nyɛla din ni chɛ ka nir ti nya binshɛŋa o ni niŋdi tahima ni o ni ti nya la; di lan nyɛla din ni chɛ ka o shiri mi ni o nina ni ku tooi nya binshɛŋa beni.
en: Faith is the reality of what we hope for, the proof of what we dont see.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ suhimiya Naawuni ka o zo ti nambɔɣu ka niŋ ti nirilim. Yinima n-nyɛ bɛn mali taali. O ni niŋ yi so nirilim? Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: So now ask God to be gracious to us. After what you have done, will he accept you? says the LORD of heavenly forces.

dag: N Naawuni, n tampiŋ, n ni sɔɣiri so sani. N nyɔtaɣirigu mini kpiɔŋlana ŋun tiligi ma. M birini mini n sɔɣisili shee, nyini n-nyɛ n tiligira ŋun tiligiri ma barina ni.
en: You are the rock where I am safe. You are my shield, my powerful weapon, and my place of shelter. You rescue me and keep me safe from violence.

dag: Naa Hɛzɛkia ni daa wum yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, o daa dari tɔhila o binyɛra, ka zaŋ buɣu ye n-chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu.
en: As soon as Hezekiah heard the news, he tore off his clothes in sorrow and put on sackcloth. Then he went into the temple of the Lord .

dag: Ka o sara maligu maa yi nyɛla bua, ŋun malimi li Yawɛ tooni.
en: If you offer a goat, you must also present it to me.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, dinzuɣu gbibiya n zaligunim mini n ni yɛli ya shɛm, ka tummiya tuun shɛli din ni chɛ ka daadam be.
en: You must obey my rules and my laws, because whoever obeys them will live. I am the Lord .

dag: Ashaara doli alahichinima, amaa tɔŋbu n-nyɛ wuntizɔriba laara.
en: You are in for trouble if you sin, but you will be rewarded if you live right.

dag: Ka Jɛsi daa bo bɔrɔbɔro mini wain koligu pali ni busaa n-zaŋ pa buŋ zuɣu ti o bia Dauda ni o zaŋ mali chaŋ Sool sani.
en: Jesse then took a donkey and loaded it with a homer of bread, a jar of wine, and a young goat, and he sent it along with his son David to Saul.

dag: Di saha ka Sulemaana daa ʒini Yawɛ nam ʒiishee maa zuɣu n-zan o ba Dauda zaani leei naa. O daa tɔŋya, ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa deeg o noli.
en: So Solomon succeeded his father David on the throne which the Lord had established. He was a successful king, and the whole nation of Israel obeyed him.

dag: Shɛb daa nyɛla jɛra n-tum tuumbiɛri, ka daa di wahala bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu.
en: Some people became fools and turned against God, and they suffered for the evil they did.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Izraɛl bihi, o yuli n-lan nyɛ Yaakubu: Rubin mini Simiɔn ni Lɛvi ni Juda ni Isaka ni Zɛbulɔn.
en: This was Israels family: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ lan yɛli, Yinim bɛn wumdi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa anabinim ni daa yɛli bɛ ni daa zali n jɛmbu duu ŋɔ tanzaa saha shɛl la wuhiya ni n jɛmbu duu maa ni me, kpaŋsimiya yimaŋa.
en: Have courage! You are now hearing the same words the prophets spoke at the time the foundation was being laid for rebuilding my Temple.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ŋuni n-lee zali wuntaŋa ni di ne dabisili puuni, ka zali goli mini saŋmarisi ni bɛ mi ne yuŋ? Ka ŋuni n-lee damdi teeku ka di kɔgbana vura? O yuli m-booni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa.
en: I am the Lord All-Powerful. I command the sun to give light each day, the moon and stars to shine at night, and ocean waves to roar.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Niŋmiya din tuhi ka doli wuntia soli. Famiya bɛ ni ŋari ninvuɣ so n fa o ŋun nahind o maa nuu ni bahi. Miriya ka yi zaŋ gala bee kpeengarigu niŋ sana bee kpibiga bee pakoli bee n-ku ŋun ka taali kpe ŋɔ.
en: I, the Lord , command you to do what is just and right. Protect the person who is being cheated from the one who is cheating him. Do not mistreat or oppress aliens, orphans, or widows; and do not kill innocent people in this holy place.

dag: Dauda bia Sulemaana ni daa ʒin o nam ʒiishee, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ŋɔ daa be o sani ka chɛ ka o mali yiko pam.
en: King Solomon, the son of David, was now in complete control of his kingdom, because the Lord God had blessed him and made him a powerful king.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa nyɛ daba tim bɛ dunia ŋɔ ni duumanim la jilima, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka so ku yɛli zaɣ biɛɣu n-dalim Naawuni yuli min o wuhibu ŋɔ.
en: Those who are under the bondage of slavery should consider their own masters as worthy of full respect so that Gods name and our teaching wont get a bad reputation.

dag: Bɛ ni ti me bɛ yinsi n-kpe m-be di ni, ka sa tihi ka di wali ka bɛ di di wala maa.
en: They will build houses and live in them; they will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa ti nya doo maa Naawuni jɛmbu duu yɛl o, Nyama, a kpaŋya zaa! Di lan tum alahichi din ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu din gari din la ti paag a yaha.
en: Later Jesus found him in the temple and said, See! You have been made well. Dont sin anymore in case something worse happens to you.

dag: A yɛla gari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be teeku duli maa tinsi ni zaa, ka dabiɛm pam gbahi bɛ nanima a zuɣu, ka bɛ nina ni maligi.
en: Everyone who lives along the coast is shocked at your fate. Even their kings are terrified, and fear is written on their faces.

dag: Ka Yisa wum lala ka yɛl o, Yɛl yini n-naɣ poog a. Kɔhim a ni mali shɛlikam zaa n-zaŋ ti nandaamba, ka kana ti doli ma, ka di chɛ ka a ti nya buni alizanda ni.
en: When Jesus heard this, he said to him, There is still one more thing you need to do. Sell all you have and give the money to the poor, and you will have riches in heaven; then come and follow me.

dag: ka nyɛ ŋun niŋdi binshɛŋa o ba ni daa bi niŋ, ka diri bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa mali buɣa zoya zuɣu la, ka zaŋdi o kpee paɣa doona.
en: even though his parents didnt do any of them. He eats on the mountains, defiles his neighbors wife.

dag: Nuhu bidibisi maa zuliya mini bɛ dɔɣirikpamba yɛla m-bala. Bɛ ni ka zuliya kam yina n-nab pali dunia ŋɔ zaa, kom ni daa di dunia maa nyaaŋa.
en: All these peoples are the descendants of Noah, nation by nation, according to their different lines of descent. After the flood all the nations of the earth were descended from the sons of Noah.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chɛ ka Lɛvinim shɛb bɛn daa be Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni daa pahi Bɛnjamin zuliya ni.
en: Some divisions of the Levites in Judah were joined to Benjamin.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ ka di ti paag a sanna, ka nyin ka suɣilo? Di shihir a mi, ka nyin yihi tahima.
en: But now it comes to you, and you are dismayed; it has struck you, and you are frightened.

dag: Ka Absalom daa chaŋ naa sani ti yɛl o, Naa nyama, a dabili yɛn chɛla o piɛri kɔbiri, ka bɔri ni naa min o kpamba zaa kana.
en: Absalom approached the king and said, Your servant is shearing sheep. Would the king and his advisors please join me.

dag: O mabia Shɛmɛr mi bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ahi mini Rɔga ni Jɛhuba ni Aram.
en: Shomers sons were Ahi, Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.

dag: m mali tahima ni n yi ti gariti chani Speen n ni nyan ya. Ka n yi ti kaai ya n-niŋ daba ayi yi sani, yi ni sɔŋ ma ka n gari chaŋ.
en: Ill visit you when I go to Spain. I hope to see you while Im passing through. And I hope you will send me on my way there, after I have first been reenergized by some time in your company.

dag: A ni nya saŋmaris ayopɔin shɛba n nudirigu ni la mini salima firilatamdis ayopɔin shɛŋa la gbinni m-bɔŋɔ: Saŋmaris ayopɔin maa nyɛla cheechinima ayopɔin la malaikanima, ka salima firilatamdis ayopɔin la mi nyɛ cheechinima ayopɔin la.
en: As for the mystery of the seven stars that you saw in my right hand and the seven gold lampstands, here is what they mean: the seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches.

dag: Bɛ doonila bɛ zaɣim yuŋ kam, ka ka situra. Bɛ ka binshɛli din ni pili wari saha.
en: They must sleep all night without clothes. They have no covers to protect them from the cold.

dag: Ka n ni pii ninvuɣ so jaaŋgbee ni puhi vari. Lala ka n yɛn niŋ ka Izraɛlnim chɛ bɛ kparima ni ŋumbu shɛli bɛ ni ŋumdi niŋdi ya sahakam maa.
en: I will choose one man to be the true priest. You will know which man I choose because his walking stick will begin to grow new leaves. In this way I will stop the people from always complaining against you and me.

dag: Dinzuɣu zaŋm a mabihi bɛn nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya ka nyɛ a daŋ niriba la na ka bɛ ti pah a zuɣu n-sɔŋd a min a bidibisi maa saha shɛli yi yi ti be alikauli suɣili maa gbini tumdi tuma.
en: Bring in your relatives, the tribe of Levi, to work with you and help you while you and your sons are serving at the Tent.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb yi niŋdi din wuhiri ni bɛ baɣa be yi ni ka di nyɛla daliri suŋ zuɣu, din nyɛla zaɣ viɛlli sahakam, din dee yi pala n yi ti be yi sani kɔŋko zuɣu.
en: Now, it is good to have such a deep interest if the purpose is good—this is true always, and not merely when I am with you.

dag: Di ni ʒiɛya lala sahakam, ni di chɛ ka niriba doli zaligunim maa ni ʒiɛyimtali mini din tuhi tumbu ni.
en: They are true and right and will stand forever.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa kahigi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa wuhi anabi Habakuk m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is the message that the Lord revealed to the prophet Habakkuk.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ ba nyaɣisim pam, ka bɛ lo o alikauli ni bɛ ni ti o liɣiri.
en: The priests were very happy about this. They promised to give Judas money for doing this.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka noli di dunia, ka niriba bɛn be di ni di wahala bɛ taali zuɣu; ka di chɛ ka daadamnim kul filinda hal ka niriba biɛla nti kpalim.
en: The earth is under a curse; its people are dying out because of their sins.

dag: ka Naawuni suhu daa yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka o ku bɛ ni bɛn mali kpiɔŋ. O daa booi Izraɛl nachimbihi gahinda kalinli.
en: when God became angry with them and killed their strongest men, the best young men of Israel.

dag: Nudirigu polo din buɣisibu ti yɛn nyɛ kilomita ayi ni mita kɔbisiyi ni pihinu la ni ti malila dunɔdaya ata. Simiɔn zuliya dunɔdali mini Isaka zuliya dunɔdali ni Zɛbulɔn zuliya dunɔdali.
en: The south side of the city will be cubits long. There will be three gates: Simeons Gate, Issachars Gate, and Zebuluns Gate.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli, Kpahimmiya fiig tia mini tia kam:.
en: Jesus told them a parable: Look at the fig tree and all the trees.

dag: Di saha paɣipuhinim mini biliɛrinim yɛla ni ti mali nambɔɣu pam!.
en: During that time it will be hard for women who are pregnant or have small babies.

dag: ka mali salima bans ayi n-zaŋ gɔhi nyolɔrigu maa naŋgbambiya.
en: Make two gold rings for the chest pendant and attach the two rings to the two edges of the chest pendant.

dag: Di lan sabi Naawuni Kundi ni yaha, Kum yi wum a dima, nyin dihim o; ka kɔnyuri yi wum o, nyin nyuhim o; dimbɔŋɔ niŋbu ni chɛ ka vi gbaag o.
en: But you should do this: If you have enemies who are hungry, give them something to eat. If you have enemies who are thirsty, give them something to drink. In doing this you will make them feel ashamed. Proverbs :-.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ salima alali mali zoligɔnima ŋ-ŋmɛl li kaman gabisi la n-zaŋ li niŋ nyolɔrigu maa.
en: Two gold rings were attached to the upper front corners of the breastpiece and fastened with two braided gold chains to gold settings on the shoulder straps.

dag: Bɛ ni daa tuhi nyaŋ na shɛb maa n-nyɛ: Jɛriko naa mini Ai.
en: The people of Israel defeated the kings of the following cities: Jericho, Ai .

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Juda Naa Jɛhoyakim polo m-bɔŋɔ: O ti ku mali bia ŋun ni ʒini Dauda nam ʒiishee. Bɛ ni ku o labi, ka wuntaŋ tulim kpe o wuntaŋ ni, ka maligim mi ti lu o zuɣu yuŋ.
en: Therefore, this is what the LORD proclaims about Judahs King Jehoiakim: He wont have any heirs to occupy the throne of David, and his dead body will be cast out and exposed to the heat of the day and the frost of the night.

dag: Ka Saimɔn Pita mini Yisa nyaandoliba ni so daa doli Yisa chaŋ. Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa ni daa mi nyaandol ŋuni maa zuɣu daa chɛ ka ŋun doli Yisa kpe maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa yiŋ dundɔŋ ni.
en: Simon Peter and another disciple followed Jesus. That disciple knew the high priest, and he followed Jesus into the courtyard of the high priest's house.

dag: ka tinim bɛn mali nyɛviya be dunia ŋɔ ni ŋɔ mini ba ti laɣim chaŋ ti kpe sagban ni n-tuhi ti Duuma soli sagbani maa ni; ka ti ni ti kpalim be ti Duuma maa sani hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Next, all of us who are still alive will be taken up into the clouds together with them to meet the Lord in the sky. From that time on we will all be with the Lord forever.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi nimaani n-nya luɣ shɛli ʒini ni bɛ gbe Gibia, dama so daa bi zaŋ ba ti kpɛh o yiŋa ni bɛ gbe.
en: They turned off the road to go and spend the night there. They went into town and sat down in the city square, but no one offered to take them home for the night.

dag: A ni yɛli ti yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa Yawɛ yuli ni ŋɔ, ti ku wum a ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Jeremiah, what do we care if you speak in the Lord 's name? We refuse to listen!.

dag: Dɔbba yi zabira nti zaŋ ŋme paɣ puulana, ka paɣ puulan maa zaŋ bahi, amaa ka mali alaafee, di simdi ka bɛ zali ŋun ŋme o maa samli kaman paɣ maa yidan ni bɔr shɛm, ka o yo li kaman sariakaritiba ni wuhi shɛm.
en: When people who are fighting injure a pregnant woman so that she has a miscarriage but no other injury occurs, then the guilty party will be fined what the womans husband demands, as negotiated with the judges.

dag: Shɛb daa bela tiŋgban nɛl ni n-dari ginda, ka bi nya tiŋ ʒiina.
en: Some wandered in the trackless desert and could not find their way to a city to live in.

dag: Di saha maa ka bɛ daa kpuɣ kuɣa ni bɛ lab Yisa, ka o ŋoli yi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: Then they picked up stones to throw at him, but Jesus hid himself and left the Temple.

dag: Hal n ni daa yɛli ya lala maa, yi daa zaɣisi wumbu ka zaɣisi Yawɛ zaligu, ka ŋme nyɔɣu chaŋ zoya ni tiŋ maa ni.
en: I told you what the Lord had said, but you paid no attention. You disobeyed him and went into the hill country anyway. You thought you were so great!.

dag: Ka Daniɛl daa suhi naa ka o zaŋ Shadirak mini Mɛshak ni Abɛdnɛgo zali Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni tuma zaashɛhi ni. Amaa ka Daniɛl ŋun daa kul kpalim be nayili.
en: Daniel asked the king to make Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego important officials over the province of Babylon. The king did as Daniel asked. Daniel himself became one of the important officials who was always near the king.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ salima gabis ayi maa noya gɔhi salima bintaɣindisi la, ka di be o binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la bɔɣusapima zuɣu tan tolima la tooni.
en: Then fasten the two ends of the cords to the two settings, which you should attach to the vests two front shoulder pieces.

dag: Amaa m mini n niriba ŋɔ mi lee nyɛ banima, ka ni tooi zaŋ pina ŋɔ ti a ti suhu yubu puuni? Dama binshɛɣukam zaa yila a sanna, a ni su shɛli ka ti lan zaŋ ti a maa.
en: But why should we be happy that we have given you these gifts? They belong to you, and we have only given back what is already yours.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ nina ni ti nya dimbɔŋɔ, ka yɛli, Yawɛ galisiya Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaŋ tabili tinduya ni.
en: Your eyes will see it and you will say, May the LORD be great beyond the borders of Israel.

dag: ka ŋun pahi ayɔbu nyɛ Atai, ka ŋun pahi ayopɔin nyɛ Ɛliɛl.
en: Attai sixth, Eliel seventh.

dag: ka lan me n-gili Bɛtizur mini Soko ni Adulam.
en: Beth-zur, Soco, Adullam.

dag: Sool ni daa wum yɛtɔɣa maa, ka Naawuni shia siɣ o zuɣu na ni kpiɔŋ pam, ka o suhu daa yiɣisi pam.
en: When Saul heard this, the spirit of God took control of him, and he became furious.

dag: Yisa daa ŋahi yɛtɔɣ ŋaha ŋɔ tatabo pam wuhiri salo Naawuni yɛligu kaman bɛ baŋsim tariga ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: Jesus used many other stories when he spoke to the people, and he taught them as much as they could understand.
