dag: Ka Alikizanda mini Rufus ba ŋun daa nyɛ Sairiini nira, ka o yuli booni Saimɔn la daa yi tinshee garita; ka bɛ daa bol o na nti muɣis o ni o ʒim Yisa dapulli maa.
en: There was a man from Cyrene named Simon walking into the city from the fields. He was the father of Alexander and Rufus. The soldiers forced him to carry Jesus cross.

dag: Woligimiya yimaŋ ka chɛ niriba ŋɔ ka n ku ba pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Move away from these men! I want to destroy them now.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ʒini Amɔrinim tiŋgbani maa ni hal ni di tintariga Arinɔn Mɔɣili noli shee la zaŋ hal ti paai Jabok n-yi di yɔɣu maa ni m-mali hal ti paai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni.
en: They occupied all the Amorite territory from the Arnon in the south to the Jabbok in the north and from the desert on the east to the Jordan on the west.

dag: Nir yi chaŋ kumsi ni be yil shɛli, di so ni o chaŋ dimma ni nyubu ni be yil shɛli. Dinzuɣu di simdi ni bɛn be bɛ nyɛviya ni baŋ ni kum nyɛla din yɛn paai sokam zaa.
en: It is better to go to a house in mourning than to a house party, because that is everyones destiny; and the living should take it to heart.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pihi kuɣa sɔŋ ni bɛ lihi nya sokam talahi tuma ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm, ninkura mini bihi ni karimbanim ni karimbihi zaa.
en: They cast lots for their assigned duties, small as well as great, teacher and pupil alike.

dag: Yisa ni daa na kul tɔɣisiri niriba maa yɛtɔɣa maa, ka o tizɔbihi min o ma daa kana nti ʒe samban ni ka tim ni be ti bol o na ka bɛ tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣ shɛli. .
en: While Jesus was talking to the people, his mother and brothers stood outside. They wanted to talk to him.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim daa ŋmaligina, ka di gari Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa, dama bɛ daa baŋya ni yɛl biɛɣu paai ba mi maa.
en: Then the Israelites turned around, and the Benjaminites were thrown into panic because they realized that they were about to be destroyed.

dag: Bihi, wummiya yi ba wuhibu, wummiya li viɛnyɛliŋga din ni chɛ ka yi nya tɛhi zilima.
en: My children, listen to what your father teaches you. Pay attention, and you will have understanding.

dag: Yinim dee kul zomiyala Yawɛ, ka jɛmmiy o ni yi suhuri zaa, dama zahimmiya o ni tum tuun kar shɛŋa zaa tin ya la.
en: You also must obey the Lord —you must worship him with all your heart and remember the great things he has done for you.

dag: Yuun pisopɔin maa saha yi ti paai, Yawɛ ni chɛ ka Taai tiŋgbɔŋ maa lan lab di tuun kura ni yaha n-lan zaŋ dimaŋ kɔhi dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa zuɣu kaman pagɔrili la.
en: At the end of those years, the Lord will let Tyre get back into business. The city will be like a woman who sells her body to everyone of every nation on earth.

dag: Yinim Mɔabnima, dabiɛm mini bɔɣa ni tɔna dola yi tooni, Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Terror, pits, and traps are waiting for you.

dag: Ti bi lan nyari ti shihira la yaha; anabi so lan kani, ka so bi mi di yuusim tariga ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm.
en: We dont see our own signs anymore. No prophet is left. And none of us know how long it will last.

dag: Dama n ni kari zuliya shɛb bɛn be yi tooni, ka yɛligi yi tiŋgbani, ka chɛ ka so ti ku niŋ yi tiŋgbani maa kɔre.
en: When you go into your land, I will force your enemies out of that land. I will expand your borders—you will get more and more land. You will go before the Lord your God three times each year. At that time no one will try to take your land from you.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ʒiya diri bindirigu maa saha shɛli, ka Yawɛ yɛligu daa ka anabi kurili ŋun bol anab ŋuni maa labisina maa sanna.
en: Then as they were sitting at the table, the LORDs word came to the prophet who had brought him back.

dag: ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o ti zaŋ bɛ ni daa ku anab shɛb zaa, tum dunia piligu ni la ha taali ʒili ʒiɛmani ŋɔ niriba.
en: So the people of this time will be punished for the murder of all the prophets killed since the creation of the world.

dag: Amaa a na kul duhirila amaŋa n niriba sani, ka zaɣisi ni a ku chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: You are still against my people. You are not letting them go free.

dag: Ka Yisa daa boli salo pah o nyaandoliba zuɣu na nti yɛli ba, Ŋunkam bɔri ni o doli ma, ŋun zaɣisim omaŋa ka kpuɣ o dapulli buɣi doli ma.
en: Jesus then told the crowd and the disciples to come closer, and he said: If any of you want to be my followers, you must forget about yourself. You must take up your cross and follow me.

dag: Tuumbiɛrinim maa zaa so ʒimi? Bɛ zaŋla n niriba n-leei bindirigu dira, ka bi jɛmdi ma.
en: Those who are evil treat my people like bread to be eaten. And they never ask for the Lord s help. Dont they know what they are doing?.

dag: ka zaŋ tɛkɔisi mini safaya ni daimɔnd m-pie taba kul shɛli din pahir ayi.
en: The second row should have a turquoise, a sapphire, and an emerald.

dag: Ka n ni ti chɛ ka Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim ni lo nia shɛŋa kpalim yoli kpe, ka n chɛ ka bɛ dimnima bɛn bɔri ni bɛ di bɛ nyɛviya la zaŋ takɔbi ku ba, ka n chɛ ka bɛ leei juri mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri bindirigu.
en: I will foil the plans of Judah and Jerusalem in this place and will have them fall in battle before their enemies, before those who seek their lives. I will give their corpses as food to the birds and the wild animals.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛli Naawuni nir maa, Balimmi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni maa, ka suh o ti ma ka o chɛ ka n nuu ŋɔ lan lab di bebu ni yaha. Ka Naawuni nir maa daa suhi Yawɛ, ka naa maa nuu maa nya alaafee n-lan be kaman di ni daa pun be shɛm.
en: Then King Jeroboam said to the man of God, Please pray to the Lord your God for me. Ask him to heal my arm. So the man of God prayed to the Lord , and the kings arm was healed, as it was before.

dag: Tumo ni daa kana ti yɛl o, Bɛ zaŋ naa bidibisi maa zuɣuri na, o daa yɛlimi, Zaŋmiya li sɔŋ duya ayi tiŋ ŋɔ dunol ni hal ka biɛɣu ti neei.
en: A messenger came and told Jehu, They have brought the heads of the kings sons. He responded, Pile them in two stacks at the entrance of the gate where they will stay until morning.

dag: N di yuya ni a zaŋ ma sɔɣi kpiimba biɛhigu shee, ka a zaŋ ma sɔɣi nimaani hal ka a suhu ti maai, ka a di zali ma saha shɛli a ni yɛn teei n yɛla.
en: Please hide me, God, deep in the ground— and when you are angry no more, remember to rescue me.

dag: Amaa Naawuni nambɔzɔbo galisiya, ka o yurilim gba galisi zaŋ chaŋ ti polo.
en: But God was merciful! We were dead because of our sins, but God loved us so much he made us alive with Christ, and God's gift of undeserved grace is what saves you.

dag: Yawɛ wumdi nandaamba suhigu, ka bi tamd o niriba bɛn be sarika ni yɛla.
en: because the LORD listens to the needy and doesnt despise his captives.

dag: ni bɛ ti yɛli ŋun Juda naa Hɛzɛkia maa: Di chɛ ka a ni zaŋ amaŋ dalim a Naawuni so maa yɔhim a n-lo a alikauli yɛri ni Asiria naa ku ŋme n-deei Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Don't trust your God or be fooled by his promise to defend Jerusalem against me.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli anabi Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ Filistianim poli pɔi ka Firawuna daa naanyi ti liri Gazanima m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is the message from the Lord that came to Jeremiah the prophet about the Philistines. This message came before Pharaoh attacked the city of Gaza.

dag: Dɔbba ŋɔ mi nyɛla bɛn tɛha bie ni bɛn yɛda niŋbu pa alali. Janeez mini Jambireez ni daa chihi Anabi Musa yɛligu shɛm la, lala ka bɛ gba chihiri din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli;.
en: These people oppose the truth in the same way that Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses. Their minds are corrupt and their faith is counterfeit.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi yɛli, Yinim bɛn zaa tumdi tuma ka di fukumsi ʒi tibisa ʒi yi zuɣu, kamiya n sanna, ka n ti tin ya vuhim.
en: Come to me, all of you who are tired from carrying heavy loads, and I will give you rest.

dag: ka zaŋ chi sara mini wain sara pahi naɣilabihi maa mini piɛlahi ni piɛbihi pola maa zuɣu kaman bɛ kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: You must also give the right amount of grain and drink offerings with the bulls, rams, and lambs.

dag: Naawuni, tiligim Izraɛlnim bɛ wahala zaa ni.
en: From all their troubles, O God, save your people Israel!.

dag: Lan bomiya zim viɛlli din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ata n-niŋ kpam ŋmiri li ka di leei chi sara m-pahi naɣilaa kam zuɣu; ka lan zaŋ zim viɛlli din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ayi n-niŋ kpam ŋmiri li ka di leei chi sara m-pahi piɛla yino zuɣu;.
en: Use three-tenths of fine flour for a grain offering mixed with oil for each bull, two-tenths of fine flour for a grain offering mixed with oil for each ram.

dag: N ni yɛri ya shɛm ŋɔ, sokam zaa ka n yɛra, Di gbihiriya.
en: What I say to you, I say to all: Stay alert.

dag: O ni daa ti nya Napaɣ Ɛsta ka o ʒe zɔŋ maa ni maa, ka o suhu gbaag o, ka o kpuɣ o salima nam jaaŋgbee din be o nuu ni maa tir o. Ka Ɛsta daa chaŋ ti shihi jaaŋgbee maa zuɣu ni.
en: He was happy to see Esther, and he held out the gold scepter to her. When Esther came up and touched the tip of the scepter.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛhiɛl bia Shɛkania ŋun daa yi Ɛlam daŋ ni na la daa yɛli Ɛzra, Tinima n-zaɣisi ti Naawuni noli ka kpuɣ tinzun paɣiba tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ niriba sani, amaa di zaa yoli, Izraɛlnim na kul mali tahima.
en: Then Shecaniah son of Jehiel, one of the descendants of Elam, spoke to Ezra and said, We have not been faithful to our God. We have married the people living around us. But, even though we have done this, there is still hope for Israel.

dag: Ka malaikanim bɛn zaa daa ʒe n-gili nam ʒiishee maa mini kpamba la ni binnɛma anahi la daa gbani nam ʒiishee maa tooni n-jɛmdi Naawuni.
en: The elders and the four living beings were there. All the angels were standing around them and the throne. The angels bowed down on their faces before the throne and worshiped God.

dag: Dama ŋunkam suhira, o deerimi; ka ŋunkam bɔra, o nyarimi; ka ŋunkam mi niŋdi gaafara, o nyarila soli kpɛra.
en: Everyone who asks, receives. Whoever seeks, finds. To everyone who knocks, the door is opened.

dag: Bomiya Yawɛ min o kpiɔŋ; ka suhimiy o sahakam.
en: Trust the Lord and his mighty power. Worship him always.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yi diri nam, niriba malila suhupiɛlli, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri yi su fukumsi, niriba fabindimi.
en: When justice rules a nation, everyone is glad; when injustice rules, everyone groans.

dag: Ka Mariama daa zaŋ tulaale alali lita pirigili ka Yisa sanna ti booi li niŋ o naba, ka zaŋ o zabiri nyɛhinyɛhi o naba maa, ka tulaale maa nyom deei yili maa zaa. Bɛ ni booni ti shɛli naad la ka bɛ daa zaŋ mali tulaale maa, ka di mali shaara pam.
en: Mary took a very expensive bottle of perfume and poured it on Jesus' feet. She wiped them with her hair, and the sweet smell of the perfume filled the house.

dag: Kɔhat bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Aminadab mini Kɔra ni Asir.
en: Kohaths family: his son Amminadab, his son Korah, his son Assir.

dag: Bɛ ni teei gili yinim ninvuɣ shɛb ŋɔ, kpuɣimiya yi daadiikunim tiŋgban ni.
en: I said to the people of Judah, Gather your things; you are surrounded.

dag: Ka maligumaana Aduna daa du Hɔr Zoli maa zuɣu nti kpi nimaani kaman Yawɛ ni daa zal o shɛm. Izraɛlnim ni daa yi Ijipti na nyaaŋa zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihinahi puuni gol so ŋun pahir anu dahin yini dali n-daa bala.
en: That's where the Lord commanded Aaron the priest to go to the top of the mountain. Aaron died there on the first day of the fifth month, years after the Israelites left Egypt.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabiyurisi bɛn nyɛ n suhu ni kul ye shɛb nyabu zuɣu la, yinima n-nyɛ bɛn chɛ ka m mali suhupiɛlli, ka nyuri bara yi zuɣu. M mabiyurisi, bamiya zani viɛnyɛliŋga ti Duuma ni!.
en: My dear brothers and sisters, I love you and want to see you. You bring me joy and make me proud of you. Continue following the Lord as I have told you.

dag: ka o daa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni yɛli ni bɛ di yɛli so o yɛla.
en: But he ordered them not to spread the word about him.

dag: Maligumaaniba daa ʒi m-bɔhi, Yawɛ lee be ya? Zaligubaŋdiba daa bi mi ma, ka nanim tum din bi tuhi n-jɛndi ma. Ka anabinim daa mali Baal yuli tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa, ka doli binshɛŋa din ka ba nyɔri.
en: The priests who teach my laws don't care to know me. Your leaders rebel against me; your prophets give messages from Baal and worship false gods.

dag: Nyin Bɛtilihɛm, tiŋ din be Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni ŋɔ, a pala tin bila Juda nabihi sani, dama a ni ka na so ŋun ni su n niriba Izraɛlnim ni ti yina. .
en: Bethlehem in the land of Judah, you are by no means the least of the leading cities of Judah; for from you will come a leader who will guide my people Israel.

dag: Amaa ka dindali maa biɛɣu daa ti neerina, ka Naawuni chɛ ka zunzuli lu yɔɣili maa zuɣu ŋ-ŋub li ka di kpi.
en: but early the next morning the Lord sent a worm to chew on the vine, and the vine dried up.

dag: Yawɛ, di tam Ɛdomnim ni daa yɛli shɛm Jɛrusalɛm lubu dal la yɛla. Bɛ daa kul yɛrimi, Daamiya li luhi! Daamiya li luhi zaa.
en: Our Lord , punish the Edomites! On the day Jerusalem fell, they shouted, Completely destroy the city! Tear down every building.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiri ni tinim kul bela kum barina ni ni di chɛ ka yinim mali nyɛvili.
en: So death is working in us, but the result is that life is working in you.

dag: Ka Mikaya lan yɛl o, Dinzuɣu wummi Yawɛ yɛtɔɣa. N daa nyala Yawɛ ka o ʒi o nam ʒiishee alizanda ni, ka malaikanim zaa ʒe o nudirigu min o nuzaa polo;.
en: Micaiah went on: Now listen to what the Lord says! I saw the Lord sitting on his throne in heaven, with all his angels standing beside him.

dag: ka din pah awɛi gbaai Jɛshua, ka din pahi pia gbaai Shɛkania.
en: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb beni n-yɛri noli tiri bɛ banima, ka bi paɣiri bɛ manima.
en: There are people who curse their fathers and do not show their appreciation for their mothers.

dag: Di simdi ka a ti zaŋ piɛlaa maa kpam min o zuli ni kpam ni o nyɔri kpam ni o saba ni o yaannina ayi ni di kpam ni o nudirigu gbalipuɣili, dama o nyɛla maligumaaniba leebu piɛlaa.
en: Then take the fat from the ram. Take the fat from around the tail and the fat that covers the organs inside the body. Then take the fat that covers the liver, both kidneys and the fat on them, and the right leg.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka yi dimnim nyaŋ ya. Yi ni ti doli so yini chaŋ ni yi ti tuhi ba, amaa ka ni ti ŋmaligi bɛ sani n-zo n-doli soya ayopɔin. Yi ni ti leei dunia nanim zaa ni je shɛba.
en: The Lord will give your enemies victory over you. You will attack them from one direction, but you will run from them in all directions, and all the people on earth will be terrified when they see what happens to you.

dag: Ka Liya daa yɛli, N suhu paligiya! Dama paɣiba ni boli ma suhupiɛlli; ka daa boli bia maa yuli Asha.
en: and Leah said, How happy I am! Now women will call me happy; so she named him Asher.

dag: Ti ni daa be Tabɛra mini Masa ni Kiburɔtihataava la gba, yi daa lan chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisimi.
en: You also made the Lord angry when you were staying at Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth-Hattaavah.

dag: dama Manaasa bipuɣinsi daa deei tiŋgbana pah o bidibisi zuɣu. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Giliad ti Manaasa zuliya niriba bɛn kpalim la.
en: since his female descendants as well as his male descendants were assigned land. The land of Gilead was assigned to the rest of the descendants of Manasseh.

dag: O ni tooi di o Naawuni bindir shɛli din nyɛ zaɣ kasi zaa la mini din nyɛ zaɣ kasi la.
en: Such a man may eat the food offered to me, both the holy food offering and the very holy food offering.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ti yɛli Musa, Siɣimi ti saɣisi niriba maa, di yi pa lala bɛ ni kab kana ni bɛ ti nya man Yawɛ, ka bɛ pam ni kpi.
en: and the Lord said to him, Go down and warn the people not to cross the boundary to come and look at me; if they do, many of them will die.

dag: Yaakubu zuliya ni ti ŋmanila buɣim; ka Yisifu zuliya mi ŋmani buɣimniɛm. Iso zuliya ni ti ŋmanila kaɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni niŋ buɣim nyo ka di di zaa; ka Iso zuliya maa ni ninvuɣ yino gba ku tiligi. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Israel will be a fire, and Edom will be straw going up in flames. The Lord has spoken!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa tuhi Midiannim maa kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm n-ku dɔbba zaa.
en: The Israelites fought against the Midianites, just as the Lord had commanded Moses. They killed all the men.

dag: Ka maligumaana Jɛhɔiada daa zaŋ kpana mini nyɔtaɣirisi din daa nyɛ Naa Dauda dini, ka be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni n-ti sapashinnim maa.
en: and he gave spears and shields to the captains. These were the spears and shields David put in the Lord s Temple.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti doli soya ŋɔ n-jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Don't worship the Lord your God in the way those nations worship their gods.

dag: Bɛ ni daa sab Shuham zuliya niriba maa ninvuɣ shɛb zaa yuya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihiyɔbunaanahi ni kɔbisinahi.
en: There were many family groups in the Shuhamite tribe. The total number of men was .

dag: Amaa di nyɛ ma la talahi ni n gbaai soli zuŋɔ ni biɛɣuni zaŋ chaŋ dali; dama anabi bi kɔŋd o nyɛvili luɣ shɛli ka pa ni Jɛrusalɛm.
en: However, its necessary for me to travel today, tomorrow, and the next day because its impossible for a prophet to be killed outside of Jerusalem.

dag: Amaa nyin bi taɣira, ka a yuma mi ka tariga.
en: But you are the one! Your years never end!.

dag: Musa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza ni daa sab ninvuɣ shɛb yuya saha shɛli bɛ ni daa kali Izraɛlnim Mɔab bɔpiɛligu ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili yaɣili Jɛriko tooni polo la m-bala.
en: These are the ones whom Moses and Eleazar the priest enrolled. They enrolled the Israelites on the plains of Moab by the Jordan opposite Jericho.

dag: ka yi yi ti doli n ni zaani ya zaligu shɛŋa zaa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga, ka yuri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ka dol o soya sahakam, dindina yi ni tooi pii fɔntins ata pahi tins ata maa zuɣu.
en: as long as you keep all this commandment that I am giving you right now by doing it, by loving the LORD your God, and by always walking in his ways—you can add three more cities for your use along with the first three.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ yinima ninvuɣ shɛb zaa n ni daa chɛ ka bɛ gbahi Jɛrusalɛm n-kuli Babilɔn la wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm:.
en: You people are captives. I forced you to leave Jerusalem and go to Babylon. So listen to the message from the Lord .

dag: tiŋgbani daa dammi, ka saa mi Sinai Zoli zuɣu nyin Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ ninni.
en: the earth shook! Yes, heaven poured down before God, the one from Sinai— before God, the God of Israel!.

dag: Yawɛ ni yu shɛlikam, dina ka o niŋda zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ ni, ni teekunim ni mini kɔbula zaa ni.
en: The LORD can do whatever he wants in heaven or on earth, in the seas and in every ocean depth.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o min o mabihi ni o ma ni o nyaandoliba daa chaŋ Kapɛrinium n-daa ti niŋ daba ayi nimaani.
en: After this, Jesus and his mother, his brothers, and his disciples went down to Capernaum and stayed there for a few days.

dag: ka o daa dɔɣ o paɣisar dɔɣim bidibiga n-zaŋ chinchini pil o sɔŋ wɔrimɔri piɛɣu ni, dama bɛ daa bi nya palo saamba yilikpɛrili ni.
en: She gave birth to her first son, wrapped him in cloths and laid him in a manger—there was no room for them to stay in the inn.

dag: Ka di daa ti lu Naa Hɛrɔd dɔɣim dabisili dali, ka Hɛrɔdias bipuɣiŋga yi salo ni na nti wa waa ka di niŋ Naa Hɔrɔd nyaɣisim pam.
en: On Herods birthday, the daughter of Herodias danced for him and his group. Herod was very pleased with her.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ tariga ka m be ka kuhiri boon a n nandahima saha maa. Zaŋm ma tahi kuɣ shɛli din du n-gari ma gbini.
en: I feel hopeless, and I cry out to you from a faraway land. Lead me to the mighty rock high above me.

dag: Shɛb mali bɛ tab paɣiba doon a ni, ka shɛb mi tumdi daɣiri tuma, ka mali bɛ bihi paɣiba doon a ni, ka shɛb mi mali bɛ tizɔpaɣiba bɛn nyɛ bɛ manim nyintahi bipuɣinsi doon a ni.
en: Some commit adultery, and others seduce their daughters-in-law or their half sisters.

dag: amaa yi ni kpi kaman sal kam ni kpiri shɛm; ka yi nyɛviya zani tariga kaman naa kam la.
en: But you will die like mortals; your life will end like that of any prince.

dag: Di saha ka Bɔaz daa yɛli Rut, M bia, chɛ ka n nyih a, di lan chaŋ so puu ni nti yihi kayiha ka pa ni m puu ŋɔ ni. Kul be paɣiba ŋɔ sani kpe n-tumm a tuma.
en: Boaz went over to Ruth and said, I think it would be best for you not to pick up grain in anyone else's field. Stay here with the women.

dag: O daa ku do shɛb bɛn daa kpalim be o ba Asa ʒiɛman ni, ka nyɛ bɛn laɣim tumdi dagɔr tuma la.
en: Jehoshaphat forced all the men and women who sold their bodies for sex to leave the places of worship. They had served in these places of worship while his father Asa was king.

dag: Ka Jɛrɔbɔam daa zal omaŋmaŋ maligumaaniba buɣa jɛmbu shee ni bɛ jɛmd o ni daa mali bu so mini naɣisa so zali, ka di nyɛ o buɣili la.
en: having appointed his own priests for the shrines and the goat and calf idols he had made.

dag: Yɛm ni ti gul a, ka yɛla baŋbu gba taɣ a.
en: Discretion will guard you; understanding will protect you.

dag: Yi zaa laɣim ʒiɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ tooni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Yi daŋ ni kpamba mini yi zuɣulaannim ni yi sapashin kpamba ni Izraɛl dɔbba zaa.
en: Today all of you are standing here before the Lord your God. Your leaders, your officials, your elders, and all the other men are here.

dag: Ka bɛ ni shɛb yi daa bi ʒe yim, di wuhiri ni Naawuni mi bi ʒe yim?.
en: It is true that some of them did not believe the message. But does this mean that God cannot be trusted, just because they did not have faith?.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni ti tum ŋun tim ma na maa tuma ni nyɛ shɛli wuntaŋ ni na be ŋɔ, dama yuŋ ni zibi ka so ku lan tooi tum tuma yaha.
en: While its daytime, we must do the works of him who sent me. Night is coming when no one can work.

dag: N daa mali suhupiɛlli o dunia din pali binnɛma ŋɔ zuɣu, ka mali suhupiɛlli ninsalinim zuɣu.
en: frolicking with his inhabited earth and delighting in the human race.

dag: Binshɛɣukam neesim ni yihi palɔni, di biɛhigu maŋli gba yirimi do palɔni; dama binshɛɣukam din yi n-do palɔni gba leela neesim.
en: But everything exposed to the light is revealed by the light.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ n ni sɔɣiri so sani. A nyɛla ŋun gbib ma wahala ni, ka chɛ ka faako yila gili ma.
en: You are my hiding place; you will save me from trouble. I sing aloud of your salvation, because you protect me.

dag: ni bɛ daa saɣiya ni ŋunkam mali dabili ka o nyɛ Hiburu nira, doo bee paɣa, ŋun bahim o din ni chɛ ka Izraɛl nira ku lan zaŋ o mabia Izraɛl nira n-leeg o dabili.
en: Everyone was supposed to free their Hebrew slaves. All male and female Hebrew slaves were to be set free. No one was supposed to keep another person from the tribe of Judah in slavery.

dag: ka Rubin bidibisi daa nyɛ: Hanok mini Pallu ni Hɛzirɔn ni Karimi.
en: Reubens sons were Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

dag: Tuhimi yɛda tɔbu la tuhiri suŋ; gbib nyɛvili din ka bahigu shɛli zuɣu Naawuni ni daa bol a, ka a niŋ shɛhira suŋ ka kahigi di yɛla wuhi shɛhiranim pam san la.
en: Fight a good fight for the faith and claim eternal life. God offered it to you when you clearly told about your faith, while so many people listened.

dag: Ka naa daa bahi noli ni bɛ niŋm lala, ka daa chɛ ka bɛ zali zaligu Susa tiŋ puuni. Ka bɛ daa shiri zaŋ Haman bidibisi maa ti yili gar dari.
en: So the king gave the command that it should be done. So the law was given in Susa, and they hanged Hamans ten sons.

dag: Di saha ka n daa pii maligumaaniba zuɣulaannima: Shɛrɛbia mini Hashabia ni bɛ dɔɣiriba ninvuɣ pia m-pahi.
en: I chose twelve of the leading priests—Sherebiah, Hashabiah and ten of their relatives.

dag: N ni zaŋ ko viɛlli mihi ya ka yi yi yi daɣiri zaa ni mini yi buɣ jɛmbo zaa ni.
en: I will sprinkle clean water on you and make you clean from all your idols and everything else that has defiled you.

dag: N ŋmanila tikpiralana, m bi tooi wumda, ka ŋmani birigu ŋun ku tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa.
en: I am like the deaf and cannot hear, like the dumb and cannot speak.

dag: N yuli zuɣu ka n chɛ ka n suhu bi yiɣisi. M paɣibu zuɣu ka n gbaai mmaŋa ni di chɛ ka n ku kun ya.
en: In order that people will praise my name, I am holding my anger in check; I am keeping it back and will not destroy you.

dag: Ka n daa nya shi biɛr ata bɛn ŋmani poloya, ka bɛ yiri waɣ biɛ tital la mini biŋkɔbigu la ni anabi ʒirilan la noya ni na.
en: Then I saw three unclean spirits, like frogs, come from the dragons mouth, the beasts mouth, and the mouth of the false prophet.

dag: So miri ka o laɣim paɣ min o bipuɣiŋga dɔni, ka miri ka o bo o bidibiga bipuɣiŋga bee o bipuɣiŋga mi bipuɣiŋga, bɛ nyɛla paɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ o dɔɣiriba ni yɛlimaŋli. Lala nyɛla zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Do not have intercourse with the daughter or granddaughter of a woman with whom you have had intercourse; they may be related to you, and that would be incest.

dag: Bashan Zoli din galisi, Bashan Zoli din mali chunchuna pam.
en: Our Lord and our God, Bashan is a mighty mountain covered with peaks.

dag: Di bi simdi ni ti be kaman Keen ŋun daa nyɛ Sintani nira ka ku o mabia la. Bɔzuɣu ka o daa lee ku o? Di nyɛla o tuma ni daa bi tuhi ka o mabia maa ŋun tuma tuhi la zuɣu.
en: Don't be like Cain, who belonged to the devil and murdered his own brother. Why did he murder him? He did it because his brother was good, and he was evil.

dag: A zaŋla a nini kpa lala nira? A zaŋ ma mi na ni a ti kari ma saria?.
en: And so, I ask you, God, why pick on me?.

dag: Di gbihi bee m-pɔb a nini.
en: Dont give sleep to your eyes or slumber to your eyelids.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Musa daa kali Izraɛlnim bidibikpamba zaa kaman Yawɛ ni daa zal o shɛm.
en: Moses enrolled all the oldest males of the Israelites as the LORD commanded.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Ŋunkam yih o paɣa ka kpuɣi paɣ so tum zina o ni yihi paɣ so maa sani.
en: He said to them, A man who divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery against his wife.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa kana ti paai Zin yɔɣu ni gol so ŋun daŋ tooni puuni n-ʒini Kadɛshi. Ka Miriam daa kpi nimaani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o nimaani.
en: In the first month, the entire Israelite community entered the Zin desert and the people stayed at Kadesh. Miriam died and was buried there.

dag: dindina yi mini Izraɛlnim zaa yin baŋmiya ni Yisa Masia Nazarɛt ninvuɣ so yi ni daa kpahi tabili dapulli zuɣu ka Naawuni neeg o kum ni la yuli zuɣu ka do so ŋun yi nyɛ gbarigu ŋɔ ti ʒe yi sani ni alaafee ŋɔ.
en: If so, then you and all the people of Israel need to know that this man stands healthy before you because of the name of Jesus Christ the Nazarene—whom you crucified but whom God raised from the dead.

dag: Ka Jɛhiɛl bia Obadia daa nyɛ Jɔab daŋ zuɣulana, ka dɔbba kɔbisiyi ni pisaayika daa pah o zuɣu.
en: from the descendants of Joab: Obadiah son of Jehiel, and other men;.

dag: Dinzuɣu n shia ni paɣ a, ka ku shini. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, n kul ni paɣir a sahakam.
en: You wanted me to praise you and not be silent. Lord my God, I will praise you forever!.

dag: ni binyaannina ayi la mini kpam din be binshee ni, ka yihi binsabili yaɣ shɛli din viɛl pahi binyaannin shɛŋa o ni yihi maa zuɣu, ka di leei o ni zaŋ sara shɛli nyo buɣim ti Yawɛ.
en: the kidneys and the fat on them, and the best part of the liver.

dag: Dinzuɣu miri ka a nyu wain bee binnyuri kpiɔŋ; a mi miri ka a di binshɛli din chihiri dibu;.
en: Now be careful not to drink wine or brandy or to eat anything that is ritually unclean.

dag: Mbusim be n zuɣu, n ni nya biɛrim shɛli zuɣu. N daŋ maa yaɣiya! Amaa ka n yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, n tibidarigibo m-bala, di kpala talahi ni n deei li.
en: The people of Jerusalem cried out, How badly we are hurt! Our wounds will not heal. And we thought this was something we could endure!.

dag: Wuhimiya ma yi paɣ bɔbo puhigu liɣiri ni nyɛ shɛm, ka yi yi ni saɣi ka n kpuɣ o, n ni tin ya yi ni kul yɛli ni n tin ya shɛm zaa.
en: Tell me what presents you want, and set the payment for the bride as high as you wish; I will give you whatever you ask, if you will only let me marry her.

dag: Di ni nyɛ zaɣ muni la di pun ka buchi, bɛ ni ti yɛri ni buɣim di li ka di niŋ sala? Bɛ ni tooi zaŋ li niŋ binshɛli yaha.
en: It was useless even before it was burned. Now that the fire has burned it and charred it, it is even more useless.

dag: sapashini maa daa yɛlila Naawuni nir maa, Hal Yawɛ yi yooi zuɣusaa soya bahi gba, lala ku tooi niŋ! Ka Naawuni nir maa yɛl o, A nini sa ni nya bindirigu maa, amaa ka a noli lee ku to li.
en: But that officer had answered the man of God, Even if the Lord made windows in heaven, this could not happen! And Elisha had told the officer, You will see it with your own eyes, but you will not eat any of that food.

dag: Ka Sool daa ti wum ni bɛ nya Dauda mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o san la. Di saha maa ŋun Sool daa ʒila ti shɛli din yuli booni tamarisik la gbini Gibia Zoli zuɣu, ka o kpani be o nuu ni ka o sapashin kpamba zaa ʒe n-gil o.
en: One day Saul was in Gibeah, sitting under a tamarisk tree on a hill, with his spear in his hand, and all his officers were standing around him. He was told that David and his men had been located.

dag: Di saha ka Musa mini Aduna daa niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni zali ba shɛm maa Firawuna min o kpamba ninni, O daa yaag o jaaŋgbee maa n-fiɛbi kom din daa be Nail Mɔɣili maa ni, ka di zaa daa shiri leei ʒim.
en: Then Moses and Aaron did as the Lord commanded. In the presence of the king and his officers, Aaron raised his stick and struck the surface of the river, and all the water in it was turned into blood.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ka n nyari zaɣ biɛɣu niŋbu mini yɛlimuɣisira? Saɣiŋgu mini damli dambu kul bela n tooni; ka zabili mini suhuyiɣisili kul yiɣisira.
en: People are stealing things and hurting others. They are arguing and fighting. Why do you make me look at these terrible things?.

dag: Zaŋmi gbantolima mini dapua m-mali naɣikɔra dapua n-zaŋ pa a nyiŋgoli zuɣu.
en: to make myself a yoke out of leather straps and wooden crossbars and to put it on my neck.

dag: Ka Naa maa yɛli, Amaa n nya ka niriba anahi n-lɔrigi be buɣim maa sunsuuni chani ginda, ka shɛli bi niŋ ba; ka ŋun pah anahi maa ŋmanila wuni.
en: The king said, Look! I see four men walking around in the fire. They are not tied up and they are not burned. The fourth man looks like an angel. .

dag: ka di pɔri gari tibiɛlinli kam la, amaa di yi ti zooi, di galisirimi gari tutuɣ kam m-mal ti leei tia, hal ka noonsi kanna nti tɛri bɛ tɛri di wula zuɣu.
en: Its the smallest of all seeds. But when its grown, its the largest of all vegetable plants. It becomes a tree so that the birds in the sky come and nest in its branches.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋun bi guni, amaa ka doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa ni wuhi shɛm, Naawuni ku lih o kaman ŋun guni?.
en: If the Gentile, who is not circumcised, obeys the commands of the Law, will not God regard him as though he were circumcised?.

dag: N ku chɛn ya, n ku zɔn ya nambɔɣu. N ni darigi yi tibili kaman yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm saha shɛli yi ni tum din chihiri shɛli maa ni na be yi kɔbili ni maa. Di saha yi ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun darigiri niriba tibili.
en: Your sins are so terrible, that you'll get no mercy from me. Then you will know that I, the Lord , have punished you.

dag: Nir yi na bi wum yɛtɔɣili bahigu ka daŋ garigibu, di nyɛla jɛrilim mini vi.
en: Those who answer before they listen are foolish and disgraceful.

dag: dama m mi ni yi wunsuhigu mini Yisa Masia Shia sɔŋsim ni fa ma bahi.
en: Im glad because I know that this will result in my release through your prayers and the help of the Spirit of Jesus Christ.

dag: Amaa ka o daa lee kpalim dɔɣibu maa ni. O ni daa ti yɛn bahi saha shɛli ka o daa boli bia maa yuli Bɛnɔni, amaa ka o ba mi daa bol o yuli Bɛnjamin.
en: Rachel died while giving birth to the son. Before dying, she named the boy Benoni. But Jacob called him Benjamin.

dag: Dama Yawɛ galisiya, ka simdi paɣibu din galisi. Di simdi ka ti lur o sizuura gari wuni kam.
en: The Lord is great and worthy of praise. He is more awesome than any of the gods.

dag: ka zaŋ gbana lo bɛ shɛhi ni, ka vili baŋtab viɛla, bɛ zaa daa ŋmanila sapashinnima. Bɛ daa nyɛla Babilɔnnima bɛn daa nyɛ Kalidia tiŋbihi la.
en: They had belts around their waists and large turbans on their heads, and they reminded her of Babylonian cavalry officers.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Niŋmiya ma naani ka labina nti nya kpiɔŋ ka tiligi. Amaa ka yi zaɣisi.
en: The holy Lord God of Israel had told all of you, I will keep you safe if you turn back to me and calm down. I will make you strong if you quietly trust me. Then you stubbornly.

dag: Yi mi dɔɣimiya bihi pam, ka bɛ nabi pali dunia ŋɔ.
en: You must have many children, so that your descendants will live all over the earth.

dag: ni Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili kpahi mini dundɔŋ maa kpahi ni di mihi.
en: the pegs used to support the Tent and the wall of curtains around the courtyard, and the ropes that tie to the pegs;.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Gaad ŋun daa nyɛ Dauda daanab la.
en: The Lord said to Gad, one of David's prophets.

dag: bɛna n-ni tiligi. Bɛ biɛhigu shee ni ti nyɛla zoya din du pam zuɣu, ka bɛ sɔɣibu shee ti nyɛ kuɣa birininim puuni, ka bɛ ti tiri ba bindirigu mini kom.
en: They will live safely in high places. They will be protected in high rock fortresses. They will always have food and water.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Ijiptinim maa niŋ ba nirilim. Musa daa nyɛla ninvuɣ titali Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni ni Firawuna min o kpamba ni o niriba sani.
en: The Lord made the Egyptians respect the Israelites. Indeed, the officials and all the people considered Moses to be a very great man.

dag: Ka yinim Judanima, n zali yi gba dabisili, saha shɛli n yi ti yɛn labisi n niriba daazichi ti ba.
en: And as for you, people of Judah, I have set a time to punish you also for what you are doing.

dag: Ti ni daa doli ti niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu la, Naawuni fukumsi zaligu daa chɛ ka ti kɔr biɛri yiɣisi, ka ti tumdi tuun shɛŋa din nyɛ kum dini ti niŋgbuŋ yaɣili kam ni.
en: When we thought only of ourselves, the Law made us have sinful desires. It made every part of our bodies into slaves who are doomed to die.

dag: Dama saha shɛli kanna ka niriba ti ku lan deeri wuhibu maŋli, amaa ka ni dolila bɛmaŋmaŋ kɔre soli n-kul bɔrila karimbanim bɛn ni wuhiri wuhibu shɛŋa din niŋdi ba nyaɣisim pahira.
en: The time will come when people will not listen to sound doctrine, but will follow their own desires and will collect for themselves more and more teachers who will tell them what they are itching to hear.

dag: Dinzuɣu chama, n ni be a nol ni n-wuh a a ni ti yɛn yɛli shɛm.
en: Now go! Ill help you speak, and Ill teach you what you should say.

dag: Ka Zadok bia Ahimaaz daa lan yɛli, Di yi kul nyɛ shɛlikam, nyin chɛ ka n gba zo n-doli Kush nir maa nyaaŋa. Ka Jɔab yɛl o, M bia, bɔzuɣu ka a lee bɔr ni a zo n-kuli nti ti lahibal maa, dama a mi ni a bi yɛn nya shɛli di zuɣu.
en: Ahimaaz insisted, I don't care what happens; please let me take the news also. Why do you want to do it, my son? Joab asked. You will get no reward for it.

dag: Yi ni ti nyɛ n niriba, ka m mi nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: You will be my people, and I will be your God. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Kul paɣimiya ti Ba Naawuni binshɛɣukam zaa puuni sahakam ti Duuma Yisa Masia yuli zuɣu.
en: Always use the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to thank God the Father for everything.

dag: N ni zaŋ mmaŋ pa talima o zuɣu, ka a ti bɔh o yɛla n sani. N yi ti bi ʒi o labina ti ti a, nyin chɛ ka di taali kul ʒi n zuɣu sahakam.
en: I will make sure he is safe. I will be responsible for him. If I dont bring him back to you, you can blame me forever.

dag: Ka o lan maa yi be katiŋa bee a yi bi mi o lana, dindina nyin taɣim o kul a yiŋa, ka o ti be a sani hal ka o lan maa ti bɔh o yɛla, ka a zaŋ o ti o.
en: If the owner doesnt live nearby, or you dont know who owns the animal, then you must take care of it. It should stay with you until your fellow Israelite comes looking for it, at which point you must return it to him.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa bɔb gbaag o tizo Bɛnjamin n-zaŋ o zuɣu pa o nyiŋgoli zuɣu kum pam; ka Bɛnjamin gba daa zaŋ o zuɣu pa o nyiŋgoli zuɣu kum pam.
en: Then Joseph hugged his brother Benjamin, and they both began crying.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni ka yɛli ba, Dɔɣimiya ka wɔɣi n-nab pali teeku mini dunia.
en: Then God blessed them: Be fertile and multiply and fill the waters in the seas, and let the birds multiply on the earth.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa pihi kuɣa laɣim sɔŋ o gballi maa zuɣu, ka di nyɛ Reechɛl gballi maa kuɣiduli, ka di na kul do nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: Jacob put a special rock on Rachels grave to honor her. That special rock is still there today.

dag: Nimaani ka yi ni ti lihi bo Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ; ka yi yi ti bo o ni yi suhu zaa ni yi shia zaa, yi ni nya o.
en: There you will look for the Lord your God, and if you search for him with all your heart, you will find him.

dag: yin bomiya naɣilaa ti Lɛvinima bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba ka nyɛ Zadok zuliya ni niriba, ka nyɛ bɛn ti yɛn kani n sanna ti tumdi n tuma la, ka bɛ mali sara alahichi zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You will provide a young bull as a purification offering to the levitical priests who are descendants of Zadok, the ones who may draw near to minster to me. This is what the LORD God says.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti yɛli ba, N kul yɛn be yi san la daba ayi kɔŋko ka lan labi ŋun tim ma na maa sani.
en: Therefore, Jesus said, Im still with you for a little while before I go to the one who sent me.

dag: Ka di simdi ni o be o sani yuuni kam kaman padir la. Di bi simdi ka o zaŋ ninkuunsi gbib o yi ninni.
en: as if they had been hired on an annual basis. Their master must not treat them harshly.

dag: ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pun nya n jilima mini n ni pun tum alahiziba tumtumsa shɛŋa Ijipti mini mɔɣu ŋɔ ni, ka zahim ma paai siɣimsiɣim pia, ka zaɣisi n noli ŋɔ.
en: none of these people will live to enter that land. They have seen the dazzling light of my presence and the miracles that I performed in Egypt and in the wilderness, but they have tried my patience over and over again and have refused to obey me.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa ti tim omaŋmaŋ bia ka yɛli, Bɛ ni ti ti m bia ŋɔ ŋun jilima.
en: So the man decided to send his son to the farmers. He said, The farmers will respect my son.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi kawaan daŋda mini yi wain daŋda ni yi kpa daŋda ni yi ni tuui chɛ biŋkɔbiri kɔb shɛŋa ti o.
en: They are to receive the first share of the grain, wine, olive oil, and wool.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm paɣiba, yimiyana. Nyamiya Naa Sulemaana ni pili nam zuɣupil shɛli, di nyɛla o ma ni daa zaŋ nam zuɣupil shɛli pil o, o daamiliya lɔbu dali din daa nyɛ o suhupiɛlli dabisili dal la.
en: Now come and see the crown given to Solomon by his mother on his happy wedding day.

dag: Di saha ka Hɛzɛkia mini Jɛrusalɛmnim daa siɣisi bɛmaŋa o karimbaani maa zuɣu, ka Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili maa daa bi lu bɛ zuɣu Hɛzɛkia ʒiɛmani maa ni.
en: But Hezekiah and the people living in Jerusalem changed their hearts and lives. They became humble and stopped being proud. So the Lord s anger didnt come on them while Hezekiah was alive.

dag: Ka bɛ yi yɛn yihi yili maa daɣiri ni, ŋun zaŋmi noombihi tintiins ayi mini sida dari ni mi ʒee ni taaŋkɔro.
en: To purify the house, he shall take two birds, some cedar wood, a red cord, and a sprig of hyssop.

dag: ka bɔhi ba, Ya polo ka yi lee sɔɣ o? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti Duuma, kamina ti nya ti ni sɔɣ o luɣ shɛli.
en: He asked, Where did you put him? They said, Lord, come and see.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ yɛli, A ni suhi ma ŋɔ zuɣu, n chɛ bɛ taali maa.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses: In answer to your prayer, I do forgive them.

dag: N lan yɛri ya mi ni laakum shɛriga nyee ni kpɛbu mal asama gari bundan Naawuni nam ni kpɛbu.
en: In fact, its easier for a camel to squeeze through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to enter Gods kingdom.

dag: Ka Sool gba daa kul o ya Gibia, ka dɔbba bɛn mali suhukpeeni, ka Naawuni yɛligu maa kpe bɛ suhuri ni daa pahi dol o kuli.
en: Saul also went to his home in Gibeah. God touched the hearts of brave men who then began to follow Saul.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli Pita, Labisim takɔbi maa su di tɔɣu ni! Ka bɔh o, N di nyu pipi shɛli m Ba ni zaŋ ti ma la ni binnyurigu maa.
en: Jesus told Peter, Put your sword away! Am I not to drink the cup the Father has given me.

dag: O doli zaligu soli kariti saria tiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be nahiŋgu ni, ka tiri kum ni mali ninvuɣ shɛba bindirigu. Yawɛ yoori bɛn be sarika ni bahira.
en: who gives justice to people who are oppressed, who gives bread to people who are starving! The LORD: who frees prisoners.

dag: Kalidianim bɛn tuhiri tiŋ ŋɔ maa ni ti kana ti niŋ buɣim dabi li n-nyo li tabili bɛ ni daa tuɣindi tulaale zim tiri Baal, ka boori binnyura bahiri buɣa yiya shɛŋa mɔpila zuɣu n-chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi la.
en: and set it on fire. They will burn it down, together with the houses where people have made me angry by burning incense to Baal on the rooftops and by pouring out wine offerings to other gods.

dag: Di saha Izraɛlnim ni ti pahi Ijiptinim mini Asirianim zuɣu, ka bɛ niŋ zuliya ata niriba; ka bɛ zuɣu chɛ ka dunia zaa nya alibarika.
en: On that day, Israel will be the third along with Egypt and Assyria, a blessing at the center of the world.

dag: o ni daa lo Ibrahimma alikauli shɛl la; o ni daa po pɔri n-lo Yisahaku alikauli shɛli.
en: Remember the agreement he made with Abraham Remember his promise to Isaac.

dag: Di ti maliya buɣim yi biɛhigu shee zaa Vuhim Dabisili maa dali.
en: Dont start a fire in any of your homes on the Sabbath day.

dag: Ŋunkam niŋ nandan nirilim dihila Yawɛ samli, ka o ni ti yo o di zaa.
en: Caring for the poor is lending to the Lord , and you will be well repaid.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Musa mini Aduna ni Nadab ni Abihu ni Izraɛl kpamba pisopɔin maa daa du zoli maa zuɣu.
en: Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of the leaders of Israel went up the mountain.

dag: Ŋuni n-daa lee wuhi Naawuni o soli ni nyɛ shɛm, bee ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yɛli Naawuni, A tum gala?.
en: to guide or correct him.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbaag o n-zaŋ o chaŋ nayili dunɔdali din yuli daa booni wɔhu dunɔdal la gbini nti ku o nimaani.
en: They seized her, took her to the palace, and there at the Horse Gate they killed her.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa chaŋ ni bɛ ti zaŋ o sɔɣi, bɛ daa bi lan nya o, ka naɣ nyala o zuɣuŋmaŋ min o napɔnvari ni o nuchɛhi.
en: But the men who went out to bury her found nothing except her skull and the bones of her hands and feet.

dag: Di saha ka Abimilɛk min o saawaralana Ahuzat ni o sapashin kpɛm Fikol daa yi Gɛra chaŋ Yisahaku sani.
en: Meanwhile, Abimelech had left Gerar and was taking his advisor Ahuzzath and his army commander Phicol to see Isaac.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka bipuɣin kpɛm maa yɛli biasan la, Nyama, Mam mini m ba sa dɔniya yuŋ la, dinzuɣu chɛ ka ti lan niŋ wain maa ti o yuŋ ŋɔ, ka a gba kpe o sani ka a min o ti dɔni, ka di chɛ ka ti nam zuliya o sani zali.
en: The next day the older daughter said to her sister, I slept with my father last night. We'll get him drunk again tonight, so you can sleep with him, and we can each have a child.

dag: Yi napɔna yi ti kul no di luɣ shɛlikam di ni leei yi dini. Yi tintariga ni ti zanila Lɛbanɔn tiŋgban nɛl ni n-zaŋ Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni hal ti paai Wulinluhili polo teeku la ni.
en: All the ground that you march over will be yours. Your territory will extend from the desert in the south to the Lebanon Mountains in the north, and from the Euphrates River in the east to the Mediterranean Sea in the west.

dag: ka guhir o Bia ni o yi alizanda ni labina, ŋuna n-nyɛ o Bia Yisa so o ni daa neei kum ni ka o nyɛ ŋun fa ti Naawuni suhuyiɣisili din ti yɛn kana la ni bahi.
en: and to wait for his Son to come from heaven—his Son Jesus, whom he raised from death and who rescues us from God's anger that is coming.

dag: Ka a ni ti na kul yɛn tɔɣisiri naa yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ saha shɛli maa, n gba ni dol a nyaaŋa kpɛna nti di a shɛhira.
en: While you are still talking to David, I'll come in and tell him that everything you said is true.

dag: A na mi n-siɣi teeku kɔbilnin ni bee n-tam teeku bulli ni tiŋgbani zuɣu chaŋ?.
en: Have you gone to the seas sources, walked in the chamber of the deep?.

dag: Ŋunkam wum yinim bɛn nyɛ n nyaandoliba ŋɔ yɛligu wumla n yɛligu, ka ŋunkam zaɣisi ya zaɣisila mani; ka ŋunkam mi zaɣisi ma zaɣisila ŋun tim ma na.
en: My followers, whoever listens to you is listening to me. Anyone who says No to you is saying No to me. And anyone who says No to me is really saying No to the one who sent me.

dag: Ti daa wum di yɛla la Bɛtilihɛm; ti daa nya li la Jiarim mɔɣu ni.
en: Yes, we heard about it in Ephrathah; we found it in the fields of Jaar.

dag: N Naawuni, teemi n ni niŋ niriba ŋɔ shɛlikam zaa ŋɔ yɛla, ka niŋ ma zaɣ viɛlli.
en: Remember in my favor, my God, all that Ive done for this people!.

dag: Ka o daa lan tɔɣis o daanabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Mbaye, Naawuni yi ti niŋ dimbɔŋɔ, ŋuni n-lee ni be?.
en: Balaam uttered this prophecy: Who are these people gathering in the north?.

dag: Naa daa chɛ ka anzinfa kul yɛrigila Jɛrusalɛm kaman kuɣa la, ka chɛ ka sida dari gba yɛrigi nimaani kaman Shɛfɛla sinsabisi la.
en: While he was king, there was silver everywhere in Jerusalem, and cedar was as common as ordinary sycamore trees in the foothills.

dag: Ka n lan nya shɛli dunia ni, ka di gba nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: Next, I saw under the sun something else that was pointless.

dag: Tinzunnima, Laɣimmiya, ka chɛ ka dabiɛm mali ya. Tin shɛŋa din be katinsinima, wummiya. Lomiya kpara, ka chɛ ka dabiɛm mali ya. Iin, lomiya kpara, ka chɛ ka dabiɛm shiri mali ya.
en: All of you foreign nations, go ahead and prepare for war, but you will be crushed.

dag: Ka Iso bɔh o ba, M ba, ka daɣila alibarika zaɣ yini kɔŋko ka a kul mali? M ba, niŋm alibarika niŋ n gba ni. Ka Iso daa duh o yee kum pam.
en: But Esau continued to beg his father. Do you have only one blessing, father? Bless me also, father! Esau began to cry.

dag: O ni ti wuhi ya jirambisa du kar shɛli bɛ ni pun malimali binshɛɣukam zali, ka yi mali chuɣu maa shili nimaani gul ti.
en: He will show you a large furnished room upstairs, where you will get everything ready.

dag: Yi bi doli yɛlimaŋli soli. Yi soya nyɛla sɔgolima, ka ŋunkam zaa dol li ka suhudoo, dama yi ʒi suhudoo soli.
en: They dont know the way of peace; theres no justice in their paths. They make their roads crooked; no one who walks in them knows peace.

dag: Amaa man yɛri ya mi, ŋunkam yih o paɣa ka di pala pagɔrisigu gɔbu zuɣu, dilana kpɛhil o paɣ maa zina niŋbu ni, ka ŋunkam mi kpuɣ paɣiyihiŋ maa gba niŋ zina.
en: But I say to you that whoever divorces his wife except for sexual unfaithfulness forces her to commit adultery. And whoever marries a divorced woman commits adultery.

dag: Ti ni daa paai Jɛrusalɛm ka ti mabihi la zaŋ ti nti kpɛhi bɛ yinsi ni suhupiɛlli.
en: The brothers and sisters in Jerusalem were very happy to see us.

dag: Yi chɛ Naawuni zaligunima, ka dolila salinim kaya.
en: You disobey God's commands in order to obey what humans have taught.

dag: Gomna Pailɛt ni daa wum bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa ka dabiɛm maan gbaag o pahi;.
en: When Pilate heard this, he was even more afraid.

dag: Miri ka a yɛli noli ti tikpiralana bee n-zaŋ kuɣili sɔŋ zom tooni ni o tuui li, amaa zom a Naawuni. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: You must not insult a deaf person or put some obstacle in front of a blind person that would cause them to trip. Instead, fear your God; I am the LORD.

dag: Amaa a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm yi pɔri ŋɔ taali ni nyɛla a yi chaŋ n dɔɣiriba maa sani, ka bɛ ti zaɣisi ni bɛ ku ti a paɣ na, dindina a yi m pɔri maa taali ni.
en: But if they refuse to let her come back with you, then you are freed from your promise.

dag: Dindali maa ka bɛ daa karim Musa litaafi n-wuhi niriba maa, ka bɛ daa nya di ni luɣ shɛli din sabi yɛli ni di bi simdi ka bɛ chɛ ka Ammɔnnim mini Mɔabnim zaŋ bɛmaŋa m-bali Naawuni niriba ni bɛ laɣiŋgu ni.
en: When the Law of Moses was being read aloud to the people, they came to the passage that said that no Ammonite or Moabite was ever to be permitted to join God's people.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ʒi luɣ shɛŋa kaman bɛ ni daa ŋmahi tiŋgbani maa tari ba shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Aduna bidibisi bɛn daa nyɛ Kɔhat daŋ niriba la n-daa daŋ tiŋgbani deebu.
en: These are the places where Aarons descendants lived. They lived in their camps in the land that was given to them. The Kohath families got the first share of the land that was given to the Levites.

dag: Miri ka a zaŋ a zo bee a ba zo bahi, ka miri ka a ti chaŋ a dɔɣira yiŋa a muɣisigu saha. A ʒiʒiinikpee ŋun be yoma so a mabihi bɛn be katiŋa.
en: Dont desert your friend or a friend of your family; dont go to your relatives house when disaster strikes. Better a neighbor nearby than a relative far away.

dag: Ka salo maa bɔh o, Ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ.
en: The people asked John, What should we do.

dag: Dauda ni daa nya ka malaika maa kuri niriba maa, di saha ka o daa yɛli Yawɛ, Nyama, n tum taali, Mani n-tum zaɣ biɛɣ maa, ka bɔ ka piɛri ŋɔ mi lee niŋ? Dinzuɣu n suhir a mi, darigim la m mini n daŋ niriba kɔŋko tibili.
en: David saw the angel who was killing the people, and said to the Lord , I am the guilty one. I am the one who did wrong. What have these poor people done? You should punish me and my family.

dag: N niriba ŋmanila wubiga ka tɔra laɣim gili ni bɛ di o. Cham ti laɣim mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri zaa, n-zaŋ ba na ka bɛ ti ŋub o.
en: My chosen people are like a bird attacked from all sides by hawks. Call the wild animals to come and join in the feast!.

dag: Ka o daa ŋmaligi yɛli bɛn ʒe nimaani maa, Deemiya pɔŋli maa o sani n-zaŋ pahi ŋun mali pɔŋ pia la.
en: He said to his attendants, Take his money and give it to the one who has ten times as much.

dag: Bɛ yi pooi dabili o bilim ni, di bahigu ti ku viɛla.
en: Slaves that you treat kindly from their childhood will cause you sorrow.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla Hiburɔn din be Juda tiŋgban ni mini di momaha tiŋgbana din gil li la ti ba.
en: they gave Hebron in the land of Judah with its surrounding pasturelands.

dag: ka dabiɛm mini niŋgbuŋ sɔhibu daa paai ma din daa dam n kɔba ni zaa.
en: I trembled and shuddered; my whole body shook with fear.

dag: Di saha ka malaika ŋun pah ayɔbu daa piɛb o kikaa, ka n wum ka kukol shɛli yi salima bimbin shɛli din do Naawuni tooni la yila anahi ni na.
en: The sixth angel blew his trumpet. Then I heard a voice coming from the horns on the four corners of the golden altar that is before God.

dag: Nir yi daŋ deeg o fali yomyom piligu ni, di bahigu ti ka anfaani.
en: Inheritance gained quickly at first wont bless later on.

dag: kaman yuun kɔbisinahi ni pihinu. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa ti ba zuɣulaannima m-mali hal ti paai Anabi Samuɛl saha.
en: All of this took about years. After this he gave them judges until the time of the prophet Samuel.

dag: ka Sabinim kana ti lu bɛ zuɣu n-zaŋ takɔbi ku tumtumdiba maa ka taɣi ba chaŋ, n kɔŋko n-nyɛ ŋun zo n-tiligi kana ni n ti yɛl a.
en: when the Sabeans took them and killed the young men with swords. I alone escaped to tell you.

dag: Labisimiya yi tɛha zali di zaashee, ka di lan tumdiya alahichi yaha. Di nyɛla vi zaŋ chaŋ yi polo ni n yɛli ni yi ni shɛb bi mi Naawuni yɛla baabiɛla.
en: Be sensible and stop sinning. You should be embarrassed that some people still don't know about God.

dag: Naawuni n-chɛ ka n leei cheechi tumtumda ka ti ma tuuni ŋɔ ni n tum yi sɔŋbu zuɣu. Dina n-nyɛ o lahibal suŋ zaa molo molibu tuma la.
en: God's plan was to make me a servant of his church and to send me to preach his complete message to you.

dag: Siɣisima, amaa ka pampam. Miri ka a ti kum o kuli. Vilim a baŋtabiga ka piri a namda. Miri ka a ti zaŋ bini pɔbi a zuɣusaa naŋgbampibili bee n-di kuli kumbu bindirigu.
en: Don't let your sobbing be heard. Do not go bareheaded or barefoot as a sign of mourning. Don't cover your face or eat the food that mourners eat.

dag: Bɛ chi sara yɛn nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ kpam ŋmiri zim viɛl shɛli, ka zaŋ di kilɔgiram ayi m-pahi piɛla yino zuɣu;.
en: You must also give cups of fine flour mixed with oil with each bull, and cups with each ram.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chɛ bɛ kpalansi mini bɛ binyɛr ŋmahi ni binyɛr waɣila yɛli ba hal zaŋ tabili bɛ zuɣupila, ka lo ba mihi n-zaŋ ba ti bahi buɣim duu din buɣim diri pam maa ni.
en: So Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego were bound, still dressed in all their clothes, and thrown into the furnace of flaming fire. .

dag: ka yɛli o suhu ni, N ka luɣ shɛli din yɛn zaŋ m bindira ŋɔ sɔŋ, ka wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ?.
en: and he said to himself, What can I do? I don't have a place large enough to store everything.

dag: Doo yi goli biŋkɔbigu, bɛn kum o, ka ku biŋkɔbigu maa gba.
en: If a man has sexual relations with an animal, he must be executed and you must kill the animal.

dag: amaa ti bi mi din chɛ ka o nina maa neei pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ, ti mi bi mi ŋun neeg o nina maa. O mi pala bia; bɔhimiy o; omaŋmaŋ ni yɛli ya.
en: But we don't know how he got his sight or who gave it to him. Ask him! He is old enough to speak for himself.

dag: Ka naazɔnim maa daa yɛl o, Haman be kpe; o ʒe zɔŋ ni. Ka naa yɛli ba, Yɛlimiy o ni o kpɛmina.
en: The kings servants answered, Thats Haman standing out in the courtyard, sir. So the king said, Have him come in.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun tiri li billi kaman o ni bɔri shɛm; o tiri bimbiɛlli kam la dimaŋmaŋ billi.
en: God gives it the sort of shape that he chooses, and he gives each of the seeds its own shape.

dag: Yi yi zaŋ liɣiri paŋ n niriba bɛn be yi ni ŋɔ nandaan so, yin di zaŋ yimaŋ leeg o sandihiriba, yi mi miriya ka yi chɛ ka o niŋ ya nyɔri di zuɣu.
en: Don't charge interest when you lend money to any of my people who are in need.

dag: Ka ŋun daa pa a zuɣu wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa ni n-daa nyɛ Ɛliɛza, Dɔdo ŋun daa nyɛ Aho nir la bia.
en: Another one of the Three Warriors was Eleazar son of Dodo the Ahohite.

dag: Ka Dan zuliya niriba maa daa zaŋ dari binnani zali ni bɛ jɛmdi li. Ka Jɔnatan ŋun daa nyɛ Gɛrishom bia ni Musa yaaŋa la min o bidibisi daa nyɛ bɛ maligumaaniba di saha maa zaŋ hal ti paai dahin shɛli bɛ ni daa kana ti gbahi ba chaŋ ti leei daba la.
en: The Danites set up the idol to be worshiped, and Jonathan, the son of Gershom and grandson of Moses, served as a priest for the Danites, and his descendants served as their priests until the people were taken away into exile.

dag: Ka Jɛrɔbɔam paɣ maa daa shiri niŋ lala n-yiɣisi chaŋ Shilo nti chaŋ Ahija yiŋa. Di saha maa Ahija ni daa kurigi zuɣu daa chɛ ka o nina niŋla liti ka o bi lan tooi nyari viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: So she went to Ahijah's home in Shiloh. Old age had made Ahijah blind.

dag: Yi nyɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ niriba, miriya ka yi ti zaŋ bini ŋmaai yimaŋa bee m-pini yi gbɛri yi kpiimba zuɣu.
en: You are the children of the Lord your God. When someone dies, you must not cut yourselves or shave your heads to show your sadness.

dag: Dama din daa bi yɛn yuu la yi daa kana ni jilima, dindina di nyɛla talahi ni din ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu ŋɔ jilima gari lala.
en: For if there was glory in that which lasted for a while, how much more glory is there in that which lasts forever!.

dag: Yihimiya putɔɣu mini suhuyiɣisili ni sujee ni zabili ni nyaanzubo ni biɛr biɛɣu zaa yi bebu ni.
en: Stop being bitter and angry and mad at others. Don't yell at one another or curse each other or ever be rude.

dag: Ka Zɛbul ŋun daa nyɛ tiŋ maa naa ni daa wum Ɛbɛd bia Gaal maa ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka o suhu yiɣisi pam.
en: Zebul, the ruler of the city, became angry when he heard what Gaal had said.

dag: Kaman nɔhi ni pali nɔsuɣu shɛm la, lala ka bɛ di nɛma ti pali bɛ yinsi. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ leei wɔɣira ni bundaamba.
en: Just as a hunter fills a cage with birds, they have filled their houses with loot. That is why they are powerful and rich.

dag: Kuruwa kɔŋkɔba zaŋ zahim binyara nyɛla din chihira Yawɛ sani, ka ʒiri sanianim bi viɛla.
en: The LORD detests false weights; deceptive scales arent right.

dag: amaa saha kanna, hal di paaya gba, ka Naawuni jɛmdi maŋa ni ti jɛm ti Ba Naawuni ni bɛ shihi zaa ni yɛlimaŋli, dama bɛ tatabo ka ti Ba Naawuni bɔri ni bɛ jɛmd o.
en: But the time is coming when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth. In fact, that time is now here. And these are the kind of people the Father wants to be his worshipers.

dag: Taai Naa Hiram n-daa bo sida mini sipirɛs dari ni salim shɛli Naa Sulemaana ni daa bɔri ni o zaŋ tum o tuma maa ti o. Ka Sulemaana mi daa zaŋ Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni fɔntinsi pisi ti Naa Hiram.
en: King Hiram of Tyre gave Solomon all the cedar, pinewood, and gold that he wanted. Then King Solomon gave Hiram twenty towns in the region of Galilee.

dag: Yawɛ nini ni tiɣi piɛlahi tusa shɛm mini kpam pam din be kaman mɔɣa tuhi pia kom la? N zaŋmi mmaŋmaŋ bituuli ŋun nyɛ n niŋgbuŋ nyɔri n-yo m biriginsim mini n daalahichi samli?.
en: Will the Lord be pleased if I bring him thousands of sheep or endless streams of olive oil? Shall I offer him my first-born child to pay for my sins?.

dag: O daa zaŋdila o bidibisi nyɔri buɣim maani sara Hinnom Bidibisi Vinvamli la ni, ka daa buɣiri baɣisi, ka niŋdi laasabu, ka chani jinwariba mini timanim sani. O daa tum alahichi pam Yawɛ sani n-chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi pam.
en: He also burned his own children for a sacrifice in the Valley of Ben Hinnom. He also used magic by doing soothsaying, divination, and sorcery. He talked with mediums and wizards. He did many things that the Lord said were evil and made him angry.

dag: Ka a zaŋ di zaa tuɣi taba ka di leei da yini n-nyɛ zaɣ yini a nuu ni.
en: Join them to each other to make a single stick so that they become one stick in your hand.

dag: ka o tiligi ti, ka di daa pala ti ni tum wuntia tuun shɛŋa zuɣu, amaa o nambɔzɔbo zuɣu ka o paɣ ti ka ti yi, ka ti ti nyɛvil palli Naawuni Shia Kasi ni daa chɛ ka ti nya biɛr palli saha shɛl la.
en: He saved us because of his mercy, not because of any good things we did. He saved us through the washing that made us new people. He saved us by making us new through the Holy Spirit.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mini Yisa daa laɣim diri maa gbaai bɛ kparima ni ŋumdi yɛra taba, Ŋun mi n-lee bɔŋɔ hal ti chɛri niriba daalahichi paŋdi ba.
en: Some other guests started saying to one another, Who is this who dares to forgive sins.

dag: Karimba maa yɛliya, Nyama, n lan nya dimbɔŋɔ, n zaŋla binshɛŋa pahi di tab ni ni m baŋ di laasabu.
en: See, this is what I found, says the Teacher, examining one matter after another to account for things.

dag: Ka Bɛzalɛl daa zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali Alikauli Adaka la. Di wɔɣilim daa nyɛla sɛntimita kɔbiga ni pia, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu, ka di dubu gba nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: Bezalel built a chest of acacia wood centimeters long, centimeters wide, and centimeters high.

dag: Dama Naawuni daalibarika niŋbu min o niriba piibu yɛla bi taɣira.
en: God never changes his mind about the people he calls. He never decides to take back the blessings he has given them.

dag: O chɛ ka sakuɣa be kaman taŋkuɣibihi la lurina, ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi zaŋ o nyɔɣu yo di wari?.
en: God sends down hailstones like chips of rocks. Who can stand the cold?.

dag: N ni saɣim o wain tihi min o fiig tihi pu shɛli o ni yɛra, M mamanim ni zaŋ shɛli yo ma samli m-bɔŋɔ la. N ni zaŋ li leei yɔɣuni, ka yɔɣuni biŋkɔbiri ŋubi di zaa.
en: I will destroy her vines and her fig trees, of which she said, These are my pay, which my lovers have given to me. I will change them into a forest, and the wild animals will eat them.

dag: Amaa o daa bi zaŋdi dari maa sɔŋdi biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn ka yaa la bɛn sani, ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka Leeban biŋkɔbiri nyɛ zaɣ gbarima, ka Yaakubu dina nyɛ bɛn mali yaa.
en: But he did not put the branches in front of the weak animals. Soon Laban had all the weak animals, and Jacob all the healthy ones.

dag: Dama tiŋgbani ni chɛri ka bimbira puhiri yiri tiŋgban ni na shɛm ni kaman puu ni chɛri ka bɛ ni zaŋ bimbiri shɛŋa biri di ni zoori shɛm la, lala ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni chɛ ka wuntia tuma yi zahira, ka zuliya kam zaa tibig o.
en: As the earth puts out its growth, and as a garden grows its seeds, so the LORD God will grow righteousness and praise before all the nations.

dag: ka zaŋ di kilɔgiram yini pahi piɛlabihi pinaanahi maa zaɣ yino kam zuɣu.
en: and cups with each of the lambs.

dag: ka o daa kuli ti yɛl o ba min o ma, N nyala Filistia do so bipuɣiŋga Timna, dinzuɣu bomiy o ti ma ka n niŋ m paɣa.
en: He went back home and told his father and mother, A Philistine woman in Timnah caught my eye; now get her for me as a wife.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan laɣim Izraɛl tɔbutuhiri biinsi ninvuɣ tuhi pihita.
en: Once again David assembled the select warriors of Israel, thirty thousand strong.

dag: Di pa shɛli yi ni saɣi ni m bi zaŋ n yɛla doli ya, amaa ka lee yɛli ni n nyɛla yɛmbimbiɛrilana ŋun zaŋ yɔhiŋgu gbahi ya.
en: It is clear that I was not a burden to you, but you think that I was tricky and used lies to catch you.

dag: Gbuɣima ŋum bahi bɛ zuɣu. Bɛ ŋumiya pam. Bɛ chɛ ka bɛ tiŋgbani bahi yoli, ka saɣim bɛ fɔntinsi, ka so lan ka di ni.
en: They have roared at him like lions; they have made his land a desert, and his towns lie in ruins, completely abandoned.

dag: Amaa pin kasi shɛŋa din yi yi sanna mini yi ni po pɔri ni yi zaŋ pin shɛŋa ti dina, zaŋmiya li chaŋ Yawɛ ni yɛn pii luɣ shɛli maa.
en: Take to the one place of worship your offerings and the gifts that you have promised the Lord .

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa kuhi pam yɛli, M Ba Naawuni, n zaŋ n shia niŋ a nuu ni! O ni daa yɛl lala maa ka o dii bahi.
en: Jesus cried out in a loud voice, Father! In your hands I place my spirit! He said this and died.

dag: Ka Sirianim maa daa kana ni bɛ ti liri Ilaisha, ka Ilaisha suhi Yawɛ yɛli, N suhir a, chɛ ka niriba ŋɔ zom! Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ shiri zom kaman Ilaisha ni daa suh o yɛli shɛm maa.
en: The Arameans came toward him, so Elisha prayed to the LORD, Strike this nation with blindness. And the LORD struck them blind, just as Elisha asked.

dag: Ka ti daa ŋme n-deeg o fɔntinsi zaa di saha maa, ka ku dɔbba mini paɣiba ni bihi fɔntiŋ kam ni. Bɛ ninvuɣ yino gba daa bi tiligi.
en: Then we captured and destroyed every town in Sihon's kingdom, killing everyone.

dag: Ka o daa ŋmaligi lih o nyaaŋa nya ma ka boli ma, ka n garigi yɛl o, N-nyɛ ma.
en: When he turned around and saw me, he called me over. I went and asked what he wanted.

dag: Ka a noli mɔɣisibu ŋmani wain viɛlli din chani viɛnyɛliŋga. Dindina, n yuya ni wain maa paagi n yura maa n-zo n-tiɛli o naŋgbampiba min o nyina.
en: and your mouth like the finest wine. Then let the wine flow straight to my lover, flowing over his lips and teeth.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni yɛl o, Jɛrigu ŋɔ! Yuŋ ŋɔ n ni deeg a nyɛvili, ka a nɛma maa zaa leei ŋun dini.
en: But God said to him, You fool! This very night you will have to give up your life; then who will get all these things you have kept for yourself.

dag: N ŋmanila bɛ ni chɛ kpiin shɛb bahi, ka ŋmani bɛ ni ku shɛb ka bɛ do gbala puuni, ka lan ŋman a ni bi lan teeri shɛb yɛla yaha, dama bɛ nyɛla a baɣa ni lan ka shɛb sɔŋsim ni.
en: I am abandoned among the dead; I am like the slain lying in their graves, those you have forgotten completely, who are beyond your help.

dag: Gbibiya yimaŋa, ka yirigimiya yimaŋ zuɣu! Yi dim ŋun nyɛ Sintani la kul chanimi gindi ŋumdi kaman gbuɣinli la m-bɔri ni o gbaai so ŋubi.
en: Be alert, be on watch! Your enemy, the Devil, roams around like a roaring lion, looking for someone to devour.

dag: Dindali maa, fabila ni ti galisi Jɛrusalɛm kaman bɛ ni daa fabili Hadadirimɔn zuɣu Mɛgido vinvamli ni shɛm la.
en: At that time the mourning in Jerusalem will be as great as the mourning for Hadad Rimmon in the plain of Megiddo.

dag: Ofiri ni Havila ni Jɔbab. Bɛmbɔŋɔ zaa n-daa laɣim nyɛ Jokitan daŋ niriba.
en: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All of these were Joktans sons.

dag: Ka anabinim bɛn daa be Jɛriko maa daa chaŋ Ilaisha sani ti bɔh o, A mi ni Yawɛ ni kpuɣ a zuɣulan maa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n-chaŋ ka chɛ a bebɔ? Ka Ilaisha garigi yɛli ba, Iin, m mi. Amaa shiniya yi noli.
en: The group of prophets at Jericho came to Elisha and said to him, Do you know that the Lord will take your master away from you today? Elisha answered, Yes, I know. Dont talk about it.

dag: Nyamiya ti Ba Naawuni ni yu ti yurilim shɛli, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o bol ti ŋun Naawuni bihi; ka lala n-shiri nyɛ ti. Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka dunia ŋɔ nim bi mi ti, ka di nyɛla bɛ ni bi mi o la zuɣu.
en: See what kind of love the Father has given to us in that we should be called Gods children, and that is what we are! Because the world didnt recognize him, it doesnt recognize us.

dag: Ka shɛb mi yɛli, Di kpa ti la talahi ni ti paŋ liɣiri n-yo farigu ti puri mini ti wain tihi puri zuɣu naa sani.
en: Still others said, We had to borrow money to pay the royal tax on our fields and vineyards.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa ti kpi ka bɛ sɔɣ o. Mɔabnim daa kul chanila Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni shɛɣuni nti fari bɛ bindira yuuni kam.
en: Elisha died and was buried. Every year in the spring, Moab's leaders sent raiding parties into Israel.

dag: Nyini n-daa teeg a nuu din mali yiko n-tum shihira mini alahiziba tuma din mali dabiɛm n-yih a niriba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na.
en: You terrified the Egyptians with your miracles, and you reached out your mighty arm and rescued your people Israel from Egypt.

dag: Ka din daa lu gɔhi ni la mi ŋmanila bɛn wum Naawuni yɛligu, ka ŋmaligi chaŋ ha ka dunia ŋɔ yɛliniŋda mini azichi yubo ni kɔre balibu kam chɛ ka di bi dɔɣi niŋ biɛlim.
en: The seeds that fell among thorn bushes stand for those who hear; but the worries and riches and pleasures of this life crowd in and choke them, and their fruit never ripens.

dag: Yɛlim o ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya ni ninvuɣ so bɛ ni booni Tiwulli la ni zoog o biɛhigu shee n-yiɣisi me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la.
en: Then tell him this is what the Lord All-Powerful says: There is a man called the Branch. He will grow strong, and he will build the Lord s Temple.

dag: Ka dɔro ni daa mali paɣ so m-pɔri gɔŋ o yuun pisaayika ka o ku tooi teeg omaŋ zaa la daa be nimaani.
en: A woman there had an evil spirit that had kept her sick for eighteen years; she was bent over and could not straighten up at all.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ o yɛligu n-yɛli Pɛtuɛl bia Joɛl shɛm m-bɔŋɔ.
en: The LORDs word that came to Joel, Pethuels son.

dag: Labisim a tiliginsim suhupiɛlli la ti ma, ka chɛ ka m mali pupiɛlim.
en: Make me as happy as you did when you saved me; make me want to obey!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛl tuun shɛb bɛn kana maa, Yi yi kuli yin yɛlimiya Jabɛshi din be Giliad tintariga maa nima, Biɛɣuni zaŋ chaŋ wuntaŋ sa ti yɛn bii, yi ni nya faako. Tuumba maa ni daa lab kuli ti yɛli Jabɛshinim lala, ka bɛ suhuri paligi.
en: The messengers who had come were then told, Say this to the people of Jabesh-gilead: Tomorrow by the time the sun is hot, you will be saved. When the messengers returned and reported this to the people of Jabesh, they were overjoyed.

dag: Ka wuntaŋ ni ti zibigi, ka goli mi ti niŋ kaman ʒim la pɔi ka Yawɛ dabisi titali din mali dabiɛm pam la dali naanyi kana.
en: The sun will be turned to darkness, and the moon to blood before the great and dreadful day of the LORD comes.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan bɔhi, Bimbɔ ka n lee yɛn zaŋ ŋ-ŋmahindi ʒiɛmani ŋɔ niriba? Bɛ ŋmanila bihi bɛn ʒi daa ni m-booni tab yɛra:.
en: To what will I compare this generation? It is like a child sitting in the marketplaces calling out to others.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ m-pii Lɛvi yi zuliya zaa ni ni o min o bihi zani zaŋ ŋun Yawɛ yuli tumdi tuma sahakam.
en: Give these gifts to the priests, because the Lord has chosen them and their descendants out of all the tribes of Israel to be his special servants at the place of worship.

dag: Yɛm nyɛla nyɛvili tia ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔbi gbaai li gbibi sani. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbibi li kirikiri nyɛ bɛn mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Wisdom is a life-giving tree, the source of happiness for all who hold on to her.

dag: Amaa n ni zo Juda zuliya nambɔɣu. Ka man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ ni fa ba bahi. M bi yɛn zaŋ tɔbiri bee takɔbi bee yuri bee wɔribariba fa ba bahi.
en: But to the people of Judah I will show love. I, the Lord their God, will save them, but I will not do it by war—with swords or bows and arrows or with horses and horsemen.

dag: Ka Lamɛk daa nyɛ Mɛtusɛla bia, ka Mɛtusɛla nyɛ Inok bia, ka Inok nyɛ Jarɛd bia, ka Jarɛd nyɛ Mahalalɛl bia, ka Mahalalɛl mi nyɛ Kɛnan so bia.
en: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalaleel, the son of Kenan.

dag: Wumma! N suhu n-yɛli ma ni n garig a, dama di muɣisi ma pam n suhu ni.
en: Therefore, my troubled thoughts make me turn back— because of my inner turmoil.

dag: Ɛliɔnai mini Jaakɔba ni Jɛshɔhaya ni Asaaya ni Adiɛl ni Jɛsimiɛl ni Bɛnaaya.
en: Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah.

dag: Ka Midiannim daa nyaŋ Izraɛlnima; ka Izraɛlnim maa zo nti sɔɣi bɔɣa din daa be zoya zuɣu puuni mini tampima voya ni ni luɣ shɛŋa bɛ n-ni tooi sɔɣi zani tuhi tɔbu.
en: The Midianites were very powerful and were cruel to the Israelites. So the Israelites made many hiding places in the mountains. They hid their food in caves and places that were hard to find.

dag: Ka o daa yiɣisi yuŋ maa n-zaŋ bia maa min o ma zo n-chaŋ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: So Joseph got ready and left for Egypt with the child and the mother. They left during the night.

dag: A ninvuɣ biɛtali ŋɔ zaa nyaaŋa, mbusim be a zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: After all these evil things, ... it will be very bad for you! The Lord GOD said all these things.

dag: Ka Jabɛz daa ti suhi Izraɛlnim Naawuni yɛli, N suhir a ni a chɛ ka a daalibarika be n ni, ka chɛ ka n tiŋgbani galisi, ka a zaŋ a nuu pa n zuɣu n-tiligi ma zaɣibiɛɣ kam zaa ni, ka zaɣibiɛɣ ku niŋ ma. Ka Naawuni daa ti o o ni suh o shɛli maa.
en: But Jabez prayed to the God of Israel, Bless me, God, and give me much land. Be with me and keep me from anything evil that might cause me pain. And God gave him what he prayed for.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, miriya ka yi di binʒim kam yi ni be luɣ shɛli zaa, noonsi ʒim bee biŋkɔbiri ʒim.
en: No matter where you live, you must never eat blood from any bird or any animal.

dag: Di saha kopaliga din mali kpiɔŋ daa naan du ti gari.
en: of high and roaring waves.

dag: Naawuni ni be ti polo zuɣu, ti ni di nasara. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun yɛn no n-taai ti dimnim maa ti ti.
en: Only God can make us strong. Only God can defeat our enemies!.

dag: Ka Yisa daa chaŋ ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu n-kariti bɛn kɔhiri mini bɛn dari nɛma Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni yihira; ka daari laɣitaɣiriba teebuya mini ŋmaŋkɔhiriba kuɣisi luhira.
en: Jesus went into the Temple and drove out all those who were buying and selling there. He overturned the tables of the moneychangers and the stools of those who sold pigeons.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa zaŋ ba niŋ foliŋga maa zuɣusaa ni bɛ ne dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Then God put these lights in the sky to shine on the earth.

dag: O kɔbili ni ka niŋgbuŋ maa yaɣili kam zoori kpɛri tab ni, ka niŋgbuŋ maa zaa kpe n-saɣisi tab ni di tuɣili kam shee. Ka niŋgbuŋ maa yaɣili kam yi tumdi di tuma viɛnyɛliŋga kaman di ni simdi ni di tumdi shɛm, niŋgbuŋ maa zaa zoorimi yurilim puuni.
en: Under his control all the different parts of the body fit together, and the whole body is held together by every joint with which it is provided. So when each separate part works as it should, the whole body grows and builds itself up through love.

dag: Dinzuɣu kum ni neebu dali, ŋun paɣa n-lee ni ti nyɛ o? Dama bɛ niriba ayopɔin maa zaa daa kpuɣ o mi.
en: But all seven brothers married her. So when people rise from death, whose wife will this woman be.

dag: Chɛ ka di yuŋ maa leei bumbɔn titali. Di chɛ ka di leei suhupiɛlli dabisili pahi yuuni puuni dabisa zuɣu. Di kal li pahi goya dabisa ni.
en: Blot that night out of the year, and never let it be counted again;.

dag: Ba maa yur o Bia maa, ka wuhir o omaŋmaŋ ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa, ka ni lan wuh o tuun kara gari dimbɔŋɔnima din ni chɛ ka di niŋ ya alahiziba.
en: For the Father loves the Son and shows him all that he himself is doing. He will show him even greater things to do than this, and you will all be amazed.

dag: Ka bɛ zaɣ kpiŋ yaɣ shɛli yi lu bimbir shɛŋa yi ni yɛn biri zuɣu, bimbira maa ni viɛla.
en: If one of them falls on seed that is going to be planted, the seed remains clean.

dag: Obɛdɛdom daa mali bidibisi: Shɛmaya n-daa nyɛ o bituuli n-zaŋ Jɛhɔzabad pa, ka Jɔa pah ata, ka Sakar pah anahi, ka Nɛtanɛl pah anu.
en: Obed-edoms family: Shemaiah the oldest, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sachar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni bɛ nyɛla bɛn suhuri ni tɛha ka galimi, ka lan nyɛ bɛn gbib yɛlimaŋa din yi zahira ti wuhibu puuni la.
en: they should hold to the revealed truth of the faith with a clear conscience.

dag: Ka o yɛli paɣ maa, Kulima! A ni yɛli shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu, alizin biɛɣu maa zoya ka chɛ a bia maa.
en: Good answer! he said. Go on home. The demon has already left your daughter.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka a yɛn niŋ lala? Bɔzuɣu ka a yɛn laɣim wuntizɔriba mini ninvuɣ biɛri ku, ka wuntizɔriba maa pahi ninvuɣ biɛri maa zuɣu nya tibidarigibo. Di niŋ lala! Nyin ŋun nyɛ dunianim zaa sariakarita ŋɔ ku niŋ din tuhi.
en: Its not like you to do this, killing the innocent with the guilty as if there were no difference. Its not like you! Will the judge of all the earth not act justly.

dag: Ka bɔh o, A tɛhiya ni di bi simdi ni n zaŋ n ni su binshɛli niŋ n yubu ni nyɛ shɛm bee yi zabiri ma la nyuli n nirilim niŋbu zuɣu.
en: Dont I have the right to do what I want with what belongs to me? Or are you resentful because Im generous.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti paɣiri Naawuni! Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun ni tooi kpaŋsi yi suhuri n ni yihiri lahibal suŋ shɛli waazu la zuɣu. Dina n-nyɛ Yisa Masia yɛla yɛtɔɣa la mini ashili yɛlimaŋli din daa sɔɣi kurimbuni ha.
en: Praise God! He can make you strong by means of my good news, which is the message about Jesus Christ. For ages and ages this message was kept secret.

dag: Bihi kabirila dari, ka dɔbba maani buɣim, ka paɣiba mi ŋɔriti zim ni bɛ mali maha ti wuni so bɛ ni booni Zuɣusaa Paɣa ŋun nyɛ naa la, ka boori binnyura tiri wun shɛŋa ni bɛ chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi.
en: Children gather firewood, their fathers build fires, and their mothers mix dough to bake bread for the goddess they call the Queen of Heaven. They even offer wine sacrifices to other gods, just to insult me.

dag: Biɛɣuni sa siɣimiya ti tuhi ba. Bɛ sa yɛn dolila Ziz polo duna. Yi sa ni tuhi ba soli vinvamli maa tariga Jɛruɛl tiŋgban nɛl la ni.
en: Attack them tomorrow as they come up the pass at Ziz. You will meet them at the end of the valley that leads to the wild country near Jeruel.

dag: Maligumaaniba kpamba mini Farisiinim daa pun bahi noli ni so yi mi Yisa ni be shɛli, ŋun nyihim ba ka bɛ chaŋ ti gbaag o.
en: The chief priests and Pharisees had given orders that anyone who knew where he was should report it, so they could arrest him.

dag: Wuntizɔriba mi nandaamba yɛlimaŋli ni nyɛ shɛli, ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn ka lala tɛhi zilima.
en: The righteous know the rights of the poor, but the wicked dont understand.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri soli ŋmanila bumbɔni. Bɛ bi mi bɛ ni tuuri binshɛŋa.
en: The path of the wicked is like deep darkness; they dont know where they will stumble.

dag: dindina, n ni zaŋ jaaŋgbee bu ba n-darigi bɛ tibili bɛ daalahichi zuɣu, ka zaŋ fiɛbiga n-fiɛbi ba darigi bɛ tibili bɛ tuumbiɛri zuɣu.
en: Then I will correct and punish them because of their sins.

dag: amaa n yi tumdi li, hal yi yi bi niŋ ma yɛda, yin niŋmiya n tuma maa yɛda, ka di chɛ ka yi shiri baŋ ka niŋ yɛda ni m Ba be n ni ka n gba be o ni.
en: But if I do what my Father does, you should believe in what I do. You might not believe in me, but you should believe in the things I do. Then you will know and understand that the Father is in me and I am in the Father.

dag: Di simdi ka yi mini saamba bɛn be yi sani zaa zaligu nyɛla zaɣ yini.
en: The same rules are for everyone. It doesnt matter if they are citizens or foreigners living among you.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yɛl o, Chɛ ka kpiimba sɔɣimi bɛ kpiin taba, amaa nyin cham ti moli Naawuni nam molo.
en: Jesus said to him, Let the dead bury their own dead. But you go and spread the news of Gods kingdom.

dag: Yinim Marɛshanima, n ni lan piɛli yi dim ŋun ni nyaŋ ya bahi yi zuɣu. Ka Izraɛl ninvuɣ zuɣuri bɛn mali jilima ni ti zo na ti sɔɣi Adulam.
en: People of Mareshah, the Lord will send someone to capture your town. Then Israel's glorious king will be forced to hide in Adullam Cave.

dag: Ka naa maa daa bo tɔbbihi zuɣulaannim mini tɔbbi wɔribariba pa n zuɣu, ka n daa lu soli m-mali hal ti paai Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli yaɣili polo maa gomnanim sani n-daa zaŋ naa gbana maa ti ba.
en: The emperor sent some army officers and a troop of cavalry with me, and I made the journey to West-of-Euphrates. There I gave the emperor's letters to the governors.

dag: Di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhiri bee n-chɛ ka dabiɛm mali ya. N daa pun bi yɛli ya kurimbuni ha, ka wuhi li? Naawuni so kani pahi n zuɣu. N ʒi Naawuni so ŋun mali yiko pam yɛla yaha. Yinima n-nyɛ n shɛhiranima.
en: Do not be afraid, my people! You know that from ancient times until now I have predicted all that would happen, and you are my witnesses. Is there any other god? Is there some powerful god I never heard of.

dag: Di saha maa Saimɔn Pita daa ʒiɛmi wuɣisiri buɣim. Ka bɛ bɔh o, A gba pala o nyaandoliba ni yino? Ka o daa chihi yɛli, M pala o nyaandola.
en: Meanwhile, Simon Peter was still standing with the guards, warming himself. They asked, Arent you one of his disciples? Peter denied it, saying, Im not.

dag: N dana, ka ti daa yɛl a, Bia maa ku tooi wolig o ba, o yi wolig o, o ba maa ni kpi.
en: And we said to my master, The young man cant leave his father. If he leaves, his father will die.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla nyin daadam, a niriba bɛn ʒe goma gbini mini bɛn ʒe dunoya ni yɛri taba, ka sokam yɛri o ʒiʒiinikpee, Kamiyana ti wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din yi Yawɛ sanna ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: The Lord said, Mortal man, your people are talking about you when they meet by the city walls or in the doorways of their houses. They say to one another, Let's go and hear what word has come from the Lord now.

dag: Amaa ka Nɛtania bia Ishimail daa zaŋ niriba anii n-zo n-tiligi Jɔhanan nuu ni kuli Ammɔnnim tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: But Ishmael and eight of his men escaped from Johanan and ran away to the Ammonites.

dag: Ka Musa daa boli Izraɛlnim zaa na nti yɛli ba, Yi daa nya Yawɛ ni tum tuun shɛŋa zaa yi ninni Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, o ni daa niŋ Firawuna min o sapashinnim ni o tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa shɛm.
en: Moses called the nation of Israel together and told them: When you were in Egypt, you saw the Lord perform great miracles that caused trouble for the king, his officials, and everyone else in the country.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛr a mi ni paɣ ŋɔ nya o daalahichi din galisi ŋɔ zaa chɛ m-paŋ, dama o yurilim galisiya pam; amaa ŋun nya o daalahichi chɛ m-paŋ ka di pɔri nyɛla ŋun yurilim pɔra.
en: I tell you that her many sins are forgiven. This is clear, because she showed great love. People who are forgiven only a little will love only a little.

dag: Ka Yisa daa naai ŋahili ŋɔ ka yɛli ba, Dinzuɣu di gbihiriya, dama yi bi mi dindali bee di saha.
en: So always be ready. You dont know the day or the time when the Son of Man will come.

dag: Ka Dauda daa ti yɛli Akishi, A suhu yi yu ma, nyin tim ma a tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni tinsi ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛli ka n ʒini, dama wula ka man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ min a lee yɛn laɣim ʒi na tiŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: David said to Achish, If you are my friend, let me have a small town to live in. There is no need, sir, for me to live with you in the capital city.

dag: Ka yi mini Shiiba daabihi ni Raama daabihi daa niŋdi daabiligu ni taba. Ka bɛ daa zaŋdi tulaale viɛla balibu kam mini kuɣ viɛla ni salima na ti taɣiri yi nɛma.
en: They were your agents in Sheba and Raamah. For your wares they exchanged the finest spices, every kind of precious stone, and gold.
