dag: Zaŋ chaŋ yuuni daa ti yɛn giligi, ka Siria tɔbbihi daa lo tɔb na ti liri Naa Jɔash. Bɛ daa lirila Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima n-ku bɛ zuɣulaannim zaa, ka di nɛma n-zaŋ li chaŋ ti ti Damaskus naa.
en: At the end of the year, the Aramean army came against Joash. They attacked Judah and Jerusalem and killed all the leaders of the people. They sent all the valuable things to the king of Damascus.

dag: Jɛra n-yɛri bɛ suhuri ni, Naawuni kani. Bɛ nyɛla tuumbiɛrinima, ka tumdi din chihira; ka so ka bɛ ni n-nyɛ ŋun tumdi din viɛla.
en: Fools say to themselves, There is no God! They are all corrupt, and they have done terrible things; there is no one who does what is right.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa shini. Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa yɛl o, Yɛlim ti Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, nyini n-shiri nyɛ Masia Naawuni Bia la.
en: But Jesus said nothing. Again the high priest said to Jesus, You are now under oath. I command you by the power of the living God to tell us the truth. Tell us, are you the Messiah, the Son of God.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu, ka o lɛb o nyaaŋa biri ba, ka chɛla Juda zuliya kɔŋko.
en: So the Lord became very angry with Israel and removed them from his sight. There were no Israelites left, except the tribe of Judah.

dag: Ka zuɣulaannim mi daa bo oniɣisi kuɣa mini kuɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ pie tab binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la nyolɔrigu la zuɣu na.
en: The chiefs brought gemstones and gems to be set in the priests vest and the chest pendant.

dag: N ni paɣi Yawɛ paɣibu shɛli din nyɛ o dini o wuntitali zuɣu, ka yili yila paɣi ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ yuli.
en: I will praise you, Lord ! You always do right. I will sing about you, the Lord Most High.

dag: Ka mɔɣ shɛli din pah ata yuli booni Tigiris. Dina n-zɔri kpari Asiria wulimpuhili polo. Ka mɔɣ shɛli din pah anahi mi yuli booni Yufretiiz.
en: The name of the third river was Tigris. This river flowed east of Assyria. The fourth river was the Euphrates.

dag: Yiɣisim chaŋ Mɛsopoteemia a ma ba Bɛtuɛl yiŋa nti kpuɣi a ma tizɔdoo Leeban bipuɣinsi ni yino niŋ a paɣa.
en: So leave this place and go to Paddan Aram. Go to the house of Bethuel, your mothers father. Laban, your mothers brother, lives there. Marry one of his daughters.

dag: Miri ka a pahi shɛli o yɛligu zuɣu, di yi pa lala o ni kpah a zuɣu ni, ka di wuhi ni a nyɛla ʒirilana.
en: So dont try to change what God says. If you do, he will punish you and prove that you are a liar.

dag: Suhudoo be ŋmɛnditoya yinsi, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋ bɛ wuna niŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ nuu ni, ka nyɛ bɛn chɛ ka Naawuni suhu yiɣisiri ŋɔ lee nyɛ bɛn yiri barina ni.
en: Robbers and other godless people live safely at home and say, God is in our hands.

dag: Ammɔnim ni daa nya ka Sirianim maa ŋmaligi guui maa, ka bɛ gba ŋmaligi Jɔab mabia Abishai sani guui ti kpe bɛ tiŋ maa puuni, ka chɛ Abishai Jɔab mabia maa. Di nyaaŋa ka Jɔab daa labi Jɛrusalɛm.
en: When the Ammonites saw the Syrians running away, they fled from Abishai and retreated into the city. Then Joab went back to Jerusalem.

dag: Ti Duuma Naawuni yi ti bi filim di dabisa maa, so ti ku tiligi, amaa o ninvuɣ gahinda la zuɣu ka o ni ti filim di dabisa maa.
en: If that time werent shortened, nobody would be rescued. But for the sake of the ones whom God chose, that time will be cut short.

dag: Niriba pam daa sab yɛl shɛŋa din daa pun niŋ ti sani.
en: Most Honorable Theophilus: Many others have tried to give a report of the things that happened among us to complete Gods plan.

dag: Ka shihira ŋɔ zaa yi ti niŋ a nyin niŋm a nuu ni ni tooi niŋ shɛlikam, dama Naawuni be a sani.
en: After that happens, you can do whatever you choose to do, because God will be with you.

dag: Naawuni Kundi yɛliya, Ŋunkam niŋ o yɛda ku di vi.
en: The scripture says, Whoever believes in him will not be disappointed.

dag: Amaa di yɛtɔɣa chaŋ gili dunia ŋɔ zaa, ka dunia ŋɔ yaɣ yini zaŋ ti kpa di tarisi zaa palila di yɛtɔɣa. Ka o ti suɣili zuɣusaa ti wuntaŋa;.
en: But their message goes throughout the world. Their teaching reaches the ends of the earth. The suns tent is set up in the heavens.

dag: N ni chɛ ka n zoya ŋɔ nim zaa zaŋ takɔbiri ti lu Gɔg zuɣu. O tɔbbihi ni ti zaŋ bɛ takɔbiri ŋmaligi lu tab zuɣu.
en: I will summon a sword against Gog on all my mountains. This is what the LORD God says! The swords of the warriors will be against each other.

dag: Kul kpalimmiya be Naawuni yurilim la puuni, ka guhimiya saha shɛli ti Duuma Yisa Masia ni ti yɛn chɛ ka yi nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu o nambɔzɔbo zuɣu la.
en: And keep in step with God's love, as you wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to show how kind he is by giving you eternal life.

dag: Amaa nyini Bɛtilihɛm din be Ɛfirata, ka nyɛ tin shɛli din pɔri Juda tinsi puuni ŋɔ, a ni ka n ninvuɣ so ŋun ni su Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni ti yina. O piligu yila kurimbuni na.
en: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, are the smallest town in Judah. Your family is almost too small to count, but the Ruler of Israel will come from you to rule for me. His beginnings are from ancient times, from long, long ago.

dag: Dama bɛ ni shɛb daa yɛliya, Ti mini ti bidibisi ni ti bipuɣinsi galisiya pam. Di simdi ni ti nya chi din ni chɛ ka ti di n-tiligi.
en: Some of them were saying, We have many children. We must get some grain if we are going to eat and stay alive.

dag: A ni je suli niŋ ti sahakam? A yɛn jɛla suli niŋ ʒiɛmani kam nima?.
en: Will you be angry with us forever? Will your anger reach to our children and to their children?.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Chamiya so sani fɔŋ ni ti yɛl o, Ti karimba n-tim ti na ni ti ti yɛl a ni o saha miriya; ka o bɔri ni o min o nyaandoliba puhi Yaɣigari Chuɣu ŋɔ a yili ŋɔ. .
en: Jesus answered, Go into the city. Go to a man I know. Tell him that the Teacher says, The chosen time is near. I will have the Passover meal with my followers at your house.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Babilɔn bipuɣiŋga, yiɣisim a nam ʒiishee nti ʒini tiŋ taŋkpaɣu ni. Bɛ ku lan bol a ninvuɣ gahindili.
en: The Lord says, Babylon, come down from your throne, and sit in the dust on the ground. You were once like a virgin, a city unconquered, but you are soft and delicate no longer! You are now a slave!.

dag: Juda zuliya daa leela Naawuni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi, ka Izraɛlnim leeg o ni su shɛba.
en: Judah was Gods sanctuary; Israel was Gods territory.

dag: Gbuɣimbihi yi bɔri bindirigu Naawuni sani, bɛ chanimi ŋumdi ginda.
en: The young lions roar for their prey, seeking their food from God.

dag: saha shɛli Babilɔn tɔbbihi ni daa tuhiri Jɛrusalɛm mini Juda fɔntin shɛŋa zaa din daa kpalim ka nyɛ Lakishi mini Azɛka la, dama di kɔŋko n-daa nyɛ Juda tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bɛ ni me goondahi gili fɔntin shɛŋa ka di na kpalim ʒiɛya.
en: while the army of the king of Babylonia was attacking the city. The army was also attacking Lachish and Azekah, the only other fortified cities left in Judah.

dag: man Yawɛ daa yi katiŋa n-ka bɛ sanna. N kul yuri ya mi sahakam, dinzuɣu ka n kul gbibi ʒiɛyimtali zaŋ chaŋ yi sani.
en: Some time ago, the Lord appeared to me and told me to say: Israel, I will always love you; that's why I've been so patient and kind.

dag: ni kanaafiri ni binnyoon viɛla balibu kam ni tulaale zim ni tulaale zin shɛŋa bɛ ni booni mɛɛr ni firanki tulaale zim la ni wain ni kpam ni zim balli mini chi ni niɣi mini piɛri ni yuri ni chɛchɛbunsi zaŋ tabili daba mini ninsalinim nyɛviya la.
en: and cinnamon, spice, incense, myrrh, and frankincense; wine and oil, flour and wheat, cattle and sheep, horses and carriages, slaves, and even human lives.

dag: Lɛvinim tuma soli ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛn nyɛ yuun pisinaanu zaŋ chana ni tooi piligi laɣiŋgu suɣili maa ni tuma tumbu.
en: This rule applies to the Levites: Everyone years old and above will enter into service, performing the duties for the meeting tent.

dag: O ni zali ti shɛm n-nyɛ ni ti niŋ o Bia Yisa Ba Masia yuli yɛda ka yuri taba kaman o ni zali ti shɛm.
en: God wants us to have faith in his Son Jesus Christ and to love each other. This is also what Jesus taught us to do.

dag: Ka n lo alikauli ni n ni yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni wahala maa ni n-zaŋ ya tahi Keenannim mini Hitinim ni Amɔrinim ni Pɛrizinim ni Hivinim ni Jɛbusinim tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Di nyɛla tiŋgban shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam.
en: Ive decided to take you away from the harassment in Egypt to the land of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, a land full of milk and honey.

dag: Ka Filistia tɔbbi shɛba daa chaŋ ti gu Mikimash solɔɣu zuɣu.
en: Now a group of Philistine soldiers had marched out to the pass at Michmash.

dag: N ka galimi, m baɣa kani. M bi lan bɔri n nyɛvili.
en: I am innocent, but I no longer care. I am sick of living. Nothing matters; innocent or guilty, God will destroy us.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli Jɔshua, Amaŋmaŋ nini nya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni niŋ nanim ayi ŋɔ shɛm zaa, lala ka Yawɛ yɛn niŋ yi ni yɛn garina shɛb tinsi ni ŋɔ zaa.
en: Then I told Joshua, You have seen all that the Lord your God has done to these two kings. The Lord will do the same thing to all the kingdoms you will enter.

dag: Ka Vuhim Dabisili dali maa daa gari, ka bakɔi piligu dali biɛɣu ti neerina, ka Mariama ŋun daa nyɛ Magdala tiŋbia la min o tɔɣima la daa chaŋ ni bɛ ti nya Yisa siliga maa.
en: After the Sabbath, at dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to look at the tomb.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli, Alizanda nam ŋmanila dabin shɛli paɣ ni yi zahim bɔrɔbɔro zim ŋmani buta n-zaŋ li gari di ni ŋɔri zali, ka di zaa ti mii m-piri la.
en: Jesus also said: The kingdom of heaven is like what happens when a woman mixes a little yeast into three big batches of flour. Finally, all the dough rises.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni ti ŋmanila bɛ ni kpuɣi pu shɛli atam, ka be kaman bɛ ni yihi binyiha pu shɛli din be Rɛfaim Vinvamli ni.
en: That time will be like the grain harvest in Rephaim Valley. The workers gather the plants that grow in the field. Then they cut the heads of grain from the plants and collect the grain.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku ba; ka yɔbahi ŋub ba.
en: Let their blood flow by the sword! Let them be food for wild jackals!.

dag: Amaa yinim ka la Ziɔn Zoli mini Naawuni ŋun nyɛ nyɛvililan ŋɔ tiŋ din nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm m-be alizanda ni la ni malaikanim bɛn ka kalinli suhupiɛlli laɣiŋgu ni na;.
en: Instead, you have come to Mount Zion and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, with its thousands of angels.

dag: Di saha ka niriba maa daa yiɣisi nimaani n-chani ka lihiri Sɔdom polo; ka Ibrahimma daa chani doli ba ni o zali ba soli.
en: Then the men left and went to a place where they could look down at Sodom, and Abraham went with them to send them on their way.

dag: Dama di nyɛla nɛma labisi ti yuuni yi sani; di ni ti nyɛla yuuni din be kasi; yi ni ti dila binshɛŋa din bili mɔɣu ni di yuuni maa.
en: The whole year shall be sacred for you; you shall eat only what the fields produce of themselves.

dag: Ka o nya ti shɛli bɛ ni booni fiig tia, ka di puhi vari ʒiɛya ha, ka o chaŋ di gbini ni o ti nya o ni nya binshɛɣu di zuɣu di; o ni daa paai di gbini o daa bi nya binshɛɣu naɣ pahila vari kɔŋko, dama fiig tihi walibu saha daa na bi paai.
en: From far away, he noticed a fig tree in leaf, so he went to see if he could find anything on it. When he came to it, he found nothing except leaves, since it wasnt the season for figs.

dag: hal ka ti ti paai ti ni niŋ yɛda yin shɛl la mini ti Naawuni Bia baŋbu la m-bi niriba ka ti biɛhigu buɣisibu saɣisi Masia biɛhigu zaa la.
en: until we all reach the unity of faith and knowledge of Gods Son. Gods goal is for us to become mature adults—to be fully grown, measured by the standard of the fullness of Christ.

dag: bɛ ni daa nahim ya, ka yɔhim ya Pɛɔr yɛla ni la mini Kɔzibi yɛla ni la zuɣu. Kɔzibi daa nyɛla Midian toondaan so bipuɣiŋga, ka nyɛ bɛ tizɔpaɣ so bɛ ni daa ku Pɛɔr alɔbo la dal la.
en: because they went after you by the deception they devised for you at Peor with Cozbi, the Midianite chiefs daughter and their sister, who was killed on the same day as the plague during the events at Peor.

dag: Dinzuɣu wulimpuhili polo nim ni ti tibigi Yawɛ; ka bɛn ʒi n-dolisi teeku tibigi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ yuli.
en: And so, everyone in the east and those on the islands should praise the Lord , the God of Israel.

dag: Yawɛ zaligunim nyɛla din kul tuhi, ka tiri suhupiɛlli. Yawɛ zaligu nyɛla din do palo ni; ka neeri niriba nini.
en: The Lord s laws are right. They make people happy. The Lord s commands are good. They show people the right way to live.

dag: amaa bɛ ni ti yɛrimi, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be, ka nyɛ ŋun daa yihi Izraɛlnim o ni daa kari ba tahi nuzaa polo tin shɛŋa zaa ni la zuɣu. Di saha bɛ ni ti be bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Instead, they will swear by me as the living God who brought the people of Israel out of a northern land and out of all the other countries where I had scattered them. Then they will live in their own land.

dag: Amaa nyin Yawɛ n-kul nyɛ ŋun galisi sahakam.
en: But, Lord , you will be honored forever.

dag: Ka Midian kɔhigɔriba daa garita, ka bɛ yihi Yisifu bɔɣili maa ni na n-zaŋ o kɔhi Ishimail zuliya maa zuɣu anzinfa laɣibaligu pisi, ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yisifu kuli Ijipti.
en: When the Midianite traders came by, the brothers took Joseph out of the well and sold him to the traders for pieces of silver. The traders took him to Egypt.

dag: Nintam kul yɛn zɔrila n ninni ka ku ŋmaai, di mi ku chɛ zɔbu.
en: My tears will pour out in a ceaseless stream.

dag: Yawɛ ni chɛ ka alɔbo mini suhusaɣiŋgu ni birimbu lu yi zuɣu yi ni bɔri ni yi niŋ shɛlikam puuni hal ka yi ti kpi yomyom naai zaa yi tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu, dama yi zaɣisi ma.
en: If you do evil and reject the Lord , he will bring on you disaster, confusion, and trouble in everything you do, until you are quickly and completely destroyed.

dag: A ni ku bɛ zuliya bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni, ka yihi bɛ bihi ninsalinim ni.
en: Their families will be destroyed. They will be removed from the earth.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nam dunia ŋɔ, ŋuna ŋun daa pil li, ka zal li ŋɔ, o yuli m-booni Yawɛ, O ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: The Lord , who made the earth, who formed it and set it in place, spoke to me. He whose name is the Lord said.

dag: Dinzuɣu chamiya ti yɛli zuliya kam ka bɛ leei n nyaandoliba, ka yi baptaizi ba ti Ba Naawuni min o Bia ni o Shia Kasi yul ni;.
en: So go and make followers of all people in the world. Baptize them in the name of the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ku Izraɛl do so mini Midian paɣ maa yuli n-daa booni Zimiri. O daa nyɛla Salu bia, ka lan nyɛ Simiɔn zuliya niriba dɔɣirikpɛma.
en: The Israelite man that was killed was Zimri son of Salu, who was one of the leaders of the Simeon tribe.

dag: Anabi Musa ni daa nya li maa ka di gar o pam, ka o tirisi mir li ha ni o lihi li viɛnyɛliŋga, ka wum ti Duuma kukoli.
en: When Moses saw this, he was amazed. He went near to look closer at it. He heard a voice; it was the Lords.

dag: Bɛ ku lan labi bɛ yinsi, ka bɛ ni daa be luɣ shɛli maa nim ku lan baŋ ba yaha.
en: wont return home again, wont be recognized in town anymore.

dag: Dama Musa daa pun piri Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo tiŋgbɔŋ la tari zuliya ayi ni pirigili la. Amaa o daa bi pirigi tiŋgban shɛli ti Lɛvinim bɛn daa be bɛ ni.
en: Moses had already given the two and a half tribes their land east of the Jordan River. The tribe of Levi did not receive any land like the other tribes.

dag: Ka so yi zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga kɔhi ka o leei dabili, di bi simdi ka o ti chaŋ kaman dɔbba ni chani shɛm.
en: When a man sells his daughter as a slave, she shouldnt be set free in the same way as male slaves are set free.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim dɔbba shɛb bɛn daa zo nti sɔɣi Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya tinsi ni la gba ni daa wum ni Filistianim maa ŋmaligi guui n-zɔri ni bɛ tiligi maa, ka bɛ gba daa dii lo kpara zo n-doli tuhiri ba.
en: Many Israelites had been hiding in the hill country of Ephraim. And when they heard that the Philistines were running away, they came out of hiding and joined in chasing the Philistines.

dag: Chɛ ka o zuliya kpi zaa; ka o yuli kpihim ʒiɛmana din pahir ayi ni.
en: Bring an end to his family, and from now on let him be a forgotten man.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun ni tiligi Izraɛlnim bɛ daalahichi zaa ni.
en: Israel, the Lord will save you from all your sins.

dag: Ka pirinsi maa daa lab ti yɛli sariakaritib maa Pool ni yɛli shɛm, ka dabiɛm gbahi ba bɛ ni daa wum ni Pool mini Silas nyɛla Rom tiŋbihi maa zuɣu;.
en: The police officers reported these words to the Roman officials; and when they heard that Paul and Silas were Roman citizens, they were afraid.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ yɛmbimbiɛtali maa ka yɛli ba.
en: But Jesus saw through their trick and said to them.

dag: nti zaŋ tulaale zim maa niŋ buɣim maa ni Yawɛ tooni, ka chɛ ka di nyɔhi tuɣi kpe bimpindigu din pili Alikauli Adaka la, di yi pa lala o ni kpi.
en: He will put the incense on the fire before the Lord . Then the cloud of incense will hide the mercy-cover that is over the Box that holds the Agreement. This way Aaron will not die.

dag: Ka n daa lihi nya kɔtomsi shɛli ka di biɛhigu ŋmani daadam. Din daa be kaman o shee la tiŋli polo daa nyɛla buɣim, ka shee maa zaŋ du zuɣusaa polo mi daa kul piɛli paratɛte, ka be kaman daanya din nyaɣisiri la.
en: I saw something that looked like fire, like a mans body. From the waist down, he was like fire. From the waist up, he was bright and shining like hot metal in a fire.

dag: Amaa Aduna ni yɛn niŋ shɛm ka naanyi kpe luɣ kasi maa puuni m-bɔŋɔ: O bom naɣila polli ŋun ni mali alahichi sanyoo sara mini piɛlaa ŋun ni mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la na.
en: Before Aaron enters the Most Holy Place, he will offer a bull for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering.

dag: Di saha ka n daa tim ti boli Ɛliɛza mini Ariɛl ni Shɛmaya ni Ɛlnatan ni Jarib ni Ɛlnatan so yaha ni Neetan ni Zakaria ni Mɛshulam bɛn daa nyɛ zuɣulaannim la ni Joyarib mini Ɛlnatan so mi yaha bɛn daa nyɛ yɛnnim la.
en: So I called for Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zechariah, and Meshullam, all leaders, together with Joiarib and Elnathan, who were wise.

dag: Kaman karakɔhi ni kul daari yiɣiri gindi shɛm bee sakpaleensi ni yiɣiri shɛm, lala ka noli yɛlibu din bi simdi gba bi chani shɛli.
en: A curse you don't deserve will take wings and fly away like a sparrow or a swallow.

dag: Yi tɛhiya ni yi ni tumdi tuun shɛŋa viɛla, amaa di mi ku sɔŋ ya.
en: I could tell about your good works and all the religious things you do, but that will not help you.

dag: Shimɛi daa malila bidibisi pinayɔbu mini bipuɣins ayɔbu. Amaa o mabihi maa bɛn daa bi dɔɣi bihi pam, lala zuɣu ka bɛ zuliya maa daa bi yɛligi kaman Judanim ni daa yɛligi shɛm la.
en: Shimei had sons and daughters. But his brothers did not have as many children, so the Simeon tribe was smaller than the Judah tribe.

dag: Saimɔn Pita mini Tomas ŋun daa nyɛ jaa la ni Nataniɛl ŋun daa yi Kɛna din be Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la ni Zɛbidii bihi la m-pahi nyaandoliba ayi n-daa laɣim taba.
en: Some of the followers were together—Simon Peter, Thomas , Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, the two sons of Zebedee, and two other followers.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N daa bɔri ni n laɣim n niriba, amaa ka bɛ daa ŋmanila wain tia din ka wala bee fiig tia din ka wala, hal bɛ ŋmanila tia din vari suui. N ni daa zaŋ binshɛli ti ba la faaya ka chɛ ba.
en: I will put an end to them, declares the LORD; there are no grapes on the vine, no figs on the tree, only withered leaves. They have squandered what I have given them!.

dag: Di kul shɛbisila tab ni hal ka pɔhim ku tooi kpe di sunsuuni gba.
en: firmly bound and closer together.

dag: Ka Yisa tuumba bɛn daa be Jɛrusalɛm la daa wum ni Samarianim deei Naawuni yɛligu, ka daa tim Pita mini Jɔn bɛ sani.
en: When word reached the apostles in Jerusalem that Samaria had accepted Gods word, they commissioned Peter and John to go to Samaria.

dag: Tim a ba mini a ma jilima kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni zal a shɛm din ni chɛ ka a mali nyɛvili wɔɣinli ka binshɛɣukam niŋ viɛnyɛla a sani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya ŋɔ ni.
en: Respect your father and your mother, as I, the Lord your God, command you, so that all may go well with you and so that you may live a long time in the land that I am giving you.

dag: Bɛ daa lan kpuɣi bɛ ni mali binshɛŋa moori buɣim mini lahi. Ka sapashin kpɛm maa daa kpuɣi bɛ ni zaŋ salima mini anzinfa mali binshɛŋa zaa kuli.
en: They took away everything that was made of gold or silver, including the small bowls and the pans used for carrying live coals.

dag: Kom ni ka man baptaiziri ya, amaa ŋun ni ti zaŋla Naawuni Shia Kasi baptaizi ya.
en: I baptize you with water, but the one who is coming will baptize you with the Holy Spirit.

dag: Amaa ka nyin Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ŋun nyɛ Dauda bia Sulemaana dabili ŋɔ ti zaɣis a duuma.
en: It was Jeroboam, Nebats son, the servant of Solomon, Davids son, who rebelled against his master.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Bolim o yuli Panniriba, dama yi pala n niriba, m mi pala yi Naawuni.
en: Then the Lord said, Name him Lo-Ammi, because these people are not mine, and I am not their God.

dag: Duhimiya tuuta zuɣusaa daboli din nyɛ zaɣ nɛli zuɣu. Kuhimiya yɛli tɔbbihi, ka kpuɣi yi nuhi zuɣusaa wuhi ni yi cham ti liri tin shɛli din niriba mali karimbaani la.
en: From high on a barren hill give a signal, shout the orders, and point the way to enter the gates of Babylon's proud rulers.

dag: yin bomiya naɣilaa ti Lɛvinima bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba ka nyɛ Zadok zuliya ni niriba, ka nyɛ bɛn ti yɛn kani n sanna ti tumdi n tuma la, ka bɛ mali sara alahichi zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You will give a young bull as a sin offering to the men from Zadoks family. These men are the priests from the tribe of Levi. They are the men who serve me by bringing the offerings to me. This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: A bi kpini shɛli yɛla ŋɔ ni, a mi nuu ka di ni, dama a suhu bi ʒe yim ni Naawuni.
en: You don't have any part in this, and God sees that your heart isn't right.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ŋmaligi lihi nya ba ka bɔhi ba, Bɔ ka yi bɔra? Ka bɛ bɔh o, Rabai, ya polo ka a kpɛra.
en: When Jesus turned and saw them, he asked, What do you want? They answered, Rabbi, where do you live? The Hebrew word Rabbi means Teacher.

dag: dama Manaasa bipuɣinsi daa deei tiŋgbana pah o bidibisi zuɣu. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Giliad ti Manaasa zuliya niriba bɛn kpalim la.
en: So these women from the tribe of Manasseh got land the same as the men. The land of Gilead was given to the rest of the families of Manasseh.

dag: Ti yi ti suhuri Naawuni tiri ya, ti kul paɣirila Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma Yisa Masia Ba ŋɔ sahakam.
en: We always give thanks to God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, when we pray for you.

dag: Ka dim maa daa yɛli, N ni kari gbahi ba; n ni di bɛ nɛma, ka zaŋ n ni bɔri shɛlikam. N ni zaŋ n nuu ŋooi takɔbi n-ku ba.
en: The enemy said, Ill chase them and catch them. Ill take all their riches. Ill take it all with my sword. Ill take everything for myself.

dag: Yisa daa ti zaŋ kpa Jɛrusalɛm polo doli fɔntinsi mini tiŋkpansi wuhiri niriba chana.
en: Jesus was teaching in every town and village. He continued to travel toward Jerusalem.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa yihi ti kum barina titali maa ni, ka na kul yihiri ti di ni, ka ti mali tahima ni o ni lan yihi ti yaha.
en: God rescued us from a terrible death, and he will rescue us. We have set our hope on him that he will rescue us again.

dag: M mabihi, n kpamdi ya jaande ti Duuma Yisa Masia mini yurilim shɛli Naawuni Shia Kasi ni tiri ti la zuɣu ni yi pahimi n zuɣu n-suhi Naawuni ti ma.
en: Brothers and sisters, I urge you, through our Lord Jesus Christ and through the love of the Spirit, to join me in my struggles in your prayers to God for me.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa gbaai Yisifu binyɛrigu gbib ka yɛl o, Chɛ ka m min a dɔni. Amaa ka Yisifu daa fuɣ o binyɛrigu maa niŋ paɣ maa nuu ni, ka guui yi yili maa ni.
en: Potiphar's wife grabbed hold of his coat and said, Make love to me! Joseph ran out of the house, leaving his coat there in her hands.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Galili do so ŋun yuli daa booni Judas la gba daa ti yiɣisi daadam biɛligu yuya sabbu saha la n-laɣim niriba pah omaŋ zuɣu, amaa o gba ni daa ti kani, bɛn dol o maa zaa daa wurimmi.
en: After that, Judas the Galilean appeared during the time of the census; he drew a crowd after him, but he also was killed, and all his followers were scattered.

dag: O ni yo ba bɛ tuumbiɛri samli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni kpihim bɛ birili bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali maa zuɣu.
en: He will punish them for their wickedness and destroy them for their sins; the Lord our God will destroy them.

dag: Dinzuɣu m po pɔri yɛli Ɛli min o yiŋnima ni sara maligu bee wumpaɣibo pini lan kani din ni tooi nyahi bɛ tuumbiɛri maa hal abada.
en: That is why I swore an oath that sacrifices and offerings will never take away the sins of the people in Elis family. .

dag: N yi tɔɣisiri ninsalinim yɛligu balibu kam, hal zaŋ tabili malaikanim yɛligu, ka ka yurilim, dindina m bemi kaman dawule bee gbiŋgbarinlun shɛŋa bɛ ni mali ŋmɛri taba ka di yɔri vuri yiriŋ la.
en: I may be able to speak the languages of human beings and even of angels, but if I have no love, my speech is no more than a noisy gong or a clanging bell.

dag: amaa benyala kasi yi biɛhigu zaa puuni kaman Naawuni ŋun boli ya la ni be kasi shɛm.
en: Be holy in everything you do, just as God is holy. He is the one who chose you.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Keen, A tizo Ɛbɛl be ya? Ka Keen garigi yɛli, M bi mi; mani n-nyɛ n tizo maa gula.
en: The Lord asked Cain, Where is your brother Abel? He answered, I don't know. Am I supposed to take care of my brother.

dag: Ka o daa me yiya Millo polo hal ti gil di zaa. Ka Jɔab mi daa mali tiŋ maa yaɣ shɛli din kpalim me.
en: He rebuilt the city, starting at the place where land was filled in on the east side of the hill, and Joab restored the rest of the city.

dag: Ibrahimma kum nyaaŋa, Naawuni daa niŋ alibarika niŋ o bia Yisahaku ni. Yisahaku daa bela Bɛrilahairoi.
en: After Abraham died, God blessed Isaac. Isaac was living at Beer Lahai Roi.

dag: ka kaɣ yi kpaŋ ha kaman nir ni ni tooi to piɛm ka di chaŋ ti lu luɣ shɛli tariga ti ʒini, ka yɛli, N je ni n nini nya bia ŋɔ bahibu. O ni daa kaɣ yi kpaŋa nti ʒiya ka chɛ o maa, ka duh o yee kuhi.
en: and sat down about a hundred yards away. She said to herself, I can't bear to see my child die. While she was sitting there, she began to cry.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛdaniŋdib shɛb bɛn daa nyɛ Farisiinim la yiɣisi zani yɛli, Di niŋ kamaata ni bɛn pa Yɛhudianim ka niŋ Yisa yɛda maa guni, ka lan niŋ kamaata ni ti yɛli ba ni bɛ doli Anabi Musa zaligu.
en: Some of the believers in Jerusalem had belonged to the Pharisees. They stood up and said, The non-Jewish believers must be circumcised. We must tell them to obey the Law of Moses.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, Yawɛ je suli niŋ ma yi zuɣu, ka po pɔri yɛli ma ni n ku du Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili ŋɔ, ni n ku kpe tiŋgbɔn viɛl shɛli ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tin ya ni yi su la ni.
en: Because of you the Lord your God was angry with me and solemnly declared that I would not cross the Jordan River to enter the fertile land which he is giving you.

dag: Ti Duuma ni chɛ ninvuɣ so daalahichi taali paŋ o ka bi lan maani di laasabu mal alibarika.
en: Happy are those whose sin isnt counted against them by the Lord .

dag: Ziɔnnim teei bɛ nuhi, amaa ka so kani ŋun ni maai bɛ suhuri. Yawɛ daa yɛli Yaakubu ni o ʒiʒiinitaba ni ti leeg o dimnima. Jɛrusalɛm leela binshɛli din nyɛ daɣiri bini bɛ sani.
en: I stretch out my hands, but no one will help me. The Lord has called enemies against me from every side; They treat me like some filthy thing.

dag: Ka lan zaŋ lɛbihi mini matarikanima n-saɣim bɛ ni kpe dari mali binshɛŋa la zaa.
en: They smashed all the wooden panels with their axes and sledge hammers.

dag: Yi ni ti booi kpa shɛli bɛ ni boori bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni la m-bahi Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa mini di puuni nɛma zaa zuɣu, ka malimali di mini di puuni binyɛra zaa, ka di leei din be kasi.
en: Then take the anointing oil and anoint the dwelling and everything in it. Make holy the dwelling and all its equipment, and it will be holy.

dag: N suhiri Naawuni ni a ni mali yurilim shɛli din yi a yɛda niŋbu ni na maa ni kpaŋs a ka a baŋ bin sun shɛŋa zaa ti ni mali Masia ni la viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: I pray that the faith you share will make you understand every blessing we have in Christ.

dag: Amaa pa dimbɔŋɔ kɔŋko. Din pahi nyɛla, ti mali suhupiɛlli Naawuni sani ti Duuma Yisa Masia ŋun daa chɛ ka simdi kpe ti mini Naawuni sunsuuni maa zuɣu.
en: And not only will we be saved, but we also rejoice right now in what God has done for us through our Lord Jesus Christ. It is because of Jesus that we are now Gods friends.

dag: Hal ka bia maa daa ti bɔri ni o dirila kuruchunim maa bindira maa shɛli, dama so daa bi tir o bindirigu.
en: He was so hungry that he wanted to eat the food the pigs were eating. But no one gave him anything.

dag: A yi lo alikauli ka bi pal li, dindina a yi bi lo li, di so.
en: It is better to promise nothing than to promise something and not be able to do it.

dag: Bɛ dɔɣirikpamba yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Izraɛl bituuli ŋun yuli daa booni Rubin la daa dɔɣi bidibis anahi; Hanok mini Pallu ni Hɛzirɔn ni Karimi, bɛna n-daa nyɛ Rubin zuliya ni kpamba.
en: These were the leaders of their households. The descendants of Reuben, Israels oldest son: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi. These were Reubens clans.

dag: Yinim Mɔabnima, yimiya yi fɔntinsi ni chaŋ ti be tampima ni. Benya kaman ŋman so ŋun te o tiɛɣu vokabili noli ni la.
en: People in Moab, leave your towns. Go live among the rocks; be like a dove that makes its nest at the opening of a cave.

dag: Bolimiya Yawɛ yuli m-puh o. Chɛliya ka zuliya kam zaa baŋ o ni tum tuun kar shɛŋa yɛla.
en: Give thanks to the LORD; call upon his name; make his deeds known to all people!.

dag: Yisa ni daa mali ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba ka o sanna o ni daa wuhiri niriba saha shɛli ti bɔh o, Ŋun yiko ni ka a lee tumdi dimbɔŋɔnima bee ŋuni n-lee ti a di yiko maa.
en: Jesus had gone into the temple and was teaching when the chief priests and the leaders of the people came up to him. They asked, What right do you have to do these things? Who gave you this authority.

dag: Ka Ilaisha yɛli, Bolim o na. Ka o daa boli paɣ maa, ka o kana ti zani dunol ni.
en: Ask her to come here again, Elisha told his servant. He called for her, and she came and stood in the doorway of Elisha's room.

dag: ni Zanɔa ni Adulam ni di tiŋkpansi ni Lakishi ni di puri ni Azɛka ni di tiŋkpansi ka bɛ daa ʒini Bɛrishiiba zaŋ hal ni Hinnom Vinvamli ni.
en: and in Zanoah and Adullam and the small towns around them, in Lachish and the fields around it, and in Azekah and the small towns around it. So the people of Judah were living all the way from Beersheba to the Valley of Hinnom.

dag: Aram bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Uzi mini Hul ni Gɛta ni Mashi.
en: The descendants of Aram were the people of Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshek.

dag: Man Klɔdius Lisias n-sab gbaŋ ŋɔ m-puhiri n dan Gomna Filiksi.
en: Greetings from Claudius Lysias to the Honorable Governor Felix:.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima ni bɛ so yi bi yuri ka tum birigi n ni zali ya ni yi di tum shɛl la n-tum alahichi.
en: to tell the people of Israel that anyone who sinned and broke any of the Lord 's commands without intending to, would have to observe the following rules.

dag: Amaa yi suhukpeeni niŋbu puuni ka yi ni ti nya yi nyɛviya.
en: By holding fast, you will gain your lives.

dag: Zɛra bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Zimiri mini Ɛtan ni Hɛman ni Kalikol ni Dara, bɛ daa nyɛla niriba anu.
en: Zerahs family: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Darda—five in all.

dag: A daa fa ba bɛn je ba nuu ni bahi; ka tiligi ba bɛ dimnim nuu ni.
en: He saved our ancestors and rescued them from their enemies.

dag: Di saha maa o yɛrimi, N ni lan labi m biɛr kurili shee. Ka o yi labina nti nya ka di nyɛ zaɣ kuŋ ka kolikoli m-mali viɛla.
en: So it says, I will go back to the home I left. When it comes back, it finds that home still empty. It is all neat and clean.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa dɔɣi Manaasa mini Ifriim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Pɔtifɛra ŋun daa nyɛ Hɛliopolis tindan bipuɣiŋga Asɛnat la ni daa dɔɣi shɛb ti o m-bala.
en: In Egypt Joseph had two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim, by Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera, a priest in Heliopolis.

dag: ka fiɛb o ka naanyi ku o; amaa di daba ata dali o ni ti neei kum ni.
en: They will beat him and kill him, but three days later he will rise to life.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ ninvuɣ so ŋun bo o kpee paɣa. Ŋunkam shihi paɣa maa ku yi tibidarigibo ni.
en: If you sleep with another mans wife, you will be punished.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa boli Izraɛlnim zaa mini sapashinnim bɛn daa su tɔbbihi tuhilituhili mini bɛn su kɔbigakɔbiga fukumsi ni sariakaritiba ni Izraɛl toondaannim zaa ni daŋ kam ni kpamba zaa na.
en: King Solomon gave an order to all the officers in charge of units of a thousand men and of a hundred men, all the government officials, all the heads of families, and all the rest of the people.

dag: ka boli Lɔt m-bɔh o, Saamba bɛn kpe a yil ŋɔ yuŋ ŋɔ la lee be ya? Zaŋm ba na ka ti goli ba.
en: and started shouting, Where are your visitors? Send them out, so we can have sex with them.

dag: Amaa dindali maa yuŋ ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Neetan.
en: That night, the Lord told Nathan.

dag: Dama Yawɛ pun pii Yaakubu n-leeg o dahalali nira. O zaŋ Izraɛlnim leeg o dahalali niriba.
en: He chose the family of Jacob and the people of Israel for his very own.

dag: N kul dolila a soya viɛnyɛliŋga ka na ʒi m-birigi.
en: I have always walked in your way and have never strayed from it.

dag: kuhi pam yɛli, M min a bɔ ni, nyin Yisa Zallakudura Naa Bia? N suhir a Naawuni yuli zuɣu, di nahim ma.
en: As Jesus was saying, You evil spirit, come out of this man, the man shouted loudly, What do you want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg you in Gods name not to punish me.

dag: Mbusim be ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn chani Ijipti ti bɔri sɔŋsim zuɣu. Bɛ niŋla Ijipti tɔbbihi bɛn galisi pam la kpiɔŋ mini bɛ wɔribariba ni bɛ chɛchɛbunsi yɛda; amaa ka bi niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ yɛda bee n-suh o ni o sɔŋ ba.
en: You are in for trouble if you go to Egypt for help, or if you depend on an army of chariots or a powerful cavalry. Instead you should depend on and trust the holy Lord God of Israel.

dag: M bi zaɣisi ka bɛ di sabi n yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ sɔŋ! M bi zaɣisi ka bɛ di sab li niŋ kundi ni!.
en: Oh, that my words were written down, inscribed on a scroll.

dag: O daa tum alahichi shɛŋa zaa o ba ni daa tum la, ka o suhu daa bi ʒe Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni la yim kaman o yab Dauda suhu ni daa ʒiɛya shɛm la.
en: Abijam did not truly obey the Lord his God as his ancestor David had done. Instead, he was sinful just like his father Rehoboam.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa kpe m-pali Pita ka o yɛli ba, Yinim bɛn nyɛ zuɣulaannim mini kpamba ŋɔ.
en: Peter was filled with the Holy Spirit and told the nation's leaders and the elders:.

dag: N nya binshɛli ka di to n-gari kum. Dina n-nyɛ paɣ so ŋun ŋmani zana. O ni wuhi ni o yur a shɛm ŋmanila zana mini tɔŋ, ka o nuhi nyɛ bandi. Ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔri ni o niŋ din tiɣi Naawuni nini ni yi o yɛla ni, amaa alahichilan ni lu o zana maa ni.
en: I also found that some women are dangerous like traps. Their hearts are like nets, and their arms are like chains. It is worse than death to be caught by these women. Gods followers should run away from them. Let the sinners be caught by them.

dag: M pola pɔri ka ʒe di nyaaŋa ni n dol a wuntia zaligunim la.
en: I have sworn, and I fully mean it: I will keep your righteous rules.

dag: Di saha maa, zuliya kam bɛn daa kana ti lu Jɛrusalɛm zuɣu maa ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tiligi ni ti chani Jɛrusalɛm yuuni kam ti jɛmdi Naa ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, ka puhiri Suɣa Tibu chuɣu la.
en: All those left from all the nations who attacked Jerusalem will go up annually to pay homage to the king, the LORD of heavenly forces, and to celebrate the Festival of Booths.

dag: O daa poya Yawɛ sani. O daa po pɔri Yaakubu Naawuni ŋun nyɛ kpiɔŋlan ŋɔ sani yɛli.
en: He made a promise to you, Lord , an oath to the Mighty God of Jacob.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbaai Naa Zɛdɛkia n-zaŋ o tahi Babilɔn Naa sani Ribila, ka o daa kar o saria.
en: Zedekiah was taken to Riblah, where Nebuchadnezzar put him on trial and found him guilty.

dag: N ni darigi Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa tibili, ka kpihim Baal tuma din kpalim mini buɣa maligumaaniba yuya kpe.
en: I will punish Judah and the people living in Jerusalem. I will remove from this place any signs of Baal worship. No one will remember the priests who serve the idols there.

dag: Ibrahimma bidibisi daa nyɛla Yisahaku mini Ishimail.
en: Abraham had two sons, Isaac and Ishmael.

dag: dama yi yi ba n-zani yi biɛhigu ni ti Duuma zuɣu, di ni chɛ ka ti leei bɛn be.
en: Your strong faith in the Lord is like a breath of new life.

dag: Amaa ŋun tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa mal li tɔɣisirila ninsalinima bɛ kpaŋsibu mini bɛ saɣisibu ni bɛ suhumaabo zuɣu.
en: But those who proclaim God's message speak to people and give them help, encouragement, and comfort.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa kana ti paai Zin yɔɣu ni gol so ŋun daŋ tooni puuni n-ʒini Kadɛshi. Ka Miriam daa kpi nimaani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o nimaani.
en: The Israelites arrived at the desert of Zin in the first month of the year. The people stayed at Kadesh. Miriam died and was buried there.

dag: Ka bɛ yi yɔhim anabi maa ka o yɛli shɛli, di wuhiya ni man Yawɛ n-yɔhim anabi maa, ka n ni teei n nuu n-jɛnd o n-ku o n niriba Izraɛlnim sunsuuni.
en: As for the prophet who was seduced into speaking a word, even though it was I, the LORD, who seduced that prophet, I will use my power against him and cut him off completely from my people Israel.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda maŋmaŋ yi daa bol o o Duuma, di chaŋ wula ka o ni lan nyɛ ŋun Naa Dauda yaaŋa? Ka Yisa yɛligu maa daa paligi salo maa suhuri pam.
en: If David called the Messiah his Lord, how can the Messiah be his son? The large crowd enjoyed listening to Jesus teach.

dag: O daa lan me bindira mini wain palli ni kpama zaashee duri, ka daa lan me o niɣi balibu kam duri ni o biŋkɔbbaligu buzɔna.
en: He made barns to store the harvest of grain, wine, and olive oil; stalls for all kinds of cattle; and pens for flocks.

dag: ka Amasai nyɛ Ɛlikana bia, ka Ɛlikana nyɛ Joɛl bia, ka Joɛl nyɛ Azaria bia, ka Azaria nyɛ Zɛfania bia.
en: son of Elkanah son of Joel son of Azariah son of Zephaniah.

dag: Sool yuma daa nyɛla kaman yuun ... ka o naanyi di nam. O daa di nam maa n-su Izraɛlnim la kaman yuun ... ni ayi.
en: Saul was a young man when he became king, and he ruled Israel for two years.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan bol o yaha, Samuɛl! Ka Samuɛl daa lan yiɣisi chaŋ Ɛli sani ti yɛl o, A ni boli ma la, n-nyɛ ma. Amaa ka o yɛl o, M bia, m bi bol a, labimi ti dɔni.
en: The Lord called Samuel again. The boy did not know that it was the Lord , because the Lord had never spoken to him before. So he got up, went to Eli, and said, You called me, and here I am. But Eli answered, My son, I didn't call you; go back to bed.

dag: ka lan me n-gili Bɛtizur mini Soko ni Adulam.
en: Bethzur, Soco, Adullam.

dag: Yɛnnim yi nya ka barina kanna, bɛ sɔɣirimi, amaa ka tarimba bɛn chaŋ ti di di wahala.
en: Wise people see trouble coming and get out of its way, but fools go straight to it and suffer for it.

dag: ka niriba dooi anzinfa mini salima pa di zuɣu, ka zaŋ kpahi mini matarika n-kpahi li zali, din ni chɛ ka di ku dam.
en: and decorated with silver and gold. It is fastened down with nails to keep it from falling over.

dag: Kɔniŋdi bini maa yaɣimɛr mia barilim daa nyɛla sɛntimita ayopɔin ni pirigili. Ka di noli daa be kaman pipia nol la, ka lan be kaman paɣiviɛligakushihikom pum la, ka di daa kpɛrila kom litanim tuhi pihinahi.
en: The sides of the bowl were millimeters thick, and its rim was like a cup that curved outward like flower petals. The bowl held about , liters.

dag: N di ba shɛhira ni bɛ suhu yubu puuni bɛ tɔhiri kaman sokam ni o nyaŋbu tariga hal n-gari lala zuɣu gba.
en: I can tell you that they gave as much as they were able and even more than they could afford. No one told them to do this. It was their idea.

dag: Di saha ka naa maa tumtumdiba bɛn daa ʒe o yiŋ dunol ni daa bɔhi Mɔdɛkai, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a zaɣisi naa zaligu dolibu.
en: Then the kings leaders at the gate asked Mordecai, Why dont you obey the kings command to bow down to Haman.

dag: Ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Babɛl , dama nimaani ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ yɛtɔɣa woligiwoligi; nimaani ka o daa lan wurim ba kpɛhi dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: Therefore, it is named Babel, because there the LORD mixed up the language of all the earth; and from there the LORD dispersed them over all the earth.

dag: N kul kuhirimi bɔri sɔŋsim hal ni asiba. O bemi kaman gbuɣinli la n-kul ŋmari n kɔba wuntaŋ ni zaŋ hal ni yuŋ, o kul ŋmaarila n nyɛvili.
en: I cried out until morning: Like a lion God crushes all my bones. Between daybreak and nightfall you carry out your verdict against me.

dag: N ni chɛ ka yi be kaman nɛl la. N ni chɛ ka yi nyina nyɛ zaɣ pala ka dira. Yi ni niɛm zoya n-wurim li, ka niŋ daboya kaman wurigu la.
en: I will let you be like a log covered with sharp spikes. You will grind and crush every mountain and hill until they turn to dust.

dag: Ka ŋunkam tibigir omaŋa ni nya filiŋ, ka ŋunkam mi siɣisiri omaŋa ni nya tibiginsim.
en: Whoever makes himself great will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be made great.

dag: Naaman ŋun daa nyɛ Siria naa sapashin kpɛma daa nyɛla ninvuɣ titali, ka mali jilima pam o naa maa sani, dama o zuɣu ka Yawɛ daa tiri Sirianim nasara. O daa mali kpiɔŋ pam, ka lan nyɛ tɔbutuhir biiŋa; amaa ka kɔŋ lee mal o.
en: Naaman, the commander of the Syrian army, was highly respected and esteemed by the king of Syria, because through Naaman the Lord had given victory to the Syrian forces. He was a great soldier, but he suffered from a dreaded skin disease.

dag: Chɛ ka o bihi chanimi gindi maani bara, ka bɛ kari ba yihi bɛ yili chɛra ni.
en: Make his children wander around as beggars, forced from homes that lie in ruins.

dag: Di saha ka Gomna maa tɔbbihi daa zaŋ Yisa kpe Gomna maa yiŋ dundɔŋ ni nti laɣim bɛ tɔbbi tab zaa na.
en: The governor's soldiers led Jesus into the fortress and brought together the rest of the troops.

dag: Bɛ yi ti niŋdi ya lala, yin chɛliya ka di niŋ ya nyaɣisim ka yi mali suhupiɛlli, dama yi laara galisiya alizanda ni. Lala ka bɛ daa pun niŋ anabinim bɛn daŋ yi tooni la gba alaka.
en: Be happy about it. Be very glad because you have a great reward waiting for you in heaven. People did these same bad things to the prophets who lived before you.

dag: N di yuya ni o be n sani n-zan a zaani n-sɔŋdi ma n ni be sarika ŋɔ ni lahibal suŋ la zuɣu saha shɛli ŋɔ.
en: I would like to keep him here to help me while I am still in prison for telling the Good News. By helping me here, he would be representing you.

dag: Bɛ daa zaliya ni di saha maa zaŋ chaŋ ʒiɛmana din kanna puuni, Yɛhudia nir kam min o yiŋnim bɛn be tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣili kam ni mini tiŋ kam ni bɛn kul teemi puhimi Purim dabisa chuɣu maa, ka kul niŋmi lala zaŋ chana.
en: It was resolved that every Jewish family of every future generation in every province and every city should remember and observe the days of Purim for all time to come.

dag: Ka Sintani yi ŋmaligi tuhir omaŋa o ku tooi be, amaa o bahigu n-yɛn bala.
en: If Satan is against himself and is fighting against his own people, he will not survive. That would be the end of Satan.

dag: Ka n ni kpaŋ mmaŋ niŋ di ni simdi ni n niŋ shɛm, ka di chɛ ka yi ti tooi teeri dimbɔŋɔnim yɛla sahakam n kalinsi nyaaŋa.
en: Im eager for you always to remember these things after my death.

dag: Di chani a ʒiʒiinikpee yiŋa waawaayili, di yi pa lala, o nyee ni ti nyɔn a, ka o ku lan bɔr a.
en: And dont visit your neighbors homes too often, or they will begin to hate you.

dag: Chɛ ka niriba ŋɔ niŋ suhutunanima, ka chɛ ka bɛ tiba kpiri, ka chɛ ka bɛ nina zom, ka di chɛ ka bɛ ku zaŋ bɛ nina lihi nya, ka zaŋ bɛ tiba wum, ka zaŋ bɛ suhuri baŋ shɛli gbinni, ka ŋmaligina nya tibbu.
en: Confuse them. Make them unable to understand what they hear and see. If you dont do this, they might really look with their eyes, hear with their ears, and understand with their minds. Then they might come back to me and be healed.

dag: nti gbaag o fiɣisibu yɛra, Ti nya ka doo ŋɔ birigirila ti zuliya ŋɔ zaa, ka yɛri ni ti di yo farigu Naa Siiza sani, ka lan yɛri ni ŋuna n-nyɛ Masia ni naa.
en: began to accuse him. They said, We have found this man misleading our people, opposing the payment of taxes to Caesar, and claiming that he is the Christ, a king.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia.
en: Then the Lord said to me.

dag: Saha shɛli Rom naa ni daa zaŋ Gallio leei Akaianim gomna la, ka Yɛhudianim daa niŋ naŋgban yini n-chaŋ ti gbaai Pool n-vo o tahi saria karibu shee.
en: When Gallio was made the Roman governor of Achaia, Jews there got together, seized Paul, and took him into court.

dag: Ka o daa bo Ijipti bin suma n-ʒili bunsi pia ni bɛ zaŋ ti ti o ba, ka lan chɛ ka bɛ su kawana mini bɔrɔbɔro ni di ti nyɛ o ba sol ni bindira n-ʒili bunnyama pia pahi.
en: To his father he sent ten donkeys loaded with the best things in Egypt, and ten other donkeys loaded with grain and bread and other food for the return trip.

dag: Amaa man yɛri ya mi: di bɔhiriya tab biɛri; hal so yi lab a nudirigu polo tapaɣa, nyin lɛbigim din la gba pah o.
en: But I tell you not to try to get even with a person who has done something to you. When someone slaps your right cheek, turn and let that person slap your other cheek.

dag: Dama Yawɛ pun pii Ziɔn. O bɔri ni o zaŋ li leeg o biɛhigu shee. O daa yɛliya.
en: The Lord has chosen Zion to be the place for his Temple, the place he wanted for his home.

dag: Pɛrɛz bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Hɛzirɔn mini Hamul.
en: Perez had two sons, Hezron and Hamul.

dag: Dunɔguliba bɛn ʒiya m-bi gbihiri hal ka bɛ duuma ti paana mal alibarika. Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, o gba ni ti mali shili chɛ ka bɛ ʒini, ka o kpuɣi bindirigu na ti zali ba ka bɛ di.
en: How happy are those servants whose master finds them awake and ready when he returns! I tell you, he will take off his coat, have them sit down, and will wait on them.

dag: So mi ku saɣi zaŋ da palli le dakol kura ni, dama o yi niŋ lala da palli maa ni chɛhichɛhi kol kura maa, ka dam maa bahi yoli, ka kola maa gba saɣim. Dinzuɣu bɛ zaŋdi da palli lɛrila kol pala ni.
en: No one pours new wine into old wineskins. The wine would swell and burst the old skins. Then the wine would be lost, and the skins would be ruined. New wine must be put into new wineskins.

dag: Di daba ata dali ka bɛ daa ti nya o la Naawuni jɛmbu duu, ka o ʒi Yɛhudia adiini karimbanim sunsuuni wumdi bɛ yɛtɔɣa ka bɔhiri ba bɔhigunima.
en: Three days later they found Jesus sitting in the temple, listening to the teachers and asking them questions.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Dindali maa, naa mini kpambaliba ti ku lan mali suhukpeeni. Dabiɛm ni ti gbahi maligumaaniba, ka di niŋ anabinim alahiziba.
en: The Lord said, When all this happens, the king and his officials, the prophets and the priests will be shocked and terrified.

dag: Bɛn daa be n sani daa nya neesim maa, amaa ka lee bi wum kukoli maa ni yɛli ma shɛm maa.
en: Those who were traveling with me saw the light, but did not hear the voice.

dag: N Naawuni, niŋm ba kaman pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga taŋkpagbiligu la; ka niŋ ba kaman pɔhim n-ʒiɛri wurigu bahiri la.
en: My God, make them like tumbleweeds, like chaff blown by wind.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, a daŋ min a nam n-kul ni ʒiɛya, n sani ka a nam kul ni ʒiɛya sahakam. .
en: Your dynasty and your kingdom will be secured forever before me. Your throne will be established forever.

dag: Ka bɛ ni shɛb yi daa bi ʒe yim, di wuhiri ni Naawuni mi bi ʒe yim?.
en: What does it matter, then, if some werent faithful? Their lack of faith wont cancel Gods faithfulness, will it?.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla Mɛriba kom, luɣ shɛli Izraɛlnim mini Yawɛ ni daa yɛl tab finafina ni luɣ shɛli o ni daa wuhi ni o nyɛla ŋun be kasi.
en: This place was called the waters of Meribah. This is where the Israelites argued with the Lord and where he showed them that he was holy.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli Yawɛ zaligu, ka ka galimi bɛ biɛhigu ni mali alibarika.
en: Our Lord , you bless everyone who lives right and obeys your Law.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛri ya mi ni alahichilaan yino yi niŋ tuuba, Naawuni malaikanim gba malila suhupiɛlli o zuɣu.
en: In the same way, its a happy time for the angels of God when one sinner decides to change.

dag: Tiligim amaŋa kaman waliga ni tiligi tɔha nuu ni shɛm la bee kaman nooŋa ni tiligi noongbahira nuu ni shɛm la.
en: Escape from that trap like a deer running from a hunter. Free yourself like a bird flying from a trap.

dag: Dinzuɣu Bia maa ŋun yi yihi ya dabitim ni, yi shiri yiya ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: So if the Son makes you free, you are really free.

dag: Di saha Ɛli daa kurigiya pam ka wumd o bihi maa ni niŋdi Izraɛlnim shɛm maa zaa, hal ka mali paɣ shɛb bɛn daa tumdi tuma Naawuni jɛmbu duu dunol ni la doona.
en: Eli was now very old. He kept hearing about everything his sons were doing to the Israelites and that they were even sleeping with the women who worked at the entrance to the Tent of the Lord 's presence.

dag: Ka Naa Rɛhɔbɔam daa ti tim Adɔram ŋun daa su o tuun kpɛma tumbu fukumsi la Izraɛlnim sani, ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa pihi kuɣa lab ku o. Ka Naa Rɛhɔbɔam daa niŋ yomyom kpe o chɛchɛbuŋ lɔɣu ni n-zo kuli Jɛrusalɛm.
en: When King Rehoboam sent Adoram to them , all Israel stoned him to death. King Rehoboam quickly got into his chariot and fled to Jerusalem.

dag: Ka n daa chaŋ malaika maa sani nti yɛl o ni o zaŋm litaafi bila maa ti ma. Ka o yɛli ma, Zaŋm li ŋubi; di ni malis a nol ni kaman shir la, amaa ka lee to a puuni.
en: When I went over to ask the angel for the little scroll, the angel said, Take the scroll and eat it! Your stomach will turn sour, but the taste in your mouth will be sweet as honey.

dag: N yɛn ŋahila ŋaha. N yɛn tɔɣisila kurimbuni ha ashili yɛtɔɣa.
en: I am going to use wise sayings and explain mysteries from the past.

dag: N yi pala tumo zaŋ chaŋ shɛb sani, amaa biɛhiŋ kani, n nyɛla tumo yinim sani, dama yinima n-nyɛ n tumɔtali shihirili ti Duuma sani.
en: Others may think that I am not an apostle, but you are proof that I am an apostle to you.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa nya ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba zaa ka nimaani maa zuɣu ka bɛ daa kpe ŋarima maa n-chaŋ Kapɛrinium ni bɛ ti bo Yisa shee.
en: They saw that Jesus and his disciples had left. Then they got into the boats and went to Capernaum to look for Jesus.

dag: Ti dimnim zaa ni daa wum li, ka tinzunnim bɛn gili ti zaa daa nya li, ka bɛ kɔba ni chɔɣisi, dama bɛ daa baŋya ni ti Naawuni sɔŋsim ni ka tuma maa tum naai maa.
en: When our enemies in the surrounding nations learned that the work was finished, they felt helpless, because they knew that our God had helped us rebuild the wall.

dag: Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Aduna zuɣu hal ka o ti bɔr ni o ku o, amaa ka n daa lan suhi Naawuni Aduna gba zuɣu di saha maa.
en: The Lord was also angry enough with Aaron to kill him, so I prayed for Aaron at the same time.

dag: Dauda ni daa mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini suhudoo sara maa naai, ka o daa zaŋ Yawɛ yuli n-suhi alibarika niŋ niriba maa ni.
en: After David had finished giving the burnt offerings and fellowship offerings, he used the Lord s name to bless the people.

dag: M Ba, m bɔri ni a chɛ ka a ni daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛba ti ma la ti be n sani n ni ti yɛn be luɣ shɛl la n-nya jilima shɛli a ni daa zaŋ ti ma ka di nyɛla a ni daa pun yuri ma ka dunia na bi nam la zuɣu.
en: Father, I want these people you have given me to be with me in every place I am. I want them to see my glory—the glory you gave me because you loved me before the world was made.

dag: A yi chɛ ka a suhu ʒe dɛde, a ni tooi teeg a nuhi tir o.
en: If you make your mind resolute and spread your palms to him.

dag: Ka ŋun yuri Naawuni daalibarika yi be yili maa ni, yi daalibarika puhigu maa ni kpalim o ni; amaa lala nir yi ka yili maa ni, di ni lab yi sanna yaha.
en: If someone who is peace-loving lives there, let your greeting of peace remain on that person; if not, take back your greeting of peace.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ cheechi din nyɛ o niŋgbuŋ la zuɣu; o kɔbili ni ka di yina. O nyɛla Naawuni Bikpɛm ŋun nyɛ kpiimba kum ni neebu toondana ni di chɛ ka o nyɛ ŋun gari binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: He is the head of the body, which is the church. He is the beginning of everything else. And he is the first among all who will be raised from death. So in everything he is most important.

dag: O daa yɛliya, Yawɛ n-nyɛ n tampiŋ ni m birini ni ŋun fari ma bahira.
en: He said: The LORD is my solid rock, my fortress, my rescuer.

dag: O daa ku Ijiptinim bidib kpamba zaa bɛn daa nyɛ bɛ ni tuui dɔɣi bi shɛba Ham suɣa ni la.
en: He killed the first-born son of each Egyptian family.

dag: ni Dilian ni Mizipa ni Jokitiɛl.
en: Dilan, Mizpeh, Jokthe-el.

dag: Ka suhusaɣiŋgu zuɣu daa chɛ ka Naa Bɛlishaaza ninni biɛhigu maan taɣi pahi, ka o kpambaliba bi lan mi bɛ ni yɛn gbaai shɛm.
en: King Belshazzars officials were confused, and the king became even more afraid and worried. His face was white from fear.

dag: N daa tum tuun kara. N daa me yiya, ka ko wain tihi puri.
en: I accomplished great things. I built myself houses and planted vineyards.

dag: Nyini ka n zaŋ ŋme n-ku doo mini paɣa. Nyini ka n zaŋ ŋme n-ku do kurugu mini bidibbila. Nyini ka n zaŋ ŋme n-ku nachimbil mini paɣisaribila.
en: I used you to smash men and women. I used you to smash men, old and young. I used you to smash young men and young women.

dag: N ni chɛ ka o dimnim di vi, amaa ka chɛ ka o nam mali jilima.
en: I will cover his enemies with shame, but his kingdom will prosper and flourish.

dag: dama m mi ni di ku lan yuui ka n kani kaman ti Duuma Yisa Masia ni kahigi wuhi ma shɛm.
en: And our Lord Jesus Christ has already told me that I will soon leave it behind.

dag: Ka sana daa ti paai bundana maa, ka o je ni o piig o piɛri maa ni bee o niɣi maa yino n-niŋ o saani, amaa ka daa chaŋ ti gbaala faralan maa piɛsaa la na nti niŋ o san maa saani.
en: One day a visitor arrived at the rich man's home. The rich man didn't want to kill one of his own animals to fix a meal for him; instead, he took the poor man's lamb and prepared a meal for his guest.

dag: Di daba ata dali ka Izraɛl kpambaliba daa yiɣisi kpe bɛ sansani maa ni chani gindi.
en: After three days the leaders went through the camp.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri soli nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ sani, amaa o yuri ninvuɣ so ŋun doli wuntitali soli.
en: The Lord hates the ways of evil people, but loves those who do what is right.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa nim daa ŋme tɔbuchiriga bah o zuɣu ka o daa lu bɛ ni gbi bɔɣ shɛli ni, ka bɛ daa zaŋ zoligɔnim yih o na n-vo o tahi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: The people heard him roar, and they caught him in their trap. They put hooks in his mouth and carried the young lion to Egypt.

dag: Ziɔn Zoli ni kpalim dabari, ka kunduna be di zuɣu gɔra.
en: Mount Zion is a wasteland. Foxes run around on Mount Zion.

dag: Yi yi ti chaŋ ti dɔni ni yi tuhi yi dimnima, yin gbaamiya yimaŋa ni zaɣ biɛɣu kam zaa.
en: When you are in camp in time of war, you are to avoid anything that would make you ritually unclean.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yi ti nya ka liɣiri din be adaka maa ni zooi, naa gbaŋsabira mini maligumaaniba zuɣulana kanimina nti kal li, ka zaŋ bɛ ni nya laɣ shɛli Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni n-niŋ kpalansi ni lo.
en: When the box was full of money, the king's secretary and the chief priest would count the money and put it in bags.

dag: Yi mi ni yi ni daa nyɛ chɛfirinim saha shɛl la, buɣa din ku tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa n-daa sun ya ka birigi ya.
en: You know that while you were still heathen, you were led astray in many ways to the worship of lifeless idols.

dag: Amaa man Naawuni bɔhiri ninvuɣ biɛri, Bɔzuɣu ka yi kul tɔɣisiri n zaligunim yɛla sahakam? Bee bɔzuɣu ka yi tɔɣisiri n daalikauli yɛla?.
en: But God says to the wicked, Stop quoting my laws! Stop talking about my agreement!.

dag: Di piligu dali zaŋ hal ti paai di naabu dali, Ɛzra daa kul karindila Naawuni zaligu litaafi maa dabisili kam. Daba ayopɔin ka bɛ daa zaŋ puhi chuɣu maa, ka daa niŋ Naawuni jɛmbu laɣiŋgu dabisi shɛli din pahir anii dali kaman zaligu ni daa wuhi shɛm.
en: He read from Gods Instruction scroll every day, from the first until the last day of the festival. They kept the festival for seven days and held a solemn assembly on the eighth day, just as the Instruction required.

dag: Bɛ paɣiri nir o yɛm zuɣu, amaa ka ʒiɛmdi ŋun tɛha bi zilima.
en: A person is praised for his insight, but a warped mind leads to contempt.

dag: Yi suhuri yi ye din tuhi tumbu zuɣu, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi niŋ ya shɛli?.
en: Who will harm you if you are eager to do what is good?.

dag: Ka Abiata daa yina, nyama, ka Zadok gba mini Lɛvinim zaa daa kpuɣi Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka la na ti zaŋ li zali hal ka niriba maa zaa ti yi tiŋ maa ni na.
en: Zadok and all the Levites with him were carrying the Box of Gods Agreement. They set down Gods Holy Box, and Abiathar said prayers until all the people had left Jerusalem.

dag: Dinzuɣu siɣisimiya yimaŋa Naawuni nuu din mali yiko la ni, ka di chɛ ka o ti duhi ya o ni yu saha shɛli.
en: So be humble under Gods powerful hand. Then he will lift you up when the right time comes.

dag: Amɔz bia Aizaia ni daa deei yɛtɔɣ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Babilɔnnim polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is the message that I was given about Babylon:.

dag: Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ kahig o suhu ni yiɣisi bahi tuun shɛŋa din bi doli wuntia soli mini tuumbiɛ shɛŋa zaa ninsalinim ni tumdi zuɣu wuhi, dama bɛ zaŋdi bɛ tuumbiɛri maa guri yɛlimaŋli soli.
en: God shows his anger from heaven against all the evil and wrong things that people do. Their evil lives hide the truth they have.

dag: Di saha ka Ziba daa yɛli naa, N dana, mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni niŋ a ni yɛli ni n niŋ shɛlikam maa zaa. Ka Mɛfibɔshɛt mini Dauda daa kul laɣindi timdi diri kaman naa maŋmaŋ bidibisi ni yino n-nyɛ o la.
en: Ziba answered, I will do everything Your Majesty commands. So Mephibosheth ate at the king's table, just like one of the king's sons.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima: Yi yi ti paai n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya la ni na, tiŋgbɔŋ maa yɛn malila di vuhim yuuni Yawɛ sani.
en: Speak to the Israelites and say to them: Once you enter the land that I am giving you, the land must celebrate a sabbath rest to the LORD.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yɛli, So n-shiri shihi ma, dama m baŋya ni yiko shɛli yi n ni.
en: But Jesus said, Someone touched me. I felt power go out from me.

dag: Chɛ ka o be n-yuui kaman wuntaŋ mini goli ni be shɛm ŋɔ ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: May your people worship you as long as the sun shines, as long as the moon gives light, for ages to come.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah ayi dol o gbin na yɛra, Babilɔn din nyɛ tin titali din daa muɣisi zuliya kam ka bɛ nyu di kɔr biɛri wain la luya.
en: Then the second angel followed the first angel and said, She is destroyed! The great city of Babylon is destroyed! She made all the nations drink the wine of her sexual sin and of Gods anger.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Ilaija.
en: Then the LORDs word came to Elijah.

dag: O daba maa bihi ni ti su li, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yur o ti be nimaani.
en: The offspring of Gods servants will inherit Zion, and those who love Gods name will dwell there.

dag: Ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdib shɛb daa yɛli, Karimba, a yɛli yɛlimaŋli.
en: Some of the teachers of the law said, Teacher, your answer was very good.

dag: Miriya ka yi niŋ din ni miligi Yɛhudianim bee bɛn pa Yɛhudianim bee Naawuni cheechinim suhuri.
en: Live in such a way as to cause no trouble either to Jews or Gentiles or to the church of God.

dag: Yawɛ kahig omaŋ wuhi, o kari saria ka tuumbiɛrinim maŋmaŋ nuhi tuma leei zana ŋmaligi gbahi ba.
en: The Lord showed that he judges fairly. The wicked were caught by what they did to hurt others. Higgayon Selah.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli, Bɛ ni yɛri Sɔdomnim mini Gomɔranim daalahichi yɛla shɛm galisiya.
en: Then the Lord said, I have heard many times that the people of Sodom and Gomorrah are very evil.

dag: a ni ti bɔhim bɛ biɛhigu maa, ka di chɛ ka a kpɛh amaŋ zana ni.
en: You might learn their habits and not be able to change.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim ni daa mali zali naai maa, ka maligumaaniba daa kul kpɛri tanti duu din daŋ tooni la ni nti tumdi bɛ maligumaanitali tuma dabisili kam;.
en: This is how those things have been arranged. The priests go into the outer tent every day to perform their duties.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛzra daa yɛli, Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋun galisi ŋɔ! Ka niriba maa zaa daa kpuɣi bɛ nuhi zuɣusaa ka yɛra, Ami! Ami! Di saha ka bɛ daa silim bɛ zuɣuri tiŋa n-jɛmdi Naawuni.
en: Ezra praised the Lord , the great God, and all the people held up their hands and said, Amen! Amen! Then all the people bowed down and put their faces low to the ground and they worshiped the Lord .

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ paɣ maa yina, ka o tim ti yɛl o yidan ba Juda, Do so ŋun su nɛma ŋɔ n-ti ma pua maa. N suhir a, lihim li nya ŋuni n-lee su li. Nɛma maa n-nyɛ: nintua din mali dalinli ŋɔ mini zoligo ŋɔ ni jaaŋgbee ŋɔ.
en: When she was brought out, she sent this message to her father-in-law, Im pregnant by the man who owns these things. See if you recognize whose seal, cord, and staff these are.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, a ni tooi kpuɣ a zuɣu ka galimi kani, a ni yi barina ni, ka ku lan zɔri dabiɛm.
en: If you will do that, you could look to God without shame. You can stand strong and not be afraid.

dag: Yisa ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai saha shɛli maa, ka o dii wuɣiri duri zuɣusaa, ka bɛ kul lihir o hal ka sagbani ti lim o, ka bɛ bi lan nya o.
en: After Jesus said these things, as they were watching, he was lifted up and a cloud took him out of their sight.

dag: Azigad daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tusaayi ni kɔbisita ni pisinaayi.
en: of Azgad .

dag: O zaŋd o bumbil lɔri wain tia, ka zaŋd o bunsaa bia lɔri wain ti viɛlli. O zaŋdi wain paɣir o situra, ka zaŋdi wain wala kom paɣir o binyɛr titali.
en: He ties his young donkey to a grapevine, To the very best of the vines. He washes his clothes in blood-red wine.

dag: A ni tooi tim saanyaɣisibu ka di chaŋ ka labina ti yɛl a, Mani m-bɔŋɔ?.
en: or will lightning flash at your command?.

dag: Zakai daŋ — kɔbisiyopɔin ni pihiyɔbu.
en: the descendants of Zaccai:.

dag: Di saha yi yi ti na kul zaɣisi n noli ka ku doli ma, n ni chɛ ka alɔbo lu yi zuɣu ʒiibuyopɔin kaman yi daalahichi ni galisi shɛm tariga.
en: If you keep rebelling against me, I'll punish you seven times worse, just as your sins deserve!.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ salima alali niŋ di puuni mini di nyaaŋa zaa, ka niŋ salima kɔɣili li gili.
en: He covered it with pure gold inside and out and put a gold border all around it.

dag: Di yi niŋ ka naŋgbankpeeni lu niriba ayi sunsuuni ka bɛ tahi li ʒiishee, ka sariakaritiba ti ŋmaai bɛ yɛtɔɣa maa, ka wuhi ŋun mali yɛlimaŋli ni ŋun ka yɛlimaŋli.
en: When two people have an argument, they should go to the court. The judges will decide which person is right and which is wrong.

dag: Barizillai daa nyɛla yuun pihinii nira, ŋuna n-daa ti bo bindira n-zaŋ ti Naa Dauda saha shɛl o ni daa be Mahanaim la, dama o daa nyɛla bundana.
en: Barzillai was a very old man, eighty years old. He was very rich and had supplied the king with food while he was staying at Mahanaim.

dag: hal ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi bi kɔŋ Naawuni Shia Kasi pin shɛli yi ni guhiri saha shɛli ti Duuma Yisa Masia ni ti yɛn yi palo dahin shɛl la.
en: that you have not failed to receive a single blessing, as you wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to be revealed.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika daa be alizanda ni ka boli Ibrahimma pahi buyi.
en: The LORDs messenger called out to Abraham from heaven a second time.

dag: Ŋun pal alikauli ni bin din pɔra ni lan pal alikauli ni bin din galisi. Ŋun mi bi pal alikauli ni bin din pɔra ku pal alikauli ni bin din galisi.
en: Anyone who can be trusted in little matters can also be trusted in important matters. But anyone who is dishonest in little matters will be dishonest in important matters.

dag: Dama lala ka ti Duuma daa zali ti kaman di ni sabi yɛli shɛm la: N zal a mi ni a leei bɛn pa Yɛhudianim firila, ka zaŋ tiliginsim yɛla ŋɔ gili dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam hal ti kpa di tarisi zaa. .
en: This is what the Lord commanded us: I have made you a light for the Gentiles, so that you could bring salvation to the end of the earth .

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N suhu ka bɛ bɔri ni bɛ yiɣisi maa? Pa bɛmaŋmaŋ ka bɛ niŋ lala ni di ŋmaligi di ba maa.
en: But they are not only insulting me; they are also harming themselves by doing these shameful things.

dag: Dama yi je saɣisigu; ka zaŋ n yɛligu labisi yi kpali nyaaŋa.
en: You hate for me to tell you what to do. You ignore what I say.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi ni yino kuli ti zaŋ yi tizo maa na, ka yinim bɛn kpalim be sarika ni, ka ti buɣisi yi ni yɛli shɛm maa nya yɛlimaŋli ka yi yɛli maa, di yi pa lala, m po Firawuna ni yi shiri nyɛla puɣisiriba.
en: One of you must go and get him. The rest of you will be kept under guard until the truth of what you say can be tested. Otherwise, as sure as the king lives, you are spies.

dag: Dinzuɣu tim man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ yɛm din ni zaŋ gbib a niriba maa, ka tooi baŋ zaɣ suŋ ni zaɣ biɛɣu woligibu; dama ŋuni n-lee ni tooi gbib a niriba bɛn galisi pam ŋɔ.
en: Please make me wise and teach me the difference between right and wrong. Then I will know how to rule your people. If you don't, there is no way I could rule this great nation of yours.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ zaa tɔɣisi ti ni daa ka yi sanna ka yi deei ti viɛnyɛliŋga shɛm la yɛla: Yi daa ŋmaligi chaŋ Naawuni sani ka chɛ buɣa ni yi jɛm Naawuni maŋli ŋun nyɛ nyɛvililana ŋɔ.
en: Everyone is talking about how you welcomed us and how you turned away from idols to serve the true and living God.

dag: Ka Piɛbil maa daa tabigi bintabinda maa ni din pah anu, ka n nya bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb Naawuni yɛligu mini bɛ shɛhira niŋbu zuɣu la shihi bimbini gbini.
en: When he opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar those who had been slaughtered on account of the word of God and the witness they had given.

dag: N ni ti ba suhu shɛli din ni chɛ ka bɛ baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. Ka bɛ ti leei n niriba, ka m mi leei bɛ Naawuni; dama bɛ ni ti labi n sanna ni bɛ suhuri zaa.
en: I will give them a heart to know me, for I am the LORD. They will be my people, and I will be their God, for they will return to me with all their heart.

dag: Ʒiri shɛhiralana ni kpi, amaa ŋun gbilisi tibili wum viɛnyɛliŋga ni di shɛhira viɛlli.
en: A lying witness will perish, but one who listens will testify successfully.

dag: Dindali maa ka bɛ daa karim Musa litaafi n-wuhi niriba maa, ka bɛ daa nya di ni luɣ shɛli din sabi yɛli ni di bi simdi ka bɛ chɛ ka Ammɔnnim mini Mɔabnim zaŋ bɛmaŋa m-bali Naawuni niriba ni bɛ laɣiŋgu ni.
en: On that day the Book of Moses was read out loud, so that all the people could hear. They found this law written there: No Ammonite and no Moabite would be permitted to join in the meetings with God.

dag: Ɛfurɔn maŋmaŋ daa ʒila o tab Hitinim maa sani; ka ŋun Ɛfurɔn daa yɛli Ibrahimma o tab Hitinim bɛn zaa daa ʒi tiŋ maa dunoli shee maa sani.
en: Ephron was sitting there among the people. He answered Abraham.

dag: Bɛ ni me goon shɛŋa din du ka mali yaa taɣi bɛmaŋ la zaa ni kab lu tiŋ dahim zaa.
en: He will destroy the fortresses of Moab with their high walls and bring them tumbling down into the dust.

dag: Chɛ ka zuɣusaanim mali suhupiɛlli, ka chɛ ka dunianim mali suhupiɛlli. Yɛlimiya zuliya kam ni, Yawɛ n-nyɛ naa.
en: Tell the heavens and the earth to be glad and celebrate! And announce to the nations, The Lord is King.

dag: Bee a kul zaɣisi ti mi zaa, ka a suhuyiɣisili maa lan ka maabu?.
en: You were very angry with us. Have you completely rejected us?.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa bɔhi Yisifu biɛyanim maa, Tuun bɔ n-lee nyɛ yi tuma? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Tinim a daba ŋɔ mini ti yaannim nyɛla piɛguliba.
en: Pharaoh said to the brothers, What work do you do? The brothers said to Pharaoh, Sir, we are shepherds, just as our ancestors were shepherds before us.

dag: Di saha ka anabi Jɛrimia daa yɛli Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa Jɛrusalɛm.
en: So Jeremiah told all this message to Zedekiah in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka Sool daa me sara maligu bimbini zali Yawɛ; dina n-daa nyɛ o ni tuui me sara maligu bimbin shɛli zali Yawɛ.
en: Then Saul built an altar for the Lord . Saul himself began building that altar for the Lord .

dag: Amaa Sulemaana daa bi zaŋ Izraɛlnim leei daba. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ o tɔbbihi min o kpamba ni o sapashinnim ni o sapashin kpamba ni o chɛchɛbunsi duhiriba kpamba ni o wɔribariba.
en: However, Solomon didnt force the Israelites to work as slaves; instead, they became warriors, his servants, his leaders, his officers, and those in charge of his chariots and cavalry.

dag: Ka o ti zaŋ Zɛdɛkia kuli Babilɔn, ka o ti be nimaani hal ka n ti lan zaŋ n zaɣa labis o polo. Hal yi yi tuhi Babilɔnnim maa, yi ku di nasara. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.?.
en: The king of Babylon will take Zedekiah to Babylon. Zedekiah will stay there until I have punished him. This message is from the Lord . If you fight against the army of the Babylonians, you will not succeed.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa yiɣisi chaŋ ni o ti zaŋ omaŋ wuhi Naa Ɛhab. Kum daa mii Samarianim pam di saha maa.
en: So Elijah went to appear before Ahab. Now the famine had become especially bad in Samaria.

dag: Garigim jɛra kaman bɛ jɛrilim ni simdi shɛm, di yi pa lala bɛ ni tɛhi ni bɛ mali yɛm.
en: Give a silly answer to a silly question, and the one who asked it will realize that he's not as smart as he thinks.

dag: ka Shammua daa nyɛ Biliga daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma, ka Jɛhɔnatan so mi daa nyɛ Shɛmaya daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma;.
en: Shammua of Bilgah, Jehonathan of Shemaiah.

dag: Ka a zaŋ bantabiga vil o, ka zaŋ zuɣupil shɛli din be kasi pil o pa bantabiga maa zuɣu.
en: Put the turban on his head and the special crown around the turban.

dag: di saha ka o daa nya yɛm ka kahigi li, ka zal li, ka bo n-yihi li na.
en: he also determined the truth and defined wisdom.

dag: Kpɛmiya tampima voya ni mini tiŋgbani voya ni n-tiligi Yawɛ dabiɛm zɔbu min o nam dariza ni saha shɛl o yi ti kana ni o ti dam dunia ŋɔ.
en: People will hide in caves in the rocky hills or dig holes in the ground to try to escape from the Lord 's anger and to hide from his power and glory, when he comes to shake the earth.

dag: Jɔtam yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaanu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pinaayɔbu. O ma yuli n-daa booni Jɛrusha, o daa nyɛla Zadok bipuɣiŋga.
en: Jotham was years old when he became king, and he ruled for sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Jerushah; she was Zadoks daughter.

dag: Ka di tintariga daa ŋmaligi kpa wulimpuhili polo n-zaŋ hal ni Bɛtidagɔn m-mali hal ti paai Zɛbulɔn mini Ifitahɛl Vinvamli din be Bɛtimɛk mini Nɛyɛl soli nuzaa polo la, ka kul zaŋ kpa nuzaa polo maa hal ti paai Kabul.
en: As it turned east, the border went to Bethdagon, touching Zebulun and Iphtahel Valley on the way north to Bethemek and Neiel. It continued north to Cabul.

dag: Lala ka bɛ daa niŋ ta bɛmaŋ daɣiri bɛ tumtumsa ni, ka bɛ tuma maa zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ bi ʒe yim.
en: They made themselves unclean by what they did; they prostituted themselves by their actions.

dag: Musa ni daa tim ninvuɣ shɛb ni bɛ chaŋ ti puɣisi nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa yuya m-bala. Ka Musa daa taɣi Nan bia Hɔshia yuli Jɔshua.
en: These are the names of the men whom Moses sent out to explore the land. Moses changed the name of Hoshea, Nuns son, to Joshua.

dag: Mbaye n niriba, pumpɔŋɔ teemiya Mɔab Naa Balak ni daa lo shɛm la yɛla, ka teei Bɛɔr bia Balaam ni daa garigi yɛl o shɛm la yɛla. Lan teemiya yi ni daa yi Shitim chani Giligal ka binshɛŋa niŋ ni di chɛ ka yi baŋ Yawɛ tiliginsim tuma yɛla la.
en: My people, remember the evil plans of Balak king of Moab. Remember what Balaam son of Beor said to Balak. Remember what happened from Acacia to Gilgal, and you will know the Lord is right.

dag: Nyama, a nya Yawɛ ni zaŋ a niŋ n nuu ni shɛm vol la ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka n niriba shɛb di yɛli ni n kum a, amaa ka man lee tilig a. N di yɛlimi, Man ku zaŋ n nuu shihi n dana, dama o nyɛla Yawɛ ni booi kpam bahi so zuɣu ni.
en: You can see that with your own eyes that is not true. The Lord put you within my grasp today in the cave, but I refused to kill you. I was merciful to you. I said, I wont hurt my master. Saul is the Lord s chosen king.

dag: Dama tulaale ŋɔ naan tooi kɔhi gari tumtumda yuun muni tuma yɔri ka bɛ zaŋ li ti nandaamba. Ka bɛ daa ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni niŋdi paɣ maa.
en: It could have been sold for more than three hundred silver coins and the money given to the poor! And they criticized her harshly.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ku lan ŋubi niriba, yi mi ku lan chɛ ka yi zuliya kɔŋ bihi. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: therefore, you will no longer devour human beings or deprive your nation of anything. This is what the LORD God says.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti tam Lɛvinim bɛn be yi tinsi maa ni la yɛla, dama bɛ ka tarili bee fali yi sani.
en: And since people of the Levi tribe won't own any land for growing crops, remember to ask the Levites to celebrate with you.

dag: Ka paɣ yi po pɔri ka lo alikauli ni o niŋ shɛli o yidan yiŋa.
en: If a married woman makes a vow or promises to abstain from something.

dag: Amaa n ni ti zaŋ o leei n niriba zuɣulana, ka chɛ ka o nam kul beni sahakam.
en: Ill install him in my house and in my kingdom forever, and his throne will be established forever.

dag: Yi biɛhigu ni ti nyɛla biɛhiŋ wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa, ka dabiɛm mali ya ka yi nyɛviya be barina ni.
en: Your life will seem to dangle before your very eyes. You will be afraid night and day. You wont be able to count on surviving for long.

dag: Gaad zuliya tiŋgbani maa tariga nudirigu polo, yi tiŋgbani maa tintariga yɛn pilila Tama zaŋ hal ni Mɛribatikadɛshi kulibɔŋ ni n-zaŋ nimaani doli Ijipti tintariga hal ni Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku ni.
en: On the south side of the portion given to the tribe of Gad, the boundary runs southwest from Tamar to the oasis of Kadesh, and then northwest along the Egyptian border to the Mediterranean Sea.

dag: Yɛlim Aduna, A yi ti zaŋ firilanim ayopɔin la zali, nyin chɛ ka di ne firilatamdigu la tooni. .
en: Tell Aaron that when he puts the seven lamps on the lampstand, he should place them so that the light shines toward the front.

dag: Anabi Hanania ni daa kabigi naɣikɔra dapua maa anabi Jɛrimia nyiŋgoli zuɣu maa nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia.
en: Sometime after Hananiah had broken the yoke that was on Jeremiahs neck, the LORD told him.

dag: Ka o ni daa tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣa maa, ka shia daa kpe n ni n-yiɣisi ma zali n naba zuɣu, ka n daa wum ka o yɛri ma;.
en: While the voice was speaking, God's spirit entered me and raised me to my feet, and I heard the voice continue.

dag: Juda zuliya n-daa zaŋ bɛ tuuta daŋ yiɣisi doli tab gbilligbilli gbaai chandi. Aminadab bia Nashɔn n-daa nyɛ bɛ zaa zuɣulana.
en: and each time they moved, they were in the same order. Those under the banner of the division led by the tribe of Judah started out first, company by company, with Nahshon son of Amminadab in command.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti mali jɛma shili, di saha ka maligumaaniba maa daa zani bɛ zaashɛhi, ka Lɛvinim mi daa piripiri taba zani kaman naa ni daa zali ba shɛm.
en: When everything was arranged for the Passover, the priests and the Levites took their posts, as commanded by the king.

dag: ka o lihi n-nya Yisa ni chani ha ka yɛli, Nyamiya Naawuni Piɛbil la ha.
en: When he saw Jesus walking by, he said, Here is the Lamb of God.

dag: Tɔbu lu baɣisi zuɣu ni di chɛ ka bɛ leei jɛra. Tɔbu lu bɛ tɔbbihi zuɣu ka bɛ suhuri fuŋ.
en: A sword against its diviners so that they become fools. A sword against its warriors so that they are terrified.

dag: Ka niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu maa yi yɛlig o niŋgbuŋ ni, ka dɔro maa niŋ dilan niŋgbuŋ zaa, o zuɣu ni hal ni o naba ni, ka maligumaana maa nya li.
en: If the skin disease spreads and covers you from head to foot.

dag: A ni saɣi diɛmd o kaman noombil la bee n-lo o zal a tumtumdiba bɛn nyɛ bipuɣinsi?.
en: Can it be tied by the leg like a pet bird for little girls?.

dag: Ka Musa daa boli Mishɛl mini Ɛlizafan bɛn daa nyɛ Aduna bapira Uziɛl bidibisi la na n ti yɛli ba, Mirimiya na ti kpuɣi yi mabihi maa luɣ kasi shee ŋɔ yi ti biɛhigu shee ŋɔ kpaŋa.
en: Moses sent for Mishael and Elzaphan, the two sons of Aaron's uncle Uzziel. Then he told them, Take these two dead relatives of yours outside the camp far from the entrance to the sacred tent.

dag: Ti Duuma, a kurimbuni ha yurilim maŋli din nyɛ a ni daa po a ʒiɛyimtali puuni n-yɛli Dauda shɛli yɛla la lee be ya?.
en: Lord, where are the former proofs of your love? Where are the promises you made to David?.

dag: ka paɣiri bɛ wuna din nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋ salima min anzinfa ni daanya ni kuriti ni dari ni kuɣa mali shɛŋa.
en: As they were drinking, they gave praise to their idol gods, which were only statues made from gold, silver, bronze, iron, wood, and stone.

dag: Dama n ʒi naŋgban malisim niŋbu, di yi nyɛ lala ŋun nam ma ŋɔ ŋun chɛ ka m bahi pumpɔŋɔ.
en: if I did, my Creator would quickly destroy me!.

dag: Ka salo zaa daa kpalim samban ni suhiri Naawuni tulaale zim maa tuɣilibu saha.
en: while the people stood outside praying.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Sulemaana, Nyama, Adɔnija zɔrila nyin Naa Sulemaana, dama nyama, o gbaala sara maligu bimbini bin yila la gbibi ka yɛra, Faashee Naa Sulemaana daŋ po pɔri yɛli ma ni o ku ku man ŋun nyɛ o dabili ŋɔ. .
en: Someone told Solomon, Adonijah is afraid of you and is holding onto the corners of the altar. He wants you to promise that you won't kill him.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ni ŋmari ʒiri, ka nyari ʒii shɛŋa din pa yɛlimaŋli maa zuɣu, n suhu yiɣisimi bahi yi zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: So now, the Lord GOD really will speak. He says, You told lies. You saw visions that were not true. So now I am against you! This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: ka yɛli, Yawɛ, amaŋmaŋ daa yɛli ni a ni wurim kpe ŋɔ, ka ninsalinim bee biŋkɔbiri ku lan be di ni, ka kpe ti zani dabari sahakam. .
en: Then say, Lord , you have said that you will destroy this place, Babylon. You will destroy it so that no people or animals will live in it. This place will be an empty ruin forever.

dag: So ka suhupiɛlli tiŋgban shɛli din mali atam maa ni. So bi tahiri bee n-yiini yila wain tihi puri maa ni. So mi bi nɔri wain tihi wala ni o yihi wain, ka so bi wumdi suhupiɛlli tahigu damli.
en: or joyful and happy times, while bringing in the crops. Singing and shouting are gone from the vineyards. There are no joyful shouts where grapes were pressed. God has silenced them all.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba daa ti laɣim zaŋ bɛ noya naai Abinɛr ka bɛ min o leei zaɣ yini n-du zoli maa zuɣu ti zani.
en: The Benjaminites rallied behind Abner, forming a single unit. Then they took their positions on the top of a hill.

dag: Dama nyini n-ti o yiko ni o su daadam kam fukumsi, ka niŋ o yiko ni o ti ninvuɣ shɛb zaa a ni zaŋ ti o nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: And you gave him power over all people, so he would give eternal life to everyone you give him.

dag: Dama yuŋ la ka n Duuma Naawuni ŋun su ma ka n jɛmd o ŋɔ malaika sa ka n sanna.
en: Last night an angel from the God to whom I belong and whom I worship stood beside me.
