dag: dindina yin zomiya takɔbi dabiɛm, dama suhuyiɣisili tahiri tibidarigibo din nyɛ takɔbi na ni di chɛ ka yi baŋ ni sariakaribo din tuhi beni.
en: But now, be afraid of the sword— the sword that brings God's wrath on sin, so that you will know there is one who judges.

dag: Ti zaɣisi ni ti ku wum a daba bɛn nyɛ anabinim bɛn daa zaŋ a yuli kana nti tɔɣisi ti nanim mini ti kpambaliba ni ti yaannim zaŋ tabili ti zuliya ŋɔ zaa la yɛligu.
en: The prophets were your servants. They spoke for you to our kings, to our leaders, to our fathers, and to the common people in our country. But we did not listen to them.

dag: ni zuɣulaannim mini tɔbbihi ni sariakaritiba ni anabinima ni baɣisi ni kpamba.
en: soldier and warrior; judge and prophet; fortune-teller and elder.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ka di chaŋ wula ka Anabi Musa daa bahi noli ni so yi yɛn yih o paɣa, ŋun tim o amiliya lɔrigibu gbaŋ ka yih o.
en: The Pharisees asked him, Why, then, did Moses give the law for a man to hand his wife a divorce notice and send her away.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa pali Stiivin, ka o kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi zuɣusaa nya Naawuni jilima, ka nya ka Yisa ʒe Naawuni nudirigu polo.
en: But Stephen was full of the Holy Spirit. He looked up into heaven and saw the glory of God. And he saw Jesus standing at Gods right side.

dag: Bɛ ni daa paai tiŋ maa sunsuuni, ka Nɛtania bia Ishimail mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o sani maa daa ku ba n-zaŋ ba niŋ kɔbiliga puuni.
en: As soon as they were inside the city, Ishmael and his men killed them and threw their bodies in a well.

dag: Amaa ka Rut daa yɛli Naomi, Di yɛri ma ni n labimi ka chɛ a, dama a ni kuni shɛli, nimaani ka n kuna, ka a ni kpɛri shɛli, nimaani ka n gba yɛn kpe. A niriba ni leei n niriba, ka a Naawuni leei n Naawuni.
en: But Ruth said, Dont force me to leave you! Dont force me to go back to my own people. Let me go with you. Wherever you go, I will go. Wherever you sleep, I will sleep. Your people will be my people. Your God will be my God.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Lala ka Izraɛlnim ti yɛn ŋubiri bɛ bɔrɔbɔro daɣiri n ni ti yɛn kari ba tahi zuliya shɛb ni maa sani.
en: When I scatter the people of Israel among the nations, they will also have to eat food that is unclean, just as you must do.

dag: Nyamiya, yinim ninʒeensinim ŋɔ, tɛhimiya ka naanyi bahi yoli, dama n tum tuun karili yi ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni, tuun kar shɛli so ni yɛli ya di yɛla ka yi ku niŋ yɛda. .
en: Listen, you people who doubt! You can wonder, but then go away and die; because during your time, I will do something that you will not believe. You will not believe it, even if someone explains it to you! Habakkuk :.

dag: Lala ka n daa shiri niŋ Jɛrusalɛm. Maligumaaniba kpamba daa ti ma yiko, ka n gbahi Yisa nyaandoliba pam ti kpɛhi duu, amaa pa lala kɔŋko ka n daa niŋ. Bɛ ni daa ti yɛn ku bɛ ni shɛb la n gba daa ʒiɛla bɛn yɛn ku ba maa nyaaŋa.
en: And thats exactly what I did in Jerusalem. I locked up many of Gods holy people in prison under the authority of the chief priests. When they were condemned to death, I voted against them.

dag: Kpiimba biɛhigu shee malila shili guli ba. Di yaala di noli gu ni di vali Jɛrusalɛm zuɣulaannim mini di tarimba bɛn galisi ni bɛnkam zaa mali suhupiɛlli be di ni.
en: They will die, and the place of death will open its mouth wide and swallow many of them. Then the noisy crowds and all the beautiful, happy people who are now so comfortable will go down into the grave.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔh o, Pa doo n-nya a? A kpee be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni? Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a bi ʒiɛya gul a dan naa? Dama ninvuɣ so kana ni o ti ku a dan naa maa.
en: David said, You are an important man, arent you? You are better than any other man in Israel. Is that right? So why didnt you guard your master, the king? An ordinary man came into your camp to kill your master, the king.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino ŋun yuli daa booni Kliɔpas la bɔh o, A kɔŋko n-nyɛ sana Jɛrusalɛm ŋun na bi wum yɛl shɛŋa din yol niŋ nimaani daba ayi ŋɔ sunsuuni la.
en: One of them, named Cleopas, asked him, Are you the only visitor in Jerusalem who doesn't know the things that have been happening there these last few days.

dag: Ka niriba chɛ solɔri dolibu, ka sochandiba chɛ so kara dolibu. Ka zɔtali saɣim, ka alikaulinim saɣim, ka so baɣa ka di yɛla ni.
en: The highways were deserted; travelers left the road. The covenant was broken; solemn pledges were rejected; no one cared for humanity.

dag: N ni chɛ ka o suhupiɛlli min o churi puhibu ni o goli paliga churi puhibu ni o vuhim dabisa ni o ni zali chu shɛŋa zaa la zani tariga.
en: I will take away all her fun. I will stop her festivals, her New Moon celebrations, and her days of rest. I will stop all her special feasts.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah anu daa piɛb o kikaa, ka n nya saŋmar so ŋun daa yi zuɣusaa lu dunia ni na la, ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ bɔɣ shɛli din ziliŋ ka tariga saafɛbia ti o.
en: Then the fifth angel blew his trumpet. I saw a star which had fallen down to the earth, and it was given the key to the abyss.

dag: Ka Sɛt daa ti dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol o yuli Ɛnɔsh. Di saha maa ka ninsalinim daa piligi jɛmdi Yawɛ.
en: Seth had a son whom he named Enosh. It was then that people began using the Lord 's holy name in worship.

dag: Dɔbba mini paɣiba bɛn pun lo amiliya, n zali ya zaligu, amaa pa mani n-zali ya lala, ti Duuma n-zali ya li. Dina n-nyɛ: Paɣ miri ka o yi o yidana yiŋa.
en: For married people I have a command which is not my own but the Lord's: a wife must not leave her husband;.

dag: Bɛ ni mɛri yiya shɛŋa maa ŋmanila tɛri, ka ŋmani puguliba suɣa.
en: They built their houses like nests, like a hut made by a watchman.

dag: Lala ka a daa yu pagɔrisigu tuma a bilim ni, ka Ijiptinim daa tabisi a paɣisari biha ka zaŋ a saɣim la.
en: Oholibah, you dreamed of those times when you were young, when your lovers touched and handled your young breasts.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Filistianim mini Laribunim bɛn daa be Itiɔpianim polo la suhiri yiɣisi bahi Naa Jɛhɔram zuɣu.
en: Then the LORD made the Philistines and the Arabs, who lived near the Cushites, angry with Jehoram.

dag: Naawuni daa niŋ alibarika ŋɔ niŋla bɛn guni kɔŋko ni bee o daa niŋ li niŋ bɛn bi guni gba ni? Ti pun yɛli ni Naawuni daa zaŋ ti yab Ibrahimma zali wuntia zaani la o yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: Is this blessing only for those who are circumcised? Or is it also for those who are not circumcised? We have already said that it was because of Abrahams faith that he was accepted as one who is right with God.

dag: Ka Izraɛl daa bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi daa yɛli doo maa ni yi mali tizo m-bo suhusaɣiŋgu ŋɔ ti ma.
en: Israel said, Why have you caused me such pain by telling the man you had another brother.

dag: M ba daa ʒili ya ʒi tibisili, amaa pumpɔŋɔ man yɛn maan pahi li la tibisim. M ba daa malila barazim fiɛbiri ya, amaa man yɛn zaŋla nɔnsi fiɛb ya! .
en: So if my father made your workload heavy, Ill make it even heavier! If my father disciplined you with whips, Ill do it with scorpions.

dag: ka yuma ayopɔin shɛŋa puuni kum ni daa yɛn lu la piligi kaman Yisifu ni daa pun yɛli shɛm la. Kum maa daa lula luɣilikam zaa tiŋgbɔna ni; amaa ka bindira daa be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ din zaa ni.
en: and the seven years of famine began, just as Joseph had said. There was not enough food in other countries, but all over Egypt there was plenty.

dag: Ka Rubin zuliya maa niriba kalinli daa yiɣisi ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahinaayɔbu ni kɔbisinu.
en: The total number of men counted from the tribe of Reuben was .

dag: yin zaŋmiya ŋun tum lala maa niŋ Sintani nuu ni ka o niŋgbuŋ saɣim, ka di chɛ ka o shia lee ti tiligi ti Duuma Dabisili la dali.
en: You must then hand that man over to Satan. His body will be destroyed, but his spirit will be saved when the Lord Jesus returns.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, dimbɔŋɔnim zaa taali ni ti ʒi ʒiɛmani ŋɔ niriba zuɣu.
en: I tell you indeed: the punishment for all these murders will fall on the people of this day!.

dag: ni Nɔha ŋun daa pah anahi ni Rafa ŋun daa pah anu la.
en: Nohah was Benjamins fourth son. And Rapha was Benjamins fifth son.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛl o, A na ʒi n-di ti ni so bini zalinsi bee n-nahim ti bee n-fa ti ni so bini.
en: You havent oppressed or mistreated us, and youve never taken anything from anyone, the people answered.

dag: N yi chaŋ tooni ha, o ka nimaani bee n yi labi nyaaŋa, n ku tooi nya o.
en: If I go to the east, God is not there. If I go to the west, I still dont see him.

dag: Di simdi ni yi chɛ ka vi mali ya dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu! Di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni yɛndan shiri ka yi ni ŋun ni tooi kari yi mabihili puuni yɛla saria?.
en: I say this to your shame. Aren't any of you wise enough to act as a judge between one follower and another?.

dag: Ka anab Gaad daa ti yɛli Dauda, Di kpalim be vokabili ŋɔ ni, yiɣisim kpe kuli Juda tiŋgban ni. Ka Dauda daa yi nimaani chaŋ Hɛrɛt yɔɣu ni.
en: One day the prophet Gad told David, Don't stay here! Go back to Judah. David then left and went to Hereth Forest.

dag: Dama di sabiya ni Ibrahimma daa dɔɣi bidibis ayi: Yino daa nyɛla dab paɣ bia, ka ŋun la mi nyɛ bilichin paɣ bia.
en: The Scriptures say that Abraham had two sons. The mother of one son was a slave woman, and the mother of the other son was a free woman.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa daa zaŋ bɛ ni piligi niŋdi shɛli maa leei bɛ kali kaman Mɔdɛkai ni daa sab yɛli ba shɛm maa.
en: The Jews agreed to continue what they had already begun to do—just what Mordecai had written to them.

dag: amaa dabisa din kpalim nyaaŋa ŋɔ puuni, o tɔɣisiri ti yɛtɔɣa la o Bia la nol ni. O Bia maa kɔbili ni ka o daa nam dunia ŋɔ, ka zal o ni o su binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: but in these last days he has spoken to us through his Son. He is the one through whom God created the universe, the one whom God has chosen to possess all things at the end.

dag: Dama n zal a la dabisa kɔbisita ni pihiwɛi, ka di mini bɛ tibidarigibo yuma kalinli saɣi. Dinzuɣu lala ka a yɛn ʒi Izraɛlnim tibidarigibo maa.
en: You must bear the guilt of Israel for days. In this way I am telling you how long Israel will be punished; one day equals one year.

dag: N niriba Izraɛlnima, yinim bɛn nyɛ bɛ ni niŋ shɛb kaman bɛ ni bu ka shɛli n-yɛl li ŋɔ, n ni wum shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ sani ka n zaŋ yɛri ya maa.
en: My people, you will be like the grain crushed on my threshing floor. I have told you everything I heard from the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ dunia ŋɔ zaa naa; Yilimiya yila paɣ o!.
en: God is king over all the world; praise him with songs!.

dag: Ka Musa daa yihi biŋkpam din daa be namanama ni zaa mini binsabili yaɣ shɛli din viɛla ni yaannina mini di biŋkpam n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu.
en: Moses took all the fat on the internal organs, the best part of the liver, and the kidneys with the fat on them, and burned it all on the altar.

dag: Amaa ka naa yɛligu maa daa ŋme n-kpihim Jɔab min o sapashin kpamba dini. Di saha ka Jɔab mini sapashin kpamba maa daa yiɣisi naa sani yi n-chaŋ ni bɛ ti kali Izraɛlnim maa.
en: But when David refused to change his mind, Joab and the army officers went out and started counting the people.

dag: Ka Jɛhu daa yiɣisi kpe duu, ka anab bil maa ti booi kpam maa bah o zuɣu ni ka yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, M boola kpam ŋɔ bah a zuɣu ni ni a leei n niriba Izraɛlnim naa;.
en: Then the two of them went indoors, and the young prophet poured the olive oil on Jehu's head and said to him, The Lord , the God of Israel, proclaims: I anoint you king of my people Israel.

dag: Di saha ka Hɛzɛkia mini Jɛrusalɛmnim daa siɣisi bɛmaŋa o karimbaani maa zuɣu, ka Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili maa daa bi lu bɛ zuɣu Hɛzɛkia ʒiɛmani maa ni.
en: Hezekiah and the people later felt sorry and asked the Lord to forgive them. So the Lord did not punish them as long as Hezekiah was king.

dag: Niaria bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ɛliɔnai mini Hizikia ni Azirikam, bɛ daa nyɛla niriba ata.
en: Neariah had three sons: Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam.

dag: O kɔŋko n-nyɛ nyɛvili din bi naari ni be so ni; ka nyɛ ŋun be neesim shɛl ni so ni ku tooi miri. So na ʒi n-nya o, ka so mi ku tooi nya o. Ŋuna n-simdi jilima tibu mini yiko subu hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Ami!.
en: He alone is immortal; he lives in the light that no one can approach. No one has ever seen him; no one can ever see him. To him be honor and eternal power! Amen.

dag: yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, n shiri ni niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni ka chɛ ka a zuliya yɛligi.
en: I, the Lord, will bless you with many descendants.

dag: Amaa nyini daadam, wummi n ni yɛl a shɛm maa, ka miri ka a niŋ duŋtaara kaman duŋtaariba maa. Yaam a noli n-di n ni zaŋ binshɛli tir a ŋɔ.
en: Mortal man, listen to what I tell you. Don't be rebellious like them. Open your mouth and eat what I am going to give you.

dag: A nyɛla do viɛlli dɔbba puuni; a zilinkom viɛla. Dinzuɣu ka Naawuni niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni sahakam.
en: You are the most handsome of men; grace has been poured out on your lips. No wonder God has blessed you forever!.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa zaŋ jaaŋgbɛhi maa Yawɛ tooni yi Izraɛlnim zaa sani ka bɛ ti nya. Ka sokam daa yih o jaaŋgbee.
en: Moses took all the sticks and showed them to the Israelites. They saw what had happened, and each leader took his own stick back.

dag: Saha shɛli Yaakubu ni daa chaŋ ti ʒini Ijipti ka Ijiptinim maa daa ti muɣisiri ba ka bɛ fabili niŋ Yawɛ la, ka o daa tim Musa mini Aduna ka bɛ ti yihi yi yaannim maa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni n-zaŋ ba na ti ʒili kpe ŋɔ.
en: When Jacob entered Egypt, the Egyptians oppressed them. So your ancestors cried out to the LORD. The LORD then sent Moses and Aaron, who brought your ancestors out of Egypt and settled them here.

dag: Yisa ni daa yi nimaani gariti tooni, ka dɔbba ayi bɛn nyɛ zoomba dol o n-kuhiri pampam yɛra, Nyin ŋun nyɛ Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ, zom ti nambɔɣu.
en: As Jesus was going away from there, two blind men followed him. They said loudly, Show kindness to us, Son of David.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba maa garita n-nya ka fiig tia la kuumi zaa nti tabili di tiŋ wula.
en: As the disciples walked past the fig tree the next morning, they noticed that it was completely dried up, roots and all.

dag: Di saha ka Amazia daa yɛli Amɔs, Anabi, zom kuli Juda tiŋgban ni nti tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa, ka nyari diri nimaani.
en: Amaziah also said to Amos, You seer, go down to Judah and eat there. Do your prophesying there.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Jɔshua daa boli Rubin mini Gaad ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili la daŋ niriba na.
en: Then Joshua called a meeting of all the people from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa yiɣisi Bɛrishiiba n-lu soli. Ka Yaakubu bihi daa zaŋ bɛ ba Yaakubu mini bɛ paɣiba ni bɛ bihi n-niŋ tɔroko shɛŋa Firawuna ni daa zaŋ ti ba ni bɛ zaŋ o niŋ n-ʒi o na la ni.
en: Then Jacob left Beersheba and traveled to Egypt. His sons, the sons of Israel, brought their father, their wives, and all their children to Egypt. They traveled in the wagons the Pharaoh had sent.

dag: Ka ti yab Yaakubu daa ti wum ni bindirigu be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka o daa tuui tim ti yaannim maa ni bɛ chaŋ Ijipti ti da bindirigu na.
en: and when Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent his sons, our ancestors, on their first visit there.

dag: dama nyini m-pun nyɛ n sɔŋda, ka n kul be a kpiŋkpama mahim ni n-yiini suhupiɛlli yila.
en: because youve been a help to me and I shout for joy in the protection of your wings.

dag: Ka o ni daa yɛl shɛm maa shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. Dinzuɣu kpahimi bɛ zuɣu ni ni nimmoo ka di chɛ ka bɛ ba n-zani wuhibu maŋli maa ni.
en: This statement is true. Because of this, correct them firmly, so that they can be healthy in their faith.

dag: Bɛ yi pooi dabili o bilim ni, di bahigu ti ku viɛla.
en: Pamper servants from a young age, and later on there will be trouble.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa yɛli, Yɛm so kpiɔŋ. Amaa bɛ daa lihi ʒiɛm doo maa yɛm maa, ka bi deeg o yɛligu.
en: I have always said that wisdom is better than strength, but no one thinks of the poor as wise or pays any attention to what they say.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn kul bela biɛrim ni bɛ nyɛviya ni zaa; yuun shɛŋa zaa din gari ka bɛ bi zɔri niriba nambɔɣu la ni.
en: All the days of the wicked are painful; the number of years reserved for the hateful.

dag: Ka Aruna daa ti lihi nya Naa Dauda min o kpamba ni kani o sanna, ka o daa tuhi ba soli ti lu naa sizuura n-damdi zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa.
en: Araunah looked down and saw the king and his officials coming up to him. He threw himself on the ground in front of David.

dag: Bɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ suhuri kpaŋmi kaman kuɣili la. Ka bɛ ni daa zaɣisi ni bɛ ku wum Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni daa pun zaŋ o yɛligu n-ti anabinim shɛb bɛn daŋ tooni na yɛligu la zuɣu, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ suhu daa yiɣisi pam bahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: They were very stubborn and would not obey the law. The Lord All-Powerful used his Spirit and sent messages to his people through the prophets. But the people would not listen, so the Lord All-Powerful became very angry.

dag: Dama ŋunkam tiligir o nyɛvili ni ti kɔŋ li, ka ŋunkam mi kɔŋ o nyɛvili m mini n lahibal suŋ ŋɔ zuɣu ni ti lan nya li.
en: If you want to save your life, you will destroy it. But if you give up your life for me and for the good news, you will save it.

dag: Ka bɛ yuri kalinli daa nyɛ kɔbisiyopɔin ni pihitanaayɔbu. Ka buntaansi kalinli nyɛ kɔbisiyi ni pihinahinaanu.
en: They had horses, mules, camels, and donkeys.

dag: M bia, bɔzuɣu ka a yɛn chɛ ka paɣ so ku a zuɣu, ka a ti bɔbili paɣ zinalana biha?.
en: Don't go crazy over a woman who is unfaithful to her own husband!.

dag: Miriya ka yi zura bee n-niŋdi tab bilikɔnsi bee ŋ-ŋmar tab ʒiri.
en: Do not steal or cheat or lie.

dag: Ilaija ni daa wum li saha shɛli, o daa zaŋla o binyɛrigu pɔb o nina yi nti ʒe vokabili maa dunol ni. Nyama, ka kukoli maa daa bɔh o, Ilaija, bɔ ka a lee niŋdi kpe.
en: and when Elijah heard it, he covered his face with his coat. He went out and stood at the entrance to the cave. A voice asked, Elijah, why are you here.

dag: Bɛ guurimi kaman tɔbutuhiriba la; ka duri goma kaman tɔbbihi la. Bɛ zaa mi kul dolila bɛ soya, ka bɛ taɣiri bɔba.
en: Like warriors they charge; like soldiers they climb the wall. Each keeps to their own path; they didnt change their course.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ alahichi shɛŋa zaa Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la.
en: He disobeyed the Lord by following the evil example of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused the Israelites to sin.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Judanim mini Izraɛlnim polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: The Lord says to the people of Israel and Judah.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ daa lan yɛli ma.
en: The word from the LORD of heavenly forces came to me.

dag: Yuria ni daa ka Dauda sanna, ka o ti puh o bɔhi Jɔab mini tɔbbihi maa zaa yɛla ni tɔb maa ni chani shɛm.
en: When Uriah came to him, David asked about the welfare of Joab and the army and how the battle was going.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl naa maa daa tim boli anabinim kɔbisinahi na nti bɔhi ba, Ti cham ti tuhi Ramɔtigiliadnim bee ti di chaŋ? Ka bɛ daa garigi yɛl o, Cham ti tuhi ba, Naawuni ni zaŋ ba niŋ nyin naa nuu ni.
en: Ahab sent for prophets and asked, Should I attack the city of Ramoth? Yes! the prophets answered. God will help you capture the city.

dag: Ka o ni nya ka wum shɛli, dina ka o tɔɣisira; ka so mi bi deer o yɛligu.
en: He tells what he has seen and heard, but people dont accept what he says.

dag: ka alizin biɛri maa daa balim o yɛli, A yi kari ti, nyin chɛ ka ti chaŋ ti kpe kuruchunim ŋɔ ni.
en: The demons pleaded with him, If you throw us out, send us into the herd of pigs.

dag: N ni zaŋ n shia niŋ yi ni, ka chɛ ka yi doli n zalikpana mini n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: and I will give you my spirit so that you may walk according to my regulations and carefully observe my case laws.

dag: amaa hal yi zabigu zaɣ yini gba ti ku bɔrigi.
en: But none of these things can really harm you.

dag: Yawɛ niŋ o ni daa lo ni o niŋ shɛl la; o niŋ o ni daa yɛli kurimbuni ha ni o ni niŋ shɛl la. O wurim a ka bi lan zo a nambɔɣu. O chɛ ka a dimnim mali suhupiɛlli a zaɣ biɛɣu nyabu zuɣu, ka chɛ ka a dimnim maa nya yaa.
en: The LORD did what he had planned. He accomplished the word that he had commanded long ago. He ripped down, showing no compassion. He made the enemy rejoice over you; he raised up your adversaries horn.

dag: Di saha ka Abija daa du n-tam zo shɛli din yuli booni Zɛmaraim Zoli din be Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya ni la zuɣu ka yɛli, Nyin Jɛrɔbɔam mini Izraɛlnim zaa, wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli shɛm ŋɔ!.
en: Abijah went to the top of Mount Zemaraim in the hills of Ephraim and shouted: Listen, Jeroboam and all you Israelites!.

dag: A ku lan ti ti kpiɔŋ, ka a niriba ŋɔ lan nya suhupiɛlli a sani yaha?.
en: Make us strong again, and we, your people, will praise you.

dag: Bɛ wain tihi yila Sɔdom wain tihi ni na, ka yi Gomɔra wain tihi puri ni na. Bɛ wain tiwala nyɛla wala din mali lɔɣu. Di zaɣ yila nyɛla din to.
en: Their enemies, corrupt as Sodom and Gomorrah, are like vines that bear bitter and poisonous grapes.

dag: Ka yi yi ŋme n-deei tiŋ maa, yin nyomiya li buɣim kaman Naawuni ni zali ya shɛm. N ni wuhi ya ni yi niŋ shɛm m-bala.
en: You must do what the Lord says. Watch me and I will give you the command to attack the city. When you have taken control of the city, burn it.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee shihi ma ŋɔ? Ka bɛ zaa daa chihi ti tuui taba, ka Pita yɛl o, N Duuma, niriba maa m-muɣi pam daar a.
en: Who touched me? Jesus asked. While everyone was denying it, Peter said, Master, people are crowding all around and pushing you from every side.

dag: ka Gɛmalli bia Ammiɛl daa yi Dan zuliya ni na;.
en: from the tribe of Dan—Ammiel son of Gemalli;.

dag: Dama o ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb maa ʒim na bela o ni. O daa kpaai li pala tampiŋ zuɣu. O daa bi kpaai li bahi tiŋa ni o niŋ taŋkpaɣu pi li.
en: because her blood is still with her. She didnt pour it out on the ground so that it could be covered with dirt, but she spread it out on a bare rock.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa zaŋ bimbuɣisirigu din ŋmani jaaŋgbee ti ma ka yɛli ma: Yiɣisima m-buɣisi Naawuni jɛmbu duu mini di bimbini, ka kali bɛn jɛmdi Naawuni di ni.
en: Then I was given a measuring rod as long as a walking stick. I was told, Go and measure the temple of God and the altar, and count the people worshiping there.

dag: Ka Bɔaz yɛl o, Yawɛ niŋm alibarika niŋ a ni. Hal a ni niŋ nirilim shɛli pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ gar a ni pun niŋ a yidan ma nirilim shɛl la. A naan tooi chaŋ ti bo nachimbil so ŋun nyɛ bundana bee faralana, amaa a bi niŋ lala.
en: The Lord bless you, he said. You are showing even greater family loyalty in what you are doing now than in what you did for your mother-in-law. You might have gone looking for a young man, either rich or poor, but you haven't.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka anabi Jɛrimia tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ Babilɔn din nyɛ Kalidianim tiŋ la polo m-bɔŋɔ.
en: This is the message that the Lord gave me about the city of Babylon and its people:.

dag: N-yi biɛɣu ka niriba bɛn daa kpalim duli din la polo kpahim baŋ ni ŋariŋ yini kɔŋko n-sa ʒe nimaani, ka lan mi ni Yisa sa bi kpe ŋariŋ maa ni pah o nyaandoliba maa zuɣu, amaa kulla bɛ kɔŋko n-sa kpe li chaŋ.
en: The people who had stayed on the east side of the lake knew that only one boat had been there. They also knew that Jesus had not left in it with his disciples. But the next day.

dag: Ka alikama maa daa ti va puya m-pil dɔɣibu, di saha ka bɛ naanyi baŋ ni piriŋkpana be di ni.
en: When the plants grew and the heads of grain began to form, then the weeds showed up.

dag: Ka ti yab Ibrahimma daa yih o ni mali binshɛɣukam pia puuni zaɣ yiniyini ti o. O yuli Mɛlikizɛdɛk gbinni nyɛla Wuntia Naa. O lan nyɛla Salɛm Naa, ka di mi gbinni nyɛla Suhudoo Naa.
en: and Abraham gave him one tenth of all he had taken.

dag: Di pa shɛli ti yi niŋ lala, Naawuni ni taɣ o tɛha zaŋ chaŋ o ni lo ni o niŋ shɛm maa polo; ka ku o suhuyiɣisili maa; ka chɛ ka ti tiligi ka ku kpi.
en: He thought, Who knows? God may see this and turn from his wrath, so that we might not perish.

dag: Ka o daa bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a nya bimburiginli a mabia ninni, ka daantaliga lee sa amaŋmaŋ ninni ka a bi nya li?.
en: You can see the speck in your friend's eye, but you don't notice the log in your own eye.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔhi nachimbil so ŋun daa yɛl o li maa, Tiŋ kani ka a lee yina? Ka o garigi yɛl o, N nyɛla Amalɛk saan so ŋun be a tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni bia.
en: David asked the young man, Where is your home? The man replied, My father is an Amalekite, but we live in Israel.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa doya hal ka biɛɣu ti neei, ka o yiɣisi yooi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa dunoya, ka zɔr dabiɛm ni o yɛli Ɛli o ni nya ʒii shɛli maa yɛla.
en: Samuel lay there until morning, then opened the doors of the LORDs house. Samuel was afraid to tell the vision to Eli.

dag: o daa yɛli ma mi, Daadam, n timd a la Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ duŋtaariba bɛn taai duŋ niŋ ma ŋɔ sani. Bɛ mini bɛ yaannim pun birigi n sani zaŋ na hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Mortal man, I am sending you to the people of Israel. They have rebelled and turned against me and are still rebels, just as their ancestors were.

dag: Ka Zara daa ti kpi Kiriatariba Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni; ka Ibrahimma daa kpe nti kum o kuli.
en: She died in Hebron in the land of Canaan, and Abraham mourned her death.

dag: Lala ka o daa niŋ me Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa naai, ka zaŋ sida dapuhi mini di dapaɣa n-siili li.
en: So King Solomon finished building the Temple. He put in a ceiling made of beams and boards of cedar.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb daa ti zaŋ bihi ka Yisa sanna ni o ti zaŋ o nuu pa bɛ zuɣu; ka o nyaandoliba daa tahiri bihinim maa zuɣu.
en: Some people brought children to Jesus for him to place his hands on them, but the disciples scolded the people.

dag: N zaŋ a leela ŋun ni be n niriba ni n-kpahindi ba ka yihiri ba daɣiri ni din ni chɛ ka a baŋ ka kpahim bɛ soya.
en: Jeremiah, test my people as though they were metal.

dag: Bɛ chɛ soli din tuhi ka birigi; bɛ dolila Bɛɔr bia Anabi Balaam ŋun daa tum din bi tuhi liɣiri nyabu zuɣu la naba.
en: They have left the true road and have gone down the wrong path by following the example of the prophet Balaam. He was the son of Beor and loved what he got from being a crook.

dag: Lala ka Sulemaana daa mali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni nɛma zaa din nyɛ: salima sara maligu bimbini mini teebu shɛŋa zuɣu bɛ ni daa zaŋdi bɔrɔbɔro m-pari zaani Naawuni tooni la.
en: King Solomon also had gold furnishings made for the Temple: the altar and the tables for the bread offered to God;.

dag: Ka wula ka n lee ni tooi yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi Naawuni ni bi yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu? Bee wula ka n lee ni tooi yɛli ni Naawuni ni wuhi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bi simdi tibidarigibo simdi ni bɛ nya tibidarigibo?.
en: How can I curse what God has not cursed, Or speak of doom when the Lord has not?.

dag: Anabinim mini karimbanim daa be Antiɔk cheechi ni. Bɛna n-nyɛ Baanabas mini Simiɔn ŋun yuli daa lan booni Naija la ni Lusius ŋun daa nyɛ Sairiini tiŋbia la mini Manaɛn, bɛ ni daa laɣim wumsi so mini Naa Hɛrɔd la m-pahi Sool.
en: The church at Antioch included prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon , Lucius from Cyrene, Manaen , and Saul.

dag: yi yi bi birigi kpa nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo n-doli jɛmdi wuna ka chɛ n ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa tiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Dont deviate even a bit from any of these words that Im commanding you right now by following other gods and serving them.

dag: Duɣu ka bɛ mali buɣisiri anzinfa, ka zaŋdi buɣim pam buɣisiri salima, amaa Yawɛ m-buɣisiri ninsal suhu.
en: A crucible is for silver and a furnace for gold, but the LORD tests the heart.

dag: Ka doo maa dii nya alaafee, ka kpuɣ o bindoo chaŋ o chandi. Dindali maa daa nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: Immediately the man got well; he picked up his mat and started walking. The day this happened was a Sabbath.

dag: Niŋmiya yomyom kana, yinim zuliya shɛb bɛn zaa gili luɣilikam maa, laɣimmiya nimaani. Yawɛ, timmi a tɔbbihi na!.
en: All you nations, hurry! Come together in that place. Lord , bring your strong soldiers.

dag: Laɣimmiya dakuɣiri duhi, ka niŋ buɣim niŋ li n-niŋ binnyoma niŋ nimdi maa ni duɣi li, ka chɛ ka di kɔba di buɣim.
en: so bring more wood and light it. Cook the meat and boil away the broth to let the bones scorch.

dag: Simiɔn zuliya ni, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa mali yaa mini suhukpeeni, ka ni tooi tuhi tɔbu kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tusaayopɔin ni kɔbiga.
en: From the tribe of Simeon there were men. They were brave soldiers ready for war.

dag: M mi ni yi niŋ ania n-saɣi nahiŋgu n yuli zuɣu, ka na bi tiri gbini.
en: You are patient, you have suffered for my sake, and you have not given up.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Niriba ŋɔ bee anabi bee maligumaana yi ti bɔh a, Yɛlimuɣisirili din yi Yawɛ sanna lee nyɛ dini?, nyin yɛlim ba, Yawɛ yɛliya: Yinima n-nyɛ yɛlimuɣisirili maa. N ni kari ya bahi. .
en: Jeremiah, when a prophet or a priest or anyone else comes to you and asks, Does the Lord have news for us? tell them, You people are a nuisance to the Lord , and he will get rid of you.

dag: Ka o yiŋlan maa yɛl o, Mbo n-faaŋa, bi suŋ ni n yɛdalana ŋun ʒe ma yim! A pal alikauli ni bin din pɔra, dinzuɣu n ni zaŋ a leei bin din zooi pam zuɣulana; chɛ ka a suhu piɛli kaman n suhu ni piɛli shɛm ŋɔ.
en: Well done, you good and faithful servant! said his master. You have been faithful in managing small amounts, so I will put you in charge of large amounts. Come on in and share my happiness.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka buɣim di Ɛdomnim tiŋa n-saɣim bɛ ni me goma gili luɣ shɛŋa Kɛriɔt la. Ka Mɔabnim ni kpi tɔbu tuhibu vuri mini tɔbbihi tahigu ni kikahi kumsi zuɣu.
en: So I will send down a fire on Moab; it will devour the palaces of Kerioth. Moab will die in a great uproar, with a war cry, with the sound of the rams horn.

dag: O daa wuh o bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ salima tibisim shɛm tariga mali teebuli din nyɛ bɛ ni yɛn zaŋdi bɔrɔbɔro piɛri tab sɔŋdi shɛli zuɣu ni bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ anzinfa shɛm tariga mali anzinfa teebuli kam.
en: for the silver tables, and for each gold table on which were placed the loaves of bread offered to God.

dag: Nyin daadam, bom tandaɣili sɔŋ a tooni, ka ŋme Jɛrusalɛm kɔtomsi pa di zuɣu.
en: God said, Mortal man, get a brick, put it in front of you, and scratch lines on it to represent the city of Jerusalem.

dag: Ka o ni daa zaŋ yaɣiri mɛri duɣ shɛli maa daa saɣim o nuu ni, ka o daa zaŋ li taɣi me o ni daa nya ka duɣ shɛli viɛl o sani.
en: And whenever the clay would not take the shape he wanted, he would change his mind and form it into some other shape.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Naa Dauda daa yɛli Yila litaafi puuni yil shɛl ni: A ku chɛ ka a ninvuɣ gahindili niŋgbuŋ pooi.
en: But in another Psalm it says, You will not let your Holy One rot in the grave. Psalm :.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ daa yɛli ma.
en: This is the message of the Lord that came to me.

dag: Gbibi ma kaman nimbil biɛlim la; ka zaŋm ma sɔɣ a kpiŋkpama mahim ni.
en: Protect me like the pupil of your eye. Hide me in the shadow of your wings.

dag: Jɔsia yuma daa nyɛla yuma anii saha shɛl o ni daa di nam. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pihitaniyini.
en: Josiah was eight years old when he became king of Judah, and he ruled in Jerusalem for thirty-one years.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, n fabili niŋ a ni a sɔŋ ma, ka a tib ma.
en: LORD, my God, I cried out to you for help, and you healed me.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa yɛli salo min o nyaandoliba.
en: Jesus said to the crowds and to his disciples:.

dag: Ka kukol shɛli daa yi nam ʒiishee maa gbin na yɛra, Yinim bɛn zaa nyɛ wɔɣira mini tarimba, ka nyɛ Naawuni daba bɛn zɔr o ŋɔ paɣimiya Naawuni.
en: Then a voice went out from the throne and said, Praise our God, all you his servants, and you who fear him, both small and great.

dag: Ka Ifriim zuliya daa zaŋ bɛ tuuta yiɣisi doli tab gbilligbilli paya. Ammihud bia Ɛlishama n-daa nyɛ bɛ zaa zuɣulana;.
en: Next came the three groups from Ephraims camp. They traveled under their flag. The first group was the tribe of Ephraim. Elishama son of Ammihud was the commander of that group.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa niŋ alibarika niŋ Nuhu min o bidibisi la ni ka yɛli ba, Dɔɣimiya n-nab pali dunia ŋɔ.
en: God said to Noah and his sons: I am giving you my blessing. Have a lot of children and grandchildren, so people will live everywhere on this earth.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ do shɛb bɛn bi kpuɣ paɣiba mini paɣ shɛb bɛn bi kuli dɔb la yɛla polo, n ka zaligu shɛli din yi ti Duuma sanna, amaa n ni nyɛ ninvuɣ so bɛ ni ni niŋ naani ti Duuma nambɔzɔbo puuni la zuɣu, n ni yɛli ya n tɛha ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Now I write about people who are not married. I have no command from the Lord about this, but I give my opinion. And I can be trusted, because the Lord has given me mercy.

dag: M mabihi, n kpamdi ya jaande ti Duuma Yisa Masia mini yurilim shɛli Naawuni Shia Kasi ni tiri ti la zuɣu ni yi pahimi n zuɣu n-suhi Naawuni ti ma.
en: I urge you, friends, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love that the Spirit gives: join me in praying fervently to God for me.

dag: Bɛnkam maani nandaamba ansarisi turila ŋun nam ba. Ka bɛnkam mali suhupiɛlli bɛ tab daashaara zuɣu ni nya tibidarigibo.
en: If you make fun of poor people, you insult the God who made them. You will be punished if you take pleasure in someone's misfortune.

dag: Chɛ ka a neesim min a yɛlimaŋli kana; ka chɛ ka di wuhi ma soli n-zaŋ ma tahi a zoli din be kasi ka nyɛ a ni be luɣ shɛl la zuɣu.
en: Send your light and your truth to guide me. Let them lead me to your house on your sacred mountain.

dag: O daa lan nyo tindaannim kɔba buɣim bɛ bimbina zuɣu, ka daa yihi Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm daɣiri ni.
en: He burned the bones of the priests on their altars, purifying Judah and Jerusalem.

dag: Ka doo maa ba min o ma maa yɛli ba, Ti mi ni ti bia m-bɔŋɔ, ka ti daa dɔɣ o la zoma.
en: His parents answered, We know he is our son. We know he was born blind.

dag: Reechɛl ni daa nya ka o bi dɔɣi bihi ti Yaakubu maa zuɣu ka o daa zabir o biɛli nyuli, ka yɛli Yaakubu, Tim ma bihi, di yi pa lala, n ni kpi.
en: Rachel was very jealous of Leah for having children, and she said to Jacob, I'll die if you don't give me some children.

dag: Ka yi lan niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim pahira. Yi kuhira, ka fabinda, ka yi nintam tɛli Yawɛ sara maligu bimbini, o ni bi lan lihi nya yi sara bee n-deeri li yi nuu ni ni yurilim la zuɣu.
en: This is another thing you do. You drown the Lord 's altar with tears, weeping and wailing because he no longer accepts the offerings you bring him.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ mi sabilifaa n-lo li tabili bantabiga la, ka di ti be bantabiga maa tooni polo.
en: Fasten the gold strip to a blue ribbon. Tie the blue ribbon around the turban. The gold strip should be on the front of the turban.

dag: Ka bintɔrili yi to so nti naai.
en: Someone might get a boil on their skin that heals over.

dag: Amaa baŋmi ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-nyɛ ŋun be kasi. Zomla ŋuna, ka chɛ ka a suhu zɔhiri zaŋ chaŋ o sani.
en: The Lord All-Powerful is the one you should fear. He is the one you should respect. He is the one who should frighten you.

dag: Mani m-mi o, amaa yinim kul ʒi o. Ka n yi yɛli ni n ʒi o, n ni leei ʒirilana kaman yinim la. M mi o, ka dol o yɛligu.
en: You dont know him, but I do. If I said I didnt know him, I would be like you, a liar. But I do know him, and I keep his word.

dag: Amaa saha shɛli Naawuni Shia Kasi yi ti kpe yi ni, yi ni nya yiko ka leei n shɛhiranima Jɛrusalɛm zaŋ tabili Judia mini Samaria tiŋgbana ni hal ti kpa dunia tarisi zaa.
en: But the Holy Spirit will come on you and give you power. You will be my witnesses. You will tell people everywhere about me—in Jerusalem, in the rest of Judea, in Samaria, and in every part of the world.

dag: Ka hal yɛlli maa yi lula Gomna tibili ni gba, ti ni bo shɛli ti o ka o ku niŋ ya shɛli.
en: And if the Governor should hear of this, we will convince him that you are innocent, and you will have nothing to worry about.

dag: Bɛ daa yila Ifriim tiŋgban ni, ka vinvamli ni na, n-doli nyin Bɛnjamin min a daŋ niriba. Ka sapashin kpamba daa yi Makiri na, ka sapashim bihi mi daa yi Zɛbulɔn na.
en: The men of Ephraim came from the hill country of Amalek. Benjamin, those men followed you and your people. And there were commanders from the family of Makir. Leaders from the tribe of Zebulun came with their bronze clubs.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti lan lab bɛ sanna pahi buta m-bɔhi ba, Yinima na kul gbihirimi ka vuhiri jɛlinsi? Di saɣ lala, saha maa paaya; so pun yi Daadam Bia nyaaŋa ka zaŋ o niŋ alahichinim nuu ni.
en: After Jesus prayed a third time, he went back to his followers. He said to them, Are you still sleeping and resting? Thats enough! The time has come for the Son of Man to be handed over to the control of sinful men.

dag: O bi ŋmani wun so tuumbaŋdiba ni mali zali, ka salindoora dooi salima pa di zuɣu, ka bɛ niŋ anzinfa zoligɔnim yɛliyɛl li la?.
en: He is not like an idol that workers make, that metalworkers cover with gold and set in a base of silver.

dag: Ka Giliad sapashinnim daa bɔhi taba, Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ ŋun ni chaŋ ti piligi Ammɔnnim ŋɔ tuhibu? Dilan ni leei Giliadnim zaa zuɣulana.
en: The leaders of Gilead asked each other, Who can lead an attack on the Ammonites? Then they agreed, If we find someone who can lead the attack, we'll make him the ruler of Gilead.

dag: Amaa Yaakubu daa bi chɛ ka Bɛnjamin ŋun nyɛ Yisifu tizo la dol o biɛyanim maa chaŋ, dama o daa zɔrimi ni binshɛli ti niŋ o.
en: However, Jacob didnt send Josephs brother Benjamin along with his brothers because he thought something bad might happen to him.

dag: Yi lihi ʒiɛm m binshɛŋa din be kasi la, ka bi tiri n vuhim dabisa jilima.
en: You have no respect for the holy places, and you don't keep the Sabbath.

dag: Ka hal binshɛli yi pili n-liri ti lahibal suŋ ŋɔ yɛla, di pili n-liri li mi zaŋ chaŋ bɛn bahi yol la kɔŋko sani.
en: The Good News that we tell people may be hidden, but it is hidden only to those who are lost.

dag: Ka Ariok daa dii zaŋ Daniɛl n-kpɛhi Naa Nɛbukadnɛza sani ti yɛl o, Naa, n nya Juda daba la ni yino ŋun ni tooi wuh a a zahindi la gbinni.
en: Arioch rushed Daniel to the king and announced, Your Majesty, I have found out that one of the men brought here from Judah can explain your dream.

dag: amaa ka n daa ti lan gariti nimaani ka bɛ kani; ka n lihi bo ba ka bi nya ba.
en: Suddenly they disappeared! I looked, but they were gone and no longer there.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ma, Nyin Daniɛl, pumpɔŋɔ kpabimi litaafi maa, ka zaŋ bintabinda n-dihi tabili li sɔŋ hal ti paai saha tariga. Amaa niriba pam ni ti zɔri ginda, ka baŋsim ti yɛligiri pahira.
en: Daniel, I now command you to keep the message of this book secret until the end of time, even though many people will go everywhere, searching for the knowledge to be found in it.

dag: Ka bɛn daa dol o liɣi ʒiɛya n-wumdi kukoli maa, amaa ka lee bi nya so.
en: The men traveling with Saul just stood there, unable to speak. They heard the voice, but they saw no one.

dag: dama bɛ bari ma la zana, ka gbi bɔɣ zilinli sɔŋ ni bɛ di n nyɛvili, ka di ka daliri.
en: I did them no harm, but they hid a net to trap me, and they dug a deep pit to catch and kill me.

dag: O ni yɛli, N ni lan chɛ ka ŋɔ nyɛla yɛtɔɣ shɛli din wuhiri ni binshɛŋa din nyɛ binnamda ka damdi la ni vuui ni di chɛ ka binshɛŋa din ku tooi dam la kpalim be.
en: The words still once more reveal the removal of what is shaken—the things that are part of this creation—so that what isnt shaken will remain.

dag: Yi zaŋ kpamli yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi ninvuɣ so ŋun ka yɛm, ka tɔɣisi yɛm yɛtɔɣa pam.
en: You have given great advice and wonderful wisdom to someone truly in need.

dag: n-zaŋ li na ti zali Sool min o tumtumdiba maa tooni ka bɛ di, ka daa yiɣisi kuli yuŋ maa.
en: The woman put the food before Saul and his officers and they ate. Then they got up and left during the night.

dag: ka Mɔza daa nyɛ Binia ba; ka Binia nyɛ Rɛfaya ba, ka Rafaya nyɛ Ɛliasa ba, ka Ɛliasa nyɛ.
en: Moza was the father of Binea; Rephaiah was his son, Eleasah was his son, and Azel was his son.

dag: N daa wurim ba kpɛhi zuliya shɛli ni, ka bɛ ti wurim kpe tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni, ka n daa kari ba saria kaman bɛ tuma mini bɛ biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: I scattered them among the nations and spread them through all the lands. I gave them the punishment they deserved for the bad things they did.

dag: Ka Aruna daa yɛli Dauda, N dana, zaŋmi li tum a ni nya ka shɛli viɛl a sani. Naɣikɔra m-bɔŋɔ, a ni tooi kɔri ba nyo buɣim mali sara, bɛ nyiŋgoya ni dapuhi mini kaburi dari din ni mali buɣim mi m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Then Araunah said to David, Take it for yourself, and may my master the king do what he thinks is best. Here are oxen for the entirely burned offering, and here are threshing boards and oxen yokes for wood.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa bi gbilisi tibili wum, ka chɛ tuumbiɛri tumbu bee buɣa jɛmbu.
en: But you would not listen or pay any attention. You would not give up your evil practice of sacrificing to other gods.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ pateesa yili Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa dunoli.
en: He hung the curtain at the entrance of the Tent.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa gbaai Sool zaŋ chaŋ Dauda polo, dama Yawɛ daa chɛ ŋun Sool, ka bela Dauda sani.
en: Saul was afraid of David, because the Lord was helping David and was no longer helping him.

dag: A dol a ni daa lo a dabili m ba Dauda alikauli shɛl la. Yɛlimaŋli, a zaŋ a nuu tum tuma m-pal a ni daa yaag a noli yɛli shɛm maa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: You have kept the promise you made to my father David; today every word has been fulfilled.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi suhuri ni zɔhiri shɛlikam zuɣu yɛla niŋ o nuu ni, dama o baɣa be yi ni.
en: God cares for you, so turn all your worries over to him.

dag: Tikub yɛtɔɣa ŋmanila saɣibɔri nyaɣisili, di kul kpɛrila ninsal niŋgbuna puuni.
en: People love to hear gossip. It is like tasty food on its way to the stomach.

dag: Amaa maligumaana maa yi lihi n-nya ka dɔr shɛli din zaɣisiri ka loori maa naai, ka kɔbiri bili di ni, o pala ŋun be daɣiri ni, di simdi ni maligumaana maa yɛli ni o nyɛla ŋun ka daɣiri ni.
en: But if the priest sees that the scabies has remained the same, and black hair has grown in it, the scabies has healed. The person is clean, and the priest will declare them to be so.

dag: Di chɛ ka ti kpe zahimbu ni, amaa yihim ti zaɣ biɛɣu ni. Dama nyini n-su nam mini yiko ni jilima hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Ami.
en: Do not bring us to hard testing, but keep us safe from the Evil One.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bindira pam pal a kambɔna, ka wain pal a wain tɔɣiri bɔɣa hal ti puuri bahira.
en: Then your barns will be full of grain, and your barrels will be overflowing with wine.

dag: Yiɣisim kpuɣi bia maa n-gbib o a nuu ni viɛnyɛliŋga, dama n ni chɛ ka o zuliya ti galisi pam.
en: Get up, go and pick him up, and comfort him. I will make a great nation out of his descendants.

dag: Miriya ka yi ku ninsala.
en: You must not murder anyone.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, o daa deei ti dɔriti mini ti suhugarigu ʒi. Amaa ka ti daa tɛhi ni Naawuni n-darig o tibili ka ti o biɛrim maa.
en: He suffered and endured great pain for us, but we thought his suffering was punishment from God.

dag: Naawuni ni chɛ bɛ daalahichi paŋ ba zuɣu, di bi lan kpa ni sara maligu din ni kpihim alahichi mali yaha.
en: When there is forgiveness for these things, there is no longer an offering for sin.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila wurigu, ka buɣim ni di ba zaa! Bɛ ku tooi tiligi bɛmaŋ buɣim barina ni. Bɛ ka sala buɣim din ni wuɣisi.
en: People who trust the stars are as helpless as straw in a flaming fire. No one can even keep warm, sitting by a fire that feeds only on straw.

dag: Ka bɛn daa ʒe Yisa sani maa ni yino ŋoog o takɔbi chɛ n-shɛligi maligumaaniba zuɣulan dabili tibili bahi.
en: One of those who were with Jesus drew his sword and struck at the High Priest's slave, cutting off his ear.

dag: Dama Ifriimnim mali maligu bimbina pam pahi ni bɛ tumdi alahichi. Ka di leei alahichi tumbu maligu bimbina bɛ sani.
en: The more altars the people of Israel build for removing sin, the more places they have for sinning!.

dag: Ka n daa suhi Yawɛ di saha maa gba yɛli.
en: It was also at that same time that I begged the LORD.

dag: Ka so daa yɛl o, A tizɔbihi min a ma be samban ni m-bɔri ni bɛ nya a n-tɔɣis a yɛtɔɣ shɛli.
en: Someone told him, Your mother and brothers are waiting for you outside. They want to talk to you.

dag: Anab ŋuni ka yi yaannim maa daa lee bi niŋ alaka? Bɛna n-daa ku Naawuni ni daa tim o daanab shɛb bɛn daa daŋ na ni bɛ ti moli ŋun Naawuni wuntialana kandina molo la, ka yi mi yi o nyaaŋa ku o.
en: Was there any prophet that your ancestors did not persecute? They killed God's messengers, who long ago announced the coming of his righteous Servant. And now you have betrayed and murdered him.

dag: Ka a ti booi li bahi Aduna min o bidibisi zuɣu ni m-mali ba ka bɛ be kasi, ka leei maligumaaniba n-tumdi n tuma.
en: Pour the oil on Aaron and his sons to show that they are separated from the rest of the people to serve as priests.

dag: Nuhu daa nyɛla pukpara, ŋuna n-daa nyɛ ŋun tuui biri wain tihi. O daa birila wain tihi.
en: Noah farmed the land and was the first to plant a vineyard.

dag: Shihira ŋɔ ni ti be ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ lahibal suŋ maa yɛda yɛligu ni: Bɛ ni ti mali n yuli karit alizin biɛri, ka ni ti tɔɣisi tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa.
en: Everyone who believes me will be able to do wonderful things. By using my name they will force out demons, and they will speak new languages.

dag: ka yɛli, M paɣiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n dan Ibrahimma Naawuni ŋun yu n dan maa yurilim maŋli din ka kpee, ka ʒe o yim ŋɔ. Ka zaŋ chaŋ m mi polo, Yawɛ kul zaŋ ma mi na ti kpɛhi n dan maa dɔɣiriba yiŋa.
en: He said, Praise be to the Lord , the God of my master Abraham. The Lord has been kind and loyal to him by leading me to his own people.

dag: Kpahimmi Naawuni tuma; o yi niŋ shɛli ka di gbiligi, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi mal li zali dɛde?.
en: Think about what God has done. How can anyone straighten out what God has made crooked?.

dag: Izraɛlnima, yɛlimiya, O yurilim maŋli bi naara.
en: Let Israel shout, God is always merciful.

dag: Ka n ni daa du zoli zuɣu ni n ti deei kuɣ parilana ayi din nyɛ Yawɛ ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛli kuɣ parilana la, n daa kpalim be zoli maa zuɣu la wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ biɛɣ pihinahi. N daa bi di bindirigu bee n-nyu kom.
en: When I went up on the mountain to get the stone tablets, the covenant tablets that the LORD made with you, I was up there forty days and forty nights. I ate no bread, drank no water.

dag: Di saha maa Ɛli daa nyɛla yuun pihiwɛinaanii nira, ka o nina daa fulim ka o bi lan nyara.
en: Now Eli was years old, and his eyes stared straight ahead, unable to see.

dag: Masia Shia ŋun daa be anabinim maa ni n-daa kahigiri wuhiri ba ka bɛ yɛri Masia ni ti yɛn di wahala shɛŋa mini jilima shɛli din ti yɛn dol di nyaaŋa yɛla; ka bɛ daa kpaŋ bɛmaŋ ni bɛ baŋ di saha mini di ni ti yɛn niŋ shɛm yɛla.
en: The Spirit of Christ was in them and was telling them how Christ would suffer and would then be given great honor. So they searched to find out exactly who Christ would be and when this would happen.

dag: Ka n wum damli shɛli binnɛma anahi maa sunsuuni kaman kukol la ka di yɛra, Alikama lita yini nyɛla tumtumda dahin yini tuma yɔri, ka chi lita ata mi nyɛ tumtumda dahin yini tuma yɔri; amaa di niŋ kpam mini wain shɛli.
en: Then I heard something that sounded like a voice. The voice came from where the four living beings were. It said, A quart of wheat or three quarts of barley will cost a full days pay. But dont harm the supply of olive oil and wine.

dag: Din bahindi nyaaŋa nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ: Maliya yaa ti Duuma min o kpiɔŋ ni o yiko ni.
en: To end my letter I tell you, be strong in the Lord and in his great power.

dag: Ninsal yɛlli kam ʒila o zuɣu, amaa yɛlli kam malila di soli ni di saha.
en: There is a right time and a right way to do everything. You must decide what you should do, even when it might cause problems.

dag: N daa ti o dahima ni o niŋ tuuba o zina niŋbu maa zuɣu, amaa ka o zaɣisi tuuba maa niŋbu.
en: I gave her a chance to turn from her sins, but she did not want to stop doing these immoral things.

dag: Amaa Jɔshua daa tiligi Reehab ŋun daa nyɛ pagɔrili la min o dɔɣiriba zaa; o ni daa zaŋ tuumba shɛb Jɔshua ni daa tim ni bɛ ti puɣisi kaai Jɛriko n-sɔɣ la zuɣu. Ka Reehab zuliya na kul be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: But Joshua spared the lives of the prostitute Rahab and all her relatives, because she had hidden the two spies that he had sent to Jericho.

dag: Ɛliɛza bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Rɛhabia ŋun daa nyɛ o bikpɛm la. O daa lan ka bidibisi yaha, amaa Rɛhabia ŋun bidibisi daa galisiya pam.
en: Rehabiah, who was Eliezer's only son, had many children.

dag: Ka Pool mini Baanabas daa kpalim Antiɔk, ka niriba pam daa pahi bɛ zuɣu ka bɛ yihiri waazu ka wuhiri niriba ti Duuma yɛligu.
en: Paul and Barnabas spent some time in Antioch, and together with many others they taught and preached the word of the Lord.

dag: Bɛ daa lan ʒini wulimpuhili polo luɣ shɛli din mini bihigu shee bi wɔɣ ni taba, ka di be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli zaŋ labi tiŋgban nɛli ŋ-ŋɔ polo na la. Dama bɛ niɣi daa yɛligiya m-pali Giliad zaa.
en: Belas people lived to the east as far as the edge of the desert, near the Euphrates River. They lived there because they had many cattle in the land of Gilead.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord God said to Moses.

dag: Gooni din ti yɛn gili fɔntiŋ maa zaa wɔɣilim ni ti nyɛla kilomita awɛi. Ka fɔntiŋ maa yuli ni ti boonila, Yawɛ Beni.
en: The total length of the wall on all four sides of the city is , yards. The name of the city from now on will be The- Lord -Is-Here.

dag: Di saha ka do so ŋun daa be jɛmbu duu maa ni ka alizin biɛɣu ʒi o zuɣu kuhi pam yɛli.
en: There in the synagogue was a man with an evil spirit. He yelled out.

dag: Yi ni sokam lum o ma min o ba sizuura, ka gbibiya n vuhim dabisa la. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Each of you must respect your mother and father, and you must keep my sabbaths; I am the LORD your God.

dag: Nir yi doli ʒiri soli bo n-nya buni, di nyɛla kaman gulisigu mini kum zana.
en: Those who gain treasure with lies are like a drifting fog, leading to death.

dag: N daa kabisi ninvuɣ biɛri nyina ka chɛ ka bɛ ni daa ŋubiri shɛb la yi n-luna.
en: I shattered the fangs of the wicked, rescued prey from their teeth.

dag: Ka o ni daa zaŋ yaɣiri mɛri duɣ shɛli maa daa saɣim o nuu ni, ka o daa zaŋ li taɣi me o ni daa nya ka duɣ shɛli viɛl o sani.
en: He was making a pot from clay. But there was something wrong with the pot. So the potter used that clay to make another pot. With his hands he shaped the pot the way he wanted it to be.

dag: M puhiri n zuliya Hɛrɔdiɔn. M puhiri Narisisus yiŋnim bɛn be ti Duuma ni la.
en: Greetings to Herodion, a fellow Jew, and to the Christians in the family of Narcissus.

dag: Miri ka a ʒiɛhi kpa nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo. Zom yi zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu ni.
en: Don't make a mistake by turning to the right or the left.

dag: Di saha ka Batishiiba daa yɛli naa, M bɔri ni n suh a la bimbil yini, a mi di mɔŋ ma li. Ka naa yɛl o, M ma, yɛlim ma a ni bɔri shɛli maa, dama n ku mɔŋ a li.
en: She said, I have a small favor to ask of you; please do not refuse me. What is it, mother? he asked. I will not refuse you.

dag: A nyuɣu bela polipoli kaman pipi shɛli din puuni na ʒi n-kɔŋ wain shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋ gab taba. A puli ŋmanila alikama mɔri din laɣisi puya, ka paɣiviɛligakushihikom ʒe n-gil li.
en: Your navel is like a round cup ; may it never be without wine. Your belly is like a pile of wheat surrounded by lilies.

dag: N dimnim mini bɛn nahindi ma galisiya pam, amaa m bi chɛ a zaligunim dolibu.
en: I have many enemies trying to hurt me, but I have not stopped following your rules.

dag: Puuni duu maa daa malila duno jaba, ka luɣ kasi shee la gba mali duno jaba.
en: The main hall and the holy place each had two doors.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba maa, Chamiya gili dunia ŋɔ zaa yihi tiliginsim lahibal suŋ ŋɔ waazu ti sokam.
en: He said to them, Go everywhere in the world. Tell the Good News to everyone.

dag: Bɛ ni ti mol o tiliginsim yɛla molo bɛ ni na bi dɔɣi ninvuɣ shɛb sani yɛra, o pun niŋ li.
en: People not yet born will be told, The Lord has saved us.

dag: O daa chaŋ nti kpɛla Naawuni jɛmbu duu nti ŋub bɔrɔbɔro shɛŋa din daa chihiri ni o mini bɛn daa be o sani ŋubi naɣila maligumaaniba kɔŋko la.
en: He went into the house of God, and then they ate the sacred loaves of bread that only priests are supposed to eat.

dag: M mi ni Ijipti naa maa ku chɛ ka yi chaŋ, naɣila n zaŋla kiŋkansi niŋ o.
en: I know that the king of Egypt will not let you go unless he is forced to do so.

dag: Naa Rɛhɔbɔam ni daa di nam ka di ti paai yuma anu, ka Ijipti Naa Shishak daa lo tɔb na ti tuhi Jɛrusalɛmnima, bɛ ni daa zaɣisi Yawɛ zaligu maa zuɣu.
en: Egypts King Shishak attacked Jerusalem in the fifth year of King Rehoboam because Israel had been unfaithful to the LORD.

dag: Naa daa lan bahi noli ni o tim ba nayili bindira mini wain shɛli o ni nyura n-dihi ba lala yuma ata. Ka yuma ata maa ti paai ka o zaŋ ba tahi ŋun naa sanna.
en: King Nebuchadnezzar gave the young men a certain amount of food and wine every day. This was the same kind of food that he ate. He wanted them to be trained for three years. After that they would become servants of the king of Babylon.

dag: Naawuni mi bi deeri ti la bindirigu dibu zuɣu: Ti yi di, di bi pahiri ti shɛli; ti mi yi bi di, di bi filindi ti.
en: Food wont bring us close to God. Were not missing out if we dont eat, and we dont have any advantage if we do eat.

dag: saha shɛli bɛ yi ti ŋuni bɛ biɛhigu shee, bee n-do bɛ dooshee n-gu?.
en: No, they hide in their caves or wait in the grass, ready to attack their prey.

dag: N ni ti yɛn darigi Ijiptinim tibili shɛm m-bala. Di saha ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: So I will punish Egypt. Then they will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Ɛlikana daa malila paɣiba ayi, yino yuli daa boonila Hanna, ka ŋun la mi yuli booni Pɛnina. Pɛnina n-daa nyɛ ŋun dɔɣi bihi, amaa ka Hanna ŋun daa bi dɔɣi bia.
en: Elkanah had two wives, Hannah and Peninnah. Peninnah had children, but Hannah did not.

dag: Dama ti ŋmanila tulaale zim shɛli Masia ni zaŋ ti Naawuni ka di nyom gili ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tiligi la mini bɛn bɔrigi sani:.
en: For we are like a sweet-smelling incense offered by Christ to God, which spreads among those who are being saved and those who are being lost.

dag: Ka nyɔhi daa yi o nyee ni na; ka buɣim niɛm din diri yi o nol ni na; ka sala buɣim niɛm yi o sanna.
en: Smoke went up from Gods nostrils; out of his mouth came a devouring fire; flaming coals blazed out in front of him!.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa zo n-chaŋ Nɔb nti chaŋ Ahimɛlɛk ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana la sani. Ka Ahimɛlɛk daa kana ti tuhi Dauda soli ka o niŋ sɔhira; ka o bɔhi Dauda, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a kɔŋko ka kpe na, ka so bi dol a na.
en: David went to the priest Ahimelech in Nob. Ahimelech came out trembling to meet him and asked, Why did you come here all by yourself.

dag: Yumakaʒe din garila ka o daa nam ma, mani ka o daa daŋ nambu pɔi ka naanyi nam dunia ŋɔ.
en: I was formed in ancient times, at the beginning, before the earth was.

dag: Naawuni tiŋa, bɛ yɛli binshɛŋa din mali jilima zaŋ chaŋ a polo yɛla.
en: Listen, city of God, to the wonderful things he says about you:.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, N ni niŋ a ni yɛli ma ni n niŋ shɛm maa, dama m mi a, ka n nini tiɣ a.
en: The Lord said to Moses, I will do just as you have asked, because I know you very well and I am pleased with you.

dag: Di saha Ɛli daa kurigiya pam ka wumd o bihi maa ni niŋdi Izraɛlnim shɛm maa zaa, hal ka mali paɣ shɛb bɛn daa tumdi tuma Naawuni jɛmbu duu dunol ni la doona.
en: Eli was now very old, and he heard what his sons were doing to the people of Israel.

dag: Dama n ku tɔɣisi shɛli yɛla n-naɣ pahila Masia ni zaŋ ma tum tuun shɛŋa ni di chɛ ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim deeg o noli n yɛligu mini n tuma ni.
en: I dont dare speak about anything except what Christ has done through me to bring about the obedience of the Gentiles. He did it by what Ive said and what Ive done.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini jintɔriba zaa daa bo niriba ni bɛ di Yisa ʒiri shɛhira ka bɛ tɔɣisi luh o, ka ku o.
en: The chief priests and the whole council were looking for false testimony against Jesus so that they could put him to death.

dag: Jɔn nyaandoliba maa ni daa kuli naai, ka Yisa piligi tɔɣisiri salo maa Jɔn yɛla ka bɔhiri ba, Bɔ ka yi daa lee chaŋ tiŋgban nɛli ni ni yi ti nya la? Gbiŋgban shɛli pɔhim ni ʒɛra?.
en: As John's followers were going away, Jesus spoke to the crowds about John: What sort of person did you go out into the desert to see? Was he like tall grass blown about by the wind?.

dag: Ɛli bidibisi daa nyɛla ninvuɣ yoya; bɛ baɣa daa ka Yawɛ ni.
en: Eli's sons were priests, but they were dishonest and refused to obey the Lord . So, while people were boiling the meat from their sacrifices, these priests would send over a servant with a large, three-pronged fork.

dag: Kaman m Ba Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ ni tim ma na ka m be m Ba maa zuɣu shɛm, lala ka ŋunkam ŋubi n niŋgbuŋ gba ni be n zuɣu.
en: As the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father, so whoever eats me lives because of me.

dag: Naawuni daa bi zaŋ dunia shɛli din ti yɛn kana ka nyɛ ti ni tɔɣisiri shɛli yɛla ŋɔ subu fukumsi niŋ malaikanim nuu ni.
en: We know that God did not put the future world under the power of angels.

dag: Naawuni yi daa ŋmaai nyin ŋun nyɛ mɔɣu ni olivi tiwulli na nti tuɣi puu ni olivi tia, dindina baŋmi ni di ku to ni ŋun Naawuni zaŋ puu ni olivi tia maa wula maa n-lan labisi tuɣi dimaŋmaŋ tia maa yaha.
en: After all, it wasn't natural for branches to be cut from a wild olive tree and to be made part of a cultivated olive tree. So it is much more likely that God will join the natural branches back to the cultivated olive tree.

dag: Amaa di bi simdi ni bɛ boli ya karimbanima, dama karimba yino ka yi mali, ka yinim bɛn zaa kpalim nyɛla mabihi ni taba.
en: You must not be called Teacher, because you are all equal and have only one Teacher.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb daa na mi n-wum wuni kukoli ni tɔɣisiri ba yɛtɔɣa buɣim ni kaman yi ni daa wum shɛm maa, ka be?.
en: Have any people ever lived after hearing a god speak to them from a fire, as you have?.

dag: Amaa doo maa yi mali bidibiga ŋun nya o ba ni tum alahichi shɛŋa zaa, ka dabiɛm gbaag o, ka ŋun bi tum lala.
en: Now, that evil son might also have a son. But this son sees the bad things his father did, and he refuses to live as his father did. He treats people fairly.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ti ma noli din ni tooi wuhi niriba ni di chɛ ka n tooi kpaŋsi bɛn gbarigi suhuri. O neeri ma la asiba kam, ka yoori n tiba ni n wum kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun deeri wuhibu.
en: The Lord GOD gave me the ability to teach, so now I teach these sad people. Every morning he wakes me and teaches me like a student.

dag: Di saha ka Naa maa daa duhi Shadirak mini Mɛshak ni Abɛdnɛgo n-zaŋ ba zali zaashe kara ni Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: After this happened, the king appointed Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego to even higher positions in Babylon Province.

dag: N ni darigi bɛ tibili bɛ daalahichi mini bɛ yaannim daalahichi zuɣu, dama bɛ tuɣindi tulaale zim buɣa maligu zoya zuɣu, ka tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri zaŋ chaŋ m polo. N shiri ni darigi bɛ tibili pam bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I, the Lord , am doing this because of your sins and the sins of your ancestors. They did these sins when they burned incense in the mountains. They shamed me on those hills, and I punished them first.

dag: O daa zaŋla anzinfa din kpalim ka di tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram pihita m-mali bansi din yɛn yili daantalisi la mini di mihi ka niŋ anzinfa pa daantalisi maa zuɣuri ni.
en: They used the remaining pounds of silver to make the hooks, the curtain rods, and the silver covers for the posts.

dag: n-wurim di bimbina la, ka ŋme ŋ-ŋma buɣili Ashɛrim min o binnana la zaa m-baɣisibaɣisi li ka di be kaman taŋkpa zim, ka daa ŋme ŋ-ŋma tulaale zim tuɣilibu bimbina din daa be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lab kuli Jɛrusalɛm.
en: tore down the altars and sacred poles, ground the idols to dust, and smashed all the incense altars throughout the land of Israel. Then Josiah returned to Jerusalem.

dag: Ka dilan yi yɛl o, Chɛ ka ti zaŋ biŋkpam nyo buɣim pɔi, ka a naanyi ŋmaag a ni bɔri shɛm tariga. O yɛrimi, Aai, ŋmaam ti ma pumpɔŋɔ, di yi pa lala n ni zaŋ kiŋkansi ŋmaai li.
en: Maybe the man offering the sacrifice would say, Burn the fat first, and then you can take whatever you want. But the servant would answer: No, give me the meat now. If you dont give it to me, Ill take it from you.

dag: A nyɛla nambɔzɔra ni ŋun chɛri taali paŋda, hal ti ni kul zaɣis a la zaa yoli.
en: Compassion and deep forgiveness belong to my Lord, our God, because we rebelled against him.

dag: Ka ti ni tɔɣisiri ya yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa bi yila chirimbu bee kɔr biɛri bee yɛmbimbiɛri yɔhiŋgu ni na;.
en: Our appeal isnt based on false information, the wrong motives, or deception.

dag: Biɛɣu ni daa neei, ka Pashihur chɛ ka bɛ baai Jɛrimia bandi maa, ka Jɛrimia yɛl o, Yawɛ daa bi bol a yuli Pashihur, amaa o daa bol a yuli la Dabiɛm be luɣilikam zaa .
en: The next day, when Pashhur released Jeremiah from confinement, Jeremiah said to him, The LORD has changed your name from Pashhur to Panic Lurks Everywhere.

dag: Juda nanim ŋmanila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn sɔɣi vuɣi tintariga kpahi. N suhuyiɣisili ni ti lu bɛ zuɣu kaman saa la.
en: The princes of Judah act like raiders who steal the land; I will pour out my anger like water upon them.

dag: Di saha maa Filistianim maa daa chaŋmi ti tuhi Rɛfaim tin shɛli din daa be vinvamli ni la nima, ka di bɛ nɛma.
en: The Philistines attacked the people living in the Valley of Rephaim and stole their things.

dag: Ŋun chɛ soli bahi ni ti nya tibidarigibo pam, ka ŋunkam mi je ni bɛ kpah o zuɣu ni ni kpi.
en: Whoever stops living right will be punished. Whoever hates to be corrected will be destroyed.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa yi Olivi Tihi Zoli maa zuɣu n-lab Jɛrusalɛm. Olivi Tihi Zoli maa mini Jɛrusalɛm bi wɔɣ ni taba.
en: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives, which is near Jerusalem—a sabbath days journey away.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Juda zuliya niriba maa daa lan chaŋ ti tuhi Keenannim shɛb bɛn be zoya tinsi ni mini bɛn be Nɛgɛb ni bɛn be zolɔna ni tinsi ni la.
en: Judah's army fought the Canaanites who lived in the hill country, the Southern Desert, and the foothills to the west.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi yɛli Tomas, Zaŋm a nubil bɔbili n nuhi ŋɔ ni, ka zaŋ a nuu tim m puluɣili bɔbili ŋɔ ni, ka niŋ yɛda.
en: Then he said to Thomas, Put your finger here. Look at my hands. Put your hand here in my side. Stop doubting and believe.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa laɣim niriba maa zaa chaŋ Raba ti tuhi deei li.
en: So David gathered all the troops, marched to Rabbah, fought against it, and captured it.

dag: Ka o paɣ Jɛzibɛl bɔh o, Pa nyini n-nyɛ Izraɛl Naa? Yiɣisim di ni suhupiɛlli. N ni zaŋ Nabɔt ŋun nyɛ Jɛziriil nir maa wain tihi puu maa ti a.
en: Then his wife Jezebel said to him, Arent you the one who rules Israel? Get up! Eat some food and cheer up. Ill get Naboths vineyard for you myself.

dag: Ʒim bɔrɔbɔro kpil pia mini maha ni shi luɣuluɣu n-chaŋ o sani, o ni ti yɛl a din yɛn niŋ bia maa.
en: Take him ten loaves of bread, some cakes, and a jar of honey. Ask him what is going to happen to our son, and he will tell you.

dag: Sokam diri Dimitirius shɛhira suŋ, hal yɛlimaŋli maŋmaŋ gba dir o shɛhira suŋ. Ka timaŋmaŋ gba dir o shɛhira pahi; ka a mi ni ti ni yɛli shɛm maa nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: Everyone says good things about Demetrius, and the truth agrees with what they say. Also, we say good about him. And you know that what we say is true.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ salima min anzinfa neen shɛŋa Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa kpuɣi Naawuni jɛmbu duu Jɛrusalɛm n-kuli Babilɔn na la n-labisi li ti zali di zaashe kura ni Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Also the gold and silver utensils which King Nebuchadnezzar brought to Babylon from the Temple in Jerusalem are to be returned to their proper place in the Jerusalem Temple.

dag: Binshɛɣukam bɛn be kom ni ka ka gɔhi mini paɣiri nyɛla yi ni chihiri shɛb dibu.
en: You must not eat anything that lives in the water and does not have fins and scales.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛl o nyaandoliba maa, Yi yi yuri ma, yi ni doli n zaligunima.
en: If you love me, you will obey my commandments.

dag: O daa lan zali sariakaritiba bɛ ni daa me goondahi gili Juda tiŋgban ni fɔntin shɛŋa la zaa yiniyini ni.
en: He appointed judges throughout the land in each of the fortified cities of Judah.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka o nam maa niŋ yaa pam, ka Judanim zaa daa kanna ti tir o pina. Ka o daa mali buni pam, ka niriba tir o jilima.
en: and helped him keep firm control of his kingdom. The people of Judah brought gifts to Jehoshaphat, but even after he became very rich and respected.

dag: Wuhim ti a yurilim maŋli la asiba, din ni chɛ ka ti yili suhupiɛlli yila, ka ti suhuri piɛli ti dabisa zaa ni.
en: When morning comes, let your love satisfy all our needs. Then we can celebrate and be glad for what time we have left.

dag: dindina bɛ ni tooi yo o zuɣu ka deeg o o ni zaŋ omaŋ pa talima maa nyaaŋa, o mabihi ni yino ni tooi yo o zuɣu ka deeg o.
en: you still have the right to be set free by a relative, such as a brother.

dag: Mani n-ni ti nyɛ o ba ka o mi nyɛ m bia, ka o yi ti tum taali, n ni zaŋ fiɛbiga fiɛb o n-saɣis o kaman ninsalinim ni saɣisiri bɛ bihi shɛm.
en: I will be his father, and he will be my son. When he sins, I will use other people to punish him. They will be my whips.

dag: Bilichiisi duri luya, amaa ti ni kpe kuɣa m-me shɛŋa zali di zaani. Sinsabisi tihi vuɣi lu, amaa ti ni bo sida tihi sa n-zali di zaani.
en: The brick buildings have fallen down, but we will replace them with stone buildings. The beams of sycamore wood have been cut down, but we will replace them with the finest cedar.

dag: Nyama, pa bɛ buni ka bɛ gbibi bɛ nuhi ni maa? Man kul ku deei ninvuɣ biɛri yɛtɔɣa.
en: Of course, evil people dont make their own success. I would never follow their advice.

dag: Ka o daa ti bɔhi Yawɛ n-nya o yɛla ti o, ka ti o bindirigu, ka lan zaŋ Goliat Filistia doo la takɔb la ti o.
en: Ahimelech prayed to the Lord for David and gave him some food. He even gave David the sword of Goliath the Philistine.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu asiba ka Yawɛ bɔhi ma.
en: The next morning the Lord spoke to me.

dag: Di saha ka o daa laɣim bɔba ni yaɣa ni gomnanim maa tɔbbihi maa, ka bɛ kalinli daa yiɣisi kɔbisiyi ni pihitanaayi. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa laɣim Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa, ka bɛ kalinli yiɣisi tusaayopɔin.
en: So the king called out the young soldiers who were under the district commanders, in all. Then he called out the Israelite army, a total of seven thousand men.

dag: Juda Naa Asa ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ata saha, ka Ahija bia Baasha daa leei Izraɛlnim zaa naa n-ʒi Tiriza. O daa niŋla nam maa ni yuun pisinaanahi.
en: In the third year of Judahs King Asa, Baasha, Ahijahs son, became king over all Israel. He ruled in Tirzah for twenty-four years.

dag: Dinzuɣu doliya n ni zaŋdi fukumsi zalikpan shɛŋa mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi n-tiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: So be sure to obey his laws and teachings I am giving you today.

dag: Ka Yisa daa teeg o nuu tir o nyaandoliba maa ka yɛli, M ma mini n tizɔbihi m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Then he pointed to his followers and said, See! These people are my mother and my brothers.

dag: Sana yi be yi tiŋgban ni, yin di niŋy o zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Do not mistreat foreigners who are living in your land.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa chaŋ teeku ni.
en: When evening came, Jesus' disciples went down to the lake.

dag: Ka Bɔaz daa kpuɣi Rut kul o yiŋa nti zaŋ o niŋ o paɣa. Ka Yawɛ daa niŋ alibarika niŋ Rut ni ka o zali pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga.
en: So Boaz took Ruth, and she became his wife. He was intimate with her, the LORD let her become pregnant, and she gave birth to a son.

dag: Ka Anabi Aizaia daa niŋ suhukpeeni gari lala yɛli ni Naawuni yɛliya: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa bi yuuni bɔri ma la nya ma; n zaŋ mmaŋ wuhi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa bi bɔhi n yɛla.
en: Then Isaiah is bold enough to say this for God: The people who were not looking for me— they are the ones who found me. I made myself known to those who did not ask for me. Isaiah :.

dag: Bɛ daa yila Midian chaŋ Paran ti zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛba m-pahi bɛmaŋ zuɣu, ka bɛ mini ba zo n-kuli Ijipti nti chaŋ Ijipti naa Firawuna sani. Ka naa maa daa ti Hadad yili mini tiŋgbani ni bindirigu.
en: They left Midian and went to Paran. In Paran some other people joined them and the whole group went to Egypt. They went to Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, and asked for help. Pharaoh gave Hadad a house, some land, and food to eat.

dag: Jɛra n-yɛri bɛ suhuri ni, Naawuni kani. Bɛ nyɛla tuumbiɛrinima, ka tumdi din chihira; ka so ka bɛ ni n-nyɛ ŋun tumdi din viɛla.
en: Only a fool would say, There is no God! People like that are worthless; they are heartless and cruel and never do right.

dag: Amaa ka Ammɔnnim naa Nahash daa yɛl ba, Yi yi ni saɣi ka n fɔɣi yi nudiriti polo nimbihi zaa din ni chɛ ka Izraɛlnim zaa nya filiŋ, n ni chɛ ka m mini ya tɔɣisi.
en: But he answered, I will make a treaty with you people only if I can poke out the right eye of each person. Then all Israel will be ashamed.

dag: Ka Aripakishad daa nyɛ Shɛla ba, ka Shɛla mi nyɛ Ɛba ba.
en: Arpachshad fathered Shelah, and Shelah fathered Eber.

dag: Mikimas — kɔbiga ni pisinaayi.
en: The people of Michmash.

dag: Niŋmiya bindira tiri kum ni kuri shɛba, ka deemiya nandaamba bɛn ka kpɛhili shee niŋmi yi yinsi; ka timiya bɛn chani gbinfini situra; ka di zaɣisiya yi dɔɣiriba sɔŋbu.
en: Isnt it sharing your bread with the hungry and bringing the homeless poor into your house, covering the naked when you see them, and not hiding from your own family?.

dag: Ka o daa teeg o nuu zuɣusaa ha n-tirina gbaai ma n-vooi ma yihi kom pam puuni na.
en: From on high God reached down and grabbed me; he took me out of deep waters.

dag: ti yɛl o, A bi mi ni Ammɔnnim naa Baalis timla Nɛtania bia Ishimail na ni o ti ku a? Amaa ka Ahikam bia Gɛdalia daa bi niŋ ba yɛda.
en: and said to him, Don't you know that King Baalis of Ammon has sent Ishmael to murder you? But Gedaliah did not believe it.

dag: Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la mini Alikauli Adaka la mini di yɔrigu ni suɣili maa puuni nɛma zaa.
en: the Tent of my presence, the Covenant Box and its lid, all the furnishings of the Tent.

dag: Yisa daa ti be luɣ shɛli suhiri Naawuni. O ni daa ti suhi naai ka o nyaandoliba maa ni yino yɛl o, Ti Duuma, wuhim ti ti ni yɛn suhiri Naawuni shɛm kaman Jɔn Baptaizira ni daa wuh o nyaandoliba shɛm la.
en: One day Jesus was praying in a certain place. When he had finished, one of his disciples said to him, Lord, teach us to pray, just as John taught his disciples.

dag: Ka Barizillai ŋun daa nyɛ Giliad nir la daa yi Rɔgɛlim n-chaŋ naa sani Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa ni ni o ti doli naa du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa.
en: Barzillai of Gilead came down from Rogelim to cross the Jordan River with King David and send him on his way home.

dag: Yuma ayopɔin kam ni di simdi ni yi ku sama.
en: Every seventh year you must cancel all debts.

dag: Yi yi ka n tooni na ni yi ti jɛm ma, ŋuni n-lee yɛli ya ni yi zaŋ biŋkɔbiri maa na? Ŋuni n-lee puhi ya ni yi be n jɛmbu duu n-nɔri ginda?.
en: When you come to appear before me, who asked this from you, this trampling of my temples courts?.

dag: Ka ti yi doli fukumsi zaligunim ŋɔ zaa viɛnyɛliŋga kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ti shɛm, dindina ti niŋ din tuhi. .
en: If we faithfully obey everything that God has commanded us, he will be pleased with us.

dag: Di darigi ti tibili ti yaannim daalahichi zuɣu. Zom ti nambɔɣu yomyom; dama ti nya filiŋ pam.
en: Do not punish us for the sins of our ancestors. Have mercy on us now; we have lost all hope.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa pɔr la n daa yuri ba. N daa boli ba yihi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na kaman m bidibisi la.
en: When Israel was a child, I loved him, and out of Egypt I called my son.

dag: N lan mali salin shɛli nuhi tuun baŋsimnim ni ti yɛn zaŋ tum salima tuma mini anzinfa shɛli bɛ ni ti yɛn zaŋ tum anzinfa tuma. Ka ŋuni n-lee ni zaŋ omaŋ zaa ti Yawɛ zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka ti binshɛli ka di nyɛla o suhuyubu zuɣu.
en: gold for gold objects, and silver for silver objects, to be used for everything the skilled workers will make. Who else, then, will volunteer, dedicating themselves to the LORD today?.

dag: Ka o zabiri piɛli kaman piɛ piɛlli kɔbiri bee gumbɔrigu; ka o nina be kaman buɣim zilinli la.
en: His hair was white as wool, or as snow, and his eyes blazed like fire;.

dag: Ka Aduna daa niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm maa n-zaŋ li ti zali baɣili shɛhira bini la.
en: Aaron followed the Lord 's instructions and put the manna in front of the sacred chest for safekeeping.

dag: A daa zaŋ wain tia Ijipti na nti kari zuliya shɛba ka zaŋ li sa.
en: When you brought us out of Egypt, we were like your special vine. You forced other nations to leave this land, and you planted that vine here.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Ka yi yɛda niŋbu maa lee bela ya? Ka di niŋ ba alahiziba pam, ka dabiɛm kpe ba ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Bɔtaa nira n-lee bɔŋɔ hal ka sanʒiɛɣu mini kɔgbana ti wumd o noli.
en: Then Jesus asked the disciples, Don't you have any faith? But they were frightened and amazed. They said to each other, Who is this? He can give orders to the wind and the waves, and they obey him.

dag: ka Bɛnaaya mini Jahaziɛl bɛn daa nyɛ maligumaaniba la mi nyɛ bɛn yɛn piɛbiri kikahi m-be Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa tooni.
en: and the two priests Benaiah and Jahaziel were to blow trumpets every day in front of the sacred chest.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa yɛli wahu, A ni niŋ shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu, n ni yɛli noli ti a n-gari yiŋ biŋkɔbiri mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri zaa; a ni nyɛritila a puli zuɣu, ka diri taŋkpaɣu hal ni a nyɛvil tariga.
en: So the Lord God said to the snake: Because of what you have done, you will be the only animal to suffer this curse— For as long as you live, you will crawl on your stomach and eat dirt.

dag: Iso ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛdomnim bɛn daa be Siɛr zoya tiŋ maa ni yab la zuliya ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ.
en: These are the descendants of Esau, the ancestor of the Edomites.

dag: Asa tuun shɛŋa din pahi min o kpiɔŋ ni o ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa ni o ni daa me tin shɛŋa zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi ni. Amaa o ni daa ti kurigi, naba polo dɔro n-daa gbaag o.
en: The rest of Asas deeds, his strength, and all that he did, as well as the towns that he built, arent they written in the official records of Judahs kings? When he was old, Asa developed a severe foot disease.

dag: dama ŋ-ŋɔ ka alikauli maa daa yɛli, Zaŋ chaŋ yuuni na ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha, n ni lab a sanna, ka a paɣ Zara ni ti dɔɣi bidibiga.
en: Sarah, At this time next year I will return, and you will already have a son.

dag: dama ti nyɛla bɛn mini Masia laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yini, ti yi kul niŋ ti ni daa tuui mali tahima shɛl la naani viɛnyɛliŋga hal ni di bahigu ni.
en: We were sure about Christ when we first became his people. So let's hold tightly to our faith until the end.

dag: Tab jɛlinsi nyɛla din tahiri zabili na, amaa yurilim limsiri taali balibu kam.
en: Hate stirs up trouble, but love forgives all offenses.

dag: Zaŋmiya li wuhi yi bihi, ka tɔɣisim di yɛla yi yi be yiŋa ni yi yi ti be luɣ shɛli polo ni yi yi ti doya ni yi yi ti yiɣisi.
en: Recite them to your children. Talk about them when you are sitting around your house and when you are out and about, when you are lying down and when you are getting up.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛli, Zaŋmiya takɔbi ti ma na. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ takɔb na nti ti naa.
en: He sent for a sword, and when it was brought.

dag: Yi ni so di bɔh o kpee biɛri, amaa niŋmiya ania n-kul niŋmi yi taba zaŋ tabili sokam zaa din viɛla.
en: Make sure no one repays a wrong with a wrong, but always pursue the good for each other and everyone else.

dag: Nir yi zu nahu bee piɛɣu nti kɔhi bee nti kɔrigi, di simdi ka o yo niɣ anu naɣ yino maa zuɣu, ka yo piɛr anahi piɛ yino maa zuɣu. Di simdi ka o yo di samli maa, ka o yi ka binshɛli din ni yo samli maa, dindina bɛn kɔhim o n-yo o zubu maa samli.
en: How should you punish a man who steals a bull or a sheep? If the man kills the animal or sells it, then he cannot give it back. So he must pay five bulls for the one he stole. Or he must pay four sheep for the one he stole. He must pay for stealing.

dag: O ba daa na ʒi m-milig o suhu dahin shɛli m-bɔh o, Bɔzuɣu ka a niŋ ŋ-ŋɔ ka niŋ ŋ-ŋɔ? Adɔnija gba daa viɛli pam, ka nyɛ ŋun pa Absalom zuɣu.
en: Now Adonijahs father had never given him direction; he never questioned why Adonijah did what he did. He was very handsome and was born after Absalom.

dag: Yaakubu bidibisi, Laɣimmiya na ti wum. Wummiya yi ba Izraɛl ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm.
en: Come together and listen, sons of Jacob. Listen to your father Israel.

dag: ka zali di tariga, ka niŋ dunoya niŋ li n-kpari li zali.
en: Then I built a wall around it, locked the gates.

dag: Zuɣulaannim bee Farisiinim ni so niŋ o yɛda?.
en: You dont see any of the leaders or any of us Pharisees believing in him, do you?.

dag: Ka zaŋ chaŋ Jɛzibɛl mi polo, Naawuni yɛliya, Bahi ni ŋub o Jɛziriil tiŋ puuni.
en: The Lord also says this about your wife Jezebel: Dogs will eat the body of Jezebel by the wall of the city of Jezreel.

dag: Chɛ ka din ni bahi ba yoli kana nti bahi ba yoli libigi ba; ka chɛ ka bɛ ni bari tɔn shɛŋa la ŋmaligi gbahi ba, ka chɛ ka bɛ lu di ni bahi yoli!.
en: But destruction will catch them before they know it; they will be caught in their own trap and fall to their destruction!.

dag: Ijipti bihi n-daa nyɛ: Ludinim mini Anamnima ni Lɛhabinima ni Nafitunima ni.
en: The descendants of Egypt were the people of Lydia, Anam, Lehab, Naphtuh.

dag: Ka o daa va bɛ nɛma zaa, ka zaŋ o dɔɣim Lɔt min o nɛma gba ni ninvuɣ shɛba ni paɣiba m-pahi labina.
en: and Abram went after them. He brought back his nephew Lot, together with Lot's possessions and the women and everyone else who had been captured.

dag: Nyamiya, Yawɛ yiko min o jilima nyɛla din yi katiŋ kanna. O suhuyiɣisili shihirili nyɛla nyɔhi ni buɣim; ka o nol ni yɛtɔɣa ŋmani buɣim din dira.
en: The Lord is coming from far away with his fiery anger and thick clouds of smoke. His angry words flame up like a destructive fire;.

dag: Ka Jokishan daa nyɛ Shiiba mini Dɛdan ba. Ka Dɛdan bihi daa nyɛ Ashurim mini Lɛtushim ni Liummim.
en: Later, Jokshan became the father of Sheba and Dedan, and when Dedan grew up, he had three sons: Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.

dag: Paɣ maa ni daa nya ka Yisifu chɛ o binyɛrigu maa niŋ o nuu ni ka guui yi yili maa ni maa.
en: The woman saw that Joseph had left his coat in her hand and had run out of the house.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ di o shɛhira o ni tumdi ni nimmoo yi mini Laodisianim ni Hiɛrapolisnim zuɣu shɛm.
en: I can personally testify to his hard work for you and for the people in Laodicea and Hierapolis.

dag: Nyama, ŋuna n-chɛ ka saa nyaɣisiri gind o, ka chɛ ka teeku puuni nyaɣa limsi.
en: And when God sends lightning, it can be seen at the bottom of the sea.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Cham Firawuna sani ti yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Hiburunim Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Chɛ ka n niriba Izraɛlnim maa chaŋ ti jɛm ma.
en: The Lord sent Moses with this message for the king of Egypt: The Lord God of the Hebrews commands you to let his people go, so they can worship him.

dag: Ka di simdi ka o ti zaŋ suhudoo maligu biŋkɔbigu maa biŋkpam din pili namanama zuɣu la mini kpam din be namanama maa ni zaa.
