en: The priest will take a part of that fellowship offering as a gift to the Lord . He will take the fat that is over and around the inner parts.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabihi, ti pala ti ninsalitali biɛhigu la sandiriba ni ti doli ti ninsalitali biɛhigu maa yubu ni wuhiri ti shɛm;.
en: So then, brothers and sisters, we have an obligation, but it isnt an obligation to ourselves to live our lives on the basis of selfishness.

dag: n-zaŋ hal ni Bɛtihɔgila n-yi nimaani zaŋ gari hal ti paai Bɛtaraba nuzaa polo. Ka di tariga maa zaŋ lala hal ni Rubin bia Bɔhan kuɣili la gbini;.
en: From there it went west up to Beth-Hoglah, continued north of Beth-Arabah, and went up to the Monument of Bohan, who belonged to the Reuben tribe.

dag: Pɛdaya bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Zɛrubabɛl mini Shimɛi. Zɛrubabɛl bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Mɛshulam mini Hanania, bɛ tizɔpaɣa n-daa nyɛ Shɛlomit.
en: Pedaiah had two sons, Zerubbabel and Shimei. Zerubbabel was the father of two sons, Meshullam and Hananiah, and one daughter, Shelomith.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Yiɣisima, yim kpe siɣi tiŋ yomyom, dama a ni daa zaŋ a ninvuɣ shɛb yi Ijipti na la tum tuumbiɛɣu, bɛ ŋmaligiya yomyom ka chɛ n ni daa zali ba ni bɛ doli so shɛli maa; ka doola binnani zali bɛmaŋa.
en: Then the Lord said to me, Get up and quickly go down from here. The people you brought out of Egypt have ruined themselves. They stopped obeying my commands so quickly. They melted gold and made an idol for themselves.

dag: Ka Siria naa maa daa yɛl o, Cham pumpɔŋɔ! N ni sab gbaŋ ti a ka a mali ti ti Izraɛl naa. Ka Naaman daa bo anzinfa laɣibaligu tuhi pia mini salima laɣibaligu tusaayɔbu ni binyɛr suma din nyɛ chuɣu binyɛra pia chaŋ.
en: The king said, Go to the king of Israel and take this letter to him. So Naaman set out, taking thirty thousand pieces of silver, six thousand pieces of gold, and ten changes of fine clothes.

dag: Dama ti Duuma ni boli so yi daa nyɛla dabili, o yipa nya yolisim ti Duuma sani. Lala n-nyɛ ŋun pun nyɛ bilichina ka ti Duuma bol o, dilan mi leela Masia dabili.
en: If you were a slave when the Lord chose you, you are now free in the Lord. You belong to the Lord. In the same way, if you were free when you were chosen, you are now Christs slave.

dag: O ni daa ti miri Bɛtifɛji mini Bɛtani zo shɛli bɛ ni booni Olivi Tihi zol la gbini ka o tim o nyaandoliba ayi.
en: As Jesus came to Bethphage and Bethany on the Mount of Olives, he gave two disciples a task.

dag: Di saha ka Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim ni bɛ zuɣulan Jɛhɔshafat daa lab kuli Jɛrusalɛm ni suhupiɛlli, dama Yawɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ nya suhupiɛlli o ni daa nyaŋ bɛ dimnim ti ba maa zuɣu.
en: Then everyone from Judah and Jerusalem, with Jehoshaphat at their head, joyfully returned home to Jerusalem because the LORD had given them reason to rejoice over their enemies.

dag: Ka Nuhu min o paɣa ni o bidibisi ni bɛ paɣiba daa kpe ŋariŋ maa ni ni bɛ yi kom maa dibu ni.
en: He and his family went into the boat to be saved from the flood. His wife and his sons and their wives were on the boat with him.

dag: O ni daa pii ninvuɣ pinaayi shɛb maa yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Saimɔn, Yisa ni daa pa so yupaa Pita la.
en: He appointed twelve: Peter, a name he gave Simon.

dag: Yɛnnim yɛm n-chɛ ka bɛ mi bɛ ni chani luɣ shɛli, amaa jɛra bɛn jɛrilim kpɛhiri ba la yɔɣu.
en: Wise people have enough sense to find their way, but stupid fools get lost.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna, Toomiya daaŋa ni tampiligim nukurigu palipali ka Musa zaŋ li bahi zuɣusaa Firawuna ninni.
en: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron, Fill your hands with the ashes from a furnace. Moses, you throw the ashes into the air in front of Pharaoh.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah ayopɔin mi daa kpaag o laa ni dini bahi pɔhim ni, ka kukol shɛli daa yi jɛmbu duu nam ʒiishee la na n-tahiri pampam yɛra, Di naaya.
en: The seventh angel poured out his bowl into the air. Then a loud voice came out of the temple from the throne. It said, It is finished.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli niriba maa, Di zɔriya dabiɛm, dama Naawuni kamina ni o ti zahim ya, dina n-nyɛ ni o chɛ ka dabiɛm be yi suhuri ni ka yi ku tum alahichi.
en: Moses said to the people, Dont be afraid, because God has come only to test you and to make sure you are always in awe of God so that you dont sin.

dag: ka daa ʒini pakolim ni mi hal ka o yuma ti paai pihiniinaanahi. O daa kul bela Naawuni jɛmbu duu wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ kam jɛmdi Naawuni ni nolɔbo mini wunsuhigu.
en: And now she was years old. Night and day she served God in the temple by praying and often going without eating.

dag: Ka malaika so ŋun daa yɛli ma yɛtɔɣa maa daa lan kana ti yɛli ma, Nyama, binshɛl lan yina chana.
en: Now the angel who was there to explain the visions came over and said, Look up and tell me what you see coming.

dag: Ka o daa piligi wuhiri ba yɛra.
en: and he began to teach them:.

dag: Gidiɔn maŋmaŋ bidibisi daa nyɛla pisopɔin, dama o daa malila paɣ bɔbili.
en: Gideon had seventy sons of his own because he had many wives.

dag: Bee n yi di zaŋ takɔbi lu tiŋgbɔŋ maa zuɣu ka yɛli, Takɔbi, lum tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zuɣu n-ku ninsalinim mini bɛ biŋkɔbiri.
en: Or suppose I bring a sword against that land and command the sword to pass through and eliminate both humans and animals.

dag: dindina a ni baŋ Yawɛ zɔbu ni nyɛ shɛm, ka nya baŋsim din nyɛ Naawuni dini.
en: If you do this, you will understand what it means to respect the Lord , and you will come to know God.

dag: Chɛ ka Mɔabnim nyu dam kuli bɛ ni duhi bɛmaŋ pam niŋ Yawɛ la zuɣu. Bɛ ni dɔni bɛmaŋmaŋ tiri ni bilim. Bɛ gba ni leei niriba ni yɛn lari shɛba.
en: People of Moab, you claim to be stronger than I am. Now I will tell other nations to make you drunk and to laugh while you collapse in your own vomit.

dag: Binshɛɣukam din kpɛri ninsal nol ni pala din tar o daɣiri; amaa din yiri ninsal nol ni na n-naɣ tar o daɣiri.
en: The food you put into your mouth doesn't make you unclean and unfit to worship God. The bad words that come out of your mouth are what make you unclean.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yihi li suɣili maa ni n-zaŋ li na ti ti Jɔshua mini Izraɛlnim zaa, ka bɛ daa zaŋ li sɔŋ Yawɛ tooni.
en: The men brought the things out of the tent and took them to Joshua and all the Israelites. They threw them on the ground before the Lord .

dag: N ni bɔri ni n yɛli ya shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi zaa yinoyino yɛrila ŋ-ŋɔ: Man dolila Pool; ka so yɛra, N dolila Apolɔs; ka so yɛra, Pita ka man doli; ka so mi yɛra, Man dolila Masia.
en: They have said that some of you claim to follow me, while others claim to follow Apollos or Peter or Christ.

dag: Bɛ ni nyɔri sara maligu buɣim bimbin shɛli zuɣu mini di daanya kurupooti la ni di dapuhi ni di lahi zaa ni di tahili mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛli zuɣu.
en: the altar on which to burn offerings, with its bronze grating attached, its poles, and all its equipment; the washbasin and its base;.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Ayuba daa ti yaag o noli n-tu bɛ ni daa dɔɣ o dabisi shɛli dali.
en: Finally Job broke the silence and cursed the day on which he had been born.

dag: Zaŋmiya bula yino mali alahichi sara pahi yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim sahakam la mini di chi sara ni di binnyura sara la zuɣu.
en: There will be one male goat for a purification offering in addition to the regular entirely burned offering with its grain offering and its drink offering.

dag: Ti wuhiri ni nir yiri taali ni Naawuni san la yɛda niŋbu zuɣu, ka pa ni Naawuni fukumsi zaligu dolibu zuɣu.
en: We see that people are acceptable to God because they have faith, and not because they obey the Law.

dag: Ka kukol shɛli daa yi nam ʒiishee maa gbin na yɛra, Yinim bɛn zaa nyɛ wɔɣira mini tarimba, ka nyɛ Naawuni daba bɛn zɔr o ŋɔ paɣimiya Naawuni.
en: Then there came from the throne the sound of a voice, saying, Praise our God, all his servants and all people, both great and small, who have reverence for him.

dag: Jɛhoyakim yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaanu saha shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋ o lee naa maa. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun piniyini. O daa tum alahichi pam Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni la sani.
en: Jehoiakim was years old when he became king, and he ruled for eleven years in Jerusalem. He did what was evil in the LORDs eyes.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa garigi yɛli, Yɛlimiya n dan naa ni o ni yɛli shɛm maa nyɛla pali, mmaŋmaŋ zaŋ tabili n ni mali shɛlikam nyɛla o dini.
en: Tell my lord, King Benhadad, that I agree; he can have me and everything I own, Ahab answered.

dag: dindina bɛ ni tooi yo o zuɣu ka deeg o o ni zaŋ omaŋ pa talima maa nyaaŋa, o mabihi ni yino ni tooi yo o zuɣu ka deeg o.
en: After they are sold, they still have the right to be bought back. A brother.

dag: ni binnɛma zaa bɛn be yi sani, bɛn nyɛ noonsi mini niɣi ni mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri balibu kam bɛn be yi sani, ka doli ya yi ŋariŋ maa ni na alikauli.
en: and with all living beings—all birds and all animals—everything that came out of the boat with you.

dag: Mbusim be piɛgul so ŋun chɛ piɛri bahi maa zuɣu! Bɛ ni zaŋ sua n-chɛ o bɔɣu tabil o nudirigu nini. Ka o bɔɣu maa kpi, ka o nudirigu nini maa gba zom zaa.
en: Too bad for you, you worthless shepherd! You abandoned my sheep. Punish him! Strike his arm and right eye with a sword. His arm will be useless. His right eye will be blind.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ Jɔshua ti zali maligumaana Ɛliɛza mini salo maa zaa tooni kaman Yawɛ ni daa zal o shɛm maa.
en: Moses did as the Lord had commanded him. He had Joshua stand before Eleazar the priest and the whole community.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yi ti niŋ nyini n dana zaɣ viɛl shɛlikam zaa o ni yɛli ni o ni niŋ a la, ka chɛ ka a leei Izraɛl naa.
en: The Lord has promised to do many good things for you, even to make you the ruler of Israel. The Lord will keep his promises to you.

dag: M mali yiko ni n di niŋ a zaɣ biɛɣu, amaa a ba Yisahaku Naawuni la sa yɛli ma yuŋ la, Miri ka a yɛli Yaakubu yɛtɔɣ viɛlli bee zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: I have the power to do you harm, but last night the God of your father warned me not to threaten you in any way.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa labi kuli ti yɛl o deemba Jɛtro, N suhir a mi, chɛ ka n labi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni n niriba sani nti nya bɛ na be bɛ nyɛviya ni. Ka Jɛtro daa yɛli Musa, Cham ni suhudoo.
en: Then Moses went back to Jethro, his father-in-law, and said to him, Please let me go back to my relatives in Egypt to see if they are still alive. Jethro agreed and told him good-bye.

dag: Di saha ka n daa nya malaika so ka o ʒe wuntaŋa n-kuhiri pampam booni noonsi bɛn yiɣiri zuɣusaa ha yɛra: Laɣimmiya na nti di Naawuni ni tin ya bindir shɛli ŋɔ!.
en: Then I saw an angel standing on the sun. He shouted in a loud voice to all the birds flying in midair: Come and gather together for God's great feast!.

dag: Dabisili din pah ayopɔin dali, zaŋmiya naɣilah ayopɔin mini piɛlah ayi ni yuun yini piɛlabihi pinaanahi bɛn ka dansi mali sara;.
en: On the seventh day: seven bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs one year old, all flawless.

dag: M mi ni yi niŋ ania n-saɣi nahiŋgu n yuli zuɣu, ka na bi tiri gbini.
en: You never stop trying. You have endured troubles for my name and have not given up.

dag: Yidaampaɣ zinalana ŋɔ, a nyɛla ŋun chɛ ka a mini saamba n-doona ka chɛ a yidana.
en: You are like a woman who commits adultery with strangers instead of loving her husband.

dag: Di zaŋya yi niŋgbuna yaɣ shɛli ti alahichi tum tuumbiɛri; amaa zaŋmiya yimaŋ tila Naawuni kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yi kum ni kpe nyɛvili ni, ka zaŋ yi niŋgbuna yaɣili kam ti Naawuni tum wuntia tuma.
en: Dont offer the parts of your body to serve sin. Dont use your bodies to do evil, but offer yourselves to God, as people who have died and now live. Offer the parts of your body to God to be used for doing good.

dag: Nama ŋɔ tariga paabu yi ti miri, ka bɛ leei ninvuɣ biɛri n-simdi tibidarigibo, na so ni ti yiɣisi n-nyɛ hal kpiɔŋlana ni baŋda ni ninvuɣ yɔhinda.
en: When these rulers have become as evil as possible, their power will end, and then a king who is dangerous and cannot be trusted will appear.

dag: Dama Naawuni ni zaɣisi ba zuɣu yi chɛ ka simdi kpe o mini dunianim sunsuuni, o yi lan deei ba, wula ka di lee ni be? Di ni ŋmanila kpiimba n-neei kum ni.
en: If their rejection has brought about a close relationship between God and the world, how can their acceptance mean anything less than life from the dead?.

dag: Ka n ni daa nya malaika so ka o tam teeku kom zuɣu mini dul la daa kpuɣ o nudirigu zuɣusaa.
en: The angel I had seen standing on the sea and the land then held his right hand up toward heaven.

dag: Ka n yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ Filistianim ŋɔ ni kana ti liri ma Giligal, ka n na bi suhi Yawɛ sɔŋsim; lala zuɣu ka m muɣisi mmaŋa m-mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maa.
en: So I thought, The Philistines are going to attack me here in Gilgal, and I have not tried to win the Lord 's favor. So I felt I had to offer a sacrifice.

dag: Ka yi ni shɛb mi doli Nikolaus nyaanzaaniba wuhibu din nyɛ n ni je shɛl la.
en: Now some of you are following the teaching of the Nicolaitans.

dag: Ti lo nia ni ti tumla din tuhi, ka di pala zaŋ chaŋ ti Duuma sani kɔŋko, amaa zaŋ chaŋ ninsalinim gba sani.
en: Our purpose is to do what is right, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of others.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri biriginsim puuni zana m-beni, amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn yiinila yila, ka mali suhupiɛlli.
en: The wicked are snared by their own sin; the righteous sing and rejoice.

dag: Di saha maa ka n daa lan nya ka Yɛhudianim kpuɣila Ashidɔdnim mini Ammɔnnim ni Mɔabnim bipuɣinsi n-niŋ bɛ paɣiba.
en: At that time I also discovered that many of the Jewish men had married women from Ashdod, Ammon, and Moab.

dag: N yi ti do m bindoo zuɣu n teerila a yɛla; ka kul tɛhir a yɛla yuntisuɣu saha;.
en: I remember you while lying on my bed. I think about you in the middle of the night.

dag: Bundan maa daa mali piɛri mini niɣi pam.
en: The rich man owned a lot of sheep and cattle.

dag: Yi mi ku lan nya karimbaannim bɛn tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛtɔɣa din nyɛ saani yi sani ka yi ʒi li, ka ku tooi baŋ di gbinni la.
en: You will no longer see the defiant people, the people of speech too obscure to understand, who stammer in an incomprehensible language.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan chɛ ka Ɛliada bia Rɛzɔn ŋun daa zo o lan Zɔba Naa Hadadɛza san la leei Sulemaana dima.
en: God raised up another opponent for Solomon: Rezon, Eliadas son, who had escaped from Zobahs King Hadadezer.

dag: Ka bɛ kul maani bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la bɛ ni nyɔr li buɣim bimbin shɛli zuɣu la n-tiri Yawɛ asiba mini zaawuni sahakam kaman di ni sabi Yawɛ fukumsi zaligu shɛl o ni daa zaŋ ti Izraɛlnim la puuni shɛm.
en: They were to offer sacrifices on the altar every morning and evening, just as the Lord had commanded in the Law he gave Israel.

dag: A ni daa zaɣisi Yawɛ noli ka bi ku Amalɛknim zaa, ka saɣim bɛ ni mali shɛlikam zaa la zuɣu ka Yawɛ niŋ a o ni niŋ a shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: The Lord was angry with the Amalekites and told you to destroy them. But you did not obey him. Thats why the Lord is doing this to you today.

dag: Yuun shɛli din pahiri pihinu maa ni ti nyɛla nɛma labisi ti yuuni yi sani. Di yuuni maa ni, di ti biriya bee n-kpuɣi bindir shɛŋa din bili di toli bee m-pɔhiya yi ni bi wahi yi wain ti shɛŋa wula nyoya ni wala.
en: You shall not plant your fields or harvest the grain that grows by itself or gather the grapes in your unpruned vineyards.

dag: Amaa ka Ahaz daa yɛli, N ku yɛl o. N ku buɣisi Yawɛ ni n nya.
en: But Ahaz said, I wont ask; I wont test the LORD.

dag: Dama yi mi wuhibu shɛŋa ti ni daa zaŋ wuhi ya ti Duuma Yisa ni zali ti shɛm puuni la yɛla.
en: Remember the instructions we gave you as followers of the Lord Jesus.

dag: Nyama, o ni daa kul yɛri maa o noli daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka nabihi maa dii kpɛna nti duhi bɛ yee kumda, ka naa min o kpamba zaa gba daa kum pam.
en: The kings sons came in just after Jonadab said that. They were crying loudly. David and all of his officers began crying. They all cried very hard.

dag: Dama yi yi diri wahala din tuhi tumbu zuɣu ka di nyɛla Naawuni yubu m-bala, di so ni yi di wahala din bi tuhi tumbu zuɣu.
en: It is better to suffer for doing good than for doing evil.

dag: Bɛ ni daa booi kpam bahi sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu ka zaŋ li ti Naawuni saha shɛli, ka Izraɛl zuɣulaannim zaŋ binshɛŋa mali sara maa n-daa nyɛ; anzinfa parantɛnim pinaayi mini anzinfa taha pinaayi ni salima lahi pinaayi.
en: This is what the Israelite chiefs provided for the dedication of the altar on the day it was anointed: twelve silver dishes, twelve silver basins, and twelve gold bowls.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ ʒiɛmana din pahir anahi ni ka bɛ ni ti lab kpe na, dama Amɔrinim tuumbiɛri na bi galisi yaɣi.
en: Four generations later, your descendants will return here and take this land, because only then will the people who live here be so sinful that they deserve to be punished.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti niŋ Lɛvinim yi baɣaka saha shɛli zaa yi ni yɛn be yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: But watch yourself: as long as you are on the land, dont forget about the Levites.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn baɣa ka Naawuni ni ŋmanila gɔ shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋ labi; dama so ku tooi zaŋ o nuu kpuɣi ba.
en: But godless people are like thorns that are thrown away; no one can touch them barehanded.

dag: Di zaɣisi ma n kuriginsim saha, a mi di chɛ ma bahi n gbariginsim saha.
en: Dont throw me away just because I am old. Dont leave me as I lose my strength.

dag: N ni chɛ ka n niriba Izraɛlnim bɔhi Ɛdomnim biɛri ti ma. Bɛ ni ti niŋ Ɛdomnim maa kaman n sujee mini n suhuyiɣisili ni nyɛ shɛm, ka bɛ baŋ m biɛri bɔhibu ni nyɛ shɛm. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will use my people Israel and get even against Edom. In this way the people of Israel will show my anger against Edom. Then the people of Edom will know that I punished them. This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: Dunoya, yoomiya yomyom! Duno kurisi ŋɔ, yoomiya! Ka Na so ŋun mali jilima ŋɔ gari kpɛna.
en: Fling wide the gates, open the ancient doors, and the great king will come in.

dag: Dama Anabi Jona ni daa be zahim pul ni yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni daba ata shɛm la, lala ka Daadam Bia gba ti yɛn be tiŋgban ni yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni daba ata.
en: Just as Jonah was in the whales belly for three days and three nights , so the Human One will be in the heart of the earth for three days and three nights.

dag: Lala ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba ni tiŋ maa ni kpamba la gba daa maan o ansarisi yɛra.
en: In the same way, the chief priests, along with the legal experts and the elders, were making fun of him, saying.

dag: Naawuni Shia Kasi mini kom ni ʒim, ka shɛhira diba ata ŋɔ zaa mi yɛla saɣisila taba.
en: They are the Spirit, the water, and the blood, and they all agree.

dag: Di pala ti daa kala soli ni ti deei shɛli yi sani zuɣu ka ti daa niŋdi lala maa, amaa ti daa bɔrimi ni ti niŋ li ka yi nya, ka di chɛ ka yi biɛhigu be kaman ti biɛhigu.
en: We did this, not because we do not have the right to demand our support; we did it to be an example for you to follow.

dag: Ŋun Yisa n-daa kpi ti daalahichi zuɣu ka lan neei kum ni ni di chɛ ka ti yi taali ni Naawuni sani.
en: Jesus was handed over to die for our sins, and he was raised from death to make us right with God.

dag: Dama yuŋ la ka n Duuma Naawuni ŋun su ma ka n jɛmd o ŋɔ malaika sa ka n sanna.
en: For last night an angel of the God to whom I belong and whom I worship came to me.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka n kul gbaani ti Ba Naawuni ŋun mi nyɛ ti Duuma Yisa Masia Ba ŋɔ tooni.
en: For this reason I fall on my knees before the Father.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa lihiri Izraɛl zuliya. Zikiri bia Ɛliɛza n-daa nyɛ Rubin zuliya ni kpɛma, ka Maaka bia Shɛfatia nyɛ Simiɔn zuliya ni kpɛma n-lihiri ba.
en: These were the leaders of the tribes of Israel: Eliezer son of Zicri, leader of the tribe of Reuben; Shephatiah son of Maacah, leader of the tribe of Simeon;.

dag: Ka naa daa chaŋ Giligal, ka Chimham daa dol o chaŋ; ka Judanim zaa mini Izraɛlnim pirigili gba daa zaŋ naa lu soli.
en: Chimham crossed the river with David. All of Judah's army and half of Israel's army were there to help David cross the river.

dag: Mɔabnima, mbusim be yi zuɣu! Yinim Chɛmɔshinima, Chɛmɔshi niriba ŋɔ ni bahi yoli zaa. O chɛ ka o bidibisi leei bɛn zo n-kpe yɔɣu, ka o bipuɣinsi mi leei Amɔrinim Naa Sihɔn daba.
en: How terrible for you, people of Moab! You worshipers of Chemosh are brought to ruin! Your god let the men become refugees, And the women became captives of the Amorite king.

dag: Zara daa lan yɛli, Ŋuni n-daa naan yɛli Ibrahimma ni bihi ni ti mɔɣi man Zara biha. Amaa m bahi dɔɣi bia ti o, o ninkurilim ŋɔ ni.
en: No one thought that I, Sarah, would be able to have Abrahams child. But I have given Abraham a son, even though he is old.

dag: Bɛ daa muɣisiri nachimba ka bɛ niɛmdi zim, ka chɛ ka bidibisi ʒiri dabɔb kara chani ʒiɛhira.
en: Young men have carried grinding stones; boys have stumbled under loads of wood.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ mali zoligɔnim kaman nyiŋgokɔriti la n-zaŋ li pa daantalisi maa zuɣusaa, ka daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ daanya mali pumpɔrinchihi kɔtomsi bini kɔbiga n-zaŋ li yiliyili zoligɔnim maa.
en: The top of each column was decorated with designs that looked like chains and with carvings of pomegranates.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba pinaayi maa laɣim ʒini ni bɛ di bindirigu maa.
en: In the evening Jesus was at the table with the twelve followers.

dag: Di pa ni ti kuunimi ni tinim su yi ni niŋ yɛda shɛm fukumsi, dama yi ʒiɛla dɛde yi ni niŋ yɛda shɛm puuni, amaa tinim lee pahila yi zuɣu n-tumdi yi suhupiɛlli nyabu zuɣu.
en: I dont mean that we are trying to control your faith. You are strong in faith. But we are workers with you for your own happiness.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Jɛrusalɛmnim mini Judanim daa chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi pam hal ka o ti kari ba o sani. Zɛdɛkia daa nyɛla ŋun zaɣisi Babilɔn naa noli.
en: Terrible things happened to the people of Jerusalem and Judah because the Lord was angry with them. Finally, he threw them out of his presence. Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

dag: Yi yi chana, yin yihimiya waazu yɛra, Alizanda nam mirina.
en: As you go, make this announcement: The kingdom of heaven has come near.

dag: Di simdi ka yi niŋ alɔbo shɛŋa mini jɛŋgbar shɛb bɛn bahi yi tiŋgbani ŋɔ yoli maa kɔtomsi, ka di lan simdi ni yi ti Izraɛlnim Naawuni maa jilima, di pa shɛli o ku lan darigi yi mini yi buɣa ni yi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tibili yaha.
en: You must make images of your tumors and the mice that have devastated the land. Honor Israels God. Perhaps he will lighten the weight of his hand on you, your gods, and your land.

dag: Yisa so bɛ ni lan booni Justus la gba puhiri ya. Niriba ata ŋɔ kɔŋko n-nyɛ Yɛhudianim bɛn nyɛ n tumtumditaba Naawuni nam zuɣu; bɛ nyɛla bɛn kpaŋsiri n suhu pam.
en: And greetings from Jesus, the one who is also called Justus. These are the only Jewish believers who work with me for Gods kingdom. They have been a great comfort to me.

dag: Liya ni daa nya ka o bi lan dɔɣiri maa, ka o daa zaŋ o dab bipuɣiŋga Zilipa ti Yaakubu ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: When Leah realized that she had stopped bearing children, she took her servant Zilpah and gave her to Jacob as his wife.

dag: Bɛ nini maa ni ka Yisa niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu daa taɣi, ka o ninni nyaɣisiri kaman wuntaŋ la, ka o binyɛrigu mi paligi paratɛte kaman gol la;.
en: There in front of the disciples, Jesus was completely changed. His face was shining like the sun, and his clothes became white as light.

dag: ka nya ka gɔhi n-kul zooi lim li; ka yihim lan zibigi di ni, ka di kuɣa gooni lu n-doya.
en: Thorns grew all over it; weeds covered the ground, and the stone wall was falling down.

dag: Yi lo nia shɛŋa din ka buchi, yimaŋmaŋ vuhim ni ŋmaligi din ya kaman buɣim la.
en: Your deeds are straw that will be set on fire by your very own breath.

dag: O daa chɛ ka Ijiptinim suhuri je o niriba maa, ka chɛ ka bɛ doli yɛmbimbiɛri soli n-nahim o daba maa.
en: He made the Egyptians hate his people and treat his servants with deceit.

dag: Ka o ti zaŋ ba ka Yawɛ sanna Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol la ni nti ti maligumaana, ka o yih o daɣiri ni dabisi shɛli din pahiri daba anii dali.
en: On the eighth day of your purification you shall bring them to the priest at the entrance of the Tent.

dag: Di saha zaŋ chana, ka Gomna Pailɛt daa lo nia ni o bahi Yisa, amaa ka Yɛhudianim maa kuhi yɛl o, A yi bahi doo ŋɔ a pala Naa Siiza sima, dama ŋunkam zaŋ omaŋ leei naa lola Naa Siiza zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Then Pilate wanted to set Jesus free. But the crowd again yelled, If you set this man free, you are no friend of the Emperor! Anyone who claims to be a king is an enemy of the Emperor.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛl o nyaandoliba maa, Yi yi yuri ma, yi ni doli n zaligunima.
en: If you love me, you will keep my commandments.

dag: Ka Barak daa kari doli chɛchɛbunsi maa mini tɔbbihi maa hal ni Harɔshɛtihagɔim nti ku Sisɛra tɔbbihi maa zaa hal ka bɛ ni yino gba bi tiligi.
en: Barak's forces went after Sisera's chariots and army as far as Harosheth-Ha-Goiim. Sisera's entire army was wiped out.

dag: Nyama, n chɛ ka a nini kpɛma n-gari bɛ nini ni kpɛm shɛm, ka chɛ ka a suhu kpɛma n-gari bɛ suhuri ni kpɛm shɛm.
en: Ive now hardened your face so that you can meet them head-on.

dag: Ka Aduna min o bidibisi maa daa niŋ Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Musa zali ba ni bɛ niŋ shɛlikam zaa maa.
en: Aaron and his sons obeyed everything that the Lord had told Moses they must do.

dag: Di saha ka Sintani daa garigi bɔhi Yawɛ, Ayuba Naawuni zɔbo maa nyɛla yoli?.
en: Satan replied, Would Job worship you if he got nothing out of it?.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Aduna.
en: The LORD said to Aaron.

dag: N ni gbilisi tibili labila yɛtɔɣ ŋaha polo, ka ŋme mɔɣilo n-kahigi di gbinni wuhi.
en: I will pay close attention to a proverb; I will explain my riddle on the lyre.

dag: Ka Dauda daa piligi Milikom zuɣupiligu o zuɣu ni, ka nya ka di tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram pihitanaanahi, ka kuɣ viɛla be di ni. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ li pili Dauda, ka o daa va bɛ ni daa tuhi di neen shɛŋa tiŋ maa ni pam kuli.
en: The Ammonite idol Molech had a gold crown which weighed about seventy-five pounds. In it there was a jewel, which David took and put in his own crown. He also took a large amount of loot from the city.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, di chɛ ka paɣ so lan zali pua di yuŋ maa yaha. Di chɛ ka so lan wum suhupiɛlli vuri di ni yaha.
en: May that night be childless; may no happy singing come in it.

dag: Miri ka a zaŋ amaŋ pahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyuri wain pam zuɣu bee n-zaŋ amaŋ pahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri ye nimdi ŋubbu zuɣu;.
en: Dont make friends with people who drink too much wine and eat too much food.

dag: Rubin zuliya mini Gaad zuliya ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili bɛn la bɛn daa pun deei bɛ tarili. Yawɛ dabili Musa n-daa pun pirigi tiŋgbɔn shɛli din be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo la ti ba.
en: Moses had already given land east of the Jordan River to the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and half of Manasseh.

dag: Ka wuntaŋ daa ti miri lubu ka bɛ ŋme kuŋ yɛli Izraɛl tɔbbihi, Sokam lab kul o ya o tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: As the sun was going down, someone in Israel's army shouted to the others, Retreat! Go back home.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa zo n-chaŋ Nɔb nti chaŋ Ahimɛlɛk ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana la sani. Ka Ahimɛlɛk daa kana ti tuhi Dauda soli ka o niŋ sɔhira; ka o bɔhi Dauda, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a kɔŋko ka kpe na, ka so bi dol a na.
en: David went to see Ahimelech, a priest who lived in the town of Nob. Ahimelech was trembling with fear as he came out to meet David. Why are you alone? Ahimelech asked. Why isn't anyone else with you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Ɛshikol vinvamli, Izraɛlnim ni daa ŋmaai tiwala yilli nimaani maa zuɣu.
en: That place was named Eshcol Valley because of the bunch of grapes the Israelites cut off there.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni zaŋ ya tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni n-labi yi ni bi mi tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni, ka yi yaannim gba daa bi mi li, ka yi ti jɛmdi wun shɛŋa nimaani yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni, dama n ku zɔn ya nambɔɣu. .
en: I will throw you out of this country. I will force you to go to a foreign land. You will go to a land that you and your ancestors never knew. There you can serve false gods all you want to. I will not help you or show you any favors.

dag: Speen ŋariŋduhiriba, kummiya ka chɛ ka nandahima mali ya, dama bɛ saɣim yi birininima.
en: So be sad, you ships from Tarshish. Your place of safety has been destroyed.

dag: Yinim Izraɛlnima, wummiya, zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka yi yɛn gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ du n-chaŋ ti deei zuliya shɛb bɛn galisi ka mali yaa gari ya fɔntin shɛŋa bɛ ni me goma gili hal ka di ti tɔri sagbana.
en: Listen, you Israelites! You will go across the Jordan River today. You will go into that land to force out nations greater and stronger than you. Their cities are big and have walls as high as the sky!.

dag: N yɛri ya mi, Anabi Ilaija pun kana, ka bɛ daa niŋ o bɛ suhu ni yu shɛm kaman di ni daa sab o yɛla shɛm la.
en: I tell you that Elijah has already come. And people did to him all the bad things they wanted to do. The Scriptures said this would happen to him.

dag: Wuntia puuni ka a daa zal a zaligunim maa ni ʒiɛyimtali zaa.
en: The laws you commanded are righteous, completely trustworthy.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Bɛ yi kanimina ni bɛ ti tuhi ti bee bɛ yi kanimina ni bɛ ti niŋ sandaani niŋ ti yin gbahimiya ba zaɣ nɛma.
en: He ordered, Take them alive, no matter whether they are coming to fight or to ask for peace.

dag: Man ŋuna, n tɔŋbu puuni, n daa yɛliya, Shɛli ku tooi nyaŋ ma.
en: When I was safe and secure, I thought nothing could hurt me.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ, Ŋuni n-lee mali kpiɔŋ paai nyin Yawɛ? A ʒiɛyimtali kul gilila a luɣilikam zaa.
en: Lord God All-Powerful, there is no one like you. You are strong, Lord , and always faithful.

dag: Gol so ŋun pah ayopɔin maa biɛɣ pinaanu dali, yin laɣimmiya jɛm Naawuni, ka di tumiya tuun shɛli, ka zaŋya daba ayopɔin puhi Yawɛ chuɣu.
en: Beginning on the fifteenth day of the seventh month and continuing for seven days, everyone must celebrate the Festival of Shelters in honor of me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ fɔŋ maa ni nti shiri nya Yisa ni yɛli ba shɛm maa zaa, ka mali Yaɣigari Chuɣu maa bindirigu dibu shili.
en: They went and found everything just as he had told them, and they prepared the Passover meal.

dag: Di nyaaŋa di daa bi yuui ka Yisa chani tin shɛli din yuli booni Nain la; ka o nyaandoliba mini salo pam dol o.
en: Soon afterward Jesus went to a town named Nain, accompanied by his disciples and a large crowd.

dag: Sana yi be yi sani, yin zaŋmiy o leei tiŋbia yi sani, ka yur o kaman yimaŋmaŋ la. Dama yi gba daa nyɛla saamba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Treat them as you would an Israelite, and love them as you love yourselves. Remember that you were once foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.

dag: O yee daa kpɛm pam ka o bi zɔri vi. O daa bi ʒiini yiŋa.
en: She was a wild and rebellious woman who would not stay at home.

dag: Ka Hatak daa chaŋ Mɔdɛkai sani tiŋ puuni pal shɛli din daa miri nayili dunol la shee.
en: Hathach went to Mordecai in the city square at the entrance of the palace.

dag: Ka dunia ŋɔ mini di kore nyɛla din garita, amaa ŋunkam tumdi Naawuni yubu kul ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: The world and everything in it that people desire is passing away; but those who do the will of God live forever.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali nandahima mal alibarika, dama Naawuni ni ti maai bɛ suhuri.
en: Happy are people who grieve, because they will be made glad.

dag: O doonila gɔtihi gbin ni, ka baa ni kaɣili lims o.
en: He lies under the lotuses, under the cover of reed and marsh.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa tim ti boli Shimɛi na nti yɛl o, Mɛm a yili Jɛrusalɛm ŋɔ n-ʒi kpe, ka miri ka a yi kpe n-chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam.
en: Then the king sent for Shimei and said to him, Build a house for yourself here in Jerusalem. Live in it and don't leave the city.

dag: Ti chaŋya ka duu maa dunoya zaa kparimi kirikiri, ka dansarika guliba ʒe dunoya ni gu, amaa ka ti kparigi ka bi nya so duu maa ni.
en: When we arrived at the jail, we found it locked up tight and all the guards on watch at the gates; but when we opened the gates, we found no one inside.

dag: Di saha maa ka Kalidianim shɛb daa nya soli ni bɛ doli fiɣisi Yɛhudianima.
en: Then some of the Chaldeans came up to the king and began speaking against the people from Judah.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa garigi paɣ maa ni bɔh o bɔhigu shɛŋa zaa; ka shɛli daa kani ka naa kɔŋ li kahigi wuh o.
en: Solomon answered all her questions; nothing was too difficult for him to answer.

dag: Pa Dauda so yɛla bɛ ni wari waa ka yiini yila yɛra, Sool kula niriba tuhilituhili, ka Dauda mi ku niriba tuhi piapia la m-bala? .
en: After all, this is David, the one about whom the women sang, as they danced, Saul has killed thousands, but David has killed tens of thousands.

dag: Amaa ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi me duu ti o, dama alizanda mini di galisim zaa ku saɣ o? Ka m mi lee nyɛ ŋuni nti mɛri duu tir o? N kul yɛn mɛla luɣ shɛli n ni yɛn tuɣindi tulaale zim o tooni.
en: No one can ever build a temple large enough for God—even the heavens are too small a place for him to live in! All I can do is build a place where we can offer sacrifices to him.

dag: Ŋuna n-saɣindi yɛmbimbiɛrinim ni lo nia ni bɛ tum tuun shɛli, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ nuhi bi diri nasara.
en: He spoils the plans of even the smartest people so that they will not succeed.

dag: Amaa o yɛla ni ti niŋ niriba pam alahiziba ka nanim ti kɔŋ bɛ noya yaabu o zuɣu. Dama bɛ nini ni ti nya bɛ ni daa bi yɛli ba shɛli yɛla; ka baŋ bɛ ni daa pun bi wum shɛli yɛla.
en: But he will astonish many nations. Kings will be silenced because of him, because they will see what they havent seen before; what they havent heard before, they will ponder.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ, a mi ma; a nyari ma, ka buɣisiri ma, ka n suhu bela a ni. Vom ba yihina kaman piɛri ka bɛ vɔri ni bɛ ti kɔrigi la. Woligim ba zali gu kɔrigibu dali.
en: But you know, Lord , how faithful I've always been, even in my thoughts. So drag my enemies away and butcher them like sheep!.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim ni ti yili yila ni suhupiɛlli; ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be wulinluhili polo ti yɛli Yawɛ ni galisi shɛm yɛla.
en: People in the west shout; they joyfully praise the majesty of the Lord .

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim pala ti ni niriba; lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa yi ti ni. Bɛ yi di daa nyɛla ti ni niriba, bɛ daa naan kpalim be ti sani. Amaa bɛ daa yi ti ni ni di kahigi wuhi ni bɛ zaa pala bɛn be ti ni.
en: These people came from our own group, yet they were not really part of us. If they had been part of us, they would have stayed with us. But they left, which proves they did not belong to our group.

dag: O ni daa mali binzahi pia maa shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: O daa mali di zaa ŋ-ŋmahindila taba n-chɛ ka di buɣisibu nyɛ yim, ka di biɛhigu gba nyɛ yim.
en: In this manner he made ten stands, each one cast in a single mold of the same size and shape.

dag: Ka Dauda niriba maa daa ti nya Ijipti nachimbil so mɔɣu maa ni n-zaŋ o ka Dauda sanna nti ti o bɔrɔbɔro ka o ŋubi, ka ti o kom ka o nyu.
en: The men with David found a young Egyptian out in the country and brought him to David. They gave him some food and water.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa yi be zibisim ni yipa nya neesim titali. Bɛn daa be zibisim tital ni, neesim neei paai ba.
en: The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light. They lived in a land of shadows, but now light is shining on them.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa nam saŋmar shɛb bɛn laɣim be ka bɛ booni ba Gbuɣinli la mini saŋmar shɛb bɛn laɣim be ka bɛ booni ba Jɛŋgbini la, ni saŋmaribihi shɛba bɛ ni booni Gbiŋgbiŋ min o bihi bɛn nyɛ nudirigu polo saŋmarisi la.
en: God hung the stars in the sky—the Dipper, Orion, the Pleiades, and the stars of the south.

dag: Dinzuɣu di nyɛnya jɛra, amaa bomiya baŋ ti Duuma yubu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: So dont be foolish with your lives, but learn what the Lord wants you to do.

dag: Fɔndi ŋɔ mini di tiŋkpansi maa zaa daa bela Isaka zuliya ni daa deei tiŋgban shɛli, ka di leei bɛ dini kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm maa ni.
en: These cities and their towns were in the land which the families of the tribe of Issachar received as their possession.

dag: N ni ti je suli niŋ a, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ suhuyiɣisili pam lu a zuɣu. Bɛ ni ti ŋmah a nyee min a tiba, ka zaŋ takɔbi ku a bi shɛb bɛn kpalim. Bɛ ni ti gbah a bidibisi min a bipuɣinsi nti zaŋ ba zaɣ nɛma nyo buɣim.
en: I will direct my passion against you, and they will deal with you in wrath. They will cut off your nose and ears, and those who are left will fall by the sword. They will seize your sons and daughters, and those who are left will be burned with fire.

dag: Yisa ni daa nya ka bɛ niŋ o yɛda shɛm maa ka o yɛli bar maa, Zɔri, n chɛ a daalahichi paŋ a.
en: When Jesus saw how much faith they had, he said to the man, Your sins are forgiven, my friend.

dag: ka Hɔshaya bia Azaria mini Karia bia Jɔhanan ni ninvuɣ yoya la zaa daa yɛli Jɛrimia, A ŋmala ʒiri, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ bi tim a na ni a ti yɛli ti, Di chaŋya Ijipti ti ʒini nimaani.
en: Azariah, Hoshaiahs son, and Johanan, Kareahs son, and all the arrogant men said to Jeremiah, Youre lying to us! The LORD our God didnt send you to tell us not to go to Egypt to live.

dag: N kul bela zibisim ni chana ka wuntaŋ kani; ka n ʒe kpamba laɣiŋgu ni n-kuhiri bɔri sɔŋsim.
en: My days are dark and gloomy and in the city council I stand and cry out.

dag: N kɔŋko ku tooi gbibi niriba ŋɔ zaa, dama bɛ galisi nyaŋ ma.
en: I cannot take care of all these people alone. The burden is too heavy for me.

dag: Ka yi ninvuɣ yino kam karitimi doli ninvuɣ tuhili ka bɛ ŋmaligiri guura, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni tuhiri ba tiri ya kaman o ni daa pun lɔn ya alikauli shɛm la zuɣu.
en: A single one of you puts a thousand to flight. This is because the LORD your God fights for you, exactly as he promised you.

dag: O ni daa kul nya ba, ka o kɔre kpe bɛ ni, ka o tim tuumba bɛ sani Kalidia tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: As soon as she saw them, she was filled with lust and sent messengers to them in Babylonia.

dag: Dinzuɣu baŋmiya ni Naawuni pun tahi tiliginsim yɛligu ŋɔ bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani, ka bɛ mi nyɛla bɛn ni wum li. .
en: I want you Jews to know that God has sent his salvation to the non-Jewish people. They will listen.

dag: Dama buɣim daa yi Hɛshibɔn na, ka buɣim niɛm daa yi Sihɔn fɔŋ ni na. Di daa di Ar din be Mɔab la, ka di Arinɔn zoya zuɣu.
en: Fire went out from Heshbon, flame from Sihons city. It consumed Ar of Moab and swallowed up the shrines of the Arnon.

dag: Yisa daa na bi paai Bɛtani tiŋ puuni; o daa na kul bela Maata ni tuh o soli luɣ shɛli maa.
en: Jesus had not yet arrived in the village, but was still in the place where Martha had met him.

dag: Samuɛl ni daa ti kurigi, o daa zaŋla o bidibisi n-leei Izraɛlnim zuɣulaannima.
en: Samuel had two sons. The older one was Joel, and the younger one was Abijah. When Samuel was getting old, he let them be leaders at Beersheba.

dag: Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bi baŋdi n yɛligu gbinni? Yi ni bi deeri n yɛligu maa zuɣu n-chɛ ka yi bi baŋdi di gbinni maa.
en: Why can't you understand what I am talking about? Can't you stand to hear what I am saying?.

dag: Nabɔt ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛziriil nir la daa mal o wain tihi puu Jɛziriil, ka di miri Samaria Naa Ɛhab yiŋa.
en: Near King Ahab's palace in Jezreel there was a vineyard owned by a man named Naboth.

dag: kul gbaai yihila bin yin shɛli n ni daa zani bɛ sani kuhi yɛl la. N daa yɛlimi, Kpiimba kum ni neebu yɛla zuɣu ka yi kariti ma saria zuŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: I did say one thing when I stood before them and shouted, You are judging me today because I believe that people will rise from death.

dag: Bɛ ni daa dɔɣi Yisa Bɛtilihɛm Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni Naa Hɛrɔd saha la ka baŋdib shɛb daa yi wulimpuhili polo ka Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: Jesus was born in the town of Bethlehem in Judea, during the time when Herod was king. Soon afterward, some men who studied the stars came from the East to Jerusalem.

dag: Nyamiya, maligumaaniba ni ʒi dunia zaa Duuma Daalikauli Adaka maa n-gari yi tooni chaŋ ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du.
en: The Box of the Agreement of the Lord of the whole world will go before you as you cross the Jordan River.

dag: Ka Sintani lan zaŋ o chaŋ nti du zo shɛli din du pam zuɣu n-wuh o dunia ŋɔ nama mini di jilima zaa.
en: Then the Devil took Jesus to a very high mountain and showed him all the kingdoms of the world in all their greatness.

dag: ka o daa chaŋ ni o ti tuhi Asa soli, ka yɛl o, Nyin Naa Asa mini Juda zuliya ni Bɛnjamin zuliya zaa, wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ, yi yi kul be Naawuni sani, o gba ni be yi sani. Yi yi bo o, yi ni nya o. Amaa yi yi zaɣis o, o gba ni zaɣisi ya.
en: he confronted Asa: Listen to me, Asa and all Judah and Benjamin, he said. The LORD is with you as long as you are with him. If you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you abandon him, he will abandon you.

dag: dama dina n-viɛla, ka nyɛ din tiɣiri Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira ŋɔ nini.
en: This is good and pleases God our Savior.

dag: Ka Napaɣ Ɛsta ŋun daa nyɛ Abiheel bia la daa pahi Mɔdɛkai zuɣu ka bɛ sab gban shɛli din pah ayi zaŋ chaŋ Purim chuɣu puhibu maa yɛla polo.
en: Queen Esther, daughter of Abihail, wanted to give full authority to Mordecai's letter about the Festival of Purim, and with his help she wrote a letter about the feast.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, N ni lab Ziɔn na nti be Jɛrusalɛm, ka bɛ ni ti booni Jɛrusalɛm la yɛlimaŋli tiŋa; ka boli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ zol la, zoli din be kasi.
en: The Lord says, I have come back to Zion, and I am living in Jerusalem. Jerusalem will be called Faithful City. The mountain of the Lord All-Powerful will be called Holy Mountain.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ ni wuhi ya o yurilim min o ʒiɛyimtali ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ yi sani; ka man gba ni niŋ ya zaɣ viɛlli yi ni daa tum tuun shɛli maa zuɣu.
en: May the LORD now show you loyal love and faithfulness. I myself will also reward you because you did this.

dag: Bɛ daa piripirila taba, ka zuliya ŋɔ tuhiri zuliya ŋɔ, ka tiŋ ŋɔ nim mi tuhiri tiŋ ŋɔ nima, dama Naawuni n-daa chɛ ka suhugarigu balibu kam ŋɔ paai ba.
en: Nation was crushed by nation and city by city, as God troubled them with every kind of problem.

dag: Di saha Yawɛ shia ni siɣi a zuɣu na pam, ka a pahi bɛ zuɣu n-tɔɣisir anabitali yɛtɔɣa ka a biɛhigu taɣi.
en: The Spirit of the Lord will suddenly take control of you. You'll become a different person and start prophesying right along with them.

dag: Ka ti Duuma malaika daa ti puhi yi bɛ zuɣu, ka ti Duuma jilima neesim neei gil ba ka dabiɛm kpe ba pam.
en: All at once an angel came down to them from the Lord, and the brightness of the Lord's glory flashed around them. The shepherds were frightened.

dag: Ka n daa wum kukol tital shɛli damli ka di yɛri nam ʒiishee maa gbini, Nyama, Naawuni biɛhigu shee bela ninsalinim sani. Ka o ni be bɛ sani, ka bɛ nyɛ o niriba, ka ŋun Naawuni maŋmaŋ mi ni be bɛ sani n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni;.
en: I heard a loud voice from the throne say, Look! Gods dwelling is here with humankind. He will dwell with them, and they will be his peoples. God himself will be with them as their God.

dag: Ka doo maa daa ti yiɣisi asibaasi n-yooi dunoli ni o yina chaŋ, ka nya ka o mam maa dola yil maa samban dunol ni, ka o nuhi teei tiri dunoli polo.
en: Her husband got up that morning, and when he opened the door to go on his way, he found his concubine lying in front of the house with her hands reaching for the door.

dag: Ka di yi kahigi wuhi bɛn ʒiya maa ni so ni o wuhi shɛli, yin chɛliya ka ŋun tuui tɔɣisirila fo;.
en: And if a message from God comes to someone who is sitting, the first speaker should be quiet.

dag: M mi ni a ni chɛ ka n kpi n-kuli yili shɛli a ni zaŋ zali nyɛvililan kam la ni.
en: I know you will return me to death, the house appointed for all the living.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim daa muɣisiri ba ka bɛ tumdi tuun kpɛma.
en: So the Egyptians made them work even harder.

dag: Ka Yaakubu suhu daa yu Reechɛl ka o yɛli, N ni tum tuma yuma ayopɔin ti a, Reechɛl ŋun nyɛ a bipuɣiŋga biasani ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Jacob loved Rachel and said, I will work for you for seven years for Rachel, your younger daughter.

dag: ni Yirɔn ni Migidalɛl ni Hɔrɛm ni Bɛtanat ni Bɛtishɛmɛshi: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔntiŋ kara pisiyinika m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Iron, Migdal-el, Horem, Beth-anath, and Beth-shemesh; in total: nineteen cities and their surrounding areas.

dag: amaa sara maligu maa nimdi yi zani hal ni daba ata, bɛn zaŋm li nyo buɣim.
en: But whatever is left over of the flesh of the communal sacrifice on the third day must be burned with fire.

dag: Timiya ba jilima, ka yuri ba pam bɛ ni tumdi tuun shɛli maa zuɣu; ka maliya suhudoo ni taba.
en: Show them the highest respect and love because of the work they do. Live in peace with each other.

dag: ka kuhi pam kaman gbuɣinli ni yi ŋum shɛm la. O ni daa kuhi maa, ka satahins ayopɔin tahi.
en: and called out in a loud voice that sounded like the roar of lions. After he had called out, the seven thunders answered with a roar.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti nya o ka bɛ jɛm o; amaa ka bɛ ni shɛb biɛhim o.
en: When they saw him, they worshiped him, even though some of them doubted.

dag: Ninvuɣ Suŋ ni ŋun lan nyɛ wuntialana ka yi daa zaɣisi maa, ka daa lee chɛ ka Gomna Pailɛt yihila ŋun kuri niriba bahi.
en: You rejected Jesus, who was holy and good. You asked for a murderer to be set free.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, Nyama, n zaŋ Jɛriko mini di naa ni di tɔbbi biinsi niŋ yi nuu ni.
en: Then the Lord said to Joshua, Look, I will let you defeat the city of Jericho. You will defeat the king and all the fighting men in the city.

dag: Ka Dauda daa piripiri ba kaman Lɛvi bidibisi ni daa nyɛ shɛm: Gɛrishɔn mini Kɔhat ni Mɛrari daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: David separated the Levites into three groups. They were the tribes of Levis three sons, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

dag: Ŋuna n-fari ninkura yɛm ka mali ba chana; ka chɛ ka sariakaritiba leeri jɛra.
en: God shames counselors, turns judges into fools.

dag: Amaa ka yuŋ daa ti paai ka o zaŋla o bipuɣiŋga Liya nti ti Yaakubu ka o zaŋ o niŋ o paɣa.
en: But that night, instead of Rachel, he took Leah to Jacob, and Jacob had intercourse with her. .

dag: Ka Yisa daa yi nimaani n-chaŋ Taai mini Sidɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Jesus left and went to the territory near the towns of Tyre and Sidon.

dag: O chɛ ka sakuɣa luri nahiri tiŋgbani m-be kaman gbaŋ ka bɛ yɛrigi sɔŋ la. O chɛ ka gulisigu be kaman taŋkpaɣu la n-gili luɣilikam.
en: He covers the ground with snow like a blanket of wool, and he scatters frost like ashes on the ground.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa yɛli Yisifu, A ba min a biɛyanim kul a sanna.
en: Pharaoh said to Joseph, Since your father and brothers have arrived.

dag: Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi anabi Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣa zaŋ chaŋ Ɛlamnim polo Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia nam dibu piligu ni.
en: Early in the time when Zedekiah was king of Judah, Jeremiah the prophet received a message from the Lord about the nation of Elam.

dag: Dinzuɣu Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi maa ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi zaɣisi n yɛligu ka dolila kiŋkansi mini yɔhiŋ soli, ka niŋ li naani.
en: Now this is the answer of the holy One of Israel: You rejected my message, and you trust in violence and lies.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa nyɛla bɛn nyɛ daɣiri bina yi sani binnɛma bɛn gbamdi tiŋgbani ni maa puuni, ka ŋunkam shihi bɛ zaɣ kpiŋ ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: Of all small moving creatures, these are unclean for you—anyone who touches them when they are dead will be unclean until evening.

dag: Bɛ yi ti gbahi tinvura bee n-nyu binshɛli din nyɛ lɔɣu, di ku niŋ ba shɛli; ka bɛ ni ti zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa barinim zuɣu ka bɛ kpaŋ.
en: if they pick up snakes or drink any poison, they will not be harmed; they will place their hands on sick people, and these will get well.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba shɛb bɛ ni daa zaŋ yi Samaria chaŋ maa ni yino daa labi nti ʒini Bɛtɛl n-wuhiri ba Yawɛ jɛmbu.
en: So one of the priests who the Assyrians had carried away from Samaria came to live in Bethel. He taught the people how they should honor the Lord .

dag: bee so ti yɛli, Nyamiya, di be kpe! Bee n-yɛli, Di be kpe ha! Dama Naawuni nam maa be yi sunsuuni pumpɔŋɔ.
en: People will not say, Look, Gods kingdom is here! or There it is! No, Gods kingdom is here with you. .

dag: Di saha ka Ayuba daa garigi yɛli.
en: Job said to his friends:.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka o yɛligu paai Hanani bia Jɛhu zaŋ chaŋ Baasha polo yɛli.
en: Then the Lord spoke against King Baasha through the prophet, Jehu son of Hanani. He said.

dag: Ka bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa niriba zaa daa mali suhupiɛlli, ka bɛ tiŋ maa daa maai bɛ ni daa zaŋ takɔb ku Atalia nayili puuni maa nyaaŋa.
en: All the people were happy, and the city was peaceful. And Queen Athaliah was killed with a sword near the kings palace.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ kpa nudirigu polo ti di, amaa ka kum na kul mali ba. Bɛ ni ti lan zaŋ kpa nuzaa polo ti di, amaa ka ku tiɣi. Hal bɛ ni ti zaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ bihi gba leei bindirigu.
en: like wild animals attacking and eating everyone around them, even their own relatives. But still they were not satisfied.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ salim shɛli zaa na ti mali sara ka bɛ zaŋ li tum tuma luɣ kasi shee la tibisim daa nyɛla kilɔgiram tuhili kaman luɣ kasi shee sania zahimbu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: All the gold that had been dedicated to the Lord for the sacred Tent weighed , pounds, weighed according to the official standard.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daba ayi ha, ka Samsin chaŋ ni o ti puh o paɣ maa alikama chɛbu saha, ka ʒi bubil polli mali ni o ti ti o paɣ maa. Ka Samsin daa ti yɛl o paɣ maa ba, N ni kpe m paɣ sani. Amaa ka o paɣ ba maa bi saɣi;.
en: Later, during the wheat harvest, Samson went to visit the young woman he thought was still his wife. He brought along a young goat as a gift and said to her father, I want to go into my wife's bedroom. You can't do that, he replied.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti zaŋ bukɔbiri wuɣi tani n-zaŋ pili m biɛhigu shee maa. Wuɣimiya li tan tolima piniyini.
en: As the material for protecting the tent, use goat hair to weave eleven sections of cloth meters by meters each.

dag: Yɛlim Sulemaana bia Naa Rɛhɔbɔam ŋun nyɛ Juda naa la mini Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn be Juda mini Bɛnjamin tiŋgbana ni la.
en: to tell Rehoboam and everyone from Judah and Benjamin.

dag: Ka dindali maa nasara dibu suhupiɛlli maa daa leela suhugarigu dabisili Naa Dauda tɔbbihi maa sani; dama bɛ daa wumya ni naa kumdila o bia maa kuli.
en: So the joy of victory turned to sadness for everyone. It was a very sad day because the people heard, The king is mourning for his son.

dag: Ka Babilɔn naa maa daa ku Zɛdɛkia bidibisi mini Juda kpambaliba zaa o ninni Ribila maa.
en: There, at the town of Riblah, the king of Babylon killed Zedekiahs sons while Zedekiah watched. The king of Babylon also killed all the royal officials of Judah.

dag: Firilatamdigu mini di tuma nɛma ni firilanima ni firila kpam.
en: the lamp with its equipment and oil;.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa kum Musa kuli Mɔabnim bɔpiɛligu maa ni hal ni biɛɣu pihita, di nyaaŋa ka Musa kuli maa kumbu daa naai.
en: The Israelites cried for Moses for days. They stayed in the Jordan Valley in Moab until the time of sadness was finished.

dag: ka Mɔza daa nyɛ Binia ba; ka Binia nyɛ Rɛfaya ba, ka Rafaya nyɛ Ɛliasa ba, ka Ɛliasa nyɛ.
en: Moza the father of Binea, Binea of Rephaiah, Rephaiah of Eleasah, and Eleasah of Azel.

dag: ka tum birigi n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi maa, ka bi doli n zalikpana la.
en: if they treat my statutes like dirt, stop keeping my commandments.

dag: Yawɛ yɛlila noli niŋ ninvuɣ biɛri yinsi, amaa o niŋdi alibarika niŋdi wuntizɔriba biɛhigu shee.
en: The LORDs curse is on the house of the wicked, but he blesses the home of the righteous.

dag: Bɔhimiya pumpɔŋɔ n-nya doo ni tooi dɔɣi bia? Ka bɔzuɣu ka n nya ka doo kam zaŋ o nuhi tab o saɣiŋga ni kaman paɣa n-wolisiri la? Bɔ n-niŋ ka sokam saɣim o ninni?.
en: Ask this question and consider it: Can a man have a baby? Of course not! Then why do I see every strong man holding his stomach like a woman having labor pains? Why is everyones face turning white like a dead man?.

dag: Wuntaŋ daa kul wɔbiri ma mi dabisili kam, ka wari mi kpɛri ma yuŋ, ka n gaani gom.
en: In the daytime the sun took away my strength, and at night sleep was taken from my eyes by the cold.

dag: Ka sakuɣa maa daa saɣim bɛ mihi mini bɛ chi zaa, dama bɛ chi maa daa bimi ka mihi maa pum puma.
en: The flax and the barley were ruined, because the barley was ripe, and the flax was budding.

dag: O ni dihi bɛn je a vi, ka ninvuɣ biɛri yiŋ ti ku lan beni.
en: Those who hate you will be clothed with shame, and the tent of the wicked will vanish.

dag: Ka ti yi mi ni ti yi suh o shɛlikam o deeri ti suhigu, dindina ti mi ni o tiri ti ti ni suhir o shɛlikam.
en: He hears us whenever we ask him; and since we know this is true, we know also that he gives us what we ask from him.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa tam Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋun daa tiligi ba bɛ dimnim bɛn gili bɛ luɣilikam zaa nuu ni la yɛla.
en: and no longer served the Lord their God, who had saved them from all their enemies around them.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti wummi tin ya n-tum tuumbiɛ titali ŋɔ, ka yi ti Naawuni nyaaŋa kpuɣi tinzun paɣiba maa.
en: So we will obey you and not rebel against our God by marrying foreign women.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa chɛ ka yɔɣili bili gara maa gbini n-zooi du nti pani gara maa zuɣusaa n-niŋ mahim ni Jona ʒi di lɔŋni ka o ni maha. Ka yɔɣili maa ni daa du m-pa Jona zuɣusaa shɛm maa niŋ o nyaɣisim pam.
en: The Lord made a vine grow up to shade Jonah's head and protect him from the sun. Jonah was very happy to have the vine.

dag: Amaa yi zuɣu ka n daa ku Amɔrinima daa wɔɣawɔɣa kaman sida tihi, ka mali yaa kaman oki tihi la. N daa ku bɛ mini bɛ bihi zaa.
en: Israel, the Amorites were there when you entered Canaan. They were tall as cedars and strong as oaks. But I wiped them out— I destroyed their branches and their roots.

dag: Di saha ka Balak daa yɛli Balaam, A yi ku yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi bɛ zuɣu hal baabiɛla, nyin di niŋ alibarika gba niŋ bɛ ni hal baabiɛla.
en: Then Balak said to Balaam, You didnt ask for good things to happen to these people, but you didnt ask for bad things to happen to them either.

dag: Yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, ka simdi ni nir dee li zaa. Dina n-nyɛ: Yisa Masia daa ka dunia ŋɔ ni na ni o ti tiligila alahichinima; mani mi n-nyɛ alahichilana n-gari sokam.
en: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners. This saying is true, and it can be trusted. I was the worst sinner of all!.

dag: Di pala timaŋmaŋ yɛla waazu ka ti yihiri ya, amaa Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma la yɛla waazu ka ti yihiri maa, ka wuhiri ya ni timaŋmaŋ mi nyɛla yi daba ŋun Yisa zuɣu.
en: For it is not ourselves that we preach; we preach Jesus Christ as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus' sake.

dag: N dɔɣiriba mini n zɔnim zoya ka chɛ ma.
en: My visitors have ceased; those who know me have forgotten me.

dag: O dimnim ku tooi nyaŋ o; putɔɣunim mi ku tooi filim o.
en: No enemy will oppress him; no wicked person will make him suffer.

dag: Ka Ribɛka min o dab bipuɣinsi daa yiɣisi m-ba laakumnima n-doli nachin kpɛm maa ka o zaŋ o lu yiŋ soli.
en: Then Rebekah and her nurse got on the camels and followed the servant and his men. So the servant took Rebekah and left.

dag: yin yɛlimiya: Ti yab daa nyɛla Aram nira ŋun chani ginda, ka o daa ti chaŋ ti ʒini Ijipti n-nyɛ sana, bɛ kalinli daa bi yaɣi lala. Nimaani ka o zuliya daa ti nabi n-galisi ka mali yaa pam.
en: Then, standing there in front of the place of worship, you must pray: My ancestor was homeless, an Aramean who went to live in Egypt. There were only a few in his family then, but they became great and powerful, a nation of many people.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ buɣisimiya yɛlli ŋɔ: Di simdi ni paɣ suhuri Naawuni ka bi zaŋ bini pil o zuɣu?.
en: Ask yourselves if it is proper for a woman to pray without something on her head.

dag: nti tim nimdi maa ni be ʒɛduɣ shɛli ni maa n-kuhi nimdi maa, ka nim shɛli din doli dirigu maa yina, maligumaana maa n-su li. Lala ka bɛ daa niŋdi Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn daa yi chani Shilo nti maani sara.
en: He would thrust it into the cauldron or the pot. Whatever the fork brought up, the priest would take for himself. This is how it was done for all the Israelites who came to Shiloh.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa chaŋ Bɛtɛl ti bɔhi Naawuni, Ti ni daŋ dini niriba n-simdi ni bɛ daŋ chaŋ ti tuhi Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa? Ka Yawɛ garigi yɛli ba, Juda zuliya niriba n-ni daŋ chaŋ ti tuhi ba.
en: The Israelites went to the place of worship at Bethel, and there they asked God, Which tribe should attack the Benjaminites first? The Lord answered, The tribe of Judah.

dag: Asha tiŋgban ni mi, bɛ daa yihila Mashal mini Abidɔn ni di momaha tiŋgbana.
en: The Gershonites received four towns from the tribe of Asher: Mashal, Abdon, Hukok, and Rehob, including the pastureland around them.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa niŋ alibarika niŋ Nuhu min o bidibisi la ni ka yɛli ba, Dɔɣimiya n-nab pali dunia ŋɔ.
en: God blessed Noah and his sons and said to them, Be fertile, multiply, and fill the earth.

dag: ka n suhu kpe bɛ ni ashilɔni ka n jɛm ba.
en: I have not been led astray to honor them by kissing my hand in reverence to them.

dag: Yila pia shɛŋa mi a ni nya la mini biŋkɔbigu la ni laɣim je pagɔrili maa, bɛ ni bah o yoli zaa hal ka o ti kpalim o zaɣim. Bɛ ni ti dari tɔh o ŋ-ŋubi ka chɛ din kpalim n-zaŋ nyo buɣim.
en: The beast and the ten horns you saw will hate the prostitute. They will take everything she has and leave her naked. They will eat her flesh and destroy her with fire.

dag: N kuhi boli Yawɛ ŋun simdi paɣibu ŋɔ, ka tiligi n dimnim nuu ni.
en: I called to the Lord for help, and he saved me from my enemies! He is worthy of my praise!.

dag: Ka o yɛli, Zaŋm Abishag Shunɛm paɣisarili la ti a biɛli Adɔnija ka o n-niŋ o paɣa.
en: So Bathsheba said, Let your brother Adonijah marry Abishag, the woman from Shunem.

dag: Di saɣimya Naawuni Shia Kasi suhu, dama ŋuna n-nyɛ Naawuni ni zaŋ so dalim ya n-wuhi ni dahin shɛli kanna ka o ni ti fan ya bahi zaa.
en: And do not make God's Holy Spirit sad; for the Spirit is God's mark of ownership on you, a guarantee that the Day will come when God will set you free.

dag: N daa malila suhudoo, ka o pirigi ma buyi, o daa gbaala n nyiŋgol ni n-zaŋ ma ŋme n-chɛrisichɛrisi, ka kul liriti ma.
en: Everything was going well, until God grabbed my neck and shook me to pieces. God set me up as the target.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Yisahaku daa suhi alibarika din ti yɛn kana saha shɛli n-niŋ Yaakubu mini Iso ni.
en: Isaac blessed the future of Jacob and Esau. He did that because he had faith.

dag: Timiy o yuli din be kasi ŋɔ jilima, ka chɛ ka bɛnkam jɛmdi Yawɛ suhuri paligi.
en: Be glad that we belong to him; let all who worship him rejoice!.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, A mini Aduna ni Nadab ni Abihu ni Izraɛl kpamba pisopɔin dumiya zoli ŋɔ n-ka n sanna nti zani kpaŋ jɛm ma.
en: The Lord told Moses, You, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and the elders of Israel must come up the mountain and worship me from a distance.

dag: N yi chɛ a ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa maa taali, di ni chɛ ka a teei di yɛla ka di gar a, ka a ku lan yaag a noli a vi maa zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Then you will remember and be ashamed, and you wont even open your mouth because of your shame, after Ive forgiven you for all that youve done. This is what the LORD God says.

dag: ka ŋun mi bɔri ni o gari yi zaa, ŋun zaŋm omaŋ lee yi zaa ha dabili.
en: And if you want to be first, you must be everyone's slave.

dag: Nahu yi ʒe n-ku so bidibiga bee o bipuɣiŋga yin doliya zaligu ŋɔ.
en: This same law applies if the bull gores someone's son or daughter.

dag: O daa yɛli Dan zuliya: Dan zuliya ŋmanila gbuɣin polli ŋun yiɣi yi Bashan na.
en: About the tribe of Dan he said: Dan is a young lion; He leaps out from Bashan.

dag: Zuɣusaa kahigi Naawuni wuntitali wuhi, dama Naawuni maŋmaŋa n-nyɛ sariakarita.
en: The skies proclaim his righteousness because God himself is the judge. Selah.

dag: Ka o daa saɣisi ba yɛli, Di sabiya, Man Naawuni duu ni boonila zuliya kam wunsuhigu duu. Amaa yinim zaŋ li leela ŋmɛnditoya duu! .
en: He taught them, Hasnt it been written, My house will be called a house of prayer for all nations? But youve turned it into a hideout for crooks .

dag: Dindali maa, maasim bee sakuɣa ti ku beni.
en: When that time comes, there will no longer be cold or frost.

dag: N daa tum tuun maŋli shihira wuhibu tuma yi sani ni suɣilo dibu zaa. Dina n-nyɛ: shihira wuhibu mini alahiziba tumtumsa ni yiko tuma.
en: When I was with you, I was patient and worked all the powerful miracles and signs and wonders of a true apostle.

dag: Ka sapashin kpɛm Nɛbuzaradan daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpalim be tiŋ maa ni mini bɛn daa zaŋ bɛmaŋ ti Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza la ni ninvuɣ gbaliŋ bɛn zaa pahi kuli.
en: Then Nebuzaradan took away to Babylonia the people who were left in the city, the remaining skilled workers, and those who had deserted to the Babylonians.

dag: Yisa daa lan ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ yaha, Naawuni nam ŋmanila ninvuɣ so ŋun chaŋ o puu ni nti ko m-biri bimbira.
en: Jesus went on to say, The Kingdom of God is like this. A man scatters seed in his field.

dag: Yawɛ nudirigu nya duhibu, Yawɛ nudirigu n-tum tuun kara maa.
en: The Lord s arm is raised in victory. The Lord has shown his great power again.

dag: Nina nyɛla niŋgbuŋ firila. Dinzuɣu a nina yi ne, a niŋgbuŋ zaa ni bela neesim ni;.
en: The eye is the lamp of the body. Therefore, if your eye is healthy, your whole body will be full of light.

dag: Taainim mɛla birini gili bɛmaŋa, ka va anzinfa mini salima puli kaman taŋkpaɣu la!.
en: Tyre built a fortress for herself. She piled up silver like dust and gold like mud in the streets.

dag: ka Ahitub nyɛ Zadok ba, ka Zadok nyɛ Shallum ba.
en: Ahitub was Zadoks father. Zadok was Shallums father.

dag: Dama Masia ʒirinim mini anab ʒirinim ni ti yi palo n-wuhiri shihir kara, ka tumd alahiziba tumtumsa ni bɛ birigi niriba; ka hal di yi ni ti nani, bɛ ni birigi Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda la gba.
en: For false Messiahs and false prophets will appear; they will perform great miracles and wonders in order to deceive even God's chosen people, if possible.

dag: Dama n ni chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn siɣisi bɛmaŋa ka nyɛ tarimba be yi sani. Bɛ ni ti bo sɔŋsim man Yawɛ sani.
en: I will let only meek and humble people stay in my city, and they will trust the Lord s name.

dag: Yawɛ, bɔhim ba biɛri, bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi tum tuun shɛŋa zaa zuɣu.
en: Pay them back fully, LORD, according to what they have done.

dag: So ti ku lan zaŋ a ni kuɣili m-me dikili gɔŋbu shee, ka so mi ti ku lan zaŋ a ni kuɣili me tanzaa. A yɛn kpalimla dabari doya sahakam. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Your stone blocks won't be reused for cornerstones or foundations, and I promise that forever you will be a desert. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka o sara maligu maa yi nyɛla piɛɣu bee bua, di simdi ka di nyɛla piɛlaa bee bulaa ŋun ka daŋa.
en: If the offering is an entirely burned offering from the flock—whether sheep or goat—you must present a flawless male.

dag: Lɛbanɔn sipirɛs mini sida tihi malila suhupiɛlli naa maa lubu maa zuɣu, ka yɛra, Pumpɔŋɔ a ni lu ŋɔ, so ku lan ŋma ti luhi yaha. .
en: Even the cypresses rejoice over you, the cedars of Lebanon: Since you were laid low, no logger comes up against us.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa nya lala ka di niŋ ba nyaɣisim pam, dama naa daa yi kul niŋ shɛli, di niŋdila niriba nyaɣisim.
en: They took note of this and were pleased. Indeed, everything the king did pleased the people.

dag: Ninvuɣ ŋuni n-lee bo yɛlli ti Taainim ŋɔ? Taai din nyɛ tin shɛli din leeri nama, ka di kɔhigɔriba nyɛ nabihi, ka di daa bihi mi nyɛ bɛn mali jilima pam dunia ŋɔ ni la?.
en: This city produced so many leaders. Its merchants were like princes. Its traders had the whole worlds respect. So who made these plans against Tyre?.

dag: Dama nir niŋdila yɛda o suhu ni, ka yi taali ni Naawuni sani; ka yaag o noli kahigi wuhi palɔni, ka tiligi.
en: Yes, we believe in Jesus deep in our hearts, and so we are made right with God. And we openly say that we believe in him, and so we are saved.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛli ba, Laɣimmiya Izraɛlnim zaa Mizipa ka n ti suhi Yawɛ tin ya.
en: Then Samuel called for all the Israelites to meet at Mizpah, telling them, I will pray to the Lord for you there.

dag: Bɛ mali tiba, amaa di bi wumda. Bɛ mali nyɛhi, amaa di bi wumdi nyom.
en: They have ears, but they cant hear. They have noses, but they cant smell.

dag: Ka din niŋ ba maa wuhiya ni yɛliŋahili la nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. Ŋahili maa ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Baa labi dir o tiri, ka bɛ ni su kuruchu so kom mi lan ŋmaligi labi ti bilindi baɣiri ni yaha.
en: What happened to them is just like the true saying, A dog will come back to lick up its own vomit. A pig that has been washed will roll in the mud.

dag: buɣim dibu la buɣim dibu, daŋ la daŋa, fiɛb bɔba la fiɛb bɔba la n-darigi dilan tibili.
en: burn for burn, wound for wound, bruise for bruise.

dag: Yawɛ, n kul guhirila a tiliginsim, ka dol a zaligunima.
en: LORD, I wait for your saving help. I do what youve commanded.

dag: Yinim Izraɛlnima, niŋmiya Yawɛ naani! Ŋuna n-nyɛ yi sɔŋda ni ŋun guli ya.
en: But you, Israel, trust in the LORD! God is their help and shield.

dag: Ka Ibram daa niŋ Yawɛ yɛda, ka Yawɛ daa lih o niŋsim maa ka di nyɛla wuntia.
en: Abram believed the Lord , and because of this faith the Lord accepted him as one who has done what is right.

dag: Ka Yisa tuumba pinaayi la daa boli Yisa nyaandol bɔbili maa na ti yɛli ba, Di bi simdi ni tinim chɛ Naawuni yɛligu tɔɣisibu ka kpalim bindira taribu ni.
en: The twelve apostles called the whole group of followers together and said, We should not give up preaching God's message in order to serve at tables.

dag: N daa wum a yɛla la n tibili ni, amaa pumpɔŋɔ n nini nya a;.
en: I heard about you from others; now I have seen you with my own eyes.

dag: Ka ti zaa kul nyari anfaani din galisi n-yir o kɔbili ni na pari taba.
en: Out of the fullness of his grace he has blessed us all, giving us one blessing after another.

dag: A chɛ ka ti ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ ti dimnima, ka ti dimnim maa di ti nɛma.
en: You made us run from our enemies, and they took for themselves what was ours.

dag: Ka Nataniɛl bɔh o, Bin suŋ ni tooi yi Nazarɛt na? Ka Filip yɛl o, Kamina ti nya.
en: Nathanael asked, Can anything good come from Nazareth? Philip answered, Come and see.

dag: Taainim kurimbuni ha suhupiɛlli tiŋ la m-bala? Tiŋ maa ni ka niriba daa yi n-du teeku duli ti ʒini la?.
en: Can this be that happy city that was founded so long ago? Is it that same city whose people traveled so far to settle other lands?.

dag: Naawuni daa bi tiligi malaika shɛb bɛn daa tuui tum alahichi la, amaa o daa zaŋ ba bahila buɣim biɛhigu shee n-lo ba zoligɔnim zali luɣ shɛli din nyɛ bumbɔni shee gu saria karibu dali.
en: When angels sinned, God did not let them go free without punishment. He sent them to hell. He put those angels in caves of darkness, where they are being held until the time when God will judge them.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Agiripa daa yɛli Gomna Fɛstus, N gba bɔri ni n wum doo maa yɛtɔɣa. Ka Fɛstus yɛl o, A sa ni wum li biɛɣuni.
en: Agrippa said to Festus, I would like to hear this man too. Festus said, Tomorrow you can hear him.

dag: Ka niriba daa yi zuliya balibu kam ni mini dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa bɛn daa pun wum Sulemaana yɛm maa yɛla sani n-ka o sanna ni bɛ ti wum o yɛm maa yɛtɔɣa.
en: People from every nation came to listen to Solomons wisdom. Kings all over the world sent their people to listen to him.

dag: O daa ba chɛrubi yiɣi; ka bɛ daa nya o ka o bela pɔhim ni chana.
en: God mounted the heavenly creatures and flew; he was seen on the winds wings.

dag: Ti bemi kaman bɛ ni ʒi shɛba, amaa ka lee nyɛ bɛ ni mi shɛb viɛnyɛliŋga. Ti bemi kaman bɛn kpira, amaa nyamiya, ka lee nyɛ bɛn be. Ti bemi kaman bɛ ni darigi shɛb tiba, amaa ka lee nyɛ bɛ ni bi ku shɛba.
en: To some people we are not known, but we are well known. We seem to be dying, but look! We continue to live. We are punished, but we are not killed.

dag: Naawuni daa nya Sɔdom mini Gomɔra tinsi la nim taali, ka daa zaŋ buɣim bahi ba yoli wuliwuli, ka di wuhi din ti yɛn niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi luri Naawuni sizuura.
en: God punished the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah by burning them to ashes, and this is a warning to anyone else who wants to sin.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ m binnamda zaa kpɛma, ŋun nam o kɔŋko n-ni tooi zaŋ takɔbi mir o.
en: The behemoth is the most amazing animal I made, but I can defeat him.

dag: A ni daa nya ka kuriti mini yaɣiri gari tab shɛm la, lala ka bɛ ni ti kpuɣiri tab bipuɣinsi n-lɔri ba amiliya ni di chɛ ka bɛ laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yini, amaa kuriti mini yaɣiri ni ku tooi gari taba n-leei zaɣ yini shɛm, lala ka bɛ gba ku tooi leei zaɣ yini.
en: You saw the iron mixed with clay, but iron and clay dont completely mix together. In the same way the people of the fourth kingdom will be a mixture. They will not be united as one people.

dag: Ka malaikanima ayi maa daa mali ti paai Sɔdom zaawuni, ka Lɔt daa ʒi Sɔdom tiŋ puuni dunol ni. Lɔt ni daa nya ba, ka o yiɣisi chaŋ ti tuhi ba soli n-damdi zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa ka yɛli.
en: The two messengers entered Sodom in the evening. Lot, who was sitting at the gate of Sodom, saw them, got up to greet them, and bowed low.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa kpe ba pam nimaani, ka biɛrim mali ba kaman paɣ ŋun wolisiri ni o dɔɣi.
en: Trembling took hold of them right there— like a woman giving birth.

dag: Teemiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa zaŋ ya doli tiŋgban nɛli ni so wɔɣinli yuun pihinahi ni o chɛ ka yi leei tarimba, ka o zahim ya nya yi ni dol o fukumsi zalikpana la bee yi ku dol li la yɛla.
en: Don't forget how the Lord your God has led you through the desert for the past years. He wanted to find out if you were truly willing to obey him and depend on him.

dag: ka o suhu yiɣisi ka o bɔh a, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi chaŋ miri tiŋ maa ni yi ti tuhi ba? Yi bi mi ni bɛ ni tɔn ya piɛma goma zuɣu na?.
en: he may get angry and ask, Why did you go so near the city to fight? Didn't you know they would shoot arrows from the wall?.

dag: ka daa tari Izraɛlnim maa dɔbba ni paɣiba zaa bɔrɔbɔro kpillikpilli mini niŋkpillikpilli ni wain tihi wala mahilimahili ti kpa.
en: and distributed a loaf of bread, a piece of meat, and a raisin cake to every Israelite man and woman.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛl o mi, Hɛzɛkia ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Zuŋɔ nyɛla nandahima mini turi ni vi dihibo dabisili. Bihi dɔɣibu saha paaya ka yaa kani ŋ-ŋuhiri dɔɣiri ba.
en: They said to Isaiah, King Hezekiah has commanded that today will be a special day for sorrow and sadness. It will be a very sad day—as sad as when a baby should be born, but there is not enough strength for the birth.

dag: A ni tooi zaŋ ziŋgoo gbaai Lɛviatan n-labi duli na bee n-zaŋ mia lo o zilinli?.
en: Can you draw out Leviathan with a hook, restrain his tongue with a rope?.

dag: ni Alikauli Adaka mini di dapuhi ni di yɔrigu.
en: They showed Moses the Box of the Agreement, the poles used for carrying it, and the mercy-cover.

dag: Kpaŋm amaŋ ka n sanna pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Do your best to come to me soon.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ kabiɛlim maa ʒi n-kuli ti wuh o yidan ma o ni nya shɛm tariga. Ka daa lan zaŋ o ni ŋub ka guui bɔrɔbɔro shɛl la gba ti o.
en: She took the grain back into town and showed her mother-in-law how much she had gathered. She also gave her the food left over from the meal.

dag: Yisa ni daa be dunia ŋɔ ni saha shɛli, o daa suhiri Naawuni yɛr o o ni bɔri shɛli, ka duhir o yee kuhiri ni nintam niŋdi Naawuni ŋun ni tooi tilig o kum ni la. Ka Naawuni daa wum o suhigu maa o ni daa zɔri ŋun Naawuni la zuɣu.
en: During his days on earth, Christ offered prayers and requests with loud cries and tears as his sacrifices to the one who was able to save him from death. He was heard because of his godly devotion.

dag: Di saha ka Musa mini Izraɛlnim maa daa yili yilli ŋɔ m-paɣiri Yawɛ yɛra: N ni yili yila paɣi Yawɛ, dama o di nasara din mali jilima; o daai wɔribara min o wɔhu niŋ teeku ni.
en: Moses and the Israelites sang this song in praise of the Lord : I sing praises to the Lord for his great victory! He has thrown the horses and their riders into the sea.

dag: O ni ti zaŋ shɛb leeg o tɔbbi kpamba n-chɛ ka bɛ su tɔbbihi tuhilituhili, ka shɛb mi su pihinunu; ka zaŋ shɛb leeg o pukpariba, ka bɛ kɔr o puu ka kpuɣir o puu atam, ka shɛb mi maani o chɛchɛbunsi min o tɔbutuhiri nɛma.
en: Some of them will be officers in charge of , soldiers, and others will be in charge of . Still others will have to farm the king's land and harvest his crops, or make weapons and parts for his chariots.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Sintani, Di viɛla, a mal o yiko, amaa leei di ku o.
en: All right! the Lord replied. Make Job suffer as much as you want, but just don't kill him.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla dunia ŋɔ ni, n nyaya ka zaligu dolibu ni be shɛli ninvuɣ biɛtali bela nimaani; ka lan nya ka wuntitali ni be shɛli ninvuɣ biɛtali lan bela nimaani gba.
en: I also saw these things in this life : I saw that the courts should be filled with goodness and fairness, but there is evil there now.

dag: Ka yi yi bɔhi Ti yi bi biri bee ti yi bi kpuɣi puri atam yuun shɛli din pahir ayopɔin maa ni, bɔ ka ti ti yɛn dira.
en: Suppose you ask, What will we eat in the seventh year if we dont plant or gather our crops then.

dag: Chɛ ka naa maa yuli ku kpi, ka chɛ ka o yul kul beni kaman wuntaŋ ni beni shɛm ŋɔ. Chɛ ka zuliya kam zaa nya alibarika o zuɣu. Ka chɛ ka zuliya kam zaa bol o alibarika naa.
en: Let the kings name last forever. Let his name endure as long as the sun. Let all the nations be blessed through him and call him happy.

dag: ka zaŋ dapuhi maa tu bansi din be Alikauli Adaka maa luɣa ni la ni bɛ mal li kpuɣiri Alikauli Adaka maa.
en: and put them through the rings, so the chest could be carried by the poles.

dag: nti zaŋ li shihi n noli ka yɛli, Dimbɔŋɔ ni shihi a noli maa, di yih a galimi, ka kpihim a daalahichi.
en: It touched my lips with the hot coal and said, This has touched your lips. Your sins are forgiven, and you are no longer guilty.

dag: Ka bɛ daa jɛm o, ka lan lab Jɛrusalɛm ni suhupiɛlli.
en: They worshiped him and went back to Jerusalem very happy.

dag: Jɛrusalɛmnima, doliya dunoya yi. Malimiya soli sɔŋ niriba. Vuɣimiya kuɣa soli maa zuɣu. Lomiya tuuta n-kpuɣ li zuɣusaa ka niriba nya li baŋ li.
en: People of Jerusalem, go out of the city And build a road for your returning people! Prepare a highway; clear it of stones! Put up a signal so that the nations can know.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa tim ti yɛli Tama, Cham a tizɔdoo Amnɔn yiŋa nti niŋ bindirigu ti o.
en: David told Tamar, Go over to Amnon's house and fix him some food.

dag: Ka o dɔro maa daa dii naai, ka o baŋ o niŋgbuŋ ni ni o nya alaafee.
en: Her bleeding stopped immediately, and she sensed in her body that her illness had been healed.

dag: Mbusim be yi zuɣu; yi nyɛla wain nyur wɔɣira, ka bi zɔri dabiɛm ni yi zaŋ binnyura gari taba.
en: And you are great at drinking and mixing drinks. But you are in for trouble.

dag: dama yimaŋmaŋ mi viɛnyɛliŋga ni ti Duuma labbuna dabisili la ni ti kana kaman tayiɣa ni kanna yuŋ shɛm la.
en: You surely know that the Lord's return will be as a thief coming at night.

dag: Naawuni yino m-beni, ka sandaantimda yino kɔŋko mi m-be Naawuni mini salinim sunsuuni, ŋuna n-nyɛ Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ daadam.
en: There is one God and one mediator between God and humanity, the human Christ Jesus.

dag: ni Kɛros daŋ niriba ni Sia daŋ niriba ni Padɔn daŋ niriba.
en: Keros, Sia, Padon.

dag: Ka Jɔtam daa zo n-kuli Bɛr nti be nimaani, dama o daa zɔrila o biɛli Abimilɛk.
en: Jotham ran off and went to live in the town of Beer, where he could be safe from his brother Abimelech.

dag: O daa piila Bɛza din be tiŋgban nɛl ni tintani ni la n-ti Rubin zuliya niriba, ka pii Ramɔt din be Giliad la n-ti Gaad zuliya niriba, ka pii Golan din be Bashan la mi ti Manaasa zuliya niriba.
en: The three cities that Moses chose were Bezer in the high plains for the tribe of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead for the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan for the tribe of Manasseh.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, yi pun wum ni Naawuni daanfaani zuɣu ka o zaŋ tuuni ŋɔ ti ma ni n tum yi sɔŋbu zuɣu.
en: Surely you know that God gave me this work through his grace to help you.

dag: Di saha maa Ibrahimma mini Zara zaa daa kurigiya pam hal ka Zara bi lan nyari sɔrilim gba.
en: Now Abraham and Sarah were both very old. Sarah was no longer menstruating.

dag: Ka bɛ ti zaŋ salima gali mini gali sabilifaa ni gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain ni tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli n-she binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa.
en: They are to make the ephod of blue, purple, and red wool, gold thread, and fine linen, decorated with embroidery.

dag: Biɛrim chɛ ka n nimbihi bi lan ne viɛnyɛliŋga, ka n niŋgbuŋ zaa ŋmanila shilinshia.
en: My eye is weak from grief; my limbs like a shadow—all of them.

dag: Gol so ŋun pah ayopɔin dabisi shɛli din daŋ tooni dali, yin laɣimmiya jɛm Naawuni, ka di tumiya tuun shɛli. Dindali maa, piɛbimiya kikahi.
en: On the first day of the seventh month you are to gather for worship, and no work is to be done. On that day trumpets are to be blown.

dag: Di daba ata dali ka bɛ daa ti nya o la Naawuni jɛmbu duu, ka o ʒi Yɛhudia adiini karimbanim sunsuuni wumdi bɛ yɛtɔɣa ka bɔhiri ba bɔhigunima.
en: After three days they found him in the temple. He was sitting among the teachers, listening to them and putting questions to them.

dag: Dindali maa Yawɛ ni ti zaŋ o ninkuunsi takɔb titali din mali kpiɔŋ la n-darigi Lɛviatan ŋun nyɛ waɣ so ŋun pɔripɔri ka yiɣiri la tibili; ka ku teeku ni biŋkɔb biɛɣu la.
en: On that day, the LORD will take a great sword, harsh and mighty, and will punish Leviathan the fleeing serpent, Leviathan the writhing serpent, and will kill the dragon that is in the sea.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ku zaɣis o niriba; o ku chɛ o ninvuɣ gahinda bahi.
en: You won't turn your back on your chosen nation.

dag: Ka kpambal so ŋun daa chaŋ ni o ti boli Mikaya na maa daa yɛl o, Nyama, anabinim maa zaa ni naai noli yɛli shɛm nyɛla din doli naa suhu ni yu shɛm. A gba kul yɛlimi la din tiɣi naa nini kaman bɛ zaa ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Meanwhile, the messenger who went to get Micaiah whispered, Micaiah, all the prophets have good news for Ahab. Now go and say the same thing.

dag: Babilɔn tɔbbihi ni daa yi Jɛrusalɛm zo saha shɛli Firawuna tɔbbihi ni daa kanna la.
en: The Babylonian army had left because the Egyptian army was on its way to help us.

dag: Amaa ka paɣ so daa kpuɣ nɛkaŋa n-daai li bah o zuɣu ni na, ka di ŋma o zuɣuŋmaŋ.
en: a woman dropped an upper millstone on Abimelechs head and cracked his skull.

dag: Ka yi yi ti yɛn zaŋ tuuli piɛbil maa mali sara maa, yin zaŋmiya zim viɛlli kilɔgiram yini mini kpa viɛlli lita yini gari taba n-zaŋ wain shɛli yi ni yɛn zaŋ booi bahi sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu lita yini m-pahi mali sara maa.
en: With each lamb offer one kilogram of your finest flour mixed with a liter of pure olive oil, and also pour out a liter of wine as an offering. The smell of this sacrifice on the fires of the altar will be pleasing to me.

dag: Chɛ ka n wunsuhigu be kaman tulaale zim la a sani, ka chɛ ka n nuhi zuɣusaa kpuɣibu be kaman zaawuni sara maligu la.
en: Accept my prayer like a gift of burning incense, the words I lift up like an evening sacrifice.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi bahi tiŋgbani maa zuɣu, ka o chɛ ka noli din yɛla zaa sab be kundi ŋɔ ni di li maa.
en: Then the LORDs anger burned against that land, and he brought against it every curse written in this scroll.

dag: Nyama, a yɛri ni a nyaŋ Ɛdomnima, ka duh amaŋa nyuri bara. Ʒi a yiŋ baalim. Bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɛn bo yɛla ti amaŋ tabili Judanima.
en: You say to yourself, I have defeated Edom! You are proud and you brag. But you should stay at home. There is no need for you to get into trouble. If you fight me, you and Judah will be destroyed.
