dag: Di saha ka Jɔab daa chaŋ naa sani ti bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋ lala? Nyama, Abinɛr kala a sanna, ka bɔ niŋ ka a bah o ka o chaŋ?.
en: Joab went to the king and asked, What have you done? Abner came to you here! Why did you send him off? Now hes gotten away!.

dag: dama o daalahichi dumi hal ti paai sagbana, ka Naawuni teeg o tuumbiɛri yɛla.
en: Her sins are piled as high as heaven. God has remembered the evil she has done.

dag: Daadam yi kpi o ni lan tooi be? Amaa n kul ni guhi n ni tumdi tuma dabisi shɛŋa ŋɔ ni zaa hal ti nya faako.
en: If a man dies, will he live again? If so, I would gladly suffer through this time waiting for my release.

dag: A yi gbib a noli min a zilinli, a ni yi yɛla ni.
en: Those who guard their mouths and their tongues guard themselves from trouble.

dag: Nyin Bɛlitishaaza ŋun nyɛ timanim kpɛm ŋɔ, dama m mi ni wun shɛŋa din be kasi la shia be a ni, ka a tooi baŋdi ashiya gbinni. N ni daa zahim zahin shɛli maa m-bɔŋɔ: Wuhim ma di gbinni.
en: I said, Belteshazzar, you are the most important of all the men of magic. I know that the spirit of the holy gods is in you. I know there is no secret that is too hard for you to understand. This was what I dreamed. Tell me what it means.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ma, Nyama, n ni chɛ ka a zaŋ naɣ bindi she bɔrɔbɔro maa ka chɛ ninsal bindi maa.
en: The Lord replied, Instead of human waste, I will let you bake your bread on a fire made from cow manure.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Tahima na be a biɛhigu ni. A bihi maa ni ti labi bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni na.
en: There is hope for your future; your children will come back home. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔ pala o ni lo shɛm bee di pun bela o suhu ni, amaa o lola nia ni o saɣim ka kpihim zuliya pam birili.
en: But the Assyrian emperor has his own violent plans in mind. He is determined to destroy many nations.

dag: Mɔab nyɛla n kopaɣiri ŋmani, ka Ɛdom nyɛ n ni pirigiri n namda sɔŋdi luɣ shɛli; n ni ŋme nasaridibo kuŋa m-bahi Filistianim zuɣu.
en: Moab will be the bowl for washing my feet. Edom will be the slave who carries my sandals. I will defeat the Philistines and shout in victory.

dag: N ni su ninvuɣ shɛb maa ŋmanila gbuɣinli ŋun be mɔɣu ni n sani. Bɛ ŋumdimi bahiri n zuɣu, dinzuɣu ka n je ba.
en: My people have turned against me and roar at me like lions. That's why I hate them.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka maligumaana maa zaŋ paɣ maa mirina ti zali Yawɛ tooni;.
en: The priest will bring her close and make her stand before the LORD.

dag: Lala ka yi yɛn niŋ naɣilaa bee piɛlaa bee piɛlabil kam bee bubil kam sara maligu ni.
en: If you are a native Israelite, you must obey these rules each time you offer a bull, a ram, or a goat as a sacrifice.

dag: ŋ-ŋme n-deei li dindali maa. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ takɔbiri ku binshɛɣukam mini ninsalinim zaa bɛn be di ni dindali maa kaman bɛ ni daa niŋ Lakishinim shɛm la.
en: They captured it on the same day and struck it down without mercy. On that day, he wiped out everyone in it as something reserved for God, just exactly as he had done to Lachish.

dag: Ŋunkam fiɣisir o ʒiʒiinikpee ashilɔni, n ni ku dilana. Ŋunkam nyuri bara ka mali karimbaani; m mini dilana ku kpe.
en: I will stop anyone who secretly says bad things about a neighbor. I will not allow people to be proud and think they are better than others.

dag: Firawuna yi ti zaɣisi ni o ku wum yi yɛligu maa, di saha ka n ni ti darigi Ijiptinim maa tibili, ka tum tuun kara pam yihi n niriba Izraɛlnim maa zaa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni gbilligbilli.
en: When Pharaoh refuses to listen to you, then Ill act against Egypt and Ill bring my people the Israelites out of the land of Egypt in military formation by momentous events of justice.

dag: A yurilim maŋli la zuɣu, kum n dimnima. N nyɛla a dabili, kum n dimnim zaa.
en: I am your servant. Show how much you love me by destroying my enemies.

dag: bɛn nyɛ wɔɣira mini tarimba ni azichilaannim ni faranim zaa, wummiya!.
en: Everyone, rich and poor, listen to me.

dag: Ahazia daa nyɛla yuun pisinaayi nira saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa; o daa di nam la maa yuun yini Jɛrusalɛm. O ma daa nyɛla Izraɛl Naa Omri yaaŋa, ka o yuli booni Atalia.
en: Ahaziah was years old when he began to rule. He ruled one year in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Athaliah. She was the daughter of King Omri of Israel.

dag: ka yɛli, Aai, ti ni ba yuri bɛn zɔri pam n-zo n-tiligi, dindina zomiya tiligi. Yi tɛhiya ni yi yuri zɔri pam, amaa bɛn kariti doli ya maa yuri zɔri gari yi yuri.
en: You say, No, we need fast horses for battle. That is true—you will need fast horses, but only to run away because your enemy will be faster than your horses.

dag: N teei dabisa shɛŋa din gari ha yɛla; N tɛhir a tuma zaa yɛla. N kul tɛhir a nuhi tuma zaa yɛla.
en: I remember the days long past; I meditate on all your deeds; I contemplate your handiwork.

dag: So mi ni yɛli, Bindirigu nyɛla puli dini, ka puli gba nyɛ bindirigu dini. Yɛlimaŋli, amaa Naawuni ni ti saɣim di zaa yim. Niŋgbuŋ bi bela kɔr biɛri tuma tumbu zuɣu; amaa di nyɛla ti Duuma dini, ka ti Duuma gba nyɛ niŋgbuŋ dini.
en: Food is for the stomach and the stomach is for food, and yet God will do away with both. The body isnt for sexual immorality but for the Lord, and the Lord is for the body.

dag: Nimaani ka bɛ daa kpah o tabili dapulli maa zuɣu, ka daa kpahi niriba ayi gba tabili dapula n-zaŋ sa m-pahi Yisa zuɣu: Yino o nudirigu polo, ŋun la mi o nuzaa polo, ka Yisa daa be bɛ sunsuuni.
en: Thats where they crucified him—and two others with him, one on each side and Jesus in the middle.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ bɛ ni daa pii ninvuɣ shɛb niriba maa ni ka bɛ nyɛ bɛ daŋ ni toondaannima ni Izraɛl zuliya kam ni zuɣulaannima.
en: All these men were the leaders of their families. The people also chose them to be leaders of their tribes.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Nyamiya, n ni chɛ ka tinvura bɛn nyɛ garinsi lu yi zuɣu n-dimdi ya, ka yi ku tooi niŋ ba tim.
en: Watch out! the Lord says, I am sending snakes among you, poisonous snakes that cannot be charmed, and they will bite you.

dag: siɣim dapulli maa zuɣu na tilig amaŋa.
en: Save yourself and come down from the cross.

dag: Ka bɛ ni so daa ka shɛli din ni yo o, ka o daa chɛ sama maa ti bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa. Dinzuɣu yɛlim ma, bɛ niriba ayi ŋɔ sunsuuni, ŋuni n-lee ni yuri sandihira ŋɔ gar o kpee.
en: Neither of them could pay him back, so he canceled the debts of both. Which one, then, will love him more.

dag: O nyaandoliba maa ni daa wum lala maa, ka di gari ba pam ka bɛ bɔhi, Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi tiligi.
en: When the disciples heard this, they were completely amazed. Who, then, can be saved? they asked.

dag: Ka yi lan zaŋ bula yino mali alahichi sanyoo sara pahi yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim sahakam la mini di chi sara ni di binnyura sara la zuɣu.
en: You must also give male goat as a sin offering. This must be in addition to the daily sacrifice and its grain offerings and drink offerings.

dag: Amaa nahu maa yi pun ʒiɛri niriba ka bɛ yɛl o lana ka o bi niŋ o fukumsi, ka chɛ ka o ti ʒe n-ku doo bee paɣa, di simdi ka bɛ labi nahu maa kuɣa ku o, ka ku nahu maa lan gba.
en: However, if the ox had gored people in the past and its owner had been warned but didnt watch out for it, and the ox ends up killing a man or a woman, then the ox should be stoned to death, and its owner should also be put to death.

dag: Di chɛ ka n suhu kpe zaɣ biɛɣu niŋbu ni, ka m pahi ninvuɣ biɛri zuɣu tum zaɣ biɛɣu. Di chɛ ka n zaŋ mmaŋ bali tuumbiɛtumdiba ni; di chɛ ka m pahi bɛ zuɣu di bɛ bindir nyaɣisa.
en: Dont let my heart turn aside to evil things so that I dont do wicked things with evildoers, so I dont taste their delicacies.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Abishai min o kpamba maa, Nyamiya, mmaŋmaŋ bia m-bɔri ni o ku ma la, di ni ti be ka Bɛnjamin zuliya ni nir ŋɔ? Chɛliy o ka o tu ma, dama Yawɛ n-zal o lala.
en: And David said to Abishai and to all his officials, My own son is trying to kill me; so why should you be surprised at this Benjaminite? The Lord told him to curse; so leave him alone and let him do it.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka wɔɣ shɛb bɛn mal lɔɣu pam yina ti dimdi Izraɛlnima ka bɛ pam daa kpi.
en: So the Lord sent poisonous snakes among the people. The snakes bit the people, and many of the Israelites died.

dag: ni Zanɔa ni Ɛnganim ni Tapua ni Ɛnam.
en: Zanoah, En Gannim, Tappuah, Enam.

dag: Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa yoobu maa ni, bɛ daa zaŋla naɣilahi kɔbiga mini piɛlahi kɔbisiyi ni piɛbihi kɔbisinahi mali sara, ka lan zaŋ bulahi pinaayi mali sara Izraɛlnim zaa daalahichi zuɣu; kaman bɛ zuliya maa kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: At the dedication of this house of God, they offered one hundred bulls, two hundred rams, four hundred lambs, and as a purification offering for all Israel, twelve male goats, according to the number of the tribes of Israel.

dag: Ŋuna n-ni ti me yili ti ma, ka n ti chɛ ka o nam kul ʒiɛya sahakam.
en: He is the one who will build me a temple, and I will establish his throne forever.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kali ba kaman bɛ daŋ mini bɛ yaannim dunoya ni daa nyɛ shɛm, bɛ kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tusaayi ni kɔbisiyɔbu ni pihita.
en: their enrollment by their clans and their households was .

dag: Karimbaannim ni ti nya filiŋ, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn duhiri bɛmaŋa, bɛ ni ti siɣisi ba; ka niriba ti duhila Yawɛ kɔŋko dindali maa.
en: Peoples proud gazing will be stopped and humanitys arrogance brought down; the LORD alone will be exalted on that day.

dag: Amaa ka Ijipti timanim gba daa tum bɛ tabibi tuma n-gba daa niŋ lala. Ka di daa kpaŋsi Firawuna suhu, ka o daa bi wum bɛ yɛligu maa kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli shɛm la.
en: Then the king's magicians did the same thing by means of their magic, and the king was as stubborn as ever. Just as the Lord had said, the king refused to listen to Moses and Aaron.

dag: Chɛliya ka bɛ niŋ kom biɛla tin ya na ka yi paɣi yi naba, ka ʒini tia ŋɔ gbini vuhi.
en: I will bring some water to wash your feet. You can rest under the trees.

dag: Yisa ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa naai ka o yɛl o nyaandoliba.
en: When Jesus had finished teaching, he told his disciples.

dag: di saha n tahima maa lee be ya? Ŋuni n-lee yɛn nya n tahima maa?.
en: But you cant really call that hope, can you? Does anyone see any hope for me?.

dag: Yawɛ, n yi tɛhi a zaligunim din yi kurimbuni na la yɛla, di kpaŋsirila n suhu.
en: I remember your judgments of long ago, and they bring me comfort, O Lord .

dag: Ka Ifriim zuliya daa zaŋ bɛ tuuta yiɣisi doli tab gbilligbilli paya. Ammihud bia Ɛlishama n-daa nyɛ bɛ zaa zuɣulana;.
en: Ephraim and the tribes that camped alongside it marched next, carrying their banner. Elishama son of Ammihud was the leader of the Ephraim tribe.

dag: N naa daa dola o bindoo zuɣu, ka n tulaale nyom deei nimaani zaa.
en: My king, while you were on your couch, my aroma was a magic charm.

dag: Pool ni daa tɔɣisiri ni o zab omaŋ zuɣu maa, ka Gomna Fɛstus ti duh o yee yɛl o, Pool, di ni bɔŋɔ a kpɛla yinyari! A baŋsim pam zuɣu n-chɛ ka a kpe yinyari maa.
en: Before Paul finished defending himself, Festus shouted, Paul, you're crazy! Too much learning has driven you out of your mind.

dag: To, bidibis ayi maa ni ŋuni n-daa lee tum o ba yubu? Ka bɛ garigi yɛli, Kpɛm san la. Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, farigudeeriba mini pagɔra daŋ ya Naawuni nam ni kpɛbu.
en: Which one of the sons obeyed his father? The older one, the chief priests and leaders answered. Then Jesus told them: You can be sure tax collectors and prostitutes will get into the kingdom of God before you ever will!.

dag: Ka Ibram daa yiɣisi nimaani n-chaŋ ti ti o suɣili Bɛtɛl wulimpuhili polo zoli zuɣu ʒini; ka chɛ Bɛtɛl bahi wulinluhili polo, ka chɛ Ai mi bahi wulimpuhili polo. Ka o daa me sara maligu bimbini zali Yawɛ nimaani gba n-jɛmd o di gbini.
en: Then he left that place and traveled to the mountains east of Bethel. He set up his tent there. Bethel was to the west, and Ai was to the east. Abram built another altar at that place to honor the Lord , and he worshiped the Lord there.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli ma shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Cham ti da jinjɛŋŋma piɛlli n-zaŋ so, amaa di zaŋ li tim kom ni.
en: The Lord told me to go and buy myself some linen shorts and to put them on; but he told me not to put them in water.

dag: ka daa lan zaŋ bantabiga vil o, ka zaŋ salima bimparilan din be kasi niŋ di tooni kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ŋun Musa shɛm.
en: Moses placed the turban on Aarons head and put the gold flower ornament, the holy crown, on the turbans front, just as the LORD had commanded him.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ nyamiya ma, mani m-bala. Wuni so lan kani m-pahi n zuɣu. Mani n-kura, ka lan neera. Mani n-tir dansi; mani n-lan tibira, ka so ku tooi fa shɛli n nuu ni.
en: I, and I alone, am God; no other god is real. I kill and I give life, I wound and I heal, and no one can oppose what I do.

dag: N ni daa pun yɛli ya shɛlikam zaa la niŋya, ka yi ni saɣi yɛli ni n ni daa yɛli shɛm maa nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. Pumpɔŋɔ n yɛn yɛli ya la yɛl pala, di nyɛla ashili yɛl shɛŋa yi ni na ʒi.
en: You heard what I said would happen. And you can see it has all been done. Shouldnt you tell this to others? Now I will tell you about new things, secrets you have not known before.

dag: Hal laakum shɛriga nyee ni kpɛbu mal asama gari bundan Naawuni nam ni kpɛbu.
en: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to enter Gods kingdom.

dag: Dama bɛ daa tum tuumbiɛri pam Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka tum zina ni bɛ tab paɣiba, ka lan zaŋ n yuli tɔɣisi ʒiri yɛtɔɣa, ka di pa n ni wuhi ba shɛm. Mani n-nyɛ ŋun mi dimbɔŋɔ, ka lan di li shɛhira. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: They committed a horrible scandal in Israel—adultery with their neighbors wives and deceit spoken in my name, with which I had nothing to do. Yet Im still aware of it and am witness to it, declares the LORD.

dag: Ka yi ni bi mi ninvuɣ shɛba ni ti di yi puri ni bindira ni yi tuma zaa daanfaani. Yi ti kul ni bela turi mini nahiŋgu ni sahakam.
en: You will work hard on your farms, but everything you harvest will be eaten by foreigners, who will mistreat you and abuse you for the rest of your life.

dag: Ka Dauda min o niriba maa daa ti paai Zikilag daba ata dali n-nya ka Amalɛknim kamina ti liri Nɛgɛbinim mini Zikilagnima n-nyaŋ Zikilagnim maa, ka nyo tiŋ maa buɣim.
en: Two days later David and his men arrived back at Ziklag. The Amalekites had raided southern Judah and attacked Ziklag. They had burned down the town.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa zaŋ li tahi nimaani, ka Yawɛ daa lan darigi di tiŋ maa nim gba tibili n-chɛ ka sokam suhu saɣim. O daa chɛ ka bintɔra tɔri bihi mini ninkura zaa.
en: the Lord made sores break out on everyone in town. The people of Gath were frightened.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka tiliginsim paag a yili ŋɔ na, dama a gba yila Ibrahimma zuliya ni na.
en: Jesus said to him, Today, salvation has come to this household because he too is a son of Abraham.

dag: Amaa ka o daa yɛli ma, N daalibarika saɣ a, dama n yaa niŋdi dɛde chɔɣinsi ni. Ka n kul ni nyuri bara m-pahiri ni suhupiɛlli n chɔɣinsi zuɣu ka di chɛ ka Masia yiko tooi be n ni.
en: He said to me, My grace is enough for you, because power is made perfect in weakness. So Ill gladly spend my time bragging about my weaknesses so that Christs power can rest on me.

dag: Dama o daa zaŋ dabiɛm kpɛhi nyɛviyanim tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Dinzuɣu bɛ ni zaŋ o sɔŋ pahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi guni zuɣu, bɛ ni daa zaŋ takɔbi ku ninvuɣ shɛb la. Firawuna min o tɔbbihi zaa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: People were afraid of Pharaoh when he was alive, but he will lie down next to those foreigners. Pharaoh and his army will lie down with all the other soldiers who were killed in battle. This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: Ka ti yi yihi yɛli ni ti ka alahichi, ti yɔhimla timaŋa ka yɛlimaŋli ka ti ni.
en: If we claim, We dont have any sin, we deceive ourselves and the truth is not in us.

dag: Nyini n-chɛ ka o yiɣiri kaman toli la? O nyeeni firisibu din mali jilima la mali dabiɛm.
en: cause him to leap like a locust, his majestic snorting, a fright?.

dag: Bɛ yi ti tahi ya Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni mini nanim ni zuɣulaannim sani, yin di ti bɔhiri yi suhuri yi ni yɛn garigi shɛm bee yi ni yɛn yɛli shɛm zuɣu.
en: When men bring you into the synagogues before the leaders and other important men, dont worry about what you will say.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yɛli Gaad, Yɛl titali paai ma, chɛ ka n kpɛla Yawɛ nuu ni, dama o nambɔzɔbo galisiya pam, amaa di chɛ ka n kpe ninsal nuu ni.
en: David said to Gad, I am in trouble! I dont want some man to decide my punishment. The Lord is very merciful, so let him decide how to punish me.

dag: Ijipti ŋmanila naɣisa viɛlli, ka viɛbiga yi nuzaa polo na ni o ti tabil o.
en: Egypt is like a beautiful cow. But a horsefly is coming from the north to attack her.

dag: Ninsalinim azichi ku tooi tiligi ba kum ni. Bɛ ni bahi kpi kaman biŋkɔbiri ni kpiri shɛm la.
en: People might be wealthy, but they cannot stay here forever. They will die like the animals.

dag: N yi kpi n-do gballi ni, nyɔ bɔ ka n kum maa lee yɛn ti a? Taŋkpaɣu ni tooi paɣ a? Di ni tooi yɛl a ʒiɛyimtali yɛla?.
en: I said, What good is it if I die and go down to the grave? The dead just lie in the dirt. They cannot praise you. They cannot tell anyone how faithful you are.

dag: Nandaamba ni ti di n-tiɣi; ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi Yawɛ ni paɣ o. Naawuni chɛ ka yi kul tɔŋdi sahakam.
en: The poor will eat and be full, and all who worship you will be thankful and live in hope.

dag: Bɛ tumdi bɛ tuma zaa la niriba nini zuɣu, ka niŋdi bɛ ni piriti sab shɛŋa mini din pari bɛ gbiɛri zuɣu ka di nyɛ zaɣ yɛlima, ka chɛri ka bɛ binyɛra naŋgbanzusa nyɛ zaɣ wɔɣila.
en: They do everything so that people will see them. Look at the straps with scripture verses on them which they wear on their foreheads and arms, and notice how large they are! Notice also how long are the tassels on their cloaks!.

dag: Bidibisi ayɔbu ka o daa dɔɣi Hiburɔn, o ni daa di nam ʒini nimaani yuma ayopɔin ni chira ayɔbu la. O daa di nam n-ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pihitanaata.
en: These six sons were born to David in Hebron. David ruled as king in Hebron for seven years and six months. He ruled as king in Jerusalem years.

dag: Di saha ka Amɔs daa garigi yɛli Amazia, M pala anabi, m mi pala anabi bia; amaa n nyɛla biŋkɔbigula ni ŋun sari fiig tihi.
en: Amos answered, I am not the kind of prophet who prophesies for pay. I am a herdsman, and I take care of fig trees.

dag: Ka n daa nya shi biɛr ata bɛn ŋmani poloya, ka bɛ yiri waɣ biɛ tital la mini biŋkɔbigu la ni anabi ʒirilan la noya ni na.
en: Then I saw three evil spirits that looked like frogs. They came out of the mouth of the dragon, out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet.

dag: Di saha a ni ti teei a ni daa be shɛm la yɛla, ka vi gbaag a. Saha shɛli n yi ti zaŋ a mabihi bɛn nyɛ a biɛli min a tizo la ti a kaman a bipuɣinsi la. Amaa dimbɔŋɔ pala n ni lo a alikauli shɛli maa zuɣu.
en: I will bring your sisters to you, and I will make them your daughters. That was not in our agreement, but I will do that for you. Then you will remember the terrible things you did, and you will be ashamed.

dag: Teem a ni daa zal a dabili Musa zaligu shɛl la yɛla. A daa yɛl o, Yi yi bi ʒe ma yim, n ni wurim ya kpɛhi zuliya shɛb ni.
en: Please remember the teaching you gave your servant Moses. You said to him, If you Israelites are not faithful, I will force you to be scattered among the other nations.

dag: Hal bɛ nyɛla bɛn kul kpaŋdi bɛmaŋa ni bɛ chɛ ka ti ku yihi waazu din tahiri tiliginsim na la n-ti bɛn pa Yɛhudianima. Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ alahichi shɛli din bahindi nyaaŋa ni bɛ tum zan tariga; amaa Naawuni suhuyiɣisili la pun paai ba.
en: They even tried to stop us from preaching to the Gentiles the message that would bring them salvation. In this way they have brought to completion all the sins they have always committed. And now God's anger has at last come down on them!.

dag: Jɛrigu ni lo shɛli nyɛla alahichi, ka ansarisimaana mi nyɛ sokam ni je ninvuɣ so.
en: Any scheme a fool thinks up is sinful. People hate a person who has nothing but scorn for others.

dag: ni Kibizaim ni Bɛtihɔrɔn mini di biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: Kibzaim, and Beth Horon. In all, Ephraim gave them four towns and some land around each town for their animals.

dag: Ka di lan nyɛla kom din daa nyɛ kokpɛɣu la ka Naawuni daa zaŋ saɣim tuuli dunia la.
en: And it was through these that the world of that time was flooded and destroyed.

dag: Ka paɣ maa paɣidɔɣisɔtali daɣiri ni yibu dabisa yɛn nyɛla biɛɣu pihitanaata. Di bi simdi ni o shihi binshɛli din be kasi bee n-kpe luɣ kasi shee hal ka o daɣiri ni yibu dabisa maa ti naai.
en: Then it will be thirty-three more days until she is ritually clean from her loss of blood; she must not touch anything that is holy or enter the sacred Tent until the time of her purification is completed.

dag: Zoya zuɣu tinsi mi n-daa nyɛ: Shamir mini Jatir ni Soko.
en: In the hill country there were Shamir, Jattir, Socoh.

dag: Ka bɔhi ba, Yi tɛhiya ni n kamina ni n ti ti dunia ŋɔ nim suhudoo? Aai, n yɛri ya mi ni ninvuɣ tuɣilibo ka n tahina.
en: Do you think I came to give peace to the world? No, I came to divide the world!.

dag: A daa fa ba bɛn je ba nuu ni bahi; ka tiligi ba bɛ dimnim nuu ni.
en: He saved them from those who hated them; he rescued them from their enemies.

dag: ka duhiri bɛ yɛhi yɛra, Tiliginsim yila ti Duuma Naawuni ŋun ʒi nam ʒiishee ŋɔ ni mini Piɛbil ŋɔ sanna.
en: They cried out with a loud voice: Victory belongs to our God who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa zaa daa zo ka chɛ o.
en: And all his disciples left him and ran away.

dag: Amaa Izraɛlnima, yi nyee daa nyɔni ma mi, ka yi daa bi lan jɛmdi ma.
en: But you didnt call out to me, Jacob; you were tired of me, Israel.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri suhuri kul yɛla ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma zuɣu, amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn nyaɣa nyɛla din tahiri wala na.
en: The wicked want a share of what an evil man might catch. But like a plant with deep roots, a good man is the one who produces the most.

dag: ka bɛn kpalim mi gbahi naa maa yiŋbihi maa n-dihi ba vi, ka ku ba.
en: Others grabbed the servants, then beat them up and killed them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋme naŋgbankpeeni di zuɣu yuui, ka Pita ti yiɣisi zani yɛli ba, M mabihi, yi mi ni mani ka Naawuni daa daŋ pii ni n chɛ ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim wum lahibal suŋ maa n nol ni ka niŋ yɛda.
en: After a long debate Peter stood up and said, My friends, you know that a long time ago God chose me from among you to preach the Good News to the Gentiles, so that they could hear and believe.

dag: Ka Leeban daa yɛli, Lala viɛla. Ti ni niŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: I agree to that, was Laban's response.

dag: Iso bia Riuɛl bidibisi bɛn daa nyɛ nanima n-daa nyɛ: Nahat mini Zɛra ni Shamma ni Miza. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Riuɛl bidibisi bɛn nyɛ nanima Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Bɛ daa nyɛla Iso paɣ Basɛmat yaansi.
en: These are the sons of Reuel, Esaus son: Chief Nahath, Chief Zerah, Chief Shammah, and Chief Mizzah. These are the tribal chiefs of Reuel in the land of Edom; they are the sons of Esaus wife Basemath.

dag: Ka a yɛli Izraɛlnima, Doo yi kpi ka ka bidibiga, yin zaŋmiya o fali ti o bipuɣiŋga.
en: So tell the Israelites, If a man has no son, when he dies everything he owns will be given to his daughter.

dag: Ka lan yɛli, O yɛli ma ni di bi simdi ni n lab kuna ni nuzaŋa, ka zaŋ chi ŋɔ zaa ti ma.
en: She added, He told me I must not come back to you empty-handed, so he gave me all this barley.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ, Ŋuni n-lee mali kpiɔŋ paai nyin Yawɛ? A ʒiɛyimtali kul gilila a luɣilikam zaa.
en: Lord God Almighty, none is as mighty as you; in all things you are faithful, O Lord .

dag: Rubin mini Gaad ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili maa ni daa mali ti paai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli din bɛ Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, bɛ daa mɛla sara maligu bimbin titali zali nimaani.
en: They went to the place called Geliloth, near the Jordan River in the land of Canaan. There they built a beautiful altar.

dag: Ka ŋunkam shihi dilan bindoo maa, ŋun paɣim o situra ka su kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: If you touch that bed, you must wash your clothes and bathe in water. You will be unclean until evening.

dag: Dama n dimnim kul tɔɣisirila n yɛla, ka bɛn puɣisiri ni bɛ ku ma laɣindi gbaari saawara.
en: My enemies make plans against me. They have met together and are making plans to kill me.

dag: Ka Yisa daa duh o zuɣu n-nya ka salo pam kani o sanna, ka o naanyi bɔhi Filip, Ya polo ka ti lee yɛn nya bindirigu n-da n-ti niriba ŋɔ zaa ka bɛ di n-tiɣi.
en: When Jesus saw the large crowd coming toward him, he asked Philip, Where will we get enough food to feed all these people.

dag: Yisa ni daa yɛl lala maa, ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba bɛn ʒe nimaani ni yino lab o tapaɣa ka bɔh o, Lala ka a garigi maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa.
en: When Jesus said this, one of the guards there slapped him and said, How dare you talk like that to the High Priest.

dag: N ni chɛ ka n zaŋsim be jɛmbu duu ŋɔ ni, ka n gbilisiri tibili wumdi bɛ ni yɛn suhiri suhigu shɛli kpe ŋɔ.
en: I will watch over this Temple and be ready to hear all the prayers that are offered here.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Karimba, m pun dolila dimbɔŋɔnim zaa m bilim ni hal ni wayo.
en: Teacher, the man said, ever since I was young, I have obeyed all these commandments.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ lala paai dabisa shɛm, ka Pool nyee ti nyɔni ka o ŋmaligi tahi kpilikpariga ŋun daa sɔŋdi bipuɣiŋga maa ka o buɣiri baɣiri maa zuɣu n-yɛli, Yisa Masia yuli zuɣu, zom ka chɛ o! Ka kpilikpariga maa daa shiri zo ka chɛ o di saha maa.
en: She continued doing this for many days. This bothered Paul, so he turned and said to the spirit, By the power of Jesus Christ, I command you to come out of her! Immediately, the spirit came out.

dag: Bɛ daa je bindirigu kam; di daa chɛ biɛla ka bɛ kpi.
en: They became so sick that they refused to eat, so they almost died.

dag: Tinsi maa biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee din nyɛ yi ni yɛn zaŋ luɣ shɛŋa ti Lɛvinim maa yɛn zaŋla tinsi maa goma gbini n-chaŋ ti paai mita kɔbisinahi ni pihinu tariga n-gili tinsi maa.
en: The pasture land is to extend outward from the city walls five hundred yards in each direction.

dag: Ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa ti bɔh o ŋahili maa gbinni.
en: His disciples asked him what this parable meant.

dag: Ka Musa daa boli Mishɛl mini Ɛlizafan bɛn daa nyɛ Aduna bapira Uziɛl bidibisi la na n ti yɛli ba, Mirimiya na ti kpuɣi yi mabihi maa luɣ kasi shee ŋɔ yi ti biɛhigu shee ŋɔ kpaŋa.
en: Aarons uncle Uzziel had two sons. They were Mishael and Elzaphan. Moses said to these sons, Come here and get your cousins bodies and carry them away from this holy place and take them outside the camp.

dag: Amaa Lɛvinim bɛn daa birigi chaŋ katiŋ ti jɛmdi buɣa ka chɛ ma saha shɛli Izraɛlnim ni daa birigi la ni nya tibidarigibo.
en: Some of the Levites turned their backs on me and joined the other people of Israel in worshiping idols. So these Levites must be punished!.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa mɔɣis o biɛyanim maa zaa kparima ka kum pam, di nyaaŋa ka o biɛyanim maa daa naanyi tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa.
en: Then, still weeping, he embraced each of his brothers and kissed them. After that, his brothers began to talk with him.

dag: Zaŋmi kuɣ kara niŋ a nuu ni n-chaŋ ti zaŋ li pi bɛ ni zaŋ yaɣiri malimali duno shɛli bɛ ni doli kpɛri Firawuna yili shɛli din be Tapanhɛs maa la ni. Chɛ ka Judanim maa nya a ni piri li shɛm.
en: Jeremiah, carry some large stones to the entrance of the government building in Tahpanhes. Bury the stones underneath the brick pavement and be sure the Jews are watching.

dag: Bɛ zaa birigimi; bɛ zaa nyɛla bɛn tumdi din chihira. Bɛ ni so bi tumdi din tuhi, hal ninvuɣ yino gba kani.
en: But all of them are crooked and corrupt. Not one of them does right.

dag: dimbɔŋɔ gba di yɛn nyɛla taali din simdi ni sariakaritiba darigi n tibili. Dama n daa naan nyɛla ʒiŋmara Naawuni ŋun be zuɣusaa ŋɔ sani.
en: Such a sin should be punished by death; it denies Almighty God.

dag: Di saha maa ka Samsin daa suhi Yawɛ yɛli, Yaa n Duuma Naawuni, n suhir a, teemi n yɛla, ka lan ti ma kpiɔŋ yim kɔŋko pahi, yaa n Duuma Naawuni, ka m bɔhi Filistianim ŋɔ biɛri labisi n nina ayi ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Then Samson called out to the LORD, LORD God, please remember me! Make me strong just this once more, God, so I can have revenge on the Philistines, just one act of revenge for my two eyes.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa chaŋ ti ŋmahi tihi balibu diba ata wula n-kɔrisikɔrisi di paɣiri ka chɛ ka di mali piɛlimpiɛlim, ka chɛ ka di piɛlimpiɛlim maa be palo ni ka di piɛlipiɛla.
en: Jacob cut branches from some poplar trees and from some almond and evergreen trees. He peeled off part of the bark and made the branches look spotted and speckled.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka ninvuɣ biɛri zaɣisi Naawuni, ka yɛri bɛ suhuri ni, A ku kari ti saria di zuɣu.
en: The wicked turn against God because they think he will not punish them.

dag: Yi churi puhibu ni, yi ŋmɛrila goonjɛnim mini mɔɣilɔnima, ka piɛbiri yuhi, ka ŋmɛri guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisa, ka nyuri wain, amaa ka bɛ lihi nya Yawɛ tuma bee n-lihi nya o yiko tuma.
en: They party with lyre and harp, tambourine, flute, and wine; but they ignore the LORDs work; they cant see what God is doing.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa ti dɔɣi bipuɣiŋga m-bol o yuli Daina.
en: Later she bore a daughter, whom she named Dinah.

dag: Amaa zaŋ chaŋ Juda naa ŋun tim ya na ni yi ti bɔhi baŋ din be Yawɛ sani ŋɔ polo, Yɛlimiy o: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya: Zaŋ chaŋ a ni wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa la polo.
en: As for the king himself, this is what I, the Lord God of Israel, say: You listened to what is written in the book.

dag: Ka Naaman daa saɣi, ka chaŋ ti mim Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni siɣimsiɣim buyopɔin kaman Naawuni nir maa ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa, ka nya alaafee zaa. Ka o niŋgbuna lab dimaŋ ni m-be kaman bibil niŋgbuna la.
en: Naaman walked down to the Jordan; he waded out into the water and stooped down in it seven times, just as Elisha had told him. At once, he was cured, and his skin became as smooth as a child's.

dag: Jɔab ni daa chɛ ka bɛ teei gili tiŋ maa, ka o zaŋ Yuria zali o ni mi ni tɔbutuhiri biinsi be shɛli polo.
en: Joab had been carefully watching the city of Rabbah, and he put Uriah in a place where he knew there were some of the enemy's best soldiers.

dag: Tuumbiɛtumdiba ni ti gbani ninvuɣ suma tooni, ka ninvuɣ biɛri ti baɣi wuntizɔriba dunɔdaya.
en: Good people will defeat those who are evil, and the wicked will be forced to show respect to those who live right.

dag: Yisa daa ti baɣisiri Galili Teeku chana nti nya Saimɔn min o tizo Anduru, ka bɛ labiri laŋa teeku ni, dama bɛ daa nyɛla kulipalinima.
en: As Jesus passed alongside the Galilee Sea, he saw two brothers, Simon and Andrew, throwing fishing nets into the sea, for they were fishermen.

dag: N ni chɛ ka a zuliya ti bemi kaman bihigu la, ka nir yi ni tooi kali bihigu, o ni ti tooi kal a zuliya gba.
en: I will make your descendants like the dust of the earth. If someone could count the bits of dust on the earth, then they could also count your descendants.

dag: Tim ti ti zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ bindirigu;.
en: Give us the food we need for each day.

dag: O ni daa yiɣisi zani maa, ka o duh o yee suhi Naawuni daalibarika niŋ Izraɛlnim zaa ni yɛli.
en: In a loud voice he asked God's blessings on all the people assembled there. He said.

dag: Wuntitali nyɛla din tibigiri zuliya, amaa alahichi nyɛla din dihiri niriba vi.
en: Doing right brings honor to a nation, but sin brings disgrace.

dag: Naawuni, a wuntitali zaŋmi hal ti paai sagbana ni. Nyini n-tum tuun kara ŋɔ. Ŋuni n-lee be kaman nyini?.
en: Your deeds of kindness are known in the heavens. No one is like you!.

dag: Ka a chɛ ka a min a bidibisi maa kpe yi duu ka yo yimaŋ niŋ di puuni, ka zaŋ kpam maa m-boori niŋdi ŋmana maa ni; ŋman yini yi ti pali, ka yi vuui li zali kpaŋa.
en: Then you and your sons go into the house, close the door, and start pouring oil into the jars. Set each one aside as soon as it is full.

dag: ni Jarimut naa ni Lakishi naa.
en: Jarmuth, Lachish.

dag: Ka Yisifu yɛli ba, Aai, yi kana ni yi ti nyala ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ gbariginsim ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Joseph said to them, No! You have come to find out where our country is weak.

dag: Ka zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, a kahigi wuhi ma a ni niŋ ma zaɣ viɛlli shɛm, ka bi ku ma saha shɛli Yawɛ ni di zaŋ ma niŋ a nuu ni la.
en: Today you have shown how good you are to me, because you did not kill me, even though the Lord put me in your power.

dag: Ʒiɛmana din gari la puuni, Naawuni daa bi kahigi ashili ŋɔ wuhi ninsalinima, amaa pumpɔŋɔ Naawuni yipa kahigi li o Shia Kasi zuɣu n-wuh o tuumba min o daanabinim bɛn be kasi la.
en: In past times human beings were not told this secret, but God has revealed it now by the Spirit to his holy apostles and prophets.

dag: Ka Jɛrɔbɔam daa ti kani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o pah o yaannim bɛn nyɛ Izraɛl nanim zuɣu; ka o bia Zakaria di nam zan o zaani.
en: Jeroboam died and was buried, and his son Zechariah became king.

dag: ni bunsi tuhi pihita ni kɔbisinu.
en: , donkeys.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka tɔbu daa ti lan lu bɛ mini Filistianim sunsuuni, ka Dauda daa chaŋ ti liri ba n-tuhi nyaŋ ba, ka bɛ ŋmaligi guui.
en: War with the Philistines broke out again. David attacked them and defeated them so thoroughly that they fled.

dag: Yilimiya yil palli, ka ŋme mɔɣilɔnim viɛnyɛliŋga n-yo suhupiɛlli vuri paɣ o!.
en: Sing to him a new song! Play your best with joyful shouts!.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, A mini Aduna ni Nadab ni Abihu ni Izraɛl kpamba pisopɔin dumiya zoli ŋɔ n-ka n sanna nti zani kpaŋ jɛm ma.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Come up the mountain to me, you and Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of the leaders of Israel; and while you are still some distance away, bow down in worship.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa wum Yisa yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ ka bɛ ni shɛb yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, doo ŋɔ shiri nyɛla bɛ ni daa yɛli anab so yɛla la.
en: Some of the people in the crowd heard him say this and said, This man is really the Prophet.

dag: Ka o daa lan leei nyɛvililana n-dii yiɣisi zani; ka Yisa daa yɛli ni bɛ tim bipuɣiŋga maa bindirigu ka o di.
en: She came back to life and got right up. Jesus told them to give her something to eat.

dag: Daba ayi nyaaŋa o ni chɛ ka ti lan niŋ nyɛvili, ka o yiɣisi ti daba ata dali maa n-chɛ ka ti min o lan be.
en: After two days he will bring us back to life. He will raise us up on the third day. Then we can live near him.

dag: Ka a bia yi ti bɔh a daliri shɛli din chɛ ka a doli zaligu maa, nyin yɛlim o, Ti ni daa nyɛ daba be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, Yawɛ n-daa zaŋ o nuu din mali kpiɔŋ n-yihi ti dabitim ni, lala zuɣu ka ti doli zaligu maa.
en: In the future your children will ask what this ceremony means. Explain it to them by saying, The Lord used his mighty power to rescue us from slavery in Egypt.

dag: Ka Jɛhu daa yi nimaani n-chani Samaria n-daa ti paai luɣ shɛli bɛ ni booni Piɛguliba Dooshee la.
en: Jehu left Jezreel to go to Samaria. On the way, at a place called Shepherds' Camp.

dag: amaa paɣ kam ŋun suhiri Naawuni bee n-tɔɣisir anabitali yɛtɔɣa, ka bi zaŋ bini pil o zuɣu ʒiɛmdila o zuɣu, ka di bemi kaman o pin la o zuɣu maa la.
en: But every woman who prays or prophesies should have her head covered. If her head is not covered, she brings shame to her head. Then she is the same as a woman who has her head shaved.

dag: N zaɣisi n yiŋa. N zaŋ n ni su shɛli bahi. N zaŋ n suhu ni yuri ninvuɣ shɛb pam niŋ bɛ dimnim nuu ni.
en: I loved my people and chose them as my very own. But now I will reject them and hand them over to their enemies.

dag: Ka Yawɛ nuu daa pa n zuɣu nimaani ka o yɛli ma, Yiɣisim zani n-chaŋ vinvamli ni ka n ti tɔɣis a yɛtɔɣa nimaani.
en: The LORDs power overcame me, and he said to me: Get up! Go out to the valley, and Ill speak to you there.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa yɛli Dauda, M bia Dauda, Naawuni niŋm alibarika niŋ a ni. A ni ti tum tuma pam, ka di nasara di tumbu ni. Ka Dauda daa chaŋ o chandi, ka Sool mi ŋmaligi kuli.
en: David, my son, I pray that the Lord will bless you and make you successful! Saul went back home. David also left.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa lihi nya ka dɔbba ata ʒiɛya mir o. O ni daa nya ba maa, ka o yiɣis o tanti suɣili dunoli maa ni n-zo n-chaŋ bɛ sani nti damdi ba tiŋa.
en: He looked up and saw three men standing in front of him. When he saw the men, he ran to them and bowed before them.

dag: Ka ŋun daa ʒi lahibali maa na garigi yɛl o, Izraɛlnim vaami guui ka chɛ Filistianima; bɛ ku niriba pam, hal bɛ ku a bih ayi la Hofini mini Finɛhas, ka fa Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka la chaŋ.
en: The messenger answered, Israel ran away from the Philistines; it was a terrible defeat for us! Besides that, your sons Hophni and Phinehas were killed, and God's Covenant Box was captured.

dag: ni bɛ ti to jina baŋ bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm sɔɣ gbaai Yisa ku o.
en: In the meeting they tried to find a way to arrest and kill Jesus without anyone knowing what they were doing. They planned to arrest Jesus and kill him.

dag: Ka o daa kpe n-chaŋ ti zan o dan Ilaisha tooni, ka Ilaisha bɔh o, Gɛhaazi, ya polo ka a lee chaŋ? Ka o garigi yɛl o, Mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ bi chaŋ luɣ shɛli.
en: He went back into the house, and Elisha asked him, Where have you been? Oh, nowhere, sir, he answered.

dag: Jɛhu ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ayopɔin saha ka Jɔash daa di nam n-ʒi Jɛrusalɛm. O daa dila nam maa yuun pihinahi. O ma daa nyɛla Bɛrishiiba paɣa, ka o yuli booni Zibia.
en: Joash became king of Judah in Jehu's seventh year as king of Israel, and he ruled years from Jerusalem. His mother Zibiah was from the town of Beersheba.

dag: Naomi yidan Ɛlimɛlɛk dɔɣir so daa beni ka o yuli booni Bɔaz, o daa nyɛla bundana ni yulilana.
en: Now Naomi had a respected relative, a man of worth, through her husband from the family of Elimelech. His name was Boaz.

dag: Naawuni lan yɛli yaha: A nyɛla Duuma ŋun daa nam dunia ŋɔ piligu ni, ka zuɣusaa mi nyɛ a nuhi ni tum tuun shɛli.
en: He also said, You, Lord, in the beginning created the earth, and with your own hands you made the heavens.

dag: N ni ti ŋme a tɔbu a nuzaa ni bahi, ka a piɛma yi a nudirigu ni lu.
en: But I will knock your bow from your left hand and your arrows from your right hand.

dag: Ka yi yi deei so chinchini sɔŋ pɔi ka naanyi zaŋ o ni bɔr shɛli paŋ o, yin labisim li ti o pɔi ka wuntaŋ naanyi lu.
en: You might take their cloak to make sure they pay the money back, but you must give that cloak back to them before sunset.

dag: Luɣ shɛlikam zaa daa zibigimi agbaa dɛde zaŋ ti paai kurig ata saha.
en: About noon the sky turned dark and stayed that way until around three o'clock.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ ti mabia Apolɔs polo, m balim o pam ni o pahi ti mabihi la zuɣu ka yi sanna, ka o bi yu ni o ka yi sanna pumpɔŋɔ; amaa o yi ti nya dahima o ni bahi kana.
en: I have tried hard to get our friend Apollos to visit you with the other followers. He doesn't want to come just now, but he will come when he can.

dag: nti sɔŋ Yisa tuumba maa tooni, ka bɛ pirigiri li n-tiri bɛ ni sokam kaman di ni simdi ni bɛ zaa deei shɛm tariga.
en: and gave it to the apostles. Then everyone was given whatever they needed.

dag: Zomiya yi Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Sokam tiligim o nyɛvili. Di kpinya di taali zuɣu; dama Yawɛ ni bɔhiri biɛri saha shɛli m-bɔŋɔ; o yɔr li la di tuma samli.
en: Get out of Babylon! Run for your lives! If you stay, you will be killed when I take revenge on the city and punish it for its sins.

dag: Nir yi zaɣisi zaligu dolibu, hal dilan wunsuhigu nyɛla din chihira.
en: When people do not listen to Gods teachings, he does not listen to their prayers.

dag: Binshɛli din ka buchi lan niŋdi dunia ŋɔ ni, dina n-nyɛ: bɛ zaŋdila bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ shɛli niŋ ninvuɣ biɛri n-niŋdi ninvuɣ suma, ka zaŋdi bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ shɛli niŋ ninvuɣ suma n-niŋdi ninvuɣ biɛri. N yɛliya ni dimbɔŋɔ gba ka buchi.
en: But this is nonsense. Look at what happens in the world: sometimes the righteous get the punishment of the wicked, and the wicked get the reward of the righteous. I say it is useless.

dag: Ka wuhiri shihir kara pam, hal ka chɛ ka buɣim yiri zuɣusaa lurina niriba ninni;.
en: It worked mighty miracles, and while people watched, it even made fire come down from the sky.

dag: Timoti yi ti ka yi sanna, yin deemiy o ni suhupiɛlli, dama o tumdila ti Duuma tuma kaman n ni tumdi shɛm.
en: Timothy might come to you. Try to make him feel comfortable with you. He is working for the Lord the same as I am.

dag: N yi yɛli ninvuɣ biɛri, Yinima ninvuɣ biɛri ŋɔ, biɛhiŋ kani, yi ni kpi, ka a bi saɣisi ninvuɣ biɛri maa ka bɛ niŋ tuuba, ninvuɣ biɛri maa ni kpi bɛ tuumbiɛri zuɣu, amaa bɛ kum maa taali ni ʒila a zuɣu.
en: When I tell wicked people they will die because of their sins, you must warn them to turn from their sinful ways. But if you refuse to warn them, you are responsible for their death.

dag: Ti bɔrila suhudoo, amaa ka bi nya zaɣ viɛlli, Ti bɔrila alaafee nyabu saha, amaa ka dabiɛm n-naɣ kul beni.
en: We hoped to have peace, but nothing good has come. We hoped that he would forgive us, but only disaster has come.

dag: Sɔŋmiya Yisa nyaandoliba bɛn be wahala ni, ka niŋmiya saani.
en: Take care of God's needy people and welcome strangers into your home.

dag: N zali zaligu n nam sulinsi ŋɔ ni zaa ni sokam lum Daniɛl Naawuni ŋɔ sizuura. O nyɛla Naawuni ŋun be, ka ni su nam hal ni saha din ka bahigu. O nam maa kul ku saɣim, ka o yiko mi ku mali tariga.
en: I am making a new law. This law is for people in every part of my kingdom. All of you must fear and respect the God of Daniel. Daniels God is the living God; he lives forever. His kingdom will never be destroyed. His rule will never end.

dag: Ti yaannim mini ti nanim ni ti zuɣulaannim ni ti maligumaaniba daa zaɣis a fukumsi zaligu la dolibu, ka daa lan zaɣisi a zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la mini zuɣu ni kpahibu yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa a ni daa zaŋ ti ba la.
en: Our ancestors, our kings, leaders, and priests have not kept your Law. They did not listen to your commands and warnings.

dag: Ka Yawɛ gba ni tuhi lala zuliyanim maa tɔbu kaman o ni daa pun niŋ shɛm tɔbu tuhibu dal la.
en: Then the Lord will go to war with those nations. It will be a real battle.

dag: Ka do so daa be Maɔn ka o tuma shee nyɛ Kamɛl. Doo maa daa mali buni pam. O daa malila piɛri tusaata, ka mali buhi tuhili. Ka o daa ti chɛr o piɛri maa kɔbiri Kamɛl maa.
en: There was a very rich man living in Maon. He had sheep and goats. That man was in Carmel taking care of some business. He went there to cut the wool from his sheep.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa zaŋ ba golimgolim tiŋgban nɛli ni kpa Teeku Ʒiɛɣu polo. Izraɛlnim daa lola tɔbu n-yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: So God led them another way through the desert by the Red Sea. The Israelites were dressed for war when they left Egypt.

dag: N ni darig o tibili o ni daa tam n yɛla Baalnim chuɣu dabisa saha, ka tuɣindi ba tulaale zim, ka pir o nintua, ka ye salima n-zo n-dol o mamanim la zuɣu. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will punish her for the times that she forgot me, when she burned incense to Baal and put on her jewelry to go chasing after her lovers. The Lord has spoken.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ daba ayi nimaani, ka yɛdaniŋdiba maa daa ti chɛbisi ba ni suhupiɛlli ka bɛ lab bɛn daa tim ba na maa sani. .
en: After spending some time there, they were sent off in peace by the believers and went back to those who had sent them.

dag: Nyamiya, m bipuɣiŋga ŋun na ʒi doo mini doo maa mam m-bɔŋɔ; chɛliya ka n zaŋ ba tin ya na pumpɔŋɔ; ka yi niŋ ba yi ni bɔri shɛm, amaa di tumiya doo ŋɔ ŋun vi tuun shɛli.
en: Let me send out my daughter instead. She's a virgin. And I'll even send out the man's wife. You can rape them or do whatever else you want, but please don't do such a horrible thing to this man.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daba ayi ka Naa Agiripa mini Bɛɛnis ka Siizaria na ni bɛ ti puhi Gomna Fɛstus.
en: A few days later King Agrippa and Bernice came to Caesarea to visit Festus.

dag: Nir yi ku ninsala, ka ninvuɣ bɔbili di li shɛhira, bɛn kum ninvuɣ kura maa, amaa di bi tuhi ni bɛ ku so ninvuɣ yino shɛhira dibu zuɣu.
en: Anyone who kills another will be executed on the evidence of witnesses. But one witness alone cannot testify against a person for a death sentence.

dag: Naawuni ni daa tɔɣisi Musa yɛtɔɣa Sinai Zoli maa zuɣu naai, ka o daa zaŋ alikauli kuɣ parilana ayi ti o. Naawuni daa zaŋla o nubila n-sabi sabbu pa di zuɣu.
en: When God finished speaking to Moses on Mount Sinai, he gave him the two stone tablets of the agreement. God had written on the stones with his finger.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun nyo n firila. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ n-chɛ ka neesim neei n zibisim ni.
en: O Lord , you give me light; you dispel my darkness.

dag: Jɛra n-zaŋdi bɛ nuhi taɣindi tab ʒiya, ka chɛ ka kum kuri ba.
en: Some people say, It is foolish to fold your hands and do nothing. If you dont work, you will starve to death.

dag: nti bɔhi ba, Bɔ ka yi lee yɛn ti ma ka n chɛ ka Yisa kpe yi nuu ni? Ka bɛ daa ti o anzinfa laɣibaligu bini pihita.
en: He said, I will hand Jesus over to you. What will you pay me for doing this? The priests gave him silver coins.

dag: M bia, dim shiri, dama di nyɛla din viɛla, ka shikpam din tɔɣiri shigbaŋ ni na nyɛla din nyaɣis a noli ni.
en: My child, eat honey, for it is good. The honeycomb is sweet in your mouth.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa yɛli Filip, Guumi paai chɛchɛbuŋ ŋɔ lana.
en: The Spirit told Philip, Approach this carriage and stay with it.

dag: Lala ka bɛ daa niŋ yiɣisi niriba mini bɛ kpamba ni Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba suhuri, ka bɛ daa kabina nti gbaai Stiivin tahi jintɔriba sani.
en: They turned the people and their leaders and the teachers of the Law of Moses against Stephen. Then they all grabbed him and dragged him in front of the council.

dag: Ka sapashin kpɛm maa yɛl o, N daa yihila liɣiri pam da Rom tiŋbitali. Ka Pool yɛl o, Bɛ kul dɔɣila mani Rom tiŋbia.
en: The commander said, I became one by paying a large amount of money. But I am one by birth, Paul answered.

dag: Jɛhɔahaz ni daa tum shɛlikam pahi min o ni daa tum shɛlikam ni o kpiɔŋ tuma zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: Everything else Jehoahaz did while he was king, including his brave deeds, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Niriba maa daa jɛmdi Yawɛ, ka daa lan pii bɛ ni ninvuɣ shɛba n-leei maligumaaniba ka bɛ maani maligu bɛ ni jɛmdi buɣa luɣ shɛŋa la tiri ba.
en: But they also worshiped the Lord . They chose priests for the high places from among the people. These priests made sacrifices for the people in the temples at those places of worship.

dag: Pool daa lan yɛli, N ni daa ti lab Jɛrusalɛm na nti be Naawuni jɛmbu duu suhiri Naawuni saha shɛli.
en: When I returned to Jerusalem and was praying in the temple, I had a visionary experience.

dag: Ka yi yi ti wum ni bɛ tuhiri tɔbu, ka wumdi ŋumaŋuma ni tɔb shɛŋa na yɛn tuhi, yin di chɛliya ka yi suhiri zɔhira; dama faashee dimbɔŋɔnim zaa bahi niŋ, amaa di ti bi yɛn wuhi ni dunia yiɣisibu saha paami maa.
en: When you hear of wars and reports of wars, dont be alarmed. These things must happen, but this isnt the end yet.

dag: Ka kpiimba kum ni neebu yi kani, dindina Masia daa bi neei kum ni m-bala.
en: If that is true, it means that Christ was not raised;.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa yɛri taba, Yɛlimaŋli, ti ni daa niŋ ti mabia la shɛm la samli n-yɔri ti ŋɔ, o ni daa balim ti ka ti daa nya o suhusaɣiŋgu ni nyɛ shɛm, amaa ka zaɣisi wumbu la; dinzuɣu ka suhusaɣiŋgu ŋɔ ti paai ti gba maa.
en: They said to each other, We are being punished for the bad thing we did to our younger brother Joseph. We saw the trouble he was in. He begged us to save him, but we refused to listen. So now we are in trouble.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa gbaai Sool zaŋ chaŋ Dauda polo, dama Yawɛ daa chɛ ŋun Sool, ka bela Dauda sani.
en: Saul was afraid of David because the LORD was with David but no longer with Saul.

dag: Bɛn su bipuɣiŋga maa ni daa nya ka bɛ ku lan di o baɣibuɣibo maa nyɔri maa ka bɛ daa gbaai Pool mini Silas n-vo ba tahi tiŋ maa kpamba sani daa puuni.
en: When the men who owned the servant girl saw this, they realized that they could no longer use her to make money. So they grabbed Paul and Silas and dragged them to the public square to meet with the authorities.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino ŋun yuli daa booni Agabus daa ti yiɣisi zani n-yɛli Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni ni kum ni lu pam dunia zaa ni; ka di daa ti shiri niŋ pali Naa Klɔdius nam dibu saha.
en: One of them, named Agabus, stood up and spoke with the help of the Spirit. He said, A very bad time is coming to the whole world. There will be no food for people to eat.

dag: Ka ya polo ka n lee yɛn zaŋ vi ŋɔ kpe? Ka sokam ni bol a jɛrigu Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, dinzuɣu jaande, yɛlim naa, o ni zaŋ ma ti a.
en: Think of me. I'll be disgraced forever! And think of yourself. Everyone in Israel will say you're nothing but trash! Just ask the king, and he will let you marry me.

dag: ka Naawuni nira Ilaisha sɔŋda Gɛhaazi yɛl o suhu ni, N dana fa Naaman ŋun nyɛ Siria nir ŋɔ bahi, o ni zaɣis o ni ʒi pin shɛŋa na nti ti o la zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, n ni kar o naba ti deei shɛli o sani.
en: But Gehazi, the servant of Elisha the man of God, said, Look, my master has let Naaman the Aramean go without accepting the gift that he brought. As the Lord lives, I will run after Naaman and get something from him.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Bɛtilihɛm din be Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la; dama anab so daa sab yɛli:.
en: They told him, He will be born in Bethlehem, just as the prophet wrote.

dag: Ka Jɔn yɛli ba, So ku tooi mali shɛli ka di pa ni Naawuni n-ti o li.
en: John answered, A person can receive only what God gives.

dag: Ka Ɛhab daa tim ti laɣim Izraɛlnim zaa mini anabinim maa na Kamɛl Zoli zuɣu.
en: So Ahab called all the Israelites and those prophets to Mount Carmel.

dag: Ka so ni daa kani simdi ni o bɔɣi litaafi maa n-lihi di puuni maa zuɣu daa chɛ ka n kum pam.
en: I cried hard because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or look inside it.

dag: dindina nyin chɛ ka n dimnim kari doli ma hal ti gbaai ma n-no ma sɔŋ tiŋa, ka zaŋ ma pi taŋkpaɣu ni.
en: then let my enemy not only chase but catch me, trampling my life into the ground, laying my reputation in the dirt. Selah.

dag: Ka n daa nya ka yi tum alahichi ni yɛlimaŋli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani. Yi daa ŋmaligiya yomyom ka chɛ Yawɛ ni zali ya ni yi doli so shɛli maa, ka doola naɣibil kɔtomsi zali yimaŋa.
en: I saw that you had already disobeyed the command that the Lord your God had given you, and that you had sinned against him by making yourselves a metal idol in the form of a bull-calf.

dag: Niŋmiy o larigim ka miriya ka yi kul chaŋ mir o yiŋ dunoli.
en: Stay away from a bad woman! Don't even go near the door of her house.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi do n-gbihira? Yiɣisimiya yirigimiya yimaŋ zuɣu, ka suhimiya Naawuni ni yi di ti lu zahimbu puuni.
en: He said to them, Why are you sleeping? Get up and pray so that you wont give in to temptation.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti paai Nakɔn kabɔɣili ni, ka naɣila shɛb bɛn daa vɔri tɔroko maa tuui, di saha ka Yuza daa teeg o nuu gbaai Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa mali.
en: When they approached Nacons threshing floor, Uzzah reached out to Gods chest and grabbed it because the oxen had stumbled.

dag: Ŋun yi zuɣusaa na gari sokam zaa; ŋun yi dunia ŋɔ ni na nyɛla dunia ŋɔ nira, ka tɔɣisiri dunia ŋɔ yɛla; amaa ŋun yi alizanda ni na gari sokam zaa.
en: The one who comes from above is above all things. The one who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks as one from the earth. The one who comes from heaven is above all things.

dag: Ti yi nya wahala, di nyɛla yi suhumaabo mini yi tiliginsim nyabu zuɣu; ka ti yi nya suhumaabo, di nyɛla yi suhumaabo shɛli yi ni nyari yi ni niŋdi suɣilo n-diri wahala shɛŋa ti gba ni diri la zuɣu.
en: So if we have trouble, it is to bring you comfort and salvation. If we are comforted, it is to bring you comfort from the experience of endurance while you go through the same sufferings that we also suffer.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yihi li suɣili maa ni n-zaŋ li na ti ti Jɔshua mini Izraɛlnim zaa, ka bɛ daa zaŋ li sɔŋ Yawɛ tooni.
en: They brought them out of the tent, took them to Joshua and all the Israelites, and laid them down in the presence of the Lord .

dag: O bi tamd o daalikauli yɛla, o mi bi tamd o ni yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zali ʒiɛmana tuhili niriba yɛla.
en: He will remember his agreement forever. He will always keep the promises he made to his people.

dag: Ninsal ni tooi fa Naawuni? Amaa yinim fari ma mi. Amaa ka yi bɔhira, Wula ka ti lee fa a? Yi binyara pirigibu bupia kam puuni yim tibu mini yi sara pina tibu puuni.
en: Should a person deceive God? Yet you deceive me. But you say, How have we deceived you? With your tenth-part gifts and offerings.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka n fabila paag a sanna. Tim ma baŋsim kaman a ni pun lo ma alikauli shɛm.
en: Please, Lord , hear my prayer and give me the understanding that comes from your word.

dag: A ni tooi kali bɛ ni dandi bɛ baɣa chɛra shɛm tariga? Ka a mi bɛ dɔɣibu saha?.
en: Can you count the months of pregnancy; do you know when they give birth?.

dag: ni Ibram, .
en: and Abram.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni chɛ ka Nɛbukadnɛza ŋun nyɛ Babilɔn naa, ka lan nyɛ nanim zaa nazuɣu ŋɔ zaŋ yuri mini chɛchɛbunsi ni wɔribariba ni tɔbbihi pam bɛn mali yaa n-yi nuzaa polo na ti liri Taainima.
en: The LORD God proclaims: Im bringing Nebuchadrezzar against Tyre, the king of Babylon from the north, the greatest of all kings, with horses, chariots, and charioteers, an assembly, a great army.

dag: Bɛ ni daa laɣim maa ka bɛ yihi Yisa tuumba ayi maa na nti zali bɛ sunsuuni m-bɔhi ba, Ŋun yiko bee ŋun yuli ka yi lee zaŋ tum yi ni tum tuun shɛli ŋɔ.
en: They brought in Peter and John and made them stand in the middle while they questioned them. They asked, By what power and in whose name have you done this.

dag: Bɛ zaŋdila jɛrilim n-dihi bɛn tɛha bi zilima nachiinsi, amaa baŋsim n-nyɛ yɛnnim zuɣupila.
en: Stupidity leads to foolishness; be smart and learn.

dag: O daa yɛli ba, Nyamiya, yi yi chaŋ yin chamiya ti sɔɣi dɔni tiŋ maa gulinyaaŋa; di kaɣiya ti do katiŋa ka chɛ tiŋ maa, ka maliya shili viɛnyɛliŋga gu;.
en: with these orders: Hide on the other side of the city, but not too far away from it; be ready to attack.

dag: ka mali dapaɣa ayi niŋ di nyaaŋa lɔrisi la ni.
en: and two frames for the corners.

dag: ni Ahimaaz ŋun daa be Naftali.
en: Ahimaaz was governor of Naphtali. He was married to Basemath the daughter of Solomon.

dag: Bom sipirɛs dari din mali kpiɔŋ mali ŋariŋ, ka niŋ duri niŋ di ni, ka bo diɣiri n-tabilitabili di puuni mini di nyaaŋa.
en: Get some good lumber and build a boat. Put rooms in it and cover it with tar inside and out.

dag: Ka o ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Ka yi mi lee yɛli ni n nyɛla ŋuni? Ka Pita garigi yɛl o, A nyɛla Masia.
en: Then Jesus asked, But who do you say I am? You are the Messiah! Peter replied.

dag: Ka bɛnkam zaa daa yi n-chaŋ tiŋ maa dunol ni maa daa saɣi Hamɔr min o bia Shɛkɛm ni yɛli shɛm maa; ka dɔbba bɛn zaa daa yi n-chaŋ bɛ tiŋ maa dunol ni maa daa guni.
en: All the men who heard this in the meeting place agreed with Hamor and Shechem. And every man was circumcised at that time.

dag: Dapaɣili kam daa malila dashɛbira ayi din ni chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ li tuɣi taba. Bɛ daa niŋla Naawuni biɛhigu shee suɣili dapaɣa maa zaa lala.
en: with two wooden pegs near the bottom. Then two silver stands were placed under each frame with sockets for the pegs, so they could be joined together. Twenty of these frames were used along the south side and more along the north.

dag: nti zaŋ ya chaŋ niriba maa tiŋgban nɛli ni, ka m mini ya gbɛri ti kpa taba, ka n kari ya saria.
en: I will lead you into a desert as I did before, but this will be a place where other nations live. We will stand face to face, and I will judge you.

dag: Di saha ka m bɔhi malaika maa, Ka bɔ ka olivi tih ayi din ʒe m-baɣi firilatamdigu la yaɣa ayi la mi lee wuhira?.
en: Then I said to him, I saw one olive tree on the right side of the lampstand and one on the left side. What do those two olive trees mean.

dag: Yi daa kali Jɛrusalɛm yiya, ka wurim yiya maa n-zaŋ di bilichiisi me di gooni zali.
en: You counted Jerusalems houses, and you tore down houses to fortify the wall.

dag: Man Yawɛ ni daŋ tila Judanim nasara, din ni chɛ ka Naa Dauda zuliya mini Jɛrusalɛmnim ni yɛn nya jilima shɛli ku gari Judanim dini.
en: I, the Lord , will give victory to the armies of Judah first, so that the honor which the descendants of David and the people of Jerusalem will receive will be no greater than that of the rest of Judah.

dag: Yumiya taba kaman mabi yinsi la, ka timiya tab jilima viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Love one another warmly as Christians, and be eager to show respect for one another.

dag: Gbib a suhu n-gari binshɛɣukam, dama di ni ka nyɛvili bilisiri yirina.
en: Carefully guard your thoughts because they are the source of true life.

dag: Bɔ ka n lee yɛn zaŋ yo Yawɛ o ni niŋ ma nirilim shɛŋa la zaa zuɣu?.
en: What can I offer the Lord for all his goodness to me?.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa gbaai Jɛhɔshafat, ka o niŋ nimmoo suhi Yawɛ, ka moli molo ni sokam lom noli Juda tiŋgbani maa ni zaa.
en: Jehoshaphat was frightened and prayed to the Lord for guidance. Then he gave orders for a fast to be observed throughout the country.

dag: Wula ka nir lee yɛn garigi yɛli Filistianim tuumba? Yawɛ m-me Ziɔn zali, ka o niriba bɛn nyɛ nandaamba ni nya biɛhigu shee nimaani.
en: How shall we answer the messengers that come to us from Philistia? We will tell them that the Lord has established Zion and that his suffering people will find safety there.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa tim tuumba ka bɛ yi Kɛdɛmɔt tiŋgban nɛli ni n-chaŋ Hɛshibɔn naa Sihɔn sani nti zaŋ suhudoo yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ yɛl o.
en: I then sent messengers from the Kedemoth desert to Sihon, Heshbons king, with words of peace.

dag: Yisa daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa la o ni daa wuhiri niriba Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni liɣiri tɔhibu shee la; amaa ka so daa bi gbaag o, dama o saha daa na bi paai.
en: Jesus said these things while he was teaching in the Temple area, near the room where the Temple offerings were kept. But no one arrested him, because the right time for him had not yet come.

dag: A zahindi maa ni nyɛ shɛm m-bala. To, ti ni wuhi nyin naa di gbinni.
en: This was the dream. Now I will tell Your Majesty what it means.

dag: Ka o daa mali dundombila ti maligumaaniba, ka lan mali dundɔn titali, ka mali pundi niŋ li, ka dooi daanya pa di pundi maa zuɣu.
en: Solomon gave orders to build two courtyards: a smaller one that only priests could use and a larger one. The doors to these courtyards were covered with bronze.

dag: Yi yi baŋ dimbɔŋɔnima ka dol li, yi ni nya alibarika.
en: You know these things, and God will bless you, if you do them.

dag: Zɛbulɔn zuliya n-daa pah ata n-nyɛ bɛ ni ti shɛb tiŋgbani kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm. Bɛ tiŋgbani maa daa zaŋmi hal ti paai Sarid.
en: The third assignment made was for the families of the tribe of Zebulun. The land which they received reached as far as Sarid.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla nirilimlana ni ŋun be tibi. Ti Naawuni maa nyɛla nambɔzɔra.
en: The LORD is merciful and righteous; our God is compassionate.

dag: Di simdi ni cheechi sɔŋdiba malila paɣ yinoyino, ka tooi gbib bɛ bihi mini bɛ yiŋnim viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Servants must be faithful to their spouse and manage their children and their own households well.

dag: Di saha ka Balaam daa zaŋ o daanabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli: Zipɔr bia Balak, yiɣisima. Luɣim a tiba wum n ni yɛn yɛli shɛm.
en: Then Balaam said this: Stand up, Balak, and listen to me. Hear me, Balak son of Zippor.

dag: Ka bɛ sɔŋdi taba, ka yɛra, M mali suhukpeeni.
en: The skilled workers help and encourage each other.

dag: Ka o daa dɔni o naba tiŋli maa, amaa ka daa ti daŋ yiɣisibu asibaasi ŋaraŋara saha shɛli so ni ku tooi nya o baŋ o, dama Bɔaz daa bi bɔri ni so baŋ ni o ka nimaani na.
en: Ruth lay down again, but she got up before daylight, because Boaz did not want anyone to know she had been there.

dag: ka o nyaandoliba bɔh o, Karimba, doo ŋɔ laamba daalahichi zuɣu n-chɛ ka bɛ dɔɣ o zom ŋɔ bee omaŋmaŋ daalahichi zuɣu.
en: Jesus followers asked him, Teacher, why was this man born blind? Whose sin made it happen? Was it his own sin or that of his parents.

dag: Dinzuɣu di nyɛnya jɛra, amaa bomiya baŋ ti Duuma yubu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Don't be fools, then, but try to find out what the Lord wants you to do.

dag: O yi yiɣisi zani, dabiɛm gbahirila wuna, ka bɛ zɔri dabiɛm ka labi nyaaŋa.
en: The divine beings dread his rising; they withdraw before his thrashing.

dag: Yawɛ zɔbu nyɛla din tiri nir nyɛvili wɔɣinli, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn yuma ni nyɛla biɛla.
en: Respect for the Lord will add years to your life, but the wicked will have their lives cut short.

dag: ni naɣila kpaba pia mini naɣ pisi bɛn nyari mɔri ŋubiri viɛnyɛliŋga ni piɛri kɔbiga m-pahi wolidibisi ni kparibudibisi ni saŋkpalindibisi ni no kara.
en: ten head of grain-fattened cattle; twenty head of pastured cattle; one hundred sheep; as well as deer, gazelles, roebucks, and the best of fowl.

dag: N lan nya ka bɛ mi n-sɔɣi ninvuɣ biɛri ka bɛ nyɛla bɛn daa kpɛri luɣ kasi shee ka yira; amaa ka niriba paɣiri ba tin shɛl ni bɛ ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa maa zuɣu. Dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: I saw the wicked buried with honor, but God's people had to leave the holy city and were forgotten. None of this makes sense.

dag: Ti mali suhupiɛlli o zuɣu, ti ni niŋ o yuli din be kasi ŋɔ naani zuɣu.
en: He makes us happy. We trust his holy name.

dag: Dunia nanima mini zuliya kam zaa ni nabihi ni tiŋgbana zuɣulaannim zaa, paɣimiy o!.
en: Do the same, you kings of the earth and every single person, you princes and every single ruler on earth!.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ zaa ha daa gbaai bɛ daliri ni nyɛ shɛm wuhibu. Ŋun daŋ tooni daa yɛlila tumo maa, N dala puu, ka yɛn chaŋ ti nya li, dinzuɣu n suhir o gaafara.
en: But they all began, one after another, to make excuses. The first one told the servant, I have bought a field and must go and look at it; please accept my apologies.

dag: Ka o daa ti yɛl o bia maa, Zom chaŋ ti pihi n ni yɛn to peen shɛŋa ŋɔ na. Bia maa ni daa zɔri chani maa, ka o to piɛm bah o tooni ha.
en: He said to the boy, Go quickly and retrieve the arrow that I shoot. So the boy ran off, and he shot an arrow beyond him.

dag: amaa di daa sabila ti gba zuɣu. Naawuni ni zaŋ tinim bɛn niŋ ŋun Naawuni ŋun daa neei ti Duuma Yisa kum ni yɛda ŋɔ gba zali wuntia zaani ti yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: They were written also for us who are to be accepted as righteous, who believe in him who raised Jesus our Lord from death.

dag: di ŋmalig a nini bahi kpaŋa ka chɛ ma. Di je suli n-kari man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ bahi. Nyini m-pun nyɛ n sɔŋda. Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n tiliginsim ŋɔ, di chɛ ma bee n-zaŋ ma bahi.
en: Don't hide yourself from me! Don't be angry with me; don't turn your servant away. You have been my help; don't leave me, don't abandon me, O God, my savior.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa ti bari zani bɛ zaashɛhi Balitama n-zaŋ bɛ nyɔri yo ba; ka Izraɛlnim shɛb bɛn daa sɔɣ doya la yi bɛ sɔɣibu shee din be Gɛba wulinluhili polo na.
en: So when the main army of the Israelites pulled back and regrouped at Baaltamar, the men surrounding Gibeah suddenly rushed out of their hiding places in the rocky country around the city.

dag: Ka salo maa ni niriba pam daa zaŋ bɛ binyɛra n-teeri sɔŋdi sol ni, ka bɛ ni shɛb mi ŋahiri tiwula din mali vari sɔŋdi soli maa ni.
en: On the way to Jerusalem, many people spread their coats on the road for Jesus. Others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.

dag: Tuumbiɛrinim maa zaa so ʒimi? Bɛ zaŋla n niriba n-leei bindirigu dira, ka bi jɛmdi ma.
en: Are they dumb, all these evildoers, devouring my people like they are eating bread but never calling on the LORD?.

dag: Di bemi kaman Naawuni Kundi ni luɣ shɛli ni yɛli shɛm la: N niŋ yɛda, dinzuɣu ka n tɔɣisira. Ti gba ni niŋ yɛda kaman ŋun daa sab sabbu maa zuɣu, ka ti gba tɔɣisira.
en: In the Scriptures it says, I spoke because I had faith. We have this same kind of faith. So we speak.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma yi dundɔntitali ni zaŋ kpa nuzaa polo nti zaŋ ma kpe du shɛŋa din daa be Naawuni jɛmbu duu sambani tooni polo mini du shɛli din daa be nuzaa polo tooni.
en: Then the man took me into the outer courtyard and led me to a building on the north side of the Temple, not far from the building at the west end of the Temple.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa zaŋ tɔrili zaɣ titali kpiŋkpama ayi ti paɣ maa ni o yiɣi zo ka chɛ wahu maa n-chaŋ mɔɣu ni ti be luɣ shɛli Naawuni ni yɛn dihir o hal ti paai yuma ata ni pirigili.
en: She was given the two wings of a large eagle in order to fly to her place in the desert, where she will be taken care of for three and a half years, safe from the dragon's attack.

dag: O daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋla sida dapaɣa n-kpahi tabili duu maa puuni dukpina gbinni zaŋ hal ti gbaai siiliŋ yɔɣira, ka zaŋ dari mali di puuni; ka zaŋ sipirɛs dapaɣa mi m-mali di puuni tiŋa.
en: The floor of the temple was made out of pine, and the walls were lined with cedar from floor to ceiling.

dag: Dama Yawɛ pun pii Ziɔn. O bɔri ni o zaŋ li leeg o biɛhigu shee. O daa yɛliya.
en: Because the LORD chose Zion; he wanted it for his home.

dag: Luɣ shɛlikam zaa m mini n niriba Izraɛlnim maa ni daa chaŋ, n daa na mi m-bɔhi sariakaritib shɛb n ni daa pii zali ni bɛ su n niriba Izraɛlnim la, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bi zaŋ sida dari me duu ti ma? .
en: I chose leaders and told them to be like shepherds for my people Israel. But did I ever say anything to even one of them about building a cedar temple for me?.

dag: Ka Dan zuliya niriba maa daa ŋmaligi chaŋ. Maika ni daa nya ka bɛ mali kpiɔŋ gar o maa, ka o ŋmaligi lab kuli.
en: Then the Danites went on. Micah saw that they were too strong for him, so he turned and went back home.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti di bɛ ni daa ʒi kawaan shɛli Ijipti na maa naai saha shɛli ka bɛ ba yɛli ba, Labimiya ti da bindirigu biɛla na nti ti ti yaha.
en: and when they had eaten all the grain that they brought from Egypt, their father said to them, Go back and buy us a little food.

dag: Noombihi zaa daa tɛrila bɛ tɛri di wula zuɣu; ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri daa dɔɣiri bɛ bihi di mahim, ka zuliya pam ʒiini di mahim.
en: All the birds of the sky made their nests in the branches of that tree, and all the animals of the field gave birth under the branches of that tree. All the great nations lived under the shade of that tree.

dag: Jɛriko niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisita ni pihinahinaanu.
en: of Jericho.

dag: Ka Hitinim maa daa zaŋ palo maa mini siliga din daa be di ni maa ti Ibrahimma, ka di leeg o dini, ka o zaŋ li leeg o kpiimba sɔɣibu shee.
en: The field and the cave in it were officially transferred from the Hittites to Abraham as his burial property.

dag: Ka tumtumdi kpeem bilikɔɣino ŋɔ dan maa daa paɣ o pam o dahin shɛli tɛha maa zuɣu, dama bɛn doli zibisim soli dunia ŋɔ ni mali yɛmbimbiɛri bɛ tuma ni gari bɛn doli neesim soli.
en: As a result the master of this dishonest manager praised him for doing such a shrewd thing; because the people of this world are much more shrewd in handling their affairs than the people who belong to the light.

dag: Zaŋmiya bidib tuuli kam ti ma. Bɛ ni kul tuui dɔɣi binshɛɣukam ka o nyɛ zaɣ lɔɣu, ninsal bee biŋkɔbigu Izraɛlnim sunsuuni nyɛla n dini.
en: You must give me every male in Israel who is his mothers first child. That means that every firstborn baby boy and every firstborn male animal will be mine.

dag: Ninvuɣ so daa kani n-lo o suhu ni n-tum zaɣ biɛɣu Yawɛ sani n-lan paai Ɛhab ŋun paɣ Jɛzibɛl daa kpaŋs o ka o tum zaɣ biɛɣu la.
en: So Ahab sold himself out to do what the Lord says is evil. There is no one who did as much evil as Ahab and his wife Jezebel, who caused him to do these things.

dag: Nyama, Naawuni nyari tibigibu o yiko puuni. Karimba ŋuni n-lee paag o?.
en: Remember how great is God's power; he is the greatest teacher of all.

dag: Yinim Izraɛlnima, n yi ti niŋ ya din viɛla n yuli zuɣu ka pa ni yi tuumbiɛri mini yi biɛri yoli ni simdi shɛm zuɣu, yi ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Family of Israel, you did many evil things, and you should be destroyed because of them. But to protect my good name, I will not give you the punishment you really deserve. Then you will know that I am the Lord . This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: N di bi zaɣisi ka m mi n ni yɛn nya o luɣ shɛli polo, ka n di chaŋ hal ni o biɛhigu shee.
en: How I wish I knew where to find him, and knew how to go where he is.

dag: Ka naa maa daa ŋmaligi kul o yiŋa nti kɔŋ gom dindali maa yuŋ. O daa bi di shɛli bee n-saɣi ka so ŋme biŋkumdi shɛli n-niŋ o.
en: Then King Darius went back to his house. He did not eat that night. He did not want anyone to come and entertain him. He could not sleep all night.

dag: A yi tahi kom maa zuɣu, di guurimi, ka a yi chɛ ka saa tahi, kom maa zɔrimi chana.
en: Then your voice thundered! And the water flowed.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ ka puu maa lan yɛl o nachin kpɛma, Cham ti boli tumtumdiba maa na ti yo ba. Daŋmi bɛn yoli kana la yɔbu pɔi, ka naanyi yo bɛn di daŋna la.
en: When evening came, the owner of the vineyard said to his manager, Call the workers and give them their wages, beginning with the last ones hired and moving on finally to the first.

dag: bɛn kul tumdi tuumbiɛri ka deeri birapu niriba san la.
en: in whose hands are evil schemes, whose strong hands are full of bribes.

dag: Yi yi yuri taba, dina n-ni chɛ ka sokam baŋ ni yi nyɛla n nyaandoliba. .
en: If you love each other, everyone will know that you are my disciples.

dag: So miri ka o zaŋ o ba mabia ŋun nyɛ doo paɣa dɔni, dama o nyɛla o ma.
en: You must not have sexual relations with the wife of your fathers brother. You must not go near your uncles wife for sexual relations. She is your aunt.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, A mini Aduna ni Nadab ni Abihu ni Izraɛl kpamba pisopɔin dumiya zoli ŋɔ n-ka n sanna nti zani kpaŋ jɛm ma.
en: Then the LORD said to Moses, Come up to the LORD, you and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of Israels elders, and worship from a distance.

dag: Nyama, dimbɔŋɔnim nyaaŋa ka n daa lihi alizanda ni n-nya ka duno shɛli yooi yɛya, ka n wum n ni daa pun tuui wum kukol shɛl la ka di be kaman kikaa kumsi la yɛri ma na: Dum kpe na ka n ti wuh a din yɛn niŋ dimbɔŋɔnim nyaaŋa.
en: Then I looked, and there before me was an open door in heaven. And I heard the same voice that spoke to me before. It was the voice that sounded like a trumpet. It said, Come up here, and I will show you what must happen after this.

dag: Binshɛɣukam din daa sabi kurimbuni ha daa sabila ti wuhibu zuɣu ni di chɛ ka ti daanzansi niŋbu mini Naawuni Kundi suhukpaŋsibo chɛ ka ti mali tahima.
en: Everything written in the Scriptures was written to teach us, in order that we might have hope through the patience and encouragement which the Scriptures give us.

dag: Dinzuɣu mmaŋmaŋ bee m mabihi bee n sɔŋdiba bee ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nyɛ guliba bɛn doli ma la ni so daa bi yeei ti situra. Ti zaɣ yino kam daa kul gbibila o bidibbini o nudirigu ni.
en: Neither I nor my relatives, nor my servants, nor my bodyguards took off our clothes, even when they sent for water.

dag: O daa malila pua, ka wolisiri n-kuhiri ni biɛrim pam ni o dɔɣi.
en: She was about to give birth, and she was crying because of the great pain.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Judanim tuumbiɛri buta ni bunahi zuɣu, n ku chɛ bɛ tibili darigibu. Dama bɛ zaɣisi Yawɛ zalikpana la, ka bi dol o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la, amaa ka bɛ ʒiri ŋmabu chɛ ka bɛ birigi n-doli bɛ yaannim ni daa doli so shɛŋa la.
en: The Lord says, The people of Judah have sinned again and again, and for this I will certainly punish them. They have despised my teachings and have not kept my commands. They have been led astray by the same false gods that their ancestors served.

dag: Amaa so yi zaŋ o ni su shɛli ti Yawɛ zaa, di yi nyɛla daadam bee biŋkɔbigu bee o ni di tiŋgban shɛli fali, di bi simdi ni bɛ kɔhi li bee n-yo di zuɣu ka dee li, bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛlikam ti Yawɛ nyɛla din be kasi zaa.
en: Anything that you completely dedicate to me must be completely destroyed. It cannot be bought back or sold. Every person, animal, and piece of property that you dedicate completely is only for me.

dag: ka o yɛligu mi ka yi suhuri ni, dama yi bi niŋ o ni tim so na la yɛda.
en: You have not believed his message, because you refused to have faith in the one he sent.

dag: Gbibi ma kaman nimbil biɛlim la; ka zaŋm ma sɔɣ a kpiŋkpama mahim ni.
en: Protect me as you would your very eyes; hide me in the shadow of your wings.

dag: Ka naɣ kara ayopɔin bɛn niŋgbuna kul nyɛlisiri daa yi Nail Mɔɣili maa ni na ti ŋubiri mɔri.
en: In the dream, seven cows came out of the river and stood there eating grass. They were healthy, good-looking cows.

dag: Ka sokam ni ti jɛn ya n yuli zuɣu. Amaa ŋunkam ti niŋ suhukpeeni hal ni wahala ŋɔ bahigu ni ti tiligi.
en: Everyone will hate you because you follow me. But the one who remains faithful to the end will be saved.

dag: ka yɛli, Nyin Sintani bia ŋɔ, nyin ŋun nyɛ wuntia tuuni kam dima, ka yɔhiŋgu mini bilikɔnsi tuma pal a kɔbili ni ŋɔ, a nyɛla ŋun kul kpaŋd amaŋ ni a zaŋ ti Duuma yɛlimaŋli soya leei ʒiri.
en: and said, You son of the devil, full of lies and all kinds of evil tricks! You are an enemy of everything that is right. Will you never stop trying to change the Lords truths into lies?.

dag: Ka malaikanim bɛn zaa daa ʒe n-gili nam ʒiishee maa mini kpamba la ni binnɛma anahi la daa gbani nam ʒiishee maa tooni n-jɛmdi Naawuni.
en: The angels who stood around the throne knelt in front of it with their faces to the ground. The elders and the four living creatures knelt there with them. Then they all worshiped God.

dag: M mabihi, n ni daa ka yi sanna la, pa yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din to ni baŋbu bee yɛm yɛtɔɣa din yi bɔhimbu pam puuni na ka n daa zaŋ Naawuni daashili yɛlimaŋli yɛla la kahigiri wuhiri ya.
en: When I came to you, my friends, to preach God's secret truth, I did not use big words and great learning.

dag: Miriya ka yi pahi ninvuɣ bɔbigu zuɣu tum tuumbiɛɣu bee m-pahi bɛ zuɣu bɛ ʒiri shɛhira dibu ni.
en: Dont take sides with important people to do wrong. When you act as a witness, dont stretch the truth to favor important people.

dag: Dama zuliya pam mini na kara ni ti zaŋ bɛ gba leei daba, ka n ti yo ba bɛ biɛhigu mini bɛ nuhi tuma samli kaman di ni simdi shɛm.
en: Yes, many great nations and powerful kings will enslave them, and I will pay them back in full for what they have done and made with their hands.

dag: Ka Jɔab ŋun daa nyɛ Zɛruya bia la mini Dauda tɔbbihi mi daa yi n-chaŋ ti paai ba Gibiɔn biaŋ ni n-chaŋ ti ʒini biaŋ maa yaɣ yini polo ka bɛn la mi chaŋ ti ʒini biaŋ maa yaɣ din la polo.
en: Joab, Zeruiahs son, and the officers of David also went to Gibeon. They met Abner and Ish Bosheths officers at the pool of Gibeon. Abners group sat on one side of the pool. Joabs group sat on the other side.

dag: Dauda daa lan tuhi nyaŋ Hadadɛza ŋun daa nyɛ Zɔba naa la, zaŋ labi Hamat polo, o ni daa chaŋ ni o ti zaŋ bini zal o Sulinsi tariga Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli luɣ shɛli la.
en: David also fought against Hadadezers army. Hadadezer was the king of Zobah. David fought against that army all the way to the town of Hamath. David did this when he went to set up a monument for himself at the Euphrates River.

dag: Ŋun wurindi niriba la kana ti liri ya. Guliya yi ni zaani gooni zuɣu luɣ shɛŋa tuhiri tɔbu la. Lihimiya soli zuɣu, lomiya kpara. Laɣimmiya yi tɔbbi kpɛma zaa.
en: Nineveh, someone is coming to attack and scatter you. Guard your fortresses! Watch the road! Be brave! Prepare for battle!.

dag: Ka Izraɛl Naa Jɛhɔash daa chɛ ka bɛ lab ti yɛli Juda Naa Amazia ni dahin shɛli ka Lɛbanɔn goo tutuɣu daa ti tim ti yɛli Lɛbanɔn sida, Zaŋm a bipuɣiŋga ti ma ka n-niŋ m paɣa; ka Lɛbanɔn mɔɣu ni biŋkɔb so daa kana ti no goo tutuɣu maa sɔŋ tiŋa.
en: Jehoash sent back this reply: Once upon a time, a small thornbush in Lebanon announced that his son was going to marry the daughter of a large cedar tree. But a wild animal came along and trampled the small bush.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa.
en: Again the Lord said to Moses.

dag: Anabinim mini karimbanim daa be Antiɔk cheechi ni. Bɛna n-nyɛ Baanabas mini Simiɔn ŋun yuli daa lan booni Naija la ni Lusius ŋun daa nyɛ Sairiini tiŋbia la mini Manaɛn, bɛ ni daa laɣim wumsi so mini Naa Hɛrɔd la m-pahi Sool.
en: In the church at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers. They were Barnabas, Simeon , Lucius , Manaen , and Saul.

dag: Amaa dabili maa yi zani yim yɛli, N yuri n dana maa mini m paɣa ni m bihi, dinzuɣu n ku chaŋ.
en: But if the slave decides that he wants to stay with the master, he must say, I love my master. I love my wife and my children. I will not become free—I will stay.

dag: Yawɛ ni lan chɛ ka dɔro balibu kam mini alaka balibu kam din yɛla bi sabi zaligu kundi ŋɔ ni lu yi zuɣu hal ti naai yi balibu.
en: The Lord will even bring troubles and diseases that are not written in this Book of Teachings . He will continue to do this until you are destroyed.

dag: Chamiya ti du zoya zuɣu ŋ-ŋma dari na ti me n jɛmbu duu maa; ka n suhu paligi di zuɣu, ka lan nya jilima di ni.
en: Go up to the highlands and bring back wood. Rebuild the temple so that I may enjoy it and that I may be honored, says the LORD.

dag: Ninsalinim azichi ku tooi tiligi ba kum ni; bɛ ni bahi kpi kaman biŋkɔbiri ni kpiri shɛm la.
en: Wealthy people dont seem to understand that they will die like the animals.

dag: So miri ka o zaŋ o tizɔpaɣa dɔni, o yi nyɛla o ba bipuɣiŋga bee o ma bipuɣiŋga, bɛ yi dɔɣ o la yiŋa bee luɣ shɛli polo.
en: Don't have sex with your sister or stepsister, whether you grew up together or not.

dag: Naawuni daanfaani maa zuɣu ka yi tiligi yi yɛda niŋbu puuni. Ka di bi yila yi kɔbili ni na, amaa di nyɛla Naawuni pini.
en: You are saved by Gods grace because of your faith. This salvation is Gods gift. Its not something you possessed.

dag: Yi lihirila binyara niŋgbuŋkom. So be yi ni n-tɛhi ni o nyɛla Masia nira? Di simdi ni dilan teeg omaŋa ni ti gba nyɛla Masia niriba kaman o ni nyɛ Masia nir shɛm.
en: You are looking at the outward appearance of things. Are there some there who reckon themselves to belong to Christ? Well, let them think again about themselves, because we belong to Christ just as much as they do.

dag: Bɛ ni ti doli Yawɛ, ka o ti ŋum kaman gbuɣinli la; yɛlimaŋli, o shiri ni ti ŋum, ka o niriba ti yi wulinluhili polo na ka bɛ ni sɔhira.
en: I, the Lord , will roar like a lion, and my children will come and follow me. They will come from the west, shaking with fear.

dag: Dinzuɣu n dana, yɛlim a tumtumdib zaa bɛn be a sani ŋɔ ni bɛ lihim nya ninvuɣ so ŋun mi mɔɣilo ŋmɛbu viɛnyɛliŋga ti a, ka Naawuni ni chɛ ka alizin biɛ so kana ti muɣisir a maa yi ti lan siɣ a zuɣu na, ka dilan ŋme mɔɣilo maa, a ni nya amaŋa.
en: Your Majesty, let us go and look for someone who is good at playing the harp. He can play for you whenever the evil spirit from God bothers you, and you'll feel better.

dag: M mabihi, m paɣi ti tizɔpaɣ so ŋun yuli booni Fiibi, ka o nyɛ ŋun tumdi Naawuni tuma Sɛnkiria cheechi ni la.
en: I recommend to you our sister Phoebe, who serves the church at Cenchreae.

dag: N suhu kul tɔrila pampam ka n kpiɔŋ zaa naai, ka n nina niŋ liti.
en: My heart pounds; my strength abandons me. Even the light of my eyes is gone.

dag: Bɛ ni daa dɔɣi bi shɛb Jɛrusalɛm ti o maa yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Shammua mini Shɔbab ni Neetan ni Sulemaana ni.
en: His sons who were born there were Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon.
