dag: yɛlimaŋli, yi ni tooi zaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni pii ninvuɣ so n-leei yi naa ka o sun ya. Yi ni tooi zaŋ yi zuliya ni nira n-leei yi naa. Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ tinzun nira ŋun pa yi mabia n-leei yi naa.
en: You can indeed appoint over you a king that the LORD your God selects. You can appoint over you a king who is one of your fellow Israelites. You are not allowed to appoint over you a foreigner who is not one of your fellow Israelites.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni ti di yi tuma nyɔri, ka di yi nia biɛri tiɣi.
en: They filled their lives with what they wanted. They went their own way, so they will get what they deserve.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri suhuri kul yɛla ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma zuɣu, amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn nyaɣa nyɛla din tahiri wala na.
en: Desiring evil is a trap for the wicked, but the root of the righteous endures.

dag: Ka teeku daa yihi kpiimba bɛn be di ni na, ka Kum mini Kpiimba Biɛhigu Shee yihi kpiimba bɛn be di ni na, ka o daa zaŋ bɛ zaa ni tum tuun shɛŋa n-kari ba saria.
en: The sea gave up the dead that were in it, and Death and the Grave gave up the dead that were in them, and people were judged by what they had done.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa chɛ ka bɛ mali daanya sara maligu bimbini ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita awɛi, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita awɛi, ka di dubu mi nyɛ mita anahi ni pirigili.
en: Solomon had a bronze altar made that was nine meters square and four and a half meters high.

dag: Ka Saimɔn Pita yɛl o, N Duuma, dindina pa n naba kɔŋko, amaa paɣimi n naba zaŋ tabili n nuhi ni n zuɣu zaa.
en: Simon Peter said, Lord, after you wash my feet, wash my hands and my head too.

dag: Farisiinima n-daa tim tuumba maa Jɔn sani maa.
en: Those sent by the Pharisees.

dag: N ni daa pun yɛli ya shɛlikam zaa la niŋya, ka yi ni saɣi yɛli ni n ni daa yɛli shɛm maa nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. Pumpɔŋɔ n yɛn yɛli ya la yɛl pala, di nyɛla ashili yɛl shɛŋa yi ni na ʒi.
en: You heard what I said, and you have seen it happen. Now admit it's true! I will show you secrets you have never known.

dag: Amaa ŋun mi n ni doli so shɛli, o yi vihi ma o ni nya ka n viɛlimi kaman salima la.
en: Yet God knows every step I take; if he tests me, he will find me pure.

dag: dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ ninʒeensinim liriti ma mi. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ ninkuunsinim lo nia ni bɛ ku ma. Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn baɣa ka Naawuni ni.
en: Proud people are coming to attack me; cruel people are trying to kill me— those who do not care about God.

dag: A ŋme n-wurisi Rahab kaman binkpiŋ la, a zaŋ a kpiɔŋ wurim a dimnim bahi.
en: You crushed the monster Rahab and killed it; with your mighty strength you defeated your enemies.

dag: Ka Ijipti naa daa zaŋ o mabia Ɛliakim leei Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm naa, ka taɣ o yuli m-bol o Jɛhoyakim; amaa ka daa zaŋ Jɛhoyakim mabia Jɛhɔahaz kuli Ijipti.
en: Neco made Joahaz' brother Eliakim king of Judah and changed his name to Jehoiakim. Joahaz was taken to Egypt by Neco.

dag: O daa yihi Izraɛlnim Ijipti. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Give thanks to the one who brought Israel out of there— Gods faithful love lasts forever.

dag: ka di ʒiɛmya anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu.
en: or ignore prophecies.

dag: A yi zahim n suhu, a yi ka n sanna yuŋ ti buɣisi ma viɛnyɛliŋga, a ni nya ka ninvuɣ biɛtali ka n ni; ka m mi noli bi tumd alahichi.
en: You know my heart, and even during the night you have tested me and found me innocent. I have made up my mind never to tell a lie.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ dunia ŋɔ zaa naa; Yilimiya yila paɣ o!.
en: the ruler of all the earth! Praise God with songs.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋa n-nyɛ ti shɛhira gbaŋ din sab ti suhuri ni ni sokam nya li karim.
en: But you are our letter, and you are in our hearts for everyone to read and understand.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛli Itai, Dindina garim ka ti chaŋ. Di saha ka Itai ŋun daa nyɛ Gaat nir maa min o niriba zaa ni bibihi bɛn daa be o sani zaa gari tooni.
en: Fine! David answered. March on! So Ittai went on with all his men and their dependents.

dag: M paɣiri Naawuni so n ni jɛmdi n suhu ni tɛha din ka galimi puuni kaman n yaannim ni daa jɛm o shɛm la. N kul teer a yɛla n wunsuhigu ni yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni, ka paɣiri Naawuni di zuɣu.
en: I always remember you in my prayers day and night. And in these prayers I thank God for you. He is the God my ancestors served, and I have always served him with a clear conscience.

dag: Ka Naaman yɛl o, Chɛ ka n zaŋ anzinfa laɣibaligu tusaayi ti a. Ka o daa balim o zaŋ anzinfa laɣibaligu tusaayi mini binyɛr suma ayi din nyɛ chuɣu binyɛra maa n-niŋ kpalans ayi ni lo n-zaŋ ʒil o tumtumdiba ayi, ka bɛ zaŋ li ʒi m-be Gɛhaazi tooni.
en: Naaman said, By all means, take two kikkars! He encouraged Gehazi to accept them. He tied two kikkars of silver up in two bags, along with two changes of clothes. Naaman gave them to two of his servants, and they carried them in front of Gehazi.

dag: Chɛ ka Izraɛlnim yɛli, Yawɛ yi di daa bi be ti polo.
en: What if the Lord had not been on our side? Answer, O Israel!.

dag: Takɔriti kulis ata daa beni. Takɔriti maa daa tuhila taba, ka tam tab ʒii buta zuɣu.
en: On each of the two side walls there were three rows of windows.

dag: Bɛ lɔna ŋmanila gbala din kabi, ka bɛ mali bɛ zilima yɔhindi niriba. Tinvura lɔɣu be bɛ naŋgbampiba ni.
en: Their words are like an open pit, and their tongues are good only for telling lies. Each word is as deadly as the fangs of a snake.

dag: Saha shɛli Jɛrimia ni daa be yiliguliba dundɔŋ la ni ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o.
en: While I was still imprisoned in the palace courtyard, the Lord told me.

dag: Ka di simdi ka o lihi dɔro maa, ka dɔro maa yi be yili maa dukpina zuɣu, ka zaɣ baŋkom garisi di ni bee bin ʒiɛhi gari di ni, ka di kpe dukpini maa puuni.
en: He will look at the mildew. If the mildew on the walls of the house has holes that are a green or red color, and if the mildew goes into the walls surface.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, N dima n-niŋ ma lala maa. Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ka daɣila a bɔri ni ti chaŋ ti sib li bahi.
en: It was some enemy who did this, he answered. Do you want us to go and pull up the weeds? they asked him.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, So bi mi dindali bee di saha, hal malaikanim bɛn be alizanda ni mini Naawuni Bia la gba bi mi li; faashee o Ba maa kɔŋko n-naɣ mi li.
en: No one knows, however, when that day or hour will come—neither the angels in heaven, nor the Son; only the Father knows.

dag: A ni kpi ŋun bi guni kum tinzunnim nuu ni. Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala. .
en: Strangers will treat you like a foreigner and kill you, because I gave the command! This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: N dabili m-bɔŋɔ. N ni pii so ni n suhu ni yu so m-bala. N zaŋ n shia niŋ o ni. O ni ti wuhi niriba zaligu soli.
en: The Lord says, Here is my servant, whom I strengthen— the one I have chosen, with whom I am pleased. I have filled him with my Spirit, and he will bring justice to every nation.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, nahiŋgu nyɛla din chɛri ka yɛndan niŋdi jɛrigu, ka birapu dibu mi saɣindi nira.
en: Oppression turns the wise into fools; a bribe corrupts the heart.

dag: Yɛhudianim bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm daa ti tim maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinima ni bɛ ti bɔhi Jɔn ni o lee nyɛla ŋuni.
en: The religious authorities in Jerusalem sent priests and temple helpers to ask John who he was. He told them plainly, I am not the Messiah.

dag: Ka yi daa nya ka bɛ chibichibi Dauda tiŋ la gooni voya; ka yi daa taɣi kom sɔŋ di biaŋ din be tiŋli la ni.
en: You found the places where the walls of Jerusalem needed repair. You inspected all the houses in Jerusalem and tore some of them down to get stones to repair the city walls. In order to store water.

dag: O bi chɛ ka ti tam o daalahiziba tumtumsa yɛla. Yawɛ nyɛla nirilimlana ni nambɔzɔra.
en: The Lord God is famous for his wonderful deeds, and he is kind and merciful.

dag: Zaŋmiya binnɛma balibu kam bɛn nyɛ noonsi mini biŋkɔbiri ni binnɛma bɛn zaa gbamdi tiŋa n-yina, ka bɛ ti dɔɣi pam nab pali dunia ŋɔ.
en: Take all the birds and animals out with you, so that they may reproduce and spread over all the earth.

dag: Hal bɛ daa gbaai Lɔt ŋun daa nyɛ Ibram tizo bia la gba, ka zaŋ o nɛma pahi chaŋ.
en: Lot, the son of Abrams brother, was living in Sodom, and they captured him. They also took everything he owned and left.

dag: Bɛ jɛmdi ma sahakam. Bɛ ŋmanila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi din tuhi, ka nyɛ bɛn suhuri ye n soli baŋbu zuɣu; ka bi tam bɛ Naawuni zaligu yɛla. Bɛ bɔri ni bɛ baŋ n saria karibu soli din tuhi yɛla. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn bɔri ni Naawuni miri ba.
en: They still come every day to worship me, acting as if they want to learn my ways. They pretend to be a nation that lives right and obeys the commands of their God. They ask me to judge them fairly. They want their God to be near them.

dag: Ŋunkam zu o ba bee o ma binshɛli ka yɛli ni di pala zaɣ biɛɣu, dilan nyɛla ŋun pahi ninvuɣ kuriba ni.
en: Someone might steal from their parents and say, I did nothing wrong. But that person is as bad as an enemy who smashes everything in the house.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa ti labina ti yɛli Yaakubu, Ti chaŋ a biɛli Iso sani, ka o zaŋ ninvuɣ kɔbisinahi pa omaŋ zuɣu n-kanna ni o ti tuh a soli.
en: The messengers returned to Jacob and said, We went out to your brother Esau, and hes coming to meet you with four hundred men.

dag: Bɛ daa lan yɛli Jɔshua, Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti ti. Ka din pahi nyɛla tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim zaa suhuri fuŋmi ti zuɣu.
en: and then said, We are sure that the Lord has given us the whole country. All the people there are terrified of us.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa deei Liya suhigu ka o niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga ŋun pah anu ti Yaakubu.
en: Then God allowed Leah to become pregnant again. She gave birth to a fifth son.

dag: Ka noonsi tɛri bɛ tɛri di zuɣu, ka shinshingoorɔnim tɛri bɛ tɛri gɔhi tihi zuɣu.
en: Thats where the birds make their nests, and the storks live in the fir trees.

dag: Nir yi sɔɣi Yawɛ sani, di so ni a niŋ nabihi naani.
en: It is better to trust in the Lord than to trust in great leaders.

dag: Bɛ daa wɔbirila giŋgaɣiri mini tuturi vari ni sɔɣu jila ŋ-ŋubira.
en: who pluck off the leaves on a bush, the root of the broom— a shrub is their food.

dag: Gol so ŋun daa pahir ata ni ka bɛ daa piligi li gbilligbilli sɔŋbu, zaŋ chaŋ gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin ni ka bɛ daa sɔŋ li gbilligbilli maa naai.
en: The people began to bring these things in the third month and they finished bringing the collection in the seventh month.

dag: Yawɛ daa lan yɛli ma.
en: The LORD spoke again to me.

dag: ka di ti nyɛ shihirili yi sani. Ka yi bihi yi ti bɔhi ya dahin shɛli ha, Ka kuɣ bɔnima n-lee bɔŋɔ.
en: These stones will remind the people of what the Lord has done. In the future, when your children ask what these stones mean to you.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi ku yi dɔbba, ka ku yi tɔbutuhiriba tɔbu ni.
en: Your men will be killed with swords. Your heroes will die in war.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda mini ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu bɛn daa be o sani maa daa yiɣisi n-chaŋ ti paai Bɛso kulibɔŋ ni, ka bɛn daa be nyaaŋa la kpalim nimaani.
en: David led his men to Besor Gorge, but of them were too tired to go across. So they stayed behind, while David and the other men crossed the gorge.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa pii niriba maa zuliyazuliya n-zali gooni maa nyaaŋa Palɔni naɣilima ni mini paliyari ni, ka bɛ gbibi takɔbiri mini kpana ni tɔbiri.
en: So I took up a position in the lowest parts of the space behind the wall in an open area. Then I stationed the people by families, and they had their swords, spears, and bows.

dag: Ka yi yi suhiri Naawuni, yin di mali yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ din ka gbinni kaman bɛn pa Yɛhudianim ni niŋdi shɛm la, dama bɛ tɛhiri ni bɛ yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ zuɣu ka Naawuni ni deei bɛ suhigu.
en: When you pray, don't talk on and on as people do who don't know God. They think God likes to hear long prayers.

dag: Di chɛ ka munaafichinim be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. Chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu di bɛn yuri duŋ taabu pam!.
en: Let no slanderer be safe in the land. Let calamity hunt down violent people—and quickly!.

dag: Amaa o ni zaŋ kokpɛɣu naag o dimnim zaa, ka kar o dimnim maa kpɛhi zibisim ni.
en: With a rushing flood, he will utterly destroy her place and pursue his enemies into darkness.

dag: Izraɛl zuɣulaannim bɛn be a ni zaŋla bɛmaŋmaŋ yiko kuri niriba.
en: Look, Israels princes, every one of them, have joined forces to shed blood in you.

dag: Ka o kuhi yɛli, N yab Ibrahimma, zom ma nambɔɣu n-tim Lazarɔs na ka o ti zaŋ o nubil tim kom ni n-tɔɣisi pa n zilinli zuɣu ka di maai, dama n nyari azaaba pam buɣim ŋɔ ni.
en: He called, Father Abraham, have mercy on me! Send Lazarus to me so that he can dip his finger in water and cool my tongue. I am suffering in this fire.

dag: Di saha ka yi ti lan deei Yawɛ noli, ka doli o fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa zaa n ni zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: And you will again obey the Lord . You will obey all his commands that I give you today.

dag: Bɛ ni daa baptaizi ya saha shɛl la, yi mini Masia ka bɛ daa laɣim sɔɣi maa, ka yi mini Masia laɣim n-neei kum ni yi ni daa niŋ Naawuni ŋun daa neei Masia kum ni yiko tuma yɛda la zuɣu.
en: You were buried with him through baptism and raised with him through faith in the power of God, who raised him from the dead.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka yinyari mini zoontali ni suhufuŋbo be yi suhuri ni;.
en: The Lord will punish you by making you crazy. He will make you blind and confused.

dag: Ka do so daa be nimaani n-garigi bɔhi ba, Ka anabinim maa ba lee nyɛ ŋuni? Dinzuɣu lala yɛtɔɣili maa daa leei yɛtɔɣ ŋahili ka bɛ mal li yɛra, Sool gba nyɛla anabi.
en: One of the locals then asked, And who is their leader? So it became a proverb: Is Saul also one of the prophets.

dag: Ka Izraɛl paɣisara chani yuuni kam ti zaŋdi daba anahi fabindi Jɛfita Giliad nir la bipuɣiŋga maa zuɣu.
en: Every year the young women of Israel would go out for four days to remember the daughter of Jephthah from Gilead and to cry for her.

dag: Dama ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Yawɛ saawaralana n-nya o ka wum o yɛligu? Ŋuni n-lee wum o yɛligu ka nyɛ ŋun ni tooi mol li?.
en: But who has stood in the LORDs council to listen to Gods word? Who has paid attention to his word and announced it?.

dag: Nyini n-yɛn wuhiri binshɛŋa din be kasi mini binshɛŋa din bi be kasi ni binshɛŋa din nyɛ daɣiri mini binshɛŋa din pa daɣiri.
en: You must be able to clearly tell the difference between what is holy and what is not holy, between what is clean and what is unclean.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ Shia daa siɣi Jɛfita zuɣu na. Ka o daa yiɣisi chaŋ ti tim Giliad mini Manaasa tiŋgbana ni n-gari chaŋ Mizipa din be Giliad tiŋgban ni la n-daa yi Mizipa din be Giliad tiŋgban ni maa gari chaŋ Ammɔnnim tiŋgban ni.
en: Then the Lord 's Spirit took control of Jephthah, and Jephthah went through Gilead and Manasseh, raising an army. Finally, he arrived at Mizpah in Gilead, where.

dag: Ka o shi sara maligu biŋkɔbigu maa ŋ-ŋmahiŋmah o.
en: Then you shall skin the animal and cut it up.

dag: Izraɛl Naa Jɛrɔbɔam ŋun pah ayi ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisinaayopɔin saha ka Amazia bia Uzia daa di Juda nam.
en: Azariah son of Amaziah became king of Judah in Jeroboam's twenty-seventh year as king of Israel.

dag: Din beni nyɛla: Zaligu kurili la leela din daai baɣili kpaŋa di gbariginsim mini di ni ka buchi zuɣu.
en: The old rule is now ended because it was weak and worthless.

dag: Ka Lamɛk daa kpuɣi paɣiba ayi, ka yino yuli booni Ada, ka yino mi yuli booni Zilla.
en: Lamech had two wives, Adah and Zillah.

dag: Ka Dilaila daa ti yɛli Samsin, Niŋm ania wuhi ma din chɛ ka a mali kpiɔŋ pam maa, ka wuhi ma nir ni yɛn niŋ shɛm lo a mihi nyaŋ a.
en: So Delilah said to Samson, Please tell me what gives you such great strength and how you can be tied up and made weak.

dag: N zaŋ dimbɔŋɔ zaa niŋ n suhu ni, ka zahim di zaa nya wuntizɔriba mini yɛnnim tuma ni be Naawuni nuu ni shɛm. Di yi nyɛ yurilim bee jɛlinsi, so ku tooi baŋ. Binshɛɣukam din paari ba nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: I thought about all this very carefully. I saw that God controls what happens to the good and wise people and what they do. People dont know if they will be loved or hated, and they dont know what will happen in the future.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa chɛ ka bɛ mali daanya sara maligu bimbini ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita awɛi, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita awɛi, ka di dubu mi nyɛ mita anahi ni pirigili.
en: He made a bronze altar that was cubits long, cubits wide, and cubits tall.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ niriba maa sara maligu maa na nti yihi niriba alahichi sanyoo sara shɛli din daa nyɛ bua la n-kɔrig o zaŋ mali alahichi sanyoo sara kaman tuuli alahichi sanyoo sara maligu la.
en: Then Aaron brought the peoples offering. He killed the goat of the sin offering that was for the people. He offered the goat for sin, like the earlier sin offering.

dag: Dinzuɣu lomiya ania n-doli dinkam sabi Musa zaligu ni la, ka miriya ka yi ŋmaligi kpa nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo ka chɛ li.
en: You must be careful to obey every command written in the Book of the Law of Moses . Never turn away from that law.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan yɛli Dauda, Kamina ka ti chaŋ mɔɣu ni. Ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa yi n-chaŋ mɔɣu ni.
en: Come on, Jonathan said to David. Lets go into the field. So both of them went out into the field.

dag: Di saha ka Reechɛl mini Liya daa yɛl o, Binshɛli ka ti ba yiŋa ka ti yɛn di li fali.
en: Rachel and Leah answered Jacob, Our father has nothing to give us when he dies.

dag: Ishimail bidibisi yuya kaman bɛ ni daa dɔɣ ba pa tab shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nɛbaiɔt ŋun daa nyɛ o bituuli la mini Kɛdar ni Adibiil ni Mibisam.
en: had the following sons, listed in the order of their birth: Nebaioth, Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam.

dag: Di pa shɛli n niŋgbuŋ mini n suhu zaa ni ti gbarigi. Amaa Naawuni n-nyɛ n kpiɔŋ n suhu ni ni ŋun kul su ma sahakam.
en: Maybe my mind and body will become weak, but God is my source of strength. He is mine forever!.

dag: Sool daa bela Gibia tintariga pumpɔrinchihi tia din be Migirɔn la gbini; ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be o sani daa nyɛla kaman dɔbba kɔbisiyɔbu laasabu.
en: Saul was sitting on the outskirts of Gibeah under the pomegranate tree at Migron. He had about six hundred men with him.

dag: Ka Sool yɛl o, Amalɛknim maa sani ka bɛ ʒi ba na, niriba maa n-daa chɛ piɛ viɛla mini naɣ viɛla maa n-zaŋ ba na ni bɛ ti mali sara ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ; amaa ti daa saɣim dinkam kpalim zaa.
en: They were taken from the Amalekites, Saul said, because the troops spared the best sheep and cattle in order to sacrifice them to the LORD your God. The rest was placed under the ban.

dag: Ka n daa wum kukol shɛli damli alizanda ni, ka di vuri kaman kokpɛɣu bee saa ni yi tahiri shɛm la. N ni daa wum kukol shɛli maa daa ŋmanila mɔɣilo ŋmɛriba ni yi ŋmɛri bɛ mɔɣilɔnim ka di kumsi vuri shɛm la.
en: And I heard a voice from heaven that sounded like a roaring waterfall, like a loud peal of thunder. It sounded like the music made by musicians playing their harps.

dag: Kɔhat bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Amiram mini Izar ni Hɛburɔn ni Uziɛl.
en: Kohaths family: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

dag: Bɛ daa malila dapaɣa ayi niŋ Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa nyaaŋa lɔris ayi la ni.
en: and two frames for the corners.

dag: Bɛnkam doli Naawuni Shia Kasi ni wuhiri ba so shɛli, bɛna n-nyɛ Naawuni bihi.
en: Those who are led by God's Spirit are God's children.

dag: O wurim o suɣili la kaman ʒiɛvari puu la. O wurim o jɛmbu duu la. Yawɛ chɛ ka Ziɔnnim tam bɛ churi puhibu mini bɛ vuhim dabisa yɛla. O suhu ni yiɣisi pam zuɣu, o zaɣisila naa mini maligumaana.
en: He shattered his temple like a hut in a garden; he completely wiped out his meeting place, and did away with festivals and Sabbaths in the city of Zion. In his fierce anger he rejected our king and priests.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Di sabiya yaha, Miri ka a zahim a Duuma Naawuni. .
en: Jesus answered, The Scriptures also say, You must not test the Lord your God.

dag: Di yi pa lala, o yi pil li mɛbu ka bi tooi me n-naai, ŋunkam nya li lala ni mal o ansarisi.
en: Otherwise, you will start building the tower, but not be able to finish. Then everyone who sees what is happening will laugh at you.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka baŋdiba bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm mali maʒin shɛŋa tamtam binwɔɣila zuɣu mini tiŋ maa gooni gɔŋbu shee kam, ka bɛ mal li tɔri piɛma, ka labiri kuɣ kara, ka o yuli daa du n-chaŋ katiŋa, dama o daa nya sɔŋsim pam hal ka o yaa ti kirisi.
en: In Jerusalem his inventors made equipment for shooting arrows and for throwing large stones from the towers and corners of the city wall. His fame spread everywhere, and he became very powerful because of the help he received from God.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa suhi Yawɛ bɛ wahala maa puuni, ka o daa yihi ba bɛ nandahima maa ni.
en: They were in trouble, so they called to the Lord for help, and he saved them from their troubles.

dag: ka bɛ ba Ifriim daa kum bɛ zuɣu dabisi gbaliŋ, ka o dɔɣiriba daa kana ti maag o suhu la.
en: Ephraim mourned for his sons a long time, and his relatives came to comfort him.

dag: Amɔs ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛkɔa piɛgul la yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ. O daa nya li zaŋ chaŋla Izraɛlnim polo Juda Naa Yuzaia mini Jɔash bia Jɛrɔbɔam ŋun daa nyɛ Izraɛl naa la ʒiɛman ni. Di saha di daa chɛla yuma ayi ni tiŋgbani dambu la niŋ.
en: These are the words of Amos, a shepherd from the town of Tekoa. Two years before the earthquake, when Uzziah was king of Judah and Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel, God revealed to Amos all these things about Israel.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, bɛ nyɛla bɛn chani kpɛri yiya ni n-saɣindi bɛ dahima; ka di pala di kɔŋko, bɛ lan nyɛla bɛn leei niriba nyaanzuriba mini bɛn dari gindi kpɛri niriba yɛla ni n-yɛri din bi simdi ni bɛ yɛli.
en: Besides, they will become lazy and get into the habit of going from house to house. Next, they will start gossiping and become busybodies, talking about things that are none of their business.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa laɣim taba n-ka Dauda sanna Hiburɔn ti yɛl o, Nyama, ti nyɛla a daŋ niriba.
en: All the Israelites gathered around David at Hebron. Were your own flesh and blood, they said.

dag: O daa poya Yawɛ sani. O daa po pɔri Yaakubu Naawuni ŋun nyɛ kpiɔŋlan ŋɔ sani yɛli.
en: Mighty God of Jacob, remember how he promised:.

dag: Kuɣ shɛli tammɛriba ni zaɣisi la, n-yipa leei kuɣ gahindili.
en: The stone that the builders tossed aside has now become the most important stone.

dag: ka lan mi o yubu, ka ʒe din tuhi nyaaŋa, ka di nyɛla Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni wuh a lala zuɣu.
en: By reading the Scriptures you learn how God wants you to behave, and you discover what is right.

dag: Ka yi yi ti wum ni bɛ tuhiri tɔbu, ka wumdi ŋumaŋuma ni tɔb shɛŋa na yɛn tuhi, yin di chɛliya ka yi suhiri zɔhira; dama faashee dimbɔŋɔnim zaa bahi niŋ, amaa di ti bi yɛn wuhi ni dunia yiɣisibu saha paami maa.
en: You will hear about wars that are being fought. And you will hear stories about other wars beginning. But dont be afraid. These things must happen before the end comes.

dag: Daniɛl daa lo o suhu ni ni o ku di nayili bindirigu maa bee n-nyu wain shɛli naa ni daa nyurila n-saɣim omaŋa; dinzuɣu ka o daa suhi namɔɣilisi kpɛm maa n-yɛl o ni o bi lo ni o saɣim omaŋa nayili bindirigu maa dibu ni, lala zuɣu ni o sɔŋm o.
en: Daniel made up his mind to eat and drink only what God had approved for his people to eat. And he asked the king's chief official for permission not to eat the food and wine served in the royal palace.

dag: Ɛba ni daa dɔɣi Pɛlɛg maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisinahi ni pihita. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: after that, he lived another years and had other children.

dag: O daa zaŋ ma zali pal tital ni. O daa tiligi ma, dama o nini daa tiɣi ma.
en: He brought me out to wide-open spaces; he pulled me out, because he is pleased with me.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum ka o tɔɣisiri ba Hiburuli ni maa ka bɛ maan fo baalim; di saha ka o yɛli.
en: When the Jews heard Paul speaking Aramaic, they became very quiet. Then Paul said.

dag: Ka Yisa daa chaŋ ti shihi ba ka yɛli ba, Yiɣisimiya! Di zɔriya dabiɛm.
en: But Jesus came to them and touched them. He said, Stand up. Dont be afraid.

dag: Hiburɔn bidibisi ni, Jɛria n-daa nyɛ kpɛma n-zaŋ Amaria pa, Jahaziɛl n-daa pah ata, ka Jɛkamiam pah anahi.
en: Hebrons oldest son was Jeriah. Hebrons second son was Amariah. Jahaziel was the third son, and Jekameam was the fourth son.

dag: ka niŋ tipawumli n-gbibi nyɔtaɣirisi din tibisa n-zɔri na ni bɛ ti tuh o.
en: and have attacked him with their weapons.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdi shɛb daa yɛli bɛ suhuri ni, Doo ŋɔ mɔri Naawuni.
en: Some legal experts said among themselves, This man is insulting God.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb nyɛ namɔɣilisi la bɛ dɔɣibu ni, ka salinim niŋ shɛb lala, ka shɛb mi zaŋ bɛmaŋ leei lala niriba la alizanda nam zuɣu. Ŋun ni tooi deei wuhibu ŋɔ, ŋun deem li.
en: For there are different reasons why men cannot marry: some, because they were born that way; others, because men made them that way; and others do not marry for the sake of the Kingdom of heaven. Let him who can accept this teaching do so.

dag: Dama o kul pala nina lihiri ninsalinim biɛhigu, ka nyari bɛ napɔna yaabu zaa.
en: Gods eyes are on human ways, and he sees all their steps.

dag: Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba maa, Wummiya pukpar bimbira ŋahili la gbinni:.
en: Listen, then, and learn what the parable of the sower means.

dag: Di saha ka n daa neei gom ni n-lihi ka n gom maa niŋ ma nyaɣisim pam.
en: After hearing that, I, Jeremiah, woke up and looked around. My sleep was very pleasant.

dag: N ni yɛri shɛm zabiri mmaŋ zuɣu m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Some people want to judge me. So this is the answer I give them:.

dag: Di piligu dali zaŋ hal ti paai di naabu dali, Ɛzra daa kul karindila Naawuni zaligu litaafi maa dabisili kam. Daba ayopɔin ka bɛ daa zaŋ puhi chuɣu maa, ka daa niŋ Naawuni jɛmbu laɣiŋgu dabisi shɛli din pahir anii dali kaman zaligu ni daa wuhi shɛm.
en: On each of the first seven days of the festival, Ezra read to the people from God's Law. Then on the eighth day, everyone gathered for worship, just as the Law had said they must.

dag: Tammɛriba ni daa sɔŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa tampuɣili, maligumaaniba daa yɛla bɛ kpariti n-zani bɛ zaashɛhi ka gbib kikahi ni bɛ paɣi Yawɛ, ka Lɛvinim bɛn daa nyɛ Asaf bidibisi la gba daa gbib chaɣisa kaman Izraɛl Naa Dauda ni daa wuhi shɛm.
en: When the builders laid the foundation of the LORDs temple, the priests clothed in their vests and carrying their trumpets, and the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals, arose to praise the LORD according to the directions of Israels King David.

dag: Amaa n ni ti teei n ni daa lo a alikauli shɛli a bipolitali saha la yɛla, ka lan lo a alikauli shɛli din ku naai.
en: Nevertheless, I will remember my covenant with you when you were young, and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you.

dag: Ifriimnim zaŋla ʒiŋmabo gili ma niŋ sunsuuni, ka Izraɛlnim mi zaŋ yɔhiŋ gili ma. Amaa Naawuni na mi Judanim yɛla, ka bɛ nyɛ bɛn ʒe Ŋun be Kasi la yim.
en: Israel is deceitful to me, their loyal and holy God; they surround me with lies, and Judah worships other gods.

dag: Paɣimiy o; ŋuna n-nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun tum tuun kara din mali dabiɛm ka yi nina nya maa.
en: He is the one you should praise. He is your God. He has done great and amazing things for you. You have seen them with your own eyes.

dag: yɛl o, Kpɛm Jɛrusalɛm tiŋ puuni nti zaŋ binshɛli dalim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa siɣinda ka ŋuhira bɛ ni tumdi din chihiri shɛŋa zaa di ni la gbɛri zuɣu.
en: Go through the whole city of Jerusalem and put a mark on the forehead of everyone who is distressed and troubled because of all the disgusting things being done in the city.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd ni daa ti tim ti bɔri Pita ka bi nya o, ka o vihi duguliba maa yɛlli maa zuɣu, ka bahi noli ni bɛ kum ba. Di nyaaŋa ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa yiɣisi Judia chaŋ Siizaria nti kpalim be nimaani.
en: Herod ordered his own soldiers to search for him, but they could not find him. Then he questioned the guards and had them put to death. After this, Herod left Judea to stay in Caesarea for a while.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi nirilim mali laara, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali putɔɣu tumdila bɛmaŋ barina.
en: You do yourself a favor when you are kind. If you are cruel, you only hurt yourself.

dag: Ka n ti darigi Mɔabnim tibili, ka bɛ baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: So I will punish Moab, and then they will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni ŋun zɔri nambɔɣu, o ku chɛn ya bahi bee n-kun ya; o mi ku tam o ni daa po pɔri lo yi yaannim alikauli shɛl la yɛla.
en: The Lord your God is a merciful God! He will not leave you there or destroy you completely. He will not forget the agreement that he made with your ancestors.

dag: Ka o daa kpuɣi salima mini anzinfa ni la shɛŋa zaa bɛ ni daa nya Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini nayili, ka gbahi bɛ ninvuɣ shɛba n-zaŋ ba kuli Samaria ti leei daba.
en: He took all the silver and gold he could find, all the Temple equipment and all the palace treasures, and carried them back to Samaria. He also took hostages with him.

dag: O miri ka o di biŋkɔb so ŋun kpi nyiŋgo muni bee biŋkɔbiri ni dari tɔhi biŋkɔb so, ka di kpɛh o daɣiri ni. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: A priest must not eat any animal that died by itself or that was killed by wild animals. If he eats that animal, he will be unclean. I am the Lord .

dag: Ka anab ʒirinim pam ni ti yi palo m-birigi niriba pam.
en: Many false prophets will come and cause many people to believe things that are wrong.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Ritima maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Rimɔnpɛrɛz.
en: They marched from Rithmah and camped at Rimmon-perez.

dag: Amaa n yɛri ya mi, n ku lan di li naɣila di gbinni ti niŋ pali Naawuni nam ni.
en: I will never eat another Passover meal until it is given its full meaning in Gods kingdom.

dag: Yawɛ mali shili ni o saɣim dunia ŋɔ n-dahimdahim li sɔŋ. O ni chɛ ka tiŋgbani dam ka sokam gbaai zɔbu.
en: The Lord is going to twist the earth out of shape and turn it into a desert. Everyone will be scattered.

dag: Ka Rabishake maa daa wum ni Asiria naa yiɣisi Lakishi, ka o daa labi ti nya ka ŋun naa tuhirila Libinanima.
en: Meanwhile the commander of the Assyrian forces heard that his king had left the town of Lachish and was now attacking Libnah. So he went there.

dag: Dindali maa ti Duuma ni ti yihi bɛ napɔnchahi ni nachintɛri mini bɔbisi ni dolibinima.
en: A day is coming when the Lord will take away from the women of Jerusalem everything they are so proud of—the ornaments they wear on their ankles, on their heads, on their necks.

dag: Miriya ka yi niŋ din bi tu kamaata yi saria karibu ni bee binyɛra wɔɣilim buɣisibu ni bee di tibisim zahimbu ni bee di galisim zahimbu ni.
en: You must not act unjustly in a legal case involving measures of length, weight, or volume.

dag: Ka Jɛhu daa yi n-lab o sapashin tab maa sani ka bɛ ti bɔh o, Alaafee? Ka lan bɔh o, Ka bɔ ka yinyaa maa lee kana ti bɔr a sani? Ka Jɛhu yɛli ba, Yi pun mi o ni o yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ.
en: Jehu went back to his kings officers. One of the officers said to Jehu, Is everything all right? Why did this crazy man come to you? Jehu answered the servants, You know the man and the crazy things he says.

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi pam dindali maa, ka o po n-yɛli.
en: The Lord became very angry with the people. He made this promise:.

dag: Tiŋgbani maa atam bupia kam puuni yim zuɣu, di yi nyɛla tiŋgban ni bindira bee tihi wala, di nyɛla Yawɛ dini, ka nyɛ din be kasi Yawɛ sani.
en: A tenth of all crops belongs to the Lord . This means the crops from fields and the fruit from trees—a tenth belongs to the Lord .

dag: Ka di daa niŋ kpamba maa mini niriba maa zaa nyaɣisim pam, ka bɛ daa kanna ti yɔri bɛ farigu liɣiri maa niŋdi adaka maa ni hal ti naai dindali maa.
en: The people and their leaders agreed, and they brought their money to Jerusalem and placed it in the box.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ niriba maa sara maligu maa na nti yihi niriba alahichi sanyoo sara shɛli din daa nyɛ bua la n-kɔrig o zaŋ mali alahichi sanyoo sara kaman tuuli alahichi sanyoo sara maligu la.
en: Next, Aaron presented the peoples offering. He took the male goat for the peoples purification offering, slaughtered it, and offered it as a purification offering like the first purification offering.

dag: Ka din nyari niriba taali yi mali jilima ŋɔ tatabo, dindina din chɛ ka niriba yiri taali ni shiri ni mali jilima gari lala.
en: If something that brings the death sentence is glorious, won't something that makes us acceptable to God be even more glorious?.

dag: Ka o daa lan bɔhi ba, Ka yinim bɛn nyɛ bihi banim ŋɔ, ŋun bia n-lee ni suh o bɔrɔbɔro ka o zaŋ kuɣili ti o bee n-suh o zahim, ka o gbaai wahu ti o.
en: Which one of you fathers would give your hungry child a snake if the child asked for a fish?.

dag: Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa:.
en: The Lord told Moses.

dag: ka bɛ ti ku o, amaa o ni ti neei kum ni daba ata dali. Ka di daa niŋ ba nandahima pam.
en: who will kill him. But on the third day he will be raised from death. The followers were very sad to hear that Jesus would be killed.

dag: A yɛligu baŋbu nyɛla din tiri neesim. Di chɛmi ka tarim nyari baŋsim.
en: Understanding your word brings light to the minds of ordinary people.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti ku tooi niŋ lala ka pa ni piɛri maa zaa laɣimmina pɔi ka bɛ naanyi paai kuɣili maa kɔbiliga maa noli, ka ti ŋɔŋ kom maa ti ba.
en: They answered, We can't do that until all the flocks are here and the stone has been rolled back; then we will water the flocks.

dag: Puhimiya taba puhiri suŋ. Masia cheechinim zaa puhiri ya.
en: Be sure to give each other a warm greeting. All of Christ's churches greet you.

dag: Ka o daa ti be o wuni Nisirok jɛmbu duu jɛmd o, ka o bidibisi Adirammɛlɛk mini Sharɛza daa zaŋ takɔbi ku o, ka zo n-kuli Ararat tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Ka o bia Ɛsarihadɔn daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: One day Sennacherib was in the temple of his god Nisroch, worshiping him. His sons Adrammelech and Sharezer killed him with a sword and ran away to Ararat. So Sennacheribs son Esarhaddon became the new king of Assyria.

dag: nti bi nya Yisa siliga maa ni; ka labina ti yɛli ti ni bɛ naɣ nyala malaikanim ʒii, ka malaikanim maa yɛli ba ni o neei kum ni.
en: But they did not find his body there. They came and told us they had seen some angels in a vision. The angels told them Jesus was alive!.

dag: Bɛ tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ yoya, ka lɔri alikauli, ka pɔri pɔri din ka buchi, dinzuɣu saria karibu tɔhi zanna kaman mɔ shɛŋa din nyɛ bɔchaa ni bili puu ni shɛm la.
en: They make promises, but they are only telling lies. They dont keep their promises. They make agreements with other countries. God does not like those agreements . The judges are like poisonous weeds growing in a plowed field.

dag: Piimiya sariakaritiba mini tuma kpamba Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ fɔntin shɛŋa tin ya maa zaa ni kaman yi daŋdaŋ ni nyɛ shɛm, ka bɛ ti doli zaligu soli maani niriba yɛla.
en: Choose men to be judges and officers in every town that the Lord your God gives you. Every tribe must do this. And these men must be fair in judging the people.

dag: Amaa di yi nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb tinsi tiri ya ni yi su maa ni, yin di ti chɛnya binvuhirigu kam;.
en: But when you take cities in the land that the Lord your God is giving you, you must kill everyone.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Di zɔriya dabiɛm! Mani m-bala.
en: But he said to them, Dont be afraid. Its me.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni daa teei Reechɛl yɛla n wum o fabila ka yoog o dɔɣim soli ti o.
en: Then God remembered Rachel, responded to her, and let her conceive.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n shiri ni ti zaŋ Shia Kasi niŋ n dab bidibisi mini n dab bipuɣinsi ni, ka bɛ ti tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: In those days I will give my Spirit to my servants, both men and women, and they will prophesy.

dag: Di saha maa ka Izraɛlnim daa tim tuumba Ɛdom naa sani ti yɛl o, Ti suhir a, chɛ ka ti kpe a tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni gari; amaa ka Ɛdom naa maa daa zaɣisi. Ka bɛ daa lan tim ti yɛli Mɔab naa lala, ka o gba zaɣisi. Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛlnim daa kpalim be Kadɛshi.
en: Then the Israelites sent messengers to the king of Edom, saying, Please allow us to pass through your land; but the Edomite king refused. They sent the same request to the king of Moab, and he was unwilling. So the Israelites stayed at Kadesh.

dag: Yi ma daa ŋmanila wain tia m-be wain tihi puu ni, ka bɛ daa zaŋ o sa m-baɣili kom. Ka kom pam maa daa chɛ ka o teei wula n-wali wala pam.
en: Your mother was a vine like you, growing near a stream. There was plenty of water, so she was filled with branches and with lots of fruit.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu puuni ka bɛ daa tuhi tin muna tɔbu di nasara. Bɛ daa zali din tuhi tumbu soli, ka daa deei Naawuni ni lo ba binshɛŋa alikaulinim la. Bɛ daa chɛ ka gbuɣima noya mum.
en: All of them had great faith. And with that faith they defeated kingdoms. They did what was right, and God helped them in the ways he promised. With their faith some people closed the mouths of lions.

dag: A ni yu zaɣ viɛlli la zuɣu, niŋm Ziɔn zaɣ viɛlli. Chɛ ka bɛ lab me Jɛrusalɛm goma zali yaha.
en: O God, be kind to Zion and help her; rebuild the walls of Jerusalem.

dag: Ijiptinim ni guui ka niŋdi vuri kaman wahu la, dama bɛ dimnim kabirimi kanna. Bɛ gbibila kpandi kanna kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ŋmari tihi la ni bɛ ti liri ba.
en: Like the sound of a snake hissing as it slithers away is Egypt as armies approach in force; they come against her with axes, like woodcutters.

dag: A jilima zuɣu daa chɛ ka karimbaani kpe a suhu ni. A jilima zuɣu daa chɛ ka a saɣim a yɛm. N daa daag a luhi tiŋa, n daa yih a palɔni nanim tooni ni bɛ lih a viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Your beauty made you proud. Your glory ruined your wisdom. So I threw you down to the ground, and now other kings stare at you.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa yiɣisi n-damdi Hitinim bɛn daa su tiŋgbɔŋ maa tiŋa.
en: Abraham rose, bowed to the local citizens the Hittites.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛl o mi, Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. Yɛlim Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa maa n ni yɛl a shɛlikam zaa.
en: he said, I am the Lord . Tell the king of Egypt everything I say to you.

dag: N suhir a, fam ma m biɛli Iso nuu ni bahi. N zɔr o, dama di pa shɛli ka o ti kana ti ku m mini m bihi ni bɛ manim ŋɔ zaa.
en: Save me from my brother Esau! Im afraid he will come and kill me, the mothers, and their children.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lo nia ni bɛ di n nyɛvil la ni chaŋ ti be kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: But what about those people who want to destroy me? Let them go into the bowels of the earth!.

dag: Amaa yinim Taiatiranim bɛn kpalim ka bi doli wuhibu maa, ka mi na bi bɔhim bɛ ni shɛb ni booni shɛli Sintani ashili yɛl kara tuma la, n yɛri ya mi ni n ku zaŋ ʒi tibisi shɛli n-ʒili ya.
en: But the rest of you in Thyatira have not followed this evil teaching; you have not learned what the others call the deep secrets of Satan. I say to you that I will not put any other burden on you.

dag: Naawuni nyɛla bɛ ni zɔri so ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi laɣiŋgu ni, o nyɛla ŋun galisi ni ŋun yɛla mali dabiɛm gari bɛnkam zaa gil o.
en: When Gods holy ones—the angels around his throne—meet together, they fear and respect him; he is more awesome than all those around him.

dag: Ka malaika maa daa zaŋ o gɔrigu maa tim dunia ni n-wɔb dunia puu tiwala n-zaŋ li bahi Naawuni suhuyiɣisili wain tɔɣiri adaka titali ni.
en: The angel swung his sickle on earth and cut off its grapes. He threw them into a pit where they were trampled on as a sign of God's anger.

dag: Ka o daa ti yɛli ba, N nyaya ka yi ba bi lan bɔri n yɛla kaman o ni daa yi bɔri n yɛla shɛm la. Amaa m ba Naawuni la kul be n sani.
en: and he told them: Your father isn't as friendly with me as he used to be, but the God my ancestors worshiped has been on my side.

dag: ka bi zaŋ li ka Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ŋɔ ni na ti mal li ti Yawɛ, bɛn yihim dilan Yawɛ niriba ni.
en: except at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you do, you will no longer belong to my people.

dag: Di saha ka Rubin daa yɛl o ba, N yi bi ʒi Bɛnjamin kuna, nyin kum m bidibis ayi ŋɔ, chɛl o niŋ n nuu ni, n ni ʒi o kuna ti ti a.
en: Reuben spoke up, Father, if I don't bring Benjamin back, you can kill both of my sons. Trust me with him, and I'll bring him back.

dag: Ka di daa gari bɛnkam daa yi mi a. A bahigu maa nyɛla din bie pam, ka a ku lan beni yaha. .
en: You are gone, gone forever, and all the nations that had come to know you are terrified, afraid that they will share your fate.

dag: Piɛɣu maa daa malila liŋa. Ka n daa kul lihiri hal ti nya ka di liŋ maa wuɣi zuɣusaa, ka paɣa ʒi piɛɣu maa puuni.
en: Then a lead cover was lifted, showing a woman sitting in the middle of the basket.

dag: Dinzuɣu yinima, yi Naawuni sɔŋsim zuɣu, labimiya o sani. Gbibiya yurilim mini yɛlimaŋli, ka kul guhimiya yi Naawuni maa sahakam.
en: So now, descendants of Jacob, trust in your God and return to him. Be loyal and just, and wait patiently for your God to act.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd ni daa diri Judia saha shɛl la, ka maligumaani so daa beni ka o yuli booni Zakaria. O daa nyɛla Abija daŋ ni nira, ka o paɣ mi daa nyɛ Aduna daŋ ni nira, ka o yuli booni Ɛlizabɛt.
en: When Herod was king of Judea, there was a priest by the name of Zechariah from the priestly group of Abijah. His wife Elizabeth was from the family of Aaron.

dag: ka tam o ni daa wuhi shihir shɛŋa Ijipti la mini alahiziba tuun shɛŋa o ni daa tum Zɔan mɔɣu ni la gba yɛla.
en: They forgot the miracles in Egypt, the miracles in the fields of Zoan.

dag: Miri ka a vuɣi tiŋgbani tariga kpaa din nyɛ a yaannim ni daa kpa shɛli kurimbuni ha.
en: Never move an old property line that your ancestors established.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ ba ni suhupiɛlli m-mali hal ti kpɛhi nayili maa.
en: As they enter the kings palace, they are led in with celebration and joy.

dag: Dinzuɣu di zaŋya yi naani niŋbu bahi, dama di mali laara pam.
en: So dont lose the courage that you had in the past. Your courage will be rewarded richly.

dag: N yur a, n ni zaŋ a ŋmahindila Firawuna chɛchɛbunsi wɔridibiga.
en: My darling, you are more exciting to me than any mare among the stallions pulling Pharaohs chariots.

dag: N ni ti daai bɛ ninkura mini bihi zaa to taba. N yi ti yɛn ku ba, n ku chɛ so bee n-zo so nambɔɣu. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Then I will smash them like jars against one another, old and young alike. No pity, compassion, or mercy will stop me from killing them.

dag: Sabimi binshɛŋa a nini ni nya maa: Binshɛŋa din be mini binshɛŋa din ti yɛn niŋ dimbɔŋɔnim nyaaŋa.
en: Write, then, the things you see, both the things that are now and the things that will happen afterward.

dag: Uziɛl bidibisi ni, Maika n-daa nyɛ kpɛma, Maika bidibisi ni, Shamir n-daa nyɛ kpɛma.
en: Shamir, a descendant of Uzziel through Micah;.

dag: Yi tiŋ daa lumi dahim leei dabari, amaa di pɔri pam pumpɔŋɔ, ka bɛn kanna ni bɛ ti be di ni ni muɣi li. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa wurim li maa ni zo n-chaŋ katiŋ ka chɛn ya.
en: Jerusalem is now in ruins! Nothing is left of the city. But it will be rebuilt and soon overcrowded; its cruel enemies will be gone far away.

dag: Sulemaana bihi ni daa nyɛ shɛba m-bɔŋɔ: Rɛhɔbɔam mini Abija daa nyɛla o bihi, ka Asa nyɛ o bia, ka Jɛhɔshafat nyɛ o bia.
en: The descendants of Solomon: Rehoboam, his son Abijah, his son Asa, his son Jehoshaphat.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa ti yiɣis o kpim maa sani n-chaŋ ti yɛli Hitinima.
en: After he got up from embracing his deceased wife, he spoke with the Hittites.

dag: Salima bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Bɛtilihɛm ŋun daa lan nyɛ Nɛtɔfa nir la mini Atirɔtibɛtijɔab ni Manahatinim pirigili ni Zɔrinima.
en: This is a list of Salmas descendants: the people from Bethlehem, Netophah, Atroth Beth Joab, half the people from Manahti, the Zorites.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ tiligi Izraɛlnima, ka di nyɛ tiliginsim din ku naai; ka bɛ kul ku lan di vi yaha. .
en: But Israel is saved by the Lord , and her victory lasts forever; her people will never be disgraced.

dag: ni n daalaka nyabu ni n wahala dibu. A mi dinkam zaa daa niŋ ma mini alaka biɛ shɛŋa n ni daa nya Antiɔk mini Aikɔnium ni Listra la gba yɛla; amaa ti Duuma daa fa ma di zaa ni bahi.
en: You have seen me experience physical abuse and ordeals in places such as Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I put up with all sorts of abuse, and the Lord rescued me from it all!.

dag: m-bɔhi ba, Yi ni niŋ yɛda maa, yi deei Naawuni Shia Kasi? Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Aai, ti na ʒi n-wum ni Naawuni Shia beni gba.
en: and asked them, Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you became believers? We have not even heard that there is a Holy Spirit, they answered.

dag: O daa nyɛla ŋun yuuni Naawuni nam kandina soli, ka daa bi yu o tab la ni daa lo ni bɛ niŋ Yisa shɛm la.
en: He hadnt agreed with the plan and actions of the council. He was from the Jewish city of Arimathea and eagerly anticipated Gods kingdom.

dag: Amɔn ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi, bɛ sabi di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛŋa bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafinim la ni.
en: Everything else that Amon did is recorded in The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: ka yɛli o suhu ni, N ka luɣ shɛli din yɛn zaŋ m bindira ŋɔ sɔŋ, ka wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ?.
en: He thought to himself, What will I do? I have no place to keep all my crops.

dag: Yɛlim bɛn nyɛ duŋtaariba maa yɛtɔɣ ŋahili ŋɔ. Yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Zaŋmiya duɣu tam, zaŋmiya li tam, ka niŋ kom niŋ di ni.
en: Then tell my rebellious people: Pour water in a cooking pot and set it over a fire. *.

dag: Zuliya shɛb bɛn Naawuni nyɛ Yawɛ mali alibarika; ka o ni pii ninvuɣ shɛba n-leeg o niriba mali alibarika.
en: The Lord blesses each nation that worships only him. He blesses his chosen ones.

dag: N yura, a viɛli pam! A viɛlim maa yaɣimi gba! A nina bemi kaman ŋmana la a sariga ni. A zabiri kul yɛbisirimi kaman bu bɔbigu ni zɔri sirigiri Giliad Zoli shɛm la.
en: How beautiful you are, my love! How your eyes shine with love behind your veil. Your hair dances like a flock of goats bounding down the hills of Gilead.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ n zaŋ ya niŋ Naawuni nuu ni, ka lan zaŋ ya niŋ o daalibarika yɛtɔɣa din ni tooi kpaŋsi ya la ni. Dina n-ni chɛ ka yi nya tarili bɛn nyɛ Naawuni ni mali ninvuɣ shɛb ka bɛ be kasi la ni.
en: I now place you in God's care. Remember the message about his gift of undeserved grace! This message can help you and give you what belongs to you as God's people.

dag: Ka n daa kabi jaaŋgbe shɛli din yuli booni Anfaani la ni n lɔrigi Yawɛ ni daa lo zuliya kam alikauli shɛl la.
en: Then I took the stick named Favor, and I broke it. I did this to show that Gods agreement with his people was broken.

dag: Garigim jɛra kaman bɛ jɛrilim ni simdi shɛm, di yi pa lala bɛ ni tɛhi ni bɛ mali yɛm.
en: But if you answer any fools, show how foolish they are, so they won't feel smart.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli pahi, Yi pun wum ka di sab yɛli yaha, Yum a ʒiʒiinikpee ka je a dima.
en: You have heard that it was said, You must love your neighbor and hate your enemy.

dag: Yawɛ darigi n tibili pam, amaa o bi chɛ ka n kpi.
en: Yes, the LORD definitely disciplined me, but he didnt hand me over to death.

dag: Ti Duuma NAAWUNI ŋun nam binshɛɣukam ŋɔ yi shihi tiŋgbani, di tahirimi bɔɣira, ka bɛnkam be di ni fabinda, ka di kpuɣi zuɣusaa kaman Nail Mɔɣili la, ka lab lu kaman Ijipti mɔɣili la.
en: The Lord GOD All-Powerful will touch the land, and the land will melt. Then all the people who live in the land will cry for the dead. The land will rise and fall like the Nile River in Egypt.

dag: Bidibisi ayɔbu ka o daa dɔɣi Hiburɔn, o ni daa di nam ʒini nimaani yuma ayopɔin ni chira ayɔbu la. O daa di nam n-ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pihitanaata.
en: All six were born in Hebron during the seven and a half years that David ruled there. In Jerusalem he ruled as king for thirty-three years.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun tiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka kpɛhili shee yili; ka yihiri sarikanim mi kpɛhiri yolisim suhupiɛlli ni. Amaa duŋtaariba bɛn ni bela tiŋgban kuŋ ni.
en: He gives the lonely a home to live in and leads prisoners out into happy freedom, but rebels will have to live in a desolate land.

dag: Ka bɔɣukpiŋlan so daa be nimaani, ka niriba maa ni shɛb daa bɔri ni bɛ nya Yisa taali ka fiɣis o. Ka bɔh o, Di luhiya ni nira chɛ ka so kpaŋ Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: A man with a withered hand was there. Wanting to bring charges against Jesus, they asked, Does the Law allow a person to heal on the Sabbath.

dag: Yurilim saha beni, ka jɛlinsi saha beni. Tɔbu tuhibu saha beni, ka tɔbu tuhibu ni kani saha shɛli beni.
en: There is a time to love and a time to hate. There is a time for war and a time for peace.

dag: Ka Aduna zuliya ni bidibiga kam ni tooi di li kaman di ni zali shɛm yi ʒiɛmani kam ni, ka binshɛɣukam din shihi li ni niŋ kasi Yawɛ sani.
en: Any male descendant of Aaron may eat from these gifts to the Lord . This is their share forever throughout your generations. Whatever touches these offerings will be made holy. .

dag: Bɛn daa di li maa kalinli daa nyɛla dɔb tusaanahi m-pahi paɣiba ni bihi.
en: The number of men who ate was four thousand, not counting the women and children.

dag: Suhuyiɣisililan nyɛla ŋun tahiri zabili na, ka suhuyiɣisili pam tahiri biriginsim pam na.
en: People with quick tempers cause a lot of quarreling and trouble.

dag: Pa kapinta bia la m-bala? Pa o ma yuli m-booni Mariama la? Pa o tizɔbihi n-nyɛ Jeemsi mini Yisifu ni Saimɔn ni Judas la?.
en: Isnt he the carpenters son? Isnt his mother named Mary? Arent James, Joseph, Simon, and Judas his brothers?.

dag: Di zaŋ ma pahi ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn tumdi tuumbiɛri ni dari ma chaŋ, bɛn tɔɣisiri bɛ ʒiʒiinitab suhudoo yɛtɔɣa, amaa ka jɛlinsi be bɛ suhuri ni la.
en: Don't drag me away, Lord , with those cruel people, who speak kind words, while planning trouble.

dag: Bɛ bi zɔri lahiba biɛri. Bɛ suhuri kul ʒiɛla yim, ka bɛ nyɛ bɛn niŋ Yawɛ naani.
en: He is not afraid of receiving bad news; his faith is strong, and he trusts in the Lord .

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Vuri mɔni Rama, di nyɛla fabila mini kuhigu pam. Reechɛl n-kumd o bihi zuɣu, ka zaɣisi ni so di maag o suhu o bihi maa zuɣu, dama bɛ lan kani.
en: In Ramah a voice is heard, crying and weeping loudly. Rachel mourns for her children and refuses to be comforted, because they are dead. *.

dag: dama o daa niŋ yɛda ka biɛhiŋ kani ni Naawuni ni tooi niŋ o ni daa lo o alikauli ni o ni niŋ shɛl la.
en: Abraham felt sure that God was able to do what he promised.

dag: Ka tinzunnim bɛn pa a niriba Izraɛlnima, ka yi tinshee katiŋ kana a yuli din galisi ŋɔ min a yiko tuma ni a ni kul tumdi shɛlikam zuɣu, bɛ yi ti zaŋ bɛ nina kpa duu ŋɔ polo na ka suh a.
en: Listen also to the foreigner who isnt from your people Israel, but who comes from a distant country because of your great reputation, your great power, and your outstretched arm. When they come and pray toward this temple.

dag: Ka dabiɛm ni gbaai sokam zaa, ka bɛ yɛli Naawuni ni niŋ shɛm maa yɛla, ka zaŋ o ni niŋ shɛm maa yɛla niŋ bɛ suhuri ni.
en: They will be afraid and say, Look at what God has done and keep it all in mind.

dag: Mani n-chɛ ka nanim diri nam. Mani n-sɔŋdi zuɣulaannim ka bɛ zaani zaligu shɛŋa din doli yɛlimaŋli.
en: By me kings rule, and princes issue righteous decrees.

dag: Teemiya yi ni daa wum shɛli mini yi ni daa deei shɛl la yɛla, ka niŋya tuuba ka gbib li. Yi yi ku neei, n ni ka yi sanna kaman tayiɣa la, ka yi ku baŋ n kandina saha.
en: So remember what you received and heard. Hold on to it and change your hearts and lives. If you dont wake up, I will come like a thief, and you wont know what time I will come upon you.

dag: Amaa ka bidibbil so daa ti nya ba ka chaŋ ti yɛli Absalom, ka bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa daa zo yomyom ti kpe Bahurim do so yiŋa, doo maa daa malila kɔbiliga o yiŋa ka bɛ siɣi di puuni.
en: But a boy saw them and reported it to Absalom. So the two of them left immediately and came to a mans house at Bahurim. He had a well in his courtyard, and they climbed down into it.

dag: O suhi ma mi ni n chɛ ka o doli kachɛriba maa nyaaŋa yihiri kayiha. Ka o kul bela o tuma ni asibaasi la zaa zaŋ kana pɔŋɔ, o na kul bi ʒini vuhi biɛla gba.
en: She asked me to let her follow the workers and gather grain. She has been working since early morning and has just now stopped to rest for a while under the shelter.

dag: A ni je suli niŋ ma ka a karimbaani yɛla kana ti lu n tibili ni shɛm zuɣu, n ni zaŋ n ziŋgoo niŋ a nyee ni, ka zaŋ n galige le a ŋ-ŋmalig a ka a dol a ni daa doli so shɛli kana labi.
en: I have received the report of that rage and that pride of yours, and now I will put a hook through your nose and a bit in your mouth and will take you back by the same road you came.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ mi viɛnyɛliŋga ni di simdi ni yi chɛ ka yi biɛhigu be kaman ti biɛhigu. Ti ni daa be yi san la ti daa pala gbinnyaɣinima.
en: You yourselves know that you should live like we do. We were not lazy when we were with you.

dag: Daadam, a ni kari ba saria? A ni kari ba saria? Di nyaaŋa ka a chɛ ka bɛ baŋ bɛ yaannim ni daa tum din chihiri shɛŋa.
en: Will you judge them, human one, will you judge them? Then expose to them the detestable practices of their ancestors.

dag: Yisa daa lan ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli, Naawuni nam ŋmanila yil yidan so ŋun daa yɛn go, ka bol o yiŋbihi na ti zaŋ o liɣiri pirigi ti ba ni bɛ deei wolimma.
en: At that time Gods kingdom will also be like a man leaving home to travel to another place for a visit. Before he left, he talked with his servants. He told his servants to take care of his things while he was gone.

dag: Yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa malaikanim ni daa tɔɣisi la kahigi wuhi ni di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, ka ŋunkam daa bi dol li bee n-deei di noli yi daa nya tibidarigibo din simd o.
en: The message spoken by angels proved to be true, and all who disobeyed or rejected it were punished as they deserved.

dag: Yinim Itiɔpianima bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi ku yi gba.
en: People of Ethiopia, the sword of the Lord will slaughter you!.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun nyɛ Baasha daŋ ni nir yi kpi yiŋa, bahi n-yɛn ŋub o; ka ŋun mi kpi mɔɣu ni, juri n-yɛn di o.
en: Dogs will eat the bodies of your relatives who die in town, and vultures will eat the bodies of those who die in the country.

dag: Di saha maa ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdib mini maligumaaniba kpamba daa lɔri nia ni bɛ gbaai Yisa, dama bɛ daa baŋya ni bɛna ka o ŋahi ŋahili maa dalim maa, amaa ka daa lee zɔri niriba.
en: The legal experts and chief priests wanted to arrest him right then because they knew he had told this parable against them. But they feared the people.

dag: Ka ŋun yɛn yi daɣiri ni maa paɣ o nɛma, ka pin o zabiri zaa, ka su kom yi daɣiri ni. Di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi labi yi biɛhigu shee maa na, amaa o ni ti bela o suɣili samban ni daba ayopɔin.
en: After this you must wash your clothes, shave your entire body, and take a bath before you are completely clean. You may move back into camp, but you must not enter your tent for seven days.

dag: Ka Yisa yuli daa maan du pam chaŋ haliya, ka salo pam daa laɣimna ni bɛ ti wum o yɛtɔɣa, ka nya bɛ dɔriti tib kpaŋ.
en: News of him spread even more and huge crowds gathered to listen and to be healed from their illnesses.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ taali galisi pahi; di chɛ ka bɛ nya gaafara a sani.
en: Keep a record of all their sins; don't let them have any part in your salvation.

dag: O ni gah o nuu boli zuliya shɛb bɛn be katiŋa, ka vulim vuliŋga boli dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam niriba, ka bɛ zɔri yomyom kanna!.
en: The Lord has signaled for the foreign nations to come and attack you. He has already whistled, and they are coming as fast as they can.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee yɛl ti di yɛla piligu ni ha ni di chɛ ka ti baŋ li, ka ŋuni n-daŋ yɛli di yɛla, ka ti ni tooi yɛli ni o mali yɛlimaŋli? So daa pun bi yɛli di yɛla, ka so bi zaŋ li moli; so mi pun bi wum yi yɛtɔɣ shɛli.
en: Which of you predicted that this would happen, so that we could say that you were right? None of you said a word about it; no one heard you say a thing!.

dag: Kalima anahi maa daa du pam ka mali dabiɛm. Ka nimbihi daa pie di fiilinim ni ti tuui.
en: The rims of the wheels were tall and frightening. There were eyes all over the rims of all four wheels.

dag: bee do so ŋun napɔŋ bee o nuu mali daŋa.
en: anyone who has a broken foot or hand.

dag: ni o tiligi ba kum ni, ka dihiri ba kum saha.
en: He saves them from death; he keeps them alive in times of famine.

dag: Ka yil maa lana daa yi bɛ sani ti yɛli ba, M mabihi, doo maa nyɛla n sana, dinzuɣu di tumiya tuun biɛɣu ŋɔ bee n-tum vi tuuni ŋɔ.
en: The owner of the house went outside and said to them, No, my friends, please dont commit such an evil act, given that this man has come to my home as a guest. Dont do this disgraceful thing!.

dag: Ka bɛ ni pam bɛn daa nyɛ bukpahinim laɣisi bɛ tabibi tumbu kundinim na nti nyɔri buɣim niriba maa ninni; ka bɛ daa mali di liɣiri laasabu ka di paai kaman ninvuɣ tusaanu dahin yini tuma yɔri.
en: Many of those who had practiced magic brought their books together and burned them in public. They added up the price of the books, and the total came to fifty thousand silver coins.

dag: Niŋmiya n ni zali ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam maa zaa viɛnyɛliŋga. Di pahiya shɛli di ni bee n-yihi shɛli di ni.
en: You must be careful to do everything I command you. Dont add anything to what I tell you, and dont take anything away.

dag: Du shɛli din dunoya daa kpa Naawuni jɛmbu duu sambani wulinluhili polo la yɛliŋ daa nyɛ mita pihitanaanu, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛla mita pihinahinaanu, ka di dikili barilim nyɛ mita ayi ni pirigili gili di zaa.
en: I noticed another building: It faced the west end of the temple and was meters wide, meters long, and had walls over . meters thick.

dag: ka yɛli, Tibigimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun zaŋ o nuu tum tuma n-chɛ ka o ni daa yaag o noli lo m ba Dauda alikauli shɛl la niŋ pali ŋɔ. O daa yɛliya.
en: He said, Praise the Lord , the God of Israel, who has done what he promised my father David. The Lord said.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zaa ʒii nyabu ŋmanila bɛ ni zaŋ bini dihi litaafi shɛli noli tabili puuni yɛtɔɣa, ka so yi zaŋ li ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mi karimbu ka yɛli ba, Karimmiya litaafi ŋɔ, bɛ ni yɛli, Ti ku tooi karim li, bini ka bɛ zaŋ dihi di noli tabili.
en: To you my words are like the words in a book that is closed and sealed. You can give the book to someone who can read and tell that person to read it. But that person will say, I cannot read the book. It is closed and I cannot open it.

dag: Chɛ ka teeku mini di puuni binshɛɣukam zaa ŋum; ka chɛ ka tiŋgbani mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni zaa suhuri paligi.
en: Roar, sea, and every creature in you; be glad, fields, and everything in you!.

dag: Bɛ maani maligunim zoya zuɣu mini oki tihi ni ti shɛŋa bɛ ni booni pɔpila ni tɛribint la gbini, dama di mahim viɛla. Dinzuɣu ka yi bipuɣinsi gɔri pagɔrisigu, ka yi daamiliyanim niŋdi zina.
en: You offer sacrifices on mountaintops and hills, under oak trees, and wherever good shade is found. Your own daughters and daughters-in-law sell themselves for sex.

dag: Naawuni, tiligim ma a yuli zuɣu. Wuhim ni n ka taali a kpiɔŋ zuɣu!.
en: God! Save me by your name; defend me by your might!.

dag: So yi kpi Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la puuni, di mi zaligu m-bɔŋɔ: Ŋunkam be suɣili maa ni mini ŋunkam kpe di ni na ni leei ŋun bi be nyam hal ni daba ayopɔin.
en: This is the instruction: When anyone dies in a tent, all who go into the tent and all who are in the tent are unclean for seven days.

dag: O ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi ku Naa Jɛrɔbɔam tɔbu ni, ka gbahi Izraɛlnim kuli tinshee katiŋ ha. .
en: This is what he says: Jeroboam will die in battle, and the people of Israel will be taken away from their land into exile.

dag: Yurilim bi mali suhupiɛlli taali tumbu ni, amaa di naɣ mali suhupiɛlli la yɛlimaŋli ni.
en: it isnt happy with injustice, but it is happy with the truth.

dag: Sapashin kpamba maa ni lan yɛli tɔbbihi maa yaha, Dabiɛm yi gbaai so bee so suhu yi fuŋ, dilana ŋun labimi kul o yiŋa, di yi pa lala o ni chɛ ka o tab suhuri fuŋ kaman o suhu ni fuŋ shɛm maa.
en: Finally, if any of you are afraid, you may go home. We don't want you to discourage the other soldiers.

dag: Dindali maa zaawun yuŋ, ka bɛ daa zaŋ alizin biɛri ni ʒi ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu n-tahi Yisa sanna; ka o daa zaŋ o nol ni yɛligu n-kari alizin biɛri maa, ka tib ŋunkam daa biɛra.
en: That evening many people with demons in them were brought to Jesus. And with only a word he forced out the evil spirits and healed everyone who was sick.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti mabihi, piimiya yi ni niriba ayopɔin shɛb Shia Kasi ni pali, ka bɛ mali shɛhira suma ka lan mali yɛm pam, ka ti chɛ ka bɛ su tuma ŋɔ fukumsi;.
en: Brothers and sisters, carefully choose seven well-respected men from among you. They must be well-respected and endowed by the Spirit with exceptional wisdom. We will put them in charge of this concern.

dag: So yi bi yuri ka tum alahichi, ŋun bom yuun yini bunyaŋ mali alahichi tumbu sara.
en: But if only one person makes a mistake and sins, that person must bring a female goat that is one year old. That goat will be the sin offering.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli kul ka ti sani hal biɛla gba, ka ninvuɣ so ŋun je zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu nyɛla ŋun be barina ni. Ka Yawɛ daa nya yɛlimaŋli biɛhigu ni kani maa, ka di bi niŋ o nyaɣisim.
en: Everyone tells lies; those who turn from crime end up ruined. When the Lord noticed that justice had disappeared, he became very displeased.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa. Saha kanna, n ni niŋ li. N ku chɛ li niŋbu, n ku tilig a, n suhu ku maai. N ni kar a saria kaman a tuma min a biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I am the Lord . I said your punishment would come, and I will make it happen. I will not hold back the punishment or feel sorry for you. I will punish you for the evil things you did. This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: Di ni nyɛla sara shɛli bɛ ni yɛn zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim Yawɛ tooni Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili dunol ŋɔ ni sahakam yi ʒiɛmana zaa ni. Di nyɛla luɣ shɛli m mini ya ni yɛn laɣim ka n tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa nimaani.
en: For all time to come, this burnt offering is to be offered in my presence at the entrance of the Tent of my presence. That is where I will meet my people and speak to you.

dag: Amaa ka Musa daa yɛli ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi kul birigiri Yawɛ zaligu? Dama lala ku nani.
en: But Moses said, Why do you disobey the LORDs command? It wont succeed.

dag: Ka kom maa daa kul gbaai nyuubu zaŋ hal ti paai gol so ŋun pahiri pia dahin yini dali, ka zoya zuɣusaa daa nyili.
en: The water kept going down, and on the first day of the tenth month the tops of the mountains appeared.

dag: Bɛla bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Ɛzibɔn mini Uzi ni Uziɛl ni Jɛrimɔt ni Iri, bɛ daa nyɛla niriba anu, ka nyɛ bɛ daŋ ni zuɣulaannima, ka lan nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi, ka bɛ zuliya maa daadambiɛligu kalinli daa nyɛ ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaayi ni pihitanaanahi.
en: Belas family: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri—five heads of households, mighty warriors; , were listed in their family records.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa ti bɛ zaa yinoyino binyɛr piɛla, ka yɛli ba ni bɛ na guhim hal ka bɛ tumtumdi tab mini bɛ mabi shɛb bɛ ni na yɛn ku kaman bɛ ni daa ku ba shɛm la gba yɛla ti naai zaa.
en: Then each of those who had been killed was given a white robe and told to rest for a little while. They had to wait until the complete number of the Lord's other servants and followers would be killed.

dag: ka gbaag o ansarisi malibu yɛra, Ti puhir a Yɛhudianim Naa! Ka ŋmɛr o nutala.
en: They came up to him and said, Hey, you king of the Jews! They also hit him with their fists.

dag: Amaa yinim Izraɛl zoya, yi ni teei wula n-wali yi wala ti n niriba Izraɛlnima. Dama di ku yuui, bɛ ni kuna pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Trees will grow on you mountains of Israel and produce fruit for my people, because they will soon come home.

dag: Amaa ka shɛb daa ti chaŋ daba ayopɔin maa dali ni bɛ ti pihi li ka bi nya shɛli.
en: A few of the Israelites did go out to look for some, but there was none.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa chɛ ka o nyaandoliba kpe ŋariŋ daŋ o tooni baari duri teeku duli, ka ŋun kpalim ni o chɛbisi salo maa.
en: At once, Jesus made his disciples get into a boat and start back across the lake. But he stayed until he had sent the crowds away.

dag: Yɛlim ba, Zuliya ŋɔ nyɛla bɛn bi deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ noli, ka zaɣisi saɣisigu; yɛlimaŋli vuuya, di lan ka bɛ noya ni.
en: So you must tell them these things: This is the nation that did not obey the Lord its God. These people did not listen to Gods teachings. They dont know the true teachings.

dag: dama Izraɛlnim mini Judanima ni bɛ nanim ni bɛ kpamba ni bɛ maligumaaniba ni bɛ daanabinim tum zaɣ biɛɣu n-chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi.
en: because of all the evil done by the people of Israel and Judah to make me angry—they, their kings and officials, their priests and prophets, the men of Judah, and those who live in Jerusalem.

dag: di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Amɔz bia Aizaia, Pirigim a buɣu ŋɔ min a namda ŋɔ, ka o daa niŋ lala, ka chani o zaɣim ni napɔn zaŋa.
en: Three years earlier the Lord had told Isaiah son of Amoz to take off his sandals and the sackcloth he was wearing. He obeyed and went around naked and barefoot.

dag: M bia, di chɛ ka a suhu zɔhira. N ni niŋ a ni yɛli shɛlikam maa zaa, dama ŋunkam be ya ŋɔ mi ni a nyɛla paɣ so ŋun mali biɛrisuŋ.
en: Don't worry, I'll do what you have asked. You are respected by everyone in town.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli ba, Dimiya li zuŋɔ, dama zuŋɔ nyɛla Yawɛ Vuhim Dabisili, yi ku nya li tiŋgban ni zuŋɔ.
en: The next day Moses said, Eat it today, because today is a Sabbath to the LORD. Today you wont find it out in the field.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ bɛ ni daa mali naɣibil so maa nyo buɣim m-baɣisi li ka di niŋ zim, ka o zaŋ li niŋ kom ni n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa nyu li.
en: He took the calf that they had made and burned it in a fire. Then he ground it down to crushed powder, scattered it on the water, and made the Israelites drink it.

dag: Di simdi ka yi zaŋ dimbɔŋɔ leei zaligu yi sani, ka yi mini yi bihi doli li sahakam.
en: You must remember this command. This law is for you and your descendants forever.

dag: N zaŋla sagani ŋɔ niŋ sagbana ni ni di nyɛ n ni lo dunia ŋɔ alikauli shɛli maa shihirili.
en: I am putting a rainbow in the clouds as proof of the agreement between me and the earth.

dag: Ka Pita daa nya lala ka bɔhi niriba maa, Yinim Izraɛlnima, bɔ n-niŋ ka yɛlli ŋɔ niŋ ya alahiziba bee wula ka yi ti yuuni ti kaman tinim maŋmaŋ yiko ni bee ti wuntitali zuɣu n-chɛ ka gbarigu ŋɔ yiɣisi leei ŋun chani maa.
en: Seeing this, Peter addressed the people: You Israelites, why are you amazed at this? Why are you staring at us as if we made him walk by our own power or piety?.

dag: Ka Reechɛl daa yɛl o ba, N dana, di je suli niŋ ma n ni ku tooi yiɣisi zani a tooni maa zuɣu, dama paɣitali biɛhigu ni ka m be. Ka Leeban daa vihi bo wuni maa ka bi nya li.
en: Rachel said to her father, Do not be angry with me, sir, but I am not able to stand up in your presence; I am having my monthly period. Laban searched but did not find his household gods.

dag: Amaa Mɔab nyɛla n kopaɣiri ŋmani. N ni pirigi n namda pa Ɛdom zuɣu; ka tuhi nyaŋ Filistianim mi.
en: But I will use Moab as my washbowl, and I will throw my sandals on Edom, as a sign that I own it. Did the Philistines think they would shout in triumph over me.

dag: Yuun piniyini puuni gol so ŋun daŋ tooni daba ayopɔin dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: On the seventh day of the first month of the eleventh year of exile, the word of the Lord came to me. He said.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim daa nyɛla bɛn tumdi naa tuma m-pah o ni daa zaŋ tɔbbi shɛb ʒil o ni daa me goondahi gili fɔntin shɛŋa Juda tiŋgbɔŋ zaa ni la zuɣu.
en: These were the individuals who served the king in addition to those the king placed in the fortified cities throughout Judah.

dag: Ka n daa lihi nya kɔtomsi shɛli ka di biɛhigu ŋmani daadam. Din daa be kaman o shee la tiŋli polo daa nyɛla buɣim, ka shee maa zaŋ du zuɣusaa polo mi daa kul piɛli paratɛte, ka be kaman daanya din nyaɣisiri la.
en: I looked up and saw a vision of a fiery human form. From the waist down his body looked like fire, and from the waist up he was shining like polished bronze.

dag: Aroa ka o daa piligi ba ŋmɛbu m-mali hal ti paai luɣ shɛli din daa baɣi Minnit la n-daa nyaŋ nimaani tinsi pisi zaa; ka daa lan zaŋ ba nimaani n-doli ba hal ni Ɛbɛlikɛramim n-daa ku ba kuri biɛɣu. Ka Izraɛlnim daa nyaŋ Ammɔnnim maa.
en: He struck at them from Aroer to the area around Minnith, twenty cities in all, and as far as Abel Keramim. There was a great slaughter, and the Ammonites were defeated by Israel.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛl o nyaandoliba maa, Suhudoo ka n zaŋ tin ya; mmaŋmaŋ suhudoo mi ka n zaŋ tin ya maa. Di pala dunianim ni tiri suhudoo shɛm la ka n tin ya maa. Di zɔriya dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka yi suhuri zɔhira.
en: Peace is what I leave with you; it is my own peace that I give you. I do not give it as the world does. Do not be worried and upset; do not be afraid.

dag: Di saha ka nu shɛli daa gbaai ma n-kpuɣi ma gbani n duna zuɣu ka n nuhi dihi tiŋa, ka n ni sɔhira.
en: Then a hand touched me. When that happened, I got on my hands and knees. I was so afraid that I was shaking.

dag: N daa wuhi ba n zalikpana mini n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi. Ka ŋunkam dol li ni be di zuɣu.
en: Then I gave them my laws and told them all my rules. All those who obey them will live.

dag: Miri ka a niŋ ninvuɣ biɛɣu, a mi di nyɛ jɛrigu. Di niŋ lala n-kpi ka a saha na bi paai.
en: Don't die before your time by being too evil or acting like a fool.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa bi gbilisi tibili wum, ka chɛ tuumbiɛri tumbu bee buɣa jɛmbu.
en: but they refused to listen and would not stop worshiping other gods.

dag: Di saha yi ni ti saɣim yi wuna mini di binnan shɛŋa zuɣu bɛ ni dooi salima mini anzinfa pa, ka va li labi kaman binchɛr biɛr la ka yɛli, Wari ya.
en: Then you will take your idols covered with gold and silver and make them unfit to be used again. You will throw them away like filthy rags and say, Go away.

dag: kpiimba biɛhigu shee mini paɣiŋoo ni tiŋgbani din bi nyuri kom tiɣira ni buɣim din na ʒi n-yɛli, Di saɣiya.
en: the place of death, a woman with no children, dry ground that needs rain, and a fire that will never stop by itself.

dag: Bɛ ni tooi pa wɔhu gali n-gu tɔbu tuhibu dali, amaa nasara dibu bela Yawɛ sani.
en: You can prepare your horses for battle, but only the Lord can give you the victory.

dag: Ka shɛŋa lu tiɛriŋ zuɣu m-bilina, ka mahili ni daa bi yuuri tiŋ nimaani zuɣu chɛ ka di zaɣi kpi.
en: Other seed fell on rock. It began to grow but then died because it had no water.

dag: Bɛ tum vi tuma, ka tum din chihira, ka vi bi mali ba. Bɛ bi mi ʒiɛrige. Dinzuɣu bɛ ni ti lu kaman sokam ni luri shɛm n yi ti yɛn darigi bɛ tibili saha shɛli. Bɛ bahigu n-ti yɛn bala. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: They should be ashamed of their detestable practices, but they have no shame; they dont even blush! Therefore, they will fall among the fallen and stumble when I bring disaster, declares the LORD.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, Zɔri, ŋuni n-lee zaŋ ma leei yi sariakarita bee yi falitarita.
en: Jesus said to him, Man, who appointed me as judge or referee between you and your brother.

dag: Paɣa bi su omaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ, amaa o yidana n-su li; lala mi n-nyɛ li, doo gba bi su omaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ, amaa o paɣa n-su li.
en: The wife does not have power over her own body. Her husband has the power over her body. And the husband does not have power over his own body. His wife has the power over his body.

dag: Ka Filistianim nanim maa daa bo tɔbimi pala zaɣ maha diba ayopɔin ti Dilaila na, ka o zaŋ li lo Samsin.
en: So the rulers of the Philistines brought her seven fresh bowstrings that werent dried out, and she tied him up with them.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ ni ti zaŋ buɣili maa maŋmaŋ kuli Asiria nti zaŋ li ti na titali, ka di leei bɛ farigu yɔbu o sani. Bɛ ni ti dihi Ifriimnim vi, ka vi ti gbahi Izraɛlnim bɛ buɣili maa zuɣu.
en: It will be taken to Assyria and given to the great king. Then Israel will be disgraced for worshiping that idol.

dag: Miriya ka yi birigi mɔɣu bee n-doli pala, dama yi dimnim maa gbibila takɔbiri ka dabiɛm be luɣilikam.
en: Dont go out into the fields. Dont go on the roads because the enemy has swords, and there is danger everywhere.

dag: Taataa kpiŋkpama vibiri ni suhupiɛlli, amaa o ka kpiŋkpaŋkɔbiri kaman tɔrili la.
en: The ostrichs wings flap joyously, but her wings and plumage are like a stork.

dag: Dama Naawuni ni tiligi Ziɔn, ka lan me Juda tinsi zali, ka o daba ti be nimaani su li.
en: God will save Zion. He will rebuild the cities of Judah. The people will settle there again and own the land.

dag: Sool mini Izraɛlnim zaa ni daa wum Filistia doo maa yɛtɔɣa maa, di daa gari ba mi ka dabiɛm gbaai ba pam.
en: When Saul and all Israel heard what the Philistine said, they were distressed and terrified.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrikɔnim daa kana ti yɛli Ilaisha, Ti dana, yiya ŋɔ ni ʒe luɣ shɛli ŋɔ viɛli pam kaman a gba ni nya li shɛm, amaa di kom nyɛla ko biɛɣu, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka paɣiba zaŋdi bahira.
en: The citizens said to Elisha, As you can see, sir, this city is in a good location, but the water is bad, and the land causes miscarriages.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa yɛli Balaam, Doli ba chaŋ, amaa kul yɛlimila n ni yɛl a ni a yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛli. Ka Balaam daa doli Balak kpamba maa chaŋ.
en: Then the Lord s angel said to Balaam, No, you can go with these men. But be careful. Speak only the words that I will tell you to say. So Balaam went with the leaders that Balak had sent.

dag: Dama nyini Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ n-kahigi dimbɔŋɔ wuhi mani a dabili ŋɔ ka yɛli, N ni me a yili ti a, dinzuɣu ka mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ mali suhukpeeni n-suhir a suhigu ŋɔ.
en: Lord Almighty, God of Israel! I have the courage to pray this prayer to you, because you have revealed all this to me, your servant, and have told me that you will make my descendants kings.

dag: Hɔrinim mi n-daa pun be Ɛdom, amaa ka Iso zuliya daa ti ŋme n-deei li, ka ku ba ka ʒini nimaani n-zani bɛ zaani kaman Izraɛlnim ni daa niŋ shɛm Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba ni bɛ su li la ni la.
en: The Horites also lived in Seir in the past. Then Esaus people destroyed the Horites, took their land, and settled there, just as the Israelites did to the people in the land that the Lord gave them.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana daa tim ti yɛli Taai Naa Hiram, A ni daa ti m ba Dauda sida dari ka o me o yil la, niŋmi n gba lala.
en: Solomon sent a message to King Hiram of Tyre: Do business with me as you did with my father, King David, when you sold him cedar logs for building his palace.

dag: Yi ni yɛli ba bahi, ka pɔhim ʒi ba chaŋ, ka sanʒiɛɣu ʒe n-wurim ba. Di saha yi suhuri ni paligi man Yawɛ zuɣu; ka yi paɣi mani ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ.
en: When you winnow them, the wind will carry them off; the tempest will scatter them. You will rejoice in the LORD and take pride in the holy one of Israel.

dag: Amaa maligumaana Zadok mini Bɛnaaya Jɛhɔiada bia la ni anabi Neetan ni Shimɛi ni Rɛi ni Dauda ninvuɣ kpɛma la daa ka Adɔnija polo.
en: But Zadok the priest, Benaiah son of Jehoiada, Nathan the prophet, Shimei, Rei, and David's bodyguards were not on Adonijah's side.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisifu daa yɛl o tumtumdiba bɛn nyɛ tima baŋdiba ni bɛ niŋm tim ʒe o ba niŋgbuŋ ka di ku pooi. Ka tima baŋdiba maa daa niŋ tim ʒe Izraɛl niŋgbuŋ.
en: Joseph gave orders for Jacob's body to be embalmed.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, A ŋmanila zo shɛli din kuri niriba, ka ku dunia zaa. N yi n-zani a zuɣu. N ni teei n nuu n-wurim a nahi tiŋgbani ka buɣim di a zaa.
en: Im against you, you mountain of destruction, declares the LORD, you destroyer of the whole earth! I will reach out against you; I will topple you from your heights; I will turn you into a rubbish heap.

dag: Ka Jɛrimia daa yɛli niriba maa zaa zaŋ tabili paɣiba maa zaa, Yinim Judanim zaa bɛn be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni ŋɔ, wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Then Jeremiah said to all the people, including the women: Listen to the LORDs word, all you Judeans in the land of Egypt.

dag: ni di chɛ ka nyuli gbaai Yɛhudianim bɛn nyɛ mmaŋmaŋ zuliya la, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ ni shɛb tiligi.
en: in the hope that somehow I might make my own people jealous and save some of them.

dag: ni Baalat ni Tama din be Juda tiŋgban ni mɔɣu ni la.
en: He also built the cities of Baalath and Tamar in the Judean desert.

dag: Di nyaaŋa di daa bi yuui ka Yisa chani tin shɛli din yuli booni Nain la; ka o nyaandoliba mini salo pam dol o.
en: The next day Jesus and his followers went to a town called Nain. A big crowd was traveling with them.

dag: Kumiya dokura, ka ku nachimba mini paɣisara ni bihi ni paɣiba. Amaa miriya ka yi ti shihi bɛ ni zaŋ bini dalim ninvuɣ shɛb gbɛri zuɣu la. Pilimiya n jɛmbu duu la shee. Di saha ka bɛ daa piligi zuɣulaannim bɛn daa be o jɛmbu duu samban ni la kubu.
en: Kill the old men, young men, young women, mothers, and children. But don't touch anyone who has the mark on his forehead. Start here at my Temple. So they began with the leaders who were standing there at the Temple.

dag: Ka Aruna daa ti lihi nya Naa Dauda min o kpamba ni kani o sanna, ka o daa tuhi ba soli ti lu naa sizuura n-damdi zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa.
en: Araunah looked and saw David and his soldiers coming up toward him. He went over to David, bowed down low.

dag: Tibidarigibo biɛɣu neeya, sanyoo biɛɣu neeya. Izraɛlnim ni ti baŋ lala. Anabi maa nyɛla jɛrigu, shia ni be ninvuɣ so ni maa nyɛla yinyaa, dama yi tuumbiɛri mini yi jɛlinsi galisiya pam.
en: The days of punishment have come; the days of judgment have arrived; Israel cries, The prophet is a fool, the spiritual man is mad! Because of your great wickedness, your rejection of me is great.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, Yiŋbi ŋuni n-lee pal alikauli ka nyɛ yɛndana? Di nyɛla yiŋbi so ŋun yiŋlana zaŋ o yili fukumsi niŋ o nuu ni ni o bahiri mɔni mɔni bahibu saha.
en: Who are faithful and wise servants? Who are the ones the master will put in charge of giving the other servants their food supplies at the proper time?.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ zaa tɔɣisi ti ni daa ka yi sanna ka yi deei ti viɛnyɛliŋga shɛm la yɛla: Yi daa ŋmaligi chaŋ Naawuni sani ka chɛ buɣa ni yi jɛm Naawuni maŋli ŋun nyɛ nyɛvililana ŋɔ.
en: People tell us about what sort of welcome we had from you and how you turned to God from idols. As a result, you are serving the living and true God.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ ba zalila Yawɛ jɛmbu duu, ka bɛ zoori ti Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: They are like trees planted in the house of the Lord , that flourish in the Temple of our God.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ maligumaana maa suhupiɛlli, ka o kpuɣi tan shɛli din ŋmani mukuru maa mini binnan bihi ni dari binnani maa n-kpe m-be niriba maa sunsuuni ka bɛ chana.
en: The priest really liked that idea. So he took the vest and the idols and joined the others.

dag: Dama yi suhuri yi ye di niŋbu zuɣu, Naawuni ni dee li kaman yi ni nyaŋ shɛm tariga zuɣu ka mi ku galim ya yi ni ka shɛli zuɣu.
en: It doesn't matter how much you have. What matters is how much you are willing to give from what you have.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ Yawɛ naani ka chɛ buɣa jɛmbu bee n-woligi bɛmaŋ ka chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi buɣa mali alibarika.
en: Great blessings belong to those who trust in the Lord , for those who do not turn to demons and false gods for help.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ oniɣisi kuɣ ayi n-sabi Izraɛl bidibisi la yuya pa di zuɣu.
en: Take two onyx stones. Write the names of the twelve sons of Israel on these jewels.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni chɛ ka bɛnkam maani maligu buɣa jɛmbu shee, ka tuɣindi tulaale zim tiri bɛ wuna Mɔab la chɛ li niŋbu.
en: I will stop the people of Moab from making burnt offerings at their places of worship and from offering sacrifices to their gods. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan lab teeku nol ni, ka salo maa zaa lan laɣimna nti gil o ka o wuhiri ba.
en: Once again, Jesus went to the shore of Lake Galilee. A large crowd gathered around him, and he taught them.
