dag: Ka Yisa daa yi nimaani chana nti nya Matiu, ka o ʒi farigu deebu shee; ka Yisa yɛl o, Yiɣisim doli ma. Ka o yiɣisi dol o.
en: Jesus left that place, and as he walked along, he saw a tax collector, named Matthew, sitting in his office. He said to him, Follow me. Matthew got up and followed him.

dag: Dina n-daa chɛ ka Farisiinim yɛri taba, Nyamiya, ti kul nahindila timaŋ yoli! Dunianim zaa n-kabiri dol o la.
en: Therefore, the Pharisees said to each other, See! Youve accomplished nothing! Look! The whole world is following him.

dag: Di saha ka Ilaisha daa yɛli Shunɛm paɣ so bia o ni daa neei kum ni la, Yiɣisim zaŋ a yiŋnim zaa kuli luɣ shɛli a ni yɛn tooi kuli; dama Yawɛ ni chɛ ka kum lu tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni yuma ayopɔin.
en: Elisha told the woman whose son he had brought back to life, The Lord has warned that there will be no food here for seven years. Take your family and go live somewhere else for a while.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ yɛliya, Yɛlimaŋli, saha kanna ka n ni ti darigi di buɣa la tibili, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nya dansi ni ti do di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa ŋ-ŋuhira.
en: So then, I say that the time is coming when I will deal with Babylon's idols, and the wounded will groan throughout the country.

dag: ka chɛ ka bɛ bihi kpi tinzun tinsi ni, ka wurim ba ka bɛ chaŋ ti be tinduya ni.
en: scattering their offspring among the nations, casting them across many lands.

dag: Biɛɣu pihinahi ka bɛ daa zaŋ niŋ tim maa ʒe o niŋgbuŋ maa, dama bɛ ni daa yi zaŋdi dabisi shɛŋa n-tumdi di tuma m-bala. Ka Ijiptinim daa zaŋ biɛɣ pisopɔin kum o kuli.
en: and it took the usual days. The Egyptians mourned days for Jacob.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛlnim daa beni ka barina shɛli kani. Yaakubu zuliya kɔŋko n-daa be tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali bindira mini wain; ni luɣ shɛli maligim ni yiri zuɣusaa luri tiŋ na.
en: So Israel now lives in safety— Jacobs residence is secure— in a land full of grain and wine, where the heavens drip dew.

dag: O daa poya Yawɛ sani. O daa po pɔri Yaakubu Naawuni ŋun nyɛ kpiɔŋlan ŋɔ sani yɛli.
en: and how he swore to the LORD, how he promised the strong one of Jacob.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa tim a ka yɛl a, Cham ti ku Amalɛknim bɛn nyɛ alahichinim ŋɔ, ka tuhi kpihim bɛ birili zaa.
en: The LORD sent you on a mission, instructing you, Go, and put the sinful Amalekites under the ban. Fight against them until youve wiped them out.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ tipawumlinim bɛn tɛhi ni tiliginsim be katiŋ ŋɔ, wummiya!.
en: Listen to me, you stubborn people! You are far from doing what is right.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba ni daa ti paai Bɛtifɛji, Olivi Tihi Zoli din miri Jɛrusalɛm la gbini, ka o tim o nyaandoliba ayi.
en: Jesus and his followers were coming closer to Jerusalem. But first they stopped at Bethphage at the hill called the Mount of Olives. From there Jesus sent two of his followers into town.

dag: Elɔn mi kalinsi yaaŋa, Hilliɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Piratɔn nir la bia Abidɔn n-daa leei Izraɛlnim zuɣulana.
en: After Elon, Abdon, Hillels son from Pirathon, led Israel.

dag: Malimiya sara shɛli yi ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl Yawɛ san la. Dina n-nyɛ: naɣilabih ayi mini piɛla yino ni yuun yini piɛlabih ayopɔin.
en: You must offer a burnt offering as a sweet-smelling gift to the Lord . You must offer bulls, ram, and lambs that are one year old. There must be nothing wrong with them.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ ni ti ku bɛ nachimba zama laɣiŋgu shee, ka ku bɛ tɔbbihi zaa dindali maa. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: People of Babylon, I, the Lord , promise that even your best soldiers will lie dead in the streets.

dag: Ka Yuria bia Mɛrɛmɔt ŋun daa nyɛ Hakɔz yaaŋa la daa mali me m-pani bɛ zuɣu. Ka Bɛrɛkia bia Mɛshulam ŋun daa nyɛ Mɛshɛzabɛl yaaŋa la daa mali me m-pani bɛ zuɣu. Ka Baana bia Zadok daa mali me m-pani bɛ zuɣu.
en: Meremoth, son of Uriah and grandson of Hakkoz, completed the next section of the wall. Meshullam, son of Berechiah and grandson of Meshezabel, rebuilt the next section, and Zadok son of Baana rebuilt the section beside that.

dag: Dama a yɛliya, M biɛhigu nyɛla din be kasi, ka n ka daɣiri Naawuni sani!.
en: You claim that what you say is true; you claim you are pure in the sight of God.

dag: Tii maa vari daa viɛli pam ka di kul wali gbilim; ka dunia ŋɔ ni daadamnim mini binnɛma zaa ni tooi paai li di n-tiɣi. Ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri kanna ti dooni di mahim vuhira, ka noonsi tɛri bɛ tɛri di wula zuɣu, ka vuhirigu kam diri di wala.
en: The leaves of the tree were beautiful. It had much good fruit on it. And on the tree was plenty of food for everyone. The wild animals found shelter under the tree, and the birds lived in its branches. Every animal ate from the tree.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni nira daa chaŋ naa maa sani ti yɛl o, N dan naa, di chɛ ka Izraɛl tɔbbihi ŋɔ pahi dol a chaŋ, dama Yawɛ ka Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ Ifriim zuliya ŋɔ zaa so sani.
en: But a man of God confronted him. King, he said, the troops from Israel must not go with you, because the LORD isnt on the side of Israel or any Ephraimite.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa zali shɛm maa daa tiɣi naa mini niriba maa zaa nini.
en: The king and the people were pleased with their plan.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli Jɔab min o sapashin kpamba bɛn daa be o sani la, Chamiya gili Izraɛl zuliyanim zaa ni, zaŋ Dan hal ti kpa Bɛrishiiba n-kali niriba maa ka m-baŋ bɛ kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: So the king said to Joab and the military commanders who were with him, Go throughout all the tribes of Israel, from Dan to Beer-sheba, and take a census of the people so I know how many people there are.

dag: Bɛna n-daa yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti deei tiŋgbɔn shɛli din nyɛ Naawuni din la n-leei ti dini.
en: who said, We will take for our own the land that belongs to God.

dag: Amaa nyini Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa yɛli ma, Zaŋmi liɣiri da puu maa ka bo shɛhiranima hal bɛ ni kul zaŋ tiŋ maa niŋ Kalidianim nuu ni maa zaa yoli.
en: So why tell me, LORD God, Buy the field for money and make sure there are witnesses, when the city is under Babylonian control?.

dag: Ka Aduna daa yɛli Musa, Nyama, zuŋɔ ka bɛ mali bɛ daalahichi sanyoo sara mini bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la, amaa di zaa yoli ka yɛla ŋ-ŋɔ ti paai ma! N yi di di alahichi sanyoo sara maligu ŋɔ zuŋɔ Yawɛ naan saɣi lala.
en: But Aaron said to Moses, Look, today they brought their sin offering and burnt offering before the Lord . But you know what happened to me today! Do you think the Lord would be happy if I ate the sin offering today.

dag: Ka Dɛbɔra yɛli, N ni dol a chaŋ, amaa pa nyini nti yɛn nya a chandi maa nasara dibu jilima, dama Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka paɣa n-nyaŋ Sisɛra. Ka Dɛbɔra daa yiɣisi doli Barak chaŋ Kɛdɛshi.
en: Of course I will go with you, Deborah answered. But because of your attitude, you will not be honored when Sisera is defeated. The Lord will allow a woman to defeat Sisera. So Deborah went with Barak to the city of Kedesh.

dag: N ni kpaŋsi yi suhuri kaman paɣ ni kpaŋsir o bia suhu shɛm la. Yi ni nya suhukpaŋsibo Jɛrusalɛm.
en: I will comfort you there like a mother comforting her child.

dag: Dinzuɣu kul gbibiya yi ni pun mali shɛl la kirikiri hal ka n ti kana.
en: Only hold on to the truth you have until I come.

dag: N wuhiya ni a yurilim maŋli maa kul yɛn benimi sahakam; a ʒiɛyimtali mi kul bami ʒiɛya kaman zuɣusaa la.
en: I will tell them, God's love can always be trusted, and his faithfulness lasts as long as the heavens.

dag: Di saha ka Balaam daa lihi Amalɛknima, ka tɔɣis o daanabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Amalɛknima n-daa be zuliya kam tooni, Amaa bɛ bahigu ni ti nyɛla bahi yoli zaa.
en: Then in his vision Balaam saw the Amalekites and uttered this prophecy: Amalek was the most powerful nation of all, But at the end it will perish forever.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ anzinfa kpila maa bahi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, ka yi n-chaŋ ti yil omaŋ mia.
en: Judas threw the silver pieces into the temple and left. Then he went and hanged himself.

dag: Bɛ zaa gbibila takɔbiri, bɛ nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biinsi, ka bɛ takɔbiri maa baɣi bɛ gbalipina; bɛ malila shili gu yuŋ bimbiɛri.
en: all of them skilled with the sword, expert in warfare, each with his sword ready at his thigh against terrors that come by night.

dag: ka Ahaz nyɛ o bia, ka Hɛzɛkia nyɛ o bia, ka Manaasa nyɛ o bia.
en: his son Ahaz, his son Hezekiah, his son Manasseh.

dag: amaa ka Maata ŋun tɛha kul bela bindirigu niŋbu ni, ka daa ti chaŋ Yisa sani ti bɔh o, N Duuma, a baɣa ka n tizo maa ni chɛ tuma jɛli ma ŋɔ ni? Yɛlim o ni o sɔŋm ma.
en: Martha was worried about all that had to be done. Finally, she went to Jesus and said, Lord, doesn't it bother you that my sister has left me to do all the work by myself? Tell her to come and help me.

dag: Amaa n yi ti tɔɣis a yɛtɔɣa, n ni chɛ ka a noli yaai ka a yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya. Chɛ ka bɛn ni wum, wum. Ka chɛ ka bɛn zaɣisi wumbu, zaɣisi. Dama bɛ nyɛla duŋtaariba.
en: But I will talk to you, and then I will allow you to speak. But you must say to them, This is what the Lord GOD says. If a person wants to listen, fine. If a person refuses to listen, fine. But those people always turn against me.

dag: Pɛrɛz zuliya ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Pɛrɛz n-daa dɔɣi Hɛzirɔn, ka Hɛzirɔn dɔɣi Ram.
en: Here is a list of the ancestors of David: Jesse, Obed, Boaz, Salmon, Nahshon, Amminadab, Ram, Hezron, and Perez.

dag: Pita daa lan yɛli ba yaha, Yi gba nyɛla anabinim maa yaansi, ka su alikauli shɛli Naawuni ni daa lo yi yaannim maa. O daa yɛli ti yab Ibrahimma ni o zuliya zuɣu ka dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam ni ti nya alibarika.
en: You are the heirs of the prophets and the covenant that God made with your ancestors when he told Abraham, Through your descendants, all the families on earth will be blessed. .

dag: Yuun pinaanahi nyaaŋa ka m mini Baanabas daa yɛn chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm, ka n daa zaŋ Taitus m-pahi ka ti chaŋ.
en: Then after fourteen years I went up to Jerusalem again with Barnabas, and I took Titus along also.

dag: O daa chɛ ka o suli min o sujee ni o suhuyiɣisili ni nandahima paai ba, ka di ŋmanila malaika bɔbili bɛn kuri niriba.
en: God was so angry and furious that he went into a rage and caused them great trouble by sending swarms of destroying angels.

dag: Ka ŋun pa o zuɣu daa nyɛ Zikiri bia Amasia ŋun daa saɣi n-zaŋ omaŋ niŋ Yawɛ tuma ni la. O mi daa sula tɔbutuhiri biinsi tuhi kɔbisiyi.
en: Amasiah son of Zichri, who had volunteered to serve the Lord , was third in command, with , soldiers under him.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma doli nuzaa polo dunɔdal la n-chaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa tooni, ka n ti lihi n-nya ka Yawɛ jilima m-pal o jɛmbu duu maa ni. Ka n daa lu n-zaŋ n nini kpa tiŋa.
en: Then the man took me through the north gate to the front of the temple. I saw that the brightness of the Lord 's glory had filled the temple, and I immediately bowed with my face to the ground.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa zaŋ biŋkɔbiri gbana n-she n-ti Adam min o paɣ maa ka bɛ so.
en: And the Lord God made clothes out of animal skins for Adam and his wife, and he clothed them.

dag: Chɛ ka niriba ŋɔ niŋ suhutunanima, ka chɛ ka bɛ tiba kpiri, ka chɛ ka bɛ nina zom, ka di chɛ ka bɛ ku zaŋ bɛ nina lihi nya, ka zaŋ bɛ tiba wum, ka zaŋ bɛ suhuri baŋ shɛli gbinni, ka ŋmaligina nya tibbu.
en: Then he said to me, Make the minds of these people dull, their ears deaf, and their eyes blind, so that they cannot see or hear or understand. If they did, they might turn to me and be healed.

dag: Mɛrari zuliya maa dɔɣirikpɛma n-daa nyɛ Abiheel bia Zuriɛl. Bɛ daa ti bɛ suɣa zalila laɣiŋgu suɣili maa nuzaa polo.
en: The chief of the household representing the clans of the Merarites was Zuriel, Abihails son. They were to camp on the north side of the dwelling.

dag: Ka Zimiri ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa lo nia biɛ shɛli maa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi ni.
en: Everything else that Zimri did, including the account of his conspiracy, is recorded in The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Zuɣusaa ni du ka chɛ tiŋgbani shɛm, lala ka o yurilim maŋli galisi zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔr o sani.
en: His love for his followers is as high above us as heaven is above the earth.

dag: Yurilim diri suɣilo binshɛɣukam zaa ni, ka niŋdi yɛda binshɛɣukam zaa ni, ka mali tahima binshɛɣukam zaa ni, ka lan niŋdi ania binshɛɣukam zaa ni.
en: Love puts up with all things, trusts in all things, hopes for all things, endures all things.

dag: Ka ŋun daa pa a zuɣu wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa ni n-daa nyɛ Ɛliɛza, Dɔdo ŋun daa nyɛ Aho nir la bia.
en: Next in command came Eleazar, Dodos son the Ahohite, who was one of the three warriors.

dag: Yilimiya wumpaɣibo yila paɣi Yawɛ, ka ŋme mɔɣilo paɣi ti Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Sing hymns of praise to the Lord ; play music on the harp to our God.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ni yɛn zaŋ binshɛŋa lo daantalisi din gili dundɔŋ maa zaa ti nyɛla anzinfa ka di bansi ti nyɛ anzinfa, ka di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu ti nyɛ daanya.
en: All the posts around the enclosure are to be connected with silver rods, and their hooks are to be made of silver and their bases of bronze.

dag: Ka yi mi din na taɣi di niŋbu zali. Dina n-nyɛ ni di chɛ ka Zaliguzaɣisira la ti yi zahira o saha dɛde.
en: Now you know what holds him back so that he can be revealed when his time comes.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim bɛn kpalim la daa pah o zuɣu n-dol o bilikɔnsi soli maa hal ka Baanabas gba daa birigi pahi bɛ zuɣu n-doli bɛ bilikɔnsi soli maa.
en: The other Jewish believers also started acting like cowards along with Peter; and even Barnabas was swept along by their cowardly action.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ʒini tiŋa o sani wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ hal ni daba ayopɔin, ka bɛ ni so daa bi yɛl o shɛli, dama bɛ daa nyaya ka o be biɛrim pam ni.
en: Then they sat there on the ground with him for seven days and nights without saying a word, because they saw how much he was suffering.

dag: Yi goma mɛbu dabisili kanna. Dindali maa yi tintarisi ni ti yɛligi pam pahi.
en: A day for the building of your walls! On that day, the boundary will be distant.

dag: N nina kul zɔrila nintam kaman kulibɔŋ kom la, bɛ ni bahi n niriba yoli zaa maa zuɣu.
en: My eyes flow with streams of tears. I cry because of the destruction of my people.

dag: A daa zaɣisi a niriba bɛn nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya la! Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ malila laasabuniŋdiba bɛn yi wulimpuhili polo na, ka mali baɣisi kaman Filisitianim la, ka zaŋ bɛ noli ti naai tinzunnima.
en: Our Lord , you have deserted your people, Israel, because they follow customs of nations from the east. They worship Philistine gods and are close friends of foreigners.

dag: N yi ti kpihim a birili, n ni chɛ ka zuɣusaa zibigi, ka saŋmarisi ku lan ne. N ni ti chɛ ka sagbana limsi wuntaŋa, ka goli ti ku lan paligi.
en: I will cover the whole sky and every star with thick clouds, so that the sun and moon will stop shining.

dag: Wummiya, yinim Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ Izraɛlnim dɔɣirikpamba mini bɛ nanim bɛn zaɣisi zaligu, ka tiri nimmira yɛlimaŋli ŋɔ.
en: Leaders of Jacob and rulers of Israel, listen to me! You hate the right way of living! If something is straight, then you make it crooked!.

dag: N Naawuni, teemi Tɔbaya mini Sanbalat ni tum shɛm ŋɔ yɛla, ka teei Nɔadia ŋun nyɛ anab paɣ la mini anab shɛb bɛn zaa pahi m-bɔri ni bɛ kpɛhi ma dabiɛm la gba yɛla.
en: My God, please remember Tobiah and Sanballat and the bad things they have done. Also remember the woman prophet Noadiah and the other prophets who have been trying to scare me.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka lahibal suŋ waazu daa yihi ti bɛn kpi la, ka hal bɛ ni nya saria karibu bɛ niŋgbuna ni kaman daadam kam la zaa yoli, bɛ shihi lee ni nya nyɛvili m-be kaman Naawuni ni be shɛm.
en: Some were told the Good News before they died. They were criticized by others in their life here on earth. But it was Gods plan that they hear the Good News so that they could have a new life through the Spirit.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ, dama o viɛla, ka o yurilim maŋli bi naara.
en: Give thanks to the LORD because he is good, because his faithful love endures forever.

dag: Pa lala n-nyɛ li n dabili Musa sani, n zaŋla n niriba zaa fukumsi niŋ o nuu ni.
en: But Moses is not like that. He is my faithful servant—I trust him with everyone in my house.

dag: O daa yɛli ba, Nyamiya, yi yi chaŋ yin chamiya ti sɔɣi dɔni tiŋ maa gulinyaaŋa; di kaɣiya ti do katiŋa ka chɛ tiŋ maa, ka maliya shili viɛnyɛliŋga gu;.
en: Joshua gave them this command: Listen carefully to what I tell you. You must hide in the area behind the city. Wait for the time to attack. Dont go far from the city. Continue to watch and be ready.

dag: Amaa paɣ maa yi ti nya omaŋa, ŋun kalimi daba ayopɔin, di nyaaŋa o ni yi daɣiri ni.
en: When the woman is cleansed of her discharge, she will count off seven days; after that, she will be clean again.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yooi n tiba, ka m mi bi niŋ tipawumli bee n-lab nyaaŋa.
en: The LORD God opened my ear; I didnt rebel; I didnt turn my back.

dag: N Duuma, a pal a ni daa lo alikauli shɛl la, dinzuɣu chɛ ka man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ yi dunia ni ni suhudoo;.
en: Now, Lord, you can let me, your servant, die in peace as you said.

dag: Ijiptinim nyɛla ninsalinima ka pa Naawuni, ka bɛ yuri nyɛ biŋkɔbiri ka pa lahizibu binyara. Yawɛ yi ti lu bɛ zuɣu, bɛn nyɛ sɔŋdiba maa ni ti tuui, ka bɛ ni sɔŋdi shɛb maa lu, ka bɛ zaa laɣim bahi yoli.
en: The Egyptians are only human, not God. The horses from Egypt are only animals, not spirit. The Lord will stretch out his arm, and the helper will be defeated. And those who wanted help will fall. They will all be destroyed together.

dag: Nyin Yawɛ yɛligu ka m paɣira, nyin Naawuni yɛligu ka m paɣira.
en: I praise God for his promise. I praise the Lord for his promise to me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛl o zilima pam ka tur o.
en: They kept on insulting Jesus in many other ways.

dag: ka zaŋ salima alali m-mali zoligɔnim ayi n-ŋmɛl li kaman gabisi la n-zaŋ li ga kuɣa maa ni yɛn taɣili binshɛŋa ni maa.
en: along with two chains of pure gold, twisted like cords. Attach the corded chains to the gold settings.

dag: Yinim jɛra ŋɔ, pa ŋun nam di nyaaŋ maa n-nam di puuni maa gba?.
en: Fools! Did not God, who made the outside, also make the inside?.

dag: Zuliya kam, yi zaa wummiya! Dunia ŋɔ mini binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni, wummiya! Chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ka be o jɛmbu duu din be kasi ŋɔ ni di shɛhira jɛndi ya.
en: Listen, all of you! Earth and everything on it, pay close attention. The Lord God accuses you from his holy temple.

dag: Kum kɔgbana daa gili ma niŋ sunsuuni, ka bahi yoli kɔgbana liri ma.
en: Death, like ocean waves, surrounded me, and I was almost swallowed by its flooding waters.

dag: Musa ni daa zaŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa yɛli Izraɛlnim zaa naai saha shɛli ka o daa yɛli ba.
en: Moses continued speaking to the people of Israel.

dag: Juda Naa Ahazia bia Naa Jɔash ni daa di Juda nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pisinaata saha, ka Jɛhu bia Jɛhɔahaz daa di Izraɛl nam n-ʒi Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ la o nam maa ni yuun pinaayopɔin.
en: Jehoahaz son of Jehu became king over Israel in Samaria. This was during the rd year that Joash son of Ahaziah was king in Judah. Jehoahaz ruled years.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Amaa wahala dabisa ŋɔ nyaaŋa saha, di ku yuui ka wuntaŋ dii zibigi, ka goli ti ku lan piɛla, ka yiko din gbib zuɣusaa ni ti dam ka saŋmarisi yi zuɣusaa luna.
en: Now immediately after the suffering of that time the sun will become dark, and the moon wont give its light. The stars will fall from the sky and the planets and other heavenly bodies will be shaken.

dag: Dinzuɣu kum ni neebu dali, ŋun paɣa n-lee ni ti nyɛ o? Dama bɛ niriba ayopɔin maa zaa daa kpuɣ o mi.
en: Now, when all the dead rise to life on the day of resurrection, whose wife will she be? All seven of them had married her.

dag: ka di chɛ ka Izraɛlnim nyaŋ Ɛdomnim tinsi din kpalim la mini tin shɛŋa din zaa daa pun nyɛ n tinsi la. Yawɛ ŋun yɛn niŋ dimbɔŋɔ maa n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Then the people left alive in Edom, and all the people called by my name, will look to me for help. This is what the Lord said, and he will make it happen.

dag: Firilanim pam daa be jirambisa du shɛl ni ti ni daa laɣim maa.
en: We were all together in a room upstairs, and there were many lights in the room.

dag: yin miriya ka yi ti doli bɛ tuma, ka zana gbahi ya. Di ti bɔhiya bɛ wuna yɛla n-yɛra, Wula ka niriba ŋɔ daa lee jɛmdi bɛ wuna ŋɔ? Ti gba bɔri ni ti jɛm li.
en: After the Lord destroys those nations, make sure that you don't follow their religious practices, because that would be fatal. Don't try to find out how they worship their gods, so that you can worship in the same way.

dag: Maligumaaniba zuɣulan kam yirila o tab sunsuuni na ni o ʒe bɛ zaani n-zaŋdi pina mini sara maani maligu niriba daalahichi zuɣu Naawuni sani.
en: Every high priest is taken from the people and put in charge of things that relate to God for their sake, in order to offer gifts and sacrifices for sins.

dag: ka doli Naawuni ni daa kari zuliya shɛb ka deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa n-ti bɛn Izraɛlnim la kaya mini Izraɛl nanim ni daa zaŋ ka shɛŋa wuhi ba la.
en: They began doing the same things that other people did. And the Lord had forced those people to leave their land when the Israelites came. The Israelites also chose to be ruled by kings.

dag: Ka o daa lan ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Yi yi yurila bɛn yuri ya ko, paɣiri bɔ ka yi lee yɛn nya? Dama alahichinim gba yurila bɛn yuri ba.
en: If you love those who love you, why should you be commended? Even sinners love those who love them.

dag: N Naawuni, teemi n yɛla zaŋ chaŋ dimbɔŋɔ polo, ka di kpihim tuun sun shɛŋa n ni tum ti n Naawuni jɛmbu duu mini di tuma ŋɔ.
en: Remember me, my God, concerning this. Dont erase my good deeds that I have done for my Gods house and for its services.

dag: Yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi yi ku wum n yɛligu, ka doli n ni zali ya zaligu shɛŋa la.
en: You will say to them, This is what the Lord says: I gave my teachings to you. You must obey me and follow my teachings.

dag: Wuntaŋ kul puhirimina n-chani ti lura, ka lan zɔri yomyom labiri o ni puhiri shɛli polo.
en: The sun rises and the sun goes down, and then it hurries to rise again in the same place.

dag: Ka ŋunkam daa yi mir o ni o damd o tiŋa n-lu o sizuura, o teerila o nuu gbaai dilana m-mɔɣis o kpariŋ.
en: When the man would approach Absalom to bow down before him, Absalom would reach out, take hold of him, and kiss him.

dag: Ka Taai Naa Hiram daa chɛ ka tuumba ʒi sida dakuɣiri chaŋ ti ti Dauda. O daa bola tammɛriba mini kapintanima ni bɛ ti me Dauda yili ti o.
en: King Hiram of Tyre sent a trade mission to David; he provided him with cedar logs and with stonemasons and carpenters to build a palace.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ lala paai dabisa shɛm, ka Pool nyee ti nyɔni ka o ŋmaligi tahi kpilikpariga ŋun daa sɔŋdi bipuɣiŋga maa ka o buɣiri baɣiri maa zuɣu n-yɛli, Yisa Masia yuli zuɣu, zom ka chɛ o! Ka kpilikpariga maa daa shiri zo ka chɛ o di saha maa.
en: She did this for many days, until Paul became so upset that he turned around and said to the spirit, In the name of Jesus Christ I order you to come out of her! The spirit went out of her that very moment.

dag: dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam ni ka n yih a na; ka bol a ka a yi dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam ni katiŋ na, ka n yɛl a, A nyɛla n dabili. Mani m-piig a ka bi zaɣis a.
en: From far across the earth I brought you here and said, You are my chosen servant. I haven't forgotten you.

dag: Ka o ni zaŋ kurigu jaaŋgbee n-su ba, ka to n-wurim ba kaman yaɣiri duɣiri ni ŋmari n-wurisiri shɛm la, ka o yiko maa ni be kaman mmaŋmaŋ gba ni daa deei yiko shɛli m Ba Naawuni san la;.
en: I will give each of them the same power my Father has given me. They will rule the nations with an iron rod and smash those nations to pieces like clay pots. I will also give them the morning star.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Zara daa nya yaa niŋ pua, hal o ni daa yaɣi dɔɣibu saha shɛl la, dama o daa niŋ ŋun lo o alikauli maa naani.
en: Sarah was not able to have children, and Abraham was too old. But he had faith in God, trusting him to do what he promised. And so God made them able to have children.

dag: ka Mɛshulam daa nyɛ Ɛzra daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma; ka Jɛhɔhanan daa nyɛ Amaria daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma;.
en: of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan.

dag: Bɛ daa yi n-chaŋ ti tumdi Masia tuma, ka bi deei sɔŋsim shɛli bɛn pa yɛdaniŋdib la sani.
en: because they left on their journey for the sake of Jesus Christ without accepting any support from the Gentiles.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda tɔbbihi mini Jɔab daa yi ŋmɛnditoli yɔɣu paana ni nɛma pam. Amaa di saha maa Abinɛr daa lan ka Dauda sani Hiburɔn. Dauda daa pun chɛbis o mi ka o chaŋ ni suhudoo.
en: Soon after Abner had left Hebron, Joab and some of David's soldiers came back, bringing a lot of things they had taken from an enemy village.

dag: Binshɛɣukam neesim ni yihi palɔni, di biɛhigu maŋli gba yirimi do palɔni; dama binshɛɣukam din yi n-do palɔni gba leela neesim.
en: But the light will show what these things are really like.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋdi tulaale zim shɛli yiri Shiiba na maa buchi lee nyɛ dini n sani? Bee binnyoma din yi katiŋ na maa buchi lee nyɛ di ni n sani? N ku deei yi ni zaŋdi binshɛŋa nyɔri buɣim maani sara la. M mi nini bi lan tiɣi yi sara maligunima.
en: People of Judah, you bring me incense from Sheba and spices from distant lands. You offer sacrifices of all kinds. But why bother? I hate these gifts of yours!.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa kaɣil o hal ka di ti niŋ o vi, ka o bahi ba noli ni bɛ timma. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa tim ninvuɣ pihinu ka bɛ chaŋ ti lihi bɔ o dabisi muna ata zaa ka bi nya o.
en: They kept begging until he was embarrassed to say no. He finally agreed, and the prophets sent the men out. They looked three days for Elijah but never found him.

dag: Amaa ka Ibram daa yɛli Zarai Nyama, o nyɛla a dabili, ka a su o fukumsi; niŋm o a ni yu shɛm. Ka Zarai daa yihi Haga halibiɛɣu ka o zo.
en: Abram answered, Very well, she is your slave and under your control; do whatever you want with her. Then Sarai treated Hagar so cruelly that she ran away.

dag: Ka a niŋ salima alali pa di zuɣu, ka niŋ salima kɔɣili li gili.
en: Cover it with pure gold and make a gold molding all around it.

dag: Bɛ ʒii nyabu nyɛla ʒiri, ka bɛ daanabitali yɛtɔɣa nyɛ ʒiri. Bɛ yɛra, Yawɛ yɛliya. Ka di mi pala Yawɛ n-tim ba. Amaa ka bɛ bɔri ni bɛ yɛligu maa niŋ pali.
en: They saw worthless visions and performed deceptive divinations. Even though the LORD didnt send them, they said, This is what the LORD says and expected their word to stand.

dag: Biɛɣuni asiba, yi sa ni nya Yawɛ jilima, dama o wum yi ni ŋumdi yi kparima ni niŋdi ŋun Yawɛ shɛm maa. Dama ti mi lee nyɛla banima, ka yi ŋumdi yi kparima ni niŋdi ti?.
en: And in the morning you will see the LORDs glorious presence, because your complaints against the LORD have been heard. Who are we? Why blame us.

dag: Amaa n ni ti chɛ ka bɛ niriba biɛla tiligi takɔbi maa mini fifali ni ni alɔbo ni din ni chɛ ka bɛ yɛli bɛ ni yɛn chaŋ zuliya shɛb sani maa, bɛ ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa zaa, di saha ka bɛ baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Some of them will survive the war, the starvation, and the deadly diseases. That way, they will be able to tell foreigners how disgusting their sins were, and that it was the Lord who punished them in this way.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ti yɛn kari dabisili kam sara maligu la, ka zaŋ din nyɛ chihi biɛɣu la zali di zaani la, di dabisa ti yɛn nyɛla biɛɣ tuhili ni kɔbisiyi ni pihiwɛi.
en: There will be one thousand two hundred ninety days from the time the daily sacrifice is stopped to the setting up of the desolating monstrosity.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni yɛli shɛm la: Yi yi wum Naawuni kukoli zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, yin miriya ka yi niŋ tipawumlinima kaman bɛ ni daa niŋ shɛm taai duŋ la.
en: This is what the scripture says: If you hear God's voice today, do not be stubborn, as your ancestors were when they rebelled against God.

dag: Dunianima, wummiya, dabiɛm mini bɔɣ biɛri ni zana n-ʒe n-gun ya.
en: I see troubles for you people living in this land. I see fear, pits, and problems all around.

dag: Vinvamli ni taŋkpaɣu niŋdi ba la nyaɣisim, ka sokam ni doli bɛ nyaaŋa. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pun daŋ tooni ka kalinli.
en: the earth welcomes them home, while crowds mourn.

dag: Ti mabihi, di gbarigiya tuun suma tumbu ni.
en: Brothers and sisters, never get tired of doing good.

dag: dama Naawuni yi daa bi tiligi puu ni olivi tia maa wula la, dindina o ku tilig a gba.
en: If God did not let the natural branches of that tree stay, he will not let you stay if you stop believing.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yihiri laɣ shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋ tahi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu na la saha shɛli ka maligumaana Hilikia daa nyɛ Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa ti Musa ni o ti o niriba la kundi.
en: While the money was being given to these supervisors, Hilkiah found the book that contained the laws that the Lord had given to Moses.

dag: Ka Babilɔn naa maa daa kul tir o o dabisili kam laɣidira hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: Each day for as long as he lived, he was given a regular allowance for his needs.

dag: Dinzuɣu miri ka a chɛ ka neesim din be a ni ti leei zibisim.
en: Therefore, see to it that the light in you isnt darkness.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka ninvuɣ so ŋun be nyam va naɣisaa maa tampiligim n-zaŋ li ti zali tiŋ tariga luɣ shɛli din be nyam, ka di nyɛ Izraɛlnim dini; ka bɛ mal li niŋdi kom din yihiri nir daɣiri ni la ni. Di nyɛla daɣiri yihibu sara.
en: Then someone who is clean will collect the ashes from the cow and put them in a clean place outside the camp. These ashes will be used when someone must keep a special ceremony to become clean. These ashes will also be used to remove a persons sins.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛn be tiŋ ŋɔ puuni, tɔbu mini kum ni alɔbo ni ti ku ba, amaa bɛn ti zaŋ bɛmaŋ niŋ Babilɔnnim maa nuu ni, bɛn ni be. Bɛ ni ti leei bɛ ni ŋme tɔbu di shɛba ka be.
en: The LORD proclaims: Whoever stays in this city will die by the sword, famine, and disease. But whoever surrenders to the Babylonians will live; yes, their lives will be spared.

dag: Tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni nim ni ti fabili. Daŋ kam puuni niriba ni ti fabili kɔŋkɔba. Dauda daŋ puuni niriba dɔbba ti yɛn bela bɛ ko fabinda, ka bɛ paɣiba be bɛ ko fabinda. Ka Neetan daŋ puuni niriba dɔbba ti be bɛ ko fabinda, ka bɛ paɣiba be bɛ ko fabinda.
en: Everyone of each family in the land will mourn, and the men will mourn separately from the women. This includes those from the family of David, and the families of Nathan.

dag: Ka paɣ maa suh o ni o kari alizin biɛɣu maa o bia maa zuɣu bahi. Bɛ daa dɔɣ paɣ maa la Siria tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Ka o lee nyɛ Fɔnisia tiŋbia, ka nyɛ ŋun wumdi Giriikili.
en: The woman was Greek, Syrophoenician by birth. She begged Jesus to throw the demon out of her daughter.

dag: Amaa ka ti Duuma malaika daa chaŋ dindali yuŋ nti yooi duu maa dunoya ka yihi ba na yɛli ba.
en: But that night an angel of the Lord opened the prison gates, led the apostles out, and said to them.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, tinzun yɛligu balibu paai shɛm be dunia ŋɔ ni, ka di shɛli mi kani ka bi mali gbinni.
en: It is true that there are many different languages in the world, and they all have meaning.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mbusim be anabi shɛb bɛn nyɛ jɛra, ka doli bɛmaŋmaŋ suhuyubu, ka bi nyari shɛli ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: This is what the Sovereign Lord says: These foolish prophets are doomed! They provide their own inspiration and invent their own visions.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yisahaku daa yiɣisi chaŋ ti ʒini Gɛra vinvamli ni.
en: Isaac left and settled in Gerar Valley.

dag: Ka tiŋgban ni kɔbil nina mini sagbana ni kɔsoya daa ŋari; ka saa chɛ mibu.
en: God stopped up the places where the water had been gushing out from under the earth. He also closed up the sky, and the rain stopped.

dag: N nya Naawuni ni zaŋ tuun shɛli ti sokam ni o tum.
en: I know the heavy burdens that God has laid on us.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Ninvuɣ bɔ n-lee tuhi ya soli n-yɛli ya lala maa.
en: Ahaziah said to them, Describe the man who met you and said these things.

dag: Yawɛ je tuumbiɛtumdiba. O bɔri ni o kpihim bɛ birili dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: But God despises evil people, and he will wipe them all from the earth, till they are forgotten.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd ni daa ti nya Yisa di daa niŋ o nyaɣisim pam, dama o daa pun wum o yɛla ka di wɔɣa, ka bɔri ni o nya o ni o nini, ka daa lan tɛhiri ni di pa shɛli Yisa ni tum alahiziba tuun shɛli ka o nya.
en: Herod was very glad to see Jesus, for he had heard about Jesus and had wanted to see him for quite some time. He was hoping to see Jesus perform some sign.

dag: Bɛ bo n-nya ma pumpɔŋɔ, bɛ teemi gili ma, bɛ lihirimi bɔri bɛ ni yɛn doli so shɛli n-voo ma luhi.
en: They have been following me, and now they are all around me. They watch me, waiting to throw me to the ground.

dag: Dama bɛ ku tooi gbihi ka pa ni bɛ tumla din bi tuhi; bɛ yi bi chɛ ka so tuui, di niŋdi ba la gɔgaliga.
en: The wicked cannot sleep until they have done something evil. They will not rest until they bring someone down.

dag: Chuɣu maa ni daa ti puhi yaɣi di puhibu pirigili saha ka Yisa daa chaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu nti wuhiri niriba.
en: Halfway through the festival, Jesus went up to the temple and started to teach.

dag: Napaɣ Ɛsta duu bihi mini namɔɣilisi ni daa kana ti yɛl o Mɔdɛkai yɛla, di daa niŋ o suhusaɣiŋgu pam. Ka o daa bo binyɛra n-ti ni bɛ zaŋ ti ti Mɔdɛkai ka o ye ka chɛ buɣu maa, ka o daa zaɣisi li.
en: When Esther's servant women and eunuchs told her what Mordecai was doing, she was deeply disturbed. She sent Mordecai some clothes to put on instead of the sackcloth, but he would not accept them.

dag: Ka n daa zaŋ n nina kpa n Duuma Naawuni ni nimmoo m-balim o ni nolɔbo, ka pili buɣu n-teei ʒi tampiligim ni.
en: I then turned my face to my Lord God, asking for an answer with prayer and pleading, and with fasting, mourning clothes, and ashes.

dag: Ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ wuhi ni o nyɛla wuntizɔra ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: He considered what Phinehas did a good work, and it will be remembered forever and ever.

dag: Yɛlim bɛn nyɛ duŋtaariba maa yɛtɔɣ ŋahili ŋɔ. Yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Zaŋmiya duɣu tam, zaŋmiya li tam, ka niŋ kom niŋ di ni.
en: The people there refuse to obey me. I have a story with a message for them. Tell them, This is what the Lord GOD says: Put the pot on the fire. Put on the pot and pour in the water.

dag: Ka Shɛkɛmnim daa bo niriba n-chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ ti sɔɣi do zoya zuɣu gu Abimilɛk, ka daa kul fari bɛnkam zaa doli nimaani gariti nɛma. Ka bɛ daa yɛli Abimilɛk di yɛla.
en: As an act against him, the leaders of Shechem set ambushes on the hilltops that robbed everyone who passed by them on the road. This was reported to Abimelech.

dag: Bɛ daa guni ma la daba anii dali. Bɛ dɔɣi ma la Izraɛl nira. N yila Bɛnjamin zuliya ni na ka nyɛ Hiburu alali. Ka zaŋ chaŋ Yɛhudianim zaligunim mi dolibu polo n daa nyɛla Farisii;.
en: I was circumcised when I was a week old. I am an Israelite by birth, of the tribe of Benjamin, a pure-blooded Hebrew. As far as keeping the Jewish Law is concerned, I was a Pharisee.

dag: Jɛhɔshafat ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o ni daa wuh o kpiɔŋ shɛm ni o ni daa tuhi tɔb shɛŋa zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: Jehoshaphat was very brave and fought many wars. The rest of what he did is written in the book, The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: n-zaŋ di zaa niŋ Aduna min o bidibisi maa nuhi ni, ka zaŋ bɛ nuhi maa gahigahi zuɣusaa, ka di leei nuhi gahibu sara Yawɛ sani.
en: Give them to Aaron and his sons. Tell them to hold these things in their hands before the Lord. This will be a special offering to the Lord .

dag: N kɔre daa bi kpe yi ni so daanzinfa bee salima bee situra ni.
en: I havent craved anyones silver, gold, or clothing.

dag: Ka yi zaŋ bulaa mali alahichi sanyoo sara maligu, ka zaŋ piɛlabihi ayi bɛn paai yuun yini m-mali suhudoo sara.
en: You must also offer one male goat as a purification offering and two one-year-old lambs as a communal sacrifice of well-being.

dag: Di saha maa ka Amɔz bia Aizaia daa tim ti yɛli Hɛzɛkia, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya: N wum suhigu shɛli a ni suhi zaŋ chaŋ Asiria Naa Sɛnachɛrib polo la.
en: Then Isaiah son of Amoz sent this message to Hezekiah. Isaiah said, The Lord , the God of Israel, says this: You prayed to me about the message that came from King Sennacherib of Assyria. I have heard you.

dag: ka din pahi pisinaata daa gbaai Mahaziɔt min o bidibisi ni o Mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: Twenty-third, there were men chosen from Mahazioths sons and relatives.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab daa yiɣisi chaŋ Absalom yiŋa nti bɔh o, Bɔ zuɣu ka a chɛ ka a tumtumdiba nyo m puu buɣim.
en: Joab got up and came to Absaloms house. He said to him, Why did your servants burn my field.

dag: Yurilim bi naara; amaa di yi nyɛla anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu, di nyɛla din garita; ka di yi nyɛla tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni, di nyɛla din garita; ka di yi nyɛla baŋsim yɛtɔɣa yɛla, di gba nyɛla din garita.
en: Love never fails. As for prophecies, they will be brought to an end. As for tongues, they will stop. As for knowledge, it will be brought to an end.

dag: Yinim pukpariba mini wain tihi kpariba, maliya nandahima. Kummiya alikama mini chi zuɣu. Dama puri atam saɣimiya.
en: Grieve, you farmers; cry, you that take care of the vineyards, because the wheat, the barley, yes all the crops are destroyed.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛn kpi bela fɔŋ ni ŋuhira, ka bɛn mali dansi kuhiri bɔri sɔŋsim, amaa ka Naawuni baɣa ka bɛ suhigu ni.
en: And along the city streets, the wounded and dying cry out, yet God does nothing.

dag: A ni yɛn yɛli ba shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Wun shɛŋa din pa din daa nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ zaa ni ti naai dunia ŋɔ ni, ka ku lan be sagbana tiŋli ŋɔ na.
en: You told me to say that idols did not create the heavens and the earth, and that you, the Lord , will destroy every idol.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o sɔɣ omaŋmaŋ gballi ni. Ka bɛ daa kum o kuli yɛra, Mbaye, m mabia.
en: The old prophet buried the man in his own family grave. The old prophet cried for him and said, Oh, my brother, I am sorry for you.

dag: Bɛ bihi kul bela barina ni, ka bɛ mɔŋ ba nasara dunɔdali shee, ka so kani ŋun ni fa ba bahi.
en: Their children can never find safety; no one stands up to defend them in court.

dag: Di pala yi zuɣu ka n yɛn tum tuuni ŋɔ. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa. Di simdi ni yi baŋ lala. Yinim Izraɛlnima, chɛliya ka vi gbahi ya, ka yi kɔba ni chɔɣisi yi tuma maa zuɣu.
en: People of Israel, I'm not doing these things for your sake. You sinned against me, and you must suffer shame and disgrace for what you have done. I, the Lord God, have spoken.

dag: Ka ŋun nyɛ sana bee yi ni bu so paa bi simdi ni o di li.
en: No temporary foreign resident or day laborer may eat it.

dag: Sisɛra daa suh o la kom, amaa ka o ti o la bihim; o daa zaŋ bihim maa niŋla pipi viɛli ni na ti ti o.
en: Sisera asked for water. Jael gave him milk. In a bowl fit for a ruler, she brought him cream.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa chaŋ ni o ti sɔɣ o ba. Ka Firawuna kpambaliba zaa min o yiŋ kpamba ni Ijipti ninvuɣ zuɣuri zaa.
en: So Joseph left to bury his father. All of Pharaohs servants went with him, together with the elder statesmen in his household and all of the elder statesmen in the land of Egypt.

dag: Daadamnim zaa tumdila bɛ tuma zaa dibu zuɣu, amaa bɛ na ʒi n-di n-tiɣi.
en: All the hard work of humans is for the mouth, but the appetite is never full.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Ŋɔri malila voya, ka noonsi mi mali tɛri, amaa Daadam Bia ka luɣ shɛli din ni zaŋ o zuɣu sɔŋ gba.
en: Jesus replied, Foxes have dens, and the birds in the sky have nests, but the Human One has no place to lay his head.

dag: Yisa ni daa deei baptaizibu naai ka puhiri yiri kom maa ni na, di saha ka zuɣusaa daa bɔɣi, ka o nya ka Naawuni Shia Kasi yi zuɣusaa na kaman ŋmani la nti tam o zuɣu.
en: When Jesus was baptized, he immediately came up out of the water. Heaven was opened to him, and he saw the Spirit of God coming down like a dove and resting on him.

dag: Di bi tu ni bɛ zali ŋun ka taali samli bee ka bɛ fiɛbi kpambaliba bɛ biɛrisuŋ zuɣu.
en: It isnt good to punish the righteous, to strike the honorable for their integrity.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kuri niriba maa, ka di daa ti kpalim n ko, ka n daa lu n-zaŋ n nina kpa tiŋ kuhi yɛli, Mbaye, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ! A yɛn kula Izraɛl ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim ŋɔ, a suhu ni yiɣisi bahi Jɛrusalɛmnim zuɣu ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: While they were attacking, I was left alone. I fell on my face, and I cried out, Oh, LORD God! When you pour out your wrath on Jerusalem, will you destroy all that is left of Israel.

dag: Amaa ka Musa daa yɛli Yawɛ, Di saha Ijiptinim ni wum li, dama bɛ sani ka a daa zaŋ a kpiɔŋ yihi ba na.
en: Moses said to the LORD, The Egyptians will hear, for with your power you brought these people up from among them.

dag: Jɛdiayɛl bidibiga n-daa nyɛ: Bilihan, ka Bilihan mi bidibisi daa nyɛ: Jɛushi mini Bɛnjamin ni Ɛhud ni Chɛnaana ni Zɛtan ni Tarishish ni Ahishahar.
en: Jediael was the father of Bilhan and the grandfather of Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.

dag: A chɛ ka niriba maa nabi, ka a ti ba suhupiɛlli pam. Bɛ malila suhupiɛlli a sani kaman niriba ni kpuɣiri puu atam ka mali suhupiɛlli shɛm la bee kaman tɔbbihi ni yi pirigi bɛ ni ŋme n-di neen shɛŋa ka mali suhupiɛlli shɛm la.
en: You have made the nation great; you have increased its joy. They rejoiced before you as with joy at the harvest, as those who divide plunder rejoice.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, Di zɔri ba, dama m pun zaŋ ba niŋ yi nuu ni. Ka bɛ ni so ku tooi zani yi tooni.
en: Joshua, the Lord said, don't be afraid of the Amorites. They will run away when you attack, and I will help you defeat them.

dag: Amaa ka Olivi tia bɔhi ba, N chɛli bɛ ni mali ma doori kpa shɛli ka di tiri wuna mini ninsalinim jilima la tuma ka leei tihi naa.
en: But the olive tree replied, My oil brings honor to people and gods. I won't stop making oil, just so my branches can wave above the other trees.

dag: Zimiri daa ku Baasha daŋ niriba maa zaa kaman Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka anabi Jɛhu yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Naa Baasha polo la.
en: And so, in accordance with what the Lord had said against Baasha through the prophet Jehu, Zimri killed all the family of Baasha.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa yiɣisi chaŋchaŋ gili duu maa ni, ka ti lan lab ti teei dɔni bia maa zuɣu yaha. Ka bia maa daa tihim siɣimsiɣim buyopɔin, ka neeg o nina.
en: Elisha got up and walked back and forth in the room, then he went back and leaned over the boy's body. The boy sneezed seven times and opened his eyes.

dag: dindina bɛn yihim paɣisarili maa na ti zal o ba yiŋ dunɔdali gbini, ka tiŋ maa ni dɔbba lab o kuɣa ku o, dama o tum vi tuuni din nyɛ pagɔrisigu gɔbu o ba yiŋa Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka yi yihi zaɣ biɛɣu maa yi sunsuuni.
en: the men of the town will take the woman to the door of her father's house and stone her to death. This woman brought evil into your community by sleeping with someone before she got married, and you must get rid of that evil by killing her.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛda niŋbu yirila bɛ ni wum shɛl ni na, ka bɛ ni wum shɛli maa mi yirila Masia yɛla waazu yihibu ni na.
en: So, faith comes from listening, but its listening by means of Christs message.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti paai Siizaria Filipai tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka o bɔh o nyaandoliba, Niriba lee yɛri ni Daadam Bia nyɛla ŋuni.
en: Now when Jesus came to the area of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, Who do people say the Human One is.

dag: Dauda ni daa kpe o yili la ni naai, ka o daa ti yɛli anabi Neetan, Nyama, man bela sida dari yil ni, amaa ka Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka ŋɔ din be suɣili ni.
en: When David was settled into his palace, he said to the prophet Nathan, Im living in a cedar palace while the chest containing the LORDs covenant is under curtains.

dag: Tuumbiɛtumda gbilisiri tibili wumdi ninvuɣ biɛɣu yɛtɔɣa, ka ʒiŋmara mi gbilisiri tibili wumdi yɛtɔɣ biɛri.
en: Evil people listen to evil ideas, and liars listen to lies.

dag: Wuntaŋ daa kul wɔbiri ma mi dabisili kam, ka wari mi kpɛri ma yuŋ, ka n gaani gom.
en: Many times I suffered from the heat during the day and from the cold at night. I was not able to sleep.

dag: Ka timanim mini saŋmaribaŋdiba ni Kalidianim ni laasabuniŋdiba daa laɣim na ka n ti yɛli ba n zahindi maa, amaa ka bɛ bi tooi wuhi ma di gbinni.
en: When the men of magic and the Chaldeans came, I told them about the dream, but they could not tell me what it meant.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Dauda zuliya ni so di nam nimaani. A ni guli n ni pii na so maa.
en: This is where I will make Davids family strong. I will never let the lamp of my chosen king stop burning.

dag: Ka ŋun Yisahaku daa ti yi nti be samban ni zaawuni n-tɛhir o suhu ni, ka daa ti kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi nya ka laakumnim kanna.
en: One evening he went out to the field to think. He looked up and saw the camels coming from far away.

dag: Ka Bɔrɔbɔro din ka Dabindi Chuɣu la piligu dali daa ti paai, bɛ ni daa yi kɔrigiri Yaɣigari Chuɣu piɛbihi dahin shɛl la.
en: The day came during the Festival of Unleavened Bread when the lambs for the Passover meal were to be killed.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ anabinim polo: N suhu saɣimmi zaa, ka n kɔba ni chɔɣisi. N ŋmanila ŋun nyu dam kuli ka ŋmani ŋun nyu wain buɣi, Yawɛ min o yɛligu kasi zuɣu.
en: When I think of the prophets, I am shocked, and I tremble like someone drunk, because of the Lord and his sacred words.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ jɛra ka ka yɛm ŋɔ, yinim bɛn mali nina ka bi nyara, ka mali tiba ka bi wumdi ŋɔ, wummiya dimbɔŋɔ:.
en: Hear this message, you foolish people who have no sense. You have eyes, but you dont see! You have ears, but you dont listen!.

dag: Bɛ jɛmdi ma sahakam. Bɛ ŋmanila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi din tuhi, ka nyɛ bɛn suhuri ye n soli baŋbu zuɣu; ka bi tam bɛ Naawuni zaligu yɛla. Bɛ bɔri ni bɛ baŋ n saria karibu soli din tuhi yɛla. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn bɔri ni Naawuni miri ba.
en: Day after day, you worship him and seem eager to learn his teachings. You act like a nation that wants to do right by obeying his laws. You ask him about justice, and say you enjoy worshiping the Lord .

dag: Di dabisa maa saha yi ti paai, n ni chɛ ka wuntizɔr so yi Dauda zuliya ni na, ŋuna n-ni ti doli zaligu mini wuntia soli n-su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: At that time I will make a good branch grow from Davids family. That branch will do what is good and right for the country.

dag: Yi tihi mini yi puri atam zaa ni ti leei toli bindirigu.
en: Crickets will take over all your trees and your soils produce.

dag: Ŋunkam ʒiya kpahindi pɔhim ku biri binshɛli, ka ŋunkam mi ʒiya lihiri sagbana ku kpuɣi puu atam.
en: If you wait until the wind and the weather are just right, you will never plant anything and never harvest anything.

dag: Ka Mɔdɛkai daa chaŋ ti niŋ Ɛsta ni yɛl o ni o niŋ shɛlikam maa zaa.
en: So Mordecai left where he was and did exactly what Esther had ordered him.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa ti Izraɛlnim vuhim ka bɛ dimnim bɛn gili ba niŋ sunsuuni bi tooi niŋ ba shɛli ka di yuui pam la nyaaŋa, Jɔshua gba daa kurigiya pam di saha maa.
en: The Lord let Israel live in peace with its neighbors for a long time, and Joshua lived to a ripe old age.

dag: Naa suhuyiɣisili nyɛla kum tumo, ka ŋun mali yɛm ni maai li.
en: An angry ruler can put you to death. So be wise! Don't make one angry.

dag: Amaa man ŋuna, di kul kpalimla biɛla ni n tuui; di kul kpalimla biɛla ni n sarigi.
en: But I almost slipped and lost my balance. I almost fell into sin.

dag: A nini daa nya ma n nambu saha. N dabisa zaa daa pun sabila a litaafi ni pɔi ka di naanyi piligi.
en: You watched my body grow there. In your book you wrote about all the days planned for me before any of them had happened.

dag: Zaŋmi jaaŋgbee ŋɔ niŋ a nuu ni mali chaŋ, dina ka a ti yɛn mali tumdi alahiziba tumtumsa maa.
en: Take this walking stick with you; for with it you will perform miracles.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti lan lab bɛ sanna pahi buta m-bɔhi ba, Yinima na kul gbihirimi ka vuhiri jɛlinsi? Di saɣ lala, saha maa paaya; so pun yi Daadam Bia nyaaŋa ka zaŋ o niŋ alahichinim nuu ni.
en: He came a third time and said to them, Will you sleep and rest all night? Thats enough! The time has come for the Human One to be betrayed into the hands of sinners.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu maa mini zahim ayi maa, ka kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi zuɣusaa, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka ŋmahiŋmahi li ti o nyaandoliba maa ni bɛ tari salo maa.
en: Jesus took the five loaves and two fish, looked up to heaven, thanked God for them, broke them, and gave them to the disciples to distribute to the people.

dag: Ti dimnim maa ni daa wum ni ti baŋ bɛ ni lɔri nia shɛli maa yɛla, ka baŋ ni Naawuni nyaŋ ba bɛ ni lo nia shɛli maa ni, ka ti zaa daa lan lab gooni maa gbini, ka sokam ti tumd o tuma.
en: Then our enemies heard that we had found out and that God had spoiled their plans. So we all returned to doing our own work on the wall.

dag: bɛ ni ti yɛrila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be taŋkpaɣu yiya ni, ka bɛ piligu shee nyɛla taŋkpaɣu ni, ka bɛ ni tooi no n-ku ba kaman zunzuli ŋɔ?.
en: how much less those who dwell in houses of clay, whose foundations are in dust, and who are crushed like a moth?.

dag: N ni daa ti gbaai yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu saha shɛli ka Naawuni Shia Kasi kana nti kpe bɛ ni kaman o ni daa kpe ti ni shɛm di piligu ni la.
en: And when I began to speak, the Holy Spirit came down on them just as on us at the beginning.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ zaa bɔh o, Ka daɣila a shiri nyɛla Naawuni Bia? Ka o yɛli ba, Yi ni yɛli shɛm maa n-nyɛ li.
en: Then they asked, Are you the Son of God? Jesus answered, You say I am.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi ti ku yi ni chani ni yi ti deei zuliya shɛb tiŋgbɔŋ maa, ka chɛ ka yi deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa, yi yi ti deei li ʒini bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: The Lord your God will destroy the nations as you invade their land, and you will occupy it and settle there.

dag: n-zaŋ li bɔhi zuliya shɛb niriba biɛri, ka darigi niriba tibili;.
en: Take revenge and punish the nations.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka naa suhu daa yiɣisi pam, ka o bahi noli ni bɛ kum baŋdiba zaa bɛn be Babilɔn.
en: At that, the king flew into a rage and ordered the execution of all the royal advisers in Babylon.

dag: O bɔɣiri nyɛla salima, ka yɛri din viɛli dolibi pir o bɔɣiri maa. O niŋgbuna nyɛlisirimi kaman wɔbinyina mini safaya kuɣa la.
en: His hands are well-formed, and he wears rings set with gems. His body is like smooth ivory, with sapphires set in it.

dag: Dabiɛm gbaai ma pam. Yawɛ, bɔ saha ka n ni guhiri shɛm yɛn zan tariga?.
en: and I am in deep distress. How long will it be?.

dag: Di saha ka Musa mini Aduna daa chaŋ ti laɣim Izraɛl kpamba zaa.
en: Then Moses and Aaron called together all the Israelite elders.

dag: Ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ suhuri ni tɛha maa ka bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bɔhiri yi suhuri dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu?.
en: Jesus knew their thoughts and said to them, Why do you think such things?.

dag: Bɛ tiŋgbani tariga daa nyɛla Jaza zaŋ tabili Giliad tin kara zaa ni Amɔrinim tiŋgbani pirigili zaŋ hal ti paai Aroa din be Raba wulimpuhili polo la.
en: He gave them the land of Jazer, all the towns of Gilead, and half of the land of the Ammonites that went as far as Aroer near Rabbah.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ba, Gbaamiya yimaŋa ni yɛliwumsa. Yi ni buɣisiri tiri yi tab shɛm, lala ka Naawuni mi ni ti buɣisi tin ya hal di ni ti gari lala gba.
en: He also said to them, Pay attention to what you hear! The same rules you use to judge others will be used by God to judge you—but with even greater severity.

dag: Yi ni daa je yɛm, ka bi zaŋ Yawɛ zɔbu kpɛhi yi kɔbili ni.
en: You have never had any use for knowledge and have always refused to obey the Lord .

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ kamina ka n ti a saɣisigu shɛli din ni chɛ ka a tooi tilig amaŋmaŋ min a bia Sulemaana nyɛviya.
en: If you want to save your life and the life of your son Solomon, I would advise you to.

dag: Yi ni sokam lum o ma min o ba sizuura, ka gbibiya n vuhim dabisa la. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Each of you must honor your mother and father and keep my special days of rest. I am the Lord your God!.

dag: Maika bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Pitɔn mini Mɛlɛk ni Taria ni Ahaz.
en: Micah had four sons: Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.

dag: So ni tooi zaŋ ziŋgoo gbaag o bee n-zaŋ tɔŋ nyini kuh o nyee?.
en: There is no way to capture a hippopotamus— not even by hooking its nose or blinding its eyes.

dag: Ka Sool ba Kish bunsi daa ti bɔrigi dahin shɛli ka o yɛl o bia Sool, Zaŋmi tumtumdiba ŋɔ ni yino pah amaŋ zuɣu ka yi chaŋ ti bo bunsi maa shee.
en: When the donkeys belonging to Sauls father Kish were lost, Kish said to his son Saul, Take one of the servant boys with you and go look for the donkeys.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ Kɛdar mini Nɛbaiɔt piɛri na nti tin ya. Yi ni ti tooi zaŋ ba mali sara n sara maligu bimbini zuɣu; ka n tibigi n jɛmbu duu din mali jilima maa.
en: People will collect all the sheep from Kedar and give them to you. They will bring you rams from Nebaioth. You will offer those animals on my altar, and I will accept them. I will make my wonderful Temple even more beautiful.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa yɛli Manɔa, N ni daa yɛli paɣ maa shɛlikam zaa la, di simdi ni o dol li viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: The angel of the Lord said to Manoah, Your wife must do everything I told her.

dag: Ti mabihi, yi daa nya wahala mi kaman Naawuni cheechinim din be Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni la niriba bɛn nyɛ Yisa Masia ni su shɛb la. Yi daa nya alaka yimaŋmaŋ zuliya sani mi kaman bɛ gba ni daa nya alaka Yɛhudianim sani shɛm.
en: Brothers and sisters, you became imitators of the churches of God in Judea, which are in Christ Jesus. This was because you also suffered the same things from your own people as they did from the Jews.

dag: A ni tooi zaŋ zoligɔnim ga saŋmar shɛb bɛn laɣim taba ka bɛ booni ba Gbiŋgbiŋ min o bihi la? Bee a ni tooi yihi binshɛli din gbibi saŋmar so bɛ ni booni Goli wulan la.
en: Can you arrange stars in groups such as Orion and the Pleiades?.

dag: M bia, binshɛli din yaɣi dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu, nyin zom li. Litaafinim pam sabbu nyɛla din ka zanibu shee, ka bɔhimbu pam nyɛ din gbarigiri nira.
en: My child, there is something else to watch out for. There is no end to the writing of books, and too much study will wear you out.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa boli maligumaaniba Zadok mini Abiata m-pahi Lɛvi zuliya ni niriba bɛn nyɛ: Uriɛl mini Asaaya ni Joɛl ni Shɛmaya ni Ɛliɛl ni Aminadab na.
en: Then David asked the priests, Zadok and Abiathar, to come to him. David also asked these Levites to come to him: Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab.

dag: Ka Pita daa bol o yi kpaŋa nti kpahir o zuɣu ni yɛra, N Duuma, Naawuni tiligim ti! Di ku niŋ a lala.
en: Peter took Jesus away from the other followers to talk to him alone. He began to criticize him. He said, God save you from those sufferings, Lord! That will never happen to you.

dag: Vinnyaɣilan mabia n-nyɛ bukaata saɣinda.
en: A lazy person is as bad as someone who is destructive.

dag: Dama n ni chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn siɣisi bɛmaŋa ka nyɛ tarimba be yi sani. Bɛ ni ti bo sɔŋsim man Yawɛ sani.
en: but I will cause a humble and powerless people to remain in your midst; they will seek refuge in the name of the LORD.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ti yab Ibrahimma ni amaa ŋun Naawuni ni ti darigi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ti yɛn zaŋ o zuliya leei daba maa tibili; di nyaaŋa ka chɛ ka o zuliya maa nya faako n-lab kpe na ti jɛm ŋun Naawuni.
en: But he also said, I will punish the nation that makes them slaves. Then later they will come and worship me in this place.

dag: Ka Jɛrikɔnim daa me m-pan o zuɣu. Ka Imri bia Zakur daa me m-pani bɛ zuɣu.
en: The men from Jericho built the wall next to the priests. And Zaccur son of a man named Imri built the wall next to the men of Jericho.

dag: A tiri ba faako wahala nyabu saha hal ka bɛ ti gbi bɔɣili sɔŋ ninvuɣ biɛri.
en: You help them stay calm when trouble comes. You will help them until the wicked are put in their graves.

dag: Chi sara dina, o bom chi lita pinaayopɔin ni pirigili pahi naɣilaa zuɣu, ka bo chi lita pinaayopɔin ni pirigili pahi piɛlaa zuɣu, o ni kul bɔri shɛm tariga ti, ka lan bo kpam lita ata pali pahi chi tahili kam zuɣu.
en: With each bull and each ram the offering is to be half a bushel of grain, and with each lamb the offering is to be whatever the prince wants to give. Three quarts of olive oil are to be offered with each half-bushel of grain.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda daa paɣi Yawɛ zama maa zaa ninni ka yɛli, Ti paɣiri nyini Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti yab Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ sahakam.
en: Then, in front of everyone, David sang praises to the Lord : I praise you forever, Lord ! You are the God our ancestor Jacob worshiped.

dag: ka bo zim viɛlli din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram yini n-niŋ kpam ŋmiri li ka di leei chi sara m-pahi piɛlabil yino kam zuɣu mali sara zaŋ nyo buɣim ti Yawɛ. Di nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛla.
en: and with each lamb, pounds. These burnt offerings are food offerings, an odor pleasing to the Lord .

dag: Kalima anahi maa daa du pam ka mali dabiɛm. Ka nimbihi daa pie di fiilinim ni ti tuui.
en: Their rims were tall and terrifying, because all four of them were filled with eyes all around.

dag: Ka salo daa pahi bɛ zuɣu liri ba; ka sariakaritib maa daa dari tɔhi Pool mini Silas binyɛra, ka bahi noli ni bɛ zaŋm jaaŋgbɛbihi fiɛb ba.
en: The crowd joined in the attacks against Paul and Silas, so the authorities ordered that they be stripped of their clothes and beaten with a rod.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa Mɔab bɔpiɛligu ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli zaŋ lab Jɛriko polo:.
en: While the people of Israel were still camped in the lowlands of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho, the Lord told Moses.

dag: Ka Sool yɛl o, Pa Bɛnjamin zuliya din pɔri gari Izraɛl zuliyanim zaa la ni nira n-nyɛ ma? Pa n yiŋnim m-pɔri gari sokam Bɛnjamin zuliya maa ni? Ka wula ka a ti tɔɣisiri ma yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ.
en: Im a Benjaminite, Saul responded, from the smallest Israelite tribe, and my family is the littlest of the families in the tribe of Benjamin. Why would you say something like that to me.

dag: Ka di simdi ka o ti yihi alahichi sanyoo naɣilaa maa kpam zaa, kpam din pili namanama la mini namanama maa ni kpam zaa.
en: Then the priest must take all the fat from the bull of the sin offering. He must take the fat that is on and around the inner parts.

dag: ni Hɔrimanim ni Bɔrashannima ni Ataknima.
en: and to the people in the towns of Hormah, Borashan, Athach.

dag: N daa tɛhiya ni bɛ ni daa niŋ dimbɔŋɔnim maa zaa nyaaŋa bɛ ni labi n sanna, amaa ka bɛ daa bi labina, ka bɛ mabihi Judanim bɛn nyɛ ʒirinim maa daa nya li.
en: I thought that after she had done all this, she would surely return to me. But she did not return, and her unfaithful sister Judah saw it all.

dag: amaa ka di chɛ ka Kɔhat daŋ niriba maa ti kpe nti lihi binshɛŋa din nyɛ kasi maa hal biɛla gba, di yi niŋ lala, bɛ ni kpi.
en: But if the Kohathites enter the Tent and see the priests preparing the sacred objects for moving, they will die.

dag: Mbusim be tin shɛli din varim daɣiri, ka saɣim dimaŋa, ka nahindi niriba ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Doom, obstinate one, the defiled one, the violent city.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, tiligim ti, ka yihi ti zuliya kam ni na n-laɣim luɣ yini, ka ti paɣ a yuli din be kasi ŋɔ, ka ti a jilima ti paɣibu maa puuni.
en: Save us, O Lord our God, and bring us back from among the nations, so that we may be thankful and praise your holy name.

dag: Ka Rɛhɔbɔam daa kpuɣi Dauda bia Jɛrimɔt bipuɣiŋga, Mahalat ŋun ma daa nyɛ Abiheel ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛsi bia Ɛliab bipuɣiŋga la.
en: Rehoboam married Mahalath, whose father was Jerimoth son of David and whose mother was Abihail, the daughter of Eliab and granddaughter of Jesse.

dag: Ka Pita daa yɛl o, Ɛnias, Yisa Masia tib a; dinzuɣu yiɣisima m-mal a bindoo maa yɛrigi! Ka o daa dii vaai yiɣisi.
en: Peter said to him, Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you! Get up and make your bed. At once he got up.

dag: Saha shɛlikam n yi ti lo ni m bɔhim nya yɛm, ka nya niriba ni gaani gom yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni n-tumdi tuun shɛŋa dunia ni.
en: Day and night I went without sleep, trying to understand what goes on in this world.

dag: O ni yo ba bɛ tuumbiɛri samli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni kpihim bɛ birili bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali maa zuɣu.
en: He will punish those evil judges for the bad things they did. He will destroy them because they sinned. The Lord our God will destroy them.

dag: Dinzuɣu Iso ni daa nya ka o ba Yisahaku nini bi tiɣi Keenan paɣiba maa.
en: Esau realized that his father Isaac considered Canaanite women unacceptable.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa lee baŋya ni Naawuni zaŋ lahibal suŋ waazu yihibu fukumsi niŋ n nuu ni ni n yihi ti bɛn pa Yɛhudianim kaman o ni zaŋ lahibal suŋ waazu fukumsi niŋ Pita nuu ni ni o yihi li ti Yɛhudianim shɛm.
en: On the contrary, they saw that God had given me the task of preaching the gospel to the Gentiles, just as he had given Peter the task of preaching the gospel to the Jews.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Dindali maa n ni ti garigi zuɣusaa ka di mi garigi tiŋgbani.
en: And at that time I will answer. This is what the Lord says. I will speak to the skies, and they will give rain to the earth.

dag: N yila m Ba sani n-ka dunia ŋɔ ni na; ka lan yɛn yi dunia ŋɔ ni labi m Ba maa sani.
en: I did come from the Father, and I came into the world; and now I am leaving the world and going to the Father.

dag: Nachimba mini paɣisara ni ninkura ni bihi zaa, paɣimiy o!.
en: Praise him, young men and women, old people and children.

dag: Ka Ahikam bia Gɛdalia Shafan yaaŋa maa daa po pɔri yɛli bɛ mini bɛ tɔbbihi maa, Di zɔriya dabiɛm ni yi tum tuma ti Babilɔnnima. Ʒinimiya tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni n-jɛmdi Babilɔn naa, ka biɛhigu niŋ viɛnyɛla tin ya.
en: Gedaliah, Ahikams son and Shaphans grandson, firmly assured them all: Dont be afraid of serving the Babylonians. Remain in the land, serve the king of Babylon, and all will go well for you.

dag: Di saha maa n daa yɛliya, N kɔŋko ku tooi gbib ya.
en: Moses said to the people, While we were still at Mount Sinai, I told you, The responsibility for leading you is too much for me. I can't do it alone.

dag: A ni nya saŋmaris ayopɔin shɛba n nudirigu ni la mini salima firilatamdis ayopɔin shɛŋa la gbinni m-bɔŋɔ: Saŋmaris ayopɔin maa nyɛla cheechinima ayopɔin la malaikanima, ka salima firilatamdis ayopɔin la mi nyɛ cheechinima ayopɔin la.
en: Here is the secret meaning of the seven stars that you see in my right hand, and of the seven gold lampstands: the seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches.

dag: Ka Pita lan chihi ka po pɔri yɛli, Man ʒi doo maa.
en: Again Peter denied it, and this time he swore, I don't even know that man.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti kpe o yilikpɛrili ka o nyaandoliba bɔh o ashilɔni, Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka tinim di bi tooi kari alizin birigu maa bahi.
en: After Jesus went into a house, his disciples asked him privately, Why couldnt we throw this spirit out.

dag: Ka daa siɣis omaŋ doli nɔdeebo soli ti paai kum, hal kum din nyɛ dapulli zuɣu kum gba.
en: he humbled himself by becoming obedient to the point of death, even death on a cross.

dag: Ka o tumtumdiba daa chaŋ o sani nti yɛl o, Ti ba, anab maa yi di yɛl a ni a niŋm binshɛli din to pam, a naan ku niŋ li? Di ni ti be ka o ni yɛl a mi, Cham ti mim kom ni ka nya alaafee ŋɔ? .
en: His servants went over to him and said, Sir, if the prophet had told you to do something difficult, you would have done it. So why don't you do what he said? Go wash and be cured.

dag: Naawuni daa nam ninsala ŋ-ŋmahindila omaŋa, dinzuɣu ŋunkam ku ninsala, bɛn kum o yo.
en: God made humans to be like himself. So whoever kills a person must be killed by another person.

dag: O daa gbaag o bia mali maligu n-zaŋ o nyo buɣim, ka daa buɣiri baɣisi, ka chani bukpahinim mini takatibinim ni jinwariba sani. O daa tum tuumbiɛri pam Naawuni sani n-chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi pam.
en: He sacrificed his own son and burned him on the altar. He used different ways of trying to know the future. He visited mediums and wizards. Manasseh did more and more things that the Lord saw as evil, which made the Lord angry.

dag: Yɛlim do kura la ni bɛ gbib bɛmaŋa, ka mali biɛrisuŋ, ka mali yɛm, ka doli wuhibu maŋli, ka mali yurilim, ka nyɛ bɛn mal ania yɛda niŋbu ni.
en: Teach the older men to have self-control, to be serious, and to be wise. They must be strong in faith, in love, and in patience.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zo n-chaŋ yaɣ shɛli polo katiŋa nti du n-tam zoli zuɣu ka o mini ba daa danigi tab pam.
en: Then David crossed over to the other side of the valley to the top of the hill, a safe distance away.

dag: A ni daa zaɣisi Yawɛ noli ka bi ku Amalɛknim zaa, ka saɣim bɛ ni mali shɛlikam zaa la zuɣu ka Yawɛ niŋ a o ni niŋ a shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: When the Lord was angry with the Amalekites, he told you to destroy them, but you didn't do it. That's why the Lord is doing this to you.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, ansarisi maaniba ʒiɛla n sani, ka n lihiri bɛ ni kuri ma suli shɛm.
en: Surely mockers are with me, and my eye looks on their rebellion.

dag: Di zɔri ba dabiɛm, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-tuhiri tɔb tiri ya.
en: Don't be afraid of them, for the Lord your God will fight for you.

dag: dindina bɛ ni tooi yo o zuɣu ka deeg o o ni zaŋ omaŋ pa talima maa nyaaŋa, o mabihi ni yino ni tooi yo o zuɣu ka deeg o.
en: These people have the right to be bought back and become free. Someone from their own country can buy them back.

dag: ka bɔhi maligumaaniba min anabinima bɔhigu shɛli. Bɔhigu maa m-bɔŋɔ: Ti na kul lom noli, ka fabilim gol so ŋun pah anu ni kaman ti ni pun niŋdi shɛm yuma pam din gari ŋɔ ni la.
en: saying to the priests who were in the house of the LORD of heavenly forces and to the prophets: Should I weep in the fifth month and abstain as I have done for a number of years.

dag: Yi ni ti di di suhumaabo daazichi din galisi pam la daanfaani kaman bia ni mɔɣiri o ma bihili shɛm la.
en: Be happy that you will receive mercy like milk coming from her breast. Jerusalems milk will satisfy you! You will drink it and enjoy her glory.

dag: Di zaŋ yɛm bahi, yɛm ni gbib a. Yum yɛm, ka yɛm gul a.
en: If you love Wisdom and don't reject her, she will watch over you.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi Ayuba yɛtɔɣa sanʒiɛɣu puuni yɛli.
en: Then the LORD answered Job from the whirlwind.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba, Dahin shɛli kanna ka yi ni ti bɔri ni yi nya Daadam Bia saha ŋɔ dabisili zaɣ yini gba, ka ku nya li.
en: Then he said to the disciples, The time will come when you will wish you could see one of the days of the Son of Man, but you will not see it.

dag: Bɛ ni yɛl a nam dariza yɛla, ka yɛl a yiko yɛla.
en: They will tell how great your kingdom is. They will tell how great you are.

dag: ka lan yɛl o, Ka din pahi nyɛla, a dabili Yaakubu doli ti nyaaŋa na. Dama Yaakubu daa yɛlila o suhu ni, N yi chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ pini ŋɔ daŋ n tooni ti ti o, n ni maag o suhu, ka di nyaaŋa m min o nini yi ti nya taba, di pa shɛli o ni deei ma.
en: Say also, Your servant Jacob is right behind us. Jacob thought, I may be able to pacify Esau with the gift Im sending ahead. When I meet him, perhaps he will be kind to me.

dag: Amaa ka Dauda daa bɔh o, Taal bɔ ka n lee tum? Dahin shɛli man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni kana ti kpe a tuma ni hal ni zuŋɔ, tuun bɔ ka n lee tum ka di bi tiɣ a nini, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka n ku tooi doli chaŋ ti tuhi n-dan naa dimnima.
en: But what have I done? David asked Achish. What wrong have you found in me, your servant, from the day I came to you until now? Why shouldnt I go and fight the enemies of my master the king.

dag: Biɛŋmarisi ni daa laɣim yili yila, ka alizanda ni malaikanim zaa yɔri suhupiɛlli vuri la, a daa beni?.
en: In the dawn of that day the stars sang together, and the heavenly beings shouted for joy.

dag: Amaa Naawuni Shia Kasi yi wuhiri ya soli, dindina yi lan pala bɛn be fukumsi zaligu la sulinsi ni.
en: But if you are being led by the Spirit, you arent under the Law.

dag: Nyin ŋun be puri ni ŋɔ, n zɔnim wumd a yɛtɔɣa; chɛ ka n gba wum li.
en: Let me hear your voice from the garden, my love; my companions are waiting to hear you speak.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia daa bɔhi Aizaia, Ka bɔ n-lee yɛn nyɛ Yawɛ ni yɛli ni o ni chɛ ka n kpaŋ maa mini n ni yɛn chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu daba ata dali maa shihirili? Ka Aizaia garigi yɛli.
en: King Hezekiah asked, What is the sign to prove that the Lord will heal me and that three days later I will be able to go to the Temple.

dag: Ka Bɛtitɔgarimanim daa zaŋdi yuri mini tɔbutuhiri yuri ni buntaansi na ti taɣiri yi nɛma.
en: Beth-togarmah traded horses, warhorses, and mules for your wares.

dag: Isaka zuliya niriba m-bala: Bɛ ni daa sab bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb yuya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihiyɔbunaanahi ni kɔbisita.
en: These are the Issacharite clans. Their enrollment was .

dag: Balinte a ti yɛli ni a bi nyar o; amaa yɛla maa kpalimla o sani, kul guhim o.
en: he will surely deny your impatient request to face him in court.

dag: Naawuni ni mali soli ti ba, ka yihi ba dabitim ni. Bɛ ni ti kabi dunɔdali n-dol li gari yi. Bɛ naa ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ŋɔ maŋmaŋa ni ti gari tooni n-zaŋ ba chaŋ.
en: The one who breaks out will go before them; they will break out and pass through the gate; they will leave by it. They will pass on, their king before them, the LORD at their head.

dag: Ka yi lan zaŋ bula yino mali alahichi sara pahi yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim sahakam la mini di chi sara ni di binnyura sara la zuɣu.
en: And offer a goat as the sacrifice to ask forgiveness for the people. These sacrifices are made in addition to the regular daily sacrifices.

dag: Nyama, yi yi lo noli yi ŋmɛrila tab naŋgbankpeeni ka zabiri buri taba buri biɛɣu. Yi ni lɔri noli maa shɛm pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ ku chɛ ka Naawuni deei yi suhigu.
en: You quarrel and brawl, and then you fast; you hit each other violently with your fists. You shouldnt fast as you are doing today if you want to make your voice heard on high.

dag: Doo yi zaŋ o tizɔpaɣa ŋun nyɛ o ba bipuɣiŋga bee o ma bipuɣiŋga dɔni n-nya o zaɣim, ka paɣa maa gba nya o zaɣim, di nyɛla vi tuuni, ka di simdi ka bɛ yihi ba bɛ niriba ni. O ni zaŋ o tizɔpaɣ dɔni maa zuɣu, di simdi ni bɛ darig o tibili.
en: If a man marries his sister or half sister, they shall be publicly disgraced and driven out of the community. He has had intercourse with his sister and must suffer the consequences.

dag: Ka kpiimba kum ni neebu yi kani, dindina Masia daa bi neei kum ni m-bala.
en: For if the dead are not raised, neither has Christ been raised.

dag: Ka Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni luɣilikam, Dan zaŋ ti kpa Bɛrishiiba polo nim zaa daa baŋ ni Samuɛl nyɛla Yawɛ daanabi maŋli.
en: So all the people of Israel, from one end of the country to the other, knew that Samuel was indeed a prophet of the Lord .

dag: Rubin, nyini n-nyɛ m bituuli, nyini n-nyɛ n kpiɔŋ; ka lan nyɛ n dɔtali tuuli bia. A nyɛla toondana ka mali kpiɔŋ pam.
en: Reuben, you are my oldest, born at the peak of my powers; you were an honored leader.

dag: Ishitɔn daa nyɛla Bɛtirafa mini Pasia ni Tɛhina ba, ka Tɛhina mi daa nyɛ Irinahash ba, bɛna n-nyɛ Rɛkanima.
en: Eshton was the father of Beth Rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah. Tehinnah was the father of Ir Nahash. These men were from Recah.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛli, Bɔ ka ti lee lan bɔri shɛhiranim ni ti niŋ yaha? Timaŋmaŋ wum li o nol ni.
en: They said, Why do we need witnesses now? We all heard what he said.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ mali wumpaɣibo sara, ka yili suhupiɛlli yila yɛl o tuma yɛla.
en: They must thank him with sacrifices, and with songs of joy must tell all that he has done.

dag: O paɣ so ŋun yuli daa booni Hushim la gba daa dɔɣi bidibisi, bɛna n-daa nyɛ: Abitub mini Ɛlipaal.
en: He also had two sons by Hushim: Abitub and Elpaal.

dag: Amaa Izraɛlnim tarili la ni, yihimiya bin yini bini pihinu kam puuni, di yi nyɛla ninsalinim bee niɣi bee bunsi bee piɛri bee buhi bee biŋkɔbiri balibu kam bɛn pahi n-zaŋ ba ti Lɛvinim bɛn su Yawɛ biɛhigu shee tuma fukumsi la.
en: But from the Israelites half you will take one out of every fifty, whether from human, oxen, donkeys, or flock—all the animals. You will give them to the Levites who carry out the duties of the LORDs dwelling.

dag: Dinzuɣu zaŋm a mabihi bɛn nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya ka nyɛ a daŋ niriba la na ka bɛ ti pah a zuɣu n-sɔŋd a min a bidibisi maa saha shɛli yi yi ti be alikauli suɣili maa gbini tumdi tuma.
en: To prevent that from happening, you must bring the rest of the men from the tribe of Levi to join you. These Levites will help you and your sons do your work in the Tent of the Agreement.

dag: Binyara ŋɔ bi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa kaman ninsalinim ni tɔɣisiri shɛm. So mi bi wumdi di kukoya.
en: Of course, theres no speech, no words— their voices cant be heard.

dag: O yi yɛn malila wumpaɣibo sara maligu, ŋun zaŋm bɛ ni zaŋ kpam gari zim ni mali mah shɛŋa, ka dabindi ka di ni mini karikaasi shɛli bɛ ni niŋ kpam niŋ ni bɛ ni zaŋ kpam gari zim viɛl shɛl ni mali mah shɛŋa m-mali wumpaɣibo sara maligu maa.
en: People can bring fellowship offerings to show their thanks to God. If you bring your sacrifice to give thanks, you should also bring unleavened bread mixed with oil, wafers with oil poured over them, and loaves of fine flour mixed with oil.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu mini zahim ayi maa, ka kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi zuɣusaa ka niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka ŋmahiŋmahi bɔrɔbɔro maa ti o nyaandoliba ni bɛ tari niriba maa; di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi ŋmahi zahim ayi la mi pahi zaŋ tari bɛ zaa.
en: He took the five loaves and the two fish, looked up to heaven, blessed them, broke the loaves into pieces, and gave them to his disciples to set before the people. He also divided the two fish among them all.

dag: O daa me li la goonda kpɛma, ka zali sapashin kpamba tinsi maa ni, ka daa me bindira kambɔna mini kpam ni wain ni yɛn zaani du shɛŋa ni tinsi maa ni.
en: He had them strongly fortified and appointed a commander for each of them, and in each one he placed supplies of food, olive oil, and wine.

dag: Yɛhudianim daa mal adiini jɛmbu du shɛli bɛ ni daa booni Bilichinnim jɛmbu duu. Di ni niriba bɛn daa nyɛ Yɛhudianima n-yi Sairiini mini Alikizandria ni bɛn daa yi Kilikia ni Ɛsha na n-daa laɣim ŋmɛri Stiivin naŋgbankpeeni;.
en: But some of the Jews there were from the synagogue of Free Men, as it was called. The group included Jews from Cyrene, Alexandria, Cilicia, and Asia. They started arguing with Stephen.

dag: Di saha ka ti Duuma daa yɛli ma, Cham ti bo tiŋgul zali, ka yɛl o ni o nini yi nya shɛlikam, ŋun yɛlima.
en: The Lord said this to me: Go, post a lookout to report what he sees.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛl o shɛm, ka chɛ ka bɛ chɛ n-chihi bɛ yuri jila, ka nyo bɛ chɛchɛbunsi mi buɣim.
en: Joshua did to them what the Lord had commanded: he crippled their horses and burned their chariots.

dag: Ka sapashin kpamba maa yi tɔɣisi tɔbbihi maa yɛtɔɣa maa naai, sapashinnim bɛn leemi bɛn su tɔbbihi maa fukumsi.
en: When the officers have finished speaking to the army, leaders are to be chosen for each unit.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ daa lan zaŋ Bashan Naa Ogi min o niriba zaa niŋ ti nuu ni, ka ti daa ku ba hal ka o ninvuɣ yino gba daa bi kpalim.
en: So the Lord our God let us defeat King Og of Bashan. We destroyed him and all his men. Not one of them was left.

dag: Di chɛ ka n suhu kpe zaɣ biɛɣu niŋbu ni, ka m pahi ninvuɣ biɛri zuɣu tum zaɣ biɛɣu. Di chɛ ka n zaŋ mmaŋ bali tuumbiɛtumdiba ni; di chɛ ka m pahi bɛ zuɣu di bɛ bindir nyaɣisa.
en: Don't let me want to do evil or waste my time doing wrong with wicked people. Don't let me even taste the good things they offer.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi ma alaka di vi. Amaa di chɛ ka man di vi. Chɛ ka dabiɛm gbahi ba, amaa di chɛ ka dabiɛm gbaai ma. Chɛ ka alɔbo lu bɛ zuɣu n-ku ba pam.
en: Keep me from failure and disgrace, but make my enemies fail and be disgraced. Send destruction to make their worst fears come true.

dag: Ka o daa garigi yɛl o, Aai, m biɛli, di zaŋ kiŋkansi doli ma, dama tuuni ŋɔ na ʒi n-tum Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, di tum jɛrilim tuuni ŋɔ.
en: No, she said. Don't force me to do such a degrading thing! That's awful!.

dag: Toli maa ni daa ŋubi mɔri maa zaa naai saha shɛli, ka n yɛli, Yaa n Duuma NAAWUNI, n suhir a, chɛli bɛ taali! Yaakubu ku be. O pɔri pam.
en: When they had finished eating the green plants of the land, I said, LORD God, please forgive! How can Jacob survive? He is so small.

dag: Ka naa daa zaŋ bini pɔb o ninni ka kuhiri pampam yɛra, Mbaye m bia Absalom, mbaye Absalom, m bia, m bia!.
en: David covered his face with his hands and kept on crying loudly, My son, Absalom! Absalom, my son, my son.

dag: Ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa dii tim zuɣuŋmara ni o cham ti ŋma Jɔn Baptaizira zuɣu na. Ka o daa chaŋ sarika duu nti ŋma o zuɣu.
en: So he sent off a guard at once with orders to bring John's head. The guard left, went to the prison, and cut John's head off;.

dag: Sanʒiɛɣu maa ni daa ʒiɛri tuhi ŋariŋ maa, ka di ku tooi lan kpa ti ni bɔri ni di doli shɛli polo zuɣu ka ti daa chɛ li ka pɔhim maa ʒiɛri li chana.
en: This wind took the ship and carried it away. The ship could not sail against the wind, so we stopped trying and let the wind blow us.

dag: Ka Yisa kpah o zuɣu ni viɛnyɛliŋga, ka dii bah o ni o chama.
en: Jesus told the man to go, but he gave him a strong warning:.

dag: Ka n-daa bɔhi ba, Pa tinzun paɣiba n-daa chɛ ka Izraɛl Naa Sulemaana tum alahichi? Zuliya pam nanim ni so daa bi ŋman o, ka o Naawuni daa yur o ka zaŋ o leei Izraɛlnim zaa naa, amaa tinzun paɣiba n-daa ti chɛ ka o tum alahichi.
en: You know that marriages like this caused Solomon to sin. In all the many nations, there was not a king as great as Solomon. God loved him and made him king over the whole nation of Israel. But even Solomon was made to sin because of foreign women.

dag: Hal malaikanim zuɣulana Maikil mini Sintani ni daa mali taba Anabi Musa niŋgbuŋ zuɣu la, o daa bi saɣi tu Sintani; o daa naɣ yɛlimi, Ti Duuma ni bɔh a.
en: The archangel Michael, when he argued with the devil about Moses body, did not dare charge him with slander. Instead, he said, The Lord rebuke you.

dag: Di saha ka Musa mini Aduna daa chaŋ Firawuna sani ti yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Hiburunim Naawuni la yɛliya, Bɔ saha ka a yɛn saɣi siɣis amaŋa n tooni? Chɛ ka n niriba maa chaŋ ti jɛm ma.
en: So Moses and Aaron went to the king and said to him, The Lord , the God of the Hebrews, says, How much longer will you refuse to submit to me? Let my people go, so that they may worship me.

dag: Ka Naa Jɛhɔram daa dii yiɣisi Samaria di saha maa n-chaŋ ti laɣim Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa.
en: At once King Joram left Samaria and gathered all his troops.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni lan me Ziɔn, o ni kana ni o jilima.
en: When the Lord rebuilds Zion, he will reveal his greatness.

dag: N ni daa nam dunia ŋɔ saha shɛli, a daa beni? A yi mi, nyin yɛlim ma.
en: Where were you when I laid the earths foundations? Tell me if you know.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Gidiɔn, A niriba maa galisiya pam ni n zaŋ Midiannim niŋ bɛ nuu ni. Di yi niŋ lala Izraɛlnim ni nyu bara niŋ ma ka yɛli, Tinima n-tuhi fa timaŋa.
en: Then the Lord said to Gideon, I am going to help your men defeat the Midianites, but you have too many men. I dont want the Israelites to forget me and brag that they saved themselves.

dag: Pool daa lan yɛli, Amaa n ni daa ti be soli chana nti miriti Damaskus kaman wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha ka neesim titali daa ti dii yi zuɣusaa na ti neei gili ma.
en: As I was traveling and coming near Damascus, about midday a bright light from the sky flashed suddenly around me.

dag: Yi yɛliya, Naawuni zaŋla bɛ zaɣ biɛɣu maa sɔŋ gu bɛ bihi; chɛ ka o zaŋ li labisi yo ba ka bɛ baŋ li.
en: God stores up his punishment for his children. Let him destroy them so they know.

dag: Ka o daa kpahi bɛ zuɣu ni yɛli, Di simdi ka yi zɔri Yawɛ ka tum tuma maa ni ʒiɛyimtali ni yi suhu zaa.
en: Jehoshaphat commanded them, You must serve faithfully with all your heart. You must fear the Lord .
