dag: Amaa ti yi bɔri ni bɛ be ti sani ka ti mini ba nyɛ ninvuɣ yinsi, faashee ka ti dɔbba zaa guni m-be kaman bɛ ni be shɛm.
en: But there is one thing that all our men must agree to do. They must agree to be circumcised as they are.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Asiria naa sapashin kpamba kana ti tuhi nyaŋ ba, ka gbaai Manaasa n-zaŋ mii tu o nyee ni, ka lo o daanya zoligɔnima n-zaŋ o kuli Babilɔn.
en: So the Lord let the commanders of the Assyrian army invade Judah. They captured Manasseh, stuck hooks in him, put him in chains, and took him to Babylon.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi bɔb gbaai Pool, ka kum ni nintam, ka puh o viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Everyone cried and hugged and kissed him.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ n-daa fa Amɔrinim tiŋgbani maa ti Izraɛlnima, ka a ti bɔri ni a fa li?.
en: The messengers also told the king of Ammon that Jephthah had said: The Lord God of Israel helped his nation get rid of the Amorites and take their land. Now do you think you're going to take over that same territory?.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli, Do so n-daa sa fiig tia o puu ni, ka di walibu saha ti paai ka o chaŋ ti bɔri wala di zuɣu ka bi nya.
en: Jesus told this parable: A man owned a fig tree planted in his vineyard. He came looking for fruit on it and found none.

dag: Kɔra, a min a nyaandoliba maa zaa ni yɛn niŋ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Korah, here is what you and your followers must do: Get some fire pans, fill them with coals and incense, and place them near the sacred tent. And the man the Lord chooses will be his priest. Korah, this time you Levites have gone too far!.

dag: Ka tin shɛli din miri kpim maa ni do luɣ shɛli maa kpamba zaa ni paɣi bɛ nuhi bahi bɛ ni kabi naɣisa so nyiŋgoli vinvamli maa ni la zuɣu.
en: Then all the leaders from the town nearest the place where the murdered person was found are to wash their hands over the cow.

dag: Yisa daa ti bol o nyaandoliba pinaayi la na nti niŋ ba yiko ni bɛ kariti alizin biɛri bahira, ka tibiri barinima;.
en: Jesus called the Twelve together and he gave them power and authority over all demons and to heal sicknesses.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o pa yuri zuɣu na ti sɔɣ o pah o yaannim zuɣu Dauda tiŋ la ni.
en: His body was taken to Jerusalem on horseback and buried beside his ancestors.

dag: Hal o ni daa ŋme tampiŋ ka kom tɔhi yi di ni na zɔri maa, o ni tooi ti bindira gba bee n-ti o niriba nimdi.
en: True, God struck the rock and water gushed and streams flowed, but can he give bread too? Can he provide meat for his people.

dag: Ti ku lab ti yinsi faashee ka Izraɛlnim zaa ti nya bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbana.
en: We will not come back home until everyone in Israel has taken his part of the land.

dag: Bɛ daa ŋmanila wɔridib shɛba bɛ ni dihiri viɛnyɛliŋga, ka bɛ kɔre be wɔrinyama ni la; sokam kɔre daa bela o kpee paɣa bɔbu ni.
en: They were like well-fed stallions wild with desire, each lusting for his neighbor's wife.

dag: Ka yi ni shɛb mi doli Nikolaus nyaanzaaniba wuhibu din nyɛ n ni je shɛl la.
en: It is the same in your group. You have people who follow the teaching of the Nicolaitans.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb tiri pini, amaa ka bɛ buni kul nabirimi pahira, ka shɛb mi vili bɛ ni su shɛli gbibi ka kɔŋda.
en: Some people give freely and gain more; others refuse to give and end up with less.

dag: Ŋunkam maani fiig tia viɛnyɛliŋga ni di di wala; ka ŋunkam lihir o dana viɛnyɛla ni nya jilima.
en: Take care of a fig tree and you will have figs to eat. Servants who take care of their master will be honored.

dag: N ni sabi gbaŋ ŋɔ tin ya maa bi wuhi ni yi ʒila yɛlimaŋli, amaa yi ni lee mi li ka baŋ ni ʒiri ka yɛlimaŋli ni la zuɣu.
en: I did not need to write you about the truth, since you already know it. You also know that liars do not belong to the truth.

dag: Naa Ahasivɛrɔs nam dibu yuun shɛli din daa pahir ayopɔin gol so ŋun pahi chir pia ka bɛ boon o Tɛbɛt la ni ka bɛ daa zaŋ Ɛsta kpɛh o sani nayili maa.
en: So in Xerxes' seventh year as king, in the tenth month, the month of Tebeth, Esther was brought to King Xerxes in the royal palace.

dag: Jɔtam daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani kaman o ba Uzia ni daa tum shɛm; ŋun daa lee bi ŋmɛla nyɔɣu kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu. Amaa niriba maa daa na kul tumdila tuumbiɛri.
en: Jotham did what the Lord wanted him to do. He obeyed God just as his father Uzziah had done. But Jotham did not enter the Lord s Temple to burn incense as his father had. But the people continued doing wrong.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chani gindi tiŋkpansi n-yihiri lahibal suŋ waazu, ka chɛ ka barinim kpaŋdi luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: So the apostles went out. They traveled through all the towns. They told the Good News and healed people everywhere.

dag: Di saha maa ka anabinima ayi bɛn daa nyɛ Hagai mini Zakaria ŋun daa nyɛ Iddo bia la daa piligi m-mali Izraɛl Naawuni yuli n-tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa tiri Yɛhudianim bɛn daa be Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm ka nyɛ o ni su shɛb la.
en: Then the prophet Haggai and the prophet Zechariah, Iddos son, prophesied to the Jews who were in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of Israels God who was over them.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa niŋ yomyom kpe o tanti suɣili ni Zara sani nti yɛl o, Toom a zim viɛlli la lita pisinaayi ŋ-ŋɔri li mali maha yomyom.
en: Abraham went quickly to his tent and said to Sarah, Hurry! Get a large sack of flour and make some bread.

dag: Ka sagbani daa sirigina ti pili Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa, ka Yawɛ jilima daa pal o biɛhigu shee maa.
en: Then the cloud covered the Tent and the dazzling light of the Lord 's presence filled it.

dag: Binshɛɣukam puuni n wuhi ya ni sokam moom o nini n-tum lala sɔŋ bɛn ka kpiɔŋ la, ka teeya ti Duuma Yisa ni daa yɛli shɛm la, Dina n-nyɛ ni Ŋun tiri mal alibarika gari ŋun deera. .
en: By everything I did, I showed how you should work to help everyone who is weak. Remember that our Lord Jesus said, More blessings come from giving than from receiving.

dag: Ka bɛ ni pam m-pahi bɛn pa Yɛhudianim paɣiba bɛn nyɛ yuyanima mini dɔbba daa niŋ yɛda.
en: Many of them put their faith in the Lord, including some important Greek women and several men.

dag: Ka Hanani ŋun daa nyɛ m mabihi ni yino la mini ninvuɣ shɛb daa ti yi Juda na, ka m-bɔhi ba Yɛhudianim bɛn daa tiligi ka bɛ bi gbahi ba daba la mini Jɛrusalɛm yɛla.
en: when my brother Hanani came with some men from Judah. So I asked them about the Jews who had escaped from being captives in Babylonia. I also asked them about the city of Jerusalem.

dag: mɔɣu ni mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni, maliya suhupiɛlli! Tihi din be nyɔŋ puuni zaa, yi gba yilimiya suhupiɛlli yila.
en: Let the countryside and everything in it celebrate! Then all the trees of the forest too will shout out joyfully.

dag: M mali suhupiɛlli ni n zaŋ mmaŋa mini n ni mali shɛlikam saɣim yi zuɣu. N ni yuri ya pam la zuɣu, yinima ni yuri ma la biɛla?.
en: I will very gladly spend and be spent for your sake. If I love you more, will you love me less?.

dag: Ka Gibianim daa ti kana ti liri ma yuŋ n-teei gili n yilikpɛrili. Bɛ daa lo ma la kubu; ka daa gbaai m mam maa chaŋ ti goli ku o.
en: and the leading citizens of Gibeah tried to attack me. They surrounded me in the house at night and were determined to kill me. They abused my secondary wife until she died.

dag: O yi vuhi, buɣim taarila sala, ka buɣim zibizibi yir o noli ni na.
en: His breath lights coals; a flame shoots from his mouth.

dag: ni wuntaŋ ni kpɛri tiwal viɛl shɛŋa, ka di wandi pam di goya ni.
en: with the gifts produced by the sun, with the gifts generated by the moon.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ nahu bee piɛɣu ŋun mali daŋ mini binshɛɣukam din bi niŋ kamaata mali sara ti ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, dama di nyɛla din chihiri ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani.
en: Do not sacrifice to the Lord your God cattle or sheep that have any defects; the Lord hates this.

dag: Di saha paɣipuhinim mini biliɛrinim yɛla ni ti mali nambɔɣu pam.
en: It will be a terrible time for women who are expecting babies or nursing young children.

dag: Amaa ti yi be neesim ni kaman o ni be neesim ni shɛm, ti ni mali dolintabitali ni taba, ka o Bia Yisa ʒim kul ni kpihindi ti daalahichi zaa bahira.
en: We should live in the light, where God is. If we live in the light, we have fellowship with each other, and the blood sacrifice of Jesus, Gods Son, washes away every sin and makes us clean.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Taainim tuumbiɛri buta ni bunahi zuɣu, n ku chɛ bɛ tibili darigibu. Dama bɛ gbahi tiŋ muni niriba zaa n-tahi Ɛdom, ka bi gbib bɛ mini ba ni daa lo alikauli shɛl la.
en: The LORD proclaims: For three crimes of Tyre, and for four, I wont hold back the punishment, because they have delivered up entire communities over to Edom, and neglected their covenantal obligations.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti suhir a, bɔhim Naawuni nya ti ni di nasara ti chandi ŋɔ ni.
en: They said to him, Ask for an answer from God so we can know whether well be successful on this trip weve taken.

dag: Ka Sool gba daa kul o ya Gibia, ka dɔbba bɛn mali suhukpeeni, ka Naawuni yɛligu maa kpe bɛ suhuri ni daa pahi dol o kuli.
en: God had encouraged some young men to become followers of Saul, and when he returned to his hometown of Gibeah, they went with him.

dag: Ayuba ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Job said.

dag: Ka Ishibɔshɛt daa kɔŋ o ni yɛn yɛli Abinɛr shɛm, dama o daa zɔr o mi.
en: Ishbosheth couldnt say a single word in reply to Abner because he was afraid of him.

dag: Ka o daa pii bɛ niriba ayi n-tim ba ti Duuma Yisa sani ni bɛ ti bɔh o, Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun yɛn kana la bee ti na yulim dilan soli.
en: He sent them to the Lord to ask, Are you the one we heard was coming, or should we wait for someone else.

dag: Ŋunkam lo nia ni o tum zaɣ biɛɣu, bɛ ni bol o barinatumda.
en: Those who plot evil will be called master schemers.

dag: Ka Pool garigi yɛli, M mabihi, m bi mi ni o nyɛla maligumaaniba zuɣulana; dama di sabiya, Miri ka a tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ biɛri n-dalim a zuliya zuɣulana. .
en: Paul answered, My fellow Israelites, I did not know that he was the High Priest. The scripture says, You must not speak evil of the ruler of your people.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu ti kpamdi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi lala maa jaande, ka zaani ba zaligu ni bɛ be baalim ka tummi tuma lihiri bɛmaŋa.
en: By the Lord Jesus Christ, we command and encourage such people to work quietly and put their own food on the table.

dag: Nyama, n chɛ ka Miidianim maani shili ni bɛ liri ba. Bɛ je anzinfa, bɛ mi baɣa ka salima ni.
en: The Medes can't be bought off with silver or gold, and I'm sending them to attack Babylonia.

dag: Yɛnnim yɛm yɛtɔɣa tir ba la jilima, amaa jɛra yɛtɔɣa nyɛla din diri ba.
en: Words from the wise bring praise, but words from a fool bring destruction.

dag: Ka Ishibɔshɛt daa kɔŋ o ni yɛn yɛli Abinɛr shɛm, dama o daa zɔr o mi.
en: Ishbosheth was so afraid of Abner that he could not even answer.

dag: Vinnyaɣinim ku nya bɛ ni bɔri shɛli, amaa bɛn tumdi tuun kpɛma ni nimmoo ni nya buni din viɛla.
en: If you are lazy, you will never get what you are after, but if you work hard, you will get a fortune.

dag: nyin gbilisim tibili alizanda ni wum ka chɛ a niriba Izraɛlnim maa taali, ka lan zaŋ ba labisi a ni daa zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti bɛ mini bɛ yaannim la ni na.
en: In heaven, please listen to the prayers of your people Israel. Forgive them for their sins and let them have their land again. You gave this land to their ancestors.

dag: M bi paɣiri ya n ni yɛn wuhi ya wuhibu shɛli ŋɔ puuni, dama yi yi laɣim di bi sɔŋdi ya, amaa di naɣ saɣindi ya mi.
en: In the following instructions, however, I do not praise you, because your meetings for worship actually do more harm than good.

dag: Kurugu ŋmanila muriga o sani, ka daanya mi ŋmani da kpima.
en: He treats iron as straw, bronze as rotten wood.

dag: Ka Isaka zuliya ni toondaannim daa doli Dɛbɔra; Isaka zuliya niriba maa daa ʒe Barak yim, ka dol o du o napɔŋkpahi siɣi vinvamli maa ni. Amaa Rubin zuliya niriba bɛn noya daa wolimi.
en: The leaders of Issachar came with Deborah; yes, Issachar came and Barak too, and they followed him into the valley. But the tribe of Reuben was divided; they could not decide to come.

dag: Wummiya n wuhibu, ka niŋ yɛm. Miriya ka yi zaɣisi li.
en: Listen to my teaching and be wise; dont ignore what I say.

dag: N di yuya ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn chirindi ya maa zaŋ bɛmaŋ dii leela namɔɣilisi kaman ninvuɣ shɛb ni niŋdi shɛm la.
en: I wish those people who are bothering you would add castration to their circumcision.

dag: Ka doo maa ba min o ma maa yɛli ba, Ti mi ni ti bia m-bɔŋɔ, ka ti daa dɔɣ o la zoma.
en: His parents answered, We know that he is our son, and we know that he was born blind.

dag: Ka Nɛtania bia Ishimail daa yi Mizipa kana ni o ti tuhi ba soli ka kumda. O ni daa tuhi ba soli maa ka o yɛli ba, Kamiya Ahikam bia Gɛdalia sanna.
en: So Ishmael went out from Mizpah to meet them, weeping as he went. When he came to them, he said, Please come in to see Gedaliah.

dag: Guum yomyom tuh o soli ti bɔh o, A min a yidan ni yi bia la mal alaafee? Ka o garigi yɛli Gɛhaazi, Ti mal alaafee.
en: Run out to meet her and ask her, Are things okay with you, your husband, and your child? She said, Things are okay.

dag: Ka Maika bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu ka yi bɔhi ma ni bɔ n-chɛ ka n zaŋ niriba ŋɔ pa mmaŋ zuɣu na? Yi kpuɣila n wuna, ka zaŋ m maligumaana pahi, ka bɔ ka yi lee chɛ n-ti mani.
en: Micah answered, What do you mean, What's the matter? You take my priest and the gods that I made, and walk off? What have I got left.

dag: Filistianim maa ni daa ti nya Samsin, bɛ daa dii gbaala bɛ buɣili maa paɣibu, ka yɛra, Ti buɣili maa n-zaŋ ti dim ŋun bahi ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ yoli, ka ku ti niriba la niŋ ti nuu ni maa.
en: When the Philistines saw Samson, they praised their god. They said, This man destroyed our people! He killed many of our people! But our god helped us take our enemy.

dag: Di saha ka napaɣ Hagit bia Adɔnija daa ti ka Sulemaana ma Batishiiba sanna. Ka Batishiiba bɔh o, Alaafee ka a kana maa? Ka o garigi yɛli, Iin, alaafee.
en: Then Adonijah, whose mother was Haggith, went to Bathsheba, who was Solomon's mother. Is this a friendly visit? she asked. It is, he answered.

dag: Ka Naawuni ŋun nyɛ suhudoo ni yiri so sanna ŋɔ ni chɛ ka di ku yuui ka yi du n-tam Sintani zuɣu n-no m-bɔr o. Ti Duuma Yisa Masia daalibarika kpalimmi be yi ni!.
en: Then God, who gives peace, will soon crush Satan under your feet. I pray that our Lord Jesus will be kind to you.

dag: Yi yab Ibrahimma suhu daa piɛli ni o nya n saha ŋɔ, ka mi daa shiri nya li ka di niŋ o suhupiɛlli.
en: Your father Abraham was very happy that he would see the day when I came. He saw that day and was happy.

dag: Gbaya anahi daa bela dapaɣa maa lɔŋni; ka gbaya maa spindilinim mi mini binzahi maa nyɛ zaɣ mundili yini, ka gbaya maa zaɣ yini kam dubu nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: There were four wheels beneath the panels. The axles of the wheels were attached to the stand. Each wheel was twenty-seven inches in height.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa be Dauda sani Pasidamim saha shɛli Filistianim ni daa lo tɔb na ni bɛ ti tuhi Izraɛlnim chi puu ni ka Izraɛlnim ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ ba la.
en: He was with David at Pas-dammim. The Philistines were gathered there for battle, where part of a field was full of barley. When the people ran away from the Philistines.

dag: Gol so ŋun daa pahir ata ni ka bɛ daa piligi li gbilligbilli sɔŋbu, zaŋ chaŋ gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin ni ka bɛ daa sɔŋ li gbilligbilli maa naai.
en: The gifts started arriving in the third month and continued to pile up for the next four months.

dag: Hal bɛ yi zaŋ takɔbi bee piɛma bee kpana bee baasali sua lir o bɛ ku tooi niŋ o shɛli.
en: The sword that touches him wont prevail; neither will the dart, spear, nor javelin.

dag: Ɛhab daa malila bidibisi pisopɔin, ka bɛ be Samaria. Ka Jɛhu daa sab gbana zaŋ tim Samaria nti ti tiŋ maa nanim mini tiŋ kpamba ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbibi Ɛhab bidibisi maa n-yɛli.
en: There were seventy descendants of King Ahab living in the city of Samaria. Jehu wrote a letter and sent copies to the rulers of the city, to the leading citizens, and to the guardians of Ahab's descendants. The letter read:.

dag: Bina anahi n-nyɛ bɛn gamdi giŋgaani bɛ biɛhigu ni.
en: There are three things that act important when they walk—really, there are four:.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani kaman o ba Manaasa ni daa niŋ shɛm la.
en: Like his father Manasseh, he sinned against the Lord ;.

dag: dama Naawuni yi daa bi tiligi puu ni olivi tia maa wula la, dindina o ku tilig a gba.
en: If God cut away those natural branches, couldn't he do the same to you?.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Zanimi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dundɔŋ ni n-yɛli Juda fɔntinsinim bɛn zaa yɛn kana ti jɛm Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ŋɔ ni yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa n ni zal a ni a yɛli, ka miri ka a sɔɣi ba yɛtɔɣ shɛli.
en: The Lord said, Jeremiah, stand in the Temple yard of the Lord . Give this message to all the people of Judah who are coming to worship at the Temple of the Lord . Tell them everything that I tell you to speak. Dont leave out any part of my message.

dag: Ka o daa wuhi ba yɛla pam yɛtɔɣ ŋaha puuni yɛli.
en: He used stories to teach them many things, and this is part of what he taught:.

dag: Dama o daa lab me buɣa jɛmbu luɣ shɛŋa o ba Hɛzɛkia ni daa wurim la; ka lan lab me Baal mini Ashɛra bimbina zali kaman Izraɛl Naa Ɛhab ni daa niŋ shɛm la; ka daa jɛmdi saŋmarisi.
en: Manasseh rebuilt the high places that his father Hezekiah had destroyed. He also built altars for Baal and made an Asherah pole, just as King Ahab of Israel had done. Manasseh worshiped and served the stars of heaven.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ku shini n noli, N ni tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ni biɛrim pam n shia ni. N ni fabili ni naŋgbantom n suhu ni.
en: But I wont keep quiet; I will speak in the adversity of my spirit, groan in the bitterness of my life.

dag: Ka Yawɛ lan yɛli Musa.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses.

dag: Ka Shimɛi ŋun daa nyɛ Rama nir la daa nyɛ ŋun lihiri wain tihi puri, ka Zabidi ŋun daa nyɛ Shifam nir la daa lihiri wain ni be du shɛŋa ni.
en: in charge of the vineyards—Shimei the Ramathite; in charge of the vineyards produce for the wine cellars—Zabdi the Shiphmite.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum kum ni neebu yɛla maa ka bɛ ni shɛb maani Pool ansarisi, ka shɛb mi yɛli ni dahin shɛli ka bɛ ni ti lan wum o yɛtɔɣa maa pahi.
en: When the people heard about Jesus being raised from death, some of them laughed. But others said, We will hear more about this from you later.

dag: dama di bemi kaman so ni daa yɛli la: O zuɣu ka ti be ka damda, ka kul be ŋɔ. Di lan bemi kaman yi baŋdib shɛb ni yɛli shɛm la, Ti gba shiri yila Naawuni ni na.
en: as someone has said, In him we live and move and exist. It is as some of your poets have said, We too are his children.

dag: Nyama, n yɛn zaŋla piɛ gbaŋ sɔŋ kabɔɣili ni, maligim yi lula piɛ gbaŋ maa kɔŋko zuɣu, ka bi lu m-mahigi tiŋgbani gil li, dindina m baŋya ni a shiri ni chɛ ka n fa Izraɛlnim bahi kaman a ni yɛli shɛm.
en: I will put a sheepskin on the threshing floor. If there is dew only on the sheepskin, while all the ground is dry, I will know that you will use me to save Israel, as you said.

dag: Wulipolli ni ti puhi yi Jɛsi gbirili ni na. Wulli ni ti to n-yi o nyaɣa ni na n-wali.
en: A small tree will begin to grow from the stump of Jesse. That branch will grow from Jesses roots.

dag: Ka Judas ŋun daa yi Yisa nyaaŋa maa daa pun wuhi ba shihir shɛli yɛli, N yi ti kul puhi so ka mɔɣis o kpariŋ, ŋuna m-bala; yin gbaamiy o.
en: Judas planned to do something to show them which one was Jesus. He said, The one I kiss will be Jesus. Arrest him.

dag: Doo daa bi lan kpalim Ai bee Bɛtɛl. Bɛ daa yimi kari doli Izraɛlnima, ka chɛ bɛ tiŋ maa dunoli yali.
en: Every man in Ai went after the Israelites, and the city was left wide open, with no one to defend it.

dag: Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa zaligu m-bɔŋɔ: Luɣ shɛlikam zaa din gili zoli maa zuɣusaa nyɛla din be kasi zaa. Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa zaligu m-bala.
en: This is the law of the Temple: All the area surrounding it on the top of the mountain is sacred and holy.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ n kpiɔŋ ni n yaa; ŋuna n-nyɛ n tiliginsim.
en: The LORD was my strength and protection; he was my saving help!.

dag: Di saha ka Balak daa yɛli Balaam, A yi ku yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi bɛ zuɣu hal baabiɛla, nyin di niŋ alibarika gba niŋ bɛ ni hal baabiɛla.
en: Then Balak said to Balaam, You refuse to curse the people of Israel, but at least don't bless them.

dag: Hal o ba bee o ma bee o biɛli bee o tizɔpaɣa yi kpi gba, ŋun di saɣim omaŋa; dama o ni wolig omaŋ ti Naawuni maa yɛla bela o zuɣu ni.
en: whether father, mother, brother, or sister. Nazirites should not defile themselves because of the death of these people, because they bear the sign of their dedication to God on their heads.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ daa shiri niŋ Judanima kaman Yawɛ ni zali shɛm ni o yihi ba o sani. Manaasa ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa la.
en: Indeed, this happened to Judah because the LORD commanded them to be removed from his presence on account of all the sins that Manasseh had committed.

dag: Ka n yi kul yi a sani chaŋ, Yawɛ shia ni kana nti kpuɣ a kpa shɛli polo n ni ʒi, ka n chaŋ ti yɛli Ɛhab ka o ti bi nya a, o ni ku ma, hal man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni kul nyɛ ŋun doli Yawɛ viɛnyɛliŋga m bilim ni ha la zaa yoli.
en: But heres what will happen: As soon as I leave you, the LORDs spirit will carry you off somewhere—I dont know where—then Ill report to Ahab, but he wont be able to find you. Then he will kill me! But your servant has feared the LORD from my youth.

dag: Niŋmiya Yawɛ naani sahakam, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni maa n-taɣiri ti ka chɛri zaɣ biɛɣu sahakam.
en: Trust in the Lord forever; he will always protect us.

dag: Di yɛli a ʒiʒiinikpee, Cham ka sa labina biɛɣuni ka n zaŋ li ti a, di yi be a sani.
en: Never tell your neighbors to wait until tomorrow if you can help them now.

dag: dama ti nyɛla bɛn mini Masia laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yini, ti yi kul niŋ ti ni daa tuui mali tahima shɛl la naani viɛnyɛliŋga hal ni di bahigu ni.
en: We are partners with Christ, but only if we hold on to the confidence we had in the beginning until the end.

dag: Jɔpa mini Lida ni daa bi wɔɣ ni tab zuɣu ka Yisa nyaandoliba maa daa wum ni Pita be Lida ka tim niriba ayi o sani ni bɛ ti yɛl o ni bɛ bɔri ni o ka bɛ sanna yomyom.
en: Joppa was not very far from Lydda, and when the believers in Joppa heard that Peter was in Lydda, they sent two men to him with the message, Please hurry and come to us.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi puu ni bindir tuuli mini yi puu ni tiwala kom na ti ti ma di tibu saha, ka di niŋya zinchili. Zaŋmiya yi bidib tuuli kam ti ma.
en: At harvest time you should give me the first grain and the first juice from your fruit. Dont wait until late in the year. Give me your firstborn sons.

dag: Ŋunkam lo nia ni o tum zaɣ biɛɣu, bɛ ni bol o barinatumda.
en: If you are always planning evil, you will earn a reputation as a troublemaker.

dag: Bɛ ni daa chani maa ka bɛ gbaai tab bɔhibu, Ka ŋuni n-lee ti yɛn biligi kuɣ shɛli din yo siliga maa nol la ti ti?.
en: The women said to each other, There is a large stone covering the entrance of the tomb. Who will move the stone for us.

dag: Ka paɣital dɔro ni daa mali paɣ so yuun pinaayi daa be bɛ ni.
en: In the crowd was a woman who had been bleeding for twelve years.

dag: Miri ka a vuɣi tiŋgbani tariga kpaa din nyɛ a yaannim ni daa kpa shɛli kurimbuni ha.
en: Dont remove an ancient boundary marker that your ancestors established.

dag: O ni daa nya ka lala niŋbu tiɣi Yɛhudianim nini zuɣu ka o daa gbaai Pita gba. Bɔrɔbɔro din ka Dabindi Chuɣu la puhibu saha ka o daa niŋ lala maa.
en: When he saw that this pleased the Jews, he arrested Peter as well. This happened during the Festival of Unleavened Bread.

dag: Ka o daa to piɛma n-wurim ba bahi; ka chɛ ka saa nyaɣisi niŋ ba ka bɛ ŋmaligi guui.
en: He scattered the enemy with his arrows— the lightning bolts that threw them into confusion.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn kul bela biɛrim ni bɛ nyɛviya ni zaa; yuun shɛŋa zaa din gari ka bɛ bi zɔri niriba nambɔɣu la ni.
en: The wicked who oppress others will be in torment as long as they live.

dag: N naa daa dola o bindoo zuɣu, ka n tulaale nyom deei nimaani zaa.
en: The smell of my perfume reaches out to the king lying on his couch.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti daa yi tumdi tuma maa, bɛ ni pirigili gbibila kpana asibaasi ŋaraŋara saha zaŋ hal ti paai yuŋ saŋmarisi peebu saha.
en: So every day, from dawn until the stars came out at night, half of us worked on the wall, while the other half stood guard with spears.

dag: Amaa biŋkɔbigu ni tuui dɔɣi bi so nyɛla Yawɛ ni su so, di bi simdi ka so ti lan zaŋ o ti Yawɛ. Di yi nyɛla nahu bee piɛɣu, o nyɛla Yawɛ dini.
en: All first-born animals of your flocks and herds are already mine, and so you cannot promise any of them to me.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka sagbana bɔɣi ka o siɣina, ka zibisim titali be o naba tiŋli.
en: He tore the sky open and came down with a dark cloud under his feet.

dag: Ŋun biriti mini ŋun mihiri kom zaa nyɛla yim, ka bɛ zaa ni ti deei bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm laara.
en: The one who plants is just as important as the one who waters. And each one will be paid for what they do.

dag: Di saha Izraɛlnim zaa daa ʒiɛla nimaani, ka naa ŋmaligi bɛ polo n-suhi alibarika niŋ bɛ ni.
en: All the people of Israel were standing there. The king turned to face them and asked God's blessing on them.

dag: ka Shallum nyɛ Hilikia ba, ka Hilikia nyɛ Azaria ba.
en: Shallum was Hilkiahs father. Hilkiah was Azariahs father.

dag: Ka Manaasa daa ti faai siɣ o o yaannim sani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o o yiŋa, ka o bia Amɔn daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Manasseh lay down with his ancestors and was buried in his palace. His son Amon succeeded him as king.

dag: Ka di wulinluhili polo daa mali pateesanim din wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pisinaayi, ka mali daantalisi pia ni di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu pia, ka daantalisi maa bansi mini di mihi la daa nyɛ anzinfa.
en: On the west side of the courtyard the wall of curtains was cubits long. There were posts and bases. The hooks for the posts and the curtain rods were made from silver.

dag: Nudirigu polo tintariga maa daa kpuɣila Teeku Kpiŋ la tariga mini di kulinol ni n-zaŋ kpa nudirigu polo.
en: The southern border of Judahs land started at the south end of the Dead Sea.

dag: Daadam ni daa tahi kum na shɛm, lala ka daadam lan tahi kpiimba kum ni neebu gba na;.
en: Since death came through a human being, the resurrection of the dead came through one too.

dag: dindina nyin chɛ ka m paɣa duɣi dihi do so, ka chɛ ka do so dɔn o.
en: then let my wife cook another man's food and sleep in another man's bed.

dag: Ka o daa mali dundombila ti maligumaaniba, ka lan mali dundɔn titali, ka mali pundi niŋ li, ka dooi daanya pa di pundi maa zuɣu.
en: He also made the priests courtyard, the large courtyard, and the doors that open to them. He used bronze to cover these doors.

dag: Yɔɣu ni bunsi tamla daboya zuɣu n-taɣiri ʒiɛɣu kaman yɔbahi la, ka bɛ nina niŋ liti, mɔri ni kani zuɣu.
en: Wild donkeys stand on the bare hills. They sniff the wind like jackals. But their eyes cannot find any food, because there are no plants to eat.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yi chɛ bɛ wuntitali tuma ka tumdi alahichi, bɛ ni kpi di zuɣu.
en: When someone righteous stops doing good and starts doing evil, he will die for it.

dag: N yi yihiri lahibal suŋ waazu, n ka bara nyubu di ni; dama di nyɛla n talahi tuuni, ka mbusim be n zuɣu n yi bi yihi lahibal suŋ waazu maa!.
en: I don't have any reason to brag about preaching the good news. Preaching is something God told me to do, and if I don't do it, I am doomed.

dag: Kum maa daa miiya pam tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: The famine was severe in the land.

dag: N daa lihiya n-nya ka tiŋgban shɛli din daa mali atam pam la leela tiŋgban nɛli, ka di fɔntinsi la zaa wurim do Yawɛ tooni, o suhuyiɣisili din galisi zuɣu.
en: Farmland had become a desert, and towns were in ruins. The Lord 's fierce anger had done all of this.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli daadamnima, Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni zɔbo n-nyɛ yɛm ka tuumbiɛri chɛbu mi nyɛ baŋsim.
en: God said to us humans, To be wise, you must have reverence for the Lord. To understand, you must turn from evil.

dag: O yiko ni ka o chɛ ka teeku fo n-dɔni baalim. O yɛm ka o daa zaŋ ku Reehab.
en: It is his strength that conquered the sea; by his skill he destroyed the monster Rahab.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ ŋun kpaŋsiri ya, ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yi zɔri daadam ŋun ni kpi ŋɔ dabiɛm? Daadam ŋmanila mɔri, o kul ku beni sahakam.
en: The Lord says, I am the one who strengthens you. Why should you fear mortals, who are no more enduring than grass?.

dag: A chɛ ka n dolintab kaɣiri ma mi, a chɛ ka n leela bɛ ni zaɣisi so. Bɛ kpari ma mi niŋ duu, ka n ku tooi zo n-tiligi.
en: You have made my friends turn in horror from me. I am a prisoner who cannot escape.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa yi nti nya farigudeer so ŋun yuli booni Lɛvi, ka o ʒi farigu deebu shee; ka Yisa yɛl o, Yiɣisim doli ma.
en: Later, Jesus went out and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the place for paying taxes. Jesus said to him, Follow me.

dag: A nyɛla puu ni kɔbil nini mini nyɛvili kom kɔbiliga ni kulibɔna kom din zɔri yiri Lɛbanɔn na.
en: Fountains water the garden, streams of flowing water, brooks gushing down from the Lebanon Mountains.

dag: Dama nyin daa niŋ li la ashilɔni, amaa man yɛn niŋ li la palɔni wuntaŋ ni Izraɛlnim zaa ninni. .
en: What you did was in secret, but I will do this in the open for everyone in Israel to see.

dag: Yi ma daa ŋmanila wain tia m-be wain tihi puu ni, ka bɛ daa zaŋ o sa m-baɣili kom. Ka kom pam maa daa chɛ ka o teei wula n-wali wala pam.
en: Your mother was like a grapevine planted near a stream. Because there was plenty of water, the vine was covered with leaves and fruit.

dag: Ka o daa tim nachimbi pola pia ka yɛli ba, Chamiya Kamɛl nti chaŋ Nabal sani ti zaŋ n yuli puh o.
en: so he sent ten young men with orders to go to Carmel, find Nabal, and give him his greetings.

dag: N ni chɛ ka kum din bahiri niriba yoli mini buɣim din dira ni alɔbo din ni chɛ ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri zaŋ bɛ nyina liri ba lu bɛ zuɣu, ka zaŋ tinvura lɔɣu lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: devastating hunger, consuming plague, bitter sickness. Ill send animal fangs after them, venom from dust crawlers too.

dag: Bɛ gbahi Judanim daba n-zaŋ ba chaŋ ka bɛ ti diri wahala, ka tumdi dabitim tuma. Pumpɔŋɔ bɛ bela tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni, ka bi nya vuhim shee. Bɛn daa kari doli ba maa zaa gbahi ba bɛ nandahima pam puuni.
en: Judah's people are helpless slaves, forced away from home. They live in other lands, with no place to call their own— Surrounded by enemies, with no way to escape.

dag: Yi daa tam tampiŋ din dɔɣi ya yɛla, ka daa tam Naawuni ŋun dɔɣi ya yɛla.
en: You people left the Rock who made you; you forgot the God who gave you life.

dag: Naawuni chɛ ka Rubin zuliya kul beni, ka ku kpihim, hal o zuliya kalinli ni kul pɔri maa zaa yoli.
en: Tribe of Reuben, you will live, even though your tribe will always be small.

dag: kpamba pisinaanahi maa gbaanila ŋuna ŋun ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu ka ʒi nam ʒiishee maa ni la tooni m-piligi bɛ nam zuɣupila n-sɔŋ nam ʒiishee maa tooni, ka jɛmd o, ka yiini yila yɛra.
en: the elders bowed down before the one who sits on the throne. They worshiped him who lives forever and ever. They put their crowns down before the throne and said.

dag: N daa deei sɔŋsim cheechi shɛŋa ni n-ka yi sanna ti sɔŋ ya. Di bemi kaman n daa fa ba mi n-sɔŋ ya maa.
en: I robbed other churches by taking a salary from them in order to serve you!.

dag: Yisa daa ti ʒi Olivi Tihi Zoli zuɣu, ka o nyaandoliba ka o sanna ashilɔni ti bɔh o, Ti Duuma, bɔ saha ka dimbɔŋɔnim ti yɛn niŋ, ka bɔ nti yɛn nyɛ a kandina mini dunia ŋɔ yiɣisibu shihira? Ti bɔri ni a yɛl ti.
en: As Jesus sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him in private. Tell us when all this will be, they asked, and what will happen to show that it is the time for your coming and the end of the age.

dag: Ka naŋgbankpeeni daa kpe bɛ sunsuuni ka bɛ woligi taba di zuɣu; ka Baanabas daa zaŋ Maak pah omaŋ zuɣu ka bɛ kpe ŋariŋ chaŋ Saipurus.
en: Paul and Barnabas argued, then each of them went his own way. Barnabas took Mark and sailed to Cyprus.

dag: bɛ ni ti yɛrila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be taŋkpaɣu yiya ni, ka bɛ piligu shee nyɛla taŋkpaɣu ni, ka bɛ ni tooi no n-ku ba kaman zunzuli ŋɔ?.
en: Humans are formed from clay and are fragile as moths, so what chance do you have?.

dag: Daadam, piimi dapaɣili sabi, Juda dini ni Izraɛlnim dini m-pa di zuɣu. Di nyaaŋa ka a lan pii dapaɣili shɛli sabi Yisifu dini ni Izraɛlnim dini m-pa di zuɣu.
en: Mortal man, he said, take a wooden stick and write on it the words, The kingdom of Judah. Then take another stick and write on it the words, The kingdom of Israel.

dag: Ʒe tibi a ni doli so shɛli ni, ka a soya zaa ni mali viɛla.
en: Plan carefully what you do, and whatever you do will turn out right.

dag: Ka di daa kpaŋsi nimaani yɛdaniŋdib suhuri, ka niriba kul pahiri bɛ zuɣu dabisili kam.
en: The churches became stronger in their faith, and each day more people put their faith in the Lord.

dag: Zaŋmiya daba ayɔbu n-tum yi tuma.
en: You have six days when you can do your work.

dag: Di saha ka n daa tim ti boli Ɛliɛza mini Ariɛl ni Shɛmaya ni Ɛlnatan ni Jarib ni Ɛlnatan so yaha ni Neetan ni Zakaria ni Mɛshulam bɛn daa nyɛ zuɣulaannim la ni Joyarib mini Ɛlnatan so mi yaha bɛn daa nyɛ yɛnnim la.
en: I sent for nine of the leaders: Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zechariah, and Meshullam, and for two teachers, Joiarib and Elnathan.

dag: ni yaannina ayi mini kpam din be di ni zaa ni binsabili yaɣ shɛli din viɛl pahi n-nyo buɣim kaman bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim tiri Yawɛ la.
en: the two kidneys and the fat around them at the loins; and the lobe on the liver, which should be removed with the kidneys.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ buɣ so ŋun yuli booni Zius la yuli ti Baanabas, ka zaŋ buɣ so ŋun mi yuli booni Hɛrimɛs la yuli ti Pool mi, Pool ni daa nyɛ bɛ yɛtɔɣ tɔɣisira la zuɣu.
en: The people then gave Barnabas the name Zeus, and they gave Paul the name Hermes, because he did the talking.

dag: ka zaŋ ʒiri shɛhiranim maa na ka bɛ ti yɛli, Doo ŋɔ kul galindila Naawuni jɛmbu duu luɣ shɛli din be kasi shee la mini Anabi Musa zaligu;.
en: Some men agreed to tell lies about Stephen, and they said, This man keeps on saying terrible things about this holy temple and the Law of Moses.

dag: n yɛri ya la zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni yi zaa ni ti kpi, yi ti ku yuui yi ni yɛn du Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili ti kpe tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni nti dee li su maa ni.
en: Im telling you right now that you will definitely die. You will not prolong your life on the fertile land that you are crossing the Jordan River to enter and possess.

dag: N ni daa nya ʒii shɛli yuŋ la ni, n daa nya so ka o ŋmanila ninsala n-yi zuɣusaa be sagbana ni sirigiri na n-daa ka ŋun pun be tum kurimbuni ha la sanna, ka bɛ daa zaŋ o wuh o.
en: As I continued to watch the vision that night, I saw what looked like a son of man coming with the clouds of heaven, and he was presented to the Eternal God.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ biɛri ni ʒirinim lu n zuɣu. Bɛ ŋmarila ʒiri pari ma.
en: Wicked people are telling lies about me. They are saying things that are not true.

dag: ka Jeesɔn deei ba kpɛh o yiŋa. Bɛ mi nyɛla bɛn saɣindi Naa Siiza zaligunima, ka yɛri ni na so lan beni m-pahi Naa Siiza zuɣu ni ŋuna n-nyɛ Yisa.
en: and Jason has welcomed them into his home. All of them break the laws of the Roman Emperor by claiming that someone named Jesus is king.

dag: A ni ti ŋmanila zuɣupil shɛli din mali jilima be Yawɛ nuu ni, ka lan be kaman nam zuɣupiligu la be a Naawuni nuu ni.
en: You will be like a beautiful crown for the Lord .

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa kari Filistianim maa ti bahi, ka lab bɛ suɣa ni ti di nɛma.
en: When the Israelite army returned from chasing the Philistines, they took what they wanted from the enemy camp.

dag: Wula ka ti lee ni yɛli ti yab Ibrahimma so zuliya ni ti ni yila na yɛla?.
en: What shall we say, then, of Abraham, the father of our race? What was his experience?.

dag: O daa yɛliya: Yawɛ daa yila Sinai Zoli zuɣu na, ka yi Siɛr ka ti sanna; o daa yi Paran Zoli zuɣu n-niŋ neesim bahi ti na, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi tuhi pia be o sani; ka omaŋmaŋ dini din galisi be o nudirigu polo.
en: The Lord came from Mount Sinai. From Edom, he gave light to his people, and his glory was shining from Mount Paran. Thousands of his warriors were with him, and fire was at his right hand.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋma Sool zuɣu ka yeeg o gbaɣino, ka tim bihi ni bɛ gili Filistia tiŋgbɔŋ zaa ni n-zaŋ lahiba suŋ maa yɛli bɛ buɣa mini bɛ niriba zaa.
en: They cut off Sauls head and stripped off his armor, and then sent word throughout Philistine territory, carrying the good news to their gods temples and to their people.

dag: Ka Pool mini Baanabas daa pihi bɛ napɔna taŋkpaɣu bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka yi ni chaŋ Aikɔnium.
en: Paul and Barnabas shook the dust from that place off their feet and went on to the city of Iconium.

dag: Amaa n zaŋsim daa be n yuli din be kasi ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim ni daa saɣim shɛli bɛ ni daa be zuliya shɛb ni la.
en: The people of Israel ruined my holy name wherever they went, and I felt sorry for my name.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan yɛli Ibrahimma, Di simdi ni a min a zuliya maa gbibi n daalikauli maa bɛ ʒiɛmana zaa ni.
en: God said to Abraham, You also must agree to keep the covenant with me, both you and your descendants in future generations.

dag: Di kpari biɛla ka dunianim ku lan nya ma yaha; amaa yinim ni nyari ma. N ni mali nyɛvili be zuɣu, yi gba ni mali nyɛvili m-be.
en: In a little while the people of this world won't be able to see me, but you will see me. And because I live, you will live.

dag: Ka saa daa gbaai nyaɣisibu ka tahira, ka vuri mɔni, ka tiŋgbani daa dam pam, ka tiŋgbani dambu lala tatabo daa na ʒi n-niŋ daadamnim nambu piligu ni zaŋ kana di saha maa.
en: There were flashes of lightning, roars of thunder, and the worst earthquake in all history.

dag: N nyaya ka daadamnim ni tumdi shɛlikam dunia ŋɔ ni zaa nyɛla din ka buchi, ka ŋmanila nir yi zɔri doli pɔhim.
en: When I observed all that happens under the sun, I realized that everything is pointless, a chasing after wind.

dag: Naa Hiram daa pun zaŋla salima din tibisim gari kilɔgiram tusaanahi n-timna ti ti naa.
en: Hiram had sent Solomon almost five tons of gold.

dag: A wuntitali nyɛla wuntitali din bi naara, ka a zaligunim nyɛ yɛlimaŋli.
en: Your goodness is forever, and your teachings can be trusted.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, a daŋ min a nam n-kul ni ʒiɛya, n sani ka a nam kul ni ʒiɛya sahakam. .
en: I will make sure that one of your descendants will always be king.

dag: Jɔab mini tɔbbi shɛb bɛn zaa daa be o sani maa ni daa kuna ka bɛ daa yɛl o, Nɛr bia Abinɛr la kala naa sanna ka o bah o ka o chaŋ ni suhudoo.
en: When Joab and his men arrived, he was told that Abner had come to King David and had been sent away with a guarantee of safety.

dag: din ni chɛ ka o duhi ya, ka yi nyari paɣibu mini yudua ni jilima n-gari o ni nam zuliya shɛb zaa, ka chɛ ka yi ti niŋ zuliya kasi ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani kaman o ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛm la.
en: The Lord will make you greater than all the nations he made. He will give you praise, fame, and honor. And you will be his own special people, as he promised.

dag: Yɛlli ŋɔ nyɛla din chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe tibi yɛma ŋma. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali yiɣisi wuɣili ninvuɣ biɛɣu zuɣu.
en: People who are truly good would feel so alarmed, that they would become angry with my worthless friends.

dag: Ka a yi ka shɛli, nyin wumma; foma, ka n wuh a yɛm.
en: If not, you must hear me; be quiet, and I will teach you wisdom.

dag: Ka o daa dii yiɣisi zani chana, dama o daa nyɛla yuun pinaayi bia, ka di daa niŋ ba alahiziba pam ti yaɣi.
en: She got up at once and started walking around. When this happened, they were completely amazed.

dag: Di lan sabi: Bɛn pa Yɛhudianima, maliya suhupiɛlli pah o niriba zuɣu.
en: And again, it says, Rejoice, Gentiles, with his people .

dag: Izraɛl zuɣulaannim bɛn be a ni zaŋla bɛmaŋmaŋ yiko kuri niriba.
en: All Israel's leaders trust in their own strength and commit murder.

dag: Ka Judanim maa zaa daa garigi yɛli Izraɛlnim maa, Naa ni nyɛ ti daŋ ni nir zuɣu. Ka wula ka yi suhuri yiɣisi yɛlli ŋɔ zuɣu? Yi nya ka ti dila naa binshɛli? Bee o ti ti la pini.
en: Then all the people of Judah answered the Israelites, Because the king is our relative! Why are you angry at us about this? Have we taken any of the kings food? Has he given us any gifts.

dag: Rɛsɛn din be Ninive mini Kala din nyɛ tin tital la sunsuuni.
en: Resen.

dag: Bɛ yuri maa ni ti galisi hal ka bɛ taŋkpagbiligu ti lim ya, ka wɔribariba mini bɛ tɔrokɔnim ni bɛ chɛchɛbunsi vuri ti chɛ ka yi dikiya sɔhigi, bɛ ni kpe yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni kaman nira ni kpɛri tin shɛli din wurim ni shɛm la.
en: He will have so many horses that the dust they stir up will seem like a thick fog. And as his chariots and cavalry approach, even the walls will shake, especially when he proudly enters your ruined city.

dag: Ka tumo so ŋun daa chaŋ ni o ti zaŋ Mikaya maa na yɛl o, Nyama, anabinim maa zaa naala noli n-yɛli naa ni yu shɛm, a gba kul yɛlimila yɛtɔɣ shɛli din ŋmani bɛ ni yino dini, ka nyɛ o yubu.
en: Meanwhile, the messenger who went to get Micaiah whispered, Micaiah, all the prophets have good news for Ahab. Now go and say the same thing.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa. Yɛlim maligumaaniba bɛn nyɛ Aduna bidibisi la ni bɛ so miri ka o chaŋ o dɔɣiri so kuyili nti kpe daɣiri ni.
en: The Lord gave Moses these instructions for Aaron's sons, the priests: Touching a dead body will make you unclean. So don't go near a dead relative.

dag: Ka yi ʒiɛmannim ti baŋ ni n ni daa yihi Izraɛlnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la, n daa chɛ ka bɛ bela suɣa ni. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: so future generations will know that I made their ancestors live in shelters when I brought them out of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.

dag: Ka Yisa daa wum lala ka yɛli, O dɔro maa pala kum dɔro, amaa di nyɛla din ni chɛ ka Naawuni nya jilima, ka Naawuni Bia gba nya jilima di zuɣu.
en: When Jesus heard it, he said, The final result of this sickness will not be the death of Lazarus; this has happened in order to bring glory to God, and it will be the means by which the Son of God will receive glory.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka m po pɔri ka o yɛli ma, Miri ka a kpuɣi n ni kana ti be Keenannim shɛb tiŋgbɔŋ ni ŋɔ bipuɣiŋga ti m bia maa ka o niŋ o paɣa;.
en: I solemnly promised my master that I would do what he said. And he told me, Don't choose a wife for my son from the women in this land of Canaan.

dag: Di saha ka Saimɔn Pita ŋun daa mali takɔb la ŋooi li n-chɛ n-shɛligi maligumaaniba zuɣulan dabili nudirigu tibili bahi. Dabili maa yuli n-daa booni Malikus.
en: Simon Peter, who had a sword, drew it and struck the High Priest's slave, cutting off his right ear. The name of the slave was Malchus.

dag: Nimaani ka bɛ daa sɔɣi Ibrahimma min o paɣ Zara ni Yisahaku min o paɣ Ribɛka; ka n gba daa sɔɣi Liya nimaani.
en: That is where they buried Abraham and his wife Sarah; that is where they buried Isaac and his wife Rebecca; and that is where I buried Leah.

dag: Ka wuntizɔriba daa nya li ka bɛ suhuri paligi, amaa ka ninvuɣ biɛri daa fo bɛ noya.
en: Those who do right see it and celebrate, but every wicked person shuts their mouth.

dag: ni Zimiri nanim zaa ni Ɛlam nanim zaa ni Miidia nanim zaa.
en: I made all the kings from Zimri, Elam, and Media drink from the cup.

dag: A nina be kasi ni di lihi zaɣ biɛɣu, ka a ku tooi lihiri zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu. Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a lihiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka yɛda, ka shini ka ninvuɣ biɛri kuri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ wuntizɔriba gari ba?.
en: Your eyes are too good to look at evil. You cannot stand to see people doing wrong. So why do you permit such evil? How can you watch while the wicked destroy people who are so much better?.

dag: ka sɔŋmiya taba. Yi ni so yi mali yɛli shɛli ni o kpee, yin chɛliya tab taali paŋ taba; di niŋ kamaata ni yi chɛri yi tab taali paŋdi ba kaman ti Duuma ni daa chɛ m-paŋ yi gba shɛm la.
en: Be tolerant with each other and, if someone has a complaint against anyone, forgive each other. As the Lord forgave you, so also forgive each other.

dag: O ni ti gbib o kayeeni ŋmani o nuu ni na ni o ti yɛl o chi kabɔɣili ni zaŋ kabiɛlim su o kunchuna ni, ka zaŋ buɣim din bi kpiri nyo wurigu mi.
en: His threshing fork is in his hand, and he is ready to separate the wheat from the husks. He will store the wheat in his barn and burn the husks with a fire that never goes out.

dag: Ka bɛ daa laɣim taai duŋ niŋ Musa mini Aduna. Bɛ daa yɛli ba mi, Yi va n-ʒi pam. Dama niriba ŋɔ zaa yinoyino nyɛla bɛn be kasi, ka Yawɛ be bɛ sani. Ka bɔzuɣu ka yi ti duhi yimaŋ Yawɛ niriba sani lala.
en: They came as a group to speak against Moses and Aaron and said, You have gone too far—you are wrong! All the Israelites are holy—the Lord still lives among them. You are making yourselves more important than the rest of the Lord s people.

dag: Ti ni mali tahima ŋɔ zuɣu ka ti mali suhukpeeni.
en: This wonderful hope makes us feel like speaking freely.

dag: N ŋmanila tiŋgban nɛli ni juɣu, ka ŋmani dabari ni viɣu.
en: I am like a wild bird in the desert, like an owl in abandoned ruins.

dag: o yi baŋ o ni tum alahichi shɛl maa, ŋun bom bunyaŋ ŋun ka dalinli m-mali sara o ni tum alahichi shɛli maa zuɣu.
en: If you learn about that sin, you must bring a female goat that has nothing wrong with it as your sin offering.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb beni ka bɛ nyina ŋmanila takɔbiri, ka ŋmani suhi, bɛ bɔri ni bɛ ku faranim dunia ni, ka bɔri ni bɛ ku nandaamba daadamnim sunsuuni.
en: There are people whose teeth are like swords and their jaws like knives. They take everything they can from the poor.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka yi kul zaɣisir o? Yi bɔrila tibidarigibo din galisi? Izraɛlnima, yi zuɣuri zaa malila dansi, ka yi suhuri mini yi tɛha ka alaafee.
en: Why do you invite further beatings? Why continue to rebel? Everyones head throbs, and everyones heart fails.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yina n-na kul yɛla kpar ʒiɛɣu la, ka pili gɔhi zuɣupiligu maa. Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa yɛli ba, Nyamiya doo maa.
en: Jesus came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe. Pilate said, Here is the man.

dag: ka kul fo n-ʒiya saha shɛli ti Duuma ni chɛ ka di paag o maa.
en: and to sit silently alone, if this is what the Lord intends.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ŋmani biɛkaali, ka piɛli kaman goli, ka ne kaman wuntaŋa, ka o ni be shɛm ŋmani tɔbbihi bɛn gbibi tuutanim chani la?.
en: You are as majestic as the morning sky— glorious as the moon— blinding as the sun! Your charms are more powerful than all the stars above.

dag: A yɛligu baŋbu nyɛla din tiri neesim. Di chɛmi ka tarim nyari baŋsim.
en: The explanation of your teachings gives light and brings wisdom to the ignorant.

dag: Yi mi ni n tum tuma ni n yaa zaa ti yi ba.
en: You know that I have worked hard for your father.

dag: Yawɛ kukoli vuri be teeku kom zuɣu; Naawuni ŋun nyɛ jilimalan ŋɔ n-tahiri maa, Yawɛ m-be ko titali maa zuɣu maa.
en: The voice of the Lord echoes over the oceans. The glorious Lord God thunders above the roar of the raging sea.

dag: Pita ni daa kul yɛri maa ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa siɣi bɛnkam daa wum yɛligu maa zuɣu na.
en: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit came down on all those who were listening to his speech.

dag: O ni daa ti piligi maani di laasabu maa ka bɛ zaŋ do so ŋun daa di naa maa laɣ gbaliŋ samli na.
en: He had just begun to do so when one of them was brought in who owed him millions of dollars.

dag: Azaria n-daa nyɛ Hɛlɛz ba, ka Hɛlɛz mi nyɛ Ɛliasa ba.
en: Helez, Eleasah.

dag: Nyama, bɛ kahi kuɣa duhi n-teei gili tiŋ maa ni bɛ ŋme n-deei li. Ka tɔb maa mini kum ni alɔbo zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ tiŋ maa niŋ Kalidianim bɛn tuhiri ni bɛ deei li maa nuu ni. A ni daa yɛli shɛm la n-niŋ pali, ka amaŋmaŋ dii nya li maa.
en: Now the siege ramps are in place to take the city. And the Babylonians are about to capture it by war, famine, and disease. What you have pronounced is now happening, as you can see.

dag: Naawuni Kundi yɛliya, Ŋunkam niŋ o yɛda ku di vi.
en: Yes, the Scriptures say, Anyone who trusts in him will never be disappointed.

dag: Ka tuumba maa daa ti labina nti yɛli Yisa bɛ ni daa niŋ shɛlikam zaa, ka o daa zaŋ ba yi kpaŋa n-chaŋ tin shɛli din yuli booni Bɛtisaida.
en: The apostles came back and told Jesus everything they had done. He then took them with him to the village of Bethsaida, where they could be alone.

dag: Ka yi yi ti yɛn kpe tɔb maa tuhibu ni, yin chɛliya ka maligumaaniba kana ti zani tooni n-tɔɣisi tɔbbihi maa.
en: Before you start fighting, a priest is to come forward and say to the army.

dag: Di chɛ ka m mali galimi n suhu ni zaŋ chaŋ a zaligunim maa polo, ka lala zuɣu ni chɛ ka n ku di vi.
en: Let me obey your laws perfectly so that I will not be ashamed.

dag: Yi bi mi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba nyari bɛ bindirigu la Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa tuma ni? Ka yi bi mi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tumdi sara maligu bimbini zuɣu tuma gba nyari bɛ bindirigu la sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu dira?.
en: Surely you know that those who work at the Temple get their food from the Temple. And those who serve at the altar get part of what is offered at the altar.

dag: Amaa ka Dauda daa chaŋ ti du Olivi tihi Zoli n-chani ka kumda. O daa zaŋla bini pil o zuɣu, ka chani napɔn zaŋa. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be o sani gba zaŋ bina pil bɛ zuɣuri n-kumdi dol o chana.
en: David went on up the slope of the Mount of Olives. He was barefoot and crying, and he covered his head to show his sorrow. Everyone with him was crying, and they covered their heads too.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔ saha ka o kpaŋ? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Sɔhila kurugu yini saha ka o niŋgbun biisim maa sa bah o.
en: So he asked them at what time his son had started to get better. And they said, The fever left him yesterday at about one oclock in the afternoon.

dag: Zaŋ kpa pal shɛli din daa do dundɔŋ ni ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pia la ni zaŋ kpa bɛ ni daa zaŋ kuɣa mali samban ni luɣ shɛli polo la, duri maa daa mɛmi tam taba buta zuɣu, ka yaɣ yini labi nyaaŋa ka chɛ din la tiŋli.
en: It was next to the twenty chambers that belonged to the inner courtyard and next to the pavement of the outer courtyard, and it had three courses of promenades.

dag: Rɛhɔbɔam daa yur o paɣ Maaka ŋun nyɛ Absalom bipuɣiŋga maa n-gar o paɣ shɛb bɛn pahi min o mamanim zaa. .
en: In all, Rehoboam had eighteen wives and sixty concubines, and he fathered twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters. Of all his wives and concubines he loved Maacah best.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Ilaija daa lan yɛl o, N suhir a, kpalimmi kpe; dama Yawɛ n-tim ma Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni. Amaa ka Ilaisha gba lan yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ mini nyini ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, n kul ku chɛ a dolibu. Ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa doli chana.
en: Elijah said to Elisha, Stay here, because the LORD has sent me to the Jordan. But Elisha said, As the LORD lives and as you live, I wont leave you. So both of them went on together.

dag: Ka salo pam daa ti lan laɣim ka Yisa sanna, ka daa ti lan ka bindirigu din ni di, ka o daa bol o nyaandoliba na ti yɛli ba.
en: One day another large crowd gathered around Jesus. They had not brought along anything to eat. So Jesus called his disciples together and said.

dag: Maligumaana bidibbil kam ni tooi ŋub li. Di simdi ka bɛ ti ŋub li la luɣ kasi shee, di nyɛla din be kasi zaa.
en: Any male in a priests family may eat the guilt offering. It is very holy, so it must be eaten in a holy place.

dag: Bɛ daa guhiri ma mi kaman bɛ ni guhiri saa shɛm la. Bɛ suhuri daa kul yɛla n zuɣu kaman niriba suhuri ni ye siɣili saa zuɣu shɛm la.
en: My words were eagerly accepted like the showers of spring.

dag: Ŋun yi zuɣusaa na gari sokam zaa; ŋun yi dunia ŋɔ ni na nyɛla dunia ŋɔ nira, ka tɔɣisiri dunia ŋɔ yɛla; amaa ŋun yi alizanda ni na gari sokam zaa.
en: God's Son comes from heaven and is above all others. Everyone who comes from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks about earthly things. The one who comes from heaven is above all others.

dag: Ibram ni daa ti paai yuun kɔbigayinika saha shɛli, ka Yawɛ daa ka o sanna ti yɛl o, Mani n-nyɛ Naawuni Kpiɔŋlan Naa; doli ma, ka tummi din tuhi.
en: When Abram was years old, the Lord appeared to him. He said, I am God All-Powerful. Obey me and live the right way.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun nyo naɣisaa maa buɣim maa, o paɣim o binyɛra ka su kom; o gba ni leei ŋun bi be nyam hal ni zaawuni.
en: The one who burned the cow will wash his clothes in water and bathe his body in water, but he will be unclean until evening.

dag: ka yɛri ba, Di sabiya, Man Naawuni duu nyɛla wunsuhigu duu. Amaa yinim zaŋ li leela ŋmɛnditoya duu! .
en: He told them, The Scriptures say, My house should be a place of worship. But you have made it a place where robbers hide.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ na so ŋun ʒi Dauda nam ʒiishee la polo mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa be tiŋ puuni ka nyɛ yi dɔɣiriba shɛb bɛ ni daa bi gbahi pahi yi zuɣu chaŋ la polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: But this is what the Lord says about your relatives who were not carried away to Babylon. I am talking about the king who is sitting on Davids throne now and all the other people who are still in the city of Jerusalem.

dag: N kul bela filiŋ ni dabisili kam; ka vi kul mali ma;.
en: All I can think about is my shame. Just look at my face, and you will see it.

dag: Ka Dauda suhu daa ti lu yiŋ ni ka o yɛli, N di bi zaɣisi ka so chaŋ Bɛtilihɛm ti tooi kɔbil shɛli din do di dunol shee la ni kom na ti ti ma ka n nyu.
en: David was thirsty for some water from his hometown, so he said, Oh, if only I could have some water from that well by the gate in Bethlehem.

dag: Ka Pool daa boli sapashinnim ni yino na ti yɛl o, Zaŋm nachimbil ŋɔ tahi sapashin kpɛm sani; o malila yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni o yɛl o.
en: Then Paul called one of the army officers and said to him, Take this young man to the commander. He has a message for him.

dag: Dama saha shɛli kanna ka tiŋguliba ni ti be Ifriim zoya zuɣu ka kuhi bahina, Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ sani Ziɔn. .
en: Yes, the time is coming when sentries will call out on the hills of Ephraim, Let's go up to Zion, to the Lord our God.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli Ibrahimma, Zaŋ chaŋ a paɣ Zarai mi polo, di lan bol o Zarai, amaa pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana bolim o la Zara.
en: God said to Abraham, You must no longer call your wife Sarai; from now on her name is Sarah.

dag: Chɛ ka n doli a yɛlimaŋli la, ka a wuhi ma, dama nyini n-nyɛ n tiliginsim Naawuni. Nyin ka n niŋ naani dabisili puuni zaa.
en: Teach me to live according to your truth, for you are my God, who saves me. I always trust in you.

dag: M mabihi, m bɔri ni n zaŋla ninsala yɛla buɣisi yɛlli ŋɔ: Ninsalinim yi laɣim lo alikauli ka zani di nyaaŋa, so ku tooi saɣim li bee m-pahi shɛli di zuɣu.
en: Brothers and sisters, let me give you an example from everyday life: Think about an agreement that one person makes with another. After that agreement is made official, no one can stop it or add anything to it, and no one can ignore it.

dag: Di daa zɔri dolila tiŋ maa puuni solɔɣu sunsuuni, ka bɛ ni booni ti shɛli nyɛvili tia la sa n-doli mɔɣili maa yaɣa ayi zaa, ka wala balibu pinaayi be di zuɣu, ka di wandi goli kam, ka di vari mi nyɛ din tibiri zuliya kam.
en: through the middle of the citys main street. On each side of the river is the tree of life, which produces twelve crops of fruit, bearing its fruit each month. The trees leaves are for the healing of the nations.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb beni n-yɛri noli tiri bɛ banima, ka bi paɣiri bɛ manima.
en: There are those who curse their father and dont bless their mother.

dag: Yidaannima, yumiya yi paɣiba, ka di yihiriya ba hal biɛɣu.
en: Husbands, love your wives, and be gentle to them.

dag: Ka niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu yi be situra ni, di yi nyɛla ago ni bee bimpiɛlli ni.
en: When there is mildew on clothing, whether wool or linen.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Yi tɛhiya ni n tahila puli niŋbu na ka ku tahi di dɔɣibu na?.
en: In the same way, I will not cause pain without allowing something new to be born. The Lord says this: I promise that if I cause you the pain of birth, I will not stop you from having your new nation. Your God said this.

dag: Tiŋ maa gooni maa daa me n-tamla di gbinni kuɣa pinaayi zuɣu, ka Piɛbil la tuumba pinaayi la yuya sab pa kuɣa pinaayi maa zuɣu.
en: The city was built on twelve foundation stones. On each of the stones was written the name of one of the Lamb's twelve apostles.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti mali sara maligu shɛli ti Duuma zaligu ni daa wuhi la; di daa nyɛla ŋmanʒiɛh ayi bee yiŋ ŋmambih ayi.
en: The Law of the Lord also says parents have to offer a sacrifice, giving at least a pair of doves or two young pigeons. So that is what Mary and Joseph did.

dag: So be yi ni n-nyari wahala? O suhimi Naawuni. So be yi ni m-mali suhupiɛlli? O yilimi yila paɣi Naawuni.
en: If you are having trouble, you should pray. And if you are feeling good, you should sing praises.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ ya tahi n ni daa po pɔri ni n zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu la ni. N ni ti zaŋ li tin ya ka di leei yi ni su shɛli. Dama mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will bring you into the land that I solemnly promised to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and it will be yours. I am the Lord .

dag: Bɛ yi ti sibigi li sa, di ni baai? Wulimpuhili polo pɔhim yi ti ʒe li, di ku kuui zaa, di ku kuui bɛ ni daa biri li luɣ shɛli maa? .
en: Yes, it is planted, but will it live and grow? Won't it wither when the east wind strikes it? Won't it wither there where it is growing.

dag: Tim Yawɛ jilima a ni mali shɛlikam ni, ka zaŋ a puu bindir daŋda zaa gba ti o jilima.
en: Honor the Lord by making him an offering from the best of all that your land produces.

dag: Yi yi wum zaligunim ŋɔ ka dol li viɛnyɛliŋga, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni gbib o ni daa po pɔri lo yi yaannim alikauli shɛli zaŋ chaŋ yi sani la.
en: If you completely obey these laws, the Lord your God will be loyal and keep the agreement he made with you, just as he promised our ancestors.

dag: Ka Musa daa deei tiliginsim liɣiri maa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kalinli daa pani, ka nyɛ Lɛvinim ni yɛn tiligi shɛb maa sani.
en: Moses collected the silver from the extra first-born men and boys.

dag: Tinima n-nyɛ o ni boli ninvuɣ shɛba, ka di pala Yɛhudianim kɔŋko, amaa bɛn pa Yɛhudianim gba.
en: We are those people, the ones God chose not only from the Jews but also from those who are not Jews.

dag: N daa niŋ ninvuɣ titali gari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa pun daŋ n tooni di Jɛrusalɛm, ka daa lan mali yɛm pam.
en: I became very rich and famous. I was greater than anyone who lived in Jerusalem before me. My wisdom was always there to help me.

dag: Dinzuɣu wummiya n ni lo nia shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Ɛdomnim polo mini n ni yɛn niŋ Tɛmannim shɛm. Biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ ni dari bɛ bihi chaŋ, ka bɛ yɛla gbahi bɛ niriba dabiɛm.
en: Therefore, listen to the counsel that the LORD has for Edom and the plans hes devised against the people of Teman: The little ones of the flock will be dragged off, as their pasture watches in utter disbelief.

dag: Ninsalinim wurindi chɛribo kuɣa, ka lɛbiri zoya sɔŋda.
en: Miners dig the hardest rocks. They dig away at the mountains and make them bare.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa zaŋla bɛmaŋ bali niriba maa ni n-niŋdi bɛ ni niŋdi shɛm.
en: but they intermarried with them and adopted their pagan ways.

dag: Yawɛ n-teeg o nuu tiri teeku maa, ka chɛ ka dabiɛm gbaai di nanima, ka zali ni bɛ saɣimmi Keenan birininima.
en: The Lord raised his arm over the sea to make the kingdoms angry enough to fight against Tyre. He commanded Canaan to destroy her place of safety.

dag: Ka n daa chaŋ bɛn ʒe nimaani maa yino sani nti yɛl o ni o wuhim ma yɛla maa zaa gbinni. Ka o daa wuhi ma di gbinni.
en: So I went to one of the servants who was standing ready nearby. I asked him for the truth about all this. He spoke to me and explained to me the meaning of these things.

dag: Yi daa lari Izraɛlnima, hal yi ni daa kul bi gbahi ba tayiɣisi ni maa zaa yoli, yi daa yi tɔɣisiri bɛ yɛla yi viinila yi zuɣuri.
en: Moab, you made fun of Israel. Israel was caught by a gang of thieves. Every time you spoke about Israel, you shook your head and acted as if you were better than Israel.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, Shihira ni ti be wuntaŋ mini goli ni saŋmarisi ni; ka wahala ni ti be dunia ni hal ka zuliya kam ti birim teeku kɔgbana vubu zuɣu;.
en: There will be strange things happening to the sun, the moon, and the stars. On earth whole countries will be in despair, afraid of the roar of the sea and the raging tides.

dag: Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba, Bundaan so n-daa mali tumtumdi kpɛma, ka bɛ ti nyih o ni o tumtumdi kpɛm maa bahir o buni maa yoli.
en: Jesus said to his followers, Once there was a rich man. He hired a manager to take care of his business. Later, he learned that his manager was cheating him.

dag: O yi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, kom din be sagbana ni damdimi. Ŋuna n-chɛ ka paɣili kpɛri dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam. Ŋuna n-chɛ ka saa nyaɣisira, ka chɛ ka pɔhim yiri o ni zaŋ li niŋ luɣ shɛli na.
en: God causes the loud thunder, and he causes great floods of water to fall from the sky. He makes clouds rise in the sky every place on earth. He sends lightning with the rain. He brings out the wind from his storehouses.

dag: Dama di luhiya ti mini Naawuni Shia Kasi sani ni ti di ʒili ya ʒi tibisa n-naɣ pahila yɛl shɛŋa din simdi niŋbu ŋɔ.
en: We agree with the Holy Spirit that you should have no more burdens, except for these necessary things:.

dag: Daba anii dali ka Musa daa boli Aduna min o bidibisi maa ni Izraɛl kpamba na.
en: The day after the ordination rites were completed, Moses called Aaron and his sons and the leaders of Israel.

dag: N di yuya ni Naawuni saɣi ku ma. O wɔɣisim o nuu ka chɛ ka n lu.
en: that God be willing to crush me, release his hand and cut me off.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa zaŋ bɛ ni daa pii kuɣ pinaayi shɛŋa Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni la na n-sɔŋ Giligal maa.
en: The men who had carried the twelve rocks from the Jordan brought them to Joshua, and they made them into a monument.

dag: Yawɛ, a chɛ ka ti kuhimi kaman paɣa ni wolisiri ni o dɔɣi ka kuhiri biɛrim zuɣu shɛm la.
en: Lord , because of you we were in pain, like a woman giving birth, who struggles and cries out when it is time.

dag: Kulla dindali maa ka bɛ daa yɛli naa bɛ ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb Susa puuni kalinli.
en: That same day, a report concerning the number killed in the fortified part of Susa reached the king.

dag: Ka Yisa daa tahi alizin biɛɣu maa zuɣu yɛli, Fom a noli ka wara! Ka alizin biɛɣu maa daa luhi doo maa bɛ sunsuuni, ka chaŋ ka chɛ o, ka bi ti o daŋa.
en: Jesus ordered the spirit, Be quiet and come out of the man! The demon threw the man down in front of them and went out of him without doing him any harm.

dag: Ka o tuma dabisa daa ti naai ka o kul o yiŋa.
en: When he completed the days of his priestly service, he returned home.

dag: Di saha ka o tɔɣis o daanabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Bɛɔr bia Balaam daanabitali yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ, Ninvuɣ so ŋun nyari viɛnyɛliŋga daanabitali yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ.
en: He raised his voice and made his address: The oracle of Balaam, Beors son, the oracle of a man whose eye is open.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa ka o sanna siɣimsiɣim buyi nti yɛl o ni o miri ka o jɛm buɣa la zaa yoli; Sulemaana daa zaɣisi Yawɛ noli ka ŋmaligi ka chɛ o jɛmbu. Ka Yawɛ daa je suli niŋ Sulemaana.
en: So Solomon did not remain faithful to the Lord , the God of Israel, even though God had appeared to him twice. The Lord became angry with him.

dag: Bɛ ni daa dɔɣi Yisa Masia shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Saha shɛli bɛ ni daa zaŋ o ma Mariama ti Yisifu ka na bi kulis o la, ka bɛ ti nya o ka o malila pua Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni.
en: This is how Jesus Christ was born. A young woman named Mary was engaged to Joseph from King David's family. But before they were married, she learned that she was going to have a baby by God's Holy Spirit.

dag: O ni daa yɛl lala maa, ka ŋmaligi lih o nyaaŋa n-nya Yisa ka o ʒiɛya, amaa ka o lee bi baŋ ni Yisa m-bala.
en: As soon as Mary said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing there. But she did not know who he was.

dag: Naawuni pala kpiimba Naawuni, amaa o nyɛla nyɛviyanim Naawuni. Yi shiri chirimya pam.
en: He isnt the God of the dead but of the living. You are seriously mistaken.

dag: Hal bɛ yi dɔɣi bihi gba, n ni ku bɛ zaa. N yi zo ka chɛ ba, bɛ ni nya mbusim.
en: Though they bring up children, I will make them childless until no one is left. Doom to them indeed when I leave them!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti nya azichi mini mɔ viɛla. Ka tiŋgbani maa lan galisi ka vuri kani ka suhudoo beni, dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa yi be nimaani daa nyɛla Hamnima.
en: They found good fields with plenty of grass. They found plenty of good land there. The land was peaceful and quiet. Hams descendants lived there in the past.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Ayuba daa ti yaag o noli n-tu bɛ ni daa dɔɣ o dabisi shɛli dali.
en: Afterward, Job spoke up and cursed the day he was born.

dag: Paɣ yi zaŋ omaŋ ti biŋkɔbigu kam ka o gol o, bɛn kum paɣa maa mini biŋkɔbigu maa, kumiya ba, ka bɛ ʒim yihibu taali ʒi bɛ zuɣu.
en: If a woman has sexual relations with an animal, you must kill the woman and the animal. They must be put to death. They are responsible for their own death.

dag: Di nyɛla yaɣ kɔŋkɔba, amaa ka nyɛ niŋgbun yini.
en: It takes many parts to make a single body.

dag: Ka Ilaija yɛl o, A ni suhi shɛli maa yɛla kpɛma, di zaa yoli, bɛ yi ti kpuɣ ma a sani chani ka a nya ma, a ni nya a ni bɔri shɛli maa, amaa a yi ti bi nya ma, a ku nya li.
en: It won't be easy, Elijah answered. It can happen only if you see me as I am being taken away.

dag: Ka a mini Rɔdinim daa laɣindi niŋdi daabiligu, teeku duli tinsi pam daa nyɛla a da gahinda, ka bɛ zaŋdi wɔbinyina mini lanjiŋ dari yɔr a nɛma zuɣu.
en: You also did business with people from Rhodes, and people from nations along the coast gave you ivory and ebony in exchange for your goods.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yihi li suɣili maa ni n-zaŋ li na ti ti Jɔshua mini Izraɛlnim zaa, ka bɛ daa zaŋ li sɔŋ Yawɛ tooni.
en: They took the things from inside the tent. They brought them to Joshua and to all the Israelites and emptied them out before the LORD.

dag: Biliɛɣu ku lan kpi nimaani bee ka ninkurigu ti kpi ka o saha na bi paai; dama nir yi ti niŋ yuun kɔbiga ka kpi, bɛ ni yɛli ni o nyɛla bipolli, ka so mi yi bi paai yuun kɔbiga ka kpi, bɛ ni yɛli ni noli n-di o.
en: In that city there will never be a baby who lives only a few days, and every older person will live for a long, long time. A person who lives years will be called young. And whoever doesnt live that long will be considered cursed.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ zuliya bahila yoli zaŋ Hɛshibɔn hal ni Dibɔn, ka ti ŋmani saɣiri doya hal ka buɣim ti di m-paai Mɛdɛba.
en: We completely defeated Moab. The towns of Heshbon and Dibon, of Nophah and Medeba are ruined and gone.

dag: Ka Dauda daa ku Sirianim maa chɛchɛbunduhiriba tusaayopɔin mini tɔbbihi bɛn chani tiŋa tuhi pihinahi. Ka o daa lan ku Shɔbak ŋun daa nyɛ bɛ Kamɔna kpɛm maa, ka Sirianim maa daa ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ Izraɛlnima.
en: and the Israelites drove the Syrian army back. David and his men killed seven thousand Syrian chariot drivers and forty thousand foot soldiers. They also killed the Syrian commander, Shobach.

dag: Bɛ daa tɛhiya ni o bela bɛ sochandi tab sani, ka daa chaŋ dabisi muni chandi zaa ka naanyi ti gbaag o bɔbu bɛ dɔɣiriba mini bɛ nimmiriba sani.
en: They thought he was traveling with some other people, and they went a whole day before they started looking for him.

dag: Ka di mi bi simdi ni ti Duuma tumtumda ŋmɛri naŋgbankpeeni. Di naɣ simdi ni o nyɛla ŋun mali nirilim zaŋ chaŋ sokam sani, ka nyɛ karimba suŋ ni ŋun mali suɣilo.
en: Gods slave shouldnt be argumentative but should be kind toward all people, able to teach, patient.

dag: Hal pumpɔŋɔ n shɛhiralana bela alizanda ni, ka ŋun ʒe n nyaaŋa nyɛla ŋun be zuɣusaa.
en: Even now there is someone in heaven who will speak for me. There is someone above who will testify for me.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Gidiɔn, A niriba maa galisiya pam ni n zaŋ Midiannim niŋ bɛ nuu ni. Di yi niŋ lala Izraɛlnim ni nyu bara niŋ ma ka yɛli, Tinima n-tuhi fa timaŋa.
en: The Lord said to Gideon, The men you have are too many for me to give them victory over the Midianites. They might think that they had won by themselves, and so give me no credit.

dag: O chɛ ka sɔŋsim yi o jɛmbu duu mini Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu na ti sɔŋ a.
en: May he send you help from his Temple and give you aid from Mount Zion.

dag: Dinzuɣu zuɣusaa duri maa daa nyɛla zaɣ muɣilinsi, dama folinsi maa daa di palo pam zuɣusaa n-gari sunsuuni mini tiŋ duri la.
en: The upper chambers were smaller, because the promenades took up more space from them than from the first and second stories.

dag: Ka niriba pam daa niŋ o yɛda nimaani.
en: A lot of those people also put their faith in Jesus.

dag: Ti mabihi, di gbarigiya tuun suma tumbu ni.
en: Dear friends, you must never become tired of doing right.

dag: Tiŋ maa ni ti mali pal yaɣu. Nuzaa polo, di ni ti nyɛla mita kɔbiga ni pisinaanu, ka nudirigu polo nyɛ mita kɔbiga ni pisinaanu, ka wulimpuhili polo nyɛ mita kɔbiga ni pisinaanu, ka wulinluhili polo gba nyɛ mita kɔbiga ni pisinaanu.
en: The city will have grasslands. These grasslands will be cubits on the north and cubits on the south. They will be cubits on the east and cubits on the west.

dag: Zaŋmiya Alikauli Adaka la zali di puuni, ka zaŋ pateesa yili limsi li.
en: Put the Box of the Agreement in the Holy Tent. Cover the Box with the curtain.

dag: Dama niriba ayi bee ata yi laɣim luɣ shɛli n yuli zuɣu, n ni be bɛ sani.
en: For where two or three come together in my name, I am there with them.

dag: Ka o nina maa dii neei, ka o doli Yisa chani ka paɣiri Naawuni. Salo maa zaa ni daa nya lala maa, ka bɛ gba daa gbaai Naawuni paɣibu.
en: Then the man was able to see. He followed Jesus, thanking God. Everyone who saw this praised God for what happened.

dag: Dama o pala ninsala kaman n ni nyɛ ninsal shɛm ŋɔ, ka n ni tooi garigi yɛl o shɛli, bee ka m min o ni ti chaŋ ʒiishee.
en: If God were human, I could answer him; we could go to court to decide our quarrel.

dag: yɛra, Sabimi a ni yɛn nya shɛli maa niŋ litaafi ni n-zaŋ tim ti ti cheechinima ayopɔin la. Di tinsi n-nyɛ: Ɛfɛsus mini Smɛɛna ni Pɛɛgamum ni Taiatira ni Saadis ni Filadɛlfia ni Laodisia.
en: It said, Write down what you see, and send the book to the churches in these seven cities: Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.

dag: A ni tooi kali bɛ ni dandi bɛ baɣa chɛra shɛm tariga? Ka a mi bɛ dɔɣibu saha?.
en: Do you know how many months they must carry their babies? Do you know when it is the right time for them to be born?.

dag: Sɔɣim ma ka chɛ ninvuɣ biɛri ni lɔri nia biɛ shɛŋa ashilɔni zaŋ chaŋ m polo la, ka sɔɣi ma ka chɛ tuumbiɛtumdiba ni lɔri yɛmbimbiɛri nia biɛ shɛŋa la.
en: Hide me from the secret plots of wicked people; hide me from the schemes of evildoers.

dag: M puhiri Yuribanus ŋun nyɛ ti tumtumdikpee Masia ni la mini Stachis n ni yuri so la.
en: Greetings also to Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ's service, and to Stachys, my dear friend.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli, N dan naa, n tumtumda n-daa yɔhim ma, man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ daa yɛl o mi, Pam m buŋ ŋɔ gali ti ma ka m ba n-doli naa chaŋ, dama a mi ni mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ nyɛla wɔbiga.
en: He answered, As you know, Your Majesty, I am crippled. I told my servant to saddle my donkey so that I could ride along with you, but he betrayed me.

dag: Yawɛ, bɔ saha ka n lee ni kuhi ni a sɔŋ ma, ka a ku wum? Bee ka n ni kuhi yɛl a Damli damiya! ka a ku tiligi ti?.
en: Lord , I continue to ask for help. When will you listen to me? I cried to you about the violence, but you did nothing!.

dag: Yɛlim o ni o maam o ni ka mali shili gu, ka di zɔri dabiɛm. O mi di chɛ ka o suhu zɔhiri Rɛzin mini Rɛmalia bia Aram bɛn suhu yiɣisi pam ka nyɛ bɛn ŋmani buɣim datɛhi ayi la zuɣu.
en: Tell him to keep alert, to stay calm, and not to be frightened or disturbed. The anger of King Rezin and his Syrians and of King Pekah is no more dangerous than the smoke from two smoldering sticks of wood.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa bi baŋ o ni yɛli shɛm maa gbinni, dama di daa nyɛla yɛlisɔɣirili bɛ sani ni bɛ di baŋ li, ka bɛ mi daa zɔr o suhu ni bɛ bɔh o baŋ.
en: But the disciples did not know what he meant. The meaning was hidden from them. They could not understand it, and they were afraid to ask.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa lan yɛli, Mani ŋun nyɛ taŋkpaɣu ni tampiligim ŋɔ niŋ suhukpeeni tɔɣisiri n Duuma yɛtɔɣa.
en: Then Abraham said, Compared to you, Lord, I am only dust and ashes. But let me bother you again and ask you this question.

dag: Ka n yaannim Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Ibrahimma Naawuni ka nyɛ Yisahaku ni jɛmdi so ŋɔ yi di ka n sani, biɛhiŋ kani, a naan chɛ ka n chaŋ ni nuzaŋa. Naawuni nya n wahala mini n ni tum tuun shɛŋa, ka sa kpah a zuɣu ni yuŋ maa.
en: If the God of my fathers, the God of Abraham and Isaac, had not been with me, you would have already sent me away empty-handed. But God has seen my trouble and the work I have done, and last night he gave his judgment.

dag: Din chɛ ka ti yɛl lala nyɛla ti ni niŋ Naawuni naani Masia zuɣu la.
en: We are sure about all this. Christ makes us sure in the very presence of God.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yɛl o, Aai, n suhir a, a suhu yi shiri maai ni mani, nyin deemi m pini maa, dama n ni nya a ka a deei ma ni suhumahili maa, di ŋmanila n nini nyala Naawuni.
en: Jacob said, No, please, if I have gained your favor, accept my gift. To see your face is for me like seeing the face of God, now that you have been so friendly to me.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ a ka a ni so a taba? Bɔ ka a lee mali ka di pala pini ka Naawuni zaŋ li ti a? Ka a yi daa dee li mi o sani, di chaŋ wula ka a nyuri bara kaman pa pini ka Naawuni daa zaŋ li ti a la?.
en: Who made you superior to others? Didn't God give you everything you have? Well, then, how can you boast, as if what you have were not a gift?.

dag: Di saha maa bɛ ni ti ʒini saria karibu ʒiya n-fa o yiko maa, ka bah o yoli kahikahi.
en: But the court will decide what should happen, and that kings power will be taken away. His kingdom will end completely.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa yɛli ba, M Ba kul tumdimi, ka n gba tumda.
en: Jesus answered them, My Father is always working, and I too must work.

dag: Zuliya kam, wummiya Yawɛ yɛligu, ka mol li gili teeku noli tiŋgbana din be katinsi. Yɛlimiya, Ŋun daa wurim Izraɛlnim kpɛhi yɔɣu la ni lan laɣim ba, o ni gul ba kaman piɛgula ni guli piɛri shɛm la.
en: Listen to me, you nations nearby or across the sea. I scattered the people of Israel, but I will gather them again. I will protect them like a shepherd guarding a flock;.

dag: ka chɛ ka Speen ŋariŋ titaŋa zaa mini ŋariŋ viɛla zaa shim.
en: They might be like great ships from Tarshish, filled with such wonderful cargo, but they will be brought down.

dag: Bɛna n-daa ku ti Duuma Yisa mini anabinima, ka daa niŋ ti gba alaka la. Bɛ kul tumdila din bi tiɣiri Naawuni nini, ka kul guri ninsalinim soli.
en: who killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and persecuted us. How displeasing they are to God! How hostile they are to everyone!.

dag: Yi daa yi niŋdi viɛnyɛliŋga; ka ŋuni n-lee kari ya ni yi di doli yɛlimaŋli maa?.
en: You were doing so well until someone made you turn from the truth.

dag: Yiɣisimiya n-lan gbaai chandi ti kpe Amɔrinim zoya ni mini tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa din baɣi ba ka nyɛ Araba zoya ni tinsi ni ni Shɛfɛla ni Nɛgɛb ni teeku noli ni Keenannim tiŋgbɔŋ ni ni Lɛbanɔn n-zaŋ hal ti paai mɔɣ titali din nyɛ Yufretiiz Mɔɣili la ni.
en: Get going! Enter the hills of the Amorites and the surrounding areas in the desert, the highlands, the lowlands, the arid southern region, and the seacoast—the land of the Canaanites—and the Lebanon range, all the way to the great Euphrates River.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ anzinfa kpila maa bahi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, ka yi n-chaŋ ti yil omaŋ mia.
en: So Judas threw the money into the Temple. Then he went out from there and hanged himself.

dag: Di saha maa kpariba daa chɛla bɛ tuma Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni hal ka nyin Dɛbɔra ti yiɣisi. O daa yiɣisiya m-bemi kaman Izraɛlnim ma la.
en: The towns of Israel stood abandoned, Deborah; they stood empty until you came, came like a mother for Israel.

dag: Naɣilahi pam n-teei gili ma. Bashan naɣilahi bɛn mali kpiɔŋ n-kul teei gili ma.
en: Many bulls surround me; mighty bulls from Bashan encircle me.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔrɔbɔro kpila ala m-be yi sani? Chamiya ti nya. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti lihi ka labina ti yɛl o, Bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu mini zahim ayi ko m-beni.
en: Then Jesus said, How much bread do you have? Go and see! They found out and answered, We have five small loaves of bread and two fish.

dag: ka di nyɛla n daa zɔrila zama dabiɛm zuɣu bee n-zɔri ni niriba ti lihi ʒiɛm ma zuɣu, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka n fo n noli ka bi yi samban ni na.
en: And the fear of public disgrace never forced me to keep silent about what I had done.

dag: ka tumdi timaŋmaŋ nuu zuɣu tuma n-dihiri timaŋa. Niriba yi turi ti, ti niŋdila alibarika niŋdi bɛ ni; ka bɛ yi niŋ ti alaka, ti zaŋdila suɣilo dee li;.
en: We work hard with our own hands. When we are insulted, we respond with a blessing; when we are harassed, we put up with it.

dag: Ti Duuma ŋun daa kahigi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha piligu ni wuhi la n-yɛl lala.
en: known from earliest times.

dag: N lan yɛri ya mi yaha ni ŋunkam guni, di nyɛla talahi ni o doli fukumsi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm zaa.
en: Again, I warn everyone: If you allow yourselves to be circumcised, then you must follow the whole law.

dag: Di saha maa Ɛli daa nyɛla yuun pihiwɛinaanii nira, ka o nina daa fulim ka o bi lan nyara.
en: Eli was now ninety-eight years old and almost completely blind.

dag: Ka bɛ lan garigi yɛli naa yaha, Naa, a yi ni yɛli ti a zahindi maa ni nyɛ shɛm, ti mi ni wuh a di gbinni.
en: Again the wise men said to the king, Please, Sir, tell us about the dream, and we will tell you what it means.

dag: Hal n yi yɛli ni n nya wahala pam, n kul gbibila yɛda.
en: I continued believing even when I said, I am completely ruined.

dag: ka daa boli nachimbil so ŋun daa tumd o tuma na ti yɛl o, Zaŋm paɣ ŋɔ yihi ka kpari dunoli.
en: He called in his servant and said, Throw this woman out and lock the door.

dag: O daa zaɣisi Yisifu zuliya, o daa bi pii Ifriim zuliya.
en: But he rejected the descendants of Joseph; he did not select the tribe of Ephraim.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yi kpi, bɛ nyarila vuhim bɛ kum maa puuni.
en: They will find peace; those who walk in straight paths will find rest on their burial beds.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim kum nyɛla yɛlikpani Yawɛ sani.
en: How painful it is to the Lord when one of his people dies!.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa ti tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ ba niŋ Midiannim nuu ni yuma ayopɔin.
en: Again the Israelites did what the Lord said was wrong. So for seven years the Lord allowed the Midianites to defeat the Israelites.

dag: Yɛlim niriba, Bɛna m-bɔŋɔ! Molimi molo jɛndi Jɛrusalɛmnim yɛli, Bɛn yɛn teei gili ya yi tiŋgban shɛli ni katiŋ kanna. Bɛ tahirila Juda tinsinim zuɣu.
en: They have come to warn the nations and to tell Jerusalem that enemies are coming from a country far away. These enemies will shout against the cities of Judah.

dag: N ŋmanila sana dunia ŋɔ ni; di zaŋ a zaligunim sɔɣi ma.
en: Im an immigrant in the land. Dont hide your commandments from me!.

dag: Lala ka Naawuni daa niŋ darigi Abimilɛk tibili o ni daa tum o ba tuumbiɛ shɛli din nyɛ o ni daa ku omaŋmaŋ ba bidibisi pisopɔin la zuɣu.
en: Thus God paid back Abimelech for the evil he had done to his father by killing his seventy brothers.
