dag: Zaŋ chaŋ Kɛdar zuliya mini Hazɔr nam sulinsi polo, Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa tuhi nyaŋ shɛb la, Yawɛ yɛliya, Yiɣisimiya, lirimiya Kɛdarinima, wurimmiya wulimpuhili zuliya maa.
en: This message is about the tribe of Kedar and the rulers of Hazor. King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon defeated them. This is what the Lord says: Go and attack the tribe of Kedar. Destroy the people of the East.

dag: Ka so yi tum taali zaŋ chaŋ dimbɔŋɔnim shɛli polo, di simdi ni o zani yim zaŋ chaŋ o ni tum taal shɛli maa polo.
en: If you are guilty of any of these things, you must confess whatever you did wrong.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa laɣim yuma ayopɔin maa bindira zaa din daa niŋ pam Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa n-sɔŋ fɔntinsi ni, ka laɣim fɔntiŋ kam ni puri ni bindira n-sɔŋ lala tinsi maa ni.
en: He collected all of the food during the seven years of abundance in the land of Egypt, and stored the food in cities. In each city, he stored the food from the fields surrounding it.

dag: Yawɛ, amaŋmaŋ nini nyaya, di zaŋ li shini! N Duuma, di be katiŋ ka chɛ ma!.
en: But youve seen it too, LORD. Dont keep quiet about it. Please dont be far from me, my Lord.

dag: Di yuuni maa puuni, gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin ni, ka anabi Hanania daa shiri kpi.
en: And Hananiah died in the seventh month of that same year.

dag: Ninvuɣ suma chɛri fali zaani bɛ yaansi, amaa alahichinim buni nyɛla wuntizɔriba ni ti yɛn su shɛli.
en: If you obey God, you will have something to leave your grandchildren. If you don't obey God, those who live right will get what you leave.

dag: Di ku yuui ka n kana; gbib a ni mali shɛli kirikiri ka so ti ku fa a nam zuɣupiligu.
en: I am coming soon. So hold firmly to what you have, and no one will take away the crown you will be given as your reward.

dag: Ka yil yin nim yi ŋmaligi zabira, bɛ yili maa mi wurindimi.
en: And a family that is divided will not survive.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yɛlimiya ninvuɣ so ŋun tim ya n sani maa na.
en: Huldah said to them, This is what the Lord , the God of Israel, says: Tell King Josiah that.

dag: Di saha ka Dan zuliya bɛn daa be nyaaŋa ka nyɛ niriba maa zaa guliba la daa yiɣisi paya. Ammishadai bia Ahiɛza n-daa nyɛ bɛ zaa zuɣulana;.
en: The last three tribes in the line were the rear guard for all the other tribes. These were the groups from Dans camp. They traveled under their flag. The first group was the tribe of Dan. Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai was their commander.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa kpe cheechi niriba zaa pam zaŋ tabili bɛnkam zaa daa wum di yɛla.
en: The church members were afraid, and so was everyone else who heard what had happened.

dag: Ka Izraɛl daa ti yɛli Yisifu, A biɛyanim zaŋ biŋkɔbiri chaŋ Shɛkɛm ni bɛ ti ŋub mɔri. Kamina ka n tim a bɛ sani. Ka o yɛli, To.
en: Jacob said to Joseph, Go to Shechem. Your brothers are there with my sheep. Joseph answered, I will go.

dag: Di chɛliya ka so yɔhim ya baabiɛla, dama di dabisili maa ku kana faashee Naawuni zaɣisibu din bahindi nyaaŋa la ti niŋ, ka Zaliguzaɣisir so Naawuni ni pun lo ni o bah o yol la gba ti yi zahira.
en: Dont let anyone deceive you in any way. That day wont come unless the rebellion comes first and the person who is lawless is revealed, who is headed for destruction.

dag: Chɛ ka ti mini ya kpuɣiri tab bihi niŋdi ti paɣiba. Zaŋmiya yi bipuɣinsi tiri ti, ka kpuɣimi ti gba bipuɣinsi niŋdi yi paɣiba.
en: Let us make an agreement that there will be intermarriage between our people and yours.

dag: N daa na ʒi n-nya ka so kpira ka di nyɛla o ni ka situra zuɣu bee ka nandana ka binshɛli din ni pili.
en: if I ever saw someone dying without clothes, the needy naked.

dag: Di saha ka Ayuba daa garigi yɛli.
en: Then Job answered.

dag: Bɛ ni daa na bi me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la zuɣu, niriba daa maani sara la maligu bimbina zuɣu.
en: A temple had not yet been built for the Lord , and so the people were still offering sacrifices at many different altars.

dag: Ti zaŋ Naa Ahaz ni daa bi lan ʒe Naawuni yim ka kahi neen shɛŋa zaa la labisi nti mali di zaa ka di niŋ kasi. Nyama di ʒe Yawɛ sara maligu bimbini la tooni.
en: And we have brought back all the things that King Ahaz took from the temple during the time he was unfaithful to God. We purified them and put them back in front of the altar.

dag: ni Hazarishual ni Bɛrishiiba ni di tiŋkpansi.
en: in Hazar-shual, in Beer-sheba and its villages.

dag: ka zaŋ o ni daa yihi sapir kɔb shɛli maa nam paɣa n-zaŋ o ti doo maa.
en: The Lord God used the rib from the man to make a woman. Then he brought the woman to the man.

dag: Bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn gbib o daalikauli, ka dol o zaligunima.
en: of those who keep his covenant and remember to keep his commands.

dag: Di ni daa biɛmbe zaŋ chaŋ di yuma ayi bahigu ni ka o dɔro maa daa ti chɛ ka o nyɔri yina, ka o daa nya biɛrim pam hal ti kpi. O ni daa kpi, o niriba daa bi mali buɣim n-ti o jilima kaman bɛ ni daa mali buɣim ti o yaannim jilima shɛm la.
en: About two years later, Jehoram died in terrible pain. No bonfire was built to honor him, even though the people had done this for his ancestors.

dag: Di zaŋya yi niŋgbuna yaɣ shɛli ti alahichi tum tuumbiɛri; amaa zaŋmiya yimaŋ tila Naawuni kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yi kum ni kpe nyɛvili ni, ka zaŋ yi niŋgbuna yaɣili kam ti Naawuni tum wuntia tuma.
en: or let any part of it become a slave of evil. Give yourselves to God, as people who have been raised from death to life. Make every part of your body a slave that pleases God.

dag: ka o daa chaŋ Ishimail zuliya ni ti kpuɣi Ibrahimma bia Ishimail bipuɣiŋga ŋun yuli daa booni Mahalat ka o tizɔdoo nyɛ Nɛbaiɔt la na ti pah o ni daa pun mali paɣ shɛb maa zuɣu.
en: Esau already had two wives, but he went to Abrahams son Ishmael and married another woman, Mahalath, the daughter of Ishmael. Mahalath was Nebaioths sister.

dag: Hiburu paɣ yi lan yɛn dɔɣi ka yi chaŋ ni yi ti deei bia, ka nya ka bia maa nyɛla bidibiga, yin kumiy o, amaa di yi nyɛ bipuɣiŋga, yin chɛliy o.
en: He told them, If a Hebrew woman gives birth to a girl, let the child live. If the baby is a boy, kill him.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla naa, O zaŋla jilima ye. Yawɛ yɛla kparibu, ka zaŋ kpiɔŋ leei shɛlɔrigu lo o shee ni. Ŋuna n-nam dunia ŋɔ zali, ka di kul ku vuui.
en: The LORD rules! He is robed in majesty— the LORD is robed, clothed with strength. Yes, he set the world firmly in place; it wont be shaken.

dag: Ti bemi kaman suhugarigunima, amaa ka lee kul mali suhupiɛlli. Ti bemi kaman faranima, amaa ka lee nyɛ bɛn chɛ ka niriba pam leeri bundaannima. Ti bemi kaman bɛn ka shɛli, amaa ka lee nyɛ bɛn su binshɛɣukam.
en: although saddened, we are always glad; we seem poor, but we make many people rich; we seem to have nothing, yet we really possess everything.

dag: Ninvuɣ yino shɛhira dibu bi saɣi ni bɛ wuhi ni nir mali taali bee galimi zaŋ chaŋ taali shɛlikam tumbu polo naɣila niriba ayi bee niriba ata shɛhira dibu ka yi ni doli n-wuhi ni nir mali taali.
en: A solitary witness against someone in any crime, wrongdoing, or in any sort of misdeed that might be done is not sufficient. The decision must stand by two or three witnesses.

dag: Nyama, m piila Ahisamak bia Oholiab ŋun nyɛ Dan zuliya ni nir la pah o zuɣu, ka lan ti tuumbaŋdiba zaa yiko ni bɛ mali binshɛɣukam zaa n ni zal a ni a mali, dina n-nyɛ:.
en: I have also appointed with him Oholiab, Ahisamachs son from the tribe of Dan. To all who are skillful, I have given the skill to make everything that I have commanded you.

dag: Ka o daa kuhi boli nachimbil so ŋun nyɛ o gbaɣino ʒira yomyom yɛl o, Ŋoom a takɔbi kuhi ku ma, di yi pa lala, niriba ni yɛli ni paɣa n-ku ma. Ka o nachimbil maa daa shiri zaŋ o takɔbi kuh o, ka o kpi.
en: He quickly cried out to the servant who carried his armor, Draw your sword and kill me. Dont let it be said of me, A woman killed him. So his servant stabbed him, and he died.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa niŋ kaman Musa ni suh o shɛm maa; ka daa yihi zɔhi pam maa zaa Firawuna min o kpambaliba ni o niriba sani, ka zaɣ yino gba daa bi kpalim.
en: And the Lord did what Moses asked. He removed the flies from Pharaoh, his officials, and his people. None of the flies remained.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ Naawuni ŋun bi kpiri ŋɔ jilima taɣi ti binnana din ŋmani ninsalinim bɛn kpiri ŋɔ bee noonsi bee biŋkɔbiri bee biŋgbamda.
en: They exchanged the glory of the immortal God for images that look like mortal humans: birds, animals, and reptiles.

dag: Dama Naawuni lihi sokam zaa la yim.
en: God does not have favorites.

dag: N ni ti yihi n jilima palo ni zuliya kam sani, ka zuliya kam ti nya n ni kari saria shɛli ŋɔ mini n ni darigi bɛ tibili shɛm maa.
en: When I glorify myself among the nations, all the nations will understand the judgments that I executed and the power that I used among them.

dag: Naawuni, n suhu kul ʒiɛla yim. N ni yili yila ni kukoli viɛlli. N shia, neema!.
en: Our God, I am faithful to you with all my heart, and you can trust me. I will sing and play music for you with all that I am.

dag: N naan tooi zaŋ n nol ni yɛtɔɣa kpaŋsi yi suhuri, ka n suhumaabo yɛtɔɣa naan ku yi biɛrim maa.
en: I could heap up words, strengthen you with my speech; my trembling lips would be held in check.

dag: Di tuhiya ni a chɛ ka a kɔbilinina yam luɣilikam n-nyɛ kɔzɔrim be solɔri zuɣu?.
en: Should your fountains flood outside, streams of water in the public squares?.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun mali ba pam mali alibarika. O yi ʒe o dimnim tooni saria karibu shee o ku di vi.
en: Happy is the man who has many such arrows. He will never be defeated when he meets his enemies in the place of judgment.

dag: Dinzuɣu di chɛ ka din nyɛ zaɣ suŋ a sani leei niriba ni galindi shɛli.
en: And dont let something you consider to be good be criticized as wrong.

dag: Tikikus ŋun nyɛ ti mabiyurigu ŋun ʒe yim ti Duuma tuma ni la ni ti yɛli ya n yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm zaa.
en: Tychicus is the dear friend, who faithfully works and serves the Lord with us, and he will give you the news about me.

dag: Di sɔɣirimi ni din kɔŋ jilima, ka neeri ni jilima. Di sɔɣirimi ni chɔɣinsi, ka neeri ni yiko.
en: Its degraded when its put into the ground, but its raised in glory. Its weak when its put into the ground, but its raised in power.

dag: Binshɛli bi lan kpalim bɛ yiŋa, ka bɛ zaŋ chilibi yaɣiri bɛ ni be luɣ shɛŋa.
en: Nothing will be left in their tents, which will be sprinkled with burning sulfur.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri kul mihirila bɛ nina ni, amaa wuntizɔriba bɛn kul tɛhirila bɛ soya yɛla.
en: Good people know they are right, but the wicked have to pretend.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa yiɣisi di ka nyu, ka bindirigu maa daa ti o kpiɔŋ wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ biɛɣ pihinahi, ka o chaŋ hal ti paai Sinai Zoli din nyɛ Naawuni zol la zuɣu.
en: So Elijah sat up and ate and drank. The food and water made him strong enough to walk more days. At last, he reached Mount Sinai, the mountain of God.

dag: Ka bɛ shini. Ka Yisa daa chɛ ka doo maa kpaŋ, ka bah o ka o lab kul o yiŋa.
en: But they would not say a thing. Jesus took the man, healed him, and sent him away.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Kpiɔŋlan Naa ŋɔ ni chɛ ka doo maa ti zɔn ya nambɔɣu, ka zaŋ yi mabi ŋun la mini Bɛnjamin n-tin ya ka yi labina. Ka n yi ni kɔŋ m bihi maa, n kul ni kɔŋ ba mi.
en: May Almighty God cause the man to have pity on you, so that he will give Benjamin and your other brother back to you. As for me, if I must lose my children, I must lose them.

dag: Yisa ni daa be dunia ŋɔ ni saha shɛli, o daa suhiri Naawuni yɛr o o ni bɔri shɛli, ka duhir o yee kuhiri ni nintam niŋdi Naawuni ŋun ni tooi tilig o kum ni la. Ka Naawuni daa wum o suhigu maa o ni daa zɔri ŋun Naawuni la zuɣu.
en: While Jesus lived on earth he prayed to God, asking for help from the one who could save him from death. He prayed to God with loud cries and tears. And his prayers were answered because of his great respect for God.

dag: Harim daŋ ni: Ɛliɛza mini Ishija ni Malikija so mi ni Shɛmaya.
en: Eliezer, Isshijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon, Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah from the family of Harim;.

dag: Amaa a yi nya a wuna maa so sani, bɛn kum o. Lihimi n nɛma ŋɔ ni nya, a bini yi be di ni, nyin yihim li ti dɔɣiriba ŋɔ zaa ninni. Yaakubu daa bi mi ni Reechɛl n-zu n-kpuɣi wuna maa.
en: But I did not steal your gods. If you find anyone here with me who has taken your gods, they will be killed. Your men will be my witnesses. You can look for anything that belongs to you. Take anything that is yours.

dag: nyin gbilisim tibili alizanda ni wum ka chɛ a niriba Izraɛlnim maa taali, ka lan zaŋ ba labisi a ni daa zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti bɛ mini bɛ yaannim la ni na.
en: listen from your home in heaven. Forgive them and bring them back to the land you gave their ancestors.

dag: Dinzuɣu miriya ka yi ti tam Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛl la yɛla, ka mali wuni ŋmahindi binshɛŋa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ya ni di nyɛla din chihiri la.
en: You must be careful not to forget the agreement that the Lord your God made with you. You must obey the Lord s command. Dont make any idols in any form.

dag: Omaŋmaŋ yubu puuni ka o daa chɛ di zaa, ka zaŋ omaŋa leei dabili. Ka daa leei daadam m-mali daadam niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu.
en: Instead, he gave up everything, even his place with God. He accepted the role of a servant, appearing in human form. During his life as a man.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ piɛgul suŋ, ka piɛgul suŋ mi zaŋd o nyɛvili taɣir o piɛri dini.
en: I am the good shepherd, and the good shepherd gives his life for the sheep.

dag: Ŋ-ŋɔ ka Naawuni niŋ wuhi ni o yuri ti: O daa tim o Bi gaŋ na ni o ti chɛ ka ti nya nyɛvili o zuɣu.
en: This is how God showed his love to us: He sent his only Son into the world to give us life through him.

dag: O ni balim a pam? O ni tɔɣis a suhumahili yɛtɔɣa?.
en: Will he beg you to let him go? Will he plead with you for mercy?.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka pɔhim kpiɔŋ yi wulinluhili polo na nti ʒe toli maa ti niŋ Teeku Ʒiɛɣu ni, ka zaɣ yino gba daa bi lan kpalim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: And the Lord changed the east wind into a very strong west wind, which picked up the locusts and blew them into the Gulf of Suez. Not one locust was left in all of Egypt.

dag: Di saha ka ti Duuma daa yɛli ma, Zaŋ chaŋ yuun yini saha din nyɛ kaman bɛ ni bu tumtumda so paa tuma yuma tariga saha, Kɛdar jilima ni zan tariga.
en: The Lord told me this would happen. He said, In one year, the way a hired helper counts time, all Kedars glory will be gone.

dag: Di daa nyɛla di daanabinim mini di maligumaaniba bɛn daa ku wuntizɔriba di puuni la daalahichi mini bɛ tuumbiɛri zuɣu.
en: But it happened, because her prophets sinned and her priests were guilty of causing the death of innocent people.

dag: Ka Pita min o tuuntab maa garigi yɛli ba, Di simdi ni ti deela Naawuni noli ka pa ni ninsalinim noli;.
en: Peter and the other apostles answered, We must obey God, not you!.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti baɣa kul be ti ni yɛn niŋ shɛm kpaŋsi tab suhuri ni, ka di chɛ ka ti wuhiri ti yurilim ni nyɛ shɛm ka tumdi tuun suma.
en: And let us consider each other carefully for the purpose of sparking love and good deeds.

dag: n daa nyɛla sana, ka yi bi deei ma kpɛhi yi yinsi; n daa chani gbinfini, ka yi bi ti ma situra; n daa biɛra, ka daa ti lan be sarika ni, ka yi bi kana ti kaai ma.
en: I was a stranger but you would not welcome me in your homes, naked but you would not clothe me; I was sick and in prison but you would not take care of me.

dag: Suhudoo din lɔn ya tabili tab la zuɣu, chɛliya ka yi suhuri ye naŋgban yini malibu shɛli Naawuni Shia Kasi ni tiri ti la zuɣu.
en: Try your best to let God's Spirit keep your hearts united. Do this by living at peace.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni bi wumdi kuhigu din ka buchi; Kpiɔŋlan Naa baɣa ka di ni.
en: God certainly doesnt respond to a deceitful cry; the Almighty doesnt pay attention to it.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Piimiya yi ni na yoli gbahi zahin shɛb maa ni na.
en: Then Jesus said, Bring some of the fish that you caught.

dag: Bɛna n-daa ku ti Duuma Yisa mini anabinima, ka daa niŋ ti gba alaka la. Bɛ kul tumdila din bi tiɣiri Naawuni nini, ka kul guri ninsalinim soli.
en: the same Jews who killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets. And they forced us to leave their country. They are not pleasing to God, and they are against everyone else.

dag: Nadab ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa pun tum tuun shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi ni.
en: Everything else Nadab did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: O filim karimbaannima; ka saɣim bɛ tiŋ din mali yaa; ka daai di goma luhi tiŋa.
en: But he will destroy the proud city and punish those who live there. He will throw that high city down to the ground. It will fall into the dust.

dag: Bɔhimiya Shɛkɛmnim zaa, yi lee yuya ni Gidiɔn bidibisi pisopɔin la zaa n-sun ya bee yi paɣiya ni o bidib yino n-sun ya? Teemiya ni n nyɛla yimaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ ni yi ʒim.
en: and told them to say to the leaders of Shechem, Do you think it would be good to have all of Gideon's sons ruling us? Wouldn't you rather have just one man be king? Abimelech would make a good king, and he's related to us.

dag: M paɣiri Naawuni n ni tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni gari yi zaa la zuɣu.
en: I thank God that my gift of speaking in different kinds of languages is greater than any of yours.

dag: ka bɛ zaŋ Anabi Aizaia litaafi ti o, ka o kpabigi li bo n-nya luɣ shɛli din daa sab yɛli.
en: The synagogue assistant gave him the scroll from the prophet Isaiah. He unrolled the scroll and found the place where it was written.

dag: Alibarika be wuntizɔr ni, amaa duŋtaabo yɛtɔɣa m-be ninvuɣ biɛɣu noli ni.
en: People say good things about those who live right, but the words of the wicked only hide their violent plans.

dag: Yawɛ shiri tum tuun kara ti ti, ka ti suhuri paligi pam.
en: Yes, the LORD has done great things for us, and we are overjoyed.

dag: Ti ni yuri ya la zuɣu ka ti daa lo ni ti pirigi ti ni mali shɛli tin ya, ka di pala Naawuni lahibal suŋ la kɔŋko, amaa zaŋ tabili timaŋmaŋ nyɛviya gba, ka di nyɛla ti ni kul yuri ya pam la zuɣu.
en: We loved you very much, so we were happy to share Gods Good News with you. But not only that—we were also happy to share even our own lives with you.

dag: ka daa zaŋ bindir nyaɣisili maa min o ni mali bɔrɔbɔro shɛli ti o bia Yaakubu.
en: and the delicious food and the bread she had made she put into her sons hands.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ, a yuli galisiya dunia ŋɔ zaa ni!.
en: Lord our Lord, your name is the most wonderful name in all the earth!.

dag: Amaa yi yi na kul yɛra, Ti ku be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka yi zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ noli.
en: But you might say, We will not stay in Judah. If you say that, you will disobey the Lord your God.

dag: Ka bɛ yi ti tum alahichi a sani, dama so kani ŋun bi tumd alahichi, ka a suhu yiɣisi, ka a zaŋ ba niŋ bɛ dimnim nuu ni, ka bɛ gbahi ba daba n-zaŋ ba chaŋ katiŋa bee yoma.
en: When your people sin against you—and there is no one who does not sin—and in your anger you let their enemies defeat them and take them as prisoners to some other land, even if that land is far away.

dag: Ti zali timaŋ zaligu ni ti ni zaŋdi ti tiŋgban ni bindir daŋda mini ti tia kam wala din daŋdi moobu zaa n-tahiri Yawɛ jɛmbu duu na yuuni kam.
en: Each year we will bring to the temple the first part of our harvest of grain and fruit.

dag: Ŋun daa pah ayopɔin n-su chira ayopɔin ni n-daa nyɛ Hɛlɛz ŋun daa nyɛ Pɛlɔn nira ka yi Ifriim zuliya ni na la, ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi ka o daa su.
en: The seventh for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite from Ephraims family. His division numbered .

dag: Di saha maa ka dɔro daa gbaai Hɛzɛkia hal ka o ti miri kpibu. Ka Amɔz bia anabi Aizaia daa ka o sanna ti yɛl o, Yawɛ yɛliya, Malim shili, dama a ku kpaŋ, a ni kpi. .
en: About this time King Hezekiah became sick and almost died. The prophet Isaiah son of Amoz went to see him and said to him, The Lord tells you that you are to put everything in order, because you will not recover. Get ready to die.

dag: n-yɛli ba, Chamiya tiŋkpan shɛli din be yi tooni ŋɔ ha; yi yi ti paai ni, yi ni nya bun so bɛ ni na ʒi m-ba ka o loya ka yi lɔrig o na.
en: He said, Go into the village over there. When you enter it, you will find tied up there a colt that no one has ever ridden. Untie it and bring it here.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun mali yɛm nyɛla ŋun mi yɛla woligibu, yɛtɔɣa viɛla mi kpaŋsiri balima.
en: A wise, mature person is known for his understanding. The more pleasant his words, the more persuasive he is.

dag: Yawɛ nina kul kpala yɛnnima, amaa o daari bɛn bi ʒe yim yɛtɔɣa bahira.
en: The Lord watches over true knowledge, and he opposes those who try to deceive others.

dag: Pa ti zuɣu ka o yɛl lala maa? Ti zuɣu ka di shiri sabi yɛl lala maa, dama ŋun kɔri mini ŋun buri chi zaa malila tahima yini, dina n-nyɛ ni bɛ laɣim di puu maa atam.
en: Didn't he really mean us when he said that? Of course that was written for us. Anyone who plows and anyone who reaps should do their work in the hope of getting a share of the crop.

dag: Bɛn daa po pɔri maa daa gari ninvuɣ pihinahi.
en: More than forty people were involved in the conspiracy.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka a yurilim maŋli ŋɔ kul be ti sani, ti ni mali tahima a san la zuɣu.
en: May your constant love be with us, Lord , as we put our hope in you.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa lan yi Libina n-gari chaŋ Lakishi ti teei gil li n-liri ba.
en: Then Joshua and all the Israelites left Libnah and went to Lachish. Joshua and his army camped around that city and attacked it.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri ye Yawɛ zuɣu ka bɛ guh o ni nya ya palli. Bɛ ni ti mali kpiɔŋ kaman tɔrili kpiŋkpama la. Bɛ ni guui ka di ku gbarigi ba. Bɛ ni chaŋ ka di ku wum ba.
en: But those who trust in the Lord for help will find their strength renewed. They will rise on wings like eagles; they will run and not get weary; they will walk and not grow weak.

dag: Jɔash daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani maligumaana Jɛhɔiada ʒiɛmani maa ni zaa.
en: Joash did right in front of the Lord as long as Jehoiada the priest was living.

dag: Ti mi ni Naawuni fukumsi zaligu nyɛla zaɣ viɛlli, nir yi dol li n-tum di ni wuhi shɛm.
en: We know that the law is good if someone uses it right.

dag: Yi mi ni n tum tuma ni n yaa zaa ti yi ba.
en: You both know that I have worked as hard as I could for your father.

dag: ka din pah anu nyɛ oniɣisi, ka din pah ayɔbu nyɛ kanɛlian, ka din pah ayopɔin nyɛ kirisolait, ka din pah anii nyɛ bɛril, ka din pah awɛi nyɛ tɔpaz, ka din pahi pia nyɛ kirisɔpirɛz, ka din pahi piniyini nyɛ jɛsint ka din pahi pinaayi mi nyɛ amɛtisit.
en: the fifth was onyx, the sixth was carnelian, the seventh was yellow quartz, the eighth was beryl, the ninth was topaz, the tenth was chrysoprase, the eleventh was jacinth, and the twelfth was amethyst.

dag: ni binyaannina ayi la mini di biŋkpam din be binshee ni, ka yihi binsabili yaɣ shɛli din viɛl pahi o ni yɛn yihi yaannin shɛŋa maa zuɣu n-zaŋ li mali sara.
en: the kidneys and the fat on them, and the best part of the liver.

dag: Di saha ka maligumaaniba mini anabinim daa yɛli nabihi mini niriba maa zaa, Doo ŋɔ simdi kubu, dama o tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa n-jɛndi ya ŋɔ ka yi zaa wum li.
en: Then the priests and the prophets said to the leaders and to the people, This man deserves to be sentenced to death because he has spoken against our city. You heard him with your own ears.

dag: O bihi ni yiɣisi paɣ o ka o yidan gba paɣ o yɛli.
en: Her children show their appreciation, and her husband praises her.

dag: Ka yi ti sabi zaligu ŋɔ yɛtɔɣa zaa viɛnyɛliŋga m-pa kuɣa maa zuɣu.
en: Don't forget to write out a copy of these laws on the stone slabs that you are going to set up. Make sure that the writing is easy to read.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Abimilɛk ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn su Shɛkɛm pii la zaa laɣim bela nimaani.
en: It was reported to Abimelech that all the leaders from the Tower of Shechem had gathered in one place.

dag: Ka Bɛnaaya daa chaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni nti yɛli Jɔab, Naa yɛliya ni a yim na. Amaa ka Jɔab daa yɛli, Aai, n ni kpi kpe. Ka Bɛnaaya daa lab naa sani nti yɛl o, Jɔab ni yɛli shɛm, ka garigi shɛm m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Benaiah went into the Lord s Tent and said to Joab, The king says, Come out! But Joab answered, No, I will die here. Benaiah went back to the king and told him what Joab had said.

dag: Amaa ka o daa nya bɛ nandahima maa, ka wum bɛ fabila.
en: But whenever they were in trouble, he listened to their prayers.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ ŋme chɛrubinim kɔtomsi mini abie tihi ni tipuma din yirigi pa di zuɣu, ka dooi salima pa bɛ ni ŋme binshɛŋa kɔtomsi maa zuɣu n-saɣisi taba.
en: The doors were covered with gold and were decorated with carvings of palm trees, flowers, and winged creatures.

dag: Amaa yinim Izraɛl zoya, yi ni teei wula n-wali yi wala ti n niriba Izraɛlnima. Dama di ku yuui, bɛ ni kuna pumpɔŋɔ.
en: But mountains of Israel, you will grow new trees and produce fruit for my people Israel. My people will soon come back.

dag: ka wuntaŋ ti zibigi ka goli mi ti niŋ kaman ʒim la pɔi, ka ti Duuma dabisi titali din mali jilima pam la naanyi kana.
en: The sun will turn dark, and the moon will be as red as blood before the great and wonderful day of the Lord appears.

dag: Nyam kpiɔŋlaannim ni lu tɔb sunsuuni shɛm! Bɛ ku Jɔnatan sɔŋ zoya zuɣu!.
en: Our warriors have fallen in the heat of battle, and Jonathan lies dead on the hills of Gilboa.

dag: So ni yɛli, Binshɛɣukam zaa luhiya n sani. Yɛlimaŋli, amaa pa binshɛɣukam zaa m-mali nir buchi. Binshɛɣukam shiri luhiya, amaa pa binshɛɣukam zaa n-kpaŋsiri nir suhu.
en: All things are allowed, you say. But not all things are good. All things are allowed. But some things dont help anyone.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa laɣim naa sani chu shɛli din daa puhiri chira ayopɔin ni la dali.
en: All the men of Israel met together before King Solomon during the special festival in the seventh month of the year.

dag: Bɛ ni daa mali ti paai Yawɛ duu maa gbini Jɛrusalɛm, bɛ puuni daŋ kam zuɣulaannim shɛb daa tila pina din yi bɛ suhuyubu ni na ni bɛ zaŋ li n-sɔŋ me Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa zali di zaashe kurili ni.
en: When the group arrived at the place in Jerusalem where the Lord s Temple had been, the family leaders gave their gifts for building this house of God again. They wanted to build it in this same place.

dag: saha shɛli bɛ yi ti ŋuni bɛ biɛhigu shee, bee n-do bɛ dooshee n-gu?.
en: when they hide in their caves, or lie in wait in their dens?.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa Masia ba Naawuni ŋun kul simdi paɣibu hal ni saha din ka bahigu ŋɔ mi ni m bi ŋmarila ʒiri.
en: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus—blessed be his name forever!—knows that I am not lying.

dag: Doo yi zaŋ o tizɔpaɣa ŋun nyɛ o ba bipuɣiŋga bee o ma bipuɣiŋga dɔni n-nya o zaɣim, ka paɣa maa gba nya o zaɣim, di nyɛla vi tuuni, ka di simdi ka bɛ yihi ba bɛ niriba ni. O ni zaŋ o tizɔpaɣ dɔni maa zuɣu, di simdi ni bɛ darig o tibili.
en: If you marry one of your sisters, you will be punished, and the two of you will be disgraced by being openly forced out of the community.

dag: Yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ puuni ka alahichi yirina, amaa yɛndana nyɛla ŋun gbaar omaŋa ni yɛtɔɣa pam tɔɣisibu.
en: A person who talks too much gets into trouble. A wise person learns to be quiet.

dag: A ni niŋdi laasabu shɛŋa la zaa yoli, a gbarigiya. Chɛ ka bɛn mi zuɣusaa yɛla tilig a, ka chɛ ka saŋmaribaŋdiba bɛn mi zuɣusaa yɛla yɛl a goli kam puuni binshɛŋa din yɛn niŋ a.
en: You are weary from all your consultations; let the astrologers stand up and save you, those who gaze at the stars, and predict what will happen to you at each new moon.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ poya yɛli ka n wum: Yiya pam ni ti zani dabari, ka so ti ku be yiya din galisi mini yiya din viɛl ni.
en: I heard the Lord All-Powerful make this oath: I swear, all these houses will be destroyed. These big, fancy houses will be empty.

dag: Chɛ ka maligumaaniba ayopɔin gbib piɛla yila kikah ayopɔin m-be Alikauli Adaka la tooni. Ka dabisi shɛli din ti pahir ayopɔin dali, nyin chɛ ka maligumaaniba maa zaŋ kikahi m-piɛbira, ka yi chaŋ gili Jɛriko maa napɔŋ buyopɔin.
en: Take along the sacred chest and tell seven priests to walk in front of it, carrying trumpets. But on the seventh day, march slowly around the town seven times while the priests blow their trumpets.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti buɣisi pal yaɣu puuni luɣ shɛli polo, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ kilomita pinaayi ni pirigili, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ kilomita anu, ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni luɣ kasi zaa kasi shee la ti be di ni.
en: Half of this area, a section miles by miles, is to be measured off; it will contain the Temple, the holiest place of all.

dag: ka bɛ gula maa yi ti nya ka tɔbu kani tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni na, ka o piɛbi kikaa yɛli niriba maa di yɛla.
en: and to sound a warning signal when the enemy is seen coming.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, di lɛb a nyaaŋa biri a ninvuɣ gahindili ŋɔ. Teem a ni daa mali yurilim maŋli shɛli zaŋ chaŋ a dabili Dauda san la yɛla.
en: Always remember the love you had for your servant David, so that you will not reject your chosen kings.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa garigi yɛli, O ʒim yihibu kpalimmi ʒi ti mini ti bihi zuɣu.
en: The whole crowd answered, Let the responsibility for his death fall on us and on our children.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yɛli Sisɛra ni Barak Abinɔam bia la be Tabo Zoli zuɣu.
en: When it was reported to Sisera that Barak, Abinoams son, had marched up to Mount Tabor.

dag: Dama ŋ-ŋɔ n di domi baalim; ŋ-ŋɔ n di gbihiya; di nyaaŋa ka n di vuhi.
en: If I had died then, I would be at rest now.

dag: Zɛrubabɛl mini Nɛhimia saha la, Izraɛlnim zaa daa tirila pina dabisili kam ka bɛ mal li tiri yiliyiiniba mini dunɔguliba. Bɛ daa yihiri Lɛvinim tarili tiri ba, ka Lɛvinim maa mi daa yihiri Aduna daŋ tarili tiri ba.
en: So in the days of Zerubbabel and of Nehemiah, all the Israelites gave every day to support the singers and gatekeepers. The people also set aside the money for the other Levites. And the Levites set aside the money for the descendants of Aaron.

dag: ni putɔɣu ni ninvuɣ kubo ni danyubo ni vuyɔbo yiriŋ ni din ŋmani dimbɔŋɔnima. N kpahiri yi zuɣu ni kaman n ni daa pun kpahi yi zuɣu ni shɛm la: Bɛn niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnima ti ku kpe Naawuni nam ni.
en: being filled with envy, getting drunk, having wild parties, and doing other things like this. I warn you now as I warned you before: The people who do these things will not have a part in Gods kingdom.

dag: Ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa gbaai chandi hal ti paai Bɛtilihɛm. Bɛ ni daa paai maa, di daa garila tiŋ maa nim zaa ka bɛ damna, ka paɣiba ti bɔhira, Naomi m-bala.
en: So both of them went along until they arrived at Bethlehem. When they arrived at Bethlehem, the whole town was excited on account of them, and the women of the town asked, Can this be Naomi.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ʒi luɣ shɛŋa kaman bɛ ni daa ŋmahi tiŋgbani maa tari ba shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Aduna bidibisi bɛn daa nyɛ Kɔhat daŋ niriba la n-daa daŋ tiŋgbani deebu.
en: These are the places they lived by their camps within their territory. To Aarons family from the Kohathite clan, as chosen by lot.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa niŋ kaman Musa ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa n-chaŋ ni o ti tuhi Amalɛknim maa. Ka Musa mini Aduna ni Hur daa chaŋ ti du n-tam daboli maa zuɣu.
en: So Joshua did as Moses told him. He fought with Amalek while Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.

dag: Ka n ni ti chɛ ka n shɛhiranima ayi pil buri, ka n niŋ ba yiko ka bɛ tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa biɛɣ tuhili ni kɔbisiyi ni pihiyɔbu.
en: And I will give power to my two witnesses. And they will prophesy for days. They will be dressed in sackcloth.

dag: Nyini n-yɛn wuhiri binshɛŋa din be kasi mini binshɛŋa din bi be kasi ni binshɛŋa din nyɛ daɣiri mini binshɛŋa din pa daɣiri.
en: so that you can distinguish between the holy and the common, and between the unclean and the clean.

dag: Ka o yi mali luɣ kasi shee maa mini Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni sara maligu bimbini maa ka di be kasi naai, ŋun zaŋm bu nɛɔŋ la na.
en: After you have purified the most holy place, the sacred tent, and the bronze altar, you must bring the live goat to the front of the tent.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa shiri niŋ lala n-chɛ ka zɔhi pam yi n-yɛrigi Firawuna min o kpambaliba yinsi ni Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa. Ka zɔhi maa daa chɛ ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa saɣim.
en: The Lord sent great swarms of flies into the king's palace and the houses of his officials. The whole land of Egypt was brought to ruin by the flies.

dag: Ka Judanim maa daa nya ka tɔb maa be n-gili ba tooni ni nyaaŋa zaa, ka bɛ suhi Yawɛ ka maligumaaniba daa piɛbi bɛ kikahi.
en: When the soldiers in Abijahs army from Judah looked around, they saw Jeroboams army attacking both in front and in back. The men of Judah shouted out to the Lord and the priests blew the trumpets.

dag: N ni chɛ ka bɛn gbarigi tiɣi, ka chɛ ka bɛn tarigi la niŋgbuna maai.
en: I will strengthen the weary and renew those who are weak.

dag: N daa zaŋla nirilim mihi vo ba chaŋ. N daa zaŋla yurilim mihi niŋ ba, ka leei ŋun yihi bin tibisi shɛŋa din ga bɛ noya la, ka silim tiŋa n-dihi ba bindirigu.
en: I led them with ropes, but they were ropes of love. I was like a person who set them free. I bent down and fed them.

dag: Bɛ ni ti va bɛ yiŋ daazichi chaŋ, Naawuni suhuyiɣisili dali ka bɛ ti yɛn va li maa.
en: His house and everything in it will be carried away in the flood of Gods anger.

dag: amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpahiri ninvuɣ biɛri zuɣu ni ni mali suhupiɛlli, ka nya alibarika pam.
en: But if you punish the guilty, things will go well for you, and you will prosper.

dag: Nir yi zaŋ ninvuɣ biɛtali soli bo n-nya buni, di ku niŋ anfaani, amaa wuntitali tiligiri nir kum ni.
en: Wealth you get by dishonesty will do you no good, but honesty can save your life.

dag: Yi ni ti booi kpa shɛli bɛ ni boori bahiri niriba zuɣuri ni la m-bahi Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa mini di puuni nɛma zaa zuɣu, ka malimali di mini di puuni binyɛra zaa, ka di leei din be kasi.
en: Use the sacred olive oil to dedicate to me the tent and everything in it.

dag: N yi zo n-du zuɣusaa, a be nimaani, ka n yi yɛrigi m bindoo sɔŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee, a be nimaani.
en: If I went up to heaven, you would be there; if I lay down in the world of the dead, you would be there.

dag: Bɛ daa sabi maligumaaniba maa yuya dolila bɛ daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm. Ka Lɛvinim mi bɛn daa paai yuun pisi zaŋ chana, bɛ yuya ka bɛ daa sabira kaman bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm ni kaman bɛ ni daa piripiri ba shɛm.
en: They also distributed to those priests registered by their families, and to Levites years of age and older according to their divisional responsibilities.

dag: Suhimiya Naawuni n-tim ti gba ka Naawuni mali soli ti ti ka ti tɔɣisi o yɛligu n-kahigi Masia ashili yɛtɔɣa gbinni ni nyɛ shɛm wuhiri niriba. Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka m be sarika ni ŋɔ.
en: Be sure to pray that God will make a way for us to spread his message and explain the mystery about Christ, even though I am in jail for doing this.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ nambu piligu ni hal ni pɔŋɔ Naawuni biɛhigu shɛli ti nini ni ku tooi nya ka di nyɛ o Naawunitali min o yiko din ka bahigu la dola palɔni, ka ninsalinim nyari li o ni nam binshɛŋa la ni. Dinzuɣu bɛ lan ka soli din ni doli yi taali ni.
en: God's eternal power and character cannot be seen. But from the beginning of creation, God has shown what these are like by all he has made. That's why those people don't have any excuse.

dag: Ka o daa kpuɣi Yawɛ ni daa kari ninvuɣ shɛb tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim ʒini la biɛr yoli n-daa tum tuumbiɛri pam Yawɛ sani.
en: Manasseh disobeyed the Lord by following the disgusting customs of the nations that the Lord had forced out of Israel.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Ijiptinim maa niŋ ba nirilim. Musa daa nyɛla ninvuɣ titali Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni ni Firawuna min o kpamba ni o niriba sani.
en: So the Lord made the Egyptians greatly respect the Israelites, and everyone, including the king's officials, considered Moses an important leader.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ n nyaandoliba ŋɔ, gbibiya ka guliya n wuhibu viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: My message and my teachings are to be sealed and given to my followers.

dag: Amaa zuŋɔ yi zaɣisi yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya azaaba mini muɣisigu ni maa. Ka yɛli, Aai! Bom naa ti ti. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ yi zuliya kam laɣimmi tab gbilligbilli ka Yawɛ sanna.
en: But today youve rejected your God who saved you from all your troubles and difficulties by saying, No! Appoint a king over us! So now assemble yourselves before the LORD by your tribes and clans.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ o niriba kpiɔŋ. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun gul o ni pii na so la, ka tiligir o.
en: The LORD is his peoples strength; he is a fortress of protection for his anointed one.

dag: ninvuɣ biɛtali lɔɣu lɛbigirila bɛ puya ni, ka leei sapaɣ binsom bɛ puya maa ni.
en: But in their stomachs the food turns bitter, as bitter as any poison could be.

dag: Ka do so ŋun yuli daa booni Ananias min o paɣ Safira bɛn daa zaŋ bɛ ni su shɛli kɔhi.
en: But there was a man named Ananias, who with his wife Sapphira sold some property that belonged to them.

dag: mini Ɛburɔn ni Rɛhɔb ni Hamɔn ni Kana m-mali hal ti paai Sidɔn din nyɛ tin tital la.
en: Abdon, Rehob, Hammon, Kanah, and as far north as the city of Sidon.

dag: Yi pala shɛli, ka yi tuma gba pa shɛli. Ŋunkam pii ya tum din chihira.
en: Look! You are nobody, and your deeds are nothing. Whoever chooses you is disgusting.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔhi, Ka Izraɛl daŋ niriba ni banima n-lee bi ka Mizipa na Naawuni san la? Ka bɛ yɛli, Jabɛshi din be Giliad la nima m-bi ka laɣiŋgu maa ni na maa.
en: So they asked, Is there anyone from the tribes of Israel who didnt march up before the LORD at Mizpah? There was! No one from Jabesh-gilead had come to the assembly at the camp.

dag: Hɛbɛr n-daa nyɛ Jafilɛt mini Shoma ni Hɔtam ni bɛ tizɔpaɣ Shua ba.
en: Heber was the father of three sons, Japhlet, Shomer, and Hotham, and one daughter, Shua.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba ni daa ti yiri Jɛriko ka salo pam dol o.
en: As Jesus and his disciples were going out of Jericho a large crowd followed him.

dag: Ka Abinɛr ti lan yɛl o, Ŋmaligim ka chɛ ma dolibu; bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɛn chɛ ka n ku a? N yi ku a wula ka n lee yɛn niŋ lih a biɛli Jɔab ninni.
en: Abner said, If you don't turn back, I'll have to kill you! Then I could never face your brother Joab again.

dag: Ka paɣiba maa kpe di puuni nti bi nya ti Duuma Yisa niŋgbuŋ;.
en: so they went in; but they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus.

dag: Ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ ni tɛhi shɛm ka yɛl lala maa ka ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Yinim bɛn yɛda bi yaɣi lala ŋɔ, bɔ n-niŋ ka yi niŋdi tab saawara yi ni ka bɔrɔbɔro maa zuɣu?.
en: Jesus knew that they were talking about this. So he asked them, Why are you talking about not having bread? Your faith is small.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Do so daa yi Jɛrusalɛm chani Jɛriko nti sirigiri zolɔŋni ka ŋmɛnditoya lir o soli maa ni m-pirig o, ka bu o hal ka o ti tarigi, ka bɛ fa o nɛma zo ka chɛ o.
en: To answer this question, Jesus said, A man was going down the road from Jerusalem to Jericho. Some robbers surrounded him, tore off his clothes, and beat him. Then they left him lying there on the ground almost dead.

dag: Naawuni n-daa zaŋ di tɛha niŋ yila pia maa suhuri ni ni bɛ tum ŋun Naawuni ni pun lo shɛm. Lala zuɣu ka o chɛ ka bɛ niŋ naŋgban yini n-zaŋ bɛ yiko zaa ti biŋkɔbigu la hal ni ŋun Naawuni yɛligu ti niŋ pali.
en: because God moved them to carry out his purposes. That is why they will be of one mind and give their royal power to the beast, until Gods words have been accomplished.

dag: Yi suhuri yi ye din tuhi tumbu zuɣu, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi niŋ ya shɛli?.
en: Who will harm you if you are zealous for good?.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba bɛn daa be nimaani daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu.
en: After him, the priests from the surrounding area made repairs.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka salo pam daa ti doli Yisa, ka o ŋmaligi yɛli ba.
en: Once when large crowds of people were going along with Jesus, he turned and said to them.

dag: Ka wula ka yi lee tɛhira? So yi mali piɛri kɔbiga, ka bɛ ni yino ti bɔrigi, o ku chɛ kɔbigayinika la zoya zuɣu bɛ mɔri ŋubbu shee ka gbaai ŋun bɔrigi maa shee bɔbu?.
en: What do you think a man does who has one hundred sheep and one of them gets lost? He will leave the other ninety-nine grazing on the hillside and go and look for the lost sheep.

dag: Yaakubu zuliya, di luhiya ni yi yɛl lala? Yawɛ suɣilo maa naami? O niŋsim m-bala? N yɛtɔɣa bi niŋdi ninvuɣ so ŋun tumdi tuun suma zaɣ viɛlli?.
en: Descendants of Jacob, is it right for you to claim that the Lord did what he did because he was angry? Doesn't he always bless those who do right?.

dag: Ka so daa kana ti yɛli Dauda, Izraɛlnim suhuri lɛbigila Absalom polo.
en: A messenger reported to David, The Israelites are pledging their loyalty to Absalom.

dag: Amaa n ni daa yuuni bɔri zaɣ viɛlli saha shɛli, zaɣ biɛɣu n-daa paai ma; ka n ni daa guhiri neesim saha shɛli, zibisim n-daa ti kana.
en: But when I hoped for good, trouble came instead. When I looked for light, darkness came.

dag: Ka o ni daa yɛli shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu chɛ ka niriba pam niŋ o yɛda.
en: Many who heard Jesus say these things believed in him.

dag: Amɔn yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaayi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuma ayi Jɛrusalɛm. O ma yuli n-daa booni Mɛshulɛmɛt. O daa nyɛla Haruzi ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔtiba nir la bipuɣiŋga.
en: Amon was years old when he began to rule. He ruled two years in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Meshullemeth daughter of Haruz from Jotbah.

dag: Zaŋmiya daba ayɔbu tum tuma, amaa dabisi shɛli din pahir ayopɔin dali, yin vuhimiya. Hal di yi nyɛla kɔbu saha mini puri atam kpuɣibu saha, yin vuhimiya.
en: You have six days in which to do your work, but do not work on the seventh day, not even during plowing time or harvest.

dag: Ka Asa daa ti niŋ ŋun kani, ka bɛ zaŋ sɔɣi pah o yaannim zuɣu o yab Dauda tiŋ la ni. Ka o bia Jɛhɔshafat daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: He died and was buried with his ancestors in Davids City. His son Jehoshaphat succeeded him as king.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, N yɛri ya mi ni ŋunkam mali ni lan nya m-pahi; ka ŋun mi ka ni ti bahi kɔŋ o ni mali biɛla shɛl la.
en: He replied, I say to you that everyone who has will be given more, but from those who have nothing, even what they have will be taken away.

dag: Ka Dauda daa niŋ kaman Naawuni ni zal o shɛm maa n-nyaŋ Filistianim maa Gibiɔn hal ni Gɛza.
en: David obeyed God and he defeated the Philistines. He even chased them all the way from Gibeon to the entrance to Gezer.

dag: Ŋunkam zaa tumdi tuumbiɛri je neesim ka mi ku saɣi chaŋ neesim ni, o tuumbiɛri maa ti yi palo zuɣu.
en: Those who do evil things hate the light and will not come to the light, because they do not want their evil deeds to be shown up.

dag: O daa lan tum alahiziba tuma Ham tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka daa lan tum tuun shɛŋa din mali dabiɛm Teeku Ʒiɛɣu ni.
en: and the fearsome things you did at the Red Sea.

dag: N yi nyɛla tuumbiɛ tumda bee n yi tumla tuun shɛli din simdi kum, m bi bɔri soli ni n yi di ni; bɛ ni fiɣisiri ma shɛli zuɣu ŋɔ zaa yi nyɛla ʒiri, so ku tooi zaŋ ma niŋ bɛ nuu ni. N ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣa maa chaŋ Naa Siiza sani.
en: If Im guilty and have done something that deserves death, then I wont try to avoid death. But if there is nothing to their accusations against me, no one has the authority to hand me over to them. I appeal to Caesar.

dag: Ka bɛ zaɣ yino kam daa kul tuhi chani tooni shia ni bɔri luɣ shɛlikam polo. Bɛ daa kul chanimi ka bi ŋmaligira.
en: Each living being went in the direction it was looking. They went wherever the spirit caused them to go, but they did not turn when they moved.

dag: O yaar o noli yɛra, ka di nyɛligira, ka chɛ ka pɔhim ʒiɛri li, ka di leeri kom zɔra.
en: Then he gives a command, and the ice melts; he sends the wind, and the water flows.

dag: Ka Kɔniilius yɛl o, Daantal la kurig ata saha ka n daa suhiri Naawuni n yili ŋɔ nti nya ka do so ye binyɛr piɛlli ʒe n tooni.
en: Cornelius said, It was about this time three days ago that I was praying in my house at three o'clock in the afternoon. Suddenly a man dressed in shining clothes stood in front of me.

dag: Naa Uzia ni daa kpi yuun shɛli ka n daa nya n Duuma ka o ʒi o nam ʒiishee din du pam ka mali jilima; ka o binyɛrigu pali Naawuni jɛmbu duu zaa.
en: In the year that King Uzziah died, I had a vision of the Lord . He was on his throne high above, and his robe filled the temple.

dag: Paɣ yi wolisiri ni o dɔɣi, o malila suhusaɣiŋgu o biɛrim nyabu saha ni paai zuɣu; amaa o yi ti dɔɣi bia maa naai, o bi lan teer o biɛrim maa yɛla yaha, o ni dɔɣi bia dunia ni maa zuɣu.
en: When a woman gives birth to a baby, she has pain, because her time has come. But when her baby is born, she forgets the pain. She forgets because she is so happy that a child has been born into the world.

dag: N yaannim daa tuhi saɣim fɔntinsi din nyɛ Gɔzan mini Haran ni Rɛzɛf ka daa ku Bɛtidɛn niriba bɛn daa be Tɛlasa, ka bɛ zaa naawuna daa bi tooi tiligi ba.
en: Did the gods of those people save them? No, my ancestors destroyed them all. They destroyed the cities of Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the people of Eden living in Tel Assar.

dag: Kaman anzinfa ni nyɛligiri binshɛli din nyɛligiri binyara puuni shɛm la, lala ka yi ni ti nyɛligi di puuni, ka yi ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-yiɣisi n suhu bahi yi zuɣu maa.
en: They will be melted in Jerusalem the way silver is melted in a furnace, and then they will know that they are feeling the anger of the Lord .

dag: Amaa Izraɛlnim bɛn ku wum a yɛligu, dama bɛ bi bɔri ni bɛ wum n yɛligu maa; Izraɛlnim zaa ni nyɛ bɛn suhuri kpɛma mini tipawumlinim zuɣu.
en: No, I am sending you to the family of Israel. Only, these people have hard heads—they are very stubborn! And the people of Israel will refuse to listen to you. They dont want to listen to me.

dag: Dama zaligu maa nyɛla firila, ka wuhibu maa mi nyɛ neesim, ka zuɣu ni kpahibu din wuhiri biɛrisuŋ la mi nyɛ nyɛvili.
en: The Law of the Lord is a lamp, and its teachings shine brightly. Correction and self-control will lead you through life.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka a yɛla gari niriba. Ka a yɛla ti gbaai bɛ nanim dabiɛm pam, ka bɛ niŋgbuna sɔhira. N yi ti ŋooi n takɔbi bɛ tooni, bɛ ninvuɣ yino kam niŋgbuna kul yɛn sɔhirimi sahakam bɛ nyɛviya zuɣu a lubu maa dali. .
en: I will make many peoples appalled because of you. Their kings will shudder violently on your account when I brandish my sword before them. They will tremble for their lives again and again on the day of your downfall.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli n suhu ni, M bo n-nya yɛm pam gari na shɛb bɛn pun daŋ n tooni ʒini Jɛrusalɛm ŋɔ zaa; ka kpahim baŋ yɛla pam yɛm mini baŋsim puuni.
en: I said to myself, I am very wise. I am wiser than all the kings who ruled Jerusalem before me. I know what wisdom and knowledge really are.

dag: O yɛliya, N niriba, gbilisimiya tibili ka n yɛli ya ka yi wum. Izraɛlnima, n ni di shɛhira jɛndi ya. Mani n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni la.
en: Listen, my people, I will now speak; Israel, I will now testify against you. I am God—your God!.

dag: O ni yɛli, Yi ni ti bɔri ma ka ku nya ma; ka n ni ti yɛn be luɣ shɛli, yi ku tooi ka nimaani na la gbinni lee nyɛla wula?.
en: What does he mean when he says, You will look for me, but you wont find me, and where I am you cant come.

dag: Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zali ya ni yi doli zaligunim ŋɔ mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi, dinzuɣu doliya li viɛnyɛliŋga ni yi suhuri zaa ni yi shihi zaa.
en: Today the Lord your God commands you to obey all these laws and rules. Be careful to follow them with all your heart and soul.

dag: Amaa ka Gɛshurinim mini Sirianim daa fa Havɔtijairi mini Kɛnat ni di tiŋkpansi bɛ sani, di daa nyɛla tinsi pihiyɔbu. Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Makiri ŋun daa nyɛ Giliad ba la bihi.
en: Some time later the nations of Geshur and Aram captured towns in that region, including the villages that belonged to Jair, as well as the town of Kenath and the nearby villages. Everyone from the region of Gilead was a descendant of Machir.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni tilig o niriba, ka zo o daba nambɔɣu, o yi ti nya ka bɛ lan ka yiko, ka bɛ ni lo so bee bɛ ni bi lo so ti ku lan kpalim.
en: The Lord will judge his people. They are his servants, and he will show them mercy. He will see that their power is gone. He will see that they are all helpless— the slaves and free people too.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ daanya mali wahu maa n-zaŋ li tabili da wɔɣinli zuɣusaa; ka wahu daa yi dim so, ka o lihi li, o tiligirimi.
en: So Moses made a bronze snake and put it on a pole. Anyone who had been bitten would look at the bronze snake and be healed.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa daa bɔhi ba, Yi bi baŋ yɛtɔɣ ŋahili ŋɔ gbinni? Ka wula ka yi lee yɛn tooi baŋ yɛtɔɣ ŋahi shɛŋa din kpalim la gbinni?.
en: Dont you understand this parable? Then how will you understand all the parables?.

dag: Ka Musa daa taɣi ʒim maa pirigili niŋ taha ni zali, ka zaŋ di pirigili din kpalim maa kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini maa.
en: Moses put half of the blood from the animals into bowls and sprinkled the rest on the altar.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabiyurisi bɛn nyɛ n suhu ni kul ye shɛb nyabu zuɣu la, yinima n-nyɛ bɛn chɛ ka m mali suhupiɛlli, ka nyuri bara yi zuɣu. M mabiyurisi, bamiya zani viɛnyɛliŋga ti Duuma ni!.
en: So then, my friends, how dear you are to me and how I miss you! How happy you make me, and how proud I am of you!—this, dear friends, is how you should stand firm in your life in the Lord.

dag: Amaa yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni wum n suhigu ka deei n suhigu maa.
en: But God did listen and answered my prayer.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa boli Musa mini Aduna ti yɛli ba, Pumpɔŋɔ n tum taali; Yawɛ mali yɛlimaŋli, m mini n niriba ŋɔ galimya.
en: The king sent for Moses and Aaron and told them, Now I have really sinned! My people and I are guilty, and the Lord is right.

dag: Bɛ ni mɛri yiya shɛŋa maa ŋmanila tɛri, ka ŋmani puguliba suɣa.
en: Evil people might build houses, but they will not last long. They will be like a spiders web or a guards tent.

dag: Musa ni daa ti kul kana ti miri suɣa maa gbini n-nya naɣibila maa, ka nya bɛ ni wari waa maa, ka o suhu yiɣisi pam, ka o daa zaŋ bimparilana din daa be o nuu ni maa bahi zoli maa gbini ka di ŋma.
en: When Moses came close enough to the camp to see the bull-calf and to see the people dancing, he became furious. There at the foot of the mountain, he threw down the tablets he was carrying and broke them.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim maa daa pii maligumaana Ɛliɛza bia Finɛhas m-pahi bɛ daŋ kam ni dɔɣirikpamba pia zuɣu n-tim ba Rubin mini Gaad ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili maa sani Giliad tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: But first they sent a priest, Phinehas the son of Eleazar, to talk with the two and a half tribes.

dag: Di bi simdi ka maligumaana di biŋkɔb so bee noon so ŋun kpi o zuɣu bee biŋkɔbiri ni ku so. .
en: Priests must not eat any bird or animal that dies a natural death or that has been killed by a wild animal.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yolitim zaŋ chaŋ n ni niŋ wahala nya shɛlikam dunia ŋɔ ni maa polo.
en: So I came to regret that I had worked so hard.

dag: Turi maa nyɛla din saɣim n suhu; ka n lan ka tahima. N daa lihi bo nambɔzɔbo, amaa ka bi nya li; ka lihi bo bɛn ni maai n suhu, ka bi nya so.
en: Insults have broken my heart. Im sick about it. I hoped for sympathy, but there wasnt any; I hoped for comforters, but couldnt find any.

dag: Nyama, ka Barak daa ti biɛhiri Sisɛra naba na, ka Jaɛl yi nti tuh o soli ka yɛl o, Kamina, ka n ti wuh a a ni bɔri ninvuɣ so maa. Ka Barak daa kpe o tanti maa ni nti nya ka tanti kpaa n-kpahi Sisɛra tapaɣa ti ba tiŋ ka o kpi n-doya.
en: When Barak came looking for Sisera, Jael went out to meet him and said to him, Come here! I'll show you the man you're looking for. So he went in with her, and there was Sisera on the ground, dead, with the tent peg through his head.

dag: Bɛ zaŋla Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni bɛ ni wuɣi tampiɛl viɛl shɛli niŋ a ŋariŋ tani, ka di nyɛ a tuuta. Ka a zuɣusaa bimparigu din nyɛ zaɣ sabinli mini zaɣ ʒee la yi Ɛlisha teeku duli na.
en: The builders used fancy linen from Egypt for your sails, so everyone could see you. Blue and purple cloth from Cyprus was used to shade your deck.

dag: Wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm: Yiɣisimiya n-zaŋ yi yɛla maa fabili niŋ zoya, ka chɛ ka daboya wum yi kukoya.
en: Now hear what the Lord says: Present your argument to the mountains. Let the hills hear your story.

dag: Di daa paai yuma ata ka Izraɛlnim mini Sirianim bi lan tuhi taba.
en: For the next three years there was peace between Israel and Syria.

dag: ka soli be di tooni. Duri maa daa bemi kaman nuzaa polo duri la. Di wɔɣilim mini di yɛliŋ zaa daa kul nyɛla yim. Ka niriba ni yɛn doli luɣ shɛŋa yira mini di mɛbu ni di dunoya zaa kul nyɛ yim.
en: These rooms were exactly like those on the north side, and they also had a walkway in front of them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa saɣi n-chɛ ka o kpe bɛ ŋariŋ maa ni, ka ŋariŋ maa dii mali ti to bɛ ni daa baari duri yaɣ shɛli polo maa.
en: When he said this, they were glad to take him into the boat. And then the boat reached the shore at the place they wanted to go.

dag: Dama n yi ti zaŋ ba tahi tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam maa ni, n ni daa po pɔri bɛ yaannim sani ni n zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti ba la ni, ka bɛ ti di n-tiɣi ŋmɛlim, bɛ ni yuli ʒiɛm ma, ka saɣim m-mini ba daalikauli maa, ka chaŋ ti jɛm wuna.
en: When I bring the Israelites to the land I swore to their ancestors, which is full of milk and honey, and they eat, get full, then fat, and then turn toward other gods, serving them and disrespecting me and breaking my covenant.

dag: O ni mi bɛ tuma zuɣu, yuŋ ka o ŋmɛri paari ba, ka ŋmɛri kabisiri ba.
en: Thus he regards their deeds, overturns them at night, and they are crushed.

dag: Nuzaa polo dunɔdali maa tooni, dunoli daa beni kpɛri dundɔŋ ni kaman di ni daa be shɛm wulimpuhili polo la. Ka o daa buɣisi dunoli zaŋ ti kpa dunoli, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pihinu.
en: Across the courtyard from the north gate, there was a gate to the inner courtyard. It was like the gate on the east. The man measured from the gate on the inner wall to the gate on the outer wall . It was cubits from gate to gate.

dag: Dina n-ni chɛ ka Izraɛlnim ku lan kpe yɔɣu ka chɛ ma bee n-lan zaŋ bɛ daalahichi ŋɔ zaa ta bɛmaŋ daɣiri. Di saha bɛ ni ti leei n niriba, ka m mi leei bɛ Naawuni. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will do this to keep the Israelites from deserting me and defiling themselves by their sins. They are to be my people, and I will be their God. The Sovereign Lord has spoken.

dag: Di saha ka Reechɛl daa kpuɣi wuna maa n-zaŋ niŋ laakum gal ni n-du n-ʒi di zuɣu. Ka Leeban daa vihi suɣili maa ni zaa bo li ka bi nya li.
en: Now Rachel had taken the divine images and put them into the camels saddlebag and sat on them. Laban felt around in the whole tent but couldnt find them.

dag: O daa lan zali Obɛdɛdom min o mabihi ninvuɣ pisopɔinayika la gba; ka Obɛdɛdom ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛdutun bia la mini Hɔsa mi daa nyɛ dunɔguliba.
en: He also left Obed Edom and other Levites to serve with Asaph and his brothers. Obed Edom and Hosah were guards. Obed Edom was Jeduthuns son.

dag: O daa ku na kara. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He defeated powerful kings. His faithful love will last forever.

dag: Bɛ daa wuh o shihira bɛ sani, ka tum alahiziba tumtumsa Ham tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: They did God's mighty acts and performed miracles in Egypt.

dag: Bɛ daa ku Hamɔr min o bia Shɛkɛm gba, ka zaŋ Daina Shɛkɛm yiŋa n-chaŋ bɛ chandi.
en: including Hamor and Shechem. Then they took Dinah and left.

dag: Amaa ka Baanabas mini Pool bɛn nyɛ Yisa tuumba la daa wum lala ka dari tɔhi bɛ binyɛra, ka zo nti kpe salo maa ni kuhiri yɛra.
en: When Barnabas and Paul heard what they were about to do, they tore their clothes and ran into the middle of the crowd, shouting.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli ma.
en: The word of the Lord came to me. He said.

dag: A nini ti yɛn nya li la, ka di chaŋ; dama yim ka di yɛn bili kpiŋkpama yiɣi kpe zuɣusaa kaman tɔrili la.
en: Your money flies away before you know it, just like an eagle suddenly taking off.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ Yawɛ naani ŋmanila Ziɔn Zoli din ku tooi dam, ka kul ni beni sahakam la.
en: Those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion, which can never be shaken, never be moved.

dag: Bɛ ni ti dihi yɛnnim vi. Bɛ ni ti zaŋ ba chaŋ ka di gari ba. Bɛ ni zaɣisi Yawɛ yɛligu ŋɔ, yɛm bɔ ka bɛ lan mali?.
en: These wise people refused to listen to the Lord s teachings. So they are not really wise at all. These wise people were trapped. They became shocked and ashamed.

dag: Di maliya karimbaani ti yaɣi bee n-tɔɣisiri kapirichi yɛtɔɣa.
en: Dont exalt your strength so highly. Dont speak so arrogantly against the rock.

dag: Naawuni daa lo ti yab Ibrahimma min o zuliya alikauli ni bɛ ni ti su dunia ŋɔ. Di daa pala o ni doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu zuɣu ka Naawuni daa lo o alikauli maa, amaa o ni daa niŋ yɛda ka Naawuni zaŋ o zali wuntia zaani la zuɣu.
en: God promised Abraham and his descendants that he would give them the world. This promise wasn't made because Abraham had obeyed a law, but because his faith in God made him acceptable.

dag: Amaa chɛliya ka binshɛɣukam zaa lee niŋdi dɛde ka doli soli.
en: Everything should be done with dignity and in proper order.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam tumd alahichi nyɛla alahichi dabili.
en: Jesus replied: I tell you for certain that anyone who sins is a slave of sin!.

dag: Kamiyana ti di m bindira ŋɔ, ka nyu n ni zaŋ wain shɛli gabi tab ŋɔ.
en: Come, eat my food and drink the wine that I have mixed.

dag: Nyama, n daa zaŋ o leela shɛhira niriba sani. Ka lan zaŋ o leei niriba toondana ni tɔbbihi zuɣulana.
en: I made him the leader and ruler of the nations; he was my witness to them.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Tahima na be a biɛhigu ni. A bihi maa ni ti labi bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni na.
en: Israel, there is hope for you. This message is from the Lord . Your children will come back to their own land.

dag: A ni yɛn deei pin shɛŋa bɛ sani m-bɔŋɔ: Salima mini anzinfa ni daanya.
en: Here is the list of the things that you should accept from the people: gold, silver, and bronze;.

dag: ka ŋunkam kpuɣi bɛ zaɣ kpiŋ yaɣ shɛlikam, ŋun paɣim o situra, ka nyɛ ŋun be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: If you pick up one of these dead insects, you must wash your clothes. You will be unclean until evening.

dag: Bɛ ni ti saɣim buɣ jɛmbo luɣ shɛŋa din be Avɛn, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim daalahichi la. Ka gɔhi mini suligunyinyaɣu ti bili di maligu bimbina maa zuɣu. Ka bɛ ti yɛli zoya, Limsimiya ti. Ka yɛli daboya, Lumiya ti zuɣu na.
en: The hilltop shrines of Aven, where the people of Israel worship idols, will be destroyed. Thorns and weeds will grow up over their altars. The people will call out to the mountains, Hide us! and to the hills, Cover us.

dag: amaa naɣ zalimiyala yi daazichi alizanda ni; nimaani ka di bi zahinda, ka lɛla ku saɣim li, ka tayiɣisi mi ku kab kpe n-zu li.
en: Instead, save your treasures in heaven, where they cannot be destroyed by moths or rust and where thieves cannot break in and steal them.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, n suhir a, chɛ ka mani a dabili ŋɔ kpalim leegi n dan dabili ka chɛ bia maa, ka a chɛ ka o dol o biɛyanim maa kuli.
en: And now, sir, I will stay here as your slave in place of the boy; let him go back with his brothers.

dag: Yi yab Ibrahimma suhu daa piɛli ni o nya n saha ŋɔ, ka mi daa shiri nya li ka di niŋ o suhupiɛlli.
en: Your father Abraham rejoiced that he was to see the time of my coming; he saw it and was glad.

dag: Di ni daa niŋ shɛm Anabi Nuhu saha la, lala ka di ti yɛn niŋ Daadam Bia gba dabisili dali.
en: When the Son of Man comes again, it will be the same as it was when Noah lived.

dag: Binshɛli din gɔŋ ku tooi lan teei tuhi; ka nir mi ku tooi yɛli binshɛli din kani yɛla.
en: You can't straighten out what is crooked; you can't count things that aren't there.

dag: Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa la min o kpambaliba ni o sapashinnima ni o niriba zaa ni ti nyu li.
en: Pharaoh, Egypts king, his attendants and officials, and all his people.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a tiligira la yɛliya, N suhu n-daa yiɣisi pam saha biɛla puuni, ka n chɛ a bahi. Amaa n yurilim din bi naari la zuɣu, n ni zo a nambɔɣu.
en: I turned away angry for only a moment, but I will show you my love forever. So says the Lord who saves you.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn yɛli ba, To, di pa taali! Amaa Yawɛ yi zaŋ Zɛba mini Zalimuna niŋ n nuu ni, n ni zaŋ ya pa mɔɣu ni gɔhi zuɣu n du n-tam yi zuɣu nɔn ya.
en: Just for that, Gideon said, when the LORD has handed over Zebah and Zalmunna to me, Im going to beat your skin with desert thorns and briars.

dag: Ka Ɛsta daa zaŋ o ni mali yɛtɔɣ shɛli ti o ni o ti yɛli Mɔdɛkai. Ɛsta ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Then Esther told Hathach to say this to Mordecai:.

dag: Yawɛ, wun ŋuni n-lee lan ŋman a? Ŋun nam dariza min o kasitali n-lee ŋman a, ka o yɛla mali dabiɛm ni jilima, ka o tumd alahiziba tuma?.
en: Are there any gods like the Lord ? No, there are no gods like you— you are wonderfully holy! You are amazingly powerful! You do great miracles!.

dag: Dama n niriba maa nyɛla jɛra; bɛ bi mi ma. Bɛ nyɛla bi jɛra, bɛ bi baŋdi binyɛra gbinni. Bɛ mali yɛm din tumdi tuumbiɛri, amaa ka lee bi mi tuun viɛla tumbu.
en: I heard the Lord say, My people ignore me. They are foolish children who do not understand that they will be punished. All they know is how to sin.

dag: Samiya Naawuni biɛhigu shee din nyɛ Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa gol tuuli dahin yini dali.
en: Set up the meeting tent dwelling on the first day of the first month.

dag: Ka bɛ daa silim zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tiŋa ka yɛli, Yaa Naawuni, nyin ŋun su vuhirigu kam zaa nyɛvili ŋɔ, wula ka ninvuɣ yino tum alahichi, ka a suhu yiɣisi bahi niriba ŋɔ zaa zuɣu.
en: They fell on their faces and said, God, the God of all living things. If one person sins, should you become angry with the entire community.

dag: nti ʒini Goshɛn tiŋgban ni miri ma. Zaŋm a bihi min a yaansi ni a biŋkɔbbaligu ni a niɣi ni a ni mali binshɛɣukam zaa na;.
en: You may live in the land of Goshen, so you will be near me, your children, your grandchildren, your flocks, your herds, and everyone with you.

dag: nti yɛl o, Nyama, pumpɔŋɔ a kurigiya, ka a bihi ŋɔ mi bi dol a naba, dinzuɣu bom naa ti ti ka o su ti kaman zuliya kam ni mali nanim shɛm ŋɔ.
en: and said to him, Look, you are getting old and your sons don't follow your example. So then, appoint a king to rule over us, so that we will have a king, as other countries have.

dag: O daa lan yɛli bia maa yaha, Kpaŋmina, niŋmi yomyom, di lan ʒiɛya. Di saha ka Jɔnatan bia maa daa pih o piɛma maa n-zaŋ ka o sanna.
en: Jonathan yelled again to the boy, Quick! Hurry up! Dont just stand there! So Jonathans servant boy gathered up the arrow and came back to his master.

dag: Naa Asa ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ayi saha, ka Nadab Jɛrɔbɔam bia daa leei Izraɛl naa. O daa diya su Izraɛlnim la yuma ayi.
en: In the second year of the reign of King Asa of Judah, King Jeroboam's son Nadab became king of Israel, and he ruled for two years.

dag: Lazarɔs tizɔpaɣ Mariama maa n-nyɛ ŋun daa zaŋ tulaale ʒe ti Duuma Yisa ka zaŋ o zabiri nyɛh o naba la.
en: This was the Mary who anointed the Lord with fragrant oil and wiped his feet with her hair. Her brother Lazarus was ill.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chaŋ tɔto tɔhi ti Yisa nyaandoliba la polo, m bɔri ni yi gba niŋ li kaman n ni daa wuhi cheechinim din be Galɛshia tiŋgbɔŋ ni shɛm la.
en: Concerning the collection of money for Gods people: You should do what I have directed the churches in Galatia to do.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ dama o nyɛla ŋun viɛla, ka o yurilim maŋli bi naara.
en: Give thanks to the Lord , because he is good, and his love is eternal.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi nyaɣa kpe o ni m-ba n-zani kaman tia la. Ka me yimaŋ tam o zuɣu, ka ʒe viɛnyɛliŋga yi yɛda niŋbu puuni kaman bɛ ni daa pun wuhi ya shɛm la. Ka chɛliya ka wumpaɣibo pali yi suhuri hal nti puuri bahira.
en: Keep your roots deep in him, build your lives on him, and become stronger in your faith, as you were taught. And be filled with thanksgiving.

dag: O daa lan mali bidibis anu, bɛna n-daa nyɛ: Hashuba mini Ohɛl ni Bɛrɛkia ni Hasadia ni Jushabihɛsɛd, bɛ daa nyɛla bɛ niriba anu.
en: Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab-hesed—these five also.

dag: N suhu yiɣisiya pam bahi zuliya shɛb bɛn be afua ni la zuɣu. N suhu daa yiɣisila biɛla bahi n niriba maa zuɣu, amaa ka bɛ kpe di ni n-dihi ba wahala biɛri pahi.
en: For a while I was angry at the nations, but now I am furious, because they have made things worse for Jerusalem and are not the least bit concerned.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Ayuba daa ti yaag o noli n-tu bɛ ni daa dɔɣ o dabisi shɛli dali.
en: Finally, Job cursed the day of his birth.

dag: Di lan sabi yaha, Bɛ ni gbib a bɛ nuhi ni, ka a napɔŋ ku tuui kuɣili kam. .
en: and they will take you up in their hands so that you wont hit your foot on a stone. .

dag: N ni ti ŋooi takɔb lu yi zuɣu wurim ya kpɛhi zuliya shɛb ni, ka yi tiŋgbɔŋ leei dabari, ka chɛ ka yi fɔntinsi ti bahi yoli.
en: I will scatter you among the nations. I will unsheathe my sword against you. Your land will be devastated and your cities will be ruins.

dag: Ka Mikal daa sɔŋ Dauda ka o doli takɔro ni yi n-zo n-tiligi.
en: Then Michal let David down out of a window, and he escaped and ran away.

dag: ka lan yɛl o, Ka din pahi nyɛla, a dabili Yaakubu doli ti nyaaŋa na. Dama Yaakubu daa yɛlila o suhu ni, N yi chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ pini ŋɔ daŋ n tooni ti ti o, n ni maag o suhu, ka di nyaaŋa m min o nini yi ti nya taba, di pa shɛli o ni deei ma.
en: You will say, This is a gift to you, and your servant Jacob is behind us. Jacob thought, If I send these men ahead with gifts, maybe Esau will forgive me and accept me.

dag: Naɣ kul malila yaa mini suhukpeeni pam; ka doli zaligu shɛŋa zaa n dabili Musa ni daa zali ya la viɛnyɛliŋga; ka miri ka a ŋmaligi kpa nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo ka chɛ li, ka di chɛ ka a tooi diri nasara luɣ shɛlikam a ni yɛn chaŋ.
en: Just be determined, be confident; and make sure that you obey the whole Law that my servant Moses gave you. Do not neglect any part of it and you will succeed wherever you go.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni ti jɛmdi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ mini Dauda ŋun nyɛ bɛ na so n ni yɛn pii ti ba la.
en: Then you will be my servants, and I will choose a king for you from the family of David. *.

dag: Bɛ ŋumdimi kaman gbuɣima la. Bɛ ŋumdimi, ka gbahiri bɛ ni yɛn gbahi biŋkɔb shɛba m-mali ba chana ka so ku tooi fa ba bahi.
en: The soldiers roar like lions that have killed an animal and are carrying it off where no one can take it away from them.

dag: Ka Neetan daa garigi yɛli Dauda, Niŋm a ni lo a suhu ni ni a niŋ shɛlikam zaa, dama Naawuni be a sani.
en: Nathan replied, Go ahead and do whatever you are thinking, because God is with you.

dag: Dinzuɣu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Yisa Masia ni la yi taali ni.
en: So now anyone who is in Christ Jesus is not judged guilty.

dag: M mi yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm. Nyamiya, n yoola dunoli n-tin ya, ka so ku tooi daa li yo. M mi ni yi yiko bi yaɣ lala, amaa di zaa yoli yi kul gbibi n yɛligu ka bi chihi n yuli.
en: I know what you do. I have put before you an open door that no one can close. I know you are weak, but you have followed my teaching. You were not afraid to speak my name.

dag: Ka kɔhigɔriba birigi n-dari gindi yɔɣu n-chaŋ hal ti kpi.
en: I am like a caravan, lost in the desert while searching for water.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, Pa ŋunkam dii booni ma, N Duuma, n Duuma, n-ni ti kpe alizanda nam ni, naɣila ŋun tumdi m Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ yubu.
en: Not everyone who calls me Lord will enter Gods kingdom. The only people who will enter are those who do what my Father in heaven wants.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa zaa daa zo ka chɛ o.
en: Then all of Jesus followers left him and ran away.

dag: O yila Rimmon n-kana Aiyat. O chaŋ ti kpe Migirɔn gari. O chɛ o nɛma sɔŋla Mikimash.
en: The army of Assyria will enter near the Ruins . The army will walk on the Threshing Floor . It will keep its food in the Storehouse .

dag: Jɛrimia ni daa tɔɣisi Yawɛ ni zal o ni o tɔɣisi niriba maa yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa maa naai, di saha ka maligumaaniba mini anabinima ni niriba maa zaa daa gbaag o, ka yɛli, Ti ni ku a!.
en: Jeremiah finished speaking everything the Lord had commanded him to say to the people. Then the priests, the prophets, and all the people grabbed Jeremiah. They said, You will die for saying such terrible things!.

dag: So yi tɛhi ni o mi shɛli, o na bi mi di ni simdi ni o mi shɛli gba.
en: In fact, people who think they know so much don't know anything at all.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa daa garigi yɛli Dauda, N ka bɔrɔbɔro ziŋ kpe, bɔrɔbɔro kasi n-naɣ beni; nachimba maa bɛn dee mini paɣiba yi bi dɔni, bɛ ni tooi ŋub li.
en: The priest said, I don't have any ordinary bread, only sacred bread; you can have it if your men haven't had sexual relations recently.

dag: Ka siɣili saha din nyɛ nanim ni daa yi tuhiri tɔbu saha shɛli la daa ti paai, ka Dauda daa tim Jɔab mini sapashin kpamba ni Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa ka bɛ chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ Ammɔnnima, ka chaŋ ti teei gili Raba. Amaa ka Dauda ŋun daa kpalim be Jɛrusalɛm.
en: The following spring, at the time of the year when kings usually go to war, David sent out Joab with his officers and the Israelite army; they defeated the Ammonites and besieged the city of Rabbah. But David himself stayed in Jerusalem.

dag: Yi nini ni lan nya na so ŋun diri mali jilima su tiŋgbɔn shɛli din galisi pam.
en: With your own eyes you will see the glorious King; you will see his kingdom reaching far and wide.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ salima alali niŋ di puuni mini di nyaaŋa zaa, ka niŋ salima kɔɣili li gili.
en: He covered the inside and outside of the Box with pure gold. Then he put gold trim around the Box.

dag: Amaa yinim bi doli yi ninsalitali biɛhigu ni wuhiri ya shɛm, ka Naawuni Shia Kasi yi shiri be yi ni, yi ni dolila Naawuni Shia Kasi yubu. Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun ka Masia Shia, o pala Masia ni su so.
en: But you do not live as your human nature tells you to; instead, you live as the Spirit tells you to—if, in fact, God's Spirit lives in you. Whoever does not have the Spirit of Christ does not belong to him.

dag: Niŋm bɛ zuɣulaannim kaman a ni daa niŋ Orɛb mini Ziib shɛm la; ka niŋ bɛ nanim kaman a ni daa niŋ Zɛba mini Zalimuna shɛm la.
en: Make their officials like Oreb and Zeeb, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna.

dag: Naawuni, a wum n ni lo alikauli shɛŋa la, ka pun ti ma pin shɛli a ni zaŋdi tiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lur a yuli sizuura la.
en: God, you heard what I promised to give you, but everything your worshipers have comes from you.

dag: Ulam bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Bɛdan. Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla Giliad bihi, ka Giliad nyɛ Makiri bia, ka Makiri mi nyɛ Manaasa bia.
en: and Ulam had a son named Bedan. These are all descendants of Gilead, the son of Machir and grandson of Manasseh.

dag: Yidaampaɣiba, zaŋmiya yimaŋ ti yi yidaannima kaman di ni simdi shɛm ti Duuma sani.
en: Wives, be willing to serve your husbands. This is the right thing to do in following the Lord.

dag: Dama ti Duuma yɛla yɛtɔɣa daa bi yi yi sani m-paala Masidɔnia mini Akaia kɔŋko, amaa yi ni niŋ Naawuni yɛda shɛm yɛla pun gili luɣ shɛlikam zaa. Dinzuɣu di bi lan simdi ni ti yɛli shɛli pahi.
en: The Lords teaching has spread from you throughout Greece and beyond. In fact, your faith in God has become known everywhere, so we never have to tell anyone about it.

dag: Yi yihi n niriba paɣiba bɛ yiya din viɛl ni, ka yihi n daalibarika bɛ bihi ni sahakam.
en: You have taken nice houses away from the women of my people. You have taken my wealth away from their small children forever.

dag: Sulemaana ni daa me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la min o nam yil la, ka me o ni daa bɔri ni o me binshɛlikam la naai nyaaŋa.
en: The Lord 's temple and Solomon's palace were now finished, and Solomon had built everything he wanted.

dag: yi ni yɛn mali sara shɛli ka n deei li nyɛla yi bo binlɔɣu ŋun ka daŋa m-mali sara maa, naɣilaa bee piɛlaa bee bulaa.
en: for it to be acceptable on your behalf, it must be a flawless male from the herd, the sheep, or the goats.

dag: A ni daa gbibi duŋ kurugu, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbiri ku Izraɛlnima saha shɛli bɛ ni daa nya yɛlibiɛɣu bɛ tibidarigibo din bahindi nyaaŋa ni la zuɣu.
en: People of Edom, not only have you been Israel's longtime enemy, you simply watched when disaster wiped out its people as punishment for their sins.

dag: Bimbir shɛŋa din daa lu gɔhi ni la mi ŋmanila bɛn wum Naawuni yɛligu.
en: Others are like the seed scattered among the thorny plants. These are the ones who have heard the word.

dag: dama ti nyɛla o niŋgbuŋ yaɣa.
en: because we are each part of his body.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa tiligi tɔb ni la daa nya nambɔzɔbo tiŋgban nɛl la ni. Izraɛlnim ni daa bɔri vuhim shee la.
en: In the desert I was kind to those who escaped death. I gave them peace, and when the time is right, I'll do the same for you. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Ka Midian kɔhigɔriba daa garita, ka bɛ yihi Yisifu bɔɣili maa ni na n-zaŋ o kɔhi Ishimail zuliya maa zuɣu anzinfa laɣibaligu pisi, ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yisifu kuli Ijipti.
en: and when some Midianite traders came by, the brothers pulled Joseph out of the well and sold him for twenty pieces of silver to the Ishmaelites, who took him to Egypt.

dag: Izraɛlnima, wummiya: Yawɛ n-nyɛ ti Naawuni, kulla Yawɛ kɔŋko.
en: Listen, people of Israel! The Lord is our God. The Lord is the only God.

dag: Chɛ ka m be a jɛmbu duu sahakam, ka chɛ ka n sɔɣ a kpiŋkpama lɔŋni.
en: Let me live in your sanctuary all my life; let me find safety under your wings.

dag: N Naawuni, n suhir a ni a kul tim ma bini diba ayi kɔŋko, di nyaaŋa n ku lan sɔɣi mmaŋa a sani.
en: Let me ask for two things; agree to them, and I will not try to hide from you:.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka naa daa bɔhi ma, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a ninni ti lihiri suhugarigu lihigu lala? A mi bi biɛra, di nyɛla a suhu ni yɛlimuɣisira suhugarigu. Ka dabiɛm daa gbaai ma pam.
en: the king asked me, Why do you seem sad? Since you arent sick, you must have a broken heart! I was very afraid.

dag: ka Uziɛl bia Ɛlizafan daa nyɛ Kɔhat daŋ niriba maa dɔɣirikpɛma.
en: The chief of the household representing the clans of the Kohathites was Elizaphan, Uzziels son.

dag: Bɛ ni ti dirila bɛ ni zaŋ chi mini kawaan shɛŋa na ti mali sara shɛli ni alahichi sanyoo sara binyara ni taali sanyoo sara binyara. Ka bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛli zaa ti Yawɛ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni nyɛla bɛ dini.
en: Instead, they will receive part of the grain sacrifices, as well as part of the sacrifices for sin and sacrifices to make things right. They will also be given everything in Israel that has been completely dedicated to me.

dag: Ibrahimma daa nyɛla Yisahaku ba, ka Yisahaku nyɛ Yaakubu ba, ka Yaakubu mi nyɛ Juda min o tizɔbihi ba.
en: From Abraham to King David, the following ancestors are listed: Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, Judah and his brothers; then Perez and Zerah , Hezron, Ram, Amminadab, Nahshon, Salmon, Boaz , Obed , Jesse, and King David.

dag: Nyini n-zaŋ bandi ba n naba, ka lihiri n ni doli so shɛŋa zaa; ka zahindi n napɔna bɔba.
en: You tie up my feet and restrict all actions; you stamp marks on the bottom of my feet.

dag: Ka Yisahaku yɛli Yaakubu, M bia, saɣisim mirina ka n shih a nya a shiri nyɛla m bia Iso bee a pa o.
en: Then Isaac said to Jacob, Come near to me so that I can feel you, my son. If I can feel you, I will know if you are really my son Esau.

dag: Ka o daa tim ka bɛ ti zaŋ o na. O daa nyɛla ŋun mal alaafee, ka o nimbihi kul viɛla, ka o lan nyɛ nachimbil viɛlli. Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Samuɛl, Yiɣisim booi kpam bah o zuɣu ni; ŋuna m-bala.
en: Jesse sent for David. He was a healthy, good-looking boy with a sparkle in his eyes. As soon as David came, the Lord told Samuel, He's the one! Get up and pour the olive oil on his head.

dag: Jɔtam yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaanu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pinaayɔbu. O ma yuli n-daa booni Jɛrusha, o daa nyɛla Zadok bipuɣiŋga.
en: Jotham was years old when he became king. He ruled years in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Jerusha. Jerusha was Zadoks daughter.

dag: Naa, a yi saɣi, nyin zalimi zaligu n-chɛ ka bɛ ku ba. A yi ni niŋ lala, n lo alikauli ni n ni tooi zaŋ anzinfa din sania zuɣu tibisim paai kilɔgiram tuhi kɔbisita ni pihinahi n-niŋ a liɣiri kpanjɔɣu ni.
en: If it please Your Majesty, issue a decree that they are to be put to death. If you do, I guarantee that I will be able to put tons of silver into the royal treasury for the administration of the empire.

dag: Pinimiya yi zabiri bahi, ka kumiya kuyila zoya zuɣu, dama Yawɛ zaɣisi ya, ka zaŋ ya bahi, yinim zuliya shɛb bɛn chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi ŋɔ.
en: Cut off your hair and cast it away; grieve on the well-traveled paths. The LORD has rejected you and has cast off a generation that provokes his anger.

dag: Ka Musa mini Aduna ni Aduna bidibisi maa daa mal li paɣiri bɛ nuhi mini bɛ naba.
en: then Moses and Aaron, together with Aaron's sons, washed their hands and feet.

dag: Galimi yɛtɔɣ shɛli yi n nol ni na? N ku tooi baŋla nia biɛɣu ni nyɛ shɛli?.
en: But you think I am lying— you think I can't tell right from wrong.

dag: A nyina piɛlimi kaman bɛ ni chɛ piɛ nyaan shɛb kɔbiri ka su ba kom ka bɛ piɛli shɛm la. Zaɣ yini kam malila jaa, ka zaɣ yini bi pooi di ni.
en: Your teeth are like newly shorn ewes as they come up from the washing pool— all of them perfectly matched, not one of them lacks its twin.

dag: Ka daa lan bɔhi Yawɛ, Doo maa ka kpe na? Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl ba, Nyamiya, o sɔɣ be kpalansi ŋɔ nyaaŋa.
en: Then they asked the Lord , Has Saul come here yet? The Lord said, Saul is hiding behind the supplies.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun tumdi tuma yɔri pala pini, amaa di nyɛla o tuma yɔri.
en: When people work, their pay is not given to them as a gift. They earn the pay they get.

dag: Dama di nyɛla zaligu Izraɛl; di nyɛla Yaakubu Naawuni zaligu.
en: Because this is the law for Israel; this is a rule of Jacobs God.

dag: Aduna ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana la bia Ɛliɛza n-daa nyɛ Lɛvinim kpamba maa zuɣulana; ŋuna n-daa lihiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn su luɣ kasi shee la.
en: The leader over the leaders of the Levites was Eleazar son of Aaron the priest. Eleazar was in charge of everyone who took care of the holy things.

dag: Pɛlɛg ni daa dɔɣi Riu maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiyinaawɛi. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: After Reu was born, Peleg lived another years. During that time he had other sons and daughters.

dag: Ka o tumtumdib kpɛm maa garigi yɛl o, Tinzun paɣisar so ŋun daa doli Naomi yi Mɔab tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la m-bala.
en: The young man who was overseeing the harvesters answered, Shes a young Moabite woman, the one who returned with Naomi from the territory of Moab.

dag: Yi ni tooi zaŋ biŋkɔb so ŋun kpi o zuɣu biŋkpam bee mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ni gbaai biŋkɔb so biŋkpam tum tuun shɛli, amaa miriya ka yi ŋub li.
en: The fat of an animal that has died naturally or the fat of an animal that was killed by another animal may be put to any use, but you must definitely not eat it.

dag: O luɣi bɛ tiba, ka wuhi ba, ka zali ba ni bɛ zom yi alahichi ni labi o sanna.
en: He will force them to listen to his warning. He will command them to stop sinning.

dag: Yi ni daa fa yi mabihi bɛn nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya nɛma, ka ku ba la zuɣu, yi ni di vi, ka n kpihim yi birili hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: Because of the slaughter and violence done to your brother Jacob, shame will cover you, and you will be destroyed forever.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka bɛ baŋ ni a nuu n-tum lala maa.
en: Let others know that you alone have saved me.

dag: Guŋgombihi din kumsi tiri suhupiɛlli mini mɔɣilɔnim kumsi foya, ka bɛn yɔri suhupiɛlli vuri gba fo.
en: They have stopped showing their joy. The happy music from the drums and harps has ended.

dag: Di bahigu ti ŋmanila wɔɣ dimli, ka dimda kaman gariŋga la.
