en: But in the end, it will bite like a snake.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa yɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o sani maa, Kalimiya niriba maa n-nya ninvuɣ banima n-lee yi ti ni chaŋ. Ka bɛ daa kali ba n-nya ka Jɔnatan min o tɔbutuhiri neenʒira maa n-kani.
en: So Saul said to his men, Count the soldiers and find out who is missing. They did so and found that Jonathan and the young man who carried his weapons were missing.

dag: Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, zuliya shɛba bee na so n-kani ka n dan naa bi tim nimaani nti bɔ a; ka bɛ yi yɛli ni a kani, faashee ka dilan chɛ ka lala zuliya maa nim po ni bɛ shiri bi nya a.
en: I swear to you in the name of the living Lord your God that the king has looked everywhere for you. He sent people to look in every country, and when they couldn't find you, he made the leader of each country swear that you were not in that country.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Mɔabnim polo m-bala.
en: The Lord said these things about Moab many times.

dag: Di ni ti leei dabari m-be tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa din pun leei dabari sunsuuni, ka di fɔntinsi ni ti pahi fɔntin shɛŋa din pun lu n-dahim ni.
en: Of all the lands laid waste, it will be the most desolate; of all cities, the most ruined.

dag: yin yɛlimiy o, Tinim a daba ŋɔ yaannim nyɛla biŋkɔbiguliba, ka ti gba nyɛ bɛn guli biŋkɔbiri ti bilim ni hal ni wayo, din ni chɛ ka o chɛ ka yi ʒini Goshɛn tiŋgban ni, dama Ijiptinim je piɛguliba yɛlli.
en: You tell him, We are shepherds. All our lives we have been shepherds, and our ancestors were shepherds before us. Then Pharaoh will allow you to live in the land of Goshen. Egyptians dont like shepherds, so it is better that you stay in Goshen.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa yɛli Samuɛl, Tim ti naa ka o su ti maa, di daa bi palig o suhu; ka o daa suhi Yawɛ.
en: Samuel was displeased with their request for a king; so he prayed to the Lord .

dag: Ziɔnnima, di zɔriya dabiɛm! Nyamiya! Yi naa bari bumbil kani yi sanna.
en: Dont be afraid, Daughter Zion. Look! Your king is coming , sitting on a donkeys colt .

dag: Ibrahimma yuma daa nyɛla yuun kɔbiga ni pisopɔinnaanu.
en: Abraham lived to be years old.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa boli Izraɛl kpamba zaa na nti yɛli ba, Sokam bom biŋkɔb bila kaman o malibu ni nyɛ shɛm nti kɔrigi puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu.
en: Moses called the leaders of Israel together and said: Each family is to pick out a sheep and kill it for Passover.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔahaz tɔbbihi daa bi lan yaɣ lala. Kulla wɔribariba pihinu mini chɛchɛbunsi pia ni tinchandiba tuhi pia, dama Siria naa daa ku bɛn kpalim maa zaa n-no ba taai tiŋa kaman kabɔɣili ni taŋkpaɣu la.
en: The king of Aram defeated Jehoahazs army and destroyed most of the men in the army. He left only horse soldiers, chariots, and , foot soldiers. Jehoahazs soldiers were like chaff blown away by the wind at the time of threshing.

dag: Yɛm ka Ayuba ni tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa ni, o yɛtɔɣa maa ka gbinni.
en: Job talks like an ignorant person. What he says doesnt make sense.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yi nimaani chaŋ Gujɔda n-daa ti yi nimaani chaŋ Jɔtibata tiŋgbɔn shɛli din kulibɔna mali kom la.
en: From there the Israelites traveled to Gudgodah, then from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, which is a land with flowing streams.

dag: Di simdi ka di ti leei shihirili be yi nuhi ni mini yi gbɛri zuɣu, dama Yawɛ daa zaŋla o yiko nuu yihi ti Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na. .
en: It will be a sign on your hand and a symbol on your forehead that the LORD brought us out of Egypt with great power.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ chiri pinaayi saha ka Nɛbukadnɛza daa ti du n-tam o nam yili din daa be Babilɔn la dufahirili zuɣusaa n-chani gindi.
en: Only twelve months later, while he was walking around on the roof of his royal palace in Babylon.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini n-yihi n shia kpiimba biɛhigu shee, a lan ti ma nyɛvili ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pun do gbala ni la kalinli ni.
en: saving me from death and the grave.

dag: ka a je suli niŋ Naawuni, ka chɛ ka yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ yir a nol ni na?.
en: You are angry with God and denounce him.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord said to Moses:.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa na kul tumd alahichi zaŋ chaŋ o sani, ka kul taari duŋ niŋdi Zallakudura Naa mɔɣu maa ni.
en: But they continued sinning against him. They rebelled against God Most High in the desert.

dag: N ni mali Naawuni ni daa lo ti yaannim alikauli shɛl la tahima zuɣu ka n ʒe kpe ŋɔ saria karibu shee pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: Today I am standing trial because of the hope in the promise God gave our ancestors.

dag: Ka n yi tumdi n ni je ni n tum shɛli, dindina di pala mani n-nyɛ ŋun tumdi lala maa, amaa di nyɛla alahichi din be n ni la n-tumdi lala maa.
en: So if I do what I dont want to do, then I am not really the one doing it. It is the sin living in me that does it.

dag: O daa tahi tɔbbihi ti ʒili Ɛdom, ka Ɛdomnim zaa daa leei Dauda ni su shɛba. Dauda daa yi chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam zaa Yawɛ chɛ ka o dirila nasara.
en: Abishai also put fortresses in Edom and all the Edomites became Davids servants. The Lord gave David victory everywhere he went.

dag: Wulinluhili polɔnim ni lu Yawɛ yuli sizuura, ka wulimpuhili polɔnim mi lu o sizuura o jilima zuɣu; dama dimnim maa yi ti kana kaman kokpɛɣu mini sanʒiɛɣu la, Yawɛ Shia ni ti yiɣisi tuhi ba.
en: From east to west everyone will fear him and his great power. He will come like a rushing river, like a strong wind.

dag: O daa tim o yɛligu na ti tib ba, ka daa yihi ba kum ni.
en: By the power of his own word, he healed you and saved you from destruction.

dag: O kuri bɛn mali kpiɔŋ, ka saɣindi bɛ ni me goma gili tin shɛŋa.
en: God destroys mighty soldiers and strong fortresses.

dag: N ni wurim ba bɛ dimnim tooni bahi kaman pɔhim n-yi gbinni polo na ti ʒe ba chaŋ la. Bɛ zaɣ biɛɣu nyabu dali, n ni ti lɛbi n nyaaŋa biri ba ka pa ni n tooni.
en: Like a strong east wind, I will scatter my people. I will use their enemies to scatter them like dust. When disaster comes upon them, they will see me leaving, not coming to help.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila yuri; bɛ guurimi kaman bɛ ni bari wɔr shɛb tuhiri tɔbu la.
en: They look like horses. They run like war horses.

dag: Doo yi zaŋ paɣ so ŋun sɔrilim na bi naai dɔni m-pirig o zaɣim, o yihila paɣ maa ʒi soya zahira, ka paɣ maa gba yih omaŋmaŋ ʒi soya zahira, di simdi ka bɛ yihi bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa bɛ daŋ ni.
en: If a man sleeps with a woman during her menstrual period and has sexual contact with her, he has exposed the source of her blood flow and she has uncovered the same. Both of them will be cut off from their people.

dag: ka zaŋ bimbilli kam din maha n-ti mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri balibu kam mini binnɛma balibu kam bɛn mali nyɛvili zaŋ tabili noonsi balibu kam ni binnɛma balibu kam bɛn gbamdi tiŋgban ni ni bɛ dira. Ka di daa shiri niŋ lala.
en: but for all the wild animals and for all the birds I have provided grass and leafy plants for food—and it was done.

dag: Di saha ka naa maa daa yɛl o yiŋbihi, Lomiy o nuhi min o naba n-zaŋ o ti bahi kpaŋ ha zibisim shee. Nimaani ka niriba ni ti fabili ka dim bɛ nyina. .
en: So the king gave orders for this person to be tied hand and foot and to be thrown outside into the dark. That's where people will cry and grit their teeth in pain.

dag: N ni niŋ Ɛhab yiŋnim kaman n ni daa niŋ Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam yiŋnim mini Ahija bia Baasha yiŋnim shɛm la.
en: I will make Ahabs family like the family of Jeroboam son of Nebat and like the family of Baasha son of Ahijah.

dag: Ka salo maa ni shɛb daa yɛl o, A tizɔbihi min a ma be samban ni bɔri ni bɛ nya a.
en: Someone told him, Your mother and brothers are standing outside, wanting to see you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan ʒiri chi mini wɔrimɔri na nti tiri yuri mini tɔb wɔr shɛb bɛn zɔri pam nayili maa kaman bɛ ni daa zali bɛ zaa yinoyino ni o niŋm shɛm.
en: as well as barley and straw for the horses.

dag: Ka Biliha daa niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga ti Yaakubu.
en: Bilhah became pregnant and bore Jacob a son.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Naa Siiza dini. Ka o yɛli ba, Dinzuɣu Naa Siiza ni su shɛli, yin zaŋmiya li ti o, ka Naawuni mi ni su shɛli, yin zaŋmiya li ti ŋun Naawuni.
en: The Emperor's, they answered. Then Jesus told them, Give the Emperor what belongs to him and give God what belongs to God.

dag: n-wuhiri Naawuni ni daa ti Yisa Nazarɛt nira Shia Kasi yiko ka o gindi tumdi tuun suma, ka chɛ ka Sintani ni daa nahindi ninvuɣ shɛb zaa kpaŋdi shɛm, dama Naawuni daa be o sani.
en: You know about Jesus of Nazareth, whom God anointed with the Holy Spirit and endowed with power. Jesus traveled around doing good and healing everyone oppressed by the devil because God was with him.

dag: ni n daalaka nyabu ni n wahala dibu. A mi dinkam zaa daa niŋ ma mini alaka biɛ shɛŋa n ni daa nya Antiɔk mini Aikɔnium ni Listra la gba yɛla; amaa ti Duuma daa fa ma di zaa ni bahi.
en: You know about my persecutions and my sufferings. You know all the things that happened to me in Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra—the persecution I suffered in those places. But the Lord saved me from all of it.

dag: Ka o daa ti chaŋ bimbin shɛli o ni daa me n-zali Bɛtɛl la gbini gol so ŋun pahir anii biɛɣ pinaanu dali din nyɛ omaŋmaŋ ni daa zali dabisi shɛli la ni o ti tuɣili tulaale zim o ni daa zali chu shɛli n-ti Izraɛlnim la puhibu dali.
en: And on the fifteenth day of the eighth month, the day that he himself had set, he went to Bethel and offered a sacrifice on the altar in celebration of the festival he had instituted for the people of Israel.

dag: Doo yi chirigi bɛ ni bi zaŋ paɣisaribil so ti doo n-zaŋ o dɔni ka bɛ gbahi ba.
en: Suppose a man is caught raping a young woman who is not engaged.

dag: amaa sagbani maa daa yi bi vuui, bɛ bi chani shɛli naɣila di yi ti vuui chana ka bɛ chana.
en: As long as the cloud stayed there, they did not move their camp.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ yɛli Baruk, Yɛlim ti a ni niŋ shɛm sabi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa. Jɛrimia n-daa yɛr a yɛtɔɣa maa ka a sabira.
en: Then the officials asked Baruch, Tell us, Baruch, where did you get these messages that you wrote on the scroll? Did you write down what Jeremiah said to you.

dag: N daa lari niŋdi ba saha shɛli bɛ daa yi ti lan ka yɛda, ka n suhupiɛlli lihigu kpaŋsiri bɛ suhuri.
en: I smiled at them, and they could hardly believe it. My smile made them feel better.

dag: O daa ba chɛrubi yiɣi; ka bɛ daa nya o ka o bela pɔhim ni chana.
en: He flew swiftly on his winged creature; he traveled on the wings of the wind.

dag: Puhimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ Yaɣigari chuɣu Abib goli ni, dama Abib goli maa ni yuŋ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: Remember, in the month of Abib you must celebrate Passover to honor the Lord your God. It was that night in Abib when the Lord your God brought you out of Egypt.

dag: Di simdi ka a zaŋ daba ayopɔin tum Aduna min o bidibisi maligumaaniba leebu tuma kaman n ni zal a shɛm maa.
en: Treat Aaron and his sons just as I have commanded you. Ordain them for seven days.

dag: O ni daa paai nimaani, Ɛli daa ʒila o kuɣ zuɣu sɔnaŋgbanyee lihira, dama o suhu daa bi doya Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa zuɣu. Doo maa ni daa kpe tiŋ puuni nti moli lahibali maa, tiŋ maa nim zaa daa duhila kuŋa.
en: When he got there, Eli was sitting in a chair beside the road, waiting because he was nervous about Gods chest. The man arrived and gave the news to the city, and the whole city cried out.

dag: Lala mi n-nyɛ li, ti suŋ kam wandila wal suma, ka ti biɛɣukam mi wandi wal biɛri.
en: In the same way, every good tree produces good fruit, and bad trees produce bad fruit.

dag: Nir yi mali biɛla ka zɔri Yawɛ, di so ni nir mali buni pam ka di mal o muɣisigu.
en: It is better to be poor and respect the Lord than to be rich and have many troubles.

dag: Dama yi yi niŋdi ba alaka ka bɛ fabili niŋ ma, biɛhiŋ kani, n ni gbilisi tibili wum bɛ fabila maa.
en: If you do treat them badly and they cry out to me, you can be sure that Ill hear their cry.

dag: Ka Dauda daa be Filistianim maa sani yuuni ni chira anahi.
en: David lived with the Philistines one year and four months.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ zaa daa gbaai Sɔstɛniiz ŋun daa nyɛ Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu zuɣulan la m-bu o saria karibu duu maa dunol ni. Ka Gallio bi gbiligi lihi ba gba.
en: Then they all grabbed Sosthenes, the leader of the synagogue. They beat him before the court. But this did not bother Gallio.

dag: Ka din daa chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔ ti niŋ maa nyɛla Izraɛlnim ni daa tum alahichi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni la sani zuɣu. Ŋuna n-daa yihi ba Ijipti Naa Firawuna nuu ni Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na, ka bɛ ti kpalim jɛmdila buɣa.
en: Samaria fell because the Israelites sinned against the Lord their God, who had rescued them from the king of Egypt and had led them out of Egypt. They worshiped other gods.

dag: Nyamiya, n ni daa kari ba bahi tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni zaa ni sujee mini suhuyiɣisili pam la, n ni yihi ba nimaani n-zaŋ ba labisi kpe na nti chɛ ka bɛ ʒiya ni alaafee.
en: I am going to gather the people from all the countries where I have scattered them in my anger and fury, and I am going to bring them back to this place and let them live here in safety.

dag: So miri ka o zaŋ o tizɔpaɣa dɔni, o yi nyɛla o ba bipuɣiŋga bee o ma bipuɣiŋga, bɛ yi dɔɣ o la yiŋa bee luɣ shɛli polo.
en: You must not have sexual contact with your sister—regardless of whether she is your fathers daughter or your mothers daughter, whether born into the same household as you or outside it.

dag: Ka dunia ŋɔ mini di kore nyɛla din garita, amaa ŋunkam tumdi Naawuni yubu kul ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: The world is passing away, and all the things that people want in the world are passing away. But whoever does what God wants will live forever.

dag: N teeg a ni mali yɛda maŋli shɛl la yɛla. Di nyɛla yɛda shɛli a yabipaɣa Lɔis mini a ma Yunis ni daa mal la tatabo, ka m mi ni a gba shiri mal li.
en: I remember the sincere faith you have, the kind of faith that your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice also had. I am sure that you have it also.

dag: ka di pala o kandina maa kɔŋko zuɣu, amaa suhumaabo shɛli o ni daa nya yi san la gba zuɣu. O daa yɛli ti yi suhuri ni ye n nyabu zuɣu shɛm yɛla mini yi suhusaɣiŋgu ni yi baɣa ni be n ni shɛm gba yɛla, ka di daa chɛ ka n suhu maan paligi pahi.
en: We werent comforted only by his arrival but also by the comfort he had received from you. He told us about your desire to see me, how you were sorry, and about your concern for me, so that I was even happier.

dag: Yisifu ni daa nya ka o ba zaŋ o nudirigu pa Ifriim zuɣu ni maa, di daa bi niŋ o nyaɣisim, ka o daa gbaag o ba nuu ni o paai li Ifriim zuɣu ni n-zaŋ li pa Manaasa zuɣu ni;.
en: Joseph was upset when he saw that his father had put his right hand on Ephraim's head; so he took his father's hand to move it from Ephraim's head to the head of Manasseh.

dag: Yɛlim Aduna min o bidibisi maa ni bɛ gbaam bɛmaŋ ka chɛ Izraɛlnim ni zaŋ bin kasi shɛŋa na ti ti ma la din ni chɛ ka bɛ ku dihi n yuli din be kasi ŋɔ vi; Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: to say to Aaron and his sons: I am the Lord God, and I demand that you honor my holy name by showing proper respect for the offerings brought to me by the people of Israel.

dag: Gomna shɛb bɛn daŋ n tooni daa yi muɣisirila niriba maa, ka fari bɛ bindira mini wain m-pahi anzinfa laɣibaligu pihinahinahi zuɣu. Hal ka bɛ tumtumdiba daa chɛ ka niriba maa jɛmdi ba. Amaa man daa bi niŋ lala, dama n zɔri Naawuni.
en: The earlier governors who had come before me laid heavy burdens on the people. They took food and wine from them as well as forty shekels of silver. Even their servants oppressed the people. But because I was God-fearing, I didnt behave in this way.

dag: Amaa o ni ti ti wun so ŋun guli sansana la jilima. O ni ti zaŋ salima min anzinfa ni kuɣ viɛla binyara ni pin suma n-ti wun so ŋun nyɛ o yaannim ni daa bi jɛm.
en: and worship only the so-called god of fortresses, who was unknown to his ancestors. And he will honor it with gold, silver, precious stones, and other costly gifts.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Yi yi gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du m-paai Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: to tell the people of Israel: After you have crossed the Jordan River and are settled in Canaan.

dag: M bia, gbaam amaŋa ka chɛ bɛ ni niŋdi shɛm maa.
en: Don't follow anyone like that or do what they do.

dag: Bɛ ni shɛba n-nyɛ Haimɛnaius mini Alikizanda bɛn nyɛ n ni zaŋ shɛb niŋ Sintani nuu ni bɛmaŋmaŋ sɔŋsim nyabu zuɣu ni di chɛ ka bɛ baŋ ni di bi simdi ni bɛ mo Naawuni la.
en: Among them are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I have punished by handing them over to the power of Satan; this will teach them to stop their blasphemy.

dag: dama ŋuna n-nyɛ ti yaannim Naawuni ŋun daa neei Yisa so yi ni daa zaŋ kpahi tabili dapulli zuɣu n-ku la.
en: The God of our ancestors raised Jesus from the dead—whom you killed by hanging him on a tree.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ bɛnkam zaa wum piɛguliba maa ni yɛli shɛm maa alahiziba.
en: Everyone listened and was surprised.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun zani sana nyaaŋa ka o di samli, yin deem o binyɛrigu sɔŋ, deemiy o ni zaŋ shɛli lo alikauli maa, ka di leei saamba talima bini.
en: Take the garment of the person who secures a loan for a stranger; take his pledge for a foreigner.

dag: Abimilɛk kum nyaaŋa ka ninvuɣ so ŋun daa yɛn fa Izraɛlnim bahi yi palo. Lala nir maa n-daa nyɛ Pua bia Tola ŋun daa nyɛ Dɔdo yaaŋa la. O daa yila Isaka zuliya ni na, ka be Shamir din be Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya zuɣu la.
en: After Abimelech's death Tola, the son of Puah and grandson of Dodo, came to free Israel. He was from the tribe of Issachar and lived at Shamir in the hill country of Ephraim.

dag: O ni zaŋ a niŋ o kpiŋkpama lɔŋni, ka a nya sɔɣibu shee o kpiŋkpama maa ni. O ʒiɛyimtali nyɛla gbaɣino mini din taɣiri nira.
en: He will spread his wings over you and keep you secure. His faithfulness is like a shield or a city wall.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be bɛ nyɛviya ni n-nyɛ bɛn paɣir a kaman n ni paɣir a shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ. Bihi banim yɛri bɛ bihi a ʒiɛyimtali yɛla.
en: It is the living who praise you, As I praise you now. Parents tell their children how faithful you are.

dag: di saha ka o wuhiri ba bɛ tuma mini bɛ biriginsim ni nyɛ shɛm ni bɛ karimbaani ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: And God will tell them what they did, that they sinned and were proud.

dag: Bɛla bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Ɛzibɔn mini Uzi ni Uziɛl ni Jɛrimɔt ni Iri, bɛ daa nyɛla niriba anu, ka nyɛ bɛ daŋ ni zuɣulaannima, ka lan nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi, ka bɛ zuliya maa daadambiɛligu kalinli daa nyɛ ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaayi ni pihitanaanahi.
en: Bela had five sons. Their names were Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri. They were leaders of their families. Their family history shows they had , soldiers.

dag: Ka Pita chihi yɛli, Paɣa, man bi mi a ni yɛri so maa.
en: Peter said, Woman, I don't even know that man.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Dindali maa, yi ni ti wum kuŋa Zahim Dunɔdal la gbini, ka wum fabila yiya pala la ni, ka wum vuri pam daboya zuɣu.
en: On that day, says the Lord , you will hear the sound of crying at the Fish Gate in Jerusalem. You will hear wailing in the newer part of the city and a great crashing sound in the hills.

dag: Amaa ka Nadab mini Abihu daa ti zaŋ buɣim din bi viɛla n-nyo sara maligu ti Yawɛ ka kpi.
en: But Nadab and Abihu died. They died because they made an offering to the Lord with fire that was not allowed.

dag: O nyaandoliba maa ni daa wum lala maa, ka di gari ba pam ka bɛ bɔhi, Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi tiligi.
en: When the disciples heard this, they were greatly surprised and asked, How can anyone ever be saved.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Ahasivɛrɔs daa bɔhi Napaɣ Ɛsta, Ninvuɣ ŋuni n-lee buɣisi lala niŋbu maa? Ya ka lala nir maa lee be.
en: Then King Xerxes asked Queen Esther, Who did this to you? Where is the man who dared to do such a thing to your people.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zaŋ Sool takɔbi nyaɣi pa gbaɣino maa zuɣu, ka yɛn chaŋ ka di nyaŋ o, dama o daa na ʒi n-zaŋ li niŋ omaŋa. Di saha ka Dauda daa yɛli Sool, N ku tooi zaŋ nɛma ŋɔ niŋ mmaŋ chaŋ; dama m bi mil li. Ka daa yihi di zaa sɔŋ.
en: David strapped his sword on over the armor, but he couldnt walk around well because hed never tried it before. I cant walk in this, David told Saul, because Ive never tried it before. So he took them off.

dag: Bɛ ŋme n-deei Babilɔn, dunia zaa ni daa mali shɛli nyuri bara la. Babilɔn leela din yɛla mali dabiɛm zuliya kam sani.
en: The Lord says about Babylon: The city that the whole world praised has been captured! What a horrifying sight Babylon has become to the nations!.

dag: dama n ni ti a jilima pam. Ka a yi yɛli ni n niŋm shɛlikam zaa, n ni niŋ li; kul kamina ti yɛli yɛtɔɣ biɛɣu bahi niriba maa zuɣu ti ma. .
en: I will reward you richly and do anything you say. Please come and curse these people for me.

dag: Chɛliya ka yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ kpe yi tiba ni viɛnyɛliŋga: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ Daadam Bia niŋ salinim nuu ni.
en: Don't forget what I am about to tell you! The Son of Man is going to be handed over to the power of human beings.

dag: Ka kum bee kɔnyuri ku lan gbaai ba, ka wuntaŋ tulim bee biisim shɛli mi ku lan kpe ba.
en: Never again will they hunger or thirst; neither sun nor any scorching heat will burn them.

dag: Tii maa vari daa viɛli pam ka di kul wali gbilim; ka dunia ŋɔ ni daadamnim mini binnɛma zaa ni tooi paai li di n-tiɣi. Ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri kanna ti dooni di mahim vuhira, ka noonsi tɛri bɛ tɛri di wula zuɣu, ka vuhirigu kam diri di wala.
en: Its leaves were beautiful, its fruit abundant; it had enough food for everyone. Wild animals took shade under it; birds nested in its branches. All living things lived off that tree.

dag: ninvuɣ yoya shɛb yila yi ni n-chaŋ ti chɛ ka tiŋ maa nim birigi ka yɛra, Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ ti jɛm wun shɛŋa yi ni bi mi.
en: You may hear that some worthless people have talked everyone there into worshiping other gods, even though these gods had never done anything for them.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa tim tuumba Kiriatijiarimnim sani ti yɛli ba, Filistianim labisi Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka la na, kamiyana ti kpuɣi li.
en: There was a priest at Kiriath Jearim. The people of Beth Shemesh sent messengers to the people of Kiriath Jearim. The messengers said, The Philistines have brought back the Lord s Holy Box. Come down and take it to your city.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Aduna, Yɛlim Izraɛlnim maa zaa, Vumiya miri Yawɛ, dama o wum yi ni ŋumdi yi kparima ni niŋd o shɛm maa. .
en: Then Moses said to Aaron, Say to the whole Israelite community, Come near to the LORD, because hes heard your complaints.

dag: Ka o daa zani paɣ maa zuɣusaa n-tahi dɔro maa zuɣu, ka paɣ maa niŋgbun biisim maa maai, ka o dii yiɣisi niŋ ba saani.
en: He bent over her and spoke harshly to the fever, and it left her. She got up at once and served them.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Ɛdom zoli zani dabari bahi yoli. Ka n chɛ ka bɛn zaa daa yi kanna ka chana ku lan kana.
en: I will make the hill country of Edom a wasteland and kill everyone who travels through it.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛl o, Man deei yi kul yi tiŋ puuni tariga, n yɛn zaŋla n nuhi duhi zuɣusaa n-suhi Yawɛ, ka satahinsi ŋɔ mini sakuɣa ŋɔ zaa chɛ. Sakuɣa ku lan beni, ka yi baŋ ni Yawɛ n-su dunia ŋɔ.
en: Moses told Pharaoh, When I leave the city, I will lift my hands in prayer to the Lord , and the thunder and hail will stop. Then you will know that the Lord is in this land.

dag: Duhimiya tuuta din nyɛ Babilɔn liribu shihirili la zuɣusaa. Bomiya guliba pahi; zalimiya tiŋ guliba, ka chɛ ka shɛb sɔɣi doya gu. Dama Yawɛ lo nia ka niŋ o ni daa yɛli ni o ni niŋ Babilɔnnim shɛm la.
en: Lift up a flag against the walls of Babylon. Bring more guards. Put the watchmen in their places. Get ready for a secret attack. The Lord will do what he has planned. He will do what he said he would do against the people of Babylon.

dag: Firawuna yi boli ya ti bɔhi ya, Tuun bɔ ka yi lee tumda.
en: When the king calls for you and asks what your occupation is.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Samuɛl daa ti boli niriba ni bɛ laɣim Yawɛ sanna Mizipa.
en: Samuel sent messengers to tell the Israelites to come to Mizpah and meet with the Lord .

dag: Tinsi ŋɔ zaa wuna maa puuni wun ŋuni n-na tooi fa bɛ tinsi maa shɛli n nuu ni bahi, ka Yawɛ ti yɛn fa Jɛrusalɛm n nuu ni bahi? .
en: When did any of the gods of all these countries ever save their country from our emperor? Then what makes you think the Lord can save Jerusalem.

dag: Zabili daa be Sool niriba mini Dauda niriba sunsuuni yuui pam, ka Dauda yaa daa kul pahira, ka Naa Sool niriba maa mi yaa daa kul gbarigiri pahira.
en: The fighting between the forces supporting Saul's family and those supporting David went on for a long time. As David became stronger and stronger, his opponents became weaker and weaker.

dag: Ka kokpɛɣu din galisi pam maa daa kul kpɛri pahiri hal ti paai biɛɣu pihinahi, ka kom maa kul zoori pahira, ka kpuɣi ŋariŋ maa zuɣusaa, ka di du ka chɛ tiŋgbani.
en: Water flooded the earth for days. The water began rising and lifted the boat off the ground.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be a jɛmbu duu n-kul yiini yila paɣir a sahakam mal alibarika.
en: Great blessings belong to those who live at your Temple! They continue to praise you. Selah.

dag: N ni niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ mini yaɣ shɛli din gili n zoli ŋɔ ni, ka chɛ ka saa miri ba saa mibu saha. Di ni ti nyɛla alibarika saa.
en: I will give them and those around my hill a blessing by sending the rain in its season. They will be rains of blessing.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa kuli yiŋa nti nya ka alizin biɛɣu maa shiri zo ka chɛ o bia maa, ka o dola o bindoo zuɣu.
en: When the woman got back home, she found her child lying on the bed. The demon had gone.

dag: amaa n ni di kul duhi n yee kuhi pam saha shɛli, ka o chɛ o binyɛrigu ŋɔ bahi ma ka guui yi yili ŋɔ.
en: But when I screamed, he ran outside, leaving his robe beside me.

dag: Di simdi ka yi doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka lumiy o kɔŋko sizuura, ka dol o zaligunima, ka deeg o noli, ka jɛmiy o, ka ʒe o yim.
en: You must follow the Lord your God. Respect him. Obey his commands and do what he tells you. Serve the Lord your God, and never leave him.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka alɔbo dɔriti gbaai Firawuna min o yiŋnima, Ibram paɣ Zarai maa zuɣu.
en: Because of Sarai, the Lord struck the king and everyone in his palace with terrible diseases.

dag: O daa lan yɛli, N yi bi chɛ ka Naawuni ni daa lo Dauda alikauli yɛli.
en: I ask God to punish me if I don't help David get what the Lord promised him!.

dag: A yurilim maŋli la so nyɛvili. N ni yaai n noli paɣ a.
en: Your love means more than life to me, and I praise you.

dag: n-chɛ ka paɣ maa nyu kɔtɔɣu din tahiri tibidarigibo maa na. Ka ko shɛli din tahiri tibidarigibo maa na ni kpe paɣ maa ni n-ti o biɛrim pam.
en: so that when the woman drinks this water, the curses will enter her body.

dag: O daa lan wuh o bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ salima shɛm tariga mali Naawuni jɛma balibu kam salima lahi ni bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ anzinfa shɛm tariga mali Naawuni jɛma kam anzinfa lahi.
en: for the weight of all the gold equipment used for every kind of service, and the weight of all the silver equipment used for every kind of service.

dag: Dama nyamiya, Yawɛ yɛn yila o biɛhigu shee na. O ni ti siɣina ti tam dunia ni daboya zuɣu chana.
en: See, the Lord is leaving his place to come down and walk on the high places of the earth.

dag: Ti ni daa deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa saha shɛli maa, ka n daa zaŋ Aroa nuzaa polo yaɣili din be Arinɔn kulibɔŋ nol la mini Giliad tiŋgbɔŋ ni zoya ni tinsi la pirigili mini di fɔntinsi ti Rubin mini Gaad zuliya niriba.
en: So this is the land we possessed at that time. I gave some of it, from Aroer, which is beside the Arnon River, up through half of the Gilead highlands, along with its cities, to the Reubenites and the Gadites.

dag: Yi nyɛla Naawuni ninvuɣ gahindi shɛb o ni yu ka pii leeg omaŋmaŋ niriba. Dinzuɣu di niŋ kamaata ni yi zaŋ nambɔzɔbo mini nirilim niŋbu ni maŋsiɣisibutali ni tarimtali ni suɣilɔdibo kpɛhi yi tɛr ni.
en: Therefore, as Gods choice, holy and loved, put on compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience.

dag: Jɛhoyakim ʒiɛmani maa ni ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa kana ti liri Judanima, ka Jɛhoyakim daa zaŋ omaŋ ti o n-jɛm o yuma ata; di nyaaŋa ka o daa ti zaɣis o jɛmbu.
en: While Jehoiakim was king, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia invaded Judah, and for three years Jehoiakim was forced to submit to his rule; then he rebelled.

dag: Ka Shamshɛrai mini Shɛharia ni Atalia.
en: Jeroham's descendants included Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah.

dag: amaa bɛnkam daa deeg o ka niŋ o yuli yɛda, bɛna ka o niŋ yiko ni bɛ leei Naawuni bidɔɣirisi.
en: But those who did welcome him, those who believed in his name, he authorized to become Gods children.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ bi mi din ti yɛn niŋ, dama ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yɛli ba di ni ti yɛn nyɛ shɛm.
en: and you are not sure what will happen. No one can tell you what will happen in the future.

dag: Hal n niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ yi saɣim ŋ-ŋɔ, ka n niŋgbuŋ na beni, dindina n ni nya Naawuni.
en: Even after my skin is eaten by disease, while still in this body I will see God.

dag: Dama m ba daa zaŋ o nyɛvili pa talima n-tuhi fan ya Midiannim nuu ni bahi.
en: my father fought for you and risked his life to rescue you from Midians power.

dag: Ka pɔhim maa ni ti mali ba ansarisi, ka sabisi ba bɛ ni be luɣ shɛlikam.
en: The wind howls at them as they run, frightening them with destructive power.

dag: Dinzuɣu nyin Jɔshua ŋun nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulan ŋɔ min a maligumaanitab bɛn ʒiin a tooni ka nyɛ binsuma din ti yɛn kana shihirili la, wummiya: N ni yihi n dab so bɛ ni booni Tiwul polli la palo.
en: Listen, Joshua, you who are the high priest, and listen, you fellow priests seated before him. You are all examples to show what will happen when I bring my special servant. He is called, the Branch.

dag: O ni zaŋ wuntia kaman nyɔtaɣirigu la ye, ka zaŋ tiliginsim kaman zuɣupiligu la pili. O ni zaŋ o suhu ni lo ni o mali binshɛɣukam zali dɛde shɛm, ka bɔhi biɛri ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn diri wahala la kaman binyɛrigu la ye.
en: He put on the armor of goodness, the helmet of salvation, the uniform of punishment, and the coat of strong love.

dag: Bɛ ni ti niŋ naŋgban yini n-zaŋ bɛ fukumsi mini bɛ yiko zaa n-ti biŋkɔbigu maa.
en: These ten all have the same purpose, and they give their power and authority to the beast.

dag: Ka Juda maa daa nyɛ Yaakubu bia, ka Yaakubu nyɛ Yisahaku bia, ka Yisahaku nyɛ Ibrahimma bia, ka Ibrahimma nyɛ Tɛra bia, ka Tɛra mi nyɛ Nahɔr bia.
en: the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor.

dag: n di bi zaɣisi ni m be yi sani pumpɔŋɔ n-taɣ zilinli zaŋ chaŋ yi polo, dama n suhu zɔhiri yi zuɣu.
en: How I wish I were with you now, so that I could take a different attitude toward you. I am so worried about you!.

dag: Sapashinnim maa ni daa ti nya Jɛhɔshafat bɛ daa yɛlimi, Biɛhiŋ kani, Izraɛl naa maa m-bala. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuh o; ka Jɛhɔshafat daa kuhi pam.
en: So when they saw King Jehoshaphat, they all thought that he was the king of Israel, and they turned to attack him. But when he cried out.

dag: N lihila a tiliginsim min a ni lo ma alikauli maŋli shɛl la soli hal ka n nina ti fulim.
en: I have worn out my eyes looking for your help, waiting for you to save me, as you promised.

dag: A zo nyɛla ŋun yur a sahakam, ka mabihi mi nyɛ bɛ ni dɔɣi shɛba ni bɛ sɔŋdi taba ashaara saha.
en: A friend is there to help, in any situation, and relatives are born to share our troubles.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa yiɣisi nimaani chaŋ teeku nol ni, ka salo pam yi Galili dol o; ka shɛb mi daa yi Judia.
en: Jesus went away with his followers to the lake. A large crowd of people from Galilee followed them.

dag: Ka Batishiiba yɛli, Di viɛla, n ni yɛli naa ti a.
en: Then Bathsheba said, Very well, I will speak to the king for you.

dag: Amaa m mabihi, din gari shɛlikam zaa nyɛla: Miriya ka yi po alizanda bee dunia ŋɔ bee m-po pɔ shɛli pahi. Chɛliya ka yi Iin kul nyɛla Iin, ka yi Aai mi kul nyɛla Aai, ka di chɛ ka yi ku kpe taali ni.
en: Above all, my friends, do not use an oath when you make a promise. Do not swear by heaven or by earth or by anything else. Say only Yes when you mean yes, and No when you mean no, and then you will not come under God's judgment.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ kuɣ viɛl shɛŋa pie taba kulis anahi. Bɛ daa zaŋla bɛ ni booni kuɣ shɛŋa kanɛlian mini kirisolait ni ɛmɛrald m-pie taba kul shɛli din daŋ tooni;.
en: with four rows of three precious stones: A carnelian, a chrysolite, and an emerald were in the first row;.

dag: Alahichilana yi tum alahichi bukɔbiga, ka kul be o nyɛvil ni yuui, m mi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔri Naawuni yɛla ni so, bɛ ni zɔr o maa zuɣu.
en: A sinner may commit a hundred crimes and still live. Oh yes, I know what they say: If you obey God, everything will be all right.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, tiligim ti, ka yihi ti zuliya kam ni na n-laɣim luɣ yini, ka ti paɣ a yuli din be kasi ŋɔ, ka ti a jilima ti paɣibu maa puuni.
en: LORD our God, save us! Gather us back together from among all the nations so we can give thanks to your holy name and rejoice in your praise!.

dag: Ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba maa yɛli ba, So na ʒi n-tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa kaman doo maa.
en: They answered, No one has ever spoken like this man.

dag: N daamiliya, a naŋgbampiba tɔɣirila binnyuri nyaɣisili ka shiri mini bihim be a zilinli ni. A situra ʒiɛɣu ŋmanila Lɛbanɔn ʒiɛɣu.
en: The taste of honey is on your lips, my darling; your tongue is milk and honey for me. Your clothing has all the fragrance of Lebanon.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ be ti sani; Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ ti ni sɔɣiri so sani.
en: The LORD of heavenly forces is with us! The God of Jacob is our place of safety. Selah.

dag: Dama bɛ dirila ninvuɣ biɛtali bindirigu, ka nyuri duŋtaabo wain.
en: Their food and drink are cruelty and wickedness.

dag: Ti ni mali dunia ŋɔ ni doo la kɔtomsi shɛm, lala ka ti ni ti mali do so ŋun yi alizanda ni na la gba kɔtomsi.
en: We will look like the heavenly person in the same way as we have looked like the person made from dust.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan zaŋ o yɛligu yɛli Jona pahi buyi.
en: Once again the Lord told Jonah.

dag: Man Pool mini Timoti bɛn nyɛ Yisa Masia daba la n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda zaa bɛn be Yisa Masia ni la mini cheechi zuɣulaannim ni sɔŋdiba bɛn be Filipai.
en: Greetings from Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ. To all of you in Philippi who are Gods holy people in Christ Jesus, including your elders and special servants.

dag: Ka o yɛli, N nyɛla Ibrahimma nachin kpɛma.
en: The servant said, I am Abrahams servant.

dag: Daadamnim saɣim dunia, dama bɛ birigi Naawuni zalikpana min o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi, ka saɣim o ni daa lo alikauli shɛli ni di kul beni sahakam la.
en: The earth is polluted because its people disobeyed the laws of God, breaking their agreement that was to last forever.

dag: Ka miriya ka yi nyuri bara yi suhuri ni yi yab ni nyɛ Ibrahimma la zuɣu; dama n yɛri ya mi ni ti Duuma Naawuni ni tooi zaŋ kuɣa ŋɔ nam ninsalinima, ka bɛ leei Ibrahimma zuliya.
en: And don't think you can escape punishment by saying that Abraham is your ancestor. I tell you that God can take these rocks and make descendants for Abraham!.

dag: Ka o yiɣisi lihi nya ka bɛ ni she mahi kpil shɛli kuɣ tula zuɣu mini kɔgaɣili n-ʒe o zuɣu polo. Ka o daa di ka nyu, ka lan lab dɔni.
en: Elijah opened his eyes and saw flatbread baked on glowing coals and a jar of water right by his head. He ate and drank, and then went back to sleep.

dag: Ka Samsin daa yɛli, Buŋ yɛno kɔbili ka n zaŋ ku ninvuɣ tuhili. Buŋ yɛno kɔbili ka n zaŋ ku ba n-laɣim ba sɔŋ gbilligbilli.
en: Samson said, With a donkeys jawbone, stacks on stacks! With a donkeys jawbone, Ive killed one thousand men.

dag: Hadadɛza kpambaliba ni daa nya ka Izraɛlnim tuhi nyaŋ ba maa, ka bɛ daa kana ti tim sandaani niŋ Dauda, ka leeg o ni su shɛba. Dinzuɣu ka Sirianim maa daa bi lan bɔri ni bɛ sɔŋ Ammɔnnim maa yaha.
en: When the kings who were subject to Hadadezer realized that they had been defeated by Israel, they made peace with David and became his subjects. The Syrians were never again willing to help the Ammonites.

dag: Chɛliya ka ŋunkam zaa be Ziɔn duh o yee yili yila ni suhupiɛlli, dama Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun galisi, ka be kasi ŋɔ be o niriba sunsuuni.
en: Let everyone who lives in Zion shout and sing! Israel's holy God is great, and he lives among his people.

dag: O kalinsi nyaaŋa ka o bia Amazia daa di nam zan o zaani. Bɛ sabi o bidibisi yɛla mini bɛ ni daa tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa pam jɛnd o la ni o ni daa mali Naawuni jɛmbu duu me shɛm la, niŋ Nanim yɛlikura litaafi ni.
en: The History of the Kings also tells more about the sons of Joash, what the prophets said about him, and how he repaired the temple. Amaziah son of Joash became king after his father's death.

dag: Di saha ka nachimbil so daa yi Bɛtilihɛm din be Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni la na. O daa nyɛla Lɛvi zuliya nira m-be nimaani.
en: There was a young man who was a Levite from the city of Bethlehem in Judah. He had been living among the tribe of Judah.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi maa daa be Dauda sani daba ata n-diri ka nyura, dama bɛ mabihi daa pun malila binshɛɣukam shili zali ba.
en: The men spent three days at Hebron with David. They ate and drank, because their relatives had prepared food for them.

dag: A kuhigu maa nyɛla din ni sɔŋ yih a muɣisigu ni bee a yaa zaa n-ni ti a sɔŋsim?.
en: It will do you no good to cry out for help; all your strength can't help you now.

dag: Miriya ka yi ni so ŋmaligi ka chɛ Naawuni daanfaani; ka miriya ka yi chɛ ka putɔɣu kpe yi ni so ni n-zooi muɣisi ya ka ta yi ni shɛb daɣiri.
en: Guard against turning back from the grace of God. Let no one become like a bitter plant that grows up and causes many troubles with its poison.

dag: Miri ka a deei anab shɛb bɛn yɛr a ni a di jɛm Babilɔn Naa la yɛligu, dama bɛ tɔɣisir a la ʒiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: But the false prophets are saying, You will never be slaves to the king of Babylon. Dont listen to those prophets, because they are telling you lies.

dag: N Duuma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, di chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali tahima a sani di vi n zuɣu. Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, di chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmd a ŋɔ nya filiŋ n zuɣu.
en: Don't let me bring shame on those who trust in you, Sovereign Lord Almighty! Don't let me bring disgrace to those who worship you, O God of Israel!.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa zaŋ jaaŋgbɛhi maa Yawɛ tooni yi Izraɛlnim zaa sani ka bɛ ti nya. Ka sokam daa yih o jaaŋgbee.
en: So Moses brought out all the sticks from the Lord s place. He showed the walking sticks to the Israelites. They all looked at the sticks, and each man took his own stick back.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti zaŋ tan tolima anu she n-tuɣi taba, ka lan zaŋ diba anu din la gba she n-tuɣi taba.
en: Join the curtains together into two groups. Join five curtains together to make one group and join five curtains together to make the other group.

dag: Yi zura, ka kuri niriba, ka niŋdi zina, ka ŋmari ʒiri pɔri pɔri, ka maani maligu tiri Baal, ka jɛmdi buɣ shɛŋa yi ni daa pun bi mi.
en: You steal, murder, commit adultery, tell lies under oath, offer sacrifices to Baal, and worship gods that you had not known before.

dag: Ɛhab ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam zaa ni o ni daa zaŋ wɔb nyina n-dih o nam yil shɛli nachiinsi la ni o ni daa me tin shɛŋa zaa la, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi ni.
en: Everything else that King Ahab did, including an account of his palace decorated with ivory and of all the cities he built, is recorded in The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Yawɛ daa ti ma laara n wuntitali zuɣu; o yo ma samli n ni ka galimi zuɣu.
en: The LORD rewarded me for my righteousness; he restored me because my hands are clean.

dag: N dɔni n gom shee yuŋ tɛhi n suhu ni yuri so pam yɛla; m bo o, amaa ka bi nya o.
en: At night on my bed, I look for the man I love. I looked for him, but I could not find him.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa zaŋ li tahi nimaani, ka Yawɛ daa lan darigi di tiŋ maa nim gba tibili n-chɛ ka sokam suhu saɣim. O daa chɛ ka bintɔra tɔri bihi mini ninkura zaa.
en: But after the Philistines had moved Gods Holy Box to Gath, the Lord punished that city. The people became very frightened. God caused many troubles for all the people—young and old. He caused the people in Gath to have tumors.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔahaz daa suhi Yawɛ, ka Yawɛ deeg o suhigu, dama o daa nya nahiŋgu shɛli Siria naa ni nahindi Izraɛlnim maa.
en: Then Jehoahaz prayed to the Lord , and the Lord , seeing how harshly the king of Syria was oppressing the Israelites, answered his prayer.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Balaam, Labimi ti zaŋ n ni yɛl a shɛm yɛli Balak.
en: The Lord told Balaam what to say and sent him back to Balak to give him his message.

dag: Bɛ nia zaa nyɛla bɛ daai ninvuɣ so ŋun ʒe zaashe titali ni luhi; bɛ nyɛla bɛn yu ʒiŋmabo. Alibarika yɛtɔɣa m-be bɛ noya ni, amaa ka turi yɛtɔɣa lee be bɛ suhuri ni.
en: You want only to destroy me, to bring me down from my important position. It makes you happy to tell lies about me. In public, you say nice things, but in private, you curse me. Selah.

dag: O daa zaŋ ma kpe o bindira dibu duu, ka o ni daa lo shɛm zaŋ chaŋ m polo nyɛla o bɔri ma mi.
en: He has brought me to the house of wine; his banner raised over me is love.

dag: Zaŋm a nudirigu di nasara, ka deei ti suhigu, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka a fa a ni yuri ninvuɣ shɛb bahi.
en: Answer my prayers and use your powerful arm to give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl anabinim yino ni o yɛlim o kpee, Ŋmɛm ma. Amaa ka o kpee maa daa zaɣisi ni o ku ŋme o.
en: At the LORDs command a certain man who belonged to a prophetic group said to his friend: Please strike me. But his friend refused to hit him.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia daa kpe Odɛd bia Azaria ni.
en: When Gods spirit came upon Azariah, Odeds son.

dag: Paɣ so ŋun bɔri zabili pam ŋmanila saa ŋun kul yɔrita ka bi baara.
en: A complaining wife is like water that never stops dripping on a rainy day.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ bela n sani kaman tɔbbia ŋun yɛla mali dabiɛm la. Dinzuɣu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi ma alaka maa ni tuui lu. Bɛ ku nyaŋ ma. Bɛ ni di vi kara, dama bɛ ku di nasara. Bɛ ni nya filiŋ sahakam, ka di yɛla ka tambu.
en: But the LORD is with me like a strong defender. Therefore, my oppressors will stumble and not prevail. They will be disgraced by their own failures. Their dishonor will never be forgotten.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa duh o zuɣu yul o nyaandoliba maa ka yɛli, Yinim bɛn nyɛ nandaamba ŋɔ mal alibarika, dama Naawuni nam nyɛla yi dini.
en: Jesus looked at his disciples and said: God will bless you people who are poor. His kingdom belongs to you!.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Bɛ daa dɔɣ a la alahichi puuni, ka nyin ti lee nyɛ ŋun wuhiri ti? Ka bɛ daa kar o bɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: They answered, You were born and brought up in sin—and you are trying to teach us? And they expelled him from the synagogue.

dag: ni Maikil ni Ishipa ni Jɔha daa nyɛla Bɛraya bidibisi.
en: Michael, Ishpah, and Joha.

dag: Ka Dilaila daa chɛ ka Samsin zaŋ o zuɣu pa o naba zuɣu gbihi, ka o bol do so na ti chɛ ka o pini Samsin zuɣu ni zab kpila ayopɔin maa. Ka o daa piligi damdi Samsin, ka o kpiɔŋ maa daa shiri yi o ni.
en: Delilah lulled Samson to sleep in her lap and then called a man, who cut off Samson's seven locks of hair. Then she began to torment him, for he had lost his strength.

dag: Di simdi ni ti ŋme goonje mini mɔɣilo paɣ a, ka ŋme biɛɣu paɣ a.
en: with the ten-stringed harp, with the melody of the lyre.

dag: Bɛ daa tum bɛ Naawuni tuma mini binyɛra mali ka di be kasi tuma viɛnyɛliŋga. Ka yiliyiiniba mini dunɔguliba gba daa tum bɛ tuma kaman Dauda min o bia Sulemaana ni daa zali shɛm la.
en: They performed the service of their God and the service of purification, as did the singers and the gatekeepers, according to the command of David and his son Solomon.

dag: ni Ɛlitolad ni Chɛsil ni Hɔrima.
en: Eltolad, Chesil, Hormah.

dag: ni Hɛlikat ni Rɛhɔb ni di zaa ha biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: Helkath and its pastures, and Rehob and its pastures; in total: four cities.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa tum tuma ka o yuli du n-gari ninvuɣ pihita maa zaa ka o leei bɛ zuɣulana la, amaa o yuli daa lee bi du m-paai wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa yuya.
en: He was the most famous of The Thirty and became their leader, but he was not as famous as The Three.

dag: Ka ti Duuma yɛl o, Yiɣisim doli pal shɛli din yuli booni Dɛde la nti bɔhi ka bɛ wuh a Judas yiŋa, ka a bɔhi Sool ŋun nyɛ Taasus nir la yɛla. Nyama, o be nimaani suhiri Naawuni.
en: The Lord said to him, Get up and go to the house of Judas on Straight Street. When you get there, you will find a man named Saul from the city of Tarsus. Saul is praying.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu zaɣ biɛɣu ni lu lala nir zuɣu libig o n-tum o barina saha biɛla puuni ka di ka yɛtɔɣa.
en: But they will be struck by sudden disaster and left without a hope.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yɛl o, Aai, n suhir a, a suhu yi shiri maai ni mani, nyin deemi m pini maa, dama n ni nya a ka a deei ma ni suhumahili maa, di ŋmanila n nini nyala Naawuni.
en: No! Jacob said. Please accept them as a sign of your friendship for me. When you welcomed me and I saw your face, it was like seeing the face of God.

dag: ka Izraɛl daa yɛli, Di saɣiya! M bia Yisifu na shiri be o nyɛvil ni. N ni chaŋ ti nya o pɔi ka naanyi kpi.
en: and said, Now I can believe you! My son Joseph must really be alive, and I will get to see him before I die.

dag: Miriya ka yi booni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yuli yiriŋyiriŋ, dama Yawɛ ku chɛ ŋunkam boon o yuli yiriŋyiriŋ taali.
en: Do not use my name for evil purposes, for I, the Lord your God, will punish anyone who misuses my name.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka ti kpaŋ timaŋ paai vuhim shee Naawuni sani, ka ti ni so ti ku lu nɔzaɣisibo ŋɔ tatabo zuɣu.
en: So let us try as hard as we can to enter Gods place of rest. We must try hard so that none of us will be lost by following the example of those who refused to obey God.

dag: Di saha naa maa daa tɔɣisirila Gɛhaazi ŋun daa nyɛ Naawuni nir maa sɔŋda la yɛtɔɣa n-yɛr o, Yɛlim ma Ilaisha ni daa tum tuun kar shɛŋa zaa yɛla.
en: She found the king talking with Gehazi, Elisha's servant; the king wanted to know about Elisha's miracles.

dag: Ka do so daa ti nya o ka o be mɔɣu ni chani ginda, ka o bɔh o, Bɔ ka a lee bɔra.
en: At Shechem, Joseph got lost. A man found him wandering in the fields. The man said, What are you looking for.

dag: Ka Yisa kpah o zuɣu ni yɛli, Miri ka a yɛli so di yɛla; amaa cham ti zaŋ amaŋ wuhi maligumaana, ka mali sara shɛli Anabi Musa ni daa sab zali zaŋ chaŋ kɔŋ tibbu polo la; dina n-ni niŋ a kpaŋbu maa shɛhira niriba sani.
en: Jesus ordered him, Don't tell anyone, but go straight to the priest and let him examine you; then to prove to everyone that you are cured, offer the sacrifice as Moses ordered.

dag: Ka o yaa daa kul pahiri biɛɣukam, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ daa be o sani.
en: He became stronger and stronger because the Lord All-Powerful was with him.

dag: Ka Shadirak mini Mɛshak ni Abɛdnɛgo daa garigi yɛli naa, Nɛbukadnɛza, di bi kpa ni ti garig a shɛli yɛla ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: The three men replied, Your Majesty, we don't need to defend ourselves.

dag: ka su wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ, ka woligi neesim ka chɛ zibisim. Ka Naawuni daa nya li ka di viɛla.
en: to rule day and night, and to separate light from darkness. God looked at what he had done, and it was good.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa n ni ti zaŋ n shia n-niŋ daadam kam ni, ka yi bidibisi mini yi bipuɣinsi ti tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa; ka yi ninkura ti zahim zahima; ka yi nachimba mi ti nya ʒii.
en: After that I will pour out my spirit upon everyone; your sons and your daughters will prophesy, your old men will dream dreams, and your young men will see visions.

dag: Ka yi bihi ŋɔ mi ni leei piɛguliba mɔɣu ŋɔ ni yuun pihinahi. Bɛ ni di wahala yi ni bi ʒe yim la zuɣu hal ka yi ni ninvuɣ so ŋun bahindi nyaaŋa ti kpi n-kpalim mɔɣu ŋɔ ni.
en: and your children will be shepherds in the desert for forty years. They will suffer for your unfaithfulness, until the last of your bodies fall in the desert.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa neei gom ni ka yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ bela kpe ka m bi mi.
en: Jacob woke up suddenly and thought, The Lord is in this place, and I didn't even know it.

dag: M bi lan je suli niŋ wain tihi puu maa. Di yi mali gɔhi mini suligunyinyari, dindina n ni mali shili lu di zuɣu, ka nyo li buɣim.
en: I am no longer angry. But if it produces thorns, I will go to war against it and burn it to the ground.

dag: Niriba maa tɛha daa zommi; ka di saha maa hal ni zuŋɔ bɛ yi karindi Naawuni daalikauli kurili la yɛla, lala chinchin yini maa na kul pilimi liri bɛ tɛha, dama Masia kɔŋko zuɣu ka di ni tooi piligi.
en: Their minds, indeed, were closed; and to this very day their minds are covered with the same veil as they read the books of the old covenant. The veil is removed only when a person is joined to Christ.

dag: ka chɛ ka di ku pali mɔchɛriba nukura bee n-saɣi mɔbɔbilɔriba mɔbɔɣu.
en: The one who goes to harvest it will not find enough to cut and stack.

dag: Yi ni so miri ka o ti zaŋ o bidibiga bee o bipuɣiŋga nyo buɣim mali sara bee n-ŋmɛri bihigu bee m-buɣiri baɣa bee n-nyɛ bɔha bee bukpaha.
en: Don't sacrifice your son or daughter. And don't try to use any kind of magic or witchcraft to tell fortunes or to cast spells or to talk with spirits of the dead.

dag: Ka bɛ daa laɣim taai duŋ niŋ Musa mini Aduna. Bɛ daa yɛli ba mi, Yi va n-ʒi pam. Dama niriba ŋɔ zaa yinoyino nyɛla bɛn be kasi, ka Yawɛ be bɛ sani. Ka bɔzuɣu ka yi ti duhi yimaŋ Yawɛ niriba sani lala.
en: They assembled against Moses and Aaron and said to them, Youve gone too far, because the entire community is holy, every last one of them, and the LORD is with them. Why then do you exalt yourselves above the LORDs assembly.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa ti bɛ zaa yinoyino binyɛr piɛla, ka yɛli ba ni bɛ na guhim hal ka bɛ tumtumdi tab mini bɛ mabi shɛb bɛ ni na yɛn ku kaman bɛ ni daa ku ba shɛm la gba yɛla ti naai zaa.
en: Each of them was given a white robe, and they were told to rest a little longer, until their fellow servants and brothers and sisters—who were about to be killed as they were—were finished.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ yi Naawuni, hal yi yi ti kurigi m-paligi gba, n ni gbib ya. Mani n-nam ya, ka ni gbib ya. N ni sɔŋ ya, ka tiligi ya.
en: I will still be the same when you are old and gray, and I will take care of you. I created you. I will carry you and always keep you safe.

dag: Ka a yi yaag a noli yɛli ni Yisa nyɛla a Duuma, ka niŋ yɛda a suhu ni ni Naawuni daa neeg o kum ni, a ni tiligi.
en: If you openly say, Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from death, you will be saved.

dag: Nir ni tooi di o ba min o ma yili mini bɛ buni fali, amaa yidaampaɣ so ŋun mali yɛm yirila Yawɛ sanna.
en: House and riches are an inheritance from ones ancestors, but an insightful wife is from the LORD.

dag: M bi baŋ mmaŋmaŋ yɛla gba, dama m bi tumdi mmaŋmaŋ ni bɔri ni n tum shɛli, amaa n ni je shɛl la, dina ka n tumda.
en: I dont understand why I act the way I do. I dont do the good I want to do, and I do the evil I hate.

dag: Ka ti zaa bɛn nyɛ chinchini ni bi pili liri shɛb ninni ŋɔ lihirila ti Duuma jilima ŋɔ, ka jilima maa mi nyɛla din kul pahiri jilima, ka nyɛ din taɣiri ti biɛhigu ni ti mal o ŋmahinli, dama dimbɔŋɔ yirila ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ Shia la sanna.
en: All of us are looking with unveiled faces at the glory of the Lord as if we were looking in a mirror. We are being transformed into that same image from one degree of glory to the next degree of glory. This comes from the Lord, who is the Spirit.

dag: N lan nya dimbɔŋɔ zaa saha shɛli n ni daa tɛhiri binshɛɣukam din niŋdi dunia ŋɔ ni yɛla. Ninvuɣ so ŋun mali yaa mi n-zaŋ o yaa maa n-nahind o taba.
en: I noticed all this and thought seriously about what goes on in the world. Why does one person have the power to hurt another?.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa bi bɔri wuntaŋ bee goli ni di ne di ni, dama Naawuni jilima n-nyɛ di neesim, ka Piɛbil maa mi nyɛ di firila.
en: And the city did not need the sun or the moon. The glory of God was shining on it, and the Lamb was its light.

dag: Chɛ ka ti me dubil tam ti yil ŋɔ zuɣusaa, ka bo garo mini teebuli ni kuɣa ni firila zali di ni, o yi ti lan ka ti sanna ka o kpe nimaani.
en: Lets make a small room on the roof. Well set up a bed, a table, a chair, and a lamp for him there. Then when he comes to us, he can stay there.

dag: Di daba ata dali ka Ibrahimma daa ti lihi nya o ni chani luɣ shɛli maa ka di be katiŋ ha.
en: On the third day Abraham saw the place in the distance.

dag: ninvuɣ so ŋun daa kana ti yɛli ma, Nyama, Sool kpiya, ka daa tɛhi ni o ʒila lahiba suŋ na ti ti ma la, n daa gbaag o mi n-ku o Zikilag, ka di leeg o yɔri o ni ti ma lahiba shɛli maa zuɣu.
en: when someone told me Saul was dead back in Ziklag, thinking he was bringing good news, I grabbed him and killed him. That was the reward I gave him for his news!.

dag: Di saha ka Rubin mini Gaad ni Manaasa zuliya pirigili maa daa chɛ Izraɛlnim shɛb bɛn be Shilo din be Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, ka kuli Giliad tiŋgbɔŋ ni din nyɛ Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Musa zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti ba, ka di leei bɛ din la ni.
en: So the people from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Manasseh left the other Israelites at Shiloh in Canaan. They went back home to Gilead. This was their own land, the land that Moses gave them, as the Lord had commanded.

dag: Bɛ bi mali noli ni yɛtɔɣa kɔŋko saɣisiri tumtumdiba, dama hal bɛ yi kul baŋ a ni yɛli shɛm, bɛ baɣa ku bɛ di ni.
en: You cannot correct servants just by talking to them. They may understand you, but they will pay no attention.

dag: N labirila a sanna pumpɔŋɔ, dinzuɣu ka n tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ n ni na be dunia ŋɔ ni ŋɔ, ni n suhupiɛlli pali bɛ suhuri ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: I am coming to you now. But I pray these things while I am still in the world. I say all this so that these followers can have the true happiness that I have. I want them to be completely happy.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa teei Yawɛ dabili Musa ʒiɛman la yɛla ka bɔhira, Yawɛ ŋun daa tilig o niriba toondaannim teeku ni la lee be ya pumpɔŋɔ? Yawɛ ŋun daa zaŋ o shia kasi ti Musa la lee be ya?.
en: Then they remembered what happened long ago. They remembered Moses and those with him. So where is the one who brought them through the sea along with the shepherds who led his flock? Where is the one who sent his Holy Spirit to live among them?.

dag: Simiɔn bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Nɛmuɛl mini Jamin ni Jarib ni Zɛra ni Shaul.
en: Simeon had five sons: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul.

dag: Yisa nyaandol so daa be Damaskus maa ka o yuli booni Ananias. Ka o daa ti nya ʒii, ka ti Duuma bol o di ni, Ananias! Ka o saɣi n-yɛli, N-nyɛ ma, n Duuma.
en: In Damascus there was a certain disciple named Ananias. The Lord spoke to him in a vision, Ananias! He answered, Yes, Lord.

dag: Bɛ ni me goon shɛŋa din du ka mali yaa taɣi bɛmaŋ la zaa ni kab lu tiŋ dahim zaa.
en: The fortified towers of their walls will be thrown down, will be leveled, will be brought down to the earth, to the dust.

dag: ni Hɔrinim bɛn be Ɛdom zoya ni la n-doli ba hal ni Ɛliparan din be mɔɣu ni tintariga la shee.
en: and the Horites in the mountains of Seir as far as El-paran near the desert.

dag: Ka Siria naa maa ni ti zaŋ o ni ŋme tɔb maa di neen shɛŋa n-lab kul o ya, ka ni ti lo nia ni o saɣim wuntizɔriba daadiini soli. O ni ti tum o suhu ni yu shɛm, ka naanyi lab o ya.
en: The northern king will go back to his own country with much wealth. Then he will decide to do bad things against the holy agreement. He will do the things he planned, and then he will go back to his own country.

dag: N ni chɛ ka kom tɛli tiŋgbani din bɔri kom, ka chɛ ka kom zo n-tiɛli tiŋgbani din kuui. N ni zaŋ n shia niŋ a zuliya ni, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a bihi ni.
en: I will give water to the thirsty land and make streams flow on the dry ground. I will pour out my spirit on your children and my blessing on your descendants.

dag: N ŋmanila dabili ŋun ʒe o dan tooni. Wula ka n ni tooi tɔɣisi n dan yɛtɔɣa? Ya buriginli bee vuhim lan ka n ni.
en: I am like a slave standing before his master. How can I talk to you? I have no strength or breath left in me.

dag: Ka Musa daa niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni zal o shɛm maa, ka laɣim niriba maa zaa Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol maa ni.
en: Moses obeyed the Lord , and when everyone had come together.

dag: Yi daa ku niriba pam bo vi niŋ yi yiŋa. Yi kɔŋ yi nyɛviya.
en: But you will bring shame on your family and ruin to yourself for what you did to others.

dag: Kpaŋmiya yimaŋa m-be baalim, ka chɛ ka yi zaɣa be yimaŋmaŋ yɛla ni, ka bɔnya yimaŋmaŋ nuu zuɣu tuma tummi kaman ti ni daa pun wuhi ya shɛm la.
en: Make it your aim to live a quiet life, to mind your own business, and to earn your own living, just as we told you before.

dag: N nyuli zabbu mini n suhuyiɣisili pam puuni ka n yɛri ŋɔ: Dindali maa Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni ti dam pam.
en: I declare in the heat of my anger that on that day there will be a severe earthquake in the land of Israel.

dag: Binnɛma anahi maa daa yi ti tibigiri ŋun ʒi nam ʒiishee maa ni ka tir o jilima, ka paɣiri ŋuna ŋun ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu maa saha shɛli.
en: The living creatures kept praising, honoring, and thanking the one who sits on the throne and who lives forever and ever.

dag: Amaa miri ka a lan tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa Bɛtɛl ŋɔ, dama di nyɛla naa sara maligu bimbini shee, ka nyɛ o nam sulinsi jɛmbu shee.
en: Don't do any more preaching at Bethel. The king worships here at our national temple.

dag: Yawɛ neem o nina lihi ya ka tin ya suhudoo.
en: May the Lord be good to you and give you peace.

dag: Gɛbal kpamba mini di yɛnnim daa bela a sani m-maani a shee kpatuɣa zaana. Teeku puuni ŋarima zaa mini di kpatoonsi zaa daa nyɛla bɛn be a ni dar a nɛma.
en: The ship's carpenters Were well-trained men from Byblos. Sailors from every seagoing ship Did business in your shops.

dag: Kul guhimiya Yawɛ, ka dol o soli, ka o duhi ya n-chɛ ka yi su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ, ka chɛ ka yi nya ninvuɣ biɛri ni yɛn bahi yoli shɛm.
en: Do what the Lord says, and wait for his help. He will reward you and give you the land he promised. You will see the wicked being forced to leave.

dag: Ka a zaligu ŋɔ yi moli gili a sulinsi tiŋgbɔn titali ŋɔ zaa ni, di ni chɛ ka paɣ kam lu o yidan sizuura, o yidana yi nyɛla wɔɣirili bee tarima.
en: Then when the kings command is announced in all parts of his large kingdom, all the women will respect their husbands. From the most important to the least important, all the women will respect their husbands.

dag: Amaŋmaŋ mi din be Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim puuni. Dina n-nyɛ: Miri ka a ku ninsala; miri ka a niŋ zina; miri ka a zu; miri ka a di shɛhira kpɛma; miri ka a di zalinsi; ka tim a ba min a ma jilima. .
en: You know the commandments: Do not commit murder; do not commit adultery; do not steal; do not accuse anyone falsely; do not cheat; respect your father and your mother.

dag: Di dubihi mini di pilanim ni di zɔntua mini dina la daa nyɛla yim, ka takɔriti be di ni zaa gili ni di zɔntua maa ni. Di wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita pisinaanu, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pinaayi ni pirigili.
en: Its guardrooms, its entrance room, and its inner walls were the same size as those in the other gateways. There were also windows in the rooms of this gateway. The total length was feet and the width feet.

dag: N ʒiɛyimtali mini n yurilim maŋli kul ni be o ni; ka o ni di nasara n yuli zuɣu.
en: I will love him and be loyal to him; I will make him always victorious.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa ŋmaligi nya ba, ka zaŋ Yawɛ yuli yɛli ba noli. Ka gbuɣin nyama ayi daa yi tibɔŋ ni na nti dim ku bidibbihi pihinahinaayi.
en: Turning around, Elisha looked at them and cursed them in the LORDs name. Then two bears came out of the woods and mangled forty-two of the youths.

dag: Tuuli binnɛɔŋ daa ŋmanila gbuɣinli, ka ŋun pah ayi ŋmani naɣilaa, ka ŋun pah ata ninni mi ŋmani ninsal ninni, ka ŋun pah anahi mi ŋmani tɔrili ŋun yiɣira.
en: The first one looked like a lion; the second looked like a bull; the third had a face like a human face; and the fourth looked like an eagle in flight.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ suma n-nyɛ bɛn ni ti be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali nyɛ bɛn ni ti kpalim be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: If you are honest and innocent, you will keep your land;.

dag: Dama Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, N ni be m biɛhigu shee ka lihina baalim kaman maligim ni lurina yuŋ kachɛɣu saha shɛm ni kaman biisim ni be wuntaŋ ni shɛm la.
en: The Lord said to me, I will look down from heaven as quietly as the dew forms in the warm nights of harvest time, as serenely as the sun shines in the heat of the day.

dag: Ɛdom daa ka naa; wulana n-daa nyɛ naa.
en: Now Edom had no king; only a deputy was ruler.

dag: O yɛliya, Bɔ saha ka yi lee yɛn chɛ saria karibu din bi doli zaligu soli mini ninvuɣ biɛri nyaaŋa zanibu?.
en: He says, How long will you judge unfairly and show special favors to the wicked? Selah.

dag: Hal Yawɛ ni daa kul timd o daba zaa bɛn nyɛ anabinim la yi sanna la zaa yoli, yi daa zaɣisiya ni yi ku gbilisi tibili wum.
en: The Lord has sent prophets to you time after time, but you refused to listen.

dag: N tizɔpaɣa ni n daamiliya n kpe m puu maa ni. N laɣim n tulaalɛnim mini mɛɛr. N di n shigbana shiri. N nyu n wain ni m bihim. Zɔrinima, dimiya ka nyu, n yurinima, nyumiya yurilim hal ti buɣi.
en: I have come to my garden, my sister, my bride! I have gathered my myrrh and my spices. I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey; I have drunk my wine and my milk. Eat, dear friends! Drink and get drunk on love!.

dag: Ka o nyaandolitab daa baŋ lala ka zaŋ o tahi Siizaria nti chɛ ka o kul o ya Taasus.
en: When the family of believers learned about this, they escorted him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.

dag: Vinnyaɣilana n-yɛra, Gbuɣinli be samban ni, o ni ku ma sol ni.
en: A lazy person says, Theres a lion in the street! Ill be killed in the town square.

dag: Jɔsia yuma daa nyɛla yuma anii saha shɛl o ni daa di nam. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pihitaniyini.
en: Josiah was years old when he became king, and he ruled for thirty-one years in Jerusalem.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ Ijipti daanya na, ka chɛ ka Itiɔpianim mi kpuɣi bɛ nuhi duhi zuɣusaa jɛm Naawuni.
en: Ambassadors will come from Egypt; the Ethiopians will raise their hands in prayer to God.

dag: Ka o daa yooi bɔɣ zilinli din ziliŋ ka tariga maa, ka nyɔhi yi di ni na kaman buɣim daaŋkpa tital ni buɣim nyɔhi la, ka di nyɔhi maa daa sabigi wuntaŋ mini zuɣusaa zaa.
en: Then the star opened the hole leading to the pit. Smoke came up from the hole like smoke from a big furnace. The sun and sky became dark because of the smoke from the hole.

dag: Ka o daa lan niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol o yuli Juda ka yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ dina n ni paɣi Yawɛ. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa chɛ dɔɣibu.
en: She became pregnant again and gave birth to a son. She said, This time I will praise the LORD. So she named him Judah. Then she stopped bearing children.

dag: ka zaŋ o ni daa yihi sapir kɔb shɛli maa nam paɣa n-zaŋ o ti doo maa.
en: the Lord made a woman out of the rib. The Lord God brought her to the man.

dag: Naa Ahaz ni daa yi Damaskus kuna, o daa chaŋmi ti nya bimbini maa. Di saha ka o daa vu m-miri bimbini maa nti du n-tam di zuɣu.
en: When the king arrived from Damascus, he inspected the altar. He came close to it, then went up on it.

dag: Di zaŋya yi niŋgbuna yaɣ shɛli ti alahichi tum tuumbiɛri; amaa zaŋmiya yimaŋ tila Naawuni kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yi kum ni kpe nyɛvili ni, ka zaŋ yi niŋgbuna yaɣili kam ti Naawuni tum wuntia tuma.
en: Dont offer parts of your body to sin, to be used as weapons to do wrong. Instead, present yourselves to God as people who have been brought back to life from the dead, and offer all the parts of your body to God to be used as weapons to do right.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Anabi Musa daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka bi zo Firawuna suhuyiɣisili. O daa bi saɣi ni o lab o nyaaŋa; o daa bemi kaman o nini nyala Naawuni ŋun nyɛ nir ni ku tooi nya so ŋɔ.
en: Moses left Egypt because he had faith. He was not afraid of the kings anger. He continued strong as if he could see the God no one can see.

dag: Amɔri nanima anu la daa zo nti sɔɣi bela vol ni Makɛda.
en: While the enemy soldiers were running from the Israelites, the five enemy kings ran away and hid in a cave near Makkedah.

dag: ka zaŋ jɛsint mini agɛt ni amɛtisit m-pie taba kul shɛli din pahir ata.
en: in the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;.

dag: Musa mini Aduna ni daa kali Kɔhat daŋ niriba bɛn zaa daa tumdi tuma Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm kalinli n-daa bala.
en: So these men from the Kohath family group were given their special work to do for the Meeting Tent. Moses and Aaron did this the way the Lord had told Moses to do.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli yi yi ku wum n ni yɛli shɛm, Naawuni ni chɛ ka tinzunnim zaŋ tinzun yɛtɔɣa wuhi ya.
en: So God will use this strange way of talking, and he will use other languages to speak to these people.

dag: Yinim Filipainim mi ka biɛhiŋ kani ni lahibal suŋ molo molibu piligu ni saha, n ni daa yiɣisi Masidɔnia la, yi kɔŋko n-daa nyɛ cheechi shɛli niriba bɛn pahi n zuɣu baŋ deebu mini tibu yɛla.
en: You people in Philippi remember when I first told the Good News there. When I left Macedonia, you were the only church that gave me help.

dag: Dindali maa yuŋ ka ti Duuma daa kana nti zani baɣili Pool yɛl o, Chɛ ka a suhu kpɛma, dama a ni niŋ n shɛhiralana Jɛrusalɛm ŋɔ shɛm, lala ka a ni ti niŋ n shɛhiralana Rom gba.
en: That night the Lord stood by Paul and said, Don't be afraid! You have given your witness for me here in Jerusalem, and you must also do the same in Rome.

dag: N kul guhirila Yawɛ; n kul guhir o mi, ka mali tahima o yɛligu ni.
en: I hope, LORD. My whole being hopes, and I wait for Gods promise.

dag: Ka saha shɛlikam ti suhuri yi ti wuhi ti ni ti mali galimi, Naawuni gari ti suhuri maa, ka mi binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: Even if our hearts condemn us, God is greater than our hearts and knows all things.

dag: Naa Sulemaana daa yuri tinzun paɣiba pam. O ni daa kpuɣi Ijipti Firawuna bipuɣiŋga la nyaaŋa, o daa lan kpuɣi Mɔab paɣiba mini Ammɔn paɣiba ni Hiti paɣiba ni Sidɔn paɣiba ni Ɛdom paɣiba.
en: King Solomon loved many foreign women, including the daughter of Pharaoh and women from Moab, Ammon, Edom, Sidon, and the Hittites.

dag: N daa yɛli ba, Yi zaa zaŋmiya yi ni yuri bimbiɛ shɛŋa la zaa labi, ka miriya ka yi zaŋ Ijipti buɣa la n-saɣim yimaŋa. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: I told them to get rid of their disgusting idols and not to sin by worshiping the gods of Egypt. I reminded them that I was the Lord their God.

dag: Miriya ka yi ŋub nimdi ka ʒim na be di ni. Di ti bɔhimya baɣitali bee sotali.
en: You must not eat any meat with blood still in it. You must not try to use different kinds of magic to tell the future.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim, maliya suhupiɛlli jilima puuni. Yilimiya suhupiɛlli yila yi bindɔhi zuɣu.
en: All of you faithful people, praise our glorious Lord! Celebrate and worship.

dag: Ka o ba maa yi ka mabihi bɛn nyɛ dɔbba, yin zaŋmiya o fali maa ti o dɔɣir so ŋun nyɛ o talahi nira o daŋ ni, ka o su li. Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla zaligu Izraɛlnim sani kaman Yawɛ ni zali Musa shɛm.
en: If his father had no brothers, you should give his inheritance to his nearest relative from his clan. He will take possession of it. This will be a regulation and a case law for the Israelites, as the LORD commanded Moses.

dag: Kul yumiya taba kaman yi nyɛla mabi yinsi la.
en: Keep being concerned about each other as the Lord's followers should.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka ti diri wahala ka tumdi ti yaa tariga, dama ti zaŋ ti tahima zaa niŋla Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ ni. Ŋuna n-nyɛ sokam zaa Tiligira, di bahi bamdi bɛn niŋ o yɛda la.
en: We struggle and work hard, because we have placed our hope in the living God, who is the Savior of all and especially of those who believe.

dag: O kul malila Naawuni biɛhigu sahakam, amaa o daa bi tɛhi ni di simdi ni o duh omaŋa n-wuhi ni o mini Naawuni saɣiya.
en: Though he was in the form of God, he did not consider being equal with God something to exploit.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ daa yɛl o mi, Bɔhim maligumaana m-baŋ zaligu ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ bɔhigu ŋɔ polo.
en: The Lord All-Powerful commands you to ask the priests what the law says about these things:.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa zaŋ bia maa n-du n-kpɛhi ti sɔŋ Naawuni nir maa garo zuɣu; ka yina n-vooi dunoli yo.
en: The woman laid the boy on the bed of Elisha, the man of God. Then she shut the door to that room and went outside.

dag: ka maligumaana Zadok mini anabi Neetan pun booi kpam bah o zuɣu ni n-leeg o nam Gihɔn; ka bɛ yi nimaani na m-mali suhupiɛlli, dina n-chɛ ka bɛ yɔri vuri tiŋ puuni maa. Di vuri ka yi wum maa.
en: Zadok the priest and the prophet Nathan have anointed him king at Gihon. They went up from there celebrating so that the city was thrown into a commotion. That is the sound you heard.

dag: Nyin daadam, yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Yi ni yɛri shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ti biriginsim mini ti daalahichi tibisim marigi ti mi ka ti tarigi. Wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ be.
en: So, son of man, speak to the family of Israel for me. They might say, We have sinned and broken the law. Our sins are too heavy to bear. We rot away because of them. What can we do to live.

dag: Nyamiya, yi tiŋguliba laɣim yili suhupiɛlli yila! Dama bɛ nini nya Yawɛ ni labisi Ziɔn zali di zaashee shɛm.
en: Those who guard the city are shouting, shouting together for joy. They can see with their own eyes the return of the Lord to Zion.

dag: Ka doo maa yɛli, Di yi nyɛla lala, hal n ni mali soli ni n da tiŋgbani maa la zaa yoli, n ni chɛ di dabu, dama di wuhiya ni mmaŋmaŋ bihi ti ku di li fali. Nyin dam li, man ku da li.
en: The man answered, In that case I will give up my right to buy the field, because it would mean that my own children would not inherit it. You buy it; I would rather not.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani; ka daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ alahichi shɛŋa zaa Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la. Lala ka o daa kul niŋdi hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: He constantly disobeyed the Lord by following the example of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused the Israelites to sin.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabiyurisi, n ni daa be yi sani ka yi deeri n noli shɛm la, hal n ni ka yi sani pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ, di niŋ kamaata ni yi na kul deeri n noli lala. Kul tummiya ni dabiɛm zɔbu mini ni sɔhibu nti nya yi tiliginsim tuma naabu.
en: Therefore, my loved ones, just as you always obey me, not just when I am present but now even more while I am away, carry out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ n nyɔtaɣirigu. Ŋuna n-tiligiri bɛn ʒe dɛde bɛ suhuri ni.
en: God is my shield; he saves those whose heart is right.

dag: ka o daa nya ba ka yɛli, Naawuni sansani m-bɔŋɔ! Dinzuɣu ka o daa boli nimaani yuli Mahanaim.
en: When Jacob saw them, he said, This is God's camp. So he named the place Mahanaim.

dag: Di saha ka a daa yɛli tinim a daba ŋɔ, Faashee ka yi ti ʒi yi tizo maa mali na, di yi pa lala, yin di ti chɛ ka n nini nyan ya.
en: But you warned us that we could never see you again, unless our youngest brother came with us.

dag: Ba ni zɔr o bihi nambɔɣu shɛm, lala ka Yawɛ zɔri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔr o la nambɔɣu.
en: As a father is kind to his children, so the Lord is kind to those who honor him.

dag: ka yɛli ni bɛn fiɣisir o maa kamila a sanna. Amaŋmaŋ yi zahim o a ni baŋ ti ni yɛli ni o tum tuun shɛŋa maa.
en: If you question this man, you yourself will be able to learn from him all the things that we are accusing him of.

dag: Ka alikama maa daa ti va puya m-pil dɔɣibu, di saha ka bɛ naanyi baŋ ni piriŋkpana be di ni.
en: Later, the wheat grew, and heads of grain grew on the plants. But at the same time the weeds also grew.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni taɣi yi mini yi bihi suhuri din ni chɛ ka yi yuri ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yi suhuri zaa mini yi shihi zaa, ka lala ti chɛ ka yi be.
en: You and your descendants are stubborn, but the Lord will make you willing to obey him and love him with all your heart and soul, and you will enjoy a long life.

dag: O ni wuhi ba alahichi ni nyɛ shɛli, bɛ ni bi niŋ ma yɛda zuɣu.
en: He will show the world it was wrong about sin because they dont believe in me.

dag: Naawuni simdi paɣibu hal ni saha din ka bahigu, ŋuna n-su yɛm mini yiko.
en: Our God, your name will be praised forever and forever. You are all-powerful, and you know everything.

dag: Ka di bi simdi ni a zaŋ pakoya bɛn nyɛ paɣisara la gba yuya pahi pakoya kalinli ni, dama bɛ kɔre yi ti kpe dɔbba kulibu ni bɛ ŋmaligirimi ka chɛ Masia.
en: But dont put younger widows on that list. When their strong physical needs pull them away from their commitment to Christ, they will want to marry again.

dag: Bɛ doonila bɛ zaɣim yuŋ kam, ka ka situra. Bɛ ka binshɛli din ni pili wari saha.
en: They sleep naked in the cold, because they have no cover.

dag: Di simdi ka yi mali luɣ shɛli yi sansani maa kpaŋa n-chani nimaani ti damdiri yɔɣuni.
en: You are to have a place outside the camp where you can go when you need to relieve yourselves.

dag: N nia lɔbu nyɛla ni n yihi lahibal suŋ waazu ŋɔ luɣ shɛli niriba ni na bi wum Masia yuli yɛla, ka di chɛ ka n ku me n-tam so mɛbu zuɣu.
en: I always want to tell the Good News in places where people have never heard of Christ. I do this because I dont want to build on the work that someone else has already started.

dag: Yi nahindi nandaamba ka fari bɛ chi. Dinzuɣu yi ku be yi ni zaŋ kuɣa me yi yiya shɛŋa la ni, yi mi ku nyu yi ni sa yi wain ti viɛl shɛŋa la wain.
en: You have oppressed the poor and robbed them of their grain. And so you will not live in the fine stone houses you build or drink wine from the beautiful vineyards you plant.

dag: Yawɛ, n daa bela gballi din zilim pam puuni, ka suh a.
en: From the bottom of the pit, I prayed to you, Lord .

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ Aduna bidibisi la na nti zaŋ zabbanim yɛli ba, ka zaŋ shɛlɔriti lo bɛ shɛhi ni, ka zaŋ zuɣupila pil ba kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ŋun Musa shɛm.
en: Next, Moses brought the sons of Aaron forward and put shirts on them, put sashes around their waists, and tied caps on their heads, just as the Lord had commanded.

dag: Yi yi me yil palli, yin niŋm bini kɔɣili yi mɔpilli ti tuui, di yi pa lala so yi yi di zuɣu luna kpi o ʒim yihibu taali ni ʒi yi yili maa zuɣu.
en: When you build a new house, you must build a wall around your roof. Then you will not be guilty for the death of a person who falls from the house.

dag: O yuma daa nyɛla yuun pihitanaayi saha shɛl o ni daa di nam. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuma anii; ka daa ti kpi ka di bi niŋ so nandahima. Ka bɛ daa sɔɣ o Dauda tiŋ la ni, amaa bɛ daa bi sɔɣ o nanim silisi la ni.
en: He was years old when he became king, and he ruled for eight years in Jerusalem. No one was sorry he died. He was buried in Davids City but not in the royal cemetery.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yimaŋmaŋ nya n ni daa chɛ ka alɔbo lu Jɛrusalɛm mini Juda fɔntinsi ni shɛm. Lihimiya li, zuŋɔ di zaa leela dabari, ka so lan ka di ni.
en: This is what the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, says: You people saw the disasters that I brought on the city of Jerusalem and on all the towns of Judah. The towns are empty piles of stones today.

dag: Kɔbil nin yini ni tooi bilisi ko nyaɣisili mini ko lɔŋolɔŋɔ?.
en: No spring of water pours out sweet water and bitter water from the same opening.

dag: O na ʒi n-zaɣisi bee n-siŋ ninvuɣ so ŋun nyari nahiŋgu; bee n-chɛ ka o baɣa ka n ni. O mi bi lɛbir o nyaaŋa biriti ma, amaa n yi kuhi niŋ o bɔri sɔŋsim, o wumda.
en: Because he didnt despise or detest the suffering of the one who suffered— he didnt hide his face from me. No, he listened when I cried out to him for help.

dag: bee alɔbo din be zibisim ni bee mbusim din paarina wuntaŋ ni agbaa saha la.
en: And you won't fear diseases that strike in the dark or sudden disaster at noon.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba daa wum lala ka bɔri so shɛli bɛ ni yɛn doli ku o, amaa ka daa lee zɔr o, dama o wuhibu maa daa gari salo maa pam.
en: The chief priests and the teachers of the Law heard of this, so they began looking for some way to kill Jesus. They were afraid of him, because the whole crowd was amazed at his teaching.

dag: Ka Balak daa kɔri naɣilahi mini piɛri duɣi tahi ti ti Balaam mini kpamba bɛn daa be o sani.
en: Balak sacrificed oxen and sheep and sent them to Balaam and the officials who were with him.

dag: ka yɛri ni yinim yi di daa be yi yaannim saha la, yi daa naan ku pahi bɛ zuɣu ku anabinim maa.
en: You say, If we had lived in our ancestors days, we wouldnt have joined them in killing the prophets.

dag: Maika bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Pitɔn mini Mɛlɛk ni Taria ni Ahaz.
en: and the great-grandfather of Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ, deem n suhigu. Yaakubu Naawuni, gbilisim tibili wum!.
en: LORD God of heavenly forces, hear my prayer; listen closely, Jacobs God! Selah.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti bi nya o, ka bɛ ŋmaligi lab Jɛrusalɛm ni bɛ ti bo o shee.
en: They did not find him, so they went back to Jerusalem looking for him.

dag: Ka ti yi nyɛla Naawuni bihi, dindina ti nyɛla o bindiriba. Ti nyɛla bɛn mini Masia laɣim nyɛ Naawuni bindiriba, tinim dee min o yi laɣim di wahala ni di chɛ ka ti min o ti laɣim nya jilima.
en: His Spirit lets us know that together with Christ we will be given what God has promised. We will also share in the glory of Christ, because we have suffered with him.

dag: Ka shɛb yɛli, Anabi Ilaija m-bala. Ka shɛb mi yɛli, O ŋmanila anab kura la ni yino.
en: Others, however, said, He is Elijah. Others said, He is a prophet, like one of the prophets of long ago.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti ŋub li, ti kpaamiya li bahi tiŋa kaman kom la.
en: Dont eat the blood. Pour it out like water onto the ground.

dag: Naawuni Kundi ni luɣ shɛli lan yɛli, Bɛ ni ti lihiri bɛ ni daa zaŋ kpani kuhi so la.
en: And another scripture says, They will look at him whom they have pierced.

dag: Ka o daa ti lab o nyaandoliba maa sanna ti nya ka bɛ gbihirimi ka o bɔhi Pita, Yi ku tooi gali gom biɛla n zuɣu?.
en: He came back to the disciples and found them sleeping. He said to Peter, Couldnt you stay alert one hour with me?.

dag: Ka Pita daa dii yiɣisi doli ba. O ni daa mali ti paai, ka bɛ zaŋ o du jirambisa zuɣusaa duu maa ni, ka tiŋ maa ni pakoya zaa daa ʒe n-gili Pita kumda, ka wuhir o binyɛr shɛŋa Dɔɔkas ni daa na be o nyɛvili ni ka she n-ti ba.
en: Peter got ready and went with them. When he arrived, they took him to the upstairs room. All the widows stood around him. They were crying and showing him the coats and other clothes that Tabitha had made during her time with them.

dag: Wuntaŋ puhibu saha zaŋ hal ti paai o lubu saha, kul paɣimiya Yawɛ yuli.
en: From sunrise to sunset, let the LORDs name be praised!.

dag: Dina ka n dan mali nyuri kom, ka lan mal li nyar ashilɔni yɛla. Yi ni niŋ shɛm maa, yi tum taali. .
en: Isnt this the cup my master drinks from and uses to discover Gods plans? What youve done is despicable.

dag: Yi mi miriya ka yi deei binshɛli ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ so ŋun zo nti be tiliginsim tiŋ ni lab ti be o ya ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan na bi kpi.
en: If they have fled to a city of refuge, do not allow them to make a payment in order to return home before the death of the High Priest.

dag: Miriya ka yi mɔŋ sana bee kpibiga o yɛlimaŋli ni nyɛ shɛli, ka miriya ka yi deei pakoli chinchini sɔŋ pɔi ka naanyi zaŋ binshɛli paŋ o.
en: Do not deprive foreigners and orphans of their rights; and do not take a widow's garment as security for a loan.

dag: N suui ʒitibisi shɛŋa din yi tam yi bɔɣusapima zuɣu la; ka yihi ya piɛri ʒiya la ʒibu ni.
en: I took the load from your shoulder. I let you drop the workers basket.
