dag: Nyin bilikɔɣindan ŋɔ! Vuɣim daantal shɛli din sa a ninni maa ka nyari viɛnyɛliŋga pɔi, ka naanyi yihi bimburigin shɛli din be a mabia ninni.
en: You're nothing but show-offs! First, take the log out of your own eye; then you can see how to take the speck out of your friend's eye.

dag: Di saha ka Sool bipuɣiŋga ŋun pah ayi ka o yuli daa booni Mikal la suhu daa yu Dauda pam, ka bɛ daa yɛli Sool di yɛla, ka di daa niŋ o nyaɣisim pam.
en: People told Saul that his daughter Michal loved David. This made Saul happy.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yɛl o, Di sabiya, Pa bindirigu kɔŋko zuɣu ka daadam be, amaa yɛtɔɣili kam din yiri Naawuni nol ni na zuɣu ka daadam be. .
en: Jesus replied, Its written, People wont live only by bread, but by every word spoken by God .

dag: Dinzuɣu n kul ni yiini yila paɣir a yuli, n yi ti zaŋ n ni lo alikauli ni n zaŋ binshɛli n-tir a dabisili kam la na ti ti a.
en: I will sing your praises forever, God, and will always keep my promises.

dag: Giliadnim yi tum alahichi, biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ ni bahi yoli. Giligal tiŋgbɔŋ ni bɛ maanila maligu tiri naɣilahi. Lala zuɣu bɛ maligu bimbina maa ni ti ŋmanila kuɣa ka bɛ laɣisi duhi puu ni.
en: But the people in Gilead have sinned. There are many terrible idols in that place. They offer sacrifices to bulls at Gilgal. They have many altars. There are rows and rows of altars—like the rows of dirt in a plowed field.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kanna maa zaa daa yi ʒirila bɛ pina din nyɛ anzinfa mini salima ni kpariti ni mɛɛr ni tulaale ni yuri ni buntaansi na ti tir o yuuni kam.
en: Everyone who came brought him a gift—articles of silver and gold, robes, weapons, spices, horses, and mules. This continued year after year.

dag: Naawuni n-daa zal o ni o nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulan ŋun tuma ni be kaman Mɛlikizɛdɛk tuma ni daa be shɛm.
en: and God declared him to be high priest, in the priestly order of Melchizedek.

dag: Ka ŋun bi be nyam maa yi shihi binshɛlikam, di ni leei din bi be nyam, ka ŋunkam mi shihi li ni leei ŋun bi be nyam hal ni zaawuni.
en: Whoever the unclean person touches will be unclean, and the one who touches the unclean will be unclean until evening.

dag: Ka doo maa dii yiɣisi zaŋ o daamaŋka maa yi bɛ zaa ninni n-kuni ka paɣiri Naawuni.
en: Right away, the man stood before them, picked up his cot, and went home, praising God.

dag: M mi bɛ tɛha mini bɛ tuma. N kanimina ni n ti laɣim zuliya kam mini tinzun yɛtɔɣa balibu kam nim zaa ka bɛ kana ti nya n jilima.
en: Because of their actions and thoughts, Im coming to gather all nations and cultures. They will come to see my glory.

dag: Nyin ŋun tɛha bi zilimmi ŋɔ, a bɔri ni so n-wuh a ni yɛda niŋbu din bi tumdi tuma nyɛla yɛda ŋoli?.
en: Does some stupid person want proof that faith without deeds is useless?.

dag: N suhir a, fam ma m biɛli Iso nuu ni bahi. N zɔr o, dama di pa shɛli ka o ti kana ti ku m mini m bihi ni bɛ manim ŋɔ zaa.
en: I ask you to please save me from my brother Esau. I am afraid that he will come and kill us all, even the mothers with the children.

dag: Bɛ daŋ maa ni dɔɣirikpamba ni daa nyɛ shɛba m-bɔŋɔ: Ɛfɛr mini Ishi ni Ɛliɛl ni Aziriɛl ni Jɛrimia ni Hɔdavia ni Jadiɛl. Bɛ daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biinsi ni bɛn yuya du, ka bɛ daa lan nyɛ bɛ daŋ ni kpamba.
en: These were the heads of their households: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel—mighty warriors, famous men, heads of their households.

dag: Ka bɛ daa boli Yisa min o nyaandoliba gba ni bɛ ka amiliya maa ni na.
en: Jesus and his disciples were also invited to the celebration.

dag: A ni yɛn kpi shɛli, nimaani ka n gba yɛn kpi ka bɛ sɔɣi ma. N yi chɛ ka binshɛli woligi m min a ka pa ni kum, Yawɛ ŋun darigim n tibili.
en: Wherever you die, I will die, and there I will be buried. May the LORD do this to me and more so if even death separates me from you.

dag: Dinzuɣu yihimiya biɛr biɛɣu zaa mini yɛmbimbiɛri ni bilikɔnsi ni nyuli zabbu zaa ni munaafichi niŋbu zaa yi biɛhigu ni.
en: Stop being hateful! Quit trying to fool people, and start being sincere. Don't be jealous or say cruel things about others.

dag: Salo maa ni daa yi n-naai, ka o kpe nti gbaai bipuɣiŋga maa nuu, ka o neei n-yiɣisi zani.
en: After he had sent the crowd away, Jesus went in and touched her hand, and the little girl rose up.

dag: Ka binshɛli daa be di sunsuuni ŋ-ŋmani binnɛma anahi. Bɛ biɛhigu ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: bɛ daa ŋmanila ninsalinima.
en: And inside that were forms of four living creatures. This was what they looked like: Each had the form of a human being.

dag: Amaa buɣisimiya binshɛɣukam nya, ka gbibiya din viɛla.
en: But test everything. Keep what is good.

dag: Ka Nikɔdimus ŋun daa chaŋ Yisa sani yuŋ la gba daa bo mɛɛr din to kaman yabiga la mini bɛ ni booni ti shɛli aloosi la sum gari taba n-zaŋ na. Di tibisim daa nyɛla kaman kilɔgiram pihita laasabu.
en: Nicodemus went with Joseph. He was the man who had come to Jesus before and talked to him at night. He brought about pounds of spices—a mixture of myrrh and aloes.

dag: ka a naanyi kɔrig o Yawɛ tooni Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni.
en: Then slaughter the bull in the LORDs presence at the meeting tents entrance.

dag: O mi bi be kaman daadam ŋun bɔri shɛl o daadamkpee nuu ni la, dama ŋun Naawuni n-tiri daadam nyɛvili m-pahi vuhim ni shɛlikam.
en: He doesn't need help from anyone. He gives life, breath, and everything else to all people.

dag: Yaa n Naawuni, luɣim a tiba wum ti suhigu ŋɔ, ka ŋmalig a nini n-lihi ti nya ti ni be muɣisigu shɛl ni, ka nya a yuli ni tab tin shɛl la ni diri wahala shɛm. A ni zɔri nambɔɣu la zuɣu ka ti suhir a, ka pa ni ti wuntitali zuɣu.
en: Listen to us, O God; look at us and see the trouble we are in and the suffering of the city that bears your name. We are praying to you because you are merciful, not because we have done right.

dag: Miriya ka yi leei buɣijɛmdiba kaman bɛ ni shɛb ni daa niŋ shɛm la; dama di sabiya, Niriba daa ʒiya diri ka nyura, ka bembe nti yiɣisi diɛmda.
en: They worshiped idols, just as the Scriptures say, The people sat down to eat and drink. Then they got up to dance around. So don't worship idols.

dag: Nɛbukadnɛza nam dibu yuun pisaayika ni, o daa gbahila ninvuɣ kɔbisinii ni pihitanaayi Jɛrusalɛm.
en: in his eighteenth year, from Jerusalem;.

dag: M mali niɣi mini bunsi ni biŋkɔbbaligu ni daba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba; ka tim na ni n ti yɛli nyini n dana din ni chɛ ka a suhu maai ni mani. .
en: I own cattle, donkeys, flocks, men servants, and women servants. Im sending this message to my master now to ask that he be kind.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ suhu ni tɛha bi wuhi ma ni m mali galimi, amaa dimbɔŋɔ bi wuhiri ni m bebu tuhiya zaa. N Duuma n-nyɛ ŋun kariti ma saria.
en: Im not aware of anything against me, but that doesnt make me innocent, because the Lord is the one who judges me.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa kpe ba pam nimaani, ka biɛrim mali ba kaman paɣ ŋun wolisiri ni o dɔɣi.
en: There they were seized with fear and anguish, like a woman about to bear a child.

dag: Ka o ti lan lab o nyaandoliba maa sanna nti nya ka bɛ lan gbihirimi, dama gom n-daa mali ba pam.
en: Jesus came back and found them sleeping again. They simply could not keep their eyes open.

dag: Nuhu yuun kɔbisiyɔbu puuni gol so ŋun pah ayi biɛɣ pinaayopɔin dali, ka tiŋgban ni kɔbil nin kara zaa daa puhigi, ka zuɣusaa sagbana kɔsoya gba yooi.
en: In the six hundredth year of Noahs life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day—on that day all the springs of the deep sea erupted, and the windows in the skies opened.

dag: Paɣimiy o, o yiko tumtumsa zuɣu. Paɣimiy o, o ni galisi pam zuɣu.
en: Praise him for the mighty things he has done. Praise his supreme greatness.

dag: Naa Bɛnhadad daa timmina nti yɛl o, Samaria taŋkpaɣu yi ni tooi pali n niriba bɛn doli ma zaa nukurigu yimyim, m buɣa bɛn niŋm ma zaɣ biɛɣu, hal n niŋ ma zaɣ biɛɣu pam gba.
en: from Benhadad: I will bring enough men to destroy this city of yours and carry off the rubble in their hands. May the gods strike me dead if I don't.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛlnim na kul mali duŋ ni Dauda yilinim hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: So Israel rebelled against the family of David, and that is how things are even today.

dag: Ka daɣila n kul yɛn lihirila tɔbu tuhibu, ka wumdi kikahi kumsi sahakam?.
en: How long must I see the war flags? How long must I hear the war trumpets?.

dag: Yinim tuumbiɛtumdiba ŋɔ zomiya ka chɛ ma; ka n doli n Naawuni zaligunima.
en: Dont come near me, you who are evil, so that I can obey my Gods commands.

dag: Yɛligu maa kɔbili ni ka Naawuni daa nam dunia ŋɔ, ka o daa ka dunia ŋɔ ni na, amaa ka dunianim ti bi baŋ o.
en: The Word was in the world, but no one knew him, though God had made the world with his Word.

dag: Amaa ka n niriba zaɣisi ni bɛ ku wum n yɛligu; Izraɛlnim zaɣisiya ni bɛ kul ku deei n noli.
en: But my people wouldnt listen to my voice. Israel simply wasnt agreeable toward me.

dag: Amaa sara maligunim ŋɔ daa kul teerila niriba maa bɛ daalahichi yɛla yuuni kam;.
en: Instead, these sacrifices are a reminder of sin every year.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Jɔshua daa lan laɣim Izraɛl zuliya maa zaa Shɛkɛm na nti boli bɛ kpamba mini sariakaritiba ni zuɣulaannima ni Izraɛl tuma zuɣulaannima, ka bɛ daa ka Naawuni tooni na.
en: Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel at Shechem. He summoned the elders of Israel, its leaders, judges, and officers. They presented themselves before God.

dag: Bɛ ni daa piri Aduna bidibisi shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Aduna bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Nadab mini Abihu ni Ɛliɛza ni Itama.
en: The divisions of the Aaronites: Aarons family: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa ŋmɛnditoya shɛb daa ti yi bɛ suɣa maa ni m-piri tab ʒii buta zuɣu; ka yim zuɣu daa ŋmaligi kpa tin shɛli din yuli booni Ofira ka di be Shual tiŋgban ni la polo.
en: Three raiding parties left the Philistine camp. One took the road to Ophrah toward the territory of Shual.

dag: Dinzuɣu yɛlim ba ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, N ni kpihim ŋahali maa ka bɛ ku lan ŋahi li Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni yaha. Amaa yɛlim ba ni dabisa maa miriya, ka ʒii kam ni niŋ pali.
en: Now tell the people that I, the Lord , am going to prove that saying wrong. No one will ever be able to use it again in Israel, because very soon everything I have said will come true!.

dag: Dama m mi ni yi nyɛla tipawumlinima, ka yi nyiŋgoya kpɛm gari kurigu, ka yi gbɛri mi be kaman daanya la.
en: Because I know that you are stubborn, your neck is made of iron, and your forehead is bronze.

dag: Niŋmiya bɛ ni zali ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam: Ŋun simdi ni a yo lampoo zuɣu o sani, nyin yom o; ka ŋun deerila farigu, nyin tim o; ka ŋun simdi ni a lu o sizuura, nyin lum o sizuura; ka ŋun mi simdi ni a ti o jilima, nyin tim o jilima.
en: Pay all that you owe, whether it is taxes and fees or respect and honor.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Siɣimi ti zaŋ Aduna pah amaŋ zuɣu duna, amaa di chɛ ka maligumaaniba mini niriba maa kab ka man Yawɛ sanna, ka n suhu ti yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: The Lord replied, Go down and bring Aaron back with you. But the priests and the people must not cross the boundary to come up to me, or I will punish them.

dag: Yawɛ, a kpiɔŋ zuɣu ka naa mali suhupiɛlli; a sɔŋsim zuɣu ka o mali suhupiɛlli pam maa.
en: The king is glad, O Lord , because you gave him strength; he rejoices because you made him victorious.

dag: Ka Farisiinim daa nya lala ka yɛli Yisa, Nyam a nyaandoliba maa ni tumdi din chihiri ni bɛ tum Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: When the Pharisees saw this, they said to him, Look, your disciples are breaking the Sabbath law.

dag: Ka zoya ti nyɛligi do o naba ni ka vinvama tahi bɔɣi kaman shigbaŋ m-miri buɣim la, bee kaman kom din kpaai bahi luɣ shɛli din nyɛ sirigili la.
en: The mountains will melt under him like wax in a fire. The valleys will break apart and slide like water rushing down a hill.

dag: Pukpar so n-daa chaŋ ti kɔr o puu ka yaɣind o bimbira; ka di shɛŋa daa lu sol zuɣu ka niriba nɔri li garita, ka noonsi ti kana nti gahim li di.
en: A farmer went out to scatter his seed. As he was scattering it, some fell on the path where it was crushed, and the birds in the sky came and ate it.

dag: amaa o yi zaŋ o ni su shɛli ti o tumtumdiba ni yino pini, di ni nyɛ o dini hal ni faako yuuni, di nyaaŋa ka o labisi li ti naa. O bidibisi kɔŋko n-ni tooi su o ni zaŋ binshɛli ti ba pini.
en: But if the ruler gives a gift from part of his land to one of his slaves, the gift will belong to the slave only until the year of freedom. Then the gift will go back to the ruler. Only the rulers sons will keep a gift of land from the ruler.

dag: ka maligumaana maa ti zal o daa ka di dol o ni viɛl shɛm bee o ni bi viɛl shɛm. Kaman ŋun maligumaana ni zal o daa shɛm, lala n-yɛn nyɛ li.
en: The priest shall set a price for it, according to its good or bad qualities, and the price will be final.

dag: Ka farigudeeriba gba daa kana ni bɛ ti deei baptaizibu ka bɔh o, Karimba, ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ.
en: Even tax collectors came to be baptized. They said to him, Teacher, what should we do.

dag: N Naawuni, n suhu yɛmi ni n tumla a yubu, a zaligu be n suhu ni.
en: How I love to do your will, my God! I keep your teaching in my heart.

dag: Ka niriba ni be tin shɛŋa ni zaa ni ti kpalim tiŋ kuma. Ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa zani dabari. Ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. .
en: Cities that are now full of people will be destroyed, and the country will be made a wilderness. Then they will know that I am the Lord .

dag: A bi nya bɛ ni tumdi tuun shɛŋa Juda fɔntinsi ni mini Jɛrusalɛm pala zuɣu?.
en: Cant you see what they are doing in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?.

dag: Ka o yiŋlan maa yɛl o, Mbo n-faaŋa, bi suŋ ni n yɛdalana ŋun ʒe ma yim! A pal alikauli ni bin din pɔra, dinzuɣu n ni zaŋ a leei bin din zooi pam zuɣulana; chɛ ka a suhu piɛli kaman n suhu ni piɛli shɛm ŋɔ.
en: His master replied, Well done! You are a good and faithful servant. Youve been faithful over a little. Ill put you in charge of much. Come, celebrate with me.

dag: Ka di nyaaŋa kɔr biɛri yi tiɣi pua, di dɔɣirila alahichi; ka alahichi mi yi ti bi zaa, di tiɣirila pua n-dɔɣi kum.
en: Then our evil desires conceive and give birth to sin; and sin, when it is full-grown, gives birth to death.

dag: Banima n-nyɛ bɛn daa lee wum Naawuni kukoli, amaa ka ti taai duŋ la? Pa bɛna n-nyɛ Anabi Musa ni daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb yi Ijipti na la?.
en: Who were those who heard Gods voice and turned against him? It was all the people Moses led out of Egypt.

dag: Jɛhu ni daa paai Jɛziriil, ka Jɛzibɛl wum o yɛla, o daa bal la chilo, ka mal o zuɣu n-vɔbisi lihiri takɔro ni.
en: When Jehu came to Jezreel, Jezebel heard the news. She put her makeup on and fixed her hair. Then she stood by the window and looked out.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pii ninvuɣ tuhilituhili Izraɛl zuliya kam ni, ka bɛ kalinli yiɣisi tɔbbihi tuhi pinaayi n-lo kpara ni bɛ chaŋ tɔb maa ni.
en: So a thousand men were chosen from each tribe, a total of twelve thousand men ready for battle.

dag: Amaa lee miriya ka yi ti ŋubi binʒim, chɛliya ka di yi m-bahi tiŋgban ni kaman kom la.
en: But you must not eat the blood. You must pour the blood on the ground like water.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ wuhirimi ni n taɣirila n ni daa lo ni n niŋ shɛm? Bee n lɔri n nia mi kaman ŋun doli dunia ŋɔ biɛhigu soli ni lɔri nia shɛm yɛra, Iin, Iin mini Aai, Aai zaa yim?.
en: Do you think that I made these plans without really thinking? Or maybe you think I make plans as the world does, saying yes and no at the same time.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa tim tuumba Yisifu sani ti yɛl o, Zaligu ŋɔ ka a ba daa zali ti pɔi ka naanyi kpi.
en: So they sent a message to Joseph: Before our father died.

dag: Yi ni ŋuni n-lee bɔri nyɛvili, ka bɔri ni o mali nyɛvili wɔɣinli, n-di din viɛli nyaɣisim?.
en: Do you love life; do you relish the chance to enjoy good things?.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, N ni chaŋ ka yi ti bo ma kɔŋ, ka yi ni ti kpi ni yi daalahichi. N ni chani luɣ shɛli yi ku tooi ka nimaani na.
en: Again, Jesus said to the people, I will leave you. You will look for me, but you will die in your sin. You cannot come where I am going.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tiŋgban nɛli ni ni ti kana ti damd o tooni, ka o dimnim mi ti kana ti lu o tooni ka bɛ noya vaai taŋkpaɣu.
en: May all the people living in the desert bow down to him. May all his enemies bow before him with their faces in the dirt.

dag: ka bɛ be bɛ ni gbahi ba kuli tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni ti leei daba maa, ka di ti lu bɛ suhuri ni, ka bɛ niŋ tuuba ka suh a bɛ ni be tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni maa yɛli, Ti tum alahichi, ka tum nyaanyibo mini ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma.
en: if they change their heart in whatever land they are held captive, changing their lives and begging for your mercy, saying, We have sinned, we have done wrong, we have acted wickedly.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah ata daa piɛb o kikaa, ka saŋmar titali ŋun ne kaman buɣim mokpalli la yi zuɣusaa n-lu mɔɣa ata kam zaɣ yin ni mini kɔbilisi ni.
en: Then the third angel blew his trumpet. A large star, burning like a torch, dropped from the sky and fell on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, N dana, pɔŋ pia la pun be o sani.
en: But they said, Sir, he already has ten times as much.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda daa nyɛ Jɛsi bia, ka Jɛsi nyɛ Obɛd bia, ka Obɛd nyɛ Bɔaz bia, ka Bɔaz nyɛ Sala bia, ka Sala mi nyɛ Nashɔn bia.
en: the son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon.

dag: Ka paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣindiba daa yɛl o, Chɛ ka a suhu kpɛma, bidibiga ka a dɔɣi maa. Ka o bi garigi shɛli.
en: She was about to die when the women who were helping her said, Dont worry, you have given birth to a son. But she did not answer or pay attention.

dag: amaa dabisa din kpalim nyaaŋa ŋɔ puuni, o tɔɣisiri ti yɛtɔɣa la o Bia la nol ni. O Bia maa kɔbili ni ka o daa nam dunia ŋɔ, ka zal o ni o su binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: And now in these last days, God has spoken to us again through his Son. He made the whole world through his Son. And he has chosen his Son to have all things.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa teei dɔni n-zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋa ka la ka yɛl o suhu ni, Wula ka ninvuɣ so ŋun paai yuun kɔbiga ni tooi lan dɔɣi bia? Ka Zara ŋun paai yuun pihiwɛi ŋɔ ni tooi lan dɔɣi bia.
en: Abraham bowed down with his face touching the ground, but he began to laugh when he thought, Can a man have a child when he is a hundred years old? Can Sarah have a child at ninety.

dag: Niŋm mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ kaman a yurilim maŋli la ni nyɛ shɛm, ka wuhi ma a zaligunima.
en: Act toward your servant according to your faithful love. Teach me your statutes!.

dag: di saha nyin be a biɛhigu shee alizanda ni; ka wum, ka chɛ o taali ka niŋ din tuhi, ka ti sokam din simd o tuma kaman a ni mi din be o suhu ni shɛm, dama a kɔŋko m-mi din be daadam kam zaa suhu ni.
en: hear their prayer. Listen to them in your home in heaven, forgive them, and help them. You alone know the thoughts of the human heart. Deal with each person as he deserves.

dag: Ka o dan maa daa nya ka Yawɛ be Yisifu sani, ka chɛ ka o ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa tɔŋda.
en: Potiphar saw that the Lord was with Joseph and that the Lord helped Joseph be successful in everything he did.

dag: Lɛvinima n-daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu. Bɛ ni ŋun daa daŋ mali me m-pan o zuɣu n-daa nyɛ Bani bia Rɛhum. Ka Hashabia ŋun daa nyɛ Kɛila yaɣili pirigili polo naa la daa mali me n-ti o yaɣili polɔnima.
en: The men from the tribe of Levi repaired the next section. They worked under Rehum son of Bani. Hashabiah repaired the next section. Hashabiah was governor of half the district of Keilah. He made repairs for his own district.

dag: Yawɛ, a chɛ ka a tuma ti ma suhupiɛlli; a ni tum tuun shɛŋa chɛ ka n yili yila ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Lord , you make us very happy because of what you did. I gladly sing about it.

dag: Saha shɛli kanna, ka Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya ŋɔ ni ti ba nyaɣa kaman tia la. Bɛ ni ti pum puma, ka wali wala. Ka bɛ zuliya ti be dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam.
en: In the days to come the people of Israel, the descendants of Jacob, will take root like a tree, and they will blossom and bud. The earth will be covered with the fruit they produce.

dag: Ka lala zuɣu ni chɛ ka bɛ mali taali alikauli shɛli bɛ ni daa lo Masia san la puuni.
en: Then they will be guilty of not doing what they first promised to do.

dag: A daa kari zuliya shɛba ka zaŋ ba ʒili bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni. A daa darigi lala zuliyanim maa tibili, amaa ka chɛ bɛna.
en: You chased off the nations by causing them trouble with your powerful arm. Then you let our ancestors take over their land.

dag: Dabiɛm ka yurilim puuni, ka yurilim din niŋ dɛde nyɛla din yihiri dabiɛm bahira. Dama dabiɛm mini tibidarigibo n-dol taba; dinzuɣu ŋunkam zɔri dabiɛm, yurilim na bi niŋ dɛde o ni.
en: There is no fear in love; perfect love drives out all fear. So then, love has not been made perfect in anyone who is afraid, because fear has to do with punishment.

dag: So yi nyɛla wuntizɔra, ka niŋdi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm ni din tuhi.
en: People are declared innocent when they act justly and responsibly.

dag: Sool paɣ mi yuli n-daa booni Ahinɔam. O daa nyɛla Ahimaaz bipuɣiŋga. Ka o tɔbbi kpɛm mi yuli daa booni Abinɛr, o daa nyɛla Sool bapir Nɛr bia.
en: Sauls wife was named Ahinoam. Ahinoam was the daughter of Ahimaaz. The commander of Sauls army was named Abner son of Ner. Ner was Sauls uncle.

dag: Zuliya kam mini nanim ni gbib a kaman paɣ ni gbib o bia ŋun mɔɣiri shɛm la. Ka a baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun tilig a. Ka lan baŋ ni Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun nyɛ kpiɔŋzaalan ŋɔ n-fa a bahi maa.
en: You will drain the wealth of kings and foreign nations. You will know that I, the mighty Lord God of Israel, have saved and rescued you.

dag: Waazuyihira maa boya ni o nya yɛtɔɣa din tuhi, ka o ni sab yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa nyɛla yɛlimaŋli zaa.
en: The Teacher searched for pleasing words, and he wrote truthful words honestly.

dag: N ni yɛli ya shɛli zibisim ni, yɛlimiya li neesim ni; ka yi ni wum shɛli ashilɔni, yin molimiya li gili luɣilikam.
en: Whatever I say to you in the dark, you must tell in the light. And you must announce from the housetops whatever I have whispered to you.

dag: Yɛm me o yili, ka sa daantalisi ayopɔin.
en: Wisdom has built her house; she has made it strong with seven columns.

dag: A yi nya li tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ ni so sani, yin kum o, ka tinim bɛn kpalim zaa mi leei ti dan daba.
en: If you find that one of us has the cup, then kill him, and the rest of us will become your slaves.

dag: N dana, ka ti daa yɛl a, Bia maa ku tooi wolig o ba, o yi wolig o, o ba maa ni kpi.
en: And we said to you, That young boy cannot come. He cannot leave his father. If his father loses him, his father will be so sad that he will die.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni nyɛ Naawuni biyurisi la zuɣu, di simdi ni yi chɛ ka yi bebu be kaman o bebu.
en: You are Gods dear children, so try to be like him.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Sintani, Nyin Sintani, man Yawɛ kpahir a zuɣu ni! Man Yawɛ ŋun pii Jɛrusalɛm la kpahir a zuɣu ni! Doo ŋɔ ŋmanila bɛ ni darigi yihi da shɛli buɣim ni.
en: But the Lord said, Satan, you are wrong. Jerusalem is my chosen city, and this man was rescued like a stick from a flaming fire.

dag: A leela ninkuunsilana zaŋ chaŋ n sani, ka niŋ ma alaka ni a yaa zaa.
en: God has turned brutal.

dag: Chamiya ti bɔhim dimbɔŋɔ gbinni: M paɣi nambɔzɔbo gari sara malibu. Pa wuntizɔriba zuɣu ka n kana, amaa alahichinim tuuba niŋbu zuɣu ka n kana.
en: Go and learn what the Scriptures mean when they say, Instead of offering sacrifices to me, I want you to be merciful to others. I didn't come to invite good people to be my followers. I came to invite sinners.

dag: A ni pahi ma jilima; ka maai n suhu yaha.
en: You will make me greater than ever; you will comfort me again.

dag: Farisiinim ni so daa ti boli Yisa ni o ka o yiŋ na ka bɛ ti laɣim di bindirigu; ka Yisa daa chaŋ o yiŋa nti ʒini bindirigu maa dibu shee ni bɛ di.
en: One of the Pharisees invited Jesus to eat with him. After he entered the Pharisees home, he took his place at the table.

dag: Ka Dauda mini Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa kuli Jɛrusalɛm din yuli daa lan nyɛ Jɛbusi la, dama nimaani ka Jɛbusinim daa be, bɛna n-daa nyɛ di tiŋbihi.
en: David and all the Israelites went to the city of Jerusalem. Jerusalem was called Jebus at that time. The people living in that city were named Jebusites. They.

dag: Bee bɔ ka yi daa lee chaŋ ni yi ti nya? Nira ŋun bɔbi? Ka o lan yɛli, Nyamiya, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔbiri ka niŋdi bɛ suhu yubu bela nanim yinsi.
en: What did you go out to see? A man dressed up in fancy clothes? People who dress like that and live in luxury are found in palaces!.

dag: ka tɛh o suhu ni ni o dii zaŋ kpani maa to Dauda tabili dukpini, amaa ka Dauda daa fɔhi li buyi zaa.
en: I'll pin him to the wall, Saul said to himself, and he threw the spear at him twice; but David dodged each time.

dag: ka o niriba ti baŋ tiliginsim ni nyɛ shɛli bɛ taali chɛ m-paŋ puuni.
en: You will tell his people how to be saved through the forgiveness of their sins.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, Alizin biɛɣu bi ʒi n zuɣu; n tirila m Ba Naawuni jilima, amaa ka yinim lee ʒiɛmdi ma.
en: I dont have a demon, Jesus replied. But I honor my Father and you dishonor me.

dag: Yi bihi yuli ni ti du pam zuliya kam sani. Ka ŋunkam zaa ti nya ba ni baŋ ni bɛ nyɛla Yawɛ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb ni.
en: Your descendants will be known in every nation. All who see them will realize that they have been blessed, by me, the Lord .

dag: O ni daa yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Lɛvi zuliya polo m-bɔŋɔ; Zaŋm a Tumim ti Lɛvi zuliya ka zaŋ a Urim ti ŋun ʒe a yim a ni daa zahim so Masa la, a mini ŋun daa mo Mɛriba kom ni la.
en: Moses said this about Levi: Levi is your true follower. He keeps the Urim and Thummim. At Massah you tested the people of Levi. At the waters of Meribah, you challenged them.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N suhuyiɣisili puuni ka n yɛn chɛ ka sanʒiɛɣu maa ʒe, ka chɛ ka sa titali mi n sujee puuni, ka sakuɣ kara luna n suhuyiɣisili maa ni saɣim li.
en: That wall is the city of Jerusalem. And I, the Lord God, am so angry that I will send strong winds, rainstorms, and hailstones to destroy it.

dag: Yawɛ, bɔ saha ka di kul yɛn be lala? A suhuyiɣisili kul yɛn beni la sahakam? A nyuli zabbu suhuyiɣisili maa yɛn dirimi kaman buɣim la?.
en: How long will you rage, LORD? Forever? How long will your anger burn like fire?.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi ka bɔh o, Paɣa, ka bɛ be ya? Bɛ ni so bi lan yɛli ni a simdi kubu.
en: He looked up again and said to her, Where did they all go? Did no one judge you guilty.

dag: Dama a deei talima a mabihi sani ka di ka daliri, ka deei bɛ situra sɔŋ ka chɛ ba bɛ zaɣim.
en: To guarantee payment of a debt, you have taken clothes from innocent people.

dag: Sulemaana daa tum din nyɛ alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka daa bi lan doli Yawɛ viɛnyɛliŋga kaman o ba Dauda la.
en: He sinned against the Lord and was not true to him as his father David had been.

dag: Izraɛlnima n-tum alahichi; bɛ zaɣisila n ni zali ba zaligu shɛl la dolibu; ka kpuɣi binshɛŋa bɛ ni daa woligi ti Man Yawɛ la. Bɛ zu n-kpuɣ li pahi bɛ nɛma ni, ka ŋma ʒiri.
en: The Israelites sinned against me. They have broken the agreement that I commanded them to obey. They took some of the things that I commanded them to destroy. They have stolen from me. They have lied. They have taken those things for themselves.

dag: Ka Matan bia Shɛfatia mini Pushihur bia Gɛdalia ni Shɛlɛmia bia Jukal ni Malikia bia Pushihur daa wum ni Jɛrimia yɛrila niriba maa zaa.
en: Shephatiah son of Mattan, Gedaliah son of Pashhur, Jehucal son of Shelemiah, and Pashhur son of Malchiah heard that I was telling the people that.

dag: Yawɛ ni chɛ ka o yiko din be kasi la tum tuma. O ni tilig o niriba, ka dunia ŋɔ nim zaa nya.
en: The Lord showed his holy strength to all the nations. All the faraway countries saw how God saved his people.

dag: Wuntizɔriba nyɛla zuɣusuŋnima, dama bɛ ni di bɛ tuma nyɔri.
en: The righteous will be happy, and things will go well for them. They will get to enjoy what they have worked for.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ, yinim bɛn nyɛ ansarisimaaniba, ka di nam ʒini Jɛrusalɛm n-su n niriba ŋɔ, wummiya man Yawɛ ni yɛn yɛli shɛm.
en: You rulers of Jerusalem do nothing but sneer; now you must listen to what the Lord says.

dag: Ka Ayuba daa kurigi zaa, ka o dabisa ti pali ka o naanyi kpi.
en: and when he finally died, he was very old.

dag: ka m bi zaŋ m piɛri kɔbiri situra ti o ka o pili ka paɣi ma o suhu ni.
en: I always gave them something to wear. I used the wool from my own sheep to make them warm. And they thanked me with all their heart.

dag: O daa mali naŋgbaŋkuɣila ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ milimita pisopɔinnaanu niŋ li, ka niŋ salima kɔɣili li gili.
en: Then he made a frame handbreadth wide around the table. He put gold trim on the frame.

dag: Ka Jɔshua min o tɔbbihi daa chaŋ ti liri ba Mɛrom kulibɔŋ maa ni libigi ba.
en: Then Joshua along with the entire army launched a surprise attack against them at the waters of Merom.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa nya lala ka di niŋ ba nyaɣisim pam, dama naa daa yi kul niŋ shɛli, di niŋdila niriba nyaɣisim.
en: Everyone noticed what David did, and they liked it, just as they always liked what he did.

dag: Yi ni ti vili yi baŋtabisi, ka piri yi namda. Di ti fabiliya bee n-kum, amaa yi tuumbiɛri ni ti ʒin ya chaŋ, ka yi ti ŋuhira niŋdi taba.
en: Your turbans will be on your heads, your sandals on your feet. You wont mourn or weep. You will waste away in your guilt, all of you groaning to each other.

dag: Bɛ ni daa be Maika yiŋ maa, ka bɛ nya nachimbil ŋun nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya nir maa m-baŋ o o yɛtɔɣa puuni, ka bɔh o, Ŋuni n-lee tah a kpe na? Ka bɔ ka a lee niŋdi kpe? Bee tuun bɔ ka a lee tumdi kpe.
en: When the five men came close to Micahs house, they heard the voice of the young Levite. They recognized his voice, so they stopped at Micahs house. They asked the young man, Who brought you to this place? What are you doing? Why are you here.

dag: Yi ni daa chaŋ Ijipti la, nyo bɔ ka yi daa lee nya? Nail Mɔɣili la ni kom ka yi daa chaŋ ni yi ti nyu? Bee yi ni daa chaŋ Asiria la, bɔ ka yi daa lee nya? Yufretiiz Mɔɣili la ni kom ka yi daa chaŋ ni yi ti nyu?.
en: and you trusted the power of Egypt and Assyria.

dag: Noombihi bɛn gbahiri binnɛma dira bi mi di soli ni be shɛli, ka suligu nini na ʒi n-nya li.
en: A path— no bird of prey knows it; a hawks eye hasnt seen it.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi vihi baŋ ti tuumbiɛri maa? Ti lo yɛmbimbiɛri nia biɛɣu ŋɔ. Dama ninsal suhu ni tɛha zilim pam.
en: They make evil plans and say, We'll commit a perfect crime. No one knows our thoughts.

dag: Nyini n-daa ŋme m-bɔri Lɛviatan zuɣuri ka zaŋ bɛ nimdi ti tiŋgban nɛli ni niriba.
en: You crushed the heads of the monster Leviathan, then fed him to wild creatures in the desert.

dag: N niriba, kpɛmiya yi duri ka yo yi dunoya. Sɔɣimiya ka di tooi biɛla ha, ka Naawuni suhuyiɣisili maa saha gari.
en: My people, go into your rooms and lock your doors. Hide in there for a short time until Gods anger is finished.

dag: Ʒiri be ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lɔri nia biɛri tɛha ni, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri din viɛli tumbu mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Those who plan evil are in for a rude surprise, but those who work for good will find happiness.

dag: N ni niŋ jila niŋ ya, ka niŋ niŋgbuna niŋ ya, ka zaŋ gbaŋ pɔbi ya, ka niŋ vuhim niŋ ya ka yi niŋ nyɛvili; ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. .
en: I will put sinews on you, place flesh on you, and cover you with skin. When I put breath in you, and you come to life, you will know that I am the LORD.

dag: Amaa daadamnim bɛn yi kpi, bɛ lan ka yaa. Daadamnim yi bahi, ya ka bɛ lee lan be?.
en: But a human dies and lies there; a person expires, and where is he?.

dag: ka daa ti kpuɣi n zuɣu lihi nya so ka o ye binyɛr piɛlli din mali shaara, ka lo salima din nyɛ alali shɛlɔrigu.
en: when I looked up and saw someone dressed in linen and wearing a solid gold belt.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa tim tuumba ka bɛ yi Kɛdɛmɔt tiŋgban nɛli ni n-chaŋ Hɛshibɔn naa Sihɔn sani nti zaŋ suhudoo yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ yɛl o.
en: Then I sent messengers from the desert of Kedemoth to King Sihon of Heshbon with the following offer of peace:.

dag: Wula ka yi zaŋ firila ti ninvuɣ so ŋun be muɣisigu ni, ka tiri ninvuɣ so ŋun be naŋgbantom ni nyɛvili?.
en: Why let people go on living in misery? Why give light to those in grief.

dag: Di simdi ka yi chɛ ka buɣim kul be sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu dira sahakam, di bi simdi ni di kpi.
en: A continuous fire must be kept burning on the altar; it must not go out.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla tana anu she n-tuɣi taba di ko, ka lan zaŋ tana ayɔbu la she n-tuɣi taba di ko.
en: They joined five curtains together and the six other curtains together.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa lan bɔhi ma pahi buyi, Bɔ ka a lee nya? Ka n garigi yɛli, N nyala duɣu ni bini ni kpeera, ka gbiligi yi nuzaa polo na.
en: The Lord s message came to me again: Jeremiah, what do you see? I answered, I see a pot of boiling water. That pot is tipping over from the north.

dag: Ula bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ara mini Hanniɛl ni Rizia.
en: Ullas family: Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa garigi yɛli ba, Yi liɣiri yi naai, yin zaŋmiya yi biŋkɔbiri na ti taɣi bindirigu.
en: Joseph answered, Bring your livestock; I will give you food in exchange for it if your money is all gone.

dag: A ŋmanila ŋmani ŋun be tampima voya ni. Chɛ ka n nya a ninni tampima voya maa ni. Chɛ ka n wum a kukoli, dama a kukoli viɛli pam, ka a ninni viɛli pam.
en: You are like a dove that hides in the crevice of a rock. Let me see your lovely face and hear your enchanting voice.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ n dimnim ka di ka daliri la mali kpiɔŋ pam; ka bɛn je ma ka di ka soli gba galisi pam.
en: My enemies are healthy and strong; there are many who hate me for no reason.

dag: Bɛ ni daa gindi napɔŋ din pahir ayopɔin maa ka maligumaaniba piɛbiri kikahi saha shɛli, ka Jɔshua daa yɛli niriba maa, Tahimiya! Dama Yawɛ zaŋ tiŋ maa niŋ yi nuu ni.
en: The seventh time they marched around the city, the priests blew their trumpets. Then Joshua gave the command: Now, shout! The Lord is giving you this city!.

dag: Dinzuɣu cheechi zaa yi ti laɣim ka sokam tɔɣisirila tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni, ka bɛn ka yi kalinli ni mini bɛn bi niŋ yɛda kpɛna, bɛ ku yɛli ni yi kpɛla yinyari?.
en: If, then, the whole church meets together and everyone starts speaking in strange tongues—and if some ordinary people or unbelievers come in, won't they say that you are all crazy?.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yɛli, Kpe ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu ti yɛn be, ka Izraɛlnim ni ti yɛn zaŋdi sara nyɔri buɣim bimbin shɛli zuɣu be kpe.
en: So David said, This is where the Temple of the Lord God will be. Here is the altar where the people of Israel are to offer burnt offerings.

dag: Di saha ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa zaŋ Gɛdalia Ahikam bia ŋun daa nyɛ Shafan yaaŋa la n-leei gomna ka o su o ni daa chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb niŋ Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni la fukumsi.
en: Babylons King Nebuchadnezzar put Gedaliah, Ahikams son and Shaphans grandson, in charge of the people he had left behind in the land of Judah.

dag: Bɛ ni shɛb daa tɛhimi ni Judas ni gbib bɛ liɣiri kolibil la zuɣu ka Yisa yɛl o ni o cham ti da bɛ ni bɔri binshɛŋa ni bɛ zaŋ puhi chuɣu maa na bee ni o pii liɣiri maa shɛli ti ti nandaamba.
en: Since Judas was in charge of the money bag, some of the disciples thought that Jesus had told him to go and buy what they needed for the festival, or to give something to the poor.

dag: Chɛ ka nanim zaa damd o tiŋa; ka chɛ ka zuliya kam zaa jɛm o.
en: May all kings bow down to our king. May all nations serve him.

dag: amaa ka bɛ daa kul mɔhiri vuri yɛra, Kpahim o tabili dapulli zuɣu! Kpahim o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: They kept shouting out, Crucify him! Crucify him.

dag: Fɔntin shɛli ni niriba ni daa kul palila n-leei dabari maa! Tin shɛli din daa nyɛ tin titali niriba sani la nti be kaman pakoli maa. Tin shɛli din daa nyɛ nabipuɣiŋga fɔntinsi ni la leela dabili.
en: How lonely lies Jerusalem, once so full of people! Once honored by the world, she is now like a widow; The noblest of cities has fallen into slavery.

dag: Adin daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu ni pihinunaanu.
en: the descendants of Adin:.

dag: N ni chɛ ka malaika kana ti wuhi ya soli, ka n kari Keenannim mini Amɔrinim ni Hitinim ni Pɛrizinim ni Hivinim ni Jɛbusinima.
en: So I will send an angel to go before you, and I will defeat the Canaanites, Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites. I will force them to leave your land.

dag: N ka galimi o sani; ka gbaai mmaŋa zaŋ chaŋ taali tumbu polo.
en: I have lived with integrity before him; Ive kept myself from wrongdoing.

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ kpalua ni wuɣi tan piɛl viɛl shɛli n-she zabbanim ti Aduna min o bidibisi maa.
en: Everything that Aaron and his sons wore was made of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool, including their robes and turbans, their fancy caps and underwear, and even their sashes that were embroidered with needlework.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa yɛli Yisifu, N zahindi maa puuni, n daa ʒiɛla Nail Mɔɣili duli;.
en: The king told Joseph: I dreamed I was standing on the bank of the Nile River.

dag: So yi tum taali din simdi ni bɛ ku o, ka bɛ zaŋ o yili tia ku o.
en: If a criminal is put to death, and you hang the dead body on a tree.

dag: Amaa a nyara, hal a nya muɣisigu mini wahala shɛŋa bɛ ni dira, chɛ ka yɛla maa be a nuu ni. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri sɔŋsim zaŋ bɛmaŋ niŋla a nuu ni; a mi pun nyɛla kpibisi sɔŋda.
en: But you do see! You do see troublemaking and grief, and you do something about it! The helpless leave it all to you. You are the orphans helper.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi yi niŋ yɛda ka bi biɛhim, pa n ni niŋ fiig tia ŋɔ shɛm ŋɔ kɔŋko ka yi ni niŋ, amaa hal yi yi yɛli zoli ŋɔ, Yiɣisim a dooshee ŋɔ ti lu teeku ni ha, di ni niŋ lala.
en: But Jesus said to them, If you have faith and don't doubt, I promise you can do what I did to this tree. And you will be able to do even more. You can tell this mountain to get up and jump into the sea, and it will.

dag: Cham Rɛkabinim sani nti tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa, ka zaŋ ba ka Yawɛ jɛmbu duu na nti zaŋ ba kpɛhi dubihi la yini puuni, ka niŋ wain ti ba ka bɛ nyu.
en: Go to the Rechabite family and invite them to come to one of the rooms of the LORDs temple. When they arrive, offer them some wine to drink.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ bi bela n sani ka n zaŋ bini dihi tabili li sɔŋ?.
en: The Lord remembers what their enemies have done; he waits for the right time to punish them.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa nya o ni nam binshɛɣukam maa zaa, ka di viɛl pam. Ka di daa niŋ zaawuni, di nyaaŋa ka biɛɣu neei; ka di niŋ dabisili din pah ayɔbu.
en: God looked at everything he had made, and he was very pleased. Evening passed and morning came—that was the sixth day.

dag: Di ni ti nyɛla zaɣ mɔɣu ka kpabi yim zuɣu, ka di wɔɣilim ti nyɛ sɛntimita pisinaayi, ka di yɛliŋ gba nyɛ sɛntimita pisinaayi.
en: It will be square and doubled, nine inches long and nine inches wide.

dag: Ka Abinɛr yɛl o, Ŋmaligim a nudirigu bee a nuzaa polo n-gbaai nachimba ŋɔ ni yino n-fa o ni mali shɛli. Amaa ka Asahɛl bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ o dolibu.
en: Break off your pursuit! Abner told him. Fight one of the young warriors and take his gear for yourself! But Asahel wouldnt stop chasing him.

dag: amaa zaŋm ma ti sɔŋla m banim dooshee. Ʒimiya ma yi Ijipti ŋɔ kuli nti sɔɣi ma bɛ sɔɣibu shee. Ka Yisifu yɛl o, N ni niŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: When I lie down with my fathers, carry me from Egypt and bury me in their grave. Joseph said, I will do just as you say.

dag: amaa ka daa bi boli anabi Neetan mini Bɛnaaya bee o tizo Sulemaana bee naa ninvuɣ kpɛma la bɛna.
en: But he didnt invite the prophet Nathan, Benaiah, Davids veterans, or his brother Solomon.

dag: Ka Simiɔn zuliya maa ni ninvuɣ shɛba daa ti chaŋ Ɛdom zoli zuɣu, kaman niriba kɔbisinu laasabu. Bɛ daa malila bɛ zuɣulaannim bɛn daa nyɛ Pɛlatia mini Niaria ni Rɛfaya ni Uziɛl bɛn daa nyɛ Ishi bidibisi la.
en: Five hundred people from the tribe of Simeon went to the hill country of Seir. Ishis sons led these men. The sons were Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel. The Simeonite men fought against the people living in that place.

dag: bee n-di m bindirigu n kɔŋko, ka kpibiga bi di li.
en: eaten my morsel alone, and not shared any with an orphan .

dag: Ka zuliya kam nim maa ti baŋ ni Izraɛlnim tuumbiɛri zuɣu ka bɛ gbahi ba leei daba chaŋ maa, dama bɛ daa nyɛla bɛn bi ʒe yim n sani, dinzuɣu ka n daa ŋmaligi n nini bahi kpaŋa, ka zaŋ ba niŋ bɛ dimnim nuu ni ka bɛ daa zaŋ takɔbiri ku bɛ zaa.
en: And the nations will know that the Israelites went into exile because of the sins which they committed against me. I turned away from them and let their enemies defeat them and kill them in battle.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ biɛri tuma nyɛla zana gbahiri ba, ka bɛ daalahichi tuma gbahiri ba.
en: The wicked will be caught by their own evil acts, grabbed by the ropes of their own sin.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Musa, Ti chaŋ a ni daa tim ti tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa ni, ka di tiŋgbani maa vuhira, di tiwala mi m-bɔŋɔ.
en: The men told Moses, We went to the land where you sent us. It is a land filled with many good things ! Here is some of the fruit that grows there.

dag: Yinim bɛn be alizanda ni, paɣimiya Yawɛ, paɣimiy o o jilima min o kpiɔŋ zuɣu.
en: Praise the Lord , you heavenly angels ! Praise the Lord s glory and power.

dag: Dama Ifriimnim mali maligu bimbina pam pahi ni bɛ tumdi alahichi. Ka di leei alahichi tumbu maligu bimbina bɛ sani.
en: When Ephraim added more altars to take away sin, they became altars to him for sinning.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔ saha ka o kpaŋ? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Sɔhila kurugu yini saha ka o niŋgbun biisim maa sa bah o.
en: He asked them when the boy got better, and they answered, The fever left him yesterday at one o'clock.

dag: nyin gbilisim tibili alizanda ni wum li, ka kari a daba saria, ka zaŋ taali maa galimi ʒili bɛn tum taali maa, ka bahi bɛn ka taali, ka ti ba laara bɛ biɛrisuntali zuɣu.
en: Please listen from heaven and judge them. If they are guilty, please show us that they are guilty. And if they are innocent, please show us that they are not guilty.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Jɔshua daa lan laɣim Izraɛl zuliya maa zaa Shɛkɛm na nti boli bɛ kpamba mini sariakaritiba ni zuɣulaannima ni Izraɛl tuma zuɣulaannima, ka bɛ daa ka Naawuni tooni na.
en: Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel together at Shechem. He called the elders, the leaders, the judges, and the officers of Israel, and they came into the presence of God.

dag: Dama ŋunkam tiligir o nyɛvili ni ti kɔŋ li, ka ŋunkam mi kɔŋd o nyɛvili n zuɣu ni ti lan nya li.
en: For if you want to save your own life, you will lose it; but if you lose your life for my sake, you will find it.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka n daa wum kukol shɛli damli kaman salo pam kukoya la ka di yi alizanda ni na yɛra, Haliluya! Ti Duuma Naawuni n-su tiliginsim mini yiko, ka simdi tibigibu!.
en: After this, I heard what sounded like a lot of voices in heaven, and they were shouting, Praise the Lord! To our God belongs the glorious power to save.

dag: ka a niriba Izraɛlnim ŋɔ ni ninvuɣ yino bee bɛ zaa yi mi bɛ wahala mini bɛ suhugarigu ni nyɛ shɛm, ka teei bɛ nuhi tiri duu ŋɔ polo na n-fabili niŋ a ka suh a.
en: When any of these things happen, people feel the need to spread their hands in prayer toward this Temple.

dag: N kul ni dol a zaligu sahakam.
en: I will always obey your law, forever and ever.

dag: Jɔsia ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa tum tuun viɛl shɛŋa kaman bɛ ni sab li shɛm Yawɛ zaligu kundi ni la.
en: The rest of Josiahs deeds, including his faithfulness in acting according to what is written in the LORDs Instruction.

dag: Di saha maa ka Zaliguzaɣisira maa ni ti yi zahira, ka ti Duuma Yisa ni ti zaŋ o vuhim pɔhim din yir o nol ni na ku o ka bah o yoli, ŋun Yisa palo yibu dali o labbuna saha.
en: Then that Man of Evil will appear. But the Lord Jesus will kill him with the breath that comes from his mouth. The Lord will come in a way that everyone will see, and that will be the end of the Man of Evil.

dag: Yiliyiiniba m-be tooni, ka biŋkumdiŋmɛriba doli nyaaŋa, ka paɣisara be bɛ sunsuuni n-chaɣisiri sayɛya.
en: Singers come marching in front, followed by the musicians; they are surrounded by young girls playing tambourines.

dag: Ka n ni ti chɛ ka Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim ni lo nia shɛŋa kpalim yoli kpe, ka n chɛ ka bɛ dimnima bɛn bɔri ni bɛ di bɛ nyɛviya la zaŋ takɔbi ku ba, ka n chɛ ka bɛ leei juri mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri bindirigu.
en: You people of Judah and Jerusalem may have big plans, but here in this valley I'll ruin those plans. I'll let your enemies kill you, and I'll tell the birds and wild animals to eat your dead bodies.

dag: Dama pa ti mini ninsalinima n-tuhiri taba, amaa ti mini alizinnim bɛn be sagbana tiŋli ŋɔ na mini bɛn nyɛ zuɣulaannima ni bɛn su fukumsi mini dunia ŋɔ yikolaannim bɛn be zibisim ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni la n-tuhiri taba.
en: For we are not fighting against human beings but against the wicked spiritual forces in the heavenly world, the rulers, authorities, and cosmic powers of this dark age.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa tim tumo ni o yim na ti yɛli Naaman ni o cham Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni nti mim di ni siɣimsiɣim buyopɔin ka o niŋgbuna lab dimaŋ ni ka o nya alaafee.
en: Elisha sent a servant out to tell him to go and wash himself seven times in the Jordan River, and he would be completely cured of his disease.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ biɛr ayi maa daa kana ti ʒin tuh o, ka fiɣisi Nabɔt yɛli, Nabɔt turila Naawuni mini naa. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o yi tiŋ maa tariga nti lab o kuɣa ku.
en: Then two men told the people that they heard Naboth speak against God and the king. So the people carried Naboth out of the city and killed him with stones.

dag: Mani, mmaŋmaŋ ni ti guli m piɛri maa, ka n ni ti chɛ ka bɛ dɔni. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I myself will feed my flock and make them lie down. This is what the LORD God says.

dag: Amaa ka o paɣ yɛl o, Naawuni yi di bɔri ti kubu, o naan ku deei ti ni zaŋ binshɛŋa nyo buɣim mali sara ti o ŋɔ ti nuu ni bee n-yɛl ti o ni yɛl ti yɛl shɛŋa ŋɔ bee n-wuhi ti o ni wuhi ti binshɛŋa ŋɔ zaa.
en: But his wife said to him, The Lord does not want to kill us. If he wanted to kill us, he would not have accepted our burnt offering and grain offering. He would not have shown us all these things or told us this.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, Bɛ nya nanima anu la ka bɛ sɔɣi bela vol ni Makɛda.
en: Joshua's soldiers told him, The five kings have been found in a cave near Makkedah.

dag: Bɛ yuri zɔri gari jɛŋgbina, ka mali suhuyiɣisili gari kunduna bɛn gɔri zaawuni. Ka bɛ yuri ni nyam. Bɛ wɔribariba yila katiŋ na. Bɛ yiɣirimi kaman tɔrili ni yiɣiri yomyom ni o ti to binshɛli shɛm la.
en: Their cavalry troops are faster than leopards, more ferocious than wolves hunting at sunset, and swifter than hungry eagles suddenly swooping down.

dag: Bɛ ni ti tuuri taba kaman bɛ yɛn zomi yi takɔbi kum ni la, ka so bi kari doli ba, ka yi ti ku mali yiko din ni tuhi yi dimnima.
en: They will stumble over each other as they would before a sword, even though no one is chasing them! You will have no power to stand before your enemies.

dag: O ni wurim pihi din du mini birini goma zaa;.
en: every strong fortress.

dag: Ka daa lan yɛl o, Dinzuɣu niŋm tuuba a biɛribiɛtali ŋɔ zuɣu ka suhi Naawuni; di pa shɛli o ni chɛ a tɛhi biɛri din nyɛ alahichi maa paŋ a.
en: Therefore, change your heart and life! Turn from your wickedness! Plead with the Lord in the hope that your wicked intent can be forgiven.

dag: Di saha ka niriba maa daa yɛl taba, Kamiyana ka ti pihi kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya ŋun zuɣu ka yɛl biɛɣu ŋɔ lee paai ti ŋɔ. Ka bɛ daa niŋ lala, ka di gbaala Jona.
en: Finally, the sailors got together and said, Let's ask our gods to show us who caused all this trouble. It turned out to be Jonah.

dag: Amaa a yi yɛn ti nandaamba pini, nyin di chɛ ka a nuzaa mi a nudirigu ni niŋdi shɛli.
en: But when you help a needy person, do it in such a way that even your closest friend will not know about it.

dag: Hal yi zuɣu ka Yawɛ je suli niŋ ma yɛli, A gba ku kpe tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: The LORD was even angry with me because of what you did. You wont enter the land either, God said.

dag: Ka ŋunkam shihi dilan ni ʒini binshɛlikam zuɣu ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni, ka ŋunkam ʒi bini maa, ŋun paɣim o situra ka su kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: Anyone who touches anything on which the man sat is unclean until evening. Anyone who carries anything on which the man sat must wash his clothes and take a bath, and he remains unclean until evening.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la: So nini na bi nya, ka so mi tibili na bi wum bee so ti baŋ binshɛŋa Naawuni ni mali zali ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yur o la.
en: However, as the scripture says, What no one ever saw or heard, what no one ever thought could happen, is the very thing God prepared for those who love him.

dag: Amaa o tɔbu ku kabi, ka ti yaannim Naawuni ŋun nyɛ kpiɔŋlan ŋɔ ni chɛ ka o nuhi mali kpiɔŋ ŋuna ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim gula, ka yihiri ba barina ni ŋɔ yuli zuɣu.
en: But you stood your ground, swiftly shooting back with the help of Jacob's God, the All-Powerful One— his name is the Shepherd, Israel's mighty rock.

dag: Naawuni vuhim ni ku ba, ka o suhuyiɣisili pɔhim di ba.
en: Like a storm, God destroys them in his anger.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N niriba m-bala, bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ku yɔhim ma. Dinzuɣu ka o daa tiligi ba.
en: The Lord rescued his people, and said, They are mine. They won't betray me.

dag: Ka bɛ yi wuh o la samli, di simdi ka o yo bɛ ni wuh o sam shɛli maa zaa o nyɛvili tiligibu zuɣu.
en: However, you may save your own life by paying whatever fine is demanded.

dag: Naawuni daa niŋ dimbɔŋɔ la o ni daa lo nia shɛli ka chɛ ka di pali ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu la puuni.
en: God did this according to his eternal plan. And he was able to do what he had planned because of all Christ Jesus our Lord had done.

dag: Yili maa yi nyɛla yil chirichi, yin chɛliya ka yi daalibarika kpalim di ni; amaa di yi pala yil chirichi, yin chɛliya ka yi daalibarika kpalim yi sani.
en: If the people in that home welcome you, they are worthy of your peace. May they have the peace you wished for them. But if they dont welcome you, they are not worthy of your peace. Take back the peace you wished for them.

dag: Ŋuna n-wuhiri li ka di lɛbiri li ginda, ni o chɛ ka di tum o ni zal li shɛm dunia ŋɔ zaa ni.
en: He overturns the circling clouds; by his guidance they do their work, doing everything he commands over the entire earth.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm tum alahichi pam, dinzuɣu ka o leei tabizahim niriba sani. Bɛnkam zaa daa tiri o jilima lihimi ʒiɛm o, dama bɛ nya o gbini. Omaŋmaŋ ŋuhirimi, ka ŋmalig o nini labi kpaŋa.
en: Jerusalem's horrible sins have made the city a joke. Those who once admired her now hate her instead— she has been disgraced; she groans and turns away.

dag: Di mi bi simdi ni o ti kpuɣi paɣiba pam niŋ o paɣiba, di yi niŋ lala o suhu ni lɛbigi. O mi di ti va anzinfa bee salima pam mali.
en: The king must not take numerous wives so that his heart doesnt go astray. Nor can the king acquire too much silver and gold.

dag: Ka yuun shɛli din pahir anahi ni, di wala zaa ni nyɛla wal suma ka ni nyɛla wumpaɣibo sara pina Yawɛ sani.
en: In the fourth year, all of the trees fruit will be holy, a celebration for the LORD.

dag: O daa zaŋla bɛ min o binshɛɣukam zaa duhi mɔɣili maa duli;.
en: He took them and everything that belonged to him, and he helped them cross the river.

dag: Ka Sadusiinim bɛn daa yɛri ni kum ni neebu kani la daa ka Yisa sanna ti bɔh o.
en: Then some Sadducees, who say that people will not rise from death, came to Jesus and said.

dag: Bɛ daa piligila Naawuni jɛmbu duu malibu tuma maa gol so ŋun daŋ tooni dahin yini dali. Goli maa daba anii dali ka bɛ daa mali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa puuni zaŋ tabili di zɔŋ la gba. Gol tuuli maa biɛɣ pinaayɔbu dali ka bɛ daa naai di tuma zaa.
en: They began to make things holy on the first day of the first month. On the eighth day of the month they reached the LORDs entrance hall. They made holy the LORDs temple for eight days, finishing on the sixteenth day of the first month.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋun daa siɣina maa n-nyɛ ŋun daa lan lab du zuɣusaa n-gari chaŋ ha ni o ti pali luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: So Christ came down, and he is the same one who went up. He went up above the highest heaven in order to fill everything with himself.

dag: Ka o nachin kpɛm maa daa bɔh o, Ka paɣ maa yi ti bi saɣi ni o doli ma kuli tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni a ni be ŋɔ na, man zaŋm a bia maa kulis a ya maa.
en: The servant said to him, Maybe this woman will not want to come back with me to this land. If that happens, should I take your son with me to your homeland.

dag: nyin wummi bɛ fabila mini bɛ suhigu alizanda ni ka niŋ bɛ ni bɔri shɛli maa ti ba.
en: Answer their prayers from heaven and give them victory.

dag: Ka bɛnkam wum pɔri ŋɔ puuni yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ ka tɛhi ni bɛ mali alibarika ka yɛri bɛ suhuri ni, Ti tiligiya, hal ti ni kul doli ti tipawumli soya ŋɔ zaa yoli, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka ashaara lu ninvuɣ biɛri mini ninvuɣ suma zuɣu.
en: When that kind of person hears the words of this agreement, they congratulate themselves, thinking: Ill be fine even though I insist on being stubborn. This would cause something wet to dry up and become like something parched.

dag: A yɛliya ni a ni du nti tam sagbana zuɣu n-zaŋ amaŋ leei kaman Zallakudura Naa.
en: I'll be above the clouds, just like God Most High.

dag: Aai, tuumbiɛri tumbu m-be yi suhuri ni, ka yi kul tumdila duŋtaabo tuma dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: No! You think only of the evil you can do, and commit crimes of violence in the land.

dag: Bɛn ka cheechi ni saria karibu yɛla bi kpa ma. Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun ni kari ba saria. Amaa bɛn be yi cheechi ni n-nyɛ yi ni kariti shɛb saria. Di nyɛla kaman di ni sab shɛm Naawuni Kundi ni la: Yihimiya ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋun be yi ni bahi.
en: It is not my business to judge those who are not part of the group of believers. God will judge them, but you must judge those who are part of your group. The Scriptures say, Make the evil person leave your group.

dag: Ka o lan yɛl o tumo maa, Yim doli pala mini puri soya n-dari niriba pahi na hal ka n yil ŋɔ ti pali niriba.
en: The master said to the servant, Go out to the highways and country roads. Tell the people there to come. I want my house to be full!.

dag: Amaa daliri shɛli zuɣu n ni chɛ a maa nyɛla m bɔrimi ni n wuh a n yiko ni nyɛ shɛm din ni chɛ ka n yuli moli gili dunia ni zaa.
en: But Ive left you standing for this reason: in order to show you my power and in order to make my name known in the whole world.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi, ka nyɛ yi tiligira la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi zuɣu, n ni tim Babilɔn nti ŋme n-kab bɛ dunoya zaa, ka chɛ ka bɛ niriba tahigu leei kumsi.
en: The LORD your redeemer, the holy one of Israel, says, For your sake, I have sent an army to Babylon, and brought down all the bars, turning the Chaldeans singing into a lament.

dag: Ka Yisa daa bɔhi ba, N ni daa tim ya ka yi bi ʒi liɣiri kolibihi bee adiikunima bee namdanim la, shɛli daa ti pooi ya? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Aai, shɛli daa bi pooi ti.
en: Jesus said to them, When I sent you out without a wallet, bag, or sandals, you didnt lack anything, did you? They said, Nothing.

dag: Fiɛbiga mini zuɣu ni kpahibu nyɛla din tiri yɛm, amaa bɛ ni chɛ bi so bahi, dihirila o ma vi.
en: Punishment and discipline can make children wise, but children who are never corrected will bring shame to their mother.

dag: Yawɛ bɔhiya, N di darigi bɛ tibili dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu? N di bɔhi zuliya ŋ-ŋɔ tatabo biɛri.
en: Should I punish the people of Judah for doing these things? This message is from the Lord . You know I should punish a nation such as this. I should give it the punishment it deserves.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni ti ŋmanila bɛ ni kpuɣi pu shɛli atam, ka be kaman bɛ ni yihi binyiha pu shɛli din be Rɛfaim Vinvamli ni.
en: It will be as when harvesters gather grain. God will harvest armfuls at a time, like one who gathers grain in the Rephaim Valley.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔiada daa ti kurigi ka o dabisa pali ka o kpi. O yuma daa nyɛla yuun kɔbiga ni pihita saha shɛl o ni daa kpi maa.
en: He died at the ripe old age of years.

dag: Gɛrishɔn zuliya maa n-daa su Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni mini di nyaaŋa binshɛŋa bɛ ni mali pindi li tuma fukumsi. Bɛna n-daa lan su Pateesa shɛli din yili di dunol ni.
en: In the dwelling, the Gershonites were responsible for the meeting tent, the tent with its covering, the screen for the entrance of the meeting tent.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni niŋ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ yi nyɛla din tuhi ni jilima ka yi ti Gidiɔn min o malibu maa, yin maliya suhupiɛlli zaŋ chaŋ Abimilɛk sani, ka o gba mali suhupiɛlli zaŋ chaŋ yi sani.
en: Now then, if what you did today to Gideon and his family was sincere and honest, then be happy with Abimelech and let him be happy with you.

dag: O niŋ o mini Ahisamak bia Oholiab ŋun nyɛ Dan zuliya ni nir la yiko ni bɛ wuhi niriba.
en: The Lord has given to him and to Oholiab son of Ahisamach, from the tribe of Dan, the ability to teach their crafts to others.

dag: Buɣim ni ti di n-kabi zuliya shɛba kaman bɛ ni nyɔri kɔba ka di leeri tampiligim shɛm la, ka lan be kaman bɛ ni ŋma go shɛŋa sɔŋ ka buɣim di li la.
en: People will be burned until their bones become lime. They will burn quickly like thorns and dry bushes.

dag: Yawɛ guli bɛn nyɛ tarimba. N daa be muɣisigu ni, ka o tiligi ma.
en: The LORD protects simple folk; he saves me whenever I am brought down.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa yi fɔŋ maa ni chani Yisa sani.
en: They left the city and were on their way to see Jesus.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ yɛliya, Nyamiya, n ni zaŋ kuɣituurili sɔŋ bɛ soli zuɣu, ka bɛ ti tuui li; bihi mini bɛ laamba zaa, ka ʒiʒiinikpee min o zo zaa ti kpi.
en: So I will put stumbling blocks in your path, and everyone will die, including parents and children, neighbors and friends.

dag: Dama du shɛŋa din daa be dundɔntitali maa ni wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita pisinaanu, ka din mi daa be Naawuni jɛmbu duu tooni la wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pihinu.
en: the same length, seventy-five feet, as the chambers facing the outer courtyard. Those facing the temple were one hundred fifty feet.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yo Aruna salima laɣibaligu kɔbisiyɔbu o kabɔɣili maa zuɣu.
en: And he paid Araunah six hundred gold coins for the threshing place.

dag: Ka pateesa shɛŋa din yɛn yili dunɔdali yaɣ yini polo wɔɣilim ti pooi mita ayopɔin biɛla, ka di ti mali daantalis ata mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu diba ata.
en: Here at the entrance to the courtyard, one side must have curtains cubits long. There must be three posts and three bases on this side.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa tim o dabili Musa mini Aduna ŋun nyɛ o ni daa pii so la.
en: God sent his servant Moses. He also chose and sent Aaron.

dag: Chɛ ka n wuhibu ŋɔ lu kaman saa la, ka n yɛtɔɣa tɔɣi lu kaman maligim la bee kaman saa ni yi luna baalim bahi mɔri zuɣu shɛm la; ka lan be kaman sa yuɣiyuɣi din yuɣisiri bahiri bimbilima zuɣu la.
en: My teaching will fall like drops of rain and form on the earth like dew. My words will fall like showers on young plants, like gentle rain on tender grass.

dag: Ti mabihi, teemiya ti ni daa tum ni ti yaa tariga ka di wahala shɛm la yɛla. Ti daa kul tumdimi wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa ni di chɛ ka ti yɛla ku muɣisi ya ka ti tooi yihi lahibal suŋ din yi Naawuni sanna la waazu tin ya.
en: Brothers and sisters, I know that you remember how hard we worked. We worked night and day to support ourselves, so that we would not be a burden to anyone while we did the work of telling you Gods Good News.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb daa kana ti yɛli Jɛhɔshafat, Salo pam yi Ɛdom kanna ni bɛ ti lir a, bɛ yila teekubil duli yaɣ din la polo kanna, ka pumpɔŋɔ bɛ bela Hazazɔntarima.
en: Messengers told Jehoshaphat, A large army from Edom east of the Dead Sea has invaded our country. They have already reached En-Gedi.

dag: N nya mbusim ni be Izraɛl tiŋgban ni; Ifriimnim tum yolimyolim, ka Izraɛlnim kpe daɣiri ni.
en: I have seen a horrible thing in Israel: my people have defiled themselves by worshiping idols.

dag: Ifriim zuliya ni toondana n-nyɛ Shifitan bia Kɛmuɛl.
en: and from the tribe of the Ephraimites, a chief, Kemuel, Shiphtans son.

dag: N yur a zaligunim maa pam. Di nyɛla n saawaranima.
en: Your laws are my greatest joy! I follow their advice.

dag: ka zaŋ o ti bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ni bɛ mal o ansarisi ka fiɛb o, ka kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu; amaa di daba ata dali, o ni ti neei kum ni.
en: and then hand him over to the Gentiles, who will make fun of him, whip him, and crucify him; but three days later he will be raised to life.

dag: Dama yi kpimi ka yi nyɛviya pahi Masia zuɣu n-sɔɣi Naawuni ni.
en: For you have died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.

dag: Ka o daa buɣisi duu maa wɔɣilim, ka di nyɛ mita pia, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pia, ka di be du titali maa tooni ha. Ka o daa yɛli ma, Luɣ kasi zaa kasi shee m-bɔŋɔ.
en: When he measured the length of the inner room, it was thirty feet, and the width of the side adjoining the main hall was also thirty feet. He said to me, This is the most holy place.

dag: Zaŋmiya dari mali sara maligu bimbini maa, ka di puuni nyɛ zaɣ yɔɣu. Malimiya li kaman n ni daa wuh a shɛm zoli zuɣu la.
en: Make the altar out of boards and leave it hollow, according to the plan that I showed you on the mountain.

dag: Judas ni daa ti paana o dii shiri chaŋmi ti zani Yisa tooni ka yɛli, Karimba! Ka mɔɣis o kpariŋ.
en: Judas walked right up to Jesus and said, Teacher! Then Judas kissed him.

dag: Ka Rubin mini Gaad zuliya niriba maa daa yɛli, Sara maligu bimbini ŋɔ nyɛla shɛhira bini ti mini ya sunsuuni ni Yawɛ n-nyɛ Naawuni. Ka bɛ daa boli sara maligu bimbini maa yuli, Shɛhira.
en: The people of Reuben and Gad said, This altar is a witness to all of us that the Lord is God. And so they named it Witness.

dag: N di bi zaɣisi ka bɛ zaŋ chiriga n-chirigi li pa tampiŋ zuɣu, ka di kul beni sahakam!.
en: I wish they were carved with an iron tool into lead or scratched on a rock so that they would last forever.

dag: Ka nachimbil so daa gɔb chinchin piɛlli kɔŋko doli Yisa, ka bɛ daa yɛn gbaag o gba.
en: A certain young man, dressed only in a linen cloth, was following Jesus. They tried to arrest him.

dag: Lala ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti Izraɛlnima kaman o ni daa pun lo bɛ yaannim alikauli shɛm la. Bɛ ni daa deei li naai, bɛ daa ʒinila di ni.
en: So the Lord gave to Israel all the land that he had solemnly promised their ancestors he would give them. When they had taken possession of it, they settled down there.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla alizin biɛri n-chani dunia nanim zaa sani nti wuhiri shihira ni bɛ laɣim ba lo tɔbu gu Naawuni Zallakudura Naa ŋɔ dabisi tital la dali.
en: They are the spirits of demons that perform miracles. These three spirits go out to all the kings of the world, to bring them together for the battle on the great Day of Almighty God.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛl o yaha, Zaŋm a nuu niŋ a binyɛrigu ni. Ka o zaŋ o nuu niŋ o binyɛrigu maa ni, o ni daa ti yihi li na, ka niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu gbaai li, ka di paligi zaa paratɛte kaman gumbɔrigu la.
en: The Lord spoke to Moses again, Put your hand inside your robe. Moses obeyed; and when he took his hand out, it was diseased, covered with white spots, like snow.

dag: Kalima anahi maa daa du pam ka mali dabiɛm. Ka nimbihi daa pie di fiilinim ni ti tuui.
en: The rims of the wheels were large and frightening, and they had eyes all the way around them.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ zanimiya baalim ka m mini ya laɣim suhi Yawɛ o ni tum tiliginsim tuun shɛŋa ti yi mini yi yaannim zaa la zuɣu.
en: Now, stand there. I will accuse you before the Lord and I will tell you about the good things the Lord did for you and your ancestors.

dag: Zakai daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiyopɔin ni pihiyɔbu.
en: of Zaccai.

dag: Suhudoo din lɔn ya tabili tab la zuɣu, chɛliya ka yi suhuri ye naŋgban yini malibu shɛli Naawuni Shia Kasi ni tiri ti la zuɣu.
en: and make an effort to preserve the unity of the Spirit with the peace that ties you together.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛhu daa kpe nti di ka nyu ka yɛli, Zaŋmiya noli ni di paɣ so maa ti sɔɣi; dama o nyɛla nabipuɣiŋga.
en: entered the palace, and had a meal. Only then did he say, Take that cursed woman and bury her; after all, she is a king's daughter.

dag: Yi yi mali yɛm, yin wummiya dimbɔŋɔ. Wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ.
en: So be smart and listen!.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Di zɔriya dabiɛm! Mani m-bala.
en: But he said, I am Jesus! Don't be afraid.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛli ma mi, Malim buɣili ŋun yɛn be ti tooni ti ti, dama Musa ŋun daa yihi ti Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na maa ŋuna, ti bi mi din niŋ o. .
en: The people said to me, Moses led us out of Egypt, but we dont know what has happened to him. So make us some gods to lead us.

dag: Dama Ammɔnnim mini Mɔabnim daa yiɣisimi lu Ɛdom Zoli zuɣunim maa zuɣu kuri ba. Bɛ ni daa ti ku ba naai, ka bɛ lan ŋmaligi lu tab zuɣu n-ku taba.
en: The Ammonites and the Moabites started to fight the men from Mount Seir. After they killed them, the Ammonites and Moabites turned on themselves and killed each other.

dag: ka di dolibu zuɣu chɛ ka n daa niŋ cheechi alaka. Ka ninsal ni ni doli Yɛhudianim zaligunim ka tooi mali wuntia biɛhigu shɛli di zuɣu la puuni, n daa ka taali.
en: With respect to devotion to the faith, I harassed the church. With respect to righteousness under the Law, Im blameless.

dag: Ka o sara maligu maa yi nyɛla piɛɣu bee bua, di simdi ka di nyɛla piɛlaa bee bulaa ŋun ka daŋa.
en: If you sacrifice a ram or a goat, it must not have anything wrong with it.

dag: N daa kabisi ninvuɣ biɛri nyina ka chɛ ka bɛ ni daa ŋubiri shɛb la yi n-luna.
en: I stopped evil people from abusing their power and saved innocent people from them.

dag: Di daliri zuɣu chɛ ka nayili tɔbbihi zaa mini bɛn zaa kpalim be kpe ŋɔ baŋ ni m be sarika ŋɔ ni la Masia zuɣu.
en: As a result, the whole palace guard and all the others here know that I am in prison because I am a servant of Christ.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ni yɛri ni tin shɛli nyɛla dabari, ka ninsal bee biŋkɔbigu lan ka di ni la, Juda fɔntinsi mini Jɛrusalɛm pal dahi din leei dabari, ka ninsalinim bee biŋkɔbigu lan ka di ni ŋɔ, bɛ ni ti lan wum.
en: Jeremiah, you say that this land is a desert without people or animals, and for now, you are right. The towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem are deserted, and people and animals are nowhere to be seen. But someday you will hear.

dag: Dama ti wumya ni ninvuɣ shɛb be yi ni n-nyɛ ʒinahigunima ka je ni bɛ tum shɛli, ka bɛ tuma naɣ kul nyɛla dari gindi kpɛri niriba yɛla ni kɔŋko.
en: We hear that some people in your group refuse to work. They are doing nothing except being busy in the lives of others.

dag: Bɛ tiŋgbani maa piligu shee n-daa nyɛ Aroa din daa ʒi Arinɔn Mɔɣili Vinvamli dul la mini tin kar shɛli din daa ʒi vinvamli maa sunsuuni la ni Mɛdɛba tintan zaŋ hal ti paai Dibɔn.
en: This region stretched north from the town in the middle of the Arnon River valley, and included the town of Aroer on the northern edge of the valley. It covered the flatlands of Medeba north of Dibon.

dag: Yawɛ zɔbu n-nyɛ yɛm piligu. Ŋun nyɛ kasi ŋɔ baŋbu tahiri tɛhi zilima na.
en: To be wise you must first have reverence for the Lord . If you know the Holy One, you have understanding.

dag: Bɛ jɛmdi ma la yoli, dama bɛ malila salinim zaligunima wuhiri niriba kaman Naawuni zaligunima n-nyɛ li la.
en: It is useless for you to worship me, when you teach rules made up by humans.

dag: Suhimiya Naawuni tiri n gba, ka Naawuni ti ma n ni yɛn tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ka n tooi tɔɣisiri li ni suhukpeeni n-kahigiri lahibal suŋ la ashili gbinni ni nyɛ shɛm wuhiri niriba.
en: Pray that I will be given the message to speak and that I may fearlessly explain the mystery about the good news.

dag: N yura n-su ma, ka o kɔre be n ni.
en: I belong to my lover, and he desires me.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa zaŋ li chaŋ Yufretiiz Mɔɣili maa ni ti pi kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛli ma shɛm maa.
en: And that's what I did.

dag: Ka ti yi doli fukumsi zaligunim ŋɔ zaa viɛnyɛliŋga kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ti shɛm, dindina ti niŋ din tuhi. .
en: If we carefully obey the whole law, exactly as the Lord our God told us to, he will say that we have done a very good thing.

dag: Bɛ yi ti niŋ tuuba ni bɛ suhuri zaa ni bɛ shihi zaa bɛ ni nyɛ daba tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni maa, ka zaŋ bɛ nina kpa a ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti bɛ yaannim ŋɔ min a ni pii tiŋ shɛli ŋɔ ni n ni me du shɛli zali ti a yuli jilima ŋɔ polo na ka n-suh a.
en: If in that land they truly and sincerely repent and pray to you as they face toward this land which you gave to our ancestors, this city which you have chosen, and this Temple which I have built for you.

dag: Daadam, fabilim Taai naa zuɣu ka yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyini n-daa nyɛ shihirili din wuhiri din ka galimi ka mali baŋsim pam, ka viɛl zaa.
en: Human one, sing a lament for the king of Tyre. Say to him, The LORD God proclaims: You were full of wisdom and beauty, the image of perfection.

dag: Ka Sool daa tim tuumba ni bɛ ti zaŋ Dauda na, ka paɣ maa yɛli ba, O biɛrimi.
en: When Saul's men came to get David, Michal told them that he was sick.

dag: Karimbaandan maa ni tuui lu ka so ku beni ŋun ni yiɣis o zali. Ka n ti nyo o fɔntinsi buɣim, ka di di binshɛɣukam din gil o.
en: The arrogant one will stumble and fall, and no one will help her up. Ill set your cities on fire, and it will consume all thats around her.

dag: Yi daa ku niriba pam bo vi niŋ yi yiŋa. Yi kɔŋ yi nyɛviya.
en: You planned shameful things, and that will bring shame to your own family. You have done wrong, and it will cost you your life.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ gili Juda tiŋgban ni fɔntinsi zaa ni nti laɣim Lɛvinim mini Izraɛl dɔɣirikpamba, ka bɛ ka Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: These five men went to the towns in Judah and called together the Levites and the clan leaders. They all came to Jerusalem.

dag: Kuhimiya boli ma yi muɣisigu dali, ka n tiligi ya, ka yi ti ma jilima.
en: God says, Call me when trouble comes. I will help you, and you will honor me.

dag: So miri ka o kpuɣ o paɣ mabia pah o zuɣu saha shɛl o paɣ maa ni na be o nyɛvili ni maa.
en: While your wife is still living, you must not take her sister as another wife. This will make the sisters become enemies. You must not have sexual relations with your wifes sister.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ nyama, Yawɛ zaŋla ʒiri shia niŋ a daanabinim ŋɔ zaa noya ni. Yawɛ yɛlila zaɣ biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ a polo.
en: So that is what has happened here. The Lord made your prophets lie to you. The Lord himself decided to bring this disaster to you.

dag: Amaa Abimilɛk daa na bi zaŋ Zara dɔni, dinzuɣu ka o daa bɔhi, N Duuma, a ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali?.
en: Abimelech said to the Lord, Don't kill me! I haven't slept with Sarah. Didn't they say they were brother and sister? I am completely innocent.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔahaz daa ti kani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Samaria; ka o bia Jɛhɔash daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: He died and was buried in Samaria, and his son Jehoash succeeded him as king.

dag: O ni zaŋ wuntia kaman nyɔtaɣirigu la ye, ka zaŋ tiliginsim kaman zuɣupiligu la pili. O ni zaŋ o suhu ni lo ni o mali binshɛɣukam zali dɛde shɛm, ka bɔhi biɛri ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn diri wahala la kaman binyɛrigu la ye.
en: Justice was the Lord 's armor; saving power was his helmet; anger and revenge were his clothes.

dag: Yawɛ bemi kaman tɔbbia la, o ŋmanila tɔbutuhira ŋun suhu ye tuhibu zuɣu. O kuhirimi yɛri pampam, ka wuhiri ni o mali yaa gar o dimnima.
en: The Lord goes out to fight like a warrior; he is ready and eager for battle. He gives a war cry, a battle shout; he shows his power against his enemies.

dag: So ka suhupiɛlli tiŋgban shɛli din mali atam maa ni. So bi tahiri bee n-yiini yila wain tihi puri maa ni. So mi bi nɔri wain tihi wala ni o yihi wain, ka so bi wumdi suhupiɛlli tahigu damli.
en: There will be no joy and happiness in the orchard. I will end the happy singing and shouting in the vineyard. The grapes are ready to make wine, but they will all be ruined.

dag: Di kari ma a sani bahi, a mi di yih a shia kasi n ni.
en: Do not banish me from your presence; do not take your holy spirit away from me.

dag: Amaa dɔbba pia daa be bɛ ni ka yɛli Ishimail, Di ku ti, dama ti mali alikama mini chi ni kpam ni shiri ka di sɔɣi mɔri ni. Dinzuɣu ka o daa chɛ ba, ka bi ku ba pahi bɛ tab maa zuɣu.
en: But there were ten men among them who begged Ishmael, Dont kill us; we have wheat, barley, oil, and honey hidden in a field. So he stopped and didnt kill them along with the rest. .

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa bɔhi taba, So n-tahi bindirigu na ti ti o ka o di yɔɣɔ.
en: So the followers asked themselves, Did someone already bring him some food.

dag: N ni ti ti ba tiŋgban shɛli din mali atam viɛnyɛliŋga, ka bɛ ku lan kpi kum tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni yaha. Ka zuliya shɛb ku lan tu ba yaha.
en: I will establish for them a place famous for what it grows. No longer will they experience famine in the land, nor will they bear the disgrace of the nations.

dag: N ni daa nyɛ bia, n daa tɔɣisirila bilim yɛtɔɣa, ka mali bia tɛha, ka buɣisiri yɛla bilim buɣisibu; amaa n ni daa ti bi doo, ka n chɛ bilim soya zaa.
en: When I was a child, my speech, feelings, and thinking were all those of a child; now that I am an adult, I have no more use for childish ways.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ binnamda zaa Duuma Naawuni la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Niriba ni doli solɔri n-kumdi ka fabindi yɛra, Mbaye! mbaye! Bɛ ni ti boli pukpariba na ti pahi bɛ ni tiri shɛb liɣiri ka bɛ kumdi kuyila zuɣu, ka bɛ kum ka fabili.
en: Truly, the LORD proclaims, the God of heavenly forces, the Lord: Crying will be heard in all the squares. In all the streets they will say, Oh no! Oh no! They will call upon the farmers to wail, and those skilled in mourning to lament.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, ŋunkam niŋ a naani mal alibarika!.
en: Lord Almighty, how happy are those who trust in you!.

dag: O ni kpaai tulaale ŋɔ niŋ ma maa, o niŋ li mi gu n sɔɣibu.
en: What she did was to pour this perfume on my body to get me ready for burial.

dag: Ka kpatoon kpɛm daa vihi hal ti nya o nimaani m-bɔh o, Bɔzuɣu ka nyin doya gbihira? Yiɣisim suh a wuni ka o sɔŋ ti. Di pa shɛli ka o zo ti nambɔɣu tiligi ti nyɛviya.
en: The ships officer came and said to him, How can you possibly be sleeping so deeply? Get up! Call on your god! Perhaps the god will give some thought to us so that we wont perish.

dag: O ni daa gbaag o maa o daa kpɛh o la duu, ka chɛ ka duguliba pinaayɔbu ʒe n-gul o, dama o daa lɔrila nia ni Yaɣigari Chuɣu puhi gari ka o zaŋ o niŋ Yɛhudianim nuu ni.
en: He put Peter in jail and ordered four squads of soldiers to guard him. Herod planned to put him on trial in public after the festival.

dag: O ni tiligi ma ni alaafee n ni tuhiri tɔb shɛŋa la ni, dama bɛn tuhiri ma maa galisiya pam.
en: He saves me, unharmed, from my struggle, though there are many who are out to get me.

dag: A tɛhiya ni n ku tooi suhi m Ba Naawuni ka o tim malaikanim tusatusa shɛm n sanna pumpɔŋɔ?.
en: Don't you know that I could ask my Father, and he would at once send me more than twelve armies of angels?.

dag: M muɣisigu nyabu dali, n daa suhi n Duuma. N daa kpuɣila n nuhi zuɣusaa n-suhi Naawuni yuŋ zaa ka di bi wum ma, ka n suhu daa zaɣisi maabu.
en: My Lord, in my time of trouble I came to you. I reached out for you all night long. My soul refused to be comforted.

dag: Musa mini Aduna maa n-daa nyɛ bɛn yɛli Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa la ni o chɛ ka Izraɛlnim yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: and so they told the king of Egypt to set the people of Israel free.

dag: Di sab Anabi Musa zaligu ni, Miri ka a zaŋ naŋgbampɔbirigu m-pɔbi naɣikɔrigu ŋun nɔri buri chi noli. Naɣikɔra zuɣu ka Naawuni yɛl lala maa?.
en: We read in the Law of Moses, Do not muzzle an ox when you are using it to thresh grain. Now, is God concerned about oxen?.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ anabinim maa polo m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn zaŋla bintɔri dihi ba, ka zaŋ kom din mali lɔɣu nyuhi ba. Dama tuumbiɛri maa yila Jɛrusalɛm anabinim maa sani n-gili tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni.
en: So then, this is what I, the Lord Almighty, say about the prophets of Jerusalem: I will give them bitter plants to eat and poison to drink, because they have spread ungodliness throughout the land.

dag: Amaa ti mi ku tooi zaŋ ti bipuɣinsi ti ba. Dama tinim Izraɛlnim pun po n-yɛli ni ti ni so yi zaŋ o bipuɣiŋga n-ti Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa, noli din dim o.
en: But we cant allow our daughters to marry them, for we Israelites have made this pledge: Let anyone who provides a wife for Benjamin be cursed.

dag: Ka di tintariga maa lan zaŋ nimaani kpa nuzaa polo m-mali ti du Bɛtihɔgila kuŋkuni, ka di tintariga maa daa zaŋ hal ti paai di tariga Yalim Teeku duli nuzaa polo zaŋ lab Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili nudirigu polo. Di nudirigu polo tintariga n-daa bala.
en: Then it went to the northern part of Beth Hoglah and ended at the north shore of the Dead Sea. This is where the Jordan River flows into that sea. That was the southern border.

dag: dama m mi yi ni pun yu ni yi niŋ shɛm yɛla. Ka n nyuri bara yi zuɣu Masidɔnianim sani, ka yɛri ni Akaianim gba pun malila shili yuuni la ha, ka yi ni yu ni yi niŋ shɛm kpaŋsi bɛ ni shɛb pam suhuri.
en: I know about your willingness to help. I brag about you to the Macedonians, saying, Greece has been ready since last year, and your enthusiasm has motivated most of them.

dag: Ka naa maa mini ba zaa daa ti di alizama, ka o nya ka Daniɛl mini Hanania ni Mishɛl ni Azaria yɛla n-kpe o nyaɣisim gari bɛ tab la zaa. Ka bɛ daa leei bɛn ʒiini naa tooni nayili.
en: When the king spoke with them, he found no one as good as Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah. So they took their place in the kings service.

dag: Ifriim zuliya niriba daa sula nudirigu polo, ka Manaasa zuliya niriba mi su nuzaa polo ka Teeku do bɛ sunsuuni n-nyɛ bɛ tintarisi bolo. Asha daa bela nuzaa polo ka Isaka mi be wulimpuhili polo.
en: Ephraim was to the south, and Manasseh was to the north, with the Mediterranean Sea as their western border. Asher was to the northwest, and Issachar to the northeast.

dag: Tiŋgbɔna ŋɔ buɣa zaa banim, na mi n-fa bɛ tiŋgbɔna bahi, ka Yawɛ ti fari Jɛrusalɛm n nuu ni bahira? .
en: None of these gods kept their people safe from the king of Assyria. Do you think the Lord your God can do any better?.

dag: Di nyaaŋa yi ni ti be n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti yi yaannim la ni, ka ti leei n niriba, ka n gba nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Then you will live in the land that I gave to your ancestors. You will be my people, and I will be your God.

dag: lala ka n yɛligu shɛli din yiri n nol ni na gba ku labi n sanna yoli. Di ni tum n ni lo ni di tum shɛli. Ka di nasara n ni tim li ni di ti tum shɛm puuni.
en: In the same way, my words leave my mouth, and they dont come back without results. My words make the things happen that I want to happen. They succeed in doing what I send them to do.

dag: Ka nachimbil maa yɛl o, M pun doli dimbɔŋɔnim zaa, ka bɔ n-lee lan kpalim ma.
en: I have obeyed all these commandments, the young man replied. What else do I need to do.

dag: Doliya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ya so shɛŋa la zaa din ni chɛ ka yi be, ka binshɛɣukam niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani, ka yi ti mali nyɛvili wɔɣila tiŋgbɔn shɛli yi ni ti yɛn su maa ni.
en: Obey them all, so that everything will go well with you and so that you will continue to live in the land that you are going to occupy.

dag: O nam yiko kul ni zoori pahira; ka suhudoo kul ni be o ʒiɛman ni. O nam ni be kaman Dauda nam. O ni doli wuntia ni din tuhi soli n-chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔ zaa niŋ pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yu ni o niŋ dimbɔŋɔ zaa.
