en: His power will never end; peace will last forever. He will rule David's kingdom and make it grow strong. He will always rule with honesty and justice. The Lord All-Powerful will make certain that all of this is done.

dag: N dimnim maa kul bɔrila soli dabisili kam ni bɛ saɣim m bukaata; bɛ tɛha zaa kul nyɛla bɛ loya ni bɛ niŋ ma la zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: My enemies are always twisting my words. They are always making plans against me.

dag: Ka Zipɔr bia Balak ŋun daa nyɛ Mɔab naa la daa ti yiɣisi lo tɔbu ni o tuhi Izraɛlnima, ka daa tim ti boli Bɛɔr bia Balaam ni o ti yɛl noli tin ya.
en: King Balak decided that his nation Moab would go to war against you, so he asked Balaam to come and put a curse on you.

dag: So miri ka o zaŋ o bidibiga bipuɣiŋga bee o bipuɣiŋga mi bipuɣiŋga dɔni, dama di nyɛla vi tuuni.
en: You must not have sexual contact with your sons daughter or your daughters daughter, because their nakedness is your own nakedness.

dag: Nimaani ka o daa ti chirigi Pɔntus tiŋbi so ŋun yuli booni Akuila min o paɣ Prisila bɛn daa yoli yi Itali na la, dama Rom Naa Klɔdius n-daa zali zaligu ni Yɛhudianim zaa yim Rom, ka bɛ mi daa nyɛ Yɛhudianima.
en: There he met a Jew named Aquila, born in Pontus, who had recently come from Italy with his wife Priscilla, for Emperor Claudius had ordered all the Jews to leave Rome. Paul went to see them.

dag: bee n-ʒin ya adiikunima n-chaŋ yi chandi maa bee n-yɛnya daliyanima ayiyi; yi mi di piriya namda bee n-gbibi jaaŋgbɛhi, dama tumtumda kam simdi ni bɛ ti o bindirigu.
en: do not carry a beggar's bag for the trip or an extra shirt or shoes or a walking stick. Workers should be given what they need.

dag: Biŋkɔbigu kam mini noonsi ni biŋgbamda ni binnɛma zaa bɛn be teeku ni nyɛla ninsal ni ni tooi maai shɛb nina hal ka pun maai li gba.
en: We humans are able to tame and have tamed all other creatures—wild animals and birds, reptiles and fish.

dag: Yi kpalim malila yi buɣ so ŋun yuli booni Molok la suɣili mini yi buɣ so ŋun gba yuli booni Rɛfan, ka o nyɛ saŋmariga kɔtomsi ka nyɛ yi ni daa me shɛŋa n-zali ni yi jɛmdi la. Dinzuɣu n ni zaŋ ya ti bahi Babilɔn tooni ha.
en: You carried with you the tent for worshiping Moloch and the image of the star of your god Rephan. These were the idols you made to worship. So I will send you away beyond Babylon. Amos :-.

dag: n-zaŋ a vilivili labi pal yaɣu ni kaman bolli la. Ka a kpi nimaani ka chɛ a chɛchɛbun shɛŋa a ni mali nyuri bara maa bahi nimaani. A nyɛla ŋun dih a dan yiŋ vi!.
en: he will indeed unroll your head wrapping, rolling it like a ball into the open country. There you will die, with your glorious chariots, you disgrace to the house of your master!.

dag: N ni ku Asirianim bɛn be n tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka du n-tam bɛ zuɣu no ba n zoya la zuɣu, ka tiligi n niriba Asirianim maa ʒi tibisa ʒibu ni.
en: I will break Assyria in my land; on my mountains I will trample it and remove its yoke from my people; his burden will be taken from their shoulders.

dag: Kpiimba biɛhigu shee dola palo ni Naawuni tooni, ka bahiyoli ka binshɛli din ni pili.
en: Nothing in that land of death and destruction is hidden from God.

dag: A tɛhiya ni n ku tooi suhi m Ba Naawuni ka o tim malaikanim tusatusa shɛm n sanna pumpɔŋɔ?.
en: Or do you think that Im not able to ask my Father and he will send to me more than twelve battle groups of angels right away?.

dag: Ti daa ʒinila tiŋa Babilɔn mɔɣa duli. Nimaani ka ti daa ʒini kum, saha shɛli ti ni daa teei Ziɔn yɛla.
en: By the rivers of Babylon we sat down; there we wept when we remembered Zion.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ ni ka yɛli ba, Dɔɣimiya ka wɔɣi n-nab pali teeku mini dunia.
en: He blessed them all and told the creatures that live in the water to reproduce and to fill the sea, and he told the birds to increase in number.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka ti bi gbarigira. Hal ti niŋgbuna yi filinda, ti suhuri ni biɛhigu din kul leerila zaɣ pala biɛɣukam.
en: So we arent depressed. But even if our bodies are breaking down on the outside, the person that we are on the inside is being renewed every day.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ti lan yi Samuɛl zuɣu Shilo, dama Yawɛ daa kahig omaŋa wuhi Samuɛl Shilo ŋun Yawɛ yɛligu ni. Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa gbilisiri tibili wumdi Samuɛl yɛligu.
en: The Lord continued to reveal himself at Shiloh, where he had appeared to Samuel and had spoken to him. And when Samuel spoke, all Israel listened.

dag: Ka o mayilinim maa daa zan o zaani n-zaŋ o yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi Shɛkɛmnim zaa ti o, ka Shɛkɛmnim maa daa wuhi ni bɛ ni doli Abimilɛk, dama ni o nyɛla bɛ mabia.
en: Abimelech's uncles talked it over with the leaders of Shechem who agreed, Yes, it would be better for one of our relatives to be king.

dag: Ka bɛ daa duna n-yi ŋariŋ maa ni na nti nya ka bɔrɔbɔro doya, ka nya sala buɣim ka zahim pa di zuɣu.
en: When they landed, they saw a fire there, with fish on it, and some bread.

dag: Hal Naa Asa daa yihila Maaka ŋun daa nyɛ o yabipaɣ la Napaɣ nam ni, o ni daa me buɣili Ashɛra ŋmahinli zal la zuɣu. Ka Naa Asa daa chɛ ka bɛ daai o ni me ŋmahinli shɛli zali maa luhi n-wurim li ka zaŋ li ti nyo buɣim Kidirɔn Vinvamli ni.
en: King Asa removed his grandmother Maacah from her position as queen mother, because she had made an obscene idol of the fertility goddess Asherah. Asa cut down the idol, chopped it up, and burned the pieces in Kidron Valley.

dag: O kul ni nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni saha shɛli zaa dɔro ŋɔ ni na be o ni, o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni, ka di simdi ni o yi kpaŋ ti be o ko.
en: You remain unclean as long as you have the disease, and you must live outside the camp, away from others.

dag: O daa ba chɛrubi yiɣi; ka bɛ daa nya o ka o bela pɔhim ni chana.
en: You rode on the backs of flying creatures. You appeared with the wind as wings.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yɛl o, Sintani, wara! Di sabiya, Sal kul ni jɛmla o Duuma Naawuni kɔŋko, ka pa ni so yaha. .
en: Then Jesus answered, Go away, Satan! The scripture says, Worship the Lord your God and serve only him.

dag: Dindali maa kaai biɛɣ asibaasi sara maligu saha, ka kom daa yi Ɛdom polo n-zo na ti tɛli tiŋgbani zaa.
en: The next morning, at the time of the regular morning sacrifice, water came flowing from the direction of Edom and covered the ground.

dag: Dinzuɣu yiɣisim siɣi doli ba chaŋ ka di biɛhind a suhu ni, dama mani n-tim ba a sanna.
en: So get ready and go down, and do not hesitate to go with them, for I have sent them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan mali salima bintaɣindisi ayi mini salima bans ayi, ka zaŋ salima bans ayi maa goli gɔhi nyolɔrigu maa naŋgbambiya.
en: The workers made two gold rings and fastened them to two corners of the judgment pouch. Then they made two gold settings for the shoulder pieces.

dag: O mabia Ɛliɛza bia n-daa nyɛ Rɛhabia, ka Rɛhabia bia nyɛ Jɛshaya, ka Jɛshaya bia nyɛ Jɔram, ka Jɔram bia nyɛ Zikiri, ka Zikiri bia nyɛ Shɛlomɔt.
en: Through Gershom's brother Eliezer he was related to Shelomith. Eliezer was the father of Rehabiah, who was the father of Jeshaiah, the father of Joram, the father of Zichri, the father of Shelomith.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛl o, Ʒinimi tiŋa n-karim li ka ti wum. Ka Baruk daa karim li ka bɛ wum.
en: They said to him, Sit down and read it to us. So Baruch read it to them.

dag: Amaa lee miriya ka yi chɛ ka yi yolisim maa leei kuɣituurili ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka kpiɔŋ la sani.
en: Be careful, however, not to let your freedom of action make those who are weak in the faith fall into sin.

dag: Ka olivi tiwula ayi shɛŋa din ʒe m-baɣi salima bimmulima ayi shɛŋa ni bɛ ni boori olivi kpam la mi gbinni lee nyɛla wula.
en: And what is the meaning of the two branches from which golden olive oil flows through the two gold pipes.

dag: M bia, alahichinim yi kpɛhir a kɔre, nyin di saɣi.
en: Don't be tempted by sinners or listen.

dag: Ka tihi maa daa chɛ ka yɛli fiig tia, Ti bɔri ni nyini n-leei ti naa.
en: Then they asked the fig tree, Will you be our king.

dag: Jɛhu ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam zaa ni o kpiɔŋ yɛla zaa, bɛ sab li niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: All the other great things that Jehu did are written in the book, The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Amaa yɛl yini zuɣu ka n naɣ galim ya: Yi bahi yi tuuli yurilim la.
en: But I do have something against you! And it is this: You don't have as much love as you used to.

dag: Ka o yɛli ma, Kpuɣim a zuɣu lihi nya bula shɛb zaa bɛn duri buhi ŋɔ, bɛ nyɛla zaɣ bomaboma mini bɛn liɣisiliɣisi ni bɛn nyɛ zaɣ bɔribɔri, dama n nya Leeban ni niŋd a shɛm.
en: The angel said, Look, only the striped and spotted goats are mating. I am causing this to happen. I have seen all the wrong things Laban has been doing to you. I am doing this so that you can have all the new baby goats.

dag: Hal n ni kul mali yɛlimaŋli maa zaa yoli, bɛ boli ma ʒirilana. Hal n ni bi tum alahichi maa yoli, n dɔro maa ka tibi kpaŋ.
en: I am right, but I am judged to be a liar. I have done no wrong, but I am badly hurt.

dag: Di ni sab zani so zuɣu ni o niŋ dabili ni bahi leei dabili; ka ŋunkam mali takɔbi kur o taba, bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku o gba. Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu di simdi ni Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda mal ania ka niŋ yɛda.
en: If you are doomed to be captured, you will be captured. If you are doomed to be killed by a sword, you will be killed by a sword. This means God's people must learn to endure and be faithful!.

dag: Ka Farisiinim mini Sadusiinim daa ka Yisa sanna nti bɔri ni bɛ zahim o ka o wuhi ba alizanda ni shihirili.
en: The Pharisees and Sadducees came to Jesus. They wanted to test him. So they asked him to show them a miracle as a sign from God.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ, ti nyɛla daba m-be tiŋgbɔn shɛli a ni daa zaŋ ti ti yaannim maa ni hal ni zuŋɔ. A daa zaŋ li ti ba ni bɛ diri di tiwala, ka nyari di pin suma daanfaani.
en: And now we are slaves in the land that you gave us, this fertile land which gives us food.

dag: Dama yi ni yɛn kari zuliya shɛb maa nyɛla bɛn doli baɣisi mini bihiŋmɛriba yɛligu, amaa yinim bɛna, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ bi saɣi ni yi niŋ lala.
en: Then Moses said, In the land you are about to occupy, people follow the advice of those who practice divination and look for omens, but the Lord your God does not allow you to do this.

dag: Amaa din sabi niŋ di ni ŋɔ sabimi ni yi niŋ yɛda ni Yisa nyɛla Masia ŋun nyɛ Naawuni Bia, ka yi yɛda niŋbu maa zuɣu chɛ ka yi nya nyɛvili o yuli zuɣu.
en: But these have been written in order that you may believe that Jesus is the Messiah, the Son of God, and that through your faith in him you may have life.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔnatan daa yɛl o, Nyama, ti ni baai du n-chaŋ bɛ sani ti zaŋ timaŋ wuhi ba.
en: This is what we will do, Jonathan said. We will go across and let them see us.

dag: Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb daba kalinli m-bɔŋɔ: Yuun shɛli din pahir ayopɔin ni, o daa gbahila Judanim ninvuɣ tusaata ni pisinaata.
en: This is the record of the people that Nebuchadnezzar took away as prisoners: in his seventh year as king he carried away ,;.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn mini ninvuɣ kɔbisita bɛn daa be o sani maa daa kana ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du m-biɛhiri bɛ dimnim maa naba, ka di daa wum ba pam.
en: Then Gideon came to the Jordan. As he and the three hundred men with him crossed over, they were exhausted but still giving chase.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka buɣim kana ti taai di nimdi maa mini dari maa ni kuɣa ni taŋkpaɣu, ka chɛ ka ko shɛli din daa be bɔɣili maa ni farifari nyuui.
en: Then the LORDs fire fell; it consumed the sacrifice, the wood, the stones, and the dust. It even licked up the water in the trench!.

dag: Ka Mɔdɛkai daa sab yɛl shɛŋa din niŋ maa zaa sɔŋ. O daa sab gbana ti Yɛhudianim bɛn zaa be yoma mini katinsi Naa Ahasivɛrɔs tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni.
en: Mordecai wrote down everything that had happened. Then he sent letters to the Jews everywhere in the provinces.

dag: Yisa daa piligi ŋahi niriba ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli, Do so n-daa sa wain tihi n-zaŋ li niŋ padiriba nuu ni ni bɛ lihiri li hal ti kpuɣi puu maa atam ti o ka deei bɛ yɔri, ka daa go n-chaŋ tinshee ti yuui.
en: Jesus told the people this parable: A certain man planted a vineyard, rented it to tenant farmers, and went on a trip for a long time.

dag: Ka yili shɛli din pɔri ka ku tooi ŋubi piɛbila muni naai, bɛn chɛ ka bɛ mini bɛ ʒiʒiinitaba bɛn baɣi ba laɣim bo piɛbil yino, di simdi ka bɛ pirigi piɛbil maa saɣisi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛn ŋub o kalinli.
en: If a household is too small for a lamb, it should share one with a neighbor nearby. You should divide the lamb in proportion to the number of people who will be eating it.

dag: Dabindi biɛla ŋ-ŋɔ n-chɛri ka bɔrɔbɔro ziŋŋɔritili zaa pirita.
en: Be careful! Just a little yeast makes the whole batch of dough rise.

dag: ni Yawɛ yɛliya, Di chaŋya ti tuhi yi mabihi maa. Labimiya kuli, Man Yawɛ sani ka din niŋ maa yina. Di saha ka bɛ daa wum Yawɛ ni yɛli ba shɛm maa ka lab kuli, ka daa bi lan chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi Jɛrɔbɔam.
en: This is what the LORD says: Dont make war against your relatives. Go home, every one of you, because this is my plan. When they heard the LORDs words, they abandoned their attack against Jeroboam.

dag: O ni daa niŋ Rubin bia Ɛliab bidibisi Datan mini Abiram shɛm la, tiŋgbani ni daa bɔɣi n-vali bɛ mini bɛ malibu ni bɛ suɣa ni binnɛɔŋ kam ŋun daa be bɛ sani Izraɛlnim zaa sunsuuni la.
en: You recall what he did to Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab of the tribe of Reuben. In the sight of everyone the earth opened up and swallowed them, along with their families, their tents, and all their servants and animals.

dag: Ka Sulemaana mini Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn daa be o sani n-galisi pam la daa zaŋ daba ayopɔin puhi chuɣu di saha maa. Niriba maa daa ʒiɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ tooni Lɛbohamat dunol la shee zaŋ hal ti paai Ijipti kulibɔŋ la shee.
en: Solomon and the huge crowd celebrated the Festival of Shelters at the temple for seven days. There were people from as far away as the Egyptian Gorge in the south and Lebo-Hamath in the north.

dag: Chamiya ti ʒini tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali anfaani mini atam maa ni, amaa n ku doli ya chaŋ nimaani. Di yi pa lala n ni ti kun ya sol ni, dama yi nyɛla tipawumlinima.
en: So go to the land filled with many good things, but I will not go with you. You people are very stubborn. If I go with you, I might destroy you along the way.

dag: O yi ti labina o dabisili la dali ni o ti nya tibiginsim o ninvuɣ gahinda sani, ka nya jilima bɛn zaa niŋ o yɛda la sani, yinim gba ni ti be bɛ ni, yi ni daa niŋ ti ni zaŋ shɛhira shɛli yɛla na nti yɛli ya la yɛda la zuɣu.
en: This will happen when he comes on that day to receive honor from his holy people and to be admired by everyone who has believed—and our testimony to you was believed.

dag: Naa ŋun mali kpiɔŋ ka nyɛ ŋun yuri zaligu soli, a nyɛla ŋun zali yɛlimaŋli soli. A nyɛla ŋun doli zaligu mini wuntia soli din be Yaakubu zuliya ni kari saria.
en: Mighty king, you love what is right; you have established justice in Israel; you have brought righteousness and fairness.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Mani n-nam binshɛɣukam din beni ŋɔ. N nini ni tiɣi ninvuɣ shɛb nyɛla bɛn siɣisiri bɛmaŋa ka niŋdi tuuba, ka luri n yɛligu sizuura, ka doli n yɛligu maa.
en: I have made everything; that's how it all came to be. I, the Lord , have spoken. The people I treasure most are the humble— they depend only on me and tremble when I speak.

dag: n-nya malaikanim ayi ka bɛ ye binyɛr piɛla n-ʒi Yisa ni daa do luɣ shɛl la: Yino o zuɣu polo, ŋun la mi o naba polo.
en: and saw two angels there dressed in white, sitting where the body of Jesus had been, one at the head and the other at the feet.

dag: A yi lo Naawuni alikauli, nyin palimi li yomyom, dama o je jɛra yɛlli. Niŋm a ni lo alikauli ni a niŋ shɛli.
en: If you make a promise to God, keep your promise. Dont be slow to do what you promised. God is not happy with fools. Give God what you promised to give him.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti damdi li tiŋa bee n-jɛm li; dama man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni ŋun zabiri nyuli, n darigiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣisi ma bihi tiba bɛ banima taali zuɣu hal ti paai ʒiɛmani din pahir ata mini din pahir anahi ni.
en: Do not bow down to any idol or worship it, for I am the Lord your God and I tolerate no rivals. I bring punishment on those who hate me and on their descendants down to the third and fourth generation.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna.
en: and said to Moses and Aaron.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim, maliya suhupiɛlli jilima puuni. Yilimiya suhupiɛlli yila yi bindɔhi zuɣu.
en: Let God's people rejoice in their triumph and sing joyfully all night long.

dag: Dama Masia daa bi tum din ni tiɣila omaŋmaŋ nini, amaa di nyɛla kaman di ni sab shɛm la: N Duuma Naawuni, zilim biɛ shɛŋa zaa niriba ni daa yɛr a la ʒinila n zuɣu.
en: For Christ did not please himself. Instead, as the scripture says, The insults which are hurled at you have fallen on me.

dag: Naawuni bi dih o malaikanim tabili, ka sagbana pala din be kasi o sani.
en: God does not even trust his angels. He does not even think the sky is pure.

dag: Bɛ mi bi zɔri Naawuni.
en: There is no fear of God in their view of the world. .

dag: Di zaŋya bindira dibu yɛla saɣim Naawuni tuma. Binshɛli kani n-chihiri dibu, amaa di nyɛla taali ni so chɛ ka o ni diri binshɛli zuɣu chɛ ka o tab lu.
en: Don't let your appetite destroy what God has done. All foods are fit to eat, but it is wrong to cause problems for others by what you eat.

dag: dama nyini n-nyɛ n ni sɔɣiri so sani. Nyini n-nyɛ binwɔɣinli shɛli din mali kpiɔŋ gari a dimnima.
en: for you are my protector, my strong defense against my enemies.

dag: Ka o daa niŋ lala paai dabisa shɛm, ka Pool nyee ti nyɔni ka o ŋmaligi tahi kpilikpariga ŋun daa sɔŋdi bipuɣiŋga maa ka o buɣiri baɣiri maa zuɣu n-yɛli, Yisa Masia yuli zuɣu, zom ka chɛ o! Ka kpilikpariga maa daa shiri zo ka chɛ o di saha maa.
en: She did this for many days. This annoyed Paul so much that he finally turned and said to the spirit, In the name of Jesus Christ, I command you to leave her! It left her at that very moment.

dag: Amaa ka dindali maa biɛɣu daa ti neerina, ka Naawuni chɛ ka zunzuli lu yɔɣili maa zuɣu ŋ-ŋub li ka di kpi.
en: The next morning, God sent a worm to eat part of the plant. The worm began eating the plant, and the plant died.

dag: Di niŋdiya pakoli kam bee kpibiga alaka.
en: Do not mistreat widows or orphans.

dag: Ɛhab bia Izraɛl Naa Jɔram ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pinaayi saha, ka Juda Naa Jɛhɔram bia Ahazia gba daa di nam.
en: In the twelfth year of the reign of Joram son of Ahab as king of Israel, Ahaziah son of Jehoram became king of Judah.

dag: ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka m pah a ninvuɣ gahinda maa zuɣu tɔŋ, ka pah a zuliya zuɣu nya suhupiɛlli, ka pah a niriba zuɣu tibig a.
en: Let me prosper with the rest of your chosen ones, as they celebrate with pride because they belong to you.

dag: Bɛmaŋmaŋ nira n-ti yɛn nyɛ bɛ naa, bɛ naa ti yɛn yila bɛ sunsuuni na. N ni voog o mirina, ka o ti be n sani. Dama so ku tooi ka n sanna omaŋmaŋ yiko ni. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: They will have their own leader; their ruler will come from among them. I will let him approach me, and he will draw near. Who would dare approach me unless I let them come? declares the LORD.

dag: Yi mi di lihiy o kaman o nyɛla yi dima, amaa lee saɣisimiy o mi kaman yi mabia la.
en: But do not treat them as enemies; instead, warn them as believers.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi zani bɛ zaashɛhi n-zaŋ awa muna ata karim Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ litaafi dabisili maa puuni, ka zaŋ awa muna ata kahigi bɛ daalahichi wuhi, ka jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: For three hours they stood and listened to the Law of the Lord their God, and then for the next three hours they confessed their sins and worshiped the Lord .

dag: Goonje mini mɔɣilo, neemiya! N ni ŋme biɛɣunaayo.
en: Wake up, my harp and lyre! I will wake up the sun.

dag: Amaa ka Dauda daa yɛli Aruna, Aai, n ni da li mi kaman di daa ni kul nyɛ shɛm. N ku zaŋ binshɛli din nyɛ a dini ti Yawɛ bee n-zaŋ n ni bi da binshɛli m-mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la.
en: But King David said to Ornan, No, I will buy them from you at a fair price. I wont offer to the LORD what belongs to you nor offer an entirely burned offering that costs me nothing.

dag: Ka napɔŋ yi yɛli ni di pala nuu, dinzuɣu ni di ka niŋgbuŋ ni; lala zuɣu ku chɛ ka di shiri pa niŋgbuŋ maa yaɣ shɛli.
en: If the foot were to say, Because I am not a hand, I don't belong to the body, that would not keep it from being a part of the body.

dag: Asiba kurig awɛi saha ka bɛ daa kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu maa.
en: It was nine in the morning when they crucified him.

dag: N ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu lu bɛ zuɣu, ka chɛ ka m piɛma nyɔɣi ba:.
en: I will bring troubles to the Israelites. I will shoot all my arrows at them.

dag: Bɛ nuhi zaa ni ti gbarigi, ka bɛ duna ni chɔɣisi.
en: Every hand will hang limp; urine will run down every leg.

dag: O ni daa vuui Amasa niŋgbuŋ solɔɣu maa zuɣu maa nyaaŋa ka niriba maa daa naanyi doli Jɔab n-lan gbaai Bikiri bia Shiiba la naba biɛhibu.
en: Once the body was out of the way, the people simply passed it by and joined up with Joab to go after Sheba son of Bicri.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n naan zaŋ li buɣi m bɔɣusapiŋ zuɣu, n naan zaŋ li pili kaman nam zuɣupiligu la.
en: Surely I would bear it on my shoulder, tie it around me like a wreath.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa wum ni Itiɔpia naa Tirihaka mini Ijipti tɔbbihi kanna ni bɛ ti tuh o. O ni daa wum lala maa, ka o tim tuumba Hɛzɛkia sani.
en: Word reached the Assyrians that the Egyptian army, led by King Tirhakah of Ethiopia, was coming to attack them. When the emperor heard this, he sent a letter to King Hezekiah.

dag: Di saha n ni ti yihi n nuu maa ka chɛ ka a nya n nyaaŋa polo. Amaa n ninni din bi nyara.
en: Then I will take my hand away, and you will see my back but not my face.

dag: Dama ti nyɛla bɛn mini Naawuni laɣim tumda, ka yi mi nyɛ Naawuni puu. Yi lan nyɛla Naawuni duu.
en: We are workers together for God, and you are like a farm that belongs to God. And you are a house that belongs to God.

dag: Maligumaaniba ni su shɛli niriba maa sani n-nyɛ: Ŋunkam yɛn mali sara, ka di nyɛla nahu bee piɛɣu, di simdi ka o yihi bimbɔɣigbini mini yɛno ni bimpuli ti maligumaana.
en: When you kill one of your sheep or cattle for a sacrifice, you must give the priests these parts: the shoulder, both cheeks, and the stomach.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, n ku lan niŋ yinim bɛ kpalim ŋɔ kaman n ni daa niŋ kurimbuni ha niriba maa shɛm maa. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But now, unlike those earlier days, Ill be with the few remaining among this people, says the LORD of heavenly forces.

dag: Bin yini ka n suhiri Yawɛ sani, ka n suhu kul ye di zuɣu: dina n-nyɛ ni m be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu hal ni n nyɛvili tariga, ka n nya Yawɛ viɛlim, ka jɛmd o o jɛmbu duu puuni.
en: I ask only one thing from the Lord . This is what I want most: Let me live in the Lord s house all my life, enjoying the Lord s beauty and spending time in his palace.

dag: Buɣim ni ti di n-kabi zuliya shɛba kaman bɛ ni nyɔri kɔba ka di leeri tampiligim shɛm la, ka lan be kaman bɛ ni ŋma go shɛŋa sɔŋ ka buɣim di li la.
en: Peoples will be burned to lime, thorns cut up and set ablaze.

dag: Daadam, zaŋm a nini kpa Sidɔn polo n-tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi li.
en: Mortal man, denounce the city of Sidon.

dag: Dina n-ni chɛ ka yi mal alaafee ka lan yuui dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: And this is the promise: Then all will go well with you, and you will have a long life on the earth.

dag: A dabili Dauda zuɣu, di zaɣis a ni pii na so ŋɔ.
en: David is your chosen one, so don't reject him.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi tiligira. Mani n-daa nam ya. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun daa nam binshɛɣukam zaa. N kɔŋko n-daa nam zuɣusaa. Mani n-daa lan nam tiŋgbani ŋɔ.
en: The LORD your redeemer who formed you in the womb says: I am the LORD, the maker of all, who alone stretched out the heavens, who spread out the earth by myself.

dag: Ka naa yɛl o, Biɛhiŋ kani, n ni ku nyini Ahimɛlɛk min a daŋ zaa.
en: The king said, Ahimelech, you and all your relatives must die.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ, bahigu maa ʒila a zuɣu, ka n ni yiɣisi n suhu pam bahi a zuɣu. N ni kar a saria kaman a tuma ni nyɛ shɛm. N ni darig a tibili a ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa zaa zuɣu.
en: Your end is coming now! I will show how angry I am with you. I will punish you for the evil things you did. I will make you pay for all the terrible things you did.

dag: Daadam, yi mabihi mini yi zuliya niriba ni yi tab Izraɛlnim bɛn be tinzun tiŋ ni ŋɔ zaa ka Jɛrusalɛmnim yɛra, Bɛ chaŋ katiŋa ka chɛ Yawɛ. Tinim ka bɛ zaŋ tiŋgbani ŋɔ ti ni ti su li.
en: Mortal man, he said, the people who live in Jerusalem are talking about you and those of your nation who are in exile. They say, The exiles are too far away to worship the Lord . He has given us possession of the land.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri bi mi din niŋ kamaata, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi Yawɛ bɛn mi li viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Evil people do not know what justice is, but those who worship the Lord understand it well.

dag: Ka o daa lab ti yɛli Juda, M bi nya paɣ maa; ka tiŋ maa nim yɛli ma ni pagɔr so na ʒi n-ka kpe na.
en: So Judahs friend went back to Judah and said, I could not find the woman. The men who live in that place said that there was never a prostitute there.

dag: Yi mi n ni chani luɣ shɛli maa, ka mi di soli.
en: You know the way to the place Im going.

dag: O daa ʒila niriba pam pahi laakumnim bɛn ʒiri tulaale zim mini salima pam ni kuɣ viɛla n-ka Jɛrusalɛm na. O ni daa paai Sulemaana sani, o daa yɛl o din be o suhu ni zaa.
en: She took along several of her officials, and she loaded her camels with gifts of spices, jewels, and gold. When she arrived, she and Solomon talked about everything she could think of.

dag: Tiŋgbani daa bɔɣiya m-mum Datan, ka pi Abiram min o nyaandoliba.
en: So the earth opened up, swallowing Dathan, and covering over Abirams crowd.

dag: Naawuni ŋun zaŋdi bimbira tiri ŋun birita, ka chɛ ka o nyari bindirigu, ni tiri yi gba m-pahiri yi ni mali shɛli zuɣu, ka chɛ ka yi nirilim niŋbu zooi pahi.
en: And God, who supplies seed for the sower and bread to eat, will also supply you with all the seed you need and will make it grow and produce a rich harvest from your generosity.

dag: A zuɣu ŋmanila Kamɛl Zoli. A zabiri nyɛlisirimi kaman ago la. Di viɛlim ni tooi chɛ ka naa kɔŋ omaŋ gbaabu.
en: Your head is held high like Mount Carmel. Your braided hair shines like the finest satin; its beauty could hold a king captive.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti bi zan tuh o, hal di yi nyɛ Naawuni daadiini zuɣulana gba, o ni chɛ ka bɛ ku o.
en: Then he will destroy armies and remove God's chosen high priest.

dag: Amaa niriba ŋɔ bɛn nyɛla tipawumlinima, ka nyɛ duŋtaariba, bɛ lɛbi bɛ nini biri ma, ka zo ka chɛ ma.
en: But you people! You are stubborn and rebellious; you have turned aside and left me.

dag: Pukpar so n-na ʒi n-kɔr o puu n-kul kɔri li yɛrigira.
en: Does the plowman plow without stopping for planting, opening and harrowing their ground?.

dag: Izraɛl daa kul bela kasi Yawɛ sani. Ŋuna n-daa nyɛ o tiwala din daŋ moobu. Bɛnkam daa di li daa kpe taali ni, ka alɔbo daa lu bɛ zuɣu. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Israel was devoted to the LORD, the early produce of the harvest. Whoever ate from it became guilty; disaster overtook them, declares the LORD.

dag: A yuli daa duya zuliya kam zaa ni a viɛlim maa zuɣu. Dama n ni daa ti a jilima shɛli la zuɣu n-daa chɛ ka a niŋ viɛlim zaa maa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: and everyone on earth knew it. I, the Lord God, had helped you become a lovely young woman.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka Apis guui? Bɔzuɣu ka yi naɣilaa maa di bi zani? Yawɛ ni ŋme o luhi zuɣu.
en: I have struck down your mighty god Apis and chased him away.

dag: Yi Naawuni yɛliya, Maamiya n niriba suhuri, maamiya bɛ suhuri!.
en: Your God says, Comfort, comfort my people.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Miriya ka yi bɔhim zuliya shɛb biɛhigu bee n-chɛ ka zuɣusaa shihira niŋ ya alahiziba, dama shihira maa niŋla zuliya shɛba alahiziba.
en: He says, Do not follow the ways of other nations; do not be disturbed by unusual sights in the sky, even though other nations are terrified.

dag: Itiɔpia mɔɣa duya ha ka ti wum binyiɣira kpiŋkpama vubu damli.
en: Doom to the land of winged ships, beyond the rivers of Cush.

dag: Ka wula ka o yi darigi tinim bɛn be ti nyɛvil ni ŋɔ tibili ti daalahichi zuɣu ka ti fabinda?.
en: Why should we ever complain when we are punished for our sin?.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛr a, zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ a ni ti be n sani Naawuni yili.
en: Then Jesus said to him, I promise you, today you will be with me in paradise.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa mali suhupiɛlli n zaɣ biɛɣu nyabu zuɣu la di vi ka birim. Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn duhiri bɛmaŋ n san la nya filiŋ ka di vi.
en: May those who gloat over my suffering be completely defeated and confused; may those who claim to be better than I am be covered with shame and disgrace.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa gbaai naa maa n-zaŋ o chaŋ Babilɔn naa sani Ribila din be Hamat tiŋgbɔŋ ni la ka o ti di o saria.
en: The army of Babylon captured King Zedekiah and took him to the king of Babylon who was at the city of Riblah, in the land of Hamath. At Riblah the king of Babylon announced his judgment on King Zedekiah.

dag: Di saha maa niriba pam ni ti taai duŋ niŋ Ijipti naa. Ka nyin Daniɛl zuliya ni ninvuɣ biɛ shɛb gba ni ti taai duŋ pahi ni di chɛ ka ʒii la ni yɛla la niŋ pali, amaa bɛ ni ti kɔŋ nasara.
en: In those times, many will oppose the southern king. Violent persons from among your people also will rise up to support the vision, but they will fail.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa bol o nyaandoliba na ti yɛli ba, Salo ŋɔ yɛla niŋ ma nambɔɣu pam, dama zuŋɔ daba ata m-bɔŋɔ ka bɛ kul be n sani ka lan ka bindirigu dira; ka m bi bɔri ni bɛ kuli ni kum, dama di pa shɛli ka bɛ ti tarigi sol ni.
en: Jesus called his followers to him and said, I feel sorry for these people. They have been with me three days, and now they have nothing to eat. I dont want to send them away hungry. They might faint while going home.

dag: O yi ti paana yuntisuɣu bee nolɔɣu kukoli n-nya ba lala, bɛ ni nya alibarika.
en: How happy they are if he finds them ready, even if he should come at midnight or even later!.

dag: Ka Naa daa bo omaŋmaŋ dahalali biŋkɔbiri ti ka bɛ kɔriti maani bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim asiba mini zaawuni ni vuhim dabisa dali ni goli palli chuɣu puhibu ni ni bɛ ni daa zali chu shɛŋa puhibu ni kaman di ni daa sab shɛm Yawɛ zaligu ni.
en: From his own flocks and herds he provided animals for the burnt offerings each morning and evening, and for those offered on the Sabbath, at the New Moon Festival, and at the other festivals which are required by the Law of the Lord .

dag: Bɛ ni me birini gili tin shɛl la lumi dahim zaa, ka bɛ chɛ li bahi kaman tiŋgban nɛl la. Di leela biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee ni bɛ ni dooni luɣ shɛli vuhira.
en: The fortified city lies in ruins. It is deserted like an empty wilderness. It has become a pasture for cattle, where they can rest and graze.

dag: Yi ni nya ka so ku tooi chihi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa maa zuɣu di simdi ni yi gbaai yimaŋa ka di niŋ shɛli ni suhuyiɣisili.
en: No one can deny this, so you should be quiet. You must stop and think before you do anything else.

dag: Amaa ka Lɔt daa yɛli ba, Aai, n duumanima, n suhiri ya.
en: But Lot answered, No, please don't make us do that, sir.

dag: N daa tɛhiya ni n ni wurim ba bahi katiŋa, ka chɛ ka so ku lan teei bɛ yɛla;.
en: I thought about destroying the Israelites so that people would forget them completely!.

dag: Amaa Izraɛlnim daa bi kari Gɛshurinim mini Maakatinima, lala zuɣu Gɛshurinim mini Maakatinim maa na kul be Izraɛlnim ni hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: However, the Israelites did not drive out the people of Geshur and Maacah; they still live in Israel.

dag: Ka Balak daa lan tim kpamba bɛn mali jilima pam, ka zooi gar o ni daa tuui tim shɛb maa.
en: Then Balak sent a larger number of leaders, who were more important than the first.

dag: Kum mini nyɛvili bela zilinli yiko ni, ka bɛn yuri li ni di di nyɔri.
en: The tongue can speak words that bring life or death. Those who love to talk must be ready to accept what it brings.

dag: Yi ni ti ŋubirila yimaŋmaŋ bidɔɣirisi, yi ni ti ŋubi yi bidibisi mini yi bipuɣin shɛb Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni tin ya la nimdi yi dimnim maa ni ti yɛn teei gili ya n-niŋdi ya alaka shɛli maa zuɣu.
en: You will eat the offspring of your own womb—the flesh of your own sons and daughters, whom the LORD your God gave you—because of the desperate and dire circumstances that your enemy has brought on you.

dag: Toli maa ni daa ŋubi mɔri maa zaa naai saha shɛli, ka n yɛli, Yaa n Duuma NAAWUNI, n suhir a, chɛli bɛ taali! Yaakubu ku be. O pɔri pam.
en: In my vision I saw the locusts eat up every green thing in the land, and then I said, Sovereign Lord , forgive your people! How can they survive? They are so small and weak.

dag: Dinzuɣu Samarianim maa ni daa paai Yisa sani bɛ daa balim o mi ni o kpalimmi bɛ sani; ka o daa kpalim niŋ dabisi muna ayi nimaani.
en: The Samaritans went to Jesus. They begged him to stay with them. So he stayed there two days.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, o tiliginsim shee bi wɔɣa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmd o sani din ni chɛ ka o jilima kul kpalim be ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Gods salvation is very close to those who honor him so that his glory can live in our land.

dag: Yawɛ maŋmaŋ ni lu yi zuɣu, ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa yi nyɛ yi daba la ŋmaligi nyaŋ ya. Ka lala yi niŋ, dina n-ni chɛ ka sokam baŋ ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-shiri tim ma na.
en: The Lord himself will fight against you, and you will be plundered by the people who were once your servants. When this happens, everyone will know that the Lord Almighty sent me.

dag: Yi bihi yuli ni ti du pam zuliya kam sani. Ka ŋunkam zaa ti nya ba ni baŋ ni bɛ nyɛla Yawɛ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb ni.
en: Their offspring will be known among the nations, and their descendants among the peoples. All who see them will recognize that they are a people blessed by the LORD.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka ti ni saɣi zaŋdi ti bipuɣinsi tiri ya, ka ti gba kpuɣiri yi bipuɣinsi, ka kpalim be yi tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni ka ti mini ya leei ninvuɣ yinsi.
en: Then we will give our daughters to you, and we will take your daughters for ourselves. We will live with you and be one people.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti paai Mara nti kɔŋ di kom nyubu, dama di daa tomi, di zuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Mara.
en: Then they came to a place called Marah, but the water there was so bitter that they could not drink it. That is why it was named Marah.

dag: Ti yab Ibrahimma daa niŋ yɛda ka mali tahima saha shɛli di ni daa to ni o niŋ tahima ni o ni leei zuliya pam yaba kaman Naawuni ni daa lo o alikauli yɛli, A zuliya ni ti galisi pam la.
en: There was no hope that Abraham would have children, but Abraham believed God and continued to hope. And that is why he became the father of many nations. As God told him, You will have many descendants.

dag: siɣim dapulli maa zuɣu na tilig amaŋa.
en: Now come down from the cross and save yourself.

dag: ka o baŋ ni o Ba pun zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa niŋ o nuu ni, ka lan mi ni o daa yila Naawuni sanna ka ni lan lab o sani.
en: Jesus knew that the Father had given him complete power; he knew that he had come from God and was going to God.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka yi mini ba lo alikauli bee n-lo bɛ buɣa la alikauli.
en: You must not make any agreements with any of those people or their gods.

dag: Binshɛɣukam din be Nail Mɔɣili maa duli ni ti kuui, ka bɛ ni biri binshɛlikam dolisi mɔɣili maa ti kuui zaa, ka pɔhim ʒe li chaŋ.
en: Grass around the Nile, the grass at the mouth of the Nile, and all the sown land of the Nile will dry up, blow away, and be no more.

dag: Ka doo maa daa zaŋ bia maa nti ti o ma; ka o zaŋ o ʒil o naba zuɣu n-gbib o hal ti paai wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha, ka o leei Naawuni dini.
en: The servant picked up the boy and carried him to his mother. The boy lay on her lap all morning, and by noon he was dead.

dag: Tɛma kɔhigɔriba lihirimi bɔri kom, ka Shiiba sochandiba mali tahima ni bɛ gba ni nya kom.
en: Caravans from Tema look; merchants from Sheba hope for it.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ni zaɣisi n yɛligu maa zuɣu.
en: Therefore, this is what the LORD of heavenly forces says: Because you havent listened to my words.

dag: N daa mi do so ŋun be Masia ni yuun pinaanahi din gari ŋɔ puuni, ka Naawuni daa kpuɣ o du zuɣusaa m-mali ti paai alizanda puuni ha. O yi daa bela o niŋgbuŋ ni bee o yi daa ka o niŋgbuŋ ni, m bi mi; Naawuni m-mi.
en: I know about one of Christ's followers who was taken up into the third heaven years ago. I don't know if the man was still in his body when it happened, but God certainly knows.

dag: Ka sapashini ŋun pa o zuɣu n-daa nyɛ Jɛhɔhanan. O daa sula tɔbbihi tuhi kɔbisiyi ni tuhi pihinii.
en: Jehohanan was the general of , soldiers.

dag: Ka Sool mini Izraɛlnim mi daa laɣim lo tɔbu chaŋ ti ti bɛ suɣa Ɛla Vinvamli ni n-doya ni bɛ tuhi Filistianim maa.
en: Saul and the Israelites assembled and camped in Elah Valley, where they got ready to fight the Philistines.

dag: Binnamda zaa, paɣimiya Yawɛ! Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: Everything that breathes, praise the Lord ! Praise the Lord !.

dag: Teeku bula mini biŋkɔb kara bɛn be di ni, paɣimiya Yawɛ dunia ni.
en: Everything on earth, praise him! Great sea animals and all the oceans, praise the Lord !.

dag: O ni daa zaŋ liɣiri maa labisi ti o ma; ka o ma daa yihi di ni anzinfa kpila kɔbisiyi ti anzinfa doora, ka o daa zaŋ li mali anzinfa binnani. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ li zali Maika yiŋa.
en: But Micah gave the silver back to his mother. So she took about pounds of the silver and gave them to a silversmith. He used the silver to make a statue covered with silver. The statue was put in Micahs house.

dag: Timiya o yuli din be kasi ŋɔ jilima. Chɛliya ka bɛnkam zaa jɛmdi Yawɛ mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Give praise to Gods holy name! Let the hearts rejoice of all those seeking the LORD!.

dag: Bɛ ni ti vɔn ya tahi gooni ŋmabu shee nti daai ya bahi Hamɔn. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You will go out through the broken wall, each one after another; and you will be flung out into Harmon, says the LORD.

dag: Bɔ saha ka a yɛn chɛ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ tɔɣisibu? Gbilisim tibili ka ti gba tɔɣisi.
en: When will you stop talking? Be sensible; let us say something.

dag: Tɔɣisim yɛtɔɣ maŋa din nyɛ so ni ku tooi galim shɛli, ka di chɛ ka bɛn chihir a di vi ka ku tooi mali zaɣ biɛ shɛli ni bɛ yɛli dalim ti.
en: Use sound words that cannot be criticized, so that your enemies may be put to shame by not having anything bad to say about us.

dag: Dabisa shɛŋa puuni zaa o ni wolig omaŋ maa, o nyɛla ŋun be kasi Yawɛ sani.
en: While a nazirite, the person is holy to the LORD.

dag: Hal yi daa chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi pam, Sinai Zoli gbini, ka o daa je suli n- yɛn kun ya.
en: You made the Lord angry at Mount Horeb. The Lord was angry enough to destroy you!.

dag: Lala ka Izraɛlnim daa niŋ. Bɛ daa niŋmi kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm.
en: So the people of Israel did everything that the Lord had commanded Moses.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa yiɣisi Yawɛ zoli maa gbini n-lu soli chaŋ daba ata chandi; ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka la n-daŋ tooni chaŋ daba ata chandi ni di ti bo dooshee ti ba.
en: The people of Israel began their journey from Mount Sinai. They traveled three days, and the Levites who carried the sacred chest led the way, so the Lord could show them where to camp.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrikɔnim daa kana ti yɛli Ilaisha, Ti dana, yiya ŋɔ ni ʒe luɣ shɛli ŋɔ viɛli pam kaman a gba ni nya li shɛm, amaa di kom nyɛla ko biɛɣu, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka paɣiba zaŋdi bahira.
en: Some men from Jericho went to Elisha and said, As you know, sir, this is a fine city, but the water is bad and causes miscarriages.

dag: Banima n-nyɛ bɛn daa lee wum Naawuni kukoli, amaa ka ti taai duŋ la? Pa bɛna n-nyɛ Anabi Musa ni daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb yi Ijipti na la?.
en: Who were those people that heard God's voice and rebelled? Weren't they the same ones that came out of Egypt with Moses?.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi kali Yaakubu zuliya? Bee ŋuni n-lee ni tooi kali Izraɛl zuliya maa pirigibu bunahi puuni yim? Chɛ ka n kpila wuntizɔra kum, ka chɛ ka m bahigu ti be kaman o bahigu.
en: Who can count the dust of Jacob, or number a fourth of Israel? Let me die the death of those who do right, and let my end be like his.

dag: Yi daa ku niriba pam bo vi niŋ yi yiŋa. Yi kɔŋ yi nyɛviya.
en: But your schemes have brought shame on your family; by destroying many nations you have only brought ruin on yourself.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-lee muɣisi ya bee bɔ n-leei niŋ ka yi biɛhindi yi suhuri ni?.
en: But Jesus said, Why are you so frightened? Why do you doubt?.

dag: Di saha ka Ribɛka daa zaŋ o bituuli Iso binyɛr suma din be o sani yiŋa n-yɛl o bia Yaakubu ŋun nyɛ biasani maa;.
en: Then she took Esau's best clothes and put them on Jacob.

dag: Amaa o ni daa zaŋ li yɛl o ba min o biɛyanim maa, o ba daa tahila o zuɣu ka bɔh o, Zahim bɔ ka a lee zahim maa? M min a ma ni a biɛyanim ŋɔ shiri ti yɛn damdila a tooni.
en: When he described it to his father and brothers, his father scolded him and said to him, What kind of dreams have you dreamed? Am I and your mother and your brothers supposed to come and bow down to the ground in front of you.

dag: Manaasa zuliya niriba n-daa su Tapua tiŋgbani maa, amaa Tapua fɔŋ din daa ʒi Manaasa zuliya niriba tintariga la dina, Ifriim zuliya niriba n-daa su li.
en: The town of Tappuah was on Manasseh's border with Ephraim. Although the land around Tappuah belonged to Manasseh, the town itself belonged to Ephraim.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ daantalisi sa zɔŋ, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pisinaayi, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pinaata ni pirigili, ka kazala din mali daantalisi daa be di tooni, ka pateesa yili di tooni.
en: The Hall of Columns was feet long and feet wide. It had a covered porch, supported by columns.

dag: Bee bɔ saha ka ti daa lee nya a ka a nyɛ sana, ka ti deeg a kpɛhi ti yinsi bee ka a chani gbinfini, ka ti ti a situra?.
en: When did we see you with no place to stay and welcome you into our home? When did we see you without clothes and give you something to wear?.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ Yisa nambɔɣu, ka o shihi bɛ nina maa ka di dii neei, ka bɛ yiɣisi doli Yisa chana.
en: Jesus felt sorry for them and touched their eyes. At once they could see, and they became his followers.

dag: Goli ŋɔ n-yɛn nyɛ goya piligu goli yi sani, dina n-yɛn nyɛ gol tuuli yi sani yuuni puuni.
en: This month will be the first month of the year for you.

dag: Anabi Musa n-daa nyɛ ŋun daa lan yɛli Izraɛlnima, Naawuni ni ti pii so yi mabihi ni n-chɛ ka o niŋ anabi kaman o ni daa pii ma shɛm la.
en: Moses is the one who told the people of Israel, God will choose one of your people to be a prophet, just as he chose me.

dag: O ni daa suhiri Naawuni maa, ka o niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu ti taɣi, ka o binyɛrigu mi paligi paratɛte kaman gol la;.
en: As he was praying, the appearance of his face changed and his clothes flashed white like lightning.

dag: ka Oholibama mi dɔɣi Jɛushi mini Jalam ni Kɔra. Iso ni daa dɔɣi bidib shɛb Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni m-bala.
en: Oholibamah had three sons: Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These were Esaus sons who were born in the land of Canaan.

dag: bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋ bɛ nyɛviya zali barina zaashee ti Duuma Yisa Masia tuma zuɣu la n-ka yi sanna.
en: who have risked their lives in the service of our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim dɔbba shɛb bɛn daa zo nti sɔɣi Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya tinsi ni la gba ni daa wum ni Filistianim maa ŋmaligi guui n-zɔri ni bɛ tiligi maa, ka bɛ gba daa dii lo kpara zo n-doli tuhiri ba.
en: Others, who had been hiding in the hills of Ephraim, heard that the Philistines were running away, so they also joined in and attacked the Philistines.

dag: Guliya Naawuni piɛ shɛba o ni zaŋ niŋ yi nuu ni la. Niŋmiya li la yi suhuri ni yu lala zuɣu, ka pa ni muɣisigu bee liɣiri zuɣu, amaa di lee simdi ka di nyɛla yi suhuri n-ye lala niŋbu zuɣu.
en: to be shepherds of the flock that God gave you and to take care of it willingly, as God wants you to, and not unwillingly. Do your work, not for mere pay, but from a real desire to serve.

dag: Nyɔtaɣirisi n-kul gil o yaaŋa zuɣu zaa, di shɛbila tab ni kaman bɛ dihi li mi tabili la.
en: His matching scales are his pride, closely locked and sealed.

dag: Ka Dauda mi bɔh o, Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka n dan ti kariti doli man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ lala? Bɔ ka n lee niŋ? Taal bɔ ka n lee tum?.
en: Sir, why are you chasing me? What wrong have I done? What am I guilty of?.

dag: ka zaŋ chaŋ o Naawunitali mi polo, yiko shɛli din daa chɛ ka o neei kum ni la kahigi wuhi ni o nyɛla Naawuni Bia. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ti Duuma Yisa Masia so.
en: as to his divine holiness, he was shown with great power to be the Son of God by being raised from death.

dag: Samuɛl ni daa nya Sool maa, ka Yawɛ yɛl o, N ni sa yɛl a ninvuɣ so yɛla la m-bala, Ŋuna n-yɛn su n niriba maa.
en: Samuel looked at Saul, and the Lord told Samuel, This is the man I told you about. He's the one who will rule Israel.

dag: Nimaani ka yi ni ti teei yi biɛhigu mini yi ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa n-saɣim yimaŋ la yɛla, ka galim yimaŋa yi ni daa tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa maa zuɣu.
en: Then you will remember your wicked sins, and you will hate yourselves for doing such horrible things. They have made you unacceptable to me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli naa, Anabi Neetan be kpe. Ka Neetan daa kpe naa sani nti damd o tooni n-zaŋ o nini kpa tiŋa;.
en: The servants told the king, Nathan the prophet is here. Nathan went in to speak to the king. He bowed down before the king.

dag: Ka Pita dii gbaai kari ka pɔri pɔri yɛra, Man ʒi doo maa. Di saha maa ka nolɔɣu dii kum.
en: Then Peter said, I swear that I am telling the truth! May God punish me if I am not! I do not know that man! Just then a rooster crowed.

dag: Ka Yisa dɔɣiriba daa wum lala, ka kana ni bɛ ti gbaag o, dama niriba daa yɛliya ni o zuɣu n-lɛbigi.
en: When his family heard what was happening, they came to take control of him. They were saying, Hes out of his mind.

dag: Bɛ daa malila dapaɣa pisi niŋ Naawuni biɛhigu shee suɣili maa nudirigu polo.
en: They made twenty boards for the dwellings southern side.

dag: N daa lihi dunia ni n-nya ka di bahila yoli, ka binshɛli lan ka di ni, ka n lihi zuɣusaa, ka neesim kani.
en: I looked at the earth. It was empty; there was nothing on it. I looked at the sky, and its light was gone.

dag: Ka Judas ŋun daa yi Yisa nyaaŋa maa daa pun wuhi ba shihir shɛli yɛli, N yi ti kul puhi so ka mɔɣis o kpariŋ, ŋuna m-bala; yin gbaamiy o zaŋ o chaŋ.
en: Judas planned to do something to show them which one was Jesus. He said, The one I kiss will be Jesus. Arrest him and guard him while you lead him away.

dag: M puhiri Ampiliatus n ni yuri so ti Duuma ni la.
en: Give my greetings to Ampliatus, my dear friend in the Lord.

dag: Yi ni ti mali alibarika gari zuliya kam. Ka dɔɣibu kalinsi ti ku be yi ni bee yi biŋkɔbiri ni.
en: No people in the world will be as richly blessed as you. None of you nor any of your livestock will be sterile.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ nyɛla yaɣili maa ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa yi dabitim ni na, ka nyɛ Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni daa gbahi shɛb daba la. Bɛ daa labila Jɛrusalɛm mini Juda na, ka sokam ti be o ya.
en: Many of the exiles left the province of Babylon and returned to Jerusalem and Judah, each to his own hometown. Their families had been living in exile in Babylonia ever since King Nebuchadnezzar had taken them there as prisoners.

dag: Yawɛ, dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu, n ni paɣ a zuliya kam sani; ka yili yila paɣ a yuli.
en: I will praise you, Lord , and I will honor you among the nations.

dag: Ka o ye binyɛr shɛl din ŋam ʒim, ka o yuli daa booni Naawuni Yɛligu.
en: He wore a robe dyed with blood, and his name was called the Word of God.

dag: Miriya ka yi zahim Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ kaman yi ni daa zahim o shɛm Masa la.
en: Dont test the LORD your God the way you frustrated him at Massah.

dag: Amaa yi yi ni tooi wuhi ma zahindi maa mini di gbinni, yi ni nya pina mini laara ni jilima pam n sani. Dinzuɣu yɛlimiya ma zahindi maa, ka wuhi ma di gbinni.
en: But if you tell me my dream and explain its meaning, I will give you gifts, rewards, and great honor. So tell me about my dream and what it means.

dag: Timmi bɛ ni gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb zaa chaŋ maa sani ti yɛli ba, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Shɛmaya ŋun nyɛ Nɛhilam nir la polo m-bɔŋɔ: Shɛmaya ni tɔɣisi ya anabitali yɛtɔɣa n-chɛ ka yi niŋ ʒiri yɛda ka di pala mani n-tim o na la zuɣu.
en: Send word to all the exiles: The LORD proclaims concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite: Because Shemaiah prophesied to you when I didnt send him, and because he convinced you to believe a lie.

dag: Ka lan zaŋ nimaani chaŋ hal ti du Ɛkurɔn nuzaa polo kuŋkuni. Ka di tariga maa daa ŋmaligi chaŋ hal ni Shikɛrɔn n-zaŋ nimaani hal ti baɣisi Baala Zoli gari, ka lan zaŋ nimaani hal ti paai Jabiniil; ka di daa naanyi kana ti paai di tariga teeku ni.
en: Then the border went to the hill north of Ekron. From there the border turned to Shikkeron and went past Mount Baalah. The border continued on to Jabneel and ended at the Mediterranean Sea.

dag: Ka bɛ ni shɛb bɛn mi daa yi Saipurus mini Sairiini n-ka Antiɔk na mali Naawuni yɛtɔɣa n-tɔɣisirila Yɛhudianim bɛn wumdi Giriikili, ka yihiri ba ti Duuma Yisa yɛla waazu.
en: Some of these believers were men from Cyprus and Cyrene. When these men came to Antioch, they began speaking to people who were not Jews. They told them the Good News about the Lord Jesus.

dag: A ʒinila gar shɛli din mali jilima zuɣu, ka zaŋ teebuli zali di tooni n-zaŋ n tulaale zim mini n kpam tam di zuɣu.
en: They sat on a fancy couch, and in front of them was a table for the olive oil and incense that had belonged to me.

dag: Ka daantalis ayi mini kɔniŋdi bini ni tɔroko shɛŋa Sulemaana ni daa mali niŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la, di zaa daanya daa galisiya pam hal ka bɛ ku tooi buɣisi baŋ di tibisim ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The bronze in all these objects—the two pillars, the Sea, and the stands that Solomon had made for the LORDs temple—was too heavy to weigh.

dag: Dama n daa zɔrila wahala din yɛn yi Naawuni sanna dabiɛm, ka n daa naan ku tooi zan o jilima tooni.
en: for Gods calamity is terror to me; I couldnt endure his splendor.

dag: Chɛrili nyɛla bɛn ka yaa, amaa bɛ nyari bindirigu diri siɣili saha.
en: Ants are small and weak, but they save their food all summer;.

dag: Yinim Izraɛl bipuɣinsi, kummiya Sool zuɣu. Ŋuna n-zaŋ mulifu viɛlli soli ya. Ŋuna n-zaŋ salima yɛri yɛli ya.
en: Daughters of Israel, cry for Saul! Saul gave you beautiful red dresses and covered them with gold jewelry!.

dag: Gooni din ti yɛn gili fɔntiŋ maa zaa wɔɣilim ni ti nyɛla kilomita awɛi. Ka fɔntiŋ maa yuli ni ti boonila, Yawɛ Beni.
en: The circumference of the city is . miles. As of today, the name of the city is The LORD Is There.

dag: o daa na bi nam tiŋgbani mini puri bee n-sɔŋ dunia tampuɣili.
en: before the earth and fields were made, before the dust of this world was formed.

dag: O tiri kɔnyuri ni mali ninvuɣ shɛb kom, ka tiri kum ni mali ninvuɣ shɛb bindir suma.
en: To everyone who is thirsty, he gives something to drink; to everyone who is hungry, he gives good things to eat.

dag: Ŋun baɣa ka Yawɛ tuma ni, noli ni di o, ka ŋun bi bɔri ni o zaŋ takɔbi ku niriba, noli ni di o.
en: I want you to kill the Moabites, and if you let them escape, I will put a curse on you.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa wum bɛ fabila maa, ka teeg o ni daa lo Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu alikauli shɛl la yɛla.
en: God heard their cry of grief, and God remembered his covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

dag: Biɛɣukam niriba daa yi kul kanila Dauda sanna ti pahir o zuɣu hal ka o tɔbbihi ti galisi kaman Naawuni tɔbbihi la.
en: Day after day, new men came to join David, and soon he had a large, powerful army.

dag: Amaa Hanna ŋun daa bi chaŋ, dama o daa yɛlila o yidana, Faashee bia maa ti ŋmaai bihili ka n zaŋ o tahi Yawɛ sani ka o ti kpalim be nimaani hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: But this time Hannah did not go. She told her husband, As soon as the child is weaned, I will take him to the house of the Lord , where he will stay all his life.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a lɛb a nyaaŋa biri ti? Di tam ti wahala dibu mini ti nahiŋgu ŋɔ yɛla!.
en: Why are you hiding from us? Have you forgotten our pain and troubles?.

dag: Chɛliya ka amiliya lɔbu mali jilima sokam sani, ka chɛliya ka yidan min o paɣa ʒe tab yim bɛ daamiliya lɔbu puuni; dama Naawuni ni kari niŋgbuŋ kɔrɛnim mini bɛn niŋdi zina saria.
en: Marriage is to be honored by all, and husbands and wives must be faithful to each other. God will judge those who are immoral and those who commit adultery.

dag: Ka bɛ daa nya ka Anabi Ilaija mini Anabi Musa puhi zan o sani, ka bɛ min o tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa.
en: Then Elijah and Moses appeared and were talking with Jesus.

dag: Amaa ka dabiɛm daa gbaai ba pam, ka bɛ yɛli, Nyama, nanima ayi bi tooi nyaŋ o, ka wula ka tinim ni tooi nyaŋ o.
en: The rulers of Samaria were terrified. How can we oppose Jehu, they said, when neither King Joram nor King Ahaziah could.

dag: Bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn daa bi deei Naawuni yɛligu saha shɛl o ni daa di suɣilo guhiri ba Anabi Nuhu ʒiɛman ni la. Di saha ka Anabi Nuhu daa kpahiri ŋariŋ shɛli niriba biɛla bɛn nyɛ niriba anii kɔŋko ni daa kpe n-tiligi kom dibu ni la.
en: They had disobeyed God while Noah was building the boat, but God had been patient with them. Eight people went into that boat and were brought safely through the flood.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa zaŋ ba niŋ foliŋga maa zuɣusaa ni bɛ ne dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: God put these lights in the sky to shine on the earth.

dag: Sandaantimdiba bɛn biri bimbira ni suhudoo ni ti kpuɣila atam din nyɛ wuntia.
en: People who work for peace in a peaceful way get the blessings that come from right living.

dag: Niriba ata maa daa bi lan garigi Ayuba o ni daa wuhi ni o ka taali maa zuɣu.
en: Finally, these three men stopped arguing with Job, because he refused to admit he was guilty.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia daa tim ti yɛli Izraɛlnim mini Judanim zaa, ka sabi gbana ti Ifriim zuliya mini Manaasa zuliya ni bɛ kana Jɛrusalɛm Yawɛ jɛmbu duu nti puhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ Yaɣigari chuɣu la.
en: Then Hezekiah sent word to all Israel and Judah, and wrote letters to Ephraim and Manasseh as well, inviting them to the LORDs temple in Jerusalem to celebrate the Passover of the LORD God of Israel.

dag: Ŋun mali tɛha yuuni bɔrila yɛm, amaa jɛrigu ŋun kul lihirila dunia luɣilikam.
en: Intelligent people think about what needs to be done here and now. Fools are always dreaming about faraway places.

dag: Izraɛl naa maa ni daa ti karim gbaŋ maa, o daa darigimi toog o binyɛrigu ka yɛli, N nyɛla Naawuni ka ni tooi ku nir ka lan neeg o, ka doo ŋɔ ti yɛri ma ni n tibimi nir kɔŋa? Nir yi kpahim yɛlli maa, a ni baŋ ni vuri ka o bɔri ma maa.
en: When the king of Israel read the letter, he ripped his clothes. He said, What? Am I God to hand out death and life? But this king writes me, asking me to cure someone of his skin disease! You must realize that he wants to start a fight with me.

dag: dama kaman nir ni kahim bihim ka bihikpam yirina shɛm ni nir ni yi ŋmahim nyee pam ka ʒim yirina shɛm, lala ka suhuyiɣisili pam gba tahiri zabili na.
en: Stirring milk causes butter to form. Hitting someones nose causes blood to flow. And making people angry causes trouble.

dag: nti nya ka o nyaandol shɛb bi doli bɛ kali soli paɣiri bɛ nuhi ka diri bindirigu.
en: They noticed that some of his disciples ate without first washing their hands.

dag: Ka Hilliɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Piratɔn nir la bia Abidɔn maa daa ti kpi, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Piratɔn Ifriim tiŋgban shɛli din daa nyɛ Amalɛknim zoya ni tiŋ la ni.
en: Then Abdon son of Hillel died and was buried in the city of Pirathon. Pirathon is in the land of Ephraim in the hill country where the Amalekites lived.

dag: Pool ni daa na do Atɛnsi n-guli Silas mini Timoti maa ka o suhu daa ti saɣim pam o ni daa nya ka tiŋ maa luɣilikam kul nyɛla buɣa la zuɣu.
en: While Paul was waiting in Athens for Silas and Timothy, he was greatly upset when he noticed how full of idols the city was.

dag: Ka bindirigu kam din be di puuni ka nyɛ kom ni kpaai bahi shɛli zuɣu nyɛla din ni leei daɣiri, ka binnyurigu kam din yi duɣu maa puuni na ni leei daɣiri.
en: If water from such a jar gets on any edible food, it will be unclean; any drinkable beverage in such a jar will be unclean.

dag: lala nti yɛn nyɛ Daadam Bia gba yi ti labina yi palo.
en: Thats the way it will be on the day the Human Oneis revealed.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa saɣim alikauli maa Adam tiŋgban ni, nimaani ka bɛ daa bi lan ʒe ma yim.
en: But as soon as they entered the land at Adam, they broke the covenant I had made with them.

dag: Teemi ni n nyɛvili nyɛla vuhim kɔŋko, n nini ku lan nya din viɛla.
en: I beg you, God, don't forget! My life is just a breath, and trouble lies ahead.

dag: Shulam paɣa, labimina, labimina! Labimina, labimina ka ti ti nya a. Bɔzuɣu ka yi lihiri man Shulam paɣa, kaman m bela tɔbbihi bɛn pie tab ʒiɛya buyi sunsuuni wari waa ŋɔ?.
en: Dance! Dance! Beautiful woman from Shulam, let us see you dance! Why do you want to see this woman from Shulam dancing with the others?.

dag: Di daa malila dunɔdura ayopɔin, ka di zɔntua be di puuni. Bɛ daa ŋmɛla abie tihi pa di pilanim maa zaa zuɣu. Yaɣili kam daa malila zaɣ yiniyini.
en: There were seven steps going up to this gate. Its porch was at the inside end of the gateway. It had carvings of palm trees on the walls that were on either side of the gateway.

dag: N ku saɣi chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu be m biɛhigu ni. N je ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn birigi tuma. M mini ba ku mali jina.
en: I wont set my eyes on anything worthless. I hate wrongdoing; none of that will stick to me.

dag: Ka bɛ yi ti yɛl ti, Guhimiya hal ka ti ti ka yi sanna, di saha ti ni kpalim ʒe nimaani ka ku lan chaŋ bɛ sani.
en: If they tell us to wait for them to come to us, then we will stay where we are.

dag: Yihimiya tɔbbihi maa tarili ni bin yini bini kɔbisinu kam puuni ti Yawɛ zaka. Di yi nyɛ ninsalinim bee niɣi bee bunsi bee piɛri bee buhi.
en: From the part that belongs to the soldiers, withhold as a tax for the Lord one out of every five hundred prisoners and the same proportion of the cattle, donkeys, sheep, and goats.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba maa, Ŋunkam bɔri ni o doli ma, ŋun zaɣisim omaŋa ka kpuɣ o dapulli buɣi doli ma.
en: Then Jesus said to his disciples: If any of you want to be my followers, you must forget about yourself. You must take up your cross and follow me.

dag: Nir yi bi tuɣ ma, o ŋmanila wul shɛli bɛ ni wooi bahi ka di kuui, ka bɛ laɣisi di dari niŋ buɣim ni ka di di li.
en: Those who do not remain in me are thrown out like a branch and dry up; such branches are gathered up and thrown into the fire, where they are burned.

dag: Ka di daa moli gili Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa ni Naa Sool nyaŋla Filistianim tɔbbi shɛba ka di zuɣu chɛ ka Izraɛlnim leei Filistianim dimnima. Ka bɛ daa boli niriba maa ni bɛ yina nti pahi Sool zuɣu Giligal.
en: All the Israelites were told that Saul had killed the Philistine commander and that the Philistines hated them. So the people answered the call to join Saul at Gilgal.

dag: Ka Firawuna bipuɣiŋga maa daa yɛl o, Chama. Di saha ka bipuɣiŋga maa daa zo n-kuli ti boli bia maa ma na.
en: Yes, the king's daughter answered. So the girl brought the baby's mother.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa n ni labi n-neei Naa Dauda yili din daa lu la. N ni lan me o dabɔɣu maa zali.
en: After this I will return, says the Lord, and restore the kingdom of David. I will rebuild its ruins and make it strong again.

dag: Yawɛ, nyin Naawuni ŋun bɔhiri biɛri, nyin Naawuni ŋun bɔhiri biɛri ŋɔ, yiɣisim zani!.
en: Lord God, you punish the guilty. Show what you are like and punish them now.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan yi nimaani n-chaŋ Mizipa din be Mɔab tiŋgbɔŋ ni la ti yɛli Mɔab naa, N suhir a ni a chɛ ka m ba mini m ma ʒini a sani hal ka n ti baŋ Naawuni ni yɛn tum tuun shɛli ti ma.
en: David left Adullam Cave and went to the town of Mizpeh in Moab, where he talked with the king of Moab. Please, David said, let my father and mother stay with you until I find out what God will do with me.

dag: Ti Duuma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni daai ba luhi kaman bɛ ni yi ŋma tia wula ka di lu shɛm la. O ni luhi karimbaannim mini wɔɣira bɛn be bɛ ni n-dihi ba vi.
en: The Lord Almighty will bring them crashing down like branches cut off a tree. The proudest and highest of them will be cut down and humiliated.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa mali hal ti zooi, ka Yawɛ be o sani, ka chɛ ka o yɛtɔɣa zaa nyɛ yɛlimaŋli.
en: The Lord was with Samuel while he grew up. He did not let any of Samuels messages prove false.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔshafat daa nya yaa pam, ka me goondahi gili fɔntinsi, ka lan me nɛma sɔŋbu shee tinsi zali Juda tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Jehoshaphat became more and more powerful. He built fortresses and storage towns in the country of Judah.

dag: Di lihi ʒiɛm ma, n ni sabigi maa zuɣu. Wuntaŋa n-kpe ma ka n sabigi maa. N tizɔdɔbba jɛla suli niŋ ma; bɛ chɛ ka n gulila wain tihi puu, ka kɔŋ dahima maani mmaŋa.
en: Dont stare at me because Im darkened by the suns gaze. My own brothers were angry with me. They made me a caretaker of the vineyards— but I couldnt care for my own vineyard.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Di nyɛla yi yɛda pɔrilim zuɣu. Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi yi mali yɛda ka di be kaman zabiliga tibiɛlim la, yi ni tooi yɛli zoli ŋɔ, Yiɣisim a dooshee ŋɔ nti dɔni kpe ha, ka di shiri yiɣisi; ka shɛli ku kɔŋ nanibu yi sani. .
en: Because you have little faith, he said. I assure you that if you have faith the size of a mustard seed, you could say to this mountain, Go from here to there, and it will go. There will be nothing that you cant do.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka yi kuhiri pampam yi ni nya dan shɛli maa zuɣu? Yi biɛrim maa ka tibbu. Yi taali ni galisi pam, ka yi daalahichi galisi yaɣi ka n niŋ ya lala maa zuɣu.
en: Complain no more about your injuries; there is no cure for you. I punished you like this because your sins are many and your wickedness is great.

dag: Ɛpafiras ŋun gba nyɛ yi ni yino ka nyɛ Yisa Masia tumtumda la puhiri ya. O kul suhiri Naawuni ni nimmoo n-tiri ya ni Naawuni chɛ ka yi bi niriba ka ba n-zani n-niŋ naani zaa Naawuni yubu tumbu puuni.
en: Epaphras, another servant of Jesus Christ from your group, sends his greetings. He constantly struggles for you in prayer. He prays that you will grow to be spiritually mature and have everything that God wants for you.

dag: Yɛlim Shɛmaya ŋun nyɛ Nɛhilam nir la.
en: Tell Shemaiah the Nehelamite.

dag: Di saha di simdi ni maligumaana lih o. Ka dɔro din mɔr o zuɣu palo maa ni bee o gbɛ palo maa ni yi nyɛla zaɣ piɛlli din mooi, ka ŋmani niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu din be niŋgbuŋ ni.
en: A priest must look at him. If the swelling of the infection is red and white and looks like the leprosy on other parts of his body.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa ʒini Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la yuun kɔbisinahi ni pihita.
en: The length of time that the Israelites had lived in Egypt was four hundred thirty years.

dag: Maligumaana so ŋun leei kpɛma o tab sunsuuni, ka nyɛ bɛ ni daa booi kpam bahi so zuɣu ni mal o kasi n-wolig o zali ni o yɛri maligumaana binyɛra miri ka o chɛ ka o zabiri yirimyirim bee n-dari chɛh o binyɛra.
en: If you are the high priest, you must not mess up your hair or tear your clothes in order to mourn for the dead.

dag: Ka bia maa dɔɣim dali naba daa ti tuui, ka bɛ laɣimna ni bɛ ti gun o. Bɛ daa bɔri ni bɛ zaŋla o ba yuli Zakaria la ti o.
en: Eight days later they did for the child what the Law of Moses commands. They were going to name him Zechariah, after his father.

dag: O zaŋ saa nyaɣisibu gbib o nuu ni n-chɛ ka di nyaɣisir o ni zal li luɣ shɛli polo.
en: He conceals lightning in his palms and orders it to its target.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ sariakarita, yiɣisima. Tim karimbaannim din simdi ba!.
en: You are the judge of us all; rise and give the proud what they deserve!.

dag: So yi daa tum din tiri suhusaɣiŋgu, pa mani ka o ti suhusaɣiŋgu, ka m mi bi bɔri ni n tibigi li, dama nir yi lihi di puuni, di nyɛla yi zaa ka o ti suhusaɣiŋgu maa.
en: But if someone has made anyone sad, that person hasnt hurt me but all of you to some degree .

dag: Ka n daa yɛli n suhu ni, M bo n-nya yɛm pam gari na shɛb bɛn pun daŋ n tooni ʒini Jɛrusalɛm ŋɔ zaa; ka kpahim baŋ yɛla pam yɛm mini baŋsim puuni.
en: I told myself, I have become a great man, far wiser than anyone who ruled Jerusalem before me. I know what wisdom and knowledge really are.

dag: Dama ŋun mali ni ti lan nya m-pahi m-mali pam, ka ŋun mi ka ni ti bahi kɔŋ o ni mali biɛla shɛl la.
en: For those who have will receive more and they will have more than enough. But as for those who dont have, even the little they have will be taken away from them.

dag: Di saha ka Napaɣ Ɛsta garigi yɛl o, Naa, a yi saɣi ni a shiri ni ti ma n ni bɔri shɛli a sani, dindina n ni bɔri shɛli nyɛla, tiligimi n nyɛvili, ka tiligi n niriba gba nyɛviya pahi.
en: Then Queen Esther answered, King, if you like me and it pleases you, please let me live. And I ask you to let my people live too. This is what I ask for.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Ibram, M bɔri ni a baŋ ka biɛhiŋ kani, ni a zuliya ni ti chaŋ ti be tiŋgbɔn shɛli din pa bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-nyɛ daba nimaani, ka bɛ ni ti nahim ba yuun kɔbisinahi.
en: Then the Lord said to Abram, You should know this: Your descendants will live in a country that is not their own. They will be strangers there. The people there will make them slaves and be cruel to them for years.

dag: Kiriatibaal mini Raba gba daa beni: di daa nyɛla fɔntiŋ kara ayi m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: The eleventh region was located in the northern part of Judah's hill country, and it had the following two towns with their surrounding villages: Rabbah, and Kiriath-Baal, which is also called Kiriath-Jearim.

dag: A ŋmanila kom din bi do baalim, a mi ku gari sokam, dama a daa zaŋ a ba paɣ dɔni o bindoo zuɣu n-ta li daɣiri. A daa dɔni m bindoo zuɣu.
en: As wild as the waters, you wont endure, for you went up to your fathers bed, you went up and violated my couch.

dag: Di saha ka Sulemaana daa yi jɛmbu shee din be Gibiɔn Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la ni n-labi Jɛrusalɛm ti su Izraɛlnima.
en: Then Solomon went from the shrine in Gibeon, from the meeting tent to Jerusalem where he ruled over Israel.

dag: Ka bɛ daa labi nti yɛli bɛ nyaandol tab la, amaa ka bɛ daa bi niŋ bɛ gba yɛda.
en: They returned and told the others, but these would not believe it.

dag: Di ti ku be kaman yinim putɔɣunim ti chaŋ ti liri ŋun ka taali o yiŋa n-ku o o gom shee pa o bindoo zuɣu, ka n ku bɔhi ya o ʒim yihibu maa biɛri ka kun ya dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: How much worse it will be for evil men who murder an innocent man asleep in his own house! I will now take revenge on you for murdering him and will wipe you off the face of the earth.

dag: Ka Iso daa yɛl o, Malim shili ka m min a doli kuli.
en: Let's get ready to travel, Esau said. I'll go along with you.

dag: N ni yu a zaligunim maa; n ku tam a yɛligu yɛla.
en: I will delight in your statutes; I will not forget what you have said.

dag: O ni yo ba bɛ tuumbiɛri samli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni kpihim bɛ birili bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali maa zuɣu.
en: He will repay them for their wickedness, completely destroy them because of their evil. Yes, the LORD our God will completely destroy them.

dag: Di saha ka Musa mini Aduna daa niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni zali ba shɛm maa Firawuna min o kpamba ninni, O daa yaag o jaaŋgbee maa n-fiɛbi kom din daa be Nail Mɔɣili maa ni, ka di zaa daa shiri leei ʒim.
en: Moses and Aaron did just as the LORD commanded. He raised the shepherds rod and hit the water in the Nile in front of Pharaoh and his officials, and all the water in the Nile turned into blood.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa guui yomyom chaŋ ti yɛl o yidana, Nyama, do so ŋun daa ka n sanna la lan yi n zuɣu.
en: so she found him and said, That same man is here again! He's the one I saw the other day.

dag: Amaa o bihi yi ti zaɣisi n zaligu, ka bi doli n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi.
en: But if his children ever abandon my Instruction, stop following my rules.

dag: hal nti paai dahin shɛli o ni daa ti o tuun shɛb o ni pii la zaligu Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni ka lab alizanda ni la.
en: until the day he was carried up into heaven. Before he went, he talked to the apostles he had chosen. With the help of the Holy Spirit, he told them what they should do.

dag: Nyini n-tiri nanim nasara, ka fa a dabili Dauda bahi.
en: You give victory to kings and rescue your servant David.

dag: Amaa ka a bi so ŋun zaŋ a buni chaŋ ti nahi pagɔra ŋɔ lee ti kuna, ka a gbaari naɣila kpabili kɔrigir o zuɣu.
en: But when this son of yours returned, after gobbling up your estate on prostitutes, you slaughtered the fattened calf for him.

dag: Dama pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ n ni teei n nuu chɛ ka alɔbo lu a min a niriba zaa zuɣu n-naai yi balibu zaa dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: By now I could have used my power to strike you and your people with a deadly disease so that you would have disappeared from the earth.

dag: Musa ni daa ti bi doo, ka o daa ti yi n-chaŋ o niriba sani nti nya bɛ ni tumdi tuun kpeen shɛŋa, ka daa ti nya Ijipti do so ni buri o niriba Hiburunim maa ni yino.
en: When Moses had grown up, he went out to visit his people, the Hebrews, and he saw how they were forced to do hard labor. He even saw an Egyptian kill a Hebrew, one of Moses' own people.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bindira pam pal a kambɔna, ka wain pal a wain tɔɣiri bɔɣa hal ti puuri bahira.
en: Then you will have more grain and grapes than you will ever need.

dag: Nyamiya, o ni ti du zuɣusaa m-pobilina kaman tɔrili la nti yirig o kpiŋkpama to Bɔziranima. Dindali maa Ɛdom tɔbbihi suhuri ni ti bemi kaman paɣ ŋun wolisiri ni o dɔɣi suhu ni be shɛm la.
en: An enemy will swoop down to attack you, like an eagle spreading its wings and circling over Bozrah. Your warriors will be as fearful as women giving birth.

dag: Di saha maa Naa Sulemaana mini Izraɛlnim bɛn daa be o sani daa zaŋla daba ayopɔin puhi chuɣu. Ka niriba pam daa yi Lɛbɔhamat mini Ijipti kulibɔŋ polo kana.
en: At that time Solomon, together with all Israel, celebrated the festival for seven days. It was a very large assembly that came from Lebo-hamath to the border of Egypt.

dag: Ʒiɛyimtali ni tɔhi yi tiŋgban ni na, ka wuntitali mi be sagbana ni ka lihirina.
en: People on earth will be loyal to God, and God in heaven will be good to them.

dag: nyama, pumpɔŋɔ n ni niŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa. Nyama, n ti a yɛm mini baŋsim tɛha, ka di chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daŋ a tooni puuni so ku ŋman a, ka so mi ti ku yiɣis a kalinsi nyaaŋa ŋ-ŋman a.
en: I will now do just what you said. Look, I hereby give you a wise and understanding mind. There has been no one like you before now, nor will there be anyone like you afterward.

dag: nti suhir o ni o kul chɛ ka bɛ shih o binyɛrigu naŋgbambili. Ka bɛnkam daa shihi li shiri kpaŋ zaa.
en: They begged Jesus to let them only touch the edge of his coat to be healed. And all the sick people who touched his coat were healed.

dag: Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba, Bundaan so n-daa mali tumtumdi kpɛma, ka bɛ ti nyih o ni o tumtumdi kpɛm maa bahir o buni maa yoli.
en: Jesus said to his disciples: A rich man once had a manager to take care of his business. But he was told that his manager was wasting money.

dag: Lihimiya ba kaman bɛn be kasi, dama bɛna n-zaŋdi yi Naawuni bindira maani sara. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn be kasi, dama man Yawɛ ŋun mali ya ka yi be kasi maa nyɛla ŋun be kasi.
en: You will treat the priests as holy, because they offer your Gods food. The priests will be holy to you, because I am the holy LORD, who makes you holy.

dag: M puhiri cheechi shɛli din laɣindi bɛ yiŋ la gba. M puhiri n zo suŋ Ɛpainɛtus ŋun nyɛ ninvuɣ so ŋun daa daŋ niŋ Masia yɛda Ɛsha la.
en: Also, give greetings to the church that meets in their house. Give greetings to my dear friend Epaenetus. He was the first person to follow Christ in Asia.

dag: nyini ŋun deeri ti suhigu ŋɔ! Ninsalinim zaa ni ka a sanna.
en: Everyone will come to you because you answer prayer.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. Yi ni so miri ka o ti chɛ ka o min o dɔɣira dɔni.
en: Don't have sex with any of your close relatives.

dag: Amaa lee bomiyala Naawuni nam dubu, ka o naanyi zaŋ dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha pahi ya.
en: What you should be thinking about is Gods kingdom. Then he will give you all these other things you need.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ n ni sɔɣiri so sani. A nyɛla ŋun gbib ma wahala ni, ka chɛ ka faako yila gili ma.
en: You are a hiding place for me. You protect me from my troubles. You surround me and protect me, so I sing about the way you saved me. Selah.

dag: Wuntaŋ ni daa ti miri lubu saha shɛli, ka gom daa gbaai Ibram pam ka o dɔni gbihi, ka zibisim titali din mali dabiɛm pam daa zibig o sani.
en: When the sun was going down, Abram fell into a deep sleep, and fear and terror came over him.

dag: Wuhim bihi so shɛli din tuhi, ka bɛ yi ti zooi niŋ ninkura, bɛ ku ŋmaligi ka chɛ li.
en: Teach your children right from wrong, and when they are grown they will still do right.

dag: Di saha ka Hɛzɛkia daa bahi ba noli ni bɛ malimi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa puuni nɛma niŋbu duri; ka bɛ daa mal li.
en: So Hezekiah ordered them to prepare storerooms in the LORDs temple. When they finished preparing them.

dag: N dolila wuntia soli ka doli yɛlimaŋli soli.
en: I walk on the way of righteousness, on the paths of justice.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: The Lord said to me.

dag: Amaa ka Yɛhudianim daa zab nyuli n-chaŋ ti laɣim tiŋ maa ni ninvuɣ yoya n-chɛ ka bɛ dam tiŋ maa, ka chaŋ ti be n-gili Jeesɔn yiŋa n-yɛli ni bɛ yihim Pool mini Silas palɔni na ti ba.
en: The Jewish leaders were jealous and got some troublemakers who hung around the marketplace to start a riot in the city. They wanted to drag Paul and Silas out to the mob, and so they went straight to Jason's home.

dag: ni di chɛ ka Sulemaana yɛm maa gari wulimpuhili polɔnim zaa yɛm zaŋ tabili Ijiptinim zaa yɛm.
en: Solomons wisdom was greater than all the famous Easterners, greater even than all the wisdom of Egypt.

dag: Yawɛ nudirigu nya duhibu, Yawɛ nudirigu n-tum tuun kara maa.
en: With his mighty arm the Lord wins victories! The Lord is powerful.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa garigi yɛli, O ʒim yihibu kpalimmi ʒi ti mini ti bihi zuɣu.
en: Everyone answered, We and our own families will take the blame for his death.

dag: Ka Bɔrɔbɔro din ka Dabindi Chuɣu la daa puhi gari, ka ti mi kpe ŋariŋ Filipai n-zaŋ daba anu chaŋ ti paai ba Troas; ka ti daa niŋ daba ayopɔin nimaani.
en: We sailed from the city of Philippi after the Festival of Unleavened Bread. We met these men in Troas five days later and stayed there seven days.

dag: Ka di simdi ka o bo o biŋkɔbbaligu ni piɛlaa ŋun ka dalinli na, ka a ti zahim o baŋ o liɣiri ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ alahichi sanyoo polo, ka maligumaana ti zaŋ o yo o ni bi yuri ka tum taal shɛli maa zuɣu, ka o daalahichi maa kpihim.
en: You must bring a ram that has nothing wrong with it to the priest. The priest will offer the ram, and God will forgive you for the sin you did without knowing it.

dag: Bɛ ni kpi kaman piɛri la, ka kum ni nyɛ bɛ gula. Bɛ ni faai siɣi gbala ni yomyom; ka bɛ niŋgbuna pooi kpiimba biɛhigu shee din yɛn nyɛ bɛ yinsi la.
en: they are doomed to die like sheep, and Death will be their shepherd. The righteous will triumph over them, as their bodies quickly decay in the world of the dead far from their homes.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Siɣim yomyom, dama a ni daa zaŋ a ninvuɣ shɛb yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na maa saɣim bɛmaŋa.
en: The Lord said to Moses: Hurry back down! Those people you led out of Egypt are acting like fools.

dag: Yisa mini ba ni daa laɣim maa ka o yɛli ba ni bɛ di yi Jɛrusalɛm chaŋ luɣ shɛli, amaa ni bɛ kul guhim hal ka bɛ ni wum ŋun Yisa sani ni o ba Naawuni lo ba alikauli shɛl la ti niŋ pali.
en: One time when Jesus was eating with them, he told them not to leave Jerusalem. He said, Wait here until you receive what the Father promised to send. Remember, I told you about it before.

dag: Yisa ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai ka o yiɣisi Galili n-chaŋ Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli ha;.
en: When Jesus finished teaching, he left Galilee and went to the part of Judea east of the Jordan River.

dag: ka Zikiri daa nyɛ Abija daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma; ka Pilitai daa nyɛ Miniamin mini Mɔadia daŋ ni dɔɣirikpɛma;.
en: Zichri of Abijah, Piltai of Moadiah.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Kaman tuŋ wula ni be mɔɣu ni tihi ni ka n zaŋ li ti ka bɛ maani buɣim shɛm, lala ka n yɛn niŋ Jɛrusalɛmnima.
en: Now this is what the Sovereign Lord is saying: Just as a vine is taken from the forest and burned, so I will take the people who live in Jerusalem.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa yɛli, M malila yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni n yɛl a. Ka Batishiiba yɛl o, Yɛlima.
en: I have something to ask you. Bathsheba said, Then speak.

dag: ka Nan bia Hɔshia daa yi Ifriim zuliya ni na;.
en: from the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea, Nuns son.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yiɣisi chani ka Naawuni malaikanim chirig o sol ni;.
en: Jacob went on his way, and Gods messengers approached him.

dag: Amaa ka Naa Rɛhɔbɔam daa chɛ ka bɛ mali daanya nyɔtaɣirisi zali di zaani, ka o daa zaŋ li niŋ tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa ʒe n-guli nayili dunol la kpamba nuu ni.
en: Rehoboam had bronze shields made to replace the gold ones, and he ordered the guards at the city gates to keep them safe.

dag: Ka o dan maa yɛl o, Ti ku zani tinzunnim bɛn pa Izraɛlnim ŋɔ tiŋ ŋɔ ni, amaa ti ni gari paala Gibia. Ka o daa lan yɛl o tumtumda maa, Chɛ ka ti tirisi chaŋ luɣ shɛŋa dimbɔŋɔ ha nti gbe Gibia bee Rama.
en: But his master replied to him, We wont turn into a city of foreigners who arent Israelites. Well travel on to Gibeah.

dag: Suhimiya Yawɛ ti ti, dama sakuɣa ŋɔ mini satahinsi ŋɔ saɣiya lala. N ni chɛ ka yi chaŋ, n ku lan chɛ ka yi be kpe yaha.
en: We can't stand any more of this thunder and hail. Please ask the Lord to make it stop. Your people can go—you don't have to stay in Egypt any longer.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb daa ti zaŋ bibihi ka Yisa sanna ni o ti zaŋ o nuu pa bɛ zuɣu; ka o nyaandoliba daa nya lala ka tahiri bihinim maa zuɣu.
en: Some people brought their babies to Jesus for him to place his hands on them. The disciples saw them and scolded them for doing so.

dag: M mabihi, yi mi n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ, dama n yɛrila yinim bɛm mi zaligu yɛla. Zaligu lo nir la kulla o ni na be o nyɛvil ni la.
en: My friends, you surely understand enough about law to know that laws only have power over people who are alive.

dag: Yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ ka Yawɛ daa duh o yee yɛli yi salo maa zaa zoli maa gbini buɣim mini sagbani ni zibisim titali sunsuuni la; ka o daa bi lan pahi yɛtɔɣ shɛli. O daa sab li pala kuɣ parilana ayi zuɣu n-zaŋ li ti ma.
en: When we were gathered at the mountain, the Lord spoke to us in a loud voice from the dark fiery cloud. The Lord gave us these commands, and only these. Then he wrote them on two flat stones and gave them to me.

dag: ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti niŋ Yawɛ ni yɛli Musa mini Aduna ni bɛ yɛli ba ka bɛ niŋ shɛm maa.
en: Then they left and did what Moses and Aaron had told them to do.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla duno shɛli din labiri wulinluhili polo la mini Shalɛkɛt duno shɛli din be pal shɛli din be kunkuni zuɣu palli polo n-ti Shupim mini Hɔsa. Ka bɛ daa gul li ka tiri taba.
en: Shuppim and Hosah were allotted the west gate and the Shallecheth Gate on the upper road. Guard duty was divided into assigned periods, one after another.

dag: Alibarika ni ti be yi piɛri mini yi ziŋŋɔriti ŋmana ni.
en: The Lord will bless your grain crops and the food you prepare from them.

dag: Buɣim mini nyɔhi ni chilibi din daa yiri yuri maa noya ni maa na n-daa nyɛ alɔbo diba ata din ku daadamnim pirigibu ʒii buta puuni yim la;.
