en: A third of all the people on earth were killed by these three plagues coming out of the horses mouths: the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur.

dag: N ni daa lihi binnɛma maa, ka n daa nya ka kalinli zaɣ yiniyini ʒe m-baɣi binnɛma maa. Bɛba anahi maa zaa yino kam daa sula zaɣ yini.
en: As I looked at the creatures, suddenly there was a wheel on the earth corresponding to all four faces of the creatures.

dag: Zimiri ni daa baŋ ni bɛ nyaŋ bɛ tiŋ maa nim maa, ka o daa du nayili birini nti niŋ buɣim nyo nayili maa, ka di di n-ku omaŋmaŋa.
en: When Zimri saw that the city had fallen, he went into the palace's inner fortress, set the palace on fire, and died in the flames.

dag: Ka Shimɛi yɛli naa, N dana, a ni yɛli shɛm maa viɛla. Mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni niŋ kaman a ni yɛli shɛm maa. Ka o daa kpalim be Jɛrusalɛm ka di yuui pam.
en: That's fair, Your Majesty, Shimei answered. I'll do that. So Shimei lived in Jerusalem from then on.

dag: N ni yihi ba zuliya shɛb ni na, ka yihi ba tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni laɣim taba n-zaŋ ba tahi bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni. N ni ti dihiri ba Izraɛl zoya zuɣu mini kom ni be luɣ shɛŋa ni ni niriba ni be luɣ shɛŋa zaa ni tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: I will bring them back from those nations. I will gather them from those countries and bring them back to their own land. I will feed them on the mountains of Israel, by the streams, and in all the places where people live.

dag: Di saha maa ka Anabi Jɛrimia ni daa yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. O ni daa yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: In this way what the prophet Jeremiah had said came true:.

dag: Wuntaŋ yi nyeei, so ku tooi lih o, ka pɔhim yi ʒe sagbana chaŋ ka chɛ o, o kul nyaɣisirimi.
en: For now, no one can look at the sun; it is bright in the sky; the wind has passed and cleared away the clouds.

dag: Ka o yi ka bipuɣiŋga, yin zaŋmiy o fali ti o mabihi bɛn nyɛ dɔbba.
en: If he doesnt have a daughter, you will give his inheritance to his brothers.

dag: Azaria daa nyɛla Amaria ba, ka Amaria nyɛ Ahitub ba.
en: Amariah, Ahitub.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛl o, Nyama, a ni zaɣisi Yawɛ noli zuɣu, a yi ŋmaligi n sani chana, di ku yuui ka gbuɣinli gbaag a ku. Ka o ni daa kul ŋmalig o sani, ka gbuɣinli shiri chirig o gbaag o ku.
en: so he said to him, Because you have disobeyed the Lord 's command, a lion will kill you as soon as you leave me. And as soon as he left, a lion came along and killed him.

dag: Bɛ ni bahi yoli yomyom n-chaŋ ti kpe luɣ shɛli din mali dabiɛm!.
en: How quickly they are devastated, utterly destroyed by terrors!.

dag: Simiɔn bidibisi ni bɛ zuliya niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nɛmuɛl daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Nɛmuɛlnima; ka Jamin daŋ niriba nyɛ Jaminnima; ka Jachin daŋ niriba mi nyɛ Jachinnima.
en: The tribe of Simeon: the clans of Nemuel, Jamin, Jachin.

dag: Ka bɛ yiɣisi zani n-yɛrigi luɣilikam chaŋ ti teei gili Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda biɛhigu shee mini Naawuni tin yurigu la; ka buɣim ti yi zuɣusaa na ti di ba.
en: They spread out over the earth and surrounded the camp of God's people and the city that he loves. But fire came down from heaven and destroyed them.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ yɛli ma, A nyaya viɛnyɛliŋga, dama n lihirimi ni n nya ka n yɛligu niŋ pali.
en: That's right, the Lord replied, and I always rise early to keep a promise.

dag: O daa zaŋla daanya mali sara maligu bimbini maa kurupooti n-zaŋ li zali di naŋgbaŋkuɣila lɔŋni, ka di du m-paai di pirigili tariga zaŋ siɣi tiŋ polo.
en: Then he made a bronze grating for the altar. This grating was shaped like a net. The grating was put under the ledge at the bottom of the altar. It went halfway up into the altar from below.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan ŋahi ba ŋahili ŋɔ pahi yɛli, Alizanda nam maa ŋmanila zabiliga tibiɛlin shɛli nir ni zaŋ biri o puu ni;.
en: Then Jesus told the people another story: Gods kingdom is like a mustard seed that a man plants in his field.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ binyɛribil din yɛri gbinni yɛl o, ka zaŋ shɛlɔrigu lo o, ka zaŋ zabba yɛl o, ka zaŋ binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa yɛl o, ka zaŋ balati lo o.
en: Moses put the woven shirt on Aaron and tied the cloth belt around him. Then Moses put the robe and the ephod on Aaron and tied the beautiful cloth belt around him.

dag: N daa bi zaɣisi ka m mali ŋun ni wum n yɛtɔɣa. M bi zaɣisi ka n dim maa di sabi o ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa jɛndi ma ŋɔ sɔŋ.
en: Why doesn't God All-Powerful listen and answer? If God has something against me, let him speak up or put it in writing!.

dag: Amaa ka Musa daa yɛli Yawɛ, N Duuma, m pala zilinvaliŋgalana, hal dahin shɛli ha bee a ni tɔɣisiri mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ yɛtɔɣa pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ. M bi tooi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa yomyom, ka n zilinli bi tooi lɛbigira.
en: But Moses said to the LORD, My Lord, Ive never been able to speak well, not yesterday, not the day before, and certainly not now since youve been talking to your servant. I have a slow mouth and a thick tongue.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun nyɛ tiligira ŋɔ, nyini n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun sɔɣ amaŋa.
en: The God of Israel, who saves his people, is a God who conceals himself.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛr a, a ku tooi yi nimaani faashee a ti yo bɛ ni zal a san shɛli zaa, ka di laɣifu ku guui.
en: I assure you that you will not leave there until you have paid everything you owe.

dag: N shini ka di yuui, N kul gbaala mmaŋ ka fo. Amaa pumpɔŋɔ n ni kuhi pam kaman paɣ ŋun wolisiri ni o dɔɣi. N ni vuhi parim.
en: God says, For a long time I kept silent; I did not answer my people. But now the time to act has come; I cry out like a woman in labor.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔhi taba, O ni di tɔɣisiri ti yɛtɔɣa sol ni ka kahigiri Naawuni litaafinim wuhiri ti la, di di bi kpe ti suhuri ni pam.
en: They said to each other, Wasn't it like a fire burning in us when he talked to us on the road and explained the Scriptures to us.

dag: Miriya ka yi mɔŋ nandaamba yɛlimaŋli bɛ saria karibu ni.
en: Make sure that the poor are given equal justice in court.

dag: ka Yawɛ daa lan ka o sanna pahi buyi kaman o ni daa pun ka o sanna shɛm Gibiɔn la.
en: Then the Lord appeared to Solomon again, just as he did at Gibeon.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ yɛli ma, A nyaya viɛnyɛliŋga, dama n lihirimi ni n nya ka n yɛligu niŋ pali.
en: You are right, the Lord said, and I am watching to see that my words come true.

dag: Shaul ni daa ti kpi, Baalihanan ŋun daa nyɛ Akibɔr bia la n-daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: When Shaul died, Baal-hanan, Achbors son, succeeded him.

dag: O ni daa gbaag o maa o daa kpɛh o la duu, ka chɛ ka duguliba pinaayɔbu ʒe n-gul o, dama o daa lɔrila nia ni Yaɣigari Chuɣu puhi gari ka o zaŋ o niŋ Yɛhudianim nuu ni.
en: He arrested Peter and put him in jail, where he was guarded by a group of soldiers. Herod planned to bring Peter before the people, but he wanted to wait until after the Passover festival.

dag: dinzuɣu m Ba Naawuni ni zali ma nam shɛm, lala ka n gba zali ya nam.
en: So I will give you the right to rule as kings, just as my Father has given me the right to rule as a king.

dag: Bɛ daa buɣisi Naawuni bɛ suhuri ni ni bɛ nya, bɛ suhuri ni daa ye bindir shɛli zuɣu la ni.
en: They deliberately put God to the test by demanding the food they wanted.

dag: Ka Shɛshibaza daa kana nti sɔŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa tampuɣili Jɛrusalɛm ŋɔ; ka mɛbu maa tuma kul tumdi di saha maa zaŋ kana pumpɔŋɔ, amaa ka di na lee bi me n-naai.
en: So Sheshbazzar came and built the foundations of Gods Temple in Jerusalem. From that day until now, the work has continued, but it is not yet finished.

dag: Yawɛ, guli ma ka yihi ma ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni, Guli ma ka yihi ma duŋtaariba bɛn lo ni bɛ chɛ ka n lu la nuu ni.
en: Protect me, Lord , from cruel and brutal enemies, who want to destroy me.

dag: Chɛ ka n di wain tiwala n-nya kpiɔŋ, ka di apil ka n nini neei, dama doo bɔbu chɛmi ka n ni chɔɣisi zaa.
en: Refresh and strengthen me with raisins and apples. I am hungry for love!.

dag: Di saha ka o daa dii zaŋ sapashinnim mini tɔbbihi zo n-chaŋ bɛ sani. Bɛ ni daa ti nya sapashin kpɛm maa mini tɔbbihi maa ka bɛ chɛ Pool bubu.
en: At once the commander took some officers and soldiers and rushed down to the crowd. When the people saw him with the soldiers, they stopped beating Paul.

dag: Buni mini jilima be n sani, ka azichi din yuura mini tɔŋsim be n sani.
en: I can make you rich and famous, important and successful.

dag: Di zaa yoli ka Firawuna daa na kul niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni o ku wum bɛ yɛligu maa kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm la.
en: The king behaved just as the Lord had said and stubbornly refused to listen.

dag: A ni zaŋ ti yi tiŋgban shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam ni na ni a ti ku ti yɔɣu ŋɔ ni la nyɛla yɛlibila, ka a ti lan bɔri ni a zaŋ amaŋ leei naa su ti?.
en: It's bad enough that you took us from our rich farmland in Egypt to let us die here in the desert. Now you also want to boss us around!.

dag: Ka dim maa daa yɛli, N ni kari gbahi ba; n ni di bɛ nɛma, ka zaŋ n ni bɔri shɛlikam. N ni zaŋ n nuu ŋooi takɔbi n-ku ba.
en: The enemy said, I will pursue them and catch them; I will divide their wealth and take all I want; I will draw my sword and take all they have.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ ʒim maa mihi niriba maa ka yɛli, Nyamiya, Yawɛ ni lɔn ya alikauli shɛl la ʒim, di nyɛla din doli o ni yɛli ya yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa zaa.
en: Then Moses held the bowls full of the blood from the sacrifices. He threw that blood on the people. He said, This blood shows that the Lord has made a special agreement with you. The laws God gave you explain the agreement.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o ti zaŋ tihi maa da shɛŋa m-mali buɣim wuɣisi; ka zaŋ di shɛŋa mali buɣim she bɔrɔbɔro. Di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi zaŋ di shɛŋa mali wuna mini binnana zali n-damdiri di tooni jɛmdi li.
en: A person uses part of a tree for fuel and part of it for making an idol. With one part he builds a fire to warm himself and bake bread; with the other part he makes a god and worships it.

dag: Nyɔhi ni tuɣiri chani shɛm la, karim ba ka bɛ chaŋ lala. Shigbaŋ ni miriti buɣim ka nyɛligiri shɛm la, chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri nyɛligi lala Naawuni tooni.
en: May your enemies be scattered like smoke blown away by the wind. May your enemies be destroyed like wax melting in a fire.

dag: N ni zaŋ Keenan tiŋgbani ti a, ka di nyɛ a tarili ka a su li.
en: He said, I will give you the land of Canaan. It will be your very own.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Nyamiya, n tim ya mi kaman piɛri ni be kunduna sunsuuni shɛm la; dinzuɣu maliya yɛm kaman tinvura, ka benya baalim kaman ŋmana la.
en: Look, Im sending you as sheep among wolves. Therefore, be wise as snakes and innocent as doves.

dag: Ka Samsin yɛl o, Bɛ yi zaŋ tɔbimi pala zaɣ maha diba ayopɔin lo ma, di ni chɛ ka n gbarigi, ka be kaman sokam ni be shɛm.
en: Samson answered, If someone ties me up with seven new bowstrings that have never been dried, it will make me just as weak as anyone else.

dag: Ka Lazarɔs ŋun daa kpi maa shiri yina. Ka kahiŋga pɔb o n-lo o nuhi min o naba, ka bantabiga vil o zuɣu tabil o ninni. Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yihimiya kahiŋga maa, ka viligi bantabiga maa, ka chɛ ka o chaŋ.
en: The man who had been dead came out. His hands and feet were wrapped with strips of burial cloth, and a cloth covered his face. Jesus then told the people, Untie him and let him go.

dag: N nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒi tiŋ dunɔdali gbini ni zuri so nyaaŋa, ka danyuriba zaŋ ma niŋ yila ni yiina.
en: Rulers and judges gossip about me, and drunkards make up songs to mock me.

dag: Ka Amɔrinim maa daa kul kpalim be Harihɛrɛs mini Aijalɔn ni Shaalibim, amaa ka Yisifu zuliya niriba daa muɣisi ba hal ka bɛ ti tumdi tuma tiri ba.
en: The Amorites decided to stay in Mount Heres, Aijalon, and Shaalbim. Later, when the descendants of Joseph grew stronger, they made the Amorites work as slaves for them.

dag: Ka Jabɛshinim maa daa yɛli Naa Nahash, Biɛɣuni ti sa ni zaŋ timaŋ ti a, ka a niŋ ti a ni bɔri shɛm.
en: Then the people of Jabesh told the Ammonites, We will surrender to you tomorrow. Then you can do whatever you want to us.

dag: Pako so yi mali bihi bee yaansi, chɛ ka bɛ baŋ bɛ daadiini fukumsi ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ dɔɣiriba polo din ni chɛ ka bɛ tooi niŋ bɛ laamba mini bɛ yabipaɣiba din simdi labisi, dama lala niŋbu n-nyɛ din tiɣiri Naawuni nini.
en: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, the first thing they need to learn is this: to show their devotion to God by taking care of their own family. They will be repaying their parents, and this pleases God.

dag: ka daa zaŋ o zilinli ti anab Neetan ka o kana m-mi ti boli bia maa yuli Jɛdidia; di gbinni nyɛla Yawɛ ni yuri so.
en: and commanded the prophet Nathan to name the boy Jedidiah, because the Lord loved him.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Ŋun mali binyɛra ayi, ŋun piimi zaɣ yini ti o kpe so ŋun ka; ka ŋun mi malila bindirigu, ŋun niŋmi lala.
en: He answered, Whoever has two shirts must give one to the man who has none, and whoever has food must share it.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli nachin kpɛm maa, Nyin ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ daalibarika nir ŋɔ, bɔ n-niŋ ka a kpalim ʒe sambani ŋɔ ni? Kpɛmina, dama m pun mali duu zal a, ka mali laakumnim ŋɔ gba biɛhigu shee zali.
en: and said, Come home with me. You are a man whom the Lord has blessed. Why are you standing out here? I have a room ready for you in my house, and there is a place for your camels.

dag: Amaa o yidan maa yi bi saɣi li o ni wum li saha shɛli maa, dindina o ni ku o pɔri maa min o noli ni daa faag o ka o yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ni o niŋ shɛl la; ka Yawɛ ni chɛ o taali.
en: But if on the day that her husband hears it he expresses disapproval to her, he can break her solemn promise and the statement by which she bound herself. Then the LORD will forgive her.

dag: Ka so daa bi tooi garig o bɔhigu maa; ka dindali maa zaŋ chana, so daa bi lan buɣisi ni o bɔh o bɔhigu yaha.
en: No one was able to give Jesus any answer, and from that day on no one dared to ask him any more questions.

dag: Nir yi bi tuɣ ma, o ŋmanila wul shɛli bɛ ni wooi bahi ka di kuui, ka bɛ laɣisi di dari niŋ buɣim ni ka di di li.
en: If you dont stay joined to me, you will be like a branch that has been thrown out and has dried up. All the dead branches like that are gathered up, thrown into the fire and burned.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛl o, Man deei yi kul yi tiŋ puuni tariga, n yɛn zaŋla n nuhi duhi zuɣusaa n-suhi Yawɛ, ka satahinsi ŋɔ mini sakuɣa ŋɔ zaa chɛ. Sakuɣa ku lan beni, ka yi baŋ ni Yawɛ n-su dunia ŋɔ.
en: Moses answered, As soon as I leave the city, I will lift my arms in prayer. When the thunder and hail stop, you will know that the earth belongs to the Lord .

dag: ka di ti pali, ka bɛ vo li duhi dul na nti ʒini n-gahim zin suma niŋ piɛri ni ka zaŋ zaɣ biɛri bahi.
en: When the net is full, it is dragged to the shore, and the fishermen sit down to separate the fish. They keep the good ones, but throw the bad ones away.

dag: Naawuni zaŋd o kukoli din nyɛ satahiŋga ŋɔ tumdi alahiziba tuma; o tumdi tuun kara din gari ti yɛm.
en: At God's command amazing things happen, wonderful things that we can't understand.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum lala maa ka di gari ba pam, ka bɛ daa chɛ o ka chaŋ.
en: When they heard this they were astonished, and they departed.

dag: Ti ni yɛn niŋ shɛm buɣisi ya m-bɔŋɔ: m po Firawuna ni yi ku kuli ka pa ni yi tizo ŋun nyɛ yi zaa biasani maa gba kala kpe na.
en: This is how you will be tested: I swear by the name of the king that you will never leave unless your youngest brother comes here.

dag: O daa chaŋ nti kpɛla Naawuni jɛmbu duu nti ŋub bɔrɔbɔro shɛŋa din daa chihiri ni o mini bɛn daa be o sani ŋubi naɣila maligumaaniba kɔŋko la.
en: David went into Gods house. He and those with him ate the bread that was offered to God. It was against the law for David or those with him to eat that bread. Only the priests were allowed to eat it.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Firawuna niŋ tipawumli n-kari doli Izraɛlnim maa saha shɛli bɛ ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni ni nasara la.
en: The Israelites were leaving with their arms raised in victory. But the Lord caused Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, to become brave. And Pharaoh chased the Israelites.

dag: Ka Pool ŋahiŋga daa wum bɛ ni to jina gbaai shɛm maa, ka chaŋ ti kpe tɔbbihi biɛhigu shee maa nti zaŋ yɛlli maa yɛli Pool.
en: Pauls sister had a son who heard about the ambush and he came to the military headquarters and reported it to Paul.

dag: Ti ni be dunia ŋɔ ni Tanti yili ŋɔ ni maa, ti kul ŋuhirimi ni suhubɔhibo; ka di pala ti bɔrimi ni ti yee li sɔŋ, amaa ti bɔri ni ti yɛla alizanda ni din la pa di zuɣu, ka di chɛ ka nyɛvili tooi vali din kpira.
en: Yes, while we are in this tent we groan, because we are weighed down. We want to be dressed not undressed, so that what is dying can be swallowed up by life.

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia Kasi mini Amiliya maa yɛli, Kamina! Ŋunkam wum dimbɔŋɔ, ŋun gba yɛlima, Kamina! Ka kɔnyuri ni mali sokam mini ŋun bɔri nyɛvili kom, ŋun kamina nti dee li yoli.
en: The Spirit and the bride say, Come! Let the one who hears say, Come! And let the one who is thirsty come! Let the one who wishes receive life-giving water as a gift.

dag: Bɛ daa dala chɛchɛbunsi tuhi pihitanaayi, ka daa lan da Maaka naa min o tɔbbihi pahi, ka bɛ daa kana ti dɔni Mɛdɛba tooni. Ka Ammɔnnim daa yi bɛ tinsi ni na ni bɛ ti tuhi tɔbu.
en: They hired thirty-two thousand chariots, as well as King Maacah and his army, who came and camped in front of Medeba, while the Ammonites left their cities and came together ready for battle.

dag: Amaa chɛliya ka yɛlimaŋli naɣ beni kaman kulibɔŋ kom din zɔri la, ka chɛ ka wuntia mi be kaman mɔɣili kom din zɔri la.
en: Instead, let justice flow like a stream, and righteousness like a river that never goes dry.

dag: So yi ti o kpee dalinli, bɛn niŋm o gba o ni niŋ shɛm maa labisi.
en: Personal injuries to others must be dealt with in keeping with the crime—.

dag: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ni n ti zaŋ Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tin ya; ka nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out from the land of Egypt to give you Canaans land and to be your God.

dag: A yi kpahi ansarisimaana zuɣu ni, o ni leei ŋun je a. A yi kpahi ŋun mali yɛm zuɣu ni, o ni yur a.
en: Any bragger you correct will only hate you. But if you correct someone who has common sense, you will be loved.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa daa yɛli Jɛhɔshafat, N di pun bi yɛl a ni o ku yɛli din nyɛ zaɣ viɛlli zaŋ chaŋ m polo naɣila zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Ahab said to Jehoshaphat, Didn't I tell you that he never prophesies anything good for me? It's always something bad.

dag: dama Yawɛ yɛli ma, Miri ka a di bindirigu bee n-nyu kom nimaani bee n-dol a ni doli so shɛli kana. .
en: because of the message that came to me from the LORDs word: Dont eat food! Dont drink water! Dont return by the way you came.

dag: Ka Abinɛr ŋun daa nyɛ Nɛr bia la mini Sool bia Ishibɔshɛt la tɔbbihi daa yi Mahanaim chaŋ Gibiɔn.
en: Abner and the officials of Ishbosheth went from Mahanaim to the city of Gibeon.

dag: ka o lu tiŋa, ka wum ka kukol shɛli boon o na yɛra, Sool, Sool, bɔ n-niŋ ka a niŋdi ma alaka.
en: He fell to the ground and heard a voice saying, Saul! Saul! Why are you so cruel to me.

dag: Niriba ni ti yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, wuntizɔriba mali laara. Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni ŋun kariti dunianim saria shiri beni.
en: Everyone will say, It's true! Good people are rewarded. God does indeed rule the earth with justice.

dag: Yi yi ti lo tɔbu chaŋ ni yi ti tuhi yi dimnima, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zaŋ ba niŋ yi nuu ni, ka yi gbahi ba daba.
en: When the Lord your God gives you victory in battle and you take prisoners.

dag: Ka Musa daa sabi Yawɛ yɛligu maa zaa sɔŋ, ka daa ti daŋ yiɣisibu asiba me sara maligu bimbini zali zoli maa gbini, ka sa bin wɔɣila pinaayi ka di zani Izraɛl zuliya pinaayi la zaani.
en: Moses wrote down all the Lord 's commands. Early the next morning he built an altar at the foot of the mountain and set up twelve stones, one for each of the twelve tribes of Israel.

dag: N yura, a viɛli pam, a shiri viɛli pam; a nina bemi kaman ŋmana la.
en: My darling, you are so beautiful! Oh, you are beautiful! Your eyes are like doves.

dag: Tuumbiɛtumdiba ni ti gbani ninvuɣ suma tooni, ka ninvuɣ biɛri ti baɣi wuntizɔriba dunɔdaya.
en: Evil people will bow down before the good; wicked people are at the gates of the righteous.

dag: N naan wuh o n napɔna yaabu zaa, ka chaŋ o sani kaman naa la.
en: I would give him an account of my steps, approach him like a prince.

dag: Wuntaŋ yi ti lu saha shɛli ka o ni yi daɣiri ni, di nyaaŋa ka o ni tooi di bin kasinim la, dama o bindirigu m-bala.
en: After the sun sets he is clean, and then he may eat the sacred offerings, which are his food.

dag: dama n sani, m bia ŋɔ daa kpimi ka lan neei na, o daa bɔrigimi ka n lan nya o yaha. Ka bɛ daa dii gbaai diɛma diɛmbu ni suhupiɛlli.
en: This son of mine was dead, but has now come back to life. He was lost and has now been found. And they began to celebrate.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun ni lan kpalim be alizanda ni hal ka binshɛɣukam zaa ti niŋ pali kaman Naawuni ni daa chɛ ka o daanab suma yɛli shɛm dunia piligu ni la ha.
en: Jesus must remain in heaven until the restoration of all things, about which God spoke long ago through his holy prophets.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Banima n-lee ni tooi sɔɣi ashilɔni luɣ shɛli ka n ku tooi nya ba? M bi bela zuɣusaa mini dunia ni zaa? Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Someone might try to hide from me in some hiding place. But it is easy for me to see that person, says the Lord , because I am everywhere in heaven and earth. This message is from the Lord :.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka yi ni shɛb pam gbarigi ka ka alaafee, ka shɛb mi kpi.
en: This is why many of you are sick and weak and why a lot of others have died.

dag: ka ŋun chaŋ ti bela kpiimba biɛhigu shee nyari azaaba, ka daa ti kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi nya ti yab Ibrahimma katiŋ ha, ka Lazarɔs be o sani.
en: and in Hades, where he was in great pain, he looked up and saw Abraham, far away, with Lazarus at his side.

dag: Ɛdomnima mini Ishimail zuliya ni Mɔabnima ni Hagirinima ni.
en: Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab and the Hagrites;.

dag: Ti suhiri ti Duuma maŋmaŋa ŋun nyɛ suhudoo ni yiri so sanna la ni o timiya suhudoo sahakam mini yɛlli kam ni. Ti Duuma kul kpalimmi be yi zaa sani!.
en: May the Lord of peace himself give you peace always in every way. The Lord be with all of you.

dag: Ka Liya daa yɛli, N ni zaŋ n dab bipuɣiŋga ti n yidan la zuɣu, Naawuni deei n suhigu; ka boli bia maa yuli Isaka.
en: Leah said, God gave me what I paid for, what I deserved for giving my servant to my husband. So she named him Issachar.

dag: Amaa ka Rut daa yɛli Naomi, Di yɛri ma ni n labimi ka chɛ a, dama a ni kuni shɛli, nimaani ka n kuna, ka a ni kpɛri shɛli, nimaani ka n gba yɛn kpe. A niriba ni leei n niriba, ka a Naawuni leei n Naawuni.
en: But Ruth answered, Don't ask me to leave you! Let me go with you. Wherever you go, I will go; wherever you live, I will live. Your people will be my people, and your God will be my God.

dag: Yɛlim Aduna, A yi ti zaŋ firilanim ayopɔin la zali, nyin chɛ ka di ne firilatamdigu la tooni. .
en: Speak to Aaron and say to him: When you set them up, the seven lamps will give light in front of the lampstand.

dag: ni Kɛnaz ni Tɛman ni Mibizar.
en: Chief Kenaz, Chief Teman, Chief Mibzar.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kɔhi bɛ ni su shɛlikam zaa m-pirigipirigi ti taba kaman di ni daa simdi ni sokam deei shɛm tariga.
en: They would sell their property and possessions and give the money to whoever was in need.

dag: Ka o yɛli salo maa ni bɛ ʒinim tiŋa;.
en: So Jesus ordered the crowd to sit down on the ground.

dag: ka bɛ daa bi nyari taba bee so ti yi n-chaŋ shɛli polo daba ata maa ni zaa. Amaa Izraɛlnim maa bɛn yaɣili polo zaa daa malila neesim.
en: During that time, the Egyptians could not see each other or leave their homes, but there was light where the Israelites lived.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Nyamiya, n je anabi shɛb bɛn mali bɛmaŋmaŋ yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisiri ka yɛra, Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa. .
en: Yes, the Lord says, I am against the false prophets. They use their own words and pretend that it is a message from me.

dag: m mali tahima ni n yi ti gariti chani Speen n ni nyan ya. Ka n yi ti kaai ya n-niŋ daba ayi yi sani, yi ni sɔŋ ma ka n gari chaŋ.
en: So I will visit you when I go to Spain. Yes, I hope to visit you while I am traveling to Spain, and I will stay and enjoy being with you. Then you can help me continue on my trip.

dag: M birimmi zaa ka dabiɛm kpe ma. N suhu kul yɛla yuŋ zibbu zuɣu, amaa ka di tahiri ma la dabiɛm na.
en: My head spins; I'm horrified! Early evening, my favorite time, has become a nightmare.

dag: Ka Dauda daa piripiri ba kaman Lɛvi bidibisi ni daa nyɛ shɛm: Gɛrishɔn mini Kɔhat ni Mɛrari daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: David then divided the Levites into three groups according to the clans of Levi's sons, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

dag: Ka Ahitub bia Zadok mini Abiata bia Ahimɛlɛk daa nyɛ maligumaaniba, ka Shavisha daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmara.
en: Ahitubs son Zadok and Abiathars son Ahimelech were priests; Shavsha was secretary.

dag: Naawuni zaligunim min anabinim yɛligu daa pun benimi hal ka Jɔn ti kana.
en: All the Prophets and the Law prophesied until John came.

dag: Dama n tumtumdiba n-nyɛ Izraɛlnima. Bɛ nyɛla n tumtumdi shɛba n ni daa yihi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: This is because the Israelites are my servants. They are the servants who I brought out of slavery in Egypt. I am the Lord your God!.

dag: Ka Zɛruya bia Jɔab ni daa ti baŋ ni Naa Dauda suhu lu Absalom ni.
en: Joab knew that David couldn't stop thinking about Absalom.

dag: Bɛ ni ti doli Yawɛ, ka o ti ŋum kaman gbuɣinli la; yɛlimaŋli, o shiri ni ti ŋum, ka o niriba ti yi wulinluhili polo na ka bɛ ni sɔhira.
en: I, the Lord , will roar like a lion, and my children will return, trembling from the west.

dag: Yawɛ ni wuhi ti o jilima, ka chɛ ka ti ʒini baɣili mɔɣ kara mini kulibɔna, amaa ka ti dimnim ŋarima ku gari nimaani.
en: The LORDs majesty will be there for us: as a place of rivers, broad streams where no boat will go, no majestic ship will cross.

dag: Zabidiɛl bia Jashɔbiam n-daa su bɛ ni tuui pirigi ninvuɣ shɛb la fukumsi gol tuuli puuni. Ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi ka o daa su.
en: In the first month, Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel.

dag: Ka o daa bol o na ti bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ka n go n-wumd a yɛla shɛm ŋɔ? Malimi m binshɛɣukam din be a sani laasabu n-zaŋ ti ma, dama a ku lan niŋ n tumtumdi kpɛma.
en: So he called the manager in and said to him, I have heard bad things about you. Give me a report of what you have done with my money. You cant be my manager anymore.

dag: Yi yi kpuɣi yi nuhi zuɣusaa n-suhi ma, hal yi yi suhi ma kabo, n ku lihi yi polo na; m mi ku wum yi suhigu maa. Yi nuhi tim ʒim ni.
en: When you extend your hands, Ill hide my eyes from you. Even when you pray for a long time, I wont listen. Your hands are stained with blood.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni yi mali yurilim yi bebu ni kaman Masia ni daa yu ti ka zaŋ omaŋ pa talima ti zuɣu, ka di tiɣi Naawuni nini kaman sara shɛli din nyom viɛl ŋun Naawuni san la.
en: Let love be your guide. Christ loved us and offered his life for us as a sacrifice that pleases God.

dag: Bɛ bi mi, bɛ mi bi baŋ, bɛ tɛha mini bɛ nina zommi, ka bɛ ku tooi baŋ shɛli bee n-nya shɛli.
en: Those who worship idols are stupid and blind!.

dag: ka niŋ ba yiko ni bɛ karit alizin biɛri niriba zuɣu bahira.
en: and to force out demons.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛliya, Naɣila yi ni yɛn be Babilɔn yuun pisopɔin la saha ti gari, ka n naanyi ka yi sanna nti chɛ ka n ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛŋa la niŋ pali, ka n zaŋ ya labisi kpe na.
en: The Lord says, When Babylonia's seventy years are over, I will show my concern for you and keep my promise to bring you back home.

dag: Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zani dabari ka yi suhuri paligi shɛm, lala ka n yɛn niŋ yi gba; nyini Siɛr Zoli mini Ɛdom zaa ni zani dabari. Di saha ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: You were happy when the country of Israel was destroyed. I will treat you the same way. Mount Seir and the whole country of Edom will be destroyed. Then you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Niriba anu maa ni daa lab Zɔra mini Ɛshitaol bɛ mabihi maa sani, bɛ daa bɔhi ba mi, Ka lahibal bɔ ka yi lee ʒina.
en: When the men came back to their relatives at Zorah and Eshtaol, they asked them, What did you find.

dag: N niriba bɛn zaa nyɛ alahichinima ka yɛra, Zaɣ biɛɣu ku niŋ ti shɛli bee m-paai ti la, bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku ba.
en: The sinners among my people will be killed in war—all those who say, God will not let any harm come near us.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan labi nti suhiri Naawuni n-kul yɛrila yɛtɔɣ yini maa o suhigu maa ni.
en: Jesus went back and prayed the same prayer.

dag: Uziɛl bidibisi ni, Maika n-daa nyɛ kpɛma n-zaŋ Ishia pa.
en: Kohath's fourth son, Uzziel, had two sons, Micah and Isshiah.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm tum alahichi pam, dinzuɣu ka o leei tabizahim niriba sani. Bɛnkam zaa daa tiri o jilima lihimi ʒiɛm o, dama bɛ nya o gbini. Omaŋmaŋ ŋuhirimi, ka ŋmalig o nini labi kpaŋa.
en: Jerusalem has sinned greatly; therefore, shes become a joke. All who honored her now detest her, for theyve seen her naked. Even she groans and turns away.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa daa bɔhi Yisa bɔhigu n-vihir o ni o baŋ o nyaandoliba min o wuhibu yɛla.
en: Meanwhile, the chief priest questioned Jesus about his disciples and his teaching.

dag: Ka o daa tim ka bɛ ti zaŋ o na. O daa nyɛla ŋun mal alaafee, ka o nimbihi kul viɛla, ka o lan nyɛ nachimbil viɛlli. Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Samuɛl, Yiɣisim booi kpam bah o zuɣu ni; ŋuna m-bala.
en: So Jesse sent for him. He was a handsome, healthy young man, and his eyes sparkled. The Lord said to Samuel, This is the one—anoint him.

dag: ka su wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ, ka woligi neesim ka chɛ zibisim. Ka Naawuni daa nya li ka di viɛla.
en: He put them in the sky to rule over the day and over the night. They separated the light from the darkness. And God saw that this was good.

dag: O ni ti labisi Izraɛlnim pam bɛ Duuma Naawuni sani yaha.
en: and he will bring back many of the people of Israel to the Lord their God.

dag: Sulemaana daa laɣi Ijipti naa Firawuna zɔri o bipuɣiŋga kpuɣibu zuɣu. Ka Sulemaana daa kpuɣi Firawuna bipuɣiŋga maa n-zaŋ o na ti niŋ Dauda tiŋ la ni hal ka bɛ ti me omaŋmaŋ yiŋ mini Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ni gooni gili Jɛrusalɛm naai.
en: Solomon became the son-in-law of Pharaoh, Egypts king, when he married Pharaohs daughter. He brought her to Davids City until he finished building his royal palace, the LORDs temple, and the wall around Jerusalem.

dag: Yi ni doli yɛlimaŋli soli mali yimaŋa ka yi biɛhigu be kasi, ka di chɛ ka yi yuri yi mabihi yurilim maŋli ni la zuɣu, kul yumiya taba yi suhuri ni ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: You obeyed the truth, and your souls were made pure. Now you sincerely love each other. But you must keep on loving with all your heart.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Pa ʒii buyopɔin kɔŋko, amaa pisopɔin mi ʒii buyopɔin.
en: Jesus answered: Not just times, but times!.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Noli ni di ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ bɛ ninsalitab naani, ka zaŋ bɛ ninsalitab maa leei bɛ kpiɔŋ, ka ŋmaligi bɛ suhuri ka chɛ man Yawɛ la.
en: The LORD proclaims: Cursed are those who trust in mere humans, who depend on human strength and turn their hearts from the LORD.

dag: N dimnim yi ŋmaligi, bɛ tuurimi lu n-kpi a tooni.
en: My enemies turned to run from you, but they fell and were destroyed.

dag: Ka nandahima daa gbaai Izraɛlnim zaŋ chaŋ Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa polo, Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim noya woligi la zuɣu.
en: The Israelites felt sorry for the men of Benjamin. They felt sorry for them because the Lord had separated them from the other tribes of Israel.

dag: Teem a ni daa pun piig a ninvuɣ shɛb kurimbuni ha la yɛla, a ni daa tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb ni bɛ nyɛ a ni su zuliya shɛb la. Teem Ziɔn Zo shɛli zuɣu a ni daa be la yɛla.
en: Remember the people you bought so long ago. You saved us, and we belong to you. And remember Mount Zion, the place where you lived.

dag: Lumiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sizuura, ka jɛmiy o kɔŋko, ka zaŋya yimaŋ ti o, ka zaŋd o yuli pɔri pɔri.
en: Respect the Lord your God, be faithful, and serve only him, making promises in his name.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma lan yɛli, N Duuma, n suhir a, di je suli niŋ ma n ni lan yɛn yɛli shɛm pahi ŋɔ zuɣu. Ka a yi ti nyala wuntizɔriba pia nimaani? Ka o garigi yɛli, Wuntizɔriba pia maa zuɣu, n ku saɣim tiŋ maa.
en: Then Abraham said, Lord, please dont be angry with me, but let me bother you this one last time. If you find ten good people there, what will you do? The Lord said, If I find ten good people in the city, I will not destroy it.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ, nyama, n niriba Izraɛlnim maa fabila maa paai ma, ka n nya Ijiptinim maa ni tiri ba wahala shɛŋa maa zaa.
en: I have heard the cries of the Israelites, and I have seen the way the Egyptians have made life hard for them.

dag: Ka Yisa chɛbis o ni o kulima ka yɛl o, Di lan lab tiŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Jesus told him to go home. He said, Dont go into the town.

dag: Ka o daa mali buɣili kɔtomsi n-zaŋ li zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni, du shɛli Naawuni ni daa yɛli Dauda min o bia Sulemaana, Duu ŋɔ ni mini Jɛrusalɛm ka m pii Izraɛl zuliya zaa ni n-lee n jɛmbu shee saha shɛlikam la.
en: Manasseh set up the carved image he had made in Gods temple, the very temple God had spoken about to David and his son Solomon, saying: In this temple and in Jerusalem, which I have selected out of all Israels tribes, I will put my name forever.

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ bimparilan shɛli din pari gbɛɣu zuɣu ka di nyɛ din be kasi, ka sabi sabbu pa di zuɣu kaman bɛ ni mali nintu shɛli dalinli dihiri tabindi binyara zuɣu la. Sabbu maa n-daa nyɛ: O nyɛla ŋun be kasi Yawɛ sani.
en: They made the ornament, the sacred sign of dedication, out of pure gold, and they engraved on it Dedicated to the Lord .

dag: ka m mi ni a kul deeri n suhigu sahakam; amaa niriba bɛn ʒe kpe ŋɔ zuɣu ka n suhir a maa ni di chɛ ka bɛ niŋ yɛda ni nyini n-shiri tim ma na.
en: I know that you always hear me. But I said these things because of the people here around me. I want them to believe that you sent me.

dag: ni oniɣisi kuɣa ni kuɣ shɛŋa din ni niŋ pa binyɛribil din yɛri pari zuɣusaa la zuɣu mini nyolɔrigu la zuɣu.
en: Also accept onyx stones and other jewels to be put on the ephod and the judgment pouch.

dag: Bɛ ni ti be n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti n dabili Yaakubu la ni; yi yaannim ni daa be shɛl ni la. Bɛ mini bɛ bihi ni bɛ yaansi ni ti be nimaani sahakam. Ka n dabili Dauda ti nyɛ bɛ naa sahakam.
en: They will live on the land that I gave to my servant Jacob, where their ancestors lived. They will live on it, they and their children and their grandchildren, forever. My servant David will be their prince forever.

dag: Ti mali tahima ni Naawuni ni ti yihi ti taali ni o sani; ka dimbɔŋɔnima n-nyɛ ti ni guhiri shɛli Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko din tumdi di tuma ti yɛda niŋbu ni la puuni.
en: But the Spirit makes us sure God will accept us because of our faith in Christ.

dag: ti niŋgbuŋ yaɣ shɛŋa din viɛl la ni bi bɔra. Amaa Naawuni zaŋ niŋgbuŋ tuɣi taba, ka pahiri yaɣ shɛŋa din pooi viɛlim la jilima pam.
en: but we don't have to be modest about other parts. God put our bodies together in such a way that even the parts that seem the least important are valuable.

dag: Dama ŋun be nam ʒiishee maa sunsuuni ŋɔ n-yɛn nyɛ bɛ gula, ka lan nyɛ ŋun yɛn zaŋdi ba tahiri nyɛvili kɔbilisirim shee. Ka Naawuni ni nyɛhi bɛ nintam zaa bahi.
en: The Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd. He will lead them to streams of life-giving water, and God will wipe all tears from their eyes.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yisa Kaiafas yiŋ maa ni n-tahi Gomna yiŋa asibaasi. Bɛmaŋmaŋ daa bi saɣi doli kpe Gomna yiŋ maa ni, dama bɛ daa bi bɔri ni bɛ tum birigi bɛ kali din ni chɛ ka daɣiri tab ba ka bɛ ku tooi di Yaɣigari Chuɣu bindirigu.
en: Early in the morning Jesus was taken from Caiaphas' house to the governor's palace. The Jewish authorities did not go inside the palace, for they wanted to keep themselves ritually clean, in order to be able to eat the Passover meal.

dag: Bɛna n-ni ti zaŋ takɔbi su Asiria tiŋgbɔŋ, ka lan zaŋ takɔbi su Nimrɔd tiŋgbɔŋ; ka Asirianim yi ti ka ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni na ti be ti tintarisi bɛ ni fa ti bahi.
en: With swords in hand our leaders will defeat the Assyrians and rule the land of Nimrod. They will save us from the Assyrians when they come into our land and march through our territory.

dag: M mabiyurisi, di chɛliya ka binshɛli yɔhim ya.
en: My dear brothers and sisters, dont be fooled about this.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka n daa zaŋ n ni da li ka deei gban shɛli ka n dalinli dihi tabili li, ka yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa mini zaligu shɛŋa ti ni daa zali be di ni mini di gban shɛli din pahi di zuɣu la.
en: Then I took the sealed copy of the deed, which contained the demands and limits of my purchase, and the copy that was not sealed.

dag: Ka Naomi yɛli Rut, M bia, guhimi nya yɛla maa zaa ni yɛn bahindi shɛm. Doo maa ku vuhi ka pa ni o nyala yɛla maa kpaa shee zuŋɔ.
en: Naomi replied, Just be patient and don't worry about what will happen. He won't rest until everything is settled today.

dag: Yawɛ daa wuhi ti shihira ka tum alahiziba tuun kara din mali dabiɛm pam jɛndi Ijipti mini Firawuna ni o yiŋnim zaa ti ninni.
en: We saw him perform miracles and make horrible things happen to the king, his officials, and everyone else.

dag: Di daa niŋ ba alahiziba pam nti yaɣi ka bɛ yɛra, O niŋdi binshɛɣukam zaa viɛnyɛliŋga, hal o chɛ ka tikpiranim wumda, ka chɛ ka biriti gba tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa.
en: And all who heard were completely amazed. How well he does everything! they exclaimed. He even causes the deaf to hear and the dumb to speak.

dag: o yi doli n zaligunima, ka niŋdi n ni zali shɛlikam viɛnyɛliŋga, ka ʒe yim, o nyɛla wuntizɔra, biɛhiŋ kani, o ni be. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: He obeys my laws and studies my rules so that he can learn to be fair and dependable. He is good, so he will live. This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: Ka Musa daa yi Sinai Zoli maa zuɣu n-gbibi alikauli bimparilana ayi la o nuu ni siɣina. Musa daa bi mi ni o ninni nyaɣisira, o mini Naawuni ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa maa zuɣu.
en: Moses came down from Mount Sinai, carrying the Ten Commandments. His face was shining brightly because the Lord had been speaking to him. But Moses did not know at first that his face was shining.

dag: Bɛ kul teemi gili ma luɣilikam zaa, amaa ka n nyaŋ ba Yawɛ yuli zuɣu!.
en: They surrounded me again and again, but I defeated them with the Lord s power.

dag: Amaa ka timanim gba daa niŋ tabibi n-chɛ ka poloya yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: However, the Egyptian religious experts were able to do the same thing by their secret knowledge. They too made frogs crawl up onto the land of Egypt.

dag: Di saha ka Musa ŋun daa nyɛ Yawɛ dabili maa daa kpi nimaani Mɔabnim tiŋgbɔŋ ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali shɛm maa.
en: And so, Moses the Lord 's servant died there in Moab, just as the Lord had said.

dag: Naa Dauda daa yɛli niriba bɛn laɣim maa zaa, M bia Sulemaana n-nyɛ Naawuni ni pii so, ka o mi na nyɛ bi polli, ka bi mi tuma looloochi, ka tuma maa mi zooi; dama pa ninsal duu ka ti yɛn me, amaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu ka ti yɛn me maa.
en: King David announced to the whole assembly: My son Solomon is the one whom God has chosen, but he is still young and lacks experience. The work to be done is tremendous, because this is not a palace for people but a temple for the Lord God.

dag: Dama Masia daa bi kpɛla daadamnim ni me Luɣ Kasi Zaa Kasi Shee din nyɛ alali din la ŋmahinli la ni, amaa alizanda maŋmaŋ ni ka o kpe nti zani Naawuni tooni ti zuɣu pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Christ went into the Most Holy Place. But it was not the man-made one, which is only a copy of the real one. He went into heaven, and he is there now before God to help us.

dag: Ka wulimpuhili polo tiŋgbani tariga yɛn kpuɣila Teeku Kpiŋ shee zaŋ hal ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili noli. Ka nuzaa polo tiŋgbani tariga mi piligi Yalim Teeku maa ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili noli shee.
en: Judah's eastern border ran the full length of the Dead Sea. The northern border started at the northern end of the Dead Sea.

dag: Yi bi mi ni bɛn pa wuntizɔriba zaa ku kpe Naawuni nam ni? Di yɔhimya yimaŋa, dama bɛn tumdi daɣiri tuma mini buɣijɛmdiba ni zinaniŋdiba ni dɔbba bɛn gɔndi bɛ dɔtaba bee paɣiba bɛn gɔndi bɛ paɣitaba.
en: Dont you know that people who are unjust wont inherit Gods kingdom? Dont be deceived. Those who are sexually immoral, those who worship false gods, adulterers, both participants in same-sex intercourse.

dag: Amaa ka Yisahaku biŋkɔbiguliba daa gbi kɔbiliga vinvamli maa ni n-nya kom.
en: Isaacs servants dug wells in the valley and found a well there with fresh water.

dag: ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ ŋman yino mali sara alahichi zuɣu, ka zaŋ ŋun la mi mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la, o ni shihi kpima n-tum alahichi shɛl la zuɣu. Ka o lan mal o zuɣu maa ka di be kasi dindali maa.
en: The priest will offer one for a purification offering and the other as an entirely burned offering. He will seek reconciliation for the person on account of the guilt acquired from the corpse, and he will make the head holy again on that same day.

dag: Ka wuntaŋ yi ti puhina, bɛ zɔrimi ti kpe bɛ biɛhigu shee.
en: When the sun rises, they go back and lie down in their dens.

dag: Juda Naa Jɛhɔyakim ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ata saha ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza min o tɔbbihi daa ka Jɛrusalɛm na nti teei gil li.
en: In the third year that Jehoiakim was king of Judah, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia attacked Jerusalem.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ba, Din yiri ninsal suhu ni na, dina n-tar o daɣiri.
en: Then Jesus said: What comes from your heart is what makes you unclean.

dag: Bɛ ʒi suhudoo soli.
en: They don't know how to live in peace.

dag: Yurilim bi mali dimaŋ kuuna bee n-ʒiɛmdi so. Yurilim bi zabiri dimaŋ yubu zuɣu; di bi mali suhuyiɣisili; di mi bi zaŋdi yɛla niŋdi suhu ni.
en: Love is not rude, it is not selfish, and it cannot be made angry easily. Love does not remember wrongs done against it.

dag: Ka Hanani bia Jɛhu ŋun daa nyɛ anabi la daa yi n-chaŋ ti tuhi Naa Jɛhɔshafat soli n-yɛl o, A tɛhiya ni di simdi ni a sɔŋdi ninvuɣ biɛri ka yuri bɛn je Yawɛ? A ni niŋ shɛm ŋɔ zuɣu, Yawɛ suhu yiɣisiya pam bahi a zuɣu.
en: A prophet, Jehu son of Hanani, went to meet the king and said to him, Do you think it is right to help those who are wicked and to take the side of those who hate the Lord ? What you have done has brought the Lord 's anger on you.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu ti kpamdi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi lala maa jaande, ka zaani ba zaligu ni bɛ be baalim ka tummi tuma lihiri bɛmaŋa.
en: So, for the sake of our Lord Jesus Christ, we ask and beg these people to settle down and start working for a living.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa boli Musa mini Aduna na ti yɛli ba, Chamiya ti mali yi sara maa ti yi Naawuni maa yaŋɔ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Then the king sent for Moses and Aaron and told them, Go ahead and sacrifice to your God, but stay here in Egypt.

dag: Yawɛ, di tam Ɛdomnim ni daa yɛli shɛm Jɛrusalɛm lubu dal la yɛla. Bɛ daa kul yɛrimi, Daamiya li luhi! Daamiya li luhi zaa.
en: Remember, Lord , what the Edomites did the day Jerusalem was captured. Remember how they kept saying, Tear it down to the ground.

dag: Amaa ka yi chɛ ka Nazarinim maa nyuri wain, ka yɛri anabinima ni bɛ miri ka bɛ tɔɣisiri Naawuni yɛtɔɣa.
en: But you commanded the prophets not to speak their message, and you pressured the Nazirites into drinking wine.

dag: O daa bi siɣis omaŋa Yawɛ tooni kaman o ba Manaasa ni daa siɣis omaŋ shɛm la, amaa Amɔn ŋɔ ŋun daa kul tumdila tuumbiɛri pahira.
en: Manasseh had turned back to the Lord , but Amon refused to do that. Instead, he sinned even more than his father.

dag: Hɛla bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Zɛrɛt mini Izar ni Ɛtinan.
en: The sons of Helah were Zereth, Zohar, Ethnan, and Koz.

dag: Yawɛ, yɛlimaŋli, Asiria naa shiri bahi niriba pam mini bɛ tiŋgbɔna yoli.
en: We all know, Lord , that the emperors of Assyria have destroyed many nations, made their lands desolate.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yɛn puhi chu shɛli din nyɛ Naawuni Jɛmbu Duu Yoobu Chuɣu la Jɛrusalɛm, di daa nyɛla kikaa saha.
en: It was winter, and the time came for the Festival of Dedication at Jerusalem.

dag: Ka lan bɔhi ba, Bee yi tɛhiya ni Sailom du shɛli din daa du pam la ni daa lu n-ku ninvuɣ pisaayika shɛb la daa nyɛla tuumbiɛrinim gari bɛn zaa daa be Jɛrusalɛm la?.
en: What about those people who died when the tower in Siloam fell on them? Do you think they were worse than everyone else in Jerusalem?.

dag: A mali pal yɛlinli ti n naba, ka m bi sarigi.
en: You clear the way for me, and now I won't stumble.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka a bi chɛ n taali ka kpihim n daalahichi maa? Dama pumpɔŋɔ n yɛn dɔnila tiŋgban ni. A ni ti lihi bo ma, amaa ka n ku beni.
en: Why do you refuse to forgive? Soon you won't find me, because I'll be dead.

dag: Isaka zuliya mini bɛ daŋ niriba ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Tola daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ Tolanima; ka Puva daŋ niriba nyɛ Puvanima.
en: The family groups from the tribe of Issachar were Tola—the Tolaite family group; Puah—the Puite family group;.

dag: Mɛfibɔshɛt dapala daa nyɛla bidibbil sariŋga ka o yuli booni Maika, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be Ziba yiŋa daa leei Mɛfibɔshɛt tumtumdiba.
en: Mephibosheth had a young son named Mica. All the members of Ziba's family became servants of Mephibosheth.

dag: Izraɛlnim zaa mini Samarianim zaa ni nya li. Amaa bɛ karimbaani ni bɛ duhimaŋtali zuɣu, bɛ ni yɛli.
en: All the people of Israel, everyone who lives in the city of Samaria, will know that he has done this. Now they are proud and arrogant. They say.

dag: mini dundɔŋ din gil li maa daantalisi ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu ni dundɔŋ maa dunɔdali daantalisi ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu ni Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili kpahi zaa ni dundɔŋ din daa gil li maa kpahi zaa.
en: It was also used to make the bases for the curtains around the courtyard and the bases for the curtains at the entrance. And the bronze was used to make the tent pegs for the Holy Tent and for the curtains around the courtyard.

dag: Ka Hushai ŋun daa nyɛ Ariki nir ka nyɛ Dauda zɔsimo la daa chaŋ Absalom sani ti yɛl o, Naawuni dolimi naa nyɛvili! Naawuni dolimi naa nyɛvili.
en: When Hushai, David's trusted friend, met Absalom, he shouted, Long live the king! Long live the king.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ zaa n-nyɛ Izraɛl zuliya pinaayi la. O ni daa yɛli ba shɛm ka niŋ alibarika shɛŋa din simdi bɛ zaa yinoyino niŋ bɛ ni shɛm m-bala.
en: These are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father said to them. He blessed them by giving each man his own particular blessing.

dag: So yi buɣisi ni o yɛl a yɛtɔɣ shɛli a suhu ni miligi? Amaa ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi chɛ yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu?.
en: I must say something. Would it upset you if I speak?.

dag: Jɔtam yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaanu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pinaayɔbu.
en: Jotham was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he ruled in Jerusalem for sixteen years.

dag: Amaa Yisa daa lan tum tuun shɛŋa pam pahi, ka di yɛla bi sabi niŋ kpe. Di zaa yi di sabi, n tɛhi n suhu ni ni di litaafinim naan ku nya palo dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Jesus did many other things as well. If all of them were recorded, I imagine the world itself wouldnt have enough room for the scrolls that would be written.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka ti kul mali suhukpeeni. Ti mi ni ti yi be ti niŋgbuŋ din nyɛ yili ŋɔ ni, ti na ka ti Duuma yiŋa m-bala.
en: So always be cheerful! As long as we are in these bodies, we are away from the Lord.

dag: Bɛ ni ti dirila bɛ ni zaŋ chi mini kawaan shɛŋa na ti mali sara shɛli ni alahichi sanyoo sara binyara ni taali sanyoo sara binyara. Ka bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛli zaa ti Yawɛ Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni nyɛla bɛ dini.
en: They will eat the grain offerings, the purification offerings, and the compensation offerings. Every dedicated thing in Israel belongs to them.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa kana ti zani miri niriba maa zaa ka bɔhi ba, Bɔ saha ka yi leei kul yɛn chɛ yi tɛha buyiyi ŋɔ? Yawɛ n-yi nyɛ Naawuni, yin doliy o, ka Baal n-yi nyɛ Naawuni, yin doliy o. Ka niriba maa daa bi garigi yɛl o shɛli.
en: Elijah went up to the people and said, How much longer will it take you to make up your minds? If the Lord is God, worship him; but if Baal is God, worship him! But the people didn't say a word.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Cham Firawuna sani, dama mani n-chɛ ka o min o kpambaliba zaa suhuri kpɛma ni di chɛ ka n tum alahiziba tuma ŋɔ bɛ sani.
en: The Lord said to Moses: Go back to the king. I have made him and his officials stubborn, so that I could work these miracles.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sab bɛ ni yɛli ni Yisa tum taal shɛli maa tabil o dapulli maa zuɣusaa o zuɣu dɛde. Di ni daa sab shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yisa ŋun nyɛ Yɛhudianim Naa la m-bɔŋɔ.
en: They placed above his head the charge against him. It read, This is Jesus, the king of the Jews.

dag: N daa bi ʒini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali suhupiɛlli sani, m mi daa bi mali suhupiɛlli; a daa chɛ ka n ʒila n ko, dama a daa chɛ ka n suhu miligi pam.
en: I didnt join the festive occasions; I took no delight in them. I sat alone because your hand was upon me and you had filled me with curses.

dag: Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Aduna zuɣu hal ka o ti bɔr ni o ku o, amaa ka n daa lan suhi Naawuni Aduna gba zuɣu di saha maa.
en: But the LORD was furious with Aaron—he was going to wipe him out! So I also prayed hard for Aaron at that time.

dag: ka kpihim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbaani mɔpila zuɣu n-jɛmdi wuntaŋ mini goli ni saŋmarisi la ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbaani pɔri Yawɛ, amaa ka lan pɔri buɣili Milikom ŋɔ.
en: those bowing down to the forces of heaven on the rooftops, those swearing by the LORD along with those swearing by Milcom.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa vuɣi li ni suhuyiɣisili n-daai li luhi tiŋa. Ka wulimpuhili polo pɔhim daa ʒe li ka di kuui. Ka di wala zaa daa suui, ka di mundili din mali yaa la daa kuui, ka buɣim di li.
en: But the vine was pulled up by the roots, and thrown down to the ground. The hot east wind blew and dried its fruit. The strong branches broke, and they were thrown into the fire.

dag: O larila dabiɛm, o bi zɔri dabiɛm, o bi tiriti gbini takɔbi zuɣu.
en: laughs at fear, unafraid. He doesnt turn away from the sword.

dag: Naa daa chɛ ka anzinfa kul yɛrigila Jɛrusalɛm kaman kuɣa la, ka chɛ ka sida dari gba yɛrigi nimaani kaman Shɛfɛla sinsabisi la.
en: In Jerusalem, the king made silver as common as stones and cedar as plentiful as sycamore trees that grow in the foothills.

dag: N kul ni be yi sani chana, ka nyɛ yi Naawuni, ka yi nyɛ n niriba.
en: I will be with you; I will be your God, and you will be my people.

dag: Dinzuɣu di chɛliya ka so zaŋ salinim ni ni tooi niŋ shɛli nyuri bara, dama binshɛɣukam nyɛla yi dini.
en: So there is not a person on earth that any of you should be boasting about. Everything is yours:.

dag: Ka o ni yɛli shɛm maa min anabinim yɛligu doli taba kaman di ni sab yɛli shɛm la:.
en: The prophets words agree with this; as it is written.

dag: Bɛnkam doli Naawuni Shia Kasi ni wuhiri ba so shɛli, bɛna n-nyɛ Naawuni bihi.
en: The true children of God are those who let Gods Spirit lead them.

dag: Naa Hɛzɛkia tuumba maa ni daa paai Aizaia sani.
en: King Hezekiahs officers went to Isaiah.

dag: Ka Ɛliakim daa nyɛ Milia bia, ka Milia nyɛ Mɛna bia, ka Mɛna nyɛ Matata bia, ka Matata nyɛ Neetan bia, ka Neetan mi nyɛ Naa Dauda bia.
en: Melea, Menna, Mattatha, Nathan, David.

dag: O ni daa karindi litaafi shɛli maa daa sabi yɛlila ŋ-ŋɔ: Bɛ daa zaŋ o mi tahi kaman bɛ ni tahiri piɛɣu o kɔrigibu shee shɛm la bee kaman bɛ ni chɛri piɛbil so kɔbiri, ka o bi yaar o nol la.
en: The passage of scripture which he was reading was this: He was like a sheep that is taken to be slaughtered, like a lamb that makes no sound when its wool is cut off. He did not say a word.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa labi kuli maa kalinli daa nyɛla tuhi pihinahinaayi ni kɔbisita ni pihiyɔbu.
en: There were , who returned, in addition to , servants and musicians, both women and men. They brought with them horses, mules, camels, and , donkeys.

dag: Ka Rut yɛli, N ni niŋ a ni yɛl shɛlikam maa zaa.
en: Ruth replied to her, Ill do everything you are telling me.

dag: Laɣimmiya tab na. Yinim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim zaa, vumiya mirina. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn buɣiri bɛ wuna din nyɛ dari ginda, ka jɛmdi wuna din ku tooi tiligi ba la nyɛla bɛn be ʒilinsi ni.
en: to every survivor from every nation: Gather around me! Learn how senseless it is to worship wooden idols or pray to helpless gods.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Doli yɛlimaŋli soli ka tummi din tuhi, dama di ku yuui ka n tiligi ya.
en: The Lord says to his people, Do what is just and right, for soon I will save you.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋun lo paɣ so bɛ ni zaŋ ti o amiliya niŋ din viɛla, amaa ŋun bi lo amiliya n-nyɛ ŋun niŋ din so.
en: It is perfectly all right to marry, but it is better not to get married at all.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ, bahigu maa ʒila a zuɣu, ka n ni yiɣisi n suhu pam bahi a zuɣu. N ni kar a saria kaman a tuma ni nyɛ shɛm. N ni darig a tibili a ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa zaa zuɣu.
en: Israel, the end has come. You will feel my anger, because I am judging you for what you have done. I will pay you back for all your disgusting conduct.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyamiya, zaɣ biɛɣu kul lurila zuliya, zuliya zuɣu kanna, ka sanʒiɛ titali yiɣisi dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛŋa polo katiŋ na.
en: The LORD of heavenly forces proclaims: Look! Disaster travels from nation to nation. A terrible storm comes from the far ends of the earth.

dag: Kulla di saha maa ka niriba ata daa yi Siizaria paai yil shɛli n ni daa be maa na. Bɛ daa tim ba la n sanna.
en: At that moment three men who had been sent to me from Caesarea arrived at the house where we were staying.

dag: Dɔdai ŋun daa nyɛ Aho nir la n-daa su bɛ ni daa lan pirigi ninvuɣ shɛb la fukumsi gol so ŋun pahi ayi ni. Mikilɔt n daa su o yaɣili fukumsi. Ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanahi ka o daa su.
en: In charge of the division for the second month was Dodai the Ahohite. His division numbered .

dag: Di ku ba, a yi niŋ lala, n niriba maa ni ti tam, amaa nyin ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ ti nyɔtaɣirigu ŋɔ, zaŋm a kpiɔŋ wurim ba, ka bɛ lu.
en: Dont just kill them, or my people might forget. My Lord and Protector, scatter and defeat them with your strength.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Di saha ka niriba maa zaa daa yɛli, Ami! Paɣimiya Yawɛ.
en: Praise the Lord , the God of Israel! Praise him now and forever! Then all the people said, Amen, and praised the Lord .

dag: Duuma yino m-beni, amaa ka o tuma soya lee nyɛ balibubalibu.
en: There are different ways to serve the same Lord.

dag: Yawɛ, bɔhim ba biɛri, bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi tum tuun shɛŋa zaa zuɣu.
en: Punish them for what they have done, O Lord ;.

dag: Ka n daa wum ka bɛ boli kalima maa yuli, Kalima din wari ginda.
en: It was these wheels that were called the wheels in my hearing.

dag: Ka n daa tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli kaman o ni daa yɛli ma shɛm maa. N ni daa tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa maa, yim ka vuri ti mɔni karikari, ka kɔba maa daa tuɣi taba, ka kɔbili kam daa chaŋ ti tuɣi di kpee.
en: So I prophesied as I had been told. While I was speaking, I heard a rattling noise, and the bones began to join together.

dag: Ka yi mi din na taɣi di niŋbu zali. Dina n-nyɛ ni di chɛ ka Zaliguzaɣisira la ti yi zahira o saha dɛde.
en: And you know what is stopping that Man of Evil now. He is being stopped now so that he will appear at the right time.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba daa dim salo maa tiba ni yɛli ni bɛ yɛlim o ni o yihimila Barabas bahi ka ku Yisa.
en: But the chief priests and the leaders convinced the crowds to ask for Barabbas to be set free and for Jesus to be killed.

dag: Pɛriʒianim mini Itiɔpianim ni Putinim be bɛ sani. Bɛ zaa gbibila nyɔtaɣiri bihi, ka pili kuriti zuɣupila.
en: Persia, Cush, and Put are with you, all of them equipped with shield and helmet.

dag: Ka naa mini Haman daa chaŋ ni bɛ mini Ɛsta ti laɣim di.
en: So the king and Haman went to eat with Queen Esther.

dag: O ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa din nyɛ o ni daa tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa Yawɛ san la zuɣu, ka o daa kpi lala maa. O daa dolila Jɛrɔbɔam soli min o daalahichi shɛŋa o ni daa tum n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la soli.
en: This happened because of the sins Zimri had committed by doing evil in the LORDs eyes and by walking in Jeroboams ways and the sin he had done by causing Israel to sin.

dag: Dama yi zaŋ yi nyɔri mini yi bɔɣusapima ni yi yila daai biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn ka yaa la zaa hal ti wurim ba kpɛhi yɔɣu katiŋa.
en: You push with your side and shoulder. You knock down all the weak sheep with your horns. You push until you have forced them away.

dag: ka di yi ti lan puhi situra maa ni bee bɛ ni bahi mi shɛŋa maa ni bee bɛ ni wuɣi tan shɛŋa maa ni bee bɛ ni zaŋ gbaŋ mali binshɛli maa ni yaha, di yɛligirimi maa, yin zaŋmiya dɔro maa ni be binshɛli ni maa nyo buɣim.
en: If it appears again in the cloth, the weaving, or any item of skin, it is starting to break out. You must burn the infected item with fire.

dag: Amaa ka o yi bi bɔr ni o yo puu maa zuɣu ka dee li bee o yi pun zaŋla puu maa kɔhi so zuɣu, o ku lan tooi yo di zuɣu ka dee li yaha.
en: If you dont buy the field back and the land is sold to someone else, you cannot get the land back.

dag: Salima min anzinfa nɛma zaa kalinli daa nyɛla tusaanu ni kɔbisinahi. Ka Shɛshibaza daa zaŋ dimbɔŋɔ zaa yi Babilɔn kuli Jɛrusalɛm saha shɛli bɛ ni daa yi tinduli n-labi kuni la.
en: The total of the gold and silver objects numbered five thousand four hundred. Sheshbazzar brought up all of these when the exiles went up from Babylonia to Jerusalem.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, n daa dihirila Yɛhudianim mini zuɣulaannim ninvuɣ kɔbiga ni pihinu m-pahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa yi tinzun tinsi din gili ti ni n-ka ti sanna.
en: I usually fed of our own Jewish people and their leaders, as well as foreign visitors from surrounding lands.

dag: Yuun shɛli din pahiri yuma ayopɔin goli dahin yini dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: In the eleventh year of exile, on the first day of the month, the word of the Lord came to me. He said.

dag: Ka ti Duuma yiko daa be bɛ sani, ka niriba pam daa niŋ yɛda ŋ-ŋmaligi jɛmdi ti Duuma.
en: The Lord was helping these men, and a large number of people believed and decided to follow the Lord.

dag: Amaa a ni yɛli, Naawuni daa ŋmahila tiwula maa bahi ni di chɛ ka o zaŋ ma tuɣi.
en: But you will say, Yes, but the branches were broken off to make room for me.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ poya yɛli, Biɛhiŋ kani, n ni chɛ ka tɔbbihi pali a ni kaman tol la. Bɛ ni ti ŋme nasara dibu kuŋa m-bah a zuɣu.
en: The Lord Almighty has sworn by his own life that he will bring many men to attack Babylonia like a swarm of locusts, and they will shout with victory.

dag: Pilanim maa zaɣ yini kam wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita anii, ka di barilim nyɛ mita anu ni biɛla; di daa nyɛla zaɣ yɔri, ka di tibisim nyɛ milimita pisopɔinnaanu.
en: Each of the bronze pillars was feet tall. Each pillar was almost feet around. Each pillar was hollow. The wall of each pillar was inches thick.

dag: Dama n daa doli Yawɛ zaligunima, ka daa bi tum ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma ŋ-ŋmaligi ka chɛ ŋuna ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni maa.
en: I have obeyed the law of the Lord ; I have not turned away from my God.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti zaŋ ya leei zuɣu, ka pa ni zuli, ka chɛ ka yi kul chani tooni ka ku lab nyaaŋa, yi yi doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa n ni zaŋ tiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka tumdi di ni wuhi shɛm viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: The Lord your God will make you the leader among the nations and not a follower; you will always prosper and never fail if you obey faithfully all his commands that I am giving you today.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini tɔbbihi maa zaa daa yiɣisi ni bɛ chaŋ Ai, ka Jɔshua daa pii tɔbutuhiri biinsi tuhi pihita n-chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ Ai yuŋ.
en: So Joshua and the whole army got ready to go up to Ai. Joshua chose thirty thousand brave soldiers. He sent them out by night.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ti yɛli Ibram, Yim a ya ŋɔ min a ba yiŋa ni a dɔɣiriba ŋɔ sani n-chaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni n ni yɛn wuh a.
en: The Lord said to Abram, Leave your country and your people. Leave your fathers family and go to the country that I will show you.

dag: So di ti zaŋ o nuu shih o, amaa bɛ ti labim o kuɣa ku o bee n-to o piɛma ku o. Biŋkɔbigu bee ninsala yi ti shihi li, bɛn kum o. Ka kikaa yi ti kum pam, di saha bɛn dum zoli maa zuɣu na.
en: either with stones or arrows, and no one must touch the body of the person being put to death in this way. Even an animal that touches this mountain must be put to death. You may go up the mountain only after a signal is given on the trumpet.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yiɣis o suhu bahi Reechɛl zuɣu pam, ka bɔh o, Mani n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun ŋar a dɔɣim soli.
en: Jacob became angry with Rachel and said, I am not God. He is the one who has caused you to not have children.

dag: Asirianim yi ti wum Yawɛ kukoli, ka nya o ni darigi bɛ tibili shɛm, bɛ ni tarigi.
en: Assyria will be frightened by the Lord s voice and the stick that will beat him.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, m mi ni lala n-nyɛ li, Amaa wula ka ninsal lee yɛn tooi nyɛ ŋun ka taali Naawuni tooni?.
en: Of course, I know that this is true. But how can a human being win an argument with God?.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Pumpɔŋɔ n ni labisi Yaakubu zuliya daazichi ti ba, ka zo Izraɛlnim zaa nambɔɣu. Ka n ni ti zabi nyuli n yuli din be kasi ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Now I will show mercy to the people of Israel and bring them back from the nations where they are living. They are Jacob's descendants, so I will bless them and show that I am holy.

dag: O maari suhugarigunim suhuri, ka tibiri bɛ dansi.
en: He heals their broken hearts and bandages their wounds.

dag: Nanima, wummiya! Zuɣulaannima, wummiya! N ni yili yila niɣim n kukoli paɣi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Listen, you kings! Pay attention, you rulers! I will sing and play music to Israel's God, the Lord .

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Dofika maa n-chaŋ ti dɔni Alushi.
en: and after that at Alush.

dag: Pɛriʒianim mini Itiɔpianim ni Putinim be bɛ sani. Bɛ zaa gbibila nyɔtaɣiri bihi, ka pili kuriti zuɣupila.
en: Troops from Persia, Ethiopia, and Libya are with him, and all have shields and helmets.

dag: Ti Duuma yɛli n Duuma, Ʒinimi n nudirigu polo hal ka n ti nyaŋ a dimnim ti a, ka a du n-tam bɛ zuɣu.
en: The Lord said to my lord, Sit at my right side until I turn your enemies into your footstool?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan pii fɔntinsi pia Ifriim mini Dan ni Manaasa zuliya niriba pirigili la tiŋgbana ni ti Kɔhat daŋ niriba bɛn kpalim la.
en: The other Kohath families were given ten towns in the areas that belonged to Ephraim, Dan, and half of Manasseh.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa ti yɛl taba, Kamiyana ka ti ŋma bilichiisi n-nyo li buɣim viɛnyɛliŋga. Ka bɛ daa ŋma bilichiisi maa ka di be kaman kuɣa la, ka zaŋ kootaali mi n-leei tandi.
en: Then they said to each other, Lets make some bricks of clay and bake them in the fire. Then they used these bricks as stones, and they used tar as mortar.

dag: N daa bi bɔhim yɛm bee m-mi ŋun be kasi ŋɔ ni nyɛ so.
en: I have never learned any wisdom, and I know nothing at all about God.

dag: Bɛ daa kpaŋsi n suhu kaman bɛ ni daa kpaŋsi yi gba suhuri shɛm; ka bɛn niŋdi lala maa simdi paɣibu.
en: and have cheered me up, just as they cheered you up. Such men as these deserve notice.

dag: Ka o daa kari doli Abinɛr, o ni daa kariti dol o maa, o daa kul sula o gbini ka bi ŋmaligi kpa o nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo.
en: Asahel went after Abner, staying completely focused in his pursuit of Abner.

dag: Ka nyin Bɛlishaaza ŋun nyɛ o bia ŋɔ mi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yɛla, amaa ka bi siɣis amaŋa.
en: But you, his son, have not humbled yourself, even though you knew all this.

dag: Maliya kpiɔŋ mini suhukpeeni pam, di zɔriya dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka yi suhuri zɔhiri bɛ zuɣu, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni be yi sani; o ku chɛ ka yi kɔŋ nasara bee n-chɛn ya bahi.
en: Be determined and confident. Do not be afraid of them. Your God, the Lord himself, will be with you. He will not fail you or abandon you.

dag: Amaa ka Yɛhudianim daa bi saɣi lala, dina n-daa chɛ ka di kpama talahi ni n yɛli ni n ni zaŋ yɛtɔɣa maa ka Naa Siiza sanna. Di mi pala n kamina ni n ti fiɣisi mmaŋmaŋ zuliya.
en: But when the Jews opposed this, I was forced to appeal to the Emperor, even though I had no accusation to make against my own people.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa maa daa yɛli Jɛhɔshafat, N di pun bi yɛl a ni o bi yɛn yɛli zaɣ viɛlli zaŋ chaŋ m polo naɣila zaɣ biɛɣu kɔŋko.
en: Then Israels king said to Jehoshaphat, Didnt I tell you? He never prophesies anything good about me, only bad.

dag: yi ma ni ti di vi pam, ka ŋun daa dɔɣi ya ti nya filiŋ. Nyama, o ni ti be zuliya kam nyaaŋa. O ni ti bemi kaman tiŋgban nɛli din kuui ka kom ka di ni la.
en: Now your mother will be very ashamed. The woman who gave you birth will be embarrassed. Babylon will be the least important of all the nations. She will be an empty, dry desert.

dag: Di saha ka o nyaandoliba maa ŋmaligi yuuni taba, ka bi baŋ o ni yɛri bɛ ni so maa ni nyɛ so.
en: They were confused about what he meant. And they just stared at each other.

dag: Naawuni Bia maa zuɣu ka Naawuni daa zaŋ binshɛɣukam labisi omaŋmaŋ sani. Naawuni deeri sandaani la o Bia maa ʒim din daa yi dapulli zuɣu la zuɣu, ka zaŋdi binshɛɣukam din be dunia ŋɔ ni mini din be alizanda ni n-labisiri omaŋmaŋ sani.
en: And through him, God was happy to bring all things back to himself again— things on earth and things in heaven. God made peace by using the blood sacrifice of his Son on the cross.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Risa maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Kɛhɛlata.
en: They left Rissah and camped at Kehelathah.

dag: Ka tibimiya barinima, ka neemiya kpiimba, ka chɛliya ka kɔnsi kpaŋda, ka karimiya alizin biɛri bahira. Yi dee li la yoli, yi gba timiya li yoli.
en: Heal the sick, raise the dead, cleanse those with skin diseases, and throw out demons. You received without having to pay. Therefore, give without demanding payment.

dag: Dama n doli Yawɛ zaligu; ka na ʒi m-birigi zaŋ chaŋ n Naawuni maa sani.
en: because I have kept the LORDs ways. I havent acted wickedly against my God.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi chaŋ zoya ni tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni nti paai Ɛshikol Vinvamli ni m-puɣisi chaŋ ti kaai li.
en: They explored the hill country as far as Bunch Valley.

dag: Di saha ka Mikaya daa yɛli, Dinzuɣu wummiya Yawɛ yɛligu: N nya Naawuni ni ʒi o nam ʒiishee, ka malaikanim zaa ʒe o nudirigu min o nuzaa polo.
en: Micaiah went on: Now listen to what the Lord says! I saw the Lord sitting on his throne in heaven, with all his angels standing beside him.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔzuɣu? Tuumbiɛ bɔ ka o lee tum? Ka bɛ maan mɔhi vuri pam yɛli, Kpahim o tabili dapulli zuɣu.
en: But Pilate asked, What crime has he committed? Then they started shouting at the top of their voices: Crucify him.

dag: Ka malaikanima ayopɔin bɛn mal alɔbo balibu ayopɔin la daa yi jɛmbu duu maa ni na. Bɛ daa yɛla binyɛra din paligi paratɛte kaman gol la, ka zaŋ salima nyolɔra lo bɛ nyɔri.
en: The seven angels who had the seven plagues came out of the temple, dressed in clean shining linen and with gold bands tied around their chests.

dag: amaa ka yipa kahigi wuhi palɔni pumpɔŋɔ la. Yɛlimaŋli maa kahigi wuhila palɔni pumpɔŋɔ anabinim sabbu puuni, ka Naawuni ŋun nyɛ saha din ka bahigu lan ŋɔ chɛ ka zuliya kam zaa baŋ li ni di chɛ ka niriba niŋ yɛda ka deeg o noli.
en: Now that secret is revealed through what the prophets wrote. It is made known to the Gentiles in order to lead to their faithful obedience based on the command of the eternal God.

dag: N yuri Yawɛ, dama o wumdi n ni yɛri shɛm; ka deeri n suhigu shɛli n ni suhir o ni o zo ma nambɔɣu ŋɔ.
en: I love the LORD because he hears my requests for mercy.

dag: ka yɛli Ɛfurɔn niriba maa zaa ninni, Amaa a yi di saɣi n naan yo a palo maa liɣiri. Saɣimi dee li, ka n zaŋ n kpim maa ti sɔɣi nimaani.
en: and said to Ephron, In front of these witnesses, I offer you the full price, so I can bury my wife. Please accept my offer.

dag: Kpiimba biɛhigu shee mihi daa vili ma gbibi, ka kum zana daa do n tooni.
en: The ropes of the grave wrapped around me. Death set its trap right there in front of me.

dag: Ka Ɛzra daa yɛli, A kɔŋko n-nyɛ Yawɛ; nyini n-nam zuɣusaa mini zuɣusaa ha ni di tɔbbihi. Nyini n-nam tiŋgbani mini binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni; ka nam teeku ni binshɛɣukam zaa din be di ni. Nyini n-ti di zaa nyɛvili, ka zuɣusaa tɔbbihi zaa jɛmd a.
en: You alone are the Lord , Creator of the heavens and all the stars, Creator of the earth and those who live on it, Creator of the ocean and all its creatures. You are the source of life, praised by the stars that fill the heavens.

dag: Ti paɣiba mini ti bihi ni ti piɛri ni buhi ni ti niɣi zaa ni kpalim be Giliad tinsi maa ni.
en: Our wives, children, and all our animals will stay in the cities of Gilead.

dag: Sabimi n-ti Taiatira Cheechi malaika n-yɛl o ni Naawuni Bia ŋun nina ŋmani buɣim zilinli ka o napɔnvari nyɛlisiri kaman daanya viɛlli la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: To the angel of the church in Thyatira write: This is the message from the Son of God, whose eyes blaze like fire, whose feet shine like polished brass.

dag: Amaa ka Zimiri ŋun daa nyɛ o sapashin so ŋun su o chɛchɛbunsi pirigili fukumsi la daa lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ o polo. Dahin shɛli ka Naa Ɛla daa ti chaŋ Tiriza, do so ŋun yuli booni Ariza ka o su nayili fukumsi la yiŋa nti nyu dam kuli.
en: Zimri, one of his officers who was in charge of half of the king's chariots, plotted against him. One day in Tirzah, Elah was getting drunk in the home of Arza, who was in charge of the palace.

dag: O daa zaŋ bɛ tiŋgbana ti o niriba Izraɛlnima. O daa zaŋ li ti ba ni bɛ su li.
en: Then God handed their land over as an inheritance— as an inheritance to Israel, his own people.

dag: Ka Yisa daa boli ba na ti yɛli ba, Yi mi ni zuliya kam zuɣulaannim kuuni bɛ nam, ka wɔɣira mi wuhiri tarimba bɛ kpiɔŋ ni nyɛ shɛm;.
en: But Jesus called them over and said, You know that those who rule the Gentiles show off their authority over them and their high-ranking officials order them around.

dag: Ka Yisa daa chaŋ Matiu maa yiŋa n-daa ti ʒini ni o di bindirigu, ka farigudeeriba pam mini alahichinim kana nti ʒini pahi Yisa min o nyaandoliba zuɣu.
en: Later, Jesus and his disciples were having dinner at Matthew's house. Many tax collectors and other sinners were also there.

dag: ka ni be kasitali mini wuntitali ni o sani hal ni ti nyɛviya tariga.
en: by being holy and good as long as we live.

dag: Timiy o yuli din be kasi ŋɔ jilima, ka chɛ ka bɛnkam jɛmdi Yawɛ suhuri paligi.
en: Give praise to Gods holy name! Let the hearts of all those seeking the LORD rejoice!.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yɛli, So n-shiri shihi ma, dama m baŋya ni yiko shɛli yi n ni.
en: But Jesus answered, Someone touched me, because I felt power going out from me.

dag: Nir yi nyɛ faralana ka mali biɛri suŋ, di so jɛrigu ŋun ŋmari ʒiri.
en: It's better to be poor and live right than to be a stupid liar.

dag: Ka Ifriim zuliya niriba daa ti lo tɔbu chaŋ ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du n-chaŋ Zafɔn ti bɔhi Jɛfita, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a daa yɛn chaŋ ti tuhi Ammɔnnima, ka bi yɛl ti ka ti kana ti pahi yi zuɣu ka ti chaŋ? Ti ni niŋ buɣim nyo a yiŋa ka di di n-kab lu a zuɣu.
en: The men of Ephraim prepared for battle; they crossed the Jordan River to Zaphon and said to Jephthah, Why did you cross the border to fight the Ammonites without calling us to go with you? We'll burn the house down over your head.

dag: Di simdi ni yi doli bɛ ni kahigi zaligu maa wuhi shɛm bee bɛ ni ŋmaai yɛtɔɣa maa shɛm. Di ti ŋmaligiya kpa yi nudirigu polo bee yi nuzaa polo ka chɛ bɛ ni ŋmaai yɛtɔɣa maa shɛm tin ya.
en: You must accept their decision and follow their instructions exactly—dont change anything!.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ ni ti zaŋ buɣili maa maŋmaŋ kuli Asiria nti zaŋ li ti na titali, ka di leei bɛ farigu yɔbu o sani. Bɛ ni ti dihi Ifriimnim vi, ka vi ti gbahi Izraɛlnim bɛ buɣili maa zuɣu.
en: To Assyria it will be carried as a gift for the great king. Ephraim will be put to shame; Israel will be ashamed of his own idol.

dag: Tinima n-nyɛ o ni boli ninvuɣ shɛba, ka di pala Yɛhudianim kɔŋko, amaa bɛn pa Yɛhudianim gba.
en: We are the ones God has called. We dont come only from the Jews but we also come from the Gentiles.

dag: Dindali maa a ni ti yaag a noli tɔɣisi ŋun zo n-tiligi maa yɛtɔɣa, ka ku lan shini yaha. Dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka a ni leei shihirili bɛ sani, ka bɛ baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: That same day you will get back the power of speech which you had lost, and you will talk with them. In this way you will be a sign to the people, and they will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Ka Filistia tɔbbihi daa kul lɔri tɔbu na ti tuhiri ba, amaa bɛ daa yi kul lo tɔb na, Dauda n-tuhiri diri nasara gariti Sool sapashinnim maa zaa, ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka Dauda yuli du pam.
en: The Philistine commanders continued to go out to fight the Israelites, but David defeated them every time. He became famous as Sauls best officer.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Paɣa, bɔ n-niŋ ka a kumda? Ka o yɛli ba, Bɛ yihila n Duuma, ka m bi mi bɛ ni zaŋ o ti sɔŋ luɣ shɛli.
en: The angels asked her, Woman, why are you crying? She replied, They have taken away my Lord, and I dont know where theyve put him.

dag: O chɛ ka niriba lihi ʒiɛm ma, ka tuhiri nintɔri viɛri n ninni.
en: God has made my name a bad word to everyone. People spit in my face.

dag: ni Taanak naa ni Mɛgido naa.
en: the king of Taanach, the king of Megiddo.

dag: Bɛ ba n-daa wuhiri bɛ zaa bɛ ni yɛn ŋmɛri Yawɛ jɛmbu duu biŋkumda din daa nyɛ: guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisanim mini mɔɣilɔnim ni goonjɛnima Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni shɛm. Naa n-daa wuhiri Asaf mini Jɛdutun ni Hɛman bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛm.
en: All of his sons played cymbals and harps under their father's direction, to accompany the Temple worship. And Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman were under orders from the king.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yi be o tooni, dabiɛm m-mali ma, ka n yi tɛhi o yɛla, dabiɛm m-mali ma.
en: That is why I am terrified to stand before him. Just thinking about it makes me afraid.

dag: Gbilisimiya tibili viɛnyɛliŋga n-wum n yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, ka chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ yi ni yɛn zaŋ shɛli maai n suhu.
en: Listen to what I say. Let this be your way of comforting me.

dag: Joɛl n-daa nyɛ zuɣulana ka Shafam nyɛ ŋun pa o zuɣu, ka Janai mini Shafat mi doli bɛ nyaaŋa Bashan tiŋgbani maa ni.
en: Joel was the first leader in Bashan. Shapham was the second leader. Then Janai became the leader.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses.

dag: Ka Keen daa yi Yawɛ sani n-chaŋ ti be tiŋgban shɛli din be Idɛn puu la wulimpuhili polo, ka di yuli booni Nɔd la.
en: Cain left the LORDs presence, and he settled down in the land of Nod, east of Eden.

dag: Ka Jɔnadab daa yɛli naa, Nyama, nabihi maa kunna kaman mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni pun yɛl a shɛm la.
en: Jonadab said, Your Majesty, look! Here come your sons now, just as I told you.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ di zaa niŋ piɛ yin ni n-zaŋ di mini naɣilaa maa mini piɛlah ayi maa na.
en: Put them all in one basket and present them in the basket along with the bull and the two rams.

dag: Ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuumba kpɛm maa min o nyaaŋa daa chaŋ ti gbahi ba na; amaa bɛ daa bi lan gbahi ba ni kiŋkansi yaha, dama bɛ daa zɔrimi ni niriba ti lab ba kuɣa.
en: The captain and his men went out and brought the apostles back. But the soldiers did not use force, because they were afraid of the people. They were afraid the people would stone them to death.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋdi tulaale zim shɛli yiri Shiiba na maa buchi lee nyɛ dini n sani? Bee binnyoma din yi katiŋ na maa buchi lee nyɛ di ni n sani? N ku deei yi ni zaŋdi binshɛŋa nyɔri buɣim maani sara la. M mi nini bi lan tiɣi yi sara maligunima.
en: What use to me is incense from Sheba or sweet cane from a faraway land? Your entirely burned offerings wont buy your pardon; your sacrifices wont appease me.

dag: Amaa nyin pun kpahim baŋ n wuhibu mini m biɛhigu ni n ni lo shɛm m bebu ni ni n yɛda niŋbu yɛla zaŋ tabili n daania niŋbu ni n yurilim ni n ʒiɛyimtali.
en: Timothy, you know what I teach and how I live. You know what I want to do and what I believe. You have seen how patient and loving I am, and how in the past I put up with.

dag: Ka o daa nya ka ŋariŋ maa duhibu muɣisiri ba, dama bɛ daa tuhila pɔhim. Ka di daa ti niŋ kaman nolɔɣu kukol saha ka Yisa tam kom zuɣu chani bɛ sani nti niŋ ka o yɛn garila bɛ zuɣu la.
en: He saw his disciples struggling. They were trying to row forward, but the wind was blowing against them. Very early in the morning, he came to them, walking on the lake. He intended to pass by them.

dag: Ka a ni tɛhi tɛhi viɛl shɛŋa ka taɣ ma zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka m bi tum taali so ʒim yihibu puuni bee n-zaŋ mmaŋmaŋ nuhi ŋɔ bɔhi biɛri ŋɔ zuɣu, a mali alibarika.
en: God bless you for your good judgment. You kept me from killing innocent people today.

dag: Jokitan daŋ niriba n-daa nyɛ: Alimɔdad mini Shɛlɛf ni Hazarimavɛt ni Jɛra ni.
en: The descendants of Joktan were the people of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah.

dag: A mi ni lan zo ti nambɔɣu, a ni zaŋ ti daalahichi sɔŋ a naba ni no li. A ni zaŋ ti daalahichi zaa bahi teeku bulli ni.
en: He will come back and comfort us again. He will throw all our sins into the deep sea.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli, Mani m-bɔŋɔ; di pun sabi n yɛla Kundi ni.
en: So I said, Here I come! Im inscribed in the written scroll.

dag: Dabiɛm kpe Ziɔn alahichinim ka bɛ ni sɔhira. Ka bɛ yɛra, Naawuni saria karibo ŋmanila buɣim din diri sahakam. Ka ti ni ŋuni n-lee ni tooi tiligi buɣim maa ni.
en: Sinners became terrified in Zion; trembling seized the godless: Who among us can live with the devouring fire? Who among us can live with the everlasting blaze.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛri ya mi ni alahichilaan yino yi niŋ tuuba, suhupiɛlli pam ni be alizanda ni o zuɣu gari wuntizɔriba kɔbigayinika bɛn bi lan simdi ni bɛ niŋ tuuba la.
en: Jesus said, In the same way there is more happiness in heaven because of one sinner who turns to God than over good people who don't need to.

dag: ni tiŋgban ni pin suma mini di binshɛɣukam ni ŋun daa be tutuɣu din diri buɣim ŋɔ yurilim. Chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔnim siɣi Yisifu zuɣu na, ka chɛ ka di siɣi ŋun ŋun nyɛ nabia o mabihi sunsuuni ŋɔ ningbaɣu kɔbiri zuɣu na.
en: May their land be filled with all that is good, Blessed by the goodness of the Lord , Who spoke from the burning bush. May these blessings come to the tribe of Joseph, Because he was the leader among his brothers.

dag: Ka di daa moli gili Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa ni Naa Sool nyaŋla Filistianim tɔbbi shɛba ka di zuɣu chɛ ka Izraɛlnim leei Filistianim dimnima. Ka bɛ daa boli niriba maa ni bɛ yina nti pahi Sool zuɣu Giligal.
en: All the Israelites heard this news: Saul has killed the Philistine leader. Now the Philistines will really hate the Israelites! The Israelites were called to join Saul at Gilgal.

dag: ka yɛli Musa, Amaŋmaŋ tɔɣisim ti yɛtɔɣa ka ti wumda, amaa di lan chɛ ka Naawuni tɔɣisi ti yɛtɔɣa, di yi nyɛ lala ti ni kpi.
en: They said to Moses, You speak to us, and well listen. But dont let God speak to us, or well die.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Dauda daa kpe nti ʒini Yawɛ tooni ka yɛli, Yaa n Duuma NAAWUNI, m mi lee nyɛ ŋuni, ka n daŋ lee nyɛ dini, ka a ti zaŋ ma zali zaashee ŋɔ tatabo ni?.
en: Then King David went into the Tent of the Lord 's presence, sat down and prayed, Sovereign Lord , I am not worthy of what you have already done for me, nor is my family.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kpahi Yisa tabili dapulli maa zuɣu ka bɛ zaŋ o binyɛra pumpu n-sɔŋ tɔri tɛte ni bɛ nya bɛ zaa yinoyino ni yɛn di shɛli.
en: The soldiers nailed Jesus to a cross. Then they divided his clothes among themselves, throwing dice to see who would get what.
