dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa zaŋ o ni buɣisi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa mini di dubihi ni di nɛma ni yɛn zaani du shɛŋa ni ni di zuɣusaa duri ni di puuni duri ni Naawuni nambɔzɔbo kuɣ ni ti yɛn be du shɛl ni gbana ti Sulemaana.
en: Then David gave his son Solomon the plan for the entrance hall, its buildings, treasuries, upper and inner rooms, and the room for the cover.

dag: Ka bɛ daa bɔri ni o kpalim n-niŋ daba ayi bɛ sani, ka o daa bi saɣi.
en: They asked him to stay longer, but he declined.

dag: Bee di yi pa lala, nyin chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒi kpe ŋɔ wuhi bɛ ni daa nya ka jintɔriba la vihi ma n-nya n ni daa tum shɛli ka di bi tuhi.
en: Or ask the ones who are here. They can tell you that they didn't find me guilty of anything when I was tried by their own council.

dag: Ka Naa maa mi ni ti garigi yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi ni daa niŋdi m mabihi ŋɔ nirilim hal zaŋ tabili bɛ ni bɛn daa pɔri la, mani ka yi daa niŋdi maa.
en: Then the king will reply to them, I assure you that when you have done it for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you have done it for me.

dag: Gbaamiya yimaŋa ni laɣiyubo, ka chɛliya ka yi nini tiɣi yi ni mali shɛli, dama Naawuni yɛliya, N kul ku chɛ a, ka mi ku bah a.
en: Your way of life should be free from the love of money, and you should be content with what you have. After all, he has said, I will never leave you or abandon you .

dag: O daa mali bidibiga ka o yuli booni Sool, O daa nyɛla nachimbil viɛlli. Do so daa ka Izraɛl n-viɛl gar o; ka o daa lan wɔɣ gari sokam.
en: Kish had a son named Saul, who was a handsome young man. There was no one more handsome than Saul. He stood a head taller than any other man in Israel.

dag: O baŋsim puuni ka teeku daa yina, ka o daa chɛ ka saa yiri sagbana ni lurina.
en: His wisdom caused the rivers to flow and the clouds to give rain to the earth.

dag: O daa dolila solɔɣu m-miri paɣa maa lɔndo polo. O daa dolila soli chani o yiŋa.
en: He was walking through the marketplace and came to the corner where a certain woman lived. He then turned up the road that goes by her house.

dag: O zaŋd o naba kɔrisiri tiŋa ni yaa, o mali suhupiɛlli pam o yaa maa zuɣu, ka zɔri tuhiri bidibbina soli.
en: Before horses are ridden into battle, they paw at the ground, proud of their strength.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba ata maa daa kana ti paala salo, ka bɛ ni do so daa kana ti damdi Yisa tooni yɛli.
en: Jesus and the followers went back to the people. A man came to Jesus and bowed before him.

dag: Samarianim suhuri zɔhirimi Bɛtavɛn naɣibil la zuɣu. Di niriba ni ti kum naɣibil maa zuɣu. Ka di tindaannim la ti kum di zuɣu pam. Bɛ ni ti kum pam di ni kɔŋ jilima shɛl la zuɣu.
en: The inhabitants of Samaria shake because of the calf of Beth-aven. Its people will mourn over it, just as its idolatrous priests who rejoiced over its glory that is now gone.

dag: n-daa tim ba Iddo ŋun daa nyɛ Kasifiya fɔŋ zuɣulan la sani ka yɛli ba bɛ ni ti yɛn yɛli Iddo min o tab bɛn nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba Kasifiya shɛm. Dina n-nyɛ ni bɛ tim ti tumtumdiba na ka bɛ ti tum tuma ti Naawuni jɛmbu duu.
en: I sent them to Iddo, head of the community at Casiphia, to ask him and his associates, the Temple workers, to send us people to serve God in the Temple.

dag: Dundombil ni dunɔdali samban ni, duri daa beni din nyɛ baansi duri. Yini daa bela nuzaa polo dunɔdali shee, ka di dunoli kpa nudirigu polo, ka zaɣ yini mi ʒe nudirigu polo dunɔdali shee, ka di dunoli kpa nuzaa polo.
en: Outside the inner gate there were two chambers in the inner courtyard. The one beside the north gate faced south, and the one beside the east gate faced north.

dag: min o ni daa lan ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali n-chɛ ka bɛ ʒim zo n-tiɛli Jɛrusalɛm la zuɣu ka Yawɛ daa bi chɛ bɛ taali.
en: and especially because of all the innocent people he had killed. The Lord could not forgive Manasseh for that.

dag: Ka a zaŋ firanki tulaale zim alali pahi kul yini kam zuɣu, ka yi ti zaŋ li pahi bɔrɔbɔro maa zuɣu nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ, ka di leei shɛhira.
en: Put some pure incense on each row, as a token food offering to the Lord to take the place of the bread.

dag: Ka o dii boli bɛ gba, ka bɛ chɛ bɛ ba Zɛbidii min o tumtumdiba ŋariŋ maa ni ka dol o.
en: Their father Zebedee and the men who worked for him were in the boat with the brothers. When Jesus saw the brothers, he told them to come. They left their father and followed Jesus.

dag: Hanna daa suhiri Naawuni la o suhu ni, amaa ka o naŋgbampiba lee damda, ka so daa bi wumd o kukoli. Dinzuɣu ka Ɛli daa tɛhi ni o nyula dam kuli.
en: She was praying silently; her lips were moving, but she made no sound. So Eli thought that she was drunk.

dag: Yawɛ, a kpuɣ a nuu zuɣusaa, amaa bɛ bi nya li. Chɛ ka bɛ baŋ a ni yur a niriba shɛm, ka chɛ ka bɛ di vi. Zaŋm a ni yɛn zaŋ buɣim shɛli wɔb a dimnim la wɔb ba.
en: Your enemies do not know that you will punish them. Lord , put them to shame and let them suffer; let them suffer the punishment you have prepared. Show them how much you love your people.

dag: Ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ zani dabari, ka lan ka buchi shɛli. Di saha ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. Dama a yɛliya, Nail nyɛla n ni su shɛli, mani n-daa gbi li.
en: until your land is a barren desert. Then you will know that I have done these things. You claimed that you made the Nile River and control it.

dag: Yawɛ ni gul a, a yibu min a lab kpe ni; pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: The Lord will protect you now and always wherever you go.

dag: Fiɛbiga mini zuɣu ni kpahibu nyɛla din tiri yɛm, amaa bɛ ni chɛ bi so bahi, dihirila o ma vi.
en: The rod and correction lead to wisdom, but children out of control shame their mothers.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa chaŋ Giliad mini Kadɛshi din be Hitinim tiŋgbɔŋ ni la nti yi nimaani chaŋ Dan n-yi Dan zaŋ goligi Sidɔn polo.
en: and on to Gilead and to Kadesh, in Hittite territory. Then they went to Dan, and from Dan they went west to Sidon.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ lan bɔh o yaha, Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ a? Dama ti bɔri ni ti ʒi a zilinli lab ti yɛli bɛn tim ti na. Nyin lee yɛliya ni a nyɛla ŋuni.
en: They asked, Who are you? We need to give an answer to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself.

dag: Nyama, n kpahi n nuhi bah a zuɣu a ni zaŋ zalinsi soya nya bun shɛŋa maa min a ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb a ni la zuɣu.
en: Now look! I will slam my hand down and stop you! I will punish you for cheating and killing people.

dag: Ka o daa wum binshɛŋa yɛla nimaani, ka di nyɛ ninsal ni ku tooi zaŋ shɛli n-niŋ yɛtɔɣa ni, ka lan nyɛ ninsal ni ku tooi zaŋ shɛli tɔɣisi.
en: But he was taken up into paradise, where he heard things too wonderful to tell.

dag: Ka Ribɛka tizɔdoo maa min o ma daa yɛli, Chɛ ka paɣisarili maa na kpalim be ti sani daba ayi kaman biɛɣu pia pahi ka naanyi chaŋ.
en: Her brother and mother said, Let the young woman stay with us not more than ten days, and after that she may go.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli Nuhu.
en: God spoke to Noah.

dag: Bɛ ku lan di jifa bee ŋ-ŋub nin shɛli din chihiri ŋubbu. Ka bɛ puuni bɛn kpalim ni leei n niriba, ka mali bɛ daŋ Juda zuliya puuni kaman Jɛbusinim la.
en: I will remove bloody food from his mouth and pieces of unclean food from between his teeth. He will be a survivor who belongs to our God. He will be like a chieftain in Judah; Ekron will be like a Jebusite.

dag: Nir yi ŋme o dabipaɣ bee o dabidoo nimbila ka di saɣim, ŋun chɛ ka dabili maa chaŋ yoli, o nimbil maa zuɣu.
en: If a man hits a slave in the eye, and the slave is blinded in that eye, then the slave will be allowed to go free. His eye is the payment for his freedom. This is the same for a man or a woman slave.

dag: Ka zuliya shɛb bɛn pa Yɛhudianim mali tahima o yuli zuɣu.
en: All people will hope in him. Isaiah :-.

dag: Naawuni tim a suhudoo! A zɔnim la zaa puhir a. Puhimi ti zɔnim la zaa ti ma.
en: Peace be with you. Your friends here greet you. Greet our friends there by name.

dag: Yawɛ sani ka n sɔɣi. Ka di chaŋ wula ka yi ti yɛri ma, Yiɣimi kaman nooŋa la n-chaŋ zoya zuɣu?.
en: I trust in the Lord for safety. How foolish of you to say to me, Fly away like a bird to the mountains.

dag: Ka ti daa kuhi niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ, ka Yawɛ daa wum ti kuhigu maa, ka nya ti wahala mini ti tuun kpɛma tumbu ni ti muɣisigu maa.
en: Then we cried out for help to the Lord , the God of our ancestors. He heard us and saw our suffering, hardship, and misery.

dag: N daa zaŋ tɔbbihi bɛn mali chɛchɛbunsi ni yuri n-kana ti ku ba. N daa ŋme ba luhi ka bɛ kɔŋ yiɣisibu. N daa pɔbisi ba mi bahi kaman bɛ ni pɔbisiri kpihiri firila mia buɣim shɛm la.
en: I sent an army to chase you with chariots and horses; now they lie dead, unable to move. They are like an oil lamp with the flame snuffed out.

dag: O gbib o yiŋnim viɛnyɛliŋga; o pala vinnyaɣilana.
en: She is vigilant over the activities of her household; she doesnt eat the food of laziness.

dag: Yuria paɣa Batishiiba ni daa wum ni o yidan kpiya, o daa kum o zuɣu.
en: When Uriahs wife heard that her husband Uriah was dead, she mourned for her husband.

dag: Bɛ daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa jɛndi Naawuni ka bɔhi, Naawuni ni tooi ti ti bindirigu tiŋgban nɛli ŋɔ ni?.
en: They spoke against God and said, Can God supply food in the desert?.

dag: Anabinim bee ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn baŋdi zahima gbinni yi ka yi sanna ti wuhi ya shihirili bee alahiziba tuun shɛli.
en: Prophets or interpreters of dreams may promise a miracle or a wonder.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sɔɣ o omaŋmaŋ ni daa chɛ ka bɛ chibi sil shɛli ka di be Dauda tiŋ la ni la puuni. Bɛ daa zaŋ o sɔŋla garibil zuɣu, ka daa chɛ ka tulaale duɣiriba zaŋ tulaale mih o, ka bɛ zaŋ o ti sɔɣi, ka mali buɣim titali sɔŋ ti o kuli maa jilima.
en: He was buried in the tomb he had prepared for himself in Davids City, and was laid on a bed filled with sweet spices and various kinds of perfume, with a huge fire made in his honor.

dag: O ni daa zaŋ liɣiri maa labisi ti o ma; ka o ma daa yihi di ni anzinfa kpila kɔbisiyi ti anzinfa doora, ka o daa zaŋ li mali anzinfa binnani. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ li zali Maika yiŋa.
en: Then he gave them back to his mother. She took two hundred of the pieces of silver and gave them to a metalworker, who made an idol, carving it from wood and covering it with the silver. It was placed in Micah's house.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila bɛ ni vuhi pɔhim shɛli bahi. Bɛ dabisa ŋmanila shilinshia din garita.
en: We are like a puff of wind; our days are like a passing shadow.

dag: Ka Naawuni yi zaŋ viɛlim ŋɔ tatabo ti mɔri din be mɔɣu ni zuŋɔ n-kaai biɛɣu ka buɣim diri li ŋɔ, di chaŋ wula ka o ku ti yinim situra? Laabira, yi yɛda shiri pɔra!.
en: God gives such beauty to everything that grows in the fields, even though it is here today and thrown into a fire tomorrow. Won't he do even more for you? You have such little faith!.

dag: n-yɛli, Man Yawɛ yɛliya ni a ni bi mɔŋ ma a bigaŋ ŋɔ zuɣu, n ni ŋmaligi po mmaŋa.
en: You were willing to offer your only son to the Lord , and so he makes you this solemn promise.

dag: Bɛ yɛri binyɛri shɛŋa bɛ ni zaŋ pa talima n-dooni bimbini kam gbini, ka nyuri wain shɛli bɛ ni deei bɛ sandiriba sani bɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu.
en: They lie down beside altars on clothes taken as security for loans. And they drink wine in my temple, wine bought with the money they received from fines.

dag: N sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tirila yinim bɛn zaa be Rom n-nyɛ Naawuni ni yuri shɛba ka boli ya ni yi leeg o ninvuɣ gahinda la: Ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka tin ya suhudoo!.
en: This letter is to all of you in Rome. God loves you, and he has chosen you to be his holy people. Grace and peace to you from God our Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Dama bɛ daa chɛ ka o suhu miligi, ka o yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din bi simdi.
en: They upset Moses, and he spoke without stopping to think.

dag: ka o chɛ ka di niŋ pali tinim bɛn nyɛ bɛ yaansi ŋɔ sani maa, dina n-nyɛ o ni daa neei Yisa kum ni kaman di ni sabi Yila litaafi puuni yil shɛli din pah ayi ni shɛm la, ni Naawuni yɛliya: A nyɛla m Bia; zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka n leeg a Ba.
en: We are their descendants, and God has made this promise come true for us. God did this by raising Jesus from death. We also read about this in Psalm : You are my Son. Today I have become your Father. Psalm :.

dag: Nyini n-daa zaŋ omaŋmaŋ piɛma to o tɔbbihi zuɣulana, bɛn daa kana kaman pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga ni bɛ ti wurim ti, ka bɛ pulaantali be kaman bɛn mali shili ni bɛ ku tarimba bɛn sɔɣi la.
en: Your arrows pierced the commander of his army when it came like a storm to scatter us, gloating like those who secretly oppress the poor.

dag: Tiŋgbɔn shɛli din niriba taari duŋ, di malila zuɣulaan bɔbigu, amaa zuɣulaan so ŋun mali yɛm yi dira, binshɛlikam niŋdila viɛnyɛliŋga yuui.
en: When a nation sins, it will have one ruler after another. But a nation will be strong and endure when it has intelligent, sensible leaders.

dag: Ka o daa pahi bɛ zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ. Ka bɛ daa paai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni nti gbaai dari maa ŋmabu.
en: So he went with them. They came to the Jordan River and began cutting down trees.

dag: Alahichilana yi tum alahichi bukɔbiga, ka kul be o nyɛvil ni yuui, m mi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔri Naawuni yɛla ni so, bɛ ni zɔr o maa zuɣu.
en: They commit hundreds of crimes and live a long time, in spite of the saying: Everyone who lives right and respects God will prosper.

dag: O bi paɣi wɔr so ŋun mali kpiɔŋ. O mi bi paɣi ninvuɣ so ŋun tooi zɔri pam.
en: War horses and powerful soldiers are not what he cares about.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim, maliya suhupiɛlli jilima puuni. Yilimiya suhupiɛlli yila yi bindɔhi zuɣu.
en: Let the faithful celebrate with glory; let them shout for joy on their beds.

dag: Di daa nyɛla Yawɛ ni yuri ya, ka gbib o ni daa po yi yaannim pɔri shɛl la zuɣu ka ŋun Yawɛ daa zaŋ o nuu din mali kpiɔŋ n yihi ya dabitim ni, ka fan ya Ijipti naa Firawuna nuu ni bahi maa.
en: But the Lord brought you out of Egypt with great power and made you free from slavery. He freed you from the control of Pharaoh, the king of Egypt. The Lord did this because he loves you and he wanted to keep the promise he made to your ancestors.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa mali ti paai Izraɛlnim sansan ni, ka Izraɛlnim maa daa yiɣisi lu bɛ zuɣu, ka Mɔabnim maa ŋmaligi guui, ka Izraɛlnim kari doli ba ŋ-ŋmɛri kuri ba chana.
en: But when they entered Israels camp, the Israelites rose up and attacked the Moabites. The Moabites fled from them. Israel moved forward, striking the Moabites down as they went.

dag: ni o yihi bɛ shihi gballi ni na, ka di chɛ ka bɛ lan nya nyɛvili neesim.
en: each one saves a person's life, and gives him the joy of living.

dag: Yiŋbia maa yiŋlan maa yi ti kuna nya o ni lala, o ni nya suhupiɛlli.
en: When the master comes and finds that servant doing the work he gave him, it will be a day of blessing for that servant.

dag: Daadam, zaŋm a nini kpa Gɔg ŋun be Magɔg tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka nyɛ Mɛshɛk mini Tubal nazuɣu ŋɔ polo tɔɣis anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛnd o.
en: Human one, face Gog in the land of Magog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal. Prophesy concerning him.

dag: Ka naa maa daa bɔhi ma, Yuma ala ka a yɛn niŋ nimaani, ka bɔ saha ka a yɛn labina? Di saha o paani daa ʒimi baɣ o. Ka di daa niŋ naa nyaɣisim ni o tim ma, ka n daa yɛl o n ni yɛn labina saha shɛli.
en: The king and the queen who was sitting next to him asked me, How long will your trip take? When will you get back here? The king was happy to send me, so I gave him a certain time.

dag: Naa, ka di yi luhi a sani pumpɔŋɔ, nyin bahim noli ka bɛ vihi Babilɔn nam litaafinim ni n-nya Naa Sairus daa shiri bahi noli ni bɛ lab me Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa zali Jɛrusalɛm, ka labisi a ni yu shɛm zaŋ chaŋ yɛlli maa polo zilinli ti ti na.
en: And now, if it seems good to the king, may a search be made in the royal archives in Babylon to see if King Cyrus had issued a decree to rebuild this house of God in Jerusalem. Then may the king be pleased to send us his decision about this matter.

dag: Yawɛ, a daa po pɔri n-lo Dauda alikauli, ka mi ku lan yi di nyaaŋa. A daa yɛliya, N ni ti zaŋ a bidibisi ni yino n-leei naa ʒil a nam ʒiishee.
en: The Lord made a promise to David, an oath of loyalty to him: I will always put one of your descendants on your throne.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ ni ti zaŋ buɣili maa maŋmaŋ kuli Asiria nti zaŋ li ti na titali, ka di leei bɛ farigu yɔbu o sani. Bɛ ni ti dihi Ifriimnim vi, ka vi ti gbahi Izraɛlnim bɛ buɣili maa zuɣu.
en: It was carried away as a gift to the great king of Assyria. He will keep Ephraims shameful idol. Israel will be ashamed of its idol.

dag: N kul ni puhir a sahakam, a ni tum shɛm zuɣu. N ni duh a yuli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim sani, dama a yuli maa viɛla.
en: I will always thank God for what he has done; I will praise his good name when his people meet.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka a yɛn chɛ ka Ijiptinim maa yɛli ni a daa lola a niriba maa zaɣ biɛɣu zuɣu ka a zaŋ ba chaŋ zoya ni ni a ti ku ba kpihim bɛ birili dunia yili? Yihim a suhuyiɣisili titali ŋɔ a suhu ni, ka chɛ a niriba ŋɔ zaɣ biɛɣu maa niŋbu.
en: Why should the Egyptians say, He had an evil plan to take the people out and kill them in the mountains and so wipe them off the earth? Calm down your fierce anger. Change your mind about doing terrible things to your own people.

dag: Di saha nir ni ti yi o mabia nyaaŋa n-chɛ ka bɛ ku o; ka doo ni ti yi o bia nyaaŋa n-chɛ ka bɛ ku o, ka bihi gba ti zaɣisi bɛ banim mini bɛ manima, ka zaŋ ba puhi kubu.
en: Brothers and sisters will hand each other over to death. A father will turn in his children. Children will rise up against their parents and have them executed.

dag: Ka dilan yi yɛl o, Chɛ ka ti zaŋ biŋkpam nyo buɣim pɔi, ka a naanyi ŋmaag a ni bɔri shɛm tariga. O yɛrimi, Aai, ŋmaam ti ma pumpɔŋɔ, di yi pa lala n ni zaŋ kiŋkansi ŋmaai li.
en: Usually the people answered, Take what you want. But first, let us sacrifice the fat to the Lord . No, the servant would reply. If you don't give it to me now, I'll take it by force.

dag: Naa Hɛzɛkia ni daa wum yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, o daa darigi toola o binyɛrigu, ka zaŋ buɣu ye n-chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu.
en: When King Hezekiah heard this, he ripped his clothes, covered himself with mourning clothes, and went to the LORDs temple.

dag: Amaa yinim ka la Ziɔn Zoli mini Naawuni ŋun nyɛ nyɛvililan ŋɔ tiŋ din nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm m-be alizanda ni la ni malaikanim bɛn ka kalinli suhupiɛlli laɣiŋgu ni na;.
en: But you have come to Mount Zion, to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem. You have come to a place where thousands of angels have gathered to celebrate.

dag: Wuntizɔra noli nyɛla nyɛvili kɔbilinini. Amaa duŋtaabo yɛtɔɣa m-be ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋun noli ni.
en: A good person's words are a fountain of life, but a wicked person's words hide a violent nature.

dag: Chamiya ti kum niŋ yi ni pii buɣ shɛŋa jɛmdi maa, ka bɛ fan ya bahi yi muɣisigu ŋɔ saha.
en: Go and cry out to the gods you have chosen. Let them rescue you when you get in trouble.

dag: Lɛbanɔn sipirɛs mini sida tihi malila suhupiɛlli naa maa lubu maa zuɣu, ka yɛra, Pumpɔŋɔ a ni lu ŋɔ, so ku lan ŋma ti luhi yaha. .
en: You were an evil king, and now you are finished. Even the pine trees are happy. The cedar trees of Lebanon rejoice. They say, The king chopped us down, but now the king has fallen, and he will never stand again.

dag: ka anzinfa pa ŋmana kpiŋkpama zuɣu, ka salima alali pa bɛ kɔbiri zuɣu. Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yi ni shɛb daa kpalim be yiŋ buzɔna ni?.
en: figures of doves covered with silver, whose wings glittered with fine gold.

dag: Hal bɛ ni daa dooi bini mali naɣibil zali ka daa yɛli, Yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya Ijipti na la m-bɔŋɔ! la, bɛ daa mo nyin Naawuni pam.
en: not even when they made an idol shaped like a calf and insulted you by claiming, This is the god who rescued us from Egypt.

dag: O ni ti tuhi sansana din mali kpiɔŋ o yaannim ni daa bi jɛm wun so la sɔŋsim zuɣu. O ni ti ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe wuni ŋɔ nyaaŋa jilima, ka zaŋ ba zali zaashe kara ni, ka pirigi paliti ti ba ka di leei bɛ laara.
en: With the help of this foreign god, he will capture the strongest fortresses. Everyone who worships this god will be put in a position of power and rewarded with wealth and land.

dag: Amaa ka Jɛhu daa lee bi doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ zaligu ni o suhu zaa. O daa bi chɛ Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la soli dolibu.
en: But Jehu wasnt careful to keep the LORD God of Israels Instruction with all his heart. He didnt deviate from the sins that Jeroboam had caused Israel to commit.

dag: Miriya ka yi di binshɛŋa din chihiri dibu.
en: Don't eat any disgusting animals.

dag: N daa dolila Vinvamli Dunɔdal la yi yuŋ chaŋ ti gari Wɔɣ Kurili kɔbilinini la shee n-chaŋ Saɣiri Dunɔdal la ni. N daa chanimi n-kaari ni n nya Jɛrusalɛm goma maa ni lunlu shɛm mini buɣim ni daa di n-saɣimsaɣim di dunɔdaya la shɛm.
en: I went through Valley Gate on the west, then south past Dragon Spring, before coming to Garbage Gate. As I rode along, I took a good look at the crumbled walls of the city and the gates that had been torn down and burned.

dag: Dauda daa bi kali ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi paai yuun pisi, dama Yawɛ daa lo alikauli ni o ni chɛ ka Izraɛlnim galisi kaman saŋmarisi bɛn be zuɣusaa ŋɔ.
en: When David decided to count the people of Israel, he gave orders not to count anyone under years of age, because the Lord had promised long ago that Israel would have as many people as there are stars in the sky.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun daa yi fari niriba, ŋun chɛli fabu maa ka tummila omaŋmaŋ nuu zuɣu tuma n-dihir omaŋa hal ka ni tooi sɔŋdi nandaamba.
en: If you are a thief, quit stealing. Be honest and work hard, so you will have something to give to people in need.

dag: O daa ŋahila ŋaha tusaata, ka o ni daa yili yil shɛŋa mi daa nyɛ tuhilinaanu.
en: He composed three thousand proverbs and more than a thousand songs.

dag: Lala niriba n-nyɛ bɛn jɛmd o, bɛna n-lan nyɛ bɛn jɛmdi Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: And thats how things are with the generation that seeks him— that seeks the face of Jacobs God. Selah.

dag: Kum zana n-daa kul gili ma; ka kpiimba biɛhigu shee dabiɛm gbaai ma; ka wahala mini suhusaɣiŋgu gbaai ma pam.
en: Deaths ropes bound me; the distress of the grave found me— I came face-to-face with trouble and grief.

dag: Amaa ŋun pa piɛgula ka mi bi su piɛri ka nyɛla bɛ ni bu so paa ka o guli ba yi ti nya kunduŋ ka o kanna, o chɛrila piɛri maa bahi ka zo, ka kunduŋ maa gbahi piɛri maa ni shɛba, ka wurim bɛn kpalim bahi.
en: The worker who is paid to keep the sheep is different from the shepherd. The paid worker does not own the sheep. So when he sees a wolf coming, he runs away and leaves the sheep alone. Then the wolf attacks the sheep and scatters them.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ di kɔhigu nɛma mini di liɣiri ti Yawɛ. Bɛ ti ku zaŋ di shɛli sɔŋ, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi Yawɛ nti yɛn zaŋ di liɣiri maa da bindira pam ni situr shɛŋa di ni simdi ni bɛ mali.
en: The money she earns by commerce will be dedicated to the Lord . She will not store it away, but those who worship the Lord will use her money to buy the food and the clothing they need.

dag: Bɛ chanimi gindi bɔri bindirigu. Ka bɛ yi bi nya n-di n-tiɣi, bɛ ŋumdimi.
en: They roam about for food, and if they dont get their fill, they stay all night.

dag: Ŋuna n-zaani wuntaŋa ka o bi nyeera, ŋuna n-chɛ ka saŋmarisi bi peera.
en: Who commands the sun, and it does not rise, even seals up the stars.

dag: amaa ka Hadad min o ba tumtumdiba shɛb bɛn daa nyɛ Ɛdomnim la shɛba daa tiligi n-zo n-kuli Ijipti.
en: While still a youth, Hadad escaped to Egypt along with his fathers Edomite officials.

dag: Ka doo maa daa gbibi binshɛli din buɣisiri la o nuu ni n-kpa wulimpuhili polo nti buɣisi mita kɔbisinu tariga, ka zaŋ ma siɣi kom maa ni, ka di ziliŋ nyɛ napɔŋkpuɣila tariga.
en: With his measuring rod the man measured yards downstream to the east and told me to wade through the stream there. The water came only to my ankles.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ti yab Ibrahimma ni amaa ŋun Naawuni ni ti darigi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ti yɛn zaŋ o zuliya leei daba maa tibili; di nyaaŋa ka chɛ ka o zuliya maa nya faako n-lab kpe na ti jɛm ŋun Naawuni.
en: And I will condemn the nation they serve as slaves, God said, and afterward they will leave that land and serve me in this place.

dag: Bɛ piɛma diri pam, bɛ tɔbiri gba guri viɛla. Bɛ yuri takarifiɛma ŋmanila pilima, ka bɛ chɛchɛbunsi kalima zɔri gindi yomyom kaman pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga la.
en: Their arrows are sharp, and their bows are ready. The hoofs of their horses are hard as flint; the wheels of their war chariots turn as fast as a whirlwind.

dag: A ni ti zaŋ n taali niŋ kpalaŋ ni lo li, ka a ti zaŋ bini limsi n tuumbiɛri.
en: you would put them in a bag, tie it tight, and toss them away.

dag: Di nyɛla talahi ni ŋun pahi, ka man filim.
en: He must increase and I must decrease.

dag: Naa Hiram daa pun zaŋla salima din tibisim gari kilɔgiram tusaanahi n-timna ti ti naa.
en: But Hiram sent the king one hundred twenty gold kikkars, nevertheless.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yi nimaani chaŋ Gujɔda n-daa ti yi nimaani chaŋ Jɔtibata tiŋgbɔn shɛli din kulibɔna mali kom la.
en: Then the Israelites went from Moserah to Gudgodah. And they went from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of rivers.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa paai Mahanaim. Ka Absalom mini Izraɛlnim zaa mi gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du.
en: David went to the town of Mahanaim, and Absalom crossed the Jordan River with the army of Israel.

dag: Dinzuɣu di pala ninsal yubu bee o ni niŋ shɛm zuɣu, amaa di nyɛla Naawuni nambɔzɔbo zuɣu.
en: So then, it doesnt depend on a persons desire or effort. It depends entirely on God, who shows mercy.

dag: Zɛdɛkia nam dibu yuun piniyini, gol so ŋun pahir anahi daba awɛi dali ka bɛ daa kabi Jɛrusalɛm goondaa luhi.
en: On the ninth day of the fourth month of Zedekiah's eleventh year as king, the city walls were broken through. .

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa ti kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi nya Iso ka o mini ninvuɣ kɔbisinahi kanna. Ka o daa pirigi bihi ti Liya mini Reechɛl ni dabipaɣiba ayi la.
en: Later that day Jacob met Esau coming with his men. So Jacob told his children to walk with their mothers.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan yɛli, Kom din be foliŋga tiŋli ŋɔ laɣimmi dɔni luɣ yini, ka chɛ ka tiŋgban kuŋ yi n-dɔni. Ka di daa shiri niŋ lala.
en: Then God commanded, Let the water below the sky come together in one place, so that the land will appear—and it was done.

dag: Bɛ ni daa laɣim maa ka bɛ yihi Yisa tuumba ayi maa na nti zali bɛ sunsuuni m-bɔhi ba, Ŋun yiko bee ŋun yuli ka yi lee zaŋ tum yi ni tum tuun shɛli ŋɔ.
en: They had Peter and John brought before them and asked, By what power or in what name did you do this.

dag: Ŋunkam tumdi Naawuni yubu, ŋuna n-nyɛ n tizo ni n tizɔpaɣa ni m ma.
en: Whoever does what God wants is my brother, my sister, my mother.

dag: Ka o ni ti yɛn bahi nyaŋ o dim so ŋun bahindi nyaaŋa nyɛla kum.
en: and the last enemy he destroys will be death.

dag: ka chɛ ka kahiŋkɔɣu doli nimaani yi. Kahiŋkɔɣu maa ni daa yiɣi yi, o daa kul yiɣirimi gindi hal ka kom maa ti nyuui.
en: He sent out a raven, and it flew back and forth until the waters over the entire earth had dried up.

dag: Sulemaana ŋaha shɛŋa din pahi m-bɔŋɔ, ka Juda naa Hɛzɛkia kpambaliba daa yaai li sabi sɔŋ.
en: These are also proverbs of Solomon, copied by the men of Hezekiah, king of Judah.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛlila taba, Zahin zahinda la n-kanna ŋɔ.
en: They said to each other, Here comes Joseph the dreamer.

dag: Ŋunkam mali yɛm, ŋun wummi dimbɔŋɔnim viɛnyɛliŋga, ka tɛhi Yawɛ yurilim maŋli ŋɔ yɛla.
en: Whoever is wise will remember these things and begin to understand the Lord s faithful love.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yɛli, So n-shiri shihi ma, dama m baŋya ni yiko shɛli yi n ni.
en: But Jesus said, Someone touched me, for I knew it when power went out of me.

dag: Jɛrusalɛmnima, yihimiya ninvuɣ biɛtali yi suhuri ni ka tiligi. Nia biɛri maa kul yɛn bela yi ni sahakam?.
en: Cleanse your heart of evil, Jerusalem, that you may be saved. How long will you entertain your destructive ideas?.

dag: Dinzuɣu bin ata ŋɔ m-beni, dina n-nyɛ: Yɛda mini tahima ni yurilim, ka din gari di zaa nyɛla yurilim.
en: Meanwhile these three remain: faith, hope, and love; and the greatest of these is love.

dag: Ninsalinim pihiri kuɣa sɔŋda ni bɛ baŋ din beni, amaa Yawɛ kɔŋko n-zaan o ni bɔri shɛli.
en: We make our own decisions, but the Lord alone determines what happens.

dag: N suhuyiɣisili pam puuni n ni ti bɔhi zuliya shɛb bɛn bi deei n noli biɛri.
en: Some nations will not listen to me, but I will show my anger and get my revenge.

dag: Teemiya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni pa yi bihi bɛn bi mi, ka bɛ nina mi bi nya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa la. Amaa yinima n-nyɛ bɛn ni wuh o galisim min o nuu din mali kpiɔŋ ni o ni daa teeg o bɔɣu shɛm.
en: Remember today what you have learned about the Lord through your experiences with him. It was you, not your children, who had these experiences. You saw the Lord 's greatness, his power, his might.

dag: Ka nimdi maa mini bɔrɔbɔro maa shɛli yi guui, yin zaŋmiya li nyo buɣim.
en: Burn what is left over.

dag: Yi yihi n niriba paɣiba bɛ yiya din viɛl ni, ka yihi n daalibarika bɛ bihi ni sahakam.
en: You drive the women of my people out of the homes they love, and you have robbed their children of my blessings forever.

dag: Nanim ŋɔ zaa daa naala noli n-laɣim bɛ tɔbbihi ti do Siddim vinvamli ni luɣ shɛli bɛ ni booni Teeku Kpiŋ pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: King Chedorlaomer and his allies had ruled these last five kings for twelve years, but in the thirteenth year the kings rebelled and joined forces in Siddim Valley, which is now covered by the southern part of the Dead Sea.

dag: Ka o ni daa zaŋ yaɣiri mɛri duɣ shɛli maa daa saɣim o nuu ni, ka o daa zaŋ li taɣi me o ni daa nya ka duɣ shɛli viɛl o sani.
en: But the piece he was making was flawed while still in his hands, so the potter started on another, as seemed best to him.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yoli, di chɛliya ka yi suhuri piɛli yi ni nyaŋ alizin biɛri maa zuɣu; amaa chɛliya ka yi suhuri piɛlila yi yuya ni sab alizanda ni la zuɣu.
en: But don't be happy because evil spirits obey you. Be happy that your names are written in heaven!.

dag: Nyini n-yɛn su n yili ŋɔ fukumsi, ka a yi kul yɛli shɛlikam, n niriba zaa ni niŋ li; kulla n nam ʒiishee ŋɔ ka n yɛn zaŋ gar a.
en: I will put you in charge of my country, and all my people will obey your orders. Your authority will be second only to mine.

dag: Biɛɣu ti yɛn neei ka zibisim zo la, n yura, nyin ŋmaligim niŋ kaman molifu bee saŋkpaliŋ la n-zo n-yi Bɛtɛr zoya zuɣu na.
en: Pretend to be a young deer dancing on mountain slopes until daylight comes and shadows fade away.

dag: ni salima alali firila tamdisi din diba anu daa ʒe Luɣ Kasi shee tooni nudirigu polo, ka diba anu mi ʒe di nuzaa polo la ni tipuma kɔtomsi ni firilanim ni salima gbabɔnima.
en: the ten lampstands that stood in front of the Most Holy Place, five on the south side and five on the north; the flowers, lamps, and tongs;.

dag: Puhimiya n churi siɣimsiɣim buta yuuni puuni.
en: You will have three special festivals each year. You must come to my special place to worship me during these festivals.

dag: Amaa di ŋmɛriya tab naŋgbankpeeni, so mi di galim o kpee. Yinim maligumaaniba ŋɔ ka n galim.
en: Don't accuse just anyone! Not everyone is at fault. My case is against you, the priests.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛn ti bɛ suɣa pa bɛ zuɣu n-nyɛ Asha zuliya. Asha niriba maa toondana n-yɛn nyɛ Okiran bia Pagiɛl.
en: On one side of Dan will be the tribe of Asher, with Pagiel son of Ochran as the leader of its , troops.

dag: Yaakubu bidibisi, Laɣimmiya na ti wum. Wummiya yi ba Izraɛl ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm.
en: Children of Jacob, gather around. Come listen to Israel, your father.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka galimi, ka tumdi din tuhi, ka tɔɣisiri yɛlimaŋli ka di yiri bɛ suhuri ni na.
en: The person who lives free of blame, does what is right, and speaks the truth sincerely.

dag: Amalɛknima m-be Nɛgɛb tiŋgbɔŋ ni; ka Hitinim mini Jɛbusinim ni Amɔrinim be zoya ni tinsi ni; ka Keenannim mi ʒi m-baɣi teeku mini Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili.
en: The Amalekites live in the Negev. The Hittites, Jebusites, and Amorites live in the hill country. The Canaanites live near the sea and by the Jordan River.

dag: Dindina a ni bi saɣi Naawuni ni niŋ shɛli zuɣu, a tɛhiya ni a ni tooi chɛ ka o niŋ a ni bɔri shɛli? Nyini n-ni pii, pa mani, dinzuɣu yɛlim a ni mi shɛli.
en: Do you make the rules, or does God? You have to decide— I can't do it for you; now make up your mind.

dag: Dama ti yi niŋ yɛda ni Yisa daa kpiya ka lan neei yaha, ti lan niŋ yɛda ni ti Duuma Naawuni ni ti chɛ ka bɛn gbihiri kum ni la ti doli ti Duuma Yisa labina.
en: Since we believe that Jesus died and rose, so we also believe that God will bring with him those who have died in Jesus.

dag: Dama o ni na pɔri maa zuɣu ninvuɣ shɛba n-ni yuun o, ka maan o yɛla tir o hal ti paag o ba ni zali dabisi shɛli dali.
en: However, they are placed under trustees and guardians until the date set by the parents.

dag: Di saha ka maligumaana ti zaŋ o nubil tim alahichi sanyoo maligu ʒim maa ni n-zaŋ li ti vie binyila din be bɛ ni nyɔri sara maligu buɣim sara maligu bimbin shɛli zuɣu la, ka kpaai ʒi shɛli din kpalim bahi sara maligu bimbini maa naba zaashee.
en: The priest will dip a finger in the blood, smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar, and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.

dag: Ka Hɛzɛkia garigi yɛl o, Di bi to ni mahim chaŋ tooni polo napɔŋ ŋmɛbu pia, dinzuɣu chɛ ka di labila nyaaŋa polo napɔŋ ŋmɛbu pia.
en: Hezekiah answered, It's easy to have the shadow go forward ten steps! Have it go back ten steps.

dag: Di saha maa ha Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni binyara zaŋ kɔhi tab zuɣu bee n-zaŋ taɣi tab yɛla ŋmaabu kali daa yi nyɛla ŋun kɔhiri pirig o namdili ti ŋun dara, lala ka Izraɛlnim daa yi niŋdi ŋmaari yɛla.
en: Then he gave Boaz something to show that he was serious. During that time in Israel, when people bought property, one person took off a sandal and gave it to the other person. This was like signing an agreement.

dag: Ka Sool daa nya Dauda ni diri nasara shɛm maa ka dabiɛm maan gbaag o pam pahi.
en: Saul saw that he was very successful, and he was afraid of him.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ kpiɔŋ hal ti liri la zuɣusaa tɔbbihi, bɛna n-nyɛ saŋmarisi n-daa vooi bɛ shɛb bahi tiŋ na n-du tam bɛ zuɣu nɔra.
en: The little horn became very big. It grew until it reached the sky. It even threw some of heavens army to the ground and trampled them.

dag: Niŋm yomyom zo nti kpe di ni, dama ka pa ni a paala nimaani, ti ku tooi niŋ shɛli. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli tiŋ maa yuli Zɔa.
en: Hurry! Escape to it! I cant do anything until you get there. That is why the name of the city is Zoar.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa boli Izraɛlnim zaa mini bɛ kpamba ni bɛ zuɣulaannim ni bɛ sariakaritiba ni bɛ tuma kpamba na nti yɛli ba, N kurigiya pam pumpɔŋɔ.
en: One day he called a meeting of the leaders of the tribes of Israel, including the old men, the judges, and the officials. Then he told them: I am now very old.

dag: ni yi mali biɛhigu shɛli din tiɣiri Naawuni ŋun boli ya kpɛh o nam ni min o jilima ni la nini.
en: We encouraged you, we comforted you, and we kept urging you to live the kind of life that pleases God, who calls you to share in his own Kingdom and glory.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa lan chɛ ka bɛ dooi salima m-mali duu maa puuni zaa, ka mali salima zoligɔnima n-zaŋ lo du shɛli din nyɛ Luɣ Kasi Zaa Shee la tooni, ka dooi salima pa di gba zuɣu.
en: Solomon covered the temples interior with pure gold. He placed gold chains in front of the inner sanctuary and covered it with gold.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya: Gbilisimiya tibili wum, chɛliya karimbaani.
en: People of Judah, don't be too proud to listen to what the Lord has said.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla gɔhi tihi din yi Sɛnir na m-mali a dapaɣa zaa. Bɛ daa ŋmahila Lɛbanɔn sida tihi daantalisi na ti sa a ni.
en: Builders used cypress trees from Mount Hermon to make your planks and a cedar tree from Lebanon for your tall mast.

dag: Pa ninsal yɛm yɛtɔɣa ka ti mali wuhiri yɛla ŋɔ maa, amaa di nyɛla yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa Naawuni Shia Kasi ni zaŋ wuhi ti, ka ti mi mal li kahigiri Naawuni Shia yɛla wuhiri bɛn mali Naawuni Shia.
en: These are the things we are talking about—not with words taught by human wisdom but with words taught by the Spirit—we are interpreting spiritual things to spiritual people.

dag: Dinzuɣu n dana, chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ n ni ʒi pin shɛli na ŋɔ n-ti nachimba bɛn be a sani ŋɔ.
en: Now, I am bringing this gift to you. Please give these things to your men.

dag: Bɛ ni ti nyɛla zuliya shɛb bɛn mali ninkuunsi ka ku tiri ninkura jilima bee n-niŋ bipola nirilim.
en: a stern nation that doesnt go easy on the very old or show pity to the very young.

dag: n-zaŋ bunsi maa na nti zaŋ bɛ binyɛra pa bɛ yaansi zuɣu, ka Yisa ba.
en: They brought the donkey and the colt and laid their clothes on them. Then he sat on them.

dag: Fɔndi ŋɔ mini di tiŋkpansi maa zaa daa bela Naftali zuliya ni daa deei tiŋgban shɛli ka di leei bɛ dini kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm maa ni.
en: These cities and the fields around them were given to the tribe of Naphtali. Each family in that tribe got its land.

dag: Ka paɣ shɛb bɛn zaa suhuri daa yu daa zaŋ bɛ baŋsim n-zaŋ buhi kɔbiri mi gali.
en: And the women who knew how to make cloth from goat hair were glad to do so.

dag: Giliad nyɛla tuumbiɛrinim tiŋa, ka ninvuɣ kubo kul pali nimaani.
en: Everyone in Gilead is evil; your hands are stained with the blood of victims.

dag: Zaŋm gɔpiɛliga dari mali yi ni yɛn tuɣindi tulaale zim sara maligu bimbi shɛli zuɣu.
en: Build an altar of acacia wood where you can burn incense.

dag: Bɛ ni daa piri tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti Izraɛl zuliya maa ka di leei bɛ dini naai, ka Izraɛlnim daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni tin shɛli ti Nan bia Jɔshua ka di leeg o dini.
en: So when they finished assigning the borders of the land, the Israelites gave to Joshua, Nuns son, a legacy among them.

dag: Dama bɛ nyɛla n tumtumdiba, n ni daa yihi shɛb Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na; di bi simdi ka yi kɔhi ba kaman daba la.
en: I brought them out of Egypt to be my servants, not to be sold as slaves.

dag: Ka Ilaisha yɛl o, Cham a ʒiʒiinitab sani nti suhi kpaŋman kuma pam na, pa biɛla.
en: He said, Go out and borrow containers from all your neighbors. Get as many empty containers as possible.

dag: Ka Midiannim mini Amalɛknim ni Wulimpuhili polo nim la zaa daa laɣim do vinvamli maa ni, ka bɛ galisim ŋmanila toli. Bɛ laakumnim daa ka kalinli; bɛ galisim daa ŋmanila teeku noli bihigu.
en: The camp was huge. The Midianites, Amalekites, and other eastern nations covered the valley like a swarm of locusts. And it would be easier to count the grains of sand on a beach than to count their camels.

dag: Mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri mini niɣi ni biŋgbamda ni binyiɣira zaa, paɣimiy o!.
en: Do the same, you animals—wild or tame— you creatures that creep along and you birds that fly!.

dag: Ka di yi na mali puma ka bɛ bi chɛ li sɔŋ, di daŋdila mɔɣu kam kuubu.
en: If the water dries up, they are the first to wither, while still too small to be cut and used.

dag: Yinim dee yi ti deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ noli, ka dol o fukumsi zaligunim mini zaligu shɛŋa din sab zaligu kundi ŋɔ puuni ŋɔ, ka ŋmaligi labi ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani ni yi suhuri zaa mini yi shihi zaa.
en: But you must decide once and for all to worship him with all your heart and soul and to obey everything in The Book of God's Law .

dag: Ka Nɛbukadnɛza daa zaŋ Naa Jɛhoyachin min o ma ni o paɣiba ni o kpambaliba ni bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni ninvuɣ zuɣuri n-yi Jɛrusalɛm kuli Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni nti leei daba.
en: Nebuchadnezzar took Jehoiachin to Babylon as a prisoner, together with Jehoiachin's mother, his wives, his officials, and the leading men of Judah.

dag: Ka bɔzuɣu ka ti be barina ni sahakam?.
en: And what about us? Why do we put ourselves in danger every hour?.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yiɣisi Giligal chaŋ Gibia din be Bɛnjamin tiŋgban ni la. Ka Sool daa kali ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o sani maa kaman ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu laasabu.
en: Then Samuel got up and left Gilgal. Saul and the rest of his army left Gilgal and went to Gibeah in Benjamin. Saul counted the men who were still with him. There were about .

dag: Hal Naa Hɛrɔd gba bi nya o taali, dama o chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o lab ti sanna. Nyamiya, o bi tum tuumbiɛ shɛli din simdi kum.
en: Herod didn't find him guilty either and sent him back. This man doesn't deserve to be put to death!.

dag: Ka Ahitub bia Zadok mini Abiata bia Ahimɛlɛk nyɛ maligumaaniba, ka Sɛraya nyɛ gbansabira.
en: Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelech son of Abiathar were priests; Seraiah was the court secretary;.

dag: Ka o daa kpe duu maa ni, ka vooi dunoli yo bɛ niriba ayi maa niŋ, ka suhi Yawɛ.
en: He walked in, shut the door, and prayed to the Lord .

dag: Ka Dauda daa sɔɣi mɔɣu maa ni. Ka gol palli dali maa daa ti paai, ka naa ʒini ni o di bindirigu.
en: So David hid there in the field. During the New Moon Festival, Saul sat down to eat.

dag: dama o daa wuhiri ba mi kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun su fukumsi, ka pa ni Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba ni daa wuhiri ba shɛm la.
en: He did not teach like their teachers of the law. He taught like someone who has authority.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, m mi ni lala n-nyɛ li, Amaa wula ka ninsal lee yɛn tooi nyɛ ŋun ka taali Naawuni tooni?.
en: I know for certain that this is so; and how can anyone be innocent before God?.

dag: Ka tiŋgul maa garigi yɛli, Biɛɣu ni neei, amaa yuŋ ni lan zibi yaha. A yi bɔri ni a bɔhi, nyin lan labimina ti bɔhi.
en: The guard said, Morning has come, but it is still night. If you must inquire, inquire; come back again.

dag: Ka nachimba pia bɛn daa nyɛ Jɔab gbaɣino ʒiriba daa laɣim gili Absalom m-bahi jɛh o.
en: Then ten of Joab's soldiers closed in on Absalom and finished killing him.

dag: Gaad zuliya tiŋgbani maa tariga nudirigu polo, yi tiŋgbani maa tintariga yɛn pilila Tama zaŋ hal ni Mɛribatikadɛshi kulibɔŋ ni n-zaŋ nimaani doli Ijipti tintariga hal ni Mɛditirɛniɛn Teeku ni.
en: The southern border of Gads land will go from Tamar to the oasis at Meribah-kadesh, then along the Brook of Egypt to the Mediterranean Sea.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛhu mini Rɛkab bia Jɛhɔnadab daa kpe Baal duu maa ni, ka o yɛli Baal jɛmdiba maa, Di chɛliya ka Yawɛ jɛmda be yi ni, amaa chɛliya ka di kul nyɛla yinim bɛn nyɛ Baal jɛmdiba maa kɔŋko.
en: Then Jehu and Jehonadab son of Recab went into the temple of Baal. Jehu said to the worshipers of Baal, Look around and be sure that there are no servants of the Lord with you. Be sure there are only people who worship Baal.

dag: Ka n daa zaŋ Jɛrusalɛm gbibbu fukumsi niŋ n tizo Hanani mini Hanania ŋun daa nyɛ birini guliba kpɛm la nuu ni, dama Hanania daa nyɛla ŋun ʒe yim ni ŋun zɔri Naawuni n-gari niriba pam.
en: Next, I put my brother Hanani in charge of Jerusalem. I chose another man named Hananiah to be the commander of the fort. I picked Hanani because he was a very honest man and he feared God more than most people do.

dag: Chɛ ka di kul be nyin Yawɛ tooni sahakam, ka chɛ ka so ku lan teeg o yɛla dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Let them be before the LORD always, and let God eliminate the very memory of them from the land.

dag: N ni chɛ ka yi nya nambɔzɔbo ka o zɔn ya nambɔɣu, ka zaŋ ya labisi ʒili yimaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: I will be merciful to you, and he will be merciful and return you to your land.

dag: Zaŋm a nini lab kpaŋa ka chɛ ba, ka bɛ di bɛ dabisa nyaɣisim kaman tumtumdiba la.
en: Look away from us and leave us alone; let us enjoy our hard life—if we can.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn yɛli ba, N ku leei yi naa; ka m bidibiga gba ku leei yi naa sun ya; Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi naa ŋun sun ya.
en: Gideon replied to them, Im not the one who will rule over you, and my son wont rule over you either. The LORD rules over you.

dag: Ka o daa yihiri ba Naawuni nam yɛla waazu, ka wuhiri ba ti Duuma Yisa Masia yɛla palɔni, ka so daa bi kar o lala niŋbu ni.
en: He told them about Gods kingdom and taught them about the Lord Jesus Christ. He was very bold, and no one tried to stop him from speaking.

dag: Yi yi zaŋ binshɛli paŋ yi kpee ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl nira, yin miriya ka yi chɛ ka o niŋ ya nyɔri, di yi nyɛ liɣiri nyɔri bee bindira nyɔri bee yi ni kul zaŋ binshɛlikam paŋ o nyɔri.
en: When you lend money, food, or anything else to another Israelite, you are not allowed to charge interest.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun guli ma kaman piɛgula ni guli piɛri shɛm la, ka binshɛli bi poori ma.
en: The LORD is my shepherd. I lack nothing.

dag: A pun wum Asiria naa ni niŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa shɛm ni o ni saɣim li zaa shɛm yɛla. A tɛhiya ni nyin ni tiligi?.
en: You have heard how we Assyrian kings have completely wiped out other nations. What makes you feel so safe?.

dag: Chɛ ka suhudoo be di puuni, ka alaafee be di nanim yinsi.
en: Let there be peace on your walls; let there be rest on your fortifications.

dag: Ka yi ni daa galisi kaman saŋmarisi bɛn be zuɣusaa ŋɔ la, yi kalinli ni ti kpalimla biɛla yi ni bi deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ nol la zuɣu.
en: Although you become as numerous as the stars in the sky, only a few of you will survive, because you did not obey the Lord your God.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan yɛli, Neesim shɛŋa neemiya zuɣusaa sagbana ni n-woligi wuntaŋ ni ka chɛ yuŋ, ka neesim maa wuhiri shihira ni saha ni dabisa ni yuma;.
en: God said, I command lights to appear in the sky and to separate day from night and to show the time for seasons, special days, and years.

dag: Ka so yi tah a ʒiishee nti deeg a binyɛrigu, nyin chɛ ka o deeg a chinchini gba pahi.
en: And if someone takes you to court to sue you for your shirt, let him have your coat as well.

dag: Ka bɛ zuliya maa daa shiri chaŋ ti deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa su, ka a daa chɛ ka bɛ su Keenannim bɛn daa nyɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni nim la, ka daa zaŋ bɛ nanim mini bɛ niriba ni bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa niŋ bɛ nuu ni, ni bɛ niŋ ba bɛ suhu ni yu shɛm.
en: So the descendants went in and possessed the land. Before them, you subdued the Canaanites who inhabited the land. You also handed over to them their kings and the neighboring peoples, to do with as they wished.

dag: Niŋm ba kaman a ni daa niŋ Midiannim mini Sisɛra ni Jabin shɛm Kishɔn Mɔɣili ni la.
en: Do to them what you did to Midian, to Sisera, and to Jabin at the Kishon River.

dag: Yinim bilikɔɣinim ŋɔ, Anabi Aizaia ni daa yɛli yi yɛla shɛm la shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. O daa yɛliya ni Naawuni yɛliya:.
en: You hypocrites! How right Isaiah was when he prophesied about you!.

dag: Ka Firawuna suhu daa yiɣisi bah o tumtumdiba ayi bɛn daa nyɛ o wain boora min o bɔrɔbɔro shɛriba kpɛm zuɣu.
en: Pharaoh became angry with his baker and wine server.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ n Naawuni; n ni duh a ka paɣ a yuli. A ʒiɛyimtali puuni, a pal a ni daa pun lo nia shɛŋa kurimbuni ha, ka di mali alahiziba la.
en: Lord , you are my God. I honor you and praise your name, because you did amazing things. The words you said long ago are completely true; everything happened exactly as you said it would.

dag: Yisa nyaandoliba daa ti ŋmɛri tab naŋgbankpeeni ni bɛ nya ŋun gar o kpee bɛ ni.
en: Later, the apostles began to argue about which one of them was the most important.

dag: O daa bɔh o mi, Bɔ n-chɛ ka naa zali zaligu kpeeni maa yomyom lala? Ka Ariok daa kahigi yɛla maa ni nyɛ shɛm yɛli Daniɛl.
en: and asked, Why did the king give such cruel orders? After Arioch explained what had happened.

dag: Yi yaanniin daa di bindir shɛli bɛ ni daa booni manna la mɔɣu ni ka kpi.
en: Your ancestors ate manna in the desert, and later they died.

dag: Yi ni yɛn pirigi tiŋgban shɛli ti Izraɛlnim maa m-bala, ka di leei bɛ ni su shɛli. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: This is the land that you will divide among the tribes of Israel. This is what each group will get. This is what the Lord GOD said!.

dag: Yi mabihi bɛn be Babilɔn ka nyɛ Naawuni ni pii shɛb kaman yinim la puhiri ya; ka m bia Maak gba puhiri ya.
en: The fellow-elect church in Babylon greets you, and so does my son Mark.

dag: Di maan kahigi yɛla ŋɔ wuhi ni maligumaani so ni ti yiɣisi ŋmani Mɛlikizɛdɛk.
en: And these things become even clearer when we see that another priest has come who is like Melchizedek.

dag: Nyama, a tɔbbihi zaa ŋmanila paɣiba. A tiŋgbani maa dunɔdaya yɔhimi ti a dimnima. Ka buɣim di a dunɔdaya dapuhi.
en: Your soldiers are helpless, and your country stands defenseless before your enemies. Fire will destroy the bars across your gates.

dag: Ŋuna n-lan chɛ ka zuliya kam zaa yi ninvuɣ yino so o ni daa nam la ni na, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaa mali nyɛvili be dunia ŋɔ ni, ka zali ʒiɛmana balibu kɔŋkɔba mini tiŋgbana tarisi.
en: From one human being he created all races of people and made them live throughout the whole earth. He himself fixed beforehand the exact times and the limits of the places where they would live.

dag: Luɣ shɛli bɛ ni kɔriti bɛ ni zaŋdi sara maligu shɛli nyɔri buɣim biŋkɔbiri la, nimaani ka bɛ yɛn kɔriti taali sanyoo biŋkɔbiri, ka zaŋ bɛ ʒim kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini luɣilikam.
en: A priest must kill the guilt offering in the same place where they kill the burnt offerings. Then he must sprinkle the blood from the guilt offering around the altar.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti kpe Lɛvi maa yiŋa, ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba ni farigudeeriba pam ni alahichinim laɣim ʒini diri bindirigu, dama bɛ pam n-daa doli Yisa na.
en: Jesus sat down to eat at Levis house. Many tax collectors and sinners were eating with Jesus and his disciples. Indeed, many of them had become his followers.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Dimbɔŋɔ n-yɛn nyɛ shihirili yi sani din wuhiri ni n ni darigi yi tibili kpe ka yi baŋ ni n ni yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa jɛndi ya la shiri ni niŋ pali.
en: I, the Lord , will give you proof that I will punish you in this place and that my promise to bring destruction on you will come true.

dag: Amaa ka Jɛhɔshafat daa bɔhi, Yawɛ daanab so lan kani ŋun bi kana kpe ka nyɛ ti n-ni bɔhi so baŋ Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm.
en: But Jehoshaphat said, Isnt there any other prophet of the LORD around whom we could ask.

dag: ni nanim shɛb bɛn daa be nuzaa polo zoya zuɣu tinsi ni la ni Araba din daa be Kinɛrɔt nudirigu polo la ni tintan ni tinsi la nima ni Nafɔtido din daa be wulinluhili polo la nima.
en: the kings in the northern hill country and in the Jordan River valley south of Lake Galilee, and the kings in the foothills and in Naphath-Dor to the west.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ kom din tahiri tibidarigibo ŋɔ na ni kpe a pul nyɔri ni n-chɛ ka a dɔɣibu soli ŋari, ka a leei paɣiŋoo. Ka paɣ maa ni garigi yɛli, Ami Ami.
en: And may the water that brings these curses enter your stomach and make your womb discharge and make you miscarry. And the woman will say, I agree, I agree.

dag: M bia Timoti, n zaŋ niriba zuɣu ni kpahibu yɛla ŋɔ niŋ a nuu ni. Di nyɛla anabitali yɛtɔɣa ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ a polo. Chɛ ka di yɛtɔɣa maa leeg a bidibbina ka a zaŋ li tuhi tuhiri suŋ.
en: Timothy, you are like a son to me. What I am telling you to do agrees with the prophecies that were told about you in the past. I want you to remember those prophecies and fight the good fight of faith.

dag: Dinzuɣu di lan ŋmariya tab ʒiri! Sokam yɛlim o mabia yɛlimaŋli, dama ti zaa nyɛla niŋgbun yini yaɣ shɛŋa.
en: We are part of the same body. Stop lying and start telling each other the truth.

dag: ka o zaŋ wain paɣ o dansi maa, ka niŋ kpam bɔbili li, ka zaŋ tana lo li, ka zaŋ o balisi omaŋmaŋ buŋa n-zaŋ o ti kpɛhi saamba yilikpɛrili n-gbib o viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: The Samaritan went to him and bandaged his wounds, tending them with oil and wine. Then he placed the wounded man on his own donkey, took him to an inn, and took care of him.

dag: A ni je suli niŋ ti sahakam? A yɛn jɛla suli niŋ ʒiɛmani kam nima?.
en: Will you be mad at us forever? Will you prolong your anger from one generation to the next?.

dag: Yawɛ daa lan yɛli ma.
en: The Lord spoke to me again.

dag: Ninvuɣ so beni n-tɛhi ni dabisi shɛli so di kpee, ka so mi beni n-tɛhi ni dabisa zaa nyɛla yim. Chɛliya ka sokam doli o ni tɛhi shɛm omaŋmaŋ suhu ni.
en: Some people might believe that one day is more important than another. And others might believe that every day is the same. Everyone should be sure about their beliefs in their own mind.

dag: amaa di zuliya maa nim yi tumdi zaɣ biɛɣu n sani, ka zaɣisi ni bɛ ku wum n yɛligu, dindina n ni taɣi n tɛha zaŋ chaŋ zaɣ viɛl shɛli n ni di yɛn niŋ ba maa polo.
en: but if that nation displeases and disobeys me, then Ill relent and not carry out the good I intended for it.

dag: N dila suɣilo guhiri Naawuni; o kɔŋko sani ka n tiliginsim yirina.
en: I must calm down and turn to God; only he can rescue me.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ yuntisuɣu, ka Pool mini Silas suhiri Naawuni ka yiini yila paɣiri Naawuni, ka bɛ dansarika tab ʒiya wumda.
en: Around midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the other prisoners were listening to them.

dag: M mali yɛla pam ni n yɛl a, amaa m bi bɔri ni n zaŋ alikalimi mini tadabo -sab li ti a.
en: I have much more to say to you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun ka yɛm n-ni saɣi po pɔri n-zan o kpee nyaaŋa ni o di samli.
en: Only someone with no sense would promise to be responsible for someone else's debts.

dag: Gomna Pailɛt ni daa wum yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ o daa zaŋla Yisa yihina nti ʒin o saria karibu ʒiishee din nyɛ luɣ shɛli bɛ ni booni Gabata Hiburuli ni la. Di gbinni nyɛla luɣ shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ kuɣa ŋme m-malimali.
en: When Pilate heard these words, he took Jesus outside and sat down on the judge's seat in the place called The Stone Pavement.

dag: hal Nuhu mini Daniɛl ni Ayuba yi di be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, bɛ naan ku tooi tiligi bɛ bidibiga bee bipuɣiŋga. Bɛmaŋmaŋ kɔŋko nyɛviya ka bɛ naan tiligi bɛ wuntitali zuɣu.
en: If Noah, Daniel, and Job lived there, as surely as I live, proclaims the LORD God, they wouldnt be able to rescue either sons or daughters. But they would save their lives because they were righteous.

dag: Ka Dauda daa chaŋ ti liri ba Baalipɛrazim n-nyaŋ ba nimaani ka yɛli, Naawuni n-chɛ ka n kpe n dimnim maa sunsuuni kaman kokpɛɣu la. Lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Baalipɛrazim.
en: So David attacked them at Baal Perazim and defeated them. He said, God has used me to break through the enemy army like a flood. So that place is called Baal Perazim.

dag: Ka ti Duuma daa yɛl o, Yinim bilikɔɣinim ŋɔ! Yi ni ŋuni n-lee ku lɔrig o nahu bee o buŋa n-taɣ o chaŋ kuliga ka o ti nyu kom Vuhim Dabisili dali?.
en: The Lord answered, You people are hypocrites! All of you untie your work animals and lead them to drink water every day—even on the Sabbath day.

dag: Ka a chɛ ka Aduna min o bidibisi maa ŋubi nimdi maa mini bɔrɔbɔro shɛli din be piɛɣu puuni la Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili ŋɔ dunol ni.
en: At the entrance of the Tent of my presence they are to eat it along with the bread left in the basket.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔash daa ti kani, ka bɛ zaŋ o sɔɣi pahi Izraɛl nanim zuɣu Samaria; ka o bia Jɛrɔbɔam daa di nam ʒin o nam ʒiishee.
en: Jehoash died and was buried with his ancestors. Jeroboam became the new king and sat on Jehoashs throne. Jehoash was buried at Samaria with the kings of Israel.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ a? Ka Yisa yɛli ba, N nyɛla n ni daa pun yɛli ya ni n nyɛ so piligu ni la.
en: Who are you? they asked. Jesus replied, Im exactly who I have claimed to be from the beginning.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa daa ti doli tiŋ maa gooni zuɣusaa n-chani garita, ka paɣ so kuhi yɛl o, N dan naa, sɔŋm ma.
en: One day as the king of Israel was walking along the top of the city wall, a woman shouted to him, Please, Your Majesty, help me.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zuɣu, ka o daa chɛ ka dabiɛm gbaai sokam ka di niŋ ba alahiziba, ka niriba mali ba ansarisi ka yimaŋmaŋ nini nya.
en: This angered the LORD so much that he made Judah and Jerusalem an object of terror and horror, something people hiss at, as you can see with your own eyes.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o pa yuri zuɣu na ti sɔɣ o pah o yaannim zuɣu Dauda tiŋ la ni.
en: Then they carried his body on horses and buried him with his ancestors in the City of Judah.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ kawana bee chi m-mali sara maligu shɛlikam, kpam yi be di ni bee kpam yi ka di ni, di nyɛla Aduna bidibisi la zaa dini, di ni kul nyɛ yino dini shɛm, lala ka di nyɛ ŋun la gba dini.
en: All other grain sacrifices—with or without olive oil in them—are to be divided equally among the priests of Aaron's family.

dag: Amaa Firawuna ni daa nya ka poloya maa lan kani, ka o suhu daa lan kpaŋ yaha, ka o zaɣisi bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa niŋbu kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli ni o ni zaɣisi bɛ ni yɛli shɛm la.
en: But when Pharaoh saw that they were free of the frogs, he again became stubborn. Pharaoh did not do what Moses and Aaron had asked him to do. This happened just as the Lord had said.

dag: Ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Ɛshikol vinvamli, Izraɛlnim ni daa ŋmaai tiwala yilli nimaani maa zuɣu.
en: That place was called the Cluster ravine because of the cluster of grapes that the Israelites cut down from there.

dag: Kunduna ni ti tam bɛ pihi zuɣu kumda, ka yɔbahi be bɛ nayili viɛla puuni kumda. Babilɔn saha miriya, ka di dabisili ku lan tirisi tooni.
en: Wild dogs and wolves will howl in the great and beautiful buildings. Babylon will be finished. The end is near, and it will not be delayed.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋunkam kun ya, bɛ ni ku o gba. Bɛ ni gbahi yi dimnim zaa daba chaŋ. Bɛnkam fa yi nɛma, bɛ ni fa bɛ gba nɛma. Ka bɛnkam zaa di yi nɛma, n ni chɛ ka bɛ di bɛ gba nɛma.
en: But now, all who devour you will be devoured, and all your enemies will be taken away as prisoners. All who oppress you will be oppressed, and all who plunder you will be plundered.

dag: Ka n daa ti lan gariti a sani ka yul a n-nya ka a saɣi bɔbu, ka n daa zaŋ n chinchini pil a limsi a zaɣim maa, ka po pɔri lo a alikauli, ka a leei n ni su so. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: When I passed by you, I realized that you were ready for love. So I spread my cloak over you and covered your nakedness. I made a solemn promise and entered into a covenant with you, and you became mine. This is what the LORD God says.

dag: Ka o ti zaŋ o nuu pa alahichi sanyoo sara maligu biŋkɔbigu maa zuɣu ni, ka kɔrigi alahichi sanyoo sara biŋkɔbigu maa luɣ shɛli bɛ ni kɔriti biŋkɔb shɛb bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la.
en: You shall put your hand on its head and kill it on the north side of the altar, where the animals for the burnt offerings are killed.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Dauda daa kpe nti ʒini Yawɛ tooni ka yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, m mi lee nyɛ ŋuni bee n daŋ lee nyɛ banima, ka a ti zaŋ ma zali n ni ʒe zaashe shɛl ni ŋɔ?.
en: Then King David went to the Holy Tent and sat before the Lord . David said, Lord God, you have done so much for me and my family. And I dont understand why.

dag: Ŋun kur niriba yiɣisirila zaawuni n-chana ni o ku nandaamba mini faranima. Yuŋ yi paai, o ŋmanila tayiɣa.
en: At dawn the murderer gets up and goes out to kill the poor, and at night he steals.

dag: O daa nyɛla ŋun yuli du ninvuɣ pihita maa puuni, amaa o yuli daa bi du m-paai wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa. Ka Dauda daa zaŋ o leei tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa guli ŋun Dauda la zuɣulana.
en: Benaiah was even more famous than the Thirty Heroes, but he was not one of the Three Heroes. David made Benaiah the leader of his bodyguards.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yoli, ka bɛ daa na kul tumd alahichi; o daalahiziba tuma la zaa yoli, bɛ daa bi niŋ o yɛda.
en: But in spite of all that, they kept sinning and had no faith in Gods wondrous works.

dag: Ka o daa yuuni salo maa gindi ni o nya ŋun niŋ lala maa.
en: But Jesus continued looking for the one who touched him.

dag: Alahichilana yi tum alahichi bukɔbiga, ka kul be o nyɛvil ni yuui, m mi ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔri Naawuni yɛla ni so, bɛ ni zɔr o maa zuɣu.
en: A sinner might do a hundred evil things and still live a long time. But I know that it is still better to obey and respect God.

dag: Ka Juda zuliya niriba maa daa tuhi deei Jɛrusalɛm, ka zaŋ takɔbi ku di niriba, ka nyo li buɣim bahi.
en: The people of Judah fought against Jerusalem and captured it. They killed its people with their swords and set the city on fire.

dag: N niriba ni ti be suhudoo mini alaafee ni vuhim ni be luɣ shɛli.
en: Then my people will live in a peaceful dwelling, in secure homes, in carefree resting places.

dag: Bɛ bi diri wahala kaman ninvuɣ shɛb ni diri wahala shɛm. Alɔbo mi bi luri bɛ zuɣu kaman di ni luri ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu shɛm.
en: They dont suffer like the rest of us. They dont have troubles like other people.

dag: Tɔb tuhibu vuri be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka saɣiŋgu pam be nimaani.
en: Sounds of war and the noise of destruction can be heard.

dag: Bɛn ka cheechi ni saria karibu yɛla bi kpa ma. Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun ni kari ba saria. Amaa bɛn be yi cheechi ni n-nyɛ yi ni kariti shɛb saria. Di nyɛla kaman di ni sab shɛm Naawuni Kundi ni la: Yihimiya ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋun be yi ni bahi.
en: What do I care about judging outsiders? Isnt it your job to judge insiders?.

dag: Inok ni daa ti paai yuun pihiyɔbunaanu saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Mɛtusɛla.
en: After Enoch was years old, he had a son named Methuselah.

dag: Ka o daa boli kɔbiliga maa yuli Shiiba. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ booni tiŋ maa yuli Bɛrishiiba hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: So Isaac named the well Shibah, and the town is still called Beersheba.

dag: Toli maa ni daa ŋubi mɔri maa zaa naai saha shɛli, ka n yɛli, Yaa n Duuma NAAWUNI, n suhir a, chɛli bɛ taali! Yaakubu ku be. O pɔri pam.
en: Before the locusts could eat all the grass in the country, I said, Lord GOD, I beg you, forgive us! Jacob cannot survive! He is too small.

dag: Di saha ka ti daa deei tiŋgbɔn shɛli din be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili dul la Amɔrinim nanim maa nuu ni, zaŋ Arinɔn kulibɔŋ ni hal ti paai Hɛrimɔn Zoli gbini.
en: At that time we took from those two Amorite kings the land east of the Jordan River, from the Arnon River to Mount Hermon. .

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Musa mini Aduna ni salo maa kpamba daa kali Kɔhatinima kaman bɛ daŋ niriba mini bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Moses, Aaron, and the leaders of the Israelites counted the Kohathites. They counted them by families and family groups.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, N ni darigi yi tibili kaman yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm. N ni niŋ buɣim dabi yi yɔɣu maa, ka buɣim maa di binshɛɣukam din be di ni.
en: I will punish you based on what you have done, declares the LORD. I will set your forests on fire; the flames will engulf everything around you.

dag: ka o daa pun lo ni o ni zaŋ ti tah omaŋmaŋ sani n-chɛ ka ti leeg o bihi Yisa Masia zuɣu; o ni daa lo shɛm min o yubu ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bala.
en: God was kind and decided that Christ would choose us to be God's own adopted children.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti ni niŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa gba, ti ku saɣim tin shɛli a ni yɛri maa.
en: All right, go there, he answered. I won't destroy that town.

dag: Miriya ka yi pɔhi yi puri ni tiwala zaa bee n-gahim yi wain wal shɛŋa din lu tiŋa. Chɛliya li ti nandaamba mini saamba. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Also do not pick your vineyard clean or gather up all the grapes that have fallen there. Leave these items for the poor and the immigrant; I am the LORD your God.

dag: Yawɛ, dunia ŋɔ nanim zaa ni paɣ a, dama bɛ wum a yɛtɔɣa.
en: Lord , all the kings on earth will praise you when they hear what you say.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa wum ni o neei kum ni, ka Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la nya o maa, bɛ daa bi niŋ li yɛda.
en: and when they heard her say that Jesus was alive and that she had seen him, they did not believe her.

dag: N daa wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa, amaa ka n lee bi baŋ di gbinni. Di zuɣu ka n daa bɔh o, Ndana, ka wula ka di zaa ti yɛn bahindi.
en: I heard what he said, but I did not understand it. So I asked, But, sir, how will it all end.

dag: Ka bia maa daa mali ti zooi. Dahin shɛli ka o daa ti dol o ba chaŋ puu ni kachɛriba sani.
en: Some years later, at harvest time, the boy went out one morning to join his father, who was in the field with the harvest workers.

dag: N ni ti be Izraɛlnim sani n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: I will live with the Israelites. I will be their God.

dag: Pool mini niriba anahi maa ni daa mali bɛmaŋa ka di ti miri daba ayopɔin paabu saha shɛli ka Yɛhudianim bɛn daa yi Ɛsha na nya Pool Naawuni jɛmbu duu n-gbaag o n-chɛ ka niriba suhuri yiɣisi bahi o zuɣu.
en: When the seven-day period was almost finished, some Jews from Asia saw Paul in the Temple area. They stirred up everyone into an angry mob. They grabbed Paul.

dag: Yinim bɛn no n-taai nandaamba, ka nahindi tiŋgbani ŋɔ tarimba ŋɔ, wummiya.
en: Hear this, you who trample on the needy and destroy the poor of the land.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu: Bɛ ni lihi m-maan lab lihi, amaa ka ku nya shɛli. Ka wum m-maan lab wum, amaa ka ku baŋ bɛ ni wum shɛli maa gbinni. Dama bɛ yi niŋ lala bɛ ni ŋmaligi lab Naawuni sani, ka o chɛ bɛ daalahichi paŋ ba. .
en: The reason is, These people will look and look, but never see. They will listen and listen, but never understand. If they did, they would turn to God and be forgiven.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ fɔɣi Zɛdɛkia nina, ka ba o bandi ni bɛ zaŋ o kuli Babilɔn.
en: Then he gouged out Zedekiahs eyes, bound him in chains, and dragged him off to Babylon.

dag: Biɛrim yɛn ti ma la daŋa, n dimnim ni tam a yɛligu yɛla zuɣu.
en: Anger consumes me because my enemies have forgotten what youve said.

dag: Ibrahimma n-daa da palo maa Hitinim sani. Nimaani ka bɛ daa sɔɣi Ibrahimma min o paɣ Zara.
en: It was the field that Abraham had bought from the Hittites; both Abraham and his wife Sarah were buried there.

dag: N ni ti niŋdi ba din viɛla ni suhupiɛlli, ka zaŋ ba ʒili tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni ni ʒiɛyimtali ni n suhu zaa ni n shia zaa.
en: I will rejoice in treating them graciously, and I will plant them in this land faithfully and with all my heart and being.

dag: Ka Liya daa yɛli, N suhu paligiya! Dama paɣiba ni boli ma suhupiɛlli; ka daa boli bia maa yuli Asha.
en: Leah exclaimed, I'm happy now, and all the women will say how happy I am. So she named him Asher.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni ku tum tuumbiɛɣu; Kpiɔŋlan Naa ku ti nimmira yɛlimaŋli.
en: The truth is that God does no wrong. God All-Powerful is always fair.

dag: Musa daa yi ti kpe suɣili maa puuni, sagban daantaliga sirigirimina ti zani suɣili maa dunol ni, ka Yawɛ tɔɣisiri Musa yɛtɔɣa.
en: After Moses had gone in, the pillar of cloud would come down and stay at the door of the Tent, and the Lord would speak to Moses from the cloud.

dag: Ka yɛnnim maa daa garigi yɛli ba, Di pa shɛli di ku saɣ ti mini ya zaa; dinzuɣu chamiya kpakɔhiriba sani nti da yi dintol dini na.
en: Those who were wise answered, There's not enough oil for all of us! Go and buy some for yourselves.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ bɛ ŋarima maa na ti zali duli, bɛ daa chɛla bɛ binshɛɣukam maa zaa ka doli Yisa.
en: They pulled the boats up on the beach, left everything, and followed Jesus.

dag: Yɛhudianim Yaɣigari Chuɣu puhibu daa ti miri, ka Yisa daa chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm.
en: It was almost time for the Jewish Passover, so Jesus went to Jerusalem.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Otiniɛl Kɛnaz bia maa daa kpi.
en: and the land was peaceful for forty years, until Othniel, Kenazs son, died.

dag: N daa yɛli ya, Di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira bee n-zɔri ba dabiɛm.
en: But I said to you: Dont be terrified! Dont be afraid of them!.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ tiligi Izraɛlnima, ka di nyɛ tiliginsim din ku naai; ka bɛ kul ku lan di vi yaha. .
en: But Israel will be saved by the Lord . That salvation will continue forever. Never again will Israel be shamed.

dag: Amaa ka n daa yɛli, Ka mani ŋɔ tatabo zo? Mani ŋɔ tatabo ni zo nti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu ni n tiligi? N ku niŋ lala.
en: But I said to Shemaiah, Should a man like me run away? You know that an ordinary man like me cannot go into the Holy Place without being put to death. I will not go.

dag: N dan naa, ka pumpɔŋɔ, Izraɛlnim zaa lihirila a ninni ni a wuhi ba ŋun yɛn zani a zaani n-di nam a kalinsi nyaaŋa ʒin a nam ʒiishee.
en: Now, my lord and king, all the Israelites are watching you. They are waiting for you to decide who will be the next king after you.

dag: N daamiliya, yim Lɛbanɔn n-doli ma kuli. Yim Lɛbanɔn n-doli ma kuli. Sheemi Amana Zoli zuɣu na. Sheemi Sɛnir mini Hɛrimɔn Zoya din nyɛ gbuɣima mini jɛŋgbina ni be luɣ shɛl la zuɣu na.
en: My bride, together we will leave Lebanon! We will say goodbye to the peaks of Mount Amana, Senir, and Hermon, where lions and leopards live in the caves.

dag: Chɛli n ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa mini tuumbiɛ shɛŋa m bipalital ni la taali. Yawɛ, a yurilim maŋli min a nirilim zuɣu, teemi n yɛla!.
en: Dont remember the sinful things I did when I was young. Because you are good, Lord , remember me with your faithful love.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Bɔrɔbɔro kpila ala ka yi lee mali? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Diba ayopɔin m-pahi zim bihi biɛla.
en: Jesus asked, How many loaves of bread do you have? They answered, We have seven loaves of bread and a few small fish.

dag: Ka bɛ daa va ba duhiduhi, ka bɛ nyɔni tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: They gathered them together in big piles, and the land began to stink.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛli ya, Ʒiɛmani din bahindi nyaaŋa puuni ansarisimaaniba bɛn maani yi ni niŋ shɛli yɛda ansarisi, ka doli bɛmaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ kɔr biɛri soli ni ti beni.
en: They said to you, In the end time scoffers will come living according to their own ungodly desires.

dag: Yi nyɛla bɛn ʒi, ka lan ka baŋsim; yi bela zibisim ni, dunia ŋɔ tiŋgbani tanzahi zaa dammi.
en: They dont know; they dont understand; they wander around in the dark. All the earths foundations shake.

dag: Amaa saha shɛli Naawuni Shia Kasi ni booni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ la puuni, kpaŋsimiya tab dabisili kam ka di chɛ ka yi ni so ku niŋ tipawumlilana alahichi yɔhiŋgu zuɣu;.
en: Instead, in order that none of you be deceived by sin and become stubborn, you must help one another every day, as long as the word Today in the scripture applies to us.

dag: Ka Filistia tɔbbihi daa kul lɔri tɔbu na ti tuhiri ba, amaa bɛ daa yi kul lo tɔb na, Dauda n-tuhiri diri nasara gariti Sool sapashinnim maa zaa, ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka Dauda yuli du pam.
en: And whenever the Philistine commanders came out for battle, David would have more success than the rest of Sauls officers, so his fame spread widely.

dag: Ka zaŋ chaŋ shɛb ni tumdi shɛm polo, n nyɛla ŋun dol a zaligu, m mi bi zaŋ mmaŋ bali duŋtaariba ni.
en: as others do; I have obeyed your command and have not followed paths of violence.

dag: Ka ŋunkam yihi yɛli ni o bela neesim ni ka je o mabia, o na kul bela zibisim ni.
en: If we claim to be in the light and hate someone, we are still in the dark.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa yi Musa sani kuli.
en: Then all the Israelites went away from Moses.

dag: Ifriimnima, buɣa bukaata lee nyɛ bɔ yi sani? Mani n-nyɛ ŋun wumdi yi suhigu, ka lihiri ya. N ŋmanila sipirɛs tia din vari kul mahi ʒiɛya sahakam la. Yi bidɔɣiligu yirila n kɔbili ni na.
en: The people of Israel will have nothing more to do with idols; I will answer their prayers and take care of them. Like an evergreen tree I will shelter them; I am the source of all their blessings.

dag: Bɛtɛlnima n-daa tim Sharɛza mini Rɛgɛmmɛlɛk m-pahi bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb zuɣu ni bɛ chaŋ ti suhi Yawɛ ka o zo ba nambɔɣu.
en: The people of Bethel sent Sharezer and Regem-Melech, along with his men, to seek the LORDs favor.

dag: Amaa doo yi chirigi paɣ so bɛ ni zaŋ ti doo mɔɣu ni n-gbaag o goli, dindina do so ŋun gol o maa kɔŋko ka bɛ ni ku.
en: If an engaged woman is raped out in the country, only the man will be put to death.

dag: Ka di tooi biɛla ka so lan nya o n-yɛli, A gba nyɛla bɛ ni yino! Ka Pita yɛli, Zɔri, m pala bɛ ni yino.
en: A short time later, someone else saw Peter and said, You are also one of them. But Peter said, Man, I am not.

dag: Di jiɣindiya yi ni yɛn di shɛli bee n-nyu shɛli zuɣu, ka di chɛliya ka yi suhuri ye di zuɣu;.
en: Don't keep worrying about having something to eat or drink.

dag: Babilɔnnim gbahibu maa vuri ni ti chɛ ka tiŋgbani dam, ka zuliya kam ti wum bɛ kuhigu.
en: Babylon will fall, and that fall will shake the earth. People in all nations will hear about the destruction of Babylon.

dag: Nudirigu polo tintariga maa daa kpuɣila Teeku Kpiŋ la tariga mini di kulinol ni n-zaŋ kpa nudirigu polo.
en: Judah's southern border started at the south end of the Dead Sea.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla zuliya shɛb bɛn ka yɛm; baŋsim ka bɛ sani.
en: They are foolish. They dont understand.

dag: ni naɣilah ayi mini piɛlah anu ni bulah anu ni yuun yini piɛlabih anu shɛb bɛ ni daa zaŋdi maani biɛrisuŋ sara la. Aminadab bia Nashɔn sara n-daa bala.
en: and for the well-being sacrifice two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Nahshon, Amminadabs son.

dag: Ka n suhu daa yiɣisi pam, ka n kahi Tɔbaya nɛma m-bahi samban ni.
en: I was furious and threw out all of Tobiah's belongings.

dag: O dimnim ku tooi nyaŋ o; putɔɣunim mi ku tooi filim o.
en: So no enemy will ever control him. The wicked will never defeat him.

dag: Yinim bɛn be ʒilinsi ni ŋɔ, kpɛmiya kpe na. Ka yɛri bɛn ka yɛm mi;.
en: Come in, ignorant people! To the foolish she says.

dag: Ka bakɔi piligu dali biɛɣu daa ti neerina, ka paɣiba maa zaŋ tulaale shɛli bɛ ni daa mali zal la chaŋ siliga maa gbini.
en: Very early Sunday morning, the women came to the tomb where Jesus body was laid. They brought the sweet-smelling spices they had prepared.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yɛli ma, Chɛ ka ti chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu; di saha n suhu daa paligiya pam!.
en: I was glad when they said to me, Let us go to the Lord 's house.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa zaŋ bia maa n-du n-kpɛhi ti sɔŋ Naawuni nir maa garo zuɣu; ka yina n-vooi dunoli yo.
en: She carried him up to Elisha's room, put him on the bed and left, closing the door behind her.

dag: Naawuni biɛhigu mali dabiɛm pam o jɛmbu duu puuni, ŋuna n-nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni! O tir o niriba yiko mini kpiɔŋ. Paɣimiya Naawuni!.
en: You are awesome, God, in your sanctuaries— the God of Israel who gives strength and power to his people! Bless God!.

dag: Anabi Musa ni daa zaŋ wahu kpahi tabili daɣu zuɣu n-zaŋ sa mɔɣu ni shɛm la, di nyɛla talahi ni bɛ ti zaŋ Daadam Bia gba sa zuɣusaa lala.
en: And the Son of Man must be lifted up, just as the metal snake was lifted up by Moses in the desert.

dag: N ni chɛ ka o kpambaliba min o ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali yɛm ni o gomnanim ni wulaannim ni tɔbbihi nyu dam buɣi. Bɛ ni gbihi go titali, ka ku lan yiɣisi. Naa ŋun yuli booni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I, the Lord All-Powerful, the true King, promise that the officials and advisors, the governors and leaders, and the soldiers of Babylon will get drunk, fall asleep, and never wake up.

dag: ka lan zaŋ bɛril mini oniɣisi ni jasipa m-pie taba kul shɛli din pahir anahi la. Di simdi ka a ti zaŋ li niŋ salima bintabindisi la ni.
en: The fourth row will be a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. Their settings will be made of decorative gold.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Amaa miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka yi kɔr biɛri mini danyubo ni dunia ŋɔ yɛliniŋda ti dihi ya sɔŋ, ka dindali maa ti dii libigi ya.
en: Don't spend all of your time thinking about eating or drinking or worrying about life. If you do, the final day will suddenly catch you.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Ishimail ni daa gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb daba Mizipa maa zaa daa ŋmaligi zo n-labi Karia bia Jɔhanan sani.
en: and turned and ran to them.

dag: Naawuni ni daa chɛ ka alizin biɛ so ʒi Sool zuɣu maa daa yi ti kul lan siɣina saha shɛlikam, Dauda zaŋdila mɔɣilo maa ŋmɛra, ka alizin biɛɣu maa zo ka chɛ Sool, ka o ni maai, ka o nya omaŋa.
en: From then on, whenever the evil spirit sent by God came on Saul, David would get his harp and play it. The evil spirit would leave, and Saul would feel better and be all right again.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi Yawɛ, bɛna n-nyɛ o zɔnima, ka o kahigir o daalikauli wuhiri ba.
en: The Lord tells his secrets to his followers. He teaches them about his agreement.

dag: Ka o daa ti chaŋ bimbin shɛli o ni daa me n-zali Bɛtɛl la gbini gol so ŋun pahir anii biɛɣ pinaanu dali din nyɛ omaŋmaŋ ni daa zali dabisi shɛli la ni o ti tuɣili tulaale zim o ni daa zali chu shɛli n-ti Izraɛlnim la puhibu dali.
en: So King Jeroboam chose his own time for a festival for the Israelites, the th day of the eighth month. And during that time he offered sacrifices and burned incense on the altar he had built at Bethel.

dag: N Naawuni, tiligim ma n dimnim nuu ni; fam ma bɛn yiɣisi wuɣili n zuɣu la nuu ni bahi.
en: God, save me from my enemies. Protect me from those who stand against me.

dag: dama bɛ ka dahin shɛli bini; ninvuɣ biɛri firila ni kpi.
en: They have no hope. Their light will burn out.

dag: Di ku yuui ka ninvuɣ biɛri vuui; hal a yi lihi viɛnyɛliŋga m-bo ba, bɛ ku beni.
en: Soon the wicked will disappear; you may look for them, but you won't find them;.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa wum saa tahibu mini kikaa maa kumsi, ka nya saa nyaɣisibu mini nyɔhi ni mɔni zoli maa zuɣu shɛm maa, ka dabiɛm gbahi ba ka bɛ niŋgbuna sɔhira, ka bɛ daa kaɣi ʒe kpaŋ ha.
en: When all the people witnessed the thunder and lightning, the sound of the horn, and the mountain smoking, the people shook with fear and stood at a distance.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka dansarika gula maa daa tom ba kpɛhi duu din be puuni ha ni nti ba ba bandi ʒili.
en: When he received these instructions, he threw them into the innermost cell and secured their feet in stocks.

dag: Ka Yisa daa dol o chana. Ka salo daa muɣ o sani kabiri dol o.
en: So Jesus went with him. A swarm of people were following Jesus, crowding in on him.

dag: ka zaŋ o ti niŋ bɔɣili ni. Kom daa ka bɔɣili maa ni, di daa nyɛla zaɣ kuŋ.
en: took him, and threw him into the cistern, an empty cistern with no water in it.

dag: Teemiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa zaŋ ya doli tiŋgban nɛli ni so wɔɣinli yuun pihinahi ni o chɛ ka yi leei tarimba, ka o zahim ya nya yi ni dol o fukumsi zalikpana la bee yi ku dol li la yɛla.
en: Remember how the Lord your God led you on this long journey through the desert these past forty years, sending hardships to test you, so that he might know what you intended to do and whether you would obey his commands.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa yiɣisi n-damdi Hitinim bɛn daa su tiŋgbɔŋ maa tiŋa.
en: Abraham got up and bowed to the people.

dag: Ka Ribɛka daa yɛl o, N nyɛla Bɛtuɛl bipuɣiŋga. Bɛtuɛl mi daa nyɛla Nahɔr mini Milika bidibiga.
en: She responded, Im the daughter of Bethuel, who is the son of Milcah and Nahor.

dag: O daa ku Bashan Naa Ogi. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Another was King Og of Bashan. God's love never fails.

dag: Man Tɛrisius ŋun sab gbaŋ ŋɔ puhiri ya ti Duuma zuɣu.
en: Im Tertius, and Im writing this letter to you in the Lord—hello!.

dag: ka booi kpam bahi Nimshi bia Jɛhu zuɣu ni ka o leei Izraɛl naa; ka lan booi kpam bahi Shafat ŋun nyɛ Ɛbɛlimɛhola nir la bia Ilaisha zuɣu ni, ka o mi leeg anabi zani a zaani.
en: Also anoint Jehu, Nimshis son, as king of Israel; and anoint Elisha from Abel-meholah, Shaphats son, to succeed you as prophet.

dag: Karimi bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Akar ŋun daa bo yɛla bahi Izraɛlnim la. O daa kpuɣila bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛli ti Naawuni.
en: Zimris son was Carmi. Carmis son was Achar. Achar was the man who brought many troubles to Israel. Achar kept the things he took in battle, but he was supposed to give them all to God.

dag: Nyini n-zaŋ ba sɔɣi sɔɣibu shee a sani, ka ninsalinim ku tooi niŋ ba zaɣ biɛɣu. A gbib ba a ni zaŋ ba niŋ a sani luɣ shɛli maa viɛnyɛliŋga; ka so ku tooi paa ba tu ba.
en: You hide them in the shelter of your wings, safe from human scheming. You conceal them in a shelter, safe from accusing tongues.

dag: Amaa ka Dauda daa yɛli Aruna, Aai, n ni da li mi kaman di daa ni kul nyɛ shɛm. N ku zaŋ binshɛli din nyɛ a dini ti Yawɛ bee n-zaŋ n ni bi da binshɛli m-mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la.
en: But David replied, No! I want to pay you what they're worth. I can't just take something from you and then offer the Lord a sacrifice that cost me nothing.
