dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba maa ni daa ʒiya diri bindirigu maa ka o zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka ŋmahiŋmahi li zaŋ ti ba ka yɛli, N niŋgbuŋ m-bala; zaŋmiya li ŋubi.
en: While they were eating, Jesus took some bread and thanked God for it. He broke off some pieces, gave them to his followers and said, Take and eat this bread. It is my body.

dag: N ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu lu bɛ zuɣu, ka chɛ ka m piɛma nyɔɣi ba:.
en: Ill throw on them disaster after disaster; Ill destroy them with my arrows.

dag: Ka Naawuni nyɛla ŋun ni tooi niŋ alibarika din galisi pam niŋ yi ni, ka di chɛ ka yi kul mali binshɛɣukam ka di saɣiri ya, ka chɛ ka yi tooi mali pam din ni zaŋ tum tuun suŋ kam.
en: And God is able to give you more than you need, so that you will always have all you need for yourselves and more than enough for every good cause.

dag: Yilimiya yila pampam paɣi Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti kpiɔŋ ŋɔ; duhimiya yi yee ni suhupiɛlli paɣi Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ!.
en: Rejoice out loud to God, our strength! Shout for joy to Jacobs God!.

dag: Ka buɣim daa dii yi Yawɛ sanna ti di bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la mini biŋkpam la zaa sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu; niriba maa zaa ni daa nya li, ka bɛ tahi ka lu n-zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tiŋa.
en: The Lord sent fiery flames that burned up everything on the altar, and when everyone saw this, they shouted and fell to their knees to worship the Lord .

dag: Ka Naawuni Shia daa kpe n ni n-yiɣisi ma zali n naba zuɣu. Ka o daa tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣa yɛli ma, Kulimi ti kpari amaŋ niŋ a yiŋa.
en: His Spirit took control of me and lifted me to my feet. Then the Lord said: Go back and lock yourself in your house!.

dag: Tɔbbi shɛb bɛn daa zaŋ bidibbina ka Dauda sanna Hiburɔn ni bɛ ti fa nam Sool sani n-ti o kaman Naawuni ni daa yɛli shɛm la kalinli m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: These are the numbers of the men who came to David at the town of Hebron. These men were ready for war. They came to give Sauls kingdom to David. That is what the Lord said would happen. This is their number:.

dag: O daa dolila o ba Asa naba, o daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani, ka bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ li, naɣila bɛ ni daa jɛmdi buɣa luɣ shɛŋa la ka o daa bi wurim; ka niriba daa na kul chani ti maani li, ka tuɣindi tulaale zim nimaani.
en: Like his father Asa before him, he did what was right in the sight of the Lord ; but the places of worship were not destroyed, and the people continued to offer sacrifices and burn incense there.

dag: Di saha o daa yɛla saalo bɔɣiwɔɣila, dama di saha maa nabipuɣinsi bɛn daa na ʒi dɔbba ni daa yi yɛri saalo shɛŋa m-bala. Ka o tumtumda maa daa daag o yihi ka kpari dunoli.
en: She was wearing a long-sleeved robe because that was what the virgin princesses wore as garments. So Amnons servant put her out and locked the door after her.

dag: Dinzuɣu man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni chɛ ka n ni daa yɛli ba alɔbo shɛli yɛla la lu bɛ zuɣu, n ni tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa ka bɛ zaɣisi wumbu, ka m boli ba ka bɛ zaɣisi saɣibu la zuɣu. .
en: your God. I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I warned you about the terrible things that would happen to you if you did not listen to me. But you have ignored me, so now disaster will strike you. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ dabindi niŋ n sara maligu ʒim ni, yi mi di chɛ ka Yaɣigari chuɣu sara nimdi zani kaai biɛɣu.
en: Dont slaughter the blood of my sacrifice with anything leavened. The sacrifice of the Passover Festival shouldnt be left over until the morning.

dag: Dama di daa nyɛla jirambisa tambu buta. Di daa ka pilanima kaman dundɔntitali ni pilanim la. Lala zuɣu du shɛŋa din daa be zuɣusaa maa daa labi nyaaŋa n-gari tiŋ mini sunsuuni dina la.
en: This was because the promenades were arranged in three levels, but they didnt have columns like those in the courtyards. For this reason, the top story was narrower than the first and second stories.

dag: Bɛ yi ti tahi ya Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni mini nanim ni zuɣulaannim sani, yin di ti bɔhiri yi suhuri yi ni yɛn garigi shɛm bee yi ni yɛn yɛli shɛm zuɣu.
en: When they bring you to be tried in the synagogues or before governors or rulers, do not be worried about how you will defend yourself or what you will say.

dag: Ka naa daa tim ti boli Shimɛi na nti bɔh o, N daa bi chɛ ka a po Yawɛ ka n kpah a zuɣu ni yɛli ni a yi ti yi kpe chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam dahin shɛli, nyin baŋmi ni a ni kpi ka biɛhiŋ kani? Ka a daa yɛli ma, A ni yɛli shɛm maa viɛla, n ni dol a noli.
en: he sent for him and said, I made you promise in the Lord 's name not to leave Jerusalem. And I warned you that if you ever did, you would certainly die. Did you not agree to it and say that you would obey me?.

dag: dama Yawɛ yɛli ma, Miri ka a di bindirigu bee n-nyu kom nimaani bee n-dol a ni doli so shɛli kana. .
en: The Lord said to me, You must not eat or drink anything in that place, and you must go back on a different road.

dag: Malimiya salima bansi anahi n-zaŋ niŋ di naba anahi ni, yaɣ yini bans ayi yaɣ din la mi bansi ayi.
en: Cast four gold rings for it and put them on its four feet, two rings on one side and two rings on the other.

dag: Hal ŋun pun beni maa yi yuui m-paai yuun tusaayi gba, amaa ka bi di binshɛli nyaɣisim, pa luɣ yini ka bɛ zaa kuna?.
en: who live a thousand years twice over but dont enjoy lifes good things. Isnt everyone heading to the same destination?.

dag: Ka ti daa chaŋ ti baɣisi tiŋgban bil shɛli din be kom sunsuuni ka bɛ booni li Kauda la gari, ka di daa taɣi ti ka chɛ pɔhim maa. Ti wahala nyabu ŋɔ puuni ti daa kpaŋ timaŋa ni ti lo ŋarin bil din daa baɣi ŋarin titali maa tabili ka di ku lu.
en: After sailing under the shelter of an island called Cauda, we were able to control the lifeboat only with difficulty.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn dol o soya, ka bi tum taali gba mali alibarika.
en: They dont even do anything wrong! They walk in Gods ways.

dag: Hal maligumaaniba mini anabinim gba nyurila wain n-chani laana. Bɛ nyula wain maa mini binnyur kpɛma n-chani laani ka birim. Bɛ bi lan baŋdi ʒii nyabu gbinni, bɛ mi bi lan kariti saria din tuhi.
en: But now those leaders are drunk. The priests and prophets are all drunk with wine and beer. They stumble and fall down. The prophets are drunk when they see their dreams. The judges are drunk when they make their decisions.

dag: N yɛn dolila dunianim zaa ni doli so shɛl la. Mali yaa.
en: My time to die has come. Be confident and determined.

dag: Kul di chɛliya ka Hɛzɛkia chɛ ka yi zaŋ yimaŋ dalim Yawɛ ka yɛra, Yawɛ shiri ni fa ti bahi, ka Asiria naa ku tooi ŋme n-fa tiŋ ŋɔ.
en: Don't trust him when he tells you that the Lord will protect you from the king of Assyria.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ poya yɛli: Biɛhiŋ kani, n ni lo shɛm ni niŋ, ka n ni zali shɛm ni niŋ pali.
en: The Lord Almighty has sworn an oath: What I have planned will happen. What I have determined to do will be done.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kali Lɛvinim shɛb zaa bɛn nyɛ Musa mini Aduna ni Izraɛl kpamba ni daa kali kaman bɛ daŋ mini bɛ yaannim dunoya ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: All the enrolled Levites whom Moses, Aaron, and the chiefs of Israel enrolled by their clans and their households.

dag: Ti Duuma zuɣu, doliya dunia ŋɔ fukumsinim zaa yɛligu, di yi nyɛla nazuɣu ŋun su fukumsi.
en: Be willing to serve the people who have authority in this world. Do this for the Lord. Obey the king, the highest authority.

dag: Ka daɣila yi tɛhiya ni Naawuni ŋun ku kari saria n-ti o ninvuɣ gahindi shɛb bɛn suhir o wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ kam la nasara? O ku sɔŋ ba yomyom?.
en: Won't God protect his chosen ones who pray to him day and night? Won't he be concerned for them?.

dag: Yisa daa na bi paai Bɛtani tiŋ puuni; o daa na kul bela Maata ni tuh o soli luɣ shɛli maa.
en: He hadnt entered the village but was still in the place where Martha had met him.

dag: Ka Izraɛl zuɣulaannim bɛn nyɛ bɛ yaannim dunoya ni dɔɣirikpamba mini bɛ ni daa kali zuliya shɛb la zuɣulaannim daa mali sara.
en: The chiefs of Israel, the leaders of their households, made their presentations. They were the tribal chiefs and those who were in charge of the enlistment.

dag: Ka o daa kpe vokabili puuni zoli maa zuɣu nti gbe nimaani. Ka Yawɛ daa bɔh o, Ilaija, bɔ ka a lee niŋdi kpe.
en: There he went into a cave to spend the night. Suddenly the Lord spoke to him, Elijah, what are you doing here.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa kana ti zani miri niriba maa zaa ka bɔhi ba, Bɔ saha ka yi leei kul yɛn chɛ yi tɛha buyiyi ŋɔ? Yawɛ n-yi nyɛ Naawuni, yin doliy o, ka Baal n-yi nyɛ Naawuni, yin doliy o. Ka niriba maa daa bi garigi yɛl o shɛli.
en: Elijah approached all the people and said, How long will you hobble back and forth between two opinions? If the LORD is God, follow God. If Baal is God, follow Baal. The people gave no answer.

dag: N ni yɛli shɛm yi nyɛla ʒiri amaa ka di zuɣu chɛ ka Naawuni yɛlimaŋli zani ka o nya jilima, dindina wula ka o ni lan kari ma saria kaman alahichilana?.
en: Someone might say, When I lie, it really gives God glory, because my lie makes his truth easier to see. So why am I judged a sinner.

dag: Di saha ka Mɛmukan daa yɛli naa min o tuma zuɣulaannim maa, Pa naa kɔŋko ka Napaɣ Vashiti lihi ʒiɛm maa, amaa o tuma zuɣulaannim gba hal zaŋ tabili doo kam ŋun be o nam sulinsi ŋɔ ni zaa!.
en: Then Memucan declared to the king and his officials: Queen Vashti has insulted not only the king but also his officials—in fact, every man in the empire!.

dag: N ku zo dabiɛm muɣisigu saha, saha shɛli n dimnim yi ti teei gili ma.
en: Why should I be afraid when trouble comes? There is no need to fear when evil enemies surround me.

dag: So miri ka o ti niŋ bindirigu ti bɛn kumdi kuyila ni o maai bɛ suhuri bɛ kpiimba maa zuɣu bee n-ti ba binnyurigu ni bɛ nyu ka bɛ suhuri maai hal di yi kul nyɛla bɛ banim bee bɛ manim kum zuɣu gba.
en: No one will bring food to those who are crying for the dead. No one will comfort those whose mother or father has died. No one will offer a drink to comfort those who are crying for the dead.

dag: O daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani kaman o ba Amazia ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa shɛm la.
en: Azariah obeyed the Lord by doing right, as his father Amaziah had done.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti puhiri yiri kom maa ni na, o dii nyami ka zuɣusaa bɔɣi, ka Naawuni Shia Kasi yi zuɣusaa na kaman ŋmani la nti tam o zuɣu.
en: As soon as Jesus came up out of the water, he saw heaven opening and the Spirit coming down on him like a dove.

dag: Timiya ba jilima, ka yuri ba pam bɛ ni tumdi tuun shɛli maa zuɣu; ka maliya suhudoo ni taba.
en: Think of them highly with love because of their work. Live in peace with each other.

dag: Ti chandi maa daa muɣisi ti, amaa ka ti kul mali hal ti paai luɣ shɛli bɛ ni booni Fɛɛhavɛns, ka di miri Lasia la.
en: We sailed along the coast only with difficulty until we came to a place called Good Harbors, near the city of Lasea.

dag: O ni zali ti shɛm n-nyɛ ni ti niŋ o Bia Yisa Masia yuli yɛda ka yuri taba kaman o ni zali ti shɛm.
en: God wants us to have faith in his Son Jesus Christ and to love each other. This is also what Jesus taught us to do.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni nir maa daa tim ti yɛli Izraɛl naa, Miri ka a doli yaakaza polo, dama Sirianim yɛn chaŋ ti dɔni la nimaani.
en: But Elisha sent word to the king of Israel, warning him not to go near that place, because the Syrians were waiting in ambush there.

dag: Tibidarigibo biɛɣu neeya, sanyoo biɛɣu neeya. Izraɛlnim ni ti baŋ lala. Anabi maa nyɛla jɛrigu, shia ni be ninvuɣ so ni maa nyɛla yinyaa, dama yi tuumbiɛri mini yi jɛlinsi galisiya pam.
en: The time for punishment has come, the time when people will get what they deserve. When that happens, Israel will know it! This prophet, you say, is a fool. This inspired man is insane. You people hate me so much because your sin is so great.

dag: Piɛ yini daa malila fiig tiwal viɛla kaman fiig tiwal daŋda din mooi, amaa piɛ din la din daa malila fiig tiwala din bie pam, ka di biɛbu maa zuɣu chɛ ka so ku tooi di li.
en: One basket was full of very good figs that ripened early, and the other was full of rotten figs that were not fit to eat.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai Chidɔn kabɔɣili ni, ka naɣ shɛb bɛn daa vɔri tɔroko maa tuui, ka Yuza daa teeg o nuu gbaai Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa gbibi.
en: But when they came to Chidon's threshing place, the oxen stumbled, and Uzzah reached out and took hold of the chest to stop it from falling.

dag: Di ni chɛ ka a nya nirilim niŋbu mini yu suŋ Naawuni mini salinim sani.
en: Then you will find favor and approval in the eyes of God and humanity.

dag: Ka Dauda daa niŋ kaman Naawuni ni zal o shɛm maa n-nyaŋ Filistianim maa Gibiɔn hal ni Gɛza.
en: David did what God told him to do. So David and his men defeated the Philistine army. They killed Philistine soldiers all the way from the town of Gibeon to the town of Gezer.

dag: Naawuni daa lola Ibrahimma min o yaaŋa alikaulinima. Naawuni daa bi yɛli Ibrahimma, N lo a min a yaansi alikaulinima, ka di wuhiri ni bɛ ninvuɣ bɔbili. Amaa o daa yɛl o mi, N lo a min a yaaŋa alikaulinima, ka di wuhirila ninvuɣ yino ŋun nyɛ Masia la.
en: God made promises to Abraham and his Descendant. The Scripture does not say, and to your descendants. That would mean many people. But it says, and to your Descendant. That means only one, and that one is Christ.

dag: Ka Dauda daa kpuɣi paɣiba Jɛrusalɛm pahi n-lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: David married more women in the city of Jerusalem and had more sons and daughters.

dag: Kom koligu maa ni kom ni daa ti naai, ka o zaŋ bia maa ti sɔŋ tutuɣu gbini.
en: Finally the water in the flask ran out, and she put the boy down under one of the desert shrubs.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, sabimi yilli ŋɔ n-zaŋ li wuhi Izraɛlnima, zaŋm li niŋ bɛ noya ni din ni chɛ ka yilli ŋɔ leei shɛhira n sani n-jɛndi Izraɛlnima.
en: So write down this song, and teach it to the Israelites. Teach them to sing this song. Then this song will be a witness for me against the Israelites.

dag: Pool min o nyaaŋa maa ni daa yi Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu maa ni na, ka niriba maa daa balim ba ni bɛ lan labimina Vuhim Dabisili din kanna dali nti tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa maa pahi.
en: As Paul and Barnabas were leaving the synagogue, the people urged them to speak about these things again on the next Sabbath.

dag: N kul guhirila Yawɛ n-gari tiŋguliba bɛn guhiri biɛɣu neebu. Yɛlimaŋli, hal n-gari tiŋguliba bɛn guhiri biɛɣu neebu.
en: My whole being waits for my Lord— more than the night watch waits for morning; yes, more than the night watch waits for morning!.

dag: N ni yɛli m mabi dɔbba ni paɣiba a yɛla; N ni paɣ a a jɛmbu laɣiŋgu ni;.
en: I will declare your name to my brothers and sisters; I will praise you in the very center of the congregation!.

dag: Nir yi zaɣisi zaligu dolibu, hal dilan wunsuhigu nyɛla din chihira.
en: God cannot stand the prayers of anyone who disobeys his Law.

dag: Ka Musa daa lan yɛli Kɔra, Yinim Lɛvi zuliya ŋɔ, wummiya!.
en: Moses also said to Korah, You Levites, listen to me.

dag: Dama zahimmiya: Bɔ n-lee kpalim? Yi yi lihi ʒiɛm fiɛbiga, lala ku niŋ? Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Hes testing. When even the rod rejects, will it not certainly happen? This is what the LORD God says.

dag: ni bimmɔriŋ bee yuma zaligu.
en: and for swelling, scabs, or shiny spots.

dag: Ka ŋunkam daa nya li yɛli, yɛlli ŋɔ tatabo na ʒi n-niŋ bee ti nini na ʒi n-nya lala Izraɛlnim ni daa yi Ijipti na dahin shɛl la hal ni zuŋɔ. Ti tɛhimi di yɛla. Ti gbaamiya saawara baŋ ti ni yɛn yɛli di yɛla shɛm.
en: Everyone who saw this said, Nothing like this has ever happened in Israel before. We havent seen anything like this from the time we came out of Egypt. Discuss this and tell us what to do.

dag: Ifriimnim tum tuun shɛli din tahi suhuyiɣisili pam na, dinzuɣu Yawɛ chɛ ka ninvuɣ kubo taali la ʒi bɛ zuɣu, ka o ni ti darigi bɛ tibili bɛ ni daa tur o la zuɣu.
en: Israel, I will make you pay for your violent crimes and for insulting me.

dag: Ka Shɛkɛm zuɣulaannim zaa bɛn daa be pii la ni wum lala, ka zo nti kpe Ɛlibɛrit jɛmbu duu ti sɔɣi.
en: When all the leaders in the Tower of Shechem heard about this, they entered the side rooms in the El-berith temple.

dag: Ka n daa laɣim bɛ zaa na mɔɣ shɛli din daa zɔri kuni fɔntin shɛli bɛ ni daa booni Ahava la gbini. Ti daa laɣim dɔnila nimaani daba ata. Ka n daa nya niriba mini maligumaaniba, ka daa bi nya Lɛvinim zuliya ni so.
en: I gathered them by the river that runs to Ahava, and there we camped for three days. As I reviewed the people and the priests, I found no Levites there.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛlnim maa daa dɔɣi bihi n-nabi ka yɛligi pam, ka mali yaa m-pali Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: but their descendants, the Israelites, had many children and became so numerous and strong that Egypt was filled with them.

dag: O yi ti kana, yin deemiy o kaman Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda ni deeri niriba shɛm ti Duuma zuɣu la; ka o yi ti bɔri shɛli yi sani, yin sɔŋmiy o, dama o nyɛla ŋun sɔŋ niriba pam zaŋ tabili mmaŋmaŋ gba.
en: I ask you to accept her in the Lord. Accept her the way Gods people should. Help her with anything she needs from you. She has helped me very much, and she has helped many others too.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ Naawuni ŋun bi kpiri ŋɔ jilima taɣi ti binnana din ŋmani ninsalinim bɛn kpiri ŋɔ bee noonsi bee biŋkɔbiri bee biŋgbamda.
en: They don't worship the glorious and eternal God. Instead, they worship idols that are made to look like humans who cannot live forever, and like birds, animals, and reptiles.

dag: Yuun piniyini puuni gol so ŋun pahir ata dahin yini dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: On the first day of the third month of the eleventh year of our exile, the Lord spoke to me.

dag: Ka o sɔrilim maa yi na bi naai ka o dɔni binshɛlikam zuɣu ni nyɛla din be daɣiri ni, o yi lan ʒini binshɛlikam zuɣu, di gba ni nyɛla din be daɣiri ni.
en: Everything she lies on during her monthly time of bleeding will be unclean. And everything she sits on during that time will be unclean.

dag: Ti daa nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be a biɛhigu shee din be kasi la, amaa ka ti dimnim daa kari ti nimaani, ka wurim a jɛmbu shee din be kasi maa.
en: Why did the wicked bring down your holy place? Why did our enemies trample your sanctuary?.

dag: ka yɛli ni di simdi ka bɛ wuhi Judanima ni di sabi Jashar litaafi puuni yɛli.
en: and he ordered his men to teach the song to everyone in Judah. He called it The Song of the Bow, and it can be found in The Book of Jashar . This is the song:.

dag: Ka Naomi daa yɛl o, Rut, nyama, a kpee maa lab o niriba min o wuna sani, dinzuɣu a gba dol o labi.
en: Naomi said, Look, your sister-in-law is returning to her people and to her gods. Turn back after your sister-in-law.

dag: ka yɛl o, Wuhim ma a ba ni nyɛ so. Duri be a ba yiŋa ka ti ni gbe nimaani.
en: Then he said, Please tell me who your father is. Does he have room in his house for me and my men to spend the night.

dag: Nahimmiya Midiannima, ka ku ba.
en: The Midianites are now enemies of Israel, so attack and defeat them! They tricked the people of Israel into worshiping their god at Peor, and they are responsible for the death of Cozbi, the daughter of one of their own leaders.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ maŋmaŋ daa yɛli ma, N ku chɛ bɛ tuumbiɛɣu ŋɔ taali hal ka bɛ ti yi dunia yili. Mani yi Duuma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The Lord All-Powerful has spoken to me this solemn promise: I won't forgive them for this, not as long as they live.

dag: Amaa Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba la daa bela Ofɛl, ka Ziha mini Gishipa daa nyɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba maa zuɣulaannima.
en: But the temple servants lived in Ophel, with Ziha and Gishpa in charge of them.

dag: Ka Bɛbai bia Zakaria daa nyɛ Bɛbai daŋ zuɣulana, ka dɔbba pihitaayika daa pah o zuɣu.
en: from the descendants of Bebai: Zechariah son of Bebai, and other men;.

dag: Ka nam din pah anahi gba ti deei. Di ni ti mali kpiɔŋ kaman kuriti din ŋmɛri burisiri ka kabiri binshɛɣukam la. Ka kuriti ni ŋmɛri burisiri binshɛɣukam shɛm la, lala ka di ni ti ŋme n-wurisi nam shɛŋa din daŋ di tooni.
en: Next, a kingdom of iron will come to power, crushing and shattering everything.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa suhi Yawɛ bɛ wahala maa puuni, ka Yawɛ daa yihi ba bɛ nandahima maa ni.
en: Then in their trouble they called to the Lord , and he saved them from their distress.

dag: O kari doli ba chani ni alaafee, ka di bi ŋman o naba shihiri tiŋa.
en: He pursues them and passes untouched, needing no path for his feet.

dag: dama o yuri ti zuliya ŋɔ hal ka me jɛmbu duu ti ti.
en: He loves our people and he himself built a synagogue for us.

dag: Ka Miriam ŋun daa nyɛ anabi ka nyɛ Aduna tizɔpaɣ la daa zaŋ guŋgombil din mali chaɣisa, ka paɣiba zaa daa zaŋ guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisa n-yi nti pah o zuɣu wari waa.
en: Then Aarons sister, the woman prophet Miriam, took a tambourine. She and the women began singing and dancing.

dag: Di daa bi yuui ka Yawɛ yɛli Musa mini Aduna ni Miriam, Yi niriba ata maa kam Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la gbin na. Ka bɛ niriba ata maa daa kana.
en: Suddenly the Lord said to Moses, Aaron, and Miriam, I want the three of you to come out to the Tent of my presence. They went.

dag: Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ ŋun ni tooi nyaŋ dunia ŋɔ? Ŋun ni tooi nyaŋ dunia ŋɔ nyɛla ŋun niŋ yɛda ni Yisa nyɛla Naawuni bia.
en: Who can defeat the world? Only the person who believes that Jesus is the Son of God.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni chɛ ka Babilɔn naa Nɛbukadnɛza naai Ijipti daazichi zaa.
en: Your Egyptian army is very strong, but I will send King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia to completely defeat that army.

dag: Daba ayopɔin nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ daa lan tɔɣisi ma yɛtɔɣa yɛli.
en: After the seven days had passed, the Lord spoke to me.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa zaŋ omaŋ pa talima ni o tiligi ti ti tuumbiɛri zaa ni ka mali ti ka ti be kasi, ka zaŋ ti leeg omaŋmaŋ niriba bɛn suhuri ye tuun suma tumbu zuɣu.
en: He gave himself for us. He died to free us from all evil. He died to make us pure—people who belong only to him and who always want to do good.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi gba malimiya shili sahakam; dama Daadam Bia ni ti labina saha shɛli yi ni bi yuun o soli.
en: You also must be ready, because the Human Oneis coming at a time when you dont expect him.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla binshɛŋa din niŋbu chihira n-zali n jɛmbu duu n-ta li daɣiri.
en: They have made their idols, and I hate those idols. They put their idols in the Temple that is called by my name, so they made my Temple dirty.

dag: Ka sagbani maa zuɣu daa chɛ ka maligumaaniba ku tooi tum bɛ tuma, dama Yawɛ jilima n-daa pali jɛmbu duu maa zaa.
en: The priests could not continue to serve because of the cloud, because the Glory of the Lord filled the Temple.

dag: M puhiri Akuila mini Prisila bɛn nyɛ n tumtumditaba Yisa Masia ni la.
en: I send greetings to Priscilla and Aquila, my fellow workers in the service of Christ Jesus;.

dag: Yi yi ni dol o fukumsi zalikpan shɛlikam n ni zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka yuri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ, ka jɛmd o ni yi suhuri zaa ni yi shihi zaa.
en: Now, if you completely obey Gods commandments that I am giving you right now, by loving the LORD your God and by serving him with all your heart and all your being.

dag: A ni nyɛ Yisa Masia tɔbbia ŋun ʒe yim la zuɣu, pahimi ti zuɣu di wahala.
en: As a good soldier of Christ Jesus, accept your share of the troubles we have.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa kum niŋ Yawɛ Midiannim zuɣu maa.
en: This time when the Israelites cried out to the LORD because of Midian.

dag: Ka Dauda zɔsimo Hushai daa labi tiŋ puuni ti saɣisi saha shɛli Absalom ni kpɛri Jɛrusalɛm na.
en: So Hushai, David's friend, returned to the city just as Absalom was arriving.

dag: Ka Goma bidibisi daa nyɛ: Ashikɛnaz mini Rifat ni Tɔgarima.
en: Gomers sons: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.

dag: Ka o daa wuhi ya o daalikauli shɛli o ni zali ya ni yi doli, dina n-nyɛ o fukumsi zaligunim pia la. Ka o daa sabi li pa kuɣiparilana ayi zuɣu.
en: The Lord said he was making an agreement with you, and he told you that your part of the agreement is to obey the Ten Commandments. Then the Lord wrote these Commandments on two flat stones.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa pirig o binyɛrigu m-pɔripɔri li zaŋ fiɛb kom maa, ka kom maa daa pirigi buyi n-daai ti dɔni di yaɣ ayi maa zaa hal ka bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa ti doli tiŋgban kuŋ zuɣu du duli.
en: Elijah took off his coat, folded it, and hit the water with it. The water separated to the right and to the left. Then Elijah and Elisha crossed the river on dry ground.

dag: Ka Pool daa tɔɣisi ni o zabi omaŋ zuɣu yɛli, M bi tum birigi Yɛhudianim zaligu shɛli bee n-tum taal shɛli Naawuni jɛmbu duu; m mi bi tum Naa Siiza taali hal baabiɛla.
en: In his own defense, Paul said, Ive done nothing wrong against the Jewish Law, against the temple, or against Caesar.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, N wuhibu maa pala n dini, amaa di nyɛla ŋun tim ma na la dini.
en: Jesus answered, What I teach is not my own teaching, but it comes from God, who sent me.

dag: Naa Atazɛrikisɛs nam dibu yuun pisi saha gol so bɛ ni booni Nisan la puuni, Naa wain nyubu saha ni daa ti paai, ka n daa zaŋ li ti ti o. N daa na ʒi m-mali suhugarigu o tooni.
en: During the month of Nisan in the twentieth year that Artaxerxes was king, I served him his wine, as I had done before. But this was the first time I had ever looked depressed.

dag: ka m min o laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yini. M bi lan mali mmaŋmaŋ wuntia, hal m bi lan mali wuntia din yi zaligunim dolibu ni na gba. Wunti shɛli n ni yipa mali pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ nyɛla din yi Masia yɛda niŋbu ni na. Di nyɛla wuntia din yi Naawuni sanna yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: and to know that I belong to him. I could not make myself acceptable to God by obeying the Law of Moses. God accepted me simply because of my faith in Christ.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Zanimiya sochira zuɣu lihi, bɔhimiya baŋ kurimbuni ha soya la, ka bɔhi baŋ so viɛlli ni nyɛ shɛli n-dol li ka nya suhudoo. Amaa ka bɛ yɛli, Ti ku dol li.
en: This is what the Lord says: Stand at the crossroads and look. Ask where the old road is. Ask where the good road is, and walk on that road. If you do, you will find rest for yourselves. But you people have said, We will not walk on the good road.

dag: Ka Rut daa gbani n-zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋa ka bɔhi Bɔaz, Bɔ n-lee chɛ ka a ti niŋdi ma nirilim lala? Ka bee bɔ n-lee chɛ ka a ti lihi nya man ŋun nyɛ tinzun nir ŋɔ lala.
en: Ruth bowed down to the ground and said, You know I come from another country. Why are you so good to me.

dag: Bɛ daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ naa ni daa zali maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim zaligu shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ shɛlikam polo bee zaŋ chaŋ nɛma duri polo la.
en: They didnt deviate in any way from the kings commands concerning the priests, the Levites, or the treasuries.

dag: Chɛ ka ti laɣ tab zɔri m-be kaman m ba min a ba ni daa be shɛm la. Nyama, n zaŋla anzinfa mini salima ŋɔ ti a pini. Saɣimm a mini Izraɛl Naa Baasha zɔtal la, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o zaŋ o tɔbbihi yiɣisi ka chɛ ma.
en: Let us be allies, as our fathers were. This silver and gold is a present for you. Now break your alliance with King Baasha of Israel, so that he will have to pull his troops out of my territory.

dag: Man Pool maŋmaŋ nuu n-sab puhigu yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ. Ŋ-ŋɔ ka n dalindi n gbaŋ kam. N ni sabiri shɛm m-bala.
en: I always sign my letters as I am now doing: PAUL.

dag: Ka Hushai daa garigi yɛli Absalom, Aai Yawɛ min o niriba ŋɔ ni Izraɛlnim ni pii ninvuɣ so, o sani ka n yɛn be ka o su ma.
en: No, Hushai replied to Absalom, I will belong to the one chosen by the LORD, by this people, and by all Israel, and I will stay with him.

dag: Bɛ yɛli bɛmaŋa, Ti ni nyaŋ ba zaa. Bɛ daa nyo Naawuni jɛma laɣiŋgu shɛhi zaa din be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni buɣim.
en: The enemy decided to crush us completely. They burned every holy place in the country.

dag: Amaa m mabihi, n yi na kul yihiri gunibu yɛla waazu, di chaŋ wula ka n na kul nyari nahiŋgu? Di yi nyɛ lala, dapulli waazu yihibu yɛla din nyɛ kuɣituurili la naan vuui.
en: My brothers and sisters, I dont teach that a man must be circumcised. If I do teach circumcision, then why am I still being persecuted? If I still taught circumcision, then my message about the cross would not be a problem.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka Naawuni chɛ ka alizin biɛɣu siɣi Naa sol zuɣu na, ka o be o yiŋ tahira, ka Dauda daa yaa ŋmɛri mɔɣilo niŋd o kaman o ni daa yi pun niŋdi shɛm dabisili kam la, ka Sool daa gbib o kpani o nuu ni;.
en: The next day an evil spirit from God suddenly took control of Saul, and he raved in his house like a madman. David was playing the harp, as he did every day, and Saul was holding a spear.

dag: O daa doli o ba ni daa doli so shɛŋa zaa, ka jɛm o ba ni daa jɛm buɣ shɛŋa zaa.
en: He walked in all the ways his father had walked. He worshipped the same worthless idols his father had worshipped, bowing down to them.

dag: Ka Dauda mini sapashin kpamba daa pii Asaf mini Hɛman ni Jɛdutun bidibisi ni shɛba ni bɛ zaŋdi mɔɣilɔnim mini goonjɛnim ni guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisa ŋ-ŋmɛri ka yiini anabitali yila. Bɛn daa tum tuma maa kalinli mini bɛ tuma n-daa bɔŋɔ.
en: David and the temple officials chose the descendants of Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun to be in charge of music. They were to praise the Lord by playing cymbals, harps and other stringed instruments. Here is a list of the musicians and their duties:.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa Izraɛlnim ni ti lan jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, ka tibigi bɛ Naa Dauda, ka bɛ ti zɔri Yawɛ, ka bɔri zaɣ viɛlli o sani dabisi shɛŋa din bahindi nyaaŋa ŋɔ puuni.
en: But later, Israel will turn back to the Lord their God and to David their king. At that time they will come to the Lord with fear and trembling, and he will be good to them.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Naa yi zaŋ o ni su shɛli ti o bidibisi pini, di simdi ni di leeg o bidibisi maa dini, ka di nyɛ bɛ fali shɛli bɛ ni yɛn su.
en: The LORD God proclaims: When the prince gives a gift to each of his sons, it becomes their inheritance. It becomes their family property as an inheritance.

dag: Ka n daa laɣim bɛ zaa na mɔɣ shɛli din daa zɔri kuni fɔntin shɛli bɛ ni daa booni Ahava la gbini. Ti daa laɣim dɔnila nimaani daba ata. Ka n daa nya niriba mini maligumaaniba, ka daa bi nya Lɛvinim zuliya ni so.
en: I brought everyone together by the river that flows to the town of Ahava where we camped for three days. Not one Levite could be found among the people and priests.

dag: Yaa be o nyiŋgoli ni, ka dabiɛmnim ʒe o tooni ka bɛ ni sɔhira.
en: Power resides in his neck; violence dances before him.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Shɛfa Zoli maa gbini, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Harada.
en: They left Mount Shepher and camped at Haradah.

dag: Amaa nyini Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia, wummi Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm. Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ a polo m-bɔŋɔ: A ku kpi tɔbu ni.
en: But listen to the promise of the Lord , King Zedekiah of Judah. This is what the Lord says about you: You will not be killed with a sword.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni nini daa kul kpa Yɛhudia zuɣulaannim maa ka bɛ daa bi tooi chɛ ka bɛ chɛ mɛbu hal ka di lahibali daa ti ti nti to Darius ka o daa sab o zilinkom gbaŋ ti na.
en: But God was watching over the Jewish leaders. The builders didnt have to stop working until a report could be sent to King Darius. They continued working until the king sent his answer back.

dag: Ka o ni daa kul tum tuun shɛlikam Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni min o ni daa gbibi Naawuni zaligu shɛm ni o ni daa bo Naawuni shɛm, o daa niŋ li mi ni o suhu zaa, ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka o di nasara.
en: He had success in every work he began—the service of Gods Temple and in obeying the law and commands, and in following his God. Hezekiah did all these things with all his heart.

dag: Ayuba bipuɣinsi maa viɛlim kpee daa ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni. Ka bɛ ba daa ti ba fali pahi bɛ tizɔdɔbba maa zuɣu.
en: No women in all the land were as beautiful as Jobs daughters; and their father gave an inheritance to them along with their brothers.

dag: Bɛ yi zaŋ nɛ karili lo n-yili dilan nyiŋgoli n-zaŋ o bahi teeku ni, di naan so o zuɣu gar o chɛ ka bibihi ŋɔ ni yino birigi.
en: would be better off thrown into the ocean with a heavy stone tied around their neck.

dag: din ni chɛ ka n gbaai Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn zaɣisi ma bɛ buɣa zuɣu la suhuri.
en: All those idols have turned the Israelites away from me, but by my answer I hope to win back their loyalty.

dag: Chɛliya ka Masia ni zaŋ suhudo shɛli tin ya la su yi suhuri, dama suhudoo maa zuɣu ka Naawuni daa boli ya n-laɣim ya niŋgbun yin la ni. Ka paɣimiya Naawuni.
en: The peace of Christ must control your hearts—a peace into which you were called in one body. And be thankful people.

dag: A ni kpi ŋun bi guni kum tinzunnim nuu ni. Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala. .
en: Foreigners will kill you, and you will die the death of those who don't worship me. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Amaa ka ŋun daa lee yi ha nti nya o kpe so ŋun daa di o gba samli ka di bi yaɣi lala, ka o ʒe n-di dilan maa nyiŋgol ni ka yɛl o, Yom ma n samli la.
en: But as this official was leaving, he happened to meet another official, who owed him silver coins. So he grabbed the man by the throat. He started choking him and said, Pay me what you owe.

dag: N ni daa yihi ba zuliya shɛb ni, ka yihi ba bɛ dimnim tiŋgbana ni na nti chɛ ka n kasitali yi palo bɛ zuɣu ka zuliya kam nya li la.
en: Foreign nations will watch as I take the Israelites from enemy lands and bring them back home, and those nations will see that I am holy.

dag: Yuun pihinahi ŋɔ zaa puuni, yi niŋgbuna ni situra daa bi chahi, ka yi naba mi daa bi mɔri.
en: Over the past years, your clothing hasn't worn out, and your feet haven't swollen.

dag: ka so yi ti be puu ni, ŋun di lan kuli yiŋa ni o ti zaŋ o binyɛrigu.
en: Those in the field shouldnt come back to grab their clothes.

dag: din ni chɛ ka bɛ doli n zaligunima, ka gbibi n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la, ka saɣi li. Di saha bɛ ni ti nyɛ n niriba, ka m mi nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: Then they will obey my laws and my commands. They will do the things I tell them. They will be my people, and I will be their God.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni yɛl o, Jɛrigu ŋɔ! Yuŋ ŋɔ n ni deeg a nyɛvili, ka a nɛma maa zaa leei ŋun dini.
en: But God said to him, Fool, tonight you will die. Now who will get the things you have prepared for yourself.

dag: Dama daliri din chɛ ka Masia daa kpi ka lan neei kum ni nyɛla ni di chɛ ka o leei bɛn kpi mini bɛn ne Duuma.
en: For Christ died and rose to life in order to be the Lord of the living and of the dead.

dag: Bɛ ni ti laɣim be vol ni sarika ni, ka o yo ba niŋ di ni zali gu bɛ tibidarigibo saha.
en: They will be gathered together like prisoners in a pit, shut into a prison, and punished after many days.

dag: Kul di chɛliya ka Hɛzɛkia chɛ ka yi zaŋ yimaŋ dalim Yawɛ ka yɛra, Yawɛ shiri ni fa ti bahi, ka Asiria naa ku tooi ŋme n-fa tiŋ ŋɔ.
en: And don't let him persuade you to rely on the Lord . Don't think that the Lord will save you and that he will stop our Assyrian army from capturing your city.

dag: Bɛ daa ŋmaligi dolila buɣa n-jɛmdi li. Di nyɛla buɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni daa pun bi mi ni o ni daa bi zaŋ buɣ shɛŋa ti ba.
en: They served other gods that they had never worshiped before, gods that the Lord had forbidden them to worship.

dag: Amaa Naawuni so be alizanda ni ka nyɛ ŋun kahigiri ashiya gbinni wuhiri niriba. Dina n-chɛ ka o kahigi yɛl shɛŋa din ti yɛn niŋ dahin shɛli ha n-wuhi nyin Naa Nɛbukadnɛza. N ni yɛl a a zahindi maa min a ni daa nya ʒii shɛli a gom puuni maa.
en: But there is a God in heaven, who reveals mysteries. He has informed Your Majesty what will happen in the future. Now I will tell you the dream, the vision you had while you were asleep.

dag: Nyamiya, n ʒiɛla dunol ni n-niŋdi gaafara, ka ŋun wum n kukoli ka yooi, n ni kpe dilan sani ka m min o ti laɣim di.
en: Look! Im standing at the door and knocking. If any hear my voice and open the door, I will come in to be with them, and will have dinner with them, and they will have dinner with me.

dag: Wula ka yi ni tooi yɛli, Ti nyɛla gandammoya ka nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biinsi.
en: How can you claim, Were soldiers; were war heroes?.

dag: Anabi Musa ni daa zaŋ wahu kpahi tabili daɣu zuɣu n-zaŋ sa mɔɣu ni shɛm la, di nyɛla talahi ni bɛ ti zaŋ Daadam Bia gba sa zuɣusaa lala.
en: Moses lifted up the snake in the desert. It is the same with the Son of Man. He must be lifted up too.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd ni daa wum dimbɔŋɔnim zaa, di daa birim o pam; dama ninvuɣ shɛb daa yɛliya ni Jɔn Baptaizira n-neei kum ni na maa. Luk .-.
en: Herod the ruler heard about all these things that were happening. He was confused because some people said, John the Baptizer has risen from death.

dag: Daadam, n kabi Firawuna ŋun nyɛ Ijipti naa ŋɔ bɔɣu, ka bɛ bi tar li moya bee n-lo li tani din ni chɛ ka di niŋ yaa, ka o zaŋ li gbaai takɔbi yaha.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, I, the Lord , have defeated the king of Egypt! I broke his arm, and no one has wrapped it or put it in a sling, so that it could heal and get strong enough to hold a sword.

dag: Jɔash yuma daa nyɛla yuma ayopɔin saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pihinahi. O ma yuli n-daa booni Zibia, o daa nyɛla Bɛrishiiba nira.
en: Joash was seven years old when he became king. He ruled years in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Zibiah. Zibiah was from the town of Beersheba.

dag: Babilɔn daa ŋmanila salima pipia m-be Yawɛ nuu ni, ka o daa chɛ ka dunia zuliya kam nyu o wain buɣi ka di zuɣu chɛ ka zuliya kam kpe yinyari.
en: Babylonia was like a gold cup in my hand, making the whole world drunk. The nations drank its wine and went out of their minds.

dag: Zuɣusaa katiŋ ha, paɣim o! Kom din be sagbana zuɣusaa ha, paɣim o.
en: Highest heavens, and the water above the highest heavens, come and offer praise.

dag: Biɛɣuni asiba, yi sa ni nya Yawɛ jilima, dama o wum yi ni ŋumdi yi kparima ni niŋdi ŋun Yawɛ shɛm maa. Dama ti mi lee nyɛla banima, ka yi ŋumdi yi kparima ni niŋdi ti?.
en: You have been complaining about the Lord , and he heard you. So tomorrow morning you will see the Glory of the Lord . You have been complaining and complaining about us. Maybe now we can have a little rest.

dag: Yi ni lo shɛli yi suhuri ni maa ku niŋ. Yi ni tɛhi shɛm nyɛla, chɛ ka ti gba be kaman zuliya shɛb ni be shɛm tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni, ka jɛmdi dari mini kuɣa.
en: They may think they can be like other nations and get away with worshiping idols made of wood and stone. But that will never happen!.

dag: N yɛli ya la dimbɔŋɔnima ni yi nya suhudoo n zuɣu. Yi ni nya nahiŋgu dunia ŋɔ ni, amaa chɛliya ka yi suhuri kpɛma! M pun nyaŋ dunia.
en: I have told you these things so that you can have peace in me. In this world you will have troubles. But be brave! I have defeated the world.

dag: Mani n-daa nyɛ zoomba nina, ka nyɛ gbariti napɔna.
en: I was eyes for the blind, and feet for the lame.

dag: Ka o daa lan tim sapashin so ŋun su tɔbbihi pihinu fukumsi min o tɔbbihi pihinu maa o sani. Ka o daa chaŋ ti yɛl o, Naawuni nira, naa zaligu yɛliya, Siɣim na yomyom! .
en: Ahaziah sent another officer and more soldiers to Elijah. The officer said, Man of God, the king orders you to come see him at once.

dag: Di niŋdiya pakoli kam bee kpibiga alaka.
en: Do not mistreat any widow or orphan.

dag: Chu shɛli din yuli booni Yaɣigari Chuɣu ka lan booni Bɔrɔbɔro din ka Dabindi Chuɣu la puhibu daa ti miri.
en: It was almost time for the Jewish Festival of Unleavened Bread, called the Passover.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Di ŋubiya biŋkpam, nahu kpam bee piɛɣu kpam bee bua kpam.
en: for the people of Israel. No fat of cattle, sheep, or goats shall be eaten.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka biɛrim yiɣisi n niŋgbuna ni m-be kaman paɣa ni yi wolisiri ni o dɔɣi ka biɛrim shɛli mal o la, ka n ni daa wum ka nya ʒii shɛli maa puuni maa chɛ ka dabiɛm gbaai ma.
en: Therefore, Im shaken to my core in anguish. Pains have seized me like the pains of a woman in labor. Im too bent over to hear, too dismayed to see.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lan zaŋ ma chaŋ nuzaa polo dunɔdali ni nti buɣisi li. Ka di mini dina la zaa nyɛ yim.
en: Then the man took me to the north gate. He measured it, and it was the same size as the others.

dag: Yawɛ, kari doli ba ni suhuyiɣisili nti kpihim bɛ birili dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Hunt them down and wipe them off the earth.

dag: ka mali tuuli biŋkɔbigu la yiko n-tumdi yiko tumtumsa tuma biŋkɔbigu maa tooni, ka muɣisiri dunia mini ŋunkam be di ni ni bɛ jɛmmi tuuli biŋkɔbigu ŋun daa mali dan titali din yɛn ku o ka daa lan tib la.
en: It exercises all the authority of the first beast in its presence. It also makes the earth and those who live in it worship the first beast, whose fatal wound was healed.

dag: Molimiya molo ŋɔ zuliya kam zaa ni n-yɛli ba: Malimiya shili n-tuhi tɔbu; bolimiya yi tɔbutuhiriba. Chɛliya ka tɔbutuhiriba zaa yina n-vu m-mirina!.
en: Say to the nations: Get ready for war! Be eager to fight. Line up for battle and prepare to attack.

dag: Yawɛ ti ti nasara. Chɛliya ka ti moli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni tum tuun shɛli ti ti ŋɔ Ziɔn.
en: The Lord says, My people shout, The Lord has shown that we are in the right. Let's go and tell the people in Jerusalem what the Lord our God has done.

dag: N kul ni nyuri bara Yawɛ zuɣu. Chɛ ka bɛn nyari nahiŋgu wum li ka mali suhupiɛlli!.
en: I praise the LORD— let the suffering listen and rejoice.

dag: M bihi, di bi simdi ni ti yurilim nyɛla yɛtɔɣa bee ti ni yɛri shɛm kɔŋko, amaa di simdi ni di nyɛla yurilim maŋli di tuma puuni.
en: My children, our love should not be just words and talk; it must be true love, which shows itself in action.

dag: M paɣiri Yawɛ n suhu ni, ka di bi simdi ni n tam o nirilim yɛla.
en: My soul, praise the Lord and never forget how kind he is!.

dag: Gbaamiya saawara, amaa di ku ku buchi. Tɔɣisimiya gbaai yi ni lo shɛm, amaa di ku zani, dama Naawuni be ti sani.
en: Make your plans! But they will never succeed. Talk all you want to! But it is all useless, because God is with us.

dag: Saha shɛli ti ni daa be nimaani maa ka anab so ŋun yuli daa booni Agabus daa yi Judia na.
en: We had been in Caesarea for several days, when the prophet Agabus came to us from Judea.

dag: Yawɛ ni chɛ ka Ijipti mɔɣili la kom nyuui, ka chɛ ka pɔhim tulli ʒe na ti kpe Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni. Ka o ti pirigi li kulibombih ayopɔin m-mali soli ti ba ka bɛ chaŋ tiŋ du.
en: The Lord will dry up the Gulf of Suez, and he will bring a hot wind to dry up the Euphrates, leaving only seven tiny streams, so that anyone can walk across.

dag: Tinzunnim luri ma la sizuura; ka man dee yi kul yɛli shɛlikam ka bɛ wum, bɛ deerila n noli.
en: After hearing about me, they obey me; foreigners grovel before me.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Sool daa ʒi o yiŋa n-gbibi kpani o nuu ni, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka alizin biɛɣu yaa siɣ o zuɣu na, ka Dauda ŋmɛri mɔɣilo niŋd o.
en: Later, in Sauls house, David was playing the harp. Saul was there with his spear in his hand. Then an evil spirit from the Lord came on Saul.

dag: Paɣ zinalan biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: O dirimi ka nyɛh o noli ka yɛli, M bi tum gala.
en: This is the way of an adulterous woman: she eats and wipes her mouth, and she says, Ive done nothing wrong.

dag: Masia n-nyɛ ti suhudoo. Ŋuna n-daai dimdi goon shɛli din be Yɛhudianim mini zuliya shɛb bɛn kpalim la sunsuuni la luhi, ka zaŋ ba naai taba.
en: Christ has made peace between Jews and Gentiles, and he has united us by breaking down the wall of hatred that separated us. Christ gave his own body.

dag: Chɛ ka o zuliya kpi zaa; ka o yuli kpihim ʒiɛmana din pahir ayi ni.
en: May all his descendants die, and may his name be forgotten in the next generation.

dag: Ka maligumaana Aduna daa du Hɔr Zoli maa zuɣu nti kpi nimaani kaman Yawɛ ni daa zal o shɛm. Izraɛlnim ni daa yi Ijipti na nyaaŋa zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihinahi puuni gol so ŋun pahir anu dahin yini dali n-daa bala.
en: Aaron the priest ascended Mount Hor at the LORDs command, and he died there in the fortieth year on the first day of the fifth month after the Israelites left the land of Egypt.

dag: Bɛ yi ti kpe Ijipti teeku ni ni bɛ gari, n ni chɛ ka di kom pirigi buyi dɔni, ka Nail Mɔɣili bulli la leei tiŋ kuŋ. Ka Asirianim bɛn nyɛ karimbaannim la ti nya filiŋ, ka Ijiptinim bɛn mali kpiɔŋ la mi kɔŋ yiko.
en: When they pass through their sea of trouble, I, the Lord , will strike the waves, and the depths of the Nile will go dry. Proud Assyria will be humbled, and mighty Egypt will lose her power.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Chɛli kumsi, ka nyɛhi nintam a ninni, dama a tuma mali laara. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa. Bɛ ni ti yi bɛ dimnim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni labina.
en: Stop your crying and wipe away your tears. All that you have done for your children will not go unrewarded; they will return from the enemy's land.

dag: Ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka tin ya suhudoo!.
en: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!.

dag: Di saha maa ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be nimaani yɛli Yisa Galilinim ni daa maani ʒim yihibu sara ka Gomna Pailɛt chaŋ ti ku bɛ ni shɛb la yɛla.
en: About this same time Jesus was told that Pilate had given orders for some people from Galilee to be killed while they were offering sacrifices.

dag: Ka Bɔaz daa lan nya tiŋ maa ni kpamba pia m-boli ba ni bɛ gba kamina ti ʒin nimaani. Bɛ ni daa ʒini.
en: Then he took ten men from the towns elders and said, Sit down here. And they sat down.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti be dufahirili zuɣu, ŋun di lan siɣina ni o ti kpe o duu kah o nɛma;.
en: If you are on the roof of your house, don't go inside to get anything.

dag: din ni chɛ ka o ku dih o bihi vi o niriba sunsuuni. Dama mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun mal o ka o be kasi.
en: In this way people will show respect for his children. I, the Lord , have separated the high priest for his special work.

dag: Yaakubu zuliya, di luhiya ni yi yɛl lala? Yawɛ suɣilo maa naami? O niŋsim m-bala? N yɛtɔɣa bi niŋdi ninvuɣ so ŋun tumdi tuun suma zaɣ viɛlli?.
en: Is the LORDs patience cut short? Are these his deeds? Dont my words help the one who behaves righteously?.

dag: Ka Jɔtam daa ti kani, ka bɛ zaŋ o sɔɣi pah o yaannim zuɣu o yab Dauda tiŋ la ni; ka o bia Ahaz daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Jotham died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Ahaz became king.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋdi buhi mini naɣilahi ʒim ni naɣisa so bɛ ni daa zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la tampiligim mihiri niriba niŋgbuna ni di chɛ ka bɛ mali be kasi, ka yi bɛ daadiini kaya dolibu taali ni.
en: The blood of goats and bulls and the ashes of a burnt calf are sprinkled on the people who are ritually unclean, and this purifies them by taking away their ritual impurity.

dag: bɔ n-lee nyɛ ninsalinima ka a tɛhiri bɛ yɛla bee daadamnim lee nyɛla bɔ ka a baɣa be bɛ ni?.
en: Then I ask, Why do you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for us weaklings.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Malimi wahu ŋun mali lɔɣu n-zaŋ tabili da wɔɣinli; ka wahu yi dim sokam ka o lihi li, o ni tiligi.
en: The Lord said to Moses, Make a bronze snake and put it on a pole. If anyone is bitten by a snake, that person should look at the bronze snake on the pole. Then that person will not die.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa Masia daalibarika kpalimmi be yi ni!.
en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, A ku tooi baŋ n ni niŋdi ya shɛli ŋɔ gbinni pumpɔŋɔ, amaa saha shɛli ka a ni ti baŋ di gbinni.
en: Jesus answered, You dont know what I am doing now. But later you will understand.

dag: A ni tooi zaŋ gabiga tu o nyee ni bee n-zaŋ goo kuh o yɛno pili yi?.
en: Can it be led around by a ring in its nose or a hook in its jaw?.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ku niriba, ka wurim bɛ tɔbbihi ni zaani luɣ shɛŋa tuhiri tɔbu, ka chɛ ka bɛ solɔri kpalim zaɣ kuma ka so bi lan dol li; ka chɛ ka bɛ fɔntinsi zani dabari, ka ninsalinim lan ka di ni, ka vuhirigu kam lan ka di ni.
en: The Lord wiped out nations and left fortresses crumbling in the dirt. Their streets and towns were reduced to ruins and emptied of people.

dag: Amaa o min o kpambaliba ni tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba daa bi wum Yawɛ yɛligu shɛli o ni daa chɛ ka anabi Jɛrimia zaŋ yɛli ba maa.
en: But Zedekiah, his officials, and everyone else in Judah ignored everything the Lord had told me.

dag: Ka so daa ka alizanda ni bee dunia ŋɔ ni bee dunia tiŋgbani puuni ŋun ni tooi bɔɣi litaafi maa bee nti tooi lihi di puuni.
en: But no one in heaven or on earth or under the earth could open the scroll or look inside it.

dag: Ka wula ka n lan yɛn yɛli pahi? N lan ka dahima ni n yɛli Gidiɔn mini Barak ni Samsin ni Jɛfita ni Naa Dauda ni Samuɛl ni anabinim bɛn pahi la yɛla.
en: What more can I say? I would run out of time if I told you about Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets.

dag: Ka Saimɔn Pita yɛli ba, Man ni chaŋ kulipaligu. Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti gba ni dol a chaŋ. Ka bɛ daa yi nti kpe ŋariŋ chaŋ, amaa dindali maa yuŋ maa bɛ daa bi gbaai shɛli.
en: Simon Peter told them, Im going fishing. They said, Well go with you. They set out in a boat, but throughout the night they caught nothing.

dag: Ŋun zo n-tiligi maa kandina dazɔhigu dali zaawuni, Yawɛ nuu daa pala n zuɣu. Amaa ŋun zo n-tiligi maa ni daa paai n sanna asiba saha shɛli maa, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka n zilinli lɛbigi, ka n noli yaai, ka n-tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa.
en: The evening before that person came to me, the power of the Lord came on me. The Lord opened my mouth. So when that person came, I could speak again.

dag: Lɔɣimi li, di doli li, ŋmaligim chaŋ ka chɛ li.
en: Don't do it! Keep away from evil! Refuse it and go on your way.

dag: M mi kɔŋsim biɛhigu, ka mi malibu gba biɛhigu. M pun bɔhim baŋ ashili ŋɔ: N ni be luɣ shɛlikam mini saha shɛlikam zaa puuni, n yi nya n-di bee n yi gbe kum, ka n yi mali pam bee n yi malila biɛla n nini tiɣiri li mi.
en: I know what it is to be in need and what it is to have more than enough. I have learned this secret, so that anywhere, at any time, I am content, whether I am full or hungry, whether I have too much or too little.

dag: ni Zɛlɛk ŋun daa nyɛ Ammɔn nir la ni Naharai ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛrɔt nira ka nyɛ Zɛruya bia Jɔab tɔbutuhiri neen ʒira la.
en: Zelek the Ammonite; Naharai from Beeroth, Zeruiahs son and the armor-bearer for Joab.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa ti daŋ yiɣisibu asibaasi m-pa o buŋ nyaampara, ka zaŋ o nachimba ayi min o bia Yisahaku pah omaŋ zuɣu, ka bo dari pahi ni o ti mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la n-daa yi n-chaŋ katiŋa Naawuni ni daa wuh o luɣ shɛli maa.
en: So Abraham got up early the next morning and chopped wood for the fire. He put a saddle on his donkey and set out with Isaac and two servants for the place where God had told him to go.

dag: A yi yi zahira kpahi nir zuɣu ni, di so ashilɔni yurilim.
en: Open criticism is better than hidden love.

dag: Amaa ti Duuma nyɛla ŋun ʒe yim. O ni tin ya kpiɔŋ, ka gbib ya ka Sintani ku paai ya.
en: But the Lord is faithful and will give you strength and protect you from the evil one.

dag: Amaa ka paɣ ŋuni maa yɛli, Aai! M bia n-nyɛ bi nɛɔŋ ŋɔ, ka a bia nyɛ bi kpiɔŋ ŋɔ! Ka paɣ so ŋun daŋ tooni maa yɛli, Aai! A bia n-nyɛ bi kpiɔŋ ŋɔ, ka m bia nyɛ bi nɛɔŋ ŋɔ! Lala ka bɛ daa yɛri naa maa tooni.
en: No! the other woman shouted. He was your son. My baby is alive! The dead baby is yours, the first woman yelled. Mine is alive! They argued back and forth in front of Solomon.

dag: Di saha ka o daa ŋmaligi yɛl o bidib tuuli Jɛta, Yiɣisim ku ba. Amaa ka bia maa daa bi saɣi ŋ-ŋoog o takɔbi. O daa zɔrila dabiɛm, o ni daa na nyɛ bipolli la zuɣu.
en: Gideon turned to Jether, his oldest son. Kill them! Gideon said. But Jether was young, and he was too afraid to even pull out his sword.

dag: O teeya ni bɛ kul nyɛla ninsalinima, ka ŋmani pɔhim din ʒe n-gari ka ku lan tooi labina.
en: He remembered that they were only mortal beings, like a wind that blows by and is gone.

dag: Asha tiŋgban ni ni ti mali bindir suma. O ni ti mali bindir shɛŋa di ni simdi ni naa di.
en: Asher grows fine foods, and he will supply the kings delicacies.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yawɛ malaika maa daa lan tirisi tooni ha ti zani luɣ muɣiliŋga shee ka palo lan kani ka nir ni tooi birigi nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo.
en: Later, the Lord s angel stood at another place where the road became narrow. There was no place where the donkey could go around him. It could not turn to the left or to the right.

dag: Juda zuliya bɛn daa be nimaani gbilligbilli kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihiniinaayɔbu ni kɔbisinahi. Bɛna nti yɛn be tooni chana.
en: The total number of men in Judahs camp is . All these men are divided into their different tribes. Judah will be the first group to move when the people travel from one place to another.

dag: ka tiwula ata be di zuɣu, ka di ni sa kul piligi puhiri vari ka dii daai pum n-wali wala ka di mooi.
en: with three branches on it. As soon as the leaves came out, the blossoms appeared, and the grapes ripened.

dag: Bɛ kpari Nɛgɛbinim niŋ bɛ fɔntinsi ni, ka so kani ŋun ni kparigi ba. Bɛ gbahi Judanim zaa chaŋ.
en: The cities in the Southern Desert are surrounded; no one can get in or out. Everyone in Judah will be taken away.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-daa beni Jɔshua bia Joyakim ŋun daa nyɛ Jɔzadak yaaŋa la saha mini Nɛhimia ŋun daa nyɛ gomna la mini Ɛzra ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana ni zaligubaŋda la gba saha.
en: All of these men lived during the time of Joiakim and during the time that I was governor and Ezra, a teacher of the Law of Moses, was priest.

dag: Dama o ni chɛ ka o malaikanim gul a a chandi shee zaa.
en: Because he will order his messengers to help you, to protect you wherever you go.

dag: Ka Dilaila daa kul zaŋ di yɛla kaɣili Samsin biɛɣukam, ka kul mal li dol o hal ka o nyee ti nyɔni pam di zuɣu.
en: She nagged him with her words day after day and begged him until he became worn out to the point of death.

dag: Jɛta ŋun daa nyɛ Shammai mabia la bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Jɛtɛrit mini Jɔnatan, Amaa ka Jɛta ŋun daa bi dɔɣi bia ka kpi.
en: The family of Jada, Shammais brother: Jether and Jonathan, but Jether died without children.

dag: ka pumpɔŋɔ o shiri niŋ o ni daa yɛli ni o ni niŋ shɛm maa, yi zaa ni tum alahichi Yawɛ sani ka bi deeg o nol la zuɣu. Dinzuɣu ka yɛlli ŋɔ paai ya maa.
en: and now he has done what he said he would. All this happened because your people sinned against the Lord and disobeyed him.

dag: ka o suhu ti maai ka o tam a ni niŋ o shɛm maa yɛla. Di nyaaŋa ka n naan yi tim na ka bɛ ti zaŋ a na. Bɔzuɣu ka n yɛn kɔŋ m bidibis ayi zaa dahin yini.
en: and he forgets what you have done to him. Then I will send someone to bring you back. Why should I lose both of my sons on the same day.

dag: Ka tumtumdiba maa daa tum tuma, ka duu maa malibu tuma chaŋ tooni. Ka bɛ daa mali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ka di be kaman di ni daa pun be shɛm, ka lan niŋ yaa pahi.
en: The workers labored hard, and the restoration progressed smoothly under their control until they had brought Gods temple back to its original state and reinforced it.

dag: Wula ka a yɛn tooi niŋ tuhi nyaŋ n dan sapashin bil yino gba, a yi du m-bala Ijiptinim ni bɛ ti a chɛchɛbunsi mini wɔribariba?.
en: But even then you couldnt beat one of my masters lowest ranking officers. So why do you still depend on Egypts chariots and horse soldiers?.

dag: Ka o daa yi n nyaaŋa n-kana ti ŋma ʒiri pa ma nyini n dan naa sani. Amaa nyini n dan naa ŋmanila Naawuni malaika, dinzuɣu niŋm a ni nya ka shɛli viɛl a sani.
en: But my servant tricked me and said bad things about me. My lord and king, you are like an angel from God. Do whatever you think is right.

dag: N yaa kuumi kaman salichee la, ka n zilinli chaŋ ti tabili n yɛno; a zaŋ ma sɔŋ la kum taŋkpaɣu ni.
en: My strength is dried up like a piece of broken pottery. My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth; youve set me down in the dirt of death.

dag: Ɛtan bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Azaria.
en: Ethan had one son, Azariah.

dag: O daa zaŋ ma zali pal tital ni. O daa tiligi ma, dama o nini daa tiɣi ma.
en: When I was fenced in, you freed and rescued me because you love me.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: M poya, zuliya shɛb bɛn gili ya ŋɔ zaa gba ni ti nya turi.
en: I, the Sovereign Lord , solemnly promise that the surrounding nations will be humiliated.

dag: Ka Aduna garigi yɛl o, N dana, di chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi pam bahi n zuɣu, a mi ni niriba maa suhuri zaa kul yɛla zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu zuɣu.
en: Aaron answered, Dont be angry, sir. You know that these people are always ready to do wrong.

dag: Ka o daa mali dundɔŋ, ka zaŋ tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli n-she pateesa din wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pihinahinaanahi n-yili di nudirigu polo.
en: For the Tent of the Lord 's presence he made the enclosure out of fine linen curtains. On the south side the curtains were yards long.

dag: Di saha ka Ayuba daa garigi yɛli.
en: Listen to what I am saying; that is all the comfort I ask from you.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ yɛl o, Bɔzuɣu ka bɛ niŋ ti tizɔpaɣ maa kaman pagɔrili n-nyɛ o maa.
en: But they answered, We cannot let our sister be treated like a common whore.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɛnkam ʒe Ijipti nyaaŋa ni ti lu, ka di ni mali yaa shɛli nyuri bara la naai. Bɛ ni ti zaŋ takɔbi ku ba, zaŋ Migidol hal ni Sine. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The LORD proclaims: When Egypts helpers fall, its proud strength will decline. From Migdol to Syene they will fall by the sword. This is what the LORD God says.

dag: Yi ni nya kpahimbu shɛŋa pam la zaa kpalimla yoli? Di yi shiri nyɛla yoli, m bɔri ni m baŋ.
en: You have experienced many things. Were all those experiences wasted? I hope they were not wasted!.

dag: Yɛlimuɣisira nyɛla din gbarigiri nira, amaa yɛtɔɣ viɛlli nyɛla din kpaŋsiri nira.
en: Worry takes away your joy, but a kind word makes you happy.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan pii fɔntins anahi Dan zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni. Dina n-nyɛ: Ɛlitɛke mini Gibɛtɔn.
en: From the territory of Dan they were given four cities: Eltekeh, Gibbethon.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Ammɔnnim tuumbiɛri buta ni bunahi zuɣu, n ku chɛ bɛ tibili darigibu. Dama bɛ ni tuhiri ni bɛ deei tiŋgbani palo pahi la zuɣu, bɛ daa kuhi karigi paɣipuhinim puya Giliad.
en: The Lord said: I will punish Ammon for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. In Gilead they ripped open pregnant women, just to take the land.

dag: Di saha maa ha Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni binyara zaŋ kɔhi tab zuɣu bee n-zaŋ taɣi tab yɛla ŋmaabu kali daa yi nyɛla ŋun kɔhiri pirig o namdili ti ŋun dara, lala ka Izraɛlnim daa yi niŋdi ŋmaari yɛla.
en: To make a sale legal in those days, one person would take off a sandal and give it to the other.

dag: Amaa binshɛɣukam zaa yi ti be o naba ni, di saha Naawuni Bia maa maŋmaŋ gba ni ti zaŋ omaŋ ti Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ŋun zaŋ binshɛɣukam sɔŋ o naba ni maa, ka di chɛ ka Naawuni su binshɛɣukam zaa, ka nyɛ binshɛɣukam sokam zaa sani.
en: But when all things have been placed under Christ's rule, then he himself, the Son, will place himself under God, who placed all things under him; and God will rule completely over all.

dag: Bɛ ku zo n-yi zibisim ni, buɣim ni di bɛ wulimama, ka pɔhim ʒe bɛ puma bahi.
en: He will not escape the darkness. He will be like a tree whose leaves die from disease and are blown away by the wind.

dag: Juda Naa Jɔsia bia Jɛhoyakim nam dibu yuma anahi ni ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ:.
en: During the fourth year that Jehoiakim son of Josiah was king of Judah, the Lord said to me, Jeremiah.

dag: Ka m bɔhi malaika so ŋun daa yɛli ma yɛtɔɣa maa, Ya ka bɛ lee mal li chana.
en: I asked the angel, Where are they taking it.

dag: bee n-kpuɣiri bɛ neem bihibihi. Amaa bɛ lee chɛ ka bɛ bebu kahigi wuhi ni bɛ nyɛla bɛn ʒe yim ni yɛlimaŋli ni be shɛb ni, ka di chɛ ka Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira ŋɔ yɛla wuhibu la nya jilima bɛ ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa puuni.
en: or steal from them. They must be completely honest and trustworthy. Then everyone will show great respect for what is taught about God our Savior.

dag: Ka Dauda daa wum lala ka chɛ ka Jɔab zaŋ o tɔbbi kpɛma zaa chaŋ bɛ tuhibu.
en: David heard what they had done, and he sent out Joab with all of his well-trained soldiers.

dag: Ka din gari lala nyɛla, di yi shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli ni kpiimba bi neeri kum ni, dindina Naawuni daa bi neei Masia kum ni m-bala, ka ti gba leei bɛn ŋma ʒiri pa Naawuni, dama ti pun di Naawuni shɛhira ni o daa neei Masia kum ni.
en: We are found to be false witnesses about God, because we testified against God that he raised Christ, when he didnt raise him if its the case that the dead arent raised.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli Nuhu.
en: God said to Noah.

dag: Ifriim nyɛla m biyurigu. O nyɛla n suhu ni yuri so pam. N yi kul galim o bushɛm, lala ka n lan teer o yɛla. Dinzuɣu m puu biɛri o zuɣu pam. Biɛhiŋ kani, n ni zo o nambɔɣu. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The Lord says, You know that Ephraim is my dear son. I love that child. Yes, I often criticized Ephraim, but I still think about him. I love him very much, and I really do want to comfort him.

dag: Ti mabihi bɛn nyɛ ti Duuma ni yuri shɛb la, di kpala talahi ni ti kul paɣiri Naawuni yi zuɣu sahakam, dama piligu ni ha ka Naawuni daa zali ya ni yi nya tiliginsim, yi ni niŋ yɛlimaŋli la yɛda ka Naawuni Shia Kasi mali ya ka yi be kasi la zuɣu.
en: We must thank God at all times for you, friends, you whom the Lord loves. For God chose you as the first to be saved by the Spirit's power to make you his holy people and by your faith in the truth.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔhi nachimbil so ŋun daa yɛl o li maa, Tiŋ kani ka a lee yina? Ka o garigi yɛl o, N nyɛla Amalɛk saan so ŋun be a tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni bia.
en: David asked the young man who had brought him the news, Where are you from? He answered, I'm an Amalekite, but I live in your country.

dag: Obadia bia Ishimaya n-daa nyɛ Zɛbulɔn zuliya ni kpɛma, ka Kɛrimɔt ŋun daa nyɛ Aziriɛl bia la daa nyɛ Naftali zuliya kpɛma.
en: for Zebulun—Ishmaiah, Obadiahs son; for Naphtali—Jerimoth, Azriels son.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa ti yi o nyaandoliba piniyini bɛn daa kpalim la zuɣu, ka bɛ ʒimi diri bindirigu. Ka o daa galim ba bɛ ni nyɛ suhutunanim mini bɛ biɛhiŋ zuɣu, dama bɛ daa bi niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nya o o kum ni neebu nyaaŋa la yɛligu yɛda.
en: Finally he appeared to the eleven while they were eating. Jesus criticized their unbelief and stubbornness because they didnt believe those who saw him after he was raised up.

dag: Dolimi naa nyɛvili; ka chɛ ka o kul be ʒiɛmani kam ni!.
en: Give the king a long life. Let him live forever!.

dag: M bi suhir a ni a yihi ba dunia ŋɔ ni, amaa n suhir a mi ni a gbib ba ka Sintani ku paai ba.
en: I am not asking you to take them out of the world. But I am asking that you keep them safe from the Evil One.

dag: Ka malaikanima ayopɔin bɛn mal alɔbo balibu ayopɔin la daa yi jɛmbu duu maa ni na. Bɛ daa yɛla binyɛra din paligi paratɛte kaman gol la, ka zaŋ salima nyolɔra lo bɛ nyɔri.
en: And the seven angels who were bringing the terrible troubles were coming out of it. They were dressed in robes of pure white linen and wore belts made of pure gold.

dag: nti yɛli Aduna, Zaŋm naɣila polli mali alahichi sanyoo sara, ka zaŋ piɛlaa mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la. Di simdi ni bɛ zaa nyɛla bɛn ka dalima, ka a zaŋ ba mali sara ti Yawɛ.
en: Then he said to Aaron: Find a young bull and a ram that have nothing wrong with them. Offer the bull to the Lord as a sacrifice for sin and the ram as a sacrifice to please him.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa kpuɣ o jaaŋgbee maa zuɣusaa ŋ-ŋme tampiŋ maa buyi, ka kom pam daa yi di ni na, ka niriba maa mini bɛ biŋkɔbiri maa daa nyu.
en: Moses lifted his arm and hit the rock twice. Water began flowing from the rock, and the people and their animals drank that water.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, a chɛ ti bahi yɔbahi sunsuuni, ka lan chɛ ti niŋ zibisim tital ni.
en: But you crushed us in this home of jackals. You left us in this place as dark as death.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa zaŋ ba niŋ foliŋga maa zuɣusaa ni bɛ ne dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: He placed the lights in the sky to shine on the earth.

dag: Ka o yɛli, N yɛli noli ti Keenan. O ni nyɛla o biɛyanim dabili.
en: he said, May there be a curse on Canaan ! May he be a slave to his brothers.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ tizɔpaɣ Ribɛka min o yiŋ dab paɣa doli Ibrahimma nachin kpɛm maa mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa dol o maa.
en: So they let Rebecca and her old family servant go with Abraham's servant and his men.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee zali dimbɔŋɔ ka niŋ li, ka wuhi ʒiɛmana yɛla piligu ni zaŋ kana? Man Yawɛ n-daa beni piligu ni, ka ni lan beni naabu ni.
en: Who was able to make all this happen? Who controlled the lives of everyone from the beginning? I, the Lord , am the one. I was here at the beginning, and I will be here when all things are finished.

dag: A zaligu maa yi di pala n suhu ni yu shɛli, n naan bahi yoli n nandahima ŋɔ ni.
en: If I had not found happiness in obeying your Law, I would have died in misery.

dag: O zaŋm binyɛribil piɛl kasi ye, ka so jinjɛŋŋma piɛlli, ka zaŋ shɛlɔr piɛlli lo o shee ni ka vili bantabiga. Di nyɛla situr shɛli din be kasi. O sum kom pɔi ka naanyi zaŋ li niŋ omaŋa.
en: You will take a bath and put on the sacred linen clothes, including the underwear, the robe, the sash, and the turban.

dag: O ni daa nya salo maa, ka bɛ yɛla niŋ o nambɔɣu pam, dama bɛ daa nyɛla bɛn nyari nahiŋgu ka bi nyari sɔŋsim; bɛ daa ŋmanila piɛri bɛn ka gula.
en: When he saw the crowds, he felt sorry for them. They were confused and helpless, like sheep without a shepherd.

dag: Yi ni yɛn tiri kpam mi shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Kpa ŋmani kam puuni, yihimiya kuruwa pirigibu bupia puuni yim zuɣu ti.
en: a regular amount of oil, one-tenth of a bath for each kor.

dag: Dama Izraɛlnim ni daa taai duŋ niŋ ma Zin mɔɣu ni la, a daa zaɣisi n yɛligu, ka chɛ ka niriba maa bi nya n kasitali kom la shee. .
en: Remember when the people became angry at the water in the desert of Zin. Both you and Aaron refused to obey my command. You did not honor me and show the people that I am holy.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka sagbana bɔɣi ka o siɣina, ka zibisim titali be o naba tiŋli.
en: You opened the heavens like curtains, and you came down with storm clouds under your feet.

dag: Dama molo yi Dan tiŋgbani polo na n-yɛra ni alɔbo yi Ifriim tiŋgbani zoli polo na.
en: Listen! The voice of a messenger from the land of Dan is speaking. Someone is bringing bad news from the hill country of Ephraim :.

dag: Ka o daa tahi tɔbbihi ti ʒili Ɛdom; o daa ʒili tɔbbihi Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni luɣilikam. Ka Ɛdomnim maa zaa daa leei ŋun Dauda ni su shɛba. Ka Yawɛ daa kul tiri Dauda nasara luɣ shɛlikam zaa o ni chaŋ.
en: He set up military camps throughout Edom, and the people there became his subjects. The Lord made David victorious everywhere.

dag: Ka Yisa daa bɔhi ba, N ni daa tim ya ka yi bi ʒi liɣiri kolibihi bee adiikunima bee namdanim la, shɛli daa ti pooi ya? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Aai, shɛli daa bi pooi ti.
en: Then Jesus said to the apostles, Remember when I sent you out without money, a bag, or sandals? Did you need anything? The apostles said, No.

dag: n daa chani gbinfini, ka yi ti ma situra; n daa biɛra, ka yi kaari ma; ka n daa ti be sarika ni, ka yi kani n sanna ti kaari ma.
en: When I was without clothes, you gave me something to wear. When I was sick, you cared for me. When I was in prison, you came to visit me.

dag: Mbusim be yi zuɣu, yi zaŋla ʒiri gabisi vɔri tuumbiɛri, ka vɔri alahichi kaman tɔroko din mali gabisi la.
en: You are in for trouble! The lies you tell are like ropes by which you drag along sin and evil.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ piɛlaa na ni bɛ ti mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la, ka Aduna min o bidibisi maa daa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa piɛlaa maa zuɣu ni.
en: Moses led out the ram for the sacrifice to please the Lord . After Aaron and his sons had laid their hands on its head.

dag: Kulla di saha maa ka niriba ata daa yi Siizaria paai yil shɛli n ni daa be maa na. Bɛ daa tim ba la n sanna.
en: Suddenly there were three men standing outside the house where I was staying. They had been sent from Caesarea to get me.

dag: ka yɛli li, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: M bi ʒe a nyaaŋa, nyini Seir Zoli. N teela n nuu jɛnd a ni n chɛ ka a zani dabari bahi yoli.
en: Say to it, The LORD God proclaims: Im against you, Mount Seir! I will use my power against you. I will make you into a desolate wasteland.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ n dan naa, di chɛ ka di muɣis a kaman a bihi maa zaa n-shiri kpi la, dama Amnɔn kɔŋko n-kpi.
en: Don't worry about the report that all your sons were killed. Only Amnon is dead.

dag: Ka Jɔn nyaandoliba daa chaŋ ti zaŋ Jɔn ti sɔɣi, ka chaŋ ti yɛli Yisa.
en: John's followers took his body and buried it. Then they told Jesus what had happened.

dag: Bɛ di n-tiɣi nyaaŋa, bɛ ni ti be muɣisigu ni. Ka yɛlibiɛɣu kam zaa ni ti ka bɛ zuɣu na.
en: Once they have everything, distress and despair will strike them down.

dag: Salima bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Bɛtilihɛm ŋun daa lan nyɛ Nɛtɔfa nir la mini Atirɔtibɛtijɔab ni Manahatinim pirigili ni Zɔrinima.
en: The family of Salma, Bethlehems father: the Netophathites, Atroth-beth-joab, half of the Manahathites, and the Zorites.

dag: Bundana tɛhiya ni o mali yɛm omaŋ duhibu ni, amaa faralan ŋun mali fahim ni nya li o biɛhigu ni.
en: Rich people always think they are wise, but a poor person who has insight into character knows better.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti mi ni bɛ yi lab me tiŋ maa ka me di goma maa gba naai, Naa, nyin baŋmi ni a ku lan tooi su Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli wulinluhili polo yaɣili maa nima.
en: King Artaxerxes, we wish to inform you that if this city and its walls are rebuilt, you will lose control of the area west of the Euphrates River.

dag: Dinzuɣu, pumpɔŋɔ n ni kuli n ya, amaa kamina ka n wuh a niriba ŋɔ ni ti yɛn niŋ a niriba shɛm dahin shɛli ha.
en: Balaam said to Balak, Now I am going back to my own people, but before I go, I am warning you what the people of Israel will do to your people in the future.

dag: Ka Pool daa yaa chaŋ bɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni Vuhim Dabisa buta pa taba, ka o mini ba ti tɔɣisiri Naawuni yɛla.
en: So as usual, Paul went there to worship, and on three Sabbaths he spoke to the people. He used the Scriptures.

dag: Ayuba ni daa suhi Naawuni ti o zɔnim maa nyaaŋa, ka Yawɛ daa lan labisi Ayuba buni ti o. Yawɛ daa tila Ayuba o ni daa pun mali shɛli ʒii buyi zuɣu.
en: Job prayed for his friends, and the Lord made Job successful again. The Lord gave him twice as much as he had before.

dag: bɛn daa nyɛ tɔbbihi bɛn ye binyɛr sabilifaa la ni. Bɛ shɛb daa nyɛla Gomnanima, ka shɛb nyɛ sapashinnima. Bɛ zaa daa nyɛla nachimbihi viɛla bɛn nyɛ wɔribariba.
en: in their blue uniforms. They were all handsome young men riding horses. They were leaders and officers.

dag: Yurilim maŋli mini ʒiɛyimtali ni tuhi taba soli; ka wuntitali mini suhudoo mi puhi taba.
en: Love and loyalty will come together; goodness and peace will unite.

dag: A ŋmanila ŋmani ŋun be tampima voya ni. Chɛ ka n nya a ninni tampima voya maa ni. Chɛ ka n wum a kukoli, dama a kukoli viɛli pam, ka a ninni viɛli pam.
en: My dove—in the rock crevices, hidden in the cliff face— let me catch sight of you; let me hear your voice! The sound of your voice is sweet, and the sight of you is lovely.

dag: Zɔrinima! Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi niŋdi lala? Ti nyɛla ninsalinim kaman yi gba, ka zaŋ lahibal suŋ na ni ti ti tin ya, ka yi chɛ bin yoya ŋɔ jɛmbu ka niŋ Naawuni ŋun be ka nam zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani ni teeku ni binshɛɣukam din be di ni ŋɔ yɛda.
en: Why are you doing this? We ourselves are only human beings like you! We are here to announce the Good News, to turn you away from these worthless things to the living God, who made heaven, earth, sea, and all that is in them.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa maa daa yɛli, Gbaamiya Mikaya n-zaŋ o ti ti Amɔn ŋun nyɛ tiŋ ŋɔ Gomna la mini nabia Jɔash.
en: Ahab shouted, Arrest Micaiah! Take him to Prince Joash and Governor Amon of Samaria.

dag: Benya kaman biliɛri la din ni chɛ ka yi suhuri kul ye Naawuni yɛligu din ŋmani bihim alal la zuɣu, ka di chɛ ka yi tooi zooi nya tiliginsim.
en: Be like newborn babies, always thirsty for the pure spiritual milk, so that by drinking it you may grow up and be saved.

dag: Ansarisimaana bɔrila yɛm kɔŋda, amaa baŋsim yɛla bi to ŋun mali tɛhi zilima sani.
en: A mocker searches for wisdom and gets none, but knowledge comes quickly to the intelligent.

dag: ka Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa daa tam di zuɣu; ka Ahio daa be Alikauli Adaka maa tooni.
en: with Ahio walking in front.

dag: Di saha tiŋ maa dɔbba zaa bɛn labim o kuɣa ku o. Lala ka yi ni niŋ n-yihi zaɣ biɛɣu maa yi sunsuuni, ka Izraɛlnim zaa wum di yɛla ka dabiɛm gbahi ba.
en: Then the men of the city are to stone him to death, and so you will get rid of this evil. Everyone in Israel will hear what has happened and be afraid.

dag: Bolimiya Yawɛ yuli m-puh o. Chɛliya ka zuliya kam zaa baŋ o ni tum tuun kar shɛŋa yɛla.
en: Give thanks to the Lord and call out to him! Tell the nations what he has done!.

dag: Gɛbal kpamba mini di yɛnnim daa bela a sani m-maani a shee kpatuɣa zaana. Teeku puuni ŋarima zaa mini di kpatoonsi zaa daa nyɛla bɛn be a ni dar a nɛma.
en: The elders and wise men of Gebal were in you, patching up your leaks. Every seagoing ship and its sailors came to do business with you.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa yi fɔŋ maa ni chani Yisa sani.
en: Everyone in town went out to see Jesus.

dag: bɛ yɛr o mi, Dindina yɛlim Shibolɛt. Ka o yɛli, Sibolɛt, ka dilan ni ku tooi yɛl li viɛnyɛliŋga maa zuɣu, bɛ gbaar o mi ku o Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili dubu shee maa. Ka bɛ daa ku Ifriim zuliya niriba maa ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahinaayi di saha maa.
en: they would tell him, Then say shibboleth . But he would say, sibboleth , because he couldnt pronounce it correctly. So they would seize him and kill him at the Jordans crossing points. Forty-two thousand of the Ephraimites fell at that time.

dag: Ka bɛ daa neeg o yɛl o, Ti Duuma, ti Duuma, kom yɛn di ti! Ka o neei n-tahi sanʒiɛɣu maa mini kɔgbana maa zuɣu, ka di zaa dii fo baalim.
en: So they went to Jesus and woke him up, Master, Master! We are about to drown! Jesus got up and ordered the wind and waves to stop. They obeyed, and everything was calm.

dag: Sagbana yi ti pali kom, saa lurimina, ka tia yi lu n-kpala nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo, di ni lu luɣ shɛli maa, nimaani ka di yɛn doya.
en: Rain clouds always bring rain; trees always stay wherever they fall.

dag: Di saha ka dabiɛm daa gbaai Adɔnija saamba maa zaa, ka bɛ vaai yiɣisi, ka bɛ zaa yinoyino zaŋ kpa o kpabu polo.
en: Trembling with fear, all of Adonijahs guests got up and fled, each going a different way.

dag: Ŋunkam ŋubi n niŋgbuŋ ka nyu n ʒim, dilana be n ni ka n gba be o ni.
en: Whoever eats my flesh and drinks my blood remains in me and I in them.

dag: Hal ninvuɣ pia puuni ninvuɣ yino yi kpalim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, bɛ ni ku o gba. O ni bemi kaman oki ti shɛli bɛ ni ŋma n-luhi ka chɛ di tigbirigu. Tigbirigu maa nyɛla bimbirili din be kasi din ni lan zooi yaha.
en: A tenth of the people will be allowed to stay in the land, but it will be destroyed again. They will be like an oak tree. When the tree is chopped down, a stump is left. This stump will be a very special seed that will grow again.

dag: Ka Malikija ŋun daa nyɛ salindoora la daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu. O daa mal li mi me hal ti paai Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba mini kɔhigɔriba yili din daa be Vihibu Dunɔdali shee la hal ti paai zuɣusaa duu din daa be gɔŋbu shee la.
en: After him, Malchiah, one of the goldsmiths, made repairs as far as the house of the temple servants and the merchants, opposite the Parade Gate, and as far as the upper room at the corner.

dag: bɛn daa nyɛ tɔbbihi bɛn ye binyɛr sabilifaa la ni. Bɛ shɛb daa nyɛla Gomnanima, ka shɛb nyɛ sapashinnima. Bɛ zaa daa nyɛla nachimbihi viɛla bɛn nyɛ wɔribariba.
en: warriors dressed in fine blue cloth, governors and officers, charioteers and horsemen, all of them the most handsome of men.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛrubaal mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o sani zaa daa daŋ yibu chaŋ ti dɔni baɣili Harɔd kulibɔŋ. Ka Midiannim mi daa do vinvamli ni zaŋ lab nuzaa polo miri Mɔre daboli.
en: Early the next morning, Gideon and his army got up and moved their camp to Fear Spring. The Midianite camp was to the north, in the valley at the foot of Moreh Hill.

dag: Ka di tooi biɛla ka so lan nya o n-yɛli, A gba nyɛla bɛ ni yino! Ka Pita yɛli, Zɔri, m pala bɛ ni yino.
en: A little while later, someone else saw him and said, You are one of them too. But Peter said, Man, Im not.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila gbuɣinli ŋun sɔɣ do n-gu m-bɔri ni o dari tɔhi ma. Bɛ ŋmanila gbuɣin polli ŋun sɔɣi doya.
en: Like hungry lions, they want to kill and eat. Like young lions, they hide, ready to attack.

dag: Sool ni daa kuli ti tuhi Filistianim maa ka labina ka bɛ yɛl o, Nyama Dauda be Ɛngɛdi.
en: When Saul got back from fighting off the Philistines, he heard that David was in the desert around En-Gedi.

dag: Bɛ yi kurim bee bɛ yi damdi, bɛ ni yɛn gbahi shɛb maa lurimi bɛ kpiɔŋ zuɣu.
en: They crouch down and wait to grab a victim.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛl o deemba maa Yawɛ ni daa niŋ Firawuna mini Ijiptinim shɛm zaa n-ti bɛn Izraɛlnima. Ka lan yɛl o muɣisigu shɛŋa zaa din paai ba soli maa ni yɛla ni Yawɛ ni yihi ba muɣisigu maa ni shɛm.
en: Moses told Jethro everything that the Lord had done to the king and the people of Egypt in order to rescue the Israelites. He also told him about the hardships the people had faced on the way and how the Lord had saved them.

dag: Lɛbanɔn tihi zaa dari ku saɣi sara maligu buɣim; ka di biŋkɔbiri zaa ku saɣi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la malibu.
en: Lebanon doesnt have enough fuel; its animals arent enough for an entirely burned offering.

dag: Ka o daa garigi yɛl o, N ni gbaai m buzɔŋ ni bubil polli ti a. Ka paɣ maa bɔh o, Ka bimbɔ ka a yɛn zaŋ ti ma ka di nyɛ alikauli lɔbu shɛhira hal ka a ti zaŋ bua maa ti ma na.
en: He said, I will give you a kid goat from my flock. She said, Only if you give me some deposit, as security to guarantee that you will send it.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti tooi li ti niriba maa ni bɛ piɛbi. Bɛ ni daa piɛbiri ʒiɛri maa ka bɛ ti kuhi yɛli, Wɛi, Naawuni nira, Lɔɣu be duɣu maa ni! Ka bɛ daa kɔŋ li piɛbbu.
en: The stew was poured out for the men to eat, but as soon as they tasted it they exclaimed to Elisha, It's poisoned!—and wouldn't eat it.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa ŋmaligi yul o nyaandoliba maa ti tuui taba ka yɛli ba, Di to ni bundaannim kpe Naawuni nam ni.
en: Looking around, Jesus said to his disciples, It will be very hard for the wealthy to enter Gods kingdom.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yi nimaani chaŋ Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya zuɣu tiŋ maa ni ti kpe Maika yiŋa.
en: From there the men traveled on to the hill country of Ephraim. Then they came to Micahs house.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun ku tooi gbaag omaŋa ŋmanila bɛ ni kabi kpe gooni ni gili tin shɛli ni shɛm la.
en: A person without self-control is like a breached city, one with no walls.

dag: ka di chɛ ka yi tooi pii din tuhi gari shɛlikam, ka chɛ ka yi yi daɣiri tuma zaa mini galimi ni Masia labbuna dabisili la dali.
en: that you will see the difference between what is important and what is not and choose what is important; that you will be pure and blameless for the coming of Christ;.

dag: Ʒii shɛli gbinni bɛ ni daa kahigi wuh a zaŋ chaŋ zaawuni min asiba sara maligu shɛŋa yɛla polo la nyɛla din ni niŋ yɛlimaŋli. Amaa lee gbib li ashilɔni, dama di ni yɛn niŋ pali saha shɛli maa na wɔɣ pam.
en: This vision about the evening and morning sacrifices which has been explained to you will come true. But keep it secret now, because it will be a long time before it does come true.

dag: O niriba kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahi ni yini ni kɔbisinu.
en: His military unit and those enlisted in it are .

dag: N ni zaŋ kuɣ yini shɛli din mali nina ayopɔin sɔŋ Jɔshua tooni; ka sab sabbu shɛli pa di zuɣu yɛli, Dahin yini puuni, n ni ti yihi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ daalahichi bahi.
