en: See this stone that I have put before Joshua. Upon one stone, there are seven facets. I am about to engrave an inscription on it, says the LORD of heavenly forces. I will remove the guilt of that land in one day.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛl o, Mani m-bala, Cham ti yɛl a dana Nyama, Ilaija be kpe. .
en: Yes, I'm Elijah, he answered. Go and tell your master the king that I am here.

dag: Di saha ka n-daa lan nya alahiziba shihir titali alizanda ni. Malaikanima ayopɔin n-daa mal alɔbo balibu ayopɔin din kpalim nyaaŋa, dina n-daa nyɛ Naawuni suhuyiɣisili alɔbɔnim din bahindi nyaaŋa.
en: Then I saw another wonder in heaven. It was great and amazing. There were seven angels bringing seven plagues. These are the last plagues, because after these, Gods anger is finished.

dag: Ka a nuu bee a napɔŋ yi chɛ ka a yɛn birigi tum alahichi, nyin ŋmaam li bahi, dama a yi kɔŋ a nu yini bee a napɔn yini ka ti be, di so ni a mali nuh ayi bee napɔna ayi ka bɛ ti zaŋ a kpɛhi buɣim din bi kpiri ni.
en: If your hand or your foot makes you lose your faith, cut it off and throw it away! It is better for you to enter life without a hand or a foot than to keep both hands and both feet and be thrown into the eternal fire.

dag: Ka a zaŋ Aduna maligumaana leebu piɛlaa nyɔɣu polo n-gahi zuɣusaa, ka di leei sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ gahi zuɣusaa Yawɛ tooni, ka di leeg a tarili.
en: Take the breast of this ram and dedicate it to me as a special gift. This part of the animal will be yours.

dag: Saha kanna, hal di paaya gba, ka yi ni ti wurim zo n-kuli yi yinsi ka chɛ ma n ko, amaa m pala n ko, dama m Ba maa be n sani.
en: The time is coming, and is already here, when all of you will be scattered, each of you to your own home, and I will be left all alone. But I am not really alone, because the Father is with me.

dag: yurilim zuɣu chɛ ka n naɣ suhir a mi. Man Pool ŋun nyɛ ninkurigu ka lan nyɛ dansarika Yisa Masia zuɣu la.
en: But I would rather ask you to do it simply because of love. Yes, as someone in jail for Christ.

dag: Amaa nir yi zaŋ kurigu ŋme so ka o kpi, o nyɛla ninvuɣ kura, bɛn kum o.
en: But if someone strikes a person with an iron object and he dies, he is a murderer. The murderer must definitely be put to death.

dag: Amaa pa dimbɔŋɔ kɔŋko. Din pahi nyɛla, ti mali suhupiɛlli Naawuni sani ti Duuma Yisa Masia ŋun daa chɛ ka simdi kpe ti mini Naawuni sunsuuni maa zuɣu.
en: And in addition to everything else, we are happy because God sent our Lord Jesus Christ to make peace with us.

dag: Dama Yawɛ n-su ti nyɔtaɣirigu, Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ n-su ti naa.
en: because our shield is the LORDs own; our king belongs to the holy one of Israel!.

dag: Ka yi yi ti kpe yil shɛli, yin daŋmi yili maa nim puhibu ŋ-ŋɔ: Naawuni niŋmi alibarika niŋ yili ŋɔ nim ni.
en: As soon as you enter a home, say, God bless this home with peace.

dag: Nyaandol maa n-nyɛ ŋun di dimbɔŋɔnim shɛhira ni ŋun sabi dimbɔŋɔnim ŋɔ, ka ti mi ni o shɛhira maa nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: This is the disciple who testifies concerning these things and who wrote them down. We know that his testimony is true.

dag: Ka nyin naa ni ti dɔɣi bidibisi; ka bɛ zani a yaannim zaani, ka a ti zaŋ ba leei nanim dunia ŋɔ zaa ni.
en: You, my king, will have many sons to succeed your ancestors as kings, and you will make them rulers over the whole earth.

dag: O tiligiri bɛ nyɛviya nahiŋgu mini duŋtaariba nuu ni; bɛ nyɛviya nyɛla din viɛl pam o sani.
en: He cares when they hurt, and he saves them from cruel and violent deaths.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, di lɛb a nyaaŋa biri a ninvuɣ gahindili ŋɔ. Teem a ni daa mali yurilim maŋli shɛli zaŋ chaŋ a dabili Dauda san la yɛla.
en: Lord God, accept your anointed king. Remember your loyal servant David.

dag: Di saha maa ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa piligi n-gbahiri cheechi ni ninvuɣ shɛba n-niŋdi ba alaka;.
en: At that time King Herod caused terrible suffering for some members of the church.

dag: Ka kuriti nyɔtaɣirisi din ŋmani zahim paɣiri pɔb bɛ nyɔri, ka bɛ kpiŋkpama vuri kaman chɛchɛbunsi wɔr bɔbili ni yi zɔri chani tɔbu tuhibu shɛm la.
en: In front they had what seemed to be iron armor upon their chests, and the sound of their wings was like the sound of many chariots and horses racing into battle.

dag: Lala ka n ti yɛn yiɣisi n suhu bahi gooni maa mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaŋ bimpiɛlli paligi li maa zuɣu, ka yɛli ya, Gooni maa lan kani, ka bɛn daa zaŋ bimpiɛlli paligi li maa gba lan kani.
en: The city of Jerusalem and its lying prophets will feel my fierce anger. Then I will announce that the city has fallen and that the lying prophets are dead.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa bahi niriba maa, ka bɛ zaa lab kuli bɛ ni su tiŋgban shɛŋa ni.
en: Then Joshua sent the people away to each ones legacy.

dag: Ka kikaa maa kumsi vuri daa maan pahi, ka Musa daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, ka Naawuni garig o satahiŋga puuni.
en: The noise from the trumpet became louder and louder. Every time Moses spoke to God, God answered him with a voice like thunder.

dag: Naa ŋun mali kpiɔŋ ka nyɛ ŋun yuri zaligu soli, a nyɛla ŋun zali yɛlimaŋli soli. A nyɛla ŋun doli zaligu mini wuntia soli din be Yaakubu zuliya ni kari saria.
en: You are our mighty King, a lover of fairness, who sees that justice is done everywhere in Israel.

dag: N Ba ŋun zaŋ ba ti ma maa gari sokam, ka so mi ku tooi fa ba m Ba maa nuu ni.
en: My Father gave them to me, and he is greater than all others. No one can snatch them from his hands.

dag: Kaman m Ba Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ ni tim ma na ka m be m Ba maa zuɣu shɛm, lala ka ŋunkam ŋubi n niŋgbuŋ gba ni be n zuɣu.
en: The living Father sent me, and because of him I live also. In the same way whoever eats me will live because of me.

dag: N ni zaŋ n zaɣa niŋ bɛ ni, ka niŋ ba din viɛla, ka ti lan zaŋ ba labisi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni na. N ni chɛ ka bɛ zani, ka ku lan daai ba luhi. N ni zaŋ ba sa, ka ku lan sibigi ba.
en: I regard them as good, and I will bring them back to this land. I will build them up and not pull them down; I will plant them and not dig them up.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa yi lihi ka dɔro maa bi yɛligi situra maa ni bee kpalua ni bahi mi shɛŋa maa ni bee bɛ ni wuɣi tan shɛŋa maa ni bee bɛ ni zaŋ biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ mali shɛli maa ni.
en: If the priest discovers that the mildew hasn't spread.

dag: Dama ŋunkam tiligir o nyɛvili ni ti kɔŋ li, ka ŋunkam mi kɔŋ o nyɛvili m mini n lahibal suŋ ŋɔ zuɣu ni ti lan nya li.
en: All who want to save their lives will lose them. But all who lose their lives because of me and because of the good news will save them.

dag: Naa maa zaligu maa ni daa kpɛm pam maa zuɣu daa chɛ ka buɣim maa bii ti yaɣi, ka di buɣimniɛm daa ŋme n-ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa zaŋ Shadirak mini Mɛshak ni Abɛdnɛgo ti bahi di ni maa.
en: Now because the king had given strict orders for the furnace to be made extremely hot, the flames burned up the guards who took the men to the furnace.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Yi yipa niŋ yɛda pumpɔŋɔ?.
en: Jesus said, So now you believe?.

dag: Lala ka naa maa daa kpi; ka bɛ daa zaŋ o kuli Samaria ti sɔɣi.
en: Ahab's body was taken to Samaria and buried there.

dag: Di saha ka niriba maa zaa daa kabi chaŋ buɣili Baal duu nti daai li luhi ka wurim di maligu bimbina la mini di binnana la n-chɛrisichɛrisi di zaa, ka ku Matan ŋun daa nyɛ Baal tindan la maligu bimbini maa tooni.
en: All the people went into the temple of the idol Baal and tore it down. They also broke the altars and idols that were in Baals temple. They killed Mattan the priest of Baal in front of the altars of Baal.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ baŋmiya ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ bi zaŋdi tiŋgbɔn viɛlli ŋɔ tiri ya la yi wuntitali zuɣu, dama yi nyɛla tipawumlinima.
en: The Lord your God is giving you that good land to live in, but you should know that it is not because you are good. The truth is that you are very stubborn people!.

dag: Naawuni n-chɛ ka n leei cheechi tumtumda ka ti ma tuuni ŋɔ ni n tum yi sɔŋbu zuɣu. Dina n-nyɛ o lahibal suŋ zaa molo molibu tuma la.
en: And I have been made a servant of the church by God, who gave me this task to perform for your good. It is the task of fully proclaiming his message.

dag: Dinzuɣu dimbɔŋɔnim zaa nyɛla yɛliŋmahima din kpahiri ti zuɣu ni ni ti di yu tuumbiɛri tumbu kaman bɛ ni daa yu li shɛm.
en: Now, all of this is an example for us, to warn us not to desire evil things, as they did.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan bɔhi Yawɛ yaha. Ka Yawɛ daa garigi yɛl o, Yiɣisima, cham Kɛila, dama n zaŋ Filistianim maa niŋ a nuu ni.
en: David asked the Lord about it again. Leave at once, the Lord answered. I will give you victory over the Philistines at Keilah.

dag: Di saha ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa baŋ ni bɛ kɔŋ nasara. Izraɛlnim maa ni daa niŋ bɛ tɔbbi shɛb bɛn sɔɣ do n-gu Gibia la naani zuɣu ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa sani zo.
en: and the Benjaminites realized they were defeated. The main body of the Israelite army had retreated from the Benjaminites because they were relying on the men that they had put in hiding around Gibeah.

dag: Ŋunkam paɣir o ʒiʒiinikpee ti yaɣi nyɛla ŋun bariti o ʒiʒiinikpee maa zana.
en: If you give false praise to others in order to get what you want, you are only setting a trap for yourself.

dag: Di zuɣu ka n timd o yi sanna ni o ti yɛli ya ti zaa ni be shɛm, ka di kpaŋsi yi suhuri.
en: That is why I am sending him to you—to tell you how all of us are getting along and to encourage you.

dag: Yawɛ, labisim ti na kaman saa ni miri n-zaŋdi kom na ti niŋdi Nɛgɛb mɔɣ kuma ni shɛm la.
en: LORD, change our circumstances for the better, like dry streams in the desert waste!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli, O beni, ka lan yɛli, Nyamiya, ŋuna kul be yi tooni chani maa ha; kpaŋ chamiya, pumpɔŋɔ ka o na yoli paana, dama bɛ yɛn malila sara daboli zuɣu zuŋɔ.
en: Yes, he is, they replied. He's in town today because there's going to be a sacrifice and a sacred meal at the place of worship. In fact, he's just ahead of you. Hurry.

dag: Karimbaani niŋbu kam nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ sani. Baŋmiya ni bɛ ku yi tibidarigibo ni.
en: The Lord hates everyone who is arrogant; he will never let them escape punishment.

dag: A lɛhu yi gbilim ka a bi sahi li, ka zaŋ li ni a tum tuma, a ni di wahala pam; amaa yɛm nyɛla din sɔŋdi nir ka o diri nasara.
en: If an ax is dull and one doesnt sharpen it first, then one must exert more force. Its profitable to be skillful and wise.

dag: Nooŋa ni yiɣiri gind o tiɛɣu shɛm la, lala ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni guli Jɛrusalɛm. O ni fa li bahi, ka gul li.
en: Just as birds fly over their nest to protect it, so the Lord All-Powerful will defend Jerusalem. He will save her. He will pass over and save Jerusalem.

dag: Ka o daa lan piri daanya muɣiri ka zaŋ daanya kpani pa o bɔɣusapima zuɣu.
en: His legs were also protected by bronze armor, and he carried a bronze javelin slung over his shoulder.

dag: Bɛ daa lan bɔhi ba, Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mɛri duu maa yuya lee booni bɔ.
en: They also asked them, What are the names of the people who are building this building.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka sapashin kpamba mi tɔɣisi tɔbbihi maa yɛtɔɣa yɛli, So beni m-me yili palli ka na bi suhi Naawuni ka kpe di ni? O labimi kul o yili maa ni, di pa shɛli ka o ti lu tɔb maa ni ka so ti suhi Naawuni ka kpe o yili maa ni.
en: The officials will also say to the troops: Is there anyone here who has just built a new house but hasnt yet dedicated it? He can leave and go back to his house; otherwise, he might die in the war and someone else would dedicate the house.

dag: Ka ti yaannim maa mini Jɔshua daa ti zaŋ li kuli Naawuni ni daa yiɣisi zuliya shɛb ka chɛ tiŋgban shɛli ti ba la ni. Nimaani ka bɛ daa mal li be hal ti paai Naa Dauda ʒiɛmani saha.
en: In time, when they had received the tent, our ancestors carried it with them when, under Joshuas leadership, they took possession of the land from the nations whom God expelled. This tent remained in the land until the time of David.

dag: Di tiɣi Yawɛ nini o wuntitali zuɣu ni o tibig o zaligunima, ka chɛ ka di mali jilima.
en: The LORD desired for the sake of his righteousness to expand and glorify the Instruction.

dag: Ka bɛ zaani zuɣusaa asiba mini zaawuni kam m-paɣiri ka tibigiri Yawɛ.
en: and to praise and glorify the Lord every morning and every evening.

dag: Buɣim di yi tinsi, ka yi tiŋgbɔŋ nyɛ zaɣ nɛli. Tinzunnim fa yi tiŋgbɔŋ n-saɣim li yi ninni, ka di kpalimla zaɣ nɛli.
en: Your country lies in ruins; your towns are in ashes. Foreigners and strangers take and destroy your land while you watch.

dag: O daa di tarimba mini nandaamba saria ka di viɛla. Pa nira ni yɛn niŋ shɛm wuhi ni o mi ma m-bala? Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Josiah helped poor and needy people, so everything went well for him. Jehoiakim, what does it mean to know God? It means living right and being fair. That is what it means to know me. This message is from the Lord .

dag: Niŋmi li la ashilɔni, ka a Ba Naawuni ŋun nyari ashilɔni ŋɔ ti a di laara.
en: Then it will be a private matter. And your Father, who sees what you do in private, will reward you.

dag: O daa lan me buɣa jɛmbu shee zali Juda fɔŋ kam ni, n-tuɣindi tulaale zim n-tiri buɣa, ka di daa chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o yaannim Naawuni la suhu yiɣisi.
en: He made shrines in all the towns of Judah for burning incense to other gods. This made the LORD, the God of his ancestors, very angry.

dag: Sool saha la bɛna n-daa chaŋ ti tuhi Hagirinima n-nyaŋ ba, ka ʒini bɛ tinsi maa ni Giliad wulimpuhili polo maa ni zaa la.
en: When Saul was king, Belas people fought a war against the Hagrites. They defeated the Hagrites. Belas people lived in the tents that had belonged to the Hagrites. They lived in those tents and traveled throughout the area east of Gilead.

dag: O chɛ n daalahichi zaa, ka tibi n dɔriti zaa.
en: He forgives all our sins and heals all our sicknesses.

dag: Ka bɛn daa ʒe Yisa sani maa ni yino ŋoog o takɔbi chɛ shɛligi maligumaaniba zuɣulan dabili tibili bahi.
en: But one of those standing there drew his sword and struck at the High Priest's slave, cutting off his ear.

dag: Gbibiya Bɔrɔbɔro Din ka Dabindi Chuɣu la. Yi ni ti ŋubi bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi daba ayopɔin kaman n ni daa zali ya shɛm ka di doli bɛ ni zal li saha shɛli Abib gol ni, dama Abib goli maa ni ka yi daa yi Ijipti na.
en: Keep the Festival of Unleavened Bread. As I have commanded you, eat unleavened bread for seven days in the month of Abib, because it was in that month that you left Egypt.

dag: Yawɛ bemi kaman tɔbbia la, o ŋmanila tɔbutuhira ŋun suhu ye tuhibu zuɣu. O kuhirimi yɛri pampam, ka wuhiri ni o mali yaa gar o dimnima.
en: The LORD will go out like a soldier; like a warrior God will stir up rage. God will shout, will roar; over enemies he will prevail.

dag: Yawɛ malaika maa daa lan yɛli Haga yaha, Nyama, a mali pua, a mi ti yɛn dɔɣila bidibiga, ka bol o yuli Ishimail, dama Yawɛ wum a nandahima kuhigu maa.
en: You are going to have a son, and you will name him Ishmael, because the Lord has heard your cry of distress.

dag: Sool ni daa kul yɛri maligumaana maa lala saha shɛli maa, ka Filistianim maa zɔbu yiriŋ mini bɛ vuri maa daa kul maan pahira; ka Sool daa yɛli maligumaana maa, Chɛl li.
en: Just as Saul finished saying this, he could see that the Philistine army camp was getting more and more confused, and he said, Ahijah, never mind.

dag: Ka o daa ti yɛl o sɔŋda Gɛhaazi, Bolim Shunɛm paɣ maa ti ma. Ka o daa bol o, ka o kana ti zan o tooni.
en: He said to his servant Gehazi, Call this Shunammite woman. Gehazi called her, and she stood before him.

dag: Suhugarigu zuɣu chɛmi ka n nina niŋ liti, Yawɛ, n kul teela n nuhi n-suhir a dabisili kam.
en: My eyes hurt from crying. Lord , I pray to you constantly! I lift my arms in prayer to you.

dag: Niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu tuma yi zahira. Dina n-nyɛ: Zina niŋbu mini daɣiri tuma ni kɔr biɛri balibu kam.
en: People's desires make them give in to immoral ways, filthy thoughts, and shameful deeds.

dag: O daa niŋ yɛda ni o yi nya turi Masia zuɣu, di so Ijipti azichi, dama o daa lihirila o ni ti yɛn nya laara shɛli dahin shɛl ha la.
en: Moses knew that the treasures of Egypt were not as wonderful as what he would receive from suffering for the Messiah, and he looked forward to his reward.

dag: Musa ni daa tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa naai, o daa zaŋla sariga pili lir o ninni.
en: When Moses finished speaking to the people, he put a covering over his face.

dag: Bɛ ni ti niŋ lala, dama bɛ bi mi ma balle m-mi m Ba Naawuni.
en: They will do these things because they don't know either the Father or me.

dag: Ŋuna n-ni ti me yili ti n yuli jilima, ka n ti chɛ ka o nam zani hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: He will build a temple for my name, and I will establish his royal throne forever.

dag: Ka yinim bɛn nyɛ tuumbiɛrinim ŋɔ yi mi ni yi zaŋ bin suma ti yi bihi, bɔ n-ni chɛ ka yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ ŋun ku zaŋ bin suma ti bɛn suhir o li?.
en: You people are so bad, but you still know how to give good things to your children. So surely your heavenly Father will give good things to those who ask him.

dag: A yɛn gbibila so kur shɛli ninvuɣ biɛri ni daa doli la?.
en: Will you keep the ancient way traveled by sinful persons.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ Kɛdar mini Nɛbaiɔt piɛri na nti tin ya. Yi ni ti tooi zaŋ ba mali sara n sara maligu bimbini zuɣu; ka n tibigi n jɛmbu duu din mali jilima maa.
en: Every sheep of Kedar will come to you; rams from Nebaioth will be yours as well. I will accept them as offerings and bring honor to my temple.

dag: Ti mabihi, din bahindi nyaaŋa nyɛla, suhimiya Naawuni tiri ti ka o chɛ ka ti Duuma yɛligu yɛligi yomyom ka di nasara kaman di ni daa di nasara yi sani shɛm la.
en: And now, brothers and sisters, pray for us. Pray that the Lords teaching will continue to spread quickly. And pray that people will give honor to that teaching, the same as happened with you.

dag: Dama tinim bɛn be ti nyɛviya ni ŋɔ kul bela kum barina ni Yisa zuɣu ni di chɛ ka Yisa nyɛvili tooi yi palo ti niŋgbuna din kpiri ŋɔ ni.
en: We are alive, but for Jesus we are always in danger of death, so that the life of Jesus can be seen in our bodies that die.

dag: Ka Naaman daa chaŋ o naa sani nti yɛl o, Izraɛl bipuɣimbil la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ.
en: So Naaman went and told his master what the young girl from the land of Israel had said.

dag: Di saha ka n daa kpe di ni nti nya ka bɛ ŋmɛla biŋgbamda mini biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn bi be kasi zaa ni Izraɛl buɣa zaa kɔtomsi pa gooni maa zuɣu gili.
en: Inside, I saw that the walls were covered with pictures of reptiles and disgusting, unclean animals, as well as with idols that the Israelites were worshiping.

dag: Yɛla ŋɔ zaa puuni, Ayuba daa bi tum alahichi bee n-galim Naawuni ni o ni niŋ shɛm maa bi tuhi.
en: In all this, Job didnt sin or blame God.

dag: N ni kana ti liri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ tipawumli nim ŋɔ n-fiɛb ba. Ka n yi ti fiɛb ba bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛri buyi maa zuɣu, zuliya shɛb ni laɣisi tab na ti liri ba.
en: Your sins have doubled, and you are rebellious. Now I have decided to send nations to attack and put you in chains.

dag: Naawuni chɛ ka bɛnkam zaa niŋ Yisa Masia yɛda yiri taali ni ŋun Naawuni san la bɛ yɛda niŋbu zuɣu. Sokam zaa nyɛla yim.
en: God makes people right through their faith in Jesus Christ. He does this for all who believe in Christ. Everyone is the same.

dag: Ka Anabi Aizaia gba daa sabi yɛli pahi: Ninvuɣ so ŋun ni ti su bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ni ti yila Jɛsi zuliya ni na. O ni ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim tahima ni ti be.
en: Isaiah says, Someone from David's family will come to power. He will rule the nations, and they will put their hope in him.

dag: Ka di puuni zaa daa palila biŋkɔbiri balibu kam mini tinvura ni biŋgbamda ni noonsi.
en: Inside the sheet were all kinds of four-legged animals, reptiles, and wild birds.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim daa kul kpaŋsiri Izraɛlnim maa ni bɛ yim bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni yomyom, dama bɛ daa yɛlimi, Di yi pa lala tinim gba kul kpimi maa.
en: The Egyptians did everything they could to get the Israelites to leave their country as quickly as possible. They said, Please hurry and leave. If you don't, we will all be dead.

dag: Saha shɛli ha yi daa pala ninvuɣ maŋa. Amaa pumpɔŋɔ yi yipa nyɛla Naawuni niriba; ka saha shɛli ha yi daa bi nya Naawuni nambɔzɔbo, amaa pumpɔŋɔ yi yipa nya nambɔzɔbo o sani.
en: In the past you were not a special people, but now you are Gods people. Once you had not received mercy, but now God has given you his mercy.

dag: Bɛna n-nyɛ: kapintanim mini tammɛriba zuɣulaannim ni tammɛriba, ka da dari mini kuɣ bɔɣa din yɛn zaŋ mali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa.
en: the workers, and with the rest of it they can buy wood and stone for the repair work.

dag: Paɣ so daa be Jɔpa n-nyɛ Yisa nyaandola ka o yuli booni Tabita. O daa tumdi tuun suma pam, ka lan tumdi nambɔzɔbo tuma gba lala.
en: In the city of Joppa there was a follower of Jesus named Tabitha. Her Greek name, Dorcas, means a deer. She was always doing good things for people and giving money to those in need.

dag: ka bɔhira, O labbuna alikauli lɔbu palibu la lee be ya? Dama ti banim kalinsi nyaaŋa hal ni pɔŋɔ, binshɛɣukam na kul bemi kaman di ni daa be shɛm dunia nambu saha la.
en: and will ask, He promised to come, didn't he? Where is he? Our ancestors have already died, but everything is still the same as it was since the creation of the world.

dag: amaa ka bɛ daa bi tooi baŋ o.
en: They were prevented from recognizing him.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ kaɣili fiɛb o zuɣu ni, ka tuhiri nintɔri viɛr o, ka damdir o tooni puhir o.
en: They beat him over the head with a stick, spat on him, fell on their knees, and bowed down to him.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa ti Sulemaana yɛm mini baŋsim din ka buɣisibu ni tɛhi wɔɣila ka di galisi kaman mɔɣ bihigu la.
en: And God gave Solomon wisdom and very great understanding—insight as long as the seashore itself.

dag: Bɛ daa mali sara maligu pam dindali maa, ka niriba maa suhuri paligi pam, dama Naawuni n-daa chɛ ka bɛ mali suhupiɛlli maa. Ka paɣiba mini bihi gba daa mali suhupiɛlli. Katiŋnim daa wum Jɛrusalɛmnim suhupiɛlli maa damli.
en: They offered great sacrifices on that day and rejoiced, for God had made them rejoice with great joy. The women and children also rejoiced, and the sound of the joy in Jerusalem could be heard from far away.

dag: Bɛ ni ti be tiŋgbani maa ni ni alaafee, ka so lan kani ŋun ni kpɛhi ba dabiɛm, bɛ ni tam bɛ vi mini bɛ ni daa bi ʒe ma yim la yɛla.
en: The people will forget their shame and all the times they turned against me. They will live in safety on their own land. No one will make them afraid.

dag: Di saha ka Ayuba daa yiɣisi zani n-darigi cheeg omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu, ka pini o zuɣu, ka gbani tiŋa n-jɛm Naawuni.
en: Then Job got up and tore his clothes in grief. He shaved his head and threw himself face downward on the ground.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ku shɛb tɔb ni la daa so kum ni daa ku shɛba la. Bɛ daa mɔŋ ba puri ni bindirigu, ka kum ʒi ba chaŋ.
en: Those who died in the war were better off than those who died later, who starved slowly to death, with no food to keep them alive.

dag: Di saha maa Dan zuliya niriba maa ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu la daa gbibila bɛ tɔbutuhiri bidibbina ʒe dunol ni.
en: While the six hundred Danites armed for battle stood at the entrance of the gate.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa yi yɛn yiɣisi chaŋ ka doli tab gbilligbilli chani shɛm m-bala.
en: That was the way the Israelites marched when they moved from place to place.

dag: Hal mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri zaa kul kumdimi n-niŋd a, kulibɔna ni koma zaa ni nyuui, ka buɣim di mɔɣu ni zaa la zuɣu.
en: Even the wild animals cry out to you because the streams have become dry.

dag: Samsin ba min o ma daa bi mi ni Yawɛ n-wuhi Samsin lala, dama Yawɛ daa bɔrila so shɛli o ni yɛn doli tuhi Filistianima. Di saha maa, Filistianima n-daa su Izraɛlnima.
en: His father and mother didnt know that the LORD was behind this. He was looking for an opening with the Philistines, because they were ruling over Israel at that time.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka a lan zaŋ piɛla ŋun la na nti chɛ ka Aduna min o bidibisi maa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa o zuɣu ni.
en: Take the other ram—the ram used for dedication—and tell Aaron and his sons to put their hands on its head.

dag: Ka Yisa lan yɛli ba yaha, Naawuni tim ya suhudoo! M Ba ni tim ma na shɛm, lala ka n gba timdi ya.
en: Jesus said to them again, Peace be with you. As the Father sent me, so I send you.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli n suhu ni, Din yɛn niŋ ma, dina n-yɛn niŋ jɛra; ka bɔzuɣu ka di lee simdi ni m mali yɛm pam? Ka n daa yɛli n suhu ni, Dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din ka buchi.
en: Finally, I said to myself, Being wise got me nowhere! The same thing will happen to me that happens to fools. Nothing makes sense.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl naa maa daa boli kpeen so na ti yɛl o, Cham yomyom ti zaŋ Imla bia Mikaya na.
en: So Israels king called an officer and ordered, Bring Micaiah, Imlahs son, right away.

dag: Bia maa ni daa ti paai Jɔnatan ni to piɛm maa bahi luɣ shɛli maa, ka Jɔnatan bol o n-yɛl o, Pa piɛm maa m-be a tooni maa ha.
en: The boy ran to the place where the arrows fell, but Jonathan called, The arrows are farther away.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni chɛ ka o daalibarika yi Ziɔn na paai ya.
en: May the LORD, the maker of heaven and earth, bless you from Zion.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Samuɛl daa ti boli niriba ni bɛ laɣim Yawɛ sanna Mizipa.
en: Samuel told all the Israelites to meet together with the Lord at Mizpah.

dag: Zoya ni gili Jɛrusalɛm shɛm la, lala ka Yawɛ gil o niriba, pumpɔŋɔ hal ni sahakam.
en: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the Lord surrounds his people, now and forever.

dag: Man Yisa n-tim m malaika ni o zaŋ yɛligu ŋɔ na nti ti cheechinima. N nyɛla Naa Dauda yaaŋa ni biɛŋmariga ŋun ne.
en: I, Jesus, have sent my angel to announce these things to you in the churches. I am descended from the family of David; I am the bright morning star.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa nam puu niŋ Idɛn din be wulimpuhili polo n-zaŋ o ni nam ninsal so maa niŋ nimaani.
en: Then the Lord God planted a garden in the East, in a place named Eden. He put the man he made in that garden.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa zo Dauda sani n-chaŋ ti doli Shiiba Bikiri bia maa, amaa ka Judanim daa doli bɛ naa maa ni ʒiɛyimtali n-yi Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa ni kuli Jɛrusalɛm.
en: So all the Israelites left David to follow Bichris son Sheba. But all the people of Judah stayed close to their king from the Jordan River all the way to Jerusalem.

dag: Alahichi daa pun bela dunia ŋɔ ni hal ka Naawuni ti naanyi zaŋ o fukumsi zaligu ti ti, amaa fukumsi zaligu ni daa na kani la, shɛli daa kani din ni wuhi ni alahichi tumbu chihira.
en: Sin was in the world before the Law came. But no record of sin was kept, because there was no Law.

dag: Ka bɔhi ba, Sal yi lee nya dunia ŋɔ binshɛɣukam zaa ka ti kɔŋ o nyɛvili, nyɔ bɔ ka o lee di bee bin bɔ ka sal lee yɛn zaŋ o nyɛvili taɣi?.
en: Will you gain anything if you win the whole world but lose your life? Of course not! There is nothing you can give to regain your life.

dag: Kum yuma maa daa ti yɛn kana, ka Yisifu pun zaŋ Asɛnat ŋun daa nyɛ Pɔtifɛra ŋun nyɛ Hɛliopolis tindan bipuɣiŋga la dɔɣila bidibis ayi.
en: Before the years of famine came, Joseph had two sons by Asenath.

dag: N daa wum a yɛligu, ka dee li, ka a yɛligu maa niŋ ma nyaɣisim, ka ti ma suhupiɛlli, dama nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ n su ma.
en: When your words turned up, I feasted on them; and they became my joy, the delight of my heart, because I belong to you, LORD God of heavenly forces.

dag: Di saha ka n daa chaŋ Yufretiiz Mɔɣili ni nti kurigi n ni daa zaŋ jinjɛŋŋmaa maa pi luɣ shɛli maa n-yihi li na. Amaa ka jinjɛŋŋmaa maa daa saɣim ka lan ka buchi.
en: So I went to Perath and dug the loincloth out of the crack in the rocks where I had hidden it. But now I could not wear the loincloth, because it was ruined. It was not good for anything.

dag: Naawuni, di be katiŋ ka chɛ ma; n Naawuni, niŋm yomyom sɔŋ ma!.
en: Don't stay so far away, O God; my God, hurry to my aid!.

dag: Bɛ ni mi ni Naawuni zaligu wuhiya ni bɛn tumdi dimbɔŋɔnim simdi kum maa zaa yoli, bɛmaŋmaŋ gba kul tumdi li mi hal ka ʒe bɛn gba tumdi li nyaaŋa.
en: They know God has said that anyone who acts this way deserves to die. But they keep on doing evil things, and they even encourage others to do them.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun be samban ni yi shihi bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi ku so bee n-shihi ninvuɣ so ŋun kpi o dahalali kum bee n-shihi ninsal kɔbili bee gballi, dilana ni leei ŋun bi be nyam daba ayopɔin.
en: If you touch the body of someone who died or was killed, or if you touch a human bone or a grave, you will be unclean for seven days.

dag: Di saha ka malaika maa daa zaŋ tulaale laa maa m-mooi bimbini maa zuɣu buɣim m-pal li n-zaŋ kpaai bahi dunia ni, ka saa daa gbaai nyaɣisibu ni tahibu, ka vuri yiɣisi mɔni ka tiŋgbani damda.
en: After this, the angel filled the incense container with fire from the altar and threw it on the earth. Thunder roared, lightning flashed, and the earth shook.

dag: Amaa Naawuni Kundi wuhiya ni sokam zaa bela alahichi sulinsi ni ni di chɛ ka Naawuni ni daa zaŋ shɛli lo alikauli Yisa Masia yɛda niŋbu puuni la tooi paai bɛn niŋ yɛda.
en: But this is not possible. The Scriptures put the whole world in prison under the control of sin, so that the only way for people to get what God promised would be through faith in Jesus Christ. It is given to those who believe in him.

dag: Zuliya shɛb bɛn pa Yɛhudianima, ka bi mali Naawuni fukumsi zaligu, amaa ka lee tumdi Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa ni wuhi shɛm, dindina hal bɛ ni bi mali Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa zaa yoli, bɛ kul mali fukumsi zaligu bɛ suhuri ni m-bala.
en: Those who are not Jews dont have the law. But when they naturally do what the law commands without even knowing the law, then they are their own law. This is true even though they dont have the written law.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn bia Abimilɛk la daa ti chaŋ Shɛkɛm o ŋahinim min o ma daŋ niriba zaa sani ti yɛli ba.
en: Abimelech was the son of Gideon. Abimelech went to his uncles who lived in the city of Shechem. He said to his uncles and all of his mothers family.

dag: Ka bɛn daa kpalim la mi zaŋ daparilana mini ŋariŋ dapaɣ shɛŋa pa kom maa zuɣu n-gba du duli. Ka ti zaa daa duɣi du duli tiligi.
en: Then he told the others to hold on to planks of wood or parts of the ship. At last, everyone safely reached shore.

dag: Anabi ninkur so daa be Bɛtɛl di saha maa. Ka o bidibisi daa kuli ti yɛl o Naawuni nir maa ni niŋ shɛlikam zaa Bɛtɛl dindali maa yɛla; ka lan yɛl o o ni daa yɛli Naa Jɛrɔbɔam shɛlikam zaa la gba yɛla.
en: Now there was an old prophet living in Bethel. His sons came and told him everything that the man of God had done that day at Bethel. They also told their father the words that he spoke to the king.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpalim ʒe samban ni maa daa guhi Zakaria je, ka di daa gari ba o ni yuui Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: Meanwhile, the people were waiting for Zechariah, and they wondered why he was in the sanctuary for such a long time.

dag: Lala ka bɛ daa niŋ ta bɛmaŋ daɣiri bɛ tumtumsa ni, ka bɛ tuma maa zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ bi ʒe yim.
en: By doing such gruesome things, they also became filthy.

dag: A yɛliya, N ka taali, m bi tum birigi shɛli, n kul bela kasi, ka taali shɛli ka n kɔbili ni.
en: Im pure, without sin; Im innocent, without offense.

dag: Bɛ ni shɛba n-nyɛ Haimɛnaius mini Alikizanda bɛn nyɛ n ni zaŋ shɛb niŋ Sintani nuu ni bɛmaŋmaŋ sɔŋsim nyabu zuɣu ni di chɛ ka bɛ baŋ ni di bi simdi ni bɛ mo Naawuni la.
en: Two of them are Hymenaeus and Alexander. I have given these men over to the power of Satan, so they will learn not to oppose God.

dag: Ka Juda daa bo paɣ ti o bituuli Ɛr. Paɣ maa yuli n-daa booni Tama.
en: Judah chose a woman named Tamar to be the wife of his first son Er.

dag: Ŋuna n-yeeri nanim kpariti, ka sooni ba piɛtɔnima.
en: He dethrones kings and makes them prisoners;.

dag: Wula ka n lee yɛn chɛ yi taali? Yi bihi zaɣisi ma, ka jɛmdila binshɛŋa din pa Naawuni. N yi dihi ba ka bɛ tiɣi, bɛ tumdila zina, ka chani pagɔra yinsi.
en: How can I pardon you? Your children have forsaken me and swear by gods that are not gods. Although I could have satisfied them, they committed adultery, dashing off to the prostitution house.

dag: Di saha ka Jɛshua mini Bani ni Kadimiɛl ni Shɛbania ni Bunni ni Shɛrɛbia ni Bani so mi ni Kɛnani daa yiɣisi zani Lɛvinim ni daa ʒe bimbin shɛli zuɣu ka duhi bɛ yee n-suhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: There was a platform for the Levites, and on it stood Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani. They prayed aloud to the Lord their God.

dag: Asha zuliya ni tuhi pinaayi, Naftali zuliya ni tuhi pinaayi, Manaasa zuliya ni tuhi pinaayi.
en: from the tribe of Asher, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Naphtali, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Manasseh, twelve thousand.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ tusa bɛn yuri ma, ka doli n fukumsi zaligunima, n wuhiri n yurilim maŋli bɛ sani.
en: But if you love me and obey my laws, I will be kind to your families for thousands of generations.

dag: ka di daa kpa o talahi ni o doli yi Samaria.
en: on his way there he had to go through Samaria.

dag: Di saha ka Manɔa daa balim Yawɛ yɛli, Yawɛ, n suhir a, chɛ ka a ni daa tim do so na la lan lab ti sanna nti wuhi ti ti ni ti yɛn niŋ bi so ti ni yɛn dɔɣi maa shɛm.
en: Manoah asked the LORD, Please, my Lord, he said, let the man of God whom you sent come back to us once more, so he can teach us how we should treat the boy who is to be born.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni daa yihi yi yaannim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni dabitim ni la, n daa lo ba alikauli yɛli.
en: The LORD, the God of Israel, proclaims: I made a covenant with your ancestors when I brought them out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.

dag: kaman bɛ ni daa nya li di piligu ni shɛm, ka moli di lahibal la.
en: They used what the original eyewitnesses and servants of the word handed down to us.

dag: Ka o kpee maa gba damd o tooni m-balind o yɛra, Na dim ma suɣilo, n ni yo a di zaa.
en: The man got down on his knees and began begging, Have pity on me, and I will pay you back.

dag: Ka wuntaŋ daa ti yɛn lu, ka Jɔshua bahi noli ka bɛ siɣisi ba tihi maa zuɣu na n-zaŋ ba bahi vo shɛl ni bɛ ni daa zo nti sɔɣ la ni, ka bilim kuɣ kara ti ŋari di noli, ka di na kul be nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: At sunset Joshua told his men to take the bodies down from the trees. So they threw the bodies into the cave where the kings had been hiding and covered the entrance of the cave with large rocks. Their bodies are still in that cave today.

dag: O daa zaŋ o niriba kpe mɔɣu ni gari. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: The Lord led his people through the desert. God's love never fails.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun nyo n firila. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ n-chɛ ka neesim neei n zibisim ni.
en: Lord , you provide the flame for my lamp. You, God, turn the darkness around me into light.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ a, nyin ninsala, ni a ŋme Naawuni naŋgbankpeeni? Duɣu ni tooi bɔhi yaɣimɛra, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a me ma lala.
en: Dont ask that. You are only human and have no right to question God. A clay jar does not question the one who made it. It does not say, Why did you make me like this.

dag: Ka ŋun daa ʒi sagbani zuɣu maa zaŋ o gɔrigu maa n-tim dunia ni chɛ li.
en: So the one seated on the cloud swung his sickle over the earth, and the earth was harvested.

dag: O bi chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri mali nyɛvili, amaa o zaŋdi bɛn diri wahala yɛlimaŋli tiri ba.
en: He does not let sinners live on, and he always treats the poor with justice.

dag: bee so ti yɛli, Nyamiya, di be kpe! Bee n-yɛli, Di be kpe ha! Dama Naawuni nam maa be yi sunsuuni pumpɔŋɔ.
en: There is no use saying, Look! Here it is or Look! There it is. God's kingdom is here with you.

dag: O daa yihi ba bumbɔni mini zibisim ni, ka kabi bɛ bandi.
en: He brought them out of their gloom and darkness and broke their chains in pieces.

dag: Ka yɛl biɛ shɛli ti kana ti ŋme n-ku li, hal ka bɛ ti bi chɛ shɛli zali bɛ bihi gba.
en: Then something bad happens and they lose everything. So they have nothing to give to their children.

dag: nini la nini, nyini la nyini, nuu la nuu, gbali la gbali.
en: an eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth, a hand for a hand, a foot for a foot.

dag: Yawɛ yɛli yinim Judanim bɛn kpalim ŋɔ, Di chaŋya Ijipti. Baŋmiya viɛnyɛliŋga ni n wuhi ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Survivors of Judah, the Lord told you: Dont go to Egypt. I warn you right now.

dag: Ka o yɛli ma, Dimbɔŋɔ maa wuhirila bɛ ni booi kpam bahi shɛb zuɣuri ni ni bɛ tum ŋun nyɛ dunia ŋɔ zaa Duuma la tuma.
en: He said, These are the two anointed ones standing beside the LORD of all the earth.

dag: Ŋuna n-tumdi tuun kara din gari ninsal yɛm, ka tumdi alahiziba tuma din ka kalinli.
en: does great and unsearchable things, wonders beyond number?.

dag: A yɛm n-chɛ ka wubiga pa zuɣusaa yiɣiri ka teeg o kpiŋkpama kpa nudirigu polo ŋɔ?.
en: Is it due to your understanding that the hawk flies, spreading its wings to the south?.

dag: Ka ŋunkam deeri anabi o ni nyɛ anabi zuɣu ni ti deeg anabi laara; ka ŋunkam deeri wuntizɔra o ni nyɛ wuntizɔra zuɣu ni ti deei wuntizɔra laara.
en: Whoever accepts a prophet because he is a prophet will get the same reward a prophet gets. And whoever accepts a godly person just because that person is godly will get the same reward a godly person gets.

dag: Zaŋmiya binyara sa n-dalim yi pala, malimiya dapaɣa din mali sabbu. Kpahimmiya palidaa la viɛnyɛliŋga, yi ni daa doli shɛli chaŋ la. Yinim Izraɛlnim bɛn ŋmani paɣipiɛliga ŋɔ labimiyana. Labimiya yi tinsi ŋɔ ni na.
en: Set up signs and mark the road; find again the way by which you left. Come back, people of Israel, come home to the towns you left.

dag: Ka Sool tumtumdiba daa yɛl o, Nyama, pumpɔŋɔ Naawuni n-chɛ ka alizin biɛɣu ŋɔ kana ti muɣisir a maa.
en: Sauls servants said to him, An evil spirit from God is bothering you.

dag: Yi ni di vi pam, ka pa ni jilima. Yimaŋmaŋ gba nyumiya ka chani ʒiɛhira. Yawɛ nudirigu ni pipia la ni paai ya, ka yi jilima ti leei vi.
en: Now you will be disgraced instead of praised. The Lord will make you drunk, and when others see you naked, you will lose their respect.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ taali galisi pahi; di chɛ ka bɛ nya gaafara a sani.
en: Make them guiltier than ever and don't forgive them.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda nachimba maa ŋmaligi labi ti yɛl o dimbɔŋɔ zaa.
en: So Davids young servants turned around and went back the way they came. When they arrived, they reported every word of this to David.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naawuni noli ni din ya; ka yi ni shɛb kul ni nyɛla daba sahakam; ka kabiri dari, ka ŋɔŋdi kom niŋdi n Naawuni jɛmbu duu.
en: So now you are under a curse, and from now on your people will have to send workers to cut wood and carry water for the place of worship.

dag: Ka maligumaana Jɛhɔiada daa zaŋ Naa Dauda kpana la min o nyɔtaɣiri kara ni zaɣibihi zaa din daa be Naawuni duu la ni n-ti sapashin kpamba bɛn su tɔbbihi kɔbigakɔbiga maa.
en: Jehoiada gave the officers the spears and shields that had belonged to King David and had been kept in the Temple.

dag: Yawɛ doli yɛlimaŋli soli, ka tumdi wuntia tuma tiri bɛn nyari nahiŋgu.
en: The Lord judges in favor of the oppressed and gives them their rights.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka doo ŋɔ tɔɣisiri lala? O mɔri Naawuni! Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi chɛ niriba daalahichi paŋ ba ka pa ni Naawuni kɔŋko.
en: Why does this man say things like that? What an insult to God! No one but God can forgive sins.

dag: Gbib ma kaman a ni lo alikauli shɛm la, ka m be. Di chɛ ka n di vi n tahima niŋbu ni.
en: Sustain me according to your word so I can live! Dont let me be put to shame because of hope.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira daa bela mɔɣu ni yihiri waazu yɛri niriba, Niŋmiya tuuba, ka m baptaizi ya kom ni, ka Naawuni kpihim yi daalahichi.
en: So John appeared in the desert, baptizing and preaching. Turn away from your sins and be baptized, he told the people, and God will forgive your sins.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni yo Babilɔn mini di niriba zaa bɛ ni daa tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa Jɛrusalɛm la samli yi nini ŋɔ ni.
en: But I will repay Babylonia and all the Babylonians for all the evil things they did to Zion. I will pay them back so that you can see it, Judah. This is what the Lord said.

dag: Ti zuɣu ka Naawuni daa zaŋ Masia ŋun ka alahichi la n-zali alahichi zaani ni di chɛ ka ti leei wuntizɔriba ŋun Naawuni sani o zuɣu.
en: Christ had no sin, but God made him become sin so that in Christ we could be right with God.

dag: Yawɛ zɔbu nyɛla yɛm wuhibu ni be shɛli ni, ka maŋsiɣisibu be tooni ka jilima doli.
en: Showing respect to the Lord will make you wise, and being humble will bring honor to you.

dag: Keenannim bɛn daa nyɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim ni daa nya ka bɛ kumdi Atad kabɔɣili maa shee maa, ka bɛ yɛli, Nandahima titali kumsi ka Ijiptinim ŋɔ kumdi ŋɔ! Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Ɛbɛl Mizraim; ka di be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli.
en: When the Canaanites who lived in the land saw the observance of grief on Atads threshing floor, they said, This is a solemn observance of grief by the Egyptians. Therefore, its name is Abel-mizraim. It is on the other side of the Jordan River.

dag: N suhiri Naawuni ni o tin ya yiko o Shia Kasi zuɣu, ka o kpaŋsi yi suhuri o jilima azichitali puuni.
en: God is wonderful and glorious. I pray that his Spirit will make you become strong followers.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam nim zaa ni ti teei, ka ŋmaligi lab Yawɛ sanna, ka zuliya kam niriba zaa ni ti jɛm o.
en: All nations will remember the Lord . From every part of the world they will turn to him; all races will worship him.

dag: Paɣimiya Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ʒiɛmani kam Naa, ka nyɛ ŋun kul be, ka nyɛ ninsalinim nini ni ku tooi nya so, ka lan nyɛ ŋun kɔŋko kul nyɛ Naawuni, ka simdi tibigibu mini jilima tibu ŋɔ hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: I pray that honor and glory will always be given to the only God, who lives forever and is the invisible and eternal King! Amen.

dag: N yi di bɔra, n naan tooi mali tahima bina lala tatabo ni. Ka so yi tɛhi ni o ni tooi mali tahima ninsalinim ni niŋdi shɛli bɛ niŋgbuna ni yɛla ni, m mali daliri ni n niŋ lala gar o.
en: I could, of course, put my trust in such things. If any of you think you can trust in external ceremonies, I have even more reason to feel that way.

dag: Ka dim pahi nyɛla: Bɛ daa lan ta n jɛmbu duu la daɣiri dindali maa, ka saɣim n vuhim dabisa.
en: And that is not all they did. They profaned my Temple and broke the Sabbath, which I had established.

dag: Wain nyɛla ansarisimaana, ka dam din kpɛma mi nyɛ vuyɔra, ka ninvuɣ so ŋun chɛ ka di kpɛh o yɔɣu nyɛla ŋun ka yɛm.
en: Drinking too much makes you loud and foolish. It's stupid to get drunk.

dag: Ka Ibram daa bɔhi, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ, bɔ ka a yɛn ti ma? Nyama, n na ka bia, ka daɣila Ɛliɛza ŋun nyɛ Damaskus nir la nti yɛn di n fali.
en: But Abram answered, Lord All-Powerful, you have given me everything I could ask for, except children. And when I die, Eliezer of Damascus will get all I own.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa bɔhi Amasa, M mabia, a mal alaafee? Ka daa zaŋ o nudirigu gbaai Amasa teeŋa n-niŋ kaman o yɛn mɔɣisila o kpariŋ la.
en: How are you, my brother? Joab asked Amasa, and with his right hand he took hold of Amasas beard as if to kiss him.

dag: Din tuhi niŋbu n-yɛn nyɛ di buɣisibu vulo, ka yɛlimaŋli nyɛ di bimbuɣisirigu. Sanʒiɛɣu ni ʒe yi ni niŋ ʒiri shɛli yɛda la bahi, ka kokpɛɣu mi ʒi yi ni niŋ yɛda ni binshɛli ni tiligi ya la chaŋ.
en: Justice and fairness will be the measuring lines that help me build. Hailstones and floods will destroy and wash away your shelter of lies.

dag: M mi ni yi nyɛla Ibrahimma zuliya; amaa di mi zaa yoli, yi bɔri ni yi ku ma, dama n yɛligu bi kpɛri yi suhuri ni.
en: I know you are Abrahams descendants. But you want to kill me, because you dont want to accept my teaching.

dag: Ka do so daa ti kani, ka bɛ zaŋ o chani ni bɛ ti sɔɣi, ka nya Mɔab ŋmɛnditoya ka zaŋ kpim maa bahi Ilaisha siliga ni ka zo. Kpim maa ni daa kul lu siliga maa ni ha n-shihi Ilaisha kɔba, o dii neemi yiɣisi zani.
en: Now it happened once that while a man was being buried, the people at the funeral suddenly saw a raiding party. They threw the body into Elishas tomb and ran off. When the body touched Elishas bones, the man came to life and stood up on his feet!.

dag: ka salo pam daa kul kabiri dol o, ka o daa tib barinim bɛn be bɛ ni.
en: Large crowds followed him, and he healed their sick.

dag: Ka Naa Ɛla ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o ni daa pun tum tuun shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi ni.
en: The rest of Elahs deeds and all that he did, arent they written in the official records of Israels kings?.

dag: Labisimiya yi tɛha zali di zaashee, ka di lan tumdiya alahichi yaha. Di nyɛla vi zaŋ chaŋ yi polo ni n yɛli ni yi ni shɛb bi mi Naawuni yɛla baabiɛla.
en: Come back to your right way of thinking and stop sinning. Some of you dont know God. I say this to shame you.

dag: Ka o daa lan po pɔri yɛl o, A yi kul yɛli ma a ni bɔri shɛlikam zaa hal di yi nyɛ n nam ŋɔ pirigili gba, n ni ti a li.
en: He promised her, Anything you ask for I will give to you—even half of my kingdom.

dag: Ka bɛ daa laɣim Izraɛl tɔbbihi na nti ti ba bidibbina ni bɛ yi n-chaŋ ti tuhi ba. Bɛ daa pirigila buyi dɔni kaman buhi biɛla la, amaa ka Siria tɔbbihi maa bɛn kul yɛrigila luɣilikam zaa.
en: The Israelites also prepared for war and went to fight the army of Aram. They made their camp opposite the camp of Aram. The Aramean soldiers filled the land, but Israels army looked like two small flocks of goats.

dag: Niriba yi chaŋ bɛ tuma ni, bɛ tumdimi hal ni zaawuni.
en: Then people go off to their work, to do their work until evening.

dag: Yawɛ dimnim ni chɛrisichɛrisi. Zallakudura Naa ni be alizanda ni ka tahi bɛ zuɣu na. Yawɛ ni kari dunia ŋɔ nim zaa saria. O ni ti o naa yaa, ka ti o ninvuɣ gahindili yiko.
en: The Lord 's enemies will be destroyed; he will thunder against them from heaven. The Lord will judge the whole world; he will give power to his king, he will make his chosen king victorious.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Asahɛl chaŋ Bɛtilihɛm ti sɔɣ o o ba siliga din daa be nimaani la puuni. Ka Jɔab min o niriba maa daa ŋmaligi doli tab yuŋ labi, zaŋ chaŋ biɛɣu daa ti yɛn neei, ka bɛ paai Hiburɔn.
en: Joab and his troops carried Asahel's body to Bethlehem and buried him in the family burial place. Then they marched all night and reached Hebron before sunrise.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa ŋme n-deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa. O daa deei zoya zuɣu tinsi mini Nɛgɛb polo tinsi zaa ni Goshɛn tiŋgbani zaa ni tintan ni tinsi ni Araba ni Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zoya zuɣu tinsi la.
en: So Joshua defeated all the people in that whole area. He had control over the hill country, the Negev, all the area of Goshen, the western foothills, the Jordan Valley, and the mountains of Israel and all the hills near them.

dag: Yi ni ŋubi wɔɣira nimdi, ka nyu dunia ŋɔ nanim ʒim mini piɛlahi ʒim ni piɛnyama ʒim ni buhi ʒim ni naɣilahi ʒim, bɛ zaa nyɛla Bashan biŋkɔb kpaba.
en: You will eat the flesh of warriors and drink the blood of the princes of the earth: rams, lambs, goats, bulls, all fattened animals from Bashan.

dag: Bɛ zaŋla zaɣ biɛɣu yo ma zaɣ viɛlli samli, ka zaŋ jɛlinsi yo ma yurilim samli.
en: They pay me back evil for good and hatred for love.

dag: N yaa paai kuɣili yaa? Bee n niŋgbuŋ nyɛla daanya?.
en: I am not strong like a rock. My body is not made from bronze.

dag: Miriya ka yi dihi yɔhiŋgu yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ tabili. Dina n-nyɛ: Yawɛ jɛmbu duu m-bɔŋɔ, Yawɛ jɛmbu duu m-bɔŋɔ, Yawɛ jɛmbu duu m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Don't fool yourselves! My temple is here in Jerusalem, but that doesn't mean I will protect you.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Sa daŋmi yibu biɛɣ asiba n-chaŋ ti chirigi Firawuna saha shɛl o ni chani mɔɣili ni la n-yɛl o ni Yawɛ yɛliya, Chɛ ka n niriba maa chaŋ ti jɛm ma.
en: The Lord said to Moses: Early tomorrow morning, while the king is on his way to the river, go and say to him, The Lord commands you to let his people go, so they can worship him.

dag: N kul guhirila Yawɛ; n kul guhir o mi, ka mali tahima o yɛligu ni.
en: With all my heart, I am waiting, Lord , for you! I trust your promises.

dag: Kalima anahi maa zaa kɔtomsi daa nyɛla yim, ka be kaman kalinli yini kpe n-gabila di kpee ni.
en: It appeared that there was one shape for all four of them, as if one wheel were inside another.

dag: dama bɛ suhutuntali zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ bi tooi baŋ bɔrɔbɔro la alahiziba tuuni la gbinni ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Thats because they hadnt understood about the loaves. Their minds had been closed so that they resisted Gods ways.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ yinim alahichinim ŋɔ yiɣisimi zani yi yaannim zaashee ni yi chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu!.
en: Now youve taken the place of your ancestors, a group of sinful men, to intensify the LORDs anger against Israel.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Sintani, Di viɛla, a mal o yiko, amaa leei di ku o.
en: The LORD answered the Adversary, There he is—within your power; only preserve his life.

dag: N dooni gbihira, ka lan yirisira, dama Yawɛ n-guli ma.
en: I sleep and wake up refreshed because you, Lord , protect me.

dag: Bɛn mali taali soli nyɛla so golima, amaa bɛn ka taali biɛhigu nyɛla din tuhi.
en: The ways of some people are twisted and strange, but the behavior of those who do right is pure.

dag: Ŋuna n-nam neesim titaŋa. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He made the bright lights in the sky. God's love never fails.

dag: Ka Iso daa nya paɣiba mini bihi maa ka bɔhi Yaakubu, Ka banima n-lee be a sani ŋɔ? Ka Yaakubu yɛl o, Naawuni ni niŋ mani a dabili ŋɔ nirilim ti ma bi shɛba m-bala.
en: Esau looked up and saw the women and children and said, Who are these with you? Jacob said, The children that God generously gave your servant.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Ba mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka tin ya suhudoo!.
en: May God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ give you grace and peace.

dag: Yɛlim din beni, karimi saria ni wuntizɔbo. Zabimi faranim mini nandaamba yɛlimaŋli zuɣu.
en: Speak for them and be a righteous judge. Protect the rights of the poor and needy.

dag: Amaa Gibiɔnnim ni daa wum Jɔshua ni niŋ Jɛriko mini Ai shɛm la zuɣu.
en: The people from the city of Gibeon heard about the way Joshua had defeated Jericho and Ai.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi pam bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu ka o yɛli, Niriba ŋɔ ni saɣim alikauli shɛli n ni daa lo bɛ yaannima, ka zaɣisi n nol la zuɣu.
en: So the LORD became angry with Israel and said, Because this nation has violated my covenant that I required of their ancestors and hasnt obeyed me.

dag: Ka naa daa zali Jɛrusalɛmnima ni bɛ tim maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim bɛ tarili kaman di ni simdi shɛm din ni chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ zaŋsim zaa niŋ Yawɛ zaligu tuma ni.
en: In addition, the king told the people of Jerusalem to bring the offerings to which the priests and the Levites were entitled, so that they could give all their time to the requirements of the Law of the Lord .

dag: Ka di daa niŋ niriba maa alahiziba pam ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Yɛtɔɣ bɔ ka doo ŋɔ lee yɛli ŋɔ? O mali yiko ka su fukumsi hal ka alizin biɛri ti deer o noli ka zɔri ka chɛri bɛ ni ʒi shɛb zuɣu.
en: They were all shaken and said to each other, What kind of word is this, that he can command unclean spirits with authority and power, and they leave.

dag: A yi be mɔpilli zuɣusaa larigi ni di so ni a mini yidaampaɣ so ŋun bɔri zabili pam laɣim be yil ni.
en: Better to live on the edge of a roof than to share a house with a contentious woman.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa nyaŋ Filistianim maa, ka bɛ daa bi lan buɣisi ni bɛ liri ba bɛ tiŋgbani maa ni yaha, ka Yawɛ daa kul darigiri Filistianim maa tibili Samuɛl ʒiɛmani maa ni zaa.
en: The Philistines were defeated and did not enter the land of Israel again. The Lord was against the Philistines during the rest of Samuels life.

dag: Miri ka a kpe bɛ ni puhiri chuɣu yili shɛli ni ka a mini ba ti ʒini n-di ka nyu.
en: Do not enter a house where people are feasting. Do not sit down with them to eat and drink.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Kulimiya ka labina dabisi shɛli din pahir ata dali. Ka niriba maa daa kuli.
en: Rehoboam answered, Come back to me in three days, and I will answer you. So the people left.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan mɔhi vuri pam yɛli, Pa doo ŋɔ ka ti bɔri ni a yihi bahi. Barabas ka ti bɔri ni a yihi bahi! Barabas daa nyɛla ŋmɛnditoli.
en: They answered him with a shout, No, not him! We want Barabbas.

dag: Deemiya saɣisigu kaman din yi yi ba sanna, dama di wuhiri ni Naawuni lihi ya la o bihi. Bi ŋuni n-lee beni ka o ba bi saɣisir o?.
en: Be patient when you are being corrected! This is how God treats his children. Don't all parents correct their children?.

dag: Yi ʒiɛmla Izraɛl Naawuni ni pii ya ka woligi ya Izraɛlnim ni n-zaŋ ya mir omaŋa ni yi tumdi tuma ŋun Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la ni, ka zaani niriba maa tooni n-tumdi tuma sɔŋdi ba la?.
en: Do you consider it a small matter that the God of Israel has set you apart from the rest of the community, so that you can approach him, perform your service in the Lord 's Tent, and minister to the community and serve them?.

dag: Juda Naa Uzia ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pihinahiyinika saha ka Jabɛshi bia Shallum daa di nam maa. O mi daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la gol yini Samaria.
en: In the thirty-ninth year of the reign of King Uzziah of Judah, Shallum son of Jabesh became king of Israel, and he ruled in Samaria for one month.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim yi ni tum n ni zali ba ni bɛ tum shɛm, ka gbibi n ni daa zaŋ n zaligu shɛŋa zaa ti Musa ni o ti ba la, dindina n ku lan chɛ ka bɛ vuui bɛ napɔŋ yi n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti bɛ yaannim la ni.
en: I will not continue to keep the Israelites off the land that I chose to give to their ancestors. But they must obey everything I commanded them. The Israelites must obey all the laws, rules, and commands that I gave Moses to give to them.

dag: Doo yi kpuɣ o mabia paɣa, o tum zaɣ biɛɣu, ka nya o mabia zaɣim, bɛ ku dɔɣi bia.
en: If a man takes his brother's wife, they will die childless. He has done a ritually unclean thing and has disgraced his brother.

dag: Din tuhi niŋbu n-yɛn nyɛ di buɣisibu vulo, ka yɛlimaŋli nyɛ di bimbuɣisirigu. Sanʒiɛɣu ni ʒe yi ni niŋ ʒiri shɛli yɛda la bahi, ka kokpɛɣu mi ʒi yi ni niŋ yɛda ni binshɛli ni tiligi ya la chaŋ.
en: I will make justice the measuring line and righteousness the plumb line. But hail will sweep away the hiding place of lies, and water will overflow the shelter.

dag: O bi chɛ ka ti tam o daalahiziba tumtumsa yɛla. Yawɛ nyɛla nirilimlana ni nambɔzɔra.
en: He does amazing things so that we will remember that the Lord is kind and merciful.

dag: Yawɛ n-teeg o nuu tiri teeku maa, ka chɛ ka dabiɛm gbaai di nanima, ka zali ni bɛ saɣimmi Keenan birininima.
en: The Lord 's hand has reached across the sea, upsetting the nations. He has given a command to destroy fortresses in the land of Canaan.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Yɛhudianim ninvuɣ zuɣuri daa chaŋ o sani nti fiɣisi Pool, ka balim o.
en: There the chief priests and some Jewish leaders told him about their charges against Paul. They also asked Festus.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa ti paai Bɛtisaida, ka bɛ zaŋ zoon so tah o sanna nti balim o ni o zaŋ o nuu shih o.
en: Jesus and his followers came to Bethsaida. Some people brought a blind man to him and begged him to touch the man.

dag: amaa m bi bɔri ni n niŋ shɛli ka di pala a yubu ni, dama m bɔri ni a tuun suŋ yila amaŋmaŋ yubu ni na, ka pa ni muɣisigu ni na.
en: But I won't do anything unless you agree to it first. I want your act of kindness to come from your heart, and not be something you feel forced to do.

dag: Shia Kasi yino m-beni, amaa ka o pina lee nyɛ balibubalibu.
en: There are different kinds of spiritual gifts, but they all come from the same Spirit.

dag: Bɛ taɣi kpibiga buŋ chaŋ, ka deei pakoli nahu talima.
en: They cheat orphans and widows by taking their donkeys and oxen.

dag: zaŋ tabili Kɛnnim mini Kɛnizinim ni Kadimɔninim.
en: together with the Kenites, the Kenizzites, the Kadmonites.

dag: Yawɛ mali yɛlimaŋli, dama n zaɣis o yɛligu. Amaa zuliya kam zaa, wummiya, nyamiya n ni diri wahala shɛm. Bɛ gbahi m paɣisara mini n nachimba n-zaŋ ba chaŋ ti leei daba.
en: The Lord was right, but I refused to obey him. Now I ask all of you to look at my sufferings— even my young people have been dragged away.

dag: Ti mi ni ti pun yi kum ni n-kpe nyɛvil ni ti ni yuri ti mabihi la zuɣu. Ka ŋunkam bi yur o mabia bela kum ni.
en: We know that we have left death and have come into life. We know this because we love each other as brothers and sisters. Anyone who does not love is still in death.

dag: Ka o daa tim tuumba Manaasa zuliya niriba zaa sani nti boli ba ka bɛ kana ti dol o. Ka o daa lan tim ti boli Asha mini Zɛbulɔn ni Naftali zuliya niriba, ka bɛ gba daa kana ti pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: He sent messengers into all of Manasseh, and they were also summoned to follow him. Then he sent messengers into Asher, Zebulun, and Naphtali too, and they marched up to meet them.

dag: Ka Judanim daa yɛli, Ʒiʒiriba gbarigiya; ka saɣiri pam mi beni, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka ti kɔŋ gooni maa mɛbu.
en: Meanwhile, the people of Judah were singing a sorrowful song: So much rubble for us to haul! Worn out and weary, will we ever finish this wall.

dag: Ŋuna n-zaani wuntaŋa ka o bi nyeera, ŋuna n-chɛ ka saŋmarisi bi peera.
en: With one command he can stop the sun from rising. He can lock up the stars and keep them from shining.

dag: Bɛ zaŋm di biŋkpam zaa mali sara, di zuli ni kpam mini kpam din pili namanama.
en: Offer all of the animal's fat, including the fat on its tail and on its insides.

dag: A min a bidibisi yi yɛn kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili ŋɔ ni, yin di nyu wain bee binnyɔr kpiɔŋ, yi yi niŋ lala yi ni kpi; di nyɛla zaligu din kul ni be yi ʒiɛmani kam ni sahakam.
en: You and your sons must not drink wine or beer when you come into the Meeting Tent. If you do, you will die. This law continues forever through your generations.

dag: Wummiya n ni yɛri ya shɛm. Chɛliya ka yi baɣa be n yɛligu ni.
en: Listen to what I am saying; pay attention to what I am telling you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti paai Ɛfɛsus, ka Pool chɛ Akuila mini Prisila ka chaŋ Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu ni o mini ba ti tɔɣisi Naawuni yɛla.
en: The three of them arrived in Ephesus, where Paul left Priscilla and Aquila. He then went into the synagogue to talk with the people there.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni ti o tarili wɔɣira puuni. O mini bɛn mali yaa ni ti laɣim pirigi bɛ ni ŋme n-di neen shɛŋa. Dama o daa saɣiya kpi, ka bɛ daa kal o pahi alahichinim ni. O daa ʒi niriba pam daalahichi, ka tim sandaani ti alahichinima.
en: And so I will give him a place of honor, a place among the great and powerful. He willingly gave his life and shared the fate of evil men. He took the place of many sinners and prayed that they might be forgiven.

dag: Zuŋɔ yuŋ ŋɔ bɛ dɔɣi yi tiligira ŋun nyɛ Masia ni yi Duuma la Naa Dauda ya Bɛtilihɛm.
en: Today your Savior was born in Davids town. He is the Messiah, the Lord.

dag: Ka lan yɛli, Nyama, a biɛli Ɛlizabɛt so bɛ ni yi booni paɣiŋoo la gba mali pua o ninkurilim ŋɔ ni; di chira ayɔbu m-bɔŋɔ;.
en: Look, even in her old age, your relative Elizabeth has conceived a son. This woman who was labeled unable to conceive is now six months pregnant.

dag: Ka bɛnkam pun mi o ni daa ti nya ka o tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa maa, ka bɛ yɛli taba, Ka bɔ n-lee siɣi Kish bia ŋɔ zuɣu na? Sool gba nyɛla anabi.
en: People who had known him before saw him doing this and asked one another, What has happened to the son of Kish? Has Saul become a prophet.

dag: Di simdi ni yi puhiri di chuɣu maa di puhibu saha yuuni kam.
en: Celebrate this festival each year at the same time.

dag: Yiliyiiniba daŋ ni: Ɛliashib. Dunɔguliba daŋ ni: Shallum mini Tɛlɛm ni Uri.
en: Among the singers, this is the man who married a foreign woman: Eliashib. Among the gatekeepers, these are the men who married foreign women: Shallum, Telem, and Uri.

dag: Amaa tinim ni lo kpara gari Izraɛlnim tooni chaŋ ti nya ʒiishee ti ba, ka ti bihi be bɛ ni me goma gili tin shɛŋa ni tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim zuɣu la ni.
en: where they can stay and be safe. Then we'll prepare to fight and lead the other tribes into battle.

dag: ka o daa yɛli ma, Kpɛm di puuni nti nya bɛ ni niŋdi vi binshɛŋa din chihiri shɛm kpe.
en: Then God said to me, Go in and look at the terrible, evil things that the people are doing here.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Leeban zuɣu ka o bɔhi Leeban, Taal bɔ ka n lee tum a? Ka alahichi dini ka n lee tum ka a kariti n naba na?.
en: Then Jacob became very angry and said, What wrong have I done? What law have I broken? What right do you have to chase me and stop me?.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti ʒini Naawuni jɛmbu duu miri bɛ liɣiri tɔhibu shee n-yuuni niriba ni tɔhiri liɣiri shɛm; ka bundaannim tɔhiri pampam.
en: Jesus sat across from the collection box for the temple treasury and observed how the crowd gave their money. Many rich people were throwing in lots of money.

dag: dindina maligumaana maa ŋun lihim o, ka niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu maa yi niŋ dilan niŋgbuŋ zaa, ŋun yɛlim ni o nyɛla ŋun ka o dɔro maa daɣiri ni, o niŋgbuŋ zaa ni leei zaɣ piɛlli maa zuɣu, o lan pala ŋun be daɣiri ni.
en: then the priest will make an examination. If the skin disease has covered the persons whole body, the priest will declare the infected person clean. The person has turned entirely white; he is clean.

dag: Ka di bi simdi ni man gba zo Ninive din nyɛ tin titali ŋɔ nambɔɣu gari lala? Dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be di ni kalinli gari tuhi kɔbiga ni pisi, ka nyɛ bɛn ʒi bɛ tooni ni bɛ nyaaŋa m-pahi biŋkɔbiri pam zuɣu.
en: Yet for my part, cant I pity Nineveh, that great city, in which there are more than one hundred twenty thousand people who cant tell their right hand from their left, and also many animals.

dag: Yawɛ soya zaa nyɛla yurilim maŋli mini ʒiɛyimtali soya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbib o daalikauli min o zaligunim sani.
en: In everything you do, you are kind and faithful to everyone who keeps our agreement with you.

dag: O ni daa chɛbisi ba naai ka o chaŋ ti du zo shɛli zuɣu ni o suhi Naawuni.
en: Then he told them goodbye and went up on the side of a mountain to pray.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Aduna bidibisi maa na ka Musa ti niŋ binʒim maa niŋ bɛ nudiriti tibinyaɣa ni mini bɛ nudiriti polo nubihilɔri ni bɛ nudiriti polo napombihilɔri. Ka Musa daa kpaai ʒim maa vie sara maligu bimbini maa.
en: Moses did the same thing for Aaron's sons, before splattering the rest of the blood against the four sides of the altar.

dag: Ka o mini ba daa laɣim doli kuli Nazarɛt, ka o daa deeri bɛ noli. Ka o ma daa zaŋ yɛla ŋɔ zaa niŋ o suhu ni.
en: Jesus went with them to Nazareth and obeyed them. His mother was still thinking about all these things.

dag: Ka Simiɔn daa deei bia maa buɣi, ka paɣiri Naawuni yɛra:.
en: Simeon took Jesus in his arms and praised God. He said.

dag: dindina maligumaana maa ni lih o, ka dɔr shɛli din zaɣisir maa yi yɛlig o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ zuɣu, di bi lan simdi ni maligumaana yuli ni o nya kɔb shɛli din nyɛ dɔzim maa, dilan nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni.
en: the priest must examine it again. If the scabies has spread over the skin at all, the priest does not need to look for the yellow hair; the person is unclean.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ yi lan lo ni yi zaŋ Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm dɔbba mini paɣiba zaa leei yi daba. Yi bi mi ni yi gba tumla alahichi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani maa?.
en: And now you think you can enslave the men and women of Judah and Jerusalem? What about your own guilt before the LORD your God?.

dag: Dama m boli ya ka yi zaɣisi, ka n teei n nuu na, ka yi baɣa ka di ni.
en: You completely ignored me and refused to listen;.

dag: Amaŋmaŋ cham ti tuhi, mali kpiɔŋ tɔb maa tuhibu ni. Di yi pa lala Naawuni ni ŋme a luh a dimnim maa tooni. Dama Naawuni mali yiko din ni sɔŋ nira bee n-ŋme o luhi.
en: Maybe you will make yourself strong and ready for war, but God can help you win or help you lose.

dag: Di zaa nyɛla yim, dinzuɣu ka n yɛli, O kurila ninvuɣ suma mini ninvuɣ biɛri zaa.
en: What difference does it make? God destroys the innocent along with the guilty.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ zaŋ o shia ti ma. O tim ma mi ni n zaŋ lahiba suŋ ti ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari nahiŋgu, ka maai bɛn suhuri saɣim la suhuri; ka yihi bɛn nyɛ daba la dabitim ni; ka yooi bɛn be sarika ni la bahi.
en: The Sovereign Lord has filled me with his Spirit. He has chosen me and sent me To bring good news to the poor, To heal the broken-hearted, To announce release to captives And freedom to those in prison.

dag: ka daa lo o mihi n-zaŋ o tahi Gomna Pailɛt sani.
en: They bound him, led him away, and turned him over to Pilate the governor.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa kana ti liri Izraɛlnima; tɔb maa ni daa ti mii, ka Filistianim daa tuhi nyaŋ Izraɛlnima, ka ku bɛ tɔbbihi tusa anahi tɔb maa ni.
en: The Philistines readied themselves to fight Israel. When the battle was joined, Israel was defeated by the Philistines, who killed about four thousand men on the battlefield.

dag: Ka anabinim shɛb bɛn daa be Bɛtɛl daa yina ti bɔhi Ilaisha, A mi ni Yawɛ ni kpuɣ a zuɣulan maa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n-chaŋ ka chɛ a bebɔ? Ka Ilaisha garigi yɛli ba, Iin, m mi. Amaa shiniya yi noli.
en: The group of prophets at Bethel came to Elisha and said to him, Do you know that the Lord will take your master away from you today? Elisha said, Yes, I know. Dont talk about it.

dag: Di ni lu yi zuɣu n-din ya; di ni lu yi zuɣu asiba n-gari yim, ka lu yi zuɣu wuntaŋ ni ni yuŋ. Ka yɛl biɛɣu kam ni chɛ ka yi baŋ Naawuni yɛligu gbinni!.
en: It will strike you again and again, morning after morning. You will have to bear it day and night. Each new message from God will bring new terror!.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yi maa ha ka bɛ yɛli taba, Doo maa bi tum tuun shɛli din simdi kum bee sarika kpɛhibu.
en: As they left, they were saying to each other, This man is doing nothing that deserves death or imprisonment.

dag: Jɛhɔiada kum maa nyaaŋa ka Juda kpamba daa kana ti jɛm naa, ka naa daa wum bɛ ni yɛli shɛm.
en: After Jehoiadas death, however, the leaders of Judah came and bowed before the king, and the king listened to them.

dag: Ninvuɣ so daa yi tum din chihi Anabi Musa zaligu, bɛ kur o mi niriba ata bee ayi shɛhira zuɣu ka nambɔzɔbo kani.
en: When someone rejected the Law from Moses, they were put to death without mercy on the basis of the testimony of two or three witnesses.

dag: So miri ka o zaŋ o ba paɣ dɔni, dama o nyɛla o ba paɣa.
en: You must not have sexual relations with your fathers wife, even if she is not your mother, because that is like having sexual relations with your father.

dag: Naa Siiza Agasitus daa ti bahi noli ni bɛ sab o tiŋgbɔŋ ni niriba zaa yuya baŋ bɛ kalinli.
en: About that time Emperor Augustus gave orders for the names of all the people to be listed in record books.

dag: Naawuni, a mi n jɛrilim ni nyɛ shɛm. N ni pun tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa bi sɔɣ a sani.
en: God, you know my faults. I cannot hide my sins from you.

dag: Ti Duuma yoomi yi suhuri ka yi baŋ Naawuni yurilim ni nyɛ shɛm, ka chɛ ka yi mali ʒiɛyimtali din nyɛ Masia dini.
en: I pray that the Lord will guide you to be as loving as God and as patient as Christ.

dag: Ka yiɣisi nimaani yi zɔŋ ni. Ka yili maa ni bipuɣin so gba ti lan nya o ka yɛli bɛn daa ʒe nimaani maa, Doo ŋɔ gba yi bela Yisa ŋun yi Nazarɛt na ŋɔ sani.
en: Then he left the yard. At the gate another girl saw him and said to the people there, This man was with Jesus of Nazareth.

dag: Amaa so yi zaŋ o puu ti Yawɛ yi chuɣu maa puhibu nyaaŋa, dindina maligumaana ni zali di liɣiri ni nyɛ shɛm, ka di doli yuun shɛŋa din na kpalim ni bɛ nɛma labisi ti yuuni maa, ka yi ni tooi yihi shɛli yi daa maa ni.
en: But if you give your field after the Jubilee, the priest must decide its exact price. He must count the number of years to the next year of Jubilee and use that number to decide the price.

dag: Amaa miri ka a lan tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa Bɛtɛl ŋɔ, dama di nyɛla naa sara maligu bimbini shee, ka nyɛ o nam sulinsi jɛmbu shee.
en: But dont prophesy anymore here at Bethel. This is Jeroboams holy place. This is Israels temple.

dag: Ka Nataniɛl yɛl o, Karimba, a nyɛla Naawuni Bia! A nyɛla Izraɛlnim Naa.
en: Nathanael replied, Rabbi, you are Gods Son. You are the king of Israel.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni zaŋ ya ti bahi tiŋgban shɛli din be Damaskus tooni ha. Man Yawɛ ŋun yuli nyɛ Binnamda zaa Naawuni la n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Therefore, I will take you away beyond Damascus, says the LORD, whose name is the God of heavenly forces.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Abimilɛk daa kpah o niriba zuɣu ni yɛli, Ŋunkam niŋ doo ŋɔ bee o paɣ ŋɔ shɛli, bɛn kum o.
en: So Abimelech gave a warning to all the people. He said, No one must hurt this man or this woman. If anyone hurts them, they will be killed.

dag: Yalim nyɛla bin suŋ; amaa ka yalim yi ti niŋ piti, wula ka yi lee yɛn niŋ chɛ ka di lan nyaɣisi yaha? Chɛliya ka yalim be yi ni, ka yi mali suhu yini ni taba.
en: Salt is good; but if salt loses its saltiness, how will it become salty again? Maintain salt among yourselves and keep peace with each other.

dag: Ka Musa mini Lɛvinim bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la daa tɔɣisi Izraɛlnim zaa yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Izraɛlnima, chɛliya vuri ka wum, zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka yi leei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ niriba.
en: Then Moses, together with the levitical priests, said to all the people of Israel, Give me your attention, people of Israel, and listen to me. Today you have become the people of the Lord your God;.

dag: Ka bɛ chɛchɛbunsi zɔri yiriŋ doli solɔri, ka kabiri kpɛri niriba ni laɣindi luɣ shɛŋa n-chani tooni ka labiri nyaaŋa. Bɛ bemi kaman buɣim mokpala la, ka bɛ labiri kpana kaman saa nyaɣisibu la.
en: Their horses prance, and their armored chariots dart around like lightning or flaming torches.

dag: N suhu yɛliya, Kamina ti jɛm o. Yawɛ, nyini ka n shiri ni jɛm;.
en: Come, my heart says, seek Gods face. LORD, I do seek your face!.

dag: Yi ni so yi mali taali ni o kpee, o ni buɣisi ni o zaŋ di yɛla maa tahi sariakaritiba bɛn pa Yisa yɛdaniŋdiba sani, ka pa ni Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda sani?.
en: If any of you have a dispute with another Christian, how dare you go before heathen judges instead of letting God's people settle the matter?.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka yi kuhiri pampam yi ni nya dan shɛli maa zuɣu? Yi biɛrim maa ka tibbu. Yi taali ni galisi pam, ka yi daalahichi galisi yaɣi ka n niŋ ya lala maa zuɣu.
en: So don't bother to cry out for relief from your pain.

dag: Yi yi ni kpalim be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, dindina n ni lan chɛ ka yi nya yaa, ka n ku lan daai ya luhi. N ni zaŋ ya sa, ka ku lan vuɣi ya, dama n ni daa chɛ ka alɔbo shɛli lu yi zuɣu maa, di lan niŋ ma yoli pam. .
en: If you are willing to go on living in this land, then I will build you up and not tear you down; I will plant you and not pull you up. The destruction I brought on you has caused me great sorrow.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi ti zaŋ ba niŋ yi nuu ni, ka yi nyaŋ ba, di saha yin kumiya bɛ zaa. Di ti lɔnya ba alikauli, yi mi di ti zo ba nambɔɣu.
en: the Lord will force them out of the land. Then you must destroy them without mercy. Don't make any peace treaties with them.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Ahaz daa tim Asiria naa sani ti yɛl o ni o zo o kuŋa.
en: The Edomites began to raid Judah again and captured many prisoners, so King Ahaz asked Tiglath Pileser, the emperor of Assyria, to send help.

dag: Ka Shisha bihi Ɛlihɔrɛf mini Ahija nyɛ gbansabiriba. Ka Ahilud bia Jɛhɔshafat nyɛ ŋun su gbana gbibbu fukumsi.
en: Elihoreph and Ahijah, sons of Shisha, had the job of writing notes about what happened in the courts; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud wrote notes about the history of the people;.

dag: Di pa shɛli na so ni tooi mali napaɣiba pihiyɔbu, ka mali mamanim pihinii ni paɣisara bɛn ka kalinli.
en: Let the king have sixty queens, eighty concubines, young women without number!.

dag: Ka niriba daa yi n-chaŋ ni bɛ ti nya din niŋ maa, ka daa paai Yisa sani nti nya alizin biɛri ni daa ʒi do so zuɣu maa, ka o leela ninvuɣ maŋli n-ye situra ʒi Yisa tooni; ka dabiɛm daa kpe ba pam.
en: People went out to see what had happened. They came to Jesus and found the man sitting there at the feet of Jesus. The man had clothes on and was in his right mind again; the demons were gone. This made the people afraid.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun tiri li billi kaman o ni bɔri shɛm; o tiri bimbiɛlli kam la dimaŋmaŋ billi.
en: But God gives it the body that he has planned for it, and he gives each kind of seed its own body.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Malimi wahu ŋun mali lɔɣu n-zaŋ tabili da wɔɣinli; ka wahu yi dim sokam ka o lihi li, o ni tiligi.
en: Then the Lord told Moses to make a metal snake and put it on a pole, so that anyone who was bitten could look at it and be healed.

dag: Di simdi ka o wurim yili maa ka va di kuɣa mini di yɔɣira ni di tari zaa ti bahi tiŋ maa tariga tampuli zuɣu.
en: The house must be destroyed—its stones, wood, and all the plaster in the house. All of it must be taken outside the city to an unclean area.

dag: ti daag o yihi bɛ tiŋ maa tariga nti labir o kuɣa. Ka bɛn daa di o kubu maa shɛhira ka lan nyɛ bɛn yɛn ku o maa fuɣi bɛ binyɛra ti sɔŋ nachimbil so ŋun yuli daa booni Sool la tooni.
en: threw him out of the city, and began to stone him. The witnesses placed their coats in the care of a young man named Saul.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Samsin daa ti chaŋ Gaza ti nya pagɔr so nimaani ka o kɔre kpe o ni, ka o zaŋ o dɔni.
en: One day Samson went to the Philistine city of Gaza, where he met a prostitute and went to bed with her.

dag: Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bi ŋubi alahichi sanyoo sara biŋkɔbigu maa luɣ kasi shee ŋɔ, dama di nyɛla din nyɛ kasi zaa. Naawuni zaŋ li mi tin ya ni yi yihi niriba maa taali ni ka mali bɛ taali ni yibu maa sanyoo sara Yawɛ sani.
en: Why didn't you eat the sin offering in a sacred place? It is very holy, and the Lord has given it to you in order to take away the sin of the community.

dag: Di saha ka n daa suhi Yawɛ yɛli, Yawɛ, n suhir a, tiligim ma!.
en: I prayed and said, Lord , please don't let me die.

dag: Ka a yɛli Izraɛlnima, Ŋunkam tu Naawuni, dilan daalahichi ni ʒin o zuɣu.
en: And warn the others that everyone else who curses me will die in the same way, whether they are Israelites by birth or foreigners living among you.

dag: Shɛhiralan ŋun ʒe yim bi ŋmari ʒiri, amaa ʒiri shɛhiralan ŋun kul tuhirila ʒiri bahira.
en: A good witness is one who does not lie. A bad witness is a liar who cannot be trusted.

dag: Ka yi daa garigi yɛli ma, A ni lo shɛm maa viɛla.
en: You answered me: What you have proposed is a good idea.

dag: ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka m pah a ninvuɣ gahinda maa zuɣu tɔŋ, ka pah a zuliya zuɣu nya suhupiɛlli, ka pah a niriba zuɣu tibig a.
en: so I can experience the good things your chosen ones experience, so I can rejoice in the joy of your nation, so I can praise along with your possession.

dag: ka din pahi pisiyinika gbaai Pɛtahia, ka din pahi pisi gbaai Jɛhɛzikɛl.
en: The nineteenth was Pethahiahs group. The twentieth was Jehezkels group.

dag: Bɛ daa yi yila daa na bɛ bi diri bindirigu faashee bɛ paɣila bɛ ni pɔi. Ka bɛ daa lan paai bɛ yaannim kal shɛŋa dol li pahi. Dina n-nyɛ: Pipihi mini duɣiri ni taha ni teebuya paɣibu.
en: nor do they eat anything that comes from the market unless they wash it first. And they follow many other rules which they have received, such as the proper way to wash cups, pots, copper bowls, and beds. .

dag: Tinzunnim ni kana ti me yi goma tin ya, ka bɛ nanim jɛm ya. N daa yiɣisila n suhu bahi yi zuɣu n-darigi yi tibili, amaa pumpɔŋɔ n ni zɔn ya nambɔɣu, ka niŋ ya nirilim.
en: The Lord says to Jerusalem, Foreigners will rebuild your walls, And their kings will serve you. In my anger I punished you, But now I will show you my favor and mercy.

dag: Di saha maa, yi ni ti fabili pam yi ni pii na so maa zuɣu, amaa ka Yawɛ ti ku garigi ya dindali maa.
en: and you will finally cry out for the Lord to save you from the king you wanted. But the Lord won't answer your prayers.

dag: Ka bia maa tizɔpaɣa daa ʒe kpaŋa ni o nya din yɛn niŋ o.
en: The babys older sister stood watch nearby to see what would happen to him.

dag: N ni bɔhi ba biɛri pam, ka darigi bɛ tibili ni suhuyiɣisili fiɛbiga. N yi bɔhi ba biɛri, di saha bɛ ni baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. .
en: In my fierce anger, I will take revenge on them. And when I punish them, they will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Yinim garinsi zuliya ŋɔ, wula ka yɛtɔɣ suma ni tooi yi yi nol ni na ka yi nyɛ ninvuɣ biɛri ŋɔ? Dama din be sal suhu ni, dina n-yir o nol ni na.
en: You snakes—how can you say good things when you are evil? For the mouth speaks what the heart is full of.

dag: Yawɛ, a chɛ ka ti kuhimi kaman paɣa ni wolisiri ni o dɔɣi ka kuhiri biɛrim zuɣu shɛm la.
en: Because of what you did to us, we suffered like a woman about to give birth.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Zɛlɔfɛhad bipuɣinsi maa polo n-nyɛ ni bɛ kulim bɛ suhuri ni yu dɔbba shɛba, amaa ni bɛ lee kulimila bɛmaŋmaŋ daŋ puuni dɔbba.
en: I will allow Zelophehad's daughters to marry anyone, as long as those men belong to one of the clans of the Manasseh tribe.

dag: Bɛ ni ʒi taali ni yibu Naawuni sani soli ka dolila bɛmaŋmaŋ ni bɔri so shɛli ni bɛ yi taali ni Naawuni san la zuɣu ka bɛ daa bi zaŋ bɛmaŋ kpɛhi taali ni yibu Naawuni sani sol la dolibu ni.
en: what makes people acceptable to him. So they refuse to trust God, and they try to be acceptable by obeying the Law.

dag: Nimaani ka o daa ti nya do so ŋun yuli booni Ɛnias, ka o gbaya kpi ka o do tiŋa yuma anii zaa.
en: There he met a man named Aeneas, who was paralyzed and had not been able to get out of bed for eight years.

dag: m-pahi ŋun Sulemaana tuma zuɣulaannim tusaata ni kɔbisita shɛb bɛn daa lihiri tumtumdiba maa ka bɛ tumdi tuma la.
en: This doesnt include Solomons , supervisors in charge of the work, who had oversight over the laborers.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Ka yi yi ti nya ka yɛlibiɛ shɛli din chihira ʒe di ni bi simdi ni di ʒe luɣ shɛli polo, ŋunkam ti karim sabbu ŋɔ, ŋun baŋmi di ni wuhi shɛm! Di saha maa bɛn ti be Judia, bɛn zom ti du zoya.
en: Someday you will see that Horrible Thing where it should not be. Everyone who reads this must try to understand! If you are living in Judea at that time, run to the mountains.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Yɛhudianim daa maan mooi bɛ nini bɔri ni bɛ ku o, dama bɛ daa zaŋ zali ni o bi saɣim la Vuhim Dabisili dali zaligu kɔŋko, amaa ni o yɛliya ni Naawuni n-nyɛ o Ba, ka di wuhi ni o zaŋ omaŋ maɣisi Naawuni.
en: Now the leaders wanted to kill Jesus for two reasons. First, he had broken the law of the Sabbath. But even worse, he had said God was his Father, which made him equal with God.

dag: Ka Harim bia Malikija mini Pahatimɔab bia Hashub daa mali me yaɣ shɛli mini Bɔrɔbɔro Shɛbu Duri Shee Pia la.
en: Malchijah son of Harim and Hasshub son of Pahath Moab built both the next section and the Tower of the Ovens.

dag: Ŋuna ka Naawuni tibigi n-zaŋ o ʒili o nudirigu polo ni o leei ti toondana ni ti tiligira n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim niŋ tuuba ka nya alahichi chɛ m-paŋ.
en: Jesus is the one God honored by giving him a place at his right side. He made him our Leader and Savior. God did this to give all the people of Israel the opportunity to change and turn to God to have their sins forgiven.

dag: Bɛ kpamba n-daa nyɛ Ahiɛza mini Jɔash bɛn daa nyɛ Shɛmaa Gibia nir bihi la. Bɛn pahi n-daa nyɛ Jɛziɛl mini Pɛlɛt bɛn daa nyɛ Azimavɛt bihi la ni Bɛraka ni Jɛhu ŋun daa nyɛ Anatɔt nir la.
en: Ahiezer, their leader, and Joash ; Jeziel and Pelet ; Beracah and Jehu from the town of Anathoth;.

dag: Ka Izraɛl kpamba zaa daa ka naa sanna Hiburɔn, ka Naa Dauda ti lo ba alikauli Yawɛ tooni Hiburɔn maa, ka bɛ daa booi kpam bahi Dauda zuɣu ni ka o leei Izraɛl naa.
en: So all the leaders of Israel came to meet with King David at Hebron. He made an agreement with them in Hebron in front of the Lord , and they anointed David to be the king of Israel.
