dag: Zaŋm a gbaɣino min a nyɔtaɣirigu yiɣisi zani sɔŋ ma.
en: Take your shield and armor and come to my rescue.

dag: Ka bɛ daa va bɛ kɔba ti sɔɣi Jabɛshi tiŋ puuni tamarisik tia gbini, ka lo noli daba ayopɔin.
en: Then they took their bones and buried them under the tamarisk tree at Jabesh, and they fasted seven days.

dag: Chɛ ka Naawuni yiɣisi, chɛ ka o dimnim wurim; chɛ ka bɛnkam je o ŋmalig o tooni guui.
en: Let God rise up; let his enemies scatter; let those who hate him run scared before him!.

dag: Ka Salɛm Naa Mɛlikizɛdɛk ŋun daa lan nyɛ Zallakudura Naa maligumaana la daa zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro mini wain na nti ti Ibram;.
en: King Melchizedek of Salem was a priest of God Most High. He brought out some bread and wine.

dag: amaa o yi zaŋ o ni su shɛli ti o tumtumdiba ni yino pini, di ni nyɛ o dini hal ni faako yuuni, di nyaaŋa ka o labisi li ti naa. O bidibisi kɔŋko n-ni tooi su o ni zaŋ binshɛli ti ba pini.
en: And if he gives one of his servants a gift from his inheritance, it will belong to the servant only until the year of release, and then it will revert to the prince. It is his childrens inheritance; it belongs to them.

dag: Di saha ka Sulemaana daa mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la n-ti Yawɛ o ni daa me Yawɛ sara maligu bimbin shɛli zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa varanda tooni la zuɣu.
en: Solomon offered sacrifices to the Lord on the altar he had built in front of the temple porch.

dag: Naawuni mi bi deeri ti la bindirigu dibu zuɣu: Ti yi di, di bi pahiri ti shɛli; ti mi yi bi di, di bi filindi ti.
en: Food, however, will not improve our relation with God; we shall not lose anything if we do not eat, nor shall we gain anything if we do eat.

dag: ka o zaŋdi ba chani tɔbu ni ka zaŋdi ba labirina; ka di chɛ ka nyin Yawɛ niriba ku be kaman piɛri bɛn ka gula.
en: who will go out before them and return before them, someone who will lead them out and bring them back, so that the LORDs community wont be like sheep without their shepherd.

dag: Yawɛ, teem a nambɔzɔbo min a yurilim maŋli la yɛla; dama di nyɛla din daa pun beni kurimbuni ha.
en: Remember to be kind to me, Lord . Show me the tender love that you have always had.

dag: Ka a bih ayi shɛb a ni pun dɔɣi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni pɔi ka n naanyi kul a sanna Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni na la nyɛla m bihi. Ifriim mini Manaasa nyɛla m bihi kaman Rubin mini Simiɔn ni nyɛ m bihi shɛm la.
en: Then Jacob went on to say: Joseph, your two sons Ephraim and Manasseh were born in Egypt, but I accept them as my own, just as Reuben and Simeon are mine.

dag: Di saha ka Aduna daa teeg o nuu tiri Ijipti koma zaa, ka poloya daa yina n-yɛrigi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: So Aaron held it out over all the water, and the frogs came out and covered the land.

dag: Babilɔn naa wum bɛ yɛla, ka o bɔɣiri ni cheei kom. Ka biɛrim gbaag o; biɛrim shɛli din be kaman paɣ ni wolisiri ni o dɔɣi ka biɛrim shɛli mal o la.
en: The king of Babylon heard about those armies, and he is paralyzed with fear. He is overcome with fear and pain, like a woman giving birth.

dag: Naa, mani Aruna zaŋ dimbɔŋɔ zaa ti a. Ka Aruna daa lan yɛli naa, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni deeg a suhigu maa.
en: Araunah gave it all to the king and said to him, May the Lord your God accept your offering.

dag: O nam maa dibu yuun tuuli puuni ka man Daniɛl daa ti karindi litaafi kasinim ni, ka tɛhiri Jɛrusalɛm ni wurim doya yuun pisopɔin kaman Naawuni ni daa pun yɛli anabi Jɛrimia shɛm la yɛla.
en: I, Daniel, pondered the scrolls, specifically the number of years that it would take to complete Jerusalems desolation according to the LORDs word to the prophet Jeremiah. It was seventy years.

dag: Ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ suhuri ni tɛha maa ka bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bɔhiri yi suhuri dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu?.
en: Jesus knew what they were thinking, and he said, Why are you thinking this?.

dag: N di darigi bɛ tibili yɛla ŋɔ zuɣu? Ka n di bɔhi zuliya ŋ-ŋɔ tatabo biɛri? n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Why shouldn't I punish the people of Judah?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kum ka fabili pam, ka lo noli Sool min o bia Jɔnatan ni Yawɛ niriba Izraɛlnim zuɣu dindali hal ni zaawuni, bɛ ni daa zaŋ takɔbiri ku ba maa zuɣu.
en: They mourned and cried and fasted until evening for Saul, his son Jonathan, the LORDs army, and the whole house of Israel, because they had died by the sword.

dag: Ka Yisa daa dii teeg o nuu na n-gbaag o ka bɔh o, Nyin ŋun yɛda pɔri ŋɔ, bɔ n-niŋ ka a biɛhinda.
en: Then Jesus caught Peter with his hand. He said, Your faith is small. Why did you doubt.

dag: Ka Pita daa nya lala ka bɔhi niriba maa, Yinim Izraɛlnima, bɔ n-niŋ ka yɛlli ŋɔ niŋ ya alahiziba bee wula ka yi ti yuuni ti kaman tinim maŋmaŋ yiko ni bee ti wuntitali zuɣu n-chɛ ka gbarigu ŋɔ yiɣisi leei ŋun chani maa.
en: When Peter saw the people, he said to them, Fellow Israelites, why are you surprised at this, and why do you stare at us? Do you think that it was by means of our own power or godliness that we made this man walk?.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Kulimiya ka labina dabisi shɛli din pahir ata dali. Ka niriba maa daa kuli.
en: Come back in three days and I will give you my answer, he replied. So they left.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli ba, Dimiya li zuŋɔ, dama zuŋɔ nyɛla Yawɛ Vuhim Dabisili, yi ku nya li tiŋgban ni zuŋɔ.
en: Moses said, Eat this today, because today is the Sabbath, a day of rest dedicated to the Lord , and you will not find any food outside the camp.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni shɛb daa shihila kpima, ka leei bɛn bi be kasi, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ ku tooi puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu maa dindali maa. Bɛna n-daa ka Musa mini Aduna sanna dindali maa.
en: But some of the people could not celebrate Passover that day. They were unclean because they had touched a dead body. So they went to Moses and Aaron that day.

dag: Dama o mi o ni zaŋ binshɛli nam ti. O teeya ni ti nyɛla taŋkpaɣu.
en: He knows all about us. He knows we are made from dust.

dag: M be yi sani, di zɔriya dabiɛm. N ni laɣim yi zuliya bɛn be wulimpuhili polo ni wulinluhili polo zaa na.
en: Dont fear, I am with you. From the east Ill bring your children; from the west Ill gather you.

dag: Ka zuɣulaannima ayi maa mini kpambaliba la daa naai noli chaŋ naa sani nti yɛl o, Naa Darius, Naawuni dolim a nyɛvili.
en: They all went to the king and said: Your Majesty, we hope you live forever!.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa lab o naɣikɔra maa sani nti zaŋ ba kɔrigi, ka zaŋ bɛ dapuhi m-mali buɣim duɣi ba n-zaŋ ti niriba ka bɛ ŋubi. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa chaŋ ti doli Ilaija n-sɔŋd o.
en: Then Elisha went to his team of oxen, killed them, and cooked the meat, using the yoke as fuel for the fire. He gave the meat to the people, and they ate it. Then he went and followed Elijah as his helper.

dag: Baanabas mini Sool ni daa tum bɛ tuma naai, ka bɛ zaŋ Jɔn ŋun yuli daa lan booni Maak la pahi bɛmaŋ zuɣu yi Jɛrusalɛm n-lan chaŋ bɛ chandi shee.
en: And after Barnabas and Saul had done the work they were sent to do, they went back to Jerusalem with John, whose other name was Mark.

dag: N ni wurim ba bɛ dimnim tooni bahi kaman pɔhim n-yi gbinni polo na ti ʒe ba chaŋ la. Bɛ zaɣ biɛɣu nyabu dali, n ni ti lɛbi n nyaaŋa biri ba ka pa ni n tooni.
en: I will scatter my people before their enemies, like dust blown by the east wind. I will turn my back on them; I will not help them when the disaster comes.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu mini zahim ayi kɔŋko n-kul be ti sani kpe.
en: But they said, We have only five small loaves of bread and two fish.

dag: Bɛmaŋmaŋ takɔbiri maa ni ŋmaligi ku ba; ka Naawuni kabisi bɛ tɔbiri maa.
en: But the sword of the wicked will enter their own hearts! Their bows will be broken!.

dag: Di yi nyɛla n daa dolila ʒiri, ka doli yɔhiŋ soli yomyom.
en: If I have walked with frauds or my feet have hurried to deceit.

dag: wuhim ma a samli ka n yo a.
en: Tell me what I should pay you, and I will give it to you.

dag: Miri ka a niŋ a kpee fitiina bee n-fa o. A yi bu so paa ka o tum a tuma, nyin di chɛ ka o liɣiri gbe a sani.
en: You must not cheat or rob your neighbor. You must not hold a hired workers salary overnight until morning.

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa la min o ni daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi ni o ni daa niŋ shɛm n-chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ suhu yiɣisi la zuɣu ka lala daa niŋ maa.
en: because Jeroboam had made the Lord God of Israel angry by sinning and causing the Israelites to sin.

dag: Ka Aduna ti zaŋ naɣilaa maa mali ŋun maŋmaŋ daalahichi sanyoo sara n-yo o min o yiŋnim daalahichi samli.
en: Aaron, you must offer the bull as a sacrifice of forgiveness for your own sins and for the sins of your family.

dag: Amaa ka a daa lan pɔbisi a pɔhim, ka teeku kom lim ba, ka bɛ shim ko tiŋa kaman kurigu n-lu kopurim ni la.
en: But one breath from you, Lord , and the Egyptians were drowned; they sank like lead in the terrible water.

dag: Chɛ ka karimbaannim di vi bɛ ni ŋmari ʒiri pari ma la zuɣu, amaa n kul ni tɛhir a zaligunim maa yɛla.
en: May the proud be ashamed for falsely accusing me; as for me, I will meditate on your instructions.

dag: Nyama, Mani n-nam machɛle, ka ti zuɣiri pɔhim, ka di chɛ ka buɣimsala buɣim nyɛligira, ka machɛli kuriti bidibbini din ni ku di bukaata. Mani n lan nam ŋun bɔhiri biɛri ka o kuri niriba.
en: Look, I myself created the metalworker who blows the fire of coal and who produces a tool for his work. And I myself created the looter to destroy.

dag: Niriba ayi maa ni daa ti ŋmaligi chani saha shɛli ka Pita yɛli Yisa, N Duuma, di viɛli ni ti be kpe. Chɛ ka ti ti suɣa ata: A zaɣ yini; Anabi Musa zaɣ yini; Anabi Ilaija mi zaɣ yini. Ŋun Pita daa ʒi o ni yɛli shɛm maa gbinni.
en: When Moses and Elijah were leaving, Peter said, Master, it is good that we are here. We will put three tents here—one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.

dag: Gbuɣinli chɛ ŋumbu, gbuɣindaa kukoli foya, ka gbuɣimpola nyina kabisi.
en: The wicked roar and growl like lions, but God silences them and breaks their teeth.

dag: Dama dimbɔŋɔ dina yi ti bi yɛn niŋ yomyom yi n-chaŋ bee n-yi n-guui. Yawɛ nti yɛn be yi tooni mali ya chana. Ka Izraɛl Naawuni nyɛ ŋun yɛn be yi nyaaŋa polo n-nyɛ yi gula.
en: This time you will not have to leave in a hurry; you will not be trying to escape. The Lord your God will lead you and protect you on every side.

dag: O daa tɔɣisi tihi yɛla. Sida tihi din be Lɛbanɔn zaŋ tabili taaŋkɔro tuturi din bili tam goma zuɣu yɛla; ka daa lan tɔɣisi biŋkɔbiri mini noonsi ni nyɛbisi ni zahim gba yɛla.
en: He spoke of trees and plants, from the Lebanon cedars to the hyssop that grows on walls; he talked about animals, birds, reptiles, and fish.

dag: Ɛpafiras ŋun be sarika ŋɔ ni pahi n zuɣu Yisa Masia zuɣu la puhir a.
en: Epaphras is also here in jail for being a follower of Christ Jesus. He sends his greetings.

dag: Buni palila wuntizɔriba yinsi, amaa ashaara kul lurila ninvuɣ biɛri nyamma zuɣu.
en: Good people become wealthy, but those who are evil will lose what they have.

dag: Ka salo maa ni yino daa kuhi yɛl o, Karimba, n suhir a mi ni a lihi m bia ŋɔ ti ma, dama o kɔŋko n-kul nyɛ m bia.
en: A man from the crowd shouted, Teacher, I beg you to take a look at my son, my only child.

dag: Ka naa maa suhu daa paligi ti yaɣi, ka o bahi noli ni bɛ yihim Daniɛl bɔɣili maa ni na. Ka bɛ daa voog o yihi na n-nya ka o bi nya daŋa hal baabiɛla gba, o ni daa niŋ Naawuni yɛda zuɣu.
en: The king was relieved to hear Daniel's voice, and he gave orders for him to be taken out of the pit. Daniel's faith in his God had kept him from being harmed.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ ya leei dari mali buɣim, ka yi ʒim ti kpe tiŋgban ni, ka so ku lan teei yi yɛla. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You will be burned and will die in your own land. Then you will be forgotten forever. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: ka o ti su Yaakubu zuliya sahakam, ka o nam ti ku mali bahigu.
en: He will rule over Jacobs house forever, and there will be no end to his kingdom.

dag: So di ti zaŋ o nuu shih o, amaa bɛ ti labim o kuɣa ku o bee n-to o piɛma ku o. Biŋkɔbigu bee ninsala yi ti shihi li, bɛn kum o. Ka kikaa yi ti kum pam, di saha bɛn dum zoli maa zuɣu na.
en: you must either be stoned or shot with arrows, without anyone touching you. This applies to both people and animals; they must be put to death. But when the trumpet is blown, then the people are to go up to the mountain.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nam zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni chɛ ka o daalibarika yi Ziɔn na paai ya.
en: The Lord is the Creator of heaven and earth, and I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni amaŋmaŋ gba tumdi tuun suma, ka di wuhi bɛn kpalim la din simdi niŋbu ni nyɛ shɛli binshɛɣukam puuni. Mali biɛri suŋ mini maŋgbibbu a wuhibu puuni.
en: in every way. Offer yourself as a role model of good actions. Show integrity, seriousness.

dag: Ŋunkam wum yinim bɛn nyɛ n nyaandoliba ŋɔ yɛligu wumla n yɛligu, ka ŋunkam zaɣisi ya zaɣisila mani; ka ŋunkam mi zaɣisi ma zaɣisila ŋun tim ma na.
en: Whoever listens to you listens to me. Whoever rejects you rejects me. Whoever rejects me rejects the one who sent me.

dag: Pako so yi mali bihi bee yaansi, chɛ ka bɛ baŋ bɛ daadiini fukumsi ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ dɔɣiriba polo din ni chɛ ka bɛ tooi niŋ bɛ laamba mini bɛ yabipaɣiba din simdi labisi, dama lala niŋbu n-nyɛ din tiɣiri Naawuni nini.
en: But if a particular widow has children or grandchildren, they should first learn to respect their own family and repay their parents, because this pleases God.

dag: Gbariti ni ti yiɣi jɛm kaman waliga la, ka biriti ti yili yila ni suhupiɛlli. Kom ni ti zɔri yiri tiŋgbani din nyɛ zaɣ nɛl la ni na. Ka mɔɣa ti dɔni di ni.
en: The lame will leap and dance, and those who cannot speak will shout for joy. Streams of water will flow through the desert;.

dag: ni Hafaraim ni Shiɔn ni Anaharat.
en: Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath.

dag: O chɛ ka n dooni momaha ni. O zaŋdi ma tahiri kom din do baalim shee.
en: He lets me rest in grassy meadows; he leads me to restful waters.

dag: O daa bɔh o mi, Karimba, Naawuni fukumsi zaligunim ni, dini n-lee nyɛ kpɛma.
en: He said, Teacher, which command in the law is the most important.

dag: Ka naa daa po n-yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun daa fa ma n dimnim zaa nuu ni bahi ka nyɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Then he said, The living Lord God of Israel has kept me safe. And so today, I will keep the promise I made to you in his name: Solomon will be the next king.

dag: Ka laɣ shɛli din daa nyɛ taali tumbu sanyoo liɣiri mini alahichi sanyoo liɣiri, bɛ daa bi zaŋ li tahi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni, dama din daa nyɛla maligumaaniba dini.
en: People gave money when they offered guilt offerings and sin offerings, but that money was not used for the Lord s temple. It belonged to the priests.

dag: Dindali n ni ti tim tuumba ka bɛ yi n sani kpe ŋarima chaŋ ti kpɛhi Itiɔpianim bɛn bi mi bɛ yɛla ŋɔ dabiɛm pam. Biɛrim ni ti paai ba Ijiptinim mbusim dabisili maa dali, dama di kanna.
en: When that day comes and Egypt is destroyed, I will send messengers in ships to arouse the unsuspecting people of Ethiopia, and they will be terrified. That day is coming.

dag: Mbusim be ninvuɣ so ŋun ŋmɛri ŋun nam o naŋgbankpeeni zuɣu. Yaɣiri ni tooi bɔhi yaɣimɛra, Bɔ ka a lee mɛra? bee m-bɔh o, A niŋ nuhi niŋ ma.
en: Israel, you have no right to argue with your Creator. You are merely a clay pot shaped by a potter. The clay doesn't ask, Why did you make me this way? Where are the handles.

dag: Saha shɛli niriba maa ni daa yi bɛ tantinim ni na chani ni bɛ ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du, ka maligumaaniba bɛn daa ʒiri Alikauli Adaka maa daa gari bɛ tooni chana.
en: It was harvest time, and the river was in flood. When the people left the camp to cross the Jordan, the priests went ahead of them, carrying the Covenant Box. As soon as the priests stepped into the river.

dag: Yuun shɛli din pahiri yuun pia puuni gol so ŋun pahiri pia biɛɣu pinaayi dali ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: In the tenth year, on the twelfth day of the tenth month, the LORDs word came to me.

dag: A bihi maa daa tumla alahichi o sani, bɛ daalahichi maa tibidarigibo ni nyɛ shɛm ka o niŋ ba maa.
en: Your children must have sinned against God, and so he punished them as they deserved.

dag: dama di sabiya, Naawuni ni bah o malaikanim noli ka bɛ gbib a ka gul a.
en: The Scriptures say: God will tell his angels to take care of you. They will catch you in their arms, and you will not even hurt your feet on the stones. .

dag: Di saha ka malaika so ŋun mali kpiɔŋ pam daa kpuɣ kuɣili din ŋmani nɛ titali m-bahi teeku puuni ha ka yɛra, Lala ka nyin Babilɔn din nyɛ tin titali ŋɔ ti shiri yɛn lu n-wurim zaa, ka so ti ku lan mi a zaashee yaha!.
en: Then a powerful angel picked up a stone that was like a huge millstone and threw it into the sea, saying, With such violent force the great city of Babylon will be thrown down, and it wont be found anymore.

dag: N-nyɛ kuɣ duli shɛli n ni pihi sɔŋ m min a sunsuuni.
en: Here are the rocks that I have piled up between us, and here is the memorial stone.

dag: Chɛliya yi kpibisi; n ni gbib ba, ka chɛ ka yi pakoya niŋ ma naani.
en: But I can be trusted to care for your orphans and widows.

dag: O ni daa yɛl lala naai ka o ŋmaligi yɛl o nyaandoliba maa, Ti zo Lazarɔs gbihirimi, amaa n chanimi ni n ti neeg o o gom maa ni.
en: Then he told them, Our friend Lazarus is asleep, and I am going there to wake him up.

dag: Nir yi be mɔpilli zuɣu yaɣ shɛli, di so ni o min o paɣa so ŋun bɔri zabili pam laɣim be yili ni.
en: It's better to stay outside on the roof of your house than to live inside with a nagging wife.

dag: Cheebu saha beni, ka shɛbu saha beni. Shinibu saha beni, ka tɔɣisibu saha beni.
en: a time for tearing and a time for repairing, a time for keeping silent and a time for speaking.

dag: Amaa binneembihi bɛn mali paɣiri ka mali naba anahi chana, ka lan tom mali gbaya pahi m-mal li tɔri tiŋ yiɣira.
en: but you can eat four-footed flying insects that have jointed legs above their feet with which they hop on the ground.

dag: Ka Uzia daa ti faai siɣ o yaannim sani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o nanim gbala ni m-baɣil o yaannima, dama bɛ daa yɛlimi ni o nyɛla kɔŋlana. Ka o bia Jɔtam daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Uzziah died and was buried in the royal burial ground, but because of his disease he was not buried in the royal tombs. His son Jotham succeeded him as king.

dag: ka yɛl o kpambaliba, Jɔn Baptaizira la n-ni bala; ŋuna n-lan neei kum ni na maa, dinzuɣu ka o mali yiko n-tumdi tuun kara ŋɔ.
en: He is really John the Baptist, who has come back to life, he told his officials. That is why he has this power to perform miracles.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya: Gbilisimiya tibili wum, chɛliya karimbaani.
en: Listen closely, dont be arrogant, for the LORD has spoken.

dag: Di saha ka Amɔs daa garigi yɛli Amazia, M pala anabi, m mi pala anabi bia; amaa n nyɛla biŋkɔbigula ni ŋun sari fiig tihi.
en: Then Amos answered Amaziah, I am not a professional prophet, and I am not from a prophets family. I raise cattle and take care of sycamore trees.

dag: Dama n ni kpi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni; n ku du Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili, amaa yinim ni du li chaŋ ti deei tiŋgbɔn viɛlli maa su.
en: So I must die here in this land. I cannot go across the Jordan River, but you will soon go across it and take that good land and live there.

dag: N Duuma, zom ma nambɔɣu, dama nyini ka n kuhiri niŋda dabisi muni zaa.
en: My Lord, be kind to me. I have been praying to you all day.

dag: Ti mi bi tibigirila timaŋa yi sani yaha, amaa ti wuhiri ya la dalir shɛli din ni chɛ ka yi nyu bara ti zuɣu, ka lan chɛ ka yi tooi garigi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali ninsal niŋgbuŋkom lihibu nyuri bara, ka pa ni o biɛhigu la bɔhigu.
en: We arent trying to commend ourselves to you again. Instead, we are giving you an opportunity to be proud of us so that you could answer those who take pride in superficial appearance, and not in what is in the heart.

dag: Amaa ka paɣ so daa kpuɣ nɛkaŋa n-daai li bah o zuɣu ni na, ka di ŋma o zuɣuŋmaŋ.
en: But, while Abimelech was standing at the door of the tower, a woman on the roof dropped a grinding stone on his head. The grinding stone crushed his skull.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o kpamba daa yɛl o, N dan naa, chɛ ka ti bo paɣisarili na nti chɛ ka o be a sani gbib a, ka doon a sani, ka di chɛ ka nyini n dan naa ni tula.
en: So they said to him, We will find a young woman to care for you. She will lie next to you and keep you warm.

dag: Yila pia shɛŋa a ni daa nya la mi nyɛla nanim pia bɛn na bi di nam, amaa bɛ ni ti ti ba yiko ka bɛ di nam pahi biŋkɔbigu la zuɣu awa yini.
en: The ten horns you saw are ten more kings, who have not yet come into power, and they will rule with the beast for only a short time.

dag: Ŋun yɛn fa ba bahi maa nyɛla kpiɔŋlana. O yuli m-booni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa. Biɛhiŋ kani, o ni lihi bɛ yɛlli maa zuɣu din ni chɛ ka o ti dunianim vuhim, amaa o ku ti Babilɔnnim bɛn vuhim.
en: But the one who will rescue them is strong—his name is the Lord Almighty. He himself will take up their cause and will bring peace to the earth, but trouble to the people of Babylonia.

dag: ni naɣilah ayi mini piɛlah anu ni bulah anu ni yuun yini piɛlabih anu shɛb bɛ ni zaŋdi maani biɛrisuŋ sara la. Okiran bia Pagiɛl sara n-daa bala.
en: and for the well-being sacrifice two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Pagiel, Ochrans son.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni so ku tooi yɛli ni n yuli ka bɛ daa zaŋ baptaizi ya.
en: No one can say, then, that you were baptized as my disciples. .

dag: O noli daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka ninvuɣ shɛb daa yi Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu zuɣulan maa yiŋ na nti yɛl o, A bipuɣiŋga maa bahiya. Ka wula ka a na kul doli suhiri karimba maa.
en: While Jesus was still speaking, some people came from Jairus' home and said, Your daughter has died! Why bother the teacher anymore.

dag: Ka bɔhi ba, Pa Anabi Musa n-daa zaŋ Naawuni fukumsi zaligu la tin ya? Amaa yi ni so bi dol li. Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yi bɔri ni yi ku ma.
en: Didn't Moses give you the Law? Yet none of you obey it! So why do you want to kill me?.

dag: Dinzuɣu chɛliya ka ti niŋ naani ka vu m-miri Naawuni ŋun nyɛ alibarikalan ŋɔ nam ʒiishee, ka di chɛ ka o zo ti nambɔɣu ka ti nya alibarika din ni sɔŋ ti saha shɛli ti ni bɔri li.
en: So whenever we are in need, we should come bravely before the throne of our merciful God. There we will be treated with undeserved grace, and we will find help.

dag: Pa n nuhi ka n daa zaŋ nam dimbɔŋɔnim zaa.
en: I have made everything.

dag: dindina nyin bom peeŋkpaa n-zaŋ o tibili tabili dunoli naŋgbanyee n-chib li voli, ka o nyɛ a dabili sahakam. Zaŋ chaŋ a dabili ŋun nyɛ paɣ gba polo, di simdi ni a niŋ o lala.
en: then you may take a needle and pierce his ear with it into the doorframe. From that point on, he will be your permanent servant. Do the same thing for female servants.

dag: yin di wumya anabinim maa bee bɛn baŋdi zahima gbinni maa yɛtɔɣa, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-zahindi ya maa ni o nya yi shiri yuri ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yi suhu zaa mini yi shihi zaa.
en: Dont listen to them, because the Lord your God is testing you. He wants to know if you love him with all your heart and all your soul.

dag: hal ka ninvuɣ so ŋun daa bi mi Yisifu daa ti di Ijipti nam.
en: Another king was ruling Egypt, and he didn't know anything about Joseph.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm paɣiba, yimiyana. Nyamiya Naa Sulemaana ni pili nam zuɣupil shɛli, di nyɛla o ma ni daa zaŋ nam zuɣupil shɛli pil o, o daamiliya lɔbu dali din daa nyɛ o suhupiɛlli dabisili dal la.
en: go forth! Look, daughters of Zion— on King Solomon wearing the crown with which his mother crowned him on the day of his wedding, on the day of his hearts joy.

dag: Sulemaana ni daa me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la min o nam yil la, ka me o ni daa bɔri ni o me binshɛlikam la naai nyaaŋa.
en: After King Solomon had finished building the Temple and the palace and everything else he wanted to build.

dag: Di saha ka n daa lan nya biŋkɔb so ka o yi tiŋgban ni na. O daa malila yila ayi kaman piɛbil yila la, ka tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa ka o lɔŋ ŋmani waɣ biɛ tital la lɔŋ.
en: Then I saw another beast coming up from the earth. It had two horns like a lamb, but it was speaking like a dragon.

dag: Amaa di saha wuntizɔriba ni ti bela bɛ Ba Naawuni nam ni n-ne kaman wuntaŋ la. Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wumma.
en: But everyone who has done right will shine like the sun in their Father's kingdom. If you have ears, pay attention!.

dag: Ka daa lan kpihim zaligu shɛli din mini di soya daa galindi ti ka kul nyari ti taali la n-daa zaŋ li kpahi tabili dapulli zuɣu n-yihi li zaa bahi.
en: God wiped out the charges that were against us for disobeying the Law of Moses. He took them away and nailed them to the cross.

dag: Tɔbbi ŋuni m-mi n-chaŋ tɔbu ni nti su omaŋmaŋ bindirigu fukumsi? Ka ŋuni m-mi n-sa tihi ka ku di di wala? Bee ŋuni m-mi n-guli niɣi ka ku nyu bɛ bihim?.
en: What soldiers ever have to pay their own expenses in the army? What farmers do not eat the grapes from their own vineyard? What shepherds do not use the milk from their own sheep?.

dag: min o ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa piligu ni hal ni bahigu ni, nyama, bɛ sab li niŋ Izraɛl mini Juda nanim litaafi ni.
en: and everything else he did, from beginning to end, are written in the official records of Israels and Judahs kings.

dag: Dauda ni daa nya ka Naawuni deeg o suhigu Aruna Jɛbusi nir maa kabɔɣili maa ni maa, ka o daa mali sara nimaani.
en: At that time, after David saw that the LORD had answered him at the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, he offered sacrifices there.

dag: Bɛ ti ma dansi n yaaŋa zuɣu. Bɛ niŋ li la zaɣ wɔɣila kaman pukpara ni wɔriti vuɣisi shɛm la.
en: They cut deep wounds in my back and made it like a plowed field.

dag: Siria Naa daa pun bahila o sapashinnim pihitanaayi bɛn su o chɛchɛbunsi fukumsi noli yɛli, Di ti tuhiya wɔɣiri so bee tarim so, naɣila Izraɛl naa kɔŋko.
en: The king of Syria had ordered his thirty-two chariot commanders to attack no one else except the king of Israel.

dag: Ka Bɔaz daa kpuɣi Rut kul o yiŋa nti zaŋ o niŋ o paɣa. Ka Yawɛ daa niŋ alibarika niŋ Rut ni ka o zali pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga.
en: Boaz married Ruth, and the Lord blessed her with a son.

dag: ka ti Duuma daa chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari tiliginsim kul pahiri bɛ ni biɛɣukam.
en: They praised God and demonstrated Gods goodness to everyone. The Lord added daily to the community those who were being saved.

dag: ka tɔɣisiri binshɛɣukam zaa din daa niŋ maa yɛla.
en: and they were talking to each other about all the things that had happened.

dag: bɛ kul durila tab dari maa gbini, ka biŋkɔbiri maa daa ti dɔɣi bi shɛb bɛn mali bomaboma mini bɛn liɣisiliɣisi ni bɛn mali sabilimsabilim.
en: Then when the goats mated in front of the branches, the young that were born were spotted, striped, or black.

dag: Zaligu shɛli din gbibi niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu ni mali ninvuɣ so daɣiri ni yibu saha zaligu m-bɔŋɔ: Di simdi ka bɛ zaŋ o ka maligumaana sanna.
en: This will be the Instruction for anyone with skin disease at the time of purification: When it has been reported to the priest.

dag: Jɛrusalɛmnima, zomiya doli di pala n-lihi gili nya! Lihimiya zama ni laɣindi luɣ shɛŋa n-nya yi ni tooi nya ninvuɣ yino ŋun tuma viɛla, ka o gbibi yɛlimaŋli, ka n chɛ Jɛrusalɛmnim taali o zuɣu.
en: Search Jerusalem for honest people who try to be faithful. If you can find even one, I'll forgive the whole city.

dag: Dinzuɣu miriya ka yi chɛ ka anabinim ni daa yɛli shɛm la ti niŋ pali yi ni. Bɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Take care that the prophets words dont apply to you.

dag: ka bi lan tuɣi Masia ŋun nyɛ zuɣu la. Masia kɔbili ni ka niŋgbuŋ mi zaa nyari dihili ka kpɛri n-saɣisiri tab ni di tuɣa mini di jila ni, ka zoori kaman Naawuni ni bɔri ni di zoori shɛm.
en: They are no longer part of Christ, who is the head of the whole body. Christ gives the body its strength, and he uses its joints and muscles to hold it together, as it grows by the power of God.

dag: ka yɛri ni yinim yi di daa be yi yaannim saha la, yi daa naan ku pahi bɛ zuɣu ku anabinim maa.
en: and you claim that if you had lived during the time of your ancestors, you would not have done what they did and killed the prophets.

dag: Yawɛ lan yɛli, N ni lab Ziɔn na nti be Jɛrusalɛm, ka bɛ ni ti booni Jɛrusalɛm la yɛlimaŋli tiŋa; ka boli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ zol la, zoli din be kasi.
en: The LORD proclaims: I have returned to Zion; I will settle in Jerusalem. Jerusalem will be called the city of truth; the mountain of the LORD of heavenly forces will be the holy mountain.

dag: N ni ti daai bɛ ninkura mini bihi zaa to taba. N yi ti yɛn ku ba, n ku chɛ so bee n-zo so nambɔɣu. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Then I will smash them against each other like jars. I will have no pity on the young or the old, and they will all be destroyed. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: O daa zali Judanim ni bɛ jɛmmila Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni la kɔŋko, ka dol o fukumsi zaligunim mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi.
en: He commanded the people of Judah to follow the Lord , the God their ancestors had worshiped, and to obey his laws and commands.

dag: Ka kpa shɛli din na kpalim be maligumaana maa nuu ni maa, o zaŋm li ʒe ŋun yɛn yi daɣiri ni maa zuɣu ni. Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka maligumaana maa naanyi mali sanyoo sara ti dilana Yawɛ tooni.
en: The priest will put whatever is left of the oil in his hand on the head of the person needing purification. In this way, the priest will make reconciliation for the person before the LORD.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni ti gbahi ya niŋ ya alaka, ka tahi ya bɛ jɛmbu duri mini sarikanim ni, ka ti zaŋ ya tahi nazuɣuri mini gomnanim tooni n yuli zuɣu pɔi ka dimbɔŋɔnim zaa naanyi niŋ.
en: Before all this happens, you will be arrested and punished. You will be tried in your synagogues and put in jail. Because of me you will be placed on trial before kings and governors.

dag: Ka ŋunkam suh a, nyin tim o; ka ŋun bɔri ni a paŋ o binshɛli, nyin paŋm o.
en: When people ask you for something, give it to them. When they want to borrow money, lend it to them.

dag: Dama n niriba maa tumla tuumbiɛri buyi zuɣu. Bɛ zaɣisi mani ŋun nyɛ nyɛvili kɔbilinini ŋɔ, ka gbi bɛmaŋmaŋ kɔbilisi, kɔbil kaba din ku tooi deei kom.
en: My people have committed two crimes: They have forsaken me, the spring of living water. And they have dug wells, broken wells that cant hold water.

dag: Yɛlim bɛn nyɛ duŋtaariba maa yɛtɔɣ ŋahili ŋɔ. Yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Zaŋmiya duɣu tam, zaŋmiya li tam, ka niŋ kom niŋ di ni.
en: Compose a parable for the rebels household and say to them, The LORD God proclaims: Put on the pot, set it on, and fill it with water.

dag: Ŋunkam wuhi zom soli kpɛhi yɔɣu, noli din dim o. Ka sokam yɛli, Ami.
en: God's curse on anyone who leads a blind person in the wrong direction. And all the people will answer, Amen.

dag: Man Pool ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ni pii so o yubu puuni n-leei Yisa Masia tumo la mini ti mabia Sɔstɛniiz.
en: From Paul, called by Gods will to be an apostle of Jesus Christ, and from Sosthenes our brother.

dag: Di saha Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim pina ni lan tiɣiri Yawɛ nini kaman di ni daa pun tiɣir o nini shɛm kurimbuni ha mini yuun shɛŋa din gari ni la.
en: and the offerings of the people of Judah and Jerusalem will please him, just as they did in the past.

dag: N nya mbusim, n ŋmanila ninvuɣ so kum ni mali ka o bi nya tiwalli bee wain tiwala dira. Dama bɛ pun pɔhi wain tiwala mini fiig tiwala zaa.
en: It's hopeless! I am like a hungry person who finds no fruit left on the trees and no grapes on the vines. All the grapes and all the tasty figs have been picked.

dag: Di bemi kaman Naawuni Kundi ni luɣ shɛli ni yɛli shɛm la: N niŋ yɛda, dinzuɣu ka n tɔɣisira. Ti gba ni niŋ yɛda kaman ŋun daa sab sabbu maa zuɣu, ka ti gba tɔɣisira.
en: The Scriptures say, I believed, so I spoke. Our faith is like that too. We believe, and so we speak.

dag: ni Hɔrimanim ni Bɔrashannima ni Ataknima.
en: Hormah, Bor Ashan, Athach.

dag: N ni zaŋ Raba leei laakuma mɔri ŋubbu shee, ka zaŋ Ammɔnnim fɔntinsi leei biŋkɔbbaligu gariche. Di saha ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will turn the city of Rabbah into a place to keep camels, and the whole country of Ammon will become a place to keep sheep, so that you will know I am the Lord .

dag: Ka Dauda daa chaŋ ti ku Ɛdomnim ninvuɣ tuhi pisaayika Yalim vinvamli ni ka labina, ka o yuli daa maan du pam.
en: David had defeated , Edomites in Salt Valley. He was famous when he came home.

dag: Ka Musa daa zaŋ Aduna bidibisi la na nti zaŋ zabbanim yɛli ba, ka zaŋ shɛlɔriti lo bɛ shɛhi ni, ka zaŋ zuɣupila pil ba kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ŋun Musa shɛm.
en: Next, Moses dressed Aaron's sons in their shirts, then tied sashes around them and put special caps on them, just as the Lord had commanded.

dag: dama niriba pam ni ti zaŋ n yuli kana ti yɛra, Mani n-nyɛ Masia! Mani n-nyɛ Masia! Ka bɛ ni ti birigi niriba pam.
en: Many men, claiming to speak for me, will come and say, I am he! and they will fool many people.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri nahiri tintarisi vulɔnima, ka fari biŋkɔbbaligu n-zaŋdi ba chani ka bɛ ti ŋubiri mɔri bɛmaŋmaŋ biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: People move property markers to get more of their neighbors land. People steal flocks and lead them to other grasslands.

dag: Gbib ma ka n tiligi, ka kul dol a zaligunim sahakam.
en: Support me so I can be saved and so I can focus constantly on your statutes.

dag: N suhu kul tɔrila pampam ka n kpiɔŋ zaa naai, ka n nina niŋ liti.
en: My heart is beating fast. I feel weak all over, and my eyes are red.

dag: O mi o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm zaŋ salima mini anzinfa ni daanya mali binyɛra.
en: He will be able to create designs; do metalwork in gold, silver, and copper.

dag: Amaa yi mali kali din ti ma soli ni n yihi dansarika yino so yi ni bɔri bahi Yaɣigari Chuɣu puhibu saha; dinzuɣu yi bɔri ni n yihi Yɛhudianim Naa maa bahi.
en: But according to the custom you have, I always set free a prisoner for you during the Passover. Do you want me to set free for you the king of the Jews.

dag: Izraɛlnima, Wummiya fabila yil shɛli n ni yiini niŋdi ya ŋɔ:.
en: Hear this word—a funeral song—that I am lifting up against you, house of Israel.

dag: O yɛtɔɣa be polipoli gari bihikpam, amaa ka lee lo tɔbu o suhu ni; o yɛtɔɣa bali gari kpam, amaa ka ŋmari kaman sudirili la.
en: His words were smoother than butter, and softer than olive oil. But hatred filled his heart, and he was ready to attack with a sword.

dag: Ka o daa balim Yisa pam ni o di kari ba yihi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: He then begged Jesus not to send them away.

dag: Yawɛ, yɛlimaŋli, Asiria nanim pun saɣim zuliya pam tiŋgbɔna.
en: We all know, Lord , that the emperors of Assyria have destroyed many nations, made their lands desolate.

dag: Naawuni yɛlimaŋtali zuɣu, o ni tiligi Ziɔn; o wuntitali zuɣu o ni tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be di ni ka niŋ tuuba.
en: Jerusalem, you will be saved by showing justice; Zion's people who turn to me will be saved by doing right.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi ni mali dahima shɛli n-tummi di ni simdi ni yi tum shɛm ni nimmoo, dama ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nyɛla ʒiɛmaan biɛɣu.
en: Make good use of every opportunity you have, because these are evil days.

dag: O daa piila Bɛza din be tiŋgban nɛl ni tintani ni la n-ti Rubin zuliya niriba, ka pii Ramɔt din be Giliad la n-ti Gaad zuliya niriba, ka pii Golan din be Bashan la mi ti Manaasa zuliya niriba.
en: Bezer in the wilderness on the plateau for the Reubenites, Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadites, and Golan in Bashan for the Manassites.

dag: Ka Naa Jɔsia daa tim ti boli Juda kpamba mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zaa, ka bɛ laɣim o sanna.
en: King Josiah summoned all the leaders of Judah and Jerusalem.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Yi ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb sɔŋ di puuni maa n-nyɛ nimdi, ka tiŋ maa mi nyɛ duɣu. Amaa bɛ ni ti yihi yinim di puuni.
en: This city is indeed a cooking pot, but the bodies of those you killed are the meat. And so I will force you to leave Jerusalem.

dag: Ibrahimma yuma daa nyɛla yuun kɔbigayinika saha shɛl o ni daa guni;.
en: Abraham was years old when he circumcised the flesh of his foreskin.

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapuhi n-zaŋ dapuh anu niŋ Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa yaɣ yini polo dapaɣa.
en: They made fifteen crossbars of acacia wood, five for the frames on one side of the Tent.

dag: Amaa ka wain tia maa bɔhi ba, N chɛli n wain shɛli din tiri wuna mini ninsalinim suhupiɛlli la tɔɣibu, ka leei tihi naa.
en: But the vine answered, In order to govern you, I would have to stop producing my wine, that makes gods and human beings happy.

dag: Ka Mariama daa yɛli, N tibigiri n Duuma n suhu ni.
en: Mary said, My heart praises the Lord;.

dag: M Ba ni zaŋ shɛb zaa ti ma ni ka n sanna, ka ŋunkam mi ka n sanna, n ku zaɣis o.
en: Everyone whom the Father gives to me will come to me, and I wont send away anyone who comes to me.

dag: Tikikus ŋun nyɛ ti mabiyurigu ŋun ʒe yim ti Duuma tuma ni la ni ti yɛli ya n yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm zaa.
en: Tychicus, our dearly loved brother, faithful minister, and fellow slave in the Lord, will inform you about everything that has happened to me.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa bi ti Kɔhat bihi la shɛli, dama bɛna n-daa su ni bɛ zaŋ neen shɛŋa din be kasi la buɣi bɛ bɔɣusapima zuɣu.
en: Moses did not give any oxen or wagons to the men in Kohaths group, because their job was to carry the holy things on their shoulders.

dag: Biŋkɔbigu kam ŋun mali takarifiɛma din wɔrigi, ka nyɛ ŋun gbuɣiri ŋubira, yin ŋubimiy o.
en: It is all right to eat meat from any animals that have divided hoofs and also chew the cud.

dag: Ka o nyintaa daa yi kur o suli pam n-chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisira, Yawɛ ni daa bi ti o bia maa zuɣu.
en: Peninnah, her rival, would torment and humiliate her, because the Lord had kept her childless.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika maa yɛli Manɔa, A yi gooi ma ʒili, n ku di yi bindirigu maa; amaa yi yi niŋ shili ni yi zaŋ li mali sara nyo buɣim, yin zaŋmiya li na ti ti Yawɛ. .
en: But the LORDs messenger replied to Manoah, If you persuaded me to stay, I wouldnt eat your food. If you prepare an entirely burned offering, offer it to the LORD. Indeed, Manoah didnt know that he was the LORDs messenger.

dag: ni Maharai ŋun daa nyɛ Nɛtɔfa nir la ni Hɛlɛd ŋun daa nyɛ Baana Nɛtɔfa nir bia la.
en: Maharai from Netophah; Heled, Baanahs son from Netophah.

dag: Bɛ gba ni ti dol li chaŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee maa nti pahi bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbiri ku zuliya shɛba mini bɛ zɔnim la ni zuliya shɛb bɛn daa ʒi di mahim la zuɣu.
en: Those people who found protection in its shade will also be sent to the world below, where they will join the dead.

dag: Bɛnkam be yi ni n-nyɛ o niriba, bɛ Naawuni maa ŋun be bɛ sani, ka chɛ ka bɛ yiɣisi kuli Jɛrusalɛm, Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni nti lab me Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ duu, ŋuna n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun be Jɛrusalɛm.
en: If there are any of you who are from his people, may their God be with them! They may go up to Jerusalem in Judah and build the house of the LORD, the God of Israel—he is the God who is in Jerusalem.

dag: Dinzuɣu di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira; yi mali buchi pam gari jahinjɛya.
en: So dont be afraid. You are worth more than a whole flock of birds.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Dindali maa n ni kabi naɣikɔra dapua o nyiŋgoli zuɣu bahi, ka kabisi o bandi maa, ka tinzunnim ku lan zaŋ o leei bɛ dabili.
en: At that time, I will break the yoke off their necks and remove their shackles. Foreigners will no longer enslave them, declares the LORD of heavenly forces.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Nyamiya, n yɛn darigila Amɔn ŋun nyɛ Tɛbis nir la tibili, ka darigi Firawuna mini Ijiptinim ni di wuna ni di nanim zaŋ tabili bɛn niŋ Firawuna naani la tibili.
en: The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, says, Very soon I will punish Amon, the god of Thebes, and I will punish Pharaoh, Egypt, and her gods. I will punish the kings of Egypt, and I will punish the people who depend on Pharaoh.

dag: Bɛ ni daa nya o katiŋa, bɛ daa bi baŋ o, ka bɛ daa duhi bɛ yee n-kum pam; ka dari chahi bɛ binyɛra, ka kɔriti taŋkpaɣu chɛri zuɣusaa ka di puɣiri bɛ zuɣuri.
en: When they came near enough to see Job, they could hardly recognize him. And in their great sorrow, they tore their clothes, then sprinkled dust on their heads and cried bitterly.

dag: m-pahi Yisifu yiŋnim zaa min o biɛyanim ni o ba yiŋnim zaa daa pahi Yisifu zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ. Kulla bɛ bihi mini piɛri ni buhi ni niɣi kɔŋko n-daa kpalim be Goshɛn tiŋgbani maa ni.
en: His family, his brothers, and the rest of his father's family all went with him. Only their small children and their sheep, goats, and cattle stayed in the region of Goshen.

dag: amaa ŋunkam chihi dimbɔŋɔ zaŋ chaŋ Yisa polo pala ŋun mali Shi so ŋun yi Naawuni sanna. Ka shia ŋɔ nyɛla shi so ŋun yi Masiachihira sanna, ka yi mi pun wum ni o ni ti kana, ka hal o pun be dunia ŋɔ ni pumpɔŋɔ.
en: and every spirit that doesnt confess Jesus is not from God. This is the spirit of the antichrist, which you have heard is coming and is now already in the world.

dag: Yi nyɛla bɛn zaŋ yɛlimaŋli leei bintɔɣu, ka daai wuntia luhi tiŋa!.
en: You are doomed, you that twist justice and cheat people out of their rights!.

dag: Dinzuɣu doli ninvuɣ suma soli, ka doli wuntizɔriba soli.
en: So you should stay on the path of good people, guarding the road of the righteous.

dag: N suhu dammi, ka bi lan doya; ka wahala dabisa kul paari ma.
en: I constantly feel upset. And my suffering has only just begun.

dag: Ka ŋunkam mi bi kpuɣ o dapulli buɣi doli ma ku tooi niŋ n nyaandola.
en: You cannot be my disciple unless you carry your own cross and follow me.

dag: Ka ŋun daa ʒi wɔhu zuɣu maa zaŋ takɔbi din yir o nol ni na ku bɛn kpalim, ka noonsi zaa daa di nimdi tiɣi.
en: Their armies were killed with the sword that came out of the mouth of the rider on the horse. All the birds ate these bodies until they were full.

dag: amaa di bahigu ni o tomi kaman yabiga ka diri kaman takɔb din mali naŋgbana ayi.
en: but in the end she is bitter as gall, sharp as a double-edged sword.

dag: Lɛvinima n-daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu. Bɛ ni ŋun daa daŋ mali me m-pan o zuɣu n-daa nyɛ Bani bia Rɛhum. Ka Hashabia ŋun daa nyɛ Kɛila yaɣili pirigili polo naa la daa mali me n-ti o yaɣili polɔnima.
en: After him, the Levites made repairs: Rehum, Banis son, and next to him Hashabiah, ruler of half the district of Keilah, made repairs for his district.

dag: Yi nini ni lan nya na so ŋun diri mali jilima su tiŋgbɔn shɛli din galisi pam.
en: Once again you will see a king ruling in splendor over a land that stretches in all directions.

dag: Bɛ daa ku Ɛli bidibis ayi bɛn daa nyɛ Hofini mini Finɛhas, ka fa Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa.
en: God's Covenant Box was captured, and Eli's sons, Hophni and Phinehas, were both killed.

dag: Di saha ka so daa kana ti yɛli ba, Yi ni sa kpɛhi ninvuɣ shɛb duu la be Naawuni jɛmbu duu wuhiri niriba.
en: Then another man came and told them, Listen! The men you put in jail are standing in the Temple area teaching the people.

dag: Wuntizɔriba bɛn ti ninvuɣ biɛɣu soli ŋmanila kɔbilinini din bilisiri ko biɛɣu bee bɛ ni saɣim kɔbil shɛli kom.
en: A good person who gives in to someone who is evil reminds you of a polluted spring or a poisoned well.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ alɔbo mini ninvuɣ kubo darigi bɛ tibili ka chɛ ka sa kura mini sakuɣa lu bɛ zuɣu. N ni ti lan chɛ ka buɣim mini chilibi lu o min o tɔbbihi ni ninvuɣ gbaliŋ shɛb bɛn be o sani zuɣu.
en: and I will enter into judgment with him, with plague and blood. I will pour out flooding rain, hailstones, fire, and sulfur on him, on all his troops, and on the many peoples with him.

dag: Yi ni be luɣ shɛlikam zaa, yi fɔntinsi ni bahi yoli, ka yi ni jɛmdi buɣa luɣ shɛŋa zaa bahi yoli, ka yi maligu bimbina wurim bahi yoli, ka yi buɣa la wurim saɣim, ka yi ni tuɣindi tulaale zim bimbin shɛŋa zuɣu la wurim ka yi tuma kpihim.
en: Every town in Israel will be destroyed to make sure that each shrine, idol, and altar is smashed—everything the Israelites made will be a pile of ruins.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla ti suhuri piɛli ti wahala dibu puuni, dama ti mi ni wahala dibu tahirila ania niŋbu na.
en: But not only that! We even take pride in our problems, because we know that trouble produces endurance.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti kpuɣi ba ni bɛ zabbanim yi bɛ biɛhigu maa shee Kpaŋa kaman Musa ni daa yɛli ba shɛm maa.
en: So they came and took hold of the clothing on the corpses and carried them outside the camp, just as Moses had commanded.

dag: Dama a sani ka nyɛvili kɔbilisirim be. A neesim zuɣu ka ti nyari neesim.
en: Within you is the spring of life. In your light, we see light.

dag: Ka o daa lan ŋahi ba ŋaha ŋɔ yɛli, So ku saɣi zaŋ tan palli din na bi tiri n-liɣi binyɛr kurili, dama o yi niŋ lala, tan palli maa ni yaai di ko n-cheei ka chɛ binyɛr kurili maa, ka di maan chɛhi pahi.
en: No one sews a piece of new, unshrunk cloth on old clothes because the patch tears away the cloth and makes a worse tear.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ŋun taali tumbu zuɣu n-lee chɛ ka yɛl biɛɣu ŋɔ ti paai ti ŋɔ? Yɛlim ti! Tuun bɔ ka a lee tumda? Tiŋkani ka a lee yina? Ka zuliya bɔ n-lee nyɛ a.
en: They started asking him, Are you the one who brought all this trouble on us? What business are you in? Where do you come from? What is your country? Who are your people.

dag: Ka o ni daa yɛli shɛm maa zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ bi tooi gbaag o o yɛtɔɣa ni niriba maa ninni, amaa ka o ni garigi ba shɛm maa daa gari ba pam, ka bɛ fo.
en: They couldnt trap him in his words in front of the people. Astonished by his answer, they were speechless.

dag: Ka Sintani daa zaŋ o du zo shɛli zuɣu nti wuh o dunia ŋɔ nama zaa nini kahimbu ni neebu yim ni.
en: Next the devil led him to a high place and showed him in a single instant all the kingdoms of the world.

dag: Di ŋmanila Hɛrimɔn Zoli zuɣu maligim din zɔri luri Ziɔn Zoya zuɣu na. Dama nimaani ka Yawɛ lo alibarika alikauli din nyɛ nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: It is like the dew on Mount Hermon, falling on the hills of Zion. That is where the Lord has promised his blessing— life that never ends.

dag: Juda Naa Amazia Jɔash bia la daa niŋla yuun pinaanu Izraɛl Naa Jɛhɔahaz bia Naa Jɛhɔash kum nyaaŋa.
en: Judahs King Amaziah, Jehoashs son, lived fifteen years after the death of Israels King Joash, Jehoahazs son.

dag: Dama binshɛɣukam din be dunia ŋɔ ni pala din yi ti Ba Naawuni sanna, amaa di nyɛla din yi dunia ŋɔ ni na. Dina n-nyɛ: Niŋgbuŋ kɔre mini nini kɔre ni barinyubo dunia ŋɔ biɛhigu zuɣu.
en: Everything that is in the world—the craving for whatever the body feels, the craving for whatever the eyes see and the arrogant pride in ones possessions—is not of the Father but is of the world.

dag: N yuya ni Naawuni noli di ma ka m mini Masia woligi tab gba mmaŋmaŋ zuliya bɛn nyɛ m mabihi la zuɣu.
en: I wish I could be cursed, cut off from Christ if it helped my brothers and sisters, who are my flesh-and-blood relatives.

dag: Di ni ti nyɛla shihirili ni alahiziba yɛlli yi mini yi zuliya sani sahakam.
en: Then everyone will look at you and your descendants and realize that the Lord has placed you under a curse.

dag: Miriya ka yi deeri birapu, dama birapu deebu zomdila niriba nina ka bɛ ŋariti bɛn mali yɛlimaŋli.
en: Don't accept bribes. Judges are blinded and justice is twisted by bribes.

dag: Ka bɛ daa bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka ti dan ti yɛl o ni yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ŋɔ? Naawuni di wuhi gba, ka tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ ti tum tuuni ŋɔ tatabo!.
en: They answered him, What do you mean, sir, by talking like this? We swear that we have done no such thing.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti be dufahirili zuɣu, ŋun di lan siɣina ni o ti kpe o duu kah o nɛma;.
en: Those on the roof shouldnt come down to grab things from their houses.

dag: Naa, mani Aruna zaŋ dimbɔŋɔ zaa ti a. Ka Aruna daa lan yɛli naa, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ ni deeg a suhigu maa.
en: O King, I give everything to you! Araunah also said to the king, May the Lord your God be pleased with you.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o ni kɔrisikɔrisi da shɛŋa maa sɔŋ biŋkɔbiri maa tooni kɔnyuri bɔɣili gbini luɣ shɛli biŋkɔbiri maa ni kanna ti nyuri kom. Ka biŋkɔbiri maa daa yi ti kana ni bɛ ti nyu kom ka duri taba.
en: He set the branches that he had peeled near the watering troughs so that they were in front of the flock when they drank, because they often mated when they came to drink.

dag: A mini Harannima ni Kannɛnima ni Idɛnnima ni Ashurinima ni Kilimadnim daa niŋdila daabiligu.
en: Haran, Canneh, Eden, the merchants of Sheba, Asshur, and Kilmad traded with you.

dag: lala nti yɛn nyɛ Daadam Bia gba yi ti labina yi palo.
en: This is exactly how it will be when the Son of Man comes again.

dag: Ka kom maa daa kul gbaai nyuubu zaŋ hal ti paai gol so ŋun pahiri pia dahin yini dali, ka zoya zuɣusaa daa nyili.
en: The waters decreased gradually until the tenth month, and on the first day of the tenth month the mountain peaks appeared.

dag: A yɛm min a baŋsim maa ka a zaŋ bo buni ti amaŋa, ka laɣisi salima min anzinfa niŋ a daazichi duri ni.
en: Through your wisdom and understanding you have gotten riches for yourself. And you put gold and silver in your treasuries.

dag: Ka di simdi ka o yo o ni tum shɛm maa zuɣu, ka yo pirigibu ʒiibunu zuɣu vaabu yim pahi di zuɣu n-zaŋ li ti maligumaana, ka maligumaana maa ni zaŋ piɛlaa maa mali taali sanyoo sara maligu n-yo o daalahichi maa samli, ka o daalahichi maa kpihim.
en: You must give what you promised and add one-fifth of that amount as a fine. Give it to the priest and he will use the ram to make you pure, and God will forgive you.

dag: Di niŋ ma yoli n ni daa zaŋ Sool leei naa maa zuɣu, dama o chɛ ma dolibu ka bi lan doli n zaligunima. Ka Samuɛl suhu daa yiɣisi, ka o kuhi niŋ Yawɛ dindali maa yuŋ zaa.
en: Saul has stopped obeying me, and I'm sorry that I made him king. Samuel was angry, and he cried out in prayer to the Lord all night.

dag: Dindali maa ni ti nyɛla Vuhim Dabisili yi sani, ka di simdi ka yi ti lo noli; di yɛn nyɛla zaligu sahakam.
en: That day is to be a very holy day, one on which they fast and do no work at all. These regulations are to be observed for all time to come.

dag: Yisa Masia zuɣu m mali daliri din ni chɛ ka n nyu bara n ni tum tuun shɛŋa ti Naawuni la puuni.
en: That is why I feel so good about what I have done for God in my service to Christ Jesus.

dag: Amaa ka paɣ maa daa shiri niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga shɛɣuni kaman Ilaisha ni daa yɛl o ni o ni dɔɣi saha shɛli maa.
en: But a few months later, the woman got pregnant. She gave birth to a son, just as Elisha had promised.

dag: M bia wumma, deemi n yɛligu ka nya nyɛvili wɔɣinli.
en: Son, listen to me. Do what I say, and you will live a long time.

dag: Yɛndan yi tahi jɛra ʒiishee, vuri yɔbu mini ansarisi ku mali tariga.
en: If someone who is wise tries to settle a problem with a fool, the fool will argue and say stupid things, and they will never agree.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Dindali maa, tɛha ni ti kpe a suhu ni, ka a bo zaɣ biɛɣu niŋbu soya.
en: The LORD God proclaims: On that day, thoughts will come into your mind, and you will devise an evil plan.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini ka n kumdi niŋd a. Dama buɣim di mɔɣu zaa, ka buɣim zilima di mɔɣu ni tihi zaa.
en: To you, LORD, I cry, for fire has completely destroyed the pastures of the wilderness; and flames have burned all the trees of the field.

dag: Di saha ka Asiria naa maa daa yɛl o niriba, Zaŋmiya maligumaaniba shɛb yi ni daa ʒi nimaani na la yino n-labisi ni, ka o ti be nimaani wuhiri ba tiŋgbɔŋ maa tiŋgbani zaligu.
en: So the king of Assyria gave this command: You took some priests from Samaria. Send one of them who I captured back to Samaria. Let that priest go and live there. Then he can teach the people the law of the god of that country.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ malaika daa chaŋ Asirianim maa sansan ni nti ku ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihinii ni tusaanu, ka biɛɣu daa neei ka kpiimba kul yɛrigi luɣilikam.
en: An angel of the Lord went to the Assyrian camp and killed , soldiers. At dawn the next day there they lay, all dead!.

dag: Ka Dauda daa fa Hadadɛza tɔbbi kpamba salima nyɔtaɣira n-zaŋ li kuli Jɛrusalɛm.
en: David took the gold shields from Hadadezers army leaders and brought them to Jerusalem.

dag: Bɛ nol ni yɛtɔɣa zuɣu, o ni chɛ ka bɛ bahi ba yoli zaa, ka bɛnkam zaa nya ba, dabiɛm gbahiri ba mi, ka bɛ ni sɔhira.
en: He will destroy them because of those words; all who see them will shake their heads.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa kana ni o ti nya ninsalinim ni me tin shɛli ka me pii tam di zuɣu maa.
en: But when the Lord came down to look at the city and the tower.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn mini ninvuɣ kɔbisita bɛn daa be o sani maa daa kana ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du m-biɛhiri bɛ dimnim maa naba, ka di daa wum ba pam.
en: By this time Gideon and his three hundred men had come to the Jordan River and had crossed it. They were exhausted, but were still pursuing the enemy.

dag: Asirianim yi ti wum Yawɛ kukoli, ka nya o ni darigi bɛ tibili shɛm, bɛ ni tarigi.
en: The LORDs voice will terrify Assyria; with a rod he will smite it.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, n na ʒi n-zaɣisi nandaamba sɔŋbu, bɛ yi ti be muɣisigu ni n-kuhiri bɔri sɔŋsim.
en: No one refuses help to others, when disaster strikes.

dag: Ka o daa kpah o nyaandoliba maa zuɣu ni yɛli ni bɛ miri ka bɛ yɛli so ni ŋun Yisa n-nyɛ Masia.
en: Then Jesus warned his followers not to tell anyone he was the Messiah.

dag: Ti yi bela Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko zuɣu, yin chɛliya ka ti doli Naawuni Shia Kasi biɛhigu.
en: If we live by the Spirit, lets follow the Spirit.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla tarimba ni yino bi yuri ka tum birigi Yawɛ ni zali ni bɛ di niŋ binshɛŋa la n-kpe taali ni.
en: When any of you ordinary people disobey me without meaning to, you are still guilty.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Ɛbɛdimɛlɛk daa zaŋ niriba maa pah omaŋ zuɣu ka bɛ chaŋ nayili nɛma duu nti zaŋ situr chɛra n-zaŋ gabisi lo li n-zaŋ li ti Jɛrimia kɔbiliga maa ni ha.
en: So Ebed Melech took the men with him. But first he went to a room under the storeroom in the kings palace. He took some old rags and worn-out clothes from that room. Then he let the rags down with some ropes to Jeremiah in the cistern.

dag: Daadam, dim a bindirigu ka a niŋgbuna sɔhira ka nyu kom ni dabiɛm, ka a niŋgbuna sɔhira.
en: Son of man, you must act as if you are very frightened. You must shake when you eat your food. You must act worried and afraid when you drink your water.

dag: ni naɣilah ayi mini piɛlah anu ni bulah anu ni yuun yini piɛlabih anu shɛb bɛ ni zaŋdi maani biɛrisuŋ sara la. Ammihud bia Ɛlishama sara n-daa bala.
en: and for the well-being sacrifice two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Elishama, Ammihuds son.

dag: Ka bɛ daa guhi ka di yuui ha, amaa ka o kul bi yoori zɔntua maa dunoya maa; ka bɛ daa zaŋ saafɛbia yooi li nya ka bɛ naa maa kpimi do tiŋa.
en: They stood there waiting until they felt foolish, but Eglon still didn't open the doors. Finally, they unlocked the doors and found King Eglon lying dead on the floor.

dag: Di saha ka n gban o tooni ni n jɛm o, ka o yɛli ma, Di niŋ lala! N nyɛla a dab kpee ni a mabihi bɛn gbibi Yisa shɛhira la ni yino. Jɛmmila Naawuni! Dama bɛn gbibi Yisa shɛhira nina neerimi kaman anabinim nina ni neeri shɛm.
en: Then I fell at his feet to worship him. But he said, Dont do that! Im a servant just like you and your brothers and sisters who hold firmly to the witness of Jesus. Worship God! The witness of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa yɛli naa, N ni daa be n ya ka wum a yɛla ni a yɛm yɛla shɛm shiri nyɛla yɛlimaŋli.
en: Then she said to King Solomon, The stories I heard in my country about your great works and your wisdom are true.

dag: Amaa ka yi zaɣisi ni yi ku ka n sanna ti nya nyɛvili.
en: but you refuse to come to me for eternal life.

dag: Tumo maa daa yɛlila Dauda, Ti dimnim maa daa gari ti la yaa ka yina ni bɛ ti tuhi ti polo ni, amaa ka ti daa lan daai ba labisi bɛ tiŋ maa dunɔdal ni.
en: He said, Our enemies were stronger than we were and came out of the city to fight us in the open, but we drove them back to the city gate.

dag: Bɛ baɣa ka fɔŋ ni vuri ni, so mi bi mali ba tumdi tuma ka bɛ wumd o tahigu.
en: They stay far from crowded cities and refuse to be tamed.

dag: Yi bi mi m mini n yaannim ni daa niŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa niriba zaa shɛm la yɛla? Tiŋgbɔna maa buɣa daa tooi tiligi di niriba n nuu ni?.
en: Don't you know what my ancestors and I have done to the people of other nations? Did the gods of any other nation save their people from the emperor of Assyria?.

dag: Yawɛ, ti garigim a muɣisigu nyabu dali! Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ yuli ni gul a.
en: I pray that the LORD answers you whenever you are in trouble. Let the name of Jacobs God protect you.

dag: Di saha ka Yɛhudianim daa ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni niŋdi Yisa, o ni daa yɛli ni o nyɛla bindirigu din yi alizanda ni na la zuɣu.
en: The people started grumbling about him, because he said, I am the bread that came down from heaven.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ tatabo kul niŋdila bɛ suhuri ni yu ni bɛ niŋ shɛm. Bɛ ŋmanila biŋkɔbiri bɛn nyɛ bɛ ni dɔɣ shɛb ni bɛ ti gbahi ba kɔri la; bɛ nyɛla bɛn ʒiɛmdi bɛ ni bi baŋ yɛl shɛŋa gbinni. Bɛ ni ti bahi yoli kaman biŋkɔbiri la.
en: But these people act by instinct, like wild animals born to be captured and killed; they attack with insults anything they do not understand. They will be destroyed like wild animals.

dag: Dama o suhu bi yu ni o nahim ti bee n-ti ti ni so suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: He definitely doesnt enjoy affliction, making humans suffer.

dag: ni Chɛfaramɔni ni Ofini ni Gɛba: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔŋ kara pinaayi m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Kephar Ammoni, Ophni, and Geba. There were twelve cities and the fields around them.

dag: Ka Yisa daa gbaai bia maa nuu ni yiɣis o ʒili, ka o yiɣisi zani.
en: But Jesus took hold of his hand and helped him stand up.

dag: Ka di daa ti lu Naa Hɛrɔd dɔɣim dabisili dali, ka Hɛrɔdias bipuɣiŋga yi salo ni na nti wa waa ka di niŋ Naa Hɔrɔd nyaɣisim pam.
en: But at Herods birthday party Herodias daughter danced in front of the guests and thrilled Herod.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa kpahi ŋmɛnditol shɛba tabili dapula zuɣu n-zaŋ sa m-pah o zuɣu la gba yɛr o zilima.
en: The two criminals also said cruel things to Jesus.

dag: Ka Iso yɛl o, M mini kum kul chɛ tab la kpe ni kpe, ka buchi bɔ ka kpamdi lan yɛn ku ma.
en: Esau said, I am almost dead with hunger, so what good are these rights to me now.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa ti dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol o yuli Samsin; ka bia maa daa mali ti zooi, ka Yawɛ niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni.
en: The woman gave birth to a son and named him Samson. The child grew and the Lord blessed him.

dag: O daa yɛlimi, M paɣiri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun zaŋ o nuu tum tuma m-pal o ni daa yaag o noli lo m ba Dauda alikauli shɛli n-yɛli.
en: and said: Praise the Lord God of Israel! Long ago he brought his people out of Egypt. He did not choose a city from any tribe in Israel where his temple would be built, but he kept his promise to make my father David the king of Israel.

dag: dinzuɣu suhimiya ŋun su puu atam maa kpuɣibu ka o bo tumtumdiba m-pahi ka bɛ kpuɣi puu atam maa na.
en: Therefore, plead with the Lord of the harvest to send out workers for his harvest.

dag: Mani n-daa yi piiri bɛ ni bɔri shɛli tiri ba. Mani n-daa nyɛ bɛ zuɣulana. N daa bemi kaman naa m-be o tɔbbihi san la, ka be kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun maari bɛn fabindi suhuri la.
en: My advice was followed as though I were a king leading my troops, or someone comforting those in sorrow.

dag: Chɛ ka Yawɛ ni tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb zaa yɛli lala, bɛna n-nyɛ o ni tiligi shɛb muɣisigu ni.
en: Everyone the Lord has saved should repeat that word of thanks. Praise him, all who have been rescued from the enemy.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ be yi sani. O tin ya suhudoo luɣ shɛlikam zaa, dama ŋuna n-daa zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa pun be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni la niŋ n nuu ni, ka tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ leei ŋun Yawɛ min o niriba ni su shɛli.
en: The LORD your God is with you! Hes given you peace on every side. Hes placed under my power the lands people, so that the land is under the control of the LORD and his people.

dag: Dama do so ŋun pa yɛdaniŋda leeri Naawuni ni deeri so la o paɣ zuɣu, ka paɣ so ŋun pa yɛdaniŋda gba leeri Naawuni ni deeri so la o yidan zuɣu; dama di yi pa lala, bɛ bihi ni nyɛla Naawuni ni ku deei shɛba, amaa ka bɛ di pun nyɛla o ni deei shɛba.
en: The husband who doesnt believe belongs to God because of his wife, and the wife who doesnt believe belongs to God because of her husband. Otherwise, your children would be contaminated by the world, but now they are spiritually set apart.

dag: Yin ni tooi di binshɛŋa zaa bɛn be kom ni n-nyɛ: binshɛɣukam bɛn mali gɔhi mini paɣiri.
en: You may eat any kind of fish that has fins and scales.

dag: Di saha maa n daa yɛliya, N kɔŋko ku tooi gbib ya.
en: Right after the Lord commanded us to leave Mount Sinai, I told you: Israel, being your leader is too big a job for one person.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sab zaligu maa ni wuhi shɛm yaɣili kam zuliya yɛtɔɣa ni mini bɛ sabbu ni nyɛ shɛm puuni n-ti o tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣili kam nima n-yɛli ni yidan kam n-nyɛ o yiŋ zuɣulana. Ka o yɛligu simdi ni di zani.
en: and he sent letters to all of his provinces. Each letter was written in the language of the province to which it was sent, and it said that husbands should be in charge of their wives and children.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa bɔh o, Ka a paɣ Zara be ya? Ka o yɛli ba, O be tanti suɣili ŋɔ ni.
en: and they asked, Where's your wife Sarah? She is right there in the tent, Abraham answered.

dag: Ka timaŋmaŋ gba baŋ Naawuni yurilim ni nyɛ shɛm zaŋ chaŋ ti sani, ka niŋ yɛda. Naawuni nyɛla yurilim, ka ŋunkam kul be yurilim puuni nyɛla ŋun be Naawuni ni, ka Naawuni gba be o ni.
en: And we ourselves know and believe the love which God has for us. God is love, and those who live in love live in union with God and God lives in union with them.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti me buɣili zali yimaŋa.
en: Don't make metal images of gods.

dag: Yi zɔnim mini yi dɔɣiriba ni yi mabihi hal zaŋ tabili yi banim mini yi manim ni ti chɛ ka bɛ gbahi ya n-ku yi ni shɛb gba.
en: You will be betrayed by your parents, brothers and sisters, relatives, and friends. They will execute some of you.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Jɛrimia shɛm zaŋ chaŋ sanzali polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: When there had been no rain for a long time, the Lord told me to say to the people:.

dag: Chɛ ka ti laɣ tab zɔri m-be kaman m ba min a ba ni daa be shɛm la. Nyama, n zaŋla anzinfa mini salima ŋɔ ti a pini. Saɣimm a mini Izraɛl Naa Baasha zɔtal la, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o zaŋ o tɔbbihi yiɣisi ka chɛ ma.
en: Asa sent this message: My father and your father had a peace agreement. Now I want to make a peace agreement with you. I am sending you this gift of gold and silver. Please break your treaty with King Baasha of Israel and make him leave us alone.

dag: Ka o ni daa tum yiko mini kpiɔŋ tuun shɛŋa zaa zaŋ tabil o ni daa duhi Mɔdɛkai n-zaŋ o zali zaashe tital ni la, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Pɛriʒia mini Miidia nanim yɛlikura litaafi ni.
en: All the great and wonderful things he did, as well as the whole story of how he promoted Mordecai to high office, are recorded in the official records of the kings of Persia and Media.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Amaa yi yi ti nya ka tɔbbihi teei gili Jɛrusalɛm, yin baŋmiya ni di wurimbu saha miriya.
en: When you see Jerusalem surrounded by soldiers, you will know that it will soon be destroyed.

dag: Ka salo daa pahi bɛ zuɣu liri ba; ka sariakaritib maa daa dari tɔhi Pool mini Silas binyɛra, ka bahi noli ni bɛ zaŋm jaaŋgbɛbihi fiɛb ba.
en: And the crowd joined in the attack against Paul and Silas. Then the officials tore the clothes off Paul and Silas and ordered them to be whipped.

dag: Bɛ kpibu bi to, yuntisuɣu ka niriba maa tabitabi kpi, ka bɛ zaŋ wɔɣira maa chaŋ ka di pala daadam nuu n-niŋ li.
en: In the middle of the night they suddenly die; people are shaken and pass away. The mighty are removed, not by a human hand.

dag: Di saha ka bɛn daa yɛn vih o maa dii yiɣis o sani yi; ka dabiɛm daa kpe sapashin kpɛm maa gba o ni daa baŋ ni Pool nyɛla Rom tiŋbia ka o lo o zoligɔnim lala maa zuɣu.
en: At once those who were about to examine him stepped away. The commander was alarmed when he realized he had bound a Roman citizen.

dag: Tindaannim maa daa bi kani Yawɛ sara maligu bimbini din daa be Jɛrusalɛm la gbin na, amaa ka lee pahiri bɛ mabihi zuɣu ŋ-ŋubiri bɔrɔbɔro shɛli din ka dabindi la.
en: Although the priests of these shrines didnt go up on the LORDs altar in Jerusalem, they did eat unleavened bread with their fellow priests.

dag: A nya Ɛhab ni siɣis omaŋ n sani shɛm bebɔ? O ni siɣis omaŋ n sani shɛm maa zuɣu, n ku lan chɛ ka yɛl biɛɣu maa paag o o ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni, amaa o bia ʒiɛman ni ka n ni ti chɛ ka di paag o daŋ niriba.
en: Have you seen how Ahab has humbled himself before me? Because he has done so, I wont bring the evil during his lifetime. Instead, I will bring the evil on his household in the days of his son.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, yinima n-shiri nyɛ ti barinyubo mini ti suhupiɛlli!.
en: You are our glory and joy!.

dag: Naawuni ni daa yɛn lo ti yab Ibrahimma alikauli ka so kani n-gari ŋun Naawuni ka o ni po o la zuɣu, o daa ŋmaligi m-pola omaŋ.
en: When God made his promise to Abraham, he made a vow to do what he had promised. Since there was no one greater than himself, he used his own name when he made his vow.

dag: ka yɛli di tiŋgbɔŋ maa, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N je a yɛlli, n ni ŋooi n takɔbi di tɔɣu ni n-ku wuntizɔriba mini ninvuɣ biɛri zaa bɛn be a ni.
en: that I, the Lord , am saying: I am your enemy. I will draw my sword and kill all of you, good and evil alike.

dag: Yi yi ni kpalim be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, dindina n ni lan chɛ ka yi nya yaa, ka n ku lan daai ya luhi. N ni zaŋ ya sa, ka ku lan vuɣi ya, dama n ni daa chɛ ka alɔbo shɛli lu yi zuɣu maa, di lan niŋ ma yoli pam. .
en: I am sorry that I had to punish you, and so I now tell you to stay here in Judah, where I will plant you and build you up, instead of tearing you down and uprooting you.

dag: N daa niŋ bɛn doli soli ŋɔ alaka, hal ka chɛ ka bɛ ku bɛ shɛba, ka chɛ ka bɛ lo bɛ shɛb bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba mihi kpɛhi duu.
en: I made trouble for everyone who followed the Lord's Way, and I even had some of them killed. I had others arrested and put in jail. I didn't care if they were men or women.

dag: Di saha Izraɛlnim zaa yi ti wum li, dabiɛm ni gbahi ba, ka bɛ ku lan tum zaɣ biɛɣu lala tatabo yaha.
en: And when the rest of Israel hears about it, they will be afraid, and no one else will ever do such an evil thing again.

dag: Ka a ni tɛhi tɛhi viɛl shɛŋa ka taɣ ma zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka m bi tum taali so ʒim yihibu puuni bee n-zaŋ mmaŋmaŋ nuhi ŋɔ bɔhi biɛri ŋɔ zuɣu, a mali alibarika.
en: And you should also be praised. Your good sense kept me from taking revenge and killing innocent people.

dag: Kahigim a daalahiziba yurilim la wuhi, nyin ŋun nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kanna ti sɔɣiri a sani a nudirigu polo tiligiri bɛ dimnim nuu ni tiligira ŋɔ.
en: Manifest your faithful love in amazing ways because you are the one who saves those who take refuge in you, saving them from their attackers by your strong hand.

dag: Di saha ka Yaakubu daa bol o bihi na nti yɛli ba, Laɣimmiya na ka n ti yɛli ya din ti yɛn niŋ ya dahin shɛli ha yɛla.
en: Jacob called for his sons and said, Gather around, and I will tell you what will happen to you in the future:.

dag: Izraɛlnim zaa saɣim a zaligunima, ka zaɣisi ni bɛ ku wum a ni yɛli shɛm. Ti tum alahichi a sani, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka a chɛ ka nopoli yɛtɔɣa din sab a dabili Musa zaligu ni la di ti.
en: Everyone in Israel has stubbornly refused to obey your laws, and so those curses written by your servant Moses have fallen upon us.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm paɣiba, pomiya saŋkpalima bee muli zaɣ nyama ni yi ku chɛ ka ti tab bɔbu kɔre yiɣisi bee n-kpaŋsi li, ka di saha na bi paai.
en: Young women of Jerusalem, promise me by the power of deer and gazelles never to awaken love before it is ready.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ taŋkpaɣu ka Naawuni daa zaŋ nam tuuli Adam; ka Adam ŋun pah ayi maa mi nyɛ ŋun yi alizanda ni na.
en: The first man came from the dust of the earth. The second man came from heaven.

dag: Asa ni daa ti paai yuun pihinahiyinika o nam maa ni saha shɛli, ka naba polo dɔro daa gbaag o, ka o dɔro maa daa muɣis o pam; amaa dɔro maa ni daa muɣis o maa zaa yoli, o daa bi suhi Yawɛ, amaa ka naɣ dolila timanim bɔri sɔŋsim.
en: In the thirty-ninth year of his rule, he got a very bad foot disease, but he relied on doctors and refused to ask the Lord for help.

dag: Ka Pool daa garigi yɛli Di chaŋ wula ka yi kuhiri ŋ-ŋmari n yɛma? M mali shili gu shɛlikam, pa ni bɛ ti lo ma mihi Jɛrusalɛm n-kpɛhi duu kɔŋko, amaa n loya ni n ti kpi nimaani gba n Duuma Yisa yuli zuɣu.
en: But he said, Why are you crying and making me feel so sad? I am willing to be put in jail in Jerusalem. I am even ready to die for the name of the Lord Jesus.

dag: Ka o daa ti zahim zahindi nya ka darigu ʒe tiŋa ka di zuɣusaa chaŋ ti tɔri alizanda, ka o nya ka Naawuni malaikanim dol li duri ka siɣirina.
en: Jacob had a dream. He dreamed there was a ladder that was on the ground and reached up into heaven. He saw the angels of God going up and down the ladder.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yiɣisi dari chah o binyɛra, ka teei dɔni tiŋgban ni ka kpambaliba bɛn daa be o sani gba dari chahi bɛ binyɛra.
en: King David tore his clothes and lay on the ground. All of Davids officers standing near him also tore their clothes.

dag: Man gba ni kpahi n nuhi, ka tum n suhuyiɣisili tuma. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I also will clap my hands, and my anger will be over. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Yisa kum la tatabo kul bela ti niŋgbuna ni ni di chɛ ka Yisa nyɛvili gba tooi yi palo ti niŋgbuna maa ni.
en: We face death every day because of Jesus. Our bodies show what his death was like, so his life can also be seen in us.

dag: Ŋun daa lan pahi n-nyɛ Baruk bia Maasɛya ŋun daa nyɛ Kolihɔze yaaŋa la. O yaannim shɛba n-daa lan nyɛ Hazaaya mini Adaya ni Joyarib ni Zakaria so mi bɛn daa nyɛ Shilo daŋ ni niriba la.
en: Maaseiah, the son of Baruch and grandson of Colhozeh. His other ancestors included Hazaiah, Adaiah, Joiarib, and Zechariah, descendants of Judah's son Shelah.

dag: Fɔntinsi zaa din daa be tintan ni mini Giliad zaa ni Bashan zaa zaŋ hal ni Salɛka ni Ɛdirɛi, fɔn shɛŋa din daa be Bashan Naa Ogi nam sulinsi ni la.
en: including all the towns on the plateau, in the regions of Gilead and Bashan, and all the way to Salecah and Edrei—all the towns that belonged to Ogs kingdom in Bashan. .

dag: ka Uzi nyɛ Zɛrahia ba, ka Zɛrahia nyɛ Mɛrayɔt ba.
en: Uzzi of Zerahiah, Zerahiah of Meraioth.

dag: ka guhir o Bia ni o yi alizanda ni labina, ŋuna n-nyɛ o Bia Yisa so o ni daa neei kum ni ka o nyɛ ŋun fa ti Naawuni suhuyiɣisili din ti yɛn kana la ni bahi.
en: They also tell how you are waiting for his Son Jesus to come from heaven. God raised him from death, and on the day of judgment Jesus will save us from God's anger.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛl o, Hal a kul lihiya ni a pɔri maa zaa yoli, pa nyini n-nyɛ Izraɛl zuliya zaa zuɣulana? Yawɛ n-daa booi kpam bah a zuɣu ni ka a leei Izraɛlnim zaa naa.
en: Samuel continued, You may not think you're very important, but the Lord chose you to be king, and you are in charge of the tribes of Israel.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ku niriba, ka wurim bɛ tɔbbihi ni zaani luɣ shɛŋa tuhiri tɔbu, ka chɛ ka bɛ solɔri kpalim zaɣ kuma ka so bi lan dol li; ka chɛ ka bɛ fɔntinsi zani dabari, ka ninsalinim lan ka di ni, ka vuhirigu kam lan ka di ni.
en: I will cut off nations; their towers will be destroyed; I will devastate their streets. No one will pass through. Their cities will be laid waste. There will be no person, no inhabitant left.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, chɛ ka nyin Yawɛ yiko shiri galisi kaman a ni daa pun lo alikauli yɛli.
en: So now, Lord , I pray, show us your power and do what you promised when you said.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka Filistianim maa daa chaŋ ni bɛ ti yeei kpiimba maa situra, ka nya Sool min o bidibis ata maa ni do Gilibɔa Zoli zuɣu.
en: The next day when the Philistines came to strip the dead, they found Saul and his sons lying dead on Mount Gilboa.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛn fiɣisiri ma maa nya filiŋ, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ vi ye kaman binyɛrigu la.
en: You will cover them with shame, just as their bodies are covered with clothes.

dag: O gbib o yiŋnim viɛnyɛliŋga; o pala vinnyaɣilana.
en: She is always busy and looks after her family's needs.

dag: Di saha kokpɛɣu daa naan ʒi ti chaŋ; kopaliga daa naan du ti gari.
en: Then the waters would have drowned us; the torrent would have come over our necks.

dag: Ka Uziɛl bidibisi mi nyɛ Mishɛl mini Ɛlizafan ni Sitiri.
en: Uzziel's sons were Mishael, Elzaphan, and Sithri.

dag: Baŋmi dimbɔŋɔ: ʒiɛmana din bahindi nyaaŋa puuni nandahima ni ti beni sahasaha.
en: Remember that there will be difficult times in the last days.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ daa zaŋ Naa Sihɔn min o tɔbbihi maa zaa niŋ Izraɛlnim nuu ni, ka bɛ nyaŋ ba. Dina n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim daa deei Amɔrinim ni daa be tiŋgban shɛl ni maa zaa su.
en: But the Lord , the God of Israel, gave the Israelites victory over Sihon and his army. So the Israelites took possession of all the territory of the Amorites who lived in that country.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa chɛ ka bɛ boli Gibiɔnnim maa na ka o ti bɔhi ba. Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi yɔhim ti yɛli, Ti mini ya shee wɔɣ pam. ka kul bela ti sani kpe ŋɔ?.
en: Joshua told some of his soldiers, I want to meet with the Gibeonite leaders. Bring them here. When the Gibeonites came, Joshua said, You live close to us. Why did you lie by claiming you lived far away?.

dag: Di saha ka Ayuba daa garigi yɛli Yawɛ.
en: Job answered the LORD.

dag: Dinzuɣu man yi Duuma NAAWUNI yɛliya: N niriba bɛn jɛmdi ma ni di n-tiɣi ka nyu, amaa ka kum ni kɔnyuri mali yinima. Bɛ ni mali suhupiɛlli, amaa ka yinim di vi.
en: Therefore, the LORD God says: Look, my servants will eat, but you will hunger. My servants will drink, but you will thirst. My servants will rejoice, but you will be ashamed.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa daa yɛli, Gbaamiya Mikaya maa n-tahi ti ti tiŋ ŋɔ ni gomna Amɔn mini naa bia Jɔash.
en: Arrest him, ordered Israels king, and turn him over to Amon the city official and to Joash the kings son.

dag: Vinnyaɣilan mabia n-nyɛ bukaata saɣinda.
en: Those who are lazy in their work are brothers to thugs.

dag: Amaa ka n yɛli, N Duuma, n ku tooi niŋ lala, dama n na ʒi n-di bin yoya ŋɔ tatabo bee n ni chihiri binshɛŋa.
en: But I said, Certainly not, Lord! No ritually unclean or defiled food has ever entered my mouth.

dag: Miri ka a chɛ ka a suhu ye naa bindir nyaɣisa zuɣu, dama di nyɛla yɔhiŋ bindira.
en: Don't be greedy for all of that fancy food! It may not be so tasty.

dag: Amaa ka yuŋ daa ti paai ka o zaŋla o bipuɣiŋga Liya nti ti Yaakubu ka o zaŋ o niŋ o paɣa.
en: That night Laban brought his daughter Leah to Jacob. Jacob and Leah had sexual relations together.

dag: Zaŋm ba pahi amaŋ zuɣu ka yi mali yimaŋ kaman di ni wuhi shɛm, ka zo ba liɣiri kuŋa ka bɛ pini bɛ zuɣuri. Dina n-ni chɛ ka sokam baŋ ni bɛ ni yɛli ni a niŋ shɛm maa pala yɛlimaŋli, amaa ni hal amaŋmaŋ gba doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Take them with you, go through the purification ritual with them, and pay the cost of having their heads shaved. Everyone will know there is nothing to those reports about you but that you too live a life in keeping with the Law.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Biɛhiŋ kani, dabisa kanna ka n ni ti darigi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn guni bɛ niŋgbuna ni kɔŋko la tibili, bɛna n-nyɛ:.
en: This is what the Lord says: The time is coming when I will punish all those who are circumcised only in the body.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa yɛl o, Ti mali zaligu shɛli din wuhiri ni o simdi kum, o ni yɛli ni o nyɛla Naawuni Bia la zuɣu.
en: The Jewish leaders replied, We have a Law, and according to this Law he ought to die because he made himself out to be Gods Son.

dag: Yɛlim daba la gba ni bɛ deemi bɛ duumanim noya, ka tumdi din tiɣiri bɛ nini binshɛɣukam zaa puuni; ka di ŋmɛri ba naŋgbankpeeni.
en: Slaves are to submit themselves to their masters and please them in all things. They must not talk back to them.

dag: Sulemaana ʒini nam ʒiishee.
en: Theres more: Solomon has taken over the throne of the kingdom.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Sintani daa zaŋ o chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ti du tam Naawuni jɛmbu duu zuɣusaa kpaakpaanyom ni ha ka yɛl o, A yi shiri nyɛla Naawuni Bia, nyin bahim amaŋ lu tiŋ sa;.
en: Finally, the devil took Jesus to Jerusalem and had him stand on top of the temple. The devil said, If you are God's Son, jump off.

dag: Ka yi yi yɛli mi, Ti du m-bala Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, pa bɛ ni jɛmd o luɣ shɛŋa min o bimbina ka Hɛzɛkia daa wurim ka yɛli Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima, Jɛmmiya Naawuni bimbin shɛli din be Jɛrusalɛm la gbin la?.
en: Now suppose you say to me, We trust in the LORD our God. Isnt he the one whose shrines and altars Hezekiah removed, telling Judah and Jerusalem, You must worship before this altar in Jerusalem?.

dag: Ka naa yɛli, Pirigimiya bi nɛɔŋ maa buyi n-zaŋ o pirigili ti yino, ka zaŋ o pirigili din la n-ti ŋun la mi.
en: He told the servant, Cut the living baby in two and give one half of the baby to each woman.

dag: Ŋ-ŋɔ ka Naawuni daa yɛli zaŋ chaŋ malaikanim mi polo: Naawuni chɛ ka o malaikanim be kaman pɔhim; ka chɛ ka o tuumba be kaman buɣim zilima la.
en: And when God speaks about the angels, he says, I change my angels into wind and my servants into flaming fire.

dag: So ni ti yɛli, n nyɛla Yawɛ nira, ka so zaŋ Yaakubu yuli bol omaŋa, ka so mi sab pa o nuu zuɣu yɛli, Yawɛ nira, ka zaŋ Izraɛl leeg o yuli.
en: One man will call himself, I am the Lord s. Another will use the name, Jacob. Another man will sign his name as The Lord s Hand. And another will use the name, Israel.

dag: Di saha maa ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa wum Yisa yuli dubu yɛla.
en: At that time Herod, the ruler of Galilee, heard about Jesus.

dag: ni Kɛdɛmɔt ni Mɛfaat ni di zaa ha biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: Kedemoth and its pastures, and Mephaath and its pastures; in total: four cities.

dag: nti yɛli ba, Yinima n-nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya ni dɔɣirikpamba, yi mini yi mabihi zaa malimiya yimaŋa n-yi daɣiri ni din ni chɛ ka yi tooi zaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka ŋɔ ti zali luɣ shɛli n ni mali ni n zaŋ li zal la.
en: He said to them, You are the household heads of the Levites. Make yourselves holy, you and your brothers, and then bring the chest of the LORD, Israels God, to the place Ive prepared for it.

dag: Ka paɣ mi yi yi o yidan yiŋ kuli do so, o gba tum zina.
en: In the same way, a woman who divorces her husband and marries another man commits adultery.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa bi ti Kɔhat bihi la shɛli, dama bɛna n-daa su ni bɛ zaŋ neen shɛŋa din be kasi la buɣi bɛ bɔɣusapima zuɣu.
en: But Moses gave no wagons or oxen to the Kohathites, because the sacred objects they took care of had to be carried on their shoulders.

dag: TƐKƐL gbinni nyɛla, Naawuni zaŋ a pa sania zuɣu n-zahim a ka a tibisim pɔra.
en: TEKEL means that youve been weighed on the scales, and you dont measure up.

dag: Kpaŋsimiya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali biɛhiŋ la suhuri;.
en: Show mercy toward those who have doubts;.

dag: Wummiya! Pukpar so n-daa chaŋ ti kɔr o puu ka yaɣind o bimbira.
en: Now listen! A farmer went out to scatter seed in a field.

dag: Dama ŋun nyɛ Yɛhudia la palɔni kɔŋko pala Yɛhudia alali, ka gunibu maŋli mi pala din niŋ niŋgbuŋ palɔni kɔŋko.
en: It isnt the Jew who maintains outward appearances who will receive praise from God, and it isnt people who are outwardly circumcised on their bodies.

dag: Wuntizɔriba bɛn ka galimi chɛmi ka bɛ soya tuhi, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri maŋmaŋ ninvuɣ biɛtali n-nyɛ din luhiri ba.
en: The righteousness of the innocent makes their path straight, but the wicked fall in their wickedness.
