dag: Ka Musa daa boli Izraɛlnim zaa na nti yɛli ba, Yi daa nya Yawɛ ni tum tuun shɛŋa zaa yi ninni Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, o ni daa niŋ Firawuna min o sapashinnim ni o tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa shɛm.
en: Moses summoned all Israel, saying to them: Youve seen with your own eyes everything the LORD did in Egypt, to Pharaoh, his servants, and all his land.

dag: Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, M mi ni bɛ ni booni so Masia la ni kana; ka o yi ti kana, o ni wuhi ti binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: The woman said, I know that the Messiah is coming, the one who is called the Christ. When he comes, he will teach everything to us.

dag: O bi galisi gari ma yili ŋɔ puuni, o mi bi mɔŋ ma shɛli naɣila nyini, dama a nyɛla o paɣa; ka wula ka n ni tooi tum ninvuɣ biɛtali tuun titali ŋɔ n-tum alahichi zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni sani.
en: My master has made me almost equal to him in his house. I cannot sleep with his wife! That is wrong! It is a sin against God.

dag: Ka n daa wum ka malaika ŋuni maa garigi yɛli: Di ni niŋ biɛɣ tusaayi ni kɔbisita. Di nyaaŋa ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni lan lab mali zani di zaashee.
en: I heard the other angel answer, It will continue for , evenings and mornings, during which sacrifices will not be offered. Then the Temple will be restored.

dag: Bɛ ni daa mali Yisa chani maa ka bɛ chirigi Sairiini nira ŋun yuli booni Saimɔn, ka bɛ gbaag o ti muɣis o n-zaŋ Yisa dapulli maa ʒil o ni o ʒi li.
en: On the way they met a man named Simon who was from Cyrene, and they forced him to carry Jesus' cross.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan yi nimaani n-chaŋ Mizipa din be Mɔab tiŋgbɔŋ ni la ti yɛli Mɔab naa, N suhir a ni a chɛ ka m ba mini m ma ʒini a sani hal ka n ti baŋ Naawuni ni yɛn tum tuun shɛli ti ma.
en: David left Adullam and went to Mizpah in Moab. David said to the king of Moab, Please let my father and mother come and stay with you until I learn what God is going to do to me.

dag: O daa yi kul paai luɣ shɛlikam zaa, di yi nyɛla puri ni bee tiŋkpansi ni bee fɔntinsi ni, bɛ ʒirila barinim na nti sɔŋdi di dahi ni, ka suhir o ni o kul chɛ ka bɛ shihi o binyɛrigu naŋgbambili, ka bɛnkam daa shihi li shiri kpaŋ zaa.
en: In every village or farm or marketplace where Jesus went, the people brought their sick to him. They begged him to let them just touch his clothes, and everyone who did was healed.

dag: Ka din pa di zuɣu ŋ-ŋman li mi nyɛla, Yum a ʒiʒiinikpee kaman amaŋmaŋ la.
en: And the second is like it: You must love your neighbor as you love yourself .

dag: Jɛrusalɛmnima, neemiya, neemiya! Yiɣisimiya zani. Yi nyu Yawɛ ni zaŋ o suhuyiɣisili tibidarigibo binnyur shɛl la buɣi. Yi nyu li, ka di chɛ ka yi chani laana.
en: Jerusalem, wake up! Rouse yourself and get up! You have drunk the cup of punishment that the Lord in his anger gave you to drink; you drank it down, and it made you stagger.

dag: ni naɣilah ayi mini piɛlah anu ni bulah anu ni yuun yini piɛlabih anu m-mali suhudoo sara. Hɛlɔn bia Ɛliab sara n-daa bala.
en: and for the well-being sacrifice, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Eliab, Helons son.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ dɔro gbaai Naa Uzia m-mal o hal ka o ti kpimi ni dina. O daa yi nayili n-taɣi ti bela yil shɛli. Ka o bia Jɔtam daa be nayili n-lihiri li, ka gbibi Juda tiŋgbɔŋ maa niriba.
en: The Lord struck Uzziah with a dreaded skin disease that stayed with him the rest of his life. He lived in a separate house, relieved of all duties, while his son Jotham governed the country.

dag: Hiram ni daa wum Sulemaana ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka di niŋ o nyaɣisim pam, ka o yɛli, Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ m paɣiri Yawɛ ŋun ti Dauda bi yɛndana ni o su ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn galisi pam ŋɔ.
en: Hiram was very happy when he heard what Solomon asked. He said, I praise the Lord today for giving David a wise son to rule this great nation.

dag: Goonje mini mɔɣilo, neemiya! N ni ŋme biɛɣunaayo.
en: Harps and lyres, wake up, and lets wake the dawn!.

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o ni daa tuhi tɔbu shɛm ni o ni daa di nam shɛm zaa yɛla sab niŋ Izraɛl nanim Litaafi ni.
en: The rest of Jeroboams deeds—how he fought and how he ruled—are written in the official records of Israels kings.

dag: Amaa ka bɛna bɛn nyɛ ti yaannim maa daa ti niŋ karimbaani mini tipawumli n-zaɣis a zaligunim maa dolibu.
en: But our ancestors became proud and stubborn. They refused to obey your commands.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka n daa wum kukol shɛli damli kaman salo pam kukoya la ka di yi alizanda ni na yɛra, Haliluya! Ti Duuma Naawuni n-su tiliginsim mini yiko, ka simdi tibigibu!.
en: After this I heard what sounded like the roar of a large crowd of people in heaven, saying, Praise God! Salvation, glory, and power belong to our God!.

dag: Amaa ka Farisiinima bɛn daa wum lala ka yɛli, Kulla alizin biɛri naa ŋun yuli booni Biilzibul la n-niŋ o yiko ka o kariti alizin biɛri bahiri maa.
en: When the Pharisees heard this, they replied, He drives out demons only because their ruler Beelzebul gives him power to do so.

dag: Di saha Jɛrimia daa kul gɔrila o yubu niriba maa sani, dama bɛ daa na bi kpɛh o duu.
en: At that time Jeremiah had not yet been put into prison, so he was free to go anywhere he wanted.

dag: Daba, deemiya yi dunia ŋɔ ni duumanim noya ni dabeenzɔbo mini ni sɔhibu, ka niŋmiya lala ni nimmoo kaman yi niŋdi li tirila Masia la.
en: Slaves, you must obey your earthly masters. Show them great respect and be as loyal to them as you are to Christ.

dag: A yi ti yɛn kali Izraɛlnim maa, nyin chɛ ka sokam yo shɛli ti man Yawɛ bɛ nyɛviya zuɣu, ka di chɛ ka alɔbo ku lu bɛ zuɣu saha shɛli a yi ti kaani ba.
en: When you take a census of the Israelites to count them, each of them should pay compensation for their life to the LORD when they are counted. Then no plague will descend on them when they are counted.

dag: Tinim a daba ŋɔ zaa nyɛla do yino bihi, ti nyɛla ninvuɣ maŋa, ti pala puɣisiriba.
en: We're honest men, and we come from the same family—we're not spies.

dag: Naa Atazɛrikisɛs ŋun nyɛ na titali la n-sabi gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri nyin Ɛzra ŋun nyɛ maligumaana ni Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ zaligubaŋda la m-puhir a. Ka pumpɔŋɔ.
en: Greetings from the great King Artaxerxes to Ezra the priest and expert in the teachings of the God of heaven.

dag: Yi ni ti lan niŋ lala goli maa daba ayopɔin dali n-ti ŋunkam tum alahichi o chirimbu puuni bee o ʒilinsi puuni din ni chɛ ka yi mali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ka di niŋ kasi.
en: The same ceremony must also be done on the seventh day of the month, so that anyone who sins accidentally or without knowing it will be forgiven, and so that my temple will remain holy.

dag: mini niɣi tuhi pisopɔinnaayi.
en: , cattle.

dag: Bɛ daa ku Ɛvi mini Rɛkɛm ni Zur ni Hur ni Rɛba bɛn daa nyɛ Midian nanim la m-pahi bɛ ni daa ku bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb zaa zuɣu. Bɛ daa zaŋ takɔbi ku Bɛɔr bia Balaam gba.
en: including the five kings of Midian: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba. They also killed Balaam son of Beor.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli malaika maa ka o labis o takɔbi maa su di tɔɣu ni.
en: Then the LORD commanded the messenger to return his sword to its sheath.

dag: Ka o yi shini, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi galim o? Ka o yi zaŋ o nini sɔɣi, ninvuɣ so beni ŋun ni tooi nya o? Amaa ŋuna n-su daadamnim mini zuliya kam zaa.
en: When God does nothing, can any person or nation find fault with him?.

dag: Ŋun tumdi din bi tuhi ni ti deela o ni tum din bi tuhi shɛli maa laara; dama Naawuni bi yaai so yuri ka chɛ so.
en: Remember that anyone who does wrong will be punished for that wrong. And the Lord treats everyone the same.

dag: Ka din pah anu gbaai Nɛtania min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: Fifth, there were men chosen from Nethaniahs sons and relatives.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda garigi yɛli, Bolimiya Batishiiba ti ma. Ka o daa kpe naa sanna nti zan o tooni.
en: King David answered, Bring me Bathsheba. She came and stood before the king.

dag: Ka binnɛma balibu kam zaa bɛba ayiyi bɛn mali nyɛvili daa kpe ŋariŋ maa ni m-pahi Nuhu zuɣu.
en: A male and a female of each kind of living being went into the boat with Noah.

dag: Ŋunkam doli yɛlimaŋli soli nyɛla ŋun yi barina ni. Amaa ŋun doli bilikɔnsi soli, o gbini ni vii.
en: You will be safe, if you always do right, but you will get caught, if you are dishonest.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun daa yɛn kpi daa suhi alibarika niŋ n ni, ka n daa chɛ ka pakoya yili yila ni suhupiɛlli.
en: The blessing of the perishing reached me; I made the widows heart sing.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni o nyɛla ŋun gbib omaŋmaŋ yiŋnim viɛnyɛliŋga, ka niŋdi din ni chɛ ka o bihi deer o noli ka tir o jilima binshɛɣukam puuni;.
en: Church officials must be in control of their own families, and they must see that their children are obedient and always respectful.

dag: ka bɛ be bɛ ni gbahi ba kuli tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni ti leei daba maa, ka di ti lu bɛ suhuri ni, ka bɛ niŋ tuuba ka suh a bɛ ni be tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni maa yɛli, Ti tum alahichi, ka tum nyaanyibo mini ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma.
en: listen to your people's prayers. If there in that land they repent and pray to you, confessing how sinful and wicked they have been, hear their prayers, O Lord .

dag: Yinim bilikɔɣinim ŋɔ! Di chaŋ wula ka yi baŋdi dunia ŋɔ mini sagbana shihira, ka lee bi baŋdi ʒiɛmani ŋɔ din shihira.
en: Hypocrites! You know how to interpret conditions on earth and in the sky. How is it that you dont know how to interpret the present time?.

dag: N yi yɛli ni zibisim sɔɣim ma, ka neesim din gili ma zaa leei zibisim.
en: Suppose I wanted to hide from you and said, Surely the darkness will hide me. The day will change to night and cover me.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa yɛl o yiŋ tumtumdiba kpɛma, Niŋm bindira su niriba maa kpalansi ni ka di saɣi bɛ ʒibu tariga, ka zaŋ bɛ zaa yinoyino liɣiri niŋ bɛ kpalansi noya ni;.
en: Joseph gave commands to his household manager: Fill the mens sacks with as much food as theyll hold, and put each mans silver at the top of his sack.

dag: Ti mali suhupiɛlli o zuɣu, ti ni niŋ o yuli din be kasi ŋɔ naani zuɣu.
en: We are glad because of him; we trust in his holy name.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa zaŋ salima dooi naɣibil kɔtomsi zali, ka kɔrigi biŋkɔbigu mal li; ka bɛ suhuri daa paligi pam bɛ ni daa zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali binshɛli maa zuɣu.
en: It was then that they made an idol in the shape of a bull, offered sacrifice to it, and had a feast in honor of what they themselves had made.

dag: Yinim peentɔriba zaa, teemiya zani yi zaashɛhi gili Babilɔn. Tomiya ba piɛma, di tɔn ya ka guui peen gaŋa, dama bɛ tum alahichi Yawɛ sani.
en: Prepare for war against Babylon. All you soldiers with bows, shoot your arrows at Babylon. Dont save any of your arrows. Babylon has sinned against the Lord .

dag: Dama Naawuni daalibarika niŋbu min o niriba piibu yɛla bi taɣira.
en: God doesn't take back the gifts he has given or disown the people he has chosen.

dag: Dama o luhi niriba pam n-ti ba dansi. Ka o ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb ka tariga.
en: She has brought down some of the most powerful men; she has left many dead bodies in her path.

dag: Ka Adɔnija daa ti zaŋ piɛri mini naɣilalantaba ni naɣibihi pol kpaba n-kɔri ba Wahu Kuɣili din daa do m-baɣi Ɛnrɔgɛl la, ka boli nabihi bɛn nyɛ o mabihi zaa mini Juda nabihi zaa na.
en: Adonijah invited his brothers and David's officials from Judah to go with him to Crawling Rock near Rogel Spring, where he sacrificed some sheep, cattle, and fat calves.

dag: Ka o daa lan wurim bɛ ni daa me binshɛli zali nayili Vuhim Dabisili zuɣu la, ka ŋari Yawɛ jɛmbu duu sambani polo duno shɛli bɛ ni daa chib ti naa ni o doli kpɛr la. Asiria naa zuɣu ka o daa niŋ shɛm maa.
en: And in order to please the Assyrian emperor, Ahaz also removed from the Temple the platform for the royal throne and closed up the king's private entrance to the Temple.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o niŋ duu kpari, dama bɛ daa na bi mi bɛ ni yɛn niŋ o shɛm.
en: They guarded the man carefully because they did not know how they should punish him.

dag: Ka Pool mi daa pii Silas pah omaŋ zuɣu ka yɛdaniŋdiba daa zaŋ ba niŋ ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ Alibarikalan ŋɔ nuu ni, ka bɛ mi naanyi chaŋ bɛ chandi shee.
en: Paul chose Silas to go with him. The believers in Antioch put Paul into the Lords care and sent him out.

dag: Yaakubu ni daa tɔɣis o bihi maa yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai, o daa vuui la o naba pa o bindoo zuɣu dɔni n-leei Naawuni dini pah o yaannim zuɣu.
en: When Jacob had finished giving instructions to his sons, he lay back down and died.

dag: Kul sɔŋm ma, dama m piila a zaligunima.
en: Be ready to protect me because I have chosen to obey your laws.

dag: Yawɛ chɛ ka na biɛri yiko zan tariga.
en: The Lord breaks the scepter of evil rulers; he takes away their power.

dag: Amaa ka o daa zaŋ o pagɔrisigu tuma maa chaŋ katiŋa. O daa nya bɛ ni mali dɔbba kɔtomsi pa dukpini zuɣu. Di daa nyɛla Babilɔnnim anfooni ka bɛ mali pa dukpina zuɣu, ka bɛ ye neen ʒiɛfaa.
en: She sank deeper and deeper in her immorality. She was attracted by the images of high Babylonian officials carved into the wall and painted bright red, with sashes around their waists and fancy turbans on their heads.

dag: paɣimiy o cheechi ni mini Yisa Masia ni, ʒiɛmani kam ni hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: to God be the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus for all time, forever and ever! Amen.

dag: Ka so yi muɣis a ni a ʒi o ʒili n-tah o tin shɛli din pa a ya zuɣu kaman zaligu ni wuhi shɛm tariga, nyin ʒim li yaɣi di zuɣu.
en: If a soldier forces you to walk with him one mile, go with him two.

dag: Ka Bɛla daa ti kpi, ka Zɛra ŋun daa nyɛ Bɔzira nir la bidibiga Jɔbab di nam zan o zaani.
en: After Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah became king.

dag: Yinim bɛn je din viɛla ka bɔrila zaɣ biɛɣu ŋɔ, yinim bɛn dariti tɔhiri n niriba niŋgbuŋ gbana, ka dariti tɔhiri bɛ nimdi ka chɛri bɛ kɔba ŋɔ.
en: but you prefer to do evil instead of what is right. You skin my people alive. You strip off their flesh.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be Ishimail sani maa ni daa nya Karia bia Jɔhanan ka tɔbbihi sapashin kpamba zaa be o sani, bɛ suhuri daa paligimi.
en: When Ishmael's prisoners saw Johanan and the officers, they were happy.

dag: Yinim bɛn daa ʒe n niriba ka di niŋ ya nyaɣisim ka yi suhuri paligi, ka yi ŋumda kaman naɣisaa n-nɔri buri chi la bee n-kuhiri kaman yuri la.
en: Babylon, you are excited and happy. You took my land. You dance around like a young cow that got into the grain. Your laughter is like the happy sounds that horses make.

dag: Amaa din beni nyɛla, saria karibu mini buɣim din mali dabiɛm ka nyɛ din ti yɛn bahi bɛn tuhiri Naawuni yol la n-naɣ kpalim.
en: Theres only a scary expectation of judgment and of a burning fire thats going to devour Gods opponents.

dag: Di saha maa ka Naa Hɛzɛkia daa yihi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dunoya ni salima ni ŋun maŋmaŋ Juda Naa Hɛzɛkia ni daa zaŋ salima shɛli m-mali dunoya la pahi n-zaŋ ti Asiria naa maa.
en: He even stripped the gold that he had used to cover the doors and doorposts in the temple. He gave it all to Sennacherib.

dag: ni bɛ daazichi zaa ni bɛ paɣiba mini bɛ bihi ni binshɛɣukam din daa be bɛ yinsi zaa chaŋ.
en: The brothers took everything those people owned. They even took their wives and children.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ni ŋmari ʒiri, ka nyari ʒii shɛŋa din pa yɛlimaŋli maa zuɣu, n suhu yiɣisimi bahi yi zuɣu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: So the Sovereign Lord says to them, Your words are false, and your visions are lies. I am against you.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa yɛl o, Labisim a takɔb maa su di tɔɣu ni, dama ŋunkam ŋoori takɔbi ti kpirila takɔb kum.
en: Put your sword back in its place, Jesus said to him. All who take the sword will die by the sword.

dag: Nira yi wum alizanda nam yɛla ka bi baŋ di gbinni, Sintani kanimina nti to n-yihi din biri o suhu ni la. Dina n-nyɛ bimbir shɛŋa din lu sol zuɣu maa.
en: The seeds that fell along the road are the people who hear the message about the kingdom, but don't understand it. Then the evil one comes and snatches the message from their hearts.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd ni daa ti tim ti bɔri Pita ka bi nya o, ka o vihi duguliba maa yɛlli maa zuɣu, ka bahi noli ni bɛ kum ba. Di nyaaŋa ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa yiɣisi Judia chaŋ Siizaria nti kpalim be nimaani.
en: Herod looked everywhere for him but could not find him. So he questioned the guards and then ordered that they be killed. Later, Herod moved from Judea. He went to the city of Caesarea and stayed there a while.

dag: A bɔri ni yɛlimaŋli be nir suhu ni; dinzuɣu wuhim ma yɛm n suhu ni.
en: Sincerity and truth are what you require; fill my mind with your wisdom.

dag: Yawɛ, ti suhir a, tiligim ti! Yawɛ, ti suhir a, tim ti nasara!.
en: The people say, Praise the Lord ! The Lord saved us!.

dag: Ka n ni ti yɛli ni n suhu zaa, Yawɛ, ŋuni n-lee beni ŋ-ŋman a? Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun fari bɛn ka yaa kpiɔŋlaannim nuu ni bahira, ka lan nyɛ ŋun fari nandaamba bɛn nahindi ba nuu ni bahira.
en: With my whole self I will say, Lord , there is no one like you. You protect the poor from those who are stronger. You save the poor and helpless from those who try to rob them.

dag: Dauda daa yɛlimi, Yɛlimaŋli, yoli ka n daa kul guli doo ŋɔ binyara ŋɔ mɔɣu ŋɔ ni ka bi chɛ ka o binshɛli bɔrigi ŋɔ, ka ŋun ti zaŋla zaɣ biɛɣu yo ma samli.
en: David was saying, I protected Nabals property in the desert. I made sure not one of his sheep was missing. I did all that for nothing. I was good to him, but he was rude to me.

dag: ka niriba daa ti gbihi maai ka o dim chaŋ ti zaŋ piriŋkpana biɛlim biri gari di ni ka chaŋ o chandi.
en: But while everyone was sleeping, an enemy came and scattered weed seeds in the field and then left.

dag: Di tiɣi Yawɛ nini o wuntitali zuɣu ni o tibig o zaligunima, ka chɛ ka di mali jilima.
en: The Lord is a God who is eager to save, so he exalted his laws and teachings, and he wanted his people to honor them.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ Pita mini Jɔn bahi maa ka bɛ chaŋ bɛ nyaandolitab sani nti yɛli ba maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba maa ni yɛli ba shɛm zaa.
en: As soon as Peter and John were set free, they returned to their group and told them what the chief priests and the elders had said.

dag: Niriba yi ti neei kum ni, bɛ bi lan yɛn kpuɣiri paɣiba bee n-zaŋdi bɛ bipuɣinsi tiri dɔbba; bɛ ti kul yɛn bemi kaman malaikanim bɛn be alizanda ni la.
en: When people rise from the dead, they wont marry nor will they be given in marriage. Instead, they will be like Gods angels.

dag: Yɛlim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ bini paligi li la ni di ni lu. Sa titali ni mi, ka sakuɣ kara luna, ka sanʒiɛɣu ʒe.
en: Say to those who laid on the plaster that it will fall. When the flooding rains appear and I send hailstones, it will collapse, and the storm winds will break it apart.

dag: Naawuni ni yɛri alikauli palli yɛla maa, di wuhiya ni o lihi tuuli din maa la zaɣ kurili. Ka binshɛli din kurigiri ka kpaari mi ku yuui ka leei din ku lan beni yaha.
en: When it says new, it makes the first obsolete. And if something is old and outdated, its close to disappearing.

dag: Ka o daa lab ti yɛli Juda, M bi nya paɣ maa; ka tiŋ maa nim yɛli ma ni pagɔr so na ʒi n-ka kpe na.
en: So he went back to Judah and said, I couldnt find her. The locals even said, Theres no holy woman here.

dag: N zaŋ n fabila sɔŋla o tooni. N yɛli n yɛlimuɣisira ni nyɛ shɛli o tooni.
en: I bring him all my complaints; I tell him all my troubles.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni nyɛla ŋun niŋdi Izraɛlnim din viɛla, ka lan niŋdi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali suhuyini din viɛla.
en: Truly God is good to Israel, to those who are have a pure heart.

dag: Ka Yawɛ bɔh o, Di simdi ni a chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi.
en: The Lord replied, What right do you have to be angry.

dag: dama ti yɛn saɣimla yaŋɔ. Bɛ ni yɛri di niriba tuumbiɛri yɛla shɛm galisiya pam Yawɛ sani; dinzuɣu ka o tim ti na ni ti ti saɣim li.
en: because we are going to destroy this place. The Lord has heard the terrible accusations against these people and has sent us to destroy Sodom.

dag: Ŋun mali yɛm, ŋun baŋmi dimbɔŋɔ gbinni. Ŋun nyɛ baŋda, ŋun baŋmi li. Dama Yawɛ soya nyɛla yɛlimaŋli soya, ka wuntizɔriba dol li, amaa alahichinim bɛn tuuri la di zuɣu.
en: A wise person understands these things, and a smart person should learn them. The Lord s ways are right. Good people will live by them. Sinners will die by them.

dag: Chinchin tibisi shɛli daa yili di puuni, ka bɛ booni tanti du shɛli din be chinchini maa nyaaŋa mi Luɣ Kasi Zaa Kasi Shee.
en: Behind the curtain was the most holy place.

dag: Ka binnɛma anahi la yɛli, Ami! Ka kpamba la mi daa gban tiŋa n-jɛmdi Naawuni.
en: Then the four living creatures said, Amen, and the elders fell down and worshipped.

dag: ka Zabad daa nyɛ Ɛfilal ba, ka Ɛfilal nyɛ Obɛd ba.
en: Zabad was the father of Ephlal, Ephlal was the father of Obed.

dag: Di saha ka Sanbalat mini Gɛshɛm daa tim na ti yɛli ma ni n chirigim ba tiŋkpan shɛli din be Ono Bɔpiɛligu ni la. Amaa bɛ daa lomi ni bɛ niŋ ma zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: So Sanballat and Geshem sent me a message, suggesting that I meet with them in one of the villages in the Plain of Ono. This was a trick of theirs to try to harm me.

dag: M mabiyurisi, di chɛliya ka binshɛli yɔhim ya.
en: Dont be misled, my dear brothers and sisters.

dag: Ŋunkam fiɣisir o ʒiʒiinikpee ashilɔni, n ni ku dilana. Ŋunkam nyuri bara ka mali karimbaani; m mini dilana ku kpe.
en: I will destroy anyone who secretly tells lies about a neighbor. I cant stomach anyone who has proud eyes or an arrogant heart.

dag: Saha shɛli Izraɛlnim ni daa do Giligal bɔpiɛligu ni Jɛriko maa, ka bɛ daa puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu di goli maa biɛɣ pinaanahi dali zaawuni.
en: Israel continued to camp at Gilgal in the desert near Jericho, and on the fourteenth day of the same month, they celebrated Passover.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa zo Izraɛlnim nambɔɣu ka niŋ ba nirilim; ka sɔŋ ba; o ni daa lo Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu alikauli shɛl la zuɣu ka o daa bi chɛ ka bɛ zaa kpi. O mi daa bi zaɣisi ba hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: But the Lord was kind to the Israelites. He had mercy and showed his care for them because of his agreement with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. He did not want them to be destroyed. He has never completely left them.

dag: Ka Sool daa bɔh o tumtumda maa, Ti yi chaŋ bɔ ka ti lee yɛn ti o? Dama ti lan ka bindirigu ti koligu ŋɔ ni bee bɔ ka ti lee mali? Ti ka pin shɛli din ni ti Naawuni nir maa.
en: Saul said to his young boy, But if we go, what should we bring to the man? The food in our bags is all gone. We dont have any gift to offer the man of God. Do we have anything.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ŋmani Ayuba n-nyuri ansarisi malibo kaman kom la?.
en: Would anyone but Job say such things? He has more thirst for insulting God than for water.

dag: N ni yɛli sarikanima, N tin ya yolisim! Ka yɛli bɛn be zibisim ni, Kamiya neesim ni na! Bɛ ni ti ŋmanila piɛ shɛb bɛn be zoya zuɣu tiŋgban nɛl ni ŋubiri mɔri la.
en: I will say to the prisoners, Go free! and to those who are in darkness, Come out to the light! They will be like sheep that graze on the hills;.

dag: Ka bɛ daa deeg o mini Bashan naa Ogi bɛn daa nyɛ Amɔrinim nanim ayi bɛn daa be Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo maa tiŋgbɔna ʒini.
en: They took possession of his land and the land of Og, Bashans king—the two Amorite kings across the Jordan River to the east.

dag: ka o mi o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm zaŋ salima mini anzinfa ni daanya mali binyɛra.
en: for planning skillful designs and working them in gold, silver, and bronze;.

dag: Yidaannima, yumiya yi paɣiba, ka di yihiriya ba hal biɛɣu.
en: Husbands, love your wives and dont be harsh with them.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun yɛn shihi ba, ŋun zaŋmila kur bini mini kpan dɔɣu n-niŋ lala, ka buɣim di ba zaa nimaani.
en: If someone touches them, it hurts like a spear made of wood and iron. Yes, evil people are like thorns. They will be thrown into the fire, and they will be completely burned.

dag: Di yɛn nyɛla Aduna min o bidibisi maa dihili ʒiɛmani kam ni. Ka Izraɛlnim yi mali suhudoo sara maligu ti Yawɛ, di simdi ni bɛ yihi li ti ba.
en: The Israelites will always give Aaron and his sons these parts. These parts will always belong to the priests when the Israelites make an offering to the Lord . When they give these parts to the priest, it will be the same as giving them to the Lord.

dag: Bɛ kul yɛla bɛ noya jɛndi ma, ka yɛra, Iin, Iin, ti nini nya li.
en: They accuse me, shouting, We saw what you did.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa yiɣisi lu Filistianim maa zuɣu n-ku ba hal ka o nuu ti ja ka o kɔŋ o takɔbi o nuu ni yihibu. Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ di nasara pam dindali maa. Ka niriba maa daa labina ti dol o nyaaŋa yihir o ni daa ku shɛb maa bidibbina.
en: but Eleazar stood and fought the Philistines until his hand became so tired that it cramped around his sword handle. The Lord won a great victory that day. The people of Israel came back, but only to take things from the dead.

dag: Zuliya shɛli na mi n-taɣi bɛ wuna, hal bɛ ni kul pa Naawuni maa zaa? Amaa n niriba bɛn zaŋla binshɛli din ka nyɔri taɣi bɛ jilima.
en: No other nation has ever changed its gods, even though they were not real. But my people have exchanged me, the God who has brought them honor, for gods that can do nothing for them.

dag: Ka alizin biɛɣu maa daa luhi doo maa, ka kuhi pam ka naanyi chaŋ ka chɛ o.
en: The unclean spirit shook him and screamed, then it came out.

dag: Dama o luhi niriba pam n-ti ba dansi. Ka o ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb ka tariga.
en: Such a woman has caused the downfall and destruction of a lot of men.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ tarimba ŋɔ, kamiya kpe na. O yɛri bɛn ka yɛm.
en: Whoever is naive turn aside here, she says to those who lack sense.

dag: O daa tum tuumbiɛri Yawɛ sani kaman Ɛhab daŋ niriba ni daa niŋ shɛm la, dama o ba kum nyaaŋa, bɛna n-daa nyɛ o saawaranim bɛn luh o.
en: He sinned against the Lord , because after his father's death other members of King Ahab's family became his advisers, and they led to his downfall.

dag: Yinim bɛn ʒiri Yawɛ jɛmbu duu lahi la, miriya ka yi shihi binshɛŋa din nyɛ daɣiri. Malimiya yimaŋ be kasi. Yimiya Babilɔn chaŋ.
en: So leave Babylon! Leave that place! Priests, you carry the things that belong to the Lord . So make yourselves pure. Dont touch anything that is not pure.

dag: ka yɛli Musa, Amaŋmaŋ tɔɣisim ti yɛtɔɣa ka ti wumda, amaa di lan chɛ ka Naawuni tɔɣisi ti yɛtɔɣa, di yi nyɛ lala ti ni kpi.
en: and said to Moses, If you speak to us, we will listen. But don't let God speak to us, or we will die.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn kul maani ma ninʒeensi ansarisi ka bi chɛra, ka dimdi bɛ nyina niŋdi ma.
en: They ridiculed me over and over again, like godless people would do, grinding their teeth at me.

dag: Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam deei n tumo deela mani, ka ŋunkam mi deei ma deela ŋun tim ma na.
en: I assure you that whoever receives someone I send receives me, and whoever receives me receives the one who sent me.

dag: Yisa ni daa ka o nyaandoliba maa sanna saha shɛli maa o nyaandoliba pinaayi la ni yino ŋun daa nyɛ jaa, ka o yuli booni Tomas la daa ka o tab maa sani.
en: One of the twelve disciples, Thomas , was not with them when Jesus came.

dag: Bɛ ni boli ninvuɣ shɛb yuya ŋɔ maa nyɛla bɛn daa yi Juda Naa Hɛzɛkia saha la n-chaŋ ti nyo ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa be nimaani ya buɣim n-kari ba bahi, ka ʒini nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ, dama mɔri daa be nimaani viɛnyɛla ka bɛ biŋkɔbiri ŋubira.
en: but when Hezekiah was king of Judah, the descendants of Simeon attacked and forced the Hamites and Meunites off the land, then settled there.

dag: Ka ti zaa kul nyari anfaani din galisi n-yir o kɔbili ni na pari taba.
en: Because of all that the Son is, we have been given one blessing after another.

dag: Amaa a yi zɔri dabiɛm ni a chaŋ, nyin zaŋm a tumtumda Pura pah amaŋ zuɣu chaŋ.
en: But if youre afraid to attack, go down to the camp with your servant Purah.

dag: Di saha maa tinzun tɔbbihi bɛn zaa kana ti liri tin shɛli din nyɛ Naawuni sara maligu bimbin la mini bɛ bidibbina ni bɛ tɔbutuhiri nɛma ni bɛ binshɛɣukam zaa ni ti yiɣi ka firi kaman zahindi la bee nir ni nya binshɛli ʒii yuŋ shɛm la.
en: Every brutal nation that attacks Jerusalem and makes it suffer will disappear like a dream when night is over.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yi daboli maa zuɣu kuli yiŋa, ka bɛ daa zaŋ bindoo n-du pii zuɣu ti yɛrigi sɔŋ Sool, ka o daa dɔni nimaani gbihi.
en: When they went down from the place of worship to the town, they fixed up a bed for Saul on the roof.

dag: Na so ŋun ka tɛhi zilima nyɛla putɔɣulana ŋun niŋdi niriba fitiina, amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun je zalinsi bini ni mali nyɛvili wɔɣinli.
en: A prince without understanding is a cruel oppressor, but one who hates unjust gain will live long.

dag: Dama wulimpuhili zaŋ hal ni wulinluhili, n yuli nyɛla din tibisa zuliya kam sani, ka bɛ kul tuɣindi tulaale zim ka maani sara din be kasi tiri ma luɣilikam, dama n yuli nyɛla din tibisa zuliya kam sani. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: From dawn until dusk my name is praised by every nation on this earth, as they burn incense and offer the proper sacrifices to me.

dag: Ka o yiŋlan maa yɛl o, Nyin bi biɛ vinnyaɣilan ŋɔ! A mi ni n dirila n ni bi di binshɛli wahala, ka kpuɣiri n ni bi di atam shɛli wahala bebɔ?.
en: His master replied, You evil and lazy servant! You knew that I harvest grain where I havent sown and that I gather crops where I havent spread seed?.

dag: Ŋunkam kahindi nini nyɛla ŋun lo zaɣ biɛɣu, ka ŋun dimd o naŋgbampiba nyɛ tuumbiɛtumda.
en: Watch out for people who grin and wink at you; they have thought of something evil.

dag: Chɛ ka a tuma yi zahira a daba sani; ka chɛ ka a jilima ŋɔ yi zahira bɛ bihi sani.
en: Let us, your servants, see your mighty deeds; let our descendants see your glorious might.

dag: O daa lan zali sariakaritiba bɛ ni daa me goondahi gili Juda tiŋgban ni fɔntin shɛŋa la zaa yiniyini ni.
en: Jehoshaphat went from town to town and appointed judges in each of the fortresses of Judah.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun mali ti shili gu dimbɔŋɔ, ka zaŋ o Shia Kasi niŋ ti ni ni o chɛ ka ti baŋ ti ni ti yɛn nya shɛl la.
en: God is the one who has prepared us for this change, and he gave us his Spirit as the guarantee of all that he has in store for us.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba yaha, Suhimiya! Naawuni ni tin ya. Bomiya! Yi ni nya. Niŋmiya gaafara! Yi ni nya soli kpe.
en: Ask, and you will receive; seek, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened to you.

dag: Ka di tiŋgbɔŋ maa salima viɛl pam; ka tulaale tihi mini kuɣ viɛla gba be nimaani.
en: Pure gold is found there and also rare perfume and precious stones.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, dabisili kanna ka n ni ti darigi Babilɔn binnana tibili. N ni ti dihi di tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa vi. Bɛ ni ti yɛn ku di ninvuɣ shɛb zaa ni ti lula di puuni.
en: The time will surely come when I will punish the false gods of Babylon, and the whole land of Babylon will be put to shame. There will be many dead people, lying in the streets of that city.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, O yi nyɛ alahichilana bee o pa alahichilana n ku tooi baŋ. Bin yini kɔŋko ka n naɣ mi: N daa nyɛla zoma, amaa pumpɔŋɔ n neeya.
en: The man answered, I dont know if he is a sinner. But I do know this: I was blind, and now I can see.

dag: Amaa a yi saɣisi wuntizɔriba ni bɛ di tum alahichi, ka bɛ bi tum alahichi maa, bɛ shiri ni be bɛ ni deei saɣisigu maa zuɣu, ka a mi tiligi a nyɛvili.
en: But if you do warn the righteous not to sin, and they dont sin, they will be declared righteous. Their lives will be preserved because they heeded the warning, and you will save your life.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya ni zim maa ku naai di duɣu ni, ka kpam la gba ku naai di ŋman ni hal ti paai dahin shɛli ŋun Yawɛ ni yɛn chɛ ka saa mi.
en: The Lord , the God of Israel, says, That jar of flour will never be empty and the jug will always have oil in it. This will continue until the day the Lord sends rain to the land.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa suhi alibarika niŋ Kalɛb ni; ka zaŋ Hiburɔn ti ŋun Kalɛb ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛfune bia la ni o su li.
en: Joshua blessed Caleb son of Jephunneh. Joshua gave him the city of Hebron as his own.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o kpamba daa yɛl o, N dan naa, chɛ ka ti bo paɣisarili na nti chɛ ka o be a sani gbib a, ka doon a sani, ka di chɛ ka nyini n dan naa ni tula.
en: So his officials said to him, Your Majesty, let us find a young woman to stay with you and take care of you. She will lie close to you and keep you warm.

dag: Ŋuna ŋun me o dufahira zali zuɣusaa, ka zali di tanzahi dunia ni ŋɔ; ŋuna n-zaŋdi teeku kom n-kpaari li bahiri tiŋgban ni na. O yuli m-booni Yawɛ.
en: He built his palace in the heavens and let its foundations rest on the earth. He scoops up the ocean and empties it on the earth. His name is the Lord .

dag: Di saha n ni ti yihi n nuu maa ka chɛ ka a nya n nyaaŋa polo. Amaa n ninni din bi nyara.
en: Then Ill take away my hand, and you will see my back, but my face wont be visible.

dag: Ka bɛ bihi pirigili daa tɔɣisirila Ashidɔdnim yɛtɔɣa ka ku tooi tɔɣisi Judanim yɛtɔɣa, amaa ka daa naɣ tɔɣisirila zuliya balibu pam yɛtɔɣa.
en: Half of their children spoke the language of Ashdod or some other language and didn't know how to speak our language.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa dɔɣi Anabi Musa, ka o daa viɛli pam ka Naawuni nini tiɣ o, ka o ba min o ma daa mal o duu hal ti paai chira ata.
en: It was at this time that Moses was born, a very beautiful child. He was cared for at home for three months.

dag: Maligumaana maa ni zaŋ ʒim maa shɛli n-ʒe ninvuɣ so ŋun yɛn yi daɣiri ni maa nudirigu tibinyaɣili min o nudirigu nubililɔɣu zuɣu ni o nudirigu napombililɔɣu zuɣu.
en: The priest shall take some of the blood of the lamb and put it on the lobe of the right ear, on the thumb of the right hand, and on the big toe of the right foot of the one of you to be declared ritually clean.

dag: Ka Lazarɔs ŋun daa kpi maa shiri yina. Ka kahiŋga pɔb o n-lo o nuhi min o naba, ka bantabiga vil o zuɣu tabil o ninni. Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Yihimiya kahiŋga maa, ka viligi bantabiga maa, ka chɛ ka o chaŋ.
en: He came out, his hands and feet wrapped in grave cloths, and with a cloth around his face. Untie him, Jesus told them, and let him go.

dag: Ka Judanim bɛn kpalim be Ijipti maa so ti ku zo n-tiligi bee n-gali bee nti lan labi Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni yaha. Hal bɛ ni daa kul bɔri ni bɛ lab ti be nimaani ka di yuui maa zaa yoli, bɛ ku labi, naɣila kuŋkɔɣinzɔriba shɛba n-ni labi.
en: From the few remaining in Judah, no fugitive or survivor who came to live here in the land of Egypt will be able to return to the land of Judah. Even though they want to return and live there, they wont be able to return, except for some fugitives.

dag: ka Annas mini Kaiafas mi daa nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulaannima. Di saha maa ka Naawuni zilinli daa ti paai Zakaria bia Jɔn ŋun daa be mɔɣu ni la.
en: Annas and Caiaphas were the high priests. During this time, John, the son of Zechariah, was living in the desert, and he received a message from God.

dag: Nyamiya, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa tin ya. Chamiya ti deei li su kaman Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛm la. Di zɔriya dabiɛm bee n-chɛ ka yi suhuri zɔhira.
en: Look! The LORD your God has laid out the land before you. Go up and take it, just as the LORD, your ancestors God, has promised you. Dont be afraid! Dont be frightened!.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti Ijiptinim daŋ pam, ka lan tib ba. Bɛ ni ti lab Yawɛ sanna, ka o deei bɛ suhigu ka tib ba.
en: The Lord will punish the Egyptians, but then he will heal them, and they will come back to him. The Lord will listen to their prayers and heal them.

dag: Yawɛ, so kani ŋ-ŋman a. A galisiya, ka a yuli tibisa, ka mali yiko.
en: Our Lord , great and powerful, you alone are God.

dag: Ka o daa yɛl o, Pom n nini ŋɔ ni; ka Yisifu daa shiri po. Di saha ka Izraɛl daa zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa o bindoo zuɣusaa polo.
en: Will you give me your word? Jacob asked. Yes, I will, Joseph promised. After this, Jacob bowed down and prayed at the head of his bed.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Libina maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Risa.
en: They left Libnah and camped at Rissah.

dag: A ninvuɣ biɛtali maa nyɛla din muɣisir a ninsal taba, ka a wuntitali nyɛ din sɔŋd a ninsal taba.
en: Your evil affects others like you, and your righteousness affects fellow human beings.

dag: Yisa min o nyaandoliba ni daa ʒiya diri bindirigu maa ka o zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro n-niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka ŋmahiŋmahi li n-zaŋ ti ba ka yɛli, N niŋgbuŋ m-bala; zaŋmiya li ŋubi.
en: While they were eating, Jesus took some bread and thanked God for it. He broke off some pieces, gave them to his followers and said, Take this bread and eat it. It is my body.

dag: ka yɛli Jɛrɔbɔam, Piim di ni zaɣ tolima pia, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Nyama, n dari tɔhila Izraɛl nam Sulemaana nuu ni.
en: Then he said to Jeroboam, Take ten pieces of this coat for yourself because the Lord , the God of Israel, says: I will tear the kingdom away from Solomon, and I will give you ten of the tribes.

dag: M mi yi wahala dibu ni yi fara yɛla, amaa yinima n-lee nyɛ azichinima. Ka lan mi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ biɛri n-jɛndiri ya, ka yɛri ni bɛ nyɛla Yɛhudianim la gba yɛla. Bɛ pala Yɛhudianima, amaa bɛ nyɛla Sintani jɛmdiba.
en: I know your troubles; I know that you are poor—but really you are rich! I know the evil things said against you by those who claim to be Jews but are not; they are a group that belongs to Satan!.

dag: A yi nyɛ yɛndana, nyini n-yɛn di a yɛm maa nyɔri, a mi yi maani ansarisi, a kɔŋko n-yɛn di wahala.
en: You are the one who will profit if you have wisdom, and if you reject it, you are the one who will suffer.

dag: N zaŋ n kayeeni ŋmani n-yɛli ya tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ dunɔdaya ni. N chɛ ka bɛ kɔŋ bɛ niriba. M bahi n niriba maa yoli. Bɛ ni bi chɛ tuumbiɛri tumbu zuɣu.
en: I will separate the people of Judah with my pitchfork. I will scatter them at the city gates of the land. My people have not changed, so I will destroy them. I will take away their children.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa boli Musa mini Aduna ti yɛli ba, Pumpɔŋɔ n tum taali; Yawɛ mali yɛlimaŋli, m mini n niriba ŋɔ galimya.
en: Then Pharaoh sent for Moses and Aaron and said to them, This time Ive sinned. The LORD is right, and I and my people are wrong.

dag: Ka wuntizɔriba daa nya li ka bɛ suhuri paligi, amaa ka ninvuɣ biɛri daa fo bɛ noya.
en: You will see this because you obey the Lord , but everyone who is wicked will be silenced.

dag: Ti wumya ni ti ni shɛb daa ka yi sanna nti mali yɛl shɛŋa doli ya ni yi niŋ, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi suhuri bi doya, amaa pa tinima n-wuhi ba lala maa.
en: We have heard that some men have come to you from our group. What they said troubled and upset you. But we did not tell them to do this.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛl o ni daa chɛ ka bɛ gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb zaa Jɛrusalɛm kuli Babilɔn la shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: The Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, says to all those people whom he allowed Nebuchadnezzar to take away as prisoners from Jerusalem to Babylonia:.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛl o, Di lan yɛli shɛli zaŋ chaŋ amaŋmaŋ polo yaha. M pun zali ni a mini Ziba pirigim tiŋgbani maa ti taba.
en: You dont need to talk any more about this, the king said to him. I order you and Ziba to divide the property.

dag: Bɛ biɛhi daa kul tuhimi, ka bɛ naba puuni be kaman naɣibila napɔŋ puuni la, ka nyaɣisira kaman daanya shɛli bɛ ni nyahi ka di nyaɣisir la.
en: Their legs were straight. Their feet looked like calves feet, and they sparkled like polished brass.

dag: Lɛvi zuliya ni maligumaaniba bɛn daa deeri zaka niriba san la daa nyɛla bɛn kpira, amaa Mɛlikizɛdɛk ŋun gba daa deeri zaka la, ŋun daa nyɛla ŋun kul be nyɛvili ni kaman Naawuni Kundi ni wuhi shɛm.
en: Priests are given a tenth of what people earn. But all priests die, except Melchizedek, and the Scriptures teach that he is alive.

dag: Ka paɣitali dɔro ni daa mali paɣ so yuun pinaayi, ka o daa saɣim o ni mali shɛlikam timanim sani ka sokam tib o je la.
en: In the crowd was a woman who had been bleeding for twelve years. She had spent everything she had on doctors, but none of them could make her well.

dag: N ni darigi yi bihi tibili, ka zaŋ yi sara biŋkɔbiri bindi ʒe yi nina ni, ka kari ya n sani.
en: I will punish your descendants and rub your faces in the manure from your animal sacrifices, and then be done with you.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, niŋmiya ania n-lihi ma, dama m bi yɛn ŋmanya ʒiri yi ninni.
en: Look me straight in the eye; I won't lie to you.

dag: Bɛ yɛra, Ti noya ni yɛtɔɣa ka ti mali nyari ti ni bɔri shɛlikam. Ti noya maa mi kul be ti sani, ka ŋuni n-leei nyɛ ti duuma.
en: Those people think they can win any argument. They say, We are so good with words, no one will be our master.

dag: Ka o biɛyanim maa bɔh o, A shiri nyɛla ŋun ti yɛn nyɛ ti naa? Bee a shiri nyɛla ŋun ti yɛn su ti fukumsi? Dinzuɣu ka bɛ jɛlinsi zaŋ chaŋ o sani daa maan pahi, o ni daa zahim zahin shɛŋa maa min o yɛtɔɣa maa zuɣu.
en: His brothers said, Do you think this means that you will be a king and rule over us? His brothers hated Joseph more now because of the dreams he had about them.

dag: Ka bia maa yɛl o, A tizɔbil la n-kuna, ka a ba chɛ ka ti kɔrigi naɣila kpabili, o ni labina ni alaafee maa zuɣu.
en: The servant answered, Your brother has come home safe and sound, and your father ordered us to kill the best calf.

dag: Amaa nyini n-daa yihi ma m ma pul ni na; nyini n-daa chɛ ka m mɔɣi m ma bihim baai.
en: You, Lord , brought me safely through birth, and you protected me when I was a baby at my mother's breast.

dag: Zaɣ biɛɣu kul ku paai wuntizɔriba, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri kul bela yɛla ni sahakam.
en: Good people never have trouble, but troublemakers have more than enough.

dag: Ka Hiburɔn daa leei Jɛfune ŋun daa nyɛ Kɛnizi nir la bia Kalɛb ni su shɛli hal ni zuŋɔ, o ni daa ʒe Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni yim la zuɣu.
en: So Hebron still belongs to Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite as a legacy today. This was because he remained loyal to the LORD God of Israel.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Yi pun wum ka di sab yɛli kurimbuni ha, Miri ka a ku ninsala, ka ŋunkam ku ninsala ni ti be yɛla ni saria karibu shee.
en: You know our ancestors were told, Do not murder and A murderer must be brought to trial.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛl kpamba daa darigi chɛhi bɛ binyɛra, ka teei dɔni n-zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tiŋa Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa tooni, ka kɔri taŋkpaɣu puɣi bɛ zuɣuri n-doya ni suhugarigu hal ni zaawuni.
en: Joshua and the leaders of Israel tore their clothes in grief, threw themselves to the ground before the Lord 's Covenant Box, and lay there till evening, with dust on their heads to show their sorrow.

dag: Yila pia shɛŋa a ni daa nya la mi nyɛla nanim pia bɛn na bi di nam, amaa bɛ ni ti ti ba yiko ka bɛ di nam pahi biŋkɔbigu la zuɣu awa yini.
en: The ten horns that you saw are ten kings, who havent yet received royal power. But they will receive royal authority for an hour, along with the beast.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Musa daa zali maligumaana Ɛliɛza mini Nan bia Jɔshua ni Izraɛlnim zuliya dunoli kam dɔɣirikpamba zaligu zaŋ chaŋ bɛ polo.
en: Moses made demands for them to Eleazar the priest, to Joshua, Nuns son, and to the leaders of the households of the Israelite tribes.

dag: Yisa ni daa niŋ li Vuhim Dabisili dali maa zuɣu daa chɛ ka Yɛhudianim maa muɣisi Yisa pam.
en: They started making a lot of trouble for Jesus because he did things like this on the Sabbath.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli, Di karitiy o; dama so kani ŋun ni tooi zaŋ n yuli tum alahiziba tuma ka dii lan ŋmaligi galim ma.
en: Jesus said, Dont stop him. Whoever uses my name to do powerful things will not soon say bad things about me.

dag: Yisa ni daa mali ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba ka o sanna o ni daa wuhiri niriba saha shɛli ti bɔh o, Ŋun yiko ni ka a lee tumdi dimbɔŋɔnima bee ŋuni n-lee ti a di yiko maa.
en: When Jesus entered the temple, the chief priests and elders of the people came to him as he was teaching. They asked, What kind of authority do you have for doing these things? Who gave you this authority.

dag: O fa n jilima, ka piligi n nam zuɣupiligu.
en: He took away my honor. He took the crown from my head.

dag: N ni daa zaŋ dabu gbaŋ maa ti Nɛria bia Baruk maa nyaaŋa, ka n daa suhi Yawɛ yɛra.
en: Then I prayed:.

dag: Dama Naawuni daa bi tim o Bia maa dunia ŋɔ ni na ni o ti karila dunianim saria, amaa ni dunianim lee ti tiligi o zuɣu.
en: For God did not send his Son into the world to be its judge, but to be its savior.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa chaŋ Gomna Pailɛt sani nti suh o soli ni o chɛ ka o zaŋ Yisa ti sɔɣi.
en: He went to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus.

dag: Di chɛliya ka Kɔhat daŋ niriba la ti kpi Lɛvinim ni.
en: Do not let the clan of Kohath.

dag: Zahima pam zahimbu mini yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ ka buchi, amaa zomiyala Naawuni.
en: Remember: When dreams multiply, so do pointless thoughts and excessive speech. Therefore, fear God.

dag: A ʒiɛyimtali kul ni be ʒiɛmani kam ni. Nyini n-daa nam dunia ŋɔ, ka di mi kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Your faithfulness endures through all the ages; you have set the earth in place, and it remains.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa lan yɛli, Mani ŋun nyɛ taŋkpaɣu ni tampiligim ŋɔ niŋ suhukpeeni tɔɣisiri n Duuma yɛtɔɣa.
en: Abraham responded, Since Ive already decided to speak with my Lord, even though Im just soil and ash.

dag: Ŋuna ka n ti yɛn nya ka o baɣi ma, ka n nina ti nya o, ka pa ni so yaha. N suhu kul yɛla di zuɣu.
en: Yes, I will see him for myself, and I long for that moment.

dag: Di lan simdi ka yi ti booi kpam maa bahi tahili la mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛli zuɣu, ka di leei din be kasi.
en: and with the bowl and its stand.

dag: Ka Judanim maa daa nya ka tɔb maa be n-gili ba tooni ni nyaaŋa zaa, ka bɛ suhi Yawɛ ka maligumaaniba daa piɛbi bɛ kikahi.
en: When Judah looked around and suddenly realized that they were surrounded, they cried out to the LORD while the priests sounded the trumpets.

dag: N tizɔpaɣa ni n daamiliya, a yurilim kpe ma nyaɣisim pam. M bɔr a yurilim gari wain. A tulaale nyom viɛl gari tulaale kam nyom.
en: Your love is sweeter than wine; the smell of your perfume is more fragrant than spices.

dag: ka di chɛ ka yi tooi pii din tuhi gari shɛlikam, ka chɛ ka yi yi daɣiri tuma zaa mini galimi ni Masia labbuna dabisili la dali.
en: so that you will be able to choose what is best. Then you will be free from all impurity and blame on the Day of Christ.

dag: Ka sokam zaa daa dii kab dol o m-piɛbiri yuhi, ka mali suhupiɛlli pam, ka tiŋgbani sɔhigi bɛ vuri yɔbu zuɣu.
en: Then they all followed him back, shouting for joy and playing flutes, making enough noise to shake the ground.

dag: Di ŋubiya li, ka binshɛɣukam ti niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani ni yi bihi sani yi kalinsi nyaaŋa, yi ni tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani zuɣu.
en: You must not consume any of it so that things go well for you and for your children later because you did what was right in the LORDs eyes.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan fa Amalɛknim maa ni daa ŋme n-di binshɛŋa maa zaa, ka lan fa o paɣiba ayi la gba.
en: David rescued everything that the Amalekites had taken, including his own two wives.

dag: N daa lihi dunia ni n-nya ka di bahila yoli, ka binshɛli lan ka di ni, ka n lihi zuɣusaa, ka neesim kani.
en: After this, I looked around. The earth was barren, with no form of life. The sun, moon, and stars had disappeared.

dag: Ka Manaasa zuliya maa niriba kalinli daa yiɣisi ninvuɣ tuhi pihitanaayi ni kɔbisiyi.
en: Those enlisted from the tribe of Manasseh were .

dag: Ka ŋunkam yur o mabia nyɛla ŋun be neesim ni, ka shɛli ka di ni din ni chɛ ka so tuui.
en: The person loving a brother and sister stays in the light, and there is nothing in the light that causes a person to stumble.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ni Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni chɛ ka di shiri niŋ kaman o ni zal li shɛm dunia ŋɔ zaa ni.
en: Yes, destruction has been announced; the LORD God of heavenly forces will carry it out against the entire land.

dag: Amaa kul ʒiɛnya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yim kaman yi ni pun niŋdi shɛm hal ni zuŋɔ la.
en: Hold on to the LORD your God instead, exactly as youve done right up to today.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ koli binshɛɣukam gari kaman pɔhim la. Bɛ birigiya ka leei bɛn mali taali, bɛmaŋmaŋ yaa n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: Then they sweep on like the wind and are gone, these men whose power is their god.

dag: Juda Naa Amazia Jɔash bia la ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pinaanu saha ka Izraɛl Naa Jɛhɔash bia Naa Jɛrɔbɔam daa di Izraɛl nam Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuun pihinahi ni yini.
en: King Jeroboam son of Jehoash of Israel began to rule in Samaria during the th year that Amaziah son of Joash was king of Judah. Jeroboam ruled years.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Musa, Ti chaŋ a ni daa tim ti tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa ni, ka di tiŋgbani maa vuhira, di tiwala mi m-bɔŋɔ.
en: and said: Look at this fruit! The land we explored is rich with milk and honey.

dag: n-wuhiri Naawuni ni daa ti Yisa Nazarɛt nira Shia Kasi yiko ka o gindi tumdi tuun suma, ka chɛ ka Sintani ni daa nahindi ninvuɣ shɛb zaa kpaŋdi shɛm, dama Naawuni daa be o sani.
en: You know about Jesus of Nazareth and how God poured out on him the Holy Spirit and power. He went everywhere, doing good and healing all who were under the power of the Devil, for God was with him.

dag: dama dimbɔŋɔnim zuɣu ka dunia ŋɔ ni zuliya kam zaa kul jiɣindi sahakam; amaa yi Ba Naawuni mi ni di zaa ha simdi ya.
en: All the nations of the world long for these things. Your Father knows that you need them.

dag: Dama Izraɛlnim mini Judanim nyɛla bɛn bi ʒe ma yim baabiɛla. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The people of Israel and Judah have been utterly faithless to me, declares the LORD.

dag: N yi tɛhi ni n yiŋ nyɛla kpiimba biɛhigu shee, ka n yi zaŋ m bindoo yɛrigi zibisim ni.
en: If I hope for the underworld as my dwelling, lay out my bed in darkness.

dag: N yi tɛhi Naawuni yɛla, n kul ŋuhirimi, ka n yi kul zaŋ n suhu sɔŋ tiŋ suhir o, gbariginsim nti kpɛri n ni.
en: When I think of God, I sigh; when I meditate, I feel discouraged.

dag: Ka paɣa maa yi ti tuui dɔɣi bidibiga, bɛn zaŋm o mabi so ŋun kpi maa yuli boli bia maa din ni chɛ ka o yuli maa ku kpihim Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: The brother-in-law will name the oldest male son that she bears after his dead brother so that his brothers legacy will not be forgotten in Israel.

dag: N ni zaŋ alikama zaɣ suma dihi ya, ka zaŋ tampiŋ ni shiri tin ya ka yi di n-tiɣi.
en: But I would feed you with the finest bread and with the best honey until you were full.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ti ku mali ninvuɣ so ŋun ni pihi kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya yi tintariga bɔbili ni nyɛ shɛli Yawɛ niriba sunsuuni.
en: So we will not be able to measure the land and divide it among the Lord s people.

dag: ni salima alali firilatamdigu la mini di zuɣu firilanim din pie tab la ni di nɛma zaa ni firila kpam.
en: They showed him the pure gold lampstand and the lamps on it, the oil, and all the other things that were used with the lamps.

dag: Bɛ yi dɔɣi bihi pam takɔbi n-yɛn ku bɛ zaa, ka bɛ bihi ka bindirigu din ni di n-tiɣi.
en: If their children increase, they belong to the sword; their offspring wont have enough bread.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Mɔabnim polo m-bala.
en: The Lord has already said all of this about Moab.

dag: Bɛ nahindila paɣ so ŋun bi dɔɣi bihi, ka bi niŋdi pakoli zaɣi viɛlli.
en: That happens because they mistreated widows and showed no kindness to childless women.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Itam maa ŋ-ŋmaligi labi Pihahirɔt din be Baalizɛfɔn wulimpuhili polo la nti dɔni miri Migidol.
en: They left Etham and went to Pi Hahiroth. This was near Baal Zephon. They camped near Migdol.

dag: O ni nya dansi, ka kɔŋ jilima, ka o filiŋ maa ku lan naai;.
en: He is wounded and disgraced. His shame will never be wiped away.

dag: dama n sani, di bi tuhi ni n chɛ ka bɛ tahi dansarika so Naa Siiza sani ka m bi sabi wuhi o taali ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: It makes no sense to send a prisoner to the Emperor without stating the charges against him.

dag: Ka tuun shɛŋa Baasha ni daa tum pahi min o ni daa pun tum tuun shɛŋa ni o kpiɔŋ yɛla, bɛ sab li niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi ni.
en: Everything else that Baasha did and all his brave deeds are recorded in The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Naawuni, deemi n suhigu; wummi n nol ni yɛtɔɣa.
en: God, listen to my prayer. Listen to what I say.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yihi ti dabitim ni labisi Ziɔn na, di daa ŋmanila zahindi ka ti zahinda.
en: When the Lord brought us back to Jerusalem, it was like a dream!.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka tiŋ maa niriba zaŋ suhi din mali nyina mini kuriti kuya ni kuriti lɛri n-tumd o tuma, ka ŋmar o bilichiisi; lala ka o daa niŋ Ammɔnnim tinsi maa zaa. Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda min o niriba maa zaa daa lab Jɛrusalɛm.
en: and put its people to work with saws, iron hoes, and iron axes, and forced them to work at making bricks. He did the same to the people of all the other towns of Ammon. Then he and his men returned to Jerusalem.

dag: Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga kpamba fomi ʒi tiŋgban ni. Bɛ kɔrila taŋkpaɣu puɣi bɛ zuɣuri ka so buri. Jɛrusalɛm paɣisara zaŋla bɛ zuɣuri fi tiŋa.
en: Zion's leaders are silent. They just sit on the ground, tossing dirt on their heads and wearing sackcloth. Her young women can do nothing but stare at the ground.

dag: Di simdi ni yi ti zaŋ biŋkɔbbihi bee niɣi mali Yaɣigari chuɣu sara ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ luɣ shɛli ŋun Yawɛ ni pii ni bɛ jɛmd o la.
en: Offer a Passover sacrifice from the flock or herd to the LORD your God at the location the LORD selects for his name to reside.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Naa Zɛdɛkia daa ti tim ka bɛ chaŋ ti yih o na ka o deeg o. Ka naa maa daa bɔh o ashilɔni o yiŋ maa ni, Yawɛ yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛli? Ka Jɛrimia garigi yɛli, O yɛli shɛli. Di saha ka o daa yɛli, Bɛ ni zaŋ a niŋ Babilɔn naa nuu ni.
en: Later King Zedekiah sent for him and questioned Jeremiah secretly in the palace: Is there a word from the LORD? There is, Jeremiah replied. You are going to be handed over to the king of Babylon.

dag: Chɛ ka di leei liɣa, ka zibisim titali be di ni. Chɛ ka sagbana zibigi niŋ di ni. Chɛ ka zibisim nyaŋ di neesim.
en: May deepest darkness claim it and a cloud linger over it; may all that darkens the day terrify it.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛl o, Mani m-bala, Cham ti yɛl a dana Nyama, Ilaija be kpe. .
en: Yes. Go tell Ahab I'm here.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa zaŋ niriba maa zaa yi sansani maa ni na ni bɛ ti zani Naawuni tooni, ka bɛ daa kana ti zani zoli maa gbini.
en: Moses led them out of the camp to meet God, and they stood at the foot of the mountain.

dag: Buɣa palila bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka bɛ jɛmdi bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali binshɛŋa.
en: Their land is filled with idols; they worship their handiwork, what their own fingers have made.

dag: Ka maligumaana maa ni lihi yum maa ka yɛli ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni, yum nyɛla daɣiri, dama di nyɛla niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu.
en: When the priest sees the raw flesh, he will declare the person unclean. Raw flesh is unclean; it is a case of skin disease.

dag: Ka bɛn daa wurim maa daa chani gindi luɣilikam n-yihiri Yisa lahibal suŋ waazu.
en: The Lord's followers who had been scattered went from place to place, telling the good news.

dag: Dama ti ŋmanila tulaale zim shɛli Masia ni zaŋ ti Naawuni ka di nyom gili ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tiligi la mini bɛn bɔrigi sani:.
en: We smell like the aroma of Christs offering to God, both to those who are being saved and to those who are on the road to destruction.

dag: Ka yi bihi ŋɔ mi ni leei piɛguliba mɔɣu ŋɔ ni yuun pihinahi. Bɛ ni di wahala yi ni bi ʒe yim la zuɣu hal ka yi ni ninvuɣ so ŋun bahindi nyaaŋa ti kpi n-kpalim mɔɣu ŋɔ ni.
en: Your children will wander around like shepherds here in the desert for years. They will suffer because you were not faithful to me. They must suffer until all of you lie dead in the desert.

dag: bee o bapir bee o bapir bia ni tooi yo o zuɣu ka deeg o bee o daŋ ni ninvuɣ so ŋun nyɛ o talahi nir ni tooi yo o zuɣu ka deeg o bee o yi ti nya buni o ni tooi yo ka deeg omaŋa.
en: or uncle or cousin, or some other family member. In fact, if you ever get enough money, you may buy your own freedom.

dag: Di saha o ni ti bɔhi, Bɛ wuna la lee be ya? Bɛ ni daa sɔɣi tampiŋ shɛli ni la lee be ya?.
en: Then the Lord will say, Where are the false gods? Where is the rock that you ran to for protection?.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn mini ninvuɣ kɔbisita bɛn daa be o sani maa daa kana ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du m-biɛhiri bɛ dimnim maa naba, ka di daa wum ba pam.
en: Then Gideon and his men came to the Jordan River and went across to the other side, but they were tired and hungry.

dag: Yi yi di mi ma, yi naan mi m Ba maa gba; amaa zuŋɔ zaŋ chana yi baŋ o, dama yi pun nya o.
en: If you really knew me, you would know my Father too. But now you know the Father. You have seen him.

dag: Saɣisim a bihi, ka bɛ ti a vuhim, ka ti a suhupiɛlli.
en: Instruct your children; they will give you peace of mind and bring delight into your life.

dag: Gomna Pailɛt ni daa wum lala maa ka o bɔhi ni Yisa nyɛla Galili nira?.
en: Pilate heard this and asked if Jesus was from Galilee.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka ti bi gbarigira. Hal ti niŋgbuna yi filinda, ti suhuri ni biɛhigu din kul leerila zaɣ pala biɛɣukam.
en: For this reason we never become discouraged. Even though our physical being is gradually decaying, yet our spiritual being is renewed day after day.

dag: Yawɛ, n daa bela gballi din zilim pam puuni, ka suh a.
en: I call on your name, LORD, from the depths of the pit.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun karindi anabitali yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn wumdi li ka doli din sabi litaafi ŋɔ puuni mal alibarika, dama saha maa miriya.
en: Happy is the one who reads this book, and happy are those who listen to the words of this prophetic message and obey what is written in this book! For the time is near when all these things will happen.

dag: Bɛ ku lan jɛm buɣa, bɛ mi ku lan tum tuun galima n-saɣim bɛmaŋa bee n-kpe bɛ biriginsim ni. N ni tiligi ba bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa zaa ni, ka yihi ba daɣiri ni. Di saha ka bɛ ti nyɛ n niriba, ka n gba nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: They will no longer defile themselves with their idols or their worthless things or with any of their rebellions. I will deliver them from all the places where they sinned, and I will cleanse them. They will be my people, and I will be their God.

dag: O daa chɛ ka zibisim gil o; sagban tibisa din sabigi ka kom be di ni n-nyɛ o sampaa.
en: Darkness was your robe; thunderclouds filled the sky, hiding you from sight.

dag: Dama n niriba maa tumla tuumbiɛri buyi zuɣu. Bɛ zaɣisi mani ŋun nyɛ nyɛvili kɔbilinini ŋɔ, ka gbi bɛmaŋmaŋ kɔbilisi, kɔbil kaba din ku tooi deei kom.
en: My people have done two evil things. They turned away from me, and they dug their own water cisterns. I am the source of living water; those cisterns are broken and cannot hold water.

dag: Kaman bɛ ni gbahi jɛŋgbini bihi ka o suhu yiɣisi shɛm la, lala ka n suhu ni yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu. N ni dari tɔhi ba, ka ŋub ba kaman gbuɣinli la, kaman mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ŋ-ŋub ba la.
en: I will fall upon them like a bear robbed of her cubs, and I will tear open the covering of their hearts. I will devour them like a lion, as a wild animal would eat them.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ lɔɣu din chaɣisira n-nyaɣil o, ka zaŋ kpan titali din nyaɣisira mini banchiriga n-nyaɣil o pahi.
en: a quiver of arrows flies by him, flashing spear and dagger.

dag: A jilima zuɣu daa chɛ ka karimbaani kpe a suhu ni. A jilima zuɣu daa chɛ ka a saɣim a yɛm. N daa daag a luhi tiŋa, n daa yih a palɔni nanim tooni ni bɛ lih a viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: You exalted yourself because of your beauty and corrupted your wisdom for the sake of your splendor. I will cast you down to the earth in the sight of kings, and I will make a spectacle of you.

dag: Giliad tizɔpaɣ Hamolɛkɛt n-daa dɔɣi Ishɔd mini Abiɛza ni Mahila.
en: Gilead's sister Hammolecheth was the mother of Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.

dag: Di daa nyɛla Naawuni yubu ni ŋun Naawuni biɛhigu zaa be o Bia maa ni.
en: God himself was pleased to live fully in his Son.

dag: Ka o daa be zuɣusaa ha, ka tirina gbaai ma n-voo ma yihi ko tital ni na.
en: You reached down from heaven, and you lifted me from deep in the ocean.

dag: Kpaŋsimiya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali biɛhiŋ la suhuri;.
en: Be helpful to all who may have doubts.

dag: Amaa yi yɛra, Ti Duuma ni niŋdi shɛm bi tuhi. Yinim Izraɛlnima, n ni kari yi zaa saria n-doli yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: You still say that I am not fair, but I am telling you the truth. Family of Israel, everyone will be judged for what they do.

dag: Yawɛ ni lan bol a labisina kaman paɣ so bɛ ni zaɣisi ka o mali suhugarigu la. Naawuni yɛliya, A ŋmanila paɣ so ŋun kuli dooyili o paɣisarilim ni ka bɛ ti zaɣis o.
en: Israel, you are like a young wife, deserted by her husband and deeply distressed. But the Lord calls you back to him and says:.

dag: Bɛ ni ti nya tibidarigibo, anabi maa mini ninvuɣ so ŋun bɔhi ni o baŋ maa tibidarigibo ni nyɛla yim.
en: So both the one who came for advice and the prophet who gave an answer will get the same punishment.

dag: A bi wum ni m pun lo dimbɔŋɔnim zaa nia ka di waɣa? Ka pumpɔŋɔ n chɛ ka di niŋ pali. N daa ti a yiko ka a wurim bɛ ni me goma gili tin shɛŋa, ka di leei dabari.
en: Sennacherib, now listen to me, the Lord . I planned all of this long ago. And you don't even know that I alone am the one who decided that you would do these things. I let you make ruins of fortified cities.

dag: Di bi simdi ka doo mini biŋkɔbigu dɔni bee ka paɣ zaŋ omaŋ ti biŋkɔbigu ka o min o dɔni; di nyɛla biriginsim.
en: No man or woman is to have sexual relations with an animal; that perversion makes you ritually unclean.

dag: Ti Duuma dabisili dali ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa ti pali ma, ka n wum kukol shɛli n nyaaŋa polo ka di tahiri kaman kikaa vur la.
en: On the Lord's day the Spirit took control of me, and behind me I heard a loud voice that sounded like a trumpet.

dag: So yi buɣisi ni o yɛl a yɛtɔɣ shɛli a suhu ni miligi? Amaa ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi chɛ yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu?.
en: Please be patient and listen to what I have to say. *.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun ti zo n-yi Hazaɛl takɔbi kubu ni, Jɛhu ŋun kum o; ka ŋun ti zo n-yi Jɛhu takɔbi kubu ni, Ilaisha mi ŋun kum o.
en: Anyone who escapes being put to death by Hazael will be killed by Jehu, and anyone who escapes Jehu will be killed by Elisha.

dag: dinzuɣu n ni laɣim a mamanim maa zaa, a mini bɛn diri nyaɣisim maa, a ni daa yuri shɛb zaa min a ni daa je shɛb la zaa. N ni chɛ ka bɛ zaa yi luɣilikam laɣimna ti lir a, ka m pirig a a zaɣim wuhi ba, ka bɛ nya a zaɣim zaa.
en: Therefore, I will now gather all of your lovers whom you pleased, the ones you loved and the ones you rejected. I will gather them against you from all around, and I will expose you to them. They will see it all.

dag: Bɛ dɔɣiriba kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiwɛi ni pihinunaayɔbu kaman bɛ daŋ maa ni daa nyɛ shɛm. Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa daa nyɛla bɛ daŋ ni dɔɣirikpamba kaman bɛ yaannim dunoya ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: There were families of this tribe living there. All the men named above were heads of families.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ yi ti niŋ pali, di mi nyɛla din ni niŋ pali, di saha bɛ ni baŋ ni anabi daa be bɛ ni.
en: When this comes—and it is certainly coming—they will know that a prophet has been among them.

dag: Sandaantimdiba bɛn biri bimbira ni suhudoo ni ti kpuɣila atam din nyɛ wuntia.
en: When peacemakers plant seeds of peace, they will harvest justice.

dag: Dama o shiri timla Babilɔn na ti yɛli ti, Di ni yuui pam. Mɛmiya yiya m-be di ni, ka kɔnya puri n-diri di bindira. .
en: He even wrote a letter to the people here in Babylonia, saying we would be here a long time. He told us to build homes and to plant gardens and grow our own food.

dag: Naawuni yɛliya, N ni saɣim ninvuɣ biɛri yiko, amaa n ni pahi wuntizɔriba yiko.
en: Our Lord, you will destroy the power of evil people, but you will give strength to those who are good.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ yɛlli maa niŋ bɛ suhuri ni, ka bɔhiri taba kum ni neebu maa gbinni ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: So the followers waited to say anything about what they saw. But they discussed among themselves what Jesus meant about rising from death.

dag: Ka bɛ daa baŋ li ka yiɣisi ni n-zo n-chaŋ Listra mini Dɛɛbi din be Laikɔnia tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaŋ tabili tiŋkpansi din daa gil li zaa.
en: But when the two apostles found out what was happening, they escaped to the region of Lycaonia. They preached the good news there in the towns of Lystra and Derbe and in the nearby countryside.

dag: N ni ti gbaag a pahi zuliya shɛb ni n-zaŋ a chaŋ a ni bi mi tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni, ka chɛ ka di muɣisi niriba pam.
en: Foreign nations you have never heard of will be shocked when I tell them how I destroyed you.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Izraɛl kpamba zaa daa ka naa sanna Hiburɔn, ka Dauda ti lo ba alikauli Yawɛ tooni Hiburɔn. Ka bɛ daa booi kpam bahi Dauda zuɣu ni n-zaŋ o leei Izraɛl naa kaman Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Samuɛl yɛli shɛm la.
en: So all of Israels elders came to the king at Hebron, and David made a covenant with them before the LORD. They anointed David to make him king over Israel, just as the LORD had promised through Samuel.

dag: Paɣ yi birigi n-tum daɣiri tuma saha shɛl o ni be o yidan sulinsi ni, ka o yidan maa zilis o.
en: This is the ceremony that must take place at my altar when a husband suspects that his wife has been unfaithful. The priest must tell the woman to stand in my presence and carefully follow these instructions.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ʒe Babilɔn, ka ŋunkam ti ʒe li ni tiɣi. Yawɛ n yɛli lala maa.
en: Babylon will be defeated; its attackers will carry off all that they want, declares the LORD.

dag: Chɛ ka n gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du n-chaŋ ti nya zoya ni tiŋgban viɛlli din be duli maa mini Lɛbanɔn.
en: Please let me cross over the Jordan River so I can see the wonderful land that lies beyond it: those beautiful highlands, even the Lebanon region.

dag: M mi yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm. Yi bi maha, yi mi bi tula. N di bɔri ka yi mahimi bee n-tula!.
en: I know everything you have done, and you are not cold or hot. I wish you were either one or the other.

dag: Ŋun saɣindi maa ni ti liri tiŋ kam, ka tin shɛli ti ku yi. O ni ti wurim vinvamli ni tinsi, ka saɣim bɔpiɛligu ni tinsi, kaman Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Not a town will escape the destruction; both valley and plain will be ruined. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Amaa shee o di wahala balibu kam pɔi, ka ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nim ti zaɣis o.
en: But first, the Son of Man must suffer many things. The people of today will refuse to accept him.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka n daa bahi noli ka bɛ mali duri maa ka di niŋ kasi, ka n daa labisi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni lahi mini chi ni kawana sara ni tulaale zim la niŋ di ni.
en: Then I ordered the room to be cleaned and the temple utensils, the grain offerings, and the incense to be brought back into the room.

dag: n-zaŋ o ti sɔɣi omaŋmaŋ silig pal shɛli o ni daa yoli chib tampiŋ ni la ni; ka daa bilim kuɣ titali na ti yo di noli, ka ŋmaligi kuli.
en: Then Joseph put the body in his own tomb that had been cut into solid rock and had never been used. He rolled a big stone against the entrance to the tomb and went away.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti paɣi Naawuni o ni niŋ anfaan shɛli din mali jilima niŋ ti ni yoli o Biyurigu zuɣu la.
en: God treated us with undeserved grace because of the Son he dearly loves, and so we should praise God.

dag: Amaa n ni lan chɛ ka bɛ nya tibbu mini alaafee, ka tib ba, ka kahigi tɔŋsim pam mini binshɛŋa din ni taɣi ba barina ni wuhi ba.
en: Then someday, I will heal this place and my people as well, and let them enjoy unending peace.

dag: Ka Neetan daa garigi yɛli Dauda, Niŋm a ni lo a suhu ni ni a niŋ shɛlikam zaa, dama Naawuni be a sani.
en: Nathan replied, The Lord is with you—do what you want.

dag: dama Masidɔnianim mini Akaianim yuya ni bɛ tɔhi tɔto ti Yisa nyaandoliba bɛn nyɛ nandaamba be Jɛrusalɛm la.
en: Some of them are poor, and the believers in Macedonia and Achaia wanted to help them. So they gathered some money to send them.

dag: O niriba kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahinaanu ni kɔbisiyɔbu ni pihinu.
en: His military unit and those enlisted in it are .

dag: Dindali maa kaai biɛɣ asibaasi sara maligu saha, ka kom daa yi Ɛdom polo n-zo na ti tɛli tiŋgbani zaa.
en: The next morning, while the sacrifice was being offered, water suddenly started flowing from the direction of Edom, and it flooded the land.

dag: Amaa n yɛri ya mi ni yi chɛ ka yi suhuri doya, dama yi ni so ku kɔŋ o nyɛvili, amaa naɣila ŋariŋ ŋɔ kɔŋko n-naɣ ni saɣim.
en: But now I beg you, take courage! Not one of you will lose your life; only the ship will be lost.

dag: Nir yi niŋdi nandaamba alaka ni o nya buni pahi ni ŋun tiri bundaamba pini, bɛ zaa ni leei nandaamba.
en: Cheat the poor to make profit or give gifts to the rich— either way you lose.

dag: Ka Yaakubu bidibisi maa daa yi mɔɣu ni na ti wum li ka bɛ suhu yiɣisi ka bɛ je suli; Shɛkɛm ni daa tum jɛrilim Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-zaŋ Yaakubu bipuɣiŋga saɣim maa zuɣu. Dama di daa bi simdi ni lala niŋ.
en: Just then, Jacobs sons got back from the countryside. When they heard what had happened, they were deeply offended and very angry, because Shechem had disgraced Israel by sleeping with Jacobs daughter. Such things are simply not done.

dag: Bɛ ni ti be n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti n dabili Yaakubu la ni; yi yaannim ni daa be shɛl ni la. Bɛ mini bɛ bihi ni bɛ yaansi ni ti be nimaani sahakam. Ka n dabili Dauda ti nyɛ bɛ naa sahakam.
en: They will live on the land I gave to my servant Jacob, the land where their ancestors lived. They will live there forever, and so will their children and all their descendants. A king like my servant David will rule them forever.

dag: Uzia daa lan me du wɔɣila zali Jɛrusalɛm goon gɔŋ dunɔdal la polo mini vinvamli dunɔdali ni malaika dunɔdal la polo zaa, ka mal li ka di niŋ yaa.
en: In Jerusalem, Uzziah built fortified towers at the Corner Gate, the Valley Gate, and the place where the city wall turned inward.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ, nyini n-zahindi wuntizɔriba, nyini n-nyari din be ninsal suhu ni min o tɛha ni; chɛ ka n nya a ni yɛn bɔhi ba biɛri shɛm, dama n zaŋ n yɛla maa niŋla a nuu ni.
en: The LORD of heavenly forces tests the righteous and discerns the heart and the mind. Let me see your retribution upon them, for I have committed my case to you.

dag: Tiligim ma n daalahichi zaa ni, ka di chɛ ka jɛra mali ma ansarisi.
en: Save me from the bad things I did. Dont let me be treated like a fool.

dag: Chɛ ka puri atam niŋ pam. Chɛ ka daboya zuɣu zaa zibigi bindira, ka chɛ ka di niŋ pam kaman Lɛbanɔn bindira ni niŋdi shɛm la. Chɛ ka fɔntinsi ni pali niriba kaman mɔri ni zibigi mɔɣu ni shɛm la.
en: Let cities overflow with food and hills be covered with grain, just like Mount Lebanon. Let the people in the cities prosper like wild flowers.

dag: N ku chɛ a bee n-zo a nambɔɣu, n ni darigi a tibili a tuma zuɣu saha shɛli a ni tum din chihiri shɛli ni na be a kɔbili ni maa. Di saha ka a baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will not show you any mercy or feel sorry for you. I am punishing you for the evil things you did. You have done such terrible things. Now, you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: Yiɣisim zani, dama daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka n yi a zuɣu ni n zal a ka a leei n tumo, ka niŋ a ni nya ma ni shɛlikam ŋɔ mini n ni na yɛn wuh a shɛli shɛhiralana.
en: Get up! Stand on your feet! I have appeared to you for this purpose: to appoint you as my servant and witness of what you have seen and what I will show you.

dag: Ŋun boli ya maa nyɛla ŋun ni niŋ li, dama o nyɛla ŋun ʒe yim.
en: The one who is calling you is faithful and will do this.

dag: So yi tɛhi ni o nyɛla shɛli ka pa shɛli, o yɔhindila omaŋa.
en: If you think you are something when you really are nothing, you are only deceiving yourself.

dag: Chɛ ka anabi so ŋun zahim zahindi yɛlila zahindi maa yɛtɔɣa, amaa ŋun mi mali n yɛligu ŋun tɔɣisim n yɛligu maa yɛla ni ʒiɛyimtali. Mɔri mini alikama nyɛla yim? Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Let the prophet who has a dream declare it, but let the one who has my word proclaim it faithfully. What a difference between straw and wheat! declares the LORD.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa buɣisi dunɔdali shee zɔntua, ka di nyɛ mita anahi.
en: He measured this room and found it was feet deep. It formed that end of the gateway which was nearest the Temple, and at its far end the walls were feet thick. .

dag: Ka o zaŋ naɣilaa maa yi kpaŋa bɛ biɛhigu maa shee nti nyo buɣim kaman o ni di nyo o tuuli naɣilaa la shɛm la, di nyɛla zama alahichi sanyoo sara maligu.
en: Then he shall take the bull outside the camp and burn it, just as he burns the bull offered for his own sin. This is an offering to take away the sin of the community.

dag: Nyamiya, Balaam ni daa wuhi yikombiɛlim so shɛl la ni, bɛmbɔŋɔ n-daa chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum din bie zaŋ chaŋ Yawɛ sani Pɛɔr yɛla la ni, ka alɔbo daa lu Yawɛ niriba zuɣu la.
en: These are the women who listened to Balaam and caused the men of Israel to turn away from the Lord that time at Peor. The disease will come to the Lord s people again.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli bɛ zaa, Ŋunkam bɔri ni o doli ma, ŋun zaɣisim omaŋa ka kpuɣ o dapulli buɣi doli ma dabisili kam.
en: Then Jesus said to all the people: If any of you want to be my followers, you must forget about yourself. You must take up your cross every day and follow me.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa di nam ʒin o ba Dauda nam ʒiishee, ka o nam maa daa ba n-zani viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: His son Solomon became king and took control of David's kingdom.

dag: Wuntizɔriba tahima niŋbu tahirila suhupiɛlli na, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn ku nya bɛ ni bɔri shɛli.
en: The expectations of the righteous result in joy, but the hopes of the wicked will perish.

dag: Ka o daa pir o tɔbbihi ʒii buta zuɣu n-zaŋ ba chaŋ mɔɣu maa ni ti sɔɣi do n-gu ba. Ka Abimilɛk daa ti lihi nya ba ka bɛ yi tiŋ maa ni kanna, ka o yiɣisi lu bɛ zuɣu ku ba.
en: So Abimelech separated his men into three groups. He wanted to attack the people of Shechem by surprise. So he hid his men in the fields. When he saw the people coming out of the city, he jumped up and attacked them.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Samuɛl daa kuli Rama, ka Sool gba kul o ya Gibia.
en: Then Samuel went to Ramah, but Saul went up to his home in Gibeah.

dag: O kum maa saha, o kul yɛn ŋmɛlimmi, ka o kɔba ni kpam kul maha.
en: enjoying good health.

dag: Heei! Kɔnyuri ni mali sokam, ŋun kam kom ŋɔ gbin na! Ka yinim bɛn mi ka liɣiri, kamiyana ti da bindirigu di! Kamiyana ti da wain mini bihim nyu ka di yɔnya shɛli!.
en: The Lord says, Come, everyone who is thirsty— here is water! Come, you that have no money— buy grain and eat! Come! Buy wine and milk— it will cost you nothing!.

dag: Hal Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-su zuɣusaa ni zuɣusaa mi zuɣusaa mini dunia ni binshɛɣukam din be di ni zaa;.
en: Everything belongs to the Lord your God. The heavens, even the highest heavens, belong to him. The earth and everything on it belong to him.

dag: Kaman kom ni nyuui biaŋ ni, ka kulibɔŋ kom nyuui ka di kuui shɛm la.
en: Like a lake that goes dry or a river that loses its source.

dag: Ninvuɣ Suŋ ni ŋun lan nyɛ wuntialana ka yi daa zaɣisi maa, ka daa lee chɛ ka Gomna Pailɛt yihila ŋun kuri niriba bahi.
en: He was holy and good, but you rejected him, and instead you asked Pilate to do you the favor of turning loose a murderer.

dag: Di ʒiɛmani maa ni naa daa ka Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Di saha maa ka Dan zuliya niriba daa lihiri bɔri luɣ shɛli ni bɛ ʒini, dama Izraɛlnim ni daa pirigi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti tab la, bɛ daa na bi ti ba bɛ tiŋgbani.
en: At that time the Israelites did not have a king. And the tribe of Dan was still looking for a place to live. They did not have their own land yet. The other tribes of Israel already had their land, but the tribe of Dan had not taken their land yet.

dag: Di chaŋ wula? Yi sani ka Naawuni yɛligu yina? Bee yi kɔŋko sani ka di kana?.
en: God's message did not start with you people, and you are not the only ones it has reached.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ tan piɛl viɛlli n-she zabba ka niŋ bimbomaboma niŋ di ni, ka zaŋ tan piɛl viɛlli n-she bantabiga ka she shɛlɔrigu n-zaŋ shɛriga wuɣi binyɛra pa di zuɣu.
en: Use fine linen to make the white woven robe and the turban. The cloth belt should have designs sewn into it.

dag: Amaa yi yi ti paai tin shɛlikam ka bɛ bi deei ya, yin doliya di pala yɛra.
en: But whenever you go into a town and are not welcomed, go out in the streets and say.

dag: Ka Jɔshua mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa ti yiɣisi asibaasi n-yi Akasia chaŋ Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ni nti dɔn nimaani ni bɛ gbaai li du.
en: Early the next morning, Joshua and all the Israelites got up and left Acacia. They traveled to the Jordan River and camped there before they crossed it.

dag: Di saha maa ka Naa Hɛzɛkia daa yihi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dunoya ni salima ni ŋun maŋmaŋ Juda Naa Hɛzɛkia ni daa zaŋ salima shɛli m-mali dunoya la pahi n-zaŋ ti Asiria naa maa.
en: At that time King Hezekiah had to strip down the doors and doorposts of the LORDs temple, which he had covered with gold. He gave all of it to the Assyrian king.

dag: M bɔrila suhudoo, amaa n yi yɛli shɛli, bɛ zaŋdi li mi leei zabili.
en: Im for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ bundaannim mini karimbaannim mali ti ansarisi ti yaɣi.
en: We have had enough of the hateful words of those proud people who make fun of us and show us no respect.

dag: Ka Farisii so ŋun daa boli Yisa na maa daa nya lala ka yɛli o suhu ni, Doo ŋɔ yi di nyɛla anabi, o naan baŋ paɣ ŋun shihir o ŋɔ ni nyɛ so, dama o nyɛla tuumbiɛrilana.
en: When the Pharisee who had invited Jesus saw what was happening, he said to himself, If this man were a prophet, he would know what kind of woman is touching him. He would know that she is a sinner.

dag: Ka n Duuma yɛli ma, Kul yim chaŋ, dama n yɛn tim a la katiŋ ha bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani. .
en: But Jesus said to me, Leave now. I will send you far away to the non-Jewish people.

dag: Ka Yisahaku mini Ishimail bɛn daa nyɛ o bidibisi la daa zaŋ o ti sɔɣi Makipɛla siliga din daa be Zɔhar ŋun daa nyɛ Hiti nir la bia Ɛfurɔn palo din be Mamri wulimpuhili polo la ni.
en: His sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave in Machpelah, which is in the field of Zohars son Ephron the Hittite, near Mamre.

dag: Bɛ nina kul kpala paɣiba bɛn nyɛ zinaniŋdiba, ka bɛ nina na ʒi n-tiɣi shɛli alahichi tumbu puuni. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn bariti zana ni bɛ gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi ʒe yim, ka nyɛ bɛn bɔhim baŋ diribarilim tuma yɛla. Mbusim be bɛ zuɣu!.
en: They want to look for nothing but the chance to commit adultery; their appetite for sin is never satisfied. They lead weak people into a trap. Their hearts are trained to be greedy. They are under God's curse!.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Musa, O ba yi di tuhi nintɔri vie o ninni, vi naan ku gbaag o paai daba ayopɔin? Chɛ ka bɛ yih o kpaŋ daba ayopɔin, di nyaaŋa ka yi naanyi zaŋ o labina.
en: The Lord answered Moses, If her father spit in her face, she would be shamed for seven days. So put her outside the camp for seven days. After that she can come back into the camp.

dag: N ni boli n niriba n-laɣim ba. N ni fa ba bahi, ka chɛ ka bɛ kalinli zooi kaman bɛ ni daa pun be shɛm.
en: I will whistle for them and gather them, because I have ransomed them. They will be as numerous as they were previously.

dag: ka o ti su Yaakubu zuliya sahakam, ka o nam ti ku mali bahigu.
en: and he will be the king of the descendants of Jacob forever; his kingdom will never end.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yiɣisi bɛ dooshee maa chana, Yawɛ sagban la daa kul ʒiɛla bɛ zuɣusaa dɛde wuntaŋ ni.
en: And the cloud always stayed with them.

dag: Di simdi ka o ti zaŋ naɣilaa maa ka Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la dunol ni na Yawɛ tooni nti zaŋ o nuu pa naɣilaa maa zuɣu ni, ka kɔrigi naɣilaa maa Yawɛ tooni.
en: He shall bring the bull to the entrance of the Tent, put his hand on its head, and kill it there in the Lord 's presence.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani kaman o ba Manaasa ni daa niŋ shɛm la.
en: Amon disobeyed the Lord , just as his father Manasseh had done.
