dag: ka yi zani Vuhim Dabisili dali neei biɛɣu maa n-kali hal ni biɛɣ pihinu, di nyaaŋa ka yi naanyi zaŋ chi mini kawaan pala na ti mali chi mini kawana sara ti Yawɛ.
en: On the fiftieth day, the day after the seventh Sabbath, present to the Lord another new offering of grain.

dag: Di simdi ka dilan zaŋ o nuhi pa nahu maa zuɣu ni ka kɔrig o Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol ni, ka Aduna bidibisi bɛn nyɛ maligumaaniba la zaŋ o ʒim kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini.
en: Lead it to the entrance of the sacred tent, lay your hand on its head, and have it killed there. A priest from Aaron's family will splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.

dag: N ni garig a min a zɔnim bɛn be a sani ŋɔ.
en: Ill answer you, and your friends along with you.

dag: Ŋunkam tumd alahichi nyɛla zaliguchihira, dama alahichi tumbu nyɛla zaligu chihibu.
en: Every person who practices sin commits an act of rebellion, and sin is rebellion.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, n yi lab m ba ŋun nyɛ a dabili maa sani, ka bia maa bi dol ti labi, dindina o nyɛvili ni tab bia maa nyɛvil la zuɣu.
en: When I now go back to your servant my father without the young man—whose life is so bound up with his.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ bindiri viɛla dihiri ba. Izraɛl zoya zuɣu nti yɛn nyɛ bɛ mɔri ŋubbu shee. Nimaani ka bɛ ni ti do momah viɛla tiŋgban ni, ka bɛ ti ŋubiri mo viɛla Izraɛl zoya zuɣu.
en: I will let them graze in safety in the mountain meadows and the valleys and in all the green pastures of the land of Israel.

dag: Nyin ŋun mali Naawuni fukumsi zaligu nyuri bara, a nyɛla ŋun saɣindi Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa n-dihiri ŋun Naawuni vi?.
en: You take pride in the Law, but you disobey the Law and bring shame to God.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa zaŋ niriba maa zaa yi sansani maa ni na ni bɛ ti zani Naawuni tooni, ka bɛ daa kana ti zani zoli maa gbini.
en: Moses brought the people out of the camp to meet God, and they took their place at the foot of the mountain.

dag: Izraɛlnim daa pun nyaŋ na shɛba ka deei bɛ tiŋgbana din be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulimpuhili polo la. Bɛ ni daa deei luɣ shɛŋa maa n-nyɛ Arinɔn Vinvamli zaŋ hal ti paai Hɛrimɔn Zoli zaŋ tabili Araba tiŋgbana din zaa daa be wulimpuhili polo maa.
en: The people of Israel had already conquered and occupied the land east of the Jordan, from the Arnon Valley up the Jordan Valley and as far north as Mount Hermon. They defeated two kings.

dag: Naawuni, zuliya shɛb kana ti kpe a tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Bɛ ta a jɛmbu du kasi la daɣiri, ka ŋme n-wurim Jɛrusalɛm.
en: O God, the heathen have invaded your land. They have desecrated your holy Temple and left Jerusalem in ruins.

dag: ni Sallu ni Amok ni Hilikia ni Jɛdaya so mi. Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-daa nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulaannim mini bɛ taba Jɛshua saha la.
en: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, Jedaiah. These were the leaders of the priests and of their associates in the days of Jeshua.

dag: Ka Abiata daa yina, nyama, ka Zadok gba mini Lɛvinim zaa daa kpuɣi Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka la na ti zaŋ li zali hal ka niriba maa zaa ti yi tiŋ maa ni na.
en: Zadok the priest was there, and with him were the Levites, carrying the sacred Covenant Box. They set it down and didn't pick it up again until all the people had left the city. The priest Abiathar was there too.

dag: So ni ti gbaag o daŋ puuni ninvuɣ so n-yɛl o, A mali binyɛrigu, leemi ti zuɣulana n-su binshɛɣukam din wurim doya ŋɔ.
en: At that time a man will grab one of his brothers from his own family and tell him, You have a coat, so you will be our leader. You will be the leader over all these ruins.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni yi kul ŋmari bilichiisi shɛm maa, lala ka bɛ na kul yɛn ŋmari li, di filimya li; bɛ nyɛla vinnyaɣinima, dina n-chɛ ka bɛ yɛli, Chɛ ka ti chaŋ ti mali sara jɛm ti Naawuni.
en: But still make sure that they produce the same number of bricks as they made before. Dont reduce the number! They are weak and lazy, and thats why they cry, Lets go and offer sacrifices to our God.

dag: Yawɛ, pumpɔŋɔ chɛ ka a ni yɛli mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ n zuliya polo ŋɔ niŋ pali sahakam. Niŋmi kaman a ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: And now, O Lord , fulfill for all time the promise you made about me and my descendants, and do what you said you would.

dag: Bɛ kpaai ma mi bahi kaman kom la, ka n kɔbituɣa zaa miligimiligi; ka n suhu be kaman kpam din nyɛligi la n nyɔɣu ni.
en: My strength is gone, gone like water spilled on the ground. All my bones are out of joint; my heart is like melted wax.

dag: O daa wurim tinzun buɣa maligu bimbina la mini buɣa jɛmbu shee, ka ŋme n-kabisi di daantalisi, ka wurim Ashɛrim.
en: He removed the foreign altars and shrines, smashed the sacred pillars, cut down the sacred poles.

dag: Yi gba lihimiya yimaŋ kaman yi kpimi zaŋ chaŋ alahichi tumbu polo, amaa ka lee mali nyɛvili zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni sani Yisa Masia zuɣu.
en: In the same way, you also should consider yourselves dead to sin but alive for God in Christ Jesus.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiri ni tinim kul bela kum barina ni ni di chɛ ka yinim mali nyɛvili.
en: This means that death is at work in us, but life is at work in you.

dag: Ɛhab ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam zaa ni o ni daa zaŋ wɔb nyina n-dih o nam yil shɛli nachiinsi la ni o ni daa me tin shɛŋa zaa la, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi ni.
en: The rest of what King Ahab did during the time he ruled is written in the book, The History of the Kings of Israel . That book tells about all the cities he built and about all the ivory that he used to decorate his palace.

dag: n-zaŋ o binyɛr wɔɣinli din bɔɣiri wɔɣ maa nti ti bɛ ba ka yɛl o, Ti pihi li mi, lihim li nya, a bia binyɛrigu m-bala bee pa dina.
en: Then the brothers showed the coat to their father. And the brothers said, We found this coat. Is this Josephs coat.

dag: Bɛ daa lo nanim nuhi n-zaŋ ba yili zuɣusaa. Bɛ bi tiri kpamba jilima.
en: The enemy hanged our princes. They didnt honor our elders.

dag: Amaa ti doliyala ti Duuma Yisa Masia biɛrisuŋ la soli, ka di bo so shɛli ti ni ni doli n-tum niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma.
en: Instead, dress yourself with the Lord Jesus Christ, and dont plan to indulge your selfish desires.

dag: Di simdi ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni niriba zaa pahi Izraɛl naa zuɣu ka bɛ mali sara maa.
en: All the people of the land must take these offerings to the ruling prince of Israel.

dag: Ka Juda daa yɛl o, Chɛ ka o zaŋ nɛma maa leeg o dini, di yi pa lala, niriba ni la ti; nyama, n-chɛ ka a zaŋ bubil polli maa ni a ti ti o, ka a bi tooi bo n-nya o.
en: Judah said, Let her keep everything so we arent laughed at. I did send this kid goat, but you couldnt find her.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la ni Naawuni yɛliya: Di ku lan yuui ka ŋun yɛn kana maa ku kpalim, ka shiri kana.
en: As the Scriptures say, God is coming soon! It won't be very long.

dag: A yi chɛ ka nahu buri a chi, nyin miri ka a zaŋ bini pɔb o noli.
en: Don't muzzle an ox while it is threshing grain.

dag: A daa bi kpaai ma mi bahi kaman bihim la, ka kahim ma kaman waagasi la?.
en: You gave my father strength to beget me; you made me grow in my mother's womb.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti dooi salima pa dapaɣa maa zuɣu, ka mali salima bansi niŋ li ka di ti gbibi dapuhi maa, ka niŋ salima pa dapaɣa maa zuɣu, ka mali salima bansi niŋ li, ka di ti gbibi dapuhi maa, ka niŋ salima pa dapuhi maa zuɣu.
en: Cover the frames and the crossbars with gold and attach gold rings to the frames to run the crossbars through.

dag: Yuun shɛli din daa ti pahiri yuun pinaanahi ni, ka Chɛdolaoma mini na shɛb bɛn daa sɔŋd o daa chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ Rɛfaim din be Ashitɛrɔtikarinaim tiŋgbɔŋ ni mini Zuzim din be Ham tiŋgbɔŋ ni ni Ɛmim din be Shavɛkiriataim tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: A year later King Chedorlaomer and his allies attacked and defeated the Rephaites in Ashteroth-Karnaim, the Zuzites in Ham, and the Emites in Shaveh-Kiriathaim.

dag: Ka niriba daa ti yiɣisi wulimpuhili polo n-chaŋchaŋ ti paai Shiina tiŋgbɔŋ ni bɔpiɛligu ni n-kpalim ʒini nimaani.
en: As they wandered about in the East, they came to a plain in Babylonia and settled there.

dag: Man Saimɔn Pita ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia dabili ni o tumo la n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛda mali buchi kaman ti gba yɛda ni mali buchi shɛm ti Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Tiligira Yisa Masia wuntitali puuni la.
en: From Simon Peter, a slave and apostle of Jesus Christ. To those who received a faith equal to ours through the justice of our God and savior Jesus Christ.

dag: Ka di lan be kaman wulimpuhili polo pɔhim n-ʒiɛri Speen teeku ni ŋarima ka di saɣindi la.
en: or like the east wind when it smashes the ships of Tarshish.

dag: Ka kukol shɛli daa yi zuɣusaa na yɛra, M Biyurigu m-bɔŋɔ, n nini ni tiɣ so pam m-bala.
en: Then a voice from heaven said, This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ba, Naawuni zali Vuhim Dabisili dali tila ninsalinima, amaa o bi nam ninsalinim ti Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: Then he said, The Sabbath was created for humans; humans werent created for the Sabbath.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Kulimiya ka labina dabisi shɛli din pahir ata dali. Ka niriba maa daa kuli.
en: He answered them, Come back in three days. So the people left.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka yi suhuri doya, ka di chɛliya ka dabiɛm mali ya; n daa deei yi liɣiri maa. Di pa shɛli, yi Naawuni ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni la n-daa zaŋ liɣiri maa niŋ yi kpalansi maa ni maa. Di saha ka o daa zaŋ Simiɔn n-yihi bɛ sanna.
en: But the servant answered, Dont be afraid; believe me. Your God, the God of your father, must have put the money in your sack as a gift. I remember that you paid me for the grain the last time. Then the servant brought Simeon out of the prison.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa da tiŋgbani Hamɔr ŋun daa nyɛ Shɛkɛm ba la bihi sani anzinfa laɣibaligu kɔbiga n-ti o suɣa zali nimaani.
en: He bought the section of the field where he pitched his tent from the sons of Hamor, Shechems father, for one hundred qesitahs.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa shiri niŋ lala n-yihi ba bɛ biɛhigu maa shee. Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm maa, lala ka Izraɛlnim daa shiri niŋ.
en: The Israelites did so and sent them outside the camp. The Israelites did just what the LORD said to Moses.

dag: N dimnim maa kul duri tamdila n zuɣu dabisili kam puuni, dama bɛn tuhiri ma maa galisiya pam.
en: My attackers trample me all day long because I have so many enemies. Exalted one.

dag: Bɛ zaŋla kurugu alikalimi sabi Judanim daalahichi, ka zaŋ daimɔnd chiriga n-chirigi li pa bɛ suhuri ni mini bɛ sara maligu bimbina binyila zuɣu.
en: People of Judah, your sins cannot be erased. They are written on your hearts like words chiseled in stone or carved on the corners of your altars. *.

dag: Yi gba lihimiya yimaŋ kaman yi kpimi zaŋ chaŋ alahichi tumbu polo, amaa ka lee mali nyɛvili zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni sani Yisa Masia zuɣu.
en: In the same way, you must think of yourselves as dead to the power of sin. But Christ Jesus has given life to you, and you live for God.

dag: N-yi biɛɣu ka o yɛn chaŋ, ka yihi liɣiri kaman tumtumda daba ayi yɔri ti o yilikpɛrilana, ka yɛl o ni o lihim bara maa viɛnyɛliŋga. Ka lan yɛli ni hal o yi ti di laɣ shɛli o ni ti o maa pooi ka di omaŋmaŋ liɣiri pahi, o yi ti labina o ni yo o.
en: The next day, he took two full days worth of wages and gave them to the innkeeper. He said, Take care of him, and when I return, I will pay you back for any additional costs.

dag: Ka Ɛhab daa yɛl o, Cham gili tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ kulibɔna mini vinvama zaa ni nti lihi nya ti ni nya mɔri ti ti yuri mini ti buntaansi ŋɔ n-tiligi ba din ni chɛ ka ti ku kɔŋ bɛ shɛba.
en: Ahab said to Obadiah, Go throughout the land and check every spring of water and every brook. Perhaps we can find some grass to keep our horses and mules alive so we dont have to kill any of them.

dag: Ka Yisa daa zaŋ o salo maa ni yi kpaŋa nti zaŋ o nubihi tim o tiba ni, ka tuhi nintɔri zaŋ shihi tikpiralan maa zilinli;.
en: After Jesus had taken him aside from the crowd, he stuck his fingers in the man's ears. Then he spit and put it on the man's tongue.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa ti lan dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol o yuli Shɛla. Chɛzib ka o daa be ka dɔɣ o.
en: Then she had another son named Shelah. Judah lived in Kezib when his third son was born.

dag: ni di chɛ ka bɛ nam maa siɣisi dimaŋa, ka ku duhi dimaŋa. Ka di yi gbibi alikauli maa, dina n-ni chɛ ka di zani.
en: to keep the nation from rising again and to make sure that the treaty would be kept.

dag: Di simdi ni bɛ tumdi tuma sɔŋdi ya, ka tumdi bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛli zaa Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni; amaa bɛ di miri sara maligu shee lahi la bee sara maligu bimbini maa, bɛ yi niŋ lala, yi mini ba ni kpi.
en: You must see that they perform their duties. But if they go near any of the sacred objects or the altar, all of you will die.

dag: Amaa n yɛri ya mi ni Anabi Ilaija pun kana, ka bɛ daa lee bi baŋ o, ka daa niŋ o bɛ suhu ni yu shɛm. Lala ka Daadam bia gba yɛn di wahala bɛ nuu ni.
en: In fact, he has already come. But the people did not recognize him and treated him just as they wanted to. They will soon make the Son of Man suffer in the same way.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla gɔpiɛliga dari mali di daantalis anahi, ka niŋ salima niŋ li, ka zaŋ salima mali di bansi. Bɛ daa lan zaŋ anzinfa mali daantalisi maa ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu ni bɛ zaŋ pateesa maa yili li.
en: They made four posts of acacia wood to hold the curtain, covered them with gold, and fitted them with gold hooks. Then they made four silver bases to hold the posts.

dag: Yi na bi bɔhi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ sochandiba? Yi bi saɣi bɛ ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Surely you have talked with travelers. Surely you will accept their stories.

dag: Bɛnkam zaa gariti kpahirila bɛ nuhi niŋd a. Bɛ maan a la ansarisi, ka gbaɣisiri bɛ zuɣuri niŋd a, nyin Jɛrusalɛm bipuɣiŋga. Tin shɛli bɛ ni daa booni tin viɛlli zaa, ka nyɛ dunia zaa suhupiɛlli shee la m-bɔŋɔ.
en: People passing by the city look at you in scorn. They shake their heads and laugh at Jerusalem's ruins: Is this that lovely city? Is this the pride of the world.

dag: O daa me Lɛbanɔn Nyɔŋ ni Yili; ka di wɔɣilim daa nyɛ mita pihinahinaanahi, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pisinaayi, ka di dubu mi nyɛ mita pinaata ni pirigili, ka bɛ daa me li tamla sida dari kulis ata mini di dapuhi zuɣu.
en: Forest Hall was the largest room in the palace. It was meters long, meters wide, and . meters high, and was lined with cedar from Lebanon. It had rows of cedar pillars, in a row, and they held up cedar beams. The ceiling was covered with cedar.

dag: Dindali maa Izraɛlnim daa zanila Mikimash n-ku Filistianim maa lala hal ti paai Aijalɔn. Ka di daa gbarigi Izraɛlnim maa pam.
en: That day the Israelites defeated the Philistines, fighting all the way from Michmash to Aijalon. By this time the Israelites were very weak from hunger.

dag: Yawɛ, m mi ni a saria karibu nyɛla din tuhi. Ʒiɛyimtali puuni ka a daa darigi n tibili maa.
en: Lord , I know that your decisions are fair, and you were right to punish me.

dag: N lan nya binshɛli din nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu pam dunia ŋɔ ni. Niriba bɔri nyari liɣiri m-mal li sɔŋda, ka di mali ba barina.
en: I have seen something terribly unfair. People get rich, but it does them no good.

dag: Naawuni nyɛla ŋun bi doli din tuhi? Bee Kpiɔŋlan Naa nyɛla ŋun bi doli din tuhi?.
en: Does God All-Powerful stand in the way of justice?.

dag: M bi zaɣisi ka bɛ di sabi n yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ sɔŋ! M bi zaɣisi ka bɛ di sab li niŋ kundi ni!.
en: I wish someone would write down everything I say. I wish my words were written on a scroll.

dag: ka yi yi zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ fukumsi zalikpana maa, ka ŋmaligi ka chɛ n ni zaani ya ni yi doli so shɛli zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka chaŋ ti jɛmdi wun shɛŋa yi ni bi mi, din mi n-nyɛ noli dibu maa.
en: but the curse if you dont obey the LORD your Gods commandments and stray from the path that I am giving you today by following other gods that you have not known.

dag: Lala ka bɛ ʒim yihibu maa taali yɛn labina ti ʒini ŋun Jɔab min o nyaaŋa zuɣu hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Amaa Dauda min o nyaaŋa ni o yiŋnim ni o nam ʒiishee ni mali suhudoo din yi Yawɛ sanna sahakam.
en: He and his family will always be guilty for their deaths. But the Lord will bring peace to David, his descendants, his family of kings, and his kingdom forever.

dag: Ka o bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a bɔhi ma bin suŋ yɛla? Ninvuɣ yino kɔŋko n-nyɛ ninvuɣ suŋ. Amaa a yi bɔri ni a ti nya nyɛvili, nyin doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligunima.
en: Why do you ask me concerning what is good? answered Jesus. There is only One who is good. Keep the commandments if you want to enter life.

dag: A yi chana, di ni wuh a soli, a yi gbihira, di ni gul a, a yi ti neei, di ni dir a alizama.
en: Their teaching will lead you when you travel, protect you at night, and advise you during the day.

dag: O daa niŋ lala la o ni daa zaŋ Naawuni yɛligu kaman kom paɣ li m-mal li ka di be kasi la puuni.
en: He made the church holy by the power of his word, and he made it pure by washing it with water.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli, N yɛn leela ʒiri shia o daanabinim zaa noya ni. Di saha ka Yawɛ yɛl o, A shiri ni tooi niŋ o naŋgban malisim, cham ti niŋ lala, a ni di nasara. .
en: The spirit replied, I will go and make all of Ahab's prophets tell lies. The Lord said, Go and deceive him. You will succeed.

dag: Gaad zuliya ni, Diuɛl bia Ɛliasaf n-yɛn sɔŋ ya;.
en: from Gad, Eliasaph, Deuels son.

dag: Ka o ni daa niŋ shɛm maa bi niŋ Yawɛ nyaɣisim, ka o daa ku o gba.
en: The Lord wasn't pleased with Onan and took his life too.

dag: Piɛbimiya kikahi mini binyila n-yili suhupiɛlli yila Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naa ŋɔ tooni.
en: With trumpets and a horn blast, shout triumphantly before the LORD, the king!.

dag: N yura, a viɛli pam. Yɛlimaŋli, a shiri viɛli pam. Ti bindoo nyɛla momaha.
en: How handsome you are, my dearest; how you delight me! The green grass will be our bed;.

dag: Nyama, n ni chɛ ka yɛl biɛɣu paag a n-kpims a zaa. N ni ku a daŋ ni doo kam ŋun nyɛ bilichina bee dabili Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: So I am now bringing evil on you! I will burn until you are consumed, and I will eliminate everyone who urinates on a wall that belongs to Ahab, whether slave or free.

dag: Di daa bi yuui, ka o kuhi yɛli, Wɔribariba be chɛchɛbuŋ ni, ka yuri ayi vɔri li kanna! Di saha ka o daa lan yɛli, Babilɔn luya, di luya! Ka di wuna binnana zaa lu n-wurisiwurisi do tiŋa.
en: Suddenly, here they come! Riders on horseback, two by two. The sentry gives the news, Babylon has fallen! All the idols they worshiped lie shattered on the ground.

dag: ka daa kpaŋsi li ka di leei zaligu Yaakubu sani, ka lan leei alikauli din ka bahigu Izraɛl san la.
en: to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba, Puu atam zooya pam, amaa ka tumtumdiba lee pɔra;.
en: He said to his disciples, A large crop is in the fields, but there are only a few workers.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ be kaman wurigu la pɔhim tooni, ka Yawɛ malaika kari ba bahi.
en: Let them be like dust on the wind— and let the LORDs messenger be the one who does the blowing!.

dag: Ka goli so ŋun pahir ayopɔin biɛɣu pia dali, yin chɛ ka bɛ piɛb kikahi pampam. Ka dabisi shɛli din nyɛ samli yɔbu dali maa, yin chɛliya ka bɛ piɛbi kikahi gili yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa.
en: on the tenth day of the seventh month, which is also the Great Day of Forgiveness, trumpets are to be blown everywhere in the land.

dag: O bihi ni yiɣisi paɣ o ka o yidan gba paɣ o, yɛli.
en: Her children show their appreciation, and her husband praises her.

dag: Amazia ni daa tuhi Ɛdomnim naai ka labiri kuna, o daa kpuɣila bɛ wuna m-mali kuli ti zaŋ li leeg omaŋmaŋ wuna n-jɛmdi li ka maani li.
en: When Amaziah returned from defeating the Edomites, he brought their idols back with him, set them up, worshiped them, and burned incense to them.

dag: Di simdi ni nir siɣis omaŋ Naawuni tooni ;.
en: He should put his mouth in the dirt—perhaps there is hope.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka tɔb daa ti lan lu bɛ mini Filistianim sunsuuni Gɛza. Di saha ka Sibɛkai ŋun daa nyɛ Husha nir la daa ku Sipai ŋun daa yi tiyaawumyanim zuliya ni na la, ka bɛ daa nyaŋ Filistianim maa.
en: Some time later, Israel fought a battle against the Philistines at Gezer. During this battle, Sibbecai from Hushah killed Sippai, a descendant of the Rephaim, and the Philistines were defeated.

dag: Ka n timdi m mabihi ŋɔ na pumpɔŋɔ ni di chɛ ka n ni nyuri bara yi zuɣu shɛm la ku kpalim yoli, ka di chɛ ka yi mali shili kaman n ni yɛli ni yi pun mali shili shɛm la.
en: This is why I am sending Titus and the two others to you. I want you to be ready, just as I promised. This will prove we were not wrong to brag about you.

dag: N ni ti vuɣi Ashɛra binwɔɣila la yi sani, ka wurim yi fɔntinsi.
en: together with the sacred poles and even your towns.

dag: Ka bɛ daa maani niriba maa yɛla sahakam. Ka bɛ daa zaŋdi yɛtɔɣ kpɛma n-kani Musa sanna, amaa yɛtɔɣ bihi dina, bɛmaŋmaŋa n-daa maani li.
en: These rulers were judges for the people. The people could always bring their arguments to these rulers, and Moses had to decide only the most important cases.

dag: ni pateesa shɛŋa din yɛn yiini ni mini di daantalisi ni di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu ni pateesa shɛli din yɛn yiini dundɔŋ maa dunoli.
en: the curtains with the posts and stands that go around the courtyard and the curtain at the entrance;.

dag: Ka yi ni diri ka nyur la, pa yimaŋmaŋ kɔre ka yi niŋdi lala kura? .
en: When you ate and drank, werent you the ones eating and drinking?.

dag: Nyin Ɛdom bipuɣiŋga ŋun be Uzi ŋɔ, kul lam ni suhupiɛlli. Bɛ ni zaŋ pipia maa ti a gba, ka a gba nyu n-kuli, ka pirig a zaɣim.
en: Be happy, people of Edom. Be happy, you who live in the land of Uz. But remember, the cup of the Lords anger will come around to you too. When you drink from that cup, you will get drunk and strip off all your clothes.

dag: Amaa Jɔshua daa tiligi Reehab ŋun daa nyɛ pagɔrili la min o dɔɣiriba zaa; o ni daa zaŋ tuumba shɛb Jɔshua ni daa tim ni bɛ ti puɣisi kaai Jɛriko n-sɔɣ la zuɣu. Ka Reehab zuliya na kul be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: Joshua saved Rahab the prostitute, her family, and all those who were with her. Joshua let them live because Rahab helped the spies Joshua had sent out to Jericho. Rahab still lives among the Israelites today.

dag: Di daba anahi dali ka bɛ daa ti yɛli Samsin paɣa, Doli yɛŋkiŋkabina soli n-chɛ ka a yidana wuhi ti o ŋahili maa, di yi pa lala, ti ni nyo a ba yiŋ buɣim ka di di li tabili amaŋmaŋa. Yi bol ti mi na ni yi ti ti ti samli.
en: On the fourth day they said to Samson's wife, Trick your husband into telling us what the riddle means. If you don't, we'll set fire to your father's house and burn you with it. You two invited us so that you could rob us, didn't you.

dag: Ka Pita yɛl o, Yɛlim ma yɛlimaŋli, yi ni shiri kɔhi yi puu la laɣ shɛli zaa m-bɔŋɔ? Ka o saɣi, Iin, di zaa m-bala.
en: Peter asked her, Tell me, did you and your husband receive this price for the field? She responded, Yes, thats the amount.

dag: Nandahima zuɣu chɛ ka n tarigimi; nintam kul mahigirila m bindoo yuŋ kam; ka n nintam maa chɛ ka n difiɛli kul mahigi gbati.
en: Lord, I am so weak. I cried to you all night. My pillow is soaked; my bed is dripping wet from my tears.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ nyɛviya zan tariga kaman nir ni yi vuhi pɔhim bahi la; ka chɛ ka dabiɛm mali ba bɛ ni be yuun shɛŋa ni.
en: So he ended their days like a breath and their lives with sudden disaster.

dag: A ba daa ʒil ti ʒi tibisili pam, dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, filimm a ba ni daa chɛ ka ti tumdi tuun kpeen shɛŋa la, ka lan filim o ni daa ʒil ti ʒitibisi shɛl la; ka ti jɛm a.
en: Your father forced us to work very hard. Now, make it easier for us. Stop the heavy work that your father forced us to do and we will serve you.

dag: Dama Yawɛ n-tiri yɛm. O noli ni ka baŋsim mini yɛla baŋbu yirina.
en: The LORD gives wisdom; from his mouth come knowledge and understanding.

dag: Di saha maa, anab kam ti ku lan nyu bara ʒii nyabu zuɣu bee n-wuhi ni o nyɛla anabi bee n-ye binyɛr shɛli din mali biŋkɔbiri kɔbiri di ni n-yɔhim niriba.
en: At that time the prophets will be ashamed of their visions and prophecies. They will not wear the rough cloth that shows a person is a prophet. They will not wear those clothes to trick people with the lies they call prophecies.

dag: Yaansi nyɛla ninkura jilima zuɣupiligu; ka bihi mi jilima nyɛ bɛ laamba.
en: Grandchildren are the crown of the elderly, and the glory of children is their parents.

dag: Dinzuɣu miriya ka yi ti tam Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛl la yɛla, ka mali wuni ŋmahindi binshɛŋa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ya ni di nyɛla din chihiri la.
en: So all of you, watch yourselves! Dont forget the covenant that the LORD your God made with you by making an idol or an image of any kind or anything the LORD your God forbids.

dag: N leela n niriba zaa ni lari ninvuɣ so; bɛ yiini yila maani ma ansarisi dabisi muni puuni zaa.
en: I have become a joke to all my people, the object of their song of ridicule all day long.

dag: Bɛ yihiri waazu yɛra ma, Di yihiri waazu. Di yihiri waazu yɛri binyara ŋɔ yɛla; vi ku di ti.
en: The people preach at me and say, Don't preach at us. Don't preach about all that. God is not going to disgrace us.

dag: O zaŋ o yɛtɔɣa yɛli Yaakubu zuliya, ka zaŋ o zaligu wuhi Izraɛlnima.
en: He gave his commands to Jacob. He gave his laws and rules to Israel.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Bɛn mali yɛm di nyuri bara bɛ yɛm zuɣu, ka bɛn mali yaa di nyuri bara bɛ yaa zuɣu. Ka bɛn gba mali buni di nyuri bara bɛ buni zuɣu.
en: The LORD proclaims: the learned should not boast of their knowledge, nor warriors boast of their might, nor the rich boast of their wealth.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun bi doli Masia wuhibu, amaa ka kpahi yaɣi di zuɣu chana, dilana maa ka Naawuni; ka ŋunkam mi doli Masia wuhibu nyɛla ŋun mali ti Ba Naawuni min o Bia.
en: Anyone who goes too far and does not continue in the teaching about Christ does not have God. Whoever continues in this teaching has both the Father and the Son.

dag: Firawuna yi ti nya ba, o suhu ni maai zaŋ chaŋ o tɔbbihi zaa polo. Bɛ daa zaŋ takɔbi ku Firawuna min o tɔbbihi zaa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Yes, Pharaoh and all his army will be killed in battle. Pharaoh will be comforted when he sees his many men and all the others who went down into the place of death. This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Zuɣuŋmaŋ Shee la ka bɛ daa kpahi Yisa tabili dapulli zuɣu, ka daa kpahi tuumbiɛtumdiba ayi maa gba tabili dapula zuɣu n-zaŋ yino sa Yisa nudirigu polo, ka zaŋ ŋun la mi sa o nuzaa polo.
en: When they came to the place called The Skull, they crucified Jesus there, and the two criminals, one on his right and the other on his left.

dag: Dinzuɣu malimiya shili yi tɛha ni ka gbibi yimaŋa, ka zaŋ yi tahima niŋ anfaan shɛli Naawuni ni ti yɛn niŋ niŋ yi ni Yisa Masia ni ti yɛn yi palo dabisi shɛli dal la.
en: Therefore, once you have your minds ready for action and you are thinking clearly, place your hope completely on the grace that will be brought to you when Jesus Christ is revealed.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa Masia daalibarika kpalimmi be yi ni!.
en: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless your life!.

dag: Bɛ ka zuɣulana bee sapashin kpɛma.
en: The ant has no commander, officer, or ruler.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔh o, Pa doo n-nya a? A kpee be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni? Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka a bi ʒiɛya gul a dan naa? Dama ninvuɣ so kana ni o ti ku a dan naa maa.
en: Abner, what kind of a man are you? David replied. Aren't you supposed to be the best soldier in Israel? Then why didn't you protect your king? Anyone who went into your camp could have killed him tonight.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛl taba, Chɛliya ka ti pii so leei ti zuɣulana n-lab Ijipti.
en: So they said to one another, Let's choose a leader and go back to Egypt.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa chɛ ka bɛ boli Gibiɔnnim maa na ka o ti bɔhi ba. Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi yɔhim ti yɛli, Ti mini ya shee wɔɣ pam. ka kul bela ti sani kpe ŋɔ?.
en: Joshua ordered the people of Gibeon to be brought to him, and he asked them, Why did you deceive us and tell us that you were from far away, when you live right here?.

dag: O yihiri nanim nam ni, ka chɛri ka bɛ leeri bɛn pa shɛli.
en: God makes dignitaries useless and the earths judges into nothing.

dag: ka kari saria din tuhi n-sɔŋ kpibisi mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari nahiŋgu, ka lala chɛ ka dabiɛm ku lan mali daadamnim yaha.
en: Protect the orphans and those who have been hurt. Dont let powerful people drive us from our land!.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Ishimail ni daa gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb daba Mizipa maa zaa daa ŋmaligi zo n-labi Karia bia Jɔhanan sani.
en: They rallied around Johanan, Kareahs son, and returned home with him.

dag: N yaannim ni daa ku tiŋ shɛŋa ninvuɣ shɛb zaa la, buɣ dini n-daa lee tooi fa di niriba n nuu ni, ka yinim Naawuni ni ti tooi tiligi ya n nuu ni?.
en: None of those gods kept their people safe from the kings of Assyria. Do you really think your God can do any better?.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli, N yi kul yi a sani chaŋ, n ni suhi Yawɛ ni o chɛ ka zɔhi pam ŋɔ zo nyin Firawuna min a kpambaliba ni a niriba zaa sani biɛɣuni ŋɔ. Amaa lee di lan yɔhim n-chɛ ka niriba maa bi chaŋ ti mali sara ti Yawɛ.
en: Moses said, Ill leave you now, and Ill pray to the LORD. Tomorrow the swarms of insects will leave Pharaoh, his officials, and his people. Just dont let Pharaoh lie to us again and not let the people go to offer sacrifices to the LORD.

dag: Man ŋuna, n tɔŋbu puuni, n daa yɛliya, Shɛli ku tooi nyaŋ ma.
en: I felt secure and thought, I'll never be shaken.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, yil yini puuni niriba anu noya ni ti woli. Niriba ata ni ti naai noli zaɣisi niriba ayi, ka niriba ayi mi ni ti zaɣisi niriba ata maa.
en: From now on, a family of five will be divided, three against two, and two against three.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka Kpiɔŋlan Naa bi zali saria karibu saha? Ka bɔzuɣu ka bɛn mi o na ʒi n-nya o ni zali saha dabisa shɛŋa ni?.
en: Why doesnt God All-Powerful set times for judgment? And why cant his followers know when those times will be?.

dag: Chamiya Lɛbanɔn nti kuhi pam, ka duhi yi yee Bashan. Kuhimiya Abarim polo bahina, dama bɛ ku yi ni yuri shɛba.
en: People of Jerusalem, the nations you trusted have been crushed. Go to Lebanon and weep; cry in the land of Bashan and in Moab.

dag: Barizillai daa nyɛla yuun pihinii nira, ŋuna n-daa ti bo bindira n-zaŋ ti Naa Dauda saha shɛl o ni daa be Mahanaim la, dama o daa nyɛla bundana.
en: Barzillai was a very old man, years old. He had given the king food and other things when David was staying at Mahanaim. Barzillai could do this because he was a very rich man.

dag: O daa zaŋla tɔrokɔnim ayi mini naɣilah anahi ti Gɛrishɔn bihi kaman bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm;.
en: Two wagons and four oxen he gave to the Gershonites for their duty.

dag: Nir yi gbilisi tibili wum saɣisigu viɛnyɛliŋga, bɛ ni kal o pahi yɛnnim ni.
en: To be counted among the wise, you must learn to accept helpful criticism.

dag: Hɔrinim nanima n-daa nyɛ: Lɔtan mini Shɔbal ni Zibiɔn ni Ana.
en: These are the Horite tribes in the land of Edom: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.

dag: Ka Husham daa ti kpi, ka Hadad ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛdad bia, ka nyɛ ŋun daa tuhi nyaŋ Midiannim Mɔabnim tiŋgbɔŋ ni la daa di nam zan o zaani, o ya yuli n-daa booni Avit.
en: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad became the new king. Hadad defeated Midian in the country of Moab. Hadads city was named Avith.

dag: N lan kpahim baŋ yɛm mini jɛrilim ni yinyatali ni nyɛ shɛm; ka nya ka di ŋmanila nir yi zɔri doli pɔhim.
en: Then I decided to find out all I could about wisdom and foolishness. Soon I realized that this too was as senseless as chasing the wind.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Gbɛmiya kpe, ka n sa zaŋ Yawɛ ni yɛli ma shɛm yɛli ya. Ka Mɔab kpamba maa daa gbe Balaam sani.
en: He said to them, Spend the night here and Ill bring back to you a word exactly as the LORD speaks to me. So the officials of Moab stayed with Balaam.

dag: Hal lari puuni suhugarigu beni, ka suhupiɛlli bahigu mi nyɛ suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: Sorrow may hide behind laughter, and happiness may end in sorrow.

dag: Di zuɣu ka n timd o yi sanna ni o ti yɛli ya ti zaa ni be shɛm, ka di kpaŋsi yi suhuri.
en: I am sending him to cheer you up by telling you how we are getting along.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa, Naa Ahasivɛrɔs suhuyiɣisili la ni daa ti maai, di saha ka o daa teei Vashiti yɛla min o ni daa niŋ shɛm ni bɛ ni daa zali zaligu shɛli ka di di o la gba yɛla.
en: Later, King Xerxes stopped being angry. Then he remembered Vashti and what she had done. He remembered his commands about her.

dag: Di saha Ɛzɛkiɛl ni ti leei shihirili yi sani. Yi ni ti niŋ kaman o ni kul niŋ shɛm ŋɔ. Di yi ti niŋ lala, yi ni baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Duuma.
en: Then I will be a sign to you; you will do everything I have done. The Lord says that when this happens, you will know that he is the Sovereign Lord .

dag: A daa bi dolila bɛ naba n-tum bɛ ni daa tum din chihiri shɛŋa maa kɔŋko, amaa saha biɛla ka a daa zaŋ tum din bie n-gari bɛ dini a soya zaa ni.
en: You didnt follow in their ways or engage in their detestable practices in any small way. You were far more destructive.

dag: Ka Jɛfita daa po pɔri n-lo Yawɛ alikauli yɛli, A yi ni zaŋ Ammɔnnim maa niŋ n nuu ni.
en: he promised the Lord , If you will let me defeat the Ammonites.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa boli nachimba maa ni yino na nti yɛl o, Cham ti ku o. Ka o daa ŋme n-ku o.
en: Then David called one of his men and said, Kill him! The man struck the Amalekite and mortally wounded him.

dag: din nyɛ Naawuni ni zaŋ shɛli zali ya alizanda ni, ka di nyɛ din ku tooi pooi bee n-saɣim bee n-kpaai la.
en: and so we look forward to possessing the rich blessings that God keeps for his people. He keeps them for you in heaven, where they cannot decay or spoil or fade away.

dag: Ka mɔɣ shɛli din pah ata yuli booni Tigiris. Dina n-zɔri kpari Asiria wulimpuhili polo. Ka mɔɣ shɛli din pah anahi mi yuli booni Yufretiiz.
en: The third river is the Tigris, which flows east of Assyria, and the fourth river is the Euphrates.

dag: n daa chani gbinfini, ka yi ti ma situra; n daa biɛra, ka yi kaari ma; ka n daa ti be sarika ni, ka yi kani n sanna ti kaari ma.
en: naked and you clothed me; I was sick and you took care of me, in prison and you visited me.

dag: ka ŋunkam kpuɣi bɛ zaɣ kpiŋ yaɣ shɛlikam, ŋun paɣim o situra, ka nyɛ ŋun be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: and anyone who carries any part of their dead bodies must wash their clothes and will be unclean until evening.

dag: Ka binshɛb bɛn mali kpiŋkpama ka be nyam, yin ŋubimiya ba.
en: Any clean winged creature can be eaten, however.

dag: Yi yi di mi ma, yi naan mi m Ba maa gba; amaa zuŋɔ zaŋ chana yi baŋ o, dama yi pun nya o.
en: If you have really known me, you will also know the Father. From now on you know him and have seen him.

dag: Gbibiya n zaligunima. Di chɛliya ka naɣ bal shɛb zuliya du yi naɣinyama. Di biriya bimbira balibu buyi pu yin ni, yi mi di yɛnya taŋgari binyɛrigu.
en: You must obey my laws. You must not let your animals mate with animals of a different kind. You must not sow your field with two kinds of seed. You must not wear clothing made from two kinds of material mixed together.

dag: Asahɛl bia Jɔnatan mini Tikiva bia Jazɛya n-daa zaɣisi yɛlli maa, ka Mɛshulam mini Shabɛtai ŋun daa nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya nir la daa ʒe bɛ nyaaŋa.
en: No one was opposed to the plan except Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah, who had the support of Meshullam and of Shabbethai, a Levite.

dag: Ŋunkam gol o tizɔpaɣa, o yi nyɛla o ba bipuɣiŋga bee o ma bipuɣiŋga, noli din dim o. Ka sokam yɛli, Ami.
en: God's curse on anyone who has intercourse with his sister or half sister. And all the people will answer, Amen.

dag: ni yɛli Yawɛ, A sani n-nyɛ n sɔɣibu shee, ni m birini; Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n ni niŋ so naani ŋɔ.
en: I say to the Lord , You are my place of safety, my fortress. My God, I trust in you.

dag: Dɛhi nɔri li mi sɔŋdi tiŋa, ka binnɛɔŋ kam ŋun gɔri mɔɣu ni diri li.
en: so that any boar from the forest can tear it up, so that the bugs can feed on it?.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm, a ni ti bela tiŋgbani puuni ha tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa, ka a yɛtɔɣa yiri tiŋgban ni na. A kukoli ni ti ŋmanila kpim kukoli n-yiri tiŋgban ni na. A ti yɛn sɔɣirimi yɛri ka di yiri tiŋgban ni na.
en: You will be pulled to the ground. Your voice will rise from the ground like the voice of a ghost. Your words come like a whisper from the dirt.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Naawuni chɛ ka nuchee ŋɔ puhi yina ti sab sabbu ŋɔ.
en: That is why God has sent the hand to write these words.

dag: Amaa zaŋ chaŋ Juda naa ŋun tim ya na ni yi ti bɔhi baŋ din be man Yawɛ sani ŋɔ polo, yɛlimiy o ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, A ni wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa.
en: As for the king himself, this is what I, the Lord God of Israel, say: You listened to what is written in the book.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka pagɔra ayi daa ti kana ti gbani naa tooni.
en: Sometime later, two prostitutes came and stood before the king.

dag: Ka di mali goon titali din du pam ka mali dunoya pinaayi, ka malaikanim pinaayi ʒe dunoya maa ni, ka Izraɛl zuliya pinaayi la yuya sab pa dunoya maa zuɣu;.
en: It had a great high wall with twelve gates. By the gates were twelve angels, and on the gates were written the names of the twelve tribes of Israels sons.

dag: n-yɛli ba, Chamiya tiŋkpan shɛli din be yi tooni ŋɔ ha; yi yi ti paai ni, yi ni nya bun so bɛ ni na ʒi m-ba ka o loya ka yi lɔrig o na.
en: with these instructions: Go to the village there ahead of you; as you go in, you will find a colt tied up that has never been ridden. Untie it and bring it here.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni chɛ ka n yi m ba yiŋa n-chani gindi ŋɔ puuni, ka n yɛl o, A ni yɛn niŋ ma nirilim shɛli m-bɔŋɔ: Ti yi ti paai luɣ shɛlikam, nyin yɛlimi ni n nyɛla a tizɔdoo. .
en: God led me away from my fathers house. He led me to wander to many different places. When that happened, I told Sarah, Do something for me. Wherever we go, tell people you are my sister.

dag: Saha shɛli Jɛrimia ni daa be yiliguliba dundɔŋ la ni ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o.
en: While I was a prisoner in the courtyard of the palace guard, the Lord told me to say.

dag: Ka salo pam daa ʒi gbariti mini bɛn mali dalima bɛ niŋgbuna ni ni zoomba ni biriti ni dɔro balibu kam ni mali shɛb pam tahi o sanna, ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ kpaŋ.
en: A large crowd of people came to him. They brought many other sick people and put them before him. There were people who could not walk, people who were blind, crippled, or deaf, and many others. Jesus healed them all.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ puuni ka yurilim niŋ dɛde ti ni ni di chɛ ka ti ti tooi mali suhukpeeni saria karibu dali, dama o ni be shɛm, lala ka ti gba biɛhigu be dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: If we truly love others and live as Christ did in this world, we won't be worried about the day of judgment.

dag: Chɛ ka m min a laɣi tab zɔri kaman a ba mini m ba ni daa be shɛm la. Nyama, Anzinfa mini salima ŋɔ, n zaŋ li mi ti a pini. Larigim a mini Izraɛl Naa Baasha zɔsimdi alikauli la din ni chɛ ka o zaŋ o tɔbbihi yiɣisi ka chɛ ma.
en: I think we should sign a peace treaty, just as our fathers did. This silver and gold is a present for you. Would you please break your treaty with King Baasha of Israel and force him to leave my country.

dag: N kul ni paɣiri Yawɛ sahakam. O paɣibu yɛla kul ni be n nol ni sahakam.
en: I will always thank the Lord ; I will never stop praising him.

dag: Ka di yɛla daa moli gili Jɔpa zaa, ka niriba pam daa niŋ ti Duuma yɛda.
en: The news about this spread all over Joppa, and many people believed in the Lord.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt.

dag: Ti Duuma dabisili dali ka Naawuni Shia Kasi daa ti pali ma, ka n wum kukol shɛli n nyaaŋa polo ka di tahiri kaman kikaa vur la.
en: On the Lords Day, the Spirit took control of me. I heard a loud voice behind me that sounded like a trumpet.

dag: Ka Naa Darius daa dih o nuu zaligu gbɔŋ maa zuɣu.
en: And so King Darius signed the order.

dag: O yi kana, Kɛilanim ni gbaai ma ti o? O shiri nyɛla ŋun ni kana kaman mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ ni wum shɛm maa? Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, n suhir a, yɛlim mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ. Ka Yawɛ garigi yɛl o, O ni kana.
en: LORD God of Israel, will Saul come down as your servant has heard? Please tell your servant. Yes, he will come down, the LORD answered.

dag: Amaa ti Duuma nyɛla ŋun ʒe yim. O ni tin ya kpiɔŋ, ka gbib ya ka Sintani ku paai ya.
en: But the Lord is faithful. He will give you strength and protect you from the Evil One.

dag: hal ka bɛ ni so ti ku kpalim. Dama Anatɔtnim tibidarigibo yuuni yi ti paai, n ni chɛ ka alɔbo lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: And when I am finished, no one from their families will be left alive.

dag: Ka di ni ti nyɛla Aduna min o bidibisi la ni su shɛli, ka bɛ ni ti di li luɣ kasi shee la, dama di nyɛla o tarili din be kasi zaa, bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ puuni; ka di nyɛla o ni su shɛli sahakam.
en: The bread belongs to Aaron and his descendants, and they shall eat it in a holy place, because this is a very holy part of the food offered to the Lord for the priests.

dag: Dama n ni ti yihi Baalnim yuya o nol ni, ka o ku lan boli bɛ yuya yaha.
en: I will take the names of those false gods out of her mouth. Then people will not use those names again.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa garigi yɛli, Ti ku nyu wain, dama ti yab Jɔnadab ŋun daa nyɛ Rɛkab bia la daa yɛli ti ni ti mini ti bihi di nyu wain.
en: But they answered: No! The ancestor of our clan, Jonadab son of Rechab, made a rule that we must obey. He said, Don't ever drink wine.

dag: N ni daa kul suhiri Naawuni maa, ka Gabirɛl ŋun nyɛ n ni daa pun nya do so tuuli ʒii la ni la daa yiɣi ka n ni daa be luɣ shɛli maa na. Zaawuni sara maligu saha n-daa nyɛ li.
en: While I was praying, Gabriel, whom I had seen in the earlier vision, came flying down to where I was. It was the time for the evening sacrifice to be offered.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi puu ni bindir tuuli mini yi puu ni tiwala kom na ti ti ma di tibu saha, ka di niŋya zinchili. Zaŋmiya yi bidib tuuli kam ti ma.
en: Give me the offerings from your grain, your wine, and your olive oil when they are due. Give me your first-born sons.

dag: Di saha maa ka Zaliguzaɣisira maa ni ti yi zahira, ka ti Duuma Yisa ni ti zaŋ o vuhim pɔhim din yir o nol ni na ku o ka bah o yoli, ŋun Yisa palo yibu dali o labbuna saha.
en: Then the Wicked One will be revealed, but when the Lord Jesus comes, he will kill him with the breath from his mouth and destroy him with his dazzling presence.

dag: Di saha maa ka nyuli daa gbaai Yawɛ o tiŋgbɔŋ maa zuɣu, ka o zo o niriba maa nambɔɣu.
en: Then the Lord showed concern for his land; he had mercy on his people.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka yi leei tampiŋ nɛli doya, ka bɛ zaŋdi ziŋgbahiri lansi yɛrigiri deeni yi zuɣu. Ka so ti ku lan me yi dabari maa. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli maa. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will make you into a bare rock, a place for drying nets, and you will never be rebuilt. I, the LORD, have spoken. This is what the LORD God says.

dag: Dama di nyɛla talahi ni ti zaa ti zani Masia tooni ka o kari ti saria, ka sokam ti deeg o ni daa tum shɛm o niŋgbuŋ ni nyɔri, di yi nyɛla zaɣ suŋ bee zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: We must all stand before Christ to be judged. Everyone will get what they should. They will be paid for whatever they did—good or bad—when they lived in this earthly body.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, a daa tiligi ba a yuli zuɣu, ni lala chɛ ka a wuh a yiko tuma ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: But the Lord saved our ancestors for the honor of his name. He saved them to show his great power.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naawuni ni laɣim shɛba, sal ŋun miri ka o woligi ba.
en: And no one should separate a couple that God has joined together.

dag: Omaŋmaŋ yubu zuɣu ka o zaŋ ti leeg o bihi yɛlimaŋli yɛligu la puuni ni di chɛ ka ti leeg o bikpamba o binnamda zaa puuni.
en: God decided to give us life through the true message he sent to us. He wanted us to be the most important of all that he created.

dag: Di saha ka Bilidad ŋun daa nyɛ Shua nir la daa garigi bɔhi.
en: Then Bildad from Shuah answered:.

dag: Keenan nir ŋun daa nyɛ Arad naa m-be Nɛgɛb ni daa wum ni Izraɛlnim dolila Atarim polo kanna, ka o daa chaŋ ti ŋme ba tɔbu, ka gbahi bɛ shɛba ti leei daba.
en: The Canaanite king of Arad lived in the Negev. He heard that the Israelites were coming on the road to Atharim, so the king went out and attacked the Israelites. Arad captured some of the people and made them prisoners.

dag: Di pa shɛli o ni ŋmala sida tia bee ka o piila oki bee siɣirili n-zaŋ li sa nyɔŋ puuni, ka saa mi n-niŋ li ka di zooi niŋ kpiɔŋ.
en: He might cut down cedars to use, or choose oak or cypress wood from the forest. Or he might plant a laurel tree and wait for the rain to make it grow.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri duŋtaabo ni ʒi ba chaŋ, bɛ ni zaɣisi ni bɛ ku tum din tuhi zuɣu.
en: The wicked are doomed by their own violence; they refuse to do what is right.

dag: N je ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali tɛha buyiyi, amaa n yur a zaligu dina.
en: I hate fickle people, but I love your Instruction.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn simdi ni bɛ ti neei kum ni n-kpe nyɛvili din ka bahigu shee ti ku kpuɣiri paɣiba bee n-zaŋdi bɛ bipuɣinsi tiri dɔbba.
en: but the men and women who are worthy to rise from death and live in the age to come will not then marry.

dag: n-yɛri malaika ŋun pah ayɔbu m-mali kikaa maa, Lɔrigim malaikanim anahi shɛb bɛ ni lo n-zali mɔɣ titali din yuli booni Yufretiiz ni la bahi.
en: The voice said to the sixth angel, Release the four angels who are bound at the great Euphrates River.

dag: Ka salo maa daa yɛl o, Ti pun wum Naawuni zaligu puuni ni Masia ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu; ka wula ka a yɛli ni shee bɛ zaŋ Daadam Bia sa zuɣusaa? Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Daadam Bia maa.
en: The crowd responded, We have heard from the Law that the Christ remains forever. How can you say that the Human One must be lifted up? Who is this Human One.

dag: Ka Izraɛl naa mini Juda naa ni Ɛdom naa daa laɣim chaŋ. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti paai daba ayopɔin chandi tariga ka kom pooi ba, hal ka shɛli kani ka bɛ tɔbbihi mini bɛ ni daa ʒiri biŋkɔb shɛb chani ni nyu.
en: So the king of Israel went with the king of Judah and the king of Edom. They traveled around for seven days. There was not enough water for the army or for their animals.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, Malɔn pakoli Rut ŋun nyɛ Mɔab nir la gba ni leegi m paɣa. Ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka ŋun kpi la zuliya na kul su tiŋgbani maa, ka o yuli ni be o niriba ni min o ya. Ka yinim mi n-di di shɛhira zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: In addition, Ruth the Moabite, Mahlon's widow, becomes my wife. This will keep the property in the dead man's family, and his family line will continue among his people and in his hometown. You are witnesses to this today.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ zaŋm a niriba yi yuŋ chaŋ mɔɣu ni nti sɔɣ dɔni gu ba.
en: Now then, you and your men should move by night and hide in the fields.

dag: Naa Jɔsia daa nyɛla na so ŋun ŋmaligi lab Naawuni sani ni o suhu zaa ni o shia zaa ni o kpiɔŋ zaa kaman Musa zaligu puuni ni sab wuhi shɛm zaa. Ka na so daa ka na shɛb bɛn daŋ o tooni mini bɛn zaa daa dol o nyaaŋa puuni m-be ka o ni be shɛm.
en: No other king before or after Josiah tried as hard as he did to obey the Law of Moses.

dag: M bia, Yawɛ yi saɣis a, nyin di lihi ʒiɛm li bee o yi kpah a zuɣu ni, nyin di chɛ ka a nyee nyɔni.
en: Dont reject the instruction of the LORD, my son; dont despise his correction.

dag: Ka so daa bi tooi garig o bɔhigu maa; ka dindali maa zaŋ chana, so daa bi lan buɣisi ni o bɔh o bɔhigu yaha.
en: No one was able to give Jesus an answer, and from that day on, no one dared ask him any more questions.

dag: Dama di sab o yɛla Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli: A nyɛla maligumaana ŋun tuma ni be kaman Mɛlikizɛdɛk tuma la hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: The Scriptures say about him, You are a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.

dag: A naŋgbampiba ŋmanila gali ʒee, ka a noli viɛli pam. A kparima ŋmanila pumpɔrinchi bɔɣa m-be a sariga ni.
en: Your lips are like a scarlet ribbon; how lovely they are when you speak. Your cheeks glow behind your veil.

dag: Dama ʒiɛmana pam din gari la ha zaŋ kana ni pumpɔŋɔ, bɛ kul karindila Anabi Musa zaligu Yɛhudianim tiŋ kam jɛmbu duu ni Vuhim Dabisili dali kam ka karimbanima naanyi yihir o yɛligu waazu.
en: They should not do any of these things, because there are still men in every city who teach the Law of Moses. The words of Moses have been read in the synagogue every Sabbath day for many years.

dag: O suhu daa yiɣisiya, ka o lan je ma, ka dari tɔhi ma. O daa dim o nyina ni niŋ ma. O mirig o nina niŋ ma kaman o dima n-nyɛ ma la.
en: His anger tears me and afflicts me; he slashes at me with his teeth. My enemy pierces me with his eyes.

dag: Musa daa zalila Lɛvinim bɛn daa ʒiri Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka la zaligu yɛli.
en: When he finished, he said to the levitical priests, who were in charge of the Lord 's Covenant Box.

dag: N-yi biɛɣ asibaasi ka o daa lan lab Naawuni jɛmbu duu yaha; ka niriba daa laɣim o sanna, ka o ʒini gbaai ba wuhibu.
en: Early in the morning he returned to the temple. All the people gathered around him, and he sat down and taught them.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka Naawuni chɛ ka biriginsim yiko kpe bɛ ni birigi ba, ka bɛ doli ʒiri soli.
en: And so God sends the power of error to work in them so that they believe what is false.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri mini zuliya shɛb bɛn zaa tam Naawuni yɛla ni ti chaŋ ti be kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: The wicked will go to the place of death, as will all the nations that forget God.

dag: Ka kukoli maa lan yɛli ma pahi buyi, Naawuni ni lihi binshɛŋa bin suma, nyin miri ka a bol li bin yoya.
en: The voice from heaven spoke a second time, Never consider unclean what God has made pure.

dag: dama Naawuni fukumsi zaligu daa bi tooi chɛ ka binshɛli niŋ dɛde; amaa din lee beni nyɛla, tahima suŋ din gari li yipa kana, ka ti ni tooi miri Naawuni di zuɣu.
en: because the Law cannot make anything perfect. At the same time, we are given a much better hope, and it can bring us close to God.

dag: Zuɣusaa katiŋ ha, paɣim o! Kom din be sagbana zuɣusaa ha, paɣim o.
en: You highest heaven, praise God! Do the same, you waters that are above the sky!.

dag: Di chaŋya; di chɛliya ka yi dimnim maa ti kun ya, dama Yawɛ ka yi sani.
en: Dont go up, for the LORD isnt with you. Dont be struck down before your enemies.

dag: Dindali maa zaŋ chana, bɛ daa booni Gidiɔn la Jɛrubaal, Di gbinni nyɛla, Chɛliya ka buɣili Baal min o va; dama o bimbini ka o wurim maa.
en: So on that day Gideon became known as Jerubbaal, meaning, Let Baal argue with him, because he tore down his altar.

dag: Ka Sool tumtumdiba maa daa yɛli Dauda yɛtɔɣa maa. Ka Dauda bɔhi ba, Yi tɛhiya ni di nyɛla asama ni n leei naa deemba? Dama yi nya ka n nyɛla faralana, ka pa yulilana.
en: Sauls servants whispered these things in Davids ear. But David said, Do you think its a simple matter to become the kings son-in-law? I dont! Im poor and insignificant.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa lan zaŋ li ti sa tiŋgban nɛli ni, luɣ shɛli kom ni kani, ka di tiŋgbani kuui.
en: Now that grapevine is planted in the desert. It is a very dry and thirsty land.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan yɛli ba yaha, Malimiya shili, ka nyo yi firilanim zali ka di dira;.
en: Be ready for whatever comes, dressed for action and with your lamps lit.

dag: Naawuni yi be ti sani, ti ni di nasara. Ŋuna n-yɛn du n-tam ti dimnim zuɣu.
en: With God on our side we will win; he will defeat our enemies.

dag: Ka yi yi ti wum ka bɛ piɛbiri piɛla yila kikahi maa ka di kumdi yuui, yinim bɛn nyɛ tɔbbihi maa zaa yin duhimi yi yee n-kul tahiri pampam, di saha tiŋ maa goondaa maa ni kab lu, ka yi zaa kab ti kpe di ni.
en: They will make one loud noise from the trumpets. When you hear that noise, tell all the people to begin shouting. When you do this, the walls of the city will fall down and your people will be able to go straight into the city.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn zabila yi zuɣu, ka bɔhi biɛri tin ya. N ni chɛ ka Babilɔn teeku kom nyuui, ka chɛ ka di kɔbilisirim gba nyuui.
en: Therefore, the LORD proclaims: Im going to defend your cause; Ill turn the tables on your attacker. Ill dry up her sea; Ill shut up her springs.

dag: Ti Duuma Naawuni daa bi boli ti ni ti ti tumdila niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma, amaa o daa boli ti ni ti ti dolila kasitali biɛhigu soli.
en: God didn't choose you to be filthy, but to be pure.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ, ka o nyaandoliba pinaayi la chaŋ o sani nti yɛl o, Bahim niriba ŋɔ ka bɛ chaŋ pukpariba bɛn puri miri ti ŋɔ na mini tiŋkpansi din baɣ ti ŋɔ ni nti da bindira di ka gbe nimaani, dama kpe nyɛla mɔɣu ni.
en: Late in the afternoon the twelve apostles came to Jesus and said, Send the crowd to the villages and farms around here. They need to find a place to stay and something to eat. There is nothing in this place. It's like a desert.

dag: Dama m mali yɛtɔɣa pam, ka n ku chɛ li tɔɣisibu.
en: because I have so much to say, that I can't keep quiet.

dag: Ŋun di nasara, n ni chɛ ka m min o laɣim ʒini n nam ʒiishee kaman n gba ni daa di nasara ka m mini m Ba Naawuni laɣim ʒi o nam ʒiishee shɛm la.
en: I will let everyone who wins the victory sit with me on my throne. It was the same with me. I won the victory and sat down with my Father on his throne.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Di saha n ni ti nyɛ Izraɛlnim zaa Naawuni, ka bɛ mi nyɛ n niriba.
en: At that time, declares the LORD, I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they will be my people.

dag: Ka kukoli maa lan yɛli ma pahi buyi, Naawuni ni lihi binshɛŋa bin suma, nyin miri ka a bol li bin yoya.
en: The voice spoke again from heaven, Do not consider anything unclean that God has declared clean.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka yi leei tampiŋ nɛli doya, ka bɛ zaŋdi ziŋgbahiri lansi yɛrigiri deeni yi zuɣu. Ka so ti ku lan me yi dabari maa. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli maa. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: because I will turn you into a bare rock where fishermen can dry their nets. And you will never rebuild your city. I, the Lord God, make this promise.

dag: A ni varisi pɔhim ni ʒe n-tɔhigi va shɛli bahi, ka kari doli wurigu din kuui?.
en: Do you really enjoy frightening a fallen leaf?.

dag: Niriba maa zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahinaayi ni kɔbisita ni pihiyɔbu.
en: The whole assembly together totaled .

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa boli Ijipti baŋdiba mini bukpahinim bɛn nyɛ timanim na, ka bɛ gba daa ti tum bɛ tabibi tuma niŋ lala.
en: So Pharaoh called for his wise men and magicians. These men used their magic, and they were able to do the same thing as Aaron.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka a bɔhira, Bɔ ka Naawuni lee mi? O ni tooi kari saria zibisim titali puuni?.
en: You say: What does God know? Can he judge through thick clouds?.

dag: M mi noonsi zaa, ka biŋkɔbiri zaa bɛn gɔri ginda nyɛla n dini.
en: I know every bird in the mountains. Everything that moves in the fields is mine.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Zaŋmi li bahi tiŋa. Ka o zaŋ li bahi tiŋa ka di leei wahu, ka Musa tirisi lab nyaaŋa ka chɛ li.
en: Throw it down! the Lord commanded. So Moses threw the stick on the ground. It immediately turned into a snake, and Moses jumped back.

dag: Pɛriʒia Naa Atazɛrikisɛs ʒiɛman ni, Bishilam mini Mitrɛdat ni Tabiil ni bɛ tab bɛn kpalim daa sabila gbaŋ ti Pɛriʒia Naa Atazɛrikisɛs Aramaik yɛtɔɣa ni, ka daa lɛbigi li.
en: In the days of Artaxerxes, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and the rest of their associates wrote to Persias King Artaxerxes. The letter was written in Aramaic and translated.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka Naa Agiripa mini Bɛɛnis di nachiinsi pam, ka bɛ mini sapashinnim mini tiŋ maa ni ninvuɣ zuɣuri daa chaŋ ti kpe bɛ laɣiŋgu duu. Ka Gomna Fɛstus daa tim ka bɛ ti zaŋ Pool na.
en: The next day Agrippa and Bernice came to the meeting with great show, acting like very important people. They entered the room with military leaders and important men of the city. Festus ordered the soldiers to bring Paul in.

dag: Yurilim zuɣu ka bɛmbɔŋɔnim bɛn niŋdi lala maa, dama bɛ mi ni Naawuni zaŋ lahibal suŋ ŋɔ zuɣu zabbu tuma ti ma.
en: These do so from love, because they know that God has given me the work of defending the gospel.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔ pala o ni lo shɛm bee di pun bela o suhu ni, amaa o lola nia ni o saɣim ka kpihim zuliya pam birili.
en: He has even bigger plans in mind, because he wants to destroy many nations.

dag: Jɛta bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Jɛfune ni Pisipa ni Ara.
en: Jethers sons were Jephunneh, Pispah, and Ara.

dag: Ka paɣ so yi yila o yidana yiŋa, ŋun kpalimmi ʒiya; ka di yi pa lala, ŋun niŋmi sandaani niŋ o yidan kuro maa, ka lan lab o yiŋa. Ka doo mi miri ka o yih o paɣa.
en: should either stay single or go back to her husband. And a husband should not leave his wife.

dag: Di dubihi mini di pilanim ni di zɔntuhi mini dina la zaa daa nyɛla yim. Ka takɔriti be di ni zaa gili. Di ziliŋ daa nyɛla mita pisinaanu, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pinaayi ni pirigili.
en: including the guardrooms, the walls separating them, and the entrance room. There were also windows in this gate. It was meters long and . meters wide.

dag: N daa yɛli ya, Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni, dinzuɣu miriya ka yi jɛm Amɔrinim shɛb tiŋgbɔŋ ni yi ni be ŋɔ wuna la. Amaa ka yi zaɣisi n noli.
en: I told you that I am the Lord your God and that you should not worship the gods of the Amorites, whose land you are now living in. But you have not listened to me.

dag: Ti zaligu wuhiya ni ti karimi nir saria ka na bi bɔh o baŋ o ni niŋ shɛli.
en: Our Law doesnt judge someone without first hearing him and learning what he is doing, does it.

dag: ka di nyɛla yi ni mali tahima shɛli alizanda ni la zuɣu. Yi daa pun wum dimbɔŋɔ yɛla la yɛlimaŋli lahibal suŋ din daa ka yi sanna la ni.
en: You have this faith and love because of the hope reserved for you in heaven. You previously heard about this hope through the true message, the good news.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam mo Naawuni Shia Kasi ŋun kul ku nya di chɛ m-paŋ Naawuni sani hal abada, amaa o daalahichi maa kul ni ʒi o zuɣu hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: But whoever says evil things against the Holy Spirit will never be forgiven, because he has committed an eternal sin. .

dag: Ka Ilaisha garigi yɛl o, Di ku ba. A ni ku a ni zaŋ a takɔb min a tɔbu n-gbahi shɛb leeg a daba? Bomi la bindirigu ti ba ka bɛ di ka nyu kom, ka lab bɛ naa sani.
en: Elisha answered, No, dont kill them. They are not soldiers you captured in battle. Give them some bread and water. Let them eat and drink. Then let them go home to their leader.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti zaŋ tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli n-she pateesa, ka bo gali sabilifaa mini gali ʒiɛkpeein ni gali ʒiɛkpain n-chɛ ka tuumbaŋda zaŋ li wuɣi chɛrubinim pa di zuɣu.
en: Make a veil of blue, purple, and deep red yarns and of fine twisted linen. Work figures of winged heavenly creatures into its design.

dag: Bi so ŋun mali yɛm, ŋuna n-deeri o ba saɣisigu, amaa ansarisimaana bi deeri zuɣu ni kpahibu.
en: Wise children pay attention when their parents correct them, but arrogant people never admit they are wrong.

dag: Ka Dauda daa kpuɣ o zuɣu lihi nya ka Yawɛ malaika maa ʒiɛla tiŋgbani mini zuɣusaa sunsuuni, ka ŋooi takɔbi gbib o nuu ni n-teeg o nuu maa tiri Jɛrusalɛm. Di saha ka Dauda min o kpamba daa chibi kpalansi ye n-lu n-zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tiŋa.
en: David saw the Lord 's angel in the air, holding a sword over Jerusalem. He and the leaders of Israel, who were all wearing sackcloth, bowed with their faces to the ground.

dag: Di saha ka o daa neei bɛ nini ni bɛ baŋ Naawuni litaafinim maa gbinni.
en: Then he opened their minds to understand the scriptures.

dag: Ka yɛlli maa daa muɣisi Siria naa maa pam ka o bol o sapashinnim na nti bɔhi ba, Yi ni ŋuni n-lee be Izraɛl naa polo.
en: The king of Syria was furious when he found out what was happening. He called in his officers and asked, Which one of you has been telling the king of Israel our plans.

dag: ka yɛli Yisa, Karimba, paɣ ŋɔ bela zina tumbu ni ka ti gbaag o.
en: Then they said, Teacher, this woman was caught sleeping with a man who isn't her husband.

dag: Yɛlimiya Aakipus ni di niŋ kamaata ni o tum ti Duuma ni ti o tuun shɛl la naai.
en: And tell Archippus, Be sure to finish the task you were given in the Lord's service.

dag: Yɛligu maa ni ka binshɛɣukam zaa nyɛvili daa yina, ka nyɛvili maa daa nyɛ neesim ninsalinim sani.
en: through the Word was life, and the life was the light for all people.

dag: Mmaŋmaŋ ni pirigi yi situra n-dihi ya vi.
en: The Lord himself will strip off your clothes and expose you to shame.

dag: yɛli, Nyam doo ŋɔ ni pil o duu ŋɔ mɛbu ka tarigi li me n-naai.
en: You began to build but can't finish the job! they will say.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd mini Gomna Pailɛt daa malila dimdi ni taba, amaa dindali maa zaŋ chana bɛ daa laɣila tab zɔri.
en: Pilate and Herod became friends with each other that day. Before this, they had been enemies.

dag: Amaa n lihiya nya ka so kani. So ka bɛ ni n-nyɛ yɛtɔɣ tɔɣisira, ka n ni bɔh o bɔhigu ka o garigi.
en: When I looked among the gods, none of them had a thing to say; not one could answer the questions I asked.

dag: Absalom daa niŋ yuma ayi Jɛrusalɛm ka o nini bi nya naa.
en: Absalom lived in Jerusalem for two full years without being allowed to visit King David.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, ŋun guli Izraɛlnim pala gom ni gbaari so bee ŋun ni gbihi.
en: The protector of Israel never dozes or sleeps.

dag: Dama n suhu daa zɔhirimi ni Yawɛ suhu ni yiɣisi pam bahi yi zuɣu shɛm maa, o ni kun ya. Amaa ka Yawɛ daa lan wum n suhigu di saha maa gba.
en: I was afraid of the Lord s terrible anger. He was angry enough to destroy you, but the Lord listened to me again.

dag: Tiligim ma ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ tuumbiɛtumdiba nuu ni, ka fa ma ninvuɣ kuriba nuu ni bahi.
en: Keep me safe from brutal people who want to kill me.

dag: Mbusim be yi zuɣu, yi zali yiya tuɣi taba, ka gbahi paliti tuɣi taba hal ka so ti ku lan nya palo nimaani pahi yi zuɣu, ka yi kɔŋko n-kul be tiŋgbani maa ni.
en: Look at you people! You join houses to houses and fields to fields until there is no room for anyone else. But when the punishment comes, you will be forced to live alone. You will be the only people in the whole land.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee niŋ ti ni yɛli shɛm yɛda? Ka ŋuni ka Yawɛ lee kahig o yiko wuhi?.
en: The people reply, Who would have believed what we now report? Who could have seen the Lord 's hand in this?.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba yaha, Suhimiya! Naawuni ni tin ya. Bomiya! Yi ni nya. Niŋmiya gaafara! Yi ni nya soli kpe.
en: Continue to ask, and God will give to you. Continue to search, and you will find. Continue to knock, and the door will open for you.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛr a, zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ a ni ti be n sani Naawuni yili.
en: Jesus replied, I assure you that today you will be with me in paradise.

dag: Bɛ tɔɣisirila yɛtɔɣ biɛri zaŋ chaŋ alizanda polo, ka chɛ ka bɛ zilima yɛtɔɣa paai dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam zaa.
en: They think they are gods! They think they are the rulers of the earth.

dag: Ka Sool daa chaŋ Amalɛknim maa ya nti sɔɣi dɔni vinvamli ni.
en: then led them to a valley near one of the towns in Amalek, where they got ready to make a surprise attack.

dag: dama tuma so titali ka n nya kpe, ka sɔguriba pam mi lee beni.
en: In spite of the fact that there are many opponents, a big and productive opportunity has opened up for my mission here.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ biɛɣ pihinahi dali, ka Nuhu daa yooi ŋariŋ maa takɔr shɛli o ni daa chib la.
en: Forty days later Noah opened a window to send out a raven, but it kept flying around until the water had dried up.

dag: Bihi n-nahindi n niriba, ka paɣiba su ba. N niriba, yi zuɣulaannima m-birigi ya, ka chɛ ka yi tum yi soya.
en: As for my people—oppressors strip them and swindlers rule them. My people—your leaders mislead you and confuse your paths.

dag: O darigiri deera, ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi gu o soli? Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi bɔh o, Bɔ ka a lee niŋdi maa.
en: He takes what he wants, and no one can stop him; no one dares ask him, What are you doing.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa mini bɛ kpamba bɛn daa lo alikauli maa daa saɣi ni bɛ ni bahi bɛ daba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba, ka ku lan zaŋ ba niŋ daba yaha. Ka bɛ daa saɣi ka bahi ba.
en: All the people and their leaders agreed to free their slaves and never to enslave them again. They did set them free.

dag: Bɛ yi kul saɣisiri nira, ka o kul niŋdi tipawumli, o ni ti kabisi yim ka ku lan tooi tib kpaŋ.
en: Some people refuse to bend when someone corrects them. Eventually they will break, and there will be no one to repair the damage.

dag: Lala mi n-nyɛ li, yi yi ti nyari ka shihira ŋɔ zaa niŋda, yin baŋmiya ni di saha miriya hal ka di ku lan yuui gba.
en: In the same way, when you see these things happening, you know that hes near, at the door.

dag: Ka ti zaŋ m bia duɣi ŋubi n-kaai biɛɣu, ka n yɛl o, Zaŋm a bidibiga la na ka ti duɣi ŋub, ka ŋun zaŋ o bidibiga maa ti sɔɣi. .
en: So we boiled my son and ate him. Then the next day, I said to this woman, Give me your son so that we can eat him. But she has hidden her son.

dag: Amaa Karia bia Jɔhanan mini tɔbbihi sapashin kpamba zaa bɛn be o sani ni daa wum Nɛtania bia Ishimail ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa maa zaa.
en: Johanan and the other army officers heard what Ishmael had done.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn yɛli ba, N ku leei yi naa; ka m bidibiga gba ku leei yi naa sun ya; Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi naa ŋun sun ya.
en: No, Gideon replied, I won't be your king, and my son won't be king either. Only the Lord is your ruler.

dag: Ŋunkam sɔɣi ku o kpee, noli din dim o. Ka sokam yɛli, Ami.
en: God's curse on anyone who secretly commits murder. And all the people will answer, Amen.

dag: Asa ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa piligu ni hal ni di bahigu ni bɛ sabi di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim mini Izraɛl nanim yɛlikura litaafi ni.
en: All the events of Asa's reign from beginning to end are recorded in The History of the Kings of Judah and Israel .

dag: Dinzuɣu ka naa maa daa tim ni bɛ chaŋ ti boli timanim mini saŋmaribaŋdiba ni baɣisi ni Kalidianim na ka bɛ ti wuh o o zahindi maa gbinni. Ka bɛ daa kana ti ʒini naa maa tooni.
en: so he sent for his fortunetellers, magicians, sorcerers, and wizards to come and explain the dream to him. When they came and stood before the king.

dag: N ni chɛ ka daadamnim nyabu ti niŋ tom kaman salima din viɛla nyabu ni to shɛm la, ka chɛ ka ninsalinim nyabu niŋ tom kaman Ofiri salima nyabu ni to shɛm la.
en: Those who survive will be scarcer than gold.

dag: Ka zuɣulaannim maa daa lan zaŋ bɛ pina ka sara maligu bimbini gbinna bɛ ni daa zaŋ sara maligu bimbini maa ti Naawuni ka booi kpam bahi di zuɣu saha shɛl la.
en: The chiefs made their presentations for the dedication of the altar on the day it was anointed. The chiefs presented their offerings before the altar.

dag: Binyara ŋɔ bi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa kaman ninsalinim ni tɔɣisiri shɛm. So mi bi wumdi di kukoya.
en: You cannot hear them say anything. They dont make any sound we can hear.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ paɣila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔr o mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ o yurilim maŋli la naani.
en: The Lord enjoys people who worship him and trust in his faithful love.

dag: ni binyaannina ayi la mini kpam din be binshee ni, ka yihi binsabili yaɣ shɛli din viɛl pahi binyaannin shɛŋa o ni yihi maa zuɣu, ka di leei o ni zaŋ sara shɛli nyo buɣim ti Yawɛ.
en: He will offer the two kidneys and the fat covering them near the lower back muscle. He will also offer the fat part of the liver. He will remove it with the kidneys.

dag: Amaa n daa kul pii ya mi kaman wain ti viɛlli bira la n-zaŋna ti sa, ka bɔzuɣu ka yi taɣi n-lee mɔɣu ni wain tia?.
en: Yet it was I who planted you, a precious vine of fine quality; how could you turn into a wild vine and become good for nothing?.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti zaŋ o kɔhi Ishimail zuliya ŋɔ zuɣu, ka di chɛliya ka ti niŋ o shɛli, dama o nyɛla ti tizo ni timaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ. Ka o mabihi maa daa wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Let's sell him to the Ishmaelites and not harm him. After all, he is our brother. And the others agreed.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Taainim tuumbiɛri buta ni bunahi zuɣu, n ku chɛ bɛ tibili darigibu. Dama bɛ gbahi tiŋ muni niriba zaa n-tahi Ɛdom, ka bi gbib bɛ mini ba ni daa lo alikauli shɛl la.
en: This is what the Lord says: I will definitely punish the people of Tyre for the many crimes they did. They took an entire nation and sent them as slaves to Edom. They did not remember the agreement they had made with their brothers.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti ni nyɛ bɛn yi Naawuni ni na maa zuɣu, di bi simdi ni ti tɛhi ni Naawuni ŋmanila buɣ shɛŋa tuumbaŋdiba ni zaŋ salima mini anzinfa ni kuɣa maani bɛmaŋmaŋ yɛm puuni la.
en: Since we are God's children, we must not think that he is like an idol made out of gold or silver or stone. He isn't like anything that humans have thought up and made.

dag: O teeg o nambɔzɔbo yɛla, ka sɔŋ o dabili Izraɛl.
en: God helps his servant Israel and is always merciful to his people.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ, a mi ni anabinim kul be kpe n-yɛri ba, Tɔbu ku lan ŋmɛn ya, ka kum mi ku lan lu yi zuɣu, amaa n kul yɛn tin ya la suhudoo ni yɛlimaŋli tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni. .
en: But I said, Lord GOD, the prophets were telling the people something different. They were telling the people of Judah, You will not suffer from war or from hunger. The Lord will give you peace in this land.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka o daa kpuɣ o nuu zuɣusaa, ka po ni o ni chɛ ka bɛ kpi yɔɣu maa ni.
en: So he swore that they would die in the desert.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Di bi sabi yimaŋmaŋ zaligu ni ni Naawuni yɛliya ni yi nyɛla Naawuni ŋmahinli?.
en: Jesus answered, It is written in your own Law that God said, You are gods.

dag: Ka malaika so ŋun daa yɛli ma yɛtɔɣa maa daa lan labina nti neei ma kaman nir ni yi gbihiri ka bɛ neeg o shɛm la.
en: Then the angel who was talking to me returned and woke me up. I was like a person waking up from sleep.

dag: Man mɛla du shɛli din mali jilima ti a ni di nyɛ a ni yɛn be luɣ shɛli sahakam.
en: Now, Lord, I have built a beautiful Temple for you, where you may live forever.

dag: Miriya ka yi yɛli Naawuni yɛtɔɣ yoya bee n-tu yi niriba toondana.
en: Don't speak evil of me or of the ruler of your people.

dag: Ka Miriam daa yiini yila yɛra: Yilimiya yila paɣi Yawɛ, dama o di nasara din mali jilima, ka daai wɔribara min o wɔhu zaa niŋ teeku ni.
en: Miriam sang for them: Sing to the Lord , because he has won a glorious victory; he has thrown the horses and their riders into the sea.

dag: Ka Simiɔn daa suhi Naawuni daalibarika niŋ o ni ka yɛl o ma Mariama, Nyama, Izraɛlnim pam ni ti lula bia ŋɔ zuɣu, ka bɛ pam mi ti yiɣisila o zuɣu. O lan nyɛla shihir shɛli niriba ni ni ti tɔɣisi jɛndi.
en: Simeon blessed them and said to Mary, his mother, This child is chosen by God for the destruction and the salvation of many in Israel. He will be a sign from God which many people will speak against.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam je o mabia, o bela zibisim ni ka kul chanila zibisim maa puuni ka ʒi o ni kpari shɛli polo, dama zibisim maa zom o nina.
en: If we hate others, we are living and walking in the dark. We don't know where we are going, because we can't see in the dark.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ a daba bihi ni be ni alaafee. Bɛ zuliya ni ti nya zaa zani a sani.
en: Our children will live in safety, and under your protection their descendants will be secure.

dag: Yaakubu zuliya, chɛliya ka ti be Yawɛ neesim ni chana.
en: People of Israel, let's live by the light of the Lord .

dag: Amaa ka Sanbalat ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtihɔrɔn nir la mini Tɔbaya ŋun mi daa nyɛ Ammɔnnim tumtumdiba zuɣulan la daa wum ni ninvuɣ so kana ni o ti tum tuun shɛli din ni sɔŋ Izraɛlnima, ka di daa bi niŋ ba nyaɣisim zaa.
en: When Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the Ammonite official heard this, they were very angry that someone had come to seek the welfare of the people of Israel.

dag: Bɛ daa pun bar o la bandi ka lɔr o zoligɔnima, ka o chihiri li ka kabiri bandi maa; ka so ku tooi maag o nini.
en: many times his feet and his hands had been tied, but every time he broke the chains and smashed the irons on his feet. He was too strong for anyone to control him.

dag: O daa kul chanila buɣa jɛmbu shee mini zoya zuɣu ni ti mahili kam gbini nti maani maligu ka tuɣindi tulaale zim.
en: Ahaz made sacrifices and burned incense at the high places and on the hills and under every green tree.

dag: ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka o nini nya ka zuɣusaa bɔɣi, ka o nya binshɛli ka di kɔtomsi be kaman adiiku tital la, ka di sirigiri o sanna hal ti paai tiŋa.
en: He saw heaven opened up and something like a large linen sheet being lowered to the earth by its four corners.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛl taba, Chɛliya ka ti pii so leei ti zuɣulana n-lab Ijipti.
en: So they said to each other, Lets pick a leader and lets go back to Egypt.

dag: n-yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ, pa nyini n-nyɛ alizanda Naawuni? Pa nyin n-nyɛ ŋun su zuliya kam zaa nam fukumsi? Kpiɔŋ mini yiko bela a nuu ni, ka so ku tooi mo a.
en: and said, Lord God of our ancestors, you are the God in heaven. You rule over all the kingdoms in all the nations. You have power and strength. No one can stand against you.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa garigi yɛli ma, Sabimi a ni nya ʒii shɛli maa ka chɛ ka di yi zahira pa kuɣiparilana zuɣu, ka ŋun guura ni tooi karim li. .
en: Then the LORD answered me and said, Write a vision, and make it plain upon a tablet so that a runner can read it.

dag: Yi ni ti zaŋ ba zali Yawɛ tooni, ka maligumaana ti niŋ yalim bahi bɛ zuɣu, ka zaŋ ba mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la ti Yawɛ.
en: You will present them to the LORD. The priests will throw salt on them and offer them as entirely burned offerings to the LORD.

dag: N di bi zaɣisi ka bɛ zaŋ chiriga n-chirigi li pa tampiŋ zuɣu, ka di kul beni sahakam!.
en: or chiseled into rock.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee chɛ ka mɔɣu ni buŋ gɔr o yubu? Ka ŋuni n-lee gaai mɔɣu ni bun so ŋun zɔri pam naba ni tanachi?.
en: Who freed the wild donkey, loosed the ropes of the onager.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ tarimba mal alibarika, dama bɛ ni ti su dunia ŋɔ.
en: Happy are people who are humble, because they will inherit the earth.

dag: Yɛhudianim adiini zaligunim nyɛla bin suma din ti yɛn kana ŋmahinli, ka pa binshɛŋa din nyɛ alali. Ka bɛ ni daa kul maani sara shɛŋa yuuni kam la daa bi tooi chɛ ka bɛn vu m-miri Naawuni di zuɣu be dɛde.
en: The Law is a shadow of the good things that are coming, not the real things themselves. It never can perfect the ones who are trying to draw near to God through the same sacrifices that are offered continually every year.

dag: N kul nɛmi doya; n ŋmanila noombil ŋun be mɔpilli zuɣu o ko.
en: or a restless sparrow alone on a roof.

dag: Di saha ka Firawuna daa boli Musa mini Aduna ti yɛli ba, Pumpɔŋɔ n tum taali; Yawɛ mali yɛlimaŋli, m mini n niriba ŋɔ galimya.
en: The king sent for Moses and Aaron and said, This time I have sinned; the Lord is in the right, and my people and I are in the wrong.

dag: dama ŋunkam kul nyurila bihim nyɛla ŋun yɛm na bi goligi wuntia yɛtɔɣa puuni, ka o na kul nyɛla bia.
en: Everyone who lives on milk is not used to the word of righteousness, because they are babies.

dag: A ni nyɛ Yisa Masia tɔbbia ŋun ʒe yim la zuɣu, pahimi ti zuɣu di wahala.
en: Accept your share of suffering like a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

dag: Takɔriti kulis ata daa beni. Takɔriti maa daa tuhila taba, ka tam tab ʒii buta zuɣu.
en: Three sets of window frames faced each other.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Juda daa yɛli Onan, Zaŋm a biɛli pakoli maa dɔni, ka niŋ di ni simdi ni a niŋ shɛm wuhi ni o yidan tizo n-nyɛ a, ka zaŋ o dɔɣi bihi ti a biɛli maa.
en: Then Judah said to Ers brother Onan, Go and sleep with your dead brothers wife. Become like a husband to her. If children are born, they will belong to your brother Er.

dag: Ɛhab ni daa kpi maa, o bia Ahazia n-daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: At his death his son Ahaziah succeeded him as king.

dag: Ka o daa lan niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol o yuli Juda ka yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ dina n ni paɣi Yawɛ. Di nyaaŋa ka o daa chɛ dɔɣibu.
en: Then she became pregnant again and gave birth to another son. She said, This time I will praise the Lord ; so she named him Judah. Then she stopped having children.

dag: Bihi, deemiya yi banim mini yi manim noya binshɛɣukam zaa ni, dama dina n-tiɣiri ti Duuma nini.
en: Children, obey your parents in everything, because this pleases the Lord.

dag: A yi bi fa bɛ ni zaŋ ninvuɣ so chani ni bɛ ti ku m-bahi, ka o chani ŋun yɛn ku o sani ka o naba sɔhira.
en: Rescue those being taken off to death; and from those staggering to the slaughter, dont hold back.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n yɛri ya, alahichi balibu kam tumbu mini Naawuni mɔbu zaa, ninsalinim ni tooi nya di taali chɛ m-paŋ Naawuni sani, amaa ŋunkam mo Naawuni Shia Kasi, dilana ŋun kul ku nya di chɛ m-paŋ Naawuni sani.
en: So I tell you, people can be forgiven for every sinful thing they do and for every bad thing they say against God. But anyone who speaks against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.

dag: Lala ka Naawuni daa nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ ni di binshɛɣukam zaa naai.
en: And so the whole universe was completed.

dag: Bɛ lan nyɛla bɛn nyari tibidarigibo ni biɛrim bɛ bindoo zuɣu, ka kul nyari biɛrim bɛ kɔba ni.
en: God corrects us by sending sickness and filling our bodies with pain.

dag: Ka nir yi yuri Naawuni ni o suhu zaa min o tɛha zaa ni o kpiɔŋ tariga, ka yur o ʒiʒiinikpee kaman omaŋmaŋ la, di gari sara malibu balibu kam.
en: It is also true that we must love God with all our heart, mind, and strength, and that we must love others as much as we love ourselves. These commandments are more important than all the sacrifices and offerings that we could possibly make.

dag: Chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒiri bimbira chani biribu, ka kumdi ti ʒi bɛ ni biri shɛli maa bɔba kuna ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Let those who go out, crying and carrying their seed, come home with joyful shouts, carrying bales of grain!.

dag: Di puuni ninvuɣ zuɣuri tim bɛ tumtumdiba ni bɛ ti ŋɔŋ kom na. Ka bɛ chaŋ kɔbilisi ni nti bi nya kom, ka ŋmaligi zaŋ bɛ kɔŋɔŋdi biŋkuma labi kuli. Vi gbahi ba ka di niŋ ba alahiziba, ka bɛ zaŋ bini pili bɛ zuɣuri.
en: The leaders of the people send their servants to get water. The servants go to the water storage places, but they dont find any water. The servants come back with empty jars, so they are ashamed and embarrassed. They cover their heads from shame.

dag: N Naawuni, teemi n yɛla zaŋ chaŋ dimbɔŋɔ polo, ka di kpihim tuun sun shɛŋa n ni tum ti n Naawuni jɛmbu duu mini di tuma ŋɔ.
en: Remember, my God, all these things that I have done for your Temple and its worship.

dag: Ka a ti baŋ ni barina shɛli ka a yiŋa. Ka a yi ti kaag a piɛri, a ni nya ka bɛ zaa beni.
en: Your home will be secure, and your sheep will be safe.

dag: Doo maa min o paɣ maa daa bela bɛ zaɣim, amaa ka di bi mali ba vi.
en: The man and the woman were both naked, but they were not embarrassed.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Izraɛlnim tuumbiɛri buta ni bunahi zuɣu, n ku chɛ bɛ tibili darigibu, dama bɛ zaŋ wuntizɔriba n-kɔhi deei anzinfa laɣibaligu, ka zaŋ nandaamba n-taɣi namda.
en: This is what the Lord says: I will definitely punish Israel for the many crimes they have done. They sold honest people for a little silver. They sold the poor for the price of a pair of sandals.

dag: Ka gbib yɛlimaŋ shɛli Naawuni Shia Kasi ŋun be ti ni ni zaŋ niŋ a nuu ni la.
en: Through the power of the Holy Spirit, who lives in us, keep the good things that have been entrusted to you.

dag: Yisahaku daa nyɛla yuun pihinahi nira saha shɛl o ni daa kpuɣi Ribɛka ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtuɛl Aram nir ŋun daa yi Mɛsopoteemia la na bipuɣiŋga la. Ribɛka daa nyɛla Leeban ŋun nyɛ Aram nir la tizɔpaɣa.
en: When Isaac was years old, he married Rebekah. Rebekah was from Paddan Aram. She was Bethuels daughter and the sister of Laban the Aramean.
