dag: Bɛ daa yi yɛn chaŋ, bɛ ni tooi chaŋ luɣa anahi maa zaa, ka bi ŋmaligi. Amaa tooni kalinli maa daa yi kul kpa shɛli polo, kalima maa zaa doli li mi ka bi ŋmaligira.
en: When they moved in any of the four directions, they moved without swerving. Whichever way the leading one faced, they moved in that direction without swerving.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Anabi Musa daa chɛ ka doo sabirila amiliya lɔrigibu gbaŋ pɔi ka naanyi yih o paɣa.
en: The Pharisees said, Moses allowed a man to divorce his wife by writing a certificate of divorce.

dag: Bɛ daa yi n-chaŋ ti tumdi Masia tuma, ka bi deei sɔŋsim shɛli bɛn pa yɛdaniŋdib la sani.
en: When they left to tell others about the Lord, they decided not to accept help from anyone who wasn't a follower.

dag: O yuli daa duya pam ninvuɣ pihita maa ni, amaa di daa bi du m-paai wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa yuya. Ka Dauda daa zaŋ o leei o tɔbbihi bɛn gul o zuɣulana.
en: Benaiah was even more famous than the Thirty Heroes, but he did not become a member of the Three Heroes. David made Benaiah the leader of his bodyguards.

dag: Ti yab Ibrahimma daa niŋ yɛda ka mali tahima saha shɛli di ni daa to ni o niŋ tahima ni o ni leei zuliya pam yaba kaman Naawuni ni daa lo o alikauli yɛli, A zuliya ni ti galisi pam la.
en: Abraham believed and hoped, even when there was no reason for hoping, and so became the father of many nations. Just as the scripture says, Your descendants will be as many as the stars.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti mali yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la yi ni kul paai luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: You are not to offer your sacrifices wherever you choose;.

dag: Ka Leeban daa bɔhi Yaakubu, Bɔzuɣu ka a ŋari ma zaŋ m bipuɣinsi zo kaman tɔbu ka a tuhi gbahi ba maa? Tuun bɔ ka a lee tum ma maa?.
en: Laban said to Jacob, Why did you trick me? Why did you take my daughters like they were women you captured during war?.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino ŋun yuli daa booni Agabus daa ti yiɣisi zani n-yɛli Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni ni kum ni lu pam dunia zaa ni; ka di daa ti shiri niŋ pali Naa Klɔdius nam dibu saha.
en: One of them, named Agabus, stood up and by the power of the Spirit predicted that a severe famine was about to come over all the earth.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan yɛli ba, Nyama, n zaŋ binyɛra din bindi tiŋgban ni zaa ka mali biɛlim mini tia kam din wala mali kpila n-tin ya ni yi dira;.
en: I have provided all kinds of grain and all kinds of fruit for you to eat;.

dag: Zaɣ biɛɣu ni ku ninvuɣ biɛri, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je wuntizɔriba ni nya tibidarigibo.
en: But just one problem will kill the wicked, and those who hate the righteous will be held responsible.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan yiɣisi nimaani chaŋ ti paai kɔbili shɛŋa bɛ ni booni Bɛr la. Nimaani ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Laɣimmi niriba maa na ka n ti ti ba kom.
en: From the Arnon, the Israelites went to the well near the town of Beer, where the Lord had said to Moses, Call the people together, and I will give them water to drink.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu pam. Bɛ ni daa kana shɛm, lala ka bɛ ti lan yɛn yi n-chaŋ. Ka nyɔ bɔ ka bɛ lee di bɛ ni tum tuun shɛŋa ti pɔhim maa ni?.
en: This too is a sickening tragedy: they must pass on just as they arrived. What then do they gain from working so hard for wind?.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses.

dag: Man karimba ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim naa m-be Jɛrusalɛm ŋɔ.
en: I said these things when I lived in Jerusalem as king of Israel.

dag: Dɔbba kalinli daa nyɛla kaman tusaanu laasabu. Ka Yisa yɛl o nyaandoliba maa ni bɛ chɛ ka salo maa ʒini gbilligbilli kaman ninvuɣ pihinunu laasabu.
en: Jesus said to his disciples, Make the people sit down in groups of about fifty each.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni tooi pahi n zuɣu ka ti tuhi tɔb shɛli yi ni daa nya ka n tuhira, ka wum ni n na kul tuhiri li pumpɔŋɔ la.
en: You saw me suffer, and you still hear about my troubles. Now you must suffer in the same way.

dag: Naawuni, darigim bɛ tibili bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu; nyaŋmi lala zuliyanim maa a suhuyiɣisili puuni!.
en: Dont rescue them for any reason! In wrath bring down the people, God!.

dag: Momaha be mɔɣu ni pam, ka suhupiɛlli pali daboya zuɣu.
en: Desert pastures blossom, and mountains celebrate.

dag: Daadam, yɛlim Izraɛlnim saliŋ lɔhili. Yɛlim ba yɛtɔɣ ŋahili ŋɔ.
en: Human one, compose a riddle and a parable about the house of Israel.

dag: Bolimi pumpɔŋɔ, so beni ŋun ni garig a? Ka malaika ŋuni sani ka a lee yɛn ŋmaligi chaŋ?.
en: Call out, Job. See if anyone answers. Is there any angel to whom you can turn?.

dag: Ka Abinɛr min o niriba maa daa chaŋ yuŋ maa zaa n-gari Araba ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du, zaŋ chaŋ wuntaŋ daa ti yɛn zani zuɣu ni ka bɛ paai Mahanaim.
en: Abner and his men marched through the Jordan Valley all that night; they crossed the Jordan River, and after marching all the next morning, they arrived back at Mahanaim.

dag: Ka Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim daa laɣim zani Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dundɔn palli la ni, ka Jɛhɔshafat daa kana ti zani bɛ sani.
en: and they and the people of Jerusalem gathered in the new courtyard of the Temple. King Jehoshaphat went and stood before them.

dag: Ɛhab bia Jɔram ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun piniyini saha ka Ahazia daa di Juda nam.
en: Ahaziah had become king of Judah in the eleventh year of the rule of Ahab's son Joram.

dag: Dama Masia daa bi kpɛla daadamnim ni me Luɣ Kasi Zaa Kasi Shee din nyɛ alali din la ŋmahinli la ni, amaa alizanda maŋmaŋ ni ka o kpe nti zani Naawuni tooni ti zuɣu pumpɔŋɔ.
en: This is why Christ did not go into a tent made by humans and was only a copy of the real one. Instead, he went into heaven and is now there with God to help us.

dag: amaa paɣ ŋun yi mali zab wɔɣila, di pahir o la jilima. Dama Naawuni ti o zabiri maa la o zuɣu pilibu zuɣu.
en: But wearing long hair is a womans honor. Long hair is given to the woman to cover her head.

dag: M bia, a yi lo a ʒiʒiinikpee alikauli bee a yi lo amaŋa nia ti so.
en: My son, dont make yourself responsible for the debts of others. Dont make such deals with friends or strangers.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛl o, Wula ka n lee ni tooi baŋ di gbinni, ka pa ni so n-dolisi ma? Ka daa yɛli Filip ni o kpɛm o chɛchɛbuŋ lɔɣu maa ni na ti ʒin o sani.
en: The man answered, How can I understand? I need someone to explain it to me. Then he invited Philip to climb in and sit with him.

dag: Di saha ka Balaam daa yɛli Yawɛ malaika maa, N tum alahichi, dama m bi mi ni a ʒiɛla sol ni gu ma soli. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, di yi bi luhi a sani, n ni ŋmaligi labi kuli.
en: Balaam replied, I have sinned. I did not know that you were standing in the road to oppose me; but now if you think it is wrong for me to go on, I will return home.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani yuli Bɛrishiiba; dama nimaani ka bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa daa laɣim po pɔri.
en: Therefore, the name of that place is Beer-sheba because there they gave each other their word.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla a daa chɛ ka sagbani wuhiri ba soli wuntaŋ ni, ka chɛ ka buɣim ne yuŋ n-wuhiri ba bɛ ni yɛn doli shɛli polo.
en: With a cloud you led them in daytime, and at night you lighted their way with fire.

dag: A nyɛla ŋun yuri din tuhi, ka je zaɣ biɛɣu. Dinzuɣu ka Naawuni ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ piig a, ka zaŋ suhupiɛlli niŋ a ni n-gari a na taba.
en: You love righteousness and hate wickedness. No wonder God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of joy more than all your companions!.

dag: Ka Nuhu daa niŋ Naawuni ni yɛl o ni o niŋ shɛm maa zaa.
en: Noah did everything God commanded him.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni ku binshɛɣukam din be dunia ni zaa.
en: I, the Lord , now promise to destroy everything on this earth—.

dag: O daa yi ʒiinila Dɛbɔra dɔbino tia din be Rama mini Bɛtɛl sunsuuni Ifriim tiŋgban ni zoya zuɣu tiŋ la ni gbini, ka Izraɛlnim chan o sani ka o ti kariti bɛ yɛla saria tiri ba.
en: One day Deborah was sitting under the Palm Tree of Deborah, and the Israelites came up to her to ask what to do about Sisera.

dag: Ŋunkam deeri bibil ŋɔ tatabo n yuli zuɣu deeri la mani; ka ŋunkam mi deeri ma, pa mani ka o deera, amaa ŋun tim ma na ka o deera.
en: Whoever welcomes one of these children in my name welcomes me; and whoever welcomes me isnt actually welcoming me but rather the one who sent me.

dag: Ka bɔ ka dimbɔŋɔ yɛn niŋ? Niriba yi niŋdi lala ni tɛhi biɛri bee tɛhi suma, Masia yɛla molo kul bahi mooni ginda, ka m mali suhupiɛlli di zuɣu. Iin, n shiri ni mali suhupiɛlli.
en: But that doesnt matter. What is important is that they are telling people about Christ, whether they are sincere or not. So I am glad they are doing it. I will continue to be glad.

dag: Stiivin yɛligu ŋɔ ni daa lu bɛ tiba ni maa, ka di dim bɛ nyinyɛhi ni ka bɛ suhuri yiɣisi pam, ka bɛ je suli niŋ o.
en: When the council members heard Stephen's speech, they were angry and furious.

dag: Ka Yawɛ lan yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord then told Moses.

dag: Ka Gaal daa gari tooni zaŋ Shɛkɛmnim chaŋ, ka bɛ mini Abimilɛk ti tuhi.
en: Gaal led the men of Shechem out and fought Abimelech.

dag: Jɛhɔahaz yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaata saha shɛl o ni di nam maa. O daa di nam ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la chira ata.
en: He was years old when he became king of Judah. He was king in Jerusalem for three months.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa niŋ alibarika pam niŋ Ayuba ni dabisa shɛŋa din daa bahindi nyaaŋa maa ni n-gari o ni daa pun niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni shɛm piligu ni la. O daa malila piɛri tuhi pinaanahi mini laakumnim tusaayɔbu ni naɣilahi tusaayi ni bunnyama tuhili.
en: The Lord now blessed Job more than ever; he gave him , sheep, , camels, , pair of oxen, and , donkeys.

dag: Miriya ka yi ku ninsala.
en: Do not commit murder.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa zaŋ o ni su binshɛlikam zaa ti Yisahaku.
en: While Abraham was still alive, he gave gifts to the sons of Hagar and Keturah. He also sent their sons to live in the east far from his son Isaac, and when Abraham died, he left everything to Isaac.

dag: N ni chɛ ka o zaŋ o nuu pa teeku zuɣu; ka chɛ ka o zaŋ o nudirigu pa mɔɣa zuɣu.
en: I will extend his kingdom from the Mediterranean to the Euphrates River.

dag: Ka Zarai daa ti yɛli Ibram, Nyama, Yawɛ bi chɛ ka n dɔɣi bihi, dinzuɣu zaŋmi n dab bipuɣiŋga ŋɔ dɔni, di pa shɛli o ni dɔɣi bihi ti ma. Ka Ibram daa saɣi Zarai ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: and so she said to Abram, The Lord has kept me from having children. Why don't you sleep with my slave? Perhaps she can have a child for me. Abram agreed with what Sarai said.

dag: Teemiy o ni daa pun tum alahiziba tuun shɛŋa la yɛla. Dina n-nyɛ o ni daa tum alahiziba tuun shɛŋa min o ni kari saria shɛŋa la.
en: You descendants of Jacob, God's servant, descendants of Israel, whom God chose, remember the miracles that God performed and the judgments that he gave.

dag: Dauda daa bi kali ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi paai yuun pisi, dama Yawɛ daa lo alikauli ni o ni chɛ ka Izraɛlnim galisi kaman saŋmarisi bɛn be zuɣusaa ŋɔ.
en: David decided to count the men in Israel. There were very many people because the Lord had promised to make the Israelites as many as the stars in the sky. So David counted only the men who were years old and older.

dag: ka din pah awɛi gbaai Jɛshua, ka din pahi pia gbaai Shɛkania.
en: The ninth was Jeshuas group. The tenth was Shecaniahs group.

dag: Bɛ ni ti yɛli Ziɔn, Bɛmbɔŋɔnim zaa leela Jɛrusalɛm tiŋbihi dama di nyɛla tin shɛli Zallakudura Naa ni daa zali.
en: God Most High will strengthen the city of Zion. Then everyone will say, We were born here too.

dag: Paɣidɔɣisɔtɔɣindiba maa ni daa zɔri Naawuni maa zuɣu ka Naawuni daa ti ba bɛ dahalali bihi.
en: And because the midwives respected God, God gave them households of their own.

dag: ka daa chɛ ka Yisahaku mi dɔɣi Yaakubu mini Iso. Ka n daa zaŋ Ɛdom zoya zuɣu tiŋgbani ti Iso ni di nyɛ o dini, amaa ka Yaakubu ŋun min o bihi daa yiɣisi kuli Ijipti.
en: To Isaac I gave Jacob and Esau. I gave Mount Seir to Esau to take over. But Jacob and his sons went down to Egypt.

dag: Di saha ka Zɛbul bɔh o, Ka a noli buɣibuɣi la lee be ya pumpɔŋɔ? Pa nyini n-daa yɛli ni Abimilɛk mi lee nyɛ ŋuni ka ti jɛmd o la? Pa bɛna ka a daa ʒiɛm la? To, pumpɔŋɔ cham ka a mini ba ti tuhi.
en: Then Zebul said to him, Where is all your big talk now? You were the one who asked why we should serve this man Abimelech. These are the men you were making fun of. Go on out now and fight them.

dag: N ka yi sani, amaa n suhu din be yi sani, ka n gba pun kari ninvuɣ so ŋun tum lala maa saria ti Duuma Yisa yuli zuɣu kaman m bela yi san la. Yi yi ti laɣim ka n suhu pahi yi zuɣu ti Duuma Yisa yiko ni.
en: Though Im absent physically, Im present in the spirit and Ive already judged the man who did this as if I were present.

dag: Miri ka a kpuɣi paɣa bee n-dɔɣi bidibisi bee bipuɣinsi kpe.
en: Jeremiah, you must not get married. You must not have sons or daughters in this place.

dag: Dinzuɣu niriba suhuri fuŋya, ka niriba pam tuura. N zaŋ takɔbi maa naŋgbancholi zali bɛ dunoya zaa ni. Bɛ mal li mi ka di nyaɣisira ka saa la. Ka nyahi neei li ni di ku niriba.
en: Their hearts will melt with fear, and many people will fall. The sword will kill many people by the city gates. Yes, the sword will flash like lightning. It was polished to kill the people!.

dag: Nyamiya, o ni ku ma; n lan ka tahima yaha. Amaa n ni zabi n soli zuɣu hal ni o tooni.
en: I will continue to trust God even if he kills me. But I will defend myself to his face.

dag: Ka ti daa ti paai ti gbɛbu shee n-yooi ti kpalansi nya ka ti zaa yinoyino liɣiri noli bela ti kpalansi maa noya ni, dinzuɣu ka ti ʒi li mali na.
en: But when we stopped for the night, we each found in our grain sacks the exact amount we had paid. We have brought that money back.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa zaligu shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ doo min o paɣa polo ni zaŋ chaŋ doo min o bipuɣiŋga ŋun na be o ba yiŋa ka nyɛ paɣisarili polo m-bala.
en: These are the commands that the Lord gave to Moses. These are the commands about a man and his wife, and about a father and his daughter who is still young and living at home in her fathers house.

dag: Yi ni ti yɛn yɛli Juda Naa Hɛzɛkia shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Di chɛ ka a ni du m-ba a Naawuni so maa yɔhim a n-lo a alikauli ni o ku zaŋ Jɛrusalɛm niŋ Asiria naa nuu ni.
en: to tell him, The god you are trusting in has told you that you will not fall into my hands, but don't let that deceive you.

dag: Amaa alahichi sanyoo sara maligu maa biŋkɔbigu kpam min o binyaannina ni binsabili yaɣ shɛli din viɛla, o daa zaŋ li nyola buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu kaman Naawuni ni daa zali Musa shɛm.
en: Then he burned on the altar the fat, the kidneys, and the best part of the liver, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.

dag: Ka tinzunnim bɛn zaŋ bɛmaŋ tabili Yawɛ ni bɛ tumd o tuma, ka yur o, ka nyɛ o daba bɛn zaa gbibi Vuhim Dabisili ka bi saɣindi di zaligunima, ka gbibi n daalikauli viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: The immigrants who have joined me, serving me and loving my name, becoming my servants, everyone who keeps the Sabbath without making it impure, and those who hold fast to my covenant.

dag: Ti suhiri ti Duuma Yisa Masia maŋmaŋa mini Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Ba ka yuri ti, ka nyɛ ŋun ti ti suhukpaŋsibo din ka bahigu mini tahima suŋ o daanfaani puuni la.
en: God our Father loves us. He treats us with undeserved grace and has given us eternal comfort and a wonderful hope. We pray that our Lord Jesus Christ and God our Father.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛr a, a ku tooi yi nimaani faashee a ti yo bɛ ni zal a san shɛli zaa, ka di laɣifu ku guui.
en: There you will stay, I tell you, until you pay the last penny of your fine.

dag: Banima n-lee be kaman mani? Bɛ wuhim li, bɛ wuhim li n tooni. Banima n-daa lee yɛli binshɛŋa din ti yɛn niŋ yɛla zali kurimbuni ha. Bɛ yɛlim ti binshɛŋa din na yɛn niŋ yɛla.
en: Who is like me? Let them speak up, explain it, and lay it out for me. Who announced long ago what is to be? Let them tell us what is to come.

dag: Amaa Yisa daa bi saɣi bahi omaŋ ti ba, dama o daa mi din be ninsal kam suhu ni.
en: But Jesus did not trust himself to them, because he knew them all.

dag: Dinzuɣu niŋmiya m-bahi naai li! Chɛliya ka yi suhuri ye di naabu zuɣu kaman yi suhuri ni daa ye di piligibu zuɣu shɛm la; zaŋmiya yi ni mali shɛli niŋ li.
en: Now finish the job as well so that you finish it with as much enthusiasm as you started, given what you can afford.

dag: Yawɛ n-daa chɛ ka bɛ niŋ tipawumli, ka lo tɔbu kana ni bɛ ti tuhi Izraɛlnima ni di chɛ ka Izraɛlnim ku bɛ zaa n-kpihim bɛ birili, ka ku zo ba nambɔɣu kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm la.
en: The Lord had made them determined to fight the Israelites, so that they would be condemned to total destruction and all be killed without mercy. This was what the Lord had commanded Moses.

dag: Ka Rɛhɔbɔam daa ti paɣ Naawuni, ka bɛ zaŋ o sɔɣi pah o yaannim zuɣu Dauda tiŋ la ni. O ma ŋun daa nyɛ Ammɔn paɣ la yuli n-daa booni Naama. Ka o bia Abijam daa di nam zan o ba zaani.
en: Rehoboam died and was buried with his ancestors in the City of David. Rehoboams son Abijah became the next king after him.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka n daa chaŋ yaɣimɛra maa yiŋa ka o ti bela yaɣiri mɛbu ni.
en: So I went down to the potters house; he was working on the potters wheel.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi Yawɛ, bɛna n-nyɛ o zɔnima, ka o kahigir o daalikauli wuhiri ba.
en: Our Lord , you are the friend of your worshipers, and you make an agreement with all of us.

dag: O yɛm puuni ka o nam zuɣusaa. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: By his wisdom he made the heavens; his love is eternal;.

dag: Hal bɛ yi gbi gbala n-kpe di ni, n ni zaŋ n nuu tim di ni yihi ba na. Ka bɛ yi dula zuɣusaa, n ni siɣisi ba na.
en: Even if they dig their way down to the world of the dead, I will catch them. Even if they climb up to heaven, I will bring them down.

dag: Ŋun tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa kpaŋsirila omaŋa, amaa ŋun tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa kpaŋsirila cheechi ni niriba.
en: People who speak in a tongue build up themselves; those who prophesy build up the church.

dag: Siɣisima, amaa ka pampam. Miri ka a ti kum o kuli. Vilim a baŋtabiga ka piri a namba. Miri ka a ti zaŋ bini pɔbi a zuɣusaa naŋgbampibili bee n-di kuli kumbu bindirigu.
en: Sigh inwardly; be deathly still. Dont perform mourning rites, but bind on your turban and put your shoes on your feet. And dont cover your upper lip or eat in human company.

dag: Yi puhiri dabisa mini goya ni saha ni yuma churi!.
en: You observe religious days and months and seasons and years.

dag: Zaŋm a nini lab kpaŋa ka chɛ ba, ka bɛ di bɛ dabisa nyaɣisim kaman tumtumdiba la.
en: Look away from us that we may rest, until we are satisfied like a worker at days end.

dag: Sabimi dimbɔŋɔ zali ʒiɛman shɛŋa din kanna nima, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ ni na bi dɔɣi bi shɛba ti paɣi Yawɛ.
en: Write down for the coming generation what the Lord has done, so that people not yet born will praise him.

dag: Wummi n suhigu shɛli n ni suhir a ni a zo ma nambɔɣu ŋɔ. N kuhirimi niŋd a bɔri sɔŋsim; ka kpuɣiri n nuhi zuɣusaa tiriti a jɛmbu du kasi la.
en: Hear me when I cry to you for help, when I lift my hands toward your holy Temple.

dag: Yi bi mi ni yi niŋgbuna nyɛla Masia niŋgbuŋ yaɣ shɛli polo? Ka di simdi ni n zaŋ Masia niŋgbuna yaɣ shɛli leei pagɔrili dini? Naawuni di wuhi gba!.
en: Don't you know that your bodies are part of the body of Christ? Is it right for me to join part of the body of Christ to a prostitute? No, it isn't!.

dag: Niriba ayi yi vara, bɛ ni yino ni luh o kpee, amaa niriba ayi ni tooi luhi ninvuɣ yino. Mih ata gabiga bi chihiri yom.
en: An enemy might be able to defeat one person, but two people can stand back-to-back to defend each other. And three people are even stronger. They are like a rope that has three parts wrapped together—it is very hard to break.

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi bahi Musa zuɣu ka o yɛl o, Pa a mabia n-nyɛ Aduna ŋun nyɛ Lɛvi nir la? M mi ni o nyɛla ŋun ni tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa viɛnyɛliŋga. Nyama, o nyɛla ŋun yɛn yina ti tuh a soli, ka o yi ti nya a, o suhu ni paligi pam.
en: At this the Lord became angry with Moses and said, What about your brother Aaron, the Levite? I know that he can speak well. In fact, he is now coming to meet you and will be glad to see you.

dag: Ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka tin ya suhudoo!.
en: Grace and peace to you from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira daa kana ka o mini niriba ti bi laɣindi diri ka nyura, ka yi yɛli ni alizin biɛɣu n-ʒi o zuɣu.
en: John the Baptizer came and did not eat the usual food or drink wine. And you say, He has a demon inside him.

dag: Guum yomyom tuh o soli ti bɔh o, A min a yidan ni yi bia la mal alaafee? Ka o garigi yɛli Gɛhaazi, Ti mal alaafee.
en: Please run now to meet her! Say to her, Are you all right? Is your husband all right? Is the child all right? She answered, Everything is all right.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ yɛda niŋbu kɔŋko gba, di yi bi tumdi tuma, di nyɛla yɛda kpiŋ.
en: Faith that doesn't lead us to do good deeds is all alone and dead!.

dag: Ka malaika so ŋun daa yɛli ma yɛtɔɣa maa yɛli ma, Molimi molo yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yuri Jɛrusalɛm mini Ziɔn pam.
en: Then the angel told me to tell the people this: The Lord All-Powerful says: I have a strong love for Jerusalem and Zion.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Musa mini Aduna daa chaŋ Firawuna sani ti yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Chɛ ka n niriba ŋɔ chaŋ tiŋgban nɛli ni ti puhi chuɣu ti ma. .
en: Afterward, Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and said, This is what the LORD, Israels God, says: Let my people go so that they can hold a festival for me in the desert.

dag: Miriya anab ʒirinim bɛn kani yi sanna m-be kaman piɛri n-nyɛ ba, amaa ka lee nyɛ kunduna bɛ suhuri ni la.
en: Be on your guard against false prophets; they come to you looking like sheep on the outside, but on the inside they are really like wild wolves.

dag: Ŋun su amiliya n-nyɛ aŋgo; amaa aŋgo zo so ŋun be o sani wumd o yɛtɔɣa nyari suhupiɛlli pam di zuɣu; lala zuɣu ka n suhupiɛlli galisi pam maa.
en: At a wedding the groom is the one who gets married. The best man is glad just to be there and to hear the groom's voice. That's why I am so glad.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa na bi di bɛ suhuri ni ye shɛli zuɣu maa tiɣi; bindirigu maa ni daa na kul be bɛ noya ni saha shɛli maa.
en: But they didnt stop craving— even with the food still in their mouths!.

dag: bɛ ni daa tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa n-chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi la zuɣu. Dina n-nyɛ: bɛ daa maani maligu ka jɛmdi buɣ shɛŋa bɛ mini bɛ yaannim ni daa bi mi ka yi gba bi mi li.
en: because of their evil ways. They have angered me by making offerings and worshipping other gods that neither they nor you nor your ancestors knew.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli niriba maa, Yawɛ ni zali ni ti niŋ shɛm m-bala.
en: Moses said to the community, This is what the LORD has commanded us to do.

dag: ti yɛli Nyama, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ wuhi ti o jilima min o galisim ni nyɛ shɛm, ka ti wum o kukoli buɣim sunsuuni; zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ti nyaya ni Naawuni ni tooi tɔɣisi ninsal yɛtɔɣa, ka ninsal maa na be o nyɛvili ni.
en: and said: Today the Lord our God has shown us how powerful and glorious he is. He spoke to us from the fire, and we learned that people can live, even though God speaks to them.

dag: Ka Pita yɛl o, A kul ku paɣi n naba hal abada. Ka Yisa yɛl o, N yi bi paɣi a naba maa, shɛl lan ka m min a sunsuuni.
en: Peter declared, Never at any time will you wash my feet! If I do not wash your feet, Jesus answered, you will no longer be my disciple.

dag: Bɛnjamin daŋ ni; Ɛliada ŋun daa nyɛ tɔbutuhiri biiŋa la daa sula tɔbbihi tuhi kɔbisiyi bɛn nyɛ peentɔriba ka gbibi nyɔtaɣirisi la.
en: From the tribe of Benjamin these were the generals: Eliada had , soldiers who used bows, arrows, and shields. Eliada was a very brave soldier.

dag: Bɛ ni daa na kul yɛr o lala saha shɛli maa, ka nayili namɔɣilisi paana nti zaŋ Haman yomyom chaŋ Ɛsta ni daa pun duɣi bindir shɛŋa la dibu.
en: They were still talking, when the king's servants came and quickly took Haman to the dinner that Esther had prepared.

dag: din ni chɛ ka Yawɛ pal o ni daa lo ma alikauli shɛli yɛli, A bihi yi ni gbib bɛmaŋa, ka doli ma ni ʒiɛyimtali ni bɛ suhuri zaa ni bɛ shia zaa, a kul ku kɔŋ ninvuɣ so ŋun ni ʒiini Izraɛl nam ʒiishee la.
en: So also the LORD will confirm the word he spoke to me: If your children will take care to walk before me faithfully, with all their heart and all their being, then one of your own children will never fail to be on the throne of Israel.

dag: ka zaŋ o ni mali yiko wuhiri shihir shɛŋa tuuli biŋkɔbigu la tooni maa n-yɔhindi bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni; ka zali niriba ni bɛ malimi binnani ŋ-ŋmahindi biŋkɔb so ŋun daa mali takɔb daŋa ka tib kpaŋ la.
en: And it deceived all the people living on earth by means of the miracles which it was allowed to perform in the presence of the first beast. The beast told them to build an image in honor of the beast that had been wounded by the sword and yet lived.

dag: Ka Samsin min o ba ni o ma daa yiɣisi chani Timna, ka Samsin daa ti kpe bɛ wain tihi puu ni; ka gbuɣim polli nya o ŋumda.
en: Samson went down with his father and mother to the city of Timnah. They went as far as the vineyards near that city. There a young lion suddenly roared and jumped at Samson!.

dag: Ŋunkam di nasara ni deei pini ŋɔ n sani, ka n ni nyɛ o Naawuni, ka o mi nyɛ m bia.
en: Those who emerge victorious will inherit these things. I will be their God, and they will be my sons and daughters.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba daa ti ka o sanna ti bɔh o, A mi ni Farisiinim ni wum a ni yɛli shɛm la bi niŋ ba nyaɣisim bebɔ.
en: Then his disciples came over to him and asked, Do you know you insulted the Pharisees by what you said.

dag: O ni ti dɔɣi bidibiga, ka a bol o yuli Yisa, dama o ni ti tilig o niriba bɛ daalahichi ni.
en: She will give birth to a son. You will name him Jesus. Give him that name because he will save his people from their sins.

dag: Di ni niŋ Daadam Bia kaman di ni sabi o yɛla shɛm la; amaa mbusim be ŋun ti yɛn yi Daadam Bia nyaaŋa maa zuɣu! Hal bɛ yi di daa bi dɔɣ o gba, di naan so o zuɣu.
en: The Human One goes to his death just as it is written about him. But how terrible it is for that person who betrays the Human One! It would have been better for him if he had never been born.

dag: Yawɛ be o jɛmbu duu din be kasi ni; ka o nam ʒiishee be alizanda ni. O nini nyari daadamnima, ka kpahindi ba.
en: The Lord is in his holy temple. The Lord sits on his throne in heaven. He sees everything that happens. He watches people closely.

dag: Amaa benya kaman tihi la m-mali wala yi biɛhigu ni din ni wuhi ni yi shiri niŋ tuuba ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: Do those things that will show that you have turned from your sins.

dag: Yawɛ mali yiko pam, amaa o suhu bi yiɣisiri yomyom. Biɛhiŋ kani, Yawɛ ku chɛ alahichilana tibili darigibu. O soli nyɛla pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga mini sanʒiɛɣu, ka sagbana nyɛ o napɔna taŋkpagbiligu.
en: The LORD is very patient but great in power; the LORD punishes. His way is in whirlwind and storm; clouds are the dust of his feet.

dag: Ka n daa lan nya ka bɛ bi lan tiri Lɛvinim bɛ dihili ni nyɛ shɛli, dinzuɣu ka Lɛvinim mini yiliyiiniba bɛn daa tumdi Naawuni jɛmbu tuma maa daa chɛ li ka chaŋ bɛ puri ni.
en: I also learned that the Temple musicians and other Levites had left Jerusalem and gone back to their farms, because the people had not been giving them enough to live on.

dag: Juda, a mabihi ni ti paɣ a. A ni ti zaŋ a nuu gbaag a dimnim nyiŋgoya ni. A ba bidibisi ni ti damd a tooni.
en: Judah, you will be praised by your brothers; they will bow down to you, as you defeat your enemies.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ garigi yɛli Yisa, Ti bi mi. Ka Yisa yɛli ba, Dindina n gba ku yɛli ya ŋun ti ma yiko shɛli n ni mali niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa maa.
en: So the leaders answered Jesus, We dont know the answer. Jesus said, Then I will not tell you who gave me the authority to do these things.

dag: Di yi ti nyɛ asiba, yi ni yɛli, Ti di bi zaɣisi ka di nyɛla zaawuni. Ka zaawuni yi ti paai, yi ni yɛli, Ti di bi zaɣisi ka di nyɛla asiba. Dabiɛm din ti yɛn be yi suhuri ni mini yi nina ni ti yɛn nya binshɛŋa zuɣu.
en: In the morning you will say: I wish it was nighttime, but at nighttime you will say, I wish it was morning—on account of your tortured mind, which will be terrified, and because of the horrible sights that your eyes will see.

dag: Adɔnikam daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu ni pihiyɔbunaayopɔin.
en: of Adonikam.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Yi gba na kuli ka fahim? Yi bi mi ni binshɛɣukam din kpɛri ninsal pul ni bi tar o daɣiri?.
en: He said to them, Dont you understand either? Dont you know that nothing from the outside that enters a person has the power to contaminate?.

dag: Ka dunia ŋɔ nanim bɛn daa niŋ zina o sani ni kɔr biɛr la yi ti nya o buɣim dibu nyɔhi, bɛ ni kum ka fabili pam.
en: The rulers of the earth who sinned sexually with her and shared her wealth will see the smoke from her burning. Then they will cry and be sad because of her death.

dag: Dama mani m-piig o ni o wuh o bihi min o yiŋnim zaa ka bɛ doli man Yawɛ soli, ka tumdi wuntia tuma ni din tuhi; ka di zuɣu chɛ ka man Yawɛ zaŋ n ni lo Ibrahimma binshɛli alikauli la ti o.
en: I have formed a relationship with him so that he will instruct his children and his household after him. And they will keep to the LORDs path, being moral and just so that the LORD can do for Abraham everything he said he would.

dag: Amaa ka Musa daa suhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni maa yɛli, Yawɛ, bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi bahi a ni daa zaŋ a nuu din mali kpiɔŋ mini yiko n-yih a ninvuɣ shɛb Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na maa zuɣu?.
en: Moses tried to get the Lord God to change his mind: Our Lord , you used your mighty power to bring these people out of Egypt. Now don't become angry and destroy them.

dag: ni Kibizaim ni Bɛtihɔrɔn mini di biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: Kibzaim, and Beth Horon, with their pasture lands.

dag: Yinim bɛn jɛmdi Yawɛ ŋɔ, paɣimiy o! Yinim bɛn zaa nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya ŋɔ, timiy o jilima! Yinim bɛn zaa nyɛ Izraɛl zuliya ŋɔ, lumiy o sizuura.
en: All who worship the Lord , now praise him! You belong to Jacob's family and to the people of Israel, so fear and honor the Lord !.

dag: Ka n daa chaŋ malaika maa sani nti yɛl o ni o zaŋm litaafi bila maa ti ma. Ka o yɛli ma, Zaŋm li ŋubi; di ni malis a nol ni kaman shir la, amaa ka lee to a puuni.
en: I went to the angel and asked him to give me the little scroll. He said to me, Take it and eat it; it will turn sour in your stomach, but in your mouth it will be sweet as honey.

dag: Jɛsi bia Dauda wunsuhigunim tariga m-bala.
en: This ends the prayers of David, the son of Jesse.

dag: Yawɛ neeri zoomba nina. Yawɛ yiɣisiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lu. Yawɛ yuri wuntizɔriba.
en: The Lord makes the blind see again. The Lord helps those who are in trouble. The Lord loves those who do right.

dag: Nuhu nini ni daa ti neei, ka bɛ yɛl o o bidibiga ŋun nyɛ biasani maa ni niŋ o shɛm.
en: When Noah woke up from his wine, he discovered what his youngest son had done to him.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Doli ma ka ti kuli n yiŋa, ka a ti di bindirigu.
en: The old prophet then said to him, Come home with me and eat some food.

dag: Yisifu ni daa nya bɛ mini Bɛnjamin, o daa yɛlila o yiŋ tumtumda, Zaŋm niriba maa kuli yiŋa, ka gbaai biŋkɔbigu kɔrigi m-mal o duɣi bindirigu, dama m mini niriba maa n-yɛn laɣim di wuntaŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: he saw Benjamin and told the servant in charge of his house, Take these men to my house. Slaughter an animal and cook it, so they can eat with me at noon.

dag: Ka Ɛbɛd bia Gaal min o mabihi daa ti ka Shɛkɛm na, Ka Shɛkɛmnim daa niŋ o naani.
en: Then Gaal son of Ebed came to Shechem with his brothers, and the men of Shechem put their confidence in him.

dag: Bɛ daa ku Ɛli bidibis ayi bɛn daa nyɛ Hofini mini Finɛhas, ka fa Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa.
en: The Philistines took Gods Holy Box and killed Elis two sons, Hophni and Phinehas.

dag: n-yɛli ba, Siɣimiya Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili maa sunsuuni ti pii kuɣa pinaayi maligumaaniba la ni ʒe luɣ shɛl la n-ʒi li ti sɔŋ yi ni ti yɛn gbe luɣ shɛli yuŋ ŋɔ. .
en: and command them to take twelve stones out of the middle of the Jordan, from the very place where the priests were standing. Tell them to carry these stones with them and to put them down where you camp tonight.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Yi gba na kuli ka fahim? Yi bi mi ni binshɛɣukam din kpɛri ninsal pul ni bi tar o daɣiri?.
en: He said, Do you still have trouble understanding? Surely you know that nothing that enters the mouth from the outside can make people unacceptable to God.

dag: Yi zuliya mini yi bihi galisim naan ŋmanila mɔɣ bihigu; ka n naan ku chɛ ka bɛ birili kpihim hal baabiɛla gba.
en: Your nation would be blessed with more people than there are grains of sand along the seashore. And I would never have let your country be destroyed.

dag: Ŋuni ka a lee maani ansarisi ka tura? Ŋun zuɣu ka a lee tahira, ka niŋ karimbaani m-mirigir a nina niŋda? Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ ka a mɔri maa.
en: Whom did you insult and ridicule? Against whom did you raise your voice and pridefully lift your eyes? It was against the holy one of Israel!.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa yɛli Izraɛlnim maa, Naawuni yi ti yihi ya tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, yin ʒimiya n kɔba mali kuli; ka daa chɛ ka bɛ po di pɔri.
en: Now promise me that you will take my body with you when God leads you to that land.

dag: Dama zaŋ chaŋ bia maa ti yɛn yaag o noli yɛli, M ba bee M ma, di saha Asiria naa ni ti kana ti zaŋ Damaskus azichi, ka di Samaria nɛma zaa chaŋ.
en: Because before he can say Mommy or Daddy, the king of Assyria will attack and take everything of value from Damascus and Samaria.

dag: Niŋgbuŋ maŋdahimbu mali nyɔri shɛli di ni, amaa wuntia soli puuni maŋdahimbu malila nyɔri shɛlikam ni, dama di lo ti nyɛvili alikauli ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni zaŋ tabili saha din ka bahigu puuni.
en: Training your body helps you in some ways. But devotion to God helps you in every way. It brings you blessings in this life and in the future life too.

dag: n daa nyɛla sana, ka yi bi deei ma kpɛhi yi yinsi; n daa chani gbinfini, ka yi bi ti ma situra; n daa biɛra, ka daa ti lan be sarika ni, ka yi bi kana ti kaai ma.
en: I was a stranger and you didnt welcome me. I was naked and you didnt give me clothes to wear. I was sick and in prison, and you didnt visit me.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ, labisim ti a sanna! Zom ti nambɔɣu, ka lala chɛ ka ti tiligi!.
en: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.

dag: N yi nya din daa niŋ tiŋ ŋɔ ni paɣisara la, di biɛri ma mi.
en: I am horrified when I see what enemies have done to the young women of our city.

dag: Yi na bi bɔhi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ sochandiba? Yi bi saɣi bɛ ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Havent you asked travelers or paid attention to their reports?.

dag: dama Yawɛ yɛli ma, Miri ka a di bindirigu bee n-nyu kom nimaani bee n doli so shɛli a ni di doli kana labi. .
en: The Lord has commanded me not to eat or drink a thing, and not to return home the same way I came.

dag: A mini Harannima ni Kannɛnima ni Idɛnnima ni Ashurinima ni Kilimadnim daa niŋdila daabiligu.
en: The cities of Haran, Canneh, and Eden, the merchants of Sheba, the cities of Asshur and Chilmad—they all traded with you.

dag: Du bihi atata n-daa be wulimpuhili polo dunɔdali maa yaɣa ayi zaa. Du bihi atata maa zaa galisim daa nyɛla yim, ka di daantalisi din be di luɣa zuɣu zaa barilim nyɛ yim.
en: Inside the east gate, there were three rooms on each side. Each was the same size, and the arches on each side were the same size also.

dag: Ka laɣiŋgu maa ni kpamba ti zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa naɣilaa maa zuɣu ni Yawɛ tooni, ka bɛ kɔrig o Yawɛ tooni maa.
en: The community elders will press their hands on the bulls head before the LORD and then slaughter it before the LORD.

dag: Bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn gbib o daalikauli, ka dol o zaligunima.
en: who faithfully obey him.

dag: Ka bɛn kpalim wum li, ka dabiɛm gbahi ba, ka tuumbiɛɣu lala tatabo ku lan tum yi sunsuuni yaha.
en: Then everyone else will hear what happened; they will be afraid, and no one will ever again do such an evil thing.

dag: Ka di simdi ka o ti nyo di biŋkpam zaa buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu kaman suhudoo sara maligu la din ni chɛ ka maligumaana zaŋ li yo alahichi maa samli ka o daalahichi maa kpihim.
en: Then he shall burn all of its fat on the altar, just as he burns the fat of the animals killed for the fellowship offerings. In this way the priest shall offer the sacrifice for the sin of the ruler, and he will be forgiven.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛl o shɛm, ka chɛ ka bɛ chɛ n-chihi bɛ yuri jila, ka nyo bɛ chɛchɛbunsi mi buɣim.
en: Joshua did what the Lord said to do; he cut the legs of their horses and burned their chariots.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ, o yuli n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: God's name is the Lord , the Lord God All-Powerful.

dag: So yi bi lih o dɔɣiriba, di bahi bamdi omaŋmaŋ malibu, dindina o tum din chihir o daadiini soli zuɣu, ka leei ŋun bie n-gari ŋun pa yɛdaniŋda.
en: People who don't take care of their relatives, and especially their own families, have given up their faith. They are worse than someone who doesn't have faith in the Lord.

dag: Ka ti daa kul be gooni maa mɛbu ni, ka gooni maa zaa daa me n-tuɣi taba hal ti paai di dubu pirigili, dama niriba maa suhuri daa be tuma maa ni.
en: We continued to build the wall. All of it was joined together, and it reached half of its intended height because the people were eager to work.

dag: Ka Yisahaku tumtumdiba daa ka o sanna dindali maa ti yɛl o bɛ ni gbi kɔbil shɛli yɛla, ka yɛli, Ti nya kom.
en: That day Isaacs servants informed him about the well that they had been digging and said to him, We found water.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ saha shɛl o ti yɛn baŋ din viɛli piibu ka zaɣisi din bi viɛla, o ni ti dirila waagasi mini shiri.
en: By the time he is old enough to make his own decisions, people will be drinking milk and eating honey.

dag: Yɛm bi boonila niriba? Ka tɛhi zilima mi duhiri di yee?.
en: Listen! Wisdom is calling out. Reason is making herself heard.

dag: A tiŋguliba ŋmanila sakɔri, ka a zaligubaŋdiba ŋmani toli bɛn galisi ni yi tabili gariche di ni maha pam dahin shɛli, ka wuntaŋ ti nyee, ka bɛ yiɣi chaŋ, ka so bi mi bɛ ni chaŋ luɣ shɛl la.
en: Your officials are like a swarm of locusts that stay in the walls on a cold day. But when the sun comes out, they fly away, and no one knows where they have gone!.

dag: M mabihi, m bɔri ni yi baŋ ni lahibal sun shɛli waazu n ni daa yihi la pala din yi daadam tɛha ni na.
en: Brothers and sisters, I want you to know that the Good News message I told you was not made up by anyone.

dag: Ka Balak daa niŋ Balaam ni yɛl o shɛm maa n-zaŋ naɣila yinoyino mini piɛla yinoyino mali sara pa bimbini kam zuɣu.
en: After Balak had done what Balaam asked, he sacrificed a bull and a ram on each altar.

dag: O daa zaŋla tɔrokɔnim ayi mini naɣilah anahi ti Gɛrishɔn bihi kaman bɛ tuma ni nyɛ shɛm;.
en: who were under the leadership of Ithamar son of Aaron. Moses gave two carts and four oxen to the Gershonites for their work, and four carts and eight oxen to the Merarites for their work.

dag: hal sakuɣa yi ti luna saɣim tibɔŋ la zaa, ka tiŋ maa lu n-dahim zaa.
en: even if hailstones flatten forests and cities.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiri ni Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun biɛhigu tuhi; o nyɛla n tampiŋ, ka dinkam pa wuntia tuuni ka o ni.
en: They are there to show everyone that the Lord is good. He is my Rock, and he does no wrong.

dag: Ka o daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ kuɣ viɛla pie taba n-dihi duu maa nachiinsi. Parivaim salima ka bɛ daa zaŋ dihi li nachiinsi.
en: He used precious stones to decorate the temple, and he used gold imported from Parvaim.

dag: M biyurisi, ti nyɛla Naawuni bihi pumpɔŋɔ, ka di na bi kahigi wuhi ti ni ti yɛn be shɛm, amaa ti lee mi ni o yi ti yi palo, ti ni bemi kaman ŋuna, dama ti ni ti nya o kaman o ni kul be shɛm.
en: My dear friends, we are now God's children, but it is not yet clear what we shall become. But we know that when Christ appears, we shall be like him, because we shall see him as he really is.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli ba, Zuliya kam zuɣulaannim kuuni bɛ nam, ka wuhiri tarimba bɛ kpiɔŋ ni nyɛ shɛm; ka niriba booni ba tarimba sɔŋdiba.
en: Jesus said to them, The kings of the pagans have power over their people, and the rulers claim the title Friends of the People.

dag: Darius Ahasivɛrɔs bia ŋun daa nyɛ Miidia tiŋgbɔŋ ni nir la daa deei Kalidianim nam di.
en: Darius the Mede, who was the son of Xerxes, ruled over the kingdom of Babylonia.

dag: So yi liri ya, di pala n yɛda ni ka o niŋ lala. Ka ŋunkam liri ya, o ku di nasara.
en: Whoever attacks you, does it without my consent; whoever fights against you will fall.

dag: Ti Duuma zal o zaligu, ka paɣiba pam zaŋ di lahibali moli gili;.
en: My Lord gives the command— many messengers are bringing good news.

dag: Amaa ka naa daa yɛli Absalom, Aai, m bia, di chɛ ka ti zaa kana, di yi nyɛ lala, ti yɛla ni ti muɣis a pam. Ka Absalom daa kpaŋ omaŋa ni o chɛ ka o chaŋ, amaa ka o daa zaɣisi, ka naɣ suhila alibarika niŋ o ni.
en: No, my son, the king answered. It would be too much trouble for you if we all went. Absalom insisted, but the king would not give in, and he asked Absalom to leave.

dag: N suhir a ni a niŋ suɣilo n-wum ti yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, dama ti bi bɔri ni ti chɛ ka a ʒini yuui.
en: I dont want to take too much of your time, so I ask that you listen with your usual courtesy to our brief statement of the facts.

dag: Din pahi, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni chɛ ka alɔbo lu bɛ zuɣu hal ka bɛ ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpalim mini bɛn daa zo n-tiligi ti kpi.
en: The Lord your God will send the hornet against them. He will do this until he destroys all the people who escaped and tried to hide.

dag: Pool daa ti chaŋ Dɛɛbi mini Listra gba. Yisa nyaandol so daa be nimaani ka o yuli booni Timoti. O ma daa nyɛla Yɛhudia paɣa ka nyɛ Yisa nyaandola, ka o ba mi nyɛ Giriiki doo.
en: Paul traveled on to Derbe and Lystra, where a Christian named Timothy lived. His mother, who was also a Christian, was Jewish, but his father was a Greek.

dag: Yisa daa ti baɣisiri Galili Teeku chana nti nya nira ni o mabia: Saimɔn ŋun yuli daa lan booni Pita la min o tizo Anduru, ka bɛ labiri laŋa teeku ni, dama bɛ daa nyɛla kulipalinima.
en: As Jesus was walking by Lake Galilee, he saw two brothers, Simon and Simons brother Andrew. These brothers were fishermen, and they were fishing in the lake with a net.

dag: ka chɛ ka o kpe n-ʒin o chɛchɛbuŋ din pah ayi puuni, ka chɛ ka bɛn be o tooni kuhiri yɛra, Damdimiy o tiŋa! Lala ka o daa niŋ zaŋ Yisifu leei Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa zuɣulana.
en: He put Joseph on the chariot of his second-in-command, and everyone in front of him cried out, Attention! So Pharaoh installed him over the entire land of Egypt.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa nyaŋ Judanima, ka bɛ zaa ŋmaligi zo n-kuli bɛ yinsi.
en: Amaziah's army was defeated, and all his soldiers fled to their homes.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛl o bia Jɔnatan min o tumtumdiba zaa ni bɛ kum Dauda. Amaa o bia Jɔnatan daa yuri Dauda yɛla pam.
en: Saul told his son Jonathan and his officers to kill David. But Jonathan liked David very much.

dag: Ka di daa zaŋ chaŋ ha nti lan gili Baala wulinluhili polo n-zaŋ hal ti paai Ɛdom zoya ni n-zaŋ chaŋ hal ti baɣisi Jiarim Zoli nuzaa polo gari bee din nyɛ Chɛsalɔn la, ka di lan zaŋ nimaani hal ti paai Bɛtishɛmɛshi n-gari chaŋ ti baɣisi Timna gari.
en: The border turned westward from Baalah to Mount Seir. It passed on to the slope of Mount Jearim on the north , went down to Beth-shemesh, and passed by Timnah.

dag: Ŋuna n-zali saŋmarisi kalinli ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm, ka mi bɛ yuya.
en: God counts the stars by number, giving each one a name.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yɛli, Bɛn wumdi Naawuni yɛligu ka gbib li n-lee mal alibarika.
en: But Jesus said, The people who hear the teaching of God and obey it—they are the ones who have Gods blessing.

dag: Amaa ka o ŋari ma. O taɣi n yɔri la siɣimsiɣim bupia, amaa Naawuni bi saɣi ka o niŋ ma shɛli.
en: But he cheated me. He has changed my pay ten times. But during all this time, God protected me from all of Labans tricks.

dag: Zaŋm Lɛvi zuliya na nti zali Aduna ŋun nyɛ maligumaana la tooni, ka bɛ sɔŋd o.
en: Bring near the tribe of Levi and place them before Aaron the priest. They will assist him.

dag: Yi ni ti di biŋkpam hal ti tiɣi, ka nyu ʒim hal ti buɣi sara maligu chu shɛli shili n ni maani tiri ya maa ni.
en: When I kill these people like sacrifices, the birds and animals are to eat all the fat they can hold and to drink blood until they are drunk.

dag: Giliad tizɔpaɣ Hamolɛkɛt n-daa dɔɣi Ishɔd mini Abiɛza ni Mahila.
en: Makirs sister Hammoleketh had Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.

dag: ka zaŋ yi tizo maa na ka n ti nya o, ka di wuhi ni yi yɛligu maa nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, ka yi tiligi. Ka bɛ daa shiri niŋ lala.
en: Then you must bring your youngest brother to me. This will prove that you have been telling the truth, and I will not put you to death. They agreed to this.

dag: Lala ka alahichi nya soli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa ni n-yiɣisi kɔre balibu kam n ni. Di yi di pa lala Naawuni fukumsi zaligu zuɣu, alahichi naan nyɛla din kpi.
en: But by means of that commandment sin found its chance to stir up all kinds of selfish desires in me. Apart from law, sin is a dead thing.

dag: Di lan chaŋya ti chɛ mɔri na ti ti ba ka bɛ ŋma bilichiisi maa. Chɛliya ka bɛ maŋmaŋ chani ti chɛri mɔri maa na.
en: He said, You have always given the people straw to use to make bricks. But now, tell them they have to go and find their own straw to make bricks.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa yɛli Yɛhudianim bɛn niŋ o yɛda maa, Yi yi doli n yɛligu, yi ni niŋ n nyaandol maŋa.
en: So Jesus said to those who believed in him, If you obey my teaching, you are really my disciples;.

dag: Ŋuni ka n lee yɛn zaŋ saɣisigu yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ tɔɣisi ka o chɛ ka bɛ wum? Nyama, bɛ tiba ŋarimi, bɛ ku tooi wum. Yawɛ yɛligu nyɛla ansarisi bini bɛ sani. Bɛ baɣa ka di ni.
en: I answered, Who would listen to me if I spoke to them and warned them? They are stubborn and refuse to listen to your message; they laugh at what you tell me to say.

dag: Di bi simdi ni yidana zaɣisir o min o paɣa laɣimbu; ka paɣ gba di zaɣisir o min o yidana laɣimbu.
en: The husband should give his wife what she deserves as his wife. And the wife should give her husband what he deserves as her husband.

dag: Biɛhiŋ kani, yi pun wum ni Naawuni daanfaani zuɣu ka o zaŋ tuuni ŋɔ ti ma ni n tum yi sɔŋbu zuɣu.
en: Youve heard, of course, about the responsibility to distribute Gods grace, which God gave to me for you, right?.

dag: Binshɛŋa din be ashilɔni nyɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ dini, amaa binshɛŋa din yi zahira nyɛla ti mini ti bihi dini sahakam ni di chɛ ka ti doli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa din be zaligu ŋɔ puuni.
en: The secret things belong to the LORD our God. The revealed things belong to us and to our children forever: to keep all the words of this covenant.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa bah o niriba noli, ka bɛ zaŋ Ibram min o paɣa ni o ni mali binshɛlikam zaa yihi soli.
en: Pharaoh gave his men orders concerning Abram, and they expelled him with his wife and everything he had.

dag: Ka n daa kul mali lala hal ti paai Kɔbilinini Dunɔdal la mini Naa Kosubo bɔɣili la polo. Ka n ni daa bari biŋkɔb so maa daa bi tooi nya soli gari.
en: Then I went on to the Spring Gate and to the Kings Pool. Since there was no room for the animal on which I was riding to pass.

dag: Bɛ ku lan labi bɛ yinsi, ka bɛ ni daa be luɣ shɛli maa nim ku lan baŋ ba yaha.
en: Never will I return home; soon I will be forgotten.

dag: hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ ti lihi tiŋ na nya li.
en: Until the Lord looks down from heaven and sees us.

dag: Ka n ni be sarika ŋɔ ni zuɣu chɛ ka ti mabihi pam niŋ ti Duuma naani, naɣ kul gbaai yihila bɛ ni niriba biɛla. Ka bɛn niŋ naani maa kul mali suhukpeeni sahakam ka yihiri lahibal suŋ waazu ka dabiɛm zɔbu kani.
en: Most of the brothers and sisters have had more confidence through the Lord to speak the word boldly and bravely because of my jail time.

dag: Huramabi daa lan zaŋ daanya viɛlli mali duɣuri mini soobuya ni dirijaba ni nɛma balibu kam zaa ti Naa Sulemaana ni o zaŋ niŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: and the pots, the shovels, and the meat forks. All the things that Huram-abi made for King Solomon for the LORDs temple were made of polished bronze.

dag: Dindali maa, kɔbil nin shɛli ni ti puhigi, ka Dauda daŋ ni niriba mini Jɛrusalɛmnim zaŋ di kom su n-yi alahichi mini buɣijɛmbo daɣiri ni.
en: On that day, a fountain will open to cleanse the sin and impurity of Davids house and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

dag: Paɣimiya Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma Yisa Masia Naawuni min o Ba ŋɔ! Ŋun Naawuni nambɔzɔbo din galisi la puuni ka ti nya nyɛvili palli o ni daa neei Yisa Masia kum ni la zuɣu, ka di chɛ ka ti mali tahima nɛɔŋ.
en: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. God is so good, and by raising Jesus from death, he has given us new life and a hope that lives on.

dag: Zilim balli nyɛla nyɛvili tia, amaa yɔhiŋ yɛtɔɣa nyɛla din chɛ ka nir suhu saɣinda.
en: Kind words bring life, but cruel words crush your spirit.

dag: Ka Sadusiinim shɛb bɛn yɛri ni kum ni neebu kani la daa ka Yisa sanna.
en: Some Sadducees came to Jesus. They asked him.

dag: Ka Gibianim daa ti kana ti liri ma yuŋ n-teei gili n yilikpɛrili. Bɛ daa lo ma la kubu; ka daa gbaai m mam maa chaŋ ti goli ku o.
en: But during the night the men of the city of Gibeah came to the house where I was staying. They surrounded the house, and they wanted to kill me. They raped my slave woman, and she died.

dag: Ka Naaman daa chaŋ o naa sani nti yɛl o, Izraɛl bipuɣimbil la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ.
en: When Naaman told the king what the girl had said.

dag: N ni daa kul ŋmaligi bɛ sani, di daa bi yuui ka n nya n suhu ni yuri so pam maa. Ka n daa gbaag o mali, ka bi saɣi bah o ka o chaŋ. Ka n daa zaŋ o kuli m ma yiŋa nti zaŋ o kpe ŋun daa zali m pua duu.
en: No sooner did I depart from them than I found the one whom I love with all my heart. I held on to him and now I wont let him go, until Ive brought him to my mothers house, to the chamber of the one who conceived me.

dag: Ŋmam nudirigu polo, ka ŋma nuzaa polo! Bɛ ni kul zaŋ a noli kpa luɣ shɛlikam polo.
en: Stab again and again! Plunge right, plunge left, wherever your edge goes.

dag: amaa yi ni mali pam pumpɔŋɔ zuɣu, di niŋ kamaata ni yi sɔŋ bɛn ka. Ka yi gba yi ti ka ka bɛ mi mali pam, bɛ ni sɔŋ ya, ka lala niŋbu ni chɛ ka yi tab sɔŋbu saɣ taba.
en: At the present moment, your surplus can fill their deficit so that in the future their surplus can fill your deficit. In this way there is equality.

dag: Naawuni, bɔ saha ka a dimnim maa lee yɛn chɛ a labu? Bɛ kul yɛn tarila a yuli daɣiri sahakam?.
en: How long, God, will foes insult you? Are enemies going to abuse your name forever?.

dag: Mani n-su anzinfa mini salima zaa. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: All their silver really belongs to me! And all the gold is mine! This is what the Lord All-Powerful said.

dag: Amaa ka Juda daa yɛl o, Doo maa daa kpahi ti zuɣu ni yɛli, Yi yi ti bi ʒi yi tizo maa na, yin di chɛ ka n ninni nyan ya.
en: Judah replied, The governor strictly warned us that we would not be allowed to see him unless we brought our youngest brother with us. If you let us take Benjamin along, we will go and buy grain. But we won't go without him.

dag: Yi gba yumiya saamba, dama yi daa nyɛla saamba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: That means you must also love immigrants because you were immigrants in Egypt.

dag: Aizaia daa yɛli ba mi, Yɛlimiya yi dana ni Yawɛ yɛliya, Di chɛ ka dabiɛm mal a yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa a ni wum ka Asiria naa tuumba kana ti yɛli tu ma maa zuɣu.
en: Isaiah said to them, Say this to your master: The LORD says this: Dont be afraid at the words you heard, which the officers of Assyrias king have used to insult me.

dag: N ni zaŋ azichi shɛli din be zibisim ni mini ashili shee ti a. Ka di chɛ ka a baŋ ni man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ m-bol a yuli.
en: I will give you treasures from dark, secret places; then you will know that I am the Lord and that the God of Israel has called you by name.

dag: Nɛma labisi ti yuuni maa ni, di simdi ka yi labisi puu maa ti bɛ ni daa da li ninvuɣ so sani maa, ŋun daa su li, ka di nyɛla o di li la fali maa.
en: In the Jubilee year the piece of land will return to the seller, to the one who is the original owner of the family property.

dag: N daa yi chaŋ tiŋ puuni dunɔdali gbini nti zaŋ n kuɣ zali laɣiŋgu ni.
en: When I sat down at the meeting of the city council.

dag: Maligumaana maa yi ti deei piɛɣu maa yi nuu ni n-zaŋ li zali Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sara maligu bimbini gbini.
en: The priest will take the basket and set it in front of the Lord 's altar.

dag: Tumo ŋun biɛ tahirila yɛla na, amaa tumo ŋun ʒe yim tahirila faako na.
en: Whoever delivers your message can make things better or worse for you.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni ti zaŋ ya ti ʒili yi yaannim ni daa su tiŋgbɔn shɛli la ni, ka yi ti su li, ka o chɛ ka yi tɔŋ, ka yi kalinli galisi gari yi yaannim maa kalinli.
en: The LORD your God will bring you home to the land that your ancestors possessed; you will possess it again. And he will do good things for you and multiply you—making you more numerous even than your ancestors!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yisa Kaiafas yiŋ maa ni n-tahi Gomna yiŋa asibaasi. Bɛmaŋmaŋ daa bi saɣi doli kpe Gomna yiŋ maa ni, dama bɛ daa bi bɔri ni bɛ tum birigi bɛ kali din ni chɛ ka daɣiri tab ba ka bɛ ku tooi di Yaɣigari Chuɣu bindirigu.
en: Then the guards took Jesus from Caiaphas house to the Roman governors palace. It was early in the morning. The Jews there would not go inside the palace. They did not want to make themselves unclean, because they wanted to eat the Passover meal.

dag: N tim ba la ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi mi Naawuni, ka nyɛ bɛn chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi pam sani. N tim ba mi ni bɛ ti di bɛ nɛma, ka du n-tam bɛ zuɣu n-no ba kaman soli zuɣu taŋkpaɣu la.
en: I sent Assyria to attack a godless nation, people who have made me angry. I sent them to loot and steal and trample the people like dirt in the streets.

dag: Ka bɛ daa puhi ti ni ti paabuna ka niŋ ti nirilim pam, dama bɛ daa malila buɣim ti ti saa ni daa miri ka wari beni zuɣu.
en: The people who lived there were very good to us. It was raining and very cold, so they built a fire and welcomed all of us.

dag: Izraɛl zuliya nam be barina ni. Di tipum zuɣupiligu din mali jilima, ka pili bɛ zuɣulaannim bɛn yu nam pam zuɣuri ni la nyɛla din kpaara. Bɛ zuɣuri zaa nyola tulaale, amaa ka bɛ lee nyu wain buɣi do nimaani.
en: The city of Samaria above a fertile valley is in for trouble! Its leaders are drunkards, who stuff themselves with food and wine. But they will be like flowers that dry up and wilt.

dag: Ka lan yɛli ba, Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, anabi kam maŋmaŋ yanim pun bi deer o.
en: But you can be sure that no prophets are liked by the people of their own hometown.

dag: Yawɛ yuri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je alahichi; o gul o ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim; o fari ba ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni bahira.
en: Hate evil, you who love the Lord . He protects his followers and saves them from evil people.

dag: amaa ŋunkam tumdi din tuhi ni nya jilima mini paɣibu ni suhudoo, Yɛhudianima n-lan daŋ tooni ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim paya.
en: But God will give glory, honor, and peace to all who do what is good, to the Jews first and also to the Gentiles.

dag: Dama ti bi be kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali Naawuni yɛligu n-niŋdi kaman neen shɛŋa bɛ ni kɔhiri alaha, amaa ti nyɛla yɛlimaŋlinima ka nyɛ Naawuni ni pii shɛb tim, ka zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni sani, ti nyɛla bɛn tɔɣisiri Masia yɛla.
en: We arent like so many people who hustle the word of God to make a profit. We are speaking through Christ in the presence of God, as those who are sincere and as those who are sent from God.

dag: Ka Naa Sulemaana mini Izraɛl niriba bɛn zaa daa laɣim o sani maa daa be Alikauli Adaka maa tooni. Bɛ daa kɔri piɛri mini naɣilahi mali sara hal ka so daa naan ku tooi lan kali ba bee m-baŋ bɛ kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm yaha.
en: while King Solomon and the entire Israelite assembly that had joined him before the chest sacrificed countless sheep and oxen.

dag: n yi di di daatam ka bi yo di zuɣu, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛn su li kpi.
en: Nor have I cheated my workers and caused them pain.

dag: Dindali maa yuŋ ka Yaakubu daa yiɣisi zaŋ o paɣiba ayi la min o dabipaɣiba ayi ni o bihi piniyini la chaŋ ti gbaai Jabok Mɔɣili du.
en: Jacob got up during the night, took his two wives, his two women servants, and his eleven sons, and crossed the Jabbok Rivers shallow water.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa nya shihir shɛli Yisa ni wuhi maa ka bɛ yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ ni daa yɛli ni anab so ni ti ka dunia ŋɔ ni na la n-shiri bala.
en: The people saw this miraculous sign that Jesus did and said, He must be the Prophet who is coming into the world.

dag: Ka Jɛfita daa yiɣisi doli Giliad kpamba maa kuli, ka Giliadnim ti zaŋ o leei bɛ zuɣulana ni bɛ sapashin kpɛma. Ka Jɛfita daa tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa ni nyɛ shɛm zaa Yawɛ sani Mizipa.
en: So Jephthah went back to Mizpah with the leaders of Gilead. The people of Gilead gathered at the place of worship and made Jephthah their ruler. Jephthah also made promises to them.

dag: Ka yuun shɛli Izraɛlnim ni labisiri nɛma tiri tab la saha yi ti paai, bɛn zaŋm bɛ tarili maa pahi bɛ ni kuli daŋ shɛli puuni dɔbba maa tarili ni, ka bɛ tarili maa ku lan be ti yaannim tarili ni.
en: In the Year of Restoration, when all property that has been sold is restored to its original owners, the property of Zelophehad's daughters will be permanently added to the tribe into which they marry and will be lost to our tribe.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Wula ka a lee niŋ ka a nina maa neei.
en: Then how can you see? they asked.

dag: Dama ŋunkam tibigir omaŋ ni nya filiŋ, ka ŋunkam mi siɣisir omaŋ ni nya tibiginsim.
en: For those who make themselves great will be humbled, and those who humble themselves will be made great.

dag: Ti yaannim maa ni daa be Ijipti saha shɛl la, bɛ baɣa daa ka a daalahiziba tuma ni. Bɛ daa tam a yurilim maŋli din galisi la yɛla, ka daa taai duŋ niŋ nyin Kpiɔŋlan Naa ŋɔ Teeku Ʒiɛɣu ni.
en: Our ancestors in Egypt didnt understand your wondrous works. They didnt remember how much faithful love you have. So they rebelled by the sea—at the Reed Sea.

dag: Dauda ni daa kpe o yili la ni naai, ka o daa ti yɛli anabi Neetan, Nyama, man bela sida dari yil ni, amaa ka Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka ŋɔ din be suɣili ni.
en: After David had moved into his palace, he said to Nathan the prophet, Look, I am living in this nice palace made of cedar, but the Box of the Lord s Agreement sits in a tent.

dag: Judanim gba daa bi doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa zalikpana la, amaa ka daa dolila Izraɛlnim ni daa zali ka shɛŋa la.
en: But even the people of Judah did not obey the laws of the Lord their God; they imitated the customs adopted by the people of Israel.

dag: Bɛ ni daa guni ba naai, Izraɛlnim zaa daa kpalim dola luɣ yini hal ka bɛn guni maa yuma ti naai zaa.
en: After the circumcision was completed, the whole nation stayed in the camp until the wounds had healed.

dag: Ka Jɛhu daa kpuɣ o tɔbu n-darigi li ni o kpiɔŋ zaa n-to Jɔram bɔɣusapima sunsuuni, ka piɛm maa chaŋ ti gbaag o suhu, ka o lɛb lu o chɛchɛbuŋ puuni.
en: Jehu shot an arrow. It hit Joram between his shoulders, then it went through his heart and came out his chest. He fell over dead in his chariot.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Yum a Duuma Naawuni ni a suhu zaa min a shia zaa ni a tɛha zaa.
en: Jesus answered, Love the Lord your God with all your heart, all your soul, and all your mind.

dag: Amaa ka Yaakubu yɛl o ma Ribɛka, Nyama, m biɛli Iso niŋgbuna mali kɔbiri pam, ka m mi niŋgbuna be polipoli.
en: But Jacob said to his mother, You know that Esau is a hairy man, but I have smooth skin.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lo noli, ka kpe duu nti teei dɔni tiŋgban ni suhiri Naawuni bia maa zuɣu din dali maa yuŋ zaa.
en: David begged God for the boy. He fasted and spent the night sleeping on the ground.

dag: Ti malila ti tizɔpaɣa, ka o biha bi yaɣi lala. Ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ ti tizɔpaɣ maa, dɔbba yi ti kana ti bɔr o?.
en: Our sister is small; she has no breasts. What will we do for our sister on the day that she is spoken for?.

dag: Abijam mini Jɛrɔbɔam daa kul tuhirila tab tɔbu hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: There was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam as long as Abijam lived.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, bɛ yi ti yihi lahibal suŋ ŋɔ waazu dunia ŋɔ ni luɣ shɛlikam zaa, bɛ ni yɛli paɣ ŋɔ ni tum tuun shɛli ŋɔ teer o yɛla.
en: Now, I assure you that wherever this gospel is preached all over the world, what she has done will be told in memory of her.

dag: dama nir yi bi mi o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm n-gbib omaŋmaŋ yiŋnima, wula ka o ni tooi gbibi Naawuni cheechi?.
en: If they don't know how to control their own families, how can they look after God's people?.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Yiɣisima, yim kpe siɣi tiŋ yomyom, dama a ni daa zaŋ a ninvuɣ shɛb yi Ijipti na la tum tuumbiɛɣu, bɛ ŋmaligiya yomyom ka chɛ n ni daa zali ba ni bɛ doli so shɛli maa; ka doola binnani zali bɛmaŋa.
en: Then the Lord said to me, Go down the mountain at once, because your people, whom you led out of Egypt, have become corrupt and have done evil. They have already turned away from what I commanded them to do, and they have made an idol for themselves.

dag: Di zaa yoli, ka o zaŋ bin suma pali bɛ yinsi. Amaa ninvuɣ biɛri ni lo shɛli ka n je.
en: Yet he filled their houses with good things; a sinners logic is beyond me.

dag: Ŋuna n-wuhi ma tɔbu tuhibu; ka chɛ ka n nuhi mali yaa din ni tooi zaŋ daanya tɔb to.
en: He trains me for war so that my arms can bend the most powerful bow.

dag: Wummiya n ni yɛri ya shɛm. Chɛliya ka yi baɣa be n yɛligu ni.
en: Pay close attention to what I am saying.

dag: Di tam a dimnim ni yɔri vu shɛl la yɛla; a mi di tam bɛ ni na kul tahiri yɔri vu shɛŋa sahakam la gba yɛla.
en: Don't forget the angry shouts of your enemies, the continuous noise made by your foes.

dag: Ka niriba maa mini bɛ malibu zaa daa yina ti ʒe bɛ suɣa dunoya ni kumda, ka Musa daa wum bɛ kumsi maa; ka Yawɛ suhi daa yiɣisi pam, ka di daa bi niŋ Musa nyaɣisim.
en: The Israelites stood around their tents complaining. Moses heard them and was upset that they had made the Lord angry.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, N ni chɛ ka tɔbu mini kum ni alɔbo lu bɛ zuɣu, ka n chɛ ka bɛ be kaman fiig tiwal poma din bie pam ka so ku tooi di li la.
en: The Lord Almighty says, I am bringing war, starvation, and disease on them, and I will make them like figs that are too rotten to be eaten.

dag: Dinzuɣu m bia, pumpɔŋɔ Yawɛ ni be a sani ka ni chɛ ka a nya nasara Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu maa mɛbu ni kaman o ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ a polo.
en: Now, my son, may the LORD be with you so that you may successfully build the temple of the LORD your God, as he promised you.

dag: Ka a mi o ni daa tum tuun sun shɛŋa Ɛfɛsus la gba yɛla viɛnyɛliŋga. Ti Duuma chɛ ka o ti nya nambɔzɔbo o sani ŋun ti Duuma labbuna dabisili la dali.
en: I pray that the Lord Jesus will ask God to show mercy to Onesiphorus on the day of judgment. You know how much he helped me in Ephesus.

dag: Amaa yi yi ku saɣi guni kaman ti ni yɛli shɛm maa, dindina ti ni zaŋ ti bipuɣiŋga maa yiɣisi chaŋ.
en: But if you will not accept our terms and be circumcised, we will take her and leave.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla a yi dol ti chaŋ, Yawɛ yi ti niŋ ti zaɣ viɛl shɛlikam, lala ka ti gba ni niŋ a.
en: Besides that, if you go, we will give you a share of the good things the Lord gives us.

dag: ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ ni zaŋ yabiga gari wain shɛl ni ti o ni o nyu; amaa ka o lam li ka zaɣisi li nyubu.
en: There they gave Jesus some wine mixed with a drug to ease the pain. But when Jesus tasted what it was, he refused to drink it.

dag: Amaa bɛ yi ti deei puu maa chuɣu puhibu la saha, di ni nyɛla din be kasi Yawɛ sani, ka nyɛ bɛ ni zaŋ pu shɛli ti Yawɛ. Maligumaana n-ni ti su li.
en: When the piece of land is released in the Jubilee year, it will be holy to the LORD like a piece of devoted land; it will be the priests property.

dag: Ka Vuhim Dabisili dali maa daa gari, ka bakɔi piligu dali biɛɣu ti neerina, ka Mariama ŋun daa nyɛ Magdala tiŋbia la min o tɔɣima la daa chaŋ ni bɛ ti nya Yisa siliga maa.
en: The day after the Sabbath day was the first day of the week. That day at dawn Mary Magdalene and the other woman named Mary went to look at the tomb.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti Duuma maŋmaŋ ni wuhi ya shihirili. Nyamiya, paɣisari so ni ti niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga, ka bɛ ti bol o yuli Imanuɛl.
en: Well then, the Lord himself will give you a sign: a young woman who is pregnant will have a son and will name him Immanuel.

dag: Amaa ka tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa yi Naa Amɔn nyaaŋa maa zaa, ka zaŋ o bia Jɔsia leei naa zal o zaani.
en: The people of the land then executed all those who had plotted against King Amon and made his son Josiah the next king.

dag: Ka Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga ŋun be o ko la bemi kaman tihi puu ni suɣili bee puu ni sampaa la; ka be kaman be ni teei gili tin shɛli.
en: Enemies surround Jerusalem, alone like a hut in a vineyard or in a cucumber field.

dag: N ni zaŋ n ni po ni n ni zaŋ shɛli ti Yawɛ n-ti o, o niriba zaa sani.
en: I will keep my promise to you when your people meet.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Di yi pala wunsuhigu mini nolɔbo zuɣu so ku tooi kari alizini ŋɔ tatabo.
en: Only prayer can drive this kind out, answered Jesus; nothing else can.

dag: Hal pumpɔŋɔ lɛhu domi gu tihi; dinzuɣu tia kam din bi wandi wal suma, bɛ ni ŋmaa li luhi n-zaŋ nyo buɣim.
en: An ax is ready to cut the trees down at their roots. Any tree that doesn't produce good fruit will be chopped down and thrown into a fire.

dag: Di saha ka Amazia daa chɛ ka tɔbutuhiriba bɛn daa yi Ifriim tiŋgban ni na maa lab kuli. Ka bɛ suhuri daa yiɣisi pam bahi Judanim zuɣu ka bɛ je suli pam lab kuli.
en: Amaziah ordered the troops from Israel to go home, but when they left, they were furious with the people of Judah.

dag: Bɛ chi sara yɛn nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ kpam ŋmiri zim viɛl shɛli, ka yi zaŋ di kilɔgiram ata pahi naɣilahi pinaata maa zaɣ yino kam zuɣu, ka zaŋ di kilɔgiram ayi pahi piɛlah ayi maa zaɣ yino kam zuɣu;.
en: You must also offer cups of fine flour mixed with oil with each of the bulls, cups with each of the rams.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛl o, Bolim o yuli Jɛziriil, dama di ku lan yuui, n ni darigi Jɛhu zuliya tibili o ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb Jɛziriil la ʒim yihibu zuɣu, ka chɛ ka Izraɛl nam zani tariga.
en: The LORD said to him, Name him Jezreel; for in a little while I will punish the house of Jehu for the blood of Jezreel, and I will destroy the kingdom of the house of Israel.

dag: Yuuni kam Yisa ba min o ma daa yi chanila Jɛrusalɛm ti puhiri Yaɣigari Chuɣu.
en: Every year Jesus' parents went to Jerusalem for Passover.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa zaŋ yilli ŋɔ puuni yɛtɔɣa n-yɛli hal ti paai di tariga, ka Izraɛl laɣiŋgu maa zaa wum li.
en: All the Israelites were gathered together, and Moses sang this whole song for them:.

dag: Di chɛliya ka yi bebu be kaman dunia ŋɔ nim bebu, amaa chɛliya ka yi bebu zaa taɣi, yi tɛha ni leei tɛhi pala la zuɣu, ka lala chɛ ka yi tooi baŋ Naawuni yubu din nyɛ din viɛli mini din tiɣir o nini ni din be tibi la.
en: Don't be like the people of this world, but let God change the way you think. Then you will know how to do everything that is good and pleasing to him.

dag: Ka Dilaila yɛl o, A boli ma la jɛrigu, ka ŋma ma ʒiri. Niŋm ania, yɛlim ma nir ni yɛn niŋ shɛm lo a mihi.
en: Then Delilah said to Samson, You made a fool out of me and lied to me. Now please tell me how you can really be tied up.

dag: A daa chɛ ka Musa mini Aduna gari tooni n-zaŋ a niriba bɛn ŋmani piɛri la chaŋ.
en: You led your people like sheep, using Moses and Aaron to guide them.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord said to Moses.

dag: Nyin Ɛdom bipuɣiŋga ŋun be Uzi ŋɔ, kul lam ni suhupiɛlli. Bɛ ni zaŋ pipia maa ti a gba, ka a gba nyu n-kuli, ka pirig a zaɣim.
en: Laugh on, people of Edom and Uz; be glad while you can. Your disaster is coming too; you too will stagger naked in shame.

dag: Dindali maa Yawɛ ni ti zaŋ o ninkuunsi takɔb titali din mali kpiɔŋ la n-darigi Lɛviatan ŋun nyɛ waɣ so ŋun pɔripɔri ka yiɣiri la tibili; ka ku teeku ni biŋkɔb biɛɣu la.
en: On that day, Leviathan, the sea monster, will squirm and try to escape, but the Lord will kill him with a cruel, sharp sword.

dag: Bɛ ni ti chɛ bɛ tɔbbihi bɛn kpi sɔŋ palo ni, ka zoya zuɣu noonsi mini mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri di ba, ka ŋub ba. Noonsi ni ti di ba shɛɣu ni, ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri mi ŋub ba kikaa saha.
en: The vines will be left for the birds from the mountains and the wild animals to eat. The birds will feed on them throughout the summer, and that winter the wild animals will eat the vines.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ti yɛn zaŋ a bibihi fiɛbi tampima ni ti mali alibarika!.
en: who take your babies and smash them against a rock.

dag: O daa ku Ijiptinim bidib kpamba zaa bɛn daa nyɛ bɛ ni tuui dɔɣi bi shɛba Ham suɣa ni la.
en: God struck down all of Egypts oldest males; in Hams tents, he struck their pride and joy.

dag: Ka n ni chɛ ka m min a ni a zuliya mali alikauli din ni ʒiɛya sahakam bɛ ʒiɛmana ni. Ka n ni nyɛ a min a zuliya maa Naawuni.
en: I will keep my promise to you and to your descendants in future generations as an everlasting covenant. I will be your God and the God of your descendants.

dag: Saha shɛlikam n yi ti lo ni m bɔhim nya yɛm, ka nya niriba ni gaani gom yuŋ ni wuntaŋ ni n-tumdi tuun shɛŋa dunia ni.
en: I carefully studied the things people do in this life. I saw how busy people are. They work day and night, and they almost never sleep.

dag: Ka Yisahaku mini Ishimail bɛn daa nyɛ o bidibisi la daa zaŋ o ti sɔɣi Makipɛla siliga din daa be Zɔhar ŋun daa nyɛ Hiti nir la bia Ɛfurɔn palo din be Mamri wulimpuhili polo la ni.
en: His sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in Machpelah Cave, in the field east of Mamre that had belonged to Ephron son of Zohar the Hittite.

dag: Deemi ti suhigu, ka zaŋ a kpiɔŋ la n-ti ti nasara, ka lala chɛ ka a ni yuri ninvuɣ shɛb la tiligi.
en: Save us by your power and answer us so that the people you love might be rescued.

dag: N nia lɔbu nyɛla ni n yihi lahibal suŋ waazu ŋɔ luɣ shɛli niriba ni na bi wum Masia yuli yɛla, ka di chɛ ka n ku me n-tam so mɛbu zuɣu.
en: My ambition has always been to proclaim the Good News in places where Christ has not been heard of, so as not to build on a foundation laid by someone else.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu gba daa mali shili ni o yi Nazarɛt Galili tiŋgbɔŋ ni kuli Bɛtilihɛm Judia tiŋgbɔŋ ni Naa Dauda ya la, dama o daa yila Naa Dauda zuliya ni na.
en: So Joseph left Nazareth, a town in Galilee, and went to the town of Bethlehem in Judea. It was known as the town of David. Joseph went there because he was from the family of David.

dag: Lala ka bɛ daa niŋ yiɣisi niriba mini bɛ kpamba ni Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba suhuri, ka bɛ daa kabina nti gbaai Stiivin tahi jintɔriba sani.
en: In this way they stirred up the people, the elders, and the teachers of the Law. They seized Stephen and took him before the Council.

dag: Amaa yi lee nyɛla bɛn duhiri yimaŋa ka nyuri bara. Ka barinyubo ŋɔ tatabo zaa nyɛla zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Yet you are stupid enough to brag, and it is wrong to be so proud.

dag: N nyaya ka daba bari yuri, ka chɛ ka nabihi chani tiŋa kaman daba la.
en: I have seen slaves on horseback, while princes walk on foot like slaves.

dag: Ka Sool min o niriba maa daa ti paai Hachila zolɔŋni zaŋ labi Jɛshimɔn wulimpuhili polo nti ti bɛ suɣa do nimaani palli noli. Amaa Dauda daa na bela mɔɣu maa ni. O ni daa ti wum ni Sool kar o naba na mɔɣu maa ni.
en: and camped by the road on Mount Hachilah. David was still in the wilderness, and when he learned that Saul had come to look for him.

dag: Ka Simiɔn daa deei bia maa buɣi, ka paɣiri Naawuni yɛra:.
en: Simeon took the child in his arms and gave thanks to God:.

dag: Kulla naa kɔŋko m-mali soli ni o ʒini di puuni n-di bindirigu Yawɛ tooni. O ni dolila dunɔdali maa polo zɔntua kpe, ka lan doli nimaani yi.
en: Only the ruler of the people may sit at this gate when he eats a meal with the Lord . He must enter through the porch of the gateway and go out the same way.

dag: Izraɛlnima, Gibia dal la ka yi daa tum alahichi. Nimaani ka bɛ daa dii gbaai alahichi tumbu. Dinzuɣu tɔbu ni lu bɛ zuɣu Gibia.
en: Israel, you have never stopped sinning since that time at Gibeah. That's why you will be attacked at Gibeah.

dag: Pamiya buŋ nyaampara ti ma. Ka bɛ daa pa buŋ maa nyaampara ti o ka o ba.
en: and he told them to saddle his donkey for him. They did so, and he rode off.

dag: Yawɛ, zom ma nambɔɣu, dama m bela muɣisigu ni. N kummi hal ka n nina ti biɛra, ka n niŋgbuŋ gba gbarigi.
en: Have pity, Lord ! I am hurting and almost blind. My whole body aches.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ daa yɛli ma, Cham Shɛbina ŋun nyɛ nayili tumtumdiba zuɣulan la sani nti bɔh o.
en: The LORD God of heavenly forces says, Go now to this official, to Shebna, who is in charge of the house, and say to him.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun ni gbibi ya hal ni di bahigu ni, ka yi ti ku mali galimi ŋun ti Duuma Yisa Masia dabisili maa dali.
en: And until the day Christ does return, he will keep you completely innocent.

dag: ka bɔh o, Ka bindir bɔ ka a lee mali? Tim ma bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu bee a ni kul mali bindir shɛli kpe.
en: Do you have any food you can give me? Could you spare five loaves of bread.

dag: Tulaale viɛlli nyom ku be bɛ sani, naɣila nyom biɛɣu. Bɛ ku mali shɛlɔri viɛla lɔra, naɣila gabisi, bɛ ku mali zab viɛla, naɣila zuɣukpina, bɛ ku mali binyɛr viɛla yɛra, naɣila buri. Bɛ viɛlim ni ŋmaligi leei vi.
en: Instead of perfume there will be a disgusting odor; instead of a sash, a rope; instead of styled hair, shaved heads; instead of expensive clothes, rags as mourning clothes; instead of beauty, shame.

dag: ka yɛli, N zaɣim ka m ma daa dɔɣi ma, n zaɣim ka n ti lan yɛn zaŋ yi dunia ni. Yawɛ n-daa ti ma, Yawɛ n-lan deei. Yawɛ yuli simdi paɣibu.
en: and said: We bring nothing at birth; we take nothing with us at death. The Lord alone gives and takes. Praise the name of the Lord .

dag: Ka di mi pala yi ni tum shɛli zuɣu ka yi tiligi, dinzuɣu shɛli kani ka yi ni nyu bara di zuɣu.
en: You are not saved by the things you have done, so there is nothing to boast about.

dag: Luɣ dini ka n lee yɛn zo n-chaŋ ka chɛ a Shia? Bee ya ka n lee yɛn zo n-kuli n-yi a sani?.
en: Where could I go to escape from your Spirit or from your sight?.

dag: Bɛ suhuri daa bi ʒe yim zaŋ chaŋ o sani; ka bɛ mi daa bi dol o ni lo ba alikauli shɛl la soli.
en: They were not loyal to him; they were not faithful to their covenant with him.

dag: Ka Ilaija yɛl o, A ni suhi shɛli maa yɛla kpɛma, di zaa yoli, bɛ yi ti kpuɣ ma a sani chani ka a nya ma, a ni nya a ni bɔri shɛli maa, amaa a yi ti bi nya ma, a ku nya li.
en: Elijah said, You have asked a hard thing. If you see me when I am taken from you, it will happen. But if you dont see me when I am taken from you, it will not happen.

dag: Naa guliba sapashin kpɛm maa daa lan kpuɣi la bihi mini buɣim moori bina ni taha ni duɣuri ni firilatamdisi ni chɛriti ni salima mini anzinfa la shɛŋa bɛ ni daa mali niŋdi sara maligu kom la.
en: The commander of the kings special guards took these things away: basins, firepans, large bowls, pots, lampstands, pans, and bowls used for drink offerings. He took everything that was made of gold or silver.

dag: ni Hivinim ni Arikinim ni Sinitinim.
en: Hivites, Arkites, Sinites.

dag: Ninsalinim ninvuɣ biɛtali dirimi kaman buɣim din diri suligunyinyari mini gɔhi ka diri neeri yɔɣu zaa, ka di nyɔhi kpuɣiri duri zuɣusaa la.
en: Evil had spread like a raging forest fire sending thornbushes up in smoke.

dag: Ka zaŋya Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa niŋ tɔroko maa ni, ka zaŋ salima binyara din nyɛ yi daalahichi sanyoo pini la zali baɣili di luɣili ni n-daai li bahi n-chɛ ka di chaŋ di ni bɔri shɛli polo.
en: Put the Lord s Holy Box on the wagon. You must put the golden models in the bag beside the Box. They are your gifts for God to forgive your sins. Send the wagon straight on its way.

dag: Yawɛ zɔbu puuni ka nir niŋdi naani din mali kpiɔŋ, ka o bihi nyari sɔɣisili shee.
en: In the fear of the LORD is strong confidence and refuge for ones children.

dag: Dinzuɣu daadam, tɔɣisim Izraɛlnim yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Dimbɔŋɔ puuni yi yaannim daa lan mo ma bɛ ni daa bi ʒe ma yim la puuni.
en: Therefore, human one, speak to the house of Israel and say to them, The LORD God proclaims: Yet again your ancestors defamed me by rebelling against me!.

dag: O ni daa yɛl o lala bahi ka kpe yili maa ni, o nya ka niriba pam m-pun laɣim ʒiya.
en: Peter kept on talking to Cornelius as he went into the house, where he found many people gathered.

dag: Di saha ka o nyaandoliba ayi bɛn yuya daa booni Jeemsi ni Jɔn daa wum lala ka bɔhi Yisa, Ti Duuma, a bɔri ni ti chɛ ka buɣim yi zuɣusaa na ti di ba kaman Anabi Ilaija ni daa niŋ shɛm la.
en: James and John, the followers of Jesus, saw this. They said, Lord, do you want us to call fire down from heaven and destroy those people.

dag: Yawɛ bela zuɣusaa o luɣ kasi shee ka lihirina. O bela alizanda ni ka lihiri dunia ŋɔ na.
en: The LORD looked down from his holy summit, surveyed the earth from heaven.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka Anabi Aizaia ni daa yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. O ni daa yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ: N Duuma, ŋuni n-lee niŋ ti yɛligu yɛda? Ka ŋuni ka ti Duuma lee kahig o yiko wuhi.
en: so that what the prophet Isaiah had said might come true: Lord, who believed the message we told? To whom did the Lord reveal his power.

dag: Nyini n-wuhi ma nyɛvili soli, ka suhupiɛl maŋli kul be a sani; ka nyaɣisim kul be a nudirigu ni sahakam.
en: You have shown me the path to life, and you make me glad by being near to me. Sitting at your right side, I will always be joyful.

dag: ka bɛ nyu li ka tam bɛ fara yɛla, ka ku lan teei bɛ suhugarigu yɛla.
en: Let them drink and forget their poverty and no longer remember their toil.

dag: Yi ni niŋ yɛda shɛli maa nyɔri nyɛla yi ni nya tiliginsim shɛl la.
en: You are receiving the goal of your faith: your salvation.

dag: Ka pumahigu mini niŋgbun duɣili daa ti gbaag o ba, ka Pool daa kpe nti kaag o ka zaŋ o nuhi pa o zuɣu n-suhi Naawuni ti o ka o kpaŋ zaa.
en: His father was in bed, sick with fever and stomach trouble, and Paul went to visit him. Paul healed the man by praying and placing his hands on him.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Hal ka man ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, Naa Jɛhoyachin ŋun nyɛ Juda Naa Jɛhoyakim bia ŋɔ yi di nyɛ n nintu shɛli n ni mali dihiri binyara zuɣu la, ka di piri n nudirigu ni gba, n naan darigi fuɣ a n nubil maa ni.
en: As surely as I live, declares the LORD, even if Coniah, King Jehoiakims son from Judah were a signet ring on my right hand, I would still remove you from there.

dag: Maligumaana so ŋun leei kpɛma o tab sunsuuni, ka nyɛ bɛ ni daa booi kpam bahi so zuɣu ni mal o kasi n-wolig o zali ni o yɛri maligumaana binyɛra miri ka o chɛ ka o zabiri yirimyirim bee n-dari chɛh o binyɛra.
en: The high priest—the one whose head has been anointed with the anointing oil and who is ordained to dress in the priestly clothing—must not dishevel his hair or tear his clothing.

dag: Pita ni daa ti kul zaŋ o zuɣu tiriti dunol ni ka Kɔniilius dii yiɣisi nti gban o tooni jɛmd o.
en: When Peter entered the house, Cornelius met him. He fell down at Peters feet and worshiped him.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Naa Sulemaana daa mali buni mini yɛm n-gari dunia ŋɔ ni nanim zaa.
en: King Solomon far exceeded all the earths kings in wealth and wisdom.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Jɔn daa bɔhi salo bɛn ka o sanna ni o ti baptaizi ba maa, Yinim garinsi zuliya ŋɔ, ŋuni n-lee saɣisi yi mi ni yi zo n-yi mbusim shɛli din ti yɛn kana ŋɔ ni?.
