en: Crowds of people came out to John to be baptized by him. You snakes! he said to them. Who told you that you could escape from the punishment God is about to send?.

dag: Ka Yawɛ nuu daa pa n zuɣu, ka Yawɛ shia daa zaŋ ma ti zali vinvamli sunsuuni. Kɔba n-daa pali di ni.
en: The LORDs power overcame me, and while I was in the LORDs spirit, he led me out and set me down in the middle of a certain valley. It was full of bones.

dag: Dinzuɣu miriya ka yi chɛ ka so zali ya zaligunima zaŋ chaŋ yi ni ni di shɛli bee n-nyu shɛli polo bee zaŋ chaŋ dabisi kasi shɛŋa mini gol palli chuɣu puhibu ni Vuhim Dabisili kaya dolibu polo.
en: Don't let anyone tell you what you must eat or drink. Don't let them say you must celebrate the New Moon festival, the Sabbath, or any other festival.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ lala yihi nanima anu maa vol maa ni na ti ti o. Nanim maa n-daa nyɛ: Jɛrusalɛm naa mini Hiburɔn naa ni Jarimut naa ni Lakishi naa ni Ɛgilɔn naa.
en: They did so. They brought the five kings out of the cave to him: the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish, and Eglon.

dag: N daa yɛli ba, Yi zaa zaŋmiya yi ni yuri bimbiɛ shɛŋa la zaa labi, ka miriya ka yi zaŋ Ijipti buɣa la n-saɣim yimaŋa. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: I told the family of Israel to throw away their horrible idols. I told them not to become filthy with those filthy statues from Egypt. I said, I am the Lord your God.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ daa bi yu ni o bahi Judanim yoli o dabili Dauda zuɣu, dama o daa pun lo Dauda alikauli ni o ni zaŋ firila ti o min o bidibisi.
en: Nevertheless, because of his servant David, the LORD wasnt willing to destroy Judah. The LORD had promised to preserve a lamp for David and his sons forever.

dag: O nam yiko kul ni zoori pahira; ka suhudoo kul ni be o ʒiɛman ni. O nam ni be kaman Dauda nam. O ni doli wuntia ni din tuhi soli n-chɛ ka dimbɔŋɔ zaa niŋ pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yu ni o niŋ dimbɔŋɔ zaa.
en: There will be vast authority and endless peace for Davids throne and for his kingdom, establishing and sustaining it with justice and righteousness now and forever. The zeal of the LORD of heavenly forces will do this.

dag: Dinzuɣu niŋmi mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ nirilim ŋɔ, dama a chɛ ka m min a lo tab alikauli suŋ. Amaa n yi mali taali, amaŋmaŋ nyin kum ma, dama bɔ zuɣu ka a lan yɛn zaŋ ma chaŋ a ba sani yaha.
en: Jonathan, be kind to me. I am your servant. You have made an agreement with me before the Lord . If I am guilty, you may kill me yourself, but dont take me to your father.

dag: Di ni chɛ ka a nya nirilim niŋbu mini yu suŋ Naawuni mini salinim sani.
en: If you do this, both God and people will be pleased with you.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ ni gbiri anzinfa luɣ shɛli beni, ka bɛ ni doori salima luɣ shɛli beni.
en: Gold and silver are mined, then purified;.

dag: Lala ka alahichi nya soli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa ni n-yiɣisi kɔre balibu kam n ni. Di yi di pa lala Naawuni fukumsi zaligu zuɣu, alahichi naan nyɛla din kpi.
en: And sin found a way to use that command and make me want all kinds of things that werent mine. So sin came to me because of the command. But without the law, sin has no power.

dag: Ti min o ni laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yini mini ti ni niŋ o yɛda la zuɣu ka ti mali suhukpeeni ka niŋ naani ti ni nya soli ni ti tooi chaŋ Naawuni sani la zuɣu.
en: In union with Christ and through our faith in him we have the boldness to go into God's presence with all confidence.

dag: Ibram ni daa nyaŋ Chɛdolaoma mini na shɛb bɛn be o sani ka labirina saha shɛli, ka Sɔdom naa daa chaŋ ti tuh o soli Shave vinvamli ni bɛ ni daa booni luɣ shɛli Naa Vinvamli la.
en: When Abram came back from his victory over Chedorlaomer and the other kings, the king of Sodom went out to meet him in Shaveh Valley .

dag: A mi ni m ba Dauda min o dimnim bɛn gil o daa kul tuhirila taba hal ka Yawɛ daa ti chɛ ka o nyaŋ ba. Lala zuɣu n-daa chɛ ka o bi tooi me Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu.
en: Remember how my father David wanted to build a temple where the Lord his God could be worshiped? But enemies kept attacking my father's kingdom, and he never had the chance.

dag: O tɔbbihi mali kalinli? Ka ŋuni ka o neesim lee bi paara?.
en: Can his troops be counted? On whom does his light not rise?.

dag: Ka Ammɔnnim daa yɔri farigu Naa Uzia sani, ka o yuli daa du hal ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ nim ti wum o yɛla, dama o daa niŋ yaa pam.
en: The Ammonites paid tribute to Uzziah. His name became famous all the way to the border of Egypt. He was famous because he was very powerful.

dag: Ka Jona daa yi tiŋ maa tariga wulimpuhili polo ti ʒini. O daa sa la gara n-kpe n-ʒi di mahim guhiri ni o nya din yɛn niŋ Ninive.
en: Jonah then left through the east gate of the city and made a shelter to protect himself from the sun. He sat under the shelter, waiting to see what would happen to Nineveh.

dag: Ka malaika maa bɔhi ma, Bɔ ka a lee nya maa? Ka n garigi yɛli, N nyala gbaŋ ka di be pɔhim ni yiɣira, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita awɛi, ka di yɛliŋ mi nyɛ mita anahi ni pirigili.
en: And he said to me, What do you see? I said, I see a flying scroll, thirty feet long and fifteen feet wide.

dag: Ka Maika yɛl o, Kpalimmi n sani leei m ba ni m maligumaana. N ni tir a anzinfa kpila pia yuuni kam, ka tir a situra mini bindirigu pahi.
en: Micah said, Stay with me. Be my adviser and priest, and I will give you ten pieces of silver a year, some clothes, and your food.

dag: N daa ka galimi o sani, dama n daa bi tum taal shɛli.
en: He knows I did nothing that was wrong. I have kept myself from sinning.

dag: Dinzuɣu man Yawɛ sujee ni n suhuyiɣisili maa dali, n ni ti chɛ ka zuɣusaa dam, ka chɛ ka tiŋgbani dam pam di biɛhigu shee.
en: In my anger I will shake the sky, and the earth will be moved from its place. That will happen on the day the Lord All-Powerful shows his anger.

dag: Ka zoya daa yiɣiri jɛmdi kaman piɛlahi la, ka daboya daa yiɣiri jɛmdi kaman piɛbihi la.
en: The mountains skipped like goats; the hills jumped around like lambs.

dag: Dama m baŋ n tuumbiɛri ni nyɛ shɛli, ka n daalahichi kul ʒe n tooni.
en: Because I know my wrongdoings, my sin is always right in front of me.

dag: M mabia Jɔnatan, n suhu saɣimya pam a zuɣu. M min a biɛhigu daa lu n-taɣili tab pam. A yurilim zaŋ chaŋ n sani daa mali alahiziba, ka galisi pam gari paɣ ni mali yurilim shɛm.
en: Jonathan, I miss you most! I loved you like a brother. You were truly loyal to me, more faithful than a wife to her husband.

dag: Alichɛbba maa nyiŋgoli daa ŋmanila kurugu gbaɣino nyiŋgoli, ka bɛ niŋ tani kɔɣili di nyiŋgoli maa zaa gili din ni chɛ ka di ku cheei.
en: They made a hole in the center of the robe and sewed a piece of cloth around the edge of this hole. This cloth kept the hole from tearing.

dag: N ku kuli n yiŋa bee n-dɔni m bindoo zuɣu.
en: I won't go home or crawl into bed.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli, O beni, ka lan yɛli, Nyamiya, ŋuna kul be yi tooni chani maa ha; kpaŋ chamiya, pumpɔŋɔ ka o na yoli paana, dama bɛ yɛn malila sara daboli zuɣu zuŋɔ.
en: The young women answered, Yes, the seer is here. He is just up the road. He came to town today. Some people are meeting together today to share in a fellowship offering at the place for worship.

dag: Naawuni, labisim ti a sanna, Zom ti nambɔɣu, ka lala chɛ ka ti tiligi!.
en: Restore us, God! Make your face shine so that we can be saved!.

dag: Jɛkɔnia so bɛ ni daa kpɛhi duu la bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Shialtiɛl mini.
en: These are the descendants of King Jehoiachin, who was taken prisoner by the Babylonians. Jehoiachin had seven sons: Shealtiel.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ ti sariakarita, ŋuna n-su ti, ŋuna n-nyɛ ti naa. O ni tiligi ti.
en: The Lord is our judge and our ruler; the Lord is our king and will keep us safe.

dag: O niriba kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahi ni kɔbisinu.
en: There are , men in this division.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa paɣ maa dɔɣir so ni ti di nam. Ka lala naa maa ni ti chaŋ ti liri Siria naa min o tɔbbihi n-kab kpe bɛ sansan ni nti tuhi nyaŋ ba.
en: Soon afterward one of her relatives will become king. He will attack the army of the king of Syria, enter their fortress, and defeat them.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka Naawuni chɛ ka alizin biɛɣu siɣi Naa sol zuɣu na, ka o be o yiŋ tahira, ka Dauda daa yaa ŋmɛri mɔɣilo niŋd o kaman o ni daa yi pun niŋdi shɛm dabisili kam la, ka Sool daa gbib o kpani o nuu ni;.
en: The next day the Lord let an evil spirit take control of Saul, and he began acting like a crazy man inside his house. David came to play the harp for Saul as usual, but this time Saul had a spear in his hand.

dag: Dahin shɛli Yawɛ ni daa tɔɣisi Musa yɛtɔɣa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni la.
en: The Lord spoke to Moses again in the land of Egypt.

dag: Amaa ka Ilaija daa garigi yɛli ba, N yi shiri nyɛla Naawuni nira, Naawuni ŋun chɛ ka buɣim yi zuɣusaa luna n-di a min a tɔbbihi pihinu ŋɔ. Di saha ka Naawuni buɣim daa shiri yi zuɣusaa luna n-di sapashini maa min o tɔbbihi pihinu maa.
en: Elijah told the captain and his men, If I am a man of God, let fire come down from heaven and destroy you and your men! Then Gods fire came down from heaven and destroyed the captain and his men.

dag: Shiiba naa ŋun nyɛ paɣ maa ni daa nya Sulemaana yɛm ni nyɛ shɛm min o ni daa me o yil shɛli maa.
en: When the queen of Sheba saw how wise Solomon was, the palace he had built.

dag: N ni chɛ ka a fɔntinsi wurim, ka a tiŋgbɔŋ zani dabari, ka a baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will leave your cities in ruins And your land desolate; Then you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: ka bɛ be bɛ ni gbahi ba kuli tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni ti leei daba maa, ka di ti lu bɛ suhuri ni, ka bɛ niŋ tuuba ka suh a bɛ ni be tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni maa yɛli, Ti tum alahichi, ka tum nyaanyibo mini ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma.
en: In that faraway land, your people will think about what happened. They will be sorry for their sins, and they will pray to you. They will say, We have sinned and done wrong.

dag: Nuzaa polo dunɔdali maa tooni, dunoli daa beni kpɛri dundɔŋ ni kaman di ni daa be shɛm wulimpuhili polo la. Ka o daa buɣisi dunoli zaŋ ti kpa dunoli, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pihinu.
en: There were also gates to the inner courtyard opposite the north and east gates. When he measured from gate to gate, it was one hundred fifty feet.

dag: Yi ni ti yi nimaani gba n-kahi yi nuhi pa yi zuɣuri ni zɔna. Dama man Yawɛ zaɣisi yi ni niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb naani maa, ka yi ku tɔŋ bɛ sani.
en: and you will leave in great sadness. I won't let you find help from those you trust.

dag: Ka nudirigu polo tintariga mi kpuɣi Kiriatijiarim tintariga n-zaŋ hal ti paai Ɛfurɔn m-mali hal ti paai Nɛfitɔa kulibɔŋ ni.
en: The southern border started on the edge of Kiriath Jearim and went to the Springs of Nephtoah.

dag: Amaa bɛ zaŋ a na ti niŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee bɔɣ zilinli ni.
en: But down to the underworld you are brought, to the depths of the pit.

dag: Lɛvinima: Jɛshua daŋ niriba bɛn daa nyɛ Kadimiɛl yiŋnim mini Hɔdɛva yiŋnim daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pisopɔinnaanahi.
en: Clans of Levites who returned from exile: Jeshua and Kadmiel - Temple musicians - Temple guards -.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛlifaz ŋun daa nyɛ Tɛman nir la garigi yɛli.
en: Then Eliphaz from Teman answered:.

dag: Nir yi ŋma ʒiri nya bindirigu di nyaɣisa, amaa di nyaaŋa taŋkuɣa n-yɛn pal o noli.
en: What you get by dishonesty you may enjoy like the finest food, but sooner or later it will be like a mouthful of sand.

dag: Tinima n-nyɛ o ni daa tum shɛlikam Yɛhudianim tinsi ni mini Jɛrusalɛm maa zaa shɛhiranima. Ka bɛ daa ti zaŋ o kpahi tabili dapulli zuɣu ku o;.
en: We are witnesses of everything he did, both in Judea and in Jerusalem. They killed him by hanging him on a tree.

dag: Di saha n ni ti darigi bɛn muɣisiri ya la tibili, ka tiligi gbariti, ka laɣim bɛ ni kari shɛb bahi la, ka chɛ ka bɛ vi leei jilima, ka bɛ yuli du dunia zaa ni.
en: At that time I will punish those who hurt you. I will save my hurt people and bring back those who were forced to leave. I will give them praise and honor everywhere, even in places where they suffered shame.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda daa mali biɛrisuŋ Naawuni sani, ka daa suh o ni o chɛ ka o me jɛmbu duu ti ŋun Naawuni ŋun nyɛ o yab Yaakubu Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: God was very pleased with David. He asked God to let him build a Temple for the people of Jacob.

dag: Ka Ayuba daa bo salichee kɔriti omaŋa. O daa ʒila tampiligim ni.
en: Job took a piece of broken pottery to scratch himself and sat down on a mound of ashes.

dag: ka Shɛmida daŋ niriba nyɛ Shɛmidanima, ka Hɛfa daŋ niriba nyɛ Hɛfanima.
en: Shemida, and Hepher.

dag: Piimiya zuliya kam ni toondaan yino ka bɛ pahi piri tiŋgbɔŋ maa ti ba ka bɛ su li.
en: You will also take one chief from each tribe to apportion the land.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nini tiɣi bɛmaŋmaŋ yɛm nyɛla jɛra, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli yɛm soli ni yi barina ni.
en: It is foolish to follow your own opinions. Be safe, and follow the teachings of wiser people.

dag: Bɛ ni ŋmahim do so lana bee bɛ ni ŋmaai do so yoli, o bi simdi ni bɛ deeg o niŋ Yawɛ niriba laɣiŋgu ni.
en: If a man's private parts have been crushed or cut off, he cannot fully belong to the Lord 's people.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi puri ni bindir daŋda din viɛla n-ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu na. Miriya ka yi zaŋ bubil bee piɛbil ma bihim duɣ o.
en: Bring the best of your lands early produce to the LORD your Gods temple. Dont boil a young goat in its mothers milk.

dag: Di simdi ni dilan gbaag o zilinli ni yɛtɔɣ biɛri tɔɣisibu mini ʒiŋmabo.
en: Then keep from speaking evil and from telling lies.

dag: Yisifu ni daa nyɛ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa gomna la zuɣu, ŋuna n-daa nyɛ ŋun kɔhiri bindira maa tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim zaa zuɣu. Ka Yisifu biɛyanim maa daa kana ti damd o tooni n-zaŋ bɛ zuɣuri silim tiŋa.
en: As for Joseph, he was the lands governor, and he was the one selling grain to all the lands people. When Josephs brothers arrived, they bowed down to him, their faces to the ground.

dag: Ka so yi ti yɛn nahim ba, buɣim ni yi bɛ ni na n-di bɛn nyɛ bɛ dimnim maa, ka ŋunkam ti yɛn nahim ba lala n-yɛn niŋ o ka o kpi.
en: If anyone tries to hurt the witnesses, fire comes from the mouths of the witnesses and kills their enemies. Anyone who tries to hurt them will die like this.

dag: Ka n daa kuhi boli Yawɛ m muɣisigu maa puuni; n daa kuhimi boli n Naawuni ni o sɔŋ ma. Ka n kuhigu maa daa chaŋ ti lu o tibili ni; ka o daa wum n kuhigu maa o jɛmbu duu puuni.
en: In my trouble I called to the Lord . Yes, I cried out to my God for help. There in his temple he heard my voice. He heard my cry for help.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yɛli Dauda yɛtɔɣa maa, ka di niŋ o nyaɣisim pam o ni yɛn leei naa deemba maa zuɣu. Ka bɛ ni zali saha shɛli maa daa ti yɛn paai.
en: Saul's officials reported to David what Saul had said, and David was delighted with the thought of becoming the king's son-in-law. Before the day set for the wedding.

dag: ni o tiligi ba kum ni, ka dihiri ba kum saha.
en: to deliver their lives from death and keep them alive during a famine.

dag: Nyama, n ni kpihim nyin Baasha min a daŋ niriba zaa birili; ka niŋ a yiŋa kaman n ni daa niŋ Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam yiŋ shɛm la.
en: So look, I am about to set fire to Baasha and his household, and I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam, Nebats son.

dag: Kpaŋmiya yimaŋ doli duno muɣiliŋga kpe, dama n yɛri ya mi ni niriba pam ni ti bɔri ni bɛ dol li kpe ka ku tooi.
en: Do all you can to go in by the narrow door! A lot of people will try to get in, but will not be able to.

dag: Piɛɣu maa daa malila liŋa. Ka n daa kul lihiri hal ti nya ka di liŋ maa wuɣi zuɣusaa, ka paɣa ʒi piɛɣu maa puuni.
en: The basket had a lid made of lead. As I watched, the lid was raised, and there in the basket sat a woman!.

dag: Ka o bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a bɔhi ma bin suŋ yɛla? Ninvuɣ yino kɔŋko n-nyɛ ninvuɣ suŋ. Amaa a yi bɔri ni a ti nya nyɛvili, nyin doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligunima.
en: Jesus said, Why do you ask me about what is good? Theres only one who is good. If you want to enter eternal life, keep the commandments.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali suhuyini mal alibarika, dama bɛ ni ti nya Naawuni.
en: Great blessings belong to those whose thoughts are pure. They will be with God.

dag: Dama bɔhimi ninkura nya bɛ yaannim ni daa mi shɛli.
en: Look for a moment at ancient wisdom; consider the truths our ancestors learned.

dag: Ifriim bidibisi n-daa lan nyɛ Rɛfa mini Rɛshɛf ni Tɛla ni Tahan.
en: His son was Rephah, his son Resheph, his son Telah, his son Tahan.

dag: Ka Bɛnaaya daa chaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni nti yɛli Jɔab, Naa yɛliya ni a yim na. Amaa ka Jɔab daa yɛli, Aai, n ni kpi kpe. Ka Bɛnaaya daa lab naa sani nti yɛl o, Jɔab ni yɛli shɛm, ka garigi shɛm m-bɔŋɔ.
en: Benaiah went to the sacred tent and yelled, Joab, the king orders you to come out! No! Joab answered. Kill me right here. Benaiah went back and told Solomon what Joab had said.

dag: Naawuni ni tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb zaa Ziɔn ka bɛ sabi bɛ yuya sɔŋ la, yɛlimaŋli, bɛn nyɛ bɛn kpalim be Jɛrusalɛm la, bɛ ni boli ba bɛn be kasi.
en: Everyone who is left alive in Jerusalem will be called special.

dag: Ka shɛŋa lu tɛriŋ zuɣu luɣ shɛli tam ni bi zilim pam n-dii bilina yomyom, nimaani tam ni bi zilim zuɣu.
en: Other seed fell on rocky ground, where there was not enough dirt. It grew very fast there, because the soil was not deep.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni daa ŋmalig o sani o ni daa tɔɣis o yɛtɔɣa luɣ shɛli maa n-lab alizanda ni.
en: Then God left that place.

dag: Ka so yi ti bi deei ya bee n-zaɣisi yi yɛligu wumbu, yi yi ti yɛn yi yili maa ni bee di tiŋ maa ni, yin pihimiya yi napɔna taŋkpaɣu bahi di zuɣu.
en: And if the people in a home or a town refuse to welcome you or listen to you, then leave that place and shake the dust off your feet.

dag: Cham ti yɛli ba ka bɛ labi bɛ suɣa ni.
en: Go and tell the people to go back to their tents.

dag: Ka Judanim maa daa gbahi ninvuɣ nɛma mi tuhi pia. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ ba du Sɛla Zoli zuɣu nti daai ba Sɛla Zoli maa zuɣu luhi zolɔŋni, ka bɛ zaa chɛrisichɛrisi.
en: and captured another ten thousand. They took the prisoners to the top of the cliff at the city of Sela and threw them off, so that they were killed on the rocks below.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ bini ŋmahiŋmahi yimaŋa kpiimba zuɣu bee n-chihi yimaŋ chiha. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: or tattoo yourselves or cut gashes in your body to mourn for the dead. I am the Lord .

dag: Naawuni yi Ziɔn din nyɛ tin suŋ la ni n-kanna ka kul nyɛlisira.
en: God appeared from Zion, the city of perfect beauty.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, Yi pun wum ka di sab yɛli, Miri ka a niŋ zina.
en: You know the commandment which says, Be faithful in marriage.

dag: Amaa a yi zaɣisi ni a ku zaŋ amaŋ ti ba, Yawɛ ni kahigi shɛli wuhi ma ʒii puuni m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: But the Lord has shown me in a vision what will happen if you refuse to surrender.

dag: Dama o ʒiɛla nandaamba nudirigu polo ni o tiligi ba bɛn yɛn wuhi ni bɛ simdi kum la nuu ni.
en: because he defends the poor and saves them from those who condemn them to death.

dag: N ŋmanila sana n dɔɣiriba sani; ka ŋmani tinzun nira m ma puuni bihi sani.
en: I am like a stranger to my relatives, like a foreigner to my family.

dag: Jarɛd daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiwɛi ni pihiyɔbunaayi, ka naanyi yi dunia yili.
en: and died at the age of .

dag: O yidana Yisifu daa nyaŋ ninvuɣ suŋ pam, dinzuɣu ka o daa bi bɔri ni o yihi li palɔni n-dihi Mariama vi, amaa ka daa lee lo ni o ku lan kpuɣ o.
en: Joseph was a good man and did not want to embarrass Mary in front of everyone. So he decided to quietly call off the wedding.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Firawuna niŋ tipawumli n-kari doli ya na din ni chɛ ka n nya jilima Firawuna min o tɔbbi gbaliŋ maa zuɣu, ka Ijiptinim maa baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ. Ka bɛ daa shiri niŋ lala.
en: I will make Pharaoh brave, and he will chase you. But I will defeat Pharaoh and his army. This will bring honor to me. Then the people of Egypt will know that I am the Lord . So the Israelites did what he told them.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni daa yɛl o yaha, Zaŋm a nuu maa labisi niŋ a binyɛrigu maa ni. Ka o daa lan zaŋ o nuu maa labisi niŋ o binyɛrigu maa ni, o ni daa ti yihi li na ka di min o niŋgbuŋ zaa lan nyɛla yim.
en: Then God said, Put your hand back inside your coat. So Moses put his hand back inside his coat. When he took it back out again, the skin of his hand had returned to normal.

dag: Dari yi kani, buɣim ni kpi. Tikub yi kani, zabili ku beni.
en: Without wood, a fire goes out; without gossip, quarreling stops.

dag: Obadia ni daa gbaai chandi, o nini nyabu yim ka o ti nya Ilaija m-baŋ o, ka teei dɔni n-zaŋ o nina kpa tiŋa ka yɛli, N dan Ilaija, nyini m-bala.
en: As Obadiah was walking along, he met Elijah. Obadiah recognized him, bowed down, and asked, Elijah, is it really you.

dag: Aripakishad ni daa ti paai yuun pihitanaanu saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Shɛla.
en: When Arpachshad was years old, he became the father of Shelah.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa yi Gibia na ti tuhi ku Izraɛlnim tɔbbihi tuhi pisinaayi dindali maa.
en: Then the army of Benjamin came out of the city of Gibeah. The army of Benjamin killed , men in the army of Israel during the battle that day.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nam ya ŋɔ yɛliya, Mani n-daa nam ya yi manim puya ni; n ni sɔŋ ya. N dabili Yaakubu zuliya, Jɛshurun ŋun nyɛ n ni pun pii so ŋɔ, di zɔriya dabiɛm.
en: I am the Lord who created you; from the time you were born, I have helped you. Do not be afraid; you are my servant, my chosen people whom I love.

dag: ka di daa niŋ niriba maa suhupiɛlli pam, dama bɛ daa zaŋ li ti Yawɛ ni suhu yini ka di nyɛ bɛ suhuyubu. Ka di daa niŋ Naa Dauda gba nyaɣisim pam.
en: The people were very happy because their leaders were willing to give so much. The leaders had given freely to the Lord from good hearts. King David was also very happy.

dag: Ka Ɛkan daa yɛli Jɔshua, Yɛlimaŋli, n tum alahichi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ sani; N ni tum alahichi shɛli maa m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Achan answered Joshua, Its true. Ive sinned against the LORD, the God of Israel. This is what I have done.

dag: Bi jɛrigu nyɛla ŋun tiri o ba suhugarigu. Yidaampaɣ so ŋun yuri zabili ŋmanila saa ŋun yɔrita.
en: Foolish children bring disgrace to their fathers. A nagging wife goes on and on like the drip, drip, drip of the rain.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, M ma mini n tizɔbihi nyɛla bɛn wum Naawuni yɛligu ka dol li.
en: Jesus answered them, My mother and my brothers are those who listen to Gods teaching and obey it.

dag: O nyaandoliba maa ni daa wum lala maa, ka di gari ba pam ka bɛ bɔhi, Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi tiligi.
en: When his disciples heard this, they were stunned. Then who can be saved? they asked.

dag: Dama di ni leei jilima zuɣupiligu a zuɣu ni, ka leei dolibi a nyiŋgol ni.
en: for they are a graceful wreath on your head, and beads for your neck.

dag: Ka bɛ daa dii yiɣisi zo yomyom ti nya Mariama mini Yisifu, ka nya biliɛɣu maa ka o do wɔrimɔri piɛɣu ni.
en: So they hurried off and found Mary and Joseph and saw the baby lying in the manger.

dag: Jɛhɔshafat yuma daa nyɛla yuun pihitanaanu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-ʒila Jɛrusalɛm. O daa niŋla o nam maa ni yuun pisinaanu. O ma daa nyɛla Shilihi bipuɣiŋga; ka o yuli booni Azuba.
en: Jehoshaphat was years old when he became king, and he ruled for twenty-five years in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Azubah; she was Shilhis daughter.

dag: Dama Izraɛlnim mini Judanim nyɛla bɛn bi ʒe ma yim baabiɛla. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The people of Israel and Judah have betrayed me completely. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Lala ka Naa Dauda gba wuhi alibarika shɛli din be ninvuɣ so ni Naawuni ni lihi wuntizɔra, ka di pala o tuma zuɣu. O ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is what David meant when he spoke of the happiness of the person whom God accepts as righteous, apart from anything that person does:.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ, Zaŋmiya yi ni gbahi yi mabi shɛb daba ŋɔ na labisi, dama Yawɛ suhu yiɣisiya pam bahi yi zuɣu. .
en: Now listen to me. Send back all those you captured, your own brothers and sisters, because the Lord s terrible anger is against you.

dag: M mabihi, n suhu zaa yuya ni mmaŋmaŋ zuliya tiligi, ka n kul suhiri Naawuni tiri ba di zuɣu.
en: My friends, how I wish with all my heart that my own people might be saved! How I pray to God for them!.

dag: Dama kum daa mali ma, ka yi mɔŋ ma bindirigu; ka kɔnyuri daa mali ma, ka yi bi ti ma kom;.
en: I was hungry and you didnt give me food to eat. I was thirsty and you didnt give me anything to drink.

dag: Yawɛ sizuura lubu viɛla; ka nyɛ din kul be sahakam. Yawɛ zaligu shɛŋa din pahi nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, ka nyɛ wuntia zaa.
en: Reverence for the Lord is good; it will continue forever. The judgments of the Lord are just; they are always fair.

dag: Yilimiya o yuli jilima yila. Paɣimiy o jilima paɣibu!.
en: Sing praises to the glory of Gods name! Make glorious his praise!.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka paɣ maa gba daa kpi.
en: Last of all, the woman died.

dag: Ka Pool garigi yɛl o, Di yi nyɛla saha biɛla bee pam puuni, pa a kɔŋko gba, amaa bɛn zaa be kpe n-wumdi n yɛligu ŋɔ, n di bi zaɣisi ni yi zaa be kaman n ni be shɛm ŋɔ kul gbaai yihila zoligɔnim din lo ma ŋɔ.
en: Paul answered, Whether it takes a short time or a long time, I wish you and everyone else who hears me today would become just like me! Except, of course, for these chains.

dag: Ka nyini ŋun niŋ yɛda ni ti Duuma ni yɛl a shɛlikam zaa shiri ni niŋ pali ŋɔ gba mal alibarika.
en: Happy is she who believed that the Lord would fulfill the promises he made to her.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka a kumdi pampam? A lan kala naa? A saawaranim kpimi, ka biɛrim mal a kaman paɣ ni yɛn dɔɣi ka biɛrim shɛli mal o la?.
en: Jerusalem, why are you crying? Don't you have a king? Have your advisors gone? Are you suffering like a woman in childbirth?.

dag: ni salima alali firilatamdisi mini di firilanima ni bɛ nyɔri li zaani luɣ kasi zaa kasi shee la kaman di ni daa wuhi shɛm.
en: He made the lamps and lampstands of pure gold. These were put inside the Holy Place in front of the Most Holy Place.

dag: Amaa saha shɛli niriba maa yi ti yɛn laɣimmi, yin piɛbimi kikaa maa, amaa ka di piɛb li kika biɛɣu piɛbbu.
en: But when you want everyone to come together, sound a different signal on the trumpet.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba maa, N ni daa be yi sani ka yɛri ya yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa la m-bɔŋɔ: Binshɛɣukam zaa din sabi Anabi Musa min anabinim litaafinim ni ni Yila litaafi ni zaŋ chaŋ n polo la daa kpami ni di zaa ha niŋ pali.
en: Jesus said to them, Remember when I was with you before? I said that everything written about me must happen—everything written in the Law of Moses, the books of the prophets, and the Psalms.

dag: Ka dansarika gula daa neei gom ni n-nya ka dunoya maa zaa yoomi, ka o ŋoog o takɔbi ni o kuhi ku omaŋa, dama o daa tɛhiya ni dansarikanim maa zaa yimi zo.
en: The jailer woke up and saw that the jail doors were open. He thought that the prisoners had already escaped, so he got his sword and was ready to kill himself.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daa tiligi Lɔt ŋun daa nyɛ wuntizɔra ka o suhu bi piɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa nyɛ zaligu saɣindiba daɣiri tuma zuɣu la zuɣu.
en: Lot lived right and was greatly troubled by the terrible way those wicked people were living. He was a good man, and day after day he suffered because of the evil things he saw and heard. So the Lord rescued him.

dag: Bɛ yi daa pun mali tɛha ŋɔ tatabo ni bɛ zɔri ma, ka doli n fukumsi zaligunima zaa sahakam, dindina binshɛɣukam naan niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga bɛ mini bɛ bihi sani.
en: If only their minds were like this: always fearing me and keeping all my commandments so that things would go well for them and their children forever!.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o ni kɔrisikɔrisi da shɛŋa maa sɔŋ biŋkɔbiri maa tooni kɔnyuri bɔɣili gbini luɣ shɛli biŋkɔbiri maa ni kanna ti nyuri kom. Ka biŋkɔbiri maa daa yi ti kana ni bɛ ti nyu kom ka duri taba.
en: He placed these branches in front of the flocks at their drinking troughs. He put them there, because the animals mated when they came to drink.

dag: Bɛ gba ni ti dol li chaŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee maa nti pahi bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbiri ku zuliya shɛba mini bɛ zɔnim la ni zuliya shɛb bɛn daa ʒi di mahim la zuɣu.
en: They will go with it to the world of the dead to join those that have already fallen. And all who live under its shadow will be scattered among the nations.

dag: a ni zaŋ zali zuliya kam zaa ninni ŋɔ.
en: Now all people can see your plan.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa daa bɔh o, Mami Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba yɛliya ni Anabi Ilaija n-yɛn daŋ kandina.
en: Then the disciples asked Jesus, Why do the teachers of the Law say that Elijah has to come first.

dag: ka ŋun boli ya maa yi ti yina ti yɛl a ni a yiɣisim ka ti ŋun gar a maa ʒiishee, di saha di ni mal a vi ni a chaŋ ti ʒini tariŋ ʒiishee.
en: Then the one who invited you will come and say, Give your place to this other guest! You will be embarrassed and will have to sit in the worst place.

dag: Lala ka bɛ ʒim yihibu maa taali yɛn labina ti ʒini ŋun Jɔab min o nyaaŋa zuɣu hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Amaa Dauda min o nyaaŋa ni o yiŋnim ni o nam ʒiishee ni mali suhudoo din yi Yawɛ sanna sahakam.
en: Joab's family will always suffer because of what he did, but the Lord will always bless David's family and his kingdom with peace.

dag: Gbibi bɛ ni wuh a shɛli viɛnyɛliŋga, ka miri ka a chɛ ka di faai. Guli yɛm, dama ŋuna n-nyɛ a nyɛvili.
en: Hold firmly to my teaching and never let go. It will mean life for you.

dag: nti gbaag o fiɣisibu yɛra, Ti nya ka doo ŋɔ birigirila ti zuliya ŋɔ zaa, ka yɛri ni ti di yo farigu Naa Siiza sani, ka lan yɛri ni ŋuna n-nyɛ Masia ni naa.
en: where they began to accuse him: We caught this man misleading our people, telling them not to pay taxes to the Emperor and claiming that he himself is the Messiah, a king.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka yi suhuri doya, ka di chɛliya ka dabiɛm mali ya; n daa deei yi liɣiri maa. Di pa shɛli, yi Naawuni ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni la n-daa zaŋ liɣiri maa niŋ yi kpalansi maa ni maa. Di saha ka o daa zaŋ Simiɔn n-yihi bɛ sanna.
en: The servant said, Don't worry. Don't be afraid. Your God, the God of your father, must have put the money in your sacks for you. I received your payment. Then he brought Simeon to them.

dag: Ka lan zaŋ wain pipia n-niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka zaŋ li ti ba ka bɛ zaa nyu.
en: He took a cup, gave thanks, and gave it to them, and they all drank from it.

dag: Ka Musa daa garigi yɛli Yawɛ, M bi tooi tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa, Firawuna ku bɔri ni o wum n yɛtɔɣa.
en: But Moses replied to the LORD, Look, Im not a very good speaker. How is Pharaoh ever going to listen to me.

dag: N lan ka suhupiɛlli, suhusaɣiŋgu m-mali ma. Biɛrim be n suhu ni.
en: My sorrow cannot be healed; I am sick at heart.

dag: ni Juda ni Bɛnjamin ni Shɛmaya ni Jɛrimia.
en: Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah, and Jeremiah.

dag: Ka o ma daa ŋmaligi yɛli yili maa ni bihi, O yi ti yɛli ya ni yi niŋm shɛlikam, yin niŋmiya li.
en: Mary then said to the servants, Do whatever Jesus tells you to do.

dag: Ka kukol shɛli daa yi zuɣusaa na yɛra, M Biyurigu m-bɔŋɔ, n nini ni tiɣ so pam m-bala.
en: A voice from heaven said, This is my Son whom I dearly love; I find happiness in him.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi yomyom bɛ tɛha ni ni ti leei baŋdiba, ka bɛn tɔri birilim ti tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa din niŋ kamaata ni viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: the minds of the rash will know and comprehend, and the tongues of those who stammer will speak fluently and plainly.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ yɛl o, Bɔzuɣu ka bɛ niŋ ti tizɔpaɣ maa kaman pagɔrili n-nyɛ o maa.
en: They said, But didnt he treat our sister like a prostitute.

dag: Abigeel ni daa ti kul nya Dauda, o dii sheela o buŋ maa zuɣu na yom lu n-gbani Dauda tooni, ka zaŋ o zuɣu silim tiŋa.
en: When Abigail saw David, she quickly got off her donkey and fell facedown before him, bowing low to the ground.

dag: Sool ni daa su ti saha shɛl la, nyini n-daa gari tooni chaŋ ti tuhi fa Izraɛlnima, ka Yawɛ daa yɛl a, Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun ni ti guli n niriba Izraɛlnim ŋɔ, ka ti nyɛ ŋun ni su Izraɛl. .
en: In the past, even when Saul was still our king, you led the people of Israel in battle, and the Lord promised you that you would lead his people and be their ruler.

dag: Sabimi binshɛŋa a nini ni nya maa: Binshɛŋa din be mini binshɛŋa din ti yɛn niŋ dimbɔŋɔnim nyaaŋa.
en: Write what you have seen and what is and what will happen after these things.

dag: Amaa ka nyin Yawɛ kul lari ba. A nyɛla ŋun maani zuliya kam zaa ansarisi.
en: Lord , laugh at them. Make fun of them all.

dag: Ka nyin na bɔri yɛl kara ni a ti amaŋa? Di lan bɔ li, dama n yɛn chɛmi ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai ninsalinim zaa. Amaa n ni tilig a nyɛvili a ni yɛn chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam zaa. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You seek great things for yourself, but dont bother. Im bringing disaster on all humanity, declares the LORD, but wherever you go I will let you escape with your life.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli vuhim, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyin vuhim, yim luɣa anahi zuɣu n-kana ti kpe bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb ŋɔ ni, ka bɛ leei nyɛviyanima. .
en: He said to me, Prophesy to the breath; prophesy, human one! Say to the breath, The LORD God proclaims: Come from the four winds, breath! Breathe into these dead bodies and let them live.

dag: Amaa ka sapashini maa daa dolila ŋariŋ maa lana mini ŋariŋ maa tuma zuɣulana yɛligu gari Pool ni daa yɛli shɛm maa.
en: But the centurion was persuaded more by the ships pilot and captain than by Pauls advice.

dag: Amaa bɛ buɣa nyɛla anzinfa mini salima din nyɛ ninsalinim ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali shɛŋa.
en: Their idols are just silver and gold— things made by human hands.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ dimnim yiɣisi lu bɛ zuɣu.
en: The Lord has stirred up their enemies to attack them.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa kana ti gari ka bol omaŋmaŋ yuli, Yawɛ, Yawɛ. N nyɛla Naawuni ŋun zɔri nambɔɣu ka niŋdi nirilim. N suhu bi yiɣisiri yomyom, ka yurilim din bi naara mini ʒiɛyimtali galisi n sani.
en: That is, the Lord passed in front of Moses and said, YAHWEH, the Lord , is a kind and merciful God. He is slow to become angry. He is full of great love. He can be trusted.

dag: Di saha ka Sool mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be o sani maa dii lu tɔb tuhibu soli. Ka niriba maa zaa daa gbaai tab tuhibu, dama bɛ daa birimya pam.
en: Then Saul called all his troops together, and they went into battle. The Philistines were completely confused; every soldiers sword was turned against his fellow soldier.

dag: ka di nyɛ nir ni yɛn ku daadam ka zo n-kuli luɣ shɛli. Ŋun bi yuri ka ku o kpee ka di pala dimdi m-pun be bɛ sunsuuni, ŋun ku nira maa ni tooi zo n-kuli fɔntinsi maa zaɣ yin ni tilig o nyɛvili.
en: to which a man could escape and be safe if he had accidentally killed someone who had not been his enemy. He could escape to one of these cities and not be put to death.

dag: Ka buŋ maa daa lan bɔhi Balaam, Pa a bun so a ni bari sahakam zaŋ na hal ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n-nyɛ ma? Ka n na mi n-niŋ a lala? Ka o garigi yɛli, Aai.
en: But the donkey said to Balaam, Look, I am your donkey. You have ridden me for so many years. And you know that I have never done this to you before! That is true, Balaam said.

dag: Samsin ba min o ma daa bi mi ni Yawɛ n-wuhi Samsin lala, dama Yawɛ daa bɔrila so shɛli o ni yɛn doli tuhi Filistianima. Di saha maa, Filistianima n-daa su Izraɛlnima.
en: His parents did not know that it was the Lord who was leading Samson to do this, for the Lord was looking for a chance to fight the Philistines. At this time the Philistines were ruling Israel.

dag: Ka Azɔr daa nyɛ Zadok ba, ka Zadok nyɛ Akim ba, ka Akim mi nyɛ Ilaiud ba.
en: Azor was the father of Zadok. Zadok was the father of Achim. Achim was the father of Eliud.

dag: Di lan yɛli: Kuɣili maa nyɛla kuɣ shɛli din ni chɛ ka niriba tuui; di lan nyɛla kuɣ shɛli din ni chɛ ka bɛ tuui lu. Din chɛ ka bɛ tuui lu maa nyɛla bɛ ni bi niŋ Naawuni yɛligu yɛda la zuɣu, ka di mi nyɛla Naawuni ni zal li shɛm m-bala.
en: This is a stone that makes people stumble and a rock that makes them fall. Because they refuse to believe in the word, they stumble. Indeed, this is the end to which they were appointed.

dag: Filistianim ni daa wum ni bɛ booi kpam bahi Dauda zuɣu ni n-zaŋ o leei Izraɛlnim zaa naa, ka Filistia tɔbbihi zaa daa yi n-chaŋ ni bɛ ti bo o shee. Ka Dauda daa wum lala ka yi n-chaŋ ni o ti liri ba.
en: When the Philistines heard that David had now been made king over the whole country of Israel, their army went out to capture him. So David marched out to meet them.

dag: Naa Ahasivɛrɔs nam dibu piligu ni, ka bɛ daa ŋma gbaŋ fiɣisi Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima.
en: At the beginning of the reign of Emperor Xerxes, the enemies of the people living in Judah and Jerusalem brought written charges against them.

dag: Ŋunkam gol o diɛmpaɣa, noli din dim o. Ka sokam yɛli, Ami.
en: The Levites will say, Cursed is the one who has sexual relations with his mother-in-law! Then all the people will say, Amen.

dag: Daadam, chɛ ka Jɛrusalɛm baŋ di ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa.
en: Son of man, tell the people of Jerusalem about the terrible things they have done.

dag: Di daantalisi pisi mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu pisi la daa nyɛla daanya. Amaa ban shɛŋa din daa yili daantalisi maa mini di mihi la din daa nyɛla anzinfa.
en: The curtains on the south side were supported by posts. The posts were on bronze bases. The hooks for the posts and the curtain rods were made from silver.

dag: Bia maa ni daa ti paai Jɔnatan ni to piɛm maa bahi luɣ shɛli maa, ka Jɔnatan bol o n-yɛl o, Pa piɛm maa m-be a tooni maa ha.
en: When the boy got near the place where the arrow had landed, Jonathan shouted, Isn't the arrow on past you.

dag: Ka Dauda mini Abishai daa chaŋ tɔbbihi maa sani yuŋ, ka Sool ti dola sansani maa sunsuuni gbihiri ka o kpani sa o zuɣusaa, ka Abinɛr mini tɔbbihi maa do n-gil o.
en: So David and Abishai approached the troops at night and found Saul lying there, asleep in the camp, with his spear stuck in the ground by his head. Abner and the army were sleeping all around him.

dag: Ka Ibizan daa ti kpi ka bɛ sɔɣ o Bɛtilihɛm.
en: Then Ibzan died and was buried in the city of Bethlehem.

dag: Dindali maa ka Firawuna daa zali bɛ tuma zuɣulaannim mini bɛn daa yuuni ba ka bɛ tumdi tuma maa zaligu yɛli.
en: On the very same day Pharaoh commanded the peoples slave masters and supervisors.

dag: Yi ni zaŋ suɣilo n-niŋ ania gbibi n yɛligu maa zuɣu, n ni ti yihi ya muɣisigu shɛli din yɛn paai dunia ŋɔ nim zaa la ni.
en: Because you kept my command to endure, I will keep you safe through the time of testing that is about to come over the whole world, to test those who live on earth.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa ti yɛli Yisifu, A ba ka alaafee; ka o daa zaŋ o bidibis ayi la, Manaasa mini Ifriim chaŋ o sani.
en: After this happened, Joseph was told, Your father is getting weaker, so he took his two sons Manasseh and Ephraim with him.

dag: Ka Ijiptinim suhuri daa paligi pam, bɛ ni daa yi n-chaŋ maa zuɣu, dama bɛ daa kpalim zɔri ba mi.
en: The Egyptians were afraid and gladly let them go.

dag: Ka o ti zaŋ o nubil suɣi ʒim maa m-mihi li buyopɔin n-yihi li Izraɛlnim daɣiri maa ni.
en: Then he will dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle it on the altar seven times. In this way Aaron will make the altar holy and clean from all the sins of the Israelites.

dag: Bɛ ni bi darigi bɛn tumdi tuumbiɛri tibili yomyom zuɣu chɛ ka niriba kul lo bɛ suhuri ni ni bɛ tumla tuumbiɛri.
en: The condemnation for wicked acts isnt carried out quickly; thats why people dare to do evil.

dag: Dama nir yi bari zana noombil ninni, yoli ka o bari li maa.
en: They are like a bird that sees the bait, but ignores the trap.

dag: Yawɛ daa lan yɛli ma yaha, N nyaya ka niriba maa nyɛla tipawumlinim ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: The Lord also said to me, I have watched these people. They are very stubborn!.

dag: Naa ni yɛn zaŋdi binshɛŋa maani bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la tiri Yawɛ Vuhim Dabisili dali nyɛla piɛbih ayɔbu bɛn ka dansi mini piɛlaa ŋun ka daŋa.
en: On the Sabbath day, the prince will offer to the LORD an entirely burned offering of six flawless lambs and a flawless ram.

dag: Ka o ti yihi bɔrɔbɔro kpil yini sara maligu kam puuni n-zaŋ li ti Yawɛ, ka di leei maligumaana ŋun zaŋ suhudoo sara maligu maa ʒim kpaai vie maa dini.
en: From this you will present one of each kind of offering as a gift to the LORD. It will belong to the priest who tosses the blood of the well-being offering.

dag: Ka Yisa daa ti ʒi Olivi Tihi Zoli zuɣu tuhi Naawuni jɛmbu duu, ka Pita mini Jeemsi ni Jɔn ni Anduru bɔh o ashilɔni.
en: Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, across from the Temple, when Peter, James, John, and Andrew came to him in private.

dag: hal ka n ti paɣi ni bɛ mirisi n nyiŋgol ni ka n kpi n-gari m biɛhigu.
en: I'd rather choke to death than live in this body.

dag: Mɛrari bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Mahili mini Mushi. Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya ni niriba kaman bɛ dɔɣirikpamba ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: Merari's sons were Mahli and Mushi. All of the above were from the Levi tribe.

dag: Ka ŋun daa zaɣisi, ka chɛ ka bɛ kpɛh o kpee maa duu, ka yɛli ni faashee o yo samli maa zaa.
en: But the first servant refused to be patient. He told the judge that the other servant owed him money, and that servant was put in jail until he could pay everything he owed.

dag: Dama jɛra lari ŋmanila gɔhi ni be buɣim ni duɣu gbinni tahiri shɛm la; ka dimbɔŋɔ gba ka buchi.
en: When a fool laughs, it is like thorns crackling in a fire. It doesn't mean a thing.

dag: Chamiya ti maan lihi viɛnyɛliŋga n-nya o shiri beni, ka baŋ o ni be luɣ shɛli maa, ka lan baŋ ninvuɣ so ŋun nya o nimaani maa, dama bɛ yɛli ma ni o neeya pam.
en: Go and make sure once more; find out for certain where he is and who has seen him there. I hear that he is very cunning.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Yi na ʒi n-karim Naa Dauda ni daa niŋ shɛm kum ni daa ti wum o mini bɛn be o san la yɛla?.
en: Jesus answered: You surely must have read what David did when he and his followers were hungry.

dag: Nasara dibu suhupiɛlli yila be wuntizɔriba suɣa shee, Yawɛ nudirigu n-tum tuun kara maa.
en: The sounds of joyful songs and deliverance are heard in the tents of the righteous: The LORDs strong hand is victorious!.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab daa kpe nayili maa nti yɛli naa, Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, a dihi a tɔbbihi bɛn zaa tilig a nyɛvili ka tilig a bidibisi min a bipuɣinsi ni a paɣiba ni a mamanim zaa nyɛviya ŋɔ vi.
en: Joab came into the kings palace and said to the king, You are humiliating every one of your officers! Look, they saved your life today and the lives of your sons and daughters and your wives and slave women.

dag: Ka Pita mini Jɔn mirigi bɛ nina kpa o, ka Pita ti yɛl o, Lihim ti.
en: But they looked straight at him and said, Look up at us.

dag: Hal a ni kul yɛn nya tiŋgbɔŋ maa ka di do katiŋ maa zaa yoli, a ku kpe n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri Izraɛlnim maa ni.
en: So I will give the land to the people of Israel, but you will only get to see it from a distance.

dag: Di simdi ni ŋun tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛtɔɣ shɛli suhi Naawuni ka o niŋ o yiko, ka o kahigi di gbinni wuhi.
en: When we speak languages that others don't know, we should pray for the power to explain what we mean.

dag: Di bi simdi ka Izraɛl bipuɣinsi ni so ti niŋ jɛmbu duu pagɔrili bee ka bidibisi ni so ti niŋ jɛmbu duu dagɔrili.
en: No Israelite, man or woman, is to become a temple prostitute.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani, ka doli Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la naba, ka daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ li.
en: and disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong. He never stopped following the example of Jeroboam, who had caused the Israelites to sin.

dag: ka lihiri buɣim ni dir o ka di nyɔhi kpuɣiri duri zuɣusaa maa ka kuhiri yɛra, Tin dini n-yi lee beni ŋ-ŋmani tin titali ŋɔ.
en: and cried out as they saw the smoke from the flames that consumed her: There never has been another city like this great city.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yisa daa chaŋ ti baai du Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili duli yaɣ shɛli polo Jɔn Baptaizira ni daa tuui baptaiziri niriba la nti be nimaani.
en: Jesus then went back again across the Jordan River to the place where John had been baptizing, and he stayed there.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee be yi ni n-zɔri Yawɛ, ka deeg o dabili noli? Ŋun be zibisim ni ka neesim ka o sani, o niŋmi Yawɛ naani, ka zaŋ omaŋ dalim o Naawuni.
en: Who among you fears the LORD? Who listens to the voice of his servant, who walks in darkness and has no light? They will trust in the LORDs name, and rely upon their God.

dag: mini di ni yɛn tamdi anzinfa binshɛŋa zuɣu bini pihinahi. Dapaɣ yini daa malila di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu diba ayi, ka dapaɣ yini gba mali di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu diba ayi.
en: and forty silver bases, two under each frame.

dag: N daa loya ni n yi ka yi sanna, n ku zaŋ yɛli shɛli yɛla wuhi ya n-naɣ pahila Masia min o dapulli zuɣu kpahibu la yɛla.
en: In fact, while I was with you, I made up my mind to speak only about Jesus Christ, who had been nailed to a cross.

dag: ni Shaaraim ni Aditaim ni Gɛdɛra ni Gɛdɛrɔtaim: ka di zaa kalinli yiɣisi fɔntiŋ kara pinaanahi m-pahi di tiŋkpansi zuɣu.
en: Shaaraim, Adithaim, and Gederah . In all, there were towns and all their fields.

dag: Yawɛ, wuhim ma a soli, ka n dol a yɛlimaŋli la; tim ma suhuyini, ka n tibigir a yuli.
en: Lord , teach me your ways, and I will live and obey your truths. Help me make worshiping your name the most important thing in my life.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yinim Izraɛlnima, n ni kari yi zaa yinoyino saria kaman yi tuma ni nyɛ shɛm. Niŋmiya tuuba, ka zo n-yi yi tuumbiɛri zaa tumbu ni, di yi pa lala tuumbiɛri tumbu maa ni chɛ ka yi bahi yoli.
en: Why? Because, family of Israel, I will judge each of you only for what you do! This is what the Lord GOD said. So come back to me! Stop committing those crimes and do away with those things that cause you to sin!.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa shiri niŋ lala n-yihi ba bɛ biɛhigu maa shee. Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm maa, lala ka Izraɛlnim daa shiri niŋ.
en: So the Israelites obeyed Gods command. They sent those people outside the camp. They did what the Lord had told Moses.

dag: A daalikaulinim nyɛla alikauli maŋa! Ka mani a dabili ŋɔ yuri li.
en: Your word to me, your servant, is like pure gold; I treasure what you say.

dag: Saha shɛli Amazia ni daa chɛ Yawɛ jɛmbu maa, ka bɛ daa lo ni bɛ ku o Jɛrusalɛm, ka o daa zo n-kuli Lakishi. Amaa ka bɛ daa chɛ ka shɛb chaŋ Lakishi maa nti ku o nimaani.
en: Ever since the time when he rebelled against the Lord , there had been a plot against him in Jerusalem. Finally he fled to the city of Lachish, but his enemies followed him there and killed him.

dag: Ka ti daa lan yiɣisi nimaani m-be teeku maa ni chaŋ ti baɣisi Saipurus gari, dama ti daa tuhila pɔhim.
en: We left that city and sailed close to the island of Cyprus because the wind was blowing against us.

dag: Ka doo maa daa ti yiɣisi asibaasi n-yooi dunoli ni o yina chaŋ, ka nya ka o mam maa dola yil maa samban dunol ni, ka o nuhi teei tiri dunoli polo.
en: The Levite got up early the next morning. He wanted to go home. He opened the door to go outside, and a hand fell across the threshold of the door. There was his slave woman. She had fallen down against the door.

dag: N yuri bɛn yuri ma, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ma ni nimmoo nyari ma.
en: I love those who love me; those who seek me will find me.

dag: ka doli ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ fukumsi zalikpana min o zaligu shɛŋa n ni zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ yimaŋmaŋ biɛrisuŋ zuɣu.
en: So obey the laws and commands of the Lord that I am giving you today. These laws and commands are for your own good.

dag: Speen ŋarima n-daa ʒiri a daguya chana. Dinzuɣu a nɛma daa palila teeku bulli zaa.
en: The ships of Tarshish carried your goods. You were filled to capacity and heavily laden in the middle of the sea.

dag: Taainim kurimbuni ha suhupiɛlli tiŋ la m-bala? Tiŋ maa ni ka niriba daa yi n-du teeku duli ti ʒini la?.
en: Is this your triumphant town, whose origin is from ancient times, whose feet carried her to settle far away?.

dag: ka bɛ daa bi nyari taba bee so ti yi n-chaŋ shɛli polo daba ata maa ni zaa. Amaa Izraɛlnim maa bɛn yaɣili polo zaa daa malila neesim.
en: People couldnt see each other, and they couldnt go anywhere for three days. But the Israelites all had light where they lived.

dag: Naa maa yi ti yɛn kpe, ŋun doli zɔntua din be dunɔdal la ni kpe, ka ti lan doli nimaani yi.
en: The prince must leave the entrance room of the gateway and go out by the same way he went in.

dag: Ka Mɔdɛkai daa zaŋ zaligu gban shɛli bɛ ni daa sabi Susa n-wuhi ni bɛ kum Yɛhudianim maa ti Hatak, ka yɛl o ni o zaŋm li ti wuhi Ɛsta, ka kahigi di yɛla zaa wuh o. O daa yɛl o, Yɛlim Ɛsta ni o cham naa sani nti suh o ni o zom ŋun Ɛsta zuliya nambɔɣu.
en: Mordecai gave Hathach a copy of the orders for the murder of the Jews and told him that these had been read in Susa. He said, Show this to Esther and explain what it means. Ask her to go to the king and beg him to have pity on her people, the Jews.

dag: Ti bi yo ti suhuri zaŋ chaŋ yi sani; yinima n-naɣ yo yi suhuri zaŋ chaŋ ti sani.
en: We are not holding back on our love for you, but you are holding back on your love for us.

dag: Ka Yisa daa bɔhi ba, Yi tɛhiya ni o ni daa ku Galilinim shɛb maa daa nyɛla tuumbiɛrinim gari Galilinim zaa zuɣu ka bɛ daa kpi maa?.
en: Jesus answered them, Because those Galileans were killed in that way, do you think it proves that they were worse sinners than all other Galileans?.

dag: N nina kul zɔrila nintam kaman kulibɔŋ kom la, bɛ ni bahi n niriba yoli zaa maa zuɣu.
en: Streams of water pour from my eyes because of the destruction of the daughter of my people.

dag: Di saha ka Hɛzɛkia daa bahi ba noli ni bɛ malimi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa puuni nɛma niŋbu duri; ka bɛ daa mal li.
en: Then Hezekiah commanded the priests to make storerooms ready in the Lord s Temple. So this was done.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti Yisahaku mini Ribɛka suhusaɣiŋgu pam.
en: But these two women brought a lot of grief to Esau's parents Isaac and Rebekah.

dag: Pur maa zuɣu n-chɛ ka bɛ booni vuhim dabisa chuɣu maa Purim. Bɛ ni daa sab gban shɛl la mini dinkam daa niŋ ba la zuɣu.
en: At this time lots were called purim. So this festival is called Purim. Mordecai wrote a letter and told the Jews to celebrate this festival. And so the Jews started the custom of celebrating these two days every year.

dag: Niriba pam yɛr ni bɛ nyɛla bɛn ʒe yim, amaa bɛ ni ŋuni n-lee nyɛ nir ni yɛn dihi so tabili?.
en: You might call many people your friends, but it is hard to find someone who can really be trusted.

dag: Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: The Lord spoke to me.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka ti chaŋ Siizaria nti kpe Filip ŋun daa nyɛ Yisa lahibal suŋ molomoona la yiŋa. O daa nyɛla tuuli cheechi -amba ayopɔin la ni yino.
en: The next day we went to Caesarea and stayed with Philip, the preacher. He was one of the seven men who helped the apostles.

dag: Amaa ka o daa nya bɛ nandahima maa, ka wum bɛ fabila.
en: You answered their prayers when they were in trouble.

dag: ka Naawuni jilima yi yi palo Daadam Bia zuɣu, dindina Naawuni ni chɛ ka Daadam Bia gba jilima yi palo ŋun Naawuni maŋmaŋ zuɣu; ka di mi ku yuui ka o chɛ ka o nya jilima maa.
en: If God receives glory through him, he will give glory to the Son through himself. And that will happen very soon.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa bi kali Lɛvinim pahi Izraɛlnim kalinli ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun zali Musa shɛm la.
en: As the Lord had commanded Moses, the Levites were not registered with the rest of the Israelites.

dag: Ka yaɣ yini yi biɛra, yaɣa maa zaa biɛrimi; ka yaɣ yini yi nya jilima, yaɣa maa zaa malila suhupiɛlli.
en: If one part suffers, all the parts suffer with it; if one part gets the glory, all the parts celebrate with it.

dag: Di saha maa ka Ilaija daa yɛli niriba maa zaa, Mirimiya ma na ka niriba maa zaa daa vu m-mir o. Ka o daa mali me Yawɛ sara maligu bimbin shɛli bɛ ni daa daai luhi la zali.
en: Then Elijah said to the people, Come closer to me, and they all gathered around him. He set about repairing the altar of the Lord which had been torn down.

dag: ka chɛ ti daalahichi paŋ ti, dama ti gba chɛri paŋdi bɛn tumdi ti taali. Ka di chɛ ka ti kpe zahimbu ni. .
en: Forgive our sins, just as we forgive everyone who has done wrong to us. And dont let us be tempted.

dag: Kpiimba biɛhigu shee mihi gbaai ma, ka kum zana do n tooni.
en: The ropes of the grave wrapped around me. Death set its trap right there in front of me.

dag: Ka Juda daa zaŋ bubil polli maa ti o zo ŋun daa nyɛ Adulam nir la ni o ti ti paɣ maa ka deeg o neen shɛŋa din daa nyɛ alikauli lɔbu shɛhira la na, amaa ka o daa bi nya paɣ maa.
en: Judah sent the kid goat with his neighbor Hirah the Adullamite so he could take back the deposits from the woman, but he couldnt find her.

dag: N ni bo biɛhigu shee ti n niriba Izraɛlnima, ka zaŋ ba ʒili nimaani ka bɛ be bɛ dahalali tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka so ku lan dam ba yaha; ka ninvuɣ galima ku lan nahim ba kaman bɛ ni daa yi niŋdi ba shɛm.
en: Im going to provide a place for my people Israel, and plant them so that they may live there and no longer be disturbed. Cruel people will no longer trouble them, as they had been earlier.

dag: Ka o yi ti kpe luɣ kasi shee maa ni ni o ti yo alahichi samli, di bi simdi ka so kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni hal ka o ti yo omaŋmaŋ min o yiŋnim daalahichi samli ni Izraɛlnim zaa daalahichi samli, ka naanyi yina.
en: From the time Aaron enters the Most Holy Place to perform the ritual of purification until he comes out, there must be no one in the Tent. When he has performed the ritual for himself, his family, and the whole community.

dag: Laɣimmiya niriba maa na Chɛliya ka laɣiŋgu maa be kasi. Laɣimmiya ninkura na, ka laɣimmiya bihi mini bimɔɣirisi gba na. Hal di nyɛla talahi ni aŋgɔnim yi bɛ duri na, ka amiliyanim yi amiliya lɔbu duri na.
en: Gather the people together; prepare them for a sacred meeting; bring the old people; gather the children and the babies too. Even newly married couples must leave their homes and come.

dag: bɛ ni daa zaɣisi n zalikpana la mini n zaligu shɛŋa din pahi, ka saɣim n vuhim dabisa la zuɣu. Dama bɛ suhuri daa kul bela bɛ buɣa jɛmbu ni.
en: I made the vow because they had rejected my commands, broken my laws, and profaned the Sabbath—they preferred to worship their idols.

dag: Gbilisim tibili wum n saɣisigu ŋɔ; n ni yɛl a din be n suhu ni, n ni chɛ ka a baŋ n ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Listen when I reprimand you; I will give you good advice and share my knowledge with you.

dag: N yi nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛɣu, mbusim be n zuɣu! Ka n yi nyɛla wuntizɔra, n ku tooi kpuɣi n zuɣu zuɣusaa, dama n yi lihi n wahala ŋɔ vi m-mali ma.
en: If I sin, I am guilty and should be cursed. But even when I am innocent, I cannot lift up my head. I am so ashamed because of all the troubles I have.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa zali ti ni ti doli zaligunim ŋɔ zaa; ka zom ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ti zaɣ viɛlli nyabu zuɣu sahakam din ni chɛ ka ti be kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: Then the LORD commanded us to perform all these regulations, revering the LORD our God, so that things go well for us always and so we continue to live, as were doing right now.

dag: Ka Dan zuliya niriba maa ninvuɣ kɔbisiyɔbu daa lo tɔbu yi Zɔra mini Ɛshitaol.
en: At this, six hundred men from the Danite clan at Zorah and Eshtaol set out armed for battle.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ a nimdi bahi zoya zuɣu, ka zaŋ a niŋgbuŋ maa pali vinvama ni.
en: I will cover mountains and valleys with your rotting corpse.

dag: Dindali maa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni fɔntins anu nim ni ti tɔɣisi Keenannim yɛtɔɣa, ka po pɔri ni bɛ ni jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ. Ka tinsi maa ni zaɣ yini yuli ni ti boonila Wuntaŋ tiŋa.
en: At that time there will be five cities in Egypt where people speak Hebrew. One of these cities will be named Destruction City. The people in these cities will promise to follow the Lord All-Powerful.

dag: Zuliya kam ŋmanila kom biɛla din tɔɣ lu bokati puuni, ka be kaman taŋkpa zim din pa sania zuɣu o sani. Nyama, ŋuna n-zahindi teeku ni gili tiŋgban bihi shɛŋa kaman taŋkpaɣu biɛla la.
en: To the Lord , all nations are merely a drop in a bucket or dust on balance scales; all of the islands are but a handful of sand.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔ ka yi lee bɔri ni n niŋ tin ya.
en: Jesus asked them what they wanted.

dag: di nyɛla niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛ kurili, ka di simdi ka maligumaana maa yɛli ni o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni. O di lan zaŋ o niŋ duu yaha, o nyɛla ŋun be daɣiri ni.
en: he will say, This is leprosy. You are unclean and must stay away from everyone else.

dag: Bɛ bi tɔɣisiri suhudoo yɛtɔɣa; amaa bɛ nyɛla ʒiŋmariba bɛn tɔɣisiri ʒiri yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din bi niŋ kamaata zaŋ chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be baalim be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni polo.
en: They dont speak the truth; instead, they plot false accusations against innocent people in the land.

dag: di saha yili maa lana ŋun cham ti yɛli maligumaana, Di ŋmanila dɔr shɛli n-lu n yiŋa.
en: First, you must say to a priest, I think there is mildew on the wall of my house.

dag: Dama ti kul nyɛla sɔhila niriba, ka bi mi shɛli; ti biɛhigu dunia ŋɔ ni ŋmanila mahim din vuura.
en: It seems as though we were born yesterday. We are too young to know anything. Our days on earth are very short, like a shadow.

dag: Yi zaŋdi bindir shɛŋa din saɣim maani sara n sara maligu bimbina zuɣu. Yi bɔhira, Wula ka ti lee saɣim li? Yi tɛhiya ni nira ni tooi ʒiɛm Yawɛ bindira dibu shee.
en: You bring unclean bread to my altar. But you ask, What makes that bread unclean? It is unclean because you show no respect for the altar of the Lord .

dag: Ka Bɛla daa ti kpi, ka Zɛra ŋun daa nyɛ Bɔzira nir la bidibiga Jɔbab di nam zan o zaani.
en: When Bela died, Jobab became king. Jobab was the son of Zerah from Bozrah.

dag: Ka sanʒiɛ titali daa ti yiɣisi teeku maa ni. Ka kɔgbana yiɣiri luri ŋariŋ maa ni hal ka kom ti yɛn kpe m-pal li.
en: Gale-force winds arose, and waves crashed against the boat so that the boat was swamped.

dag: Ka o yiɣisi zani n-chani doli ba hal ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, ka kul gbaai chandi ka yiɣiri jɛmdi ka paɣiri Naawuni.
en: and he jumped up and started walking. He went with Peter and John into the temple, walking and jumping and praising God.

dag: Dama nandaamba kul ni be yi sani sahakam, ka yi yi bɔri ba din viɛli niŋbu, yi ni tooi niŋ ba saha shɛlikam; amaa man kul ku be yi sani sahakam.
en: You always have the poor with you; and whenever you want, you can do something good for them. But you wont always have me.

dag: Amaa yi yi nyɛla bɛn dimdi taba, ka vandi taba, yin miriya ka yi ti bahi tab yoli zaa.
en: If you continue hurting each other and tearing each other apart, be careful, or you will completely destroy each other.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi zɔri Naawuni ku dɔɣi bihi, ka buɣim ni di ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn deei birapu yiya.
en: That is because people without God have nothing. Those who take bribes will have their homes destroyed by fire.

dag: Ka Ɛhud daa yɛli ba, Doli ya ma, dama Yawɛ zaŋ yi dimnim Mɔabnim niŋ yi nuu ni. Ka bɛ daa dol o chaŋ ti gu so shɛli Mɔabnim ni yɛn doli gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du, ka daa bi saɣi ka so doli nimaani du.
en: He told them, Follow me! The Lord has given you victory over your enemies, the Moabites. So they followed Ehud down and captured the place where the Moabites were to cross the Jordan; they did not allow anyone to cross.

dag: Chɛliya ka nandahima mali ya, ka fabilimiya, ka kuhimiya. Chɛliya ka yi lari leei kumsi, ka chɛ ka yi suhupiɛlli leei suhugarigu.
en: Be sorrowful, cry, and weep; change your laughter into crying, your joy into gloom!.

dag: Ka Yisa lan bɔhi ba, Ŋuni ka yi bɔra? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Yisa Nazarɛt nir la ka ti bɔra.
en: He asked them again, Who are you looking for? They said, Jesus the Nazarene.

dag: Ka ŋunkam zaɣis a zaligu dolibu bee n-zaɣis a yɛligu wumbu, a ni zali ni o niŋ shɛlikam ni, bɛn kum o. Kul malila yaa mini suhukpeeni pam.
en: Whoever questions your authority or disobeys any of your orders will be put to death. Be determined and confident.

dag: Ka lala zuɣu daa chɛ ka Jɔshua zaŋ takɔbi tuhi nyaŋ Amalɛknim maa zaa.
en: That's how Joshua defeated the Amalekites.

dag: ka chɛliya ka barinim bɛn be nimaani kpaŋ, ka yɛliya ba ni Naawuni nam miri ba.
en: Heal their sick and say, God's kingdom will soon be here.

dag: di saha nyin be a biɛhigu shee alizanda ni; ka wum, ka chɛ o taali ka niŋ din tuhi, ka ti sokam din simd o tuma kaman a ni mi din be o suhu ni shɛm, dama a kɔŋko m-mi din be daadam kam zaa suhu ni.
en: please listen to their prayer. Listen while you are in your home in heaven and forgive them and help them. Only you know what people are really thinking, so only you can judge them fairly.

dag: Ka bɛ ni shɛb mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ka nyɛ wuntizɔriba pahi paɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ yuyanim pam daa dihi bɛ yɛligu maa tabili, ka zaŋ bɛmaŋ tabili Pool mini Silas.
en: Some of the Jews there believed Paul and Silas and decided to join them. Also, a large number of Greeks who were worshipers of the true God and many important women joined them.

dag: Kpaŋm amaŋ kana ka kikaa na bi daai. Yubulus mini Pudɛns ni Linus ni Klɔdia zaŋ tabili ti mabihi bɛn kpalim la zaa puhir a.
en: Try as hard as you can to come to me before winter. Greetings to you from Eubulus, Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers and sisters here.

dag: O nam maa ni daa ti niŋ yaa naai, ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ ku o kpamba bɛn daa ku o ba ŋun daa nyɛ naa la.
en: For example, as soon as he had control of Judah, he arrested and killed the officers who had murdered his father.

dag: amaa ŋunkam chihi dimbɔŋɔ zaŋ chaŋ Yisa polo pala ŋun mali Shi so ŋun yi Naawuni sanna. Ka shia ŋɔ nyɛla shi so ŋun yi Masiachihira sanna, ka yi mi pun wum ni o ni ti kana, ka hal o pun be dunia ŋɔ ni pumpɔŋɔ.
en: But when someone doesn't say this about Jesus, you know this person has a spirit that doesn't come from God and is the enemy of Christ. You knew this enemy was coming into the world and now is already here.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kul niŋdi lala hal ka wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha ti gari, ka bɛ kul mali lala hal ti paai zaawuni sara malibu saha, ka bi wum so kukoli, ka so mi bi garigi ba.
en: As noon passed they went crazy with their ritual until it was time for the evening offering. Still there was no sound or answer, no response whatsoever.

dag: Yi yi di daa pun doli n zaligunima, yi naan nya alibarika, ka di be kaman kɔzɔrim din bi ŋmaara. Ka yi nasara dibu mi be kaman teeku kɔgbana la.
en: If only you had listened to my commands! Then blessings would have flowed for you like a stream that never goes dry. Victory would have come to you like the waves that roll on the shore.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pirig o o zaɣim, ka fa o bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi, ka zaŋ takɔbi ku o. Bɛ daa kar o saria, ka o leei paɣiba ni maani so ansarisi.
en: They stripped her naked, seized her sons and daughters, and then killed her with a sword. Women everywhere gossiped about her fate.

dag: Amaa man yɛri ya mi, di kul pɔnya gba. Di pɔ alizanda, dama di nyɛla Naawuni nam ʒiishee.
en: But I tell you not to swear by anything when you make a promise! Heaven is God's throne, so don't swear by heaven.

dag: Napɔŋ buta ka n kani yi sanna pahiri ŋɔ. So taali nyabu kam ni, di simdi ni niriba ayi bee ata n-di shɛhira.
en: This is the third time that Im coming to visit you. Every matter is settled on the evidence of two or three witnesses.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni daa wum yɛlli ŋɔ, o suhu daa yiɣisiya pam, ka o daa zaŋ buɣim lu Yaakubu zuliya zuɣu; ka o suhu daa yiɣisi pam bahi Izraɛlnim zuɣu.
en: When the Lord heard this, he was angry and furious with Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel.

dag: Ka bɛn be ŋariŋ maa ni daa jɛm o ka yɛli, Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni Bia n-shiri nyɛ a.
en: Then the followers in the boat worshiped Jesus and said, You really are the Son of God.

dag: O ni ti zaŋ o ni woligi shɛb kaman piɛri la zal o nudirigu polo, ka zaŋ o ni woligi shɛb mi kaman buhi la zal o nuzaa polo.
en: He will put the sheep on his right side. But the goats he will put on his left.

dag: Dama ʒii maa saha na kparimi. Di yɛrila naabu saha yɛla, ka bi ŋmari ʒiri. Di yi ŋmanila di bi niŋdi yomyom, nyin kul guhim li. Biɛhiŋ kani, di ni niŋ, di ku yuui.
en: Put it in writing, because it is not yet time for it to come true. But the time is coming quickly, and what I show you will come true. It may seem slow in coming, but wait for it; it will certainly take place, and it will not be delayed.

dag: ni bɛ daazichi zaa ni bɛ paɣiba mini bɛ bihi ni binshɛɣukam din daa be bɛ yinsi zaa chaŋ.
en: They carried off their property, their children, and their wives. They looted the entire place.

dag: Miriya ka yi mali binnana bee n-zaŋ dari kpe biŋŋmahima bee n-sa daantalisi bee n-zaŋ kuɣa biŋŋmahima sa yi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni n-jɛmdi li, dama man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Dont make idols for yourselves. Dont set up statues or memorial stones in your land to bow down to, because I am the Lord your God!.

dag: Ti mabihi, suhimiya Naawuni tiri ti gba.
en: Brothers and sisters, pray for us.

dag: Ka Yisa tuumba la daa tɔɣisiri ti Duuma Yisa kum ni neebu yɛla ni yiko pam; ka Naawuni daalibarika pam daa be bɛ zaa ni.
en: The apostles continued to bear powerful witness to the resurrection of the Lord Jesus, and an abundance of grace was at work among them all.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma kpa nudirigu polo, ka dunɔdali daa be nudirigu polo maa, ka o daa buɣisi di pilanima mini di zɔntua, ka di mini dunɔda dina la zaa nyɛ yim.
en: Then he had me walk toward the south, where there was a gate facing south. He measured its arches and porch using the same measurements.

dag: Ka kpatoonsi maa daa zo Yawɛ dabiɛm pam, ka mali sara n-jɛm Yawɛ ka lo alikauli ni bɛ ni jɛmd o.
en: The sailors were so terrified that they offered a sacrifice to the Lord and made all kinds of promises.

dag: Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zo shɛli din du pam zuɣu ka n ti yɛn sa li. Ka di teei wula n-wali wala, ka leei sida ti titali. Ka noonsi balibu kam ni ti kana ti zaani di gbini. Ka noonsi balibu kam ni ti te bɛ tɛri di wula mahim ni.
en: where it will grow strong branches and produce large fruit. All kinds of birds will find shelter under the tree, and they will rest in the shade of its branches.

dag: Bɔ ka n niŋ ya ka di be di ko ni cheechi shɛŋa din kpalim la n-naɣ pahila n ni bi zaŋ n yɛla doli ya la? Chɛliya dimbɔŋɔ taali paŋ ma!.
en: How were you treated any worse than the other churches, except that I did not bother you for financial help? Please forgive me for being so unfair!.

dag: N kul nɛmi doya; n ŋmanila noombil ŋun be mɔpilli zuɣu o ko.
en: I cannot sleep. I am like a lonely bird on the roof.

dag: Ka bɛ daa suhi alibarika suhigu ti Ribɛka n-yɛli: Ti tizɔpaɣa, Naawuni chɛ ka a leei niriba tusatusa ni tuhi piapia ma! Naawuni chɛ ka a zuliya ti nyaŋ bɛ dimnima.
en: And they blessed Rebekah, saying to her, May you, our sister, become thousands of ten thousand; may your children possess their enemies cities.

dag: Pool ni daa paana ka Yɛhudianim bɛn daa yi Jɛrusalɛm kana la zani gil o m-mali yɛl biɛ shɛŋa pam bɛmaŋmaŋ ni ku tooi wuhi ni di nyɛla yɛlimaŋli fiɣisir o.
en: When he arrived, many Jews who had come down from Jerusalem surrounded him. They brought serious charges against him, but they couldnt prove them.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi ti niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni kaman o ni lɔn ya alikauli shɛm la, yi ni ti dihi zuliyanim pam samli; amaa yinim ti ku paŋ shɛli. Yi ni ti su zuliyanim pam, amaa bɛn ti ku sun ya.
en: Once the LORD your God has blessed you, exactly as he said he would, you will end up lending to many different peoples but wont need to borrow a thing. You will dominate many different peoples, but they wont dominate you.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa yɛl o, Man bi lan yɛn ku saha a sani yaha, ka daa dii zaŋ kpana ata chaŋ ti kuhi Absalom suhu dɛde saha shɛl o ni daa na ne n-yili oki tia maa zuɣu maa.
en: I'm not going to waste any more time with you, Joab said. He took three spears and plunged them into Absalom's chest while he was still alive, hanging in the oak tree.

dag: Di saha ka shia daa kpuɣi ma zuɣusaa, ka Yawɛ jilima daa yiɣisi di biɛhigu shee, ka n daa wum vuri pam n nyaaŋa.
en: Then God's spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me the loud roar of a voice that said, Praise the glory of the Lord in heaven above.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa bɔh o, Ti Duuma, ya polo ka dimbɔŋɔnim ti yɛn niŋ maa? Ka o yɛli ba, Bin kpiŋ ni be luɣ shɛli, nimaani ka juri laana.
en: The followers asked Jesus, Where will this be, Lord? Jesus answered, Its like looking for a dead body—you will find it where the vultures are gathering above.

dag: N yi nyɛla ninvuɣ biɛɣu, mbusim be n zuɣu! Ka n yi nyɛla wuntizɔra, n ku tooi kpuɣi n zuɣu zuɣusaa, dama n yi lihi n wahala ŋɔ vi m-mali ma.
en: If I were guilty, doom to me; Im innocent, but cant lift my head, full of shame and facing my misery.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni nyɛ Naawuni biyurisi la zuɣu, di simdi ni yi chɛ ka yi bebu be kaman o bebu.
en: Since you are God's dear children, you must try to be like him.

dag: ka daadamnim ni ti tarigi binshɛŋa din ti yɛn niŋdi dunia ni maa dabiɛm zuɣu, dama yiko din gbib zuɣusaa ni ti dam.
en: People will be so frightened that they will faint because of what is happening to the world. Every power in the sky will be shaken.

dag: Bɛ ni daa tu o la, o daa bi tu so labisi; o ni daa di wahala la, o daa bi tɛhi biɛri bɔhibu yɛla, amaa o daa chɛla shɛlikam niŋ ŋun kariti saria dɛde la nuu ni.
en: When he was insulted, he did not answer back with an insult; when he suffered, he did not threaten, but placed his hopes in God, the righteous Judge.

dag: Man Pool mini Timoti bɛn nyɛ Yisa Masia daba la n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda zaa bɛn be Yisa Masia ni la mini cheechi zuɣulaannim ni sɔŋdiba bɛn be Filipai.
en: From Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus— To all God's people in Philippi who are in union with Christ Jesus, including the church leaders and helpers:.

dag: Ka Ilaisha daa lan yɛli Naa Jɛhɔash, Kpuɣim piɛma; ka o kpuɣ li. Ka Ilaisha yɛl o, Zaŋm li fiɛb tiŋa; ka o zaŋ li fiɛb tiŋ buta ka chɛ lala.
en: Then Elisha said, Take the arrows! so Joash took them. Elisha then said to Israels king, Hit the ground with them! Joash hit the ground three times and stopped.

dag: Puhimiya ti mabihi bɛn be Laodisia mini paɣ so ŋun yuli booni Nimfa la ni yɛdaniŋdiba bɛn laɣind o yiŋ la ti ma.
en: Give our greetings to the brothers and sisters in Laodicea. Greetings also to Nympha and to the church that meets in her house.

dag: yinim bɛn zaŋ ʒim me Ziɔn, ka zaŋ tuumbiɛri me Jɛrusalɛm ŋɔ.
en: You build Zion by murdering people. You build Jerusalem by cheating people!.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yiɣisi chaŋ Taai mini Sidɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni nti kpe yil shɛli, ka bi bɔri ni so baŋ o yɛla, amaa ka daa bi tooi sɔɣ omaŋa.
en: Then Jesus left and went away to the territory near the city of Tyre. He went into a house and did not want anyone to know he was there, but he could not stay hidden.

dag: Yawɛ, tibimi ma, ka n kpaŋ, tiligim ma, ka n tiligi, dama nyini n-nyɛ n ni paɣiri so.
en: Lord , heal me and I will be completely well; rescue me and I will be perfectly safe. You are the one I praise!.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Yawɛ.
en: Moses said to the Lord .

dag: Dinzuɣu ka ti laɣim kpe n-tɔɣisi, ka tɛhi ni di luhiya ni ti pii ti ni shɛba n-chɛ ka bɛ doli ti mabiyurisi Baanabas mini Pool.
en: So we met together and decided to choose some men and to send them to you along with our good friends Barnabas and Paul.

dag: Amaa Yisa daa bi saɣi bahi omaŋ ti ba, dama o daa mi din be ninsal kam suhu ni.
en: But Jesus knew what was in their hearts, and he would not let them have power over him.

dag: Di saha ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ buŋ nyaampara pa buŋa, ka o yɛl o tumtumda, Niŋm buŋ maa ka o chani yomyom, ka di chɛ ka o baligi chandi naɣila mani nti yɛl a ni a chɛ ka o baligi chandi.
en: Then she had the donkey saddled, and ordered the servant, Make the donkey go as fast as it can, and don't slow down unless I tell you to.

dag: Lala ka Naawuni Shia Kasi sɔŋdi ti ti chɔɣinsi ni, dama ti ʒi di ni simdi ni ti suhiri Naawuni shɛm, amaa Naawuni Shia Kasi maŋmaŋa n-deeri suhiri Naawuni ni ŋuhibu din ka yɛtɔɣa tiri ti.
en: In the same way, the Spirit comes to help our weakness. We dont know what we should pray, but the Spirit himself pleads our case with unexpressed groans.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Haman ti yil o ni daa sa gar da shɛŋa ni o zaŋ M.
en: At once, Haman was hanged on the gallows he had built to hang Mordecai, and the king calmed down.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ma, Daniɛl, cham a chandi shee pumpɔŋɔ, dama yɛla ŋɔ nyɛla din yɛn be ashilɔni n-sɔɣiya hal ti paai saha tariga.
en: Daniel, go about your business, because the meaning of this message will remain secret until the end of time.

dag: Ka yi ti sabi zaligu ŋɔ yɛtɔɣa zaa viɛnyɛliŋga m-pa kuɣa maa zuɣu.
en: On the stones covered with plaster write clearly every word of God's laws.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt daa bɔhi ba pahi buta, Bɔzuɣu? Tuumbiɛ bɔ ka o lee tum? M bi nya ka o tum tuumbiɛ shɛli din simdi kum. Dinzuɣu n ni chɛmi ka bɛ fiɛb o, ka zaŋ o bahi.
en: A third time Pilate said to the people, Why? What wrong has he done? He is not guilty. I can find no reason to kill him. So I will let him go free after I punish him a little.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o yi samban ni ti yɛl o, Kpuɣim a zuɣu lihi zuɣusaa n-kali saŋmarisi, a yi ni tooi kali ba. Di saha ka o daa yɛl o, Lala ka a zuliya ti yɛn be.
en: Then he brought Abram outside and said, Look up at the sky and count the stars if you think you can count them. He continued, This is how many children you will have.

dag: Amaa nahu maa yi pun ʒiɛri niriba ka bɛ yɛl o lana ka o bi niŋ o fukumsi, ka chɛ ka o ti ʒe n-ku doo bee paɣa, di simdi ka bɛ labi nahu maa kuɣa ku o, ka ku nahu maa lan gba.
en: Suppose you own a bull that has been in the habit of attacking people, but you have refused to keep it fenced in. If that bull kills someone, both you and the bull must be put to death by stoning.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni daa nya ka n ku tooi lan guhi pahi zuɣu ka n daa tim Timoti yi sanna ni di chɛ ka m baŋ yi yɛda niŋbu yɛla ni nyɛ shɛm. Dama n suhu daa kul zɔhirimi ni di pa shɛli ka Sintani ti zahim ya ka ti tuma la zaa kpalim yoli.
en: At last, when I could not wait any longer, I sent Timothy to find out about your faith. I hoped Satan had not tempted you and made all our work useless.

dag: Sidɔnnima, yi ku lan mali suhupiɛlli, ka yi niriba ni nya nahiŋgu. Hal bɛ yi zo n-kuli Saipurus, bɛ na kul bi yi.
en: The Lord has said to the people of Sidon, Your celebrating is over— you are crushed. Even if you escape to Cyprus, you won't find peace.

dag: Ka bɛnkam zaa daa wum li maa zaŋ li niŋ bɛ suhuri ni ka bɔhira, Bɔtaa nira n-lee ti yɛn nyɛ bia ŋɔ? Dama sokam daa baŋya ni ti Duuma zaɣa be o ni.
en: All who heard about this considered it carefully. They said, What then will this child be? Indeed, the Lords power was with him.

dag: Wuntizɔra tɛhirila o ni yɛn garigi shɛm, amaa ninvuɣ biɛɣu ŋun noli ni zaɣ biɛɣu n-yirina.
en: Good people think before they answer, but the wicked speak evil without ever thinking.

dag: Ka o yɛli, Chɛliya ka di shiri niŋ kaman yi ni yɛli shɛm maa. Ti yi nya li so sani, dilan ni leei n dabili, ka yinim bɛn kpalim ku mali taali.
en: He said, I agree; but only the one who has taken the cup will become my slave, and the rest of you can go free.

dag: Ka bɛ daa daŋ ti tooni chaŋ Troas nti gul ti.
en: They went on ahead to Troas and waited for us there.

dag: Di saha ka do so ŋun daa be jɛmbu duu maa ni ka alizin biɛɣu ʒi o zuɣu kuhi pam yɛli.
en: In the synagogue was a man who had the spirit of an evil demon in him; he screamed out in a loud voice.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ wɔɣira zaa ni ti gbani n-jɛm o; bɛnkam zaa nyɛ bɛn ni ti dɔni taŋkpaɣu ni ni ti gban o tooni, ka n ti beni sahakam.
en: All who are rich and have more than enough will bow down to you, Lord. Even those who are dying and almost in the grave will come and bow down.

dag: Yuuni maa ni daa ti gari, ka bɛ daa lan lab o sanna yuuni din paya ni ti yɛl o, N dana, ti ku sɔɣ a, ti di ti liɣiri zaa; ka ti niɣi zaa nyɛla nyin n dan dini; ti lan ka binshɛɣu nyin n dan tooni m-pahila ti niŋgbuna ŋɔ mini ti puri.
en: The following year they came to him and said, We will not hide the fact from you, sir, that our money is all gone and our livestock belongs to you. There is nothing left to give you except our bodies and our lands.

dag: Ka o napɔnvari be kaman daanya sun shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ she zuɣiri buɣim ni m-paɣi ka di yi viɛnyɛliŋga la. Ka o kukoli mi vuri kaman kɔzɔrim vubu la.
en: his feet shone like brass that has been refined and polished, and his voice sounded like a roaring waterfall.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu zaɣ biɛɣu ni lu lala nir zuɣu libig o n-tum o barina saha biɛla puuni ka di ka yɛtɔɣa.
en: Because of this, disaster will strike them without warning, and they will be fatally wounded.

dag: Filistia doo maa daa yi kul yirimina ti zaana asiba ni zaawuni n-kul niŋdi lala hal ti paai biɛɣ pihinahi.
en: Goliath came out and gave his challenge every morning and every evening for days.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Teem a nuu tiri teeku maa n-chɛ ka kom maa nahi tab yaha n-lim Ijiptinim maa n-tabili bɛ chɛchɛbunsi mini bɛ chɛchɛbunduhiriba maa zaa.
en: Then the Lord told Moses, Raise your hand over the sea to make the water fall and cover the Egyptian chariots and horse soldiers.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa kum niŋ Yawɛ yɛli, Ti tum alahichi a sani, dama ti chɛ nyini ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu, ka jɛmdila buɣa Baalnima.
en: Then the Israelites cried out to the Lord and said, We have sinned against you, for we left you, our God, and worshiped the Baals.

dag: n-chaŋ naa sani ti yɛl o n ni yɛn yɛl a shɛm ŋɔ, Ka Jɔab daa yɛli paɣ maa o ni ti yɛn yɛli shɛm.
en: Go to the king and speak to him as follows. Then Joab told her what to say.

dag: Dinzuɣu ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Yisa Masia ni la yi taali ni.
en: So now there isnt any condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.

dag: A suhu yiɣisiya, ka a kari dol ti n-kuri ti ka nambɔzɔbo kani.
en: You wrapped yourself with anger. You chased us. You killed us without mercy!.

dag: Bɛ leeri nanima, ka bi niŋdi ma saawara. Bɛ piiri kpamba, amaa ka m bi mi di yɛla. Bɛ zaŋdi bɛ salima mini bɛ daanzinfa maani binnana din yɛn bahi bɛn maŋmaŋ yoli.
en: The Israelites chose their kings, but they didnt come to me for advice. They chose leaders, but they didnt choose men I knew. The Israelites used their silver and gold to make idols for themselves, so they will be destroyed.

dag: Goli so ŋun daŋ tooni maa biɛɣu pinaanahi dali, yin ti puhimiya Yaɣigari chuɣu, ka sokam ti ŋubi bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi hal ni daba ayopɔin.
en: Beginning on the fourteenth day of the first month, and continuing for seven days, everyone will celebrate Passover and eat bread made without yeast.

dag: Ka o yɛli, N yɛli noli ti Keenan. O ni nyɛla o biɛyanim dabili.
en: he said, I now put a curse on Canaan! He will be the lowest slave of his brothers.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ bɛ ŋarima maa na ti zali duli, bɛ daa chɛla bɛ binshɛɣukam maa zaa ka doli Yisa.
en: As soon as they brought the boats to the shore, they left everything and followed Jesus.

dag: Nyamiya, ti Duuma ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ŋɔ kanimina ni o ti zaŋ yiko pam di nam. O ni tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o sani; o laara gba be o sani.
en: The Sovereign Lord is coming to rule with power, bringing with him the people he has rescued.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni niŋdi anfaan shɛli niŋdi ti ni galisiya pam; dinzuɣu ka Naawuni Kundi yɛli, Naawuni zaɣisiri karimbaannima, amaa ka lee niŋdi anfaani niŋdi bɛn siɣisiri bɛmaŋ ni.
en: But the kindness God shows is greater. As the Scripture says, God is against the proud, but he is kind to the humble.
