dag: Ka shɛli ni n ni tooi yɛli zuliya shɛli bee nam shɛli niriba ni n ni chɛ ka bɛ zani viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: At the same time, I may announce that I will build and plant a nation or kingdom.

dag: Amaa ŋun zaŋ omaŋa tabili ti Duuma min o leela shi yino.
en: The one who is joined to the Lord is one spirit with him.

dag: Musa ni daa piri tiŋgbani maa tari Mɔab bɔpiɛligu la ni Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli mini Jɛriko wulimpuhili polo la shɛm m-bala.
en: That was how Moses divided up the Moab Plains to the east of Jericho on the other side of the Jordan River, so these two and a half tribes would have land of their own.

dag: Yiɣisim sɔŋ ti! Tiligim ti a yurilim maŋli la zuɣu!.
en: Get up and help us! Rescue us because of your faithful love.

dag: A yɛtɔɣa daa taɣiri bɛn tuuri zaana. A daa kpaŋsi bɛn duna ni ka yaa la.
en: When someone stumbled, weak and tired, your words encouraged him to stand.

dag: Yi ni ti sa wain tihi ka mali di ni, amaa yi ti ku pɔhi di wala bee n-nyu di wain, dama zunzuya ni ti ŋubi di zaa.
en: You might plant lots of vineyards and work hard in them, but you wont drink any wine or harvest the grapes because worms will devour them.

dag: Ka zaŋ piɛlaa la mini bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi piɛɣu pal la m-mali biɛrisuŋ sara Yawɛ sani; ka maligumaana maa lan mali chi sara mini binnyura sara din pahi la.
en: The ram he will offer as a well-being sacrifice to the LORD with the basket of unleavened bread; then the priest will offer the grain offering and the drink offering.

dag: Amaa o yi mali daŋa, ka di nyɛ dan titali, kaman o yi nyɛ napombara bee o yi nyɛ zoma, yin di zaŋy o mali sara ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: But if there is anything wrong with the animals, if they are crippled or blind or have any other serious defect, you must not sacrifice them to the Lord your God.

dag: ka booi kom din be kasi niŋ laa ni, ka tooi taŋkpaɣu din do Naawuni jɛmbu shee tiŋgban ni n-zaŋ li niŋ kom maa ni.
en: He shall pour some holy water into a clay bowl and take some of the earth that is on the floor of the Tent of the Lord 's presence and put it in the water to make it bitter.

dag: Ka yim zuɣu daa ŋmaligi kpa Bɛtihɔrɔn polo, ka yim zuɣu la mi daa zaŋ kpa tintariga luɣ shɛli nir ni ni zani lihi bahi tin shɛli din yuli booni Zɛbɔiim la zolɔŋ din be mɔɣu ni la polo.
en: another went toward Beth Horon, and the other one went to the border overlooking Zeboim Valley and the wilderness.

dag: Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na la min o tɔɣima la daa ʒiɛla kpaŋ ha tuhi siliga maa.
en: Mary Magdalene and the other woman named Mary were sitting near the tomb.

dag: Bɛ daa birila alikama, ka ti chɛla gɔhi. Bɛ tum tuma ka di wum ba, amaa ka bi nya shɛli. Bɛ yi ti kpuɣi bɛ puri atam, vi ni gbahi ba, Yawɛ suhu ni yiɣisi pam maa zuɣu.
en: They have sown wheat and reaped weeds; they have worn themselves out for nothing. They will be ashamed of their harvest on account of the LORDs fierce anger.

dag: O ni daa yɛl lala maa ka Farisiinim mini Sadusiinim maa daa gbaai tab naŋgbankpeeni ŋmɛbu, ka jintɔriba maa noya daa woli taba.
en: As soon as he said this, the Pharisees and Sadducees started to quarrel, and the group was divided. .

dag: O ni daa paai naa sani, ka naa bɔh o, Mikaya, ti cham ti tuhi Ramɔtigiliadnim bee ti di chaŋ? Ka Makaya garigi yɛl o, Chamiya, yi ni di nasara; Yawɛ ni zaŋ ba niŋ nyin naa nuu ni.
en: When he appeared before King Ahab, the king asked him, Micaiah, should King Jehoshaphat and I go and attack Ramoth, or not? Attack! Micaiah answered. Of course you'll win. The Lord will give you victory.

dag: Ka sapashin kpɛm maa daa yɛli nachimbil maa, Miri ka a yɛli so ni a kana ti yɛli ma yɛlli maa. Ka daa chɛ ka o yi n-kuli.
en: The commander sent the young man away after saying to him, Don't let anyone know you told me this.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N suhuyiɣisili puuni ka n yɛn chɛ ka sanʒiɛɣu maa ʒe, ka chɛ ka sa titali mi n sujee puuni, ka sakuɣ kara luna n suhuyiɣisili maa ni saɣim li.
en: The Lord GOD says, I am angry and I will send a storm against you. I am angry and I will send a strong rain. I am angry and I will make hail fall from the sky and completely destroy you!.

dag: amaa milinsi din pali la yi ti kana, milinsi din bi pali zaa ŋɔ ni vuui.
en: but when the perfect comes, what is partial will be brought to an end.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti ni niŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa gba, ti ku saɣim tin shɛli a ni yɛri maa.
en: He said to Lot, Ill do this for you as well; I wont overthrow the city that you have described.

dag: ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ niriba chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi Nɛtania bia Ishimail. Bɛ daa ti paag o la Gibiɔn been tital la ni.
en: So they mustered all their forces and went to fight him. They found Ishmael, Nethaniahs son, at the great pool in Gibeon.

dag: Ka di chaŋ wula ka a bi dol a ni daa po pɔ shɛli Yawɛ sani maa mini zaligu shɛli n ni daa zal a maa.
en: Why didnt you keep your solemn promise to the LORD and the command that I gave you.

dag: Ka n daa ti tim Musa mini Aduna Ijipti maa; ka chɛ ka alɔbo lu Ijiptinim zuɣu m-muɣisi ba pam, di nyaaŋa ka n daa yihi ya nimaani na.
en: Later I sent Moses and Aaron, and I brought great trouble on Egypt. But I led you out;.

dag: ka daa ti yɛl o nyaandoliba, Chɛliya ka ti lab Judia.
en: Then he said to the disciples, Let us go back to Judea.

dag: Wumma, n ni wuh a n ni yɛli n ni nya shɛli.
en: Now listen, Job, to what I know.

dag: ka yi yi karim n ni pun sab shɛli maa, yi ni tooi nya n ni baŋ Masia daashili maa yɛla shɛm.
en: when you read this, youll understand my insight into the secret plan about Christ.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa bɔhi Jɔshua, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a teei doya zaŋ a nina kpa tiŋa? Yiɣisima!.
en: The Lord said to Joshua, Get up! Why are you lying on the ground like this?.

dag: Amaa nir yi daag o kpee luhi, ka di pala o dima n-nyɛ o bee n-zaŋ binshɛli lab o kpee ka di pala o dɔnimi gu o.
en: But if suddenly and without hostility someone hits another or throws any object at him without premeditation.

dag: A daa zaŋ a shia suŋ ti ba ka o wuhi ba baŋsim, a daa bi mɔŋ ba manna, ka daa ti ba kom ka bɛ nyu.
en: Your gentle Spirit instructed them, and you gave them manna to eat and water to drink.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ dunianim zaa yipa vuhiya, ka nya suhudoo, ka sokam yiini yila ni suhupiɛlli.
en: All the earth rests quietly, then it breaks into song.

dag: Dama di pala ŋun paɣ omaŋa n-nyari paɣibu, amaa ti Duuma ni paɣ so n-nyari paɣibu.
en: You may brag about yourself, but the only approval that counts is the Lord's approval.

dag: Ka Samuɛl yɛl o, Yawɛ darigi cheei Izraɛl nam kparibu a sani zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ n-zaŋ li yɛl a kpe so ŋun so a.
en: Samuel said, The Lord has torn the kingdom of Israel away from you today, and he will give it to someone who is better than you.

dag: Jɛhoyakim ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o ni daa pun tum shɛlikam zaa, bɛ sabi di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛŋa bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafinim la ni.
en: Everything that Jehoiakim did is recorded in The History of the Kings of Judah .

dag: Yawɛ, a nirilim niŋbu puuni, ka a daa ba ma zali kaman zo shɛli din mali kpiɔŋ la; a lɛb a nyaaŋa biri ma, ka dabiɛm gbaai ma pam.
en: You were good to me, Lord ; you protected me like a mountain fortress. But then you hid yourself from me, and I was afraid.

dag: Di saha ka n daa lan yɛli, N Duuma Naawuni, n ka kpe ŋɔ na ni n ti tumla a yubu kaman di ni sabi n yɛla shɛm nyin Naawuni Kundi ni la. .
en: Then I said, Here I am, to do your will, O God, just as it is written of me in the book of the Law.

dag: Riu ni daa dɔɣi Sɛrug maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiyinaayopɔin. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: After Serug was born, Reu lived another years. During that time he had other sons and daughters.

dag: N zɔri dolila a zaligunim soli, dama a yɛligi m baŋsim.
en: I am eager to learn all that you want me to do; help me to understand more.

dag: Bɔ ka a lee bɔri ni n niŋ ti a? Ka o yɛl o, N dana, m bɔri ni a neela n nina ŋɔ ti ma.
en: What do you want me to do for you? Sir, he answered, I want to see again.

dag: N ku niŋ n suhu ni yiɣisi ka n yɛn niŋ shɛm maa. N ku lan ku Ifriimnim yaha, dama m pala daadam, n nyɛla Naawuni. Mani ŋun be kasi ŋɔ be yi sunsuuni, ka n ku kana ni n ti ku niriba.
en: I will not let my terrible anger win. I will not destroy Ephraim again. I am God and not a human. I am the Holy One. I am with you. I will not show my anger.

dag: Kalima maa biɛhigu mini bɛ ni daa mal li shɛm. Di zaa kɔtomsi daa nyɛla zaɣ yinsi, ka nyɛlisira kaman vakahili la. Di malibu maa daa ŋmanila bɛ zaŋla kalinli yini kpɛhi din la ni.
en: The appearance and composition of the wheels were like sparkling topaz. There was one shape for all four of them, as if one wheel were inside another.

dag: A chɛ ka tiŋgbani sɔhigi, ka chɛ ka di tahi bɔɣi; liɣimi di tahibu maa, dama di kul sɔhirimi.
en: You shook the earth and split it open. It is falling apart like a broken wall. Please put it back together.

dag: Ka din beni nyɛla, di niŋ kamaata ni bɛ ni zaŋ fukumsi niŋ ninvuɣ so nuu ni nyɛla ŋun ni ʒe o duuma yim.
en: In this kind of situation, what is expected of a manager is that they prove to be faithful.

dag: Di bi wuhiri ni m pun nya dimbɔŋɔnima bee ni n nyɛla ŋun be tibi, amaa n na kul kpaŋdila mmaŋ chani tooni ni n nya Masia ni gbaai ma kpɛhi nuu ni ni n nya shɛl la.
en: Its not that I have already reached this goal or have already been perfected, but I pursue it, so that I may grab hold of it because Christ grabbed hold of me for just this purpose.

dag: Di saha ka naa mini niriba maa zaa daa mali sara maligunim Yawɛ tooni.
en: Then King Solomon and all the Israelites offered sacrifices to the Lord .

dag: do so ŋun zaŋ o dɔni maa ŋun bom anzinfa laɣibaligu pihinu ti paɣisarili maa ba, ka paɣisarili maa leeg o paɣa, o ni daa zaŋ kiŋkansi dɔni o maa zuɣu, o ka soli ni o yih o hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: the man who had sex with her must give fifty silver shekels to the young womans father. She will also become his wife because he has humiliated her. He is never allowed to divorce her.

dag: a yi zaŋ a salima bahi taŋkpaɣu ni, ka zaŋ salima din yi Ofiri na ti bahi kulibɔŋ kuŋ ni kuɣa zuɣu.
en: Throw away your gold; dump your finest gold in the dry stream bed.

dag: N niriba bɛn jɛmdi ma maa ni zaŋdi bɛ piɛri mini bɛ niɣi chani Sharɔn bɔpiɛligu ni mini Akɔr Vinvamli ni ka bɛ ti ŋubiri mɔri.
en: Sharon will become a pasture for sheep, and the Achor Valley a resting place for cattle, for my people who seek me.

dag: Tiŋ maa ni ti mali pal yaɣu. Nuzaa polo, di ni ti nyɛla mita kɔbiga ni pisinaanu, ka nudirigu polo nyɛ mita kɔbiga ni pisinaanu, ka wulimpuhili polo nyɛ mita kɔbiga ni pisinaanu, ka wulinluhili polo gba nyɛ mita kɔbiga ni pisinaanu.
en: All around the city on each side there will be an open space yards across.

dag: Nyama, yi ni ti boli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒin ya, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒin ya ti zo n-ka yi sanna. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ ni tibigi ya shɛm la zuɣu.
en: There are nations in places you dont know, but you will call for them to come. They dont know you, but they will run to you. This will happen because the Lord , your God, wants it. It will happen because the Holy One of Israel honors you.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi, ka nyɛ yi tiligira la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi zuɣu, n ni tim Babilɔn nti ŋme n-kab bɛ dunoya zaa, ka chɛ ka bɛ niriba tahigu leei kumsi.
en: I, the Lord , will rescue you! I am Israel's holy God, and this is my promise: For your sake, I will send an army against Babylon to drag its people away, crying as they go.

dag: Namɔɣilisi kpɛm maa daa taɣi ba la yuya: O daa boli Daniɛl la Bɛlitishaaza, ka boli Hanania Shadirak, ka boli Mishɛl Mɛshak, ka boli Azaria mi Abɛdnɛgo.
en: The chief official gave them new names: Belteshazzar, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego.

dag: Ka Nahɔr daa nyɛ Sɛrug bia ka Sɛrug nyɛ Riu bia, ka Riu nyɛ Pɛlɛg bia, ka Pɛlɛg nyɛ Ɛba bia, ka Ɛba mi nyɛ Shɛla bia.
en: Serug, Reu, Peleg, Eber, Shelah;.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa tir o ba min o yiŋnim zaa ni o biɛyanim maa bindira n-saɣisiri bɛ ni daa su ninvuɣ shɛb kalinli tariga.
en: Joseph also provided food for their families.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun be, ŋun nyɛ n tampiŋ ŋɔ mali alibarika, Tibigimiya n Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n tiliginsim tampiŋ ŋɔ.
en: The Lord lives! I praise my Rock! How great is my God, the Rock who saves me!.

dag: Ka Gomna Pailɛt yɛli ba, N ni pun sab shɛm maa n-ni zani.
en: Pilate answered, What Ive written, Ive written.

dag: Ka bɛ bihi pirigili daa tɔɣisirila Ashidɔdnim yɛtɔɣa ka ku tooi tɔɣisi Judanim yɛtɔɣa, amaa ka daa naɣ tɔɣisirila zuliya balibu pam yɛtɔɣa.
en: Half of their children spoke the language of Ashdod or the language of various peoples; they couldnt speak the language of Judah.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Musa yaha, Yɛlim Aduna ni o zaŋm o jaaŋgbee niŋ o nuu ni n-teei li tiri kulibɔna mini ko soya ni kopurim ni be luɣ shɛlikam zaa n-chɛ ka poloya yi Ijipti n-yɛrigi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni luɣilikam.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses, Tell Aaron to hold the walking stick in his hand over the canals, rivers, and lakes. Then the frogs will come out onto the land of Egypt.

dag: A ku chɛ ka sula a wuni Chɛmɔshi ni zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti a ni a su la? Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgban shɛŋa zaa ti ti la, ka ti mi su li.
en: Surely you can live in the land that your god Chemosh has given to you. So we will live in the land that the Lord our God has given to us.

dag: Yi sɔŋ ninvuɣ so ŋun ka yiko pam; yi tiligi bɔɣu din ka yaa ŋɔ.
en: Bildad, what a great help you are to this tired, weary man! You have really supported me!.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ alahichinim mini ʒiŋmariba bihi ŋɔ, ŋuni ka yi lee maani ansarisi? Bee ŋuni ka yi lee mɛrigiri yi noya niŋda?.
en: Who are you making fun of? Who are you liars jeering at?.

dag: So be yi ni m-biɛra? O bolimi cheechi toondaannima, ka bɛ ti zaŋ kpam ʒe o ti Duuma yuli zuɣu ka suhi Naawuni ti o.
en: Are any among you sick? They should send for the church elders, who will pray for them and rub olive oil on them in the name of the Lord.

dag: Anabi Musa daa sab taali ni yibu Naawuni sani soli din yi Naawuni fukumsi zaligu dolibu ni na yɛla n-wuhi ni ŋunkam doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm zaa ni nya nyɛvili di zuɣu.
en: Moses writes about being made right by following the law. He says, The person who obeys these laws is the one who will have life through them.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni daa neeg o kum maa ni ka yih o di biɛrim ni, dama o daa pala ŋun ni kpi n-kpalim kum ni.
en: God raised him up! God freed him from deaths dreadful grip, since it was impossible for death to hang on to him.

dag: N zaŋ n faako tibu mirina yomyom. N tiliginsim be soli, n ni bo yɛlimaŋli soli ti niriba. Bɛn be katiŋ ha kul guhiri ma mi, ka niŋ n yaa naani.
en: I will quickly bring my victory. My salvation is on its way, and my arm will judge the peoples. The coastlands hope for me; they wait for my judgment.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti niŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ lala, dama binshɛŋa din chihira ka nyɛ Yawɛ ni je shɛŋa zaa, bɛ niŋdi li tiri bɛ wuna maa, dama hal bɛ daa mi n-zaŋ bɛ bidibisi mini bɛ bipuɣinsi nyo buɣim mali bɛ wuna maa.
en: No, you should not! The Lord hates the disgusting way those nations worship their gods, because they even burn their sons and daughters as sacrifices.

dag: Dindali maa ka Firawuna daa zali bɛ tuma zuɣulaannim mini bɛn daa yuuni ba ka bɛ tumdi tuma maa zaligu yɛli.
en: That same day Pharaoh gave a command to the slave masters and Hebrew foremen.

dag: Di ni daa niŋ dabisa shɛm ka ti nini bi nya wuntaŋa bee saŋmarisi ka sanʒiɛɣu maa na kul bi chɛ ti ʒiɛbu la zuɣu daa chɛ ka ti yihi ti nyɛviya tahima.
en: For many days we could not see the sun or the stars, and the wind kept on blowing very hard. We finally gave up all hope of being saved.

dag: Ŋuni ka a lee viɛli gari? Siɣimiya tiŋgban ni ti dɔni pahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi guni zuɣu.
en: Say to them: Do you think you are more beautiful than anyone else? You will go down to the world of the dead and lie there among the ungodly.

dag: Ka di simdi ni o be o sani yuuni kam kaman padir la. Di bi simdi ka o zaŋ ninkuunsi gbib o yi ninni.
en: And even while you are the slaves of foreigners in your own country, your people must make sure that you are not mistreated.

dag: Man Jud ŋun nyɛ Yisa Masia dabili ni Jeemsi mabia la n-sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri ninvuɣ shɛb Naawuni ni boli ka bɛ nyɛ ŋun ti Ba Naawuni ni yuri shɛba, ka lan nyɛ Yisa Masia ni gbib shɛb la:.
en: Jude, a slave of Jesus Christ and brother of James. To those who are called, loved by God the Father and kept safe by Jesus Christ.

dag: Dinzuɣu miriya ka yi wumdi yi daanabinim mini yi laasabuniŋdiba bee yi zahinzahindiba ni yi baɣisi bee yi bukpahinim bɛn yɛri ya ni yi di jɛm Babilɔn Naa la yɛligu.
en: As for you, dont listen to your prophets, diviners, dreamers, mediums, or your sorcerers who say to you, Dont serve the king of Babylon.

dag: O ti ku kuhi bee n-duh o yee bee n-chɛ ka so wum o kukoli damli solɔɣu zuɣu.
en: He wont cry out or shout aloud or make his voice heard in public.

dag: Ka Ɛsta daa zaŋ o ni mali yɛtɔɣ shɛli ti o ni o ti yɛli Mɔdɛkai. Ɛsta ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: She answered, Tell Mordecai.

dag: Ka malaika maa yɛli ma, Sabimi dimbɔŋɔ sɔŋ: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛ ni boli ni bɛ ka Piɛbil maa amiliya lɔbu chuɣu bindirigu dibu ni na mal alibarika! Ka lan yɛli ma, Dimbɔŋɔnim shiri nyɛla Naawuni yɛligu maŋli.
en: Then the angel said to me, Write this: Great blessings belong to those who are invited to the wedding meal of the Lamb! Then the angel said, These are the true words of God.

dag: Kul niŋmiya bɛ ni wuhi ya ni yi ŋmaai yɛtɔɣa maa shɛm Yawɛ ni pii tin shɛl maa ni, ka doliya bɛ ni wuhi ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam zaa viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: They will give their decision, and you are to do exactly as they tell you.

dag: Lala ka bɛ daa lo tab alikauli Bɛrishiiba. Di nyaaŋa ka Abimilɛk min o sapashin kpɛm Fikol daa lab kuli Filistia tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: When the treaty was completed, Abimelech and his army commander Phicol went back to the land of the Philistines.

dag: Ka Mariama daa zaŋ tulaale alali lita pirigili ka Yisa sanna ti booi li niŋ o naba, ka zaŋ o zabiri nyɛhinyɛhi o naba maa, ka tulaale maa nyom deei yili maa zaa. Bɛ ni booni ti shɛli naad la ka bɛ daa zaŋ mali tulaale maa, ka di mali shaara pam.
en: Then Mary took a whole pint of a very expensive perfume made of pure nard, poured it on Jesus' feet, and wiped them with her hair. The sweet smell of the perfume filled the whole house.

dag: Ka chaŋ ti shihi kpim maa daamaŋka, ka bɛn daa ʒir o maa kpalim zani. Ka o kuhi boli kpim maa, Nachimbila, n yɛr a mi, yiɣisima.
en: He walked to the open coffin and touched it. The men who were carrying the coffin stopped. Jesus spoke to the dead son: Young man, I tell you, get up.

dag: Man gba ni kpahi n nuhi, ka tum n suhuyiɣisili tuma. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Then I, too, will clap my hands and stop showing my anger. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Di ʒiɛman maa ni Ahitɔfɛl daa yi kul yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛli, di ŋmanila Naawuni maŋmaŋ yɛligu n-nyɛ li. Ka Dauda min o bia Absalom zaa daa yi bi zaŋd o yɛligu niŋd asahi.
en: Ahithophel gave such good advice in those days that both Absalom and David thought it came straight from God.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu saha shɛli n ni daa wum yi ni niŋ ti Duuma yɛda mini yi ni yuri Yisa nyaandoliba zaa shɛm yɛla, di chɛ ka.
en: That is why I always remember you in my prayers and thank God for you. I have done this ever since I heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all of Gods people.

dag: Sulemaana daa nyarila salima din tibisim nyɛ kaman kilɔgiram tuhi pisinaata yuun yini puuni.
en: Solomon received almost tons of gold a year.

dag: Nyama, man Yawɛ n-zaŋ Vuhim Dabisili maa tin ya, lala zuɣu ka n tiri ya daba ayi bindirigu daba ayɔbu dali maa din ni chɛ ka sokam be o yiŋa, ka ku yi n-chaŋ luɣ shɛli polo daba ayopɔin maa dali.
en: Look! The LORD has given you the Sabbath. Therefore, on the sixth day he gives you enough food for two days. Each of you should stay where you are and not leave your place on the seventh day.

dag: Ka Jɛtro daa wum Yawɛ ni niŋ zaɣ viɛl shɛli ti Izraɛlnim maa min o ni daa yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni shɛm maa, ka o suhu daa paligi pam.
en: Jethro was glad about all the good things that the LORD had done for Israel in saving them from the Egyptians power.

dag: Daadam, kummi ka fabili, dama di nyɛla din yɛn lu n niriba zuɣu, di nyɛla din yɛn lu Izraɛl nanim zaa zuɣu. Bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbi maa ku bɛ mini n niriba. Mbaye! Kpahimiya yi gbalipina.
en: Groan in sorrow, Ezekiel; the sword is drawn against my people and their leaders. They will die! So give up all hope.

dag: Di simdi ni a guni bɛ ni dɔɣi dab so a yiŋa min a ni zaŋ a liɣiri da so na zaa. Dina n-ni chɛ ka n daalikauli maa be yi niŋgbuna ni n-nyɛ alikauli din ni be sahakam.
en: So every baby boy in your nation will be circumcised. Every boy who is born from your family or bought as a slave will be circumcised.

dag: Ka tintariga maa daa lan kpuɣi zoli maa zuɣu n-zaŋ hal ti paai Nɛfitɔa kulibɔna n-yi nimaani zaŋ hal ti paai tiŋ kar shɛŋa din ʒi Ɛfurɔn Zoli zuɣu la. Ka di daa lan yi nimaani n-chaŋ ti ŋmaligi n-zaŋ hal ti paai Baala bee Kiriatijiarim.
en: From there it went to the Springs of Nephtoah and out to the cities near Mount Ephron. There it turned toward Baalah .

dag: Ŋunkam mali ansarisimaana n-zali dɛde, o kpa turi. Ŋunkam kpahi ninvuɣ biɛɣu zuɣu ni ni nya daŋa.
en: If you correct conceited people, you will only be insulted. If you reprimand evil people, you will only get hurt.

dag: Tiŋ ŋɔ ti ku nyɛ yi duɣu, ka yi mi ti ku nyɛ nimdi be di ni. N ni kari ya saria la Izraɛl tintariga.
en: You leaders claim to be meat in a cooking pot, but you won't be protected by this city. No, you will die at the border of Israel.

dag: ka naanyi di bindirigu n-lan nya kpiɔŋ. Ka Sool daa kpalim Yisa nyaandoliba bɛn daa be Damaskus sani n-niŋ daba ayi;.
en: Then he ate and felt much better. For several days Saul stayed with the Lord's followers in Damascus.

dag: Ka Pita mini Jɔn mirigi bɛ nina kpa o, ka Pita ti yɛl o, Lihim ti.
en: Peter and John stared at him. Peter said, Look at us.

dag: Bee miri ka a zu.
en: Do not steal.

dag: O ni daa di bindirigu maa ka nyu kom naai nyaaŋa ka o daa pa buŋ nyaampara ti o ni daa bol a anab so labisina maa.
en: The man of God finished eating and drinking. Then the old prophet saddled the mans donkey for him and the man left.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulana ŋun yuli daa booni Ananias yɛli bɛn ʒe m-miri Pool maa ni bɛ ŋmɛm o naŋgbani.
en: The High Priest Ananias ordered those who were standing close to Paul to strike him on the mouth.

dag: ka o ba wum o ni po pɔri shɛli bee o ni lo alikauli shɛli maa ka bi yɛl o shɛli, dindina o pɔri maa zaa ni zani, ka o ni lo alikauli ni o niŋ shɛlikam maa ni zani.
en: and her father hears her solemn promise or her binding obligation for herself and keeps silent—then all her solemn promises and any of her binding obligations for herself will stand.

dag: Daadam, zaŋm a nini kpa Jɛrusalɛm polo n-yihi waazu jɛndi bɛ luɣ shɛŋa din be kasi. Tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa jɛndi Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the places in Jerusalem where people worship. Warn everyone in Israel.

dag: N kɔŋko n-daa kul kpalim be nimaani n-lihiri alahiziba ʒii maa. Ya buriginli daa lan ka n ni, ka n ninni biɛhigu taɣi hal ka so ku lan tooi baŋ ni mani m-bala gba.
en: I was left there alone, watching this amazing vision. I had no strength left, and my face was so changed that no one could have recognized me.

dag: dama ŋunkam nya vuhim Naawuni sani chɛ o tuma ka vuhirimi kaman Naawuni ni daa chɛ omaŋmaŋ tuma ka vuhi shɛm la.
en: The one who entered Gods rest also rested from his works, just as God rested from his own.

dag: Ka Siria naa maa daa yɛl o, Cham pumpɔŋɔ! N ni sab gbaŋ ti a ka a mali ti ti Izraɛl naa. Ka Naaman daa bo anzinfa laɣibaligu tuhi pia mini salima laɣibaligu tusaayɔbu ni binyɛr suma din nyɛ chuɣu binyɛra pia chaŋ.
en: Then Arams king said, Go ahead. I will send a letter to Israels king. So Naaman left. He took along ten kikkars of silver, six thousand shekels of gold, and ten changes of clothing.

dag: N ni ti niŋ buɣim nyo Ijipti, ka Pɛlusiumnim ti nya suhusaɣiŋgu pam. Ka sanʒiɛɣu ti ʒe Tɛbis n-da di goma luhi, ka Mɛmfisinim dimnim ti liri ba wuntaŋ ni.
en: I will start a fire in Egypt; the city of Pelusium will ache with fear. The soldiers will break into the city of Thebes, and Memphis will have new troubles every day.

dag: Chamiya Kaline nti nya; ka chaŋ Hamat din nyɛ tin tital la ni mini Gaat din nyɛ Filistianim tiŋ la ni nti nya. Tinsi maa gari Juda mini Izraɛl tinsi? Bee bɛ tiŋgbɔna galisimi gari yi tiŋgbɔŋ?.
en: Look what happened to the cities of Calneh, powerful Hamath, and Gath in Philistia. Are you greater than any of those kingdoms?.

dag: dama kaman nir ni kahim bihim ka bihikpam yirina shɛm ni nir ni yi ŋmahim nyee pam ka ʒim yirina shɛm, lala ka suhuyiɣisili pam gba tahiri zabili na.
en: If you churn milk, you get butter. If you hit someone's nose, it bleeds. If you stir up anger, you get into trouble.

dag: Ka Yisifu zuliya niriba gba daa chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi Bɛtɛlnima, ka Yawɛ daa sɔŋ ba.
en: In the same way, Josephs household went up against Bethel, and the LORD was with them.

dag: Ka yi yi ti duɣi li ŋubi luɣ shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛn pii maa n-yi biɛɣu asiba, yin labimiya yi suɣa ni.
en: Cook it and eat it in the location that the LORD your God selects. The next morning you can return to your tents.

dag: A naɣ ni zaŋla a nina lihi nya ninvuɣ biɛri tibidarigibo.
en: All you will have to do is watch, and you will see that the wicked are punished.

dag: Yisa daa ŋahi ŋahili ŋɔ yɛli, Alizanda nam ŋmanila azichi shɛli din sɔɣi tiŋgban ni so puu ni, ka do so kana nti nya li ka daai tam pi li, ka chaŋ ni suhupiɛlli nti zaŋ o ni mali shɛlikam kɔhi n-lab ti da puu maa.
en: The kingdom of heaven is like a treasure that somebody hid in a field, which someone else found and covered up. Full of joy, the finder sold everything and bought that field.

dag: ka yɛli, Tibigimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun zaŋ o nuu tum tuma n-chɛ ka o ni daa yaag o noli lo m ba Dauda alikauli shɛl la niŋ pali ŋɔ. O daa yɛliya.
en: saying: Bless the LORD, the God of Israel, who spoke directly to my father David and now has kept his promise.

dag: Nyin Sulemaana n-su anzinfa laɣibaligu tuhilituhili maa, ka pukpariba maa mi su anzinfa laɣibaligu kɔbisiyiyi. Man malila mmaŋmaŋ dahalali wain tihi puu.
en: My vineyard is mine alone! Solomon can keep his silver and the others can keep their share of the profits.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna:.
en: The Lord commanded Moses and Aaron.

dag: Yinim Jɛshurunnima, so kani ŋ-ŋmani yi Naawuni ŋun yi zuɣusaa na ni o ti sɔŋ ya ka nyɛ ŋun yi sagbana ni na ni jilima ŋɔ. Naawuni so ŋun ka bahigu ŋɔ n-nyɛ yi sɔɣisili shee.
en: Jeshurun! No one compares to God! He rides through heaven to help you, rides majestically through the clouds.

dag: saha shɛli taŋkpagbiligu yi ti laɣim niŋ tampuɣa ka tampuɣa maa tabili taba?.
en: rain that hardens the dust into lumps?.

dag: Yi ni daa wum yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa piligu ni ha la nyɛla ni ti yum taba.
en: From the beginning you were told we must love each other.

dag: Bɛ ku zo n-yi zibisim ni, buɣim ni di bɛ wulimama, ka pɔhim ʒe bɛ puma bahi.
en: They cant turn away from darkness; a flame will dry out their shoots, and they will be taken away by the wind from his mouth.

dag: Molimiy o jilima yɛla zuliya kam sani, ka mol o ni tumd alahiziba tuun shɛŋa niriba zaa sunsuuni shɛm la gba yɛla.
en: Declare Gods glory among the nations; declare his wondrous works among all people.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni chɛ ka bɛnkam maani maligu buɣa jɛmbu shee, ka tuɣindi tulaale zim tiri bɛ wuna Mɔab la chɛ li niŋbu.
en: I will stop Moab from making burnt offerings on the high places. I will stop them from making sacrifices to their gods. This is what the Lord said.

dag: M birimmi zaa ka dabiɛm kpe ma. N suhu kul yɛla yuŋ zibbu zuɣu, amaa ka di tahiri ma la dabiɛm na.
en: My heart pounds; convulsions overpower me. He has turned my evening of pleasure into dread.

dag: Anabi Musa zaligu daa zalila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi be tibi ni bɛ nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulaannima, amaa Naawuni pɔri din daa doli fukumsi zaligu nyaaŋa la daa zalila ŋun Naawuni maŋmaŋ Bia ŋun be tibi hal ni saha din ka bahigu la.
en: The law chooses high priests who are men and have the same weaknesses that all people have. But after the law, God spoke the oath that made his Son high priest. And that Son, made perfect through suffering, will serve forever.

dag: Ti daa bi bɔri paɣibu so sani, di yi nyɛla yi sani bee shɛb sani, hal ti di mali soli ni ti tooi suhi ya binshɛŋa ti ni nyɛ Masia tuumba la zuɣu.
en: We didnt ask for special treatment from people—not from you or from others.

dag: N yɛli barinyuriba, Di nyuriya bara. Ka yɛli ninvuɣ biɛri mi, Di maliya karimbaani.
en: You tell every bragger, Stop bragging! And to the wicked you say, Don't boast of your power!.

dag: Guum yomyom tuh o soli ti bɔh o, A min a yidan ni yi bia la mal alaafee? Ka o garigi yɛli Gɛhaazi, Ti mal alaafee.
en: Run and meet her. And ask her if everything is all right with her and her family. Everything is fine, she answered Gehazi.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa ti chɛ ka dimdi kpe Abimilɛk mini Shɛkɛmnim sunsuuni, ka bɛ daa yi o nyaaŋa.
en: when God decided to punish him and the leaders of Shechem for killing Gideon's sons. So God turned the leaders of Shechem against Abimelech.

dag: Ka Farisiinim daa yɛl o, A di amaŋ shɛhira; dinzuɣu a shɛhira maa pala shɛhira maŋli.
en: Then the Pharisees said to him, Because you are testifying about yourself, your testimony isnt valid.

dag: Di simdi ka yi mal li ka di be kaman n ni daa wuh a shɛm zoli zuɣu la.
en: Be very careful to make everything exactly the way I showed you on the mountain.

dag: Chɛrubi ŋun la gba kpiŋkpama wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita anahi ni biɛla. Chɛrubinima ayi maa zaa barilim mini bɛ wɔɣilim daa nyɛla yim. Chɛrubinima ayi maa zaa kpiŋkpama wɔɣilim daa nyɛla yim.
en: The second winged creature also measured fifteen feet. Both winged creatures had identical measurements and form.

dag: Ka salo maa ni shɛb daa tahiri yɛra, ŋ-ŋɔ nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ; ka bɛn la mi yɛra, ŋ-ŋɔ nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ; dama salo daa kul tahirila yiriŋ, hal bɛ shɛb daa bi mi din chɛ ka bɛ laɣimna.
en: Some of the people in the meeting were shouting one thing, and others were shouting something else. Everyone was completely confused, and most of them did not even know why they were there.

dag: Amaa ka jintɔriba maa ni yino ŋun yuli daa booni Kaiafas, ka o nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulana di yuuni maa la yɛli ba, Yi ʒi shɛli!.
en: One of the men there was Caiaphas. He was the high priest that year. He said, You people know nothing!.

dag: Dama o daa yɛlimi, ka di niŋ. O daa zal li zaligu, ka di ba n-zani.
en: When he spoke, the world was created; at his command everything appeared.

dag: Ka Abinɛr daa lan yɛli Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba gba di yɛla, di nyaaŋa ka o daa chaŋ Dauda sani Hiburɔn ni o ti yɛl o Izraɛlnim mini Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba ni lo ni bɛ niŋ zaɣ viɛl shɛli zaa yɛla.
en: Abner spoke also to the people of the tribe of Benjamin and then went to Hebron to tell David what the people of Benjamin and of Israel had agreed to do.

dag: Ka salo pam daa ʒin gil o niŋ sunsuuni ka bɛ yɛl o, A tizɔbihi min a ma be samban ni bɔr a.
en: The crowd sitting around Jesus told him, Your mother and your brothers and sisters are outside and want to see you.

dag: n-chɛ ka paɣ maa nyu kɔtɔɣu din tahiri tibidarigibo maa na. Ka ko shɛli din tahiri tibidarigibo maa na ni kpe paɣ maa ni n-ti o biɛrim pam.
en: Then he will make the woman drink the water of bitterness that brings the curse. And the water that brings the curse will enter her, causing bitterness.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa ku Midian paɣ so maa mi yuli daa boonila Kɔzibi. O daa nyɛla Zur bipuɣiŋga, ka Zur daa nyɛ o daŋ ni niriba dɔɣirikpɛma Midian.
en: The woman's name was Cozbi. Zur, her father, was chief of a group of Midianite clans.

dag: O mi ku kabigi gbiŋgban dalim bee n-kpihim firila mia buɣim hal nti tahi yɛlimaŋli nasara dibu na.
en: He wont break a bent stalk, and he wont snuff out a smoldering wick, until he makes justice win.

dag: Yi yi di be n ni be shɛm ŋɔ, n gba naan tooi yɛli kaman yi ni yɛri shɛm ŋɔ. N naan tooi yɛli ya yɛtɔɣa pam, ka vili n zuɣu niŋ ya.
en: I also could say the same things you say, if you had my troubles. I could say wise things against you and shake my head at you.

dag: Ka Hiram daa tim ti yɛli Sulemaana, N wum a ni tim na nti yɛli ma shɛm la, ka m mali shili ni n-niŋ a ni bɔri shɛlikam zaa zaŋ chaŋ sida dakuɣiri mini sipirɛs dakuɣuri ŋmabu polo la.
en: Then Hiram sent Solomon the following message: I have received your message, and I am ready to do what you ask. I will provide the cedars and the pine trees.

dag: Ka Gaal lan yɛl o yaha, Nyama, niriba n-yi zoya maa sunsuuni siɣirina ŋɔ, ka shɛb mi yi baɣisi oki tia la polo kanna.
en: But Gaal spoke up again, Look! People are coming down from Tabbur-erez, and one company is coming from the direction of Elon-meonenim.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kpah o tabili dapulli maa zuɣu, ka bɛ zaŋ o binyɛra pumpu n-sɔŋ tɔri tɛte ni bɛ nya bɛ zaa yinoyino ni yɛn di shɛli;.
en: The soldiers nailed Jesus to a cross. Then they threw dice to divide his clothes between them.

dag: ka Zabad daa nyɛ Ɛfilal ba, ka Ɛfilal nyɛ Obɛd ba.
en: Ephlal, Obed.

dag: Izraɛl ni daa be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni saha shɛli maa ka Rubin daa zaŋ ŋun o ba dabipaɣa Biliha dɔni, ka ŋun Izraɛl wum li. Yaakubu bidibisi daa nyɛla pinaayi.
en: While Israel stayed in that place, Reuben went and slept with Bilhah his fathers secondary wife, and Israel heard about it. Jacob had twelve sons.

dag: Ka o napɔnvari be kaman daanya sun shɛli bɛ ni zaŋ she zuɣiri buɣim ni m-paɣi ka di yi viɛnyɛliŋga la. Ka o kukoli mi vuri kaman kɔzɔrim vubu la.
en: His feet were glowing like bronze being heated in a furnace, and his voice sounded like the roar of a waterfall.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa ʒini ni bɛ di bindirigu ka lihi nya Ishimail zuliya sochandiba, ka bɛ yi Giliad n-taɣiri bɛ laakumnim bɛn ʒiri taansuri mini kpam ni mɛɛr, bɛ ni zaŋdi shɛŋa maani tima kuni Ijipti.
en: While Joseph was in the well, the brothers sat down to eat. They looked up and saw a group of traders traveling from Gilead to Egypt. Their camels were carrying many different spices and riches.

dag: Saha shɛli yi yi ti yɛn yiɣisi chaŋ, Aduna min o bidibisi bɛn kpɛm suɣili maa ni nti yiligi pateesa shɛli din yiliya la n-zaŋ li pili Alikauli Adaka la.
en: When the Israelites are ready to move their camp, Aaron and his sons will enter the tent and take down the curtain that separates the sacred chest from the rest of the tent. They will cover the chest with this curtain.

dag: Yi chaŋ gili zoya ni tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni ka di yuui, kpamiya yi nuzaa polo.
en: that we had spent enough time wandering about in those hills and that we should go north.

dag: Ka binshɛli din ŋmani buɣim zilima puhi yina nti tamtam bɛ zaa yinoyino zuɣu ni ti kpa.
en: Then they saw what looked like fiery tongues moving in all directions, and a tongue came and settled on each person there.

dag: Ram daa nyɛla Aminadab ba, ka Aminadab daa nyɛ Nashɔn ŋun daa nyɛ Juda bidibisi ni asanza nir la ba.
en: The family line from Ram to Jesse is as follows: Ram, Amminadab, Nahshon .

dag: Dabiɛm gbaai ma mi ka n ni sɔhira, ka dabiɛm din galisi nyaŋ ma;.
en: I am gripped by fear and trembling; I am overcome with horror.

dag: Ka Jɛfita daa po pɔri n-lo Yawɛ alikauli yɛli, A yi ni zaŋ Ammɔnnim maa niŋ n nuu ni.
en: Jephthah promised the Lord : If you will give me victory over the Ammonites.

dag: Bɛ ni nya alibarika Yawɛ sani, ka yi taali ni Naawuni ŋun nyɛ bɛ tiliginsim ŋɔ sani.
en: The Lord God, who saves them, will bless and reward them.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa pii wun pala la, di saha ka tɔbu daa be bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. Ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahi bɛn be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni ŋuni n-daa lee mali nyɔtaɣirigu bee kpani?.
en: Then there was war in the land when the Israelites chose new gods. Of the forty thousand men in Israel, did anyone carry shield or spear?.

dag: Tɔɣisim yɛtɔɣ maŋa din nyɛ so ni ku tooi galim shɛli, ka di chɛ ka bɛn chihir a di vi ka ku tooi mali zaɣ biɛ shɛli ni bɛ yɛli dalim ti.
en: And your teaching should be clearly right so that you cannot be criticized. Then anyone who is against you will be ashamed. There will not be anything bad they can say about us.

dag: Bɛ daa tam Naawuni ŋun nyɛ bɛ tiligira, ka lan nyɛ ŋun daa tum tuun kara Ijipti la yɛla.
en: They forgot the God who had saved them by his mighty acts in Egypt.

dag: Ŋunkam mali ansarisimaana n-zali dɛde, o kpa turi. Ŋunkam kpahi ninvuɣ biɛɣu zuɣu ni ni nya daŋa.
en: Whoever instructs the cynic gets insulted; whoever corrects the wicked gets hurt.

dag: Doo yi zaŋ o bia paɣ dɔni, bɛn kum bɛ niriba ayi maa, bɛ tumla taali bɛ ni nyɛ dɔɣiri yini zuɣu, bɛ ʒim yihibu taali ʒila bɛ zuɣu.
en: If a man has intercourse with his daughter-in-law, they shall both be put to death. They have committed incest and are responsible for their own death.

dag: Ka Sool bipuɣiŋga Mikal maa daa bi dɔɣi bia hal ni o nyɛvili tariga.
en: Sauls daughter Michal never had a child. She died without having any children.

dag: Di saha maa ka anabinima ayi bɛn daa nyɛ Hagai mini Zakaria ŋun daa nyɛ Iddo bia la daa piligi m-mali Izraɛl Naawuni yuli n-tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa tiri Yɛhudianim bɛn daa be Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm ka nyɛ o ni su shɛb la.
en: At that time two prophets, Haggai and Zechariah son of Iddo, began to speak in the name of the God of Israel to the Jews who lived in Judah and Jerusalem.

dag: Faranim mini nandaamba yi ti bɔri kom ka bi nya, ka kɔnyuri chɛ ka bɛ lɔna kuui, man Yawɛ ni deei bɛ suhigu. Mani ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ ku bahi ba.
en: When my people in their need look for water, when their throats are dry with thirst, then I, the Lord , will answer their prayer; I, the God of Israel, will never abandon them.

dag: Bɛ daa ku Ɛvi mini Rɛkɛm ni Zur ni Hur ni Rɛba bɛn daa nyɛ Midian nanim la m-pahi bɛ ni daa ku bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb zaa zuɣu. Bɛ daa zaŋ takɔbi ku Bɛɔr bia Balaam gba.
en: including Balaam son of Beor and the five Midianite kings, Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba.

dag: Ka salo maa daa nya Yisa ni chaŋ ti kpe Zakius yiŋ maa ka ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni yɛra, O chaŋ ti kpe alahichilan la yiŋa.
en: All the people who saw it started grumbling, This man has gone as a guest to the home of a sinner.

dag: Ka yi sara maligu maa yi nyɛla bɛ ni duɣi bindir shɛli tahilaa puuni, di simdi ka di nyɛla zim viɛlli, ka kpam be di ni.
en: If the offering is bread cooked in a pan, it is to be made of flour and olive oil.

dag: Ka o daa kpuɣiri bihi maa buɣira, ka zaŋd o nuhi pari bɛ zuɣu niŋdi alibarika niŋdi bɛ ni.
en: Then he took the children in his arms, placed his hands on each of them, and blessed them.

dag: Di saha ka Ilaisha daa je suli niŋ o, ka yɛli, Di di simdi ni a zaŋ li fiɛbila siɣimsiɣim bunu bee buyɔbu; dindina a naan ŋme Sirianim hal ti kpimsi bɛ birili, amaa a ni bi niŋ lala maa zuɣu, a ni ŋme n-nyaŋ ba la siɣimsiɣim buta kɔŋko.
en: The man of God was angry with Jehoash. Elisha said, You should have hit five or six times! Then you would have defeated Aram until you destroyed it! But now, you will defeat Aram only three times.

dag: Di nyaaŋa n ni ku paɣ maa bihi, ka cheechinim zaa baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ ŋun vihiri baŋdi din be salinim suhuri ni mini bɛ tɛha ni, ka nyɛ ŋun ni ti yi zaa yinoyino yi tuma ni simdi shɛm laara.
en: and I will even put her children to death with disease. Then all the churches will know that Im the one who examines minds and hearts, and that I will give to each of you what your actions deserve.

dag: Pa ninsal ka n fabindi niŋdi maa, ka bɔzuɣu ka n yɛn niŋ suɣilo?.
en: My complaint is against God; that's why I am impatient.

dag: Mɛshɛlɛmia daa mali mabihi ni bidibisi bɛn daa mali yiko din ni tooi tum Naawuni jɛmbu duu tuma, bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pisaayika.
en: Meshelemiah's family furnished eighteen qualified men.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, m bi bɔri yi naɣikpahi ni naɣilahi bee yi buzɔna ni buhi.
en: Why would I want more bulls from your barns or goats from your pens?.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ man Naa Sulemaana ni, ka chɛ ka Dauda nam nya zaashee zani ŋun Yawɛ sani hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: But the Lord will bless me and keep Davids throne before him forever.

dag: Gbibiy o zalikpana min o zaligu shɛŋa n ni zaani ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ yi mini yi bihi biɛrisuŋ zuɣu, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka yi yuui Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya sahakam ŋɔ ni.
en: Obey all his laws that I have given you today, and all will go well with you and your descendants. You will continue to live in the land that the Lord your God is giving you to be yours forever.

dag: Dina ka Yawɛ zali ya ni sokam pihim o dimma tarig la. Di simdi ka sokam baŋ o malibu ni nyɛ shɛm tariga, ka pihi lita ayi ninvuɣ yino kam zuɣu.
en: And he orders you to gather about two liters for each person in your family—that should be more than enough.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mbusim be tin shɛli nim bɛn kuri niriba zuɣu. Hal mmaŋmaŋ ni laɣisi dari pam duhi.
en: I, the Lord God, will punish that city of violence! I will make a huge pile of firewood.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa chaŋ ti yɛl o yidana, Naawuni nira n-ka n sanna, o biɛhigu ŋmanila Naawuni malaika, ka o ninni lihibu mali dabiɛm pam. M bi bɔh o o ni yi luɣ shɛl na, ka o mi bi wuhi ma o yuli.
en: Then the woman went and told her husband, A man of God came to me, and he looked like Gods messenger—very scary! I didnt ask him where he was from, and he didnt tell me his name.

dag: Dindali maa ka yi ni ti baŋ ni n shiri be m Ba ni, ka yi mi be n ni, ka n gba be yi ni.
en: On that day you will know that I am in my Father, you are in me, and I am in you.

dag: Amaa ka Jɔab mini Abishai bɛn daa kari doli Abinɛr, zaŋ chaŋ wuntan luhili saha ka bɛ daa paai Amma Zoli din be Gia polo Gibiɔn mɔɣu ni soli zuɣu la gbini.
en: but Joab and Abishai went after Abner. The sun was setting when they came to the hill of Ammah, which faces Giah on the road to the Gibeon wilderness.

dag: O yuri takarifiɛma mini o chɛchɛbunsi gbaya vuri ni ti chɛ ka bihi banim ku lan bɔhi bɛ bihi yɛla, bɛ bɔɣiri ti kul yɛn zalizalimi.
en: They will hear the hoofbeats of horses, the clatter of chariots, the rumble of wheels. Parents will not turn back for their children; their hands will hang limp at their sides.

dag: Bɛ wɔɣira mini tarimba zaa ni ti kpi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka so ti ku sɔɣi ba, ka so mi ti ku fabili bɛ zuɣu. So ti ku zaŋ bini ŋmaag omaŋ bee m-pini o zuɣu bɛ zuɣu.
en: Rich and poor alike will die and be left unburied. No one will mourn and show their sorrow by cutting themselves or shaving their heads.

dag: Molimiy o jilima molo zuliya kam ni, ka yɛl o daalahizib tuma yɛla niriba zaa sani.
en: Tell all the nations how wonderful he is! Tell people everywhere about the amazing things he does.

dag: Ka tin shɛŋa din pahi n-daa lan nyɛ: Maɔn mini Kamɛl ni Zif ni Juta.
en: There were Maon, Carmel, Ziph, Juttah.

dag: Mɛtusɛla ni daa paai yuun kɔbiga ni pihiniinaayopɔin saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Lamɛk.
en: When Methuselah was , he had a son, Lamech.

dag: O ni daa niŋ Rubin bia Ɛliab bidibisi Datan mini Abiram shɛm la, tiŋgbani ni daa bɔɣi n-vali bɛ mini bɛ malibu ni bɛ suɣa ni binnɛɔŋ kam ŋun daa be bɛ sani Izraɛlnim zaa sunsuuni la.
en: and what he did to Dathan and Abiram, the descendants of Eliab the Reubenite, when the ground opened up its mouth and swallowed them, their families, their tents, and every living thing they possessed in the presence of all Israel.

dag: Ka Rut daa shiri doli Bɔaz kachɛriba maa n-yihiri kayiha maa hal ka bɛ ti chɛ chi maa zaa naai. Ka Rut daa kul kpalim be o yidan ma maa sani.
en: So Ruth continued working closely with the women servants of Boaz. She gathered grain until the barley harvest was finished. She also worked there through the end of the wheat harvest. Ruth continued living with her mother-in-law Naomi.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa teeg o nuu shihi n noli ka yɛli ma, Pumpɔŋɔ n zaŋ n yɛtɔɣa niŋ a noli ni.
en: Then the Lord reached out, touched my lips, and said to me, Listen, I am giving you the words you must speak.

dag: Ka Pita kpuɣ o nuhi gahi wuhi ni bɛ foma, ka o daa kahigi Naawuni ni niŋ shɛm yih o duu maa ni wuhi ba; ka yɛli ba ni bɛ yɛlim Jeemsi mini yɛdaniŋdiba zaa di yɛla. Ka daa yi nimaani chaŋ luɣ shɛli.
en: He motioned with his hand for them to be quiet, and he explained to them how the Lord had brought him out of prison. Tell this to James and the rest of the believers, he said; then he left and went somewhere else.

dag: N ni chɛ ka m min a lo tab alikauli, ka n chɛ ka a zuliya nab pam.
en: I will make a covenant between us and I will give you many, many descendants.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa yɛli Izraɛlnim maa, Malimiya yimaŋa, dama biɛɣuni Yawɛ sa ni tum alahiziba tuma yi sani.
en: Joshua told the people, Purify yourselves, because tomorrow the Lord will perform miracles among you.

dag: Bɛ ni zaɣisi ma jɛmbu ka tuɣindila tulaale zim maani bɛ buɣa la zuɣu, bɛ chɛ ka bɛ nuhi tuma zaa ku ma suli ka n suhu ni yiɣisi bahi yi yaŋɔ nim zuɣu ka ku maai.
en: They have rejected me and have offered sacrifices to other gods, and so have stirred up my anger by all they have done. My anger is aroused against Jerusalem, and it will not die down.

dag: Ka Makiri bia Giliad ŋun daa nyɛ Yisifu bia Manaasa yaaŋa la daŋ puuni dunoya dɔɣirikpamba daa ka Musa mini Izraɛlnim dunoya dɔɣirikpamba sanna.
en: One day the family leaders from the Gilead clan of the Manasseh tribe went to Moses and the other family leaders of Israel.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla zaligu yi sani sahakam. Gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin biɛɣu pia dali, di simdi ka yi lo noli ka di tumiya tuma dindali, yinim bɛn nyɛ tiŋbihi bee tinzunnim bɛn be yi sani.
en: On the tenth day of the seventh month of each year, you must go without eating to show sorrow for your sins, and no one, including foreigners who live among you, is allowed to work.

dag: Ka di simdi ka o lihi dɔro maa, ka dɔro maa yi be yili maa dukpina zuɣu, ka zaɣ baŋkom garisi di ni bee bin ʒiɛhi gari di ni, ka di kpe dukpini maa puuni.
en: and examine the mildew. If there are greenish or reddish spots that appear to be eating into the wall.

dag: Zaŋm ma tabil a suhu kaman a nyɛla dalinli la, ka zaŋ ma pa a baɣiri zuɣu kaman n nyɛla dalinli la. Dama yurilim malila yaa kaman kum la, ka kɔre mali yaa kaman gballi. Di dirimi kaman buɣim la, ka di buɣim zilinli mali kpiɔŋ pam.
en: Keep me near you like a seal you wear over your heart, like a signet ring you wear on your hand. Love is as strong as death. Passion is as strong as the grave. Its sparks become a flame, and it grows to become a great fire !.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Kaman tuŋ wula ni be mɔɣu ni tihi ni ka n zaŋ li ti ka bɛ maani buɣim shɛm, lala ka n yɛn niŋ Jɛrusalɛmnima.
en: Therefore, the LORD God proclaims: Of all the trees in the forest, I have decreed that the vines wood is destined to be consumed by fire. So also have I decreed for those who live in Jerusalem.

dag: Dama nyini n Duuma n-nyɛ n tahima. Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ n ni niŋ so naani m bilim ni hal ni wayo.
en: I depend on you, and I have trusted you since I was young.

dag: N daa je suli n-tin ya nanima, ka n suhu ti yiɣisi, ka n lan deei ba ka chɛn ya.
en: I was angry, and I gave you a king. And when I became very angry, I took him away.

dag: Ŋun Naa Dauda daa daŋ nya Masia kum ni neebu ka tɔɣisi di yɛla yɛli: O ti ku kpalim be kpiimba biɛhigu shee bee o niŋgbuŋ ti pooi. .
en: David knew this would happen, and so he told us Christ would be raised to life. He said God would not leave him in the grave or let his body decay.

dag: yin piimiya tin shɛŋa ka di nyɛ tiliginsim tinsi zali. Ka nir yi ku ninsal sarati kubu, o ni tooi zo n-kuli nimaani.
en: You must choose towns to be cities of safety. If someone accidentally kills another person, that person can run to one of those towns for safety.

dag: ka koma maa daa labina ti lim Firawuna chɛchɛbunsi min o chɛchɛbunduhiriba ni o tɔbbihi bɛn daa doli Izraɛlnim maa siɣi teeku maa ni zaa, ka bɛ ninvuɣ yino gba daa bi kpalim.
en: The water returned and covered the chariots, the drivers, and all the Egyptian army that had followed the Israelites into the sea; not one of them was left.

dag: N nyee nyɔni m biɛhigu. N ni tɔɣisi n fabila ŋɔ yɛtɔɣa ka shɛli ku kaɣili ma. N ni tɔɣisi ni suhusaɣiŋgu.
en: I loathe my life; I will let loose my complaint; I will speak out of my own bitterness.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani kaman o yaannim ni daa niŋ shɛm la. O daa bi ŋmaligi ka chɛ alahichi shɛŋa Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la.
en: He did what was evil in the LORDs eyes, just as his ancestors had done. He didnt deviate from the sins that Jeroboam, Nebats son, had caused Israel to commit.

dag: Bɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ suhuri kpaŋmi kaman kuɣili la. Ka bɛ ni daa zaɣisi ni bɛ ku wum Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni daa pun zaŋ o yɛligu n-ti anabinim shɛb bɛn daŋ tooni na yɛligu la zuɣu, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ suhu daa yiɣisi pam bahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: They steeled their hearts against hearing the Instruction and the words that the LORD of heavenly forces sent by his spirit through the earlier prophets. As a result, the LORD of heavenly forces became enraged.

dag: Ka Asiria Naa Shalimanɛsa daa ti lo tɔbu kana ni o ti tuh o. Ka Hɔshia daa zaŋ omaŋ ti Asiria naa maa ka yɔr o farigu.
en: Assyrias King Shalmaneser marched against Hoshea, and Hoshea became Shalmanesers servant, paying him tribute.

dag: Ka nyin Firawuna ni nya zahindi maa buyi la wuhiya ni Naawuni n-zal li, ka ni chɛ ka di ku yuui, ka di niŋ.
en: God has given you two dreams to let you know that he has definitely decided to do this and that he will do it soon.

dag: Bɛ lo ba yolisim nyabu alikauli, amaa ka bɛmaŋmaŋ nyɛ bɛn zaŋ bɛmaŋ leei bahiyotali tuun shɛŋa bɛ ni tum ka di mili ba la daba, dama ninsal nyɛla binshɛɣukam din nyaŋ o dabili.
en: They promise them freedom while they themselves are slaves of destructive habits—for we are slaves of anything that has conquered us.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Kpahimmiya fiig tia; Yi yi ti kul nya ka di wula puhiri va mama, di saha yi baŋya ni siɣili miriya.
en: Let the fig tree teach you a lesson. When its branches become green and tender and it starts putting out leaves, you know that summer is near.

dag: N daa to ba la kpani ka di pili yi, ka bɛ lu n naba ni ka kɔŋ yiɣisibu, ka n ku bɛ zaa.
en: I destroyed my enemies. I struck them down. They did not get up again. They fell under my feet.

dag: O daa dolila Izraɛl nanim naba, ka daa tumdi kaman Ɛhab daŋ niriba ni daa tumdi shɛm, dama Ɛhab bipuɣiŋga n-daa nyɛ o paɣa. O daa tum tuumbiɛri pam Yawɛ sani.
en: He followed the wicked example of King Ahab and the other kings of Israel, because he had married one of Ahab's daughters. He sinned against the Lord .

dag: Bomiya bua mini naɣilaa ni biŋkɔbbaligu ni piɛlaa bɛn ka dansi dabisili kam m-maani alahichi sanyoo sara hal ti paai daba ayopɔin.
en: Each day for the next seven days, you must offer a goat and a bull and a ram as sacrifices for sin. These animals must have nothing wrong with them.

dag: A ni tooi vihi baŋ ni di bi gari biɛɣ pinaayi zuŋɔ ka n daa chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm ni n ti jɛm Naawuni.
en: I went to worship in Jerusalem only twelve days ago. You can learn for yourself that this is true.

dag: Amaa sabimi Aduna min o bidibisi maa yuya n-chɛ ka bɛ tumdi maligumaanitali tuma, ka ninvuɣ zino yi ka bɛ sanna, yin kum o.
en: You will appoint Aaron and his sons to be responsible for the priesthood. Any other person who approaches will be put to death.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ba, Ninvuɣ biɛri bɛn bi ʒe Naawuni yim ʒiɛman nim ŋɔ bɔrila shihirili nyabu, amaa bɛ ku nya shihir shɛli m-pahila Anabi Jona shihirili la.
en: How evil and godless are the people of this day! Jesus exclaimed. You ask me for a miracle? No! The only miracle you will be given is the miracle of the prophet Jonah.

dag: Ka malaikanim bɛn zaa daa ʒe n-gili nam ʒiishee maa mini kpamba la ni binnɛma anahi la daa gbani nam ʒiishee maa tooni n-jɛmdi Naawuni.
en: All the angels stood around the throne, the elders, and the four living creatures. Then they threw themselves face downward in front of the throne and worshiped God.

dag: Bɛ lan ka yɛmbahiga bɛ chandi ni, ka bɛ ni lo nia shɛŋa luhi ba.
en: Their powerful legs become weak, and they stumble on schemes of their own doing. *.

dag: Izraɛlnim karimbaani di shɛhira jɛndi ba. Amaa ka bɛ bi ŋmaligi chaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni sani bee n-suh o dimbɔŋɔnim zaa zuɣu.
en: The arrogance of the people of Israel cries out against them. In spite of everything that has happened, they have not returned to me, the Lord their God.

dag: N ni yili yilli paɣi Naawuni yuli; ka zaŋ wumpaɣibo tibig o.
en: I will praise Gods name in song. I will honor him by giving him thanks.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Nuhu, A min a malibu zaa kpɛm ŋariŋ maa ni, dama n nyaya ka nyini n-nyɛ wuntizɔra n sani ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni.
en: The Lord said to Noah, Go into the boat with your whole family; I have found that you are the only one in all the world who does what is right.

dag: A tɛhiya ni dimbɔŋɔ tuhiya? A yɛliya, M mali yɛlimaŋli Naawuni sani.
en: Do you think it right? You say, Im more just than God.

dag: Ka n daa na kul suhiri Naawuni, ka kahigiri m mini n niriba Izraɛlnim daalahichi wuhiri Naawuni, ka balindi ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ ni o chɛ ka o Jɛmbu du kasi la lan me n-zali yaha.
en: I went on praying, confessing my sins and the sins of my people Israel and pleading with the Lord my God to restore his holy Temple.

dag: Ka Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa daa kpalim be Obɛdɛdom Gaat nir maa yiŋ chira ata, ka Yawɛ daa niŋ alibarika niŋ Obɛdɛdom min o yiŋnim zaa ni.
en: It stayed there three months, and the Lord blessed Obed Edom and his family.

dag: Jɛfita ni daa ti labiri kuni yiŋ na Mizipa, o bipuɣiŋga n-daa daŋ o soli tuhibu na n-gbib chaɣisa chaɣisiri ka wari waa. O kɔŋko mi n-daa kul nyɛ o bia. O daa lan ka bidibiga bee bipuɣiŋga pah o zuɣu.
en: But when Jephthah came to his house in Mizpah, it was his daughter who came out to meet him with tambourines and dancing! She was an only child; he had no other son or daughter except her.

dag: Yawɛ, a bi lihiri bɔrila yɛlimaŋli? A ŋme ba, amaa di bi mii ba, a darigi bɛ tibili, amaa ka bɛ zaɣisi ni bɛ ku deeg a saɣisigu. Bɛ chɛ ka bɛ suhuri kpɛm gari kuɣili. Bɛ zaɣisiya ni bɛ ku niŋ tuuba.
en: I answered, I know that you look for truth. You punished your people for their lies, but in spite of the pain, they became more stubborn and refused to turn back to you.

dag: ni Buki ni Uzi ni Zɛrahia.
en: Bukki was Abishuas son. Uzzi was Bukkis son. Zerahiah was Uzzis son.

dag: N ni ti yiɣisi n suhu bahi Pɛlusium din nyɛ Ijiptinim tɔbu tuhibu yaa shee la zuɣu, ka saɣim Tɛbisinim daazichi.
en: I will pour out my anger against Pelusium, the fortress of Egypt! I will destroy the people of Thebes.

dag: Suhuyiɣisililana tumdila jɛrilim, ka yɛndan mi nyɛ ŋun be baalim.
en: Fools have quick tempers, and no one likes you if you can't be trusted.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma lan yɛli, Ka a yi ti nyala wuntizɔriba pihinahi nimaani? Ka o garigi yɛli, Wuntizɔriba pihinahi maa zuɣu, n ku saɣim tiŋ maa.
en: Abraham spoke again: Perhaps there will be only forty. He replied, I will not destroy it if there are forty.

dag: Naawuni jɛmbu duu yiliyiiniba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbiga ni pihinahaayika.
en: The singers: the descendants of Asaph.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda daa yɛl o, Doli ma kuli Jɛrusalɛm ka n ti gbib a.
en: The king said to him, Come with me to Jerusalem, and I will take care of you.

dag: yin di wumya anabinim maa bee bɛn baŋdi zahima gbinni maa yɛtɔɣa, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-zahindi ya maa ni o nya yi shiri yuri ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yi suhu zaa mini yi shihi zaa.
en: do not pay any attention to them. The Lord your God is using them to test you, to see if you love the Lord with all your heart.

dag: M bi sabila yɛtɔɣa pihita ti a ni di ti a saɣisigu mini baŋsim.
en: I have written thirty sayings filled with sound advice.

dag: Ka Sirianim bɛn be Damaskus daa kana ni bɛ ti sɔŋ Hadadɛza ŋun daa nyɛ Zɔba naa maa, ka Dauda daa ku Sirianim maa ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaayi.
en: When troops from the Syrian kingdom of Damascus came to help Hadadezer, David killed , of them.

dag: Dindali maa n ni ti lo mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri mini noonsi bɛn yiɣiri zuɣusaa ni biŋgbamda bɛn be tiŋgban ni alikauli tin ya, ka kpihim tɔbiri mini takɔbiri ni tɔb tuhibu tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni, ka chɛ ka yi dɔni ka barina shɛli kani.
en: And I will agree to let you live in peace—you will no longer be attacked by wild animals and birds or by weapons of war.

dag: Ninive yɛla ŋɔ zaa ŋmanila pagɔr tuma din nyɛ kɔre kpɛhibu din ka kalinli; di ŋmanila paɣ timalana ŋun zaŋ kɔre kpɛhibu gbahi zuliya pam, ka zaŋ o tima maa yɔhim niriba pam la.
en: All this happened because of Nineveh. Nineveh is like a prostitute who could never get enough. She wanted more and more. She sold herself to many nations, and she used her magic to make them her slaves.

dag: Apaim bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Ishi, Ishi bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Shɛshan, Shɛshan bidibiga n-daa nyɛ Ahilai.
en: Appaim's son was Ishi, the father of Sheshan and the grandfather of Ahlai.

dag: Ka o daa ti be o buɣili Nisirok duu n-jɛmdi li, ka o bidibisi bɛn nyɛ Adirammɛlɛk mini Sharɛza daa zaŋ takɔbi ku o ka zo n-kuli Ararat tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Ka o bia Ɛsarihadɔn daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: One day, when he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch, two of his sons, Adrammelech and Sharezer, killed him with their swords and then escaped to the land of Ararat. Another of his sons, Esarhaddon, succeeded him as emperor.

dag: O daa yaag o noli yɛli ka toli mini sakɔri bɛn ka kalinli waɣi yɛrigi.
en: God spoke, and the locusts came— countless grasshoppers came!.

dag: A me dunia tamla di tanzaa zuɣu, ka shɛli kul ku tooi dam li sahakam.
en: You built the earth on its foundations, so it can never be moved.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya: A yi ni doli n zaligunima ka tumdi n ni zal a tuun shɛŋa ni a tum, n ni chɛ ka a su n jɛmbu duu tuma, ka ti a zaashee bɛn ʒe kpe ŋɔ sunsuuni.
en: The LORD of heavenly forces proclaims: If you will walk in my paths, if you will keep my charge, then you will lead my house and guard my courts, and I will allow you to walk among those standing here.

dag: Wɔribariba niŋdi shili, ka takɔbi chɛri piɣibpiɣib, ka kpana nyaɣisira. Ka bɛ ku niriba pam, n-zaŋ ba sɔŋ duyaduya. Kpiimba maa ka tariga, ka bɛ tuuri kpiimba maa.
en: Cavalry troops charge, swords flash, spears gleam! Corpses are piled high, dead bodies without number— men stumble over them!.

dag: Bɛ ni daa pihi kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya maa, tuuli dini daa gbaala Jɛhoyarib, ka din pah ayi gbaai Jɛdaya.
en: The first was Jehoiaribs group. The second was Jedaiahs group.

dag: Ka Dauda daa kpuɣi paɣiba Jɛrusalɛm pahi n-lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: David married more secondary wives in Jerusalem and fathered more sons and daughters.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Ti wumla dabiɛm mini abirima lubu kuhigu, pa suhudoo kuhigu.
en: I heard a cry of terror, a cry of fear and not of peace.

dag: Ka o daa ti paai luɣ shɛli ka wuntaŋ lu ka o kpalim gbe nimaani dindali maa yuŋ. O daa piila kuɣ yini nimaani sɔŋ n-dɔni zaŋ o zuɣu kuɣ li gbihi.
en: The sun had already set when he came to a good place to spend the night. He took a rock there and laid his head on it to sleep.

dag: Ka bɛ daa bi baŋ o ni yɛli ba shɛm maa gbinni.
en: But they did not understand the meaning of what he said to them.

dag: Lala mi n-nyɛ li, yinim yidaannima, benya yɛm biɛhigu ni yi paɣiba, ka mi ni bɛ kpiɔŋ bi paai yi dini, ka timiya ba jilima yi mini ba zaa ni ti yɛn laɣim deei pin suŋ din nyɛ nyɛvil la zuɣu. Niŋmiya lala ka shɛli ku gu yi wunsuhigu soli.
en: Husbands, likewise, submit by living with your wife in ways that honor her, knowing that she is the weaker partner. Honor her all the more, as she is also a coheir of the gracious care of life. Do this so that your prayers wont be hindered.

dag: Yi tɛhiya ni Yawɛ bi mi bee n-teeri yi mini yi yaannim ni yi nanim ni yi kpamba ni tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim ni daa mali maligu shɛŋa Juda fɔndi ni mini Jɛrusalɛm solɔri zuɣu la yɛla?.
en: Don't you think the Lord knew that you and your ancestors, your leaders and kings, and the rest of the people were burning incense to other gods in Jerusalem and everywhere else in Judah?.

dag: Ka wuntizɔriba maa yi nyɛla pihinahinaanu, a ni saɣim tiŋ maa niriba anu maa ni pooi maa zuɣu? Ka o yɛli, N yi nya wuntizɔriba pihinahinaanu tiŋ maa ni, n ku saɣim li.
en: What if there are five less than fifty? Will you destroy a whole city because of just five people? The Lord said, If I find forty-five good people there, I will not destroy the city.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Yi ni ti nya ti yab Ibrahimma mini Yisahaku ni Yaakubu ni anabinim zaa ka bɛ be Naawuni nam ni, amaa ka Naawuni ti kari yinim di ni bahi. Yinim ni ti fabili ka dim yi nyina.
en: Then when you have been thrown outside, you will weep and grit your teeth because you will see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in God's kingdom.

dag: Ka Ijipti naa daa zaŋ o mabia Ɛliakim leei Juda mini Jɛrusalɛm naa, ka taɣ o yuli m-bol o Jɛhoyakim; amaa ka daa zaŋ Jɛhoyakim mabia Jɛhɔahaz kuli Ijipti.
en: Then Neco appointed Jehoahaz's brother Eliakim king of Judah and changed his name to Jehoiakim. He led Jehoahaz away to Egypt as his prisoner.

dag: Daba ayi nyaaŋa o ni chɛ ka ti lan niŋ nyɛvili, ka o yiɣisi ti daba ata dali maa n-chɛ ka ti min o lan be.
en: In two or three days he will heal us and restore our strength that we may live with him.

dag: Naa Sulemaana daa lan kpahi ŋarima din zɔri pam zali Ɛziɔngɛba din miri Ɛlat, ka be Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni Teeku Ʒiɛɣu kulinol ni la.
en: He also had a lot of ships at Ezion-Geber, a town in Edom near Eloth on the Red Sea.

dag: Di lan simdi ka yi booi kpam maa bahi bɛ ni nyɔri sara maligu buɣim bimbin shɛli zuɣu la gba mini di nɛma la zaa zuɣu, ka malimali sara maligu bimbini maa ka di leei din be kasi zaa.
en: Anoint the altar for burning offerings. Anoint everything on the altar. You will make the altar holy. It will be very holy.

dag: Amaa ka niriba maa daa yɛl o, Di bi simdi ni a dol ti chaŋ. Dama tinim yi ŋmaligi guui bɛ baɣa ku be ti ni, ka ti pirigili yi kpi, bɛ baɣa ku be ti ni, a kɔŋko saɣi ti niriba tuhi pia, dinzuɣu di simdi ka a kpalim yiŋ ŋɔ, ka lee tir ti sɔŋsim na.
en: You mustn't go with us, they answered. It won't make any difference to the enemy if the rest of us turn and run, or even if half of us are killed; but you are worth ten thousand of us. It will be better if you stay here in the city and send us help.

dag: N yɛli noli tin ya, dama yi zuliya maa zaa fari ma mi.
en: In this way your whole nation has stolen things from me, so bad things are happening to you.

dag: N sabi Ifriimnim tuumbiɛri sɔŋ, n zaŋ bɛ daalahichi maa niŋ sɔɣisili shee.
en: Ephraim tried to hide his guilt. He thought his sins were a secret, but he will be punished.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu Naawuni ni daa ti buɣisi ti yab Ibrahimma saha shɛl la, o daa zaŋ Yisahaku mali sara ŋun Naawuni sani. Ti yab Ibrahimma ni daa nyɛ Naawuni ni lo so alikaulinim la zaa yoli, o daa saɣiya n-zaŋ o bi gaŋ Yisahaku mali sara Naawuni sani.
en: By faith Abraham offered Isaac when he was tested. The one who received the promises was offering his only son.

dag: Ka ŋun bahindi nyaaŋa ka Masia daa yi o zuɣu nyɛla man ŋun kpalim nyaaŋa dɔɣim palli nyabu ni ŋɔ;.
en: and last of all he appeared to me, as if I were born at the wrong time.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna.
en: The Lord said to Moses and Aaron.

dag: Bɛ daa bɔhimi, Pa Yisifu bia Yisa ŋun nyɛ ti ni mi so ba min o ma la m-bala? Ka di chaŋ wula ka o ti yɛli ni o yila alizanda ni na.
en: They said, This is Jesus. We know his father and mother. He is only Josephs son. How can he say, I came down from heaven.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa:.
en: The Lord told Moses.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan pirigi maligumaaniba zalizali bɛ zaashɛhi, ka pirigi Lɛvinima zalizali bɛ zaashɛhi ni bɛ tumdi Naawuni tuma Jɛrusalɛm kaman di ni sabi shɛm Musa litaafi ni la.
en: Then the priests and Levites were assigned their duties in God's temple in Jerusalem, according to the instructions Moses had written.

dag: Yi yi ti du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili chaŋ ti ʒi tiŋgbɔn shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiri ya maa ni, yi yi ti ʒini di ni ka be di ni.
en: Soon you will cross the Jordan River to conquer the land that the Lord your God is giving you. And when you have settled there.

dag: Jɛhɔshafat ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa pahi min o ni daa wuh o kpiɔŋ shɛm ni o ni daa tuhi tɔb shɛŋa zaa, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Juda nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: The rest of Jehoshaphats deeds, the great acts he did, and how he fought in battle, arent they written in the official records of Judahs kings?.

dag: Ka Pita daa puɣisiri doli Yisa nyaaŋa m-mali ti paai maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa yiŋ dundɔŋ ni nti ʒi yili maa ni dunɔguliba sani wuɣisiri buɣim.
en: Peter followed him from a distance, right into the high priests courtyard. He was sitting with the guards, warming himself by the fire.

dag: Ka ti nya dimbɔŋɔ ka di li shɛhira n-yɛri ni ti Ba Naawuni daa tim o Bia na ni o ti leei dunianim Tiligira.
en: And we have seen and tell others that the Father sent his Son to be the Savior of the world.

dag: Di ku paai yuuni ka yinim bɛn nya vuhim ŋɔ ni sɔhigi. Wain tihi ku wali, ka di daatam kpuɣibu ku beni.
en: In a little over a year, the carefree will shudder, because the grape harvest will fail; the vintage wont arrive.

dag: Di pala yinim bɛn ʒe ti sani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ tooni ŋɔ kɔŋko ka m po pɔri lɔri alikauli zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: But Im not making this covenant and this agreement with you alone.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ yi ti niŋ pali, di mi nyɛla din ni niŋ pali, di saha bɛ ni baŋ ni anabi daa be bɛ ni.
en: But the things you sing about really will happen, and then the people will know that there was a prophet living among them.

dag: Birimiya wuntitali ti yimaŋa, ka ti kpuɣi atam din nyɛ yurilim din ka ŋmali. Komiya yi tiŋgbani din doya ka bi ko la, dama saha paaya ni yi bo Yawɛ ka o kana ti tiligi ya.
en: Plow your fields, scatter seeds of justice, and harvest faithfulness. Worship me, the Lord , and I will send my saving power down like rain.

dag: Chuɣu maa puhi naai dali n-daa nyɛ chuɣu maa dabisi tital dali, ka Yisa daa yiɣisi zani kuhi yɛli, Kɔnyuri yi wum so, ŋun kam n sanna ti nyu.
en: On the last and most important day of the festival, Jesus stood up and shouted, All who are thirsty should come to me!.

dag: Ka Musa mini Aduna ni Izraɛlnim zaa daa niŋ Lɛvinim maa kaman di ni wuhi shɛm. Izraɛlnim maa daa niŋ Lɛvinim maa mi kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa ni o niŋ shɛlikam zaa zaŋ chaŋ Lɛvinim maa polo la.
en: So Moses, Aaron, and all the Israelites obeyed the Lord . They did with the Levites everything that the Lord commanded Moses.

dag: Lala ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdib gba daa maan o ansarisi ka yɛri taba, O daa tiligi shɛba ka lee ku tooi tilig omaŋa.
en: The leading priests and the teachers of the law were also there. They made fun of Jesus the same as the other people did. They said to each other, He saved others, but he cant save himself!.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yi di daa bi chɛ ka shɛb tiligi, ti tiŋ maa naan bemi kaman Sɔdom mini Gomɔra.
en: If the Lord Almighty had not let some of the people survive, Jerusalem would have been totally destroyed, just as Sodom and Gomorrah were.

dag: Niriba maa daa na kul maanila sara buɣa jɛmbu shee maa, amaa bɛ daa maani li n-tirila Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa.
en: The people, however, still sacrificed at the shrines, but only to the LORD their God.

dag: A yiko ni ka ti nyaŋ ti dimnima. A yuli zuɣu ka ti no n-taai bɛn kana ti lir ti la.
en: and by your power we defeat our enemies.

dag: Naawuni yɛliya, N ni zali saha shɛli yi ti paai, n ni doli yɛlimaŋli soli kari saria.
en: I have set a time for judgment, says God, and I will judge with fairness.

dag: ka bɛ ʒin ya chaŋ kaman wurigu la pɔi ka Yawɛ suhu naanyi yiɣisi bahi yi zuɣu. Niŋmiya tab saawara ka laɣimmiya pɔi ka Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili titali dabisili la naanyi paai ya.
en: before you become like a dry and dying flower. In the heat of day, a flower will wilt and die. You will be like that when the Lord shows his terrible anger. So change your lives before the Lord shows his anger against you!.

dag: Jɛramiil ŋun daa nyɛ Hɛzirɔn bituuli san la bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Ram ŋun daa nyɛ o bituuli san la mini Buna ni Orɛn ni Ozɛm ni Ahija.
en: Jerahmeel, the oldest son of Hezron, had five sons: Ram, the oldest, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.

dag: Ka alizanda ni tɔbbihi ye binyɛr piɛla din piɛli ka be kasikasi m-bari wɔr piɛla dol o.
en: The armies of heaven followed him, riding on white horses and dressed in clean white linen.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa niŋ kaman Musa ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa n-chaŋ ni o ti tuhi Amalɛknim maa. Ka Musa mini Aduna ni Hur daa chaŋ ti du n-tam daboli maa zuɣu.
en: Joshua led the attack as Moses had commanded, while Moses, Aaron, and Hur stood on the hilltop.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa tim ti yɛli Hiram.
en: Solomon sent the following message to Hiram.

dag: Kalim Gɛrishɔn gba zuliya kaman bɛ daŋ ni bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Count all the people of the Gershon family. List them by family and family group.

dag: O bi ŋmani wun so tuumbaŋdiba ni mali zali, ka salindoora dooi salima pa di zuɣu, ka bɛ niŋ anzinfa zoligɔnim yɛliyɛl li la?.
en: Is an idol at all like God? It is made of bronze with a thin layer of gold, and decorated with silver.

dag: A daa zaŋ a shia suŋ ti ba ka o wuhi ba baŋsim, a daa bi mɔŋ ba manna, ka daa ti ba kom ka bɛ nyu.
en: You gave your good spirit to teach them. You didnt withhold your manna from them, and you gave them water for their thirst.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛliya, Yi daŋ maa galisiya pam, di ka tibi kpaŋ.
en: The Lord said: My people, you are wounded and near death.

dag: Ka o daa boli bibil so na nti zaŋ o zali bɛ sunsuuni.
en: So Jesus called a child to come and stand in front of them.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa yi n-gbaai bɛ naba biɛhibu hal ti paai luɣ shɛli bɛ ni dol duri Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili. Bɛn daa biɛhiri bɛ naba maa ni daa kul yi n-naai, ka bɛ lan yo dunoli maa yaha.
en: So the kings men went out of the city, and the people closed the city gates. The kings men went to look for the two men from Israel. They went to the Jordan River and looked at all the places where people cross the river.

dag: Zuŋɔ zaŋ chana, n ku lan boli ya n daba, dama dabili bi mi o duuma daashili; amaa n ni boli ya la n zɔnima, dama n ni wum shɛlikam zaa m Ba sani, n zaŋ li wuhi ya.
en: I no longer call you servants, because servants dont know what their master is doing. But now I call you friends, because I have told you everything that my Father told me.

dag: A daa lo a suhu ni ni a ni du zuɣusaa ha n-chaŋ ti yaɣi Naawuni saŋmarisi zuɣu n-zaŋ a nam kuɣ zali nimaani. A daa tɛhiya ni a ni chaŋ ti ʒini laɣiŋgu zoli din du pam ka be nuzaa polo la zuɣu.
en: You said to yourself, I'll climb to heaven and place my throne above the highest stars. I'll sit there with the gods far away in the north.

dag: A daa zaŋ liiga shɛŋa bɛ ni wuɣi n-yɛli ba, ka zaŋ n kpam mini n tulaale zim la zali bɛ tooni.
en: You took your fine garments and clothed them. You set my oil and incense before them.

dag: Binshɛɣukam neesim ni yihi palɔni, di biɛhigu maŋli gba yirimi do palɔni; dama binshɛɣukam din yi n-do palɔni gba leela neesim.
en: But the light makes clear how wrong those things are.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ daa yiɣisi Yawɛ zoli maa gbini n-lu soli chaŋ daba ata chandi; ka bɛ daa zaŋ Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka la n-daŋ tooni chaŋ daba ata chandi ni di ti bo dooshee ti ba.
en: When the people left Sinai, the holy mountain, they traveled three days. The Lord 's Covenant Box always went ahead of them to find a place for them to camp.

dag: Darius Ahasivɛrɔs bia ŋun daa nyɛ Miidia tiŋgbɔŋ ni nir la daa deei Kalidianim nam di.
en: These things happened during the first year that Darius son of Ahasuerus was king. Darius was a Mede by birth, but he was appointed to be the king of Babylon.

dag: Bɛ ni daa niŋ dabisa biɛla o sani ka Gomna Fɛstus daa ti pii Pool yɛla maa n-yɛli Naa Agiripa. O daa yɛl o mi, Gomna Filiksi daa chɛ do so niŋ sarika ni ya ŋɔ;.
en: They stayed there many days, and Festus told the king about Pauls case. Festus said, There is a man that Felix left in prison.

dag: Ka Jɛfita nin ni daa kul nya o bia maa, o dii darigimi cheeg omaŋmaŋ binyɛrigu ka kuhi yɛli, Mbaye, m bia! A chɛ ka n suhu saɣim. A leei ŋun ti ma nandahima; dama m pun yaai n noli lo Yawɛ alikauli, ka ku tooi lan yi di nyaaŋa.
en: When he saw her, he tore his clothes and said, Oh no! My daughter! You have brought me to my knees! You are my agony! For I opened my mouth to the LORD, and I cant take it back.

dag: Binshɛɣukam din kpɛri ninsal nol ni pala din tar o daɣiri; amaa din yiri ninsal nol ni na n-naɣ tar o daɣiri.
en: It is not what goes into your mouth that makes you ritually unclean; rather, what comes out of it makes you unclean.

dag: Yisa daa chani gindila fɔntinsi mini tiŋkpansi zaa n-wuhiri niriba Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duri ni, ka yihiri Naawuni nam lahibal suŋ waazu, ka tibiri dɔro balibu kam mini dɔr biɛri balibu kam ni mali ninvuɣ shɛba.
en: Jesus traveled among all the cities and villages, teaching in their synagogues, announcing the good news of the kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness.

dag: N tɔɣisiri ya mi kaman m bihi n-nyɛn ya la. Niŋmiya ti kaman ti ni niŋ ya shɛm; yi gba yoomiya yi suhuri ti ti!.
en: I speak to you as I would speak to my own children. Please make room in your hearts for us.

dag: Ka Haga daa ti dɔɣi Ibram bidibiga, ka Ibram daa boli bi so Haga ni dɔɣi maa yuli Ishimail.
en: Hagar gave birth to a son for Abram, and Abram named him Ishmael.

dag: Ninsal yɛlli kam ʒila o zuɣu, amaa yɛlli kam malila di soli ni di saha.
en: There is a right time and a right way to do everything, but we know so little!.

dag: Ka so yi tum Yawɛ ni zali ni bɛ di tum binshɛŋa la ni shɛli n-tum alahichi, hal o yi kul bi mi gba, o mali taali, ka di taali maa ʒi o zuɣu.
en: If you sin and break any of the commands that the Lord said must not be done, you are guilty. Even if you did not know about it, you are still responsible for your sin.

dag: N yɛn gbib biɛrim n suhu ni ti paala bɔ saha? N yɛn malila suhugarigu dabisi muni puuni zaa? N dimnim kul yɛn nyandi ma ka di yuusim paala bɔ saha?.
en: How long must I endure trouble? How long will sorrow fill my heart day and night? How long will my enemies triumph over me?.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb beni ka bɛ nini tiɣi bɛmaŋ kasitali, amaa ka lee bi yi bɛ daɣiri ni.
en: Some people think they are pure, but they have done nothing to remove the filth of their sin.

dag: Amaa ka Diɔnisius ŋun daa nyɛ Ariɔpagus jintɔriba ni yino la mini paɣ so ŋun yuli daa booni Damaris m-pahi ninvuɣ shɛba daa niŋ yɛda, ka zaŋ bɛmaŋ tabili Pool.
en: But some of the people joined with Paul and became believers. Among these were Dionysius, a member of the Areopagus council, a woman named Damaris, and some others.

dag: Cham yaɣimɛra yiŋa ka n ti zaŋ n yɛtɔɣa tɔɣis a nimaani.
en: Jeremiah, go down to the potters house. I will give you my message there.

dag: Ka Asa daa ti niŋ ŋun kani, ka bɛ zaŋ sɔɣi pah o yaannim zuɣu o yab Dauda tiŋ la ni. Ka o bia Jɛhɔshafat daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Asa died and was buried in the tomb of his ancestors in Jerusalem. His son Jehoshaphat then became king.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn yɛli ba, M mabihi n-daa bala. M mini ba zaa nyɛla ma pu yin ni bihi. Yawɛ zuɣu, yi yi di daa chɛ ba, n naan ku kun ya.
en: Gideon said, They were my brothers, my own mother's sons. I solemnly swear that if you had not killed them, I would not kill you.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Bɔhimi zuliya kam, ŋuni n-lee na mi n-wum yɛlli ŋɔ tatabo? Izraɛlnim bɛn ŋmani paɣipiɛliga ŋɔ tum zaɣ biɛ titali.
en: Listen to what the Lord says: Ask the other nations this question: Have you ever heard of anything so bad? Israel, who is as dear to me as a young daughter, has done this terrible thing!.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli Zɛbulɔn zuliya: Yinim Zɛbulɔn zuliya, Maliya suhupiɛlli yi yibu ni. Yinim Isaka zuliya, bɛnya yi suɣa puuni.
en: Be happy, Zebulun, as your boats set sail; be happy, Issachar, in your tents.

dag: Amaa di saha wuntizɔriba ni ti bela bɛ Ba Naawuni nam ni n-ne kaman wuntaŋ la. Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wumma.
en: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in their Fathers kingdom. Those who have ears should hear.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ daba ata dali, Firawuna ni chɛ ka bɛ kana ti yih a nti lan zaŋ a labis a tuma ni; ka a ni lan zaŋdi Firawuna pipia maa ni binnyura maa ti tir o kaman a ni daa pun nyɛ o wain tɔɣira shɛm la.
en: and in three days the king will pardon you. He will make you his personal servant again, and you will serve him his wine, just as you used to do.

dag: Ka din pahi nyɛla, n daa dihirila Yɛhudianim mini zuɣulaannim ninvuɣ kɔbiga ni pihinu m-pahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa yi tinzun tinsi din gili ti ni n-ka ti sanna.
en: I regularly fed at my table a hundred and fifty of the Jewish people and their leaders, besides all the people who came to me from the surrounding nations.

dag: Ka Liya min o bihi kana ti gban o tiŋa, ka Yisifu mini Reechɛl gba doli nyaaŋa na ti gban o tiŋa.
en: Then Leah and her servants also came forward and bowed, and afterward Joseph and Rachel came forward and bowed.

dag: Noombihi shɛb yi ni yɛn chihiri dibu m-bɔŋɔ: Di bi simdi ni yi di ba; bɛ nyɛla yi ni chihiri shɛb dibu. Bɛna n-nyɛ: tɔrili mini juɣu ni zinyaarigu.
en: Of the birds, the following are the ones you must detest—they must not be eaten; they are detestable: the eagle, the black vulture, the bearded vulture.

dag: Yi mi ni di bela Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli zaŋ labi wulinluhili polo Keenannim bɛn be Araba la tiŋgban ni. Tiŋgbani din be Giligal tooni polo m-baɣi Mɔre oki tia la.
en: You know that these two mountains are west of the Jordan River in land now controlled by the Canaanites living in the Jordan River valley. The mountains are west of the road near the sacred trees of Moreh on the other side of Gilgal.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl naa daa bol o kpambal so na ti yɛl o, Cham ti zaŋ Imla bia Mikaya maa na yomyom.
en: So Israels king called an officer and ordered, Bring Micaiah, Imlahs son, right away.

dag: ka zaŋ o yiko niŋ dabitim ni, ka chɛ o jilima ti ti dimnima.
en: He let foreigners capture the Box of the Agreement, the symbol of his power and glory.

dag: Yɛlim din beni, karimi saria ni wuntizɔbo. Zabimi faranim mini nandaamba yɛlimaŋli zuɣu.
en: Be fair and give justice to the poor and homeless.

dag: Di saha maa ka bɛ ni ti nya Daadam Bia ka o be sagbana ni kanna ni yiko pam mini jilima.
en: Then they will see the Human One coming in the clouds with great power and splendor.

dag: Ka Jahaziɛl bia Shɛkania la daa nyɛ Zatu daŋ zuɣulana, ka dɔbba kɔbisita daa pah o zuɣu.
en: of Zattu, Shecaniah, Jahaziels son and with him men.

dag: Niriba bɛn daa ʒi zibisim ni la yipa nya neesim titali; ka bɛn daa ʒi kum zibisim ni be luɣ shɛli polo la gba nya ka neesim maa neei m-paai ba.
en: The people who live in spiritual darkness have seen a great light. The light has shined for those who live in the land that is as dark as a grave. Isaiah :-.

dag: Amaa nir yi zaŋ kurigu ŋme so ka o kpi, o nyɛla ninvuɣ kura, bɛn kum o.
