en: If you use an iron weapon to kill someone, you are a murderer, and you must die.

dag: Doo yi po pɔri Yawɛ sani bee m-po pɔri lo alikauli ni o niŋ shɛli, ŋun miri ka o yi o yɛligu maa nyaaŋa; amaa o niŋm o ni yaag o noli yɛli shɛlikam maa zaa.
en: If a man makes a special promise to the Lord or makes a promise with an oath, he must not break his promise. He must do everything he said he would do.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa lan yɛli Ahaz yaha.
en: Then the Lord spoke to Ahaz again.

dag: n-yɛli, So miri ka o shihi n ninvuɣ gahinda ŋɔ. Di niŋya n daanabinim ŋɔ zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: Don't harm my chosen servants; do not touch my prophets.

dag: Dama bɛn mali niŋgbuŋ zaa ŋuni n-na mi n-wum Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ kukoli ni tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa buɣim sunsuuni kaman ti ni wum shɛm ŋɔ, ka na be o nyɛvili ni?.
en: Has any human being ever lived after hearing the living God speak from a fire?.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Biɛhiŋ kani, saha kanna ka n ni ti pii wuntizɔr so Dauda daŋ ni, ka o ti di nam n-zaŋ yɛm su niriba, ka niŋdi din tuhi, ka tumdi wuntitali tuma tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: Someday I will appoint an honest king from the family of David, a king who will be wise and rule with justice.

dag: Di saha maa ka Jɛrɔbɔam daa ti yi Jɛrusalɛm chana, ka anabi Ahija ŋun daa nyɛ Shilo nir la chirig o sol ni. Anabi Ahija daa yɛla binyɛr palli; ka bɛ niriba ayi maa kɔŋko daa be mɔɣu maa ni chana.
en: At that time, when Jeroboam left Jerusalem, Ahijah the prophet of Shiloh met him along the way. Ahijah was wearing a new garment. The two of them were alone in the country.

dag: Ka Firawuna pipia daa be n nuu ni, ka m pɔhi wain tiwala maa kahim di kom niŋ Firawuna pipia maa ni n-zaŋ li ti ti ŋun Firawuna.
en: I was holding Pharaohs cup, so I took the grapes and squeezed the juice into the cup. Then I gave the cup to Pharaoh.

dag: Puhimiya n churi siɣimsiɣim buta yuuni puuni.
en: Celebrate three festivals each year in my honor.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnim ni bɛ zaŋm pina ti ma. Ŋunkam suhu yu ni o ti pini, nyin deem li ti ma.
en: Tell the Israelites to collect gift offerings for me. Receive my gift offerings from everyone who freely wants to give.

dag: Yi kul lɔrila nia biɛri sahakam, ka jiɣiri zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu zuɣu; ka niŋdi yomyom chani ti kuri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali. Yi yi kul gari luɣ shɛlikam, yi saɣindimi bahi.
en: Your feet run toward evil. You are always ready to kill innocent people. You think of nothing but evil. Everywhere you go you cause trouble and ruin.

dag: Bɛ suhuri daa bi ʒe yim zaŋ chaŋ o sani; ka bɛ mi daa bi dol o ni lo ba alikauli shɛl la soli.
en: Their hearts were not really with him. They were not faithful to the agreement he gave them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba sani ti yɛli ba, Ti pola pɔri ni shee ti ku Pool, di yi pa lala ti ku di shɛli.
en: Then some of them went to the chief priests and the nation's leaders and said, We have promised God that we would not eat a thing until we have killed Paul.

dag: Yisa ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai, o daa kpuɣila o zuɣu lihi zuɣusaa ka gbaai Naawuni suhibu yɛra, M Ba, saha yipa paaya ni a chɛ ka a Bia nya jilima, ka a Bia maa gba chɛ ka a nya jilima.
en: After Jesus said these things, he looked toward heaven and prayed, Father, the time has come. Give glory to your Son so that the Son can give glory to you.

dag: Ti ni be dunia ŋɔ ni Tanti yili ŋɔ ni maa, ti kul ŋuhirimi ni suhubɔhibo; ka di pala ti bɔrimi ni ti yee li sɔŋ, amaa ti bɔri ni ti yɛla alizanda ni din la pa di zuɣu, ka di chɛ ka nyɛvili tooi vali din kpira.
en: These tents we now live in are like a heavy burden, and we groan. But we don't do this just because we want to leave these bodies that will die. It is because we want to change them for bodies that will never die.

dag: Maligumaaniba maa ni daa yi Luɣ Kasi shee maa na, ka sagbani sirigina nti pali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa.
en: As the priests were leaving the Temple, it was suddenly filled with a cloud.

dag: Hal bɛ yi kari ya tahi dunia ŋɔ ni luɣilikam, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni laɣim ya nimaani n-zaŋ ya nimaani labisina.
en: Even if you are scattered to the farthest corners of the earth, the Lord your God will gather you together and bring you back.

dag: Ka o sara maligu maa yi nyɛla piɛɣu bee bua, di simdi ka di nyɛla piɛlaa bee bulaa ŋun ka daŋa.
en: If you offer a sheep or a goat as a burnt offering, it must be a male that has nothing wrong with it.

dag: Ka Jɔnatan yɛli Sool, Dauda suhi ma la soli ni o chaŋ Bɛtilihɛm.
en: Jonathan answered, David asked me to let him go to Bethlehem.

dag: Ka Samsin yɛl o, Bɛ yi zaŋ mi pal shɛŋa bɛ ni na bi zaŋ lo binshɛli lo ma, n ni gbarigi, ka be kaman sokam ni be shɛm.
en: Samson answered, Use some new ropes. If I'm tied up with ropes that have never been used, I'll be just as weak as anyone else.

dag: Ka salo maa ni yino yɛl o, Karimba, alizin birigu n-ʒi m bia zuɣu, ka n zaŋ o tah a sanna.
en: Someone from the crowd responded, Teacher, I brought my son to you, since he has a spirit that doesnt allow him to speak.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yi nimaani chaŋ Gujɔda n-daa ti yi nimaani chaŋ Jɔtibata tiŋgbɔn shɛli din kulibɔna mali kom la.
en: Next, we camped at Gudgodah and then at Jotbathah, where there are flowing streams.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa lan zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapaɣa niŋ Naawuni biɛhigu shee suɣili maa.
en: They made upright frames of acacia wood for the Tent.

dag: Bɛ ni lo barina tumbu nia shɛli ŋmaligiri lurila bɛ zuɣu, ka bɛ duŋtaabo ŋmaligiri luri bɛ zuɣu.
en: The trouble they cause will come back on them. They plan harm for others, but they are the ones who will be hurt.

dag: Tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ti sɔɣi ba din ni chɛ ka bɛ nya jilima dahin shɛli n ni ti yɛn wuhi ba n jilima ni nyɛ shɛm maa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: All the people of the land will take part in the burial, so they will make a name for themselves on the day that I glorify myself. This is what the LORD God says.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka Sisɛra min o chɛchɛbunsi ni o tɔbbihi zaa birim Barak tooni, ka Barak daa zaŋ takɔbi ku ba. Ka Sisɛra daa sheeg o chɛchɛbuŋ zuɣu na guui.
en: When Barak attacked with his army, the Lord threw Sisera into confusion together with all his chariots and men. Sisera got down from his chariot and fled on foot.

dag: Yɛlim a mabia ŋun nyɛ doo la, N niriba. Ka yɛl a tizɔpaɣa, O nya nambɔzɔbo.
en: Then you will say to your brothers, You are my people, and you will say to your sisters, He has shown mercy to you.

dag: A nyiŋgoli ŋmanila wɔbinyina ka bɛ zaŋ me pii zali. A nina ŋmanila Hɛshibɔn kom din do m-miri Batirabim dunol la. A nyee ŋmanila Lɛbanɔn pia din be Damaskus polo la.
en: your neck, like a tower of ivory; your eyes, pools in Heshbon, by the gate of that lordly city. Your profile is like the tower of Lebanon, looking out toward Damascus.

dag: Ka yinim bihi banima, di yihiri ya yi bihi hal biɛɣu hal ka di ti chɛ ka bɛ suhuri miligi, amaa zaŋmiyala saɣisigu din nyɛ ti Duuma dini wumsiri ba.
en: As for parents, dont provoke your children to anger, but raise them with discipline and instruction about the Lord.

dag: Ŋun be tibi n-lihiri nyari din be ninvuɣ biɛri yinsi; ŋuna n-chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri lura m-bahiri yoli.
en: The righteous one observes the house of the wicked, turning the wicked toward trouble.

dag: N-kaai biɛɣu ka bɛ paai Siizaria, ka Kɔniilius pun laɣim o dɔɣiriba min o zo suma na ka bɛ ti ʒiya guli ba.
en: The following day he arrived in Caesarea, where Cornelius was waiting for him, together with relatives and close friends that he had invited.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli, Lala zuɣu ka m pun yɛli ya ni so ku tooi ka n sanna ka pa ni m Ba n-niŋ o di yiko.
en: Then Jesus said, You cannot come to me, unless the Father makes you want to come. That is why I have told these things to all of you.

dag: dama nyɛvili samli galisiya pam, ka so ku tooi nya liɣiri din ni saɣi di zuɣu yɔbu;.
en: It costs far too much to buy back your life. You can never pay God enough.

dag: Yinim bɛn bari bun piɛla ka ʒi bunnyaampar gahinda zuɣu mini yinim bɛn doli soya, yɛlimiya di yɛla.
en: Tell of it, you that ride on white donkeys, sitting on saddles, and you that must walk wherever you go.

dag: Chɛ ka di kul be nyin Yawɛ tooni sahakam, ka chɛ ka so ku lan teeg o yɛla dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: May the Lord remember their sins forever, and may he cause people to forget his family completely.

dag: Ka yi ni zaŋ yi bimbɔba maa na ti mali gahibu sara vuhim dabisi shɛli dali maa neei biɛɣu, yin kalimiya dabisa hal ti paai bakɔi ayopɔin dɛde.
en: Count seven full weeks from the day after the Sabbath on which you bring your sheaf of grain to present to the Lord .

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ lan yɛli yaha, N ni yihi n niriba bɛn be tiŋgban shɛŋa din be wulimpuhili mini wulinluhili polo la.
en: I will save those who were taken to lands in the east and the west.

dag: Yinim zoya mini dunia ŋɔ tanza kurisi la, wummiya Yawɛ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, dama Yawɛ min o niriba mali yɛtɔɣa; o mini Izraɛlnima m-mali yɛtɔɣa.
en: You mountains, you everlasting foundations of the earth, listen to the Lord 's case! The Lord has a case against his people. He is going to bring an accusation against Israel.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋdi nirilim zaŋdi bɛ binyara paŋdi niriba mali alibarika. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli yɛlimaŋli soli tumdi bɛ tuma mali alibarika.
en: It is good for people to be kind and generous and to be fair in business.

dag: Tiligim ma ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ tuumbiɛtumdiba nuu ni, ka fa ma ninvuɣ kuriba nuu ni bahi.
en: Save me from those evil people; rescue me from those murderers!.

dag: Ka jɛra la daa yɛli bɛn nyɛ yɛnnim la, Niŋmiya yi kpam ŋɔ shɛli ti ti, dama tinim firilanim maa kpirimi.
en: But the foolish bridesmaids said to the wise ones, Give us some of your oil, because our lamps have gone out.

dag: Amaa dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yoli, ka bɛ daa na kul tumd alahichi; o daalahiziba tuma la zaa yoli, bɛ daa bi niŋ o yɛda.
en: In spite of all this the people kept sinning; in spite of his miracles they did not trust him.

dag: Teeku puuni zahim mini noonsi bɛn be zuɣusaa ŋɔ ni biŋkɔbiri bɛn be mɔɣu ni ŋɔ ni biŋgbamda ni ninsalinim zaa bɛn be dunia ni niŋgbuna ni ti sɔhigi n tooni, ka zoya ti wurim ka tampima luna, ka gooni kam lu.
en: Every living thing on earth will tremble in fear of me—every fish and bird, every wild animal and reptile, and every human. Mountains will crumble, cliffs will fall, and cities will collapse.

dag: N suhiri Naawuni ni o tin ya yiko o Shia Kasi zuɣu, ka o kpaŋsi yi suhuri o jilima azichitali puuni.
en: I ask the Father with his great glory to give you the power to be strong in your spirits. He will give you that strength through his Spirit.

dag: Ka yil yidan maa yiŋbihi daa kana ti bɔh o, Ti dana, pa alikama suma ka a daa biri a puu la ni? Ka di chaŋ wula ka piriŋkpana ti be di ni.
en: The man's servants came to him and said, Sir, it was good seed you sowed in your field; where did the weeds come from.

dag: Dum Pisiga Zoli zuɣu nti kpuɣ a zuɣu lihi bahi wulinluhili polo mini nuzaa polo ni nudirigu polo ni wulimpuhili polo, lihim li viɛnyɛliŋga, dama a ku du Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ.
en: Go up to the top of Mount Pisgah. Look to the west, to the north, to the south, and to the east. You may see these things with your eyes, but you can never go across the Jordan River.

dag: Ti ni daa tum alahichi shɛli Pɛɔr ka alɔbo lu ti zuɣu, ka ti na kul diri di wahala la bi galisi nyaŋ ti?.
en: Wasn't our people's sin at Peor terrible enough for you? The Lord punished us by sending a horrible sickness that killed many of us, and we still suffer because of that sin.

dag: Di saha maa ka Samsin daa nya buŋ yɛno kɔbili kpuɣ li n-zaŋ li ku ninvuɣ tuhili.
en: Then he found a jawbone of a donkey that had recently died. He reached down and picked it up, and killed a thousand men with it.

dag: Di dunoya pinaayi la daa nyɛla waya pinaayi, waya zaɣ yiniyini ka bɛ daa zaŋ mali dunoli kam, ka tiŋ maa puuni solɔɣu nyɛ salima din nyɛ alali n-doya ne kaman takɔriti diɣisi la.
en: Each of the twelve gates was a solid pearl. The streets of the city were made of pure gold, clear as crystal.

dag: Musa daa nyɛla tarima n-gari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Now the man Moses was humble, more so than anyone on earth.

dag: Amaa dalinli maa yi piɛl o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ maa zuɣu, ka bi kpe o niŋgbuŋ puuni, ka kɔbiri din be dalinli maa ni bi paligi, maligumaana maa ŋun zaŋmi dɔro maa lana niŋ duu daba ayopɔin.
en: Sometimes there is a white spot on a persons skin that does not seem deeper than the skin. If that is true, the priest must separate that person from other people for seven days.

dag: Zaŋmi salima alali mali firilatamdigu, ka zaŋ matarika kuri firilatamdigu maa ni yɛn tamdi binshɛli zuɣu mini di mundili, ka di mini di lahi ni bintira kɔtomsi mini tipum kɔtomsi zaa din be di ni ti nyɛ zaɣ yini.
en: Make a lampstand of pure gold. Make its base and its shaft of hammered gold; its decorative flowers, including buds and petals, are to form one piece with it.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pii ninvuɣ tuhilituhili Izraɛl zuliya kam ni, ka bɛ kalinli yiɣisi tɔbbihi tuhi pinaayi n-lo kpara ni bɛ chaŋ tɔb maa ni.
en: From the thousands of Israel, one thousand from each tribe were selected. Twelve thousand were equipped for battle.

dag: ka ŋma ʒiri pa o pumpɔŋɔ yɛra, N daa bi nya paɣipalitali shihirili yi bia maa sani. Amaa n-nyɛ m bipuɣiŋga maa paɣipalitali shihira. Di saha ka bɛ zaŋ tani yɛrigi sɔŋ tiŋ maa kpamba maa tooni.
en: and accusing her of not being a virgin. But he is wrong, because here is proof that she was a virgin! Then the bride's parents will show them the bed sheet from the woman's wedding night.

dag: Miriya ka yi zaŋ dabindi gari chi bee kawana sara ti Yawɛ, dama di bi simdi ni yi zaŋ dabindi bee shiri nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ.
en: No grain offering that you give to the LORD can be made with yeast. You must not completely burn any yeast or honey as a food gift for the LORD.

dag: Bɛn daa kari doli ti maa daa guuri gari tɔrili ni yiɣiri zuɣusaa shɛm la. Bɛ daa kari doli ti la zoya zuɣu, bɛ daa gu ti la soli mɔɣu ni.
en: Our hunters were faster than airborne eagles. They chased us up the mountains; they ambushed us in the wilderness.

dag: Ibram ni daa nyaŋ Chɛdolaoma mini na shɛb bɛn be o sani ka labirina saha shɛli, ka Sɔdom naa daa chaŋ ti tuh o soli Shave vinvamli ni bɛ ni daa booni luɣ shɛli Naa Vinvamli la.
en: After Abram returned from his attack on Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him, the king of Sodom came out to the Shaveh Valley to meet him.

dag: N ni pirig o ka chɛ o o zaɣim o mamanim maa ninni, ka so ti ku tooi fa o n nuu ni bahi.
en: Now I will uncover her nakedness in plain view of her lovers, and no one will rescue her from me.

dag: Bɛ ni daa tumdi buɣijɛmbo tuma niriba maa sani, ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim birigi n-tum alahichi la zuɣu. Dinzuɣu m poya zaŋ chaŋ bɛ polo ni bɛ ni nya tibidarigibo. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But because they conducted the worship of idols for the people of Israel and in this way led the people into sin, I, the Sovereign Lord , solemnly swear that they must be punished.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ Pita mini Jɔn bahi maa ka bɛ chaŋ bɛ nyaandolitab sani nti yɛli ba maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba maa ni yɛli ba shɛm zaa.
en: As soon as Peter and John had been set free, they went back and told the others everything the chief priests and the leaders had said to them.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yi yi yɛn suhi Naawuni, yin yɛlimiya ŋ-ŋɔ: Ti Ba Naawuni, chɛ ka a yuli du, ka chɛ ka a nam kana.
en: So Jesus told them, Pray in this way: Father, help us to honor your name. Come and set up your kingdom.

dag: Ti Duuma lan yɛli: Dinzuɣu yimiya buɣa ni na n-woligi yi ko ka chɛ ba; ka di niŋya din ni ta nir daɣiri, ka n deei ya.
en: So come away from those people and separate yourselves from them, says the Lord. Dont touch anything that is not clean, and I will accept you. Isaiah :.

dag: dindina maligumaana maa ŋun chɛ ka bɛ paɣi dɔro ni be binshɛl ni maa, ka o lan kpari li niŋ duu daba ayopɔin yaha.
en: he shall order that it be washed and put away for another seven days.

dag: Amaa ka man ti tuui, ka bɛn laɣimmi mali suhupiɛlli di zuɣu; ka lan laɣim lu n zuɣu. Ka ninvuɣ yoya pahi m-maani ma ansarisi ka bi chɛra.
en: But when I had troubles, they laughed at me. They were not really friends. I was surrounded and attacked by people I didnt even know.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima: Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Tell the Israelites: I am the Lord your God.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka a bi chɛ n taali ka kpihim n daalahichi maa? Dama pumpɔŋɔ n yɛn dɔnila tiŋgban ni. A ni ti lihi bo ma, amaa ka n ku beni.
en: Why dont you just pardon me for doing wrong? Why dont you just forgive me for my sins? Soon I will die and be in my grave. You will search for me, but I will be gone.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli naa, Naawuni dolim a nyɛvili! Wula ka n yaannim gbala ni do tin shɛl ni lu n-dahim, ka buɣim di di dunɔdaya, ka n ku lihiri suhugarigu lihigu.
en: and replied, May the king live forever! Why shouldnt I seem sad when the city, the place of my familys graves, is in ruins and its gates destroyed by fire.

dag: Amaa ka Jɔshua yɛli ba, Yi ku tooi jɛm Yawɛ dama o nyɛla Naawuni ŋun be kasi; ka nyɛ ŋun zabiri nyuli; ka ku chɛ yi tuumbiɛri bee yi daalahichi.
en: Then Joshua said, You will not be able to continue serving the Lord . God is holy. And God hates his people worshiping other gods. He will not forgive you if you turn against him like that.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa chaŋ Samuɛl sani tiŋ maa gooni dunol ni nti yɛl o, Wuhim ma ŋun nyari niriba yɛla la yiŋa.
en: Then Saul went over to Samuel, who was near the gate, and asked, Tell me, where does the seer live.

dag: Amaa nir yi di wahala la o ni nyɛ Kristiɛn zuɣu, ŋun di chɛ ka vi mal o, amaa ŋun naɣ paɣimila Naawuni bɛ ni zaŋ Masia yuli pa o yupaa la zuɣu.
en: Don't be ashamed to suffer for being a Christian. Praise God that you belong to him.

dag: Dama binshɛɣukam yirila o sanna; ka binshɛɣukam bela o zuɣu; ka binshɛɣukam zaa nyɛla o ni su shɛli. Ŋuna n-simdi paɣibu hal ni saha din ka bahigu! Ami!.
en: Everything comes from the Lord. All things were made because of him and will return to him. Praise the Lord forever! Amen.

dag: N yilikpɛrilaannima, n nya ka sarati ni paai ti ti chandi ŋɔ ni, ka di pala neen shɛŋa din be ŋariŋ ŋɔ ni bee ŋariŋ maa maŋmaŋ kɔŋko m-be barina ni, amaa timaŋmaŋ gba nyɛviya be barina ni.
en: Then Paul spoke to the crew of the ship, Men, listen to me! If we sail now, our ship and its cargo will be badly damaged, and many lives will be lost.

dag: Ka Sool daa yɛli Kɛnnima, Yimiya chaŋ ka chɛ Amalɛknim ŋɔ, di so ni n ti ku ba tabili ya; dama yi daa niŋ Izraɛlnim zaa nirilim pam saha shɛli bɛ ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la. Di saha ka Kɛnnim maa daa yi ka chɛ Amalɛknim maa.
en: He said to the Kenites, Go away! Leave the Amalekites. Then I wont destroy you with the Amalekites. You showed kindness to the Israelites when they came out of Egypt. So the Kenites left the Amalekites.

dag: Ɛhab daa lan mɛla buɣili Ashɛra gba binnani zali. O daa tum din ni yiɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Duuma Naawuni ŋɔ suhu n-gari Izraɛl na shɛb bɛn zaa daa daŋ o tooni la.
en: Ahab also made a sacred pole and did more to anger the LORD, the God of Israel, than any of Israels kings who preceded him.

dag: Yɛtɔɣ viɛla ŋmanila shigbaŋ, di nyaɣisi niriba sani ka nyɛ din tiri niŋgbuŋ alaafee.
en: Kind words are like honey—sweet to the taste and good for your health.

dag: Doli n ni zal a shɛm, ka be. Gbibi n ni wuhir a shɛli kaman a nimbil biɛlim la.
en: Do what I say, and you will live. Be as careful to follow my teaching as you are to protect your eyes.

dag: ka Zɛfania nyɛ Tahat bia, ka Tahat nyɛ Asir bia, ka Asir nyɛ Ɛbiasaf bia, ka Ɛbiasaf nyɛ Kɔra bia.
en: Tahath, Assir, Ebiasaph, Korah.

dag: Kaman ninvuɣ fariba ni sɔɣi doya guli so shɛm, lala ka bɛ maligumaaniba gba laɣim doya. Bɛ kula niriba sol ni hal ni Shɛkɛm. Yɛlimaŋli bɛ tum ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma.
en: As robbers lie in wait for someone, so the priests are in league with each other; they murder on the road to Shechem; they have done evil things.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab daa kpe nayili maa nti yɛli naa, Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, a dihi a tɔbbihi bɛn zaa tilig a nyɛvili ka tilig a bidibisi min a bipuɣinsi ni a paɣiba ni a mamanim zaa nyɛviya ŋɔ vi.
en: Joab went to the king's house and said to him, Today you have humiliated your men—the men who saved your life and the lives of your sons and daughters and of your wives and concubines.

dag: Di zɔnya yi dimnim dabiɛm! Kul maliya suhukpeeni ka di kahigi wuhi ba ni bɛ ni ti bahi yoli, amaa ka yinim ti tiligi, dama Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun tiri ti nasara.
en: Don't be afraid of your enemies; always be courageous, and this will prove to them that they will lose and that you will win, because it is God who gives you the victory.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa di tiŋ maa ni nɛma, ka gbahi niɣi pahi kaman Yawɛ ni daa pun yɛli Jɔshua shɛm.
en: However, Israel did take the cattle and other booty of that city as plunder for themselves, in agreement with the command that the LORD had given Joshua.

dag: M mabihi, suhimiya sɔŋ yi ma, dama o lan pala m paɣa, m mi lan pala o yidana. Suhimiya ka o yihi pagɔrisigu o kɔbili ni ka yihi zina niŋbu o suhu ni.
en: Accuse! Accuse your mother! She is no longer my wife, and now I, the Lord , am not her husband. Beg her to give up prostitution and stop being unfaithful.

dag: Ka Ayuba daa lan gbaag o yɛtɔɣa yɛli.
en: Job said:.

dag: Dama o ni na pɔri maa zuɣu ninvuɣ shɛba n-ni yuun o, ka maan o yɛla tir o hal ti paag o ba ni zali dabisi shɛli dali.
en: While he is young, there are men who take care of him and manage his affairs until the time set by his father.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ pin shɛŋa zaa tin ya, yihimiya Yawɛ dini ni nyɛ shɛli zaa di puuni. Din nyɛ din viɛli gari di zaa ka yi yɛn zaŋ ti o.
en: so the best of what you receive will be mine.

dag: Lala ka o daa niŋdi hal ti paai yuma ayi, ka Yɛhudianim zaŋ tabili bɛn pa Yɛhudianim ka be Ɛsha daa wum ti Duuma yɛligu maa.
en: This went on for two years, so that everyone living in the province of Asia—both Jews and Greeks—heard the Lords word.

dag: O ŋmanila gbuɣinli n-yiɣisi o sɔɣisili shee, dama bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa leei dabari tɔb biɛ shɛli din lu di ni la min o suhuyiɣisili pam la zuɣu.
en: He is like an angry lion that has left his cave. And because of his terrible anger and by the attacks of the enemy army, their land will become an empty desert.

dag: Nyama, n yɛn zaŋla piɛ gbaŋ sɔŋ kabɔɣili ni, maligim yi lula piɛ gbaŋ maa kɔŋko zuɣu, ka bi lu m-mahigi tiŋgbani gil li, dindina m baŋya ni a shiri ni chɛ ka n fa Izraɛlnim bahi kaman a ni yɛli shɛm.
en: Well, I am putting some wool on the ground where we thresh the wheat. If in the morning there is dew only on the wool but not on the ground, then I will know that you are going to use me to rescue Israel.

dag: Ka n daa chaŋ malaika maa sani nti yɛl o ni o zaŋm litaafi bila maa ti ma. Ka o yɛli ma, Zaŋm li ŋubi; di ni malis a nol ni kaman shir la, amaa ka lee to a puuni.
en: So I went to the angel and told him to give me the scroll. He said to me, Take it and eat it. It will make you sick to your stomach, but sweet as honey in your mouth.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n yɛli ya zuŋɔ, amaa yi bi deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni tim ma na ni n ti yɛli ya shɛlikam zaa maa ni shɛli.
en: because now that I have given you the Lord 's answer, you refuse to obey him.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛɣu yili ni wurim, amaa ninvuɣ suŋ ŋun suɣili kul ni ʒiɛya.
en: A good person's house will still be standing after an evildoer's house has been destroyed.

dag: Bɛ ni ti lo tɔbu tuh a, amaa bɛ ti ku tooi nyaŋ a. Dama m be a sani ni n fa a bahi. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: All those people will fight against you, but they will not defeat you, because I am with you, and I will save you. This message is from the Lord .

dag: Dinzuɣu Yisifu ni daa mali ti paag o biɛyanim maa sani, bɛ daa darigimi fuɣ o binyɛr shɛli o ni daa ye ka di nyɛ zaɣ wɔɣinli ka mali bɔɣ wɔɣila la;.
en: When Joseph came to his brothers, they pulled off his fancy coat.

dag: Yawɛ viɛla, ka nyɛ bɛ ni sɔɣiri so sani muɣisigu saha; o guli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn sɔɣir o sani.
en: The Lord is good. He protects those who trust him in times of trouble.

dag: Aduna ku paai n ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli ti Izraɛlnim maa ni, o ni kpi, yi ni daa zaɣisi n zaligu Mɛriba kom la yɛla ni la zuɣu.
en: Aaron, this is where you will die. You and Moses disobeyed me at Meribah, and so you will not enter the land I promised the Israelites.

dag: Jarɛd ni daa ti paai yuun kɔbiga ni pihiyɔbunaayi saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Inok.
en: After Jared was years old, he had a son named Enoch.

dag: yin tooi ŋub bɛna, sakɔnooŋa min o balibu zaa ni sakɔnooŋa ŋun ka paɣiri min o balibu zaa ni paaŋa min o balibu zaa ni sakɔɣu min o balibu zaa.
en: Of these you can eat the following: any kind of migrating locust, any kind of bald locust, any kind of cricket, and any kind of grasshopper.

dag: Man Pool n-nyɛ ninvuɣ so shɛb ni yɛli ni n siɣisiri mmaŋa n yi ti be yi sani, amaa ka lee ti ka yi sani ka wuhiri dɔbilim la. N suhiri ya Masia tarimtali min o baalimtali puuni.
en: I, Paul, make a personal request to you with the gentleness and kindness of Christ. Im shy when Im with you, but Im bossy when Im away from you!.

dag: Ti nyari wahala binshɛɣukam zaa ni, amaa ti bi ŋma n-chɛrisichɛrisi; ti birinda, amaa ti suhuri bi saɣinda;.
en: We are often troubled, but not crushed; sometimes in doubt, but never in despair;.

dag: Yi dim nahu bee o buŋ yi chihi chani ka yi nya o, yin taɣim o labisi ti ti o.
en: When you happen to come upon your enemys ox or donkey that has wandered off, you should bring it back to them.

dag: Yiɣisim zani, dama daliri ŋɔ zuɣu ka n yi a zuɣu ni n zal a ka a leei n tumo, ka niŋ a ni nya ma ni shɛlikam ŋɔ mini n ni na yɛn wuh a shɛli shɛhiralana.
en: Stand up! I have chosen you to be my servant. You will tell people about me—what you have seen today and what I will show you. This is why I have come to you.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛlnim daa yɛli Musa, Ti kpe yɔɣu, ti zaa ni kpi.
en: The Israelites cried out to Moses, We're done for.

dag: O daa bɔh o bipalitab maa mi, Yi lee tɛhiya ni wula ka di simdi ni ti yɛli niriba bɛn yɛli ma, Filimmi ʒi tibisi shɛl a ba ni daa ʒil ti la? .
en: Rehoboam asked them, The people said, Give us easier work than your father gave us. How do you think I should answer them? What should I tell them.

dag: Bɛ ni ti nyɛla Naawuni jɛmbu duu tumtumdiba, ka guli Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa dunɔdaya. Bɛ ni ti kɔriti bɛ ni zaŋdi biŋkɔb shɛb nyɔri buɣim maani sara la mini niriba ni zaŋdi biŋkɔb shɛb na ni bɛ ti mali sara la. Bɛ ni ti tumdi tuma tiri niriba maa.
en: They will still be allowed to serve me as temple workers by guarding the gates and by killing the animals to be sacrificed and by helping the worshipers.

dag: Di saha ka Nɛbukadnɛza suhu daa yiɣisi pam ka o je suli, ka o ninni biɛhigu taɣi zaŋ chaŋ Shadirak mini Mɛshak ni Abɛdnɛgo polo, ka yɛl o niriba ni bɛ malim buɣim maa n-chɛ ka di bii ʒii buyopɔin zuɣu n-gari di ni yi pun biiri shɛm.
en: Then Nebuchadnezzar became very angry with Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego. He gave an order for the oven to be heated seven times hotter than it usually was.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ tan shɛli din guui, ka nyɛ tani maa pirigili la n-yili m biɛhigu shee maa nyaaŋa polo.
en: Hang the extra half piece over the back of the Tent.

dag: N-daa lan yi biɛɣu yaha ka Yisa yɛn chaŋ Galili; ka daa ti nya Filip yɛl o, Doli ma.
en: The next day Jesus decided to go to Galilee. He found Philip and said to him, Come with me! .

dag: Dinzuɣu zaŋmiya yimaŋ ti Naawuni. Zaɣisimiya Sintani, ka o zo ka chɛn ya.
en: So give yourselves to God. Stand against the devil, and he will run away from you.

dag: Dindali maa tɔbbihi bɛn mali suhukpeeni ni ti zaŋ bɛ bidibbina bahi ka zo ni nuzaŋa. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: You may be brave and strong, but you will run away, stripped naked. I, the Lord , have spoken!.

dag: Ka lan bɔh o pahi buta yaha, Saimɔn Jɔn bia, a yuri ma? Ka Pita suhu saɣim o ni bɔh o m-pahi buta ni o yur o maa zuɣu, ka yɛl o, N Duuma, a mi binshɛɣukam zaa; a mi ni n yur a. Ka Yisa yɛl o, Dihimi m piɛri.
en: A third time Jesus said, Simon son of John, do you love me? Peter became sad because Jesus asked him the third time, Do you love me? and so he said to him, Lord, you know everything; you know that I love you! Jesus said to him, Take care of my sheep.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ ni daa laɣimna ka Gomna Pailɛt bɔhi ba, Ŋuni ka yi lee bɔri ni n yihi bahi? Barabas bee Yisa so bɛ ni booni Masia la.
en: When a crowd gathered, Pilate said to them, I will free one man for you. Which one do you want me to free: Barabbas or Jesus who is called the Messiah.

dag: Lihim pakoya bɛn nyɛ pako maŋa la.
en: Take care of widows who really need help.

dag: Yawɛ zal o ni yɛn siɣisi karimbaannim zaa mini ninʒeensinim ni bɛnkam zaa duhi bɛmaŋa dahin shɛli.
en: On that day the Lord Almighty will humble everyone who is powerful, everyone who is proud and conceited.

dag: N daa da daba bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba, ka bɛ daa dɔɣi daba n yiŋ puuni. Ka n daa lan mali niɣi mini piɛri ni buhi gari ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa daŋ n tooni be Jɛrusalɛm.
en: I owned slaves, and their sons and daughters became my slaves. I had more sheep and goats than anyone who had ever lived in Jerusalem.

dag: Hilikia ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛnjamin tiŋgban ni tin shɛli din yuli booni Anatɔt la maligumaaniba ni yino la bia Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ.
en: My name is Jeremiah. I am a priest, and my father Hilkiah and everyone else in my family are from Anathoth in the territory of the Benjamin tribe. This book contains the things that the Lord told me to say.

dag: Di saha ka Bɛlishaaza daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ ago kparibu na ti yɛli Daniɛl, ka bo salima dolibi din mali jilima na ti yɛl o pahi, ka chɛ ka o leei naa ŋun pah ata o nam sulinsi maa ni.
en: Then Belshazzar commanded that Daniel be dressed in a purple robe, have a gold chain around his neck, and be officially appointed as third in command in the kingdom.

dag: A mi yuli ku lan booni Ibram, amaa a yuli ni boonila Ibrahimma; dama n zaŋ a leela zuliya pam yaba.
en: And because I have made you the ancestor of many nations, your name will no longer be Abram but Abraham.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn suhuri kul ye ni bɛ niŋ bundaannim zaŋ bɛmaŋ kpɛhi zahimbu ni ka jɛritali mini barina kɔre zana din saɣindi daadamnim ka bahiri ba yoli zaa kahikahi la gbahi ba.
en: But those who want to get rich fall into temptation and are caught in the trap of many foolish and harmful desires, which pull them down to ruin and destruction.

dag: Amaa alahichinim bɛn ni ti bahi yoli zaa, ka ninvuɣ biɛri zuliya ti bahi yoli.
en: but sinners are completely destroyed, and their descendants are wiped out.

dag: Naa ŋun yuli booni Yawɛ, ka o nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya, Ŋun yɛn wurim Mɔabnim fɔntinsi ka ku bɛ nachimbihi viɛla la kana.
en: Moab is doomed; its towns will surrender; its elite forces will go down in defeat, declares the king whose name is the LORD of heavenly forces.

dag: O bɔɣiri nyɛla salima, ka yɛri din viɛli dolibi pir o bɔɣiri maa. O niŋgbuna nyɛlisirimi kaman wɔbinyina mini safaya kuɣa la.
en: His arms are branches of gold covered with jewels; his body is ivory decorated with sapphires.

dag: Di saha ka Zɛbul bɔh o, Ka a noli buɣibuɣi la lee be ya pumpɔŋɔ? Pa nyini n-daa yɛli ni Abimilɛk mi lee nyɛ ŋuni ka ti jɛmd o la? Pa bɛna ka a daa ʒiɛm la? To, pumpɔŋɔ cham ka a mini ba ti tuhi.
en: Then Zebul replied, What good is all of your bragging now? You were the one who said Abimelech shouldn't be the ruler of Shechem. Out there is the army that you made fun of. So go out and fight them.

dag: Maligumaaniba kpamba mini Farisiinim daa pun bahi noli ni so yi mi Yisa ni be shɛli, ŋun nyihim ba ka bɛ chaŋ ti gbaag o.
en: The chief priests and the Pharisees told the people to let them know if any of them saw Jesus. This is how they hoped to arrest him.

dag: n ni daa mali bihim paɣiri n naba, ka doori kpam tampima zuɣu la.
en: My herds gave enough milk to bathe my feet, and from my olive harvest flowed rivers of oil. *.

dag: Ka Dauda daa lan yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun daa fa ma gbuɣinli nyinyɛhi ni bahi ka lan fa ma kunduŋ nyinyɛhi ni bahi ŋɔ ni lan fa ma Filistia doo ŋɔ gba nuu ni bahi. Ka Sool daa yɛli Dauda, Chama, Yawɛ be a sani.
en: The Lord has saved me from lions and bears; he will save me from this Philistine. All right, Saul answered. Go, and the Lord be with you.

dag: N daa kul darigila yi niriba ŋɔ tibili yoli; bɛ daa bi deei saɣisigu. Yimaŋmaŋ takɔbiri ka yi daa zaŋ ku yi daanabinima kaman gbuɣinli ŋun kuri niriba.
en: I punished you people of Judah, but it did not help. You did not come back when you were punished. With your swords you killed the prophets who came to you. Like a dangerous lion, you killed the prophets.

dag: Ka o ti zaŋ ba ka Yawɛ sanna Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili dunol la ni nti ti maligumaana, ka o yih o daɣiri ni dabisi shɛli din pahiri daba anii dali.
en: The priest will offer these to me in front of the sacred tent on the eighth day.

dag: M mi ni Naawuni ni tum shɛlikam kul ni beni sahakam. So ku tooi zaŋ shɛli pahi di ni bee n-yihi shɛli di ni. Naawuni n-tum lala ni di chɛ ka sokam zaa zo o.
en: I know that everything God does will last forever. You can't add anything to it or take anything away from it. And one thing God does is to make us stand in awe of him.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli niriba maa, Yawɛ ni zali ni ti niŋ shɛm m-bala.
en: he said to them, What I am now about to do is what the Lord has commanded.

dag: Nyama, yi yi lo noli yi ŋmɛrila tab naŋgbankpeeni ka zabiri buri taba buri biɛɣu. Yi ni lɔri noli maa shɛm pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ ku chɛ ka Naawuni deei yi suhigu.
en: Your fasting makes you violent, and you quarrel and fight. Do you think this kind of fasting will make me listen to your prayers?.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa nyaandoliba piniyini la daa chaŋ Galili zo shɛli zuɣu Yisa ni daa wuhi ba la.
en: Jesus' eleven disciples went to a mountain in Galilee, where Jesus had told them to meet him.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n ni zaani ya zaligu shɛŋa zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ pala din kpɛm pam yi sani bee din be katiŋ ha.
en: You know God's laws, and it isn't impossible to obey them.

dag: Amaa di nyaaŋa, yuma ayopɔin din yɛn dolina puuni, kum ni ti lu, ka so ti ku mi ni bindira daa niŋya pam Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, kum maa ni ti dam tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ nim pam.
en: After that, there will be seven years of famine, and all the good years will be forgotten, because the famine will ruin the country.

dag: Ka niriba daa jɛmdi waɣ biɛ titali maa, o ni daa zaŋ fukumsi din nyɛ omaŋmaŋ dini n-niŋ biŋkɔbigu la nuu ni zuɣu, ka bɛ daa jɛmdi biŋkɔbigu maa n-yɛra, Ŋuni n-lee ŋmani biŋkɔbigu ŋɔ bee ŋuni n-lee ni tooi tuh o tɔbu.
en: They worshipped the dragon because it had given the beast its authority. They worshipped the beast and said, Who is like the beast, and who can fight against it.

dag: dindina o mabia maa paɣa maa ŋun cham o sani kpamba maa ninni nti pirigi doo maa namdili o napɔŋ ni, ka tuhi nintɔri vie o ninni ka yɛli, Lala ka bɛ niŋdi ninvuɣ so ŋun je ni o me o mabia yili.
en: she must go over to him while the town leaders watch. She will pull off one of his sandals and spit in his face, while saying, That's what happens to a man who won't help provide descendants for his dead brother.

dag: Ka di chaŋ wula ka ti ti wumdi ka bɛ tɔɣisirila ti zaa yinoyino ya yɛligu.
en: How then can each of us hear them speaking in our native language?.

dag: Di bi tuhi ni ti tum niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma kaman bɛ ni shɛb ni daa tum shɛm, ka bɛ ni ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaata bahi yoli dahin yin la.
en: We should not commit sexual sins as some of them did. In one day , of them died because of their sin.

dag: ka Hɛlɔn bia Ɛliab nyɛ Zɛbulɔn zuliya zuɣulana.
en: And then came the tribe of Zebulun. Eliab son of Helon was the commander of that group.

dag: Miri ka a zabi ninvuɣ biɛri nyuli bee m-bɔri ni a mini ba be.
en: Dont envy evil people, and dont long to be with them.

dag: Ti Naa maa nam dibu chuɣu puhibu dabisili yi ti paai, o min o kpambaliba nyurila wain hal ti yɛli ni bo m-bala, ka laɣim maani niriba ansarisi.
en: On the day of our king, the officials became sick with the heat of wine; he stretched out his hand to those who mocked him.

dag: Yinim bɛn zaa yuri Jɛrusalɛm, maliya suhupiɛlli di zuɣu, ka chɛ ka yi mini li laɣim mali suhupiɛlli. Yinim bɛn zaa fabindi di zuɣu, chɛliya ka yi mini li laɣim mali suhupiɛlli pam!.
en: If you love Jerusalem, celebrate and shout! If you were in sorrow because of the city, you can now be glad.

dag: N ni chɛ ka Ijiptinim niŋ ya nirilim din ni chɛ ka yi ku yi nimaani chaŋ ni nu zaŋa.
en: And I will cause the Egyptians to be kind to the Israelites. They will give many gifts to your people when they leave Egypt.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yiɣis o suhu bahi Reechɛl zuɣu pam, ka bɔh o, Mani n-nyɛ Naawuni ŋun ŋar a dɔɣim soli.
en: But Jacob became upset with Rachel and answered, Don't blame me! I'm not God.

dag: Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa daa be Filistianim tiŋgbɔŋ ni la chira ayopɔin.
en: The Philistines kept the Lord s Holy Box in their land for seven months.

dag: Naawuni nyari jilima o ni sɔɣiri yɛla zuɣu; amaa nanim bɛn nyari jilima la bɛ ni vihiri yɛla n-yihiri li palo ni zuɣu.
en: We honor God for the things he keeps secret. But we honor kings for the things they can discover.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Ba yuri o ni tim o Bi so na maa, ka zaŋ binshɛɣukam zaa niŋ o nuu ni.
en: The Father loves his Son and has put everything in his power.

dag: Dama Yisa daa pun yɛl o mi, Nyin alizin biɛɣu ŋɔ, yim doo maa ni.
en: He said this because Jesus had already commanded him, Unclean spirit, come out of the man.

dag: N ku saɣim n ni lo o alikauli shɛli, bee n-taɣi n ni yaai n noli yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛli.
en: I won't break my agreement or go back on my word.

dag: ka Zabad daa nyɛ Ɛfilal ba, ka Ɛfilal nyɛ Obɛd ba.
en: Zabad was Ephlals father. Ephlal was Obeds father.

dag: Di fɔntinsi leela dabiɛm shee. Di nyɛla saa ni bi miri tiŋgban shɛl ni, ka lan nyɛ tiŋgban nɛli. So lan ka tiŋgbani maa ni, ka so mi bi lan doli nimaani garita.
en: Horrible destruction will strike the nearby towns. The land will become a barren desert, where no one can live or even travel.

dag: O daa dɔɣila bidibis ayopɔin mini bipuɣins ata.
en: Job had seven sons and three daughters.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa bɔhi Yaakubu, A yuma ala.
en: and the king asked him, How old are you.

dag: Yawɛ kukoli vuri chɛ ka oki tihi laani ginda, ka chɛ ka nyɔŋ tihi vari suu. Ka bɛnkam zaa be o jɛmbu duu puuni yɛli, Timiya Naawuni jilima.
en: The voice of the Lord makes deer give birth before their time. Forests are stripped of leaves, and the temple is filled with shouts of praise.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ yɛliya: Gol so ŋun pah anahi mini ŋun pah anu ni ŋun pah ayopɔin ni ŋun pahi pia puuni nolɔbo la zaa ha ni ti leela suhupiɛlli saha Judanim sani. Dinzuɣu yumiya yɛlimaŋli mini suhudoo.
en: The LORD of heavenly forces proclaims: The fasts of the fourth, fifth, seventh, and tenth months will become times of joy and gladness, pleasant feasts for the house of Judah. Love truth and peace!.

dag: Bɛ pirigim tiŋgbɔŋ maa ʒii buyopɔin ka sab wuhi di ni nyɛ shɛm na ti ti ma, ka m bo kuɣa sɔŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ tooni n-lihi nya.
en: Write down a description of these seven divisions and bring it to me. Then I will draw lots to consult the Lord our God for you.

dag: o nyɛla karimbaandana ŋun duh omaŋa, ka nyɛ ŋun ʒi shɛli. O lan nyɛla kɔribiɛrilana ŋun suhu kul yɛla bɔhigu chɔɣima mini yɛtɔɣ yoya tɔɣisibu zuɣu. Ka dimbɔŋɔ tahirila nyuli zabbu mini woligibu ni turi ni tab zilisibu.
en: is swollen with pride and knows nothing. He has an unhealthy desire to argue and quarrel about words, and this brings on jealousy, disputes, insults, evil suspicions.

dag: Nyama, Yawɛ dabisili dali kanna ka bɛ ni ti pirigi bɛ ni ŋme n-di neen shɛŋa ti taba yi ninni.
en: The day when the Lord will sit in judgment is near. Then Jerusalem will be looted, and the loot will be divided up before your eyes.

dag: Di saha maa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Filistia Teeku noli ni ti yɛli, Nyamiya din niŋ ti ni zaŋ ti tahima niŋ ninvuɣ shɛb ni la mini ti ni daa zo nti paai shɛb ni bɛ fa ti Asiria naa nuu ni bahi la. Ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ tiligi? .
en: When this happens, the people who live along the coast will say, Look what happened to them! We ran to them for safety, hoping they would protect us from the king of Assyria. But now, there is no escape for us.

dag: Dama n fabila n-leei m bindirigu, ka n ŋuhibu galisi kaman kɔzɔrim la.
en: Instead of eating, I mourn, and I can never stop groaning.

dag: Ka naa yɛli, Pirigimiya bi nɛɔŋ maa buyi n-zaŋ o pirigili ti yino, ka zaŋ o pirigili din la n-ti ŋun la mi.
en: Cut the baby in half! That way each of you can have part of him.

dag: Bɛ yi ti paai goli yini, nyin zalim ba ka bɛ yo anzinfa laɣibaligu diba anu, ka bɛ daa zali ba kaman Naawuni jɛmbu duu liɣiri zahimbu ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: They must make the payment when the baby is one month old. The cost will be shekels of silver. You must use the official measure to weigh this silver. A shekel by the official measure is gerahs.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri bi nyari nyɔri zaɣ maŋli, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn biri wuntitali nyari laara maŋli.
en: The work of evil people is all lies, but those who do right will receive a good reward.

dag: Buni nyɛla din taɣiri nir nyɛvili, amaa so bi varisiri faralana.
en: Wealth can ransom a persons life, but the poor dont even receive threats.

dag: Amaa ka Olivi tia bɔhi ba, N chɛli bɛ ni mali ma doori kpa shɛli ka di tiri wuna mini ninsalinim jilima la tuma ka leei tihi naa.
en: But the olive tree said, My oil is used to honor gods and humans. Should I stop making my oil just to go and sway over the other trees.

dag: Ka o yɛli, N Duuma, bɛ ni so bi lan yɛl lala. Ka Yisa yɛl o, Man gba bi yɛli ni a simdi kubu. Cham a chandi, amaa ka di lan tum alahichi yaha. .
en: No one, sir, she answered. Well, then, Jesus said, I do not condemn you either. Go, but do not sin again.

dag: Bɛ daa naɣ kul wummi ka ninvuɣ shɛb yɛra, Ŋun daa niŋdi ti alaka la yipa yihirila o ni daa kpaŋd omaŋ ni o saɣim adiini so shɛl la waazu pumpɔŋɔ.
en: They had only heard that the one who had been cruel to them was now preaching the message that he had once tried to destroy.

dag: Ti ni daa yuui soli maa ni zuɣu ka barina daa ti yɛn paai ti, ka nolɔbo saha mi pun gari, ka Pool daa saɣisi ba yɛli.
en: We had lost much time, and it was now dangerous to sail, because it was already after the Jewish day of fasting. So Paul warned them.

dag: Di chɛ ka tuumbiɛtumdiba yɛla muɣis a. Di zabiri ninvuɣ biɛri nyuli;.
en: Don't let evil people worry you; don't be envious of them.

dag: M mi ni Yawɛ baɣa be nandaamba ni, ka o zabiri faranim zuɣu.
en: Our Lord , I know that you defend the homeless and see that the poor are given justice.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa yɛl o, Zaŋm a kpamdi ti ma pɔi.
en: Jacob replied, Sell me your rights as the first-born son.

dag: O chɛ ka di niŋda, di yi nyɛla tibidarigibo zuɣu bee o yurilim zuɣu.
en: Whether for punishment, for his world, or for kindness, God makes it all happen.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ tiŋkpansi mini di paliti polo, Judanim shɛb daa bela Kiriatariba tiŋkpansi mini Dibɔn ni di tiŋkpansi ni Jɛkabiziil ni di tiŋkpansi.
en: Some of the people of Judah lived in the following towns near their farms: Kiriath-Arba, Dibon, Jekabzeel.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣ asiba ka Jɔnatan zaŋ bia pa omaŋ zuɣu chaŋ mɔɣu ni kaman o mini Dauda ni daa pun tɔɣisi shɛm la.
en: The next morning Jonathan went out to the field to meet David as they had agreed. Jonathan brought a little boy with him.

dag: N Duuma NAAWUNI daa lan chɛ ka n nya binshɛli ʒii. Nyama ŋuna n Duuma NAAWUNI daa zaŋla buɣim ni o darig o niriba tibili. Buɣim maa daa dila teeku, ka lan diri tiŋgbani gba.
en: This is what the LORD God showed me: The LORD God was calling for judgment with fire, and it devoured the great deep and was eating up part of the land.

dag: Ka bɛ ni ti garigi yɛli, Bɛ ni daa zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ alikauli, ka jɛmdila wun shɛŋa la zuɣu.
en: And the answer will be, Because they abandoned the covenant with the LORD their God and worshipped and served other gods.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun nyo n firila. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ n-chɛ ka neesim neei n zibisim ni.
en: You, the Lord God, keep my lamp burning and turn darkness to light.

dag: O bi zaŋdi kaburi jaambɔn titali buri buŋgu bee n-zaŋdi naɣikɔra tɔroko nɔri nili, amaa kaburi jaambɔn bila ka o zaŋdi buri buŋgu, ka zaŋdi li ŋmari nili.
en: They never use a heavy club to beat out dill seeds or cumin seeds; instead they use light sticks of the proper size.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda daa yɛl o, Doli ma kuli Jɛrusalɛm ka n ti gbib a.
en: The king said to Barzillai, Come over the Jordan with me. I will provide for you at my side in Jerusalem.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋun tɛhi ni o ʒe dɛde, ŋun miri ka o ti niŋ lu.
en: So those who think they are standing need to watch out or else they may fall.

dag: Yawɛ ni zali chu shɛŋa ka di nyɛ laɣiŋgu kasinima, ka nyɛ yi ni yɛn puhiri shɛŋa o ni zal li saha shɛli m-bala.
en: These are the Lord s chosen festivals. You will announce the holy meetings at the times chosen for them.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Zaŋm a nuu tiri zuɣusaa ka sakuɣa lu Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaa, di ni lu daadamnim mini biŋkɔbiri ni bimbilima din be puri ni Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni zuɣu.
en: The LORD said to Moses, Raise your hand toward the sky so that hail will fall on the whole land of Egypt, on people and animals and all the grain in the fields in the land of Egypt.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Nyin bi biɛɣu ŋɔ, amaŋmaŋ nol ni yɛtɔɣa ka n yɛn zaŋ kar a saria! A mi ni m mali halli, ka bɔri ni n nya binshɛɣukam yoli, ka chɛri n ni bi biri binshɛli bebɔ?.
en: He said to him, You bad servant! I will use your own words to condemn you! You know that I am a hard man, taking what is not mine and reaping what I have not planted.

dag: ka tooi chi zim maa nukurigu pali kaman di ni wuhi shɛm n-zaŋ li niŋ buɣim ni sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu, di nyaaŋa ka o chɛ ka paɣ maa zaŋ kom maa nyu.
en: The priest will take a handful of the grain offering as a token part of it and turn it into smoke on the altar. And afterward he will make the woman drink the water.

dag: A ni ti yɛn yɛli ba shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Juda nanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima, wummiya Yawɛ yɛligu. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn chɛmi ka zaɣ biɛɣu lu kpe ŋɔ, ka ŋunkam ti wum di yɛla tiba ni vura.
en: The Lord told me to say, Kings of Judah and people of Jerusalem, listen to what I, the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, have to say. I am going to bring such a disaster on this place that everyone who hears about it will be stunned.

dag: N daa na ʒi n-gbibi m biriginsim ashilɔni kaman shɛb ni niŋdi shɛm, din nyɛ n zaŋ n tuumbiɛri sɔɣi n jɔɣu ni.
en: I have not tried to hide my sins as some people do. I have never hidden my guilt.

dag: Yi yi ku gbilisi tibili wum ka ku zaŋ li niŋ yi suhuri ni n-tiri ma jilima, dindina, n ni yɛli noli niŋ yi daalibarikanim ni. Yɛlimaŋli m pun yɛli noli niŋ di ni, dama yi bi zaŋ li niŋ yi suhuri ni.
en: You had better take seriously the need to honor my name. Otherwise, when you give a blessing, I will turn it into a curse. In fact, I have already done this, because you haven't taken to heart your duties as priests.

dag: ni o chɛ ka Pool lab Jɛrusalɛm na, dama bɛ daa lɔrila nia ni bɛ gu soli ku o.
en: They asked Festus to do them a favor. They wanted him to send Paul back to Jerusalem because they had a plan to kill Paul on the way.

dag: Ka ti yab Yaakubu daa ti wum ni bindirigu be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka o daa tuui tim ti yaannim maa ni bɛ chaŋ Ijipti ti da bindirigu na.
en: When Jacob heard there was grain in Egypt, he sent our ancestors there for the first time.

dag: Ka yi yi ti kpuɣi puri maa atam, yin pum li sɔŋ ʒiibunu n-vaai di yim zuɣu ti Firawuna, ka yi mi zaŋ di ʒiibunahi la ka yi mini yi yiŋnim ni yi bihi di, ka chɛ di shɛli zali nti biri.
en: but one fifth of your crops must go to the king. You can keep the rest as seed or as food for your families.

dag: Naawuni, di be katiŋ ka chɛ ma; n Naawuni, niŋm yomyom sɔŋ ma!.
en: Come closer, God! Please hurry and help.

dag: Shallum daa nyɛla Jɛkamia ba, ka Jɛkamia mi daa nyɛ Ɛlishama ba.
en: Shallum was Jekamiahs father, and Jekamiah was Elishamas father.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu nyɛla din ni chɛ ka nir ti nya binshɛŋa o ni niŋdi tahima ni o ni ti nya la; di lan nyɛla din ni chɛ ka o shiri mi ni o nina ni ku tooi nya binshɛŋa beni.
en: Faith is what makes real the things we hope for. It is proof of what we cannot see.

dag: Pilanim maa zaɣ yini kam wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita anii, ka di barilim nyɛ mita anu ni biɛla; di daa nyɛla zaɣ yɔri, ka di tibisim nyɛ milimita pisopɔinnaanu.
en: For example, the columns were about meters high and . meters around. They were hollow, but the bronze was about millimeters thick.

dag: Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyamiya n ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu lu tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ mini di niriba zuɣu din nyɛ yɛl biɛ shɛŋa zaa din sabi kundi shɛli bɛ ni karim wuhi Juda naa maa ni la.
en: the Lord says, I will bring trouble to this place and to the people living here. I will bring all the terrible things that are written in the book that was read in front of the king of Judah.

dag: Ka o yɛli doo maa, Yihim li, ka o zaŋ o nuu tim ha yihi li.
en: Take it out, he ordered, and the man reached down and picked it up.

dag: Ka Mikal daa zaŋ biŋŋmahindili na ti sɔŋ garo zuɣu n-zaŋ bukɔbiri difiɛli sɔŋ zaŋ di zuɣu kuɣ li, ka zaŋ chinchini pil li.
en: Then she took the household idol, laid it on the bed, put a pillow made of goats' hair at its head, and put a cover over it.

dag: Di sab Naawuni zaligu ni ni ti Duuma yɛliya: N ni zaŋ niriba bɛn tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa mini tinzunnim noya ni yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi niriba ŋɔ, amaa di zaa yoli, bɛ ku bahi wum n yɛligu.
en: In the Scriptures the Lord says, I will use strangers who speak unknown languages to talk to my people. They will speak to them in foreign languages, but still my people won't listen to me.

dag: Zuliya shɛb gbi bɔɣili sɔŋ ŋ-ŋmaligi lu di ni; bɛmaŋmaŋ ni bari tɔn shɛli ŋmaligi gbahi ba.
en: Our Lord , the nations fell into their own pits, and their feet were caught in their own traps.

dag: O yi ti labina o dabisili la dali ni o ti nya tibiginsim o ninvuɣ gahinda sani, ka nya jilima bɛn zaa niŋ o yɛda la sani, yinim gba ni ti be bɛ ni, yi ni daa niŋ ti ni zaŋ shɛhira shɛli yɛla na nti yɛli ya la yɛda la zuɣu.
en: This will happen on the day when the Lord returns to be praised and honored by all who have faith in him and belong to him. This includes you, because you believed what we said.

dag: Ka Abinɛr daa yɛli Dauda, N ni yiɣisi chaŋ ti laɣim Izraɛlnim zaa n-ka n dan naa sanna ka bɛ ti lo a alikauli, ka di chɛ ka a su a suhu ni bɔri shɛb zaa. Di saha ka Dauda daa chɛbisi Abinɛr ka o kuli ni suhudoo.
en: Then Abner said to David, Please let me get going so I can assemble all Israel for my master the king. Then they can make a covenant with you, and you will rule over everything your heart desires. At that, David sent Abner off in peace.

dag: Bɛ ni daa yɛn me Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa, bɛ daa zaŋla kuɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni pun kpe di kpɛbu shee m-me li, ka di chɛ ka so daa bi wum matarika bee lɛhu bee kuribini vuri Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni bɛ ni daa mɛri li maa.
en: Solomon did not want the noise of hammers and axes to be heard at the place where the temple was being built. So he gave orders for the workers to shape the blocks of stone at the quarry.

dag: Gbibiya Bɔrɔbɔro Din ka Dabindi Chuɣu la. Yi ni ti ŋubi bɔrɔbɔro din ka dabindi daba ayopɔin kaman n ni daa zali ya shɛm ka di doli bɛ ni zal li saha shɛli Abib gol ni, dama Abib goli maa ni ka yi daa yi Ijipti na.
en: Celebrate the Festival of Unleavened Bread. For seven days, eat the bread made without yeast as I commanded you before. Do this during the month I have chosen, the month of Abib, because that is the month you came out of Egypt.

dag: Bɛ daa leela zoomba n-dari gindi soya zuɣu, ka ʒim varim ba hal ka so ti ku tooi shihi bɛ binyɛra.
en: People wandered blindly in the streets, polluted with blood. No one would even touch their clothing.

dag: Zuŋɔ nyɛla Yawɛ ni nam dabisi shɛli. Chɛliya ka ti suhuri paligi ka mali suhupiɛlli di ni.
en: This day belongs to the Lord ! Let's celebrate and be glad today.

dag: Dama n ni zɔri binshɛli pam n-ka n sanna, ka binshɛli din kpɛhiri ma dabiɛm lu n zuɣu.
en: Everything I fear and dread comes true.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Di saha maa, bɛ ni ti kurigi Juda nanima mini kpambaliba ni maligumaaniba ni anabinim ni Jɛrusalɛmnim kɔba bɛ gbala ni;.
en: At that time the bones of the kings and of the officials of Judah, as well as the bones of the priests, of the prophets, and of the other people who lived in Jerusalem, will be taken out of their graves.

dag: Di saha ka o daa zaŋ pin shɛŋa o ni ʒina ka di nyɛ salima din tibisim gari kilɔgiram tusaanahi mini tulaale pam ni kuɣ viɛla ti naa. Ka so n-daa bi ti Naa Sulemaana tulaale ka di galisi paai Shiiba naa ŋun nyɛ paɣ maa ni daa ti o tulaale shɛli maa.
en: Then the queen of Sheba gave King Solomon / tons of gold, a huge amount of spices, and precious stones. She gave him more spices than anyone has ever brought into Israel.

dag: Chɛliya ka n yili yilli ŋɔ ka yi wum, di nyɛla n yura min o tihi puu yilli: N yura m-mal o tihi puu ka di be daboli din tiŋgbani vuhiri zuɣu.
en: I will sing a song about my friend's vineyard that was on the side of a fertile hill.

dag: Jɛrigu yɛtɔɣa tahirila zabili na, ka jɛrigu noli ni yɛtɔɣa lan bɔri buri tir o.
en: When some fool starts an argument, he is asking for a beating.

dag: Yawɛ, tiligim a niriba; ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni su ninvuɣ shɛb maa ni. Leem bɛ gula, ka lihiri ba sahakam kaman piɛgul ni lihir o piɛri shɛm la.
en: Save your people, Lord , and bless those who are yours. Be their shepherd, and take care of them forever.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ buɣ so ŋun yuli booni Zius la yuli ti Baanabas, ka zaŋ buɣ so ŋun mi yuli booni Hɛrimɛs la yuli ti Pool mi, Pool ni daa nyɛ bɛ yɛtɔɣ tɔɣisira la zuɣu.
en: The people began to call Barnabas Zeus, and they called Paul Hermes, because he was the main speaker.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli Baruk bɛ nini maa ni.
en: Before them all I said to Baruch.

dag: Bɛ biɛhigu maa yɛla garila wulinluhili polɔnima, ka dabiɛm gbahi wulimpuhili polɔnima.
en: Everyone, from east to west, is overwhelmed with horror.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ mi niŋmi ni di chɛ ka di ni sab shɛm bɛ zaligu ni ni bɛ kul je ma la yol la niŋ pali.
en: This fulfills the word written in their Law, They hated me without a reason.

dag: A mini Ɛdomnim daa niŋdi daabiligu tab tiŋgbɔna ni a nɛma din galisi pam zuɣu, ka bɛ zaŋdi tɛkɔisi mini binʒiɛhi ni bɛ ni wuɣi situr shɛŋa ni tampiɛl viɛla ni kɔral ni rubinim na ti taɣiri yi nɛma maa.
en: The people of Syria bought your merchandise and your many products. They gave emeralds, purple cloth, embroidery, fine linen, coral, and rubies in payment for your wares.

dag: Lumiya bɛn zuɣuri paligi sizuura, ka timiya ninkura jilima, ka zomiya yi Naawuni; Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I command you to show respect for older people and to obey me with fear and trembling.

dag: Ka niriba pam bɛn daa pun niŋ yɛda kana nti kahigiri bɛ ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa wuhiri palɔni.
en: Many of the believers began to confess, telling about all the evil things they had done.

dag: O daa yɛliya, N ni lɛbi n nyaaŋa biri ba. N ni nya bɛ bahigu ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm, dama bɛ nyɛla ʒiɛman golimanima. Bɛ nyɛla bi shɛb bɛn bi ʒe yim.
en: So he said, I will turn away from them, then lets see what happens! They are a rebellious people. They are like children who will not learn their lessons.

dag: Naawuni ʒila o nam ʒiishee din be kasi la. Ŋuna n-nyɛ zuliya kam zaa naa.
en: God sits on his holy throne; he rules all the nations.

dag: Ka Samsin daa chaŋ ka o mini paɣisarili maa ti nya taba, ka Samsin suhu daa yu o pam.
en: Then he went and talked to the young woman, and he liked her.

dag: Lala ka Zara daa be; o daa deei ti yab Ibrahimma noli, hal ka boon o la o duuma. Ka pumpɔŋɔ yi yi tumdi din viɛla ka bi chɛ ka yi suhuri zɔhiri shɛli zuɣu, dina n-ni wuhi ni yi nyɛla Zara yaansi.
en: Sarah was like that; she obeyed Abraham and called him her master. You are now her daughters if you do good and are not afraid of anything.

dag: Ka ninkurigu maa daa yɛl o, Naawuni chɛ ka yi suhuri doya. N ni tin ya yi ni bɔri shɛlikam, amaa lee di gbɛnya palo ŋɔ ni.
en: The old man said, You are welcome in my home! I'll take care of you; you don't have to spend the night in the square.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ n niriba ŋɔ, wummiya n saɣisigu; Izraɛlnima, n di yuya ni yi wum n yɛligu!.
en: Listen, my people, to my warning; Israel, how I wish you would listen to me!.

dag: Ka n nya lala, ka di shɛhira ni ŋuna n-shiri nyɛ Naawuni Bia maa.
en: I saw this happen, and I tell you that he is the Son of God.

dag: Alizin biɛɣu yi zo ka chɛ nira, alizin biɛɣu maa chanimi nti be kom ni bi dooni luɣ shɛŋa polo n-chani ginda m-bɔri vuhim shee ka bi nyara.
en: When an evil spirit leaves a person, it travels through the desert, looking for a place to rest. But when the demon doesn't find a place.

dag: Areebianim mini Kɛdar nabihi zaa daa nyɛla a daabi yurisi bɛn niŋdi piɛnyama mini piɛlahi ni buhi daabiligu. Binyara ŋɔ ni ka a mini ba daa niŋdi daabiligu.
en: The Arabians and the rulers of the land of Kedar paid for your merchandise with lambs, sheep, and goats.

dag: Bɛ bi niŋ yɛda ni bɛ ni lan yi zibisim ni yaha, bɛ nyɛla takɔbi ni yɛn ku shɛba.
en: They cant count on turning away from darkness; they are destined for a sword.

dag: Di jiɣindiya yi ni yɛn di shɛli bee n-nyu shɛli zuɣu, ka di chɛliya ka yi suhuri ye di zuɣu;.
en: So dont always think about what you will eat or what you will drink. Dont worry about it.

dag: Pɛriʒia nabia n-daa taɣ ma zali sol ni biɛɣ pisiniyini. Amaa ka Maikil ŋun nyɛ malaikanim nabia la daa kana ti sɔŋ ma, ka n daa chɛ o mini Pɛriʒia nabia maa nimaani.
en: The angel prince of the kingdom of Persia opposed me for twenty-one days. Then Michael, one of the chief angels, came to help me, because I had been left there alone in Persia.

dag: Ka biɛɣ daa neei asiba ka Dauda sabi gbaŋ ti o ni o zaŋ mali chaŋ ti ti Jɔab.
en: The next morning David wrote a letter to Joab and sent it by Uriah.

dag: Ka Pool daa boli sapashinnim ni yino na ti yɛl o, Zaŋm nachimbil ŋɔ tahi sapashin kpɛm sani; o malila yɛtɔɣ shɛli ni o yɛl o.
en: Paul called for one of the centurions and said, Take this young man to the commander because he has something to report to him.

dag: Ŋun tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa kpaŋsirila omaŋa, amaa ŋun tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa kpaŋsirila cheechi ni niriba.
en: Those who speak in strange tongues help only themselves, but those who proclaim God's message help the whole church.

dag: ka chɛ ka maligumaana Zadok mini anabi Neetan ni Jɛhɔiada bia Bɛnaaya ni Chɛrɛtinim ni Pɛlɛtinim dol o chaŋ ti chɛ ka o ba naa buntaaŋa la.
en: To support him, the king sent along Zadok the priest; the prophet Nathan; Benaiah, Jehoiadas son; and the Cherethites and the Pelethites. Theyve put Solomon on the royal mule.

dag: Ka nam din pah anahi gba ti deei. Di ni ti mali kpiɔŋ kaman kuriti din ŋmɛri burisiri ka kabiri binshɛɣukam la. Ka kuriti ni ŋmɛri burisiri binshɛɣukam shɛm la, lala ka di ni ti ŋme n-wurisi nam shɛŋa din daŋ di tooni.
en: Then there will be a fourth kingdom. That kingdom will be strong like iron. Just as iron breaks things and smashes them to pieces, that fourth kingdom will break all the other kingdoms and smash them to pieces.

dag: Ŋunkam ti ninvuɣ biɛɣu yɛlimaŋli mini ŋunkam galim wuntizɔra, di zaa nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ sani.
en: The Lord doesn't like those who defend the guilty or condemn the innocent.

dag: Di saha ka malaika maa daa kuhi yɛli ma, Nyama, wɔr shɛb bɛn zaŋ kpa nuzaa polo din nyɛ Babilɔn polo la nyɛla bɛn chɛ ka Yawɛ suhu maai.
en: Then the angel cried out to me, The horses that went north to Babylonia have quieted the Lord 's anger.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ tab saawara yɛli, Ti yi yɛli ni Naawuni n-daa zal li, o ni bɔhi ti ni ka bɔ n-niŋ ka ti daa bi niŋ o yɛda?.
en: They argued among themselves, If we say, Its of heavenly origin, hell say, Then why didnt you believe him.

dag: dama naɣilahi mini buhi ʒim ku tooi kpihim niriba daalahichi.
en: because its impossible for the blood of bulls and goats to take away sins.

dag: Amaa maligumaana maa yi lihi li ka di zuɣu kɔbiri maa bi paligi, ka di mi bi kpe o niŋgbuŋ puuni, amaa ka nyɛla din sabigi, dindina maligumaana maa ŋun zaŋm o niŋ duu daba ayopɔin.
en: But if the priest looks at the spot, and there are no white hairs in it, and the spot is not deeper than the skin but is faded, the priest must separate the person for seven days.

dag: Be baalim Yawɛ sani, ka di suɣilo guhir o; di chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lɔri nia biɛri tɔŋsim yɛla muɣis a.
en: Be still before the LORD, and wait for him. Dont get upset when someone gets ahead— someone who invents evil schemes.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli, Bɛmbɔŋɔnim nyɛla tarimba, bɛ ka yɛm, dama bɛ bi mi Yawɛ soli din nyɛ bɛ Naawuni zaligu la.
en: Then I thought, These are only the poor and ignorant. They behave foolishly; they don't know what their God requires, what the Lord wants them to do.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi doli zaligu paɣirila ninvuɣ biɛri, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli zaligu mini ba bi tuhira.
en: Lawbreakers praise criminals, but law-abiding citizens always oppose them.

dag: Yawɛ, tibimi ma, ka n kpaŋ, tiligim ma, ka n tiligi, dama nyini n-nyɛ n ni paɣiri so.
en: Lord , if you heal me, I surely will be healed. Save me, and I surely will be saved. Lord, I praise you!.

dag: N daa yɛli ya, Di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira bee n-zɔri ba dabiɛm.
en: But I told you, Don't be afraid of those people.

dag: Hal a ni kul bi mi ma ŋɔ zaa yoli, mani m-piig a ni a sɔŋ n daba Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ n ni pii shɛb la. Mani m-bol a yuli.
en: I do this for my servant, Jacob. I do it for my chosen people, Israel. Cyrus, I am calling you by name. You dont know me, but I know you.

dag: ni Igal ŋun daa nyɛ Neetan Zɔba nir la bia ni Bɛni ŋun daa nyɛ Gaad nir la.
en: Igal, Nathans son from Zobah; Bani the Gadite.

dag: Yi ni zaŋ suɣilo n-niŋ ania gbibi n yɛligu maa zuɣu, n ni ti yihi ya muɣisigu shɛli din yɛn paai dunia ŋɔ nim zaa la ni.
en: You followed my command to endure patiently. So I will keep you from the time of trouble that will come to the world—a time that will test everyone living on earth.

dag: Bɛ ni ŋuni n-lee bi mi ni Naawuni nuu n-tum tuuni ŋɔ?.
en: Any of them can tell you what the Lord has done.

dag: Siria naa maa saha tariga yi ti miri, Ijipti naa ni ti chaŋ ti lir o, ka Siria naa maa ni ti zaŋ chɛchɛbunsi mini wɔribariba ni sitimanim pam tuh o ni o kpiɔŋ zaa. Siria naa maa ni ti ŋmanila kokpɛɣu n-chaŋ ti liri tin bɔbili.
en: At the time of the end, the king of the south will attack the kingdom of the north. But its king will rush out like a storm with war chariots, cavalry, and many ships. Indeed, his forces will flood one country after another.

dag: N daa laɣisi anzinfa mini salima ni nanim azichi na ti puli, ka su tiŋgbana. N daa mali baansi bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba; ka daa mali mamanim pam n-di niŋgbuŋ nyaɣisim.
en: I also piled up silver and gold from the royal treasuries of the lands I ruled. Men and women sang to entertain me, and I had all the women a man could want.

dag: Di lan sabi Naawuni Kundi ni yaha, Kum yi wum a dima, nyin dihim o; ka kɔnyuri yi wum o, nyin nyuhim o; dimbɔŋɔ niŋbu ni chɛ ka vi gbaag o.
en: Instead, as the scripture says: If your enemies are hungry, feed them; if they are thirsty, give them a drink; for by doing this you will make them burn with shame.

dag: ni Zabad ni Shutɛla ni Ɛzɛr mini Ɛliad bɛn daa chaŋ ni bɛ ti taɣi Gaatinim niɣi chaŋ ka bɛ ku ba.
en: Zabad, and Shuthelah. Ephraim had two other sons, Ezer and Elead. But they were killed when they tried to steal livestock from the people who lived in the territory of Gath.

dag: Izra bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Jɛta mini Mɛrɛd ni Ɛfɛr ni Jalɔn. Ka Mɛrɛd daa kpuɣi Firawuna bipuɣiŋga Bitia, ka o daa niŋ pua n-dɔɣi Miriam mini Shammai ni Ishiba ŋun daa nyɛ Ɛshitɛmɔa ba la. Bitia bihi n-daa bala.
en: Ezrahs family: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon. Jether was the father of Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah, Eshtemoas father.

dag: Timiya ni yi suhu zaa, ka yi yi yɛn niŋ li yin di ŋumdiya yi kparima ni, dama dimbɔŋɔ n-ni chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ niŋ alibarika niŋ yi tuma mini yi ni niŋdi shɛlikam ni.
en: No, give generously to needy persons. Dont resent giving to them because it is this very thing that will lead to the LORD your Gods blessing you in all you do and work at.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka a bɔhira, Bɔ ka Naawuni lee mi? O ni tooi kari saria zibisim titali puuni?.
en: And yet you ask, What does God know? He is hidden by clouds—how can he judge us.

dag: Mabihi yi laɣim be ka mali naŋgban yini, di viɛli ka nyaɣisi pam!.
en: Look at how good and pleasing it is when families live together as one!.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri soli nyɛla din chihiri Yawɛ sani, amaa o yuri ninvuɣ so ŋun doli wuntitali soli.
en: The Lord hates the way evil people live, but he loves those who try to do good.

dag: Amaa ka Dauda daa garigi yɛli Rɛkab min o mabia Baana bɛn daa nyɛ Rimɔn Bɛrɔt nir la bihi maa, Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ka nyɛ ŋun tiligi ma n dimnim zaa nuu ni ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: But David told Recab and his brother Baanah, As surely as the Lord lives, he is the one who has rescued me from all my troubles!.

dag: Ka Dauda daa ŋmalig o sani n-chaŋ shɛb sani nti lan yɛli lala yaha; ka niriba maa gba garigi yɛl o kaman bɛn la ni pun yɛl o shɛm maa.
en: So David turned to someone else and asked the same thing, and the people said the same thing in reply.

dag: O yi taɣi saa zali, binshɛɣukam kuurimi; o yi bahi saa, kom din puhigi tiŋgban ni zaa.
en: Drought comes when God withholds rain; floods come when he turns water loose.

dag: Di saha ka Daniɛl daa chaŋ nayil guliba kpɛm Ariok ŋun nyɛ bɛ ni daa bahi so noli ni o ku Babilɔn baŋdiba zaa la sani nti zaŋ yɛm yɛtɔɣa n-tɔɣis o.
en: Arioch was the king's official in charge of putting the wise men to death. He was on his way to have it done, when Daniel very wisely went to him.

dag: Napaɣ Ɛsta zaligu ŋɔ n-daa wuhi Purim.
en: Esthers letter made the rules for Purim official, and these things were written down in a book.

dag: Ka Dauda daa zaŋ tampiɛlli din ŋmani mukuru la lo o shee ni n-wa waa ni o yaa zaa Yawɛ tooni.
en: David, wearing only a linen cloth around his waist, danced with all his might to honor the Lord .

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ pin shɛŋa zaa tin ya, yihimiya Yawɛ dini ni nyɛ shɛli zaa di puuni. Din nyɛ din viɛli gari di zaa ka yi yɛn zaŋ ti o.
en: When the Israelites give you one-tenth of everything that they own, then you must give the best and the holiest part of these things as your gift to the Lord .

dag: Ka Daniɛl dimnim la daa naai noli kana ti nya o ka o suhiri la o Naawuni.
en: Then the supervisors and satraps went as a group and found Daniel praying and asking God for help.

dag: Puhimiya yi zuɣulaannim mini Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda la zaa ti ma. Ti mabihi bɛn nyɛ Italinim la puhiri ya.
en: Give our greetings to all your leaders and to all God's people. The believers from Italy send you their greetings.

dag: Mɛrari zuliya n-daa nyɛ Mahilinim daŋ mini Mushinim daŋ. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ Mɛrari zuliya.
en: The clan of Merari was composed of the families of Mahli and Mushi.

dag: Bɛna ka n suhir a tira; m bi suhir a tirila dunianima. A ni zaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb ti ma maa ka n suhir a tira, dama bɛ nyɛla a niriba.
en: Im praying for them. Im not praying for the world but for those you gave me, because they are yours.

dag: Tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa ni wurim n-leei dabari, ka zuliya shɛb bɛn gili ya maa ti jɛm Babilɔn naa yuun pisopɔin.
en: This whole country will be reduced to a wasteland, and these nations will serve the king of Babylon for seventy years.

dag: Ti lan wuhiri li ti biɛr kasi puuni mini baŋsim ni ni suɣilo dibu ni ni nirilim niŋbu ni ni Naawuni Shia Kasi ni yurilim maŋli ni.
en: But we have kept ourselves pure and have been understanding, patient, and kind. The Holy Spirit has been with us, and our love has been real.

dag: dindina n ni niŋ jɛmbu duu ŋɔ kaman n ni daa niŋ Shilo shɛm la, ka chɛ ka tiŋ ŋɔ leei noli ni di shɛli dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam sani.
en: then I will make this temple a ruin like Shiloh, and this city I will make a curse before all nations on earth.

dag: Nuhu ʒiɛman ni, n ni daa lo alikauli ni n ku chɛ ka kom lan di dunia la, lala ka n lo alikauli ni n ku lan chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi bah a zuɣu, ka mi ku lan darig a tibili.
en: Remember, in Noahs time I punished the world with the flood. But I made a promise to Noah that I would never again destroy the world with water. In the same way, I promise that I will never again be angry with you and say bad things to you.

dag: Yɛlim Naa Rɛhɔbɔam ŋun nyɛ Sulemaana bia ka nyɛ Juda naa la mini Juda zuliya niriba ni Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba zaa ni man Yawɛ yɛliya.
en: to give this message to Rehoboam and to all the people of the tribes of Judah and Benjamin:.

dag: Ka Leeban daa zaŋ o dɔɣiriba pa omaŋ zuɣu n-kari Yaakubu naba daba ayopɔin hal ti mir o zoya ni tiŋ shɛli din yuli daa booni Giliad maa.
en: He took his men with him and pursued Jacob for seven days until he caught up with him in the hill country of Gilead.

dag: Di saha ka dabiɛm daa gbaai Sool ka o lu n-teei dɔni tiŋa, Samuɛl ni daa yɛl o yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa zuɣu. O daa lan ka yaa, dama o daa bi di binshɛli dindali maa wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa.
en: Saul quickly fell to the ground and lay stretched out there. Saul was afraid because of what Samuel said. Saul was also very weak because he had not eaten any food all that day and night.

dag: Ka Samsin yɛl o, Bɛ yi zaŋ tɔbimi pala zaɣ maha diba ayopɔin lo ma, di ni chɛ ka n gbarigi, ka be kaman sokam ni be shɛm.
en: Samson replied to her, If someone ties me up with seven fresh bowstrings that arent dried out, Ill become weak. Ill be like any other person.

dag: Rubin daa yɛli ba, Di yihiya o ʒim, zaŋmiy o niŋ bɔɣili ŋɔ ni mɔɣu ŋɔ ni, ka di niŋy o shɛli. O daa yɛlila lala ni o fa o bɛ nuu ni bahi n-zaŋ o kulisi ti ti bɛ ba.
en: Reuben said to them, Dont spill his blood! Throw him into this desert cistern, but dont lay a hand on him. He intended to save Joseph from them and take him back to his father.

dag: Amaa ŋunkam mali biɛhiŋ zaŋ chaŋ o ni diri shɛli polo ka diri li mali taali o ni niŋdi shɛli maa ni bi yi yɛda niŋbu ni na zuɣu, dama binshɛɣukam din bi yi yɛda niŋbu ni na nyɛla alahichi.
en: But if they have doubts about what they eat, God condemns them when they eat it, because their action is not based on faith. And anything that is not based on faith is sin.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ daa lo ti alikauli Sinai zoli gbini.
en: The Lord our God made an agreement with us at Mount Horeb.

dag: Ka o yɛli ma, Kamina ti zani baɣili ma n-ku ma, dama n nya daŋ pam, ka m mi shia na bi siɣi.
en: Then he said, Come here and kill me! I have been badly wounded, and I'm about to die.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ lan bɔh o yaha, Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ a? Dama ti bɔri ni ti ʒi a zilinli lab ti yɛli bɛn tim ti na. Nyin lee yɛliya ni a nyɛla ŋuni.
en: Finally, they said, Who are you then? We have to give an answer to the ones who sent us. Tell us who you are.

dag: Ʒimiya liɣiri pahi bɛ ni daa zaŋ laɣ shɛli labisi niŋ yi kpalansi noya ni la zuɣu mali chaŋ, di pa shɛli bɛ daa chirimmi maa.
en: Take twice as much money with you this time. Take the money that was given back to you after you paid last time. Maybe the governor made a mistake.

dag: ni yaannina ayi mini di kpam din be binshee ni, ka yihi binsabili yaɣ shɛli din viɛl pahi binyaannin shɛŋa o ni yihi maa zuɣu.
en: the two kidneys and the fat around them at the loins; and the lobe on the liver, which must be removed with the kidneys.

dag: Ka Naa Hɛzɛkia daa deei gbaŋ maa tuumba maa nuu ni n-karim, ka yiɣisi chaŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu nti teei gbaŋ maa sɔŋ Yawɛ tooni.
en: After Hezekiah had read the note from the king of Assyria, he took it to the temple and spread it out for the Lord to see.

dag: Ka n kpamdi ya jaande ni yi kul suhim Naawuni ka o chɛ ka di ku yuui ka n lab yi sanna.
en: And I beg you to pray that God will send me back to you soon. I want this more than anything else.

dag: Mɛrari daŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpalim, bɛ daa zaŋla Zɛbulɔn tiŋgban ni tinsi kaman Rimɔno mini Tabo ni di momaha tiŋgbana zaa ti ba.
en: The rest of the Merari clan received the towns of Rimmono and Tabor and their pastureland from the tribe of Zebulun.

dag: Naawuni ni lo nia shɛli ni di saha ti paai ka o pal li la nyɛla ni o ti laɣim binnamda zaa luɣ yini: Binnamda bɛn be alizanda ni mini bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni, ka Masia ti nyɛ bɛ zuɣulana.
en: Then when the time is right, God will do all he has planned, and Christ will bring together everything in heaven and on earth.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ n ni kpɛm ninvuɣ shɛba m-maani ma ansarisi la; n ni daa yuli ʒiɛm shɛb banima, ka ku saɣi zaŋ ba pahi m bahi zuɣu ka bɛ doli m piɛri la.
en: But now men younger than I make fun of me— men whose fathers were too worthless to put with my sheep dogs.

dag: Dama zuŋɔ o chaŋmi ti kɔri naɣilalantaba mini naɣibihipol kpaba ni piɛri pam mali sara, ka boli nabihi zaa mini tɔbbihi sapashin kpɛm Jɔab ni maligumaana Abiata. Nyama, bɛ be o sani n-diri ka nyuri ka yɛra, Naawuni dolimi Naa Adɔnija nyɛvili.
en: Earlier today, he sacrificed a lot of cattle, calves, and sheep. He invited the army commanders, Abiathar, and all your sons to be there. They are already eating and drinking and shouting, Long live King Adonijah.

dag: Amaa ka Ɛsta daa chaŋ naa sani, ka naa ti zali zaligu, ka chɛ ka bɛ sab li sɔŋ ni Haman ni lo nia biɛ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Yɛhudianim polo maa simdi ni di ŋmaligi dila ŋuna. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Haman maa min o bidibisi yili gar dari.
en: But when Esther came before the king, his written order said: The wicked plan that Haman made against the Jews should turn back on him instead. So they impaled him and his sons on pointed poles.

dag: Ka bɛ daa fa biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn kpalim la yiko, amaa ka lee chɛ ba ni bɛ be saha biɛla pahi.
en: Then the authority of the remaining beasts was brought to an end, but they were given an extension among the living for a set time and season.

dag: Amaa n yɛlila yinima: N ni zaŋ bɛ tiŋgbɔn maa tin ya, ka yi di li fali n-su li. Di nyɛla tiŋgban shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋun woligi ya ka chɛ zuliya shɛba.
en: But I have promised you this rich and fertile land as your possession, and I will give it to you. I am the Lord your God, and I have set you apart from the other nations.

dag: Bɛ ti yɛn zahindila kom kɔpu buyi tir a ka a nyura. A ni ti nyuri li la bɛ ni zal a ni a nyu li saha shɛli.
en: and drink only two large cups of water.

dag: O daa chɛ ka teeku pirigi ka chɛ ka bɛ siɣi di ni gari, o daa chɛ ka kom laɣim ti dɔni kaman kunkuni la.
en: God made a path in the sea and piled up the water as he led them across.

dag: Hal yi zabiri zaa mali kalinli. Dinzuɣu di chɛliya ka yi suhuri zɔhira; yi mali buchi pam gari jahinjɛya.
en: Even the hairs on your head are counted. So don't be afraid! You are worth much more than many sparrows.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Yɛhudianim chu shɛli daa ti yɛn puhi, ka Yisa daa chaŋ Jɛrusalɛm.
en: After this, Jesus went to Jerusalem for a religious festival.

dag: Barinyuriba ku zan a tooni; a mi je tuumbiɛtumdiba zaa.
en: Fools cannot come near you. You hate those who do evil.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka yi suhuri doya, ka di chɛliya ka dabiɛm mali ya; n daa deei yi liɣiri maa. Di pa shɛli, yi Naawuni ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni la n-daa zaŋ liɣiri maa niŋ yi kpalansi maa ni maa. Di saha ka o daa zaŋ Simiɔn n-yihi bɛ sanna.
en: It's all right, the servant replied. Don't worry. The God you and your father worship must have put the money there, because I received your payment in full. Then he brought Simeon out to them.

dag: Dindali maa, n ni boli Hilikia bia Ɛliakim ŋun nyɛ n dabili la na.
en: On that day, I will call my servant Eliakim, Hilkiahs son.

dag: Ka o mi ti yɛli ya yaha, N yɛri ya mi, n ʒi yi ni yi shɛl na. Yinim tuumbiɛrinim ŋɔ, wariya! .
en: But he will say again, I don't know where you come from. Get away from me, all you wicked people.

dag: ni Ifita ni Ashina ni Nɛzib.
en: Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib.

dag: ka a kɔrig o n-zaŋ o ʒim kpaai vie sara maligu bimbini maa luɣilikam zaa.
en: Kill the ram and splatter its blood against all four sides of the altar.

dag: Haa Kum, a nasara dibu be ya? Haa Kum, a dimbu yiko be ya?.
en: Where is its victory? Where is its sting.

dag: Bɛ teebuya zuɣu zaa nyɛla tiri, ka di luɣ shɛli ka nyam.
en: Their tables are covered, completely covered, with their stinking vomit.

dag: M mabihi, pumpɔŋɔ ti ŋmanila Yisahaku; ti nyɛla Naawuni bihi o daalikauli lɔbu zuɣu.
en: Brothers and sisters, you are children of the promise like Isaac.

dag: A mi sagbana ni yili zuɣusaa shɛm? Ŋuna ŋun mi binshɛɣukam ŋɔ daalahiziba tuma ni ka di niŋda.
en: of God who knows all things? Or how he hangs the clouds in empty space?.

dag: Di saha ka Manɔa daa yɛli Yawɛ malaika maa, Wuhim ti a yuli, ka a yɛligu maa ti niŋ pali ka ti ti a jilima.
en: Manoah replied, Tell us your name, so that we can honor you when your words come true.

dag: Di saha ka salo maa zaa daa tim tuumba Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba bɛn daa be Rimɔn tampiŋ gbin la sani nti yɛli ba ni bɛ ku bɛ mini ba zabili la.
en: The whole community then sent word to the Benjaminites who were at the rock of Rimmon and offered them a truce.

dag: N yɛn ŋahila ŋaha. N yɛn tɔɣisila kurimbuni ha ashili yɛtɔɣa.
en: I will open my mouth with a proverb. Ill declare riddles from days long gone.

dag: Luk ŋun nyɛ dɔɣite so ti ni yuri la mini Diimas gba puhiri ya.
en: Luke, our dear doctor, and Demas send you their greetings.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa ti tuhi deei Hamatizɔba.
en: After this Solomon went to Hamath of Zobah and captured it.

dag: Di saha ka tiŋgbani daa dam ka sɔhigi; ka zoya gbina ni gba sɔhigi ka dam, o suhu ni daa yiɣisi pam zuɣu.
en: Then the earth trembled and shook; the foundations of the mountains rocked and quivered, because God was angry.

dag: Ka Izraɛl zuliya zaa daa laɣim ka Dauda sanna Hiburɔn ti yɛl o, Nyama, ti nyɛla a niŋgbuŋ ni a ʒim.
en: All the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron. They said to David, Look, we are one family !.

dag: N daa lan ti a bindirigu din nyɛ zim viɛlli mini kpam ni shiri ni a di, ka a daa zaŋ li zali bɛ tooni ni di nyɛ din nyom viɛla, ka di daa shiri nyɛ lala. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I gave you bread, honey, and oil, but you gave that food to your idols. You offered them as a sweet smell to please your false gods. You acted like a prostitute with those false gods! This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: Ka o ʒiʒiinitab min o dɔɣiriba daa wum ti Duuma ni zo o nambɔ shɛli maa yɛla, ka di niŋ bɛ min o zaa suhupiɛlli pam.
en: her neighbors and relatives heard how kind the Lord had been to her, and they too were glad.

dag: Tim o o nuhi tuma tarili, ka chɛ ka o tuma paɣ o tiŋ maa dunɔdaya ni.
en: Give her credit for all she does. She deserves the respect of everyone.

dag: Ka o daa vihi li. O daa daŋla bɛ kpɛm dini vihibu m-mali lala hal ti paai bɛ biasani dini; ka daa nya pipia maa Bɛnjamin kpalaŋa ni.
en: He searched the oldest first and the youngest last, and the cup was found in Benjamins sack.

dag: Nam fukumsi yi nahindi tarimba ka bi niŋdi din tuhi, ka mɔŋ ba bɛ yɛlimaŋli soya, nyin di chɛ ka di gar a; dama tuma zuɣulan kam gba malila zuɣulana, ka ŋun nyɛ bɛ zaa mi zuɣulan gba beni.
