en: If you witness the poor being oppressed or the violation of what is just and right in some territory, dont be surprised because a high official watches over another, and yet others stand over them.

dag: Nudirigu polo tintariga yɛn zaŋla Zin mɔɣu ni m-baɣisi Ɛdom tintariga chaŋ, ka yi tintariga piligu shee yɛn nyɛla Teeku Kpiŋ wulimpuhili polo.
en: Your southern boundary extends from the Zin desert alongside Edom. Your southern border extends from the edge of the Dead Sea on the east.

dag: Kuruchu bɔbigu daa ʒe kpaŋ ha n-gbiri binyara ŋubira.
en: Near that place there was a large herd of pigs feeding.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam yɛli zoli ŋɔ, Yiɣisim a dooshee ŋɔ nti lu teeku ni ha, ka bi biɛhim o suhu ni, amaa ka niŋ yɛda ni o ni yɛli shɛm maa ni niŋ pali, o ni nya ka di shiri niŋ lala.
en: The truth is, you can say to this mountain, Go, mountain, fall into the sea. And if you have no doubts in your mind and believe that what you say will happen, then God will do it for you.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa yɛrigi nuzaa polo sagbana limsi vau, ka daa bi zaŋ dunia ŋɔ yili binshɛli.
en: who hung the northern sky and suspended the earth on empty space.

dag: amaa ka daa lee yɛli ni bɛ di niŋ li chuɣu maa dali, dama ni di pa shɛli ka niriba ti taai duŋ o gbaabu zuɣu.
en: But they agreed that it shouldnt happen during the feast so there wouldnt be an uproar among the people.

dag: Zanimiya luɣ kasi shee kaman yi daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm, ka chɛ ka Lɛvinim be bɛ ni piripiri yi zuliya daŋ niriba maa pirigibu kam puuni.
en: and arrange yourselves so that some of you will be available to help each family of the people of Israel.

dag: Amaa Sulemaana daa bi zaŋ Izraɛlnim leei daba. Bɛna n-daa nyɛ o tɔbbihi min o kpamba ni o sapashinnim ni o sapashin kpamba ni o chɛchɛbunsi duhiriba kpamba ni o wɔribariba.
en: Solomon did not make slaves of Israelites; they served as his soldiers, officers, commanders, chariot captains, and cavalry.

dag: Di saha ka a zaŋ salima alali m-mali di yɔrigu, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ sɛntimita kɔbiga ni pia, ka di yɛliŋ mi nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: Make the lid of the chest out of pure gold.

dag: Ka bɛ daa kali Lɛvinim maa bɛn yuma paai pihita zaŋ chana, ka bɛ kalinli daa nyɛ ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahaayika.
en: He took a census of all the male Levites aged thirty or older. The total was thirty-eight thousand.

dag: Ti bi be kaman Anabi Musa ŋun daa zaŋ sariga pili n-lir o ninni ni Izraɛlnim di nya jilima din daa ti yɛn vuu la bahigu la.
en: We are not like Moses. His face was shining, but he covered it to keep the people of Israel from seeing the brightness fade away.

dag: Ka yaɣ din la gba mali pateesa shɛŋa din wɔɣilim nyɛ mita ayɔbu ni pirigili, ka mali daantalis ata mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu diba ata.
en: The other side of the entrance must also have curtains cubits long. There must be three posts and three bases on that side.

dag: Di simdi ni yi baŋ ni yi gba daa nyɛla daba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daa teeg o yiko nuu yihi ya nimaani na. Dinzuɣu ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zali ya ni yi gbibi Vuhim Dabisili maa.
en: Remember that you were a slave in Egypt, but the LORD your God brought you out of there with a strong hand and an outstretched arm. Thats why the LORD your God commands you to keep the Sabbath day.

dag: Lala ka bɛ daa piri tɔbbihi maa sɔŋ n-gu tɔbu maa. Bɛ daa chɛ ka tɔbbihi bɛn galisi pam dola tiŋ maa nuzaa polo, ka chɛ ka bɛn kpalim mi do tiŋ maa wulinluhili polo. Amaa ka Jɔshua daa gbe vinvamli maa ni.
en: The soldiers were arranged for battle with the main camp north of the city and the rest of the men to the west. Joshua spent the night in the valley.

dag: Daadam ŋun mali bahigu ŋɔ ni tooi be tibi gari Naawuni? Daadamnim ni tooi be kasi gari ŋun nam ba?.
en: Can a human be more righteous than God, a person purer than their maker.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ nyɛla buɣim din dira, o nyɛla Naawuni ŋun zabiri nyuli.
en: because the Lord your God is like a flaming fire; he tolerates no rivals.

dag: So di kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni naɣila maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim bɛn tumdi tuma la kɔŋko; bɛna n-ni tooi kpe di puuni, dama bɛna m-be kasi, amaa di simdi ka bɛnkam kpalim zaa saɣi Yawɛ ni zali ba shɛm maa.
en: Dont enter the LORDs temple, because only the priests or Levites on duty can do that. They are allowed to enter because they are holy, but the rest of the people must follow the LORDs requirements.

dag: Banima n-lee zɔri yomyom kaman sagbana ŋɔ bee n-zɔri yomyom kaman ŋmani n-yiɣiri chani ni o ti kpe o tiɛɣu ni ŋɔ?.
en: Look at the people. They are rushing toward you like clouds quickly crossing the sky. They are like doves flying to their nests.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ cham ti ku Amalɛknim maa, ka saɣim bɛ binshɛɣukam zaa, di chɛ ka bɛ ni so kpalim, amaa kum dɔbba mini paɣiba ni biliɛri ni bimɔɣirisi n-tabili naɣilahi mini piɛri ni laakumnim ni bunsi zaa. .
en: Go and attack the Amalekites and completely destroy everything they have. Don't leave a thing; kill all the men, women, children, and babies; the cattle, sheep, camels, and donkeys.

dag: O miri ka o di biŋkɔb so ŋun kpi nyiŋgo muni bee biŋkɔbiri ni dari tɔhi biŋkɔb so, ka di kpɛh o daɣiri ni. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: He shall not eat the meat of any animal that has died a natural death or has been killed by wild animals; it will make him unclean. I am the Lord .

dag: ni n yi yuui kandina, di ni chɛ ka a mi a ni yɛn niŋdi shɛm Naawuni niriba bɛn nyɛ ŋun Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ cheechi la ni, ka nyɛ daantaliga mini tanzaa Naawuni yɛlimaŋli ni tam shɛli zuɣu la.
en: if Im delayed, youll know how you should behave in Gods household. It is the church of the living God and the backbone and support of the truth.

dag: Ka salo bɛn daa ʒe nimaani maa wum lala ka yɛli ni saa n-tahira. Ka shɛb mi yɛli ni malaika n-tɔɣisir o yɛtɔɣa shɛm maa.
en: The people standing there heard the voice. They said it was thunder. But others said, An angel spoke to him.

dag: Naawuni n-nyɛ ŋun su binshɛɣukam, ka nyɛ bɛ ni zo so dabiɛm, ŋuna n-chɛ ka suhudoo be o daalizanda din be zuɣusaa ŋɔ ni.
en: God is the ruler. He makes people fear and respect him. He keeps peace in his kingdom above.

dag: Bɛ ʒim mini bɛ kpam ni ti ŋam Yawɛ takɔb maa kaman bɛ ni zaŋ piɛ shɛb mini bu shɛb mali sara ʒim ni bɛ kpam la. Dama Yawɛ ni mali sara Bɔzira. O ni ku niriba pam Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: The Lord decided there should be a time for killing in Bozrah and in Edom. So the sword of the Lord is covered with blood and fat. The blood is from the goats. The fat is from the kidneys of the rams.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, yiɣisim ka a min a yiko Alikauli Adaka ŋɔ kpe a vuhim shee. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, yiɣisim chɛ ka a maligumaaniba ŋɔ nya tiliginsim, ka chɛ ka bɛn ʒe a yim mali suhupiɛlli a ninvuɣ suntali puuni.
en: Rise up now, Lord God, and with the Covenant Box, the symbol of your power, enter the Temple and stay here forever. Bless your priests in all they do, and may all your people be happy because of your goodness to them.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbaai Yisa n-zaŋ o tahi maligumaaniba zuɣulan yiŋa; ka Pita daa puɣisiri doli nyaaŋa.
en: After they arrested Jesus, they led him away and brought him to the high priests house. Peter followed from a distance.

dag: Piɛgul shɛb daa be tiŋ maa ni mɔɣu ni gul bɛ piɛri yuŋ.
en: Nearby shepherds were living in the fields, guarding their sheep at night.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna, Toomiya daaŋa ni tampiligim nukurigu palipali ka Musa zaŋ li bahi zuɣusaa Firawuna ninni.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, Take a few handfuls of ashes from a furnace; Moses is to throw them into the air in front of the king.

dag: Gunimiya, ka di nyɛ m mini ya daalikauli maa shihirili.
en: From now on you must circumcise every baby boy when he is eight days old, including slaves born in your homes and slaves bought from foreigners. This will show that there is a covenant between you and me.

dag: ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛril mini oniɣisi ni jasipa m-pie taba kul shɛli din pahir anahi. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ li niŋ salima bintaɣindisi la ni.
en: The fourth row was a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. The settings around them were decorative gold.

dag: Ka n daa nya ka Piɛbil maa tabigi bintabinda maa ni din pah ayɔbu, ka tiŋgbani damda, ka wuntaŋ sabigi kaman bɛ ni zaŋ chinchin shɛli n-tim shim ni la, ka goli mi mooi kaman ʒim la.
en: And I saw the Lamb break open the sixth seal. There was a violent earthquake, and the sun became black like coarse black cloth, and the moon turned completely red like blood.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Naa Hɛrɔd daa boli baŋdiba maa ashilɔni na nti vihi ba viɛnyɛliŋga ni o baŋ saha shɛli saŋmariga maa ni daa puhi.
en: So Herod called the visitors from the East to a secret meeting and found out from them the exact time the star had appeared.

dag: Ti daa wum bɛ yɛla ka ti kɔba ni chɔɣisimi, ka biɛrim pam mali ti, ka biɛrim maa ŋmanila paɣ ni yɛn dɔɣi ka biɛrim shɛli mal o la.
en: We have heard the news about that army, and we are paralyzed with fear. We feel trapped by our troubles, in pain like a woman giving birth.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ maŋmaŋ daa yɛli ma, N ku chɛ bɛ tuumbiɛɣu ŋɔ taali hal ka bɛ ti yi dunia yili. Mani yi Duuma Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The Lord All-Powerful said this to me and I heard it with my own ears: You are guilty of doing wrong, and I promise that you will die before this guilt is forgiven. The Lord GOD All-Powerful said these things.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: Then the Lord told me to say:.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Ijipti naa daa yih o nam maa ni Jɛrusalɛm, ka zali Judanim ni bɛ yom farigu din nyɛ anzinfa kilɔgiram tusaata ni kɔbisinahi mini salima kilɔgiram pihitanaanahi.
en: King Neco of Egypt took him prisoner and made Judah pay , pounds of silver and pounds of gold as tribute.

dag: ka ŋunkam ti niŋ o yɛda nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: Then everyone who believes in him can have eternal life.

dag: O yidan niŋ o naani o suhu ni, ka shɛli ku poog o yidana maa.
en: Her husband entrusts his heart to her, and with her he will have all he needs.

dag: Lala ka Asiria naa ti yɛn gbahi Ijiptinim leei daba, ka gbahi Itiɔpianim ninkura mini bipola n-zaŋ ba bɛ zaɣim ni bɛ napɔn zaŋa, ka bɛ gbina do palo ni, n-kuli o yiŋa, ka di dihi Ijiptinim vi.
en: so will the king of Assyria lead the captives of Egypt and the exiles of Cush, both young and old, naked and barefoot, with buttocks bared, humiliating Egypt.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kul pahirila baŋsim mini zoosim, ka mali zuɣu pam Naawuni mini salinim sani.
en: Jesus grew both in body and in wisdom, gaining favor with God and people.

dag: Molimi zuliya kam ni. Samiya tuuta, ka mol di yɛla. Miriya ka yi sɔɣi di shɛli. Yɛlimiya, Bɛ tuhi deei Babilɔn Bɛl di vi. Di niŋ Mariduk alahiziba. Bɛ dih o binnana vi, ka di gar o buɣa la.
en: Tell the nations; proclaim it far and wide! Set up a flag; proclaim it far and wide! Hold nothing back; just shout it: Babylon is captured; Bel is shamed; Marduk is panic-stricken. Her images are shamed; her idols are panic-stricken.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ biɛɣ pihinahi dali, ka Nuhu daa yooi ŋariŋ maa takɔr shɛli o ni daa chib la.
en: After forty days Noah opened a window.

dag: O daa zaŋ o niriba kpe mɔɣu ni gari. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: Give thanks to the one who led his people through the desert— Gods faithful love lasts forever.

dag: Ŋun wurindi niriba la kana ti liri ya. Guliya yi ni zaani gooni zuɣu luɣ shɛŋa tuhiri tɔbu la. Lihimiya soli zuɣu, lomiya kpara. Laɣimmiya yi tɔbbi kpɛma zaa.
en: A scatterer has come up against you. Guard the ramparts, watch the road, protect your groin, save your strength!.

dag: Bɛ ni di nasara bɛ tuma ni, ka alɔbo ku di bɛ bihi. N ni niŋ alibarika niŋ bɛ mini bɛ bihi ni sahakam.
en: Their work won't be wasted, and their children won't die of dreadful diseases. I will bless their children and their grandchildren.

dag: Kasitali sara maligu biŋkɔbiri daa nyɛla naɣilahi kɔbisiyɔbu mini piɛri tusaata.
en: as well as six hundred bulls and three thousand sheep as holy offerings.

dag: ka o bia Ishimail mi daa nyɛ yuun pinaata bia saha shɛl o ni daa guni.
en: and his son Ishmael was years old when the flesh of his foreskin was circumcised.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa di nam ʒin o ba Dauda nam ʒiishee, ka o nam maa daa ba n-zani viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: Solomon sat on the throne of his father David, and his royal power was well established.

dag: Hɛzirɔn ni daa ti paai yuun pihiyɔbu saha shɛli, ka o daa lan kpuɣi Makiri ŋun daa nyɛ Giliad ba la bipuɣiŋga n-daa zaŋ o dɔɣi Sɛgub.
en: When Hezron was years old, he married the daughter of Machir, who settled the region of Gilead. Their son Segub.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ daa yɛl o mi, Bɔhim maligumaana m-baŋ zaligu ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ bɔhigu ŋɔ polo.
en: This is what the LORD of heavenly forces says: Go ahead and ask the priests for a ruling.

dag: Ŋuna n-ni ti me yili ti n yuli jilima, ka n ti chɛ ka o nam zani hal ni saha din ka bahigu.
en: He will be the one to build a temple for me, and I will make sure that his dynasty continues forever.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali yɛm mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali baŋsim yi wum n ni yɛli shɛm ŋɔ, bɛ ni yɛli ma.
en: Smart people say to me, the wise who hear me.

dag: Yisa ni daa na kul yɛri maa, ka Farisii so yɛl o ni o bɔri ni o ka ŋun Farisii maa yiŋ na ka o min o ti laɣim di bindirigu. Ka o daa chaŋ ka bɛ ti ʒini ni bɛ di;.
en: While Jesus was speaking, a Pharisee invited him to share a meal with him, so Jesus went and took his place at the table.

dag: Ka o daa ti yɛl o bia maa, Zom chaŋ ti pihi n ni yɛn to peen shɛŋa ŋɔ na. Bia maa ni daa zɔri chani maa, ka o to piɛm bah o tooni ha.
en: He said to the boy, Run. Go find the arrows I shoot. The boy began to run, and Jonathan shot the arrows over his head.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa ti be puu maa ni zaawun mahili saha n-chani ginda, ka doo maa min o paɣ maa wum o damli, ka zo nti sɔɣi puu maa ni tihi ni ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ di nya ba.
en: During that days cool evening breeze, they heard the sound of the LORD God walking in the garden; and the man and his wife hid themselves from the LORD God in the middle of the gardens trees.

dag: Bɛn pa Yɛhudianim la ni daa wum lala maa ka di paligi bɛ suhuri pam ka bɛ paɣi ti Duuma yɛligu maa; ka Naawuni ni daa zali shɛb ni bɛ nya nyɛvili din ka bahigu la niŋ yɛda.
en: This message made the Gentiles glad, and they praised what they had heard about the Lord. Everyone who had been chosen for eternal life then put their faith in the Lord.

dag: Binneembihi kam zaa bɛn mali paɣiri ka mali bɛ naba anahi zaa chana nyɛla yi ni chihiri shɛb dibu.
en: Dont eat insects that have wings and crawl. Even the thought of eating them should make you sick!.

dag: Nyamiya Yawɛ sanʒiɛɣu, suhuyiɣisili titali. Di ŋmanila pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga, di ni lu ninvuɣ biɛri zuɣu.
en: His anger is a storm, a furious wind that will rage over the heads of the wicked.

dag: Ka yi ni daa galisi kaman saŋmarisi bɛn be zuɣusaa ŋɔ la, yi kalinli ni ti kpalimla biɛla yi ni bi deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ nol la zuɣu.
en: There are as many of you now as the stars in the sky, but if you disobey the Lord your God, only a few of you will be left.

dag: ni Zɔra ni Aijalɔn ni Hiburɔn. O ni daa me goondahi gili Juda mini Bɛnjamin fɔntin shɛŋa m-bala.
en: Zorah, Aijalon, and Hebron. These were the fortified cities in Judah and Benjamin.

dag: Ka biŋkɔbir anahi daa yi teeku maa ni na, bɛ zaa mi daa bela kɔŋkɔba.
en: Four huge beasts came up out of the ocean, each one different from the others.

dag: Di saha ka n yɛli, Din niŋ ma suhugarigu nyɛla, Zallakudura Naa nudirigu yiko la taɣimi.
en: Then I said, What hurts me most is this— that God is no longer powerful.

dag: Naɣila biŋkɔbiri ka ti daa zaŋ leei ti ni ŋme tɔb di shɛli m-pahi ti ni daa ŋme n-fa neen shɛŋa fɔntin shɛŋa ti ni daa dee la ni.
en: The only things we kept for ourselves were the animals and the plunder from the towns we had taken.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, Hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, biɛhiŋ kani, na so ŋun daa leeg o nam ka o yuli ʒiɛm o ni daa po pɔri shɛli la, ka saɣim alikauli maa ni be luɣ shɛli din nyɛ Babilɔn maa ni ka o ni kpi.
en: As surely as I am the living Lord God, I swear that the king of Judah will die in Babylon, because he broke the treaty with the king of Babylonia, who appointed him king.

dag: N ni fa a ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni bahi, ka tilig a ninvuɣ galima gbaabu ni.
en: I will save you from these evil people. They frighten you, but I will save you from them.

dag: Ka saha daa ti paai ka Yisa min o tuumba maa laɣim ʒini ni bɛ di bindirigu maa.
en: The time came for them to eat the Passover meal. Jesus and the apostles were together at the table.

dag: Ka m bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee bala, n Duuma? Ka o yɛli, Man Yisa so a ni niŋdi alaka maa m-bala.
en: Who are you? I asked. Then the Lord answered, I am Jesus! I am the one you are so cruel to.

dag: Amaa ka aŋgo maa garigi yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, n ʒin ya.
en: But the groom replied, I don't even know you.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa daa kana ti nya shigbaŋ, ka shikpam do tiŋa.
en: They all came into a wooded area and found honey everywhere.

dag: Amaa ka Yisahaku biŋkɔbiguliba daa gbi kɔbiliga vinvamli maa ni n-nya kom.
en: While his servants were digging in the valley, they found a spring-fed well.

dag: Tuuli, o nam sulinsi tinsi n-daa nyɛ Babɛl mini Ɛrɛk ni Akad, ka di zaa daa bela Shiina tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: The most important cities in his kingdom were Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh in the land of Shinar.

dag: Naawuni mi bi deeri ti la bindirigu dibu zuɣu: Ti yi di, di bi pahiri ti shɛli; ti mi yi bi di, di bi filindi ti.
en: But food will not bring us closer to God. Refusing to eat does not make us less pleasing to God, and eating does not make us closer to him.

dag: Yi nini na bi nya o, amaa ka yi kul yur o; ka hal yi nini ni na kul bi nya o maa zaa yoli, yi niŋ o yɛda ka kul mali suhupiɛl shɛli din galisi hal ka so ku tooi zaŋ yɛtɔɣa kahigi li wuhi gba.
en: You have not seen Christ, but still you love him. You cant see him now, but you believe in him. You are filled with a wonderful and heavenly joy that cannot be explained.

dag: Ka Dauda tɔbbihi maa daa chirigi Absalom ka o ba o buntaaŋa zɔra, ka buntaaŋa maa daa ti yɛn zaŋ o gari oki ti titali gbini, ka o zuɣu kpe n-shɛbisi oki tia maa wula ni ka o yili zuɣusaa, ka buntaaŋa maa zo ka chɛ o ka o kpalim yiliya.
en: Absalom came upon some of Davids men. Absalom was riding on a mule, and the mule went under the tangled branches of a large oak tree. Absaloms head got caught in the tree. He was left hanging in midair while the mule under him kept on going.

dag: Ka Ɛdomnim daa zaɣisi ni Judanim ku lan su ba hal ni zuŋɔ. Di saha maa ka Libinanim gba daa zaɣisi ni Judanim ku lan su ba.
en: So the Edomites broke away from the rule of Judah. And they have been free from the rule of Judah until today. At the same time Libnah also broke away from Judahs rule.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ n tampiŋ mini n gooni din gili ma ni ŋun fari ma bahira. Ŋuna n-nyɛ n Naawuni ni n tampiŋ. Naawuni n-nyɛ n ni sɔɣiri so sani ni n nyɔtaɣirigu ni n tiliginsim yiligu ni m birini.
en: The LORD is my solid rock, my fortress, my rescuer. My God is my rock— I take refuge in him!— hes my shield, my salvations strength, my place of safety.

dag: Yi ni sɔɣ yɛli shɛlikam zibisim ni ni ti yi neesim ni; ka yi ni sɔɣ ŋumsi shɛli duu puuni, bɛ ni mol li gili luɣilikam.
en: Whatever you say in the dark will be heard when it is day. Whatever you whisper in a closed room will be shouted from the housetops.

dag: Dinzuɣu m mabihi, chɛliya ka yi suhuri kul ye anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu zuɣu, ka di zaɣisiya tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni gba.
en: So my brothers and sisters, continue to give your attention to prophesying. And dont stop anyone from using the gift of speaking in different languages.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa wum yi yɛligu maa ka o suhu yiɣisi ka o po pɔri yɛli.
en: You had made the Lord angry, and he said:.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yɛli, Bɛn wumdi Naawuni yɛligu ka gbib li n-lee mal alibarika.
en: Jesus replied, That's true, but the people who are really blessed are the ones who hear and obey God's message.

dag: Di chaŋ wula ka ninvuɣ shɛb zaani kpiimba zaani n-deeri kom baptaizibu tiri ba? Kpiimba yi bi neeri kum ni, di chaŋ wula ka shɛb deeri kom baptaizibu tiri ba?.
en: If the dead are not going to be raised to life, what will people do who are being baptized for them? Why are they being baptized for those dead people?.

dag: Dunianima, wummiya, n yɛn chɛmi ka alɔbo lu niriba ŋɔ zuɣu, ka di leei bɛ tuma nyɔri, dama bɛ zaɣisi n yɛligu wumbu, ka zaɣisi n wuhibu gba.
en: Listen, earth! As punishment for all their schemes I am bringing ruin on these people, because they have rejected my teaching and have not obeyed my words.

dag: nti zaŋ ya chaŋ niriba maa tiŋgban nɛli ni, ka m mini ya gbɛri ti kpa taba, ka n kari ya saria.
en: and lead you into a desert surrounded by nations. I will meet you there face to face. Then I will pass judgment on you.

dag: Jɔtam yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaanu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam maa ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pinaayɔbu.
en: Jotham was years old when he became king. He ruled years in Jerusalem.

dag: Ʒim la ni ti nyɛla shihirili din wuhiri yi ni be yi yiya shɛŋa ni. Ka n yi ti kuri Ijiptinim na ti paai ya ka nya ʒim maa, n ni kpahi yaɣ ya gari, ka yinim yi alɔbo maa ni.
en: The blood will be your sign on the houses where you live. Whenever I see the blood, Ill pass over you. No plague will destroy you when I strike the land of Egypt.

dag: O daa zaŋla o ni mali binshɛɣukam zaa yiɣisi zo n-chaŋ ti gbaai Yufretiiz Mɔɣili du n-zaŋ o zuɣu kpa zoya ni tin shɛli din yuli booni Giliad la polo.
en: Jacob took his family and everything he owned and left quickly. They crossed the Euphrates River and traveled toward the hill country of Gilead.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb daa yi Judia n-ka Antiɔk na n-daa ti gbaai Yisa nyaandoliba wuhibu yɛri ni shee bɛ guniya kaman Anabi Musa ni daa zali shɛm la ni di yi pa lala bɛ ku tiligi.
en: Some men came from Judea to Antioch and started teaching the believers, You cannot be saved unless you are circumcised as the Law of Moses requires.

dag: O tiri paɣiŋoo bihi, ka zaŋd o leeri bihi ma ŋun mali suhupiɛlli. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: God nests the once barren woman at home— now a joyful mother with children! Praise the LORD!.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ Bɛtɛl Naawuni, luɣ shɛl a ni daa booi kpam bahi bimbini zuɣu ka po pɔri n san la. Yiɣisim tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni lab bɛ ni daa dɔɣ a tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni pumpɔŋɔ. .
en: I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed a sacred pillar and where you made a solemn promise to me. Now, get up and leave this country and go back to the land of your relatives.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi yɛli ŋun labina maa, Yiɣisim chaŋ a chandi; a yɛda niŋbu zuɣu n-chɛ ka a kpaŋ.
en: Then Jesus said to him, Get up and go. Your faith has healed you.

dag: O yi ti labina o dabisili la dali ni o ti nya tibiginsim o ninvuɣ gahinda sani, ka nya jilima bɛn zaa niŋ o yɛda la sani, yinim gba ni ti be bɛ ni, yi ni daa niŋ ti ni zaŋ shɛhira shɛli yɛla na nti yɛli ya la yɛda la zuɣu.
en: when he comes on that Day to receive glory from all his people and honor from all who believe. You too will be among them, because you have believed the message that we told you.

dag: Niriba yi daŋ yiɣisibu asiba n-tum tuun kpɛma bindirigu zuɣu hal ni yuŋ, ka bi daŋ gbihibu, di ka buchi, dama Yawɛ n-tir o ni yuri ninvuɣ shɛb gom.
en: It is useless to work so hard for a living, getting up early and going to bed late. For the Lord provides for those he loves, while they are asleep.

dag: Ka Asha bidibisi daa nyɛ: Imna mini Ishiva ni Ishivi ni Bɛraya ni bɛ tizɔpaɣ Sɛra. Ka Bɛraya bidibisi daa nyɛ: Hɛbɛr mini Malikiɛl.
en: Asher and his sons: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and their sister Serah. Beriah's sons were Heber and Malchiel.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ Yisa yɛdaniŋdib bɛn nyɛ Yɛhudianima n-doli Pita na la alahiziba bɛ ni daa nya ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim gba deei Naawuni Shia Kasi maa zuɣu;.
en: The Jewish believers who came with Peter were amazed that the Holy Spirit had been poured out as a gift also to people who were not Jews.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti ŋubi bin so ŋun kpi nyiŋgo muni bee biŋkɔbiri ni dar tɔhi binshɛli, dilan yi nyɛla tiŋbia bee sana, ŋun paɣim o situra, ka su kom, ka nyɛ ŋun ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni, di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi leei ŋun ka daɣiri ni.
en: Any people, Israelites or foreigners, who eat meat from an animal that has died a natural death or has been killed by wild animals must wash their clothes, take a bath, and wait until evening before they are ritually clean.

dag: Ka Yisa daa dii teeg o nuu na n-gbaag o ka bɔh o, Nyin ŋun yɛda pɔri ŋɔ, bɔ n-niŋ ka a biɛhinda.
en: Jesus immediately reached out and grabbed him, saying, You man of weak faith! Why did you begin to have doubts.

dag: Ka bɛ daa tim ti yɛli Jɛzibɛl, Ti lab Nabɔt kuɣa ku o.
en: Then the leaders sent a message to Jezebel that said: Naboth has been killed.

dag: Ka yi lan zaŋ bula yino mal alahichi sanyoo sara pahi yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim sahakam la mini di chi sara ni di binnyura sara la zuɣu.
en: There will be one male goat for a purification offering in addition to the regular entirely burned offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ninvuɣ shɛb be kpe ka ku kpi hal ka bɛ nini ti nya ka Naawuni nam kana ni yiko.
en: I can assure you that some of the people standing here will not die before they see God's kingdom come with power.

dag: Yisa daa ti kari alizin birigu do so zuɣu bahi; alizin birigu maa ni daa chaŋ naai ka doo maa lan leei ŋun tɔɣisira, ka di daa niŋ niriba maa alahiziba pam.
en: One time Jesus was sending a demon out of a man who could not talk. When the demon came out, the man was able to speak. The crowds were amazed.

dag: Yawɛ tumtumsa galisiya pam, ka ŋunkam yuri li bɔhindi li mi.
en: The works of the LORD are magnificent; they are treasured by all who desire them.

dag: dama nyɛvili gari bindirigu, ka niŋgbuŋ mi gari situra.
en: Life is much more important than food, and the body much more important than clothes.

dag: ka o ti niŋ ni biɛɣ pihinahi; ka Sintani daa ti zahim o. Yisa daa bi di shɛli di dabisa maa ni, ka di dabisa maa daa ti gari ka kum wum o.
en: where he was tempted by the Devil for forty days. In all that time he ate nothing, so that he was hungry when it was over.

dag: dindina n ni zo ni suhuyiɣisili ka chɛn ya, ka mmaŋmaŋ darigi yi tibili buyopɔin yi daalahichinim maa zuɣu.
en: then I will continue to oppose you—with anger! I will punish you for your sins seven more times.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, a nya dimbɔŋɔ? Di nyaaŋa ka o daa lan zaŋ ma doli mɔɣili maa duli labi.
en: He said to me, Human one, do you see? Then he led me back to the edge of the river.

dag: N shɛla buɣu m-pɔbi mmaŋa, ka zaŋ n yaa sɔŋ taŋkpaɣu ni.
en: I mourn and wear clothes made of sackcloth, and I sit here in the dust defeated.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira baptaizibu la, Naawuni n-daa lee zal li bee ninsalinima? Ka bɛ niŋ tab saawara yɛli, Ti yi yɛli ni Naawuni n-daa zal li, o ni bɔhi ti ni ka bɔ n-niŋ ka ti daa bi niŋ o yɛda?.
en: Where did John get his authority to baptize? Did he get it from heaven or from humans? They argued among themselves, If we say from heaven, hell say to us, Then why didnt you believe him.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka maligumaaniba kpamba daa lo nia ni bɛ ku Lazarɔs gba.
en: So the chief priests made plans to kill Lazarus.

dag: ka daa bahi Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni zuliyanima ayopɔin yoli, ka chɛ ka ti yaannim maa di bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa fali.
en: He destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan and made his people the owners of the land.

dag: Ka Pita daa bɔh o, Ananias, bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ka Sintani kpe a suhu ni ka a pii liɣiri maa shɛli sɔɣi ka ŋmari Naawuni Shia Kasi ʒiri?.
en: Peter said, Why has Satan made you keep back some of the money from the sale of the property? Why have you lied to the Holy Spirit?.

dag: Di saha ka tiŋgbani daa sɔhigi ka dam; ka zuɣusaa tanzahi daa sɔhigi ka dam o suhuyiɣisili zuɣu.
en: Earth shook and shivered! The columns supporting the sky rocked back and forth. You were angry.

dag: Bɛ ni ti bɔhi baŋ Ziɔn soli, ka zaŋ bɛ zuɣuri kpa nimaani polo, ka bɛ mini Yawɛ ti laɣim lo alikauli din kul ni ʒiɛya sahakam ka ku yiɣisi, ka bɛ ku lan tam di yɛla.
en: They will ask the way to Zion and then go in that direction. They will make an eternal covenant with me and never break it.

dag: Ka pakoli maa daa yi o sani kuli nti chɛ ka o min o bihi maa kpe duu ka yo bɛmaŋ niŋ di puuni; ka o bihi maa zaŋdi ŋmana n-zaan o, ka o boori kpam maa niŋdi di ni.
en: The woman left. Later, when she and her sons were back inside their house, the two sons brought her the jars, and she began filling them.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ŋmani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ? Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun ʒi nam kuɣu zuɣu zuɣusaa ha.
en: There is no one like the Lord our God. He lives in the heights above.

dag: Aduna ni daa nya li ka o me maligu bimbini zali di gbini, ka moli molo yɛli, Biɛɣuni ti sa yɛn puhila Yawɛ chuɣu.
en: Aaron saw all these things, so he built an altar in front of the calf. Then Aaron made an announcement. He said, Tomorrow will be a special festival to honor the Lord .

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ nyama, Ammɔnnim mini Mɔabnim ni Ɛdom zoli zuɣunima lola tɔb na ni bɛ ti liri ti. Saha shɛli Izraɛlnim ni daa yi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na ka a bi saɣi ni bɛ kpe zuliya shɛba tiŋgbɔna ni, ka bɛ daa chɛ ba ka bi ku ba la.
en: So look here! The Ammonites, the Moabites, and those from Mount Seir—the people you wouldnt let Israel invade when they came out of Egypts land, so Israel avoided them and didnt destroy them.

dag: Ka o ni tum so taali maa dɔɣiri so yi kani ka o ni zaŋ taali tumbu samli maa yo o, ŋun zaŋm li ti Yawɛ, ka bɛ zaŋ li ti maligumaana m-pahi piɛla so bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ mali sara ŋun tum taali maa zuɣu la.
en: But if that person has died and has no near relative to whom payment can be made, it shall be given to the Lord for the priest. This payment is in addition to the ram used to perform the ritual of purification for the guilty person.

dag: Ka Barak daa laɣim Zɛbulɔn mini Naftali zuliya niriba maa Kɛdɛshi, ka ninvuɣ tuhi pia daa dol o mini Dɛbɔra chaŋ.
en: Barak called the tribes of Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh, and ten thousand men followed him. Deborah went with him.

dag: Dindali maa tɔbbihi bɛn mali suhukpeeni ni ti zaŋ bɛ bidibbina bahi ka zo ni nuzaŋa. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: The bravest warrior will flee away naked in that day, says the LORD.

dag: N-daa yi biɛɣu ka o lan yi nti nya ka Izraɛlnim niriba ayi ŋmaligi zabira, ka o chaŋ ni o ti gooi ba ka yɛli, M mabihi, yi nyɛla mabi yinsi, ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yi lan ŋmaligi zabira.
en: The next day Moses saw two of his own people fighting, and he tried to make them stop. He said, Men, you are both Israelites. Why are you so cruel to each other.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti lan yiɣisi nimaani chaŋ ti dɔni Arinɔn Mɔɣili yaɣili yɔ shɛli din zaŋ hal ni Amɔrinim tintariga la ni; dama Arinɔn Mɔɣili n-nyɛ Mɔabnim tintariga m-be Mɔabnim mini Amɔrinim sunsuuni.
en: From there they moved again and camped on the north side of the Arnon River, in the wilderness which extends into Amorite territory.

dag: ka zibisim din ni chɛ ka a ku tooi nya mini kɔgbana lim a maa.
en: It has grown so dark that you cannot see, and a flood overwhelms you.

dag: Naa maa ni ti nyu sokpaŋ kulibɔŋ kom n-nya kpiɔŋ di nasara.
en: God drinks from a stream along the way, then holds his head up high.

dag: Yi mini Masia ni laɣim kpi ka yi yi alizinnim bɛn nyɛ dunia ŋɔ yɛliniŋda dabitim ni la, di chaŋ wula ka yi lan be kaman dunia ŋɔ ni su ninvuɣ shɛba? Bɔzuɣu ka yi doli zaligunim din yɛli:.
en: If you died with Christ to the way the world thinks and acts, why do you submit to rules and regulations as though you were living in the world?.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan bɔhi zom maa yaha, O ni neeg a nina maa, a lee tɛhiya ni o nyɛla ŋuni? Ka o yɛli ba, O nyɛla anabi.
en: So the Pharisees asked the man once more, You say he cured you of your blindness—well, what do you say about him? He is a prophet, the man answered.

dag: N tum din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli ni din tuhi. Di chɛ ma ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nahindi ma.
en: I did what was fair and right! Don't hand me over to those who want to mistreat me.

dag: Hanania bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Pɛlatia mini Jɛshaya ni o bia Rɛfaya ni o bia Arinan ni o bia Obadia ni o bia Shɛkania.
en: Hananiahs son was Pelatiah. His son was Jeshaiah. His son was Rephaiah. His son was Arnan. His son was Obadiah. His son was Shecaniah.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o ŋmaligi zaŋ din buɣisiri maa buɣisi nudirigu polo, ka di buɣisibu nyɛ mita kɔbisiyi ni pihinu.
en: the south side, seven hundred fifty feet.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Tiligira ni ka Jɛrusalɛm na nti tiligi Yaakubu zuliya bɛn niŋ tuuba bɛ daalahichi zuɣu.
en: The Lord says to his people, I will come to Jerusalem to defend you and to save all of you that turn from your sins.

dag: ka leei yi Ba, ka yi mi leei m bidibisi mini m bipuɣinsi. Ti Duuma Kpiɔŋlan Naa n-yɛl lala maa.
en: I will be your father, and you will be my sons and daughters, says the Lord All-Powerful. Samuel :; :.

dag: N ni daa siɣisi mmaŋa n-yihi Naawuni lahibal suŋ waazu tin ya ka bi deei ya shɛli ni di chɛ ka yi nya duhibu la, n tumla taali maa?.
en: I did the work of telling Gods Good News to you without pay. I humbled myself to make you important. Do you think that was wrong?.

dag: Zaŋ kana pumpɔŋɔ di di simdi ni yi nyɛla yi tab sowuhiriba, amaa ka yi ti na bɔrimi ni so n-wuhi ya Naawuni yɛtɔɣa bɔhimbu piligu ni yɛla. Yi na kul nyurila bihim, ka pa ni bindir maŋli.
en: There has been enough time for you to be teachers—yet you still need someone to teach you the first lessons of God's message. Instead of eating solid food, you still have to drink milk.

dag: amaa n suhu daa bi doya n ni daa bi nya ti mabia Taitus nimaani la zuɣu. Dina n-daa chɛ ka n chɛbisi bɛn be nimaani ka chaŋ Masidɔnia.
en: But I was worried because I couldnt find my brother Titus there. So I said good-bye to them and went on to Macedonia.

dag: Amaa ninsal mali buchi pam gari piɛɣu! Dinzuɣu di tuhiya ni nir tum tuun suŋ Vuhim Dabisili dali.
en: How much more valuable is a person than a sheep! So the Law allows a person to do what is good on the Sabbath.

dag: Wulimpuhili polo dunoli maa, niriba ayɔbuyɔbu n-daa yi gul li dabisili kam, ka niriba anahinahi daa yi guli nuzaa polo dunoya la dabisili kam, ka niriba ayiyi mi daa guli nɛma duu la dabisili kam.
en: On the east, six guards were on duty each day, on the north, four, and on the south, four. Four guards were stationed at the storerooms daily, two at each storeroom.

dag: Siria tinsi ni zani dabari zaa. Mɔri ni be nimaani, ka niɣi mini biŋkɔbbaligu ŋubira, ka so ku kari ba.
en: The cities of Syria will be deserted forever. They will be a pasture for sheep and cattle, and no one will drive them away.

dag: Dama nir niŋdila yɛda o suhu ni, ka yi taali ni Naawuni sani; ka yaag o noli kahigi wuhi palɔni, ka tiligi.
en: Trusting with the heart leads to righteousness, and confessing with the mouth leads to salvation.

dag: Di lan simdi ka yi ŋmaai palo shɛli din dolisi luɣ kasi yaɣili la ti Izraɛlnima ka bɛ me bɛ fɔntiŋa. Di wɔɣilim ni ti nyɛla kilomita pinaayi ni pirigili, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ kilomita ayi ni pirigili. Di ni ti nyɛla Izraɛlnim zaa ni su shɛli.
en: As the property for the city, you will set aside an area . miles wide and . miles long next to the holy portion. It will be for the whole house of Israel.

dag: O tim tiligira so ŋun nyɛ kpiɔŋlana ŋun yi o dabili Naa Dauda zuliya ni na.
en: He has given us a powerful Savior from the family of his servant David.

dag: Ka Yisa daa boli salo pah o nyaandoliba zuɣu na nti yɛli ba, Ŋunkam bɔri ni o doli ma, ŋun zaɣisim omaŋa ka kpuɣ o dapulli buɣi doli ma.
en: Then Jesus called the crowd and his disciples to him. If any of you want to come with me, he told them, you must forget yourself, carry your cross, and follow me.

dag: N yi tɛhi di yɛla, di gariti ma mi, ka dabiɛm mali ma, ka n ni sɔhira.
en: When I think about what happened to me, I feel afraid and my body shakes!.

dag: Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi ni ti kum ka fabili, amaa ka dunianim bɛn suhuri ti piɛla; yi suhuri ni ti saɣim, amaa yi suhusaɣiŋgu maa ni ti leei suhupiɛlli.
en: I am telling you the truth: you will cry and weep, but the world will be glad; you will be sad, but your sadness will turn into gladness.

dag: Zalim Izraɛlnim zaligu n-yɛli ba, M pina din nyɛ bindir shɛŋa yi ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim tiri ma ka di nyom niŋdi ma nyaɣisim la, zaŋmiya li tim ma di tibu saha.
en: to instruct the Israelites to present to God at the appointed times the required food offerings that are pleasing to him.

dag: ka daa bahi Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni zuliyanima ayopɔin yoli, ka chɛ ka ti yaannim maa di bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa fali.
en: He destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan and gave their land to our people.

dag: Bɛ nolɔbo maa mini bɛ Naawuni suhibu nyaaŋa, ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ nuhi pa bɛ zuɣu n-suhi alibarika niŋ bɛ ni, ka chɛbisi ba ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: After they fasted and prayed, they laid their hands on these two and sent them off.

dag: Dama Naawunitali biɛhigu zaa be Masia daadamtali niŋgbuŋ ni.
en: All the fullness of deity lives in Christs body.

dag: Ka din pah awɛi daa gbaai Matania min o bidibisi ni o mabihi. Bɛ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pinaayi.
en: the ninth to Mattaniah, his family, and his relatives.

dag: Rɛsɛn din be Ninive mini Kala din nyɛ tin tital la sunsuuni.
en: and Resen, which is between Nineveh and the great city of Calah.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daba ayi ha yuun shɛli din pahir ata ni, ka Yawɛ daa ti yɛli Ilaija, Cham ti zaŋ amaŋ wuhi Ɛhab, ka n chɛ ka saa mi dunia ni.
en: During the third year that no rain fell, the Lord said to Elijah, Go meet with King Ahab, and I will make it rain.

dag: Di moliya di yɛla gili Gaat fɔŋ ni; yi mi di moliya di yɛla doli Ashikɛlɔn solɔri, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka Filistia bipuɣinsi yiɣi jam, bee n-chɛ ka bɛn bi gundi ŋɔ bipuɣinsi suhuri paligi.
en: Don't tell it in Gath or spread the news on the streets of Ashkelon. The godless Philistine women will be happy and jump for joy.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ŋmani Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ? Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun ʒi nam kuɣu zuɣu zuɣusaa ha.
en: No one can compare with the Lord our God. His throne is high above.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ma, Daadam, kɔba ŋɔ ni tooi lan niŋ nyɛvili? Ka n garigi yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ, nyini m-mi.
en: He said to me, Mortal man, can these bones come back to life? I replied, Sovereign Lord , only you can answer that.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti yi Tɛra maa, bɛ daa chaŋ ti dɔnila Mitika.
en: They marched from Terah and camped at Mithkah.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Naa Bɛlishaaza daa ti laɣim o kpambaliba tuhili na ni bɛ ti puhi chu titali ka nyu wain.
en: One evening, King Belshazzar gave a great banquet for a thousand of his highest officials, and he drank wine with them.

dag: Naawuni zaŋ ma tila ninvuɣ biɛri, ka zaŋ ma niŋ putɔɣunim nuu ni.
en: God has given me to evil people. He let the wicked hurt me.

dag: Lala ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba ni tiŋ maa ni kpamba la gba daa maan o ansarisi yɛra.
en: The leading priests, the teachers of the law, and the older Jewish leaders were also there. They made fun of Jesus the same as the other people did.

dag: Ti ni daa paai Jɛrusalɛm, ti daa kpalim be nimaani la daba ata.
en: After arriving in Jerusalem, we rested there three days.

dag: M bolila do so ni o yi wulimpuhili polo kana. O yɛn kabimina kaman suligu la nti niŋ n ni lo ni n niŋ shɛli. Mani n yɛli maa, ka di mi shiri ni niŋ lala.
en: I am calling a man to come from the east; he will swoop down like a hawk and accomplish what I have planned. I have spoken, and it will be done.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa gbaag omaŋmaŋ binyɛra n-dar chahi li, ka bɛnkam daa be o sani gba daa niŋ lala.
en: At once, David and his soldiers tore their clothes in sorrow.

dag: Kush n-daa nyɛ Nimrɔd ba. O daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiri biiŋa dunia ni.
en: Cush was the father of Nimrod, the first warrior in the land.

dag: Di simdi ni ti zaŋ ti niɣi zaa chaŋ, hal naɣ takarifeeni ku kpalim. Di simdi ni ti zaŋ bɛ zaa chaŋ ti jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni maa, dama ti bi mi ti ni ti yɛn zaŋ shɛli mali sara ti Yawɛ naɣila ti paala nimaani.
en: Yes, we will take our animals with us to worship the Lord our God. Not one hoof will be left behind. We dont know yet exactly what we will need to worship the Lord . We will learn that only when we get there.

dag: A nyɛla jilimalana, ka mali dariza gari zo shɛŋa din zuɣu pali mɔɣu ni nimdi.
en: God, you are glorious coming back from the hills where you defeated your enemies.

dag: Ahitɔfɛl ni daa nya ka bɛ bi deeg o yikombiɛlim soli maa, ka o dii pa o buŋ gali n-kul o ya nti malimal o yiŋ binshɛɣukam zali dɛde ka yil omaŋ mia kpi, ka bɛ daa zaŋ o sɔɣ o yaannim siliga ni.
en: When Ahithophel saw that his advice had not been followed, he saddled his donkey and went back to his hometown. After putting his affairs in order, he hanged himself. He was buried in the family grave.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa tim Ɛliakim ŋun daa su nayili fukumsi la mini Shɛbina ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la ni maligumaaniba kpamba bɛn daa ye buri Amɔz bia anabi Aizaia sani.
en: Hezekiah sent Eliakim the palace manager, Shebna the royal secretary, and the elders of the priests to the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz. They wore the special clothes that showed they were sad and upset.

dag: Ka a yi ti chɛ ka a niriba ŋɔ doli so shɛlikam n-lo tɔbu chaŋ ni bɛ ti tuhi bɛ dimnima, ka bɛ zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tin shɛli a ni pii ŋɔ mini n ni me a jɛmbu du shɛli ŋɔ polo na ka suh a.
en: When your people go to war against their enemies, wherever you may send them, and they pray to the LORD toward the city you have chosen and toward this temple that I have built for your name.

dag: O ni kana nti ku padiriba maa, ka zaŋ o tihi puu maa niŋ padir shɛb nuu ni. Niriba maa ni daa wum lala maa ka bɛ yɛli, Naawuni tiligim ti ni ŋ-ŋɔ.
en: He will come and kill those men, and turn the vineyard over to other tenants. When the people heard this, they said, Surely not.

dag: N ni chɛ n niriba bɛn kpalim la bahi, ka zaŋ ba niŋ bɛ dimnim nuu ni, ka bɛ nyaŋ ba ka di bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ nɛma zaa.
en: I will even get rid of my people who survive. They will be defeated and robbed by their enemies.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛriya mi, Wummiya; chɛliya ka n gba yɛli din be n suhu ni.
en: So now I want you to listen to me; let me tell you what I think.

dag: Ka o bipalitab bɛn min o daa laɣim zooi maa yɛl o, Di ni simdi ni a yɛli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛl a, A ba daa ʒil ti ʒi tibisa pam, amaa nyin filimmi li ti ti la shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, yɛlim ba, Man nubil kpaliŋga bari gari m ba shee!.
en: The young people who had grown up with him said to him, This people said to you, Your father made our workload heavy; lighten it for us! Now this is what you should say to them: My baby finger is thicker than my fathers entire waist!.

dag: Amaa ka Samaria do so gba daa ti doli soli maa na nti paai nimaani nya o, ka di niŋ o nambɔɣu pam;.
en: A Samaritan, who was on a journey, came to where the man was. But when he saw him, he was moved with compassion.

dag: a yi zaŋ a salima bahi taŋkpaɣu ni, ka zaŋ salima din yi Ofiri na ti bahi kulibɔŋ kuŋ ni kuɣa zuɣu.
en: Think of your gold as nothing but dirt. Think of your finest gold as rocks from a stream.

dag: ka booi kpam bahi Nimshi bia Jɛhu zuɣu ni ka o leei Izraɛl naa; ka lan booi kpam bahi Shafat ŋun nyɛ Ɛbɛlimɛhola nir la bia Ilaisha zuɣu ni, ka o mi leeg anabi zani a zaani.
en: Then appoint Jehu son of Nimshi to be king of Israel, and Elisha son of Shaphat to take your place as my prophet.

dag: Birapu tibu ŋmanila tim bɛn tiri li sani, bɛ yi kul chaŋ luɣilikam bɛ dirila nasara.
en: A bribe works miracles like a magic charm that brings good luck.

dag: Ka Musa mini Aduna daa chaŋ ti kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni. Bɛ ni daa ti yi suɣili maa ni na, bɛ daa suhila alibarika niŋ niriba maa ni; ka Yawɛ jilima daa yi zahira niriba maa zaa sani.
en: Moses and Aaron went into the Tent of the Lord 's presence, and when they came out, they blessed the people, and the dazzling light of the Lord 's presence appeared to all the people.

dag: Jɛrɔbɔam daa yɛlila o suhu ni, N yi bi baŋ, nam ŋɔ ni bahi lab Dauda daŋ niriba ŋɔ sani.
en: Jeroboam thought to himself, The kingdom is in danger of reverting to the house of David.

dag: Yawɛ gari zuliya kam zaa, ka o jilima yaɣi sagbana zuɣu.
en: The Lord is far above all of the nations; he is more glorious than the heavens.

dag: Dundɔŋ maa yɛliŋ zaŋ labi wulinluhili polo, di simdi ka di ti mali pateesanim din wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pisinaayi yil li, ka di mali daantalisi pia mini di ni yɛn tamdi binshɛŋa zuɣu.
en: The courtyards width on the west side should consist of seventy-five feet of drapes with their ten posts and their ten bases.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa.
en: The Lord God said to Moses:.

dag: Ifriimnima, wula ka n ni tooi zaɣisi ya? Izraɛlnima, wula ka n ni tooi chɛn ya bahi? Wula ka n ni niŋ ya kaman n ni daa niŋ Adimanim shɛm la? Ka wula ka n ni tooi niŋ ya kaman n ni daa niŋ Zɛbɔiimnim shɛm la? N suhu taɣiya, ka n nambɔzɔbo galisi.
en: How can I give you up, Israel? How can I abandon you? Could I ever destroy you as I did Admah, or treat you as I did Zeboiim? My heart will not let me do it! My love for you is too strong.

dag: M bia, dim shiri, dama di nyɛla din viɛla, ka shikpam din tɔɣiri shigbaŋ ni na nyɛla din nyaɣis a noli ni.
en: Honey is good for you, my children, and it tastes sweet.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka a wurim duɣu maa, a mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn chaŋ maa ninni.
en: Jeremiah, as soon as you have said this, smash the jar while the people are watching.

dag: Pool mini niriba anahi maa ni daa mali bɛmaŋa ka di ti miri daba ayopɔin paabu saha shɛli ka Yɛhudianim bɛn daa yi Ɛsha na nya Pool Naawuni jɛmbu duu n-gbaag o n-chɛ ka niriba suhuri yiɣisi bahi o zuɣu.
en: But just when the seven days were about to come to an end, some Jews from the province of Asia saw Paul in the Temple. They stirred up the whole crowd and grabbed Paul.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Haman ti yil o ni daa sa gar da shɛŋa ni o zaŋ M.
en: So they impaled Haman on the very pole that he had set up for Mordecai, and the kings anger went away.

dag: Zaɣ biɛɣu yi be a nuu ni, nyin yihimi li kpaŋa, ka miri ka a chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu be a yiŋa.
en: and give up your sins— even those you do in secret.

dag: Bɛ ni ti pirig a situra, ka yeeg a yɛ viɛla zaa.
en: Your clothes and jewelry will be torn off.

dag: Yurilim saha beni, ka jɛlinsi saha beni. Tɔbu tuhibu saha beni, ka tɔbu tuhibu ni kani saha shɛli beni.
en: a time for loving and a time for hating, a time for war and a time for peace.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Otiniɛl Kɛnaz bia maa daa kpi.
en: There was peace in the land for forty years, and then Othniel died.

dag: Nyin daadam, a ni kari saria, a ni kari tin shɛli nim bɛn kuri niriba ŋɔ saria? Di nyaaŋa ka a yɛli ba bɛ ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa zaa.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, are you ready to condemn Jerusalem? That city is filled with murderers, so remind the people of their sins.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yihi tinsi pinaata Isaka zuliya mini Asha zuliya ni Naftali zuliya ni Manaasa zuliya bɛn be Bashan la tiŋgbana ni n-zaŋ tari Gɛrishomnima kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The Levite clan of Gershon received thirteen towns from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and East Manasseh in Bashan.

dag: Ka Naa Rɛhɔbɔam daa be Jɛrusalɛm, ka me goondahi gili fɔntinsi ni di taɣi Judanima.
en: Rehoboam lived in Jerusalem, but he built cities for Judahs defense.

dag: M bolila n tumtumda, amaa ka o bi garigi ma. Di simdi ni mmaŋmaŋ balim o.
en: I call for my servant, but he does not answer. Even if I beg for help, he will not answer.

dag: Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni zani dabari ka yi suhuri paligi shɛm, lala ka n yɛn niŋ yi gba; nyini Siɛr Zoli mini Ɛdom zaa ni zani dabari. Di saha ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: just as you celebrated when Israel was destroyed. Your nation of Edom will be nothing but a wasteland. Then everyone will know that I am the Lord .

dag: ka zaŋ firilanim la tamtam di zuɣu Yawɛ tooni kaman Yawɛ ni daa wuh o shɛm.
en: and there in the Lord 's presence he lit the lamps, just as the Lord had commanded.

dag: Dama bɛ tɔɣisiri ya la ʒiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa ni di chɛ ka bɛ yihi ya yi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni n-zaŋ ya tahi katiŋa. N ni kari ya bahi ka yi ti kpi.
en: They are deceiving you and will cause you to be taken far away from your country. I will drive you out, and you will be destroyed.

dag: Ka Asa daa chaŋ ni o ti tuh o. Ka bɛ zaa daa zani bɛ tɔb gɔri ni Zɛfata din daa be Marɛsha la vinvamli ni.
en: Asa went out to fight him, and both sides took up their positions at Zephathah Valley near Mareshah.

dag: Babilɔn bipuɣiŋga, a ni nya tibidarigibo, a ni daa niŋ ti shɛm la zuɣu. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ti yɛn bɔh a biɛri ni ti mali suhupiɛlli!.
en: Babylon, you are doomed! I pray the Lord's blessings on anyone who punishes you for what you did to us.

dag: Ka yi ni tumdi binshɛɣukam zaa tiri ba puuni, tummiya li ni yi suhuri zaa kaman ti Duuma ka yi tumdi li tiri la, ka pa ni ninsalinim ka yi tumdi li tira.
en: Do your work willingly, as though you were serving the Lord himself, and not just your earthly master.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ku o min o bihi ni o niriba zaa hal ka o ninvuɣ yino gba bi tiligi; ka daa deeg o tiŋgbɔŋ maa su.
en: They slaughtered Og, his sons, and all his people until there were no survivors. Then they took possession of his land.

dag: N daa je suli n-tin ya nanima, ka n suhu ti yiɣisi, ka n lan deei ba ka chɛn ya.
en: In my anger I have given you kings, and in my fury I have taken them away.

dag: Ka di daa ti niŋ zaawun yuŋ ka o nyaandoliba chaŋ o sani nti yɛl o, Kpe nyɛla mɔɣu ni, ka wuntaŋ mi yɛn lu, dinzuɣu bahim niriba maa ka bɛ chaŋ tiŋkpansi nti da bindira di.
en: Late that afternoon, the followers came to Jesus and said, No one lives in this place. And it is already late. Send the people away so they can go to the towns and buy food for themselves.

dag: Ka n daa galim zuɣulaannim la pam ka bɔhi ba, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi chɛ Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa bahi? Ka n daa laɣim ba na nti zaŋ ba zali bɛ zaashɛhi.
en: So I told the officials that they were wrong. I asked them, Why didnt you take care of Gods Temple? Then I called all Levites together and told them to go back to their places and duties in the Temple.

dag: Bɛ ni daa bi nya ba ka bɛ gbaai Jeesɔn min o yɛdaniŋditab shɛba n-vo ba tahi tiŋ maa kpamba sani ka kuhiri yɛra, Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lɛbigiri dunia pindi tiŋ la paai ti ya ŋɔ gba na.
en: But when they did not find them, they dragged Jason and some other believers before the city authorities and shouted, These men have caused trouble everywhere! Now they have come to our city.

dag: Ŋuna ka Naawuni tibigi n-zaŋ o ʒili o nudirigu polo ni o leei ti toondana ni ti tiligira n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim niŋ tuuba ka nya alahichi chɛ m-paŋ.
en: God has exalted Jesus to his right side as leader and savior so that he could enable Israel to change its heart and life and to find forgiveness for sins.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa gbahi Midian paɣiba mini bɛ bihi, ka gbahi bɛ niɣi mini bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu zaa, ka di bɛ nɛma zaa chaŋ.
en: The Israelites captured every woman and child, then led away the Midianites' cattle and sheep, and took everything else that belonged to them.

dag: Amaa ka Ijipti naa maa daa yɛli ba, Musa mini Aduna, bɔzuɣu ka yi chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa bi tumdi bɛ tuma? Chamiya ti tum yi tuma.
en: But Pharaoh said to them, Moses and Aaron, you are bothering the workers. Let them do their work. Go back to your own work!.

dag: Amaa ka Ziɔnnim yɛli, Yawɛ chɛ ti bahi! O tam ti yɛla.
en: But Zion says, The LORD has abandoned me; my Lord has forgotten me.

dag: ka Lɛvinim bɛn ka tarili bee fali yi sani la mini tinzunnim bɛn be yi sani ni kpibisi ni pakoya bɛn be yi tinsi ni gba di n-tiɣi, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ niŋ alibarika niŋ yi tuma zaa ni.
en: This food is for the Levites, since they own no property, and for the foreigners, orphans, and widows who live in your towns. They are to come and get all they need. Do this, and the Lord your God will bless you in everything you do.

dag: Izraɛl ninvuɣ so bee saan shɛb bɛn be bɛ sani ninvuɣ so yi ti ŋubi bin so ŋun kpi nyiŋgo muni, n suhu ni yiɣisi bahi dilan zuɣu, ka yih o n niriba ni.
en: If any Israelites or any foreigners living in the community eat meat with blood still in it, the Lord will turn against them and no longer consider them his people.

dag: Bɛ ni daa di n-tiɣi zaa, ka o yɛl o nyaandoliba ni bɛ laɣisim bɔrɔbɔro chɛhi din guui maa zaa ka di shɛli ku bahi yoli.
en: The people ate all they wanted, and Jesus told his disciples to gather up the leftovers, so that nothing would be wasted.

dag: Ka Ilaija daa chaŋ ti dɔni miri Chɛrit kulibɔŋ din be Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili wulimpuhili polo maa kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛl o shɛm maa.
en: Elijah obeyed the Lord and went to live near Cherith Creek.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa kuhi pam yɛli, M Ba Naawuni, n zaŋ n shia niŋ a nuu ni! O ni daa yɛl lala maa ka o dii bahi.
en: Jesus shouted, Father, I put myself in your hands! Then he died.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa baŋ ni Yawɛ zaŋ o leei Izraɛlnim zaa naa, ka lan chɛ ka o nam du pam o niriba Izraɛlnim zuɣu.
en: Then David understood that the Lord had really made him king of Israel. And he had made his kingdom large and powerful for the benefit of Israel, his people.

dag: Saha shɛli ha yi gba daa bela katiŋ ni Naawuni, ka nyɛ o dimnima yi biɛhigu puuni yi ni daa tɛhiri bin biɛ shɛŋa yɛla ka tumdi li la zuɣu.
en: Once you were alienated from God and you were enemies with him in your minds, which was shown by your evil actions.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ zaŋm a niriba yi yuŋ chaŋ mɔɣu ni nti sɔɣ dɔni gu ba.
en: Now, you and the men who are with you: Get up tonight and set an ambush in the fields.

dag: Yinim garinsi zuliya ŋɔ, wula ka yɛtɔɣ suma ni tooi yi yi nol ni na ka yi nyɛ ninvuɣ biɛri ŋɔ? Dama din be sal suhu ni, dina n-yir o nol ni na.
en: Children of snakes! How can you speak good things while you are evil? What fills the heart comes out of the mouth.

dag: ni Ɛnrimɔn ni Zɔra ni Jarimut.
en: and in En Rimmon, in Zorah, in Jarmuth.

dag: N ni ti yɛn darigi Ijiptinim tibili shɛm m-bala. Di saha ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: When I'm through punishing Egypt, you will know that I am the Lord .

dag: A zaligunim nyɛla yɛlimaŋli. Yawɛ, a jɛmbu duu nyɛla din simdi ni di kul be kasi sahakam.
en: Your laws are so faithful. Holiness decorates your house, LORD, for all time.

dag: Suhimi Yawɛ ti ti, Babilɔn naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni kana ti liri ti la zuɣu. Di pa shɛli Yawɛ ni tum alahiziba tuma ti ti kaman o ni pun niŋdi shɛm la, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka o zo ka chɛ ti.
en: Speak to the LORD on our behalf because Babylons King Nebuchadnezzar is attacking us. Perhaps the LORD will perform one of his mighty deeds and force him to withdraw from us.

dag: ka Farisiinim mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba daa ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni yɛra, Doo ŋɔ kul chɛri ka alahichinim kanila o sanna hal ka o mini ba ti laɣindi dira.
en: So the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law of Moses started grumbling, This man is friendly with sinners. He even eats with them.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka anabi Aizaia daa ka Naa Hɛzɛkia sanna nti bɔh o, Ya polo ka niriba maa lee yina, ka wula ka bɛ lee yɛl a? Ka Hɛzɛkia daa garigi yɛli, Bɛ yila Babilɔn din nyɛ tin shɛli din be katiŋ la n-ka n sanna.
en: Then Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah and said to him, What did these men say? Where did they come from? Hezekiah replied, They came to me from a distant land, from Babylon.

dag: Di saha maa ka Anabi Jɛrimia ni daa yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. O ni daa yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This fulfilled the word spoken through Jeremiah the prophet.

dag: Yi nini na kul bi neei? N ni daa ŋmahi bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu n-dihi niriba tusaanu la, yi bi teei yi ni daa laɣisi li pali piɛ shɛŋa tariga la yɛla?.
en: Don't you understand yet? Don't you remember when I broke the five loaves for the five thousand men? How many baskets did you fill?.

dag: Pool ni daa yɛl lala naai ka zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro n-suhi Naawuni daalibarika niŋ di ni bɛ zaa ninni, ka zaŋ li ŋubi.
en: After Paul had said this, he took a piece of bread and gave thanks to God. Then in front of everyone, he broke the bread and ate some.

dag: Ka Jɛsi daa bo bɔrɔbɔro mini wain koligu pali ni busaa n-zaŋ pa buŋ zuɣu ti o bia Dauda ni o zaŋ mali chaŋ Sool sani.
en: Jesse sent David to Saul with a young goat, a donkey loaded with bread, and a leather bag full of wine.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yihi tinsi pinaata Isaka zuliya mini Asha zuliya ni Naftali zuliya ni Manaasa zuliya bɛn be Bashan la tiŋgbana ni n-zaŋ tari Gɛrishomnima kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: The Gershomites received by lot according to their clans thirteen towns from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and Manasseh in Bashan.

dag: Shɛb daa ʒila zibisim mini bumbɔn ni, ka nyɛ sarikanima, ka bɛ ba ba bandi ʒili ka bɛ diri wahala.
en: Some of Gods people were prisoners, locked behind bars in dark prisons.

dag: Ka din daa lu vuhim shee la, din ŋmanila bɛn wum Naawuni yɛligu maa ka gbib li kirikiri bɛ suhuri ni ni yɛlimaŋli, ka di dɔɣira n-niŋdi biɛlim pam bɛ suɣilo dibu puuni la.
en: And what about the seed that fell on the good ground? That is like the people who hear Gods teaching with a good, honest heart. They obey it and patiently produce a good crop.

dag: Ka niriba bɛn daa paɣiri Naawuni la pirigibu bɛn pahi buyi daa zaŋ kpa gooni maa zuɣu nuzaa polo, ka m mi zaŋ bɛ pirigili n-doli bɛ nyaaŋa gooni maa zuɣu Kpimkpimbihi Pia zuɣusaa polo m-mali hal ti paai Goon Yɛlinli la shee.
en: The other group of those who gave thanks went to the left along the top of the wall, and I followed with half of the people. We marched past the Tower of the Ovens to the Broad Wall.

dag: Ka o daa boli kɔbiliga maa yuli Shiiba. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ booni tiŋ maa yuli Bɛrishiiba hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: So Isaac named it Shibah. And that city is still called Beersheba.

dag: Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya ŋɔ, teemiya dimbɔŋɔ; yi nyɛla n-daba. Mani n-nam ya ni yi nyɛ n daba. N ku tam yi yɛla.
en: People of Israel, you are my servant, so remember all of this. Israel, I created you, and you are my servant. I won't forget you.

dag: Dama o daa dolila Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam soli, ka tumdi alahichi shɛŋa o ni daa tum n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim jɛm buɣa n-tum alahichi, ka di chɛ ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ suhu yiɣisi la.
en: He acted just like Jeroboam and made the Lord God of Israel angry by causing the Israelites to sin and to worship idols.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ ŋme chɛrubinim kɔtomsi mini abie tihi ni tipuma din yirigi pa di zuɣu, ka dooi salima pa bɛ ni ŋme binshɛŋa kɔtomsi maa zuɣu n-saɣisi taba.
en: They carved pictures of Cherub angels, palm trees, and flowers on the doors. Then they covered them with gold.

dag: Ka malaika ŋun pah anu daa kpaag o laa ni dini bahi biŋkɔbigu la nam ʒiishee, ka o nam sulinsi tariga zaa daa zibigi, ka niriba daa dimdi be zilima biɛrim zuɣu.
en: The fifth angel poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast. And darkness covered the beasts kingdom. People bit their tongues because of the pain.

dag: ŋuna n-nyɛ ti Naawuni, ŋuna n-nyɛ ti Naawuni hal ni saha din ka bahigu; ŋuna n-kul yɛn wuhiri ti soli sahakam.
en: This God is our God forever and ever. He will lead us from now to the end of time!.

dag: Yisa daa yɛliya, Mani n-nyɛ wain ti maŋli la, ka m Ba mi nyɛ di gula.
en: I am the real vine, and my Father is the gardener.

dag: Naɣ kul miriya ka yi ti ŋubila binʒim, dama ʒim nyɛla nyɛvili, ka di bi simdi ni yi ti ŋubi nimdi mini di nyɛvili.
en: Furthermore, make sure that you dont consume any of the blood, because blood is life. You must not consume the life along with the meat.

dag: Bɛ ni ti kɔri taŋkpaɣu duhiduhi, ka me teei gili goma ni bɛ ku niriba pam. Firawuna min o tɔbbihi pam bɛn mali yaa ku tuhi tɔbu maa sɔŋ o.
en: The king of Egypt will not be able to save the king of Judah. He might send many soldiers, but Egypts great power will not save Judah. Nebuchadnezzars army will build dirt roads and dirt walls to capture the city. Many people will die.

dag: O chɛ ka niriba lihi ʒiɛm ma, ka tuhiri nintɔri viɛri n ninni.
en: And now people use this proverb against me; they come and spit in my face.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔri Yawɛ, yɛlimiya, O yurilim maŋli bi naara.
en: Let every true worshiper of the Lord shout, God is always merciful.

dag: Dauda ni daa labi Zikilag, o daa piila o ni tuhi di neen shɛŋa maa shɛli nti ti o zɔnim bɛn daa nyɛ Juda kpamba la ka yɛli ba, N ni tuhi Yawɛ dimnim ka di neen shɛŋa ka m pii tin ya na maa.
en: When David returned to Ziklag, he sent part of the loot to his friends, the leaders of Judah, with the message, Here is a present for you from the loot we took from the Lord 's enemies.

dag: Bɛ kabɔɣa mini bɛ wain tɔɣiri bɔɣa ku dihi ba, ka bɛ ku nya wain palli.
en: But you will run short of grain and wine.

dag: ka o zaŋdi ba chani tɔbu ni ka zaŋdi ba labirina; ka di chɛ ka nyin Yawɛ niriba ku be kaman piɛri bɛn ka gula.
en: and can command them in battle, so that your community will not be like sheep without a shepherd.

dag: Man maŋmaŋ ni ti pa nina lihiri dilana, ka yih o n niriba ni, o ni zaŋ o bia ti Molɛk n-ta m biɛhigu shee daɣiri, ka dihi n yuli din be kasi ŋɔ vi zuɣu.
en: If any of you give one of your children to Molech and make my sacred Tent unclean and disgrace my holy name, I will turn against you and will no longer consider you my people.

dag: N ni yu a zaligunim maa; n ku tam a yɛligu yɛla.
en: I take pleasure in your laws; your commands I will not forget.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa daa bi baŋ o ni yɛli shɛm maa gbinni, amaa ka mi daa lee zɔr o suhu ni bɛ bɔh o baŋ.
en: But they didnt understand this kind of talk, and they were afraid to ask him.

dag: Ka o chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ li ti tuma zuɣulaannim bɛn lihiri ka bɛ tumdi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu tuma la, ka bɛ zaŋ li yo tumtumdiba bɛn tumdi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa tuma maa.
en: It should be given to the supervisors in charge of the LORDs temple, who in turn should pay it to those who are in the LORDs temple, repairing the temple.

dag: A naɣ ni zaŋla a nina lihi nya ninvuɣ biɛri tibidarigibo.
en: Just look with your eyes, and you will see the wicked punished.

dag: O min o yiŋ zaa ni daa deei kom baptaizibu nyaaŋa ka o balim ti yɛli, Yi yi zahim ma nya ka n nyɛla ŋun ʒe yim n suhu ni ni ti Duuma, yin kamiyana ti be n yiŋa. Ka o ni daa balim ti ni nimmoo zuɣu chɛ ka ti niŋ lala.
en: Once she and her household were baptized, she urged, Now that you have decided that I am a believer in the Lord, come and stay in my house. And she persuaded us.

dag: Jɛrigu ni lo shɛli nyɛla alahichi, ka ansarisimaana mi nyɛ sokam ni je ninvuɣ so.
en: The scheming of fools is sin; people detest mockers.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi yi maani yɛla ŋɔ tatabo, di chaŋ wula ka yi zaŋdi yi yɛla tahiri cheechi ni bi dihi ninvuɣ shɛb bebu tabili sani?.
en: Why do you take everyday complaints to judges who are not respected by the church?.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka di daa muɣisi Dauda pam, o ni daa ŋmaai Sool binyɛrigu maa zuɣu.
en: But then David's conscience began to hurt.

dag: dindina yi ni nya suhupiɛlli man Yawɛ sani, ka n chɛ ka yi nya jilima dunia ŋɔ luɣ shɛlikam zaa; ka chɛ ka yi di n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ti yi yab Yaakubu la daanfaani. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Then you will truly enjoy knowing the Lord . He will let you rule from the highest mountains and bless you with the land of your ancestor Jacob. The Lord has spoken!.

dag: Bɛ kuhiri booni ma, Ti Naawuni, tinim Izraɛlnim mi a.
en: Israel, you say, We claim you, the Lord , as our God.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni sakom leei taŋkpa zim ka duɣiduɣi kɔŋko yiri sagbana ni luri yi zuɣu na hal ti kun ya.
en: Instead of rain, the Lord will send down duststorms and sandstorms until you are destroyed.

dag: Teeku n-doya ŋɔ, di galisiya ka yɛlim pam, biŋgbamda bɛn ka kalinli m-be di ni. Bɛ nyɛla binneen kara ni zaɣ bihi.
en: There is the ocean, large and wide, where countless creatures live, large and small alike.

dag: Jaande chɛ ka n labi n ya ti kpi ka bɛ sɔɣi ma baɣili m ba mini m ma gbala. Amaa a dabili Chimham m-bɔŋɔ, chɛ ka o doli nyini n dan naa kuli ka a ti niŋ o a ni nya ka shɛli viɛl a sani.
en: Just let me return to my hometown, where I can someday be buried near my father and mother. My servant Chimham can go with you, and you can treat him as your own.

dag: Dama bɛ birila pɔhim, bɛ ni chɛla pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga. Bɛ chi ni saai ʒiɛya ka ku niŋ bindirigu. Ka di yi niŋ bindirigu, tinzunnima n-ni di li.
en: Because they sow the wind, they will get the whirlwind. Standing grain, but no fresh growth; it will yield no meal; if it were to yield, strangers would devour it.

dag: ka o yɛl o mabihi maa, Bɛ zaŋla n liɣiri labisi niŋ ma, dina m-be n kpalaŋ ni ŋɔ. Ka bɛ suhuri daa fuŋ di zuɣu, ka bɛ ni sɔhiri ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Ka tuun bɔ ka Naawuni lee tum ti ŋɔ.
en: He said to the other brothers, Look! Here is the money I paid for the grain. Someone put the money back in my sack. The brothers were very afraid. They said to one another, What is God doing to us.

dag: Ka Siria naa maa daa yɛl o, Cham pumpɔŋɔ! N ni sab gbaŋ ti a ka a mali ti ti Izraɛl naa. Ka Naaman daa bo anzinfa laɣibaligu tuhi pia mini salima laɣibaligu tusaayɔbu ni binyɛr suma din nyɛ chuɣu binyɛra pia chaŋ.
en: the king replied, Go ahead! I will give you a letter to take to the king of Israel. Naaman left and took along , pieces of silver, , pieces of gold, and new outfits.

dag: Ka yi yurilim tuuni maa tumbu zuɣu ni chɛ ka niriba paɣi Naawuni, dama di wuhiri yi ni deeri ŋun Naawuni noli shɛm Masia lahibal suŋ yɛda niŋbu ni mini yi ni tiri Yisa nyaandoliba zaŋ tabili sokam zaa pina la ni.
en: And because of the proof which this service of yours brings, many will give glory to God for your loyalty to the gospel of Christ, which you profess, and for your generosity in sharing with them and everyone else.

dag: Manaasa bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Asiriɛl, o mam ŋun daa nyɛ Aram paɣ la ni daa dɔɣi bi so, ŋuna n-daa lan dɔɣi Makiri ŋun daa nyɛ Giliad ba la.
en: Manasseh and his Syrian wife were the parents of Asriel and Machir the father of Gilead.

dag: Amɔs daa yɛliya, Bɛ wum Yawɛ damli Ziɔn zoli zuɣu; ka o kukoli tahigu yi Jɛrusalɛm na. Biŋkɔbiri mɔŋubira kuuya, ka Kamɛl Zoli zuɣu kuui.
en: He said: The LORD roars from Zion. He shouts from Jerusalem; the pastures of the shepherds wither, and the top of Carmel dries up.

dag: Ka o suhu daa yiɣisi bah o niriba maa zuɣu, ka chɛ ka bɛ dimnim zaŋ takɔbiri ku ba.
en: God took out his anger on his chosen ones and let them be killed by enemy swords.

dag: bɛ muɣisigu zaa ni. Pa malaika ka o daa tim na, amaa ŋun Yawɛ maŋmaŋa n-daa tiligi ba. O nambɔzɔbo min o yurilim zuɣu ka o daa tiligi ba. Ŋuna n-daa pun gbib ba piligu ni ha.
en: During all their distress, God also was distressed, so a messenger who served him saved them. In love and mercy God redeemed them, lifting and carrying them throughout earlier times.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Zɛbulɔn zuliya paya. Zɛbulɔn niriba maa toondana n-yɛn nyɛ Hɛlɔn bia Ɛliab.
en: The tribe of Zebulun will also camp next to the tribe of Judah. The leader of the tribe of Zebulun is Eliab son of Helon.

dag: Bɛn daa be o nuzaa polo n-daa nyɛ bɛ mabihi bɛn daa nyɛ Mɛrari bidibisi la, Ɛtan daa nyɛla Kish bia, ka Kish nyɛ Abidi bia, ka Abidi nyɛ Maluk bia.
en: On the left were their relatives, Meraris family: Ethan son of Kishi son of Abdi son of Malluch.

dag: Do so ŋun yuli daa booni Ananias ka o nyɛ wuntizɔra kaman Naawuni zaligu ni wuhi shɛm la daa nyɛla ŋun mali yu suŋ nimaani Yɛhudianim zaa sani.
en: In that city was a man named Ananias, a religious man who obeyed our Law and was highly respected by all the Jews living there.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa bɔhi nachimbil so ŋun yɛl o li maa, Wula ka a lee niŋ baŋ ni Sool min o bia Jɔnatan lu tɔb maa ni.
en: How do you know, David asked the young man who brought the news, that Saul and his son Jonathan are dead.

dag: Yawɛ shiri tum tuun kara ti ti, ka ti suhuri paligi pam.
en: Yes, we will be happy because the Lord did a great thing for us.

dag: Yi bindir daŋda dina, yi ni tooi zaŋ li na ti ti Yawɛ, amaa di bi simdi ka yi nyo li buɣim sara maligu bimbini zuɣu ni di leei din nyom viɛla.
en: You may offer either of them separately, when you present the first part of your harvest to me, but they must never be burned on the altar.

dag: Ka Yisa daa dii teeg o nuu na n-gbaag o ka bɔh o, Nyin ŋun yɛda pɔri ŋɔ, bɔ n-niŋ ka a biɛhinda.
en: At once Jesus reached out and grabbed hold of him and said, What little faith you have! Why did you doubt.

dag: Amaa wuhim Jɔshua ka kpaŋs o suhu, dama ŋuna n-yɛn leei niriba ŋɔ zuɣulana n-zaŋ ba du nti deei a ni yɛn nya tiŋgbɔn shɛli maa ti ba.
en: Instead, command Joshua, strengthen him, and encourage him because hes the one who will cross the river before this people. Hes the one who will make sure they inherit the land you will see.

dag: amaa ka ŋmani maa daa yiɣi chaŋ ti bi nya o ni yɛn tam binshɛli zuɣu, dama kom maa daa na kul tɛlila tiŋgbani luɣilikam zaa. Ka o daa lab o sani ŋariŋ maa ni, ka o ti zaŋ o nuu tiri takɔro maa ni n-gbaag o kpɛh o sani ŋariŋ maa ni.
en: The dove could not find a place to rest because water still covered the earth, so the dove came back to the boat. Noah reached out his hand and caught the dove and brought it back into the boat.

dag: Yuun pihita puuni gol so ŋun pahir anahi daba anu dali, n daa bela bɛ ni gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb chaŋ la sani Kɛba Mɔɣili duli, ka zuɣusaa daa yooi, ka n nya ʒiinim din yi Naawuni sanna.
en: On the fifth day of the fourth month of the thirtieth year, I, Ezekiel the priest, son of Buzi, was living with the Jewish exiles by the Chebar River in Babylonia. The sky opened, and I saw a vision of God. .

dag: O kul ku nyari nir taali sahakam, bee n-jɛri suli sahakam.
en: God wont always play the judge; he wont be angry forever.

dag: Ka Mikaya daa garigi yɛl o, Nyama, a yi ti zo n-kpe duu puuni ti sɔɣi, dindali maa ka a yɛn baŋ.
en: You will find out when you go into some back room to hide, Micaiah replied.

dag: Yisa ni daa nya ka bɛ niŋ o yɛda shɛm maa ka o yɛli bar maa, Zɔri, n chɛ a daalahichi paŋ a.
en: When Jesus saw how much faith they had, he said to the man, My friend, your sins are forgiven.

dag: Ka n teei ti Duuma ni daa yɛli ni Jɔn Baptaizira daa baptaiziri niriba la kom ni, amaa yinima ni dee la Naawuni Shia Kasi baptaizibu la yɛla.
en: Then I remembered what the Lord had said: John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.

dag: Ka suhimiya Naawuni tiri nazuɣuri mini bɛn su fukumsi din ni chɛ ka ti be ni alaafee, ka mali suhudoo n-niŋdi din luri Naawuni sizuura ka tumdi din tuhi daadamnim ninni;.
en: You should pray for rulers and for all who have authority. Pray for these leaders so that we can live quiet and peaceful lives—lives full of devotion to God and respect for him.

dag: Ka Musa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza daa deei bɛ ni daa zaŋ salima mali binshɛŋa maa zaa.
en: Moses and Eleazar the priest took all the gold articles from them.

dag: Nyamiya, n zaŋla nyɛvili mini tɔŋsim ni kum mini ashaara n-zali yi tooni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Today I am giving you a choice between good and evil, between life and death.

dag: Musa ni daa ti Yawɛ jɛmbu suɣili la naai dahin shɛli, o daa boola kpam bahi di zuɣu m-mali di mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni zaa ka di be kasi, ka lan booi kpam bahi sara maligu bimbini mini di nɛma zaa zuɣu m-mali di gba ka di be kasi.
en: On the day when Moses finished setting up the dwelling, he anointed and made it holy. All its equipment, as well as the altar and all its equipment, he also anointed and made holy.

dag: Bɛ tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣ yoya, ka lɔri alikauli, ka pɔri pɔri din ka buchi, dinzuɣu saria karibu tɔhi zanna kaman mɔ shɛŋa din nyɛ bɔchaa ni bili puu ni shɛm la.
en: They have spoken empty words, swearing falsely when making covenants; so judgment springs up like poisonous weeds in the furrows of the field.

dag: Ka yi ni so yɛl o ni o cham ni suhudoo; ka lan yɛl o ni Naawuni ni chɛ ka o nya n-ye ka di n-tiɣi, amaa ka bi ti o binshɛl din simd o niŋgbuŋ, di buchi lee nyɛla dini?.
en: And you say to them, God be with you! I hope you stay warm and get plenty to eat, but you dont give them the things they need. If you dont help them, your words are worthless.

dag: O tim buɣim ka di yi zuɣusaa na, ka di nyooi ma hal ti kpe n kɔba ni. O bari zana, ka di gbaai n naba. O kari ma labisi. O chɛ ka bɛ zaɣisi ma, ka n tarigi doya dabisili kam zaa puuni.
en: The Lord sent fire from above that went down into my bones. He stretched out a net for my feet. He turned me all the way around. He made me into a wasteland. I am sick all day.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti niŋ dimbɔŋɔnima n-saɣim yimaŋa, dama n ni kariti ninvuɣ shɛb ka chɛri palo tiri ya ŋɔ zaŋla dimbɔŋɔnim saɣim bɛmaŋa.
en: Do not make yourselves unclean in any of these ways because that is how the nations that I am throwing out before you became unclean.

dag: Miriya Naawuni zaligubaŋdib bɛn yuri binyɛr wɔɣila yɛri gɔra, ka lan yuri ni niriba puhiri ba dahi ni la, ka yuri ʒiishe viɛla ni ʒinibu bɛ jɛmbu duri ni, ka yuri jilima ʒiishɛhi ʒinibu bɛ churi puhibu ni.
en: Guard against the teachers of the Law of Moses! They love to walk around in long robes, and they like to be greeted in the market. They want the front seats in the synagogues and the best seats at banquets.

dag: Uzia yuma daa nyɛla yuun pinaayɔbu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa di nam ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pihinunaayi. O ma yuli n-daa booni Jɛkolia. O ya n-daa nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Uzziah was years old when he became king, and he ruled for fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Jecoliah; she was from Jerusalem.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔnim mini bɛ mabihi bɛn daa bɔhim Yawɛ jɛmbu yila, ka mi li yilibu viɛnyɛliŋga kalinli daa nyɛla niriba kɔbisiyi ni pihiwɛiayika.
en: the number of themselves and their relatives, who were trained in singing to the LORD and who were all skillful, was .

dag: Wuntizɔriba kul ni su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ, ka kul ni be di ni sahakam.
en: God's people will own the land and live here forever.

dag: Ti Duuma be a nudirigu polo. O ni ti nyaŋ nanima o suhuyiɣisili dali.
en: My Lord is at your right side. He will defeat the other kings when he becomes angry.

dag: Ka niriba bɛn daa be Yisa sani saha shɛl o ni daa neei Lazarɔs kum ni gballi ni la daa di o shɛhira.
en: A crowd had come to meet Jesus because they had seen him call Lazarus out of the tomb. They kept talking about him and this miracle.

dag: Dinzuɣu a yi lihi ma ni n nyɛla a tumtumdikpee, nyin deem o kaman a ni ni deei ma shɛm.
en: If you consider me a friend because of Christ, then welcome Onesimus as you would welcome me.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Samsin daa ti chaŋ Gaza ti nya pagɔr so nimaani ka o kɔre kpe o ni, ka o zaŋ o dɔni.
en: One day Samson went to the city of Gaza. He saw a prostitute there and went in to stay the night with her.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ Sool min o bia Jɔnatan kɔba maa na nti laɣisi bɛ ni ku shɛb maa kɔba m-pahi di zuɣu.
en: David had their bones taken to the land of Benjamin and buried in a side room in Saul's family burial place. Then he gave orders for the bones of the men who had been hanged to be buried there. It was done, and God answered prayers to bless the land.

dag: Ka Naawuni yɛli Musa, Mani n-nyɛ Mani. Ka lan yɛli yaha, Yɛlim Izraɛlnim maa, Mani n-tim ma yi sanna. .
en: God said to Moses: I am the eternal God. So tell them that the Lord , whose name is I Am, has sent you. This is my name forever, and it is the name that people must use from now on.

dag: Ka yi yi suhiri Naawuni ka taali be yi mini yi tab sunsuuni, yin chɛliya paŋ taba din ni chɛ ka yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ gba chɛ yi taali paŋ ya. .
en: And when you stand and pray, forgive anything you may have against anyone, so that your Father in heaven will forgive the wrongs you have done.

dag: Yawɛ, n teer a yuli yɛla yuŋ, ka dol a zaligu.
en: Even in the night I think about you, Lord , and I obey your Law.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Naftali zuliya paya. Naftali niriba maa toondana n-yɛn nyɛ Ɛnan bia Ahira.
en: On the other side, the tribe of Naphtali: the chief of the people of Naphtali is Ahira, Enans son.

dag: Adɔnija mini saamba bɛn zaa daa be o sani ni daa ti di bɛ bindira naari saha shɛli, ka bɛ daa wum vuri maa. Jɔab ni daa wum kikaa kumsi saha shɛli ka o bɔhi, Ka vu bɔ ka bɛ lee yɔri tiŋ puuni ŋɔ.
en: Adonijah and his guests had almost finished eating when they heard the noise. Joab also heard the trumpet and asked, What's all that noise about in the city.

dag: ni Alammɛlɛk ni Amad ni Mishal. Zaŋ kpa wulinluhili polo, di daa zaŋmi hal ni Kamɛl mini Shihɔrilibinat.
en: Allam Melech, Amad, and Mishal. On the west it touched Carmel and Shihor Libnath.

dag: m-pahi Giliad pirigili ni Ashitarɔt ni Ɛdirɛi din daa nyɛ fɔntiŋ kar shɛŋa Bashan Naa Ogi ni daa su la. Musa daa zaŋ dimbɔŋɔnim tila Manaasa bia Makiri ni di nyɛ Makiri maa zuliya pirigili dini kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Half of Gilead along with Ashtaroth and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, belonged to the people of Machir son of Manasseh. It belonged to the clans for half of the people of Machir.

dag: ka zo yomyom ti yɛl o nyaandoliba ni o neei kum ni n-daŋ yi tooni chaŋ Galili; nimaani ka yi ni ti nya o. Nyamiya, mani n-yɛli ya lala maa.
en: And go quickly and tell his followers, Jesus has risen from death. He is going into Galilee and will be there before you. You will see him there. Then the angel said, Now I have told you.

dag: amaa ti kul bela suɣa ni, ka doli ti yab Jɔnadab ni daa zali ti ni ti niŋmi shɛlikam zaa.
en: We have lived in tents and done everything our ancestor Jonadab commanded us.

dag: Bɛ daa sabi bɛ yuya dolila bɛ daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm. Juda zuliya ni sapashin kpamba bɛn daa su tɔbbihi tusatusa fukumsi puuni, Adina daa sula tɔbutuhiri biinsi tuhi kɔbisita.
en: These soldiers were listed in their tribes. This is the list of these soldiers in Jerusalem: From the tribe of Judah, these were the generals: Adnah was the general of , soldiers.

dag: Ka Dauda daa garigi yɛl o, N dan naa, a kpani maa m-bɔŋɔ, chɛ ka nachimba maa ni yino kana ti zaŋ li.
en: David answered, Here is the kings spear. Let one of your young men come here and get it.

dag: Alizin biɛɣu yi zo ka chɛ nira, alizin biɛɣu maa chanimi nti be kom ni bi dooni luɣ shɛŋa polo n-chani ginda m-bɔri vuhim shee ka bi nyara.
en: When an unclean spirit leaves a person, it wanders through dry places looking for a place to rest. But it doesnt find any.

dag: Dama tulaale ŋɔ naan tooi kɔhi gari tumtumda yuun muni tuma yɔri ka bɛ zaŋ li ti nandaamba. Ka bɛ daa ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni niŋdi paɣ maa.
en: We could have sold this perfume for more than silver coins and given the money to the poor! So they started saying cruel things to the woman.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti zaŋ yi bi so ti ni bɛ nyo buɣim mali buɣili Molɛk ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi saɣim yi Naawuni yuli. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: You must not give any of your children through the fire to Molech. If you do this, you will show that you dont respect the name of your God. I am the Lord .

dag: O ni daa yɛri ma yɛla maa, ka n daa lu n-dɔni tiŋ tarigi. Amaa ka o daa gbaai ma n-yiɣisi ma zali n naba zuɣu.
en: While he was talking, I fell to the ground unconscious. But he took hold of me, raised me to my feet.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔri Yawɛ, bɛna ka o wuhiri di ni simdi ni bɛ doli so shɛli.
en: Those who have reverence for the Lord will learn from him the path they should follow.
