dag: Yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi yi ku wum n yɛligu, ka doli n ni zali ya zaligu shɛŋa la.
en: Tell them that I have said: You have refused to listen to me and to obey my laws and teachings.

dag: ni Atirɔtishɔfan ni Jaza ni Jɔgbɛha.
en: Atroth-shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah.

dag: amaa di bahigu ni o tomi kaman yabiga ka diri kaman takɔb din mali naŋgbana ayi.
en: but when it is all over, she leaves you nothing but bitterness and pain.

dag: Dama Yawɛ zali biɛri bɔhibu dabisili. O mi ni bɔhi biɛri maa ti Ziɔn.
en: The LORD has a day of vengeance, a year of payback for Zions cause.

dag: Di saha zuɣusaa mini dunia ni binshɛŋa din be di ni ni ti yo vuri, ka mali suhupiɛlli Babilɔn zuɣu, dama bɛn ti yɛn wurim li maa ni ti yila nuzaa polo na. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Then all creation will rejoice over Babylon, because out of the north destroying armies will come to attack her, declares the LORD.

dag: O gbibila gummua o nuu ni, ka mali o nubihi wahiri jɛni.
en: She makes her own thread and weaves her own cloth.

dag: Bɛ ni ti yiɣi ka firi kaman zahindi la, ka so ku lan nya ba. Bɛ ni kari ba kaman yuŋ ʒii la.
en: They will disappear like a dream, and none will find them, carried away like a nighttime vision.

dag: Ka ti yi kpaŋdi timaŋa ni ti doli Masia n-yi taali ni Naawuni sani, amaa ka nya ka ti nyɛla alahichinima kaman bɛn pa Yɛhudianim la, di wuhiri ni Masia nyɛla ŋun ʒe alahichi tumbu nyaaŋa? Naawuni di wuhi gba!.
en: If, then, as we try to be put right with God by our union with Christ, we are found to be sinners, as much as the Gentiles are—does this mean that Christ is serving the cause of sin? By no means!.

dag: Amaa ka o ma daa bi saɣi ka yɛli ba, Bolimiy o la Jɔn.
en: But his mother said, No, he will be named John.

dag: N yɛlila n suhu ni, Yawɛ n-kul nyɛ n ni bɔri so. Dinzuɣu n ni mali tahima o sani.
en: I think: The LORD is my portion! Therefore, Ill wait for him.

dag: Barinyuriba ku zan a tooni; a mi je tuumbiɛtumdiba zaa.
en: No one who boasts can stand in your presence, Lord , and you hate evil people.

dag: Naɣilabil tuuli jilima nyɛla o dini. O yila nyɛla yɔnahu yila. Dina ka o ti yɛn zaŋ ʒe niriba n-kari ba ti bahi dunia tarisi. Bɛna n-nyɛ Ifriim zuliya niriba tuhi pia; bɛna n-nyɛ Manaasa zuliya niriba tusa shɛm la.
en: A firstborn bull—thats how majestic he is! A wild oxs horns—those are his horns! With them he gores all peoples completely, to the far ends of the earth! His horns are Ephraims tens of thousands. His horns are Manassehs thousands.

dag: Niŋm bɛ zuɣulaannim kaman a ni daa niŋ Orɛb mini Ziib shɛm la; ka niŋ bɛ nanim kaman a ni daa niŋ Zɛba mini Zalimuna shɛm la.
en: Punish their leaders as you did Oreb and Zeeb. Do what you did to Zebah and Zalmunna.

dag: Amaa yuun shɛli din pahir ayopɔin ni nyɛla tiŋgbɔŋ maa vuhim yuuni, di nyɛla Yawɛ vuhim yuuni; di ti biriya yi puri bee n-wahi yi wain tihi wula nyoya ni bahi.
en: But the seventh year is to be a year of complete rest for the land, a year dedicated to the Lord . Do not plant your fields or prune your vineyards.

dag: Dama bɛ ku tooi gbihi ka pa ni bɛ tumla din bi tuhi; bɛ yi bi chɛ ka so tuui, di niŋdi ba la gɔgaliga.
en: They can't sleep or rest until they do wrong or harm some innocent victim.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n lan ka yaburiga n niŋgbuŋ ni. N sɔŋsim zaa zoya ka chɛ ma.
en: I have no strength left to save myself; there is nowhere I can turn for help.

dag: Ka Yisahaku daa garigi yɛli Iso, M pun zaŋ o leeg a dana, ka zaŋ o mabihi zaa leeg o daba; ka zaŋ kawana mini wain ti o. M bia, ka bɔ ka n ni tooi lan niŋ ti a mi.
en: My son, Isaac answered, I have made Jacob the ruler over you and your brothers, and all of you will be his servants. I have also promised him all the grain and grapes that he needs. There's nothing left that I can do for you.

dag: ka bɛ suhuri ti lɛbigi bɛ ni gbahi ba daba kuli tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni maa, ka bɛ niŋ tuuba ka fabili niŋ a bɛ ni be tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni maa yɛli, Ti tum alahichi, ka birigi, ka tum ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma.
en: In that faraway land, your people will think about what happened. They will be sorry for their sins, and they will pray to you. They will say, We have sinned and done wrong.

dag: Ka Ifriim zuliya niriba daa bi kari Keenannim bɛn be Gɛza, ka Keenannim maa daa kpalim be nimaani pahi bɛ zuɣu.
en: The tribe of Ephraim did not drive out the Canaanites living in the city of Gezer, and so the Canaanites continued to live there with them.

dag: A daa yi alizanda ni n-siɣi Sinai Zoli zuɣu na nti tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa, ka ti ba zaligu maŋa mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi.
en: At Sinai you came down from heaven, and you gave your people good laws and teachings that are fair and honest.

dag: Ka Musa daa wum lala ka saɣi ti li.
en: When Moses heard this, he agreed.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti mabihi, ʒiɛnya viɛnyɛliŋga, ka gbibiya wuhibu shɛŋa ti ni pun wuhi ya ti waazu yihibu ni mini ti ni sab gban shɛŋa tin ya la puuni la.
en: So, brothers and sisters, stand strong and continue to believe the teachings we gave you when we were there and by letter.

dag: Ka maligumaani maa ti booi kpam maa shɛli niŋ o nuzaa nutal ni;.
en: He will also pour some of this oil into his own left palm.

dag: O daa lan yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun be ka tiligi Izraɛlnim ŋɔ zuɣu, biɛhiŋ kani, n ni ku m bia Jɔnatan, hal Naawuni ni kul chɛ ka ti nya tiliginsim ŋun Jɔnatan kɔbili ni maa zaa yoli. Amaa ka niriba maa zaa so daa bi garig o.
en: I promise by the living Lord , who gives Israel victory, that the guilty one will be put to death, even if he is my son Jonathan. But no one said anything.

dag: Dahin shɛli man Yawɛ ni ti yɛn kari zuliya kam zaa saria la miriya. Yi ni nya yi ni daa zaŋ shɛli ti yi tab la tatabo. Yi ni daa niŋ shɛm la ni ŋmaligi lu yi zuɣu.
en: The day is near when I, the Lord , will judge all nations. Edom, what you have done will be done to you. You will get back what you have given.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa ti yɛli Ibram, Yim a ya ŋɔ min a ba yiŋa ni a dɔɣiriba ŋɔ sani n-chaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni n ni yɛn wuh a.
en: The Lord said to Abram: Leave your country, your family, and your relatives and go to the land that I will show you.

dag: Daadam, Izraɛlnim leela saɣiri n sani. Bɛ zaa bɛn nyɛ anzinfa mini daanya ni samafuu ni kurugu ni dalima ŋɔ, bɛ nyɛligibu shee ka bɛ daa leei saɣiri.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, I consider the people of Israel as worthless as the leftover metal in a furnace after silver has been purified.

dag: M bihi, pumpɔŋɔ wummiya n yɛligu. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli n soli mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Now, young people, listen to me. Do as I say, and you will be happy.

dag: N jɛmd a mi ni n suhu zaa, di chɛ ka m birig a zaligunima.
en: I worship you with all my heart. Don't let me walk away from your commands.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa nyaandoliba bɛn daa be Judia mini Galili ni Samaria zaa daa naanyi nya nyee vuhi ka bɛ yiko maan pahi, ka bɛ daa zɔri ti Duuma ka dol o viɛnyɛliŋga, ka bɛ kalinli kul pahira, Naawuni Shia Kasi sɔŋsim puuni.
en: The church in Judea, Galilee, and Samaria now had a time of peace and kept on worshiping the Lord. The church became stronger, as the Holy Spirit encouraged it and helped it grow.

dag: A daag o tiŋ gooni luhi, ka wurim o birininima.
en: The walls of his city have been broken through, and every fortress now lies in ruins.

dag: Yuun pihinahi ŋɔ zaa puuni, yi niŋgbuna ni situra daa bi chahi, ka yi naba mi daa bi mɔri.
en: During these forty years, your clothes didnt wear out and your feet didnt swell up.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, a nyaŋ Ɛdomnima, ka karimbaani kpe a suhu ni n-chɛ ka a duh amaŋa. Chɛ ka a nini tiɣ a jilima, ka ʒi a yiŋa. Bee bɔzuɣu ka a bɔri vuri ni a chɛ ka bɛ ku a tabili Judanima.
en: True, you have defeated Edom. But you have become proud because of your victory over Edom. But stay at home and brag! Dont make trouble for yourself. If you do this, you will fall, and Judah will fall with you.

dag: Ti Naawuni maa nyɛla tiliginsim Naawuni. Ti Duuma Yawɛ n-nyɛ ŋun tiligiri niriba kum ni.
en: Our God is the God of salvation, and escape from certain death comes through God my LORD.

dag: Ka ŋariŋ maa kpatoonsi maa daa bɔri ni bɛ yi n-zo n-tiligi, ka daa sirigi ŋarim bil din be ŋariŋ maa ni la pa kom zuɣu n-niŋ kaman bɛ yɛn zaŋla kur tibisa din bari ŋariŋ maa zaani la bahi ŋariŋ maa tooni polo ka zaŋ ŋarim bil maa n-zo n-tiligi.
en: Then the sailors tried to escape from the ship; they lowered the boat into the water and pretended that they were going to put out some anchors from the front of the ship.

dag: Ka Jɔab min o niriba zaa daa kana ti teei gili Ɛbɛl Bɛtimaaka n-kɔri taŋkpaɣu duhiduhi gili tiŋ maa ka di du nti saɣisi di gooni zuɣusaa, ka gbiri di gbinni ni bɛ daai li luhi.
en: Joab's men heard that Sheba was there, and so they went and besieged the city. They built ramps of earth against the outer wall and also began to dig under the wall to make it fall down.

dag: N yi be luɣ shɛlikam zaa, m malila a zaligunim maa yiini yila.
en: During my brief earthly life I compose songs about your commands.

dag: Ka ʒiɛman shɛli din dolina puuni, yi bihi yi ti yiɣisina yi kalinsi nyaaŋa bee saan so yi ti yi tinshee katiŋ na n-nya Yawɛ ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛ shɛli mini nahiŋgu shɛli paai tiŋgbani maa.
en: In the future, your descendants and foreigners from faraway countries will see how the land has been ruined. They will see the diseases that the Lord has brought to it.

dag: N daa kari doli n dimnima nti ku ba, ka n daa bi ŋmaligi labi n nyaaŋa hal ka ti naai bɛ balibu zaa.
en: I pursue my enemies and defeat them; I do not stop until I destroy them.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ nanim daa bi niŋ yɛda bee dunia ŋɔ ninvuɣ so ti niŋ yɛda ni dimnim ni tooi kpe Jɛrusalɛm puuni.
en: Not a king on this earth or the people of any nation believed enemies could break through her gates.

dag: Doo maa ni daa nya ka o bi tooi nyaŋ Yaakubu maa, ka o daa shih o sakpuɣu, ka o sakpuɣu maa ŋmirigi bɛ ni daa vari saha shɛli maa.
en: When the man saw that he could not defeat Jacob, he touched Jacobs leg and put it out of joint.

dag: dama di saha maa Naawuni Shia Kasi ni ti wuhi ya yi ni yɛn yɛli shɛm.
en: The Holy Spirit will teach you at that time what you should say.

dag: ni bindir viɛla din niŋdi kurimbuni ha zoya zuɣu ni bindira din niŋdi pam dabo kura zuɣu.
en: May their ancient hills be covered with choice fruit.

dag: Ka bia maa ma maa daa yɛli Ilaisha, Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ mini nyin ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, n ku chaŋ ka chɛ a. Ka Ilaisha daa yiɣisi dol o.
en: But the boy's mother said to Elisha, I swear by the living Lord and by your own life that I won't leave without you. So Elisha got up and went with them.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ lan yɛli, Yinim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim beni pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ sani, di pa shɛli ka yi tɛhi ni yɛlli ŋɔ ku tooi nani, amaa man sani, di ni tooi nani.
en: This may seem impossible for my people who are left, but it isn't impossible for me, the Lord All-Powerful.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, n ku lan niŋ yinim bɛ kpalim ŋɔ kaman n ni daa niŋ kurimbuni ha niriba maa shɛm maa. Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But it is not like that now. It will not be like that for the survivors. This is what the Lord All-Powerful said.

dag: Bɛ tiŋkpaŋ shɛŋa zaa din daa gili bɛ fɔntinsi maa n-nyɛ bɛ ni daa be luɣ shɛŋa. Ka bɛ daa sabi bɛ dɔɣirikpamba yuya zali.
en: There were also other villages as far away as Baalath. This is where they lived. And they also wrote the history about their family.

dag: Nira yi wum alizanda nam yɛla ka bi baŋ di gbinni, Sintani kanimina nti to n-yihi din biri o suhu ni la. Dina n-nyɛ bimbir shɛŋa din lu sol zuɣu maa.
en: What about the seed that fell by the path? That is like the people who hear the teaching about Gods kingdom but do not understand it. The Evil One comes and takes away what was planted in their hearts.

dag: Alizin biɛri ni daa nahindi shɛb zaa gba daa nya alaafee.
en: These people had come to listen to Jesus and to be healed of their diseases. All who were troubled by evil spirits were also healed.

dag: Ka Firawuna Nɛko daa zaŋ Jɔsia bia Ɛliakim n-leei naa zal o ba Jɔsia zaani, ka taɣ o yuli m-bol o Jɛhoyakim. Ka o daa zaŋ Jɛhɔahaz n-kuli Ijipti, ka o ti kpi nimaani.
en: Pharaoh Neco made Josiahs son Eliakim the new king. Eliakim took the place of Josiah his father. Pharaoh Neco changed Eliakims name to Jehoiakim. And Pharaoh Neco took Jehoahaz away to Egypt where he died.

dag: N ni tɔɣis a zaligunim maa yɛla nanim tooni, ka ku zo vi.
en: and I trust them so much that I tell them to kings.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa zaŋ Miriam yihi kpaŋ daba ayopɔin, ka niriba maa daa bi yiɣisi chaŋ hal ka bɛ daa ti lan zaŋ Miriam labina.
en: So they shut Miriam out of the camp seven days. And the people didnt march until Miriam was brought back.

dag: Lɔt saha la gba, lala n-daa nyɛ li: Bɛ daa diri ka nyura; ka dari ka kɔhira; ka biriti ka mɛri yiya.
en: Likewise in the days of Lot, people were eating, drinking, buying, selling, planting, and building.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, Bɛ yi ku niŋ Anabi Musa min anabinim yɛligu yɛda, hal so yi neei kum ni chaŋ ti yɛli ba, bɛ ku niŋ o gba yɛligu yɛda. .
en: So Abraham said, If they won't pay attention to Moses and the prophets, they won't listen even to someone who comes back from the dead.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋunkam mi zaɣ suŋ tumbu ka bi tum li, di nyɛla alahichi o sani.
en: It is a sin when someone knows the right thing to do and doesnt do it.

dag: Yawɛ, amaŋmaŋ nini nyaya, di zaŋ li shini! N Duuma, di be katiŋ ka chɛ ma!.
en: But you, O Lord , have seen this. So don't be silent, Lord; don't keep yourself far away!.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be o sani maa yiɣisi, zaŋ chaŋ biɛɣu ti yɛn neei la ka bɛ zaa gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du, ka bɛ yino bi kpalim ka bi du.
en: So David and his men started crossing the Jordan, and by daybreak they had all gone across.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni ti tum ŋun tim ma na maa tuma ni nyɛ shɛli wuntaŋ ni na be ŋɔ, dama yuŋ ni zibi ka so ku lan tooi tum tuma yaha.
en: As long as it is day, we must do what the one who sent me wants me to do. When night comes, no one can work.

dag: Ka Naa Jɔsia daa yɛl o niriba zaa, Puhimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ Yaɣigari chuɣu kaman di ni sab shɛm alikauli kundi ni la.
en: The king commanded all the people, Celebrate a Passover to the LORD your God following what is instructed in this scroll containing the covenant.

dag: O gba daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani; ka daa bi chɛ alahichi shɛŋa zaa Nɛbat bia Jɛrɔbɔam ni daa tum n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim tum alahichi la, amaa ka kul dolila di soli maa.
en: He disobeyed the Lord by doing just like Jeroboam, who had caused the Israelites to sin.

dag: Ka n yɛli n suhu ni, Naawuni ni ti kari wuntizɔriba mini ninvuɣ biɛri saria, dama o zali yɛlli kam mini tuuni kam saha.
en: So I said to myself, God has planned a time for everything, and he has planned a time to judge everything people do. He will judge good people and bad people.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni ti chɛ ka yi nya alahiziba binyara kaman yi ni daa yi Ijipti na, ka n chɛ ka yi nya li shɛm la.
en: I, the Lord , will work miracles just as I did when I led you out of Egypt.

dag: Yi ni nyari ʒii shɛŋa maa pala ʒiri? Ka yi daanabitali nyɛ ʒiri. Hal n yi bi yɛli shɛli, yi yɛrimi, Yawɛ yɛliya. .
en: I tell them: Those visions you see are false, and the predictions you make are lies. You say that they are my words, but I haven't spoken to you.

dag: Bin ayi ka n suhir a ni a ti ma li pɔi ka n naanyi kpi.
en: There are two things, Lord, I want you to do for me before I die:.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Bɔrɔbɔro kpila ala m-be yi sani? Chamiya ti nya. Ka bɛ daa chaŋ ti lihi ka labina ti yɛl o, Bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu mini zahim ayi ko m-beni.
en: Jesus asked them, How many loaves of bread do you have now? Go and see. They counted their loaves of bread. They came to Jesus and said, We have five loaves of bread and two fish.

dag: Bɛ kul malila kpiɔŋ chana; bɛ ni nya Naawuni ŋun gari wuna zaa Ziɔn Zoli zuɣu la zuɣu.
en: They go from strength to strength, until they see the supreme God in Zion.

dag: Ka kukoli maa lan yɛl o pahi buyi, Naawuni ni lihi binshɛŋa bin suma, nyin miri ka a bol li bin yoya.
en: The voice spoke to him again, When God says that something can be used for food, don't say it isn't fit to eat.

dag: Ka n daa nya binshɛli din ŋmani teeku, ka ŋmani diɣi din mini buɣim gari taba. Ka bɛn daa nyaŋ biŋkɔbigu la min o binnan la ni o yuli dalinli deebu la daa ʒe m-baɣi teeku din ŋmani diɣi maa n-gbib Naawuni mɔɣilɔnima.
en: I saw what looked like a sea of glass mixed with fire. All those who had won the victory over the beast and his idol and over the number of its name were standing by the sea. These people had harps that God had given them.

dag: Zanimiya luɣ kasi shee kaman yi daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm, ka chɛ ka Lɛvinim be bɛ ni piripiri yi zuliya daŋ niriba maa pirigibu kam puuni.
en: Stand in the Holy Place with a group of Levites. Do this for each different tribe of the people so that you can help them.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti di li la yili yin ni ka di bi simdi ni yi zaŋ di nimdi yi samban ni bee ŋ-ŋma di kɔbili.
en: Each family must eat the meal in one house. None of the food is to be taken outside the house. Dont break any of the lambs bones.

dag: Nyini n dan naa m-bahi noli ka tuuni ŋɔ tum, ka bi yɛli tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ ŋun yɛn ʒini a nam ʒiishee ŋɔ a kalinsi nyaaŋa.
en: My lord and king, did you do this without telling us? Please tell us, who will be the next king after you.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni cheechi toondana mali biɛrisuŋ: di simdi ni o malila paɣ yino, ka nyɛ ŋun gbib omaŋa ni ŋun mali yɛm ni ŋun biɛhigu doli soli ni ŋun niŋdi saani ni ŋun ni tooi wuhi niriba viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: A church leader must be without fault; he must have only one wife, be sober, self-controlled, and orderly; he must welcome strangers in his home; he must be able to teach;.

dag: A nyu bara yɛli ni a gbi kɔbilisi tinzun tinsi ni n-nyu di kom, ka a tɔbbihi siɣi Nail Mɔɣili ni n-no n-gili ka di kom nyuui.
en: I dug wells and drank water from new places. I dried up the rivers of Egypt and walked where the water was.

dag: m-pahi daabihi mini kɔhigɔriba ni daa yɔr o farigu shɛli zuɣu. Ka Areebia nanim zaa mini tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni gomnanim zaa daa ʒiri salima mini anzinfa na ti tiri Sulemaana.
en: in addition to the taxes paid by the traders and merchants. The kings of Arabia and the governors of the Israelite districts also brought him silver and gold.

dag: Dama ti ka tin shɛli din ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu dunia ŋɔ ni, dinzuɣu ti lihiri bɔrila tin shɛli din ti yɛn kana la.
en: We dont have a permanent city here, but rather we are looking for the city that is still to come.

dag: N ni bahi nyu bara. Di naɣ kala buchi, amaa n na kul ni tɔɣisi ʒiinim mini kahigibunim shɛŋa ti Duuma ni daa zaŋ ti ma la yɛla.
en: There is more that I have to say about myself. It wont help, but I will talk now about visions and revelations from the Lord.

dag: Yisifu ni daa sɔɣ o ba maa nyaaŋa, ka o min o biɛyanim ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa dol o chaŋ sɔɣibu maa shee maa daa lan lab Ijipti.
en: After Joseph buried his father, he and everyone in the group with him went back to Egypt.

dag: Ŋuna n-kuri nabihi, ka chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ nanim zɔri dabiɛm.
en: God defeats great leaders; all the kings on earth fear him.

dag: Leedan ŋun daa nyɛ Gɛrishɔn bidibisi ni yino la daa nyɛla zuliya pam zaŋ tabil o bia Jɛhiɛl daŋ niriba yabidoo.
en: Ladan was from the Gershon clan and was the father of Jehieli. Many of his other descendants were family leaders in the clan.

dag: nti zaŋ Izraɛlnim ni daa zaŋ bɛ suhuyubu pin shɛŋa na ni bɛ ti zaŋ tum luɣ kasi shee tuma maa ti ba. Ka niriba maa daa na kul zaŋdi pina na ni bɛ suhuyubu asiba kam nti tir o.
en: Moses gave them everything the Israelites had brought as gifts, and they used these things to build the holy place. The people continued to bring gifts each morning.

dag: Ka Izraɛl Naa Ɛhab daa bɔhi Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat, A ni pahi n zuɣu ka ti chaŋ ti tuhi Ramɔtigiliadnima? Ka o garigi yɛl o, M bela a polo ka n niriba nyɛ a niriba, ti ni pah a zuɣu chaŋ tɔb maa ni.
en: and finally asked, Jehoshaphat, would you go with me to attack Ramoth? Yes, Jehoshaphat answered. My army is at your command.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Miriya ka yi ti chɛ ka so birigi ya; dama niriba pam ni ti zaŋ n yuli kana ti yɛra, Mani n-nyɛ Masia! Mani n-nyɛ Masia. Saha maa paaya! Miriya ka yi ti doli ba!.
en: Jesus said, Watch out; don't be fooled. Many men, claiming to speak for me, will come and say, I am he! and, The time has come! But don't follow them.

dag: Ka Amɔrinim maa daa kul kpalim be Harihɛrɛs mini Aijalɔn ni Shaalibim, amaa ka Yisifu zuliya niriba daa muɣisi ba hal ka bɛ ti tumdi tuma tiri ba.
en: The Amorites on Mount Heres and in Aijalon and Shaalbim were also determined to stay. Later on, as Ephraim and Manasseh grew more powerful, they forced those Amorites into slave labor.

dag: Ibrahimma daa kurigiya pam, ka Yawɛ daa niŋ alibarika niŋ o binshɛɣukam zaa ni.
en: Abraham was now a very old man. The Lord had made him rich, and he was successful in everything he did.

dag: Di kalinli ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Salima taha pihita min anzinfa taha tuhili ni tahi shɛŋa pihitayinika.
en: as follows: gold bowls for offerings silver bowls for offerings , other bowls small gold bowls small silver bowls other utensils .

dag: So daa ka Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ zaa ni n-viɛli paai Absalom. O daa ka dalinli o napɔnvari ni zaŋ hal ni o zuɣu ni.
en: There was no one in Israel as famous for his good looks as Absalom; he had no defect from head to toe.

dag: N ni yɛli nuzaa polo nim ni bɛ bahimi ba ka bɛ kuna; ka yɛli nudirigu polo nim ni bɛ di gbibi ba. Chɛliya ka m bidibisi bɛn be katiŋ ha kuna, ka chɛ ka m bipuɣinsi bɛn be dunia luɣa anahi ŋɔ ni zaa kuna.
en: I will tell the north: Give my people to me. I will tell the south: Dont keep my people in prison. Bring my sons and daughters to me from the faraway places.

dag: Mbusim be yi zuɣu! Dama yi ŋmanila gbal shɛŋa niriba ni nɔri gariti ka bi mi ni gbala m-bala.
en: It will be bad for you, because you are like hidden graves. People walk on them without knowing it.

dag: Yumakaʒe din garila ka o daa nam ma, mani ka o daa daŋ nambu pɔi ka naanyi nam dunia ŋɔ.
en: I was formed a long time ago, before the world was made.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, n lan ka yaburiga n niŋgbuŋ ni. N sɔŋsim zaa zoya ka chɛ ma.
en: I dont have a helper for myself; success has been taken from me.

dag: Kuruwa kɔŋkɔba zaŋ zahim binyara nyɛla din chihira Yawɛ sani, ka ʒiri sanianim bi viɛla.
en: The Lord hates people who use dishonest scales and weights.

dag: Saimɔn ŋun daa nyɛ bɛn bɔri ni bɛn Izraɛlnim su bɛmaŋ la ni yino ni Judas Isikariɔt ŋun daa ti yi Yisa nyaaŋa la.
en: The others were Simon, known as the Eager One, and Judas Iscariot, who later betrayed Jesus.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa tim Izraɛlnim maa sani ka bɛ chaŋ ti nya ka bɛn biŋkɔbigu zaɣ yino gba bi kpi. Amaa ka Firawuna daa lan niŋ tipawumli n-zaɣisi ni o ku chɛ ka bɛ chaŋ.
en: The king asked what had happened and was told that none of the animals of the Israelites had died. But he was stubborn and would not let the people go.

dag: Yi ni ti zaŋ bimbira pam chaŋ yi puri ni, amaa ka ti kpuɣila atam biɛla, dama toli ni ti ŋub di zaa.
en: You will plant a lot of seed, but gather a small harvest, because locusts will eat your crops.

dag: Yi yi ti chaŋ ti dɔni ni yi tuhi yi dimnima, yin gbaamiya yimaŋa ni zaɣ biɛɣu kam zaa.
en: When you are camped in battle against your enemies, guard yourself from every possible evil.

dag: Ŋuna n-fari ninkura yɛm ka mali ba chana; ka chɛ ka sariakaritiba leeri jɛra.
en: He strips advisors of their wisdom and makes leaders act like fools.

dag: ni bina ni kɔre kpɛbu ni ninvuɣ biɛtali ni yɔhiŋ ni biɛr yoli ni nyuli zabbu ni nyaanzubo ni karimbaani ni jɛrilim.
en: adultery, greed, evil actions, deceit, unrestrained immorality, envy, insults, arrogance, and foolishness.

dag: Yinim bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ka n yɛri pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ. N ni nyɛ Naawuni ni tim tuun so bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani zuɣu ka m mali n tuma maa kuuna.
en: I am now speaking to you Gentiles, and as long as I am an apostle to you, I will take pride in my work.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua.
en: The LORD said to Joshua.

dag: Yawɛ, guli ma ka yihi ma ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni, Guli ma ka yihi ma duŋtaariba bɛn lo ni bɛ chɛ ka n lu la nuu ni.
en: Protect me from the power of the wicked, LORD! Guard me from violent people who plot to trip me up!.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm mɛmi kaman fɔntin titali din me n-shɛbisi tab ni.
en: Jerusalem is a city restored in beautiful order and harmony.

dag: Ka Babilɔn naa daa ku Zɛdɛkia bidibisi o ninni Ribila maa; Babilɔn naa maa daa lan ku Juda kpambaliba zaa.
en: The king of Babylon slaughtered Zedekiahs children at Riblah before his very own eyes, and the king of Babylon slaughtered all the officials of Judah.

dag: Silas mini Timoti ni daa yi Masidɔnia paai Pool sani, o nini daa kul moola waazu yihibu zuɣu, ka o yɛri Yɛhudianim ni Yisa n-shiri nyɛ Masia.
en: But after Silas and Timothy came from Macedonia, Paul spent all his time telling Gods message to the Jews, trying to convince them that Jesus is the Messiah.

dag: Yi bi mi ni binshɛɣukam din kpɛri ninsal nol ni chani ti kpɛrila o pul ni n-gariti ti yira?.
en: Surely you know that all the food that enters the mouth goes into the stomach. Then it goes out of the body.

dag: Zaŋm biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn be kasi la zaɣ lɔri ayopɔin mini zaɣ nyama ayopɔin, ka zaŋ biŋkɔb shɛb bɛn bi be kasi la zaɣ lɔɣu mini zaɣ nyaŋ.
en: Get seven pairs of every kind of clean animal. And get one pair of every other animal on the earth. Lead all these animals into the boat with you.

dag: Ka Inok daa dɔɣi Irad; ka Irad daa nyɛ Mɛhujaɛl ba, ka Mɛhujaɛl nyɛ Mɛtushaɛl ba, ka Mɛtushaɛl mi nyɛ Lamɛk ba.
en: Enoch had a son named Irad, who was the father of Mehujael, and Mehujael had a son named Methushael, who was the father of Lamech.

dag: Binshɛɣukam bɛn vuri bɛ puya zuɣu bee bɛn mali nab anahi zaa chana bee binshɛɣukam bɛn mali napɔn bɔbili, biŋgbamda zaa bɛn gbamdi tiŋgban ni, di dinya ba, dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn dibu chihira.
en: Among all such creatures that swarm on the earth, you must not eat anything that moves on its belly or anything that walks on four or more feet because they are detestable.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ bɛ ni daa mali naɣibil so maa nyo buɣim m-baɣisi li ka di niŋ zim, ka o zaŋ li niŋ kom ni n-chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa nyu li.
en: He melted the idol the people had made, and he ground it into powder. He scattered it in their water and made them drink it.

dag: Yinima n-nyɛ bɛn deei Naawuni zaligu malaikanim nuu ni, amaa ka lee bi dol li.
en: You received the Law given by angels, but you havent kept it.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ yi chani Jɛrusalɛm ti maani sara Yawɛ jɛmbu duu, bɛ suhuri ni ti ŋmaligi kpa bɛ dan Rɛhɔbɔam ŋun nyɛ Juda naa la polo; ka bɛ ku ma, ka ŋmaligi labi Rɛhɔbɔam ŋun nyɛ Juda naa maa polo.
en: If these people continue to sacrifice at the LORDs temple in Jerusalem, they will again become loyal to their master Rehoboam, Judahs king, and they will kill me so they can return to Judahs King Rehoboam.

dag: Di daa kul wum ma la yoli, buɣim maa ni daa bi yihi di ni din zahimzahim maa shɛm.
en: I've tried everything else. Now the rust must be burned away.

dag: N ni niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni; ka din pahi nyɛla, n ni chɛ ka o dɔɣi bidibiga ti a. N shiri ni niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni, ka chɛ ka o leei zuliya pam yabipaɣa; ka nanim ni ti yi o zuliya ni na.
en: I will bless her, and you will have a son by her. She will become the mother of nations, and some of her descendants will even be kings.

dag: Dama man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ kul gbibila a nudirigu ni. Mani n-nyɛ ŋun yɛl a, Di zɔri dabiɛm; n ni sɔŋ a la.
en: I am the LORD your God, who grasps your strong hand, who says to you, Dont fear; I will help you.

dag: Ka Nataniɛl bɔh o, Bin suŋ ni tooi yi Nazarɛt na? Ka Filip yɛl o, Kamina ti nya.
en: But Nathanael said to Philip, Nazareth! Can anything good come from Nazareth? Philip answered, Come and see.

dag: Ka bɛ ni booi kpam bahi maligumaana so zuɣu ni ti zaŋ naɣilaa maa ʒim kpe Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa puuni.
en: The High Priest shall take some of the bull's blood into the Tent.

dag: Ka ti daa ti nya ti nyaandolitab nimaani, ka bɛ yɛli ti ni ti kpalimmi bɛ sani niŋ daba ayopɔin. Ka ti daa ti yi nimaani chani Rom.
en: We found some believers there, who asked us to stay with them a week. Finally, we came to Rome.

dag: amaa Naawuni yɛl ti, Miriya ka yi di ti shɛli din be puu ŋɔ sunsuuni ŋɔ wala bee n-shihi li gba, yi yi niŋ lala, yi ni kpi. .
en: but not the fruit of the tree in the middle of the garden. God said, Dont eat from it, and dont touch it, or you will die.

dag: Jokitan bihi n-daa nyɛ: Alimɔdad mini Shɛlɛf ni Hazarimavɛt ni Jɛra.
en: the ancestor of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah, Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah, Ebal, Abimael, Sheba, Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab.

dag: N nyɛla ŋun pɔra ka bɛ ʒiɛm ma, amaa m bi tam a zaligunim yɛla.
en: Everyone calls me a nobody, but I remember your laws.

dag: ni Kɛdɛshi naa ni Jokiniam naa.
en: Kedesh, Jokneam .

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan pii fɔntins ata Naftali zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni ti ba. Tinsi maa n-nyɛ: Kɛdɛshi din be Galili, ka nyɛ ninvuɣ so ŋun ku o kpee ni zɔri kuni tiligiri la mini Hamɔtidɔr ni Karitan m-pahi di zaa biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee zuɣu.
en: From the territory of Naphtali they received three cities: Kedesh in Galilee, with its pasture lands , Hammoth Dor, and Kartan, with their pasture lands.

dag: Dina n-nyɛ: Di niŋ kamaata ni cheechi toondana malila biɛrisuŋ; di simdi ni o malila paɣ yino; ka di mi simdi ni o bihi nyɛla yɛdaniŋdiba, ka pa ni niriba ni ni tooi galim shɛba bɛ ni bi gbaari bɛmaŋ shɛm bee bɛ tipawumli zuɣu.
en: they must have a good reputation and be faithful in marriage. Their children must be followers of the Lord and not have a reputation for being wild and disobedient.

dag: Di simdi ni sokam doli nam fukumsinim yɛligu; dama nam fukumsi nir kani ka pa ni Naawuni n-zal o, ka nam fukumsi din beni nyɛla Naawuni ni zali shɛli.
en: Every person should place themselves under the authority of the government. There isnt any authority unless it comes from God, and the authorities that are there have been put in place by God.

dag: Adam daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiwɛi ni pihita, ka naanyi yi dunia yili.
en: So Adam lived a total of years; then he died.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛli, Bɛ ni zaɣisi n ni daa zali ba zaligu shɛŋa la dolibu, ka bi deei n noli.
en: The LORD says: It is because they have abandoned my Instruction that I gave them, and havent obeyed or followed it.

dag: Anabinim zaa kpiya; ka nyin lee zaŋ amaŋ leela ŋuni? A gari ti yab Ibrahimma ŋun daa kpi maa.
en: Do you think you are greater than our father Abraham? He died, and so did the prophets. Who do you think you are.

dag: Yinim bɛna, yi zaŋla ʒiri leei situra ye; yi zaa nyɛla timalaannim bɛn ka buchi.
en: You, however, are plasterers of lies; ineffective healers, all of you.

dag: Kuɣa wurim bahi saha beni, ka kuɣa laɣisi sɔŋ saha beni. Tab nuhi tibu saha beni, ka tab nuhi tibu ni kani saha shɛli beni.
en: the time for making love and the time for not making love, the time for kissing and the time for not kissing.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila ba shɛb bɛn nyɛ diribarilimnima ka bi diri tiɣiri la. Zuɣulaannim ŋɔ gba ka baŋsim. Bɛ zaa dolila bɛ suhuyubu soli, ka kul niŋdila din ni sɔŋ bɛmaŋmaŋ kɔŋko.
en: They are like hungry dogs. They are never satisfied. The shepherds dont know what they are doing. Like their sheep, they have all wandered away. They are greedy. All they want is to satisfy themselves.

dag: Pɔhim ni ʒe ba chaŋ, ka bɛ maligu bimbina zuɣu ti chɛ ka vi gbahi.
en: They will be carried away as by the wind, and they will be ashamed of their pagan sacrifices.

dag: Bi so ŋun mal o ba ansarisi ka ʒiɛm o ma, ka zaɣis o noli, vinvamli ni kahiŋkɔri ni kpuɣ o chaŋ ka juri ti di o.
en: People who make fun of their father or refuse to obey their mother should have their eyes plucked out by wild birds and be eaten by vultures.

dag: Ka o daa lan yɛli ba, Dinzuɣu n yɛri ya mi: Suhimiya! Naawuni ni tin ya. Bomiya! Yi ni nya. Niŋmiya gaafara! Yi ni nya soli kpe.
en: So I tell you to ask and you will receive, search and you will find, knock and the door will be opened for you.

dag: Ka Asa daa tum din tuhi Yawɛ sani kaman o yab Dauda ni daa tum shɛm la.
en: Asa obeyed the Lord , as David had done.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun ti tum tuma dindali maa, n ni yihi dilan maa niriba sunsuuni.
en: If anyone does any work on this day, I will destroy that person from among the people.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli, Yawɛ yɛliya, Zaŋ chaŋ yuntisuɣu saha, n ni kpe Ijipti tiŋ puuni.
en: Moses said to the king, The Lord says, At midnight tonight, I will go through Egypt.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli ba, N tum tuun yini ka di gari yi zaa ha.
en: Jesus said to them, I did one miracle on a Sabbath day, and you were all surprised.

dag: Bɛ daa naɣ yɛl ti mi ni bɛ bɔri ni ti teeri nandaamba bɛn be bɛ ni yɛla, ka n gba suhu ni daa pun ye shɛli niŋbu zuɣu n-daa bala.
en: They asked only that we would remember the poor, which was certainly something I was willing to do.

dag: Di wɔɣilim din ti yɛn kpalim dolisi luɣ kasi shee la ni ti nyɛla kilomita anu wulimpuhili polo, ka nyɛ kilomita anu wulinluhili polo. Di ni ti do m-baɣila luɣ kasi shee. Di ni atam ni ti nyɛla tiŋ maa ni tumtumdiba bindirigu.
en: What is left of the length along the side of the holy area will be , cubits on the east and , cubits on the west. This land will be along the side of the holy area. This land will grow food for the city workers.

dag: A bi kpahim nya niriba maa ni yɛra, Yawɛ zaɣisila o ni daa pii zuliya ayi shɛb la? Lala zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ lihi ʒiɛmla n niriba maa, ka bi lan lihi ba ka bɛ ŋmani zuliya yaha. .
en: You've heard foreigners insult my people by saying, The Lord chose Israel and Judah, but now he has rejected them, and they are no longer a nation.

dag: Ka biɛɣ daa neei ka bɛ daŋ yiɣisibu lo tab alikauli, ka Yisahaku daa chɛbisi ba ka bɛ kuli ni suhudoo.
en: Early the next morning each man made a promise and a vow. Then the men left in peace.

dag: O daa wuhi Musa o soya, ka wuhi Izraɛlnim o tuma.
en: He taught his laws to Moses. He let Israel see the powerful things he can do.

dag: Mɔab yili kam zuɣusaa mini di dahi ni, shɛli lan kani n-naɣi pahila fabila kɔŋko, dama n wurim Mɔab kaman so ni lan je duɣ shɛli. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: People are crying for the dead everywhere in Moab—on every housetop and in every public square. There is sadness because I have broken Moab like an empty jar. This is what the Lord said.

dag: Ka Aduna ti zaŋ li yɛri saha shɛl o yi ti yɛn tum tuma, ka o yi ti kpɛri luɣ kasi shee Yawɛ tooni bee o yi ti yirina, di ni chaɣisiri ka bɛ wumdi di vuri din ni chɛ ka o ku kpi.
en: Aaron will wear the robe when he ministers as a priest. Its sound will be heard when he goes into the sanctuary in the LORDs presence and when he comes out, so that he will not die.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔiada daa ti kurigi ka o dabisa pali ka o kpi. O yuma daa nyɛla yuun kɔbiga ni pihita saha shɛl o ni daa kpi maa.
en: Jehoiada grew old, and when he reached the age of , he died.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛl o, Yuŋ ka yɔɣili maa daa zani bili zooi n-neei biɛɣu niŋ dahin yini ka lan ŋmaligi kpi yuŋ. A bi niŋ li shɛli; pa nyin mi n-chɛ ka di zooi, amaa ka a zɔri li nambɔɣu.
en: The Lord said to him, This plant grew up in one night and disappeared the next; you didn't do anything for it and you didn't make it grow—yet you feel sorry for it!.

dag: Ka Izraɛl Naa daa garigi yɛli, Yɛlimiy o, Tɔbbi so ŋun na lɔri kpara bi simdi ka o nyuri bara kaman tɔbbi so ŋun lɔrigi kpara ni nyuri bara shɛm. .
en: King Ahab answered, Tell King Benhadad that a real soldier does his bragging after a battle, not before it.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛl o paɣ tizɔdoo Hɔbab ŋun daa nyɛ o deemba Riuɛl Midian nir bia la, Ti yiɣisiri kunila luɣ shɛli Yawɛ ni daa yɛl ti, N ni zaŋ li tin ya la ni. Dol ti, ka ti ti niŋ a zaɣ viɛlli; dama Yawɛ pun lo Izraɛlnim zaɣ viɛlli niŋbu alikauli.
en: Moses said to his brother-in-law Hobab son of Jethro the Midianite, We are about to start out for the place which the Lord said he would give us. He has promised to make Israel prosperous, so come with us, and we will share our prosperity with you.

dag: Dinzuɣu alizanda mini bɛn zaa be di ni, maliya suhupiɛlli! Amaa mbusim be dunia mini teeku zuɣu! Dama Sintani siɣi yi sanna ni sujee zaɣ titali o ni mi ni o saha bi lan wɔɣa zuɣu.
en: The heavens should rejoice, together with everyone who lives there. But pity the earth and the sea, because the devil was thrown down to the earth. He knows his time is short, and he is very angry.

dag: Daliri ŋɔ zuɣu Masia ni daa yɛn ka dunia ŋɔ ni na, o daa yɛli Naawuni: A bi bɔri biŋkɔbiri sara maligu mini sara malibu balibu kam, amaa ninsal niŋgbuŋ ka a zaŋ ti ma.
en: When Christ came into the world, he said to God, Sacrifices and offerings are not what you want, but you have given me my body.

dag: Ka o yi ti yoog omaŋmaŋ piɛri maa zaa, o bela bɛ tooni ka piɛri maa dol o, bɛ ni mi o kukoli zuɣu.
en: When he has led out all of his sheep, he walks in front of them, and they follow, because they know his voice.

dag: N ni bɔri ni n yɛli ya shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi zaa yinoyino yɛrila ŋ-ŋɔ: Man dolila Pool; ka so yɛra, N dolila Apolɔs; ka so yɛra, Pita ka man doli; ka so mi yɛra, Man dolila Masia.
en: Let me put it this way: each one of you says something different. One says, I follow Paul; another, I follow Apollos; another, I follow Peter; and another, I follow Christ.

dag: Ka Sɛt daa ti dɔɣi bidibiga m-bol o yuli Ɛnɔsh. Di saha maa ka ninsalinim daa piligi jɛmdi Yawɛ.
en: Later, Seth had a son and named him Enosh. About this time people started worshiping the Lord .

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ a mini niriba ŋɔ zaa wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa ŋɔ.
en: But let me remind you and everyone else.

dag: Ka Yaakubu daa tim tuumba o biɛli Iso sani Siɛr Ɛdom tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka bɛ daŋ o tooni.
en: Jacob sent messengers on ahead to Esau, who lived in the land of Seir, also known as Edom.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ n labirila ŋun daa tim ma na maa sani, ka yi ni so mi bi bɔhi ma, Ya ka a chana.
en: But now I go away to the one who sent me. None of you ask me, Where are you going.

dag: Dama a pala Naawuni ŋun yu gala tumbu, a mi mini zaɣ biɛɣu bi kpɛra.
en: God, you dont want evil people near you. They cannot stay in your presence.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Naawuni chɛ ba bahi ka bɛ doli bɛ suhuri ni kɔr biɛri soli n-tumdi tuun shɛŋa ni bɛ taba, ka di dihiri bɛmaŋmaŋ nama vi.
en: And so God has given those people over to do the filthy things their hearts desire, and they do shameful things with each other.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ naa! Dunia zaa, maliya suhupiɛlli; teeku duli tiŋgbana nima, maliya suhupiɛlli!.
en: The Lord is king! Earth, be glad! Rejoice, you islands of the seas!.

dag: Di simdi ka yi zaŋ dimbɔŋɔ leei zaligu yi sani, ka yi mini yi bihi doli li sahakam.
en: You should observe this ritual as a regulation for all time for you and your children.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, Yi ni chɛ ka bɛ teei yi tuumbiɛri yɛla, ka yi biriginsim yi palo, ka yi daalahichi yi palo yi tuuni kam puuni, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ teei yi yɛla la zuɣu, bɛ ni gbahi ya bɛ nuhi ni.
en: So the LORD God proclaims: Now that you have remembered your guilt and your treacheries are exposed, your sins can be seen in everything you do. Because you have brought your guilt to light, you will be captured!.

dag: Ka Lɛvi maa daa nyɛ Simiɔn bia, ka Simiɔn nyɛ Juda bia, ka Juda nyɛ Yisifu so bia, ka Yisifu maa nyɛ Jɔnam bia, ka Jɔnam mi nyɛ Ɛliakim bia.
en: the son of Simeon, the son of Judah, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonam, the son of Eliakim.

dag: Ka dindina wula ka ti lee ni yɛli? Ti ni yɛli ni bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ka nyɛ bɛn daa bi lihiri bɔri wuntitali Naawuni san la nya li bɛ yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: So we say that the Gentiles, who were not trying to put themselves right with God, were put right with him through faith;.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din yi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ sanna. O saɣisiri niriba viɛnyɛliŋga, ka nyɛ yɛm zaalana.
en: This also comes from the LORD of heavenly forces, who gives wondrous counsel and increases wisdom.

dag: Bɛn daa lo o nia biɛɣu maa n-daa nyɛ Zabad Shimiat ŋun daa nyɛ Ammɔn nir la bia mini Shimrit ŋun daa nyɛ Mɔab nir la bia Jɛhɔzabad.
en: Those who plotted against him were Zabad, the son of an Ammonite woman named Shimeath, and Jehozabad, the son of a Moabite woman named Shimrith.

dag: Tun dunia piligu ni hal ni zuŋɔ so na ʒi n-wum ni so neei zoondɔɣirili nina.
en: And this is the first time in history anyone has ever given sight to someone born blind.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa yihi ba Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-zaŋ ba chaŋ tiŋgban nɛli ni.
en: So I brought them out and led them into the desert.

dag: N daa suhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ n-kahigi ti daalahichi wuh o. N daa yɛlimi, Yaa n Duuma Naawuni, nyini n-nyɛ ŋun galisi ka mali jilima. A ʒe a daalikauli nyaaŋa, ka yuri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yur a ka dol a zaligunima.
en: I prayed to the Lord my God and confessed the sins of my people. I said, Lord God, you are great, and we honor you. You are faithful to your covenant and show constant love to those who love you and do what you command.

dag: Ka bɛ garigi yɛl o, Doo maa n-daa bɔhi ti ti mini ti dɔɣiriba yɛla pam hal ti bɔhi ti, Yi ba na be o nyɛvil ni? Yi mali tizo? Ka ti mi daa garig o bɔhigunim maa; ti daa lee yɛn niŋ wula baŋ ni o ni yɛl ti, Zaŋmiya yi tizo maa na? .
en: They answered, The man kept asking about us and our family, Is your father still living? Do you have another brother? We had to answer his questions. How could we know that he would tell us to bring our brother with us.

dag: ka tahima niŋbu mi zuɣu ku chɛ ka ti suhuri miligi, dama Naawuni zaŋ o yurilim niŋ ti suhuri ni o Shia Kasi so o ni zaŋ ti ti la zuɣu.
en: And this hope will never disappoint us. We know this because God has poured out his love to fill our hearts through the Holy Spirit he gave us.

dag: Bɛ ni ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni ŋɔ be bɛ sani. Ka bɛn Izraɛlnim nyɛ n niriba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Then everyone will know that I protect my people Israel. I, the Lord , make this promise.

dag: Amaa ti Duuma yɛligu din kul ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Yɛligu maa nyɛla lahibal suŋ molomooniba ni tahi shɛl na ti tin ya.
en: But the word of the Lord lasts forever. Isaiah :- And that word is the Good News that was told to you.

dag: Ka Judas ŋun daa yi Yisa nyaaŋa maa daa pun wuhi ba shihir shɛli yɛli, N yi ti kul puhi so ka mɔɣis o kpariŋ, ŋuna m-bala; yin gbaamiy o.
en: His betrayer had given them a sign: Arrest the man I kiss.

dag: Dama di nyɛla nɛma labisi ti yuuni yi sani; di ni ti nyɛla yuuni din be kasi; yi ni ti dila binshɛŋa din bili mɔɣu ni di yuuni maa.
en: because it is a Jubilee: it will be holy to you. You can eat only the produce directly out of the field.

dag: Bɛ chɛ ka bɛ zilima dirimi kaman tinvura zilima la, ka garinsi lɔɣu be bɛ noya ni.
en: They sharpen their tongues like a snakes; spider poison is on their lips. Selah.

dag: Naawuni daa sɔŋ o ka o tuhi nyaŋ Filistianim maa mini Laribunim bɛn daa be Guribaal la ni Miunnima.
en: God helped him defeat the Philistines, the Arabs living in Gur-Baal, and the Meunites.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Di yɛra, N na nyɛla bia, dama a ni chaŋ n ni tim a ni a chaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb zaa sani nti yɛli ba n ni zal a ni a yɛlim ba shɛlikam.
en: Don't say you're too young, the Lord answered. If I tell you to go and speak to someone, then go! And when I tell you what to say, don't leave out a word!.

dag: Ti daa nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be a biɛhigu shee din be kasi la, amaa ka ti dimnim daa kari ti nimaani, ka wurim a jɛmbu shee din be kasi maa.
en: Your holy people had their land only a short time. Then our enemies trampled down your holy Temple.

dag: N daa na ʒi m-mɔŋ nandaamba bɛ ni bɔri shɛli bee n-chɛ ka pakoli kɔŋ tahima.
en: I have never refused to help the poor; never have I let widows live in despair.

dag: Amaa n yi kariti alizin biɛri bahirila Naawuni yiko ni, dindina Naawuni nam yipa paai ya mi m-bala.
en: No, it is rather by means of God's power that I drive out demons, and this proves that the Kingdom of God has already come to you.

dag: Amaa ka padiriba maa daa ti yɛli taba, O falidir la m-bɔŋɔ na; chɛliya ka ti ku o, ka fali maa leei ti dini.
en: But they said to themselves, Someday he will own this vineyard. Let's kill him! That way we can have it all for ourselves.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛl o binshɛɣukam, ka bi sɔɣ o shɛli. Ka Ɛli garigi yɛli, Ŋuna n-nyɛ Yawɛ, o niŋm o ni nya ka shɛli viɛl o sani.
en: Samuel told Eli everything. Then Eli said, He is the Lord , and he will do what's right.

dag: N zaŋ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ti o ka di leeg o tuma yɔri, dama n tuma ka bɛ daa tum ti ma maa. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I am giving him Egypt in payment for his services, because his army was working for me. I, the Sovereign Lord , have spoken.

dag: Teemiya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni pa yi bihi bɛn bi mi, ka bɛ nina mi bi nya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa la. Amaa yinima n-nyɛ bɛn ni wuh o galisim min o nuu din mali kpiɔŋ ni o ni daa teeg o bɔɣu shɛm.
en: Remember, he corrected you and not your children. You are the ones who saw the Lord use his great power.

dag: Jɛhɔshafat yuma daa nyɛla yuun pihitanaanu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-ʒila Jɛrusalɛm. O daa niŋla o nam maa ni yuun pisinaanu. O ma daa nyɛla Shilihi bipuɣiŋga; ka o yuli booni Azuba.
en: Jehoshaphat was years old when he became king, and he ruled from Jerusalem for years. His mother was Azubah daughter of Shilhi.

dag: ni Ahio ni Shashak ni Jɛrɛmɔt.
en: Their brothers were Shashak and Jeremoth.

dag: N jɛmbu duu yi ti be bɛ sani saha shɛlikam, di saha zuliya kam ni ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ m-mali Izraɛlnim ka bɛ be kasi. .
en: The nations will know that I, the LORD, make Israel holy, when my sanctuary is among them forever.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n yɛli, Zomiya ka chɛ ma ka n kum pam m pubiɛ niriba kum zuɣu. Di bɔriya ni yi maai n suhu.
en: Then I said, Leave me alone! Let me cry bitter tears. My people have been destroyed, so don't try to comfort me.

dag: Miriya ka yi jɛm wuna bee ka yimaŋmaŋ ti zaŋ binshɛli dooi mali binnana. Man Yawɛ n-nyɛ yi Naawuni.
en: Do not turn to idols or make gods of cast metal for yourselves; I am the LORD your God.

dag: Binshɛɣukam ni tuui dɔɣi bi so nyɛla n dini, bɛ ni tuui dɔɣi yi bidib shɛb zaa mini yi niɣi ni yi piɛri ni tuui dɔɣi naɣila shɛb ni piɛla shɛb zaa nyɛla n dini.
en: A womans first baby always belongs to me. Even the first animals that are born from your cattle or sheep belong to me.

dag: Ka Zabai bia Baruk daa niŋ nimmoo mali me gooni maa gɔŋbu shee yaɣ shɛli hal ti paai maligumaaniba zuɣulana Ɛliashib yiŋ dunoli shee m-pan o zuɣu.
en: After him, Baruch, Zabbais son, thoroughly repaired another section from the Angle to the door of the house of the high priest Eliashib.

dag: Yɛhudianim shɛb a ni zaŋ zali ni bɛ su Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni yaɣ shɛŋa fukumsi la be kpe ka bi lihi nya a, ka zaɣisi ni bɛ ku jɛm a wuna maa bee n-damdi tiŋ jɛm salima binnan shɛl a ni mali zal la. Bɛna n-nyɛ: Shadirak mini Mɛshak ni Abɛdnɛgo.
en: There are some Jews whom you put in charge of the province of Babylon—Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego—who are disobeying Your Majesty's orders. They do not worship your god or bow down to the statue you set up.

dag: Bɛ daa kpɛnkpɛla sida dari din be duu maa puuni m-malimal li, ka ŋme yɔɣa mini tipuma din yirigi kɔtomsi m-pampa di zuɣu, sida dapaɣa maa noli ka bɛ daa zaŋ kpahi pa di puuni zaa hal ka kuɣ yini gba ti bi lan nyiya.
en: The cedar inside the temple was carved with gourds and blossoming flowers. The whole thing was cedar. No stone was seen.

dag: Ka n chɛ ka Jabin sapashin kpɛm Sisɛra zaŋ o chɛchɛbunsi min o tɔbbihi kana ti chirigi ya Kishɔn Mɔɣili ni; ka n zaŋ o niŋ a nuu ni.
en: I will make Sisera, the commander of King Jabins army, come to you. I will make Sisera, his chariots, and his army come to the Kishon River. I will help you defeat Sisera there.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Sulemaana daa po Yawɛ n-yɛli, Adɔnija yi bi kɔŋ o nyɛvili yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ zuɣu, Naawuni ŋun niŋm ma zaɣ biɛɣu gar lala!.
en: Then Solomon made a solemn promise in the Lord 's name, May God strike me dead if I don't make Adonijah pay with his life for asking this!.

dag: Amaa kom yi be bimbira maa ni ka bɛ zaɣ kpiŋ yaɣ shɛli lu di zuɣu, bimbira maa leei daɣiri bini yi sani.
en: But if water is poured on some seed and part of their dead bodies falls on it, it is unclean for you.

dag: Di jiɣindiya yi ni yɛn di shɛli bee n-nyu shɛli zuɣu, ka di chɛliya ka yi suhuri ye di zuɣu;.
en: Dont chase after what you will eat and what you will drink. Stop worrying.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti mali Yaɣigari chuɣu sara maa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tin shɛŋa tin ya maa tin shɛli ni.
en: Don't offer the Passover sacrifice in just any town where you happen to live.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni yiɣisi n suhu bahi Ɛdomnim zuɣu n-ku ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri zaa, ka chɛ ka di kpalim zani dabari, bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbiri ku ba Tɛman hal ni Dɛdan.
en: So the Lord GOD says: I will punish Edom. I will destroy the people and the animals in Edom. I will destroy the whole country of Edom, all the way from Teman to Dedan. The Edomites will be killed in battle.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli ba, Yi zaa ni ti zo ka chɛ ma, dama di sabiya ni Naawuni yɛliya, N ni ku piɛgula, ka piɛri wurim.
en: Then Jesus told the followers, You will all lose your faith. The Scriptures say, I will kill the shepherd, and the sheep will run away. Zechariah :.

dag: ka o yɛli, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, N ni chɛ ka kom tɛli baa din kuui ŋɔ ni zaa.
en: The Lord says that this dry riverbed will be filled with water.

dag: O ni ti wuhi zuliya kam shihirili ni o lan laɣindi Izraɛlnim mini Judanim bɛn daa wurim be dunia ŋɔ yaɣa anahi ŋɔ ni la.
en: God will raise a signal for the nations and gather the outcast men of Israel. God will collect the dispersed women of Judah from the four corners of the earth.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa nyaŋ Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa ti Izraɛlnima. Ka Izraɛlnim daa ku Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa ninvuɣ tuhi pisinaanu ni kɔbiga dindali maa; ka bɛ zaa daa nyɛla takɔbichɛriba.
en: The Lord used the army of Israel and defeated the army of Benjamin. On that day the army of Israel killed , soldiers from Benjamin. All of them had been trained for war.

dag: O nyɛla ŋun yɛli, N ni me mmaŋmaŋ yili titali, ka me zuɣusaa du kara, ka niŋ takɔriti niŋ li, ka zaŋ sida dari pa di zuɣusaa, ka zaŋ piɛnta ʒee piɛnti li.
en: You put in big windows and used cedar paneling and red paint. But you were unfair and forced the builders to work without pay. *.

dag: Bɛ ni ti labina ti ʒini m mahim. Bɛ ni ti yirigi puma kaman sambani puu la. Bɛ ni ti wali wala kaman wain tia la, ka bɛ nyom viɛlim ni ti ŋmanila Lɛbanɔn wain nyom viɛlim.
en: The people of Israel will again live under my protection. They will grow like grain. They will bloom like a vine. They will be like the wine of Lebanon.

dag: yɛra, Bɛn yoli ka tuma ŋɔ ni na kul tumla awa yini kɔŋko, ka tinim bɛn lee di tuma ŋɔ wahala ka wuntaŋ kpe ti biɛɣu zaa pahi ŋɔ mini ba zaa yɔri ti nyɛ yim.
en: They said, Those people were hired last and worked only one hour. But you paid them the same as us. And we worked hard all day in the hot sun.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, N ni niŋ a ni yɛli ma ni n niŋ shɛm maa, dama m mi a, ka n nini tiɣ a.
en: The LORD said to Moses, Ill do exactly what youve asked because you have my special approval, and I know you by name.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o pa yuri zuɣu na ti sɔɣ o pah o yaannim zuɣu Dauda tiŋ la ni.
en: They carried him back on horses and he was buried with his ancestors in Davids City.

dag: Yɛlim niriba maa, miligimiya Kɔra mini Datan ni Abiram biɛhigu shee.
en: Tell the people to stay away from the tents of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.

dag: Nanim maa ni yino n-nyɛ Amɔrinim naa Sihɔn ŋun daa be Hɛshibɔn, ka su Aroa din daa baɣi Arinɔn Vinvamli la mini vinvamli maa sunsuuni zaŋ hal ti paai Jabok Mɔɣili din nyɛ Ammɔnnim tintariga ka nyɛ Giliad pirigili la.
en: First there was the Amorites King Sihon, who lived in Heshbon. He ruled from Aroer by the rim of Arnon Valley and then from the middle of the valley as far as the Jabbok Valley, the border of the Ammonites. This was half of Gilead.

dag: Yinim peentɔriba zaa, teemiya zani yi zaashɛhi gili Babilɔn. Tomiya ba piɛma, di tɔn ya ka guui peen gaŋa, dama bɛ tum alahichi Yawɛ sani.
en: Babylon has rebelled against me. Archers, take your places. Shoot all your arrows at Babylon.

dag: amaa ka daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o bɔrɔbɔro shɛriba kpɛm maa ti yil tia kaman Yisifu ni daa yɛli ba shɛm maa.
en: and had the cook put to death. Everything happened just as Joseph had said it would.

dag: Ka Jɔab daa zaŋ niriba maa kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm ti ti naa. Izraɛl tiŋgban ni, dɔbba bɛn daa naan tooi chaŋ tɔbu kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbisinii. Ka Juda tiŋgban ni mi nyɛ ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbisinu.
en: They reported to the king the total number of men capable of military service: , in Israel and , in Judah.

dag: Dinzuɣu kum maa ni daa ti lu n-gili bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa puuni saha shɛli, ka Yisifu daa chɛ ka bɛ yooi bindira duri maa zaa n-kɔhiri bindira maa Ijiptinim zaa zuɣu, dama kum maa daa miiya pam Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: The famine covered every part of the land, and Joseph opened all of the granaries and sold grain to the Egyptians. In the land of Egypt, the famine became more and more severe.

dag: Dama Yawɛ galisiya, ka simdi paɣibu din galisi. Di simdi ka ti lur o sizuura gari wuni kam.
en: The Lord is great and is to be highly praised; he is to be honored more than all the gods.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ ni daa ti paana n-yi biɛɣu n daa bi niŋ zinchili, ka chaŋ ti ʒini n sariadibo ʒiishee ka yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm Pool na.
en: When they came here, I didnt put them off. The very next day I took my seat in the court and ordered that the man be brought before me.

dag: Bɛ zuliya m-bɔŋɔ: Ishimail bituuli n-daa nyɛ Nɛbaiɔt, bɛn daa dol o nyaaŋa n-daa nyɛ: Kɛdar mini Adibiil ni Mibisam.
en: Ishmael had twelve sons, who were born in the following order: Nebaioth, Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam, Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.

dag: Ka daɣila di daa bi simdi ni Masia nya wahala ŋɔ zaa ka naanyi nya jilima.
en: Wasnt it necessary for the Christ to suffer these things and then enter into his glory.

dag: Ka naa daa chɛ ka bɛ kpe kuɣ viɛla zaɣ kara ni bɛ zaŋ li me duu maa tanzaa m-pahi kuɣ shɛŋa bɛ ni daa mali ka di viɛla.
en: He ordered the workers to cut and shape large blocks of good stone for the foundation of the temple.

dag: Ŋunkam bi doli zaligu ŋɔ puuni yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga noli din dim o. Ka sokam yɛli, Ami.
en: God's curse on anyone who does not obey all of God's laws and teachings. And all the people will answer, Amen.

dag: Dama o mi ninvuɣ yoya, ka o yi nya zaɣ biɛɣu, o ku niŋ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ di polo?.
en: God knows who is worthless. When he sees evil, he remembers it.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o chaŋ Zɔfim mɔɣu ni Pisiga Zoli zuɣu nti me sara maligu bimbina ayopɔin zali, ka kɔrigi naɣila yinoyino mini piɛla yinoyino m-mali sara pa di zaɣ yini kam zuɣu.
en: So he took Balaam to a field on top of Mount Pisgah where lookouts were stationed. Then he built seven altars there and sacrificed a bull and a ram on each one.

dag: Bɛmaŋmaŋa n-daa yu ni bɛ niŋ lala, ka di mi shiri simdi ni bɛ niŋ lala ti ba, dama bɛn pa Yɛhudianim yi daa nya Naawuni alibarika Yɛhudianim bɛn niŋ Yisa yɛda maa zuɣu, dindina di niŋ kamaata ni bɛ gba zaŋ dunia ŋɔ binyara sɔŋ ba.
en: They were happy to do this. And it was like paying something they owed them, because as non-Jews they have been blessed spiritually by the Jews. So now they should use the material blessings they have to help the Jews.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa Sinai mɔɣu ni.
en: The LORD spoke to Moses in the Sinai desert.

dag: Di saha ka dabipaɣiba maa mini bɛ bihi daa kana ti gban o tiŋa.
en: Then the two maids and the children with them went to Esau. They bowed down before him.

dag: Ŋunkam tumdi tuumbiɛri, ŋun na kul be tuumbiɛri maa tumbu ni; ka ŋunkam mali tabizahim, ŋun na kul be o tabizahim tuma maa ni; ka ŋunkam nyɛ wuntizɔra, ŋun na kul be din tuhi tumbu ni; ka ŋunkam mi be kasi, ŋun na kul kpalimmi be kasi.
en: Let those who do wrong keep doing what is wrong. Let the filthy still be filthy. Let those who are righteous keep doing what is right. Let those who are holy still be holy.

dag: Ŋun dɔɣi jɛrigu nya yɛla; jɛrigu ba ka suhupiɛlli.
en: Having a fool for a son brings grief; theres no joy for a scoundrels father.

dag: Ka n daa bɔri ni m baŋ bɛ ni gbaag o shɛli zuɣu, ka zaŋ o tahi bɛ jintɔriba sani.
en: I wanted to know what they were accusing him of, so I took him down to their Council.

dag: Hiburɔn bidibisi ni, Jɛria n-daa nyɛ kpɛma n-zaŋ Amaria pa, ŋun pah ata n-daa nyɛ Jahaziɛl, ŋun pah anahi n-daa nyɛ Jɛkamiam.
en: Jeriah was the oldest son of Hebron. Amariah was Hebrons second son. Jahaziel was his third son, and Jekameam was his fourth son.

dag: Yi bi kpaŋsiri bɛn ka yaa la, yi bi tibiri bɛn biɛri la, yi bi niŋdi tana lɔri bɛn nya dansi la, yi bi taɣiri bɛn yirigi la na, yi mi bi bo bɛn bɔrigi la shee. Amaa yi zaŋla kiŋkansi mini ninkuunsi su ba.
en: You have never protected the weak ones or healed the sick ones or bandaged those that get hurt. You let them wander off and never look for those that get lost. You are cruel and mean to my sheep.

dag: Yi tɛhiya ni yi ni tooi galim yɛtɔɣa, ka di be kaman ninvuɣ so ŋun ka tahima yɛtɔɣa nyɛla pɔhim?.
en: Do you intend to correct my words, to treat the words of a hopeless man as wind?.

dag: Ka dabiɛm daa gbaai Ilaija, ka o yiɣisi zo ni o tilig o nyɛvili. O daa zaŋla o tumo la n-zo n-kuli Bɛrishiiba din be Juda tiŋgbɔŋ ni la nti chɛ o nimaani.
en: Elijah was afraid when he got her message, and he ran to the town of Beersheba in Judah. He left his servant there.

dag: M Ba ni zaŋ shɛb zaa ti ma ni ka n sanna, ka ŋunkam mi ka n sanna, n ku zaɣis o.
en: Everyone whom my Father gives me will come to me. I will never turn away anyone who comes to me.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm maa daa niŋ Hamɔr min o bia Shɛkɛm nyaɣisim pam.
en: Their idea seemed like a good one to Hamor and Hamors son Shechem.

dag: Saha shɛli Dauda ni daa di nam ʒi Hiburɔn n-su Judanim maa yuma daa nyɛla yuma ayopɔin ni chira ayɔbu.
en: The amount of time David ruled in Hebron over the house of Judah totaled seven and a half years.

dag: Ka zoomba mini gbariti daa ka o sanna Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ kpaŋ.
en: Blind and lame people came to Jesus in the temple, and he healed them.

dag: Ka nyɔhi daa yi o nyee ni na; ka buɣim niɛm din diri yi o nol ni na; ka sala buɣim niɛm yi o sanna.
en: Smoke poured out of his nostrils, a consuming flame and burning coals from his mouth.

dag: Haa Kum, a nasara dibu be ya? Haa Kum, a dimbu yiko be ya?.
en: Where is your victory, Death? Where is your sting, Death? .

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n chɛ ka anabinim daa kana ti saɣisi ba. Ka n zaŋ n nol ni yɛtɔɣa ku ba, n saria karibu kul nɛmi kaman neesim la.
en: Therefore, I have attacked them by the prophets, I have killed them by the words of my mouth, and my judgment goes forth like a light.

dag: O ni daa tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ naai ka o tuhi nintɔri bahi tiŋa n-niŋ taŋkpaɣu garigari di ni n-zaŋ ʒe zom maa nina;.
en: After he said this, he spit on the ground, made mud with the saliva, and smeared the mud on the mans eyes.

dag: Miri ka a vuɣi tiŋgbani tariga kpaa din nyɛ a yaannim ni daa kpa shɛli kurimbuni ha.
en: Never move an old property line that was marked long ago by your ancestors.

dag: Dinzuɣu Izraɛlnim ni yɛn niŋ shɛm nya bɛ daalahichi chɛ m-paŋ nyɛla, faashee ka bɛ ŋme n-wurisi chɛfirinim maligu malibu bimbina la buɣibuɣi kaman zim la; ka saɣim Ashɛra ŋmahinli binyara mini di tulaale tuɣilibu bimbina la zaa.
en: There's only one way that Israel's sin and guilt can be completely forgiven: They must crush the stones of every pagan altar and place of worship.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa be Jɔshua sani; ka o yuli daa du pam bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni.
en: The LORD was with Joshua. News about him spread throughout the land.

dag: Zaŋmiya adiini yila mini Naawuni paɣibu yila ni Yila litaafi ni yila kpaŋsiri taba, ka yilimiya yila paɣimi ti Duuma ni yi suhuri zaa.
en: speak to each other with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; sing and make music to the Lord in your hearts.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋme ŋ-ŋma Baal binnan la, ka ŋme n-wurim o duu maa, ka zaŋ nimaani leei bimbɔɣili hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: So they destroyed the sacred pillar and the temple, and turned the temple into a latrine—which it still is today.

dag: Pool ni daa na do Atɛnsi n-guli Silas mini Timoti maa ka o suhu daa ti saɣim pam o ni daa nya ka tiŋ maa luɣilikam kul nyɛla buɣa la zuɣu.
en: While Paul waited for them in Athens, he was deeply distressed to find that the city was flooded with idols.

dag: Di saha yi ni ti teei yi tuumbiɛri mini yi biɛhigu din daa bi viɛl la yɛla, ka ku lan bɔri yi ni daa tum alahichi shɛŋa mini din chihiri shɛŋa la.
en: You will remember the bad things you did. You will remember that those things were not good. Then you will hate yourselves because of your sins and the terrible things you did.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ Ɛhab yuli sab gbana, ka zaŋ o dalinli dihi tabili li n-zaŋ li ti ti Jɛziriil kpamba mini ninvuɣ zuɣuri bɛn mini Nabɔt daa laɣim be tin yin ni la.
en: So she wrote letters in Ahabs name, putting his seal on them. She sent them to the elders and officials who lived in the same town as Naboth.

dag: Ka Masia yi daa shiri bi neei kum ni, dindina yi yɛda niŋbu nyɛla yoli, ka yi na kul kpalim be yi daalahichi ni;.
en: If Christ hasnt been raised, then your faith is worthless; you are still in your sins.

dag: Kul suhimiya Naawuni ni o yihim ti tɛhibiɛrinim mini ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni, dama pa sokam zaa n-nyɛ bɛn niŋ yɛda.
en: Pray also that God will rescue us from wicked and evil people; for not everyone believes the message.

dag: Di zaŋya fukumsi biɛɣu su piɛ shɛb Naawuni ni zaŋ niŋ yi nuu ni la, amaa lee maliya biɛhigu shɛli din simdi ni bɛ doli di naba.
en: Do not try to rule over those who have been put in your care, but be examples to the flock.

dag: Ka ʒiri mi ka bɛ ni so nol ni, dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn ka galimi hal baabiɛla.
en: They have never been known to tell lies; they are faultless.

dag: Bɛ ni daa garigi yɛli ti shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Ti nyɛla Naawuni ŋun su zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani ŋɔ daba, ka lab mɛri du shɛli Izraɛl na so ŋun mali yiko pam ni daa pun me n-naai zali yuun gbaliŋ din gari la ni ha.
en: They claimed to be servants of the God who rules heaven and earth. And they said they were rebuilding the temple that was built many years ago by one of Israel's greatest kings.

dag: Ŋunkam daa nya ba ŋubiri ba mi, ka bɛ dimnim yɛli, Ti ka taali, dama bɛ zaɣisila Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ŋun guli ba ni yɛlimaŋli la, bɛ yaannim ni daa mali tahima Yawɛ so san la.
en: They were attacked by all who saw them. And their attackers said, We were not wrong to attack them because they sinned against the Lord . They should have stayed close to him, their true resting place. The Lord is the one their fathers trusted in.

dag: Mɛrari daŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa kpalim, bɛ daa zaŋla Zɛbulɔn tiŋgban ni tinsi kaman Rimɔno mini Tabo ni di momaha tiŋgbana zaa ti ba.
en: The rest of the Levites, from the Merari families, got the towns of Jokneam, Kartah, Rimmono, and Tabor from the tribe of Zebulun. They also got the fields near those towns.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianim ka nyɛ bɛn daa be Ɛfɛsus daa wum yɛlli ŋɔ, ka dabiɛm kpe bɛ zaa, ka ti Duuma Yisa yuli daa du n-chaŋ haliya.
en: When the Jews and Gentiles in Ephesus heard about this, they were so frightened that they praised the name of the Lord Jesus.

dag: Ka tiŋguliba ti chani gindina nti nya ma, ka m bɔhi ba, Yi nya n yura la.
en: The sentries patrolling the city saw me. I asked them, Have you found my lover.

dag: ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu n-nya ka naɣikɔhiriba mini piɛkɔhiriba ni ŋmaŋkɔhiriba be di puuni m-pahi laɣitaɣiriba bɛn ʒi bɛ teebuya gbini.
en: There he found people selling cattle, sheep, and doves in the temple. He also saw moneychangers sitting at their tables.

dag: Naawuni, n suhir a, chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri kpi, ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri zo ka chɛ ma.
en: If only, God, you would kill the wicked! If only murderers would get away from me.

dag: Naa Sulemaana daa zaŋla yuun pisi m-me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu mini ŋun Sulemaana nam yili.
en: After twenty years of building the LORDs temple and his royal palace.

dag: ka nachimbil maa fuɣ o chinchini maa bahi, ka guui ni nyɔfindili.
en: he left the cloth behind and ran away naked.

dag: Ka daɣila n kul yɛn lihirila tɔbu tuhibu, ka wumdi kikahi kumsi sahakam?.
en: How long must I see the battle flags and hear the blast of the trumpet?.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa zaa daa ŋumdi bɛ kparima ni niŋdi Musa mini Aduna tiŋgban nɛli maa ni.
en: The whole Israelite community complained against Moses and Aaron in the desert.

dag: Bɛ daa zaŋla Tɔrokɔnima ayɔbu mini naɣilahi pinaayi din daa nyɛ bɛ sara na nti sɔŋ Yawɛ tooni. Zuɣulaannim ayi kam daa laɣim sula tɔroko yini, ka bɛ ninvuɣ yino kam su naɣila yino. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ ba mali sara Yawɛ jɛmbu suɣili tooni.
en: These leaders brought gifts and gave them to the Lord in front of the Holy Tent. They brought six covered wagons and twelve oxen for pulling the wagons. Each leader gave an ox and joined with another leader to give a wagon.

dag: Hal yi naɣikɔra mini bunsi bɛn kɔri yi puri ni ti ŋubi bɛ ni zaŋ soobul mini soobul jɛba yɛli bindir shɛli.
en: The oxen and donkeys that are working the ground will eat tasty feed spread for them with shovel and fork.

dag: A chɛ ka pɔhim kpuɣi ma, ka chɛ ka m ba pɔhim maa, ka a tɔri ma gindi sanʒiɛɣu ni.
en: You let the wind blow me away; you toss me about in a raging storm.

dag: Amaa nyini n-chɛ ka a shia kanna ti kpɛri bɛ ni, ka bɛ leeri a ni nam shɛba; ka a ti tiŋgbani nyɛvil palli.
en: But when you give them breath, they are created; you give new life to the earth.

dag: Amaa yi yi yɛli, Yɛlimuɣisirili din yi Yawɛ sanna, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Yi ni yɛra, Yɛlimuɣisirili din yi Yawɛ sanna ŋɔ zuɣu, m pun tim na ti yɛli ya, Di lan yɛliya, Yɛlimuɣisirili din yi Yawɛ sanna. .
en: But dont say, What was the announcement from the Lord ? If you use these words, the Lord will say this to you: You should not have called my message an announcement from the Lord . I told you not to use those words.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ o dabili Izraɛl zuliya, ka lan nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya bɛn nyɛ o ninvuɣ gahinda ŋɔ!.
en: The people of Israel are his servants. The descendants of Jacob are his chosen people.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni yɛl o, Jɛrigu ŋɔ! Yuŋ ŋɔ n ni deeg a nyɛvili, ka a nɛma maa zaa leei ŋun dini.
en: But God said to him, You fool! Tonight you will die. Then who will get what you have stored up.

dag: Gadamanim yɔhindi bɛ ʒiʒiinitaba n-zaŋdi ba doli so shɛli din bi viɛla.
en: Violent people entice their neighbors and walk them down a path that isnt good.

dag: O ni daa pii ninvuɣ pinaayi shɛb maa yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Saimɔn, Yisa ni daa pa so yupaa Pita la.
en: These are the names of the twelve men Jesus chose: Simon .

dag: N daa tuui zaŋ li yɛl la Ziɔnnima, ka zaŋ di lahiba suŋ molo m-moli Jɛrusalɛmnim sani.
en: I, the Lord , was the first to tell Zion the news; I sent a messenger to Jerusalem to say, Your people are coming! They are coming home.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ! Kul paɣimiy o ʒiɛmani kam ni. Ami! Ami!.
en: Praise the Lord , the God of Israel! Praise him now and forever! Amen! Amen!.

dag: O yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaanu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-ʒini Jɛrusalɛm la yuun pihitayinika. O ma daa nyɛla Jɛrusalɛm paɣa, ka o yuli booni Jɛhɔadin.
en: Amaziah was years old when he began to rule. He ruled years in Jerusalem. His mother was Jehoaddin from Jerusalem.

dag: Amaa ka Naaman daa je suli ŋ-ŋmaligi chani ka yɛra, Man di mi ni o yɛn yimina nti zani n-suhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni maa, ka zaŋ o nuu gahigahi kpe, ka chɛ ka n kɔŋ maa naai.
en: But Naaman left in a rage, saying, I thought that he would at least come out to me, pray to the Lord his God, wave his hand over the diseased spot, and cure me!.

dag: Di simdi ka firilatamdigu maa ti mali jaba ayɔbu di luɣa zuɣu; jaba ata yaɣ yini polo, jaba ata yaɣ din la mi polo.
en: It should have six branches growing out from its sides, three branches on one side of the lampstand and three branches on the other side of the lampstand.

dag: Amaa ka a dabili nini daa ti moog o tuma zuɣu, ka doo maa zo n-tiligi. Ka Izraɛl naa maa yɛl o, A saria karibu ni nyɛ shɛm m-bala; dama amaŋmaŋ pun wuhi samli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: While I was busy doing other things, the man ran away. The king of Israel answered, You admitted that you are guilty, so you know the answer. You must do what the man said.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka ti daa lo noli suhi ti Naawuni di zuɣu, ka o daa deei ti suhigu maa.
en: So we fasted and prayed to our God about our trip. He answered our prayers.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Jɛsi daa ti yɛl o bia Dauda, Zaŋmi kawaan chimda kpalaŋ ŋɔ mini bɔrɔbɔro kpil pia ŋɔ chaŋ sansan maa ni yomyom ti ti a biɛyanima.
en: One day Jesse said to David, Take a half-bushel of this roasted grain and these ten loaves of bread, and hurry with them to your brothers in the camp.

dag: Niŋgbuŋ dɔr biɛɣu ni mali ninvuɣ so ka o ku tooi nyaŋ o daɣiri ni yibu sara maligu zaligu m-bala.
en: These are the rules for making people clean after they become well from a skin disease. These are the rules for those who cannot afford the regular sacrifices for becoming clean.

dag: Ti bi ŋmaligi ti suhuri ka chɛ a; ti mi bi birigi ka chɛ a soli.
en: We always kept you in mind and followed your teaching.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa dii guui chaŋ ti du n-tam Filistia doo maa zuɣu, ka darigi ŋooi ŋun Filistia doo maa maŋmaŋ takɔbi di tɔɣu ni n-zaŋ li ku o, ka ŋma o zuɣu. Filistianim maa ni daa nya ka bɛ tiyaawumya maa kpi maa, ka bɛ ŋmaligi guui.
en: He ran to him, stood over him, took Goliath's sword out of its sheath, and cut off his head and killed him. When the Philistines saw that their hero was dead, they ran away.

dag: Pateesa shɛŋa din zaa daa yili gili lɔndo maa daa nyɛla tan piɛl viɛlli din ŋmɛliŋmɛli.
en: All the drapes around the courtyard were made of fine twisted linen.

dag: Amaa Yawɛ n-yihi ya kuriti nyɛligibu daaŋa ni na Ijipti ni yi ti leei omaŋmaŋ ni su ninvuɣ shɛba kaman yi ni nyɛ shɛm pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ.
en: But the LORD took you and brought you out of that iron furnace, out of Egypt, so that you might be his own treasured people, which is what you are right now.

dag: Daba ata maa dali asiba, ka saa daa gbaai tahibu, ka nyaɣisira, ka sagban tibisili daa be zoli maa zuɣu, ka kika titali din yo vuri pam kum, ka niriba bɛn daa be sansani maa ni zaa niŋgbuna sɔhira.
en: On the morning of the third day there was thunder and lightning, a thick cloud appeared on the mountain, and a very loud trumpet blast was heard. All the people in the camp trembled with fear.

dag: Chɛ ka zoya zuɣu niŋ bindira ka di niŋ niriba anfaani pam, ka chɛ ka wuntitali mi yi zahira daboya zuɣu.
en: Let the mountains bring peace to the people; let the hills bring righteousness.

dag: Bɛ ni ti ku ba sɔŋ Babilɔn tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka shɛb mi diɛhi dansi do di solɔri zuɣu.
en: They will be wounded and die in the streets of their cities.

dag: Yi zaa yinoyino kpuɣim o labila, ka di kalinli yiɣisi kɔbisiyi ni pihinu ka yi niŋ tulaale zim niŋ di ni n-zaŋ li ka Yawɛ tooni na. Ka a gba mini Aduna gbibi yi tulaale lahi.
en: Each of you must bring a pan, put incense in it, and present it to the Lord . There will be pans for the leaders and one pan for you and one pan for Aaron.

dag: Ka yi daa nya ka bɛ chibichibi Dauda tiŋ la gooni voya; ka yi daa taɣi kom sɔŋ di biaŋ din be tiŋli la ni.
en: You observed the many broken defenses in Davids City, and you collected the waters of the lower pool.

dag: ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma, Miri ka a muɣisi Mɔabnima bee n-tuhi ba tɔbu, dama n ku zaŋ bɛ tiŋgban shɛli tin ya ka yi su li, n ni pun zaŋ Ar ti Lɔt zuliya la zuɣu. .
en: The Lord told me, Don't try to start a war with Moab. Leave them alone, because I gave the land of Ar to them, and I will not let you have any of it.

dag: Ka Zilipa daa lan dɔɣi bidibiga ti Yaakubu pahi.
en: Zilpah bore Jacob another son.

dag: Ka n yi mal anabitali yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu pini, ka tooi baŋdi yɛlisɔɣira, ka mali baŋsim zaa, hal n yi mali yɛda din ni chɛ ka n tooi vuui zoya di dooshɛhi, ka ka yurilim, dindina m pala shɛli.
en: If I have the gift of prophecy and I know all the mysteries and everything else, and if I have such complete faith that I can move mountains but I dont have love, Im nothing.

dag: Ka bɛ daa gbahi bɛ biŋkɔbiri. Laakumnim daa nyɛla tuhi pihinu, ka piɛri nyɛ tuhi kɔbisiyi ni tuhi pihinu, ka bunsi mi daa nyɛ tusaayi, ka daa gbahi ninvuɣ nɛma tuhi kɔbiga.
en: They seized their livestock: , of their camels, , sheep and goats, , donkeys, and , captives.

dag: Ka Zɛruya bia Jɔab la daa piligi niriba maa kalibu, amaa o daa bi kali ba naai, ka alɔbo daa lu Izraɛlnim zuɣu niriba kalibu maa zuɣu, ka bɛ daa bi sabi bɛ kalinli maa niŋ Naa Dauda yɛla teebu litaafi ni.
en: Joab, whose mother was Zeruiah, began to take a census, but he did not complete it. God punished Israel because of this census, so the final figures were never recorded in King David's official records.

dag: a nyɛla ŋun saɣisiri niriba viɛnyɛliŋga, ka tumdi tuun kara. A nyari ninsal kam biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm, ka tiri bɛ zaa laara kaman bɛ biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm ni bɛ tuma ni simdi shɛm.
en: You plan and do great things. You see everything that people do. You give a reward to those who do good things, and you punish those who do bad things—you give them what they deserve.

dag: Doli wuhibu maŋ shɛŋa n ni daa zaŋ wuh a la yɛda niŋbu mini yurilim shɛli din be Yisa Masia ni la puuni.
en: What you heard me teach is an example of what you should teach. Follow that model of right teaching with the faith and love we have in Christ Jesus.

dag: Zaɣ biɛɣu kul ku paai wuntizɔriba, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri kul bela yɛla ni sahakam.
en: The Lord will keep good people safe, but evil people will have many troubles.

dag: Niŋm mani a dabili ŋɔ zaɣ viɛlli, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka m be, ka doli a yɛligu.
en: Be good to me, your servant, so that I may live to obey your word.

dag: Ti suhupiɛlli la naaya. Ti wahi wabu la leela kuyila.
en: Happiness has gone out of our lives; grief has taken the place of our dances.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Sokam zaŋm o takɔbi nyaɣ o luɣili zuɣu n-chaŋ gili sansani ŋɔ ni zaa n-kpe suɣili kam puuni, ka sokam ti ku o mabia ni o mini ŋun doli ni o ʒiʒiinikpee. .
en: and he said to them, The Lord God of Israel commands every one of you to put on your sword and go through the camp from this gate to the other and kill your brothers, your friends, and your neighbors.

dag: Ka bɛ daa biligi kuɣili maa bahi. Ka Yisa duh o zuɣu zuɣusaa ka yɛli, M Ba, m paɣir a a ni deeri n suhigu zuɣu.
en: So they removed the stone. Jesus looked up and said, Father, thank you for hearing me.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Aai, ti dana, a daba kala bindira dabu na.
en: No, sir, they answered. We have come as your slaves, to buy food.

dag: Bɛ daa lan zaŋ gɔpiɛliga dari mali dapuhi n-zaŋ dapuh anu niŋ Naawuni biɛhigu shee maa yaɣ yini polo dapaɣa.
en: Then the workers used acacia wood to make the braces for the frames—five braces for the first side of the Holy Tent.

dag: Ka di simdi ka o ti zaŋ suhudoo maligu biŋkɔbigu maa biŋkpam din pili namanama zuɣu la mini kpam din be namanama maa ni zaa.
en: and present the following parts of the animal as a food offering to the Lord : all the fat on the internal organs.

dag: Bɛ ni ti be ni ni alaafee, ka me yiya, ka ko wain tihi puri. N yi ti kari bɛ ʒiʒiinitaba bɛn zaa lihi ʒiɛm ba la saria, bɛ ni baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni.
en: They will be safe and will build houses and plant vineyards. They will no longer be in danger, because I will punish their hateful neighbors. Israel will know that I am the Lord their God.

dag: Dauda ni daa su Izraɛlnim zaa shɛm m-bala. O daa zaŋla yɛlimaŋli mini nimmaŋtali gbibi sokam zaa.
en: David ruled all Israel with fairness and justice.

dag: Dauda ni daa mali tɔbutuhiri biinsi shɛb yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Jɔshɛbashɛbɛt Tachɛmɔn nira ŋun daa nyɛ wɔɣiri kɔba ata la naa, ŋun daa zaŋ o kpani lu niriba kɔbisinii zuɣu n-ku bɛ zaa tɔb tuhibu yim puuni la.
en: These are the names of Davids warriors: Jeshbaal from Hachmon was chief of the Three. He raised his spear against eight hundred, killing them on a single occasion.

dag: Ka Yisa ti bɔh o, Bɔ ka a lee bɔri ni n niŋ ti a? Ka zom maa yɛl o, Karimba, m bɔri ni a neela n nina ŋɔ ti ma.
en: Jesus asked the man, What do you want me to do for you? He answered, Teacher, I want to see again.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun tumdi tuma yɔri pala pini, amaa di nyɛla o tuma yɔri.
en: A person who works is paid wages, but they are not regarded as a gift; they are something that has been earned.

dag: Amaa zom yɛtɔɣ gbalin chɔɣima tɔɣisibu mini dɔɣirikpamba yuya yɛla ni naŋgbankpeeni ŋmɛbu ni zabili zaŋ chaŋ Naawuni zaligu yɛla polo, dama di nyɛla yoli ni din ka buchi.
en: Stay away from those who have foolish arguments, who talk about useless family histories, or who make trouble and fight about what the Law of Moses teaches. These things are useless and will not help anyone.

dag: Ka Dauda daa sɔɣi mɔɣu maa ni. Ka gol palli dali maa daa ti paai, ka naa ʒini ni o di bindirigu.
en: So David hid in the fields. At the New Moon Festival, King Saul came to the meal.

dag: di yi simdi ni bɛ bu ŋun mali taali maa, dindina sariakarita maa ŋun chɛ ka bɛ gbaag o sɔŋ n fiɛb o o ninni, ka o fiɛbbu kalinli yɛn dolila o taali ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: If the guilty party is to be beaten, the presiding judge will have that person lie down and be punished in his presence—the number of blows in measure with the guilt determined.

dag: O niriba kalinli daa yiɣisila ninvuɣ tuhi pihiyɔbuyinika ni kɔbisita.
en: His military unit and those enlisted in it are .

dag: N dabisa zɔri yomyom gari tizɔra; di kul zɔrimi gariti ka zaɣ viɛlli ka di ni.
en: My life is speeding by, without a hope of happiness.

dag: Ka tuuli malaika daa piɛb o kikaa, ka sakuɣa mini buɣim ni ʒim daa gari taba luri dunia ni, ka dunia tiŋgbani pirigibu ʒii buta puuni yim di buɣim, ka tihi pirigibu ʒii buta puuni yim di buɣim, ka momaha zaa di buɣim.
en: The first angel blew his trumpet. Then hail and fire mixed with blood was poured down on the earth. And a third of the earth and all the green grass and a third of the trees were burned up.

dag: N ni ti zaŋ tiŋ ŋɔ ni daazichi zaa mini di nyamma zaa ni di binshɛɣukam zaa din mali anfaani ni Juda nanim daazichi zaa niŋ bɛ dimnim nuu ni, ka bɛ ŋme n-di li n-zaŋ li kuli Babilɔn.
en: He will clean out the royal treasury and take everything else of value from Jerusalem.

dag: N ni ŋme solɔɣu du n zoya zaa, ka mali n soya ka di viɛla.
en: I will turn all my mountains into roads; my highways will be built up.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛli ba, N gba ni bɔhi ya bɔhigu, ka yi yi garigi m bɔhigu maa, m mi ni yɛli ya yiko shɛli n ni mali niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa maa ni yi shɛl na.
en: Jesus answered, I will ask you a question. You answer my question. Then I will tell you whose authority I use to do these things.

dag: Yisa ni daa ti paai Bɛtani dahin shɛli ka o wum ni bɛ ni sɔɣi Lazarɔs daba anahi dali m-bala.
en: When Jesus arrived, he found that Lazarus had been buried four days before.

dag: O daa lan bo naɣilabil yino mini piɛla yino ni yuun yini piɛlabil yino mali sara shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim la.
