en: one bull from the herd, one ram, one year-old male lamb for an entirely burned offering.

dag: Dama m mi ni Yawɛ galisiya; ti Duuma maa gari wuna zaa.
en: Yes, I know for certain that the LORD is great— I know our Lord is greater than all other gods.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ salinim zaa, yomiya suhupiɛlli vuri paɣi Naawuni.
en: Tell everyone on this earth to shout praises to God!.

dag: Ka Pita chihi bɛ zaa nini maa ni yɛli, Man bi baŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa gbinni.
en: But Peter told everyone there that this was not true. I dont know what you are talking about, he said.

dag: Man Pool ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ni pii so o yubu puuni n-leei Yisa Masia tumo la mini ti mabia Sɔstɛniiz.
en: From Paul, who was called by the will of God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from our brother Sosthenes—.

dag: O nyɛla ŋun mali kpiɔŋ, ka kpaŋsir o bɔɣiri n-tumdi kpiɔŋ tuma.
en: She works energetically; her arms are powerful.

dag: Kɔhimiya yi ni mali shɛli n-zaŋ ti nandaamba pini; bomiya liɣiri kolibihi shɛŋa din bi kurigira n-sɔŋ azichi shɛli din ti ku naai Naawuni yili, tayiɣ ni ti ku be shɛli bee lɛla ni ti ku saɣim li luɣ shɛli.
en: Sell your possessions and give to those in need. Make for yourselves wallets that dont wear out—a treasure in heaven that never runs out. No thief comes near there, and no moth destroys.

dag: Nyini n-daa chɛ ka n dimnim ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ ma, ka chɛ ka n ku bɛn je ma la.
en: You made my enemies turn tail from me; I destroyed my foes.

dag: A yɛn gbibila so kur shɛli ninvuɣ biɛri ni daa doli la?.
en: Are you determined to walk in the paths that evil people have always followed?.

dag: Amaa yi yi ti ŋmaligi labi n sanna ka doli n zaligunima, ka tumdi di tuma, n ni lan labisi ya luɣ shɛli n ni pii zali ni di nyɛ n jɛmbu shee la na, hal yi yi kul wurim chaŋ ti be dunia ŋɔ tarisi luɣ shɛlikam zaa ha.
en: But you also said that no matter how far away we were, we could turn to you and start obeying your laws. Then you would bring us back to the place where you have chosen to be worshiped.

dag: Amaa di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Bɛ ni daa na bi yɛli ninvuɣ shɛb o yɛla nini ni nya o; ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn na ʒi n-wum o yɛla ni baŋ o.
en: It is just as the Scriptures say, All who haven't been told about him will see him, and those who haven't heard about him will understand.

dag: Jɛrigu ŋɔ! A ni biri binshɛli ku bilina ka pa ni di poomi.
en: These are stupid questions. When you plant something, it must die in the ground before it can live and grow.

dag: Ka Yisa daa dii chirigi ba soli maa ni puhi ba; ka bɛ chaŋ ti gban o tooni m-bɔbil o naba, ka jɛm o.
en: Suddenly Jesus met them and said, Peace be with you. They came up to him, took hold of his feet, and worshiped him.

dag: Di ti tumiya tuma, di nyɛla zaligu yi ʒiɛmani kam ni sahakam yi ni be luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: You must not do any work at all. This is a law that continues forever for you, wherever you live.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi yurilim nyɛ yurilim maŋli. Di niŋ kamaata ni yi je din bie, ka gbibiya din viɛli kirikiri.
en: Your love must be real. Hate what is evil. Do only what is good.

dag: Di bi simdi ka yi zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro din mali dabindi pahi biŋkɔbigu ʒim zuɣu m-mali sara ti ma bee n-chɛ ka yi ni zaŋ biŋkɔb so mali sara biŋkpam zani hal ka biɛɣu ti neei.
en: Do not offer bread made with yeast when you sacrifice an animal to me. And make sure that the fat of the animal is burned that same day.

dag: Di saha maa ka sanʒiɛɣu maa ʒiɛbu daa kul moorila nini pahira. Ka bɛ daa bɔhi Jona, Ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ a ka teeku ŋɔ fo n-dɔni baalim.
en: They said to him, What will we do about you so that the sea will become calm around us.

dag: Doliya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ya so shɛŋa la zaa din ni chɛ ka yi be, ka binshɛɣukam niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani, ka yi ti mali nyɛvili wɔɣila tiŋgbɔn shɛli yi ni ti yɛn su maa ni.
en: You must walk the precise path that the LORD your God indicates for you so that you will live, and so that things will go well for you, and so you will extend your time on the land that you will possess.

dag: ka o daa dɔɣ o paɣisar dɔɣim bidibiga n-zaŋ chinchini pil o sɔŋ wɔrimɔri piɛɣu ni, dama bɛ daa bi nya palo saamba yilikpɛrili ni.
en: she gave birth to her first-born son. She dressed him in baby clothes and laid him on a bed of hay, because there was no room for them in the inn.

dag: Ka ti mi yi yihi yɛli ni ti bi tum alahichi, dindina ti zaŋ Naawuni leela ʒirilana, ka o yɛligu ka ti ni.
en: If we say we have not sinned, we make God a liar, and his message isn't in our hearts.

dag: Hal kunduna gba chɛ ka bɛ bihi mɔɣira, amaa n niriba maa bɛn malila ninkuunsi kaman taatahi bɛn be mɔɣu ni la.
en: Even jackals offer the breast; they nurse their young. But the daughter of my people has become cruel, like desert ostriches.

dag: Di saha ka o daa dii zaŋ sapashinnim mini tɔbbihi zo n-chaŋ bɛ sani. Bɛ ni daa ti nya sapashin kpɛm maa mini tɔbbihi maa ka bɛ chɛ Pool bubu.
en: Without a moments hesitation, he took some soldiers and officers and ran down to the mob. When the mob saw the commander and his soldiers, they stopped beating Paul.

dag: Yi ni be luɣ shɛlikam zaa, yi fɔntinsi ni bahi yoli, ka yi ni jɛmdi buɣa luɣ shɛŋa zaa bahi yoli, ka yi maligu bimbina wurim bahi yoli, ka yi buɣa la wurim saɣim, ka yi ni tuɣindi tulaale zim bimbin shɛŋa zuɣu la wurim ka yi tuma kpihim.
en: All the cities of Israel will be destroyed, so that all their altars and their idols will be smashed to pieces, their incense altars will be shattered, and everything they made will disappear.

dag: Siɛr ŋun daa nyɛ Hɔri nir la bidibisi bɛn daa nyɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa tiŋbihi la n-daa nyɛ: Lɔtan mini Shɔbal ni Zibiɔn.
en: These are the sons of Seir, the Horite, who live in the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah.

dag: Nuhu bidibis ata maa zuliya m-pali dunia ŋɔ zaa ŋɔ.
en: These three sons of Noah were the ancestors of all the people on earth.

dag: A yi yɛn niŋ ma la lala, nyin niŋm ma nirilim n-dii ku ma, ka lala chɛ ka n ku nya n nandahima biɛhigu.
en: If youre going to treat me like this, please kill me. If Ive found favor in your eyes, then dont let me endure this wretched situation.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba kpamba maa daa kpuɣi anzinfa kpila maa ka yɛli, Di bi simdi ni ti lan zaŋ li gari Naawuni jɛmbu duu liɣiri ni, dama di nyɛla ninsal ʒim liɣiri.
en: The leading priests picked up the silver coins in the Temple. They said, Our law does not allow us to keep this money with the Temple money, because this money has paid for a mans death.

dag: Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, M mi ni bɛ ni booni so Masia la ni kana; ka o yi ti kana, o ni wuhi ti binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: The woman said, I know that the Messiah is coming. When he comes, he will explain everything to us.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, a nyɛla Yɛlimaŋlilana, amaa ti nyɛla bɛn tiligi ka kpalim kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ. Tinima n-ʒe a tooni ni ti taali maa hal so ni ku tooi zani a tooni lala maa zaa yoli.
en: Lord , God of Israel, you are good, and you still have let some of us live. Yes, we are guilty, and because of our guilt, not one of us should be allowed to stand in front of you.

dag: Ka Sool min o niriba maa daa ti paai Hachila zolɔŋni zaŋ labi Jɛshimɔn wulimpuhili polo nti ti bɛ suɣa do nimaani palli noli. Amaa Dauda daa na bela mɔɣu maa ni. O ni daa ti wum ni Sool kar o naba na mɔɣu maa ni.
en: Saul camped on Hachilahs hill opposite Jeshimon beside the road, but David stayed in the wilderness. When David learned that Saul had come after him into the wilderness.

dag: N kɔba zaa kul yimi paya. Bɛ kul kpaala bɛ nina kpa ma lihiri ma.
en: I can see each one of my bones. My enemies are looking at me; they just keep staring.

dag: Ʒimiya tab ʒiya, ka di chɛ ka Masia zaligu niŋ pali.
en: Carry each others burdens and so you will fulfill the law of Christ.

dag: Di simdi ni a ti kɔrigiri naɣilaa dabisili kam m-maani alahichi sanyoo sara. Di lan simdi ka a maani alahichi kpihimbu sara maligu bimbini maa kasitali zuɣu; ka booi kpam bahi di zuɣu m-mal li ka di niŋ kasi.
en: You must kill one bull every day for seven days. This will be an offering for the sins of Aaron and his sons. You will use these sacrifices to make the altar pure, and pour olive oil on the altar to make it holy.

dag: Ka Sool bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee bala, n Duuma? Ka kukoli maa yɛli, Man Yisa ŋun nyɛ a ni niŋdi so alaka maa m-bala.
en: Who are you, Lord? he asked. I am Jesus, whom you persecute, the voice said.

dag: Ka o daa bol o na ti bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a chɛ ka n go n-wumd a yɛla shɛm ŋɔ? Malimi m binshɛɣukam din be a sani laasabu n-zaŋ ti ma, dama a ku lan niŋ n tumtumdi kpɛma.
en: So the rich man called him in and said, What is this I hear about you? Tell me what you have done! You are no longer going to work for me.

dag: Ŋunkam doli yɛlimaŋli soli nyɛla ŋun yi barina ni. Amaa ŋun doli bilikɔnsi soli, o gbini ni vii.
en: Honest people are safe and secure, but the dishonest will be caught.

dag: Ka o daa yi di tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni chaŋ Asiria nti me Ninive mini Rɛhɔbɔtir ni Kala ni.
en: Nimrod also went into Assyria. In Assyria, Nimrod built the cities of Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah, and.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa lan tim tuumba Amɔrinim Naa Sihɔn ŋun daa nyɛ Hɛshibɔn naa la sani ti yɛl o, Ti suhir a, chɛ ka ti kpe a tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni gari kuli ti ya.
en: The Israelites sent messengers to the Amorite King Sihon of Heshbon. Please, they said, let our people go through your country to get to our own land.

dag: Bini bahigu so di piligu; ka suɣilo so karimbaani.
en: Something completed is better than something just begun; patience is better than too much pride.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa bi bɔri wuntaŋ bee goli ni di ne di ni, dama Naawuni jilima n-nyɛ di neesim, ka Piɛbil maa mi nyɛ di firila.
en: The city has no need of the sun or the moon to shine on it, because the glory of God shines on it, and the Lamb is its lamp.

dag: Dinzuɣu zanimiya baalim pumpɔŋɔ n-nya Yawɛ ni yɛn tum tuun kar shɛli yi nini ŋɔ ni.
en: So then, stand where you are, and you will see the great thing which the Lord is going to do.

dag: Dama niriba maa zaɣisi ma, ka ta kpe daɣiri m-maani maligunim tiri wun shɛŋa bɛ mini bɛ yaannim ni Juda nanim ni daa bi mi ni bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali la zuɣu.
en: They have deserted me and degraded this place into a shrine for other gods, which neither they nor their ancestors nor Judahs kings have ever known. And they have filled this place with the blood of the innocent.

dag: ka yɛli ba, Yinim Lɛvinima, wummiya, Malimiya yimaŋa m-be kasi, ka maliya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu ŋɔ ka di be kasi, ka yihiya neen daɣiri din bi be kasi luɣ kasi shee la.
en: and spoke to them there. He said, You Levites are to consecrate yourselves and purify the Temple of the Lord , the God of your ancestors. Remove from the Temple everything that defiles it.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Sool di yɛla ka o lan tim tuun shɛba, ka bɛ gba ti tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa. Ka Sool daa lan tim tuun shɛb yaha m-pahi buta, ka bɛ gba daa tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: When Saul heard what had happened, he sent some more soldiers, but they prophesied just like the first group. He sent a third group of soldiers, but the same thing happened to them.

dag: N nyaya ka sokam bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni zaa dolila nachimbil so ŋun di nam zani naa zaani.
en: I once saw everyone in the world follow a young leader who came to power after the king was gone.

dag: Ifriim bidibisi n-daa lan nyɛ Rɛfa mini Rɛshɛf ni Tɛla ni Tahan.
en: Rephah was Ephraims son. Resheph was Rephahs son. Telah was Reshephs son. Tahan was Telahs son.

dag: Nyini, yilimi fabila yilli ŋɔ niŋ Izraɛl nanima.
en: Ezekiel, sing a funeral song for two of Israel's leaders:.

dag: O daa chɛ ka zunzuya kana ti ŋub bɛ bindira, ka chɛ ka toli kana ti saɣim bɛ puri atam.
en: God let worms and grasshoppers eat their crops.

dag: Ka Absalom tumtumdiba maa daa shiri niŋ Amnɔn kaman Absalom ni wuhi ba ni bɛ niŋ o shɛm maa. Di saha ka nabihi maa zaa daa dii yiɣisi ba bɛ buntaansi zo.
en: So the servants followed Absalom's instructions and killed Amnon. All the rest of David's sons mounted their mules and fled.

dag: Hal ka bia maa daa ti bɔri ni o dirila kuruchunim maa bindira maa shɛli, dama so daa bi tir o bindirigu.
en: He wished he could fill himself with the bean pods the pigs ate, but no one gave him anything to eat.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri lɔri nia biɛri zaŋ chaŋ wuntizɔriba polo, ka dimdi bɛ nyina niŋdi ba.
en: The wicked plot against the righteous, grinding their teeth at them.

dag: Yawɛ suhu ni ti yiɣisi bahi yi zuɣu, ka o chɛ ka saa ku lan min ya, ka yi bindira ku niŋ, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi kpi yomyom Yawɛ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ viɛl shɛli tiri ya maa ni.
en: If you do that, the Lord will become very angry with you. He will shut the skies, and there will be no rain. The land will not make a harvest, and you will soon die in the good land that the Lord is giving you.

dag: amaa n nudirigu mini n nuzaa polo ʒinibu maa, din pala man tibu, amaa Naawuni ni mal li zali ninvuɣ shɛba n-ni ti ʒin nimaani.
en: But it isn't for me to say who will sit at my right side and at my left. This is for God to decide.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ti ku mali ninvuɣ so ŋun ni pihi kuɣa sɔŋ lihi nya yi tintariga bɔbili ni nyɛ shɛli Yawɛ niriba sunsuuni.
en: Therefore, you will have no one to set boundary lines by lot in the LORDs assembly.

dag: Ka o ni ti zaŋ yɔhiŋgu maa n-yɔhim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ti yɛn bahi yol la. Din chɛ ka bɛ ti yɛn bahi yoli maa nyɛla bɛ ni zaɣisi ni bɛ yu yɛlimaŋli ka tiligi la zuɣu.
en: It will happen with every sort of wicked deception of those who are heading toward destruction because they have refused to love the truth that would allow them to be saved.

dag: dama bɛn zaa piila bɛ bun ni na ti tɔhi, amaa pakoli ŋɔ ŋun zaŋla o duu ni o yiŋ zaa na ti tɔhi.
en: They have plenty, and they gave only what they did not need. This woman is very poor, but she gave all she had. It was money she needed to live on.

dag: Zaŋmiya adiini yila mini Naawuni paɣibu yila ni Yila litaafi ni yila kpaŋsiri taba, ka yilimiya yila paɣimi ti Duuma ni yi suhuri zaa.
en: Speak to one another with the words of psalms, hymns, and sacred songs; sing hymns and psalms to the Lord with praise in your hearts.

dag: Yisa ni daa tɔɣisi niriba maa yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ zaa naai o daa chaŋla Kapɛrinium.
en: When Jesus had finished saying all these things to the people, he went to Capernaum.

dag: Ka naa maa daa ʒi o dufahirili zuɣusaa zɔntu mahili ni, ka Ɛhud ka o sanna ti yɛl o, M malila yɛtɔɣ shɛli din yi Naawuni sanna ni n-yɛl a. Ka naa maa vaai yiɣis o ʒiishee zani.
en: Then, as the king was sitting there alone in his cool room on the roof, Ehud went over to him and said, I have a message from God for you. The king stood up.

dag: Maligumaaniba maa ni daa yi Luɣ Kasi shee maa na, ka sagbani sirigina nti pali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa.
en: When the priests left the holy place, the cloud filled the LORDs temple.

dag: Dinzuɣu malimiya shili yi tɛha ni ka gbibi yimaŋa, ka zaŋ yi tahima niŋ anfaan shɛli Naawuni ni ti yɛn niŋ niŋ yi ni Yisa Masia ni ti yɛn yi palo dabisi shɛli dal la.
en: So then, have your minds ready for action. Keep alert and set your hope completely on the blessing which will be given you when Jesus Christ is revealed.

dag: Hal yinim Izraɛlnim ni tum bi ʒe yim tuma maa zaa yoli, di bi simdi ni di zuɣu chɛ ka Judanim gba kpe taali ni. Di kpɛnya Giligal tiŋ puuni bee n-kpɛnya Bɛtavɛn, ka miriya ka yi po n-yɛli Hal ka Yawɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Israel, you are unfaithful, but don't lead Judah to sin. Stop worshiping at Gilgal or at sinful Bethel. And quit making promises in my name—the name of the living Lord .

dag: A daa lan zaŋ n ni ti a salima min anzinfa yɛ viɛli shɛŋa la m-mali binnana din nyɛ dɔbba n-zaŋ ba tum pagɔrisigu tuma.
en: You took the beautiful gold and silver jewelry that I had given to you, and you made male images for yourself and prostituted yourself with them.

dag: Yi yi ti nya ka doo bee paɣa ŋun be yi ni tum tuumbiɛɣu ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ sani, ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tin shɛŋa tin ya ŋɔ tin shɛl ni m-birig o daalikauli la.
en: You might hear about an evil thing that happens in one of the cities that the Lord your God is giving you. You might hear that a man or woman in your group has sinned against the Lord your God. You might hear that they have broken his agreement or.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa niŋ yɛda. Bɛ ni daa wum ni Yawɛ baɣa be Izraɛlnim ni ka nya bɛ wahala maa, ka bɛ daa silim bɛ zuɣuri tiŋa n-jɛm Naawuni.
en: and they believed what they had heard. Then the Israelites understood that the Lord had seen their troubles and had come to help them. So they bowed down and worshiped God.

dag: Ka Mɔdɛkai daa baŋ bɛ ni lo shɛm maa ka zaŋ li yɛli Napaɣ Ɛsta, ka o mi yɛli Naa Ahasivɛrɔs Mɔdɛkai ni wum shɛm ka yɛl o.
en: Mordecai learned about it and told Queen Esther, who then told the king what Mordecai had found out.

dag: Ka kukol shɛli vuri daa yi binfalafala din daa be bɛ zuɣusaa maa ni na. Bɛ ni daa ti zani, ka bɛ kpabi bɛ kpiŋkpama maa.
en: The living beings stopped moving and lowered their wings. Then there was another loud sound that came from above the bowl over their heads.

dag: N ni yɛli Yawɛ zaligu yɛla. O yɛli ma, A nyɛla m bia; zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka n dɔɣ a.
en: I will announce the LORDs decision: He said to me, You are my son, today I have become your father.

dag: Ŋunkam bɔri ni o tilig o nyɛvili ni ti kɔŋ li, ka ŋunkam mi kɔŋ o nyɛvili ni ti lan nya li.
en: Those who try to save their own life will lose it; those who lose their life will save it.

dag: ka Yawɛ bɔhi, Ŋuni n-lee yɛn yɔhim Ɛhab ka o chaŋ ti lu Ramɔtigiliad? Ka yino yɛli ni ŋ-ŋɔ, ka ŋun la mi yɛli ni ŋ-ŋɔ.
en: The Lord asked, Who can trick Ahab and make him go to Ramoth where he will be killed? They talked about it for a while.

dag: Ka so yi bɔhi ya ni bɔzuɣu ka yi lɔrig o, yin yɛlimiy o ni yi Duuma m-bɔr o, amaa ni o ni lan zaŋ o labisina pumpɔŋɔ.
en: If anyone asks why you are doing this, say, The Lord needs it and will soon bring it back. .

dag: Tiŋgban ni bindira niŋya pam; Naawuni ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ niŋ alibarika niŋ ti ni.
en: The land has produced its harvest; God, our God, has blessed us.

dag: ka daa boli nachimbil so ŋun daa tumd o tuma na ti yɛl o, Zaŋm paɣ ŋɔ yihi ka kpari dunoli.
en: He summoned his young servant and said, Get this woman out of my presence and lock the door after her. .

dag: Ka n tin ya suhudoo yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka yi ti dɔni tiŋa, ka so ku varisi ya. N ni ti yihi biŋkɔb biɛri tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka so ti ku lo tɔbu n-kpe yi tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: I will give peace to your country. You will lie down in peace. No one will come to make you afraid. I will keep harmful animals out of your country. And armies will not come through your country.

dag: Di saha maa ka Yisa daa yɛl o nyaandoliba maa, Ŋunkam bɔri ni o doli ma, ŋun zaɣisim omaŋa ka kpuɣ o dapulli buɣi doli ma.
en: Then Jesus said to his followers, If any of you want to be my follower, you must stop thinking about yourself and what you want. You must be willing to carry the cross that is given to you for following me.

dag: Wamiya waa paɣ o yuli. Ŋmɛmiya biŋkumda mini guŋgombihi ni mɔɣilɔnim ni chaɣisa paɣ o.
en: Let them praise Gods name with dance; let them sing Gods praise with the drum and lyre!.

dag: ni Tiriza naa, ka bɛ zaa kalinli yiɣisi nanim pihita ni yini.
en: and Tirzah—thirty-one kings in all.

dag: Amaa di nyaaŋa n ni ti labisi Ammɔnnim daazichi ti ba. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: But later on I will make Ammon prosperous again. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: Sokam fom baalim Yawɛ tooni, dama o yiɣisi zani luɣ kasi biɛhigu shee la.
en: Everyone, be silent! The Lord is present and moving about in his holy place.

dag: Vinvamli ni taŋkpaɣu niŋdi ba la nyaɣisim, ka sokam ni doli bɛ nyaaŋa. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pun daŋ tooni ka kalinli.
en: The soil near the desert streambed is sweet to them; everyone marches after them— those before them, beyond counting.

dag: ni ŋun wuhiri bɛn ŋmɛr o naŋgbankpeeni din tuhi biɛribaalimtali puuni. Dama di pa shɛli ka Naawuni ti chɛ ka bɛ baŋ yɛlimaŋli ni nyɛ shɛli ka niŋ tuuba.
en: Be humble when you correct people who oppose you. Maybe God will lead them to turn to him and learn the truth.

dag: Bɛ mini Zɛrubabɛl ni Jɛshua ni Nɛhimia ni Azaria ni Raamia ni Nahamani ni Mɔdɛkai ni Bilishan ni Misipɛrɛt ni Biɣivai ni Nɛhum ni Baana n-daa doli kuna.
en: and that they had come with Zerubbabel, Joshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, and Baanah.

dag: Jɛramiil daa lan mali paɣ so ka o yuli booni Atara, ŋuna n-daa nyɛ Onam ma.
en: Jerahmeel had a second wife, Atarah, who gave birth to Onam.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ni yɛn zaŋ kuruwa shɛli zahindi biŋkuma mini yi ni yɛn zaŋ binshɛli zahindi binshɛŋa din nyɛ zaɣ kom saɣila taba. Kuruwa pia n-nyɛ tahili. Tahili n-nyɛ sokam ni yɛn zaŋdi shɛli zahindi binyara.
en: The ephah and the bath must be the same size. Both should be calibrated to the homer: each will contain one-tenth of a homer.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ daba ayi ka Yisifu dan maa paɣ ti lihir o kɔre lihigu, ka yɛl o, Chɛ ka m min a dɔni.
en: and after a while his master's wife began to desire Joseph and asked him to go to bed with her.

dag: Nuhu bidibisi maa zuliya mini bɛ dɔɣirikpamba yɛla m-bala. Bɛ ni ka zuliya kam yina n-nab pali dunia ŋɔ zaa, kom ni daa di dunia maa nyaaŋa.
en: This completes the list of Noah's descendants. After the flood their descendants became nations and spread all over the world.

dag: Ka n daa nya tiŋ kasi din nyɛ Jɛrusalɛm palli, ka di yi Naawuni sani alizanda ni n-sirigirina, ka malimali m-be kaman amiliya ni yi mal omaŋa n-gu o daaŋgo shɛm la.
en: I saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, made ready as a bride beautifully dressed for her husband.

dag: Amaa ka n daa ti zahim dabiɛm zahindi n-nya ʒii shɛŋa n gom shee ka di muɣisi ma pam.
en: I had a terrifying dream. My thoughts while I was lying in bed and the vision in my mind overwhelmed me.

dag: Ka n daa niŋ kaman pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga n-wurim ba kpɛhi tinzun tinsi ni din nyɛ luɣ shɛli so ni bi mi ba. Ka tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ daa kpalim zani dabari, ka so bi lan kpɛri di ni gariti yira. Lala ka di daa niŋ ka tiŋgban suŋ maa ti leei so ni ka shɛl ni.
en: That's why I came with a whirlwind and scattered them among foreign nations, leaving their lovely country empty of people and in ruins.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni yɛli shɛm Naawuni Kundi ni la: O ni daa du zuɣusaa ha la, o daa zaŋ bɛn nyɛ daba la pam mali chaŋ, ka daa zaŋ pina ti ninsalinima.
en: Thats why scripture says, When he climbed up to the heights, he captured prisoners, and he gave gifts to people .

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla kpiimba kum ni neebu yɛla, yi na bi karim Naawuni ni daa yɛli ya shɛm la?.
en: And as for people being raised to life, God was speaking to you when he said.

dag: ni Kɛdɛshi ni Ɛdirɛi ni Ɛnhazɔr.
en: Kedesh, Edrei, En Hazor.

dag: Yuma ayopɔin din kanna puuni, bindira ni niŋ pam Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ zaa ni.
en: For seven years there will be plenty of food in Egypt.

dag: Chɛliya ka zuliya kam mali shili lir o, Miidia nanim mini bɛ gomnanim ni bɛ wulaannima ni tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa din be bɛ sulinsi ni zaa.
en: Tell the kings and governors, the leaders and the people of the kingdoms of the Medes to prepare for war!.

dag: Ti ni nyɛ bɛn mini Naawuni laɣim tumdi zuɣu, ti suhiri ya ni yi di deeya Naawuni daalibarika la yoli.
en: We are workers together with God. So we beg you: Dont let the grace that you received from God be for nothing.

dag: M bihi, n sabirila dimbɔŋɔnim tiri ya ni di chɛ ka yi ku tum alahichi, amaa yi ni so yi tum alahichi, ti mali sandaantimda ŋun be ti Ba Naawuni sani: ŋuna n-nyɛ Yisa Masia ŋun nyɛ wuntialan la.
en: My children, I am writing this so you won't sin. But if you do sin, Jesus Christ always does the right thing, and he will speak to the Father for us.

dag: dama bɛ ka dahin shɛli bini; ninvuɣ biɛri firila ni kpi.
en: They will soon be gone like the flame of a lamp that burns out.

dag: Ka n daa tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa kaman o ni daa zali ma shɛm maa, ka vuhim daa kana ti kpe bɛ ni, ka bɛ leei nyɛviyanima n-yiɣisi zani bɛ naba zuɣu. Bɛ daa galisiya pam.
en: So I prophesied as I had been told. Breath entered the bodies, and they came to life and stood up. There were enough of them to form an army.

dag: Ka Sintani daa zaŋ o du zo shɛli zuɣu nti wuh o dunia ŋɔ nama zaa nini kahimbu ni neebu yim ni.
en: Then the devil took Jesus and in a moment of time showed him all the kingdoms of the world.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa yɛli Yisifu, Yɛlim a biɛyanim maa ni bɛ ʒilim bɛ bunsi ʒiya n-lab Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: So Pharaoh told Joseph, Tell your brothers to take all the food they need and go back to the land of Canaan.

dag: O ni ti zo n-dol o mamanima, amaa ka ku paai ba. O ni ti bo bɛ shee, amaa ka ku nya ba. Di saha o ni ti yɛli, N ni labi n yidaan taa la yiŋa; dama di daa so n zuɣu gari pumpɔŋɔ.
en: She will run after her lovers but will not catch them. She will look for them but will not find them. Then she will say, I am going back to my first husband—I was better off then than I am now.

dag: Nyama, a nya Yawɛ ni zaŋ a niŋ n nuu ni shɛm vol la ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, ka n niriba shɛb di yɛli ni n kum a, amaa ka man lee tilig a. N di yɛlimi, Man ku zaŋ n nuu shihi n dana, dama o nyɛla Yawɛ ni booi kpam bahi so zuɣu ni.
en: Look! Today your own eyes have seen that the LORD handed you over to me in the cave. But I refused to kill you. I spared you, saying, I wont lift a hand against my master because he is the LORDs anointed.

dag: Bakibukia mini Unno n-daa nyɛ bɛ tab bɛn ʒe n-tuhi ba laɣiŋgu maa ni.
en: Bakbukiah and Unn and their associates stood opposite them in the service.

dag: Malaika so ŋun daa yihi ma yɛl biɛri ni la, niŋm alibarika niŋ bɛ ni! Naawuni chɛ ka bihi ŋɔ zuɣu ti chɛ ka m mini n yab Ibrahimma ni m ba Yisahaku yuya ku kpi! Naawuni tim ba bihi pam, ka chɛ ka bɛ zuliya nabi.
en: He was the Angel who saved me from all my troubles. And I pray that he will bless these boys. Now they will have my name and the name of our ancestors, Abraham and Isaac. I pray that they will grow to become great families and nations on earth.

dag: Ka yihi di biŋkpam zaa nyo buɣim sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu.
en: After this, the priest will remove the fat from the bull and send it up in smoke on the altar. Finally, he will burn its remains outside the camp, just as he did with the other bull. By this sacrifice the sin of the whole nation will be forgiven.

dag: Di nabihi daa be kasi gari sakuɣa, ka piɛli gari bihim. Bɛ niŋgbuna daa mali alaafee. Bɛ zabiri viɛlim daa ŋmanila safaya kuɣa viɛlim.
en: Some of the men of Judah were dedicated to God in a special way. They were very pure. They were whiter than snow, and whiter than milk. Their bodies were red like coral and their beards like sapphire stones.

dag: Di saha ka zuliya bɛn kpalim ka nyɛ bɛn gili ya la zaa ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ m-mali luɣ shɛŋa din daa wurim maa me, ka labi biri luɣ shɛŋa din daa leei tiŋgban nɛl la. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa, ka ni niŋ li.
en: Then the nations that are still around you will know I am the Lord and that I rebuilt those places. I planted things in this land that was empty. I am the Lord . I said this, and I will make them happen.

dag: Yi daa kam ni dolila jɛmbu duu sania. Gɛra bini pisi n-ni nyɛ anzinfa laɣibaligu zaɣ yini.
en: You must use the official measure in paying these prices. The shekel by that measure weighs gerahs.

dag: Jɛrigu yi ŋahi ŋahili, di ŋmanila nir ni nyu dam kuli ka bɔri ni o ŋooi goo o nuu ni la.
en: Like a thorny bush in the hand of a drunk, so is a proverb in the mouth of fools.

dag: Bɛna n-yɛn ʒiri Naawuni jɛmbu shee pateesanim mini Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni di bimpindigu ni biŋkɔbigu gbaŋ din yɛn pa di zuɣusaa la ni Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni pateesa la.
en: for carrying the curtains of the sacred tent, its two outer coverings, the curtain for the entrance to the tent.

dag: amaa biɛɣuni ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha n sa ni tim n tuumba na ka bɛ ti kpe a min a kpambaliba yinsi nti vihi, ka bɛ yi kul nya binshɛlikam ka di tiɣi bɛ nini, bɛn kpuɣim li. .
en: Tomorrow I will send my men to search through your house and through the houses of your officials. Give my men all of your valuables, and they will bring them back to me.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni daa neeg o kum maa ni ka yih o di biɛrim ni, dama o daa pala ŋun ni kpi n-kpalim kum ni.
en: But God raised him from death, setting him free from its power, because it was impossible that death should hold him prisoner.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Di zɔriya dabiɛm; chamiya ti yɛli m mabihi maa ni bɛ cham Galili; nimaani ka bɛ ni ti nya ma.
en: Then Jesus said to them, Dont be afraid. Go tell my followers to go to Galilee. They will see me there.

dag: Siria naa mi ni ti kana ti liri Ijiptinima, amaa o ni ti kɔŋ nasara ka ŋmaligi lab kul o ya.
en: the king of Syria will invade Egypt, but he will be forced to retreat.

dag: Firawuna kpambaliba ni daa nya o, bɛ daa paɣ o pam Firawuna sani. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o tahi Firawuna yiŋa.
en: Some of the court officials saw her and told the king how beautiful she was; so she was taken to his palace.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: The Lord said to me:.

dag: Ti piligima n-lan tibigiri timaŋ yaha? Bee di nyɛla talahi ni ti tin ya shɛhira gbana bee n-deei shɛhira gbana yi sani kaman shɛb ni niŋdi shɛm la?.
en: Why are we beginning again to tell you all these good things about ourselves? Do we need letters of introduction to you or from you, like some other people?.

dag: Doo yi zaŋ paɣ so ŋun sɔrilim na bi naai dɔni m-pirig o zaɣim, o yihila paɣ maa ʒi soya zahira, ka paɣ maa gba yih omaŋmaŋ ʒi soya zahira, di simdi ka bɛ yihi bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa bɛ daŋ ni.
en: If a man has sexual relations with a woman during her monthly time of bleeding, both the woman and the man must be separated from their people. They sinned because they exposed her source of blood.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o chɛ ka bɛ niŋ buɣim nyo naɣ muni maa zaa o ninni, dina n-nyɛ o gbaŋ min o nimdi ni o ʒim ni o puuni binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: Then the whole cow, including its skin, meat, blood, and insides must be burned.

dag: Lala mi ka ti Duuma zali ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mooni lahibal suŋ ŋɔ molo gba dirila lahibal suŋ maa tuma ni.
en: In the same way, the Lord has ordered that those who preach the gospel should get their living from it.

dag: Yawɛ ni yihi ninvuɣ so ŋun niŋ lala Yaakubu zuliya ni, ka o ku lan di shɛhira bee n-garigi yɛtɔɣ shɛli bee n-zaŋ pina na ti ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ.
en: May the LORD eliminate anyone who does so from the tents of Jacob, anyone awaking, testifying, and making an offering to the LORD of heavenly forces.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kul yɛri lala chani maa, yim, ka chɛchɛbuŋ din mali buɣim mini di yuri din mali buɣim dii kana ti kpe bɛ niriba ayi maa sunsuuni n-woligi ba, ka pɔhim din mali kpiɔŋ dii kpuɣi Ilaija du zuɣusaa.
en: They were walking along, talking, when suddenly a fiery chariot and fiery horses appeared and separated the two of them. Then Elijah went to heaven in a windstorm.

dag: Ŋunkam gbi bɔɣili ni lu di ni, ka kuɣili ni marigi ŋun biligi li.
en: Those who dig a pit will fall in it; those who roll a stone will have it turn back on them.

dag: So yi nyɛla wuntizɔra, ka niŋdi zaligu ni wuhi shɛm ni din tuhi.
en: A person who is good will live! He is fair and does what is right.

dag: ka Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa daa tam di zuɣu; ka Ahio daa be Alikauli Adaka maa tooni.
en: So they carried the Holy Box out of Abinadabs house on the hill. The sons of Abinadab, Uzzah and Ahio, drove the new wagon. Ahio was walking in front of the Holy Box.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Sool, Nyama, Dauda be Naiɔt Rama tiŋgban ni.
en: Saul was told that David was in Naioth in Ramah.

dag: Ka Yisa garigi yɛl o, Chɛ ka di niŋ lala pumpɔŋɔ, dama di simdi ni ti tum din ni chɛ ka Naawuni ni zali shɛm zaa niŋ pali. Di saha ka Jɔn daa saɣi ka baptaiz o.
en: But Jesus answered him, Let it be so for now. For in this way we shall do all that God requires. So John agreed.

dag: Ka nachimbil maa daa guni yomyom, dama o suhu daa yu Yaakubu bipuɣiŋga maa hal ti yaɣi. O daa nyɛla yulilana o daŋ ni.
en: The young man didnt waste any time doing this because he liked Jacobs daughter so much. He was more respected than anyone else in his fathers household.

dag: Ti lan suhiri ti Duuma ni o chɛ ka yi yurilim zaŋ chaŋ yi tab mini sokam zaa sani zooi pahi kaman ti gba yurilim ni galisi zaŋ chaŋ yi sani shɛm la.
en: May the Lord make your love for one another and for all people grow more and more and become as great as our love for you.

dag: nti zaŋ li kpɛhi bɛ buɣili Dagɔn duu ti zali baɣili buɣili Dagɔn.
en: took it into the temple of their god Dagon, and set it up beside his statue.

dag: Laligim ka chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi luri Naawuni sizuura bɛ yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu puuni la; di nyɛla din kariti niriba Naawuni sani tahiri katiŋa.
en: Avoid their godless discussions, because they will lead many people into ungodly behavior.

dag: N yi bi tumdi m Ba tuma, yin di niŋ ma yɛda;.
en: If I dont do what my Father does, then dont believe what I say.

dag: ka di chɛliya ka yi mini ba tuhi, n ti ku zaŋ bɛ tiŋgbani maa hal napɔŋ ŋmɛbu yim gba tin ya, dama n daa pun zaŋ Ɛdom Zoli maa tila Iso ni o su li.
en: but you must not start a war with them, because I am not going to give you so much as a square foot of their land. I have given Edom to Esau's descendants.

dag: O zaani tiŋgbani zaligu, ka o ni yɛli shɛm niŋdi yomyom.
en: God issues his command to the earth— Gods word speeds off fast!.

dag: Ka ti paɣ li sahakam mini luɣ shɛlikam zaa, ka puhir a pam.
en: We welcome this everywhere and at all times, and we are deeply grateful to you.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, N ni fa yi ni gbibi yi bidibbin shɛŋa ni yi zaŋ tuhi Babilɔn naa mini Kalidianim bɛn teei gili ya yi gooni ŋɔ nyaaŋa ŋɔ labisi yi ya ŋɔ tiŋ puuni na.
en: to tell Zedekiah that the Lord , the God of Israel, had said, Zedekiah, I am going to defeat your army that is fighting against the king of Babylonia and his army. I will pile up your soldiers' weapons in the center of the city.

dag: Amaa luɣ shɛli Yawɛ ni pii yi zuliya yini sani, nimaani kɔŋko ka yi ni ti maani bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim maa, ka niŋmiya n ni zali ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam maa zaa nimaani.
en: you must offer them only in the one place that the Lord will choose in the territory of one of your tribes. Only there are you to offer your sacrifices that are to be burned and do all the other things that I have commanded you.

dag: Ti ba maa ni ka bidibisi maa zuɣu ka o yuli yɛn kpi o daŋ ni maa? Timiya ti ti tarili ni nyɛ shɛli ti ba maa mabihi sani.
en: This means that our fathers name will not continue. It is not fair that our fathers name will not continue. His name will end because he had no sons. So we ask you to give us some of the land that our fathers brothers will get.

dag: Judanim gba daa bi doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ Naawuni maa zalikpana la, amaa ka daa dolila Izraɛlnim ni daa zali ka shɛŋa la.
en: But Judah didnt keep the commands of the LORD their God either. They followed the practices of Israel.

dag: Dama bɛ daa lan mɛla buɣa jɛmbu shee mini binchunchuna zali, ka me buɣili Ashɛrim binnana n-tamtam zoli kam zuɣu; ka me shɛŋa mi zali timahili kam gbini.
en: They also built their own local shrines and stone images of foreign gods, and they set up sacred poles for worshiping the goddess Asherah on every hill and in the shade of large trees.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Tuuli Adam nyɛla Naawuni ni daa nam so ninvuɣ nɛɔŋ, ka Adam ŋun bahindi nyaaŋa mi nyɛ Shi so ŋun tiri nyɛvili.
en: For the scripture says, The first man, Adam, was created a living being; but the last Adam is the life-giving Spirit.

dag: Ka Lɔt daa vooi dunoli yo ka yi bɛ sani nti yɛli ba.
en: Lot went outside and shut the door behind him.

dag: ka o daa chɛ ka bɛ yiɣina ti lu bɛ sansani maa ni n-gili bɛ biɛhigu maa shee zaa.
en: The birds fell in the middle of the camp, all around their tents.

dag: Izraɛlnim ni daa pii wun pala la, di saha ka tɔbu daa be bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. Ninvuɣ tuhi pihinahi bɛn be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni ŋuni n-daa lee mali nyɔtaɣirigu bee kpani?.
en: The Israelites worshiped other gods, and the gates of their towns were then attacked. But they had no shields or spears to fight with.

dag: M mali kpamdi zilinkom din viɛla mini yɛm maŋli. M mali tɛhi zilima, ka lan mali kpiɔŋ.
en: I am strong, and I offer sensible advice and sound judgment.

dag: N daa tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa yi tɔŋbu saha, amaa ka yi daa yɛli, Ti ku wum. Yi biɛhigu m-pun bala yi bilim tariga, dama yi bi deei n noli.
en: The Lord spoke to you when you were prosperous, but you refused to listen. That is what you've done all your life; you never would obey the Lord .

dag: Ti yab Ibrahimma daa nyɛla yuun kɔbiga nira, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka o niŋgbuŋ gbarigi zaa, ka o paɣa Zara daa nyɛ paɣiŋoo, amaa di zaa yoli, o daa bi chɛ ka o yɛda gbarigi di zuɣu.
en: He was then almost one hundred years old; but his faith did not weaken when he thought of his body, which was already practically dead, or of the fact that Sarah could not have children.

dag: Bɛ zuɣu ka o daa teeg o daalikauli la yɛla, ka daa taɣi o tɛha o yurilim maŋli la zuɣu.
en: God remembered his covenant for their sake, and because of how much faithful love he has, God changed his mind.

dag: Ka Maluk daa nyɛ Hashabia bia, ka Hashabia nyɛ Amazia bia, ka Amazia nyɛ Hilikia bia.
en: Malluch was Hashabiahs son. Hashabiah was Amaziahs son. Amaziah was Hilkiahs son.

dag: Dama n nya ka a mali putɔɣu, ka be alahichi bandi ni.
en: For I see that you are full of bitter envy and are a prisoner of sin.

dag: Antiɔk yɛdaniŋdiba maa ni daa tim ba maa, bɛ daa zaŋ doli yila Fɔnisia mini Samaria polo n-yɛri nimaani yɛdaniŋdiba zuliya shɛb bɛn pa Yɛhudianim gba ni niŋ tuuba shɛm yɛla chana, ka di daa niŋ ba suhupiɛlli pam.
en: They were sent on their way by the church; and as they went through Phoenicia and Samaria, they reported how the Gentiles had turned to God; this news brought great joy to all the believers.

dag: Amɔz bia Aizaia ni daa deei yɛtɔɣ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Babilɔnnim polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: God showed Isaiah son of Amoz this message about Babylon:.

dag: Ka Judanim mini Izraɛlnim bɛn daa be Dan tiŋgban ni zaŋ hal ti paai Bɛrishiiba tiŋgban ni nim zaa kul be ni alaafee, ka sokam ʒin omaŋmaŋ yiŋ wain tihi mini fiig tihi gbina ni Sulemaana ʒiɛmani maa ni.
en: As long as he lived, the people throughout Judah and Israel lived in safety, each family with its own grapevines and fig trees.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, baŋmi ni o nyɛla ninvuɣ so ŋun mali taali, dama a nyɛla yɛndana; a mi a ni yɛn niŋ o shɛm chɛ ka o zuɣu piɛlli maa kpe gballi ni ni ʒim.
en: Now, dont leave him unpunished. You are a wise man. You will know what you must do, but dont let him die peacefully of old age.

dag: Yimaŋmaŋ buɣisimiya yɛlli ŋɔ: Di simdi ni paɣ suhuri Naawuni ka bi zaŋ bini pil o zuɣu?.
en: Decide this for yourselves: Is it right for a woman to pray to God without something on her head?.

dag: Di saha kokpɛɣu daa naan ʒi ti chaŋ; kopaliga daa naan du ti gari.
en: Their armies would have been like a flood washing over us, like a river drowning us.

dag: Wuntitali nyɛla din tibigiri zuliya, amaa alahichi nyɛla din dihiri niriba vi.
en: Goodness makes a nation great, but sin is a shame to any people.

dag: Zaŋmiya di binnyura lita yini sara m-pahi piɛlabil yino kam zuɣu, ka booi binnyuri kpiɔŋ bahi luɣ kasi shee m-mali binnyura sara ti Yawɛ.
en: The people must also give the drink offerings that go with the gifts. They must give quart of wine with every lamb. Pour that drink offering on the altar in the Holy Place. This is a gift to the Lord .

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ shia daa zo ka chɛ Sool, ka Yawɛ daa chɛ ka alizin biɛɣu ʒini Sool zuɣu m-muɣis o pam.
en: The Spirit of the Lord had left Saul, and an evil spirit from the Lord was terrifying him.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ yɛnnim ŋɔ, yi diri jɛra suɣilo ni suhupiɛlli!.
en: You are wise, so you will gladly be patient with fools!.

dag: Ŋuna n-kuri nabihi, ka chɛ ka dunia ŋɔ nanim zɔri dabiɛm.
en: God destroys the courage of rulers and kings and makes cowards of them.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o naanyi yi n-chaŋ sara maligu bimbini din be Yawɛ tooni la gbini nti mal li ka di be kasi, ka zaŋ naɣilaa maa mini bulaa maa ʒim shɛli n-niŋ binyila din be sara maligu bimbini la ni ti gili.
en: Then Aaron will go out to the altar that is before the Lord . Aaron will make the altar pure. He will take some of the blood from the bull and from the goat and put it on the corners of the altar on all four sides.

dag: Ka yi ti leei bɛ ni je ninvuɣ shɛb mini bɛ ni turi ninvuɣ shɛba ni bɛ ni maani ninvuɣ shɛba ansarisi Yawɛ ni yɛn zaŋ ya tahi zuliya shɛb zaa sani maa.
en: You will become a horror, fit only for use in proverbs and in insults by all the nations where the LORD drives you.

dag: A niriba ni mali suhupiɛlli! Ka a kpambaliba bɛn kul ʒiini a tooni sahakam n-wumd a yɛm maa yɛtɔɣa gba mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Your wives and officers are very fortunate! They can serve you and hear your wisdom every day.

dag: ka yɛli ba, Di ʒin ya binshɛli chaŋ yi chandi maa naɣila jaaŋgbɛhi kɔŋko; di ʒin ya bindira bee adiikunima; yi mi di zaŋya liɣiri niŋ yi liɣiri kolibihi ni.
en: He instructed them to take nothing for the journey except a walking stick—no bread, no bags, and no money in their belts.

dag: A zaligunim maa nyɛla n fali sahakam. Dina n-tiri ma suhupiɛlli.
en: They will always be my most prized possession and my source of joy.

dag: Ka n daa wum bɛ ni tabili ninvuɣ shɛb maa kalinli, ka bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihinahi ni tusaanahi bɛn nyɛ bɛn yi Izraɛl zuliya kam ni na:.
en: Then I heard the number of those who were sealed: one hundred forty-four thousand, sealed from every tribe of the Israelites.

dag: Bɛ sɔɣirimi dooni tiŋkpansi n-guri ni bɛ ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali. Bɛ kul lihirimi ni bɛ nya bɛn ku tooi sɔŋ bɛmaŋa.
en: They wait in a place perfect for ambush; from their hiding places they kill innocent people; their eyes spot those who are helpless.

dag: Miriya ka yi saɣim yi ni be tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni maa, dama ninvuɣ kubo nyɛla din saɣindi tiŋgbani. Binshɛli kani ka yi ni tooi zaŋ mali tiŋgbani maa naɣila ninvuɣ so ŋun ku nir maa ʒim.
en: If you did this, you would defile the land where you are living. Murder defiles the land, and except by the death of the murderer there is no way to perform the ritual of purification for the land where someone has been murdered.

dag: Na so ŋun doli zaligu soli, o tiŋ ni mali suhudoo, amaa na so ŋun yu liɣiri pam ni wurim o tiŋa.
en: When the king is concerned with justice, the nation will be strong, but when he is only concerned with money, he will ruin his country.

dag: Wuhim bihi so shɛli din tuhi, ka bɛ yi ti zooi niŋ ninkura, bɛ ku ŋmaligi ka chɛ li.
en: Train children in the way they should go; when they grow old, they wont depart from it.

dag: Di ni sɔhigi kaman buɣim ni chɛ ka kom din tam di zuɣu kpeeri shɛm la. Kamina ti wuh a yiko ni nyɛ shɛm a dimnim sani, ka zuliya kam zaa ni sɔhig a tooni.
en: like fire igniting brushwood or making water boil. If you would make your name known to your enemies, the nations would tremble in your presence.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, o daa deei ti dɔriti mini ti suhugarigu ʒi. Amaa ka ti daa tɛhi ni Naawuni n-darig o tibili ka ti o biɛrim maa.
en: The fact is, it was our suffering he took on himself; he bore our pain. But we thought that God was punishing him, that God was beating him for something he did.

dag: Zaŋm a nuhi shih o, ka tɛhi a min o ni yɛn va shɛm, a ku lan niŋ lala yaha.
en: Should you lay your hand on him, you would never remember the battle.

dag: Yawɛ zaligu ka Izraɛlnim maa daa doli yiɣisira, ka lan doli Yawɛ zaligu n-tiri bɛ suɣa doona. Sagbani maa daa yi kul kpalim ʒe Yawɛ biɛhigu shee suɣili maa zuɣusaa, bɛ mi kpalindimi doya.
en: The people broke camp at the command of the Lord , and at his command they set up camp. As long as the cloud stayed over the Tent, they stayed in the same camp.

dag: ka buɣim kulibɔŋ zɔri yiri di ni na. Ka niriba tusatusa shɛm tumdi tuma tir o, ka niriba tuhipii ʒiibu tuhipia ʒe o tooni. Ka saria karibu daa piligi, ka litaafinim bɔɣi doya.
en: and flames were dashing out from all around him. Countless thousands were standing there to serve him. The time of judgment began, and the books were opened.

dag: O yi daa kala o zaɣ zaŋli na, di simdi ka o lan chaŋ o zaɣ zaŋli. Ka di yi nyɛla o min o paɣa n-daa kana, dindina di simdi ka o min o paɣa maa zaa lan chaŋ.
en: If he was unmarried when he became your slave, he is not to take a wife with him when he leaves; but if he was married when he became your slave, he may take his wife with him.

dag: Bɛ tɛhirila bɛ suhuri ni, Naawuni tamiya. O ŋmaligila o nini bahi kpaŋa, o kul ku nya li sahakam.
en: They say, God can't see! He's got on a blindfold.

dag: ni Dibɔn ni Nɛbo ni Bɛtidibilateem.
en: Dibon, Nebo, Beth-Diblathaim.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti kpuɣi ti nuhi zuɣusaa, ka zaŋ ti suhuri ti Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ.
en: We should lift up our hearts and hands to God in heaven.

dag: Amaa ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa ʒe Omri nyaaŋa daa nyaŋ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe Ginat bia Tibini nyaaŋa, ka Tibini daa kpi; ka Omri leei naa.
en: In the end, those in favor of Omri won out; Tibni died and Omri became king.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Naawuni daa pun yɛli o Kundi ni ni o ni tim anabinim mini tuumba na, ka bɛ ti ku bɛ shɛba, ka niŋ bɛ shɛb mi alaka;.
en: This is why God in his wisdom said, I will send prophets and apostles to them. Some of my prophets and apostles will be killed by evil men. Others will be treated badly.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa gili Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa niŋ sunsuuni n-kari doli ba kuri ba n-zaŋ Nɔha hal ti paai Gibia wulimpuhili polo.
en: The men of Israel surrounded the men of Benjamin and began chasing them. They did not let them rest. They defeated them in the area east of Gibeah.

dag: Ka Judas Isikariɔt ŋun daa nyɛ Yisa nyaandoliba ni yino ka nyɛ ŋun daa ti yɛn yi Yisa nyaaŋa la bɔhi.
en: A disciple named Judas Iscariot was there. He was the one who was going to betray Jesus, and he asked.

dag: Deem pina maa bɛ sani n-zaŋ ba ti Lɛvinima kaman sokam tuma ni nyɛ shɛm, ka bɛ zaŋ ba tum suɣili maa ni tuma.
en: Accept these gifts for use in the work to be done for the Tent; give them to the Levites according to the work they have to do.

dag: Yidana n-su o paɣ fukumsi kaman Masia ni su cheechi fukumsi shɛm la; Masia maŋmaŋ mi n-lan nyɛ cheechi din nyɛ o niŋgbuŋ la tiligira.
en: A husband is the head of his wife, just as Christ is the head of the church. Christ is the Savior of the church, which is his body.

dag: Yinim Shafirinima, zaŋmiya yi zaɣim mini yi vi gari chaŋ. Zaanannima, di yin ya na. Bɛtɛzɛlnim kuhirimi, ka ku lan sɔŋ ya.
en: You people of Shaphir, go into exile, naked and ashamed. Those who live in Zaanan do not dare to come out of their city. When you hear the people of Bethezel mourn, you will know that there is no refuge there.

dag: Nyini n-su Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ fukumsi, zaŋm a ba min a biɛyanim maa ʒili luɣ viɛlli shee; chɛ ka bɛ ʒini Goshɛn tiŋgban ni. Ka a yi mi bɛ ni bɛn mi biŋkɔbiri gbibbu, nyin chɛ ka bɛ guli n niɣi.
en: You can choose any place in Egypt for them to live. Give your father and your brothers the best land. Let them live in the land of Goshen. And if they are skilled shepherds, they can also care for my cattle.

dag: Dama Naawuni lihi sokam zaa la yim.
en: God judges everyone the same. It doesnt matter who they are.

dag: Gbuɣindaa dari tɔhi binyara din ni saɣ o bihi, ka dim kabi binyara nyiŋgoya n-zaŋ ti ti gbuɣinnyaŋ. O zaŋ o ni gbahi binneen shɛba ti pal o ni be vokab shɛŋa ni, ka zaŋ o ni dari tɔhi nim shɛli ti pal o ni do luɣ shɛŋa.
en: The lion has torn enough prey for his cubs and strangled enough for his lionesses; he has filled his lairs with prey, his dens with torn flesh.

dag: Ka o mabia Ɛshɛk mi bidibisi daa nyɛ: Ulam n-daa nyɛ o bituuli, ŋun pah ayi n-daa nyɛ Jɛushi, ka Ɛlifɛlɛt mi daa pah ata.
en: Azel's brother Eshek was the father of Ulam, Jeush, and Eliphelet.

dag: Alɔbɔnim ŋɔ ka Yawɛ ti yɛn chɛ ka di di ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lo tɔbu na ni bɛ ti tuhi Jɛrusalɛm. Bɛ ti yɛn nɛmi ka bɛ niŋgbuna piligi poobu; ka bɛ nina ti be bɛ nimbɔɣa ni ka piligi poobu; ka bɛ zilima gba ti be bɛ noya ni ka piligi poobu.
en: Here is what the Lord will do to those who attack Jerusalem: While they are standing there, he will make their flesh rot and their eyes fall from their sockets and their tongues drop out.

dag: Puhimiya ti mabihi bɛn be Laodisia mini paɣ so ŋun yuli booni Nimfa la ni yɛdaniŋdiba bɛn laɣind o yiŋ la ti ma.
en: Say hello to the brothers and sisters in Laodicea, along with Nympha and the church that meets in her house.

dag: Binnamdi so ku tooi sɔɣi Naawuni, dama binshɛɣukam dola palɔni o sani. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ti zaa ni ti yɛn kahigi ti bebu ni nyɛ shɛm wuhi so.
en: No creature is hidden from it, but rather everything is naked and exposed to the eyes of the one to whom we have to give an answer.

dag: Zahimmi Asiria din nyɛ Lɛbanɔn sida tia, din mali wul viɛla, ka nyɛ tibɔŋ ni mahim, ka nyɛ din wɔɣa pam, ka di wulikpani chaŋ ti tɔri sagbana la.
en: There was once a cedar tree in Lebanon with large, strong branches reaching to the sky.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mi chuɣu yila yilibu mal alibarika. Yawɛ, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be a tooni neesim ni mal alibarika.
en: The people who know the celebratory shout are truly happy! They walk in the light of your presence, LORD!.

dag: Dinzuɣu benya tibi kaman yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ ni be tibi shɛm.
en: Therefore, just as your heavenly Father is complete in showing love to everyone, so also you must be complete.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ daa niŋmi ni di chɛ ka Anabi Aizaia ni daa yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. O ni daa yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ: N Duuma, ŋuni n-lee niŋ ti yɛligu yɛda? Ka ŋuni ka ti Duuma lee kahig o yiko wuhi.
en: This was to fulfill the word of the prophet Isaiah: Lord, who has believed through our message? To whom is the arm of the Lord fully revealed?.

dag: Ka doo maa yɛl o, Bɛ zaŋ kpa luɣ shɛli polo, dama n wumya ka bɛ yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ Dɔtan. Di saha ka Yisifu daa biɛh o biɛyanim maa naba nti nya ba Dɔtan maa.
en: The man said, They left here. I heard them saying, Lets go to Dothan. So Joseph went after his brothers and found them in Dothan.

dag: N pun wum dimbɔŋɔnim pam; yi zaa bɛn di yɛn maai n suhu ŋɔ nyɛla bɛn lan saɣindi n suhu pam.
en: I have heard all these things before. You men give me trouble, not comfort.

dag: Yi yi mali yɛm, yin wummiya dimbɔŋɔ. Wummiya n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ.
en: But if you have understanding, hear this; pay attention to the sound of my words.

dag: ka ŋunkam ti shihi biŋgbamdigu din ni chɛ ka o kpe daɣiri ni bee di yi nyɛla ninsal sani ka o nya daɣiri maa, o daɣiri maa yi kul nyɛ shɛlikam;.
en: He can also become unclean if he touches any unclean crawling animal. And he can become unclean if he touches an unclean person. It doesnt matter what made that person unclean.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa lan deei Filistianim ni daa tuhi fa tiŋ shɛŋa bɛ sani zaa. Ɛkurɔn zaŋ hal ti kpa Gaat, bɛ daa fa bɛ tiŋgbana zaa Filistianim sani. Ka suhudoo daa lan niŋ bɛn Izraɛlnim maa mini Amɔrinim sunsuuni.
en: All the cities which the Philistines had captured between Ekron and Gath were returned to Israel, and so Israel got back all its territory. And there was peace also between the Israelites and the Canaanites.

dag: Bɛ naala noli n-lu wuntizɔriba zuɣu, ka kari saria n-zali ni bɛ kum ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali.
en: who plot against good people and sentence the innocent to death.

dag: Balaam ni daa nya ka Yawɛ lo ni o niŋla alibarika niŋ Izraɛlnim ni maa zuɣu, o daa bi lan lihi o ni daa yi lihiri binshɛŋa ni baŋdi din yɛn niŋ kaman o ni daa yi pun niŋdi shɛm la, amaa ka zaŋ o zuɣu ʒila mɔɣu polo.
en: By now Balaam knew that the Lord wanted him to bless the people of Israel, so he did not go to look for omens, as he had done before. He turned toward the desert.

dag: Ka di simdi ka yi gbibi n ni zali ya zaligu shɛŋa zaa, ka tummiya di tuma. Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Obey all my laws and commands. I am the Lord .

dag: Ka Yisa daa yi nimaani chana nti nya Matiu, ka o ʒi farigu deebu shee; ka Yisa yɛl o, Yiɣisim doli ma. Ka o yiɣisi dol o.
en: When Jesus was leaving, he saw a man named Matthew sitting at the place for collecting taxes. Jesus said to him, Follow me. So he got up and followed Jesus.

dag: Yi zaŋ yimaŋ niŋ alaha n-chani ginda, ka taɣiri jɛmbu soya. Ijiptinim ni ti dihi ya vi kaman Asirianim ni daa dihi ya vi shɛm la.
en: You go from one place to another looking for help, always changing your mind. But Egypt will also disappoint you, just as Assyria did.

dag: Ka naa suhu daa yiɣisi pam, ka o yiɣisi bindira dibu mini binnyura nyubu duu maa ni yi nayili tihi puu ni. Ka Haman daa baŋ ni naa ni darig o tibili yɛlli maa zuɣu, ka daa kpalim ni o suh o nyɛvili Napaɣ Ɛsta sani.
en: Furious, the king got up and left the banquet for the palace garden. But Haman stood up to beg Queen Esther for his life. He saw clearly that the kings mood meant a bad end for him.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ku ninvuɣ shɛb zaa dunia ŋɔ ni Babilɔn zuɣu shɛm, lala ka di simdi ni Babilɔnnim gba kpi bɛ ni ku lzraɛlnim la zuɣu.
en: Babylon killed people from Israel. Babylon killed people from every place on earth. So Babylon must fall!.

dag: ni Kɛriɔt ni Bɔzira ni Mɔab tiŋgbɔŋ fɔntinsi zaa din be yoma mini katiŋa.
en: Kerioth, and Bozrah.

dag: Kaman piɛguliba ni vihiri bɔri bɛ piɛri shee shɛm saha shɛli bɛ yi ti wurim kpe yɔɣu la, lala ka n yɛn bo m piɛri maa shee. Sagbani mini zibisim titali dali, n ni lihi bo ba bɛ ni daa wurim kpe yɔɣu m-be luɣ shɛlikam zaa n-tiligi ba.
en: just as a shepherd looks for lost sheep. My sheep have been lost since that dark and miserable day when they were scattered throughout the nations. But I will rescue them.

dag: Filistianim mini Izraɛlnim daa ti tuhiri tɔbu, ka Izraɛlnim daa ŋmaligi guui ka chɛ Filistianim maa; ka Filistianim maa daa dol ba ti ku ba Gilibɔa Zoli zuɣu.
en: Meanwhile, the Philistines were fighting Israel at Mount Gilboa. Israel's soldiers ran from the Philistines, and many of them were killed.

dag: Ka Maata daa paai Yisa sani ti yɛl o, N Duuma, a yi di daa be ya ŋɔ, n tizɔdoo ŋɔ daa naan ku kpi;.
en: Martha said to Jesus, Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.

dag: o bidibisi min o bipuɣinsi ni o yaansi bɛn nyɛ bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi zaa kuli Ijipti.
en: His sons and grandsons, his daughters and his granddaughters—all of his descendants he brought with him to Egypt.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛlnim ni bɛ puhim Yaɣigari chuɣu maa.
en: Moses told the people what the Lord had said, and they celebrated Passover there in the desert in the evening of the fourteenth day of the first month.

dag: Di saha maa ka Siria Naa Hazaɛl daa chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ Gaatinima, ka deei bɛ tiŋ maa. Amaa Naa Hazaɛl ni daa chani ni o ti tuhi Jɛrusalɛmnima.
en: About this same time, Arams King Hazael came up, attacked Gath, and captured it. Next Hazael decided to march against Jerusalem.

dag: Ka tibili yi yɛli ni di pala nini, dinzuɣu ni di ka niŋgbuŋ ni, lala zuɣu ku chɛ ka di shiri pa niŋgbuŋ maa yaɣ shɛli.
en: Or suppose an ear says, I'm not an eye, and so I'm not part of the body. Wouldn't the ear still belong to the body?.

dag: Yisa so bɛ ni lan booni Justus la gba puhiri ya. Niriba ata ŋɔ kɔŋko n-nyɛ Yɛhudianim bɛn nyɛ n tumtumditaba Naawuni nam zuɣu; bɛ nyɛla bɛn kpaŋsiri n suhu pam.
en: Jesus, who is known as Justus, sends his greetings. These three men are the only Jewish followers who have worked with me for the kingdom of God. They have given me much comfort.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum ka o tɔɣisiri ba Hiburuli ni maa ka bɛ maan fo baalim; di saha ka o yɛli.
en: When the crowd heard Paul speak to them in Aramaic, they became even quieter. Then Paul said:.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ n Naa ni n Naawuni ŋun chɛ ka Yaakubu zuliya di nasara gbaliŋ ŋɔ.
en: You are my God and King, and you give victory to the people of Jacob.

dag: Ka o daa lan tim o yiŋbi shɛb yaha, ka yɛli ba, Chamiya ti yɛli n ni pun boli ninvuɣ shɛb la ni m pun mali bindirigu dibu shili; ka pun ku naɣilahi mini naɣipol kpaba, ka mali binshɛɣukam shili, dinzuɣu ni bɛ kam amiliya lɔbu chuɣu maa ni na.
en: He sent other servants to say to the guests, The banquet is ready! My cattle and prize calves have all been prepared. Everything is ready. Come to the banquet.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun yɛn me Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ka nya jilima shɛli din nyɛ naa jilima n-ʒin o nam ʒiishee. Ka maligumaana ni ʒe m-baɣ o nam ʒiishee maa, ka bɛ niriba ayi maa ni laɣim tumdi ni suhudoo ni naŋgban yini.
en: He will build the Lord s Temple, and he will receive the honor. He will sit on his throne and be the ruler, and a priest will stand by his throne. These two men will work together in peace.

dag: Amaa ka Izraɛl daa zaŋ o nuhi puli pa tab zuɣu n-zaŋ o nudirigu pa Ifriim ŋun daa nyɛ biasan la zuɣu ni, ka zaŋ o nuzaa mi pa Manaasa ŋun daa nyɛ bituuli maa zuɣu ni.
en: But Israel crossed his hands and put his right hand on the head of the younger boy Ephraim. Then he put his left hand on Manasseh, even though Manasseh was the firstborn.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa yi Ijipti maa na bɛn daa pun guni, amaa bɛ ni daa yi Ijipti maa na nyaaŋa ka dɔɣi bidib shɛb zaa sol ni yɔɣu maa ni la bɛn daa na bi guni.
en: All the people who went out were circumcised. But none of the people born in the desert on the way after they had left Egypt had been circumcised.

dag: ka bɛ nyɛ yuun pihita zaŋ ti paai yuun pihinu, ka bɛ zaa nyɛ bɛn ni tooi tum tuma Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili la puuni.
en: and to register all the men between the ages of thirty and fifty who were qualified to work in the Tent of the Lord 's presence.

dag: Ka o nachin kpɛm maa daa yo bɛn daa yoli kana maa tumtumda dabisi munimuni yɔri.
en: When those who were hired at five in the afternoon came, each one received a denarion.

dag: Sulemaana tumtumdiba zuliya daŋ bɛn daa yi Babilɔn n-lab kuli yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Sɔtai daŋ mini Hasofɛrɛt daŋ ni Pɛruda daŋ.
en: Sotai, Hassophereth, Peruda.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋmaligi siliga maa gbini zo yomyom, dama di daa gari ba mi pam ka bɛ ni sɔhira; bɛ mi daa bi yɛli so shɛli sol ni, dama dabiɛm daa kpe ba. .
en: So they went out and ran from the tomb, distressed and terrified. They said nothing to anyone, because they were afraid. .

dag: N daa zaŋ liiga viɛlli yɛl a, ka zaŋ gban duɣira namda pir a, ka zaŋ bɔb piɛlli bɔb a, ka zaŋ chinchin nyɛlisira sol a.
en: I dressed you in embroidered gowns and gave you shoes of the best leather, a linen headband, and a silk cloak.

dag: Ka so yi yɛli ni o yuri Naawuni ka je o mabia, o nyɛla ʒirilana; dama ŋunkam bi yur o mabi so o nini ni nyari ku tooi yuri Naawuni ŋun nyɛ o ni bi nyari so la.
en: If we say we love God but hate any of our brothers or sisters in his family, we are liars. If we dont love someone we have seen, how can we love God? We have never even seen him.

dag: Luɣ shɛlikam zaa daa zibigimi agbaa dɛde zaŋ ti paai kurig ata saha.
en: At noon the whole country became dark. The darkness continued for three hours.

dag: Ka ti Duuma yɛl o, Chɛli di zaa ha ka chaŋ, dama o nyɛla n ni pii so ni o zaŋ n yuli wuhi bɛn pa Yɛhudianim mini nazuɣuri ni Izraɛlnima.
en: The Lord said to him, Go, because I have chosen him to serve me, to make my name known to Gentiles and kings and to the people of Israel.

dag: amaa di simdi ni ti naɣ sabimi yɛli ba ni bɛ di diri buɣa maligu nimdi mini jifa ni binʒim, ka mi di niŋdi zina.
en: Instead, we should write a letter, telling them to avoid the pollution associated with idols, sexual immorality, eating meat from strangled animals, and consuming blood.

dag: ka yɛra, Nyin ŋun wurindi Naawuni jɛmbu duu ka lan mɛri li daba ata sunsuuni ŋɔ, tiligim amaŋa! A yi shiri nyɛla Naawuni Bia, nyin siɣim dapulli maa zuɣu na.
en: and said, You said you could destroy the Temple and build it again in three days. So save yourself! Come down from that cross if you really are the Son of God.

dag: Salima beni ka kuɣ viɛla pam din mali shaara beni, amaa noli din tɔɣisiri baŋsim yɛtɔɣa n-nyɛ binshɛli din viɛl gari di zaa.
en: Much gold and many pearls exist, but wise speech is the most precious jewel.

dag: Yi ni tooi zani Naawuni zaani n-tɔɣisi ʒiri yɛtɔɣa, bee n-zan o zaani tɔɣisi yɔhiŋ yɛtɔɣa?.
en: Are you telling lies for God.

dag: Ti Duuma zal o zaligu, ka paɣiba pam zaŋ di lahibali moli gili;.
en: You gave the command, Lord , and a chorus of women told what had happened:.

dag: Amaa yinim bɛn zaɣisi ma, ka tam n zoli din be kasi la yɛla, ka puhiri churi ka jɛmdi zuɣusuŋ wuna la.
en: But you who abandon the LORD, who forget my holy mountain, who set a table for a god of good fortune, and fill cups of mixed wine for a god of fate.

dag: Ka o daa ti chaŋ bimbin shɛli o ni daa me n-zali Bɛtɛl la gbini gol so ŋun pahir anii biɛɣ pinaanu dali din nyɛ omaŋmaŋ ni daa zali dabisi shɛli la ni o ti tuɣili tulaale zim o ni daa zali chu shɛli n-ti Izraɛlnim la puhibu dali.
en: On the fifteenth day of the eighth month—the time he alone had decided—Jeroboam went up to the altar he had built in Bethel. He made a celebration for the Israelites and offered sacrifices on the altar by burning them up.

dag: Hal ninvuɣ biɛri ni bari ma zana la zaa yoli, n ku tam a zaligu maa yɛla.
en: Evil people may set a trap, but I obey your Law.

dag: Bɛtani do so ŋun yuli daa booni Lazarɔs daa ti biɛra. O min o tizɔpaɣiba Mariama mini Maata zaa ya n-daa bala.
en: A certain man, Lazarus, was ill. He was from Bethany, the village of Mary and her sister Martha. .

dag: M bihi, chɛliya ka yi baɣa be yi tuma ni, dama Yawɛ m-pii ya ni yi zaan o tooni tumd o tuma, ka leeg o tumtumdiba m-maani sara tir o.
en: So my sons, dont be lazy or waste any more time. The Lord chose you to serve him in the Temple and to burn incense.

dag: Biɛɣ asiba ka Yawɛ daa be sagban buɣim daantaliga maa ni, ka lihi tiŋ na n-nya Ijipti tɔbbihi maa, ka o chɛ ka bɛ lu abirima.
en: Just before dawn the Lord looked down from the pillar of fire and cloud at the Egyptian army and threw them into a panic.

dag: O daa lan zaŋ nyolɔrigu lo o pahi, ka zaŋ Urim mini Tumim niŋ di ni;.
en: Next, he put on Aaron the sacred breastpiece that was used in finding out what the Lord wanted his people to do.

dag: Ijipti naa ni ti mali kpiɔŋ, amaa o sapashinnim ni yino ni ti mali kpiɔŋ gar o, ka ni ti di nam din galisi.
en: The southern king will become strong, but then one of his commanders will defeat him. The commander will begin to rule, and he will be very powerful.

dag: Bɛ wain tihi yila Sɔdom wain tihi ni na, ka yi Gomɔra wain tihi puri ni na. Bɛ wain tiwala nyɛla wala din mali lɔɣu. Di zaɣ yila nyɛla din to.
en: Their roots run straight from Sodom— from the fields of Gomorrah! Their grapes are pure poison; their grape clusters, nothing but bitter.

dag: N daa kul fomi baalim ka bi yɛli shɛli, hal n daa bi yɛli shɛli zaŋ chaŋ din viɛli gba polo! Amaa ka n wahala daa lee kul pahira;.
en: I kept completely silent, but it did no good, and I hurt even worse.

dag: Hamat mini Aripad ni Sɛfarivaim ni Hɛna ni Iva nanim la lee kpalim ya.
en: Where is the king of Hamath? The king of Arpad? The king of the city of Sepharvaim? The kings of Hena and Ivvah.

dag: Ka o bɔhi n ni nyɛ ninvuɣ so, ka n yɛl o, N nyɛla Amalɛk nira.
en: Who are you? he asked, and I told him, Im an Amalekite.

dag: Jɛhɔshafat daa kul dolila o ba Asa soli ka bi birigi li. O daa kul tumdila din tiɣiri Yawɛ nini.
en: Jehoshaphat obeyed the Lord , just as his father Asa had done.

dag: Dinzuɣu tintariga maa yɛn zaŋla teeku tariga hal ni Hazɛrɛnɔn din be Damaskus tintariga nuzaa polo, ka chɛ Hamat tintariga bahi nuzaa polo. Dina n-yɛn nyɛ nuzaa polo maa yaɣili.
en: So the northern boundary runs from the Mediterranean eastward to Enon City, with the border regions of Damascus and Hamath to the north of it.

dag: amaa ka di ni nyɛla bɛ ni nyari yi biɛrisuŋ zaŋ tabili yi ni luri ba sizuura Naawuni zuɣu shɛm la zuɣu.
en: Your husbands will see the pure lives that you live with respect for God.

dag: Bani daŋ ni: Mɛshulam mini Maluk ni Adaya ni Jashub ni Shial ni Jɛrɛmɔt so yaha.
en: Of the family of Bani: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth.

dag: N ni yili yila paɣi Yawɛ, dama a niŋ ma zaɣ viɛlli pam.
en: I will sing to you, O Lord , because you have been good to me.

dag: Ka Maika daa labisi anzinfa kpila tuhili ni kɔbiga maa ti o ma. Ka o ma yɛli, N zaŋ anzinfa maa ti Yawɛ ni n zaŋ li ti m bia ŋɔ ka o zaŋ li mali anzinfa binnani. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ n ni labisi li ti a.
en: Micah gave the pounds of silver back to his mother. Then she said, I will give this silver as a special gift to the Lord . I will give it to my son so that he can make a statue and cover it with the silver. So now, son, I give the silver back to you.

dag: Amaa ni a ni chaŋla n ya n dɔɣiriba sani ti bo paɣ na ti ti m bia Yisahaku ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: You must go back to the country where I was born and get a wife for my son Isaac from among my relatives.

dag: dindina n ni niŋ jɛmbu duu ŋɔ kaman n ni daa niŋ Shilo shɛm la, ka chɛ ka tiŋ ŋɔ leei noli ni di shɛli dunia ŋɔ zuliya kam sani.
en: If you dont obey me, I will make my Temple in Jerusalem just like my Holy Tent at Shiloh. People all over the world will think of Jerusalem when they ask for bad things to happen to other cities.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli, Yi ni niŋdi shɛm maa bi viɛla. Di simdi ni yi zɔri Naawuni ka tumdi din tuhi. Ka di zuɣu chɛ ka yi ku ti zuliya shɛb bɛn nyɛ ti dimnim la soli ka bɛ mali ti ansarisi.
en: Then I said, What you are doing is wrong! You ought to obey God and do what's right. Then you would not give our enemies, the Gentiles, any reason to ridicule us.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnim zaa: Gol so ŋun pahir ayopɔin maa biɛɣ pinaanu dali, zaŋmiya daba ayopɔin m-puhi Naawuni chuɣu din nyɛ suɣa tibu chuɣu la.
en: Say to the Israelites: The Festival of Booths to the LORD will start on the fifteenth day of the seventh month and will last for seven days.

dag: Yisa mabihi maa ni daa chaŋ chuɣu maa ni nyaaŋa ka o gba daa ti yiɣisi chaŋ chuɣu maa ni ashilɔni.
en: However, after his brothers left for the festival, he went too—not openly but in secret.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino daa shiri chɛ n-shɛligi maligumaaniba zuɣulan dabili nudirigu tibili bahi.
en: One of them struck the high priests servant, cutting off his right ear.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum Judas ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka di niŋ ba nyaɣisim pam, ka bɛ lo o alikauli ni bɛ ni ti o liɣiri. Ka o daa piligi bɔri so shɛli o ni yɛn doli yi Yisa nyaaŋa chɛ ka bɛ gbaag o.
en: When they heard it, they were delighted and promised to give him money. So he started looking for an opportunity to turn him in.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim dɔɣirikpamba maa daa ti zab bɛ ni yino ŋun yuli daa booni Yisifu la nyuli n-gaŋ o, ka daa ti zaŋ o kɔhi Ijiptinim zuɣu; amaa ka Naawuni daa zan o nyaaŋa.
en: Because the patriarchs were jealous of Joseph, they sold him into slavery in Egypt. God was with him, however.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Piɛgula ni fari biŋgbaya ayi bee bin tibichaɣu gbuɣinli nol ni shɛm la, lala ka n fa Izraɛlnim bɛn be Samaria n-do gar suma zuɣu la bahi.
en: The Lord says, As a shepherd recovers only two legs or an ear of a sheep that a lion has eaten, so only a few will survive of Samaria's people, who now recline on luxurious couches.

dag: Bɛ daa lab bɛ shɛb kuɣa ku ba, ka daa zaŋ sua m-pirigi bɛ shɛb buyiyi; ka daa zahim bɛ shɛba, ka zaŋ takɔbi ku shɛba. Bɛ ni shɛb daa yɛrila piɛri mini buhi gbana chani ginda. Bɛ daa nyɛla nandaamba ni bɛn nyari muɣisigu mini nahiŋgu.
en: They were stoned to death, they were cut in two, and they died by being murdered with swords. They went around wearing the skins of sheep and goats, needy, oppressed, and mistreated.

dag: n yi ti sahi n takɔb shɛli din nyaɣisiri ŋɔ, ka zaŋ saria karibu niŋ n nuu ni, n ni bɔhi n dimnim biɛri, ka darigi bɛn je ma la tibili.
en: I swear, I will sharpen my flashing sword. I will use it to punish my enemies. I will give them the punishment they deserve.

dag: Ka n suhi a nyaandoliba ŋɔ ni bɛ kari alizin biɛɣu maa, ka bɛ bi tooi.
en: I begged your followers to make the evil spirit leave my son, but they could not do it.

dag: Dama ŋunkam niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnima nyɛla Yawɛ ni bi bɔri so, binyɛra din chihiri ŋɔ niŋbu zuɣu ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ daŋ kariti ba maa.
en: The Lord your God hates people who do these disgusting things, and that is why he is driving those nations out of the land as you advance.

dag: Ka naa maa daa bahi noli ni bɛ cham ti gbaai Daniɛl na nti niŋ gbuɣima bɔɣili maa ni. Naa maa daa yɛli Daniɛl, A ni jɛmd a Naawuni so viɛnyɛliŋga maa ni fa a bahi.
en: So the king gave orders for Daniel to be taken and thrown into the pit filled with lions. He said to Daniel, May your God, whom you serve so loyally, rescue you.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, wuntizɔriba ni paɣ a yuli; ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be tibi ni ti be a sani.
en: Your people will praise you and will live with you because they do right.

dag: O daa yɛli ba, Na so ŋun ti yɛn sun ya biɛhigu ni ti yɛn nyɛ shɛm yi sani m-bɔŋɔ, o ni ti zaŋ yi bidibisi niŋ chɛchɛbumbariba mini wɔribariba, ka bɛ be o chɛchɛbuŋ tooni.
en: If you have a king, this is how he will treat you. He will force your sons to join his army. Some of them will ride in his chariots, some will serve in the cavalry, and others will run ahead of his own chariot.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ biɛri mini karimba ʒirinim kul ni chani tooni n-tumdi din bie nti yaɣi, ka yɔhindi niriba, ka bɛmaŋmaŋ gba ni ti lu yɔhiŋgu ni.
en: and evil persons and impostors will keep on going from bad to worse, deceiving others and being deceived themselves.

dag: Di nyɛla kaman n ni pun yɛli nyin Firawuna shɛm la, Naawuni n-kahig o ni yɛn niŋ shɛli wuh a.
en: It is just as I told you—God has shown you what he is going to do.

dag: Lala ka bɛ yɛn ku yi gba m-pahi bɛ ni daa zaŋ takɔbi ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi guni la zuɣu.
en: You Egyptians will be cruelly defeated, and you will be buried alongside these other godless soldiers who died in battle.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa sabi yilli ŋɔ dindali maa n-zaŋ li wuhi Izraɛlnim maa.
en: So that same day Moses wrote down the song and taught it to the Israelites.

dag: Bi so ŋun bɔri yɛm, o tirila o ba bee o ma suhupiɛlli, amaa ŋun doli pagɔra ni bahi o buni yoli.
en: A man who loves wisdom makes his father rejoice, but one who spends time with prostitutes destroys riches.

dag: Stɛfanas mini Fɔtunatus ni Akaikus ni daa ka n sanna la niŋ ma suhupiɛlli pam, dama bɛ daa zani yi zaani n-niŋ ma yi ni naan niŋ ma shɛm.
en: I was glad to see Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus. Having them here was like having you.

dag: Chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi bahila zuliya shɛb bɛn bi mi a la mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bi jɛmd a la zuɣu. Dama bɛna n-vali Yaakubu zuliya. Bɛ vali Yaakubu zuliya n-naai ba; ka chɛ ka bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ zani dabari.
en: Turn your anger on the nations that do not worship you and on the people who reject you. They have killed your people; they have destroyed us completely and left our country in ruins.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Pool daa yi Atɛnsi n-chaŋ Kɔrinti.
en: Paul left Athens and went to Corinth.

dag: M bi suhir a tirila bɛmbɔŋɔ kɔŋko, amaa n suhir a tiri bɛn gba na yɛn niŋ ma yɛda bɛmbɔŋɔ yɛligu wumbu ni la.
en: I pray not only for them, but also for those who believe in me because of their message.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ zilinli gba: di nyɛla din pɔra, amaa ka nyɛ din nyuri bara yɛri yɛl kara. Lihimiya buɣim biɛla ni yi taai tibɔŋ ni n-di li shɛm!.
en: Our tongues are small too, and yet they brag about big things. It takes only a spark to start a forest fire!.

dag: Hal o yi tum a taali siɣimsiɣim buyopɔin dahin yini ka ŋmaligi deeg o galimi siɣimsiɣim buyopɔin maa zaa, di niŋ kamaata ni a chɛ m-paŋ o.
en: Even if they do something wrong to you seven times in one day, but they say they are sorry each time, you should forgive them.

dag: O kpani maa daa ŋmanila kpalu dapua, ka o kpani maa zuɣu tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram ayopɔin. Ka ŋun ʒir o nyɔtaɣirigu be o tooni.
en: His spear shaft was as strong as the bar on a weavers loom, and its iron head weighed fifteen pounds. His shield-bearer walked in front of him.

dag: Amaa nyini n tiligi ti ti dimnim nuu ni, ka chɛ ka bɛn je ti la birim.
en: But you saved us from our hateful enemies, and you put them to shame.

dag: Ka Dauda daa duh o yee bɔhi tɔbbihi maa mini Nɛr bia Abinɛr la, Abinɛr, a ku garigi ma? Ka Abinɛr garigi bɔhi, Nyin ŋuni n-lee booni naa maa.
en: Then David shouted to the army and to Abner, Ners son, Abner! Arent you going to answer me? Who are you to shout to the king? Abner asked.

dag: Dama Man Yawɛ bi taɣira. Dinzuɣu ka yinim Yaakubu zuliya bi bahi yoli.
en: I am the LORD, and I do not change; and you, children of Jacob, have not perished.

dag: Di saha ka niriba maa zaa daa saɣi ni bɛ lan zaŋm daba ayopɔin puhi chuɣu maa yaha. Ka bɛ daa lan zaŋ daba ayopɔin puhi chuɣu maa ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Everyone was so excited that they agreed to celebrate seven more days.

dag: Yawɛ, tiligim ma n dimnim nuu ni. A sani ka n zona ti sɔɣi.
en: I go to you for protection, Lord ; rescue me from my enemies.

dag: O mini Ammɔn naa min o niriba daa tuhiya ka o daa nyaŋ ba. Ka Ammɔnnim maa daa ti o anzinfa kilɔgiram tusaata ni kɔbisinahi mini alikama din tibisim nyɛ tɔn tuhili ni chi din tibisim nyɛ tɔn tuhili, ka bɛ daa ti o li lala yuma ata.
en: He fought against the king of the Ammonites and defeated the Ammonites. They paid him one hundred kikkars of silver, ten thousand kors of wheat, and ten thousand kors of barley that year and for the next two years.

dag: Ka bɛn ti yɛn bɛ suɣa pa bɛ zuɣu nyɛla Isaka zuliya. Isaka niriba maa toondana n-yɛn nyɛ Zua bia Nɛtanɛl.
en: Those camping on one side of him are the tribe of Issachar. The chief of the people of Issachar is Nethanel, Zuars son.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-kahigiri wuhiri Naawuni bihi ni nyɛ shɛba, ka lan wuhiri Sintani gba bihi ni nyɛ shɛba: Ŋunkam bi tumdi din tuhi bee n-yur o mabia pala Naawuni bia.
en: Here is the clear difference between God's children and the Devil's children: those who do not do what is right or do not love others are not God's children.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yi ti kari ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ zuliya shɛb tiŋgbɔŋ tiri ya maa, ka yi yihi ba, ka ʒini bɛ fɔntinsi ni n-kpe m-be bɛ yiya ni.
en: After the Lord your God has destroyed the people whose land he is giving you and after you have taken their cities and houses and settled there.

dag: O tɔbbihi mali kalinli? Ka ŋuni ka o neesim lee bi paara?.
en: No one can count his stars. His sun rises on all people.

dag: Yɛla ŋɔ zaa puuni, Ayuba daa bi tum alahichi bee n-galim Naawuni ni o ni niŋ shɛm maa bi tuhi.
en: In spite of everything, Job did not sin or accuse God of doing wrong.

dag: N di kul gbilisirila tibili, amaa yɛlimaŋli, yi ni so bi wuhi ni Ayuba mali taali bee n-garig o yɛtɔɣa maa shɛli.
en: I paid close attention and heard you fail; you have not disproved what Job has said.

dag: Ka binshɛli yi sɔɣi, di sɔɣimi ni di ti yi zahira, ka binshɛli din mi be ashilɔni, di be ashilɔni maa ni di ti yila palo.
en: There is nothing hidden that will not be made public. There is no secret that will not be well known.

dag: Utai daa nyɛla Ammihud bia, ka Ammihud daa nyɛ Omri bia, ka Omri nyɛ Imri bia, ka Imri nyɛ Bani bia. Bani maa daa yila Pɛrɛz daŋ ni na, ka Pɛrɛz mi daa nyɛ Juda bia.
en: Uthai was Ammihuds son. Ammihud was Omris son. Omri was Imris son. Imri was Banis son. Bani was a descendant of Perez. Perez was Judahs son.

dag: Di saha ka Hɛzɛkia daa yɛli Aizaia A ni zaŋ Yawɛ yɛtɔɣ shɛli yɛli maa viɛla. O daa tɛhimi ni suhudoo ni alaafee ni be o ʒiɛman ni.
en: King Hezekiah understood this to mean that there would be peace and security during his lifetime, so he replied, The message you have given me from the Lord is good.

dag: Gomna Pailɛt ni daa ʒiya kariti saria maa ka o paɣ timna ti yɛl o, Yihim a nuu wuntizɔra ŋɔ yɛla ni, dama yuŋ la n sa nya muɣisigu pam zahindi ni o zuɣu.
en: While Pilate was sitting there in the place for judging, his wife sent a message to him. It said, Dont do anything with that man. He is not guilty. Last night I had a dream about him, and it troubled me very much.

dag: Ka Abiata maa daa yɛli Dauda ni Sool ku Yawɛ maligumaaniba la.
en: Abiathar reported to David that Saul had slaughtered the LORDs priests.

dag: Naawuni, yiɣisim kari dunianim saria, dama nyini n-su zuliya kam zaa.
en: Rise up, God! Judge the earth because you hold all nations in your possession!.

dag: M paɣiri Naawuni n ni tɔɣisiri tinzun yɛligu balibu kam yɛtɔɣa Naawuni Shia Kasi yiko ni gari yi zaa la zuɣu.
en: I thank God that I speak in tongues more than all of you.

dag: N ni daa zaŋ dabu gbaŋ maa ti Nɛria bia Baruk maa nyaaŋa, ka n daa suhi Yawɛ yɛra.
en: After I gave the deed to Baruch son of Neriah, I prayed to the Lord :.

dag: Di saha ka bɛ ni yino daa yɛl o, A yi di saɣi n-dol ti chaŋ. Ka o garigi yɛli, N ni chaŋ.
en: Aren't you going with us? one of the prophets asked. Yes, I'll go, Elisha answered.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn paya ŋɔ n-nyɛ bɛn daa yi Tɛlimɛla mini Tɛliharisha ni Kɛrub ni Addɔn ni Imɛr n-lab kuli na la, amaa ka bɛ daa lee bi tooi wuhi bɛ yaannim ni nyɛ shɛba bee bɛ ni yi shɛli na din wuhiri ni bɛ nyɛla Izraɛl zuliya.
en: The following came up from Tel-Melah, Tel-harsha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer, but were unable to prove that their family or their descent was from Israel.

dag: Ka yiɣisi nimaani yi zɔŋ ni. Ka yili maa ni bipuɣin so gba ti lan nya o ka yɛli bɛn daa ʒe nimaani maa, Doo ŋɔ gba yi bela Yisa ŋun yi Nazarɛt na ŋɔ sani.
en: When Peter had gone out to the gate, another servant girl saw him and said to some people there, This man was with Jesus from Nazareth.

dag: Ti Duuma zuɣu, doliya dunia ŋɔ fukumsinim zaa yɛligu, di yi nyɛla nazuɣu ŋun su fukumsi.
en: For the sake of the Lord submit to every human institution. Do this whether it means submitting to the emperor as supreme ruler.

dag: Fukumsinim yi bɔhi ti zuŋɔ taabu ŋɔ gbinni, ti ni kpe yɛla ni di zuɣu, dama ti ka daliri yɛlli ŋɔ puuni din ni zaŋ wuhi ba.
en: For after what has happened today, there is the danger that we will be accused of a riot. There is no excuse for all this uproar, and we would not be able to give a good reason for it.

dag: Amaa di wuhiri yi gba yɛla: Di simdi ni yidan kam yur o paɣa kaman omaŋmaŋ la; ka di simdi ni yidaampaɣ kam gba lur o yidan sizuura.
en: In any case, as for you individually, each one of you should love his wife as himself, and wives should respect their husbands.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihinahi ni tusaanahi la daa zani nam ʒiishee la mini binnɛma anahi la ni kpamba la tooni n-yili yil palli. Ka so daa naan ku tooi bɔhim yilli maa m-pahila bɛn bɛn daa tiligi dunia ni la kɔŋko.
en: They sing a new song in front of the throne, the four living creatures, and the elders. And no one could learn the song except the one hundred forty-four thousand who had been purchased from the earth.

dag: O yi lo ni o kul doli n fukumsi zaligunim mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi kaman o ni doli li shɛm zuŋɔ ŋɔ, n ni chɛ ka o nam mali yaa.
en: I will make his kingdom last forever if he continues to obey carefully all my laws and commands as he does now.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla wuntialana. O chihi ninvuɣ biɛri ni lo ti mi shɛŋa.
en: But the Lord does what is right; he cut the ropes and set me free from those wicked people.

dag: Sɔŋmi ti ka ti nyaŋ ti dimnima; dama ninsal sɔŋsim ka buchi.
en: Give us help against the enemy; human help is worthless.

dag: N Naa ni n Naawuni, wummi n ni kuhiri bɔri sɔŋsim shɛm ŋɔ, dama nyini ka n suhira.
en: Listen to my cry for help, my God and king! I pray to you, O Lord ;.
