dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ yi ti yɛli ya, Nyamiya, o be mɔɣu ni, yin di chaŋya; ka bɛ mi yi ti yɛli ya, O be duu puuni, yin di niŋya li yɛda.
en: So if they say to you, Look, hes in the desert, dont go out. And if they say, Look, hes in the rooms deep inside the house, dont believe it.

dag: N ni ku ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri zaa, ka ku noonsi bɛn yiɣiri zuɣusaa ŋɔ mini teeku ni zahim, ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri tuui; n ni ku ninsalinim zaa dunia yili. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I will destroy humanity and the beasts; I will destroy the birds in the sky and the fish in the sea. I will make the wicked into a heap of ruins; I will eliminate humanity from the earth, says the LORD.

dag: Bɛ zuliya maa ni ninvuɣ zuɣuri yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Mɛshɔbab mini Jamlɛk ni Amazia bia Jɔsha.
en: The following men were the heads of their clans: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah son of Amaziah, Joel, Jehu , Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah, Ziza . Because their families continued to grow.

dag: Dama n yɛri ya mi ni Masia daa leei Yɛhudianim dapala ni o wuhi ni Naawuni nyɛla ŋun ni chɛ ka o ni daa lo ti yaannim alikauli shɛŋa la niŋ pali.
en: I tell you that Christ came as a servant of the Jews to show that God has kept the promises he made to their famous ancestors. Christ also came.

dag: Ka n daa ti yiɣis asiba ni o mɔɣi, ka nya ka o kpimi. Amaa ka n daa lih o viɛnyɛliŋga asiba maa n-nya ka o pala m bi so n ni daa dɔɣi maa.
en: In the morning when I got up to feed my son, I saw that he was dead. But when I looked at him in the light, I knew he wasn't my son.

dag: amaa zaŋ tabili ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka ti sani kpe zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ gba.
en: Yes, he is making this agreement with all of you who stand here with us today before the Lord our God. But this agreement is also for our descendants who are not here with us today.

dag: Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun gbibi duu maa zaa ka chɛ ka di mɛri zoori hal ti leeri jɛmbu du kasi ti Duuma ni.
en: The whole building is joined together in Christ, and he makes it grow and become a holy temple in the Lord.

dag: N yɛliya, Timiya ma pini? Bee Piimiya yi buni shɛli m-pa talima ti ma?.
en: But have I ever asked you to help me? Did I ask you to offer a bribe for me from your wealth?.

dag: Ka nyɔhi daa mɔni Sinai Zoli maa zuɣu zaa, dama Yawɛ n-daa siɣi di zuɣu na ni buɣim, ka di nyɔhi maa daa kpuɣi du kaman tampuli zuɣu nyɔhi la, ka zoli maa zaa daa dam pam.
en: Mount Sinai was all in smoke because the LORD had come down on it with lightning. The smoke went up like the smoke of a hot furnace, while the whole mountain shook violently.

dag: Ka n ni ti yɛli ni n suhu zaa, Yawɛ, ŋuni n-lee beni ŋ-ŋman a? Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun fari bɛn ka yaa kpiɔŋlaannim nuu ni bahira, ka lan nyɛ ŋun fari nandaamba bɛn nahindi ba nuu ni bahira.
en: All my bones will say, LORD, who could compare to you? You rescue the weak from those who overpower them; you rescue the weak and the needy from those who plunder them.

dag: Di chaŋya ti tuhi Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ yi mabihi maa. Labimiya kuli, n sani ka din niŋ maa yina. Ka bɛ daa wum Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa ka lab kuli kaman Yawɛ ni daa shiri yɛli ba shɛm maa.
en: This is what the LORD says: Dont make war against your relatives the Israelites. Go home, every one of you, because this is my plan. When they heard the LORDs words, they went back home, just as the LORD had said.

dag: Dama ŋun nam a ni be a kaman paɣ yidan ni be o shɛm la. O yuli n-nyɛ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa. Ŋuna n-nyɛ a tiligira ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun be kasi la. O yuli n-lan nyɛ, dunia zaa Naawuni.
en: The one marrying you is the one who made you— the LORD of heavenly forces is his name. The one redeeming you is the holy one of Israel, the one called the God of all the earth.

dag: Yɛlim Aduna, A bihi bɛn be a ʒiɛman ni zaa ŋun mali dalinli, ŋun miri ka o mirina ni o ti zaŋ o Naawuni bindirigu mali sara.
en: Say to Aaron: None of your future descendants who have some kind of imperfection are allowed to offer their Gods food.

dag: Lala ka Naawuni niŋ zaŋ yi ba biŋkɔbiri ti ma.
en: That's how God has taken sheep and goats from your father and given them to me.

dag: Yi ni tooi lan da saan shɛb mini tinzunnim bɛn be yi sani mini bɛ malibu ni dɔɣi bi shɛb yi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni bɛ sani, ka bɛ leei yi sulinsi.
en: You can also buy them from the foreign guests who live with you and from their extended families that are with you, who were born in your land. These can belong to you as property.

dag: Nyini n-nyɛ ŋun daa yihi ma n dimnim nuu ni. Nyini n-daa duhi ma gari n dimnima. Nyini n-daa fa ma ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn taai duŋ nuu ni bahi.
en: You protected me from violent enemies, and you made me much greater than all of them.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛli Hilikia maa mini Shafan bia Ahikam ni Maika bia Abidɔn ni Shafan ŋun daa nyɛ gbaŋŋmar la ni naa kpambala Asaaya.
en: At once he called together Hilkiah, Shaphan, Ahikam son of Shaphan, Abdon son of Micah, and his own servant Asaiah. He said.

dag: Amaa daadamnim bɛn yi kpi, bɛ lan ka yaa. Daadamnim yi bahi, ya ka bɛ lee lan be?.
en: But when a man dies, he becomes weak and sick, and then he is gone!.

dag: Di saha ka Musa mini Izraɛl kpamba daa yɛli niriba maa zaa. Doliya n ni zaŋ zaligu shɛŋa zaa tin ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Then Moses and Israels elders commanded the people: Keep all of the commandment that I am giving you right now.

dag: Di saha ka Kɔra daa laɣim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa taai duŋ maa zaa Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni. Ka Yawɛ jilima neesim daa neei niriba maa zaa sani.
en: Korah also gathered all the people together at the entrance of the Meeting Tent. Then the Glory of the Lord appeared to everyone there.

dag: Bɛ yɛrila Naawuni, Zom ka chɛ ti! Ti bi bɔri ni ti baŋ a soli.
en: They say to God, Turn away from us; we take no pleasure in knowing your ways.

dag: Yaa n Naawuni, ka dimbɔŋɔ na nyɛla din pɔra a sani, ka a lan yɛli n yili ni ti yɛn be shɛm saha shɛli din na kanna. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, a lan wuhi ma n zuliya ni ti yɛn be shɛm yuma din kanna.
en: and yet you have promised to do even more for my descendants. You are treating me as if I am a very important person.

dag: Ka Babilɔnnim daa ŋme n-wurim daanya daantalisi mini tɔrokɔnim daanya ni daanya kɔniŋdi bin titali din daa be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la, ka kpuɣi daanya maa kuli Babilɔn.
en: The Babylonian soldiers took the two bronze columns that stood in front of the temple, the ten movable bronze stands, and the large bronze bowl called the Sea. They broke them into pieces so they could take the bronze to Babylonia.

dag: Ka yi ninvuɣ yino kam karitimi doli ninvuɣ tuhili ka bɛ ŋmaligiri guura, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni tuhiri ba tiri ya kaman o ni daa pun lɔn ya alikauli shɛm la zuɣu.
en: With his help, one man from Israel could defeat enemy soldiers, because the Lord your God fights for you, as he promised.

dag: O ni daa ti yina, o daa kɔŋla yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu, ka bɛ baŋ ni o nya ʒii Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, dama o daa kul malila o nuhi buɣisira, ka ku lan tooi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa yaha.
en: When he came out, he could not speak to them, and so they knew that he had seen a vision in the Temple. Unable to say a word, he made signs to them with his hands.

dag: A niŋ yɛda ni o ni ʒi a puu atam labina ti sɔŋ a kabɔɣili ni?.
en: Can you trust him to gather your grain and bring it to your threshing place?.

dag: Ka din pa di zuɣu ŋ-ŋman li mi nyɛla, Yum a ʒiʒiinikpee kaman amaŋmaŋ la.
en: And the second command is like the first: Love your neighbor the same as you love yourself.

dag: Ka n daa nya ka Piɛbil maa tabigi bintabinda maa ni din pah ayɔbu, ka tiŋgbani damda, ka wuntaŋ sabigi kaman bɛ ni zaŋ chinchin shɛli n-tim shim ni la, ka goli mi mooi kaman ʒim la.
en: When I saw the Lamb open the sixth seal, I looked and saw a great earthquake. The sun turned as dark as sackcloth, and the moon became red as blood.

dag: Amaa Ɛhab kum nyaaŋa, ka Mɔab naa maa daa zaɣisi ni o ku lan niŋ lala ti Izraɛl naa.
en: But when Ahab died, Moabs king rebelled against Israels king.

dag: Yɛlim ba yaha ni bɛ zaŋm tɔrokɔnim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni m-mali kuli ti zaŋ bɛ paɣiba mini bɛ bibihi ni yi ba n-kuli kpe na.
en: Tell them also to take wagons with them from Egypt for their wives and small children and to bring their father with them.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa yɛl o kpamba bɛn be o sani zaa, Yiɣisimiya ka ti zo, di yi pa lala ti ti ku tooi lan zo n-yi Absalom nuu ni. Ti zomiya yomyom, di yi pa lala o ni gbahi ti pumpɔŋɔ n-niŋ ti zaɣ biɛɣu, ka zaŋ takɔbi ku ya ŋɔ nima.
en: Then David said to all of his officers who were still in Jerusalem with him, Come on, we cannot let him trap us here in Jerusalem. Hurry up, before he catches us. He will destroy us all, and Jerusalem will be destroyed in the battle.

dag: Di saha ka Yisifu daa yɛl o, Di gbinni m-bɔŋɔ: Tiwula ata maa nyɛla daba ata.
en: Joseph said: This is the meaning of your dream. The three branches stand for three days.

dag: Niriba anu maa ni daa lab Zɔra mini Ɛshitaol bɛ mabihi maa sani, bɛ daa bɔhi ba mi, Ka lahibal bɔ ka yi lee ʒina.
en: When the five men returned to Zorah and Eshtaol, the people asked them what they had found out.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi lir o ka tiligi? Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi niŋ lala dunia zaa ni?.
en: I owe nothing to anyone. Everything under heaven belongs to me.

dag: O daa nyɛla yuun pisinaanu nir saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa dila nam maa Jɛrusalɛm yuun pihitayinika. O ma daa nyɛla Zakaria bia, ka o yuli booni Abija.
en: He was years old when he became king, and he ruled twenty-nine years in Jerusalem. His mothers name was Abi; she was Zechariahs daughter.

dag: Ka yi sara maligu maa yi nyɛla bɛ ni duɣi bindir shɛli tahilaa puuni, di simdi ka di nyɛla zim viɛlli, ka kpam be di ni.
en: If you cook your bread in a pan with a lid on it, you must also use the finest flour mixed with oil.

dag: Yinim mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri bɛn zaa be nyɔŋ puuni, kamiyana ti gbahi di.
en: All you beasts of the field, come and eat, all you beasts of the forest!.

dag: Yi salima mini yi daanzinfa zahimya ka di zahimbu maa din ya shɛhira biɛɣu, ka ni di yi niŋgbuna kaman buɣim ni diri binyara shɛm la. Yi kahi azichi guli dabisa din bahindi nyaaŋa ŋɔ puuni.
en: Your gold and silver will rust, and that rust will be a proof that you were wrong. That rust will eat your bodies like fire. You saved your treasure in the last days.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ yɛli, N ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai Jɛrusalɛm mini Judanima, ka di chɛ ka ŋunkam wum di yɛla niŋgbuna sɔhigi.
en: So the Lord , the God of Israel, says, Look! I will bring so much trouble against Jerusalem and Judah that anyone who hears about it will be shocked.

dag: ka a naanyi kɔrig o Yawɛ tooni Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni.
en: Kill the bull near my altar in front of the tent.

dag: Chɛ ka n suhigu paag a sanna ka a tiligi ma kaman a ni pun lo ma alikauli shɛm.
en: Let my request for grace come before you; deliver me according to your promise!.

dag: Ka Musa mini Aduna ni Aduna bidibisi maa daa mal li paɣiri bɛ nuhi mini bɛ naba.
en: Moses, Aaron, and his sons used it to wash their hands and their feet.

dag: ni putɔɣu ni ninvuɣ kubo ni danyubo ni vuyɔbo yiriŋ ni din ŋmani dimbɔŋɔnima. N kpahiri yi zuɣu ni kaman n ni daa pun kpahi yi zuɣu ni shɛm la: Bɛn niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnima ti ku kpe Naawuni nam ni.
en: envious. They get drunk, carry on at wild parties, and do other evil things as well. I told you before, and I am telling you again: No one who does these things will share in the blessings of God's kingdom.

dag: Ninsal kam ŋun tumdi tuumbiɛri ni nya nahiŋgu mini wahala, Yɛhudianima n-daŋ tooni ka bɛn pa Yɛhudianim paya;.
en: He will give trouble and suffering to everyone who does evil—to the Jews first and also to those who are not Jews.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ Maika ni daa mali dari binnan shɛl la n-leei bɛ dini zali nimaani, ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu la mi daa kul ʒe Shilo di saha maa zaa.
en: Micah's idol remained there as long as the Tent where God was worshiped remained at Shiloh.

dag: Ka so yi mal o suhu n-yi din nyɛ daɣiri ni ka be kasi, dindina o ni leei la shɛli din mali jilima, ka mali shili ni di tum tuun suŋ kam, ka yil yidana ni woligi li n-zali di ko ni o zaŋ li tumd o tuma.
en: So if anyone washes filth off themselves, they will be set apart as a special bowl. They will be useful to the owner of the mansion for every sort of good work.

dag: Ti kpamba mini ti tiŋgbɔŋ maa nim zaa daa yɛlimi, Bomiya bindira niŋ yi nuu ni n-gbaai soli chaŋ ti nya ba yɛli ba, Ti nyɛla yi daba, ka chɛ m-bɔri ni ti mini ya lo tab alikauli.
en: Our leaders and all the people that live in our land told us to get some food ready for a trip and to go and meet you. We were told to put ourselves at your service and ask you to make a treaty with us.

dag: Gbibi bɛ ni wuh a shɛli viɛnyɛliŋga, ka miri ka a chɛ ka di faai. Guli yɛm, dama ŋuna n-nyɛ a nyɛvili.
en: Hold on to instruction; dont slack off; protect it, for it is your life.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ bindira leei tɔŋ gbahi ba; ka chɛ ka bɛ churi puhibu leei zana gbahi ba.
en: Let the table before them become a trap, their offerings a snare.

dag: Ka Asiria Naa Shalimanɛsa daa ti lo tɔbu kana ni o ti tuh o. Ka Hɔshia daa zaŋ omaŋ ti Asiria naa maa ka yɔr o farigu.
en: Emperor Shalmaneser of Assyria made war against him; Hoshea surrendered to Shalmaneser and paid him tribute every year.

dag: Ka yi ti niŋ dundɔŋ gili di zaa, ka zaŋ pateesa yili di dunɔdali.
en: Put up the surrounding enclosure and hang the curtain at its entrance.

dag: Ka kum ni mali ninvuɣ shɛb diri bɛ puri bindira, hal ka kpɛri gɔhi ni ti yihiri li; ka kɔnyuri ni mali ninvuɣ shɛb suhuri ye bɛ buni zuɣu.
en: Hungry people will eat the fool's crops— even the grain growing among thorns — and thirsty people will envy his wealth.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, N ni niŋ a ni yɛli ma ni n niŋ shɛm maa, dama m mi a, ka n nini tiɣ a.
en: Then the Lord said to Moses, I will do what you ask. I will do this because I am pleased with you and because I know you very well.

dag: Ka laɣ shɛli din daa nyɛ taali tumbu sanyoo liɣiri mini alahichi sanyoo liɣiri, bɛ daa bi zaŋ li tahi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa ni, dama din daa nyɛla maligumaaniba dini.
en: Now as for the money for compensation and purification offerings, it wasnt brought to the LORDs temple. It belonged to the priests.

dag: dama alɔbo ni tooi yi bɛ sanna n-libig a, ka ŋuni n-lee mi bɛ ni yɛn tahi saɣiŋgu shɛl na?.
en: such people could be ruined in a moment. Do you realize the disaster that God or the king can cause?.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl naa maa daa tim boli anabinim kɔbisinahi na nti bɔhi ba, Ti cham ti tuhi Ramɔtigiliadnim bee ti di chaŋ? Ka bɛ daa garigi yɛl o, Cham ti tuhi ba, Naawuni ni zaŋ ba niŋ nyin naa nuu ni.
en: So Ahab called a meeting of the prophets. There were about prophets at that time. Ahab asked the prophets, Should we go and attack Ramoth Gilead or not? The prophets answered Ahab, Yes, because God will let you defeat Ramoth Gilead.

dag: Nyamiya! N ni siɣisi ya m Ba Naawuni ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛl la na, dinzuɣu kul benya Jɛrusalɛm hal ti deei yiko shɛli din yɛn yi alizanda ni na maa.
en: And I myself will send upon you what my Father has promised. But you must wait in the city until the power from above comes down upon you.

dag: Yinim mi n-nyɛ n shɛhiranim dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ha ni.
en: You are witnesses of these things.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ paɣi Yawɛ o yurilim maŋli min o ni tumdi alahiziba tuun shɛŋa tiri daadamnim la zuɣu.
en: They must thank the Lord for his constant love, for the wonderful things he did for them.

dag: Yawɛ, a ni ti ti suhudoo; dama yɛlimaŋli, nyini n-chɛ ka ti niŋ ti ni niŋ shɛlikam zaa.
en: You will give us prosperity, Lord ; everything that we achieve is the result of what you do.

dag: O ni vuui suhugarigu sagban shɛli din sirigina ti pili zuliya kam zaa maa zoli ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Here the Lord will strip away the burial clothes that cover the nations.

dag: Amaa bɛ daa zaɣisi bɛ yaannim Naawuni ka jɛmdila Naawuni ni ku ninvuɣ shɛb tiŋgbani maa ni ka chɛ ka bɛ ʒini maa buɣa.
en: But they were unfaithful to the God of their ancestors and faithlessly followed the gods of the peoples of the land, whom God had destroyed before them.

dag: Miriya ka yi mini ba ti kpuɣiri taba, di zaŋya yi bipuɣinsi ti bɛ bidibisi bee n-kpuɣi bɛ bipuɣinsi ti yi bidibisi.
en: Dont marry any of them, and dont let your sons or daughters marry any of the people from those other nations.

dag: O sani, jaambɔna ŋmanila kaɣa. Bɛ yi to kpani ka o wum di damli, o lari li mi.
en: To him a club is a piece of straw, and he laughs when men throw spears.

dag: Bɛ ni ti deei Ɛdomnim tiŋgbɔŋ su. Siɛrinim dimnim ni ti deei bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ su.
en: Edom will become a possession, Seir a possession of its enemies. But Israel acts powerfully.

dag: Bɛ tɛha din ni chɛ ka bɛ baŋ nyɛla din be zibisim ni; ka bɛ nuu ka Naawuni ni ti nyɛvil shɛl la ni, dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn be ʒilinsi ni ka nyɛ suhutunanima.
en: and whose minds are in the dark. They have no part in the life that God gives, for they are completely ignorant and stubborn.

dag: Ka o ni daa niŋ shɛm maa chɛ ka Anabi Aizaia ni daa yɛl o yɛla shɛm la niŋ pali, Anabi Aizaia ni daa yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ, Omaŋmaŋ n-daa deei ti niŋgbun biisim mini ti dɔriti zaa ʒi.
en: So God's promise came true, just as the prophet Isaiah had said, He healed our diseases and made us well.

dag: Mɛrari bidibisi mini bɛ daŋ ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mahili mini Mushi. Bɛmbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ Lɛvinim zuliya kaman bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: Meraris sons by their clans: Mahli and Mushi. These were the clans of Levi by their households.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka a yurilim maŋli maa paai ma, ka tiligi ma kaman a daalikauli ni wuhi shɛm.
en: Show me how much you love me, Lord , and save me according to your promise.

dag: O ni yɛn wolig omaŋ dabisa shɛŋa maa zaa puuni, o miri ka o di wain tia binshɛlikam, hal o miri ka o di di biɛlim bee di paɣiri.
en: While a nazirite, the person may not eat anything produced from the grapevine, not even its seeds or skin.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Zara daa nya yaa niŋ pua, hal o ni daa yaɣi dɔɣibu saha shɛl la, dama o daa niŋ ŋun lo o alikauli maa naani.
en: Even when Sarah was too old to have children, she had faith that God would do what he had promised, and she had a son.

dag: Daadam Bia kamina ni o ti tiligi nyɛviya, ka pa ni o ti di nyɛviya. Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi taɣi tiŋkpan shɛli.
en: Then they all went on to another village.

dag: Ka Bɔaz yɛl o, Yawɛ niŋm alibarika niŋ a ni. Hal a ni niŋ nirilim shɛli pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ gar a ni pun niŋ a yidan ma nirilim shɛl la. A naan tooi chaŋ ti bo nachimbil so ŋun nyɛ bundana bee faralana, amaa a bi niŋ lala.
en: He said, May you be blessed by the LORD, my daughter! You have acted even more faithfully than you did at first. You havent gone after rich or poor young men.

dag: Dinzuɣu gbaamiya yimaŋa, ka tummiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zali ni yi tum shɛm maa, ka miriya ka yi birigi kpa yi nudirigu polo bee yi nuzaa polo.
en: Israel, you must carefully obey the Lord 's commands.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Dauda daa maag o paɣa Batishiiba suhu, ka o min o daa lan dɔni ka o dɔɣi bidibiga, ka o bol o yuli Sulemaana. Ka Yawɛ daa yur o pam.
en: Then David comforted Bathsheba his wife. He slept with her and had sexual relations with her. Bathsheba became pregnant again and had another son. David named the boy Solomon. The Lord loved Solomon.

dag: N nya mbusim, n ŋmanila ninvuɣ so kum ni mali ka o bi nya tiwalli bee wain tiwala dira. Dama bɛ pun pɔhi wain tiwala mini fiig tiwala zaa.
en: I am upset because I am like fruit that has been gathered, like grapes that have already been picked. There are no grapes left to eat. There are none of the early figs that I love.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla naa, O zaŋla jilima ye. Yawɛ yɛla kparibu, ka zaŋ kpiɔŋ leei shɛlɔrigu lo o shee ni. Ŋuna n-nam dunia ŋɔ zali, ka di kul ku vuui.
en: The Lord is King. The Lord wears majesty and strength like clothes. He is ready, so the whole world is safe. It will not be shaken.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Zuɣuŋmaŋ Shee la ka bɛ daa kpahi Yisa tabili dapulli zuɣu, ka daa kpahi tuumbiɛtumdiba ayi maa gba tabili dapula zuɣu n-zaŋ yino sa Yisa nudirigu polo, ka zaŋ ŋun la mi sa o nuzaa polo.
en: When the soldiers came to the place called The Skull, they nailed Jesus to a cross. They also nailed the two criminals to crosses, one on each side of Jesus.

dag: Ka yi yi puhirila yi zɔnim kɔŋko, tuun suŋ bɔ ka yi lee zaŋ gari yi taba? Pa lala ka zuliya kam gba niŋda?.
en: If you greet only your friends, what's so great about this? Don't even unbelievers do that?.

dag: Ka kapinta yɛli machɛle, A niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga. Ka ŋun kpɛri dari ka di niŋdi polipoli kpaŋsi ŋun kpahiri li tuɣiri taba ka yɛra, Di tuɣibu maa viɛla; ka bɛ zaŋ kpahikpahi li tuɣi taba, ka di ku tooi yihi.
en: Woodcarvers, goldsmiths, and other workers encourage one another and say, We've done a great job! Then they nail the idol down, so it won't fall over.

dag: Ka o daa lɔrigi malaikanim anahi shɛb bɛn daa pun mali shili gu di saha maa ni di dabisili maa ni di goli maa ni di yuuni maa ni bɛ ku daadamnim pirigibu ʒii buta puuni yim la.
en: These four angels had been kept ready for this hour and day and month and year. The angels were set free to kill a third of all the people on the earth.

dag: Yisa daa ti be Naawuni jɛmbu duu wuhiri niriba ka daa ti bɔhi ba, Wula ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba lee ni tooi yɛli ni Masia nyɛla Naa Dauda yaaŋa?.
en: As Jesus was teaching in the Temple, he asked the question, How can the teachers of the Law say that the Messiah will be the descendant of David?.

dag: ni Maasɛya so mi mini Shɛmaya ni Ɛliɛza ni Uzi ni Jɛhɔhanan ni Malikija ni Ɛlam ni Ɛzɛr. Ka Jɛzirahia daa gari tooni zaŋ yiliyiiniba ka bɛ yili yila.
en: Then these priests stood in their places in the Temple: Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malkijah, Elam, and Ezer. Then two singing groups began singing with Jezrahiah leading them.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa zaŋ omaŋ pa talima ni o tiligi ti ti tuumbiɛri zaa ni ka mali ti ka ti be kasi, ka zaŋ ti leeg omaŋmaŋ niriba bɛn suhuri ye tuun suma tumbu zuɣu.
en: He gave himself for us, to rescue us from all wickedness and to make us a pure people who belong to him alone and are eager to do good.

dag: A yi nya li tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ ni so sani, yin kum o, ka tinim bɛn kpalim zaa mi leei ti dan daba.
en: Whoever of your servants is found with it will be put to death, and well be my masters slaves.

dag: Amaa n ni zaŋ n daalikauli n-lola Yisahaku so Zara ni yɛn dɔɣi ti a yuuni na ŋ-ŋɔ tasaha la.
en: But I will make my agreement with Isaac, the son who Sarah will have. He will be born at this same time next year.

dag: Naawuni, ti kul tɛhir a yurilim maŋli la yɛla a jɛmbu duu la puuni.
en: God, in your Temple we remember your loving kindness.

dag: Naawuni ʒiinim maa puuni ka o daa zaŋ ma chaŋ nimaani nti tam zoli din du pam zuɣu, ka binshɛli daa ʒe zoli maa zuɣu nudirigu polo m-be kaman fɔntiŋ la.
en: In a vision, God carried me to the land of Israel. He put me down near a very high mountain. On the mountain in front of me was a building that looked like a city.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti yihi dɔriti balibu kam yi ni, ka Ijipti dɔr biɛ shɛŋa zaa din daa gbahiri ya la, o ku lan chɛ ka di gbahi ya. Amaa o ni chɛ ka di gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa jɛn ya.
en: The LORD will remove all sickness from you. As for all those dreadful Egyptian diseases you experienced, the Lord wont put them on you but will inflict them on all who hate you.

dag: Bɛ ni ti bɔhi baŋ Ziɔn soli, ka zaŋ bɛ zuɣuri kpa nimaani polo, ka bɛ mini Yawɛ ti laɣim lo alikauli din kul ni ʒiɛya sahakam ka ku yiɣisi, ka bɛ ku lan tam di yɛla.
en: You will ask the way to Zion and then come and join with me in making an agreement you won't break or forget.

dag: dama yi pun baŋ ti Duuma nirilim nyaɣisim ni nyɛ shɛm yɛla.
en: As the scripture says, You have found out for yourselves how kind the Lord is.

dag: Ka yi yi ti wɔbi yi olivi tiwala, yin di lan labi ti yihi din kpalim; di nyɛla sana mini kpibiga ni pakoli dini.
en: When you beat your olive trees, you must not go back to check the branches. The olives you leave will be for the foreigners, the orphans, and the widows.

dag: Ka Pita ŋun daa kpalim ʒe samban dunol ni. Ka maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa ni daa mi nyaandol so maa daa yi nti suhi soli yili maa ni bipuɣin so ŋun daa guli dunoli la sani n-zaŋ Pita kpe.
en: But Peter waited outside near the door. The follower who knew the high priest came back outside and spoke to the gatekeeper. Then he brought Peter inside.

dag: Dama sɔtim ku tooi gbaai Yaakubu zuliya, ka so mi ku tooi wa Izraɛlnim bukpahigu. Niriba ni ti tɔɣisi Yaakubu mini Izraɛlnim yɛla ka yɛli, Nyamiya Naawuni ni tum shɛm.
en: There is no power that can defeat the people of Jacob. There is no magic that can stop the Israelites. People will say this about Jacob and the Israelites: Look at the great things God did.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Zɛdɛkia daa yɛli Jɛrimia, Di chɛ ka so baŋ yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, di yi pa lala a ni kpi.
en: Then Zedekiah said to Jeremiah, Dont tell anyone that I have been talking to you. If you do, you might die.

dag: Di yi ni nani, yin chɛliya ka yi mini sokam ʒini ni suhudoo.
en: If possible, to the best of your ability, live at peace with all people.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan yɛli, So na ʒi n-nyo firila zaŋ lɔɣu pil li bee n-zaŋ li zali garo lɔŋni, amaa o ni zaŋ li mi tam binshɛli zuɣu ni bɛnkam kpɛri yili maa ni na nyari li.
en: No one lights a lamp and puts it under a bowl or under a bed. A lamp is always put on a lampstand, so people who come into a house will see the light.

dag: O yidan niŋ o naani o suhu ni, ka shɛli ku poog o yidana maa.
en: Her husband depends on her. He will never be poor.

dag: Ka Siria naa daa zal o chɛchɛbunsi sapashin kpamba zaligu n-yɛli ba, Di ti tuhiya dabirisi, yi mi di ti tuhiya wɔɣira, amaa ti kul tuhimiyala Izraɛl naa maa kɔŋko.
en: The king of Aram had chariot commanders. He gave them this command, Dont go after anyone except the king of Israel, no matter how important they are.

dag: Ka naa maa daa tim ti boli Haman na yomyom ni bɛ ti niŋ Ɛsta ni bɔri shɛm maa. Ka naa mini Haman daa chaŋ Ɛsta sani ni bɛ ti di ka nyu binnyura maa.
en: The king then ordered Haman to come quickly, so that they could be Esther's guests. So the king and Haman went to Esther's banquet.

dag: Ka bɔ n-daa lee niŋ ka a bi zaŋ n liɣiri maa ti sɔŋ banki ni? N ni di kuli ŋɔ na, n naan ku nya nyɔri pahi n laɣidaya maa zuɣu.
en: Well, then, why didn't you put my money in the bank? Then I would have received it back with interest when I returned.

dag: Dama mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni, dinzuɣu malimiya yimaŋa m-be kasi, dama n nyɛla ŋun be kasi. Miriya ka yi zaŋ biŋgbamda bɛn gbamdi tiŋgban ni ŋɔ saɣim yimaŋa.
en: because I am the Lord your God. I am holy, so you should keep yourselves holy. Dont make yourselves unclean with these crawling things.

dag: ka a naanyi kɔrig o Yawɛ tooni Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni.
en: Kill the bull there in my holy presence at the entrance of the Tent.

dag: Ka yi lan zaŋ di vulo maa yi Hɔr Zoli maa gbini hal ni Lɛbohamat samban ni, ka di tintariga naabu shee yɛn nyɛla Zɛdad.
en: After that, it will run to Lebo-Hamath and across to Zedad, which is the northern edge of your land.

dag: faashee n ni daa ti chaŋ Naawuni jɛmbu duu la, ka n naanyi baŋ bɛ bahigu ni yɛn nyɛ shɛm.
en: But then, God, I went to your Temple, and I understood what will happen to the wicked.

dag: Yawɛ chɛ ka na biɛri yiko zan tariga.
en: The Lord has ended the power of the evil rulers.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa buɣisi dunɔdali maa yɛliŋ, ka di nyɛ mita anu. Ka o daa buɣisi foliŋga din kpe dunɔdali maa ni, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita ayɔbu ni pirigili.
en: Next, the man measured the width of the passageway, and it was six and a half meters, but the two doors of the gate were only five meters wide.

dag: Yawɛ ku chɛ ka zaɣ biɛ shɛli niŋ a. O ni gul a nyɛvili.
en: The Lord will protect you from all danger; he will keep you safe.

dag: Di sabi yi zaligu ni ni niriba ayi shɛhiradibo n-nyɛ yɛlimaŋli.
en: Your Law requires two witnesses to prove that something is true.

dag: Yi ni daa sab gban shɛli ti ma zaŋ chaŋ yɛl shɛŋa la polo yɛla m-bɔŋɔ: Doo yi bi kpuɣ paɣa, di viɛla.
en: Now, about what you wrote: Its good for a man not to have sex with a woman.

dag: N daa suhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ n-kahigi ti daalahichi wuh o. N daa yɛlimi, Yaa n Duuma Naawuni, nyini n-nyɛ ŋun galisi ka mali jilima. A ʒe a daalikauli nyaaŋa, ka yuri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yur a ka dol a zaligunima.
en: As I prayed to the LORD my God, I made this confession: Please, my Lord—you are the great and awesome God, the one who keeps the covenant, and truly faithful to all who love him and keep his commands.

dag: O ni yɛn nyɛ Nazari nir dabisa shɛŋa ŋɔ zaa puuni, o miri ka o pini o zuɣu hal ka o ni wolig omaŋ ti Yawɛ saha shɛli maa ti gari. Di simdi ka o be kasi, ka chɛ ka o zabiri zooi wɔɣawɔɣa.
en: The whole time of their Nazirite vow they must not cut their hair. They must be holy until this time of special dedication to the Lord is ended. They must let their hair grow long.

dag: O ni ti fa yi tumtumdi dɔbba mini paɣiba, ka deei yi naɣ viɛla mini yi bun viɛla zaa ka bɛ tumd o tuma.
en: A king will take your men and women servants. He will take your best cattle and your donkeys. He will use them all for his own work.

dag: Yi mini Masia ni mali simdi la zuɣu, yi nya binshɛɣukam pam o zuɣu hal zaŋ tabili yɛtɔɣa mini baŋsim zaa.
en: For in union with Christ you have become rich in all things, including all speech and all knowledge.

dag: Ŋunkam maani fiig tia viɛnyɛliŋga ni di di wala; ka ŋunkam lihir o dana viɛnyɛla ni nya jilima.
en: People who take care of fig trees are allowed to eat the fruit. In the same way, people who take care of their masters will be rewarded.

dag: Ka Saimɔn min o tab la daa chani bɔr o shee.
en: Simon and those with him tracked him down.

dag: Ka so yi ti bi deei ya bee n-zaɣisi yi yɛligu wumbu, yi yi ti yɛn yi yili maa ni bee di tiŋ maa ni, yin pihimiya yi napɔna taŋkpaɣu bahi di zuɣu.
en: If anyone refuses to welcome you or listen to your words, shake the dust off your feet as you leave that house or city.

dag: Gɛrishɔn zuliya maa tuma zaa yɛn nyɛla Aduna min o bidibisi la ni zali shɛm zaŋ chaŋ bɛ ni yɛn ʒi shɛlikam mini bɛ ni yɛn niŋ shɛlikam polo; ka a wuhi ba bɛ ni yɛn su binshɛlikam zaa ʒibu fukumsi.
en: All the duties of the Gershonites for carrying their load and for their work will be at the command of Aaron and his sons. You will assign to them the responsibility to carry their load.

dag: Gbaya anahi daa bela dapaɣa maa lɔŋni; ka gbaya maa spindilinim mi mini binzahi maa nyɛ zaɣ mundili yini, ka gbaya maa zaɣ yini kam dubu nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: There were four wheels under the frame. The wheels were / cubits in diameter. The axles between the wheels were made as one piece with the cart.

dag: Paɣ yi nya sɔrilim din nyɛ o ni pun nyari shɛli sahakam, o ni be daɣiri ni hal ni daba ayopɔin, ka ŋunkam shih o ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: Whenever a woman has a discharge of blood that is her normal bodily discharge, she will be unclean due to her menstruation for seven days. Anyone who touches her will be unclean until evening.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli tia maa, Zuŋɔ din tariga, so ku lan di nyin wala hal abada. Ka o nyaandoliba daa wum o ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: So Jesus said to the tree, People will never eat fruit from you again. His followers heard him say this.

dag: Dum Abarim zoli din nyɛ Nɛbo zoli ka be Mɔabnim tiŋgbɔŋ ni zaŋ labi Jɛriko tooni polo la nti lihi Keenan tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni zaŋ ti Izraɛlnim ni bɛ su maa.
en: Hike up the Abarim mountains, to Mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab opposite Jericho. Take a good look at the land of Canaan, which Im giving to the Israelites as their property.

dag: Ka Naawuni nir daa ti ka Ɛli sanna ti yɛl o, Yawɛ yɛliya, Mani n-daa kahigi mmaŋ wuh a yab yiŋnim bɛ ni daa nyɛ Ijipti naa daba m-be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni saha shɛl la.
en: Now a man of God came to Eli and said, This is what the LORD says: I revealed myself very clearly to your fathers household when they were slaves in Egypt to the house of Pharaoh.

dag: Ʒe tibi a ni doli so shɛli ni, ka a soya zaa ni mali viɛla.
en: Make sure you are going the right way, and nothing will make you fall.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ daa yi Bɛtɛl chani ti miri Ɛfirat ka Reechɛl piligi wolisibu ka o wolisibu maa daa kpɛm pam.
en: Jacob and his family had left Bethel and were still a long way from Ephrath, when the time came for Rachel's baby to be born.

dag: ka tinzunnim vuri ŋmani tiŋgban kuŋ ni tulim la, a daa chɛ ka sagbana limsi li n-ku di tulim maa, ka putɔɣunim maa chɛ yila yilibu.
en: Like the heat of summer in a dry land, the angry shouts of those foreigners brought us to our knees. But like a thick cloud that blocks the summer heat, you answered their challenge.

dag: Pa ti yaannim kɔŋko ka Yawɛ daa lo alikauli ŋɔ, amaa tinim bɛn zaa na be ti nyɛviya ni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: The Lord did not make this agreement with our ancestors, but with us—yes, with all of us who are alive here today.

dag: Ka Naa Sool daa yɛli Samuɛl, N doli Yawɛ yɛligu maa, n chaŋ Yawɛ timsim maa, n gbaai Amalɛknim Naa Agag na ka ku Amalɛknim maa zaa.
en: But I did listen to the Lord ! Saul answered. He sent me on a mission, and I went. I captured King Agag and destroyed his nation.

dag: Ka di daa mali ti niŋ yuun shɛŋa, ka Ijipti naa maa daa kpi. Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa na kul be bɛ dabitim maa ni fabinda, ka kuhiri bɔri sɔŋsim. Ka bɛ dabitim ni kuhigu maa daa paai Naawuni.
en: A long time passed, and the Egyptian king died. The Israelites were still groaning because of their hard work. They cried out, and their cry to be rescued from the hard work rose up to God.

dag: Yawɛ, yɛtɔɣili ti yɛn yi n nol ni na, ka a pun mi li zaa.
en: Lord , you know what I want to say, even before the words leave my mouth.

dag: bɛn chɛ yɛlimaŋli soli bahi, ka yɛri ni kpiimba kum ni neebu la pun niŋ la. Lala ka bɛ niŋdi n-gbarigiri ninvuɣ shɛb yɛda.
en: who have deviated from the truth by claiming that the resurrection has already happened. This has undermined some peoples faith.

dag: Ka shɛb mi daa yɛli, Di kpa ti la talahi ni ti zaŋ ti puri mini ti wain tihi puri ni ti yiya m-pa talima din ni chɛ ka ti nya chi.
en: Others said, During the famine we even had to mortgage our fields, vineyards, and homes to them in order to buy grain.

dag: ni Ɛla bia Shimɛi ŋun daa be Bɛnjamin tiŋgban ni.
en: Shimei son of Ela was in charge of the territory of Benjamin.

dag: Nyin daadam, bom tandaɣili sɔŋ a tooni, ka ŋme Jɛrusalɛm kɔtomsi pa di zuɣu.
en: Ezekiel, son of man, find a brick and sketch a picture of Jerusalem on it.

dag: Ka ŋunkam shihi binyɛra maa ni be daɣiri ni, ka di simdi ni dilan paɣ o situra ka su kom, ka ni be daɣiri ni hal ni zaawuni.
en: If you touch either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee ni ʒiɛm tuma biɛla dabisili? Niriba yi ti nya tammɛri bimbuɣisirigu Zɛrubabɛl nuu ni, di ni niŋ ba suhupiɛlli. Firilanima ayopɔin la wuhirila Yawɛ nina din lihiri gindi dunia ŋɔ zaa la.
en: Those who despise a time of little things will rejoice when they see the plumb line in Zerubbabels hand. These are the seven eyes of the LORD, surveying the entire earth.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ ni ti ku bɛ nachimba zama laɣiŋgu shee, ka ku bɛ tɔbbihi zaa dindali maa. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Therefore, her soldiers will fall in the streets; all her warriors will be silenced on that day, declares the LORD.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna ka bɛ ni ti ŋum bahi ba na kaman teeku kom ni vuri shɛm la. Ka so yi ti lihi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, zibisim mini nandahima n-yɛn beni; ka sagbana zibigi fa neesim.
en: On the day they attack, they will roar like the ocean. And across the land you will see nothing but darkness and trouble, because the light of day will be covered by thick clouds.

dag: N nyaya ka daba bari yuri, ka chɛ ka nabihi chani tiŋa kaman daba la.
en: I have seen slaves on horseback while noblemen go on foot like slaves.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ teeku dulinim ŋɔ, fomiya ka wum n ni yɛn yɛli ya shɛm ŋɔ. Di simdi ni zuliya kam labi neei bɛ kpiɔŋ. Bɛ zaŋm bɛ yɛtɔɣa kana ti tɔɣisi. Chɛliya ka ti laɣim saria karibu shee.
en: The Lord says, Faraway countries, be quiet and listen to me! Nations be brave. Come to me and speak. We will meet together and decide who is right.

dag: Ka biŋkɔbigu maa daa nya yiko n-tɔɣisiri duhimaŋtali mini Naawuni mɔbu yɛtɔɣa, ka mali soli ni o wuh o fukumsi yiko tuma ni nyɛ shɛm chira pihinahinaayi.
en: The beast was allowed to boast and speak insults against God. It was allowed to use its power for months.

dag: daa tim ka bɛ chaŋ yiliguliba dundɔŋ ni ti zaŋ Jɛrimia na; ka bɛ daa zaŋ o niŋ Ahikam bia Gɛdalia ŋun daa nyɛ Shafan yaaŋa la nuu ni ni o zaŋ o kuli. Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu daa chɛ ka o be omaŋmaŋ niriba sani.
en: sent some of their troops to bring me from the courtyard of the royal palace guards. They put me in the care of Gedaliah son of Ahikam and told him to take me to my home. And so I was allowed to stay with the people who remained in Judah.

dag: Dama Naawuni lihi sokam zaa la yim.
en: For God judges everyone by the same standard.

dag: Di saha Yawɛ shia ni siɣi a zuɣu na pam, ka a pahi bɛ zuɣu n-tɔɣisir anabitali yɛtɔɣa ka a biɛhigu taɣi.
en: Suddenly the spirit of the Lord will take control of you, and you will join in their religious dancing and shouting and will become a different person.

dag: Wummiya vu shɛli din yɔri pampam tiŋ puuni ŋɔ, ka wumya vuri din yiri Naawuni jɛmbu duu na ŋɔ! Yawɛ n-darigir o dimnim tibili maa!.
en: Listen! There is a loud noise coming from the city and from the Temple. It is the Lord punishing his enemies. He is giving them the punishment they deserve.

dag: N dimnim maa kul duri tamdila n zuɣu dabisili kam puuni, dama bɛn tuhiri ma maa galisiya pam.
en: My enemies come at me constantly. There are too many fighters to count.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnima, Yi yi gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili ŋɔ du m-paai Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: the following instructions for Israel: When you cross the Jordan into the land of Canaan.

dag: Ka naa maa daa bol o na ti yɛl o, Nyin zaɣ yoli ŋɔ! A ni daa balim ma la, n daa bi ku a samli la zaa ti a?.
en: So he called the servant in. You worthless slave! he said. I forgave you the whole amount you owed me, just because you asked me to.

dag: Ka ŋunkam tibigir omaŋa ni nya filiŋ, ka ŋunkam mi siɣisiri omaŋa ni nya tibiginsim.
en: If you put yourself above others, you will be put down. But if you humble yourself, you will be honored.

dag: Timaŋmaŋ kom ka ti lan ŋmaligi dari nyura, ka lan ŋmaligi yɔri timaŋmaŋ dari zuɣu.
en: We have to buy the water that we drink. We have to pay for the wood that we use.

dag: Dindali maa zaŋ chana, ka bɛ daa to jina bɔri so shɛli bɛ yɛn doli ku o.
en: From that day on the Jewish authorities made plans to kill Jesus.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ba, M Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ ni bi sa ti shɛlikam ni vuɣi lu.
en: Jesus answered, Every plant that my Father in heaven has not planted will be pulled up by the roots.

dag: Ninvuɣ so ŋun nyu dam mili mi bi bɔri da palli, dama o yɛrimi ni da kurili ko n-nyaɣisi o sani.
en: No one wants new wine after drinking old wine. They say, The old wine is better.

dag: ka yi gba deei nyɛvili maŋli o sani, yi mini Masia ni laɣim nyɛ zaɣ yin la zuɣu. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun gari alizinnim bɛn nyɛ zuɣulaannim mini bɛn su fukumsi zaa.
en: And you are fully grown because you belong to Christ, who is over every power and authority.

dag: Dama lala ka ti Duuma daa zali ti kaman di ni sabi yɛli shɛm la: N zal a mi ni a leei bɛn pa Yɛhudianim firila, ka zaŋ tiliginsim yɛla ŋɔ gili dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam hal ti kpa di tarisi zaa. .
en: This is what the Lord told us to do: I have made you a light for the other nations, to show people all over the world the way to be saved. Isaiah :.

dag: Naawuni ni daa zali Jɔshua shɛm zuɣu daa chɛ ka o ŋmaai Juda zuliya la tiŋgbani yaɣ shɛli polo bɛ ni booni Hiburɔn la ti Jɛfune bia Kalɛb. Kiriatariba, di gbinni nyɛla Hiburɔn.
en: The Lord had commanded Joshua to give Caleb son of Jephunneh part of the land in Judah. So Joshua gave Caleb the land God had commanded. Joshua gave him the town of Kiriath Arba, that is, Hebron.

dag: Amaa so yi ti yihi yɛli ya, Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla bɛ ni zaŋ shɛli mali buɣa, yin di dinya li ŋun yɛli ya maa zuɣu mini suhu ni tɛha zuɣu;.
en: But if someone says to you, This meat was sacrificed in a temple, then dont eat it for the sake of the one who told you and for the sake of conscience.

dag: Ka bɛ daa bɔri ni bɛ gbaag o, amaa ka zɔri salo, dama sokam daa saɣiya ni Yisa nyɛla anabi.
en: so they tried to arrest him. But they were afraid of the crowds, who considered Jesus to be a prophet.

dag: Dinzuɣu baŋmiya viɛnyɛliŋga ni tɔbu ni din ya, ka kum kun ya, ka alɔbo din ya luɣ shɛli yi ni bɔri ni yi chaŋ ti ʒini maa.
en: So now be sure you understand this: You want to go live in Egypt. But these things will happen to you in Egypt: You will die by a sword, or hunger, or terrible sickness.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ti yi Punɔn maa n-chaŋ ti dɔni Obɔt.
en: They left Punon and camped at Oboth.

dag: N ni daa suh a dahin shɛli, a daa deei n suhigu, ka pahi ma kpiɔŋ.
en: When I asked for your help, you answered my prayer and gave me courage.

dag: Ka niŋgbuŋ din poori ŋɔ yi ti leei din bi poora, ka niŋgbuŋ din kpiri ŋɔ mi ti leei din bi kpira, di saha maa di ni ti niŋ kaman di ni sab shɛm la: Kum kɔŋ nasara!.
en: So when this takes place, and the mortal has been changed into the immortal, then the scripture will come true: Death is destroyed; victory is complete.

dag: Kul teemiya bɛn be sarika ni yɛla ka di be kaman yi mini ba ka bɛ laɣim kpɛhi sarika maa la. Teemiya bɛn diri wahala yɛla ka di be kaman yi mini ba n-laɣim diri wahala maa la.
en: Remember prisoners as if you were in prison with them, and people who are mistreated as if you were in their place.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira baptaizibu la, Naawuni n-daa lee zal li bee ninsalinima.
en: did John's right to baptize come from God or from human beings.

dag: A chɛ ka niriba du n-tam ti zuɣu; ti kpe buɣim mini kom ni gari yi, amaa a zaŋ ti tahi luɣ shɛli din galisi na.
en: You let our enemies trample us; we went through fire and flood, but now you have brought us to a place of safety.

dag: Ka o daa gbaai waɣ biɛ titali ŋun nyɛ kurimbuni ha waɣ so bɛ ni booni Fiɣisira ni Sintani la n-lo o ni o sɔŋ yuun tuhili.
en: He seized the dragon, that ancient serpent—that is, the Devil, or Satan—and chained him up for a thousand years.

dag: O daa chɛ ka bɛ kpaɣila Zɛdɛkia nina, ka ba o bandi. Ka Babilɔn naa maa daa zaŋ o kuli Babilɔn nti niŋ sarika ni hal ka o ti kpi.
en: Then he gouged out Zedekiahs eyes and bound him in chains. The king of Babylon dragged him off to Babylon and put him in prison, where he remained until he died.

dag: Ka ŋuni n-lee nyɛ Na so ŋun mali jilima maa? Yawɛ ŋun mali kpiɔŋ mini yaa maa. Yawɛ ŋun mali yaa tɔbu ni maa.
en: Who is this glorious king? The LORD—strong and powerful! The LORD—powerful in battle!.

dag: Ka paɣ maa daa bɔh o, Ŋuni ka a lee bɔri ni n chɛ ka o yina? Ka o yɛl o, M bɔri ni a chɛ ka Samuɛl n-yina.
en: The woman asked, Who do you want me to bring up for you? Saul answered, Bring up Samuel.

dag: A viɛlim zuɣu ni chɛ ka naa bɔr a. Ka o ni nyɛ a duuma la zuɣu, lum o sizuura.
en: so that the king will be pleased with your beauty. He will be your new husband, so you must honor him.

dag: Jɛhɔash ni daa tum shɛlikam pahi min o kpiɔŋ tuun shɛŋa zaa o ni daa zaŋ tuhi Juda Naa Amazia la, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: Everything else that Jehoash did, including his bravery in the war against King Amaziah of Judah, is recorded in The History of the Kings of Israel .

dag: Amaa yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, yi sɔŋbu zuɣu, di niŋ kamaata ni n lab ŋun tim ma na maa sani, dama n yi bi labi, Sɔŋda la ku ka yi sanna; amaa n yi labi, n ni tim o yi sanna.
en: But I am telling you the truth: it is better for you that I go away, because if I do not go, the Helper will not come to you. But if I do go away, then I will send him to you.

dag: Ifriimnim jilima ni ti yiɣi bɛ sani chaŋ kaman noombil la. Bɛ ti ku lan dɔɣi bihi, paɣipuulan ti ku lan beni, bɛ paɣiba ti ku lan zali puhi.
en: Ephraims glory will fly away like a bird— no birth, no pregnancy, no conception!.

dag: Nyin ŋun mali kpiɔŋ ŋɔ, bɔzuɣu ka a lee nyuri bara zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu ni? Naawuni nirilim niŋbu kul benimi sahakam. Dabisi muni puuni zaa.
en: Hey, powerful person! Why do you brag about evil? Gods faithful love lasts all day long.

dag: Di ʒiɛman maa ni Ahitɔfɛl daa yi kul yɛli yɛtɔɣ shɛli, di ŋmanila Naawuni maŋmaŋ yɛligu n-nyɛ li. Ka Dauda min o bia Absalom zaa daa yi bi zaŋd o yɛligu niŋd asahi.
en: Any advice that Ahithophel gave in those days was accepted as though it were the very word of God; both David and Absalom followed it.

dag: Amaa yi yi mali nyuli zabbu din yiri putɔɣu ni na mini diribarilim tɛha yi suhuri ni, yin miriya ka yi nyuri bara, ka leei bɛn chihiri din nyɛ yɛlimaŋli.
en: But if your heart is full of bitter jealousy and selfishness, don't brag or lie to cover up the truth.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka a tam ti yɛla zaa? Bɔzuɣu ka a chɛ ti bahi dabisi gbaliŋ ŋɔ zaa?.
en: Why have you abandoned us so long? Will you ever remember us again?.

dag: Tihi nyɔŋ mini tiŋgbani din mal atam, Yawɛ ni ti saɣim li, o ni ti saɣim niŋgbuŋ min o shia, ka di ni be kaman dɔr biɛɣu ni saɣindi ninsal niŋgbuŋ shɛm la.
en: and then spreads to burn up the tall trees and vineyards. Finally, everything will be destroyed—even the people. Assyria will be like a rotting log.

dag: Ŋuna n-gbaari yɛnnim bɛ yɛŋkiŋkabina ni, ka yɛŋkiŋkabinanim ni lo nia shɛŋa zaani tariga yomyom.
en: trapping the wise in their cleverness so that the plans of the devious dont succeed.

dag: Naawuni ni nam binshɛɣukam nyɛla din viɛla, ka di bi simdi ni ti siŋ li, tinim dee yi di li ni Naawuni paɣibu.
en: Everything that has been created by God is good, and nothing that is received with thanksgiving should be rejected.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o chɛ ka bɛ niŋ buɣim nyo naɣ muni maa zaa o ninni, dina n-nyɛ o gbaŋ min o nimdi ni o ʒim ni o puuni binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: The whole animal, including skin, meat, blood, and intestines, is to be burned in the presence of the priest.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini n-kpɛhi ma kɔre, ka kɔre maa gbaa ma. A mali yaa gari ma, ka nyaŋ ma. N leela bɛ ni lari so asiba hal ni yuŋ; sokam maani ma la ansarisi.
en: You tricked me, Lord , and I was really fooled. You are stronger than I am, and you have defeated me. People never stop sneering and insulting me.

dag: Ka o daa garigi yɛl o, Aai, m biɛli, di zaŋ kiŋkansi doli ma, dama tuuni ŋɔ na ʒi n-tum Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, di tum jɛrilim tuuni ŋɔ.
en: She answered, No! Please don't force me! This sort of thing isn't done in Israel. It's disgusting!.

dag: Nyin ŋun chɛ ka n nya wahala pam mini naŋgbantom ŋɔ ni lan yiɣisi ma zali yaha; a ni yihi ma tiŋgbani puuni na.
en: You have sent troubles and suffering on me, but you will restore my strength; you will keep me from the grave.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛl o, Mani ŋun tɔɣisir a yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ m-bala.
en: Then Jesus said, He is talking to you now—I am the Messiah.

dag: Amaa yi daalahichi n-leei kuɣituurili be yi mini yi Naawuni maa sunsuuni. Yi daalahichi maa zuɣu ka o lɛb o nyaaŋa biri ya, ka ku wum yi suhigu.
en: It is because of your sins that he doesn't hear you. It is your sins that separate you from God when you try to worship him.

dag: Di simdi ni ŋun deeri wuhibu zaŋdi bin suma balibu kam tiri ŋun wuhir o.
en: Those who are taught the word should share all good things with their teacher.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa zaŋ Yawɛ ni zali chu shɛŋa puhibu maa n-wuhi Izraɛlnima.
en: This is how Moses instructed the people of Israel to celebrate the Lord 's festivals.

dag: Bakibukia mini Unno n-daa nyɛ bɛ tab bɛn ʒe n-tuhi ba laɣiŋgu maa ni.
en: Bakbukiah and Unni were the relatives of those Levites. These two men stood across from them in the services.

dag: Dinzuɣu baŋmiya ni Yawɛ ni daa yɛli shɛlikam zaa zaŋ chaŋ Ɛhab min o daŋ zaa polo la shɛli ku yiɣisi. Yawɛ niŋmi kaman o ni daa chɛ ka o dabili Ilaija yɛli shɛm la.
en: Listen to me. Everything the Lord 's servant Elijah promised about Ahab's family will come true.

dag: Jɛzibɛl ni daa kul wum ni bɛ lab Nabɔt kuɣa ku o, ka o yɛli Ɛhab, Yiɣisim chaŋ ti deei Nabɔt ŋun nyɛ Jɛziriil nir la wain tihi pu shɛli o ni daa zaɣisi ni o ku zaŋ kɔh a zuɣu la su, dama Nabɔt lan ka o nyɛvil ni, o kpiya.
en: As soon as Jezebel heard that Naboth had been stoned to death, she said to Ahab, Get up and take ownership of the vineyard of Naboth, which he had refused to sell to you. Naboth is no longer alive; hes dead.

dag: Bɛ nahindila paɣ so ŋun bi dɔɣi bihi, ka bi niŋdi pakoli zaɣi viɛlli.
en: Sinners take advantage of widows and other helpless women.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ so ŋun yɛn shihi ba, ŋun zaŋmila kur bini mini kpan dɔɣu n-niŋ lala, ka buɣim di ba zaa nimaani.
en: No one can touch them, except with iron bar or the shaft of a spear. They must be burned up with fire right on the spot!.

dag: O yi di be dunia ŋɔ ni, o naan ku nyɛla maligumaana hal baabiɛla, maligumaaniba bɛn zaŋdi pina maani maligu kaman Yɛhudianim zaligu ni wuhi shɛm ni beni la zuɣu.
en: If our high priest were now living on earth, he would not be a priest. I say this because there are already priests here who follow the law by offering gifts to God.

dag: Di bi simdi ni bɛ miri ma na nti tum tuma kaman maligumaaniba la bee m-miri sara maligu kasi shɛli mini binshɛli din be kasi. Amaa di simdi ka bɛ di vi, ka di wahala shɛlikam bɛ ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa maa zuɣu.
en: So the Levites will not bring offerings to me like the priests. They will not come near any of my holy things or the things that are most holy. They must carry their shame because of the terrible things that they did.

dag: Wummiya n wuhibu, ka niŋ yɛm. Miriya ka yi zaɣisi li.
en: Listen to what you are taught. Be wise; do not neglect it.

dag: Di saha maa ka nyuli daa gbaai Yawɛ o tiŋgbɔŋ maa zuɣu, ka o zo o niriba maa nambɔɣu.
en: Then the Lord cared very much about his land. He felt sorry for his people.

dag: Ka Yawɛ malaika daa chaŋ Asirianim sansan ni dindali maa yuŋ nti ku bɛ tɔbbihi tuhi kɔbiga ni tuhi pihinii ni tusaanu. Ka niriba daa yiɣisi asibaasi n-nya ka kpiimba n-kul do luɣilikam zaa.
en: That night an angel of the Lord went to the Assyrian camp and killed , soldiers. At dawn the next day there they lay, all dead!.

dag: Naawuni Shia Kasi n-naɣ wuhiri ma tiŋ kam ni ni sarika kpɛbu mini wahala n-guli ma nimaani.
en: What I do know is that the Holy Spirit testifies to me from city to city that prisons and troubles await me.

dag: Nyamiya, m mali bipuɣins ayi bɛn na ʒi dɔbba, chɛliya ka n zaŋ ba tin ya na ka yi niŋ ba yi ni bɔri shɛm; ka di niŋ ya niriba ŋɔ shɛli, bɛ ni kpe n yili ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Look, I have two daughters who are still virgins. Let me bring them out to you, and you can do whatever you want with them. But don't do anything to these men; they are guests in my house, and I must protect them.

dag: Ka Firawuna min o kpamba ni Ijiptinim zaa daa yiɣisi yuŋ maa ka kuŋ mɔni Ijipti fɔŋ ni zaa, dama yili shɛli daa kani ka kum bi ku nimaani.
en: That night, the king, his officials, and all the other Egyptians were awakened. There was loud crying throughout Egypt, because there was not one home in which there was not a dead son.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka Ifriim zuliya niriba daa kana ti bɔhi Gidiɔn, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a daa yɛn chaŋ ti tuhi Midiannim ka bi bol ti? Bɔzuɣu ka a niŋ ti lala? Ka bɛ daa galim o pam di zuɣu.
en: Then the Ephraimites said to him, Why did you offend us this way by not calling us when you went to fight the Midianites? And they argued with him fiercely.

dag: Nyini n-zaŋ a yuri siɣi teeku ni, ka fuɣifuɣi pani di ko titali zuɣu.
en: Then your chariots churned the waters of the sea.

dag: Ka Jɛrɔbɔam daa zal omaŋmaŋ maligumaaniba buɣa jɛmbu shee ni bɛ jɛmd o ni daa mali bu so mini naɣisa so zali, ka di nyɛ o buɣili la.
en: Jeroboam appointed priests of his own to serve at the pagan places of worship and to worship demons and the idols he made in the form of bull-calves.

dag: Ka Jɛhoyakim daa ti kani ka o bia Jɛhoyachin di nam zan o zaani.
en: Jehoiakim lay down with his ancestors. His son Jehoiachin succeeded him as king.

dag: yin piimiya tin shɛŋa ka di nyɛ tiliginsim tinsi zali. Ka nir yi ku ninsal sarati kubu, o ni tooi zo n-kuli nimaani.
en: identify for yourselves cities to be refuge cities, where a person who kills someone by accident may flee.

dag: Zuliya kam ni niriba, kamiyana ti wum! Daadamnima, Wummiya! Dunia mini bɛnkam be di ni zaŋ tabili binshɛɣukam zaa, kamiyana ti wum!.
en: Everyone of every nation, the entire earth, and all its creatures, come here and listen!.

dag: Dama yi tam yi Naawuni ŋun tiligi ya, ka nyɛ ŋun ʒe n-taɣi ya kaman tampiŋ din mali kpiɔŋ la yɛla. Dinzuɣu ka yi sa tihi ni yi jɛmdi tinzun wuna.
en: This will happen because you have forgotten the God who saves you. You have not remembered that God is your place of safety. You brought some very good grapevines from faraway places. You might plant those grapevines, but they will not grow.

dag: Dinzuɣu benya tibi kaman yi Ba Naawuni ŋun be alizanda ni ŋɔ ni be tibi shɛm.
en: But you must always act like your Father in heaven.

dag: Ka timanim gba daa niŋ bɛ tabibi ni bɛ chɛ ka pɔri yina, ka wolim je. Ka pɔri maa daa kul dimdi ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri.
en: When the magicians tried to use their secret powers to do this, they failed, and gnats stayed on people and animals.

dag: Dindali maa n shiri ni ti ŋmaligi n nini lab kpaŋa ka chɛ ba, bɛ ni tum zaɣ biɛ shɛŋa zaa din nyɛ bɛ ni jɛmdi wuna la zuɣu.
en: They will pray to me, but I will ignore them because they were evil and started worshiping other gods.

dag: Ka yi yurilim tuuni maa tumbu zuɣu ni chɛ ka niriba paɣi Naawuni, dama di wuhiri yi ni deeri ŋun Naawuni noli shɛm Masia lahibal suŋ yɛda niŋbu ni mini yi ni tiri Yisa nyaandoliba zaŋ tabili sokam zaa pina la ni.
en: They will give honor to God for your obedience to your confession of Christs gospel. They will do this because this service provides evidence of your obedience, and because of your generosity in sharing with them and with everyone.

dag: Di saha maa ka teeku puuni daa yi palɔni, ka tiŋgbani tanzaa daa yi palɔni. Yawɛ, a tahigu min a suhuyiɣisili tuma m-bala.
en: The floor of the ocean was laid bare, and the foundations of the earth were uncovered, when you rebuked your enemies, Lord , and roared at them in anger.

dag: ka yɛli sariakaritiba maa, Gbibiya yimaŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi saria karibu ni, dama pa ninsalinim ka yi yɛn niŋdi li tira, amaa Yawɛ ka yi yɛn niŋdi li tira. O be yi sani yi saria karibu ni.
en: instructing them, Be careful when you pass judgment. You arent dispensing justice by merely human standards but for the LORD, who is with you.

dag: Bɛ naɣ zaŋdi li mi maani buɣim. Ka di zuɣu polo mini di nyoya polo yi di buɣim ka chɛ di sunsuuni ka di leei sala doya, di ni tooi lan ku buchi yaha?.
en: It can only be used as firewood. But after its ends are burnt and its middle is charred, it can't be used for anything.

dag: Yinim Izraɛlnim bɛn be kaman paɣipiɛliga ŋɔ, n ni lan mali ya zali, ka yi zani viɛnyɛliŋga. Yi ni lan zaŋ yi guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisa m-pahi bɛn mali suhupiɛlli zuɣu n-wari waa.
en: Once again I will rebuild you. Once again you will take up your tambourines and dance joyfully.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ zaligu shɛli Masia ni zali ti. Dina n-nyɛ: Ŋunkam yuri Naawuni, di simdi ni o yur o mabia gba.
en: The command that Christ has given us is this: whoever loves God must love others also.

dag: O daa niŋ lala la o ni daa zaŋ Naawuni yɛligu kaman kom paɣ li m-mal li ka di be kasi la puuni.
en: He died to make the church holy. He used the telling of the Good News to make the church clean by washing it with water.

dag: Yaa n Naawuni, teemi dimbɔŋɔnim yɛla, dama bɛ ta maligumaaniba tuma zaŋ tabil a ni daa lo maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim alikauli shɛl la daɣiri.
en: I pray that God will punish them for breaking their priestly vows and disgracing the Levi tribe.

dag: Ka din kpalim leei Aduna min o bidibisi dini, dama di nyɛla din be kasi bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ maa puuni.
en: The rest of this sacrifice is for the priests; it is very holy because it was offered to me.

dag: Ka o daa lab o sanna nti nya ka o mini Mɔab kpamba zaa ʒila o sara maligu shɛli bɛ ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim maa gbini.
en: So Balaam went back to Balak. Balak was still standing near the altar, and all the leaders of Moab were standing there with them.

dag: Zaligu lola paɣa tabil o yidana hal ni o nyɛvil tariga, amaa o yidan maa yi ti kpi, o nya yolisim din ni tooi kuli do so o suhu ni bɔra; di mi simdi ni o kul la ŋun doli ti Duuma.
en: A woman is obligated to stay in her marriage as long as her husband is alive. But if her husband dies, she is free to marry whomever she wants, only it should be a believer in the Lord.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ nyɛla ŋun zabiri nyuli ni ŋun bɔhiri biɛri. Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun bɔhiri biɛri ni suhuyiɣisili pam. Yawɛ bɔhir o dimnim biɛri, ka yiɣisir o suhu pam bahir o dimnim zuɣu.
en: The Lord is a jealous God. The Lord punishes the guilty, and he is very angry. The Lord punishes his enemies, and he stays angry with them.

dag: Ka o yidan Ɛlikana daa bɔh o Hanna, bɔ n-niŋ ka a mali suhugarigu, ka kumdi hal ti zaɣisi bindirigu? M bi gari bihi pia a sani.
en: Hannah, why are you crying? her husband Elkanah would say to her. Why wont you eat? Why are you so sad? Arent I worth more to you than ten sons.

dag: Ka Gidiɔn daa diɛhi duɣubihi mini kikahi Izraɛlnim shɛb bɛn kpalim la sani, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaa lab kuli ka chɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisita maa. Ka Midiannim daa zaŋ bɛ tantinim kpa n-do bɛ ni daa be zo shɛli zuɣu maa vinvamli ni.
en: So the people gathered their supplies and trumpets, and Gideon sent all the Israelites home, but kept the three hundred. Now Midians camp was below Gideon in the valley.

dag: Amaa di chaŋya Bɛrishiiba ni yi ti jɛm ma bee n-chaŋ Bɛtɛl ni yi ti nya ma, dama Bɛtɛl ni kpalim yoli. Yi mi di chaŋya Giligal, dama bɛ ni gbahi Giligalnim kuli tinduli ni.
en: But dont seek Bethel, dont enter into Gilgal, or cross over to Beer-sheba; for Gilgal will go into exile, and Bethel will come to nothing.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli Farisiinim mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdib maa, M bɔhiri ya mi, tuun dini n-lee simdi tumbu Vuhim Dabisili dali? Tuun viɛlli bee tuun biɛɣu? Din ni tiligi ninsal nyɛvili bee din ni di li.
en: Jesus said to the legal experts and Pharisees, Heres a question for you: Is it legal on the Sabbath to do good or to do evil, to save life or to destroy it.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda daa yɛli, Bolimiya maligumaana Zadok mini anabi Neetan ni Bɛnaaya Jɛhɔiada bia la ti ma. Ka bɛ daa ka naa sanna.
en: Then King David said, Tell Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah son of Jehoiada to come in here. So the three men came in to meet with the king.

dag: Ka ti lan mi ni Naawuni Bia daa kana nti ti ti la baŋsim ni di chɛ ka ti baŋ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni maŋli; ka ti nyɛla bɛn be Naawuni maŋli ni o Bia Yisa Masia puuni. Ŋuna n-nyɛ Naawuni maŋli, ka lan nyɛ nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: We know that Gods Son has come and has given us understanding to know the one who is true. We are in the one who is true by being in his Son, Jesus Christ. This is the true God and eternal life.

dag: Ka toli maa daa ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni na n-yɛrigi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni zaa. Ka bɛ galisim maa kpee daa na ʒi n-niŋ, ka di kpee mi ku lan niŋ.
en: The locusts flew into the country of Egypt and landed on the ground. There were more locusts than there had ever been in Egypt. And there will never again be that many locusts there.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zaa daa niŋmi ni ti Duuma ni daa chɛ ka anab so yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. O ni daa yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ.
en: So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet had said.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa nya ka o tam kom zuɣu chani maa, ka bɛ tɛhi ni alizini m-bala ka kuhi pam.
en: But the followers saw Jesus walking on the water. They thought he was a ghost, and they started screaming.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni nir maa daa tim ti yɛli Izraɛl naa, Miri ka a doli yaakaza polo, dama Sirianim yɛn chaŋ ti dɔni la nimaani.
en: The man of God sent word to Israels king: Beware of passing by this place because the Arameans are going down there.

dag: Malimiya yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl Yawɛ san la. Dina n-nyɛ: naɣilabihi pinaata mini piɛlah ayi ni yuun yini piɛlabihi pinaanahi bɛn ka dansi.
en: You will offer burnt offerings as sweet-smelling gifts to the Lord . You will offer bulls, rams, and lambs that are one year old. There must be nothing wrong with them.

dag: Kɔhigɔriba bɛn be niriba maa ni ni mal a ansarisi. A bahigu maa nyɛla din bie, ka a ku lan beni yaha.
en: You are gone, gone forever, and merchants all over the world are terrified, afraid that they will share your fate.

dag: Nakpahi pia puuni wain tihi wala ni ti yihi wain palila lita anii kɔŋko, ka kawaan bira din ni pali lita kɔbiga ni pihinii daatam ni ti palila lita pisaayika.
en: A ten-acre vineyard will make only a little wine, and many sacks of seed will grow only a little grain. .

dag: Hal o yi kari ma o tuma maa ni pumpɔŋɔ, m mi n ni yɛn niŋ shɛm ka m mini niriba be.
en: I know what I'll do, so that people will welcome me into their homes after I've lost my job.

dag: N ni zaŋ mmaŋ pa talima o zuɣu, ka a ti bɔh o yɛla n sani. N yi ti bi ʒi o labina ti ti a, nyin chɛ ka di taali kul ʒi n zuɣu sahakam.
en: I will pledge my own life, and you can hold me responsible for him. If I do not bring him back to you safe and sound, I will always bear the blame.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛɣu ni di wahala pam, amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ Yawɛ naani, o yurilim maŋli ni be bɛ sani.
en: The pain of the wicked is severe, but faithful love surrounds the one who trusts the LORD.

dag: Daliri din chɛ ka Jɔshua daa chɛ ka bɛ guni ba maa nyɛla: Izraɛl dɔbba bɛn zaa daa yi Ijipti na la puuni bɛn zaa daa nyɛ tɔbutuhiriba daa kpila sol ni yɔɣu maa ni, bɛ ni daa yi Ijipti maa na nyaaŋa.
en: This is the reason Joshua did so: All the people who went out of Egypt, that is, all the men who were soldiers, had died in the desert on the way after they left Egypt.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛli Samuɛl, Wummi bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka bo naa ti ba. Di saha ka Samuɛl daa yɛli Izraɛlnim maa, Sokam labimi kul o ya.
en: The Lord answered, Listen to them and give them a king. Then Samuel told the Israelites, You will have a king. Now go home.

dag: Yi mini yi tɔbbihi ni yi niriba pam bɛn be yi sani ni ti kana kaman sanʒiɛɣu, ka be kaman sagbani din limsi tiŋgban la.
en: He and his army and the many nations with him will attack like a storm and cover the land like a cloud.

dag: Bundana bee nandana bee nabia bee tarima ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-nyɛ ŋun ni tooi niŋ shɛli sɔŋ Ijiptinima.
en: There is nothing the leaders can do.

dag: Ka o mi buɣisi yɛli ba ni bɛ tim o gbaŋ; ka bɛ daa ti o gbaŋ maa ka o sab yɛli, Bia maa yuli Jɔn. Ka di daa gari sokam pam.
en: After asking for a tablet, he surprised everyone by writing, His name is John.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli Jɔab min o sapashin kpamba bɛn daa be o sani la, Chamiya gili Izraɛl zuliyanim zaa ni, zaŋ Dan hal ti kpa Bɛrishiiba n-kali niriba maa ka m-baŋ bɛ kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: So David gave orders to Joab, the commander of his army: Go with your officers through all the tribes of Israel from one end of the country to the other, and count the people. I want to know how many there are.

dag: Alizanda ni niŋgbuŋ beni, ka dunia ŋɔ ni niŋgbuŋ gba beni; amaa alizanda ni niŋgbuŋ viɛlim bela di ko, ka dunia ŋɔ ni niŋgbuŋ gba viɛlim be di ko.
en: Also there are heavenly bodies and earthly bodies. But the beauty of the heavenly bodies is one kind, and the beauty of the earthly bodies is another.

dag: Ka bɛn daa wurim maa daa chani gindi luɣilikam n-yihiri Yisa lahibal suŋ waazu.
en: The believers who were scattered went everywhere, preaching the message.

dag: Kom be kulibɔŋ maa ni ka a ni nyura, ka n zali kahiŋkɔri ni bɛ tahiri bindirigu na ti tir a.
en: You can get your water from that stream, and I have commanded ravens to bring food to you there.

dag: Di simdi ka yi niŋ biŋgolinsi pihinu niŋ pateesa tuuli la naŋgbambili, ka lan niŋ biŋgolinsi pihinu niŋ pateesa shɛli din pah ayi la gba naŋgbambili, ka di zaa doya tuhi taba.
en: Put fifty loops on the first piece of the first set and fifty loops matching them on the last piece of the second set.

dag: Yi mabihi bɛn be Babilɔn ka nyɛ Naawuni ni pii shɛb kaman yinim la puhiri ya; ka m bia Maak gba puhiri ya.
en: Your sister church in Babylon, also chosen by God, sends you greetings, and so does my son Mark.

dag: Amaa ka Zarai daa lee nyɛ paɣiŋoo; o daa ka bia.
en: Sarai did not have any children because she was not able to have children.

dag: Ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka bɛ wuhi ni o nyɛla wuntizɔra ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: Now he will always be highly honored.

dag: Niriba Zuɣulaannim n-daa nyɛ: Parɔsh mini Pahatimɔab ni Ɛlam ni Zatu ni Bani so mi ni.
en: And these are the names of the leaders who put their names on the sealed agreement: Parosh, Pahath-Moab, Elam, Zattu, Bani.

dag: Yisa ni daa yiɣisi ni n-chaŋ naai ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdib mini Farisiinim daa kul gbaag o nol ni luɣisibu ni di chɛ ka o yɛli din bie.
en: As he left there, the legal experts and Pharisees began to resent him deeply and to ask him pointed questions about many things.

dag: Bɛraya mini Shɛma.
en: Beriah and Shema were family leaders in the clan that lived in the town of Aijalon and that forced out the people of Gath.

dag: Di saha ka Yisa daa kuhi pam ka naanyi bahi.
en: With a loud cry Jesus died.

dag: Nyin ŋun chɛ ka n nya wahala pam mini naŋgbantom ŋɔ ni lan yiɣisi ma zali yaha; a ni yihi ma tiŋgbani puuni na.
en: You made me suffer a lot, but you will bring me back from this deep pit and give me new life.

dag: O tiri paɣiŋoo bihi, ka zaŋd o leeri bihi ma ŋun mali suhupiɛlli. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: When a wife has no children, he blesses her with some, and she is happy. Shout praises to the Lord !.

dag: O daa lan zali Obɛdɛdom min o mabihi ninvuɣ pisopɔinayika la gba; ka Obɛdɛdom ŋun daa nyɛ Jɛdutun bia la mini Hɔsa mi daa nyɛ dunɔguliba.
en: Obed-edom, Jeduthuns son, and Hosah served as gatekeepers.

dag: N ni zaŋ o kpa luɣ viɛlli shee viɛnyɛliŋga kaman kpaa la, ka o leeg o daŋ niriba jilima nam ʒiishee.
en: He will be like a favorite chair in his fathers house. I will make him like a strong peg in a solid board.

dag: Ka a zaŋ yɛtɔɣa maa ti o, n ni ti be a min o zaa noya ni, ka wuhi ya yi ni yɛn niŋ shɛm.
en: You can speak to him and tell him what to say. I will help both of you to speak, and I will tell you both what to do.

dag: Di saha ka Maika daa yɛli, Pumpɔŋɔ m baŋya ni Yawɛ ni chɛ ka n tɔŋ, n ni zaŋ Lɛvi zuliya nira leei m maligumaana ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: And Micah said, Now I know that the Lord will be good to me. I know this because I have a man from the tribe of Levi to be my priest.

dag: Ka bɛ ʒiʒiinitab zaa daa sɔŋ ba n-ti ba anzinfa nɛma mini salima ni nɛma ni biŋkɔbiri ni binshɛŋa din mali bukaata m-pahi niriba suhu ni daa yu ka bɛ ti binshɛlikam zaa.
en: All their neighbors assisted them with silver equipment, with gold, with goods, livestock, and valuable gifts, in addition to all that was freely offered.

dag: Bɛ ni ti kun ya tɔbu ni, ka gbahi yi ni shɛba ti leei daba. Amaa di zaa yoli, Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili maa na ku zan tariga. O daa loya ni o darigi bɛ tibili.
en: You will be killed in battle or dragged off as prisoners. Yet even so the Lord 's anger will not be ended; his hand will still be stretched out to punish.

dag: A suhuyiɣisili ŋme ma mi gari, ka a ni lu n zuɣu ka di mali dabiɛm shɛm bahi jahi ma.
en: Your anger covers me like a flood. Your attacks are killing me.

dag: Yisa daa lan bɔhi ba, Wula ka nir ni tooi kpe kpiɔŋlan yiŋa nti fa n nɛma ka pa ni o daŋ o la mii lɔbu pɔi? Di nyaaŋa ka o ni tooi fa o nɛma maa.
en: No one can break into a strong man's house and take away his belongings unless he first ties up the strong man; then he can plunder his house.

dag: Bundana bee nandana bee nabia bee tarima ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni n-nyɛ ŋun ni tooi niŋ shɛli sɔŋ Ijiptinima.
en: No one in Egypt can do a thing, no matter who they are.

dag: Ka Dɛbɔra daa yɛli Barak, Yiɣisima! Yawɛ m-be a tooni mal a chana. Zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, Yawɛ zaŋ Sisɛra niŋ a nuu ni. Di saha ka Barak daa yiɣisi ka tɔbbihi tuhi pia dol o ka bɛ yi Tabo Zoli zuɣu siɣi.
en: Deborah shouted, Barak, it's time to attack Sisera! Because today the Lord is going to help you defeat him. In fact, the Lord has already gone on ahead to fight for you. Barak led his , troops down from Mount Tabor.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn paɣir a dabisi muni puuni zaa; ka nyɛ bɛn tibigir a wuntitali.
en: They rejoice in your name all day long and are uplifted by your righteousness.

dag: Ka yi yi deei so chinchini sɔŋ pɔi ka naanyi zaŋ o ni bɔr shɛli paŋ o, yin labisim li ti o pɔi ka wuntaŋ naanyi lu.
en: If you take someone's cloak as a pledge that he will pay you, you must give it back to him before the sun sets.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla n daa po pɔri yɛli ba tiŋgban nɛli maa ni ni n ku lan zaŋ ba tahi n ni daa zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali bihim mini shiri pam, ka lan nyɛ tiŋgbɔn shɛli din mali jilima gari tiŋgbɔna zaa la ni.
en: Instead, I told them in the desert that I would not lead them into the beautiful, fertile land I had promised.

dag: Di bi simdi ka Izraɛl bipuɣinsi ni so ti niŋ jɛmbu duu pagɔrili bee ka bidibisi ni so ti niŋ jɛmbu duu dagɔrili.
en: An Israelite man or woman must never become a temple prostitute.

dag: Nandaamba bɛn dabisa zaa nyɛla wahala dabisa, amaa bɛn suhuri piɛla kul puhirila chuɣu sahakam.
en: Life is always hard for the poor, but the right attitude can turn it into a party.

dag: O daa ku Amɔri Naa Sihɔn mini Bashan Naa Ogi ni Keenan nanim zaa.
en: Sihon, king of the Amorites, Og, king of Bashan, and all the kings in Canaan.

dag: ka labina ti yɛli Jɔshua, Ainim bi yaɣ lala. Lala zuɣu di chɛ ka tɔbbihi maa zaa chaŋ, amaa chɛ ka tɔbbihi tusaayi bee tusaata laasabu chaŋ.
en: They went back to Joshua and reported, You don't need to send the whole army to attack Ai—, or , troops will be enough. Why bother the whole army for a town that small.

dag: Ijiptinima, o daa wuhi shihira, ka tum alahiziba tuma yi sunsuuni n-darigi Firawuna min o niriba zaa tibili.
en: He did great wonders and miracles in Egypt. He used them against Pharaoh and his officials.

dag: Ka n daa nya ka o saɣim pam. Bɛ niriba ayi maa zaa daa dolila so yini.
en: I saw that she too defiled herself. Both had the same tendencies.

dag: Yawɛ, di zaŋ a niriba Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ a ni tiligi shɛb ŋɔ taali; ka di chɛ ka ŋun ka taali ŋɔ ʒim yihibu taali be a niriba Izraɛlnim sunsuuni. Di saha ka bɛ ni yi ʒim yihibu taali ni.
en: Lord , forgive your people Israel, whom you rescued from Egypt. Forgive us and do not hold us responsible for the murder of an innocent person.

dag: Mɔɣa kom zɔri ti lurila teeku ni, amaa ka di bi paana. Kɔzɔrima maa ni zɔri yiri luɣ shɛŋa na, nimaani ka di na kul zɔri yirina.
en: All rivers flow again and again to the same place. They all flow to the sea, but the sea never becomes full.

dag: Yinim Izraɛlnim bɛn be kaman paɣipiɛliga ŋɔ, n ni lan mali ya zali, ka yi zani viɛnyɛliŋga. Yi ni lan zaŋ yi guŋgombihi din mali chaɣisa m-pahi bɛn mali suhupiɛlli zuɣu n-wari waa.
en: Again, I will build you up, and you will be rebuilt, virgin Israel. Again, you will play your tambourines and dance with joy.

dag: Ka Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat daa lab kul o ya Jɛrusalɛm ni alaafee.
en: King Jehoshaphat of Judah returned safely to his palace in Jerusalem.

dag: Pa yinima m-pii ma, amaa mani m-pii ya, ka zali ya ni yi chaŋ ti pum puma n-wali ka yi wala maa ku kpihim; ka yi yi ti zaŋ n yuli suhi binshɛɣukam m Ba sani, o ni tin ya li.
en: You did not choose me; I chose you and appointed you to go and bear much fruit, the kind of fruit that endures. And so the Father will give you whatever you ask of him in my name.

dag: Yinim gba maliya suɣilo lala; ka kul maliya suhukpeeni, dama ti Duuma labbuna miriya.
en: You must be patient too. Never stop hoping. The Lord is coming soon.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ dapuhi maa tu bansi din be adaka maa luɣa ni la ni n-kpuɣiri li.
en: Then put the poles into the rings on the chests sides and use them to carry the chest.

dag: Ka o yɛl o, N Duuma, n niŋ yɛda! Ka dii gbaag o jɛmbu.
en: The man answered, Yes, I believe, Lord! Then he bowed and worshiped Jesus.

dag: ka bantabiga din daa vili Yisa zuɣu la gba kpabikpabi do di ko ha ka chɛ bimpiɛlli maa.
en: and the cloth which had been around Jesus' head. It was not lying with the linen cloths but was rolled up by itself.

dag: Ŋunkam ku nira mini ŋunkam shihi kpima, benya sambani ŋɔ ni daba ayopɔin. Yi mini yi ni gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb na maa zaa malimiya yimaŋa n-niŋ kasi daba ata dali mini daba ayopɔin dali.
en: You will remain outside the camp for seven days. Everyone among you or your captives who has killed a person or touched a corpse must purify themselves on the third and seventh days.

dag: Nandaamba bɛn dabisa zaa nyɛla wahala dabisa, amaa bɛn suhuri piɛla kul puhirila chuɣu sahakam.
en: The poor have a hard life, but being content is as good as an endless feast.

dag: Ti yi di chɛ nyin ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu ka ŋmaligi jɛmdila buɣa.
en: We did not forget you or lift our hands in prayer to foreign gods.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Zaligu dini ka Anabi Musa daa lee zali ya.
en: Jesus asked them, What does the Law of Moses say about this.

dag: Di saha zuɣusaa mini dunia ni binshɛŋa din be di ni ni ti yo vuri, ka mali suhupiɛlli Babilɔn zuɣu, dama bɛn ti yɛn wurim li maa ni ti yila nuzaa polo na. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Then heaven and earth and all that is in them will shout with joy about Babylon. They will shout because an army came from the north and fought against Babylon. This is what the Lord said.

dag: Ka Iso daa yɛl o, Malim shili ka m min a doli kuli.
en: Esau said, Let's get ready and leave. I will go ahead of you.

dag: Dauda ni daa wum di yɛla, o daa chɛ ka Jɔab zaŋla tɔbutuhiri biinsi zaa chaŋ.
en: When David heard what was happening, he sent out Joab and the whole army.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli, N dabili Aizaia ni daa chaŋ o zaɣim ni napɔn zaŋa yuma ata la, di nyɛla din yɛn niŋ Ijiptinim mini Itiɔpianim shihirili.
en: Then the Lord said, My servant Isaiah has gone without clothes or sandals for three years. This is a sign for Egypt and Ethiopia.

dag: Ka kpambaliba bɛn daa be o yiŋa kana ti zan o sani ni bɛ kpuɣ o yiɣisi, amaa ka o bi saɣi bee n-chɛ ka o mini ba laɣim ʒini di bindirigu.
en: The leaders of Davids family came and tried to pull David up from the ground, but he refused to get up. He refused to eat with these leaders.

dag: Ka o yɛli paɣ maa, yiɣisim ka ti chaŋ. Amaa ka o bi garigi. Ka o daa kpuɣi paɣ maa pa o buŋ zuɣu n-zaŋ o kul o ya.
en: He said, Get up. Let's go. But there was no answer. So he put her body across the donkey and started on his way home.

dag: Ka Sool daa tuhi nyaŋ Amalɛknim maa, Havila zaŋ hal ti kpa Shur tin shɛli din be Ijipti wulimpuhili polo la.
en: Saul defeated the Amalekites, fighting all the way from Havilah to Shur, east of Egypt;.

dag: Dunianim yi jɛn ya, yin baŋmiya ni mani ka bɛ pun daŋ zaɣisi ka naanyi ti jɛn ya maa.
en: If the people of this world hate you, just remember that they hated me first.

dag: dama n niŋ li mi ni yi nya ka mi niŋdi taba kaman n ni niŋ ya shɛm maa.
en: I have set an example for you, so that you will do just what I have done for you.

dag: Ti ni daa paai Rom ka bɛ chɛ ka Pool bo o dahalali duu beni, ka bɛ daa bo tɔbbi so nti zali nimaani ka o gul o.
en: We arrived in Rome, and Paul was allowed to live in a house by himself with a soldier to guard him.

dag: M bɔhim din be a zaligunim puuni ka di wɔɣa, ni a zal li mi ni di kul be sahakam.
en: From studying your laws, I found out long ago you made them to last forever.

dag: N ni saɣim Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga ŋun viɛlim ŋmani momaha la.
en: You are like a lovely pasture, Daughter Zion.

dag: Ŋuna n-lan nyɛ ŋun maari ti suhuri ti wahala dibu puuni ni di chɛ ka ti gba tooi zaŋ suhumaabo shɛli ŋun Naawuni ni mali maari ti suhuri maa m-maari bɛn zaa nyari wahala balibu kam suhuri.
en: Hes the one who comforts us in all our trouble so that we can comfort other people who are in every kind of trouble. We offer the same comfort that we ourselves received from God.

dag: Di saha ka Naa Sulemaana daa tim ka bɛ chaŋ ti siɣis o bimbini maa zuɣu na. Ka o daa kana nti damdi lu Naa Sulemaana sizuura. Ka Sulemaana daa yɛl o, Kulim a yiŋa.
en: King Solomon sent word and had him brought down from the altar. He came and bowed down to King Solomon. Solomon said to him, Go home.

dag: ka di gari Farisii maa, o ni daa nya ka Yisa bi doli bɛ kali soli paɣ o nuhi ka ʒini ni o di maa zuɣu.
en: The Pharisee was surprised that he did not wash his hands before eating.

dag: Di saha ka sokam daa ŋmah o dabɔbili n-zaŋ li doli Abimilɛk ti sɔŋ baɣili bɛ sɔɣisili shee maa n-niŋ buɣim nyo li pa bɛ zuɣu, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be di ni kpi. Bɛ kalinli daa nyɛla kaman dɔbba mini paɣiba tuhili.
en: So everyone cut off a tree limb; then they followed Abimelech and piled the wood up against the stronghold. They set it on fire, with the people inside, and all the people of the fort died—about a thousand men and women.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa ka Musa sanna ti yɛl o, Ti tum alahichi, dama ti yɛl a mini Yawɛ finafina; suhim Yawɛ ti ti ka o vuui tinvura maa ka chɛ ti. Ka Musa daa suhi Naawuni ti niriba maa.
en: The people came to Moses and said, We know that we sinned when we spoke against the Lord and against you. Pray to the Lord . Ask him to take away these snakes. So Moses prayed for them.

dag: O daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani. Amaa o daa lee bi tummi kaman o ba min o ma ni daa tum shɛm la; dama o daa wurim o ba ni daa me Baal binwɔɣinli shɛli zal la.
en: and disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong. He tore down the stone image his father had made to honor Baal, and so he wasn't as sinful as his parents.

dag: Ninive ŋmanila biaŋ din kom zo n-yi ka chɛ li. Ka bɛ kuhiri yɛra, Zanimiya! Zanimiya! Amaa ka so bi ŋmaligi labina.
en: Nineveh is like a pool whose water is draining away. People yell, Stop! Stop running away! But it does not do any good.

dag: Nandaamba mini faranima ni ti lan nya suhupiɛl shɛli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ ni tiri la.
en: The poor will again find joy in the LORD, and the neediest of people will rejoice in the holy one of Israel.

dag: Zaŋmiya bula yino mali alahichi sara pahi yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim sahakam la mini di chi sara ni di binnyura sara la zuɣu.
en: Also offer one male goat as a sin offering. Offer these in addition to the daily burnt offering with its grain offering and wine offering.

dag: Dina n-daa chɛ ka bɛ bi tooi niŋ yɛda; dama Anabi Aizaia daa lan yɛli ni Naawuni yɛliya:.
en: This is why the people could not believe. Because Isaiah also said.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna:.
en: The Lord told Moses and Aaron:.

dag: Ka dindina wula ka ti lee ni yɛli? Ti ni yɛli ni bɛn pa Yɛhudianima ka nyɛ bɛn daa bi lihiri bɔri wuntitali Naawuni san la nya li bɛ yɛda niŋbu zuɣu.
en: What does all of this mean? It means that the Gentiles were not trying to be acceptable to God, but they found that he would accept them if they had faith.

dag: Ka tɔbbihi maa daa be Dauda sani daba ata n-diri ka nyura, dama bɛ mabihi daa pun malila binshɛɣukam shili zali ba.
