en: They spent three days there with David, feasting on the food and drink which their relatives had prepared for them.

dag: Yawɛ, yiɣisima n-lu bɛ zuɣu nyaŋ ba. Zaŋm a takɔbi n-fa n nyɛvili ninvuɣ biɛri nuu ni bahi.
en: Lord , get up and face the enemy. Make them surrender. Use your sword and save me from these wicked people.

dag: ka ŋun maligumaana maa ti zaŋ o nubil tim ʒim maa ni n-zaŋ li mihi Yawɛ tooni buyopɔin tantolinli din yili luɣ kasi shee la tooni.
en: He must put his finger in the blood and sprinkle the blood seven times before the Lord in front of the curtain of the Most Holy Place.

dag: Amɔz bia Aizaia ni daa nya ʒii shɛŋa zaŋ chaŋ Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnim polo shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Uzia mini Jɔtam ni Ahaz ni Hɛzɛkia bɛn daa nyɛ Juda nanim la ʒiɛman ni n-daa bala.
en: This book contains the messages about Judah and Jerusalem which God revealed to Isaiah son of Amoz during the time when Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were kings of Judah.

dag: Ka Filip yɛl o, Hal tumtumda chira anii yɔri ku tooi da bindirigu ka niriba ŋɔ zaa paai biɛlabiɛla gba di.
en: Philip answered, We would all have to work a month to buy enough bread for each person here to have only a little piece.

dag: O yuma daa nyɛla yuun pisinaanu saha shɛl o ni daa di nam maa. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuun pinaayɔbu Jɛrusalɛm. O ma daa nyɛla Zadok bia, ka o yuli booni Jɛrusha.
en: Jotham was years old when he became king. He ruled years in Jerusalem. His mother was named Jerusha, the daughter of Zadok.

dag: Yisa daa lan yɛli yaha, N ku tooi niŋ shɛli mmaŋmaŋ yiko ni; n ni wum shɛm, dina ka m mali kariti saria, ka n sariakaribo maa mi nyɛla din tuhi, dama m bi bɔri mmaŋmaŋ yubu, amaa ŋun tim ma na maa yubu ka m bɔra.
en: I can do nothing on my own authority; I judge only as God tells me, so my judgment is right, because I am not trying to do what I want, but only what he who sent me wants.

dag: Naawuni lo alikauli o luɣ kasi shee yɛli, N kpiɔŋ zuɣu, n ni pirigi Shɛkɛm; ka zaŋ Sukɔt Vinvamli tari.
en: God has spoken in his sanctuary: I will celebrate as I divide up Shechem and portion out the Succoth Valley.

dag: Jona ni daa be ziŋ karili maa puuni saha shɛli maa, ka o daa suhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni maa yɛli.
en: From inside the fish, Jonah prayed to the Lord his God:.

dag: Teeku bulli vali ba, ka bɛ siɣi kɔtiŋ kaman kuɣili la.
en: They sank to the bottom just like stones.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni niŋ ya dimbɔŋɔnim zaa n zuɣu, dama bɛ bi mi ŋun tim ma na.
en: People will do to you exactly what they did to me. They will do it because you belong to me, and they don't know the one who sent me.

dag: Nyin Yawɛ ni gbib ti ʒiɛmani ŋɔ puuni viɛnyɛliŋga sahakam, ka gul ti.
en: Lord , take care of the helpless. Protect them forever from the wicked people in this world.

dag: Cham ti yɛli Jɛrɔbɔam ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mani n-daa duh a niriba ni, ka piig a leei n niriba Izraɛlnim naa.
en: Give your husband this message from the Lord God of Israel: Jeroboam, you know that I, the Lord , chose you over anyone else to be the leader of my people Israel.

dag: Jaande chɛ ka n labi n ya ti kpi ka bɛ sɔɣi ma baɣili m ba mini m ma gbala. Amaa a dabili Chimham m-bɔŋɔ, chɛ ka o doli nyini n dan naa kuli ka a ti niŋ o a ni nya ka shɛli viɛl a sani.
en: Then please let me go back so that I can die in my own town and be buried in the grave of my father and mother. But here is Kimham; take him back with you as a servant, my lord and king. Do whatever you want with him.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni, n ni daa chɛ ka bɛ gbahi ba chaŋ, ka n lan zaŋ ba labisi bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la zuɣu. N ku chɛ bɛ ni so bahi.
en: They will know that I am the LORD their God when, after I made them go into exile among the nations, I gathered them to their land. I wont leave any of them behind.

dag: Ɛhab bia Izraɛl Naa Jɔram ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pinaayi saha, ka Juda Naa Jɛhɔram bia Ahazia gba daa di nam.
en: Ahaziah son of Jehoram became king of Judah in the twelfth year of Joram's rule in Israel.

dag: ka lala chɛ ka yi ku ku ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ka taali Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tiri ya ni yi su maa ni, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka ʒim yihibu taali ʒi yi zuɣu.
en: Innocent blood must not be spilled in the land the LORD your God is giving to you as an inheritance, or it will be bloodshed that will be required of you.

dag: M bihi, miriya ka yi jɛm buɣa!.
en: My children, keep yourselves safe from false gods!.

dag: Yi mini Masia ni mali simdi la zuɣu, yi nya binshɛɣukam pam o zuɣu hal zaŋ tabili yɛtɔɣa mini baŋsim zaa.
en: That is, you were made rich through him in everything: in all your communication and every kind of knowledge.

dag: Dinzuɣu nyama, n ni niŋ o marisa n-zaŋ o ka tiŋgban nɛli ni na nti tɔɣis o yurilim yɛtɔɣa.
en: Israel, I, the Lord , will lure you into the desert and speak gently to you.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daanfaani din nyɛ pin la n-chɛ ka bɛ yi taali ni ŋun Naawuni sani tiliginsim shɛli din be Yisa Masia ni la zuɣu.
en: They are made right with God by his grace. This is a free gift. They are made right with God by being made free from sin through Jesus Christ.

dag: Tiŋbunsi nyɛla bɛn ka yiko, amaa bɛ maani bɛ biɛhigu shee la kuɣa ni.
en: badgers, who seem to be weak, but live among the rocks;.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka gbaŋŋmara Shafan lan yɛli naa, Maligumaana Hilikia n-zaŋ kundi ŋɔ ti ma; ka daa zani naa maa tooni karim li.
en: Then Shaphan the secretary told the king, Hilkiah the priest has given me a scroll, and he read it out loud before the king.

dag: Niŋmiya bin zusanim niŋ yi ni yɛri situr shɛŋa naŋgbambiya anahi.
en: Make tassels for the four corners of the coat you wear.

dag: Ka a ni ti lan nya ka a zuliya galisi. Ka a bihi ti galisi kaman mɔri ni galisi shɛm ŋɔ.
en: You will have as many children as there are blades of grass in a pasture.

dag: ka Nɛtania bia Ishimail mini dɔbba pia bɛn be o sani maa daa yiɣisi zaŋ takɔbi ku Ahikam bia Gɛdalia Shafan yaaŋa maa, Babilɔn naa ni daa zaŋ o leei tiŋgbɔŋ maa Gomna maa zuɣu.
en: Ishmael and the ten men with him pulled out their swords and killed Gedaliah.

dag: Bɛ ni lan me du shɛŋa din daa lu la zali. Binshɛɣukam din daa saɣim ka di yuui la zaa, bɛ ni lan mal li zali di zaashee.
en: Then they will rebuild cities that have been in ruins for many generations.

dag: M mini ya n-yi be Naawuni jɛmbu duu dabisili kam ka n wuhiri ya, ka yi bi gbaai ma. Amaa dimbɔŋɔ niŋmi ni Naawuni Kundi yɛligu la niŋ pali.
en: Day after day I was with you and taught in the temple, and you didn't arrest me. But what the Scriptures say must come true.

dag: Amaa a nambɔzɔbo din galisi la zuɣu, a daa bi zaɣisi ba bee m-bahi ba yoli. A nyɛla nirilimlana ni nambɔzɔbo Naawuni!.
en: And yet, because your mercy is great, you did not forsake or destroy them. You are a gracious and merciful God!.

dag: Suhimiya alibarika tim bɛn yɛri ya zilima; ka suhimiya Naawuni tim bɛn turi ya la.
en: Ask God to bless anyone who curses you, and pray for everyone who is cruel to you.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi Duuma NAAWUNI yɛliya, Yi dimnim ni kana nti teei gili yi tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ n-saɣim yi ni zaŋ binshɛŋa taɣi yimaŋa, ka ʒe yi nayiya nɛma maa.
en: And so an enemy will surround their land, destroy their defenses, and plunder their mansions.

dag: Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ ti liri Juda tiŋgbɔŋ n-saɣim li, ka fa li leei timaŋmaŋ tiŋa, ka zaŋ Tabiil bia la leei di naa. .
en: They intend to invade Judah, terrify the people into joining their side, and then put Tabeel's son on the throne.

dag: Ka o daa kari alizin birigu maa doo maa zuɣu bahi, ka doo maa lan leei ŋun tɔɣisira; ka di daa niŋ salo maa alahiziba pam ka bɛ yɛra, Ti na ʒi n-nya tuuni ŋɔ tatabo Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: After Jesus had forced the demon out, the man started talking. The crowds were so amazed they began saying, Nothing like this has ever happened in Israel.

dag: Amaa paɣ ni tiligi bihi dɔɣibu puuni, ka di mi ni yila o yi kul mali yɛda niŋbu mini yurilim ni biɛr kasi zaŋ tabil omaŋgbibbu ni na.
en: But a wife will be brought safely through childbirth, if they both continue in faith, love, and holiness, together with self-control.

dag: So ku lan wum girigiri yɛla yi tiŋgban ni. Ka so mi ku lan saɣim yi tiŋgbani ŋɔ yaha. N ni be kaman gooni la n-taɣi ya ka chɛ zaɣ biɛɣu; ka yi paɣi ma n ni tiligi ya zuɣu.
en: There will never again be news of violence in your country. People will never again attack your country and steal from you. You will name your walls, Salvation and your gates, Praise.

dag: N ni yɛn yɛli shɛm ŋɔ pala din yi n Duuma sanna, amaa m barinyubo ŋɔ puuni n tɔɣisirimi kaman jɛrigu la.
en: Of course what I am saying now is not what the Lord would have me say; in this matter of boasting I am really talking like a fool.

dag: So yi bol a ni a ka o daamiliya lɔbu ni na, nyin miri ka a chaŋ ti ʒini jilima ʒiishee, dama di pa shɛli ka o ti boli ninvuɣ so ŋun mali yuli gar a;.
en: When someone invites you to a wedding feast, do not sit down in the best place. It could happen that someone more important than you has been invited.

dag: ka Asiriɛl daŋ niriba nyɛ Asiriɛlnima, ka Shɛkɛm daŋ niriba nyɛ Shɛkɛmnima.
en: Asriel—the Asrielite family group; Shechem—the Shechemite family group;.

dag: Ka Anabi Aizaia gba daa yɛli Izraɛl zuliya yɛla: Hal Izraɛl yaansi ni galisi kaman mɔɣ bihigu maa zaa yoli, bɛ ni niriba bɛn kpalim biɛla kɔŋko n-ni tiligi;.
en: And Isaiah exclaims about Israel: Even if the people of Israel are as many as the grains of sand by the sea, yet only a few of them will be saved;.

dag: Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili noli n-daa nyɛ Rubin zuliya maa tiŋgbani tariga. Fɔntiŋ kara mini tiŋkpansi ŋɔ ka Musa daa zaŋ ti Rubin zuliya maa ni bɛ su li.
en: The border of the people of Reuben was the Jordan and the territory next to it. This was the legacy of the people of Reuben—for their clans, their cities, and their settlements.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd min o tɔbbihi daa ʒiɛm Yisa ka mal o ansarisi; ka daa zaŋ kpar viɛlli yɛl o, ka chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ o labi Gomna Pailɛt sani.
en: Then Herod and his soldiers laughed at him. They made fun of him by dressing him in clothes like kings wear. Then Herod sent him back to Pilate.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli, Mbusim be n zuɣu, n lan ka tahima, dama yɛtɔɣ biɛri n-yiri n nol ni na, ka m mini yɛtɔɣ biɛri ni yiri ninvuɣ shɛb noya ni na laɣim be; amaa ka n nini nya naa ŋun nyɛ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ.
en: Then I cried out, I'm doomed! Everything I say is sinful, and so are the words of everyone around me. Yet I have seen the King, the Lord All-Powerful.

dag: Ka Dauda daa be birini maa ni, ka daa bol li Dauda tiŋa. Ka Naa Dauda daa piligi me yiya Millo polo na ti gil li.
en: David occupied the fortress, so it was renamed Davids City. David built a city around it from the earthen terraces inward.

dag: Ka Lamɛk daa nyɛ Mɛtusɛla bia, ka Mɛtusɛla nyɛ Inok bia, ka Inok nyɛ Jarɛd bia, ka Jarɛd nyɛ Mahalalɛl bia, ka Mahalalɛl mi nyɛ Kɛnan so bia.
en: Methuselah, Enoch, Jared, Mahalaleel, Kenan.

dag: Siɣisima, amaa ka pampam. Miri ka a ti kum o kuli. Vilim a baŋtabiga ka piri a namba. Miri ka a ti zaŋ bini pɔbi a zuɣusaa naŋgbampibili bee n-di kuli kumbu bindirigu.
en: Mourn in silence and don't show that you are grieving. Don't remove your turban or take off your sandals; don't cover your face to show your sorrow, or eat the food that mourners eat.

dag: Dahin shɛli kanna ka bɛ ni ti ŋum bahi ba na kaman teeku kom ni vuri shɛm la. Ka so yi ti lihi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, zibisim mini nandahima n-yɛn beni; ka sagbana zibigi fa neesim.
en: On that day, they will roar over it like the roaring of the sea. And if one looks toward the land, theres darkness. Tyre and the Nile will be darkened by the clouds.

dag: Ka Gaad zuliya mini Rubin zuliya maa daa yɛli, Ti ni niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni zali tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ ni ti niŋ shɛm maa.
en: The men of Gad and Reuben answered, Sir, we will do as the Lord has commanded.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli, N tum taali, amaa di zaa yoli, tim ma jilima n kpamba ŋɔ mini Izraɛlnim zaa tooni, ka chɛ ka m min a labi ka n ti jɛm Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Duuma Naawuni maa.
en: I have sinned, Saul said, but please honor me in front of my peoples elders and before Israel, and come back with me so I can worship the LORD your God.

dag: Dama m mali yɛtɔɣa pam, ka n ku chɛ li tɔɣisibu.
en: I can hardly wait to speak. I can't hold back the words.

dag: O mali ninkuunsi ni o bihi, di bi ŋman o bihi n-nyɛ ba; hal o wahala ni yɛn bahi yoli maa o baɣa kani.
en: She treats her young harshly as if they were not hers, without worrying that her labor might be in vain.

dag: Ka kum daa ti lu, ka Ilaisha lab Giligal na. Ka anabinim daa ti ʒi o sani, ka o yɛl o sɔŋda, Zaŋm duɣ titali tam n-duɣi ʒiɛri ti anabinim ŋɔ.
en: When Elisha returned to Gilgal, there was a famine in the land. A group of prophets was sitting before him. He said to his servant, Put on the big pot and cook some stew for the prophets.

dag: Ijiptinim ni guui ka niŋdi vuri kaman wahu la, dama bɛ dimnim kabirimi kanna. Bɛ gbibila kpandi kanna kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ŋmari tihi la ni bɛ ti liri ba.
en: The enemy army will go forward like a swarm of locusts. Your troops will feel helpless, like a snake in a forest.

dag: Juda zuliya daa leela Naawuni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi, ka Izraɛlnim leeg o ni su shɛba.
en: He made Judah his holy place and ruled over Israel.

dag: Bɛ ni bi darigi bɛn tumdi tuumbiɛri tibili yomyom zuɣu chɛ ka niriba kul lo bɛ suhuri ni ni bɛ tumla tuumbiɛri.
en: Why do people commit crimes so readily? Because crime is not punished quickly enough.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti tɔɣisi Naawuni yɛligu Pɛɛga naai bɛ daa gari chaŋla Atalia.
en: where they preached in the town of Perga. Then they went down to Attalia.

dag: Bɛ tiŋgbani maa ni ka Jɛziriil mini Chɛsulɔt ni Shunɛm.
en: Its area included Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem.

dag: Ka Ahija ŋun daa nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya ni nir la daa su Naawuni jɛmbu duu azichi sɔŋbu shee mini bɛ ni daa yi zaŋdi pin shɛŋa zaa na ti tiri Naawuni la fukumsi.
en: The Levites who were relatives of the Korahites and the Merarites were in charge of guarding the temple treasury and the gifts that had been dedicated to God.

dag: Dinzuɣu nyin Jɔshua ŋun nyɛ maligumaaniba zuɣulan ŋɔ min a maligumaanitab bɛn ʒiin a tooni ka nyɛ binsuma din ti yɛn kana shihirili la, wummiya: N ni yihi n dab so bɛ ni booni Tiwul polli la palo.
en: Listen then, Joshua, you who are the High Priest; and listen, you fellow priests of his, you that are the sign of a good future: I will reveal my servant, who is called The Branch!.

dag: Dama Izraɛlnim ni tuui dɔɣi bi shɛb zaa zaŋ tabili biŋkɔbiri tuuli bihi nyɛla n ni su shɛba. N ni daa ku bikpamba zaa Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni dahin shɛl la, ka n daa mali ba kasi ti mmaŋa.
en: Every firstborn in Israel—man or animal—is mine, because I killed all the firstborn children and animals in Egypt. And I chose to take the firstborn sons to belong to me.

dag: Di viɛl ni ti paɣi nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Zallakudura Naa, ka yili yila paɣ a yuli;.
en: It is good to praise the Lord . God Most High, it is good to praise your name.

dag: Di saha o daa yɛla saalo bɔɣiwɔɣila, dama di saha maa nabipuɣinsi bɛn daa na ʒi dɔbba ni daa yi yɛri saalo shɛŋa m-bala. Ka o tumtumda maa daa daag o yihi ka kpari dunoli.
en: The servant made her leave, and he locked the door behind her. The king's unmarried daughters used to wear long robes with sleeves.

dag: Ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ daa zaŋ biŋkɔbiri gbana n-she n-ti Adam min o paɣ maa ka bɛ so.
en: Then the Lord God made clothes out of animal skins for the man and his wife.

dag: Dahin shɛli, kaman kurig ata saha ka o nini daa ti nya Naawuni malaika ʒii ka o kpɛr o sanna ka bol o, Kɔniilius.
en: One afternoon at about three o'clock, Cornelius had a vision. He saw an angel from God coming to him and calling him by name.

dag: N duumanima, ŋmaligimiya kpe mani yi dabili ŋɔ yiŋ na nti paɣi yi naba, ka gbe kpe n-sa daŋ yibu chaŋ yi chandi shee. Ka bɛ yɛl o, Aai, ti ni gbe solɔɣu zuɣu.
en: and said, Gentlemen, I am your servant. Please come to my home. You can wash your feet, spend the night, and be on your way in the morning. They told him, No, we'll spend the night in the city square.

dag: Bɛnkam mali ba mini bɛnkam niŋ ba naani ni be kaman bɛ ni mali buɣ shɛŋa maa.
en: Let the people who made these idols and all who trust in them become just like them!.

dag: Mbusim be ninvuɣ so ŋun bi yuri ti Duuma Yisa zuɣu. Maranaata! Ti Duuma, kamina!.
en: Whoever does not love the Lord—a curse on him! Marana tha —Our Lord, come!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa karim li hal ti paai luɣ shɛli din wuhi Bigitana mini Tɛrɛsh bɛn daa nyɛ nayili namɔɣilis ayi bɛn guli naa zɔntua dunol la ni daa lo nia ni bɛ sɔɣ ku Naa Ahasivɛrɔs, ka Mɔdɛkai daa wum li ka zaŋ yɛli naa la.
en: When the servant read how Mordecai had kept Bigthana and Teresh from killing the king.

dag: Yi yi ku gbilisi tibili wum ka ku zaŋ li niŋ yi suhuri ni n-tiri ma jilima, dindina, n ni yɛli noli niŋ yi daalibarikanim ni. Yɛlimaŋli m pun yɛli noli niŋ di ni, dama yi bi zaŋ li niŋ yi suhuri ni.
en: If you dont listen, or dont intend to glorify my name, says the LORD of heavenly forces, then I will send a curse among you. I will curse your blessings, and I mean really curse them, because none of you intend to do it.

dag: Zaŋ hal ni ʒiɛmani din pahiri buta ni, yi ni tooi deei bɛ ni dɔɣi bi shɛba niŋ Yawɛ niriba laɣiŋgu ni.
en: and let their great-grandchildren become part of Israel, the Lord 's people.

dag: Ka Samuɛl daa yɛli Sool Zanimi ka n yɛl a Yawɛ ni sa yɛli ma shɛm yuŋ la. Ka o yɛl o, Yɛlima.
en: Stop, Samuel ordered, and I will tell you what the Lord said to me last night. Tell me, Saul said.

dag: ka Naawuni yi di yiɣisi zani, wula ka n di yɛn niŋ? Ka o yi bɔhi ma, wula ka n yɛn garigi yɛl o?.
en: then what will I do when I must face God? What will I say when he asks me to explain what I did?.

dag: Chɛ ka n suhigu paag a sanna ka a tiligi ma kaman a ni pun lo ma alikauli shɛm.
en: Listen to my prayer, and save me according to your promise!.

dag: Nabipuɣiŋga, a naba viɛli namda ni pam! A gbalipina bela polipoli kaman nyiŋgokor shɛli tuumbaŋda ni mali.
en: You are a princess, and your feet are graceful in their sandals. Your thighs are works of art, each one a jewel;.

dag: ŋun daa nyɛ Shɛkania bia la daa nyɛ Dauda daŋ zuɣulana. Ka Zakaria daa nyɛ Parɔsh daŋ zuɣulana, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa pah o zuɣu sabi bɛ yuya daa nyɛ dɔbba kɔbiga ni pihinu.
en: Shecaniahs son; of Parosh, Zechariah and with him were registered men.

dag: N ni ti niŋ buɣim nyo Ijipti, ka Pɛlusiumnim ti nya suhusaɣiŋgu pam. Ka sanʒiɛɣu ti ʒe Tɛbis n-da di goma luhi, ka Mɛmfisinim dimnim ti liri ba wuntaŋ ni.
en: I will set fire to your nation of Egypt! The city of Pelusium will be in anguish. Thebes will fall, and the people of Memphis will live in constant fear.

dag: ni Matiu mini Tomas ni Jeemsi Alifius bia mini Saimɔn ŋun daa nyɛ bɛn bɔri ni bɛn Izraɛlnim su bɛmaŋ la ni yino.
en: Matthew, Thomas, and James the son of Alphaeus. The rest of the apostles were Simon, known as the Eager One.

dag: Ka bɛ zaɣ yino kam daa ku o mini ŋun nyɔɣu yo taba. Ka Sirianim maa daa ŋmaligi guui, ka Izraɛlnim kari doli ba, amaa ka Siria Naa Bɛnhadad daa ba wɔhu pahi wɔribariba ni n-zo n-tiligi.
en: and each one killed the man he fought. The Syrians fled, with the Israelites in hot pursuit, but Benhadad escaped on horseback, accompanied by some of the cavalry.

dag: Chɛliya ka Masia ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naa ŋɔ siɣi dapulli ŋɔ zuɣu na pumpɔŋɔ, ka ti nya ka niŋ o yɛda. Ka bɛ ni daa kpahi shɛb tabili dapula m-pah o zuɣu la gba yɛr o zilima.
en: If he is really the Messiah, the king of Israel, he should come down from the cross now. When we see this, then we will believe in him. The criminals on the crosses beside Jesus also said bad things to him.

dag: Ka yinim teeku noli tinsi ŋɔ, yi ni ti leei biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee mini piɛguliba ni yɛn chɛri momaha luɣ shɛli, ka leei biŋkɔbbaligu gbɛbu shee.
en: Your seacoast will be changed into pastureland and sheep pens.

dag: Dinzuɣu bomiya nya o ni sɔɣiri luɣ shɛŋa zaa ka labina ti yɛli ma yɛlimaŋli, ka m mini ya chaŋ; ŋun dee yi be tiŋgbani maa ni, n ni bɔ o shee Judanim zaa niriba tusatusa puuni.
en: Find all the hiding places that David uses. Then come back to me and tell me everything. Then Ill go with you. If David is in the area, I will find him, even if I must go to every family group in Judah.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Balaam daa yiɣisi kul o ya, ka Balak gba ŋmaligi chaŋ o chandi.
en: Then Balaam got up and went back home, and Balak went his own way.

dag: N kɔre lan ka di zaa ni, di nyɛla bindir shɛŋa din bi luhi n kpaɣa.
en: I refuse to touch that kind of food; it makes me sick!.

dag: Ka o ni nya ka wum shɛli, dina ka o tɔɣisira; ka so mi bi deer o yɛligu.
en: He testifies to what he has seen and heard, but no one accepts his testimony.

dag: ni Gɛdɔr ni Ahio ni Zɛkɛr.
en: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher, and Mikloth.

dag: nti yi ŋariŋ ni nimaani chaŋ Filipai din daa nyɛ Masidɔnia tiŋgbɔŋ ni tinzuɣu ka Romnim su li la. Ka ti daa niŋ daba ayi nimaani.
en: Then we went to Philippi, a Roman colony and the leading city in that part of Macedonia. We stayed there for a few days.

dag: O daa lan yɛli, N ni niŋ Naawuni naani. Ka daa lan yɛli yaha, M mini bi shɛba n Duuma Naawuni ni zaŋ ti ma la ni laɣim be.
en: He also says, I will put my trust in God. And he also says, Here I am with the children that God has given me.

dag: Ka o dan maa yɛl o, Ti ku zani tinzunnim bɛn pa Izraɛlnim ŋɔ tiŋ ŋɔ ni, amaa ti ni gari paala Gibia. Ka o daa lan yɛl o tumtumda maa, Chɛ ka ti tirisi chaŋ luɣ shɛŋa dimbɔŋɔ ha nti gbe Gibia bee Rama.
en: No, the Levite answered. They aren't Israelites, and I refuse to spend the night there. We'll stop for the night at Gibeah.

dag: Ka anab ʒirinim pam ni ti yi palo m-birigi niriba pam.
en: Then many false prophets will appear and fool many people.

dag: Bɛ ni daa wum lala maa ka di gari ba pam, ka bɛ daa chɛ o ka chaŋ.
en: When they heard this, they were amazed; and they left him and went away.

dag: Bɛ ni ti yɛrila ninsala ŋun nyɛ binneembila, ka nyɛ daadam ŋun nyɛ zunzuli ŋɔ.
en: So how can we humans, when we are merely worms?.

dag: Binnui so mi daŋ ni: Shimɛi so yaha.
en: Of the family of Binnui: Shimei.

dag: Di saha n ni tooi nya garigibu din ni garigi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn maani ma ansarisi la, dama n niŋ a yɛligu naani.
en: so I can have a response for those who mock me because I have trusted in your word!.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chaŋ maligumaaniba kpamba mini tiŋ maa ni kpamba sani ti yɛli ba, Ti pola pɔri ni shee ti ku Pool, di yi pa lala ti ku di shɛli.
en: They went and talked to the leading priests and the older Jewish leaders. They said, We have promised ourselves that we will not eat or drink until we have killed Paul.

dag: Ka n tarili lee nyɛ dini Naawuni ŋun be zuɣusaa ŋɔ sani? Ka n fali lee nyɛ dini Kpiɔŋlan Naa ŋun be zuɣusaa ŋɔ sani?.
en: What does God above have for us? How does God All-Powerful repay people from his home high in heaven?.

dag: Ŋuna n-damdi dunia ŋɔ di zaashee, ka di daantalisi sɔhira.
en: God can shake the earth loose from its foundations.

dag: Amaa di yɛtɔɣa chaŋ gili dunia ŋɔ zaa, ka dunia ŋɔ yaɣ yini zaŋ ti kpa di tarisi zaa palila di yɛtɔɣa. Ka o ti suɣili zuɣusaa ti wuntaŋa;.
en: but their sound extends throughout the world; their words reach the ends of the earth. God has made a tent in heaven for the sun.

dag: Yi yi zaŋ kawaan daŋda bee ka daŋda na ni yi ti mali sara ti Yawɛ, yin zaŋmiya zaɣ maha n-chim li niɛm zim.
en: When you bring to the Lord an offering of the first grain harvested, offer roasted grain or ground meal.

dag: Ka n daa tim tuumba ni bɛ ti yɛli ba, N tumdila tuun shɛli din niŋ kamaata, n ku tooi kana. Bɔzuɣu ka n yɛn chɛ tuma maa ka di kpalim zani, ka ka yi sanna.
en: I sent messengers to say to them, I am doing important work and can't go down there. I am not going to let the work stop just to go and see you.

dag: Yawɛ nol ni yɛligu ka o daa zaŋ nam zuɣusaa. Yawɛ nol ni yɛligu ka o daa zaŋ nam wuntaŋa mini goli ni saŋmarisi zaa.
en: The Lord created the heavens by his command, the sun, moon, and stars by his spoken word.

dag: Bi jɛrigu nyɛla ŋun tiri o ba suhugarigu. Yidaampaɣ so ŋun yuri zabili ŋmanila saa ŋun yɔrita.
en: A foolish son is a disaster to his father; a contentious wife is like constant dripping.

dag: Ka Balak daa niŋ Balaam ni yɛl o shɛm maa n-zaŋ naɣila yinoyino mini piɛla yinoyino mali sara pa bimbini kam zuɣu.
en: Balak did what Balaam asked. Balak offered the bulls and rams on the altars.

dag: Wulipolli ni ti puhi yi Jɛsi gbirili ni na. Wulli ni ti to n-yi o nyaɣa ni na n-wali.
en: A shoot will grow up from the stump of Jesse; a branch will sprout from his roots.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa, ka Ayuba daa lan niŋ yuun kɔbiga ni pihinahi pahi. Ka o nini daa nya o yaantibichahi mi yaansi.
en: After this, Job lived years and saw four generations of his children.

dag: Ka Gomna Fɛstus daa yɛli, Naa Agiripa mini yi zaa bɛn be kpe ŋɔ, doo ŋɔ yɛla ka Yɛhudianim bɛn be Jɛrusalɛm mini ya ŋɔ zaa kul mali doli ma n-kuhiri yɛri ni o bi simdi ni o be la.
en: Festus said, King Agrippa and everyone present with us: You see this man! The entire Jewish community, both here and in Jerusalem, has appealed to me concerning him. Theyve been calling for his immediate death.

dag: yɛl o, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyin Gɔg ŋun nyɛ Mɛshɛk mini Tubal nazuɣu ŋɔ, m bi ʒe a nyaaŋa.
en: and tell him that I, the Sovereign Lord , am his enemy.

dag: Ka so yi yɛn mali suhudoo sara ti Yawɛ, di zaligu m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: The following are the regulations for the fellowship offerings presented to the Lord .

dag: Ŋuni n-lee zaŋ Yaakubu ti neendiriba, ka zaŋ Izraɛlnim ti ŋmɛnditoya? Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti ni tum alahichi so sani, ka bi dol o zaligu ni o soya la n-niŋ lala maa.
en: Who gave Jacob to the looter, and Israel to the plunderers? Wasnt it the LORD, the one we sinned against? They were not willing to walk in Gods ways, and wouldnt listen to his teaching.

dag: Ka o ni daa yɛli shɛm maa zuɣu chɛ ka dabiɛm gbaai niriba maa pam ka bɛ yɛl o, Ka tuun bɔ ka a lee tum ŋɔ? Bɛ daa baŋya ni o yila Yawɛ sani zɔra, dama omaŋmaŋa n-daa pun yɛli ba lala.
en: Jonah went on to tell them that he was running away from the Lord . The sailors were terrified, and said to him, That was an awful thing to do.

dag: Dama niriba ayi bee ata yi laɣim luɣ shɛli n yuli zuɣu, n ni be bɛ sani.
en: For where two or three are gathered in my name, Im there with them.

dag: ka zali di tariga, ka niŋ dunoya niŋ li n-kpari li zali.
en: when I imposed my limit for it, put on a bar and doors.

dag: Amaa di nyaaŋa ka yi ti taɣi yi tɛha, ka bi lan tiri n yuli jilima, ka yi ni yino kam lan zaŋ yi ni daa bahi yi dab shɛb bɛn nyɛ dɔbba mini paɣiba ni bɛ cham bɛ chandi kaman bɛ suhu ni yu shɛm la n-lan leei yi daba yaha.
en: But then you changed your minds again and dishonored me. All of you took back the slaves whom you had set free as they desired, and you forced them into slavery again.

dag: Ka Dauda daa yɛl o, Di zɔri dabiɛm, dama n ni niŋ a nirilim a ba Jɔnatan zuɣu, ka zaŋ a yab Sool ni daa su tiŋgban shɛli zaa ti a, ka lan chɛ ka m min a laɣindi ʒiini diri sahakam.
en: David said, Don't be afraid. I'll be kind to you because Jonathan was your father. I'm going to give you back the land that belonged to your grandfather Saul. Besides that, you will always eat with me at my table.

dag: Ka Samaria paɣ maa bɔh o, Di chaŋ wula ka nyin Yɛhudia nir ti suhiri man Samaria paɣ kom? Dama Yɛhudianim bi saɣiri ka bɛ mini Samarianim laɣindi timdi dira.
en: The woman answered, You are a Jew, and I am a Samaritan—so how can you ask me for a drink.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya, N ni yiɣisi n suhu bahi Filistianim zuɣu. N ni ku Chɛrɛtinima, ka ku bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim be teeku dul la.
en: Now it's my turn to treat the Philistines as my enemies and to kill everyone living in their towns along the seacoast.

dag: Ka Yisifu daa dɔɣi Manaasa mini Ifriim Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Pɔtifɛra ŋun daa nyɛ Hɛliopolis tindan bipuɣiŋga Asɛnat la ni daa dɔɣi shɛb ti o m-bala.
en: In Egypt, Joseph had two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.

dag: Ka Naawuni ni daa zal li shɛm o nia lɔbu min o milinsi puuni zuɣu ka o daa zaŋ o niŋ yi nuu ni, ka yi mi daa chɛ ka ninvuɣ biɛri kpah o tabili dapulli zuɣu ku o.
en: Jesus was handed over to you, and you killed him. With the help of evil men, you nailed him to a cross. But God knew all this would happen. It was his plan—a plan he made long ago.

dag: O mabihi bɛn daa nyɛ bɛ daŋ maa ni dɔɣirikpamba zaa kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiyi ni pihinahinaayi. Azarɛl bia Amashisai daa nyɛla Ahizai yaaŋa. O yaannim shɛba n-daa nyɛ Mɛshilɛmɔt mini Imɛr.
en: Altogether, there were clan leaders among his relatives. The fourth priest to settle there was Amashsai son of Azarel. His ancestors were Ahzai, Meshillemoth, and Immer.

dag: Ka kum yi ti lu tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni bee alɔbo bee bimbilima dɔriti yi ti lu bee toli bee zunzuya yi ti saɣindi bindira, ka bɛ dimnim yi ti kana ti teei gili tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni tin shɛli nima bee muɣisigu shɛlikam bee dɔro balibu kam yi ti lu bɛ zuɣu;.
en: Whenever there is a famine or plague in the land, or whenever there is blight, mildew, locusts, or grasshoppers, or whenever someones enemies attack them in their cities, or any plague or illness comes.

dag: Amaa tinim n-ni paɣi Yawɛ pumpɔŋɔ hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: But we will praise the Lord now and forever! Praise the Lord !.

dag: ka yɛli ba, Ŋunkam deeri bibil ŋɔ tatabo n yuli zuɣu deerila mani, ka ŋunkam mi deeri ma deerila ŋun tim ma na; dama ŋun pɔri yi zaa ha ni, dilana n-nyɛ wɔɣirili yi ni.
en: Then he said to the followers, Whoever accepts a little child like this in my name is accepting me. And anyone who accepts me is also accepting the one who sent me. The one among you who is the most humble—this is the one who is great.

dag: Di simdi ka yi piɛbil nyɛla ŋun ka daŋa, ka nyɛ yuun yini piɛbila. Yi ni tooi zaŋ bulaa ŋun be lala gba.
en: Your lamb should be a flawless year-old male. You may take it from the sheep or from the goats.

dag: Yuun shɛli din pahir ayɔbu puuni gol so ŋun pahir ayɔbu daba anu dali ka n daa ʒi n yiŋa, ka Juda kpamba daa ʒi n tooni, ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yiko daa siɣi n zuɣu na nimaani.
en: Six years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the leaders of Judah were meeting with me in my house. On the fifth day of the sixth month, the Lord God suddenly took control of me.

dag: A mini Izraɛl tɔbbihi zaa cham gilimi Jɛriko goondaa maa napɔŋ yim dahin yini kam n-niŋ lala hal ti paai daba ayɔbu.
en: March around the city with your army once every day for six days.

dag: N Naawuni, n ni ŋme mɔɣilo paɣ a a ʒiɛyimtali zuɣu; N ni ŋme mɔɣilo n-yili yila paɣi nyin Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ.
en: I will indeed praise you with the harp; I will praise your faithfulness, my God. On my harp I will play hymns to you, the Holy One of Israel.

dag: Ka yi ni daa galisi kaman saŋmarisi bɛn be zuɣusaa ŋɔ la, yi kalinli ni ti kpalimla biɛla yi ni bi deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ nol la zuɣu.
en: Once as countless as the stars in the night sky, only a few of you will be left alive—all because you didnt obey the LORD your Gods voice.

dag: Yi ni yɛn tiri Naawuni pina shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Alikama tahili kam puuni, yi ni yihi kuruwa pirigibu buyɔbu puuni yim zuɣu ti. Chi tahili kam puuni, yi ni yihi kuruwa pirigibu buyɔbu puuni yim zuɣu ti.
en: These are your prescribed contributions: one-sixth of an ephah for each homer of wheat, and one-sixth of an ephah for each homer of barley.

dag: Di bemi kaman di ni sab shɛm la, Ŋunkam kuhi boli ti Duuma yuli ni tiligi.
en: All who call out to the Lord will be saved.

dag: Di chɛ ka o be kaman bɛ ni yi dɔɣi bikpiin so bahina ka o yaɣ yini saɣim la.
en: Dont let her lose her skin like a baby who is born dead.

dag: O nuu din mali kpiɔŋ min o bɔɣu ka o daa teei yihi ba. O yurilim maŋli la kul ni beni sahakam.
en: He used his powerful arms and strong hands. His faithful love will last forever.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o daa zaŋ ma kpe dundombila din be wulimpuhili polo ni nti buɣisi dunɔdali, ka di mini dina la zaa nyɛ yim.
en: Then he brought me to the inner courtyard on the east side, and again he took the same measurements of the gate.

dag: Amaa yi yi na kul yɛra, Ti ku be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, ka lala zuɣu chɛ ka yi zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ noli.
en: But you might keep on saying, We won't stay here in Judah, and we won't obey the Lord our God.

dag: Ninvuɣ ŋuni n-lee bo yɛlli ti Taainim ŋɔ? Taai din nyɛ tin shɛli din leeri nama, ka di kɔhigɔriba nyɛ nabihi, ka di daa bihi mi nyɛ bɛn mali jilima pam dunia ŋɔ ni la?.
en: Who planned this concerning Tyre, the one who gives crowns, whose merchants were princes, whose traders were the honored of the earth?.

dag: Ka Mariama daa kpalim Ɛlizabɛt sani kaman chira ata laasabu, ka naanyi kul o ya.
en: Mary stayed with Elizabeth about three months. Then she went back home.

dag: Ti bɔrila suhudoo, amaa ka bi nya zaɣ viɛlli, Ti bɔrila alaafee nyabu saha, amaa ka dabiɛm n-naɣ kul beni.
en: We longed for relief, but received none; for a time of healing, but found only terror.

dag: Shɛfatia daŋ niriba daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisita ni pisopɔinnaayi.
en: the descendants of Shephatiah:.

dag: Di daa zɔri dolila tiŋ maa puuni solɔɣu sunsuuni, ka bɛ ni booni ti shɛli nyɛvili tia la sa n-doli mɔɣili maa yaɣa ayi zaa, ka wala balibu pinaayi be di zuɣu, ka di wandi goli kam, ka di vari mi nyɛ din tibiri zuliya kam.
en: and flowing down the middle of the city's street. On each side of the river was the tree of life, which bears fruit twelve times a year, once each month; and its leaves are for the healing of the nations.

dag: N di n-tiɣi kaman chuɣu ka m puhi la, ka yaai n noli paɣ a ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Im fully satisfied— as with a rich dinner. My mouth speaks praise with joy on my lips.

dag: Amaa alahichinim bɛn ni ti bahi yoli zaa, ka ninvuɣ biɛri zuliya ti bahi yoli.
en: But those who break the law will be destroyed completely. And their descendants will be forced to leave the land.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛli n taali a yuli zuɣu, dama n daalahichi galisiya pam.
en: Please, for the sake of your good name, LORD, forgive my sins, which are many!.

dag: Nuhu bidibisi n-daa nyɛ; Shɛm mini Ham ni Jafɛt.
en: who was the father of Noah. Noah had three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

dag: Mali suhupiɛlli tɔŋbu saha, ka yɛla mi yi ti paag a, nyin teemi ni Naawuni n-tahiri suhupiɛlli mini yɛlimuɣisira maa zaa na. Dinzuɣu ninsalinim ku tooi baŋ binshɛli din yɛn niŋ bɛ kalinsi nyaaŋa.
en: When things are going well for you, be glad, and when trouble comes, just remember: God sends both happiness and trouble; you never know what is going to happen next.

dag: Din ni chɛ ka n tooi nyaŋ niŋ dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka n kul tumdi ka mɔra, yiko shɛli Masia ni ti ma ka di tumdi di tuma pam n ni la zuɣu.
en: I work hard and struggle for this goal with his energy, which works in me powerfully.

dag: Ka yi yi bi doli zaligu ŋɔ yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din sabi be kundi ŋɔ ni ŋɔ n-luri Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yuli din mali jilima mini dabiɛm ŋɔ sizuura.
en: You must obey everything in The Book of God's Law . Because if you don't respect the Lord .

dag: Miri ka a niŋ a kpee fitiina bee n-fa o. A yi bu so paa ka o tum a tuma, nyin di chɛ ka o liɣiri gbe a sani.
en: Do not rob or take advantage of anyone. Do not hold back the wages of someone you have hired, not even for one night.

dag: Dama a yurilim maŋli zaŋ chaŋ m polo galisiya pam; a yihi n shia kpiimba biɛhigu shee.
en: Your love for me is so great that you protected me from death and the grave.

dag: Bɛna n-nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaɣisiri neesim la, bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn bi mili di soya ka bi ʒe di soya zuɣu la.
en: There are those who reject the light; they don't understand it or go where it leads.

dag: Ka n yi chɛ ka mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri yi bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni nti kuri ba, ka di leei dabari, ka so ku lan gari nimaani biŋkɔb biɛri ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Or I might send wild animals to kill the people, making the land so dangerous that no one could travel through it.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa daa baŋ bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali maa ka bɔhi ba, Yinim bilikɔɣinim ŋɔ, bɔ n-niŋ ka yi zahindi ma?.
en: Jesus, however, was aware of their evil plan, and so he said, You hypocrites! Why are you trying to trap me?.

dag: Ka Naawuni suhu daa bi paligi bɛ ni niŋ shɛm maa zuɣu, ka o daa darigi Izraɛlnim tibili.
en: David had done a bad thing in Gods sight, so God punished Israel.

dag: Ka Filip daa guui paag o sani nti wum ka o karindila Anabi Aizaia litaafi. Ka Filip bɔh o, A baŋ a ni karindi litaafi shɛli maa gbinni.
en: Running up to the carriage, Philip heard the man reading the prophet Isaiah. He asked, Do you really understand what you are reading.

dag: Ka Musa daa yɛli Izraɛl zuɣulaannima, Yi zaa yinoyino kum yi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpe Pɛɔr Baal jɛmbu ni maa.
en: Then Moses said to Israels officials, Each of you: kill your men who are attached to the Baal of Peor.

dag: Di yuriya dunia ŋɔ bee binshɛŋa din be dunia ŋɔ ni. So yi yuri dunia ŋɔ, ti Ba Naawuni yurilim ka o ni.
en: Dont love this evil world or the things in it. If you love the world, you do not have the love of the Father in you.

dag: Dinzuɣu Naawuni noli ni din ya; ka yi ni shɛb kul ni nyɛla daba sahakam; ka kabiri dari, ka ŋɔŋdi kom niŋdi n Naawuni jɛmbu duu.
en: Because you did this, God has condemned you. Your people will always be slaves, cutting wood and carrying water for the sanctuary of my God.

dag: Ka bɛ zaa daa laɣim di bindir yin shɛli Naawuni ni daa ti ba la.
en: All of them also ate the same spiritual food.

dag: Zɛdɛkia daa tum alahichi Yawɛ sani kaman Jɛhoyakim ni daa tum shɛm la.
en: Zedekiah did what the Lord said was wrong. He did all the same things that Jehoiakim did.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka Babilɔn naa bɔɣiri niŋ kpiɔŋ, ka n zaŋ n takɔbi niŋ o nuu ni. Amaa n ni kabisi Firawuna bɔɣiri, ka o ti be o tooni ŋuhira kaman ŋun nya daŋa din yɛn ku o la.
en: I will make the arms of the king of Babylon strong. I will put my sword in his hand, but I will break the arms of Pharaoh. Then Pharaoh will cry out in pain, the kind of cry that a dying man makes.

dag: Zaŋm a bindirigu bahi kom ni, dama di yi niŋ daba ayi, di ni lan lab a sanna yaha.
en: Be generous, and someday you will be rewarded.

dag: M mi bɛ tɛha mini bɛ tuma. N kanimina ni n ti laɣim zuliya kam mini tinzun yɛtɔɣa balibu kam nim zaa ka bɛ kana ti nya n jilima.
en: They have evil thoughts and do evil things, so I am coming to punish them. I will gather all nations and all people. Everyone will be gathered together to see my Glory.

dag: Ka o daa lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ daanya mali gaɣa kɔtomsi m-pie taba ʒiibuyi zuɣu n-zaŋ li zali kɔniŋdi bini maa lɔŋni, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita pinaata ni pirigili, ka di daa tuɣituɣi taba.
en: There were images of bulls under the lip of the large bronze tank. They were in two rows that went cubits around the tank. The bulls were molded in place when the tank was shaped.

dag: Di saha ka paɣ maa daa zaŋ o ni niŋ yɛn shɛli maa chaŋ tiŋ maa nim zaa sani, ka bɛ daa ŋmaai Bikiri bia Shiiba maa zuɣu n-zaŋ li bahi Jɔab na. Ka o daa piɛbi kikaa ka sokam wurim kul o yiŋa, ka Jɔab mi daa labi naa sani Jɛrusalɛm.
en: She went to the people of the town and talked them into doing it. They cut off Sheba's head and threw it to Joab. Joab blew a signal on his trumpet, and the soldiers returned to their homes. Joab went back to David in Jerusalem.

dag: Bɛ tɔɣisirila yɛtɔɣ biɛri zaŋ chaŋ alizanda polo, ka chɛ ka bɛ zilima yɛtɔɣa paai dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam zaa.
en: They dare to speak against God and to order others around.

dag: Ka ŋun yuri Naawuni daalibarika yi be yili maa ni, yi daalibarika puhigu maa ni kpalim o ni; amaa lala nir yi ka yili maa ni, di ni lab yi sanna yaha.
en: If the people living there are peace-loving, your prayer for peace will bless them. But if they are not peace-loving, your prayer will return to you.

dag: Ti paɣiri Naawuni o pin shɛli yɛla ninsal maŋmaŋ yɛtɔɣa ni ku tooi kahigi wuhi ŋɔ zuɣu!.
en: Thank God for his gift that words cant describe!.

dag: Yisa Masia ŋun daa yi Naa Dauda ŋun nyɛ Ibrahimma yaaŋa la zuliya ni na dɔɣirikpamba ni nyɛ shɛba m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: A record of the ancestors of Jesus Christ, son of David, son of Abraham.

dag: Dama saa ni yi nyaɣisi wulimpuhili polo m-mali ti ba wulinluhili polo shɛm la, lala ka Daadam Bia kandina maa ti yɛn be.
en: Just as the lightning flashes from the east to the west, so it will be with the coming of the Human One.

dag: Dauda bia Sulemaana ŋun daa nyɛ Izraɛl naa la ŋaha.
en: The proverbs of Solomon, son of David and king of Israel.

dag: Ka o nyaandolitab maa daa ti yɛl o, Ti nya ti Duuma. Amaa ka o yɛli ba, Ka pa ni man ti nya o nuhi ni kpahi bɔba la, ka zaŋ n nubil bɔbili kpahi maa bɔba maa ni, ka zaŋ n nuu tim o puluɣili la bɔbili la ni, n ku niŋ yɛda.
en: So they told him, We have seen the Lord! But Thomas said, First, I must see the nail scars in his hands and touch them with my finger. I must put my hand where the spear went into his side. I won't believe unless I do this.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa buɣim maa sunsuuni; ka yi daa wum yɛtɔɣa maa vuri, amaa ka lee bi nya kɔtomsi shɛli, kukoli kɔŋko n-daa kul beni.
en: Then the Lord spoke to you from the fire. You heard the sound of someone speaking, but you did not see any form. There was only a voice.

dag: dama yi dibu ni, sokam kpaɣirimi dira, ka kum mali shɛba ka shɛb mi nyu m-buɣi.
en: I say this because when you eat, each one eats without waiting for the others. Some people dont get enough to eat or drink, while others have too much.

dag: Amaa di nyɛ ma la talahi ni n gbaai soli zuŋɔ ni biɛɣuni zaŋ chaŋ dali; dama anabi bi kɔŋd o nyɛvili luɣ shɛli ka pa ni Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Yet I must be on my way today, tomorrow, and the next day; it is not right for a prophet to be killed anywhere except in Jerusalem.

dag: Pa bɛna n-nyɛ bɛn turi jilima yu shɛli Naawuni ni zaŋ boli ya la?.
en: And the rich are the ones who insult the wonderful name of Christ, the name by which you are known.

dag: Ka doo maa daa ti lan yiɣisi ni o kuli, ka o deemba maa lan balim o hal ka o ti lan gbe yaha.
en: The Levite got up to leave, but his father-in-law persuaded him to stay the night again.

dag: Ka Farisiinim shɛb daa ka Yisa sanna nti ŋmɛr o naŋgbankpeeni m-bɔri ni bɛ zahim o ka o wuhi ba alizanda ni shihirili.
en: The Pharisees came out and started an argument with Jesus. They wanted to test him by asking for a sign from heaven.

dag: Dama a zaŋ alibarika pam na ti ti o; ka zaŋ salima alali nam zuɣupiligu pil o.
en: You came to him with great blessings and set a crown of gold on his head.

dag: Zaŋmiya yimaŋ ti taba yi ni luri Masia sizuura la zuɣu.
en: Submit yourselves to one another because of your reverence for Christ.

dag: Riu ni daa dɔɣi Sɛrug maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiyinaayopɔin. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: after that, he lived another years and had other children.

dag: Ka daɣila n kul yɛn lihirila tɔbu tuhibu, ka wumdi kikahi kumsi sahakam?.
en: How long will I see enemy flags and hear their trumpets?.

dag: Di ni ti nyɛla bɛ ni su shɛli, ka nyɛ luɣ gahindili luɣ kasi shee tiŋgbani maa ni. Di ni ti nyɛla luɣ kasi zaa luɣ kasi shee n-tuɣi Lɛvinim tiŋgbani.
en: The land belonging to the priests will be the most sacred area and will lie south of the area that belongs to the Levites.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ, a yuli galisiya dunia ŋɔ zaa ni! A chɛ ka a jilima yi zahira zuɣusaa.
en: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth! You let your glory be seen in the heavens above.

dag: Ka ŋunkam daa mali kuɣ viɛla zaŋ li ti niŋ Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa daazichi ni be luɣ shɛli, ka Jɛhiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Gɛrishɔn zuliya nir la daa gul li.
en: Everyone who owned precious stones also donated them to the temple treasury, where Jehiel from the Levite clan of Gershon guarded them.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee zaŋ yɛm niŋ nir puuni? Bee n-chɛ ka baŋsim be nir zuɣu ni?.
en: Who put wisdom in remote places, or who gave understanding to a rooster?.

dag: Yi mi ni dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa o ni daa ti bɔri alibarika o ba san la, o daa bi tooi nya li, dama o daa bi nya soli din ni doli taɣi o ni daa tum shɛm la hal o ni daa kul bo li ni nintam la zaa yoli.
en: Afterward, you know, he wanted to receive his father's blessing; but he was turned back, because he could not find any way to change what he had done, even though in tears he looked for it.

dag: Nyama, ŋuna n-chɛ ka saa nyaɣisiri gind o, ka chɛ ka teeku puuni nyaɣa limsi.
en: He sends lightning through all the sky, but the depths of the sea remain dark.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa yɛli paɣ maa, Lab kuli, ka n lihi a yɛlli maa zuɣu.
en: Go back home, the king answered, and I will take care of the matter.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tahiri woligibu na, ka nyɛ bɛn maŋmaŋ nama biɛhigu yubu su ba, ka Naawuni Shia ka bɛ ni.
en: And now these people are already making you turn against each other. They think only about this life, and they don't have God's Spirit.

dag: Di daa ti lu Farisiinim tibili ni ni Yisa nyari nyaandoliba pam baptaiziri ba n-gari Jɔn Baptaizira.
en: Jesus knew that the Pharisees had heard that he was winning and baptizing more followers than John was.

dag: Amaa bɛ ni daa ti di n-tiɣi, ka di wuhi ni bɛ tiɣiya ka bɛ daa zaŋ karimbaani kpɛhi bɛ suhuri ni, dinzuɣu ka bɛ tam n yɛla.
en: When I fed them, they were satisfied; and their hearts became proud; therefore, they forgot me.

dag: ka bɛ dii chɛ bɛ ba mini ŋariŋ maa ka dol o.
en: immediately they left the boat and their father and followed him.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb ni ti yiɣisi yimaŋmaŋ gba ni n-tɔɣisi ya chirimbu yɛtɔɣa ni bɛ lɛbigi nyaandoliba maa suhuri n-zu ba chaŋ.
en: Also, men from your own group will begin to teach things that are wrong. They will lead some of the Lords followers away from the truth to follow them.

dag: Dama mani a dabili ŋɔ daa zaŋla n nyɛvili pa talima bia maa zuɣu m ba sani ka yɛli, N yi ti bi ʒi bia maa kuna, di taali din ʒinimi n zuɣu hal ni n nyɛvili tariga.
en: What is more, I pledged my life to my father for the boy. I told him that if I did not bring the boy back to him, I would bear the blame all my life.

dag: N daa wurim ba kpɛhi zuliya shɛli ni, ka bɛ ti wurim kpe tiŋgbɔn shɛŋa ni, ka n daa kari ba saria kaman bɛ tuma mini bɛ biɛhigu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: When I scattered them to the nations and dispersed them into other lands, I judged them according to their ways and deeds.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba daa ti laɣim zaŋ bɛ noya naai Abinɛr ka bɛ min o leei zaɣ yini n-du zoli maa zuɣu ti zani.
en: The men from the tribe of Benjamin gathered around Abner again and took their stand on the top of a hill.

dag: Yi ʒiɛmla Izraɛl Naawuni ni pii ya ka woligi ya Izraɛlnim ni n-zaŋ ya mir omaŋa ni yi tumdi tuma ŋun Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la ni, ka zaani niriba maa tooni n-tumdi tuma sɔŋdi ba la?.
en: isnt it enough for you that Israels God has separated you from the Israelite community to allow you to approach him, to perform the service of the LORDs dwelling, and to serve before the community by ministering for them?.

dag: Dinzuɣu yi ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa puuni, di yi nyɛ yɛtɔɣa ni bee tuma ni, yin niŋmiya di zaa ti Duuma Yisa yuli ni, ka paɣimiya ti Ba Naawuni o zuɣu.
en: Whatever you say or do should be done in the name of the Lord Jesus, as you give thanks to God the Father because of him.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ, tiligim ti Asiria naa maa nuu ni, ka dunia ŋɔ nama zaa niriba baŋ ni a kɔŋko n-shiri nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: So now, LORD our God, please save us from Sennacheribs power! Then all the earths kingdoms will know that you alone are LORD.

dag: Yisa daa lan bɔhi ba, Wula ka nir ni tooi kpe kpiɔŋlan yiŋa nti fa n nɛma ka pa ni o daŋ o la mii lɔbu pɔi? Di nyaaŋa ka o ni tooi fa o nɛma maa.
en: Can people go into a house that belongs to a strong man and steal his possessions, unless they first tie up the strong man? Then they can rob his house.

dag: Ka a zaŋ a noli yɛtɔɣa duhiri amaŋa n-niŋdi ma, ka tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa pam jɛndiri ma, n wum li.
en: Your proud boasting is really against me. Time after time you have insulted me, and I have heard every word.

dag: Ka yi mi yi suhi li, yi bi nyari li, dama yi tɛha bi tuhi lala niŋbu ni; yi suhirila binshɛŋa yi ni yɛn zaŋ tum yimaŋmaŋ niŋgbuŋ kɔre nyaɣisim tuma.
en: Or when you ask, you dont receive anything, because the reason you ask is wrong. You only want to use it for your own pleasure.

dag: Niriba yi chaŋ bɛ tuma ni, bɛ tumdimi hal ni zaawuni.
en: then we go out to work until the end of day.

dag: Yisa noli daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka do so yi Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu zuɣulan maa yiŋ na ti yɛl o, A bipuɣiŋga maa bahiya. Di lan muɣisiri karimba maa yaha.
en: While Jesus was saying this, a messenger came from the official's house. Your daughter has died, he told Jairus; don't bother the Teacher any longer.

dag: Di saha ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn luri Yawɛ sizuura daa tɔɣisiri tab yɛtɔɣa, ka Yawɛ gbilisi tibili wum li, ka sabi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zɔri ŋun Yawɛ, ka tir o yuli jilima maa yɛla niŋ yɛla teebu litaafi ni o sani.
en: Then the Lord s followers spoke with each other, and the Lord listened to them. There is a book in front of him. In that book are the names of his followers. They are the people who honor the Lord s name.

dag: Dinzuɣu lomiya ania n-doli dinkam sabi Musa zaligu ni la, ka miriya ka yi ŋmaligi kpa nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo ka chɛ li.
en: Be sure that you carefully obey everything written in The Book of the Law of Moses and do exactly what it says.

dag: Ka maligumaana so ŋun ti zaŋ li mali alahichi sanyoo sara maligu maa ni ti ŋub li. O ti ŋubim li luɣ kasi shee Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili maa dundɔŋ ni.
en: The priest who offers this sacrifice must eat it in the sacred courtyard of the sacred tent.

dag: N ni su ninvuɣ shɛb maa ŋmanila gbuɣinli ŋun be mɔɣu ni n sani. Bɛ ŋumdimi bahiri n zuɣu, dinzuɣu ka n je ba.
en: My own people turned against me like a wild lion. They roared at me, so I turned away from them.

dag: Maligumaana zuɣulana Ɛliashib bia Joyada bidibisi ni yino daa nyɛla Sanbalat ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtihɔrɔn nir la bipuɣiŋga yidana, ka n daa kar o n sani.
en: Joiada was the son of Eliashib the High Priest, but one of Joiada's sons married the daughter of Sanballat, from the town of Beth Horon, so I made Joiada leave Jerusalem.

dag: ka daa ti kpuɣi n zuɣu lihi nya so ka o ye binyɛr piɛlli din mali shaara, ka lo salima din nyɛ alali shɛlɔrigu.
en: While I was standing there, I looked up and I saw a man standing in front of me. He was wearing linen clothes. He wore a belt made of pure gold around his waist.

dag: Ka Shɛkɛm daa yɛl o ba Hamɔr, Bom paɣisarili ŋɔ ti ma ka n niŋ m paɣa.
en: Shechem said to his father Hamor, Get this girl for me as my wife.

dag: O ni daa be suhusaɣiŋgu ni pam zuɣu ka o daa suhuri Naawuni ni nimmoo hal ka o niŋgbuŋ ni woligu ti tɔɣiri luri tiŋa kaman ʒim la.
en: Jesus was in great pain and prayed so sincerely that his sweat fell to the ground like drops of blood.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa deei Liya suhigu ka o niŋ pua n-dɔɣi bidibiga ŋun pah anu ti Yaakubu.
en: and God answered Leah's prayers by giving her a fifth son.

dag: Amaa ka Samsin zabiri maa daa ti lan bilina gbaai zoobu o pinibu maa nyaaŋa.
en: But his hair began to grow again.

dag: Dahin shɛli ka Keen daa ti zaŋ o puu ni bindira na nti mali sara Yawɛ sani.
en: After some time Cain brought some of his harvest and gave it as an offering to the Lord .

dag: O mali ninkuunsi ni o bihi, di bi ŋman o bihi n-nyɛ ba; hal o wahala ni yɛn bahi yoli maa o baɣa kani.
en: She acts as if the eggs were not hers, and is unconcerned that her efforts were wasted.

dag: Ka paɣ maa dii lu Pita tooni kpi. Ka nachimba maa daa kpɛna nti nya ka o kpimi doya, ka bɛ kpuɣ o gba yi nti sɔɣ o baɣil o yidan maa gballi.
en: At once she fell at Peter's feet and died. When the young men came back in, they found Sapphira lying there dead. So they carried her out and buried her beside her husband.

dag: Di tuhiya a sani ni a niŋ a ni zaŋ a nuhi tum tuun shɛli alaka ka lihi ʒiɛm li, ka lee yurila ninvuɣ biɛri ni lo shɛli?.
en: Why do you take such delight in destroying those you created and in smiling on sinners?.

dag: Zunzuya mini daɣiri m-pali n niŋgbuŋ ni, ka n niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ kul mɔri ti puhigira.
en: My flesh is covered with worms and crusted earth; my skin hardens and oozes.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu di simdi ni Naawuni ninvuɣ gahinda bɛn dol Naawuni zaligunima, ka ʒe Yisa yim la mal ania.
en: God's people must learn to endure. They must also obey his commands and have faith in Jesus.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Cham ti yɛli Juda Naa Zɛdɛkia, Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn zaŋla tiŋ ŋɔ niŋ Babilɔn naa nuu ni, ka o nyo li buɣim.
en: to say to King Zedekiah: I am the Lord , and I am going to let Nebuchadnezzar capture this city and burn it down.

dag: Bɛ ni baŋ Naawuni maa zaa yoli: Bɛ bi tir o jilima kaman Naawuni; bɛ mi bi puhir o taalitaali; amaa ka bɛ tɛha zaa naɣ leela tɛhi yoya, ka zibisim zibigi bɛ tɛhi yoya maa ni.
en: They know about God, but they don't honor him or even thank him. Their thoughts are useless, and their stupid minds are in the dark.

dag: Kpiɔŋlan Naa ni daa kari nanim nimaani, o daa chɛ ka sakuɣa lu Zalimɔn Zoli zuɣu na.
en: When Almighty God scattered the kings on Mount Zalmon, he caused snow to fall there.

dag: Ka chɛ ka ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri zaa so buri; ka sokam zaa duh o yee suhi Naawuni viɛnyɛliŋga; ka ŋmaligi ka chɛ o tuumbiɛri soya mini tuumbiɛ shɛŋa o nuhi ni tumda.
en: Let humans and animals alike put on mourning clothes, and let them call upon God forcefully! And let all persons stop their evil behavior and the violence thats under their control.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma yɛl o, Deem piɛsah ayopɔin ŋɔ n nuu ni, ka di wuhi ni a di ma shɛhira ni mani n-daa gbi kɔbiliga ŋɔ.
en: Abraham said, These seven lambs that you take from me will attest that I dug this well.

dag: N ni tooi niŋ shɛlikam zaa Masia ni tiri ma yaa la zuɣu.
en: Christ gives me the strength to face anything.

dag: O daa darig o niriba maa tibili n-chɛ ka bɛ gbahi ba kuli tinduya ni. O suhuyiɣisili puuni, o daa chɛ ka wulimpuhili polo pɔhim kana ti ʒe ba chaŋ.
en: I carefully measured out Israel's punishment and sent the scorching heat to chase them far away.

dag: dindina bɛ niriba ayi bɛn mali yɛtɔɣa maa bɛn cham Yawɛ tooni maligumaaniba mini sariakaritiba bɛn be tuma ni di saha maa sani.
en: then both you and the accused must be taken to the court at the place where the Lord is worshiped. There the priests and judges will find out if you are lying or telling the truth. If you are lying and the accused is innocent.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, o mali buɣim shɛli din yɛn di Asiria naa sɔŋ ka di waɣa. Buɣim maa dari kul pumi, ka doya yɛlim ka zilim pam. Yawɛ ni vuhi o vuhim din ŋmani chilibi bahi di zuɣu, ka di taai buɣim.
en: Long ago the Lord got a place ready for burning the body of the dead king. The place for the fire is deep and wide, the wood is piled high, and the Lord will start the fire by breathing out flaming sulfur.

dag: dama niriba pam ni ti zaŋ n yuli kana ti yɛra, Mani n-nyɛ Masia! Mani n-nyɛ Masia! Ka bɛ ni ti birigi niriba pam.
en: Many will come and claim to be me. They will use my name and fool many people.

dag: Daadam napɔŋ ti ku lan no di ni, ka biŋkɔbiri gba napɔna ti ku lan no di ni. Binvuhirigu ti ku lan be di ni hal ni yuun pihinahi.
en: No human being or animal will walk through it. For forty years nothing will live there.

dag: M mali tahima ni di ku yuui ka n nya a, ka ti nini nya taba ka ti tɔɣisi.
en: I hope to visit you soon. Then we can be together and talk.

dag: Wummi nyaɣisim a ni yuri paɣ so sani a ni mali nyɛvili shɛli din ka buchi dunia puuni ŋɔ, dama dina n-nyɛ a biɛhigu min a dunia ŋɔ ni tuma wahala tarili.
en: Enjoy life with the one you love, as long as you live the useless life that God has given you in this world. Enjoy every useless day of it, because that is all you will get for all your trouble.

dag: O ni daa kul nyɛ Naawuni Bia maa zaa yoli, o daa bɔhim nɔdeebo wahala dibu puuni.
en: Although he was a Son, he learned obedience from what he suffered.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n suhu daa yiɣisi ka n je suli niŋ Juda fɔntinsinim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima, ka chɛ ka di bahi yoli n-leei dabari doya kaman di ni na kul doya shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ.
en: Finally, my anger struck like a raging flood, and today Jerusalem and the towns of Judah are nothing but empty ruins.

dag: Ka pukpara ŋun mi tumdi viɛnyɛliŋga nyɛla ŋun simdi ni o daŋ bindir pala dibu.
en: The farmer who has done the hard work should have the first share of the harvest.

dag: Ŋun pah ata n-daa nyɛ Absalom ŋun ma daa nyɛ Maaka ŋun daa nyɛ Gɛshur naa Talimai bipuɣiŋga la, ŋun pah anahi n-daa nyɛ Adɔnija ŋun ma daa nyɛ Hagit la.
en: the third Absalom son of Maacah, the daughter of Geshurs King Talmai; the fourth Adonijah, Haggiths son.

dag: Ka Naa Ahasivɛrɔs daa yu Ɛsta gari paɣiba maa zaa. Hal o nini daa tiɣ o ka o yur o gari paɣisar bɛn la zaa. Dinzuɣu ka o daa dii zaŋ nam zuɣupiligu pil o n-zaŋ o leei napaɣa n-zali Vashiti zaashee.
en: Xerxes liked Esther more than he did any of the other young women. None of them pleased him as much as she did, and he immediately fell in love with her and crowned her queen in place of Vashti.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ninvuɣ shɛb be kpe ka ku kpi hal ka bɛ nini ti nya Naawuni nam.
en: Believe me when I say that some of you people standing here will see Gods kingdom before you die.

dag: Pool mini Baanabas ni daa be Aikɔnium maa ka bɛ daa ti doli taba chaŋ Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu ti yihi waazu, ka Yɛhudianim mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianim pam daa niŋ yɛda.
en: The same thing happened in Iconium. Paul and Barnabas entered the Jewish synagogue and spoke as they had before. As a result, a huge number of Jews and Greeks believed.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ o piɛma n-to n-wurim ba; ka chɛ ka o saa nyaɣisiri ginda.
en: You scattered your enemies with arrows of lightning.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ sahakam. Ami, ami.
en: Praise the Lord forever! Amen! Amen!.

dag: Amaa paɣ maa yi bi tum daɣiri tuma, ka nyɛla ŋun ka taali, dindina di ku niŋ o shɛli, o ni tooi dɔɣi bihi.
en: But if the woman has not sinned against her husband and she is pure, the priest will say that she is not guilty. Then she will be normal and able to have children.

dag: Ka Kush bidibisi daa nyɛ: Siiba mini Havila ni Sabita ni Raama ni Sabitɛka. Ka Raama bidibisi nyɛ: Shiiba mini Dɛdan.
en: Cushs sons were Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. Raamahs sons were Sheba and Dedan.

dag: Ti Naawuni maa bela zuɣusaa. O ni yu shɛm ka o tumda.
en: Our God is in heaven, and he does whatever he wants.

dag: Ti daa wum di yɛla la Bɛtilihɛm; ti daa nya li la Jiarim mɔɣu ni.
en: We heard about this in Ephrathah. We found the Box of the Agreement at Kiriath Jearim.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ naa maa yoli nti yaɣi, amaa ka o pɔri la mini saamba la zuɣu chɛ ka o bahi noli ni bɛ niŋmi lala.
en: Herod was sorry for what he had said. But he did not want to break the promise he had made in front of his guests. So he ordered a guard.

dag: M pola pɔri ka ʒe di nyaaŋa ni n dol a wuntia zaligunim la.
en: Your laws are fair, and I have given my word to respect them all.

dag: Firawuna chɛchɛbunsi min o tɔbbihi zaa ka o zaŋ niŋ teeku ni, ka o sapashin kpɛma zaa shim Teeku Ʒiɛɣu ni.
en: He threw Egypt's army and its chariots into the sea; the best of its officers were drowned in the Red Sea.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla ŋun be tibi ni ŋun niŋdi din viɛla, dinzuɣu ka o wuhiri alahichinima di soli maa.
en: You are honest and merciful, and you teach sinners how to follow your path.

dag: Yilimiya wumpaɣibo yila paɣi Yawɛ, ka ŋme mɔɣilo paɣi ti Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: Give thanks to the Lord . Praise our God with harps.

dag: Wula ka yi lee yɛn tooi yɛli, Ti mali yɛm, ka Yawɛ zaligunim be ti sani? Zaligubaŋdib ʒirinim zaŋ li leei ʒiri.
en: You keep saying, We have the Lord s teachings. So we are wise! But this is not true, because the scribes have lied with their pens.

dag: Hal Siria tɔbbihi maa ni daa bi galisi maa zaa yoli, Naawuni daa zaŋ tɔbbihi pam niŋ bɛ nuu ni, dama tɔbbihi maa daa nyɛla bɛn zaɣisi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni la. Lala zuɣu ka bɛ daa darigi Jɔash tibili.
en: The Syrian army was very small, but the Lord let them defeat Judah's large army, because he was punishing Joash and the people of Judah for turning away from him.

dag: Ka o daa ti laɣim o tumtumdiba mini bɛn mini ba tuma nyɛ tuun yinsi na nti yɛli ba, M mabihi, yi mi ni ti nyarila liɣiri ti tuma ŋɔ ni.
en: Demetrius had a meeting with these men and some others who did the same kind of work. He told them, Men, you know that we make a lot of money from our business.

dag: Asha zuliya niriba m-bala: Bɛ ni daa sab bɛ ninvuɣ shɛb yuya kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ tuhi pihinunaata ni kɔbisinahi.
en: These clans numbered , men.

dag: Zahimbu na ʒi m-paai ya ka di pala din tatabo pun zahindi niriba; amaa Naawuni kul ʒiɛla yim, ka ku saɣi chɛ ka yi nya zahimbu din yaɣi yi kpiɔŋ tariga; ka yi zahimbu nyabu puuni, o ni mali soli tin ya ka yi nya yaa n-yi di ni ka ku lu.
en: No temptation has seized you that isnt common for people. But God is faithful. He wont allow you to be tempted beyond your abilities. Instead, with the temptation, God will also supply a way out so that you will be able to endure it.

dag: Dapaɣili kam wɔɣilim daa nyɛla mita anahi, ka di yɛliŋ mi nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: Each frame was meters high and centimeters wide.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm mɛmi kaman fɔntin titali din me n-shɛbisi tab ni.
en: Jerusalem is built like a city joined together in unity.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Chɛliya ka ti chaŋ tin shɛŋa din be tooni ŋɔ ha ka n ti yihi waazu nimaani gba; dama di zuɣu ka n kana.
en: Jesus replied, We must go to the nearby towns, so that I can tell the good news to those people. This is why I have come.

dag: Bɛ ni daa zaŋ biŋkɔb shɛb na ni bɛ ti nyo buɣim mali sara maa daa nyɛla naɣilahi pisopɔin mini piɛlahi kɔbiga ni piɛbihi kɔbisiyi. Bɛ zaa daa nyɛla bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ shɛb nyo buɣim mali sara ti Yawɛ.
en: This is how many burnt offerings the assembly brought to the Temple: bulls, rams, and lambs. All these animals were sacrificed as burnt offerings to the Lord .

dag: Yawɛ, hal a ni kul be zuɣusaa ha maa zaa yoli, a baɣa be tarimba ni, amaa a be katiŋ ka chɛ karimbaannima.
en: Even though you are so high above, you care for the lowly, and the proud cannot hide from you.

dag: O ku kabigi gbiŋgbaŋ din dalim. O mi ku kpihi firila mia din diri biɛlabiɛla. O ni wuhi zaligu soli ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: He wont break a bruised reed; he wont extinguish a faint wick, but he will surely bring justice.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam bi deei Naawuni nam kaman bia ni deeri li shɛm ti ku kpe di ni.
en: You will never get into God's kingdom unless you enter it like a child.

dag: Di saha ka bundan maa lan yɛli, N yaba, n suhir a mi ni a tim Lazarɔs m ba yiŋa dunia ni.
en: The rich man said, Then please, father Abraham, send Lazarus to my fathers house on earth.

dag: nti kul be Naawuni jɛmbu duu m-paɣiri Naawuni.
en: and spent all their time in the Temple giving thanks to God.

dag: Wari yi beni o suhu bi zɔhiri o yiŋnim zuɣu, dama o yiŋnim zaa yɛrila situr tibisa.
en: She doesnt fear for her household when it snows, because they are all dressed in warm clothes.

dag: Ka ʒiɛman shɛli din dolina puuni, yi bihi yi ti yiɣisina yi kalinsi nyaaŋa bee saan so yi ti yi tinshee katiŋ na n-nya Yawɛ ni chɛ ka zaɣ biɛ shɛli mini nahiŋgu shɛli paai tiŋgbani maa.
en: In future generations your descendants and foreigners from distant lands will see the disasters and sufferings that the Lord has brought on your land.

dag: ka yi ti bo bɛ bipuɣinsi ti yi bidibisi, ka bɛ bipuɣinsi maa ni ti jɛmdi bɛ buɣa maa, ka yi bidibisi maa gba ti jɛm bɛ buɣa maa.
en: Your sons might marry those foreign women, who would lead them to be unfaithful to me and to worship their pagan gods.

dag: Ka sokam ni ti jɛn ya n yuli zuɣu. Amaa ŋunkam ti niŋ suhukpeeni hal ni wahala ŋɔ bahigu ni ti tiligi.
en: Everyone will hate you because of me. But whoever holds out to the end will be saved.

dag: Nir ni tooi yɛli ni Lɛvi ŋun daa deeri zaka la gba daa be ti yab Ibrahimma ni n-yihi zaka ti Mɛlikizɛdɛk;.
en: Now those from the family of Levi are the ones who get a tenth from the people. But we can say that when Abraham paid Melchizedek a tenth, then Levi also paid it.

dag: Absalom ni daa ti maani sara maa saha shɛli, ka o tim boli Ahitɔfɛl Gilo nir ŋun daa nyɛ Dauda saawarimaana la o ya Gilo na. Ka Absalom ni daa lo nia biɛ shɛli maa kul nyari yaa, ka o kul nyari niriba pahira.
en: And while he was offering sacrifices, Absalom also sent to the town of Gilo for Ahithophel, who was one of King David's advisers. The plot against the king gained strength, and Absalom's followers grew in number.

dag: amaa ka o nini daa bi tiɣi Keen ŋun min o sara maa. Dinzuɣu ka Keen suhu daa yiɣisi pam, ka o zuŋ o ninni.
en: but not with Cain and his offering. This made Cain so angry that he could not hide his feelings.

dag: Ti ni daa be yi sani maa, ti daa bahi ya noli ni ŋun je ni o tum tuma bi simdi ni o di.
en: When we were with you, we gave you this rule: Whoever will not work should not be allowed to eat.

dag: ka bi di bɛ ni zaŋ binshɛŋa mali buɣa zoya zuɣu bee n-jɛm Izraɛlnim buɣa la, ka bi zaŋ o kpee paɣa dɔni.
en: He does not go to the mountains and eat foods offered to false gods. He does not pray to filthy idols in Israel. He does not commit the sin of adultery with his neighbors wife.

dag: Di saha ka n kuhi yɛli, N Duuma NAAWUNI, n suhir a, dim suɣilo. Yaakubu ku be. O pɔri pam.
en: But I said, Lord GOD, stop, I beg you! Jacob cannot survive! He is too small.

dag: Nyini n-zaŋ a yuri siɣi teeku ni, ka fuɣifuɣi pani di ko titali zuɣu.
en: But you marched your horses through the deep water, stirring up the mud.

dag: Zaŋm a bindirigu bahi kom ni, dama di yi niŋ daba ayi, di ni lan lab a sanna yaha.
en: Do good wherever you go. After a while, the good you do will come back to you.

dag: Yi Naawuni yɛliya, Maamiya n niriba suhuri, maamiya bɛ suhuri!.
en: Our God has said: Encourage my people! Give them comfort.

dag: Amaa di zaa yoli, Yawɛ suhu daa na kul bi maai. O suhu daa yiɣisiya pam bahi Judanim zuɣu Manaasa ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa zaa n-chɛ ka o suhu yiɣisi pam la zuɣu.
en: But the Lord did not stop being angry with the people of Judah. He was still angry with them for everything that Manasseh had done.

dag: Ka o ni tooi be tiŋ maa ni hal ka bɛ ti kar o saria palɔni, ka o na kul ni be nimaani hal ni maligumaaniba zuɣulaan so ŋun beni ka o tum tuuni maa kum nyaaŋa, di saha ka o naanyi tooi lab o ya din nyɛ o ni daa zo luɣ shɛli maa ti beni.
en: You may stay in the city until you have received a public trial and until the death of the man who is then the High Priest. Then you may go back home to your own town, from which you had run away.

dag: Di saha ka maligumaaniba maa daa zaŋ Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa ti kpɛhi Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa puuni luɣ kasi zaa kasi shee la nti zali di zaashee chɛrubinim la kpiŋkpama lɔŋni.
en: The priests carried the chest into the most holy place and put it under the winged creatures.

dag: Dinzuɣu miriya ka yi wumdi yi daanabinim mini yi laasabuniŋdiba bee yi zahinzahindiba ni yi baɣisi bee yi bukpahinim bɛn yɛri ya ni yi di jɛm Babilɔn Naa la yɛligu.
en: Do not listen to your prophets or to those who claim they can predict the future, either by dreams or by calling up the spirits of the dead or by magic. They all tell you not to submit to the king of Babylonia.

dag: N firila baɣiri ni, ka n naba ni yɛn tam binshɛli zuɣu kani, m paala kɔbulli ni, ka kɔgbana ŋmɛri ma garita.
en: I have nothing to stand on. I am sinking down, down into the mud. I am in deep water, and the waves are about to cover me.

dag: amaa di zaa yoli, o kul tumdi tuun suma din wuhiri ni o beni. O tiri ya saa ka di chɛ ka yi bindira niŋdi ka yi diri tiɣiri ka mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Nevertheless, he hasnt left himself without a witness. He has blessed you by giving you rain from above as well as seasonal harvests, and satisfying you with food and happiness.

dag: Chinchin tibisi shɛli daa yili di puuni, ka bɛ booni tanti du shɛli din be chinchini maa nyaaŋa mi Luɣ Kasi Zaa Kasi Shee.
en: Behind the second curtain was the tent called the Most Holy Place.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Di yi pala wunsuhigu mini nolɔbo zuɣu so ku tooi kari alizini ŋɔ tatabo.
en: Jesus answered, That kind of spirit can be forced out only with prayer. .

dag: Dama ti ka tin shɛli din ni be hal ni saha din ka bahigu dunia ŋɔ ni, dinzuɣu ti lihiri bɔrila tin shɛli din ti yɛn kana la.
en: On this earth we don't have a city that lasts forever, but we are waiting for such a city.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee bɔŋɔ n-yiɣisi be kaman Nail mɔɣili la, ka be kaman kulibɔna din kpe m-pal la?.
en: Who is coming like the Nile River? Who is coming like that strong, fast river?.

dag: Yinim Izraɛl bipuɣinsi, kummiya Sool zuɣu. Ŋuna n-zaŋ mulifu viɛlli soli ya. Ŋuna n-zaŋ salima yɛri yɛli ya.
en: Daughters of Israel, weep over Saul! He dressed you in crimson with jewels; he decorated your clothes with gold jewelry.

dag: Ka bɛ zuliya ayopɔin daa kpalim ka na bi deei bɛ tiŋgbana tarili.
en: There were still seven tribes of the people of Israel who had not yet been assigned their share of the land.

dag: Kpihimmi bɛ yuya nyɛviyanim litaafi la ni, ka di chɛ ka bɛ sabi bɛ yuya pahi wuntizɔriba yuya ni.
en: Let them be wiped out of the scroll of life! Let them not be recorded along with the righteous!.

dag: Ka o di yɛl a baŋsim ashili yɛtɔɣa! Dama baŋsim mali yaɣa pam. Baŋmi ni Naawuni ni darig a tibili shɛm ŋɔ bi paag a ni tum taali shɛm.
en: He could tell you the secret of wisdom. He would tell you that every story has two sides. You can be sure of this: God is not punishing you as much as he should.

dag: Di saha ka ti daa gari ka chɛ ti mabihi bɛn nyɛ Iso zuliya m-be Ɛdom maa, ka daa chɛ Araba soli bahi nyaaŋa, ka lan chɛ Ɛlat mini Ɛziɔngɛba bahi nyaaŋa. Ti ni daa ŋmaligi n-zaŋ kpa Mɔab yɔɣu polo.
en: So we passed through the territory of our relatives who live in Seir, Esaus descendants, leaving the desert road from Elath and from Ezion-geber. Next we turned and went along the Moab wilderness route.

dag: Dinzuɣu bɛ daa kul teei gilila tiŋ maa hal ti paai Naa Zɛdɛkia nam dibu yuun piniyini saha.
en: The city was under siege until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.

dag: Dama, Yaa n Duuma NAAWUNI, nyini m-pii ba dunia ŋɔ ninsalinim zaa ni ni a su ba kaman a ni daa chɛ ka a dabili Musa yɛl ba shɛm saha shɛli a ni daa yihi ti yaannim maa Ijipti na la.
en: You chose them from all the peoples to be your own people, as you told them through your servant Moses when you brought our ancestors out of Egypt.

dag: Naa Dauda maŋmaŋ daa bol o o Duuma, ka di chaŋ wula ka o ni lan nyɛ ŋun Naa Dauda yaaŋa.
en: David called him Lord; how, then, can the Messiah be David's descendant.

dag: Fɔntinsi ŋɔ zaa daa nyɛla bɛ ni me goon wɔɣila gili tin shɛŋa, ka di mali dunoyɔriti din mali kpiɔŋ ni dunokparitisi m-pahi tiŋkpansi pam zuɣu.
en: All these cities were very strong. They had high walls, gates, and strong bars on the gates. There were also many towns that did not have walls.

dag: Mɔab Naa Mɛsha daa wumsirila piɛri, ka di daa kpala talahi ni o tahiri piɛbihi polo tuhi kɔbiga mini piɛlahi tuhi kɔbiga kɔbiri yuuni kam nti tiri Izraɛl naa.
en: King Mesha of Moab raised sheep, and every year he gave as tribute to the king of Israel , lambs and the wool from , sheep.

dag: dama m mabih anu na beni, ka o chaŋ ti lee saɣisi bɛna, ka bɛn ti ku kana ti kpe azaaba shɛl ni n ni be ŋɔ.
en: I have five brothers. He needs to warn them so that they dont come to this place of agony.

dag: Ka o pirig o chinchini sɔŋ, ka vaai yiɣisi chaŋ Yisa sani.
en: The man threw off his coat as he jumped up and ran to Jesus.

dag: N ni chɛ ka malaika kana ti wuhi ya soli, ka n kari Keenannim mini Amɔrinim ni Hitinim ni Pɛrizinim ni Hivinim ni Jɛbusinima.
en: I will send an angel to guide you, and I will drive out the Canaanites, the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

dag: Malimiya yimaŋ ti Yawɛ. Yinim Judanim mini Jɛrusalɛmnima, gunimiya yi suhuri ni, di yi pa lala n suhu ni yiɣisi bahi yi zuɣu kaman buɣim la n-diri ka so ku tooi kpihi li, yi ni tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa maa zuɣu.
en: Dedicate yourselves to the LORD; dont be thick-skinned, people of Judah and residents of Jerusalem, or else my anger will spread like a wildfire. It will burn, with no one to put it out, because of your evil deeds.

dag: Nyini n-shiri nyɛ n tampiŋ mini m birini; a yuli zuɣu, be n tooni, ka wuhiri ma.
en: You are my refuge and defense; guide me and lead me as you have promised.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, miriya ka yi di binʒim kam yi ni be luɣ shɛli zaa, noonsi ʒim bee biŋkɔbiri ʒim.
en: And no matter where you live, you must not eat the blood of any bird or animal.

dag: dama Yawɛ je tuumbiɛrinima, amaa wuntizɔriba nyɛla o zɔsimnima.
en: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is dishonest, but he lets good people be his friends.

dag: Karimbaannim kul ŋmarila ʒiri pari ma, amaa n dolila a zaligunim ni n suhu zaa.
en: My reputation is being ruined by conceited liars, but with all my heart I follow your teachings.

dag: Yi yi ti suhiri Naawuni, yi boon o la yi Ba. Ŋun Naawuni n-nyɛ sariakarita ŋun kariti sokam zaa yinoyino saria kaman o tuma ni nyɛ shɛm, ka bi yaari so yuri ka chɛ so, dinzuɣu lumiy o sizuura saha shɛli yi ni be dunia ŋɔ ni ŋɔ.
en: You say that God is your Father, but God doesn't have favorites! He judges all people by what they do. So you must honor God while you live as strangers here on earth.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ tuumbiɛri yi palo a sani, ka a niŋ ba kaman a ni niŋ ma shɛm n tuumbiɛri zaa zuɣu ŋɔ. Dama n ŋuhibu maa yaɣiya; ka n suhu saɣim.
en: Look how evil my enemies are! Then you can treat them the same way you treated me because of all my sins. Do this because I am groaning again and again. Do this because my heart is sick.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyin Taai, nyama, m bi ʒe a nyaaŋa. N ni chɛ ka tinsi pam kana ti lir a kaman teeku ni chɛ ka kɔgbana yiɣiri luri shɛm la.
en: Because the people of Tyre have sung that song, I have the following warning for them: I am the Lord God, and I am now your enemy! I will send nations to attack you, like waves crashing against the shore.

dag: Bɛ daa guni ma la daba anii dali. Bɛ dɔɣi ma la Izraɛl nira. N yila Bɛnjamin zuliya ni na ka nyɛ Hiburu alali. Ka zaŋ chaŋ Yɛhudianim zaligunim mi dolibu polo n daa nyɛla Farisii;.
en: I was circumcised when I was eight days old, and I am from the nation of Israel and the tribe of Benjamin. I am a true Hebrew. As a Pharisee, I strictly obeyed the Law of Moses.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim Suɣa Tibu Chuɣu puhibu daa ti mirina.
en: It was time for the Jewish Festival of Shelters.

dag: N ni wurim Ijiptinim kpɛhi zuliya shɛb ni, ka kari ba kpɛhi tiŋgbɔna zaa ni.
en: I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them throughout the earth.

dag: Amaa ka Musa daa boli ba, ka Aduna mini bɛ laɣiŋgu zuɣulaannim zaa daa ka o sanna, ka o ti tɔɣisi ba yɛtɔɣa.
en: But Moses called them, and Aaron and all the leaders of the community went to him, and Moses spoke with them.

dag: Saɣiŋgu! Dabari zanibu! Saɣiŋgu! Niriba suhuri ŋooya, ka bɛ duna ŋmɛri taba, ka bɛ ni sɔhira, ka bɛ nina mɔhi zaa.
en: Nineveh is doomed! Destroyed! Her people tremble with fear; their faces turn pale.

dag: Ka malaika daa yi alizanda ni na ti kpaŋsir o suhu.
en: An angel from heaven appeared to him and strengthened him.

dag: nti kahigi yɛla maa zaa wuhi ba, ka naanyi tim ba Jɔpa maa.
en: He told them what had happened and sent them off to Joppa.

dag: O kpɛrila o tɔɣima Saimɔn ŋun nyɛ gbanzaba, ka o yiŋ baɣi teeku noli la yiŋa.
en: He is a guest of Simon the tanner, whose house is near the seacoast.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ zaŋ o shia ti ma. O tim ma mi ni n zaŋ lahiba suŋ ti ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyari nahiŋgu, ka maai bɛn suhuri saɣim la suhuri; ka yihi bɛn nyɛ daba la dabitim ni; ka yooi bɛn be sarika ni la bahi.
en: The LORD Gods spirit is upon me, because the LORD has anointed me. He has sent me to bring good news to the poor, to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim release for captives, and liberation for prisoners.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa wum n yɛla, bɛ daa paɣi ma mi, ka bɛn nina daa nya ma mi di ma shɛhira.
en: Indeed, the ear that heard blessed me; the eye that looked commended me.

dag: A nyiŋgoli ŋmanila Dauda pii shɛli bɛ ni daa me di kulisi tam tab zuɣu ka nyɔtaɣirisi yiliyil li la. Di zaa daa nyɛla tɔbutuhiriba nyɔtaɣirisi.
en: Your neck is long and thin like Davids tower. That tower was built to be decorated with a thousand shields on its walls, with the shields of powerful soldiers.

dag: Dama ŋuni n-lee be sagbana ni ŋ-ŋmani nyin Yawɛ? Ŋuni n-leei be alizanda ni ŋ-ŋmani nyin Yawɛ?.
en: No one in heaven is equal to the Lord . None of the gods can compare to the Lord .

dag: Hal bɛ ni daa be bɛ nyɛviya ni ka lihi bɛmaŋ suhupiɛlli niriba, ka bɛ paɣiri ba bɛ nasara dibu zuɣu la.
en: Though they consider themselves blessed during their lives, and even thank you when you deal well with them.

dag: Bɛ bi fabindi niŋdi ma ni bɛ suhuri zaa, amaa bɛ dola bɛ bindɔhi zuɣu kuhira. Dama bɛ zaŋ bini ŋma bɛmaŋa bɛ kawana mini bɛ wain zuɣu, ka zaɣisi ma.
en: They don't really pray to me; they just howl in their beds. They have rejected me for Baal and slashed themselves, in the hope that Baal will bless their crops.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔab daa piɛbi kikaa, ka niriba maa kpalim zani ka bi lan kariti doli Izraɛlnim maa bee n-lan tuhiri ba.
en: Joab took his trumpet and blew the signal for his soldiers to stop chasing the soldiers of Israel. At once, the fighting stopped.

dag: A yi shin a noli saha shɛli ti ni be ŋɔ ni, sɔŋsim ni yi luɣ shɛl polo na nti tiligi Yɛhudianima, amaa ka nyin lee kpi ka a ba zuliya kpihim. Bee ŋuni n-ni tooi baŋ ni pa lala zuɣu ka a ʒe a ni ʒe zaashe tital shɛl ni ŋɔ.
en: If you keep quiet at a time like this, help will come from heaven to the Jews, and they will be saved, but you will die and your father's family will come to an end. Yet who knows—maybe it was for a time like this that you were made queen.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yiɣisi gbaai bɛ tuuli chandi kaman Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Musa zali ba shɛm.
en: They began to march at the command of the Lord through Moses.

dag: Yawɛ, m mi ni ninsalinim ni doli so shɛŋa maa, bɛ bi yurimi. Bɛ ni nyɛ daadamnim bɛn mali bahigu zuɣu bɛ ku tooi be viɛnyɛla.
en: Lord , I know that our lives do not belong to us. We have no control over what happens.

dag: Ka Sool daa ti wum ni bɛ nya Dauda mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be o san la. Di saha maa ŋun Sool daa ʒila ti shɛli din yuli booni tamarisik la gbini Gibia Zoli zuɣu, ka o kpani be o nuu ni ka o sapashin kpamba zaa ʒe n-gil o.
en: Saul heard the report about David and his men while sitting under the tree on the hill at Gibeah. Saul had his spear in his hand. All of his officers were standing around him.

dag: Paɣisara maa ni daa laɣimna m-pahi buyi saha shɛli, Mɔdɛkai daa ʒila nayili dunol ni.
en: When the young women were brought together again, Esther's cousin Mordecai had become a palace official.

dag: Dinzuɣu niŋmiya suhukpeeni, dama n niŋ Naawuni yɛda ni o ni chɛ ka o malaika maa yɛli ma shɛm maa shiri ni niŋ pali.
en: So take courage, men! For I trust in God that it will be just as I was told.
