dag: Bɛ ni daa labiri kuna ka Yisa doli ba. O ni daa ti miri sapashini maa yiŋa ka sapashini maa lan tim o zɔnim Yisa sanna ni bɛ ti yɛl o ni o di nahim omaŋa, dama ni ŋun sapashini maa pɔri ni Yisa ka o yiŋ na.
en: So Jesus went with them. When Jesus wasn't far from the house, the officer sent some friends to tell him, Lord, don't go to any trouble for me! I am not good enough for you to come into my house.

dag: Di saha zuɣusaa mini dunia ni binshɛŋa din be di ni ni ti yo vuri, ka mali suhupiɛlli Babilɔn zuɣu, dama bɛn ti yɛn wurim li maa ni ti yila nuzaa polo na. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: when an army attacks from the north and brings destruction. Then the earth and the heavens and everything in them will celebrate.

dag: Ka o daa yaag o noli m-mɔri Naawuni, ka galindi Naawuni yuli min o biɛhigu shee zaŋ tabili bɛnkam be alizanda ni.
en: The beast opened its mouth to insult God—to insult his name, the place where he lives, and all those who live in heaven.

dag: Ka n ni ti kari ba saria bɛ ni zaɣisi ma bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali kam puuni la zuɣu. Bɛ mali maligu ti buɣa, ka jɛm bɛmaŋmaŋ ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali binshɛŋa.
en: I will punish my people because they have sinned; they have abandoned me, have offered sacrifices to other gods, and have made idols and worshiped them.

dag: Di yihi yɛlimaŋli n nol ni hal biɛla gba, dama n tahima bela a zaligunim ni.
en: Please dont take your true word out of my mouth, because I have waited for your rules.

dag: Tuunkpɛmalana ni lo nia shɛŋa nyɛla din tahiri nyamma pam na, amaa ŋunkam bɔri yomyom ni nyari shɛlikam poor o mi.
en: Careful planning leads to profit. Acting too quickly leads to poverty.

dag: n ni chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ takɔbi kun ya. Yi ni ti teei dɔni ka bɛ kun ya. Dama n daa boli ya ka yi zaɣisi, ka tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa ka yi zaɣisi wumbu; amaa ka tumdila tuumbiɛri zaŋ chaŋ n sani, ka dolila n ni je shɛli.
en: It will be your fate to die a violent death, because you did not answer when I called you or listen when I spoke. You chose to disobey me and do evil.

dag: Bɛ ni daa na kul tɔɣisiri lala maa ka Yisa maŋmaŋ dii zani bɛ sunsuuni yɛli ba, Naawuni tim ya suhudoo.
en: While they were saying these things, Jesus himself stood among them and said, Peace be with you.

dag: Malaika maa ni daa ti paai Mariama sani o yɛl o mi, M puhir a nyin ŋun mal alibarika pam ŋɔ, ti Duuma be a sani! A mal alibarika paɣiba ni.
en: The angel came to her and said, Greetings! The Lord is with you; you are very special to him.

dag: ka n leei Yisa Masia tumo bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani ni n zaŋ Naawuni lahibal suŋ tum di tuma kaman maligumaana la, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka Naawuni deei bɛn pa Yɛhudianima kaman sara maligu shɛli din mali be kasi Naawuni Shia Kasi zuɣu.
en: He chose me to be a servant of Christ Jesus for the Gentiles and to do the work of a priest in the service of his good news. God did this so that the Holy Spirit could make the Gentiles into a holy offering, pleasing to him.

dag: Naawuni ŋun nyɛ Kpiɔŋlan Naa ŋɔ ni chɛ ka doo maa ti zɔn ya nambɔɣu, ka zaŋ yi mabi ŋun la mini Bɛnjamin n-tin ya ka yi labina. Ka n yi ni kɔŋ m bihi maa, n kul ni kɔŋ ba mi.
en: When you go in to see the governor, I pray that God All-Powerful will be good to you and that the governor will let your other brother and Benjamin come back home with you. But if I must lose my children, I suppose I must.

dag: Ŋunkam niŋ yɛda ni Yisa nyɛla Masia, dilana nyɛla Naawuni bia, ka ŋunkam yuri ba so ŋun dɔɣi bia ni yur o bia maa gba.
en: Whoever believes that Jesus is the Messiah is a child of God; and whoever loves a father loves his child also.

dag: Amaa ka o ba daa zaɣisi ka yɛli, M bia, m mi ni Manaasa gba zuliya ni ti galisi; amaa o tizo ŋɔ ni ti gar o, ka o zuliya ni ti galisi pam.
en: But his father refused and said, I know, my son, I know. Hell become a people too, and hell also be great. But his younger brother will be greater than he will, and his descendants will become many nations.

dag: dindina a ni baŋ Yawɛ zɔbu ni nyɛ shɛm, ka nya baŋsim din nyɛ Naawuni dini.
en: Then you will understand the fear of the LORD, and discover the knowledge of God.

dag: N suhir o ni o neei yi tɛha ka yi nya o neesim, ka di chɛ ka yi baŋ o ni boli ya tahima shɛli zuɣu min o ni lo o niriba alahiziba alibarika shɛŋa alikaulinim la.
en: I ask that your minds may be opened to see his light, so that you will know what is the hope to which he has called you, how rich are the wonderful blessings he promises his people.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, Yilimiya yila pampam ni suhupiɛlli ti Yaakubu, ka duhiya yi yee m-paɣi ŋuna ŋun nyɛ zuliya kam naa ŋɔ. Molimiya, ka paɣimiy o yɛra, Yawɛ, tiligim a niriba Izraɛlnim bɛn kpalim ŋɔ.
en: This is what the Lord says: Be happy and sing for Jacob! Shout for Israel, the greatest of the nations! Sing your praises and shout: Lord , save your people! Save those who are left alive from the nation of Israel.

dag: Ŋun daa yɛli zaŋ chaŋ o banim min o manim polo, M bi lihi nya ba. O daa zaɣisi o mabihi, ka zaɣisi o bihi. Dama bɛ nyɛla bɛn dol a yɛligu, ka gbib a daalikauli.
en: the one who said of his own mother and father: I dont consider them as such; of their siblings: I dont recognize them; of their own children, I dont know them— but who obeyed your words and who guarded your covenant!.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ n-nyɛ alikauli shɛli n ni ti yɛn lo ba, saha shɛli n yi ti kpihim bɛ daalahichi.
en: This is what the Lord has promised to do when he forgives their sins.

dag: Amaa pumpɔŋɔ, nyini Ayuba, wummi n yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ, ka gbilisi tibili wum n yɛtɔɣa maa zaa.
en: Now, Job, listen to me. Listen carefully to what I say.

dag: Amaa nyin Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ, niŋmi dimbɔŋɔ ti ma a yuli zuɣu. Fam ma bahi, dama a yurilim maŋli la viɛla.
en: My Lord GOD, treat me in a way that brings honor to your name. Save me because of your faithful love.

dag: ni Taanak naa ni Mɛgido naa.
en: the king of Taanach one.

dag: Teeku dulinim nyaya ka dabiɛm kpe ba, ka dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam nim niŋgbuna sɔhira, ka bɛ kab laɣimna.
en: The people of distant lands have seen what I have done; they are frightened and tremble with fear. So they all assemble and come.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa yɛli Dauda, M bia Dauda, Naawuni niŋm alibarika niŋ a ni. A ni ti tum tuma pam, ka di nasara di tumbu ni. Ka Dauda daa chaŋ o chandi, ka Sool mi ŋmaligi kuli.
en: Then Saul said to David, God bless you, David my son. You will do great things and you will win. David went on his way, and Saul went back home.

dag: Izraɛlnim pin shɛŋa zaa din be kasi puuni bɛ ni zaŋ pin shɛlikam ti maligumaana, di nyɛla o dini.
en: When you make a donation to the sacred tent, that money belongs only to the priest, and each priest will keep what is given to him.

dag: Chɛ ka Izraɛlnim puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu di puhibu saha.
en: Tell the Israelites to celebrate Passover at the chosen time.

dag: Nyamiya, bɛ bi zaŋ o ʒim kpe luɣ kasi shee na, di di kul simdi ni yi ŋub li luɣ kasi ŋɔ shee kaman n ni daa zali shɛm la.
en: Since its blood wasnt brought into the sanctuarys interior, you were to have eaten it in the sanctuary, just as I was commanded.

dag: Ti mi doo ŋɔ ni yi shɛl na, amaa Masia ŋun yi ti yi palo, so ku mi o ni yi shɛl na.
en: We know where he is from, but when the Christ comes, no one will know where he is from.

dag: Amaa m bi zaŋ Naawuni ni zali zaligu shɛli ŋɔ tumdi di tuma bee n sabiri gbaŋ ŋɔ tiri ya mi ni n deei shɛli yi sani, dama m paɣiya ni n kpi n-gari ni so niŋ ma shɛli din ni chɛ ka n kɔŋ n ni yɛn nyu bara shɛli zuɣu.
en: But I havent taken advantage of this. And Im not writing this so that it will be done for me. Its better for me to die than to lose my right to brag about this!.

dag: Faralan tɔɣisirila yɛtɔɣa ni sizuura lubu, amaa bundan ŋun kul tuhirimi bahira.
en: The poor plead for help, but the wealthy answer harshly.

dag: Dama alahichi tumbu yɔri nyɛla kum, amaa Naawuni pini nyɛla nyɛvili din ka bahigu ti Duuma Yisa Masia zuɣu.
en: When people sin, they earn what sin pays—death. But God gives his people a free gift—eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

dag: Yawɛ kukoli vuri be teeku kom zuɣu; Naawuni ŋun nyɛ jilimalan ŋɔ n-tahiri maa, Yawɛ m-be ko titali maa zuɣu maa.
en: The Lord s voice can be heard over the sea. The voice of our glorious Lord God is like thunder over the great ocean.

dag: ka o mi o ni yɛn niŋ shɛm zaŋ salima mini anzinfa ni daanya mali binyɛra.
en: He will be able to create designs, do metalwork in gold, silver, and copper.

dag: Miri ka a zabiri alahichinim nyuli, amaa kul jɛmmila Yawɛ.
en: Dont let your heart envy sinners, but fear the LORD constantly.

dag: N ni chɛ ka yi tihi wali, ka yi puri ni bindira niŋ pam din ni chɛ ka kum ku lan lu yi zuɣu ka yi di vi zuliya shɛb sani.
en: I will give you large crops of fruit from your trees and the harvest from your fields so that you will never again feel the shame of being hungry in a foreign country.

dag: Ka Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa daa shiri niŋ lala n-kpuɣi paɣiba wawariba maa ni saɣisi bɛ kalinli tariga n-ʒi ba lab kuli bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgban ni nti lab me bɛ tinsi ʒini di ni yaha.
en: The Benjaminites did this; each of them chose a wife from the young women who were dancing at Shiloh and carried her away. Then they went back to their own territory, rebuilt their towns, and lived there.

dag: Dinzuɣu bin ata ŋɔ m-beni, dina n-nyɛ: Yɛda mini tahima ni yurilim, ka din gari di zaa nyɛla yurilim.
en: So these three things continue: faith, hope, and love. And the greatest of these is love.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Zaŋm a nuu gbaag o zuli, ka o daa zaŋ o nuu gbaag o zuli maa, ka di lan leei jaaŋgbee o nuu ni.
en: but the Lord said to him, Reach out and grab the snake by its tail. When Moses reached out and caught the snakes tail, the snake became a walking stick again.

dag: Bɛ daa ba o bandi n-ti o naba biɛrim, ka zaŋ kuriti ga o nyiŋgol ni.
en: Josephs feet hurt in his shackles; his neck was in an iron collar.

dag: Ɛlizabɛt ni daa wum Mariama puhigu maa ka ŋun Ɛlizabɛt bia dam o pul ni, ka Shia Kasi daa pali Ɛlizabɛt.
en: When Elizabeth heard Mary's greeting, her baby moved within her. The Holy Spirit came upon Elizabeth.

dag: Amaa Izraɛlnim ni daa yi Ijipti maa na, bɛ daa kpɛla yɔɣu ni chaŋ na hal ti paai Teeku Ʒiɛɣu n-gbaai li du n-ka Kadɛshi na.
en: This is what happened: when the Israelites left Egypt, they went through the desert to the Gulf of Aqaba and came to Kadesh.

dag: Yɛlim yɛm, N tizɔpaɣa n-nyɛ a. Ka boli tɛhi zilima mi N zɔsimo.
en: Let wisdom be your sister and make common sense your closest friend.

dag: Noombihi shɛb yi ni yɛn chihiri dibu m-bɔŋɔ: Di bi simdi ni yi di ba; bɛ nyɛla yi ni chihiri shɛb dibu. Bɛna n-nyɛ: tɔrili mini juɣu ni zinyaarigu.
en: You must not eat any of the following birds: eagles, owls, hawks, falcons; buzzards, vultures, crows; ostriches; seagulls, storks, herons, pelicans, cormorants; hoopoes; or bats.

dag: Bɔzuɣu ka zuliya kam lɔri duŋ taabo nia, ka zuliya kam lɔri nia biɛri din ka buchi?.
en: Why do the nations plan rebellion? Why do people make their useless plots?.

dag: ni bɛ ni daa she binyɛr viɛl shɛŋa ni bɛ yɛri tumdi tuma luɣ kasi shee la mini binyɛr kasi shɛŋa bɛ ni daa she n-ti Aduna ŋun nyɛ maligumaana la min o bidibisi ni bɛ tumdi maligumaaniba tuma la.
en: and the magnificent garments the priests were to wear in the Holy Place—the sacred clothes for Aaron the priest and for his sons.

dag: Di saha Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni ti kpihim kum birili, ka nyahi sokam zaa nintam, ka vuui o niriba ni nyari filiŋ shɛl la dunia ŋɔ ni zaa. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: He will swallow up death forever. The LORD God will wipe tears from every face; he will remove his peoples disgrace from off the whole earth, for the LORD has spoken.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka chɛrubinim la daa wuɣi bɛ kpiŋkpama mini din daa baɣi ba la zuɣusaa, ka Izraɛl Naawuni jilima daa be bɛ zuɣusaa.
en: Then the winged creatures raised their wings. The wheels were next to them, and the glory of Israels God was above them.

dag: Viri ni ti te bɛ tɛri nimaani n-nye gala wɔɣi, ka dihiri bɛ bihi maa nimaani. Juri gba ni ti laɣindi nimaani.
en: There the snake will nest and lay eggs and brood and hatch in its shadow. There too vultures will gather, each with its mate.

dag: Ŋuna n-daa tiligi ti ka boli ti ni di chɛ ka ti be kasi, ka di pala ti ni tum shɛli zuɣu, amaa di nyɛla omaŋmaŋ ni lo shɛm min o daanfaan shɛl o ni daa pun niŋ niŋ ti ni Yisa Masia zuɣu ʒiɛmana din gari la ni ha la zuɣu.
en: He saved us and called us to be his own people, not because of what we have done, but because of his own purpose and grace. He gave us this grace by means of Christ Jesus before the beginning of time.

dag: Malimiya firilanim ayopɔin tam di zuɣu, ka di ne di tooni.
en: The lamp on the top and those at the end of each of its six branches must be made so as to shine toward the front of the lampstand.

dag: Paɣisarili maa daa viɛl pam, ka lan nyɛ paɣipiɛliga ŋun mini doo na bi dɔni. Ka o daa chaŋ kɔbiliga maa ni nti ŋɔŋ kom du na.
en: She was very pretty. She was a virgin; no man had ever had sexual relations with her. She went down to the well and filled her jar.

dag: Amaa ka Naawuni daa ka Abimilɛk sanna zahindi puuni yuŋ ti yɛl o, Nyama, a nyɛla kpima, a ni kpuɣi paɣ so la na zuɣu; dama o nyɛla do so paɣa.
en: But God came to Abimelech in a dream and said, You have taken a married woman into your home, and for this you will die.

dag: O zaŋ m malibu chaŋ katiŋa ka chɛ ma, ka n leei sana bɛn daa mi ma la zaa sani.
en: God has turned relatives and friends against me.

dag: Ka bɛ daa chɛ ka bɛ bihi mini bɛ niɣi ni bɛn ʒiri bɛ nɛma be tooni, ka bɛ ŋmaligi doli.
en: from the tribe of Dan. Then they turned and left, after putting their children, their cattle, and the rest of their other possessions in front.

dag: Bɛ yi darigi ansarisimaana tibili, bɛn bi mi leerila yɛnnima, bɛ yi wuhi yɛnnim shɛli, bɛ baŋsim pahirimi.
en: An ignorant fool learns by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being instructed.

dag: Di sabi Yisa maa yɛla Naawuni Kundi ni yɛli: Kuɣ shɛli yinim tammɛriba ŋɔ ni daa zaɣisi la n-yipa leei kuɣ gahindili.
en: This Jesus is the stone you builders rejected; he has become the cornerstone!.

dag: Ka Yisa min o nyaandoliba daa chaŋ luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Gɛtsɛmani la ka o ti yɛli ba, Ʒinimiya kpe ka n chaŋ ti suhi Naawuni.
en: Jesus and his disciples came to a place called Gethsemane. Jesus said to them, Sit here while I pray.

dag: Ka malaika maa yɛl o, Miri ka a zaŋ a nuu shihi bia maa bee n-niŋ o shɛli; dama pumpɔŋɔ m baŋya ni a shiri zɔri Naawuni hal ka bi mɔŋ o a bigaŋ ŋɔ.
en: Don't hurt the boy or harm him in any way! the angel said. Now I know that you truly obey God, because you were willing to offer him your only son.

dag: Ka niriba maa zaa garigi yɛli, O ʒim yihibu kpalimmi ʒi ti mini ti bihi zuɣu.
en: The people answered, We will take full responsibility for his death. You can blame us and even our children.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma lan yɛli, N na kul bɔri ni n yɛli n Duuma shɛli pahi. Ka a yi ti nyala wuntizɔriba pisi nimaani? Ka o garigi yɛli, Wuntizɔriba pisi maa zuɣu, n ku saɣim tiŋ maa.
en: Abraham said, Please forgive my boldness in continuing to speak to you, Lord. Suppose that only twenty are found? He said, I will not destroy the city if I find twenty.

dag: Dama yi ni ti bemi kaman oki ti shɛli din vari suui, ka be kaman mahili ni ka pu shɛl ni.
en: because you will be like an oak tree whose leaves are dying. You will be like a garden dying without water.

dag: Ŋuni n-daa lee wuhi Naawuni o soli ni nyɛ shɛm, bee ŋuni n-lee ni tooi yɛli Naawuni, A tum gala?.
en: No one can tell God what to do or accuse him of doing evil.

dag: Ka n chɛ ka Izraɛlnim zaa daadambiɛligu nabi, ka niriba ʒini yi fɔntinsi ni, ka yi lab me luɣ shɛŋa din daa bahi yol la.
en: The people of Israel will return and rebuild your ruined towns and live in them.

dag: Ka maligumaana zaŋ o nubil suɣi ʒim maa n-zaŋ li vie binyila din be bɛ ni nyɔri sara maligu buɣim bimbin shɛli zuɣu la, ka kpaai ʒi shɛli din kpalim bahi bɛ ni zaŋdi sara maligu nyɔri buɣim sara maligu bimbin shɛli zuɣu la naba zaashee.
en: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood of the animal, put it on the projections at the corners of the altar, and pour out the rest of it at the base of the altar.

dag: Ka o yi ka mabihi bɛn nyɛ dɔbba, yin zaŋmiy o fali maa ti o ba mabihi bɛn nyɛ dɔbba.
en: If he doesnt have any brothers, you should give his inheritance to his fathers brothers.

dag: M mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa chaŋ chandi maa bɛn daa chɛ ka dabiɛm kpɛla Izraɛlnima, amaa ka man daa kul ʒe Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ yim.
en: The other spies said things that made our people afraid, but I completely trusted the Lord God.

dag: Bɛ daa leela zoomba n-dari gindi soya zuɣu, ka ʒim varim ba hal ka so ti ku tooi shihi bɛ binyɛra.
en: The prophets and priests walked around like blind men in the streets. They had become dirty with blood. No one could even touch their clothes because they were dirty.

dag: Yidaannima, yumiya yi paɣiba kaman Masia ni yuri cheechi maa ka zaŋ omaŋ pa talima di zuɣu shɛm la.
en: A husband should love his wife as much as Christ loved the church and gave his life for it.

dag: Ka Adɔram daa nyɛ ŋun su tumtumdiba fukumsi; ka Ahilud bia Jɛhɔshafat daa nyɛ ŋun su gbana sabbu fukumsi.
en: Adoniram led the men who were forced to do hard work. Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was the historian.

dag: Dama nyama, mani ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ mi ni n daa tum taali, dinzuɣu ka mani n-nyɛ ŋun daŋ yi Yisifu zuliya ni kana ni n ti tuhi nyini n dan naa soli maa.
en: I know that I sinned. That is why today I am the first person from Josephs family to come down and meet you, my lord and king.

dag: Ka Jɛhɔshafat daa ti kani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o o yab Dauda tiŋ la ni; ka o bia Jɛhɔram daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Jehoshaphat died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Jehoram became king.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ba ka bɛ be Mɔab naa maa sani saha shɛli zaa ŋun Dauda ni daa be vokabili maa ni maa.
en: So David left his parents with the king of Moab, and they stayed there as long as David was hiding out in the cave.

dag: Naawuni ni daa ti yɛn tim o Bikpɛm la dunia ŋɔ ni na o daa yɛlimi: Naawuni malaikanim zaa, jɛmmiy o.
en: And then, when God presents his firstborn Son to the world, he says, Let all Gods angels worship him.

dag: A nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tɛhi ni bɛ mali yɛm la? Jɛra mali tahima pam gari ba.
en: There is more hope for a fool than for someone who says, I'm really smart.

dag: Babilɔn wuna bahigu m-bɔŋɔ! Bɛl mini Nɛbo daa nyɛla bɛ ni jɛmdi wun shɛŋa. Amaa pumpɔŋɔ bɛ zaŋ li ʒilila bunsi; ka di nyɛ ʒi shɛŋa din chɛ ka di wum bunsi maa.
en: This is the end for Babylon's gods! Bel and Nebo once were worshiped, but now they are loaded on donkeys, a burden for the backs of tired animals.

dag: Sɛrug ni daa ti paai yuun pihita saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Nahɔr.
en: When Serug was years old, he had a son, Nahor;.

dag: N ni ti chɛ ka kpiɔŋnim zaŋ takɔbiri na ti ku a tɔbbihi. Bɛ zaa ni ti nyɛla zuliya kam ni ninvuɣ biɛri. Bɛ ni ti saɣim Ijiptinim ni mali binshɛŋa nyuri bara la, ka ku bɛ tɔbbihi zaa.
en: I will use those soldiers to kill your people in battle. They come from the most terrible of the nations. They will destroy the things Egypt is proud of. The people of Egypt will be destroyed.

dag: Dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛli ni bɛ mali baŋsim maa birigiya ka chɛ yɛda niŋbu soli. Naawuni daalibarika kpalimmi be yi ni!.
en: Some people who claim to have that knowledge have gone completely away from what we believe. Gods grace be with you all.

dag: Timiya pini, ka Naawuni ti yi gba; ka yi ni yɛn deei shɛli maa ni pali yi nuhi hal ti puuri bahira; dama yi ni zahindi binyara shɛm tiri yi taba, lala ka Naawuni ni ti zahim ti yi gba.
en: Give to others, and you will receive. You will be given much. It will be poured into your hands—more than you can hold. You will be given so much that it will spill into your lap. The way you give to others is the way God will give to you.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli ma ni bɛn daa tiligi ka bɛ bi gbahi ba daba maa be muɣisigu ni pam ni vi ni bɛ yaɣili maa ni, ka Jɛrusalɛm gooni la lu, ka buɣim di di dunɔdaya.
en: They told me, Those captives who have come back are having all kinds of troubles. They are terribly disgraced, Jerusalem's walls are broken down, and its gates have been burned.

dag: Ka bɛ daa go n-gili di tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa n-daa mali ti paai tin shɛli din yuli booni Pafɔs. Nimaani ka bɛ daa chirigi do so ŋun nyɛ bukpaha ka o yuli booni Baajiisɛs. O daa nyɛla Yɛhudia nira ŋun nyɛ anab ʒirilana.
en: They went across the whole island to the city of Paphos. There they met a Jewish man named Barjesus who did magic. He was a false prophet.

dag: Amaa Masia daa zaŋ omaŋ pa talima n-fa ti fukumsi zaligu noli din daa doli ti la ni bahi, o ni daa zani ti zaani n-chɛ ka noli di o ti zuɣu la puuni, dama di sabiya: Noli di bɛ ni zaŋ sokam yili tia.
en: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the Law by becoming a curse for us—because it is written, Everyone who is hung on a tree is cursed .

dag: Kum dimbu yiko nyɛla alahichi; ka alahichi yiko nyɛ zaligu.
en: Deaths sting is sin, and the power of sin is the Law.

dag: Dama bɛ tɛhi bɛ ni niŋ shɛm yɛla, ka zo n-yi bɛ ni tumdi tuumbiɛ shɛŋa zaa maa ni, biɛhiŋ kani, bɛ ni be, bɛ ku kpi.
en: They saw how wicked they were and came back to me. They stopped doing the evil things they did in the past. So they will live! They will not die.

dag: Ka di daa chɛ ka Anabi Jɛrimia ni daa yɛli shɛm la niŋ pali. O ni daa yɛli shɛm maa m-bɔŋɔ, Bɛ zaŋ anzinfa kpil pihita shɛli Izraɛlnim shɛb ni daa zal o daa shɛm la.
en: Then what the prophet Jeremiah had said came true: They took the thirty silver coins, the amount the people of Israel had agreed to pay for him.

dag: N di yuya ni bɛ zaŋ n nahiŋgu ŋɔ mini n suhusaɣiŋgu ŋɔ pa sania zuɣu zahim li.
en: It's impossible to weigh my misery and grief!.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, a nyɛla Yɛlimaŋlilana, amaa ti nyɛla bɛn tiligi ka kpalim kaman di ni nyɛ shɛm pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ. Tinima n-ʒe a tooni ni ti taali maa hal so ni ku tooi zani a tooni lala maa zaa yoli.
en: Lord God of Israel, you are just, but you have let us survive. We confess our guilt to you; we have no right to come into your presence.

dag: Bɛn nyari nahiŋgu mini nandaamba ni be di ni chani gindi ka mali bɛ naba nɔri li.
en: Then poor and humble people will walk on those ruins.

dag: Ka n chaŋ hal ti paai teeku maa puuni zolɔna ni m-mal hal ti paai luɣ shɛli din dunoya nyɛ din yo n-kpari ʒiɛya hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Amaa, yaa Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ, ka a yihi ma bɔɣ zilinli maa ni na ni nyɛvili.
en: I was at the bottom of the sea, the place where the mountains begin. I thought I was locked in this prison forever, but the Lord my God took me out of my grave. God, you gave me life again!.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be Ishimail sani maa ni daa nya Karia bia Jɔhanan ka tɔbbihi sapashin kpamba zaa be o sani, bɛ suhuri daa paligimi.
en: When all those taken by Ishmael at Mizpah saw Johanan, Kareahs son, and all his army officers with him, they were delighted.

dag: di bahi bamdi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli bɛ niŋgbuŋ kɔre daɣiri tuma soli ka ʒiɛm Naawuni fukumsi subu la. Karimba ʒirinim ŋɔ nyɛla suhukpeendaannima ni bɛn duhiri bɛmaŋa. Bɛ bi zɔri ni bɛ tu bɛn mali jilima be alizanda ni la, amaa ka naɣ lee ʒiɛmdi ba mi.
en: The Lord is especially hard on people who disobey him and don't think of anything except their own filthy desires. They are reckless and proud and are not afraid of cursing the glorious beings in heaven.

dag: Di ni simdi ni o niŋ naɣilaa maa shɛm m-bala, kaman o ni yɛn niŋ alahichi sanyoo naɣilaa la shɛm, di simdi ka o niŋ naɣilaa ŋɔ gba lala, ka maligumaana maa ti zaŋ li yo bɛ daalahichi maa samli, ka bɛ daalahichi maa kpihim.
en: He shall do the same thing with this bull as he does with the bull for the sin offering, and in this way he shall make the sacrifice for the people's sin, and they will be forgiven.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa bɔhi Lɔt, A mali ninvuɣ shɛb yaŋɔ pahi? A bidibisi min a bipuɣinsi ni a deennim bee a dɔɣiriba shɛb yi be yaŋɔ, nyin cham ti zaŋ ba yi yaŋɔ.
en: The men said to Lot, Whos still with you here? Take away from this place your sons-in-law, your sons, your daughters, and everyone else you have in the city.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ gbinni lee nyɛ wula? N ni suhi Naawuni n shia ni, ka lan suhi Naawuni m milinsi ni; n ni yili yila n shia ni, ka lan yili yila m milinsi ni gba.
en: Then what should I do? There are times when I should pray with my spirit, and times when I should pray with my mind. Sometimes I should sing with my spirit, and at other times I should sing with my mind.

dag: Ka Yawɛ bɔh o, Di simdi ni a chɛ ka a suhu yiɣisi.
en: The LORD responded, Is your anger a good thing.

dag: Ninvuɣ pia n-yi kpalim be yili yin ni, bɛ ni kpi.
en: If there are ten men left in a family, they will die.

dag: Yawɛ darigi n tibili pam, amaa o bi chɛ ka n kpi.
en: He has punished me severely, but he has not let me die.

dag: Ka Naawuni zaligubaŋdi so daa kana nti yɛl o, Karimba, n ni dol a chaŋ a ni chani luɣ shɛlikam zaa.
en: A legal expert came and said to him, Teacher, Ill follow you wherever you go.

dag: Yawɛ nini yi tiɣi ti, o ni zaŋ ti tahi tiŋgban shɛli din vuhiri maa ni nti zaŋ li ti ti.
en: If the LORD is pleased with us, hell bring us into this land and give it to us. Its a land thats full of milk and honey.

dag: Ka lan yɛli, Nyama, a biɛli Ɛlizabɛt so bɛ ni yi booni paɣiŋoo la gba mali pua o ninkurilim ŋɔ ni; di chira ayɔbu m-bɔŋɔ;.
en: And heres something else: Your relative Elizabeth is pregnant. She is very old, but she is going to have a son. Everyone thought she could not have a baby, but she has been pregnant now for six months.

dag: Naɣ kara bɛba ayopɔin la gbinni nyɛla yuma ayopɔin, ka kawaan kar ayopɔin la gba gbinni nyɛla yuma ayopɔin; zahindi maa kul nyɛla zaɣ yini.
en: The seven good cows and the seven good heads of grain are seven good years.

dag: So miri ka o ʒiɛm o, ka chɛliya ka o ti yi yi sani ni suhudoo lab n sanna, dama n kul lihirila o mini ti mabihi la soli.
en: No one should look down on him, but you must help him continue his trip in peace, so that he will come back to me; for I am expecting him back with the believers.

dag: Bee di yi pa lala, nyin chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒi kpe ŋɔ wuhi bɛ ni daa nya ka jintɔriba la vihi ma n-nya n ni daa tum shɛli ka di bi tuhi.
en: Or let these who are here tell what crime they found me guilty of when I stood before the Council—.

dag: Naawuni nyɛla shia, ka di niŋ kamaata ni bɛn jɛmd o, jɛmd o ni bɛ shihi ni yɛlimaŋli.
en: God is Spirit, and only by the power of his Spirit can people worship him as he really is.

dag: Bɛ yi niŋ lala, bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ daazichi maa zali tanza kpeeni n-gu dahin shɛli; ka di chɛ ka bɛ tooi vili n-gbib nyɛvili din nyɛ nyɛvili maŋli la.
en: In this way they will store up for themselves a treasure which will be a solid foundation for the future. And then they will be able to win the life which is true life.

dag: ni o ni yihi Sool nam ni ka zaŋ ŋun Dauda ʒili nam gbandi maa zuɣu, ka o su Judanim mini Izraɛlnim zaa, zaŋ Dan hal ti kpa Bɛrishiiba la niŋ pali, Naawuni ŋun darigim n tibili, hal ŋun darigim n tibili pam gba.
en: removing the kingdom from Sauls house and securing Davids throne over Israel and over Judah, from Dan all the way to Beer-sheba.

dag: A du zoli din du pam zuɣu ka zaŋ daba pam mali chaŋ; ka deei pina niriba sani hal zaŋ tabili ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ duŋtaariba bɛn je ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ be nimaani la sani.
en: You went up to your high place, leading a parade of captives. You received gifts from people, even those who turned against you. The Lord God went up there to live.

dag: Yi ni tooi zani Naawuni zaani n-tɔɣisi ʒiri yɛtɔɣa, bee n-zan o zaani tɔɣisi yɔhiŋ yɛtɔɣa?.
en: Will you speak lies for God? Do you really believe your lies are what God wants you to say?.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa o ni ti chaŋ ti liri zuliya shɛb bɛn ʒi m-baɣi teeku la n-tuhi nyaŋ bɛ pam. Amaa tinshee sapashin so ni ti kana ti nyaŋ o n-chɛ ka o karimbaani maa zan tariga. Yɛlimaŋli, o shiri ni ti labis o karimbaani maa yɛl biɛri ʒil o.
en: He will turn his face to the coastlands, capturing many people. A commander will put an end to his disgrace, even though he wont repay that disgrace.

dag: Ka Dauda daa garigi yɛli Mikal, Yawɛ ŋun daa pii ma ka duhi ma gar a ba min o yiŋnim zaa, ka zaŋ ma leei nabia ni n su Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ ŋun Yawɛ niriba ŋɔ tooni ka n di wari waa maa, ka di simdi ni m mali suhupiɛlli Yawɛ tooni.
en: David told her, The Lord didn't choose your father or anyone else in your family to be the leader of his people. The Lord chose me, and I was celebrating in honor of him.

dag: Ibrahimma daa lan kpuɣi paɣ so. O yuli n-daa booni Kɛtuura.
en: Abraham married another wife, named Keturah.

dag: Lala zuɣu ka Yisa gba daa kpi tin tariga ni o zaŋ omaŋmaŋ ʒim mali niriba ka bɛ be kasi.
en: And so Jesus also suffered outside the city gate to make the people holy with his own blood.

dag: Paɣ kam ŋun nyɛ sɔnya, yin kum o.
en: You must not allow any woman to do evil magic. If she does magic, you must not let her live.

dag: ni yi doli niriba ŋɔ tatabo niŋsim maa mini ŋunkam pahi bɛ zuɣu tumdi bɛ ni tumdi shɛm maa naba.
en: So accept the authority of people like them and of anyone who cooperates and works hard.

dag: Dinzuɣu malaikanim lee nyɛla bɔ? Bɛ nyɛla shihi bɛn jɛmdi Naawuni, ka lan nyɛ o ni timdi shɛb ka bɛ ti sɔŋdi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yɛn nyari tiliginsim.
en: What are the angels, then? They are spirits who serve God and are sent by him to help those who are to receive salvation.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka salo maa zaa daa pii bɛ ni ninvuɣ tuhi pinaayi bɛn mali suhukpeeni n-tim ba ka yɛli ba, Zaŋmiya takɔbiri chaŋ ti ku Jabɛshigiliadnima, hal kumiya paɣiba mini bihi gba.
en: So the assembly sent twelve thousand of their bravest men with the orders, Go and kill everyone in Jabesh, including women and children.

dag: Yɛhudianima adiini kali soli dolibu puuni kɔsins ayɔbu daa ʒe nimaani bɛ ni paɣibu zuɣu, ka di zaa zaɣ yiniyini daa naan tooi deei ko guŋgɔna ayɔbuyɔbu bee ayopɔinpɔin.
en: There were six large stone waterpots there that were used by the Jews in their washing ceremonies. Each one held about or gallons.

dag: Di saha maa zuliya pam ni ti zo n-ka Yawɛ sanna nti leeg o niriba. Ka ŋun Yawɛ ni be yi sani, ka yi baŋ ni ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-shiri tim ma yi sanna maa.
en: When he does, many nations will turn to him and become his people. At that time you will know that I am a prophet of the Lord All-Powerful.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli anabi Jɛrimia.
en: Then the Lord , the God of Israel, told me.

dag: Di saha bɛ ni ti baŋ ni man Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ Naawuni, n ni daa chɛ ka bɛ gbahi ba chaŋ, ka n lan zaŋ ba labisi bɛmaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni na la zuɣu. N ku chɛ bɛ ni so bahi.
en: Then my people will know that I am the Lord their God. They will know this, because I sent them into captivity and now gather them and bring them back into their own land, not leaving even one of them behind.

dag: Ka n yi vuɣi ba, di nyaaŋa n ni lan zo ba nambɔɣu, ka zaŋ bɛ zaa labisi bɛmaŋmaŋ ni su tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni.
en: But after I pull them up out of their land, I will feel sorry for them. I will bring each family back to its own property and to its own land.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔh o, Ka shihir bɔ ka a yɛn wuhi ka ti nya ka niŋ a yɛda? Alahiziba tuun bɔ ka a lee tumda?.
en: So the people asked, What miraculous sign will you do for us? If we can see you do a miracle, then we will believe you. What will you do?.

dag: M pun zaŋ n naa maa ʒili Ziɔn din nyɛ n zo kasi la zuɣu.
en: On Zion, my sacred hill, he says, I have installed my king.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ni yɛn zaŋ kuruwa shɛli zahindi biŋkuma mini yi ni yɛn zaŋ binshɛli zahindi binshɛŋa din nyɛ zaɣ kom saɣila taba. Kuruwa pia n-nyɛ tahili. Tahili n-nyɛ sokam ni yɛn zaŋdi shɛli zahindi binyara.
en: The ephah will be the standard dry measure, and the bath will be the standard liquid measure. Their size will be based on the homer , which will equal ten ephahs or ten baths .

dag: Naawuni daa tum alahiziba tuun gahinda n-chɛ ka yiko be Pool nuhi ni.
en: God was performing unusual miracles through Paul.

dag: So yi bi saɣi li, yin di chɛliya ka yi baɣa be o ni.
en: If someone doesnt recognize this, they arent recognized.

dag: Ka Dilaila daa bo mi pala lo o, ka kuhi yɛl o, Samsin Filistianim kana ni bɛ ti lir a. Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa sɔɣi do n-gu o maa be yil maa ni du shɛl ni. Ka Samsin daa darigi chihi mihi maa kaman gal la.
en: So Delilah got some new ropes and tied him up. Then she shouted, Samson! The Philistines are coming! The men were waiting in another room. But he snapped the ropes off his arms like thread.

dag: ka m mini tɔbbi shɛb bɛn be n sani ni chaŋ ti liri ba. Ka bɛ yi ti yina ni ti mini ba zaŋ nya taba, ti ni ŋmaligi guui kaman ti ni daa pun niŋ shɛm la.
en: My men and I will approach the city. When the men of Ai come out against us, we will turn and run, just as we did the first time.

dag: Ka Dauda bɔh o, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a daa yɛn ku Yawɛ ni pii ninvuɣ so maa ka dabiɛm bi mal a.
en: David said to the young soldier, Why were you not afraid to kill the Lord s chosen king .

dag: Ka salo pam daa doli Yisa nyaaŋa, ka paɣ shɛb daa be bɛ ni n-kuhiri ka fabind o zuɣu.
en: A large crowd of people followed him; among them were some women who were weeping and wailing for him.

dag: O ni daa lo Ibrahimma alikauli shɛl la, o daa pola pɔri pahi alikauli maa zuɣu ti Yisahaku.
en: He will keep the agreement he made with Abraham and his promise to Isaac.

dag: Dama m boli ya ka yi zaɣisi, ka n teei n nuu na, ka yi baɣa ka di ni.
en: I have been calling you, inviting you to come, but you would not listen. You paid no attention to me.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni darig a tibili kaman a ni daa niŋ shɛm maa, nyin ŋun bi lihi nya pɔri, ka saɣim alikauli ŋɔ.
en: Jerusalem, you deserve to be punished, because you broke your promises and ignored our agreement.

dag: Dama n nyari ba zoya zuɣu, ka nyari ba daboya zuɣu. Bɛ nyɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be bɛ ko; ka bi tɛhi ni bɛ mini zuliya shɛli nyɛla yim. Bɛ wuhiya ni bɛ be bɛ ko ka chɛ zuliya kam.
en: From the mountain peaks, I look down and see Israel, the obedient people of God.

dag: Ti suhiri ti Duuma maŋmaŋa ŋun nyɛ suhudoo ni yiri so sanna la ni o timiya suhudoo sahakam mini yɛlli kam ni. Ti Duuma kul kpalimmi be yi zaa sani!.
en: We pray that the Lord of peace will give you peace at all times and in every way. The Lord be with you all.

dag: Bɛ ni daa pirigi Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili duli wulinluhili polo Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ tiŋgbana ti Izraɛlnim shɛm m-bɔŋɔ. Ɛliɛza ŋun daa nyɛ maligumaana la mini Nan bia Jɔshua ni Izraɛl zuliyanim kpamba n-daa pirigi tiŋgbɔŋ maa tari ba.
en: The Israelites received these inheritances in the land of Canaan. Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the families of the Israelite tribes assigned them.

dag: Ka naa daa lan yɛl o, A mi amaŋmaŋ suhu ni a ni daa tum m ba Dauda tuumbiɛ shɛŋa la zaa, dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni labis a tuumbiɛri maa zaa ʒil a.
en: The king said further, You know quite well all the evil that you did to my father David. May the LORD return your evil on your own head.

dag: Ka Hiburu nachimbil so ŋun nyɛ a tɔbbihi bɛn gul a la sapashin kpɛm dabili daa be ti sani, ka ti yɛl o, ka o daa wuhi ti ti zaa yinoyino zahindi gbinni ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: There was a young Hebrew man in prison with us. He was a servant of the commander of the guards. We told him our dreams, and he explained them to us. He told us the meaning of each dream.

dag: Kukol shɛli n-kuhiri yɛra: Malimiya soli mɔɣu ni ti Yawɛ! Malimiya soli maa tiŋgban nɛli ni ka di tuhi ti ti Naawuni maa!.
en: Listen, there is someone shouting: Prepare a way in the desert for the Lord . Make a straight road there for our God.

dag: Bɔ saha ka a lee yɛn chɛ yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisibu? A noli ni yɛtɔɣa maa ŋmanila pɔhim.
en: How long will you talk like that? Your words are nothing but hot air!.

dag: N suhir a yɛra, Di chɛ ka n dimnim di suhupiɛlli dari niŋ ma, a mi di chɛ ka bɛ di dari niŋ ma n napɔŋ sarigibu zuɣu.
en: I said, Don't let them laugh or brag when I slip and fall.

dag: Ka yi ni zaɣisi n saɣisigu ka bi deei n ni kpahi yi zuɣu ni shɛm la zuɣu.
en: You ignored all my advice, and you didnt want me to correct you.

dag: Daanya viɛlli ka Huram daa zaŋ mali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu binyara din nyɛ duɣuri mini soobuya ni taha la zaa ti Naa Sulemaana.
en: and the pots, shovels, and bowls. All the equipment that Hiram made for King Solomon for the LORDs temple was made from polished bronze.

dag: ka Diuɛl bia Ɛliasaf nyɛ Gaad zuliya zuɣulana.
en: And then came the tribe of Gad. Eliasaph son of Deuel was the commander of that group.

dag: ni Bɛnabinadab ŋun daa su Nafatido tiŋgbɔŋ zaa, ka daa kpuɣi Sulemaana bipuɣiŋga Tafat la.
en: The son of Abinadab was in charge of Naphath-Dor and was married to Solomon's daughter Taphath.

dag: Ka Musa daa tim ba kaman Yawɛ ni daa zal o shɛm maa, ka bɛ daa yi Paran mɔɣu ni chaŋ. Bɛ zaa daa nyɛla Izraɛlnim zuɣulaannima.
en: So Moses sent twelve tribal leaders from Israel's camp in the Paran Desert.

dag: A ti o o suhu ni bɔri shɛli; ka bi mɔŋ o o ni suh a bɔri binshɛli.
en: And you gave him what he wanted. You gave him what he asked for. Selah.

dag: N Naawuni, n ni ŋme mɔɣilo paɣ a a ʒiɛyimtali zuɣu; N ni ŋme mɔɣilo n-yili yila paɣi nyin Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋun be kasi ŋɔ.
en: Then Ill give you thanks with a harp— I will thank you for your faithfulness, my God. I will make music for you with the lyre, holy one of Israel.

dag: Yilimiya yila paɣi Yawɛ ŋun be Ziɔn ŋɔ! Yɛlimiya zuliya kam zaa o ni tum tuun kar shɛŋa yɛla!.
en: Sing praise to the Lord , who rules in Zion! Tell every nation what he has done!.

dag: Wuntizɔriba tɛha nyɛla din viɛla, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri saɣisigu nyɛla yɔhiŋ.
en: The plans of the righteous are just, but the guidance of the wicked is deceptive.

dag: Dama biɛri bɔhibu saha mini binshɛɣukam zaa din daa sab zalila palibu saha nti yɛn bala.
en: For those will be The Days of Punishment, to make come true all that the Scriptures say.

dag: Ka o daa chɛ ba, ka lan kpe ŋariŋ maa m-baai du dul din la ha.
en: Then Jesus left them and went in the boat to the other side of the lake.

dag: Tiŋgban shɛŋa din be teeku puuni daa sɔhigimi a ni daa lu dahin shɛli maa, ka di gari ba a ni daa naai shɛm maa zuɣu.
en: But now Tyre is in ruins, and the people on the coast stare at it in horror and tremble in fear.

dag: Jɛramiil daa lan mali paɣ so ka o yuli booni Atara, ŋuna n-daa nyɛ Onam ma.
en: Jerahmeel had another wife named Atarah. Onams mother was Atarah.

dag: Ka Yawɛ yɛl o, Wummi niriba maa ni yɛl a shɛlikam maa zaa, dama pa nyini ka bɛ zaɣisi, amaa mani ka bɛ zaɣisi ni n di lan nyɛ bɛ naa maa.
en: and the Lord said, Listen to everything the people say to you. You are not the one they have rejected; I am the one they have rejected as their king.

dag: Ka Ahimaaz daa lan yɛli, Di yi kul nyɛ shɛlikam, man ni zo n-kuli. Ka Jɔab daa yɛl o, Zom kuli. Di saha ka Ahimaaz daa ŋmaligi guui n-zo n-doli bɔpiɛligu polo nti gari Kush nir maa zuɣu.
en: Ahimaaz answered, No matter what happens, I will run to David. Joab said to Ahimaaz, All right, run to David! Then Ahimaaz ran through Jordan Valley and passed the Ethiopian.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli anabi Jɛrimia.
en: This message from the Lord came to Jeremiah the prophet:.

dag: Dama di nyɛla Naawuni yubu ni yi tum din tuhi, ka di chɛ ka yi mum jɛra bɛn tɔɣisiri ʒilinsi yɛtɔɣa la noya.
en: When you do good, you stop ignorant people from saying foolish things about you. This is what God wants.

dag: ka tooi chi zim maa nukurigu pali kaman di ni wuhi shɛm n-zaŋ li niŋ buɣim ni sara maligu bimbini maa zuɣu, di nyaaŋa ka o chɛ ka paɣ maa zaŋ kom maa nyu.
en: and burn part of it as a sacrifice. After that, the woman must drink the bitter water.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛli Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba maa, Chamiya ti sɔɣi do wain tihi pur la ni gu.
en: The leaders told the men of Benjamin who still did not have wives: Go to Shiloh and hide in the vineyards near the festival.

dag: Ka salo maa tahi bɛ zuɣu ni bɛ foma; amaa ka bɛ maan kuhi pam yɛli, Ti dana, nyin ŋun nyɛ Naa Dauda yaaŋa ŋɔ, zom ti nambɔɣu.
en: The crowd scolded them and told them to be quiet. But they shouted even more loudly, Son of David! Have mercy on us, sir.

dag: yimaŋmaŋ di ʒiɛnya nimaani, amaa yinim karimiya doli yi dimnim maa nyaaŋa nti liri ba, ka di chɛliya ka bɛ zo m-paai bɛ ya, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-zaŋ ba niŋ yi nuu ni.
en: but dont you stay there. Chase after your enemies and attack them from the rear. Dont let them enter their cities, because the LORD your God has given them into your power.

dag: bɛn nyɛ yuun pihitata zaŋ ti paai yuun pihinunu, ka nyɛ bɛn zaa ni tooi tum tuma ka ʒi Naawuni chirigibu shee suɣili maa ni ʒiya.
en: All the men between the ages of and who qualified to serve were counted. These men were given a special work to do for the Meeting Tent. They did the work of carrying the Meeting Tent when they traveled.

dag: Ka naa mini Haman daa chaŋ ni bɛ mini Ɛsta ti laɣim di.
en: When the king and Haman came in for the banquet with Queen Esther.

dag: ka nya ka gɔhi n-kul zooi lim li; ka yihim lan zibigi di ni, ka di kuɣa gooni lu n-doya.
en: Weeds were growing everywhere! Wild vines covered the ground, and the wall around the vineyard was broken and falling down.

dag: Yisa daa ŋahi yɛtɔɣ ŋaha ŋɔ tatabo pam wuhiri salo Naawuni yɛligu kaman bɛ baŋsim tariga ni daa nyɛ shɛm.
en: Jesus preached his message to the people, using many other parables like these; he told them as much as they could understand.

dag: ka baŋ yɛlimaŋli ni nyɛ shɛli, ka yɛlimaŋli maa yihi ya dabitim ni.
en: you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.

dag: Ka Abinɛr min o niriba maa daa chaŋ yuŋ maa zaa n-gari Araba ti gbaai Jɔɔdɛn Mɔɣili du, zaŋ chaŋ wuntaŋ daa ti yɛn zani zuɣu ni ka bɛ paai Mahanaim.
en: Abner and his men marched all night through the Jordan Valley. They crossed the Jordan River and then marched all day until they came to Mahanaim.

dag: Man ŋuna, di pala m malila baŋsim gari sokam zuɣu ka Naawuni kahigi ashili maa gbinni wuhi ma maa, amaa o niŋla lala ni di chɛ ka nyin naa baŋ zahindi maa gbinni mini tɛhi shɛŋa din daa ka a sanna maa gbinni.
en: However, you must realize that these mysteries weren't explained to me because I am smarter than everyone else. Instead, it was done so that you would understand what you have seen.

dag: Di saha ka Dauda daa zaŋ o jaaŋgbee niŋ o nuu ni ka gahim kuɣ polipoli diba anu n-niŋ o piɛgul koligu ni, ka o kuɣilɔŋ be o nuu ni ka o vu m-miri Filistia doo maa ha.
en: He then grabbed his staff and chose five smooth stones from the streambed. He put them in the pocket of his shepherds bag and with sling in hand went out to the Philistine.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa wuhi ba zahindi ni ni bɛ di lan lab Naa Hɛrɔd sani; ka bɛ daa taɣi so shɛli kuli bɛ ya.
en: Later they were warned in a dream not to return to Herod, and they went back home by another road.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni wurim buɣa, ka saɣim Mɛmfisi binnana la naai. Naa ti ku lan be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, dinzuɣu n ni ti zaŋ dabiɛm niŋ Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: All the idols and images you Egyptians worship in the city of Memphis will be smashed. No one will be left to rule your nation, and terror will fill the land.

dag: Machɛlizuɣiri kul zuɣirimi ni nimmoo, amaa ka buɣim bi diri yihiri daɣiri; bɛ daɣiri ni yibu maa kul nyɛla yoli, dama bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali maa bi yi bɛ ni.
en: The bellows roar; the lead is consumed. Yet the refining fails; the impurities remain.

dag: M mabihi, Naawuni n-daa pii ya leei bilichinnima; amaa lee miriya ka yi zaŋ yi bilichinsi soli maa tum niŋgbuŋ kɔre tuma, naɣ zaŋmiyala yimaŋ leei tab daba yurilim zuɣu.
en: You were called to freedom, brothers and sisters; only dont let this freedom be an opportunity to indulge your selfish impulses, but serve each other through love.

dag: A nyɛla Naawuni suŋ, ka tumdi din viɛla; wuhim ma a zaligunima.
en: You are good and you do good. Teach me your statutes!.

dag: Samaria anabinim sani, n nya binshɛli din bi viɛla. Bɛ malila Baal yuli tɔɣisiri anabitali yɛtɔɣa, ka chɛ ka n niriba birigi.
en: In the prophets of Samaria I saw something shocking: They prophesied by Baal and led astray my people Israel.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ bɔrɔbɔro kpil shɛli din daŋ tooni ti Naawuni yi be kasi, dindina bɔrɔbɔro maa zaa ni be kasi. Ka tia nyaɣa yi be kasi, di wula gba ni be kasi.
en: If the first piece of bread is offered to God, then the whole loaf is made holy. If the roots of a tree are holy, the trees branches are holy too.

dag: ni tammɛriba ni kuɣikpɛriba, ka da dari mini nyolimbɔɣa shɛli bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ mali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa, ka lan zaŋ di shɛli mi mali duu maa luɣ shɛlikam din simdi ni bɛ dihi li nachiinsi.
en: They used that money to pay the stoneworkers and stonecutters, and they used it to buy timber, cut stone, and everything else to repair the Lord s Temple.

dag: Tuumba bɛn ʒe yim ŋmanila atam kpuɣibu saha sakuɣili din maai bɛ kpamba sani; bɛ chɛ ka bɛn tim ba suhuri maara.
en: A reliable messenger is refreshing to the one who sends him, like cold water in the heat of harvest time.

dag: Di niŋ zuɣulaannim naani, a mi di niŋ daadamnim bɛn ka sɔŋsim ŋɔ naani.
en: You can't depend on anyone, not even a great leader.

dag: Amaa man Yawɛ nti yɛn zaŋ n yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi, ka di niŋ pali. Di ti bi lan yɛn yuui yaha. Amaa yinim duŋtaariba ŋɔ ʒiɛman ŋɔ ni ka n ni tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa ka chɛ ka di niŋ pali. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: I, the Lord , will speak to them, and what I say will be done. There will be no more delay. In your own lifetime, you rebels, I will do what I have warned you I would do. I have spoken, says the Sovereign Lord .

dag: Gbuɣim pola mi n-ti kɔŋ bindirigu dira, ka kum mali ba; amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi Yawɛ bɛn kul ku kɔŋ binsuma.
en: Even lions go hungry for lack of food, but those who obey the Lord lack nothing good.

dag: Ka Bɔaz daa bɔh o tumtumdib kpɛma, Ka paɣisar ŋuni n-lee bɔŋɔ.
en: Then Boaz spoke to his servant who was in charge of the workers. He asked, Whose girl is that.

dag: O daa lan yɛli niriba maa, Chɛliya ka bɛn gbib bidibbina be Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka maa tooni ka yi chaŋ gili tiŋ maa.
en: Then Joshua ordered the people, Now go! March around the city. The soldiers with weapons will march in front of the Holy Box of the Lord .

dag: Bɛ daa buɣisi Naawuni bɛ suhuri ni ni bɛ nya, bɛ suhuri ni daa ye bindir shɛli zuɣu la ni.
en: Then they decided to test God by telling him to give them the food they wanted.

dag: Amaa di daa nyɛla Yawɛ yubu ni o chɛ ka o nya dansi ni biɛrim. O daa chɛ ka o zaŋ o nyɛvili pa talima alahichi zuɣu, ka o ni ti nya o zuliya, ka mali nyɛvili wɔɣinli. Yawɛ ni lo nia shɛli ni niŋ pali o zuɣu.
en: But the Lord was pleased with this humble servant who suffered such pain. Even after giving himself as an offering for sin, he will see his descendants and enjoy a long life. He will succeed in doing what the Lord wanted.

dag: Di ni daa ti kpalim daba ayi ni bɛ puhi Yaɣigari Chuɣu, bɛ ni lan booni shɛli Bɔrɔbɔro din ka Dabindi Chuɣu la, ka maligumaaniba kpamba mini Naawuni zaligubaŋdiba daa bɔri so shɛli bɛ ni yɛn doli sɔɣ gbaai Yisa ku o;.
en: It was now two days before Passover and the Festival of Thin Bread. The chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses were planning how they could sneak around and have Jesus arrested and put to death.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa niŋ tipawumli zaɣisi wumbu.
en: But they refused to listen and refused to do what he wanted. They closed their ears so that they could not hear what God said.

dag: Yɛndan lee bela ya? Ka zaligubaŋda lee bela ya? Ka ʒiɛmani ŋɔ yɛlibuɣisira lee bela ya? Pa Naawuni m-pun wuhi ni dunia ŋɔ yɛm nyɛla jɛrilim?.
en: What happened to those wise people? What happened to those experts in the Scriptures? What happened to the ones who think they have all the answers? Didn't God show that the wisdom of this world is foolish?.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa zali ma ni n wuhim ya zalikpana mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi maa, ka yi ti gbib li yi ni chani ni yi ti deei tiŋgbɔn shɛli ʒini maa ni.
en: The Lord told me to teach you all the laws that you are to obey in the land that you are about to invade and occupy.

dag: Di saha ka Rimɔn ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛrɔt nir la bihi bɛn daa nyɛ Rɛkab mini Baana daa yiɣisi lu soli n-daa ti paai Ishibɔshɛt yiŋ wuntaŋ zuɣusaa saha din nyɛ saha shɛl o ni daa dɔni ni o vuhi wuntaŋ ni.
en: Recab and Baanah, sons of Rimmon from Beeroth, went to Ish Bosheths house at noon. Ish Bosheth was resting because it was hot.

dag: Wula ka yi ni tooi yɛli, Ti bi saɣim timaŋa, ti na ʒi n-jɛm Baalinima? Lihimiya yi biɛhigu ni daa nyɛ shɛm vinvamli ni, nyamiya yi ni daa tum shɛm. Yi daa ŋmanila laakum nyaŋ ŋun bɔri dubu ka faai zɔra ginda.
en: Judah, how can you say to me, I am not guilty because I have not worshiped the Baal idols? Think about what you did in the valley. Think about what you have done. You are like a fast she-camel that runs from place to place.

dag: M biɛhigu din ka buchi ŋɔ puuni, n nya binshɛɣukam zaa. Wuntizɔriba kpiri bɛ wuntitali tuma puuni, ka ninvuɣ biɛri kul tumdi tuumbiɛri ka mali nyɛvili wɔɣila.
en: I have seen everything during this senseless life of mine. I have seen good citizens die for doing the right thing, while criminals live and prosper.

dag: Malimiya yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim ka di nyom viɛl Yawɛ san la. Dina n-nyɛ: naɣila yino mini piɛla yino ni yuun yini piɛlabih ayopɔin bɛn ka dansi;.
en: Bring to the altar one bull, one full-grown ram, and seven rams a year old that have nothing wrong with them. Then offer these as sacrifices to please me.

dag: Ibram yuma daa nyɛla yuun pihiniinaayɔbu saha shɛli Haga ni daa dɔɣi Ishimail ti o maa.
en: Abram was years old when Ishmael was born from Hagar.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ tikpiranima, wummiya! Yinim bɛn nyɛ zoomba, duhimiya yi zuɣuri lihi nya!.
en: The Lord says, Listen, you deaf people! Look closely, you that are blind!.

dag: Nam jaaŋgbee ti ku yi Juda nuu ni. Nam jaaŋgbee mi ti ku yi o zuliya nuu ni hal ka ŋun su li ti kana. Ka niriba ni ti deer o noli.
en: Men from Judahs family will be kings. The sign that his family rules will not leave his family before the real king comes. Then many people will obey and serve him.

dag: Ŋmaligim a nini ka chɛ ma, dama di gbaari ma! A zabiri yirigirimi kaman buhi ni zɔri sirigiri Giliad Zoli zuɣu shɛm la.
en: Turn away your eyes— they make me melt. Your hair tosses about as gracefully as goats coming down from Gilead.

dag: Ti mi ni Masia ni daa neei kum ni maa, o ku lan kpi yaha; dama kum lan ka o yiko.
en: We know that Christ has been raised from the dead and he will never die again. Death no longer has power over him.

dag: Kahigim a daalahiziba yurilim la wuhi, nyin ŋun nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kanna ti sɔɣiri a sani a nudirigu polo tiligiri bɛ dimnim nuu ni tiligira ŋɔ.
en: Show your amazing kindness and rescue those who depend on you. Use your great power and protect them from their enemies.

dag: Bɛ daa yɛlimi, Pa Musa kɔŋko ka Yawɛ daa zaŋ o yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi. O daa zaŋ o yɛtɔɣa tɔɣisi tinim gba. Ka Yawɛ daa wum li.
en: They said, Has the Lord spoken only through Moses? Hasn't he also spoken through us? The Lord heard what they said. .

dag: N di yɛlimi, Chɛ ka ninkura tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, ka chɛ ka bɛn yuma galisi pam mi wuhi yɛm.
en: I once believed age was the source of wisdom;.

dag: A kuhigu maa nyɛla din ni sɔŋ yih a muɣisigu ni bee a yaa zaa n-ni ti a sɔŋsim?.
en: Do you think your wealth will keep you out of trouble? Will your great strength be of any help to you now?.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Naa Siiza dini. Ka o yɛli ba, Dinzuɣu Naa Siiza ni su shɛli, yin zaŋmiya li ti o, ka Naawuni mi ni su shɛli, yin zaŋmiya li ti ŋun Naawuni.
en: The Emperor's, they answered. So Jesus said to them, Well, then, pay to the Emperor what belongs to the Emperor, and pay to God what belongs to God.

dag: Ka anabinim maa zaa daa tɔɣisi bɛ daanabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛl lala. Bɛ daa yɛl o mi, Cham Ramɔtigiliad nti tuhi di nasara; Yawɛ ni zaŋ ba niŋ nyin naa nuu ni.
en: All the other prophets agreed: Attack Ramoth-gilead and win! The LORD will hand it over to the king.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm zuɣu ka o daa zali sokam o ni yɛn tum tuun shɛli bee o ni yɛn ʒi ʒi shɛli. Lala ka o daa kali ba kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali ŋun Musa shɛm.
en: Each was enrolled by the LORDs command through Moses to work and to carry his load. Each was assigned just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

dag: N ni yɛli Naawuni, Di wuhi ni m mali taali. Chɛ ka m baŋ a ni tuhiri ma daliri shɛli zuɣu.
en: Don't condemn me, God. Tell me! What is the charge against me?.

dag: ka zaŋ ya tahi gomnanim mini nazuɣuri tooni n zuɣu, ka yi ti niŋ n shɛhiranima bɛ mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianim sani.
en: Because of me, you will be dragged before rulers and kings to tell them and the Gentiles about your faith.

dag: N ni wurim ba bɛ dimnim tooni bahi kaman pɔhim n-yi gbinni polo na ti ʒe ba chaŋ la. Bɛ zaɣ biɛɣu nyabu dali, n ni ti lɛbi n nyaaŋa biri ba ka pa ni n tooni.
en: When your enemies attack, I will scatter you like dust blown by an eastern wind. Then, on that day of disaster, I will turn my back on you.

dag: Bɛ ni ti nyɛla zuliya shɛb bɛn mali ninkuunsi ka ku tiri ninkura jilima bee n-niŋ bipola nirilim.
en: They won't show any mercy, and they will have no respect for old people or pity for children.

dag: Ka bɛ yi ba ba bandi, ka bɛ be wahala mia ni.
en: If they are tied with ropes, caught in cords of affliction.

dag: Amaa bia maa ŋun daa bi mi di ni nyɛ shɛm, kulla Jɔnatan mini Dauda n-daa mi di ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: not knowing what it all meant; only Jonathan and David knew.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔh o, A shiri ni saɣi kpi n zuɣu? Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛr a, a ni ti chihi paai siɣimsiɣim buta ni a bi mi ma ka nolɔɣu na bi kum.
en: Jesus answered, Will you really give your life for me? The truth is, before the rooster crows, you will say three times that you dont know me.

dag: Ka n yi ti na be n nyɛvili ni, nyin kul gbibi Yawɛ yurilim ŋɔ ni mani, ka ʒe ma yim din ni chɛ ka n ku kpi.
en: Someday the Lord will wipe out all of your enemies. Then if I'm still alive, please be as kind to me as the Lord has been. But if I'm dead, be kind to my family.

dag: Ka Azibuk bia Nɛhimia ŋun daa nyɛ Bɛtizur yaɣili pirigili polo naa la daa mali me m-pan o zuɣu. O daa zaŋla lala hal ti paai Dauda siliga la tooni hal ti paai bɛ ni daa gbi mɔɣ shɛl la mini tɔbbihi biɛhigu shee la.
en: After him, Nehemiah, Azbuks son, ruler of half the Beth-zur district, repaired from the point opposite Davids tombs as far as the artificial pool and the Warriors House.

dag: ka o yɛli ba, N suhu saɣimya pam, hal di ŋmanila n yɛn kpimi. Yinim kpalimmiya kpe guhima.
en: He said to them, Im very sad. Its as if Im dying. Stay here and keep alert.

dag: Niriba ŋɔ tatabo wuhiri ni di bi tuhi ni nir kpuɣ paɣa bee n-diri bindira balibu shɛŋa Naawuni ni nam ti salinima ni bɛn niŋ yɛda ka baŋ yɛlimaŋli la diri li ka paɣiri ŋun Naawuni di zuɣu la.
en: They will prohibit marriage and eating foods that God created—and he intended them to be accepted with thanksgiving by those who are faithful and have come to know the truth.

dag: O daa me n-gili Bɛtilihɛm mini Ɛtam ni Tɛkɔa.
en: Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa.

dag: Ka o yi ti yoog omaŋmaŋ piɛri maa zaa, o bela bɛ tooni ka piɛri maa dol o, bɛ ni mi o kukoli zuɣu.
en: When he has brought them out, he goes ahead of them, and the sheep follow him, because they know his voice.

dag: ka chɛ ka yi maŋgbibbu pahi yi baŋsim zuɣu, ka chɛ ka yi ʒiɛyimtali pahi yi maŋgbibbu zuɣu, ka chɛ ka yi Naawuni sizuura lubu pahi yi ʒiɛyimtali zuɣu.
en: to your knowledge add self-control; to your self-control add endurance; to your endurance add godliness;.

dag: N zaŋ a yɛligu ti ba, ka dunianim zaɣisi ba, bɛ ni lan pa dunia ŋɔ nima kaman n ni pa dunia ŋɔ nir shɛm la zuɣu.
en: I have given them your teaching. And the world has hated them, because they dont belong to the world, just as I dont belong to the world.

dag: Ka biɛɣu daa neei, ka Musa kpe suɣili maa ni nti nya ka Aduna jaaŋgbee din daa nyɛ Lɛvinim din la puhila vari, ka daai pum n-wali alimɔnd wal moma.
en: The next day, when Moses went into the Tent, he saw that Aaron's stick, representing the tribe of Levi, had sprouted. It had budded, blossomed, and produced ripe almonds!.

dag: Ka Yisa kpah o zuɣu ni viɛnyɛliŋga, ka dii bah o ni o chama.
en: Then Jesus spoke sternly to him and sent him away at once.

dag: Yawɛ, a kul yɛn lihiri yɛlli maa la hal ni bɔ saha? Fam ma ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku ma maa nuu ni bahi. Fam n nyɛvili gbuɣima maa nuu ni bahi!.
en: But all you do is watch! When will you do something? Save me from the attack of those vicious lions.

dag: Bɛ tiɣila barina pua ka ni dɔɣi zaɣ biɛɣu, ka bɛ suhuri mali ʒiri ŋmabu shili.
en: because they are the parents of trouble and vicious lies.

dag: Ka o daa kpuɣi Yawɛ ni daa kari ninvuɣ shɛb tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni ka chɛ ka Izraɛlnim ʒini la biɛr yoli n-daa tum tuumbiɛri pam Yawɛ sani.
en: He did what was evil in the LORDs eyes, imitating the detestable practices of the nations that the LORD had driven out before the Israelites.

dag: Bɛ ku kpalim be Yawɛ tiŋgbani maa ni. Amaa Ifriimnim ni labi Ijipti nti di bindir shɛli din bi be kasi Asiria tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: They wont remain in the land of the LORD; but Ephraim will return to Egypt, and in Assyria they will eat unclean food.

dag: ka n ti tir a bindira nimaani, dama kum maa yuma na kpalim yuma anu, di yi pa lala kum maa ni ti miig a min a yiŋnim ni a ni mali binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: I will take care of you there during the next five years of famine. But if you don't come, you and your family and your animals will starve to death.

dag: Ka binnɛma anahi la yɛli, Ami! Ka kpamba la mi daa gban tiŋa n-jɛmdi Naawuni.
en: The four living beings said, Amen! And the elders bowed down and worshiped.

dag: A dim ni tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ maŋa ti a, amaa ka di lee nyɛla yɔhiŋ o suhu ni.
en: Evil people say things to make themselves look good, but they keep their evil plans a secret.

dag: Yawɛ ni zali zaligu shɛŋa m-bɔŋɔ. Yɛlim Izraɛlnima ni bɛ bom naɣisa ʒee ŋun ka dalinli ni galimi, ka nyɛ bɛ ni na bi zaŋ naɣikɔra dapua n-niŋ so na.
en: These are the laws from the teachings that the Lord gave to the Israelites. Get a red cow that has nothing wrong with it. That cow must not have any bruises. And it must never have worn a yoke.

dag: Dinzuɣu a ni yɛn niŋ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, yihim nanim pihitanaayi la zaa nam ni, ka zaŋ sapashin kpamba zali bɛ zaashɛhi maa.
en: Now, remove the thirty-two rulers from their commands and replace them with field commanders.

dag: O tizo yuli n-daa booni Jubal. Ŋun mi n-daa nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ŋmɛri mɔɣilɔnim mini yupiɛbiriba yaba.
en: Jabal was Jubals brother. Jubal was the father of people who play the harp and flute.

dag: Yawɛ sizuura lubu viɛla; ka nyɛ din kul be sahakam. Yawɛ zaligu shɛŋa din pahi nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, ka nyɛ wuntia zaa.
en: Worshiping the Lord is sacred; he will always be worshiped. All his decisions are correct and fair.

dag: O ni daa yɛli do so ŋun daa ye binyɛr piɛlli maa ni o moomi buɣim maa kalima shɛŋa din be chɛrubinim maa sunsuuni maa, ka o daa kpe di puuni ti zani baɣili kalinli yini.
en: When the Lord commanded the man wearing linen clothes to take some fire from between the wheels that were under the creatures, the man went in and stood by one of the wheels.

dag: Ka Sirianim bɛn be wulimpuhili polo mini Filistianim bɛn be wulinluhili polo daa kana ti lu Izraɛlnim zaa zuɣu ni bɛ naai ba. Amaa di zaa yoli, Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili maa daa na kul bi chɛ; o daa na kul loya ni o darigi bɛ tibili.
en: As for Israel, the Arameans are in front of him and the Philistines are behind him. And they are both eating away at him. But the Lord is not finished yet. He is still angry, and his arm is raised to continue punishing Israel.

dag: Yawɛ, a nyɛla ŋun wumdi nandaamba suhigu; ka lan nyɛ ŋun kpaŋsiri bɛ suhuri, ka ni gbilis a tibili wum.
en: You listen to the longings of those who suffer. You offer them hope, and you pay attention to their cries for help.

dag: Dama Yawɛ yɛliya, Kaman n ni daa kul chɛ ka zaɣ biɛ titaŋa paai niriba ŋɔ shɛm, lala ka n lan yɛn chɛ ka n ni lo ba zaɣ viɛl shɛŋa zaa alikauli pumpɔŋɔ ŋɔ paai ba.
en: This is what the Lord says: I have brought this great disaster to the people of Israel and Judah. In the same way I will bring good things to them. I promise to do good things for them.

dag: Ka Naawuni yi zaŋ viɛlim ŋɔ tatabo ti mɔri din be mɔɣu ni zuŋɔ n-kaai biɛɣu ka buɣim diri li ŋɔ, di chaŋ wula ka o ku ti yinim situra? Laabira, yi yɛda shiri pɔra!.
en: God gives such beauty to everything that grows in the fields, even though it is here today and thrown into a fire tomorrow. God will surely do even more for you! Why do you have such little faith?.

dag: ni Shɛkania ni Rɛhum ni Mɛrɛmɔt.
en: Shecaniah, Rehum, Meremoth.

dag: Dindali maa zaŋ chana, bɛ daa booni Gidiɔn la Jɛrubaal, Di gbinni nyɛla, Chɛliya ka buɣili Baal min o va; dama o bimbini ka o wurim maa.
en: Joash said, If Gideon pulled Baals altar down, let Baal argue with him. On that day Joash gave Gideon a new name. He called him Jerub-Baal.

dag: N ku lan teei bɛ ni tum alahichi shɛŋa maa zaa yɛla. Dama bɛ ni tum wuntitali tuun shɛŋa zuɣu bɛ ni be. .
en: God will not remember all the bad things they did. He will remember only their goodness, so they will live.

dag: Bɛ kpibu bi to, yuntisuɣu ka niriba maa tabitabi kpi, ka bɛ zaŋ wɔɣira maa chaŋ ka di pala daadam nuu n-niŋ li.
en: Any of us can die suddenly, in the middle of the night. Anyone can get sick and pass away. Even powerful people die for no reason we can see.

dag: Yinim zoomba ŋɔ, bina ayi maa ni dini n-lee gari di kpee: Sara maa bee bimbini din chɛ ka sara maa be kasi maa?.
en: Are you blind? Which is more important, the gift or the altar that makes the gift sacred?.

dag: Ka niŋgbuŋ zaa yi di nyɛla nini, wula ka di di yɛn niŋ wum? Ka niŋgbuŋ zaa yi di nyɛla tibili, wula ka di di yɛn wum nyom?.
en: If our bodies were only an eye, we couldn't hear a thing. And if they were only an ear, we couldn't smell a thing.

dag: Pa ti zuɣu ka o yɛl lala maa? Ti zuɣu ka di shiri sabi yɛl lala maa, dama ŋun kɔri mini ŋun buri chi zaa malila tahima yini, dina n-nyɛ ni bɛ laɣim di puu maa atam.
en: or did he say this entirely for our sake? It was written for our sake because the one who plows and the one who threshes should each do so with the hope of sharing the produce.

dag: Ka bɔ ka yi daa lee chaŋ ni yi ti nya? Anabi ka yi daa chaŋ ni yi ti nya? Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, hal o gari anabi gba.
en: Tell me, what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes indeed, but you saw much more than a prophet.

dag: Yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Anabitali yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ nyɛla Jɛrusalɛm naa mini Izraɛlnim bɛn zaa be di ni dini.
en: Say to them, The LORD God proclaims: This concerns the prince in Jerusalem, along with the entire house of Israel in it.

dag: A ni zaŋ kurigu jaaŋgbee ŋme n-wurim ba; ka to n-wurisi ba kaman yaɣimɛr duɣu la.
en: You will smash them with an iron rod; you will shatter them like a pottery jar.

dag: M be a sani, ka so ku tooi niŋ a shɛli, dama m mali niriba pam tiŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: for I am with you. No one will be able to harm you, for many in this city are my people.

dag: N Duuma, n ni paɣ a niriba balibu kam sani. N ni yili yila paɣ a zuliya balibu kam sani.
en: I will praise you, Lord, for everyone to hear, and I will sing hymns to you in every nation.

dag: ka piligi bur o taba, ka pahi danyuriba zuɣu diri ka nyura.
en: He will begin to beat the other servants. He will eat and drink with others who are drunk.

dag: amaa tinim ni zaŋ ti dahima zaa n-niŋla Naawuni suhibu min o yɛligu tɔɣisibu tuma ni.
en: As for us, we will devote ourselves to prayer and the service of proclaiming the word.

dag: Izraɛlnim maa ni daa nya li, ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Bɔ n-lee bala? Dama bɛ daa bi mi di ni nyɛ shɛli. Ka Musa daa yɛli ba, Yawɛ ni zaŋ bindir shɛli tin ya ni yi di m-bala.
en: The people had never seen anything like this, and they started asking each other, What is it? Moses answered, This is the bread that the Lord has given you to eat.

dag: O ni yi nyam, ka o ni sɔhira, o varila tiŋa. Bɛ yi ti piɛbi kikaa, o bi tooi zaani luɣ yini.
en: Unable to stand still, they gallop eagerly into battle when trumpets blast.

dag: Ahi daa nyɛla Abidiɛl bia, ka Abidiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Guni bia la daa nyɛ bɛ daŋ maa ni dɔɣirikpɛma.
en: Ahi, the son of Abdiel and the grandson of Guni, was the leader of their clan.

dag: Bɛ daa nyɛla kaman ninvuɣ pinaayi laasabu.
en: They were about twelve men in all.

dag: Bɛ kul niŋdila nirilim sahakam, ka zaŋdi bɛ liɣiri paŋdi niriba, ka alibarika be bɛ bihi ni.
en: They are kind and generous, and their children are a blessing.

dag: Yawɛ malaika kul gulila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn lur o sizuura; ka fari ba bahira.
en: If you honor the Lord , his angel will protect you.

dag: Chɛliya ka amiliya lɔbu mali jilima sokam sani, ka chɛliya ka yidan min o paɣa ʒe tab yim bɛ daamiliya lɔbu puuni; dama Naawuni ni kari niŋgbuŋ kɔrɛnim mini bɛn niŋdi zina saria.
en: Marriage must be honored in every respect, with no cheating on the relationship, because God will judge the sexually immoral person and the person who commits adultery.

dag: Amaa yi ni yi alahichi dabitim ni pumpɔŋɔ n-yipa leela Naawuni daba ŋɔ, yi ni nya nyɔ shɛli di ni nyɛla biɛr kasi, ka di bahigu nyɛla nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: Now you have been set free from sin, and you are God's slaves. This will make you holy and will lead you to eternal life.

dag: Bɛ zaŋla zaɣ biɛɣu n-yo ma zaɣ viɛlli samli, ka n lan ka tahima yaha.
en: They pay me back evil for the good I have done. They make me so very sad.

dag: Amaa bomiya baaŋa ti ma na pumpɔŋɔ. Baaŋa maa ni daa ti yiini yila saha shɛli, ka Yawɛ yiko siɣi Ilaisha zuɣu na.
en: Now bring me a musician. While the musician played, the LORDs power came over Elisha.

dag: Suhusaɣiŋgu mini suhugarigu ni nintam pam puuni ka n daa sabi gbaŋ maa tin ya, ka di daa pala n lomi ni n tin ya suhusaɣiŋgu, amaa n daa bɔrimi ni di chɛ ka yi baŋ n yurilim ni galisi shɛm zaŋ chaŋ yi sani.
en: When I wrote to you before, I was very troubled and my heart was full of sadness. I wrote with many tears. I did not write to make you sad, but to let you know how much I love you.

dag: Piɛla so a ni daa nya ka o mali yil ayi la wuhirila Miidianim mini Pɛriʒianim nanim yɛla.
en: You saw a ram with two horns. The horns are the countries of Media and Persia.

dag: Yuun shɛli din nyɛ nɛma labisi ti yuuni maa puuni, sokam ni ti labi ti su o ni di pun su binshɛɣukam.
en: During this year, all property must go back to its original owner.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lo o zoligɔnima n-zaŋ o niŋ gampiliga ni n-zaŋ o tahi ti ti Babilɔn naa. Ka bɛ daa zaŋ o niŋ duu ni di chɛ ka bɛ ku lan wum o kukoli Izraɛl zoya zuɣu yaha.
en: They put hooks on him and locked him up. They had him in their trap, so they took him to the king of Babylon. And now, you cannot hear his roar on the mountains of Israel.

dag: Hal yi ni maani sara shɛli yi ni zaŋdi nyɔri buɣim tiri ma la mini chi sara la, n ku deei li. M mi ku gbiligi lihi yi ni zaŋdi biŋkɔb kar shɛb na nti maani suhudoo sara la.
en: When you bring me burnt offerings and grain offerings, I will not accept them; I will not accept the animals you have fattened to bring me as offerings.

dag: Ka Rɛmalia bia Pɛka ŋun daa nyɛ o sapashin kpɛm daa lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ o polo, ka daa zaŋ Giliadnim ninvuɣ pihinu chaŋ Samaria nti kpe nayili puuni birini ni nti ŋme o luhi n-ku o, ka deei nam maa di n-zan o zaani.
en: Pekah son of Remaliah was Pekahiah's chief officer, but he made plans to kill the king. So he and men from Gilead broke into the strongest part of the palace in Samaria and murdered Pekahiah, together with Argob and Arieh. Pekah then became king.

dag: Bɛ yi bɔri ni bɛ baŋ shɛli, bɛn bɔhimi bɛ yidaannim yiŋa, dama di nyɛla vi ni paɣ tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa cheechi ni.
en: If there is something they want to know, they should ask their own husbands at home. It is shameful for a woman to speak up like that in the church meeting.

dag: Ka o daa yiɣisi tirisi tooni nti lan gbi kɔbil shɛli, ka so daa bi lan niŋ o naŋgbankpeeni di zuɣu yaha; dinzuɣu ka o daa boli di mi yuli Rɛhɔbɔt ka yɛra, Yawɛ yipa ti ti luɣ shɛli din mali palo pumpɔŋɔ, ka ti ni tɔŋ tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni.
en: He left there and dug another well, but they didnt argue about it, so he named it Rehoboth and said, Now the LORD has made an open space for us and has made us fertile in the land.

dag: Bɛ gba ni ti dol li chaŋ kpiimba biɛhigu shee maa nti pahi bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbiri ku zuliya shɛba mini bɛ zɔnim la ni zuliya shɛb bɛn daa ʒi di mahim la zuɣu.
en: Yes, those trees also went down with the big tree to the place of death. They joined the people who were killed in battle. That big tree made the other trees strong. Those trees had lived under the big trees shadow among the nations.

dag: M biyurisi bɛn nyɛ n ni lan wolisiri shɛb zuɣu ni Masia be yi ni ŋɔ.
en: My dear children! Once again, just like a mother in childbirth, I feel the same kind of pain for you until Christ's nature is formed in you.

dag: Ka Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza daa bahi Nɛbuzaradan ŋun daa nyɛ yiliguliba sapashin kpɛm maa noli zaŋ chaŋ Jɛrimia polo yɛli.
en: Nebuchadnezzar had given the following orders to Nebuzaradan:.

dag: Ka bɛ bɔhi, Ka Izraɛl daŋ niriba ni banima n-lee bi ka Mizipa na Naawuni san la? Ka bɛ yɛli, Jabɛshi din be Giliad la nima m-bi ka laɣiŋgu maa ni na maa.
en: Again the Israelites asked, Did any of the tribes stay away from the meeting at Mizpah? After asking around, they discovered that no one had come from Jabesh in Gilead.

dag: Ka n daa nya do so ʒii puuni yuŋ ka o bari wɔr ʒiɛɣu. O daa ʒiɛla vinvamli ni mitil tihi sunsuuni, ka wɔr ʒiɛ so mini wɔr ʒiɛ taŋkpaɣu ni wɔr piɛlli dol o nyaaŋa.
en: I saw someone riding a red horse. He had stopped among some myrtle trees in a valley, and behind him were other horses—red, dappled, and white.

dag: Ka maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim daa yi bɛ ni be Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni luɣ shɛŋa zaa ni kul o sani.
en: From all the territory of Israel priests and Levites came south to Judah.

dag: Achiikatim, yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, ŋunkam niŋ yɛda mali nyɛvili din ka bahigu.
en: I can assure you that anyone who believes has eternal life.

dag: N suhu ni yɛla yi ti galisi pam, a suhukpaŋsibo nyɛla din tiri ma suhupiɛlli.
en: When my anxieties multiply, your comforting calms me down.

dag: Pool ni daa ti gbaai dunɔdura dubu, tɔbbihi maa daa kpuɣ o mi buɣi salo maa ni daa na kul bi chɛ o zuɣu.
en: When Paul reached the steps, he had to be carried by the soldiers in order to protect him from the violence of the crowd.

dag: N Naawuni, n tampiŋ, n ni sɔɣiri so sani. N nyɔtaɣirigu mini kpiɔŋlana ŋun tiligi ma. M birini mini n sɔɣisili shee, nyini n-nyɛ n tiligira ŋun tiligiri ma barina ni.
en: My God is my rock—I take refuge in him!— hes my shield and my salvations strength, my place of safety and my shelter. My savior! Save me from violence!.

dag: Dindali maa tɔbbihi bɛn mali suhukpeeni ni ti zaŋ bɛ bidibbina bahi ka zo ni nuzaŋa. Man Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: At that time even very brave soldiers will run away. They will not take the time to put their clothes on. This is what the Lord said.

dag: Ka bɛ daa niŋ lala n-chɛ ka bɛ zaa ʒini.
en: They did this, and all the people sat down.

dag: Di saha ka Juda zuliya daŋ kam ninvuɣ zuɣuri mini Bɛnjamin zuliya daŋ kam ninvuɣ zuɣuri ni maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim ni sokam bɛn nyɛ Naawuni ni daa neei shɛb suhuri daa mali shili ni bɛ kuli nti lab me Yawɛ duu maa Jɛrusalɛm.
en: Then the heads of the families of Judah and Benjamin, and the priests and the Levites—everyone whose spirit God had stirred up—got ready to go up and build Gods house in Jerusalem.

dag: Ka zaligubaŋda maa garigi yɛl o, Di sabiya, Yum a Duuma Naawuni ni a suhu zaa min a shia zaa ni a kpiɔŋ zaa ni a tɛha zaa, ka yum a ʒiʒiinikpee kaman amaŋmaŋ la. .
en: The man answered, Love the Lord your God with all your heart, all your soul, all your strength, and all your mind. Also, Love your neighbor the same as you love yourself. .

dag: Ka bɛn daa ʒe nimaani maa shɛb wum lala ka yɛli, Doo maa boonila Anabi Ilaija.
en: Some of the people standing there heard this. They said, He is calling Elijah.

dag: Yawɛ, a nyari paɣibu a kpiɔŋ zuɣu! Ti ni yili yila paɣ a yiko maa.
en: Show your strength, Lord , so that we may sing and praise your power.

dag: Di saha ka Rubin daa yɛl o ba, N yi bi ʒi Bɛnjamin kuna, nyin kum m bidibis ayi ŋɔ, chɛl o niŋ n nuu ni, n ni ʒi o kuna ti ti a.
en: Reuben said to his father, You may put both of my sons to death if I dont bring him back to you. Make him my responsibility, and I will make sure he returns to you.

dag: Ka o daa ʒiya n-wumdi Pool waazu, ka Pool ti mirig o nina kpa o n-nya ka o mali yɛda din ni chɛ ka o kpaŋ.
en: heard Paul speaking. Paul stared at him and saw that he believed he could be healed.

dag: Bɛ ni chɛ ka niriba baŋ a kpiɔŋ tuma min a nam dariza din galisi pam ŋɔ yɛla.
en: Then everyone will know about the mighty things you do and your glorious kingdom.

dag: Amaa wula ka Naawuni daa lee garigi yɛl o? O daa yɛl o, M mali niriba tusa ayopɔin bɛn na bi jɛm buɣili Baal.
en: But what answer did God give to Elijah? God said, I have kept for myself seven thousand men who have never given worship to Baal.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini ka n suhira.
en: I offer my life to you, LORD.

dag: Sara maligu bimbini maa ni ti nyɛla zaɣ mɔɣumɔɣu ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ mita ayɔbu, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita ayɔbu.
en: The place for the fire on the altar was cubits long by cubits wide. It was perfectly square.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yimiya! Bipuɣiŋga maa bi kpi, amaa o gbihirimi. Ka bɛ lar o.
en: Jesus said, Go away. The girl is not dead. She is only sleeping. But the people laughed at him.

dag: Ka Rɛmalia bia Pɛka ŋun daa nyɛ o sapashin kpɛm daa lo nia biɛɣu zaŋ chaŋ o polo, ka daa zaŋ Giliadnim ninvuɣ pihinu chaŋ Samaria nti kpe nayili puuni birini ni nti ŋme o luhi n-ku o, ka deei nam maa di n-zan o zaani.
en: The commander of Pekahiahs army was Pekah son of Remaliah. Pekah killed Pekahiah in Samaria at the kings palace. Pekah had men from Gilead with him when he killed Pekahiah. Then Pekah became the new king after him.

dag: Chɛ ka Izraɛlnim puhi Yaɣigari chuɣu di puhibu saha.
en: On the fourteenth day of this month, beginning at sunset, the people of Israel are to observe the Passover according to all the rules and regulations for it.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka a yurilim maŋli maa paai ma, ka tiligi ma kaman a daalikauli ni wuhi shɛm.
en: Show me your love and save me, Lord , as you have promised.

dag: Ka Musa mini Izraɛl kpamba maa daa lab yiŋa.
en: Then Moses and the leaders went back to camp.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa duhi Sulemaana pam Izraɛlnim zaa sani, ka lan chɛ ka o nam mali dariza pam gari na shɛb bɛn daa pun daŋ o tooni Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni maa zaa.
en: Moreover, the LORD magnified Solomon before all Israel, giving him such royal majesty as no king before him had enjoyed.

dag: Ninsal ni kul ni niŋ shɛli nyɛla o di ka nyu, ka di o tuma nyaɣisim. N nyaya ka dimbɔŋɔ gba nyɛla din yi Naawuni sanna.
en: Theres nothing better for human beings than to eat, drink, and experience pleasure in their hard work. I also saw that this is from Gods hand.

dag: M mabihi, m bɔri ni yi baŋ ni din niŋ ma la shiri sɔŋ chɛ ka lahibal suŋ la tuma chaŋ tooni.
en: Brothers and sisters, I want you to know that the things that have happened to me have actually advanced the gospel.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ daantalisi la mini kɔniŋdibin la ni di ni tam binshɛŋa zuɣu la ni la shɛŋa din kpalim tiŋ ŋɔ.
en: When King Nebuchadnezzar took away to Babylonia the king of Judah, Jehoiachin son of Jehoiakim, and the leading men of Judah and Jerusalem, he left the columns, the bronze tank, the carts, and some of the other Temple treasures.

dag: Nyama, bɛ yi kul ʒini luɣ shɛli bee bɛ yi kul yiɣisi luɣ shɛli, mani ka bɛ yiini yila tura.
en: Whether sitting or standing, look at how I am the object of their song of ridicule.

dag: N ʒiɛyimtali mini n yurilim maŋli kul ni be o ni; ka o ni di nasara n yuli zuɣu.
en: I will always love and support him. I will always make him strong.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yi deeri din simdi ba dunia ŋɔ ni, wula ka ninvuɣ biɛri mini alahichinim bɛn ku deeri din simdi ba?.
en: Those who are good are rewarded here on earth, so you can be sure that wicked and sinful people will be punished.

dag: Yɛlimaŋ shɛli n ni wum Naawuni sani, dina ka m mali tɔɣisiri ya ka yi bɔri ni yi ku ma maa, amaa Ibrahimma daa bi niŋdi lala.
en: I am someone who has told you the truth I heard from God. But you are trying to kill me. Abraham did nothing like that.

dag: Nir yi mali biɛla ka wuntitali be di ni, di so ni nir mali pam ka di bi doli yɛlimaŋli soli.
en: It is better to be poor and do right than to be rich and do wrong.

dag: Ka ti daa ti chani Naawuni suhibu shee n-tuhi bipuɣin so ŋun daa nyɛ dabili ka lan nyɛ kpilikparisilana soli. Bɛn daa su o daa diri kpilikparisi maa baɣitali nyɔri pam.
en: One day as we were going to the place of prayer, we were met by a young servant woman who had an evil spirit that enabled her to predict the future. She earned a lot of money for her owners by telling fortunes.

dag: n-saɣim di tinsi maa mini di vinvamli zaa ni tinsi maa niriba zaa ni tiŋgban ni bimbilli kam zaa.
en: He destroyed the whole valley—all the cities, the people living in the cities, and all the plants in the valley.

dag: Ka niriba maa daa yiɣisi daŋ Sool tooni chaŋ Zif. Di saha Dauda min o niriba daa bela Maɔn yɔɣu ni luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Araba, ka di be Jɛshimɔn nudirigu polo la.
en: So those people went back to Ziph before Saul. David and his men were in the desert of Maon, south of Jeshimon.

dag: Yɛlim ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, m bi yu ni ninvuɣ biɛri kpi. Amaa m bɔri ni ninvuɣ biɛri niŋla tuuba ka be, dama yinim Izraɛlnima, bɔzuɣu ka yi lee yɛn kpi.
en: Tell them that as surely as I am the living Lord God, I don't like to see wicked people die. I enjoy seeing them turn from their sins and live. So if the Israelites want to live, they must stop sinning and turn back to me.

dag: Ka Mɔza nyɛ Binia ba; o bihi n-daa nyɛ Rafa mini Ɛliasa ni Azɛl.
en: Binea, Raphah, Eleasah, Azel.

dag: Iso ŋun nyɛ bɛ ni daa lan booni so Ɛdom la zuliya ni nyɛ shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: Esau, also known as Edom, had many descendants.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Jɛrusalɛm m-bɔŋɔ, mani n-zaŋ li zali zuliya pam sunsuuni, ka chɛ ka tiŋgbɔna pam gil li.
en: The LORD God proclaims: This is Jerusalem! I have set her in the middle of the nations and surrounding countries.

dag: Ka bɛ daa paai Jɛrusalɛm; ka Yisa chaŋ ti kpe Naawuni jɛmbu duu nti kariti bɛn kɔhiri mini bɛn dari nɛma Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni, ka daari laɣitaɣiriba teebuya mini ŋmaŋkɔhiriba kuɣisi luhira;.
en: They came into Jerusalem. After entering the temple, he threw out those who were selling and buying there. He pushed over the tables used for currency exchange and the chairs of those who sold doves.

dag: Ka a yi nya li, a gba ni chaŋ ti pah a yaannim zuɣu kaman a biɛli Aduna ni pahi bɛ zuɣu shɛm la.
en: You will see it and then join your ancestors just as Aaron your brother has.

dag: Di saha ka nolɔɣu dii kum pahi buyi, ka Pita teei Yisa ni daa yɛl o ni nolɔɣu ti yɛn kum buyi o ni chihi siɣimsiɣim buta ni o bi mi ŋun Yisa la yɛla. Ka di daa niŋ Pita suhugarigu ka o kum pam.
