en: At that very moment, a rooster crowed a second time. Peter remembered what Jesus told him, Before a rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times. And he broke down, sobbing.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ wuhiri ni ti zaŋmi yɛda niŋbu maa saɣim Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa? Naawuni di wuhi gba! Ti lee ʒiɛla di nyaaŋa.
en: So do we destroy the law by following the way of faith? Not at all! In fact, faith causes us to be what the law actually wants.

dag: Amaa zuŋɔ yi zaɣisi yi Naawuni ŋun daa yihi ya azaaba mini muɣisigu ni maa. Ka yɛli, Aai! Bom naa ti ti. Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ yi zuliya kam laɣimmi tab gbilligbilli ka Yawɛ sanna.
en: But today you have rejected your God. Your God saves you from all your troubles and problems. But you said, No, we want a king to rule us. Now come, stand before the Lord in your family groups and tribes.

dag: Kum yi mali tayiɣisi ka bɛ zu bindirigu di, niriba ku lihi ʒiɛm ba di zuɣu.
en: A hungry man might steal to fill his stomach. If he is caught, he must pay seven times more than he stole. It might cost him everything he owns, but other people understand. They dont lose all their respect for him.

dag: Maligumaaniba daŋ ni, do shɛb bɛn daa kpuɣ tinzun paɣiba maa n-nyɛ: Jɔzadak bia Jɛshua min o mabihi daŋ ni: Maasɛya mini Ɛliɛza ni Jarib ni Gɛdalia.
en: Of the family of priests, there were found the following who had married foreign women—of the family of Jeshua, Jozadaks son and his brothers: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah.

dag: Di saha ka niriba maa zaa daa duhi bɛ yee n-garigi yɛl o, Yɛlimaŋli, ti ni niŋ a ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Everyone in the crowd shouted: You're right! We will do what you say.

dag: Nyin daadam, a ni kari saria, a ni kari tin shɛli nim bɛn kuri niriba ŋɔ saria? Di nyaaŋa ka a yɛli ba bɛ ni tum din chihiri shɛŋa zaa.
en: Mortal man, he said, are you ready to judge the city that is full of murderers? Make clear to her all the disgusting things she has done.

dag: Ka o nyaandoliba maa bɔh o, Ka ya polo ka ti lee yɛn nya bindirigu mɔɣu ŋɔ ni ti ninvuɣ gbaliŋ ŋɔ zaa ka bɛ di n-tiɣi.
en: The followers asked Jesus, Where can we get enough bread to feed all these people? We are a long way from any town.

dag: Bɛ ni ti kɔri taŋkpaɣu duhiduhi, ka me teei gili goma ni bɛ ku niriba pam. Firawuna min o tɔbbihi pam bɛn mali yaa ku tuhi tɔbu maa sɔŋ o.
en: Even the powerful army of the king of Egypt will not be able to help him fight when the Babylonians build earthworks and dig trenches in order to kill many people.

dag: Yɛlimiya Naawuni, A tuma mali dabiɛm pam. A yiko ni galisi zuɣu chɛ ka a dimnim gbaanila a tooni.
en: Say to God, How wonderful are the things you do! Your power is so great that your enemies bow down in fear before you.

dag: piɛri mini niɣi zaa ni mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri gba.
en: all sheep and all cattle, the wild animals too.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N suhu ka bɛ bɔri ni bɛ yiɣisi maa? Pa bɛmaŋmaŋ ka bɛ niŋ lala ni di ŋmaligi di ba maa.
en: But I am not the one they are really hurting. This message is from the Lord . They are only hurting themselves. They are bringing shame on themselves.

dag: ka bɔh o, Ka bindir bɔ ka a lee mali? Tim ma bɔrɔbɔro kpila anu bee a ni kul mali bindir shɛli kpe.
en: Now what do you have here with you? Give me five loaves of bread or whatever you can find.

dag: Di saha ka naa daa tim o sapashin so ŋun su tɔbbihi pihinu fukumsi min o tɔbbihi pihinu maa o sani. Ka sapashini maa daa chaŋ Ilaija sani ka o ti ʒila zoli zuɣu, ka o yɛl o, Naawuni nira, naa yɛliya, Siɣim na. .
en: So Ahaziah sent out a commander with fifty soldiers. The commander met up with Elijah while he was sitting on a hilltop. The commander said, Man of God, the king says, Come down.

dag: A yi ti karim gbaŋ ŋɔ naai, nyin zaŋmi li lo n-tabili kuɣili n-zaŋ li ti bahi Yufretiiz Mɔɣili sunsuuni.
en: When you finish reading the scroll, tie a stone to it and throw it into the Euphrates River.

dag: Ka n daa dihi n nuu di gbana zuɣu, ka zaŋ n dalinli dihi tabili li, ka chɛ ka shɛhiranim kana ka n ti zahim liɣiri maa sania zuɣu.
en: I signed and sealed the deed, had it witnessed, and weighed out the money on scales.

dag: Ka Rubin zuliya daa yiɣisi zaŋ bɛ tuuta doli tab gbilligbilli pa bɛ zuɣu. Shɛdiu bia Ɛlizu n-daa nyɛ bɛ zaa zuɣulana.
en: The banner of Reubens camp marched with its military units. Elizur, Shedeurs son, commanded its military.

dag: Ka yuun shɛli din pahir anahi ni, di wala zaa ni nyɛla wal suma ka ni nyɛla wumpaɣibo sara pina Yawɛ sani.
en: In the fourth year all the fruit shall be dedicated as an offering to show your gratitude to me, the Lord .

dag: Di saha ka Pita yɛl o, Nyama, ti chɛla binshɛɣukam ka dol a.
en: Peter said to Jesus, We left everything to follow you.

dag: Ŋun mali tibili, ŋun wummi Naawuni Shia Kasi ni yɛli cheechinim shɛm! Ŋun di nasara ti ku lan kpi kum din pahi buyi la yaha.
en: If you can hear, listen to what the Spirit is saying to the churches. Those who emerge victorious wont be hurt by the second death.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yɛli, Aai, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ n Duuma ŋɔ, n na ʒi n-saɣim mmaŋa. M bilim ni hal ni zuŋɔ n na ʒi ŋ-ŋubi biŋkɔb kpiŋ bee mɔɣu ni biŋkɔbiri ni ku biŋkɔb so. Ka nimdi din pooi mi na ʒi n-lu n noli ni.
en: But I replied, No, Sovereign Lord ! I have never defiled myself. From childhood on I have never eaten meat from any animal that died a natural death or was killed by wild animals. I have never eaten any food considered unclean.

dag: Ŋuna n-gbaari yɛnnim bɛ yɛŋkiŋkabina ni, ka yɛŋkiŋkabinanim ni lo nia shɛŋa zaani tariga yomyom.
en: in their own evil schemes, and their wisdom fails.

dag: Bɛ daa gbahi bɛ biŋkɔbbaligu mini niɣi ni bunsi, ka zaŋ binshɛlikam zaa din be tiŋ maa puuni mini din be mɔɣu ni.
en: They took the flocks, the cattle, the donkeys, and everything else in the city and in the fields.

dag: O daa niŋ yɛm n-zaŋ o bidibisi maa shɛba tahi Juda mini Bɛnjamin zuliya niriba tiŋgbana yaɣa zaa ni ti ʒili bɛ ni me goondahi gili fɔntin shɛŋa la zaa ni, ka ti ba bɛ ni bɔri shɛlikam, ka lan bo paɣiba pam ti ba.
en: Rehoboam was wise enough to put one of his sons in charge of each fortified city in his kingdom. He gave them all the supplies they needed and found wives for every one of them.

dag: Ka bɛ ni shɛb ni nyɛla ninkuunsinima mini halikpɛmanima ni munaafichinima ni bɛn bi gbaari bɛmaŋa ni ninvuɣ yarisi ni bɛn je zaɣ suŋ.
en: They will have no love for others and will refuse to forgive anyone. They will talk about others to hurt them and will have no self-control. They will be cruel and hate what is good.

dag: Bɛ chɛ ka bɛ zilima dirimi kaman tinvura zilima la, ka garinsi lɔɣu be bɛ noya ni.
en: Their words are as harmful as the fangs of a snake, as deadly as its venom. Selah.

dag: O daa niŋ li wuhi ya ni di chɛ ka yi baŋ ni Yawɛ n-nyɛ Naawuni, ka so lan kani pah o zuɣu.
en: The Lord showed you all this so that you would know that he is God. There is no other god like him.

dag: Yawɛ yɛliya, N ni ti lan labisi Mɔabnim daazichi ti ba dabisa shɛŋa din bahindi nyaaŋa puuni. Mɔabnim tibidarigibo tariga m-bala.
en: But in the days to come Ill bring back Moab from captivity, declares the LORD. Such is the judgment on Moab.

dag: n ni chɛ ka a nam kul beni sahakam kaman n ni daa lo a ba Dauda alikauli n-yɛli ni so kul ku kɔŋ o daŋ ni ŋun ni di nam su Izraɛlnim la.
en: and I will keep my solemn promise to him that someone from your family will always be king of Israel.

dag: Dabiɛm ka bɛ yinsi puuni, ka Naawuni bi darigiri bɛ tibili.
en: Their homes are safe and free from fear. God does not punish them.

dag: O daa zaŋ bɛ tiŋgbana ti o niriba Izraɛlnima. O daa zaŋ li ti ba ni bɛ su li.
en: He gave their lands to his people; he gave them to Israel.

dag: O ni ti yihi biŋkɔb yino yi biŋkɔbiri pia kam puuni ka yi ti leeg o daba.
en: He will take a tenth of your flocks. And you yourselves will become his slaves.

dag: Ka bɛ daa zaŋ ba paai sariakaritib sani ti yɛli, Niriba ŋɔ nyɛla Yɛhudianima, ka saɣindi ti tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ.
en: They brought them before the Roman officials and said, These men are Jews, and they are causing trouble in our city.

dag: Bɛ nini daa nya Yawɛ tuma din nyɛ o daalahiziba tuma la teeku bulli maa ni.
en: They saw what the Lord can do, his wonderful acts on the seas.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan yɛl taba, Ti ku nya ti ni yɛn zaŋ yɛl shɛli fiɣisi Daniɛl, naɣila zaŋ chaŋ o Naawuni jɛma la polo.
en: They said to each other, We are not going to find anything of which to accuse Daniel unless it is something in connection with his religion.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa lan chɛ ka Shɛkɛmnim gba nya bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali tibidarigibo kaman Gidiɔn bia Jɔtan la ni daa pun yɛli noli ti ba wuhi ni di ni niŋ ba shɛm la.
en: God also paid back the people of Shechem for their evil. The curse of Jotham, Jerubbaals son, had come upon them.

dag: Amaa ka niriba maa puuni zuliya kam daa bahi me bɛmaŋmaŋ buɣa n-zaŋ zalizali Samarianim ni daa jɛmdi buɣa luɣ shɛŋa la. Zuliya kam daa me buɣa maa zalizal la bɛ ni be tin shɛŋa ni.
en: But the people who settled in Samaria continued to make their own idols, and they placed them in the shrines that the Israelites had built. Each different group made idols in the cities they were living in:.

dag: M bia, a yi lo a ʒiʒiinikpee alikauli bee a yi lo amaŋa nia ti so.
en: My child, have you promised to be responsible for someone else's debts?.

dag: Dama o zaligunim zaa kul dola n tooni, ka n na ʒi n-zaɣis o zaligu shɛŋa din pahi la gba.
en: All his rules are right in front of me; I havent turned away from any of his laws.

dag: Kum mini kpiimba biɛhigu shee ni na ʒi n-tiɣi shɛm la, lala ka ninsal nina gba na ʒi n-tiɣi.
en: The grave and the underworld are never satisfied; and peoples eyes are never satisfied.

dag: Amaa Sirianim maa ni daa nya ka Izraɛlnim nyaŋ ba maa, ka bɛ daa tim tuumba Sirianim bɛn daa be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili dul la nim sani nti zaŋ ba na, Ka Shɔbak ŋun daa nyɛ Hadadɛza kamɔna kpɛm la ti leei bɛ zuɣulana.
en: The Syrians realized that they had been defeated by the Israelites, so they brought troops from the Syrian states on the east side of the Euphrates River and placed them under the command of Shobach, commander of the army of King Hadadezer of Zobah.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa kum o kuli, ka zaŋ o ti sɔɣi kaman Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka o dabili anabi Ahija yɛli shɛm la.
en: They buried him and all the people of Israel cried for him. This happened just as the Lord said it would through his servant, the prophet Ahijah.

dag: Buɣa palila bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ni, ka bɛ jɛmdi bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali binshɛŋa.
en: Everywhere in the country they worship the idols they have made.

dag: Zallakudura Naa ni daa ti zuliyanim bɛ tiŋgbana saha shɛl o ni daa woligi daadamnima, o daa zali zuliya kam tintarisi kaman Izraɛlnim kalinli ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: God Most High separated the people on earth and gave each nation its land. He set up borders for all people. He made as many nations as there are angels.

dag: A ni be alizanda ni a biɛhigu shee din be kasi ka mali jilima ŋɔ, lihim na nya. A baɣa ni daa yi be ti ni shɛm ni a yiko la lee kpalimla ya? A yurilim min a nambɔzɔbo la lan kani zaŋ kana ti sani.
en: Lord , look upon us from heaven, where you live in your holiness and glory. Where is your great concern for us? Where is your power? Where are your love and compassion? Do not ignore us.

dag: Amaa n ni kpalim be Ɛfɛsus hal ti paai Pɛntikɔst dali;.
en: I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost.

dag: Ŋunkam doli zaligu, zaɣ biɛɣu ku paag o, ka yɛndana mi o ni yɛn niŋ lala saha shɛli.
en: People will be safe if they obey his command. But wise people know the right time to do this, and they also know when to do the right thing.

dag: Jɛrusalɛm din be dabitim ni ŋɔ, yiɣisim taŋkpaɣu ni n-dam amaŋa. Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga ŋun be dabitim ni ŋɔ, yihim mii din be a nyiŋgol ni bahi.
en: Zion, rise from the dirt! Free yourself from the rope around your neck.

dag: Kum chɛ ka ti niŋgbuna biimi kaman duduhugu puuni la.
en: Hunger has made us burn with fever until our skin is as hot as an oven.

dag: ka bɛ niriba ayi maa be kaman ninvuɣ yino la. Lala zuɣu n yɛri ya mi, bɛ lan pala niriba ayi yaha.
en: And the two people will become one. So they are no longer two, but one.

dag: Bɛ yi dɔɣi bihi pam takɔbi n-yɛn ku bɛ zaa, ka bɛ bihi ka bindirigu din ni di n-tiɣi.
en: They may have many sons, but all will be killed in war; their children never have enough to eat.

dag: Bɛ daa yiɣi du zuɣusaa ha n-lab ti lu bulli ni, ka dabiɛm daa kpe ba bɛ barina maa puuni.
en: The waves lifted them high into the sky and dropped them into the deep sea. The storm was so dangerous that the men lost their courage.

dag: Ka Absalom mini Izraɛlnim zaa daa yɛli, Hushai ŋun nyɛ Ariki nir ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm ŋɔ ne nini gari Ahitɔfɛl ni yɛli shɛm la. Dama Yawɛ daa zaliya ni Ahitɔfɛl ni yɛli shɛm maa di nya nasara, ka di chɛ ka ŋun Yawɛ chɛ ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai Absalom.
en: Absalom and all the Israelites said, Hushai's advice is better than Ahithophel's. The Lord had decided that Ahithophel's good advice would not be followed, so that disaster would come on Absalom.

dag: Nahɔr ni daa ti paai yuun pihitayinika saha shɛli ka o daa dɔɣi Tɛra.
en: When Nahor was , he had a son named Terah.

dag: Tahima ŋɔ puuni ka ti daa tiligi; amaa pa nir nini ni nya shɛli n-nyɛ tahima, dama ŋuni n-lee ni niŋ tahima o nini ni nya shɛli zuɣu?.
en: We were saved to have this hope. If we can see what we are waiting for, that is not really hope. People dont hope for something they already have.

dag: A mabihi maa, Sɔdom mini di tiŋkpansi zaa ni labi di biɛri kurili ni. Ka Samaria mini di tiŋkpansi ti labi di biɛri kurili ni. Ka a gba min a bipuɣinsi zaa ni ti labi yi biɛri kurili ni.
en: They will become prosperous again, and you and your villages will also be restored.

dag: Amaa bɔhimi biŋkɔbiri ka bɛ wuh a; ka bɔhi noonsi ka bɛ yɛl a;.
en: If you want to learn, then go and ask the wild animals and the birds.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Miri ka a kpe bɛ ni kuhiri kuyila yili shɛli ni bee n-fabili bɛ zuɣu bee n-kum bɛ zuɣu, dama man yihi n suhudoo mini n yurilim din bi taɣira ni n nambɔzɔbo niriba ŋɔ ni.
en: When someone dies, don't visit the family or show any sorrow. I will no longer love or bless or have any pity on the people of Judah.

dag: Nyin ʒirilana ŋɔ, a yu yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa din biɛri niriba tɔɣisibu!.
en: You love to say cruel things, and your words are a trap.

dag: Jɔn Baptaizira nyaandoliba mini Farisiinim daa ti lɔri noli; ka ninvuɣ shɛb kana nti bɔhi Yisa, Bɔ niŋ ka Jɔn nyaandoliba mini Farisiinim nyaandoliba lɔri noli, ka nyin nyaandoliba bi lɔra.
en: The followers of John and the Pharisees were fasting. Some people came to Jesus and said, Johns followers fast, and the followers of the Pharisees fast. But your followers dont fast. Why.

dag: Ka niriba daa ʒiri barinim bɛ bindɔhi zuɣu mini bɛ daamaŋkanim ni na nti sɔŋdi sɔnaŋgbanyɛhi ni Pita ti gariti ka o shilinshia mahim lee lu bɛ ni shɛb zuɣu.
en: Then sick people were brought out to the road and placed on mats. It was hoped that Peter would walk by, and his shadow would fall on them and heal them.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn mali nandahima mal alibarika, dama Naawuni ni ti maai bɛ suhuri.
en: Happy are those who mourn; God will comfort them!.

dag: Ka naa daa yɛli Naawuni nir maa, Balimmi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni maa, ka suh o ti ma ka o chɛ ka n nuu ŋɔ lan lab di bebu ni yaha. Ka Naawuni nir maa daa suhi Yawɛ, ka naa maa nuu maa nya alaafee n-lan be kaman di ni daa pun be shɛm.
en: Please pray to the Lord your God and ask him to heal my hand, Jeroboam begged. The prophet prayed, and Jeroboam's hand was healed.

dag: ni Zɔra ni Aijalɔn ni Hiburɔn. O ni daa me goondahi gili Juda mini Bɛnjamin fɔntin shɛŋa m-bala.
en: Zorah, Aijalon, and Hebron.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naawuni ŋɔ, deem n suhigu. Yaakubu Naawuni, gbilisim tibili wum!.
en: Lord God All-Powerful, listen to my prayer. God of Jacob, listen to me. Selah.

dag: Ka Dauda daa garigi yɛli Mikal, Yawɛ ŋun daa pii ma ka duhi ma gar a ba min o yiŋnim zaa, ka zaŋ ma leei nabia ni n su Izraɛlnim bɛn nyɛ ŋun Yawɛ niriba ŋɔ tooni ka n di wari waa maa, ka di simdi ni m mali suhupiɛlli Yawɛ tooni.
en: Then David said to Michal, The Lord chose me, not your father or anyone from his family. The Lord chose me to be leader of his people, the Israelites. So I will continue dancing and celebrating in front of the Lord .

dag: Ka Naawuni daa chɛ ka nambɔzɔbo kpe Ashpɛnaz suhu ni zaŋ chaŋ Daniɛl polo.
en: and God made Ashpenaz sympathetic to Daniel.

dag: nti kaŋka bɛ daalahichi ka o naanyi baptaizi ba Jɔɔdɛn mɔɣili maa ni.
en: They confessed their sins, and he baptized them in the Jordan.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa yuya pun bi sabi niŋ Piɛbil so bɛ ni daa ku la nyɛvili litaafi la ni tun dunia piligu ni la ha ni ti jɛm biŋkɔbigu maa.
en: The beast was worshiped by everyone whose name wasn't written before the time of creation in the book of the Lamb who was killed.

dag: bɛn mali suhupiɛlli zaɣ biɛɣu tumbu ni ka lan mali suhupiɛlli yɛtɔɣ biɛri tɔɣisibu ni la nuu ni.
en: They enjoy doing evil, rejoicing in their twisted evil.

dag: N bɔbi n gar bila zali. N zaŋla Ijipti tampiɛl shɛŋa bɛ ni niŋ shim niŋ pa di zuɣu.
en: Ive spread my bed with luxurious covers, with colored linens from Egypt.

dag: Di yɛla daa naɣ ti yila ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn pa ti mabi maŋa la sanna. Bɛ daa kamina nti kpe ti ni ni bɛ puɣisi baŋ ti ni mali yolisim shɛli Yisa Masia ni din ni chɛ ka bɛ kpɛhi ti dabitim ni.
en: We needed to talk about these problems, because some who pretended to be our brothers had come into our group secretly. They came in like spies to find out about the freedom we have in Christ Jesus. They wanted to make us slaves.

dag: Ka nyin Firawuna ni nya zahindi maa buyi la wuhiya ni Naawuni n-zal li, ka ni chɛ ka di ku yuui, ka di niŋ.
en: The repetition of your dream means that the matter is fixed by God and that he will make it happen in the near future.

dag: Bɛ ni ti zaŋ paɣa n-tin ya, amaa ka do so zaŋ o dɔni, yi ni ti me yi yili ka bi kpe di ni. Yi ni ti sa yi wain tihi, ka ku di di wala.
en: You will be engaged to a young woman—but someone else will marry her. You will build a house—but never live in it. You will plant a vineyard—but never eat its grapes.

dag: Ka ŋuni n-lee ni tooi nya bɛ taali? Yisa Masia n-nyɛ ŋun daa kpi; ka din gari lala nyɛla, ŋuna n-daa neei kum ni, ka ʒi Naawuni nudirigu polo n-suhiri Naawuni tiri ti.
en: Who is going to convict them? It is Christ Jesus who died, even more, who was raised, and who also is at Gods right side. It is Christ Jesus who also pleads our case for us.

dag: Yawɛ, deemi n suhigu, dama a yurilim maŋli la viɛla. A nambɔzɔbo din galisi pam la zuɣu, ŋmaligim m polo na.
en: Answer me, Lord , from the goodness of your faithful love. Out of your great kindness turn to me and help me!.

dag: Ka Abimilɛk yɛl o, M bi mi ŋun daa niŋ lala maa, ka a mi daa bi yɛli ma, ka n gba mi na bi wum di yɛla shee zuŋɔ ka n ti wum li maa.
en: But Abimelech said, I dont know who did this. You never told me about this before today.

dag: Ka bɛ yi ti kul zaɣisi alahiziba tuma ayi ŋɔ dihi tabili bee n-zaɣisi ni bɛ ku wum a yɛligu, nyin toomi Nail Mɔɣili la kom kpaai bahi tiŋkuŋ zuɣu ka di leei ʒim tiŋkuŋ maa zuɣu.
en: If in spite of these two miracles they still will not believe you, and if they refuse to listen to what you say, take some water from the Nile and pour it on the ground. The water will turn into blood.

dag: Amaa ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa mini Aduna, Yi bi niŋ ma yɛda, ka bi wuhi n ni be kasi shɛm Izraɛlnim sani, dinzuɣu yi ku zaŋ ba kuli tiŋgbɔn shɛli n ni zaŋ ti ba maa ni.
en: But the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, Because you refused to believe in my power, these people did not respect me. And so, you will not be the ones to lead them into the land I have promised.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ o binnamda zaa, ka be o nam sulinsi ni zaa ŋɔ, paɣimiya ŋun Yawɛ. M paɣiri Yawɛ n suhu ni.
en: Everything the Lord has made should praise him throughout the world that he rules! My soul, praise the Lord !.

dag: N Duuma ŋun nyɛ n tiligira ŋɔ, niŋm yomyom sɔŋ ma!.
en: Help me now, O Lord my savior!.

dag: Ka naa maa daa ʒi o dufahirili zuɣusaa zɔntu mahili ni, ka Ɛhud ka o sanna ti yɛl o, M malila yɛtɔɣ shɛli din yi Naawuni sanna ni n-yɛl a. Ka naa maa vaai yiɣis o ʒiishee zani.
en: Ehud went to King Eglon. The king was sitting all alone in the upper room of his palace. Then Ehud said, I have a message from God for you. The king stood up from his throne. He was very close to Ehud.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli ka n yɛri ya, o ni ti zaŋ o binshɛɣukam fukumsi niŋ o yiŋbia maa nuu ni.
en: I can tell you without a doubt, the master will choose that servant to take care of everything he owns.

dag: Dunianim ku tooi zaɣisi ya, amaa bɛ ni zaɣisi mani, n ni yɛri ni bɛ tuma bie la zuɣu.
en: The world cannot hate you, but it hates me, because I keep telling it that its ways are bad.

dag: Niriba maa ni daa wum Dauda yɛtɔɣa maa ka bɛ chaŋ ti yɛli Sool, ka o daa tim ti bol o na.
en: Some men heard what David had said, and they told Saul, who sent for him.

dag: Daadam, n yɛn zaŋla a ni yuri ninvuɣ so pam yim ka chɛ a. Amaa miri ka a ti fabili bee n-kum bee n-chɛ ka nintam yi a ninni.
en: Mortal man, he said, with one blow I am going to take away the person you love most. You are not to complain or cry or shed any tears.

dag: Amaa ka Yisa yɛl o, Di karitiy o, dama ŋunkam bi galindi ya bela yi polo.
en: But Jesus replied, Dont stop him, because whoever isnt against you is for you.

dag: Di ŋmanila zabiliga tibiɛl shɛli nir ni zaŋ bir o puu ni, ka di zooi niŋ tia hal ka noonsi ti tɛri bɛ tɛri di wula zuɣu la.
en: It is like what happens when someone plants a mustard seed in a garden. The seed grows as big as a tree, and birds nest in its branches.

dag: Amaa o daa bi baŋ o ni paɣitali hal ka o ti dɔɣ o paɣisar dɔɣim bidibiga; ka Yisifu daa bol o yuli Yisa.
en: But Joseph did not have sexual relations with her until her son was born. And he named him Jesus.

dag: O doonila gɔtihi gbin ni, ka baa ni kaɣili lims o.
en: He lies down under the thorn bushes, and hides among the reeds in the swamp.

dag: n-zaŋ li ti sa vuhim shee, kom ni be luɣ shɛli pam din ni chɛ ka di niŋ wula n-wali wala, ka niŋ yɔɣili din mali jilima.
en: The grapevine was planted in a good field near plenty of water. It could have grown branches and fruit. It could have become a very good grapevine.

dag: Bɛ ni ŋmɛri bɔɣiri tampiŋ sɔŋdi tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni shɛm la, lala ka bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ kɔba bahi gballi nol ni.
en: Like rocks in a field that a farmer has plowed, so our bones will be scattered in the grave.

dag: Amaa ka o yɛl o, N Duuma, n suhir a, taɣimi tim so.
en: Moses begged, Lord , please send someone else to do it.

dag: O daa zaŋ o ba ni daa zaŋ pin shɛŋa la min omaŋmaŋ ni daa zaŋ pin shɛŋa ti Yawɛ ka di nyɛ anzinfa mini salima ni lahi la ti zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu.
en: He brought into the LORDs temple the silver and gold equipment that he and his father had dedicated.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Gazanim ni Samsin be nimaani, ka bɛ laɣimna ti teei gil o ni be shɛli maa, ka chaŋ ti gu o tiŋ maa gooni dunol ni yuŋ zaa. Bɛ daa kul fomi chichi dindali maa yuŋ maa, ka yɛra Ti ni do n-gul o hal ka biɛɣu ti neei ka ti ku o.
en: The people who lived in Gaza found out he was there, and they decided to kill him at sunrise. So they went to the city gate and waited all night in the guardrooms on each side of the gate.

dag: Yɛlim niriba maa mi ni Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Nyamiya, n zaŋla nyɛvili soli mini kum soli sɔŋ ya.
en: Also tell the people of Jerusalem, This is what the Lord says: Understand that I will let you choose to live or die.

dag: Sabimi n-ti Ɛfɛsus Cheechi malaika n-yɛl o ni ŋun gbibi saŋmaris ayopɔin o nudirigu ni m-be salima firilatamdis ayopɔin sunsuuni n-chani gindi la ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: To the angel of the church in Ephesus write: This is the message from the one who holds the seven stars in his right hand and who walks among the seven gold lampstands.

dag: yin piimiya tin shɛŋa ka di nyɛ tiliginsim tinsi zali. Ka nir yi ku ninsal sarati kubu, o ni tooi zo n-kuli nimaani.
en: choose Safe Towns, where a person who has accidentally killed someone can run for protection.

dag: Yisifu zuliya ni, Manaasa zuliya ni toondana n-nyɛ Ɛfɔd bia Hanniɛl.
en: from the descendants of Joseph; from the tribe of Manasseh—Hanniel son of Ephod;.

dag: Ka di yi nyɛla biŋkɔb so ŋun bi be kasi, dindina o ni tooi yo yi ni zal o da shɛli, ka yo o daa maa pirigibu ʒiibunu yim zuɣu pahi bee o yi bi yo ka deeg o, dindina yin kɔhimiy o yi ni zal o da shɛli.
en: If you promise me a donkey, you may buy it back by adding an additional percent to its value. If you don't buy it back, it can be sold to someone else for whatever a priest has said it is worth.

dag: Dinzuɣu n yɛri ya mi, zaŋmiya yi dunia ŋɔ laɣ yoya ŋɔ bo simdi, ka di yi ti naai, yi ni tooi kpe nyɛvili din ka bahigu shee.
en: And Jesus went on to say, And so I tell you: make friends for yourselves with worldly wealth, so that when it gives out, you will be welcomed in the eternal home.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa, Firawuna suhu kpɛm pam; o zaɣisiya ni o ku chɛ ka niriba maa chaŋ.
en: The Lord said to Moses: The Egyptian king stubbornly refuses to change his mind and let the people go.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daanfaani din nyɛ pin la n-chɛ ka bɛ yi taali ni ŋun Naawuni sani tiliginsim shɛli din be Yisa Masia ni la zuɣu.
en: but all are treated as righteous freely by his grace because of a ransom that was paid by Christ Jesus.

dag: Wuntizɔriba yɛtɔɣa nyɛla yɛm yɛtɔɣa. Ka bɛ kul tɔɣisirila din tuhi yɛla.
en: Words of wisdom come when good people speak for justice.

dag: Zalim ba dimbɔŋɔ lala, ka di chɛ ka bɛ ku mali galimi.
en: Tell the believers there to take care of their family so that no one can say they are doing wrong.

dag: Amaa yi lee nyɛla bɛn duhiri yimaŋa ka nyuri bara. Ka barinyubo ŋɔ tatabo zaa nyɛla zaɣ biɛɣu.
en: But now you boast and brag, and all such boasting is evil.

dag: bee n-zaŋ o nuu ŋme o dim ku o, dindina ŋun ŋme o maa nyɛla ninvuɣ kura, ka ŋun yɛn bɔhi biɛri maa yi nya ninvuɣ kura maa, ŋun kum o.
en: Or if in hostility someone strikes another with his hand and he dies, the one who struck is a murderer and he will be put to death. The close relative will put the murderer to death when he meets him.

dag: Ka Yisa daa duh o zuɣu n-nya ka salo pam kani o sanna, ka o naanyi bɔhi Filip, Ya polo ka ti lee yɛn nya bindirigu n-da n-ti niriba ŋɔ zaa ka bɛ di n-tiɣi.
en: Jesus looked up and saw the large crowd coming toward him. He asked Philip, Where will we buy food to feed these people.

dag: Din pahi dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu, yi mi ni pumpɔŋɔ nyɛla nimmoo saha ka di simdi ni yi neei gom ni, dama pumpɔŋɔ ka tiliginsim miri ti n-gari ti ni daa tuui niŋ yɛda saha shɛl la.
en: As you do all this, you know what time it is. The hour has already come for you to wake up from your sleep. Now our salvation is nearer than when we first had faith.

dag: Ka lan bɔhi taba, O ni yɛli ni di kpari biɛla maa gbinni lee nyɛla wula? Ti bi baŋ o ni yɛli shɛm maa gbinni.
en: What is this little while that he is talking about? We don't know what he means.

dag: Wuntaŋ ku lan nyɛ yi neesim wuntaŋ ni. Ka goli gba ku lan nyɛ yi neesim yuŋ. Man Yawɛ n-yɛn nyɛ yi neesim sahakam, ka mani ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ jilima neesim ni nɛn ya.
en: No longer will the sun be your light by day Or the moon be your light by night; I, the Lord , will be your eternal light; The light of my glory will shine on you.

dag: Ka lala chɛ ka o ku duh omaŋ yaɣ o mabihi maa sani, ka mi ku birigi fukumsi zaligu maa n-kpa nudirigu polo bee nuzaa polo din ni chɛ ka o min o zuliya ti di nam yuui Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: This will keep him from thinking that he is better than other Israelites and from disobeying the Lord 's commands in any way. Then he will reign for many years, and his descendants will rule Israel for many generations.

dag: Pɔhim ni ti ʒe yi zuɣulaannim chaŋ, ka bɛ ti gbahi yi ni yuri shɛba leei daba n-zaŋ ba chaŋ, ka vi ti gbahi ya ka di gari ya yi ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma zaa zuɣu.
en: Your shepherds will be tossed to the wind, your lovers taken off to exile. Then you will be embarrassed and humiliated by all your wickedness.

dag: Ka Firawuna daa yɛl o, Cham ti sɔɣ a ba kaman o ni daa chɛ ka a po ni a ni niŋ shɛm maa.
en: The king answered, Go to Canaan and keep your promise to your father.

dag: Ka Samsin daa ti yɛli ninvuɣ so ŋun gbib o nuu vɔr o, Chɛ ka m bɔbili gbaai duu ŋɔ ni tam daantal shɛŋa zuɣu n-zaŋ mmaŋ dalim li.
en: Samson said to the boy who was leading him by the hand, Let me touch the columns that hold up the building. I want to lean on them.

dag: Dinzuɣu bahim noli ka bɛ chaŋ ti guli siliga maa viɛnyɛliŋga hal ti paai daba ata maa dali, ka di chɛ ka o nyaandoliba ti ku chaŋ ti zu n-yih o ka yɛli niriba ni o neela kum ni, ka yɔhiŋgu din bahindi nyaaŋa maa ni ti bie n-gari tuuli din la.
en: So give the order for the tomb to be guarded well for three days. His followers might come and try to steal the body. Then they could tell everyone that he has risen from death. That lie will be even worse than what they said about him before.

dag: Wummiya zoya zuɣu vuri, salo vuri n-nyɛ li. Wummiya nama balibu mini zuliya balibu niriba tab laɣimbu vuri. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ n-laɣindi tɔbbihi ni o tuhi tɔbu.
en: Listen to the noise on the mountains—the sound of a great crowd of people, the sound of nations and kingdoms gathering. The Lord of Armies is preparing his troops for battle.

dag: Bɛ ni zaŋ bɛ tɔbiri mini bɛ piɛma n-to n-ku bipola. Bɛ ku zo biliɛri mini bibihi nambɔɣu.
en: They will walk on the bows of the young soldiers of Babylon. The enemy soldiers will not show any kindness or mercy even to the babies and young children.

dag: Di simdi ni a guni bɛ ni dɔɣi dab so a yiŋa min a ni zaŋ a liɣiri da so na zaa. Dina n-ni chɛ ka n daalikauli maa be yi niŋgbuna ni n-nyɛ alikauli din ni be sahakam.
en: Be sure you circumcise those born in your household and those purchased with your silver. Your flesh will embody my covenant as an enduring covenant.

dag: Buŋ maa ni daa nya Yawɛ malaika maa, ka o teei dɔni Balaam jɔɣu ni, ka Balaam suhu daa yiɣisi pam, ka o zaŋ o jaaŋgbe bil fiɛbi buŋ maa.
en: The donkey saw the Lord s angel. So the donkey lay down with Balaam sitting on top of it. Balaam was very angry at the donkey. So he hit it with his walking stick.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli ba, Yi yi ti nya ka Sirianim maa yɛn nyaŋ ma, yin zomiya n kuŋa, ka m mi yi ti nya ka Ammɔnnim maa yɛn nyaŋ ya, n ni zo yi kuŋa.
en: Joab said to him, If you see that the Syrians are defeating me, come and help me, and if the Ammonites are defeating you, I will go and help you.

dag: Ka bia maa ba maa baŋ ni di nyɛla saha shɛli Yisa ni sa yɛl o ni o bia maa ni gal la. Ka o min o yiŋnim zaa daa niŋ yɛda.
en: The father knew that one oclock was the same time that Jesus had said, Your son will live. So the man and everyone in his house believed in Jesus.

dag: Di saha ka Absalom daa yɛli naa, N suhir a mi, a yi ku chaŋ, nyin lee chɛ ka ti mini m mabia Amnɔn chaŋ. Ka naa daa bɔh o, Bɔzuɣu ka a lee bɔri ni yi min o chaŋ.
en: But Absalom said, Well, then, will you at least let my brother Amnon come? Why should he? the king asked.

dag: A kɔŋko ka n tum alahichi maa, ka tum din nyɛ zaɣ biɛɣu a sani. Dinzuɣu a niŋ din tuhi, a ni wuhi ni m mali taali la puuni; a ka galimi a ni kari ma saria shɛm maa gba puuni.
en: Ive sinned against you—you alone. Ive committed evil in your sight. Thats why you are justified when you render your verdict, completely correct when you issue your judgment.

dag: Ka Lɛvinim maa daa zaŋ Alikauli Adaka maa tam dapuhi zuɣu n-zaŋ li buɣi bɛ bɔɣusapima zuɣu kaman Yawɛ ni daa yɛli Musa ka o zali shɛm la.
en: The Levites used the special poles to carry Gods Holy Box on their shoulders, the way Moses commanded. They carried the Holy Box just as the Lord had said.

dag: ni o ti kari sokam zaa saria, ka nya bɛnkam zaa bi luri Naawuni sizuura la taali, ka di nyɛla bɛ ni tumdi tuun biɛ shɛŋa mini bɛna bɛn nyɛ alahichinim maa ni tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣ biɛ shɛŋa dalim ŋun Naawuni la zuɣu.
en: to bring judgment on all, to condemn them all for the godless deeds they have performed and for all the terrible words that godless sinners have spoken against him.

dag: Pa n nuhi ka n daa zaŋ nam dimbɔŋɔnim zaa.
en: Didnt I make all these things with my own hand? .

dag: Dinzuɣu gol so ŋun daa daŋ tooni yuun shɛli din pahir ayi maa ni dahin yini dali, ka o daa sa Naawuni biɛhigu shee suɣili maa.
en: So the Holy Tent was set up at the right time. It was the first day of the first month during the second year from the time they left Egypt.

dag: Yawɛ n-su tiŋgbani ŋɔ mini binshɛɣukam din be di ni; ka su dunia ŋɔ mini bɛnkam zaa be di ni.
en: The world and all that is in it belong to the Lord ; the earth and all who live on it are his.

dag: Lahibali suŋ din yi tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni katiŋ na ŋmanila kɔnyuri ni yi wum nir ka o ti nya komahili la.
en: Good news from a faraway place is like a cool drink of water when you are hot and thirsty.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ma, Daadam, a nya Izraɛl kpamba ni tumdi tuun shɛŋa zibisim ni bebɔ? Sokam bela o binnana duu. Dama bɛ yɛlimi, Yawɛ bi nya ti, Yawɛ chɛla tiŋgbani maa bahi. .
en: He said to me: Human one, do you see what the elders of the house of Israel are doing in the dark, every one of them in their rooms full of sculptured images? They say, The LORD doesnt see us; the LORD has abandoned the land.

dag: Ka m mi ni o zaligu nyɛla din tiri nyɛvili din ka bahigu. Dinzuɣu n ni yɛri shɛlikam nyɛla m Ba ni wuhi ma ni n yɛli shɛm.
en: And I know that whatever he says to do will bring eternal life. So the things I say are exactly what the Father told me to say.

dag: Nyini, miri ka a suhi ma ti niriba ŋɔ bee n-kum bee n-zani bɛ zaani suhi ma, dama bɛ yi ti kuhi boli ma bɛ muɣisigu saha, n ku garigi ba.
en: Jeremiah, don't pray for these people or beg me to rescue them. If you do, I won't listen, and I certainly won't listen if they pray!.

dag: O wuhi ma yili palli, di nyɛla yil shɛli din nyɛ ti Naawuni paɣibu yilli. Niriba pam ni nya ka lu Yawɛ sizuura, ka niŋ o naani.
en: He put a new song in my mouth, a song of praise for our God. Many people will learn of this and be amazed; they will trust the LORD.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni yiɣisi n suhu bahi Ɛdomnim zuɣu n-ku ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri zaa, ka chɛ ka di kpalim zani dabari, bɛ ni zaŋ takɔbiri ku ba Tɛman hal ni Dɛdan.
en: So the LORD God now proclaims: Ill overpower Edom, eliminate all living creatures, and make it a wasteland from Teman to Dedan. They will fall by the sword.

dag: Ka salo maa ni shɛb tahiri yɛri ni ŋ-ŋɔ nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ; ka shɛb mi yɛri ni ŋ-ŋɔ nyɛla ŋ-ŋɔ. O ni daa bi tooi baŋ yɛlli maa zuɣu ni di naba maa zuɣu ka o daa yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm Pool tahi tɔbbihi maa yiŋ na.
en: Part of the crowd shouted one thing, and part of them shouted something else. But they were making so much noise that the commander could not find out a thing. Then he ordered Paul to be taken into the fortress.

dag: N daa nyɛla yuun pihinahi nira saha shɛli Yawɛ dabili Musa ni daa tim ma ka n yi Kadɛshibarinia n-kana ti puɣisi nya tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ; ka daa ʒi di lahiba maŋli ti yɛl o.
en: I was years old at the time Moses sent me from Kadesh-Barnea into Canaan as a spy. When I came back and told him about the land, everything I said was true.

dag: Di yi pa lala a yi paɣiri Naawuni la a shia ni kɔŋko, wula ka ŋun ka yi kalinli ni ka lan ʒi a ni yɛli shɛm maa gbinni ni tooi yɛli, Ami, a Naawuni paɣibu maa zuɣu?.
en: You might be praising God with your spirit. But someone there without understanding cannot say Amen to your prayer of thanks, because they dont know what you are saying.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ ma gili di zaa, di daa galisiya pam be vinvamli maa ni, di daa nyɛla din kuui zaa.
en: He led me through them all around, and I saw that there were a great many of them on the valley floor, and they were very dry.

dag: Di saha maa ka Ilaija daa yɛli niriba maa zaa, Mirimiya ma na ka niriba maa zaa daa vu m-mir o. Ka o daa mali me Yawɛ sara maligu bimbin shɛli bɛ ni daa daai luhi la zali.
en: Then Elijah said to all the people, Now come here. So they gathered around Elijah. The Lord s altar had been torn down, so Elijah repaired it.

dag: Chɛ ka vi di ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn maani ma ansarisi yɛra, N-yɛwaa! N-yɛwaa! la.
en: May those who make fun of me be too embarrassed to speak!.

dag: Musa daa gulila o deemba Jɛtro ŋun daa nyɛ Midian maligumaana la biŋkɔbbaligu maa. Ka o daa ti zaŋ ba ti kpe tiŋgban nɛli ni n-gari chaŋ Naawuni zoli din yuli booni Sinai la gbini.
en: One day, Moses was taking care of the sheep and goats of his father-in-law Jethro, the priest of Midian, and Moses decided to lead them across the desert to Sinai, the holy mountain.

dag: Ka Hazaɛl daa bo Damaskus binshɛɣukam n-ʒili laakumnim pihinahi chaŋ ni o ti puhi Naawuni nir maa. Ka Hazaɛl daa paai ti zani Ilaisha tooni ka yɛl o, A bia Siria Naa Bɛnhadad n-tim ma a sanna ni n ti bɔh a nya o ni kpaŋ o barigu ŋɔ ni.
en: So Hazael went out to meet Elisha. He took along forty camel-loads of Damascus finest goods as a gift. He came and stood before Elisha and said, Your son Ben-hadad, the king of Aram, sent me to you to ask, Will I recover from this sickness.

dag: ka o shih o nuu, ka o niŋgbun biisim maa dii maai, ka o yiɣisi niŋ o saani.
en: He touched her hand, and the fever left her. Then she stood up and began to serve him.

dag: Ka o chɛ, ka chaŋ ŋun paya sani ti yɛl o kaman o ni yɛl o bikpɛm maa shɛm maa. Ka o saɣi yɛli, M ba, n ni chaŋ; amaa ka bi chaŋ.
en: Then the father went to the other son and said, Son, go and work today in the vineyard. He answered, Yes, sir, I will go and work. But he did not go.

dag: Di dunoli yɛliŋ daa nyɛla mita anu, ka goma din barilim nyɛ mita ayi ni pirigili daa be di luɣa zuɣu. Ka o daa buɣisi du titali maa puuni wɔɣilim, ka di nyɛ mita pisi, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ mita pia.
en: The door was cubits wide. The sides of the doorway were cubits on each side. He measured that room. It was cubits long and cubits wide.

dag: Amaa o ni daa ti kul kpɛri ha m-be dunol ni, ka Ahija wum o naba vubu ka yɛli, Jɛrɔbɔam paɣa, kpɛmina; bɔ n-niŋ ka a taɣ a biɛhigu ni a be kaman paɣ so la. M mali yɛtɔɣ kpɛma ni n yɛl a.
en: When Ahijah heard the sound of her feet coming through the doorway, he said, Come in, Jeroboams wife! Why have you disguised yourself? I have hard news for you.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ Yawɛ naani ka chɛ buɣa jɛmbu bee n-woligi bɛmaŋ ka chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn jɛmdi buɣa mali alibarika.
en: You bless all of those who trust you, Lord , and refuse to worship idols or follow false gods.

dag: amaa chamila n ya n dɔɣiriba sani ti bo paɣ na ti ti m bia maa ka o niŋ o paɣa.
en: So you must promise to go to my fathers country. Go to my family and choose a wife for my son.

dag: O nyɛla ŋun bɔri ni sokam zaa tiligi ka bɔhim baŋ yɛlimaŋli ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: God wants everyone to be saved and to fully understand the truth.

dag: Ka yi yi bi tum taali ka diri wahala, ka mali suɣilo di puuni Naawuni zuɣu, yi ni nya paɣibu Naawuni sani.
en: God will bless you for this, if you endure the pain of undeserved suffering because you are conscious of his will.

dag: Ka Mɛfibɔshɛt daa yɛli naa, Nyini n dan naa ni kul lab yiŋ na ni alaafee ŋɔ, chɛ ka o zaŋ di zaa.
en: Mephibosheth said to the king, My lord and king, it is enough that you have come home in peace. Let Ziba have the land.

dag: Pa Jɛhoyachin ŋɔ n-nyɛ bɛ ni lihi ʒiɛm duɣu ŋmaŋ shɛli, ni duɣ shɛli so ni je la? Bɔzuɣu ka bɛ zaŋ o min o bihi vil labi bɛ ni bi mi tiŋgbɔn shɛli ni?.
en: Jehoiachin is like a broken pot that someone threw away. He is like a pot that no one wants. Why will Jehoiachin and his children be thrown out and sent away into a foreign land?.

dag: Ka Filistia doo maa daa vu m-miri Dauda, ka o nyɔtaɣiriʒira be o tooni.
en: The Philistine got closer and closer to David, and his shield-bearer was in front of him.

dag: Ka bɛ daa lan yihi fɔntins ayi Manaasa zuliya niriba pirigili la tiŋgban ni. Dina n-nyɛ: Taanak mini Gatirimɔn ni di zaa ha biŋkɔbiri mɔri ŋubbu shee.
en: From the territory of West Manasseh they were given two cities: Taanach and Gathrimmon, with their pasture lands.

dag: Di saha ka Zɔfar ŋun daa nyɛ Naama nir la daa garigi yɛli.
en: Zophar from Naamah responded.

dag: Pita ni daa ti lab Jɛrusalɛm ka bɛn doli Yɛhudianim gunibu kali soli daa galim o.
en: But when Peter came to Jerusalem, some Jewish believers argued with him.

dag: Saha shɛli paɣiba ni siɣiri kuliga zaawuni ka o daa chɛ ka laakumnim maa gbani tiŋ tariga kɔbiliga gbini.
en: When he arrived, he made the camels kneel down at the well outside the city. It was late afternoon, the time when women came out to get water.

dag: Bɛ kul teemi gili ma luɣilikam zaa, amaa ka n nyaŋ ba Yawɛ yuli zuɣu!.
en: They attacked from all sides, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord .

dag: Ka buɣim maa buɣim niɛm daa kpuɣi bimbini maa zuɣu du zuɣusaa, ka Yawɛ malaika maa yiɣi kpe di ni n-dol li du zuɣusaa, ka Manɔa min o paɣ daa nya lala ka teei dɔni n-zaŋ bɛ nina kpa tiŋa.
en: as the flame from the altar went up toward the sky, the LORDs messenger went up in the altars flame. When Manoah and his wife saw this, they fell facedown on the ground.

dag: Ka bɛ ni daa kali ninvuɣ shɛb la ni daa zaŋ anzinfa shɛli na tibisim daa nyɛ kilɔgiram tusaata ni kɔbisinahi ni pihita kaman luɣ kasi shee sania zahimbu ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: All the men years old or older were counted. Each man had to pay a tax of beka of silver. There were , men. So they collected about pounds of silver.

dag: Yi zaa wum o ni mɔri Naawuni shɛm. Yi lee zahimla wula? Ka sokam yɛli, O simdila kubu.
en: You heard him claim to be God! What is your decision? They all agreed he should be put to death.

dag: zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ yi yi vihiri ti mi ni yi baŋ tuun sun shɛli din sa tum ti gbarigu ŋɔ ka o kpaŋ maa.
en: are we being examined today because something good was done for a sick person, a good deed that healed him?.

dag: ka o daa tim o bia Hadɔram Naa Dauda sani ni o ti puh o ni o zuɣusuŋ, o ni daa tuhi nyaŋ Hadadɛza maa zuɣu. Dama ŋun Tɔi mini Hadadɛza daa kul tuhirila taba waawaayili. Ka Tɔi daa chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ salima mini anzinfa ni daanya ti ti Dauda.
en: So he sent his son Joram to greet King David and congratulate him for his victory over Hadadezer, against whom Toi had fought many times. Joram brought David presents made of gold, silver, and bronze.

dag: Ka Asiria Naa Pul daa ti kana ni o ti tuhi Izraɛlnima, ka Naa Mɛnahɛm daa zaŋ anzinfa din tibisim nyɛ kilɔgiram tuhi pihitanaanahi n-ti Asiria Naa Pul ni o sɔŋ o ka o kul su o nam maa.
en: During Menahem's rule, King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria invaded Israel. He agreed to help Menahem keep control of his kingdom, if Menahem would pay him over tons of silver.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka Izraɛlnim daa chaŋ gili Jɛriko goma hal ti paai daba ayopɔin dali, ka goma maa lu.
en: It was faith that made the walls of Jericho fall down after the Israelites had marched around them for seven days.

dag: Bihim ka n daa mali dihiri ya, pa saɣim; dama yi daa naan na kul ku tooi di li; hal ka na kul tooi di li pumpɔŋɔ gba.
en: And the teaching I gave you was like milk, not solid food. I did this because you were not ready for solid food. And even now you are not ready.

dag: Di saha ka n daa yiɣisi chaŋ vinvamli maa ni, ka Yawɛ jilima ʒe nimaani ŋ-ŋmani n ni daa pun nya jilima shɛli Kɛba Mɔɣili dul la. Ka n daa lu n-zaŋ n nini kpa tiŋa.
en: So I got up and went out to the valley. The Glory of the Lord was there—as I had seen it by the Kebar Canal. So I bowed with my face to the ground.

dag: Ka Kush bidibisi daa nyɛ: Siiba mini Havila ni Sabita ni Raama ni Sabitɛka. Ka Raama bidibisi nyɛ: Shiiba mini Dɛdan.
en: The descendants of Cush were the people of Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The descendants of Raamah were the people of Sheba and Dedan.

dag: Chɛ ka di be kaman chinchin la, ka o zaŋ li vil omaŋa, ka chɛ ka di be kaman shɛlɔrigu la, ka o zaŋ li lɔri dabisili kam.
en: May they cover him like clothes and always be around him like a belt!.

dag: Di simdi ni dapaɣ yini kam wɔɣilim nyɛla mita anahi, ka di yɛliŋ mi nyɛ sɛntimita pihiyɔbunaayɔbu.
en: The frames should be cubits high and / cubits wide.

dag: Malaika ŋun daa yɛli ma lala maa daa malila salima jaaŋgbee din nyɛ o ni mali shɛli buɣisiri binyara ni o ti buɣisi tiŋ maa mini di dunoya ni di gooni la.
en: The angel who spoke to me had a gold measuring rod with which to measure the city, its gates, and its wall.

dag: To, n yɛri ya la dimbɔŋɔ ka di na bi niŋ, amaa ni di ti niŋ pali ka yi niŋ ma yɛda.
en: I am telling you this before I leave, so when it does happen, you will have faith in me.

dag: Kpaŋmiya yimaŋa m-be baalim, ka chɛ ka yi zaɣa be yimaŋmaŋ yɛla ni, ka bɔnya yimaŋmaŋ nuu zuɣu tuma tummi kaman ti ni daa pun wuhi ya shɛm la.
en: Do all you can to live a peaceful life. Mind your own business, and earn your own living, as we told you before.

dag: Ka Saimɔn yɛli, N tɛhiya ni ŋun samli galisi pam la. Ka Yisa yɛl o, A shiri baŋya.
en: Simon answered, I think it would be the one who owed him the most money. Jesus said to him, You are right.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ so ŋun kpuɣi binshɛŋa din nyɛ man Yawɛ dini maa, bɛ nyom o min o ni su binshɛɣukam zaa buɣim, o ni saɣim Yawɛ zaligu min o ni tum tuun shɛli n-dihi Izraɛlnim vi la zuɣu.
en: and the Lord will show who stole what should have been destroyed. That man must be put to death, his body burned, and his possessions thrown into the fire. He has done a terrible thing by breaking the sacred agreement that the Lord made with Israel.

dag: Naawuni ʒila o nam ʒiishee din be kasi la. Ŋuna n-nyɛ zuliya kam zaa naa.
en: God is king over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.

dag: Yi daazichi pooya, ka lɛla ŋubi saɣim yi situra.
en: Your riches have rotted. Moths have destroyed your clothes.

dag: Ɛzɛr n-daa nyɛ bɛ kpɛma, ka ŋun pa o zuɣu nyɛ Obadia, ka ŋun pahi ata nyɛ Ɛliab.
en: There were eleven of them, ranked in the following order: Ezer the leader, then Obadiah, Eliab, Mishmannah, Jeremiah, Attai, Eliel, Johanan, Elzabad, Jeremiah, and Machbannai.

dag: Dinzuɣu baŋmiya ni ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ yɛda n-nyɛ Ibrahimma yaansi.
en: And so, you should understand that everyone who has faith is a child of Abraham.

dag: Yawɛ nyɛla nirilimlana ni nambɔzɔra. O suhu bi yiɣisiri yom, ka o yurilim maŋli galisi pam.
en: The Lord is kind and merciful, patient and full of love.

dag: Di saha ka Izraɛl naa mini Juda Naa Jɛhɔshafat daa chaŋ Ramɔtigiliad.
en: King Ahab of Israel and King Jehoshaphat of Judah went to fight the Arameans at Ramoth Gilead.

dag: So yi chɛ ka o biŋkɔbiri ŋub so puu ni binyɛra bee o wain tihi puu bee n-chɛ o biŋkɔbigu bahi ka o chaŋ so puu ni nti ŋub o bindira, di simdi ka dilan zaŋ o puu ni bindira din niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga bee o wain tihi din wali viɛnyɛliŋga yo di samli.
en: If you allow any of your animals to stray from your property and graze in someone else's field or vineyard, you must repay the damage from the best part of your own harvest of grapes and grain.

dag: Suhusaɣiŋgu yi ti paai ya kaman sanʒiɛɣu la, ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai ya kaman pɔhimʒiɛpiliŋga la, ka biɛrim mini nandahima yi ti paai ya;.
en: when terror hits you like a hurricane, and your disaster comes in like a tornado, when distress and oppression overcome you.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Di wumdi ya anabi shɛb bɛn be yi sani ŋɔ yɛligu. Bɛ ŋmari ya la ʒiri; bɛ suhuyubu yɛtɔɣa ka bɛ tɔɣisiri maa. Di pala Yawɛ noli ni yɛtɔɣa.
en: Don't listen to the lies of these false prophets, you people of Judah! The message they preach is something they imagined; it did not come from me, the Lord All-Powerful.

dag: Lihimi nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa mali karimbaani, ka a filim ba, ka bahi ninvuɣ biɛri yoli bɛ ni be luɣ shɛlikam.
en: Yes, just look at the proud and make them humble. Crush those evil people where they stand.

dag: Piɛguliba ti ku tooi zo n-tiligi, ka zuɣulaannim gba ti ku tooi zo n-tiligi.
en: There will be no way for you to escape.

dag: Ka o bɔhi ba, Yi mi Leeban Nahɔr bia la? Ka bɛ yɛl o, Ti mi o.
en: Then Jacob said, Do you know Laban, the son of Nahor? The shepherds answered, We know him.

dag: Yɛtɔɣili ŋɔ nyɛla yɛlimaŋli: So suhu yi yɛya ni o leei cheechi toondana, o ni bɔri tuun shɛli maa nyɛla tuun suŋ.
en: This is a true saying: If a man is eager to be a church leader, he desires an excellent work.

dag: dama ti Ba Naawuni sani ti teeri yi yɛda niŋbu mini yi yurilim tuma ni yi tahima shɛli din ʒe yim ti Duuma Masia ni la yɛla.
en: For we remember before our God and Father how you put your faith into practice, how your love made you work so hard, and how your hope in our Lord Jesus Christ is firm.

dag: A ni daa bi doli wuntia soli n-niŋ daabiligu, ka tum alahichi pam zuɣu daa chɛ ka a saɣim a jɛmbu duri. Dinzuɣu ka buɣim yi a ni na n-di a zaa; ka n daa chɛ ka a leei tampiligim do tiŋa bɛn zaa daa nya a ninni.
en: You did many wrong things. You were a very crooked merchant. In this way you made the holy places unclean. So I brought fire from inside you. It burned you! You burned to ashes on the ground. Now everyone can see your shame.

dag: A ni daa piligi balindi Naawuni saha shɛl la ka o daa garig a. Naawuni yur a pam. Lala zuɣu ka n kana ni n ti yɛl a o ni garig a yɛli shɛm. Dinzuɣu luɣim a tiba wum n ni yɛn wuh a ʒii maa gbinni shɛm.
en: When you began making your requests, a word went out, and Ive come to tell it to you because you are greatly treasured. So now understand this word and grasp the meaning of this vision!.

dag: Di lan simdi ni a pii kpambal shɛb ka bɛ su tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ tuma fukumsi, ka bɛ ti laɣim bindira pirigibu bunu puuni yim zuɣu zali bindira ni ti yɛn niŋ pam yuma ayopɔin shɛŋa puuni la.
en: Then Pharaoh should appoint administrators over the land and take one-fifth of all the produce of the land of Egypt during the seven years of abundance.

dag: Amaa zuŋɔ zaŋ chana, Daadam Bia ni ti ʒila Kpiɔŋlan Naa nudirigu polo.
en: But beginning now, the Son of Man will sit at the right side of God All-Powerful.

dag: Ka bɛ daa ŋme kuŋ boli Izraɛlnim zaa bɛn nyɛ Naftali mini Asha ni Manaasa zuliya niriba zaa, ka bɛ kana ti doli Midiannim maa.
en: Then men from the tribes of Naphtali, Asher, and both parts of Manasseh were called out, and they pursued the Midianites.

dag: Ka Mɛfibɔshɛt ŋun daa nyɛ Sool yaaŋa la daa yina ni o ti tuhi naa soli. Naa ni daa kul yi Jɛrusalɛm dahin shɛli maa Mɛfibɔshɛt daa bi lan paɣ o naba bee m-mal o teeŋa bee m-paɣ o situra hal ka o ti labina ni alaafee maa.
en: Mephibosheth, the grandson of Saul, also came to meet David. He had missed David so much that he had not taken a bath or trimmed his beard or washed his clothes the whole time David was gone. David asked him, Why didn't you go with me.

dag: nti yihiri lahibal suŋ waazu nimaani.
en: They told the Good News there too.

dag: Ka Taai Naa Hiram daa ti wum ni bɛ leei Sulemaana nam n-zal o ba zaashee, ka o daa tim tuumba Naa Sulemaana sani, dama Naa Hiram daa yuri Dauda pam.
en: King Hiram of Tyre had always been friends with Solomon's father David. When Hiram learned that Solomon was king, he sent some of his officials to meet with Solomon.

dag: A niŋ ti mi kaman a ni daa pun yɛli ni a ni niŋ ti mini ti kpamba shɛm. A darigi Jɛrusalɛm tibili pam gari tiŋ kam dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: God said those things would happen to us and our leaders, and he made them happen. He made terrible things happen to us. No other city suffered the way Jerusalem suffered.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa zaŋ omaŋmaŋ tɔbutuhiri nɛma min o kurigu gbaɣino yɛli Dauda, ka zaŋ kurigu zuɣupiligu pil o.
en: Then Saul dressed David in his own gear, putting a coat of armor on him and a bronze helmet on his head.

dag: Dinzuɣu zomiya Yawɛ, ka gbaamiya yimaŋ yi tuma ni; dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ bi bɔri ŋaribu bee gaŋbu bee yi bɔri ni niriba tiri ya birapu.
en: Honor the Lord and act carefully, because the Lord our God does not tolerate fraud or partiality or the taking of bribes.

dag: Bɛ ni ʒi taali ni yibu Naawuni sani soli ka dolila bɛmaŋmaŋ ni bɔri so shɛli ni bɛ yi taali ni Naawuni san la zuɣu ka bɛ daa bi zaŋ bɛmaŋ kpɛhi taali ni yibu Naawuni sani sol la dolibu ni.
en: They did not know the way that God makes people right with him. And they tried to make themselves right in their own way. So they did not accept Gods way of making people right.

dag: Dinzuɣu piɛguliba, wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm:.
en: So, you shepherds, listen to the word of the Lord !.

dag: Amaa ka Yaakubu yɛl o, N dana, a mi ni bihi ŋɔ ka yaa, ka biŋkɔb bihi bɛn mɔɣiri be biŋkɔbiri maa ni, ka di simdi ni n chɛ ka n zaɣa be bɛ ni viɛnyɛliŋga. Ti yi taɣi ba chaŋ pam dahin yini, bɛ zaa ni kpi.
en: But Jacob said to him, My master knows that the children arent strong and that I am responsible for the nursing flocks and cattle. If I push them hard for even one day, all of the flocks will die.

dag: Sokam ni tooi bir o bimbira ni suhudoo. Tihi din wandi wala ni wali, ka tiŋgban ni bindira niŋ, ka saa gba mi pam. N ni chɛ ka n ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpalim ŋɔ di binyara ŋɔ zaa daanfaani.
en: Instead, I will make sure that your crops are planted in peace and your vineyards are fruitful, that your fields are fertile, and the dew falls from the sky.

dag: Chamiya Kaline nti nya; ka chaŋ Hamat din nyɛ tin tital la ni mini Gaat din nyɛ Filistianim tiŋ la ni nti nya. Tinsi maa gari Juda mini Izraɛl tinsi? Bee bɛ tiŋgbɔna galisimi gari yi tiŋgbɔŋ?.
en: Cross over to Calneh and see; from there go to Hamath the great; then go down to Gath of the Philistines. Are you better than these kingdoms? Or is your territory greater than their territory?.

dag: Ka n tarili lee nyɛ dini Naawuni ŋun be zuɣusaa ŋɔ sani? Ka n fali lee nyɛ dini Kpiɔŋlan Naa ŋun be zuɣusaa ŋɔ sani?.
en: God All-Powerful punishes men who do that.

dag: Yawɛ gari zuliya kam zaa, ka o jilima yaɣi sagbana zuɣu.
en: The Lord is higher than all nations. His glory rises to the skies.

dag: Ansarisimaaniba ni ti nya tibidarigibo, ka jɛra mi yaansi zuɣu ti nya fiɛbiga.
en: A stupid fool should expect to be punished.

dag: Omaŋmaŋ yubu zuɣu ka o zaŋ ti leeg o bihi yɛlimaŋli yɛligu la puuni ni di chɛ ka ti leeg o bikpamba o binnamda zaa puuni.
en: By his own will he brought us into being through the word of truth, so that we should have first place among all his creatures.

dag: Sool mam daa beni ka o yuli booni Rizipa. O daa nyɛla Aiya bipuɣiŋga, ka Ishibɔshɛt daa ti bɔhi Abinɛr, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a zaŋ m ba mam maa dɔni.
en: He had even slept with a wife of Saul by the name of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah. But Saul's son Ishbosheth told Abner, You shouldn't have slept with one of my father's wives.

dag: Ka pumpɔŋɔ wuntitali zuɣupil shɛli ti Duuma ŋun mali wuntia n-kariti saria la ni ti yɛn zaŋ ti ma di dabisili la dali n-do n-guli ma, ka di pala n kɔŋko ka o ti yɛn zaŋ ti, amaa o ni ti zaŋ li ti bɛnkam zaa gba suhuri ye o labbuna zuɣu la.
en: So a crown will be given to me for pleasing the Lord. He judges fairly, and on the day of judgment he will give a crown to me and to everyone else who wants him to appear with power.

dag: Di saha ka o kpamba maa daa bɔh o, Wula ka a lee niŋ shɛm maa? Bia maa ni daa na ne, a daa lola noli ka kum o zuɣu pam, amaa ka o ti lee kpi ka a yiɣisi di bindirigu.
en: We don't understand this, his officials said to him. While the child was alive, you wept for him and would not eat; but as soon as he died, you got up and ate.

dag: Ka o daa mali salima bans anahi n-niŋ di naŋgbaŋkuɣila anahi. Bans ayi yaɣ yini, bans ayi yaɣ din la gba.
en: He made four rings of gold and put them on the four corners. These rings were used for carrying the Box. There were two rings on each side.

dag: Din pahi nyɛla, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni taɣi yi mini yi bihi suhuri din ni chɛ ka yi yuri ŋun Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni yi suhuri zaa mini yi shihi zaa, ka lala ti chɛ ka yi be.
en: Then the LORD your God will circumcise your hearts and the hearts of your descendants so that you love the LORD your God with all your mind and with all your being in order that you may live.

dag: Ka Dauda daa bɔh o, Bɔ ka n niŋ? Pa bɔhigu yini kɔŋko ka m bɔhi.
en: Now what have I done? David answered. Can't I even ask a question.

dag: Suhubɔhibo yi mali nira, di chɛrimi ka o zahindi zahima. Ka jɛrigu mi mali yɛtɔɣ gbaliŋ.
en: The more you worry, the more likely you are to have bad dreams, and the more you talk, the more likely you are to say something foolish.

dag: Bɛ ku saɣi doli sana, amaa bɛ ni zomi ka chɛ o, dama bɛ bi mi saamba kukoya.
en: They wont follow a stranger but will run away because they dont know the strangers voice.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa deei Ilaija suhigu, ka chɛ ka bia maa nyɛvili lab o ni na ka o neei.
en: The Lord answered Elijahs prayer. The boy began breathing again and was alive.

dag: Adam zuliya yuya n-sab kpe ŋɔ. Naawuni ni daa nam ninsala, o daa nam o ŋ-ŋmahindila omaŋa.
en: This is the history of Adams family. When God created people, he made them like himself.

dag: Naa Asa ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuma ayi saha, ka Nadab Jɛrɔbɔam bia daa leei Izraɛl naa. O daa diya su Izraɛlnim la yuma ayi.
en: Nadab son of Jeroboam became king of Israel in Asa's second year as king of Judah, and he ruled two years.

dag: Bɛ kɔba ni chɔɣisiya, bɛ bi lan garigi shɛli. Bɛ lan ka yɛtɔɣ shɛli din ni yɛli.
en: They are troubled, no longer answer; words now escape them.

dag: So mi n-nyɛ bundana, ka mali suhudoo ka binshɛli yɛla bi muɣis o, ka o ti kpi.
en: One person dies after living a full and successful life, a life completely safe and comfortable.

dag: Amaa ka Judanim daa bi tooi kari Jɛbusinim bɛn daa pun be Jɛrusalɛm la bahi. Dina n-chɛ ka Jɛbusinim mini Judanim na kul laɣim be Jɛrusalɛm hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: The Jebusites lived in Jerusalem, and the people of the Judah tribe could not capture the city and get rid of them. That's why Jebusites still live in Jerusalem along with the people of Judah.

dag: Daanya pilanim mini tɔrokɔnim la ni daanya kɔniŋdi bini din daa be Yawɛ jɛmbu duu la, Babilɔnnim naa maa daa wurim li mi, ka va di daanya maa zaa kuli Babilɔn.
en: The Babylonians broke apart the bronze columns, the stands, and the bronze Sea in the LORDs temple. They carried the bronze to Babylon.

dag: Di simdi ni tinim bɛn zaa bi niriba malila tɛhi yini ŋɔ tatabo, ka yi ni shɛb yi mali tɛhi kɔŋkɔba, Naawuni ni kahigi di yɛla wuhi ya.
en: So all of us who are spiritually mature should think this way, and if anyone thinks differently, God will reveal it to him or her.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda daa zali Jɔab mini Abishai ni Itai zaligu n-yɛli N zuɣu, miriya ka yi niŋ nachimbil Absalom shɛli. Ka niriba maa zaa daa wum naa ni zali sapashin kpamba maa zaligu shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Absalom polo maa.
en: He gave orders to Joab, Abishai, and Ittai: For my sake don't harm the young man Absalom. And all the troops heard David give this command to his officers.

dag: Yisa ni daa du Galili Teeku duli m-paai Gɛrasa tiŋgbɔŋ ni ka alizin biɛri ni daa ʒi dɔbba ayi shɛb zuɣu yi gbala polo n-tuhir o sol na. Bɛ nini daa tuli pam hal ka so ku tooi gari bɛ ni be shɛli polo maa.
en: When Jesus came to the territory of Gadara on the other side of the lake, he was met by two men who came out of the burial caves there. These men had demons in them and were so fierce that no one dared travel on that road.

dag: O yi po pɔri yoli zaŋ chaŋ binshɛli polo; di simdi ka o niŋ di zaa, ka niŋ di pirigibu ʒiibunu zuɣu yim pahi ti ŋun su li, o yi ti baŋ ni o tum taali.
en: or whatever it was that you swore falsely about. You must make amends for the principal amount and add one-fifth to it. You must give it to the owner on the day you become guilty.

dag: Tɔbbia ŋun be tɔbbitali tuma ni bi zaŋd o nuu kpɛhiri bɛn pa tɔbbihi yɛla ni, dama o nia nyɛla ni o tum din tiɣi ŋun kpɛh o tɔbbitali tuma ni maa nini.
en: Nobody who serves in the military gets tied up with civilian matters, so that they can please the one who recruited them.

dag: Amaa hal ni pɔŋɔ, yi na ʒi n-zaŋ n yuli suhi shɛli; dinzuɣu suhimiya, Naawuni ni tin ya, ka yi suhuri pali suhupiɛlli.
en: Until now you have not asked for anything in my name; ask and you will receive, so that your happiness may be complete.

dag: Ka a ti zaŋ salima mali bans ayi n-zaŋ li goli sara maligu bimbini maa yaɣ yini naŋgbaŋkuɣila salima din kɔɣili li maa lɔŋni, ka lan mali bans ayi niŋ yaɣ din la gba, ka bɛ ti zaŋ dapuhi turi di ni kpuɣiri sara maligu bimbini maa.
en: Below this trim there should be two gold rings. There should be two gold rings on opposite sides of the altar. These gold rings will be used with poles to carry the altar.

dag: Dinzuɣu ti ni daa nya ka ti ku tooi lan guhi pahi zuɣu ka ti daa saɣi ni ti kɔŋko kpalim be Atɛnsi.
en: So when we couldnt stand it any longer, we thought it was a good idea to stay on in Athens by ourselves.

dag: O daa yɛl lala ni o wuhi la kum shɛli o ni daa ti yɛn kpi la yɛla.
en: In saying this he indicated the kind of death he was going to suffer.

dag: Ka a boli tuumbaŋdiba bɛn nyɛ ninvuɣ shɛb n ni zaŋ baŋsim ti na nti chɛ ka bɛ she binyɛra ti Aduna ka o leei m maligumaana.
en: Call all the skilled workers to whom I have given ability, and tell them to make Aaron's clothes, so that he may be dedicated as a priest in my service.

dag: Doli n ni zal a shɛm, ka be. Gbibi n ni wuhir a shɛli kaman a nimbil biɛlim la.
en: Obey me, and you will live! Let my instructions be your greatest treasure.

dag: Ka bɛ ti baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ, ka n ni daa yɛli ni n ni niŋ ba zaɣ biɛ shɛl la, n daa bi diɛmdimi maa.
en: and they will know that I am the LORD. Not in vain have I threatened to bring this evil against them.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim zaa daa kana ti paai Zin yɔɣu ni gol so ŋun daŋ tooni puuni n-ʒini Kadɛshi. Ka Miriam daa kpi nimaani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o nimaani.
en: In the first month the whole community of Israel came to the wilderness of Zin and camped at Kadesh. There Miriam died and was buried.

dag: O nol daa na bi lu tiŋa, ka kuko shɛli yi zuɣusaa na yɛli, Naa Nɛbukadnɛza, wummi n ni yɛn yɛl a shɛm ŋɔ. N deeg a nam yiko a sani.
en: These words hadnt even left the kings mouth when a voice came from heaven: You, King Nebuchadnezzar, are now informed: Kingship is taken away from you.

dag: O yi tɔɣisi yɛtɔɣa, kom din be sagbana ni damdimi. Ŋuna n-chɛ ka paɣili kpɛri dunia ŋɔ luɣilikam. Ŋuna n-chɛ ka saa nyaɣisira, ka chɛ ka pɔhim yiri o ni zaŋ li niŋ luɣ shɛli na.
en: The waters in the heavens roar at your command. You make clouds appear— you send the winds from your storehouse and make lightning flash in the rain.

dag: Ka o daa kpe ŋariŋ ni ni o chaŋ, ka alizin biɛri ni daa zo ka chɛ do so maa balim o ni o chɛ ka o dol o chaŋ.
en: As Jesus was getting into the boat, the man who had had the demons begged him, Let me go with you.

dag: ka anzinfa pa ŋmana kpiŋkpama zuɣu, ka salima alali pa bɛ kɔbiri zuɣu. Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka yi ni shɛb daa kpalim be yiŋ buzɔna ni?.
en: Even if you lie down among the sheepfolds, there are wings of a dove covered with silver; its pinions covered in precious gold.

dag: Yawɛ, chɛ ka a yurilim maŋli la kul be n sani wuntaŋ ni, ka chɛ ka a yilli mi be n sani yuŋ. Di nyɛla n suhigu zaŋ chaŋ n Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n nyɛvil la sani.
en: By day the Lord shows his faithful love, and at night I have a song for him—a prayer for the God of my life.

dag: Ka Jɔshua daa bɔhi Izraɛlnima, Bɔ n-niŋ ka yi zaŋ Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi yaannim Naawuni ŋɔ ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔn shɛli tin ya la deebu niŋ yi baɣaka hal ni wayo?.
en: So Joshua said to the people of Israel, How long are you going to wait before you go in and take the land that the Lord , the God of your ancestors, has given you?.

dag: Ka Mɛlatia ŋun daa yi Gibiɔn na la mini Jadɔn ŋun daa yi Mɛrɔnɔt na la ni Gibiɔnnim ni Mizipanim bɛn daa be Yufretiiz Mɔɣili duli yaɣili polo gomna sulinsi ni la daa mali me m-pani bɛ zuɣu.
en: Next to them repairs were made by Melatiah the Gibeonite, Jadon the Meronothite, and the people of Gibeon and of Mizpah, who were ruled by the governor of the province Beyond the River.

dag: Amaa ka n daa ti zahim dabiɛm zahindi n-nya ʒii shɛŋa n gom shee ka di muɣisi ma pam.
en: when suddenly I had some horrifying dreams and visions.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka m pun piligi kuri ya ni m bahi ya yoli yi daalahichi maa zuɣu.
en: So I have made you sick by striking you! I have struck you because of your sins.

dag: Saha shɛli Sulemaana ni daa ti kurigi, o paɣiba maa daa shiri ŋmalig o suhu n-labisi buɣa jɛmbu polo; ka o daa bi lan doli Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni ŋɔ o suhu ni ni yɛlimaŋli kaman o ba Dauda la.
en: When Solomon was old, his wives caused him to follow other gods, so he did not follow the Lord completely as his father David did.

dag: M mabihi, n suhu zaa yuya ni mmaŋmaŋ zuliya tiligi, ka n kul suhiri Naawuni tiri ba di zuɣu.
en: Brothers and sisters, what I want most is for all the people of Israel to be saved. That is my prayer to God.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Sabimi n ni yɛl a yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa maa zaa niŋ litaafi ni.
en: The Lord , the God of the people of Israel, said, Jeremiah, write in a book the words I have spoken to you. Write this book for yourself.

dag: n ni chɛ ka a nam kul beni sahakam kaman n ni daa lo a ba Dauda alikauli n-yɛli ni so kul ku kɔŋ o daŋ ni ŋun ni di nam su Izraɛlnim la.
en: I will keep the promise I made to your father David when I told him that Israel would always be ruled by his descendants.

dag: Chɛ ka ti me dubil tam ti yil ŋɔ zuɣusaa, ka bo garo mini teebuli ni kuɣa ni firila zali di ni, o yi ti lan ka ti sanna ka o kpe nimaani.
en: Let's build a small room on the roof, put a bed, a table, a chair, and a lamp in it, and he can stay there whenever he visits us.

dag: Zaŋmi salima mali bansi anahi n-zaŋ niŋ di yaɣa anahi maa gbaya anahi la.
en: Make four gold rings for the table. Fasten the rings to the four corners at its four legs.

dag: Maika bidibisi n-daa nyɛ Pitɔn mini Mɛlɛk ni Taria ni Ahaz.
en: Micahs family were Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti buɣisi pal yaɣu puuni luɣ shɛli polo, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ kilomita pinaayi ni pirigili, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ kilomita anu, ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni luɣ kasi zaa kasi shee la ti be di ni.
en: In the holy area you will measure , cubits long and , cubits wide. The Temple will be in this area. The Temple area will be the Most Holy Place.

dag: Dama m bi timd a la zuliya shɛb bɛn yɛtɔɣa bi ne, ka di wumbu to sani, amaa n timd a la Izraɛlnim sani.
en: You arent being sent to a people whose language and speech are difficult and obscure but to the house of Israel.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, nyini ŋun yuri niriba ŋɔ, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be kasi zaa daa bela a nuu ni, bɛ daa dolila a naba, ka deer a noli.
en: The Lord loves his people and protects those who belong to him. So we bow at his feet and obey his commands.

dag: Shɛb yi nya azichi, nyin di chɛ ka di yɛla muɣis a, hal bɛ yinsi daazichi maa yi kul zoori pahiri gba.
en: Don't be upset when someone becomes rich, when his wealth grows even greater;.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli anabi Jɛrimia yɛtɔɣ shɛli zaŋ chaŋ Babilɔn Naa Nɛbukadnɛza ni yɛn kana ti tuhi Ijiptinim la polo m-bɔŋɔ:.
en: This is the message the Lord spoke to Jeremiah the prophet about Nebuchadnezzar coming to attack Egypt.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ n dana, jaande wummi n ni yɛn yɛl a shɛm ŋɔ. Niŋmi ania wum n fabila ŋɔ, ka di lan chɛ ka bɛ zaŋ ma labisi Jɔnatan yiŋ maa ni ka n ti kpi nimaani.
en: And now, Your Majesty, I beg you to listen to me and do what I ask. Please do not send me back to the prison in Jonathan's house. If you do, I will surely die there.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma yɛl o, N ni po pɔri maa.
en: And Abraham said, I promise to treat you the same way you have treated me.

dag: Dama ŋun saɣinda kana ni o ti liri Babilɔn. Bɛ gbahi bɛ tɔbbihi, ka kabisi bɛ tɔburi, dama Yawɛ nyɛla Naawuni ŋun yɔri samli, o mi ni yo di zaa.
en: They have come to destroy Babylon; its soldiers are captured, and their bows are broken. I am a God who punishes evil, and I will treat Babylon as it deserves.

dag: N nyaya ka ninvuɣ biɛri kul nahindila niriba ka duri zuɣusaa kaman Lɛbanɔn sida tihi la.
en: I once knew someone wicked who was a tyrant; he towered over everyone like a cedar of Lebanon;.

dag: Yidaampaɣiba, zaŋmiya yimaŋ ti yi yidaannima ka di be kaman yi zaŋ yimaŋ tila ti Duuma la.
en: For example, wives should submit to their husbands as if to the Lord.

dag: ni Hɛlɛb ŋun daa nyɛ Baana Nɛtɔfa nir la bia ni Itai ŋun ba daa nyɛ Ribai ŋun daa nyɛ Gibia din daa be Bɛnjamin tiŋgban ni nir la.
en: Heled son of Baanah from Netophah; Ithai son of Ribai from Gibeah of Benjamin;.

dag: Anab so daa bi lan yiɣisi Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni ŋ-ŋmani Musa, ka Yawɛ min o nini daa nya taba.
en: There has never been a prophet in Israel like Moses; the Lord spoke with him face-to-face.

dag: Nyin biɛŋmariga ŋun ne pam ŋɔ, nyam a ni yi zuɣusaa lu tiŋ na shɛm! Nyin ŋun daa dihi zuliya pam vi ŋɔ, bɛ daag a luhi tiŋa.
en: You, the bright morning star, have fallen from the sky! You brought down other nations; now you are brought down.

dag: Ka Baasha daa ti kani, ka bɛ sɔɣ o Tiriza; ka o bia Ɛla daa di nam zan o zaani.
en: Baasha lay down with his ancestors and was buried in Tirzah. His son Elah succeeded him as king.

dag: N suhu saɣimmi zaa, ka kum dabiɛm gbaai ma.
en: I am terrified, and the terrors of death crush me.

dag: Ka maligumaana so bipuɣiŋga yi ti gɔri pagɔrisigu n-dih omaŋ vi, o ba ka o dihi vi maa, bɛn nyom o buɣim.
en: If a priest's daughter becomes a prostitute, she disgraces her father; she shall be burned to death.

dag: amaa milinsi din pali la yi ti kana, milinsi din bi pali zaa ŋɔ ni vuui.
en: but when what is perfect comes, then what is partial will disappear.

dag: Yawɛ, yɛtɔɣili ti yɛn yi n nol ni na, ka a pun mi li zaa.
en: Before I even speak a word, you know what I will say.

dag: Ka dimbɔŋɔ daa chɛ ka Yawɛ ni daa lo Jɛhu alikauli shɛli yɛli, A bihi ni ti diri Izraɛl nam zaŋ hal ti paai ʒiɛmani din pahir anahi ni la niŋ pali.
en: In this way the Lord s word came true. He had told Jehu that four generations of his descendants would be kings of Israel.

dag: Tɔbu lu baɣisi zuɣu ni di chɛ ka bɛ leei jɛra. Tɔbu lu bɛ tɔbbihi zuɣu ka bɛ suhuri fuŋ.
en: Death to its lying prophets— what fools they are! Death to its soldiers— how terrified they are!.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti chɛ ka yi nyaŋ yi dimnim bɛn yiɣisi ni bɛ tuhi ya. Bɛ ni ti doli so yini kana ni be ti tuhi ya, ka ni ti ŋmaligi guui doli soya ayopɔin zo ka chɛn ya.
en: The Lord will defeat your enemies when they attack you. They will attack from one direction, but they will run from you in all directions.

dag: ka o tɔɣis o daanabitali yɛtɔɣa yɛli, Bɛɔr bia Balaam anabitali yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ, Ninvuɣ so ŋun nyari viɛnyɛliŋga anabitali yɛtɔɣa m-bɔŋɔ.
en: and he uttered this prophecy: The message of Balaam son of Beor, The words of the man who can see clearly.

dag: Yaakubu daa zo n-kuli Mɛsopoteemia, nimaani ka o daa tum tuma paɣ zuɣu; o daa gulila biŋkɔbiri ni di yo o paɣ kpuɣibu samli.
en: Jacob escaped to Syria where he tended sheep to earn himself a wife.

dag: Amaa a ba Dauda zuɣu, n ku niŋ li a ʒiɛmani ŋɔ ni, n ni ti darigi deei nam maa la a bia nuu ni.
en: However, for the sake of your father David I will not do this in your lifetime, but during the reign of your son.

dag: ka chɛ ka noombil nɛɔŋ maa yiɣi yi tiŋ maa ni chaŋ mɔɣu ni, ka maligumaana maa yo yili maa alahichi samli, ka di yi daɣiri ni.
en: Finally, he will release the bird and let it fly away, ending the ceremony for purifying the house.

dag: Ka Yisa yɛli, Di lan pahi lala! Ka daa zaŋ o nuu shihi doo maa tibili maa ka di lab tabili yaha.
en: Enough of that! Jesus said. Then he touched the servant's ear and healed it.

dag: Nimaani ka yi mini yi yinsinim ni ti di li Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ tooni, ka mali suhupiɛlli. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ yi ni yi tuuni kam zaa ni zuɣu.
en: You will have a feast there, each of you and your families, in the LORD your Gods presence, and you will celebrate all you have done because the LORD your God has blessed you.

dag: Di saha maa Jɔab daa na kul tuhirila Ammɔnnim bɛ tin zuɣu din nyɛ Raba la ni.
en: Meanwhile Joab continued his campaign against Rabbah, the capital city of Ammon, and was about to capture it.

dag: Ka Yisa ti bɔh o, Bɔ ka a lee bɔri ni n niŋ ti a? Ka zom maa yɛl o, Karimba, m bɔri ni a neela n nina ŋɔ ti ma.
en: What do you want me to do for you? Jesus asked him. Teacher, the blind man answered, I want to see again.

dag: Ka Zɛlɔfɛhad bipuɣinsi maa daa shiri niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm maa.
en: Zelophehads daughters did as the LORD commanded Moses.

dag: Ka n yi saɣim yi suhuri n ni daa sab gban shɛli tin ya la puuni, n suhu bi miligi di zuɣu, hal n suhu ni daa pun miligi di zuɣu la zaa yoli, dama n nyaya ka gbaŋ maa daa shiri saɣim yi suhuri, amaa ka yi suhusaɣiŋgu maa daa lee bi yuui.
en: I don't feel bad anymore, even though my letter hurt your feelings. I did feel bad at first, but I don't now. I know that the letter hurt you for a while.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛl o, Di bi simdi ni nir zaŋ bihi bindirigu ti bahi, shee bihi dimi tiɣi pɔi.
en: Jesus told the woman, It is not right to take the childrens bread and give it to the dogs. First let the children eat all they want.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ bɛn bɔrigi maa sani, di nyɛla nyom din tahiri kum na; amaa zaŋ chaŋ bɛn tiligi la sani, di nyɛla nyom din tahiri nyɛvili na. Ŋuni n-lee ni tooi su tuuni ŋɔ tatabo fukumsi?.
en: We smell like a contagious dead person to those who are dying, but we smell like the fountain of life to those who are being saved. Who is qualified for this kind of ministry?.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli Jɔn nyaandoliba maa, Labimiya ti yɛli Jɔn yi ni nya ka wum shɛm: Zoomba nina neera, ka wɔbisi chana, ka kɔnsi tibiri kpaŋda, ka tikpiranim wumda, hal ka kpiimba gba neeri kum ni, ka lahibal suŋ waazu mi yihiri tiri tarimba.
en: Then he said to Johns followers, Go tell John what you have seen and heard: The blind can see. The crippled can walk. People with leprosy are healed. The deaf can hear. The dead are brought back to life. And the Good News is being told to the poor.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Hal ka mani ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu, a mabia Sɔdom min o bipuɣinsi daa bi tum tuumbiɛri ka di paag a min a bipuɣinsi ni tum shɛm ŋɔ.
en: As surely as I am the living Lord God, the people of Sodom and its nearby villages were never as sinful as you.

dag: Bɛtazimavɛtnim daa nyɛla ninvuɣ pihinahinaayi.
en: from the town of Beth Azmaveth:.

dag: Yihim ma bɛ daansarisi mini bɛ ninvuɣ tubo ni, dama n dol a zaligunima.
en: Take all their insults and contempt away from me because Ive kept your laws!.

dag: Ka Naawuni zaligubaŋda maa yɛl o, Karimba, achiika! A yɛli yɛlimaŋli; dama Naawuni yino n-shiri beni, ka Naawuni so lan kani pah o zuɣu.
en: The legal expert said to him, Well said, Teacher. You have truthfully said that God is one and there is no other besides him.

dag: Ka n ni ti kari ba saria bɛ ni zaɣisi ma bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali kam puuni la zuɣu. Bɛ mali maligu ti buɣa, ka jɛm bɛmaŋmaŋ ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali binshɛŋa.
en: I will declare my judgment against them for doing evil: for abandoning me, worshipping other gods, and trusting in the works of their hands.

dag: Tɔb tuhibu vuri be tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, ka saɣiŋgu pam be nimaani.
en: Theres the sound of war in the land and enormous devastation.

dag: Ka amaŋmaŋ mi ni be hal ti kurigi n-kpi ni suhudoo, ka bɛ sɔɣ a.
en: As for you, you will join your ancestors in peace and be buried after a good long life.

dag: Ka Filistianim maa daa zo ka chɛ bɛ buɣa bahi nimaani, ka Dauda min o niriba maa daa kahi di zaa chaŋ.
en: When the Philistines fled, they left their idols behind, and David and his men carried them away.

dag: Yiɣisim kpuɣi bia maa n-gbib o a nuu ni viɛnyɛliŋga, dama n ni chɛ ka o zuliya ti galisi pam.
en: Go help the boy. Hold his hand and lead him. I will make him the father of many people.

dag: Ka Musa mini maligumaana Ɛliɛza daa deei bɛ ni daa zaŋ salima mali binshɛŋa maa zaa.
en: So Moses and Eleazar the priest accepted all these gold items from them.

dag: Di daa bi yuui ka Yawɛ yɛli Musa mini Aduna ni Miriam, Yi niriba ata maa kam Yawɛ chirigibu shee suɣili la gbin na. Ka bɛ niriba ata maa daa kana.
en: Immediately, the LORD said to Moses, Aaron, and Miriam, You three go out to the meeting tent. So the three of them went out.

dag: ka yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, wun so ka zuɣusaa bee tiŋgban ni ŋ-ŋman a; a dol a ni lo alikauli shɛli ka mali yurilim din bi naari zaŋ chaŋ a daba zaa sani.
en: and said, Lord , God of Israel, there is no other god like you in heaven or on the earth. You keep the agreement that you made with your people. You are kind and loyal to those who follow you with all their heart.

dag: O niŋla Naawuni naani; lala zuɣu Naawuni yi bɔr o, ŋun fam o bahi pumpɔŋɔ, dama o yɛliya, N nyɛla Naawuni Bia. .
en: He trusted God. So let God save him now, if God really wants him. He himself said, I am the Son of God.

dag: N wum Naawuni ni yɛli siɣimsiɣim bushɛm ni ŋun Naawuni n-su yiko.
en: I heard God say two things: I am powerful.

dag: Ka Ammɔnnim daa yɔri farigu Naa Uzia sani, ka o yuli daa du hal ka Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ nim ti wum o yɛla, dama o daa niŋ yaa pam.
en: Even the Ammonites paid taxes to Uzziah. He became very powerful, and people who lived as far away as Egypt heard about him.

dag: Zɛra yaaŋa Ɛkan ni daa zaɣisi Naawuni noli ka kpuɣi binshɛŋa bɛ ni daa zaŋ ti Naawuni la, yi bi teei Naawuni suhu ni daa yiɣisi bahi Izraɛlnim zaa zuɣu shɛm la yɛla? Ka di pala Ɛkan kɔŋko n-daa kpi o daalahichi maa tumbu zuɣu. .
en: Remember how Achan son of Zerah refused to obey the command about things that must be destroyed. That one man broke Gods law, but all the Israelites were punished. Achan died because of his sin, but also many other people died.

dag: Yawɛ ni ti yihi dɔriti balibu kam yi ni, ka Ijipti dɔr biɛ shɛŋa zaa din daa gbahiri ya la, o ku lan chɛ ka di gbahi ya. Amaa o ni chɛ ka di gbahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa jɛn ya.
en: The Lord will take away all sickness from you and he will not let you catch any of the terrible diseases that you had in Egypt. But he will make your enemies catch those diseases.

dag: O daa zaŋ zibisim din gil o leeg o sampaa, ka sagban tibisa leeg o kom dooshee.
en: Darkness was your tent! Thunderclouds filled the sky, hiding you from sight.

dag: O daa bɔh o bipalitab maa mi, Yi lee tɛhiya ni wula ka di simdi ni ti yɛli niriba bɛn yɛli ma, Filimmi ʒi tibisi shɛl a ba ni daa ʒil ti la? .
en: What do you advise? he asked them. How should we respond to these people who have said to me, Lighten the workload your father demanded of us.

dag: Ka tulaale zim ni daa pali salima lahi pinaayi shɛŋa la zaɣ yini kam tibisim nyɛ giram kɔbiga ni pia kaman Naawuni jɛmbu duu liɣiri tibisim zahimbu ni nyɛ shɛm. Ka salima lahi maa zaa tibisim nyɛ kaman kilɔgiram yini ni giram pihitanaayi.
en: The gold spoons filled with incense weighed ounces each, using the official measure. The gold spoons all together weighed about pounds.

dag: Ka di daa niŋ niriba maa alahiziba pam ka bɛ bɔhiri taba, Yɛtɔɣ bɔ ka doo ŋɔ lee yɛli ŋɔ? O mali yiko ka su fukumsi hal ka alizin biɛri ti deer o noli ka zɔri ka chɛri bɛ ni ʒi shɛb zuɣu.
en: The people were amazed. They said to each other, What does this mean? With authority and power he commands evil spirits and they come out.

dag: Tumo maa daa yɛlila Dauda, Ti dimnim maa daa gari ti la yaa ka yina ni bɛ ti tuhi ti polo ni, amaa ka ti daa lan daai ba labisi bɛ tiŋ maa dunɔdal ni.
en: He added, The enemy chased us from the wall and out into the open fields. But we pushed them back as far as the city gate.
