dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Naawuni daa ti yɛn zahim Ibrahimma ka bol o, Ibrahimma! Ka Ibrahimma garigi yɛli, N-nyɛ ma.
en: After these events, God tested Abraham and said to him, Abraham! Abraham answered, Im here.

dag: Teeku kom yiɣisiya pili Babilɔn, ka di kɔgbana din mali vuri pam la lim li.
en: The sea has rolled over Babylon and covered it with roaring waves.

dag: Haman ni daa nya ka Mɔdɛkai zaɣisi ni o ku ti o jilima bee n-damd o tiŋ maa, ka o suhu yiɣisi pam.
en: When Haman himself saw that Mordecai didnt kneel or bow down to him, he became very angry.

dag: O zaŋ o lɔɣu ni piɛm to n suhu.
en: He shot the arrows of his quiver into my inside parts.

dag: Ka Yawɛ suhu daa yiɣisi pam dindali maa, ka o po n-yɛli.
en: The Lord became very angry.

dag: Ka o ni tum so taali maa dɔɣiri so yi kani ka o ni zaŋ taali tumbu samli maa yo o, ŋun zaŋm li ti Yawɛ, ka bɛ zaŋ li ti maligumaana m-pahi piɛla so bɛ ni yɛn zaŋ mali sara ŋun tum taali maa zuɣu la.
en: If the victim has no relative who can accept this money, it belongs to me and will be paid to the priest. In addition to that payment, you must take a ram for the priest to sacrifice so your sin will be forgiven.

dag: amaa ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn kpahiri ninvuɣ biɛri zuɣu ni ni mali suhupiɛlli, ka nya alibarika pam.
en: But it will go well for those who rebuke them. A rich blessing will come to them.

dag: Tia kam din bi wandi wal suma, bɛ ŋmari li mi luhi n-zaŋ nyo buɣim.
en: Every tree that doesnt produce good fruit is chopped down and thrown into the fire.

dag: Di saha ka Naawuni daa yɛl o, Di miri kpe na, pirigim a namda maa, dama a ni ʒe luɣ shɛli ŋɔ nyɛla luɣ kasi shee.
en: Then the LORD said, Dont come any closer! Take off your sandals, because you are standing on holy ground.

dag: Fɔndi ŋɔ mini di tiŋkpansi zaa daa bela Dan zuliya ni daa deei tiŋgban shɛli ka di leei bɛ dini kaman bɛ daŋ niriba ni nyɛ shɛm maa ni.
en: These cities and their towns were in the land which the families of the tribe of Dan received as their possession.

dag: Di ni sab shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Naawuni yɛligu mir a; hal di be a nol ni min a suhu ni. .
en: What it says is this: God's message is near you, on your lips and in your heart—that is, the message of faith that we preach.

dag: ka goli daa kpalim zani di jilima shee; a piɛma neesim din daa gariti yomyom la min a kpani din daa nyaɣisira la zuɣu.
en: The sun and moon stood still, while your arrows and spears flashed like lightning.

dag: Ka Midian nanima ayi bɛn nyɛ: Zɛba mini Zalimuna daa guui, ka Gidiɔn kari doli ti gbahi ba, ka chɛ ka bɛ tɔbbihi zaa suhuri chihi.
en: Zebah and Zalmunna, kings of the Midianites, ran away. But Gideon chased and caught them. Gideon and his men defeated the enemy army.

dag: Amaa ka Sisɛra daa guui hal ti paai Hɛbɛr Kɛn nir la paɣ Jaɛl tanti gbini; dama zabili daa lan ka Hazɔr Naa Jabin mini Hɛbɛr Kɛn nir maa yiŋnim sunsuuni.
en: Sisera ran away to the tent of Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite, because King Jabin of Hazor was at peace with Heber's family.

dag: O daa lan tuhi nyaŋ Mɔabnima, ka bɛ leeg o daba, ka yɔri farigu o sani.
en: He also defeated the Moabites, who became his subjects and paid taxes to him.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn kabiri kpɛri fɔntinsi ni, ka duri goma, ka duri kpɛri yiya puuni ka duri kpɛri takɔriti ni kaman tayiɣisi la.
en: They swarm over city walls and enter our homes; they crawl in through windows, just like thieves.

dag: Ka o yi po pɔri shɛlikam ni o niŋ shɛli, o yidana mali soli ni o saɣi li bee n-zaɣisi li.
en: Her husband has the final say about any promises she makes to the Lord .

dag: Nir nyamma yi pahi, bɛn diri li gba pahirimi. Ka di nyɔri nyɛ dini ŋun su li sani m-pahila o nini n-kul yɛn nya li?.
en: The more wealth people have, the more friends they have to help spend it. So the rich really gain nothing. They can only look at their wealth.

dag: Ka Pita daa puɣisiri doli Yisa nyaaŋa m-mali ti paai maligumaaniba zuɣulan maa yiŋ dundɔŋ ni nti ʒi yili maa ni dunɔguliba sani wuɣisiri buɣim.
en: Peter had followed at a distance, and when he reached the courtyard of the high priest's house, he sat down with the guards to warm himself beside a fire.

dag: Duuma yino m-beni, amaa ka o tuma soya lee nyɛ balibubalibu.
en: There are different ways to serve, but we serve the same Lord.

dag: Ka a ni diri binshɛli zuɣu yi chɛ ka a kpee suhu miligi, dindina a bi doli yurilim soli. Di chɛ ka a ni diri binshɛli zuɣu chɛ ka Yisa Masia ni kpi a kpe so zuɣu bahi yoli.
en: If you hurt others because of something you eat, then you are no longer acting from love. Do not let the food that you eat ruin the person for whom Christ died!.

dag: Amaa ŋuni n-lee ni ti tooi tiligi o kandina dabisili maa dali? Ka o yi ti yi palo, ŋuni n-lee ni tooi zani? Dama o ni ŋmanila saviɣu ni buɣim, ka ŋmani chibo din paɣiri yiri zaa.
en: Who can endure the day of his coming? Who can withstand his appearance? He is like the refiners fire or the cleaners soap.

dag: Miriya ka yi ti zo o nambɔɣu. Amaa yihimiya ninvuɣ so ŋun ka taali maa ʒim yihibu taali Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni din ni chɛ ka binshɛɣukam niŋ viɛnyɛliŋga yi sani.
en: Show no mercy to such killers. Remove innocent bloodshed from Israel so that things go well for you.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N ni zaŋ a niŋ a ni je ninvuɣ shɛba ka ŋmaligi ni suhuyiɣisili ka chɛ ba la nuu ni.
en: I, the Lord God, am ready to hand you over to those hateful enemies that you find so disgusting.

dag: Chɛliya ka yi daania niŋbu maa niŋ pali, ka di chɛ ka yi bi niriba ka ba n-zani shɛlikam zaa puuni, ka ku kɔŋ shɛli.
en: Make sure that your endurance carries you all the way without failing, so that you may be perfect and complete, lacking nothing.

dag: Pɛlɛg ni daa dɔɣi Riu maa nyaaŋa, o daa niŋla yuun kɔbisiyinaawɛi. O daa lan dɔɣi bidibisi mini bipuɣinsi pahi.
en: after that, he lived another years and had other children.

dag: Amaa yi kpalim jɛmdila yi wuni din nyɛ yi naa ka yi booni li Sakut la mini yi saŋmariga wuni din yuli booni Kaiwan la binnana.
en: But you also carried statues of Sakkuth, your king, and Kaiwan. There was also that star god that you made for yourselves.

dag: Ka ŋunkam ti be dufahirili zuɣu, ŋun di lan siɣina ni o ti kpe o duu kah o nɛma.
en: If you are on the roof of your house, don't go inside to get anything.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka Gɛhaazi daa shiri yiɣisi kariti Naaman naba. Ka Naaman daa ti nya ka so zɔri dol o nyaaŋa na, ka o sheeg o chɛchɛbuŋ zuɣu n-chaŋ ti tuh o soli bɔh o, Alaafee.
en: So Gehazi ran to Naaman. Naaman saw someone running after him. He stepped down from the chariot to meet Gehazi. Naaman said, Is everything all right.

dag: Ka n daa chaŋ tiwala tihi puu ni, ni n ti nya vinvamli ni tipuma, ka nya wain tihi puma, ka nya pumpɔrinchihi tihi puma.
en: I went down to see if blossoms were on the walnut trees, grapevines, and fruit trees.

dag: Ka o yɛtɔɣa maa daa paligi Absalom mini Izraɛl kpamba zaa suhuri.
en: This plan seemed excellent to Absalom and the Israelite elders.

dag: Ka lan zaŋ wain pipia niŋ alibarika niŋ di ni, ka zaŋ li ti ba ka yɛli, Yi zaa nyumiya li.
en: He took a cup, gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying, Drink from this, all of you.

dag: Dama Naawuni nina kul gɔrimi gindi dunia ŋɔ ni luɣilikam ni o kpaŋsi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn gbibi yɛlimaŋli zaŋ chaŋ o sani suhuri. A tum jɛrilim dimbɔŋɔ puuni, dama pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ chana, a kul yɛn bela tɔb tuhibu ni.
en: The eyes of the Lord go around looking in all the earth for people who are faithful to him so that he can make them strong. Asa, you did a foolish thing. So from now on you will have wars.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Yawɛ, nyini n-nyɛ n firila, Yawɛ tiri ma neesim n zibisim ni.
en: Lord , you are my lamp. You, Lord , turn the darkness around me into light.

dag: Zalim Izraɛlnim ka bɛ bɔri olivi kpa viɛlli na nti niŋdi firila ni din ni chɛ ka firila maa kul ne n-ʒiɛya sahakam.
en: Command the people of Israel to supply you with the purest olive oil. Do this so the lamp will keep burning.

dag: Pukpara maa daa yaɣindila Naawuni yɛligu.
en: The sower sows God's message.

dag: Zaligu ŋɔ nyɛla binshɛli din yi o tooni na ka nyɛ daɣiri maa zaligu. O tooni yi yiɣisi bee di yi bi yiɣisi, di nyɛla daɣiri o sani.
en: This is the nature of the uncleanness brought about by his emission: regardless of whether his genital organ allows his emission to flow or blocks the flow, it is unclean to him.

dag: Amaa ti tuumbiɛri yi nyɛla din wuhiri ni Naawuni niŋdi din tuhi, dindina wula ka ti lee ni yɛli? Ti ni yɛli ni Naawuni yi darigi ti tibili o bi niŋ din tuhi? Ninsal tɛha yɛtɔɣa ka n tɔɣisi maa.
en: If our evil deeds show how right God is, then what can we say? Is it wrong for God to become angry and punish us? What a foolish thing to ask.

dag: Ka o daa chaŋ ti deei litaafi maa ŋun ʒi nam ʒiishee maa nudirigu ni.
en: He came forward and took the scroll from the right hand of the one seated on the throne.

dag: O guli ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli zaligu soli, ka taɣiri ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe o yim barina ni.
en: He protects those who treat others fairly, and guards those who are devoted to him.

dag: ni o ni daa chɛ ka Musa tum tuun kar shɛŋa zaa ni o ni daa wuhi yiko din mali dabiɛm Izraɛlnim zaa ninni shɛm la.
en: No other prophet has been able to do the great and terrifying things that Moses did in the sight of all Israel.

dag: Ŋuni n-lee nyɛ a, nyin ninsala, ni a ŋme Naawuni naŋgbankpeeni? Duɣu ni tooi bɔhi yaɣimɛra, Bɔ n-niŋ ka a me ma lala.
en: But, my friend, I ask, Who do you think you are to question God? Does the clay have the right to ask the potter why he shaped it the way he did?.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka o mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa dol o la daa naanyi di ka nyu, ka gbe nimaani. Ka biɛɣu daa neei ka o yiɣisi ka yɛli ba, N suhiri soli ni n labi n dan sani.
en: He and the men with him ate and drank and spent the night. When they got up in the morning, the servant said, See me off to my master.

dag: Pɛriʒia Naa Sairus daa zaŋ li n-tila Mitrɛdat ŋun daa nyɛ laɣiguliba kpɛm ŋun daa niŋ di laasabu n-ti Juda gomna Shɛshibaza la.
en: Cyrus placed Mithredath, his chief treasurer, in charge of these things. Mithredath counted them and gave a list to Sheshbazzar, the governor of Judah.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ tɔbbihi naa ŋɔ ni gul o niriba, ka chɛ ka bɛ nyaŋ bɛ dimnima. Bɛ ni ti tahiri tɔb gɔɣu ni kaman danyuriba la, ka ti yihi bɛ dimnim ʒim, ka di zɔri kaman sara maligu ʒim ka bɛ zaŋ niŋ laa ni n-kpaai pa bimbini zuɣu la.
en: The Lord All-Powerful will protect his people, and they will trample down the sharpshooters and their slingshots. They will drink and get rowdy; they will be as full as a bowl at the time of sacrifice.

dag: Ka paɣ so ŋun nyɛ wɔɣirili yi ni, ka nyɛ ŋun diri viɛnyɛla, hal ka ku saɣi zaŋ o napɔŋ no tiŋa, o gba ni ti mɔŋ o ni yur o yidaan so min o bidibiga ni o bipuɣiŋga bindirigu.
en: A woman may have grown up in such luxury that she never had to put a foot on the ground. But times will be so bad that she will secretly eat both her newborn baby and the afterbirth, without sharing any with her husband or her other children.

dag: Ka o dan maa daa nya ka Yawɛ be Yisifu sani, ka chɛ ka o ni niŋdi shɛlikam zaa tɔŋda.
en: His master saw that the LORD was with him and that the LORD made everything he did successful.

dag: dindina maligumaana maa ŋun chɛ ka bɛ paɣi dɔro ni be binshɛl ni maa, ka o lan kpari li niŋ duu daba ayopɔin yaha.
en: the priest will order that the infected piece be washed, and he will quarantine it for another seven days.

dag: So miri ka o zaŋ o mabia paɣ dɔni, dama o nyɛla o mabia maa paɣa.
en: or with your brother's wife.

dag: O ni daa mali ti paai Naawuni nir maa sani zoli maa zuɣu, o daa gbaala o napɔŋ, ka Gɛhaazi kana ni o ti daag o bahi, ka Naawuni nir maa yɛl o, Chɛl o. O malila yɛli muɣisirili ka Yawɛ zaŋ li sɔɣi ma ka bi kahigi li wuhi ma.
en: When she got to the man of God at the mountain, she grabbed his feet. Gehazi came up to push her away, but the man of God said, Leave her alone! She is distraught, but the LORD has hidden the reason from me and hasnt told me why.

dag: Ka Ahija ŋun daa nyɛ Lɛvi zuliya ni nir la daa su Naawuni jɛmbu duu azichi sɔŋbu shee mini bɛ ni daa yi zaŋdi pin shɛŋa zaa na ti tiri Naawuni la fukumsi.
en: Ahijah was from the tribe of Levi. Ahijah was responsible for taking care of the valuable things in Gods Temple. Ahijah also was responsible for the places where the holy things were kept.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni kari zuliya shɛb bɛn be yi tooni maa zaa biɛlabiɛla; yi ku tooi kari ba naai yomyom, di yi niŋ lala mɔɣu ni biŋkɔb biɛri ni ti galisi nyaŋ ya.
en: The LORD your God will drive out these nations before you bit by bit. You wont be able to finish them off quickly; otherwise, the wild animals would become too much for you to handle.

dag: Dinzuɣu yinima, yi Naawuni sɔŋsim zuɣu, labimiya o sani. Gbibiya yurilim mini yɛlimaŋli, ka kul guhimiya yi Naawuni maa sahakam.
en: But you! Return to your God with faithful love and justice, and wait continually for your God.

dag: Saimɔn Pita ni daa nya lala maa, ka o damdi Yisa tooni yɛr o, N Duuma, m bi simdi ni m mir a, dama n nyɛla alahichilana.
en: The fishermen were all amazed at the many fish they caught. When Simon Peter saw this, he bowed down before Jesus and said, Go away from me, Lord. I am a sinful man.

dag: Ka Babilɔnnim maa daa kana ka o mini ba ti dɔni, ka bɛ daa zaŋ bɛ kɔre maa saɣim o, o ni daa saɣim omaŋ maa nyaaŋa, ka o daa yi bɛ sani chaŋ ni suhuyiɣisili.
en: The Babylonians came to her to lie down and make love with her, defiling her with their seductions. But once she had defiled herself with them, she recoiled from them in disgust.

dag: Masia zuɣu ka tinim bɛn nyɛ Yɛhudianim mini bɛn pa Yɛhudianim zaa ni tooi chaŋ ti Ba Naawuni sani o Shi yino la zuɣu.
en: It is through Christ that all of us, Jews and Gentiles, are able to come in the one Spirit into the presence of the Father.

dag: Dinzuɣu baŋmiya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ni Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ n-nyɛ ŋun yɛn daŋ yi tooni du kaman buɣim din dira. O ni nyaŋ ba ka gbarigi ba tin ya din ni chɛ ka yi kari ba yihi, ka ku ba yomyom kaman Yawɛ ni daa lɔn ya alikauli shɛm.
en: But now you will see for yourselves that the Lord your God will go ahead of you like a raging fire. He will defeat them as you advance, so that you will drive them out and destroy them quickly, as he promised.

dag: Zaŋmiya dimbɔŋɔnim maani sara tiri Yawɛ yi churi puhibu ni m-pahi yi pɔri pɔbu sara mini yi suhuyubu sara kaman yi ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ni yi chi sara ni yi binnyura sara ni yi biɛrisuŋ sara la zuɣu.
en: These you will offer to the LORD at your appointed times in addition to your payments for solemn promises, your spontaneous gifts, your entirely burned offerings, your grain offerings, your drink offerings, and your well-being sacrifices.

dag: Ka ti nya dimbɔŋɔ ka di li shɛhira n-yɛri ni ti Ba Naawuni daa tim o Bia na ni o ti leei dunianim Tiligira.
en: We have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son to be the savior of the world.

dag: Amaa bɛ yi ku lo kpara pahi yi zuɣu du, yi mini ba zaa tarili ni bela Keenan tiŋgbɔŋ ni.
en: But if they break their promise, they will receive land on the other side of the Jordan, like the rest of the tribes.

dag: Dama bɛn mali niŋgbuŋ zaa ŋuni n-na mi n-wum Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ kukoli ni tɔɣisiri yɛtɔɣa buɣim sunsuuni kaman ti ni wum shɛm ŋɔ, ka na be o nyɛvili ni?.
en: No one has ever heard the living God speak from the fire like we have and still lived!.

dag: Dama zuliya shɛli yi nuzaa polo na ti lir o. Bɛ ni ti chɛ ka o tiŋgbani maa leei dabari, ka so ku lan be nimaani. Ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri zaa ni ti yi nimaani zo.
en: The attack on the Babylonians will come from the north; they and their animals will run, leaving the land empty.

dag: Dinzuɣu ka n daa zaŋ anzinfa laɣibaligu pinaanu mini chi kilɔgiram kɔbiga ni pihinu yo o zuɣu.
en: So I bought her for fifteen pieces of silver, a large amount of barley, and a portion of wine.

dag: N-yi biɛɣu ka o daa bol o nyaandoliba na nti pii bɛ ni ninvuɣ pinaayi m-boli ba tuumba.
en: The next morning he called his disciples together and chose twelve of them to be his apostles.

dag: Amaa ka Sool daa yɛli, Aai, di bi simdi ni ti ku so zuŋɔ, dama zuŋɔ ka Yawɛ ti Izraɛlnim faako.
en: But Saul said, No, dont kill anyone today! The Lord saved Israel today.

dag: Yi ni ti teerila dabiɛm din daa yi mali ya la yɛla ka bɔhira, Ka ŋun kaani liɣiri la lee be ya? Ka ŋun zahindi farigu binyara tibisim la lee be ya? Ka ŋun kaani pihi la lee be ya.
en: in dismay you will think: Where is the one who counts? Where is the one who weighs? Where is the one who counts towers?.

dag: Wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm: Yiɣisimiya n-zaŋ yi yɛla maa fabili niŋ zoya, ka chɛ ka daboya wum yi kukoya.
en: The Lord said to his people: Come and present your case to the hills and mountains.

dag: Mani n-nyɛ tia maa, ka yi mi nyɛ di wula; ŋun kul tuɣ ma ka n gba tuɣ o, ŋuna n-wandi wala pam; dama yi yi bi tuɣ ma, yi ku tooi niŋ shɛli.
en: I am the vine, and you are the branches. Those who remain in me, and I in them, will bear much fruit; for you can do nothing without me.

dag: Ka shi so daa tɔhi zani Yawɛ tooni yɛl o, Man ni niŋ o naŋgban malisim. Ka Yawɛ bɔh o, So dini ka a lee yɛn doli.
en: then finally a spirit came forward and said to the Lord , I can trick Ahab. How? the Lord asked.

dag: Ka bɛ ni ti yo ba li bɛ nyɛviya ni, ka bɛ wula ti ku maha.
en: like a date palm tree without a leaf.

dag: Dama a yihi ma muɣisigu kam ni, ka chɛ ka n nini nya n dimnim nasara kɔŋbu.
en: You saved me from all my troubles. I saw my enemies defeated.

dag: m-pahi paɣ shɛb o ni daa chɛ ka bɛ dɔriti naai min o ni daa kari alizin biɛri paɣ shɛb zuɣu bahi la. Bɛna n-nyɛ: Mariama ŋun daa yi Magdala na ka nyɛ alizin biɛr ayopɔin ni daa ʒi so zuɣu la.
en: and so were some women who had been healed of evil spirits and all sorts of diseases. One of the women was Mary Magdalene, who once had seven demons in her.

dag: Wuntizɔriba nya li, ka bɛ suhuri paligi, ka bɛn ka taali lara, ka maani ba ansarisi yɛra.
en: The righteous see and rejoice; the innocent mock them.

dag: Ka o daa ti wumis o bi yino, ka o niŋ yaa, ka bɔhim binyara gbahibu, ka daa ŋubiri ninsalinima.
en: She raised a cub and taught him to hunt; he learned to eat people.

dag: Ka shɛb yɛli ni Anabi Ilaija n-lan yi palo maa yaha, ka shɛb mi yɛli ni anab kura la ni yino n-neei kum ni na maa.
en: Others were saying that Elijah had appeared, and still others that one of the prophets of long ago had come back to life.

dag: Ka nyin na bɔri yɛl kara ni a ti amaŋa? Di lan bɔ li, dama n yɛn chɛmi ka zaɣ biɛɣu paai ninsalinim zaa. Amaa n ni tilig a nyɛvili a ni yɛn chaŋ luɣ shɛlikam zaa. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Are you looking for special treatment for yourself? Don't do it. I am bringing disaster on all people, but you will at least escape with your life, wherever you go. I, the Lord , have spoken.

dag: O daa chɛ ka tampiŋ bɔɣi ka kom yi di ni na n-zɔri chani tiŋgban nɛli zuɣu kaman mɔɣili la.
en: He opened a rock, and water gushed out, flowing through the desert like a river.

dag: Ka o daa yɛli Musa, Mmaŋmaŋ n yɛn dol a chaŋ, ka ti a vuhim.
en: The Lord said, I will go with you and give you peace.

dag: A chɛ ka a mini Ijiptinim bɛn nyɛ a ʒiʒiinitaba, ka nyɛ kɔribiɛrinim la tum pagɔrisigu tuma, ka di zuɣu chɛ ka a pagɔrisigu tuma maa galisi pam, ni a chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi.
en: You prostituted yourself with the Egyptians, your neighbors with the large sexual organs, and as you added to your seductions, you provoked me to anger.

dag: Amaa dapuhi maa daa wɔɣ pam, ka so daa yi ʒe luɣ kasi shee maa ka lihi, o ni tooi nya di nyoya ni. Amaa so daa yi zani samban ni, o ku tooi nya li. Di na kul be nimaani hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: The poles were so long that they could be seen from just outside the most holy place, but not from anywhere else. And they stayed there from then on.

dag: Ka Naawuni bɔh o, Ŋuni n-lee yɛl a ni a bela a zaɣim? A dila ti shɛli n ni yɛl a ni a miri ka a di la.
en: Who told you that you were naked? God asked. Did you eat the fruit that I told you not to eat.

dag: Dindali maa ka Yawɛ daa lo Ibram alikauli yɛli, N ni zaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ti a zuliya. Zaŋ Ijipti mɔɣili noli hal ti paai Yufretiiz Mɔɣ tital la noli.
en: That day the LORD cut a covenant with Abram: To your descendants I give this land, from Egypts river to the great Euphrates.

dag: Bakibakar ni Hɛrɛsh ni Galal ni Matania ŋun daa nyɛ Maika bia la, Maika daa nyɛla Zikiri bia, ka Zikiri nyɛ Asaf bia.
en: Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, and Mattaniah son of Mica son of Zichri son of Asaph.

dag: Simiɔn bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Jɛmuɛl mini Jamin ni Ohad ni Jachin ni Zɔhar ni Shaul ŋun daa nyɛ Keenan paɣ bia la. Bɛmbɔŋɔnima n-daa nyɛ Simiɔn zuliya ni kpamba.
en: Simeons sons were Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Zohar, and Shaul. .

dag: Ka Zurishadai bia Shɛlumiɛl daa nyɛ Simiɔn zuliya zuɣulana;.
en: Shelumiel, Zurishaddais son, commanded the military of the tribe of Simeon.

dag: Dama o daa yɛlimi, ka di niŋ. O daa zal li zaligu, ka di ba n-zani.
en: Because when he spoke, it happened! When he commanded, there it was!.

dag: N ŋman piɛlli ŋun luɣ shɛli ka galimi maa kul nyɛla zaɣ yino ko. O kɔŋko n-kul nyɛ o ma bipuɣiŋga. O ka dalinli. Paɣiba yi kul nya o, bɛ paɣir o mi. Napaɣiba mini naa mamanim gba yi kul nya o bɛ paɣir o mi.
en: but my dove, my perfect one, is one of a kind. To her mother shes the only one, radiant to the one who bore her. Young women see her and declare her fortunate; queens and secondary wives praise her.

dag: Naa Hɛrɔd ni daa diri Judia saha shɛl la, ka maligumaani so daa beni ka o yuli booni Zakaria. O daa nyɛla Abija daŋ ni nira, ka o paɣ mi daa nyɛ Aduna daŋ ni nira, ka o yuli booni Ɛlizabɛt.
en: During the rule of King Herod of Judea there was a priest named Zechariah who belonged to the priestly division of Abijah. His wife Elizabeth was a descendant of Aaron.

dag: Ka Balaam daa yɛli Balak, Mɛm sara maligu bimbina ayopɔin zali ma kpe, ka bo naɣilah ayopɔin mini piɛlah ayopɔin ti ma kpe na.
en: He said to Balak, Build seven altars here for me, and bring me seven bulls and seven rams.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yɛlimaŋli, yi ni ti nyu binnyur shɛli din be m pipia maa ni, amaa n nudirigu mini n nuzaa polo ʒinibu maa din pala man tibu; amaa m Ba Naawuni ni mal li zali ninvuɣ shɛba n-ni ti ʒin nimaani.
en: He said to them, You will drink from my cup, but to sit at my right or left hand isnt mine to give. It belongs to those for whom my Father prepared it.

dag: Yi daa bi zaŋ piɛri na nti mali sara nyo buɣim ti ma jilima. M bi muɣisi ya ni yi zaŋ sara maligunim na ti ti ma. M mi bi muɣisi ya ni yi zaŋ tulaale zim na ti tuɣili ti ma.
en: You did not bring me your burnt offerings of sheep; you did not honor me with your sacrifices. I did not burden you by demanding offerings or wear you out by asking for incense.

dag: Ka Hɛnadad bia Binnui daa mali me yaɣ shɛli m-pan o zuɣu. O daa kpuɣi li la Azaria yiŋ hal ti paai gooni maa gɔŋbu shee.
en: Binnui son of Henadad built the next section, from Azariah's house to the corner of the wall;.

dag: Ka Liya daa yɛli, N ni zaŋ n dab bipuɣiŋga ti n yidan la zuɣu, Naawuni deei n suhigu; ka boli bia maa yuli Isaka.
en: Leah said, God has given me my reward, because I gave my slave to my husband; so she named her son Issachar.

dag: Yawɛ, nyini n-kul nyɛ n ni bɔri so; n lo alikauli ni n ni gbib a yɛligu.
en: Lord , I decided that my duty is to obey your commandments.

dag: Miri ka a nahind amaŋa buni nyabu zuɣu, niŋmi yɛm din ni chɛ ka a yi di yɛla ni.
en: Give up trying so hard to get rich.

dag: Di lan sab yaha: Bɛn pa Yɛhudianim zaa, paɣimiya ti Duuma, ka chɛ ka zuliya kam zaa paɣ o.
en: Again the Scriptures say, Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles. All you nations, come and worship him.

dag: Amaa ka bɛ daa kaɣil o hal ka di ti niŋ o vi, ka o bahi ba noli ni bɛ timma. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa tim ninvuɣ pihinu ka bɛ chaŋ ti lihi bɔ o dabisi muna ata zaa ka bi nya o.
en: The group of prophets begged Elisha until he was embarrassed. Then Elisha said, Send the men to look for Elijah. The group of prophets sent the men to look for Elijah. They looked three days, but they could not find him.

dag: N ni lan chahi yi sarisi ŋɔ, ka fa n niriba bɛn be yi nuu ni maa bahi, ka bɛ ku lan be yi nuu ni n-nyɛ yi ni yɛn ku shɛba. Ka yi baŋ ni mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: I will tear the scarves from their heads and rescue my people from their power once and for all. Then they will know that I am the Lord God.

dag: Di saha ka Finɛhas daa yiɣisi zani n-tim sandaani ka alɔbo maa chɛ.
en: Then Phinehas stood up and prayed, and the plague was contained.

dag: Zuɣu ni kpahibu ka a mali darigiri ninsalinim tibili bɛ daalahichi zuɣu, ka saɣindi bɛ ni yuri binshɛŋa zaa kaman binneembihi n-nyɛ li la. Yɛlimaŋli, ninsal biɛhigu shiri ŋmanila vuhim.
en: You discipline people for their sin, punishing them; like a moth, you ruin what they treasure. Yes, a human life is just a puff of air! Selah.

dag: Ka zim maa daa shiri bi naai di duɣu maa ni; ka kpam la gba daa bi naai di ŋmani maa ni kaman Yawɛ ni daa chɛ ka Ilaija pun yɛli shɛm la.
en: The jar of flour and the jug of oil were never empty. This happened just as the Lord said through Elijah.

dag: Baanabas mini Sool ni daa tum bɛ tuma naai, ka bɛ zaŋ Jɔn ŋun yuli daa lan booni Maak la pahi bɛmaŋ zuɣu yi Jɛrusalɛm n-lan chaŋ bɛ chandi shee.
en: After Barnabas and Saul finished their work in Jerusalem, they returned to Antioch, taking John Mark with them.

dag: N ni siɣina ti tɔɣisi ya yɛtɔɣa nimaani; ka zaŋ shi so ŋun be a zuɣu maa yiko shɛli niŋ bɛ ni, ka bɛ ʒi niriba maa ʒili maa sɔŋ a, ka a kɔŋko ku lan ʒi li.
en: Then I will come down and speak with you there. The Spirit is on you now. But I will also give some of that Spirit to them. Then they will help you take care of the people. In this way you will not have to be responsible for these people alone.

dag: Samuɛl ni daa nya Sool maa, ka Yawɛ yɛl o, N ni sa yɛl a ninvuɣ so yɛla la m-bala, Ŋuna n-yɛn su n niriba maa.
en: When Samuel saw Saul, the Lord said to Samuel, This is the man I told you about. He will rule my people.

dag: Ka Musa daa niŋ binshɛɣukam kaman Yawɛ ni daa wuh o ni o niŋ maa.
en: Moses obeyed the Lord. He did everything that the Lord commanded him.

dag: Nyama, man Yawɛ n-zaŋ Vuhim Dabisili maa tin ya, lala zuɣu ka n tiri ya daba ayi bindirigu daba ayɔbu dali maa din ni chɛ ka sokam be o yiŋa, ka ku yi n-chaŋ luɣ shɛli polo daba ayopɔin maa dali.
en: Remember that I, the Lord , have given you a day of rest, and that is why on the sixth day I will always give you enough food for two days. Everyone is to stay where he is on the seventh day and not leave his home.

dag: Zaŋmiya yi puri ni bindir daŋda din viɛla n-ka Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ jɛmbu duu na. Miriya ka yi zaŋ bubil bee piɛbil ma bihim duɣ o.
en: When you gather your crops at harvest time, you should bring the first of everything you harvest to the house of the Lord your God. You must not eat the meat from a young goat that is boiled in its mothers milk.

dag: Di saha Izraɛlnim zaa daa ʒiɛla nimaani, ka naa ŋmaligi bɛ polo n-suhi alibarika niŋ bɛ ni.
en: Solomon turned toward the people standing there. Then he blessed them.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa deei Ilaija suhigu, ka chɛ ka bia maa nyɛvili lab o ni na ka o neei.
en: The Lord answered Elijah's prayer; the child started breathing again and revived.

dag: tiŋgbani maa tintariga; o ni yɛn su shɛli m-bala Izraɛl tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Ka n nanim maa ku lan muɣisi n niriba maa. Amaa bɛ ni ti chɛ ka Izraɛlnim su tiŋgbɔŋ maa kaman bɛ zuliya ni nyɛ shɛm.
en: This land will be the rulers property in Israel. So he will not need to make life hard for my people anymore. But they will give the land to the Israelites for their tribes.

dag: Naawuni daa bi zaŋ dunia shɛli din ti yɛn kana ka nyɛ ti ni tɔɣisiri shɛli yɛla ŋɔ subu fukumsi niŋ malaikanim nuu ni.
en: God didnt put the world that is coming under the angels control.

dag: Ka farigudeeriba gba daa kana ni bɛ ti deei baptaizibu ka bɔh o, Karimba, ka wula ka ti lee yɛn niŋ.
en: Even the tax collectors came to John. They wanted to be baptized. They said to him, Teacher, what should we do.

dag: Nimaani ka yi ni ti jɛmdi wuna din nyɛ kuɣa mini dari, ka nyɛ ninsalinim ni zaŋ bɛ nuhi mali binshɛŋa, ka di ku tooi nya bee n-wum bee n-di bee n-wum nyom ŋɔ.
en: There you will serve gods made by human hands, gods of wood and stone, gods that cannot see or hear, eat or smell.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli ma ni bɛn daa tiligi ka bɛ bi gbahi ba daba maa be muɣisigu ni pam ni vi ni bɛ yaɣili maa ni, ka Jɛrusalɛm gooni la lu, ka buɣim di di dunɔdaya.
en: They answered, Nehemiah, the Jews who escaped captivity and are in the land of Judah are in much trouble. They are having many problems and are full of shame because the wall of Jerusalem is broken down, and its gates have been burned with fire.

dag: Di saha ka nabihi maa mini niriba maa zaa daa yɛli maligumaaniba maa mini anabinim maa, Doo ŋɔ bi simdi ni ti ku o, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ yuli ka o zaŋ tɔɣisi ti yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ.
en: Then the leaders and the people said to the priests and the prophets, This man spoke to us in the name of the Lord our God; he should not be put to death.

dag: Ka ti suhiri Naawuni ni yi di tum birigi, ka di pala din wuhiri ni tinim nyaŋla timaŋ buɣisibu, amaa di lee nyɛla din ni chɛ ka yi tum din tuhi hal di ni kul be kaman ti nyɛla bɛn bi nyaŋ timaŋ buɣisibu maa la.
en: We pray to God that you will not do anything wrong. Our concern here is not for people to see that we have passed the test in our work with you. Our main concern is that you do what is right, even if it looks as if we have failed the test.

dag: Di saha ka Samuɛl daa bo kuɣili sa Mizipa mini Jɛshana sunsuuni, ka bol li Ɛbɛnɛza, dama o daa yɛlimi, Kpe ka Yawɛ sɔŋ ti.
en: Then Samuel took a stone and set it up between Mizpah and Jeshanah. He named it Ebenezer, explaining, The LORD helped us to this very point.

dag: Teem o yɛla pɔi ka anzinfa mia la naanyi yihi, ka salima laa la ŋma; ka koyul la ŋma kɔbiliga ni bee ka kalinli la kabi kɔbiliga ni.
en: The silver chain will snap, and the golden lamp will fall and break; the rope at the well will break, and the water jar will be shattered.

dag: Hal bɛ ni booni binshɛŋa buɣa la yi bela zuɣusaa bee dunia ŋɔ ni, dama buɣa pam mini duumanim pam shiri beni.
en: Even if there are so-called gods, whether in heaven or on earth, and even though there are many of these gods and lords.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ ba zalila Yawɛ jɛmbu duu, ka bɛ zoori ti Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa ni.
en: They will take root in your house, Lord God, and they will do well.

dag: Ti lan yɛl a ni di bi tu ni maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim ni yiliyiiniba ni dunɔguliba ni Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa tumtumdiba bɛn pahi yo farigu.
en: We want you to know that no priests, Levites, musicians, guards, temple servants, or any other temple workers will have to pay any kind of taxes.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sabi Naftali zuliya yuya kaman bɛ daŋ ni bɛ malibu ni bɛ yaannim dunoya ni nyɛ shɛm, bɛn paai yuun pisi bee n-gar lala, ka nyɛ bɛn ni tooi chaŋ tɔbu ni.
en: There were the descendants of Naphtali, registered by their clans and their households. The men years old and above eligible for military service were recorded by name.

dag: Bɛ nyɛla bɛn lo nia biɛri bɛ suhuri ni, ka kul bɔrila zabili.
en: They think up evil plans and always cause trouble.

dag: N wum anab shɛb bɛn mali n yuli ŋmari ʒiri yɛra, N zahimla zahindi, n zahimla zahindi.
en: There are prophets who tell lies in my name. They say, I have had a dream! I have had a dream! I heard them say those things.

dag: Yi mal alibarika saha shɛli niriba yi ti jɛn ya, ka gaŋdi ya, ka turi ya, ka saɣindi yi yuya yɛri ni ninvuɣ biɛri n-nyɛn ya Daadam Bia zuɣu.
en: People will hate you because you belong to the Son of Man. They will make you leave their group. They will insult you. They will think it is wrong even to say your name. When these things happen, know that great blessings belong to you.

dag: Miriya ka yi di ʒiri shɛhira n-jɛndi yi kpee.
en: You must not tell lies about other people.

dag: Yɛlim ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Ashidɔd nayiya mini ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni nayiya, Laɣimmiya Samaria zoya zuɣu nti nya taawaaye niŋbu mini tuumbiɛ shɛŋa din tumdi nimaani.
en: Proclaim it to the palaces of Ashdod and to the palaces in the land of Egypt. Say, Gather yourselves on Mount Samaria, and see the great turmoil in the city, and what violent deeds are inside it.

dag: Amaa man ŋmanila olivi ti mahili din sa Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni. N niŋla Naawuni yurilim maŋli la naani sahakam.
en: But I am like a green olive tree in Gods house; I trust in Gods faithful love forever and always.

dag: Pumpɔŋɔ ŋuna m-be palli zuɣu la, pumpɔŋɔ ŋuna m-be daa ni la. O daa kul dola lɔriga kam ni guhira.
en: She has one foot in the street, one foot in the public square. She lies in wait at every corner.

dag: Ti Duuma Yisa Masia daalibarika kpalimmi be yi ni!.
en: May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Zanimi Yawɛ jɛmbu duu dundɔŋ ni n-yɛli Juda fɔntinsinim bɛn zaa yɛn kana ti jɛm Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ŋɔ ni yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa zaa n ni zal a ni a yɛli, ka miri ka a sɔɣi ba yɛtɔɣ shɛli.
en: The LORD proclaims: Stand in the temple courtyard and speak to all the people of the towns of Judah who have come to the temple to worship. Tell them everything I command you; leave nothing out.

dag: Ka sokam ni ti jɛn ya n yuli zuɣu. Amaa ŋunkam ti niŋ suhukpeeni hal ni wahala ŋɔ bahigu ni ti tiligi.
en: All people will hate you because you follow me. But those who remain faithful to the end will be saved.

dag: Di saha ka Napaɣ Ɛsta garigi yɛl o, Naa, a yi saɣi ni a shiri ni ti ma n ni bɔri shɛli a sani, dindina n ni bɔri shɛli nyɛla, tiligimi n nyɛvili, ka tiligi n niriba gba nyɛviya pahi.
en: Queen Esther answered, If I please the king, and if the king wishes, give me my life—thats my wish—and the lives of my people too. Thats my desire.

dag: Naawuni daa niŋ lala ni o kahigila o daanfaani din galisi pam la wuhi palɔni ʒiɛman shɛŋa din kanna ni, ka di yila o ni wuhi ti yurilim shɛli Yisa Masia zuɣu la ni na.
en: God did this so in the future world he could show how truly good and kind he is to us because of what Christ Jesus has done.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma yɛl o, N ni po pɔri maa.
en: And so, Abraham promised he would.

dag: A dabili Jɔab bɔrimi ni o mali yɛla zali dɛde, dina n-chɛ ka o niŋ lala maa. Amaa n dan mali yɛm kaman Naawuni malaika ni mali yɛm shɛm la din ni tooi baŋ binshɛɣukam din be dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: Your servant Joab did this to change the way things look. But my masters wisdom is like the wisdom of one of Gods own messengers—he knows everything that takes place in the land.

dag: O daa lan wurim Juda tiŋgban ni fɔntinsi ni zaa buɣa mini bɛ ni daa yi tuɣindi tulaale zim bimbin shɛŋa zuɣu la zaa, ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka suhudoo be o nam ʒiɛmani maa ni.
en: He also removed all the high places and incense altars from all the towns in Judah. So the kingdom had peace when Asa was king.

dag: Ka Yisa daa yɛli ba ni bɛ yɛlim salo maa zaa ni bɛ laɣimmi gbilligbilli ʒini momaha zuɣu.
en: Jesus told his disciples to tell the people to sit down on the green grass.

dag: Zaŋmiya gali sabilifaa n-she biŋgolinsi niŋ tuuli pateesa la naŋgbambili, ka lan niŋ pateesa shɛli din pah ayi naŋgbambili gba lala.
en: Put loops of blue cloth along one of the wider sides of each panel, then fasten the two panels at the loops with gold hooks.

dag: Yi yi kpe kom puuni ni yi gari, n ni be yi sani, ka yi yi siɣila mɔɣa ni, di ku niŋ ya shɛli. Ka yi yi kpɛla buɣim ni, di ku din ya; di buɣim niɛm ku tooi din ya.
en: When you cross deep rivers, I will be with you, and you won't drown. When you walk through fire, you won't be burned or scorched by the flames.

dag: Bɛ chɛ ka bɛ zilima dirimi kaman tinvura zilima la, ka garinsi lɔɣu be bɛ noya ni.
en: Their tongues are like deadly snakes; their words are like a cobra's poison.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu ka n tɔɣisiri niriba maa yɛtɔɣa yɛtɔɣ ŋaha puuni maa, dama bɛ lihiri ka bi nyari shɛli, ka wumdi ka bi baŋdi bɛ ni wumdi shɛli maa gbinni.
en: The reason I use parables in talking to them is that they look, but do not see, and they listen, but do not hear or understand.

dag: Yi mi ni ti daa niŋdi ya mi kaman ba ni niŋd o bihi shɛm la: Ti daa kpam ya jaande ka kpaŋsi ya, ka zali ya.
en: You know that we treated each one of you the way a father treats his own children.

dag: ka Yisa mabihi yɛl o, Yim kpe chaŋ Judia ka di chɛ ka a nyaandoliba nya tuun shɛŋa a ni tumdi ŋɔ.
en: and Jesus' brothers said to him, Why don't you go to Judea? Then your disciples can see what you are doing.

dag: Naawuni daa yɛl o, A yuli Yaakubu, amaa a yuli ku lan boli Yaakubu; a yuli yɛn boonila Izraɛl. Dinzuɣu ka o yuli booni Izraɛl maa.
en: God said to him, Your name is Jacob, but your name will be Jacob no longer. No, your name will be Israel. And he named him Israel.

dag: Ka Pool mini Silas daa chaŋ nti gari Amfipolis mini Apolɔnia m-mali ti paai Tɛsalɔnaika, ka Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu daa be nimaani.
en: After Paul and his friends had traveled through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they went on to Thessalonica. A synagogue was in that city.

dag: Juda Naa Ahaz ni daa di nam zaŋ chaŋ yuun pinaayi saha ka Ɛla bia Hɔshia daa di Izraɛl nam Samaria. O daa diya n-niŋ o nam maa ni la yuma awɛi.
en: In the twelfth year of the reign of King Ahaz of Judah, Hoshea son of Elah became king of Israel, and he ruled in Samaria for nine years.

dag: Ka ŋun pa o zuɣu kana ti yɛl o, N dana, a pɔŋli la dɔɣila pɔŋa anu.
en: The second servant came and said, Master, your money has made a return of five hundred percent.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ n dan naa, di chɛ ka di muɣis a kaman a bihi maa zaa n-shiri kpi la, dama Amnɔn kɔŋko n-kpi.
en: My lord and king, dont think that all of your sons are dead. Only Amnon is dead.

dag: Ka n daa yihi ba tinzun yɛlli kam daɣiri ni; ka daa zali maligumaaniba mini Lɛvinim tuma ni nyɛ shɛm ni sokam tuuni ni nyɛ shɛli.
en: I purified the people from everything foreign; I prepared regulations for the priests and the Levites so that all of them would know their duties;.

dag: Ya ka zabili mini naŋgbankpeeni ŋmɛbu zaa lee yina nti be yi sunsuuni? Pa yi niŋgbuŋ kɔre nyaɣisim bɔbu din be yi niŋgbuna yaɣa ni n-zabiri la ni ka di yina?.
en: Why do you fight and argue with each other? Isn't it because you are full of selfish desires that fight to control your body?.

dag: Ka Musa daa niŋ binshɛɣukam kaman Yawɛ ni daa wuh o ni o niŋ maa.
en: Moses followed the Lord 's instructions.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ di simdi ka a gba niŋ mani ŋun nyɛ a dabipaɣ ŋɔ ni yɛn yɛl a ni a niŋ shɛm ŋɔ. Chɛ ka n niŋ bindirigu ti a ka a di ka nya yaa lab yiŋa.
en: Now please do what I ask. Let me fix you some food. You must eat so that you will be strong enough to travel.

dag: Amaa o ni daa nya yaa saha shɛli maa, ka o daa zaŋ karimbaani kpɛh o kɔbili ni, ka di daa luh o. Dama o daa bi niŋdi din tuhi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ o Naawuni maa sani, ka daa kpe Yawɛ jɛmbu duu ni o ti tuɣili tulaale zim tulaale zim tuɣilibu bimbini zuɣu.
en: But as soon as he became powerful, he grew so arrogant that he acted corruptly. He was unfaithful to the LORD his God by entering the LORDs sanctuary to burn incense upon the incense altar.

dag: Mbaye n zɔnima, zomiya ma nambɔɣu, zomiya ma nambɔɣu! Dama Naawuni n-niŋ ma lala maa!.
en: You are my friends! Take pity on me! The hand of God has struck me down.

dag: Garigim jɛra kaman bɛ jɛrilim ni simdi shɛm, di yi pa lala bɛ ni tɛhi ni bɛ mali yɛm.
en: Answer fools according to their folly, or they will deem themselves wise.

dag: yi yi niŋdi lala, yi bi yaala so yuri ka chɛ so, ka lan leei bɛn doli tɛhi biɛri soli kariti saria?.
en: Wouldnt you have shown favoritism among yourselves and become evil-minded judges?.

dag: Ka ŋun pah ayɔbu mi nyɛ Itiriam, o ma n-daa nyɛ Ɛgila ŋun daa nyɛ Dauda paɣ la, Hiburɔn ka bɛ daa dɔɣi bɛ zaa.
en: Ithream, whose mother was Eglah. All of these sons were born in Hebron.

dag: Amɔri nanima anu la daa zo nti sɔɣi bela vol ni Makɛda.
en: The five Amorite kings, however, had escaped and were hiding in the cave at Makkedah.

dag: Ka Pita teei Yisa ni daa yɛl o ni o ni ti chihi siɣimsiɣim buta ni o bi mi ŋun Yisa ka nolɔɣu naanyi kum la yɛla, ka daa yi nti kum pam.
en: Peter remembered Jesus words, Before the rooster crows you will deny me three times.And Peter went out and cried uncontrollably.

dag: ka zaŋ yi tizo maa na ka n ti nya o, ka di wuhi ni yi yɛligu maa nyɛla yɛlimaŋli, ka yi tiligi. Ka bɛ daa shiri niŋ lala.
en: But you must bring your youngest brother to me. Then I'll know that you are telling the truth, and you won't be put to death. Joseph's brothers agreed.

dag: Alizin biɛri ni daa nahindi shɛb zaa gba daa nya alaafee.
en: they had come to hear him and to be healed of their diseases. Those who were troubled by evil spirits also came and were healed.

dag: Ka Sool yɛl o, Amalɛknim maa sani ka bɛ ʒi ba na, niriba maa n-daa chɛ piɛ viɛla mini naɣ viɛla maa n-zaŋ ba na ni bɛ ti mali sara ti Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ a Naawuni ŋɔ; amaa ti daa saɣim dinkam kpalim zaa.
en: Saul answered, My men took them from the Amalekites. They kept the best sheep and cattle to offer as a sacrifice to the Lord your God, and the rest we have destroyed completely.

dag: N kpamdi ya jaande ti Duuma zuɣu ni yi karimmi gbaŋ ŋɔ wuhi ti mabihi la zaa.
en: I urge you by the authority of the Lord to read this letter to all the believers.

dag: Bɛ zuliya maa nyɛla bɛn baɣa ka niriba ni ka lan nyɛ tipawumlinima, ka n timd a bɛ sani ni a ti yɛli ba, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ.
en: They are stubborn and hardheaded. But I, the Lord God, have chosen you to tell them what I say.

dag: N tɔɣisi jɛrilim m barinyubo ni, amaa yinima m-muɣisi ma ka n niŋ lala. Di di simdi ni yinim paɣi ma, dama hal n yi kul pa shɛli, n lee pala ŋun pɔri tuum shɛba yi ni tibigiri la ni.
en: I have been making a fool of myself. But you forced me to do it, when you should have been speaking up for me. I may be nothing at all, but I am as good as those super apostles.

dag: Bɛ ni chɛ ninvuɣ shɛb daalahichi, ka bɛ daalahichi maa kpihim, mali alibarika.
en: It is a great blessing when people are forgiven for the wrongs they have done, when their sins are erased.

dag: Dama di ku lan yuui, ka n ni yɛn darigi yi tibili zali shɛm tariga paai, di nyaaŋa ka n chɛ ka n suhu yiɣisi bahi bɛ zuɣu m-bahi ba yoli.
en: In only a little while I will finish punishing you, and then I will destroy them.

dag: Ka Ɛlam tiŋgbɔŋ ni tɔbbihi daa nyaɣi lɔɣiri ba yuri n-zaŋ chɛchɛbunsi kana. Ka Kɛɛr tiŋgbɔŋ ni tɔbbihi mi daa gbibi nyɔtaɣirisi.
en: Horse soldiers from Elam took their bags of arrows and rode into battle. Soldiers from Kir rattled their shields.

dag: Waazuyihira maa pala yɛndana kɔŋko, amaa o nyɛla ŋun wuhi niriba baŋsim, ka bɔhim, ka kpahim yɛla baŋ li, ka ŋahi ŋaha pam.
en: The Teacher was very wise. He used his wisdom to teach the people. He very carefully studied and arranged many wise teachings.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka bɛ bo chi sara mini binnyura sara pahi piɛlabil ŋun la zuɣu mali sara zaawuni kaman asiba din la n-zaŋ li nyo buɣim. Di nyɛla din nyom viɛl Yawɛ sani.
en: The second ram will be sacrificed that evening, along with the other offerings, just like the one sacrificed that morning. The smell of the smoke from these sacrifices will please me.

dag: Ka bɛ zuliya maa niriba daa be kaman bɛ yaannim dunoya ni daa nyɛ shɛm. Bɛ yaannim maa n-daa nyɛ: Maikil mini Mɛshulam ni Shiiba ni Jɔrai ni Jakan ni Zia ni Ɛba. Bɛ daa nyɛla niriba ayopɔin.
en: Their relatives according to their households: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber—seven in all.

dag: Amaa bɛ ku mali fali bɛ mabihi sani, Yawɛ n-nyɛ bɛ fali kaman o ni daa lo ba alikauli shɛm la.
en: They are to own no land, as the other tribes do; their share is the privilege of being the Lord 's priests, as the Lord has promised.

dag: Jair daa malila bidibisi pihita, ka bɛ nyɛ bɛn bari bunsi pihita. Ka o bihi maa daa mali tinsi pihita Giliad tiŋgban ni; ka bɛ na kul booni li Havɔtijairi hal ni zuŋɔ.
en: Jair had sons who rode donkeys. These sons controlled towns in the area of Gilead. These towns are called the Towns of Jair to this very day.

dag: Bɛ ni daa kuhiri yɛri lala maa ka bɛ mali bɛ binyɛra gahiri ka toori taŋkpaɣu yaɣindi zuɣusaa.
en: They were screaming, waving their clothes, and throwing dust up in the air.

dag: Ka Sool min o niriba daa chaŋ ni bɛ ti bɔ Dauda shee. Ka bɛ daa yɛli Dauda, ka o zo n-chaŋ tampima zo shɛli din daa be Maɔn yɔɣu ni la zuɣu. Ka Sool daa wum lala ka kari Dauda naba Maɔn yɔɣu maa ni.
en: Saul and his army set out to find David. But David heard that Saul was coming, and he went to a place called The Rock, one of his hideouts in Maon Desert. Saul found out where David was and started closing in on him.

dag: Chɛ ka bɛ paɣ a yuli din galisi ka mali dabiɛm ŋɔ. O nyɛla ŋun be kasi!.
en: Let all the nations praise your name. Your name is great and awesome. Your name is holy.

dag: Paɣimiya Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛl Naawuni ŋɔ, pumpɔŋɔ zaŋ hal ni saha din ka bahigu. Sokam yɛlima, Ami! Paɣimiya Yawɛ!.
en: Praise the Lord , the God of Israel; praise him now and forever! Let everyone say, Amen! Praise the Lord !.

dag: Chɛ ka o be kaman saa ŋun miri bahiri bindira zuɣu la, ka chɛ ka o be kaman sakurili ŋun maari tiŋgbani la.
en: Let him be as helpful as rain that refreshes the meadows and the ground.

dag: Dama n ni bɔri ni n tum zaɣ sun shɛli, m bi tumdi li; amaa zaɣ biɛ shɛli n ni je ni n tum la, dina ka n kul tumda.
en: I dont do the good that I want to do. I do the evil that I dont want to do.

dag: Ti Ba Naawuni mini ti Duuma Yisa Masia niŋm alibarika niŋ yi ni, ka tin ya suhudoo!.
en: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ.

dag: A suhuyiɣisili zuɣu chɛ ka n niŋgbuna zaa kul biɛrimi, ka n daalahichi mi zuɣu chɛ ka alaafee ka n niŋgbuna ni.
en: My body hurts all over because of your anger. Even my bones are in pain, and my sins.

dag: O daa bi saɣi ka so dol o pahila Pita mini Jeemsi ni Jeemsi tizo Jɔn.
en: Jesus let only Peter, James, and John the brother of James go with him.

dag: ni Leedan ni Ammihud ni Ɛlishama.
en: Ladan, Ammihud, Elishama.

dag: bee n-ʒin ya adiikunima n-chaŋ yi chandi maa bee n-yɛnya daliyanima ayiyi; yi mi di piriya namda bee n-gbibi jaaŋgbɛhi, dama tumtumda kam simdi ni bɛ ti o bindirigu.
en: Dont take a backpack for the road or two shirts or sandals or a walking stick.

dag: Ka o daa ba chɛrubi yiɣi; o daa bela pɔhim kpiŋkpama zuɣu n-kana yomyom.
en: He flew swiftly on his winged creature; he traveled on the wings of the wind.

dag: Yihimiya li bɛ tarili maa ni n-zaŋ ti maligumaana Ɛliɛza ka o zaŋ mali sara ti Yawɛ.
en: Take it from the warriors half and give it to Eleazar the priest as a gift offering to the LORD.

dag: A ni ti yɛli n ni zal a ni a yɛlim shɛlikam zaa, ka a mabia Aduna mi ti yɛli Firawuna ni o chɛ ka Izraɛlnim maa yi o tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: Tell Aaron everything I command you, and he will tell the king to let the Israelites leave his country.

dag: ka maligumaana maa lan lih o daba ayopɔin maa dali. O yi lihi nya ka dɔro maa bi yɛlig o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ maa zuɣu, dindina ŋun lan zaŋm o niŋ duu daba ayopɔin yaha.
en: On the seventh day the priest must look at the person again. If the priest sees that the sore has not changed and has not spread on the skin, he must separate the person for seven more days.

dag: M bɔri ni yi baŋ ni bɛ yihi ti mabia Timoti sarika ni; o yi paana tu n kandina saha, n ni zaŋ o pahi mmaŋ zuɣu na ti nyan ya.
en: By now you surely must know that our friend Timothy is out of jail. If he gets here in time, I will bring him with me when I come to visit you.

dag: N daa lola n nina alikauli ni n ku lihi paɣisarili.
en: I made an agreement with my eyes not to look at a young woman in a way that would make me want her.

dag: Lala ka bɛ zaŋ chira din ka binshɛli ti ma, ka zaŋ yuŋ shɛŋa din mali wahala ti ma.
en: God has made my days drag on and my nights miserable.

dag: A zal a zaligunima ni niriba dol li viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: God, you have ordered that your decrees should be kept most carefully.

dag: M ba daa ʒili ya ʒi tibisili, amaa pumpɔŋɔ man yɛn maan pahi li la tibisim. M ba daa malila barazim fiɛbiri ya, amaa man yɛn zaŋla nɔnsi fiɛb ya! .
en: He made you work hard, but I'll make you work even harder. He punished you with whips, but I'll use whips with pieces of sharp metal.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛzra daa yiɣisi zani ka chɛ ka maligumaaniba zuɣulaannim mini Lɛvinim ni Izraɛlnim zaa po pɔri n-wuhi ni bɛ ni niŋ bɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka bɛ daa shiri po.
en: So Ezra got up and made the leading priests, the Levites, and all Israel take a solemn pledge that they would do as had been said. So they took a solemn pledge.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn ʒe yim kum nyɛla yɛlikpani Yawɛ sani.
en: The death of the LORDs faithful is a costly loss in his eyes.

dag: Maluk ni Harim ni Baana.
en: Malluch, Harim, and Baanah.

dag: O yi taɣi saa zali, binshɛɣukam kuurimi; o yi bahi saa, kom din puhigi tiŋgban ni zaa.
en: If he restricts water, they have drought; if he lets it loose, it overturns the land.

dag: Di zɔri ba dabiɛm, dama n ni be a sani din ni fa a bahi. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Dont be afraid of them, because Im with you to rescue you, declares the LORD.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ yɛliya, Yi tɛhiya ni n tahila puli niŋbu na ka ku tahi di dɔɣibu na?.
en: Do not think that I will bring my people to the point of birth and not let them be born. The Lord has spoken.

dag: Di saha ka Musa daa zaŋ Izraɛlnim maa Teeku Ʒiɛɣu duli n-chaŋ ti kpe Shur tiŋgban nɛli ni, ka bɛ daa chaŋ dabisi muna ata chandi ka bi nya kom.
en: After the Israelites left the Red Sea, Moses led them through the Shur Desert for three days, before finding water.

dag: Di saha ka Jɔsia daa bo o dahalali piɛbihi pola mini bubihi pola, ka bɛ zaa kalinli daa yiɣisi tuhi pihita ni naɣilahi tusaata n-zaŋ ba ti ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be nimaani ni bɛ mali Yaɣigari chuɣu sara.
en: Josiah gave the Israelites , sheep and goats to kill for the Passover sacrifices. He also gave cattle to the people. All these animals were from King Josiahs own animals.

dag: Ka di tooi biɛla ka so lan nya o n-yɛli, A gba nyɛla bɛ ni yino! Ka Pita yɛli, Zɔri, m pala bɛ ni yino.
en: A little later someone else saw Peter and said, You are one of them! No, I'm not! Peter replied.

dag: amaa ka daa bi boli anabi Neetan mini Bɛnaaya bee o tizo Sulemaana bee naa ninvuɣ kpɛma la bɛna.
en: But he did not invite his brother Solomon, Nathan the prophet, Benaiah, or the men in the kings special guard.

dag: Di saha ka Juda daa yi o mabihi maa sani chaŋ Adulam nti be do so ŋun yuli daa booni Hira la sani.
en: About that time Judah left his brothers in the hill country and went to live near his friend Hirah in the town of Adullam.

dag: Ti zaa bɛn daa be ŋariŋ maa ni kalinli daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiyi ni pisopɔinnaayɔbu.
en: In all, there were two hundred seventy-six of us on the ship.

dag: O daa chɛ ka tiŋgbani din vuhiri leei wubilim tiŋgbani, ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be nimaani ninvuɣ biɛtali zuɣu.
en: He made the fertile land become salty, because the people living there did such evil things.

dag: ka zaŋ Kpiɔŋlan Naa leeg a salima min a daanzinfa din viɛli pam.
en: And let God All-Powerful be your gold. Let him be your pile of silver.

dag: Lala ka naa maa daa kpi; ka bɛ daa zaŋ o kuli Samaria ti sɔɣi.
en: Once the king had died, people came from Samaria and buried the king there.

dag: ka daa tim o yiŋbihi ni bɛ ti yɛli o ni daa pun boli ninvuɣ shɛba ni bɛ ka amiliya lɔbu chuɣu maa ni na; amaa ka bɛ daa zaɣisi kandina.
en: The king sent some servants to tell the invited guests to come to the banquet, but the guests refused.

dag: Yinim bɛn zaa nyɛ tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni tarimba, ka tumd o ni zali ya shɛm ŋɔ, jɛmmiya Yawɛ. Bomiya wuntitali mini tarimtali, di pa shɛli ka yi ti nya sɔɣisili shee Yawɛ suhuyiɣisili dabisili maa dali.
en: All you humble people, come to the Lord ! Obey his laws. Learn to do good things. Learn to be humble. Maybe then you will be safe when the Lord shows his anger.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim maa daa tuhi lu di saha maa, ka Judanim di nasara, dama bɛ daa niŋla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ bɛ yaannim Naawuni la naani.
en: So at that time the Israelites were defeated, and the people of Judah won. The army from Judah won because they depended on the Lord , the God of their ancestors.

dag: Di simdi ni a vili zaɣ yini gbibi, amaa ka di chɛ din la gba bahi; dama ninvuɣ so ŋun zɔri Naawuni ni tooi gbibi di bina ayi maa zaa.
en: Its good that you take hold of one of these without letting go of the other because the one who fears God will go forth with both.

dag: Di saha ka n ni chaŋ nyin Naawuni sara maligu bimbin la gbini, luɣ shɛli din nyɛ nyin Naawuni ŋun tiri ma suhupiɛlli pam ŋɔ sani la; ka ŋme m mɔɣilo paɣi nyin Naawuni ŋun nyɛ n Naawuni ŋɔ.
en: I want to go to Gods altar, to the God who makes me so very happy. God, my God, I want to play my harp and sing praises to you!.

dag: Ka yi yi saɣi deei Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ noli ka doli n ni zaŋ o fukumsi zaligu shɛŋa tiri ya zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ viɛnyɛliŋga, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ ni duhi ya gari dunia ŋɔ ni zuliya kam zaa.
en: Today I am giving you the laws and teachings of the Lord your God. Always obey them, and the Lord will make Israel the most famous and important nation on earth, and he will bless you in many ways.

dag: Yinim Izraɛlnima, wummiya Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm, dama tiŋgbani ŋɔ nim mali galimi o sani. Ʒiɛyimtali lan kani, ka nirilim lan kani, ka so bi lan mi Naawuni tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: People of Israel, listen to the Lord s message. The Lord has something to say against those who live in this land: The people in this land are not honest or loyal. They dont really know God.

dag: Ka ti yi yihi yɛli ni ti min o mali dolintabitali ka be zibisim ni, dindina ti ŋmarila ʒiri ti yɛtɔɣa ni mini ti tuma puuni.
en: If, then, we say that we have fellowship with him, yet at the same time live in the darkness, we are lying both in our words and in our actions.

dag: amaa ka Maikil min o malaikanim maa daa nyaŋ waɣ biɛ titali maa min o malaikanima, ka bɛ lan ka biɛhigu shee alizanda ni.
en: but they did not prevail, and there was no longer any place for them in heaven.

dag: Baŋsim puuni ka bɛ zaŋdi neen viɛla mini azichi nɛma paani duri.
en: By knowledge rooms are filled with all precious and pleasant wealth.

dag: Ka o binyɛrigu mi paligi paratɛte kaman gol la; ka chib shɛli ka dunia ŋɔ ni din ni tooi paɣ li ka di piɛl lala.
en: and his clothes were amazingly bright, brighter than if they had been bleached white.

dag: Ka ti daa lan nya Nɛfilimnima ; ka tinim ŋmanila sakɔri bɛ sani. Lala n-shiri nyɛ ti bɛ sani.
en: We saw the giant Nephilim people there! We felt like little grasshoppers. Yes, we were like grasshoppers to them.

dag: Bɛn daa diri bindir viɛla la nti kpiri kum solɔri zuɣu ŋɔ. Bɛ ni daa zaŋ nɛma nyaɣinyaɣi wumsi shɛb la nti do tampuya zuɣu ŋɔ.
en: People who once ate the finest foods die starving in the streets; those raised in luxury are pawing through garbage for food.

dag: Naawuni, kul niŋmi alibarika niŋmi ti ni. Niriba bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni zaa jɛmm a.
en: May God bless us, and may all people on earth fear and respect him.

dag: Ŋunkam ŋubi n niŋgbuŋ ka nyu n ʒim, ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun mali nyɛvili din ka bahigu, ka n ni ti neeg o kum ni zaadali.
en: But if you do eat my flesh and drink my blood, you will have eternal life, and I will raise you to life on the last day.

dag: amaa ka o yɛli ba, Di nyɛ ma la talahi ni n chaŋ tin shɛŋa gba ni ti yihi ba Naawuni nam lahibal suŋ waazu, dama di zuɣu ka Naawuni tim ma na.
en: But Jesus said, People in other towns must hear the good news about God's kingdom. This is why I was sent.

dag: Ka o ba maa yi ka mabihi bɛn nyɛ dɔbba, yin zaŋmiya o fali maa ti o dɔɣir so ŋun nyɛ o talahi nira o daŋ ni, ka o su li. Dimbɔŋɔ nyɛla zaligu Izraɛlnim sani kaman Yawɛ ni zali Musa shɛm.
en: If he has no brothers or uncles, then his nearest relative is to inherit it and hold it as his own property. The people of Israel are to observe this as a legal requirement, just as I, the Lord , have commanded you.

dag: Amaa yi yi bi po pɔri, yi ku kpe taali ni.
en: On the other hand, if you never make a sacred promise, you can't be guilty of breaking it.

dag: Amaa Naawuni Shia Kasi so ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn niŋ ŋun Yisa yɛda ni daa ti yɛn deela yɛla ka o daa yɛri ba maa; dama Naawuni daa na bi tim o Shia Kasi na, Yisa ni daa na bi nya jilima shɛli din doli o kum ni neebu nyaaŋa la zuɣu.
en: Jesus was talking about the Holy Spirit, who would be given to everyone that had faith in him. The Spirit had not yet been given to anyone, since Jesus had not yet been given his full glory.

dag: O daa tahi tɔbbihi ti ʒili bɛ ni daa me goondahi gili Juda fɔntin shɛŋa la zaa puuni, ka lan zali tɔbbihi Juda tiŋgban ni min o ba Asa ni daa tuhi deei tin shɛŋa Ifriim zuliya niriba tiŋgban ni la puuni.
en: He put groups of soldiers in all the towns of Judah that were made into fortresses. He built fortresses in Judah and in the towns of Ephraim that his father Asa had captured.

dag: Dindali maa vi ti ku din ya yi ni daa tum tuumbiɛ shɛŋa ka zaɣisi n noli la zuɣu; dama di saha n ni ti yihi karimbaannim bɛn be yi ni ka mali suhupiɛlli di zuɣu la, ka yi ti ku lan mali karimbaani n zoli din be kasi ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: At that time you, my people, will no longer need to be ashamed that you rebelled against me. I will remove everyone who is proud and arrogant, and you will never again rebel against me on my sacred hill.

dag: kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm. Dinzuɣu ka Musa daa sab bɛ yuya maa Sinai mɔɣu ni.
en: as the Lord had commanded. In the Sinai Desert, Moses registered the people.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka a ti zaŋ Aduna min o bidibisi maa ka Naawuni min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa dunol ni na nti chɛ ka bɛ niŋ kom paɣi bɛ ni.
en: Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the Meeting Tent. Wash them with water.

dag: Dinzuɣu niriba ni nya filiŋ, ka sokam di vi. Di chɛ bɛ taali!.
en: And so, all of them will be ashamed and disgraced. Don't forgive them!.

dag: Ka Yɛhudianim maa yɛl o, Ti mali zaligu shɛli din wuhiri ni o simdi kum, o ni yɛli ni o nyɛla Naawuni Bia la zuɣu.
en: The crowd answered back, We have a law that says he ought to die, because he claimed to be the Son of God.

dag: Ninvuɣ biɛri mini tiliginsim shee waɣ pam, dama bɛ bi bɔri a zaligunima.
en: The wicked have no hope of being saved, because they dont follow your laws.

dag: Amaa Naawuni ni lan chɛ ka o shia siɣi ti zuɣu na, ka chɛ ka tiŋgban shɛli din kpi la leei tiŋgban shɛli din vuhira; ka puri atam niŋ pam.
en: until a spirit from on high is poured out on us, and the desert turns into farmland, and the farmland is considered a forest.

dag: M bihi, pumpɔŋɔ wummiya n yɛligu. Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli n soli mali suhupiɛlli.
en: Now, children, listen to me. If you follow my ways, you will be happy too.

dag: Dama kaman niŋgbuŋ ni nyɛ zaɣ yini ka mali yaɣ bɔbili, ka di yaɣ bɔbili maa zaa nyɛ niŋgbun yin la, lala mi n-nyɛ Masia gba.
en: A person has only one body, but it has many parts. Yes, there are many parts, but all those parts are still just one body. Christ is like that too.

dag: Yɛtɔɣ yoya ŋmanila takɔbi n-kuhiri niriba, amaa yɛndana yɛtɔɣa tahirila tibbuna.
en: Some chatter on like a stabbing sword, but a wise tongue heals.

dag: Bɔ n-lee pahi dimbɔŋɔ zuɣu? Izraɛlnim daa kɔŋ bɛ ni bɔri shɛli nyabu. Naawuni ni daa pii niriba biɛla shɛb la n-naɣ nya li, amaa bɛn kpalim la bɛn suhuri daa kpɛmmi.
en: This means that only a chosen few of the people of Israel found what all of them were searching for. And the rest of them were stubborn.

dag: N ni chɛ ka mɔɣa dɔni zoya sunsuuni tiŋgban kuŋ ni, ka chɛ ka kɔbil nina yooi vinvama ni. N ni chɛ ka kom puhigi mɔɣu ni zɔra, ka chɛ ka kom yi tiŋgban kuŋ ni na zɔra.
en: I will make rivers flow on dry hills. I will make springs of water flow through the valleys. I will change the desert into a lake filled with water. There will be springs of water in that dry land.

dag: Yi nyɛla bɛn je ninvuɣ so ŋun galindi din bi tuhi, ka zaɣisiri ŋun yɛri yɛlimaŋli.
en: You people hate anyone who challenges injustice and speaks the whole truth in court.

dag: Tibidarigibo dabisili dali, Ifriim tiŋ ni ti kpalim dabari. Izraɛl zuliya ka n yɛri din shiri ti yɛn niŋ maa.
en: The day of punishment is coming, and Israel will be ruined. People of Israel, this will surely happen!.

dag: Yɛlim Izraɛlnim ni bɛ zaŋm pina ti ma. Ŋunkam suhu yu ni o ti pini, nyin deem li ti ma.
en: Tell everyone in Israel who wants to give gifts that they must bring them to you.

dag: Di saha ka Zɔfar ŋun daa nyɛ Naama nir la daa garigi yɛli.
en: Then Zophar from Naamah answered Job and said.

dag: Ka shɛb yɛli ni Anabi Ilaija n-lan yi palo maa yaha, ka shɛb mi yɛli ni anab kura la ni yino n-neei kum ni na maa.
en: others that Elijah had appeared, and still others that one of the ancient prophets had come back to life.

dag: Kum mihi daa vili ma, ka kokpɛɣu din ni di nir varisi ma.
en: Death had wrapped its ropes around me, and I was almost swallowed by its flooding waters.

dag: Amaa sokam zaa ni o saha: Masia n-nyɛ ŋun daŋ tooni; ka o ni ti yɛn su shɛb o labbuna saha mi naanyi paya.
en: But each one will be raised in proper order: Christ, first of all; then, at the time of his coming, those who belong to him.

dag: Kul be tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni, ka m be a sani, ka niŋ alibarika niŋ a ni, ka zaŋ tiŋgbana ŋɔ zaa ti a min a zuliya, ka chɛ ka n ni daa lo a ba Ibrahimma alikauli shɛl la pali.
en: Stay in this land, and I will be with you. I will bless you. I will give you and your family all these lands. I will do what I promised to Abraham your father.

dag: Ka Yisa daa garigi yɛli ba, Yi chirimya, dama yi ʒi din be Naawuni Kundi ni, ka bi lan mi Naawuni yiko gba.
en: Jesus answered them, How wrong you are! It is because you don't know the Scriptures or God's power.

dag: Mbusim be bɛ zuɣu! Bɛ dolila Keen biɛhigu soli. Liɣiri zuɣu ka bɛ doli Balaam biriginsim sol la. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn taai duŋ kaman Kɔra ni daa taai duŋ shɛm la; bɛ ni bahi yoli kaman o ni daa bahi yoli shɛm.
en: They are damned, for they follow in the footsteps of Cain. For profit they give themselves over to Balaams error. They are destroyed in the uprising of Korah.

dag: ka maligumaana maa lan lih o daba ayopɔin maa dali. O yi lihi nya ka dɔro maa bi yɛlig o niŋgbuŋ gbaŋ maa zuɣu, dindina ŋun lan zaŋm o niŋ duu daba ayopɔin yaha.
en: On the seventh day the priest will again examine the infection. If he sees that it has remained the same—the infection has not spread on the skin—the priest will quarantine the person for seven more days.

dag: ka gbaag o ansarisi malibu yɛra, Ti puhir a Yɛhudianim Naa! Ka ŋmɛr o nutala.
en: Over and over they went up to him and said, Greetings, king of the Jews! And they slapped him in the face.

dag: N dimnim kul sɔɣirimi yɛri ŋumaŋuma n-jɛndiri ma, ka lɔri ma nia biɛri dabisi muni puuni zaa.
en: The words and the thoughts of my enemies are against me all the time—.

dag: O yi di milig o jaaŋgbee ka chɛ ma, ka bi chɛ ka o yɛla kpɛhiri ma dabiɛm.
en: I wish someone could take away the threat of Gods punishment. Then he would not frighten me anymore.

dag: Dama Yawɛ viɛla. O yurilim maŋli kul ni beni sahakam, ka o ʒiɛyimtali mi kul ni be ʒiɛmani kam ni.
en: The Lord is good! His love and faithfulness will last forever.

dag: Ka Ibrahimma daa zaŋ piɛri mini niɣi ti Abimilɛk, ka bɛ niriba ayi maa daa lo tab alikauli.
en: Then Abraham gave some sheep and cattle to Abimelech, and the two of them made an agreement.

dag: Jafɛt bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Goma mini Magɔg ni Madai ni Javan ni Tubal ni Mɛshɛk ni Tiras.
en: Japheths sons: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

dag: N ni yɛli Yawɛ zaligu yɛla. O yɛli ma, A nyɛla m bia; zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ ka n dɔɣ a.
en: I will tell the promise that the Lord made to me: You are my son, because today I have become your father.

dag: Ka Naomi yɛli Rut, M bia, guhimi nya yɛla maa zaa ni yɛn bahindi shɛm. Doo maa ku vuhi ka pa ni o nyala yɛla maa kpaa shee zuŋɔ.
en: Naomi said, Daughter, be patient until we hear what happens. Boaz will not rest until he has finished doing what he should do. We will know what will happen before the day is ended.

dag: Chɛliya ka ŋunkam zaa be Ziɔn duh o yee yili yila ni suhupiɛlli, dama Izraɛl Naawuni ŋun galisi, ka be kasi ŋɔ be o niriba sunsuuni.
en: Shout and sing for joy, city of Zion, because the holy one of Israel is great among you.

dag: Ka Shɛkɛm daa yɛl o ba Hamɔr, Bom paɣisarili ŋɔ ti ma ka n niŋ m paɣa.
en: Shechem even asked his father to arrange for him to marry her.

dag: Ka Musa daa chaŋ ti yɛli Izraɛlnim maa lala. Amaa ka bɛ daa zaɣisi li wumbu, bɛ suhugarigu mini bɛ ni daa be putɔɣu dabitim bandi shɛli ni maa zuɣu.
en: So Moses told this to the Israelites, but the people would not listen to him. They were working so hard that they were not patient with Moses.

dag: Ka o daa mir o ti mɔɣis o kpariŋ; ka Yisahaku wum o binyɛra ʒiɛɣu ka niŋ alibarika niŋ o ni ka yɛli, Wummi m bia ʒiɛɣu, di ŋmanila Yawɛ ni niŋ alibarika niŋ mɔ shɛl ni ʒiɛɣu.
en: As he came up to kiss him, Isaac smelled his clothes—so he gave him his blessing. He said, The pleasant smell of my son is like the smell of a field which the Lord has blessed.

dag: A nya ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn tɛhi ni bɛ mali yɛm la? Jɛra mali tahima pam gari ba.
en: People who think they are wise when they are not are worse than fools.

dag: Ka o tizo daa gbib o napɔŋkpaa n-dol o yina; ka bɛ daa bol o mi yuli Yaakubu. Yisahaku daa nyɛla yuun pihiyɔbu nira saha shɛli Ribɛka ni daa dɔɣi jahi maa.
en: The second one was born holding on tightly to the heel of Esau, so he was named Jacob. Isaac was sixty years old when they were born.

dag: N kul dolila o ni wuhi ma shɛm; n kul dolila o soli ka na ʒi m-birigi.
en: I have always lived the way God wants. I have never stopped following him.

dag: Yi ni nya ka so ku tooi chihi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa maa zuɣu di simdi ni yi gbaai yimaŋa ka di niŋ shɛli ni suhuyiɣisili.
en: Nobody can deny these things. So then, you must calm down and not do anything reckless.

dag: Ka bɛ daa yɛli Naa Dauda ni Yawɛ niŋla alibarika niŋ Obɛdɛdom min o malibu zaa ni, Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa zuɣu. Di saha ka Dauda daa chaŋ ti kpuɣi Naawuni Daalikauli Adaka maa Obɛdɛdom yiŋa n-zaŋ li kuli ŋun Dauda tiŋ la ni ni suhupiɛlli.
en: Later people told David, The Lord has blessed the family of Obed Edom and everything he owns, because Gods Holy Box is there. So David went and brought Gods Holy Box from Obed Edoms house. David was very happy and excited.

dag: Yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka ti yab Ibrahimma daa deei Naawuni noli o ni daa yɛl o ni o yiɣisim chaŋ tiŋgban shɛli ŋun Naawuni ni lo alikauli ni o ni zaŋ ti o la ni; ka o daa yiɣisi omaŋmaŋ tiŋgbɔŋ ni gbaai chandi, hal ka ʒi o ni chani luɣ shɛli maa.
en: It was faith that made Abraham obey when God called him to go out to a country which God had promised to give him. He left his own country without knowing where he was going.

dag: O bihi ni yiɣisi paɣ o ka o yidan gba paɣ o, yɛli.
en: Her children bless her; her husband praises her.

dag: Man Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ ni zaŋ fiɛbiga fiɛb ba kaman n ni daa fiɛbi Midiannim Orɛb tampiŋ gbini shɛm la. N ni ti kpuɣi n fiɛbiga maa teeku kom puuni n-fiɛb ba kaman n ni daa niŋ Ijiptinim shɛm la.
en: Therefore, the LORD of heavenly forces will crack a whip against Assyria, as when he struck Midian at the rock of Oreb. He will raise a rod over the sea, as he did in Egypt.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yur a zaligunim mali suhudoo pam; ka binshɛli ku chɛ ka bɛ tuui lu.
en: You give peace of mind to all who love your Law. Nothing can make them fall.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa shiri niŋ lala dindali maa yuŋ. O daa chɛ ka piɛ gbaŋ maa zuɣu kummi, amaa ka chɛ ka maligim lu m-mahigi tiŋgbani din gil li zaa.
en: That night God did that very thing. The next morning the wool was dry, but the ground was wet with dew.

dag: ka pii mah shɛŋa din ka dabindi la zaɣ yini mini bɔrɔbɔro din mali kpam zaɣ yini ni karikaasi zaɣ yini piɛ shɛli din ʒe Yawɛ tooni la puuni n-zaŋ li pa biŋkpam la mini nudirigu biŋgbalipuɣili la zuɣu.
en: Then he took one loaf of bread from the basket of unleavened bread dedicated to the Lord , one loaf made with oil, and one thin cake, and he put them on top of the fat and the right hind leg.

dag: Ka naa daa po pɔri yɛli Shimɛi, A ku kpi.
en: Then the king told Shimei, You will not die. And the king swore this to him.

dag: Amaa lahaba shɛli din ti yɛn yi wulimpuhili mini nuzaa polo na ni ti kpɛh o dabiɛm, ka o yiɣis o suhu n-tuhi ku niriba pam.
en: But reports from the east and north will alarm him, and in a great rage he will set off to devastate and destroy many.

dag: Kamina ti pahi ti zuɣu, ti zaa ni laɣim mal liɣiri kolibil yini.
en: Throw in your lot with us; well share our money.

dag: Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga, Naawuni darigi a tibili naai a tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu, o ku lan chɛ ka a be tinzun tiŋ ni. Amaa nyini Ɛdom bipuɣiŋga, a tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu, o ni darig a tibili. O ni yih a daalahichi maa palo.
en: The people of Zion have paid for their sins, and the Lord will soon let them return home. But, people of Edom, you will be punished, and your sins exposed.

dag: Ka o yɛli, N nyɛla Ibrahimma nachin kpɛma.
en: I am the servant of Abraham, he began.

dag: Ka bɛ biriginsim zuɣu yi chɛ ka dunianim nya Naawuni daalibarika din galisi, ka bɛ ni kɔŋ shɛli nyabu zuɣu mi yi chɛ ka bɛn pa Izraɛlnim nya Naawuni daalibarika din galisi, dindina Izraɛlnim yi pahi bɛ zuɣu Naawuni daalibarika maa ni gari lala.
en: Their mistake brought rich blessings to the world. And what they lost brought rich blessings to the non-Jewish people. So surely the world will get much richer blessings when enough Jews become the kind of people God wants.

dag: Nyama, n ni lihi a nyɛvili ka di nyɛ binsuŋ shɛm zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ, lala ka Naawuni gba ni lihi n nyɛvili ka di nyɛ binsuŋ, ka o ni tiligi ma nahiŋgu kam zaa ni.
en: Today I showed you that your life is important to me. In the same way the Lord will show that my life is important to him. He will save me from every trouble.

dag: ka yɛli, Din kariya ni n niŋ lala n Naawuni sani. N ni tooi nyu niriba ŋɔ ʒim ŋɔ? Dama bɛ nyɛviya ka bɛ zaŋ pa talima chaŋ ti tooi kom ŋɔ na. Dinzuɣu ka o daa zaɣisi li nyubu maa. Wɔɣiri kɔba ata maa mi ni daa tum tuun shɛli m-bala.
en: and said, Drinking this water would be like drinking the blood of these men who risked their lives to get it for me. The Three Warriors did these brave deeds.

dag: Niriba yɛla bɛ noya gu ma, bɛ lab ma tapaɣisi din ku dɔni, ka laɣim tab liri ma.
en: They open their mouths at me and strike my cheek in a taunt; they gang up on me.

dag: Di simdi ka yi ti buɣisi pal yaɣu puuni luɣ shɛli polo, ka di wɔɣilim nyɛ kilomita pinaayi ni pirigili, ka di yɛliŋ nyɛ kilomita anu, ka Naawuni jɛmbu duu puuni luɣ kasi zaa kasi shee la ti be di ni.
en: I will give half of my sacred land, a section . kilometers long and kilometers wide, to the priests who serve in the temple. Their houses will be in this half, as well as my temple, which is the most sacred place of all.

dag: N ni zaŋ zuliya biɛri na ka bɛ ti deei bɛ yiya su. N ni chɛ ka bɛn mali yaa karimbaani naai, ka bɛ ta bɛ luɣ shɛŋa din be kasi daɣiri.
en: I will bring the most evil nations here and let them have your homes. Your strongest men will lose their confidence when I let the nations profane the places where you worship.

dag: Ka Dauda mi bɔh o, Ka bɔ n-niŋ ka n dan ti kariti doli man ŋun nyɛ a dabili ŋɔ lala? Bɔ ka n lee niŋ? Taal bɔ ka n lee tum?.
en: And he added, Why, sir, are you still pursuing me, your servant? What have I done? What crime have I committed?.

dag: Kom daa lim bɛ dimnim maa, ka bɛ ni yino gba daa bi tiligi.
en: He covered their enemies with the sea. Not one of them escaped!.

dag: Di zaa yoli, ka Naa Dauda daa ti tuhi fa Ziɔn birini la, dina ka bɛ booni Naa Dauda tiŋ la.
en: But David did capture the fortress of Zion—which became Davids City.

dag: O daa chɛ ka sakuɣa m-miri ba ka pa ni saa, ka chɛ ka saa nyaɣisiri gindi bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa zaa ni.
en: God turned their rain into hail along with lightning flashes throughout their land.

dag: Zaŋmiya biŋgolinsi pihinu niŋ pateesa yini naŋgbambili, ka lan zaŋ biŋgolinsi pihinu niŋ pateesa shɛli din pahi ayi la gba naŋgbambili.
en: Put loops along one of the wider sides of each panel.

dag: Nɛbuzaradan ŋun daa nyɛ yiliguliba sapashin kpɛm maa daa chɛla ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ nandaamba ka ka binshɛli niŋ tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni. Di saha maa o daa ti ba wain tihi puri mini pu shɛŋa pahi.
en: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the special guard left some of the poorest people in the land of Judah. He gave them vineyards and fields at that time.

dag: Di daa lan yɛli ni bɛ zaŋm yɛl shɛŋa din sab gbaŋ maa ni n-wuhi ni di nyɛla zaligu, ka chɛ ka sokam ŋun be bɛ tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣili kam ni baŋ di yɛla lala. Ka di daa chɛ ka Yɛhudianim mali shili gu ni bɛ ti bɔhi bɛ dimnim biɛri di dabisili maa dali.
en: A copy of the writing was to become law in each province and be on public display for all its peoples to read. The Jews were to be ready on this day to get back at their enemies.

dag: Ka naa daa po n-yɛli, Yawɛ ŋun daa fa ma n dimnim zaa nuu ni bahi ka nyɛ ŋun be ŋɔ zuɣu.
en: Then he said to her, I promise you by the living Lord , who has rescued me from all my troubles.

dag: Dinzuɣu alizanda nam ŋmanila na so ŋun daa bol o yiŋbihi na ni o ti mal o liɣiri din be bɛ sani laasabu.
en: because the Kingdom of heaven is like this. Once there was a king who decided to check on his servants' accounts.

dag: ka Nɛtania bia Ishimail mini dɔbba pia bɛn be o sani maa daa yiɣisi zaŋ takɔbi ku Ahikam bia Gɛdalia Shafan yaaŋa maa, Babilɔn naa ni daa zaŋ o leei tiŋgbɔŋ maa Gomna maa zuɣu.
en: While they were eating together, Ishmael and his ten men got up and killed Gedaliah son of Ahikam with a sword. Gedaliah was the man the king of Babylon had chosen to be governor of Judah.

dag: Ti bemi kaman suhugarigunima, amaa ka lee kul mali suhupiɛlli. Ti bemi kaman faranima, amaa ka lee nyɛ bɛn chɛ ka niriba pam leeri bundaannima. Ti bemi kaman bɛn ka shɛli, amaa ka lee nyɛ bɛn su binshɛɣukam.
en: We have much sadness, but we are always rejoicing. We are poor, but we are making many people rich in faith. We have nothing, but really we have everything.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka o min o mabihi ni o ma ni o nyaandoliba daa chaŋ Kapɛrinium n-daa ti niŋ daba ayi nimaani.
en: Then Jesus went to the town of Capernaum. His mother and brothers and his followers went with him. They all stayed there a few days.

dag: M bi paɣiri ya n ni yɛn wuhi ya wuhibu shɛli ŋɔ puuni, dama yi yi laɣim di bi sɔŋdi ya, amaa di naɣ saɣindi ya mi.
en: In the things I tell you now I dont praise you. Your meetings hurt you more than they help you.

dag: Anabi Ilaija daa nyɛla ninsala kaman ti ni be shɛm ŋɔ, ka o daa ti suhi Naawuni ni o suhu zaa ni saa di mi, ka saa maa daa shiri bi tɔɣisi lu tiŋgbani zuɣu yuun muna ata ni pirigili.
en: Elijah was a person just like us. When he earnestly prayed that it wouldnt rain, no rain fell for three and a half years.

dag: Ka Izraɛlnim daa lan deei Filistianim ni daa tuhi fa tiŋ shɛŋa bɛ sani zaa. Ɛkurɔn zaŋ hal ti kpa Gaat, bɛ daa fa bɛ tiŋgbana zaa Filistianim sani. Ka suhudoo daa lan niŋ bɛn Izraɛlnim maa mini Amɔrinim sunsuuni.
en: The Israelites were even able to recapture their towns and territory between Ekron and Gath. Israel was also at peace with the Amorites.

dag: Yawɛ, nyin ŋun nyɛ n tampiŋ ŋɔ ka n kuhiri niŋda. Di zaɣisi n kuhigu maa wumbu! Dama a yi shini ma, n ni ŋmanila kpiimba bɛn do gbala ni la.
en: I cry out to you, LORD. You are my rock; dont refuse to hear me. If you wont talk to me, Ill be just like those going down to the pit.

dag: Ka Aduna daa niŋ kaman Yawɛ ni daa zali Musa shɛm maa n-zaŋ li ti zali baɣili Alikauli Adaka la.
en: Aaron followed the Lord 's instructions and put the manna in front of the sacred chest for safekeeping.

dag: Dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni be yi sani ŋɔ nyɛla Naawuni ŋun zabiri nyuli. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ suhu ni yiɣisi bahi yi zuɣu, ka o kpihim yi birili dunia ŋɔ ni.
en: If you do worship other gods, the Lord 's anger will come against you like fire and will destroy you completely, because the Lord your God, who is present with you, tolerates no rivals.

dag: Shɛm zuliya mini bɛ malibu ni bɛ yɛtɔɣa ni bɛ tiŋgbana ni bɛ zuliyazuliya ni daa nyɛ shɛm m-bala.
en: These are Shems sons according to their clans, their languages, their lands, and their nations.

dag: Naawuni Shia Kasi n-nyɛ Naawuni ni daa lo o niriba alikauli ni bɛ ti yɛn nya shɛl la shihirili, hal ka tinim bɛn nyɛ omaŋmaŋ niriba nya yolisim maŋli, ka di chɛ ka ti tibigiri Naawuni ka tir o jilima.
en: The Spirit is the first payment that guarantees we will get all that God has for us. Then we will enjoy complete freedom as people who belong to him. The goal for all of us is the praise of God in all his glory.

dag: Yiɣisimiya ka ti chaŋ ti liri ba yuŋ n-saɣim bɛ nanim yinsi.
en: Get ready, lets attack by night and destroy her fortresses.

dag: ni kahiŋkɔɣu kam min o balibu zaa.
en: all kinds of black birds.

dag: Ka Yisa daa kuhi pam ka naanyi bahi.
en: Once again Jesus shouted, and then he died.

dag: Di saha ka o daa yɛli ba, Kulimiya ti duɣi bindir suma n-di ka nyu binnyuri nyaɣisa, ka niŋya shɛli ti bɛn bi duɣi la, dama zuŋɔ nyɛla Yawɛ dabisili kasi. Di chɛliya ka nandahima mali ya, dama Yawɛ ni tiri suhupiɛlli shɛli n-nyɛ yi kpiɔŋ.
en: Nehemiah said, Go and enjoy the good food and sweet drinks. Give some food and drinks to those who didnt prepare any food. Today is a special day to our Lord. Dont be sad, because the joy of the Lord will make you strong.

dag: Bɛ gbibila tɔbiri mini kpana; bɛ nyɛla putɔɣunima, ka bi zɔri nambɔɣu. Bɛ chandi vuri ŋmanila teeku vuri. Bɛ barila yuri, ka lo kpara kaman tɔbutuhira n-chani tɔbu tuhibu n-kanna ni bɛ ti liri nyini Ziɔn bipuɣiŋga.
en: Its well-armed troops are cruel and never show mercy. Their galloping horses sound like ocean waves pounding on the shore. This army will attack you, lovely Jerusalem.

dag: Dama Mani Naawuni m-mɔŋ o yɛm, ka mɔŋ o baŋsim.
en: I myself made her foolish and without common sense.

dag: Tayiɣ bi kanna ka pa ni o yɛn zumi bee n-ku bee n-saɣim bahi. Amaa man kamina ni niriba ti nya nyɛvili n-kul nya li la pam.
en: The thief comes only in order to steal, kill, and destroy. I have come in order that you might have life—life in all its fullness.

dag: Goli ni ti nɛmi kaman wuntaŋ la, ka wuntaŋ neesim mi ti laɣim ʒii buyopɔin zuɣu n-nyɛ kaman daba ayopɔin neesim din leei dahin yini dini. Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa ni ti niŋla dahin shɛli Yawɛ yi ti tib o ni ti o niriba dan shɛl la.
en: The moon will be as bright as the sun, and the sun will be seven times brighter than usual, like the light of seven days in one. This will all happen when the Lord bandages and heals the wounds he has given his people.

dag: Ka niriba pam daa ʒiri pina kani Jɛrusalɛm na nti tiri Yawɛ, ka tiri Juda Naa Hɛzɛkia neen viɛla ka di daa chɛ ka zuliya kam tibig o di saha maa zaŋ chana.
en: Many people came to Jerusalem, bringing offerings to the Lord and gifts to Hezekiah, so that from then on all the nations held Hezekiah in honor.

dag: Naawuni ni daa nam zuɣusaa mini dunia ŋɔ binshɛɣukam zaa shɛm m-bala. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ ni daa nam dunia ŋɔ mini zuɣusaa dahin shɛli.
en: That's how God created the heavens and the earth. When the Lord God made the heavens and the earth.

dag: Dinzuɣu m po pɔri yɛli Ɛli min o yiŋnima ni sara maligu bee wumpaɣibo pini lan kani din ni tooi nyahi bɛ tuumbiɛri maa hal abada.
