en: So I solemnly declare to the family of Eli that no sacrifice or offering will ever be able to remove the consequences of this terrible sin.

dag: N Duuma Naawuni, fam ma bahi. Yawɛ, n suhir a mi, sɔŋm ma yomyom.
en: Please, God, rescue me! Lord , hurry and help me!.

dag: N ni bɔhim a zaligunim maa, ka zaŋ n zaɣa niŋ a soya ni.
en: I will study your instructions. I will give thought to your way of life.

dag: Ka chɛ ka ninsalinim mini biŋkɔbiri zaa so buri; ka sokam zaa duh o yee suhi Naawuni viɛnyɛliŋga; ka ŋmaligi ka chɛ o tuumbiɛri soya mini tuumbiɛ shɛŋa o nuhi ni tumda.
en: But every person and every animal must be covered with a special cloth to show they are sad. People must cry loudly to God. Everyone must change their life and stop doing bad things.

dag: Ka o yi bi tooi deeg omaŋ soya ŋɔ zaa puuni, dindina bɛn bahim o min o bihi nɛma labisi ti yuuni maa ni.
en: If you cannot gain your freedom in any of these ways, both you and your children will still be set free in the Year of Celebration.

dag: Amaa a yi saɣisi ninvuɣ biɛri ka bɛ bi zo n-yi bɛ ninvuɣ biɛtali ni bee n-zo n-yi ninvuɣ biɛtali tuma ni bɛ ni kpi bɛ tuumbiɛri maa zuɣu, amaa ka nyin tiligi a nyɛvili.
en: However, if you do warn them, and they keep on sinning, they will die because of their sins, and you will be innocent.

dag: N di bi zaɣisi ka a nuzaa tabila n zuɣu gbibi, ka a nudirigu mi bɔb gbaai ma mali.
en: Put your left hand under my head and embrace me with your right arm.

dag: Di simdi ni yi doli bɛ ni kahigi zaligu maa wuhi shɛm bee bɛ ni ŋmaai yɛtɔɣa maa shɛm. Di ti ŋmaligiya kpa yi nudirigu polo bee yi nuzaa polo ka chɛ bɛ ni ŋmaai yɛtɔɣa maa shɛm tin ya.
en: Accept their verdict and follow their instructions in every detail.

dag: ka deei tiŋgbɔŋ maa, di nyaaŋa yi ni tooi labina, ka ku mali talahi yɛl shɛli Yawɛ mini Izraɛlnim sani; ka tiŋgbani ŋɔ leei yi ni su shɛli Yawɛ sani.
en: and takes possession of the land. After that, you may return, because you will have fulfilled your obligation to the Lord and to the other Israelites. Then the Lord will acknowledge that this land east of the Jordan is yours.

dag: Kɔbil nin yini ni tooi bilisi ko nyaɣisili mini ko lɔŋolɔŋɔ?.
en: Do good water and bad water flow from the same spring? Of course not.

dag: Ka ŋmaligi yɛli, Ŋunkam suhu bi miligi n zuɣu mal alibarika.
en: Happy are those who dont stumble and fall because of me.

dag: Dama a deei talima a mabihi sani ka di ka daliri, ka deei bɛ situra sɔŋ ka chɛ ba bɛ zaɣim.
en: To make a brother repay you the money he owed, you took away his clothes and left him nothing to wear.

dag: Ka Sool daa chɛ Dauda kari doli ka lab kuli ni o ti tuhi Filistianim maa. Dinzuɣu ka bɛ daa boli nimaani zo n-tiligi tampiŋ.
en: So Saul broke off his pursuit of David and went to fight the Philistines. Thats why that place is called Escape Rock.

dag: Ka Yisa daa dii chirigi ba soli maa ni puhi ba; ka bɛ chaŋ ti gban o tooni m-bɔbil o naba, ka jɛm o.
en: But Jesus met them and greeted them. They came and grabbed his feet and worshipped him.

dag: Zɔri, Yawɛ ni to n-kpuɣ a ni suli n-zaŋ ti labi. O ni gbaag a kirikiri.
en: You may be powerful, but the Lord is about to snatch you up and throw you away.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Musa Midian tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni, Labimi Ijipti tiŋgbɔŋ ni, dama ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa lo ni bɛ ku a maa zaa kpiya.
en: Then, while Moses was still in Midian, the Lord said to him, It is safe for you to go back to Egypt now. The men who wanted to kill you are now dead.

dag: Yinim malaikanima, Paɣimiya Yawɛ! Yinima n-nyɛ bɛn mali yaa ka tumd o ni yɛli shɛm, ka dol o yɛligu.
en: You divine messengers, bless the LORD! You who are mighty in power and keep his word, who obey everything he says, bless him!.

dag: Firilatamdigu maa daa malila jaba ayɔbu: jaba ata daa bela yaɣ yini polo, ka jaba ata be yaɣ din la mi polo.
en: The lampstand had six branches—three branches on one side and three branches on the other side.

dag: Naawuni yɛlimaŋtali zuɣu, o ni tiligi Ziɔn; o wuntitali zuɣu o ni tiligi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn be di ni ka niŋ tuuba.
en: Because the Lord is righteous, he will save Jerusalem and everyone there who repents.

dag: Naawuni ni daa yɛli Kushi bia Zɛfania yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa Juda Naa Amɔn bia Naa Jɔsia ʒiɛman ni. Zɛfania yaannim n-daa nyɛ: Gɛdalia mini Amaria ni Naa Hɛzɛkia.
en: I am Zephaniah, the son of Cushi, the grandson of Gedaliah, the great-grandson of Amariah, and the great-great-grandson of Hezekiah. When Josiah son of Amon was king of Judah, the Lord gave me this message.

dag: ka o min o kpamba ni tɔbbihi daa niŋ tab saawara n-saɣi ni bɛ ŋarim bɛ ya maa kɔbilisi din be tiŋ maa kpaŋa, ka bɛ daa sɔŋ o.
en: Then Hezekiah talked to his officials and army officers. They all agreed to stop the waters of the water springs outside the city. The officials and army officers helped Hezekiah.

dag: Hal shinshingoorɔnim mi bɛ yiŋ labbu saha. Ka ŋmanʒee mini sakpaleeŋa ni noombihi bɛn daari doli taba zaa gba mi bɛ kandina saha. Amaa n niriba bɛn bi mi Yawɛ zaligunima.
en: Even storks know when it is time to return; doves, swallows, and thrushes know when it is time to migrate. But, my people, you do not know the laws by which I rule you.

dag: Ka luɣ shɛli n ni daa yɛli ba ni bɛ pala n niriba la, nimaani ka niriba ni boli ba, Naawuni ŋun be ŋɔ bihi.
en: And in the place where it was said to them, You arent my people, there they will be called the living Gods children .

dag: Di saha Yawɛ ni ti darigi yiko shɛŋa din be zuɣusaa tibili, ka darigi dunia ŋɔ nanim tibili.
en: A time is coming when the Lord will punish the powers above and the rulers of the earth.

dag: Ka di simdi ka bɛ ti ŋubi o ni mali suhudoo sara maligu shɛli, ka di nyɛ o wumpaɣibo sara maligu maa nimdi zaa o ni mal li dahin shɛli maa. O di ti chɛ di shɛli zali hal ni biɛɣ asiba.
en: The flesh of the animal must be eaten on the day it is sacrificed; none of it may be left until the next morning.

dag: O daa zaŋ o leeg o yiŋ zuɣulana, ka chɛ ka o su o binshɛɣukam zaa fukumsi.
en: The king made Joseph master of his house and ruler over everything he owned.

dag: Ka Jair daa ti kpi ka bɛ sɔɣ o Kamɔn.
en: Jair died and was buried in the city of Kamon.

dag: Ka tiŋ maa nim daa pirigi ʒii buyi: Bɛ shɛb daa dolila Yɛhudianim maa; ka bɛn la mi doli Yisa tuumba maa.
en: The people of the city were divided: some were for the Jews, others for the apostles.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, yiɣisim ka a min a yiko Alikauli Adaka ŋɔ kpe a vuhim shee. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Naawuni ŋɔ, yiɣisim chɛ ka a maligumaaniba ŋɔ nya tiliginsim, ka chɛ ka bɛn ʒe a yim mali suhupiɛlli a ninvuɣ suntali puuni.
en: Come to your new home, where we have already placed the sacred chest, which is the symbol of your strength. I pray that when the priests announce your power to save people, those who are faithful to you will celebrate what you've done for them.

dag: Dama Sulemaana ŋarima daa yi zaŋdila Hiram tumtumdiba n-chani Tarishish. Ŋarima maa daa yi yiri Tarishish labirina yim yuma ata puuni bɛ ʒirila salima mini anzinfa ni wɔbinyina ni kpara ni noon shɛb bɛn ŋmani tɔrotɔronim na.
en: The king also had cargo ships that went to Tarshish to trade things with other countries. Hirams men were on these ships. Every three years the ships would come back with a new load of gold, silver, ivory, and apes and baboons.

dag: Di simdi ka a chibi di nyiŋgoli ka o zuɣu ni tooi kpe di ni, ka a ti niŋ tani kɔɣili di nyiŋgoli maa zaa gili kaman bɛ ni niŋdi kur tolinli niŋdi gbaɣino nyiŋgoli shɛm la ni kaman teela ni niŋdi shɛm la din ni chɛ ka di ku cheei.
en: It is to have a hole for the head, and this hole is to be reinforced with a woven binding to keep it from tearing.

dag: Yisa daa ti chaŋ Nazarɛt bɛ ni daa wubis o tin shɛl ni la n-daa ti chaŋ Yɛhudianim jɛmbu duu Vuhim Dabisili dali kaman o ni daa yi pun niŋdi shɛm la. Ka o daa ti yiɣisi zani ni o karim.
en: Jesus went back to Nazareth, where he had been brought up, and as usual he went to the synagogue on the Sabbath. When he stood up to read from the Scriptures.

dag: O chɛ ka n naba ŋmanila naba anahilan nyaaŋa naba, ka chɛ ka m be zoya zuɣu chana ka barina shɛli kani.
en: He makes me sure-footed as a deer; he keeps me safe on the mountains.

dag: Dinzuɣu daadam, tɔɣisim anabitali yɛtɔɣa. Kpahim a nuhi, ka chɛ ka takɔbi din ni ku niriba lu buyi bee buta. Di nyɛla takɔbi din kura, ka nyɛ takɔbi din ni ku niriba pam. Di gili ba mi niŋ sunsuuni.
en: Son of man, clap your hands to show your sadness, and speak to the people for me. Let the sword come down twice, no, three times! This sword is for killing the people. This is the sword for the great killing. This sword will cut into them.

dag: dinzuɣu niŋmiya bɛ ni wuhi ya ni yi niŋ shɛlikam, amaa ka di niŋdiya bɛ ni niŋdi shɛm, dama bɛ wuhiri din tuhi, amaa ka bɛmaŋmaŋ lee bi dol li.
en: Therefore, you must take care to do everything they say. But dont do what they do.

dag: Ka Musa daa kɔrig o n-zaŋ o ʒim maa shɛli niŋ Aduna nudirigu polo tibinyaɣili min o nudirigu nubililɔɣu ni o nudirigu napombililɔɣu.
en: Then Moses killed the ram. He put some of its blood on the tip of Aarons ear, on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.

dag: Bɛ laɣiŋgu maa ni daa ti wurim naai ka Yɛhudianim mini niriba pam bɛn daa doli Yɛhudianim daadiini soli kabiri doli Pool mini Baanabas. Ka Pool mini Baanabas daa kpaŋsi bɛ suhuri ni bɛ kul kpalimmi be Naawuni daanfaani ni.
en: After the service, many Jews and a lot of Gentiles who worshiped God went with them. Paul and Barnabas begged them all to remain faithful to God, who had treated them with undeserved grace.

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn nyɛ n dimnim ka di ka daliri la mali kpiɔŋ pam; ka bɛn je ma ka di ka soli gba galisi pam.
en: But my enemies are alive and healthy, and they have told many lies.

dag: Niriba ayi laɣim be so ninvuɣ yino, dama bɛ ni tooi tum bɛ tuma viɛnyɛliŋga.
en: You are better having a friend than to be all alone, because then you will get more enjoyment out of what you earn.

dag: Di simdi ni o ŋmaligi ka chɛ zaɣ biɛɣu ka tumdila din tuhi. Di simdi ni o bola suhudoo, ka kul biɛhiri di naba hal ti nya li.
en: Stop doing what is wrong, and do good. Look for peace, and do all you can to help people live peacefully.

dag: Yinim Speennima, labimiya yimaŋmaŋ tiŋgban ni. Kpe lan pala teeku kulinoli.
en: Ships from Tarshish, go back home. Cross the sea as if it were a river. No one will stop you now.

dag: N yɛri ya la dimbɔŋɔ pumpɔŋɔ ka di na bi niŋ, amaa ni di ti niŋ ka yi niŋ yɛda ni mani n-shiri nyɛ n ni yɛli ya ni n nyɛ so la.
en: I tell you this now before it happens, so that when it does happen, you will believe that I Am Who I Am.

dag: Di saha maa ka Siria Naa Hazaɛl daa chaŋ ti tuhi nyaŋ Gaatinima, ka deei bɛ tiŋ maa. Amaa Naa Hazaɛl ni daa chani ni o ti tuhi Jɛrusalɛmnima.
en: About the same time, King Hazael of Syria attacked the town of Gath and captured it. Next, he decided to attack Jerusalem.

dag: Salo maa ni daa nya lala maa ka dabiɛm gbahi ba, ka bɛ tibigi Naawuni ŋun niŋ ninsalinim yiko ŋɔ tatabo maa.
en: The people saw this and they were amazed. They praised God for letting someone have such power.

dag: Ka Jona garigi yɛli ba, N nyɛla Hiburu, ka jɛmdi Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ alizanda Naawuni, ka nyɛ ŋun nam tiŋgbani mini teeku ŋɔ.
en: He said to them, Im a Hebrew. I worship the LORD, the God of heaven—who made the sea and the dry land.

dag: Ka tuun biɛri ni ti yɛn zooi zuɣu ni chɛ ka niriba pam yurilim filim.
en: There will be so much more evil in the world that the love of most believers will grow cold.

dag: Ka bɛ daa pii fɔntinsi pinaata Isaka mini Asha ni Naftali ni Manaasa zuliya niriba pirigili bɛn be Bashan la tiŋgbana ni ti Gɛrishɔn daŋ niriba.
en: The people from the Gershon family were given towns. These towns were in the areas that belonged to Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and the half of Manasseh that was in Bashan.

dag: ka Saimɔn Pita daa buɣisi yɛl o ni o wuhim ba Yisa ni yɛri bɛ ni so maa ni nyɛ so.
en: Simon Peter made signs to this follower to ask Jesus who he was talking about.

dag: Ka bɛ ni yino zo n-chaŋ ti zaŋ gumdi tim komihigu ni zaŋ kaɣili gbab li zaŋ ti o ha ni o nyu ka lan yɛli, Chɛliya ka ti guhi pɔi nya Anabi Ilaija ni kana nti siɣis o na bee o ku kana.
en: Someone ran, filled a sponge with sour wine, and put it on a pole. He offered it to Jesus to drink, saying, Lets see if Elijah will come to take him down.

dag: O ni daa yɛl lala maa ka Farisiinim mini Sadusiinim maa daa gbaai tab naŋgbankpeeni ŋmɛbu, ka jintɔriba maa noya daa woli taba.
en: As soon as Paul said this, the Pharisees and the Sadducees got into a big argument, and the council members started taking sides.

dag: Di nyaaŋa ka maligumaana maa sabi tibidarigibo maa yɛla niŋ litaafi ni m-paɣ li niŋ kɔtɔɣu maa ni.
en: The priest will write these curses on special paper and wash them off into the bitter water.

dag: Ka bɛ zuliya ayopɔin daa kpalim ka na bi deei bɛ tiŋgbana tarili.
en: But at this time there were still seven tribes of Israel that had not yet received their land.

dag: N yaa nyɛ dini ka n yɛn guhira? Ka m bahigu lee nyɛ dini ka n ni di suɣilo?.
en: With my strength gone, I have no hope to go on living. With nothing to look forward to, why should I be patient?.

dag: N ni daa bol a maa, a daa vu m-miri ma; a daa yɛli ma, Di zɔri dabiɛm.
en: Come near to me on the day I call to you. Say to me, Dont be afraid.

dag: Nyini, miri ka a suhi ma n-ti niriba ŋɔ. Miri ka a duh a yee n-suhi bɛ zuɣu, a mi miri ka a balim ma, n ku deeg a suhigu.
en: As for you, Jeremiah, dont pray for these people of Judah. Dont beg for them or pray for them. Dont beg me to help them. I will not listen to your prayer for them.

dag: Bɛ niŋgbuna zaa sheei lu, ka nir ku lan tooi nya li, ka bɛ kɔba din daa bi tooi nyarila yina.
en: Their bodies might waste away until they become thin and all their bones stick out.

dag: Buɣa ni naai kahikahi.
en: Idols will be gone for good.

dag: A yi nya li tinim bɛn nyɛ a daba ŋɔ ni so sani, yin kum o, ka tinim bɛn kpalim zaa mi leei ti dan daba.
en: Sir, if any one of us is found to have it, he will be put to death, and the rest of us will become your slaves.

dag: Dinzuɣu ŋun bi guni, amaa ka doli Naawuni fukumsi zaligu maa ni wuhi shɛm, Naawuni ku lih o kaman ŋun guni?.
en: So if the person who isnt circumcised keeps the Law, wont his status of not being circumcised be counted as if he were circumcised?.

dag: N yur a zaligunim soli maa pam kaman n ni yuri azichi balibu kam shɛm.
en: Obeying your instructions brings as much happiness as being rich.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa boli foliŋga maa Zuɣusaa. Ka di daa niŋ zaawuni, di nyaaŋa ka biɛɣu neei; ka di niŋ dabisili din pah ayi.
en: He named the dome Sky. Evening passed and morning came—that was the second day.

dag: Lala n-nyɛ li pumpɔŋɔ gba, niriba biɛla ka Naawuni piig o daalibarika zuɣu.
en: It is the same way now: there is a small number left of those whom God has chosen because of his grace.

dag: Ka binshɛli din ŋmani buɣim zilima puhi yina nti tamtam bɛ zaa yinoyino zuɣu ni ti kpa.
en: They saw something that looked like flames of fire. The flames were separated and stood over each person there.

dag: O ni yɛli, Yi ni ti bɔri ma ka ku nya ma; ka n ni ti yɛn be luɣ shɛli, yi ku tooi ka nimaani na la gbinni lee nyɛla wula?.
en: He says that we will look for him but will not find him, and that we cannot go where he will be. What does he mean.

dag: ni Shimirɔnmɛrɔn naa ni Akishaf naa.
en: the king of Shimron Meron, the king of Acshaph.

dag: Ka Ahazia ni daa tum shɛlikam zaa pahi, bɛ sab di yɛla niŋ Izraɛl nanim litaafi shɛli bɛ ni booni Yɛlikura litaafi la ni.
en: The rest of Ahaziahs deeds, arent they written in the official records of Israels kings?.

dag: Ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn saɣi yɛli ŋ-ŋɔ wuhiya ni bɛ bɔrila tiŋgbɔn shɛli din ni nyɛ bɛmaŋmaŋ dini.
en: When people accept something like that, they show they are waiting for a country that will be their own.

dag: Ka Dauda daa kul nyari yaa pahira, dama Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa ŋɔ daa be o sani.
en: David became a great and strong ruler, because the Lord All-Powerful was on his side.

dag: Bɔ saha ka a yɛn chɛ biɛhiŋ, nyin bipuɣiŋga ŋun ka yɛda ŋɔ? Dama n yɛn namla bin palli niŋ dunia ni. Di ni ti ŋmanila paɣa n-ni ti nyɛ ŋun taɣiri doo barina ni.
en: How long will you hesitate, faithless people? I have created something new and different, as different as a woman protecting a man.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ daadamnim zaa, kamiya n sanna ka n tiligi ya! N kɔŋko n-nyɛ Naawuni ka so kani pahi n zuɣu.
en: Turn to me and be saved, all you ends of the earth, for I am God, and theres no other.

dag: Laɣimmiya yi zuliya ni kpamba mini yi sapashin kpamba zaa n sanna, ka n ti yɛli ba yɛtɔɣa ŋɔ ka bɛ wum, ka n chɛ ka zuɣusaa mini tiŋgbani di shɛhira jɛndi ba.
en: Assemble all your tribal leaders and officials before me, so that I can tell them these things; I will call heaven and earth to be my witnesses against them.

dag: Ŋuna n-wuhiri li ka di lɛbiri li ginda, ni o chɛ ka di tum o ni zal li shɛm dunia ŋɔ zaa ni.
en: as they move at God's will. They do all that God commands, everywhere throughout the world.

dag: Jake bia Agur yɛtɔɣ kpɛma m-bɔŋɔ. Di nyɛla anabitali yɛtɔɣa. Doo maa ni daa yɛli Itiɛl mini Ukal shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Naawuni, n gbarigiya, Naawuni, n gbarigiya; wula ka n yɛn niŋ di nasara?.
en: These are the sayings and the message of Agur son of Jakeh. Someone cries out to God, I am completely worn out! How can I last?.

dag: Yisa daa ŋahi ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn daa wum o wuhibu maa ŋahili, dama bɛ daa mirila Jɛrusalɛm ka niriba maa tɛhiri ni o dii yɛn chɛmi ka Naawuni nam piligi.
en: While the people were listening to this, Jesus continued and told them a parable. He was now almost at Jerusalem, and they supposed that the Kingdom of God was just about to appear.

dag: Ka Yisa bɔhi ba, Yi gba na kul ka fahim?.
en: Jesus then said: Don't any of you know by now what I am talking about?.

dag: Dinzuɣu pumpɔŋɔ, Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ, gbib a ni daa lo a dabili m ba Dauda alikauli shɛli n-yɛli, A bihi yi ni doli n zaligunim kaman a ni dol li shɛm, a kul ku kɔŋ ŋun ni zan a zaani n sani ŋun ni ʒini Izraɛl nam ʒiishee la.
en: Now, Lord God of Israel, keep the other promise you made to my father when you told him that there would always be one of his descendants ruling as king of Israel, provided that they carefully obeyed your Law just as he did.

dag: Di chɛ ka kɔgbana lim ma bee n-chɛ ka kɔbulli di ma bee n-chɛ ka bɔɣ zilinli mum ma niŋ.
en: Don't let the flood come over me; don't let me drown in the depths or sink into the grave.

dag: Ka n ti ba suhuyini, ka zaŋ shi palli kpɛhi bɛ ni. Ka n ti yihi suhu shɛli din be kaman kuɣili ŋɔ bɛ ni, ka zaŋ suhu balli niŋ bɛ ni.
en: I will give them a single heart, and I will put a new spirit in them. I will remove the stony hearts from their bodies and give them hearts of flesh.

dag: Ka paɣ maa yɛl o, N dana, dindina ka tim ma kom maa ka n nyu, ka kɔnyuri ku lan gbaai ma bee ka n ti lan ka kpe na ni n ti ŋɔŋ kom yaha.
en: The woman replied, Sir, please give me a drink of that water! Then I won't get thirsty and have to come to this well again.

dag: Hazɔr ni ti lu n-dahim doya sahakam, ka yɔbahi ti gɔri di ni. So ti ku lan be nimaani bee ka so ti lan ʒini di ni. Yawɛ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: Hazor will become a den for wild dogs, a wilderness forever. No one will live there; no human will dwell in it.

dag: Miriya ka yi zaŋ tiŋgbani kɔhi ti so ka o su li sahakam, dama tiŋgbani maa nyɛla n dini, yi nyɛla tinzunnim mini saamba n sani.
en: Your land must not be sold on a permanent basis, because you do not own it; it belongs to God, and you are like foreigners who are allowed to make use of it.

dag: Yinima n-kpuɣi n daanzinfa mini n salima; ka ʒi n daazichi nɛma nti niŋ yi wuna jɛmbu duri ni.
en: You have taken my silver and gold and carried my rich treasures into your temples.

dag: M bilim ni zaa, n nyɛla nandahimalana ka miri kum. A ni kpɛhi ma dabiɛm shɛli chɛ ka n di wahala, ka n lan ka tahima.
en: Since I was young Ive been afflicted, Ive been dying. Ive endured your terrors. Im lifeless.

dag: Hal Babilɔn naa kpambaliba tuumba ni daa kana ni bɛ ti bɔhi baŋ shihirili shɛli din niŋ o tiŋgbɔŋ ni la, Naawuni daa chɛ o mi ni o niŋ o ni bɔri shɛm, ka di chɛ ka o zahim o baŋ dinkam zaa be o suhu ni.
en: One time the leaders of Babylon sent messengers to Hezekiah. The messengers asked about a strange sign that had happened in the nations. When they came, God left Hezekiah alone to test him and to know everything that was in Hezekiahs heart.

dag: Judanim bi ʒe yim, ka din chihiri kul tumdi Izraɛl mini Jɛrusalɛm puuni. Dama Judanim saɣim Yawɛ ni yuri o jɛmbu du shɛl la, ka kpuɣi tinzunnim bɛn jɛmdi buɣa bipuɣinsi.
en: Judah cheated— a detestable thing was done in Israel and Jerusalem. Judah made the LORDs holy place impure, which God loved, and married the daughter of a foreign god.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ bi wuhiri ni Naawuni yɛligu kɔŋla palibu, dama pa bɛn zaa yi Izraɛl zuliya ni na n-nyɛ Izraɛl yaan maŋa.
en: I dont mean that God failed to keep his promise to the Jewish people. But only some of the people of Israel are really Gods people.

dag: Ka Pita daa yiɣisi zo n-chaŋ siliga maa gbini nti kurim lihi di puuni n-nya ka kahiŋga kɔŋko n-doya; ka o ŋmaligi kuna, ka bɔhir o suhu din niŋ maa zuɣu.
en: But Peter got up and ran to the tomb to see. He looked in, but he saw only the cloth that Jesus body had been wrapped in. It was just lying there. Peter went away to be alone, wondering what had happened.

dag: Musa daa zalila Lɛvinim bɛn daa ʒiri Yawɛ Daalikauli Adaka la zaligu yɛli.
en: he commanded the Levites who carry the chest containing the LORDs covenant as follows.

dag: Salo maa ni daa nya o maa ka di gari ba pam, ka bɛ dii zɔri chan o sani ti puhir o.
en: When the people saw Jesus, they were greatly surprised, and ran to him and greeted him.

dag: O daa tuhi nyaŋ Filistianim hal ti paai Gaza mini di tintariga tinsi; ni di tiŋkpansi zaŋ tabili di fɔntinsi.
en: He defeated the Philistines and raided their settlements, from the smallest village to the largest city, including Gaza and its surrounding territory.

dag: Karimbaandan ŋun nyɛ nyarimaŋlana yuli m-booni Ansarisimaana. O kul tumdila karimbaani duhimaŋtali tuma.
en: Incredibly proud—mockers are their name! Their conduct involves excessive pride.

dag: Ka ŋunkam niŋ Naawuni Bia maa yɛda mali shɛhira ŋɔ o suhu ni. Ka ŋunkam mi bi niŋ Naawuni yɛda zaŋ o leela ʒirilana, o ni bi niŋ Naawuni ni di o Bia maa shɛhira shɛl la yɛda zuɣu.
en: If we have faith in God's Son, we have believed what God has said. But if we don't believe what God has said about his Son, it is the same as calling God a liar.

dag: N ni daa kul ŋmaligi bɛ sani, di daa bi yuui ka n nya n suhu ni yuri so pam maa. Ka n daa gbaag o mali, ka bi saɣi bah o ka o chaŋ. Ka n daa zaŋ o kuli m ma yiŋa nti zaŋ o kpe ŋun daa zali m pua duu.
en: Right after that, I found him. I held him and would not let go until I had taken him to the home of my mother.

dag: So yi zaŋ liɣiri bee binshɛli nti puh o kpee sɔŋbu, ka bɛ zu bini maa dilan yiŋa, ka bɛ gbaai tayiɣ maa, di simdi ka tayiɣ maa yo bini maa zuɣu ʒii buyi.
en: If anyone agrees to keep someone else's money or other valuables for him and they are stolen from his house, the thief, if found, shall repay double.

dag: O ni ti chɛ ka bɛn nyɛ sariakaritiba doli yɛlimaŋli soli, ka ti bɛn ʒe dunɔdali gbini kariti bɛn kanna ni bɛ ti liri ba la suhukpeeni.
en: Then he will give wisdom to the judges who rule his people. He will give strength to the people who are in battles at the city gates.

dag: Naawuni niŋmi alibarika niŋ a kɔbilinina ni; chɛ ka a suhu piɛli paɣ so a ni daa kpuɣi a nachimbilim saha la zuɣu.
en: Be happy with your own wife. Enjoy the woman you married while you were young.

dag: Di zaŋya yi niŋgbuna yaɣ shɛli ti alahichi tum tuumbiɛri; amaa zaŋmiya yimaŋ tila Naawuni kaman ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn yi kum ni kpe nyɛvili ni, ka zaŋ yi niŋgbuna yaɣili kam ti Naawuni tum wuntia tuma.
en: Nor must you surrender any part of yourselves to sin to be used for wicked purposes. Instead, give yourselves to God, as those who have been brought from death to life, and surrender your whole being to him to be used for righteous purposes.

dag: Piɛbimiya kikaa Ziɔn puuni. Ŋmɛmiya kuŋa n zoli din be kasi la zuɣu. Bɛnkam zaa be tiŋgbɔŋ ŋɔ ni, chɛliya ka yi ni sɔhira! Dama Yawɛ dabisili la kanna, hal di miriya.
en: Blow the horn in Zion; give a shout on my holy mountain! Let all the people of the land tremble, for the day of the LORD is coming. It is near.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔnim zaa yi ti gbaai niŋbu, di saha yin kpuɣimiya yi zuɣuri lihi zuɣusaa, dama yi tiliginsim saha ti miritimi maa.
en: When these things begin to happen, stand up and raise your heads, because your salvation is near.

dag: O tɔbutuhiriba nyɔtaɣirisi nyɛla zaɣ ʒiɛhi, ka o tɔbbihi ye gbaɣino ʒiɛhi. Bɛ yi mali bɛ chɛchɛbunsi shili zali dahin shɛli kur shɛŋa din tab li nyaɣisirimi. Ka sapashinnim yuri yiɣira.
en: Nineveh, on this day of attack, your enemies' shields are red; their uniforms are crimson.

dag: Bɛ daa daai ma la pam ka n yɛn lu, amaa ka Yawɛ daa sɔŋ ma.
en: I was fiercely attacked and was being defeated, but the Lord helped me.

dag: Ka niriba maa yɛl o, Alizin biɛɣu n-naɣ ʒi a zuɣu! Ŋuni n-lee bɔri ni o ku a.
en: You have a demon in you! the crowd answered. Who is trying to kill you.

dag: Ka Izraɛl daa yɛli Yisifu, N yi kpi pumpɔŋɔ, m paɣiya, n ni nya a ni n nini ka baŋ ni a na be a nyɛvil ni maa zuɣu.
en: Jacob said to Joseph, Now that I have seen you and know you are still alive, I am ready to die.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Jɔshua, N ni duh a Izraɛlnim zaa ninni zuŋɔ dabisili ŋɔ; ka bɛ baŋ ni n ni be a sani kaman n ni daa be Musa sani shɛm la.
en: The Lord told Joshua, Beginning today I will show the people that you are their leader, and they will know that I am helping you as I helped Moses.

dag: Amaa nyin kul dol a ni daa bɔhim yɛlimaŋ shɛŋa yɛla ka niŋ li yɛda la viɛnyɛliŋga. A mi a karimbanim ni nyɛ shɛba.
en: Keep on being faithful to what you were taught and to what you believed. After all, you know who taught you these things.

dag: Yawɛ nina kul kpala wuntizɔriba, ka gbilisir o tibili wumdi bɛ kuhigu.
en: The LORDs eyes watch the righteous, his ears listen to their cries for help.

dag: Gol so ŋun daŋ tooni biɛɣ pinaayi dali ka ti daa yiɣisi Ahava Mɔɣili maa gbini n-kuni Jɛrusalɛm, ka ti Naawuni maa nuu daa pa ti zuɣu ka o tiligi ti ti dimnim mini sɔguriba nuu ni ti chandi maa ni.
en: On the twelfth day of the first month, we left the Ahava River and started for Jerusalem. Our God watched over us, and as we traveled along, he kept our enemies from ambushing us.

dag: A zaŋla a nini kpa lala nira? A zaŋ ma mi na ni a ti kari ma saria?.
en: God, do you need to keep an eye on something so small? Why bother to bring charges against me?.

dag: N ni guli tiŋ ŋɔ ka tiligi li mmaŋmaŋ zuɣu ni n dabili Dauda zuɣu.
en: I will defend this city and save it for my sake and for the sake of my servant David.

dag: Filip mini Baatolomiu ni Tomas ni Matiu ŋun daa nyɛ farigudeera la ni Alifius bia Jeemsi ni Taddius ni.
en: Philip and Bartholomew; Thomas and Matthew, the tax collector; James son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus;.

dag: A yɛm n-chɛ ka wubiga pa zuɣusaa yiɣiri ka teeg o kpiŋkpama kpa nudirigu polo ŋɔ?.
en: Does a hawk learn from you how to fly when it spreads its wings toward the south?.

dag: Zaadali paɣ so ŋun daa nyɛ naa n-yi nudirigu polo na la gba ni ti wuhi ni ʒiɛmani ŋɔ nim mali taali, dama o daa yi katiŋa n-kana ni o ti wum Sulemaana yɛm yɛtɔɣa; ka nyamiya, yɛl shɛli din gari Sulemaana be kpe.
en: On the Judgment Day the Queen of Sheba will stand up and accuse you, because she traveled all the way from her country to listen to King Solomon's wise teaching; and I assure you that there is something here greater than Solomon!.

dag: Ka Sulemaana daa me Mɔabnim buɣili Chɛmɔshi din nyɛ daɣiri la jɛmbu shee mini Ammɔnnim buɣili Molɛk din nyɛ daɣiri la jɛmbu shee zali Jɛrusalɛm wulimpuhili polo zoli zuɣu.
en: On the mountain east of Jerusalem he built a place to worship Chemosh, the disgusting god of Moab, and a place to worship Molech, the disgusting god of Ammon.

dag: Ka o yɛli ba, Yimiya! Bipuɣiŋga maa bi kpi, amaa o gbihirimi. Ka bɛ lar o.
en: he said, Get out, everybody! The little girl is not dead—she is only sleeping! Then they all started making fun of him.

dag: Naawuni, nyini n-nyɛ n Naawuni, ka n kul bɔr a. N suhu zaa kul yɛla a zuɣu. N niŋgbuŋ luɣili pinaayi zaa kul bɔr a mi. Di bemi kaman tiŋgban kuŋ din chaɣisi ka kom ka nimaani la.
en: God, you are my God. I am searching so hard to find you. Body and soul, I thirst for you in this dry and weary land without water.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka Dauda daa bɔhi Yawɛ, N cham Juda tin shɛl ni ti ʒini? Ka Yawɛ yɛl o, Chama. Ka Dauda lan bɔhi, N cham tiŋ kani? Ka o yɛl o, Cham Hiburɔn.
en: After this, David asked the Lord , Shall I go and take control of one of the towns of Judah? Yes, the Lord answered. Which one? David asked. Hebron, the Lord said.

dag: Ka Bɔrɔbɔro din ka Dabindi Chuɣu la piligu dali daa ti paai ka Yisa nyaandoliba ka o sanna ti bɔh o, Ya polo ka a lee bɔri ni ti mali ʒiishee ti a ka a puhi Yaɣigari Chuɣu ŋɔ.
en: On the first day of the Festival of Unleavened Bread, the disciples came to Jesus and said, Where do you want us to prepare for you to eat the Passover meal.

dag: Yɛm be Yawɛ sizuura lubu ni. Yawɛ kukoli tahiri yɛri tiŋ maa: Wummiya, yinim zuliya shɛb bɛn laɣim be tiŋ ŋɔ ni.
en: It is wise to fear the Lord . He calls to the city, Listen, you people who assemble in the city!.

dag: Ka Pool mini Baanabas daa ʒini nimaani yuui, ka kul tɔɣisiri ti Duuma yɛla ni suhukpeeni, ka ti Duuma daa ʒe bɛ ni tɔɣisiri ŋun Yisa daanfaani yɛl shɛŋa maa nyaaŋa, ka chɛ ka bɛ wuhiri shihira ka tumd alahiziba tumtumsa.
en: Paul and Barnabas stayed there for a while, having faith in the Lord and bravely speaking his message. The Lord gave them the power to work miracles and wonders, and he showed that their message about his gift of undeserved grace was true.

dag: Mɛmiya yiya m-be di ni, ka kɔnya puri n-diri di bindira.
en: to settle there and build houses. Plant gardens and eat what you grow in them.

dag: Gbuɣinli chɛ ŋumbu, gbuɣindaa kukoli foya, ka gbuɣimpola nyina kabisi.
en: The roar of a lion and snarl of the king of beasts— yet the teeth of lions are shattered.

dag: Sulemaana yiŋ dahin yini mɔni daa yi nyɛla bɔrɔbɔro zim viɛlli lita tusaanu zim maŋli lita tuhi pia.
en: Solomons food requirements for a single day included thirty kors of refined flour; sixty kors of flour.

dag: Di saha ka Yawɛ daa yɛli ma.
en: The Lord spoke to me.

dag: Yɛli shɛŋa din mali dabiɛm pam niŋya tiŋgbɔŋ maa ni.
en: A terrible and shocking thing has happened in the land:.

dag: Bɛ zaŋ a zaligunim wuhiri Yaakubu zuliya, ka zaŋ a zalikpana wuhiri Izraɛlnima. Bɛ ni ti tuɣili tulaale zim a tooni, ka maani bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la a sara maligu bimbini zuɣu, ka di di buɣim zaa.
en: They teach your case laws to Jacob, your Instruction to Israel. They hold sweet incense to your nose; put the entirely burned offering on your altar.

dag: Sulemaana daa dila nam ʒini Jɛrusalɛm n-su Izraɛlnim zaa yuun pihinahi.
en: Solomon ruled over all Israel in Jerusalem for forty years.

dag: Di niŋ kamaata ni bɛ nyɛla bɛn suhuri ni tɛha ka galimi, ka lan nyɛ bɛn gbib yɛlimaŋa din yi zahira ti wuhibu puuni la.
en: They should hold on to the faith that has been revealed with a clear conscience.

dag: Noli ni di ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa zaŋ bɛmaŋ dalim Naawuni fukumsi zaligu dolibu, dama di sabiya: Noli ni di ŋunkam bi deei binshɛɣukam zaa din sabi Naawuni fukumsi zaligu ni n-dol li.
en: Those who depend on obeying the Law live under a curse. For the scripture says, Whoever does not always obey everything that is written in the book of the Law is under God's curse.

dag: Bɛraya bidibisi n-daa nyɛ: Hɛbɛr mini Malikiɛl ŋun daa nyɛ Birizait ba la.
en: Beriah had two sons, Heber and Malchiel.

dag: Ka m biɛrimaŋtali tuma ni ti yi palo a yi ti kana ni a ti nya n yɔri maa dahin shɛli. Ka bu shɛb mini piɛbihi shɛb bɛn bi liɣisiliɣisi ka mali sabilimsabilim ni bɛn nyɛ zaɣ sabila yi ti be m biŋkɔbiri ni, di wuhiya ni n zu ba mi maa.
en: I will be completely honest with you: when you come to check on our agreement, every female goat with me that isnt speckled or spotted and every male lamb with me that isnt black will be considered stolen.

dag: Ka Musa daa pii asanza niriba Izraɛlnim maa puuni n-zaŋ ba leei niriba maa zuɣulaannima, ka bɛ shɛb su niriba tuhilituhili, ka shɛb su niriba kɔbigakɔbiga, ka shɛb su niriba pihinunu ka shɛb mi su niriba piapia fukumsi.
en: Moses chose capable persons from all Israel and set them as leaders over the people, as officers over groups of thousands, hundreds, fifties, and tens.

dag: Chɛ ka o sandan fa o ni mali shɛlikam zaa; ka saamba ʒe o ni tum tuma nya binshɛlikam zaa.
en: May his creditors take away all his property, and may strangers get everything he worked for.

dag: Ninvuɣ yoya bɛn daa be bɛ ni daa kpiri kɔre pam; ka Izraɛlnim gba daa lan kum ka yɛli, Ti bi zaɣisi ka ti di nya nimdi ŋubi.
en: There were foreigners traveling with the Israelites. They had a strong craving for meat, and even the Israelites themselves began to complain: If only we could have some meat!.

dag: A niriba Izraɛlnim yi ti tum alahichi a sani ka di zuɣu chɛ ka bɛ dimnim nyaŋ ba, amaa di nyaaŋa ka bɛ labina ti bol a yuli, ka fabili niŋ a, ka suh a, duu ŋɔ puuni.
en: Sometimes your people Israel will sin against you, and their enemies will defeat them. Then the people will come back to you and praise you. They will pray to you in this Temple.

dag: Ka Naa maa yɛli, Amaa n nya ka niriba anahi n-lɔrigi be buɣim maa sunsuuni chani ginda, ka shɛli bi niŋ ba; ka ŋun pah anahi maa ŋmanila wuni.
en: Then why do I see four men walking around in the fire? he asked. They are not tied up, and they show no sign of being hurt—and the fourth one looks like an angel.

dag: Ka Musa deemba Jɛtro daa mali bɛ ni zaŋdi sara shɛli nyɔri buɣim la ti Naawuni. Ka Aduna mini Izraɛl kpamba zaa daa kana, ka bɛ mini Musa deemba maa ti laɣim di bindirigu Naawuni tooni.
en: Jethro offered sacrifices to God. Then Aaron and Israel's leaders came to eat with Jethro there at the place of worship.

dag: ni Ɛlishama ni Biiliada ni Ɛlifɛlɛt.
en: Elishama, Beeliada, and Eliphelet.

dag: Alɔbo maa ni daa chɛ, ka Aduna labi Musa sani Yawɛ min o niriba chirigibu shee suɣili maa dunol ni.
en: Aaron walked back and stood with Moses at the sacred tent.

dag: Yɛlimaŋli, Naawuni galisiya, ka ti ku tooi baŋ o yuma tariga.
en: We cannot fully know his greatness or count the number of his years.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm zaŋ chaŋ Anatɔtnim bɛn bɔri ni bɛ ku a la polo m-bɔŋɔ. Bɛ yɛra, Miri ka a lan zaŋ Yawɛ yuli tɔɣisi anabitali yɛtɔɣa yaha, di yi pa lala ti ni ku a.
en: Then the Lord said: Jeremiah, some men from Anathoth say they will kill you, if you keep on speaking for me.

dag: Dimbɔŋɔ nyaaŋa ka chɛrubinim la daa wuɣi bɛ kpiŋkpama mini din daa baɣi ba la zuɣusaa, ka Izraɛl Naawuni jilima daa be bɛ zuɣusaa.
en: The living creatures began to fly, and the wheels went with them. The dazzling light of the presence of the God of Israel was over them.

dag: Firawuna ni daa mirina, ka Izraɛlnim maa daa lihi bɛ nyaaŋa n-nya ka Ijiptinim maa kani bɛ sanna, ka dabiɛm daa gbahi ba pam, ka bɛ kuhi pam niŋ Yawɛ.
en: When the Israelites saw the king coming with his army, they were frightened and begged the Lord for help.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa sɔŋ Judanima ka bɛ tuhi deei zoya ni tinsi la, amaa ka lee bi tooi kari bɛn daa be bɔpiɛligu ni la, bɛ ni daa mali kuriti chɛchɛbunsi la zuɣu.
en: The Lord was on the side of the men of Judah when they fought. They took the land in the hill country, but they failed to take the land in the valleys, because the people living there had iron chariots.

dag: Amaa ka Dauda niriba maa daa bɔh o, Nyama, ti na be Juda tiŋgbani ŋɔ ni ŋɔ ka dabiɛm mali ti mi, ka ti yi ti chaŋ Kɛila ni ti ti tuhi Filistia tɔbbihi ŋɔ, wula ka di lee yɛn be.
en: But Davids men said to him, Look how frightened we are here in Judah. Itll be worse if we go to Keilah against Philistine forces.

dag: Ka bɛ yɛl o, Di pala yɛlimaŋli, yɛlim ti o ni yɛli shɛm. Ka o yɛli ba, O yɛli ma mi Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ, M boola kpam ŋɔ bah a zuɣu ni ni a leei Izraɛl naa. .
en: No, we don't. What did he say? they asked. He had a message from the Lord , Jehu replied. He said that the Lord has chosen me to be the next king of Israel.

dag: Ka Naawuni ti o binyɛr piɛlli din nyɛlisiri ka be nyam ni o ye. Binyɛr piɛlli maa nyɛla wuntizɔriba wuntia tuma.
en: Fine linen was given to the bride for her to wear. The linen was bright and clean.

dag: N duumanima, ŋmaligimiya kpe mani yi dabili ŋɔ yiŋ na nti paɣi yi naba, ka gbe kpe n-sa daŋ yibu chaŋ yi chandi shee. Ka bɛ yɛl o, Aai, ti ni gbe solɔɣu zuɣu.
en: and said, Sirs, I am here to serve you. Please come to my house. You can wash your feet and spend the night. In the morning you can get up early and go on your way. But they answered, No, we will spend the night here in the city square.

dag: Ka o dii suug o koyuli maa o bɔɣusapiŋ zuɣu na ti ma ka yɛli, Nyuma, ka chɛ ka n ŋɔŋ shɛli ti a laakumnim ŋɔ gba ka bɛ nyu. Ka n di nyu ka chɛ ka o ŋɔŋ na ti ti n laakumnim maa gba ka bɛ nyu.
en: She quickly lowered the jar from her shoulder and poured me some water. Then she said, Drink this, and Ill get some water for your camels. So I drank the water, and she gave water to my camels.

dag: Amaa yinim ni kpi n-kpalim mɔɣu ŋɔ ni.
en: You will die here in this wilderness.

dag: Ribɛka daa mali tizɔdoo ka o yuli booni Leeban. Ka Leeban daa guui yi n-chaŋ nachin kpɛm maa sani kɔbiliga maa gbini.
en: She had a brother named Laban. She told him what the man had said to her. Laban was listening to her. And when he saw the ring and the bracelets on his sisters arms, he ran out to the well. There the man was, standing by the camels at the well.

dag: Ka Vuhim Dabisili dali maa daa gari, ka bakɔi piligu dali biɛɣu ti neerina, ka Mariama ŋun daa nyɛ Magdala tiŋbia la min o tɔɣima la daa chaŋ ni bɛ ti nya Yisa siliga maa.
en: The Sabbath was over, and it was almost daybreak on Sunday when Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went to see the tomb.

dag: Nyin ŋun bol amaŋa Yɛhudia ŋɔ, wula n-lee nyɛ li a sani? A niŋ Naawuni fukumsi zaligu naani ka nyuri bara a Naawuni milinsi zuɣu.
en: What about you? You call yourself a Jew; you depend on the Law and boast about God;.

dag: Di nyɛla Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ zaŋsim ni be tiŋgbɔn shɛl ni. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ yi Naawuni ŋɔ kul lihirila tiŋgbɔŋ maa viɛnyɛliŋga yuuni piligu ni hal ni di naabu ni.
en: Its a land that the LORD cares for: the LORDs eyes are on it constantly from the first of the year until the very end of the year.

dag: di saha nyin be a biɛhigu shee alizanda ni; ka wum, ka chɛ o taali ka niŋ din tuhi, ka ti sokam din simd o tuma kaman a ni mi din be o suhu ni shɛm, dama a kɔŋko m-mi din be daadam kam zaa suhu ni.
en: then listen from heaven where you live. Forgive, act, and repay each person according to all their conduct, because you know their hearts. You alone know the human heart.

dag: Hal n ni kul nyɛ ŋun ka taali ŋɔ zaa yoli mmaŋmaŋ nol ni yɛtɔɣa n-yɛn wuhi ni m mali taali. Hal n kul ka galimi maa zaa yoli ŋuna n-ni wuhi ni n kul bela galimi ni.
en: Even if I were innocent, God would prove me wrong.

dag: Yawɛ n-nyɛ n kpiɔŋ ŋuna n-lan nyɛ n yaa. Ŋuna n-nyɛ ŋun ti ma tiliginsim. Ŋuna n-nyɛ n Naawuni, ka n ni paɣir o. O nyɛla n yab Naawuni, ka n ni duh o pam.
en: The LORD is my strength and my power; he has become my salvation. This is my God, whom I will praise, the God of my ancestors, whom I will acclaim.

dag: amaa ka bɛ daa lihi paɣiba maa yɛligu maa kaman lahibal kpɛma, ka daa bi dihi li tabili. .
en: But the apostles did not believe what they said. It sounded like nonsense.

dag: Ka o daa zaŋ binzahi maa diba anu n-zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa nudirigu polo, ka zaŋ diba anu zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa nuzaa polo; ka zaŋ kɔniŋdi bin la mi zali nudirigu polo zaŋ lab wulimpuhili polo.
en: He put five carts on the south side of the Temple and five carts on the north side. He put the large tank in the southeast corner of the Temple.

dag: Taainim mini Sidɔnnim ni tin shɛŋa din zaa be Filistia tiŋgbɔŋ ni ŋɔ, bɔ ka yi lee bɔri ni yi niŋ ma maa? Yi bɔrimi ni yi bɔhi ma biɛri binshɛli zuɣu? Yi yi bɔrimi ni yi bɔhi ma biɛri, n ni chɛ ka yi tuma maa ŋmaligi lu yi zuɣu yomyom!.
en: Tyre! Sidon! All of you areas of Philistia! You are not important to me! Are you punishing me for something I did? You might think that you are punishing me, but I will soon punish you.

dag: Dinzuɣu n ni chɛ ka buɣim di Raba gooni n-saɣim bɛ ni me goma gili luɣ shɛŋa la zaa. Di saha tɔbu tuhibu tahigu ni ti tahiri dindali maa, ka zabili ti be kaman sanʒiɛɣu la.
en: So I will start a fire at the wall of Rabbah that will destroy the high towers of Rabbah. Troubles will come to them like a whirlwind into their country.

dag: Ka Sadusiinim shɛb bɛn yɛri ni kum ni neebu kani la daa ka Yisa sanna.
en: The Sadducees did not believe that people would rise to life after death. So some of them came to Jesus.

dag: Amaa ka namɔɣilisi maa daa chaŋ ti yɛli Napaɣ Vashiti naa ni yɛli shɛm maa, ka o daa zaɣisi ni o ku kana. Ka di zuɣu daa chɛ ka Naa maa suhu yiɣisi pam.
en: But when the eunuchs told Queen Vashti about the kings command, she refused to come. Then the king was very angry.

dag: Yinim bɛn nyɛ zoon jɛra ŋɔ, bina ayi ŋɔ dini n-lee gari di kpee: Salima maa bee Naawuni jɛmbu duu din chɛ ka salima maa be kasi maa?.
en: You foolish and blind people! Which is greater, the gold or the temple that makes the gold holy?.

dag: Paɣ bee doo yi leei jinwara bee bukpaha bɛn kum o. Bɛn labimi ba kuɣa. Bɛ ʒim yihibu taali ni ʒi bɛmaŋmaŋ zuɣu.
en: If someone, whether male or female, is a medium with the dead or a diviner, they must be executed. They will be stoned; their blood is on their own head.

dag: Zaŋ chaŋ dunia ŋɔ yɛlimuɣisira polo, n tɛhiya ni nir yi kpalim be kaman o ni pun be shɛm, di so.
en: Considering the present distress, I think it is better for a man to stay as he is.

dag: Nyama, zibisim ni ti be dunia ni, ka niriba be bumbɔn ni. Amaa Yawɛ ni chɛ ka o neesim neei gili ya, ka chɛ ka o jilima siɣi yi zuɣu na.
en: The earth and its people are covered with darkness, but the glory of the Lord is shining upon you.

dag: Di saha ka Sool daa tim tuumba ni bɛ chaŋ ti gbaai Dauda na. Ka bɛ daa paai ti nya anab bɔbili, ka bɛ tɔɣisir anabitali yɛtɔɣa, ka Samuɛl nyɛ bɛ zuɣulana, ka Naawuni Shia daa siɣi Sool tuumba maa zuɣu na ka bɛ gba tɔɣis anabitali yɛtɔɣa.
en: he sent messengers to arrest David. They saw a group of prophets in a prophetic frenzy, with Samuel standing there as their leader. Gods spirit came over Sauls messengers, and they also fell into a prophetic frenzy.

dag: Hɛzɛkia ni daa tum tuun shɛŋa pahi min o tuun suma, bɛ sab li niŋla Amɔz bia anabi Aizaia ni daa nya ʒii shɛli ka di be Juda mini Izraɛl nanim litaafi puuni la.
en: Everything else Hezekiah did while he was king, including how faithful he was to the Lord , is included in the records kept by Isaiah the prophet. These are written in The History of the Kings of Judah and Israel .

dag: Anabitali yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa Yawɛ ni daa zaŋ ti Malaki ni o yɛli Izraɛlnima.
en: A pronouncement. The LORDs word to Israel through Malachi.

dag: di saha ka o luɣiri ninsalinim tiba, ka kpahiri bɛ zuɣuri ni ka dabiɛm mali ba.
en: He makes them listen to what he says, and they are frightened at his warnings.

dag: Di saha ka sokam daa ŋmah o dabɔbili n-zaŋ li doli Abimilɛk ti sɔŋ baɣili bɛ sɔɣisili shee maa n-niŋ buɣim nyo li pa bɛ zuɣu, ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn zaa daa be di ni kpi. Bɛ kalinli daa nyɛla kaman dɔbba mini paɣiba tuhili.
en: Each one of the men cut off a bundle as well and followed Abimelech. They piled them up against the side rooms and set fire to the side rooms above them. So all the people in the Tower of Shechem died too, about one thousand men and women.

dag: Bɛ ni ti di yi buni, ka ʒe yi daguya. Bɛ ni ti daai yi goma luhi, ka wurim yi yil viɛla la. Bɛ ni ti va yi kuɣa mini yi taabɔdari ni yi taŋkpazim ti bahi kom ni.
en: The troops will steal your valuable possessions; they will break down your walls, and crush your expensive houses. Then the stones and wood and all the remains will be dumped into the sea.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ li zali sara maligu bimbini naŋgbaŋkuɣila la lɔŋni, ka di du m-paai sara maligu bimbini maa pirigili tariga zaŋ siɣi tiŋ polo.
en: Slide the mesh underneath the bottom edge of the altar and then extend the mesh halfway up to the middle of the altar.

dag: N ni zaŋ ko viɛlli mihi ya ka yi yi yi daɣiri zaa ni mini yi buɣ jɛmbo zaa ni.
en: I will sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be cleansed of all your pollution. I will cleanse you of all your idols.

dag: Di saha maa o yɛrimi, N ni lan labi m biɛr kurili shee. Ka o yi labina nti nya ka di nyɛ zaɣ kuŋ ka kolikoli m-mali viɛla.
en: it says, I will go back to the home I left. When it gets there and finds the place empty, clean, and neat.

dag: Amaa bɛ bi tɛhiri ni m mi bɛ tuumbiɛri maa. Ka pumpɔŋɔ bɛ tuumbiɛri maa gili ba niŋla sunsuuni, ka bɛ ʒe n tooni.
en: But they dont consider within their hearts that I remember all their wickedness. Now their deeds show who they are, right in front of my face.

dag: Bɛ yi ti niŋdi ya lala, yin chɛliya ka di niŋ ya nyaɣisim ka yi mali suhupiɛlli, dama yi laara galisiya alizanda ni. Lala ka bɛ daa pun niŋ anabinim bɛn daŋ yi tooni la gba alaka.
en: Be happy and glad, for a great reward is kept for you in heaven. This is how the prophets who lived before you were persecuted.

dag: Yɛtɔɣ viɛla ŋmanila shigbaŋ, di nyaɣisi niriba sani ka nyɛ din tiri niŋgbuŋ alaafee.
en: Kind words are like honey— they cheer you up and make you feel strong.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ biɛri ni bi zɔri Naawuni maa zuɣu, bɛ yɛla ku so, ka bɛ nyɛviya gba ku wɔɣa.
en: but it will not go well for the wicked. Their life is like a shadow and they will die young, because they do not obey God.

dag: Ka Jɔram daa ŋmaligi guui ka kuhi yɛli Ahazia, Nyaanyibo yɛtɔɣa m-bala.
en: It's treason, Ahaziah! Joram cried out, as he turned his chariot around and fled.

dag: O ŋmanila tammɛr so ŋun daa gbi tiŋa n-zal o yili tampiŋ zuɣu. Ka kom daa ti kpe n-gili yili maa ka bi tooi dam li la, dama di daa me n-tamla tampiŋ zuɣu.
en: is like someone who dug down deep and built a house on solid rock. When a flood came and the river rushed against the house, it was built so well that it didn't even shake.

dag: Imɛr daŋ ni: Hanani mini Zɛbadia.
en: From the descendants of Immer, these men: Hanani and Zebadiah.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti paai luɣ shɛli din yuli booni Goligɔta la .
en: They came to a place named Golgotha, which means Place of a Skull.

dag: Bɛmbɔŋɔ daa nyɛla Iso bidibisi , bɛna n-daa nyɛ bɛ nanima.
en: All these tribes were descended from Esau.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ m biɛhigu shee maa zali kaman n ni daa pun wuh a shɛm zoli zuɣu la.
en: Set up the Tent according to the plan that I showed you on the mountain.

dag: Di saha maa ka Pita daa yɛli Yisa, Nyama, ti chɛla ti yinsi ka dol a.
en: Peter said, Remember, we left everything to be your followers.

dag: Absalom ni daa boli ninvuɣ shɛb ka bɛ yi Jɛrusalɛm dol o chaŋ daa nyɛla ninvuɣ kɔbisiyi, bɛn daa kul chaŋla bɛ tariŋ chandi, ka bi mi o ni lo nia shɛli maa yɛla.
en: There were two hundred men who at Absalom's invitation had gone from Jerusalem with him; they knew nothing of the plot and went in all good faith.

dag: Naawuni, darigim bɛ tibili. Chɛ ka bɛmaŋmaŋ nia biɛri ŋmaligi di ba. Karim ba a sani, bɛ daalahichi din galisi pam la zuɣu; dama bɛ bi zan tuh a.
en: Condemn them, God! Let them fail by their own plans. Throw them out for their many sins because theyve rebelled against you.

dag: Saha shɛlikam bɛ daa yi ti kpuɣi Alikauli Adaka maa chana, Musa yɛrimi, Yawɛ, yiɣisim chɛ ka a dimnim wurim, ka chɛ ka ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn je a ŋmalig a tooni guui.
en: When the chest set out, Moses would say, Arise, LORD, let your enemies scatter, and those who hate you flee.

dag: Di zɔri dabiɛm. Naa ni tooi niŋ o ni bɔr shɛm, dinzuɣu o tooni zanibu yi ti mali barina, nyin zom yomyom.
en: The king can do anything he likes, so depart from his presence; don't stay in such a dangerous place.

dag: Nyama, n-nyɛ Ribɛka, zaŋm o kuli nti chɛ ka o leeg a dan bia maa paɣa kaman Yawɛ ni yɛli shɛm maa.
en: Take Rebekah with you; she can marry your master's son, just as the Lord has said.

dag: Ka o garigi yɛli ma, Dimbɔŋɔnim maa nyɛla din ʒe pɔhima anahi din yi Yawɛ ŋun su dunia ŋɔ zaa la sanna zaani.
en: The angel said, These are the four winds. They have just come from the Lord of the whole world.

dag: Dinzuɣu karimbaani n-nyɛ bɛ nyiŋgoya ni dolibi, ka duŋ taabo mi nyɛ bɛ kparibu.
en: And so they wear pride like a necklace and violence like a robe;.

dag: Dunia ŋɔ taŋkpaɣu ka Naawuni daa zaŋ nam tuuli Adam; ka Adam ŋun pah ayi maa mi nyɛ ŋun yi alizanda ni na.
en: The first human was from the earth made from dust; the second human is from heaven.

dag: O yuli yiko n-ti gbarigu ŋɔ alaafee maa; o yuli yɛda niŋbu zuɣu ka yi nya ka wum din niŋ ŋɔ. Yɛda niŋbu zaŋ chaŋ Yisa sani zuɣu n-chɛ ka gbarigu maa nya alaafee zaa yi zaa ninni ŋɔ.
en: This crippled man was healed because we trusted in Jesus. It was Jesus power that made him well. You can see this man, and you know him. He was made completely well because of faith in Jesus. You all saw it happen!.

dag: Ka n daa yɛli, Yinim Yaakubu zuliya zuɣulaannima ni yinim Izraɛl nanim ŋɔ, wummiya! Pa yinima n-di simdi ni yi mi zaligu ni wuhi ni shɛli tuhiya?.
en: Listen, you rulers of Israel! You are supposed to be concerned about justice.

dag: Ka o daa lan ŋmaligi bɔhi ba, Yi yi yurila bɛn yuri ya ko, paɣiri bɔ ka yi lee yɛn nya? Dama alahichinim gba yurila bɛn yuri ba.
en: If you love only those who love you, should you get any special praise for doing that? No, even sinners love those who love them!.

dag: Di sɔɣiya ka chɛ binnɛma zaa nina, di limsiya ka chɛ noombihi bɛn be zuɣusaa.
en: No living creature can see it, Not even a bird in flight.

dag: Di saha ka Ɛbɛdimɛlɛk ŋun nyɛ Itiɔpia nir maa daa yɛli Jɛrimia, Zaŋmi binchɛra maa niŋ gabisi maa min a bɔɣulɔna puuni. Ka Jɛrimia daa niŋ lala.
en: He told me to put the rags under my arms, so that the ropes wouldn't hurt me. I did this.

dag: Ka ŋun Haman daa nyu bara o daazichi min o ni mali bidibisi shɛm zuɣu bɛ sani. O daa lan nyu bara zaŋ chaŋ naa ni duh o n-zaŋ o zali zaashe shɛl ni la min o ni nyɛ ninvuɣ titali n-gar o tab bɛn nyɛ naa tuma zuɣulaannim la gba zuɣu.
en: Haman boasted to them about his great wealth and his many sons. He told all about how the king had honored him by promoting him over the officials and high royal workers.

dag: M paɣiri Yawɛ ŋun saɣisiri ma ŋɔ, ka n suhu ni tɛha mi wuhiri ma yuŋ.
en: I praise the Lord because he taught me well. Even at night he put his instructions deep inside my mind.

dag: Yinima ŋ-ŋubiri n niriba ka shiri bɛ niŋgbuŋ gbana, ka ŋmari bɛ kɔba ka ŋmahiŋmahi ba kaman nimdi din be ʒɛduɣubil ni bee kaman nimdi din be ʒɛduɣutitali ni la.
en: break their bones, cook it all in a pot, and gulp it down.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Naawuni ŋɔ chɛ ka n ni zaŋ n yɛtɔɣ shɛŋa suh o suhigu shɛli mini n ni suhi binshɛŋa ŋɔ zaa yɛla be o suhu ni wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ zaa; ka zo mani ŋun nyɛ o dabili ŋɔ min o niriba Izraɛlnim ŋɔ nambɔɣu kaman di ni simdi shɛm dabisili kam.
en: May the Lord our God remember at all times this prayer and these petitions I have made to him. May he always be merciful to the people of Israel and to their king, according to their daily needs.

dag: Ti tum a taali pam, ka bi dol a ni zali ti zaligu shɛl la zaŋ tabili zaligu shɛŋa din pahi n-nyɛ a ni daa zaŋ shɛŋa ti a dabili Musa la.
en: We have wronged you greatly. We havent kept the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances that you commanded your servant Moses.

dag: Yawɛ ni daa yɛli ma shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: Cham ti da jinjɛŋŋma piɛlli n-zaŋ so, amaa di zaŋ li tim kom ni.
en: This is what the Lord said to me: Jeremiah, go and buy a linen loincloth. Then put it around your waist. Dont let it get wet.

dag: Amaa ka Juda bituuli Ɛr maa daa nyɛ ninvuɣ biɛɣu Yawɛ sani, ka Yawɛ daa ku o.
en: Er's conduct was evil, and it displeased the Lord , so the Lord killed him.

dag: Dama o yɛliya, N sapashinnim zaa nyɛla nanima.
en: The king of Assyria says: My army commanders are kings!.

dag: Ka bɛ ʒiʒiinitab zaa daa sɔŋ ba n-ti ba anzinfa nɛma mini salima ni nɛma ni biŋkɔbiri ni binshɛŋa din mali bukaata m-pahi niriba suhu ni daa yu ka bɛ ti binshɛlikam zaa.
en: All their neighbors gave them many gifts. They gave them silver, gold, animals, and other expensive things. Their neighbors freely gave them all those things.

dag: Di kpalim biɛla ka yuŋ gari, ka di ku yuui ka biɛɣu neei. Chɛliya ka ti chɛ zibisim tuma, ka zaŋ bidibbina n-tuhi tɔbu neesim ni.
en: The night is nearly over, day is almost here. Let us stop doing the things that belong to the dark, and let us take up weapons for fighting in the light.

dag: Tin shɛŋa din gba daa be yɔɣu ni la n-daa nyɛ: Bɛtaraba mini Midin ni Sɛkaka.
en: The people of Judah were also given these towns in the desert: Beth Arabah, Middin, Secacah.

dag: O yi lo ni o kul doli n fukumsi zaligunim mini zaligu shɛŋa din pahi kaman o ni doli li shɛm zuŋɔ ŋɔ, n ni chɛ ka o nam mali yaa.
en: Solomon is obeying my laws and commands now. If he continues to obey my laws, I will make Solomons kingdom strong forever.

dag: Ka Naawuni daa yɛli Musa yaha, Mani n-nyɛ Yawɛ.
en: Then God said to Moses, I am the Lord .

dag: Ka Naawuni yiko tuuni ŋɔ daa niŋ niriba maa zaa alahiziba pam. Niriba maa ni daa na kul tɛhiri Yisa ni tumd alahiziba tuun shɛlikam zaa yɛla maa ka o daa yɛl o nyaandoliba.
en: All the people were amazed at the great power of God. The people were still amazed about all the things Jesus did. He said to his followers.

dag: Wuntizɔriba bɛn ka galimi chɛmi ka bɛ soya tuhi, amaa ninvuɣ biɛri maŋmaŋ ninvuɣ biɛtali n-nyɛ din luhiri ba.
en: Doing right makes life better for those who are good, but the wicked are destroyed by their own wicked ways.

dag: Paɣimiy o, o yiko tumtumsa zuɣu. Paɣimiy o, o ni galisi pam zuɣu.
en: Praise him for the great things he does! Praise him for all his greatness!.

dag: Yuun shɛli din pahir anahi puuni Ziv gol ni ka bɛ daa zali Naawuni jɛmbu duu maa tanzaa.
en: Solomon laid the foundation of the LORDs temple in the fourth year in the month of Ziv.

dag: Bɛ ni daa ti ku a dabili Stiivin la, n gba daa be bɛ ni ka yu o kubu maa, ka daa gbib bɛn ku o maa binyɛra.
en: The people also know that I was there when Stephen, your witness, was killed. I stood there and agreed that they should kill him. I even held the coats of the men who were killing him.

dag: Ka salo maa ni niriba pam daa zaŋ bɛ binyɛra n-teeri sɔŋdi sol ni, ka bɛ ni shɛb mi ŋahiri tiwula din mali vari sɔŋdi soli maa ni.
en: Many people spread clothes in the road, while others put down branches which they had cut from trees.

dag: Ka wuntaŋ ni mini yuŋ biɛɣ pihinahi maa naabu dali daa ti paai ka Yawɛ zaŋ kuɣ parilana ayi din daa nyɛ alikauli kuɣ parilana maa ti ma.
en: At the end of those forty days and nights, the LORD gave me the two stone tablets—the covenant tablets.

dag: n-zaŋ hal ni Bɛrɔta ni Sibiraim . N-zaŋ hal ni Hazɛrihatikɔn fɔntiŋ din be Hauran tintariga la.
en: Berothah, Sibraim , and Hazer-hatticon .

dag: Ninvuɣ shɛb bɛn doli fukumsi zaligunim ni be, ka bɛn lihi ʒiɛm li ni kpi.
en: Obey the Lord's teachings and you will live— disobey and you will die.

dag: Bɛ ŋmanila yuri; bɛ guurimi kaman bɛ ni bari wɔr shɛb tuhiri tɔbu la.
en: They look like horses and charge like cavalry.

dag: Naawuni daa tum alahiziba tuun gahinda n-chɛ ka yiko be Pool nuhi ni.
en: God used Paul to do some very special miracles.

dag: Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ yɛliya: Dɔr bɔ n-lee be a suhu ni ka a tum dimbɔŋɔ zaa maa, din nyɛ vi kalinsi pagɔrisigu tuma ŋɔ?.
en: You are so weak. You let all those men cause you to sin. You acted just like a prostitute who wants to be the one in control. This is what the Lord GOD said.

dag: Mani n-nam neesim mini zibisim, mani n-tahiri alibarika na, ka lan tahiri tɔbu na. Man Yawɛ n-niŋdi dimbɔŋɔnim zaa.
en: I made the light and the darkness. I bring peace, and I cause trouble. I, the Lord , do all these things.

dag: Jɔn saha zaŋ kana zuŋɔ, bɛn suhuri ye alizanda nam ni kpɛbu zuɣu kul kabirimi chani ni bɛ ti zaŋ kpiɔŋ kpe di ni.
en: From the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven is violently attacked as violent people seize it.

dag: Ka yi ti zaŋ sara maligu bimbin shɛli zuɣu bɛ ni nyɔri sara maligu buɣim la zali Naawuni biɛhigu shee din nyɛ Naawuni chirigibu min o niriba laɣiŋgu suɣili maa dunol la tooni.
en: Put in front of the Tent the altar for burning offerings.

dag: M puhiri Andurɔnikus mini Junias bɛn nyɛ n zuliya mini n sarikakpɛritab la. Bɛ nyɛla bɛn mali jilima tuumba ni, ka nyɛ bɛn daŋ ma Masia yɛda niŋbu.
en: Greetings also to Andronicus and Junia, fellow Jews who were in prison with me; they are well known among the apostles, and they became Christians before I did.

dag: Uzi bidibiga n-daa nyɛ: Izirahia, ka Izirahia bidibisi daa nyɛ: Maikil mini Obadia ni Joɛl ni Ishia, bɛ daa nyɛla bɛ niriba anu; bɛ zaa daa nyɛla zuɣulaannima.
en: Uzzi had one son, Izrahiah. Izrahiah and his four sons, Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, were all heads of families.

dag: ka di nyɛla yi ni mali tahima shɛli alizanda ni la zuɣu. Yi daa pun wum dimbɔŋɔ yɛla la yɛlimaŋli lahibal suŋ din daa ka yi sanna la ni.
en: Your faith and love continue because you know what is waiting for you in heaven—the hope you have had since you first heard the true message, the Good News.

dag: Bɛn daa niŋ Yisa yɛda maa zaa daa malila suhu yini ni tɛhi yini, ka bɛ ni so daa bi yɛli ni o ni su shɛli nyɛla o kɔŋko dini, amaa bɛ zaa daa laɣim sula bɛ ni mali binshɛɣukam zaa.
en: The group of followers all felt the same way about everything. None of them claimed that their possessions were their own, and they shared everything they had with each other.

dag: Amaa ninvuɣ biɛri ni bi zɔri Naawuni maa zuɣu, bɛ yɛla ku so, ka bɛ nyɛviya gba ku wɔɣa.
en: Evil people dont respect God, so they will not get good things or live long lives. Their lives will not be like the shadows that become longer and longer as the sun goes down.

dag: Nyama, Naawuni ku zaɣisi ninvuɣ so ŋun ka galimi bee n-deei tuumbiɛrilana.
en: Surely God wont reject integrity, wont strengthen the hand of the wicked.

dag: ka zaŋ o ni mali yiko wuhiri shihir shɛŋa tuuli biŋkɔbigu la tooni maa n-yɔhindi bɛn be dunia ŋɔ ni; ka zali niriba ni bɛ malimi binnani ŋ-ŋmahindi biŋkɔb so ŋun daa mali takɔb daŋa ka tib kpaŋ la.
en: This second beast fooled the people living on earth by using the miracles that he had been given the power to do for the first beast. He ordered people to make an idol to honor the first beast, the one that was wounded by the sword but did not die.

dag: Ka Sɛrafinim daa ʒe o zuɣusaa polo. Bɛ zaa yinoyino daa malila kpiŋkpama ayɔbuyɔbu. Bɛ daa zaŋla diba ayiyi pɔb bɛ nina, ka zaŋ diba ayiyi pɔb bɛ napɔnvari, ka zaŋ diba ayiyi yiɣira.
en: Seraph angels stood around him. Each angel had six wings. They used two wings to cover their faces, two wings to cover their bodies, and two wings to fly.

dag: Bɛ daa mali bɛ ni shɛb ansarisi ka fiɛb ba, ka daa ga shɛb zoligɔnima n-zaŋ ba kpɛhi duu.
en: But others experienced public shame by being taunted and whipped; they were even put in chains and in prison.

dag: Ka Pita daa yiɣisi zo n-chaŋ siliga maa gbini nti kurim lihi di puuni n-nya ka kahiŋga kɔŋko n-doya; ka o ŋmaligi kuna, ka bɔhir o suhu din niŋ maa zuɣu.
en: But Peter ran to the tomb. And when he stooped down and looked in, he saw only the burial clothes. Then he returned, wondering what had happened.

dag: Dinzuɣu Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ Tɔbbihi Naa, ka nyɛ Izraɛlnim Naawuni ŋɔ ni yɛli shɛm m-bɔŋɔ: N yɛn zaŋla yabiga nyuhi niriba ŋɔ, ka zaŋ lɔɣu ni be ko shɛl ni nyuhi ba.
en: So then, listen to what I, the Lord Almighty, the God of Israel, will do: I will give my people bitter plants to eat and poison to drink.

dag: Bɛ daa yi tuhi tɔbu ka di nɛma shɛŋa, bɛ piirila di ni shɛli n-zaŋ li mali Yawɛ jɛmbu duu maa.
en: They took some of the loot they captured in battle and dedicated it for use in the Temple.

dag: Bɛ ninani ni daa be shɛm m-bala. Bɛ kpiŋkpama daa yirigila zuɣusaa. Binneen yino kam daa malila kpiŋkpama ayiyi, ka di zaɣ yini chaŋ ti shih o kpee dini. Ka kpiŋkpama ayi din la pɔbi bɛ niŋgbuna.
en: The pairs of wings that stretched out overhead touched each other, while the other pairs covered their bodies.

dag: Ka Naa Dauda daa nyɛ Jɛsi bia, ka Jɛsi nyɛ Obɛd bia, ka Obɛd nyɛ Bɔaz bia, ka Bɔaz nyɛ Sala bia, ka Sala mi nyɛ Nashɔn bia.
en: Jesse, Obed, Boaz, Salmon, Nahshon;.

dag: Amaa doo maa yi mali bidibiga ŋun nya o ba ni tum alahichi shɛŋa zaa, ka dabiɛm gbaag o, ka ŋun bi tum lala.
en: Now suppose this second man has a son. He sees all the sins his father practiced, but does not follow his example.

dag: Bɛn daa tumdi di tuma maa mini bɛ bidibisi yuya m-bɔŋɔ: Kɔhat daŋ ni niriba n-daa nyɛ: Hɛman ŋun daa nyɛ yiliyiina, ka nyɛ Joɛl bia la, Joɛl daa nyɛla Samuɛl bia.
en: These are the names of the men and their sons who served with music: The descendants from the Kohath family were Heman the singer who was Joels son; Joel was Samuels son;.

dag: Ka bɛ daa sab gbana ti Yɛhudianim zaa bɛn daa be Naa Ahasivɛrɔs tiŋgbɔŋ maa yaɣa kɔbiga ni pisinaayopɔin la zaa ni. Gbaŋ maa puuni yɛtɔɣa daa nyɛla Yɛhudianim suhudoo mini yɛlimaŋli puhigu.
en: Letters conveying good wishes and words of friendship were sent to all the Jews throughout the one hundred twenty-seven provinces in the kingdom of Ahasuerus.

dag: Ka daliri din chɛ ka o daa leei Naa Sulemaana dim maa m-bɔŋɔ: Sulemaana daa mɛla Millo gooni ŋari foliŋga din daa be o ba Dauda tiŋ la ni la.
en: This is the story about how Jeroboam turned against the king. Solomon was building the Millo and repairing the wall around the city of David, his father.

dag: Ka daa yɛli ba ni bɛ deem kom baptaizibu Yisa Masia yuli zuɣu. Ka bɛ daa balim Pita ni o kpalimmi bɛ sani niŋ daba ayi.
en: So he ordered them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to stay with them for a few days.

dag: Bɛ daa nyɛla Yawɛ ni zaŋ shɛb ni o buɣisi Izraɛlnim nya bɛ ni dol o zaligu shɛŋa o ni daa zaŋ ti Musa ka o ti bɛ yaannim la bee bɛ ku dol li.
en: They were to be a test for Israel, to find out whether or not the Israelites would obey the commands that the Lord had given their ancestors through Moses.

dag: A daa zaɣisi a niriba bɛn nyɛ Yaakubu zuliya la! Yɛlimaŋli, bɛ malila laasabuniŋdiba bɛn yi wulimpuhili polo na, ka mali baɣisi kaman Filisitianim la, ka zaŋ bɛ noli ti naai tinzunnima.
en: Family of Jacob, you have abandoned your people. This is clear because they have been filled with bad influences from the East, and now your people try to tell the future like the Philistines. They have completely accepted those strange ideas.

dag: Dama nimaani ka saria karibu ʒiishɛhi be, saria karibu ʒiishɛhi din nyɛ Dauda zuliya dini.
en: David's royal throne is here where justice rules.

dag: Bɛ daa guhiri ma mi kaman bɛ ni guhiri saa shɛm la. Bɛ suhuri daa kul yɛla n zuɣu kaman niriba suhuri ni ye siɣili saa zuɣu shɛm la.
en: everyone welcomed them just as farmers welcome rain in spring.

dag: Ka Yisa daa lan yɛli ba, Ŋahili maa gbinni m-bɔŋɔ: Bimbira maa nyɛla Naawuni yɛligu.
en: The parable means this: The seed is Gods word.

dag: Gbahim ŋɔri mini bɛ bihi bɛn saɣindi ti wain tihi puri la. Dama ti wain tihi maa daari pum.
en: Catch the foxes, the little foxes, before they ruin our vineyard in bloom.

dag: Ka paɣ maa suh o ni o kari alizin biɛɣu maa o bia maa zuɣu bahi. Bɛ daa dɔɣ paɣ maa la Siria tiŋgbɔŋ ni. Ka o lee nyɛ Fɔnisia tiŋbia, ka nyɛ ŋun wumdi Giriikili.
en: The woman was a Gentile, born in the region of Phoenicia in Syria. She begged Jesus to drive the demon out of her daughter.

dag: Bɛ diri birapu ka kuri niriba a ni. Yi paŋdi niriba binyara ka niŋdi ba nyɔri, ka pahiri yi nɛma daa n-fari yi taba nyari buni ka tam n yɛla. Yawɛ ŋun nyɛ ti Duuma ŋɔ n-yɛli lala maa.
en: In you they take bribes to shed blood. You collect interest and fees, you profit by extorting your neighbor, and you neglect even me! This is what the LORD God says.

dag: Ka Yawɛ daa yɛli Aduna, Cham tiŋgban nɛli ni ti tuhi Musa soli. Ka o daa chaŋ ti tuh o soli Naawuni zol la gbini m-mɔɣis o kpariŋ.
en: The Lord had spoken to Aaron and told him, Go out into the desert and meet Moses. So Aaron went and met Moses at the Mountain of God. He saw Moses and kissed him.

dag: Dinzuɣu kul suhimiya Naawuni tiri ma din ni chɛ ka n tooi tɔɣisiri Naawuni yɛligu n-kahigiri di gbinni wuhiri kaman di ni simdi ni n kahigiri li wuhiri shɛm.
en: Please pray that I will make the message as clear as possible.

dag: Ka Manɔa daa yɛl o paɣa, Ti nini nya Naawuni, dinzuɣu biɛhiŋ kani, ti ni kpi.
en: Manoah said, We have seen an angel. Now we're going to die.

dag: N ni lan kpaŋsi bɛ ʒiɛyimtali n sani. N ni yuri ba ni n suhu zaa, dama n suhuyiɣisili zaŋ chaŋ bɛ sani maaya.
en: Israel, you have rejected me, but my anger is gone; I will heal you and love you without limit.

dag: Ninvuɣ pia n-yi kpalim be yili yin ni, bɛ ni kpi.
en: If ten people remain in one house, then they will die.

dag: Amaa Naawuni daa zo o niriba maa nambɔɣu, ka chɛ bɛ daalahichi maa, ka bi chɛ ka bɛ bahi yoli. O gbaar omaŋa o sujee puuni waawaayili, ka bi chɛ ka o suhuyiɣisili dii chani tooni.
en: But God was merciful to his people. He forgave their sin and did not destroy them. Many times he held back his anger and restrained his fury.

dag: M mini m Ba maa nyɛla zaɣ yini.
en: I and the Father are one.

dag: Zoya ni gili Jɛrusalɛm shɛm la, lala ka Yawɛ gil o niriba, pumpɔŋɔ hal ni sahakam.
en: Like the mountains that surround Jerusalem, the Lord surrounds and protects his people now and forever.

dag: Shɛb yɛra, Pool gbana puuni yɛtɔɣa nyɛla yɛl kpɛma ni din mali yiko, amaa o yi ti be ti sani o niŋgbuŋ biɛhigu ni, o nyɛla ninvuɣ gbariŋ ka o yɛtɔɣa bi ŋmani shɛli.
en: I know what some people are saying: His letters are severe and powerful, but in person he is weak and his speech is worth nothing.
